English: Notice: Kenya Gazette opens voter registration centres in Kajiado County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linafungua vituo vya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kajiado County mwezi huu wa Juni.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Kenya Gazette waxay billaabaneysaa xarumaha diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee degmada Kajiado bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Gazette chako timo chenro mar ndiko joma biro yiero e county mar Kajiado e dwe mar Jun.

English: Taita Taveta County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Taita Taveta: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2024
Somali: Degmada Taita Taveta: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Taita Taveta: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar Septemba 2024

English: The H.E will this afternoon join key world leaders in the Gavi Global Vaccine Summit 2020, hosted by UK Prime Minister, Rt. Hon Boris Johnson.
Kiswahili: The HE ataungana na viongozi wakuu wa dunia leo alasiri katika Mkutano wa kilele wa chanjo ya Gavi Global 2020, ulioandaliwa na Waziri Mkuu wa Uingereza, Rt. Mhe Boris Johnson.
Somali: Mudane Boris Johnson ayaa galabta ku biiri doona hoggaamiyeyaasha muhiimka ah ee adduunka ee ka qayb galaya Shir-madaxeedka Tallaalka Adduunka ee Gavi 2020, oo uu martigelinayo Ra'iisul Wasaaraha UK, Rt. Hon.
Dholuo: H.E biro riwre gi jotelo madongo mag piny mangima e odiechieng’ ma kawuono e chokruok mar piny mangima mar Gavi mar 2020, ma biro bedo gi Jatend Pinyruoth, Rt. Boris Jonson.

English: State Department for Basic Education reminds needy students in Laikipia County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kwamba ufadhili wa masomo kwa maombi ya wanafunzi wenye uhitaji utafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Laikipia in deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay codsiyada ardayda baahan ay dhowaan dhammaadaan.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education oparo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e County mar Laikipia ni tuke mag somo ma konyo jopuonjre ma nigi chan biro rumo machiegni.

English: KEPHIS informs coffee farmers in Kitui County of new market linkage opportunities this October.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawafahamisha wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Oktoba hii.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Kitui fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KEPHIS chiwo ripot ne jopur mag chai e County mar Kitui kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Ministry of Education reminds schools in Homa Bay County to strengthen anti-bullying measures this June.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuimarisha hatua za kupambana na uonevu Juni hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay dugsiyada gobolka Homa Bay ku xasuusineysaa inay xoojiyaan tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibaatada bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok oparo ne skunde man Homa Bay County mondo omed jiwo yore mag geng'o nindruok e dwe mar Jun.

English: EACC reminds voters in Narok County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Narok kuwa na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya usajili wa wapiga Kura.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha gobolka Narok inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor diiwaangelinta codbixisayaasha.
Dholuo: EACC parone jogweng' Narok mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero ka pok gidonj e register mar joma oyiero.

English: TVET invites youth in Uasin Gishu County to enroll for tailoring and design training this January.
Kiswahili: TVET inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni Januari hii.
Somali: TVET waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Uasin Gishu inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka tailoring iyo naqshadeynta bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: TVET gwelo rowere manie Uasin Gishu County mondo odonjre e tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko e dwe mar Januar.

English: COMESA urges rice growers in Vihiga County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawataka wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda bariiska ee degmada Vihiga inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: COMESA ojiwo jopur ma pidho kodhi e County mar Vihiga mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: Criminals target livestock markets. Trade only in official markets, verify identities, and keep transaction records.
Kiswahili: Wahalifu hulenga masoko ya mifugo. Fanya biashara katika masoko rasmi pekee, thibitisha utambulisho, na uweke rekodi za miamala.
Somali: Dambiilayaashu waxay bartilmaameedsadaan suuqyada xoolaha. Ganacsi kaliya suuqyada rasmiga ah, xaqiiji aqoonsiga, oo haysta diiwaanada macaamilka.
Dholuo: Jomahundu ohero choko jamni, ouso jamni, kendo timo ohala mana e choko jamni, ka gitiyo gi weche mag ohala.

English: FAO reminds livestock keepers in Laikipia County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa za kuponda ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha Laikipia County inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: FAO parone jopur mag jamni e county mar Laikipia mondo opidhgi gi tuoche e kuonde moketi mag chamo jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: Kenya Key Message Update: High fuel and food prices are limiting household purchasing power, May 2023
Kiswahili: Sasisho la Ujumbe Muhimu wa Kenya: Bei ya juu ya mafuta na vyakula inapunguza uwezo wa kununua wa kaya, Mei 2023
Somali: Cusbooneysiinta Fariinta Muhiimka ah ee Kenya: Qiimaha shidaalka iyo cuntada oo sarreeya ayaa xaddidaya awoodda wax iibsiga ee qoysaska, Maajo 2023
Dholuo: Oda maduong' mar piny Kenya: Nengo mamalo mar mafuta kod chiemo geng'o teko mar nyiewo mar udi, dwe mar abich higa mar 2023

English: KEPHIS advises horticultural produce producers in Nairobi County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawashauri wazalishaji wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha wax soo saarka beeraha ee degmada Nairobi inay wax soo saarkooda ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KEPHIS nyiso jopur ma loso puothe mag puothe e County mar Nairobi ni gius puothegi mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo puothego kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds parents in Tana River County that free day secondary education registration is open this August.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Tana River kwamba usajili wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo umefunguliwa Agosti hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu xasuusinayaa waalidiinta degmada Tana River in diiwaangelinta dugsiga dhexe ee bilaashka ah ay furan tahay bisha August.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne jonyuol manie Tana River County ni somo mar sekondari mar odiechieng' maonge chudo osechakore e dwe mar Agost.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Bungoma County about the importance of hypertension awareness for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuhusu umuhimu wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMRI waxay dadweynaha degmada Bungoma ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay wacyiga cadaadiska sare ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMRI parone ji duto e County mar Bungoma kuom ber mar miyo ji ong'e ni tuwo mar hypertension en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Signs of Menta Illness: Quarrelsome, weakness, blindness and sudden sickness and, trembling body, the brain is sick
Kiswahili: Dalili za Ugonjwa wa Akili: ugomvi, udhaifu, upofu na ugonjwa wa ghafula na, mwili wenye kutetemeka, ubongo ni mgonjwa
Somali: Calaamadaha cudurka maskaxda: Dagaal, daciifnimo, indho la'aan iyo xanuun degdeg ah iyo, jir gariiraya, maskaxdu waa xanuunsan tahay
Dholuo: Ranyisi mag tuoche mag obwongo: bedo gi ywaruok, bedo gi nyawo, bedo muofu, bedo matuwo apoya, kod bedo gi tuoche e obwongo

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development restricts movement of dairy cows in Homa Bay County due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inazuia harakati za ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Newcastle.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da caanaha ee Gobolka Homa Bay sababo la xiriira cudurka Newcastle.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok makwayo e Homa Bay County nikech tuo mar Newcastle.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens voter education centres in Kirinyaga County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu furayaa xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee Gobolka Kirinyaga bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties ochako tiego josiasa e boma mar Kirinyaga e dwe mar Januar.

English: IEBC reminds the public in Taita-Taveta County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: IEBC inakumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Taita-Taveta in sheegashada khiyaamooyinka iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: IEBC paronwa ji duto e Taita-Taveta County ni lando miriambo mag yuto en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: Kilifi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for January 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kilifi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Januari 2024
Somali: Degmada Kilifi: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Janaayo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kilifi: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar achiel higa mar 2024

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations issues a cybersecurity alert on mobile money scams affecting residents of Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya kashfa za pesa za rununu zinazoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka Cilmi baarista dambiyada ayaa soo saaray digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaanooyinka lacagta mobile ee saameynaya dadka deggan degmada Mombasa.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations ogolo siem e wi weche mag cybersecurity e wi timbe mag wuondruok ma timore ne joma odak e county mar Mombasa.

English: Council of Governors reminds residents of Embu County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kwamba upatikanaji wa utunzaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay xasuusinayaan dadka deggan degmada Embu in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch oparo ne jogweng' mar Embu County ni koro nyalo bedo mayot yudo barua mar nyuol kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: The High Court has dismissed a petition against the Nzoia Sugar lease allowing West Kenya Sugar to proceed with its Ksh 5 7 billion investment
Kiswahili: Mahakama kuu imetupilia mbali ombi la kupinga ukodishaji wa Nzoia Sugar kuruhusu West Kenya Sugar kuendelea na uwekezaji wake wa Ksh 5 7 bilioni.
Somali: Maxkamadda sare ayaa diiday codsi ka dhan ah heshiiska kirada sonkorta Nzoia oo u oggolaanaya Galbeedka Kenya Sonkorta inay sii wado maalgashiga Ksh 5.7 bilyan
Dholuo: Kot Maduong ' osewito kwayo moro ma ne ogol e kind joma ne dwaro ng'ado mar Nzoia Sugar lease ma ne omiyo West Kenya Sugar thuolo mar dhi nyime gi tich mar keto pesane mar Ksh 5 7 bilion

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on residents of Mandera County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of border security.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawaomba wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ugu baaqay dadka deggan degmada Mandera inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga waxqabadka aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah si ay u taageeraan amniga xuduudda.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations okwayo jogweng'o mag Mandera County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma rito tong'o ni gitimo gik maok kare.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Baringo County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandaoni wa kaunti ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' Baringo County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county mar konyo e loso bajet.

English: Notice: IEBC opens a new motor vehicle mechanics programme at the vocational centre in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inafungua programu mpya ya ufundi wa magari katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan farsamada gawaarida gawaari ee xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IEBC chako chenro manyien mar loso mtokni mag mtoka e kar tiegruok e taon mar Siaya.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds youth in Mandera County that HELB funding is available for welding and fabrication training.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka ayaa xasuusinaya dhalinyarada degmada Mandera in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne rowere man Mandera County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing.

English: Notice: NTSA conducts a community briefing on border security in Marsabit County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha degmada Marsabit bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Riwruok mar National Security Agency (NTSA) biro timo romo mar nono weche motudore gi rito tong' mar gweng' mar Marsabit e dwe mar Desemba.

English: NPS reminds the public in Kwale County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NPS inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kwale inay ka feejignaadaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: NPS parone ji duto e county mar Kwale mondo omed bedo motang' ne loso kuwe e piny.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Kericho County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan khiyaamooyinka ay gacan ka geystaan ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service parone jogweng' Kericho County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar wuondruok konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: KUCCPS urges parents and teachers in Nairobi County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Nairobi inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Nairobi mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto.

English: Kenya Medical Association announces eye and dental camps for residents of Nakuru County starting this March.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatangaza kambi za macho na meno kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kuanzia Machi hii.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu ku dhawaaqay in xeryaha indhaha iyo ilkaha loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Nakuru ay bilaaban doonaan bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association ogolo kambi mag thieth mag wang' kod lak mag lakteche ne joma odak e gweng' mar Nakuru kochakore dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: FAO will conduct a fertiliser application workshop for farmers in Kisumu County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itafanya warsha ya maombi ya mbolea kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan isticmaalka bacriminta beeraleyda ee degmada Kisumu bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Nonro: FAO biro timo chokruok mar tiyo gi yien mag yien ne jopur e gweng' mar Kisumu e dwe mar April.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges sheep farmers in Kajiado County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported rabies cases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inahimiza wafugaji wa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya kichaa cha mbwa vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda idaha ee degmada Kajiado inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska xanaaqa la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur mag rombe e Kajiado County mondo oland le matuwo e ofise mar thieth mar dhok man machiegni kodgi bang' yudo weche mag rabies.

English: NPS reminds mobile money users in Kiambu County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa pesa ya rununu.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kiambu inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: NPS paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mobil e County mar Kiambu mondo onyis ni giketo pachgi kuom kwayo mag pesa e yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo kik gitim timbe mag mibadhi.

English: Ministry of Health encourages residents of Busia County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay la xiriiraan lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Busia mondo kik gisandgi gi ling'ling' kendo mondo giwuo gi jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds the public in Wajir County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this June.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba ushiriki katika mashauriano ya sera za umma unakaribishwa mwezi Juni huu.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) ayaa xasuusinaya shacabka degmada Wajir in la soo dhaweynayo talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone ji duto e county mar Wajir ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mag oganda e dwe mar Jun.

English: Public notice: CDC will host a free hand hygiene outreach in Mombasa County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: CDC itakuwa mwenyeji wa uhamasishaji wa bure wa usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: CDC waxay martigelin doontaa dhaqdhaqaaqa nadaafadda gacmaha ee bilaashka ah ee gobolka Mombasa bisha November.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuoche (CDC) biro timo kampen mar rito ler mar lwete e boma mar Mombasa e dwe mar Novemba.

English: E-Citizen warns public officers in Machakos County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Machakos dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya madaraka.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Machakos inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: E-Citizen chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e kaunti mar Machakos ni kik giti marach gi migepegi.

English: Kenya Dairy Board urges sheep farmers in Homa Bay County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawataka wafugaji wa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa ngozi vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda idaha ee gobolka Homa Bay inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo ka dib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur ma pidho rombe e Homa Bay County mondo ogeng'e legi e kuonde moyier mag ywayo rombe bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag dhoot.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Bomet County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Bomet juu ya umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMRI waxay dadka degmada Bomet ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay nadaafadda saxda ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMRI paronwa ji duto e County mar Bomet kuom ber mar rito ler mar ngima mar joot.

English: UNDP Kenya and NCTC lead PREVENT to strengthen community resilience.
Kiswahili: UNDP Kenya na NCTC huongoza PREVENT kuimarisha uthabiti wa jumuiya.
Somali: UNDP Kenya iyo NCTC waxay hogaamiyaan PREVENT si loo xoojiyo adkeysiga bulshada.
Dholuo: UNDP Kenya kod NCTC otelo ne PREVENT e jiwo teko mar oganda.

English: To improve soil fertility and get a source of firewood, plant Gliricidia sepium trees (grown from seed or stem cuttings) in alley rows alongside your crops - space trees 100cm apart within rows, with 5 metres between rows, to allow enough sunlight and easy pruning and harvesting.
Kiswahili: Ili kuboresha rutuba ya udongo na kupata chanzo cha kuni, panda miti ya sepium ya Gliricidia (iliyopandwa kutoka kwa vipandikizi vya mbegu au shina) katika safu za uchochoro kando ya mazao yako - weka miti 100cm mbali ndani ya safu, na mita 5 kati ya safu, ili kuruhusu mwanga wa jua wa kutosha na kupogoa na kuvuna kwa urahisi.
Somali: Si loo hagaajiyo dhalashada ciidda loona helo isha qoryaha, ku beero Gliricidia sepium geedo (oo laga soo saaray abuurka ama geedo lakabka ah) safka jidadka ah ee dhirtaada - geedo meel u dhexeeya 100cm safka, 5 mitir safka u dhexeeya, si loo oggolaado iftiin qorrax ku filan iyo si fudud loo gooyo iyo goosashada.
Dholuo: Mondo omi lowo obed maber kendo mondo yien obed mang'eny, pidhi yiende mag Gliricidia sepium (ma ipidho gi kodhi kata yiende ma ipidho) e nderni mag udi machiegni gi puothegi - yiende ma nigi tong' 100 cm e kindgi, kendo ma nigi mita 5 e kind tong'go, mondo chieng' orieny kendo obed mayot tong'o kendo keyo.

English: Announcing  meeting to create strategy for postâ€‘2025 nutrition programs.
Kiswahili: Kutangaza mkutano wa kuunda mkakati wa mipango ya lishe baada ya 2025.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqista kulan si loo abuuro istaraatiijiyad loogu talagalay barnaamijyada nafaqada kadib 2025.
Dholuo: Olando romo mar loso chenro mar chenro mag chiemo ma bang' higa mar 2025.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda gobolka ee Gobolka Garissa.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Huduma Kenya biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e county mar Garissa.

English: Due to the effects of Covid 19 farmers are encouraged to focus on drought resistant crops like sorghum and millet for better resilience in production
Kiswahili: Kutokana na athari za Covid-19 wakulima wanahimizwa kuzingatia mazao yanayostahimili ukame kama vile mtama na mtama ili kustahimili vyema uzalishaji.
Somali: Sababo la xiriira saameynta Covid 19, beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay diiradda saaraan dalagyada u adkeysan abaaraha sida sorghum iyo millet si ay u helaan adkeysi wanaagsan oo wax-soo-saarka ah
Dholuo: Nikech masiche mag Covid-19, jopur jiwo mondo oket pachgi kuom cham ma nyalo geng'o oro kaka sorghum kod millet mondo omi gibed gi nyalo mar timo dongruok e tijgi mar loso.

English: Universities Fund advises students in Mombasa County to collect materials from the county education office to access revision guides.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kukusanya vifaa kutoka kwa ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata miongozo ya marekebisho.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ardayda degmada Mombasa kula talinayaa inay ka soo ururiyaan waxyaabo xafiiska waxbarashada degmada si ay u helaan hagaha dib u eegista.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund nyiso jopuonjre e county mar Mombasa mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar tiegruok mar county mondo giyud weche ma nyalo konyogi.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties invites residents of Embu County to attend the public participation forum regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa huwaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Embu inay ka qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties ogwelo jogweng' Embu County mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges residents of Laikipia County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama wakati wa umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaala aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo la adeegsanayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo jogweng' mar Laikipia County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkande mag sirkal e wi gik ma ne timore e alwora mar tong'gi nikech ji osebedo ka chiwo siem chon ne joma odak e alworano.

English: Makueni County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Makueni: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2022
Somali: Degmada Makueni: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Makueni: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar 2022

English: Notice: HELB opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay furaysaa codsiyada deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan ardayda wax barata ee degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: HELB oyawo kwayo mag somo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e gweng' mar Kericho.

English: TSC mandates digital skills training for all teachers at Ksh 2,500.
Kiswahili: TSC inaamuru mafunzo ya ujuzi wa dijiti kwa walimu wote kwa Ksh 2,500.
Somali: TSC waxay dalbanaysaa tababarka xirfadaha dhijitaalka ah dhammaan macalimiinta Ksh 2,500.
Dholuo: TSC dwaro tiego jopuonj duto e yore mag digital e kind Ksh 2,500.

English: TSC advises students in Turkana County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: TSC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Turkana kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kufikia maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza dijitali.
Somali: TSC waxay ardayda degmada Turkana kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga deeqda waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan waxyaabaha barashada dijitaalka ah ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo jopuonjre e County mar Turkana mondo okonygi kokalo kuom websait mar somo ma yudore e Intanet mondo giyud thuolo mar somo e yor digital.

English: Kenya Drought - DREF Final Report (MDRKE065)
Kiswahili: Ukame wa Kenya - Ripoti ya Mwisho ya DREF (MDRKE065)
Somali: Abaarta Kenya - Warbixinta kama dambaysta ah ee DREF (MDRKE065)
Dholuo: Ochruok e piny Kenya - Ripot mogik mar DREF (MDRKE065)

English: NCPB reminds farmers in Taita-Taveta County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Somali: NCPB waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Taita-Taveta barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee ka dambeeya goosashada.
Dholuo: NCPB parone jopur manie Taita-Taveta County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime bang' keyo.

English: Public notice: Kenya Medical Association will host a free food safety outreach in Busia County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa usalama wa chakula bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Busia Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu martigelin doonaa adeeg bilaash ah oo ku saabsan badbaadada cuntada ee degmada Busia bisha November.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association biro timo chenro mar chiwo kony maonge chudo e weche mag chiemo e County mar Busia e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: NDMA activates an emergency response plan for fire outbreaks in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa milipuko ya moto katika Kaunti ya Kitui.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay dabka ka kacay Gobolka Kitui.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony mapiyo ne masiche mag mach e gweng' mar Kitui.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) advises residents of Busia County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa usaidizi wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow si ay uga caawiyaan helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ee lacageed.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) nyiso jogweng' County mar Busia mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni mondo giyud kony mar yudo kony kuom weche thieth.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Lamu County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the May planting season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Mei.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Lamu inay qaataan noocyo abuurka ah oo abaarta u adkaysta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maajo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development nyiso jopur e County mar Lamu mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochako chwoyo kodhi e dwe mar Mei.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) warns public officers in Vihiga County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Vihiga dhidi ya udanganyifu wa fedha za umma.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Vihiga in ay ka faa'iideystaan dhaqaale dawladeed.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Vihiga ni kik giti gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo e yo marach.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development urges parents and teachers in Baringo County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku boorinayaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Baringo inay u soo sheegaan mas'uuliyadda amniga ee dugsiga.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e Baringo County mondo onyis sirkal mar skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok.

English: These three counties also account for about 65 percent of the total number of people estimated in IPC Phase 4 (Emergency).
Kiswahili: Kaunti hizi tatu pia zinachukua takriban asilimia 65 ya jumla ya idadi ya watu wanaokadiriwa katika IPC Awamu ya 4 (Dharura).
Somali: Saddexdan degmo ayaa sidoo kale ah qiyaastii 65 boqolkiiba tirada guud ee dadka lagu qiyaasay IPC Wajiga 4aad (Xaaladda Degdegga ah).
Dholuo: Kaunti adek gi bende nigi kwan mar ji madirom 65 kuom mia achiel ma ne opimre e IPC Phase 4 (Masira).

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds farmers in Garissa County of the ongoing greenhouse farming training programme.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kilimo cha chafu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Garissa barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development parone jopur e county mar Garissa kuom chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar timo pur.

English: NTSA warns residents of Makueni County to prepare for possible drought this June.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kujiandaa kwa ukame unaowezekana Juni hii.
Somali: NTSA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay isu diyaariyaan abaaraha iman kara bisha Juun.
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Makueni County mondo giikre ne oro ma nyalo betie e dwe mar Jun.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to attend the public participation forum to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si loo qaabeeyo dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar timo nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: Kenya Key Message Update: Record high food prices and a fifth consecutive below-average rainy season drive high levels of acute food insecurity, January 2023
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Ujumbe Muhimu nchini Kenya: Rekodi bei za juu za vyakula na msimu wa tano mfululizo wa mvua chini ya wastani husababisha viwango vya juu vya uhaba wa chakula, Januari 2023.
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta Fariinta Muhiimka ah ee Kenya: Qiimaha cuntada oo aad u sarreeya iyo xilli roobaadkii shanaad oo xiriir ah oo ka hooseeya celceliska ayaa horseeday heerar sare oo ah amni-darro cunto oo ba'an, Janaayo 2023
Dholuo: Oda maduong’ ma Kenya ogolo: Nengo mamalo mar chiemo kod kinde koth mar abich moluwore okelo okang’ mamalo mar bedo maonge gi chiemo, dwe mar achiel higa mar 2023

English: List of common mental disorders: anxiety, depression, bipolar disorder, PTSD, schizophrenia
Kiswahili: Orodha ya matatizo ya akili ya kawaida: wasiwasi, mfadhaiko, ugonjwa wa bipolar, PTSD, skizofrenia
Somali: Liiska cudurrada maskaxda ee caadiga ah: walwalka, niyadjabka, cudurka laba-geesoodka ah, PTSD, schizophrenia
Dholuo: Ng'eny tuoche mag parruok: parruok, chuny monyosore, tuwo mar bipolar, PTSD, schizophrenia

English: Inspiring a Change: JRS students advocate for gender equality
Kiswahili: Kuhamasisha Mabadiliko: Wanafunzi wa JRS wanatetea usawa wa kijinsia
Somali: Dhiirigelinta Isbeddelka: Ardayda JRS waxay u doodaan sinnaanta jinsiga
Dholuo: Kuom kelo lokruok: Jopuonjre mag JRS siro mondo ji obed kaka chwo gi mon

English: Kenya - Tropical cyclone IALY (media, Kenya Meteorological Department, MFLR, GDACS) (ECHO Daily Flash of 23 May 2024)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Kimbunga cha Tropiki IALY (vyombo vya habari, Idara ya Hali ya Hewa ya Kenya, MFLR, GDACS) (ECHO Daily Flash ya 23 Mei 2024)
Somali: Kenya - Duufaanta Kulaylaha IALY (warbaahinta, Waaxda Saadaasha Hawada Kenya, MFLR, GDACS) (ECHO Daily Flash ee 23 Maajo 2024)
Dholuo: Kenya - Yamo mapek mar yamo mapek miluongo ni IALY (mige lendo, Apis mar weche yamo mar piny Kenya, MFLR, GDACS) (Rich ma rieny pile pile tarik 23 dwe mar abich 2024)

English: Notice: KNEC opens applications for school laptops under the digital literacy programme for learners in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inafungua maombi ya kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee Garissa County u furaysaa codsiyada laptops-ka dugsiga.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KNEC chako tiyo gi kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar somo gi somo mar digital e taon mar Garissa.

English: Women hold the Key to Success of Pastoralism in Africa
Kiswahili: Wanawake wanashikilia Ufunguo wa Mafanikio ya Ufugaji Barani Afrika
Somali: Haweenku waxay haystaan ​​Furaha Guusha Xoolo-dhaqatada Afrika
Dholuo: Mon nigi Kido mar Loch mar Tich mar Jakwath e Afrika

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health warns of increased Rift Valley Fever risk in Bungoma County and advises the public to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya yaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa katika Kaunti ya Bungoma na kushauri umma kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Talo-bixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ka digtay kororka halista Cudurka Rift Valley ee Gobolka Bungoma waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: Ministry of Health osiemo ji kuom medruok mar Rift Valley Fever e County mar Bungoma kendo ojiwo ji mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni kodgi.

English: Youth interested in agribusiness can participate in the TEJATI initiative aimed at transforming agricultural ecosystems through technology and innovation Sign up by November 29 2024
Kiswahili: Vijana wanaopenda kilimo biashara wanaweza kushiriki katika mpango wa TEJATI unaolenga kubadilisha mifumo ikolojia ya kilimo kupitia teknolojia na uvumbuzi Jisajili ifikapo Novemba 29 2024
Somali: Dhallinyarada xiiseynaya ganacsiga beeraha waxay ka qayb qaadan karaan hindisaha TEJATI ee loogu talagalay beddelashada nidaamyada deegaanka beeraha iyada oo loo marayo tikniyoolajiyada iyo hal-abuurnimada Isdiiwaangaliya 29ka Nofeembar 2024
Dholuo: Rowere mohero weche mag ohala nyalo dhi e chenrono mar TEJATI ma dwaro loko yore mag ohala e yore mag ohala kokalo kuom teknoloji kod lony

English: KMTC urges parents and teachers in Mandera County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Mandera inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: KMTC jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Mandera mondo omany namba mar kony mar nyithindo 116.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: free antenatal care clinics will run every April at designated health centres in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi: kliniki za bure za utunzaji wa ujauzito zitafanya kazi kila Aprili katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka: rugta daryeelka dhalmada ee bilaashka ah ayaa lagu bilaabi doonaa bishii Abriil kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Rieko moa e Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: Klinike mag rito nyithindo kapok ginyuol biro tiyo dwe mar April higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Nyandarua.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Mei hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu qabtaa warbixin bulsho ku saabsan dhismaha nabadda qaranka ee gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Forest Service timo romo mar oganda e wi loso kuwe e gweng' mar Elgeyo-Marakwet e dwe mar Mei.

English: KUCCPS conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in Mombasa County this November.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Novemba hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee gobolka Mombasa bishii November.
Dholuo: KUCCPS timo romo mar tiego ji e wi ratiro mag chik e County mar Mombasa e dwe mar Novemba.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds expectant mothers in Kakamega County that access to skilled birth attendance is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba upatikanaji wa mahudhurio ya uzazi wenye ujuzi ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Kakamega in helitaanka daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfad leh ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa mine ma biro nyuolo nyithindo e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni thuolo mar yudo nyithindo ma nigi lony onge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges residents of Vihiga County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Uhalifu unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya dadka deggan degmada Vihiga in ay soo sheegaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo la sii xoojinayo fiiro gaar ah u lahaanshaha ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo jogweng' County mar Vihiga mondo onyis riwruok mag sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e alwora mar tong'gi e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya e weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Narok County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the February planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Februari.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda Gobolka Narok inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Febraayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur manie Narok County mondo otim lokruok e puothe mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak kapok ochako chuoyo e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will train farmers in Nandi County on water harvesting this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi juu ya uvunaji wa maji Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) ayaa tababar siin doonta beeraleyda gobolka Nandi ku saabsan goosashada biyaha bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro tiego jopur e county mar Nandi e wi ywayo pi e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Judiciary of Kenya announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kushughulikia vyeti vya kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la horumariyo waqtiga wareejinta shahaadada dhalashada ee degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya olando lokruok e seche mag timo nonro mar nyuol e county mar Baringo.

English: Notice: KALRO will train farmers in Laikipia County on soil conservation this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Laikipia juu ya uhifadhi wa udongo Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Laikipia ee ku saabsan ilaalinta ciidda bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Rapar: KALRO biro tiego jopur e County mar Laikipia e weche mag rito lowo e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages mothers in Vihiga County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku dhiirigelisay hooyooyinka degmada Vihiga inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ojiwo mine e County mar Vihiga mondo odhi olim ringregi machiegni mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: NCPB invites farmers in Kilifi County to a free training on record keeping for farmers this October.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima Oktoba hii.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kilifi tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan diiwaangelinta beeralayda bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: NCPB ogwelo jopur e gweng' mar Kilifi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi rito rekod mag jopur dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Zambian cotton farmers can now access the Harmonized Cotton Extension Manual which provides standardized guidelines and practices to enhance productivity and sustainability
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa pamba wa Zambia sasa wanaweza kupata Mwongozo wa Upanuzi wa Pamba Iliyounganishwa ambao unatoa miongozo na mazoea sanifu ili kuongeza tija na uendelevu.
Somali: Beeraleyda suufka Zambia waxay hadda heli karaan Buugga Kordhinta Cotton ee Iswaafajinaya oo bixiya tilmaamo iyo habab caadi ah si loo kordhiyo wax soo saarka iyo waara
Dholuo: Jo-Zambia ma pidho puodho sani nyalo yudo buk miluongo ni Harmonized Cotton Extension Manual ma chiwo chike kod timbe mapile mag medo nyak kod dhi nyime maber

English: Pest Control Products Board announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for pigs in Migori County this November.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Migori Novemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Waxsoosaarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku dhawaaqay jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee doofaarka ee Degmada Migori bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products olando chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo e dwe mar Novemba e kaunti mar Migori.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Nyeri County that reporting carjacking promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba kuripoti utekaji nyara mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan baabuurta la xaday ay gacan ka geystaan ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne jogweng' Nyeri County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar wuondo mtokni konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Universities Fund encourages residents of Kirinyaga County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga inay ka qeybgalaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadwaynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo jogweng' Kirinyaga County mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar jopiny mar county mondo ging'e kaka jopiny biro tiyo gi bajet mag county.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges cassava growers in Migori County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Migori kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda cassava ee degmada Migori inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobka si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur ma pidho manija e county mar Migori mondo oti gi ratiro ma gichiwo mar chamo yien kapok koth ochue mondo okony e medo nyak mar yien e higani.

English: Universities Fund reminds youth in Bungoma County that HELB funding is available for welding and fabrication training.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xasuusinayaa dhalinyarada degmada Bungoma in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa rowere man Bungoma County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing.

English: Small scale tea farmers are encouraged to enhance the quality of their produce to secure better prices
Kiswahili: Wakulima wadogo wa chai wanahimizwa kuimarisha ubora wa mazao yao ili kupata bei nzuri
Somali: Beeraleyda yaryar ee shaaha waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay kor u qaadaan tayada wax soo saarka si ay u helaan qiimo wanaagsan
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur matindo mag chai mondo omed timo dongruok e kit olembe ma ginyago mondo omi ohala obed maber

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges rice growers in Nyamira County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawahimiza wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda bariiska ee degmada Nyamira inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur ma pidho kodhi e Kaunti mar Nyamira mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri katika shule kote Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij ku saabsan hagida iyo la-talinta dugsiyada gobolka Samburu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission of Teachers Service osechako chenro mar konyo kendo chiwo paro e skunde duto e county mar Samburu.

English: Notice: DCI launches a theft prevention campaign in Marsabit County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI inazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada degmada Marsabit bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: DCI chako kampen mar geng'o kuo e taon mar Marsabit e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: DCI opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay fureysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya taageero maskaxeed ee degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni DCI ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony e weche mag pach ji e taon mar Bungoma County.

English: Council of Governors opens civic education hubs in rural areas.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linafungua vituo vya elimu ya raia katika maeneo ya vijijini.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ka furayaan xarumaha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee deegaannada miyiga ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch ochako chenro mar tiego ji e alwora ma ji odakie.

English: Beware of emails pretending to be from banks asking for account verification.
Kiswahili: Jihadhari na barua pepe zinazojifanya kuwa zinatoka benki zinazoomba uthibitishaji wa akaunti.
Somali: Ka digtoonow emails u muuqda inay ka yimaadaan bangiyada oo weydiinaya xaqiijinta xisaabta.
Dholuo: Tang' gi barupe mag e-mail ma wuondore ni gin mag bengi ka gikwayo mondo okony ng'ato ong'e ka be en gi pesa.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development urges youth in Makueni County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Makueni kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku boorinayaa dhalinyarada degmada Makueni inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo rowere mag Makueni County mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gitimo tije mag oganda.

English: IPOA urges residents of Kirinyaga County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa umakini mkubwa wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: IPOA ojiwo jogweng' Kirinyaga County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'enyie nikech ji medo keto pachgi kuom loso kuwe e piny.

English: KRA urges residents of Kajiado County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kajiado County kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e loso chenro mag dongruok.

English: IEBC rolls out a campaign to boost voter registration in all counties.
Kiswahili: IEBC inazindua kampeni ya kuongeza usajili wa wapiga kura katika wilaya zote.
Somali: Ururka IEBC wuxuu bilaabay olole lagu xoojinayo diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha degmooyinka oo dhan.
Dholuo: IEBC chako kampen mar jiwo ji mondo odonj e loje duto.

English: Nakuru County announces review and expansion of its Nutrition Action Plan targeting 60% reduction in childhood malnutrition by 2027.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Nakuru yatangaza mapitio na upanuzi wa Mpango wake wa Lishe unaolenga kupunguza utapiamlo kwa watoto kwa 60% ifikapo mwaka wa 2027.
Somali: Degmada Nakuru ayaa ku dhawaaqday dib u eegis iyo ballaarin Qorshe Hawleedkeeda Nafaqada oo lagu beegsanayo 60% dhimista nafaqo-darrada carruurta marka la gaaro 2027.
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Nakuru olando ni ibiro nono kendo medo chenro mare mar timo gik moko e wi chiemo ma nigi gombo mar duoko piny kwan mar nyithindo ma nigi chiemo ma ok owinjore gi 60% nyaka higa mar 2027.

English: Play is vital for a childÂ’s emotional, physical, and cognitive development.
Kiswahili: Kucheza ni muhimu kwa ukuaji wa kihisia, kimwili, na kiakili wa mtoto.
Somali: Ciyaartu waa muhiim u ah koritaanka shucuureed, jireed, iyo garasho ee ilmaha.
Dholuo: Tugo en gima dwarore ahinya e dongruok mar nyathi e chuny, e ringruok, kod e ng’eyo.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will be held in Kiambu County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu bila malipo iliyoandaliwa na Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ay qabanqaabisay qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Kiambu bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma biro bedoe e dwe mar Julai ma biro e county mar Kiambu, ma ne ochan gi Division of Disease Surveillance and Response.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Mandera County about the importance of hypertension awareness for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera juu ya umuhimu wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay dadka degmada Mandera ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay wacyiga cadaadiska dhiig karka ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne ji e Mandera County kuom ber mar keto pachgi kuom tuo mar hypertension e ngima joot.

English: State Department for TVET conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Nakuru County this December.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Desemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha gobolka Nakuru bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET timo romo mar tiego ji e wi migawo mar ombudsman e kaunti mar Nakuru e dwe mar Desemba.

English: DCI calls on the community in Murang'a County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: DCI waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Murang'a inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wici doonaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: DCI okwayo ji duto manie County mar Murang'a mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: Ministry of Education advises applicants in Murang'a County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kutembelea kituo cha mafunzo ya ufundi kilicho karibu kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Murang'a inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow si ay u helaan waxbarashada soo socota.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Murang'a mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: KEPHIS invites farmers in Nyamira County to a free training on post-harvest handling this May.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno Mei hii.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyamira tababar lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan maareynta goosashada ka dib bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: KEPHIS ogwelo jopur e kaunti mar Nyamira e tiegruok ma onge chudo e dwe mar Mei.

English: Launch of smartphone app to track daily steps, hydration, dietary intake, and stress levels with community leaderboards.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa programu ya simu mahiri ili kufuatilia hatua za kila siku, unyevu, ulaji wa chakula, na viwango vya msongo wa mawazo kwa kutumia ubao wa viongozi wa jamii.
Somali: Bilaabidda abka taleefannada casriga ah si loola socdo tallaabooyinka maalinlaha ah, fuuq-baxa, qaadashada cuntada, iyo heerarka walbahaarka iyadoo la adeegsanayo guddiyada bulshada.
Dholuo: Chako program mar simu mar ng'ato mar luwo okang' ma pile ka pile, bedo gi pi e del, chiemo ma ichamo, kod rang'iny mar parruok ka itiyo gi bod mag jotelo mag oganda.

English: ODPP reminds the public in Nandi County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this December.
Kiswahili: ODPP anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba maoni juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma yanakaribishwa Desemba hii.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Nandi in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: ODPP oparo ne ji duto e County mar Nandi ni paro ma ji chiwo e wi chenro mag siasa en gima owinjore e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: IPOA issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Busia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa utambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay soo saartaa digniin amniga internetka ah oo ku saabsan xadaysiga aqoonsiga ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Busia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IPOA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity e wi kuo mar ng'ato makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e county mar Busia.

English: Universities Fund urges residents of Nakuru County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from free primary education.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kutuma maombi ya bursari hiyo kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kufaidika na elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo jogweng' Nakuru County mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud somo ma onge chudo.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds residents of Siaya County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya in helitaanka adeegyada baasaboorka ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette parone ji modak e county mar Siaya ni koro yot yudo passport kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Kajiado County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kuthibitisha kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay xaqiijiyaan in xaruntoodu la aqoonsaday ka hor inta aysan booqan si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo ong'e ni kuondegi mag thieth oseyudo ratiro kapok gibiro mondo giyud thieth.

English: Ministry of Education encourages residents of West Pokot County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.

Kiswahili: DCI inatoa wito kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuunga mkono kamati za ujenzi wa amani za mitaa kuunga mkono usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: DCI waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah ee taageeraya amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: DCI okwayo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gweng'no e siro sirkal mar tong'.

English: EACC advises residents of Kilifi County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: EACC inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: EACC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jogweng' Kilifi County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport services.

English: Council of Governors urges residents of Lamu County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kuwasilisha maandishi ya kumbukumbu kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha waxay ku boorinayaan dadka deggan degmada Lamu inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay si loo qaabeeyo wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Lamu mondo ochiw paro mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso chenro mag chenro mag sirkal.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages residents of Kirinyaga County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay la xiriiraan lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' Kirinyaga County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giwuo gi jang'ad rieko molony.

English: NPS urges motorists and pedestrians in Tana River County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NPS inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Tana River kusakinisha na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa darawalada gawaarida iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Tana River inay guryahooda rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dabka daminta iyo inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo derebe mag mtokni kod joma wuotho e ndara e taon mar Tana River County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo gitim kinda mar geng'o hinyruok mag ndara.

English: Huduma Kenya invites residents of Lamu County to attend the public participation forum regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu inay ka qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la xiriira wadatashiyada siyaasadda guud.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya gwelo jogweng' Lamu County mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi weche siasa.

English: Notice from Kenya Medical Association: skilled birth attendance clinics will run every March at designated health centres in Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya: kliniki za mahudhurio ya uzazi zenye ujuzi zitaendeshwa kila Machi katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya: rugta daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfadlayaasha ah ayaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Maarso oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee lagu magacaabo degmada Marsabit.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association: klinik mag rito nyuol ma nigi lony biro tiyo dwe mar Mach higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Marsabit.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Tharaka-Nithi County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Degmada Tharaka-Nithi inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo odhi ir japuonj molony.

English: ODPP updates residents of Baringo County on progress of the county integrated development plan this November.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti hii Novemba.
Somali: ODPP waxay cusbooneysiineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo horumarka qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada bisha November.
Dholuo: ODPP medo lero ne jogweng' Baringo County kaka chenro mar dongruok mar county integrated development dhi nyime e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Kakamega County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kumtia moyo rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Kakamega inuu ku dhiirrigeliyo saaxiibkiisa dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nyagore gi tuoche mag obwongo e Kaunti mar Kakamega mondo ojiw osiepne moro ma chandore omany kony.

English: TSC urges parents and teachers in Trans Nzoia County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Somali: TSC waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Trans Nzoia inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto.

English: KALRO reminds residents of Laikipia County that water harvesting improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kwamba uvunaji wa maji unaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Somali: KALRO waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia in biyo la goynayo ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: KALRO paronwa jogweng' Laikipia County ni choko pi kelo nyak e puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: However, in northeastern and some eastern areas (Mandera, Wajir, Garissa and Tana River counties) pasture conditions in March remained belowâ€‘average following a severe drought in late 2025 (Vegetation Condition Index map).
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, katika maeneo ya kaskazini-mashariki na baadhi ya mashariki (kaunti za Mandera, Wajir, Garissa na Tana River) hali ya malisho mnamo Machi ilisalia chini- wastani kufuatia ukame mkali mwishoni mwa 2025 (ramani ya Kielezo cha Hali ya Uoto).
Somali: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, gobollada waqooyi-bari iyo qaar ka mid ah bariga (degmooyinka Mandera, Wajeer, Garissa iyo Tana River) xaaladaha daaqsinka bishii Maarso waxay ahaayeen kuwo ka hooseeya celceliska ka dib abaar daran oo dhacday dabayaaqadii 2025 (Khariidadda Tusmada Xaaladaha Dhirta).
Dholuo: Kata kamano, e nyandwat ma yo wuokchieng' kod kuonde moko ma yo wuokchieng' (kaunti mag Mandera, Wajir, Garissa kod Tana River) chal mar puothe e dwe mar adek ne odong' piny moloyo ma pile bang' oro mager ma ne otimore e giko higa mar 2025 (map mar chal mar lum).

English: NPS urges the public in Uasin Gishu County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: NPS inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: NPS waxay ugu baaqeysaa shacabka degmada Uasin Gishu inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: NPS ojiwo ji duto e Uasin Gishu County mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro bang' yudo weche mag phishing.

English: SHA reminds the public in Siaya County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Siaya in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: SHA parone ji duto e county mar Siaya ni chiwo ripot mar kawo asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.
