English: ODPP warns public officers in Kisumu County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: ODPP inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Kisumu dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: ODPP waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Kisumu inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: ODPP chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal ma Kisumu County ni kik giti marach gi migepegi.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Siaya County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya in si dhakhso leh u soo sheegidda tuugada ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogweng'o mag Siaya County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo kuom nek konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: DCI reminds residents of Kericho County that reporting carjacking promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba kuripoti utekaji nyara mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan baabuurta la xaday ay gacan ka geystaan ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: DCI parone jogweng'o mag Kericho County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo mtokni konyo rito alwora.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages mothers in Nyandarua County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Nyandarua inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta caafimaad ee la qorsheeyay si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo mine manie County mar Nyandarua mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar thieth mar rito ngima nyathigi.

English: Kenya â€” Findings from WISE Assessment â€” Tana River County
Kiswahili: Kenya - Matokeo kutoka Tathmini ya WISE - Kaunti ya Tana River
Somali: Kenya - Natiijooyinka Qiimaynta WISE - Degmada Tana River
Dholuo: Kenya – Gik ma ne oyudre kuom nonro mar WISE – Kaunti mar Aora Tana

English: The CSA approach is built on the context, technology and on transformative agriculture, which focuses on transparency in enjoining..
Kiswahili: Mbinu ya CSA imejengwa juu ya muktadha, teknolojia na juu ya kilimo cha mabadiliko, ambacho kinazingatia uwazi katika kuagiza..
Somali: Habka CSA wuxuu ku dhisan yahay macnaha, tiknoolajiyada iyo beeraha isbeddelka leh, kaas oo diiradda saaraya hufnaanta in la fariiyo..
Dholuo: Yo ma ji tiyogo e timo dongruok e weche mag dongruok otenore kuom weche machuok, teknoloji, kod weche mag pur ma kelo lokruok, kendo mano jiwo ahinya weche ma nyiso ni ji nigi thuolo mar timo dongruok.

English: DPP urges residents of Kwale County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama katikati ya umakini mkubwa wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay soo sheegaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: DPP ojiwo jogweng' Kwale County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e alwora mar tong'gi nikech ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom loso kuwe e piny.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds residents of Meru County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya parone jogweng' mar Meru County ni luwo dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: CDC urges residents of Wajir County to complete the full recommended vaccination dose following a rise in reported malaria cases.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya malaria vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: CDC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Wajir inay dhammaystiraan qiyaasta tallaalka oo dhan ee lagugula talinayo ka dib kororka kiisaska malaria ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Wajir mondo otiek dose duto mar thieth ma ji osechiwo bang' medruok mar tuo mar malaria.

English: EACC urges eligible citizens in Kisii County to participate in polling procedures.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Kisii kushiriki katika utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kisii inay ka qaybqaataan nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo raia mag Kisii County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag yiero.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross confirms a Rift Valley Fever outbreak alert for West Pokot County. Residents are advised to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa kwa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka Rift Valley Fever ee Gobolka West Pokot. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bad Romo mar Kenya (Kenya Red Cross) osenyiso ni nitie masira mar Rift Valley Fever e gweng' mar West Pokot.

English: Eastern Africa: Heavy rains and flooding Flash Update #2 (10 May 2024)
Kiswahili: Afrika Mashariki: Mvua kubwa na mafuriko Sasisho la Flash #2 (10 Mei 2024)
Somali: Bariga Afrika: Roobab Mahiigaan ah iyo Daadad Cusub #2 (10 Maajo 2024)
Dholuo: Afrika ma Wuokchieng': Koth mang'eny kod pi ma pong'o piny #2 (10 Mei 2024)

English: Kenya Gazette reminds the public in Taita-Taveta County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linakumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu dadka degmada Taita-Taveta ku xasuusinayaa in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette parone ji duto manie Taita-Taveta County ni chiwo ripot mar kawo asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Duty free rice imports are now limited to 250 000 tonnes with a new import deadline of October 31 2025 Stakeholders should plan accordingly
Kiswahili: Uagizaji wa mchele bila ushuru sasa umepunguzwa kwa tani 250,000 na tarehe mpya ya mwisho ya kuagiza ya Oktoba 31 2025 Wadau wanapaswa kupanga ipasavyo.
Somali: Dhoofinta bariiska ee aan canshuurta lahayn hadda waxaa lagu xaddiday 250,000 tan iyadoo waqti cusub oo soo dejinta ah uu yahay Oktoobar 31, 2025. Daneeyayaashu waa inay qorsheeyaan sidaas.
Dholuo: Tuke ma ok ochuno ni nyaka oter e lowo sani romo ton 250 000, kendo ndalo mar golo e lowo manyien nyaka chop Oktoba 31, 2025, joma nie bwo loch onego otim chenro kaluwore gi mano

English: DCI urges residents of Kwale County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: DCI inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa umakini mkubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: DCI ojiwo jogweng' Kwale County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'enyie e bwo sirkal.

English: The FAO s Junior Farmer Field and Life Schools JFFLS program offers agricultural and entrepreneurial training for youth in rural areas Interested individuals should apply to enhance their skills and business potential
Kiswahili: Mpango wa FAO's Junior Farmer Field and Life Schools JFFLS unatoa mafunzo ya kilimo na ujasiriamali kwa vijana wa maeneo ya vijijini Watu wanaovutiwa wanapaswa kutuma maombi ili kuongeza ujuzi wao na uwezo wao wa kibiashara.
Somali: Barnaamijka FAO ee Junior Farmer Field and Life Schools JFFLS wuxuu bixiyaa tababar beeraha iyo ganacsi oo loogu talagalay dhalinyarada miyiga ah. Kuwa xiiseynaya waa inay codsadaan si ay u horumariyaan xirfadooda iyo awoodda ganacsi
Dholuo: Chenro mar JFFLS mar FAO mar Junior Farmer Field and Life Schools chiwo tiegruok e weche mag pur kod ohala ne rowere manie gwenge ma ni e gwenge mag gweng' Joma dwaro yudo kony onego oketgi mondo gimed lony margi kod nyalo margi mar bedo gi ohala

English: KEPHIS invites farmers in Kiambu County to a free training on modern irrigation techniques this June.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kupata mafunzo ya bure juu ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji Juni hii.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Kiambu tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah bisha Juun.
Dholuo: KEPHIS ogwelo jopur e gweng' mar Kiambu e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi yore mag lero pi e dwe mar Jun.

English: KMTC calls on the community in Marsabit County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KMTC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: KMTC waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Marsabit inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban si loo ilaaliyo nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: KMTC jiwo oganda mar Marsabit County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission opens a new ICT skills programme at the vocational centre in Turkana County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafungua programu mpya ya ujuzi wa ICT katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan xirfadaha ICT ka furayaa xarunta xirfadda ee degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj chako chenro manyien mar lony e yore mag ICT e kar tiegruok e county mar Turkana.

English: Waiting a minute before clamping the cord improves baby_x0092_s iron levels and immunity.
Kiswahili: Kusubiri dakika moja kabla ya kufunga kamba huongeza kiwango cha chuma na kinga ya mtoto.
Somali: Sugitaanka daqiiqad ka hor inta aan la xidhin xadhiggu waxay hagaajinaysaa heerarka birta iyo difaaca jirka ee ilmaha.
Dholuo: Ka irito dakika achiel kapok iketo ng’injo, mano miyo nyathi bedo gi iron maber kendo miyo ringre bedo gi teko mar geng’o tuoche.

English: Universities Fund encourages out-of-school children in Narok County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Narok kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa watu wazima chini ya mgao wa bursary.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Narok inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee la siinayo deeq waxbarasho.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e Narok County mondo odonj e program mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo e bwo mich mar bursary.

English: CDC reminds the public in Isiolo County that access to SHA registration is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kwamba ufikiaji wa usajili wa SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Isiolo in helitaanka diiwaangelinta SHA hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji duto manie Isiolo County ni sani ginyalo yudo weche mag SHA e kuonde moketi.

English: To reduce Brown Leaf Spot in cassava, use good, healthy planting stock, destroy infected crop husks after harvest, and plant early so the crop grows vigorously; if healthy planting material isn't available, dip cassava stems in a diluted fungicide before planting.
Kiswahili: Ili kupunguza jani la Brown katika muhogo, tumia mbegu nzuri za kupanda, uharibu maganda ya mazao yaliyoambukizwa baada ya mavuno, na uote mapema ili mmea ukue kwa nguvu; ikiwa vifaa vyenye afya havipatikani, chovya mashina ya muhogo katika kuvu iliyotiwa chumvi kabla ya kupanda.
Somali: Si loo yareeyo Brown Leaf Spot ee cassava, isticmaal beero caafimaad qaba oo wanaagsan, burburi qolofyada dalagga cudurka ka dib goosashada, oo beerta hore si dalaggu si xooggan u koro; Haddii walxaha beerta caafimaadka leh aysan la heli karin, ku qubi laamaha cassava fungicide la khufiyay ka hor inta aan la beerin.
Dholuo: Mondo omi ng'ato odwok chien kama oting'o Brown Leaf Spot e manias, onego oti gi yien mabeyo kendo ma nigi teko mar pidho, onego oketh tong' mag yien ma nigi tuoche bang' keyo, kendo onego ogolgi chon mondo cham odongi maber; ka ok yud gik ma nyalo konyo e pidho manias, onego omwodhgi e yath ma ok nyal thiedhore kapok ogolgi.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds expectant mothers in Kirinyaga County that access to childhood immunization is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba upatikanaji wa chanjo ya utotoni ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Kirinyaga in helitaanka tallaalka carruurta ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Kirinyaga ni yudo thieth mar nyithindo en gima onge chudo e kuonde duto ma ji yudoe thieth.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Bungoma County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Bungoma mwezi huu wa Novemba.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ku saabsan dhismaha nabadda qaranka ee degmada Bungoma bishii November.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji (Communications Authority of Kenya) timo romo mar oganda e wi loso kuwe e piny mangima e County mar Bungoma e dwe mar Novemba.

English: DCI alerts residents of Busia County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: DCI waxay dadka deggan degmada Busia uga digtay kororka kiisaska gaadiidka la xaday waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne ji modak e County mar Busia e wi medruok mar wach kwalo mtokni kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Kenya Summary Report: Rapid gender and needs analysis in Marsabit (September 2022)
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Muhtasari wa Kenya: Uchambuzi wa haraka wa jinsia na mahitaji huko Marsabit (Septemba 2022)
Somali: Warbixinta Kooban ee Kenya: Falanqaynta Degdegga ah ee Jinsiga iyo Baahiyaha ee Marsabit (Sebtembar 2022)
Dholuo: Ripot machuok mar piny Kenya: Nonro mapiyo mar kido mar chuech kod dwaro e piny Marsabit (Dwe mar Apar 2022)

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka ayaa furaya codsiyada deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan ardayda ku jira degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oseyawo kwayo mag yudo chudo ne jopuonjre man gi dwaro mag somo e County mar Vihiga.

English: Kenya - Severe weather and floods (media, NOAA-CPC) (ECHO Daily Flash of 2 April 2026)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Hali ya hewa kali na mafuriko (vyombo vya habari, NOAA-CPC) (ECHO Daily Flash ya 2 Aprili 2026)
Somali: Kenya - Cimilo daran iyo daadad (warbaahinta, NOAA-CPC) (ECHO Daily Flash ee 2 Abriil 2026)
Dholuo: Kenya - Weche mag kor lwasi mager kod pi mopong'o piny (oboke, NOAA-CPC)

English: AFA promotes soil conservation among farmers in Taita-Taveta County as part of the March climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: AFA inakuza uhifadhi wa udongo miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Machi.
Somali: AFA waxay dhiirrigelisay ilaalinta ciidda beeraleyda gobolka Taita-Taveta iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Maarso.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo rito lowo e kind jopur e Taita-Taveta County kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo kinda mar kedo gi lokruok e kit yamo e dwe mar Mach.

English: The cost of targeted testing for Covid-19 and government quarantine facilities shall be met by the government effective today. Kenyans should not be afraid to get tested
Kiswahili: Gharama ya upimaji unaolengwa wa Covid-19 na vituo vya karantini vya serikali italipwa na serikali kuanzia leo. Wakenya hawapaswi kuogopa kupimwa.
Somali: Qiimaha baaritaanka bartilmaameedka ah ee COVID-19 iyo xarumaha karantiil ee dowladda ayaa ay xukuumaddu bixin doontaa maanta laga bilaabo maanta. Dadka Kenya waa inaysan ka baqin inay tijaabiyaan
Dholuo: Oganda Kenya ok onego oluor timo nonro mar Covid-19 kod kuonde ma sirkal ketoe ji kar kende.

English: IEBC encourages out-of-school children in Busia County to register their children at the nearest public school under free primary education.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Busia kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Busia inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan iskuulka guud ee ugu dhow ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e county mar Busia mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni gi skul mar sirkal ka gin gi tiegruok ma onge chudo.

English: State Department for Basic Education encourages out-of-school children in West Pokot County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada West Pokot inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e West Pokot County mondo odonj e program mar puonjo jomadongo somo mar sekondari.

English: Depression is a serious mental health problem which can impact your life, relationships, and work negatively.
Kiswahili: Kushuka moyo ni tatizo zito la afya ya akili ambalo linaweza kuathiri maisha yako, mahusiano yako, na kazi yako.
Somali: Dhibaatadu waa dhibaato maskaxeed oo halis ah oo saameyn xun ku yeelan karta noloshaada, xiriirkaada iyo shaqadaada.
Dholuo: Bedo gi parruok mang'eny e paro nyalo miyo ng'ato obed gi paro maok owinjore e wi ngimane, winjruokne gi nyawadgi, kod tich.

English: Samburu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Samburu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2022
Somali: Degmada Samburu: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Samburu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar adek higa mar 2022

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Kisii County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight abuse of office.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia simu ya EACC ya bure ili kupambana na matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee EACC si looga hortago xadgudubka xilka.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo jogweng' Kisii County mondo ochiw ripode mag mibadhi kokalo kuom hotline mar EACC ma onge chudo mondo giked gi timbe mag tiyo marach gi migepe.

English: Scale up vaccination campaigns and intensify disease surveillance to improve the health of livestock.
Kiswahili: Kuongeza kampeni za chanjo na kuongeza ufuatiliaji wa magonjwa ili kuboresha afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Kordhi ololayaasha tallaalka iyo xoojinta kormeerka cudurrada si loo hagaajiyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Med kampen mar chamo yedhe mamero kod medo neno kaka tuoche timore mondo ngima mar jamni obed maber.

English: KALRO reminds residents of Nandi County that terracing improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba terracing inaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Somali: KALRO waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Nandi in dhulka lagu beerayo uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: KALRO paronwa jogweng' kaunti mar Nandi ni terracing medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: US promotes bovine viral diarrhea control programs.
Kiswahili: Marekani huendeleza mipango ya kudhibiti mchochota wa virusi wa ng'ombe.
Somali: Maraykanku wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa barnaamijyo lagu xakameeyo ciribta fayraska ah ee lo'da.
Dholuo: Amerka jiwo chenro mag kedo gi tuwo mar dhoho mar dhok.

English: Notice: ODPP opens polling procedures centres in Laikipia County this April.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay furaysaa xarumaha nidaamyada codbixinta ee Gobolka Laikipia bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: ODPP ochako chenro mar timo yiero e Laikipia County e dwe mar April.

English: IEBC encourages first-time voters in Turkana County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Turkana kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Turkana inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogo madwaro yiero mokwongo e county mar Turkana mondo oting'e ID kata pasi mar pinygi e odiechieng'no mar yiero.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the public in Samburu County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa SIM-swap.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaannada dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya shacabka gobolka Samburu inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ji duto e county mar Samburu mondo ong'e kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma ne oland kuom wuond mar SIM-swap.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Narok County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Narok in warbixinta khiyaanada si deg deg ah ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogweng' Narok County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo kuom wuond konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: EACC urges residents of Kisumu County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili kuwajulisha juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika kiwango cha wilaya.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay la xiriiraan maamulaha qaybta maxalliga ah si ay uga warqabaan bixinta adeegga heerka qaybta.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kisumu mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jotelo mag utegi mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi tij lendo ma itimo e utegi.

English: KRA advises residents of Baringo County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: KRA inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: KRA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: KRA nyiso jogweng' Baringo County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport.

English: Kenya Medical Association announces free medical camps for residents of Lamu County starting this November.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kuanzia Novemba hii.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu ku dhawaaqay xeryo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Lamu laga bilaabo bisha November.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association ogolo kambi mag thieth maonge chudo ne jogweng' Lamu County kochakore dwe mar Novemba.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) urges beans growers in Nakuru County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawataka wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Nakuru inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey roobka ka hor si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur ma pidho puothe e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo oti gi ratiro mar chwoyo puothe kapok koth ochue mondo omed kelo nyak e higani.

English: IEBC invites residents of Mandera County to attend the public participation forum regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: IEBC inakaribisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: IEBC gwelo ji duto modak e county mar Mandera mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: ASAL Humanitarian Network MPCT Endline Assessment, Kenya, January 2022
Kiswahili: Tathmini ya Mwisho ya Mtandao wa Kibinadamu wa ASAL MPCT, Kenya, Januari 2022
Somali: Qiimaynta Dhammaadka ee Shabakadda Bani'aadamnimada ee ASAL ee MPCT, Kenya, Janaayo 2022
Dholuo: Riwruok mar konyo dhano mar ASAL MPCT, Kenya, dwe mar achiel higa mar 2022

English: Notice: KMTC announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Turkana County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta dugsiyada dugsiga dhexe ee maalin bilaash ah ee degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KMTC ogolo chenro mar somo sekondari maonge chudo e skunde mag Turkana County.

English: Pregnant women should seek immediate care if they experience severe headaches, swelling, blurred vision, or bleeding. These may be signs of serious complications.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanapaswa kutafuta huduma ya haraka ikiwa watapata maumivu makali ya kichwa, uvimbe, kutoona vizuri, au kutokwa na damu. Hizi zinaweza kuwa ishara za matatizo makubwa.
Somali: Haweenka uurka leh waxay u baahan yihiin daryeel degdeg ah haddii ay qabaan madax xanuun daran, caabuq, aragti murugsan, ama dhiig bax, kuwaas oo calaamad u noqon kara dhibaatooyin culus.
Dholuo: Mon ma nigi ich onego okwa thieth mapiyo kapo ni giyudo lit e wiye, ich wang', wang'gi ok nen maber, kata rembgi rumo.

English: Establishing a satellite office to further the cause of peace in Marsabit
Kiswahili: Kuanzisha afisi ya setilaiti ili kuendeleza masuala ya amani huko Marsabit
Somali: Sameynta xafiis dayax-gacmeed si loo sii horumariyo nabadda Marsabit
Dholuo: Keto apis mar setlait mar dhi nyime gi kelo kwe e boma mar Marsabit

English: Notice: KTDA will conduct a pest and disease management workshop for farmers in Vihiga County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itafanya warsha ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada beeraleyda ee degmada Vihiga bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA biro timo chokruok mar rieyo tuoche kod tuoche ne jopur e County mar Vihiga e dwe mar Agost.

English: ODPP urges residents of Turkana County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay si loo qaabeeyo wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Turkana mondo ochiw paro mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso chenro mag chenro mag sirkal.

English: NCPB urges maize growers in Machakos County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawasihi wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Machakos watumie viwango vinavyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee Machakos County in ay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur ma pidho cham e County ma Machakos mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue mondo omed kelo nyak e higani.

English: Notice from Division of Disease Surveillance and Response: childhood immunization clinics will run every September at designated health centres in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa: kliniki za chanjo ya watoto zitaendeshwa kila Septemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka socda qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada: rugaha tallaalka carruurta waxaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Sebtember ee xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Nandi.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuwo: Klinike mag thiedho nyithindo biro tiyo e dwe mar ochiko higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e county mar Nandi.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Machakos County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuhusu umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay dadka degmada Machakos ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay nadaafadda saxda ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji duto e County mar Machakos kuom ber mar rito ler mar pi e ngima joot.

English: Notice: HELB announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ee dugsiyada degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: HELB ogolo chenro mar dhi e skunde mag Siaya County.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Embu County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu in ay biyo cabitaan ah ku kariyaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo jogweng' mar Embu County mondo omak pi modho kapok gitiyo kode mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Wajir inay xoojiyaan ammaanka kaabayaasha dugsiga bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: IEBC oparo ne skunde man Wajir County mondo omed jiwo ritruok mar chenro mag skul e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Smallholder tea farmers are urged to stay informed about potential changes in the Kenya Tea Development Agency as the President calls for its overhaul to enhance their welfare
Kiswahili: Wakulima wadogo wa chai wanahimizwa kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu mabadiliko yanayoweza kutokea katika Shirika la Maendeleo ya Chai la Kenya huku Rais akitoa wito wa kufanyiwa marekebisho ili kuimarisha ustawi wao.
Somali: Beeraleyda yaryar ee shaaha waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyay inay la socdaan isbeddelada suurtagalka ah ee ku dhici doona Hay'adda Horumarinta Shaaha Kenya iyadoo Madaxweynaha uu ku baaqay in dib-u-habeyn lagu sameeyo si loo horumariyo daryeelkooda
Dholuo: Owete ma pidho chai matindo ikwayo mondo ong'e lokruok manyalo timore e Kenya Tea Development Agency kaka Jaloch owacho ni otim lokruok e chenrono mondo omed gwedho ngimagi

English: SHA updates residents of Nyamira County on progress of the county integrated development plan this August.
Kiswahili: SHA inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja ya kaunti hii Agosti.
Somali: SHA waxay dadka deggan degmada Nyamira ku wargelineysaa horumarka qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: SHA osemiyo jogweng' Nyamira ong'eyo dongruok mar chenro mar dongruok mar county e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: OGP opens polling procedures centres in Homa Bay County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay furaysaa xarumaha nidaamyada codbixinta ee gobolka Homa Bay bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: OGP chako tiyo gi chenro mag yiero e Homa Bay County e dwe mar Agost.

English: NTSA calls on residents of Embu County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: NTSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga dhaqdhaqaaq aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah si ay u taageeraan taxadarka ka dhanka ah argagixisada.
Dholuo: NTSA okwayo jogweng' mar Embu County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma rito sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e gwenge man machiegni gi tong'gi.

English: Notice: IEBC opens the electoral calendar centres in Nakuru County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee degmada Nakuru bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e kaunti mar Nakuru e dwe mar Julai.

English: KICD urges youth in Laikipia County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KICD inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KICD waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Laikipia inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada rayidka ah ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada rayidnimada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo rowere e county mar Laikipia mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok gitim gik ma biro timore ne oganda.

English: KEMSA calls on parents in Uasin Gishu County to have children under five screened for tuberculosis during the December outreach.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kifua kikuu wakati wa mawasiliano ya Desemba.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Uasin Gishu in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka 'tuberculosis' inta lagu jiro bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: KEMSA okwayo jonyuol e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Desemba.

English: IEBC reminds schools in Migori County to strengthen inclusion of learners with disabilities this April.
Kiswahili: IEBC inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Migori kuimarisha ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu Aprili hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Migori inay xoojiyaan ka mid noqoshada ardayda naafada ah bisha April.
Dholuo: IEBC parone skunde mag Migori County mondo omed tiego jopuonjre ma nigi midekre e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Kenya Gazette waxay ka furaysaa goob adeeg cusub oo lagu shaqeynayo shahaadada dhalashada ee degmada Mandera.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Gazette oseyawo kama itimee tije manyien mar loso barua mag nyuol e County mar Mandera.

English: KTDA reminds livestock keepers in Bungoma County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KTDA waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Bungoma in ay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska xayawaanada ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KTDA parone jorit jamni mag Bungoma County ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges residents of Kakamega County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kakamega inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay si loo qaabeeyo geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo jogweng' Kakamega County mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso bajet mar county ochopo.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will distribute certified tea seed to farmers in Wajir County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itasambaza mbegu za chai zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir mwezi Novemba huu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Wax soo saarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka ayaa bishii November qeybin doona abuurka shaaha ee shahaadada leh beeraleyda Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Chandruoge biro pogo kodhi mag chai ne jopur e gweng' mar Wajir e dwe mar Novemba.

English: TVET announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in Makueni County this September.
Kiswahili: TVET inatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Makueni Septemba hii.
Somali: TVET waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta deeqaha waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan dugsiyada degmada Makueni bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: TVET ogolo chiwo mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre man gi chan e skunde man Makueni County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: AFA reminds farmers in Mombasa County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya wakulima.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Mombasa in barnaamijka tababarka beeralayda uu socdo.
Dholuo: AFA parone jopur e county mar Mombasa e wi chenro mar tiego jopur ma dhi nyime.

English: Kenya - Floods (Kenya Met, media) (ECHO Daily Flash of 28 April 2023)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Mafuriko (Kenya Met, media) (ECHO Daily Flash ya 28 Aprili 2023)
Somali: Kenya - Daadad (Kenya Met, warbaahinta) (ECHO Daily Flash ee 28 Abriil 2023)
Dholuo: Kenya - Pi mang'eny (Kenya ne oromo, yor mbui) (28 dwe mar Ang'wen higa mar 2023)

English: SHA invites residents of Baringo County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: SHA inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuwasilisha kumbukumbu za maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: SHA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: SHA gwelo jogweng' Baringo County mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso bajet mar county ochopo.

English: Manage your farm labor effectively by understanding fair hiring practices, providing good working conditions, and ensuring worker safety for irrigation.
Kiswahili: Usimamie kazi yako ya shamba kwa ufanisi kwa kuelewa mazoea ya kuajiri kwa haki, kutoa hali nzuri za kazi, na kuhakikisha usalama wa wafanyakazi kwa ajili ya umwagiliaji.
Somali: Si wax ku ool ah u maaree shaqadaada beeraha adoo fahamaya hababka shaqaaleysiinta ee cadaalad ah, bixinta xaalado shaqo oo wanaagsan, iyo hubinta badbaadada shaqaalaha ee waraabinta.
Dholuo: Ti gi tijni e puodho e yo maber kuom ng'eyo kaka inyalo tiyo gi joma owinjore, chiwo chal maber mar tich, kendo rito ritruok mar jotich e yor dhi e lowo.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Lamu County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Lamu kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Lamu inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka maskaxeed ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pachgi e County mar Lamu mondo oluong kony mar thieth mar pach maonge chudo.

English: DPP alerts residents of Nyeri County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: DPP anawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhusu kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: DPP waxay dadka deggan degmada Nyeri uga digtay kororka kiisaska xoolaha lagu xado waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan mashaariicda booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: DPP chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nyeri County e wi medruok mar weche mag kwalo jamni kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Closing the Climate Information Gap
Kiswahili: Kuziba Pengo la Taarifa za Hali ya Hewa
Somali: Xidhitaanka Farqiga Macluumaadka Cimilada
Dholuo: Kuong’o pogruok e wi weche mag kor lwasi

English: KRA announces improved turnaround times for e-Citizen registration in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: KRA inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujiandikisha kwa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: KRA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee Gobolka Nyamira.
Dholuo: KRA olando lokruok e seche mag timo chenro mar e-Citizen registration e county mar Nyamira.

English: Notice: KEMRI will hold a depression awareness forum in Laikipia County this July. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI itafanya kongamano la uhamasishaji wa unyogovu katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Julai hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay qabaneysaa madasha wacyiga dhimirka ee degmada Laikipia bishii Luulyo. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMRI biro timo chokruok mar chiwo paro e wi tuwo mar depression e taon mar Laikipia e dwe mar Julai.

English: KALRO urges rice growers in Nyandarua County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawataka wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda bariiska ee gobolka Nyandarua inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo miraha ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur loso loso loso kodhi e Kaunti mar Nyandarua mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response calls on parents in Meru County to have children under five screened for HIV/AIDS during the July outreach.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Meru kuwafanya watoto chini ya miaka mitano wachunguzwe VVU/UKIMWI wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Julai.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Meru inay carruurta ka yar shan sano u sameeyaan baaritaanka HIV / AIDS inta lagu gudajiro bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo Tuoche kwayo jonyuol e County mar Meru mondo otim nonro mar HIV/AIDS ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Julai.

English: Announcement on educating people in the whole region on poor eating habits in the counties
Kiswahili: Tangazo kuhusu kuelimisha watu katika mkoa mzima kuhusu tabia mbaya za kula katika kaunti
Somali: Ogeysiis ku saabsan barashada dadka gobolka oo dhan ku saabsan caadooyinka cuntada ee xun ee degmooyinka
Dholuo: Lando mar tiego ji e alwora duto kuom timbe maricho mag chiemo e gwenge

English: KRA urges residents of Nairobi County to attend the public participation forum to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si loo qaabeeyo habka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo ji duto modak Nairobi County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar loso chenro mar bajet mar county.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds the public in Nakuru County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nakuru in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya paronwa ji duto e gweng' mar Nakuru ni golo ripot mar tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: Council of Governors warns public officers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet dhidi ya udanganyifu wa fedha za umma.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ka digeen saraakiisha dowladda ee gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet in ay ka faa'iideystaan dhaqaale dawladeed.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni kik giti gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo e yo marach.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public in Wajir County about the importance of hypertension awareness for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Wajir juu ya umuhimu wa ufahamu wa shinikizo la damu kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay dadka degmada Wajir ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay wacyiga cadaadiska dhiig karka ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji duto e gweng' mar Wajir kuom ber mar miyo ji ong'e ni tuwo mar hypertension en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: NTSA calls on the community in Lamu County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Lamu kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: NTSA waxay bulshada degmada Lamu ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: NTSA luongo oganda man Lamu County mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo manyo kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development calls on the community in Baringo County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi wa watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka ayaa ugu baaqay bulshada degmada Baringo inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116 si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyada.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oluongo oganda man Baringo County mondo omany namba 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo orit ngima skul.

English: FAO invites farmers in Baringo County to a free training on modern irrigation techniques this April.
Kiswahili: FAO inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Baringo kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji Aprili hii.
Somali: FAO waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Baringo tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: FAO gwelo jopur e gweng' mar Baringo mondo otim tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi yore mag lero pi e dwe mar April.

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages mothers in Kericho County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kericho kutembelea mrengo wa uzazi ulio karibu nao ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kericho inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo mine manie County mar Kericho mondo olimgi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response calls on parents in West Pokot County to have children under five screened for malaria during the August outreach.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuwafanyia watoto chini ya miaka mitano uchunguzi wa malaria wakati wa mawasiliano ya Agosti.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku baaqeysaa waalidiinta Gobolka West Pokot inay carruurta ka yar shan sano u sameeyaan baaritaanka cudurka daacuunka inta lagu gudajiro bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche kwayo jonyuol e West Pokot County mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Agost.

English: To treat chicken diarrhea naturally, some Tanzanian poultry farmers wash and cut ripe Aloe Vera leaves, squeeze out the juice, and mix it into the chickens' drinking water or feed - but consult a veterinarian first for the correct dosage for the chickens' age, and always keep the chicken house clean and provide a balanced diet alongside any natural remedy.
Kiswahili: Ili kutibu kuhara kwa kuku kwa kawaida, baadhi ya wafugaji wa kuku wa Tanzania huosha na kukata majani ya Aloe Vera yaliyoiva, kufinya juisi, na kuchanganya kwenye maji ya kunywa ya kuku au malisho - lakini wasiliana na daktari wa mifugo kwanza kwa kipimo sahihi cha umri wa kuku, na daima weka nyumba ya kuku safi na kutoa lishe bora pamoja na dawa yoyote ya asili.
Somali: Si ay u daaweeyaan ciridka digaagga si dabiici ah, qaar ka mid ah beeraleyda digaagga Tansaaniya waxay maydhaan oo gooyayaan caleemaha Aloe Vera ee bislaaday, waxay ku qasanayaan casiirka, waxayna ku qasi karaan biyaha digaagga ama quudinta - laakiin marka hore la tasho dhakhtarka xoolaha si aad u ogaatid qiyaasta saxda ah ee da'da digaagga, marwalba guriga digaagga si nadiif ah u ilaaliyo oo u siiya cunto dheelitiran oo ay la soc
Dholuo: Mondo ginyagre gi tuwo mar yadh-piende e yo makare, jopur moko ma pidho dhok e piny Tanzania lwoko kendo ng'ado kite ma osechopo e Aloe Vera, gichiwo pi ma gichuoyo, kae to gichiwe e pi modho kod chiemo ma gikwongo chamo - to mokwongo, ne laktar mar le mondo ong'e okang' mowinjore gi higni ma gikwongo tiyogo, kendo kinde duto rituru ot ma gikwongo chamo le kendo keturu chiemo mowinjore gi chiemo mapile.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit appeals to caregivers in Kirinyaga County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the January maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya harakati za afya ya uzazi Januari.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Kirinyaga inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Janaayo.

English: IPOA calls on the community in Kisumu County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.

English: During the 2025 GLASS reporting cycle, Rwanda began reporting both aggregate and individual-level data, ensuring continuity while transitioning to more detailed surveillance reporting.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa mzunguko wa kuripoti wa GLASS wa 2025, Rwanda ilianza kuripoti data ya jumla na ya kiwango cha mtu binafsi, kuhakikisha uendelevu wakati wa mpito kwa ripoti ya kina zaidi ya ufuatiliaji.
Somali: Intii lagu jiray wareegga warbixinta GLASS ee 2025, Rwanda waxay bilowday inay soo sheegto xogta guud iyo tan heerka shakhsi ahaaneed labadaba, iyadoo hubinaysa sii socoshada iyadoo u gudbaysa warbixinta kormeerka oo faahfaahsan.
Dholuo: E kinde ma ne itimo ripot mar GLASS e higa mar 2025, piny Rwanda nochako timo ripot mag weche ma oting’o weche duto kod weche ma ng’ato ka ng’ato oting’o, ma ne omiyo gik moko dhi nyime e seche ma ne olokore gi ripot ma ng’ato ka ng’ato onego ogol.

Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati huu wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
