Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar geng'o ji kik nege yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e County mar Vihiga.

English: Public notice: KEMSA will host a free hand hygiene outreach in Nandi County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMSA itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mikono bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Nandi Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: KEMSA waxay martigelin doontaa wacyi galinta nadaafadda gacmaha ee bilaashka ah ee gobolka Nandi bisha November.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMSA biro timo kampen mar rito ler mar lwedo e kaunti mar Nandi e dwe mar Novemba.

English: KRA urges eligible citizens in Kericho County to participate in polling procedures.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Kericho kushiriki katika utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kericho inay ka qaybqaataan nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo raia mag Kericho County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag yiero.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public that free suicide prevention support is available through county health facilities in Embu County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kuzuia kujiua unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo ka hortagga ismiidaaminta laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Embu County.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar geng'o ji kik donjre yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Embu.

English: Council of Governors reminds the public in Nairobi County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay xasuusinayaan shacabka degmada Nairobi in sheegashada khiyaamooyinka iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch paronwa ji duto e County mar Nairobi ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag ohala en gima onge nengo, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public in Narok County about the importance of hypertension awareness for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Narok juu ya umuhimu wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay dadka degmada Narok ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay wacyiga cadaadiska sare ee caafimaadka guryaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji duto e Narok County kuom ber mar miyo ji ong'e ni tuwo mar hypertension en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya launches the county integrated development plan in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay bilaabaysaa qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Huduma Kenya chako chenro mar dongruok e kaunti mar Kakamega County.

English: DPP alerts residents of Wajir County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: DPP anawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Somali: DPP waxay dadka deggan degmada Wajir uga digtay kororka kiisaska xoolaha lagu xado waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: DPP chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar Wajir County e wi medruok mar weche mag kwalo jamni kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag ritruok gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: USDA continues with farmer's sensitization on controlling viruses on poultry and livestock.
Kiswahili: USDA inaendelea na uhamasishaji wa mkulima juu ya kudhibiti virusi kwenye kuku na mifugo.
Somali: USDA waxay sii wadaa dareenka beeraleyda ee xakamaynta fayrasyada digaagga iyo xoolaha.
Dholuo: USDA dhi nyime gi jiwo jopur mondo ong'e kaka ginyalo geng'o tugo mar tugo kod dhok.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds farmers in Trans Nzoia County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia barnaamijka tababarka ka socda ka dib goosashada.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development parone jopur e county mar Trans Nzoia e wi program mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime bang' keyo.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Laikipia County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya utoaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca bogga shabakadda degmada si ay uga warqabaan bixinta adeegyada degmada.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng' County mar Laikipia mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche ma timore e wi tij lendo.

English: KICD partners with NGOs to train Early Childhood Development educators on inclusive teaching methods.
Kiswahili: KICD inashirikiana na mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali kuwazoeza walimu wa Maendeleo ya Utoto wa Mapema juu ya mbinu za kufundisha zinazojumuisha.
Somali: KICD waxay la shaqeyneysaa ururada aan dawliga ahayn si ay u tababaraan barayaasha horumarinta caruurnimada ugu horreysa hababka waxbarasho ee ka kooban.
Dholuo: KICD tiyo gi riwruoge maok mag sirkal e tiego jopuonjo e wi yore mag puonjo ma oriwo ji duto.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) calls on parents in Wajir County to have children under five screened for meningitis during the August outreach.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa ugonjwa wa uti wa mgongo wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Agosti.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta Gobolka Wajir in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro meningitis inta lagu jiro adeegga bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) kwayo jonyuol e County mar Wajir mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Agost.

English: IPOA alerts residents of Taita-Taveta County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Somali: IPOA waxay dadka deggan degmada Taita-Taveta uga digtay kororka kiisaska tuugada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: IPOA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Taita-Taveta County ni kwan mag joma ok oluoro Nyasaye biro medore kendo ojiwo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Run an efficient pack house to ensure consistent quality sorting grading and packaging of meat before sale
Kiswahili: Endesha duka la kuhifadhia nyama kwa ufanisi ili kuhakikisha upangaji upangaji na ufungashaji wa nyama kwa ubora unaolingana kabla ya kuuzwa
Somali: Maamul guri xirmooyin hufan si loo hubiyo tayada joogtada ah, kala soocidda, kala soocidda, iyo baakadaha hilibka ka hor iibinta ka hor inta aan la iibin
Dholuo: Tiyo gi ot ma nigi tich maber mar loso gik moko mondo omi ng'ato obed gi ratiro mar loso gik moko e yo makare kendo mondo okawgi e yo maber kapok ouso

English: Notice: KTDA restricts movement of dairy cows in Homa Bay County due to an anthrax outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA inazuia harakati za ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kutokana na mlipuko wa kimeta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da caanaha ah ee gobolka Homa Bay sababo la xiriira cudurka Anthrax.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok makwayo e Homa Bay County nikech tuwo mar anthrax.

English: KUCCPS conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Siaya County this August.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Siaya Agosti hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada ee degmada Siaya bishii Ogosto.
Dholuo: KUCCPS dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e dwe mar Agost e wi riwruok mar oganda mar ji duto e bajet mar county e county mar Siaya.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds the public in Murang'a County to remain vigilant on border security.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Uhalifu unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka degmada Murang'a ku xasuusinaya in ay ka feejignaadaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne ji duto e county mar Murang'a ni gibed motang' ne sirkal mar boda.

English: Promoting integrated solutions through capacity building in Refugee settlement
Kiswahili: Kukuza suluhu zilizounganishwa kwa kujenga uwezo katika makazi ya Wakimbizi
Somali: Horumarinta xalalka isku dhafan iyada oo loo marayo dhisidda awoodda degsiimooyinka Qaxootiga
Dholuo: Keto yore mag dwoko penjo ma oriw kokalo kuom gero nyalo e kar dak mar jolweny

English: Notice: KALRO will train farmers in Nyeri County on terracing this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri juu ya mashindano Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: KALRO waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Nyeri oo ku saabsan dhulka lagu beerayo bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KALRO biro tiego jopur e County mar Nyeri e wi timo terracing e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: KICD announces school feeding programme enrollment dates for schools in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa programu ya kulisha shule kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiyada degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KICD olando tarik mag dhi e skunde mag Kisumu County.

English: KALRO encourages farmers in Lamu County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for horticultural produce.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa ili kupata bei bora za mazao ya bustani.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Lamu inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay wax soo saarka beeraha.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e county mar Lamu mondo oti gi nengo mar piny mosingi mondo giyud nengo maber mar yiende mag puodho.

English: Food entry points have started negotiations as agreed in counties that they start reporting under CNAP
Kiswahili: Vituo vya kuingia chakula wameanza mazungumzo kama ilivyokubaliwa katika kaunti kwamba kuanza kuripoti chini ya CNAP
Somali: Goobaha cuntada lagu galo waxay bilaabeen wadahadalada sida lagu heshiiyey degmooyinka in ay bilaabaan inay ka warbixiyaan CNAP
Dholuo: Yore mag donjo e chiemo osechako tudore kaka osewinjore e gwenge ma gichako chiwo ripode e bwo CNAP

English: Ruto urges Wundanyi residents to register under SHA
Kiswahili: Ruto anawahimiza wakazi wa Wundanyi kujiandikisha chini ya SHA
Somali: Ruto wuxuu ku booriyay dadka deggan Wundanyi inay iska diiwaangeliyaan SHA
Dholuo: Ruto jiwo jogweng ' mar Wundanyi mondo odonj e bwo chenro mar SHA

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds livestock keepers in Siaya County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Siaya inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha ka guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyada oo aan la helin rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service parone jorit jamni e county mar Siaya ni kik giting' jamni ka ok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: KEMRI urges residents of Narok County to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility following a rise in reported HIV/AIDS cases.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya VVU/UKIMWI.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Narok inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow kadib kororka kiisaska HIV / AIDS ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuo mar AYAKI/AIDS osemedore.

English: Narok County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Narok: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Juni 2022
Somali: Degmada Narok: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Narok: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2022

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Baringo County about the importance of tobacco control for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuhusu umuhimu wa udhibiti wa tumbaku kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay dadka degmada Baringo ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay ka hortagga sigaarka ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji duto e County mar Baringo ni thieth mar ndawa en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Kenya steps up political, multisector, and interdisciplinary actions towards nutrition resilience
Kiswahili: Kenya inapiga hatua za kisiasa, sekta nyingi, na taaluma mbalimbali kuelekea kustahimili lishe
Somali: Kenya waxay xoojineysaa tallaabooyin siyaasadeed, kuwo dhinacyo badan leh, iyo kuwo isku xiran oo ku wajahan adkeysiga nafaqada
Dholuo: Kenya omedo timo gik moko mag siasa, mag migepe mathoth, kod mag puonj mopogore opogore mag rito chiemo ma nigi gik ma konyo e ringruok

English: IGAD commits to improving food and nutrition security in Africa. Data shows 21% of people across IGAD member states are food insecure
Kiswahili: IGAD imejitolea kuboresha usalama wa chakula na lishe barani Afrika. Takwimu zinaonyesha 21% ya watu katika nchi wanachama wa IGAD hawana uhakika wa chakula
Somali: IGAD waxay ka go'an tahay in la wanaajiyo ammaanka cuntada iyo nafaqada ee Afrika.
Dholuo: IGAD ochiwore mondo otim dongruok e weche mag chiemo kod chiemb chuny e Afrika.

English: Kenya - Garissa County - Dadaab - Dagahaley Refugee Camp - Administration Offices and Community Facilities Infrastructure - as of May 2022
Kiswahili: Kenya - Kaunti ya Garissa - Dadaab - Kambi ya Wakimbizi ya Dagahaley - Ofisi za Utawala na Miundombinu ya Vifaa vya Jamii - hadi Mei 2022
Somali: Kenya - Degmada Garissa - Dadaab - Xerada Qaxootiga Dhagaxley - Xafiisyada Maamulka iyo Kaabayaasha Adeegyada Bulshada - laga bilaabo Maajo 2022
Dholuo: Kenya - Oganda mar Garissa - Dadaab - Kambi mar Jolweny - Apis mag Loch kod Gedo mag Oganda - chakre Mei 2022

English: KMTC urges residents of Garissa County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Garissa inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KMTC jiwo ji duto modak e gweng' mar Garissa mondo okonygi kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud somo mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: KEPHIS urges beans growers in Narok County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Narok kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Narok inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu talinayo roobka ka hor si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur ma pidho keyo e gweng' mar Narok mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue mondo omed nyak e higani.

English: NTSA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Siaya County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: NTSA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Siaya piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Siaya inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e County mar Siaya mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195 maonge chudo.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na ugawaji wa bursary.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan deeq lacageed.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo odonj e program mar puonjo ji somo gi somo ne joma dongo mondo giyud konyruok kuom chenrono.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) calls on parents in Mombasa County to have children under five screened for typhoid during the February outreach.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuwachunguza watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa homa ya matumbo wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Februari.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Mombasa in carruurta ka yar shan sano la baaro cudurka tifooska inta lagu gudajiro bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) kwayo jonyuol e county mar Mombasa mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Februar.

English: KEMSA encourages mothers in Nairobi County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhudhuria siku iliyopangwa ya kliniki ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Nairobi inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta caafimaad ee la qorsheeyay si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo mine man Nairobi County mondo odhi e odiechieng'no mar thieth mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Universities Fund advises applicants in Kirinyaga County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kutembelea kituo cha mafunzo ya ufundi kilicho karibu kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku talinayaa codsadayaasha degmada Kirinyaga inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee la heli karo.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e gweng' mar Kirinyaga mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of Mandera County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' mar Mandera County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Narok County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Narok inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyadoo la sii xoojinayo amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji ng'enyie e bwo sirkal.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges eligible citizens in Garissa County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Garissa kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Garissa inay ka qaybqaataan jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro mar yiero e county mar Garissa mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar yiero.

English: AFA urges farmers in Samburu County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: AFA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Samburu inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e county mar Samburu mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e weche mag pur mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Council of Governors urges residents of Baringo County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku boorinayaan dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga guud ee golaha gobolka si ay uga warqabaan bixinta adeegyada degmada.
Dholuo: Council of Governors jiwo jogweng' mar Baringo County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo gibed molony gi weche ma timore e wi tiegruok mar gwenge.

English: KMTC calls on the community in Nairobi County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KMTC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: KMTC waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Nairobi inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116 si ay u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: KMTC okwayo ji duto manie County mar Nairobi mondo omany namba mar 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Notice: NTSA activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NTSA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay shilalka waddooyinka ee Gobolka Garissa.
Dholuo: Rapar: NTSA tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne masiche mag ndara e gweng' mar Garissa.

English: Notice: IEBC opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay ka furaysaa goob adeeg cusub oo lagu shaqeynayo shahaadada dhalashada ee degmada Meru.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mar loso barua mag nyuol e County mar Meru.

English: African governments are urged to invest in regional agricultural infrastructure and innovation to build resilient food systems in collaboration with international partners
Kiswahili: Serikali za Afrika zimehimizwa kuwekeza katika miundombinu ya kilimo na ubunifu wa kikanda ili kujenga mifumo thabiti ya chakula kwa kushirikiana na washirika wa kimataifa.
Somali: Dowladaha Afrika waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyay inay maalgeliyaan kaabayaasha beeraha ee gobollada iyo hal-abuurka si loo dhiso nidaamyo cunto oo adkaysi leh iyagoo la kaashanaya la-hawlgalayaasha caalamiga ah
Dholuo: Oganda Afrika ijiwo mondo ogol pesa e yore mag pur mag pinyno kod e yore mag timo dongruok mondo gichak loso chenro mag chiemo ma nigi teko e kind pinje mamoko

English: Universities Fund reminds schools in Murang'a County to strengthen school infrastructure safety this January.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuimarisha usalama wa miundombinu ya shule Januari hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xusuusinayaa dugsiyada degmada Murang'a inay xoojiyaan ammaanka kaabayaasha dugsiga bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund oparo ne skunde man Murang'a County mondo omed jiwo ritruok mar chenro mag skul e dwe mar Januar.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Wajir County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Wajir mondo odonj e riwruok mar insuarans mar thieth mondo giyud thieth makonyogi.

English: KEMSA calls on parents in Kisii County to have children under five screened for cholera during the May outreach.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuwapima watoto chini ya miaka mitano kipindupindu wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Mei.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Kisii in caruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka kolera inta lagu jiro safarka bisha May.
Dholuo: KEMSA okwayo jonyuol e County mar Kisii mondo otim nonro mar cholera ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Mei.

English: CDC encourages residents of Kirinyaga County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay la xiriiraan lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo jogweng' Kirinyaga County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giwuo gi jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Embu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu soo saaray digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Embu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Forest Service ogolo siem mar sirkal e wi weche mag cybersecurity e wi chenro mag gwelo pesa mag miriambo makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Embu County.

English: Register your childÂ’s birth early to secure legal identity and access to services.
Kiswahili: Sajili kuzaliwa kwa mtoto wako mapema ili kupata utambulisho halali na upatikanaji wa huduma.
Somali: Diiwaangeli dhalashada ilmahaaga goor hore si aad u hesho aqoonsi sharci iyo helitaanka adeegyada.
Dholuo: Ndik nyuol mar nyathini mapiyo mondo iyud ng’eyo ma chik oyiego kendo yudo kony.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette launches county development projects in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Kenya Gazette waxay bilawday mashaariic horumarineed oo ka socda degmada Meru.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Gazette chako tich mar timo dongruok e alwora mar Meru County.

English: The Committee on World Food Security CFS continues to promote food security and nutrition for all All stakeholders are encouraged to participate in this multistakeholder platform
Kiswahili: Kamati ya Usalama wa Chakula Duniani CFS inaendelea kuhimiza usalama wa chakula na lishe kwa wote Wadau wote wanahimizwa kushiriki katika jukwaa hili la wadau wengi.
Somali: Guddiga Amniga CFS ee Cuntada Adduunka wuxuu sii wadaa inuu dhiirrigeliyo amniga cuntada iyo nafaqada dhammaan daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qaybgalaan barxadan daneeyayaasha badan
Dholuo: Komiti mar Piny Mangima mar Yudo Riwruok mar Oganda Matut (CFS) dhi nyime jiwo weche mag chiemo kod chiemo ne ji duto.

English: Air pollution fuels lung cancer among non-smokers
Kiswahili: Uchafuzi wa hewa husababisha kansa ya mapafu miongoni mwa wasiovuta sigara
Somali: Qiiqa hawada wuxuu u horseedaa kansarka sanbabada dadka aan sigaarka cabin
Dholuo: Richo mar kor lwasi miyo joma ok madho ndawa bedo gi kansa mar obo

English: IPOA calls on residents of Kisumu County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of border security.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaomba wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga waxqabadka aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah si ay u taageeraan amniga xuduudda.
Dholuo: IPOA okwayo jogweng' mar Kisumu County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma rito tong'o ni gitimo gik maok kare e alworano.

English: NDMA warns residents of Nairobi County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: NDMA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi kororka khiyaamada SIM-swap waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: NDMA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nairobi County e wi medruok mar mibadhi mar SIM swap kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: Gov't now calls for wearing of masks, vaccination as Kenya faces 6th COVID-19 wave
Kiswahili: Serikali sasa yatoa wito wa kuvaa barakoa na chanjo huku Kenya ikikabiliwa na wimbi la 6 la COVID-19
Somali: Dowladda ayaa hadda ku baaqeysa in la xidho maaskaro, la tallaalo maadaama Kenya ay wajahdo hirkii lixaad ee COVID-19
Dholuo: Sirkal koro dwaro ni ng'ato orwak mask, oti gi thieth kaka Kenya romo gi masira mar 6 mar COVID-19

English: As we stay home & celebrate Easter holiday, we are reminded about our mental health. Be keen on what you consume as information during these troubled times, be mindful about your health & that of others. Share love, not panic & fear
Kiswahili: Tunapokaa nyumbani na kusherehekea sikukuu ya Pasaka, tunakumbushwa kuhusu afya yetu ya akili. Kuwa makini na kile unachotumia kama taarifa wakati huu wa matatizo, kuwa makini na afya yako na ya wengine. Shiriki upendo, si hofu na hofu.
Somali: Marka aan guriga joogno oo aan dabaaldegno ciidaha Easter, waxaan xusuusaneynaa caafimaadka maskaxdeena. Ka taxaddar waxa aad u cuntid sida macluumaad inta lagu jiro wakhtiyadaas dhibaatada leh, ka taxadar caafimaadkaaga & kuwa kale. La wadaag jacayl, ma aha baqdin & cabsi
Dholuo: Sama wan pacho kendo wamor gi nyasi mar Pasaka, waparo kaka ngimawa chalo e pachwa. Beduru motang' gi gik ma uchamo e kinde matekgi, beduru moikore ne ngimau koda mar jomamoko. Wuouru e wi hera, to kik ubed gi luoro kod luoro

English: New announcement through sent SMS with some advice on new mosquitoes that feed in every week, food management and plan for all those that have registered
Kiswahili: Tangazo jipya kupitia ujumbe uliotumwa na ushauri juu ya mbu mpya wanaokula kila wiki, usimamizi wa chakula na mpango kwa wale wote ambao wamejiandikisha
Somali: Ogeysiis cusub oo lagu soo diro SMS oo la siinayo talooyin ku saabsan cayayaanka cusub ee todobaad kasta quudiya, maareynta cuntada iyo qorshe loogu talagalay dhammaan kuwa isdiiwaangaliyay
Dholuo: Chenro manyien mar oro ote kokalo kuom SMS moting'o paro moko e wi lum manyien ma pidho ji juma ka juma, chenro mar rito chiemo kod chenro mar jogo duto mosendiko

English: NTSA alerts residents of Tana River County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: NTSA waxay ka digtay dadka deggan degmada Tana River in ay kordheen kiisaska tuugada waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar Tana River County e wi kwan mag joma oketho kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Climate Change Is Controlling Everything, Let Them Compensate Us": Stories Of Loss And Damage In Kenya
Kiswahili: Mabadiliko ya Hali ya Hewa Yanadhibiti Kila Kitu, Waache Watulipe Fidia": Hadithi za Hasara na Uharibifu nchini Kenya
Somali: Isbeddelka Cimiladu Wax Walba Wuu Xakameynayaa, Ha Na Magdhawaan": Sheekooyinka Khasaaraha Iyo Khasaaraha Ka Dhashay Kenya
Dholuo: Loch mag piny ema rito gik moko duto, wegi ochulwa": Sigana mag ketho kod ketho e piny Kenya

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief, October 2024
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP Kenya, Oktoba 2024
Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya, Oktoobar 2024
Dholuo: Wach machuok mar piny Kenya mar WFP, dwe mar apar higa mar 2024

English: IPOA calls on the community in Siaya County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Siaya kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu ya simu ya GBV 1195.
Somali: IPOA waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Siaya inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wici doonaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: IPOA luongo ji duto e county mar Siaya mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong simo mar GBV 1195.

English: Guide older children to handle babies gently to prevent unintentional harm.
Kiswahili: Waongoze watoto wakubwa kuwashughulikia watoto kwa upole ili kuzuia madhara yasiyokusudiwa.
Somali: Carruurta da'da weyn ha u hoggaamiyaan ilmaha si jilicsan si looga hortago waxyeelada aan ula kac ahayn.
Dholuo: Tieg nyithindo madongo mondo oting' nyithindgi e yo mamuol mondo kik gitim gimoro marach ma ok ging'eyo.

English: Notice: DCI issues a cybersecurity alert on SIM-swap fraud affecting residents of Narok County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DCI inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM ambao unaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Ogaysiis: DCI waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaanooyinka SIM-swap ee saameeya dadka deggan gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: DCI ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity kuom wuond mag SIM-swap makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Narok County.

English: State Department for Basic Education advises applicants in Bomet County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Bomet kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Bomet inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State for Basic Education nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Bomet ni mondo gidonj e tiegruok kapok iketho skundno.

English: Ban on all public gatherings extended to May 29 to curb the spread of Covid-19.
Kiswahili: Marufuku ya mikusanyiko yote ya umma yaongezwa hadi Mei 29 ili kupunguza kuenea kwa Covid-19.
Somali: Mamnuucidda dhammaan isu imaatinka dadweynaha ayaa la kordhiyay illaa May 29 si loo xakameeyo faafitaanka COVID-19.
Dholuo: Chenro mar geng'o chokruoge duto mag ji osemedore nyaka tarik 29 dwe mar abich mondo otiek landruok mar Covid-19.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya launches county development projects in Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay bilowday mashaariic horumarineed oo ka socda degmada Kiambu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Huduma Kenya chako tije mag dongruok e county ma Kiambu County.

English: Notice: IPOA launches a fraud prevention campaign in Taita-Taveta County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga khiyaamooyinka Gobolka Taita-Taveta bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA chako kampen mar geng'o wuondruok e taon mar Taita-Taveta e dwe mar Mach.

English: IEBC reminds residents of Bomet County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba upatikanaji wa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: IEBC parone jogweng'o mag Bomet County ni sani yudo weche mag kwayo nyuol nyalo bedo mayot ka gitiyo gi yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Highlights youth musicians promoting civic action
Kiswahili: Inasisitiza wanamuziki vijana wanaoendeleza vitendo vya kiraia
Somali: Waxay soo bandhigeysaa muusikada dhalinyarada ah ee dhiirigelinaya dhaqdhaqaaqa rayidka ah
Dholuo: Onyiso jothum ma rowere ma jiwo timbe mag oganda

English: NTSA alerts residents of Busia County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Somali: NTSA waxay dadka deggan degmada Busia uga digtay kororka kiisaska xanta xoolaha waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan wadaagista faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' County mar Busia e wi medruok mar weche mag kwalo jamni kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag ritruok gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Laikipia County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Laikipia: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2022
Somali: Degmada Laikipia: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Laikipia: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar adek higa mar 2022

English: Locally Led Climate Action for Sustainable Community Resilience
Kiswahili: Hatua za Hali ya Hewa zinazoongozwa na Mashinani kwa Ustahimilivu wa Jamii
Somali: Ficilka Cimilada ee Deegaanka ku Hoggaaminaya ee loogu talagalay Adkeysiga Bulshada ee Waara
Dholuo: Tich mar weche mag kor lwasi ma otelo ne jodak mag alwora mondo obed gi teko mar oganda

English: The corona virus, as of today still has no cure, neither is there a vaccine. The only available means of defence against it is the containment measures; Mutahi Kagwe, CAS Health. #KomeshaCorona update.
Kiswahili: Virusi vya corona, hadi leo bado havina tiba, wala hakuna chanjo. Njia pekee inayopatikana ya ulinzi dhidi yake ni hatua za kuzuia; Mutahi Kagwe, CAS Afya. #KomeshaCorona sasisho.
Somali: Fayraska korona, ilaa maantadan la joogo, weli daawo ma lahan, tallaalna ma jiro. Habka kaliya ee looga hortagi karo waa tallaabooyinka xakamaynta; Mutahi Kagwe, CAS Health. #CusbooneysiintaKomeshaCorona.
Dholuo: Virus mar corona, nyaka sani pod onge thieth, kendo onge chanjo. Yo kende ma nitie mar geng’ruok kuome en yore mag geng’o; Mutahi Kagwe, CAS Thieth. #KomeshaKorona ma manyien.

English: Kenya is pushing forward with its international labour initiatives by sending 350 seasonal workers to the United Kingdom, despite the recent wave of violent protests that have rocked the former coloni...
Kiswahili: Kenya inaendeleza mipango yake ya kimataifa ya kazi kwa kutuma wafanyakazi 350 wa msimu nchini Uingereza, licha ya wimbi la hivi karibuni la maandamano yenye vurugu ambayo yamegonga koloni ya zamani...
Somali: Kenya waxay horumarineysaa dadaalkeeda shaqaalaha caalamiga ah iyada oo 350 shaqaale xilliyeed ay u dirayaan Boqortooyada Ingiriiska, inkastoo hirarka ugu dambeeyay ee dibadbaxyada rabshadaha ah ee ruxay gumeysigii hore...
Dholuo: Kenya dhi nyime gi chenro mare mar tiyo e pinje mang'eny kuom oro jotich 350 e piny Ingresa, kata obedo ni ji osebedo ka goyo mbaka mager e pinyno...

English: AFA reminds farmers in Murang'a County of the ongoing modern irrigation techniques training programme.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Murang'a juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Murang'a barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah.
Dholuo: AFA oparo ne jopur e county mar Murang'a chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar yore mag lero pi.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Nairobi County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the January planting season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Januari.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nairobi inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Janaayo.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e County mar Nairobi mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Januar.

English:
Your health is our priority! No one should face TB alone. Get tested early and access FREE treatment at your nearest public health facility.
Together, we can end TB in Kenya!
Kiswahili: Afya yako ni kipaumbele chetu! Hakuna mtu anayepaswa kukabiliana na kifua kikuu peke yake. Fanya mtihani mapema na upate matibabu ya BURE katika kituo chako cha afya ya umma kilicho karibu zaidi. Pamoja, tunaweza kumaliza kifua Kikuu nchini Kenya!
Somali: Caafimaadkaaga ayaa ah mudnaantaada! Qofna waa inuusan keligiis la kulmi karin cudurka TB. Tijaabi si dhakhso ah oo u hel daaweyn BILAASH ah xarunta caafimaadka dadweynaha ee kuugu dhow. Wadajir, waxaan joojin karnaa TB Kenya!
Dholuo: Onge ng'ato ang'ata monego onyagre gi tuwo mar TB kende, tim nonro chon kendo iyud thieth ma onge chudo e osiptal ma ni machiegni kodi.

English: DCI reminds residents of Meru County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada daadadka ka dhacay xilligan dabka.
Dholuo: DCI oparo ne jogweng' mar Meru County ni kik giwuoth e kind yiengni mag mach e kinde ma pi opong'o ponde kod aoche.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of Nakuru County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay u dhiiri galiyaan saaxiibo dhibaataysan inay caawimaad raadsadaan.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' Nakuru County mondo kik gisandre aling' ling' kendo mondo gijiw osiepgi moro ma chandore omany kony.

English: Penetrating markets has been the undoing amongst farmers who rear cattle for beef...market availability as a challenge coupled with unpredictable weather. This challenge weakens..
Kiswahili: Kupenya kwa masoko kumekuwa uharibifu kati ya wakulima wanaofuga ng'ombe kwa nyama ya ng'ombe... Upatikanaji wa soko kama changamoto pamoja na hali ya hewa isiyotabirika. Changamoto hii inadhoofika..
Somali: Suuqyada soo galitaanka ayaa ahaa mid aan la awoodin dadka beeraleyda ah ee xoolaha u soo koraya... suuqa la heli karo waa caqabad la xidhiidha cimilada aan la saadaalin karin.
Dholuo: Bedo ni piny ne ok nyal bedo maber nikech ndalo ne ok nyal rumo, mano osemiyo jopur ma pidho dhok obedo gi luoro ahinya.

English: IEBC reminds parents in Kakamega County that bursary allocation registration is open this January.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba usajili wa ugawaji wa bursary umefunguliwa Januari hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Kakamega in diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ay furan tahay bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: IEBC parone jonyuol e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni kad mar chiwo mich mag tiegruok osechakore e dwe mar Januar.

English: KNEC reminds needy students in Elgeyo-Marakwet County that school laptops under the digital literacy programme applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya maombi ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika za kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KNEC waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in laptop-yada dugsiga ee ku jira codsiyada barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: KNEC parone jopuonjre man gi chandruok e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni kompyuta mag skul manie program mar digital literacy program chiegni rumo.

English: E-Citizen announces improved turnaround times for e-Citizen registration in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujiandikisha kwa e- Citizen katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-Dadku ee Gobolka Kericho.
Dholuo: E-Citizen lando lokruok e seche mag dhi e chokruoge mag e - Citizen e County mar Kericho.

English: Priority for bursary to needy TVET students.
Kiswahili: Kipaumbele cha ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wa TVET wenye uhitaji.
Somali: Horumarinta deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay ardayda TVET ee u baahan.
Dholuo: Tiego jopuonjre ma nigi chan e TVET en gima dwarore ahinya.

English: Notice: DCI conducts a community briefing on border security in Garissa County this August.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Garissa Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha ee Gobolka Garissa bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni DCI biro timo romo mar alwora e dwe mar Agost e wi weche mag rito tong' e gweng' mar Garissa.

English: As rainfall increases and soils become saturated, farmers are encouraged to properly prepare their fields to reduce the risk of flooding and minimize damage to crops, including creating drainage channels where possible to prevent waterlogging.
Kiswahili: Mvua inapoongezeka na udongo kujaa, wakulima wanatiwa moyo kutayarisha mashamba yao ifaavyo ili kupunguza mafuriko na kupunguza uharibifu wa mazao, kutia ndani kufanyiza mifereji ya kuondoa maji inapowezekana ili kuzuia maji yasipenye.
Somali: Maaddaama roobabka ay sii kordhayaan oo ciidda ay buuxsamaan, beeralayda waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay si habboon u diyaariyaan beerahooda si loo yareeyo halista fatahaadaha iyo in la yareeyo waxyeelada dalagga, oo ay ku jiraan abuurista kanaalada biyo-xireenka meesha ay suurtagal tahay si looga hortago biyo-xireenka.
Dholuo: Kaka koth medore kendo lowo medo bedo mopong', ijiwo jopur mondo oik puothegi e yo makare mondo omi oketh nengo mar koth kendo omed ketho cham, moriwo nyaka loso yore mag ywayo pi kuonde ma nyalore mondo omi kik pi opong' piny.

English: Notice: COMESA will train farmers in Kilifi County on conservation tillage this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi juu ya kilimo cha uhifadhi Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Kilifi ee ku saabsan beerashada ilaalinta bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA biro tiego jopur e gweng' mar Kilifi e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e gweng' mar Kisumu.

English: Kenya | Cholera - Simplified Early Action Protocol (EAP No.: sEAP2025KE04, Operation No: MDRKE071)
Kiswahili: Kenya | Kipindupindu - Itifaki ya Hatua ya Mapema Iliyorahisishwa (EAP Na.: sEAP2025KE04, Nambari ya Operesheni: MDRKE071)
Somali: Kenya | Daacuunka - Hab-raaca Ficilka Hore ee La Fududeeyay (Lambarka EAP: s EAP2025KE04, Lambarka Hawlgalka: MDRKE071)
Dholuo: Kenya | Kolera - Yore mayot mar timo gik moko mapiyo (namba mar EAP: namba mar tije: MDRKE071)

English: Grade 7 free feeding program starts Jan Ã¢Â€Â“ 3 meals daily guaranteed!
Kiswahili: Programu ya kulisha bila malipo ya Darasa la 7 inaanza Januari Ã¢Â€Â“ Milo 3 kila siku imehakikishwa!
Somali: Barnaamijka quudinta bilaashka ah ee fasalka 7aad wuxuu bilaabmayaa Jan â€œ3 cunto oo la hubo maalin kasta!
Dholuo: Program mar chiwo chiemo ma nono mar klas mar 7 chakore dwe mar achiel, chiemo 3 pile ka pile nigi geno!

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Kitui County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga kama dambaysta ah si loo qaabeeyo goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' Kitui County mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso chenro mag dongruok.

English: Tana River County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tana River: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Aprili 2023
Somali: Degmada Tana River: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Aora Tana: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Ang’wen 2023

English: Motorcycle ambulance helps pregnant women in drought-stricken community to access life-saving maternal health care
Kiswahili: Ambulance ya pikipiki husaidia wanawake wajawazito katika jamii iliyokumbwa na ukame kupata huduma ya afya ya uzazi ya kuokoa maisha
Somali: Ambalaasyada mootooyinka ayaa ka caawiya haweenka uurka leh ee bulshada abaartu saameysay inay helaan daryeelka caafimaadka hooyada ee badbaadinaya nolosha.
Dholuo: Ambulans mar pikipiki konyo mon ma nigi ich e gwenge ma opong’ gi oro mondo oyud thieth ma nyalo reso ngimagi

English: IPOA issued updates on detainee fatality investigations and outlined measures to improve custodial conditions.
Kiswahili: IPOA ilitoa taarifa mpya kuhusu uchunguzi wa vifo vya wafungwa na kuainisha hatua za kuboresha hali ya kifungo.
Somali: IPOA waxay soo saartay macluumaad ku saabsan baaritaannada dhimashada maxaabiista waxaana lagu soo bandhigay tallaabooyin lagu hagaajinayo xaaladaha xabsiga.
Dholuo: IPOA ne ogolo weche manyien e wi nonro ma ne otim kuom tho mag joma notwe kendo ne olero okang' ma ne onego oluw mondo omed bedo gi ngima maber e jela.

English: Notice: KTDA will distribute certified sorghum seed to farmers in Bungoma County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KTDA itasambaza mbegu zilizothibitishwa za sorghum kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay ku qeybin doontaa abuurka sorghum-ka ee la caddeeyay beeraleyda degmada Bungoma bishii Maarso ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KTDA biro pogo kodhi mag sorghum ne jopur man Bungoma County e dwe mar Mach.

English: Trucks ferrying top dressing fertilizer are now arriving at the Eldoret Depot of the National Cereals and Produce Board Farmers are encouraged to collect their supplies
Kiswahili: Malori ya kubeba mbolea ya kukuzia sasa yanawasili katika Bohari ya Eldoret ya Bodi ya Kitaifa ya Nafaka na Mazao Wakulima wanahimizwa kukusanya vifaa vyao.
Somali: Gaadiidka qaada bacriminta dharka sare ayaa hadda imaanaya Eldoret Depot ee Guddiga Qaranka ee Hadhuudhka iyo Khudaarta Beeraha waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyay inay ururiyaan alaabtooda
Dholuo: Loche mag wuoth miting'o yien ma nigi kit lewni mabeyo sani chopo e Eldoret Depot mar National Cereals and Produce Board

English: IEBC reminds the public in Taita-Taveta County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this November.
Kiswahili: IEBC inakumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kwamba maoni juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma yanakaribishwa Novemba hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Taita-Taveta in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha la soo dhaweynayo bisha November.
Dholuo: IEBC parone ji duto manie Taita-Taveta County ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mag sirkal e dwe mar Novemba.

English: The Salvation Army response to unexpected flooding in Turkana, northern Kenya
Kiswahili: Jeshi la Wokovu likikabiliana na mafuriko yasiyotarajiwa huko Turkana, kaskazini mwa Kenya
Somali: Jawaabta Ciidanka Badbaadada ee daadad aan la fileyn oo ka dhacay Turkana, waqooyiga Kenya
Dholuo: Jolweny mag Warruok ne odwoko bang' pi ma ne oumo piny Turkana, nyandwat mar piny Kenya

English: Announcing release of 2025 guidelines recommending physical activity routines across age groups to support wellness.
Kiswahili: Kutangaza kutolewa kwa miongozo ya 2025 inayopendekeza mazoea ya mazoezi ya mwili katika vikundi vyote vya umri kusaidia ustawi.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida soo saarista Tilmaamaha 2025 ee ku talinaya dhaqdhaqaaqyada jimicsiga guud ahaan kooxaha da'da si loo taageero caafimaadka.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova biro chiwo paro e wi chenro mag timo gik moko e yor ringruok e higa mar 2025 mondo okony ji obed gi winjruok maber gi Nyasaye.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Baringo County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on community-based development programmes.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jogweng' Baringo County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono ka gitiyo gi websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mag dongruok mag oganda.

English: Notice from SHA (Social Health Authority): family planning counselling clinics will run every May at designated health centres in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii): kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Mei katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada): rugaha la talinta qorshaynta qoyska waxaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Maajo ee kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Kwale.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar SHA (Social Health Authority): klinik mag chiwo paro e wi chenro mar ngima joot biro tiyo e dwe mar Mei higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e county mar Kwale.

English: Kenya Medical Association calls on parents in Vihiga County to have children under five screened for HIV/AIDS during the February outreach.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuwapima watoto chini ya miaka mitano VVU/UKIMWI wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Februari.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqay waalidiinta degmada Vihiga in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro HIV/AIDS inta lagu jiro bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association okwayo jonyuol e County mar Vihiga mondo otim nonro mar HIV/AIDS ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: ODPP opens voter education centres in Samburu County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Samburu Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay furaysaa xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee Gobolka Samburu bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: ODPP biro yawo kuonde tiego josiasa e county mar Samburu e dwe mar Februar.

English: DCI reminds mobile money users in Narok County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha watumiaji wa fedha za simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Narok kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa pesa za simu.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Narok inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: DCI paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mobil e Narok County mondo ochiw ripot mar ote maok kare ne jatendgi mondo kik gitim timbe mag wuondruok.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kajiado County that access to the GBV toll-free helpline is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kajiado County kwamba upatikanaji wa simu ya GBV ya bure ya msaada unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ee ka dhacay degmada Kajiado in helitaanka khadka caawimaadda ee GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah uu yahay mid lacag-la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e Kajiado County ni gibiro yudo kony ma onge chudo mar GBV maonge chudo.

English: Garissa County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Garissa: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Juni 2022
Somali: Degmada Garissa: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Garissa: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2022

English: Kenya Gazette encourages first-time voters in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawatia moyo wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo josiasa ma ne okwongo yiero e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero.

English: Join or start a neighborhood watch program in your area.
Kiswahili: Jiunge au anza programu ya ulinzi wa ujirani katika eneo lako.
Somali: Ku biir ama bilow barnaamij lagu ilaaliyo xaafadaada.
Dholuo: Bed achiel kuomgi kata chak chenro mar bedo jarit alwora e alworau.

English: NPS reminds residents of Nyandarua County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati wa msimu huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lugta ku mara inta lagu jiro xilliyada dhulgariirada.
Dholuo: NPS parone jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo oti gi yore mag wuotho e kinde mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) will hold a public participation forum on development planning forums in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta ee Degmada Mandera.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag dongruok e county mar Mandera.

English: Public launch event held to introduce the MoreMilk 2 initiative intended to enhance milk handling and market access in key milk-producing counties.
Kiswahili: Hafla ya uzinduzi wa hadhara ilifanyika ili kutambulisha mpango wa MoreMilk2 unaolenga kuboresha utunzaji wa maziwa na upatikanaji wa soko katika kaunti muhimu zinazozalisha maziwa.
Somali: Munaasabad lagu daah-furayay dadweynaha ayaa loo qabtay si loogu soo bandhigo hindisaha MoreMilk 2 oo loogu talagalay in lagu wanaajiyo maaraynta caanaha iyo helitaanka suuqa ee degmooyinka muhiimka ah ee soo saara caanaha.
Dholuo: E chokruok mar keto chak e wang’ ji duto ma ne otim mondo onyis chenro mar MoreMilk 2 ma ne ochung’ne bero kaka itiyo gi chak kod yudo chiro e kaunti madongo ma kelo chak.

English: DPP reminds residents of Bungoma County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: DPP anawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma in warbixinta degdegga ah ee xanta xoolaha ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogweng'o mag Bungoma County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo jamni konyo rito alwora.

English: TVET calls on the community in Murang'a County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TVET inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TVET waxay bulshada degmada Murang'a ugu baaqeysaa inay u soo wargeliyaan maamulka dugsiga wixii arrimo ah oo ku saabsan amniga si ay dugsiyada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: TVET okwayo ji duto manie County mar Murang'a mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar skul e wi weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds residents of Mombasa County that conservation tillage improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba kilimo cha uhifadhi kinaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba la muda mrefu.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa in beerashada ilaalinta ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jogweng' mar County mar Mombasa ni chwoyo puothe e yor ritruok medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: What do you do to prioritize mental health? Talking about it is a great first step.
Kiswahili: Unafanya nini ili kuweka kipaumbele afya ya akili? Kuzungumzia kuhusu hilo ni hatua nzuri ya kwanza.
Somali: Waa maxay waxa aad sameyneyso si aad u mudnaato caafimaadka maskaxda?
Dholuo: Ang'o minyalo timo mondo iket ngima mar ng'ato obed motelo?

English: E-Citizen updates residents of Bungoma County on progress of county development projects this January.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma juu ya maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo katika kaunti hii Januari.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay dadka deggan degmada Bungoma ku wargelineysaa horumarka mashaariicda horumarinta degmada bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: E-Citizen miyo ji duto modak e County mar Bungoma ng'eyo kaka tij gero county dhi nyime e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: IEBC opens the electoral calendar centres in Nairobi County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee Gobolka Nairobi bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e taon mar Nairobi e dwe mar Agost.

English: Worsening Humanitarian crisis unfolds amid escalating flooding in ASAL counties: Joint statement and Appeal by the ASAL Humanitarian Network (AHN)
Kiswahili: Mgogoro wa Kibinadamu unaozidi kuwa mbaya unatokea huku mafuriko yakiongezeka katika kaunti za ASAL: Taarifa ya Pamoja na Rufaa ya Mtandao wa Kibinadamu wa ASAL (AHN)
Somali: Dhibaatooyinka bani'aadamnimada ee sii xumaanaya ayaa soo ifbaxaya iyadoo daadadku sii kordhayaan degmooyinka ASAL: Bayaan wadajir ah iyo codsi ay soo saareen Shabakadda Bani'aadamnimada ee ASAL (AHN)
Dholuo: Gima medore marach mar konyo dhano timore e kind medo mar pi ma pong’o piny e gwenge mag ASAL: Wach ma oriwre kod kwayo mar riwruok mar ASAL mar konyo dhano (AHN)

English: KALRO encourages farmers in Nandi County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for coffee.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora za kahawa.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Nandi inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo kafee ah.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e county mar Nandi mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar chai.

English: KNEC encourages out-of-school children in Lamu County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Lamu kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa watu wazima chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Lamu inay ku biiraan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee barnaamijyada quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e County mar Lamu mondo odonj e program mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo e bwo program mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: Samburu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Samburu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Aprili 2024
Somali: Degmada Samburu: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Samburu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar ang'wen higa mar 2024

English: Marsabit County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Marsabit: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Mei 2024
Somali: Degmada Marsabit: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Marsabit: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar abich 2024

English: DPP reminds mobile money users in Nairobi County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid identity theft.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Nairobi inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado in la xado aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: DPP paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e County mar Nairobi ni mondo ginyis jomisonari maggi weche ma nyalo kelo hinyruok mondo kik gidonj e wuond mar ng'ato.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health confirms a cholera outbreak alert for Kwale County. Residents are advised to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa kipindupindu kwa Kaunti ya Kwale. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka kolera ee Gobolka Kwale. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isticmaalaan shabaqa cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth osenyiso ni nitie masira mar cholera e gweng' mar Kwale.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Waaxda Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero dib u soo kabashada xadgudubka maadooyinka bilaashka ah laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tiyo gi yedhe mamero yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Kisii.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Meru County this October. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utafanya kongamano la kuokoa matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Meru Oktoba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa qaban doonta munaasabad dib u soo kabashada isticmaalka maandooriyaha degmada Meru bisha Oktoobar. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: 'Kenya Red Cross' biro timo chokruok mar loso winjruok e kind joma tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero e dwe mar Oktoba e kaunti mar Meru.

English: KALRO promotes conservation tillage among farmers in Nandi County as part of the April climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: KALRO inakuza kilimo cha uhifadhi kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Aprili.
Somali: KALRO waxay kor u qaadeysaa beerashada ilaalinta beeraleyda gobolka Nandi iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka adkeysiga cimilada ee Abriil.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo puodho mar ritruok e kind jopur e county mar Nandi kaka achiel kuom chenro mar April mar kedo gi lokruok e kor lwasi.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of Samburu County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Samburu inaysan ku xanuunsadaan si aamusan oo ay ugu yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' Samburu County mondo kik gisandre gi muolo kendo mondo giluong kony mar thieth mar chuny maonge chudo.
