Kiswahili: Kenya: Ukame - Muhtasari wa Itifaki ya Hatua ya Mapema (EAP2022KE02)
Somali: Kenya: Abaaraha - Soo Koobidda Habraaca Tallaabooyinka Hore (EAP2022KE02)
Dholuo: Kenya: Oro - Oboke machuok mar chenro mar timo gik moko mapiyo (EAP2022KE02)

English: TVET announces distribution of school laptops under the digital literacy programme to schools in Migori County this November.
Kiswahili: TVET inatangaza usambazaji wa kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa shule za Kaunti ya Migori Novemba hii.
Somali: TVET waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Migori bishii November.
Dholuo: TVET lando ni ibiro pog laptop mag skul e bwo program mar digital literacy e skunde mag Migori County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Statement by Ms. Alice Wairimu Nderitu, Special Adviser on the Prevention of Genocide, on the launch of Kenya National Action Plan against Hate Speech, 15 June 2022
Kiswahili: Kauli ya Bi Alice Wairimu Nderitu, Mshauri Maalum kuhusu Kuzuia Mauaji ya Kimbari, kuhusu uzinduzi wa Mpango wa Kitaifa wa Kenya dhidi ya Matamshi ya Chuki, 15 Juni 2022.
Somali: Bayaanka ay soo saartay Marwo Alice Wairimu Nderitu, La-taliyaha Gaarka ah ee Ka-hortagga Xasuuqa, oo ku saabsan daahfurka Qorshaha Waxqabadka Qaranka ee Kenya ee ka dhanka ah Khudbadaha Nacaybka, 15 Juun 2022
Dholuo: Wach ma Ms. Alice Wairimu Nderitu, Jalony Maduong' mar geng'o nek mar oganda, ewi chak mar chenro mar piny Kenya mar lwenyo weche mag sigu, tarik 15 dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2022

English: IEBC urges eligible citizens in Makueni County to participate in voter education.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi wananchi wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Makueni kushiriki katika elimu ya wapiga kura.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Makueni inay ka qaybqaataan waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo raia mag Makueni County mondo oriwre e tiegruok mar josiasa.

English: COMESA informs fish farmers in Lamu County of new market linkage opportunities this April.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawafahamisha wafugaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Lamu juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Aprili hii.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku wargelineysaa kalluumeysatada ku nool gobolka Lamu fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: COMESA nyiso jopur ma pidho rech e County mar Lamu kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar April.

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on residents of Homa Bay County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Homa Bay kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqay dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji nitie mondo okony e loso kuwe e piny.

English: Kenya Medical Association announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Lamu County starting this August.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kuanzia Agosti hii.
Somali: Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya ayaa ku dhawaaqay in ay bilawday bishii Agoosto dialysis lacageed oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association olando thieth mar dialysis kuom joma odak e County mar Lamu kochakore Agost mar higani.

English: Notice: EACC will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ee degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: EACC biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag siasa e County mar Vihiga.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Mandera County to attend the public participation forum to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si ay u qaabeeyaan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Mandera mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar loso chenro mar dongruok.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds residents of Baringo County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo in ilaalinta ciidda ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service parone jogweng' Baringo County ni rito lowo miyo puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will distribute certified coffee seed to farmers in Kericho County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itasambaza mbegu za kahawa zilizothibitishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Wax soo saarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu abuuraha degmada Kericho u qaybin doonaa abuurka kafeega ee shahaadada leh bisha Sebtember ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Locho e Wi Yien mag Pest Control biro pogo kodhi mag kofi ne jopur manie Kericho County e dwe mar ochiko.

English: FAO urges farmers in Uasin Gishu County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: FAO inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Uasin Gishu inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo lagu soo ururiyo biyaha beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok e kaka koth chue.

English: TVET reminds parents in Kisii County that school feeding programme registration is open this March.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba usajili wa programu ya kulisha shule umefunguliwa Machi hii.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Kisii in diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga ay furan tahay bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: TVET parone jonyuol e County mar Kisii ni chenro mar kwayo nyithindo chiemo e skul ochakore e dwe mar Mach.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds the public in Siaya County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni huru, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu dadka degmada Siaya ku xasuusinayaa in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone ji duto e county mar Siaya ni golo ripot mar tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board restricts movement of pigs in Machakos County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya yazuia harakati za nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Machakos kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa doofaarka ee degmada Machakos sababtuna tahay faafitaanka cudurka maqaarka.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Dairy Board ogeng'o wuoth mar le e County ma Machakos nikech tuoche mag pien.

English: DPP reminds residents of Mombasa County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: DPP anawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan dhac ay gacan ka geystaan in xaafadaha ay nabad qabaan.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogweng' mar Mombasa County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar donjo e ot konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: COMESA reminds livestock keepers in Isiolo County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: COMESA waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Isiolo inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanada buka xafiiska xayawaanka ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: COMESA paronwa jorit jamni e County mar Isiolo ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: NCPB encourages farmers in Laikipia County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for tea.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za chai.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Laikipia inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo shaaha ah.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e county mar Laikipia mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro mar yudo nengo maber mar chai.

Dholuo: Kaunti mar Wajir: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2023

English: KALRO advises farmers in Mandera County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa mkulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Mandera inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qayb galaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KALRO nyiso jopur man Mandera County mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya Isiolo kwamba ushiriki katika mashauriano ya sera za umma unakaribishwa Oktoba hii.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Isiolo in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha la soo dhaweynayo bisha Oktoobar.

Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada oo ku saabsan dhismaha nabadda qaranka ee gobolka Nyandarua bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: DCI timo romo mar oganda e wi loso kuwe e piny mangima e County mar Nyandarua e dwe mar Februar.

English: TVET reminds youth in Kericho County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya mafundi wa magari.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kericho in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka mashiinka gawaarida.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa rowere man Kericho County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar jomisonari mag mtokni.

English: Abdirizak Kontoma, Kenya Cash Consortium Coordinator and Project Manager, on the goals of the 2026 action.
Kiswahili: Abdirizak Kontoma, Mratibu wa Kenya Cash Consortium na Meneja Mradi, kuhusu malengo ya hatua ya 2026.
Somali: Cabdirisaaq Kontoma, Iskuduwaha Dalada Lacagta ee Kenya iyo Maareeyaha Mashruuca, oo ku saabsan yoolalka waxqabadka 2026.
Dholuo: Abdirizak Kontoma, Jatend Riwruok mar Pesa e piny Kenya kendo Jatend Chenro, kuom gigo mane ochopo e higa mar 2026.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Turkana County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada la hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit nyiso ji duto modak e County mar Turkana mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth mar oganda ma onge chudo mondo kik tuoche ma inyalo geng'e landre.

English: This further highlights the need for regional API supply-chain collaboration across Africa and calls for a dedicated strategy to strengthen the largely under-prioritized diagnostics and medical devices sector.
Kiswahili: Hii inaangazia zaidi hitaji la ushirikiano wa kikanda wa ugavi wa API kote barani Afrika na kutoa wito wa mkakati mahususi wa kuimarisha sekta ya uchunguzi na vifaa vya matibabu ambayo haijapewa kipaumbele kwa kiasi kikubwa.
Somali: Tani waxay si dheeraad ah u iftiiminaysaa baahida loo qabo iskaashiga silsiladda sahayda API ee gobolka ee Afrika oo dhan waxayna ku baaqeysaa istaraatiijiyad u heellan si loo xoojiyo qaybta baaritaanka iyo aaladaha caafimaadka ee inta badan aan mudnaanta la siinin.
Dholuo: Mano medo nyiso dwaro mar riwruok mar API e alwora duto e Afrika duto kendo dwaro ni oket chenro mochung’ motegno mar jiwo sektor mar ng’iyo tuoche kod gige thieth ma ok oket mokuongo.

English: Samburu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Samburu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2024
Somali: Degmada Samburu: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Samburu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2024

English: Notice: FAO will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Nyamira County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi diiwaangelinta beeraleyda loogu talagalay beeralayda degmada Nyamira bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: FAO biro timo rapar mar jopur e dwe mar Desemba e kaunti mar Nyamira.

English: Notice: KNEC opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay furaysaa codsiyada deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan ardayda barta degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KNEC oseyawo kwayo mag somo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e gweng' mar Isiolo.

English: KUCCPS conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Kiambu County this June.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Juni hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha gobolka Kiambu bishii Juun.
Dholuo: KUCCPS timo romo mar tiego ji e wi migawo mar Ombudsman e County mar Kiambu e dwe mar Jun.

English: Agri-tourism can diversify income. Explore opportunities to combine farming with tourism activities like farm visits, u-pick, or accommodation.
Kiswahili: Utalii wa kilimo unaweza kubadilisha mapato. Gundua fursa za kuchanganya kilimo na shughuli za utalii kama vile ziara za shambani, u-pick, au malazi.
Somali: Dalxiiska beeraha wuxuu kala duwanaan karaa dakhliga. Sahamin fursadaha lagu isku daro beeraha iyo hawlaha dalxiiska sida booqashooyinka beerta, u-pick, ama hoyga.
Dholuo: Ng'e yore ma inyalo riwogo tij pur gi tije mag wuoth kaka limo puothe, dhi bayo, kata dhi dak.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds mobile money users in Nairobi County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Nairobi inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN ee M-Pesa si looga fogaado khiyaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e County mar Nairobi ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo kik gitim wuond mar loko SIM.

English: Council of Governors reminds residents of Uasin Gishu County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay xasuusinayaan dadka deggan gobolka Uasin Gishu in ay ku hawlan yihiin maamulayaasha degmooyinkooda si ay u xoojiyaan maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch oparo ne jogweng' Uasin Gishu County ni tudruok gi jotelo mag gwenge maggi miyo sirkal bedo gi loch maber.

English: KMTC reminds schools in Busia County to strengthen inclusion of learners with disabilities this July.
Kiswahili: KMTC inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Busia kuimarisha ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu Julai hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Busia inay xoojiyaan ka mid noqoshada ardayda naafada ah bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: KMTC oparo ne skunde man Busia County mondo omed tiego jopuonjre ma nigi midekre e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: DPP issues a cybersecurity alert on phishing messages affecting residents of Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya ujumbe wa udanganyifu unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan fariimaha phishing ee saameeya dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Rapar: DPP ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity e wi ote mag phishing makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e Kaunti mar Kakamega.

English: FAO urges sheep farmers in Taita-Taveta County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported foot and mouth disease cases.
Kiswahili: FAO inawahimiza wafugaji wa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda idaha ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma pidho rombe e gweng' mar Taita-Taveta mondo ochiw ripot ne jamni matuo man machiegni gi kama thieth mar dhok yudoree bang'e.

English: H.E President Uhuru Kenyatta, in 2019, took up the role of Gavi Champion in support of the Gavi replenishment. This is due to his commitment to immunization & improving the lives of children, & his leadership in the global movement for Universal Health Coverage.
Kiswahili: Rais Uhuru Kenyatta, mnamo 2019, alichukua jukumu la Bingwa wa Gavi kuunga mkono ujanibishaji wa Gavi. Hii ni kutokana na kujitolea kwake katika chanjo na kuboresha maisha ya watoto, na uongozi wake katika vuguvugu la kimataifa la Huduma ya Afya kwa Wote.
Somali: Madaxweyne Uhuru Kenyatta, sannadkii 2019, wuxuu qabtay doorka Gavi Champion isagoo taageeraya dib-u-buuxinta Gavi. Tani waxay sabab u tahay ballanqaadkiisa tallaalka iyo hagaajinta nolosha carruurta, iyo hoggaankiisa dhaqdhaqaaqa caalamiga ah ee Caymiska Caafimaadka Caalamiga ah.
Dholuo: Jatend Piny Uhuru Kenyatta, e higa mar 2019, ne okawo okang’ mar Jatelo mar Gavi e siro pong’o mar Gavi. <2Zepa> Mano en nikech ng’uono mare mar chiwo thieth & bero ngima mar nyithindo, & telo mare e riwruok mar piny mangima mar rito thieth mar piny mangima.

English: TVET conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Migori County this December.
Kiswahili: TVET inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Migori Desemba hii.
Somali: TVET waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan wareejinta degmada Migori bishii Diseembar ee sannadkan.
Dholuo: E dwe mar Desemba, TVET dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi wach golo pesa e sirkal mar Migori County.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges dairy cows farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported foot and mouth disease cases.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawataka wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa kufuatia kuripotiwa visa vya ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda goobaha lagu burburiyo ee loo qoondeeyay ka dib kiisaska cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service ojiwo jopur mag dhok mag chak e County mar Tharaka-Nithi mondo ogeng' legi e kuonde moketi mag nego dhok bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag dhoot kod dhoot.

English: AFA invites farmers in Nyamira County to a free training on modern irrigation techniques this July.
Kiswahili: AFA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kupata mafunzo ya bure juu ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji Julai hii.
Somali: AFA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda gobolka Nyamira tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah bisha July.
Dholuo: AFA ogwelo jopur e Kaunti mar Nyamira e tiegruok maonge chudo e wi yore mag lero pi e dwe mar Julai.

English: The Kenyan Fertilizer and Soil Health delegates forum is taking place at KALRO Nairobi on April 24 2024 Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to attend
Kiswahili: Kongamano la wajumbe wa Mbolea na Afya ya Udongo nchini Kenya linafanyika KALRO Nairobi Aprili 24 2024 Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kuhudhuria.
Somali: Madasha wakiilada Bacriminta Kenya iyo Caafimaadka Carrada ayaa ka furmaya magaalada KALRO Nairobi 24ka Abriil 2024 Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha ayaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka soo qayb galaan
Dholuo: Chokruok mar Kenya Fertilizer and Soil Health delegates forum dhi nyime e KALRO Nairobi tarik 24 April 2024 Jo puothe gi jo ohala mag agro-business ijiwogi mondo obi

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Kitui County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia laini ya bure ya EACC ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee EACC si looga hortago khiyaamada iibsiga.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' Kitui County mondo ochiw ripode mag mibadhi kokalo kuom hotline mar EACC maonge chudo mondo giked gi wuond mag yuto.

English: Universities Fund invites youth in Uasin Gishu County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this November.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Novemba hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku casuumay dhalinyarada degmada Uasin Gishu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista bisha Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund gwelo rowere manie Uasin Gishu County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar welding kod loso e dwe mar Novemba.

English: DPP warns residents of Kilifi County about a rise in phishing messages and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: DPP inawaonya wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi juu ya kuongezeka kwa ujumbe wa phishing na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: DPP waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi kororka farriimaha phishing waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax falin.
Dholuo: DPP osiemo jogweng' Kilifi County kuom wach medruok mar ote mag phishing kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public in Busia County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba upatikanaji wa usaidizi wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Busia in helitaanka taageerada sheegashada NHIF / SHA ay hadda ka heli karto xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji duto e County mar Busia ni kony mar kwayo kwayo kuom NHIF/SHA sani yudore e ofise moyier.

English: KUCCPS encourages out-of-school children in Bungoma County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under free primary education.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta dugsiga ka baxsan ee degmada Bungoma inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e County mar Bungoma mondo okonygi yudo konyno kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges motorists and pedestrians in Murang'a County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Somali: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada ayaa ku boorinaya darawalada gaadiidka iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Murang'a inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay adeegsadaan meelaha loo qoondeeyay dadka socoto si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo joidh mtokni kod jowuoth e County mar Murang'a mondo oluw tong' mar wuoth kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe mondo gikwed hinyruok mag ndara.

English: Ministry of Education encourages out-of-school children in Turkana County to register their children at the nearest public school under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Turkana kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Turkana inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e County mar Turkana mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni kodgi e bwo chenro mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: KEMSA encourages residents of Turkana County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay la xiriiraan lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng'o mag Turkana County mondo kik gisandre ka giling' kendo mondo giwuo gi jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Notice from SHA (Social Health Authority): free antenatal care clinics will run every February at designated health centres in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii): kliniki za bure za utunzaji wa ujauzito zitafanya kazi kila Februari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada): rugaha daryeelka dhalmada ee bilaashka ah waxaa lagu qaban doonaa Febraayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Nairobi.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar SHA (Social Health Authority): ibiro ti gi klinike maonge chudo e dwe mar Februar e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Nairobi.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service activates an emergency response plan for landslides in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu soo saaray qorshe xaalad deg deg ah oo looga jawaabayo dhulgariirada ka dhaca degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Forest Service tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony mapiyo ne yiengni mag piny e County mar Nyeri.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties advises residents of Murang'a County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay dalbadaan internetka iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan shahaadada dhalashada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties nyiso jogweng' mar County mar Murang'a mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom websait mar e-Citizen sama gidwaro yudo barua mar nyuol.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Bungoma County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ili kupambana na matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago xadgudubka xilka.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo kwayo mar kwedo timbe mag ketho migepe.

English: KNEC reminds parents in Isiolo County that adult literacy classes registration is open this June.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kwamba usajili wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima umefunguliwa Juni hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Isiolo in diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ay furan tahay bisha Juun.
Dholuo: KNEC oparo ne jonyuol e County mar Isiolo ni ikruok mar somo kod somo mar jomoti osechakore e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: NTSA opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Ogaysiis: NTSA waxay furaysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya daryeel caafimaad ka dib rabshadaha Degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Riwruok mar National Security Agency (NTSA) ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony e alwora mar Elgeyo-Marakwet bang' timbe mahundu.

English: Notice: FAO will open a tea collection centre in Murang'a County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya chai katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay xarun soo ururinta shaaha ka furi doontaa degmada Murang'a bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: FAO biro yawo ot mar choko chai e County mar Murang'a e dwe mar Desemba.

English: The African Union has adopted a 10 Year CAADP Strategy and Action Plan 2026 2035 to enhance agricultural transformation and food systems across Africa Stakeholders should prepare for upcoming initiatives and reforms
Kiswahili: Umoja wa Afrika umepitisha Mkakati wa Miaka 10 na Mpango Kazi wa CAADP 2026 2035 ili kuimarisha mageuzi ya kilimo na mifumo ya chakula katika bara la Afrika Wadau wanapaswa kujiandaa kwa ajili ya mipango na mageuzi yajayo.

Dholuo: African Union oseyudo chenro mar tich mar CAADP mar higni apar kod chenro mar tich 2026 2035 mar medo dongruok e yore mag loso yore mag pur kod yore mag chiemo e Afrika

English: State Department for Basic Education reminds needy students in Nakuru County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Nakuru in deeqaha waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay codsiyada ardayda baahan ay dhowaan dhammaadaan.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education oparo ne jopuonjre man Nakuru County ni tuke mag somo mag jopuonjre ma nigi chan biro rumo machiegni.

English: Our education system has prioritised examinations and assessment scores over comprehensive learning of diverse disciplines. The devaluing of so-called blue collar jobs in Kenya has become a mentality ...
Kiswahili: Mfumo wetu wa elimu umependelea mitihani na alama za tathmini juu ya kujifunza kikamilifu ya taaluma mbalimbali.
Somali: Nidaamkeena waxbarashadu wuxuu mudnaanta siinayaa imtixaanada iyo dhibcaha qiimeynta marka loo eego barashada dhamaystiran ee dhinacyada kala duwan.
Dholuo: Chenrowa mar tiegruok osemiyo penj kod nonro bedo motelo moloyo puonjruok e yore mopogore opogore.

English: KEMSA encourages mothers in Nandi County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Nandi kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Nandi inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo mine manie county mar Nandi mondo olim kama gibiro yudoe nyithindo machiegni mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Notice: KEMRI confirms a malaria outbreak alert for Migori County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa malaria kwa Kaunti ya Migori. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka fayraska ee degmada Migori. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KEMRI osenyiso ni nitie masira mar malaria e kaunti mar Migori.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service conducts a community briefing on border security in Lamu County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Lamu Machi hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu qabtaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha ee Gobolka Lamu bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Forest Service timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e County mar Lamu e dwe mar Mach.

English: In far-flung counties like Samburu, Wajir, Lamu and others where distance from a health facility or other essential services was a great barrier, enabled health teams were pleasantly surprised by the readiness for vaccination.
Kiswahili: Katika kaunti za mbali kama Samburu, Wajir, Lamu na zingine ambapo umbali kutoka kwa kituo cha afya au huduma zingine muhimu ulikuwa kizuizi kikubwa, timu za afya zilizowezeshwa zilishangazwa sana na utayari wa chanjo.
Somali: Degmooyinka fog fog sida Samburu, Wajeer, Lamu iyo kuwa kale halkaas oo masaafada u dhaxaysa xarumaha caafimaadka ama adeegyada kale ee muhiimka ah ay ahayd caqabad weyn, kooxaha caafimaadka ayaa si farxad leh ula yaabay diyaargarowga tallaalka.
Dholuo: E gwenge mabor kaka Samburu, Wajir, Lamu kod mamoko ma bor gi kar thieth kata tich mamoko ma dwarore ne en obadho maduong’, jogo ma ne ochung’ ne thieth ne obedo gi bwok maduong’ kuom bedo moikre mar chiwo chanjo.

English: E-Citizen reminds residents of Kajiado County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kajiado County kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa jogweng' Kajiado County ni luwo dongruok mar tich kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: "While the clear priority is to prevent people from starving, we must simultaneously strengthen our health response to prevent disease and save lives.
Kiswahili: "Wakati kipaumbele cha wazi ni kuzuia watu kutoka kwa njaa, lazima wakati huo huo tuimarishe mwitikio wetu wa kiafya ili kuzuia magonjwa na kuokoa maisha.
Somali: "In kasta oo mudnaanta koowaad ay tahay in laga hortago in dadku gaajoodaan, haddana waa in aan si isku mid ah u xoojinnaa jawaab celinta caafimaad si aan uga hortagno cudurrada una badbaadinno nolosha."
Dholuo: Kata obedo ni gima duong' maler en geng'o ji mondo kik otho gi kech, nyaka wabed gi teko e kinde maromre mar dwoko marwa mar thieth mondo ogeng' tuoche kendo wares ngima.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education opens a new catering and hospitality programme at the vocational centre in Busia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inafungua mpango mpya wa upishi na ukarimu katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Busia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka Busia waxay ka furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan cuntada iyo marti-gelinta xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Busia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Puonjruok ma Chakre e Piny owacho ochako chenro manyien mar chiemo kod rwako welo e skul mar tiegruok e gweng' mar Busia.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges residents of Meru County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya dadka deggan degmada Meru inay iskaashi la sameeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyadoo la sii xoojinayo amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Meru mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji ng'iyoe sirkal e kinde ma sirkal medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom rito tong'.

English: KALRO urges goats farmers in Baringo County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawataka wafugaji wa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda orgiga ee degmada Baringo inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib markii ay soo muuqdeen kiisaska anthrax.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur ma pidho diek e gweng' mar Baringo mondo ochiw ripot kuom le matuwo e ofis mar thieth man machiegni gi kanyo bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag anthrax.

English: Teachers Service Commission conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Kirinyaga County this February.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Februari hii.

Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiegruok mar ji duto e County mar Kirinyaga e dwe mar Februar.

English: Judiciary of Kenya advises residents of Nyeri County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya nyiso jogweng' Nyeri County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport.

Kiswahili: Wakulima wamehimizwa kuchunguza uzalishaji wa mbegu za viazi zilizoidhinishwa kwa kuwa kuna uhaba sokoni. Fikiria kuwa mzalishaji wa mbegu ili kuimarisha kilimo chako cha viazi.

Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur mondo onon kaka ginyalo loso kodhi mag le gi kodhi mag le nikech nitie yuto matin e piny

English: Strengthen transboundary disease and pest early-warning and surveillance systems, especially for African Migratory Locusts and Foot and Mouth Disease in livestock.
Kiswahili: Kuimarisha mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema na ufuatiliaji wa magonjwa ya mipaka na wadudu, haswa kwa Nzige Wanaohama wa Kiafrika na Ugonjwa wa Miguu na Mdomo katika mifugo.

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Nairobi County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada la hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso jogweng' Nairobi County mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth ma onge chudo mar oganda mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: KEMSA encourages mothers in Nairobi County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Nairobi inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.

English: AFA urges cassava growers in Uasin Gishu County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda cassava ee degmada Uasin Gishu inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka ciidanka xilliga dayrta iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur ma pidho manija e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e higa ka gitiyo gi tuoche ma thiedho yien mondo okony e medo nyak mar yien e kinde machuok.

English: Ministry of Education announces distribution of school laptops under the digital literacy programme to schools in Trans Nzoia County this November.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inatangaza usambazaji wa kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa shule za Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Novemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa ku dhawaaqday qaybinta kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Trans Nzoia bisha November ee sannadkan.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok olando ni ibiro mi skunde mag Trans Nzoia laptop e dwe mar Novemba e bwo chenro mar somo gi somo e yore mag digital.

English: Notice: KRA opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Machakos County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Wananchi katika Kaunti ya Machakos.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay ka furaysaa goob adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-muwaadiniinta degmada Machakos.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KRA oseyawo kar lendo manyien mar e-Citizen registration e county mar Machakos.

English: KUCCPS calls on the community in Baringo County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Baringo kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Baringo inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyo.
Dholuo: KUCCPS luongo ji duto manie Baringo County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Kajiado County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this drought season.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati wa msimu huu wa ukame.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lugta ku mara inta lagu jiro xilliga abaarta.
Dholuo: NTSA parone jogweng' Kajiado County mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo oti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe e kinde oro.

English: Notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will hold a suicide prevention forum in Busia County this September. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanya kongamano la kuzuia kujiua katika Kaunti ya Busia Septemba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay qabaneysaa madasha ka hortagga ismiidaaminta ee degmada Busia bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Rango Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche biro timo chokruok mar geng'o ji kik donj e kend e dwe mar ochiko e taon mar Busia.

English: NPS reminds the public in Kajiado County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha umma katika Kajiado County kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kajiado inay ka feejignaadaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: NPS parone ji duto e Kajiado County mondo obed motang' gi chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: Kwale County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for January 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kwale: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Januari 2023

English: Notice: Ministry of Education launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Nairobi County.

Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Education chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe mahundu e skunde duto mag Nairobi County.

English: Notice: DPP issues a cybersecurity alert on phishing messages affecting residents of Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya ujumbe wa udanganyifu unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties encourages first-time voters in Lamu County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Lamu kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Lamu inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelin ee IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties ojiwo jogo ma ne okwongo yiero e County mar Lamu mondo olim kama ichanoe IEBC machiegni kodgi.

English: Huduma Kenya updates residents of Embu County on progress of the county integrated development plan this December.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja ya kaunti hii Desemba.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay dadka deggan degmada Embu ku wargelineysaa horumarka qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya osemiyo jogweng' Embu ong'eyo dongruok mar chenro mar dongruok mar county e dwe mar Desemba.

English: KEMRI announces free medical camps for residents of Nairobi County starting this February.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuanzia Februari hii.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa xeryo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Nairobi laga bilaabo Febraayo.
Dholuo: KEMRI ogolo kambi mag thieth maonge chudo ne jogweng' Nairobi County kochakore e dwe mar Februar.

English: HELB encourages out-of-school children in Nakuru County to register their children at the nearest public school under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
