Dholuo: Riwruok mar Huduma Kenya chako chiwo kony e alwora mar Kirinyaga County.

English: DPP reminds the public in Narok County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Narok kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Narok inay ka feejignaadaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: DPP parone ji duto manie Narok County mondo obed motang' ne loso kuwe e piny.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka waxay bilaabeysaa barnaamij ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada iskuulada guud ahaan Gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Puonjruok ma Chakre e Piny owacho chako chenro mar rito nyithindo e skunde e skul duto mag Lamu County.

English: Over the last 24 hours we have tested over 300 Kenyans, out of those 22 have tested positive for covid-19 (13-males, 9-females). 21 out of the 22 cases are people who are currently in quarantine
Kiswahili: Katika saa 24 zilizopita tumewapima Wakenya zaidi ya 300, kati ya hao 22 wamepimwa na kukutwa na virusi vya covid-19 (wanaume 13, wanawake 9). Visa 21 kati ya 22 ni watu ambao kwa sasa wako karantini.
Somali: 24kii saac ee la soo dhaafay waxaan tijaabinay in ka badan 300 oo reer Kenya ah, kuwaas oo 22 ka mid ah ay u muuqdaan kuwo COVID-19 ah (13 lab, 9 dumar ah). 21 ka mida 22 kiis ayaa ah dadka hadda ku jira karantiil
Dholuo: Kuom seche 24 mosekalo, wasetimo nonro kuom Jo-Kenya mokalo 300, kuom jogo 22 osenwang'o ni gin gi tuo mar COVID-19 (13- chwo, 9- mon).

English: Pregnant women should seek immediate care if they experience severe headaches, swelling, blurred vision, or bleeding. These may be signs of serious complications.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanapaswa kutafuta huduma ya haraka ikiwa watapata maumivu makali ya kichwa, uvimbe, kutoona vizuri, au kutokwa na damu. Hizi zinaweza kuwa ishara za matatizo makubwa.
Somali: Haweenka uurka leh waxay u baahan yihiin daryeel degdeg ah haddii ay qabaan madax xanuun daran, caabuq, aragti murugsan, ama dhiig bax, kuwaas oo calaamad u noqon kara dhibaatooyin culus.
Dholuo: Mon ma nigi ich onego okwa thieth mapiyo kapo ni giyudo lit e wiye, ich wang', wang'gi ok nen maber, kata rembgi rumo.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageerada soo kabashada xadgudubka maandooriyaha ee bilaashka ah ay ka heli karto xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Baringo County.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tiyo gi yedhe mamero yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Baringo.

English: All sugar millers must cease cane poaching immediately to combat the sugar shortage failure to comply may involve police action
Kiswahili: Wasagaji sukari wote lazima wakomeshe ujangili wa miwa mara moja ili kukabiliana na uhaba wa sukari kushindwa kuzingatia kunaweza kuhusisha hatua za polisi.
Somali: Dhammaan warshadaha sonkorta waa inay isla markiiba joojiyaan ugaarsiga qamadi si loola tacaalo yaraanta sonkorta, haddii aan la raacin waxay keeni kartaa tallaabo booliis
Dholuo: Joma loso sukari duto nyaka we timo kamano mapiyo mondo giked gi pek mar sukari ma nyalo miyo polis otiek tijno

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds voters in Kwale County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kwale kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya kujiandikisha.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Kwale inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor diiwaangelinta codbixisayaasha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya paronwa jogweng' mar Kwale County mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero ka pok gidonj e register mar joma oyiero.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Trans Nzoia County that access to SHA registration is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba ufikiaji wa usajili wa SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya dadweynaha degmada Trans Nzoia in hadda la heli karo diiwaangelinta SHA xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji duto e County mar Trans Nzoia ni sani ginyalo yudo kwayo mar SHA e kuonde moketi.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds residents of Wajir County that access to national ID applications is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba kufikia maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir in helitaanka codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone jogweng' mar County mar Wajir ni yudo kwayo mag ID mar piny sani yot moloyo kokalo kuom yore mag tich.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) informs coffee farmers in Nakuru County of new market linkage opportunities this July.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawafahamisha wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Julai hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku wargelisaa beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Nakuru fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nyiso jopur mag chai e gweng' mar Nakuru kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General opens voter education centres in Garissa County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Garissa Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud ayaa furaya xarumo waxbarasho codbixiyeyaasha ee Gobolka Garissa bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Jarit Maduong' ochako tiego josiasa e taon mar Garissa e dwe mar Agost.

English: E-Citizen encourages first-time voters in Busia County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Busia kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Busia inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo jogweng' mokwongo e county mar Busia mondo ong'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: KRA urges eligible citizens in Trans Nzoia County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka qaybqaataan jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo raia mag Trans Nzoia County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar yiero.

English: IEBC advises applicants in Baringo County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Baringo kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: IEBC waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Baringo inay dalbadaan booska TVET iyada oo loo marayo KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: IEBC nyiso jokanyo mag Baringo County mondo oketgi e tiegruok mar TVET kokalo kuom KUCCPS.

English: KUCCPS conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in Isiolo County this March.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Machi hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay bishii Maarso ku qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: KUCCPS dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi ratiro mag sirkal e kaunti mar Isiolo e dwe mar Mach.

English: IEBC warns public officers in Turkana County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: IEBC inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Wilaya ya Turkana dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: IEBC waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Turkana khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: IEBC chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e County mar Turkana kuom timbe mag wuondruok.

English: Genome sequencing is central to combatting COVID-19, allowing governments and health authorities to take swift and informed public health decisions such as measures to bolster preparedness for potential surges owing to more infectious variants or stepping up vaccination, diagnostics and treatment.
Kiswahili: Mfuatano wa jenomu ni muhimu katika kupambana na COVID-19, kuruhusu serikali na mamlaka za afya kuchukua maamuzi ya haraka na ya kuarifu ya afya ya umma kama vile hatua za kuimarisha utayari wa ongezeko linaloweza kutokea kutokana na lahaja zinazoambukiza zaidi au kuongeza chanjo, uchunguzi na matibabu.
Somali: Kala-soocidda hidde-sideyaashu waxay udub-dhexaad u tahay la dagaallanka COVID-19, taasoo u oggolaanaysa dowladaha iyo mas'uuliyiinta caafimaadka inay qaadaan go'aanno caafimaad oo degdeg ah oo xog-ogaal ah sida tallaabooyinka lagu xoojinayo u diyaargarowga kororka suurtagalka ah ee ka dhasha noocyada faafa ee badan ama kor u qaadista tallaalka, ogaanshaha iyo daaweynta.
Dholuo: Okenge mag genome en gima duong’ ahinya e kedo kod COVID-19, ma miyo sirkande kod jotelo mag thieth kawo okang’ mapiyo kendo mowinjore mag thieth mar oganda kaka okenge mag jiwo ikruok ne medruok manyalo bedoe nikech kit tuoche mathoth kata medo chiwo chanjo, pim kod thieth.

English: IEBC updates residents of Kisii County on progress of county development projects this August.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii juu ya maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo katika kaunti hii Agosti.
Somali: IEBC waxay dadka deggan degmada Kisii ka wargelineysaa horumarka mashaariicda horumarinta degmada bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: IEBC chiwo ripot ne jogweng' Kisii e wi dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok e gweng'no e dwe mar Agost.

English: AFA urges farmers in Uasin Gishu County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: AFA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Uasin Gishu inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqli-galka ah si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi pur mar piny mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageerada soo kabashada xadgudubka maandooriyaha ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Mandera.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tiyo gi yedhe mamero yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county man Mandera County.

English: Notice: FAO will open a coffee collection centre in Turkana County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya kahawa katika Kaunti ya Turkana Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: FAO waxay xarun soo uruurinta kafeega ka furi doontaa degmada Turkana bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: FAO biro yawo kambi mar choko chai e taon mar Turkana e dwe mar April.

English: KEMRI urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Kitui County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Kitui kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku boorineysaa qofkasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Kitui inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e gweng' mar Kitui mondo oluong simo mar thieth mar paro maonge chudo.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development opens a new electrical installation programme at the vocational centre in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yafungua programu mpya ya ufungaji wa umeme katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ka furayaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan rakibidda korontada xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ochako chenro manyien mar keto sitima e kar tiegruok e county mar Siaya.

English: Notice from KEMSA: family planning counselling clinics will run every January at designated health centres in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka KEMSA: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Januari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid KEMSA: Caafimaadka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska waxaa lagu qaban doonaa Janaayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMSA: Klinike mag chiwo paro e wi chenro mag ngima joot biro tiyo e dwe mar Januar higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises horticultural produce producers in Meru County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inashauri wazalishaji wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Meru kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa soo saarayaasha wax soo saarka beeraha ee degmada Meru inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur ma loso puothe e county mar Meru mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Mandera County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Mandera: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2023
Somali: Degmada Mandheera: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Mandera: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2023

English: Notice: DCI launches a burglary prevention campaign in Embu County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Embu Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada degmada Embu bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni DCI chako kampen mar geng'o jokuoge odonj e taon mar Embu e dwe mar April.

English: KMTC conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Uasin Gishu County this June.
Kiswahili: KMTC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Juni hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda gobolka ee gobolka Uasin Gishu bishii Juun.
Dholuo: KMTC dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi riwruok mar oganda e bajet mar county e county mar Uasin Gishu e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: ODPP opens a new service point for national ID applications in West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya West Pokot.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay ka furaysaa barta adeegga cusub ee codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee Gobolka West Pokot.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: ODPP oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag kwayo nying' e alwora mar West Pokot County.

English: Employers can identify signs of mental health issues in the workplace by observing changes in behavior, such as increased absenteeism, decreased productivity, or withdrawal from colleagues
Kiswahili: Waajiri wanaweza kutambua dalili za matatizo ya afya ya akili mahali pa kazi kwa kuona mabadiliko katika tabia, kama vile kuongezeka kwa kutokuwepo kazini, kupungua kwa tija, au kujiondoa kutoka kwa wafanyakazi wenzao.
Somali: Shaqo-bixiyeyaashu waxay aqoonsan karaan calaamadaha dhibaatooyinka caafimaadka maskaxda ee goobta shaqada iyagoo arki doona isbeddellada dabeecadda, sida kororka maqnaanshaha, hoos u dhaca wax soo saarka, ama ka bixitaanka asxaabta
Dholuo: Jotelo nyalo fwenyo ranyisi mag tuoche mag obwongo ka gin e tich kuom ng'iyo kaka tim ng'ato lokore, kaka bedo maonge, bedo gi nyak matin, kata weyo tiyo gi jotich wetene

English: COMESA advises farmers in Kisii County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the January planting season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Januari.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kisii inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta ee la caddeeyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Janaayo.
Dholuo: COMESA nyiso jopur e gweng' mar Kisii mondo oti gi kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochopo dwe mar Januar.

English: Kenya confirms 10 more Covid-19 cases bringing the total number of confirmed infections to 384, nine of the new cases are from Mombasa and one from Nairobi
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha visa 10 zaidi vya Covid-19 na kufikisha jumla ya maambukizi 384, tisa kati ya visa vipya ni kutoka Mombasa na kimoja kutoka Nairobi.
Somali: Kenya ayaa xaqiijisay 10 kiis oo dheeraad ah oo ka mid ah cudurka Covid-19, taasoo keentay in tirada guud ee cudurrada la xaqiijiyay ay gaarto 384, sagaal ka mida kiisaska cusub ayaa ka yimid Mombasa iyo mid ka yimid Nairobi
Dholuo: Kenya oseyudo ji 10 mamoko ma nigi tuo mar Covid-19 omiyo kwan duto mar joma oyudo tuo mar COVID-19 ochopo 384, ochiko kuom joma oyudo tuwono gin jo Mombasa to achiel en Nairobi.

English: Kenya Anticipatory Actions - EVD Outbreak (MDRKE052) - Operational Update (8 July 2023)
Kiswahili: Vitendo vya Kutarajia vya Kenya - Mlipuko wa EVD (MDRKE052) - Taarifa ya Uendeshaji (8 Julai 2023)
Somali: Tallaabooyinka La Filayo ee Kenya - Cudurka Faafa ee EVD (MDRKE052) - Cusboonaysiinta Hawlgalka (8 Luulyo 2023)
Dholuo: Timbe mag piny Kenya - Tuwo mar EVD (MDRKE052) - Loso mar Tich (8 dwe mar Julaini 2023)

English: Kenyan rose exporters must prepare for stricter EU pest management regulations effective April 26 2025 due to the False Codling Moth threat Ensure compliance to maintain market access
Kiswahili: Wasafirishaji wa waridi nchini Kenya lazima wajitayarishe kwa kanuni kali zaidi za udhibiti wa wadudu wa Umoja wa Ulaya kuanzia Aprili 26 2025 kutokana na Tishio la Uongo la Codling Nondo Hakikisha kufuata sheria ili kudumisha ufikiaji wa soko.
Somali: Dhoofiyeyaasha Kenya ee ubaxyada u soo dhoofiya waa inay isu diyaariyaan sharciyada ka adag ee ka dhanka ah maareynta cayayaanka ee Midowga Yurub laga bilaabo 26 Abriil 2025 sababo la xiriira khatarta 'False Codling Moth'
Dholuo: Jo Kenya ma oro ros onego oikre ne chike mag EU ma rito tuoche ma ok nyal geng'o nyaka chop April 26, 2025 nikech pek mar kodho kodho mag miriambo

English: Notice: EACC launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Busia County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Busia mwezi Juni huu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee gobolka Busia bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Rapar: EACC chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Busia e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will train farmers in Mandera County on water harvesting this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera juu ya uvunaji wa maji Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda Degmada Mandera oo ku saabsan goosashada biyaha bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro tiego jopur e county mar Mandera e wi ywayo pi e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: IEBC reminds citizens in Vihiga County about their rights regarding devolution.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Vihiga ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC paronwa raia mag County mar Vihiga ratiro ma gin-go mar golo pesa.

English: Because aid still accounted for about three quarters of total revenue for campâ€‘based refugees in 2024, these cuts translated directly into falling household incomes and weaker demand in local camp economies, squeezing host community livelihoods tied to trade, services, and casual work.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu misaada bado ilichangia takriban robo tatu ya mapato ya jumla ya wakimbizi waliokaa kambini mwaka wa 2024, upunguzaji huu ulitafsiri moja kwa moja katika kupungua kwa mapato ya kaya na mahitaji duni katika uchumi wa kambi za ndani, kubana riziki za jamii zinazohusishwa na biashara, huduma, na kazi za kawaida.
Somali: Maadaama gargaarku uu weli ahaa qiyaastii saddex meelood meel dakhliga guud ee qaxootiga ku nool xeryaha sannadkii 2024, dhimistan waxay si toos ah u beddeshay dakhliga qoyska iyo baahida liidata ee dhaqaalaha xeryaha maxalliga ah, taasoo ku qasabtay nolosha bulshada martida loo yahay inay ku xiran tahay ganacsiga, adeegyada, iyo shaqada aan joogtada ahayn.
Dholuo: Nikech kony pod ne okawo madirom adek kuom ang'wen mar ohala duto ma ne yudo ne jolweny ma ne odak e kambi e higa mar 2024, ng'ado pinygo ne omiyo pesa ma ne yudore e ot ne dok piny kendo dwaro matin e yuto mag kambi ma ne ni e alworano, ma ne omiyo ngima mar oganda ma ne okawogi odok piny e weche mag ohala, tich, kod tich ma pile ka pile.

English: KNEC announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Siaya County this December.
Kiswahili: KNEC inatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Siaya Desemba hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta waxyaabaha barashada digitalka ah ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Siaya bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: KNEC olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag digital maonge chudo e skunde man Siaya County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: May is a reminder to prioritize self-care and nurture your mental health. Practice mindfulness, engage in activities that bring you joy, and seek support when needed
Kiswahili: Mei ni ukumbusho wa kuweka kipaumbele utunzaji wa kibinafsi na kukuza afya yako ya akili. Fanya mazoezi ya kuzingatia, shiriki katika shughuli zinazokuletea furaha, na utafute msaada inapohitajika.
Somali: May waxay xasuusinaysaa inaad naftaada daryeesho oo aad daryeesho caafimaadkaaga maskaxda.
Dholuo: Mei paronwa kaka onego waket ting'wa mokwongo e rito ngimawa wawegi kendo rito winjruokwa gi Nyasaye.

English: Universities Fund reminds youth in Samburu County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xasuusinayaa dhalinyarada degmada Samburu in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka farsamada gawaarida gawaariyada.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa rowere man Samburu County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar mechanics mag mtokni.

English: SHA urges residents of Turkana County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Turkana kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ili kupambana na ufisadi wa fedha za umma.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u soo gudbiyaan cabasho si ay ula dagaallamaan xadgudubka maalgashiga dadweynaha.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Turkana mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo kwayo mar kedo gi ketho pesa mag sirkal.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges parents and teachers in Murang'a County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Murang'a inay u soo sheegaan maamulka iskuulka wixii arrimo ah oo ku saabsan amniga.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e county mar Murang'a mondo onyis jotelo mag skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development encourages farmers in Turkana County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for avocado.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za parachichi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Turkana inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan avocado.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur e county mar Turkana mondo odonj e riwruok ma nigi ratiro mar timo ohala mondo giyud nengo maber mar avocado.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will hold a stress management forum in West Pokot County this January. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitafanya kongamano la kudhibiti mafadhaiko katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Januari hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa qaban doonta madasha maareynta walbahaarka ee Gobolka West Pokot bisha Janaayo. Dhammaantood waa soo dhaweynayaan.
Dholuo: Rapar: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo romo mar kedo gi parruok e West Pokot County e dwe mar Januar.

English: How children in Kenya are involved in tackling climate change
Kiswahili: Jinsi watoto nchini Kenya wanahusika katika kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa
Somali: Sida carruurta Kenya ay uga qayb qaataan wax ka qabashada isbeddelka cimilada
Dholuo: Kaka nyithindo ma piny Kenya odonjore e kedo kod lokruok mag piny

English: SHA invites residents of Mombasa County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: SHA inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: SHA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: SHA gwelo ji modak e county mar Mombasa mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ochopo kinde mogik mar nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: Key findings in Turkana County - Mobility Tracking Round 2, April and May 2023
Kiswahili: Matokeo muhimu katika Kaunti ya Turkana - Raundi ya 2 ya Ufuatiliaji wa Uhamaji, Aprili na Mei 2023
Somali: Natiijooyinka Muhiimka ah ee Degmada Turkana - Wareegga 2aad ee Raad-raaca Dhaqdhaqaaqa, Abriil iyo Maajo 2023
Dholuo: Duong' maduong' ma oyudre e gweng' mar Turkana - Luwo wuoth mar ariyo, dwe mar ang'wen kod dwe mar abich higa mar 2023

English: All schools install CCTV + hire guards by Dec 31 Ã¢Â€Â“ Ministry directive or face closure!
Kiswahili: Shule zote zaweka CCTV + kuajiri walinzi ifikapo Desemba 31 Ã¢Â€Â“ Maagizo ya Wizara au tutalazimika kufungwa!
Somali: Dhammaan iskuulladu waxay rakibaan CCTV + ilaalada kireysiga kahor Diseembar 31 - amarka Wasaaradda ama wajiga ayaa la xiri doonaa!
Dholuo: Suku duto keto CCTV + ng’iewo jorit nyaka tarik 31 dwe mar apar gi ariyo.

English: KEMSA appeals to caregivers in Tana River County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the February maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Februari.
Somali: KEMSA waxay u baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Tana River inay ka qeybgalaan maalinta bukaanka ee la qorsheeyay qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Febraayo.
Dholuo: KEMSA okwayo jorit e taon mar Tana River County mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar thieth ma ne otim e dwe mar Februar.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges residents of Nyandarua County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaala aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ilaalinta ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkande mag sirkal e wi gik ma ne timore e alwora mar tong'gi nikech ji osebedo ka kawo okang' mar kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations launches a cattle rustling prevention campaign in Makueni County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Makueni Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada ayaa bilaabay olole looga hortago xanta xoolaha ee Gobolka Makueni bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova chako kampen mar geng'o ywaruok e gweng' mar Makueni e dwe mar ochiko.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) invites farmers in Isiolo County to a free training on greenhouse farming this July.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo cha chafu Julai hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Isiolo tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo bisha July.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) ogwelo jopur e gweng' mar Isiolo e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar yien e dwe mar Julai.

English: Agriculture (UNDFF). Groups can register in FO...(3) to attain farming on digital and technology among small scale farmers and large scale factories .
Kiswahili: Kilimo (UNDFF). makundi wanaweza kujiandikisha katika FO...(3) kufikia kilimo juu ya digital na teknolojia kati ya wakulima wadogo na viwanda vya ukubwa.
Somali: Beeraha (UNDFF). Kooxuhu waxay iska diiwaan gelin karaan FO... (3) in la gaaro beeralayda dijitaalka iyo tiknoolajiyada ee beeraleyda yaryar iyo warshadaha waaweyn.
Dholuo: Tij Lemo (UNDFF). grube nyalo dhi e FO...(3) mondo giyud tij pur e yore mag digital kod teknoloji e kind jopur matindo kod ute mag loso gik madongo.

English: KICD advises students in Busia County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: KICD inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Busia kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza dijitali.
Somali: KICD waxay kula talineysaa ardayda degmada Busia inay dalbadaan bogga deeqda waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan waxyaabo waxbarasho digital ah oo bilaash ah.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo jopuonjre e County mar Busia mondo oketgi e websait mar somo ma yudore e intanet mondo giyud thuolo mar somo weche mag digital maonge chudo.

English: NDMA calls on residents of Nyandarua County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NDMA inatoa wito kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika kumbi za umma ili kuunga mkono ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: NDMA waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: NDMA luongo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji nitie mondo okony e loso kuwe e piny.

English: Kenya Dairy Board promotes conservation tillage among farmers in Turkana County as part of the September climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inakuza kilimo cha uhifadhi kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Turkana kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa Septemba.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa beerashada ilaalinta beeraleyda degmada Turkana iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka iska caabbinta cimilada ee Sebtember.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo puodho mar choko puodho e kind jopur e County mar Turkana kaka achiel kuom chenro mar kedo gi lokruok mar kor lwasi mar piny e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public in Kiambu County that access to eye and dental camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za macho na meno sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kiambu in helitaanka xeryaha indhaha iyo ilkaha ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche parone ji duto e County mar Kiambu ni koro ginyalo dhi e kambi mag thieth mag wang' kod lakteche mag laktech.

English: ODPP urges residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandaoni wa kaunti ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo oriwre gi county's online participation portal e loso chenro mar bajet mar county.

English: Notice: FAO will train farmers in Mombasa County on water harvesting this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa juu ya uvunaji wa maji Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda gobolka Mombasa oo ku saabsan goosashada biyaha bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: FAO biro tiego jopur e county mar Mombasa e dwe mar Mei.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Garissa County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Garissa kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Garissa inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pachgi e County mar Garissa mondo oluong kony mar thieth mar pach maonge chudo.

English: Marsabit County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Marsabit: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2024
Somali: Degmada Marsabit: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Marsabit: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Septemba 2024

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds parents in Embu County that free primary education registration is open this November.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Embu kwamba usajili wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo umefunguliwa Novemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu xusuusinayaa waalidiinta degmada Embu in diiwaangelinta bilaashka ah ee waxbarashada hoose ay furan tahay bisha November.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne jonyuol e county mar Embu ni kwan mar joma dhi e tiegruok mokwongo en nono e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will conduct a post-harvest handling workshop for farmers in Bungoma County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itaendesha warsha ya kushughulikia baada ya mavuno kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi ka dib goosashada beeraleyda degmada Bungoma bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro timo chokruok mar timo nonro bang' keyo ne jopur e taon mar Bungoma e dwe mar Mach.

English: Wajir County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Wajir: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Februari 2023
Somali: Degmada Wajeer: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Wajir: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2023

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service announces a free anthrax vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Lamu County this July.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kimeta kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Lamu Julai hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhawaaqay jimicsi tallaal ah oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay lo'da caanaha ah ee Gobolka Lamu bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok ma chwoyo dhok e dwe mar Julai e taon mar Lamu.

English: Samburu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Samburu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Aprili 2023
Somali: Degmada Samburu: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Samburu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar ang'wen 2023

English: KNEC reminds parents in Baringo County that school feeding programme registration is open this December.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba usajili wa mpango wa kulisha shule umefunguliwa Desemba hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Baringo in diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga ay furan tahay bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: KNEC oparo ne jonyuol e County mar Baringo ni chenro mar kwayo nyithindo chiemo e skul ochakore e dwe mar Desemba.

English: NCPB informs tea farmers in Mombasa County of new market linkage opportunities this August.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawafahamisha wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Agosti hii.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee gobolka Mombasa fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: NCPB nyiso jopur chai e county mar Mombasa kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Agost.

English: KALRO advises farmers in Makueni County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Makueni inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Makueni mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Uasin Gishu County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti hiyo kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya ojiwo jogweng' Uasin Gishu County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county mar chiwo paro e wi tich ma gitimo higa ka higa.

English: Huduma Kenya encourages first-time voters in Bungoma County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Bungoma inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jogo matimo yiero mokwongo e County mar Bungoma mondo oting'e ID mar piny kata pasipoti e odiechieng' mar yiero.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Nyeri County that access to post-violence medical care is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Uhalifu unakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Nyeri in helitaanka daryeelka caafimaad ee rabshadda ka dib ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e County mar Nyeri ni yudo kony mar thieth bang' tim mahundu en gima ng'ato nyalo yudo maonge chudo.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will train farmers in Kwale County on water harvesting this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale juu ya uvunaji wa maji Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka ayaa tababar siin doona beeraleyda Gobolka Kwale ee ku saabsan goosashada biyaha bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro tiego jopur e Kaunti mar Kwale e wi choko pi e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Ministry of Education advises students in Kwale County to collect materials from the county education office to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kwale kukusanya vifaa kutoka kwa ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ardayda degmada Kwale kula talineysaa inay ka soo ururiyaan agabyada xafiiska waxbarashada degmada si ay u helaan deeq waxbarasho ardayda u baahan.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jopuonjre e Kaunti mar Kwale mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar tiegruok mar kaunti mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo osuru ne jopuonjre mochando.

English: IEBC urges residents of Machakos County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kudai usambazaji wa huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa fedha za umma.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay dalbadaan bixinta adeegyada iyada oo aan la bixin laaluush si looga hortago xadgudubka maalgashiga dadweynaha.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Machakos mondo ochiw kony maok ochulo asoya mondo giked gi ketho pesa mag sirkal.

English: Kenya Forest Service alerts residents of Turkana County to a rise in fraud cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za ulaghai na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya ayaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana uga digaya kororka kiisaska khiyaanada wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Forest Service chiwo siem ne jogweng' Turkana County kuom wach medruok mar weche mag wuondruok kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot e stesen mar polise man machiegni.

English: KEMRI encourages residents of Kakamega County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng' Kakamega County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Taking different types of vaccines is not recommended. After being fully vaccinated you will obtain your COVID-19 certificate from the MOH website https://portal.health.go.ke.
Kiswahili: Kuchukua aina tofauti za chanjo haipendekezwi. Baada ya kuchanjwa kikamilifu utapata cheti chako cha COVID-19 kutoka kwa tovuti ya MOH https://portal.health.go.ke.
Somali: Qaadashada noocyo kala duwan oo tallaal ah laguma talinayo. Ka dib markaad si buuxda u tallaasho waxaad shahaadadaada COVID-19 ka heli doontaa websaydhka wasaaradda caafimaadka https://portal.health.go.ke.
Dholuo: Tiyo gi yore mopogore opogore mag thieth ok owinjore. Bang' yudo thieth duto ibiro yudo singruok mari mar thieth mar COVID-19 e websait mar Ministry of Health (MOH) ma en https://portal.health.go.ke.

English: Kenya, WHO launch bold initiative to transform Africaâ€™s health emergency response
Kiswahili: Kenya, WHO yazindua mpango wa kijasiri wa kubadilisha majibu ya dharura ya kiafya barani Afrika
Somali: Kenya iyo WHO oo bilaabay hindise geesinimo leh oo wax looga qabanayo xaaladaha degdegga ah ee caafimaadka ee Afrika
Dholuo: Kenya, WHO ochako chenro motegno mar loko kaka Afrika chiwo duoko mapiyo mar thieth

English: Notice: EACC opens the electoral calendar centres in Samburu County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Samburu Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay furaysaa xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee Gobolka Samburu bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: EACC chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e county mar Samburu e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Mpox symptoms include fever, rash, and swollen lymph nodes. Seek medical care immediately if you notice any of these.
Kiswahili: Dalili za Mpox ni pamoja na homa, upele, na uvimbe wa tezi za limfu. Tafuta huduma ya matibabu mara moja ikiwa utagundua yoyote kati ya haya.
Somali: Calaamadaha Mpox waxaa ka mid ah hargabka, ciribtirka, iyo qanjirka lymph node ee bararka.
Dholuo: Ranyisi mag tuwo mar Mpox oriwo bedo gi tuwo mar muoch, tuwo mar apaka, kod ng'injo mar lymph nodes. Tem manyo thieth mapiyo kapo ni ineno gimoro kuomgi.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Nairobi County that access to the GBV toll-free helpline is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba upatikanaji wa simu ya GBV ya bure ya msaada unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee Gobolka Nairobi in helitaanka khadka caawimaadda ee GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah uu yahay mid lacag-la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e County mar Nairobi ni gibiro yudo kony ma onge chudo mar GBV maonge chudo.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds residents of Nyamira County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Nyamira in helitaanka adeegyada baasaboorka ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone jogweng' Nyamira County ni koro yot yudo passport services kokalo kuom chenro mag sirkal.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages mothers in Kisumu County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhudhuria siku iliyopangwa ya kliniki ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kisumu inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta caafimaad ee la qorsheeyay si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo mine manie County mar Kisumu mondo odhi e odiechienge mag thieth mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: KMTC advises applicants in Nyamira County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KMTC waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Nyamira inay dalbadaan booska TVET iyada oo loo marayo KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: KMTC nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e County mar Nyamira mondo oketgi e tiegruok mar TVET kokalo kuom KUCCPS.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Garissa County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Garissa kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Garissa inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e gweng' mar Garissa County mondo oluong kony mar thieth mar paro maonge chudo.

English: CDC reminds the public in Mandera County that access to subsidised dialysis is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba upatikanaji wa dialysis ya ruzuku sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Mandera in helitaanka dialysis-ka la taageeray ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji duto man Mandera County ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mar dialysis e kuonde moyier.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds parents in Bomet County that free day secondary education registration is open this September.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba usajili wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo umefunguliwa Septemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu xusuusinayaa waalidiinta degmada Bomet in diiwaangelinta dugsiga dhexe ee bilaashka ah ay furan tahay bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne jonyuol e County mar Bomet ni somo mar sekondari mar odiechieng' maonge chudo osechakore e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Meru (Meru-North) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Meru (Meru-Kaskazini): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Machi 2022
Somali: Degmada Meru (Meru-Waqooyi): War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Meru (Meru-Nyath): Oboke mar Chik Mapile mar Oro mar Adek 2022

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Vihiga County to attend the public participation forum to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si ay u qaabeeyaan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Vihiga mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar loso chenro mar dongruok.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya warns residents of Siaya County to prepare for possible flooding this August.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kujiandaa kwa mafuriko yanayoweza kutokea Agosti hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay u diyaar garoobaan fatahaadaha iman kara bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chiwo siem ne ji duto modak e county mar Siaya mondo giikre ne koth maduong' mabiro timore e dwe mar Agost.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Murang'a County this August.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Agosti hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo bilaash ah oo cudurka Newcastle ah oo loogu talagalay lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Murang'a bishii Ogosto.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) ogolo chenro mar thieth mar tuo mar Newcastle maonge chudo e dwe mar Agost mar higani e county mar Murang'a.

English: ACTED Kenya: providing emergency cash assistance to support the drought-affected families in Turkana County
Kiswahili: ACTED Kenya: kutoa msaada wa dharura wa pesa kusaidia familia zilizoathiriwa na ukame katika Kaunti ya Turkana
Somali: Kenya oo wax ka qabatay: waxay bixinaysaa gargaar lacageed oo degdeg ah si loo taageero qoysaska ay abaartu saameysay ee Degmada Turkana
Dholuo: NE OTIMO KENYA: chiwo kony mar pesa mapiyo mondo okony joot ma ne oyudo masira mag oro e gweng’ mar Turkana

English: Notice: DCI conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Murang'a County this April.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada ku saabsan dhismaha nabadda qaranka ee degmada Murang'a bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DCI timo romo mar oganda e wi loso kuwe e gweng' mar Murang'a e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: IPOA issues a cybersecurity alert on SIM-swap fraud affecting residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inatoa onyo la usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Ogaysiis: IPOA waxay soo saartaa digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaanooyinka SIM-swap ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IPOA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity kuom wuond mag SIM-swap makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County.

English: Council of Governors reminds the public in Kisumu County that input on development planning forums is welcome this May.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba mchango kwenye vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo unakaribishwa Mei hii.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa xasuusinaya shacabka degmada Kisumu in laga soo dhaweynayo talooyinka ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta bisha May.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch oparo ne ji duto e County mar Kisumu ni gibiro rwako pachgi e wi chenro mag dongruok e dwe mar Mei.

English: Meru (Meru-North) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Meru (Meru-Kaskazini): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Aprili 2023
Somali: Degmada Meru (Meru-Waqooyi): War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Meru (Meru-Nyath): Oboke mar Chik Mapile mar Oro mar Ang'wen 2023

English: KEMSA appeals to caregivers in Murang'a County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the December maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya harakati za afya ya mama ya Desemba.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Murang'a inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka ee Diseembar.
Dholuo: KEMSA okwayo jorit e County mar Murang'a mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Kenya: Livestock Market Systems Activity (LMS)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Shughuli ya Mifumo ya Soko la Mifugo (LMS)
Somali: Kenya: Dhaqdhaqaaqa Nidaamka Suuqa Xoolaha (LMS)
Dholuo: Kenya: Tich mar Chiro mag Le (LMS)

English: Civil society organizations are vital for these models, yet much of their work is unrecognized and underfunded.
Kiswahili: Mashirika ya kiraia ni muhimu kwa mifano hii, lakini kazi zao nyingi hazitambuliki na hazina ufadhili wa kutosha.
Somali: Ururada bulshada rayidka ah ayaa muhiim u ah moodooyinkan, haddana inta badan shaqadooda lama aqoonsan oo miisaaniyad yar ayaa ku filan.
Dholuo: Riwruoge mag oganda gin gik ma dwarore ahinya e ranyisi ma kamago, kata kamano, thoth tijegi ok ong’ere kendo ok yudgi pesa moromo.

English: CDC encourages residents of Meru County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay u dhiiri galiyaan saaxiibo dhibaataysan inay caawimaad raadsadaan.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo jogweng' mar Meru County mondo kik gisandre aling' ling' kendo mondo gijiw osiepgi moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: SHA encourages first-time voters in Kiambu County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: SHA inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: SHA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Kiambu inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jogo matimoga yiero mokwongo e County mar Kiambu mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi kata pasipoti e odiechieng'no mar timo yiero.

English: KEMRI urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Vihiga County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku boorineysaa qofkasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Vihiga inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pachgi e County mar Vihiga mondo oluong kony mar thieth mar pach maonge chudo.

English: Notice: TSC launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC yazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay bilawday barnaamij tallaabooyin looga hortago dhibta dugsiyada gobolka Garissa.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: TSC chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe mahundu e skunde duto mag County mar Garissa.

English: KNEC urges youth in Kisumu County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kisumu inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada rayidka ah ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada rayidnimada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo rowere e County mar Kisumu mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok gichako timo tije mag oganda.

English: FAO and FMO are launching a partnership to enhance agricultural financing in Kenya focusing on small scale producers and SMEs Engage with this initiative for better access to finance and management practices
Kiswahili: FAO na FMO zinazindua ushirikiano wa kuimarisha ufadhili wa kilimo nchini Kenya unaolenga wazalishaji wadogo na wajasiriamali wadogo na wa kati Kujihusisha na mpango huu wa upatikanaji bora wa fedha na usimamizi.
Somali: FAO iyo FMO waxay bilaabeen iskaashi si loo xoojiyo maalgelinta beeraha Kenya oo diiradda lagu saaro soo saarayaasha yaryar iyo shirkadaha yaryar ee ganacsiga.
Dholuo: FAO kod FMO chako riwruok mar oganda Jehova mondo omed konyo e yore mag pesa e weche mag pur e piny Kenya, ka giketo pachgi kuom joma loso gik matindo kod SMEs.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Kisii County this November. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya itafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Kisii Novemba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay qabaneysaa madasha caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada ee degmada Kisii bisha November. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth biro timo chokruok mar paro ne rowere e gweng' mar Kisii e dwe mar Novemba.

English: DCI urges motorists and pedestrians in Garissa County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent landslides-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DCI inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Garissa kusakinisha na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa darawalada gawaarida iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Garissa inay guryahooda rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dabka daminta iyo inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa dhacdooyinka la xiriira dhulgariirka.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo derebe kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Garissa mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo gitim kinda mondo gikwed masiche ma timore nikech yiengni mag lowo.

English: Notice: NCPB will distribute certified coffee seed to farmers in Nairobi County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itasambaza mbegu za kahawa zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay abuurka kafeega ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda Gobolka Nairobi bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NCPB biro pogo kodhi mag kahawa ne jopur man Nairobi County e dwe mar Mach.

English: DPP reminds mobile money users in Taita-Taveta County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa pesa ya rununu.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta in ay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogo matiyo gi pesa mobil e Taita-Taveta County ni mondo ging'e kwayo margi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo gitang' gi mibadhi mag pesa mobilu.

English: Council of Governors reminds voters in Nandi County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Nandi kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyayaashu waxay xasuusiyaan codbixiyayaasha gobolka Nandi inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor inta aan la helin nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch oparo ne jokanyo mag county mar Nandi mondo olim kama ichanoe IEBC machiegni kodgi kapok itimo yiero.

English: Article 227 of the Constitution of Kenya requires that when a state organ or any other public entity contracts for goods or services, it shall do so in accordance with a system that is fair equitable transparent, competitive and cost effective.
Kiswahili: Kifungu cha 227 cha Katiba ya Kenya kinataka kwamba wakati chombo cha serikali au shirika lingine lolote la umma likiweka kandarasi za bidhaa au huduma, litafanya hivyo kwa mujibu wa mfumo ambao ni wa usawa wa uwazi, wenye ushindani na wa gharama nafuu.
Somali: Qodobka 227 ee Dastuurka Kenya wuxuu dhigayaa in marka hay'ad dawladeed ama hay'ad kale oo dadweyne ay qandaraas ku bixiso badeecadaha ama adeegyada, ay sidaas ku sameyso iyadoo la raacayo nidaam cadaalad ah oo hufan, tartan leh, isla markaana kharash-ool ah.
Dholuo: 227 mar chik mar piny Kenya dwaro ni ka riwruok mar piny kata riwruok moro amora mar piny owacho otimo kontrak mar ng’iewo gikmoko kata tich, onego otim kamano kaluwore gi chenro ma ng’ato nyalo ng’iewogo gikmoko, ma nyalo ng’iewo gikmoko kendo ma ok oting’o pesa mang’eny.

English: Council of Governors urges residents of Kisumu County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaskazini.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha waxay ku boorinayaan dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan mashaariicda horumarinta degmada.
Dholuo: Council of Governors jiwo jogweng' mar Kisumu County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche momedore e wi chenrogo mag dongruok.

English: Public notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will host a free hand hygiene outreach in Baringo County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mikono bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Baringo Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay marti gelineysaa dhaqdhaqaaqa nadaafadda gacmaha ee bilaashka ah ee Gobolka Baringo bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Rango Kendo Luwo Tuwo biro timo kampen mar rito ler mar lwedo e taon mar Baringo e dwe mar Agost.

English: NCTC highlighted socio-economic vulnerabilitiesâ€”poverty and marginalizationâ€”as drivers of youth susceptibility to extremist recruitment.
Kiswahili: NCTC ilisisitiza udhaifu wa kijamii na kiuchumi - umaskini na ubaguzi - kama vichocheo vya uwezekano wa vijana wa kuajiriwa wa kimabavu.
Somali: NCTC waxay iftiimisay nuglaanta bulsho-dhaqaale - saboolnimada iyo faquuqidda - inay yihiin sababaha keena u nuglaanshaha dhalinyarada ee shaqaalaysiinta xagjirka ah.
Dholuo: NCTC noketo ler kuom pek mag ngima mar oganda kod weche mag ohala- - chandruok mar bedo jodhier kod keto ji oko - kaka gik ma miyo rowere bedo gi nyalo mar ng'ado bura ne jolweny ma ng'anjo ahinya.

Kiswahili: Nchi za Afrika Mashariki zinatekeleza mipango jumuishi ya maendeleo ya sekta ya mpunga ili kupunguza uagizaji wa bidhaa kutoka nje Wakulima na wafanyabiashara wa kilimo wahimizwa kushiriki katika ushirikiano wa kikanda na fursa za uwekezaji.

Dholuo: Pinje mag Afrika ma Ugwe tiyo gi chenro mar timo dongruok e yore mag loso loso loso kodhi mondo gikony e tieko ohala

Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMRI biro timo chenro mar chiwo pi maonge chudo e taon mar Wajir e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: AFA will train farmers in Kwale County on agroforestry this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale juu ya kilimo cha misitu Februari hii.

Kiswahili: NTSA inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya West Pokot wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za kashfa za pesa za rununu.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha gobolka West Pokot inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada lacagta mobilada.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo ji duto e West Pokot County mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo weche mag wuond mag pesa e simo.

Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche ogolo kambi mag thieth mag wang' kod lak mag lakteche ne jogweng' Nakuru County kochakore dwe mar Novemba.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges residents of Kilifi County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya mawasiliano ya Kenya inawahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya usalama wa mpaka.

Dholuo: Ng'eyo: COMESA ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok e county mar Uasin Gishu nikech tuoche mag dhoot.

English: State Department for Basic Education announces distribution of school laptops under the digital literacy programme to schools in Nyeri County this December.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inatangaza usambazaji wa kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa shule za Kaunti ya Nyeri Desemba hii.

English: Public health advisory: KEMRI warns of increased Rift Valley Fever risk in Kisumu County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMRI inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa katika Kaunti ya Kisumu na inashauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii.

Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: KEMRI chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuwo mar Rift Valley Fever e County mar Kisumu kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore e thieth.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Kwale County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
