Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Murang'a ni thuolo mar yudo nyithindo ma nigi lony en maonge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: KRA reminds residents of Vihiga County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Vihiga kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya wilaya inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: KRA parone jogweng' County mar Vihiga ni luwo dongruok mar tich kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Migori County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Migori kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Migori inuu ka qayb galo kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pachgi e County mar Migori mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: TSC calls on the community in Makueni County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TSC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Makueni kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TSC waxay bulshada degmada Makueni ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyada.
Dholuo: TSC okwayo ji duto e gweng' mar Makueni mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Tana River County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the September planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Septemba.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Tana River inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Sebtember.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur manie Tana River County mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro ka pok ochopo dwe mar Septemba.

English: HELB reminds schools in Kiambu County to strengthen child protection in schools this April.
Kiswahili: HELB inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuimarisha ulinzi wa watoto shuleni Aprili hii.
Somali: HELB waxay xusuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Kiambu inay xoojiyaan ilaalinta carruurta ee iskuulada bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa skunde man Kiambu County mondo oteg rit mar nyithindo e skunde e dwe mar April.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Mombasa County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhusu umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ajili ya ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya ayaa dadka degmada Mombasa ku xasuusinaya muhiimadda ay leedahay nadaafadda saxda ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association parone ji duto e county mar Mombasa kuom ber mar rito ler mar pi e ngima joot.

English: NCPB reminds farmers in Mombasa County of the ongoing modern irrigation techniques training programme.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhusu programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji.
Somali: NCPB waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Mombasa barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah.
Dholuo: NCPB oparo ne jopur e county mar Mombasa chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar yore mag lero pi.

English: Kenya Medical Association appeals to caregivers in Lamu County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the February maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Lamu kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya harakati za afya ya uzazi Februari.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ka codsadaa daryeelayaasha degmada Lamu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka ee Febraayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association okwayo jorit e County mar Lamu mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi e dwe mar Februar.

English: DPP alerts residents of Narok County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: DPP anawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka kwa kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: DPP waxay dadka deggan degmada Narok uga digtay kororka kiisaska xoolaha lagu xado waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka warbixiyaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: DPP chiwo siem ne jogweng' Narok County e wi medruok mar weche mag kwalo jamni kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot e stesen mar polise man machiegni.

English: TSC announces distribution of school laptops under the digital literacy programme to schools in Mombasa County this March.
Kiswahili: TSC inatangaza usambazaji wa kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Mombasa mwezi huu wa Machi.
Somali: TSC waxay ku dhawaaqday qaybinta kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada gobolka Mombasa bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: TSC ong'ado mar pogo kompyuta mag skul e bwo chenro mar somo gi somo mar digital e skunde man Mombasa County e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Nyandarua County this April. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Aprili hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhallinyarada ee gobolka Nyandarua bishii Abriil. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni Kenya Medical Association biro timo romo mar paro ne rowere e dwe mar April e kaunti mar Nyandarua.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges anyone experiencing abuse in Trans Nzoia County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kutafuta msaada katika nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Trans Nzoia inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Young parents are encouraged, talked to by health workers on family planning so as to enable the body to heal from the previous pregnance and birth.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wachanga hutiwa moyo, wakizungumziwa na wafanyakazi wa afya kuhusu kupanga familia ili kuwezesha mwili upone kutokana na ujauzito na kuzaliwa uliopita.
Somali: Waalidiinta dhalinyarada ah waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa, shaqaalaha caafimaadka waxay ka hadlaan qorshaynta qoyska si jidhku u bogsado uurka iyo dhalashada hore.
Dholuo: Jonyuol ma pod tindo ijiwo kendo jothieth mag thieth wuoyo kodgi e wi chenro mag ngima joot mondo omi ringre dhano obed gi nyalo mar chango chakre nyuol.

English: DCI alerts residents of Nairobi County to a rise in fraud cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhusu kuongezeka kwa kesi za ulaghai na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: DCI waxay dadka deggan degmada Nairobi uga digtay kororka kiisaska khiyaanada waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nairobi County e wi medruok mar weche mag wuondruok kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Public health advisory: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response warns of increased cyclosporiasis risk in Kisii County and advises the public to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya cyclosporiasis katika Kaunti ya Kisii na inashauri umma kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Somali: Talo-bixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay ka digeysaa kororka halista cyclosporiasis ee Gobolka Kisii waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: Migawo mar Nono kod Duoko ne Tuoche chiwo siem kuom medo nengo mar cyclosporiasis e County mar Kisii kendo ojiwo ji duto mondo otiek dose duto mar thiedho.

English: KENAFF and iCRA are offering agribusiness training to farmers across Kenya Interested farmers should contact KENAFF for details on how to participate
Kiswahili: KENAFF na iCRA wanatoa mafunzo ya kilimo biashara kwa wakulima kote nchini Kenya Wakulima wanaovutiwa wanapaswa kuwasiliana na KENAFF kwa maelezo zaidi kuhusu jinsi ya kushiriki.
Somali: KENAFF iyo iCRA waxay bixiyaan tababar ganacsi beeraley ah oo ku yaal Kenya Beeraleyda xiisaynaya waa inay la xiriiraan KENAFF si ay u helaan faahfaahin ku saabsan sida looga qaybgalayo
Dholuo: KENAFF kod iCRA chiwo tiegruok e weche mag ohala ne jopur e piny Kenya Jopur ma dwaro ng'eyo onego omany ripot gi KENAFF mondo ong'e kaka ginyalo dhi e chenrono

English: Missed Opportunities: A Scorecard on the Jubilee Administration and Lessons for the Next Government
Kiswahili: Fursa Zilizokosa: Kadi ya Alama kuhusu Utawala wa Jubilee na Masomo kwa Serikali Inayofuata
Somali: Fursadaha La Lumiyay: Kaarka Dhibcaha ee Maamulka Jubilee iyo Casharrada Dowladda Xigta
Dholuo: Thuolo ma Oweyo: Kad mar Skor e wi Loch mar Jubili kod Gik ma wapuonjore kuom Sirkal mabiro

English: Chronic heat: impacts and solutions from South-East Asia and East Africa
Kiswahili: Joto sugu: athari na suluhisho kutoka Kusini-Mashariki mwa Asia na Afrika Mashariki
Somali: Kulaylka daba-dheeraaday: saameynta iyo xalalka ka imanaya Koonfur-bari Aasiya iyo Bariga Afrika
Dholuo: Liet ma ok rum: gik ma kelo pek kod duoko mag Asia ma milambo-wuok chieng' kod Afrika ma milambo-wuok chieng'

English: Notice: FAO will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Homa Bay County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa wakulima kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi diiwaangelinta beeraleyda loogu talagalay beeralayda gobolka Homa Bay bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Nonro: FAO biro timo rapar mar jopur e dwe mar Februar e Homa Bay County.

English: Kenya Dairy Board announces a free anthrax vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Nyamira County this December.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya yatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kimeta kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Desemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhawaaqay jimicsi tallaal ah oo lacag la'aan ah oo loo sameeyo lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Nyamira bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board olando chenro mar thiedho dhok e dwe mar Desemba e kaunti mar Nyamira.

English: NTSA calls on the community in Nyandarua County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Somali: NTSA waxay bulshada degmada Nyandarua ugu baaqeysaa inay ka soo horjeedaan rabshadaha jinsiga iyo inay taageero ka raadsadaan hoyga ugu dhow.
Dholuo: NTSA okwayo ji duto manie County mar Nyandarua mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gidwar kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: IPOA warns residents of Narok County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok juu ya kuongezeka kwa kashfa za pesa za rununu na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kutenda.
Somali: IPOA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan gobolka Narok kororka khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobilada waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan falin.
Dholuo: IPOA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Narok County e wi medruok mar timbe mag wuondo pesa mag simo kendo ojiwo ji mondo ong'e kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: Washing hands before harvesting mangoes prevents cross contamination.
Kiswahili: Kufua mikono kabla ya kuvuna maembe huzuia uchafuzi wa kuvuka.
Somali: Dhaqidda gacmaha ka hor goosashada mango-yada ayaa ka hortagaya wasakheynta isdhaafka.
Dholuo: Luoko lweteni kapok ichoko mango, miyo ok idok e obadho mar chwoyo.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) advises residents of West Pokot County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay biyo cabitaan ah ku kariyaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo omak pi modho kapok gitiyo kode e geng'o tuwono kik landre.

English: Judiciary of Kenya invites residents of Kericho County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya gwelo joma odak e County mar Kericho mondo oriwre gi sirkal mar county e chiwo paro e wi tich mitimo higa ka higa.

English: Notice from CDC: family planning counselling clinics will run every January at designated health centres in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa CDC: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Januari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid CDC: rugta la talinta qorshaynta qoyska waxay ka shaqeyn doontaa Janaayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth miluongo ni CDC: Klinike mag chiwo paro e wi chenro mag ngima joot biro tiyo e dwe mar Januar higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e gweng' mar Baringo.

English: IEBC urges residents of Nyamira County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from free primary education.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawataka wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogweng' Nyamira County mondo odonj e program mar somo kod somo mar jomoti mondo giyud somo ma onge chudo.

English: IPOA urges motorists and pedestrians in Embu County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent landslides-related incidents.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Embu kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa gawaarida wadayaasha iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Embu inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada fatahaada ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira dhulgariirka.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo joidh mtokni kod jowuoth e county mar Embu mondo kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o mondo kik gidonj e masiche motudore gi yiengni mag lowo.

English: Announcement that public service will now provide tele and in-person counselling services through Huduma Centres and hotline 1919.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwamba huduma ya umma sasa itatoa huduma za ushauri nasaha kwa njia ya simu na ana kwa ana kupitia Vituo vya Huduma na simu ya dharura 1919.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida in adeegga dadweynaha uu hadda bixin doono adeegyo la-talin telefishan iyo shakhsi ahaan iyada oo loo marayo Xarumaha Huduma iyo khadka tooska ah 1919.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda biro chiwo kony e yor simo kod e wang' ng'ato kokalo kuom Huduma Centres kod hotline 1919.

English: Notice: SHA opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Shirika la SHA linafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Shirkadda SHA waxay ka furtay barta adeegga cusub ee ka shaqeynta shahaadada dhalashada ee gobolka Nandi.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA oseyawo kama itimee tije manyien mar loso barua mag nyuol e county mar Nandi.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free cyclosporiasis screening is available at all public health centres in Kakamega County this October.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa cyclosporiasis unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Oktoba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka bilaashka ah ee cyclosporiasis laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee Gobolka Kakamega bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji ni thieth mar cyclosporiasis en mar nono maonge chudo e kuonde thieth duto e Kaunti mar Kakamega e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Research Briefs: Results From Re:BUiLDâ€™s Wave 1 Randomized Control Trials (RCTs) On Mentorship And Cash Grants For Microentrepreneurs in Nairobi, Kenya and Kampala, Uganda
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Utafiti: Matokeo Kutoka kwa Re:BUiLD's Wave 1 Randomized Control Trials (RCTs) Juu ya Ushauri na Ruzuku ya Fedha kwa Wajasiriamali Wadogo huko Nairobi, Kenya na Kampala, Uganda.
Somali: Kooban oo Cilmi-baaris ah: Natiijooyinka Tijaabooyinka Xakamaynta Kala Sooca ee Re: BUiLD's Move 1 (RCTs) ee ku saabsan La-talinta iyo Deeqaha Lacagta ah ee Ganacsatada Yaryar ee Nairobi, Kenya iyo Kampala, Uganda
Dholuo: Oboke mag Nonro: Duoko mag Temo mag Re: BuiLD ma ne otimre e wi puonj kod pesa ma ne imiyo jo ohala matindo e boma ma Nairobi, piny Kenya kod Kampala, piny Uganda

English: Public declaration of stress management, substance abuse, workplace safety, and wellness training for employers via FKE curriculum.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la umma la usimamizi wa msongo wa mawazo, matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya, usalama mahali pa kazi, na mafunzo ya ustawi kwa waajiri kupitia mtaala wa FKE.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha ee maareynta stress, xadgudubka maadooyinka, ammaanka goobta shaqada, iyo tababarka caafimaadka ee loo shaqeeyaha iyada oo loo marayo manhajka FKE.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda mang'ongo mar weche thieth mag stress, tiyo marach gi yedhe ma mero ji, ritruok e tich, kod tiegruok mar ngima maber ne jotelo mag tich kokalo kuom chenro mar somo mar FKE.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds voters in Murang'a County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya kusajili wapiga Kura.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaan-hayaha xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa xasuusinaya codbixiyayaasha degmada Murang'a inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta ee IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor diiwaangelinta codbixisayaasha.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties parone jogweng' Murang'a County ni mondo gidhi e centre mar IEBC man machiegni kodgi kapok gidonjo e register mar joma biro yiero.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Lamu County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan dhac lagu caawinayo in xaafadaha la ilaaliyo.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogweng'o mag Lamu County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo odno konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: State Department for Basic Education advises students in Busia County to register early to secure allocation to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Busia kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ardayda degmada Busia kula talineysaa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan si ay u helaan deeq waxbarasho oo loogu talagalay ardayda u baahan.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education nyiso jopuonjre e county mar Busia ni gidonj e skundno chon mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo osuru ne jopuonjre mochando.

English: Notice: AFA restricts movement of sheep in Elgeyo-Marakwet County due to a rabies outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA inazuia harakati za kondoo katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kutokana na mlipuko wa kichaa cha mbwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa idaha degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet sababtuna tahay cudurka cadhada.
Dholuo: Rapar: AFA ogeng'o wuoth mar rombe e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet nikech tuwo mar rabies.

English: Employers are encouraged to advise, their staff & general public accessing their workplaces, to adhere to the laid down containment measures of hand washing, keeping social & physical distance, observing cough etiquette, avoiding face touching, & proper use of face mask.
Kiswahili: Waajiri wanahimizwa kushauri, wafanyakazi wao na umma kwa ujumla kufikia maeneo yao ya kazi, kuzingatia hatua zilizowekwa za kuzuia mikono, kuweka umbali wa kijamii na kimwili, kuzingatia adabu za kikohozi, kuepuka kugusa uso, na matumizi sahihi ya barakoa.
Somali: Loo-shaqeeyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay kula taliyaan, shaqaalahooda iyo dadweynaha guud ee galaya goobahooda shaqada, inay u hoggaansamaan tallaabooyinka xakamaynta ee la dejiyay sida dhaqidda gacmaha, ilaalinta kala fogaanshaha bulshada iyo jirka, ilaalinta anshaxa qufaca, ka fogaanshaha taabashada wejiga, iyo isticmaalka habboon ee maaskaro wejiga.
Dholuo: Jotich jiwo mondo omi jotichgi kod ji duto ma donjo e kuonde tichgi rieko, mondo oluw okenge ma oketi mag lwoko lwedo, rito thuolo e kind ji kod ringruok, luwo yore mag ng’iyo, weyo mulo wang’, kod tiyo maber gi mask mar wang’.

English: HELB calls on the community in Nyeri County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: HELB inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: HELB waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Nyeri inay u soo sheegaan mas'uuliyadda dugsiga wixii dhibaato ah ee ku saabsan amniga si ay dugsiyada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: HELB kwayo ji duto manie County mar Nyeri mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar skul e wi weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds farmers in Nandi County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi juu ya mpango unaoendelea wa mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa xusuusinaya beeraleyda degmada Nandi barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee xakamaynta cayayaannada iyo cudurrada.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products oparo ne jopur e County mar Nandi chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche.

English: Coverage of CS Murkomen requiring all stations to formalize COP practices
Kiswahili: Ufunikaji wa CS Murkomen ambayo inahitaji vituo vyote kuhalalisha mazoea ya COP
Somali: Ka qaybgalka CS Murkomen oo looga baahan yahay dhammaan saldhigyada inay si rasmi ah u qaabeeyaan dhaqanka COP
Dholuo: Riwruok mar CS Murkomen ma dwaro ni stesen duto ochak tiyo gi yore mag COP

English: Notice: KEPHIS will open a maize collection centre in Meru County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mahindi katika Kaunti ya Meru Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay ka furi doontaa xarun ururinta hadhuudhka degmada Meru bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro yawo kama ichokoe cham e kaunti mar Meru e dwe mar Mei.

English: CDC reminds the public that free stress management support is available through county health facilities in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kudhibiti mafadhaiko unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero lacag la'aan ah ee maaraynta stress-ka laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka degmada ee degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji ni kony mar thieth mar parruok ma onge chudo yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Bungoma.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges parents and teachers in Trans Nzoia County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa usimamizi wa shule.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Trans Nzoia inay u soo sheegaan maamulka iskuulka wixii arrimo ah oo ku saabsan amniga.
Dholuo: Ofis mar State for Basic Education jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo onyis sirkal mar skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ee degmada Laikipia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag siasa e County mar Laikipia.

English: SHA urges residents of Homa Bay County to attend the public participation forum to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Homa Bay kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si ay u qaabeeyaan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo ji duto modak e Homa Bay County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar loso chenro mar dongruok.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) advises residents of Nyandarua County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay yareeyaan qaadashada cusbada iyo sonkorta si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nyandarua County ni giduog chien e chamo chamo mor kod sukari mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: TSC encourages residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: TSC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabtaan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo ong'e weche ma giduto giduto giseyudogo mondo ging'e tich mar ombudsman.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service promotes soil conservation among farmers in Vihiga County as part of the March climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inakuza uhifadhi wa udongo miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Machi.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa ilaalinta ciidda beeraleyda degmada Vihiga iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo rito lowo e kind jopur e County mar Vihiga kaka achiel kuom chenro mar March mar kedo gi lokruok e kor lwasi.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET opens a new catering and hospitality programme at the vocational centre in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inafungua mpango mpya wa upishi na ukarimu katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Qaranka ee TVET waxay ka furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan cuntada iyo marti-gelinta xarunta xirfadaha ee Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar State for TVET ochako chenro manyien mar chiemo kod rwako welo e skul mar tich e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Lamu County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the March planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu watumie viwango vinavyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Machi.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Lamu County inay isticmaalaan sicirka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur e County mar Lamu ni mondo giti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Mach.

English: Govt kicks of distribution of mosquito nets. Govt aims at distributing 15.3M treated nets
Kiswahili: Serikali yazindua usambazaji wa vyandarua. Serikali inalenga kusambaza vyandarua milioni 15.3 vilivyotibiwa
Somali: Dowladda waxay bilaabaneysaa qaybinta shabagyada cayayaanka. Dowladdu waxay higsaneysaa in loo qaybiyo 15.3M shababyada la daaweeyey
Dholuo: Sirkal oseng'ado mar pogo net mag lum. Sirkal dwaro pogo net mamol milion 15.3

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds the public in West Pokot County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Auditor Mkuu kuwakumbusha umma katika West Pokot County kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadweynaha gobolka West Pokot in warbixinta khayaanada iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General parone ji duto e West Pokot County ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag yuto en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises avocado producers in Kakamega County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inashauri wazalishaji wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walio na leseni kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha avocado ee Gobolka Kakamega inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development nyiso jopur mag avocado e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni gius olembegi mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo olembe kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Notice: NTSA conducts a community briefing on border security in Tana River County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Wilaya ya Tana River mwezi huu Oktoba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha degmada Tana River bishii Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Riwruok mar National Security Agency (NTSA) timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e taon mar Tana River County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Makueni County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Makueni: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Aprili 2023
Somali: Degmada Makueni: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Makueni: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar ang'wen 2023

English: NCPB urges pigs farmers in Kisii County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawataka wafugaji wa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa ngozi wa uvimbe ulioripotiwa.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda doofaarka ee degmada Kisii inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyada oo aan la helin ruqsad ka dib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur puothe e County mar Kisii mondo kik giting' jamni ka giwuok e county maok giyudo rusa bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag pien.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay ugu yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo kik gisandgi ka giol kendo giluong kony mar thieth mar chuny maonge chudo.

English: What Can We Learn from Refugee-Led Education in Kenya?
Kiswahili: Je, Tunaweza Kujifunza Nini Kutokana na Elimu Inayoongozwa na Wakimbizi nchini Kenya?
Somali: Maxaan ka baran karnaa waxbarashada ay hormuudka ka yihiin qaxootiga ee Kenya?
Dholuo: Ang’o ma wanyalo puonjore kuom somo ma jolweny ma ng’ado piny otelo e piny Kenya?

English: EACC warns public officers in Garissa County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: EACC inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa dhidi ya rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: EACC waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee Gobolka Garissa inay musuqmaasuq ku sameeyaan xafiisyada dowladda.
Dholuo: EACC chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e gweng' mar Garissa kuom kawo asoya e migepe mar sirkal.

English: Notice: TVET announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Makueni.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET olando tarik mag somo mar pinyruoth ma onge chudo e skunde mag Makueni County.

English: Notice: KEMSA will hold a depression awareness forum in Migori County this April. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA itafanya kongamano la uhamasishaji wa unyogovu katika Kaunti ya Migori Aprili hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMSA waxay qabaneysaa madasha wacyiga dhibta ee Degmada Migori bisha April. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMSA biro timo chokruok mar chiwo paro e wi tuwo mar depression e taon mar Migori e dwe mar April.

English: NPS reminds mobile money users in Taita-Taveta County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa fedha za simu.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna si looga fogaado khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: NPS paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mobil e Taita-Taveta County ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo kik gitim timbe mag wuondruok.

English: OGP encourages first-time voters in Kwale County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: OGP inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kwale kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: OGP waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Kwale inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogo matimoga yiero mokwongo e Kaunti mar Kwale mondo oting'e ID mar piny kata pasipoti e odiechieng'no mar yiero.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Kirinyaga County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kirinyaga in warbixinta degdegga ah ee jabsashada ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NTSA parone jogweng' Kirinyaga County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar donjo e ot konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Agricultural insurance protects against risks like pest outbreak. Learn about available insurance products for poultry and how to access them.
Kiswahili: Bima ya kilimo hulinda dhidi ya hatari kama vile mlipuko wa wadudu. Jifunze kuhusu bidhaa za bima zinazopatikana kwa kuku na jinsi ya kuzipata.
Somali: Caymiska beeraha ayaa ka hortaga khataraha sida faafitaanka cayayaanka. Baro alaabooyinka caymiska ee digaagga iyo sida loo heli karo.
Dholuo: Puonjri weche momedore e wi gik ma inyalo yudo kuom choko le kod kaka inyalo yudo yuto.

English: DCI reminds the public in Kwale County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DCI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kwale inay ka feejignaadaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: DCI parone ji duto e county mar Kwale ni gibed motang' ne loso kuwe e piny mangima.

English: FAO advises farmers in Nakuru County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the April planting season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji Aprili.
Somali: FAO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nakuru inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar April.

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of Homa Bay County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this February.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Februari hii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay u diyaar garoobaan qaraxyo dab ah oo dhici kara bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross osiemo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo oikre ne yiengni manyalo timore e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: HELB opens a new catering and hospitality programme at the vocational centre in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB inafungua mpango mpya wa upishi na ukarimu katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan cuntada iyo marti-gelinta xarunta xirfadaha ee Gobolka Kwale.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: HELB chako chenro manyien mar chiemo kod rwako welo e skul mar tich e county mar Kwale.

English: Notice: KALRO will conduct a greenhouse farming workshop for farmers in Machakos County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafanya warsha ya kilimo cha chafu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo ee beeraleyda degmada Machakos bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KALRO biro timo chokruok mar timo tijno ne jopur e gweng' mar Machakos e dwe mar April.

English: DCI warns residents of Makueni County to prepare for possible road accidents this August.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Agosti hii.
Somali: DCI waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay u diyaar garoobaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: DCI osiemo jogweng' Makueni mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Agost.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development invites farmers in Nyandarua County to a free training on fertiliser application this February.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwa mafunzo ya bure juu ya matumizi ya mbolea Februari hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku casuumaysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyandarua inay tababar bilaash ah ku helaan isticmaalka Bacriminta bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ogwelo jopur e County mar Nyandarua e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar tiyo gi yien e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission reminds citizens in Nandi County about their rights regarding the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuhusu haki zao kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu muwaadiniinta degmada Nandi xasuusinayaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj parone raia e County mar Nandi kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo ombudsman.

English: Notice: KUCCPS launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay bilawday barnaamij lagu darayo ardayda naafada ah dugsiyada gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KUCCPS chako chenro mar tiego nyithindo ma nigi midekre e skunde duto mag Homa Bay County.

English: Laikipia County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Laikipia: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2024
Somali: Degmada Laikipia: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Laikipia: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2024

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds residents of Kilifi County that organic farming improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kwamba kilimo hai kinaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: Guddiga xakamaynta cayayaanka ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Kilifi in beeraha dabiiciga ah uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne Jo-Kilifi County ni pur ma nigi yien okelo nyak e puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: DPP reminds the public in Lamu County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: DPP inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Lamu kubaki macho juu ya mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Lamu inay ka feejignaadaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: DPP paronwa ji duto e County mar Lamu mondo gibed motang' gi chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: ODPP reminds residents of Narok County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Narok in ay ku hawlan yihiin maamulaha qaybta maxalliga ah si ay u xoojiyaan maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: ODPP paronwa jogweng' Narok County ni tudruok gi jotelo mag gwenge maggi miyo sirkal bedo gi loch maber.

English: IPOA calls on residents of Machakos County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: IPOA inatoa wito kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpakani kwa vyombo vya usalama ili kuunga mkono umakini wa kukabiliana na ugaidi.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga dhaqdhaqaaq aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaalla aagagga xuduudda si ay u taageeraan taxadarka ka dhanka ah argagixisada.
Dholuo: IPOA okwayo jogweng'o mag Machakos County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma kedo gi timbe mahundu ni gitimo gik maok kare e alwora mar tong'gi.

English: Teachers Service Commission invites youth in Lamu County to enroll for motor vehicle mechanics training this August.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Lamu kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari Agosti hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka ayaa ku casuumay dhalinyarada degmada Lamu inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka mashiinnada gawaarida gaadiidka bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission ogwelo rowere e County mar Lamu mondo odonj e tiegruok mar jomisonari mag mtokni e dwe mar Agost.

English: COMESA advises farmers in Machakos County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the March planting season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji Machi.
Somali: COMESA waxay kula talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Machakos inay qaataan noocyo abuurka ah oo u adkaysta abaarta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: COMESA nyiso jopur e county mar Machakos mondo oti gi kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochako chwoyo kodhi e dwe mar Mach.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Kericho County about the importance of tobacco control for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuhusu umuhimu wa udhibiti wa tumbaku kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu dadka degmada Kericho ku xasuusinayaa muhiimadda ay leedahay ka hortagga sigaarka caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association parone ji duto e County mar Kericho ni thieth mar madho ndawa en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: COMESA advises horticultural produce producers in Bomet County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inashauri wazalishaji wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Bomet kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: COMESA waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha wax soo saarka beeraha ee degmada Bomet inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: COMESA nyiso jopur ma loso puothe e county mar Bomet ni gidonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: TSC reminds youth in Isiolo County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari.
Somali: TSC waxay xasuusineysaa dhallinyarada degmada Isiolo in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka farsamada gawaarida.
Dholuo: TSC oparo ne rowere man Isiolo County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar jomisonari mag mtokni.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Taita-Taveta County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa wilaya ili kuwa na habari juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Taita-Taveta inay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga guud ee golaha gobolka si ay uga warqabtaan bixinta adeegyada degmada.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng'o mag Taita-Taveta County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo omed ng'eyo weche momedore e wi tiegruok mar tij lendo.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will conduct a pest and disease management workshop for farmers in West Pokot County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itafanya warsha ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada beeraleyda ee Gobolka West Pokot bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro timo tiegruok mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche ne jopur e West Pokot County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds livestock keepers in Tana River County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu xasuusinayaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Tana River inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyada oo aan la helin rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jorit mag jamni e taon mar Tana River County ni kik giting' jamni ka ok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima rombe.

English: DCI reminds mobile money users in Migori County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Migori kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Migori inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: DCI paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e County mar Migori ni mondo ging'e kwayo margi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo gitang' gi weche mag phishing.

English: CDC reminds the public in Kisii County about the importance of diabetes screening for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuhusu umuhimu wa uchunguzi wa kisukari kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kisii muhiimadda baaritaanka sonkorowga ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji duto e County mar Kisii kuom gimomiyo thieth mar thieth mag ndhoga dwarore ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Nearly three-quarters of residents report experiencing heat-related health problems, including heat exhaustion, dehydration and skin conditions.
Kiswahili: Takriban robo tatu ya wakazi wanaripoti kukumbana na matatizo ya kiafya yanayohusiana na joto, ikiwa ni pamoja na uchovu wa joto, upungufu wa maji mwilini na hali ya ngozi.
Somali: Ku dhawaad ​​saddex meelood meel dadka deegaanka ayaa soo sheegaya inay la kulmaan dhibaatooyin caafimaad oo la xiriira kulaylka, oo ay ku jiraan daal kulayl, fuuqbax iyo xaalado maqaarka ah.
Dholuo: Chiegni nus adek kuom ang’wen mag jodak nyiso ni giyudo pek mag thieth ma luwore gi liet, moriwo nyaka ng’ol nikech liet, bedo gi pi matin e del kod tuoche mag del.

English: Public notice: Kenya Red Cross will host a free hand hygiene outreach in Samburu County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Samburu Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay martigelin doontaa dhaqdhaqaaqa nadaafadda gacmaha ee bilaashka ah ee Gobolka Samburu bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova mar Kenya Red Cross biro timo kampen mar rito ler mar lwedo e taon mar Samburu e dwe mar Februar.

English: NPS urges motorists and pedestrians in Vihiga County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NPS inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa wadayaasha gawaarida iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Vihiga inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay adeegsadaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee socodka si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira qaraxyada dabka.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo joidh mtokni kod jowuoth e County mar Vihiga mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe mondo gikwed hinyruok mag yiengni.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds residents of Kakamega County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba upatikanaji wa usajili wa e-Citizen sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kakamega in helitaanka diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone jogweng' Kakamega County ni koro nyalo bedo mayot donjo e e-Citizen registration ka gitiyo gi yore ma sirkal tiyogo.
