English: HELB reminds needy students in Embu County that revision guides applications close soon.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Embu kwamba maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda baahsan ee degmada Embu in dib u eegis lagu wado codsiyada la dhammeeyo dhowaan.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa jopuonjre modhier e county mar Embu ni lokruok mar gwelo kwayo mag kwayo biro rumo machiegni.

English: COMESA advises farmers in Kwale County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kwale inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e county mar Kwale mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Farmers are encouraged to participate in the government s initiative providing Kshs 500 million for the distribution of 20 million high yielding coffee seedlings to coffee growing regions
Kiswahili: Wakulima wamehimizwa kushiriki katika mpango wa serikali wa kutoa Kshs 500 milioni kwa usambazaji wa miche milioni 20 ya kahawa yenye mavuno mengi kwa mikoa inayolima kahawa.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay ka qayb qaataan hindisaha dowladda ee siinaya Kshs 500 milyan si loo qaybiyo 20 milyan oo geed qaxwo ah oo wax-soo-saarka sare leh gobollada kafee beerta
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma bende timo kamano, ijiwo mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar sirkal mar chiwo Kshs 500 milion mondo okony e pogo kodhi mag kahwa ma nigi nyak maduong ' mar milion 20 ne gwenge ma pidhoe kahwa

English: COMESA warns cassava farmers in Nyeri County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawaonya wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Nyeri juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: COMESA waxay uga digtay beeraleyda cassava ee degmada Nyeri cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: COMESA chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho manias e County mar Nyeri kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Adopt the One Health approach recognizing the interconnectedness of human animal and environmental health especially in managing zoonotic diseases
Kiswahili: Tumia mbinu ya Afya Moja ukitambua muunganiko wa afya ya binadamu wanyama na mazingira hasa katika kudhibiti magonjwa ya wanyama
Somali: Qaadashada habka One Health oo aqoonsanaysa isku xirka caafimaadka xayawaanka aadanaha iyo deegaanka, gaar ahaan maaraynta cudurrada zoonotic
Dholuo: Ti gi chenro mar One Health, manyiso tudruok e kind ngima dhano gi ngima mar le kod alwora, to moloyo e thiedho tuoche mag le

English: KEMSA encourages mothers in Meru County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Meru kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Meru inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo mine manie County mar Meru mondo olim kama gibiro yudoe nyithindo machiegni mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: AFA advises farmers in Garissa County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the January planting season.
Kiswahili: AFA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Januari.
Somali: AFA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Garissa inay qaataan noocyo abuurka ah oo abaarta u adkaysta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Janaayo.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Garissa mondo oti gi kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochopo dwe mar Januar.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties urges residents of Siaya County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia wavuti ya kaunti ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja wa kaunti.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca bogga shabakadda degmada si ay uga warqabtaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Siaya mondo ong'e dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mar dongruok e alwora.

English: Health Ministry mandating provision of fruit-based snacks instead of sugary options in public primary schools by 2026.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya ikiagiza utoaji wa vitafunio vyenye matunda badala ya vyakula vyenye sukari katika shule za msingi za umma ifikapo mwaka 2026.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka oo amar ku bixisay bixinta cuntooyinka khafiifka ah ee ku saleysan miraha halkii laga heli lahaa xulashooyinka sonkorta ah ee dugsiyada hoose ee dadweynaha sanadka 2026.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth dwaro ni nyaka chop higa mar 2026 ochiw chiemo ma nigi olemo e kar chiemo mamit e skunde matindo mag sirkal.

English: Informing small scale farmers importance of incorporating technology can minimise diseases brought by ( spodoptera frugiperda) survey about..
Kiswahili: Kuwafahamisha wakulima wadogo umuhimu wa kujumuisha teknolojia kunaweza kupunguza magonjwa yanayoletwa na ( spodoptera frugiperda) utafiti kuhusu..
Somali: In la wargeliyo beeraleyda yaryar muhiimadda ay leedahay in la soo daro tikniyoolajiyadda ayaa yareyn kara cudurrada ay keeneen ( spodoptera frugiperda) sahan ku saabsan ...
Dholuo: Nyiso jopur matindo gimomiyo tiyo gi teknoloji nyalo miyo tuoche ma nonro mar spodoptera frugiperda (Frugiperda) kelo okethre.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General opens a new service point for passport services in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee degmada Nyamira.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Auditor General oseyawo kama tiyo gi passport e County mar Nyamira.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds the public in Meru County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Meru kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu dadka degmada Meru ku xasuusinayaa in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette parone ji duto manie County mar Meru ni chiwo ripot mar kawo asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges youth in Samburu County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Samburu kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ugu baaqaysaa dhalinyarada degmada Samburu inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education ojiwo rowere e county mar Samburu mondo oriwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gitimo tije mag oganda.

English: As you stay home to #KomeshaCorona try to add the following anti-viral and immune-boosting herbs and spices to the meals you prepare for yourself and your family: *Chili pepper, oregano , rosemary, or turmeric. *Fresh garlic and ginger.
Kiswahili: Unapokaa nyumbani kwa #KomeshaCorona jaribu kuongeza mimea na viungo vifuatavyo vya kuzuia virusi na kuongeza kinga kwenye milo unayojiandalia wewe na familia yako: *Pilipili Chili, oregano , rosemary, au manjano. *Kitunguu saumu safi na tangawizi.
Somali: Markaad guriga joogtid #KomeshaCorona isku day inaad ku darto geedaha iyo xawaashka soo socda ee ka hortagga fayraska iyo difaaca jirka cuntooyinka aad u diyaariso naftaada iyo qoyskaaga: *Basbaaska basbaaska leh, oregano, rosemary, ama turmeric. *Toon iyo sinjibiil cusub.
Dholuo: Ka idong' pacho ne #KomeshaCorona tem medo gigo maluwogi mag lweny kod midhiero mag del e chiemo ma iloso ne in kod joodi: *Apile mar chili, oregano , rosemary, kata angus. *Gallik mayom kod tangaja.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya activates an emergency response plan for flooding in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya yaanzisha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay hirgelinaysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ku saabsan fatahaadaha gobolka Nakuru.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chako tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne ataro mar pi e gweng' mar Nakuru.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges residents of Trans Nzoia County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Elimu ya Msingi ya Jimbo inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia in ay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan Barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok Dhano jiwo ji duto modak e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo odonj e program mar tiego joma dongo mondo giyud konyruok kuom program mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: Notice: ODPP will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada ee Degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: ODPP biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mar bajet mar kaunti e kaunti mar Isiolo.

English: Public health advisory: KEMRI warns of increased measles risk in Marsabit County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMRI inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya surua katika Kaunti ya Marsabit na inashauri umma kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na dawa za kuua wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Talo-bixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: KEMRI waxay ka digtay kororka halista ah ee suuxdinta ee degmada Marsabit waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: KEMRI chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar nyol e taon mar Marsabit County kendo ojiwo ji mondo oti gi gige choko alot molos gi yedhe makelo tuoche madho diek otieno ka otieno.

English: Notice: KMTC opens applications for textbooks and learning materials for learners in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inafungua maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay u furaysaa codsiyada buugaagta waxbarasho iyo qalabka wax lagu barto ardayda degmada Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC chako tiyo gi buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok ne jopuonjre man Kirinyaga County.

English: Notice: COMESA will conduct a greenhouse farming workshop for farmers in Bungoma County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itaendesha warsha ya kilimo cha chafu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo ee beeraleyda degmada Bungoma bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA biro timo chokruok mar timo tijno ne jopur e bungoma county e dwe mar abich.

English: Ministry of Education invites youth in Laikipia County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this November.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Novemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku casuumaysaa dhalinyarada degmada Laikipia inay iska diiwaangeliyaan tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista bisha November.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education ogwelo rowere e County mar Laikipia mondo odonj e tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing e dwe mar Novemba.

English: COMESA reminds farmers in Kilifi County of the ongoing greenhouse farming training programme.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kilimo cha chafu.
Somali: COMESA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kilifi barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo.
Dholuo: COMESA parone jopur e gweng' mar Kilifi chenro mar tiegruok ma sani dhi nyime e weche mag pidho cham.

English: Kenya Gazette advises residents of Bomet County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan shahaadada dhalashada.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette nyiso jogweng'o mag Bomet County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro yudo barua mar nyuol.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association confirms a malaria outbreak alert for Mandera County. Residents are advised to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya chathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa malaria katika Kaunti ya Mandera. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xaqiijiyay digniin ku saabsan cudurka Cudurka Cudurada ee Gobolka Mandera. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Medical Association osenyiso ni nitie masira mar malaria e taon mar Mandera.

English: Marsabit County pastoralists can now access support for smallholder fish farming as a climate adaptation strategy Contact the county s fisheries directorate for more information
Kiswahili: Wafugaji wa Kaunti ya Marsabit sasa wanaweza kupata usaidizi wa ufugaji wa samaki wadogo kama mkakati wa kukabiliana na hali ya hewa Wasiliana na kurugenzi ya uvuvi ya kaunti kwa taarifa zaidi.
Somali: Xoolo-dhaqatada degmada Marsabit hadda waxay heli karaan taageero beeralayda kalluunka yaryar sida istiraatiijiyad la qabsiga cimilada La xiriir waaxda kalluumaysiga ee gobolka si aad u hesho macluumaad dheeraad ah
Dholuo: Jo-Marsabit County jodongo nyalo yudo kony mar pidho rech matindo kaka yo mar timo lokruok e kit ngima mar piny

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will distribute certified sorghum seed to farmers in Vihiga County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu abuuraha Degmada Vihiga u qaybin doonaa abuurka sorghum ee la caddeeyay bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro pogo kodhi mag sorghum ne jopur man Vihiga County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will hold a trauma counselling forum in Baringo County this August. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitafanya kongamano la ushauri wa kiwewe katika Kaunti ya Baringo Agosti hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafiminta Wax-soo-saarka ayaa qaban doonta madasha la-talinta dhaawaca ee Degmada Baringo bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo chokruok mar chiwo paro e baringo County e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: KTDA restricts movement of cattle in Siaya County due to a rabies outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA inazuia harakati za ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Siaya kutokana na mlipuko wa kichaa cha mbwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da Gobolka Siaya sababo la xiriira cudurka qabyaalada.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok e county mar Siaya nikech tuwo mar rabies.

English: Kilifi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kilifi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2024
Somali: Degmada Kilifi: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kilifi: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Septemba 2024

English: State Department for TVET announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in Baringo County this December.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Baringo Desemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhawaaqday qaybinta deeqaha waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan dugsiyada degmada Baringo bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET ogolo chiwo mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre man gi chandruok e skunde man Baringo County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Universities Fund advises applicants in Turkana County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Turkana kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu kula talinayaa codsadayaasha degmada Turkana inay dalbadaan booska TVET ee KUCCPS loogu talagalay gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund chiwo paro ne jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e County mar Turkana mondo okonygi yudo thuolo mar dhi e tiegruok mar TVET kokalo kuom KUCCPS.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit appeals to caregivers in Kajiado County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the October maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Oktoba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Kajiado inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta rugta caafimaadka ee la qorsheeyay iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit okwayo jorit e Kajiado County mondo odhi e klinik ma ne otim e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Narok County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok kuleta nambari yao ya usajili wa mkulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Narok inay keenaan lambarrada diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qayb galaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e county mar Narok mondo okel namba mar pimo jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: Notice: Council of Governors launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Mombasa County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuq maasuqa ee ka socda gobolka Mombasa bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Jaloch chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Mombasa e dwe mar Septemba.

English: ODPP invites residents of Murang'a County to attend the public participation forum regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay ka qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: ODPP gwelo ji duto modak e county mar Murang'a mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenro mag dongruok.

English: CDC reminds the public in Mandera County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Mandera in helitaanka adeegyada bukaanka dibedda ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji duto man Mandera County ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mag thieth e kuonde moketi.

English: Kenya: Building strong and sustainable communities through resource sharing
Kiswahili: Kenya: Kujenga jumuiya imara na endelevu kupitia kugawana rasilimali
Somali: Kenya: Dhisidda bulshooyin xooggan oo waara iyada oo loo marayo wadaagga kheyraadka
Dholuo: Kenya: Gero oganda motegno kendo manyalo dak kokalo kuom pogo mwandu

English: Kenya confirms three new Mpox cases from Nairobi, Nakuru and Mombasa counties, this brings the total to 17, Health CS Barasa says.
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha visa vitatu vipya vya Mpox kutoka kaunti za Nairobi, Nakuru na Mombasa, hii inafikisha jumla ya visa 17, Waziri wa Afya Barasa anasema.
Somali: Kenya ayaa xaqiijisay saddex kiis oo cusub oo Mpox ah oo ka yimid degmooyinka Nairobi, Nakuru iyo Mombasa, taasoo wadarta guud u kordhineysa 17, sida ay sheegtay Health CS Barasa.
Dholuo: Kenya osenyiso ni ji adek manyien ma nigi tuwo mar Mpox owuok Nairobi, Nakuru kod Mombasa, omiyo kwan mar ji duto osedok 17, Health CS Barasa wacho.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds residents of Lamu County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kwamba kufikia usajili wa e-Citizen sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu in helitaanka diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone jogweng' mar County mar Lamu ni yudo e-Citizen registration koro yot kokalo kuom yore mag tich.

English: Notice: IPOA issues a cybersecurity alert on mobile money scams affecting residents of Narok County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya kashfa za pesa za rununu zinazoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Ogaysiis: IPOA waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile ee saameynaya dadka deggan gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Rapar: IPOA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity kuom timbe mag wuond mag pesa mitimo ne joma odak Narok County.

English: AATF is seeking to increase their knowledge through initiating farmers training institute, with a bid of expanding knowledge inside and outside.
Kiswahili: AATF inatafuta kuongeza maarifa yao kupitia kuanzisha taasisi ya mafunzo ya wakulima, kwa zabuni ya kupanua maarifa ndani na nje.
Somali: AATF waxay doonaysaa inay kordhiso aqoontooda iyada oo la bilaabayayo machadka tababarka beeraleyda, iyadoo la doonayo in aqoontooda la ballaariyo gudaha iyo dibaddaba.
Dholuo: AATF dwaro medo ng'eyo margi kuom chako riwruok mar tiego jopur, ka gitemo medo ng'eyo margi e ot ka ot.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development opens a new tailoring and design programme at the vocational centre in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yafungua programu mpya ya ushonaji na kubuni katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ka furayaa barnaamij cusub oo loogu talagalay qaabeynta iyo naqshadeynta xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Kilifi.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ochako chenro manyien mar loso kendo loso gik moko e skul mar tiegruok e gweng' mar Kilifi.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds youth in Kitui County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka ayaa xasuusinaya dhalinyarada degmada Kitui in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka mashiinka gawaarida.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne rowere man Kitui County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar masinde mag mtokni.

English: Agriculture follows rules and customs of productivity with high yields all the year round, feeds, energy,food that helps metabolism...
Kiswahili: Kilimo hufuata sheria na desturi za utengenezaji na mavuno ya juu mwaka mzima, malisho, nishati, chakula ambacho husaidia kimetaboliki...
Somali: Beeraha wuxuu raacaa xeerarka iyo caadooyinka wax soo saarka leh wax soo saar sare sanadka oo dhan, quudinta, tamarta, cuntada ka caawisa dheef-shiid kiimikaadka...
Dholuo: Tij pur luwo chike kod timbe mag tich ma kelo nyak maber higa mangima, chiemo, teko, chiemo makonyo ringo...

English: Pest Control Products Board encourages farmers in Kajiado County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for tea.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za chai.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda degmada Kajiado inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo hubiyo qiimaha wanaagsan ee shaaha.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e Kajiado County mondo odonj e riwruok ma nigi ratiro mar loso gik makelo hinyruok mondo giyud nengo maber mar chai.

English: Universities Fund urges parents and teachers in Bomet County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa usimamizi wa shule.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku boorinayaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Bomet inay u soo sheegaan arrimaha amniga maamulka dugsiga.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e county mar Bomet mondo onyis sirkal mar skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok.

English: The Ministry of Education launched a project to equip 15 TVET institutions with modern labs under the AfDB TVET Phase II project.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu ilizindua mradi wa kuzipa taasisi 15 za TVET maabara za kisasa chini ya mradi wa AfDB TVET Awamu ya Pili.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa bilowday mashruuc lagu qalabeynayo 15 xarumood oo TVET ah oo leh shaybaaro casri ah iyadoo la raacayo mashruuca AfDB TVET Wajiga II.
Dholuo: Od tich mar somo nochako chenro mar keto kuonde 15 mag TVET gi laboratori mag ndalogi e bwo chenro mar AfDB mar TVET Phase II.

English: NCPB warns millet farmers in Uasin Gishu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza uingiliaji kati kwa wakati.
Somali: NCPB waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda millet ee degmada Uasin Gishu cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: NCPB osiemo jopur mag millet e county mar Uasin Gishu kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ochiwo paro mar kawo okang' e kinde mowinjore.

English: DPP urges residents of Bungoma County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: DPP anawataka wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kuunga mkono kamati za kujenga amani huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gweng'no nikech ji medo keto pachgi kuom chenro mag chiwo siem motelo ne oganda.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET opens applications for school laptops under the digital literacy programme for learners in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inafungua maombi ya kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda TVET ee Gobolka ayaa furaysa codsiyada kumbuyuutarrada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee ardayda degmada Meru.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State Department for TVET oseyawo kwayo mag kompyuta mag skul e bwo chenro mar somo kod somo mar digital literacy ne jopuonjre e county mar Meru.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross launches a cattle rustling prevention campaign in Mombasa County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Julai hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay bilaabaneysaa olole looga hortago xanta xoolaha ee gobolka Mombasa bishii July.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ripot Mamit mar Kenya chako kampen mar geng'o ywaruok mag dhok e County mar Mombasa e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: IEBC reminds citizens in Meru County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Meru kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Meru xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC paronwa raia mag County mar Meru kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo gi ji duto e bajet mar county.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds residents of Isiolo County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya wilaya inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on the community in Garissa County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.

English: KEMRI reminds expectant mothers in Nyeri County that access to postnatal check-ups is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba upatikanaji wa uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Nyeri in helitaanka baaritaano ka dib dhalashada ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMRI oparo ne mine ma biro nyuolo e County mar Nyeri ni thuolo mar dhi e nonro bang' nyuol en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag sirkal.

English: Public notice: KEMSA will host a free hand hygiene outreach in Turkana County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMSA itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mikono bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Turkana Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: KEMSA waxay marti gelineysaa barnaamij ku saabsan nadaafadda gacmaha oo bilaash ah degmada Turkana bisha November.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMSA biro timo kampen mar rito ler mar lwedo e taon mar Turkana e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Kenya: Humanitarian Snapshot (As of May 2026)

Somali: Kenya: Sawir Bani'aadamnimo (Laga bilaabo Maajo 2026)
Dholuo: Kenya: Picha mar Kony Dhano (Chakre Mei 2026)

English: NDMA reminds residents of Kericho County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lugta ku mara inta lagu jiro xilliyada fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogweng' mar Kericho County mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo oti gi kuonde ma ng'ato nyalo wuothoe e kinde ma pi opong'o piny.

English: KNEC urges youth in Machakos County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Machakos inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo rowere e County ma Machakos mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok gichako timo tije mag oganda.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Lamu County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Lamu inay la yimaadaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products jiwo jopur e County mar Lamu mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development promotes agroforestry among farmers in Tana River County as part of the August climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inakuza kilimo cha misitu kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Agosti.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa kor u qaadeysa beeraleyda deegaanka Tana River County iyada oo qayb ka ah ololaha iska caabinta cimilada ee Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development dhi nyime jiwo yiende mag yiende e kind jopur e taon mar Tana River County kaka achiel kuom chenro mar Agost mar kedo gi tuoche mag kor lwasi.

English: FAO announces a free anthrax vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Nyeri County this March.
Kiswahili: FAO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kimeta kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Machi hii.
Somali: FAO waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay lo'da caanaha ah ee Gobolka Nyeri bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar chiemo gi yedhe (FAO) ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok ma nigi pi e dwe mar Mach e kaunti mar Nyeri.

English: KEMRI reminds the public that free HIV/AIDS screening is available at all public health centres in Mandera County this September.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa VVU/UKIMWI unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera Septemba hii.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka HIV / AIDS ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Mandera bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: KEMRI parone ji ni nonro ma onge chudo mar HIV/AIDS yudore maonge chudo e kuonde thieth duto e County Mandera e dwe mar Septemba.

English: IEBC reminds the public in Siaya County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this April.
Kiswahili: IEBC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba maoni juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma ni kuwakaribisha Aprili hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Siaya in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: IEBC parone ji duto e county mar Siaya ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mag sirkal e dwe mar April.

English: "Going forward we will need to look at the impact of the floods, continuity of care and provide resilience capacity building to communities.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges the community in Bungoma County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Bungoma inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha si looga hortago xanta xoolaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo oganda man Bungoma County mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo kik gikwed kwalo jamni.

English: Notice: IEBC launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Garissa County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Garissa Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: IEBC waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee Gobolka Garissa bishii November.
Dholuo: IEBC chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e gweng' mar Garissa e dwe mar Novemba.

English: KNEC announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in Nairobi County this July.
Kiswahili: KNEC yatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika shule za Kaunti ya Nairobi Julai hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta deeqaha waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan dugsiyada Gobolka Nairobi bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: KNEC ogolo chiwo mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre man gi chandruok e skunde man Nairobi County e dwe mar Julai.

English: The implementation of the CMA Coffee Exchange Fees Regulations 2024 is suspended for six months Farmers and stakeholders are urged to participate in consultations during this period
Kiswahili: Utekelezaji wa Kanuni za ada ya kubadilisha kahawa ya CMA 2024 umesitishwa kwa muda wa miezi sita Wakulima na wadau wametakiwa kushiriki katika mashauriano katika kipindi hiki.
Somali: Hirgelinta Xeerarka Khidmadaha Isweydaarsiga Kafeega CMA 2024 ayaa la hakiyay muddo lix bilood ah Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan la-tashiyada muddadan
Dholuo: Tiego chike mag CMA Coffee Exchange Fees Regulations 2024 ochung' kuom dweche auchiel Jo-Purie gi jogo motudore gi wachno ijiwo mondo oriw lwedo e chenrono

English: Notice: KICD launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD yazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Nyamira.

Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KICD chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe mahundu e skunde duto e County mar Nyamira.

Kiswahili: DCI inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.

Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne jogweng'o mag Bungoma County kuom wach medruok mar timbe mag wuondo pesa mag simo kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: State Department for TVET urges residents of Mombasa County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from free primary education.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na elimu ya msingi bila malipo.

Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Turkana kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Turkana inay codsadaan deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e County mar Turkana mondo okonygi yudo konyno kapok kindeno ochopo kaluwore gi chenro mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: AFA announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for sheep in Lamu County this February.
Kiswahili: AFA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Lamu Februari hii.

Dholuo: AFA olando chenro mar thiedho rombo maonge chudo mar dhoot e County mar Lamu e dwe mar Februar.

Kiswahili: TVET inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: TVET waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Bomet inay u soo sheegaan maamulka iskuulka wixii arrimo ah oo ku saabsan amniga.

Kiswahili: E-Citizen inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Garissa khiyaanooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: E-Citizen chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e gweng' mar Garissa kuom timbe mag wuondruok.

Kiswahili: TVET inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Somali: TVET waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Nyandarua inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Nyandarua mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto.

English: IEBC warns public officers in Samburu County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: IEBC inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Samburu dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya madaraka.
Somali: IEBC waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee gobolka Samburu inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: IEBC chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Samburu ni kik giti marach gi migepegi.

English: SHA reminds voters in Kiambu County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: SHA inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.

Dholuo: SHA parone jogweng' Kiambu County ni giting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero ka pok itimo yiero.

English: FAO reminds livestock keepers in Nyeri County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xayawaanka ah ee degmada Nyeri inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: FAO parone jopur mag jamni e county mar Nyeri mondo opidhgi gi tuoche e kuonde moketi mag chamo jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waendelee kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inay la xiriiraan maamulaha degmada si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda horumarinta degmada.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogweng' mar Marsabit County mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jotelo mag gwenge ma gidakie mondo ging'e chenro mag dongruok mar gwenge.

Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Embu kuwasiliana na nambari ya msaada wa watoto 116.

English: KRA reminds the public in Kwale County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this September.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba maoni juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma yanakaribishwa Septemba hii.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kwale in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha la soo dhaweynayo bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KRA oparo ne ji duto e Kaunti mar Kwale ni giyudo thuolo mar wuoyo e wi chenro mag sirkal e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: IPOA issues a cybersecurity alert on mobile money scams affecting residents of Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya kashfa za pesa za rununu zinazoathiri wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogaysiis: IPOA waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khayaanada lacagta mobile ee saameyn ku leh dadka deggan gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA ogolo siem e wi weche mag cybersecurity e wi wuond mag pesa mitimo gi gik moko e simo ma mulo joma odak e Taita-Taveta County.

English: Notice: NDMA opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa maelekezo ya makazi salama katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay fureysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya talooyin ku saabsan magangelyo ammaan ah Degmada Makueni.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA ochako ofis ma wuoyo e wi weche mag nindruok e gweng' mar Makueni.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds farmers in Wajir County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Somali: Guddiga alaabada xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa xusuusinaya beeraleyda degmada Wajir barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee xakamaynta cayayaannada iyo cudurrada.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products oparo ne jopur e county mar Wajir chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche.

English: COMESA urges sorghum growers in Trans Nzoia County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda sorghum ee degmada Trans Nzoia inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si kor loogu qaado wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur mag sorghum e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo oti gi kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed nyak e higani.

English: Wear your face mask properly to protect yourself against the coronavirus. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Vaa kinyago chako vizuri ili kujikinga dhidi ya virusi vya corona. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Xiro maaskaro wejigaaga si sax ah si aad iskaga ilaaliso fayraska korona. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Rwak mask mar wang'i makare mondo irikri ne midhusi mar korona. #KomeshaKorona

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free depression awareness support is available through county health facilities in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa uhamasishaji wa unyogovu unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay wacyiga niyadjabku laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Kisumu County.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar parruok yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth e County ma Kisumu County.

English: Important message to prevent Mpox. Keep distace from a person with symptoms of TB. Do not share personal items like towels, utensils neither cloths. Ensure washing your hands all the times.
Kiswahili: Ujumbe muhimu wa kuzuia Mpox. Weka mbali na mtu mwenye dalili za Kifua Kikuu. Usishiriki vitu vya kibinafsi kama vile taulo, vyombo wala vitambaa. Hakikisha unaosha mikono yako kila wakati.
Somali: Fariin muhiim ah oo looga hortago Mpox. Qofka qaba calaamadaha cudurka TB ka fogaada. Ha la wadaagin alaabada shakhsiyeed sida towels, weelasha ama dharka. Hubi inaad gacmahaaga si joogto ah u maydho.
Dholuo: Puonj maduong' manyalo konyo e geng'o tuo mar Mpox. Ketri mabor gi ng'at ma nigi tuo mar TB. Kik ipog gik moko mag ng'ato gi nyawadgi kaka twanda, gige tich, kata lewni.
