English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges wheat growers in Nyandarua County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda wheat-ka ee Gobolka Nyandarua inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka xilliga dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur mag ngano e county mar Nyandarua mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma giyudo e higa mondo okonygi loyo kodhino chon.

English: Turkana County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Turkana: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2024
Somali: Degmada Turkana: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Turkana: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar apar 2024

English: The government is implementing reforms to improve tea prices for farmers including an automated auction system to enhance trading efficiency Tea farmers are encouraged to stay informed on these changes
Kiswahili: Serikali inatekeleza mageuzi ya kuboresha bei ya chai kwa wakulima ikiwa ni pamoja na mfumo wa minada otomatiki ili kuongeza ufanisi wa kibiashara Wakulima wa chai wanahimizwa kuendelea kufahamisha mabadiliko haya.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay hirgelinaysaa dib-u-habeyn lagu hagaajinayo qiimaha shaaha ee beeraleyda, oo ay ku jirto nidaam xaraash otomaatig ah si loo kordhiyo waxtarka ganacsiga. Beeraleyda shaaha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka warqabaan isbeddeladan
Dholuo: Sirkal tiyo gi lokruok mondo okony jopur bedo gi nengo mabeyo mag chai moriwo koda chenro mar loso ng'ur ma itiyogo e loso ohala.

English: Kenya Dairy Board invites farmers in Taita-Taveta County to a free training on greenhouse farming this February.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kwa mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo cha chafu Februari hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku casuumay beeraleyda Gobolka Taita-Taveta tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board ogwelo jopur e Taita-Taveta County e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar greenhouse agriculture e dwe mar Februar.

English: World Vision and KOICA partner to tackle climate change induced droughts in Narok County with KSh 177 million investment
Kiswahili: World Vision na washirika wa KOICA kukabiliana na ukame unaosababishwa na mabadiliko ya hali ya anga katika Kaunti ya Narok kwa uwekezaji wa KSh 177 milioni.
Somali: World Vision iyo KOICA oo iska kaashanaya wax ka qabashada abaaraha ka dhashay isbeddelka cimilada ee ka jira Degmada Narok iyadoo maalgelin ku kacaysa KSh 177 milyan
Dholuo: 177 KSh

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission opens a new motor vehicle mechanics programme at the vocational centre in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yafungua programu mpya ya ufundi wa magari katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu furayaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan farsamada gawaarida gawaari ee xarunta xirfadaha ee gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj chako chenro manyien mar tiyo gi masinde mag riembo mtokni e kar tiegruok e gweng' mar Nyandarua.

English: NDMA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Lamu County that access to post-violence medical care is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Lamu kwamba huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu zinapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee Gobolka Lamu in helitaanka daryeelka caafimaad ee rabshadda ka dib ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e County mar Lamu ni yudo kony mar thieth ma iyudo bang' timno onge chudo.

English: Notice: NTSA launches a cattle rustling prevention campaign in Kwale County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NTSA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kwale Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga xanta xoolaha ee Gobolka Kwale bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NTSA chako kampen mar geng'o kwalo jamni e taon mar Kwale e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: Universities Fund reminds citizens in Mombasa County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu muwaadiniinta degmada Mombasa xusuusinayaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa raia mag Mombasa County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo gi ji duto e bajet mar county.

English: Government invests in ICT infrastructure upgrades in national polytechnic institutes to support modern learning.
Kiswahili: Serikali huwekeza katika kuboresha miundombinu ya ICT katika taasisi za kitaifa za polytechnic kusaidia kujifunza kisasa.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay maalgelineysaa casriyeynta kaabayaasha ICT ee machadyada farsamada ee qaranka si ay u taageerto barashada casriga ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal keto pesa e tiego chenro mag ICT e nderni mag polotekni mag piny mangima mondo okony e puonjo ji e kindewagi.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) confirms a measles outbreak alert for Vihiga County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa surua kwa Kaunti ya Vihiga. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xaqiijineysaa feejignaanta faafitaanka cudurka hargabka ee degmada Vihiga. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: SHA (Social Health Authority) osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuwono e County mar Vihiga.

English: State Department for TVET invites youth in Nyeri County to enroll for electrical installation training this January.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Januari hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku casuumaysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nyeri inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET ogwelo rowere man Nyeri County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar keto sitima e dwe mar Januar.

English: NDMA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Nairobi County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba upatikanaji wa maelekezo ya makazi salama unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee Gobolka Nairobi in helitaanka tixraacyada magangelyo ammaan ah la heli karo lacag la'aan.
Dholuo: NDMA paronwa jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu motudore gi dichwo gi dhako e County mar Nairobi ni thuolo mar yudo kuonde mag dak ma onge tuoche yudore maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Siaya County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay biyo cabitaan ah ku kariyaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso joma odak e county mar Siaya ni mondo gimi pi omodhi kapok gitiyo kode mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche ma ok nyal geng'o.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Nakuru County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay dadka deggan degmada Nakuru kula talineysaa inay biyo cabbiyaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit nyiso jogweng' Nakuru County mondo omak pi modho kapok gitiyo kode mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: State Department for Basic Education advises applicants in Laikipia County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Waaxda waxbarashada aasaasiga ah ee dowladda waxay ku talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Laikipia inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow si ay u helaan waxbarashada soo socota.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State for Basic Education jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e County mar Laikipia mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: MoH assures parents of vaccine safety after two children died from polio shot
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahakikishia wazazi usalama wa chanjo baada ya watoto wawili kufariki kutokana na chanjo ya polio
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa waalidiinta u xaqiijisay badbaadada tallaalka kadib markii laba carruur ah ay ku dhinteen tallaalka polio
Dholuo: Ministry of Health osemiyo jonyuol geno kuom thieth mar chan bang ' ka nyithindo ariyo osetho nikech tuo mar polio

English: However, these populations face challenges such as weak health infrastructure, food insecurity, and frequent displacement.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, watu hawa wanakabiliwa na changamoto kama vile miundombinu dhaifu ya afya, uhaba wa chakula, na kuhama mara kwa mara.
Somali: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, dadkani waxay la kulmaan caqabado sida kaabayaasha caafimaadka oo liita, cunto yari, iyo barokac joogto ah.
Dholuo: Kata kamano, ogandagi yudo pek kaka gedo mag thieth ma ok tek, bedo maonge gi chiemo, kod bedo ma ji odak e udigi kinde ka kinde.

English: State Department for Basic Education reminds needy students in Wajir County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan Gobolka Wajir in deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay codsiyada ardayda baahan ay dhowaan dhammaadaan.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education oparo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e gweng' mar Wajir ni tuke mag somo mag jopuonjre ma nigi chan biro rumo machiegni.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens polling procedures centres in Homa Bay County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay mwezi huu wa Novemba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu furayaa xarumaha codbixinta ee gobolka Homa Bay bishii November.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya osechako tiyo gi chenro mar timo yiero e Homa Bay County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: TVET reminds youth in Isiolo County that HELB funding is available for tailoring and design training.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Isiolo in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka qaabeynta iyo naqshadeynta.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa rowere man Isiolo County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds voters in Garissa County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Garissa kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha Gobolka Garissa inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor waxbarashada codbixisayaasha.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette paronwa jogedo e County mar Garissa mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero kapok giyudo tiegruok.

English: NDMA urges the public in Turkana County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of identity theft.
Kiswahili: NDMA inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: NDMA waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadweynaha degmada Turkana inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada iyada oo loo marayo kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee tuugista aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo ji duto e county mar Turkana mondo ong'e kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro bang' weche mag kuo mar kitgi.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Trans Nzoia County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada daadadka ka dhacay xilligan dhulgariirka.
Dholuo: NTSA parone jogweng' mar Trans Nzoia County ni kik giwuoth e wi borni kod aoche ma pi opong'o e kinde mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on parents in Nandi County to have children under five screened for dengue fever during the April outreach.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya watoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuwafanyia uchunguzi watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa homa ya dengue wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Aprili.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Nandi in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka dengue inta lagu jiro safarka bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross okwayo jonyuol e county mar Nandi mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar April.

English: [Training Achievement] Over 91,000 teachers trained to deliver digital learning content as part of Digital Literacy Programme implementation
Kiswahili: [Ufanisi wa Mafunzo] Zaidi ya walimu 91,000 wamezoezwa kutoa maudhui ya kujifunza digital kama sehemu ya utekelezaji wa Mpango wa Digital Literacy
Somali: [Tallaabooyinka tababarka] In ka badan 91,000 macallimiin ayaa loo tababaray inay bixiyaan waxyaabaha barashada dhijitaalka ah ee qayb ka ah hirgelinta barnaamijka akhriska digital
Dholuo: [Konyruok mar tiegruok] Thoth jopuonj mokalo 91,000 osetieg mondo ochiw puonj mag digital kaka achiel kuom chenro mag dhi nyime gi program mar digital literacy

English: Broadcasts customized per region
Kiswahili: Matangazo yaliyopangwa kwa ajili ya kila mkoa
Somali: Barnaamijyada loo habeeyay gobol kasta
Dholuo: Gige lendo mochan kaluwore gi alwora

English: Teachers Service Commission encourages out-of-school children in Kiambu County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Kiambu inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee fasallada akhris-xisaabta dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo nyithindo maok dhi e skul e County mar Kiambu mondo odonj e program mar somo kod somo mar joma dongo.

English: KRA reminds the public in Nyamira County that reporting embezzlement of public funds is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa fedha za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Nyamira in warbixinta xadgudubka lacagta dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: KRA oparo ne ji duto e County mar Nyamira ni lando weche mag ketho pesa mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: UK Parliamentarians conclude study tour to Kenya aimed at gaining insights into global sexual and reproductive health and rights
Kiswahili: Wabunge wa Uingereza wahitimisha ziara ya mafunzo nchini Kenya yenye lengo la kupata maarifa kuhusu afya na haki za ngono na uzazi duniani.
Somali: Xildhibaannada UK ayaa soo gabagabeeyay safar cilmi baaris ah oo ay ku tageen Kenya, kaas oo ujeedadiisu ahayd in la helo aragtiyo ku saabsan caafimaadka iyo xuquuqda galmada ee caalamiga ah iyo taranka.
Dholuo: Jotend bura mag piny Ingresa otieko wuodhgi mar somo e piny Kenya ma nigi gino mar yudo ng’eyo matut e wi thieth kod ratiro mag piny mangima mag nindruok kod nyuol

English: Ministry of ICT and County Governments partner to establish ICT resource centers in rural areas to support digital literacy.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya ICT na serikali za wilaya zinafanya kazi pamoja ili kuanzisha vituo vya rasilimali za ICT katika maeneo ya vijijini kusaidia uandishi wa dijiti.
Somali: Wasaaradda ICT iyo dowladaha degmooyinka waxay iskaashi la sameeyaan si ay u aasaasaan xarumaha khayraadka ICT ee deegaannada miyiga ah si loo taageero akhriska dijitaalka ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of ICT kod sirkande mag county noriwore mondo gichak chenro mag ICT resource centers e gwenge mag gweng' mondo gijiw somo kod somo mar digital.

English: State Department for Basic Education reminds schools in Nandi County to strengthen inclusion of learners with disabilities this April.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuimarisha ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu Aprili hii.
Somali: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka Nandi waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada gobolka inay xoojiyaan ka mid noqoshada ardayda naafada ah bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education oparo ne skunde man e county mar Nandi mondo omed tiego jopuonjre ma nigi midekre e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: IPOA activates an emergency response plan for flooding in Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay hirgelinaysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ku saabsan fatahaadaha degmada Kiambu.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony ne pi e gweng' mar Kiambu.

English: AFA advises milk producers in Kisii County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: AFA inashauri wazalishaji wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: AFA waxay kula talineysaa soosaarayaasha caanaha ee degmada Kisii inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: AFA nyiso jopur mag chak e county mar Kisii mondo oti gi nengo mar piny moseketo kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Sweet potato (Ipomoea batatas) â€“ kiazi kitamu. Use against: rice brown leaf spot, rice blast and other fungal diseases, insects (aphids). Preparation: crush and soak leaves in water, use as spray. Heavily starched water after cooking can be sprayed on small insects such as aphids.
Kiswahili: Sweet Potato / Kiazi kitamu (Ipomea batatas). Inazuia: rice brown leaf spot, rice blast na magonjwa mengine ya ukungu, wadudu (aphids). Kutayarisha: ponda na ulowe majani kwa maji, nyunyiza. Maji yanayo wanga mzito baada ya kupika yanaweza kunyunyizwa kwa wadudu wadogo kama aphids.
Somali: Baradho macaan (Ipomoea batatas) - kiazi kitamu. Loo isticmaalo: caleenta bariiska buniga ah, bariiska qarxa iyo cudurrada kale ee fungal, cayayaanka (aphids). Diyaarinta: burburin oo ku qoyso caleenta biyo, u isticmaal buufin ahaan. Biyaha si xoog leh loo istaarijiyey ka dib karinta waxaa lagu buufin karaa cayayaanka yaryar sida aphids.
Dholuo: Tiyo kode mar geng'o: ng'injo mar oboke marabuor mar oboke, oboke mag oboke kod tuoche mamoko mag fungi, kwiri (aphids). Yore mar loso: ng'ad kendo keto oboke e pi, ti kode kaka spray. Pi moting'o starch mang'eny bang' tedo inyalo spray ewi oboke matin kaka aphids.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations conducts a community briefing on border security in Baringo County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inafanya mkutano wa jamii juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Baringo Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka Baaritaanka Dembiyada wuxuu qabtaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha ee Gobolka Baringo bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Directorate of Criminal Investigations timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e taon mar Baringo e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will hold a trauma counselling forum in Trans Nzoia County this July. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanya kongamano la ushauri wa kiwewe katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Julai hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay qaban doontaa madasha la talinta dhaawaca ee Gobolka Trans Nzoia bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo biro bedo gi chokruok mar chiwo paro e wi tuoche e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia e dwe mar Julai.

English: KALRO urges farmers in Busia County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Busia inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Busia mondo opidh olembe ma nyalo miyo lowo okethre, mondo omi girit lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: KEPHIS warns beans farmers in Migori County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawaonya wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Migori juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza uingiliaji kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda ku nool degmada Migori cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa in si sax ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: KEPHIS chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho puothe e gweng' mar Migori ni nitie tuoche ma nyalo landore kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Kenya Health Products and Technologies Local Manufacturing Strategy 2026â€“2030 (June 2026)
Kiswahili: Mkakati wa Utengenezaji wa Bidhaa za Afya na Teknolojia nchini Kenya 2026â€“2030 (Juni 2026)
Somali: Badeecadaha Caafimaadka Kenya iyo Tiknoolajiyada Istaraatiijiyadda Wax-soo-saarka Deegaanka 2026-2030 (Juun 2026)
Dholuo: Yor loso mwandu mag thieth kod teknoloji mag piny Kenya higa mar 2026 nyaka 2030 (dwe mar auchiel 2026)

English: WFP and Republic of Korea boost food security and resilience for vulnerable families in Kenya
Kiswahili: WFP na Jamhuri ya Korea yaongeza usalama wa chakula na ustahimilivu kwa familia zilizo hatarini nchini Kenya
Somali: Hay'adda Cunnada Adduunka (WFP) iyo Dowladda Kuuriyada Koonfureed ayaa ka wada hadlay xoojinta amniga cuntada iyo adkeysiga qoysaska nugul ee ku nool Kenya.
Dholuo: WFP kod piny Korea medo rito chiemo kod chir ne joot ma nigi chandruok e piny Kenya

English: Office of the Auditor-General updates residents of Nairobi County on progress of the county integrated development plan this December.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti hii Desemba.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Nairobi ka wargeliyaa horumarka qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General nyiso jood Nairobi County kaka chenro mar dongruok mar county integrated development dhi nyime e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development warns beans farmers in Samburu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawaonya wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay uga digtay beeraleyda Gobolka Samburu cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna kugula talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ochiwo siem ne jopur mag nyinyo e county mar Samburu kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ochiwo paro mar kawo okang' e kinde mowinjore.

English: Kenya Dairy Board informs maize farmers in Taita-Taveta County of new market linkage opportunities this March.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawafahamisha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Machi hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku wargalinayaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur mag kodhi e Taita-Taveta County kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Mach.

English: CDC encourages mothers in Mandera County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Mandera kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Mandera inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo mine man Mandera County mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross activates an emergency response plan for flooding in West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya waanzisha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ku saabsan fatahaadaha gobolka West Pokot.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ripot Makwar mar Kenya osechako tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne ataro mar pi e gweng' mar West Pokot.

English: Council of Governors urges residents of Migori County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Migori watumie portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa ku boorinaya dadka deggan degmada Migori inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo jogweng' Migori County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo kwayo mar kedo gi mibadhi e tije mag sirkal.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges parents and teachers in Samburu County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Samburu ku boorinayaa inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission ojiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e county mar Samburu mondo omany namba mar kony mar nyithindo 116.

English: Notice: EACC will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay qabaneysaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ee degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: EACC biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e kaunti mar Bungoma.

English: AFA advises farmers in Wajir County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: AFA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: AFA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Wajir inay keenaan lambarrada diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qaybqaataan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Wajir mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: Free revision materials uploaded for KCPE and KCSE candidates.
Kiswahili: Nyenzo za masahihisho bila malipo zimepakiwa kwa watahiniwa wa KCPE na KCSE.
Somali: Waxyaabaha dib u eegista ee lacag la'aanta ah ee loogu talagalay musharixiinta KCPE iyo KCSE.
Dholuo: Weche mag somo ma onge chudo mag KCPE kod KCSE.

English: Flood impact analysis in Nairobi Kenya as of 1 May 2024 - Imagery Analysis: 01/05/2024 Published 06/05/2024 V1
Kiswahili: Uchambuzi wa athari za mafuriko Nairobi Kenya kuanzia tarehe 1 Mei 2024 - Uchambuzi wa Picha: 01/05/2024 Ilichapishwa 06/05/2024 V1
Somali: Falanqaynta saameynta daadadka ee Nairobi Kenya laga bilaabo 1dii Maajo 2024 - Falanqaynta Sawirka: 01/05/2024 La daabacay 06/05/2024 V1
Dholuo: - Nonro mar pichni: 05/01/2024.

English: KEPHIS invites farmers in Migori County to a free training on fertiliser application this January.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya matumizi ya mbolea Januari hii.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Migori tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan isticmaalka bacriminta bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: KEPHIS ogwelo jopur mag Migori County e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi tiyo gi yien e dwe mar Januar.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges residents of Kirinyaga County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee deegaanka iyada oo la adeegsanayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo jogweng' Kirinyaga County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano nikech ji medo keto pachgi kuom chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: SHA urges residents of Tana River County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Tana River wapewe huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay dalbadaan bixinta adeegyada aan la siinayo laaluush si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo odwar ni ji ochiw kony maok ochulo asoya mondo giked gi asoya e migepe mag sirkal.

English: NPS warns residents of Nyeri County about a rise in phishing messages and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri juu ya kuongezeka kwa ujumbe wa udanganyifu na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: NPS waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri kororka farriimaha phishing waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: NPS chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nyeri County e wi medruok mar weche mag phishing kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: There is ongoing collaboration between the PS for Agriculture and the World Bank Group regarding Kenya s Digital Agriculture Roadmap Stay informed for upcoming initiatives
Kiswahili: Kuna ushirikiano unaoendelea kati ya PS kwa ajili ya Kilimo na Kundi la Benki ya Dunia kuhusu Kenyas Digital Agriculture Roadmap Endelea kufahamishwa kwa mipango ijayo.
Somali: Waxaa jira iskaashi joogto ah oo u dhexeeya PS for Agriculture iyo World Bank Group oo ku saabsan Khariidadda Beeraha Dijitaalka ah ee Kenya. La soco mashaariicda soo socda
Dholuo: Nitie winjruok ma dhi nyime e kind PS for Agriculture kod World Bank Group e wi Kenya Digital Agriculture Roadmap

English: Office of the Auditor-General encourages first-time voters in Nakuru County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa codbixiyayaasha ugu horreeya ee degmada Nakuru inay soo booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Jorit Maduong' jiwo joma okwongo yiero e county mar Nakuru mondo olim kama ichikoe ji ne IEBC machiegni kodgi.

English: Kenya Forest Service alerts residents of Makueni County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ka digay dadka deggan degmada Makueni in ay kordhaan kiisaska tuugada wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan macluumaadka amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service chiwo siem ne jogweng' Makueni County kuom wach kwan mar joma odonjo e utegi kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Notice: NPS conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Samburu County this April.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Samburu Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho oo ku saabsan ka hortagga argagixisada ee Gobolka Samburu bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NPS timo romo mar oganda e dwe mar April e county mar Samburu kuom wach kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of Kisumu County about a rise in phishing messages and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: Kenya Red Cross inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu juu ya kuongezeka kwa ujumbe wa udanganyifu na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu kororka farriimaha phishing waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross osiemo jogweng' mar Kisumu County kuom medruok mar weche mag phishing kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: Notice: e-Citizen launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kericho County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kericho Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: e-Citizen waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa degmada Kericho bishii November.
Dholuo: Rapar: e-Citizen chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Kericho e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross activates an emergency response plan for flooding in Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya waanzisha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ku saabsan fatahaadaha Gobolka Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova e piny Kenya, miluongo ni Kenya Red Cross, tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony mapiyo ne pi e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia.

English: KRA invites residents of Embu County to attend the public participation forum regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: KRA inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: KRA waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: KRA gwelo joma odak e county mar Embu mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenro mag dongruok.

English: Notice: SHA launches the county integrated development plan in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Shirika la SHA linazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika wilaya ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA waxay bilaabaysaa qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Nyamira.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova (SHA) chako chenro mar timo dongruok e alwora mar Nyamira County.

English: E-Citizen urges eligible citizens in Nyandarua County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wananchi wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Nyandarua inay ka qaybqaataan jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro e County mar Nyandarua mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar yiero.

English: Notice: CDC confirms a cyclosporiasis outbreak alert for Mombasa County. Residents are advised to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ilani: CDC inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa cyclosporiasis kwa Kaunti ya Mombasa. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: CDC waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka cyclosporiasis ee degmada Mombasa. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar yedhe ma thiedho tuoche mag cyclosporiasis (CDC) osenyiso ni nitie masira moro mar tuoche ma timore e county mar Mombasa. Ojiwo jogweng'no mondo otim nonro mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni kodgi.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Wajir County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda Gobolka Wajir inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur e county mar Wajir mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: To prevent mealybug spread in cassava, collect planting cuttings from a known mealybug-free area (not during the dry season), cut off the top and bottom 10-20cm of each stem, then soak the remaining cuttings in hot (not boiling) water for 5 minutes before cooling and planting.
Kiswahili: Ili kuzuia kuenea kwa mealybug katika mihogo, kusanya vipandikizi vya kupanda kutoka eneo linalojulikana lisilo na mealybug (sio wakati wa kiangazi), kata juu na chini 10-20cm ya kila shina, kisha loweka vipandikizi vilivyobaki kwenye maji ya moto (sio ya kuchemsha) kwa dakika 5 kabla ya kupoa na kupanda.
Somali: Si looga hortago faafitaanka mealybug-ka ee cassava, ururi godadka beerta meel aan cayayaanka lahayn (ma aha xilliga qalalan), goyn 10-20cm kore iyo hoose ee laan kasta, kadibna ku qoy godadka haray biyo kulul (aan karkarin) 5 daqiiqo ka hor qaboojinta oo beerin.
Dholuo: Mondo kik ng'ato oyud ng'ato gi ng'ato ma nigi ng'ama ok nyal chamo ng'ato, nyaka ochak chamo ng'ato gi ng'ato ma ok onyal chamo ng'ato gi ng'ato.

Dholuo: Mae en gima inyalo timo mondo ikony e geng'o lalruok mar #COVID19 e ot kata e tich.

English: Kenya Forest Service alerts residents of Turkana County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya ayaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana uga digaya kororka kiisaska burburka wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service chiwo siem ne jogweng'o mag Turkana County ni kwan mag joma odonjo e utegi biro medore kendo gijiwo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: NCPB warns maize farmers in Vihiga County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawaonya wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza uingiliaji kati kwa wakati.
Somali: NCPB waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Vihiga faafitaanka cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: NCPB chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho kodhi e County mar Vihiga kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: KEMSA calls on parents in West Pokot County to have children under five screened for dengue fever during the September outreach.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa homa ya dengue wakati wa mawasiliano ya Septemba.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada West Pokot in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka dengue inta lagu jiro adeegga bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KEMSA kwayo jonyuol e West Pokot County mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma hikgi tin ne abich kuom tuwo mar dengue e dwe mar Septemba.

English: It is recommended that farmers cultivate improved tomato varieties with a longer shelf life.
Kiswahili: Inapendekezwa kuwa wakulima walime aina za nyanya zilizoboreshwa na maisha marefu ya rafu.
Somali: Waxaa lagu talinayaa in beeraleyda ay beeraan noocyo yaanyada ah oo la wanaajiyay oo leh cimri dheer.
Dholuo: Ojiwo jopur mondo opidh kit pomade mabeyo ma nigi ndalo moromo.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Kiambu County about the importance of tobacco control for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhusu umuhimu wa udhibiti wa tumbaku kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay dadka degmada Kiambu ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay ka hortagga sigaarka ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa ji duto e County mar Kiambu gimomiyo thieth mar madho ndawa en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: KRA urges residents of Kajiado County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kajiado County kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KRA ojiwo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet mondo okel kes mar kedo gi mibadhi e migepe mag sirkal.

English: Early warning systems and dryland communities in the Horn of Africa: Kenya country report
Kiswahili: Mifumo ya hadhari ya mapema na jumuiya za nchi kavu katika Pembe ya Afrika: Ripoti ya nchi ya Kenya
Somali: Nidaamyada digniinta hore iyo bulshooyinka dhul-gariirsan ee Geeska Afrika: Warbixinta dalka Kenya
Dholuo: Sistem mag riembo mapiyo kod kuonde ma onge pi e Tung’ mar Afrika: Ripot mar piny Kenya

English: Farmers are encouraged to consider organic fertilizer as part of their agricultural practices following its focus at the recent African Fertilizer and Soil Health Summit
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kuzingatia mbolea-hai kama sehemu ya mazoea yao ya kilimo kufuatia mkazo wake katika Mkutano wa hivi karibuni wa Mbolea na Afya ya Udongo barani Afrika.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay tixgeliyaan bacriminta organic qayb ka mid ah habadooda beeraha kadib markii ay diiradda saartay shirkii dhawaan ee African Fertilizer and Soil Health Summit
Dholuo: Josupni ijiwo mondo onon yien mag yien kaka achiel kuom yore mag purgi bang' neno kaka yienno ne ochan e romo ma nyocha otim e wi yien mag yien mag Afrika kod ngima mar lowo

English: DPP reminds residents of Trans Nzoia County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: DPP anawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia in warbixinta degdegga ah ee xannibaadda lo'da ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: DPP oparo ne jogweng' Trans Nzoia County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo jamni konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Public health advisory: Kenya Red Cross warns of increased HIV/AIDS risk in Siaya County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya VVU/UKIMWI katika Kaunti ya Siaya na kushauri umma kutumia vyandarua vilivyotiwa dawa ya wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Warbixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ka digeysaa khatarta sii kordheysa ee HIV/AIDS ee Gobolka Siaya waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Chenro mar thieth mar ji: Kenya Red Cross chiwo siem e wi medruok mar AYAKI/AIDS e County mar Siaya kendo ojiwo ji mondo oti gi gige choko kute ma otigo gi yedhe makelo tuoche mag kute otieno ka otieno.

English: State Department for TVET reminds needy students in Turkana County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Turkana in deeqaha waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay codsiyada ardayda baahan ay dhowaan dhammaadaan.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET oparo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e County mar Turkana ni tuke mag somo ma jopuonjre ma nigi chan biro chopo machiegni.

English: Kenya Forest Service alerts residents of Kilifi County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi juu ya kuongezeka kwa visa vya utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya ayaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi uga digay kororka kiisaska gaadiidka la afduubayo wuxuuna bulshada kula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Forest Service chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kilifi County kuom wach medruok mar wuondo mtokni kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne polis man machiegni.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges eligible citizens in Meru County to participate in polling procedures.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Meru kushiriki katika utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Meru inay ka qeyb galaan nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General jiwo raia mowinjore e county mar Meru mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag yiero.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa kitambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada ayaa soo saaray digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan xadaysiga aqoonsiga ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Nyamira.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Ng'ado Weche mag Mahundu ogolo siem mar rito weche mag sirkal kuom wach kuo mar ng'ato ma en ng'at modak e kaunti mar Nyamira.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee Gobolka Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura mar Kenya biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e County mar Kirinyaga.

English: Looking ahead, UNDRR plans to offer continued support to Kenya's institutional DRM capacity, including by advancing its costâ€“benefit analysis of DRR investments.
Kiswahili: Tukiangalia mbeleni, UNDRR inapanga kuendelea kutoa usaidizi kwa uwezo wa kitaasisi wa DRM wa Kenya, ikiwa ni pamoja na kuendeleza uchanganuzi wake wa gharama-manufaa ya uwekezaji wa DRR.
Somali: Iyada oo la eegayo mustaqbalka, UNDRR waxay qorsheyneysaa inay taageero joogto ah siiso awoodda hay'adaha DRM ee Kenya, oo ay ku jirto horumarinta falanqaynta faa'iidada ee maalgashiyada DRR.
Dholuo: Ka wang’iyo nyime, UNDRR nigi chenro mar chiwo kony ma dhi nyime ne nyalo mar DRM mar riwruok mar Kenya, moriwo nyaka kuom dhi nyime gi ng’iyo mar pesa ma DRR oketo.

English: KRA reminds residents of Nakuru County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru in ay ku hawlan yihiin maamulahooda degmada si ay u xoojiyaan maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: KRA paronwa jogweng' Nakuru County ni tudruok gi jotelo mag gwenge maggi miyo sirkal bedo gi loch maber.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds farmers in Laikipia County of the ongoing modern irrigation techniques training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Laikipia juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa xusuusinaya beeraleyda degmada Laikipia barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jopur e county mar Laikipia chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar yore mag lero pi.

English: Notice: KICD opens applications for revision guides for learners in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay furaysaa codsiyada hagaha dib-u-eegista ardayda degmada Nakuru.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KICD oseyawo kwayo mag somo mar somo e kaunti mar Nakuru.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds livestock keepers in Nairobi County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Nairobi inay xoolahooda tallaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development oparo ne jopur mag jamni e County mar Nairobi ni mondo gimi jamnigi chan e kuonde moketi mag chwoyo jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: Notice: KMTC opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inafungua maombi ya maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay codsiyada u furaysaa barayaasha degmada Vihiga si ay u helaan barasho digital ah oo lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC oyawo kwayo mag somo maonge chudo mar digital ne jopuonjre man Vihiga County.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will conduct a post-harvest handling workshop for farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi ka dib goosashada beeraleyda degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro timo tiegruok mar rito jopur bang' keyo e Elgeyo-Marakwet County e dwe mar Februar.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free typhoid screening is available at all public health centres in Kilifi County this January.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa matumbo bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Januari hii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka tifooska ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Kilifi bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji ni thieth mar typhoid ma onge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County Kilifi e dwe mar Januar.

English: State Department for Basic Education encourages out-of-school children in Kisii County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Kisii kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya elimu ya sekondari ya siku ya bure.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Kisii inay dalbadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e County mar Kisii mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Notice: EACC opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogaysiis: EACC waxay ka furtay goob adeeg cusub oo lagu shaqeynayo shahaadada dhalashada ee gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: EACC oseyawo kama itimee tije manyien mar loso barua mag nyuol e county mar Uasin Gishu.

English: State Department for TVET invites youth in Trans Nzoia County to enroll for electrical installation training this July.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Julai hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku casuumaysaa dhalinyarada degmada Trans Nzoia inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State for TVET ogwelo rowere mag Trans Nzoia County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar loso sitima e dwe mar Julai.

English: GNDR members respond to Kenya floods
Kiswahili: Wanachama wa GNDR wakabiliana na mafuriko nchini Kenya
Somali: Xubnaha GNDR ayaa ka jawaabay fatahaadaha Kenya
Dholuo: Jokanyo mag GNDR dwoko wach mar pi ma oumo piny Kenya

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds residents of Kiambu County that agroforestry improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba kilimo cha misitu kinaboresha uzalishaji wa muda mrefu wa shamba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu in beeraha iyo kaymaha ay hagaajinayaan wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development parone jogweng' Kiambu County ni agroforestry medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges residents of Isiolo County to register their children at the nearest public school to benefit from free primary education.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu ili kufaidika na elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo jogweng' Isiolo County mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok ma onge chudo.

English: Notice: DCI opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DCI inafungua ofisi ya kijinsia inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: Ogaysiis: DCI waxay furaysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya daryeel caafimaad ka dib rabshadaha gobolka Samburu.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DCI ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony mar thieth bang' timbe mahundu e county mar Samburu.

English: CDC appeals to caregivers in Migori County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the October maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Migori kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Oktoba.
Somali: CDC waxay u baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Migori inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka ee Oktoobar.
Dholuo: CDC kwayo jorit e County mar Migori mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathine kaka achiel kuom chenro mag thieth ma timore e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health: nutrition supplementation for infants clinics will run every June at designated health centres in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya: nyongeza ya lishe kwa kliniki za watoto wachanga itaendeshwa kila Juni katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka: nafaqo-maalmeedka dhallaanka ee xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Kajiado ayaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Juun ee kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth: thieth mar chiemo ne nyithindo matindo ibiro tim dwe mar auchiel higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e Kajiado County.

English: DPP reminds residents of West Pokot County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: DPP anawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot in warbixinta degdegga ah ee xanta xoolaha ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogweng' mar West Pokot County ni lando piyo piyo mag jamni konyo rito kuonde modakie.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges residents of Uasin Gishu County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Uhalifu unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama katikati ya umakini mkubwa wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ka socda aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo sidii loo dhisi lahaa nabadgelyada qaranka.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ugu baaqeysaa beeraleyda Degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo lagu soo uruuriyo biyaha beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan qaababka roobka ee isbeddelaya.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Dual training alert: Sign industry contract by Dec 31 or lose admission!
Kiswahili: Alert mbili za mafunzo: saini sekta ya mkataba kabla ya Desemba 31 au kupoteza uandikishaji!

English: Pest Control Products Board warns wheat farmers in Marsabit County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawaonya wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa uga digaya beeraleyda sarreenka ee degmada Marsabit cudurrada cayayaanta waxayna kugula talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Bura mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok mar Pest, chiwo siem ne jopur mag ngano e taon mar Marsabit e wi tuoche ma kelo hinyruok kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Notice: DCI issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DCI inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa utambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Wilaya ya West Pokot.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka ah oo ku saabsan xadiidka aqoonsiga ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada West Pokot.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: DCI ogolo siem mar rito weche mag intanet kuom wach kuo mar ng'at ma odak West Pokot County.
