English: OGP urges residents of Murang'a County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight abuse of office.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago xadgudubka xilka.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogweng'o mag County mar Murang'a mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet mondo gikel ng'ur mar kedo gi tiyo marach gi migepe.

English: To protect stored maize from insect pests using an airtight metal silo: load only clean, dry maize (13% moisture or less), place a lit candle inside on a tray, then seal the silo. The candle burns up the oxygen and goes out on its own (5-20 minutes), and the resulting low-oxygen environment kills the insects without chemicals.
Kiswahili: Ili kulinda mahindi yaliyohifadhiwa dhidi ya wadudu wadudu kwa kutumia silo ya chuma isiyopitisha hewa: pakia mahindi safi tu, kavu (unyevu 13% au chini), weka mshumaa uliowashwa ndani kwenye trei, kisha uzibe silo. Mshumaa huchoma oksijeni na kwenda peke yake (dakika 5-20), na mazingira ya chini ya oksijeni huua wadudu bila kemikali.
Somali: Si loo ilaaliyo hadhuudhka kaydsan cayayaanka iyadoo la adeegsanayo silo bir ah oo aan hawada u adkeyn: ku shubi kaliya hadhuudh nadiif ah oo qalalan (13% qoyaan ama ka yar), ku rid shumac iftiimiya gudaha saxan, ka dibna xidh shumaca. Shumaca ayaa gubaya oksijiin waxayna si gooni gooni ah u baxdaa (5-20 daqiiqo), waxaana deegaanka oksijiin yar ee soo baxa uu dilaa cayayaanka iyada oo aan la helin kiimikooyin.
Dholuo: Mondo igeng' kodhi ma ne okan-go kik hiny chuech mamoko, ti gi silos mar chuma ma ok rum: ting'e mana kodhi maler (13% mar yuto kata matin) kae to iket kandel moting'o mach e otas, kae to ing'i silosno.

English: KEMRI calls on parents in Marsabit County to have children under five screened for cholera during the February outreach.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano wakati wa mawasiliano ya Februari.
Somali: KEMRI waxay waalidiinta degmada Marsabit ugu baaqeysaa in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka kolera inta lagu gudajiro bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: KEMRI okwayo jonyuol e county mar Marsabit mondo otim nonro mar cholera ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Februar.

English: "We have received multiple reports of individuals faking job placement letters for Qatar and UAE. All foreign employment must go through accredited agencies."
Kiswahili: "Tumepokea ripoti nyingi za watu wanaodanganya barua za kuajiri kazi kwa Qatar na UAE. Kazi zote za kigeni lazima ziende kupitia mashirika yaliyothibitishwa".
Somali: "Waxaan helnay warbixinno badan oo ku saabsan shaqsiyaad been abuuraya waraaqaha shaqooyinka ee Qatar iyo Imaaraadka. Dhammaan shaqooyinka ajnabiga ah waa inay maraan hay'adaha la aqoonsan yahay".
Dholuo: "Waseyudo ripode mang'eny mag ji ma wuondo barupe mag tich ne Qatar kod UAE.

English: KTDA invites farmers in Taita-Taveta County to a free training on modern irrigation techniques this August.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kwa mafunzo ya bure juu ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji Agosti hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Taita-Taveta tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: KTDA ogwelo jopur manie Taita-Taveta County e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi yore mag lero pi e dwe mar Agost.

English: Ministry of Health calls on parents in Nairobi County to have children under five screened for typhoid during the December outreach.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuwafanyia uchunguzi wa watoto chini ya miaka mitano wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Desemba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Nairobi inay caruurta ka yar shan sano baaritaan ku sameeyaan cudurka 'typhoid' inta lagu gudajiro bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health okwayo jonyuol e County mar Nairobi mondo otim nonro mar tuo mar typhoid ne nyithindgi ma hikgi tin ne abich e dwe mar Desemba.

English: To protect stored maize from weevils without chemicals: once cobs are fully dry, remove the kernels, pound the empty cobs into a fine powder, mix this with the kernels, and pack tightly into jute sacks. The powder blocks the weevils' movement so they cannot find new kernels to infest, protecting the maize for up to 12 months.
Kiswahili: Ili kulinda mahindi yaliyohifadhiwa kutoka kwa wadudu bila kemikali: mara tu mahindi yamekauka kabisa, ondoa punje, piga cobs tupu kwenye poda laini, changanya hii na punje, na pakia vizuri kwenye magunia ya jute. Poda huzuia harakati za wadudu kwa hivyo hawawezi kupata punje mpya za kushambulia, kulinda mahindi kwa hadi miezi 12.
Somali: Si loo ilaaliyo galleyda kaydka ah ee ka hortagga weevil-ka aan kiimikooyin lahayn: marka cobs-ku si buuxda u enegiyo, ka saar geedka, ku garaac cobs-ka madhan si uu u noqdo budo khafiif ah, isku qas tan iyo kernel-ka, kadibna si adag ugu xir bacaha jute-ka. Budadu waxay xannibaysaa dhaqdhaqaaqa weevils-ka si aysan u helin kernels cusub oo ay ku faafaan, taasoo ilaalinaysa galleyda ilaa 12 bilood.
Dholuo: Mondo kik cham ma ne okan-go kethre gi mag chwech mag chwech: ka chwech mag chwechgo osetieko yweyo, onego gologi oko, gichiwgi e powder matin, gichiwgi e chwechgo, kendo gipakgi e sanduge mag jute.

English: Kenya Dairy Board urges sheep farmers in Nairobi County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported foot and mouth disease cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawataka wafugaji wa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kuripotiwa visa vya ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda idaha ee degmada Nairobi inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib markii la soo sheegay kiisaska cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur ma pidho rombe e County mar Nairobi mondo onyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth machiegni kodgi bang' ka osenyis ni gin gi tuoche mag dhoot.

English: Notice: IPOA issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa kitambulisho unaoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay soo saartaa digniin amniga internetka ah oo ku saabsan dhacda aqoonsiga oo saameyn ku leh dadka deggan degmada Wajir.
Dholuo: Rapar: IPOA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity e wi kuo mar ng'ato makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free tuberculosis screening is available at all public health centres in Nyeri County this October.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kifua kikuu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Oktoba hii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka caabuqa ee bilaashka ah lagu heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Nyeri bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji ni thieth mar tuo mar tuberculosis onge chudo e kuonde thieth duto e county mar Nyeri e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Agriculture sector is seeking 65% in the world to fill world revenues as 15% and 40% through sell of farm produce to diaspora markets .
Kiswahili: Sekta ya kilimo inatafuta 65% ulimwenguni kujaza mapato ya ulimwengu kama 15% na 40% kupitia uuzaji wa mazao ya shamba kwa masoko ya diaspora.
Somali: Qaybta beeraha waxay raadineysaa 65% adduunka si ay u buuxiso dakhliga caalamka sida 15% iyo 40% iyada oo loo marayo iibinta wax soo saarka beeraha suuqyada qurbajoogta.
Dholuo: Sech mar jopur manyo ni ji 65% e piny mangima ochop pesa ma giyudo e piny mangima e kind 15% kod 40% kuom uso gik ma jopur timo e pinje ma ji odakie .

English: AFA advises horticultural produce producers in Kilifi County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: AFA inawashauri wazalishaji wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: AFA waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha wax soo saarka beeraha ee degmada Kilifi inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: AFA nyiso jopur ma loso puothe e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur ka pok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Ministry annoucning  unveiling agenda for Multiple Micronutrient Supplementation (MMS) to reduce maternal anaemia and improve birth outcomes.
Kiswahili: Wizara inatangaza mpango wa kuongeza virutubisho vingi vya chakula (MMS) ili kupunguza upungufu wa damu ya mama na kuboresha matokeo ya kujifungua.
Somali: Wasaaraddu waxay soo bandhigtay ajandaha dheeraadka ah ee Micronutrient Supplementation (MMS) si loo yareeyo dhiigla'aanta hooyooyinka loona hagaajiyo natiijooyinka dhalmada.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Joneno mag Jehova ogolo chenro mar tiyo gi gik mang'eny ma nyalo miyo nyithindo obed gi midekre mar remo kendo kelo nyak e nyuol.

English: Notice: KUCCPS reminds citizens in Embu County about their rights regarding voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Embu kuhusu haki zao kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Embu ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KUCCPS paronwa raia mag Embu County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar ndiko joma oyiero.

English: Kenya since 1980, established the Kenya Expanded Programme for Immunization, KEPI, which set its pace to ensure all child diseases are prevented through immunization from birth.
Kiswahili: Kenya tangu mwaka wa 1980, ilianzisha Mpango wa Kenya wa Kupanua Chanjo, KEPI, ambao uliweka kasi yake kuhakikisha magonjwa yote ya watoto yanazuiliwa kupitia chanjo tangu kuzaliwa.
Somali: Tan iyo 1980-kii, Kenya waxay aasaastay Barnaamijka Ballaarinta Tallaalka Kenya, KEPI, kaas oo dejiyay xawaareheeda si loo hubiyo in dhammaan cudurrada carruurta laga hortago iyada oo loo marayo tallaal laga bilaabo dhalashada.
Dholuo: Kenya chakre higa mar 1980, noloso chenro mar keto tuoche mag thieth, KEPI, ma ne oketo chenro mare mar neno ni tuoche duto mag nyithindo ogeng’ore kokalo kuom chiwo thieth chakre e nyuol.

English: A section of the Isiolo â€œMeru community has raised concerns over what they describe as rampant bad governance within the county administration. The leaders accused local officials of mismanagement and failing to fulfill key development pledges.
Kiswahili: Sehemu ya jumuiya ya Isiolo Meru imeelezea wasiwasi juu ya kile wanachoelezea kama utawala mbaya ndani ya utawala wa kaunti. Viongozi waliwashtaki maafisa wa mitaa kwa usimamizi mbaya na kushindwa kutimiza ahadi muhimu za maendeleo.
Somali: Qayb ka mid ah bulshada Isiolo “Meru” ayaa walaac ka muujisay waxa ay ku tilmaameen maamul xumo baahsan oo ka jirta maamulka degmada. Hogaamiyayaashu waxay ku eedeeyeen mas'uuliyiinta deegaanka inay maamul xumo sameeyeen oo ay ku guuldareysteen inay fuliyaan ballanqaadyada horumarineed ee muhiimka ah.
Dholuo: Okang' moro mar jo Isiolo â€œMeru osekelo paro kuom gima giwacho ni en loch marach ma opong'o piny e kind loch mar kaunti. Jotelo ne odonjore gi jotend pinyno ni ne ok gitiyo maber gi pesa kendo ne ok gitimo gik madongo ma ne gising’o mar timo dongruok.

English: Pest Control Products Board announces a free lumpy skin disease vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Siaya County this June.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa ngozi kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Siaya Juni hii.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa ku dhawaaqaya jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan cudurka maqaarka ee lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Siaya bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok mag Pest olando chenro mar thiedho dhok makwayo pi e dwe mar Jun e gweng' mar Siaya.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds expectant mothers in Homa Bay County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Homa Bay in helitaanka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association parone mine ma biro bedo gi ich e Homa Bay County ni thuolo mar yudo kony mar chano ngima joot en maonge chudo e kuonde duto ma ji odakie.

English: KEMRI calls on parents in Nakuru County to have children under five screened for measles during the October outreach.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuwafanyia uchunguzi wa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa surua wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Oktoba.
Somali: KEMRI waxay waalidiinta degmada Nakuru ugu baaqeysaa in caruurta ka yar shan sano la baaro cudurka hargabka inta lagu gudajiro bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KEMRI okwayo jonyuol e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: DCI conducts a community briefing on community early-warning systems in Mandera County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI inafanya muhtasari wa jamii juu ya mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii katika Kaunti ya Mandera Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada oo ku saabsan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada ee Degmada Mandera bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DCI timo romo mar chiwo siem ne ji e wi chenro mag chiwo siem chon e taon mar Mandera e dwe mar Februar.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds residents of Samburu County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Samburu in helitaanka adeegyada baasaboorka ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette parone ji modak e county mar Samburu ni koro yot yudo passport kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Notice: Universities Fund launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu wazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha katika shule kote Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij ku saabsan hagitaan iyo adeegyo la-talin ah oo ku yaal dugsiyada degmada Murang'a.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Yunivasiti Fund chako chenro mar tiego kendo chiwo paro e skunde duto e County mar Murang'a.

English: This study tested the hypothesis that inclusion of Desmodium spp. into maize cropping system under the push-pull technology.
Kiswahili: Utafiti huu ulijaribu dhana kwamba kuingizwa kwa Desmodium spp. katika mfumo wa upandaji wa mahindi chini ya teknolojia ya kusukuma-kuvuta.
Somali: Daraasaddan waxay tijaabisay mala-awaalka ah in ku darista noocyada Desmodium ee nidaamka goynta galleyda iyadoo la adeegsanayo tiknoolajiyada push-pull.
Dholuo: Puonjruokni notemo paro ni Desmodium spp. ne inyalo ket e puodho mar cham e bwo teknoloji mar push-pull.

English: CDC announces free medical camps for residents of Nairobi County starting this December.
Kiswahili: CDC inatangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuanzia Desemba hii.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa xeryo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Nairobi laga bilaabo Diseembar.
Dholuo: CDC ogolo kampen mag thieth maonge chudo ne jogweng' Nairobi County kochakore Desemba.

English: A malaria vaccine tested in Kenya gains WHO prequalification, costing as low as Sh300, becoming the world's second vaccine on the global prequalified list.
Kiswahili: Chanjo ya malaria iliyojaribiwa nchini Kenya yapata sifa ya awali ya WHO, ikigharimu hadi Sh300, na kuwa chanjo ya pili duniani kwenye orodha ya chanjo zilizoidhinishwa awali duniani.
Somali: Tallaalka duumada ee lagu tijaabiyey Kenya ayaa helay shahaadada WHO, qiimihiisu wuxuu gaadhay Sh300, taasoo ka dhigaysa tallaalka labaad ee adduunka ee ku jira liiska caalamiga ah ee shahaadooyinka hore.
Dholuo: Yadh thieth mar malaria ma ne otim e piny Kenya, ne oyudo ratiro mar riwruok mar thieth miluongo ni WHO, kendo nengo mar yadhno ne ochopo Sh300, ma en mar ariyo e piny mangima.

English: Kenya Gazette encourages first-time voters in Uasin Gishu County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa codbixiyayaasha ugu horreeya ee degmada Uasin Gishu inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogo ma ne okwongo yiero e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo olim kama ichikoe ji ne IEBC.

English: NPS calls on residents of West Pokot County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaita wakazi wa Wilaya ya West Pokot kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: NPS waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga si ay u taageeraan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: NPS okwayo jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma rito sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e alworano.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges goats farmers in Kakamega County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wafugaji wa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kuripotiwa kwa visa vya kimeta.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda orgiga ee Gobolka Kakamega inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanada buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib markii la soo sheegay kiisaska anthrax.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur mag diek e county mar Kakamega mondo orwak le matuwo e ofise mar thieth man machiegni bang' yudo weche mag anthrax.

English: Baringo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Baringo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Februari 2023
Somali: Degmada Baringo: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Baringo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2023

English: PSA promoting tree planting for sustainable agricultural landscapes.
Kiswahili: PSA kukuza upandaji miti kwa mandhari endelevu ya kilimo.
Somali: PSA oo dhiirrigelinaysa beerista geedaha ee dhulalka beeraha waara.
Dholuo: PSA jiwo pidho yiende mondo omi lowo obed maber.

English: Notice from CDC: skilled birth attendance clinics will run every August at designated health centres in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa CDC: kliniki za mahudhurio ya uzazi zenye ujuzi zitaendeshwa kila Agosti katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid CDC: rugta caafimaad ee dhalmada ee xirfadlayaasha ah ayaa la qaban doonaa bishii Agoosto oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Bomet.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar yedhe ma thiedho tuoche (CDC): klinik mag thieth mag nyuol ma nigi lony biro tiyo dwe mar Agost higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e county mar Bomet.

English: Notice: OGP will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Embu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee degmada Embu.
Dholuo: Rapar: OGP biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e county mar Embu.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free Rift Valley Fever screening is available at all public health centres in Siaya County this May.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya Mei hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka hargabka Rift Valley ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Siaya bisha May.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji ni thieth mar Rift Valley Fever ma onge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e county mar Siaya e dwe mar Mei.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds the public in Kwale County that reporting embezzlement of public funds is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa fedha za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kwale in warbixinta xadgudubka lacagaha dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette parone ji duto e Kaunti mar Kwale ni chiwo ripot mar ketho pesa mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens a new service point for national ID applications in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu ka furayaa barta adeegga cusub ee codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties oyawo kama itimee tije manyien ne kwayo mag ng'eyo nying' e gweng' mar Baringo.

English: KEMRI reminds the public that free tuberculosis screening is available at all public health centres in Kwale County this November.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kifua kikuu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kwale Novemba hii.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka caabuqa ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynta ee Gobolka Kwale bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: KEMRI parone ji ni nonro mar thieth mar tuberculosis ma onge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e county mar Kwale e dwe mar Novemba.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Nakuru County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru in warbixinta degdegga ah ee jabsashada ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NDMA oparo ne jogweng' Nakuru County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar donjo e ot konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) launches a January awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Turkana County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Januari juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Janaayo oo ku saabsan wacyiga cadaadiska sare ee degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Januar kuom wach ng'eyo ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar hypertension e County duto mar Turkana.

English: Kenya Price Bulletin, March 2023
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Bei ya Kenya, Machi 2023
Somali: Warbixinta Qiimaha Kenya, Maarso 2023
Dholuo: Oboke mar nengo mar piny Kenya, dwe mar adek higa mar 2023

English: Notice: KALRO will conduct a pest and disease management workshop for farmers in Kisii County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafanya warsha ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada beeraleyda ee degmada Kisii bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KALRO biro timo chokruok mar rieyo tuoche kod tuoche ne jopur e County mar Kisii e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: IEBC announces bursary allocation enrollment dates for schools in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa mgao wa bursary kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ee dugsiyada degmada Kilifi.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IEBC landoga tarik ma ne idhi mi skul mag Kilifi thuolo mar dhi e skundno.

English: Through this approach, the project aims to strengthen women's financial decision-making skills, encourage savings and investment practices, and support the development of sustainable income-generating opportunities.
Kiswahili: Kupitia mbinu hii, mradi unalenga kuimarisha ujuzi wa wanawake wa kufanya maamuzi ya kifedha, kuhimiza mazoea ya kuweka akiba na uwekezaji, na kusaidia maendeleo ya fursa endelevu za kuzalisha mapato.
Somali: Habkan, mashruucu wuxuu higsanayaa inuu xoojiyo xirfadaha go'aan qaadashada maaliyadeed ee haweenka, dhiirrigeliyo dhaqamada keydinta iyo maalgashiga, iyo inuu taageero horumarinta fursadaha dakhli-abuurka waara.
Dholuo: Kokalo kuom yo ma kamano, chenro ni nigi gombo mar jiwo nyalo mar mon mar ng’ado bura e wi weche mag omwom, jiwo yore mag kano mwandu kod keto mwandu, kendo konyo e loso yore mag yudo mwandu ma nyalo sikon.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) advises residents of Kitui County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' Kitui County mondo odonj e riwruok mar insuarans mar thieth mondo giyud thieth ma yudo kony.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inaamsha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada wuxuu soo saaray qorshe deg-deg ah oo looga jawaabayo shilkii waddooyinka ee gobolka Kajiado.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche motudore gi weche mag mahundu tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne aksident mag ndara e Kajiado County.

English: Notice: FAO will distribute certified coffee seed to farmers in Marsabit County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itasambaza mbegu za kahawa zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay abuurka kafeega ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Marsabit bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: FAO biro pogo kodhi mag chai ne jopur man Marsabit County e dwe mar Julai.

English: NDMA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Samburu County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NDMA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Samburu inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e county mar Samburu mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Farmers are encouraged to utilize the Digifarm mobile platform offered by the Kenya Livestock Producers Association for enhanced agricultural practices
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kutumia jukwaa la rununu la Digifarm linalotolewa na Chama cha Wazalishaji Mifugo cha Kenya kwa ajili ya kuimarisha mbinu za kilimo.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay isticmaalaan madal moobil Digifarm oo ay bixiso Kenya Livestock Producers Association si loo horumariyo hababka beeraha
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur mondo oti gi Digifarm mobile platform ma Kenya Livestock Producers Association chiwo mondo otigo e timo dongruok e yore mag pur

English: Refugeesâ€™ Access to Work Permits and Business Licences in Kenya
Kiswahili: Upatikanaji wa Wakimbizi wa Vibali vya Kazi na Leseni za Biashara nchini Kenya
Somali: Helitaanka Ruqsadaha Shaqada iyo Ruqsadaha Ganacsiga ee Qaxootiga ee Kenya
Dholuo: Jolweny yudo oboke mag tiyo kod oboke mag timo ohala e piny Kenya

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Kiambu County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this drought season.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati huu wa ukame.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lugta lagu maro xilligan abaarta.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross paronwa jogweng' Kiambu County mondo oluw tong' mag wuoth kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe e kinde oro.

English: Notice: IPOA launches a fraud prevention campaign in Mandera County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Mandera Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga khiyaamooyinka Degmada Mandera bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA chako kampen mar geng'o wuondruok e taon mar Mandera e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Nyandarua County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Utafiti wa Jinai inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua juu ya kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua uga digay kororka qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah wuxuuna bulshada kula talinayaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nyandarua County e wi medruok mar chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will conduct a pest and disease management workshop for farmers in Murang'a County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya itafanya warsha ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan xakamaynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada beeraleyda ee degmada Murang'a bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro timo chokruok mar rieyo tuoche kod tuoche ne jopur e County mar Murang'a e dwe mar Jun.

English: General advice! Wearing a medical mask is one of the preventive measures to limit spread of certain respiratory diseases, including COVID-19. The use of masks must be combined with hand hygiene, social distancing, stay home, clean surfaces & other measures. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa jumla! Kuvaa barakoa ya matibabu ni moja wapo ya hatua za kuzuia kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa fulani ya kupumua, pamoja na COVID-19. Matumizi ya barakoa lazima yaunganishwe na usafi wa mikono, umbali wa kijamii, kukaa nyumbani, nyuso safi na hatua zingine. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Talo guud! Xidhashada maaskaro caafimaad waa mid ka mid ah tallaabooyinka ka hortagga ah ee lagu xakameynayo faafitaanka cudurrada qaarkood ee neefsashada, oo ay ku jirto COVID-19. Isticmaalka maaskaro waa in lagu daraa nadaafadda gacmaha, kala fogaanshaha bulshada, joogista guriga, meelaha nadiifka ah iyo tallaabooyin kale. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Rieko ma ji duto nyalo ng’eyo! Rwako masgu mar thieth en achiel kuom yore mag geng'o lalruok mar twoche moko mag yweyo, moriwo COVID-19. Tiyo gi mask nyaka oriw gi ler mar lwedo, bedo mabor gi ji, bedo e ot, loso kuonde maler kod yore mamoko. #KomeshaKorona

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages mothers in Bomet County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuhudhuria siku iliyopangwa ya kliniki ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya ayaa ku dhiirigelinaya hooyooyinka degmada Bomet inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta caafimaad ee la qorsheeyay si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo mine manie county mar Bomet mondo odhi e odiechieng'no mar thieth mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Vihiga County about the importance of diabetes screening for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuhusu umuhimu wa uchunguzi wa kisukari kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay dadka degmada Vihiga ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay baaritaanka sonkorowga caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji e County mar Vihiga gimomiyo thieth mar thieth mag ndhoga en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: State Department for TVET conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in Bomet County this November.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Bomet Novemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee gobolka Bomet bishii November.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi chike mag sirkal e taon mar Bomet County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Kenya Key Message Update January 2024: Household access to food and income is expected to improve through at least May 2024
Kiswahili: Taarifa Muhimu ya Kenya Januari 2024: Upatikanaji wa chakula na mapato ya kaya unatarajiwa kuboreshwa hadi angalau Mei 2024
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta Fariinta Muhiimka ah ee Kenya Janaayo 2024: Helitaanka qoysaska ee cuntada iyo dakhliga ayaa la filayaa inay soo hagaagto ugu yaraan Maajo 2024
Dholuo: Oda Maduong’ mar Kenya Maloki dwe mar achiel higa mar 2024: Yudo mar chiemo kod pesa ma joot yudo biro bedo maber nyaka dwe mar abich higa mar 2024

English: NGEC organizes national summits for inclusive governance.
Kiswahili: NGEC huandaa mikutano ya kitaifa kwa ajili ya utawala wa pamoja.
Somali: NGEC waxay qabanqaabisaa shirar sare oo qaran oo loogu talagalay maamulka oo dhanka ah.
Dholuo: NGEC chano chokruoge madongo e piny mangima mag locho e yo moriwo ji duto.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service issues a cybersecurity alert on SIM-swap fraud affecting residents of Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM unaoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu soo saaray digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaanooyinka SIM-swap ee saameeya dadka deggan Gobolka Garissa.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Forest Service ogolo siem mar sirkal mar cybersecurity kuom wuond mar SIM-swap makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e County mar Garissa.

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Samburu County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Samburu inay yareeyaan qaadashada cusbada iyo sonkorta si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health osiemo jogweng'o mag Samburu County mondo giketh chamo mor kod sukari mondo kik tuoche ma inyalo geng'e landre.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Meru County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka waxay dadka degmada Meru kula talineysaa inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun iyo biyo nadiif ah si joogto ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit nyiso jogweng' mar Meru County mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Medical Association will be held in Turkana County this March.

English: IEBC urges residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to register their children at the nearest public school to benefit from free primary education.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu ili kufaidika na elimu ya msingi bila malipo.

Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul mar sirkal man machiegni kodgi mondo giyud tiegruok ma onge chudo.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages mothers in Kisii County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kisii kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.

Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo mine manie County mar Kisii mondo olim kama giwuokie machiegni mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: IGAD Strengthens Conflict Sensitive Land Use and Management in the Somali/Mandera Cluster

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Samburu County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu wape huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Samburu inay dalbadaan bixinta adeegyada aan la bixin laaluush si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jogweng' mar Samburu County mondo okonygi ka ok gichiwo asoya mondo giked gi asoya e migepe mag sirkal.

English: DCI urges the community in Mandera County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: DCI inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Mandera inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shisheeyaha si looga hortago xannibaadda lo'da.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo oganda man Mandera County mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo gikwed kwalo jamni.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds mobile money users in Kiambu County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha watumiaji wa fedha za simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa pesa za simu.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kiambu inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa si looga fogaado khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e gweng' mar Kiambu ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo kik gitim mibadhi mar pesa mag simu.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Tana River County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this drought season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati huu wa ukame.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada ay fatahaadu ka dhacdo xilligan abaarta.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne jogweng' mar Tana River County ni kik giwuoth e kind yiengni mag oro kod nderni ma pi opong'o.

English: DCI reminds residents of Kitui County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this road accidents season.

Dholuo: SHA ojiwo jogweng' Laikipia County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo kwayo mar kwedo mibadhi e tije mag sirkal.

Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.

Kiswahili: KMTC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme.

English: Notice: IPOA conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Bomet County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA inafanya mkutano wa jamii juu ya umakini wa kukabiliana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Bomet Septemba hii.

English: DPP urges the public in Kisumu County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: DPP inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za ujumbe wa udanganyifu.

English: NTSA alerts residents of Kiambu County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu juu ya kuongezeka kwa visa vya wizi na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.

Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kiambu County e wi kwan mag joma oketho kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot e stesen mar polise man machiegni.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya warns residents of Murang'a County about a rise in identity theft and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a juu ya kuongezeka kwa wizi wa kitambulisho na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a kororka xadgudubka aqoonsiga waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds livestock keepers in Tharaka-Nithi County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.

Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service oparo ne jorit jamni e Tharaka-Nithi County ni kik giting' jamni ka ok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: KALRO informs tea farmers in Nyandarua County of new market linkage opportunities this January.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawafahamisha wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Januari hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee gobolka Nyandarua fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Janaayo.

English: IEBC urges residents of Mombasa County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan fasallada akhriskaaga dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Mombasa mondo odonj e program mar somo kod somo mar joma dongo.

English: Public notice: KEMSA will host a free tobacco control outreach in Meru County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMSA itaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa kudhibiti tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Meru Desemba hii.
