Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMSA biro timo kampen mar nono kong'o e dwe mar Desemba e kaunti mar Meru.

English: Notice: Council of Governors will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana litafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha waxay qaban doonaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynta ee degmada Mombasa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Bura mar Jaloch biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi weche siasa e County mar Mombasa.

English: A contextual analysis of Kenya's food system and policy environment
Kiswahili: Uchambuzi wa muktadha wa mfumo wa chakula wa Kenya na mazingira ya sera
Somali: Falanqayn ku saabsan nidaamka cuntada ee Kenya iyo jawiga siyaasadda
Dholuo: Nonro mar weche ma mulo chenro mar chiemo e piny Kenya kod alwora mar chike

English: Notice: Ministry of Education opens a new motor vehicle mechanics programme at the vocational centre in Machakos County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu inafungua programu mpya ya ufundi wa magari katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Machakos.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ka furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan mashiinnada gawaarida ee xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Machakos.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Puonjruok chako chenro manyien mar tiyo gi masinde mag riembo mtokni e skul mar tich e gweng' mar Machakos.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds the public in Elgeyo-Marakwet County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu dadka ku nool gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet ku xasuusinayaa in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette parone ji duto e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni chiwo ripot mar ketho migepe mag sirkal en gima onge ratiro, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Notice: NPS conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Nakuru County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ku saabsan dhismaha nabadda qaranka ee Gobolka Nakuru bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Riwruok mar NPS timo romo mar oganda e wi loso kuwe e gweng' mar Nakuru e dwe mar Mach.

English: Council of Governors reminds residents of West Pokot County that access to national ID applications is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya West Pokot kwamba kufikia maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada West Pokot in helitaanka codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch oparo ne jogweng' mar West Pokot County ni yudo kwayo mag ID mar piny sani yot ahinya kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal.

English: Garissa County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Garissa: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2023
Somali: Degmada Garissa: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Garissa: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Adek 2023

English: KEMRI launches a November awareness campaign on tobacco control across Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: KEMRI yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Novemba juu ya udhibiti wa tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: KEMRI waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Nofeembar ee ka dhanka ah xakamaynta sigaarka ee Gobolka Laikipia.
Dholuo: KEMRI chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Novemba e wi thieth mar ndawa e County duto mar Laikipia.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development informs horticultural produce farmers in Bungoma County of new market linkage opportunities this October.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawafahamisha wakulima wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Oktoba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay uga warrameysaa beeraleyda wax soo saarka beeraha ee degmada Bungoma fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development olero ne jopur ma loso puothe mag puothe e county mar Bungoma thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: State Department for TVET urges parents and teachers in Nakuru County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Nakuru inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e kaunti mar Nakuru mondo oriw lwedo kuonde ma ji duto puonjoree.

English: KUCCPS reminds youth in Samburu County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Samburu in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta.
Dholuo: KUCCPS oparo ne rowere man Samburu County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar chiemo kod mar rwako welo.

English: Ministry of Health urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Bungoma County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kumhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Bungoma inuu ku dhiirrigeliyo saaxiibkiisa dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi tuoche mag pach e County mar Bungoma mondo ojiw osiepne moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: The Kenya Agricultural Livestock Research Organization KALRO is launching a program to develop new pest management technologies and practices to help farmers reduce crop losses
Kiswahili: Shirika la Utafiti wa Mifugo ya Kilimo nchini Kenya KALRO linazindua mpango wa kuendeleza teknolojia na mbinu mpya za kudhibiti wadudu ili kuwasaidia wakulima kupunguza upotevu wa mazao.
Somali: Ururka Cilmi-baarista Xoolaha Beeraha Kenya ee KALRO wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij loogu talagalay horumarinta tikniyoolajiyada iyo hababka cusub ee xakamaynta cayayaanka si looga caawiyo beeraleyda inay yareeyaan khasaaraha dalagga
Dholuo: Kenya Agricultural Livestock Research Organization KALRO chako chenro mar loso teknoloji kod timbe manyien mag kedo gi tuoche mondo okony jopur tieko chudo

English: Ministry of Health appeals to caregivers in Kericho County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the January maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kericho kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Januari.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Kericho inay ilmahooda u keenaan kormeerka koritaanka iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health okwayo jorit e County mar Kericho mondo okel nyithindgi mondo onon dongruok margi e dwe mar Januar.

English: World Health Organization supported this effort through technical guidance, coordination and the strengthening of regional networks, helping to ensure that clinical capacity continues to grow across countries and is sustained between outbreaks.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Afya Ulimwenguni liliunga mkono juhudi hizi kupitia mwongozo wa kiufundi, uratibu na uimarishaji wa mitandao ya kikanda, kusaidia kuhakikisha kwamba uwezo wa kimatibabu unaendelea kukua katika nchi zote na unadumishwa kati ya milipuko.
Somali: Hay'adda Caafimaadka Adduunka ayaa taageertay dadaalkan iyada oo loo marayo hagitaan farsamo, isku-dubarid iyo xoojinta shabakadaha gobolka, iyada oo gacan ka geysaneysa hubinta in awoodda caafimaadku ay sii kordheyso dhammaan waddamada oo ay sii socoto inta u dhaxaysa cudurrada faafa.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Pinyruoth mar Thieth ne okonyo tichni kokalo kuom puonj mag lony, loso gik moko e kindgi kod keto teko e kindgi e kindgi, ma konyo neno ni nyalo mar thieth dhi nyime medore e pinje mopogore opogore kendo ochung’ motegno e kind kinde ma tuochego opong’o piny.

English: IPOA urges the public in Nyeri County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: IPOA inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nyeri inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo ji duto e County mar Nyeri mondo ochiw ripot mar ote mamulo pachgi ne jatendgi bang' yudo ripode mag mibadhi mar SIM-swap.

English: Notice: KMTC announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta dugsiyada dugsiga dhexe ee maalin bilaash ah ee Degmada Mandera.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC ogolo chenro mar somo mar sekondari maonge chudo e skunde man Mandera County.

English: Produce revenue. This includes through access to finance and skills development, market access opportunities, enhanced access to inputs and improved.
Kiswahili: Kuzalisha mapato. Hii ni pamoja na kwa njia ya upatikanaji wa fedha na maendeleo ya ujuzi, fursa za ufikiaji wa soko, kuongezeka kwa upataji wa kipato na kuboresha.
Somali: Soo saarista dakhliga. Tan waxaa ka mid ah helitaanka maaliyadeed iyo horumarinta xirfadaha, fursadaha marin u helka suuqa, kor u qaadista marin u helidda wax soo saarka iyo hagaajinta.
Dholuo: Tiyo gi yore mopogore opogore mag yudo pesa.

English: TVET reminds needy students in Homa Bay County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan gobolka Homa Bay in deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay codsiyada ardayda baahan ay dhowaan dhammaadaan.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa jopuonjre mochando e Homa Bay County ni tuke mag somo ne jopuonjre ma nigi chan biro rumo machiegni.

English: KALRO warns maize farmers in Nyamira County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaonya wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KALRO waxay uga digtay beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Nyamira cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: KALRO chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho cham e County mar Nyamira kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: COMESA urges goats farmers in Bungoma County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawataka wafugaji wa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa ngozi ya uvimbe.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda orgiga ee degmada Bungoma inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanada buka xafiiska xayawaanka ugu dhow kadib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur ma pidho diek e county mar Bungoma mondo ochiw ripot ne jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth machiegni kodgi bang' ka osenyis ni nitie tuoche mang'eny mag pien.

English: OGP announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Busia County.
Kiswahili: OGP inatangaza nyakati bora za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Busia.
Somali: OGP waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Busia.
Dholuo: OGP olando lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mag ng'eyo ng'ato e gweng' mar Busia.

English: Notice: Council of Governors will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana litafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha waxay qaban doonaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Jaloch biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e county mar Siaya.

English: KALRO encourages farmers in Nandi County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for horticultural produce.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora za mazao ya bustani.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Nandi inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay wax soo saarka beeraha.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e county mar Nandi mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar puothe mag puothe.

English: NDMA calls on the community in Embu County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Embu kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: NDMA waxay bulshada degmada Embu ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wici doonaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: NDMA okwayo ji duto e county mar Embu mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Kirinyaga County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika kumbi za umma huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Kirinyaga County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag rito sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'adoe bura ka ji medo chiwo siem ne ji chon.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) urges farmers in Taita-Taveta County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Taita-Taveta mondo opidh olembe ma nyalo miyo lowo okethre mondo ginyagre gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Council of Governors reminds residents of Kericho County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Kericho in helitaanka adeegyada baasaboorka ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch oparo ne jogweng' Kericho County ni koro yot yudo passport kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Kenya Dairy Board promotes agroforestry among farmers in Bungoma County as part of the August climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inakuza kilimo cha misitu miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Agosti.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa beeraleyda duurka ee degmada Bungoma iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka iska caabinta cimilada ee Agoosto.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo yiende mag agroforestry e kind jopur mag Bungoma County kaka achiel kuom chenro mar Agost mar kedo gi lokruok e kit yamo.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public that free tuberculosis screening is available at all public health centres in Garissa County this July.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kifua kikuu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa Julai hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka caabuqa ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee Gobolka Garissa bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth parone ji ni thieth mar thieth ma onge choke mar tuberculosis yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Garissa e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: IEBC launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay bilawday barnaamij ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada iskuulada guud ahaan degmada Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC chako chenro mar rito nyithindo e skunde e skul duto e County mar Kirinyaga.

English: DPP urges the public in Murang'a County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: DPP inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: DPP waxay ugu baaqeysaa shacabka degmada Murang'a inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo ji duto e County mar Murang'a mondo ochiw ripot mar ote mamulo pachgi ne jatendgi mar tich bang' ka osenyis ni gin gi chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo.

English: Ministry urges farmers to adopt waterÃ¢Â€Â‘harvesting irrigation techniques.
Kiswahili: Wizara inawahimiza wakulima kutumia mbinu za umwagiliaji za kuvuna maji.
Somali: Wasaaraddu waxay ku boorrisay beeralayda inay qaataan farsamooyinka waraabka ee beerashada biyaha.
Dholuo: Ministeri dwaro ni jopur okaw yore mag pi mag pi.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service conducts a community briefing on border security in Nairobi County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu qabtaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha ee Gobolka Nairobi bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Forest Service timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e Nairobi County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: For rice, optimize water use to support grain filling and manage flowering.
Kiswahili: Kwa mchele, boresha matumizi ya maji ili kusaidia kujaza nafaka na kudhibiti maua.
Somali: Bariiska, si fiican u isticmaal biyaha si loo taageero buuxinta hadhuudhka loona maareeyo ubaxa.
Dholuo: Kuom loso loso kodhi, ti gi pi e yo maber moloyo mondo omi cham opong' maber kendo omi cham odongi maber.

English: Public launch of irrigated crop and fodder production in Naoros, where malnutrition cases among under-fives declined by 41% thanks to integrated agricultural-nutrition interventions.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa umma wa uzalishaji wa mazao ya umwagiliaji na malisho ya mifugo huko Naoros, ambapo visa vya utapiamlo miongoni mwa watoto walio chini ya umri wa miaka mitano vilipungua kwa 41% kutokana na hatua jumuishi za kilimo na lishe.
Somali: Daahfurka dadweynaha ee wax soo saarka dalagyada waraabka iyo calafka ee Naoros, halkaas oo kiisaska nafaqo-darrada ee carruurta da'doodu ka yar tahay shan sano ay hoos u dhaceen 41% iyada oo ay ugu wacan tahay waxqabadyada isku dhafan ee nafaqada beeraha iyo beeraha.
Dholuo: Ochako loso cham ma itiyogo gi pi kod chiemo mag le e piny Naoros, kama kes mag chiemo ma ok oromo e kind nyithindo ma hikgi pok ochopo abich ne dok piny gi 41% nikech ng’ado bura ma oriw mar pur kod chiemo.

English: MSF tackles three simultaneous disease outbreaks in Kenya
Kiswahili: MSF inakabiliana na milipuko mitatu ya magonjwa kwa wakati mmoja nchini Kenya
Somali: MSF waxay wax ka qabatay saddex cudur oo isku mar ka dilaacay Kenya
Dholuo: MSF ochung' ne tuoche adek ma nyalo landore e kinde achiel e piny Kenya

English: Upgrade labs in secondary schools 2024.
Kiswahili: Kuboresha maabara katika shule za upili 2024.
Somali: Tijaabinta shaybaarada dugsiyada sare 2024.
Dholuo: Tiego laboratori mag tiego nyithindo e skunde mag sekondari e higa mar 2024.

English: NDMA urges the public in Kiambu County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: NDMA inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: NDMA waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadweynaha degmada Kiambu inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo ji duto e Kaunti mar Kiambu mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma osefweny kuom ote mag phishing.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free tuberculosis screening is available at all public health centres in Samburu County this September.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kifua kikuu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Samburu Septemba hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka caabuqa ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee Gobolka Samburu bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone ji ni nonro mar thieth mar tuberculosis ma onge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e county mar Samburu e dwe mar Septemba.

English: DPP reminds residents of Busia County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kusakinisha na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kazini wakati wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia inay guryahooda ku rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo shaqada inta lagu jiro xilliyada fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogweng' County mar Busia mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo giti e kinde mag koth.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds residents of Murang'a County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba kufikia usajili wa e-Citizen sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaan-hayaha xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Murang'a in helitaanka diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties parone jogweng' mar County mar Murang'a ni yudo e-Citizen registration koro yot ahinya kokalo kuom chenro mag sirkal.

English: NPS alerts residents of Nyandarua County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: NPS waxay dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua uga digtay kororka kiisaska jabsashada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka warbixiyaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: NPS chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nyandarua County kuom wach kwan mar joma odonjo e ot kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne polis man machiegni.

English: ODPP urges residents of Narok County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Narok inay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda horumarinta degmada.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo omed ng'eyo weche momedore e wi chenro mag dongruok mag county.

English: Public Service CS Geoffrey Ruku urges IEBC to ensure credible 2027 elections
Kiswahili: Mkurugenzi Mtendaji wa Huduma ya Umma Geoffrey Ruku anahimiza IEBC kuhakikisha uchaguzi wa kuaminika wa 2027
Somali: Xoghayaha Adeegga Dadweynaha Geoffrey Ruku wuxuu ku booriyay IEBC inay xaqiijiso doorashooyinka la isku halleyn karo ee 2027
Dholuo: Geoffrey Ruku ma en jatend sirkal mar sirkal jiwo IEBC mondo omi yiero mar 2027 obed maber

English: E-Citizen announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inatangaza nyakati bora za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Makueni.
Dholuo: E-Citizen olando lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mag ng'eyo ng'ato e gweng' mar Makueni.

English: Agriculture isn't in vain but is one way of alleviating climate change. We need online technology to undertake kitchen gardening especially for small scale farmers in Guatemala against...
Kiswahili: Kilimo si bure lakini ni njia moja ya kupunguza mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa. Tunahitaji teknolojia ya mtandaoni kufanya bustani ya jikoni hasa kwa wakulima wadogo katika Guatemala dhidi ya...
Somali: Beeraha ma aha mid aan micno lahayn laakiin waa hab lagu yareeyo isbeddelka cimilada. Waxaan u baahanahay tiknoolajiyad online ah si aan u fulino beeraleyda jikada gaar ahaan beeraleyda yaryar ee Guatemala ka dhanka ah...
Dholuo: Tij pur ok en gima nono, to en yo achiel mar tieko lokruok mar lokruok mar piny. Dwarore ni wati gi teknoloji e Intanet mondo wati gi puothe mag jikni, to moloyo ne jopur matindo e piny Guatemala, e bwo...

English: AFA reminds farmers in Embu County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Embu barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee ka dambeeya goosashada.
Dholuo: AFA parone jopur e county mar Embu chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime bang' keyo.

English: Ministry of Health reminds expectant mothers in Samburu County that access to free antenatal care is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma ya bure ya ujauzito ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Samburu in helitaanka daryeelka uurka ka hor ee bilaashka ah ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne mine ma nigi ich e county mar Samburu ni thuolo mar yudo thieth ma onge chudo e kuonde duto mag sirkal en maonge chudo.

English: Farmers are encouraged to explore onion cultivation due to high demand with an estimated annual consumption of 365 million kgs in Kenya Consider growing bulb onions to benefit from this lucrative market
Kiswahili: Wakulima wamehimizwa kuchunguza kilimo cha vitunguu kwa sababu ya mahitaji makubwa na inakadiriwa matumizi ya kila mwaka ya kilo milioni 365 nchini Kenya Fikiria kulima vitunguu vya balbu ili kufaidika na soko hili la faida.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay sahamiyaan beerashada subagga sababtoo ah baahida sare leh iyadoo la qiyaaso isticmaalka sanadlaha ah ee 365 milyan kg ee Kenya tixgeli beerashada subagga bulb si aad uga faa'iideysato suuqa faa'iidada leh
Dholuo: Josupni ijiwo mondo ong'e pidho adundo nikech ji dwaro adundo, kendo kwan mar odundo mar higa ka higa mar Kenya romo kilo milion 365

English: DPP calls on residents of Nyamira County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of border security.
Kiswahili: DPP inawaomba wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: DPP waxay dadka deggan degmada Nyamira ugu baaqeysaa inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga waxqabadka aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah si ay u taageeraan amniga xuduudda.
Dholuo: DPP okwayo jogweng' mar Nyamira County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma rito tong'o ni gitimo gik maok kare e alworano.

English: OGP urges residents of Homa Bay County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay si loo qaabeeyo wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo ochiw paro mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso chenro mag chenro mag sirkal.

English: Health CS Mutahi Kagwe held discussions with Ukraine Ambassador to Kenya H.E Andriy Pravedynk who paid a courtesy call on him at his Afya House office.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Afya Mutahi Kagwe alifanya mazungumzo na Balozi wa Ukraine nchini Kenya H.E Andriy Pravedynk ambaye alimtembelea katika ofisi yake ya Afya House.
Somali: Wasiirka Caafimaadka Mutahi Kagwe ayaa wadahadallo la yeeshay Safiirka Ukraine u fadhiya Kenya H.E. Andriy Pravedynk oo si sharaf leh ugu soo booqday xafiiskiisa Afya House.
Dholuo: 10:10, 11. 10 Ne otimo mbaka gi Jatend piny Ukraine ma ne odhi e piny Kenya, ma ne odhi limogi e ofis mare ma ne ni e ot mar Afya.

English: FAO reminds farmers in Lamu County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Lamu barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee xakamaynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada.
Dholuo: FAO parone jopur e county mar Lamu chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Kakamega County to prepare for possible road accidents this October.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Oktoba hii.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ka digaya dadka deggan degmada Kakamega inay u diyaar garoobaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations osiemo jogweng' Kakamega County mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: CDC reminds the public in Kisumu County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhusu umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: CDC waxay dadka degmada Kisumu ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay nadaafadda saxda ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji duto e Kisumu County kuom ber mar rito ler mar ngima mar ot.

English: Tana River County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tana River: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Mei 2023
Somali: Degmada Tana River: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Aora Tana: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo kuom Oro mar Mei 2023

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development calls on the community in Machakos County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Machakos kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada Waxbarashada wuxuu ugu baaqay bulshada Degmada Machakos inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oluongo oganda man Machakos County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Kenya Gazette invites residents of Kilifi County to attend the public participation forum regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya wilaya.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inay ka qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan habka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette gwelo jogweng' Kilifi County mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenro mar bajet mar county.

English: IEBC reminds the public in Machakos County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this February.
Kiswahili: IEBC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba maoni juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka ni ya kukaribishwa Februari hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Machakos in talooyinka dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: IEBC parone ji duto manie County ma Machakos ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e dwe mar Februar.

English: NCPB urges maize growers in Nandi County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Nandi kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee gobolka Nandi inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey roobka ka hor si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: NCPB ojiwo jopur mag kodhi e county mar Nandi mondo oti gi ratiro mar chwoyo kodhi kapok koth ochue mondo okony e medo nyak mar yien e higani.

English: DPP reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Tana River County that access to post-violence medical care is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Wilaya ya Tana River kwamba huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu zinapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Tana River in helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ka dib rabshaduhu uu yahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag nindruok e taon mar Tana River County ni yudo kony mar thieth bang' timno onge chudo.

English: KEMSA encourages residents of Kiambu County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay uga qayb galaan kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' Kiambu County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Annual Country Report 2023 - Country Strategic Plan 2018 - 2023
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Mwaka ya Nchi ya Kenya 2023 - Mpango Mkakati wa Nchi 2018 - 2023
Somali: Warbixinta Sannadlaha ah ee Dalka Kenya 2023 - Qorshaha Istaraatiijiyadda Dalka 2018 - 2023
Dholuo: Ripot mar Higa mar Piny Kenya 2023 - Chenro mar Piny 2018 - 2023

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free stress management support is available through county health facilities in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa kudhibiti mafadhaiko unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo lagu maareeyo walbahaarka laga helo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Kajiado.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji ni kony mar thieth mar parruok yudore maonge chudo kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e Kajiado County.

English: Kenya is one of the few African countries to have introduced the HPV vaccine free of charge into routine immunization schedules. The Vaccine targets girls who are currently 10 years old & subsequently to all girls as they turn 10 years @WHOKenya @UNICEFKenya #STOPCervicalCancer
Kiswahili: Kenya ni mojawapo ya nchi chache za Kiafrika ambazo zimeanzisha chanjo ya HPV bila malipo katika ratiba za kawaida za chanjo. Chanjo hiyo inalenga wasichana ambao kwa sasa wana umri wa miaka 10 na kisha wasichana wote wanapofikisha miaka 10 @WHOKenya @UNICEFKenya #STOPCervicalCancer
Somali: Kenya waa mid ka mid ah dalalka yar ee Afrika ee tallaalka HPV si bilaash ah ugu soo bandhigay jadwalka tallaalka caadiga ah. Tallaalku wuxuu bartilmaameedsadaa gabdhaha hadda jira 10 sano iyo ka dib dhammaan gabdhaha marka ay gaaraan 10 sano @WHOKenya @UNICEFKenya #STOPCervicalCancer
Dholuo: Kenya en achiel kuom pinje matin mag Afrika ma oseketo thieth mar HPV ma onge chudo e chenro mag thieth ma pile pile. Chanjono ochung’ ne nyiri ma sani nigi higni 10 kendo bang’e ne nyiri duto ka gichopo higni 10

English: E-Citizen reminds the public in Mombasa County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this February.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen anakumbusha umma katika Mombasa County kwamba maoni juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma ni kuwakaribisha Februari hii.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Mombasa in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: E-Citizen oparo ne ji duto e County mar Mombasa ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mag siasa e dwe mar Februar.

English: TVET encourages residents of Garissa County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Garissa inay ka qaybgalaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada si ay uga warqabaan wareejinta.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Garissa mondo oriwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county mondo gibed molony e weche mag golo pesa.

English: Notice: KALRO restricts movement of poultry in Baringo County due to an anthrax outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO inazuia harakati za kuku katika Kaunti ya Baringo kwa sababu ya mlipuko wa kimeta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa digaagga Gobolka Baringo sababo la xiriira cudurka anthrax.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KALRO ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok e taon mar Baringo nikech tuwo mar anthrax.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will distribute certified cassava seed to farmers in Embu County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itasambaza mbegu za mihogo zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay abuuraha degmada Embu u qaybin doontaa abuurka cassava ee la caddeeyay bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro pogo kodhi mag cassava ne jopur e county mar Embu e dwe mar Mach.

English: HELB urges residents of Kericho County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from free primary education.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: HELB waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay iska diiwaangeliyaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo ji duto modak e gweng' mar Kericho mondo odonj e program mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo mondo giyud somo ma onge chudo.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will distribute certified maize seed to farmers in Samburu County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Wanyama itawapa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu mbegu zilizothibitishwa za mahindi mwezi Julai huu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa bishii Luulyo ee soo socota u qaybin doonta abuurka hadhuudhka ee la caddeeyay beeraleyda Gobolka Samburu.
Dholuo: Rieko: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro pogo kodhi mag mahinya ne jopur manie Samburu County e dwe mar Julai.

English: E-Citizen announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inatangaza nyakati bora za kugeuza kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay ka shaqeynta shahaadada dhalashada ee gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: E-Citizen lando lokruok e seche mag timo tij loso barua mag nyuol e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board restricts movement of sheep in Isiolo County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inazuia harakati za kondoo katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi wenye uvimbe.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Wax soo saarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka ayaa xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa idaha degmada Isiolo sababtuna tahay faafitaanka cudurka maqaarka.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok mag Pest ogeng'o wuoth mar rombe e gweng' mar Isiolo nikech tuwo moro mar dhoho.

English: Public health advisory: CDC warns of increased Rift Valley Fever risk in Kwale County and advises the public to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: CDC inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa katika Kaunti ya Kwale na inashauri umma kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Talobixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: CDC waxay ka digtay kororka halista Cudurka Rift Valley ee Gobolka Kwale waxayna ku talineysaa dadweynaha inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: CDC siemo ji kuom medruok mar tuwo mar Rift Valley Fever e county mar Kwale kendo osiemo ji mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni kodgi.

English: Register your child's birth early to secure legal identity and access to services.
Kiswahili: Sajili kuzaliwa kwa mtoto wako mapema ili kupata utambulisho halali na upatikanaji wa huduma.
Somali: Diiwaangeli dhalashada ilmahaaga goor hore si aad u hesho aqoonsi sharci ah iyo helitaanka adeegyada.
Dholuo: Ndiki nying nyuol mar nyathini mapiyo mondo iyud oboke mar chik kendo yudo kony.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission announces school feeding programme enrollment dates for schools in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa programu ya kulisha shule kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku dhawaaqay taariikhda diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiyada degmada Kwale.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj lando tarik mag dhi e skunde mag Kwale County.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises milk producers in Lamu County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inashauri wazalishaji wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.

Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa pesa ya rununu.

Kiswahili: IEBC inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.

Dholuo: IEBC jiwo joma okwongo yiero e kaunti mar Nakuru mondo onyis weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Kisii County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia laini ya bure ya EACC ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.

Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa za kuponda ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xayawaanka ah ee degmada Nakuru inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KEPHIS paronwa jopur mag jamni e gweng' mar Nakuru ni mondo gimi jamnigi thieth e kuonde moyier mag nego jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: Huduma Kenya urges eligible citizens in Taita-Taveta County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inahimiza wananchi wanaostahili katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Taita-Taveta inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya ojiwo jokanyo mag Taita-Taveta County mondo oriwre gi jogo madwaro donjo e tiegruok mar yiero.

Kiswahili: Sasisho la Hali ya Kenya | Desemba 2023: Kukagua Makubaliano ya Amani ya Jumuiya ya Maeneo Kama Njia Mbadala za Amani

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) invites residents of Nyandarua County to attend the public participation forum regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Guddiga Garsoorka Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) gwelo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenro mag dongruok.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Turkana County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kazini wakati wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana in ay guryahooda ku rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo shaqada inta lagu jiro xilliyada shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross parone jogweng' County mar Turkana mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi koda e tijegi e kinde masiche mag ndara.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Red Cross will be held in Makueni County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Makueni Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Makueni bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni kambi mar thieth ma Kenya Red Cross ochano ibiro tim e gweng' mar Makueni e dwe mar Novemba.

English: State Department for TVET conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Marsabit County this May.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Mei hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda gobolka ee degmada Marsabit bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi riwruok mar oganda e bajet mar county mar Marsabit County e dwe mar abich.

English: Youth Agenda empowers counties with active youth councils.
Kiswahili: Agenda ya Vijana inawezesha wilaya na baraza za vijana kazi.
Somali: Barnaamijka dhalinyarada wuxuu awood u siinayaa degmooyinka in ay leeyihiin gole dhalinyaro oo firfircoon.
Dholuo: Chenro mar Rowere miyo sirkande mag distrikt teko mar bedo gi bura matayo rowere.

English: Farmers are urged to review the proposed Crops Tea Industry Regulations 2020 which may negatively impact earnings and increase bureaucracy Take action by voicing concerns before implementation
Kiswahili: Wakulima wamehimizwa kupitia upya Kanuni za Sekta ya Chai ya Mazao ya 2020 zinazopendekezwa ambazo zinaweza kuathiri vibaya mapato na kuongeza urasimu Chukua hatua kwa kutoa hoja kabla ya utekelezaji.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay dib u eegaan Xeerarka Warshadaha Shaaha Dalagyada 2020 oo laga yaabo inay si xun u saameeyaan dakhliga isla markaana kordhin kara xafiisyada. Tallaabo qaado adigoo muujinaya walaac ka hor hirgelinta
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma loso puothe mag chamo chai, ma gin chamo cham kod puothe mag chamo chai, jiwo jopur mondo onon chike ma ne oketi e higa mar 2020 ma nyalo kelo yuto marach kendo medo loch mar sirkal.

English: Proper post-harvest handling is crucial for maintaining quality of sweet potatoes. Learn best practices for sorting, grading, and initial storage.
Kiswahili: Utunzaji sahihi wa baada ya mavuno ni muhimu kwa kudumisha ubora wa viazi vitamu. Jifunze mbinu bora za kupanga, kuweka alama na uhifadhi wa awali.
Somali: Si sax ah u qabashada goosashada kadib waa muhiim si loo ilaaliyo tayada baradho macaan. Baro habdhaqanka ugu wanaagsan ee kala soocidda, kala-soocidda iyo keydinta bilowga ah.
Dholuo: Puonjri kaka inyalo tigo maber ka ipogo cham kendo kaka inyalo kano cham e yo maber.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMSA will be held in Trans Nzoia County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMSA itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay KEMSA ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Trans Nzoia bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma KEMSA ochano ibiro tim e dwe mar Jun e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia.

English: FAO announces a free lumpy skin disease vaccination exercise for poultry in Mombasa County this February.
Kiswahili: FAO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa ngozi kwa kuku katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Februari hii.
Somali: FAO waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi lacag la'aan ah oo tallaal ah oo ku saabsan cudurka maqaarka ee digaagga ee gobolka Mombasa bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: FAO olando chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar dhoot e dwe mar Februar e county mar Mombasa.

English: KEMRI encourages mothers in Kisii County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kisii inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta caafimaad ee la qorsheeyay si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo mine manie Kisii County mondo odhi e odiechieng'no mar thieth mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission reminds citizens in Turkana County about their rights regarding voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuhusu haki zao kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu muwaadiniinta degmada Turkana ku xasuusinayaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj parone raia mag Turkana County ratiro ma gin-go mar ndiko joma oyiero.

English: Include all! Provide ramps and resources for disabled students.

Somali: Dhammaantood ka qaybqaada, ardayda naafada ah u siiya xarumo iyo kheyraad.
Dholuo: Mi jopuonjre ma nigi midekre thuolo mar dhi e skundno.

English: Ministry of Education reminds schools in Busia County to strengthen child protection in schools this January.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Busia kuimarisha ulinzi wa watoto shuleni Januari hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa dib u xasuusineysa dugsiyada degmada Busia inay xoojiyaan ilaalinta carruurta ee dugsiyada bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok parone skunde man Busia County mondo omed jiwo rit mar nyithindo e skunde e dwe mar Januar.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds residents of Kwale County that terracing improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba usafirishaji wa mimea huboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kwale in dhulka lagu beero uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service parone jogweng' Kwale County ni terracing miyo puothe dongo maber.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ee Gobolka Garissa.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura mar Kenya biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e kaunti mar Garissa.

English: Notice: KEMRI will hold a depression awareness forum in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this March. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI itafanya kongamano la uhamasishaji wa unyogovu katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Machi hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay qaban doontaa madasha wacyiga dhimirka ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet bishii Maarso. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMRI biro timo chokruok mar chiwo paro e wi tuwo mar depression e taon mar Elgeyo-Marakwet e dwe mar Mach.

English: Marsabit County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for December 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Marsabit: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Desemba 2023
Somali: Degmada Marsabit: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Diseembar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Marsabit: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2023

English: NTSA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Meru County that access to the GBV toll-free helpline is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Meru kwamba upatikanaji wa simu ya GBV ya bure ya msaada unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee degmada Meru in helitaanka khadka caawimaadda ee GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah uu yahay mid lacag-la'aan ah.
Dholuo: NTSA parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e County mar Meru ni gibiro yudo kony ma onge chudo mar GBV maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges motorists and pedestrians in Kirinyaga County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa gawaarida iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Kirinyaga inay u hoggaansamaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Forest Service jiwo derebe kod joma wuotho gi tiendegi e gweng' mar Kirinyaga mondo oluw chike mag golo ji moa kuonde ma ji odakie mondo gikwed masiche ma timore nikech ataro.

English: To store potatoes longer without them rotting or drying out, layer them with sawdust in a store (alternating layers of sawdust and potatoes, starting and ending with sawdust). The sawdust must be kept moist but not too wet - too dry and the potatoes shrivel and attract pests, too wet and they rot.
Kiswahili: Ili kuhifadhi viazi kwa muda mrefu bila kuoza au kukauka, ziweke na machujo ya mbao kwenye duka (tabaka zinazopishana za machujo ya mbao na viazi, kuanzia na kuishia na machujo ya mbao). Machujo ya mbao lazima yawekwe unyevu lakini sio mvua sana - kavu sana na viazi hunyauka na kuvutia wadudu, mvua sana na huoza.
Somali: Si baradhada loo kaydiyo muddo dheer iyada oo aysan qalamaynin ama u qalajin, ku rid lakabyo alwaax ah dukaanka (lakabyo isdaba joog ah oo alwaax iyo baradho ah, ka bilaab oo ku dhammaato boodka alwaaxda). Boodka alwaaxda waa in la qoyanaa laakiin aan aad u qoyan - aad u qalalan baradhadana way qalalan tahay oo cayayaanka soo jiitaan, aad bay u qoyan yihiin, way qudhmaanayaan.
Dholuo: Mondo kik ng'ato kethre kata kik oyudi, nyaka okan cham gi yien e duka moro (tiende ni, ng'ato ka ng'ato nyaka ketie yien e wi ot machielo, kochakore gi yien e ot machielo kendo bang'e otieko gi yien e ot machielo).

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) calls on parents in Homa Bay County to have children under five screened for meningitis during the June outreach.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa ugonjwa wa uti wa mgongo wakati wa ufikiaji wa Juni.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta gobolka Homa Bay in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro meningitis intii lagu jiray bisha Juun.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) kwayo jonyuol e Homa Bay County mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Jun.

English: USDA promotes regenerative agriculture for livestock to enhance soil health.
Kiswahili: USDA inakuza kilimo cha kuzaliwa upya kwa mifugo ili kuimarisha afya ya udongo.
Somali: USDA waxay dhiirrigelisaa beeraha dib-u-soo-nooleynta xoolaha si loo horumariyo caafimaadka ciidda.
Dholuo: USDA jiwo tij chwoyo jamni mondo omi lowo obed gi ngima maber.

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Mombasa County that access to childhood immunization is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba upatikanaji wa chanjo ya utotoni ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Mombasa in helitaanka tallaalka carruurta ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Mombasa ni yudo thieth mar nyithindo en gima onge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Embu County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu in si dhakhso leh u soo sheegaan dhac ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NTSA parone jogweng' mar Embu County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo odno konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: KTDA urges rice growers in Trans Nzoia County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda bariiska ee degmada Trans Nzoia inay si hore u xakameeyaan ciidanka dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaanka la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur ma pidho kodhi e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e kinde machuok.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will distribute certified rice seed to farmers in Isiolo County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu za mchele zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa bishii Maarso u qeybin doona abuurka bariiska ee shahaadooyinka leh beeraleyda ku nool degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Dairy Board biro pogo kodhi mag loso kodhi ne jopur manie Isiolo County e dwe mar Mach.

English: Kenya: IPC Food Security & Malnutrition Snapshot - Acute Food Insecurity: July 2023 - January 2024; Acute Malnutrition: April - October 2023
Kiswahili: Kenya: Usalama wa Chakula na Utapiamlo wa IPC - Uhaba Mkali wa Chakula: Julai 2023 - Januari 2024; Utapiamlo Mkali: Aprili - Oktoba 2023
Somali: Kenya: Sawir-qaadis Amniga Cuntada iyo Nafaqada ee IPC - Amniga Cuntada ee Ba'an: Luulyo 2023 - Janaayo 2024; Nafaqo-xumada Ba'an: Abriil - Oktoobar 2023
Dholuo: Kenya: Picha mar Rieko mar Chiemo kod Chiemo ma Ok Owinjore - Rieko mar Chiemo mager: Julaini 2023 - dwe mar achiel 2024; Chiemo ma oromo: Ang'wen - Oktoba 2023

English: KEPHIS urges farmers in Bungoma County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Bungoma inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo lagu soo ururiyo biyaha beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e kaunti mar Bungoma mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: Pest Control Products Board promotes terracing among farmers in Laikipia County as part of the April climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inakuza usafirishaji kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Aprili.
Somali: Guddiga Waxsoosaarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa beeraleyda ku nool degmada Laikipia iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka adkeysiga cimilada ee Abriil.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok mag Pest jiwo jopur e County mar Laikipia kaka achiel kuom chenro mar April mar kedo gi lokruok e kor lwasi.

English: Digital tools can be a gamechanger for both small-scale farmers and sustainable food systems as a whole.
Kiswahili: Zana za kidijitali zinaweza kuwa mabadiliko makubwa kwa wakulima wadogo na mifumo endelevu ya chakula kwa ujumla.
Somali: Qalabka dhijitaalka ah wuxuu noqon karaa ciyaar-beddelayaal labadaba beeraleyda yaryar iyo nidaamyada cuntada ee caadiga ah.
Dholuo: Gik ma nyalo konyo e loso chiemo nyalo kelo lokruok e ngima jopur matindo koda e ngima ji duto.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Kericho County to attend the public participation forum to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay ka qayb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si loo qaabeeyo dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kericho mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto ma biro timo nonro mar tich higa ka higa.

English: Wearing a face mask correctly can help prevent the spread of #COVID19 to others. Take action to slow the spread of #COVID19 by wearing a face mask in public, correctly. #KomeshaCorona update.
Kiswahili: Kuvaa barakoa kwa njia ipasavyo kunaweza kusaidia kuzuia kuenea kwa #COVID19 kwa wengine. Chukua hatua kupunguza kasi ya kuenea kwa #COVID19 kwa kuvaa barakoa hadharani, ipasavyo. #KomeshaCorona sasisho.
Somali: Xirashada maaskaro wejiga si sax ah waxay gacan ka geysan kartaa ka hortagga faafitaanka #COVID19 ee dadka kale. Qaado tallaabo si aad u yareyso faafitaanka #COVID19 adigoo si sax ah u xirata maaskaro wejiga meel fagaare ah. #KomeshaCorona update.
Dholuo: Rwako mask mar wang' makare nyalo konyo geng'o landruok mar #COVID19 ne ji mamoko. Tim okang' mar geng'o lalruok mar #COVID19 kuom rwako mask mar wang' e nyim ji, e yoo makare. #KomeshaKorona ma manyien.

English: Learn how Thailand's "Merit Maker" DrowningPrevention strategy brought down drowning deaths in children under 15 by 67% since 2006. WorldDrowningPreventionDay
Kiswahili: Jifunze jinsi Mbinu ya Thailand ya 'Merit Maker' ya Kuzuia Kuzama Majini ilivyopunguza vifo vya watoto chini ya miaka 15 kwa 67% tangu mwaka 2006.
Somali: Baro sida "Sameeyaha Mudan" ee Thailand ee Qarqidda Istaraatiijiyadda ka hortagga hoos u dhigtay dhimashada qarqidda ee carruurta ka yar 15 sano 67% tan iyo 2006. Maalinta Ka Hortagga Qarqidda Adduunka
Dholuo: Fweny kaka yo mar piny Thailand mar geng’o ng’anjo e pi nomiyo tho mag nyithindo ma hikgi pok ochopo 15 odok piny gi 67% chakre higa mar 2006.

English: Farmers can now save share and exchange indigenous seeds without fear of criminal penalties This ruling supports traditional farming practices vital for food security and livelihoods
Kiswahili: Wakulima sasa wanaweza kuhifadhi hisa na kubadilishana mbegu za kienyeji bila kuogopa adhabu ya jinai Uamuzi huu unaunga mkono mila na desturi za ukulima muhimu kwa usalama wa chakula na maisha.
Somali: Beeraleydu hadda waxay kaydsan karaan, la wadaagi karaan oo isweydaarsan karaan abuurka asaliga ah iyagoo aan ka baqin ciqaab dambiyeed. Xukunkan wuxuu taageerayaa hababka beeraleyda dhaqameed ee muhiimka u ah amniga cuntada iyo nolosha
Dholuo: Jo-Purie sani nyalo keto pachgi e choko kod loko kodhi ma gin - go maok giluor yudo kum mag buch tho

English: The IEBC urges the public to report any incidents of ahead of the upcoming to strengthen governance.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza umma kuripoti matukio yoyote kabla ya wakati ujao ili kuimarisha utawala.
Somali: IEBC waxay dadweynaha ugu baaqeysaa inay soo sheegaan wixii dhacdooyin ah ee soo socda si loo xoojiyo maamulka.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot e wi gik moko duto mabiro timore e kinde mabiro mondo gimed bedo gi loch maber.

English: DPP calls on residents of Nyamira County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DPP inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: DPP waxay dadka deggan degmada Nyamira ugu baaqeysaa inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga dhaqdhaqaaqyo aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal aagagga xuduudka ah si ay u taageeraan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: DPP okwayo jogweng' mar Nyamira County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal mag sirkandno ni gitimo gik maok kare e gwenge man machiegni gi tong'gi mondo gikony e loso kuwe e piny.

English: KEMSA encourages residents of Murang'a County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay u dhiiri galiyaan saaxiibo dhibaataysan inay caawimaad raadsadaan.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo ji modak e County mar Murang'a mondo kik gisandre aling'a kendo mondo gijiw osiepgi moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: Notice: NDMA activates an emergency response plan for flooding in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ku saabsan fatahaadaha Gobolka Mandera.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NDMA tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne pi opong'o gweng' mar Mandera.

English: NTSA reminds the public in Kericho County to remain vigilant on counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: NTSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kericho in ay sii joogaan feejignaanta ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: NTSA parone ji duto e County mar Kericho ni mondo gisik ka girito weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: The youth are our center of the fight against this disease. It is a journey that requires the youth to take responsibility, Observe and be part of the solution to fight CoVid 19 and ensure physical distance is being observed... #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Vijana ndio kitovu chetu cha mapambano dhidi ya ugonjwa huu. Ni safari inayohitaji vijana kuwajibika, Kuzingatia na kuwa sehemu ya suluhisho la kupambana na Covid 19 na kuhakikisha umbali wa mwili unazingatiwa... #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Dhallinyaradu waa xaruntayada la dagaallanka cudurkan. Waa safar u baahan in dhallinyaradu ay mas'uuliyad qaadaan, ay fiiro gaar ah u yeeshaan oo ay qayb ka noqdaan xalka lagula dagaallamayo Covid-19 isla markaana ay hubiyaan in la ilaalinayo masaafada jireed... #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Joma tindo gin jogo ma wan-go e lweny mar kedo kod tuo mar kansa. En wuoth ma dwaro ni joma tindo okaw ting', Orang' kendo obed achiel kuom gik ma nyalo konyo e kedo gi tuwo mar CoVid 19 kendo neno ni ji luwo thuolo mar ng'ado bura... #KomeshaCorona

English: Smartphone adoption among traders in Kenya and Uganda, March 2022
Kiswahili: Kupitishwa kwa simu mahiri miongoni mwa wafanyabiashara nchini Kenya na Uganda, Machi 2022
Somali: Ganacsatada Kenya iyo Uganda oo qaatay taleefannada casriga ah, Maarso 2022
Dholuo: Tiyo gi simu mariek e kind jo ohala e piny Kenya kod Uganda, dwe mar Adek 2022

English: Judiciary of Kenya invites residents of Garissa County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Garissa inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya gwelo joma odak e county mar Garissa mondo oriwre gi county's online participation portal kaluwore gi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: Judiciary of Kenya announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la hagaajiyay waqtiga wareejinta codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee Gobolka Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya olando lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mar yudo ng'eyono e gweng' mar Kirinyaga.

English: Notice: DCI conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Vihiga County this September.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga mwezi huu wa Septemba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ku saabsan ka hortagga argagixisada ee degmada Vihiga bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni DCI timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu e County mar Vihiga e dwe mar Septemba.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges parents and teachers in Homa Bay County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta gobolka Homa Bay inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e Homa Bay County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto.

English: Notice: NPS activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NPS inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay shilalka waddooyinka ee gobolka Mombasa.
Dholuo: Rapar: NPS tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne masiche ma timore e nderni e County mar Mombasa.

English: KTDA announces a free lumpy skin disease vaccination exercise for pigs in Kericho County this September.
Kiswahili: KTDA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa ngozi kwa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Kericho Septemba hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay doofaarka ee gobolka Kericho bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: KTDA olando chenro mar goyo tugo mar thieth mar tuoche mag dhoho ma ok ochuno ne jamni e County mar Kericho e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Farmers are urged to report any sightings of migratory and invasive pests to local authorities to aid in pest management efforts Your timely reporting is crucial for the protection of crops and livelihoods
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kuripoti matukio yoyote ya wadudu wanaohama na kuvamia kwa mamlaka za mitaa ili kusaidia katika juhudi za kudhibiti wadudu Kuripoti kwako kwa wakati ni muhimu kwa ulinzi wa mazao na maisha.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay u soo sheegaan maamulada deegaanka aragtida kasta ee cayayaanka socdaalka iyo kuwa soo galootiga ah si ay uga caawiyaan dadaallada xakamaynta cayayaanka Warbixintaada waqtigeeda waa mid muhiim u ah ilaalinta dalagyada iyo nolosha
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur mondo onyis sirkal ma kama gibiro e piny ni giseneno kit kute ma kelo tuoche kod mag wuoth ma dhi e pinje mamoko mondo okonygi loyo tuoche ma kamago.

English: Notice: NCPB will distribute certified wheat seed to farmers in Baringo County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itasambaza mbegu za ngano zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Baringo Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay u qaybin doontaa abuurka sarreenka ee la caddeeyay beeraleyda degmada Baringo bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NCPB biro pogo kodhi mag ngano ne jopur man Baringo County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: IPOA conducts a community briefing on community early-warning systems in Homa Bay County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay mwezi huu wa Septemba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada oo ku saabsan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada ee gobolka Homa Bay bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA timo romo mar chiwo siem ne oganda e wi chenro mag chiwo siem chon e Homa Bay County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds voters in Meru County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Meru kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu xusuusinayaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Meru inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor taariikhda doorashada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General parone jogweng' Meru mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar timo yiero kapok tarik mar yiero ochopo.

English: National Drought Early Warning Bulletin (April 2024)
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Tahadhari ya Mapema ya Kitaifa (Aprili 2024)
Somali: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Qaranka (Abriil 2024)
Dholuo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro (dwe mar Ang'wen 2024)

English: TSC reminds schools in Laikipia County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this January.
Kiswahili: TSC inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Januari hii.
Somali: TSC waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Laikipia inay xoojiyaan adeegyada hagista iyo la-talinta bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: TSC paronwa skunde e County mar Laikipia mondo omed jiwo kendo chiwo kony e dwe mar Januar.

English: KRA reminds the public in Trans Nzoia County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Trans Nzoia in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid bilaash ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: KRA paronwa ji duto e Trans Nzoia County ni lando wach tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'.
