English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds livestock keepers in Nandi County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Nandi inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska xoolaha ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service paronwa jorit jamni e county mar Nandi ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: Notice: e-Citizen launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Samburu County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Samburu Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: e-Citizen waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa gobolka Samburu bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Par ane: e-Citizen chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e county mar Samburu e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will hold a trauma counselling forum in Kisumu County this March. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitafanya kongamano la ushauri wa kiwewe katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Machi hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa qaban doonta madasha la talinta dhaawaca ee degmada Kisumu bishii Maarso. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Rapar: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo chokruok mar chiwo paro e wi tuoche e Kisumu County e dwe mar Mach. Ji duto mor.

English: IRC: Severe drought is projected to leave about 5.4 million people in Kenya without adequate access to food and water between March and June 2023
Kiswahili: IRC: Ukame mkali unatarajiwa kuacha takriban watu milioni 5.4 nchini Kenya bila kupata chakula na maji ya kutosha kati ya Machi na Juni 2023.
Somali: IRC: Abaar daran ayaa la saadaalinayaa inay ka tagi doonto qiyaastii 5.4 milyan oo qof oo ku nool Kenya iyagoon haysan cunto iyo biyo ku filan inta u dhaxaysa Maarso iyo Juun 2023
Dholuo: IRC: Igeno ni oro mager biro miyo ji madirom milion 5.4 e piny Kenya bedo maonge gi chiemo kod pi moromo e kind dwe mar adek gi dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2023

English: Public health advisory: KEMRI warns of increased Rift Valley Fever risk in Nyandarua County and advises the public to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMRI inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua na inashauri umma kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa.
Somali: Talobixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: KEMRI waxay ka digtay kororka halista Cudurka Rift Valley ee Gobolka Nyandarua waxayna ku talineysaa dadweynaha inay dhammaystiraan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: KEMRI chiwo siem kuom medruok mar tuwo mar Rift Valley Fever e County mar Nyandarua kendo ojiwo ji duto mondo otiek dose duto mar thiedho.

English: Ministry of Education reminds needy students in Mandera County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba vitabu vya kiada na matumizi ya vifaa vya kujifunzia hufungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Mandera in dalabka buugaagta iyo qalabka wax lagu barto uu dhowaan soo gabagabeyn doono.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok parone jopuonjre man Mandera County ni buk mag somo kod weche mag somo biro rumo machiegni.

English: Notice: NDMA conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Samburu County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Samburu Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada oo ku saabsan dhismaha nabadda qaranka ee Gobolka Samburu bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA timo romo mar oganda e wi loso kuwe e gweng' mar Samburu e dwe mar Februar.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development announces distribution of revision guides to schools in Kisumu County this August.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yatangaza usambazaji wa miongozo ya marekebisho kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Agosti hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka ayaa ku dhawaaqay in bishii Agoosto ay u qaybiyaan buugaagta dib u eegista dugsiyada degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag somo e skunde man Kisumu County e dwe mar Agost.

English: KTDA advises farmers in Lamu County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Lamu inay keenaan lambarrada diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qaybqaataan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e County mar Lamu mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: NTSA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Wajir County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NTSA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuripoti kesi kwenye dawati la karibu la jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Wajir inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e gweng' mar Wajir mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: NTSA warns residents of Embu County to prepare for possible drought this March.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kujiandaa kwa ukame unaowezekana Machi hii.
Somali: NTSA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay u diyaar garoobaan abaaraha iman kara bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: NTSA osiemo jogweng' Embu County mondo oikre ne oro ma nyalo betie e dwe mar Mach.

English: TSC advises applicants in Nyeri County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: TSC inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: TSC waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Nyeri inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: TSC nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e County mar Nyeri ni gidonj e skundgi kapok ichopo e chokruok mabiro.

English: Ministry of ICT runs national digital literacy awareness campaigns targeting parents and caregivers.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya ICT inaendesha kampeni za kitaifa za ufahamu wa uandishi wa dijiti kwa wazazi na walezi.
Somali: Wasaaradda ICT waxay wadashaqeyn ku sameyneysaa ololeyo wacyi galineed oo ku saabsan akhriska dhijitaalka ah oo loogu talagalay waalidiinta iyo daryeelayaasha.
Dholuo: Ministry of ICT tiyo gi chenro mar lando wach somo kod somo e yore mag digital e piny mangima ka giketo pachgi kuom jonyuol kod jogo makonyogi.

English: KEMSA appeals to caregivers in Busia County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the October maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Busia kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Oktoba.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Busia inay ilmahooda u keenaan kormeerka koritaanka iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KEMSA okwayo jorit e county mar Busia mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongruok kaka achiel kuom chenro mar October Maternal Health drive.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds residents of Tharaka-Nithi County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette parone jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County ni luwo dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: IPOA warns residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to prepare for possible drought this June.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kujiandaa kwa ukame unaowezekana Juni hii.
Somali: IPOA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay isu diyaariyaan abaaraha iman kara bisha Juun.
Dholuo: IPOA osiemo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oikre ne oro ma nyalo betie e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will distribute certified sweet potatoes seed to farmers in Marsabit County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itasambaza mbegu za viazi vitamu zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu abuurka baradho macaan ee shahaado leh u qaybin doonaa beeraleyda degmada Marsabit bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro pogo kodhi mag le mamit ne jopur man Marsabit County e dwe mar abich.

English: CDC advises residents of Garissa County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: CDC inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: CDC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Garissa inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun iyo biyo nadiif ah si joogto ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Garissa mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the public in Nakuru County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Nakuru wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa shacabka degmada Nakuru inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN ee M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada lacagta mobilada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Communications Authority jiwo ji duto e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo ripode mag wuondo pesa e simo.

English: KEPHIS reminds residents of Kitui County that water harvesting improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba uvunaji wa maji unaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kitui in goosashada biyaha ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: KEPHIS paronwa jogweng' Kitui County ni choko pi kelo nyak e puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: KUCCPS urges residents of Narok County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kutuma maombi ya bursari kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Narok inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo ji duto modak Narok County mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud somo mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds livestock keepers in Migori County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Migori kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Migori inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jopur mag jamni e county mar Migori ni gimi jamnigi thieth e kuonde moketi mag chamo jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: DPP reminds residents of Kajiado County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: DPP anawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado in warbixinta degdegga ah ee xanta xoolaha ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: DPP oparo ne jogweng' Kajiado County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo jamni konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Bomet County to avoid contact with contaminated water sources following a rise in reported meningitis cases.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya homa ya uti wa mgongo.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay ka fogaadaan inay la xiriiraan ilo biyo oo wasakheysan ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska meningitis ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' County mar Bomet mondo kik giriwre gi kuonde ma pi yudoree nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuwo mar meningitis osemedore.

English: 2,169 people test positive for COVID-19 from 9,428 samples, positivity rate at 23pc; MoH says no death recorded
Kiswahili: Watu 2,169 wamepatikana na virusi vya COVID-19 kutoka kwa sampuli 9,428, kiwango cha walioambukizwa kikiwa asilimia 23; Wizara ya Afya yasema hakuna kifo kilichorekodiwa
Somali: 2,169 qof ayaa laga helay COVID-19 9,428 muunad, heerka cudurka ayaa ahaa 23 boqolkiiba; Wasiirka Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa sheegay in aan la diiwaangelin dhimashada
Dholuo: Ji 2,169 ne onwang'o ni gin gi tuwo mar COVID-19 kuom nonro 9,428 ma ne otim, kwan mar joma nigi tuwo mar Covid-19 ne en pasent 23; Ministry of Health wacho ni onge tho moro amora ma nonenore

English: DPP reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Nyeri County that access to psychosocial support is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisaikolojia unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee degmada Nyeri in helitaanka taageerada cilmu-nafsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e County mar Nyeri ni ginyalo yudo kony maonge chudo.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will conduct a post-harvest handling workshop for farmers in Bomet County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi ka dib goosashada beeraleyda gobolka Bomet bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro timo tiegruok mar rito puodho bang' keyo ne jopur e County mar Bomet e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Announcement that faltering of the mind due to use of drinks that affect the body, care at work places and continuing awareness to media people by use ofâ€¦???
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwamba kupoteza akili kutokana na matumizi ya vinywaji vinavyoathiri mwili, utunzaji wa mahali pa kazi na kuendelea ufahamu kwa watu wa vyombo vya habari kwa kutumia...???
Somali: Ku dhawaaqid in maskaxda oo leexata ay sabab u tahay isticmaalka cabitaannada saameeya jirka, daryeelka goobaha shaqada iyo wacyigelinta joogtada ah ee dadka warbaahinta iyadoo la isticmaalayo…
Dholuo: Onyiso ni ng'ato nyalo ng'ado paro nikech tiyo kod math ma ketho ringruok, rito e kuonde tich kod dhi nyime gi ng'eyo ne jo media kuom tiyo kodâ€¦???

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) updates residents of Siaya County on progress of the county integrated development plan this November.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja ya kaunti hii mwezi Novemba.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Siaya u wargeliyay horumarka qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada bisha November.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chiwo ripot ne jogweng' County mar Siaya kuom dongruok mar chenro mar dongruok mar county e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Over the last 24 hours we have tested over 300 Kenyans, out of those 22 have tested positive for covid-19 (13-males, 9-females). 21 out of the 22 cases are people who are currently in quarantine
Kiswahili: Katika saa 24 zilizopita tumewapima Wakenya zaidi ya 300, kati ya hao 22 wamepimwa na kukutwa na virusi vya covid-19 (wanaume 13, wanawake 9). Visa 21 kati ya 22 ni watu ambao kwa sasa wako karantini.
Somali: 24kii saac ee la soo dhaafay waxaan tijaabinay in ka badan 300 oo reer Kenya ah, kuwaas oo 22 ka mid ah ay u muuqdaan kuwo COVID-19 ah (13 lab, 9 dumar ah). 21 ka mida 22 kiis ayaa ah dadka hadda ku jira karantiil
Dholuo: Kuom seche 24 mosekalo, wasetimo nonro kuom Jo-Kenya mokalo 300, kuom jogo 22 osenwang'o ni gin gi tuo mar COVID-19 (13- chwo, 9- mon).

English: DCI urges residents of Vihiga County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: DCI inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Vihiga mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gweng'no e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi kuom rito tong'.

English: Rebuilding Kenya Stronger: Here's What's Needed to Rebound After Catastrophic Floods
Kiswahili: Kuijenga Kenya Imara Zaidi: Hiki ndicho Kinachohitajika ili Kurudi Baada ya Mafuriko
Somali: Dib-u-dhiska Kenya oo Xoog Badan: Waa kuwan waxa loo baahan yahay si dib loogu soo kabto ka dib daadadkii Musiibada ahaa
Dholuo: Gigero Piny Kenya kendo Motegno: Mae e Gima Dwarore Mondo Obed gi Teko Bang’ Pi Ma Opong’o Pi

English: Kenya Turkana County - General Reference Map (09/11/2023)
Kiswahili: Kenya Kaunti ya Turkana - Ramani ya Marejeleo ya Jumla (09/11/2023)
Somali: Gobolka Turkana ee Kenya - Khariidadda Tixraaca Guud (09/11/2023)
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kenya - Map mar Duto Maduong' (11/09/2023)

English: KMTC conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Laikipia County this September.
Kiswahili: KMTC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Septemba hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda gobolka ee Gobolka Laikipia bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: KMTC dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi riwruok mar oganda e bajet mar county e county mar Laikipia e dwe mar Septemba.

English: KALRO urges coffee growers in Kericho County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Kericho kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Kericho inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e gweng' mar Kericho mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue mondo omed kelo nyak e higani.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development urges parents and teachers in Machakos County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada Waxbarashada wuxuu ku boorinayaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta Degmada Machakos inay u soo sheegaan maamulka iskuulka wixii arrimo ah oo ku saabsan amniga.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County ma Machakos mondo onyis jotelo mag skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok.

English: NCPB urges maize growers in Busia County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Busia kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Busia inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si loo wanaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur ma pidho cham e gweng' mar Busia mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo okony e medo nyak mar cham e higani.

English: TVETA reported a 10.4 percent increase in TVET enrollment to 709885 students with Eldoret National Polytechnic leading at 7.9 percent.
Kiswahili: TVETA iliripoti ongezeko la asilimia 10.4 katika usajili wa TVET kwa wanafunzi 70,9885 na Eldoret National Polytechnic kuongoza kwa asilimia 7.9.
Somali: TVETA waxay soo sheegtay kororka 10.4 boqolkiiba ee diiwaangelinta TVET ilaa 709885 arday iyadoo Eldoret National Polytechnic ay hormuud u tahay 7.9 boqolkiibo.
Dholuo: TVETA nowacho ni kwan mar jopuonjre ma ne odonjo e tiegruok mar TVET nomedore gi pasent 10.4 mochopo 70,9885 ka Eldoret National Polytechnic ne nigi pasent 7.9.

English: KICD invites youth in Uasin Gishu County to enroll for ICT skills training this June.
Kiswahili: KICD inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT Juni hii.
Somali: KICD waxay ku casuumaysaa dhalinyarada degmada Uasin Gishu inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka xirfadaha ICT bisha Juun.
Dholuo: KICD gwelo rowere manie Uasin Gishu County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar ICT e dwe mar Jun.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) announces SHA registration for residents of Nakuru County starting this April.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatangaza usajili wa SHA kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kuanzia Aprili hii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa ku dhawaaqday diiwaangelinta SHA ee dadka deggan degmada Nakuru laga bilaabo Abriil.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) olando chenro mar SHA mar kwayo joma odak e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo odonj e skundno kochakore dwe mar April.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) announces eye and dental camps for residents of Lamu County starting this September.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatangaza kambi za macho na meno kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kuanzia Septemba hii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa ku dhawaaqday xeryo indhaha iyo ilkaha loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Lamu laga bilaabo Sebtember.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) ogolo kambi mag thieth mag wang' kod lak mag lak mag ji ma odak e County mar Lamu kochakore Septemba.

English: GESI in WASH Capacity Statement
Kiswahili: GESI katika Taarifa ya Uwezo wa WASH
Somali: Bayaanka Awoodda Biyaha ee GESI
Dholuo: GESI e Wash mar nyalo mar WASH

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free Rift Valley Fever screening is available at all public health centres in Kiambu County this March.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Machi hii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka bilaashka ah ee Rift Valley Fever laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynta ee degmada Kiambu bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji ni nonro mar Rift Valley Fever maonge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Kiambu e dwe mar Mach.

English: FAO urges maize growers in Kiambu County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawataka wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Kiambu inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagyada si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda si loo hagaajiyo goosashada xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma pidho cham e gweng' mar Kiambu mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: ODPP urges residents of Samburu County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kuwasiliana na msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waendelee kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja ya kaunti.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Samburu inay la xiriiraan maamulaha qaybta maxalliga ah si ay uga warqabaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogweng' county mar Samburu mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jotelo mag gwenge ma gidakie mondo ging'e chenro mar dongruok mar county.

Dholuo: Chenro mar AgriBiz oseyiero chakruok 200 kod ohala mag agro e okang ' mokwongo mag konyruok Ohala mag agro ma owinjore onego oket kwayo mag yudo thuolo mag yudo kony kuom pesa ma romo bilion Kshs 22 2

Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi mpango unaoendelea wa mafunzo ya mbinu za umwagiliaji.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Kajiado County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges farmers in Trans Nzoia County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.

English: Kenya among 12 African countries to get 18 million doses of malaria vaccine by 2025, WHO says priority will go to countries with the greatest need.

English: AFA invites farmers in Meru County to a free training on greenhouse farming this September.
Kiswahili: AFA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo cha chafu Septemba hii.
Somali: AFA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Meru tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: AFA gwelo jopur e county mar Meru e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar yien e dwe mar Septemba.

English: TVET advises students in Garissa County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Garissa kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Somali: TVET waxay ardayda degmada Garissa kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga deeqda waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan deeq waxbarasho oo loogu talagalay ardayda u baahan.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jopuonjre e County mar Garissa mondo oketgi e intanet mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo chiwo mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre mochando.

English: NDMA reminds the public in Tharaka-Nithi County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kubaki macho juu ya ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: NDMA waxay dadka degmada Tharaka-Nithi xasuusineysaa inay ka feejignaadaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: NDMA oparo ne ji duto e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo gibed motang' ne loso kuwe e piny.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMSA will be held in Nyamira County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMSA itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay KEMSA ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Nyamira bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma KEMSA ochano ibiro tim e dwe mar Jun e kaunti mar Nyamira.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development informs avocado farmers in Wajir County of new market linkage opportunities this September.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inafahamisha wakulima wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Wajir juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Septemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay beeraleyda avocado ee Gobolka Wajir ka wargelineysaa fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development nyiso jopur mag avocado e County mar Wajir thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Septemba.

English: FAO urges wheat growers in Vihiga County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawataka wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda sarreenka ee degmada Vihiga inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagyada si loo soo celiyo miraha ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur mag ngano e County mar Vihiga mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds expectant mothers in Kajiado County that access to skilled birth attendance is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kwamba upatikanaji wa mahudhurio ya uzazi wa ujuzi ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Kajiado in helitaanka daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfadlayaasha ah ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne mine ma biro nyuolo nyithindo e Kajiado County ni thuolo mar yudo nyithindo ma nigi lony en maonge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: Kenya's Journey Towards Protecting Children: A Decade of Change (2010-2019)
Kiswahili: Safari ya Kenya Kuelekea Kuwalinda Watoto: Muongo wa Mabadiliko (2010-2019)
Somali: Safarka Kenya ee ku wajahan Ilaalinta Carruurta: Toban sano oo isbeddel ah (2010-2019)
Dholuo: Wuoth mar piny Kenya mar rito nyithindo: Higni Apar mag Lokruok (2010-2019)

English: Lamu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Lamu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Mei 2023
Somali: Degmada Lamu: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Lamu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar abich 2023

English: OGP urges eligible citizens in Wajir County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Wajir kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Wajir inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jokanyo mowinjore e county mar Wajir mondo oriwgi e kwedo josiasa.

English: Its not unmanly to struggle.Check on the men in your life.
Kiswahili: Si jambo la kiume kujitahidi. Waangalie wanaume katika maisha yako.
Somali: Ma aha wax aan ragga ahayn in la dagaallamo. Fiiri ragga noloshaada ku jira.
Dholuo: Ok en gima rach mondo ng'ato oked. Non ane chwo manie ngimani.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Embu County this March. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitafanya kongamano la kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Embu Machi hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka soo kabashada isticmaalka maandooriyaha ee Gobolka Embu bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni Kenya Medical Association biro timo chokruok mar chango joma otiyo gi yedhe mamero e dwe mar Mach e county mar Embu.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi za Utafiti wa Jinai zinawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dambiyada wuxuu ugu baaqay dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyadoo si weyn loo fiirsanayo amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations ojiwo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'adoe bura e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom weche mag rito tong'.

English:
By recognizing the humanity of individuals with mental illnesses, we can cultivate a more compassionate and understanding society.
If you or someone you know needs psychosocial support, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at our toll-free number, 1199
Kiswahili:
Kwa kutambua ubinadamu wa watu wenye magonjwa ya akili, tunaweza kukuza jamii yenye huruma na uelewa zaidi.

Ikiwa wewe au mtu unayemjua anahitaji usaidizi wa kisaikolojia, tafadhali usisite kuwasiliana nasi kwa nambari yetu ya simu isiyolipishwa, 1199.
Somali: Marka aan aqoonsano bani'aadamnimada shakhsiyaadka qaba cudurrada maskaxda, waxaan horumarin karnaa bulsho naxariis iyo faham badan. Haddii adiga ama qof aad taqaanid u baahan tahay taageero maskaxeed, fadlan ha ka waaban inaad nala soo xiriirto lambarkayaga lacag la'aanta ah, 1199
Dholuo: Ka wang'eyo kaka joma nigi tuoche mag obwongo chalo, wanyalo bedo gi chuny mar kecho ji kendo winjo pachgi maber. Kapo ni in kata ng'at ming'eyo dwaro kony kuom weche mag pach ji, kik iluor tudori kodwa gi namba mar 1199 maonge chudo.

English: The effects of substance use on the mental health of women can be influenced by various biological factors
Kiswahili: Athari za matumizi ya dawa za kulevya juu ya afya ya akili ya wanawake zinaweza kuathiriwa na mambo mbalimbali ya kibiolojia
Somali: Saameynta isticmaalka maadooyinka caafimaadka maskaxda ee haweenka waxaa saameyn ku yeelan kara arrimo kala duwan oo bayoolaji ah
Dholuo: Weche mopogore opogore mag ngima dhano nyalo chiko kaka tiyo gi yedhe mamero miyo dhako bedo gi paro mowinjore.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inafungua maombi ya maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu u furayaa codsiyada waxbarashada bilaashka ah ee dhijitaalka ah ee ardayda ku nool gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oyawo kwayo mag somo maonge chudo mar digital ne jopuonjre man Uasin Gishu County.

English: DCI alerts residents of Meru County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Somali: DCI waxay dadka deggan degmada Meru uga digtay kororka kiisaska gaadiidka la xaday waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar County mar Meru kuom wach medruok mar wuondo mtokni kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag ritruok gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Notice: DCI launches a fraud prevention campaign in Nairobi County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga khiyaamooyinka degmada Nairobi bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: DCI chako kampen mar geng'o wuondruok e taon mar Nairobi e dwe mar Agost.

English: Kenya has issued a warning on a bad mosquito that has come. Anopheles Stephensis causes bad malaria. All health workers have detected this mosquitoe at Mandera. Mosquitos transimit malaria among people and villages
Kiswahili: Kenya imetoa onyo kuhusu mbu mbaya ambaye amekuja. Anopheles Stephensis husababisha malaria mbaya. Wafanyakazi wote wa afya wamegundua mbu huyu huko Mandera.
Somali: Kenya waxay soo saartay digniin ku saabsan cayayaanka xun ee yimid. Anopheles Stephensis waxay sababeysaa makaraariya xun. Dhammaan shaqaalaha caafimaadka ayaa ogaaday cayayaankan Mandera.
Dholuo: Kenya osechiwo siem e wi lum moro marach ma osechopo. Anopheles Stephensis kelo malaria marach. Jorit thieth duto osefwenyo lum man Mandera.

English: KNEC reminds parents in Murang'a County that school feeding programme registration is open this April.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba usajili wa programu ya kulisha shule umefunguliwa Aprili hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Murang'a in diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga ay furan tahay bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: KNEC oparo ne jonyuol e County mar Murang'a ni chenro mar kwayo nyithindo chiemo e skul ochakore e dwe mar April.

English: Ministry of Health calls on parents in Nyandarua County to have children under five screened for measles during the November outreach.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuwafanyia uchunguzi wa watoto chini ya miaka mitano wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Novemba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay waalidiinta degmada Nyandarua ugu baaqeysaa in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cirbadaha inta lagu gudajiro bisha November.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health okwayo jonyuol e County mar Nyandarua mondo otim nonro mar nyithindo ma hikgi tin ne abich e dwe mar Novemba.

English: KTDA advises farmers in Kajiado County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the August planting season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Agosti.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kajiado inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e Kajiado County mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Agost.

English: The 12th STAK Congress has opened focusing on the seed industry s vital role in Kenya s food security Stakeholders in agriculture are encouraged to participate and engage in discussions
Kiswahili: Kongamano la 12 la STAK limefunguliwa likiangazia jukumu muhimu la tasnia ya mbegu katika usalama wa chakula nchini Kenya Wadau katika kilimo wanahimizwa kushiriki na kushiriki katika mijadala.
Somali: Shirka 12aad ee STAK ayaa furmay, isagoo diiradda saaraya doorka muhiimka ah ee warshadaha abuurka ee amniga cuntada Kenya. Daneeyayaasha beeraha waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay ka qayb qaataan oo ka qaybqaataan doodaha
Dholuo: Chokruok mar 12 mar STAK osechakore ka oketo pachgi kuom migawo maduong' ma mibadhi mar kodhi nigo e weche mag chiemo e piny Kenya.

English: Kenya Price Bulletin, July 2023
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Bei ya Kenya, Julai 2023
Somali: Warbixinta Qiimaha Kenya, Luulyo 2023
Dholuo: Oboke mar nengo mag piny Kenya, dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2023

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free youth mental wellness support is available through county health facilities in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa afya ya akili ya vijana unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Garissa County.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo ne rowere yudo kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e County mar Garissa.

English: Farmers are encouraged to manage debts for inputs like fertilizer and pesticides responsibly to boost production and ensure timely repayments
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kusimamia madeni ya pembejeo kama vile mbolea na viuatilifu kwa kuwajibika ili kuongeza uzalishaji na kuhakikisha unarejeshwa kwa wakati.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay si mas'uul ah u maareeyaan deynta alaabada sida bacriminta iyo cayayaanka si kor loogu qaado wax soo saarka loona hubiyo in la bixiyo waqtigeeda
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur mondo oti gi gope mag gik ma gitiyogo kaka yien kod yedhe mamero mondo gimed timo dongruok e tijgi mar loso kod chulo pesgi e kinde mowinjore

English: Men's mental health awareness is critically important because they face unique challenges and pressures from society. Research shows that men are less likely to ask for help with mental health issues than women. This is often because society expects men not to show vulnerability or emotions. This can lead to serious problems, including a higher rate of suicide among men, who are almost four times more likely to die by suicide than women
Kiswahili: Uelewa wa afya ya akili ya wanaume ni muhimu sana kwa sababu wanakabiliwa na changamoto na shinikizo la kipekee kutoka kwa jamii. Utafiti unaonyesha kuwa wanaume wana uwezekano mdogo wa kuomba msaada kuhusu masuala ya afya ya akili kuliko wanawake. Hii mara nyingi ni kwa sababu jamii inatarajia wanaume kutoonyesha udhaifu au hisia. Hii inaweza kusababisha matatizo makubwa, ikiwa ni pamoja na kiwango cha juu cha kujiua miongoni mwa wanaume, ambao wana uwezekano wa karibu mara nne zaidi wa kufa kwa kujiua kuliko wanawake.
Somali: Aqoonta caafimaadka maskaxda ee ragga waa mid aad muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxay la kulmaan caqabado gaar ah iyo cadaadis ka yimid bulshada. Cilmi-baarista ayaa muujineysa in ragga ay ka yar yihiin haweenka inay caawimaad ka codsadaan arrimaha caafimaadka dhimirka. Tani badanaa waa sababta oo ah bulshada waxay ka filaysaa ragga inaysan muujin xasaasiyad ama shucuur. Tani waxay keeni kartaa dhibaatooyin halis ah, oo ay ku jiraan heer sare oo isdil ah ragga, kuwaas oo ku dhowaad afar jeer ka badan
Dholuo: Riwruok mar chwo e wi weche thieth mar pach en gima duong' ahinya nikech giduto giromo gi pek kod pek mopogore opogore moa e oganda. Nonro nyiso ni chwo ok yudga thuolo mar kwayo kony e weche mag thieth mag pach moloyo mon.

English: State Department for TVET urges youth in Homa Bay County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhalinyarada gobolka Homa Bay inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada rayidka ah ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada rayidnimada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo rowere e Homa Bay County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok ochopo tije mag oganda.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay shilalka waddooyinka ee Gobolka Kwale.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chako tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony e masiche mag ndara e gweng' mar Kwale.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Mombasa County that access to subsidised dialysis is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba upatikanaji wa dialysis ya ruzuku sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Mombasa in helitaanka dialysis-ka la taageeray ay hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMSA oparo ne ji duto manie County mar Mombasa ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mar dialysis e kuonde moyier.

English: IPOA reminds residents of Taita-Taveta County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lugta lagu maro inta lagu jiro xilliyada dabka.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo oti gi kuonde ma ng'ato nyalo wuothoe e kind yiengni mag mach.

English: AFA announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for sheep in Garissa County this July.
Kiswahili: AFA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Garissa Julai hii.
Somali: AFA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee idaha ee Gobolka Garissa bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: AFA olando chenro mar thiedho rombo e dwe mar Julai e kaunti mar Garissa.

English: Flooding and Displacement in Nairobi, Kenya - April 24 to May 15, 2024
Kiswahili: Mafuriko na Uhamishaji katika Nairobi, Kenya - Aprili 24 hadi Mei 15, 2024
Somali: Daadad iyo Barakac ka dhacay Nairobi, Kenya - Abriil 24 ilaa Maajo 15, 2024
Dholuo: Muomruok mar Pi kod Oloch mar Ji e Nairobi, Kenya - tarik 24 dwe mar ang'wen nyaka tarik 15 dwe mar abich higa mar 2024

English: Lamu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Lamu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2022
Somali: Degmada Lamu: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Lamu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar adek higa mar 2022

English: Bungoma County is enhancing its agricultural sector to benefit local farmers and stakeholders Stay informed on new initiatives and support programs
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Bungoma inaboresha sekta yake ya kilimo ili kuwafaidi wakulima na washikadau wa eneo hilo. Endelea kufahamishwa kuhusu mipango mipya na programu za usaidizi.
Somali: Degmada Bungoma waxay horumarinaysaa qaybteeda beeraha si ay uga faa'iideysato beeraleyda deegaanka iyo daneeyayaasha La soco qorshayaasha cusub iyo barnaamijyada taageerada

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds livestock keepers in Vihiga County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu xasuusinayaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Vihiga inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyada oo aan la helin rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.

Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kwamba upatikanaji wa maelekezo ya makazi salama unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ee ka dhacay degmada West Pokot in helitaanka tixraacyada magangelyo ammaan ah ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e West Pokot County ni ginyalo yudo kar dak maonge chudo.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Samburu County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Samburu inay biyo cabitaan ah ku kariyaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Samburu mondo omak pi modho kapok gitiyo kode mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Notice: DPP launches a theft prevention campaign in Marsabit County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DPP yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada degmada Marsabit bisha May.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: DPP chako kampen mar geng'o kuo e taon mar Marsabit e dwe mar Mei.

English: Narok County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Narok: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2023
Somali: Degmada Narok: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Narok: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar adek higa mar 2023

English: NPS urges motorists and pedestrians in Tharaka-Nithi County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NPS inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ilaaliyaan xaddidaadaha xawaaraha iyo inay adeegsadaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee socodka si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira dabka.
Dholuo: NPS ojiwo joidh mtokni kod jowuoth e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oluw tong' mar wuoth kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothie mondo gikwed hinyruok mag mach.

English: KALRO informs milk farmers in Meru County of new market linkage opportunities this December.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawafahamisha wakulima wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Meru kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Desemba hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda caanaha ee degmada Meru fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: KALRO nyiso jopur mag chak e county mar Meru e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Kenya has identified 3 different Covid 19 viruses virus, Omicron; The cabinet secretary Kagwe has disclosed that this was detected among quarantined, but continued travelling
Kiswahili: Kenya imegundua virusi 3 tofauti vya Covid 19 virusi, Omicron; Katibu wa baraza la mawaziri Kagwe amefunua kwamba hii ilipatikana kati ya watu waliowekwa katika karantini, lakini waliendelea kusafiri
Somali: Kenya waxay aqoonsatay 3 nooc oo kala duwan oo ah fayraska Covid-19, Omicron; Xoghayaha golaha wasiirada Kagwe ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in tani laga helay dadka ku jira karantiil, laakiin ay sii wadeen safarka
Dholuo: Kenya osefwenyo kit tuoche adek mopogore opogore mag Covid-19, Omicron; Jatend kambi Kagwe osenyiso ni mano ne ofwenyore e kind joma ne nie karantin, kata kamano ne gidhi nyime gi wuoth

English: Agriculture is biggest contributor of our GDP in Kenya and those employed to do so. Information on GDP in 2024 indicated farmers have reduced, 7 % of other contributors to GDP like energy services have reduced. However there are other challenges surrounding unsuccessful farming and manure deplation in farms, low harvests and poor farming skills. To learn progressive farming is vital in this situation,to increase satisfaction and improve GDP.
Kiswahili: Kilimo ni mchangiaji mkubwa wa Pato la Taifa nchini Kenya na wale walioajiriwa kufanya hivyo. Taarifa kuhusu Pato la Taifa mwaka 2024 zilionyesha wakulima wamepungua, 7% ya wachangiaji wengine wa Pato la Taifa kama vile huduma za nishati wamepungua. Hata hivyo kuna changamoto nyingine zinazohusu kilimo kisichofanikiwa na upungufu wa mbolea katika mashamba, mavuno kidogo na ujuzi duni wa kilimo. Kujifunza kilimo kinachoendelea ni muhimu katika hali hii,kuongeza kuridhika na kuboresha Pato la Taifa.
Somali: Beeraha ayaa ah qeyb ka ah GDP-ga Kenya iyo kuwa u shaqeeya inay sidaas sameeyaan. Macluumaadka ku saabsan GDP-ga sannadka 2024 ayaa muujinaya in beeraleyda ay hoos u dhaceen, 7% ka mid ah qeyb ka ah GDP-ga kale sida adeegyada tamarta ayaa hoos u dhacay. Si kastaba ha noqotee waxaa jira caqabado kale oo ku saabsan beeraha aan guul lahayn iyo caymiska bacriminta beeraha, goosashada hooseeya iyo xirfadaha beeraha ee liita. Barashada beeraha horumarsan waa mid
Dholuo: Tij pur e ma miyo GDP mar Kenya duong' moloyo, kendo joma tiyo e tijno bende timo kamano. Weche ma nyiso ni GDP mar 2024 nyiso ni jopur osedok chien, 7% mag joma kelo GDP mamoko kaka tije mag teko mar lowo osedok chien. Kata kamano, nitie pek mamoko ma ok nyal romore nikech pur ma ok dhi maber, kod tho mar yiende ma ok nyag maber, kod lony marach e pur. Puonjruok pur ma dhi nyime en gima dwarore ahinya e chalni, mondo omi ng'ato obed mamor kendo omed bedo gi GDP maber.

English: AFA reminds farmers in Busia County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia juu ya utunzaji wa rekodi unaoendelea kwa programu ya mafunzo ya wakulima.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Busia in barnaamijka tababarka beeralayda uu socdo.
Dholuo: AFA parone jopur e county mar Busia ni chenro mar tiego jopur dhi nyime.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges the public in Embu County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza raia wa Kaunti ya Embu wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya mashtaka yaliyoripotiwa ya ujumbe wa udanganyifu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa shacabka degmada Embu inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ji duto e county mar Embu mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo ripode mag twege mag phishing.

English: KICD reminds parents in Kilifi County that bursary allocation registration is open this February.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kwamba usajili wa ugawaji wa bursary umefunguliwa Februari hii.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Kilifi in diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ay furan tahay bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne jonyuol manie County Kilifi ni kad mar chiwo mich mag tiegruok osechakore e dwe mar Februar.

English: The KCC's approach is guided by the understanding that how assistance is delivered, the scale of delivery, and what partners are engaged, account for the largest gains and losses in efficiency and effectiveness.
Kiswahili: Mtazamo wa KCC unaongozwa na ufahamu kwamba jinsi usaidizi unavyotolewa, ukubwa wa utoaji, na washirika gani wanashirikishwa, huchangia faida na hasara kubwa zaidi katika ufanisi na ufanisi.
Somali: Habka KCC waxaa hagaya fahamka ah in sida gargaarka loo bixiyo, baaxadda gaarsiinta, iyo la-hawlgalayaasha la hawlgelinayo, ay yihiin faa'iidooyinka iyo khasaaraha ugu badan ee hufnaanta iyo waxtarka.
Dholuo: Yo ma KCC tiyogo ochung’ne ng’eyo ni kaka kony imiyo, kwan mar kony ma imiyo, kod jowete mage ma itiyogo, gin gik ma kelo ber kod ketho maduong’ie moloyo e tiyo maber kod tiyo maber.

English: DPP calls on the community in Kwale County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: DPP inawatia moyo jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: DPP waxay bulshada degmada Kwale ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wacayaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: DPP okwayo ji duto e county mar Kwale mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the public in Kajiado County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unashauri umma katika Kajiado County kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa SIM-swap.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya shacabka degmada Kajiado inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ji duto e Kajiado County mondo ong'e kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche mag wuond motudore gi SIM-swap.

English: Laikipia County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for January 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Laikipia: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Januari 2023
Somali: Degmada Laikipia: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Janaayo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Laikipia: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar achiel higa mar 2023

English: Notice from KEMSA: free antenatal care clinics will run every January at designated health centres in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa KEMSA: kliniki za bure za utunzaji wa ujauzito zitaendeshwa kila Januari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid KEMSA: rugta daryeelka dhalmada ee bilaashka ah waxaa lagu qaban doonaa Janaayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee lagu magacaabo degmada Nakuru.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMSA: Klinike mag rito nyithindo kapok onyuol biro tiyo dwe ka dwe e dwe mar Januar e kuonde thieth moyier e kaunti mar Nakuru.

English: Notice: DCI launches a carjacking prevention campaign in Narok County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia utekaji nyara katika Kaunti ya Narok Januari hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: DCI waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga baabuurta la xaday ee Gobolka Narok bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni DCI chako kampen mar geng'o joma kwalo mtokni e taon mar Narok e dwe mar Januar.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges motorists and pedestrians in Wajir County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Wajir kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Wajir inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka fatahaadaha la xiriira.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Forest Service jiwo derebe kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Wajir mondo oluw chike mag golo ji moa kuonde ma ji odakie mondo gikwed masiche motudore gi koth.

English: Climate smart agriculture and drought and floods resistance crops is important resilience methods at times of difficulty, change farmers to suit current farming methods that are sustainable. A group Sustainable Solutions Kenya (SUSOK), they encourage planting resilient crops, to fortify small scale farmers during climate change to sustain food security, protect the environment and increase food intake. This program inspires continuous learning to maintain achievements gained so far.
Kiswahili: Kilimo cha hali ya hewa na mazao ya upinzani wa ukame na mafuriko ni njia muhimu za kustahimili wakati wa shida, badilisha wakulima ili kuendana na njia za sasa za kilimo ambazo ni endelevu. Kundi la Sustainable Solutions Kenya (SUSOK), wanahimiza kupanda mazao yenye ustahimilivu, ili kuwaimarisha wakulima wadogo wakati wa mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa ili kudumisha usalama wa chakula, kulinda mazingira na kuongeza ulaji wa chakula. Mpango huu unahamasisha ujifunzaji endelevu ili kudumisha mafanikio yaliyopatikana hadi sasa.
Somali: Beeraha cimilada ku habboon iyo dalagyada iska caabinta abaaraha iyo fatahaadaha waa habab muhiim ah oo adkeysi leh xilliyada adag, beddel beeraleyda si ay ula jaanqaado hababka beeraha ee hadda jira ee waara. Koox la yiraahdo Sustainable Solutions Kenya (SUSOK), waxay dhiirrigeliyaan beerista dalagyo adkaysi leh, si loo xoojiyo beeraleyda yaryar xilliga isbeddelka cimilada si loo ilaaliyo ammaanka cuntada, loo ilaaliyo deegaanka loona kordhiyo qaadista cuntada. Barnaamijkan wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa barashada joogtada ah si loo ilaaliyo guulaha la gaaray ilaa hadda.
Dholuo: Chenro mar timo dongruok e yore mag pidho kod puodho ma nigi nyalo mar geng'o ywaruok e kinde mag chandruok, kelo lokruok e ngima jopur mondo oluw yore ma sani itiyogo e timo tijno. Grup miluongo ni Sustainable Solutions Kenya (SUSOK), jiwo ji mondo opidh cham ma nigi teko, mondo ojiw jopur matindo tindo e kinde lokruoge mag piny mondo gisiki ka gin gi winjruok maber gi chiemo, girito alwora, kendo gimedo chamo chiemo.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Kilifi County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Kilifi inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo odhi ir japuonj molony.

English: State Department for Basic Education calls on the community in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyo.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education okwayo ji duto e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo oriwgi lwedo e timo chenro mag somo ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ngima maber e skunde.

English: OGP urges residents of Nairobi County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: OGP ojiwo jogweng' Nairobi County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo ng'ur mar kedo gi mibadhi e migepe mag sirkal.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises coffee producers in Migori County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inashauri wazalishaji wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Migori kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa soo saarayaasha kafeega ee degmada Migori inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur ma loso kahera e county mar Migori mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds schools in Nyandarua County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this November.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inazikumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Novemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xusuusinaya dugsiyada degmada Nyandarua inay xoojiyaan adeegyada hagista iyo la-talinta bisha November.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne skunde man Nyandarua County mondo omed jiwo kendo chiwo kony e dwe mar Novemba.

English: In a schedule provided by the Chief Justice Martha Koome-led JSC, the public interviews will run from January 12 to March 23 2026.
Kiswahili: Katika ratiba iliyotolewa na Jaji Mkuu Martha Koome, JSC, mahojiano ya umma yatafanyika kutoka Januari 12 hadi Machi 23, 2026.
Somali: Sida ku cad jadwalka ay soo bandhigtay Garsoorka Sare ee Martha Koome, JSC, wareysiyada dadweynaha waxay socon doonaan 12-ka Janaayo ilaa 23-ka Maarso 2026.
Dholuo: Kaluwore gi chenro ma ne ochiw gi Chief Justice Martha Koome, JSC, mbaka mag ji duto biro timore chakre Januar 12 nyaka Mach 23, 2026.

English: IEBC urges residents of Homa Bay County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuwasilisha maandishi ya maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga kama dambaysta ah si loo qaabeeyo goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo ochiw paro mondik kapok ndalo ochopo mondo gichop chenro mar timo dongruok.

English: West Pokot County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2024
Somali: Degmada Galbeedka Pokot: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Pokot ma milambo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Septemba 2024

English: Notice: FAO restricts movement of poultry in Kajiado County due to a foot and mouth disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO inazuia harakati za kuku katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa digaagga ee Gobolka Kajiado sababo la xiriira faafitaanka cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: FAO ogeng'o wuoth mar le mag dhok e Kajiado County nikech tuwo mar dhoho.

English: Notice: HELB launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay bilawday barnaamij lagu darayo ardayda naafada ah dugsiyada degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: HELB chako chenro mar tiego nyithindo ma nigi midekre e skunde duto mag County mar Vihiga.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service promotes terracing among farmers in Busia County as part of the October climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inakuza uchungaji kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Oktoba.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa beeraleyda ku nool degmada Busia sida qayb ka ah dadaalka adkeysiga cimilada ee Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo terracing e kind jopur e county mar Busia kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Tharaka Nithi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for January 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Januari 2024
Somali: Degmada Tharaka Nithi: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Janaayo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Tharaka Nithi: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar achiel higa mar 2024

English: â€œWe are soon introducing a mobile app that allows citizens to report incidents, particularly road-related cases, directly online, he said.
Kiswahili: Tutaanzisha programu ya simu ambayo itawawezesha raia kuripoti visa, haswa visa vinavyohusiana na barabara, moja kwa moja mkondoni, alisema.
Somali: “Waxaan dhawaan soo bandhigi doonnaa barnaamij moobayl ah oo u oggolaanaya muwaadiniinta inay si toos ah online ugu soo sheegaan dhacdooyinka, gaar ahaan kiisaska la xiriira waddooyinka,” ayuu yiri.
Dholuo: â€œMachiegni wabiro keto app mar simu ma miyo jodak nyalo lando weche matimore, ahinya ahinya e weche ma mulo yore, e yor mbui, nowacho ni.

English: Notice: DPP activates an emergency response plan for landslides in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DPP inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ka dhan ah dhulgariirada gobolka Nandi.
Dholuo: Rapar: DPP tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne yiengni mag lowo e county mar Nandi.

English: IPOA reminds mobile money users in Nyeri County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Nyeri inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e County mar Nyeri ni mondo ging'e kwayo mag pesa kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo gitang' gi weche mag phishing.

English: NCPB urges sweet potatoes growers in Kajiado County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda baradho macaan ee degmada Kajiado inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobka si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur ma pidho adundo e Kajiado County mondo oti gi ratiro mar yien kapok koth ochue mondo okony e medo nyak mar yieno e higani.

English: Embu (Mbeere) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Embu (Mbeere): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Machi 2022
Somali: Degmada Embu (Mbeere): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Embu (Mbeere): Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar adek higa mar 2022

English: Notice: Council of Governors launches county development projects in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya wilaya katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa bilaabay mashaariic horumarineed oo ka socda degmada Kakamega.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Jaloch ochako tich mar timo dongruok e gweng' mar Kakamega.

English: Residents of St Teresa Primary school Mlango Kubwa, turned up in large numbers for the free targeted COVID-19 testing to prevent the transmission of the virus in the area. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Wakaazi wa shule ya msingi ya St Teresa Mlango Kubwa, walijitokeza kwa wingi kwa ajili ya upimaji wa bure wa COVID-19 uliolengwa ili kuzuia maambukizi ya virusi katika eneo hilo. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Dadka degan dugsiga hoose ee St Teresa Mlango Kubwa, ayaa tiro badan soo xaadiray si loo sameeyo baaritaanka bilaashka ah ee COVID-19 si looga hortago faafitaanka fayraska ee aagga. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Jodak mag sikund skul maduong' mar St Teresa Mlango Kubwa, ne obiro kwan mang'eny e timo pim mar COVID-19 maonge chudo mondo ogeng' lando midhusi e alwora no. #KomeshaKorona

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Makueni County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this drought season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati huu wa ukame.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni in ay dhagaystaan amarada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha deegaanka xilligan abaarta.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne jogweng' Makueni County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji e gweng'no e kinde mar oro.

English: Public health advisory: SHA (Social Health Authority) warns of increased HIV/AIDS risk in Kilifi County and advises the public to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya VVU/UKIMWI katika Kaunti ya Kilifi na kushauri umma kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ka digtay kororka halista HIV/AIDS ee Gobolka Kilifi waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar oganda: SHA (Social Health Authority) chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar AYAKI/AIDS e gweng' mar Kilifi kendo ojiwo ji mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal mar thieth man machiegni kodgi.

English: NCPB advises farmers in Taita-Taveta County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the May planting season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Mei.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maajo.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e Taita-Taveta County mondo oti gi ratiro mar yien kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: KEMSA confirms a typhoid outbreak alert for Bungoma County. Residents are advised to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA yathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa typhoid katika Kaunti ya Bungoma. Wakazi wanashauriwa kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMSA waxay xaqiijineysaa feejignaanta cudurka tifooska ee degmada Bungoma. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KEMSA osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuo mar typhoid e County mar Bungoma.

English: Kenya Key Message Update: Emergency (IPC Phase 4) acute food insecurity in northern and northeastern Kenya, May 2022
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Ujumbe Muhimu wa Kenya: Dharura (IPC Awamu ya 4) uhaba mkubwa wa chakula kaskazini na kaskazini mashariki mwa Kenya, Mei 2022

Dholuo: Oda maduong' mar piny Kenya: Okang' mapiyo (IPC Kidieny mar 4) bedo maonge gi chiemo e nyandwat kod nyandwat ma yo wuokchieng' mar Kenya, Mei 2022

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Meru County this August. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanya kongamano la kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Meru Agosti hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) ayaa qaban doonta madasha dib u soo kabashada isticmaalka maandooriyaha ee degmada Meru bisha Agoosto. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo romo mar chango joma tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero e dwe mar Agost e kaunti mar Meru.

English: E-Citizen reminds the public in Kwale County that input on development planning forums is welcome this June.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba maoni juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo yanakaribishwa Juni hii.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kwale in talooyinka ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta la soo dhaweynayo bisha Juun.
Dholuo: E-Citizen oparo ne ji duto e Kaunti mar Kwale ni gibiro rwako pachgi e chokruok mar timo chenro mar dongruok e dwe mar Jun.

English: NCPB urges farmers in Kiambu County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kiambu inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e Kaunti mar Kiambu mondo opidh olembe ma ok nyal geng'o lowo kethore mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Store sharp, toxic, or breakable items out of children's reach to prevent injuries.
Kiswahili: Hifadhi vitu vyenye ncha kali, sumu, au vinavyoweza kuvunjika mbali na watoto ili kuzuia majeraha.
Somali: Alaabta fiiqan, sunta ah, ama jabaysa ku kaydi meel aanay carruurtu gaadhi karin si looga hortago dhaawacyada.
Dholuo: Ket gik mabith, ma nigi kwiri, kata manyalo kethore kama nyithindo ok nyal chopoe mondo kik giyud hinyruok.

English: Meru (Meru-North) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Meru (Meru-Kaskazini): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2023
Somali: Degmada Meru (Meru-Waqooyi): War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2023

English: Embu (Mbeere) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for January 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Embu (Mbeere): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Januari 2023
Somali: Degmada Embu (Mbeere): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Janaayo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Embu (Mbeere): Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar achiel higa mar 2023
