English: Ministry of Health announces SHA registration for residents of Nairobi County starting this April.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yatangaza usajili wa SHA kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuanzia Aprili hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ku dhawaaqday diiwaangelinta SHA ee dadka deggan degmada Nairobi laga bilaabo Abriil.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health olando chenro mar SHA mar joma odak e County mar Nairobi kochakore April ma kawuono.

English: TVET urges parents and teachers in Wajir County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: TVET inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi kwa watoto 116.
Somali: TVET waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Wajir inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Wajir mondo omany namba mar kony mar nyithindo 116.

English: HELB encourages residents of Bungoma County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on voter registration.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: HELB waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada si ay uga warqabaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi weche mag kwayo ji mondo oyiergi.

English: Notice: KEPHIS restricts movement of pigs in Mandera County due to an anthrax outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS inazuia harakati za nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwa sababu ya mlipuko wa kimeta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay xaddiddaa dhaqdhaqaaqa doofaarka ee Gobolka Mandera sababtuna tahay cudurka Anthrax.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS ogeng'o wuoth mar le e County Mandera nikech tuwo mar anthrax.

English: EACC reminds voters in Lamu County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha gobolka Lamu in ay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor inta aysan helin waxbarasho codbixinayaasha.
Dholuo: EACC parone jogweng'o mag Lamu County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom SMS ne ji 70000 kapok giyudo tiegruok.

English: Teachers Service Commission announces distribution of revision guides to schools in Kajiado County this October.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inatangaza usambazaji wa miongozo ya marekebisho kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kajiado Oktoba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa ku dhawaaqay in bisha Oktoobar la qeybiyo hagaha dib u eegista dugsiyada degmada Kajiado.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission ong'ado mar pogo buge mag somo e skunde mag Kajiado County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Kenya - Key Message Update: Crisis (IPC Phase 3) outcomes expanding as anomalous dry conditions intensify, January 2026
Kiswahili: Kenya - Taarifa Muhimu ya Ujumbe: Matokeo ya Mgogoro (IPC Awamu ya 3) yanapanuka huku hali ya ukame isiyo ya kawaida inavyozidi, Januari 2026
Somali: Kenya - Cusboonaysiinta Fariinta Muhiimka ah: Natiijooyinka Dhibaatada (IPC Wajiga 3aad) ayaa sii kordhaya iyadoo xaaladaha qalalan ee aan caadiga ahayn ay sii xoogaysanayaan, Janaayo 2026
Dholuo: Kenya - Oda Maduong' Maduong': Duoko mag Masira (IPC Kidieny mar 3) medore kaka piny otuo ma ok owinjore medore, dwe mar achiel higa mar 2026

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross will hold a stress management forum in Laikipia County this April. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utafanya kongamano la kudhibiti mafadhaiko katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Aprili hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay qabaneysaa madasha xakamaynta stress-ka ee Gobolka Laikipia bishii Abriil. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Red Cross biro timo romo mar kedo gi parruok e Laikipia County e dwe mar April. Ji duto mor.

English: KEMSA encourages mothers in Laikipia County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Laikipia inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo mine man Laikipia County mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Notice: DCI opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay fureysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya taageero maskaxeed iyo bulsheed Gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DCI ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony e weche mag pach ji e gweng' mar Taita-Taveta.

English: Dadaab and Kakuma Refugee Camp in Kenya | Joint Market Monitoring Initiative (JMMI) Q3 (July - September, 2024)
Kiswahili: Kambi ya Wakimbizi ya Dadaab na Kakuma nchini Kenya | Mpango wa Pamoja wa Ufuatiliaji wa Soko (JMMI) Q3 (Julai - Septemba, 2024)
Somali: Xeryaha Qaxootiga Dhadhaab iyo Kakuma ee Kenya | Hindisaha Kormeerka Suuqa Wadajirka ah (JMMI) Q3 (Luulyo - Sebtembar, 2024)
Dholuo: Kambi mar Jolweny ma Dadaab kod Kakuma e piny Kenya | Chenro mar Luoro Chiro Riwre (JMMI) Q3 (Dwe mar Abiriyo - Apar, 2024)

English: Notice: KTDA restricts movement of cattle in Nyandarua County due to a foot and mouth disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA inazuia harakati za ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da Gobolka Nyandarua sababo la xiriira faafitaanka cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KTDA ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok e County mar Nyandarua nikech tuoche mag dhoot.

English: Notice: DPP conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Nandi County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Nandi Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho oo ku saabsan dhismaha nabadda qaranka ee degmada Nandi bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: DPP timo romo mar oganda e wi loso kuwe e gweng' mar Nandi e dwe mar Julai.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Uasin Gishu County to attend the public participation forum to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si loo qaabeeyo dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya ojiwo jogweng' Uasin Gishu County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar timo nonro mar tich higa ka higa.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges cattle farmers in Embu County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Embu kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za ugonjwa wa ngozi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da ee degmada Embu inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur mag jamni e county mar Embu mondo onyis jamni matuwo e ofise mar thieth machiegni bang' yudo ni nitie tuoche mang'eny mag pien.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds mobile money users in Kiambu County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha watumiaji wa fedha za simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kiambu inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e gweng' mar Kiambu ni mondo gimi jatendgi mar konyo ji kik hinygi gi weche mag phishing.

English: Young parents have been encouraged to have a conversation on their birth plan with their doctors, so as to enable to enable the body of the mother to prepare for the next conception
Kiswahili: Wazazi wachanga wametiwa moyo wazungumze na madaktari wao kuhusu mpango wao wa kuzaa ili mwili wa mama uweze kujitayarisha kwa ajili ya mimba inayofuata
Somali: Waalidiinta dhalinyarada ah waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay dhakhaatiirtooda kala hadlaan qorshaha dhalmada si ay jidhka hooyada u diyaariyaan uurka soo socda
Dholuo: Ojiwo jonyuol ma rowere mondo owuo gi lakteche e wi chenro ma gin-go mar nyuol, mondo omi ringre min nyathi obed gi nyalo mar ikore ne nyuolne ma biro

English: OGP reminds residents of Lamu County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: OGP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kwamba kufikia usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: OGP parone jogweng'o mag Lamu County ni yudo weche mag nyasi mar nyuol koro yot moloyo kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Notice: KRA launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Nairobi County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhanka ah gobolka Nairobi bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KRA chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Nairobi e dwe mar Januar.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Garissa County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Garissa inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qayb galaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur e County mar Garissa mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges residents of Narok County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Narok inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo ji duto modak e Narok County mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud somo mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: KALRO urges pigs farmers in Trans Nzoia County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wafugaji wa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda doofaarka ee degmada Trans Nzoia inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha lagu burburiyo ee loo qoondeeyay ka dib kiisaska cudurka Anthrax ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur puothe e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo ogeng'e legi e kuonde moketi mag chamo puothe bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag anthrax.

English: Notice: COMESA will open a milk collection centre in Nyandarua County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itafungua kituo cha kukusanya maziwa katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay ka furi doontaa xarun lagu soo uruurinayo caanaha degmada Nyandarua bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA biro yawo kambi mar choko chak e County mar Nyandarua e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Council of Governors invites residents of Kajiado County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawaalika wakazi wa Kajiado County kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandao wa kaunti kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku martiqaadaan dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee la xiriira wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch ogwelo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county mar chiwo paro e wi chenro mag oganda.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges motorists and pedestrians in Meru County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Meru kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya gawaarida iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Meru inay u hoggaansamaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay adeegsadaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee socodka si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira qaraxyada dabka.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo joidh mtokni kod jowuoth e County mar Meru mondo oluw tong' mar wuoth kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe mondo gikwed hinyruok mar mach.

English: HELB advises applicants in Turkana County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: HELB inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: HELB waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Turkana inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: HELB nyiso jogo madwaro donjo e skundno e county mar Turkana ni gidonj e skundni ka pok giyudo thuolo mar donjo.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds livestock keepers in Lamu County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa za kuponda ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu xasuusinayaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Lamu inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jokwath mag jamni e County mar Lamu ni mondo gimi jamnigi thieth e kuonde moketi mag nego jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: Discover the benefits of propolis a natural product made by bees known for its antibacterial properties Farmers are encouraged to explore its uses in agribusiness
Kiswahili: Gundua faida za propolis bidhaa asilia inayotengenezwa na nyuki inayojulikana kwa sifa zake za kuzuia bakteria Wakulima wanahimizwa kuchunguza matumizi yake katika biashara ya kilimo.
Somali: Baro faa'iidooyinka propolis, oo ah badeecad dabiici ah oo ay sameeyaan shinnida oo caan ku ah sifooyinkeeda antibakteeriyada Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay sahamiyaan isticmaalkeeda ganacsiga beeraha
Dholuo: Puonjri kuom ber ma propolis kelo, ma en gima ichueyo gi le mag le ma ong'ere kaka yedhe makedo gi kute mag yedhe mamero, kendo mano jiwo jopur mondo onon kaka gitiyogo e weche mag uso cham

English: Kenya Food Security Alert: As an already historic four-season drought drives widespread need, a fifth poor season is now forecast, 10 May 2022
Kiswahili: Tahadhari ya Usalama wa Chakula Kenya: Kama ukame ambao tayari ni wa kihistoria wa misimu minne unachochea mahitaji makubwa, msimu wa tano duni sasa unatabiriwa, 10 Mei 2022.
Somali: Digniin ku saabsan Sugnaanta Cuntada Kenya: Maadaama abaartii afarta xilli ee horeba u jirtay ay keentay baahi baahsan, haddana waxaa la saadaalinayaa xilli ciyaareedkii shanaad ee liita, 10 Maajo 2022
Dholuo: Chik mar Rieko mar Chiemo e piny Kenya: Kaka oro ma osebedo ka timore kuom kinde ang’wen kelo dwaro maduong’ ahinya, sani igeno ni oro mar abich biro bedo ma ok ber, tarik 10 dwe mar abich higa mar 2022

English: DPP urges anyone experiencing abuse in Samburu County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: DPP inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Samburu piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa qofkasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Samburu inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: DPP ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e county mar Samburu mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195 maonge chudo.

English: The Global Fund Boss has requested President Ruto, to start contributing to the fight of HIVAIDS, TB and Malaria
Kiswahili: Mkuu wa Mfuko wa Dunia amemwomba Rais Ruto, kuanza kuchangia katika mapambano dhidi ya UKIMWI, kifua kikuu na malaria
Somali: Hoggaamiyaha Sanduuqa Caalamiga ah wuxuu Madaxweyne Ruto ka codsaday inuu bilaabo gacan ka geysashada la dagaalanka HIVAIDS, TB iyo Maleriya
Dholuo: Jatelo mar Global Fund osekwayo President Ruto, mondo ochak konyo e kedo gi HIVAIDS, TB kod malaria

English: Council of Governors warns public officers in Garissa County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa dhidi ya udanganyifu wa mikopo.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ka digaysaa saraakiisha dawladda ee Gobolka Garissa khiyaanooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e gweng' mar Garissa kuom timbe mag mibadhi.

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of Kisii County about a rise in phishing messages and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: Kenya Red Cross inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii juu ya kuongezeka kwa ujumbe wa udanganyifu na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii kororka farriimaha phishing waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross osiemo jogweng' Kisii County kuom wach medruok mar ote mag phishing kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: Teenage mothers are at higher risk of complications. Encourage young girls to stay in school and delay pregnancy.
Kiswahili: Akina mama vijana wako katika hatari kubwa ya kupata matatizo. Wahimize wasichana wadogo kuendelea na shule na kuchelewesha ujauzito.
Somali: Hooyooyinka dhallinyarada ah waxay halis ugu jiraan inay qabaan dhibaatooyin badan. Gabdhaha yaryar ku dhiirigeliso inay iskuulka sii joogaan oo ay uurka dib u dhigaan.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma rowere nyalo bedo gi tuoche mang'eny, omiyo jiwuru mon matindo mondo odhi nyime gi dhi e skul kendo giter ich bang'e.

English: CDC urges residents of Mombasa County to complete the full recommended vaccination dose following a rise in reported tuberculosis cases.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya kifua kikuu vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: CDC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa inay dhammaystiraan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo kadib kororka kiisaska cudurka 'tuberculosis' ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo ji modak e County mar Mombasa mondo otiek dose duto mar thieth ma ichikoe nikech kwan mar ji ma nigi tuberculosis osemedore.

English: KICD reminds youth in Mandera County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Mandera in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne rowere man Mandera County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar chiemo kod mar rwako welo.

English: On September 1 2025 KUCCPS will open its portal for the September 2025 university and TVET intake targeting 2024 KCSE candidates.
Kiswahili: Mnamo Septemba 1, 2025, KUCCPS itafungua portal yake kwa chuo kikuu cha Septemba 2025 na kuingia kwa TVET ikilenga wagombea 2024 wa KCSE.
Somali: Bishii Sebtember 1, 2025, KUCCPS waxay furi doontaa boggeeda loogu talagalay gelitaanka jaamacadaha iyo TVET ee Sebtembar 2025, oo bartilmaameedsanaya musharixiinta 2024 KCSE.
Dholuo: E dwe mar Septemba 1, 2025, KUCCPS biro yawo dhoot mare mar somo e yunivasiti kod TVET e dwe mar ochiko 2025.

English: KICD reminds youth in Migori County that HELB funding is available for ICT skills training.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Migori kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Migori in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka xirfadaha ICT.
Dholuo: KICD parone rowere mag Migori County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar lony e yore mag ICT.

English: Ministry of Health reminds expectant mothers in Kirinyaga County that access to postnatal check-ups is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba upatikanaji wa uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Kirinyaga in helitaanka baaritaannada dhalmada ka dib ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne mine ma biro nyuolo e County mar Kirinyaga ni dhi e nonro bang' nyuol en gima onge chudo e kuonde duto mag ji duto.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the public in Nyeri County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Nyeri wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nyeri inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto e County mar Nyeri mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo weche ma nyiso ni ne giyudo ote mag phishing.

English: Kenya Medical Association launches a June awareness campaign on hand hygiene across Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kizindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Juni juu ya usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu bilaabay olole wacyi galineed bishii Juun oo ku saabsan nadaafadda gacmaha ee Gobolka Samburu.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Jun e wi ler mar lwete e gweng' mar Samburu.

English: Notice: KNEC announces school feeding programme enrollment dates for schools in Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa mpango wa kulisha shule kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiyada degmada Marsabit.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KNEC landoga tarik mag dhi e skunde mag Marsabit mondo giyud thuolo mar dhi e program mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMSA will be held in Machakos County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMSA itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Machakos Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay KEMSA ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Machakos bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni kambi mar thieth ma KEMSA ochano ibiro tim e dwe mar Agost e kaunti mar Machakos.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) advises residents of Busia County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma ya afya ya ruzuku.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia inay haystaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Busia mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi ka gidwaro thieth mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: This comedy touches on important topics such as washing your hands, social distancing, wearing masks in the community, courtesy of Julius Ole Menye from Narok county. I would say watch all & share to help prevent the spread of coronavirus. #KomeshaKorona campaign.
Kiswahili: Kichekesho hiki kinagusa mada muhimu kama vile kunawa mikono, umbali wa kijamii, kuvaa vinyago katika jamii, kwa hisani ya Julius Ole Menye kutoka kaunti ya Narok. Ningesema tazama zote na ushiriki ili kusaidia kuzuia kuenea kwa coronavirus. Kampeni ya #KomeshaKorona.
Somali: Majaajiladan waxay taabanaysaa mowduucyo muhiim ah sida dhaqidda gacmaha, kala fogaanshaha bulshada, xirashada maaskaro bulshada dhexdeeda, waxaana soo jeedinaya Julius Ole Menye oo ka soo jeeda degmada Narok. Waxaan dhihi lahaa dhammaan daawada oo la wadaag si looga hortago faafitaanka coronavirus. Ololaha #KomeshaKorona.
Dholuo: Gima miyo ji nyiero mulo weche madongo kaka lwoko lwedo, bedo mabor gi jowetegi, rwako mask e kambi, ng'uono mar Julius Ole Menye mawuok e kaunti mar Narok. Anyalo wacho ni ng'i duto & lando mondo okony e geng'o lando mar korona. Kampein mar #Korona.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) announces improved turnaround times for e-Citizen registration in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inatangaza nyakati bora za kujiandikisha kwa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la hagaajiyay waqtiga diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) olando lokruok e kinde mag dhi e e-Citizen registration e County mar Nyeri.

English: NDMA alerts residents of Turkana County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Somali: NDMA waxay dadka deggan degmada Turkana uga digtay kororka kiisaska xoolaha lagu xado waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: NDMA chiwo siem ne ji modak e County mar Turkana kuom wach medruok mar weche mag kwalo jamni kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag rito ngimagi gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Notice: KTDA will train farmers in Trans Nzoia County on soil conservation this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia juu ya uhifadhi wa udongo Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia ee ilaalinta ciidda bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA biro tiego jopur e Trans Nzoia County e wi rito lowo e dwe mar Julai.

English: KEMSA encourages residents of Bungoma County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwahimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay u dhiiri galiyaan saaxiibo dhibaataysan inay caawimaad raadsadaan.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo kik gisandre ling'ling', kendo ojiw osiepgi moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: National Coordinating Committee affirming Kenyaâ€™s pledges on food system reform, nutrition financing, and wellness pathways.
Kiswahili: Kamati ya Kitaifa ya Uhariri ikithibitisha ahadi za Kenya kuhusu mageuzi ya mfumo wa chakula, ufadhili wa lishe, na njia za ustawi.
Somali: Guddiga Isku-dubaridka Qaranka oo xaqiijinaya ballanqaadyada Kenya ee ku saabsan dib-u-habeynta nidaamka cuntada, maalgelinta nafaqada, iyo waddooyinka fayoobaanta.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Riwruok mar Pinyruoth ma siro singo mag piny Kenya kuom loso chenro mar chiemo, chiwo pesa mag chiemo ma nigi gik ma konyo e ringruok, kod yore mag rito ngima maber.

English: Notice: NPS conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Kirinyaga County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan ka hortagga argagixisada ee Gobolka Kirinyaga bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar National Security Service (NPS) timo romo mar oganda e dwe mar Novemba e gweng' mar Kirinyaga.

English: TVET reminds schools in Kericho County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this April.
Kiswahili: TVET inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Aprili hii.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Kericho inay xoojiyaan adeegyada hagista iyo la-talinta bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa skunde mag Kericho County mondo omed jiwo kendo chiwo kony e dwe mar April.

English: ODPP reminds residents of Kisumu County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu in ka qaybgalka maamulaha qaybta deegaanka ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: ODPP paronwa jogweng' mar Kisumu County ni tudruok gi jarit mar ward margi jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response calls on parents in Trans Nzoia County to have children under five screened for typhoid during the December outreach.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuwafanya watoto chini ya miaka mitano wachunguzwe typhoid wakati wa mawasiliano ya Desemba.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Trans Nzoia in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka tifooska inta lagu gudajiro bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche kwayo jonyuol e County mar Trans Nzoia mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Desemba mondo gine ni gin gi tuwo mar typhoid.

English: Safe walking and cycling contributes to healthier lives preventing Non- Communicable diseases such Cancer, diabetes and hypertension and improves one's mental health
Kiswahili: Kutembea salama na kuendesha baiskeli huchangia maisha yenye afya njema kuzuia magonjwa yasiyoambukiza kama vile Saratani, kisukari na shinikizo la damu na kuboresha afya ya akili ya mtu.
Somali: Socod ammaan ah iyo baaskiil wadista ayaa gacan ka geysta nolol caafimaad qabta ka hortagga cudurrada aan la is qaadsiin karin sida Kansarka, sonkorowga iyo dhiigkarka waxayna wanaajisaa caafimaadka maskaxda qofka.

English: E-Citizen reminds the public in Nyamira County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this July.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba ushiriki katika mashauriano ya sera za umma unakaribishwa Julai hii.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Nyamira in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha July.
Dholuo: E-Citizen oparo ne ji duto e County mar Nyamira ni gibiro yie gi chiwo mag paro e wi chenro mag sirkal e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: e-Citizen opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa ajili ya usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Ogeysiis: e-Citizen waxay ka furaysaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay ka shaqeynta shahaadada dhalashada ee Gobolka Kwale.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: e-Citizen oseyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag loso nyasi mag nyuol e county mar Kwale.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free Rift Valley Fever screening is available at all public health centres in Baringo County this March.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo Machi hii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka bilaashka ah ee Rift Valley Fever laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynta ee Gobolka Baringo bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji ni nonro mar Rift Valley Fever maonge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e Baringo County e dwe mar Mach.

Kiswahili: IMF inasisitiza sheria mpya za Kenya kuhusu mali za crypto ili kukabiliana na ufadhili wa ugaidi.

English: NPS urges residents of Mandera County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: NPS inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: NPS ojiwo jogweng'o mag Mandera County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e gwenge man machiegni gi tong'gi nikech ji osebedo ka kawo okang' mar kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Kenya | Joint Market Monitoring Initiative (JMMI) Dadaab and Kakuma Refugee Camp, Q4 2025 (October - December)
Kiswahili: Kenya | Mpango wa Pamoja wa Ufuatiliaji wa Soko (JMMI) Dadaab na Kambi ya Wakimbizi ya Kakuma, Q4 2025 (Oktoba - Desemba)

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds voters in Murang'a County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya kusajili wapiga Kura.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Murang'a inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor inta aan la diiwaangelin codbixinayaashu.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General parone jogweng'o e County mar Murang'a mondo olim kama ichanoe mar IEBC machiegni kodgi kapok gidonjo e register mar joma oyiero.

English: KALRO reminds livestock keepers in Nyandarua County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KALRO waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xayawaanka ah ee degmada Nyandarua inay ka fogaadaan in xoolaha laga guuro xadka degmada iyada oo aan la helin rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KALRO parone jorit jamni e Kaunti mar Nyandarua ni kik giting' jamni ka ok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: NDMA calls on residents of Trans Nzoia County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of border security.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: NDMA waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga waxqabadka aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah si ay u taageeraan amniga xuduudda.
Dholuo: NDMA okwayo jogweng' mar Trans Nzoia County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma rito tong'o ni gitimo gik maok kare e alworano.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges youth in Nyamira County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nyamira inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education ojiwo rowere e County mar Nyamira mondo oriwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gichako timo tije mag oganda.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay qabaneysaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee Gobolka Nairobi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Huduma Kenya biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e County mar Nairobi.

English: AFA urges pigs farmers in Kericho County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported rabies cases.
Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wafugaji wa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya kichaa cha mbwa vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda doofaarka ee degmada Kericho inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyaga oo aan haysan rukhsad ka dib kiisaska xanaaqa la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur puothe e County mar Kericho mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni ka giwuok e county maok giyudo rusa bang' yudo weche mag rabies.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa maelekezo ya makazi salama katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa furaya xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya tixraacyo magangelyo ammaan ah oo ku yaal degmada Mandera.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar weche motudore gi timbe mahundu chako tiyo gi ofis mar weche mag nindruok e alwora mar Mandera County.

English: HELB announces distribution of school laptops under the digital literacy programme to schools in Kericho County this November.
Kiswahili: HELB inatangaza usambazaji wa kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kericho Novemba hii.
Somali: HELB waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Kericho bishii November.
Dholuo: HELB ogolo chiwo mag laptop mag skul e bwo chenro mar somo gi somo mar digital e skunde man Kericho County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafungua maombi ya maudhui ya kujifunza dijitali bila malipo kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu codsiyada u furayaa ardayda ku nool gobolka Homa Bay si ay u helaan waxyaabaha waxbarasho ee bilaashka ah ee dhijitaalka ah.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj chako timo kwayo mar yudo puonj mag digital maonge chudo ne jopuonjre manie Homa Bay County.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties urges residents of Bungoma County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties jiwo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county mar tiego ji e weche siasa.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Wajir County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku boorrinaysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Wajir inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pache e County mar Wajir mondo omany japuonj molony.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages mothers in Nyeri County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa hooyooyinka degmada Nyeri inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo mine manie County mar Nyeri mondo olimgi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: KTDA urges dairy cows farmers in Makueni County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawataka wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa ngozi vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Makueni inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo ka dib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KTDA ojiwo jopur mag dhok ma loso dhok e gweng' mar Makueni mondo ogeng'e legi e kuonde moyier mag chwoyo dhok bang' ka osenyis ni nitie tuoche mang'eny mag pien.

English: Effectively market your free range eggs or services using social media platforms Get tips on creating engaging content and reaching customers
Kiswahili: Tangaza kwa ufanisi huduma au huduma zako za kujivinjari kwa kutumia mitandao ya kijamii Pata vidokezo kuhusu kuunda maudhui yanayovutia na kuwafikia wateja
Somali: Si wax ku ool ah u suuq geliyaan ukumahaaga ama adeegyadaada adoo adeegsanaya barxadaha warbaahinta bulshada Hel talooyin ku saabsan abuurista waxyaabaha soo jiidasho leh iyo gaarsiinta macaamiisha
Dholuo: Ti gi yore mag manyo mor e piny mondo iyud weche ma nyalo konyi loso weche mag mor kod manyo joma diher kony

English: KALRO urges tea growers in Narok County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Narok kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee Gobolka Narok inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka xilliga dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e kaunti mar Narok mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e higa ka gitiyo gi tuoche mag thieth molony mondo gimed nyak e higani.

English: Notice: DCI issues a cybersecurity alert on phishing messages affecting residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DCI inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya ujumbe wa phishing unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan fariimaha phishing ee saameynaya dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Rapar: DCI ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity e wi ote mag phishing makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada iskuulada ee degmada Mandera.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development chako chenro mar rito nyithindo e skul e skunde duto mag Mandera County.

English: KUCCPS advises applicants in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee la heli karo.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: Ministry of Education implements virtual mentorship platform connecting students with industry experts.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inatekeleza jukwaa la ushauri wa virtual linalounganisha wanafunzi na wataalamu wa sekta hiyo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay hirgelineysaa barnaamij tababbar oo dalwad ah oo ardayda la xiriira khubarada warshadaha.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok tiyo gi chenro mar tiego jopuonjre gi joma olony e weche mag somo.

English: This builds on early action and interventions supported by IFRC'sDisaster Response Emergency Fund, which was activated as conditions deteriorated from late 2024 into 2025 and enabled rapid, targeted scale-up of the crisis response.
Kiswahili: Mtazamo huu unajumuisha mwitikio wa dharura, hatua za mapema, na kujenga uthabiti kupitia uingiliaji kati unaoongozwa na jamii, wa sekta mbalimbali unaolenga mahitaji ya ndani.
Somali: Tani waxay ku dhisan tahay ficil hore iyo faragelin ay taageerto Sanduuqa Gurmadka ee Jawaab celinta Masiibooyinka ee IFRC, kaas oo la hawlgeliyay markii xaaladuhu ka sii dartay laga soo bilaabo dabayaaqadii 2024 ilaa 2025 wuxuuna suurtageliyay in si degdeg ah loo kordhiyo jawaabta dhibaatooyinka.
Dholuo: Mae gero kuom timo gik moko mapiyo kendo donjo e gik ma ne okor gi pesa mar IFRC mar dwoko masira, ma ne oket kaka gik moko ne dhi marach chakre e giko higa mar 2024 nyaka 2025 kendo ne omiyo nyalo mar dwoko mapiyo kendo ma ochung’ motegno mar dwoko masira.

English: NPS calls on residents of Mombasa County to support local peace-building committees in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani kwa msaada wa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: NPS waxay dadka deggan degmada Mombasa ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee deegaanka si ay u taageerayaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: NPS okwayo jogweng' mar Mombasa County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gwenge ma gidakie mondo gikony e chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: COMESA advises farmers in Busia County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the May planting season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Mei.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Busia inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka jiilaalka hore iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maajo.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e county mar Busia mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok chon kapok ochopo dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Nyeri County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu qaban doonaa diiwaangelinta aqoon isweydaarsi loogu talagalay beeraleyda degmada Nyeri bishii Ogosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro timo rapar mar jopur e dwe mar Agost e kaunti mar Nyeri.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education reminds citizens in Tharaka-Nithi County about their rights regarding voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuhusu haki zao kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka Tharaka-Nithi waxay muwaadiniinta ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaasha.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Puonjruok Mokwongo mar Piny owacho parone raia mag Tharaka-Nithi County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar ndiko jogo madwaro yiero.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges motorists and pedestrians in Kisumu County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya gawaarida iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Kisumu inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada ay fatahan yihiin si looga hortago dhacdooyinka abaarta la xiriira.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo dereche mag mtokni kod joma wuotho gi tiendegi e gweng' mar Kisumu mondo kik ging'ad ponde kod aoche ma pi opong'o mondo kik masira mar oro timre.

English: "If you receive an email asking you to verify your bank account, dont click  it's phishing. Report to the DCI Cybercrime Unit."
Kiswahili: "Ukipokea barua pepe inayokuomba uthibitishe akaunti yako ya benki, usibofye ni ulaghai. Ripoti kwa Kitengo cha Uhalifu wa Mtandaoni cha DCI."

English: Public health advisory: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response warns of increased Rift Valley Fever risk in Mombasa County and advises the public to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa katika Kaunti ya Mombasa na kushauri umma kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.

Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NPS tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne masiche ma timore e nderni e County mar Mandera.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Uasin Gishu County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Machi hii.

Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Forest Service timo romo mar oganda e wi loso kuwe e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu e dwe mar Mach.

English: The Ministry of Education reiterates that bursary forms are distributed freely and do not require payment. Any demand for money should be reported.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inasisitiza kwamba fomu za ufadhili wa masomo zinasambazwa kwa uhuru na hazihitaji malipo. Ombi lolote la pesa linapaswa kuripotiwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda waxbarashadu waxay ku celinaysaa in foomamka deeqda waxbarasho si xor ah loo qaybiyo oo aan loo baahnayn lacag. Wixii dalab ah ee lacag ah waa in la soo sheegaa.
Dholuo: Ofis mar somo odwoko ni fom mag bursary ipogo maonge chudo kendo ok odwar chudo. Owinjore ondiki ripot mar dwaro moro amora mar pesa.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds voters in Uasin Gishu County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu xasuusinayaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Uasin Gishu inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor nidaamyada doorashada.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette paronwa jogedo e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero ka pok itimo yiero.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) encourages farmers in Nandi County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for tea.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa ili kupata bei bora ya chai.

Dholuo: Jatelo mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e county mar Nandi mondo oti gi nengo matin mar chai mondo giyud nengo maber mar chai.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kajiado County this April.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inazindua kampeni ya kupambana na ufisadi katika Kajiado County Aprili hii.

Dholuo: Rieko: Huduma Kenya chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e Kajiado County e dwe mar April.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development warns millet farmers in Kitui County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.

Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development osiemo jopur mag millet e County mar Kitui kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim gik moko e kinde mowinjore.

English: KALRO promotes organic farming among farmers in Nandi County as part of the August climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: KALRO inakuza kilimo hai kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Agosti.
Somali: KALRO waxay kor u qaadeysaa beeraha dabiiciga ah ee beeraleyda gobolka Nandi iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka iska caabbinta cimilada ee Agoosto.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo tij pur e kind jopur e County mar Nandi kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi e dwe mar Agost.

English: KALRO advises farmers in Kilifi County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kilifi inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Washing your hands with soap when you are attending the child e.g changing its napkins prevents infection transimision to the child and its mother
Kiswahili: Kuosha mikono yako kwa sabuni unapomtunza mtoto kwa mfano kubadili sareti yake huzuia maambukizi ya maambukizo kwa mtoto na mama yake
Somali: Gacmaha lagu maydho saabuun marka aad ilmaha daryeesho tusaale ahaan beddelidda sariiraha ayaa ka hortagta in cudurku u gudbo ilmaha iyo hooyadiisa
Dholuo: Luoko lueti gi sabun sama irito nyathi, kuom ranyisi loko lep nyathi, geng'o tuwono kik lal ne nyathi kod min mare

English: Kenya Medical Association appeals to caregivers in Tana River County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the September maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi Septemba.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ka codsadaa daryeelayaasha degmada Tana River inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta bukaanka ee la qorsheeyay qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Sebtember.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association ogwelo jorit e taon mar Tana River County mondo obi e odiechieng' mar thieth ma ne otim e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: AFA restricts movement of poultry in Tharaka-Nithi County due to an anthrax outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA inazuia harakati za kuku katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kutokana na mlipuko wa kimeta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa digaagga ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi sababtoo ah cudurka Anthrax.
Dholuo: Rapar: AFA ogeng'o wuoth mar winy e Tharaka-Nithi County nikech tuwo mar anthrax.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Kitui County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuhusu umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMRI waxay dadka degmada Kitui ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay nadaafadda saxda ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMRI parone ji duto e Kitui County kuom ber mar rito ler mar ngima e ot.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public that free stress management support is available through county health facilities in Busia County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa kudhibiti mafadhaiko unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Busia.

Dholuo: Ministry of Health parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar stress yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Busia.

English: Coffee farmers are urged to apply for the Kshs 3 billion Coffee Cherry Advance Fund available through New KPCU Society officials must sign forms to facilitate access
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa kahawa wamehimizwa kutuma maombi ya Kshs 3 bilioni Coffee Cherry Advance Fund inayopatikana kupitia New KPCU Society maafisa lazima watie sahihi fomu ili kuwezesha upatikanaji.
Somali: Beeraleyda kafeega waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay codsadaan Kshs 3 bilyan oo Coffee Cherry Advance Fund oo laga heli karo masuuliyiinta New KPCU Society waa inay saxiixaan foomamka si loo fududeeyo helitaanka
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma loso chai, ma gin jopur ma loso chai, jiwo mondo okonygi yudo pesa ma romo bilion 3 mag kony ma yudore e bengi mar New KPCU Society

English: COMESA warns rice farmers in Makueni County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawaonya wakulima wa mchele katika Kaunti ya Makueni dhidi ya mlipuko wa wadudu na inapendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: COMESA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda bariiska ee degmada Makueni cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyin waqtigeeda ah.
Dholuo: COMESA chiwo siem ne jopur loso loso loso kodhi e gweng ' mar Makueni kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni otim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges cassava growers in Turkana County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Turkana kudhibiti minyoo mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda cassava ee degmada Turkana inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka xilliga dayrta iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur ma pidho manija e County mar Turkana mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e higa ka gitiyo gi tuoche ma thiedho yien mondo okony e medo nyak mar yien e higani.

English: Continue breastfeeding during the night to meet baby_x0092_s nutrition needs and maintain milk supply.
Kiswahili: Endelea kunyonyesha usiku ili kutosheleza mahitaji ya lishe ya mtoto na kudumisha ugavi wa maziwa.

English: IEBC urges residents of Kericho County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: IEBC inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kericho mondo oriwre gi county's online participation portal e loso nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: Mental health is important in work places and successful service delivery. Prioritize mental health more than bodily priorities.
Kiswahili: Afya ya akili ni muhimu katika maeneo ya kazi na utoaji wa huduma wenye mafanikio. Panga afya ya akili zaidi ya vipaumbele vya mwili.
Somali: Caafimaadka maskaxda waa mid muhiim u ah meelaha shaqada iyo adeegyada guusha leh.
Dholuo: Bedo gi paro mowinjore e wi weche mag ngima en gima dwarore ahinya e tij lendo kendo miyo ng'ato obed gi ngima maber.

English: KUCCPS reminds parents in Migori County that free primary education registration is open this March.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Migori kwamba usajili wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo umefunguliwa Machi hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Migori in diiwaangelinta bilaashka ah ee waxbarashada hoose ay furan tahay bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: KUCCPS paronwa jonyuol manie County mar Migori ni somo mar pinyruoth ma onge chudo ochakore e dwe mar Mach.

English: Public notice: CDC will host a free hand hygiene outreach in Migori County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: CDC itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mikono bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Migori Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: CDC waxay marti gelineysaa dhaqdhaqaaqa nadaafadda gacmaha ee bilaashka ah ee Degmada Migori bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuoche (CDC) biro timo kampen mar rito ler mar lwedo e taon mar Migori e dwe mar Januar.

English: IEBC reminds the public in Turkana County that input on development planning forums is welcome this October.
Kiswahili: IEBC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba maoni juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo yanakaribishwa Oktoba hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Turkana in talooyinka ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta la soo dhaweynayo bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: IEBC oparo ne ji duto e County mar Turkana ni ji mor ahinya gi weche ma gichiwo e wi chenro mag dongruok e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response calls on parents in Siaya County to have children under five screened for measles during the August outreach.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuwafanya watoto chini ya miaka mitano wachunguzwe surua wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Agosti.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Siaya in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cirbadaha inta lagu gudajiro bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche kwayo jonyuol e county mar Siaya mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Agost.

English: Kajiado County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kajiado: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Mei 2024

English: NDMA calls on the community in Mandera County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: NDMA waxay bulshada degmada Mandera ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: NDMA luongo oganda man Mandera County mondo owuo e wi timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: KNEC urges youth in Bomet County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Bomet kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Bomet inay ka qaybqaataan munaasabadda dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo rowere e county mar Bomet mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gitimo gik ma biro timore ne oganda.

English: EACC urges residents of Migori County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Migori kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa wilaya ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya wilaya.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Migori inay ka qeybgalaan kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda horumarinta degmada.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jogweng'o mag Migori County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mag dongruok mag county.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development calls on the community in Lamu County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada Waxbarashada ayaa ugu baaqay bulshada degmada Lamu County inay u soo sheegaan arrimaha amniga maamulka dugsiga si ay u ilaaliyaan amniga dugsiyada.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oluongo oganda man Lamu County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar skul kuom weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: Notice: Council of Governors opens polling procedures centres in Taita-Taveta County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa furaya xarumaha nidaamyada codbixinta ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Bura mar Jaloch ochako tiyo gi chenro mar timo yiero e taon mar Taita-Taveta e dwe mar Jun.

English: KTDA informs avocado farmers in Kisumu County of new market linkage opportunities this June.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawafahamisha wakulima wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Juni hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda avocado ee degmada Kisumu fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Juun.
Dholuo: KTDA nyiso jopur mag avocado e gweng' mar Kisumu kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Jun.

English: TVET calls on the community in Vihiga County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TVET inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TVET waxay bulshada degmada Vihiga ugu baaqeysaa inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116 si ay u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: TVET okwayo ji duto manie County mar Vihiga mondo omany namba mar 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Council of Governors creates audio series on devolution matters.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana huandaa mfululizo wa sauti juu ya masuala ya uhamisho.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay sameeyaan taxane maqal ah oo ku saabsan arrimaha wareejinta.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch loso chenro mar golo pesa.

English: Laikipia County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for November 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Laikipia: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Novemba 2023
Somali: Degmada Laikipia: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Noofambar 2023

English: DCI reminds residents of West Pokot County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuzingatia vikomo vya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati wa msimu huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lugta lagu maro inta lagu jiro xilliyada dhulgariirada.
Dholuo: DCI parone jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo oti gi yore mag wuotho e kinde mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: NPS reminds residents of West Pokot County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah inta lagu jiro xilliyada dabka.
Dholuo: NPS parone jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji moa kuonde ma ji odakie e kinde mag yiengni.

English: Kenya Drought Response Dashboard (January to December 2023)
Kiswahili: Dashibodi ya Kukabiliana na Ukame Kenya (Januari hadi Desemba 2023)
Somali: Shaxda Jawaab celinta Abaaraha Kenya (Janaayo ilaa Diseembar 2023)
Dholuo: Dabod mar duoko mar oro e piny Kenya (dwe mar achiel nyaka dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2023)

English: KEMSA calls on parents in Nairobi County to have children under five screened for typhoid during the September outreach.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuwapima watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa homa ya matumbo wakati wa mawasiliano ya Septemba.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Nairobi inay caruurta ka yar shan sano ay baaritaan ku sameeyaan cudurka 'typhoid' inta lagu gudajiro bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KEMSA okwayo jonyuol e County mar Nairobi mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice from CDC: family planning counselling clinics will run every March at designated health centres in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa CDC: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Machi katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid CDC: rugta la talinta qorshaynta qoyska waxay ka shaqeyn doontaa Maarso kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Nandi.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar yedhe (CDC): kuonde thieth mag chenro mag ngima joot ibiro tiyoe e dwe mar Mach higa ka higa e kuonde ma thieth yudoree e county mar Nandi.

English: Council of Governors warns public officers in Baringo County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo dhidi ya udanganyifu wa mikopo.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ka digeen saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Baringo khiyaanooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e kaunti mar Baringo ni kik gitim mibadhi.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development invites youth in Nyeri County to enroll for catering and hospitality training this January.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu Januari hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku casuumay dhalinyarada degmada Nyeri inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ogwelo rowere man Nyeri County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar chiemo kod rwako welo e dwe mar Januar.

English: State Dept. affirming expansion of labs to enforce fortification and nutrient profiling in major food markets.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo ikithibitisha upanuzi wa maabara ili kutekeleza uimarishaji na uainishaji wa virutubisho katika masoko makubwa ya chakula.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda oo xaqiijisay ballaarinta shaybaarada si loo xoojiyo xoojinta iyo qaabeynta nafaqada suuqyada waaweyn ee cuntada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Piny owacho wacho ni ibiro med tiyo gi kembe mag timo nonro mondo omi olos kuonde madongo mag chamo chiemo.

English: IPOA warns residents of Busia County about a rise in identity theft and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: IPOA inaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia juu ya kuongezeka kwa wizi wa kitambulisho na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: IPOA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia kororka xadgudubka aqoonsiga waxayna kula talineysaa shacabka inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax falin.
Dholuo: IPOA chiwo siem ne jogweng' County mar Busia e wi medruok mar kuo mar kitgi kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: CDC calls on parents in Samburu County to have children under five screened for measles during the June outreach.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano wakati wa ufikiaji wa Juni.
Somali: CDC waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta gobolka Samburu in carruurta ka yar shan sano la baaro cudurka canabka ah intii lagu jiray bisha Juun.
Dholuo: CDC kwayo jonyuol e county mar Samburu mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Jun.
