English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Lamu County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu inay yareeyaan qaadashada cusbada iyo sonkorta si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso jogweng'o mag Lamu County ni giduog chien e chamo chumbi kod sukari mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche ma ok nyal geng'o.

English: KUCCPS reminds schools in Samburu County to strengthen inclusion of learners with disabilities this October.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuimarisha ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu Oktoba hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada Gobolka Samburu inay xoojiyaan ka mid noqoshada ardayda naafada ah bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KUCCPS oparo ne skunde e county mar Samburu mondo omed tiego jopuonjre ma nigi midekre e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Homa Bay County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo odonj e riwruok mar insuarans mar thieth mondo giyud thieth ma yudo kony.

English: Notice: NCPB restricts movement of pigs in Tana River County due to a rabies outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB inazuia harakati za nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Tana River kwa sababu ya mlipuko wa kichaa cha mbwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa doofaarka degmada Tana River sababo la xiriira cudurka cadho.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NCPB ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok e taon mar Tana River County nikech tuwo mar rabies.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds youth in Makueni County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya dhalinyarada degmada Makueni in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne rowere man Makueni County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar chiemo kod mar rwako welo.

English: IPOA urges the community in Samburu County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: IPOA inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Samburu kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada Gobolka Samburu inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo xannibaadda lo'da.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo ji duto manie county mar Samburu mondo oriwre gi chenro mag polis mar oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o kwalo jamni.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Medical Association will be held in Nyamira County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu bila malipo iliyoandaliwa na Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Nyamira bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma Kenya Medical Association ochano ibiro tim e County mar Nyamira e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will conduct a fertiliser application workshop for farmers in Kisii County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itafanya warsha ya maombi ya mbolea kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan codsiyada Bacriminta beeraleyda ee degmada Kisii bisha May.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro timo tiegruok mar tiyo gi yien mag yien ne jopur e County mar Kisii e dwe mar Mei.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on residents of Kitui County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawaomba wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kitui kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga si ay u taageeraan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross okwayo jogweng' Kitui County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma rito sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e alwora mar tong'gi.

English: CDC reminds expectant mothers in Samburu County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: CDC inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Samburu in helitaanka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: CDC parone mine ma biro bedo gi ich e county mar Samburu ni thuolo mar yudo kony mar chano ngima joot en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag sirkal.

English:
Did you know? Your sleep quality directly affects your mental health!

1.Aim for 7-9 hours of restful sleep each night.
2. Avoid stimulants like caffeine or drugs before bedÂ— they disrupt your ZzzÂ’s!
Prioritize your rest, recharge your mind, and wake up refreshed!
Kiswahili:
Ulijua? Ubora wa usingizi wako huathiri moja kwa moja afya yako ya akili!

1. Lenga kulala kwa saa 7-9 kila usiku.

2. Epuka vichocheo kama vile kafeini au dawa za kulevya kabla ya kulala—huvuruga mawazo yako!
Panga mapumziko yako, chaji akili yako, na uamke ukiwa umeburudika!
Somali:
Ma ogtahay? Tayada hurdadaadu waxay si toos ah u saamaysaa caafimaadkaaga maskaxda!

1. Ku dadaal 7-9 saacadood oo hurdo nasasho leh habeen kasta.
2. Ka fogow waxyaabaha kiciya sida kafeyn ama daroogooyinka ka hor intaadan seexan—waxay carqaladeeyaan Zzz-kaaga!
Mudnaan sii nasashadaada, maskaxdaada dib u cusboonaysii, oo soo kac adigoo firfircoon!
Dholuo:
Be ing'eyo? Kido mar nindo mari mulo ngimani mar paro!

1.Bed gi gombo mar nindo kuom seche 7-9 otieno ka otieno.
2. Weri gi gik ma kelo gombo kaka kafein kata yath kapok idonjo e nindo—gi ketho Zzz’s mari!
Ket yueyo mari obed mokuongo, chak pachi, kendo chiew ka in gi teko!

English: Smoke is harmful to expectant mothers and their unborn children. Keep homes clean safe from smoke
Kiswahili: Moshi ni hatari kwa mama wajawazito na watoto wao ambao hawajazaliwa.
Somali: Sigaarku wuxuu khatar ku yahay hooyooyinka uurka leh iyo carruurtooda aan dhalan.
Dholuo: Madho ndawa nyalo hinyo mine ma nigi ich kod nyithindgi mapok onyuol.

Kiswahili: Hapa ndio unahitaji kujua kuhusu jinsi ya kuvaa mask ya uso vizuri. #KomeshaCorona

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds residents of Busia County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Busia in si dhakhso leh u soo sheegaan jabsashada ay gacan ka geystaan ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne jogweng' mar County mar Busia ni nyiso ji mapiyo kaka ne gidonjo e odno konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: KICD reminds schools in Mandera County to strengthen inclusion of learners with disabilities this January.
Kiswahili: KICD inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuimarisha ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu Januari hii.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Mandera inay xoojiyaan ka mid noqoshada ardayda naafada ah bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: KICD paronwa skunde man Mandera County mondo omed tiego jopuonjre ma nigi midekre e dwe mar Januar.

Kiswahili: Angalia umbali wa kijamii, osha mikono yako, vaa vinyago na ukae nyumbani ikiwezekana, ili kuzuia virusi kuenea. Tunaongeza uwezo wa kufuatilia mipaka ya vinyweleo; Dk Rashid Aman. #KomeshaCorona sasisho

English: Farmers in Nyeri County are encouraged to consider maize as fodder for dairy cows as it has advantages over napier grass for silage making
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri wanahimizwa kuzingatia mahindi kama lishe ya ng'ombe wa maziwa kwani yana faida zaidi ya nyasi ya napier kwa kutengeneza silage.
Somali: Beeraleyda Gobolka Nyeri waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay galleyda u tixgeliyaan sidii cunto lo'da caanaha ah maadaama ay leedahay faa'iidooyin marka loo eego cawska napier ee samaynta silage
Dholuo: Jo-Farmer e County mar Nyeri ijiwo mondo okwan cham kaka chiemb dhok makwayo pi, nimar en gi ber moloyo lum makwayo e loso silage

English: DPP calls on residents of Busia County to support local peace-building committees in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: DPP inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani kwa msaada wa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: DPP waxay dadka deggan degmada Busia ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee deegaanka si ay u taageerayaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: DPP okwayo jogweng' mar County mar Busia mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gwenge ma gidakie mondo gikony e chiwo siem motelo ne oganda.

English: DCI calls on the community in Bungoma County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatia moyo jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: DCI waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Bungoma inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan waxayna ka raadsadaan taageero guryaha ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: DCI okwayo ji duto manie Bungoma County mondo owuo e wi timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo mondo giyud kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Kajiado County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kuthibitisha kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay xaqiijiyaan in xaruntooda la aqoonsaday ka hor inta aysan booqan si ay u helaan daryeelka caafimaadka ee lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMSA nyiso jogweng' Kajiado County mondo ong'e ni kuondegi mag thieth oseyudo ratiro kapok gibiro mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Notice: SHA launches ward-level service delivery in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Shirika la SHA linazindua huduma za huduma katika wilaya ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Shirkadda SHA waxay bilaabaneysaa bixinta adeegyada heerka qaybta gobolka Bomet.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova (SHA) chako lendo e alwora mar Bomet County.

English: NDMA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Homa Bay County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NDMA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Wilaya ya Homa Bay kutafuta msaada katika nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka gobolka Homa Bay inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo tembe e Homa Bay County mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Notice: KUCCPS announces school feeding programme enrollment dates for schools in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa programu ya kulisha shule kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiyada degmada Garissa.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KUCCPS ogolo chenro mar somo e skunde mag Garissa County.

English: NGEC advocates for equal representation of women in elective posts.
Kiswahili: NGEC inapendekeza uwakilishi sawa wa wanawake katika nafasi za uchaguzi.
Somali: NGEC waxay u doodaa matalaadda siman ee haweenka ee jagooyinka doorashada.
Dholuo: NGEC jiwo ni mon obed gi migawo maromre e migepe mag yiero.

English: Kenya Dairy Board announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Uasin Gishu County this February.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya yatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Februari hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhawaaqay jimicsi tallaal oo bilaash ah oo cudurka Newcastle ah oo loogu talagalay lo'da caanaha ee Gobolka Uasin Gishu bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board olando chenro mar thiedho dhok ma nigi tuo mar Newcastle maonge chudo e dwe mar Februar e county mar Uasin Gishu.

English: FAO reminds livestock keepers in Garissa County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee Gobolka Garissa in ay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska xayawaanada ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: FAO parone jopur mag jamni e gweng' mar Garissa ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni kodgi mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges maize growers in Isiolo County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kudhibiti minyoo mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Isiolo inay si hore u xakameeyaan xayawaanka ciidanka xilliga dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo waxsoosaarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur ma pidho cham e gweng' mar Isiolo mondo oti gi yedhe makelo hinyruok e kinde machuok ka gitiyo gi tuoche makelo tuoche mamono mondo gimed nyak e higani.

English: Opposition leaders demanded the presidentâ€™s resignation after he appeared to endorse shoot-on-sight rhetoric during protests.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa upinzani walimtaka rais kujiuzulu baada ya yeye kuonekana kuunga mkono hotuba ya risasi wakati wa maandamano.
Somali: Hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka ayaa dalbaday in madaxweynaha uu is casilo ka dib markii uu u muuqday inuu taageeray hadallada rasaasta ee ka dhanka ah dadka dibadbaxyada dhigaya.
Dholuo: Jotelo mag loch ma ne ochung' ne loch ne odwaro ni jatend pinyno ogol tich bang' ka ne onenore ni oyie gi weche ma ne ji wacho ni ng'ato ka ng'ato ka ng'ato ka ng'ato e kinde ma ne itimoe gik ma ok owinjore.

English: To differentiate, farming using CSA has three pillars: increase yields progressively, profitable produce and build resilience.
Kiswahili: Ili kutofautisha, kilimo kwa kutumia CSA kina nguzo tatu: kuongeza mavuno hatua kwa hatua, mazao yenye faida na kujenga uthabiti.
Somali: Si loo kala saaro, beeraha isticmaalaya CSA wuxuu leeyahay saddex tiir: si tartiib tartiib ah u kordhinta wax soo saarka, wax soo saarka faa'iido leh iyo dhisida adkeysiga.
Dholuo: Mondo mi mi miwa pogruok, pur ma tiyo gi CSA nigi tungni adek: medore mos mos nyak, nyago olemo ma kelo ohala, kendo gero teko mar nano.

English: EACC invites residents of Nakuru County to attend the public participation forum regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: EACC inakaribisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: EACC waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: EACC gwelo jogweng' Nakuru County mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenro mag dongruok.

English: Kenya Gazette announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kuajiri kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku dhawaaqay waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette olando lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mag ng'eyo kit oganda e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: E-Citizen reminds voters in Wajir County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Wajir kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha Gobolka Wajir inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor inta aan la samayn nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa jogweng' Wajir mondo olim kama ichikoe ji ne IEBC motelo kapok itimo yiero.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) encourages farmers in Nyeri County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for milk.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishiwa kupata bei bora ya maziwa.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyeri inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo caano ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e county mar Nyeri mondo oti gi nengo mar piny moseketo mondo omi ohala mar chak obed maber.

English: Notice: IPOA activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay shilalka waddooyinka ee Gobolka Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Rapar: IPOA tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne masiche mag ndara e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia.

English: AFA informs tea farmers in Nyandarua County of new market linkage opportunities this May.
Kiswahili: AFA inawafahamisha wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Mei hii.
Somali: AFA waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee gobolka Nyandarua fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha May.
Dholuo: AFA nyiso jopur mag chai e County mar Nyandarua e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: NPS activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NPS inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab degdeg ah oo loogu talagalay shilalka waddooyinka ee Gobolka Laikipia.
Dholuo: Rapar: NPS tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne masiche mag ndara e County mar Laikipia.

English: COMESA invites farmers in Baringo County to a free training on post-harvest handling this October.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Baringo kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno Oktoba hii.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Baringo tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan maareynta goosashada ka dib bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: COMESA ogwelo jopur e gweng' mar Baringo e tiegruok ma onge chudo e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens a new service point for passport services in West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Wilaya ya West Pokot.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee Gobolka West Pokot.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya oseyawo kamachielo mar tiyo gi passport e West Pokot County.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds mobile money users in Murang'a County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Murang'a inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne jogo matiyo gi pesa mobil e County mar Murang'a ni mondo ging'e kwayo mag pesa kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo gitang' gi chenro mag gwelo pesa mag miriambo.

English: NCPB advises farmers in Murang'a County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Murang'a inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e County mar Murang'a mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will open a tea collection centre in Nandi County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itafungua kituo cha kukusanya chai katika Kaunti ya Nandi Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay xarun soo uruurinaysa shaaha ka furi doontaa gobolka Nandi bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro chako loso chai e taon mar Nandi e dwe mar Jun.

English: IEBC encourages out-of-school children in Tana River County to register their children at the nearest public school under free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Tana River kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Tana River inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha ee waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e taon mar Tana River County mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni kodgi e skul mar sekondari.

English: IEBC urges youth in Taita-Taveta County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Taita-Taveta inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo rowere man Taita-Taveta County mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gichako timo tije mag sirkal.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Makueni County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the July planting season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Julai.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Makueni inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development nyiso jopur e county mar Makueni ni giti gi ratiro mar yien kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Julai.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds residents of Homa Bay County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti huimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay in ka qaybgalka kalfadhiga guud ee shirka gobolka uu xoojiyo maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) paronwa jogweng' Homa Bay County ni dhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: FAO announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for pigs in Machakos County this March.
Kiswahili: FAO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Machakos Machi hii.
Somali: FAO waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan rabshadaha loogu talagalay doofaarka gobolka Machakos bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar chiemo kod yedhe ma loso yedhe (FAO) olando chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar rabies ne le e gweng' mar Machakos e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: TSC reminds citizens in Nairobi County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Nairobi xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: TSC paronwa raia mag Nairobi County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo gi ji duto e bajet mag county.

English: Office of the Auditor-General invites residents of Nakuru County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inakaribisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kushiriki kupitia portal ya kushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusu ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General ogwelo jogweng' Nakuru County mondo oriwre kodgi e nono tich ma gitimo higa ka higa kokalo kuom websait mar county.

English: NDMA warns residents of Mandera County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera juu ya kuongezeka kwa kashfa za pesa za rununu na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: NDMA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera kororka khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aanay wax ka qaban.
Dholuo: NDMA osiemo jogweng'o mag Mandera County kuom medruok mar timbe mag wuondo pesa mag simo kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: The Sugar Bill has been signed to revitalize Kenya s sugar industry farmers and stakeholders should stay informed on upcoming regulations and opportunities
Kiswahili: Mswada wa Sukari umetiwa saini ili kufufua wakulima wa sekta ya sukari nchini Kenya na washikadau wanapaswa kufahamishwa kuhusu kanuni na fursa zijazo
Somali: Sharciga Sonkorta ayaa la saxiixay si loo noolaado warshadaha sonkorta Kenya beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha waa inay sii joogaan warbixin ku saabsan xeerarka iyo fursadaha soo socda
Dholuo: Chik mar Sugar Bill osendik mondo okony jopur mag Kenya e loso sukari kendo jogo madwaro ni gibed gi winjruok maber gi jopur mag Kenya onego ong'e chike kod thuolo ma biro yudo jopur mag sukari

English: CDC urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Lamu County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: CDC inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: CDC waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee gobolka Lamu inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nyagore gi tuoche mag obwongo e County mar Lamu mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County of the ongoing fertiliser application training programme.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya mpango unaoendelea wa mafunzo ya matumizi ya mbolea.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa beeraleyda Degmada Tharaka-Nithi barnaamijka tababarka codsiga bacriminta ee socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service oparo ne jopur e Tharaka-Nithi County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar tiyo gi yien.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development announces distribution of textbooks and learning materials to schools in Samburu County this June.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yatangaza usambazaji wa vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Samburu Juni hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada Waxbarashada ayaa ku dhawaaqay in buugaag iyo qalab waxbarasho loo qaybiyo dugsiyada Gobolka Samburu bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok e skunde man Samburu County e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Kajiado County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kajiado County mwezi huu wa Septemba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu qabtaa warbixin bulsho ku saabsan dhismaha nabadda qaranka ee Gobolka Kajiado bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Forest Service timo romo mar oganda e wi loso kuwe e piny Kajiado County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: Universities Fund opens a new tailoring and design programme at the vocational centre in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unafungua programu mpya ya ushonaji na muundo katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ka furayaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan qaabeynta iyo qaabeynta xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Migori.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Yunivasiti Fund chako chenro manyien mar loso piche kendo loso gik moko e skul mar tich e county mar Migori.

English: Notice: KEPHIS restricts movement of poultry in Murang'a County due to an anthrax outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS inazuia harakati za kuku katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kutokana na mlipuko wa kimeta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa digaagga degmada Murang'a sababo la xiriira cudurka anthrax.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok e County mar Murang'a nikech tuwo mar anthrax.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds voters in Kiambu County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa xasuusinaya codbixiyayaasha degmada Kiambu inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties parone jogweng' Kiambu County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go ka gitiyo gi sms e simo mar 70000 kapok kinde mar yiero ochopo.

English: Building Evidence to Enhance the Welfare of Refugees and Host Communities in Kenya
Kiswahili: Kujenga Ushahidi wa Kuimarisha Maslahi ya Wakimbizi na Jamii Wenyeji Nchini Kenya

English: Huduma Kenya invites residents of Siaya County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kushiriki kupitia portal ya kushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee la xiriira wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya gwelo joma odak e county mar Siaya mondo oriwre gi county's online participation portal e wi chenro mag siasa.

English: Notice: IEBC reminds citizens in Narok County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Narok kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Narok ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC paronwa raia mag Narok County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar konyo ji e weche mag pesa.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges sheep farmers in Turkana County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wafugaji wa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa ngozi wa uvimbe ulioripotiwa.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda idaha ee degmada Turkana inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur mag rombe e county mar Turkana mondo onyis jatuo matuwo e ofis mar thieth man machiegni kodgi bang' ka osenyis ni gin gi tuoche mag dhoot.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds the public in Mandera County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadweynaha gobolka Mandera in sheegashada khiyaamooyinka iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone ji duto man Mandera County ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag yuto en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: KRA reminds the public in Kirinyaga County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Kirinyaga in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: KRA paronwa ji duto e County mar Kirinyaga ni lando wach tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'.

English: Special announcement through media houses through DHS robots have confirmed reduction; warning has been issued to increase delivery services in all maternity ward centres.
Kiswahili: Tangazo maalum kupitia nyumba za vyombo vya habari kupitia roboti za DHS zimethibitisha kupunguzwa; onyo limechapishwa ili kuongeza huduma za kujifungua katika vituo vyote vya uzazi.
Somali: Ogeysiis gaar ah oo laga soo saaray guryaha warbaahinta iyada oo loo marayo aaladda DHS ayaa xaqiijisay in la yareeyay; digniin ayaa la soo saariyay si loo kordhiyo adeegyada dhalmada dhammaan xarumaha xarumaha hooyada.
Dholuo: Chenro makende mar lando wach kokalo kuom ot milandoe weche kokalo kuom robot mag DHS osenyiso ni kwan mar nyithindo osedok chien; oseng'ad siem mondo omed miyo nyithindo nyuol e gwenge duto mag nyuol.

English: IEBC reminds residents of Siaya County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba upatikanaji wa usajili wa e-Citizen sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya in helitaanka diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: IEBC parone jogweng'o mag Siaya County ni yudo e-Citizen registration koro yot ahinya kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal.

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit warns of increased dengue fever risk in Marsabit County and advises the public to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya homa ya dengue katika Kaunti ya Marsabit na inashauri umma kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ka digtay khatarta dhimashada cudurka dengue ee ka jirta degmada Marsabit waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakhda leh.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar oganda: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osiemo ji kuom medruok mar tuwo mar dengue e county mar Marsabit kendo osiemo jopiny mondo kik giriwre gi pi mochido.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free cyclosporiasis screening is available at all public health centres in Baringo County this January.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa cyclosporiasis unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo Januari hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka bilaashka ah ee cyclosporiasis laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Baringo bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji ni thieth mar cyclosporiasis onge chudo e kuonde thieth mag ji duto e Baringo County e dwe mar Januar.

English: FAO urges coffee growers in Machakos County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawataka wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Machakos kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Machakos inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu talinayo roobka ka hor si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e gweng' mar Machakos mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue mondo omed kelo nyak e higani.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada ee Degmada Mandera.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura mar Kenya biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e county mar Mandera.

English: NPS urges the community in Kisii County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb fraud.
Kiswahili: NPS inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Kisii kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia udanganyifu.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Kisii inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo khiyaamooyinka.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo oganda ma Kisii County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o mibadhi.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Nyandarua County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the April planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji Aprili.
Somali: Guddiga Waxsoosaarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Nyandarua inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products nyiso jopur e County mar Nyandarua ni giti gi ratiro mag yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar April.

English: IEBC reminds residents of Isiolo County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo in ay ku hawlan yihiin maamulahooda degmada si ay u xoojiyaan maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: IEBC paronwa jogweng' Isiolo County ni tiyo gi jaritgi mar alwora jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Uasin Gishu County starting this July.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuanzia Julai hii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa ku dhawaaqday in laga bilaabo bisha Luulyo ee soo socota la siinayo dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) ogolo chenro mar keto thieth mar dialysis kuom joma odak e county mar Uasin Gishu kochakore dwe mar Julai.

English: AFA reminds farmers in Narok County of the ongoing modern irrigation techniques training programme.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Narok barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah.
Dholuo: AFA oparo ne jopur man Narok County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar yore mag lero pi.

English: Public notice: Kenya Medical Association will host a free hand hygiene outreach in Nyamira County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu qabanqaabi doonaa dhaqdhaqaaqa nadaafadda gacmaha ee bilaashka ah ee degmada Nyamira bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association biro timo kampen mar rito ler mar lwedo e taon mar Nyamira e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka Kajiado waxay furaysaa codsiyada deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan ardayda.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Department of State for Basic Education oyawo kwayo mar yudo osuru ne jopuonjre man gi chan e Kajiado County.

English: Scoping the cash and climate landscape in East Africa and Kenya: focusing on Cash and Anticipatory Action
Kiswahili: Kuweka mawanda ya fedha na hali ya hewa katika Afrika Mashariki na Kenya: kwa kuzingatia Pesa na Hatua ya Kutarajia
Somali: Qiimaynta xaaladda lacagta iyo cimilada ee Bariga Afrika iyo Kenya: diiradda saarista Lacagta Caddaan ah iyo Waxqabadka La Filayo
Dholuo: Kuong’o pesa kod chal mar piny e Afrika ma Wuokchieng’ kod Kenya: keto pach kuom pesa kod gik ma ibiro timo

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will open a horticultural produce collection centre in Nyandarua County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Januari hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu bilaabi doonaa xarun ururinta alaabada beeraha ee Gobolka Nyandarua bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro yawo kama ichokoe cham mag puodho e County mar Nyandarua e dwe mar Januar.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free cholera screening is available at all public health centres in Tana River County this April.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kipindupindu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Tana River Aprili hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka fayraska ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynta ee degmada Tana River bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche parone ji ni nonro ma onge cholera yudore e kuonde thieth duto e taon mar Tana River County e dwe mar April.

English: IEBC updates residents of Mandera County on progress of ward-level service delivery this September.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera juu ya maendeleo ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya mwezi Septemba.
Somali: IEBC waxay cusbooneysiineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera horumarka adeegga heerka degmada bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: IEBC osemiyo jodak mag Mandera County ng'eyo dongruok mar tij chiwo kony e wi ward e dwe mar Septemba.

English: specialized hospitals like Othaya & KU Teaching Research & Referral Hospital HPV & Malaria vaccine strengthened HRM by expanding KMTC review of national pharmaceutical policy Cuban doctors mental health taskforce NHIF & Kemsa reforms
Kiswahili: hospitali maalum kama Othaya & KU Kufundisha Utafiti na Hospitali ya Rufaa ya HPV & Malaria chanjo iliimarishwa HRM kwa kupanua ukaguzi wa KMTC wa sera ya kitaifa ya dawa Madaktari wa Cuba kikosi kazi cha afya ya akili NHIF & Kemsa
Somali: Isbitaalada gaarka ah sida Othaya & KU Cilmi-baarista Waxbaridda & Tixraaca Isbitaalka Tallaalka HPV & Duumada ayaa xoojiyay HRM iyadoo la ballaarinayo dib u eegista KMTC ee siyaasadda dawooyinka qaranka ee dhakhaatiirta Cuba ee shaqada caafimaadka dhimirka ee NHIF & Kemsa.
Dholuo: Osiptal makende kaka Othaya kod KU puonjo nonro kod osiptal mar oro jotuo mamoko.

English: Public health advisory: KEMRI warns of increased typhoid risk in Baringo County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMRI inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya matumbo katika Kaunti ya Baringo na inashauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Talobixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: KEMRI waxay ka digeysaa khatarta sii kordheysa ee cudurka 'typhoid' ee Gobolka Baringo waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: KEMRI chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar typhoid e county mar Baringo kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore mar konyo e thieth.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds residents of Uasin Gishu County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha uzalishaji wa muda mrefu wa shamba.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan gobolka Uasin Gishu in ilaalinta ciidda ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board oparo ne jogweng' Uasin Gishu County ni rito lowo miyo puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: State Department for Basic Education conducts a civic education forum on voter registration in Bungoma County this March.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Bungoma mwezi huu Machi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha degmada Bungoma bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiegruok mar ji duto e dwe mar Mach e county mar Bungoma.

English: IPOA calls on the community in Siaya County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Siaya kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: IPOA waxay bulshada degmada Siaya ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: IPOA luongo ji duto e county mar Siaya mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gidwar kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Kenya Gazette updates residents of Garissa County on progress of the county integrated development plan this August.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawasilisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti hii mwezi Agosti.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Garissa ka warbixiyaa horumarka qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette osemiyo jopiny mar Garissa ong'eyo dongruok mar chenro mar dongruok mar county e dwe mar Agost.

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Tana River County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun iyo biyo nadiif ah si joogto ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso joma odak e taon mar Tana River County mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche ma ok nyal geng'o.

English: FAO reminds livestock keepers in Makueni County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Makueni inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: FAO parone jopur mag jamni e gweng' mar Makueni mondo ogeng'gi gi tuoche e kuonde moyier mag nego jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: TVET reminds schools in Machakos County to strengthen child protection in schools this July.
Kiswahili: TVET inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuimarisha ulinzi wa watoto shuleni Julai hii.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Machakos inay xoojiyaan ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada bisha July.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa skunde mag Machakos County mondo omed jiwo rit mar nyithindo e skunde e dwe mar Julai.

English: Public health advisory: KEMSA warns of increased malaria risk in Kisumu County and advises the public to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMSA inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya malaria katika Kaunti ya Kisumu na inashauri umma kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa.
Somali: Talobixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: KEMSA waxay ka digtay kororka halista daacuunka ee degmada Kisumu waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay dhammaystiraan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagula talinayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: KEMSA chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar malaria e County mar Kisumu kendo ojiwo ji duto mondo otiek dose duto mar thiedho.

English: ODPP urges residents of Machakos County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda horumarinta degmada.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Machakos mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi chenro mag dongruok.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Kisumu County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kuwasilisha maandishi ya kumbukumbu kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga loo dhigay si loo qaabeeyo dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' mar Kisumu County mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso nonro mar tich mar higa ka higa.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges motorists and pedestrians in Murang'a County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa gawaarida iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Murang'a inay u hoggaansamaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha deegaanka si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira dabka.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo derebe kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Murang'a mondo oluw chike mag wuotho ma jotelo mag gweng'no ogolo mondo gikwed hinyruok mag yiengni.

English: There is no shame in seeking help for depression. In fact, seeking help is a sign of strength, not weakness. If you or someone you know is struggling with depression, please reach out to a mental health professional or a crisis hotline
Kiswahili: Hakuna aibu kutafuta msaada kwa ajili ya mfadhaiko. Kwa kweli, kutafuta msaada ni ishara ya nguvu, si udhaifu. Ikiwa wewe au mtu unayemjua anapambana na mfadhaiko, tafadhali wasiliana na mtaalamu wa afya ya akili au simu ya dharura ya dharura.
Somali: Haddii adiga ama qof aad taqaanid uu la halgamayo niyadjab, fadlan la xiriir xirfadle caafimaad maskaxeed ama khadka tooska ah ee xaaladaha dhibaatada.
Dholuo: Ka in kata ng'ato ing'eyo ma nyagore gi tuwo mar depression, tudri gi laktar molony e weche thieth mar paro kata achiel kuom joma wuoyo gi ji e simo.

English: Kenya, Rwanda strengthen their defences against antimicrobial resistance
Kiswahili: Kenya, Rwanda kuimarisha ulinzi wao dhidi ya ukinzani wa antimicrobial
Somali: Kenya iyo Rwanda oo xoojiyay difaacooda ka dhanka ah iska caabbinta jeermiska dila
Dholuo: Kenya kod Rwanda jiwo arita margi mar geng'o tuoche mago tuoche

English: Notice: AFA will distribute certified millet seed to farmers in Kiambu County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: AFA waxay abuuraha degmada Kiambu u qaybin doontaa abuurka miraha shahaadada leh bisha Diseembar ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: AFA biro pogo kodhi mag millet ne jopur man Kiambu County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Ministry of Education advises students in Meru County to collect materials from the county education office to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Meru kukusanya vifaa kutoka ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ardayda degmada Meru kula talineysaa inay ka soo ururiyaan agab xafiiska waxbarashada degmada si ay u helaan buugaagta waxbarasho iyo agab waxbarasho.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jopuonjre e kaunti mar Meru mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar tiegruok mar kaunti mondo giyud buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok.

English: Kenya Dairy Board informs tea farmers in Nakuru County of new market linkage opportunities this December.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawafahamisha wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Desemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku wargalinayaa beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Nakuru fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur ma loso chai e kaunti mar Nakuru thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) opens voter education centres in Bomet County this February.

Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhusu kuongezeka kwa visa vya wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.

Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.

English: Ministry of Health encourages mothers in Mombasa County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.

Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Garissa kushiriki katika utaratibu wa kupiga kura.

Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro mar yiero e County mar Garissa mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag yiero.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free typhoid screening is available at all public health centres in Marsabit County this February.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa matumbo bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Februari hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka tifooska ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Marsabit bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: KEMSA oparo ne ji ni thieth mar typhoid ma onge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto mag ji e County mar Marsabit e dwe mar Februar.

English: CDC reminds the public that free meningitis screening is available at all public health centres in Samburu County this July.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa uti wa mgongo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Samburu Julai hii.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka meningitis-ka ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka guud ee Gobolka Samburu bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji ni nono tuo mar meningitis en gima nono e kuonde thieth duto mag oganda e county mar Samburu e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on the community in Embu County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Embu kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqayaa bulshada degmada Embu inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan isla markaana ay taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service luongo joma odak e county mar Embu mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gidwar kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Migori County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa mkulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kula talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Migori inay keenaan lambarka diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qayb galaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e county mar Migori mondo okel namba mar register mar jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to participate in new opportunities under the Bottom Up Economic Transformation Agenda BETA for agricultural reforms and sugar sector revitalization
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kushiriki katika fursa mpya chini ya Agenda ya Mabadiliko ya Kiuchumi ya Bottom Up BETA kwa ajili ya mageuzi ya kilimo na ufufuaji wa sekta ya sukari.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay ka qayb qaataan fursado cusub oo hoos yimaada Barnaamijka Isbeddelka Dhaqaalaha ee Bottom Up BETA ee dib-u-habaynta beeraha iyo dib-u-soo-nooleynta warshadaha sonkorta
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma tiyo e tije mag pur gi pur jiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo thuolo manyien mag timo lokruok e yore mag ohala e piny mangima e bwo chenro mar BETA mar loso dongruok e yore mag ohala kod loso ngima manyien mar ohala

English:
Mombasa Covid-19 Booths: 
Contactless testing booths to be distributed in 6 constituencies. Booths have zero contact between the medic and patient. Contactless booths allow for safer, faster mass testing. The locally assembled booths are a game changer
Kiswahili:
Vibanda vya Mombasa Covid-19:

Vibanda vya kupima bila kugusa vitasambazwa katika majimbo 6 ya uchaguzi. Vibanda havina mguso wowote kati ya daktari na mgonjwa. Vibanda visivyogusa vinaruhusu upimaji salama na wa haraka wa wingi. Vibanda vilivyokusanyika ndani ya eneo husika vinabadilisha mchezo.
Somali: Mombasa COVID-19 Booths: Goobaha tijaabada ah ee aan xiriir laheyn ayaa lagu qaybin doonaa 6 goobood. Booths waxay leeyihiin xiriir la'aan u dhexeeya dhakhtarka iyo bukaanka. Goobta isgaarsiinta la'aanta waxay u oggolaaneysaa baaritaano badan oo ammaan ah, oo dhakhso badan. Goobooyinka lagu soo ururiyay deegaanka ayaa beddelaya ciyaarta
Dholuo: Mombasa Covid-19 Booths: Booths mag nonro maonge tudruok ibiro pog e alwora auchiel. Booths onge tudruok e kind laktar kod jatuo. Booth ma onge tudrruok miyo ji thuolo mar timo nonro e okang' mapiyo kendo ma nigi ritruok.

English: CDC reminds the public that free dengue fever screening is available at all public health centres in Baringo County this January.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa homa ya dengue unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo Januari hii.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka hargabka dengue ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynta ee degmada Baringo bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji ni nono tuwo mar dengue maonge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e Baringo County e dwe mar Januar.

English: EACC reminds residents of Kitui County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kitui kwamba kufikia usajili wa e-Citizen sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui in helitaanka diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.

Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu Septemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka ayaa ku casuumay dhalinyarada degmada West Pokot inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta bisha Sebtember.
