Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay adeegaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah xilligan abaarta.
Dholuo: DCI parone jogweng'o mag Bomet County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji e alwora ma gidakie e kinde mar oro.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) invites farmers in Samburu County to a free training on fertiliser application this January.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu kupata mafunzo ya bure juu ya matumizi ya mbolea Januari hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku casuumaysaa beeraleyda gobolka Samburu inay tababar bilaash ah ku helaan isticmaalka Bacriminta bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Jatelo mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) ogwelo jopur e county mar Samburu e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi tiyo gi yien e dwe mar Januar.

English: NPS calls on the community in Bomet County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatia moyo jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuongea dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: NPS waxay bulshada degmada Bomet ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan oo ay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: NPS okwayo ji duto e county mar Bomet mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo onyis ji weche mag mahundu e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: State Department for Basic Education calls on the community in Murang'a County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Murang'a inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ku lug leh si loo ilaaliyo nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education oluongo ji duto manie County mar Murang'a mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ngima maber e skunde.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds residents of Bomet County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba kufikia utunzaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone jogweng'o mag Bomet County ni koro yot yudo weche mag nyuol ka gitiyo gi yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds voters in Siaya County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa xasuusinaya codbixiyayaasha degmada Siaya in ay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka ilaa 70000 ka hor inta aysan helin waxbarasho codbixinayaasha.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties parone jogweng' Siaya County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom SMS ne ji 70000 kapok giyudo tiegruok.

English: DCI reminds the public in Mandera County to remain vigilant on counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka gobolka Mandera in ay sii joogaan feejignaanta ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: DCI paronwa ji duto e County mar Mandera ni gibed motang' ahinya e weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Breastfeeding is foundational for both child survival and maternal health.
Kiswahili: Kunyonyesha ni msingi wa maisha ya mtoto na afya ya uzazi.
Somali: Naas-nuujintu waa aasaaska badbaadada ilmaha iyo caafimaadka hooyada labadaba.
Dholuo: Chiwo thuno en gima duong’ ahinya e ngima mar nyathi kod ngima mar min.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges farmers in Bomet County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa ku boorinaya beeraleyda degmada Bomet inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo soo-saarka biyaha ee beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e county mar Bomet mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok mar koth.

English: IEBC collaborates with universities on voter education research.
Kiswahili: IEBC inashirikiana na vyuo vikuu katika utafiti wa elimu ya wapiga kura.
Somali: IEBC waxay la shaqeysaa jaamacadaha cilmi baarista waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: IEBC tiyo kanyachiel gi yunivasiti e timo nonro e wi tiegruok mar josiasa.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri katika shule kote Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij hagis iyo adeegyo la-talin ah oo ku yaal dugsiyada degmada Murang'a.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development chako chenro mar tayo kendo chiwo paro e skunde duto mag County mar Murang'a.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds residents of Nairobi County that terracing improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba usafirishaji wa mimea huboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan Gobolka Nairobi in dhulka lagu beero uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service parone jogweng' mar Nairobi County ni tiyo gi puodho mar terracing miyo puodho bedo maber kuom kinde malach.

English: Kenyan farmers are encouraged to participate in the EU funded Market Access Upgrade Programme MARKUP to enhance agricultural exports and meet international standards
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Kenya wanahimizwa kushiriki katika Mpango wa Uboreshaji wa Ufikiaji Soko unaofadhiliwa na EU MARKUP ili kuimarisha mauzo ya nje ya kilimo na kufikia viwango vya kimataifa.
Somali: Beeraleyda Kenya waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay ka qaybqaataan Barnaamijka MARKUP ee kor u qaadista marin u helka suuqa ee ay maalgeliso Midowga Yurub si loo xoojiyo dhoofinta beeraha loona buuxiyo heerarka caalamiga ah
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma Kenya ijiwo mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar MARKUP mar timo dongruok e weche mag ohala ma yudo kony kuom chenro mar EU mar timo dongruok e weche mag ohala kendo chopo chike mag pinje

English: Ministry of Health calls on parents in Kericho County to have children under five screened for HIV/AIDS during the January outreach.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa VVU/UKIMWI wakati wa mawasiliano ya Januari.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Kericho in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro HIV/AIDS intii lagu jiray bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health okwayo jonyuol e County mar Kericho mondo otim nonro mar HIV/AIDS ne nyithindgi ma hikgi tin ne abich e dwe mar Januar.

English: NTSA urges residents of Makueni County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta deegaanka iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo jogweng' Makueni County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gweng'no e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada la hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth ma onge chudo mar oganda mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development encourages farmers in Mandera County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for milk.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kupata bei bora ya maziwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda Degmada Mandera inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo caano ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur man Mandera County mondo oti gi nengo matin mar chak mondo omi ohala mar chak obed maber.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds expectant mothers in Nyamira County that access to postnatal check-ups is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba upatikanaji wa uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Nyamira in helitaanka baaritaannada dhalmada ka dib ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Nyamira ni dhi e nonro mag nyuol en gima onge chudo e kuonde duto mag oganda.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inafungua ofisi ya kijinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya ayaa furtay xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya taageero maskaxeed iyo bulsheed degmada Mombasa.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji ochako ofis ma chiwo kony e weche mag pach ji e county mar Mombasa.

English: Counties are urged to integrate violent extremism prevention into development programs.
Kiswahili: Kaunti zinahimizwa kuingiza kuzuia vurugu katika mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Degmooyinka waxaa lagu baaqayaa inay ka hortagga xagjirnimada rabshadaha ku darsadaan barnaamijyada horumarinta.
Dholuo: Ijiwo kaunti mondo oriw geng'o timbe mahundu e chenro mag dongruok.

English: We are urging any person visiting a supermarket or open air market to put on a mask to protect and prevent the spread COVID19; CS Kagwe #KomeshaCorona update
Kiswahili: Tunamsihi mtu yeyote anayetembelea duka kubwa au soko la wazi avae barakoa ili kulinda na kuzuia kuenea kwa COVID19; CS Kagwe #KomeshaCorona sasisho
Somali: Waxaan ku boorinaynaa qof kasta oo booqanaya suuq weyn ama suuq furan inuu xidho maaskaro si loo ilaaliyo loogana hortago faafitaanka COVID19; Cusboonaysiinta CS Kagwe #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Wakwayo ng'ato ang'ata ma dhi e duka maduong' kata chiro ma oyaw mondo oket mask mar rito kendo geng'o lalruok mar COVID19; CS Kagwe #KomeshaCorona manyien

English: Â£15 million funding to strengthen health workforce in Kenya, Nigeria and Ghana
Kiswahili: Pauni milioni 15 za ufadhili wa kuimarisha nguvu kazi ya afya nchini Kenya, Nigeria na Ghana
Somali: 15 milyan oo ginni oo maalgelin ah si loo xoojiyo shaqaalaha caafimaadka ee Kenya, Nigeria iyo Ghana
Dholuo: Chiwo mar £15 mar jiwo jotich mag thieth e piny Kenya, Naijeria kod Ghana

English: IPOA calls on residents of Kakamega County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of national peace-building.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaomba wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku baaqeysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga dhaqdhaqaaq aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah si ay u taageeraan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: IPOA okwayo jogweng' Kakamega County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma rito kuwe e gwenge molworo tong'gi ni gitimo gik maok kare.

English: AFA reminds farmers in Samburu County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Samburu barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee ka dambeeya goosashada.
Dholuo: AFA parone jopur e county mar Samburu chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime bang' keyo.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati huu wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada daadadka ku dhacay xilligan fatahaadda.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service parone jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County ni kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o e kinde mag pi.

English: Wajir County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Wajir: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2023
Somali: Degmada Wajeer: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Wajir: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2023

English: KRA urges residents of Makueni County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kuwasilisha hati za maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay si loo qaabeeyo dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo jogweng' Makueni County mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: KTDA announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for pigs in Kakamega County this January.
Kiswahili: KTDA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Januari hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee doofaarka ee Gobolka Kakamega bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: KTDA olando chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo e dwe mar Januar e kaunti mar Kakamega.

English: Kenya â€” Report on Human Mobility in Garissa County (September 2022)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Ripoti ya Uhamaji wa Binadamu katika Kaunti ya Garissa (Septemba 2022)
Somali: Kenya â€” Warbixin ku saabsan Dhaqdhaqaaqa Aadanaha ee Degmada Gaarisa (Sebtembar 2022)
Dholuo: Kenya – Ripot ewi wuoth mar dhano e gweng’ mar Garissa (Dwe mar Apar 2022)

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Garissa County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Garissa kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku boorrinaysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Garissa inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag parone e County mar Garissa mondo oluong kony mar thieth mar parone maonge chudo.

English: IPOA calls on residents of Migori County to support local peace-building committees in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaita wakazi wa Wilaya ya Migori kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za mitaa katika kusaidia tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: IPOA waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Migori inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee deegaanka si ay u taageerayaan taxadarka ka dhanka ah argagixisada.
Dholuo: IPOA luongo jogweng' Migori County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gweng'no e siro tich mar kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: KEPHIS announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for goats in Kitui County this May.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Kitui Mei hii.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan rabshadaha lo'da ee Gobolka Kitui bisha May.
Dholuo: KEPHIS ogolo chenro mar thiedho diek maonge chudo mar rabies e gweng' mar Kitui e dwe mar Mei.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages mothers in Tana River County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Tana River kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Tana River inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo mine man Tana River County mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Notice: KTDA will distribute certified rice seed to farmers in Taita-Taveta County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itasambaza mbegu za mpunga zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta Juni hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: KTDA waxay abuurka bariiska ee shahaadada leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda Gobolka Taita-Taveta bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA biro pogo kodhi mag loso kodhi ne jopur manie Taita-Taveta County e dwe mar Jun.

English: KALRO advises farmers in Tana River County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the May planting season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Mei.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Tana River inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maajo.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e taon mar Tana River County mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Mei.

English: KEPHIS advises coffee producers in Narok County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inashauri wazalishaji wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Narok kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kafeega ee gobolka Narok inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KEPHIS nyiso jopur ma loso chai e gweng' mar Narok ni mondo giti gi nengo maromo nade kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: KICD accelerates development and distribution of digital textbooks tailored for the Competency-Based Curriculum (CBC).
Kiswahili: KICD huharakisha maendeleo na usambazaji wa vitabu vya masomo vya digital vilivyoundwa kwa ajili ya Mafunzo ya Msingi wa Uwezo (CBC).
Somali: KICD waxay dardargelineysaa horumarinta iyo qaybinta buugaagta waxbarasho ee dhijitaalka ah ee loogu talagalay manhajka ku saleysan aqoonta (CBC).
Dholuo: KICD medo timo dongruok e loso kendo pogo buge mag somo mag digital molos kaluwore gi chenro mar tiegruok motenore kuom lony (CBC).

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development encourages out-of-school children in Lamu County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Lamu kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Lamu inay isdiiwaangaliyaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e County mar Lamu mondo odonj e program mar puonjo jomadongo somo mar sekondari.

English: Notice: e-Citizen launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Bungoma County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: e-Citizen waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa degmada Bungoma bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni e-Citizen chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Bungoma e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education opens a new electrical installation programme at the vocational centre in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu inafungua programu mpya ya ufungaji wa umeme katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Migori.

Dholuo: NPS parone ji duto e county mar Bomet ni mondo gisik ka girito weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: IEBC encourages first-time voters in Marsabit County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Marsabit inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo joma okwongo yiero e taon mar Marsabit mondo onon weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: Now is the time: The only way to prevent this is physical distancing today. Not tomorrow. Today. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Sasa ni wakati: Njia pekee ya kuzuia hii ni umbali wa mwili leo. Si kesho. Leo. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Hadda waa waqtigii: Sida kaliya ee looga hortagi karo tan waa kala fogaanshaha jirka maanta. Maaha berri. Maanta. #KomeshaCorona

English: Public health advisory: Kenya Red Cross warns of increased typhoid risk in Bomet County and advises the public to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya matumbo katika Kaunti ya Bomet na kushauri umma kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ka digeysaa khatarta sii kordheysa ee cudurka 'typhoid' ee gobolka Bomet waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo.
Dholuo: Chenro mar thieth mar ji: Kenya Red Cross chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar typhoid e county mar Bomet kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochop e okang' malach kaka dwarore.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free suicide prevention support is available through county health facilities in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kuzuia kujiua unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo ka hortagga ismiidaaminta laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Kilifi County.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar geng'o ji kik nege yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth e gweng' mar Kilifi.

English: FAO reminds residents of West Pokot County that agroforestry improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kwamba kilimo cha misitu kinaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot in beeraha kaynta ah uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: FAO parone jogweng' mar West Pokot County ni agroforestry kelo nyak mar pur kuom kinde malach.

English: The High Court has halted the formation of the National Steering Committee on Tea Reforms affected parties should stay updated on the ongoing legal proceedings
Kiswahili: Mahakama Kuu imesitisha uundaji wa Kamati ya Kitaifa ya Uongozi ya Marekebisho ya Chai kwa pande zote zilizoathiriwa zinapaswa kusasishwa kuhusu kesi zinazoendelea za kisheria.

English: Somali refugees struggle during Ramadan as drought drives further need
Kiswahili: Wakimbizi wa Kisomali wanahangaika wakati wa Ramadhani huku ukame ukichochea mahitaji zaidi
Somali: Qaxootiga Soomaaliyeed ayaa la daalaa dhacaya bisha Ramadaan iyadoo abaartu ay sii kordhinayso baahida loo qabo
Dholuo: Jolweny mag Somalia temo matek e kinde Ramadhan nikech oro medo dwaro

English: Announcement that local farmer cooperatives are now contracted to supply nutritious meals directly to schools under new pilot model.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwamba vyama vya ushirika vya wakulima wa eneo hilo sasa vimepewa mkataba wa kusambaza milo yenye lishe moja kwa moja shuleni chini ya mfumo mpya wa majaribio.
Somali: Ogeysiis ah in iskaashatada beeraleyda maxalliga ah hadda loo qandaraasleeyay inay si toos ah ugu siiyaan iskuulada cuntooyin nafaqo leh iyadoo la raacayo qaab cusub oo tijaabo ah.
Dholuo: Owacho ni koro riwruoge mag jopur manie alworano osechano mar chiwo chiemo moromo e skunde e bwo ranyisi manyien mar tich.

English: Announcement that preâ€‘service nursing curriculum now includes nutrition and wellness modules for community care.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwamba mtaala wa uuguzi wa kabla ya huduma sasa unajumuisha moduli za lishe na ustawi kwa ajili ya utunzaji wa jamii.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida in manhajka kalkaalinta kahor adeegga hadda uu ku jiro qaybaha nafaqada iyo fayoobaanta ee daryeelka bulshada.
Dholuo: Onyiso ni somo mar nas ma pok ochako tiyo sani oriwo somo mag chiemo kod ngima maber mar rito oganda.

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Homa Bay County that access to childhood immunization is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba upatikanaji wa chanjo ya utotoni ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee gobolka Homa Bay in helitaanka tallaalka carruurta ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa mine ma biro bedo gi ich e Homa Bay County ni thuolo mar yudo thieth mar nyithindo en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag sirkal.

English: Notice: KRA launches the county integrated development plan in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika wilaya ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay bilaabaysaa qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Vihiga.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KRA chako chenro mar timo dongruok e alwora mar Vihiga County.

English: Addressing the human rights implications of climate change displacement including legal protection of people displaced across international borders
Kiswahili: Kushughulikia athari za haki za binadamu za kuhama kwa mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa ikiwa ni pamoja na ulinzi wa kisheria wa watu waliohamishwa kuvuka mipaka ya kimataifa
Somali: Wax ka qabashada saameynta xuquuqda aadanaha ee barakaca isbeddelka cimilada oo ay ku jiraan ilaalinta sharciga ah ee dadka ku barakacay xuduudaha caalamiga ah
Dholuo: Kaka ng’ato nyalo ng’ado bura kuom ratiro mag dhano nikech lokruok mag piny, oting’o bende rito chik ne ji ma owuok e udigi e ohinga mag piny mangima

English: Kenya Gazette reminds residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet wanaohudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti kuimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet ee ka qeybgalaya kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada ayaa xoojinaya maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette paronwa jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County ma biro e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Kenya: Polio outbreak - DREF Operation (MDRKE062)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Mlipuko wa Polio - Operesheni ya DREF (MDRKE062)
Somali: Kenya: Cudurka Dabaysha oo ka dillaacay - Hawlgalka DREF (MDRKE062)
Dholuo: Kenya: Wach mar tuo mar Polio - Tich mar DREF (MDRKE062)

English: Notice: NCPB will distribute certified millet seed to farmers in Meru County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay u qaybin doontaa abuurka miraha la caddeeyay beeraleyda degmada Meru bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Rapar: NCPB biro pogo kodhi mag millet ne jopur manie County mar Meru e dwe mar Mach.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges residents of Kirinyaga County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kufaidika na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kirinyaga mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Strong soaps can irritate baby's skin. Use mild, unscented options.
Kiswahili: Sabuni kali zinaweza kuwasha ngozi ya mtoto. Tumia chaguo laini, zisizo na harufu.
Somali: Saabuun adag ayaa cuncun ku keeni kara maqaarka ilmaha. Isticmaal ikhtiyaarro khafiif ah oo aan caraf lahayn.
Dholuo: Sabun ma nigi teko nyalo ketho dend nyathi. Ti kod gik ma ok ng’ich kendo ma onge ndhadhu.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Kakamega County to avoid contact with contaminated water sources following a rise in reported measles cases.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya surua vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega inay ka fogaadaan inay la xiriiraan ilo biyo ah oo wasakheysan ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska suuxdinta ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Kakamega County mondo kik giriwre gi kuonde ma pi yudoree nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuwono osemedore.

English: Notice from SHA (Social Health Authority): postnatal check-ups clinics will run every March at designated health centres in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii): kliniki za uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa zitafanya kazi kila Machi katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada): Xarumaha baaritaanka dhalmada ka dib waxay ka shaqeyn doonaan bishii Maarso xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Kilifi.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar SHA (Social Health Authority): klinik mag nonro bang' nyuol ibiro timie higa ka higa e dwe mar Mach e kuonde thieth moyier e gweng' mar Kilifi.

English: IEBC urges residents of Trans Nzoia County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia wavuti ya kaunti ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja wa kaunti.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogweng'o mag Trans Nzoia County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mar dongruok e county.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: skilled birth attendance clinics will run every August at designated health centres in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi: kliniki za mahudhurio ya uzazi zenye ujuzi zitaendeshwa kila Agosti katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka: rugaha caafimaad ee dhalashada xirfadlayaasha ah ayaa la qaban doonaa bishii Ogosto oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: Rieko moa e Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: Klinike mag rito nyuol ma nigi lony biro tiyo dwe mar Agost higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Baringo.

English: Mental health conditions like depression can lead to physical symptoms such as fatigue and illness, highlighting the strong mind-body connection
Kiswahili: Hali za afya ya akili kama vile mfadhaiko zinaweza kusababisha dalili za kimwili kama vile uchovu na ugonjwa, na hivyo kuonyesha uhusiano mkubwa kati ya akili na mwili.
Somali: Xaaladaha caafimaadka maskaxda sida niyadjabku waxay keeni karaan calaamado jireed sida daal iyo cudur, taas oo muujineysa xiriirka xooggan ee maskaxda iyo jirka
Dholuo: Tuoche kaka depression nyalo miyo ng'ato obed gi parruok mang'eny, to mano nyiso ni nitie tudruok e kind ringre gi pache

English: E-Citizen advises residents of Tana River County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inashauri wakazi wa Wilaya ya Tana River kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan shahaadada dhalashada.
Dholuo: E-Citizen nyiso jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo odhi e Huduma Centre man machiegni kode sama gidwaro yudo barua mar nyuol.

English: Tana River County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tana River: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Mei 2024
Somali: Degmada Tana River: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Aora Tana: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Mei 2024

English: KTDA urges millet growers in Mandera County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Mandera kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda millet ee degmada Mandera inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobka si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur ma pidho millet e county mar Mandera mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue mondo omed kelo nyak e higani.

English: Raila In Wajir: Former Prime Minister Raila Odinga intensifies consultations ODM leader engages residents, local leaders for feedback Raila hits back at Gachagua over  ËœState House traps  remarks
Kiswahili: Raila In Wajir: Waziri Mkuu wa zamani Raila Odinga anaimarisha mashauriano Kiongozi wa ODM anawashirikisha wakazi, viongozi wa mitaa kwa maoni Raila anarudi Gachagua juu ya maoni ya nyumba ya serikali kuhusu mitego
Somali: Raila oo ku sugan Wajeer: Raila Odinga oo xoojinaya wadatashiyada Hogaamiyaha ODM oo la macaamilaya dadka deegaanka iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha maxalliga ah si ay uga jawaabaan Raila oo ka jawaabay Gachagua oo ku saabsan hadalladii Aqalka Dowladda
Dholuo: Raila e Wajir: Jatend piny machon Raila Odinga omedo loso gi jodak, jotelo mag gwenge mondo giyud paro.

English: Council of Governors urges residents of Busia County to attend the public participation forum to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha waxay ku boorinayaan dadka deggan degmada Busia inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si ay u qaabeeyaan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Busia mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar loso chenro mar dongruok.

English: IEBC updates residents of Kisii County on progress of the county integrated development plan this February.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti hii Februari.
Somali: IEBC waxay dadka deggan degmada Kisii ka wargelineysaa horumarka qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: IEBC chiwo ripot ne jogweng' Kisii kuom dongruok mar chenro mar dongruok mar county e dwe mar Februar.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Nandi County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Nandi in adeegyada bukaanka dibedda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne ji duto e county mar Nandi ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mag ambulatori e kuonde moyier.

English: Ksh 6.5 billion capitation released for free day secondary education nationwide.
Kiswahili: Ksh bilioni 6.5 zilitolewa kwa ajili ya elimu ya sekondari ya bure nchini kote.
Somali: Ksh 6.5 bilyan oo lacag ah ayaa loo sii daayay waxbarashada dugsiga sare ee bilaashka ah ee dalka oo dhan.
Dholuo: Ksh bilionde 6.5 ne ogol mondo otigo e tiegruok mar sekondari maonge chudo e piny mangima.

English: 20 doctors from Cuba are expected to land in Nairobi this night, the Cabinet secretary of Health Kagwe has said that they will be posted in Kenyatta University for the next 6 months in a bid to boost Covid 19 management
Kiswahili: Madaktari 20 kutoka Cuba wanatarajiwa kutua Nairobi usiku huu, Waziri wa Afya Kagwe amesema watahudumu katika Chuo Kikuu cha Kenyatta kwa miezi 6 ijayo katika juhudi za kuimarisha usimamizi wa Covid 19.
Somali: 20 dhakhtar oo ka socda Cuba ayaa la filayaa inay galabta soo degaan Nairobi, Wasiirka Caafimaadka ee Golaha Wasiirada Kagwe ayaa sheegay in 6ka bilood ee soo socota lagu soo diri doono Jaamacadda Kenyatta si loo xoojiyo maaraynta Covid-19.
Dholuo: Laktar 20 moa e piny Cuba biro chopo Nairobi gotieno, Jatend weche thieth mar Kabinet Kagwe owacho ni gibiro ketogi e Kenyatta University kuom dweche auchiel mabiro mondo gimed loyo tuo mar Covid 19.

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief, March 2025
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP wa Kenya, Machi 2025
Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya, Maarso 2025
Dholuo: Wach machuok mar piny Kenya mar WFP, dwe mar adek 2025

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds residents of Kiambu County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu in ka qaybgalka maamulaha qaybta deegaanka ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General parone jogweng' Kiambu County ni tudruok gi jarit mar ward margi miyo sirkal bedo gi loch maber.

English: ODPP urges eligible citizens in Nyandarua County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Nyandarua inay ka qaybqaataan jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro e County mar Nyandarua mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar yiero.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on parents in Laikipia County to have children under five screened for tuberculosis during the April outreach.
Kiswahili: Kenya Red Cross inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuwafanyia watoto chini ya miaka mitano uchunguzi wa kifua kikuu wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Aprili.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Laikipia in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka 'tuberculosis' inta lagu jiro safarka bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross kwayo jonyuol e county mar Laikipia mondo otim nonro mar tuo mar tuberculosis ne nyithindo ma johigni abich nyaka tin e dwe mar April.

English: Public notice: CDC will host a free proper sanitation outreach in Migori County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: CDC itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mazingira bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Migori Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: CDC waxay marti gelineysaa adeegyo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan Degmada Migori bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuoche (CDC) biro kawo okang' mar konyo ji mondo obed gi ngima maler e kaunti mar Migori e dwe mar Julai.

English: DCI urges the public in Tharaka-Nithi County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: DCI inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: DCI waxay shacabka degmada Tharaka-Nithi ugu baaqeysaa inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: DCI ojiwo ji duto e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma osefweny kuom wuond mag SIM-swap.

English: KICD announces distribution of textbooks and learning materials to schools in Baringo County this December.
Kiswahili: KICD inatangaza usambazaji wa vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Baringo Desemba hii.
Somali: KICD waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta buugaagta waxbarasho iyo qalabka wax lagu barto dugsiyada degmada Baringo bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: KICD olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok e skunde mag Baringo County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Embu (Mbeere) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Embu (Mbeere): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Oktoba 2022
Somali: Degmada Embu (Mbeere): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Embu (Mbeere): Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar 2022

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association confirms a typhoid outbreak alert for Murang'a County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari Kenya chathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa matumbo katika Kaunti ya Murang'a. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu xaqiijiyay digniin ku saabsan cudurka tifooska ee degmada Murang'a. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Medical Association osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuwo mar typhoid e kaunti mar Murang'a.

English: State Department for TVET reminds parents in Kericho County that bursary allocation registration is open this March.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba usajili wa ugawaji wa bursari umefunguliwa Machi hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Kericho in diiwaangelinta deeqda deeq waxbarasho ay furan tahay bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET oparo ne jonyuol e County mar Kericho ni kad mar yudo mich mar tiegruok mar skul osechakore e dwe mar Mach.

English: AFA informs avocado farmers in Kwale County of new market linkage opportunities this February.
Kiswahili: AFA inawafahamisha wakulima wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Kwale juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Februari hii.
Somali: AFA waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda avocado ee Gobolka Kwale fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: AFA nyiso jopur mag avocado e county mar Kwale kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: KRA opens a new service point for passport services in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Wilaya ya Kilifi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay furaysaa goob adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee degmada Kilifi.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KRA oseyawo kama itimee tije mag kawo kad e gweng' mar Kilifi.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya warns residents of Kakamega County about a rise in phishing messages and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega juu ya kuongezeka kwa ujumbe wa udanganyifu na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay ka digtay dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega kororka farriimaha phishing waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kakamega County e wi medruok mar weche mag phishing kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: Farmers are advised to stay updated on the Fertilizer Subsidy Program and Food Security Preparedness Plan Further details will be provided soon
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa kusasishwa kuhusu Mpango wa Ruzuku ya Mbolea na Mpango wa Maandalizi ya Usalama wa Chakula Maelezo zaidi yatatolewa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu talinayaa inay la socdaan wararka Barnaamijka Bacriminta iyo Qorshaha Diyaargarowga Amniga Cuntada. Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ayaa dhawaan la siin doonaa
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma bende timo dongruok e weche mag chiemo, ibiro kony mondo gibed gi paro makare e wi chenro mar chiwo kony ne ji e wi yiende mag yiende kod chiemo.

English: DCI urges residents of Kisumu County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DCI inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida katika maeneo ya mpakani kwa vyombo vya usalama huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa katika ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay soo sheegaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: DCI ojiwo jogweng' mar Kisumu County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e alwora mar tong'gi e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom loso kuwe e piny.

English: The Ministry of Health has started substracting people and advicing people to keep distance to prevent themselves from Monkeypox in our country
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya imeanza kuwaondoa watu na kuwashauri watu kuweka umbali ili kujikinga na Tumbili katika nchi yetu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa bilowday in ay dadka ka dhigto kuwa aan caadi ahayn, waxayna dadka kula talineysaa in ay fogaadaan si looga hortago cudurka Monkeypox ee dalkeena.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth osechako chiko ji mondo kik gidonj e tuwo mar Monkeypox e pinywa.

English: TVET conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in Nyamira County this April.
Kiswahili: TVET inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Aprili hii.
Somali: TVET waxay bishii Abriil ku qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee degmada Nyamira.
Dholuo: TVET timo romo mar tiego ji e wi ratiro mag sirkal e County mar Nyamira e dwe mar April.

English: Climate-smart agriculture practices include holistic integration, crop adaptation, livestock management, land/water management, and efficient energy use.
Kiswahili: Mazoezi ya kilimo ya hali ya hewa ya busara ni pamoja na ushirikiano kamili, kukabiliana na mazao, usimamizi wa mifugo, usimamizi wa ardhi / maji, na matumizi ya nishati yenye ufanisi.
Somali: Dhaqdhaqaaqa beeraha ee cimilada u habboon waxaa ka mid ah isdhexgalka guud, isbeddelka dalagga, maaraynta xoolaha, maaraynta dhulka / biyaha, iyo isticmaalka tamarta hufan.
Dholuo: Tije mag pur ma nigi rieko mar timo lokruok e kit ngima mar piny oriwo tiyo gi yore duto mag pur, loso kod chamo cham, rito lowo gi pi, kod tiyo gi teko mar teko mar teko mar lowo.

English: Locally led and Adaptive Alert-Based Cash Assistance to Disaster-Affected Communities in the Kenyan ASALs: Baseline, May, 2024
Kiswahili: Usaidizi wa Pesa Unaoongozwa na Tahadhari Unaoongozwa na Mashinani kwa Jamii zilizoathiriwa na Maafa katika ASAL za Kenya: Msingi, Mei, 2024
Somali: Kaalmo Lacageed oo ku salaysan Digniin La-qabsi oo ay maamulaan dadka deegaanka iyo kuwa ASAL-ka Kenya: Saldhigga, Maajo, 2024
Dholuo: Kony mar pesa ma otelo kendo ma ochung’ne ng’eyo ma nyalo lokore ne jodak ma oyudo masira e ASAL mag piny Kenya: Chakruok, dwe mar abich, higa mar 2024

English: Notice: KEPHIS restricts movement of poultry in Kisii County due to a foot and mouth disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS inazuia harakati za kuku katika Kaunti ya Kisii kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa digaagga ee degmada Kisii sababo la xiriira faafitaanka cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS ogeng'o wuoth mar le mag dhok e County mar Kisii nikech tuwo mar dhoho.

English: Notice: FAO will train farmers in Busia County on soil conservation this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia juu ya uhifadhi wa udongo Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Busia ee ku saabsan ilaalinta ciidda bisha July.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: FAO biro tiego jopur e gweng' mar Busia e wi rito lowo e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will hold a suicide prevention forum in Narok County this July. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanya kongamano la kuzuia kujiua katika Kaunti ya Narok Julai hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka hortagga ismiidaaminta ee Gobolka Narok bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo romo mar geng'o ji kik donjre e taon mar Narok e dwe mar Julai.

English: Back to Basics: Understanding the Problem of Persistent Global Acute Malnutrition in Isiolo and Marsabit Counties, Kenya (August 2024)
Kiswahili: Rejea Msingi: Kuelewa Tatizo la Utapiamlo Uliokithiri Ulimwenguni katika Kaunti za Isiolo na Marsabit, Kenya (Agosti 2024)
Somali: Ku noqo Aasaaska: Fahmidda Dhibaatada Nafaqo-xumada Ba'an ee Caalamiga ah ee Joogtada ah ee ka jirta Degmooyinka Isiolo iyo Marsabit, Kenya (Agoosto 2024)
Dholuo: Dwoke e weche madongo: Ng’eyo chandruok mar bedo gi chiemo ma ok oromo e piny mangima e gwenge mag Isiolo kod Marsabit, Kenya (Agost 2024)

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service encourages farmers in Busia County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for coffee.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kupata bei bora ya kahawa.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda degmada Busia inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan kafeega.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur e county mar Busia mondo oti gi nengo matin mar kofi mondo omi ohala obed maber.

English: ODPP invites residents of Kisumu County to attend the public participation forum regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay ka qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: ODPP gwelo ji duto modak Kisumu County mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenro mag dongruok.

English: TVET urges parents and teachers in Lamu County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: TVET inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Lamu kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Somali: TVET waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Lamu inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Lamu mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto.

English: Government calling on employers to integrate mental wellness supports into occupational safety standards.
Kiswahili: Serikali inatoa wito kwa waajiri kuunganisha usaidizi wa afya ya akili katika viwango vya usalama kazini.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay shaqo-bixiyeyaasha ugu baaqeysaa inay ku darsadaan taageerada caafimaadka maskaxda heerarka badbaadada shaqada.
Dholuo: Sirkal dwaro ni jotelo omed tiyo gi yore mag thieth mar chuny e weche mag ritruok e tich.

English: "People have been sent 'Safaricom refund claim' links that look like the real site. Safaricom does not issue refunds without an official claim form."
Kiswahili: "Watu wametumwa viungo vya 'Safaricom claim refund' vinavyoonekana kama tovuti halisi. Safaricom haitoi refund bila fomu rasmi ya claim".
Somali: "Dadka waxaa loo soo diray 'Safaricom codsiga lacag celin' oo u eg bogga dhabta ah. Safaricom ma bixiso lacag celin iyada oo aan la helin foomka codsiga rasmiga ah".
Dholuo: "Ji oseyudo tudruok mar 'Safaricom claim refund' ma chalo gi websait mar adier.

English: Some measures you can take to avoid close contact with others include: Stay home as much as possible & reduce visitors. Practice social & physical distancing: Stay at least six feet away from others in public places. Call friends & family or visit by video. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya hatua unazoweza kuchukua ili kuepuka kuwasiliana kwa karibu na wengine ni pamoja na: Kaa nyumbani iwezekanavyo na upunguze wageni. Fanya mazoezi ya umbali wa kijamii na kimwili: Kaa angalau futi sita kutoka kwa wengine katika maeneo ya umma. Piga marafiki na familia au tembelea kwa video. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Tallaabooyinka aad qaadi karto si aad uga fogaato xiriir dhow oo aad la yeelato dadka kale waxaa ka mid ah: Guriga joog intii suurtagal ah oo yaree booqdayaasha. Ku celceli kala fogaanshaha bulshada iyo jirka: Ka fogow ugu yaraan lix cagood dadka kale meelaha dadweynaha. Wac asxaabtaada iyo qoyskaaga ama booqo muuqaal ahaan. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Gik moko ma inyalo timo mondo kik ibed gi tudruok machiegni gi jomoko gin kaka: Bed e ot kaka nyalore & dwoko piny welo mobiro. Ti gi puonjruok mar bedo mabor gi ji mamoko: Bed mabor gi ji mamoko kuom fut auchiel e kuonde ma ji mang’eny romoe. Goch osiepe kod joodu kata limogi kokalo kuom vidio. #KomeshaKorona

English: Definitition of bipolar,causes,symptoms,diagnostic tools and treatment.
Kiswahili: Ufafanuzi wa bipolar, sababu, dalili, vifaa vya uchunguzi na matibabu.
Somali: Qeexida cudurka 'bipolar', sababaha, calaamadaha, qalabka baaritaanka iyo daaweynta.
Dholuo: Tiyo gi yore mag thieth kod thieth.

English: Kenya Red Cross alerts residents of Migori County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kuhusu kuongezeka kwa visa vya utekaji nyara wa magari na kuwashauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay uga digtay dadka deggan degmada Migori kororka kiisaska gaadiidka la xaday waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross chiwo siem ne jogweng' Migori County kuom wach medruok mar wuondo mtokni kendo osiemo oganda mondo kik gipog weche mag ritruok gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Notice: TSC reminds citizens in Kirinyaga County about their rights regarding the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuhusu haki zao kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Kirinyaga ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: TSC paronwa raia mag Kirinyaga County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo ombudsman.

English: KEPHIS urges farmers in Mandera County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Mandera inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Mandera mondo opidh olembe ma nyalo miyo lowo okethre mondo omi giritre kuom lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: Tana River County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tana River: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2024
Somali: Degmada Tana River: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Aora Tana: Oboke Mapiyo mar Oro mar Julaini 2024

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association will hold a stress management forum in Lamu County this January. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitafanya kongamano la kudhibiti mafadhaiko katika Kaunti ya Lamu Januari hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha maareynta stress ee degmada Lamu bisha Janaayo. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni Kenya Medical Association biro timo romo mar kedo gi parruok e taon mar Lamu e dwe mar Januar.

English: ODPP reminds voters in Kajiado County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kajiado County kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha usajili wa IEBC kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Kajiado inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor inta aan la helin nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: ODPP parone jogweng' Kajiado County mondo olim kama ichanoe IEBC machiegni kodgi kapok itimo yiero.

English: KNEC Annual Report FY 2019/2020.
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya kila mwaka ya KNEC kwa mwaka wa 2019/2020.
Somali: Warbixinta sanadlaha ah ee KNEC ee sanadka 2019/2020.
Dholuo: Ripot mar higa mar KNEC e higa mar 2019/2020.

English: Farmers in Muranga County can access a stable market for milk through 45 co operatives and sell to Muranga County Creameries at Kshs 35 per liter
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Muranga wanaweza kupata soko zuri la maziwa kupitia vyama 45 vya ushirika na kuuza kwa Kaunti ya Muranga Creameries kwa Kshs 35 kwa lita.
Somali: Beeraleyda Muranga County waxay heli karaan suuq xasillooni oo caano ah iyagoo adeegsanaya 45 iskaashatadood, waxayna u iibin karaan Muranga County Creameries qiimo dhan Kshs 35 litir kasta
Dholuo: Jo-Purie e County mar Muranga nyalo yudo ohala mar chak e yor jo-pilo 45 kendo ginyalo uso ne Muranga County Creameries e nengo mar Kshs 35 kuom lita

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Vihiga County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa umakini mkubwa wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' County mar Vihiga mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'enyie nikech ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom loso kuwe e piny.

English: Universities Fund encourages residents of Kitui County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo jogweng' Kitui County mondo ong'e weche ma gidonjogo e register mar joma oyiero mondo ging'e kaka jopiny biro tiyo gi bajet mar county.

English: The Cabinet Secretyary of Health, Mr. Mutayi Kagwe has said that a curfew will be imposed if Covid viruses increase
Kiswahili: Waziri Mkuu wa Afya, Mheshimiwa Mutayi Kagwe amesema kuwa kufungwa kwa kazi kutatolewa ikiwa virusi vya Covid vinaongezeka
Somali: Xoghayaha Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ee Golaha Wasiirada Mudane Mutayi Kagwe ayaa sheegay in xayiraad lagu soo roogi doono haddii fayraska Covid uu kordho
Dholuo: Jatelo mar Kabinet mar weche thieth, Mr. Mutayi Kagwe osewacho ni ibiro ket thieth ka tuoche mag Covid medore

English: She also supported the mother to initiate breastfeeding within the first hour, an essential step in protecting the newborn's health.
Kiswahili: Pia alimsaidia mama kuanza kunyonyesha ndani ya saa ya kwanza, hatua muhimu katika kulinda afya ya mtoto mchanga.
Somali: Waxay sidoo kale ka taageertay hooyada inay naas nuujiso saacadda ugu horreysa gudahood, taasoo ah tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu ilaalinayo caafimaadka ilmaha dhashay.
Dholuo: Bende, ne okonyo min nyathino mondo ochaki miyo nyathino thuolo mar madho pi e saa mokwongo, ma en gima duong’ ahinya e rito ngima mar nyathino ma pok onyuol.

English: KEMRI reminds expectant mothers in Kajiado County that access to skilled birth attendance is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kwamba upatikanaji wa mahudhurio ya uzazi wenye ujuzi ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Kajiado in helitaanka daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfad leh ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMRI parone mine ma biro nyuolo nyithindo e Kajiado County ni thuolo mar yudo nyithindo ma nigi lony en maonge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Nakuru County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the June planting season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Juni.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Nakuru inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagyada si loo soo celiyo miraha ciidda ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Juun.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur man Nakuru County ni gitim lokruok e puothe mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber kapok dwe mar auchiel ochopo.

English: IEBC announces improved turnaround times for e-Citizen registration in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: IEBC inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujiandikisha kwa e-Citizen katika Kajiado County.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee Gobolka Kajiado.
Dholuo: IEBC olando lokruok e seche mag kwayo ji mondo odonj e e-Citizen registration e Kajiado County.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free trauma counselling support is available through county health facilities in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa ushauri wa kiwewe unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Tana River.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah ee la talinta dhaawaca laga helo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Tana River County.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth e taon mar Tana River County.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages residents of Narok County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Narok inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay u yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giluong kony mar thieth mar parruok maonge chudo.

English: ODPP urges residents of Isiolo County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on community-based development programmes.
Kiswahili: ODPP inahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa wilaya ili kuwa na habari juu ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo inay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada si ay uga warqabaan barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogweng' Isiolo County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo gibed molony gi chenro mag dongruok mar oganda.

English: A growing urban heat crisis is placing residents of informal settlements at particular risk in countries such as Kenya, the United Republic of Tanzania and Zimbabwe.
Kiswahili: Mgogoro unaoongezeka wa joto mijini unawaweka wakazi wa makazi yasiyo rasmi katika hatari fulani katika nchi kama vile Kenya, Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania na Zimbabwe.
Somali: Xiisadda kulaylka magaalooyinka oo sii kordheysa ayaa khatar gaar ah gelinaysa dadka deggan deegaannada aan rasmiga ahayn ee ku nool waddamada sida Kenya, Jamhuuriyadda Midaysan ee Tanzania iyo Zimbabwe.
Dholuo: Midhiero mar liet ma medore e bombe keto jodak kuonde ma ok owinjore e arita makende e pinje kaka Kenya, Piny Riwruok mar Tanzania kod Zimbabwe.

English: State Department for TVET calls on the community in Bomet County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Bomet kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Bomet inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban iskuulada si ay u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyada iskuulada.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET kwayo ji duto e county mar Bomet mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ngima maber e skunde.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will conduct a greenhouse farming workshop for farmers in Lamu County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itafanya warsha ya kilimo cha chafu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo ee beeraleyda gobolka Lamu bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Dairy Board biro timo chokruok mar timo yien e alwora mar Lamu County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: DPP reminds the public in Busia County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DPP inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Busia kubaki macho juu ya ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Busia inay ka feejignaadaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: DPP parone ji duto e county mar Busia mondo obed motang' gi loso kuwe e piny.

English: Ministry of Education reminds youth in Bungoma County that HELB funding is available for tailoring and design training.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Bungoma in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka qaabeynta iyo naqshadeynta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok parone rowere mag Bungoma County ni pesa mag HELB yudore e tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko.

English: Notice: IEBC opens the electoral calendar centres in Siaya County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Siaya Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee degmada Siaya bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IEBC chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e county mar Siaya e dwe mar Januar.

English: Taita Taveta County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Taita Taveta: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Juni 2023
Somali: Degmada Taita Taveta: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Taita Taveta: Oboke machon mar gombo mar oro dwe mar auchiel 2023

English: Exhibit intelligence about agricultural technology in Africa.
Kiswahili: Onyesha akili kuhusu teknolojia ya kilimo barani Afrika.
Somali: Muuji sirdoonka ku saabsan tikniyoolajiyadda beeraha ee Afrika.
Dholuo: Nyis rieko e wi teknoloji mag pur e Afrika.

English: EACC warns public officers in Kilifi County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: EACC inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Wilaya ya Kilifi dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: EACC waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Kilifi inay musuqmaasuqa ka qaadaan xafiisyada dowladda.
Dholuo: EACC chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e gweng' mar Kilifi kuom kawo asoya e migepe mar sirkal.

English: NDMA reminds the public in Bomet County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Bomet inay ka feejignaadaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: NDMA parone ji duto e county mar Bomet ni mondo gibed motang' ne loso kuwe e piny.

English: E-Citizen reminds voters in Nyamira County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Nyamira inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor waxbarashada codbixisayaasha.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa jogedo e County mar Nyamira mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar timo yiero ka pok giyudo tiegruok.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges motorists and pedestrians in Vihiga County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent landslides-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawataka madereva wa magari na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa gawaarida iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Vihiga in ay ka fogaadaan in ay soo gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada daadadku ka da'ay si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira dhulgariirka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Forest Service jiwo derebe kod joma wuotho e wi tiendgi e gweng' mar Vihiga mondo kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o mondo gikwed masiche ma timore nikech yiengni mag lowo.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds residents of Kakamega County that conservation tillage improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba kilimo cha uhifadhi kinaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba la muda mrefu.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega in beerashada ilaalinta ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board oparo ne jogweng' Kakamega County ni choko puothe mag puothe nyalo miyo puothe obed gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds residents of Kisumu County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu wanaohudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu ee ka qeybgalaya kalfadhiga guud ee shirka degmada ayaa xoojinaya maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General paronwa jogweng' mar Kisumu County ma biro e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo omed jiwo sirkal.

English: KEMRI advises residents of Laikipia County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMRI waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay haystaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMRI nyiso jogweng' County mar Laikipia mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi ka gidwaro thieth mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Kenya Forest Service warns residents of Trans Nzoia County about a rise in identity theft and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia juu ya kuongezeka kwa wizi wa kitambulisho na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ka digayaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia kororka xadgudubka aqoonsiga wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga leh bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service chiwo siem ne ji modak e Trans Nzoia County kuom dongruok mar kwalo kitgi kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok adier ne jatendgi.

English: KEMRI encourages mothers in Kitui County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kitui kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kitui inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo mine man Kitui County mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: High blood pressure in pregnancy can lead to preeclampsia. Regular check-ups are essential for early detection.
Kiswahili: Shinikizo la damu kubwa wakati wa ujauzito linaweza kusababisha preeclampsia. Uchunguzi wa mara kwa mara ni muhimu kwa ugunduzi wa mapema.
Somali: Cadaadiska dhiigga sare ee uurka ayaa keeni kara preeclampsia. baaritaano joogto ah ayaa lagama maarmaan u ah ogaanshaha hore.
Dholuo: Medruok mar remo e kinde mag ich nyalo miyo ng'ato obed gi tuwo mar preeclampsia.

English: FAO informs horticultural produce farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County of new market linkage opportunities this February.
Kiswahili: FAO inawafahamisha wakulima wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Februari hii.
Somali: FAO waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda wax soo saarka beeraha ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: FAO nyiso jopur ma loso puothe mag puothe e County mar Elgeyo-Marakwet thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice from Division of Disease Surveillance and Response: free antenatal care clinics will run every February at designated health centres in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa: kliniki za bure za utunzaji wa ujauzito zitaendeshwa kila Februari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka socda qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada: rugta daryeelka dhalmada ee bilaashka ah waxaa lagu qaban doonaa Febraayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee la magacaabay ee Gobolka Nairobi.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuwo: Klinike mag rito nyithindo kapok ginyuolo ibiro tiye dwe mar ariyo ka dwe e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Nairobi.

English: Cracked bottles can harbor germs. Replace damaged feeding equipment promptly.
Kiswahili: Chupa zilizopasuka zinaweza kuhifadhi vijidudu. Badilisha vifaa vya kulishia vilivyoharibika haraka.
Somali: Dhalooyinka jeexjeexan waxay keeni karaan bakteeriyo, qalabka quudinta ee dhaawacmayna si dhakhso leh u beddela.
Dholuo: Bombe mokethore nyalo bedo gi tuwoche ma nyalo miyo ng'ato oyud chiemo.

English: Announcement about SNV pledging continued support to Kenya's food systems transformation during Nairobi National Summit.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kuhusu SNV kuahidi kuendelea kuunga mkono mabadiliko ya mifumo ya chakula nchini Kenya wakati wa Mkutano wa Kitaifa wa Nairobi.
Somali: Shaacinta ku saabsan SNV waxay ballanqaadaysaa inay sii wadi doonto taageerada isbeddelka nidaamyada cuntada ee Kenya intii lagu jiray Shir-madaxeedka Qaran ee Nairobi.
Dholuo: Oboke kuom SNV ma singo mar dhi nyime gi konyo e loko yore mag chiemo e piny Kenya e kinde mar chokruok maduong’ mar piny Nairobi.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Nyandarua County that access to free medical camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za matibabu bila malipo sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Nyandarua in helitaanka xeryaha caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha loo qoondeeyay.
