Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne ji duto e County mar Nyandarua ni koro ginyalo yudo kuonde thieth maonge chudo e kuonde moketi.

English: Immediate skin-to-skin contact after birth helps regulate baby's temperature and encourages bonding.
Kiswahili: Kugusana mara moja kutoka ngozi hadi ngozi baada ya kuzaliwa husaidia kudhibiti halijoto ya mtoto na kuhimiza kuungana.
Somali: Taabasho degdeg ah oo maqaar-ilaa-maqaar ah ka dib dhalashada ayaa gacan ka geysata nidaaminta heerkulka ilmaha waxayna dhiirigelisaa isku xirnaanta.
Dholuo: Ka ng’ato oromo ng’ato mapiyo bang’ nyuol, mano konyo e rito liet mar nyathi kendo miyo obed gi winjruok maber.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will train farmers in Bomet County on water harvesting this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet juu ya uvunaji wa maji Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) ayaa tababar siin doonta beeraleyda degmada Bomet ee ku saabsan goosashada biyaha bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro tiego jopur e county mar Bomet e wi choko pi e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: KMTC reminds citizens in West Pokot County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay muwaadiniinta degmada West Pokot ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC paronwa raia mag West Pokot County kuom ratiro ma gin-go kaluwore gi chike mag sirkal.

English: KEPHIS warns millet farmers in Vihiga County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Vihiga juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda cawska ee degmada Vihiga cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda ah.
Dholuo: KEPHIS chiwo siem ne jopur mag millet e County mar Vihiga ni nitie tuoche ma nyalo landore kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: KTDA reminds livestock keepers in Bungoma County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KTDA waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Bungoma inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha ka guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyada oo aan la helin rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KTDA parone jorit jamni e Bungoma County ni kik giting' jamni ka ok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: Access to infrastructure is vital for boosting youth engagement in agriculture Stakeholders should focus on improving infrastructure to create more agribusiness opportunities for young people
Kiswahili: Upatikanaji wa miundombinu ni muhimu katika kukuza ushiriki wa vijana katika kilimo Wadau wanapaswa kuzingatia kuboresha miundombinu ili kutengeneza fursa nyingi za kilimo biashara kwa vijana.
Somali: Helitaanka kaabayaasha waa mid muhiim u ah kor u qaadista ka qaybgalka dhalinyarada beeraha Dhinacyada daneeyayaasha waa inay diiradda saaraan hagaajinta kaabayaasha si loo abuuro fursado badan oo ganacsi beeraha ah oo loogu talagalay dhalinyarada
Dholuo: Bedo gi chenro mar yudo gik mochuno e ngima en gima dwarore ahinya mondo omi rowere omed tiyo gi yore mag pur.

English: Farmers are encouraged to attend seminars on technological agriculture.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kuhudhuria semina kuhusu kilimo cha kiteknolojia.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay ka qayb galaan siminaaro ku saabsan beeraha tiknoolajiyadeed.
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur mondo odhi e chokruoge mag timo nonro e wi weche mag pur.

English: DCI warns residents of Baringo County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: DCI waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo kororka khiyaamada SIM-swap waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne jogweng' Baringo County e wi medruok mar wuond mar loko SIM kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar ote maok kare ne jatendgi.

English: Ministry of Education calls on the community in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay bulshada degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyo.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok kwayo ji duto e County mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ngima maber e skunde.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kitui.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay bilowday barnaamij lagu darayo ardayda naafada ah dugsiyada gobolka Kitui.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State Department for TVET chako chenro mar tiego nyithindo ma nigi midekre e skunde duto mag Kitui County.

English: Weekly Bulletin on Outbreaks and other Emergencies: Week 45: 4 - 10 November 2024 Data as reported by: 17:00; 10 November 2024
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Kila Wiki kuhusu Milipuko na Dharura Nyingine: Wiki 45: 4 - 10 Novemba 2024 Data kama ilivyoripotiwa na: 17:00; 10 Novemba 2024
Somali: War-saxaafadeed Todobaadle ah oo ku saabsan Cudurrada faafa iyo Xaaladaha kale ee Degdegga ah: Toddobaadka 45: 4 - 10 Noofambar 2024 Xogta sida ay soo sheegtay: 17:00; 10 Noofambar 2024
Dholuo: Oboke mar juma ka juma kuom tuoche ma nyalo kelo tuoche kod gik mamoko ma nyalo timore mapiyo: Jumapil mar 45: 4 - 10 dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2024 Data kaka ondik gi: 17:00; 10 dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2024

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the community in Migori County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb burglary.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Migori kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa bulshada Degmada Migori inay ka warbixiyaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo shaki leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Forest Service jiwo oganda manie Migori County mondo onyis polis ma machiegni gi kanyo ni gitimo gimoro marach mondo kik jokuoge odonj e odno.

English: KNEC invites youth in Makueni County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this July.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Makueni kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Julai hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Makueni inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: KNEC gwelo rowere e gweng' mar Makueni mondo odonj e tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing e dwe mar Julai.

English: IEBC reminds parents in Vihiga County that adult literacy classes registration is open this January.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba usajili wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima umefunguliwa Januari hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Vihiga in diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ay furan tahay bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: IEBC paronwa jonyuol e County mar Vihiga ni somo mar somo gi somo mar jomoti biro chakore Januar.

English: Kenya - Northern Kenya: Drought Severity and Population Exposure in Wajir County (28 Jan 2026)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Kaskazini mwa Kenya: Ukali wa Ukame na Mfichuo wa Idadi ya Watu katika Kaunti ya Wajir (28 Januari 2026)
Somali: Kenya - Waqooyiga Kenya: Heerka Abaarta iyo Soo-gaadhista Dadka ee Degmada Wajeer (28 Jannaayo 2026)
Dholuo: Kenya - Kenya ma Nyanduat: Pek mar Oro kod Kwan mar Oganda e Kambi mar Wajir (28 dwe mar achiel higa mar 2026)

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) appeals to caregivers in Kisii County to visit their nearest maternity wing as part of the March maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kisii kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Machi.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Kisii inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) okwayo jorit e County mar Kisii mondo odhi olimgi ka gin machiegni gi kama giyudoe nyithindo e dwe mar Mach.

English: KEPHIS reminds residents of Busia County that conservation tillage improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kwamba kilimo cha uhifadhi kinaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia in beerashada ilaalinta ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: KEPHIS paronwa jogweng' mar County mar Busia ni chwoyo puothe e yor ritruok medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development encourages farmers in Kisii County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for horticultural produce.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora ya mazao ya bustani.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kisii inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay alaabada beeraha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur e County mar Kisii mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar puothe mag puothe.

English: KALRO urges maize growers in Narok County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Narok kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee Gobolka Narok inay qaataan noocyo abuurka ah oo abaarta u adkaysta si loo wanaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur ma pidho cham e gweng' mar Narok mondo okaw kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed kelo nyak e higani.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Turkana County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay ka furtay goob adeeg cusub oo lagu shaqeynayo shahaadada dhalashada ee degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Huduma Kenya oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag loso nyasi mag nyuol e County mar Turkana.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free youth mental wellness support is available through county health facilities in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa ustawi wa akili wa vijana unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Baringo County.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar paro mar rowere yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Baringo.

English: Kenya: Floods - DREF Operation (MDRKE056)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Mafuriko - Operesheni ya DREF (MDRKE056)
Somali: Kenya: Daadadka - Hawlgalka DREF (MDRKE056)
Dholuo: Kenya: Muomruok - Tich mar DREF (MDRKE056)

English: @DrMercyHealth . The Ministry through Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI) and Kenya Aids Vaccine Initiative Institute of Clinical Research (KAVI-ICR) has been on the lead on both local and international collaborative Covid-19 researches. #CoronaVirus
Kiswahili: @DrMercyHealth . Wizara kupitia Taasisi ya Utafiti wa Kimatibabu ya Kenya (KEMRI) na Taasisi ya Kenya Aids Vaccine Initiative Initiative (KAVI-ICR) imekuwa ikiongoza katika tafiti shirikishi za Covid-19 nchini na kimataifa. Taarifa za #CoronaVirus
Somali: @DrMercyHealth. Wasaaradda oo kaashanaysa Machadka Cilmi-baarista Caafimaadka ee Kenya (KEMRI) iyo Machadka Cilmi-baarista Kiliinikada ee Tallaalka Aids ee Kenya (KAVI-ICR) ayaa hormuud ka ahaa cilmi-baarisyada iskaashiga maxalliga ah iyo kuwa caalamiga ah ee la xiriira Covid-19. #CoronaVirus
Dholuo: @Dktar mar ng'uono mar ngima . Od tich kokalo kuom Duol mar Nonro mar Thieth ma Kenya (KEMRI) kod Duol mar Nonro mar Chanjo mar Aids (KAVI-ICR) osebedo ka otelo e nonro mag Covid-19 ma oriwre e pinyno kod e piny mangima. #Midhusi mar Korona

English: KEMRI reminds expectant mothers in Siaya County that access to skilled birth attendance is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba upatikanaji wa mahudhurio ya uzazi wenye ujuzi ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Siaya in helitaanka daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfad leh ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMRI oparo ne mine ma biro nyuolo e county mar Siaya ni thuolo mar yudo nyithindo ma nigi lony onge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: KALRO warns rice farmers in Nyamira County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaonya wakulima wa mchele katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhusu maambukizi ya wadudu na kupendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: KALRO waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda bariiska ee gobolka Nyamira cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyin waqtigeeda ah.
Dholuo: KALRO chiwo siem ne jopur loso loso loso kodhi e kaunti mar Nyamira kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni otim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: IEBC encourages residents of Kilifi County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inay ka qeybgalaan madasha dadweynaha degmada si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadwaynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogweng' Kilifi County mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar jopiny mar county mondo ging'e kaka jopiny biro tiyo gi bajet mag county.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Nairobi County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inazindua kampeni ya kupambana na ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi mwezi huu wa Oktoba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya ayaa bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee Gobolka Nairobi bishii Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura mar Kenya chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Nairobi e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations alerts residents of West Pokot County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada ayaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot uga digaya kororka kiisaska gawaarida la xaday wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar West Pokot County kuom wach medruok mar wach kwalo mtokni kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: State Department for Basic Education encourages residents of Bomet County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on voter registration.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada si ay uga warqabaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo jogweng' County mar Bomet mondo oriwgi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county mondo ging'e weche duto motudore gi kad mar joma oyier.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds residents of Machakos County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba upatikanaji wa usajili wa e-Citizen sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos in helitaanka diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya parone jogweng'o mag County ma Machakos ni yudo e-Citizen registration koro yot ahinya kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal.

English: Kenya and Zambia: Insurance for Sustainable water systems
Kiswahili: Kenya na Zambia: Bima kwa mifumo ya maji Endelevu
Somali: Kenya iyo Zambia: Caymiska nidaamyada biyaha ee waara
Dholuo: Kenya kod Zambia: Benda mar chenro mag pi manyalo siko

English: KRA announces improved turnaround times for e-Citizen registration in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: KRA inatangaza nyakati bora za kujiandikisha kwa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: KRA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee Gobolka Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: KRA olando lokruok e seche mag timo chenro mar e-Citizen registration e County mar Kirinyaga.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Busia County.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kushughulikia vyeti vya kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Busia.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la hagaajiyay waqtiga wareejinta shahaadada dhalashada ee degmada Busia.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties olando lokruok e seche mag timo nonro mar nyasi mar nyuol e county mar Busia.

English: Gov't increases SHA benefits for Cancer patients, adds real-time claims tracking
Kiswahili: Serikali haiongezi faida za SHA kwa wagonjwa wa Saratani, inaongeza ufuatiliaji wa madai ya wakati halisi
Somali: Dowladdu waxay kordhisay faa'iidooyinka SHA ee bukaanka Kansarka, waxay ku dartay raadinta sheegashada waqtiga dhabta ah
Dholuo: Sirkal medo gweth mag SHA ne jotuo mag Cancer, omedo timo nonro kuom weche mag yuto e kinde masie

English: Notice: COMESA will distribute certified sweet potatoes seed to farmers in Kiambu County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itasambaza mbegu za viazi vitamu zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay u qaybin doontaa abuurka baradho macaan oo shahaado leh beeraleyda degmada Kiambu bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA biro pogo kodhi mag le mamit ne jopur e County mar Kiambu e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) launches community-based development programmes in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inazindua mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu bilaabay barnaamijyo horumarineed oo ku salaysan bulshada ee degmada Nandi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chako chenro mag dongruok e alwora mar Nandi County.

English: If you are using a cyber computer, log out after using your Gmail!
Kiswahili: Ikiwa unatumia kompyuta ya mtandao, jitenge baada ya kutumia Gmail yako!
Somali: Haddii aad isticmaaleysid kombiyuutar internetka, ka tag ka dib markaad isticmaasho Gmail-kaaga!
Dholuo: Kapo ni itiyo gi kompyuta mar intanet, golri ka isetiyo gi Gmail!

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free suicide prevention support is available through county health facilities in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kuzuia kujiua unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo ka hortagga ismiidaaminta laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Bungoma County.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar geng'o ji kik nege yudore maonge chudo kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e Bungoma County.

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of Kakamega County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this May.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Mei hii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kakamega inay u diyaar garoobaan qaraxyo dab ah oo dhici kara bisha May.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross osiemo jogweng' Kakamega County mondo oikre ne yiengni manyalo timore e dwe mar Mei.

English: Good governance is key to a successful cooperative Tips on leadership transparency member participation and financial management
Kiswahili: Utawala bora ni muhimu kwa ushirika wenye mafanikio Vidokezo kuhusu uongozi uwazi ushiriki wa wanachama na usimamizi wa fedha
Somali: Maamul wanaagsan waa furaha iskaashi guuleysta Talooyin ku saabsan hufnaanta hoggaaminta, ka qaybgalka xubnaha iyo maareynta maaliyadda
Dholuo: Riwruok maber en gima dwarore ahinya mondo riwruok mar oganda obed gi nyak

English: Kenya Food Security Outlook, October 2022 to May 2023
Kiswahili: Mtazamo wa Usalama wa Chakula nchini Kenya, Oktoba 2022 hadi Mei 2023
Somali: Aragtida Sugnaanta Cuntada Kenya, Oktoobar 2022 ilaa Maajo 2023
Dholuo: Neno mar Rieko mar Chiemo e piny Kenya, dwe mar apar 2022 nyaka dwe mar abich 2023

English: NTSA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Nairobi County that access to the GBV toll-free helpline is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba upatikanaji wa simu ya GBV ya bure ya msaada unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee Gobolka Nairobi in helitaanka khadka caawimaadda ee GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah uu yahay mid lacag-la'aan ah.
Dholuo: NTSA oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e County mar Nairobi ni gibiro yudo kony ma onge chudo mar GBV maonge chudo.

English: Announcement of multi-sector collaboration to support school nutrition and small-scale dairy livelihoods through public procurement.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la ushirikiano wa sekta mbalimbali ili kusaidia lishe shuleni na riziki ndogo za maziwa kupitia ununuzi wa umma.
Somali: Ogeysiis iskaashi dhowr qaybood ah si loo taageero nafaqada dugsiyada iyo nolosha caanaha yaryar iyada oo loo marayo iibsashada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar pinje mang'eny biro timo chenro mar konyo e siro chiemo ma yudore e skunde kod ngima mar nyithindo matindo e yore mag loso chak kokalo kuom chenro mag loso gik moko.

English: Pest Control Products Board promotes agroforestry among farmers in Laikipia County as part of the November climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inakuza kilimo cha misitu kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Novemba.
Somali: Guddiga Wax soo saarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa beeraleyda beeraha ee degmada Laikipia qayb ka ah dadaalka u adkeynta cimilada ee bisha Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok mag Pest jiwo yore mag loso bunge e kind jopur e county mar Laikipia kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi mar lokruok mar piny e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on residents of Kirinyaga County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of border security.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Utafiti wa Uhalifu inawaomba wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ugu baaqay dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga inay la shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oluongo jogweng' Kirinyaga County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji nitie mondo okony sirkal rito tong'.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges residents of Kericho County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma katikati ya umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo la adeegsanayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo jogweng' Kericho County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'adoe bura nikech ji medo keto pachgi kuom chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne ji.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the community in Nakuru County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb theft.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Nakuru inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo kik gikwel.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Kwale County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the August planting season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa za kukabiliana na ukame kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Agosti.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kwale inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur manie Kwale County mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochopo dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by SHA (Social Health Authority) will be held in Tana River County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Tana River Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ay soo qabanqaabisay SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Tana River bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth maonge chudo ma olos gi SHA (Social Health Authority) ibiro tim e taon mar Tana River e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free youth mental wellness support is available through county health facilities in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa ustawi wa akili wa vijana unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar paro mar rowere yudore maonge chudo kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on parents in Kilifi County to have children under five screened for typhoid during the February outreach.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya watoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuwafanyia uchunguzi watoto walio chini ya miaka mitano kwa ugonjwa wa matumbo wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Februari.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Kilifi in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka tifooska inta lagu gudajiro bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross kwayo jonyuol e County Kilifi mondo otim nonro mar tuo mar typhoid ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Februar.

English: Announcement of expansion plan sourcing school meals from local farmers while integrating climate-resilient crops.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la mpango wa upanuzi wa kutafuta chakula cha shule kutoka kwa wakulima wa eneo hilo huku ukijumuisha mazao yanayostahimili mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa.
Somali: Ogeysiiska qorshe ballaarin ah oo ka helaya cuntooyinka iskuulka beeraleyda deegaanka iyadoo la isku darayo dalagyada cimilada u adkeysan.
Dholuo: Owacho ni chenro mar medo yaro chiemo ne skul biro yudo chiemo moa kuom jopur ma kuno, kendo ni obiro konyo e choko cham ma nigi teko mar geng'o kit yamo.

English: Notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Garissa County this May. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanya kongamano la kurejesha matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Garissa Mei hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay qaban doontaa madasha soo kabashada isticmaalka maandooriyaha ee Gobolka Garissa bisha May. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Riwruok mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo biro timo romo mar chango joma tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero e taon mar Garissa e dwe mar abich.

English: The Horticulture Council of Eastern Africa HoCEA has been established to tackle challenges in the horticulture sector Stakeholders are encouraged to engage with the council for solutions
Kiswahili: Baraza la Kilimo cha Bustani la Afrika Mashariki HoCEA limeanzishwa ili kukabiliana na changamoto katika sekta ya bustani Wadau wahimizwa kushirikiana na baraza hilo kwa ajili ya ufumbuzi.
Somali: Horticulture Council of Eastern Africa HoCEA ayaa la aasaasay si ay ula tacaalto caqabadaha qaybta beeraleyda. Daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay la shaqeeyaan golaha si loo helo xalal
Dholuo: Bura mar Horticulture Council of East Africa (HoCEA) osechako mondo otiek chandruoge ma yudo ji e tij horticulture.

English: Notice: FAO will distribute certified maize seed to farmers in Bomet County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itasambaza mbegu za mahindi zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay abuurka hadhuudhka ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda gobolka Bomet bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: FAO biro pogo kodhi mag kodhi mar kodhi ne jopur man Bomet County e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development opens a new tailoring and design programme at the vocational centre in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yafungua programu mpya ya ushonaji na usanifu katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada Waxbarashada wuxuu ka furayaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan qaabeynta iyo naqshadeynta xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ochako chenro manyien mar loso kendo loso gik moko e skul mar tiegruok e taon mar Nyeri.

English: TSC advises students in Bomet County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: TSC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Bomet kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya udhamini mkondoni kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Somali: TSC waxay ardayda degmada Bomet kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan buugaag iyo qalab waxbarasho.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo jopuonjre e county mar Bomet mondo oketgi e intanet mondo giyud buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages mothers in Kajiado County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kajiado inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit jiwo mine e Kajiado County mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Nyandarua County that access to the GBV toll-free helpline is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba upatikanaji wa simu ya msaada ya GBV ya bure unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ee ka dhacay degmada Nyandarua in helitaanka khadka caawimaadda ee GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah uu yahay mid lacag-la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e County mar Nyandarua ni gibiro yudo kony maonge chudo mar GBV.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds schools in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this August.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Agosti hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xusuusinaya dugsiyada degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay xoojiyaan adeegyada hagista iyo la-talinta bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne skunde man Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo omed jiwo kendo chiwo kony e dwe mar Agost.

English: COMESA reminds farmers in Trans Nzoia County of the ongoing fertiliser application training programme.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya matumizi ya mbolea.
Somali: COMESA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee isticmaalka bacriminta.
Dholuo: COMESA parone jopur e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar tiyo gi yien.

English: KALRO reminds farmers in Trans Nzoia County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Somali: KALRO waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee xakamaynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada.
Dholuo: KALRO parone jopur e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will open a fish collection centre in Marsabit County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itafungua kituo cha kukusanya samaki katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu bilaabi doonaa xarun lagu soo ururiyo kalluunka degmada Marsabit bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: Kenya Dairy Board biro yawo kambi mar choko rech e taon mar Marsabit e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will distribute certified wheat seed to farmers in Laikipia County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itasambaza mbegu za ngano zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu abuurka sarreenka ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doonaa beeraleyda Gobolka Laikipia bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro pogo kodhi mag ngano ne jopur man Laikipia County e dwe mar Januar.

English: Council of Governors urges eligible citizens in Kitui County to participate in voter education.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza raia wenye haki katika Kaunti ya Kitui kushiriki katika elimu ya wapiga kura.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku boorinayaan muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kitui inay ka qaybqaataan waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro mar yiero e kaunti mar Kitui mondo oriwgi e tiegruok mar joma yiero.

English: Kenya: Registered refugees and asylum-seekers (as of 31 August 2024)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Wakimbizi waliosajiliwa na wanaotafuta hifadhi (kuanzia tarehe 31 Agosti 2024)
Somali: Kenya: Qaxootiga diiwaangashan iyo kuwa magangalyo doonka ah (laga bilaabo 31 Agoosto 2024)
Dholuo: Kenya: Jolweny ma ondiki nyinggi kod jogo madwaro dak (chakre tarik 31 dwe mar aboro higa mar 2024)

English: #COVID19 Myth Vs Fact. Myth Gargling warm salty water can help prevent #COVID19. Fact Respiratory viruses are not impacted by saltwater, data on such conditions show. Some claims that gargling with bleach or ethanol can help are also false & dangerous. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Hadithi za #COVID19 Vs Ukweli. Hadithi ya Gargling maji moto yenye chumvi inaweza kusaidia kuzuia #COVID19. Ukweli kwamba virusi vya kupumua haviathiriwi na maji ya chumvi, data juu ya hali kama hizo zinaonyesha. Baadhi ya madai kwamba kusugua na bleach au ethanol kunaweza kusaidia pia ni uwongo na hatari. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: #Khuraafaad COVID19 vs Xaqiiqo. Khuraafaad Luqluqashada biyaha diirran ee milixda leh waxay kaa caawin kartaa ka hortagga #COVID19. Xaqiiqo Fayrasyada neef-mareenka saameyn kuma yeeshaan biyaha milixda leh, sida ay muujinayaan xogta ku saabsan xaaladaha noocaas ah. Sheegashooyinka qaarkood ee ah in luqluqashada warankiilo ama ethanol ay sidoo kale caawin karto waa been abuur iyo khatar. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: #KOVID19 Miriambo Koda Adier. Miriambo Goyo pi maliet ma nigi chumbi nyalo konyo e geng'o #COVID19. Adier Virus mag muya ok yudre gi pi ma nigi chumbi, data ma yudore kuom gik ma kamago nyiso. Jomoko wacho ni ng’ado lak gi blech kata ethanol nyalo konyo bende gin miriambo kendo gin gik ma kelo luoro. #KomeshaKorona

English: KEPHIS urges dairy cows farmers in Kilifi County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported foot and mouth disease cases.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawataka wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Kilifi inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur ma pidho dhok e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo ochiw ripot ne jamni ma nigi tuoche e od thieth machiegni kodgi bang' yudo kit tuoche mag dhoot.

English: Kenya: Cholera Outbreak DREF Application (MDRKE054)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Maombi ya DREF ya Mlipuko wa Kipindupindu (MDRKE054)
Somali: Kenya: Codsiga DREF ee ka dillaacay cudurka daacuunka (MDRKE054)
Dholuo: Kenya: Tuwo mar Kolera Kwayo mar DREF (MDRKE054)

English: ODPP encourages first-time voters in Kisii County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Kisii inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogo ma ne okwongo yiero e County mar Kisii mondo onon weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: TSC advises applicants in Nyamira County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: TSC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kutembelea kituo cha mafunzo ya ufundi kilicho karibu kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: TSC waxay ku talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Nyamira inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee la heli karo.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Nyamira mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: childhood immunization clinics will run every February at designated health centres in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi: kliniki za chanjo za watoto zitafanya kazi kila Februari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka: rugta tallaalka carruurta ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Febraayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Bomet.
Dholuo: Rieko moa kuom Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: Klinike mag thiedho nyithindo ibiro tiyoe e dwe mar ariyo higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e county mar Bomet.

English: Notice: KEMSA will hold a suicide prevention forum in Bomet County this October. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA itafanya kongamano la kuzuia kujiua katika Kaunti ya Bomet Oktoba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMSA waxay qabaneysaa madasha ka hortagga ismiidaaminta ee gobolka Bomet bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni KEMSA biro timo chokruok mar geng'o ji kik donjre e dwe mar Oktoba e taon mar Bomet County.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises tea producers in Nandi County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inashauri wazalishaji wa chai katika Kaunti ya Nandi kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu kula talinayaa soo saarayaasha shaaha ee degmada Nandi inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products nyiso jopur ma loso chai e county mar Nandi mondo odonj e riwruok ma nigi ratiro mar timo gik ma chando ji kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: CDC reminds expectant mothers in Nyandarua County that access to childhood immunization is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: CDC inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba upatikanaji wa chanjo ya utotoni ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Nyandarua in helitaanka tallaalka carruurta ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: CDC paronwa mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Nyandarua ni yudo thieth mar nyithindo en gima onge chudo e kuonde duto mag sirkal.

English: Office of the Auditor-General updates residents of Lamu County on progress of county development projects this June.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawajulisha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Lamu maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo ya wilaya hii Juni.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Lamu ka warbixiyaa horumarka mashaariicda horumarinta degmada bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General medo lero ne jogweng' mar County mar Lamu kaka chenro mag dongruok mar county dhi nyime e dwe mar Jun.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Kakamega County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega inay biyo cabitaan ah ku kariyaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' Kakamega County mondo omak pi modho kapok gitiyo kode mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Strengthen livestock disease surveillance and monitoring, and promote pasture and fodder conservation.
Kiswahili: Kuimarisha ufuatiliaji na ufuatiliaji wa magonjwa ya mifugo, na kukuza uhifadhi wa malisho na wanyama.
Somali: Xoojinta kormeerka iyo kormeerka cudurrada xoolaha, iyo kor u qaadida ilaalinta daaqsinka iyo hilibka.
Dholuo: Tiyo gi yore mopogore opogore mag rito kod rito tuoche mag jamni, kendo jiwo rito yiende kod ringre jamni.

English: NPS reminds residents of Siaya County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada daadadka ka dhacay xilligan shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: NPS oparo ne jogweng' County mar Siaya ni kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o e kinde masiche mag ndara.

English: KTDA reminds residents of Murang'a County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: KTDA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a in ilaalinta ciidda ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: KTDA parone jogweng' mar County mar Murang'a ni rito lowo miyo puodho bedo maber e kinde mabiro.

English: NPS warns residents of Kiambu County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: NPS waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu kororka khiyaamada SIM-swap waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: NPS chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kiambu County e wi medruok mar wuond mag SIM-swap kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: Government to ectend curview, including various larget gatherings until may 29
Kiswahili: Serikali kupanua muda wa kuondoka, ikiwa ni pamoja na makusanyiko mbalimbali makubwa hadi Mei 29
Somali: Xukuumadda ayaa kordhin doonta waqtiga curfeed, oo ay ku jiraan shirar kala duwan oo ballaaran illaa May 29
Dholuo: Sirkal biro medo bedo gi thuolo mar dhi e chokruoge madongo nyaka tarik 29 dwe mar abich

English: Pest Control Products Board announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for poultry in Mandera County this May.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa kuku katika Kaunti ya Mandera Mei hii.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa ku dhawaaqaya jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ka dhan ah qabyaalada digaagga ee Gobolka Mandera bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok mar Pest olando chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar rabies e taon mar Mandera e dwe mar Mei.

English: Office of the Auditor-General warns public officers in Nyeri County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Nyeri dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya madaraka.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Nyeri inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e County mar Nyeri ni kik giti marach gi migepegi.

English: CDC calls on parents in Nyeri County to have children under five screened for typhoid during the November outreach.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa matumbo wakati wa mawasiliano ya Novemba.
Somali: CDC waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Nyeri in carruurta ka yar shan sano la baaro cudurka tifooska inta lagu gudajiro bisha November.
Dholuo: CDC kwayo jonyuol e County mar Nyeri mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Novemba.

English: To address these challenges, the WHO Digital Finance Team, in collaboration with the Ministry of Health and the World Health Organization in Kenya, introduced a digital payment system to ensure health workers are compensated faster and more reliably.
Kiswahili: Ili kukabiliana na changamoto hizi, Timu ya Fedha ya Kidijitali ya WHO, kwa ushirikiano na Wizara ya Afya na Shirika la Afya Ulimwenguni nchini Kenya, ilianzisha mfumo wa malipo wa kidijitali ili kuhakikisha wafanyakazi wa afya wanalipwa fidia haraka na kwa uhakika zaidi.
Somali: Si wax looga qabto caqabadahan, Kooxda Maaliyadda Dijitaalka ah ee WHO, oo kaashanaysa Wasaaradda Caafimaadka iyo Hay'adda Caafimaadka Adduunka ee Kenya, waxay soo bandhigeen nidaam lacag bixin dijitaal ah si loo hubiyo in shaqaalaha caafimaadka si dhakhso leh oo kalsooni leh loo siiyo magdhowga.
Dholuo: Mondo oket ler kuom pek ma kamago, Tich mar WHO mar Chudo mag Dijital, ka oriwre gi Od Romo mar Thieth kod Riwruok mar Pinyruoth mar Thieth e piny Kenya, nokelo yo mar chudo mag dijital mondo gine ni jotich mag thieth yudo chudo mapiyo kendo ma nyalo geno.

English: KNEC advises students in Siaya County to register early to secure allocation to access revision guides.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Siaya kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata miongozo ya marekebisho.
Somali: KNEC waxay ardayda degmada Siaya kula talineysaa inay horay u diiwaangeliyaan si loo helo kaalmo si ay u helaan hagaha dib-u-eegista.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jopuonjre e county mar Siaya mondo odonj e skundno chon mondo giyud thuolo mar somo buge ma nyiso kaka nonro ne dhi timore.

English: Public health advisory: KEMSA warns of increased dengue fever risk in Mandera County and advises the public to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMSA inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya homa ya dengue katika Kaunti ya Mandera na inashauri umma kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Talobixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: KEMSA waxay ka digtay kororka halista hargabka dengue ee Degmada Mandera waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: KEMSA osiemo ji kuom medruok mar tuwo mar dengue e County mar Mandera kendo ojiwo ji mondo omany thieth mapiyo e kama thieth nitie machiegni kodgi.

English: Notice: IEBC opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa ajili ya usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Homa Bay County.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay ka furaysaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay ka shaqeynta shahaadada dhalashada ee gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC oseyawo kama itimee tije manyien mar loso barua mag nyuol e Homa Bay County.

English: Kenya Dairy Board warns rice farmers in Siaya County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda bariiska ee degmada Siaya cudurrada cayayaanka waxaana uu ku talinayaa in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board chiwo siem ne jopur ma loso loso loso kodhi e county mar Siaya kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Wajir County that access to post-violence medical care is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu zinapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay Gobolka Wajir in helitaanka daryeelka caafimaad ee rabshadda ka dib la heli karo lacag la'aan.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Wajir ni yudo kony mar thieth bang' lweny en gima ng'ato nyalo yudo maonge chudo.

English: Integrating Traditional & Religious Healers into the Formal Health Care System for Preparedness & Management of Highly Infectious Diseases such as Ebola
Kiswahili: Kujumuisha Waganga wa Kienyeji na Kidini katika Mfumo Rasmi wa Huduma ya Afya kwa Maandalizi na Udhibiti wa Magonjwa Ambukizi Sana kama vile Ebola.
Somali: Ku-biirinta Dhakhaatiirta Dhaqanka iyo Diinta Nidaamka Daryeelka Caafimaadka ee Rasmiga ah si loogu Diyaargaroobo & Loo Maareeyo Cudurrada Faafa ee aadka u faafa sida Ebola
Dholuo: Kodo Keto Jothieth mag Kido kod Dini e Sistem mar Thieth ma Owinjore mondo oikre kendo orit tuoche ma nyalo landore ahinya kaka Ebola

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross issues a cybersecurity alert on phishing messages affecting residents of Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya ujumbe wa udanganyifu unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan fariimaha phishing ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ripot Mamit mar Kenya ogolo siem e wi weche mag cybersecurity e wi ote mag phishing makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e County mar Kisii.

English: IPOA urges the community in Samburu County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb carjacking.
Kiswahili: IPOA inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia utekaji nyara wa gari.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada gobolka Samburu inay ka warbixiyaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo shaki leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo afduubka gawaarida.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo ji duto manie county mar Samburu mondo onyis polis ma ni machiegni gi kanyo ni gitimo gik ma chando mtokni.

English: KEPHIS advises farmers in Vihiga County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the November planting season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Novemba.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Vihiga inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagyada si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Nofeembar.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e County mar Vihiga mondo otim lokruok e puothe mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber kapok ochako chuoyo e dwe mar Novemba.

English: New curriculum for motor vehicle mechanics launched in TVETs.
Kiswahili: Mtaala mpya wa ufundi wa magari wazinduliwa katika Vyuo Vikuu vya Elimu ya Juu.
Somali: Manhaj cusub oo loogu talagalay farsamoyaqaannada baabuurta ayaa lagu bilaabay TVET-yada.
Dholuo: Karikulum manyien mar mekanik mag gari ochakore e skul mag TVET.

English: Ministry of Health reminds expectant mothers in Vihiga County that access to free antenatal care is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma ya bure ya ujauzito ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Vihiga in helitaanka daryeelka uurka ka hor ee bilaashka ah ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth parone mine madwaro nyuol e County mar Vihiga ni thuolo mar yudo rit ma onge chudo mar nyathine en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag sirkal.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds residents of Turkana County that agroforestry improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba kilimo cha misitu kinaboresha uzalishaji wa muda mrefu wa shamba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana in beeraha iyo kaymaha ay hagaajinayaan wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development oparo ne jogweng' Turkana County ni agroforestry medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Notice: Council of Governors will hold a public participation forum on development planning forums in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana litafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha waxay qaban doonaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta ee Gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Jaloch biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag dongruok e county mar Uasin Gishu.

English: Notice: NTSA issues a cybersecurity alert on phishing messages affecting residents of Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya ujumbe wa udanganyifu unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan fariimaha phishing ee saameeya dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NTSA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity e wi ote mag phishing makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e Kaunti mar Kakamega.

English: NTSA reminds the public in Taita-Taveta County to remain vigilant on border security.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: NTSA waxay dadka degmada Taita-Taveta ku xasuusineysaa inay ka feejignaadaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: NTSA parone ji duto manie Taita-Taveta County ni gibed motang' e weche mag rito tong'.

English: KNEC reminds schools in Nyandarua County to strengthen school infrastructure safety this May.
Kiswahili: KNEC inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuimarisha usalama wa miundombinu ya shule Mei hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay xusuusineysaa dugsiyada gobolka Nyandarua inay xoojiyaan ammaanka kaabayaasha dugsiga bisha May.
Dholuo: KNEC oparo ne skunde man Nyandarua County mondo omed jiwo ritruok mar chenro mag skul e dwe mar Mei.

English: The Maneno Yetu study aimed to fill these gaps by providing descriptions of our PSA creation workshop process that was peer-driven from conception to completion.
Kiswahili: Utafiti wa Maneno Yetu ulikuwa na lengo la kujaza mapengo haya kwa kutoa maelezo ya mchakato wa semina yetu ya uundaji wa PSA ambayo iliendeshwa na wenzao kutoka kuanzishwa hadi kukamilika.
Somali: Daraasadda Maneno Yetu waxay ujeedkeedu ahaa in la buuxiyo farqigaas iyada oo la siinayo sharaxaad ku saabsan geedi socodka aqoon isweydaarsiga sameynta PSA ee loo maareeyay asxaabteeda laga bilaabo fikirka ilaa dhammaystirka.
Dholuo: Nonro mar Maneno Yetu ne dwaro tieko ywaruokgo kuom chiwo weche malero chenro ma ne wan-go mar loso PSA ma ne itimo gi joma welo chakre chakruok nyaka giko.

English: Notice: TVET opens applications for school laptops under the digital literacy programme for learners in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inafungua maombi ya kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay barnaamijka akhriska digitalka ee gobolka Bomet u fureysaa codsiyada kumbuyuutarrada iskuulka.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET chako tiyo gi kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar somo kod somo mar digital e county mar Bomet.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds the public in Migori County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mkurugenzi Mkuu wa Idadi ya Watu inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Migori kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu dadka degmada Migori xusuusinayaa in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General parone ji duto e County mar Migori ni chiwo ripot mar asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge chudo, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Notice from CDC: childhood immunization clinics will run every July at designated health centres in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa CDC: kliniki za chanjo za watoto zitafanya kazi kila Julai katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid CDC: rugta tallaalka carruurta ayaa ka shaqeyn doonta July kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar yedhe (CDC): klinik mag thiedho nyithindo biro dhi nyime higa ka higa e dwe mar Julai e kuonde thieth moyier e county mar Nyandarua.

English: Notice from Division of Disease Surveillance and Response: nutrition supplementation for infants clinics will run every August at designated health centres in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa: nyongeza ya lishe kwa kliniki za watoto wachanga itaendeshwa kila Agosti katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka socda qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada: Kordhinta nafaqada ee rugta caafimaadka ee dhallaanka ayaa lagu sameyn doonaa bishii Agoosto ee kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Nakuru.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo wacho ni: Yore mag thieth ne nyithindo matindo ibiro tim dwe mar Agost higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e gweng' mar Nakuru.

English: Notice: IEBC will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada ee degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e county mar Kisii.

English: KNEC urges residents of Homa Bay County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo ji duto modak e Homa Bay County mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud tiegruok mar sekondar maonge chudo.

English: HelpAge International's statement on Kenya floods
Kiswahili: Kauli ya HelpAge International kuhusu mafuriko ya Kenya
Somali: War-saxaafadeed ka soo baxay HelpAge International oo ku saabsan daadadka Kenya
Dholuo: Wach ma HelpAge mar piny mangima owacho e wi pi ma oumo piny Kenya

English: CDC advises residents of Kisumu County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: CDC inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: CDC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay yareeyaan qaadashada cusbada iyo sonkorta si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: CDC nyiso jogweng' mar Kisumu County ni giduog chien e chamo chumbi kod sukari mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association confirms a meningitis outbreak alert for West Pokot County. Residents are advised to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya chathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa uti wa mgongo katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi. Wakazi wanashauriwa kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu xaqiijiyay digniin ku saabsan cudurka meningitis ee gobolka West Pokot. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Medical Association osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuo mar meningitis e West Pokot County.

English: AFA invites farmers in Nandi County to a free training on post-harvest handling this October.
Kiswahili: AFA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno Oktoba hii.
Somali: AFA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda gobolka Nandi tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan maareynta goosashada ka dib bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: AFA ogwelo jopur e county mar Nandi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Public invitation and details for October 2025 national conference themed â€œSecuring the Futureâ€ on holistic mental health.
Kiswahili: Mwaliko wa umma na maelezo ya mkutano wa kitaifa wa Oktoba 2025 wenye mandhari ya "Kuhakikisha Wakati Ujao" juu ya afya ya akili ya jumla.
Somali: Casuumad dadweyne iyo faahfaahin ku saabsan shirka qaran ee Oktoobar 2025 oo cinwaankiisu yahay "Sugidda Mustaqbalka" oo ku saabsan caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhammaystiran.
Dholuo: Oboke mar ji duto kod weche matut mag chokruok mar piny mangima ma biro bedo e dwe mar apar 2025 ma nigi wi wach ni â€œKeto kinde mabiroâ€TM e wi ngima mar paro ma opong’o.

English: Covid 19 injection are ideal for adults, women and those breast feeding as adiviced by WHO. They can get vaccinated through the Doctors prescriptions.
Kiswahili: Sindano ya Covid 19 ni bora kwa watu wazima, wanawake na wale wanaonyonyesha kama ilivyoagizwa na WHO. Wanaweza kupata chanjo kupitia maagizo ya Madaktari.
Somali: Cirbadeynta COVID-19 waxay ku habboon tahay dadka waaweyn, haweenka iyo kuwa naas nuujinaya sida ay soo jeedisay WHO. Waxay tallaali karaan iyada oo loo marayo qodobbada dhakhaatiirta.
Dholuo: Covid 19 injection en gima ber ahinya ne joma dongo, mon kod jogo machiemo mana kaka osenyis gi WHO. Ginyalo yudo thieth kokalo kuom chike mag lakteche.

English: COMESA warns rice farmers in Migori County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawaonya wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Migori juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: COMESA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda bariiska ee degmada Migori cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: COMESA chiwo siem ne jopur loso loso kodhi e gweng' mar Migori kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni otim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: NPS warns residents of Baringo County about a rise in phishing messages and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo juu ya kuongezeka kwa ujumbe wa udanganyifu na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: NPS waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo kororka fariimaha phishing waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: NPS chiwo siem ne jogweng' Baringo County kuom wach medruok mar ote mag phishing kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar ote maok kare ne jatendgi.

English: IPOA reminds residents of Siaya County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada ay fatahaadu ka dhacdo xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogweng' County mar Siaya mondo kik giwuoth e wi borni kod aoche ma pi opong'o e kinde mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: KEMRI calls on parents in Kirinyaga County to have children under five screened for meningitis during the November outreach.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuwachunguza watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa ugonjwa wa uti wa mgongo wakati wa mawasiliano ya Novemba.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Kirinyaga in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro meningitis inta lagu jiro adeegga bisha November.
Dholuo: KEMRI okwayo jonyuol e County mar Kirinyaga mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service activates an emergency response plan for landslides in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inaamsha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu soo saaray qorshe xaalad deg deg ah oo looga jawaabayo dhulgariirada ka dhaca degmada Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Forest Service tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony mapiyo ne yiengni mag piny e County mar Lamu.

English: OGP encourages first-time voters in Garissa County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: OGP inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Garissa kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: OGP waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Garissa inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogo matimoga yiero mokwongo e County mar Garissa mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi kata pasipoti e odiechieng'no mar timo yiero.

English: Notice: KEMRI will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Mombasa County this December. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI itafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Desemba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay qabaneysaa madasha caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada ee degmada Mombasa bisha December. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMRI biro timo romo mar paro ne rowere e Mombasa County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: FAO restricts movement of goats in Kwale County due to a foot and mouth disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO inazuia harakati za mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Kwale kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa riyaha ee Gobolka Kwale sababo la xiriira faafitaanka cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: FAO ogeng'o wuoth mar diek e county mar Kwale nikech tuwo mar dhoho.

English: Climate-smart agriculture (CSA) is an approach to managing landscapes that addresses the interlinked challenges of food security and accelerating climate ...
Kiswahili: Kilimo cha hali ya hewa (CSA) ni njia ya kusimamia mandhari ambayo inashughulikia changamoto zilizounganishwa za usalama wa chakula na kuharakisha hali ya hewa ...
Somali: Beeraha cimilada-caqli-galka ah (CSA) waa hab lagu maareeyo muuqaalada muuqaalka ee wax ka qabta caqabadaha isku xiran ee amniga cuntada iyo dardargelinta cimilada ...
Dholuo: Tij pur mariek e weche mag lokruok e yo ma piny chalo (Climate-Smart Agriculture - CSA) en yo ma itiyogo e rito kuonde ma piny chalo, kendo ma kedo gi pek ma yudo ji nikech weche mag chiemo kod lokruok e kit ngima mar piny.

English: Farmers need access to information from research on how to farm sustainably, and indigenous knowledge should be prioritized in decisions that affect farmers.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahitaji kupata habari kutoka kwa utafiti juu ya jinsi ya kulima kwa uendelevu, na maarifa ya asili yanapaswa kupewa kipaumbele katika maamuzi ambayo yanaathiri wakulima.
Somali: Beeraleydu waxay u baahan yihiin helitaanka macluumaadka cilmi-baarista ee ku saabsan sida loo beero si joogto ah, aqoonta asaliga ahna waa in la mudnaanta siiyo go'aannada saameeya beeraleyda.
Dholuo: Jo-Puritan nyaka bed gi thuolo mar yudo weche ma yudore e nonro ma nyiso kaka ginyalo pidho puothegi e yo ma nigi nyak, kendo ng'eyo ma jopurgo nigo onego obed mokwongo e yiero ma gitimo.

English: Consider therapy or counseling. A mental health professional can provide strategies to cope with stigma and help you develop a positive self-image

English: KEMSA urges residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night following a rise in reported dengue fever cases.
