Somali: COMESA waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee gobolka Homa Bay fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Juun.
Dholuo: COMESA nyiso jopur mag chai e Homa Bay County kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Jun.

English: KUCCPS urges parents and teachers in Uasin Gishu County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Uasin Gishu inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto.

English: Public notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will host a free safe water storage outreach in Wajir County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa kuhifadhi maji salama katika Kaunti ya Wajir Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa qaban doonta adeeg lacag la'aan ah oo lagu kaydiyo biyaha ammaanka ah ee Gobolka Wajir bisha May.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo chenro mar choko pi maonge chudo e boma mar Wajir e dwe mar abich.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds expectant mothers in Turkana County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Turkana in helitaanka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche paro ne mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Turkana ni thuolo mar yudo kony mar chano ngima joot en maonge chudo e kuonde duto ma ji yudoree.

English: Ministry of Health announces eye and dental camps for residents of Nandi County starting this November.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatangaza kambi za macho na meno kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kuanzia Novemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ku dhawaaqday xeryo indhaha iyo ilkaha loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Nandi laga bilaabo bisha November.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health olando kambi mag neno kendo thieth mag lakteche mag jo dala mar Nandi County kochakore e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges the public in Kakamega County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Kenya Red Cross inawasihi watu katika Kaunti ya Kakamega wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa shacabka degmada Kakamega inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka M-Pesa qof kasta oo ka dambeeya kiisaska la soo sheegay ee nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ojiwo ji duto e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo weche ma nyiso ni gin gi chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo.

English: KEPHIS warns tea farmers in Kwale County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawaonya wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Kwale juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee Gobolka Kwale cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda ah.
Dholuo: KEPHIS chiwo siem ne jopur ma loso chai e gweng' mar Kwale kuom masiche ma nyalo kelo tuoche kendo ojiwo ni otim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds residents of Tharaka-Nithi County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi wanaohudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi ee ka qeybgalaya kalfadhiga guud ee golaha deegaanka inay xoojiyaan maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County ma biro e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges wheat growers in Nakuru County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawasihi wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kutumia viwango vinavyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda wheat ee degmada Nakuru inay isticmaalaan sicirka bacriminta lagu taliyey roobka ka hor si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur mag ngano e gweng ' mar Nakuru County mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue mondo omed nyak mar ngano e higani.

English: Notice: SHA launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Bomet County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Shirika la SHA linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu ya kupambana na ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Bomet mwezi huu wa Oktoba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee gobolka Bomet bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova (SHA) chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Bomet e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Makueni County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay yareeyaan qaadashada cusbada iyo sonkorta si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso jogweng' Makueni County ni giduog chien e chamo chumbi kod sukari mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche ma ok nyal geng'o.

English: Council of Governors invites residents of Nyandarua County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuwasilisha maandishi ya kumbukumbu kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku martiqaadaan dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch ogwelo jogweng' kaunti mar Nyandarua mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso bajet mar kaunti.

English: Coalition Against Sexual Violence Calls on Government of Kenya to Act to End Femicide and Violence Against Women in Kenya
Kiswahili: Muungano wa Kupinga Unyanyasaji wa Kijinsia Waitaka Serikali ya Kenya Kuchukua Hatua Kukomesha Mauaji ya Wanawake na Unyanyasaji Dhidi ya Wanawake nchini Kenya.
Somali: Isbahaysiga Ka Hortagga Xadgudubyada Galmada ayaa ugu baaqay Dowladda Kenya inay tallaabo ka qaaddo joojinta dilka iyo rabshadaha ka dhanka ah haweenka ee Kenya.
Dholuo: Oganda ma Kedo Tulo mar Nindruok Okwayo Sirkal mar Kenya mondo Otim Okang’ mar Tieko Nek mar Mon kod Timbe mag anjao ne Mon e piny Kenya

English: EACC reminds residents of Nandi County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nandi in ay ku hawlan yihiin maamulaha qaybta deegaanka si loo xoojiyo maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: EACC parone jogweng' kaunti mar Nandi ni tudruok gi jotelo mag gwenge maggi miyo sirkal bedo gi loch maber.

English: KUCCPS reminds schools in Tana River County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this April.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Aprili hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Tana River inay xoojiyaan adeegyada hagista iyo la-talinta bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: KUCCPS paronwa skunde mag Tana River County mondo omed jiwo kendo chiwo kony e dwe mar April.

English: CDC urges residents of Kisii County to complete the full recommended vaccination dose following a rise in reported tuberculosis cases.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya kifua kikuu vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: CDC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay dhammaystiraan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo kadib kororka kiisaska cudurka 'tuberculosis' ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo jogweng' County mar Kisii mondo otiek dose duto mar thieth ma ichikoe nikech kwan mar ji ma nigi tuberculosis osemedore.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises tea producers in Kericho County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inashauri wazalishaji wa chai katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha shaaha ee degmada Kericho inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur ma loso chai e county mar Kericho mondo oti gi nengo mar piny mosingi kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Nyamira County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira in si deg deg ah u soo sheegidda dhac ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne jogweng' Nyamira County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo odno konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: IPOA urges the public in Tharaka-Nithi County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: IPOA inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu.
Somali: IPOA waxay ugu baaqaysaa dadweynaha degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada lacagta mobilada.
Dholuo: IPOA ojiwo ji duto e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo ochiw ripot mar ote makelo hinyruok ne jatendgi mar tich bang' yudo ripode mag wuond mag pesa e simo.

English: In our pursuit of a healthier society, let's not forget that there is no health without mental health! As we prioritize physical well-being, it is equally important to prioritize our mental and emotional well-being.
Kiswahili: Katika kutafuta jamii yenye afya njema, tusisahau kwamba hakuna afya bila afya ya akili! Tunapoweka kipaumbele ustawi wa kimwili, ni muhimu pia kuweka kipaumbele ustawi wetu wa kiakili na kihisia.
Somali: Marka aynu raadinayno bulsho caafimaad leh, ha iloobinno in caafimaad aan caafimaad maskaxeed lahayn la'aantiis aysan jirin!
Dholuo: Sama watemo matek mondo wabed gi ngima maber, kik wiwa wil ni onge ngima maber maok wan gi ngima mar paro!

English: Notice: Ministry of Education reminds citizens in Machakos County about their rights regarding devolution.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Machakos xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Puonjruok parone raia mag Machakos County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar golo pesa.

English: Healthy mental life contributes to success in your daily work. Priritizing mental health contributes to fruiful work you do and increase yiour incomes
Kiswahili: Maisha yenye afya ya akili huchangia mafanikio katika kazi yako ya kila siku.
Somali: Nolosha maskaxda ee caafimaad leh waxay gacan ka geysaneysaa guusha shaqadaada maalinlaha ah.
Dholuo: Bedo gi ngima maber mar paro konyo ahinya e tije mitimo pile ka pile.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds residents of Meru County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Meru ku xasuusinayaa inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay adeegsadaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lugta lagu maro inta lagu jiro xilliyada shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations parone jogweng' mar County mar Meru mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo oti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe e kinde masiche mag ndara.

English: Notice: ODPP opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay fureysaa barta adeegga cusub ee diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee Gobolka Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: ODPP oseyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag e-Citizen registration e Trans Nzoia County.

English: State Department unveils pilot of e-voucher and digital tools to monitor input delivery, production and dietary outcomes.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Mambo ya Nje yazindua majaribio ya vocha za kielektroniki na zana za kidijitali ili kufuatilia utoaji wa pembejeo, uzalishaji na matokeo ya lishe.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda waxay soo bandhigtay tijaabo ah oo ah gunno elektiroonig ah iyo qalab dhijitaal ah si loo kormeero bixinta wax soo saarka, soo saarista iyo natiijooyinka cuntada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Piny owacho ogolo chenro mar tiyo gi e-voucher kod gik mamoko mag digital mondo gine kaka gikonyore, kaka gikonyo e loso chiemo, koda kaka giketo pachgi kuom chiemo.

English: Notice: KALRO will open an avocado collection centre in Kitui County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya parachichi katika Kaunti ya Kitui Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay ka furi doontaa xarun ururinta avocado ee Gobolka Kitui bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KALRO biro yawo ot mar choko avocado e taon mar Kitui e dwe mar Mach.

English: Communities should educate and support adolescents to avoid early pregnancies through life skills, counseling, and access to reproductive health services.
Kiswahili: Jamii zinapaswa kuwaelimisha na kuwasaidia vijana kuepuka mimba za mapema kupitia ujuzi wa maisha, ushauri nasaha, na upatikanaji wa huduma za afya ya uzazi.
Somali: Bulshooyinka waa inay bartaan oo taageeraan dhalinyarada si ay uga fogaadaan uurka hore iyada oo loo marayo xirfadaha nolosha, la talinta, iyo helitaanka adeegyada caafimaadka taranka.
Dholuo: Oganda onego opuonj kendo okony rowere ma rowere mondo kik ginyuol chon ka gitiyo gi lony ma gin-go e ngima, chiwo puonj, kendo tiyo gi yore mag thieth mar nyuol.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Kitui County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo katika msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay adeegaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha deegaanka xilli ciyaareedkan dabka.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service parone jogweng' Kitui County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji moa kuonde ma kamago ma jotelo mag gweng'no ogolo e kinde mag yiengni.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will open a maize collection centre in Samburu County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mahindi katika Kaunti ya Samburu Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xarun ururinta hadhuudhka ka furi doontaa gobolka Samburu bisha Ogosto.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro yawo kama ichokoe cham e county mar Samburu e dwe mar Agost.

English: NDMA alerts residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: NDMA waxay uga digtay dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in ay kordheen kiisaska tuugada waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: NDMA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County e wi medruok mar kwan mag jokuoge kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Ministry of Health announces SHA registration for residents of Kericho County starting this October.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatangaza usajili wa SHA kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuanzia Oktoba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ku dhawaaqday diiwaangelinta SHA ee dadka deggan degmada Kericho laga bilaabo Oktoobarkan.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health olando SHA kad mar joma odak e County mar Kericho kochakore dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Council of Governors urges residents of Machakos County to attend the public participation forum to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku boorinayaan dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si loo qaabeeyo dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Council of Governors jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Machakos mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar timo nonro mar tich higa ka higa.

English: Kenya - Garissa County - Dadaab - Hagader Refugee Camp Infrastructure Map (29/08/2024)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Kaunti ya Garissa - Dadaab - Ramani ya Miundombinu ya Kambi ya Wakimbizi ya Hagader (29/08/2024)
Somali: Kenya - Degmada Gaarisa - Dhadhaab - Khariidadda Kaabayaasha Kaabayaasha Xerada Qaxootiga Xagardheer (29/08/2024)
Dholuo: Kenya - Guonda mar Garissa - Dadaab - Map mar gedo mag kambi mar jolweny mag Hagader (29/08/2024)

English: Minister Sajjan announces $68 million in international assistance funding on trip to Rwanda and Kenya
Kiswahili: Waziri Sajjan atangaza ufadhili wa msaada wa kimataifa wa dola milioni 68 katika safari ya Rwanda na Kenya
Somali: Wasiir Sajjan ayaa ku dhawaaqay $68 milyan oo ah maalgelin caalami ah oo ku saabsan safar uu ku tagayo Rwanda iyo Kenya
Dholuo: Jatend piny Sajjan olando ni obiro chiwo dola milion 68 mag kony mar piny mangima e wuodhe ma dhi dhi e piny Rwanda kod Kenya

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development restricts movement of dairy cows in Kisumu County due to an anthrax outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo yazuia harakati za ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kutokana na mlipuko wa kimeta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Kisumu sababo la xiriira cudurka Anthrax.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok makwayo e Kisumu County nikech tuo mar anthrax.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Mombasa County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kula talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Mombasa inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qayb galaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e county mar Mombasa mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mar jopur mabiro.

English: NCPB promotes terracing among farmers in Vihiga County as part of the January climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: NCPB inakuza usafirishaji kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kama sehemu ya harakati za ustahimilivu wa hali ya hewa ya Januari.
Somali: NCPB waxay dhiirrigelisay dhulka beeraleyda degmada Vihiga iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka u adkeynta cimilada ee Janaayo.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo puodho e kind jopur e County mar Vihiga kaka achiel kuom chenro mar Januar mar kedo gi lokruok e kor lwasi.

English: New mothers can begin light exercises after consulting their doctor to improve recovery and mental health.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wapya wanaweza kuanza mazoezi mepesi baada ya kushauriana na daktari wao ili kuboresha kupona na afya ya akili.
Somali: Hooyooyinka cusub waxay bilaabi karaan jimicsi fudud ka dib markay la tashadaan dhakhtarkooda si loo hagaajiyo soo kabashada iyo caafimaadka maskaxda.
Dholuo: Min nyithindo manyien nyalo chako timo tiegruok matin bang' wuoyo gi laktar mondo omi gibed gi paro mowinjore.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Kwale County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah xilligan shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross parone jogweng' mar Kwale County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji e nderni ma sirkal ogolo e kinde masiche mag ndara.

English: EACC urges residents of Murang'a County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on community-based development programmes.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee golaha gobolka si ay uga warqabaan barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Murang'a mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo gibed molony gi chenro mag dongruok e kind oganda.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Wajir County this April.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Wajir Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed ayaa bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee Gobolka Wajir bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Wajir e dwe mar April.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges residents of Kilifi County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi kuwasilisha maandishi ya kumbukumbu kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya wilaya.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si loo qaabeeyo geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General jiwo ji duto modak e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso bajet mar gweng'no ochopo.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Vihiga County this March. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanya kongamano la kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Machi hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) waxay qaban doontaa munaasabad dib u soo kabashada xadgudubka maandooriyaha ee degmada Vihiga bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo chokruok mar chango joma tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero e taon mar Vihiga e dwe mar Mach.

English: All TVET students get Ksh 10,000 monthly stipend + free laptop from Jan!
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wote wa TVET wanapata posho ya kila mwezi ya Ksh 10,000 + kompyuta mpakato bila malipo kuanzia Januari!
Somali: Dhamaan ardayda TVET waxay ka helayaan Ksh 10,000 oo mushahar bille ah + laptop bilaash ah Jan!
Dholuo: Jopuonjre duto mag TVET yudo chudo mar Ksh 10,000 dwe ka dwe + laptop maonge chudo kuom Jan!

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service informs horticultural produce farmers in Wajir County of new market linkage opportunities this June.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawafahamisha wakulima wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Juni hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu uga warramiyaa beeraleyda wax soo saarka beeraha ee Gobolka Wajir fursado cusub oo ku saabsan xiriirka suuqa bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur ma loso puothe e gweng' mar Wajir thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Jun.

English: KALRO advises maize producers in Tana River County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inashauri wazalishaji wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Tana River kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KALRO waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha hadhuudhka ee degmada Tana River inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KALRO nyiso jopur ma loso kodhi e taon mar Tana River County mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: It is not good for infants to be exposed to sigarette smoke because it affects the lungs of the child and can lead to suddeb death of the child
Kiswahili: Ni vibaya kwa watoto wachanga kuathiriwa na moshi wa sigara kwa sababu huathiri mapafu ya mtoto na inaweza kusababisha kifo cha mtoto

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on the community in Laikipia County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwa ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa bulshada degmada Laikipia ugu baaqay inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan oo ay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oluongo ji duto e County mar Laikipia mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gichiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges eligible citizens in Kajiado County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kajiado County kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Guddiga Garsoorka Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kajiado inay ka qaybqaataan jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jokanyo mag Kajiado County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar yiero.

English: NDMA calls on residents of West Pokot County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaita wakazi wa Wilaya ya West Pokot kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: NDMA waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga dhaqdhaqaaq aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah si ay u taageeraan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: NDMA okwayo jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma rito kuwe e gwenge mag tong' mondo okony e loso kuwe e piny.

English: CDC reminds the public in Nyandarua County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba ufikiaji wa msaada wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nyandarua in helitaanka taageerada sheegashada NHIF / SHA ay hadda ka heli karto xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji duto manie Nyandarua County ni kony mar kwayo kwayo mag NHIF/SHA sani yudore e kuonde moyier.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges eligible citizens in Laikipia County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Xafiiska tijaabiyaha guud wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Laikipia inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro mar yiero e county mar Laikipia mondo oriwgi e ndiko joma oyier.

English: State Department for TVET encourages out-of-school children in Garissa County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Garissa kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Garissa inay dalbadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State for TVET jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e County mar Garissa mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Floods in Kenya underscore urgent need for anticipatory action in disaster situations
Kiswahili: Mafuriko nchini Kenya yanasisitiza haja ya haraka ya hatua za kutarajia katika hali za maafa
Somali: Daadad ka dhacay Kenya ayaa hoosta ka xariiqay baahida degdegga ah ee loo qabo tallaabo la saadaalin karo xaaladaha masiibooyinka.
Dholuo: Pi ma pong’o piny Kenya nyiso ni dwarore ni otim gik moko mapiyo e kinde ma masira timore

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya opens a new service point for passport services in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay ka furaysaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee Gobolka Garissa.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Huduma Kenya oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag tiyo gi passport e County mar Garissa.

English: The United States provides nearly $255 million in humanitarian and development assistance to meet emergency needs amid unprecedented drought, dire food crisis in Kenya
Kiswahili: Marekani inatoa karibu dola milioni 255 za msaada wa kibinadamu na maendeleo ili kukidhi mahitaji ya dharura huku kukiwa na ukame usio na kifani, mzozo mbaya wa chakula nchini Kenya.
Somali: Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa ku bixisay ku dhawaad ​​$255 milyan oo gargaar bani'aadamnimo iyo horumarineed si loo daboolo baahiyaha degdegga ah xilli abaaro aan horay loo arag iyo xaalad cunto oo daran ay ka jiraan Kenya.
Dholuo: Amerka chiwo chiegni dola milion 255 mag kony mar konyo dhano kod dongruok mondo ochop dwaro mag mapiyo e kind oro ma pok oneno chon, kod chandruok maduong’ mar chiemo e piny Kenya .

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for poultry in Tana River County this May.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa kuku katika Kaunti ya Tana River Mei hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa ku dhawaaqday jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ka dhan ah xanaaqa digaagga ee degmada Tana River bisha May.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development olando chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar rabies e taon mar Tana River County e dwe mar abich.

English: FAO reminds farmers in Kiambu County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu juu ya programu inayoendelea ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa mafunzo ya wakulima.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kiambu in barnaamijka tababarka beeralayda uu socdo.
Dholuo: FAO parone jopur e county mar Kiambu e wi chenro mar tiego jopur ma sani dhi nyime.

English: AFA urges pigs farmers in Mombasa County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: AFA inawataka wafugaji wa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda doofaarka ee degmada Mombasa inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska cudurka Anthrax ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur puothe e county mar Mombasa mondo ochiw ripot ne jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth man machiegni gi kanyo bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag anthrax.

English: OGP urges residents of Nyamira County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: OGP ojiwo jogweng' Nyamira County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e loso nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: E-Citizen updates residents of Kakamega County on progress of community-based development programmes this July.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega juu ya maendeleo ya mipango ya maendeleo katika jamii mwezi huu wa Julai.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay dadka deggan degmada Kakamega ku wargelineysaa horumarka barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada ee bisha July.
Dholuo: E-Citizen miyo ji duto modak e Kaunti mar Kakamega ng'eyo dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag oganda e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises milk producers in Makueni County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inashauri wazalishaji wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Makueni kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa soosaarayaasha caanaha ee degmada Makueni inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur mag chak e county mar Makueni mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: ODPP urges eligible citizens in Machakos County to participate in voter education.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Machakos kushiriki katika elimu ya wapiga kura.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Machakos inay ka qaybqaataan waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro mar yiero e county mar Machakos mondo oriwgi e tiegruok mar josiasa.

English: Notice: NPS launches a theft prevention campaign in Bungoma County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NPS yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada degmada Bungoma bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NPS chako kampen mar geng'o kuo e taon mar Bungoma e dwe mar April.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) informs avocado farmers in Narok County of new market linkage opportunities this September.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawafahamisha wakulima wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Narok kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Septemba hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda avocado ee Gobolka Narok fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nyiso jopur mag avocado e County mar Narok e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Septemba.

Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO inazuia harakati za mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kutokana na mlipuko wa kimeta.

English: Notice: KRA launches the county integrated development plan in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika wilaya ya Meru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay bilaabaysaa qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Meru.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KRA chako chenro mar timo dongruok e alwora mar Meru County.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) opens voter registration centres in Kirinyaga County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inafungua vituo vya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu furayaa xarumaha diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee Gobolka Kirinyaga bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) ochako chenro mar chano joma biro donjo e sirkal mar Kirinyaga e dwe mar Februar.

English: West Pokot: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2023
Kiswahili: Pokot Magharibi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Mei 2023
Somali: Galbeedka Pokot: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2023
Dholuo: Pokot ma milambo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar dwe mar abich higa mar 2023

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response urges residents of Kitui County to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility following a rise in reported HIV/AIDS cases.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya VVU/UKIMWI.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kitui inay si dhakhso leh u raadsadaan baaritaanka xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow ka dib kororka kiisaska HIV / AIDS ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo Tuoche jiwo jogweng' Kitui County mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal ma machiegni gi kama thieth nitie nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuo mar HIV/AIDS osemedore.

English: DPP urges residents of Kwale County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa umakini mkubwa wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: DPP ojiwo jogweng' Kwale County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'enyie nikech ji medo keto pachgi kuom loso kuwe e piny.

English: Kenya Forest Service alerts residents of Mombasa County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ka digay dadka deggan degmada Mombasa in ay kordhaan kiisaska tuugada wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan in ay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar Mombasa County kuom wach kwan mag jokuoge medore kendo osiemo oganda mondo kik gipog weche mag ritruok gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: KEMRI launches a June awareness campaign on proper sanitation across Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: KEMRI yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Juni juu ya usafi wa mazingira katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: KEMRI waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Juun oo ku saabsan nadaafadda saxda ah ee Gobolka Laikipia.
Dholuo: KEMRI chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Jun e wi thieth mowinjore e County duto mar Laikipia.

English: Recommended malt barley production practices include row planting, weeding, and drainage, along with appropriate seed rates and the application of fertilizers and chemicals such as herbicides and fungicides.
Kiswahili: Mazoea yanayopendekezwa ya uzalishaji wa shayiri ya kimea ni pamoja na upandaji wa safu, kupalilia na mifereji ya maji, pamoja na viwango vinavyofaa vya mbegu na uwekaji wa mbolea na kemikali kama vile dawa za kuulia wadudu na dawa za kuvu.
Somali: Hababka lagu talinayo ee wax soo saarka barley malt waxaa ka mid ah beerista safka, cawska, iyo qulqulka, oo ay weheliso heerarka abuurka ee ku habboon iyo isticmaalka bacriminta iyo kiimikada sida daanyeyaasha iyo fangasyada.
Dholuo: Yo ma ji tiyogo e loso shayiri mar malt en kaka pidho yiende, chwoyo ogolo, kod chwero yiende, kaachiel gi chwoyo kodhi mowinjore, kod tiyo gi yiende kod gik mamoko kaka yedhe makelo tho kod yedhe makelo tho.

English: KEMSA encourages mothers in Narok County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Narok kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Narok inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo mine manie Narok County mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Notice: HELB launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB yazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay bilawday barnaamij ka dhan ah tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibta dugsiyada gobolka Nyamira.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: HELB chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe gero e skunde duto mag Nyamira County.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service warns coffee farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi oo ku saabsan cudurrada cayayaanka wuxuuna kugula talinayaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho chai e Tharaka-Nithi County kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will be held in Nandi County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Nandi Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo bilaash ah oo ay qabanqaabisay qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Nandi bishii December.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo mitimo gi Migawo mar Rango Kendo Duogo Tuoche ibiro tim e County mar Nandi e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Samburu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Samburu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2024
Somali: Degmada Samburu: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Samburu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2024

English: Register in the upcoming course on bee keeping to increase knowledge and experience on bee keeping.
Kiswahili: Jiandikishe katika kozi inayokuja juu ya kulea nyuki ili kuongeza ujuzi na uzoefu juu ya ufugaji wa nyuki.
Somali: Iska diiwaangeli koorsada soo socota ee ku saabsan beerashada shinnida si aad u kordhiso aqoonta iyo waayo aragnimada ku saabsan beeraha.
Dholuo: Dhi e tiegruok mabiro e weche mag pidho dhok mondo imed ng'eyo kendo bedo gi lony.

English: DPP reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Elgeyo-Marakwet County that access to psychosocial support is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisaikolojia unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in helitaanka taageerada cilmu-nafsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni thuolo mar yudo kony kuom weche mag pach ji yudore maonge chudo.

English: KEMRI advises residents of Baringo County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: KEMRI waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay biyo cabitaan ah ku kariyaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng' Baringo County mondo omak pi modho kapok gitiyo kode mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Sossion urges transparency in IEBC, calls for recall of underperforming MPs
Kiswahili: Sossion inahimiza uwazi katika IEBC, inaomba kurejeshwa kwa MEPs chini ya utendaji
Somali: Sossion waxay ku boorineysaa caddeynta IEBC, waxay ku baaqeysaa dib u celinta xildhibaanada waxqabadka ka hooseeya
Dholuo: Sosotion jiwo mondo chenro mar IEBC obed maler, okwayo mondo odwok jood bura ma nigi migepe ma ok dhi maber

English: State Department for TVET reminds schools in Nandi County to strengthen anti-bullying measures this May.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inazikumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuimarisha hatua za kupambana na uonevu Mei hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay xusuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Nandi inay xoojiyaan tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibaatada bisha May.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET oparo ne skunde man e county mar Nandi mondo omed jiwo chenro mag kedo gi timbe mahundu e dwe mar abich.

English:
Stressed about money? DonÂ’t gamble with your mental health!
When finances feel overwhelming, itÂ’s tempting to chase "quick fixes" like gambling or substance useÂ—but these only make things worse. Instead, take control by seeking free financial counseling and building healthy money habits.
Your mental health matters. Choose smart solutions over short-term risks.
Kiswahili:
Una msongo wa mawazo kuhusu pesa? Usicheze kamari na afya yako ya akili!
Wakati fedha zinapokulemea, inakuvutia kutafuta "suluhisho la haraka" kama vile kamari au matumizi ya dawa za kulevya—lakini hizi hufanya mambo kuwa mabaya zaidi. Badala yake, chukua udhibiti kwa kutafuta ushauri wa kifedha bila malipo na kujenga tabia nzuri za pesa.
Afya yako ya akili ni muhimu. Chagua suluhisho bora badala ya hatari za muda mfupi.
Somali:
Ma ka walwalsan tahay lacagta? Ha ku khamaarin caafimaadkaaga maskaxda!
Marka dhaqaaluhu dareemo culeys, waa wax lagu farxo inaad raadiso "hagaajin degdeg ah" sida khamaarka ama isticmaalka maandooriyaha - laakiin kuwani waxay ka sii darayaan oo keliya. Taa beddelkeeda, la wareeg xakamaynta adigoo raadinaya la-talin dhaqaale oo bilaash ah oo aad dhisto caadooyin lacag oo caafimaad qaba.
Caafimaadkaaga maskaxeed waa muhiim. Dooro xalal caqli badan halkii aad ka dooran lahayd khataraha muddada-gaaban.
Dholuo:
Ibedo gi parruok kuom pesa? Kik ibed gi gombo mar ng’ado bura gi ngimani mar paro!
Ka pesa winjo ka ng’eny ahinya, en gima kelo gombo mar luwo “gik ma nyalo loso mapiyo”” kaka tugo mar pesa kata tiyo kod gik ma mero ji—to gigo mana miyo gik moko bedo marach ahinya. Mopogore, kawo loch kuom manyo rieko ma onge chudo e wi pesa kendo bedo gi kido maber mar tiyo kod pesa.
Ngima mari mar paro en gima duong’. Yier yore mariek moloyo pek mag kinde machuok.

English: KEMSA urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Homa Bay County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku boorineysaa qofkasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee gobolka Homa Bay inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pach e Homa Bay County mondo oluong kony mar thieth mar pach maonge chudo.

English: Excessive screen use affects attention and sleep in young children. Encourage physical play instead.
Kiswahili: Matumizi ya skrini kupita kiasi huathiri umakini na usingizi kwa watoto wadogo. Himiza kucheza kimwili badala yake.
Somali: Isticmaalka xad dhaafka ah ee shaashadda ayaa saameyn ku leh dareenka iyo hurdada carruurta yaryar.
Dholuo: Sama nyithindo otiyo gi kompyuta mokalo tong', mano nyalo miyo kik giket pachgi kuom gik ma gipuonjore kendo ok ginyal nindo.

English: SHA updates residents of Embu County on progress of community-based development programmes this September.
Kiswahili: SHA inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu juu ya maendeleo ya programu za maendeleo ya jamii mwezi Septemba.
Somali: SHA waxay dadka deggan degmada Embu ku wargelineysaa horumarka barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada ee bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: SHA chiwo ripot ne jogweng' mar Embu County kuom dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag oganda e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: NCPB restricts movement of sheep in Siaya County due to a foot and mouth disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB inazuia harakati za kondoo katika Kaunti ya Siaya kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa idaha ee degmada Siaya sababtuna tahay faafitaanka cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: Rapar: NCPB ogeng'o wuoth mar rombe e county mar Siaya nikech tuwo mar dhoho.

English: Teachers Service Commission announces distribution of textbooks and learning materials to schools in Kilifi County this June.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yatangaza usambazaji wa vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Juni hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa ku dhawaaqay in buugaag iyo qalab waxbarasho loo qaybiyo dugsiyada Gobolka Kilifi bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj ogolo buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok e skunde man Kilifi County e dwe mar Jun.

English: Council of Governors updates residents of Narok County on progress of the county integrated development plan this January.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawasilisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti hii Januari.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay dadka deggan degmada Narok ku wargeliyaan horumarka qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch chiwo ripot ne jokanyo mag Narok County e wi dongruok mar chenro mar dongruok mar county e dwe mar Januar.

English: Kenya Dairy Board invites farmers in Meru County to a free training on pest and disease management this May.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru kupata mafunzo ya bure juu ya udhibiti wa wadudu na magonjwa Mei hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa ku casuumay beeraleyda degmada Meru inay tababar lacag la'aan ah ka helaan maaraynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada bisha May.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board ogwelo jopur e county mar Meru e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar tuoche kod tuoche e dwe mar Mei.

English: KALRO warns millet farmers in Kakamega County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KALRO waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda cawska ee Gobolka Kakamega cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda ah.
Dholuo: KALRO chiwo siem ne jopur mag millet e gweng' mar Kakamega kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Bamboo is now classified as a scheduled crop under the Crop Act offering advantages such as reduced regulatory barriers and promoting private investment in agriculture
Kiswahili: Mwanzi sasa umeainishwa kama zao lililoratibiwa chini ya Sheria ya Mazao inayotoa faida kama vile kupunguzwa kwa vizuizi vya udhibiti na kukuza uwekezaji wa kibinafsi katika kilimo.
Somali: Bamboo waxaa hadda loo kala saaray beeritaanka jadwalka ah ee sharciga dalagyada, taas oo bixiya faa'iidooyin sida yareynta caqabadaha sharciyada iyo kor u qaadista maalgashiga gaarka loo leeyahay ee beeraha
Dholuo: Bamboo sani ipimo kaka yien mochan kaluwore gi Chik mar Yien, kendo mano miyo ji yudo ber moko kaka dwoko chien gik ma chando chike kod jiwo jomisonari mondo otim ohala e weche mag pur.

English: Notice: FAO will train farmers in Nyandarua County on water harvesting this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua juu ya uvunaji wa maji Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda gobolka Nyandarua oo ku saabsan goosashada biyaha bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: FAO biro tiego jopur e County mar Nyandarua e nono pi e dwe mar Septemba.

English: FAO encourages farmers in Kiambu County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for horticultural produce.
Kiswahili: FAO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora ya mazao ya bustani.
Somali: FAO waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kiambu inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay wax soo saarka beeraha.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kiambu mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar puothe mag puothe.

English: Council of Governors urges residents of Kiambu County to attend the public participation forum to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku boorinayaan dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si loo qaabeeyo dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kiambu mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mondo oket chenro mar nono tich ma gitimo higa ka higa.

English: UNICEF Kenya Humanitarian Situation Report No. 5, 7 July 2023 (Reporting Period 1 to 31 May 2023)
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Hali ya Kibinadamu ya UNICEF Kenya No. 5, 7 Julai 2023 (Kipindi cha Kuripoti 1 hadi 31 Mei 2023)
Somali: Warbixinta Xaaladda Bani'aadamnimada ee UNICEF Kenya Lambarka 5, 7 Luulyo 2023 (Muddada Warbixinta 1aad ilaa 31 Maajo 2023)
Dholuo: Ripot mar chal mar konyo dhano mar UNICEF e piny Kenya namba 5, tarik 7 dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2023 (Kinde mar chiwo ripot chakre tarik 3 nyaka tarik 31 dwe mar abich higa mar 2023)

English: Ministry of Education urges youth in Migori County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Migori kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Migori inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo rowere e County Migori mondo oriwre gi chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gitimo tije mag oganda.

English: Notice: Universities Fund reminds citizens in Turkana County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Jaamacadaha waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Turkana ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Pesa mar Yunivasiti paronwa raia mag Turkana County kuom ratiro ma gin-go e wi ratiro mag chik.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross launches a cattle rustling prevention campaign in Nairobi County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay bilaabaneysaa olole looga hortago xanta xoolaha ee Gobolka Nairobi bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ripot Mamit mar Kenya chako kampen mar geng'o ywaruok mag dhok e taon mar Nairobi e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: NCPB will train farmers in Makueni County on water harvesting this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni juu ya uvunaji wa maji Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Makueni ee ku saabsan goosashada biyaha bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Rapar: NCPB biro tiego jopur e kaunti mar Makueni e tij choko pi e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will open a fish collection centre in Kajiado County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itafungua kituo cha kukusanya samaki katika Kaunti ya Kajiado Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha Kenya ayaa furaya xarun lagu soo uruurinayo kalluunka Gobolka Kajiado bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Dairy Board biro yawo kama ichokoe rech e Kajiado County e dwe mar Februar.

English: If the cord stump bleeds or oozes pus, seek medical attention immediately.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa kisiki cha kamba kitatoka damu au kutoa usaha, tafuta matibabu mara moja.
Somali: Haddii xididdada xarkaha ay dhiig baxdo ama ay qiiq soo baxdo, dhaqso u tag dhakhtarka.
Dholuo: Kapo ni ng'ato yudo remo kata ng'ich, dwarore ni omany thieth mapiyo.

English: KALRO invites farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County to a free training on post-harvest handling this April.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwa mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno Aprili hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku casuumaysaa beeraleyda degmada Tharaka-Nithi si ay u helaan tababar lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan maareynta goosashada ka dib bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: KALRO ogwelo jopur e Tharaka-Nithi County e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi kaka inyalo ting'o cham bang' keyo e dwe mar April.

English: Deworming children every six months improves their growth, energy levels, and school performance.
Kiswahili: Kutoa dawa za minyoo kwa watoto kila baada ya miezi sita huboresha ukuaji wao, viwango vya nishati, na utendaji wao shuleni.
Somali: Carruurta lixdii biloodba mar in la baabi'iyo cayayaanka waxay kordhiyaan koritaanka, tamarta, iyo waxqabadka dugsiga.
Dholuo: Nyithindo mang'eny medo bedo gi teko mar timo kamano bang' dweche auchiel, kendo timo kamano miyo gibedo gi nyak maber e skul.

English: DCI warns residents of Murang'a County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: DCI waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a kororka khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne Jo-Murang'a County e wi medruok mar timbe mag wuondo pesa mag simo kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok kare ne jatendgi.

English: "Our future is bright": Women farmers in Kenya weather the drought
Kiswahili: "Mustakabali wetu ni mzuri": Wanawake wakulima nchini Kenya wanakabiliana na ukame
Somali: "Mustaqbalkeenu waa mid ifaya": Haweenka beeraleyda ah ee Kenya ayaa la daalaa dhacaya abaarta
Dholuo: Kinde marwa ber: Mon ma jopur e piny Kenya ng'ado bura e wi oro

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds residents of Nyeri County that access to national ID applications is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba kufikia maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri in helitaanka codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone jogweng' Nyeri County ni koro yot yudo weche mag kwayo mar ng'eyo ng'at manie pinyno kokalo kuom chenro mag sirkal.

English: KALRO urges millet growers in Kiambu County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda millet ee degmada Kiambu inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo miraha ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur ma pidho millet e County mar Kiambu mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges farmers in West Pokot County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ugu baaqeysaa beeraleyda Gobolka West Pokot inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee beeraha cimilada ee caqli-galka ah si ay ula qabsadaan isbedelka qaabka roobabka.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur e West Pokot County mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi pur mar piny mondo ginyagre gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by SHA (Social Health Authority) will be held in Siaya County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Siaya Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ay soo qabanqaabisay SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Siaya bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth maonge chudo ma olos gi SHA (Social Health Authority) ibiro tim e taon mar Siaya e dwe mar Agost.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) encourages first-time voters in Tana River County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Wilaya ya Tana River kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.

Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogo matimoga yiero mokwongo e taon mar Tana River County mondo oting'e ID kata pasipoti mar pinygi e odiechieng'no mar timo yiero.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Nakuru County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati huu wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lugta lagu maro inta lagu jiro xilliyada fatahaadaha.

Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: CDC siemo ji kuom medruok mar tuwo mar Rift Valley Fever e County mar Bungoma kendo ojiwo ji mondo oti gi net mag lum ma nigi yedhe makelo tuoche mag kute otieno ka otieno.

Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa uhamasishaji wa unyogovu unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kwale.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development invites youth in Trans Nzoia County to enroll for tailoring and design training this October.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni Oktoba hii.

Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ogwelo rowere e Trans Nzoia County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: KEMSA calls on parents in Baringo County to have children under five screened for cholera during the March outreach.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Machi.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Baringo in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka kolera inta lagu jiro safarka bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: KEMSA okwayo jonyuol e County mar Baringo mondo onyis nyithindo ma johigni abich gi matin ni gin gi tuwo mar cholera e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: KNEC opens a new ICT skills programme at the vocational centre in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inafungua programu mpya ya ujuzi wa ICT katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan xirfadaha ICT ka furaysaa xarunta xirfadda ee degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KNEC chako chenro manyien mar lony e yore mag ICT e skul mar tiegruok e County of Kericho.

English: FAO advises maize producers in Kirinyaga County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: FAO inashauri wazalishaji wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: FAO waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha hadhuudhka ee degmada Kirinyaga inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: FAO nyiso jopur mag kodhi e County mar Kirinyaga ni mondo gidonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges the community in Migori County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb fraud.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Migori kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia udanganyifu.

Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo oganda manie Migori County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o mibadhi.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Bomet County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Bomet kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.

English: IEBC encourages first-time voters in Bomet County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.

Dholuo: IEBC jiwo josiasa ma ne okwongo yiero e county mar Bomet mondo ong'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development advises students in Tana River County to collect materials from the county education office to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Tana River kukusanya vifaa kutoka ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ardayda Degmada Tana River kula talinayaa inay ka soo ururiyaan qalabka xafiiska waxbarashada ee degmada si ay u helaan deeq waxbarasho ardayda u baahan.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development nyiso jopuonjre manie Tana River County mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar tiegruok mar county mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo osuru ne jopuonjre mochando.

English: Notice: SHA launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Vihiga County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Shirika la SHA linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee degmada Vihiga bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Vihiga e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association confirms a malaria outbreak alert for Mandera County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya chathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa malaria katika Kaunti ya Mandera. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.

Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Medical Association osenyiso ni nitie masira mar malaria e kaunti mar Mandera.

English: DPP reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kajiado County that access to the GBV toll-free helpline is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kajiado County kwamba upatikanaji wa simu ya GBV ya bure ya msaada unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee Gobolka Kajiado in helitaanka khadka caawimaadda ee GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ay tahay mid lacag la 'aan ah.

English: State Department for Basic Education advises students in Turkana County to register early to secure allocation to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.

English: KMTC advises students in Garissa County to register early to secure allocation to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Garissa kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Somali: KMTC waxay ardayda degmada Garissa kula talineysaa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan si ay u helaan buugaag iyo qalab waxbarasho.

English: NTSA warns residents of Kajiado County to prepare for possible road accidents this January.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Januari hii.
Somali: NTSA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay u diyaar garoobaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: NTSA osiemo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Januar.

English: TVET calls on the community in Narok County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TVET inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Narok kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
