Dholuo: KALRO ogwelo jopur e Homa Bay County e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar tuoche kod tuoche e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: KICD launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha katika shule kote Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay bilawday barnaamij hagitaan iyo adeegyo la-talin ah oo lagu sameeyo dugsiyada gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KICD chako chenro mar tayo kendo chiwo paro e skunde duto e County mar Nyandarua.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Machakos County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the April planting season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji Aprili.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda Degmada Machakos inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur e county mar Machakos mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochako chwoyo kodhi e dwe mar April.

English: Kenya Gazette invites residents of Kericho County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette gwelo jogweng' Kericho County mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso chenro mag dongruok.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges motorists and pedestrians in Garissa County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent landslides-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa baabuurta iyo dadka lugta ku mara degmada Garissa inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha lugta lagu maro ee loo qoondeeyay si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira dhulgariirka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Forest Service jiwo joidh mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Garissa mondo oluw tong' mar wuoth kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe mondo gikwed masiche ma timore nikech yiengni mag lowo.

English: Drought in the Horn of Africa: the arduous path to assistance for unregistered refugees in Dadaab Refugee camps, Kenya
Kiswahili: Ukame katika Pembe ya Afrika: njia ngumu ya usaidizi kwa wakimbizi ambao hawajasajiliwa katika kambi za Wakimbizi za Dadaab, Kenya.
Somali: Abaaraha Geeska Afrika: wadada adag ee loo maro caawinta qaxootiga aan diiwaangashanayn ee ku jira xeryaha qaxootiga ee Dhadhaab, Kenya
Dholuo: Okang’ ma ok odhi kare e piny Afrika: yo matek mar yudo kony ne jolweny ma ok ondiki nyinggi e kambi mag jolweny mag Dadaab, e piny Kenya

English: NPS urges the public in Marsabit County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: NPS inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Marsabit wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu.
Somali: NPS waxay ugu baaqeysaa shacabka degmada Marsabit inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada lacagta mobilada.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo ji duto e Marsabit County mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' weche mag wuondo pesa e simo.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health: free antenatal care clinics will run every February at designated health centres in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya: kliniki za bure za utunzaji wa ujauzito zitafanya kazi kila Februari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka: rugaha daryeelka dhalmada ee bilaashka ah waxaa lagu qaban doonaa Febraayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee la magacaabay ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth: Klinike mag thieth ma onge chudo biro tiyo e dwe mar Februar e kuonde thieth moyier e Taita-Taveta County.

English: NDMA urges the community in Kisii County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb fraud.
Kiswahili: NDMA inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu usiowajua ili kuzuia udanganyifu.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Kisii inay ka fogaadaan in ay macluumaadka amniga shaqsiyadeed la wadaagaan shisheeyaha si loo xakameeyo khiyaamooyinka.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo ji duto manie County mar Kisii mondo kik gipog weche mag ritruok gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo gikwed mibadhi.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross confirms a HIV/AIDS outbreak alert for Trans Nzoia County. Residents are advised to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa VVU/UKIMWI katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ku saabsan cudurka HIV / AIDS ee Gobolka Trans Nzoia. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Red Cross osenyiso ni nitie siem mar tuo mar AYAKI/AIDS e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia.

English: DCI calls on the community in West Pokot County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: DCI waxay bulshada ku nool degmada West Pokot ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wici doonaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: DCI okwayo ji duto manie West Pokot County mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195 maonge chudo.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds the public in Taita-Taveta County that input on development planning forums is welcome this May.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inakumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kwamba mchango kwenye vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo unakaribishwa Mei hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) ayaa xasuusinaya shacabka degmada Taita-Taveta in laga soo dhaweynayo talooyinka ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta bisha May.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone ji duto manie Taita-Taveta County ni gibiro rwako pachgi e wi chenro mag dongruok e dwe mar Mei.

English: Revert to the old tales that contributed to brain building and mental health care. This can be of help to build â€¦â€¦..
Kiswahili: Turudi kwenye hadithi za kale ambazo zilichangia kujenga ubongo na utunzaji wa afya ya akili.
Somali: Ku noqo sheekooyinkii hore ee gacan ka geystay dhismaha maskaxda iyo daryeelka caafimaadka maskaxda. Tani waxay kaa caawin kartaa dhisidda ...
Dholuo: Dwoki e weche machon ma ne okonyo e gero obwongo kod rito ngima mar paro. Mano nyalo konyo e gero â€¦â€¦..

English: Up to 6 months from the date of the child, start feeding the child with food rich in minerals as you continue with breast feeding. Prevent feeding the child with sugarly fast foods, and also ensure cleanlinness.
Kiswahili: Hadi miezi 6 tangu tarehe ya mtoto, anza kumlisha mtoto chakula chenye madini mengi unapoendelea kunyonyesha. Zuia kumlisha mtoto vyakula vyenye sukari nyingi, na pia hakikisha usafi.
Somali: Ilaa 6 bilood laga bilaabo taariikhda ilmaha, bilow inaad ilmaha ku quudiso cunto hodan ku ah macdanta intaad nuujineyso.
Dholuo: Chak gi dweche auchiel bang' nyuol nyathi, chak chiemo nyathi gi chiemo mopong' gi gik mang'eny mag lowo sama idhi nyime miyo nyathi kong'o.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens voter education centres in Uasin Gishu County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu mwezi Septemba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya ayaa furaya xarumo waxbarasho codbixiyeyaasha ku leh gobolka Uasin Gishu bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya biro yawo kuonde tiego josiasa e kaunti mar Uasin Gishu e dwe mar Septemba.

English: KICD conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Kisii County this September.
Kiswahili: KICD inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kisii Septemba hii.
Somali: KICD waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada ee degmada Kisii bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: KICD dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi riwruok mar oganda e weche mag pesa mag county e County mar Kisii e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Farmers can cultivate high yielding cassava and other GMOs if they choose however regulatory oversight and ongoing legal challenges are in place
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaweza kulima mihogo yenye mavuno mengi na GMO zingine kama watachagua hata hivyo uangalizi wa udhibiti na changamoto zinazoendelea za kisheria zipo.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxay beeran karaan cassava iyo GMO-yada kale ee wax soo saarka sare leh haddii ay doortaan, si kastaba ha ahaatee kormeerka sharcigu iyo caqabadaha sharciga ee socda ayaa jira
Dholuo: Jo-Purvey nyalo pidho maniva kod GMO mamoko ma nigi nyak maber ka giyiero, kata kamano nitie chike ma tayo tijno kod pek ma chik okelo

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will be held in Migori County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Migori Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo bilaash ah oo ay soo qabanqaabisay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Degmada Migori bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Rapar: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ochano ibiro tim e County mar Migori e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) confirms a dengue fever outbreak alert for Kiambu County. Residents are advised to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa homa ya dengue kwa Kaunti ya Kiambu. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ku saabsan cudurka hargabka dengue ee degmada Kiambu. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: SHA (Social Health Authority) osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuwo mar dengue e kaunti mar Kiambu.

English: TSC reminds schools in Makueni County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this October.
Kiswahili: TSC inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Oktoba hii.
Somali: TSC waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Makueni inay xoojiyaan adeegyada hagista iyo la-talinta bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: TSC paronwa skunde mag Makueni County mondo omed jiwo kendo chiwo kony e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: DCI reminds residents of Mombasa County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa in warbixinta khiyaanada si deg deg ah ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: DCI parone jogweng' mar Mombasa County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar wuondruok konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Nairobi County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kazini wakati huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi in ay guryahooda ku rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo in ay ka shaqeeyaan xilliyada dhulgariirada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross parone jogweng' Nairobi County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag nego ligek mach e utegi kendo giti e kinde mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: EACC urges residents of Makueni County to attend the public participation forum to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay ka qaybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si loo qaabeeyo habka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jogweng' Makueni County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar loso bajet mar county.

English: KTDA reminds farmers in Homa Bay County of the ongoing fertiliser application training programme.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya matumizi ya mbolea.
Somali: KTDA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Homa Bay barnaamijka tababarka codsiyada bacriminta ee socda.
Dholuo: KTDA parone jopur manie Homa Bay County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar tiyo gi yien.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMRI will be held in Bomet County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMRI itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Bomet Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay KEMRI ayaa lagu qaban doonaa gobolka Bomet bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni kambi mar thieth ma KEMRI ochano ibiro tim e dwe mar Novemba e county mar Bomet.

English: Implemented through strong local partnerships, this work directly contributes to the 2030 CGIAR outcomes by enhancing the resilience, self-reliance and social cohesion of displacement affected communities.
Kiswahili: Ikitekelezwa kupitia ushirikiano dhabiti wa ndani, kazi hii inachangia moja kwa moja matokeo ya CGIAR ya 2030 kwa kuimarisha uthabiti, kujitegemea na mshikamano wa kijamii wa jamii zilizoathirika.
Somali: Shaqadan oo lagu hirgeliyay iskaashi xooggan oo maxalli ah, waxay si toos ah gacan uga geysaneysaa natiijooyinka CGIAR ee 2030 iyadoo kor u qaadaysa adkeysiga, isku-kalsoonida iyo isku xirnaanta bulshada ee bulshooyinka ay saameeyeen barakacayaasha.
Dholuo: Ka otimre kokalo kuom riwruok motegno mag oganda, tichni konyo achiel kachiel kuom duoko mag CGIAR mag higa mar 2030 kuom medo nyalo mar ng’ado bura, geno mar ng’ato ka ng’ato kod riwruok mar oganda ma oyudo masira mar ng’anjo.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds livestock keepers in Nyamira County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xayawaanka ah ee degmada Nyamira inay ka fogaadaan in xoolaha laga guuro xadka degmada iyada oo aan la helin rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development parone jorit jamni e county mar Nyamira ni kik giwuoth gi jamni ka ok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: Universities Fund advises students in Migori County to register early to secure allocation to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Migori kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ardayda Degmada Migori kula talinayaa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan si ay u helaan buugaag waxbarasho iyo qalab waxbarasho.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund nyiso jopuonjre mag Migori County ni gidonj e skundno chon mondo giyud pesa ma ginyalo tiyogo e yudo buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok.

English: Kenya Dairy Board promotes terracing among farmers in Siaya County as part of the July climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inakuza usafirishaji kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Siaya kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Julai.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa beeraleyda beeraha ee degmada Siaya iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo tij loso yiende e kind jopur e county mar Siaya kaka achiel kuom chenro mar dwe mar Julai mar kedo gi lokruok e kor lwasi.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) announces a free lumpy skin disease vaccination exercise for pigs in Turkana County this August.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa ngozi kwa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Turkana Agosti hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku dhawaaqday jimicsi tallaal oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka maqaarka ee doofaarka ee degmada Turkana bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) ogolo chenro mar goyo tugo mar thieth mar tuoche mag dhoho maonge chudo e dwe mar Agost e county mar Turkana.

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Meru County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kuthibitisha kuwa kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay xaqiijiyaan in xaruntooda la aqoonsaday ka hor inta aysan booqan si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso jogweng' mar County mar Meru mondo ong'e ni kuondegi mag thieth oseyudo ratiro kapok gibiro mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on residents of Machakos County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inatoa wito kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida katika maeneo ya mpakani kwa vyombo vya usalama kuunga mkono ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqay dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga dhaqdhaqaaq aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah si ay u taageeraan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service okwayo jogweng'o mag Machakos County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal mag ritruok ni gitimo gik maok kare e alwora mar tong'gi mondo gikony e loso kuwe e piny.

English: KEMRI reminds the public that free stress management support is available through county health facilities in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kudhibiti mafadhaiko unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo lagu maareeyo stress-ka laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Kwale.
Dholuo: KEMRI paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar stress yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Kwale.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education reminds citizens in Nyeri County about their rights regarding devolution.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka Nyeri waxay muwaadiniinta ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Department of State for Basic Education paronwa jogweng' Nyeri County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar golo pesa.

English: Ministry of Education partners with NGOs to provide digital learning devices and internet access for orphans and vulnerable children.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inashirikiana na mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali kutoa vifaa vya kujifunza digital na upatikanaji wa mtandao kwa watoto yatima na watoto walio hatarini.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay iskaashi la sameysay ururada aan dawliga ahayn si ay u siiyaan qalabka barashada dhijitaalka ah iyo helitaanka internetka carruurta agoonta ah iyo carruurta nugul.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education noriwore gi riwruoge maok nie sirkal mondo gimi nyithind kiye kod nyithindo mayom thuolo mar yudo somo e Intanet.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Murang'a County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay ka qeybgalaan kalfadhiga guud ee golaha gobolka si ay uga warqabaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee gobolka.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' County mar Murang'a mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo omed ng'eyo chenro mar dongruok e county.

English: KALRO informs coffee farmers in Kajiado County of new market linkage opportunities this February.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawafahamisha wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Kajiado juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Februari hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Kajiado fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: KALRO nyiso jopur mag chai e Kajiado County kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Februar.

English: Huduma Kenya invites residents of Murang'a County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya ogwelo jogweng' mar Murang'a County mondo ochiw weche mondik motudore gi nonro mar tich mitimo higa ka higa kapok ndalo ochopo.

English: KALRO urges cattle farmers in Uasin Gishu County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizoteuliwa kufuatia kuripotiwa kwa visa vya ugonjwa wa ngozi ya uvimbe.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da ee degmada Uasin Gishu inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo ka dib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KALRO ojiwo jopur mag jamni e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo ogeng'gi e kuonde moketi mag chamo jamni bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag dhoot.

English: Everybody must make an effort to wear a face mask in public places #KomeshaCorona media briefing by CS Health, Mutahi Kagwe.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu lazima ajitahidi kuvaa barakoa katika maeneo ya umma mkutano wa wanahabari wa #KomeshaCorona na Waziri wa Afya, Mutahi Kagwe.
Somali: Qof walba waa inuu sameeyaa dadaal uu ku xirto maaskaro wejiga goobaha dadweynaha #KomeshaCorona warbixin kooban oo uu soo diray CS Health, Mutahi Kagwe.
Dholuo: Ng'ato ka ng'ato nyaka tim kinda mar rwako mask mar wang' kuonde ma ji mang'eny romoe # KomeshaCorona lendo mar jotudo mag CS Health, Mutahi Kagwe.

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief, November 2022
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP Kenya, Novemba 2022
Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya, Noofambar 2022
Dholuo: Wach machuok mar piny Kenya mar WFP, dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2022

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kurejesha huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la hagaajiyay waqtiga wareejinta adeegyada baasaboorka ee degmada Kiambu.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties olando lokruok e seche mag tiyo gi passport e County mar Kiambu.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education opens applications for revision guides for learners in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka ayaa furaysa codsiyada hagaha dib u eegista ee ardayda Baringo County.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Puonjruok ma Chakre e Piny owacho chako kwayo mondo japuonjre e taon mar Baringo oyud weche mag somo.

English: Pest Control Products Board informs maize farmers in Turkana County of new market linkage opportunities this September.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inafahamisha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Septemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa ku wargeliyay beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Turkana fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok mar Pest nyiso jopur mag kodhi e County mar Turkana thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Kiosks of Mombasa Covid 19: Testing kiosks without toutching is implemented in 6 elective counties in which there is no physical contact with the doctor and the patient. These kiosks test safely and with security, very fast and in plenty. These kiosks are build in this areas have become game changer
Kiswahili: Vibanda vya Mombasa Covid 19: Vibanda vya kupima bila kugusana vinatekelezwa katika kaunti 6 za uchaguzi ambapo hakuna mawasiliano ya kimwili na daktari na mgonjwa. Vibanda hivi hupimwa kwa usalama na usalama, haraka sana na kwa wingi. Vibanda hivi vimejengwa katika maeneo haya vimebadilisha mchezo.
Somali: Kioskii Mombasa Covid 19: Tijaabinta kioskii iyada oo aan la dhicin ayaa lagu hirgeliyaa 6 degmo oo doorasho ah oo aan lahayn xiriir jireed oo dhakhtar iyo bukaan ah. Kioskooyinkani waxay tijaabiyaan si nabadgelyo leh oo amni leh, si dhakhso leh oo badan.
Dholuo: Kiosks mag Mombasa Covid 19: Temo kiosks maonge toutching itimo e counties 6 mag yiero ma onge tudruok mar ringruok gi laktar kata jatuo.

English: SHA announces improved turnaround times for e-Citizen registration in Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujiandikisha kwa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Somali: SHA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee Degmada Tharaka-Nithi.
Dholuo: SHA olando lokruok e seche mag ndiko e e-Citizen e Tharaka-Nithi County.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of Wajir County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay u yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' mar Wajir County mondo kik gisandre gi muol kendo mondo giluong kony mar thieth mar chuny maonge chudo.

English: Climate-smart agriculture is a response to historical and on-going changes in climate and projected climate change. Weather and climate data are key components ...
Kiswahili: Kilimo cha hali ya hewa ni jibu kwa mabadiliko ya kihistoria na yanayoendelea katika hali ya hewa na makadirio ya mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa. Data ya hali ya hewa na hali ya hewa ni vipengele muhimu ...
Somali: Beeraha cimilada ku habboon waa jawaab ka dhan ah isbeddelada taariikhiga ah iyo kuwa socda ee cimilada iyo isbeddelka la filayo ee cimilada. Xogta cimilada iyo cimilada waa qaybaha muhiimka ah ...
Dholuo: Tije mag pur ma nigi rieko mar timo lokruok e kit ngima dhano, gin kaka timo lokruok e kit ngima dhano kod lokruok ma timore e kit ngima dhano.

English: NCPB warns maize farmers in Nairobi County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawaonya wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: NCPB waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Nairobi faafitaanka cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: NCPB osiemo jopur mag kodhi e County mar Nairobi kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: KEPHIS promotes organic farming among farmers in Homa Bay County as part of the April climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inakuza kilimo hai kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Aprili.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay kor u qaadeysaa beeraha dabiiciga ah ee beeraleyda gobolka Homa Bay iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka iska caabinta cimilada ee Abriil.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e Homa Bay County kaka achiel kuom chenro mar April mar kedo gi tuoche mag yamo.

English: KALRO advises horticultural produce producers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inashauri wazalishaji wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KALRO waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha wax soo saarka beeraha ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur ma loso puothe e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Notice: NPS issues a cybersecurity alert on SIM-swap fraud affecting residents of Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM ambao unaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Ogaysiis: NPS waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaamada SIM-swap ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Nakuru.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NPS ogolo siem mar sirkal kuom wach wuond mar SIM-swap makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Nakuru County.

English: KALRO advises avocado producers in Kilifi County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inashauri wazalishaji wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KALRO waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha avocado ee degmada Kilifi inay ka iibsadaan wax soo saarka kaliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KALRO nyiso jopur ma loso avocado e gweng' mar Kilifi ni gius olembegi mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo olembego kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Council of Governors reminds residents of Lamu County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kwamba upatikanaji wa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay xasuusinayaan dadka deggan degmada Lamu in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch oparo ne jogweng' mar County mar Lamu ni koro yot yudo thuolo mar timo nonro mar nyuol kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: CDC urges residents of Samburu County to complete the full recommended vaccination dose following a rise in reported HIV/AIDS cases.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya VVU/UKIMWI.
Somali: CDC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Samburu inay dhammaystiraan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo ka dib kororka kiisaska HIV / AIDS ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo ji modak e county mar Samburu mondo ochop e okang' malach mar thieth ma gichiwo bang' ka kwan mar joma nigi tuo mar HIV/AIDS osemedore.

English: ILO Brief - Embracing innovation and inclusion: Strengthening Kenyaâ€™s beauty sector for host communities and urban refugees
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa ILO - Kukumbatia uvumbuzi na ujumuishaji: Kuimarisha sekta ya urembo ya Kenya kwa jamii zinazowakaribisha na wakimbizi wa mijini.
Somali: Warbixinta ILO - Qaadashada hal-abuurka iyo ka mid noqoshada: Xoojinta qaybta quruxda ee Kenya ee bulshooyinka martida loo yahay iyo qaxootiga magaalooyinka
Dholuo: ILO machuok - Kwayo loso gik manyien kod keto ji duto e piny: Keto teko e sektor mar loso gik mabeyo e piny Kenya ne jodak ma rwako jolweny kod jolweny ma ni e boma

English: NCIC integrates peace lessons into school programs.
Kiswahili: NCIC huingiza masomo ya amani katika programu za shule.
Somali: NCIC waxay barashada nabadda ku darsataa barnaamijyada dugsiga.
Dholuo: NCIC keto puonj mag kuwe e program mag skul.

English: Art, music, and writing provide powerful, nonverbal avenues for processing complex emotions and fostering mental clarity. These creative outlets can serve as effective tools for emotional regulation and psychological well-being.
Kiswahili: Sanaa, muziki, na kuandika hutoa njia zenye nguvu zisizo za maneno za kushughulikia hisia tata na kukuza uwazi wa akili.
Somali: Farshaxanka, muusikada, iyo qorista waxay bixiyaan habab xoog leh oo aan hadal ahayn oo lagu maareeyo shucuurta adag iyo kor u qaadista caddaaladda maskaxda.
Dholuo: Tic ki diro, wer, ki coyo waraga miyowa yo maber me tic ki cwiny ma rwatte ki jami ma watye kwede ki i cwinywa kacel ki yo me cuko cwinywa.

English: Notice: KICD launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay bilawday barnaamij ilaalinta caruurta iskuulada iskuulada guud ahaan degmada Kwale.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KICD chako chenro mar rito nyithindo e skunde e skul duto mag Kwale County.

English: Kenya: Protection cost effectiveness brief - Girls Empowered by Micro-franchise, 2014
Kiswahili: Kenya: Muhtasari wa gharama za ulinzi - Girls Empowered by Micro-franchise, 2014
Somali: Kenya: Warbixin kooban oo ku saabsan waxtarka kharashka ilaalinta - Gabdhaha oo ay awood siisay Micro-franchise, 2014
Dholuo: Kenya: Oboke machuok mar rito pesa - Nyiri Omiye Teko gi Ratiro Matin, 2014

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) urges sorghum growers in Tharaka-Nithi County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawasihi wakulima wa sorghum katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurudisha uzazi wa udongo ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda sorghum ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalaalka ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur mag sorghum e County mar Tharaka-Nithi mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber kendo mondo omed nyak maber e higani.

English: Notice: NTSA opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Busia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa marejeleo salama makazi katika Busia County.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya tixraacyo hoy amaan ah oo ku yaal degmada Busia.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Riwruok mar National Security Agency (NTSA) ochako ofis ma wuoyo e wi weche mag nindruok e gweng' mar Busia.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds the public in Baringo County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu dadka degmada Baringo ku xasuusinayaa in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone ji duto e gweng' mar Baringo ni chiwo ripot mar asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health: childhood immunization clinics will run every November at designated health centres in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya: kliniki za chanjo za watoto zitafanya kazi kila Novemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka: rugta tallaalka carruurta ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Nofeembar kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Mombasa.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth: klinik mag thieth mar nyithindo biro tiyo dwe mar Novemba higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e county mar Mombasa.

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on the community in Mandera County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Mandera kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwa ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqayaa bulshada Degmada Mandera inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan oo ay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service kwayo oganda man Mandera County mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo ochiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET opens applications for school laptops under the digital literacy programme for learners in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inafungua maombi ya kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda TVET ee Gobolka ayaa furtay codsiyada kumbuyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee ardayda degmada Kajiado.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State Department for TVET oseyawo kwayo mag kompyuta mag skul e bwo chenro mar somo kod somo mar digital literacy ne jopuonjre man Kajiado County.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations conducts a community briefing on border security in Murang'a County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inafanya mkutano wa jamii juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada wuxuu qabtaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha ee degmada Murang'a bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Directorate of Criminal Investigations timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong ' e County mar Murang'a e dwe mar Januar.

English: NDMA reminds the public in Laikipia County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NDMA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Laikipia inay ka feejignaadaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: NDMA parone ji duto e County mar Laikipia mondo gibed motang' gi chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: Notice: IEBC opens a new tailoring and design programme at the vocational centre in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inafungua programu mpya ya ushonaji na usanifu katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan dharka iyo naqshadeynta xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IEBC chako chenro manyien mar loso piche kendo loso gik moko e skul mar tiegruok e taon mar Nyeri.

English: Meru (Meru-North) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Meru (Meru-Kaskazini): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Februari 2023
Somali: Degmada Meru (Meru-Waqooyi): War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Meru (Meru-Nyath): Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2023

English: FAO encourages farmers in Embu County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for horticultural produce.
Kiswahili: FAO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora ya mazao ya bustani.
Somali: FAO waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Embu inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay wax soo saarka beeraha.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e county mar Embu mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar puothe mag puothe.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Kurugenzi ya Utafiti wa Jinai inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa soo saaray digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations ogolo siem mar sirkal kuom chenro mag gwelo pesa mag miriambo makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Uasin Gishu County.

English: Public health advisory: CDC warns of increased meningitis risk in Samburu County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: CDC inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya ugonjwa wa uti wa mgongo katika Kaunti ya Samburu na inashauri umma kutumia vyandarua vya mbu vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: CDC waxay ka digeysaa khatarta sii kordheysa ee meningitis ee Gobolka Samburu waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: CDC siemo ji kuom medo bedo gi tuo mar meningitis e county mar Samburu kendo ojiwo ji mondo oti gi net mag kute ma itiyogo e thiedho oyaki otieno ka otieno.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds residents of Mandera County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati wa msimu huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera ku xasuusinaya inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyay dadka socotada ah inta lagu jiro xilliyada dhulgariirada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations parone jogweng'o mag Mandera County mondo oluw tong' mar piyo kendo giti gi yore mag wuotho e kinde mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: Ministry of Health appeals to caregivers in Makueni County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the August maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Makueni kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Agosti.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Makueni inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health okwayo jorit e county mar Makueni mondo okel nyithindgi mondo gitim nonro kuom dongruok margi kaka achiel kuom chenro mar August Maternal Health drive.

English: KEPHIS encourages farmers in Kakamega County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for tea.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei nzuri ya chai.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kakamega inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo shaaha ah.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kakamega mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar chai.

English: KEMSA urges residents of Machakos County to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility following a rise in reported dengue fever cases.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya homa ya dengue.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow ka dib kororka kiisaska cudurka dengue ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' Machakos County mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni bang' medruok mar tuo mar dengue.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges eligible citizens in Samburu County to participate in polling procedures.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Samburu kushiriki katika utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Samburu inay ka qeyb galaan nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General jiwo raia mowinjore e county mar Samburu mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag yiero.

English: Ministry of Education reminds schools in Taita-Taveta County to strengthen school infrastructure safety this September.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuimarisha usalama wa miundombinu ya shule Septemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay dib u xasuusineysaa dugsiyada Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay xoojiyaan ammaanka kaabayaasha dugsiga bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok oparo ne skunde man Taita-Taveta County mondo omed jiwo ritruok mar chenro mag skul e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Baringo County to avoid contact with contaminated water sources following a rise in reported dengue fever cases.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya homa ya dengue.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay ka fogaadaan inay la xiriiraan ilo biyo ah oo wasakheysan ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska cudurka dengue ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Baringo County mondo kik giriwre gi kuonde ma pi yudoree nikech ji mang'eny nigi tuwo mar dengue.

English: KEMSA appeals to caregivers in Siaya County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the August maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Agosti.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Siaya inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta bukaanka ee la qorsheeyay iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Agoosto.
Dholuo: KEMSA okwayo jorit e county mar Siaya mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar thieth ma ne otim e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa furaya xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya taageero maskaxeed iyo bulsheed degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Directorate of Criminal Investigations ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony e weche mag paro e gweng' mar Nyeri.

English: Notice: OGP launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kisii County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kisii Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ka dhanka ah degmada Kisii bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Rapar: OGP chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Kisii e dwe mar Januar.

English: AFA urges cattle farmers in Kajiado County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported foot and mouth disease cases.
Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da ee degmada Kajiado inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib markii la soo sheegay kiisaska cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur mag jamni e Kajiado County mondo onyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth ma machiegni gi kanyo bang' ka osenyis ni nitie tuoche mag dhoot.

English: Office of the Auditor-General advises residents of Kisii County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay qaataan dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado dib u dhac marka la raadinayo shahaadada dhalashada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar jarit-distrikt jiwo jogweng' mar County of Kisii mondo oting'e buge duto madwarore mondo kik gibed gi ywaruok sama gidwaro yudo barua mar nyuol.

English: DCI reminds residents of Baringo County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada daadadku ka da'ay xilliyada dabka.
Dholuo: DCI parone jogweng' mar Baringo County ni kik giwuoth e kind yiengni mag mach e kinde ma pi opong'o yiengegi.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on the community in Kirinyaga County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Kirinyaga inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan isla markaana ay taageero ka raadsadaan hoyga ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross okwayo oganda man Kirinyaga County mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: KEMRI  unveiling pilot program training religious figures in suicide prevention as mental wellbeing outreach.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inazindua programu ya majaribio ya mafunzo ya watu wa kidini katika kuzuia kujiua kama utangazaji wa ustawi wa akili.
Somali: KEMRI waxay soo bandhigtay barnaamij tijaabo ah oo lagu tababarayo dadka diinta ah ee ka hortagga ismiidaaminta sida caawinta caafimaadka maskaxda.
Dholuo: KEMRI chako timo chenro mar tiego jotelo mag din e yore mag geng'o ji kik nege kaka yore mag konyo ji obed gi paro makare.

English: KUCCPS reminds parents in Samburu County that bursary allocation registration is open this March.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba usajili wa ugawaji wa bursari umefunguliwa Machi hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta gobolka Samburu in diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ay furan tahay bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: KUCCPS parone jonyuol e county mar Samburu ni kad mar chulo chiwo mag bursary ochakore e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds citizens in Machakos County about their rights regarding voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuhusu haki zao kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu muwaadiniinta degmada Machakos xusuusinayaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development parone raia mag Machakos County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar ndiko joma oyiero.

English: IEBC urges residents of Tana River County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Tana River kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waendelee kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya wilaya.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay la xiriiraan maamulaha degmada si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda horumarinta degmada.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jotend buchegi mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche momedore e wi chenro mag dongruok mar buchego.

English: Weekly Bulletin on Outbreaks and other Emergencies: Week 23: 3 - 9 June 2024 (Data as reported by: 17:00; 9 June 2024)
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Kila Wiki kuhusu Milipuko na Dharura Nyingine: Wiki 23: 3 - 9 Juni 2024 (Data kama ilivyoripotiwa na: 17:00; 9 Juni 2024)
Somali: War-saxaafadeedka Todobaadlaha ah ee ku saabsan Cudurrada faafa iyo Xaaladaha kale ee Degdegga ah: Toddobaadka 23: 3 - 9 Juun 2024 (Xogta sida ay soo sheegtay: 17:00; 9 Juun 2024)
Dholuo: Oboke mar juma ka juma kuom tuoche ma nyalo kelo pek kod gik mamoko ma nyalo timore mapiyo: Juma mar 23: 3 - 9 dwe mar auchiel 2024 (Weche kaka ondiki gi: 17:00; 9 dwe mar auchiel 2024)

English: Notice: IEBC opens voter education centres in Kisumu County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee degmada Kisumu bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC biro yawo kuonde tiego josiasa e kaunti mar Kisumu e dwe mar Septemba.

English: KNEC urges residents of Marsabit County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inay codsadaan deeqda waxbarasho ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga ugu dambeeya si ay uga faa'iideystaan barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jogweng' mar Marsabit County mondo okonygi gi chenrono kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Creating epicentres for peace in the North Rift Region in Kenya
Kiswahili: Kuunda vitovu vya amani katika Mkoa wa Kaskazini mwa Ufa nchini Kenya
Somali: Abuurista saldhigyo nabad ah oo ka jira Gobolka Waqooyiga Rift ee Kenya
Dholuo: Oloso kuonde ma kelo kuwe e alwora mar Rift ma Nyanduat e piny Kenya

English: Kenya Dairy Board urges rice growers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawataka wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda bariiska ee gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka xilliga dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur ma pidho kodhi e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e higa ka gitiyo gi tuoche mag thieth ma giyiego mondo gimed nyak e higani.

English: Notice: TVET opens a new catering and hospitality programme at the vocational centre in Busia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inafungua programu mpya ya upishi na ukarimu katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Busia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay ka furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan cuntada iyo marti-gelinta xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Busia.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET chako chenro manyien mar chiemo kod rwako welo e skul mar tich e county mar Busia.

English: Nyeri (Kieni) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Nyeri (Kieni): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Juni 2023
Somali: Gobolka Nyeri (Kieni): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Nyeri (Kieni): Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2023

English: Notice from Division of Disease Surveillance and Response: skilled birth attendance clinics will run every June at designated health centres in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa: kliniki za mahudhurio ya uzazi zenye ujuzi zitaendeshwa kila Juni katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka socda qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada: rugta daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfadleyda ah ayaa la qaban doonaa bishii Juun ee kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Bomet.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuwo: Klinike mag rito nyuol ma nigi lony biro tiyo dwe mar auchiel higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e county mar Bomet.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response urges residents of Nyamira County to complete the full recommended vaccination dose following a rise in reported dengue fever cases.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya homa ya dengue.
Somali: Waaxda Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inay dhammaystiraan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo ka dib kororka kiisaska cudurka dengue ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Nyamira mondo ochop e okang' mar thieth ma gichiwo bang' medruok mar joma ne nigi tuwo mar dengue.

English: DCI calls on the community in Kilifi County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: DCI waxay bulshada degmada Kilifi ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wici doonaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: DCI okwayo ji duto manie gweng' mar Kilifi mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong simo mar GBV 1195.

English: Using a smartphone app, farmers can get a diagnosis of a crop disease and recommendations on what treatment to apply.
Kiswahili: Kwa kutumia programu ya smartphone, wakulima wanaweza kupata utambuzi wa ugonjwa wa mazao na mapendekezo juu ya matibabu gani ya kutumia.
Somali: Iyadoo la adeegsanayo app-ka taleefanka casriga ah, beeraleydu waxay heli karaan ogaansho cudur dalag ah iyo talooyin ku saabsan daaweynta la dabaqi karo.
Dholuo: Kuom tiyo gi app mar smartphone, jopur nyalo yudo ni gin gi tuwo moro e puothe kendo ginyalo yudo paro kuom kaka onego giti gi thiethno.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the public in Wajir County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadweynaha degmada Wajir inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda kadib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada lacagta mobilada.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ji duto e County mar Wajir mondo ochiw ripot mar ote manyalo kelo hinyruok ne jomisonari margi bang' yudo ripot mag timbe mag wuondruok gi pesa mag simo.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageerada soo kabashada xadgudubka maandooriyaha ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tiyo gi yedhe mamero yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e Homa Bay County.

English: Farmers and coffee producers are encouraged to engage with KEPROBA and AFA for support and training in expanding and diversifying coffee exports
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wazalishaji wa kahawa wanahimizwa kushirikiana na KEPROBA na AFA kwa usaidizi na mafunzo ya kupanua na kusambaza kahawa nje ya nchi.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo soo saarayaasha bunka waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay la shaqeeyaan KEPROBA iyo AFA si ay u taageeraan una tababaraan ballaarinta iyo kala duwanaanshaha dhoofinta bunka
Dholuo: Ojiwo jopur koda jopur mag chai mondo oriwre gi KEPROBA kod AFA e konyo kendo tiego ji e medo yaro kendo kelo yore mopogore opogore mag ohala mar chai

English: FAO urges maize growers in Kisumu County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawataka wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Kisumu inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si kor loogu qaado wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma pidho kodhi e gweng' mar Kisumu mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed nyak e higani.

English: Notice: KTDA will train farmers in Tana River County on terracing this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River juu ya mashindano ya terracing Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: KTDA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Tana River ee ku saabsan dhulka lagu beeray bisha Sebtember ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KTDA biro tiego jopur e taon mar Tana River County e dwe mar Septemba.

Kiswahili: Angalia mashirika ya kutoa misaada kabla ya kutoa michango mtandaoni. "Mikusanyiko ya fedha bandia ni ya kawaida.
Somali: Hubi samafalka ka hor intaadan ku deeqin khadka tooska ah._x009d_ Lacag ururinta been abuurka ah waa wax caadi ah.
