English: KICD announces distribution of textbooks and learning materials to schools in Nyeri County this February.
Kiswahili: KICD inatangaza usambazaji wa vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Februari hii.
Somali: KICD waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qeybinta buugaagta iyo qalabka wax lagu barto dugsiyada degmada Nyeri bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: KICD olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok e skunde man Nyeri County e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: COMESA will conduct a pest and disease management workshop for farmers in Migori County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itafanya warsha ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan xakamaynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada beeraleyda ee degmada Migori bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: COMESA biro timo chokruok mar rieyo tuoche kod tuoche ne jopur e County mar Migori e dwe mar Mei.

English: Humanitarian Action for Children 2024 - Kenya
Kiswahili: Hatua za Kibinadamu kwa Watoto 2024 - Kenya
Somali: Waxqabadka Bani'aadamnimada ee Carruurta 2024 - Kenya
Dholuo: Tich mar konyo nyithindo higa mar 2024 - Kenya

English: Notice: KUCCPS opens applications for textbooks and learning materials for learners in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inafungua maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay u furaysaa codsiyada buugaagta waxbarasho iyo qalabka wax lagu barto ardayda degmada Wajir.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KUCCPS chako tiyo gi buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok ne jopuonjre e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: TVET urges youth in Tharaka-Nithi County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: TVET waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo rowere mag Tharaka-Nithi County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiego ji kapok gitimo gik ma biro timore ne ji.

English: Notice: KALRO will conduct a pest and disease management workshop for farmers in Nakuru County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafanya warsha ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada beeraleyda ee degmada Nakuru bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KALRO biro timo chokruok mar rieyo tuoche kod tuoche ne jopur e kaunti mar Nakuru e dwe mar Mach.

English: Kenya MVD Readiness - DREF Final Report (MDRKE069)
Kiswahili: Utayari wa MVD ya Kenya - Ripoti ya Mwisho ya DREF (MDRKE069)
Somali: Diyaargarowga MVD ee Kenya - Warbixinta kama dambaysta ah ee DREF (MDRKE069)
Dholuo: Oikore mar MVD mar piny Kenya - Ripot mogik mar DREF (MDRKE069)

English: Use deadbolt locks on exterior doors for added security.
Kiswahili: Tumia kufuli za ziada kwenye milango ya nje kwa ajili ya usalama wa ziada.
Somali: Isticmaal qufulka albaabada dibedda si aad u hesho ammaan dheeraad ah.
Dholuo: Ti gi dhoudi mag oko mondo omi ibed gi ritruok momedore.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette will hold a public participation forum on development planning forums in Embu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya litafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Kenya Gazette waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta ee degmada Embu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Gazette biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag dongruok e county mar Embu.

English: Notice: KMTC launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC yazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay bilowday barnaamij tallaabooyin ka dhan ah dhibaatada dugsiyada degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KMTC chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe mahundu e skunde duto mag Bungoma County.

English: Beyond that, research firm together with Kenya Agricultural...good markets, market access: resilient groups, digital production..
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, kampuni ya utafiti pamoja na Kenya Kilimo... masoko mazuri, upatikanaji wa soko: vikundi kuhimili, uzalishaji digital ..
Somali: Intaas waxaa dheer, shirkadda cilmi-baarista oo ay weheliyaan Kenya Agricultural... suuqyada wanaagsan, helitaanka suuqa: kooxo adkaysi leh, soo saarista dijitaalka ah..
Dholuo: E wi mano, kambi mar timo nonro kaachiel gi Kenya Agricultural...ohala mabeyo, thuolo mar yudo ohala: grube ma nigi teko mar geng'o, loso gik moko e yo digital..

English: Council of Governors urges residents of Nyandarua County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku boorinayaan dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee golaha gobolka si ay uga warqabtaan bixinta adeegyada degmada.
Dholuo: Council of Governors jiwo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo gibed ka ging'eyo weche duto e wi tiegruok mar gwenge.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa ajili ya usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu ka furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay ka shaqeynta shahaadada dhalashada ee degmada Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mar loso nyasi mag nyuol e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Kisumu County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the March planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kutumia viwango vinavyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Machi.
Somali: Guddiga Wax soo saarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Kisumu inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok Chiko jopur mag Kisumu County mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Mach.

English: SPEECH BY HIS EXCELLENCY HON. UHURU KENYATTA, C.G.H., PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC OF KENYA AND COMMANDER-INCHIEF OF THE DEFENCE FORCES DURING THE MASHUJAA DAY STATE ADDRESS ON, 20TH OCTOBER, 2021 DISTIN...
Kiswahili: HOTUBA YA MHESHIMIWA MHESHIMIWA UHURU KENYATTA, C.G.H., RAIS WA JAMHURI YA KENYA NA Amiri Jeshi Mkuu wa Majeshi ya Ulinzi Wakati wa Hotuba ya Kitaifa ya Siku ya Mashujaa mnamo, 20 Oktoba, 2021 DISTIN...
Somali: Hadal uu soo jeediyay Mudane Xaaji Xasan Xasan Sheekh, Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Kenya iyo Taliyaha Guud ee Ciidamada Difaaca inta lagu gudajiray maalinta Mashujaa.
Dholuo: Wuoyo mar Wuon mare Maduong', UHURU KENYATTA, C.G.H., President of the Republic of Kenya and Commander-in-Chief of the Defence Forces during the MashujaA Day State Address on, 20th October, 2021 DISTIN...

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds the public in Kilifi County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu dadka degmada Kilifi ku xasuustaa inay ka feejignaadaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service parone ji duto manie County Kilifi mondo obed motang' gi chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: Universities Fund advises students in Laikipia County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya udhamini mkondoni kupata yaliyomo kwenye ujifunzaji wa dijiti bila malipo.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ardayda degmada Laikipia kula talinayaa inay dalbadaan bogga deeqda waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan waxyaabaha barashada dijitaalka ah ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund chiwo paro ne jopuonjre man Laikipia County mondo oketgi e intanet mondo giyud thuolo mar somo weche mag digital maonge chudo.

English: TSC announces 3,000 internships for graduate teachers in TVETs.
Kiswahili: TSC yatangaza mafunzo 3,000 kwa walimu wahitimu katika Vyuo vya Ufundi Stadi (TVET).
Somali: TSC waxay ku dhawaaqday 3,000 oo tababar shaqo ah oo loogu talagalay macallimiinta qalin-jabinta ee ku jira barnaamijyada TVET-yada.
Dholuo: TSC ogolo lendo mar puonjruok 3,000 ne jopuonj ma otieko sikul ma malo e skul mag TVET.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free measles screening is available at all public health centres in Baringo County this February.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa surua unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo Februari hii.
Somali: Shirkadda SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka fayraska ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka guud ee degmada Baringo bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji ni nonro mar thieth mar midho ma onge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto mag oganda e County mar Baringo e dwe mar Februar.

English: KALRO urges sweet potatoes growers in Meru County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Meru kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda baradho macaan ee degmada Meru inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur ma pidho olemo mag sweet potato e county mar Meru mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue mondo okony e medo nyak mar olemo e higani.

English: Kenya Red Cross alerts residents of Machakos County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos juu ya kuongezeka kwa visa vya wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay uga digtay dadka deggan degmada Machakos kororka kiisaska tuugada waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan macluumaadka amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross chiwo siem ne ji modak e County ma Machakos kuom wach kwan mag jokuoge medore kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on parents in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to have children under five screened for dengue fever during the December outreach.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuwafanyia uchunguzi watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa homa ya dengue wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Desemba.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baarayo cudurka dengue inta lagu jiro bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross kwayo jonyuol e County mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Turkana County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Turkana: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Februari 2023
Somali: Degmada Turkana: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Turkana: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2023

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMRI will be held in Kajiado County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMRI itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kajiado Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay KEMRI ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Kajiado bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma KEMRI ochano biro bedo maonge chudo e Kajiado County e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: TVET opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inafungua maombi ya maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali bila malipo kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay codsiyada u furaysaa barayaasha degmada Meru inay helaan waxyaabaha barashada digitalka ah ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET yawo kwayo mag somo mar digital maonge chudo ne jopuonjre man e county mar Meru.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will conduct a fertiliser application workshop for farmers in Trans Nzoia County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itafanya warsha ya maombi ya mbolea kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan isticmaalka bacriminta beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro timo tiegruok mar tiyo gi yien mag lowo ne jopur e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia e dwe mar Februar.

English: A malaria vaccine tested in Kenya gains WHO prequalification, costing as low as Sh300, becoming the world's second vaccine on the global prequalified list.
Kiswahili: Chanjo ya malaria iliyojaribiwa nchini Kenya yapata sifa ya awali ya WHO, ikigharimu hadi Sh300, na kuwa chanjo ya pili duniani kwenye orodha ya chanjo zilizoidhinishwa awali duniani.
Somali: Tallaalka duumada ee lagu tijaabiyey Kenya ayaa helay shahaadada WHO, qiimihiisu wuxuu gaadhay Sh300, taasoo ka dhigaysa tallaalka labaad ee adduunka ee ku jira liiska caalamiga ah ee shahaadooyinka hore.
Dholuo: Yadh thieth mar malaria ma ne otim e piny Kenya, ne oyudo ratiro mar riwruok mar thieth miluongo ni WHO, kendo nengo mar yadhno ne ochopo Sh300, ma en mar ariyo e piny mangima.

English: Notice: KUCCPS reminds citizens in Mandera County about their rights regarding voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuhusu haki zao kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Mandera xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KUCCPS paronwa raia mag Mandera County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar ndiko joma oyiero.

English: DCI calls on the community in Kajiado County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatia moyo jamii katika Kajiado County kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: DCI waxay bulshada degmada Kajiado ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan waxayna taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: DCI okwayo ji duto manie Kajiado County mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo mondo giyud kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Narok County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri katika shule kote Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay bilawday barnaamij hagitaan iyo adeegyo la-talin ah oo lagu sameeyo dugsiyada gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State Department for TVET chako chenro mar tayo kendo chiwo paro e skunde duto mag Narok County.

English: Universities Fund invites youth in Meru County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this December.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Meru kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Desemba hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku casuumay dhalinyarada degmada Meru inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund gwelo rowere e County mar Meru mondo odonjre e tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing e dwe mar Desemba.

English: KEPHIS reminds residents of Trans Nzoia County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia in ilaalinta ciidda ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: KEPHIS paronwa jogweng' mar Trans Nzoia County ni rito lowo miyo puothe bedo gi nyak maber e kinde mabiro.

English: Marsabit County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Marsabit: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Mei 2023
Somali: Degmada Marsabit: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Marsabit: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar abich 2023

English: E-Citizen warns public officers in Lamu County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Wilaya ya Lamu dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dawladda ee gobolka Lamu inay musuqmaasuq ku sameeyaan xafiisyada dawladda.
Dholuo: E-Citizen chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e County mar Lamu kuom kawo asoya e migepe mar sirkal.

English: CDC advises residents of Kakamega County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: CDC inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kuthibitisha kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: CDC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega inay xaqiijiyaan in xaruntoodu la aqoonsaday ka hor inta aysan booqan si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: CDC nyiso jogweng' Kakamega County mondo ong'e ni kuondegi mag thieth oseyudo ratiro kapok gibiro mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages residents of Embu County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay la xiriiraan lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo jogweng' mar Embu County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giwuo gi jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Samburu County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the December planting season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Desemba.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda Gobolka Samburu inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka xilliga dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur e county mar Samburu mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e dwe mar Desemba.

English: NCPB invites farmers in Bomet County to a free training on modern irrigation techniques this January.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji Januari hii.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku casuumaysaa beeraleyda gobolka Bomet inay tababar bilaash ah ku helaan farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: NCPB ogwelo jopur e county mar Bomet e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi yore mag lero pi e dwe mar Januar.

English: 11 Human Rights Organizations Laud â€œLandmarkâ€ New Mental Health Amendment Act in Kenya
Kiswahili: Mashirika 11 ya Haki za Kibinadamu Yanasifu Sheria Mpya ya Marekebisho ya Afya ya Akili "Alama" nchini Kenya
Somali: 11 Urur oo Xuquuqda Aadanaha ah oo lagu ammaanay "Astaanta ugu Muhiimsan" Xeerka Cusub ee Wax-ka-beddelka Caafimaadka Dhimirka ee Kenya
Dholuo: 11 Riwruoge ma rito ratiro mag dhano ogoyo erokamano ne chik manyien mar loko weche mag thieth mar paro e piny Kenya

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties urges residents of Narok County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia laini ya bure ya EACC ili kukabiliana na udanganyifu wa fedha za umma.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Narok ku boorinayaa inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee EACC si looga hortago xadgudubka maaliyadeed ee dawladda.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo oland weche mag mibadhi kokalo kuom hotline mar EACC maonge chudo mondo giked gi ketho pesa mag sirkal.

English: SHA reminds the public in Uasin Gishu County that input on the county budget process is welcome this September.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linakumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya Uasin Gishu kwamba mapendekezo juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya wilaya yanakaribishwa Septemba hii.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Uasin Gishu in talooyinka ku saabsan habka miisaaniyadda gobolka ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: SHA parone ji duto e county mar Uasin Gishu ni gibiro yie gi chiwo mag pesa e dwe mar Septemba.

English: IEBC warns public officers in Lamu County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: IEBC inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Wilaya ya Lamu dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: IEBC waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dawladda ee gobolka Lamu inay musuqmaasuqa ka qaataan xafiisyada dawladda.
Dholuo: IEBC chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e County mar Lamu kuom kawo asoya e migepe mar sirkal.

English: Kenya Gazette encourages first-time voters in Laikipia County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawatia moyo wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Laikipia inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo joma okwongo yiero e county mar Laikipia mondo olim kama ichikoe ji ne IEBC.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Meru County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Meru kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Meru inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e gweng' mar Meru mondo odhi ir japuonj molony.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Embu County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the April planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo kabla ya msimu wa upandaji Aprili.
Somali: Guddiga Waxsoosaarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Embu inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagyada si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda ka hor xilliga beerashada bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e county mar Embu mondo otim lokruok e puothe mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber kapok higa mar April ochopo.

English: The Kshs 3 Billion Cherry Advance Revolving Fund regulations have been approved Coffee stakeholders are invited to submit written feedback by January 15 2020
Kiswahili: Kanuni za Kshs 3 Bilioni za Cherry Advance Revolving Fund zimeidhinishwa Wadau wa Kahawa wamealikwa kuwasilisha maoni yao kwa maandishi kufikia Januari 15 2020.
Somali: Xeerarka Kshs 3 Bilyan Cherry Advance Revolving Fund waa la ansixiyay Daneeyayaasha kafeega waxaa lagu martiqaadayaa inay soo gudbiyaan jawaab qoraal ah ka hor Janaayo 15, 2020
Dholuo: chike mag Kshs 3 Billion Cherry Advance Revolving Fund oseyudo ratiro.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges motorists and pedestrians in Kericho County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Kericho inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada daadad ku soo daatay si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Lando Wach (Kenya Communications Authority) jiwo derebe kod joma wuotho gi tiendegi e gweng' mar Kericho mondo kik ging'ad kor lwasi ma pi opong'o kendo kik gikalo e kor yiedhi mondo kik gitim aksident mag ndara.

English: Kenya Gazette warns public officers in Nairobi County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi dhidi ya kupotosha fedha za umma.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Nairobi in ay ka faa'iideystaan dhaqaale dawladeed.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e County mar Nairobi ni kik giti gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo e yo marach.

English: Huduma Kenya warns public officers in Meru County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Meru dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Meru inay musuqmaasuqa ka qaataan xafiisyada dowladda.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Meru kuom kawo asoya e migepe mar sirkal.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij lagu daro ardayda naafada ah dugsiyada guud ahaan Degmada Laikipia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission of Teachers Service osechako chenro mar tiego nyithindo ma nigi midekre e skunde duto e County mar Laikipia.

English: KEMRI launches a May awareness campaign on safe water storage across Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: KEMRI yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Mei juu ya uhifadhi wa maji salama katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Somali: KEMRI waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Maajo oo ku saabsan kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: KEMRI chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Mei kuom wach kano pi maler e gweng' mar Isiolo.

English: Notice: SHA opens polling procedures centres in Marsabit County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: SHA inafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika wilaya ya Marsabit Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA waxay furaysaa xarumaha nidaamyada codbixinta ee degmada Marsabit bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA chako tiyo gi chenro mag timo yiero e taon mar Marsabit e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education opens a new welding and fabrication programme at the vocational centre in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inafungua programu mpya ya kulehemu na utengenezaji katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan alxanka iyo soo saarista xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Puonjruok ma Chakre e Piny owacho chako chenro manyien mar loso kendo loso gik moko e skul mar tiegruok ma yudore e gweng' mar Kericho.

English: IPOA reminds residents of Migori County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Migori in warbixinta degdegga ah ee xanta xoolaha ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogweng' Migori County ni lando piyo piyo mag jamni konyo rito kuonde ma gidakie.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development invites youth in Wajir County to enroll for ICT skills training this May.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Wajir kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT Mei hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku casuumay dhalinyarada degmada Wajir inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka xirfadaha ICT bisha May.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ogwelo rowere e County mar Wajir mondo odonj e tiegruok mar ICT e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service activates an emergency response plan for flooding in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya yaanzisha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu hirgeliyaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ku saabsan fatahaadaha gobolka Mombasa.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Forest Service chako tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony mapiyo ne pi e gweng' mar Mombasa.

English: Notice: KUCCPS opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay furaysaa codsiyada deeqda waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan ardayda ku jira degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KUCCPS oyawo kwayo mag yudo siko mar somo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e gweng' mar Kisumu.

English: AFA promotes water harvesting among farmers in Kitui County as part of the April climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: AFA inakuza uvunaji wa maji miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa Aprili.
Somali: AFA waxay dhiirrigelisay goosashada biyaha beeraleyda degmada Kitui iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka adkeysiga cimilada ee Abriil.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo choko pi e kind jopur e County mar Kitui kaka achiel kuom chenro mar April mar kedo gi lokruok e kor lwasi.

English: Notice: NDMA issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah ee saameeya dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NDMA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity kuom chenro mag ohala ma ok kare makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Kakamega County.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Kiambu County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Kiambu inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qaybqaataan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur e County mar Kiambu mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are urged to focus on improving soil health as part of the Kenya Food Systems and Land Use Action Plan 2024 2030
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wamehimizwa kuzingatia kuboresha afya ya udongo kama sehemu ya Mpango wa Utekelezaji wa Mifumo ya Chakula na Matumizi ya Ardhi ya Kenya 2024 2030.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay diiradda saaraan horumarinta caafimaadka ciidda qayb ka ah Qorshaha Hawlgalka Nidaamyada Cuntada iyo Isticmaalka Dhulka Kenya 2024 2030
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma tiyo gi weche mag ohala e weche mag ohala jiwo jopur koda jomamoko mondo oket pachgi kuom medo bedo gi ngima maber e lowo kaka achiel kuom chenro mar Kenya Food Systems and Land Use Action Plan 2024 2030

English: Farmers are assured of uninterrupted fertilizer supply from the Thika NCPB Depot
Kiswahili: Wakulima wamehakikishiwa usambazaji wa mbolea bila kukatizwa kutoka kwa Bohari ya Thika NCPB
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu xaqiijiyay bixinta bacriminta ee aan kala go' lahayn ee Thika NCPB Depot
Dholuo: Jo-Purie ne omi thuolo mar yudo yien maok ochwanyre e depo mar NCPB e Thika

English: In our pursuit of a healthier society, let's not forget that there is no health without mental health! As we prioritize physical well-being, it is equally important to prioritize our mental and emotional well-being.
Kiswahili: Katika kutafuta jamii yenye afya njema, tusisahau kwamba hakuna afya bila afya ya akili! Tunapoweka kipaumbele ustawi wa kimwili, ni muhimu pia kuweka kipaumbele ustawi wetu wa kiakili na kihisia.
Somali: Marka aynu raadinayno bulsho caafimaad leh, ha iloobinno in caafimaad aan caafimaad maskaxeed lahayn la'aantiis aysan jirin!
Dholuo: Sama watemo matek mondo wabed gi ngima maber, kik wiwa wil ni onge ngima maber maok wan gi ngima mar paro!

English: Women have a bigger role in fish sales. Learn about available policy, markets and support pillars, women inclusivity and capacity building.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wana jukumu kubwa katika mauzo ya samaki. Jifunze kuhusu sera zilizopo, masoko na nguzo za msaada, uingiliaji wa wanawake na kujenga uwezo.
Somali: Haweenka waxay door weyn ka ciyaaraan iibka kalluunka. Baro siyaasadaha la heli karo, suuqyada iyo tiirarka taageerada, ka qaybgalka haweenka iyo kor u qaadista awoodaha.
Dholuo: Mon nigi migawo maduong' ahinya e uso rech. Puonjri e wi chenro mag siasa, ohala, kod kuonde ma ji yudoe kony, koda kuom wach miyo mon thuolo kendo gero nyalo.

English: Ministry of ICT provides training for over 500 teachers on the use of Learning Management Systems (LMS) for blended learning.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya ICT hutoa mafunzo kwa walimu zaidi ya 500 juu ya matumizi ya Mfumo wa Usimamizi wa Kujifunza (LMS) kwa kujifunza kuchanganywa.
Somali: Wasaaradda ICT waxay tababar u siineysaa in ka badan 500 macalin oo ku saabsan isticmaalka Nidaamyada Maareynta Barashada (LMS) ee barashada isku dhafan.
Dholuo: Ministry of ICT chiwo tiegruok ne jopuonj mokalo 500 kuom kaka ginyalo tiyo gi yore mag Puonjruok (LMS) e puonjo ji e yore mopogore opogore.

English: KICD reminds needy students in Makueni County that free digital learning content applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba programu za bure za maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Makueni in codsiyada barnaamijyada barashada bilaashka ah ee dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan soo gabagabeyn doonaan.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e gweng' mar Makueni ni chenro mag puonjruok mar digital ma onge chudo chiegni rumo.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties urges eligible citizens in Kwale County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Kwale kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kwale inay ka qaybqaataan jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties jiwo raia ma kwan-gi owinjore e county mar Kwale mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar yiero.

English: Use fertilizers wisely to maximize nutrient uptake by goats and minimize environmental impact. Learn about soil testing and balanced fertilization.
Kiswahili: Tumia mbolea kwa busara ili kuongeza uchukuaji wa virutubishi na mbuzi na kupunguza athari za mazingira. Jifunze kuhusu upimaji wa udongo na mbolea yenye usawa.
Somali: Si xikmad leh u isticmaal bacriminta si aad u kordhiso qaadashada nafaqada ee riyaha, loona yareeyo saameynta deegaanka. Baro tijaabada ciidda iyo bacriminta isku dheelitiran.
Dholuo: Ti gi yien mag yien e yo mariek mondo omi diek omed tiyo gi yien ma nigi gik ma kelonegi chiemo kendo oketh alwora.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health: family planning counselling clinics will run every January at designated health centres in Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Januari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka: rugta la talinta qorshaynta qoyska waxay ka shaqeyn doontaa Janaayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee lagu magacaabo degmada Marsabit.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth: Klinike mag chiwo paro e wi chenro mag ngima joot biro tiyo e dwe mar Januar higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e county mar Marsabit.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health confirms a tuberculosis outbreak alert for Garissa County. Residents are advised to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa kifua kikuu kwa Kaunti ya Garissa. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka hargabka ee Gobolka Garissa. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuberculosis e gweng' mar Garissa.

English: KEPHIS advises farmers in Kwale County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kwale inay iska diiwaangeliyaan tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qeybgalaan waxbarashada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e county mar Kwale mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e tiego jopur mabiro.

English: TVET encourages residents of Meru County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Meru mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda mondo gibed gi ng'eyo kuom kaka ji biro tiyo gi bajet mar county.

English: COMESA urges farmers in Meru County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Meru inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e county mar Meru mondo opidh olembe ma ok nyal geng'o lowo kethore mondo omi girit lokruok ma timore e kaka koth chue.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development encourages farmers in Bomet County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for horticultural produce.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za mazao ya bustani.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Bomet inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay waxyaabaha beeraha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur e county mar Bomet mondo ous olemo mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo olemo mondo giyud nengo maber mar olemo mag puodho.

English: Notice: NPS issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa utambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Somali: Ogaysiis: NPS waxay soo saartaa digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan xadiidka aqoonsiga ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Kiambu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NPS ogolo siem mar rito weche mag sirkal kuom wach kwalo nying' jogo modak e County mar Kiambu.

English: Market access, influenced by transport infrastructure, plays a crucial role in promoting food security, productivity, income changes, and food price ...
Kiswahili: Ufikiaji wa soko, unaoathiriwa na miundombinu ya usafiri, una jukumu muhimu katika kukuza usalama wa chakula, tija, mabadiliko ya mapato, na bei ya chakula ...
Somali: Helitaanka suuqa, oo ay saameyn ku yeelato kaabayaasha gaadiidka, ayaa door muhiim ah ka ciyaara horumarinta amniga cuntada, wax soo saarka, isbeddelka dakhliga, iyo qiimaha cuntada ...
Dholuo: Bedo gi thuolo mar tiyo gi yore mag wuoth konyo ahinya e jiwo weche mag chiemo, nyak mar chiemo, lokruok e yuto, koda nengo mar chiemo...

English: EACC encourages first-time voters in Narok County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: EACC inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Narok kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: EACC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha marka ugu horeysa ee degmada Narok inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo joma okwongo yiero e Narok County mondo onon weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: NCPB warns wheat farmers in Tana River County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawaonya wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Tana River juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: NCPB waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda wheat ee degmada Tana River cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: NCPB chiwo siem ne jopur mag ngano e taon mar Tana River County kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ochiwo paro mar kawo okang' mapiyo.

English: KTDA warns millet farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KTDA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda millet ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: KTDA osiemo jopur mag millet e Tharaka-Nithi County kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim gik moko e kinde mowinjore.

English: REBUILD: COVID-19 Pandemic and Women in the Informal Economy in Kenya, Uganda and India
Kiswahili: JENGA UPYA: Janga la COVID-19 na Wanawake katika Uchumi Usio Rasmi nchini Kenya, Uganda na India
Somali: DIB U DHISID: Cudurka Faafa ee COVID-19 iyo Haweenka ku jira Dhaqaalaha aan rasmiga ahayn ee Kenya, Uganda iyo Hindiya
Dholuo: GERO CHIEN: Tuwo mar COVID-19 kod Mon e Yor Ochumi ma Ok Owinjore e Pinje mag Kenya, Uganda kod India

English: NPS urges the community in Machakos County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb theft.
Kiswahili: NPS inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Machakos inay ka warbixiyaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo shaki leh xarunta booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo ji duto manie County mar Machakos mondo onyis polis ma ni machiegni gi kanyo ni gitimo gik ma chando ji.

English: KEPHIS informs maize farmers in Nyamira County of new market linkage opportunities this September.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawafahamisha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Septemba hii.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Nyamira fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KEPHIS nyiso jopur mag kodhi e County mar Nyamira e dwe mar Septemba e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala.

English: COMESA reminds farmers in Turkana County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Turkana juu ya programu inayoendelea ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa wakulima.
Somali: COMESA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Turkana in barnaamijka tababarka beeralayda uu socdo.
Dholuo: COMESA parone jopur e county mar Turkana chenro mar tiego jopur ma dhi nyime.

English: Caregivers should change diapers frequently and clean the babyÂ’s skin gently to avoid rashes and infections.
Kiswahili: Walezi wanapaswa kubadilisha nepi mara kwa mara na kusafisha ngozi ya mtoto kwa upole ili kuepuka vipele na maambukizi.
Somali: Daryeelayaashu waa inay si joogto ah u beddelaan xafaayadaha ilmaha oo ay si tartiib ah u nadiifiyaan maqaarka ilmaha si looga fogaado finan iyo caabuqyo.
Dholuo: Joma rito nyathi onego olok diaper kinde ka kinde kendo olos dende nyathino e yo mayom mondo kik oyud ng’ol kod tuoche.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations alerts residents of Mombasa County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa uga digaya kororka kiisaska gawaarida la xaday wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng' County mar Mombasa kuom wach medruok mar weche mag kwalo mtokni kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot e stesen mar polise man machiegni.

English: Regular weight checks at clinics help detect growth issues early. Caregivers are encouraged to attend monthly child welfare clinics.
Kiswahili: Kupima uzito mara kwa mara katika kliniki husaidia kugundua matatizo ya ukuaji mapema. Walezi wanahimizwa kuhudhuria kliniki za ustawi wa watoto kila mwezi.
Somali: Imtixaanka miisaanka ee joogtada ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka ayaa gacan ka geysanaya in la ogaado dhibaatooyinka koritaanka ka hor.
Dholuo: Nono dendi pile ka pile e osiptal konyo ng'ato fwenyo ni en gi chandruok mar dongo chon, kendo ijiwo jorit mondo odhi e klinik mag rito nyithindo dwe ka dwe.

English: EACC reminds voters in Bomet County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Bomet kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya kusajili wapiga Kura.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha gobolka Bomet in ay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor diiwaangelinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: EACC parone jogweng'o mag Bomet County ni mondo gidhi e kama ichanoe mar IEBC machiegni kodgi kapok gidonjo e tiegruok mar joma biro yiero.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) promotes water harvesting among farmers in Kakamega County as part of the August climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inakuza uvunaji wa maji miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Agosti.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kor u qaadeysaa goosashada biyaha beeraleyda Gobolka Kakamega iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Agoosto.
Dholuo: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo choko pi e kind jopur e Kaunti mar Kakamega kaka achiel kuom chenro mar Agost mar geng'o lokruok e kit yamo.

English: TVET reminds needy students in Kakamega County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Kakamega in buugaagta waxbarasho iyo codsiyada qalabka wax lagu barto ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa jopuonjre modhier e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok biro rumo machiegni.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will distribute certified millet seed to farmers in Nandi County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Waxsoosaarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu abuurka miiraha la caddeeyay u qaybin doonaa beeraleyda gobolka Nandi bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Rapar: Bura matayo gik makelo tuoche mag tuoche biro pogo kodhi mag millet ne jopur man Nandi County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Murang'a County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba upatikanaji wa maelekezo ya makazi salama unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee ka dhacay degmada Murang'a in helitaanka tixraacyada magangelyo ammaan ah ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e county mar Murang'a ni thuolo mar yudo kuonde mag dak ma ji nyalo dakie onge chudo.

English: Ministry of Health launches a September awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Busia County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Septemba juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Busia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Sebtember oo ku saabsan wacyiga cadaadiska sare ee gobolka Busia.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health osechako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Septemba e wi wach medo ng'eyo ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar hypertension e gweng' mar Busia.

English: OGP reminds voters in Marsabit County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: OGP inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Marsabit inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor nidaamyada doorashada.
Dholuo: OGP parone jogweng' mar Marsabit mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero ka pok oyud thuolo mar timo yiero.

English: Embu (Mbeere) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Embu (Mbeere): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Juni 2024
Somali: Degmada Embu (Mbeere): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Embu (Mbeere): Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2024

English: Get out, Walk, run or climb hills. Expose yourself to new environment. Be glad. Take your time to rejoice as the sun risises and sets down. It might appear difficult to start with, but take heart
Kiswahili: Toka nje, tembea, ukimbie, au upige milima. Jitambulishe kwa mazingira mapya. Furahi. Chukua wakati wako kufurahi wakati jua linapochomoza na kushuka. Huenda ikaonekana vigumu kuanza, lakini uwe na moyo mkuu
Somali: Ka bax, socdo, ordo ama buuraha fuulo. Naftaada u soo bandhig jawi cusub. Farxiso. Waqtiga qaato si aad ugu faraxdo sida qorraxdu u soo baxdo oo u dhacdo. Waxay u muuqan kartaa inay adag tahay inaad bilowdo, laakiin kalsooni qabso
Dholuo: Wuog oko, wuoth, ring, kata idonj e gode. Ketri e alwora manyien. Bed mamor. Kaw thuolo mar mor sama chieng' wuok kendo podho.

English: Notice: IPOA launches a carjacking prevention campaign in Garissa County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia utekaji nyara katika Kaunti ya Garissa Mei hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: IPOA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga baabuurta la xaday ee Gobolka Garissa bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA chako kampen mar geng'o joma kwalo mtokni e taon mar Garissa e dwe mar Mei.

English: OGP updates residents of Baringo County on progress of community-based development programmes this November.
Kiswahili: OGP inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo juu ya maendeleo ya programu za maendeleo ya jamii mwezi huu wa Novemba.
Somali: OGP waxay dadka deggan degmada Baringo ku wargelineysaa horumarka barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada ee bisha November.
Dholuo: OGP chiwo ripot ne jogweng' Baringo County kuom dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag oganda e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Farmers are encouraged to participate in the upcoming initiatives aimed at boosting crop production with a target of 2 118 000 tons in the 2026 2027 agricultural year
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mipango ijayo inayolenga kukuza uzalishaji wa mazao kwa lengo la tani 2,118,000 katika mwaka wa kilimo wa 2026 2027.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay ka qaybqaataan dadaallada soo socda ee lagu xoojinayo wax soo saarka dalagga iyadoo la beegsanayo 2 118 000 ton sanadka beeraha 2026-2027
Dholuo: Ojiwo jopur mondo oriw lwedo chenro mabiro mar jiwo cham gi yien gi tong' mar ton 2 118 000 e higa mar 2026 2027

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces free medical camps for residents of Kitui County starting this May.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inatangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kuanzia Mei hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhawaaqday xeryo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Kitui laga bilaabo bisha May.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche ogolo kampen mag thieth maonge chudo ne jogweng' Kitui County kochakore e dwe mar Mei.

English: IEBC reminds youth in Kiambu County that HELB funding is available for tailoring and design training.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kiambu in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka qaabeynta iyo naqshadeynta.
Dholuo: IEBC parone rowere e County mar Kiambu ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko.

English: Announcement of new policy requiring lactation rooms and nursing breaks at public and private workplaces.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la sera mpya inayohitaji vyumba vya kunyonyesha na mapumziko ya uuguzi katika maeneo ya kazi ya umma na ya kibinafsi.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida siyaasad cusub oo u baahan qolalka naas nuujinta iyo fasaxyada kalkaalisada ee goobaha shaqada ee dadweynaha iyo kuwa gaarka loo leeyahay.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda mang'ongo ne olando chenro manyien mar loso kuonde mitimie nyithi kiye kod yueyo mar rito nyithindo e kuonde tich mag sirkal kod mag jomoko.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development announces a free anthrax vaccination exercise for pigs in Kisumu County this November.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kimeta kwa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Novemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo lacag la'aan ah oo ah anthrax loogu talagalay doofaarka gobolka Kisumu bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development olando chenro mar thieth mar anthrax maonge chudo mar ng'ato e dwe mar Novemba e Kisumu County.

English: Kenya Flood and Cholera Outbreak 2025 - DREF Final Report (MDRKE066)
Kiswahili: Mlipuko wa Mafuriko na Kipindupindu Kenya 2025 - Ripoti ya Mwisho ya DREF (MDRKE066)
Somali: Daadadka iyo Daacuunka Kenya oo ka dillaacay 2025 - Warbixinta kama dambaysta ah ee DREF (MDRKE066)
Dholuo: Pi mang'eny ma opong'o piny Kenya kod tuwo mar kolera 2025 - Ripot mogik mar DREF (MDRKE066)

English: KUCCPS advises students in Nakuru County to register early to secure allocation to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ardayda degmada Nakuru kula talineysaa inay si hore u diiwaangeliyaan si ay u helaan kaalmo ay ku helaan kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo jopuonjre e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo odonj e skundno chon mondo giyud thuolo mar tiyo gi kompyuta mag skul kaluwore gi chenro mar somo gi somo mar digital.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Uasin Gishu County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhanka ah gobolka Uasin Gishu bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Rapar: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e county mar Uasin Gishu e dwe mar Julai.

English: FAO empowers Kenyan desert locust frontline counties in surveillance and reporting
Kiswahili: FAO inazipa nguvu kaunti zilizo mstari wa mbele wa nzige wa jangwani nchini Kenya katika ufuatiliaji na utoaji taarifa
Somali: FAO waxay awood siisay degmooyinka safka hore ee ayaxa saxaraha Kenya inay la socdaan oo ay soo sheegaan
Dholuo: FAO omiyo kaunti ma ni e nyim winyo mag gwenge ma Kenya teko mar ng’iyo kendo chiwo ripot

English: Notice: IEBC launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Mandera County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Mandera Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhanka ah gobolka Mandera bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Rapar: IEBC chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Mandera e dwe mar Julai.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges youth in Wajir County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Wajir inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda ka hor inta aysan qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education ojiwo rowere e county mar Wajir mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto gikwongo tiyogo ka pok gichako timo tije mag sirkal.

English: NPS warns residents of Nakuru County to prepare for possible flooding this February.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa mafuriko Februari hii.
Somali: NPS waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inay isu diyaariyaan fatahaadaha suurtagalka ah bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: NPS osiemo jogweng' Nakuru County mondo oikre ne koth maduong' ma biro timore e dwe mar Februar.

English: NPS warns residents of Marsabit County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this February.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Februari hii.
Somali: NPS waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inay u diyaar garoobaan qaraxyo dab ah oo dhici kara bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: NPS chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar Marsabit County mondo giikre ne yiengni manyalo timore e dwe mar Februar.

English: What is the best way to wash hands; Wet your hands with clean running water Use soap & lather up for 20 seconds Make sure you get in between your fingers, on the back of hands & under nails & wrists Rinse & dry well with a clean towel. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Ni ipi njia bora ya kuosha mikono; Lowesha mikono yako kwa maji safi yanayotiririka Tumia sabuni na upakae kwa muda wa sekunde 20 Hakikisha umeingia katikati ya vidole vyako, sehemu ya nyuma ya mikono na chini ya kucha na mikononi Suuza na kausha vizuri kwa taulo safi. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Waa maxay habka ugu wanaagsan ee gacmaha lagu dhaqo; Gacmahaaga ku qoyso biyo nadiif ah oo socda. Isticmaal saabuun oo ku dhaq biyo muddo 20 ilbiriqsi ah. Hubi inaad farahaaga dhex gasho, gacmaha gadaasha iyo ciddiyaha iyo curcurada hoostooda. Ku raaci oo si fiican ugu qalaji shukumaan nadiif ah. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Ang’o ma en yo maber moloyo mar lwoko lwedo; Ong’ad lweteni gi pi maler ma ng’ich Ti kod sabun kendo oting’o lum kuom sekon 20 Ne ni idonjo e kind lweteni, e kor lweteni & e bwo lak & lweteni Rach & ng’ad maber gi taulo maler. #KomeshaKorona

English: Notice: KEPHIS will distribute certified rice seed to farmers in Bungoma County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itasambaza mbegu za mpunga zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay abuuraha degmada Bungoma u qaybin doontaa abuurka bariiska ee shahaadada leh bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro pogo kodhi mag loso kodhi ne jopur e County mar Bungoma e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) confirms a typhoid outbreak alert for Bomet County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa matumbo kwa Kaunti ya Bomet. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xaqiijineysaa feejignaanta cudurka tifooska ee degmada Bomet. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: SHA (Social Health Authority) osenyiso ni nitie masira mar typhoid e county mar Bomet.

English: State Department for Basic Education announces distribution of textbooks and learning materials to schools in Mombasa County this March.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi yatangaza usambazaji wa vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Machi hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ayaa ku dhawaaqday qaybinta buugaagta iyo agabyada waxbarasho ee dugsiyada gobolka Mombasa bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok e skunde man Mombasa County e dwe mar Mach.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Nairobi County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nairobi in helitaanka taageerada dalabka NHIF/SHA ay hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa ji e County mar Nairobi ni kony mar kwayo kuom NHIF/SHA sani yudore e kuonde moyier.

English: Notice: KICD opens applications for revision guides for learners in Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay u furaysaa codsiyada hagaha dib u eegista ardayda degmada Samburu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KICD oseyawo kwayo mag somo mar somo e kaunti mar Samburu.

English: FAO urges farmers in Nyandarua County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: FAO inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Nyandarua inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo lagu soo ururiyo biyaha beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e kaunti mar Nyandarua mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok e kaka koth chue.

English: NDMA urges motorists and pedestrians in Nyandarua County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent drought-related incidents.

Dholuo: NDMA jiwo jowuoth mag mtokni kod joma wuotho e paw Nyandarua County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo gitim kinda mar geng'o chandruoge mag oro.

English: Notice: Council of Governors opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Siaya County.

English: Eligible youth in Uganda can access opportunities under the new National Strategy for Youth Employment in Agriculture Engage with the Ministry of Agriculture for details on participation
Kiswahili: Vijana wanaostahiki nchini Uganda wanaweza kupata fursa chini ya Mkakati mpya wa Kitaifa wa Ajira kwa Vijana katika Kilimo Shirikiana na Wizara ya Kilimo kwa maelezo zaidi juu ya ushiriki.

Dholuo: Rowere ma nigi ratiro e piny Uganda nyalo yudo thuolo mag tiyo e bwo chenro manyien mar National Strategy for Youth Employment in Agriculture

English: Notice from Kenya Medical Association: skilled birth attendance clinics will run every June at designated health centres in Kiambu County.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Mombasa County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.

Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya imethibitisha visa viwili vipya vya Mpox, na kufanya jumla ya maambukizi kufikia 33 tangu mlipuko huo uanze.

Kiswahili: TSC inatangaza usambazaji wa vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Oktoba hii.

English: Public health advisory: KEMSA warns of increased tuberculosis risk in Kericho County and advises the public to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.

English: KMTC advises applicants in Migori County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KMTC inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Migori kutembelea kituo cha mafunzo ya ufundi kilicho karibu kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Migori inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee la heli karo.
Dholuo: KMTC jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Migori mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on residents of Nandi County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of border security.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaomba wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqay dadka deggan degmada Nandi inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga waxqabadka aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah si ay u taageeraan amniga xuduudda.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service okwayo jogweng' kaunti mar Nandi mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma rito alwora mar tong'o ni gitimo gik maok kare.

English: Notice: NDMA conducts a community briefing on border security in Nairobi County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha ee Gobolka Nairobi bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA timo romo mar oganda kuom weche mag rito tong' e Nairobi County e dwe mar Februar.

English: IPOA urges the public in Narok County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Narok wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Narok inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada lacagta mobilada.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo ji duto e Narok County mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' weche mag wuondo pesa e simo.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges residents of Laikipia County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay ka qeybgalaan kalfadhiga guud ee golaha gobolka si ay uga warqabaan bixinta adeegyada heerka degmada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Laikipia mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo ging'e weche ma biro timore e wi tij lendo.

English: Tharaka Nithi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2024
Somali: Degmada Tharaka Nithi: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Tharaka Nithi: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar adek higa mar 2024

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public that free dengue fever screening is available at all public health centres in Kakamega County this June.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa homa ya dengue bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Juni hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka hargabka dengue ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee Gobolka Kakamega bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health parone ji ni nonro ma onge chudo mar dengue yudore maonge chudo e kuonde thieth duto e County Kakamega e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: NTSA activates an emergency response plan for fire outbreaks in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NTSA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa milipuko ya moto katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay qaraxyada dabka ee Degmada Migori.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NTSA tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony mapiyo ne masiche mag mach e County mar Migori.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Busia County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Busia kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Busia inay ka feejignaadaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross parone ji duto e County mar Busia ni gibed motang' gi chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges residents of Bungoma County to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers following a rise in reported HIV/AIDS cases.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kuripoti visa vyovyote vinavyoshukiwa kwa wafanyakazi wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya VVU/UKIMWI.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay soo sheegaan kiisas kasta oo loo maleynayo inay u sheegaan mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada ka dib kororka kiisaska HIV / AIDS ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore e weche thieth nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuo mar HIV/AIDS osemedore.

English: DCI calls on the community in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatia moyo jamii katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: DCI waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: DCI okwayo ji duto e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo onyis ji weche mag mahundu e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Notice: Universities Fund opens applications for school laptops under the digital literacy programme for learners in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu hufungua maombi ya kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu u furayaa codsiyada laptops-ka dugsiga barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee ardayda degmada Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Yunivasiti Fund oseyawo kwayo mag kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar somo kod somo mar digital ne jopuonjre e county mar Uasin Gishu.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will open a milk collection centre in Nakuru County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itafungua kituo cha kukusanya maziwa katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay bilaabi doontaa xarun ururinta caanaha ee Gobolka Nakuru bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro yawo kama ichokoe chak e taon mar Nakuru e dwe mar Julai.

English: These Regulations may be cited as the Sports, Arts and Social Development Fund (Amendment) Regulations, 2024.
Kiswahili: Kanuni hizi zinaweza kutajwa kuwa Kanuni za Mfuko wa Michezo, Sanaa na Maendeleo ya Jamii (Marekebisho) za 2024.
Somali: Xeerarkan waxaa loo soo qaadan karaa Xeerarka Sanduuqa Ciyaaraha, Farshaxanka iyo Horumarinta Bulshada (Wax ka Beddelka), 2024.
Dholuo: Chike gi inyalo luongo ni Chike mag Tuke, Gik Motudore kod Fond mar Dongruok mar Oganda (Lokruok), 2024.

English: Educational challenges in refugee camps in Turkana County, Kenya: a brief literature review
Kiswahili: Changamoto za elimu katika kambi za wakimbizi katika Kaunti ya Turkana, Kenya: mapitio mafupi ya fasihi
Somali: Caqabadaha waxbarasho ee ka jira xeryaha qaxootiga ee Degmada Turkana, Kenya: dib u eegis suugaaneed oo kooban
Dholuo: Gik ma kelo pek mag somo e kambi mag jolweny e gweng’ mar Turkana, piny Kenya: nonro machuok mar buge

English: All youth who have reached eighteen (18) years of age are urged to register as voters at IEBC centers to get the right to vote in the election.
Kiswahili: Vijana wote waliotimiza miaka kumi na nane (18) wanaombwa kujisajili kama wapiga kura kwenye vituo vya IEBC ili kupata haki ya kupiga kura katika uchaguzi.
Somali: Dhammaan dhalinyarada gaaray siddeed iyo toban (18) sano waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay iska diiwaan galiyaan codbixiyeyaasha xarumaha IEBC si ay u helaan xuquuqda ay ku codeeyaan doorashada.
Dholuo: Joma tindo duto ma osechopo higni apar gi aboro (18) ikwayo mondo ondiki nyinggi kaka jogo ma dhi goyo ombulu e senta mag IEBC mondo giyud ratiro mar goyo ombulu e yiero.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to adopt climate smart water and soil management practices to enhance agricultural resilience against climate change impacts
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wamehimizwa kufuata kanuni za udhibiti wa hali ya hewa ya maji na udongo ili kuimarisha ustahimilivu wa kilimo dhidi ya athari za mabadiliko ya tabianchi.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay qaataan hababyo ku saabsan maaraynta biyaha iyo ciidda si loo xoojiyo adkeysiga beeraha ee ka dhanka ah saameynta isbeddelka cimilada

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Tana River County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on community-based development programmes.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Tana River kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa wilaya ili kuwa na habari juu ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay ka qeybgalaan kalfadhiga guud ee golaha gobolka si ay uga warqabaan barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo ji duto modak e taon mar Tana River County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi chenro mag dongruok mag oganda.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds parents in Trans Nzoia County that free day secondary education registration is open this December.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba usajili wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo umefunguliwa Desemba hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu xasuusinayaa waalidiinta degmada Trans Nzoia in diiwaangelinta dugsiga dhexe ee bilaashka ah ay furan tahay bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne jonyuol e Trans Nzoia County ni somo mar sekondari mar odiechieng' maonge chudo ochakore e dwe mar Desemba.
