English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges residents of Makueni County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyadoo la xoojinayo amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo jogweng' Makueni County mondo oriwgi lwedo e nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'enyie nikech sirkal medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom weche mag rito tong'.

English: KEMRI encourages mothers in Narok County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Narok kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Narok inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo mine manie Narok County mondo olim kama gibiro nyuolie machiegni kodgi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: IsraAID completes NuWASH program in Kenya
Kiswahili: IsraAID inakamilisha mpango wa NuWASH nchini Kenya
Somali: IsraAID waxay Kenya ku soo gabagabaysay barnaamijka NuWASH
Dholuo: IsraAID otieko chenro mar NuWASH e piny Kenya

English: KALRO warns wheat farmers in Wajir County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaonya wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuhusu maambukizi ya wadudu na kupendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: KALRO waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda wheat ee Gobolka Wajir cudurrada cayayaanka ah waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyin waqtigeeda ah.
Dholuo: KALRO chiwo siem ne jopur mag ngano e gweng ' mar Wajir e wi masiche ma nyalo kelo tuoche, kendo ojiwo ni otim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: TSC announces distribution of revision guides to schools in Bomet County this July.
Kiswahili: TSC inatangaza usambazaji wa miongozo ya marekebisho kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Bomet Julai hii.
Somali: TSC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta hagaha dib u eegista dugsiyada degmada Bomet bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: TSC olando ni gibiro pogo buge malero weche manyien e skunde man Bomet County e dwe mar Julai.

English: KRA invites residents of Turkana County to attend the public participation forum regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: KRA inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Turkana kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: KRA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: KRA gwelo ji duto modak e County mar Turkana mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: Notice: TSC opens a new electrical installation programme at the vocational centre in Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC inafungua programu mpya ya ufungaji wa umeme katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo lagu rakibo korontada xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar TSC chako chenro manyien mar keto sitima e kambi mar tich e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit calls on parents in Kirinyaga County to have children under five screened for cholera during the August outreach.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuwapima watoto chini ya miaka mitano kipindupindu wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Agosti.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Kirinyaga in carruurta ka yar shan sano la sameeyo baaritaanka cudurka kolera inta lagu gudajiro bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit okwayo jonyuol e County mar Kirinyaga mondo otim nonro mar cholera ne nyithindo ma hikgi tin ne abich e dwe mar Agost.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the community in Turkana County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb carjacking.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua ili kuzuia utekaji nyara wa gari.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Turkana inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha si loo xakameeyo afduubka gawaarida.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto e county mar Turkana mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo kik gikwed kwalo mtokni.

English: Notice from Kenya Medical Association: childhood immunization clinics will run every August at designated health centres in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya: kliniki za chanjo za watoto zitafanya kazi kila Agosti katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya: rugta tallaalka carruurta ayaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Agoosto oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee lagu magacaabo degmada Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association: klinik mag thieth mar nyithindo biro tiyo dwe mar Agost higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Nyandarua.

English: Kenya confirms 12 more COVID-19 cases bringing total number to 246. Health CS Mutahi Kagwe says 5 of them are hotel workers.
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha visa 12 zaidi vya COVID-19 na kufanya jumla ya idadi kufikia 246. Waziri wa Afya Mutahi Kagwe anasema 5 kati yao ni wafanyakazi wa hoteli.
Somali: Kenya ayaa xaqiijisay 12 kiis oo kale oo COVID-19 ah, taasoo wadarta tirada ay gaartay 246. CS Caafimaadka Mutahi Kagwe ayaa sheegay in 5 ka mid ah ay yihiin shaqaale hoteel ah.
Dholuo: Kenya osenyiso ni nitie ji 12 mamoko ma nigi tuo mar COVID-19 kendo kwan mar jogo osedok 246. Jatend weche thieth miluongo ni Mutahi Kagwe wacho ni ji 5 kuomgi gin joma tiyo e otel.

English: As part of Zambia's national drought response, farming households in affected areas are being provided with seeds and planting materials for early-maturing, drought-resistant crops (including vegetables, maize, mixed beans, and cowpeas), and encouraged to diversify crops to reduce reliance on staples and improve dietary diversity.
Kiswahili: Kama sehemu ya mwitikio wa ukame wa kitaifa wa Zambia, kaya za wakulima katika maeneo yaliyoathiriwa zinapewa mbegu na vifaa vya kupanda kwa mazao yanayokomaa mapema, yanayostahimili ukame (pamoja na mboga, mahindi, maharagwe mchanganyiko, na mbaazi), na kuhimizwa kubadilisha mazao ili kupunguza utegemezi wa chakula kikuu na kuboresha utofauti wa lishe.
Somali: Qayb ka mid ah jawaabta abaaraha qaran ee Zambia, qoysaska beeralayda ee meelaha ay saameysay waxaa la siiyaa abuur iyo agab beereed si ay u helaan dalagyada hore ee u adkeysan abaaraha (oo ay ku jiraan khudradda, galleyda, digirta isku dhafan, iyo digirta), waxaana lagu dhiirrigelinayaa in la kala duwanaado dalagyada si loo yareeyo ku tiirsanaanta cuntooyinka muhiimka ah loona hagaajiyo kala duwanaanshaha cunto.
Dholuo: E bwo chandruok mar oro mar piny Zambia, ji mang'eny ma pidho puothe e alwora ma ohinyore yudoga kodhi kod gik ma ginyalo pidho mondo giti gi cham ma ok nyal chwoyo piyo (moriwo gi alot, kod cham, kod cham ma ok nyal chwoyo), kendo ijiwo ji mondo oti gi le mopogore opogore mondo omi giduok chien kaka gik ma gipidho e chiemo kendo gimed bedo gi chiemo mopogore opogore.

English: NTSA reminds mobile money users in Embu County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid identity theft.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Embu wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Embu inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna si looga fogaado in la xado aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: NTSA paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e county mar Embu ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo kik gikwed kwalo kitgi.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds residents of Kwale County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kwale in ilaalinta ciidda ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jogweng' mar Kwale County ni rito lowo miyo puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: Notice: NTSA opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inafungua dawati la jinsia kutoa simu ya msaada ya GBV bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ee gobolka Mombasa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NTSA ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo chenro mar tiyo gi simo maonge chudo mar GBV e county mar Mombasa.

English: West Pokot: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2022
Kiswahili: Pokot Magharibi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2022
Somali: Galbeedka Pokot: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2022
Dholuo: Pokot ma milambo: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar adek higa mar 2022

English: KEPHIS urges sorghum growers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda sorghum ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka xilliga dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur mag sorghum e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e kinde mag koth koth ka gitiyo gi tuoche maloso yiendgi.

English: This wealth helps legislators, researchers and executors on matters cimate Ã§hange at national, regional and village level.
Kiswahili: Utajiri huu husaidia wabunge, watafiti na watekelezaji katika masuala yanayohusiana na maendeleo ya kitaifa, ya kikanda na ya kijiji.
Somali: Hantidan waxay ka caawisaa sharci-dejiyeyaasha, cilmi-baarayaasha iyo fuliyayaasha arrimaha khuseeya heer qaran, heer gobol iyo heer tuulo.
Dholuo: Oganda ma kamago konyo jotelo mag piny, jotim nonro kod jotend chik e wi weche ma nyalo kelo lokruok e rang’iny mar piny, mar ng’om kod mar gwenge.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds residents of Bungoma County that terracing improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba usafirishaji wa wadudu unaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: Guddiga xakamaynta cayayaanka ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Bungoma in dhulka lagu beerayo uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: Bura mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jogweng' Bungoma County ni loso puothe mag lowo kelo nyak e puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: IEBC advises students in Mandera County to register early to secure allocation to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Mandera kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali.
Somali: IEBC waxay ardayda Degmada Mandera kula talineysaa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan waqti hore si ay u helaan kaalmo ay ku helaan kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jopuonjre man Mandera County mondo odonj e tiegruok chon mondo giyud pesa mar tiyo gi kompyuta mag skul e bwo chenro mar somo gi somo mar digital.

English: Stressed about money? Don't gamble with your mental health! When finances feel overwhelming, it's tempting to chase "quick fixes" like gambling or substance useâ€”but these only make things worse. Instead, take control by seeking free financial counseling and building healthy money habits. Your mental health matters. Choose smart solutions over short-term risks.
Kiswahili: Una msongo wa mawazo kuhusu pesa? Usicheze kamari na afya yako ya akili! Wakati fedha zinapozidi, inakuvutia kutafuta "suluhisho la haraka" kama vile kamari au matumizi ya dawa za kulevya - lakini hizi hufanya mambo kuwa mabaya zaidi. Badala yake, chukua udhibiti kwa kutafuta ushauri wa kifedha bila malipo na kujenga tabia nzuri za pesa. Afya yako ya akili ni muhimu. Chagua suluhisho bora badala ya hatari za muda mfupi.
Somali: Ma ka walwalsan tahay lacagta? Ha ku khamaarin caafimaadkaaga maskaxda! Marka dhaqaaluhu dareemo culeys, waa wax lagu farxo inaad raadiso "hagaajin degdeg ah" sida khamaarka ama isticmaalka maandooriyaha - laakiin kuwani waxay ka sii darayaan oo keliya. Taa beddelkeeda, la wareeg xakamaynta adigoo raadinaya la-talin dhaqaale oo bilaash ah oo dhisa caadooyin lacag caafimaad leh. Caafimaadkaaga maskaxeed waa muhiim. Dooro xalal caqli badan halkii aad ka dooran lahayd khataraha muddada-gaaban.
Dholuo: Be in gi parruok kuom pesa? Okidwar ng’ado bura gi ngimani mar paro! Ka pesa winjo ni opong' ahinya, en gima kelo gombo mar luwo "yore mapiyo" kaka tugo mar pesa kata tiyo kod yath ma mero ji - to gigo mana medo rach. Mopogore, kawo loch kuom manyo rieko mar pesa ma nono kendo loso kido mabeyo mag pesa. Ngima mari mar paro en gima duong'. Yier yore mariek mag duoko pek mag kinde machuok.

English: Kenya Dairy Board announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Kwale County this June.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya yatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kwale Juni hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhawaaqay jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan qabyaalada lo'da caanaha ee Gobolka Kwale bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board olando chenro mar thiedho dhok makwayo dhok e dwe mar Jun e kaunti mar Kwale.

English: Huduma Kenya warns public officers in Homa Bay County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay dhidi ya kupotosha fedha za umma.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee gobolka Homa Bay in ay ka faa'iideystaan dhaqaale dawladeed.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e Homa Bay County ni kik giti gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo e yo marach.

English: Isiolo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for November 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Isiolo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Novemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Isiolo: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Noofambar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Isiolo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar gi achiel dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2022

English: Notice: COMESA will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Meru County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi diiwaan-gelin ah oo loogu talagalay beeraleyda degmada Meru bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: COMESA biro timo rapar mar jopur e dwe mar April e kaunti mar Meru.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Kajiado County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the April planting season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inashauri wakulima katika Kajiado County kudhibiti Armyworm mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizopendekezwa kabla ya msimu wa kupanda Aprili.
Somali: Maamulka Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Kajiado inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka ciidanka ee dayrta iyagoo isticmaalaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e Kajiado County mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma oseyudo ratiro mar chango jolweny e dwe mar April.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges parents and teachers in Siaya County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa usimamizi wa shule.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Siaya inay u soo sheegaan maamulka dugsiga wixii arrimo ah oo ku saabsan amniga.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e county mar Siaya mondo onyis jotelo mag skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok.

English: NDMA urges residents of Homa Bay County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika kumbi za umma huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji ng'enyie nikech ji medo keto pachgi kuom chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: Pest Control Products Board warns rice farmers in Embu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawaonya wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Embu juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa uga digaya beeraleyda bariiska ee degmada Embu cudurrada cayayaanta waxayna kugula talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products chiwo siem ne jopur ma loso loso loso kodhi e county mar Embu kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ochiwo paro mar kawo okang' e kinde mowinjore.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties urges residents of Vihiga County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Vihiga mondo oriwgi e loso chenro mag dongruok kokalo kuom websait mar county.

English: Waiting a minute before clamping the cord improves babyÂ’s iron levels and immunity.
Kiswahili: Kusubiri dakika moja kabla ya kubana kitovu huboresha viwango vya chuma na kinga ya mtoto.
Somali: Sugitaanka daqiiqad ka hor inta aan la xidhin xadhiggu waxay wanaajisaa heerarka birta iyo difaaca jirka ee ilmaha.
Dholuo: Ka irito dakika achiel kapok iketo ng’ut ng’ato, mano miyo nyathi bedo gi iron kendo bedo gi teko mar geng’o tuoche.

English: Kenyan coffee farmers are encouraged to participate in the Coffee Revitalization Program to benefit from reforms and support aimed at increasing production and exports
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa kahawa nchini Kenya wamehimizwa kushiriki katika Mpango wa Kufufua Kahawa ili kufaidika na mageuzi na usaidizi unaolenga kuongeza uzalishaji na mauzo ya nje.
Somali: Beeraleyda kafeega Kenya waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay ka qayb qaataan Barnaamijka Dib-u-soo-nooleynta Kafeega si ay uga faa'iidaystaan dib-u-habeyn iyo taageero lagu kordhinayo wax-soo-saarka iyo dhoofinta
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma loso chai e piny Kenya ijiwo mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar loso kendo loso chai mondo giyud kony mar medo loso kod oro olembe

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations launches a fraud prevention campaign in Migori County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Migori Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa bilaabay olole ka hortagga khiyaamooyinka degmada Migori bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche mag ketho chik ochako kampen mar geng'o mibadhi e kaunti mar Migori e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds residents of Tharaka-Nithi County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi wanaohudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti kuimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi ee ka qeybgalaya kalfadhiga guud ee shirka degmada ayaa xoojinaya maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General parone jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County ma biro e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the October planting season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Wanyama inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kufanya mazoezi ya kugeuza mazao ili kurejesha uzazi wa udongo kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Oktoba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda ka hor xilliga beerashada ee Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development nyiso jopur e County mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni gitim lokruok e puothe mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber kapok ochopo dwe mar Oktoba.

English: SHA urges eligible citizens in Nyandarua County to participate in polling procedures.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawahimiza raia wanaostahiki katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kushiriki katika utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Nyandarua inay ka qaybqaataan nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro mar donjo e chokruok mar Nyandarua County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag yiero.

English: Support fodder conservation and pasture regeneration, and provide targeted feed supplementation in drought hotspot areas.
Kiswahili: Kuunga mkono uhifadhi wa malisho na urejesho wa malisho, na kutoa nyongeza ya malisho kwa lengo katika maeneo ya joto ya ukame.
Somali: Taageer ilaalinta xoolaha iyo dib-u-soo-nooleynta daaqyada, iyo bixinta taageerada quudinta ee bartilmaameedsan meelaha abaaraha.
Dholuo: Jiwo rito le kod yiende mag kwath, kendo miyogi chiemb chuny mochanore e kuonde ma kech nitie.

English: Walk by to raise awareness on Cancer by Gertrudes: this walk will help in collecting funds in a bid to help children suffring fron cancer. Many of them have come out in support of this walk
Kiswahili: Kutembea ili kuongeza ufahamu juu ya Saratani na Gertrudes: kutembea hii itasaidia katika kukusanya fedha katika jitihada za kusaidia watoto wanaougua kansa.
Somali: Socdaal si loo kordhiyo wacyiga ku saabsan Kansarka by Gertrudes: socodkani wuxuu gacan ka geysan doonaa ururinta lacagaha si loo caawiyo carruurta qaba kansarka. Qaar badan oo ka mid ah ayaa soo baxay si ay u taageeraan socodkan
Dholuo: Wuoth mondo ji ong'e wach kansa gi Gertrudes: wuothni biro konyo e choko pesa mondo okony nyithindo ma nigi kansa.

English: Notice: NPS issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa utambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay soo saartaa digniin amniga internetka ah oo ku saabsan xadaysiga aqoonsiga ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NPS ogolo siem mar rito weche mag sirkal kuom wach kuo mar ng'ato ma en ng'at modak e gweng' mar Kericho.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya umetoa onyo la usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Kilifi.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Red Cross ogolo siem e wi weche mag cybersecurity e wi chenro mag gwelo pesa mag miriambo makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e gweng' mar Kilifi.

English: KTDA advises farmers in Mombasa County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Mombasa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan kalfadhiga tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e county mar Mombasa mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e tiego jopur mabiro.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Elgeyo-Marakwet County about the importance of hypertension awareness for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuhusu umuhimu wa ufahamu wa shinikizo la damu kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMSA waxay dadweynaha degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay wacyiga cadaadiska sare ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone ji duto e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet kuom ber mar miyo ji ong'e ni tuwo mar hypertension en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Working mothers can express and store breast milk to ensure continued breastfeeding support while away.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wanaofanya kazi wanaweza kukamua na kuhifadhi maziwa ya mama ili kuhakikisha unyonyeshaji unaoendelea wakiwa mbali.
Somali: Hooyooyinka shaqada ka shaqeeya waxay soo bandhigi karaan caanaha hooyada waxayna kaydin karaan si loo hubiyo in ay sii wadaan taageerada naasnuujinta inta ay maqnaadaan.
Dholuo: Minwa matiyo nyalo nyiso kendo kano chak mar min mare mondo omi odhi nyime miyogi chak ka gin mabor.

English: Notice: KICD launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Meru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha katika shule kote Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay bilawday barnaamij hagitaan iyo adeegyo la-talin ah oo lagu sameeyo dugsiyada gobolka Meru.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KICD chako chenro mar tayo kendo chiwo paro e skunde duto e County mar Meru.

English: KEPHIS promotes terracing among farmers in Kakamega County as part of the November climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inakuza ustahimilivu kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Novemba.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay dhiirrigelisay dhulka beeraleyda ee Gobolka Kakamega iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee bisha Nofeembar.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo puodho e kind jopur e Kaunti mar Kakamega kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response launches an October awareness campaign on tobacco control across Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Oktoba juu ya udhibiti wa tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Oktoobar ee ka dhanka ah xakamaynta sigaarka ee gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Oktoba e wi thieth mar ndawa e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu.

English: CDC launches a campaign promoting hand hygiene to prevent disease spread.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya kuhimiza usafi wa mikono ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa.
Somali: CDC waxay bilowday olole lagu dhiirigelinayo nadaafadda gacmaha si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada.
Dholuo: CDC ochako kampen mar jiwo ler mar lwedo mondo ogeng’ lalruok mar tuoche.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens a new service point for passport services in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu furayaa goob adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee Gobolka Nandi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties oyawo kama tiyo gi passport e county mar Nandi.

English: FAO urges farmers in Vihiga County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: FAO inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Vihiga inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddelka qaabka roobabka.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e county mar Vihiga mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e weche mag pur mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok mar koth.

Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Siaya Januari hii.

Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kamp mar thieth ma Kenya Red Cross ochano ibiro tim e taon mar Siaya e dwe mar Januar.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Turkana County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this drought season.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa ukame.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada fatahaada ah xilligan abaarta.
Dholuo: NTSA oparo ne jogweng' Turkana County ni kik giwuoth e kind yiengni mag pi kod nderni ma pi opong'o.

English: DCI urges motorists and pedestrians in Baringo County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DCI inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Baringo inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada ay fatahan yihiin si looga hortago dhacdooyinka abaarta la xiriira.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo joidh mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Baringo mondo kik ging'ad ponde kod aoche ma pi opong'o mondo kik gitim gik makelo kech.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) advises residents of Nyeri County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuthibitisha kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay xaqiijiyaan in xaruntooda la aqoonsaday ka hor inta aysan booqan si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) nyiso jogweng' Nyeri County mondo ong'e ni kuondegi mag thieth oseyudo ratiro kapok gilimo kuondego mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Gov't orders Mama Mbogas to stop chopping vegetables for customers over COVID-19 fears
Kiswahili: Serikali yamwagiza Mama Mbogas kuacha kukata mboga kwa ajili ya wateja wake kutokana na hofu ya COVID-19
Somali: Dowladdu waxay Mama Mbogas ku amartay inay joojiso jarista khudaarta macaamiisha cabsi laga qabo COVID-19 awgeed
Dholuo: Sirkal ogolo chik ne Mama Mbogas mondo ogeng' ng'ado alode ne jonyiewo nikech luoro mar COVID-19

English: The second part of the paper surveys institutional and policy options available to promote the transition to climateÃ¢â‚¬Âsmart agriculture at the smallholder level.
Kiswahili: Sehemu ya pili ya karatasi inachunguza chaguzi za kitaasisi na sera zinazopatikana ili kukuza mpito kuelekea kilimo kinachozingatia mabadiliko ya tabianchi katika ngazi ya wakulima wadogo.
Somali: Qaybta labaad ee warqadda waxay sahaminaysaa fursadaha hay'adaha iyo siyaasadda ee la heli karo si kor loogu qaado u gudubka beeraha caqliga leh ee cimilada ee heerka beeralayda yaryar.
Dholuo: Okang’ mar ariyo mar oboke no ng’iyo yore mag riwruok kod chike ma nitie mar keto lokruok e pur ma rito piny e rang’iny mar jopur matindo.

English: Baringo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Baringo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2022
Somali: Degmada Baringo: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Baringo: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2022

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages mothers in Bungoma County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuhudhuria siku iliyopangwa ya kliniki ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Bungoma inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta bukaanka ee la qorsheeyay si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo mine manie County mar Bungoma mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar thieth mar rito ngima nyithindgi.

English: SHA reminds voters in Kitui County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: SHA inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Kitui inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor inta aysan helin waxbarashada codbixinta.
Dholuo: SHA parone jogweng'o mag Kitui County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom SMS ne ji 70000 kapok giyudo tiegruok.

English: Counties will start food distribution of good quality and by reaching twelf thousand children within in the next six months and fifty nine through vitamin A supliments and deworming tablets purposed to strengthen children's immunity through quality food.
Kiswahili: Kaunti zitaanza kusambaza vyakula vyenye ubora mzuri na kwa kufikia watoto elfu kumi na mbili ndani ya miezi sita ijayo na 59 kupitia virutubisho vya vitamini A na vidonge vya kuondoa wadudu vinavyokusudiwa kuimarisha kinga ya watoto kupitia vyakula vya ubora.
Somali: Degmooyinku waxay bilaabi doonaan qaybinta cuntooyinka tayada wanaagsan leh waxayna gaadhi doonaan laba iyo toban kun oo caruur ah lix bilood ee soo socota iyo 59 iyada oo loo marayo kaabisyada fiitamiin A iyo kiniiniyada cayayaanka ee loogu talagalay in lagu xoojiyo ka hortagga carruurta iyada oo la adeegsanayo cuntooyin tayo leh.
Dholuo: Alwora biro chako pogo chiemo ma nigi ber kendo biro chopo ne nyithindo 12,000 e dweche auchiel mabiro kod 59 kokalo kuom chiemo mar vitamin A kod tablet mag thieth ma konyo nyithindo mondo obed gi teko mar geng'o tuoche kokalo kuom chiemo mabeyo.

English: Notice: KEMSA confirms a typhoid outbreak alert for Nandi County. Residents are advised to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa matumbo kwa Kaunti ya Nandi. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMSA waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka 'typhoid' ee gobolka Nandi. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isticmaalaan shabaqa cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Rapar: KEMSA osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuwo mar typhoid e county mar Nandi.

English: Kenya â€“ Mobility Tracking Turkana, Garissa, Marsabit and Isiolo Round #3 (May 2024)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Ufuatiliaji wa Uhamaji Turkana, Garissa, Marsabit na Isiolo Awamu ya #3 (Mei 2024)
Somali: Kenya â€“ Raadinta Dhaqdhaqaaqa Turkana, Garissa, Marsabit iyo Isiolo Wareega #3 (Maajo 2024)
Dholuo: Kenya - Luwo Wuoth Turkana, Garisa, Marsabit kod Isiolo Raun mar adek (Mei 2024)

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges residents of Siaya County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Uhalifu unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee deegaanka iyada oo la sii xoojinayo amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Siaya mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano ka ji medo keto pachgi kuom rito tong'.

English: Safaricom Chief Executive Officer, Mr. Peter Ndegwa today paid a courtesy call on the Cabinet Secretary for Health, Hon. Mutahi Kagwe and explored areas of partnership in regard to COVID-19. @SafaricomPLC is currently hosting the COVID-19 call centre. #KomeshaCorona Update.
Kiswahili: Afisa Mkuu Mtendaji wa Safaricom, Bw. Peter Ndegwa leo amemtembelea Katibu wa Baraza la Mawaziri wa Afya, Mhe. Mutahi Kagwe na kuchunguza maeneo ya ushirikiano kuhusu COVID-19. @SafaricomPLC kwa sasa ni mwenyeji wa kituo cha simu cha COVID-19. #KomeshaCorona Update.
Somali: Madaxa Fulinta ee Safaricom, Mudane Peter Ndegwa ayaa maanta booqasho sharafeed ku tagay Xoghayaha Golaha Wasiirada Caafimaadka, Mudane Mutahi Kagwe, wuxuuna sahmiyay meelaha iskaashiga la leh COVID-19. @SafaricomPLC waxay hadda martigelineysaa xarunta wicitaanka ee COVID-19. #KomeshaCorona Update.
Dholuo: Jatend Safaricom, Mr. Mutahi Kagwe kendo nonono kuonde mag riwruok ewi COVID-19. @SafaricomPLC sani orwako kar goyo simu mar COVID-19. #KomeshaKorona Update.

English: Tana River County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tana River: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2023
Somali: Degmada Tana River: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Aora Tana: Oboke mar Chik Motelo kuom Oro mar Adek 2023

English: Universities Fund urges residents of Kisumu County to register their children at the nearest public school to benefit from school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu ili kufaidika na mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha si ay uga faa'iideystaan barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: University Fund jiwo jogweng' mar Kisumu County mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud konyruok kuom chenro mar chiemo e skul.

English: Lamu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Lamu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2024
Somali: Degmada Lamu: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Lamu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2024

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for poultry in Taita-Taveta County this October.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa kuku katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta Oktoba hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) ayaa ku dhawaaqday jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee digaagga ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) olando chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar dhoot kod dhoot ne dhok e Taita-Taveta County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: HELB announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in Isiolo County this February.
Kiswahili: HELB inatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Februari hii.
Somali: HELB waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta deeqaha waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan dugsiyada degmada Isiolo bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: HELB ogolo chiwo mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre man gi chan e skunde man Isiolo County e dwe mar Februar.

English: SMI indicators align with the Inter-Agency Standing Committee's (IASC) Framework for Durable Solutions and integrates data from IOM's Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM) to ensure a comprehensive, evidence-based approach.
Kiswahili: Viashiria vya SMI vinapatana na Mfumo wa Kamati ya Kudumu ya Wakala wa Kimataifa (IASC) kwa Suluhisho la Kudumu na kuunganisha data kutoka kwa Mfumo wa Ufuatiliaji wa Uhamisho wa IOM (DTM) ili kuhakikisha mbinu ya kina, inayotegemea ushahidi.
Somali: Tilmaamayaasha SMI waxay la jaan qaadayaan Qaab-dhismeedka Guddiga Joogtada ah ee Hay'adaha Isku-dhafka ah (IASC) ee Xallinta Waarta waxayna isku daraan xogta laga helay Matrix-ka Raad-raaca Barakaca (DTM) ee IOM si loo hubiyo hab dhammaystiran oo ku salaysan caddayn.
Dholuo: Gik ma nyiso SMI luwore gi chenro mar Komiti ma ochung’ motegno (IASC) mar loso gik ma nyalo tiyo kuom kinde malach kendo oting’o weche ma wuok e chenro mar IOM mar luwo jogo ma osewuok e udigi (DTM) mondo gine ni yo ma owinjore kendo ma nigi gik ma nyiso adier.

English: Huduma Kenya encourages first-time voters in Bomet County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kaunti ya Bomet kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku dhiirigelisay codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Bomet inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jogo ma ne okwongo yiero e county mar Bomet mondo olim kama ichikoe ji ne IEBC.

English: NCPB urges farmers in Migori County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Migori inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e county mar Migori mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e weche mag pur mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Samburu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Samburu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Aprili 2022
Somali: Degmada Samburu: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Samburu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar ang'wen 2022

English: Self-care is important - it directly affects your overall well-being, including physical, mental, and emotional health. Prioritizing self-care helps you manage stress, avoid burnout, and maintain a balanced life. Engaging in exercise, good sleep, healthy eating, and mindfulness boosts resilience and promotes a positive outlook
Kiswahili: Kujitunza ni muhimu - kunaathiri moja kwa moja ustawi wako kwa ujumla, ikiwa ni pamoja na afya ya kimwili, kiakili, na kihisia. Kuweka kipaumbele katika kujitunza kunakusaidia kudhibiti msongo wa mawazo, kuepuka uchovu, na kudumisha maisha yenye usawa. Kufanya mazoezi, kulala vizuri, kula vizuri, na kuzingatia huongeza ustahimilivu na kukuza mtazamo chanya.
Somali: Daryeelka naftaadu waa mid muhiim ah - wuxuu si toos ah u saameynayaa caafimaadkaaga guud, oo ay ku jiraan caafimaadka jirka, maskaxda iyo shucuurta. Daryeelinta naftaadu waxay kaa caawineysaa inaad maamusho walbahaarka, ka fogaato daalka, oo aad noolaato nolol isku dheelitiran.
Dholuo: Ritruok en gima duong' ahinya nikech okonyo ng'ato mondo kik obed gi parruok mang'eny, moriwo nyaka bedo gi ngima maber e dende, e pache, koda e paro. Keto weche motudore gi ritruok obed motelo nyalo konyi loyo parruok, geng'o riyo mar ngima, kendo bedo gi paro mowinjore.

English: Ministry of Health urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Uasin Gishu County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Uasin Gishu inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar paro e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu mondo omany jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free HIV/AIDS screening is available at all public health centres in Kisii County this May.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa VVU/UKIMWI unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kisii Mei hii.
Somali: Laanta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka HIV / AIDS ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Kisii bisha May.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji ni thieth mar HIV/AIDS maonge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Kisii e dwe mar Mei.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds voters in Lamu County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Lamu kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa xusuusinaya codbixiyayaasha degmada Lamu inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor waxbarashada codbixisayaasha.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties paronwa jotelo e County mar Lamu mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar piny mangima e odiechieng' mar timo yiero ka pok oyud tiegruok mar jotelo.

English: Taking time for yourself is not a luxury, it's a necessity. Remember to prioritize your mental, emotional, and physical health.
Kiswahili: Kuchukua muda kwa ajili yako mwenyewe si anasa, ni lazima. Kumbuka kuweka kipaumbele kwa afya yako ya kiakili, kihisia, na kimwili.
Somali: Waqtiga aad naftaada u qaadatid ma aha raaxo, laakiin waa baahi. Xusuusnow inaad mudnaanta siiso caafimaadkaaga maskaxda, shucuurta iyo jirka.
Dholuo: Kaw thuolo mar bedo kendi ok en gima ber, to en gima dwarore ahinya. Ng'e ni onego iket pachi, chunyi, kod ringri obed motelo.

English: Ministry of Education urges parents and teachers in Laikipia County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Laikipia inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Puonjruok jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Laikipia mondo omany namba mar kony mar nyithindo 116.

English: AFA warns rice farmers in Siaya County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: AFA inawaonya wakulima wa mchele katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuhusu maambukizi ya wadudu na kupendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: AFA waxay uga digtaa beeraleyda bariiska ee degmada Siaya cudurrada cayayaanka ah waxayna ku talineysaa in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: AFA chiwo siem ne jopur ma loso loso loso kodhi e County mar Siaya kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni otim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: NCPB encourages farmers in Kericho County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya mahindi.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kericho inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay hadhuudhka.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e county mar Kericho mondo ous olembe mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo mondo giyud nengo maber mar kodhi.

English: SHA announces improved turnaround times for e-Citizen registration in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujiandikisha kwa raia katika wilaya ya Vihiga.
Somali: SHA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee Degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: SHA olando lokruok e seche mag timo chenro mar e-Citizen registration e County mar Vihiga.

English: Marga Farmers Cooperative Society is recommended for deregistration due to fraudulent activities Coffee farmers in Murang a County should stay informed about potential impacts on their operations
Kiswahili: Chama cha Ushirika cha Wakulima wa Marga kinapendekezwa kufutiliwa mbali kwa sababu ya shughuli za ulaghai Wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Murang a wanapaswa kufahamishwa kuhusu athari zinazoweza kujitokeza katika shughuli zao.
Somali: Marga Farmers Cooperative Society waxaa lagu taliyay in la joojiyo diiwaangelinta sababo la xiriira hawlo khiyaano ah Beeraleyda kafeega ee Murang a County waa in ay si war leh uga warqabaan saameynta suurtagalka ah ee hawlahooda
Dholuo: Marga Farmers Cooperative Society ijiwo mondo ogol riwruok mar joma ok lam nikech timbe mag wuondruok Jo-Kafie e Murang a County onego ong'e gik manyalo mulo ngimagi

English: PRAPS project in Sahel encourages progressive livestock rearing through quality rearing and professional feeding.
Kiswahili: Mradi wa PRAPS huko Sahel unahimiza ufugaji wa mifugo unaoendelea kupitia ufugaji bora na ulishaji wa kitaalamu.
Somali: Mashruuca PRAPS ee Sahel wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa korinta xoolaha horumarsan iyada oo loo marayo korinta tayo leh iyo quudin xirfadeed.
Dholuo: Chenro mar PRAPS e piny Sahel jiwo pidho jamni e yo mosiko kokalo kuom pidho jamni e yo maber kendo pidhogi gi chiembgi e yor tich.

English: Kenya Gazette warns public officers in Siaya County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Siaya khiyaanooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Siaya kuom timbe mag mibadhi.

English: NPS reminds residents of Kilifi County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi in warbixinta degdegga ah ee xanta xoolaha ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NPS oparo ne jogweng' Kilifi County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo jamni konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Judiciary of Kenya advises residents of Wajir County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kubeba hati zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir inay qaataan dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado dib u dhac marka la raadinayo adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya nyiso jogweng' mar County mar Wajir ni giting'e buge duto madwarore mondo kik gimi ng'ato odog chien sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport.

English: Notice: IEBC opens polling procedures centres in Mombasa County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa xarumaha nidaamyada codbixinta ee gobolka Mombasa bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC chako tiyo gi chenro mar timo yiero e Mombasa County e dwe mar Agost.

English: AFA encourages farmers in Kisii County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for milk.
Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa ili kupata bei bora ya maziwa.
Somali: AFA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kisii inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo caano ah.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kisii mondo oti gi nengo matin mar chakruok mar chak mondo omi ohala obed maber.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges cassava growers in Narok County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Narok kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda cassava ee Gobolka Narok inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si loo wanaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur ma pidho manija e Narok County mondo okaw kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed kelo nyak e higani.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds residents of Kericho County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba upatikanaji wa usajili wa e-Citizen sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho in helitaanka diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya oparo ne jogweng' Kericho County ni yudo e-Citizen registration koro yot kokalo kuom yore mag tich.

English: DPP reminds residents of Samburu County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: DPP anawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Samburu in si deg deg ah u soo sheegidda tuugada ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogweng' Samburu County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo kuom nek konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: DPP reminds residents of Nyeri County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: DPP anawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri in si dhakhso leh u soo sheegaan jabsashada ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogweng' Nyeri County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar donjo e ot konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds residents of Busia County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Busia kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya wilaya inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Busia in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone jogweng' mar County mar Busia ni luwo dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Large gatherings increase theft risks. Supervise herds and coordinate with security agencies.
Kiswahili: Mikutano mikubwa huongeza hatari ya wizi, usimamizi wa makundi na ushirikiano na mashirika ya usalama.
Somali: Shirarka waaweyn waxay kordhiyaan khatarta tuugada, kormeerka xoolaha iyo isdhexgalka hay'adaha amniga.
Dholuo: Chokruoge madongo miyo ji bedo gi ratiro mar kwalo gik moko, kendo girito kwethgi, kendo gitiyo kanyachiel gi riwruoge ma rito weche mag sirkal.

English: KMTC invites youth in Garissa County to enroll for ICT skills training this October.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Garissa kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT Oktoba hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Garissa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka xirfadaha ICT bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KMTC gwelo rowere e County mar Garissa mondo odonj e tiegruok mar ICT e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: DPP warns residents of Lamu County to prepare for possible flooding this October.
Kiswahili: DPP anawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kujiandaa kwa mafuriko yanayoweza kutokea Oktoba hii.
Somali: DPP waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu inay isu diyaariyaan fatahaadaha iman kara bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: DPP osiemo jogweng' Lamu County mondo oikre ne koth maduong' mabiro timore e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: EACC urges residents of Mandera County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan bixinta adeegyada heerka degmooyinka.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Mandera mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche duto e wi tich mitimo e gwenge mopogore opogore.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya alerts residents of Nakuru County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru juu ya kuongezeka kwa visa vya wizi na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay uga digtay dadka deggan degmada Nakuru in ay kordheen kiisaska tuugada waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya maloso weche mag tudruok chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nakuru County kuom wach kwan mar joma okwalo gik moko kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot e stesen mar polise man machiegni.

English: AFA urges farmers in Murang'a County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: AFA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Murang'a inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e county mar Murang'a mondo opidh cham mondo omi piny okethre mondo omi giritre kuom lokruok mar koth.

English: DPP calls on the community in Nyeri County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: DPP inawatia moyo jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: DPP waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Nyeri inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wacayaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: DPP okwayo ji duto manie County mar Nyeri mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong simo mar GBV 1195.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education opens applications for revision guides for learners in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka waxay furaysaa codsiyada hagaha dib-u-eegista ardayda Degmada Migori.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Puonjruok ma Chakre e Piny owacho, oseyawo kwayo mag somo mondo okony jopuonjre ma Migori County.

English: IPOA reminds the public in Nyeri County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jumuiya.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nyeri inay ka feejignaadaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa ji duto e County mar Nyeri mondo gibed motang' gi chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: KUCCPS urges residents of Kisumu County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kutuma maombi ya bursari hiyo kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kufaidika na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo ji duto modak e gweng' mar Kisumu mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: DCI urges the public in Busia County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: DCI inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Busia kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha degmada Busia inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda kadib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo ji duto e County mar Busia mondo ochiw ripot ne jatendgi mar weche ma ok kare bang' ka osenyis ni nitie chenro mag miriambo mag timo ohala.

English: The Kenyan government has allocated Kshs 8 billion for maize meal subsidies to support farmers facing challenges
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya imetenga Kshs 8 bilioni kwa ajili ya ruzuku ya unga wa mahindi kusaidia wakulima wanaokabiliwa na changamoto
Somali: Dowladda Kenya ayaa u qoondeysay Kshs 8 bilyan oo loogu talagalay taageerada cuntooyinka galleyda si loo taageero beeraleyda la kulmaya caqabadaha
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya osechiwo Kshs bilion 8 e siro chiemb cham mar cham mondo okony jopur ma romo gi pek moko

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Mombasa County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Mombasa in helitaanka taageerada sheegashada NHIF/SHA ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji duto e County mar Mombasa ni kony mar kwayo kwayo mag NHIF/SHA sani yudore e kuonde moyier.

English: Kenya Forest Service warns residents of Kisii County to prepare for possible road accidents this November.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Novemba hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ka digay dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay u diyaar garoobaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha November.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service osiemo jogweng' Kisii mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Novemba.

English: IEBC urges eligible citizens in Nakuru County to participate in polling procedures.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kushiriki katika utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Nakuru inay ka qaybqaataan nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jokanyo ma nigi ratiro mar yiero e kaunti mar Nakuru mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag yiero.

English: KTDA warns sweet potatoes farmers in Nyeri County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaonya wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Nyeri juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KTDA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda baradho macaan ee degmada Nyeri cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa faragelinta waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: KTDA chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho adundo e County mar Nyeri kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: We are advising members of the public to put on masks when getting into a matatu one is advised to put on a mask. Local production of masks and PPEs has began
Kiswahili: Tunawashauri wananchi kuvaa barakoa wanapoingia kwenye matatu, mtu anashauriwa kuvaa barakoa. Uzalishaji wa barakoa na vifaa vya kujikinga umeanza.
Somali: Waxaan kula talineynaa shacabka inay xirtaan maaskaro marka ay soo galaan matatu waxaa lagula talinayaa in la xirto maaskari.
Dholuo: Wachiwo siem ne ji mondo orwak mask sama gidonjo e matatu.

English: Notice: Universities Fund reminds citizens in Nyeri County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu muwaadiniinta degmada Nyeri xusuusinayaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa raia mag Nyeri County e wi ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo gi ji duto e bajet mar county.

English:
This are the first steps to keeping your family safe from Covid 19;
1.Wash your hands regularly with soap & running water
2. Cover your mouth and nose with a flexed elbow or tissue, when coughing or sneezing.
3.Avoid close contact with anyone who has cold or flu-like symptoms
Kiswahili:
Hizi ni hatua za kwanza za kulinda familia yako kutokana na Covid 19;
1. Osha mikono yako mara kwa mara kwa sabuni na maji yanayotiririka
2. Funika mdomo na pua yako kwa kiwiko au tishu iliyokunjwa, unapokohoa au kupiga chafya.
3. Epuka kugusana kwa karibu na mtu yeyote ambaye ana dalili za mafua au mafua.
Somali: Kuwani waa tallaabooyinka ugu horreeya si qoyskaaga looga ilaaliyo COVID 19; 1. Gacmaha si joogto ah ugu maydho saabuun iyo biyo socdo 2. Afka iyo sanka ku daboolo lafdhabarta la jiifay ama dhar, marka aad suuxdo ama qaniineyso. 3. Ka fogow xiriir dhow qof kasta oo qaba calaamadaha qabowga ama hargabka
Dholuo: Magi e okenge mokwongo mar rito joodi kuom tuo mar Covid 19; 1.Lwok lweti kinde ka kinde gi sabun kod pi ma ringo 2.Lok dhogi kod wang'i gi lwete moting'o lwete kata lewni, sama ichho kata ng'ich. 3.Kwed tudruok machiegni gi ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi tuwono kata tuoche machalo gi tuwo mar apaka

English: FAO urges farmers in Kisumu County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: FAO inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kisumu inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo lagu soo ururiyo biyaha beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kisumu mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok e kaka koth chue.

English: Farmers are urged to prioritize safe agrochemical usage as Kenya hosts the World Farmers Organisation General Assembly
Kiswahili: Wakulima wamehimizwa kuweka kipaumbele kwa matumizi salama ya kemikali za kilimo huku Kenya ikiwa mwenyeji wa Mkutano Mkuu wa Shirika la Wakulima Ulimwenguni
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyay inay mudnaanta siiyaan isticmaalka ammaan ah ee kiimikada beeraha maadaama Kenya ay martigelisay Golaha Guud ee World Farmers Organisation
Dholuo: Ojiwo jopur mondo oket mokwongo tiyo gi gik ma nigi kemia e yo makare nikech Kenya ema nigi chokruok maduong' mar World Farmers Organization

English: Public notice: KEMSA will host a free diabetes screening outreach in Makueni County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMSA itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uchunguzi wa kisukari bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Makueni Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: KEMSA waxay martigelin doontaa baaritaano bukaan-socodka oo bilaash ah oo lagu ogaanayo cudurka macaanka ee degmada Makueni bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMSA biro timo kampen mar nono thieth mar thieth ma thiedhruok kelo e provins mar Makueni e dwe mar ang'wen e higani.

English: Kenya Dairy Board warns millet farmers in Siaya County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda cawska ee degmada Siaya cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka wuxuuna kugula talinayaa faragelinta waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board chiwo siem ne jopur mag millet e county mar Siaya kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in West Pokot County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the July planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kudhibiti wizi wa jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa za kuua wadudu zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Julai.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda ku nool Gobolka West Pokot in ay ka hortagaan ciidamada ciidanka xilliga dayrta iyagoo isticmaalaya cayayaanka la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka July.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur manie West Pokot County mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma nigi ratiro mar chango jolweny e dwe mar Julai.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development invites farmers in Meru County to a free training on modern irrigation techniques this April.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji Aprili hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku casuumaysaa beeraleyda degmada Meru inay tababar lacag la'aan ah ku helaan farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ogwelo jopur e county mar Meru e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi yore mag lero pi e dwe mar April.

English: IEBC advises applicants in Turkana County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Turkana kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Turkana inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee la heli karo.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Turkana mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges the community in Tana River County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb burglary.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorrinaysaa bulshada degmada Tana River County inay ka warbixiyaan waxqabadka shakiga ah xarunta booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo oganda man Tana River County mondo onyis polis ma ni machiegni gi kanyo ni gitimo gimoro marach mondo kik jokuoge odonj e odno.

English: KTDA urges cassava growers in West Pokot County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda cassava ee Gobolka West Pokot inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalaalka ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KTDA ojiwo jopur mag cassava e West Pokot County mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: DPP urges the public in West Pokot County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: DPP inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: DPP waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadweynaha gobolka West Pokot inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo ji duto e West Pokot County mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma ne oland kuom weche mag phishing.

English: Notice: Universities Fund reminds citizens in Nyeri County about their rights regarding devolution.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Jaamacadaha waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Nyeri ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan wareejinta.

Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Migori.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya launches the county integrated development plan in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika Wilaya ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu bilaabay qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Nairobi.

English: NDMA calls on the community in Mandera County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatia moyo jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: NDMA waxay bulshada degmada Mandera ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
