English: Kenya: Drought - County with Sub-County Boundaries (14 Apr 2023)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Ukame - Kaunti yenye Mipaka ya Kaunti Ndogo (14 Apr 2023)
Somali: Kenya: Abaar - Gobol leh Xuduudo Hoosaad (14 Abriil 2023)
Dholuo: Kenya: Oro - Kaunti ma nigi mipaka mag kaunti matindo (14 dwe mar Ang'wen 2023)

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) warns coffee farmers in Uasin Gishu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaonya wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay uga digtay beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Uasin Gishu cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna kugula talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) chiwo siem ne jopur ma loso chai e county mar Uasin Gishu kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ochiwo paro mar kawo okang' mapiyo.

English: Notice: KUCCPS launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Narok County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay bilawday barnaamij lagu darayo ardayda naafada ah dugsiyada gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KUCCPS chako chenro mar tiego nyithindo ma nigi midekre e skunde duto mag Narok County.

English: Meeting with UASU and KUSU leadership.
Kiswahili: Mkutano na viongozi wa UASU na KUSU.
Somali: Kulan la yeeshay hoggaanka UASU iyo KUSU.
Dholuo: Chokruok gi jotelo mag UASU kod KUSU.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit announces free medical camps for residents of Kitui County starting this December.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinatangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kuanzia Desemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa ku dhawaaqday xeryo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Kitui laga bilaabo bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ogolo kambi mag thieth ma onge chudo ne jogweng' Kitui County kochakore e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Mobile health services in Kenya reduce the risk of stillbirths
Kiswahili: Huduma za afya kwa njia ya simu nchini Kenya hupunguza hatari ya watoto kuzaliwa wakiwa wamekufa
Somali: Adeegyada caafimaadka ee moobaylka ee Kenya ayaa yareeya khatarta dhalmada meydka ah
Dholuo: Tich mag thieth ma wuotho ​​e piny Kenya dwoko piny nyalo mar nyuol nyithindo ma osetho

English: Judiciary of Kenya warns public officers in Homa Bay County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee gobolka Homa Bay khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e Homa Bay County kuom timbe mag mibadhi.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will distribute certified tea seed to farmers in Marsabit County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itasambaza mbegu za chai zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay abuuraha degmada Marsabit u qaybin doontaa abuurka shaaha ee shahaadada la siiyo bisha Nofeembar ee sannadkan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro pogo kodhi mag chai ne jopur man Marsabit County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Farmers are encouraged to consider dairy goat farming as a sustainable option for smallholder agriculture due to their low space requirements and high nutritional value of milk
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kuzingatia ufugaji wa mbuzi wa maziwa kama chaguo endelevu kwa kilimo cha wakulima wadogo kutokana na mahitaji yao ya nafasi ya chini na thamani ya juu ya lishe ya maziwa.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay tixgeliyaan beeralayda riyaha caanaha inay tahay ikhtiyaar waara oo loogu talagalay beeraha yaryar sababtoo ah baahida yar ee meel iyo qiimaha nafatada ee caanaha
Dholuo: Ojiwo jopur mondo opar ni pidho diek mag dhok kaka dhok ma nigi pi kaka nyalore e yore mag pidho dhok matindo nikech kuonde ma gidhiye nok kendo nikech chiemo ma gipidho e chak beyo.

English: KUCCPS conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in Vihiga County this April.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Aprili hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay bishii Abriil ku qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: KUCCPS timo romo mar tiego ji e wi ratiro mag chik e County mar Vihiga e dwe mar April.

English: IEBC reminds residents of Taita-Taveta County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kwamba upatikanaji wa usajili wa e-Citizen sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Taita-Taveta in helitaanka diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: IEBC oparo ne jogweng' Taita-Taveta County ni yudo e-Citizen registration koro yot kokalo kuom yore mag tich.

English: Pest Control Products Board warns sweet potatoes farmers in Makueni County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawaonya wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Makueni juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda baradho macaan ee degmada Makueni cudurrada cayayaanta waxayna kugula talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok mar Pest, chiwo siem ne jopur mag le mag makati e gweng' mar Makueni kuom masiche mag hinyruok mag masiche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Announcement that Kenya is tracking midterm progress in five food system transformation pathways ahead of UNFSS+4.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwamba Kenya inafuatilia maendeleo ya katikati ya muhula katika njia tano za mabadiliko ya mfumo wa chakula kabla ya UNFSS+4.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida in Kenya ay raadineyso horumarka dhexdhexaadka ah ee shan siyaabood oo loogu talagalay isbeddelka nidaamka cuntada ka hor UNFSS+4.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda Jehova mar Kenya ne owacho ni Kenya ne dhi timo dongruok e yore abich mag loko chenro mag chiemo e kinde ma UNFSS+4 ne dhi chakore.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges beans growers in Kericho County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Kericho kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Waxsoosaarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda gobolka Kericho inay qaataan noocyo abuurka ah oo abaarta u adkaysta si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur ma pidho keyo e County mar Kericho mondo okaw kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo okony e medo nyak mar yien e higani.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges residents of Makueni County to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers following a rise in reported meningitis cases.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya homa ya uti wa mgongo.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni in ay soo sheegaan kiisaska loo maleynayo inay u sheegaan mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaskii la soo sheegay ee meningitis.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' Makueni County mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore e weche thieth mar oganda nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuwo mar meningitis osemedore.

English: E-Citizen announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Embu County.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kushughulikia vyeti vya kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay ka shaqeynta shahaadada dhalashada ee degmada Embu.
Dholuo: E-Citizen lando lokruok e seche mag timo tij loso barua mag nyuol e county mar Embu.

English: KUCCPS encourages residents of Siaya County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay ka qaybgalaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadwaynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo jogweng' county mar Siaya mondo oriwgi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county mondo ging'e kaka ji duto biro tiyo gi bajet mag county.

English: IPOA warns residents of Laikipia County to prepare for possible drought this August.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kujiandaa kwa ukame unaowezekana Agosti hii.
Somali: IPOA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay isu diyaariyaan abaaraha iman kara bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: IPOA osiemo jogweng' Laikipia County mondo oikre ne oro ma nyalo betie e dwe mar Agost.

English: Public health advisory: Kenya Medical Association warns of increased Rift Valley Fever risk in Kitui County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa katika Kaunti ya Kitui na kushauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ka digay khatarta sii kordheysa ee Cudurka Rift Valley ee Gobolka Kitui wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar piny Kenya Medical Association chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuwo mar Rift Valley Fever e County mar Kitui kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore mar thieth.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Mombasa County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Mombasa in si deg deg ah u soo sheegidda tuugada ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne jogweng' Mombasa County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo kuom nek konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: KTDA invites farmers in Migori County to a free training on greenhouse farming this September.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo cha chafu Septemba hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Migori tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KTDA ogwelo jopur mag Migori County e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar greenhouse agriculture e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds farmers in Mombasa County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa juu ya programu inayoendelea ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa ajili ya mafunzo ya wakulima.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa beeraleyda degmada Mombasa barnaamijka tababarka beeralayda ee socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service oparo ne jopur e county mar Mombasa chenro mar tiego jopur ma sani dhi nyime.

English: Kenya Red Cross appeals to caregivers in Marsabit County to visit their nearest maternity wing as part of the April maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya watoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi Aprili.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Marsabit inay soo booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross okwayo jorit e county mar Marsabit mondo olimgi ka gin machiegni gi kama giyudoe nyithindo e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhawaaqday taariikhaha diiwaangelinta dugsiyada dugsiga sare ee Samburu County.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Education olando tarik mag somo mar sekondari ma onge chudo e skunde man Samburu County.

Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kushirikiana na New KPCU kwa uuzaji wa kusaga kahawa na huduma za ghala na pia kupata Coffee Cherry Advance Revolving Fund.

English: Notice: SHA launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Siaya County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Shirika la SHA linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Siaya Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Shirkadda SHA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa degmada Siaya bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova (SHA) chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Siaya e dwe mar Desemba.

English: EACC reminds the public in Kajiado County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this June.
Kiswahili: EACC inakumbusha umma katika Kajiado County kwamba maoni juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma ni kuwakaribisha Juni hii.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kajiado in talobixinta la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha lagu soo dhaweynayo bisha Juun.
Dholuo: EACC oparo ne ji duto e Kajiado County ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mag siasa e dwe mar Jun.

English: The Ministry of Health is planning to conduct a massive malaria vaccination drive after the WHO warned of a surge in mosquito-borne diseases due to global warming
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inapanga kufanya kampeni kubwa ya chanjo ya malaria baada ya WHO kuonya kuhusu ongezeko la magonjwa yanayoenezwa na mbu kutokana na ongezeko la joto duniani.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa qorsheyneysa inay qabato olole ballaaran oo tallaal ah oo ka dhan ah malaria ka dib markii WHO ay ka digtay kororka cudurrada lagu faafiyo cayayaanka sababo la xiriira kuleylka caalamiga ah
Dholuo: Ministry of Health ochano mar timo kampen maduong ' mar thiedho malaria bang ' ka WHO osechiwo siem kuom medruok mar tuoche makelo nikech liet mar piny

English: Smallholder tea factories elections will be held as per the timetable released by CS Munya all smallholder tea farmers are encouraged to participate
Kiswahili: Uchaguzi wa viwanda vidogo vya chai utafanyika kulingana na ratiba iliyotolewa na CS Munya wakulima wote wadogo wa chai wanahimizwa kushiriki.
Somali: Doorashooyinka warshadaha shaaha yaryar ayaa la qaban doonaa iyadoo la raacayo jadwalka ay soo saartay CS Munya, dhammaan beeraleyda yaryar ee shaaha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qayb galaan
Dholuo: Yiero mag tigo mag tigo matindo biro timore kaluwore gi chenro ma CS Munya osefwenyogo, ji duto ma pidho tigo jiwo mondo oriwre

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Isiolo County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa msaada wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow si ay uga caawiyaan helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ee lacageed.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' Isiolo County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni mondo giyud kony mar yudo kony kuom weche thieth.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kisumu County that access to post-violence medical care is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu zinapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Kisumu in helitaanka daryeelka caafimaad ee rabshadda ka dib ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e gweng' mar Kisumu ni yudo thieth ma iyudo bang' timno en gima ng'ato nyalo timo maonge chudo.

English: IEBC Urges Residents to Register as Iten Records No New Voters
Kiswahili: IEBC Yawasihi Wakazi Kujiandikisha huku Iten Akirekodi Hakuna Wapiga Kura Wapya
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan inay iska diiwaangeliyaan diiwaangelinta Iten ma jiraan codbixiyeyaal cusub
Dholuo: IEBC Ojiwo Jokanyo mag Pinje Mondo Oter Nyinge mar Iten

English: Ministry updating training module to strengthen response to malnutrition at community level.
Kiswahili: Wizara inasasisha moduli ya mafunzo ili kuimarisha mwitikio wa utapiamlo katika ngazi ya jamii.
Somali: Wasaaraddu waxay cusbooneysiineysaa qaab-dhismeedka tababarka si loo xoojiyo jawaab celinta quudinta hoose ee heer bulshada.
Dholuo: Migawo mar tiego ji mondo omed rieyo yore mag kedo gi tuoche mag chiemo e okang' malach.

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief, April 2025
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP Kenya, Aprili 2025

Somali: Saamaynta Joojinta Mareykanka ee gargaarka dibadda ay ku yeelatay barnaamijyada caalamiga ah ee AIDS-ka ee Kenya
Dholuo: Bedo gi piny Amerka ma weyo kony ma pinje ma moko chiwo ne chenro mag AIDS mag piny mangima e piny Kenya

English: Be safe from coronavirus.Washing your hands is the most important way to stop transmission. 1.Wet hands 2.Apply enough soap 3.Scrub all surfaces of the hands for 20-30 seconds. 4.Rinse thoroughly with running water 5.Dry hands with a clean cloth or single-use towel
Kiswahili: Kuwa salama kutokana na virusi vya corona. Kuosha mikono yako ndiyo njia muhimu zaidi ya kuzuia maambukizi. 1. Lowesha mikono 2. Paka sabuni ya kutosha 3. Sugua sehemu zote za mikono kwa sekunde 20-30. 4. Suuza vizuri na maji yanayotiririka 5. Kausha mikono kwa kitambaa safi au taulo ya matumizi moja
Somali: Iska ilaali cudurka Coronavirus. Gacmahaada maydhka ayaa ah habka ugu muhiimsan ee lagu joojin karo gudbinta. 1. Gacmaha qoyan 2.Sabayl ku filan ku dheji 3.Dadka oo dhan 20-30 ilbidhiqsi ku tirtir. 4. Biyaha qulqulaya si fiican u maydho 5. Gacmaha qalalan dhar nadiif ah ama tuulo hal mar loo isticmaalo
Dholuo: Bed motang' gi tuo mar Coronavirus.Lwoko lweti e yo maduong'ie moloyo mar geng'o tugo mar tuoche. 1.Lwoko lweteni. 2.Tigo sabun moromo. 3.Loso lweti duto kuom sekond 20-30. 4.Lwok lweti maber gi pi ma ringo. 5.Lwok lweteni gi lewni maler kata lewni ma itiyogo dichiel.

English: Kenyan farmers will have the opportunity to export specialty tea to China potentially up to 5 million kilos annually valued at Ksh 7 billion beginning this year
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Kenya watapata fursa ya kusafirisha chai maalum nchini China ambayo inaweza kufikia kilo milioni 5 kila mwaka yenye thamani ya Ksh 7 bilioni kuanzia mwaka huu.
Somali: Beeraleyda Kenya waxay heli doonaan fursad ay shaaha khaaska ah u dhoofiyaan Shiinaha, taasoo laga yaabo inay gaarto ilaa 5 milyan kiilo sanadkii oo qiimaheedu yahay Ksh 7 bilyan laga bilaabo sanadkan
Dholuo: Jo-Kenya ma loso chai biro yudo thuolo mar oro chai e piny China ma nyalo chopo kilo milion 5 e higa ka higa ma kwanne romo bilion 7 mag Ksh kochakore higani

English: HELB encourages residents of Nyeri County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: HELB waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabaan kaqeybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jogweng' Nyeri County mondo ong'e weche ma gin-go e wi ndiko joma oyiero mondo ging'e kaka jopiny biro tiyo gi bajet mar county.

English: Kenya Registered refugees and asylum-seekers | August 2025
Kiswahili: Kenya Wakimbizi waliosajiliwa na wanaotafuta hifadhi | Agosti 2025
Somali: Kenya Qaxootiga diiwaangashan iyo kuwa magangalyo doonka ah | Ogosto 2025
Dholuo: Kenya Ondiko nying’ jolweny kod jogo ma dwaro dak e pinyno | Agost higa mar 2025

English: [Kenya] Along the transit corridors: PWJ's intricate contribution to Kakuma and Kalobeyei Reception Centers
Kiswahili: [Kenya] Kando ya njia za kupita: Mchango tata wa PWJ katika Vituo vya Mapokezi vya Kakuma na Kalobeyei
Somali: [Kenya] Waddooyinka gaadiidka: Kaalinta adag ee PWJ ay ka geysatay Xarumaha Soo Dhaweynta Kakuma iyo Kalobeyei
Dholuo: [Kenya] E yore mag ng’ado mtoka: Kony mapek mar PWJ ne Kuonde Orwako Welo mag Kakuma kod Kalobeyei

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds expectant mothers in Nyamira County that access to free antenatal care is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma ya ujauzito bila malipo ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Nyamira in helitaanka daryeelka uurka ka hor ee bilaashka ah ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Nyamira ni thuolo mar yudo rit ma onge chudo mar nywol en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag sirkal.

English: Societal pressures and gender-based discrimination can contribute to stress and mental health challenges.
Kiswahili: Shinikizo la kijamii na ubaguzi wa kijinsia vinaweza kuchangia msongo wa mawazo na changamoto za afya ya akili.
Somali: Dhibaatooyinka bulshada iyo takoorka jinsiga ku salaysan waxay gacan ka geysan karaan stress iyo dhibaatooyinka caafimaadka dhimirka.
Dholuo: Tembe mag oganda koda buono ji nikech dichwo gi dhako nyalo miyo ng'ato obed gi parruok mang'eny koda chandruok mag paro.

English: OGP announces improved turnaround times for e-Citizen registration in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: OGP inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujiandikisha kwa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: OGP waxay ku dhawaaqday waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee Gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: OGP olando lokruok e seche mag ndiko e e-Citizen e County mar Uasin Gishu.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) restricts movement of pigs in Isiolo County due to a foot and mouth disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inazuia harakati za nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa doofaarka ee Gobolka Isiolo sababo la xiriira faafitaanka cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Lemo kod Chiemo (AFA) ogeng'o wuoth mar le e County Isiolo nikech tuoche mag dhoot.

English: Notice: DCI conducts a community briefing on community early-warning systems in Mombasa County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI inafanya mkutano wa jamii juu ya mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada oo ku saabsan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada ee degmada Mombasa bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DCI timo romo mar chiwo siem ne ji e wi chenro mag chiwo siem motelo e alwora mar Mombasa e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges anyone experiencing abuse in Uasin Gishu County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya ngono katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Uasin Gishu inuu kiisaska u soo sheegayo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the public in Garissa County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadweynaha Gobolka Garissa inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada lacagta mobilada.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ji duto e County mar Garissa mondo onyis kwayo margi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche mag wuond mag pesa mitimo gi simo.

English: Notice: TSC announces school feeding programme enrollment dates for schools in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa programu ya kulisha shule kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiyada degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TSC lando tarik mag dhi e skunde mag Kisii mondo giyud thuolo mar dhi e program mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: ODPP reminds the public in Laikipia County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Laikipia in sheegashada khiyaamooyinka iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, ammaan ah, iyo mid qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: ODPP paronwa ji duto e County mar Laikipia ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag yuto en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: Ministry of Health urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Laikipia County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Laikipia inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka maskaxeed ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pachgi e County mar Laikipia mondo oluong kony mar thieth mar pach maonge chudo.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Taita-Taveta County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Taita-Taveta in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan jabsashada ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne jogweng' Taita-Taveta County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo odno konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit confirms a typhoid outbreak alert for Wajir County. Residents are advised to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa typhoid kwa Kaunti ya Wajir. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa xaqiijisay feejignaanta cudurka tifooska ee Gobolka Wajir. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osenyiso ni masira mar typhoid osechakore e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: TVET advises students in Trans Nzoia County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Somali: TVET waxay ardayda degmada Trans Nzoia kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga deeqda waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan deeq waxbarasho oo loogu talagalay ardayda u baahan.
Dholuo: TVET nyiso jopuonjre mag Trans Nzoia County mondo oketgi e intanet mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo chiwo mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre mochando.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Laikipia County that access to SHA registration is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kwamba ufikiaji wa usajili wa SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Laikipia in helitaanka diiwaangelinta SHA hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMSA oparo ne ji duto e County mar Laikipia ni sani ginyalo yudo weche mag SHA e kuonde moketi.

English: CS Machogu advises parents to guide children in festive season.
Kiswahili: CS Machogu anashauri wazazi kuongoza watoto katika msimu wa sherehe.
Somali: CS Machogu wuxuu waalidiinta kula talinayaa inay carruurta ku hagtaan xilliyada ciidaha.
Dholuo: CS Machogu jiwo jonyuol mondo ota nyithindgi e kinde nyasi.

English: Kenya - Floods and landslides (UN OCHA, UNICEF, NOAA-CPC, Kenya Met) (ECHO Daily Flash of 06 May 2024)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Mafuriko na maporomoko ya ardhi (UN OCHA, UNICEF, NOAA-CPC, Kenya Met) (ECHO Daily Flash ya 06 Mei 2024)
Somali: Kenya - Daadad iyo dhul-go' (UN OCHA, UNICEF, NOAA-CPC, Kenya Met) (ECHO Daily Flash ee 06 Maajo 2024)
Dholuo: Kenya - Pi ma opong'o pi kod mosruok mar lowo (manyruok mar piny mangima mar piny mangima mar 06 dwe mar abich 2024)

English: Notice from KEMSA: family planning counselling clinics will run every March at designated health centres in West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa KEMSA: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Machi katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid KEMSA: rugta la talinta qorshaynta qoyska waxay ka shaqeyn doontaa Maarso kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka West Pokot.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMSA: Klinike mag chiwo paro e wi chenro mag ngima joot biro tiyo e dwe mar Mach higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e West Pokot County.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) restricts movement of goats in Elgeyo-Marakwet County due to an anthrax outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inazuia harakati za mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kutokana na mlipuko wa kimeta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa riyaha ee gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet sababtuna tahay cudur aflagaado ah.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche pur kod chiemo (AFA) ogeng'o wuoth mar diek e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet nikech tuwo mar anthrax.

English: UNICEF Kenya Humanitarian Situation Report No. 7, January - December 2022
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Hali ya Kibinadamu ya UNICEF Kenya Nambari 7, Januari - Desemba 2022
Somali: Warbixinta Xaaladda Bani'aadamnimada ee UNICEF Kenya Lambarka 7, Janaayo - Diseembar 2022

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Uasin Gishu County that access to eye and dental camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za macho na meno sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya dadweynaha degmada Uasin Gishu in helitaanka xeryaha indhaha iyo ilkaha ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji duto e county mar Uasin Gishu ni koro ginyalo dhi e kambini mag thieth mar wang' kod lakteche mag laktech.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free tuberculosis screening is available at all public health centres in Machakos County this May.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kifua kikuu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Machakos Mei hii.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya dadweynaha in baaritaanka bukaanka ee cudurka 'tuberculosis screening' ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Machakos bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association parone ji ni nonro mar thieth mar tuberculosis en nono maonge chudo e kuonde thieth duto e County ma Machakos e dwe mar Mei.

English: Ten primary schools in Nairobi have received 10 000 seedlings to support 4 K Clubs schools are expected to utilize their produce in the School Feeding Programme
Kiswahili: Shule kumi za msingi jijini Nairobi zimepokea miche 10,000 kusaidia shule za Vilabu 4 K zinazotarajiwa kutumia mazao yao katika Mpango wa Kulisha Shule
Somali: Toban dugsi oo hoose oo ku yaal Nairobi ayaa helay 10 000 geedo si ay u taageeraan 4 K Clubs dugsiyada ayaa la filayaa inay ka faa'iideystaan wax soo saarkooda Barnaamijka Quudinta Dugsiga
Dholuo: Skunde apar mag sekondari e Nairobi oseyudo kodhi 10,000 mondo okony skul 4 K Clubs

English: COMESA warns tea farmers in Nyamira County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawaonya wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: COMESA waxay uga digtay beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Nyamira cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: COMESA chiwo siem ne jopur ma loso chai e County mar Nyamira kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: State Department for Basic Education reminds schools in Wajir County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this May.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Mei hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay xusuusineysaa dugsiyada Gobolka Wajir inay xoojiyaan adeegyada hagista iyo la-talinta bisha May.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education oparo ne skunde mag Wajir County mondo omed jiwo kendo chiwo kony e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET announces bursary allocation enrollment dates for schools in Machakos County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa bursary kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Machakos.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ee dugsiyada degmada Machakos.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar State for TVET olando tarik mag somo e skunde mag Machakos County.

English: AFA warns tea farmers in Kirinyaga County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: AFA inawaonya wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: AFA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee Gobolka Kirinyaga cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna kugula talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: AFA chiwo siem ne jopur ma loso chai e County mar Kirinyaga kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: CDC reminds the public in Migori County about the importance of hypertension awareness for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Migori juu ya umuhimu wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: CDC waxay dadweynaha degmada Migori ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay wacyiga cadaadiska dhiig karka ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji duto e County mar Migori kuom ber mar bedo gi ng'eyo e wi tuwo mar hypertension e ngima joot.

English: KMTC reminds schools in Meru County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this June.
Kiswahili: KMTC inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Meru kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Juni hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Meru inay xoojiyaan adeegyada hagista iyo la-talinta bisha Juun.
Dholuo: KMTC oparo ne skunde man Meru County mondo omed jiwo kendo chiwo kony e dwe mar Jun.

Kiswahili: Kilimo kiakili kwa hali ya hewa ni mbinu mpya ya kupanga njia ya kuendeleza mifumo ya kilimo ambayo inakuza uendelevu, kuimarisha usalama wa chakula na ...

English: Notice: HELB reminds citizens in Nyeri County about their rights regarding the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhusu haki zao kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Nyeri ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: HELB paronwa raia mag Nyeri County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo ombudsman.

English: IPOA warns residents of Turkana County to prepare for possible landslides this March.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa maporomoko ya ardhi Machi hii.
Somali: IPOA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay u diyaar garoobaan dhulgariir dhici kara bishii Maarso.

English: KNEC urges youth in Wajir County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Wajir inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KNEC ojiwo rowere e gweng' mar Wajir mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok gichako timo tije mag oganda.

English: Health Ministry launching SMS alert to inform citizens when foods exceed sugar/salt/fat thresholds.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yazindua tahadhari ya SMS ili kuwafahamisha raia wakati vyakula vinazidi viwango vya sukari/chumvi/mafuta.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka oo soo saartay digniin SMS ah si loo wargeliyo muwaadiniinta marka cuntooyinka ay ka badan yihiin heerarka sonkorta / cusbada / dufanka.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth chako chiwo siem e yor SMS mondo okony raia ng'eyo ka chiemo okalo tong' mar sukari / chumbi / chamo kong'o.

English: MTRH conducts its first Stereotactic Radiosurgery on brain cancer patient
Kiswahili: MTRH yafanya upasuaji wake wa kwanza wa mionzi wa stereotactic kwa mgonjwa wa saratani ya ubongo
Somali: MTRH waxay sameysay qalliinka ugu horeeya ee loo yaqaan 'Stereotactic Radiosurgery' ee bukaanka qaba kansarka maskaxda
Dholuo: MTRH timo nonro mare mokwongo mar Stereotactic Radiosurgery kuom jatuo ma nigi kansa mar obwongo

English: Notice: Universities Fund opens a new motor vehicle mechanics programme at the vocational centre in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu wafungua programu mpya ya ufundi wa magari katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu furayaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan mashiinka gawaarida gaadiidka ee xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Yunivasiti Fund ochako program manyien mar masin mag mtokni e skul mar tich e gweng' mar Kisumu.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit launches a January awareness campaign on hand hygiene across Migori County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kizindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Januari juu ya usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Janaayo oo ku saabsan nadaafadda gacmaha ee degmada Migori.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Januar e wi ler mar lwete e kaunti duto mar Migori.

English: DPP urges motorists and pedestrians in Migori County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DPP anawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Migori kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa wadayaasha gawaarida iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Migori inay guryahooda rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa dhacdooyinka dabka la xiriira.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo joidh mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Migori mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo gitim kinda mar geng'o hinyruok mag yiengni.

English: Universities Fund urges parents and teachers in Siaya County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa usimamizi wa shule.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku boorinayaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Siaya inay u soo sheegaan mas'uuliyadda ammaanka ee dugsiga.
Dholuo: University Fund jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e county mar Siaya mondo onyis jotend skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok.

English: Notice: OGP launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Mombasa County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay bilaabaysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhanka ah gobolka Mombasa bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Rapar: OGP chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e county mar Mombasa e dwe mar Mach.

Kiswahili: Tunahimiza shule zingine na umma kufuata mkondo huo na kuhakikisha plastiki zinasindikwa ipasavyo, alisema.
Somali: Waxaan ku dhiirigelinaynaa iskuulada kale iyo dadweynaha inay ku daydaan oo ay hubiyaan in balaastikada si habboon loo warshadeeyo, ayuu yiri.
Dholuo: Wajiwo skul mamoko kod oganda mondo oluw yo ma kamano kendo one ni plastik itiyogo maber,ÃƒÂ¢ â€šÂ¬ Â nowacho ni.

English: Global partnerships enhance antiâ€‘corruption efforts through stronger enforcement and transparency.
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano wa kimataifa huimarisha juhudi za kupambana na ufisadi kupitia utekelezaji na uwazi wenye nguvu.
Somali: Iskaashiga caalamiga ah wuxuu xoojiyaa dadaallada ka dhanka ah musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo fulin xooggan iyo hufnaan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mag piny mangima medo temo mag kedo kod camu kokalo kuom keto chike matek kendo timo gik moko e yo maler.

English: KICD publishes guidelines on accessing and utilizing approved online educational resources for learners.
Kiswahili: KICD huchapisha miongozo juu ya kupata na kutumia rasilimali za elimu ya mtandaoni zilizokubaliwa kwa wanafunzi.
Somali: KICD waxay daabacdaa tilmaamo ku saabsan helitaanka iyo isticmaalka kheyraadka waxbarashada ee internetka ee la ansixiyay ee ardayda.
Dholuo: KICD goyo buge ma tayo kaka inyalo yudo kendo tiyo gi gige tiegruok mag intanet ma oseyie mondo otigo.

English: Notice: KEMRI will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Kitui County this May. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI itafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Kitui Mei hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogsoonow: KEMRI waxay qabaneysaa madasha caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada ee degmada Kitui bisha May. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMRI biro timo chokruok mar paro ne rowere e taon mar Kitui e dwe mar Mei.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya warns residents of Nyeri County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhusu ongezeko la udanganyifu wa simu za mkononi na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri kororka khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobilada waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Communications Authority chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nyeri County kuom wach medruok mar timbe mag wuondo pesa mag simo kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: Notice: OGP launches ward-level service delivery in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inazindua huduma za huduma katika wilaya ya Kajiado.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay bilowday bixinta adeegyada heerka qaybta ee degmada Kajiado.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: OGP chako chiwo kony e alwora mar Kajiado County.

English: IEBC updates residents of Bungoma County on progress of community-based development programmes this February.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma juu ya maendeleo ya mipango ya maendeleo katika jumuiya Februari hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay dadka deggan degmada Bungoma ku wargelineysaa horumarka barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: IEBC chiwo ripot ne jogweng'o mag Bungoma County kuom dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag oganda e dwe mar Februar.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds mobile money users in Trans Nzoia County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa pesa ya rununu.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Trans Nzoia inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qabanin si looga fogaado khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e Trans Nzoia County mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo gitang' gi mibadhi mag pesa mag simu.

English: State Department for TVET urges residents of Kwale County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kutuma maombi ya bursari hiyo kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar State for TVET jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Kwale mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud tiegruok mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: IEBC invites youth in Kakamega County to enroll for tailoring and design training this December.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni Desemba hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kakamega inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka tailoring iyo naqshadeynta bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: IEBC gwelo rowere e Kaunti mar Kakamega mondo odonj e tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko e dwe mar Desemba.

English: The Senate has rejected the Crops Tea Industry Regulations 2020 Stakeholders in the tea industry should stay informed about any forthcoming regulations regarding county roles in agriculture
Kiswahili: Bunge la Seneti limekataa Kanuni za Sekta ya Mazao ya Chai 2020 Washikadau katika sekta ya chai wanapaswa kujulishwa kuhusu kanuni zozote zinazokuja kuhusu majukumu ya kaunti katika kilimo.
Somali: Senate-ka ayaa diiday Xeerarka Warshadaha Crops Tea 2020 Qaybaha daneeyayaasha warshadaha shaaha waa inay sii joogaan warbixin ku saabsan xeerarka soo socda ee ku saabsan doorka degmooyinka ee beeraha
Dholuo: Senate osewito chike mag ohala mar chai 2020 Jo ma nigi paro e ohala mar chai onego ong'e chike mabiro luwore gi migawo mar county e tij pur

English: KEMSA encourages residents of Meru County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay ugu yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' mar Meru County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giluong kony mar thieth mar chuny maonge chudo.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds mobile money users in West Pokot County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee gobolka West Pokot inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne joma tiyo gi pesa mag simo e West Pokot County ni mondo ginyis jomisonari maggi weche ma ok adier mondo kik gitim kamano.

English: Office of the Auditor-General warns public officers in Kitui County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Wilaya ya Kitui dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Kitui khiyaanooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e County mar Kitui kuom timbe mag wuondruok.

English: KEPHIS invites farmers in Murang'a County to a free training on pest and disease management this March.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya udhibiti wa wadudu na magonjwa Machi hii.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Murang'a tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan xakamaynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: KEPHIS ogwelo jopur e County mar Murang'a e tiegruok maonge chudo e wi thieth mar tuoche kod tuoche e dwe mar Mach.

English: ODPP reminds the public in Baringo County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this February.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba maoni juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma yanakaribishwa Februari hii.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Baringo in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha lagu soo dhaweynayo bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: ODPP oparo ne ji duto e Baringo County ni paro ma ji chiwo e wi chenro mag sirkal en gima owinjore e dwe mar Februar.

English: KNEC encourages residents of Nandi County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya ugatuzi.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nandi inay ka qeybgalaan madasha dadweynaha degmada si ay uga warqabaan wareejinta.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jogweng' county mar Nandi mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county mondo gibed molony e weche mag golo pesa.

English: Marsabit County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Marsabit: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2023
Somali: Degmada Marsabit: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Marsabit: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar 2023

English: DPP urges residents of Nakuru County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: DPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo jogweng' Nakuru County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'adoe bura e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay la xiriiraan lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giwuo gi jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Country Brief Kenya - Climate Change, Mobility, and Conflict Dynamics (April 2026)
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi Kenya - Mabadiliko ya Tabianchi, Uhamaji, na Mienendo ya Migogoro (Aprili 2026)
Somali: Warbixinta Dalka Kenya - Isbeddelka Cimilada, Dhaqdhaqaaqa, iyo Isbeddellada Khilaafaadka (Abriil 2026)
Dholuo: Oboke machuok mar piny Kenya - Lokruok mar kor lwasi, wuotho, kod lwenje mag lweny (Dwe mar Ang'wen 2026)

English: West Pokot: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2022
Kiswahili: Pokot Magharibi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Aprili 2022
Somali: Galbeedka Pokot: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2022
Dholuo: Pokot ma milambo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar dwe mar ang'wen higa mar 2022

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Kilifi County starting this August.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kuanzia Agosti hii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa in laga bilaabo bisha Agoosto ee la soo dhaafay la siinayo dadka deggan degmada Kilifi.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) lando ni dhialisi mar ji duto modak Kilifi County biro chakore e dwe mar Agost.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds the public in Busia County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni huru, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu dadka degmada Busia xusuusinayaa in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone ji duto e county mar Busia ni golo ripot mar tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: IPOA urges the public in Nairobi County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: IPOA inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nairobi inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo ji duto e County mar Nairobi mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok adier ne jatendgi mar tich bang' yudo weche ma nyiso ni gin gi chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Nandi County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inazindua kampeni ya kupambana na ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nandi Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee gobolka Nandi bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Auditor General chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Nandi e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties urges residents of Kericho County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuwasilisha kumbukumbu za maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Kericho ku boorinayaa inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga lagu soo gabagabeynayo si loo qaabeeyo goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kericho mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso chenro mag dongruok.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan khiyaamooyinka ay gacan ka geystaan ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service oparo ne jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar wuond konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Notice: KEMRI confirms a measles outbreak alert for Kakamega County. Residents are advised to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI yathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa surua kwa Kaunti ya Kakamega. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay xaqiijineysaa feejignaan ku saabsan faafitaanka cudurka hargabka ee Gobolka Kakamega. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KEMRI osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuwono e Kaunti mar Kakamega.

English: Kenya Dairy Board warns cassava farmers in Busia County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa manii katika Kaunti ya Busia dhidi ya mlipuko wa wadudu na kupendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda cassava ee degmada Busia cudurrada cayayaanka waxaana uu ku talinayaa in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board chiwo siem ne jopur mag cassava e kaunti mar Busia kuom masiche ma nyalo kelo tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: TVET advises applicants in West Pokot County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: TVET waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha gobolka West Pokot inay dalbadaan booska TVET iyada oo loo marayo KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e West Pokot County mondo oketgi e tiegruok mar TVET kokalo kuom KUCCPS.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Nyamira County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inazindua kampeni ya kupambana na ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhanka ah gobolka Nyamira bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Nyamira e dwe mar Februar.

English: NPS calls on the community in Narok County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaita jamii katika Kaunti ya Narok kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: NPS waxay bulshada degmada Narok ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: NPS okwayo ji duto manie Narok County mondo owuo e wi timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo onyis ji weche mag mahundu e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: KTDA reminds livestock keepers in Kitui County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KTDA waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Kitui inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KTDA paronwa jorit jamni e gweng' mar Kitui mondo opidhgi gi tuoche e kuonde moketi mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: TVET calls on the community in Kisii County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TVET inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TVET waxay bulshada degmada Kisii ugu baaqeysaa inay u soo wargeliyaan maamulka dugsiga wixii dhibaato ah ee ku saabsan amniga si ay dugsiyada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: TVET okwayo ji duto manie County mar Kisii mondo onyis sirkal mar skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: Kenya Gazette advises residents of Nandi County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nandi inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette nyiso ji modak e county mar Nandi mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport services.

English: Peace came from the herders. Supporting peace amidst drought, food insecurity and conflict. Lessons from Marsabit County, Kenya
Kiswahili: Amani ilitoka kwa wafugaji. Kusaidia amani wakati wa ukame, uhaba wa chakula na migogoro. Masomo kutoka Kaunti ya Marsabit, Kenya
Somali: Nabaddu waxay ka timid xoolo dhaqatada. Taageeridda nabadda iyadoo abaar, cunto la'aan iyo colaado jiraan. Casharrada laga bartay Marsabit County, Kenya
Dholuo: Kwe ne owuok kuom jokwath. Chiro kwe e kind oro, koso yudo chiemo kod lweny. Puonj kowuok e gweng' mar Marsabit ma piny Kenya

English: State Department for Basic Education urges parents and teachers in Uasin Gishu County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa usimamizi wa shule.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku boorrinaysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta gobolka Uasin Gishu inay u soo sheegaan maamulka iskuulka wixii arrimo ah oo ku saabsan amniga.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo onyis jotelo mag skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public that free meningitis screening is available at all public health centres in Nyandarua County this July.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa uti wa mgongo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Julai hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka meningitis ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee Gobolka Nyandarua bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne ji ni nonro mar meningitis ma onge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Nyandarua e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: Council of Governors launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Isiolo County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha waxay bilaabeen olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhanka ah Degmada Isiolo bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Jaloch chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Isiolo e dwe mar Mach.
