English: Notice: NDMA opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogaysiis: NDMA waxay furaysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya taageero maskaxeed iyo bulsheed Gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA ochako ofis ma konyo ji e weche mag nindruok e gweng' mar Taita-Taveta.

English: TVET students to receive Ksh 5,000 monthly stipend from January.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa TVET watapata ksh 5,000 kila mwezi kuanzia Januari.
Somali: Ardayda TVET waxay heli doonaan Ksh 5,000 oo mushahar bille ah laga bilaabo Janaayo.
Dholuo: Jopuonjre mag TVET biro yudo chudo mar Ksh 5,000 dwe ka dwe kochakore Januar.

English: OGP urges residents of Meru County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: OGP ojiwo jogweng' mar Meru County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county mar tiego ji e intanet e loso chenro mag dongruok.

English: SHA urges eligible citizens in Laikipia County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: SHA inawasihi raia wanaostahiki katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Laikipia inay ka qaybqaataan jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jokanyo mag county mar Laikipia mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar yiero.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free cholera screening is available at all public health centres in Murang'a County this April.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kipindupindu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Aprili hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka fayraska ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Murang'a bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji ni nonro ma onge cholera yudore e kuonde thieth duto mag oganda e County mar Murang'a e dwe mar April.

English: Children are bearing the brunt:complementary evidencepoints to worsening nutrition outcomes, and suggest sustained nutritional stress rather than shortâ€‘term shocks alone.
Kiswahili: Watoto wanabeba mzigo huu:ushahidi wa nyongeza wa matokeo mabaya ya lishe, na kupendekeza dhiki endelevu ya lishe badala ya mishtuko ya muda mfupi pekee.
Somali: Carruurtu waxay la ildaran yihiin dhibaatada ugu badan: caddayn dheeraad ah ayaa tilmaamaysa natiijooyinka nafaqada oo sii xumaanaya, waxayna soo jeedinayaan walaac nafaqo oo joogto ah halkii ay ka ahaan lahaayeen naxdin muddo gaaban ah oo keliya.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ema ting'o pek: neno momedore nyiso ni gik ma kelo pek mag chiemo medo bedo marach, kendo ginyiso ni ng'ato nyalo bedo gi parruok ma dhi nyime e wi chiemo moloyo bedo gi parruok ma kinde matin kende.

English: DCI warns residents of Turkana County about a rise in identity theft and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaonya wakazi wa Wilaya ya Turkana juu ya kuongezeka kwa wizi wa kitambulisho na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: DCI waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana in ay kordhaan dhacda aqoonsiga waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne jogweng' Turkana County e wi medruok mar kuo mar kitgi kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: UNFPA and Kenya Red Cross join forces to deliver critical reproductive health supplies in ongoing El-Nino response
Kiswahili: UNFPA na Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wanaungana kusambaza vifaa muhimu vya afya ya uzazi katika kukabiliana na El-Nino
Somali: UNFPA iyo Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa iska kaashanaya sidii loo gaarsiin lahaa agab caafimaad oo muhiim ah oo ku saabsan taranka iyadoo la adeegsanayo jawaabta El-Nino ee socota
Dholuo: UNFPA kod Kenya Red Cross riwre kanyakla mar chiwo kony madongo mag thieth mar nyuol e duoko mar El-Nino madhi nyime

English: Ministry of Education encourages out-of-school children in Busia County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Busia kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya ugawaji wa bursary.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Busia inay codsadaan deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee loo qoondeeyay deeqaha waxbarasho.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e County mar Busia mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds livestock keepers in Mandera County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa za kuponda ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xayawaanka ah ee degmada Mandera inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jopur mag jamni e county mar Mandera ni gimi jamnigi thieth e kuonde moyier mag chwoyo jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: Universities Fund reminds youth in Meru County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Meru kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xasuusinayaa dhalinyarada degmada Meru in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka farsamada gawaarida gawaariyada.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa rowere manie County mar Meru ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar mechanics mag mtokni.

English: Circulating vaccine-derived poliovirus type 2 (cVDPV2) - Kenya
Kiswahili: Virusi vya polio vinavyotokana na chanjo ya aina 2 (cVDPV2) - Kenya
Somali: Nooca 2aad ee fayraska dabaysha ee tallaalka laga helo (cVDPV2) - Kenya
Dholuo: Midhusi mar polio mawuok kuom chanjo magoyore e del mar kit 2 (cVDPV2) - Kenya

English: TSC conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Kisii County this March.
Kiswahili: TSC inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kisii Machi hii.
Somali: TSC waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada ee degmada Kisii bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: TSC dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego jopiny e dwe mar Mach e sulani mar Kisii County.

English: Turkana County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Turkana: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2024
Somali: Degmada Turkana: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Turkana: Oboke machon mar oro mar Septemba 2024

English: Notice: KUCCPS announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ee dugsiyada degmada Kajiado.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KUCCPS ogolo chenro mar somo e skunde mag Kajiado County.

English: State Department for Basic Education encourages residents of Taita-Taveta County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Taita-Taveta inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabtaan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo ong'e weche ma gin-go e wi register mar joma oyiero mondo ging'e tich mar ombudsman.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette will hold a public participation forum on development planning forums in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya litafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Kenya Gazette waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta ee gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Gazette biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag dongruok e Homa Bay County.

English: HELB invites youth in Mandera County to enroll for tailoring and design training this March.
Kiswahili: HELB inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Mandera kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni Machi hii.
Somali: HELB waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Mandera inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka tailoring iyo naqshadeynta bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: HELB gwelo rowere man Mandera County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko e dwe mar Mach.

English: Anticipatory action to mitigate drought-induced crises: Learning from Kenya and Somalia
Kiswahili: Hatua ya kutarajia kupunguza majanga yanayosababishwa na ukame: Kujifunza kutoka Kenya na Somalia
Somali: Tallaabo la filayo in lagu yareeyo dhibaatooyinka abaartu keento: Wax laga barto Kenya iyo Soomaaliya
Dholuo: Tich motelo mar duoko piny pek ma okel gi oro: Puonjruok kowuok e piny Kenya kod Somalia

English: Notice: IEBC opens a new electrical installation programme at the vocational centre in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inafungua programu mpya ya ufungaji wa umeme katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo koronto lagu rakibo xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IEBC chako chenro manyien mar keto sitima e kar tich e taon mar Isiolo.

English: KEPHIS advises milk producers in Machakos County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inashauri wazalishaji wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay kula talineysaa soosaarayaasha caanaha ee degmada Machakos inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur mag chak e gweng' mar Machakos mondo oti gi nengo mar piny mosingi kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: KALRO invites farmers in Trans Nzoia County to a free training on record keeping for farmers this September.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwa mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima Septemba hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan diiwaangelinta beeralayda bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KALRO ogwelo jopur e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi rito rekod mag jopur dwe mar ochiko.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Narok County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa maelekezo ya makazi salama katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay furtay xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya talooyin ku saabsan magangelyo ammaan ah Gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Red Cross oseyawo ofis mar joma okendore ma chiwo kuonde dak ma onge tuoche e taon mar Narok.

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Wajir County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kuthibitisha kuwa kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir inay xaqiijiyaan in xaruntooda la aqoonsaday ka hor inta aysan booqan si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso jogweng' mar Wajir County ni mondo ging'e ni kuondegi mag thieth oseyudo ratiro kapok gibiro mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Notice: Council of Governors launches the county integrated development plan in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa bilaabay qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Nyeri.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Jaloch chako chenro mar dongruok mar county e county mar Nyeri.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kurejesha huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la hagaajiyay waqtiga wareejinta adeegyada baasaboorka ee degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties olando lokruok e seche mag tiyo gi passport e county mar Baringo.

English: Drought-affected populations in northern Kenya, October 2022
Kiswahili: Idadi ya watu walioathiriwa na ukame kaskazini mwa Kenya, Oktoba 2022
Somali: Dadka ay abaartu saameysay ee waqooyiga Kenya, Oktoobar 2022
Dholuo: Oganda ma oyudo hinyruok nikech oro e nyandwat mar Kenya, dwe mar apar higa mar 2022

English: Kenya Registered refugees and asylum-seekers | October 2025
Kiswahili: Kenya Wakimbizi waliosajiliwa na wanaotafuta hifadhi | Oktoba 2025
Somali: Kenya Qaxootiga diiwaangashan iyo kuwa magangalyo doonka ah | Oktoobar 2025
Dholuo: Kenya Ondiko nying’ jolweny kod jogo ma dwaro dak e pinyno | Oktoba higa mar 2025

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will be held in Nandi County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Nandi Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo bilaash ah oo ay soo qabanqaabisay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta Caafimada taranka ayaa lagu qabanqaabi doonaa degmada Nandi bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Rapar: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo mitimo gi Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ibiro tim e County mar Nandi e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Ministry of Health will be held in Machakos County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Wizara ya Afya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Machakos Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ay soo qabanqaabisay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa lagu qabanqaabi doonaa Degmada Machakos bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo mitimo gi Ministry of Health ibiro tim e County ma Machakos e dwe mar Agost.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges residents of Tana River County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya mawasiliano ya Kenya inawahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Tana River kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama katikati ya tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River County inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga waxqabadka aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah iyada oo xoogga la siinayo amniga xuduudda.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkande mag sirkal e wi gik ma ne timore e alwora mar tong'gi nikech sirkal ne medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom weche sirkal.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya calls on the community in Busia County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Busia kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwa ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Busia inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji (Communications Authority of Kenya) dwaro ni ji duto manie county mar Busia ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako, kendo ginyis joma kamago e stesen mar polise.

English: Public notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will host a free hypertension awareness outreach in Mombasa County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itakuwa mwenyeji wa uhamasishaji wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska Dadweynaha: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka jawaabista Cudurrada waxay marti gelineysaa wacyi-gelin bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cadaadiska dhiig karka ee gobolka Mombasa bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Rango Kendo Luwo Tuwo biro timo kampen mar konyo ji ng'eyo ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar hypertension maonge chudo e dwe mar ochiko e kaunti mar Mombasa.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the community in Isiolo County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb carjacking.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia utekaji nyara wa magari.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa bulshada degmada Isiolo inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo afduubka gawaarida.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo oganda manie Isiolo County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o kwalo mtokni.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on residents of Taita-Taveta County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawaomba wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ugu baaqay dadka deggan gobolka Taita-Taveta in ay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga dhaqdhaqaaq aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah si ay u taageeraan taxadarka ka dhanka ah argagixisada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations okwayo jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo onyis sirkal mag sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e tong'gi.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya launches ward-level service delivery in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya yaanza kutoa huduma katika wilaya ya Mandera County.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu bilaabay adeegga adeegga heerka qaybta ee Degmada Mandera.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura mar Kenya chako tiyo gi tije mag sirkal e alwora mar Mandera County.

English: Protect your baby's hearing by keeping them away from loud environments.
Kiswahili: Linda usikivu wa mtoto wako kwa kumzuia asisikie mazingira yenye kelele.
Somali: Ka ilaali maqalka ilmahaaga adigoo ka fogeynaya goobaha buuqa badan.
Dholuo: Rit winjo mar nyathini kuom ketogi mabor gi kuonde ma dwol winjore ahinya.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun iyo biyo nadiif ah si joogto ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds the public in Kakamega County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuendelea kuwa macho katika ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka degmada Kakamega ku xasuusinaya inay ka feejignaadaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne ji duto e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni gibed motang' ne loso kuwe e piny mangima.

English: Job losses and aid cuts leave Dadaab refugees uncertain of their future
Kiswahili: Hasara za kazi na kupunguzwa kwa misaada huwaacha wakimbizi wa Dadaab kutokuwa na uhakika wa maisha yao ya baadaye
Somali: Shaqo la'aanta iyo gargaarka oo la dhimo ayaa qaxootiga Dhadhaab ka dhigaya kuwo aan hubin mustaqbalkooda
Dholuo: Kuong’ruok mar tich kod weyo kony miyo jolweny mag Dadaab bedo gi adier kuom kinde mabiro

English: Taita Taveta County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Taita Taveta: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2024
Somali: Degmada Taita Taveta: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Taita Taveta: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2024

English: Notice: IEBC opens voter education centres in Nakuru County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Nakuru mwezi Juni huu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee degmada Nakuru bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC chako tiego josiasa e taon mar Nakuru e dwe mar Jun.

English: ODPP reminds voters in Makueni County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya michakato ya uchaguzi.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Makueni inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor inta aan la helin nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: ODPP parone jogweng' Makueni County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom SMS ne ji 70000 kapok gitimo yiero.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) restricts movement of dairy cows in Makueni County due to a rabies outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inazuia harakati za ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Makueni kutokana na mlipuko wa kichaa cha mbwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Makueni sababtuna tahay cudurka cadho.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok makwayo e gweng' mar Makueni nikech tuwo mar rabies.

English: Transformative farming in Kenya is aimed at long-term solution effects between environment and humanity and their complimentary to support livelihood. As climate change keeps affecting farming, when government focuses on bumper harvests to export to foreign markets, kenyan farmers have tried to conduct farming that doesn't affect the environment thus fortify farming and sustainable harvest.
Kiswahili: Kilimo cha mabadiliko nchini Kenya kinalenga athari za suluhisho la muda mrefu kati ya mazingira na ubinadamu na kujitolea kwao kusaidia maisha. Wakati mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa yanaendelea kuathiri kilimo, wakati serikali inazingatia mavuno mengi ya kusafirisha kwa masoko ya nje, wakulima wa Kenya wamejaribu kufanya kilimo ambacho hakiathiri mazingira na hivyo kuimarisha kilimo na mavuno endelevu.
Somali: Beeralayda beddelka ah ee Kenya waxaa loogu talagalay xalka muddada-dheer ee u dhexeeya deegaanka iyo aadanaha iyo taageeridooda taageerada nolosha. Maadaama isbeddelka cimilada uu sii saameeyo beeraleyda, marka dowladdu diiradda saarto goosashada badan si loo dhoofiyo suuqyada dibadda, beeraleyda Kenya waxay isku dayeen inay sameeyaan beero aan saameyn ku yeelan deegaanka, taasoo xoojisay beeralayda iyo goosashada waara.
Dholuo: Tij pur ma kelo lokruok e piny Kenya dwaro ni ji obed gi winjruok maber gi alwora kod dhano kendo mondo gikonygi e ngima. Kaka lokruok mar piny medo ketho tij pur, sama sirkal keto pachgi kuom yien ma ok nyal geng'o, mondo oter oko e pinje mamoko, jopur ma Kenya osetemo timo tij pur ma ok nyal ketho alwora, kendo mano osemiyo tij pur kod yien ma ok nyal geng'o kethruok mar alwora.

English: Nairobi floods 2024 during 'long' rain season
Kiswahili: Mafuriko ya Nairobi 2024 wakati wa msimu wa mvua 'mrefu
Somali: Daadad ka dhacay Nairobi 2024 xilli roobaadkii 'dheeraa'
Dholuo: Opong'o pi e taon mar Nairobi higa mar 2024 e kinde koth 'mabor'

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will conduct a post-harvest handling workshop for farmers in Garissa County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi ka dib goosashada beeraleyda Gobolka Garissa bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro timo tiegruok mar rito jopur bang' keyo e taon mar Garissa e dwe mar Julai.

English: Council of Governors warns public officers in Samburu County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Samburu dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ka digeen saraakiisha dowladda ee Gobolka Samburu inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Samburu ni kik giti marach gi migepegi.

English: Government promoting daily exercise challenge across all counties, emphasizing movement for health.
Kiswahili: Serikali inakuza changamoto ya mazoezi ya kila siku katika kaunti zote, ikisisitiza harakati za afya.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay horumarineysaa caqabadda jimicsiga maalinlaha ah ee dhammaan degmooyinka, iyadoo lagu adkeynayo dhaqdhaqaaqa caafimaadka.
Dholuo: Sirkal jiwo kinda mar timo tiegruok pile ka pile e gwenge duto, koketo pek ahinya kuom riwruok mar oganda Jehova.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette opens polling procedures centres in Lamu County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Lamu Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Kenya Gazette waxay furaysaa xarumaha nidaamyada codbixinta ee degmada Lamu bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Gazette chako tiyo gi kuonde ma itimoe yiero e County mar Lamu e dwe mar Januar.

English: KALRO advises farmers in Nairobi County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nairobi inay iska diiwaangeliyaan tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qeybgalaan waxbarashada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e County mar Nairobi mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e chokruok mabiro.

English: Kenya Gazette invites residents of Kisumu County to attend the public participation forum regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay ka qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la xiriira wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynta.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette gwelo jogweng' mar Kisumu County mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenrono.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay furaysaa codsiyada deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan ardayda ku jira degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Ofis mar Puonjruok oseyawo kwayo mar yudo osuru ne jopuonjre man gi chan e Kericho County.

English: Teachers Service Commission advises applicants in Kisumu County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kutembelea kituo cha mafunzo ya ufundi kilicho karibu zaidi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa ku talinaya codsadayaasha degmada Kisumu inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow si ay u helaan waxbarashada soo socota.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e gweng' mar Kisumu mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: The analysis is based on information available as of April 30, 2026.
Kiswahili: Uchambuzi huo unatokana na taarifa inayopatikana kuanzia tarehe 30 Aprili 2026.
Somali: Falanqaynta waxay ku salaysan tahay macluumaadka la heli karo laga bilaabo Abriil 30, 2026.
Dholuo: Nonro no ochung’ne weche ma yudore nyaka tarik 30 dwe mar ang’wen higa mar 2026.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya waanzisha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay shilalka waddooyinka ee Gobolka Samburu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Red Cross tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne masiche mag ndara e county mar Samburu.

English: Research in settlements such as Mathare in Nairobi and Kombo in Dar es Salaam shows that indoor temperatures are often higher than outdoor conditions, leading to chronic heat stress.
Kiswahili: Utafiti katika makazi kama vile Mathare huko Nairobi na Kombo jijini Dar es Salaam unaonyesha kuwa halijoto ya ndani ya nyumba mara nyingi ni ya juu kuliko hali ya nje, na kusababisha msongo wa joto sugu.
Somali: Cilmi-baaris lagu sameeyay degsiimooyinka sida Mathare ee Nairobi iyo Kombo ee Dar es Salaam ayaa muujinaya in heerkulka gudaha uu badanaa ka sarreeyo xaaladaha bannaanka, taasoo keenta cadaadis kulayl oo daba dheeraada.
Dholuo: Nonro mane otim e gwenge kaka Mathare e Nairobi kod Kombo e Dar es Salaam nyiso ni liet mar ei ot kinde mang'eny bedo mamalo liet mar oko, mamiyo ng'ato bedo gi liet ma okrum.

English: Farmers interested in the cashew nut value chain can benefit from new opportunities as the Ministry of Agriculture Animal Industry and Fisheries partners with Uganda Cashewnut and Trees Limited
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaopenda mnyororo wa thamani wa korosho wanaweza kufaidika na fursa mpya kwani Wizara ya Kilimo Sekta ya Wanyama na Uvuvi inashirikiana na Uganda Cashewnut and Trees Limited.
Somali: Beeraleyda xiisaynaya silsiladda qiimaha lowska cashew waxay ka faa'iideysan karaan fursado cusub maadaama Wasaaradda Beeraha, Warshadaha Xoolaha iyo Kalluumeysiga ay iskaashi la leedahay Uganda, Cashewnut and Trees Limited
Dholuo: Jo-Purchasing ma dwaro ng'eyo kaka olemo mar cahew ber, nyalo yudo thuolo manyien nikech Ministry of Agriculture Animal Industry and Fisheries oriwore gi Uganda Cashewnut and Trees Limited

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will distribute certified cassava seed to farmers in Migori County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itasambaza mbegu zilizothibitishwa za manii kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Wax soo saarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu abuuraha Degmada Migori u qaybin doonaa abuurka cassava ee la caddeeyay bisha Agoosto ee sannadkan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Chandruoge biro pogo kodhi mag cassava ne jopur manie Migori County e dwe mar Agost.

English: IGAD commits to improving food and nutrition security in Africa. Data shows 21% of people across IGAD member states are food insecure
Kiswahili: IGAD imejitolea kuboresha usalama wa chakula na lishe barani Afrika. Takwimu zinaonyesha 21% ya watu katika nchi wanachama wa IGAD hawana uhakika wa chakula
Somali: IGAD waxay ka go'an tahay in la wanaajiyo ammaanka cuntada iyo nafaqada ee Afrika.
Dholuo: IGAD ochiwore mondo otim dongruok e weche mag chiemo kod chiemb chuny e Afrika.

English: Samburu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Samburu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Mei 2024
Somali: Degmada Samburu: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Samburu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar Mei 2024

English: Play is vital for a child_x0092_s emotional, physical, and cognitive development.
Kiswahili: Kucheza ni muhimu sana kwa ukuzi wa kihisia-moyo, kimwili, na utambuzi wa mtoto.
Somali: Ciyaartu waa muhiim u ah koritaanka shucuureed, jireed, iyo garasho ee ilmaha_x0092_s.
Dholuo: Tugo en gima duong’ ahinya e dongruok mar nyathi e chuny, e ringruok, kod e ng’eyo.

English: Meru (Meru-North) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Meru (Meru-Kaskazini): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Mei 2022
Somali: Degmada Meru (Meru-Waqooyi): War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Meru (Meru-Nyath): Oboke mar Chik Mapile mar Mei 2022

English: Public health advisory: KEMSA warns of increased cyclosporiasis risk in Kajiado County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMSA inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya cyclosporiasis katika Kaunti ya Kajiado na inashauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Talobixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: KEMSA waxay ka digeysaa kororka halista cyclosporiasis ee Gobolka Kajiado waxayna ku talineysaa dadweynaha inay soo sheegaan kiisaska loo maleynayo inay u sheegaan mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar oganda: KEMSA chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo cyclosporiasis e Kajiado County kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore mar thieth.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges residents of Tana River County to complete the full recommended vaccination dose following a rise in reported dengue fever cases.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya homa ya dengue.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay dhammaystiraan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo ka dib kororka kiisaska cudurka dengue ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo ochop e okang' moromo mar thieth ma gichiwo bang' medruok mar joma nigi tuwo mar dengue.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa furaya xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya daryeel caafimaad ka dib rabshadaha degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis ma nono weche mag mahundu chako tiyo gi ofis mar weche nindruok e kaunti mar Isiolo.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds residents of Mandera County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba upatikanaji wa usajili wa e-Citizen sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera in helitaanka diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone jogweng' mar Mandera County ni koro yot yudo e-Citizen registration kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMRI will be held in Narok County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMRI itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Narok Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay KEMRI ayaa lagu qaban doonaa gobolka Narok bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni kambi mar thieth ma KEMRI ochano biro timore e taon mar Narok e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross conducts a community briefing on border security in Meru County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Meru mwezi huu wa Oktoba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha degmada Meru bishii Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Red Cross timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e County mar Meru e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will train farmers in Kilifi County on organic farming this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuhusu kilimo hai Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Kilifi ee beeraha dabiiciga ah bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro tiego jopur e gweng' mar Kilifi e weche mag pur e dwe mar April.

English: Council of Governors announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kushughulikia vyeti vya kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku dhawaaqeen in la hagaajiyay waqtiga wareejinta shahaadada dhalashada ee gobolka Bomet.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch olando lokruok e seche mag timo nonro kuom weche mag nyuol e county mar Bomet.

English: Register your child's birth early to secure legal identity and access to services.
Kiswahili: Sajili kuzaliwa kwa mtoto wako mapema ili kupata utambulisho halali na upatikanaji wa huduma.
Somali: Diiwaangeli dhalashada ilmahaaga goor hore si aad u hesho aqoonsi sharci ah iyo helitaanka adeegyada.
Dholuo: Ndiki nying nyuol mar nyathini mapiyo mondo iyud oboke mar chik kendo yudo kony.

English: Curbing the march of African Armyworm
Kiswahili: Kuzuia maandamano ya African Armyworm
Somali: Joojinta socodka cudurka dabaysha ee Afrika
Dholuo: Ogeng’o wuoth mar winyo mag jolweny mag Afrika

English: KTDA promotes conservation tillage among farmers in Samburu County as part of the May climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: KTDA inakuza kilimo cha uhifadhi kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Mei.
Somali: KTDA waxay kor u qaadeysaa beerashada ilaalinta beeraleyda gobolka Samburu iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka u adkaysiga cimilada ee bisha Maajo.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo puodho mar ritruok e kind jopur e county mar Samburu kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi e dwe mar Mei.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges residents of Kajiado County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kuunga mkono kamati za ujenzi wa amani huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa wa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee deegaanka iyada oo la sii xoojinayo amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations ojiwo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gweng'no ka ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom rito tong'.

English: Notice: IPOA activates an emergency response plan for landslides in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ka dhan ah dhulgariirada Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony mapiyo ne yiengni mag piny e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: CS Machogu stresses harmonizing skills through RPL.
Kiswahili: CS Machogu anasisitiza kuunganisha ujuzi kupitia RPL.
Somali: CS Machogu wuxuu xoogga saarayaa iswaafajinta xirfadaha iyada oo loo marayo RPL.
Dholuo: CS Machogu jiwo winjruok e kind lony kokalo kuom RPL.

English: KTDA advises maize producers in Kwale County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawashauri wazalishaji wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KTDA waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha hadhuudhka ee Gobolka Kwale inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KTDA nyiso jopur mag kodhi e county mar Kwale mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur ma biro ka kinde keyo pok ochopo.

English: Ongoing drought in the Horn of Africa severely impacts women
Kiswahili: Ukame unaoendelea katika Pembe ya Afrika unaathiri sana wanawake
Somali: Abaarta ka jirta Geeska Afrika ayaa si xun u saameysa haweenka
Dholuo: Oro ma dhi nyime e Tung’ mar Afrika ketho mon ahinya

English: Notice: KTDA restricts movement of goats in Siaya County due to an anthrax outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA inazuia harakati za mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Siaya kutokana na mlipuko wa kimeta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa riyaha ee degmada Siaya sababtuna tahay cudurka anthrax.
Dholuo: Rapar: KTDA ogeng'o wuoth mar diek e county mar Siaya nikech tuwo mar anthrax.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada ee degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura mar Kenya biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e county mar Siaya.

English: Public health advisory: KEMSA warns of increased malaria risk in Nyamira County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMSA inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya malaria katika Kaunti ya Nyamira na inashauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Talobixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: KEMSA waxay ka digeysaa kororka halista daacuunka ee degmada Nyamira waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga ah mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar oganda: KEMSA chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar malaria e County mar Nyamira kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore mar thieth.

English: DPP urges the public in Homa Bay County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of identity theft.
Kiswahili: DPP inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: DPP waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadweynaha gobolka Homa Bay inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee tuugista aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo ji duto manie Homa Bay County mondo ochiw ripot mar weche ma ok adier ne jatendgi mar konyo ji bang' yudo weche ma nyiso ni ne owalo ng'ato.

English: Africa CDC Epidemic Intelligence Weekly Report, 03 January 2025
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Kila Wiki ya Ujasusi wa Mlipuko wa Afrika CDC, 03 Januari 2025
Somali: Warbixinta Todobaadlaha ah ee Sirdoonka Cudurrada Faafa ee Afrika CDC, 03 Janaayo 2025
Dholuo: Ripot mar juma ka juma mar rang'iny mar tuo mar CDC mar Afrika, tarik 03 dwe mar achiel higa mar 2025

English: Notice: DPP opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay furaysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya taageero maskaxeed iyo bulsheed degmada Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DPP ochako ofis ma konyo ji e weche mag nindruok e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia.

English: Notice: SHA opens the electoral calendar centres in Mandera County this April.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: SHA inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Mandera Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA waxay furaysaa xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee degmada Mandera bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e kaunti mar Mandera e dwe mar April.

English: "I would like to congratulate the Government of Kenya for this step toward increasing access to the first malaria vaccine, as part of a package of WHO-recommended measures to strengthen malaria control.
Kiswahili: "Ningependa kupongeza Serikali ya Kenya kwa hatua hii ya kuongeza upatikanaji wa chanjo ya kwanza ya malaria, ikiwa ni sehemu ya hatua zilizopendekezwa na WHO za kuimarisha udhibiti wa malaria.
Somali: "Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan u hambalyeeyo Dowladda Kenya tallaabadan ku aaddan kordhinta helitaanka tallaalka duumada ee ugu horreeya, taasoo qayb ka ah xirmo tallaabooyin ay WHO ku talisay si loo xoojiyo xakamaynta duumada."
Dholuo: "Adwaro goyo erokamano ne Sirkal mar Kenya kuom okang'ni mar medo yudo chanjo mokwongo mar maleria, kaka achiel kuom chenro ma WHO ogolo mar jiwo geng'o maleria.

English: An Act of Faith: Overcoming Malnutrition in Kenya
Kiswahili: Tendo la Imani: Kushinda Utapiamlo nchini Kenya
Somali: Fal Iimaan ah: Ka Gudubka Nafaqada Kenya
Dholuo: Tich mar Yie: Loyo Chiemo ma Ong’eny e piny Kenya

English: Ministry of Education advises students in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to register early to secure allocation to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ardayda degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet kula talineysaa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan si ay u helaan deeq deeq waxbarasho oo loogu talagalay ardayda u baahan.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jopuonjre e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo odonj e skundno chon mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo osuru ne jopuonjre mochando.

English: Council of Governors reminds residents of Kirinyaga County that access to national ID applications is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba kufikia maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga in helitaanka codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch parone jogweng' Kirinyaga County ni yudo kwayo mag ID e piny sani yot ahinya kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Kakamega County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi diiwaangelinta beeraleyda loogu talagalay beeralayda Gobolka Kakamega bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro timo rapar mar jopur e dwe mar ochiko mar higani.

English: Notice: KEMRI will hold a suicide prevention forum in Garissa County this May. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI itafanya kongamano la kuzuia kujiua katika Kaunti ya Garissa Mei hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay qabaneysaa madasha ka hortagga ismiidaaminta ee Gobolka Garissa bisha May. Dhammaantood waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni KEMRI biro timo chokruok mar geng'o ji kik donjre e dwe mar Mei e taon mar Garissa County.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) launches ward-level service delivery in Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inazindua huduma za huduma katika wilaya ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu bilaabay bixinta adeegyada heerka qaybta ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi.
Dholuo: Rapar: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chako chiwo kony e ward level e Tharaka-Nithi County.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response launches a February awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Februari juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Febraayo oo ku saabsan baaritaanka sonkorowga gobolka Nakuru.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Februar e wi nonro mar thieth mar sukari e kaunti duto mar Nakuru.

English: Ndaro ini coffee farmers have earned Kshs 115 per kg by selling directly to Trabocca Farmers are encouraged to explore direct marketing avenues for better profits
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa kahawa wa Ndaro ini wamepata Kshs 115 kwa kilo kwa kuuza moja kwa moja kwa Trabocca Wakulima wanahimizwa kutafuta njia za moja kwa moja za masoko ili kupata faida bora.
Somali: Beeraleyda kafeega ee Ndaro ini waxay kasbadeen 115 Kshs kg kasta iyagoo si toos ah u iibinaya Trabocca Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiiri gelinayaa inay sahamiyaan siyaabo suuq geyn toos ah si ay u helaan faa'iidooyin wanaagsan
Dholuo: Jo-Farmer ma loso chai e piny Ndaro osenwang'o Kshs 115 e kilo ka giuso achiel kachiel Trabocca Jo-Farmer ijiwo mondo onon yore mag uso chai achiel kachiel mondo giyud ohala maber

English: NDMA urges residents of Mandera County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo la sii xoojinayo taxaddarka ka dhanka ah argagixisada.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo jogweng'o mag Mandera County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar sirkal e wi gik ma ne timore e alwora mar tong'gi nikech ji osebedo ka kawo okang' mar kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Notice: EACC will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay qabaneysaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee Gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: EACC biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e County mar Lamu.

English: Notice: SHA launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Nakuru County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Shirika la SHA linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru mwezi huu wa Julai.
Somali: Ogaysiis: SHA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhanka ah gobolka Nakuru bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Rapar: SHA chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e gweng' mar Nakuru e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya - Key Message Update: Long rains to drive improvement, but widespread Crisis (IPC Phase 3) will persist, March 2026
Kiswahili: Kenya - Taarifa ya Ujumbe Muhimu: Mvua ndefu ili kuboresha uboreshaji, lakini Mgogoro ulioenea (IPC Awamu ya 3) utaendelea, Machi 2026
Somali: Kenya - Cusbooneysiinta Fariinta Muhiimka ah: Roobab dhaadheer ayaa horseedaya horumar, laakiin Xiisad baahsan (IPC Wajiga 3aad) ayaa sii jiri doonta, Maarso 2026
Dholuo: Kenya - Oda Maduong’: Koth mabor biro kelo dongruok, kata kamano, chandruok ma lach (IPC Kidieny mar adek) biro dhi nyime, dwe mar adek higa mar 2026

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds schools in Isiolo County to strengthen inclusion of learners with disabilities this August.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuimarisha ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu Agosti hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka ayaa xusuusinaya dugsiyada degmada Isiolo inay xoojiyaan ka mid noqoshada ardayda naafada ah bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne skunde mag Isiolo County mondo omed jiwo jopuonjre ma nigi midekre e dwe mar Agost.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds residents of Tharaka-Nithi County that agroforestry improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwamba kilimo cha misitu kinaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan Degmada Tharaka-Nithi in beeraha kaynta ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board parone jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County ni agroforestry medo nyak mar pur kuom kinde malach.

English: AATF was encouraged to focus on developing programmes on smart and resilient agriculture that emphasize indigenous food systems as an intervention.
Kiswahili: AATF ilihimizwa kuzingatia kuendeleza programu za kilimo bora na imara ambazo zinasisitiza mifumo ya chakula cha asili kama hatua ya kuingilia kati.
Somali: AATF waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyay inay diiradda saarto horumarinta barnaamijyo ku saabsan beeraha caqliga leh iyo adkaysiga leh oo xoogga saaraya nidaamyada cuntada asaliga ah sida faragelin ahaan.
Dholuo: Ne ojiw AATF mondo oket pachgi kuom loso chenro mag pur mar rieko kendo ma nigi teko mar timo dongruok ma jiwo chenro mag chiemo ma wuok e ogandagi kaka chenro mar konyo.

English: Office of the Auditor-General encourages first-time voters in Siaya County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Siaya kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa codbixiyayaasha ugu horreeya ee degmada Siaya inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General jiwo joma okwongo yiero e county mar Siaya mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds voters in Embu County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Embu kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Embu inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette parone jogweng' Embu County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go ka gitiyo gi sms e simo mar 70000 kapok kinde mar yiero ochopo.

English: TVET conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Machakos County this January.
Kiswahili: TVET inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Machakos Januari hii.
Somali: TVET waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan wareejinta degmada Machakos bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: E dwe mar Januar, TVET dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi weche mag golo pesa e gweng' mar Machakos.

English: KMTC advises applicants in Murang'a County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KMTC waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Murang'a inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: KMTC nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Murang'a ni mondo gidonj e tiegruok kapok ichopo e chokruok mabiro.

English: Supporting refugees in Somalia and Kenya
Kiswahili: Kusaidia wakimbizi nchini Somalia na Kenya
Somali: Taageerada qaxootiga ku sugan Soomaaliya iyo Kenya
Dholuo: Chiwo kony ne jolweny e piny Somalia kod Kenya

English: State Department for TVET reminds needy students in Nyamira County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Nyamira in buugaagta waxbarasho iyo codsiyada qalabka waxbarasho ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET oparo ne jopuonjre man Nyamira County ni buk mag somo kod weche mag somo mag somo chiegni rumo.

English: HELB reminds schools in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this September.
Kiswahili: HELB inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Septemba hii.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay xoojiyaan adeegyada hagista iyo la talinta bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa skunde man Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo omed jiwo kendo chiwo kony e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: SHA opens the electoral calendar centres in Kilifi County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: SHA inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Wilaya ya Kilifi Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA waxay furaysaa xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee degmada Kilifi bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e gweng' mar Kilifi e dwe mar Julai.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free cholera screening is available at all public health centres in Nyamira County this August.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kipindupindu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Agosti hii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka fayraska ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaad ee gobolka Nyamira bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji ni nonro ma onge cholera yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Nyamira e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will hold a depression awareness forum in Migori County this July. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanya kongamano la uhamasishaji wa unyogovu katika Kaunti ya Migori Julai hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) waxay qabaneysaa madasha wacyi galinta niyadjabka ee Degmada Migori bishii Luulyo. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo chokruok mar chiwo paro e wi tuoche mag depression e taon mar Migori e dwe mar Julai.

English: We are soon introducing a mobile app that allows citizens to report incidents, particularly road-related cases, directly online, he said.
Kiswahili: Hivi karibuni tutaanzisha programu ya simu ambayo inaruhusu raia kuripoti matukio, hasa matukio yanayohusiana na barabara, moja kwa moja mtandaoni," alisema.
Somali: Dhawaan waxaan soo bandhigaynaa barnaamij moobayl ah oo u oggolaanaya muwaadiniinta inay si toos ah online ugu soo sheegaan dhacdooyinka, gaar ahaan kiisaska la xiriira waddooyinka, ayuu yiri.
Dholuo: Owacho ni machiegni ni wabiro keto app mar simu ma miyo jodak nyalo lando weche matimore, ahinya ahinya weche ma mulo yore, e yor mbui.

English: Weeding can be done manually or with herbicides; when using herbicides, use the correct product, wear the correct protective clothing, and follow correct disposal of containers. Weed more often when rains are heavy, and less often when rains are light.
Kiswahili: Palizi inaweza kufanywa kwa kutumia mikono au kwa dawa ya kuua magugu; wakati wa kutumia dawa za kuua magugu, tumia dawa inayofaa, vaa nguo sahihi za kujikinga, na uzingatie utupaji sahihi wa vyombo vya dawa baada ya kutumia. Wakati wa mvua nyingi, palilia magugu mara nyingi zaidi, na ikiwa mvua ni chache, punguza upaliliaji.
Somali: Xadhigga cawska waxaa lagu samayn karaa gacanta ama iyada oo loo marayo jeermis-demmayaal; marka la isticmaalo jeermis-demmayaal, isticmaal alaabta saxda ah, xir dharka difaaca saxda ah, oo raac baabi'inta saxda ah ee weel.
Dholuo: Ka itiyo gi yedhe mamero yien, ti gi gik makare, rwakri gi lewni mowinjore, kendo iket gik ma inyalo ting'o e bwo yien.

English: DCI reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Lamu County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Lamu kwamba upatikanaji wa maelekezo ya makazi salama unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee Gobolka Lamu in helitaanka tixraacyada magangelyo ammaan ah la heli karo lacag la'aan.
Dholuo: DCI parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag nindruok e County mar Lamu ni ginyalo yudo kuonde dak maonge chudo.

English: DCI urges the community in Uasin Gishu County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb carjacking.
Kiswahili: DCI inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia utekaji nyara wa magari.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Uasin Gishu inay ku biiraan mashaariicda booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo afduubka gawaarida.
Dholuo: DCI ojiwo oganda mar Uasin Gishu County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o kwalo mtokni.

English: Notice: e-Citizen launches county development projects in West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya wilaya katika wilaya ya West Pokot.
Somali: Ogeysiis: e-Citizen waxay bilawday mashaariic horumarineed oo ka socda degmada West Pokot County.
Dholuo: Rapar: e-Citizen chako tije mag dongruok e gweng' mar West Pokot County.

English: If rains are predicted as normal to below normal, select drought-tolerant varieties of the crops recommended for your area, or change to drought-tolerant crops - for example, replacing maize with sorghum and millet.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mvua zinatabiriwa kunyesha kiwango cha chini ya kiwango cha kawaida, chagua aina za mazao yanayostahimili ukame kwa eneo lako, au badilisha mazao na kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame. Kwa mfano, badala ya mahindi unaweza kupanda mtama au uwele.
Somali: Haddii roobabka la saadaaliyo inay caadi ahaan u dhacaan ama ka hooseeyaan caadiga, dooro noocyo abaaro u dulqaadan kara oo lagu taliyo deegaankaaga, ama u beddela dalagyo abaaro u dulqaadan kara - tusaale ahaan, ku darso hadhuudhka iyo xiirka.
Dholuo: Kapo ni koth chue e alwora ma idakie, inyalo yiero kodhi ma nyalo nyagore gi pek mar yiengni, kata inyalo tiyo gi kodhi mamoko ma ok nyal nyagore gi pekno. Kuom ranyisi, inyalo loko kodhi mondo iti gi sorghum kod millet.

English: KICD reminds youth in Kirinyaga County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kirinyaga in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne rowere man Kirinyaga County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar chiemo kod mar rwako welo.

English: UNICEF Kenya Humanitarian Situation Report No. 5 (Drought): 30 September 2022
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Hali ya Kibinadamu ya UNICEF Kenya Nambari 5 (Ukame): 30 Septemba 2022
Somali: Warbixinta Xaaladda Bani'aadamnimada ee UNICEF Kenya Lambarka 5 (Abaarta): 30 Sebtembar 2022
Dholuo: Ripot mar chal mar konyo dhano mar UNICEF e piny Kenya namba 5 (Oro): 30 dwe mar apar higa mar 2022

English: NPS urges the public in Tharaka-Nithi County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: NPS inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za ujumbe wa udanganyifu.
Somali: NPS waxay ugu baaqaysaa shacabka degmada Tharaka-Nithi inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo ji duto e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo weche mag phishing.

English: Pest Control Products Board informs fish farmers in Mombasa County of new market linkage opportunities this September.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawafahamisha wafugaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Septemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku wargalinayaa kalluumeysatada ku nool gobolka Mombasa fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products nyiso jopur ma pidho rech e county mar Mombasa kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Septemba.

English: KTDA announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for cattle in Mandera County this April.
Kiswahili: KTDA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Mandera Aprili hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo cudurka Newcastle ah oo loogu talagalay lo'da Gobolka Mandera bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: KTDA olando chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar Newcastle e dwe mar April e kaunti mar Mandera.

English: KUCCPS opened its portal for course revision for 2025/2026 placement targeting 2024 KCSE candidates and past candidates from 2000 to 2024.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS ilifungua jukwaa lake la marekebisho ya kozi kwa ajili ya nafasi za 2025/2026, ikilenga wagombea 2024 wa KCSE na wa zamani kutoka 2000 hadi 2024.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay furtay boggeeda dib-u-eegista koorsooyinka 2025/2026 oo bartilmaameedsanaya 2024 musharixiin KCSE ah iyo musharrixiin hore laga bilaabo 2000 ilaa 2024.
Dholuo: KUCCPS oseyawo dhoot mare mar nono somo mar somo mar 2025/2026, motudore gi jopuonjre 2024 mag KCSE kod jopuonjre machon chakre higa mar 2000 nyaka 2024.

English: Kenya: abductions of citizens suspected of involvement in protests violate human rights
Kiswahili: Kenya: utekaji nyara wa raia wanaoshukiwa kuhusika na maandamano unakiuka haki za binadamu
Somali: Kenya: Afduubka muwaadiniinta looga shakisan yahay inay ku lug lahaayeen dibadbaxyada ayaa xadgudub ku ah xuquuqda aadanaha
Dholuo: Kenya: mako jodak ma igeno ni gin e lwenje mag kwedo ng’anjo ketho ratiro mag dhano

English: Severe cough fir a child can be a sign of malaria of transmission of cold. Visit hospital for testing
Kiswahili: Kutokwa na kikohozi kikubwa mtoto anaweza kuwa dalili ya malaria ya kuambukizwa baridi. Tembelea hospitali kwa ajili ya upimaji
Somali: Xaaladda qandho daran ee ilmaha waxay calaamad u noqon kartaa cudurka malarya ama gudbinta qabowga.
Dholuo: Nyathi nyalo bedo gi tuwo mar malaria kata tuwo mar koyo.

English: FAO encourages farmers in Laikipia County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for tea.
Kiswahili: FAO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa ili kupata bei bora za chai.
Somali: FAO waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Laikipia inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan shaaha.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e county mar Laikipia mondo oti gi nengo matin mar chai mondo giyud nengo maber mar chai.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Embu County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi diiwaan-gelin ah oo loogu talagalay beeraleyda degmada Embu bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro timo tiegruok mar rito rekod mag jopur ne jopur e County mar Embu e dwe mar Agost.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges residents of Kisii County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga kama dambaysta ah si loo qaabeeyo goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Kisii mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso chenro mag dongruok.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds residents of Kiambu County that access to national ID applications is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba kufikia maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Kiambu in helitaanka codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties parone jogweng' mar County mar Kiambu ni yudo kwayo mag ID mar piny sani yot ahinya kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal.

English: KRA reminds residents of Meru County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: KRA parone jogweng' mar Meru County ni luwo dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Nyandarua County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa usaidizi wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow si ay uga caawiyaan helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ee lacageed.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni mondo giyud kony mar yudo thieth makonyo.

English: Public and private partnership opens new COP centre next to MKU campus to promote neighborhood policing engagement
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano wa umma na binafsi unafungua kituo kipya cha COP karibu na chuo cha MKU ili kukuza ushirikiano wa polisi wa jirani
Somali: Wada-shaqaynta dadweynaha iyo kuwa gaarka loo leeyahay ayaa xarun cusub oo COP ah ka furmay xarunta MKU si kor loogu qaado ka-qaybgalka booliska xaafadda
Dholuo: Riwruok mar ji duto gi jomamoko oseyawo kama manyien mar COP machiegni gi kampus mar MKU mondo okony joma rito polise e alworagi

English: COMESA reminds residents of Garissa County that organic farming improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba kilimo hai kinaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: COMESA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Garissa in beeraha dabiiciga ah uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: COMESA paronwa jogweng' mar County mar Garissa ni pur ma nigi gik mochido konyo e miyo puothe obed gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: Notice: IPOA issues a cybersecurity alert on SIM-swap fraud affecting residents of Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa SIM-swap inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogaysiis: IPOA waxay soo saartaa digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaanooyinka SIM-swap ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IPOA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag sirkal e wi wuond mag SIM-swap makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Bungoma County.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens a new service point for passport services in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee Gobolka Garissa.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Jondiko mar Riwruok mag Pinje Oyawo kama itimee tije mag kawo kad e gweng' mar Garissa.

English: Embu (Mbeere) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Embu (Mbeere): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Mei 2023
Somali: Degmada Embu (Mbeere): War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Embu (Mbeere): Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar dwe mar abich higa mar 2023

English: KEMRI reminds the public that free youth mental wellness support is available through county health facilities in Samburu County.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa afya ya akili ya vijana unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Samburu.
Dholuo: KEMRI oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar paro mar rowere yudore maonge chudo kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Samburu.

English: IPOA reminds the public in Makueni County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuendelea kuwa macho katika kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Makueni in ay ka feejignaadaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa ji duto e gweng' mar Makueni mondo obed motang' ne loso kuwe e piny mangima.

English: Notice: KALRO will open a coffee collection centre in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya kahawa katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay ka furi doontaa xarun ururinta kafeega ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KALRO biro yawo kambi mar choko chai e taon mar Elgeyo-Marakwet e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: EACC launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Nyandarua County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhanka ah gobolka Nyandarua bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: Rapar: EACC chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Nyandarua e dwe mar Agost.

English: CDC launches a September awareness campaign on tobacco control across Wajir County.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Septemba juu ya udhibiti wa tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: CDC waxay bilaabeysaa olole wacyi galineed bishii Sebtember ee ka dhanka ah xakamaynta sigaarka ee Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: CDC chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Septemba e wi thieth mar ndawa e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: National exams field administration runs from October 17 to November 21.
Kiswahili: Usimamizi wa uwanja wa mitihani ya kitaifa hufanyika kutoka Oktoba 17 hadi Novemba 21.
Somali: Maamulka imtixaanka qaranka wuxuu socdaa laga bilaabo Oktoobar 17 illaa Nofeembar 21.
Dholuo: Chenro mar timo penj mag piny mangima chakre Oktoba 17 nyaka Novemba 21.

English: SHA urges residents of Meru County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru wapewe huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay dalbadaan bixinta adeegyada iyada oo aan la bixin laaluush si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: SHA ojiwo jogweng' mar Meru County mondo okonygi gi tij lendo maok gichiwo asoya mondo giked gi timbe mag mibadhi.

English: County leaders and stakeholders should prepare for upcoming discussions on agricultural advancement with the World Bank Stay informed for details on participation opportunities
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa kaunti na washikadau wanapaswa kujiandaa kwa mijadala ijayo kuhusu maendeleo ya kilimo na Benki ya Dunia Endelea kufahamishwa kwa maelezo zaidi kuhusu fursa za ushiriki.
Somali: Hoggaamiyeyaasha gobollada iyo daneeyayaasha waa inay isu diyaariyaan wadahadallo soo socda oo ku saabsan horumarinta beeraha ee Bangiga Adduunka La soco faahfaahinta fursadaha ka qaybgalka
Dholuo: Jotelo mag county kod joma nie bwo loch onego oikre ne mbaka mabiro e wi dongruok mar pur gi World Bank

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service restricts movement of poultry in Kiambu County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya yazuia harakati za kuku katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi wenye uvimbe.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa digaagga Gobolka Kiambu sababo la xiriira faafitaanka cudurka maqaarka.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service ogeng'o wuoth mar le e Kaunti mar Kiambu nikech tuwo mar dhoot.

English: Narok County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Narok: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Aprili 2023
Somali: Degmada Narok: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Narok: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar ang'wen higa mar 2023
