English: Kenya Forest Service warns residents of Uasin Gishu County to prepare for possible drought this August.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kujiandaa kwa ukame unaowezekana Agosti hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ka digay dadka deggan gobolka Uasin Gishu inay isu diyaariyaan abaaraha iman kara bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service osiemo jogweng' Uasin Gishu County mondo oikre ne oro ma nyalo betie e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations conducts a community briefing on community early-warning systems in Meru County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inafanya muhtasari wa jamii juu ya mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii katika Kaunti ya Meru Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada wuxuu qabtaa aqoon-isweydaarsi bulshada ku saabsan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada ee degmada Meru bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Directorate of Criminal Investigations timo romo mar oganda e dwe mar Jun e wi chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda e kaunti mar Meru.

English: Health Chief Administrative Secretary, Dr. Rashid Aman, today flagged off vehicles procured through the support of @gavi to boost the national vaccine & immunization program activities in the Counties of Garissa, Lamu, Mandera, Wajir, West Pokot & Nandi. #KomeshaCorona update.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu wa Utawala wa Afya, Dkt. Rashid Aman, leo ameashiria magari yaliyonunuliwa kupitia usaidizi wa @gavi ili kuimarisha shughuli za mpango wa kitaifa wa chanjo na chanjo katika Kaunti za Garissa, Lamu, Mandera, Wajir, Pokot Magharibi na Nandi. #KomeshaCorona sasisho.
Somali: Xoghayaha Maamulka ee Caafimaadka, Dr. Rashid Aman, ayaa maanta calaamadeeyay gawaari lagu soo iibiyay taageerada @gavi si loo xoojiyo howlaha barnaamijka tallaalka iyo tallaalka qaranka ee degmooyinka Garissa, Lamu, Mandheera, Wajir, Galbeedka Pokot iyo Nandi. #Warbixinta #KomeshaCorona.
Dholuo: Od bura maduong’ mar thieth, Dr. #KomeshaKorona ma manyien.

English: Public notice: Kenya Medical Association will host a free hand hygiene outreach in Lamu County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mikono bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Lamu Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu marti gelin doonaa dhaqdhaqaaqa nadaafadda gacmaha ee bilaashka ah ee Gobolka Lamu bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association biro timo kampen mar rito ler mar lwedo e County mar Lamu e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on the community in Kiambu County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa bulshada degmada Kiambu ugu baaqaya inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wacayaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations okwayo ji duto manie County mar Kiambu mondo owuo e wi timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong simo mar GBV 1195.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds voters in Kisii County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya codbixiyayaasha degmada Kisii inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor inta aysan helin waxbarasho codbixinayaasha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone josiasa e County mar Kisii ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom SMS ne ji 70000 kapok giyudo tiegruok.

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages residents of Wajir County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Wajir inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay ku dhiirigeliso saaxiibka dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' mar Wajir County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo gijiw osiepgi moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Bomet County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Bomet in adeegyada bukaanka dibedda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMSA oparo ne ji duto e County mar Bomet ni koro ginyalo yudo kony mag thieth mag ambulatori e kuonde moyier.

English: Notice: e-Citizen opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Busia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa ajili ya usajili wa e-citizen katika Wilaya ya Busia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: e-Citizen waxay ka furaysaa barta adeegga cusub ee diiwaangelinta e-citizen ee degmada Busia.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: e-Citizen oseyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag ndiko ji e e - Citizen e county mar Busia.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Bungoma County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo kwayo mar kwedo mibadhi e migepe mag sirkal.

English: Epidemiological impact and cost-effectiveness analysis of COVID-19 vaccination in Kenya
Kiswahili: Athari za janga na uchanganuzi wa ufaafu wa gharama wa chanjo ya COVID-19 nchini Kenya
Somali: Saamaynta cudurrada faafa iyo falanqaynta kharash-oolnimada tallaalka COVID-19 ee Kenya
Dholuo: Nonro mar chanjo mar COVID-19 e piny Kenya e wi tuwo ma landore kod bero nengo mar pesa

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMRI will be held in Nandi County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMRI itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Nandi Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay KEMRI ayaa lagu qaban doonaa gobolka Nandi bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma KEMRI ochano biro timore e county mar Nandi e dwe mar Januar.

English: NPS urges residents of Laikipia County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NPS inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa umakini mkubwa wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay iskaashi ku sameeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: NPS ojiwo jogweng' Laikipia County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji ng'enyie e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom loso kuwe e piny.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Trans Nzoia County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the January planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kudhibiti wizi wa jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa za kuua wadudu zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Januari.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia County in ay ka hortagaan weerarka ciidanka dayrta ee hore iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaanka la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beerashada ee Janaayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur e Trans Nzoia County mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma oseyudo ratiro mar chango jolweny e dwe mar Januar.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Bungoma County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma in warbixinta degdegga ah ee xanta xoolaha ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NTSA parone jogweng'o mag Bungoma County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo jamni konyo rito kuonde modakie.

English: ODPP encourages first-time voters in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogo ma ne okwongo yiero e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo onon weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: NCPB encourages farmers in Samburu County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za mahindi.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Samburu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay hadhuudhka.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e county mar Samburu mondo odonj e riwruok mar riwruok ma nigi ratiro mar timo tich mondo giyud nengo maber mar kodhi.

English: Key findings: Wajir County - Mobility Tracking Round 2, 1 - 18 November 2023
Kiswahili: Matokeo muhimu: Kaunti ya Wajir - Ufuatiliaji wa Uhamaji Awamu ya 2, 1 - 18 Novemba 2023
Somali: Natiijooyinka Muhiimka ah: Degmada Wajeer - Wareega 2aad ee Raad-raaca Dhaqdhaqaaqa, 1 - 18 Noofambar 2023
Dholuo: Duong' maduong' ma oyudre: Kaunti mar Wajir - Luwo wuoth mar 2, 1 nyaka 18 dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2023

English: KUCCPS urges residents of Murang'a County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from free primary education.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Murang'a mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud somo ma onge chudo.

English: NPS calls on the community in Nyeri County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: NPS waxay bulshada degmada Nyeri ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: NPS okwayo ji duto manie County mar Nyeri mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gichiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: KTDA reminds livestock keepers in Uasin Gishu County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KTDA waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee gobolka Uasin Gishu inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanada buka xafiiska xayawaanka ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KTDA paronwa jorit jamni e county mar Uasin Gishu ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) promotes organic farming among farmers in Nakuru County as part of the July climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inakuza kilimo hai miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Julai.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kor u qaadeysaa beeraha dabiiciga ah ee beeraleyda degmada Nakuru iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo tij pur e kind jopur e gweng' mar Nakuru kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi mar dwe mar Julai.

English: Vulnerability, Risk, and Resilience: The implications for the drivers of malnutrition in Isiolo and Marsabit Counties, Kenya
Kiswahili: Udhaifu, Hatari, na Ustahimilivu: Athari kwa vichochezi vya utapiamlo katika Kaunti za Isiolo na Marsabit, Kenya.
Somali: Nuglaanta, Khatarta, iyo Adkeysiga: Saamaynta ay ku yeelan karaan waxyaabaha keena nafaqo-darrada ee degmooyinka Isiolo iyo Marsabit, Kenya
Dholuo: Kaka ng’ato nyalo bedo gi pek, bedo gi luoro, kod bedo gi nyalo mar ng’ado bura: Gik ma nyalo timore ne jogo ma kelo bedo gi chiemo ma ok oromo e gwenge mag Isiolo kod Marsabit, piny Kenya

English: Kwale County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kwale: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2024
Somali: Degmada Kwale: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kwale: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar adek higa mar 2024

English: Unlike acute heatwaves, chronic heat refers to sustained periods of elevated temperatures that can silently undermine health and wellbeing of populations and ecosystem as well as critical sectors such as transport, energy, agriculture and infrastructure.
Kiswahili: Tofauti na mawimbi ya joto kali, joto sugu hurejelea vipindi endelevu vya viwango vya juu vya joto ambavyo vinaweza kudhoofisha afya na ustawi wa watu na mfumo ikolojia kimya kimya na sekta muhimu kama vile usafiri, nishati, kilimo na miundombinu.
Somali: Si ka duwan hirarka kulaylka daran, kulaylka daba-dheeraada waxaa loola jeedaa xilliyo joogto ah oo heerkul sarreeya oo si aamusnaan ah u wiiqi kara caafimaadka iyo fayoobaanta dadka iyo nidaamka deegaanka iyo sidoo kale qaybaha muhiimka ah sida gaadiidka, tamarta, beeraha iyo kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha.
Dholuo: Mopogore gi yamo mager mag liet, liet ma ok rum nyiso kinde ma liet ma malo nyalo ketho ngima kod ngima maber mar oganda kod gik ma dongo e piny kaachiel gi sektor madongo kaka ng’iepo, teko, pur kod gedo mag piny.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) urges farmers in Kericho County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kericho inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e county mar Kericho mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e weche mag pur mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Notice: COMESA restricts movement of cattle in Machakos County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA inazuia harakati za ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Machakos kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da degmada Machakos sababo la xiriira faafitaanka cudurka maqaarka.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok e County ma Machakos nikech tuoche mag pien.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) advises residents of Samburu County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Samburu inay qaataan dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado dib u dhac marka la raadinayo adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) nyiso jogweng' mar county mar Samburu ni giting'e buge duto madwarore mondo kik gideki sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport.

English: Kenya - Landslide and floods, update (Meteo Kenya, media) (ECHO Daily Flash of 7 November 2025)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Maporomoko ya ardhi na mafuriko, sasisho (Meteo Kenya, vyombo vya habari) (ECHO Daily Flash ya 7 Novemba 2025)
Somali: Kenya - Dhul-go' iyo daadad, warbixin cusub (Meteo Kenya, warbaahinta) (ECHO Daily Flash ee 7 Noofambar 2025)
Dholuo: Kenya - Ong'ol mar piny kod pi mopong'o piny, loso (Meteo Kenya, lendo) (Rieny ma pile ka pile mar 7 dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2025)

English: Kajiado County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kajiado: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Oktoba 2023
Somali: Degmada Kajiado: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kajiado: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar 2023

English: HELB invites youth in Kiambu County to enroll for motor vehicle mechanics training this September.
Kiswahili: HELB inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari Septemba hii.
Somali: HELB waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kiambu inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka mashiinka gawaarida gaadiidka bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: HELB gwelo rowere e gweng' mar Kiambu mondo odonj e tiegruok mar jomisonari mag mtokni e dwe mar Septemba.

English: FAO urges millet growers in Lamu County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Lamu kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda millet ee degmada Lamu inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si loo wanaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma pidho millet e County mar Lamu mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo okony e medo nyak mar cham e higani.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges farmers in Kajiado County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kajiado inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee beeraha cimilada ee caqli-galka ah si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur e Kajiado County mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi pur mar piny mondo ginyagre gi lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the public in Kwale County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawahimiza raia wa Kaunti ya Kwale wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadweynaha degmada Kwale inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khiyaamo ah ee SIM-swap.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ji duto e County mar Kwale mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' weche mag wuond mar SIM-swap.

English: Notice: NTSA conducts a community briefing on community early-warning systems in Bomet County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Bomet Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada oo ku saabsan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada ee degmada Bomet bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Riwruok mar NTSA timo romo mar lendo e wi chenro mag chiwo siem chon e alwora mar Bomet County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: KALRO reminds farmers in Mandera County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Somali: KALRO waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Mandera barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada.
Dholuo: KALRO oparo ne jopur e county mar Mandera chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche.

English: E-Citizen advises residents of Garissa County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Garissa inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: E-Citizen nyiso joma odak e County mar Garissa mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport.

English: Notice: KUCCPS announces bursary allocation enrollment dates for schools in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa bursary kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ee dugsiyada gobolka Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KUCCPS ogolo chenro mar somo e skunde mag Kirinyaga County.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on residents of Tana River County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Uhalifu unawaomba wakazi wa Wilaya ya Tana River kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ugu baaqay dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay u sheegaan hay'adaha amniga dhaqdhaqaaq aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah si ay u taageeraan taxadarka ka dhanka ah argagixisada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations okwayo jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma rito sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e tong'gi.

English: Ministry of Education conducts a civic education forum on voter registration in Garissa County this February.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Garissa Februari hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa bishii Febraayo ku qabanaysa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha degmada Garissa.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda e dwe mar Februar e county mar Garissa.

English: Notice: EACC launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kirinyaga County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhanka ah gobolka Kirinyaga bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Rapar: EACC chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Kirinyaga e dwe mar Jun.

English: Govâ€™t extends nationwide curfew, ban on public gatherings until May 29
Kiswahili: Serikali yaongeza muda wa kutotoka nje nchini kote, kupiga marufuku mikusanyiko ya umma hadi Mei 29
Somali: Dowladdu waxay kordhisay bandowga dalka oo dhan, waxayna mamnuucday isu imaatinka dadweynaha ilaa 29-ka May
Dholuo: Sirkal ok medo kafiu e piny mangima, chik mar geng'o chokruok mag ji nyaka tarik 29 dwe mar Mei

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will train farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County on water harvesting this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya uvunaji wa maji Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu tababar siin doonaa beeraleyda degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet oo ku saabsan goosashada biyaha bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Dairy Board biro tiego jopur e County mar Elgeyo-Marakwet e wi choko pi e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges coffee growers in Busia County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Busia kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Busia inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobka si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e county mar Busia mondo oti gi ratiro ma gichiwo mar chamo olemo kapok koth ochue mondo okony e medo nyak mar olemo e higani.

English: Notice: NCPB restricts movement of dairy cows in Kajiado County due to an anthrax outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB inazuia harakati za ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kutokana na mlipuko wa kimeta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da caanaha ah ee Gobolka Kajiado sababo la xiriira cudurka Anthrax.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NCPB ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok makwayo e Kajiado County nikech tuwo mar anthrax.

English: Ministry of Health launches an October awareness campaign on proper sanitation across Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Oktoba juu ya usafi wa mazingira katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay billowday olole wacyigelin ah oo Oktoobar ah oo ku saabsan nadaafadda saxda ah ee degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health osechako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Oktoba e wi thieth mowinjore e gweng' mar Baringo.

English: Store sharp, toxic, or breakable items out of children_x0092_s reach to prevent injuries.
Kiswahili: Weka vitu vyenye makali, vyenye sumu, au vinavyoweza kuvunjika mbali na watoto ili kuepuka kuumia.
Somali: Alaabta fiiqan, sunta ah, ama jabaysa ku kaydi meel aan carruurta_x0092_s gaarin si looga hortago dhaawacyada.
Dholuo: Ket gik mabith, ma nigi kwiri, kata manyalo kethore kama nyithindo ok nyal chopoe mondo kik giyud hinyruok.

English: EHAGL Region: Community Feedback Analysis Report, October - December 2024
Kiswahili: Eneo la EHAGL: Ripoti ya Uchambuzi wa Maoni ya Jamii, Oktoba - Desemba 2024
Somali: Gobolka EHAGL: Warbixinta Falanqaynta Jawaab celinta Bulshada, Oktoobar - Diseembar 2024
Dholuo: Kidieny mar EHAGL: Ripot mar Nonro Duoko mag Oganda, Oktoba - Desimba 2024

English: KEMRI appeals to caregivers in Kisii County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the June maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kisii kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya harakati za afya ya uzazi za Juni.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Kisii inay ilmahooda u keenaan kormeerka koritaanka iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee bisha Juun.
Dholuo: KEMRI okwayo jorit e county mar Kisii mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo kaka achiel kuom gik ma timore e dwe mar Jun e weche thieth mar mine.

English: Announcement that local farmer cooperatives are now contracted to supply nutritious meals directly to schools under new pilot model.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwamba vyama vya ushirika vya wakulima wa eneo hilo sasa vimepewa mkataba wa kusambaza milo yenye lishe moja kwa moja shuleni chini ya mfumo mpya wa majaribio.
Somali: Ogeysiis ah in iskaashatada beeraleyda maxalliga ah hadda loo qandaraasleeyay inay si toos ah ugu siiyaan iskuulada cuntooyin nafaqo leh iyadoo la raacayo qaab cusub oo tijaabo ah.
Dholuo: Owacho ni koro riwruoge mag jopur manie alworano osechano mar chiwo chiemo moromo e skunde e bwo ranyisi manyien mar tich.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response calls on parents in Migori County to have children under five screened for cholera during the October outreach.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Migori kuwafanya watoto chini ya miaka mitano wachunguzwe kipindupindu wakati wa mawasiliano ya Oktoba.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku baaqeysaa waalidiinta Degmada Migori inay carruurta ka yar shan sano u sameeyaan baaritaanka cudurka kolera inta lagu jiro bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche kwayo jonyuol e County mar Migori mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) urges farmers in Baringo County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Baringo inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee beeraha cimilada ee caqli-galka ah si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e county mar Baringo mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e weche mag pur mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok mar koth.

English: KICD reminds parents in Kisumu County that free day secondary education registration is open this August.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba usajili wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo utafunguliwa Agosti hii.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Kisumu in diiwaangelinta dugsiga dhexe ee bilaashka ah ay furan tahay bisha August.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne jonyuol ma Kisumu County ni somo mar sekondari mar odiechieng' achiel ma onge chudo osechakore e dwe mar Agost.

English: Ministry of Education conducts a civic education forum on voter registration in Kajiado County this September.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kajiado Septemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha degmada Kajiado bishii Sebtember ee sannadkan.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Puonjruok dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi ndiko joma oyiero e Kajiado County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges residents of Laikipia County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: Waaxda waxbarashada aasaasiga ah ee dowladda waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Laikipia mondo okonygi kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud kony kuom program mar chiemo e skul.

English: Are you enjoying relaxing by the water this summer? Be safe around the water. Learn about drowning prevention tips.
Kiswahili: Je, unafurahia kupumzika karibu na maji msimu huu? Mwe salama karibu na maji na ujifunze dokezo za kuzuia kuzama majini.
Somali: Ma ku raaxaysataa inaad ku nasato biyaha agtooda xagaagan? Ku nabad gal agagaarka biyaha. Baro talooyinka ka hortagga qarqidda.
Dholuo: Be imor gi yweyo e dho nam e kinde ng’ichni? Bed gi ritruok e alwora mar pi. Inyalo ng’eyo yore mag geng’o ng’ato mondo kik odonj e pi.

English: IEBC reminds residents of Nandi County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nandi in ay ku hawlan yihiin maamulaha qaybta maxalliga ah si loo xoojiyo maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: IEBC parone jogweng' kaunti mar Nandi ni tudruok gi jotelo mag gwenge maggi miyo sirkal bedo gi loch maber.

English: DCI urges residents of Mandera County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: DCI inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera inay soo sheegaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo loo marayo dadaal sare oo loo qabo amniga xuduudda.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo jogweng'o mag Mandera County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkande mag sirkal e wi gik ma ne timore e alwora mar tong'gi nikech sirkal ne medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom weche sirkal.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds expectant mothers in Kiambu County that access to childhood immunization is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba upatikanaji wa chanjo ya utotoni ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Kiambu in helitaanka tallaalka carruurta ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Kiambu ni yudo thieth mar nyithindo onge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: DPP urges anyone experiencing abuse in Taita-Taveta County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: DPP inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta apeleke simu ya simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Taita-Taveta inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: DPP ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e Taita-Taveta County mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195 maonge chudo.

English: EACC reminds residents of Migori County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Migori kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Migori in ka qaybgalka maamulaha qaybta deegaanka ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: EACC parone jogweng' Migori County ni tudruok gi jorit mar gwenge maggi miyo sirkal bedo gi loch maber.

English: IEBC reminds voters in Kiambu County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Kiambu in ay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor inta aysan helin waxbarasho codbixinayaasha.
Dholuo: IEBC parone jogweng' Kiambu County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom SMS ne ji 70000 kapok giyudo tiegruok.

English: Every day, we are vulnerable to a new outbreak, disease, pandemic or virus. Recent ones include the Marburg virus, Mpox, Ebola, Zika and the nightmarish experience we faced during the Covid-19 pandemic.
Kiswahili: Kila siku, tuko katika hatari ya kupata mlipuko mpya, ugonjwa, janga au virusi. Vipya ni pamoja na virusi vya Marburg, Mpox, Ebola, Zika na tukio baya tulilokabiliana nalo wakati wa janga la Covid-19.
Somali: Maalin kasta, waxaan u nugul nahay cudur cusub, cudur, masiibo ama fayras. Kuwa ugu dambeeyay waxaa ka mid ah fayraska Marburg, Mpox, Ebola, Zika iyo khibradda masiibada ah ee aan la kulanay intii lagu jiray masiibadda Covid-19.
Dholuo: Odiechieng' kodiechieng', waduto wan gi tuoche manyien, tuoche, masiche mag tuoche kata tuoche mamoko. Moko kuom masiche ma nyocha otimore gin mar Marburg virus, Mpox, Ebola, Zika kod masiche maricho ma ne wayudo e kinde mar tuoche mag Covid-19.

English: IEBC encourages residents of Kericho County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay ka qeybgalaan madasha dadweynaha degmada si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadwaynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogweng' Kericho County mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar jopiny mar county mondo ging'e kaka jopiny biro tiyo gi bajet mag county.

English:
Take a journal and note down how your days are and how you're feeling.

Examine your thoughts written over time and soon they become clearer and hidden thoughts and feelings come to the surface to bring a more complete light to the situation.
Kiswahili: Chukua jarida na uandike jinsi siku zako zilivyo na jinsi unavyohisi, uchunguze mawazo yako yaliyoandikwa kwa muda na hivi karibuni yatakuwa wazi zaidi na mawazo na hisia zilizofichwa zitakuja kwenye uso ili kuleta nuru kamili zaidi ya hali hiyo.
Somali: Qaado qoraal qoraal ah oo qor sida ay u socdaan maalmahaaga iyo sida aad dareento. Tijaabi fikradahaada qoraalka ah waqtiga ka dibna si dhakhso ah ayay u noqdaan kuwo cad oo fikirrada iyo dareenka qarsoon ay soo baxaan si ay u keenaan iftiin dhammaystiran xaaladda.
Dholuo: Kaw buk mondik e dendi mondo ine kaka in iwuon iwuoyo e wi odiechieng'no kod kaka iwinjo e chunyi.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by CDC will be held in Wajir County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na CDC itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Wajir Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabiyeen CDC ayaa lagu qaban doonaa gobolka Wajir bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kampen mar thieth ma onge chudo ma CDC ochano ibiro tim e County mar Wajir e dwe mar Agost.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises maize producers in Makueni County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inashauri wazalishaji wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa soo saarayaasha hadhuudhka ee degmada Makueni inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur mag mahinya e gweng' mar Makueni ni giusgi mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo gigo kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) urges sweet potatoes growers in Isiolo County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawasihi wakulima wa viazi baridi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kutumia viwango vinavyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda baradho macaan ee degmada Isiolo inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur ma pidho mbese mag Isiolo County mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue mondo omed nyak e higani.

English: Kenya Gazette encourages first-time voters in Nyandarua County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa codbixiyayaasha ugu horreeya ee degmada Nyandarua inay soo booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogo ma ne okwongo yiero e county mar Nyandarua mondo olim kama ichikoe ji ne IEBC.

English: KMTC reminds needy students in Elgeyo-Marakwet County that revision guides applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KMTC waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in dib-u-eegista ay ku hagaajinayso codsiyada la soo gabagabeeyo.
Dholuo: KMTC oparo ne jopuonjre man gi chandruok e County mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni lokruok mar gwelo kwayo mag kwayo biro rumo machiegni.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Vihiga County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kumhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Vihiga inuu ku dhiirrigeliyo saaxiibkiisa dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar paro e County mar Vihiga mondo ojiw osiepne moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: Universities Fund invites youth in Marsabit County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this February.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Februari hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku martiqaadey dhalinyarada degmada Marsabit inay iska diiwaangeliyaan tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund gwelo rowere mag Marsabit County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing e dwe mar Februar.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds farmers in Baringo County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Baringo juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa xusuusinaya beeraleyda degmada Baringo barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee xakamaynta cayayaannada iyo cudurrada.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jopur e gweng' mar Baringo chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar kedo gi hinyruok kod tuoche.

English: Ministry of Education reminds needy students in Wajir County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan Gobolka Wajir in deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay codsiyada ardayda baahan ay dhowaan soo gabagabeyn doonaan.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok parone jopuonjre man gi chan e gweng' mar Wajir ni tuke mag somo ne jopuonjre ma nigi chan biro rumo machiegni.

English: Kiawamururu Farmers Cooperative is now offering a payout of Ksh 142 30 per kilogram of cherry and Ksh 470 50 for Mbuni for the 2025 2026 season
Kiswahili: Kiawamururu Farmers Cooperative sasa inatoa malipo ya Ksh 142 30 kwa kilo ya cheri na Ksh 470 50 kwa Mbuni kwa msimu wa 2025 2026.
Somali: Iskaashiga Beeraleyda Kiawamururu hadda wuxuu bixinayaa lacag dhan Ksh 142.30 halkii kiilo kiilo oo cherry ah iyo Ksh 470.50 Mbuni xilli ciyaareedka 2025 iyo 2026
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Jo-Purie mar Kiawamururu koro chiwo pesa mar Ksh 142 30 kuom kilo achiel mar yiend yiend yiendgi kod Ksh 470 50 kuom Mbuni e higa mar 2025-2026

English: CDC urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Nandi County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: CDC inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: CDC waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee gobolka Nandi inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nyagore gi tuoche mag obwongo e county mar Nandi mondo odhi ir japuonj molony.

English: FAO reminds livestock keepers in Narok County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Narok kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Narok inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha ka guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyaga oo aan haysan rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: FAO parone jorit jamni man Narok County ni kik giting' jamni e gweng'no maok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Makueni County that access to nutrition supplementation for infants is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba upatikanaji wa nyongeza ya lishe kwa watoto wachanga ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Makueni in helitaanka cuntada lagu daro dhallaanka ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa mine ma biro bedo gi ich e gweng' mar Makueni ni yudo chiemo moromo ne nyithindo mayom en gima onge chudo e ute duto mag oganda.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross will hold a stress management forum in Siaya County this March. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utafanya kongamano la kudhibiti mafadhaiko katika Kaunti ya Siaya Machi hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay qaban doontaa madasha xakamaynta stress-ka ee degmada Siaya bishii Maarso. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: 'Kenya Red Cross' biro timo romo mar kedo gi parruok e taon mar Siaya e dwe mar Mach.

English: Samburu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for December 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Samburu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Desemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Samburu: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Diseembar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Samburu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2022

English: Kenya | Joint Market Monitoring Initiative (JMMI) Dadaab and Kakuma Refugee Camp, Q3 2025 (July - September 2025)
Kiswahili: Kenya | Mpango wa Pamoja wa Ufuatiliaji wa Soko (JMMI) Dadaab na Kambi ya Wakimbizi ya Kakuma, Q3 2025 (Julai - Septemba 2025)
Somali: Kenya | Hindisaha Wadajirka ah ee La Socodka Suuqa (JMMI) Xerada Qaxootiga ee Dhadhaab iyo Kakuma, Q3 2025 (Luulyo - Sebtembar 2025)
Dholuo: Kenya | Chenro mar Rang'o Chiro Riwre (JMMI) Dadaab kod Kambi mar Jolweny mag Kakuma, dwe mar adek dwe mar adek higa mar 2025 (dwe mar abiriyo - dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2025)

English: Notice: Council of Governors launches ward-level service delivery in Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linazindua huduma za huduma katika wilaya ya Marsabit.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay bilaabeen bixinta adeegyada heerka degmada ee degmada Marsabit.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Jaloch ochako chiwo kony e alwora mar Marsabit County.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges residents of Bungoma County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on community-based development programmes.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca bogga internetka ee degmada si ay uga warqabaan barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General jiwo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mag dongruok e kind oganda.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free tuberculosis screening is available at all public health centres in Homa Bay County this August.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kifua kikuu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Agosti hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka caabuqa ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynta ee gobolka Homa Bay bishii Ogosto.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone ji ni thieth mar thieth ma onge nengo mar tuo mar tuberculosis yudore e kuonde thieth duto e Homa Bay County e dwe mar Agost.

English: Kenya - Northern Kenya: Drought Severity and Population Exposure in Mandera County (28 Jan 2026)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Kaskazini mwa Kenya: Ukali wa Ukame na Mfichuo wa Idadi ya Watu katika Kaunti ya Mandera (28 Januari 2026)
Somali: Kenya - Waqooyiga Kenya: Heerka Abaarta iyo Soo-gaadhista Dadka ee Degmada Mandheera (28 Jannaayo 2026)
Dholuo: Kenya - Kenya ma Nyanduat: Pek mar oro kod kwan mar oganda e gweng' mar mandera (28 dwe mar achiel higa mar 2026)

English: KUCCPS reminds needy students in Kakamega County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Kakamega in buugaag iyo codsiyada wax lagu barto ay dhowaan soo gabagabeyn doonaan.
Dholuo: KUCCPS parone jopuonjre man Kakamega County ni buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok biro rumo machiegni.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) appeals to caregivers in Migori County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the October maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Migori kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Oktoba.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Migori inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta bukaanka ee la qorsheeyay iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Oktoobar.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) kwayo jorit e county mar Migori mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar thieth ma ne otim e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: COMESA urges beans growers in Nyamira County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawataka wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Nyamira inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si kor loogu qaado wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur ma pidho keyo e County mar Nyamira mondo oti gi kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo okony e medo nyak mar yien e higani.

English: Notice: Universities Fund launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu wazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri katika shule kote Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij hagitaan iyo adeegyo la-talin ah oo lagu sameeyo dugsiyada gobolka Nandi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Yunivasiti Fund chako chenro mar tiego kendo chiwo paro e skunde e alwora duto mar Nandi County.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Tana River County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River in si deg deg ah u soo sheegidda tuugada ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NTSA parone jogweng' mar Tana River County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar nek konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) invites residents of Murang'a County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) gwelo ji modak e county mar Murang'a mondo ochiw ripode mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar nono tich mitimo higa ka higa.

English: NPS urges residents of Kajiado County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: NPS inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika kumbi za umma huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa wa kukabiliana na ugaidi.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay iskaashi la sameeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: NPS ojiwo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'iyoe ji nikech ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on the community in Turkana County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Turkana kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka kwa nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Turkana inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga iyo inay taageero ka raadsadaan hoyga ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross okwayo ji duto manie County mar Turkana mondo owuo e wi timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gidwar kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Siaya County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun iyo biyo nadiif ah si joogto ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso joma odak e county mar Siaya mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Nairobi, Kajiado, Machakos, Kiambu & Nakuru counties are individually and collectively declared a disease infected area. There shall be a cessation of movement by road, rail, air in to & out of these areas effective midnight
Kiswahili: Kaunti za Nairobi, Kajiado, Machakos, Kiambu na Nakuru zimetangazwa kuwa eneo lililoathiriwa na magonjwa moja moja na kwa pamoja. Kutakuwa na kusimamishwa kwa usafiri kwa barabara, reli, hewa kuingia na kutoka katika maeneo haya kuanzia saa sita usiku.
Somali: Gobollada Nairobi, Kajiado, Machakos, Kiambu & Nakuru ayaa si gaar ah iyo si wadajir ah loogu dhawaaqay inay yihiin aagag cudurku ku dhacay.
Dholuo: Sirkande mag Nairobi, Kajiado, Machakos, Kiambu & Nakuru ne oler achiel kachiel kendo kanyachiel ni gin kuonde ma tuwono nitie.

English: Universities Fund calls on the community in Makueni County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu bulshada degmada Makueni ugu baaqayaa inay u soo sheegaan mas'uuliyada amniga ee dugsiyada si ay u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyada iskuulada.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund dwaro ni oganda manie Makueni County ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar skul kuom weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds mobile money users in Siaya County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Siaya wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa fedha za simu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Siaya inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN ee M-Pesa si looga fogaado khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e county mar Siaya ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo kik gitim timbe mag wuondo pesa mag simu.

English: ODPP invites residents of Migori County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Migori inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee la xiriira wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: ODPP gwelo jogweng' Migori County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e wi chenro mag chike mag sirkal.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e County mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo oluong kony mar thieth mar paro maonge chudo.

English: ODPP warns public officers in Makueni County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: ODPP inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Makueni dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: ODPP waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Makueni inay musuqmaasuqa ka qaataan xafiisyada dawladda.
Dholuo: ODPP chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e gweng' mar Makueni kuom kawo asoya e migepe mar sirkal.

English: KRA urges eligible citizens in West Pokot County to participate in voter education.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kushiriki katika elimu ya wapiga kura.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada West Pokot inay ka qaybqaataan waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo jokanyo mowinjore e West Pokot County mondo oriwgi e tiegruok mar josiasa.

English: "When girls succeed, entire communities change": A rural shelter in Kenya giving girls hope beyond female genital mutilation
Kiswahili: "Wasichana wanapofaulu, jamii nzima hubadilika": Makazi ya mashambani nchini Kenya yanayowapa wasichana matumaini zaidi ya ukeketaji
Somali: "Marka gabdhuhu guuleystaan, bulshooyinka oo dhan way isbeddelaan": Hoy miyiga ah oo ku yaal Kenya oo gabdhaha siinaya rajo ka baxsan gudniinka fircooniga ah ee dumarka
Dholuo: Ka nyiri otimo maber, oganda duto lokore: Od rito ma ni e gwenge ma Kenya miyo nyiri geno mokalo ng'ado ng'ut mon

English: The Kenya Cash Consortium locally-led and adaptive alert-based cash assistance to disaster-affected communities in Tana River County: Baseline (September, 2024)
Kiswahili: Muungano wa Kenya Cash Consortium unaoongozwa na wenyeji na usaidizi wa arifa unaobadilika kulingana na arifa kwa jamii zilizoathiriwa na maafa katika Kaunti ya Tana River: Msingi (Septemba, 2024)
Somali: Ururka Lacagta Caddaan ee Kenya oo maxalli ahaan hormuud ka ah isla markaana ku salaysan digniin la qabsi ah oo loogu talagalay bulshooyinka ay masiibooyinka saameeyeen ee Degmada Tana River: Saldhigga (Sebtembar, 2024)
Dholuo: Kony mar omwom mar Kenya ma otelo ne jopinyno kendo ma luwo yore mag riembo konyo jodak ma oyudo masira e gweng' mar Aora Tana: Chakruok (Dwe mar Septemba, higa mar 2024)

English: KUCCPS opened its portal for a second course revision for 2024/2025 placement targeting 2023 KCSE candidates with a deadline of June 15 2024.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS ilifungua portal yake kwa marekebisho ya pili ya kozi kwa ajili ya nafasi ya 2024/2025 ambayo inalenga wagombea 2023 wa KCSE na tarehe ya mwisho ya Juni 15, 2024.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay furtay boggeeda dib-u-eegista koorsada labaad ee booska 2024/2025 ee bartilmaameedsanaya musharixiinta 2023 KCSE iyadoo waqtigeedu yahay 15 Juun 2024.
Dholuo: KUCCPS oseyawo dhoot mare mar timo nonro mar ariyo mar tiegruok mar 2024/2025 ne jogo madwaro dhi e KCSE 2023, kendo mano biro timore tarik 15 dwe mar auchiel 2024.

English: E-Citizen reminds the public in Siaya County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this January.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba maoni juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma yanakaribishwa Januari hii.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Siaya in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa ji duto e county mar Siaya ni gibiro yie gi chiwo mag paro e wi chenro mag sirkal e dwe mar Januar.

English: NTSA warns residents of Kilifi County to prepare for possible road accidents this May.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Mei hii.
Somali: NTSA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inay u diyaar garoobaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha May.
Dholuo: NTSA osiemo jogweng' Kilifi County mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Mei.

English: Ministry of Health announces NHIF/SHA claims support for residents of Kajiado County starting this April.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatangaza NHIF/SHA inadai msaada kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kuanzia Aprili hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ku dhawaaqday in NHIF/SHA ay sheegtay in ay taageero siiso dadka deggan degmada Kajiado laga bilaabo Abriil.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health olando ni NHIF/SHA dwaro kony ne jogweng' Kajiado County kochakore April.

English: Public health advisory: Kenya Red Cross warns of increased measles risk in Migori County and advises the public to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya surua katika Kaunti ya Migori na kushauri umma kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ka digtay kororka halista suuxdinta ee degmada Migori waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Chenro mar thieth mar ji: Kenya Red Cross chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar nyol e county mar Migori kendo ojiwo ji mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni kodgi.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross confirms a tuberculosis outbreak alert for Kitui County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa kifua kikuu katika Kaunti ya Kitui. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka hargabka ee Gobolka Kitui. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Red Cross osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuo mar tuberculosis e gweng' mar Kitui.

English: KICD urges parents and teachers in Trans Nzoia County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: KICD inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Somali: KICD waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Trans Nzoia inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo omany simo mar kony ne nyithindo namba 116.

English: Notice: AFA will distribute certified millet seed to farmers in Kakamega County this April.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: AFA itawapa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kakamega mbegu zilizothibitishwa za millet Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay abuuri doontaa abuurka miraha la xaqiijiyay beeraleyda Gobolka Kakamega bisha Abriil ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Inyisowa ni: AFA biro pogo kodhi mag millet ne jopur man Kakamega County e dwe mar April.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response urges residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night following a rise in reported typhoid cases.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kutumia vyandarua vya mbu vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya matumbo vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska la soo sheegay ee tayfooska.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo oti gi net mag choke molos gi yedhe maketho ring'o otieno ka otieno nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuwo mar typhoid osemedore.

English: ODPP reminds voters in Embu County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Embu kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Embu inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor taariikhda doorashada.
Dholuo: ODPP parone jogweng' Embu County mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar timo yiero kapok kinde mag yiero ochopo.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya litafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya West Pokot.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Kenya Gazette waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda gobolka ee Gobolka West Pokot.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Gazette biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e West Pokot County.

English: Notice: KALRO will distribute certified cassava seed to farmers in Murang'a County this April.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KALRO itasambaza mbegu zilizothibitishwa za manii kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay abuurka cassava ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Murang'a bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KALRO biro pogo kodhi mag cassava ne jopur manie Murang'a County e dwe mar April.

English: ... digital agriculture to facilitate sustainability and cost-efficiency. Is climate-smart agriculture enough? Despite the multiple benefits ...

English: Notice: SHA launches the county integrated development plan in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: SHA inazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika Wilaya ya Makueni.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA waxay bilaabaysaa qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Makueni.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova (SHA) chako chenro mar timo dongruok e alwora mar Makueni County.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds farmers in Kitui County of the ongoing fertiliser application training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui juu ya mpango unaoendelea wa mafunzo ya matumizi ya mbolea.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa beeraleyda degmada Kitui barnaamijka tababarka codsiga bacriminta ee socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board parone jopur man Kitui County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar tiyo gi yien mag yien.

English: Public notice: Kenya Red Cross will host a free diabetes screening outreach in Siaya County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utaandaa uhamasishaji wa uchunguzi wa kisukari bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Siaya Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay martigelin doontaa baaritaano bilaash ah oo lagu ogaanayo cudurka macaanka ee degmada Siaya bisha November ee sannadkan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova mar Kenya Red Cross biro timo kampen mar nono tuo mar sukari e dwe mar Novemba e taon mar Siaya County.

English: KEMRI launches a May awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Tana River County.
Kiswahili: KEMRI yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Mei juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Tana River.
Somali: KEMRI waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Maajo oo ku saabsan baaritaanka sonkorowga gobolka Tana River.
Dholuo: KEMRI chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Mei e wi thieth mar sukari e taon duto mar Tana River County.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges residents of Lamu County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida katika maeneo ya mpakani kwa vyombo vya usalama huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa wa ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo jogweng'o mag Lamu County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e alwora mar tong'gi e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom loso kuwe e piny.

English: State Department for Basic Education invites youth in Tharaka-Nithi County to enroll for electrical installation training this August.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Agosti hii.
Somali: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka Tharaka-Nithi waxay ku casuumaysaa dhalinyarada degmada inay iska diiwaangeliyaan tababarka rakibidda korontada bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education ogwelo rowere mag Tharaka-Nithi County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar keto sitima e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: CDC confirms a Rift Valley Fever outbreak alert for Mandera County. Residents are advised to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ilani: CDC inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa kwa Kaunti ya Mandera. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: CDC waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ku saabsan cudurka Rift Valley Fever ee Gobolka Mandera. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha ee wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuoche mar Rift Valley Fever (Rift Valley fever) wacho ni joma odak e alworano onego otang' gi pi mochido.

English: State Department for TVET urges residents of Migori County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kutuma maombi ya bursari hiyo kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Migori inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: Ofis mar State for TVET jiwo jogweng'o mag Migori County mondo okonygi gi chenrono kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud kony kuom chenro mar chiemo e skul.

English: Notice: COMESA will conduct a fertiliser application workshop for farmers in Nakuru County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itaendesha warsha ya maombi ya mbolea kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan isticmaalka bacriminta beeraleyda ee degmada Nakuru bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Rapar: COMESA biro timo tiegruok mar tiyo gi yien mag yien ne jopur e kaunti mar Nakuru e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya: Heavy Rains and Flooding Update - Flash Update #5 (10 May 2024)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Mvua Kubwa na Taarifa ya Mafuriko - Sasisho la Flash #5 (10 Mei 2024)
Somali: Kenya: Roobab Mahiigaan ah iyo Warbixin Daadad - Cusboonaysiinta Degdegga ah #5 (10 Maajo 2024)
Dholuo: Kenya: Koth Mapek kod Pi Opong'o - Oboke #5 (10 dwe mar abich higa mar 2024)

English: State Department for Basic Education urges residents of Kajiado County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na mgao wa bursary.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay isdiiwaangaliyaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan deeq lacageed.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo ji duto modak e Kajiado County mondo odonj e program mar puonjo joma dongo somo kendo somo.

English: Members of the task force on mental health led by Prof. Lukoye Atwoli paid a courtesy call to Uasin Gishu county CEC Evelyine Rotich before conducting public hearings at Uasin Gishu town Hall. The Taskforce also visited mental health patients at MTRH @syengomutisya @360mental
Kiswahili: Wanachama wa jopo kazi kuhusu afya ya akili wakiongozwa na Prof. Lukoye Atwoli walimtembelea CEC wa kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Eveline Rotich kabla ya kuendesha vikao vya umma katika Ukumbi wa mji wa Uasin Gishu. Kikosi Kazi pia kilitembelea wagonjwa wa afya ya akili katika MTRH @syengomutisya @360mental
Somali: Xubno ka tirsan guddiga hawsha ee caafimaadka dhimirka oo uu hoggaaminayo Prof. Lukoye Atwoli ayaa booqasho sharafeed ku tagay degmada Uasin Gishu CEC Evelyine Rotich ka hor inta aysan qaban dhageysi dadweyne oo ka dhacay Hoolka Magaalada Uasin Gishu. Guddigu wuxuu sidoo kale booqday bukaanada caafimaadka dhimirka ee MTRH @syengomutisya @360mental.

English: Judiciary of Kenya invites residents of Murang'a County to attend the public participation forum regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay ka qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya gwelo jogweng' mar County mar Murang'a mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenro mar bajet mar county.

English: ODPP reminds residents of Bomet County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet wanaohudhuria mkutano wa umma wa mkutano wa kaunti kuimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet ee ka qeybgalaya kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada ayaa xoojinaya maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: ODPP paronwa jogweng' County ma biro e chokruok maduong' mar county Assembly mondo omed jiwo sirkal.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges cattle farmers in Lamu County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda Lo'da ee Gobolka Lamu inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha lagu burburiyo ee loo qoondeeyay ka dib kiisaska cudurka Anthrax ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service ojiwo jopur mag jamni e County mar Lamu mondo ogeng'gi e kuonde moyier mag chwoyo jamni bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag anthrax.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone experiencing abuse in Nyamira County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Nyamira apigie simu ya simu ya GBV 1195.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Nyamira inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e County mar Nyamira mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens voter education centres in Lamu County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Lamu mwezi huu wa Oktoba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu furayaa xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee Gobolka Lamu bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties oseyawo kuonde tiego josiasa e kaunti mar Lamu e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: DPP activates an emergency response plan for flooding in West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DPP inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi.
