English: NTSA warns residents of Wajir County about a rise in identity theft and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir juu ya kuongezeka kwa wizi wa kitambulisho na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: NTSA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir kororka xadgudubka aqoonsiga waxayna kula talineysaa shacabka inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax falin.
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar Wajir County e wi medruok mar kuo mar kitgi kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

Kiswahili: KICD inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya ugatuzi.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free malaria screening is available at all public health centres in Bomet County this June.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa malaria bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Bomet Juni hii.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka daacuunka ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka guud ee degmada Bomet bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji ni nono malaria maonge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Bomet e dwe mar Jun.

English: Where markets are functioning, KRCS is scaling unconditional cash transfer modality to enhance household purchasing power and dignity.
Kiswahili: Ambapo masoko yanafanya kazi, KRCS inaongeza mbinu ya uhawilishaji pesa bila masharti ili kuimarisha uwezo na heshima ya ununuzi wa kaya.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by SHA (Social Health Authority) will be held in Narok County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Narok Aprili hii.

Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kuhusu maendeleo ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jumuiya mwezi Septemba.

Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General miyo ji duto modak e county mar Siaya ng'eyo dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag oganda e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development invites farmers in Garissa County to a free training on record keeping for farmers this December.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima Desemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku casuumaysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Garissa inay tababar bilaash ah ku helaan diiwaangelinta beeralayda bisha Diseembar.

English: The 8th Africa Agric Expo 2025 is officially open at KICC Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to attend and explore opportunities
Kiswahili: Maonesho ya 8 ya Kilimo Afrika 2025 yamefunguliwa rasmi katika KICC Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kuhudhuria na kuchunguza fursa.
Somali: Bandhigga 8aad ee Africa Agric Expo 2025 si rasmi ah ayaa looga furay KICC Dadka Beeraleyda iyo ganacsiga beeraha ayaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay ka soo qayb galaan oo ay sahamiyaan fursadaha
Dholuo: Chokruok mar 8th Africa Agricultural Expo 2025 ochakore e KICC Jo-Purie gi jo ohala mag agro-go ijiwogi mondo odhi e chokruok kendo ging'e thuolo

English: FAO invites farmers in Nakuru County to a free training on fertiliser application this August.
Kiswahili: FAO inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya matumizi ya mbolea Agosti hii.
Somali: FAO waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Nakuru tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan isticmaalka bacriminta bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: FAO gwelo jopur e gweng' mar Nakuru e dwe mar Agost mondo otim tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi tiyo gi yien.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Baringo County that access to psychosocial support is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisaikolojia unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Baringo in helitaanka taageerada cilmu-nafsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne joma notony kuom timbe mahundu e taon mar Baringo ni ginyalo yudo kony maonge chudo.

English: The shocks include d: COVID-19 pandemic and its ensuing effects , conflict in Eastern Europe and Middle East that led to global supply chain disruptions and the adverse effects of climate change from the prolonged drought in 2 021 to the floods in the first half of 2024.
Kiswahili: Mishtuko hiyo ni pamoja na d: Janga la COVID-19 na athari zake zilizofuata, migogoro katika Ulaya Mashariki na Mashariki ya Kati ambayo ilisababisha usumbufu wa usambazaji wa kimataifa na athari mbaya za mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa kutoka kwa ukame wa muda mrefu mnamo 2021 hadi mafuriko katika nusu ya kwanza ya 2024.
Somali: Masiibooyinka waxaa ka mid ah: Cudurka faafa ee COVID-19 iyo saameyntiisa, iskahorimaadka ka jira Bariga Yurub iyo Bariga Dhexe oo horseeday carqaladeyn silsiladda sahayda adduunka iyo saameynta xun ee isbeddelka cimilada laga bilaabo abaartii daba dheeraatay ee 2021 ilaa daadadkii qeybtii hore ee 2024.
Dholuo: Gik ma ne omiyo ji obedo gi luoro gin kaka: Tuwo mar COVID-19 kod gik ma ne okelo bang’e, lweny ma ne otimore e piny Ulaya ma Wuokchieng’ kod Wuokchieng’ ma Diere ma ne okelo ng’anjo e piny mangima kod gik ma ok beyo ma ne okelo gi lokruok mag piny chakre e oro ma ne odhi nyime kuom thuolo malach e higa mar 2021 nyaka e pi ma ne oumo piny e nus mokwongo mar higa mar 2024.

English: IPOA urges the community in Tana River County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb theft.
Kiswahili: IPOA inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Tana River kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Tana River County inay ku biiraan mashaariicda booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo oganda manie Tana River County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polis mar oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o kuo.

English: DPP reminds the public in Kericho County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DPP inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kericho inay ka feejignaadaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: DPP parone ji duto e County mar Kericho ni gisik ka girito weche mag loso kuwe e piny.

English: DCI alerts residents of Kisumu County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua.
Somali: DCI waxay dadka deggan degmada Kisumu uga digtay kororka kiisaska jabsashada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne ji modak Kisumu County ni kwan mag joma odonjo e odno biro medore kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: NTSA calls on the community in Wajir County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Wajir kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Somali: NTSA waxay bulshada degmada Wajir ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: NTSA okwayo ji duto manie gweng' mar Wajir mondo owuo e wi timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo mondo giyud kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Train on climate education 2023.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo kuhusu elimu ya hali ya hewa 2023.
Somali: Tababar ku saabsan waxbarashada cimilada 2023.
Dholuo: Chenro mar tiego ji e wi tiegruok e wi weche mag lokruok e kor lwasi e higa mar 2023.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Samburu County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Samburu inay yareeyaan qaadashada cusbada iyo sonkorta si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: KEMSA nyiso ji modak e county mar Samburu mondo omed chamo makate kod sukari mondo kik tuoche ma inyalo geng'e landre.

English: COMESA promotes soil conservation among farmers in Kajiado County as part of the October climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: COMESA inakuza uhifadhi wa udongo miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Oktoba.
Somali: COMESA waxay dhiirrigelisay ilaalinta ciidda beeraleyda degmada Kajiado iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka iska caabinta cimilada ee Oktoobar.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo rito lowo e kind jopur e Kajiado County kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi mar piny e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: DPP reminds residents of Busia County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada ay fatahaadu ka dhacdo xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogweng' mar County mar Busia ni kik giwuoth e kind yiengni mag pi kod orujre ma pi opong'o.

English: Waiting a minute before clamping the cord improves baby's iron levels and immunity.
Kiswahili: Kusubiri dakika moja kabla ya kubana kitovu huboresha viwango vya chuma na kinga ya mtoto.
Somali: Sugitaanka daqiiqad ka hor inta aan la xidhin xadhiggu waxay wanaajisaa heerarka birta iyo difaaca jirka ee ilmaha.
Dholuo: Ka irito dakika achiel kapok iketo ng’injo, mano miyo nyathi bedo gi iron kendo miyo ringre bedo gi teko mar geng’o tuoche.

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will host a free diabetes screening outreach in Kiambu County this July.
Kiswahili: Notisi kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa uchunguzi wa kisukari bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska Dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa qaban doonta baaritaanka bukaanka ee bilaashka ah ee degmada Kiambu bishii Luulyo ee sannadkan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo chenro mar nono thieth mar diabetes maonge chudo e County mar Kiambu e dwe mar Julai.

English: Media Advisory: Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs Martin Griffiths mission to Kenya
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa Vyombo vya Habari: Msaidizi wa Katibu Mkuu wa Masuala ya Kibinadamu Ujumbe wa Martin Griffiths nchini Kenya
Somali: La-talin Warbaahinta: Wafdi uu hoggaaminayo Ku-xigeenka Xoghayaha Guud ee Arrimaha Bani'aadamnimada Martin Griffiths oo booqasho ku tagay Kenya
Dholuo: Rieko ne jotugo: Jatend-alwora ma piny mar weche mag konyo dhano Martin Griffiths odhi piny Kenya

English: Nearly all households (99%) reported being affected by drought, with significant water and hygiene needs reported.
Kiswahili: Mipangilio dhaifu na inayoathiriwa na uhamishaji inakabiliwa na shinikizo zilizounganishwa za uharibifu wa mazingira, majanga ya hali ya hewa, uhaba wa rasilimali na mivutano ya kijamii.
Somali: Ku dhawaad ​​​​dhammaan qoysaska (99%) ayaa soo sheegay inay saameeyeen abaarta, iyadoo la soo sheegay baahiyo badan oo biyo iyo nadaafadeed.
Dholuo: Chiegni ni udi duto (99%) nonyiso ni ne giyudo pek nikech oro, kendo ne ginyiso ni ne gin gi dwaro maduong’ mar pi kod ler.

English: Notice: NTSA issues a cybersecurity alert on mobile money scams affecting residents of Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu zinazoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobilada ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Makueni.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NTSA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity kuom timbe mag wuond mag pesa mitimo gi simo ma mulo joma odak e gweng' mar Makueni.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will be held in Taita-Taveta County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo bilaash ah oo ay soo qabanqaabisay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Gobolka Taita-Taveta bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Rapar: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ochano ibiro tim e Taita-Taveta County e dwe mar Mach.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds farmers in Siaya County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Siaya juu ya programu inayoendelea ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa mafunzo ya wakulima.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa beeraleyda degmada Siaya barnaamijka tababarka beeralayda ee socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service oparo ne jopur e county mar Siaya chenro mar tiego jopur ma sani dhi nyime.

English: Ministry of Health launches a November awareness campaign on food safety across Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Novemba juu ya usalama wa chakula katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Nofeembar oo ku saabsan amniga cuntada ee degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Novemba e wi wach rito chiemo e gweng' mar Bungoma.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET reminds citizens in Makueni County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda TVET waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Makueni ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar State Department for TVET parone raia mag Makueni County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo gi ji duto e bajet mar county.

English: KNEC urges youth in Nyandarua County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nyandarua inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo rowere e County mar Nyandarua mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok gichako timo tije mag oganda.

English: Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) for all bank and social media accounts.
Kiswahili: Wezesha uthibitishaji wa vipengele viwili (2FA) kwa akaunti zote za benki na mitandao ya kijamii.
Somali: U oggolow xaqiijinta laba-factor (2FA) dhammaan xisaabaadka bangiyada iyo warbaahinta bulshada.
Dholuo: Miye thuolo mar nyiso adiera mar weche ariyo (2FA) ne weche duto mag bengi koda mag social media.

English: KTDA urges tea growers in Mombasa County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee gobolka Mombasa inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si kor loogu qaado wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e county mar Mombasa mondo okaw kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed nyak e higani.

English: A healthy mind drives workplace success. Prioritizing mental health boosts morale, reduces stress, and improves productivity
Kiswahili: Akili yenye afya huchochea mafanikio mahali pa kazi. Kuweka kipaumbele katika afya ya akili huongeza ari, hupunguza msongo wa mawazo, na huboresha tija
Somali: Maskax caafimaad qaba ayaa guusha ka dhigeysa goobta shaqada. Caafimaadka maskaxdu waxay kor u qaadeysaa niyadda, waxay yareyneysaa walwalka, waxayna hagaajineysaa wax soo saarka
Dholuo: Bedo gi paro makare miyo ng'ato bedo gi ngima maber e tich.

English: Caregivers should change diapers frequently and clean the baby_x0092_s skin gently to avoid rashes and infections.
Kiswahili: Watunzaji wanapaswa kubadili diapers mara kwa mara na kusafisha ngozi ya mtoto kwa upole ili kuepuka kupasuka na maambukizo.
Somali: Daryeelayaashu waa inay si joogto ah u beddelaan xafaayadaha oo ay si tartiib ah u nadiifiyaan maqaarka ilmaha_x0092_s si looga fogaado finan iyo caabuqyo.
Dholuo: Joma rito nyathi onego olok diaper kinde ka kinde kendo olos ng’ut nyathino e yo makare mondo kik oyud ng’ol kod tuoche.

English: SHA reminds the public in Murang'a County that reporting embezzlement of public funds is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa fedha za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Murang'a in warbixinta xadgudubka lacagta dadweynaha ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: SHA paronwa ji duto e County mar Murang'a ni lando wach ketho pesa mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'.

English: Public advised not to circulate graphic images after the DusitD2 attack to protect victimsâ€™ dignity.
Kiswahili: Umma ulishauriwa kutotangaza picha baada ya shambulio la DusitD2 ili kulinda heshima ya waathirika.
Somali: Dadweynaha ayaa lagula taliyay inaysan faafin sawirro muuqaal ah ka dib weerarkii DusitD2 si loo ilaaliyo sharafta dhibanayaasha.
Dholuo: Oganda ne omiye paro ni kik giland piche ma nyiso gik ma ok owinjore bang' ketho mar DusitD2 mondo orit luor mar jogo ma ne oyudo hinyruok.

English: Isiolo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Isiolo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2022
Somali: Degmada Isiolo: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Isiolo: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Julaini 2022

English: Farmers are advised to maintain vigilance as the threat of desert locust re infestation persists Monitor for any signs of locust activity and report sightings immediately
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa kuwa waangalifu kwani tishio la kushambuliwa na nzige wa jangwani linaendelea Fuatilia dalili zozote za shughuli ya nzige na toa taarifa mara moja.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagula talinayaa inay feejignaadaan maadaama khatarta dib u dhacda cayayaanka lamadegaanka ay sii jirto La soco calaamadaha kasta ee dhaqdhaqaaqa cayayaanka isla markaana si dhakhso leh u soo sheeg aragtida
Dholuo: Ojiwo jopur mondo obed motang ' nikech masira mar chwat mar thim pod dhi nyime.

English: Promote early-maturing and drought-tolerant crop varieties, and strengthen soil moisture conservation and water harvesting techniques.
Kiswahili: Kukuza aina za mazao yanayokomaa mapema na yanayostahimili ukame, na kuimarisha uhifadhi wa unyevu wa udongo na mbinu za kuvuna maji.
Somali: Horumarinta noocyada dalagga ee gabowga iyo abaarta u dulqaadanaya, iyo xoojinta ilaalinta qoyaanada ciidda iyo farsamooyinka soo kabashada biyaha.
Dholuo: Jiw kit yien ma dongo chon kendo ma nyalo nano e kinde oro, kendo jiwo yore mag rito lowo mondo pi kik tho kendo mondo pi kik cham.

English: As labour intensified, Lucy Makena, a reproductive health officer from a nearby mobile outreach clinic supported by World Health Organization (WHO), reached the home.
Kiswahili: Uchungu ulipokuwa ukiongezeka, Lucy Makena, afisa wa afya ya uzazi kutoka kliniki inayohamishika ya karibu inayoungwa mkono na Shirika la Afya Duniani (WHO), alifika nyumbani hapo.
Somali: Markii foosha ay sii xoogeysatay, Lucy Makena, oo ah sarkaal ka tirsan caafimaadka taranka oo ka socota xarun caafimaad oo guurguurta oo u dhow oo ay taageerto Hay'adda Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO), ayaa gaartay guriga.
Dholuo: Kaka nyuol ne medo bedo matek, Lucy Makena maen apisa mar thieth mar nyuol mane wuok e klinik machiegni ma wuotho ​​ma riwruok mar piny mangima mar thieth (WHO) konyo, nochopo e ot.

English: CDC appeals to caregivers in Migori County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the August maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Migori kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Agosti.
Somali: CDC waxay u baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Migori inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyadda ee Agoosto.
Dholuo: CDC kwayo jorit e County mar Migori mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathine kaka achiel kuom chenro mar August Maternal Health drive.

English: KALRO warns beans farmers in Nyamira County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaonya wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Nyamira juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KALRO waxay uga digtay beeraleyda ku nool degmada Nyamira cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: KALRO chiwo siem ne jopur molony e puodho mar Nyamira kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ochiwo paro mar kawo okang' mapiyo.

English: Youth Agenda trains youth to use tech for civic engagement.
Kiswahili: Agenda ya Vijana inawazoeza vijana kutumia teknolojia kwa ajili ya ushiriki wa kiraia.
Somali: Barnaamijka dhalinyaradu wuxuu tababarayaa dhalinyarada inay u adeegsadaan tiknoolajiyada hawlaha bulshada.
Dholuo: Chenro mar Rowere tiego rowere mondo oti gi teknoloji e chopo dwaro mag oganda.

English: Kwale County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kwale: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2023
Somali: Degmada Kwale: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kwale: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Septemba 2023

English: Notice: NTSA launches a theft prevention campaign in Baringo County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NTSA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Baringo Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada Gobolka Baringo bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: NTSA chako kampen mar geng'o kuo e taon mar Baringo e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will open a horticultural produce collection centre in Nakuru County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu furayaa xarun ururinta alaabada beeraha ee degmada Nakuru bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro yawo ot mar choko olemo mag puodho e taon mar Nakuru e dwe mar Februar.

English: Garissa County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Garissa: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Mei 2024
Somali: Degmada Garissa: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Garissa: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar abich higa mar 2024

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Medical Association will be held in Nairobi County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Gobolka Nairobi bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma Kenya Medical Association ochano ibiro tim Nairobi County e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: KALRO restricts movement of goats in West Pokot County due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO inazuia harakati za mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Newcastle.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa riyaha gobolka West Pokot sababo la xiriira cudurka Newcastle.
Dholuo: Rapar: KALRO ogeng'o wuoth mar diek e West Pokot County nikech tuo mar Newcastle.

English: Kenya Dairy Board warns rice farmers in Kitui County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa mchele katika Kaunti ya Kitui juu ya mlipuko wa wadudu na inapendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda bariiska ee degmada Kitui cudurrada cayayaanka waxaana uu ku talinayaa in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho opur e Kitui County kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Data is critical tool as farmers fight drought in Kenya
Kiswahili: Data ni nyenzo muhimu wakulima wanapopambana na ukame nchini Kenya
Somali: Xogtu waa qalab muhiim ah maadaama beeralaydu ay la dagaallamayaan abaarta Kenya
Dholuo: Data en gino maduong' ahinya e kinde ma jopur kedo kod oro e piny Kenya

English: TSC advises applicants in Tana River County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: TSC inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Tana River kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: TSC waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Tana River inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: TSC nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e taon mar Tana River County ni mondo gidonj e tiegruok kapok ichopo e chokruok mabiro.

English: Tharaka Nithi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Februari 2024
Somali: Degmada Tharaka Nithi: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Tharaka Nithi: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2024

English: KTDA advises coffee producers in Mandera County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inashauri wazalishaji wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KTDA waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kafeega ee degmada Mandera inay ka iibsadaan wax soo saarka kaliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KTDA nyiso jopur ma loso chai e gweng' mar Mandera ni gius olembegi mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo olembe kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges farmers in Kwale County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa ku boorinaya beeraleyda degmada Kwale inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kwale mondo opidh olembe mondo omi piny okethre mondo omi giritre kuom lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa xusuusinaya beeraleyda degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee ka dambeeya goosashada.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jopur e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime bang' keyo.

English: Notice: ODPP opens a new service point for passport services in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Homa Bay County.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay fureysaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: ODPP oyawo kama itimee tije mag kawo kad e Homa Bay County.

English: IEBC encourages residents of Baringo County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay ka qaybgalaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadweynta miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogweng' Baringo County mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar jopiny mar county mondo ging'e kaka jopiny biro tiyo gi bajet mag county.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageerada soo kabashada xadgudubka maandooriyaha ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Nairobi.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tiyo gi yedhe mamero yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e County mar Nairobi.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will conduct a post-harvest handling workshop for farmers in Kitui County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi ka dib goosashada beeraleyda Gobolka Kitui bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro timo tiegruok mar rito kodhi bang' keyo ne jopur e gweng' mar Kitui e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces NHIF/SHA claims support for residents of Turkana County starting this April.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatangaza NHIF/SHA inadai msaada kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kuanzia Aprili hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taageerada sheegashada NHIF / SHA ee dadka deggan degmada Turkana laga bilaabo Abriil.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche lando ni NHIF/SHA biro chiwo kony ne joma odak e County mar Turkana kochakore April.

Somali: Waalidiinta ku nool meelaha qalalan: Codso hadda si aad u hesho 15,000 oo deeq waxbarasho oo dugsi sare ah ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…â€œ kama dambaysta ah Noofambar 30.

English: Notice: KALRO will train farmers in Kericho County on organic farming this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho juu ya kilimo hai Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Kericho ee beeraha dabiiciga ah bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KALRO biro tiego jopur e gweng' mar Kericho e weche mag pur e dwe mar Mei.

English: Kenya Red Cross advises residents of Meru County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Laanta Cas ee Kenya waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay haystaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' mar Meru County mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi ka gidwaro thieth mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service informs horticultural produce farmers in Murang'a County of new market linkage opportunities this July.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawafahamisha wakulima wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Julai hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku wargalinayaa beeraleyda wax soo saarka beeraha ee degmada Murang'a fursado cusub oo ku saabsan xiriirka suuqa bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur ma loso puothe e county mar Murang'a thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Julai.

English: Mental distress is daily sickness to us and contrinutor to body disability in the whole world. The world Organization estimates that more than 264 million people have undergone mental distress
Kiswahili: Shirika la Ulimwenguni linakadiria kwamba watu zaidi ya milioni 264 wamepatwa na matatizo ya akili
Somali: Dhibaatada maskaxeed waa cudur maalinle ah oo noo ah oo ka hortagta naafonimada jirka adduunka oo dhan. Ururka caalamiga ah wuxuu qiyaasaa in in ka badan 264 milyan oo qof ay la kulmeen dhibaatada maskaxda
Dholuo: Riwruok mar riwruok mar oganda Jehova (WHO) wacho ni ji mokalo milion 264 oseyudo chandruok mar paro.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds parents in Kwale County that school feeding programme registration is open this April.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba usajili wa programu ya kulisha shule umefunguliwa Aprili hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada Waxbarashada ayaa xasuusinaya waalidiinta degmada Kwale in diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga ay furan tahay bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne jonyuol man Kwale County ni chenro mar kwayo nyithindo chiemo e skul osechakore e dwe mar April.

English: IEBC encourages out-of-school children in Laikipia County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under free primary education.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Laikipia inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga ugu dambeeya ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e county mar Laikipia mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Notice: IEBC opens the electoral calendar centres in Machakos County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Machakos mwezi huu wa Novemba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee degmada Machakos bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e kaunti mar Machakos e dwe mar Novemba.

English: @MOH_Kenya public health officers today carried out a massive fumigation and disinfection exercise in Kawangware to prevent community spread of #COVID19. Currently, the area has 20 positive cases. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Maafisa wa afya ya umma wa @MOH_Kenya leo wametekeleza zoezi kubwa la ufukizaji na kuua vijidudu huko Kawangware ili kuzuia kuenea kwa #COVID19 kwa jamii. Hivi sasa, eneo hilo lina kesi 20 chanya. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Saraakiisha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee @MOH_Kenya ayaa maanta Kawangware ka sameeyay jimicsi ballaaran oo lagu buufinayo laguna jeermis dilayo si looga hortago faafitaanka bulshada ee #COVID19. Hadda, aaggu wuxuu leeyahay 20 kiis oo togan. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: @MOH_Kenya apisas mag thieth oganda kawuono ne otimo chenro maduong' mar kudho muya kod tieko midhusi e Kawangware mar geng'o lando mar midhusi mar #COVID19 e alwora. Kawuono, alworano nigi jogo ma oyudo tuo mar HIV 20. #KomeshaKorona

English: HELB urges youth in Marsabit County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: HELB waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Marsabit inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo rowere e gweng' mar Marsabit mondo onon weche duto motudore gi ndiko joma oyierogi kapok gitimo tije mag oganda.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on residents of Kakamega County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of border security.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kakamega inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross okwayo jogweng' Kakamega County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji nitie mondo okony sirkal rito tong'gi.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Embu County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the November planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Novemba.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Embu inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beerto ee Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur e county mar Embu ni giti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya alerts residents of Nairobi County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhusu kuongezeka kwa visa vya utekaji nyara wa magari na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay uga digtay dadka deggan degmada Nairobi in ay kordheen kiisaska gaadiidka la xaday waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Communications Authority chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nairobi County kuom wach medruok e kwan mag joma oketho mtokni kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: State Department for Basic Education calls on the community in Kiambu County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Kiambu inay ka warbixiyaan wixii dhibaato ah ee ku saabsan amniga maamulka dugsiga si ay u ilaaliyaan amniga dugsiyada.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education okwayo ji duto manie County mar Kiambu mondo onyis sirkal mar skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: KALRO promotes soil conservation among farmers in Turkana County as part of the December climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: KALRO inakuza uhifadhi wa udongo miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Turkana kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Desemba.
Somali: KALRO waxay dhiirrigelisay ilaalinta ciidda beeraleyda degmada Turkana iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka iska caabinta cimilada ee Diseembar.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo rito lowo e kind jopur e county mar Turkana kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo kinda mar kedo gi lokruok e kit yamo e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: NCPB will open a horticultural produce collection centre in Uasin Gishu County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay ka furi doontaa xarun ururinta wax soo saarka beeraha ee gobolka Uasin Gishu bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Rapar: NCPB biro yawo kama ichokoe puothe mag puothe e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu e dwe mar Septemba.

English: ODPP urges eligible citizens in Homa Bay County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Homa Bay inay ka qaybqaataan jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo raia mowinjore e Homa Bay County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar yiero.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free cyclosporiasis screening is available at all public health centres in Siaya County this November.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa cyclosporiasis unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya Novemba hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka bilaashka ah ee cyclosporiasis laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynta ee degmada Siaya bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone ji ni nono cyclosporiasis onge chudo e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Siaya e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will distribute certified tea seed to farmers in Trans Nzoia County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu za chai zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu abuurka shaaha ee shahaadada leh u qaybin doonaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro pogo kodhi mag chai ne jopur e Trans Nzoia County e dwe mar Agost.

English: CDC encourages mothers in Kilifi County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kilifi inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo mine man Kilifi County mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: DPP calls on residents of Baringo County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: DPP atoa wito kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika kumbi za umma ili kuunga mkono umakini wa kukabiliana na ugaidi.
Somali: DPP waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan kahortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: DPP okwayo jogweng' Baringo County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji nitie mondo okony e kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Public notice: CDC will host a free proper sanitation outreach in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: CDC itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mazingira bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: CDC waxay martigelin doontaa adeegyo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuoche (CDC) biro timo chenro mar konyo joma nigi tuoche e alwora mar Elgeyo-Marakwet e dwe mar Mach.

English: KTDA advises farmers in Nakuru County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nakuru inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kalfadhiga tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e tiego jopur mabiro.

English: Notice: NCPB will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Makueni County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi diiwaan-gelin ah oo loogu talagalay beeraleyda degmada Makueni bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Rapar: NCPB biro timo rapar mar jopur e dwe mar Jun e kaunti mar Makueni.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Meru County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.

English: Notice: OGP opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa ajili ya usajili wa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay fureysaa barta adeegga cusub ee diiwaangelinta e-muwaadiniinta ee Gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: OGP oseyawo kar lendo manyien mar e-Citizen registration e County mar Lamu.

English: FAO promotes organic farming among farmers in Bomet County as part of the August climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: FAO inakuza kilimo hai kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Agosti.
Somali: FAO waxay dhiirrigelisay beeraha dabiiciga ah ee beeraleyda degmada Bomet iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Agoosto.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e county mar Bomet kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi e dwe mar Agost.

English: Ksh 50,000 annual grant for special needs learners Ã¢Â€Â“ apply before Dec 10!

English: KALRO reminds residents of Tana River County that terracing improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kwamba terracing inaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: KALRO waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River in dhulka lagu beerayo uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: KALRO paronwa jogweng' mar Tana River County ni tiyo gi puodho mar terracing kelo nyak e puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Nyeri County about the importance of hypertension awareness for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhusu umuhimu wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMSA waxay dadweynaha degmada Nyeri ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay wacyiga cadaadiska dhiig karka ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMSA oparo ne ji e County mar Nyeri kuom ber mar miyo ji ong'e ni tuwo mar hypertension en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay bilawday barnaamij hagitaan iyo adeegyo la-talin ah oo ku yaal dugsiyada gobolka Kajiado.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State Department for TVET chako chenro mar tayo kendo chiwo paro e skunde duto mag Kajiado County.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Isiolo County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the December planting season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kutumia kiwango cha mbolea kilichopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Desemba.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Isiolo inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur manie Isiolo County ni giti gi yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Health facilities offer family planning counseling to couples and individuals to support informed decisions about spacing and limiting births.
Kiswahili: Vituo vya afya hutoa ushauri nasaha wa uzazi wa mpango kwa wanandoa na watu binafsi ili kusaidia maamuzi sahihi kuhusu nafasi na kupunguza uzazi.
Somali: Xarumaha caafimaadka waxay la talin ku bixiyaan qorsheynta qoyska lamaanaha iyo shakhsiyaadka si ay u taageeraan go'aamada la og yahay ee ku saabsan kala duwanaanshaha iyo xaddidaadda dhalmada.
Dholuo: Ofise mag thieth chiwo kony e wi kaka inyalo chano ngima joot ne joma okendore koda ne joma nie kend mondo okonygi ng'ado paro e yo mong'ith kuom wach pogo nyuol gi nyuol.

English: SHA reminds the public in Kericho County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: SHA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kericho in sheegashada khiyaamooyinka iibsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: SHA paronwa ji duto e County mar Kericho ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag yuto en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: Form One reporting starts January 6 Ã¢Â€Â“ bring only admission letter and birth certificate.
Kiswahili: Kuripoti kidato cha kwanza kunaanza Januari 6 Ã¢Â€Â“ leta barua ya udahili na cheti cha kuzaliwa pekee.
Somali: Warbixinta Foomka Koowaad waxay bilaabanaysaa Janaayo 6 - waxay keeneysaa oo keliya warqadda ogolaanshaha iyo shahaadada dhalashada.
Dholuo: Ripot mar Fom Achiel chakore tarik 6 dwe mar achiel Ã¢Â€Â“ kelo mana oboke mar rwako sikul kod oboke mar nyuol.

English: Office of the Auditor-General updates residents of Wajir County on progress of community-based development programmes this October.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kuhusu maendeleo ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jumuiya mwezi huu wa Oktoba.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Wajir ka warbixiyaa horumarka barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada ee bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General medo lero ne jogweng' mar County mar Wajir dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag oganda e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: FAO announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for sheep in Embu County this September.
Kiswahili: FAO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Embu Septemba hii.
Somali: FAO waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee idaha ee Gobolka Embu bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: FAO olando chenro mar thiedho rombo maonge chudo e dwe mar Septemba e county mar Embu.

English: Kilifi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kilifi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2023
Somali: Degmada Kilifi: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kilifi: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar adek higa mar 2023

English: Notice: KUCCPS launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay bilawday barnaamij lagu darayo ardayda naafada ah dugsiyada gobolka Nairobi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KUCCPS chako chenro mar tiego nyithindo ma nigi midekre e skunde duto mag Nairobi County.

English: Notice: OGP launches the county integrated development plan in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika wilaya ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay bilawday qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Nyamira.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: OGP chako chenro mar dongruok mar county e county mar Nyamira.
