English: Climate-smart agriculture has three objectives: sustainably increase agricultural productivity and the incomes of agricultural producers.
Kiswahili: Kilimo cha hali ya hewa kina malengo matatu: kuongeza uzalishaji wa kilimo kwa uendelevu na mapato ya wazalishaji wa kilimo.
Somali: Beeraha cimilada ku saleysan waxay leedahay saddex ujeedo: si joogto ah loo kordhiyo wax-soo-saarka beeraha iyo dakhliga soo saarayaasha beeraha.
Dholuo: Tij pur motudore gi lokruok mar alwora nigi chenro adek: medo nyak mar pur e yo mosiko kod kelo yuto ne jopur.

English: AFA urges wheat growers in Embu County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Embu kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Embu inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka ciidanka xilliga dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur mag ngano e county mar Embu mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma giyudo e higa mondo okony e loyo chwanyruok mar jolweny e kinde machuok ka gitiyo gi tuoche makelo tuoche ma nyalo konyo e miyo nyak obed maber e higani.

English: Kenya Forest Service warns residents of Wajir County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ka digay dadka deggan degmada Wajir oo ku saabsan kororka khiyaamada SIM-swap wuxuuna kula talinayaa dadweynaha inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service osiemo jogweng' mar Wajir County kuom wach medruok mar wuond mar SIM-swap kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds residents of Garissa County that agroforestry improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba kilimo cha misitu kinaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Garissa in kaynta beeraha ay hagaajineyso waxsoosaarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jogweng' mar Garissa County ni yien mag yien medo kelo nyak e puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service issues a cybersecurity alert on mobile money scams affecting residents of Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu zinazoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu soo saaray digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khayaanada lacagta mobile ee saameyn ku leh dadka deggan degmada Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Forest Service ogolo siem mar sirkal mar cybersecurity kuom timbe mag wuond mag pesa mitimo ne jood Lamu County.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response launches a November awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Novemba juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay bilaabeysaa olole wacyi galineed bishii Nofeembar oo ku saabsan wacyiga cadaadiska sare ee degmada Kilifi.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Novemba e wi wach remo mang'eny e gweng' mar Kilifi.

English: Public notice: KEMRI will host a free hand hygiene outreach in Trans Nzoia County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMRI itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mikono bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: KEMRI waxay martigelin doontaa dhaqdhaqaaqa nadaafadda gacmaha bilaashka ah ee Gobolka Trans Nzoia bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMRI biro timo kampen mar rito ler mar lwedo e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia e dwe mar April.

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of Nyamira County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: Kenya Red Cross inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhusu ongezeko la udanganyifu wa pesa za simu na inawashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira kororka khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobilada waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga leh bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross osiemo jogweng' Nyamira County kuom medruok mar timbe mag wuondo pesa mag simo kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok kare ne jatendgi.

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Lamu County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu inay biyo cabitaan ah ku kariyaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso jogweng' Lamu County ni mondo gimi pi omodhi kapok gitiyo kode mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche ma ok nyal geng'o.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free suicide prevention support is available through county health facilities in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kuzuia kujiua unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo ka hortagga ismiidaaminta laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Nyamira.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar geng'o ji kik nege yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Nyamira.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development urges youth in Homa Bay County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Machadka Horumarinta Manhajka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dhalinyarada degmada Homa Bay inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo rowere manie Homa Bay County mondo onon weche ma giduto gikwongo tiyogo ka pok gichako timo tije mag sirkal.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Nyeri County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nyeri inay ka feejignaadaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji duto e County mar Nyeri mondo gibed motang' gi chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: TVET calls on the community in Bungoma County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TVET inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuwasiliana na nambari ya msaada kwa watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TVET waxay bulshada degmada Bungoma ugu baaqeysaa inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116, si loo ilaaliyo nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: TVET okwayo ji duto manie County mar Bungoma mondo omany namba mar 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: The Mionistry of Health has launched a campaign vaccine on Misolsi, and also stomach disease (TCV) in its daily vaccination routine. This campaign will commense on 5th - 14th March 2025
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya imezindua kampeni ya chanjo dhidi ya Misolsi, na pia magonjwa ya tumbo (TCV) katika utaratibu wake wa kila siku wa chanjo. Kampeni hii itaanza tarehe 5 - 14 Machi 2025.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Mionistry ayaa bilaabay tallaal olole ah oo ku saabsan cudurka Misolsi, iyo sidoo kale cudurrada caloosha (TCV) oo ku jira tallaalkooda maalinlaha ah. Ololahan wuxuu bilaaban doonaa 5 - 14 Maarso 2025.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Thieth osechako kampen mar chanjo kuom Misolsi, kaachiel gi two mag ich (TCV) e chenro mare mar chanjo ma pile ka pile. Kampein ni biro chakore tarik 5 nyaka 14 dwe mar adek higa mar 2025

English: Notice from Kenya Medical Association: postnatal check-ups clinics will run every September at designated health centres in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya: kliniki za uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa zitafanya kazi kila Septemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kitui.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya: Caafimaadka baaritaanka dhalmada ka dib waxaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Sebtember ee xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Kitui.
Dholuo: Chenro mar Kenya Medical Association: Klinike mag nonro bang' nyuol ibiro tim dwe mar ochiko higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Kitui.

English: KEPHIS warns maize farmers in Nyeri County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawaonya wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Nyeri cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda ah.
Dholuo: KEPHIS chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho cham e County mar Nyeri kuom masiche ma nyalo kelo tuoche, kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: KEPHIS reminds residents of Machakos County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos in ilaalinta ciidda ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: KEPHIS paronwa joma odak e gweng' mar Machakos ni rito lowo kelo nyak e puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: ODPP urges eligible citizens in Kisii County to participate in voter education.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Kisii kushiriki katika elimu ya wapiga kura.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kisii inay ka qaybqaataan waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro mar yiero e county mar Kisii mondo oriwgi e tiegruok mar josiasa.

English: EACC announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: EACC inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: EACC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: EACC olando lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mar yudo ng'eyo mar piny e County mar Nyeri.

English: NPS reminds residents of Bungoma County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kazini wakati wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay guryahooda ku rakibaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo shaqada inta lagu jiro xilliyada shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: NPS parone jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e miechgi kendo giti e kinde masiche mag ndara.

English: COMESA reminds residents of Lamu County that terracing improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kwamba terracing inaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Somali: COMESA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Lamu in dhulka lagu beerayo uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: COMESA paronwa jogweng' Lamu County ni loso puothe mag lowo miyo puothego bedo gi nyak maber e kinde mabiro.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the public in Uasin Gishu County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadweynaha degmada Uasin Gishu inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aanay wax ka qabanin ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ji duto e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo ong'e kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma osefweny kuom chenro mag ohala ma miriambo.

English: NCPB informs horticultural produce farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County of new market linkage opportunities this February.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawafahamisha wakulima wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Februari hii.
Somali: NCPB waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda wax soo saarka beeraha ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi fursadaha cusub ee isku xirka suuqa bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: NCPB ong'eyo jopur ma loso puothe e Tharaka-Nithi County kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Februar.

English: The new Strategy, developed with technical support from the United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR), provides a comprehensive framework to strengthen financial resilience through a shift from reactive, crisis-driven financing to proactive, risk-informed financial preparedness through 2030.
Kiswahili: Mkakati huo mpya, uliotayarishwa kwa msaada wa kiufundi kutoka Ofisi ya Umoja wa Mataifa ya Kupunguza Hatari za Maafa (UNDRR), unatoa mfumo mpana wa kuimarisha ustahimilivu wa kifedha kupitia kuhama kutoka kwa ufadhili tendaji, unaotokana na shida hadi utayarishaji wa kifedha unaozingatia hatari hadi 2030.
Somali: Istaraatiijiyadda cusub, oo lagu sameeyay taageero farsamo oo ka timid Xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee Yaraynta Khatarta Masiibooyinka (UNDRR), waxay bixisaa qaab-dhismeed dhammaystiran si loo xoojiyo adkeysiga dhaqaale iyada oo loo marayo isbeddel laga bilaabo maalgelinta fal-celinta leh, ee ku salaysan dhibaatooyinka una gudubto diyaargarow dhaqaale oo firfircoon, oo ku salaysan khatarta ilaa 2030.
Dholuo: Okenge manyien, ma olosi gi kony mar lony kowuok kuom Ofis mar Pinje Motudore mar Duoko Rieko mag Masira (UNDRR), chiwo chenro matut mar jiwo chir mar pesa kokalo kuom lokore kowuok kuom chiwo pesa ma kelo masira nyaka e ikruok mar pesa ma luwo masira nyaka higa mar 2030.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds residents of Samburu County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba la muda mrefu.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Samburu in ilaalinta ciidda ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jogweng' mar Samburu County ni rito lowo kelo nyak mar puodho kuom kinde malach.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges rice growers in Nakuru County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda bariiska ee degmada Nakuru inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka guga guga iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur ma pidho kodhi e kaunti mar Nakuru mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma giyudo e higa mar 2020 mondo okony jolweny mag piny mondo oked gi yadhno chon ka gitiyo gi gik makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok.

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Kericho County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun iyo biyo nadiif ah si joogto ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health nyiso jogweng' Kericho County mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: NTSA urges motorists and pedestrians in Mombasa County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Mombasa inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay adeegsadaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee socodka si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo joidh mtokni kod jowuoth e County mar Mombasa mondo oluw tong' mag wuoth kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe mondo gikwed hinyruok mag ndara.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations launches a fraud prevention campaign in Mandera County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Mandera Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka Cilmi baarista dambiyada ayaa bilaabay olole ka hortagga khiyaamooyinka degmada Mandera bishii Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova chako kampen mar geng'o mibadhi e taon mar Mandera e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: CDC reminds the public in Narok County that access to free medical camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Narok kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za matibabu bila malipo sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Narok in helitaanka xeryaha caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha loo qoondeeyay.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji duto manie Narok County ni koro ginyalo yudo kuonde thieth ma onge chudo e gwenge moyier.

English: Notice: HELB opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB inafungua maombi ya maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali bila malipo kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay codsiyada u furaysaa ardayda degmada Kilifi si ay u helaan waxyaabaha waxbarasho ee bilaashka ah ee digital ah.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: HELB chako tiyo gi weche mag tiegruok mag digital maonge chudo ne jopuonjre manie gweng' mar Kilifi.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Nairobi County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kumhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Nairobi inuu ku dhiirrigeliyo saaxiibkiisa dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi tuwo mar paro e County mar Nairobi mondo ojiw osiepne moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Migori County that reporting carjacking promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kwamba kuripoti utekaji nyara mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan Degmada Migori in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan baabuurta la xaday ay gacan ka geystaan ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service parone jogweng' Migori County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo mtokni konyo rito alwora.

English: KEMRI reminds expectant mothers in Busia County that access to postnatal check-ups is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba ufikiaji wa uchunguzi wa baada ya kuzaa ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Busia in helitaanka baaritaano ka dib dhalashada ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMRI parone mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Busia ni thuolo mar dhi e nonro bang' nyuol en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag oganda.

English: The Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development has withdrawn 77 pesticide products Farmers are advised to review their pesticide use immediately
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo imeondoa viuatilifu 77 Wakulima washauriwa kupitia upya matumizi yao ya viuatilifu mara moja.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa ka soo baxday 77 alaabooyin cayayaanka ah Beeraleyda waxaa lagula talinayaa inay si deg deg ah dib u eegis u sameeyaan isticmaalka cayayaanka
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development osegolo gik moko 77 mag thieth mag kute mag nego dhok.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Kilifi County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kumhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Kilifi inuu ku dhiirrigeliyo saaxiibkiisa dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo ojiw osiepne moro ma chandore omany kony.

English: Non-compliant schools face closure after audit.
Kiswahili: Shule zisizofuata sheria zinakabiliwa na kufungwa baada ya ukaguzi.
Somali: Dugsiyada aan u hoggaansamin waxay la kulmaan xiritaanka ka dib baaritaanka.
Dholuo: Skunde ma ok luw chike mag sirkal nyalo riwo lwedo tijno bang' timo nonro.

English: SHA advises residents of Kisumu County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: SHA inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: SHA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: SHA nyiso jogweng'o mag Kisumu County mondo oketgi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro kwayo mag ID mar piny.

English: Innovativeness steers development. Discover new ways in agribusiness thatvcan help small holder farmers..
Kiswahili: Ubunifu unaongoza maendeleo. Gundua njia mpya katika biashara ya kilimo ambayoinaweza kusaidia wakulima wadogo..
Somali: Hal-abuurnimadu waxay hagaa horumarka. Ogow siyaabo cusub oo ku saabsan ganacsiga beeraha ee ka caawin kara beeralayda yar-yar..
Dholuo: Bedo gi lony e timo dongruok. Fwenyo yore manyien mag timo ohala mag gik ma nyalo konyo jopur matindo.

English: Notice: KEMRI confirms a Rift Valley Fever outbreak alert for Nairobi County. Residents are advised to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI yathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa katika Kaunti ya Nairobi. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka Rift Valley Fever ee Gobolka Nairobi. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KEMRI osenyiso ni nitie masira mar Rift Valley Fever e County mar Nairobi.

English: Notice: TVET opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inafungua maombi ya maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali bila malipo kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay u furaysaa codsiyada barashada bilaashka ah ee barashada digital-ka ee ardayda degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET oyawo kwayo mag somo maonge chudo mar digital ne jopuonjre e county mar Siaya.

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief, June 2023
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP Kenya, Juni 2023
Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya, Juun 2023
Dholuo: Wach machuok mar piny Kenya mar WFP, dwe mar auchiel 2023

English: KALRO announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for poultry in Baringo County this September.
Kiswahili: KALRO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa kuku katika Kaunti ya Baringo Septemba hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee digaagga ee Gobolka Baringo bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: KALRO olando chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar dhoot e baringo County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: ODPP invites residents of Lamu County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Lamu kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: ODPP gwelo jogweng' County mar Lamu mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili kuwajulisha juu ya usambazaji wa huduma kwa kiwango cha wilaya.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay la xiriiraan maamulaha qaybta maxalliga ah si ay uga warqabaan bixinta adeegga heerka qaybta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General ojiwo ji duto modak e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jorit-alwora margi mondo ging'e weche duto motudore gi tij lendo.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges eligible citizens in Kilifi County to participate in polling procedures.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kushiriki katika utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kilifi inay ka qeyb galaan nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro mar donjo e kes mar Kilifi County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag yiero.

English: During the day-to-day activities people can take the following measures to prevent infection. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Wakati wa shughuli za kila siku watu wanaweza kuchukua hatua zifuatazo kuzuia maambukizi. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Inta lagu jiro hawlaha maalinlaha ah dadku waxay qaadi karaan tallaabooyinka soo socda si looga hortago caabuqa. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: E kinde ma ji timoe gik moko pile ka pile, ji nyalo kawo okang’ maluwogi mondo kik giyud tuoche. #KomeshaKorona

English: Kakuma - Disaster Risk Mitigation Strategy 2023
Kiswahili: Kakuma - Mkakati wa Kupunguza Hatari za Maafa 2023
Somali: Kakuma - Istaraatiijiyadda Yaraynta Khatarta Musiibada 2023
Dholuo: Kakuma - Yor duoko piny arita mar masira higa mar 2023

English: Notice: KICD reminds citizens in Makueni County about their rights regarding devolution.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Makueni ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KICD paronwa raia mag Makueni County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar golo pesa.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) confirms a dengue fever outbreak alert for Kakamega County. Residents are advised to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) yathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa homa ya dengue kwa Kaunti ya Kakamega. Wakazi wanashauriwa kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka hargabka dengue ee Gobolka Kakamega. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagu taliyey.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: SHA (Social Health Authority) osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuwo mar dengue e kaunti mar Kakamega.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service conducts a community briefing on border security in Tharaka-Nithi County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu qabtaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha Degmada Tharaka-Nithi bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Forest Service timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will conduct a pest and disease management workshop for farmers in Nairobi County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itafanya semina ya usimamizi wa wadudu na magonjwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) ayaa qaban doonta aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada beeraleyda ee Gobolka Nairobi bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: E dwe mar Februar, riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro timo tiegruok mar tieko tuoche kod tuoche ne jopur e taon mar Nairobi County.

English: FAO reminds farmers in Machakos County of the ongoing greenhouse farming training programme.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kilimo cha chafu.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Machakos barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo.
Dholuo: FAO parone jopur e county mar Machakos chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime e weche mag pidho yien.

Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhusu kilimo cha misitu Juni hii.

English: Kenya | DG ECHO response 2022 - DG ECHO Daily Map | 02/12/2022

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kajiado County that access to free legal aid is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kajiado County kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisheria wa bure unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ee ka dhacay degmada Kajiado in la heli karo caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah oo lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Kajiado ni ginyalo yudo kony ma onge chudo.

English: NTSA reminds the public in Baringo County to remain vigilant on counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: NTSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Baringo inay sii joogaan feejignaanta ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: NTSA parone ji duto manie Baringo County mondo omed bedo motang' ne weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya launches ward-level service delivery in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya yaanza kutoa huduma katika wilaya ya Kajiado County.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu bilaabay adeegga heerka qaybta ee degmada Kajiado.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya chako tiyo gi tije mag sirkal e alwora mar Kajiado County.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education reminds citizens in Kiambu County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Dowladda waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Kiambu xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Department of State for Basic Education paronwa raia mag Kaunti mar Kiambu kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo gi ji duto e bajet mar kaunti.

English: Notice: KALRO will open a maize collection centre in Machakos County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mahindi katika Kaunti ya Machakos Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay bilaabi doontaa xarun ururinta hadhuudhka ee Gobolka Machakos bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KALRO biro yawo kambi mar choko cham e gweng' mar Machakos e dwe mar Mach.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the public in Taita-Taveta County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of identity theft.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inahimiza umma katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadweynaha Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee tuugista aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ji duto e Taita-Taveta County mondo ong'e kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche mag kwalo kitgi.

English: DCI urges the public in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: DCI inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka ee M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada lacagta mobilada.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo ji duto e County mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo weche mag wuond mag pesa.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges motorists and pedestrians in Kilifi County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Kilifi inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay adeegsadaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee socodka si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira qaraxyada dabka.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo joidh mtokni kod jowuoth e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo oluw tong' mar wuoth kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe mondo gikwed hinyruok mar mach.

English: IEBC encourages out-of-school children in Migori County to register their children at the nearest public school under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Migori kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Migori inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e county mar Migori mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni e bwo chenro mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: Kenya builds capacity to produce its own vaccines
Kiswahili: Kenya inajenga uwezo wa kuzalisha chanjo zake
Somali: Kenya waxay dhistaa awood ay ku soo saarto tallaalladeeda gaarka ah
Dholuo: Kenya gero nyalo mar loso chanjo mare owuon

English: Wrap babies in warm clothes and avoid exposing them to cold air, especially in early months.
Kiswahili: Wafunge watoto nguo za joto na epuka kuwaweka kwenye hewa baridi, hasa katika miezi ya mwanzo.
Somali: Carruurta dhar kulul ku duub oo iska ilaali hawada qabow, gaar ahaan bilaha ugu horreeya.
Dholuo: Rwak nyithindo gi lewni mang'ich kendo kik iketgi e muya maliet, to ahinya wuon e dweche mokwongo.

English: Notice: AFA restricts movement of poultry in Baringo County due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA inazuia harakati za kuku katika Kaunti ya Baringo kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Newcastle.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa digaagga ee degmada Baringo sababtuna tahay cudurka Newcastle.
Dholuo: Rapar: AFA ogeng'o wuoth mar le e County mar Baringo nikech tuo mar Newcastle.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the community in Kakamega County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa bulshada Gobolka Kakamega inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo xanta lo'da.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo oganda man Kakamega County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polis mar oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o kwalo jamni.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) warns public officers in Murang'a County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a dhidi ya kutumia vibaya fedha za umma.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Murang'a in ay ka faa'iideystaan dhaqaale dawladeed.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Murang'a ni kik giti gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo e yo marach.

English: KEMSA announces eye and dental camps for residents of Makueni County starting this December.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatangaza kambi za macho na meno kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kuanzia Desemba hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa xeryaha indhaha iyo ilkaha ee dadka deggan degmada Makueni laga bilaabo Diseembar.
Dholuo: KEMSA ogolo kambi mag thieth mag wang' kod lakteche mag laktech ne joma odak e gweng' mar Makueni kochakore e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Kenya Forest Service warns residents of Nairobi County to prepare for possible road accidents this November.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Novemba hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ka digay dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay u diyaar garoobaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha November.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service osiemo jogweng' Nairobi mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Novemba.

English: OGP warns public officers in Homa Bay County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: OGP anaonya maafisa wa umma katika Wilaya ya Homa Bay dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: OGP waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee gobolka Homa Bay inay musuqmaasuq ku sameeyaan xafiisyada dawladda.
Dholuo: OGP chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e Homa Bay County kuom kawo asoya e migepe mar sirkal.

English: As incomes fall and food becomes less affordable, households increasingly resort to negative coping strategies, signaling eroding resilience.
Kiswahili: Kadiri mapato yanavyopungua na chakula kinapokuwa chini ya bei nafuu, kaya zinazidi kutumia mikakati mibaya ya kukabiliana na hali hiyo, kuashiria kumomonyoka kwa ustahimilivu.
Somali: Maadaama dakhliga soo gala uu hoos u dhaco cuntaduna ay noqoto mid aan la awoodi karin, qoysasku waxay si isa soo taraysa u adeegsadaan xeelado wax ka qabasho oo taban, taasoo muujinaysa in adkeysiga uu meesha ka baxayo.
Dholuo: Kaka pesa ma ji yudo medore kendo chiemo bedo ma ok nyal ng’iewo, udi medo tiyo kod yore ma ok beyo mag geng’o pek, ma nyiso ni nyalo mar ng’ado bura medore.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will be held in Nairobi County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu bila malipo iliyoandaliwa na Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo bilaash ah oo ay soo qabanqaabisay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Gobolka Nairobi bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Rapar: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ochano ibiro tim Nairobi County e dwe mar April.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Makueni County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Makueni inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e gweng' mar Makueni mondo odhi ir japuonj molony.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges motorists and pedestrians in Tana River County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent landslides-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka lugta leh ee degmada Tana River inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha lugta ah ee loo qoondeeyey si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira dhulgariirka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo jorit mtokni kod joma wuotho gi tiendegi e taon mar Tana River County mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe mondo gikwed masiche ma timore nikech yiengni mag lowo.

English: EACC encourages first-time voters in Meru County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: EACC inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Meru kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC.
Somali: EACC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Meru inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo joma okwongo yiero e county mar Meru mondo olim kama ichanoe ji e IEBC.

English: Announcement of TOT training initiative for 26 health workers from four counties under BFHI supported by USAID.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la mpango wa mafunzo ya TOT kwa wafanyakazi 26 wa afya kutoka kaunti nne chini ya BFHI inayoungwa mkono na USAID.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida dadaalka tababarka TOT ee loogu talagalay 26 shaqaale caafimaad oo ka socda afar degmo oo hoos yimaada BFHI oo ay taageerto USAID.
Dholuo: Walando chenro mar tiego jorit thieth 26 moa e gwenge ang'wen e bwo BFHI makonyo gi USAID.

English: Notice: KRA launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kiambu County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Januari hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: KRA waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ka dhanka ah degmada Kiambu bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Rapar: KRA chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Kiambu e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens voter education centres in Taita-Taveta County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta mwezi huu Julai.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu furayaa xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya oseyawo chenro mar tiego josiasa e kaunti mar Taita-Taveta e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on residents of Vihiga County to support local peace-building committees in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za mitaa katika kusaidia tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Adeegga kaynta Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqay dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee deegaanka si ay u taageerayaan taxadarka ka dhanka ah argagixisada.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service kwayo jogweng' County mar Vihiga mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e pinyno e siro tij kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: The Coffee Bill 2021 is currently undergoing public participation Coffee farmers and stakeholders are encouraged to review the proposed reforms and provide feedback
Kiswahili: Muswada wa Sheria ya Kahawa wa 2021 kwa sasa unashirikishwa na umma Wakulima wa kahawa na wadau wanahimizwa kupitia marekebisho yaliyopendekezwa na kutoa maoni.
Somali: Sharciga Kafeega 2021 hadda waxaa lagu marayaa ka qaybgalka dadweynaha Beeraleyda kafee iyo daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay dib u eegaan isbeddelada la soo jeediyay oo ay bixiyaan jawaab celin
Dholuo: Kofu Bill 2021 sani itimo e kind ji duto ka jopur mag kofi kod joma nie bwo chikego ijiwo mondo onon lokruok ma osetiki kendo gichiw paro

English: TVET advises students in Kisii County to collect materials from the county education office to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kisii kukusanya vifaa kutoka ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Somali: TVET waxay ardayda degmada Kisii kula talineysaa inay ka soo ururiyaan xogta xafiiska waxbarashada degmada si ay u helaan deeq waxbarasho ardayda u baahan.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jopuonjre e County mar Kisii mondo ochok gik moko moa e ofis mar somo mar county mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo osuru ne jopuonjre mochando.

English: Kilifi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kilifi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2023
Somali: Degmada Kilifi: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kilifi: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2023

English: Meru (Meru-North) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Meru (Meru-Kaskazini): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2024
Somali: Degmada Meru (Meru-Waqooyi): War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Agoosto 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Meru (Meru-Nyath): Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo kuom Oro mar Agost 2024

English: Teachers Service Commission conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Murang'a County this June.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Juni hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu qabtaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan kaqeybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada ee degmada Murang'a bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission otimo chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda e dwe mar Jun e kaunti mar Murang'a.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds expectant mothers in Baringo County that access to skilled birth attendance is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba upatikanaji wa mahudhurio ya uzazi wenye ujuzi ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Baringo in helitaanka daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfad leh ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne mine ma biro nyuolo e county mar Baringo ni thuolo mar yudo nyithindo ma nigi lony en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag sirkal.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges motorists and pedestrians in Nyeri County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawataka madereva wa magari na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Nyeri inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka abaarta la xiriira.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo joidh mtokni kod jowuoth e County mar Nyeri mondo oluw chike mag golo ji moa e gweng'no mondo gikwed masiche motudore gi oro.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) appeals to caregivers in Samburu County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the October maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Oktoba.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Samburu inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta bukaanka ee la qorsheeyay iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Oktoobar.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) kwayo jorit e county mar Samburu mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar klinik ma ne ochan e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: IEBC urges residents of Taita-Taveta County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuwasilisha maandishi ya maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga kama dambaysta ah si loo qaabeeyo goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo ochiw weche mondik kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso chenro mag dongruok.

English: Ksh 2,000 HELB upkeep loan disbursed to all university students ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…â€œ check portal.
Kiswahili: Ksh 2,000 HELB matengenezo mkopo uliotolewa kwa wanafunzi wote wa chuo kikuu kupitia portal ya kuangalia.
Somali: Ksh 2,000 deyn dayactir ah oo HELB ah oo la siiyay dhammaan ardayda jaamacadda.
Dholuo: Ksh 2,000 HELB rito loan ma ne ochiw ne jopuonjre duto mag yunivasiti ma ne ochung’ ne mbui.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada ee Degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mar bajet mar kaunti e kaunti mar Isiolo.

English: KICD releases digital textbooks adapted for learners with special educational needs, including audio and braille format.
Kiswahili: KICD hutoa vitabu vya masomo vya digital vinavyofaa kwa wanafunzi wenye mahitaji maalum ya elimu, ikiwa ni pamoja na muundo wa sauti na braille.
Somali: KICD waxay soo saartaa buugaag waxbarasho oo dhijitaal ah oo loogu talagalay ardayda leh baahiyo waxbarasho gaar ah, oo ay ku jiraan qaabka maqalka iyo braille.
Dholuo: KICD golo buge mag somo mag digital molos ne jopuonjre ma nigi dwaro makende mag tiegruok, moriwo koda weche mag winjo kod ndiko e dho Braille.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges youth in Nyamira County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku boorinayaa dhalinyarada degmada Nyamira inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo rowere e Kaunti mar Nyamira mondo onyis weche ma gin-go mar ndiko ji kapok gitimo gik ma biro timore ne oganda.

English: CDC urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Trans Nzoia County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: CDC inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: CDC waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Trans Nzoia inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nyagore gi tuoche mag obwongo e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo owuo gi jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Develop a sensitization program to promote drought-resistant breeds and seed varieties.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza mpango wa uhamasishaji ili kukuza mifugo inayostahimili ukame na aina za mbegu.
Somali: Horumarinta barnaamij wacyigelin ah si loo dhiirrigeliyo noocyada abuurka ee u adkeysan abaaraha.
Dholuo: Tim chenro mar konyo ji ong'e ni kodhi ma nigi kodhi ma ok nyal yuso kata matin.

English: KALRO advises farmers in Garissa County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the May planting season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Mei.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Garissa inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maajo.

Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inafungua maombi ya kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will hold a depression awareness forum in Nyandarua County this June. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanya kongamano la uhamasishaji wa unyogovu katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Juni hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay qabaneysaa madasha wacyi galinta niyadjabka ee ku taal gobolka Nyandarua bisha Juun. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo chokruok mar chiwo paro e wi tuoche mag depression e taon mar Nyandarua e dwe mar Jun. Ji duto mor.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) warns public officers in Kilifi County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Kilifi dhidi ya rushwa katika ofisi za umma.

Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e gweng' mar Kilifi ni kik giyud asoya e migepe mar sirkal.

English: Notice: CDC will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Machakos County this November. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: CDC itafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Machakos Novemba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Xusuusin: CDC waxay qabaneysaa madasha caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada ee degmada Machakos bisha November. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni CDC biro timo romo mar paro ne rowere e gweng' mar Machakos e dwe mar Novemba.

Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur e County mar Lamu mondo okel namba mar pimo jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General nyiso jogweng' Kilifi County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom websait mar e-Citizen sama gidwaro yudo barua mar nyuol.

Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa msaada wa kisheria bure katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NTSA ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony ma onge chudo e bwo chik e County mar Nyandarua.

English: Notice: KMTC opens applications for textbooks and learning materials for learners in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inafungua maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.

Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KMTC chako tiyo gi buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok ne jopuonjre man Nairobi County.

English: Ministry of Education conducts a civic education forum on voter registration in Wajir County this July.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Wajir Julai hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa bishii Luulyo ee sannadkan ka qaban doonta madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha degmada Wajir.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Puonjruok dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi ndiko joma oyiero e boma mar Wajir County e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya launches a burglary prevention campaign in Kakamega County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Maamulka Isgaarsiinta Kenya wuxuu bilaabay olole ka hortagga jabsashada Gobolka Kakamega bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chako kampen mar geng'o jokuoge odonj e boma mar Kakamega e dwe mar Jun.

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health warns of increased cyclosporiasis risk in Kirinyaga County and advises the public to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya cyclosporiasis katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga na kushauri umma kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ka digtay kororka halista cyclosporiasis ee Gobolka Kirinyaga waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Trans Nzoia County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kazini wakati wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia inay guryahooda ku rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo shaqada inta lagu jiro xilliyada shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service parone jogweng' Trans Nzoia County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag nego ligek mach e utegi kendo giti e kinde masiche mag ndara.

English: NPS urges the public in Nyeri County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: NPS inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: NPS waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadweynaha degmada Nyeri inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo ji duto e County mar Nyeri mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma ne oland kuom weche mag phishing.

English: KTDA urges sheep farmers in Garissa County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wafugaji wa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa kufuatia kesi za ugonjwa wa Newcastle zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda idaha ee Gobolka Garissa inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo ka dib kiisaska cudurka Newcastle ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur ma pidho rombe e gweng' mar Garissa mondo ogeng'e legi e kuonde moyier mag chamo rombe bang' yudo weche mag tuo mar Newcastle.

English: AFA encourages farmers in Murang'a County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for horticultural produce.
Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora za mazao ya bustani.

Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e county mar Murang'a mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar puothe mag puothe.

Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuimarisha usalama wa miundombinu ya shule Februari hii.

Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Desemba.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Embu inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Diseembar.

Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu hutumia madarasa ya kurekebisha kupitia majukwaa ya dijiti kusaidia wanafunzi katika mikoa iliyopuuzwa.

Dholuo: COMESA chiwo siem ne jopur mag ngano e gweng' mar Kilifi ni nitie tuoche ma nyalo kelo tuoche kendo ojiwo ni otim kamano e kinde mowinjore.
