English: NDMA alerts residents of Kitui County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Somali: NDMA waxay dadka deggan degmada Kitui uga digtay kororka kiisaska xoolaha lagu xado waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: NDMA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kitui County e wi medruok mar weche mag kwalo jamni kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag ritruok gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Notice: OGP will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee degmada Marsabit.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: OGP biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e taon mar Marsabit.

English: HELB calls on the community in Nyeri County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: HELB inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: HELB waxay bulshada degmada Nyeri ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyo.
Dholuo: HELB luongo ji duto manie County mar Nyeri mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: NCPB reminds residents of Nyandarua County that organic farming improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba kilimo hai kinaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: NCPB waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Nyandarua in beeraha dabiiciga ah uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: NCPB paronwa jogweng' Nyandarua County ni pur ma nigi yien ma ok oketie yien miyo puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: Council of Governors rolls out civic education on how county budgets work.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana huanzisha elimu ya raia juu ya jinsi bajeti za kaunti zinavyofanya kazi.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay soo saaraan waxbarasho dadweyne ah oo ku saabsan sida miisaaniyadda gobolka ay u shaqeyso.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch chako puonjo ji kaka bajet mag sirkal tiyo.

English: Judiciary of Kenya announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kurejesha huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la hagaajiyay waqtiga wareejinta adeegyada baasaboorka ee degmada Marsabit.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya olando lokruok e seche mag tiyo gi passport e county mar Marsabit.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds expectant mothers in Trans Nzoia County that access to nutrition supplementation for infants is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba upatikanaji wa nyongeza ya lishe kwa watoto wachanga ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Trans Nzoia in helitaanka cuntada lagu daro dhallaanka ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Trans Nzoia ni nyithindo ma rowere nyalo yudo chiemb chuny maonge chudo e ute duto.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Elgeyo-Marakwet County that access to post-violence medical care is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu zinapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in helitaanka daryeelka caafimaad ee rabshadda ka dib ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni yudo kony mar thieth ma iyudo bang' timno onge chudo.

English: IPOA alerts residents of Kisii County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: IPOA waxay dadka deggan degmada Kisii uga digtay kororka kiisaska gaadiidka la xaday waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: IPOA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kisii County kuom wach medruok mar wuondo mtokni kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne polis man machiegni.

English: Council of Governors urges residents of Kisumu County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kuwasilisha maandishi ya kumbukumbu kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha waxay ku boorinayaan dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga loo dhigay si loo qaabeeyo wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Council of Governors jiwo jogweng' mar Kisumu County mondo ochiw paro mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso chenro mag chenro mag oganda.

English: Fight environmental pollution through community action.
Kiswahili: Kupambana na uchafuzi wa mazingira kupitia hatua za jamii.
Somali: La dagaalanka wasakhda deegaanka iyada oo la adeegsanayo dhaqdhaqaaqyo bulshada.
Dholuo: Kedo gi kethruok mar alwora kokalo kuom timbe mag oganda.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya issues a cybersecurity alert on SIM-swap fraud affecting residents of Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Maamulka Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya wuxuu soo saaray digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaanooyinka SIM-swap ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji ogolo siem mar rito weche mag intanet e wi wuond mag SIM-swap makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Nyeri County.

English: TVET reminds schools in Trans Nzoia County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this January.
Kiswahili: TVET inazikumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Januari hii.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Trans Nzoia inay xoojiyaan adeegyada hagista iyo la talinta bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa skunde mag Trans Nzoia County mondo omed jiwo kendo chiwo kony e dwe mar Januar.

English: OGP reminds the public in Bungoma County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this June.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba mchango juu ya mapitio ya utendaji wa kila mwaka unakaribishwa Juni hii.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Bungoma in talooyinka ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah la soo dhaweynayo bisha Juun.
Dholuo: OGP oparo ne ji duto e County mar Bungoma ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e dwe mar Jun.

English: KALRO announces a free lumpy skin disease vaccination exercise for poultry in Nyamira County this October.
Kiswahili: KALRO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa ngozi kwa kuku katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Oktoba hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo cudurka maqaarka ee digaagga ee gobolka Nyamira bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KALRO ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar dhoot e dwe mar Oktoba e kaunti mar Nyamira.

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages mothers in Kirinyaga County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kirinyaga inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo mine manie County mar Kirinyaga mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Garissa County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Garissa: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Februari 2024
Somali: Degmada Garissa: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Garissa: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2024

English: FAO and Belgium assist communities in Kenya to avert a hunger crisis
Kiswahili: FAO na Ubelgiji zinasaidia jamii nchini Kenya kuepusha janga la njaa
Somali: FAO iyo Belgium waxay ka caawinayaan bulshooyinka ku nool Kenya inay ka hortagaan xaalad gaajo ah
Dholuo: FAO kod Belgium konyo oganda e piny Kenya mondo ogeng' masira mar kech

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds residents of Nyeri County that water harvesting improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba uvunaji wa maji unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri in soo-saarka biyaha uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development parone jogweng' Nyeri County ni choko pi miyo puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: KTDA urges poultry farmers in Makueni County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wafugaji wa kuku katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyoteuliwa kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa Newcastle vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda digaagga ee degmada Makueni inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo ka dib kiisaska cudurka Newcastle ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur ma pidho dhok e gweng' mar Makueni mondo ogeng'e legi e kuonde moketi mag ywayo le bang' yudo weche mag tuo mar Newcastle.

English: NDMA urges the public in Embu County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Embu wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: NDMA waxay ugu baaqeysaa shacabka degmada Embu inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo ji duto e county mar Embu mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' weche mag wuond ma ne otim gi SIM-swap.

English: The Kenya Cash Consortium's Locally Led Multi-Purpose Cash Response to Flood-Affected Refugees in Kenya: Endline - Baringo, Garissa, Marsabit, and Tana River Counties, April, 2024
Kiswahili: Mwitikio wa Pesa wa Malengo Mbalimbali wa Kenya Cash Consortium kwa Wakimbizi Walioathiriwa na Mafuriko nchini Kenya: Endline - Kaunti za Baringo, Garissa, Marsabit na Tana River, Aprili, 2024
Somali: Jawaab celinta Lacag-bixinta ee Ururka Lacagta ee Kenya oo ay Hoggaaminayaan Dadweyne badan oo u jeeddooyin kala duwan leh oo loogu talagalay Qaxootiga ay fatahaaduhu saameeyeen ee Kenya: Endline - Degmooyinka Baringo, Garissa, Marsabit, iyo Tana River, Abriil, 2024
Dholuo: Odruok mar pesa mang'eny ma otelo ne jolweny ma oyudo masira e piny Kenya: Giko - Baringo, Garissa, Marsabit, kod Kaunti mag Aora Tana, dwe mar ang'wen, higa mar 2024

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response calls on parents in Taita-Taveta County to have children under five screened for malaria during the July outreach.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuwafanya watoto chini ya miaka mitano wachunguzwe malaria wakati wa mawasiliano ya Julai.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta Gobolka Taita-Taveta in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka malariyada inta lagu gudajiro bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche kwayo jonyuol e Taita-Taveta County mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Julai.

English: Council of Governors reminds residents of Nyandarua County that access to national ID applications is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba kufikia maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua in helitaanka codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Council of Governors parone jogweng' Nyandarua County ni yudo kwayo mag ID mar piny sani yot ahinya kokalo kuom yore mag tich.

English: Notice: KRA opens a new service point for national ID applications in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay ka furaysaa goob adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee Gobolka Laikipia.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KRA oseyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag kwayo nying' mar ng'ato e gweng' mar Laikipia.

English: Notice: Council of Governors will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana litafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha waxay qaban doonaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada ee Degmada Tharaka-Nithi.
Dholuo: Rapar: Bura mar Jaloch biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e county mar Tharaka-Nithi.

English: HELB advises applicants in Meru County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: HELB inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Meru kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: HELB waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Meru inay dalbadaan booska TVET ee KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Meru mondo oketgi e program mar TVET kokalo kuom KUCCPS.

English: La preuve que handicap nâ€™est pas synonyme dâ€™inaptitude : CrÃ©ations dâ€™emplois dans lâ€™agriculture pour des jeunes en situation de handicap au Kenya
Kiswahili: La preuve que handicap n'est pas synonyme d'inaptitude : Creations d'emplois dans l'agriculture pour des jeunes en situation de handicap au Kenya
Somali: La preuve que handicap nâ€™est pas synonyme dâ€™inaptitude
Dholuo: Okang' motelo, ng'at ma nigi nyalruok ok en wach ma chal gi ng'at ma nigi nyalruok: Kido ma ne an-go mar tiyo e pur mondo okony nyithindo ma rowere ma ni e chal mar ng'at ma nigi nyalruok e piny Kenya.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will be held in Bomet County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Bomet Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ay qabanqaabisay qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada ayaa lagu qaban doonaa gobolka Bomet bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma biro bedoe e dwe mar Mei e taon mar Bomet County.

English: Notice: Council of Governors launches the county integrated development plan in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Mawaziri linazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa bilaabay qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee Baringo County.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Jaloch chako chenro mar timo dongruok e alwora mar Baringo County.

English: Kenya: Humanitarian impact of heavy rains and flooding - Flash Update #2 (20 November 2023)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Athari za kibinadamu za mvua kubwa na mafuriko - Sasisho la Flash #2 (20 Novemba 2023)
Somali: Kenya: Saamaynta Bani'aadamnimada ee Roobabka culus iyo Daadadka - Cusboonaysiinta Degdegga ah #2 (20 Noofambar 2023)
Dholuo: Kenya: Midhiero mag koth mang'eny kod pi mopong'o piny - Oboke mar ariyo (20 dwe mar apar gi achiel dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2023)

English: Poultry breeders are losing significant profits due to cheap day old chick imports Stakeholders should assess market conditions to adapt their breeding plans accordingly
Kiswahili: Wafugaji wa kuku wanapoteza faida kubwa kutokana na uagizaji wa vifaranga kwa bei nafuu Wadau wanapaswa kutathmini hali ya soko ili kuendana na mipango yao ya ufugaji ipasavyo.
Somali: Reer digaagga ayaa luminaya faa'iidooyin badan sababtoo ah soo dejinta digaagga da'da yar ee maalmaha yar ee da'da yar ee laga keenay Dhinacyada daneeyayaashu waa inay qiimeeyaan xaaladaha suuqa si ay u hagaajiraan qorshahooda taranka si waafaqsan
Dholuo: Jochiwo mag le mag dhok yudogi pesa mang'eny nikech ohala ma ne gigolo kuom dhok ma ne ok nyal nyiew ahinya

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges anyone experiencing abuse in Bungoma County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unashauri mtu yeyote anayeona unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuripoti kesi hiyo kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada wuxuu ku boorinayaa qofkasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Bungoma inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e County mar Bungoma mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Kenya - Floods, update (UN OCHA, Kenya Meteorological Department) (ECHO Daily Flash of 20 June 2024)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Mafuriko, sasisho (UN OCHA, Idara ya Hali ya Hewa ya Kenya) (ECHO Daily Flash ya 20 Juni 2024)
Somali: Kenya - Daadadka, cusbooneysiinta (UN OCHA, Waaxda Saadaasha Hawada Kenya) (Flash Maalinle ah oo ECHO ah oo ah 20 Juun 2024)
Dholuo: Kenya - Pi mang'eny, duoko manyien (Ofis mar weche mag kor lwasi e piny Kenya) (20 dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2024)

English: Health Ministry launching SMS alert to inform citizens when foods exceed sugar/salt/fat thresholds.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yazindua tahadhari ya SMS ili kuwafahamisha raia wakati vyakula vinazidi viwango vya sukari/chumvi/mafuta.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka oo soo saartay digniin SMS ah si loo wargeliyo muwaadiniinta marka cuntooyinka ay ka badan yihiin heerarka sonkorta / cusbada / dufanka.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth chako chiwo siem e yor SMS mondo okony raia ng'eyo ka chiemo okalo tong' mar sukari / chumbi / chamo kong'o.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on parents in Kiambu County to have children under five screened for cyclosporiasis during the October outreach.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya watoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuwafanyia uchunguzi watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa ugonjwa wa cyclosporiasis wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Oktoba.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Kiambu in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka cyclosporiasis inta lagu jiro tallaalka Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross kwayo jonyuol e County mar Kiambu mondo onyis nyithindgi ma johigni abich kata matin ni gin gi tuwo mar cyclosporiasis e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges youth in West Pokot County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhalinyarada degmada West Pokot inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education ojiwo rowere e West Pokot County mondo oriwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county ka pok ochopo tije mag oganda.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges anyone experiencing abuse in Nyamira County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Nyamira piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Nyamira inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e County mar Nyamira mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: The idealogy of starting climate smart agriculture (CSA) pioneered by FAO together with International Alliance on Clinate Smart Agriculture (IACSS)whose duty...
Kiswahili: Wazo la kuanzisha kilimo mahiri cha hali ya hewa (CSA) lililoanzishwa na FAO pamoja na Muungano wa Kimataifa wa Kilimo Mahiri cha Clinate (IACSS)ambao wajibu...
Somali: Fikradda ah in la bilaabo beeraleyda caqliga leh ee cimilada (CSA) oo ay hormuud u ahayd FAO oo ay weheliyaan International Alliance on Clinate Smart Agriculture (IACSS) oo waajibaadkoodu yahay...
Dholuo: Chenro mar chako timo pur mar piny (Climate Smart Agriculture - CSA) ma ne otim gi FAO kaachiel gi International Alliance on Clinate Smart Agriculture (IACSS) ma ne nigi tich mar...

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education reminds citizens in Uasin Gishu County about their rights regarding devolution.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka Uasin Gishu waxay muwaadiniinta ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Puonjruok ma Chakre e Piny owacho parone raia mag Uasin Gishu County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar chiwo.

English: Ministry of Education organizes a national STEM entrepreneurship week with workshops and innovation showcases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inaandaa wiki ya kitaifa ya ujasiriamali ya STEM na mafunzo na maonyesho ya uvumbuzi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay qabanqaabisaa toddobaadkii ganacsiga STEM ee qaranka oo leh aqoon isweydaarsiyo iyo bandhigyada hal-abuurnimada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok ochano juma mar bedo jatelo e yore mag STEM e piny mangima.

English: Farmers are urged to report any suspected sale or distribution of fake seeds to the Tanzania Official Seed Certification Institute TOSCI or the Prevention and Combating of Corruption Bureau PCCB
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaombwa kutoa taarifa kwa tuhuma za uuzaji au usambazaji wa mbegu feki kwa Taasisi Rasmi ya Udhibitishaji wa Mbegu Tanzania TOSCI au Taasisi ya Kuzuia na Kupambana na Rushwa TAKUKURU.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu booriyay inay soo sheegaan iibka ama qaybinta abuurka been abuurka ah ee la tuhmay Machadka Shahaadada Abuurka ee TOSCI ee Tanzania ama Xafiiska Ka Hortagga iyo La-dagaallanka Musuqmaasuqa ee PCCB
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma bende timo tijno, onego ochiw ripot ne TOSCI ma en riwruok mar Tanzania mar chiwo kodhino mag miriambo, kata ne PCCB ma en ofis mar geng'o mibadhi.

English: Refugee and host communities often experience limited livelihood opportunities, while competition over water, energy, forests and land intensifies environmental stress and weakens social cohesion.
Kiswahili: Wakimbizi na jumuiya zinazowapokea mara nyingi hupata fursa ndogo za kujikimu, wakati ushindani juu ya maji, nishati, misitu na ardhi huzidisha dhiki ya mazingira na kudhoofisha mshikamano wa kijamii.
Somali: Bulshooyinka qaxootiga iyo kuwa martida loo yahay waxay inta badan la kulmaan fursado nololeed oo xaddidan, halka tartanka biyaha, tamarta, kaymaha iyo dhulka uu xoojiyo walbahaarka deegaanka isla markaana uu wiiqayo isku xirnaanta bulshada.
Dholuo: Jolweny kod jodak ma rwakogi kinde ka kinde yudo thuolo matin mag dak, to ng’wech mar yudo pi, teko, bungu kod piny medo pek mag alwora kendo ketho winjruok e kind oganda.

English: KRA urges eligible citizens in Meru County to participate in voter education.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wananchi wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Meru kushiriki katika elimu ya wapiga kura.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Meru inay ka qaybqaataan waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro mar yiero e county mar Meru mondo oriwgi e tiegruok mar josiasa.

Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandaoni wa kaunti ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.

Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng' county mar Mombasa mondo oriwre gi county's online participation portal e loso chenro mar bajet mar county.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Medical Association will be held in Homa Bay County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Mei hii.

English: Motorcycle riders and passengers (boda boda) are required to wear helmets at all times when traveling to protect themselves against road accidents.
Kiswahili: Madereva na abiria wa pikipiki (boda boda) wanatakiwa kuvaa kofia ngumu (helimeti) kila wakati wanaposafiri ili kujilinda dhidi ya ajali za barabarani.

Kiswahili: EACC inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga juu ya maendeleo ya programu za maendeleo ya jamii mnamo Agosti hii.

Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji ni nonro mar Rift Valley Fever maonge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County Kilifi e dwe mar Jun.

English: KEPHIS encourages farmers in Kiambu County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora ya mahindi.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kiambu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay hadhuudhka.

English: IEBC encourages out-of-school children in Murang'a County to register their children at the nearest public school under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.

Dholuo: IEBC jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e county mar Murang'a mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni gi skul mar ji duto e klas mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Narok County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.

Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne jogweng' Narok County ni kik ging'ad kor lwasi mag pi kod pi e kinde mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: Notice: FAO will distribute certified rice seed to farmers in Kilifi County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itasambaza mbegu za mpunga zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Machi hii.

English: E-Citizen invites residents of Siaya County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kushiriki kupitia portal ya kushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.

Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Narok Machi hii.

Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA timo romo mar oganda e dwe mar Mach e kaunti mar Narok.

English: ODPP reminds residents of Lamu County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kwamba upatikanaji wa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Nakuru County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.

Dholuo: Ministry of Health nyiso jogweng' Nakuru County mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Notice: KMTC announces school feeding programme enrollment dates for schools in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa programu ya kulisha shule kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.

Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kakamega inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.

Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC yazindua mpango wa usalama wa miundombinu ya shule katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kiambu.

Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu imetoa mafunzo kwa watoa huduma wa AI kuhusu utunzaji wa rekodi za kidijitali kwa kutumia DigiCow Mobile Application kwa ripoti bora za ufugaji.

Dholuo: Sirkal mar County mar Uasin Gishu osepuonjo jorit ma tiyo gi teko mar timo nonro e weche mag digital ka gitiyo gi DigiCow Mobile Application mondo gimed nyiso kit kit le

Dholuo: Kenya osenyiso ji adek manyien ma nigi tuwo mar Mpox e piny Busia; Ministry of Health osiemo ni nitie nengo maduong' mar kelo tuoche mar Marburg kod Ebola e piny Tanzania kod Sudan.

Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa za kuponda ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.

Dholuo: NCPB paronwa jorit jamni e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo ogeng'e legi e kuonde moketi mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: Devastating flooding in South Sudan is affecting around 1.4 million people, with more than 379,000 displaced, according to a United Nations update that warned about an upsurge in malaria.
Kiswahili: Mafuriko yenye kuharibu nchini Sudan Kusini yanaathiri watu milioni 1.4 hivi, na zaidi ya watu 379,000 wametoroka makao yao, kulingana na ripoti ya Umoja wa Mataifa iliyoonya kuhusu kuongezeka kwa malaria.
Somali: Daadad burburin ah oo ka dhacay Koonfurta Suudaan ayaa saameyn ku leh qiyaastii 1.4 milyan oo qof, iyadoo in ka badan 379,000 oo qof ay barakaceen, sida ku cad warbixinta Qaramada Midoobay oo ka digtay kororka cudurka malaria.
Dholuo: Ripot moro mar Riwruok mar Pinje ma ne ochiwo siem e wi kaka malaria biro medore e piny Sudan ma Milambo, nyiso ni koth maduong' osekelo ne ji ma dirom milion 1.4 chandruok, kendo ji mokalo 379,000 osewuok e miechgi.

English: E-Citizen reminds residents of Trans Nzoia County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia in ka qaybgalka maamulaha degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa jogweng'o mag Trans Nzoia County ni tudruok gi jotelo mag gwenge maggi miyo sirkal bedo gi loch maber.

English: Universities Fund encourages out-of-school children in Turkana County to register their children at the nearest public school under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Turkana kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya mgao wa bursary.

Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo nyithindo maok dhi e skul e County mar Turkana mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni gi skul mar sirkal.

English: IPOA alerts residents of Murang'a County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua.

English: Trainings from Chlorophyll Africa on soils, guarding organic manure in land to sustain ground fertility is important in parts of Kenya, not for production alone but as a lifestyle. Just as growing population demand food, sustainable food system is vital urgently. Chlorophyll Africa is on the frontline in this initiatives, in making innovative steps and a friend to the environment of agriculture but guarding investment among farmers.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo kutoka Chlorophyll Afrika juu ya udongo, kulinda uchafu wa kikaboni katika ardhi ili kudumisha uzazi wa ardhi ni muhimu katika sehemu za Kenya, si kwa uzalishaji tu lakini kama mtindo wa maisha. Kama vile mahitaji ya watu unaozidi kukua kwa chakula, mfumo wa chakula endelevu ni muhimu kwa haraka. Chlorophyll Afrika ni katika mstari wa mbele katika mipango hii, katika kufanya hatua za ubunifu na rafiki kwa mazingira ya kilimo lakini kulinda uwekezaji kati ya wakulima.
Somali: Tababaro ka socda Chlorophyll Africa oo ku saabsan ciidda, ilaalinta baahinta organic ee dhulka si loo ilaaliyo bacrinta dhulka waa muhiim qaybo ka mid ah Kenya, ma aha oo kaliya wax soo saarka balse sida nolol nololeed. Sida dadka sii kordhaya ay u baahan yihiin cunto, nidaamka cuntada waara waa mid muhiim ah si degdeg ah. Chlorophyll Africa waxay hormuud ka tahay mashaariicdan, iyadoo qaadaysa tallaabooyin hal-abuur leh isla markaana saaxiib u ah deegaanka beeraha laakiin ilaalinaysa maalgelinta beeraleyda.
Dholuo: Tiegruok ma Chlorophyll Africa timo e lowo, rito yien mag yien e lowo mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber, en gima duong' ahinya e pinje mag Kenya, ok mana e weche mag loso chiemo kende, to bende e yore mag ngima. Mana kaka kwan mar ji mang'eny dwaro chiemo, chenro mar chiemo ma nigi nyak dwarore ahinya. Chlorophyll Africa en achiel kuom joma otelo e chenrono, kuom timo dongruok e yore mag timo dongruok kendo bedo osiep alwora mar pur to bende rito ohala e kind jopur.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds mobile money users in Narok County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Narok kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Narok inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e Narok County ni mondo ginyis jomisonari maggi weche maok adier mondo kik gitim chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Kitui County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada daadadka ka dhacay xilligan dabka.
Dholuo: NDMA oparo ne jogweng' Kitui County ni kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o e kinde mag yiengni.

English: IPOA warns residents of Siaya County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this May.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Mei hii.
Somali: IPOA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay u diyaargaroobaan qaraxyo dab ah oo dhici kara bisha May.
Dholuo: IPOA osiemo jogweng' mar Siaya County mondo oikre ne yiengni manyalo timore e dwe mar Mei.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of Kajiado County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay la xiriiraan lataliye la tababaran yahay.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giwuo gi jang'ad rieko molony.

English: NDMA reminds the public in Meru County to remain vigilant on border security.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Meru kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Meru inay ka feejignaadaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: NDMA parone ji duto e County mar Meru ni gibed motang' e weche mag rito tong'.

English: Notice: KEMRI confirms a typhoid outbreak alert for Migori County. Residents are advised to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa matumbo kwa Kaunti ya Migori. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ku saabsan cudurka tifooska ee degmada Migori. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KEMRI osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuwo mar typhoid e kaunti mar Migori.

English: NDMA urges the community in Mombasa County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb burglary.
Kiswahili: NDMA inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Mombasa inay ka warbixiyaan waxqabadka shakiga ah xarunta booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo ji duto e county mar Mombasa mondo ochiw ripot e stesen mar polise man machiegni mondo gikwed nek.

English: DPP urges residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa umakini mkubwa wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: DPP waxay ugu baaqaysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nabadgelyada qaranka.
Dholuo: DPP ojiwo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi kuom loso kuwe.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will train farmers in Machakos County on organic farming this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos juu ya kilimo hai Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa tababar siin doonta beeraleyda Degmada Machakos ee beeraha dabiiciga ah bisha July.
Dholuo: Rapar: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro tiego jopur e county mar Machakos e wi pur mar le e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Makueni County this March.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Makueni Machi hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada Waxbarashada wuxuu qabtaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha gobolka Makueni bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi migawo mar Ombudsman e kaunti mar Makueni e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: KMTC opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay furaysaa codsiyada deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan ardayda ku jira degmada Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC oyawo kwayo mag yudo osuru ne jopuonjre man gi dwaro mag somo e County mar Lamu.

English: Notice: KRA will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ee degmada Makueni.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KRA biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e kaunti mar Makueni.

English: Kitui County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kitui: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2023
Somali: Degmada Kitui: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kitui: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar adek higa mar 2023

English: KEMRI advises residents of Meru County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMRI waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay haystaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMRI nyiso jogweng' mar County mar Meru mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi ka gidwaro yudo thieth mar yudo kony mar thieth.

English: NDMA reminds mobile money users in Kilifi County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa fedha za simu.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kilifi inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: NDMA paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e County ma Kilifi mondo ochiw ripot mar ote manyalo kelo hinyruok ne jatendgi mar konyo ji mondo kik gitim timbe mag mibadhi.

English: NCPB promotes agroforestry among farmers in Trans Nzoia County as part of the September climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: NCPB inakuza kilimo cha misitu kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Septemba.
Somali: NCPB waxay dhiirrigelisay beeraleyda beeraha ee degmada Trans Nzoia iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo yiende mag yiende e kind jopur e Trans Nzoia County kaka achiel kuom chenro mar Septemba mar kedo gi lokruok e kit yamo.

English: DPP urges residents of West Pokot County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya West Pokot kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa umakini mkubwa kwa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi kuom loso kuwe.

English: Kenya Dairy Board urges poultry farmers in Busia County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported rabies cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawahimiza wafugaji wa kuku katika Kaunti ya Busia kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya kichaa cha mbwa vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda digaagga ee degmada Busia inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska xanaaqa la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur ma pidho dhok e county mar Busia mondo onyis le matuwo e ofise mar thieth machiegni gi kanyo bang' yudo weche mag rabies.

English: OGP urges residents of Kajiado County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on community-based development programmes.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kajiado County kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono ka gitiyo gi websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mag dongruok mag oganda.

English: Mandera County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Mandera: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Februari 2024
Somali: Degmada Mandheera: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Mandera: Oboke machon mar goyo oro mar dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2024

English: Council of Governors advises residents of Homa Bay County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e-Citizen.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay kula talinayaan dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan diiwaangelinta e-Citizen.
Dholuo: Council of Governors nyiso jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro dhi e e-Citizen registration.

English: #KnowTheFacts What are the symptoms of #COVID19. fever. cough shortness of breath. Help to #KomeshaCorona protect yourself & loved ones from #CoronaVirus
Kiswahili: #Fahamu Ukweli Dalili za #COVID19 ni zipi. homa. kikohozi upungufu wa pumzi. Msaada wa #KomeshaCorona kujikinga na uwapendao dhidi ya #CoronaVirus
Somali: #Ogow Xaqiiqooyinka Waa maxay astaamaha #COVID19. qandho. qufac neefsasho gaaban. Caawinta #KomeshaCorona si aad naftaada iyo kuwa aad jeceshahay uga ilaaliso #CoronaVirus
Dholuo: #Ng'e Adier Gin ranyisi mage mag #COVID19. liet mar del. ng’ol ng’ol mar muya. Kony mondo #KomeshaCorona orit in iwuon & johera gi #CoronaVirus

English: Event includes civic talks and games
Kiswahili: Tukio hilo linajumuisha mazungumzo na michezo ya kiraia
Somali: Dhacdadan waxaa ka mid ah wadahadal iyo ciyaaro dadweyne ah
Dholuo: Chokruogno oting'o twege kod tuke mag oganda

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations alerts residents of Murang'a County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: Agaasinka Cilmi baarista dambiyada ayaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a uga digaya kororka kiisaska xoolaha lagu xado wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne ji modak e County mar Murang'a e wi medruok mar weche mag kwalo jamni kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Kenya Red Cross launches an April awareness campaign on food safety across Embu County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Aprili juu ya usalama wa chakula katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Abriil oo ku saabsan amniga cuntada ee Gobolka Embu.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar April e wi wach rito chiemo e alwora duto mar Embu County.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations launches a fraud prevention campaign in Makueni County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Makueni Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa bilaabay olole ka hortagga khiyaamooyinka degmada Makueni bishii November.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche motudore gi timbe mahundu chako kampen mar geng'o mibadhi e gweng' mar Makueni e dwe mar Novemba.

English: East Africa Seasonal Monitor: Extensive flooding across parts of East Africa (April 30, 2024)
Kiswahili: Ufuatiliaji wa Msimu wa Afrika Mashariki: Mafuriko makubwa katika maeneo ya Afrika Mashariki (Aprili 30, 2024)
Somali: Kormeeraha Xilliyeedka Bariga Afrika: Daadad ballaaran oo ka dhacay qaybo ka mid ah Bariga Afrika (Abriil 30, 2024)
Dholuo: Rang'o Kinde mag Afrika ma Wuokchieng': Opong'o pi mang'eny e kuonde moko mag Afrika ma Wuokchieng' (30 Ang'wen higa mar 2024)

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages residents of Baringo County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay ula xiriiraan lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit jiwo jogweng' Baringo County mondo kik gisandgi gi ling'ling' kendo mondo giwuo gi jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds residents of Narok County that access to national ID applications is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kwamba kufikia maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Narok in helitaanka codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone jogweng' Narok County ni yudo kwayo mag ID e piny mangima koro yot moloyo kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds needy students in Siaya County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka ayaa xasuusinaya ardayda u baahan degmada Siaya in buugaagta waxbarasho iyo codsiyada qalabka waxbarasho ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e county mar Siaya ni buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok biro rumo machiegni.

English: Verify charities before donating online.Ã‚ÂFake fundraisers are common.
Kiswahili: Thibitisha mashirika ya kutoa misaada kabla ya kutoa michango mtandaoni.Ã‚ÂMichango bandia ni ya kawaida.
Somali: Hubi samafalka ka hor intaadan ku deeqin khadka tooska ah. Lacag ururinta been abuurka ah waa wax caadi ah.
Dholuo: Inyalo ng’eyo ni riwruoge mag konyo joma ochando kapok ichiwo chiwo e mbui.

English: HELB advises applicants in Migori County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: HELB inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Migori kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: HELB waxay ku talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Migori inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee la heli karo.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Migori mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: Notice: IEBC opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Embu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay ka furaysaa goob adeeg cusub oo lagu shaqeynayo shahaadada dhalashada degmada Embu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mar loso nyasi mag nyuol e County mar Embu.

English: Notice: KEMRI will hold a suicide prevention forum in Kirinyaga County this August. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI itafanya kongamano la kuzuia kujiua katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Agosti hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka hortagga ismiidaaminta ee Gobolka Kirinyaga bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMRI biro timo chokruok mar geng'o ji kik donjre e dwe mar Agost e gweng' mar Kirinyaga.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges farmers in Mombasa County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda gobolka Mombasa inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Chandruok jiwo jopur e County mar Mombasa mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi pur mar piny mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Huduma Kenya advises residents of Kwale County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya nyiso jogweng' mar Kwale County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal ka gidwaro tiyo gi passport.

English: Ministry of Health announces outpatient services for residents of Samburu County starting this July.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatangaza huduma za wagonjwa wa nje kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kuanzia Julai hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ku dhawaaqday adeegyada bukaanka dibedda ee dadka deggan degmada Samburu laga bilaabo bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health olando ni obiro konyo joma odak e county mar Samburu chakre dwe mar Julai.

English: Ministry updating training module  to strengthen response to malnutrition at community level.
Kiswahili: Wizara inasasisha moduli ya mafunzo ili kuimarisha majibu dhidi ya utapiamlo katika kiwango cha jamii.
Somali: Wasaaraddu waxay cusbooneysiineysaa qaab-dhismeedka tababarka si loo xoojiyo jawaab celinta quudinta hoose ee heer bulshada.
Dholuo: Migawo mar tiego ji mondo omed rieyo yore mag kedo gi tuoche mag chiemo e okang' malach.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) restricts movement of cattle in Kirinyaga County due to a rabies outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inazuia harakati za ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kutokana na mlipuko wa kichaa cha mbwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da Gobolka Kirinyaga sababo la xiriira cudurka cadho.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Tij Lemo kod Chiemo (AFA) ogeng'o wuoth mar jamni e County mar Kirinyaga nikech tuo mar rabies.

English: KICD announces distribution of revision guides to schools in Marsabit County this April.
Kiswahili: KICD inatangaza usambazaji wa miongozo ya marekebisho kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Aprili hii.
Somali: KICD waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta hagaha dib u eegista dugsiyada degmada Marsabit bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: KICD olando ni gibiro pogo buge malero weche manyien e skunde mag Marsabit County e dwe mar April.

English: take care of your mental health, health relationship and seek for help when you need it
Kiswahili: kutunza afya yako ya akili, uhusiano wa afya na kutafuta msaada wakati unahitaji
Somali: daryeelka caafimaadkaaga maskaxda, xiriirka caafimaadka iyo raadinta caawimaad marka aad u baahan tahay
Dholuo: ritri gi parruok ma in-go, winjruokni gi jomoko, kendo iyud kony sama idwaro

English: Three pathways IFAD can support digital agriculture in Asia-Pacific region. Business farmers in Asia-Pacific continue increasing sales..
Kiswahili: Njia tatu IFAD inaweza kusaidia kilimo digital katika kanda ya Asia-Pacific. wakulima wa biashara katika Asia-Pacific kuendelea kuongeza mauzo..
Somali: Saddex waddo oo IFAD ay taageeri karto beeraha dijitaalka ah ee gobolka Asia-Pacific. Beeraleyda ganacsiga ee Asia-Pacific ayaa sii kordhinaya iibka..
Dholuo: Yore adek ma IFAD nyalo tiyogo e siro tij pur mar digital e Asia Pacific.

English: Kenya launches 'Early Warnings for All' initiative to enhance disaster preparedness
Kiswahili: Kenya inazindua mpango wa 'Tahadhari za Mapema kwa Wote' ili kuimarisha kujitayarisha kwa majanga
Somali: Kenya oo billowday hindisaha 'Digniinaha Hore ee Dhammaan' si kor loogu qaado u diyaargarowga masiibooyinka
Dholuo: Kenya ochako chenro mar ‘Chiemo Mopich ne Ji Duto’ mondo omed bedo moikore ne masira

English: HELB urges parents and teachers in Vihiga County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: HELB inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Somali: HELB waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Vihiga inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Vihiga mondo omany simo mar kony ne nyithindo namba 116.

English: IEBC encourages residents of Garissa County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on voter registration.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Garissa inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabaan diiwaangelinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Garissa mondo onyis weche duto motudore gi kad mar joma oyiero mondo ging'e weche duto e wi kad mar jogo ma oyiero.

English: KALRO reminds farmers in Homa Bay County of the ongoing modern irrigation techniques training programme.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji.
Somali: KALRO waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Homa Bay barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah.
Dholuo: KALRO parone jopur manie Homa Bay County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar yore mag lero pi.

English: Government to invest in infrastructure for digital learning hubs in communities to broaden access.
Kiswahili: Serikali yawekeza katika miundombinu kwa ajili ya vituo vya kujifunza digital katika jamii ili kupanua upatikanaji.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay maalgelineysaa kaabayaasha loogu talagalay xarumaha barashada dhijitaalka ah ee bulshooyinka si loo ballaariyo helitaanka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mondo oti gi chenro mar tiego ji e yore mag digital learning hubs e gwenge ma ji odakie mondo omed bedo gi thuolo mar somo.

English: HELB reminds parents in Nyamira County that free primary education registration is open this November.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba usajili wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo umefunguliwa Novemba hii.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Nyamira in diiwaangelinta bilaashka ah ee waxbarashada hoose ay furan tahay bisha November.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa jonyuol manie County mar Nyamira ni somo mar pinyruoth ma onge chudo ochakore e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Nyamira County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa msaada wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow si ay uga caawiyaan helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ee lacageed.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' Nyamira County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni mondo giyud kony mar yudo kony kuom weche thieth.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development opens a new ICT skills programme at the vocational centre in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yafungua programu mpya ya ujuzi wa ICT katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ka furayaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan xirfadaha ICT xarunta xirfadeed ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ochako chenro manyien mar lony e yore mag ICT e kar tich e Taita-Taveta County.

English: Ministry of Education pilots mobile science labs to enhance STEM education in arid and semi-arid lands.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inazindua maabara ya sayansi ya mkononi ili kuboresha elimu ya STEM katika nchi kavu na kavu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay bilaabaneysaa shaybaarro saynis oo mobile ah si kor loogu qaado waxbarashada STEM ee dhulka qalalan iyo kuwa semi-qalalan.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok chako tiyo gi masin mar sayans mondo otiek tiegruok e weche mag STEM e gwenge motuwo kod kuonde motuwo.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health: postnatal check-ups clinics will run every May at designated health centres in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya: kliniki za uchunguzi wa baada ya kuzaa zitafanya kazi kila Mei katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka: Xarumaha baaritaanka dhalmada ka dib waxaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Maajo ee kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth: Klinike mag thieth bang' nyuol ibiro timie dwe mar abich higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e county mar Siaya.

English: Notice: KEMSA confirms a dengue fever outbreak alert for Kilifi County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa homa ya dengue kwa Kaunti ya Kilifi. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMSA waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka hargabka dengue ee degmada Kilifi. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KEMSA osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuwo mar dengue e gweng' mar Kilifi.

English: Kenya, Africa | Floods 2023 Operational Strategy (MDRKE058)
Kiswahili: Kenya, Afrika | Mkakati wa Uendeshaji wa Mafuriko 2023 (MDRKE058)
Somali: Kenya, Afrika | Istaraatiijiyadda Hawlgalka Daadadka 2023 (MDRKE058)
Dholuo: Kenya, Afrika | Yore mag Tich mar Pi mang'eny e higa mar 2023 (MDRKE058)

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds needy students in Nyeri County that revision guides applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba maombi ya marekebisho yanafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya ardayda u baahan degmada Nyeri in dib u eegis lagu wado codsiyada la soo gabagabeeyay.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e County mar Nyeri ni lokruok mar gwelo kwayo mar dhi e skundno chiegni rumo.

English: Notice: IEBC launches ward-level service delivery in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inazindua huduma za huduma katika wilaya ya Kajiado.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay bilaabaysaa bixinta adeegyada heerka qaybta ee Gobolka Kajiado.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC chako chiwo kony e alwora mar Kajiado County.

English: Samburu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Samburu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2023
Somali: Degmada Samburu: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Samburu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar adek higa mar 2023

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) invites farmers in Taita-Taveta County to a free training on fertiliser application this July.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kwa mafunzo ya bure juu ya matumizi ya mbolea Julai hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Taita-Taveta tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan isticmaalka Bacriminta bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) ogwelo jopur e Taita-Taveta County e tiegruok ma onge chudo e dwe mar Julai.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) encourages farmers in Kiambu County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for coffee.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya kahawa.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kiambu inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan kafeega.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e County mar Kiambu mondo ous olembe mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo, mondo omi ohala mar chai obed maber.

English: The expansion of malaria vaccination follows the first WHO recommendation for a malaria vaccine in October 2021 that was informed by data and insights generated from the pilots.
Kiswahili: Upanuzi wa chanjo ya malaria unafuatia pendekezo la kwanza la WHO la chanjo ya malaria mnamo Oktoba 2021 ambalo lilitokana na data na maarifa yaliyotolewa kutoka kwa majaribio.
Somali: Ballaarinta tallaalka duumada ayaa ka dambeysay talo soo jeedintii ugu horreysay ee WHO ee tallaalka duumada bishii Oktoobar 2021 taas oo lagu ogaaday xog iyo aragtiyo laga soo saaray duuliyeyaasha.
Dholuo: Medo chanjo mar maleria luwore gi paro mokwongo ma WHO ne ogolo mar chanjo mar maleria e dwe mar apar higa mar 2021 ma ne onyis gi data kod paro ma ne owuok kuom jopidh ndege.

English: IEBC advises students in Samburu County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Samburu kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Somali: IEBC waxay ardayda degmada Samburu kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan buugaagta waxbarasho iyo qalabka wax lagu barto.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jopuonjre e county mar Samburu mondo oketgi e websait mar somo e yor intanet mondo giyud buge mag somo kod gik ma gipuonjore.

English: Urban gardening allows city dwellers to grow food. Explore techniques like container gardening and vertical growing for avocados.
Kiswahili: Ulimaji wa bustani mijini huwawezesha wakazi wa mijini kulima chakula. Chunguza mbinu kama vile ulimaji wa kwenye vyombo na ulimaji wima wa parachichi.
Somali: Beeraha magaalooyinka waxay u oggolaanayaan dadka deggan magaalooyinka inay koraan cunto. Baro farsamooyinka sida beeraha weelka iyo koritaanka toosan ee avocados.
Dholuo: Tij loso puothe e taonde miyo jogweng'e thuolo mar pidho chiemo.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will distribute certified sorghum seed to farmers in Garissa County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay abuuraha Gobolka Garissa u qaybin doontaa abuurka sorghum ee shahaadada la siiyay bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro pogo kodhi mag sorghum ne jopur e County mar Garissa e dwe mar Jun.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties urges residents of Laikipia County to attend the public participation forum to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si ay u qaabeeyaan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Laikipia mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar loso chenro mar dongruok.

English: IEBC advises residents of Bungoma County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: IEBC inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Somali: IEBC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan shahaadada dhalashada.
Dholuo: IEBC nyiso jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro yudo barua mar nyuol.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds livestock keepers in Kisii County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya xoolaha ka shaqeeya degmada Kisii inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda goobaha lagu burburiyo ee loo qoondeeyay si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board parone jopur mag jamni e County mar Kisii mondo ogeng' jamni maggi e kuonde moketi mag nego jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: All magistrates at all courts during this Covid period, will only manage important cases in all prisons, and proving rehabilitative directives, in a bid to reduce prison congetion. Courts handling petty crimes will dissemionate on bonding of suspects in remands
Kiswahili: Mawakili wote katika mahakama zote wakati wa kipindi hiki cha Covid, watashughulikia tu kesi muhimu katika magereza yote, na kuthibitisha maagizo ya urejesho, katika juhudi za kupunguza usumbufu wa magereza. Mahakama zinazoshughulikia uhalifu mdogo zitatangaza juu ya uhamisho wa washukiwa katika kifungo cha kizuizini
Somali: Dhammaan garsoorayaasha maxkamadaha inta lagu jiro muddadan COVID, waxay maareyn doonaan oo keliya kiisaska muhiimka ah ee dhammaan xabsiyada, waxayna cadeyn doonaan tilmaamaha dib-u-habeynta, si loo yareeyo culeyska xabsiga.
Dholuo: Joloch duto e kot duto e kinde mar Covid, biro mana rito weche madongo e jela duto, kendo nyiso chike mag dwoko ji e jela, e temo tieko ywaruok e jela.

English: Notice: KMTC launches a school infrastructure safety programme in schools across Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC yazindua mpango wa usalama wa miundombinu ya shule katika shule kote Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay bilawday barnaamij ku saabsan badbaadada kaabayaasha dugsiga ee dugsiyada gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC chako chenro mar rito kuonde tiegruok mag skul e skunde duto mag Lamu County.

English: HELB calls on the community in Siaya County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: HELB inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: HELB waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Siaya inay ka warbixiyaan wixii dhibaato ah ee ku saabsan amniga maamulka dugsiga si ay u ilaaliyaan amniga dugsiyada.
Dholuo: HELB kwayo ji duto e county mar Siaya mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar skul e wi weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: OGP reminds the public in Meru County that input on development planning forums is welcome this November.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Meru kwamba mchango kwenye vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo unakaribishwa Novemba hii.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Meru in talooyinka ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta la soo dhaweynayo bisha November.
Dholuo: OGP oparo ne ji duto e County mar Meru ni paro ma ji chiwo e wi chenro mag dongruok en gima owinjore e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: HELB launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha katika shule kote Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay bilawday barnaamij adeegyo hagis iyo la-talin ah oo ku yaal dugsiyada degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: HELB chako chenro mar konyo kendo chiwo paro e skunde duto mag Bungoma County.

English: NPS reminds residents of Nyeri County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this drought season.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi wakati huu wa ukame.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri in ay guryahooda ku rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo shaqada xilliyada abaarta.
Dholuo: NPS parone jogweng' Nyeri County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo giti e kinde mar oro.

English: KICD invites youth in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to enroll for motor vehicle mechanics training this May.
Kiswahili: KICD inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari Mei hii.
Somali: KICD waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka mashiinka gawaarida gaadiidka bisha May.
Dholuo: KICD gwelo rowere e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo odonj e tiegruok mar mechanics mag mtokni e dwe mar Mei.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges beans growers in Baringo County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawasihi wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Baringo kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa za kukabiliana na ukame ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda Baringo County inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur ma pidho keyo e Baringo County mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed nyak e higani.

English: Another, Omar, heard the announcement for vaccination at prayer at the Swalihini Mosque, Mombasa and made up his mind to go for it.
Kiswahili: Mwingine, Omar, alisikia tangazo la chanjo katika swala katika Msikiti wa Swalihini, Mombasa na akaamua kwenda kulipokea.
Somali: Mid kale oo la yiraahdo Cumar, ayaa maqlay ku dhawaaqista tallaalka salaadda ee Masjidka Swalihini ee Mombasa, wuxuuna go'aansaday inuu sidaas sameeyo.
Dholuo: Machielo manyinge Omar, nawinjo lendo mar chiwo chanjo e lamo e Mosque mar Swalihini, Mombasa kendo ne ong'ado paro mar dhi mondo omiye chanjo.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds the public in Siaya County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mkurugenzi Mkuu wa Ukaguzi hukumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa shacabka degmada Siaya in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General paronwa ji duto e County mar Siaya ni lando wach tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Notice: AFA will conduct a fertiliser application workshop for farmers in Kwale County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itafanya warsha ya maombi ya mbolea kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan isticmaalka bacriminta beeraleyda Gobolka Kwale bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Rapar: AFA biro timo tiegruok mar tiyo gi yien mag yien ne jopur e provins mar Kwale e dwe mar Februar.

English: Kenya: Heavy Rains and Flooding Update - Flash Update #1 (11 April 2024)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Mvua Kubwa na Taarifa ya Mafuriko - Sasisho la Flash #1 (11 Aprili 2024)
Somali: Kenya: Roobab Mahiigaan ah iyo Warbixin Daadad - Cusboonaysiinta Degdegga ah #1 (11 Abriil 2024)
Dholuo: Kenya: Koth Mapek kod Pi Opong'o Pi - Weche Mapiyo #1 (11 dwe mar ang'wen higa mar 2024)

English: Teachers Service Commission encourages residents of Migori County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kukaa na habari juu ya haki za kikatiba.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Migori inay ka qaybgalaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada si ay uga warqabaan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jogweng' Migori mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county mondo ging'e chike mag sirkal.

English: GIEWS Country Brief: Kenya 16-September-2024
Kiswahili: GIEWS Muhtasari wa Nchi: Kenya 16-Septemba-2024
Somali: Warbixinta Dalka ee GIEWS: Kenya 16-Sebtembar-2024
Dholuo: Wach machuok mar piny: Kenya tarik 16 dwe mar apar-2024

English: Ministry of Education reminds parents in Turkana County that free day secondary education registration is open this October.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba usajili wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo umefunguliwa Oktoba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Turkana in diiwaangelinta dugsiga dhexe ee bilaashka ah ay furan tahay bisha Oktoobar.
