Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi watumie portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.

English: KNEC conducts a civic education forum on voter registration in Nandi County this April.
Kiswahili: KNEC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Nandi Aprili hii.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ugu baaqay beeraleyda degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan qaabka roobabka ee isbeddelaya.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok mag Pest jiwo jopur e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo opidh olembe mag choko lowo mondo omed dwoko chien kethruok mar lowo mondo ginyagre gi lokruok mar koth.

Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unafungua dawati la jinsia kutoa simu ya msaada ya GBV ya bure katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa furaya xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ee degmada Meru.

Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, ufuatiliaji ulianzishwa, sampuli zilikusanywa na kupimwa kwa ugonjwa wa virusi vya Bundibugyo (BVD) na matokeo yakabadilika kuwa hasi.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges motorists and pedestrians in Narok County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Narok kuzingatia mipaka ya mwendo kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa baabuurta iyo dadka lugta ku mara gobolka Narok inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha lugta lagu maro si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Forest Service jiwo joidh mtokni kod joma wuotho e ndara e gweng' mar Narok mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe mondo gikwed hinyruok mag ndara.

English: Kenya Medical Association calls on parents in Laikipia County to have children under five screened for tuberculosis during the August outreach.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuwapima watoto chini ya miaka mitano kifua kikuu wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Agosti.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqay waalidiinta degmada Laikipia inay carruurta ka yar shan sano u sameeyaan baaritaanka cudurka 'tuberculosis' inta lagu gudajiro bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association okwayo jonyuol e County mar Laikipia mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Agost.

English: DCI reminds mobile money users in Homa Bay County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Wilaya ya Homa Bay kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee gobolka Homa Bay inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado khiyaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: DCI paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e Homa Bay County ni mondo ginyis jomisonari maggi weche maok adier mondo kik gitim mibadhi mar SIM-swap.

English: The Tea Bill has been passed by the Senate reintroducing the Tea Board Stakeholders are advised to prepare for future consultations regarding the Bill s implementation
Kiswahili: Mswada wa Chai umepitishwa na Seneti ikileta tena Washikadau wa Bodi ya Chai wanashauriwa kujiandaa kwa mashauriano yajayo kuhusu utekelezaji wa Mswada huo.
Somali: Sharciga shaaha ayaa la ansixiyay Senate-ka oo dib u soo bandhigaya Guddiga shaaha Dhinacyada daneeyayaasha waxaa lagula talinayaa inay u diyaariyaan la-tashiga mustaqbalka ee ku saabsan hirgelinta Sharciga
Dholuo: Senate oseyie gi Bill mar Chai ma miyo Komiti mar Chai ochako tiyo kendo.

English: Notice: COMESA will open a horticultural produce collection centre in Wajir County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Wajir Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay bilaabi doontaa xarun ururinta alaabada beeraha ee Gobolka Wajir bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: COMESA biro yawo ot mar choko puothe mag puothe e gweng' mar Wajir e dwe mar Novemba.

English: The National Cereals and Produce Board is offering Ksh 3000 per 90kg bag of maize Farmers are encouraged to deliver their maize to NCPB depots payment is processed within 24 hours
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Kitaifa ya Nafaka na Mazao yatoa Ksh 3000 kwa kila gunia la kilo 90 la mahindi Wakulima wanahimizwa kupeleka mahindi yao kwenye bohari za NCPB malipo huchakatwa ndani ya saa 24.
Somali: Guddiga Qaranka ee Cereals and Produce Board wuxuu bixiyaa Ksh 3000 halkii 90 kg oo bacaha hadhuudhka ah Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay hadhuudhkooda gaarsiiyaan bakhaarada NCPB lacag bixinta ayaa lagu farsameeyay 24 saac gudahood
Dholuo: National Cereals and Produce Board chiwo Ksh 3000 kuom bag moro mar kodhi ma romo kilo 90 Jogi jiwo jopur mondo ochiw kodhigi e NCPB depo ka otiyo gi pesa e seche 24

English: FAO urges pigs farmers in Garissa County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported rabies cases.
Kiswahili: FAO inawahimiza wafugaji wa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya kichaa cha mbwa vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda doofaarka ee degmada Garissa inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib markii ay soo muuqdeen kiisaska rabshadaha.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma pidho anguro e gweng' mar Garissa mondo onyis le matuwo e ofis mar thieth ma machiegni gi kanyo bang' yudo weche mag rabies.

English: From Refugees to Citizens? Rethinking Refugee Education Dilemmas
Kiswahili: Kutoka kwa Wakimbizi hadi Wananchi? Kutafakari upya Matatizo ya Elimu ya Wakimbizi
Somali: Qaxootiga ilaa Muwaadiniinta? Dib-u-fikirka Dhibaatooyinka Waxbarashada Qaxootiga
Dholuo: Be Kowuok kuom Jolweny nyaka Jodak? Paro kendo kuom pek mag somo mar jolweny

English: Kajiado County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kajiado: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Septemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Kajiado: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kajiado: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar Septemba 2022

English: These shocks escalated the cost of essential household commodities including fuel prices, and led to a rapid depreciation of the Kenya Shilling exchange rate, pilling pressure on public debt.
Kiswahili: Mishtuko hii iliongeza gharama ya bidhaa muhimu za nyumbani ikiwa ni pamoja na bei ya mafuta, na kusababisha kushuka kwa kasi kwa kiwango cha ubadilishaji wa Shilingi ya Kenya, na hivyo kuongeza shinikizo kwenye deni la umma.
Somali: Shilalkan ayaa kor u qaaday qiimaha badeecadaha muhiimka ah ee guryaha oo ay ku jiraan qiimaha shidaalka, waxayna horseedeen hoos u dhac degdeg ah oo ku yimid qiimaha sarrifka Shilinka Kenya, taasoo hoos u dhigtay cadaadiska deynta dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Gik ma ne otimorego ne omiyo nengo mar gik ma dwarore ahinya e ot omedore moriwo nyaka nengo mar mafuta, kendo ne omiyo nengo mar pesa ma ne itiyogo e piny Kenya odok piny mapiyo, ma ne omiyo nengo mar gowi mag piny odok piny.

English: KICD reminds youth in Narok County that HELB funding is available for electrical installation training.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Narok kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Narok in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne rowere man Narok County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar loso sitima.

English: KNEC reminds needy students in Nyeri County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba vitabu vya kiada na matumizi ya vifaa vya kujifunzia vitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KNEC waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Nyeri in buugaagta waxbarasho iyo codsiyada qalabka waxbarasho ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: KNEC oparo ne jopuonjre man Nyeri County ni buk mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok biro rumo machiegni.

English: Council of Governors urges residents of Taita-Taveta County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta watumie portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku boorinayaan dadka deggan degmada Taita-Taveta inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Council of Governors jiwo jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo kwayo mar kedo gi mibadhi mar chulo pesa.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Vihiga County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay yareeyaan qaadashada cusbada iyo sonkorta si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Vihiga mondo omed chamo chumbi kod sukari mondo kik tuwono landre.

English: Taita Taveta County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Taita Taveta: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Juni 2024
Somali: Degmada Taita Taveta: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Taita Taveta: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar auchiel 2024

English: Embu (Mbeere) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for January 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Embu (Mbeere): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Januari 2024
Somali: Degmada Embu (Mbeere): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Janaayo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Embu (Mbeere): Oboke machon mar goyo oro mar dwe mar achiel higa mar 2024

English: Kenya: Desalinating salty water for Samburu communities
Kiswahili: Kenya: Kusafisha maji ya chumvi kwa jamii za Samburu

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges residents of Makueni County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kuwasilisha maandishi ya maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay si loo qaabeeyo goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General jiwo jogweng' Makueni County mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso chenro mag dongruok.

English: DCI alerts residents of Nyeri County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: DCI waxay uga digtay dadka deggan degmada Nyeri in ay kordheen kiisaska xoolaha lagu xado waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nyeri County kuom wach medruok mar weche mag kwalo jamni kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne polis man machiegni.

English: Judiciary of Kenya advises residents of Kirinyaga County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya nyiso jogweng' Kirinyaga County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport.

English: Students engage civic mentors
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wanashirikiana na washauri wa kiraia

English: KEPHIS announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for sheep in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this December.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Desemba hii.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan qabyaalada idaha ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: KEPHIS olando chenro mar thiedho rombe maonge chudo mar rabies e Elgeyo-Marakwet County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Tana River County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tana River: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Juni 2023

Dholuo: Kaunti mar Aora Tana: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2023

English: Kenya Dairy Board warns beans farmers in Turkana County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Turkana juu ya mlipuko wa wadudu na kupendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda ku nool degmada Turkana cudurrada cayayaanka waxaana uu ku talinayaa in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board chiwo siem ne jopur mag nyinyo e County mar Turkana kuom masiche ma nyalo kelo tuoche kendo ojiwo ni otim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: KICD publishes new digital teaching aids specifically designed for Early Childhood Development Education.
Kiswahili: KICD huchapisha misaada mpya ya kufundisha digital iliyoundwa hasa kwa ajili ya Elimu ya Maendeleo ya Utoto wa Mapema.
Somali: KICD waxay daabacdaa caawimaad waxbarasho oo cusub oo dhijitaal ah oo si gaar ah loogu talagalay Waxbarashada Horumarinta Carruurta Hore.
Dholuo: KICD goyo buge manyien mag puonjo mag digital molos mondo okony e tiego nyithindo e kinde ma tindo chako dongo.

English: Notice: OGP opens a new service point for national ID applications in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay ka fureysaa barta adeegga cusub ee codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: OGP oseyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag kwayo nying' mar ng'ato e gweng' mar Kakamega.

English: Import of maize mixed with soya beans has been annoubnced to primary schools as a measure to increase body immunity
Kiswahili: Uagizaji wa mahindi yaliyochanganywa na maharagwe ya soya umetangazwa kwa shule za msingi kama hatua ya kuongeza kinga ya mwili
Somali: Soo dejinta galleyda lagu daray digirta soya ayaa loo oggolaaday dugsiyada hoose si loo kordhiyo difaaca jirka
Dholuo: Oganda mar oganda Jehova e piny mangima osemiyo kwan mar joma ne dhi bedo e pinyno obedo mayot.

English: NPS urges the community in Kericho County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb burglary.
Kiswahili: NPS inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka kwa kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Kericho inay ka warbixiyaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo shaki leh xarunta booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo ji duto manie County mar Kericho mondo onyis polis ma ni machiegni gi kanyo ni gitimo gik ma chando ji.

English: Kenya: El Nino Floods 2023 - Emergency Appeal (MDRKE058)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Mafuriko ya El Nino 2023 - Rufaa ya Dharura (MDRKE058)

Dholuo: Kenya: Pi mang'eny mar el nino 2023 - Kwayo mapiyo (MDRKE058)

English: TVET reminds schools in Kirinyaga County to strengthen child protection in schools this June.
Kiswahili: TVET inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuimarisha ulinzi wa watoto shuleni Juni hii.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada Gobolka Kirinyaga inay xoojiyaan ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada bisha Juun.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa skunde mag County mar Kirinyaga mondo omed jiwo rit mar nyithindo e skunde e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health: nutrition supplementation for infants clinics will run every April at designated health centres in Narok County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya: nyongeza ya lishe kwa kliniki za watoto wachanga itaendeshwa kila Aprili katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka: Kordhinta nafaqada ee dhallaanka ee xarumaha caafimaad ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Narok ayaa la qaban doonaa bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth: thieth mar chiemo ne nyithindo matindo ibiro tim dwe mar ang'wen higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e kaunti mar Narok.

English: KMTC urges residents of Kisumu County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: KMTC jiwo jogweng' mar Kisumu County mondo okonygi yudo konyno kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud konyruok kuom chenro mar chiemo e skul.

English: KRA reminds the public in Murang'a County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this December.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba maoni juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma yanakaribishwa Desemba hii.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Murang'a in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: KRA oparo ne ji duto e County mar Murang'a ni gibiro yie gi chiwo mag paro e wi chenro mag sirkal e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: IEBC announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ee dugsiyada degmada Murang'a.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IEBC ogolo chenro mar dhi e skunde mag Murang'a County e tiego jopuonjre madongo.

English: Notice: AFA will distribute certified maize seed to farmers in Machakos County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itasambaza mbegu za mahindi zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay abuurka hadhuudhka ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Machakos bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: AFA biro pogo kodhi mag kodhi mar kodhi ne jopur e kaunti mar Machakos e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: IPOA conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Taita-Taveta County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: IPOA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ku saabsan ka hortagga argagixisada Degmada Taita-Taveta bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA dhi timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu e Taita-Taveta County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Office of the Auditor-General invites residents of Vihiga County to attend the public participation forum regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inakaribisha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Vihiga kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya wilaya.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay ka qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan habka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General ogwelo jogweng' County mar Vihiga mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenro mar bajet mar county.

English: HELB conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Kitui County this December.
Kiswahili: HELB inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kitui Desemba hii.
Somali: HELB waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda gobolka ee degmada Kitui bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: HELB dhi nyime gi chenro mar tiego ji mondo gibed gi thuolo mar konyo ji e weche mag bungu e dwe mar Desemba e kaunti mar Kitui.

English: KEMSA appeals to caregivers in Kitui County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the July maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kitui kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Julai.
Somali: KEMSA waxay u baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Kitui inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha ee qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka bisha July.
Dholuo: KEMSA okwayo jorit e County mar Kitui mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi e dwe mar Julai.

English: NPS urges anyone experiencing abuse in Nyeri County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: NPS inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Nyeri piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Nyeri inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: NPS ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e County mar Nyeri mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195 maonge chudo.

English: KEMSA encourages residents of Makueni County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay ugu yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' Makueni County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giluong simo mar thieth mar paro maonge chudo.

English: Notice: NDMA conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Kilifi County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada oo ku saabsan dhismaha nabadda qaranka ee Gobolka Kilifi bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA timo romo mar oganda e wi loso kuwe e gweng' mar Kilifi e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: PSA encouraging use of organic fertilizers to improve soil health.
Kiswahili: PSA hutia moyo matumizi ya mbolea za kikaboni ili kuboresha afya ya udongo.
Somali: PSA oo dhiirrigelinaysa isticmaalka bacriminta organic si loo hagaajiyo caafimaadka ciidda.
Dholuo: PSA jiwo tiyo gi yiende mag yiende mag lowo mondo omi lowo obed gi ngima maber.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Narok County about the importance of safe water storage for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Narok juu ya umuhimu wa uhifadhi wa maji salama kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Shirkadda SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay dadka degmada Narok ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji e Narok County kuom ber mar kano pi maler e ngima joot.

English: NCPB urges rice growers in Nyeri County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawataka wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda bariiska ee degmada Nyeri inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur loso loso loso kodhi e County mar Nyeri mondo oti gi nengo ma gichiwo mar mogo kapok koth ochue mondo okony e medo nyak mar yien e higani.

English: Rain and loss: Kenya grapples with severe floods, displacing thousands
Kiswahili: Mvua na hasara: Kenya inakabiliana na mafuriko makubwa, na kusababisha maelfu ya watu kuyahama makazi yao
Somali: Roobab iyo khasaaro: Kenya oo la daalaa dhacaysa daadad xooggan, kumanaan qofna barakicisay
Dholuo: Koth kod lalruok: Kenya temo matek gi pi mang’eny, ma miyo ji gana gi gana owuok e udigi

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Uasin Gishu County to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night following a rise in reported malaria cases.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na dawa za wadudu kila usiku kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya malaria vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Uasin Gishu inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska fayraska ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ojiwo jogweng' Uasin Gishu County mondo oti gi otamba molos gi yedhe makelo tuoche mag kute otieno ka otieno nikech kwan mar joma nigi malaria osemedore.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ee dugsiyada Gobolka Kwale.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar State for TVET olando tarik mag somo e skunde mag Kwale County.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free stress management support is available through county health facilities in Samburu County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa kudhibiti mafadhaiko unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero lacag la'aan ah ee maaraynta stress-ka laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Samburu.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar stress yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Samburu.

English: Kenya: Government Operation Against Pastoralist Militias in North Rift Region, 31 March 2023
Kiswahili: Kenya: Operesheni ya Serikali Dhidi ya Wanamgambo wa Wafugaji katika Mkoa wa Kaskazini mwa Ufa, 31 Machi 2023
Somali: Kenya: Hawlgalka Dowladda ee Ka Dhanka ah Maleeshiyada Xoolo-dhaqatada ee Gobolka Waqooyiga Rift, 31 Maarso 2023
Dholuo: Kenya: Tich mar Sirkal Kedo Jolweny Jokwath e Chund Rift ma Nyanduat, tarik 31 dwe mar Adek higa mar 2023

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds residents of Baringo County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba upatikanaji wa usajili wa e-Citizen sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo in helitaanka diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General parone jogweng' Baringo County ni koro yot yudo e-Citizen registration kokalo kuom chenro mag sirkal.

English: Wajir County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for December 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Wajir: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Desemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Wajeer: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Diseembar 2022
Dholuo: Kaun mar Wajir: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2022

English: DPP urges motorists and pedestrians in Mombasa County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DPP anawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Mombasa inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka abaarta la xiriira.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo derebe kod joma wuotho e ndara e county mar Mombasa mondo oluw chike mag golo ji ma sirkal ogolo mondo gikwed masiche mag oro.

English: Kenya: Flow Monitoring Dashboard (Aug-Sept 24)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Dashibodi ya Ufuatiliaji Mtiririko (Ago-Sep 24)
Somali: Kenya: Dashboard-ka La Socodka Socodka (Agoosto-Sebteembar 24)
Dholuo: Kenya: Dasbod mar Rang'o Pimo (Agost nyaka Septemba 24)

English: Kenya Forest Service urges residents of Kilifi County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta deegaanka iyada oo la adeegsanayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo jogweng' Kilifi County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano nikech ji medo keto pachgi kuom chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: Tomato prices in Kisumu have nearly doubled due to heavy rains disrupting supply chains Expect prices at Kibuye Market to range between Sh15 and Sh30 per piece
Kiswahili: Bei ya nyanya mjini Kisumu imekaribia kupanda maradufu kutokana na mvua kubwa inayonyesha na kutatiza ugavi. Tarajia bei katika Soko la Kibuye kuwa kati ya Sh15 na Sh30 kwa kipande
Somali: Qiimaha yaanyada ee Kisumu ayaa ku dhowaad labanlaabmay roobab culus oo burburiyay silsiladaha sahayda Suuqa Kibuye ayaa lagu wadaa in ay u dhaxeyso Sh15 ilaa Sh30 halkii qaybood
Dholuo: nengo mag pomade e Kisumu osedok nyadiriyo nikech koth maduong' ma okelo ywaruok e weche mag chiwo.

English: Climate smart agriculture is a system of placing best practices in farming to enhance food security and triggger development..
Kiswahili: Kilimo mahiri cha hali ya hewa ni mfumo wa kuweka mbinu bora katika kilimo ili kuimarisha usalama wa chakula na maendeleo ya triggger..
Somali: Beeraleyda caqliga leh ee cimilada waa nidaam lagu meeleeyo hababka ugu wanaagsan ee beeraleyda si loo xoojiyo amniga cuntada iyo horumarinta trigggers..

English: State Department for TVET announces distribution of textbooks and learning materials to schools in Tharaka-Nithi County this June.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inatangaza usambazaji wa vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Juni hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhawaaqday in buugaag iyo qalab waxbarasho loo qaybiyo dugsiyada degmada Tharaka-Nithi bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok e skunde mag Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar auchiel.

English: Kenya: Anticipated impact of drought conditions in Mandera, Tana River, Turkana, and Wajir counties (Anticipatory Note 27 November 2025)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Athari zinazotarajiwa za hali ya ukame katika kaunti za Mandera, Tana River, Turkana na Wajir (Maelezo ya Kutarajia 27 Novemba 2025)
Somali: Kenya: Saamaynta la filayo ee xaaladaha abaarta ee degmooyinka Mandheera, Tana River, Turkana, iyo Wajeer (Qoraal la filayo 27 Nofembar 2025)
Dholuo: Kenya: Gigeno ber mar chal mar oro e kaunti mag Mandera, aora Tana, Turkana, kod Wajir (Oboke ma igeno tarik 27 dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2025)

Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika wilaya ya Garissa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay bilawday qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Garissa.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: ODPP chako chenro mar dongruok mar county integrated development e county mar Garissa.

English: Youth Agenda trains youth leaders on governance principles.
Kiswahili: Agenda ya Vijana inawazoeza viongozi wa vijana juu ya kanuni za utawala.
Somali: Barnaamijka dhalinyarada wuxuu horumariyaa hoggaamiyeyaasha dhalinyaradu mabaadi'da maamulka.
Dholuo: Chenro mar Rowere tiego jotelo mag rowere e wi puonj mag locho.

English: CAS, Dr. Rashid: Trained mental health personnel, including nurses & doctors have been identified & will be on call, work in shifts at the tele counselling & telepsychiatry Centre. #WorldSuicidePreventionDay
Kiswahili: CAS, Dk. Rashid: Wafanyakazi wa afya ya akili waliofunzwa, wakiwemo wauguzi na madaktari wametambuliwa na watakuwa kwenye simu, watafanya kazi kwa zamu katika kituo cha ushauri nasaha na telepsychiatry. #Siku ya Kuzuia Kujiua Duniani

English: KEMSA launches a June awareness campaign on proper sanitation across Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Juni juu ya usafi wa mazingira katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: KEMSA waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Juun oo ku saabsan nadaafadda saxda ah ee degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: KEMSA chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Jun e wi thieth mowinjore e gweng' mar Kisumu.

English: Notice: EACC launches the county integrated development plan in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika wilaya ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay bilaabaysaa qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Vihiga.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: EACC chako chenro mar dongruok mar county e county mar Vihiga.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit appeals to caregivers in Taita-Taveta County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the August maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Agosti.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa ugu baaqay daryeelayaasha gobolka Taita-Taveta inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka iyada oo qayb ka ah ololaha caafimaadka hooyada ee Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit okwayo jorit e Taita-Taveta County mondo okel nyithindgi e timo nonro mar dongo kaka achiel kuom chenro mar August Maternal Health Campaign.

English: KICD advises students in Turkana County to register early to secure allocation to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: KICD inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata maudhui ya ujifunzaji wa kidijitali bila malipo.
Somali: KICD waxay kula talineysaa ardayda degmada Turkana inay isdiiwaangaliyaan si ay u helaan lacag la'aan ah oo barashada digital ah.
Dholuo: KICD nyiso jopuonjre e county mar Turkana ni gidonj e skundno chon mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo somo maonge chudo.

English: Kenya confirms two new Mpox cases in Kericho and Taita Taveta counties, raising total to 33; Health Ministry urges schools to enhance safety measures to curb spread.
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha visa viwili vipya vya Mpox katika kaunti za Kericho na Taita Taveta, na kuongeza jumla ya visa hivyo kufikia 33; Wizara ya Afya yahimiza shule kuimarisha hatua za usalama ili kupunguza kuenea kwa virusi hivyo.
Somali: Kenya ayaa xaqiijisay laba kiis oo cusub oo Mpox ah oo ka dhacay degmooyinka Kericho iyo Taita Taveta, taasoo wadarta guud u kordhisay 33; Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku boorineysaa dugsiyada inay xoojiyaan tallaabooyinka amniga si loo xakameeyo faafitaanka.
Dholuo: Kenya osenyiso ni nitie ji ariyo manyien ma nigi tuwo mar Mpox e counties mag Kericho kod Taita Taveta, kendo mano osemiyo kwan mar ji duto okalo 33; Ministry of Health jiwo skunde mondo omed timo dongruok e ritruok mar thieth.

English: Kenya, Cash-Based Transfers on Food Security and Gender Equality: Impact Evaluation | World Food Programme
Kiswahili: Kenya, Uhamisho wa Pesa Juu ya Usalama wa Chakula na Usawa wa Jinsia: Tathmini ya Athari | Mpango wa Chakula Duniani

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will train farmers in Lamu County on soil conservation this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu juu ya uhifadhi wa udongo Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa tababar siin doonta beeraleyda degmada Lamu ee ku saabsan ilaalinta ciidda bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Rapar: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro tiego jopur e County mar Lamu kuom rito lowo e dwe mar Julai.

English: KRA reminds residents of Nakuru County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba upatikanaji wa utunzaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda ka sahlan tahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: KRA oparo ne jogweng' Nakuru County ni yudo weche mag nyasi mar nyuol koro yot moloyo kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development urges residents of Bomet County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na mgao wa bursary.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay iska diiwaangeliyaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan deeqda deeq waxbarasho.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Bomet mondo odonj e program mar puonjo jomadongo somo kendo somo.

English: Public notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will host a free tobacco control outreach in Trans Nzoia County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa kudhibiti tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay marti gelineysaa dadaal lacag la'aan ah oo ka dhan ah ka hortagga sigaarka ee Gobolka Trans Nzoia bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Rango Kendo Luwo Tuwo biro timo kampen mar golo ndawa maonge chudo e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will be held in Migori County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Migori Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo bilaash ah oo ay qabanqaabisay qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Degmada Migori bisha July.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth maonge chudo mitimo gi Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche ibiro tim e County mar Migori e dwe mar Julai.

English: IPOA alerts residents of Nyandarua County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua.
Somali: IPOA waxay dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua uga digtay kororka kiisaska jabsashada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan wadaagista faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: IPOA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nyandarua County ni kwan mag joma odonjo e ot biro medore kendo ojiwo oganda mondo kik gipog weche mag ritruok gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Lamu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Lamu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Juni 2024
Somali: Degmada Lamu: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Lamu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2024

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Medical Association will be held in Makueni County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu bila malipo iliyoandaliwa na Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Makueni Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Degmada Makueni bisha April.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma Kenya Medical Association ochano ibiro tim e kaunti mar Makueni e dwe mar April.

English: Ministry of Education advises applicants in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay booqdaan xarunta ugu dhow ee tababarka xirfadeed ee loogu talagalay gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: KUCCPS urges youth in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada rayidka ah ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada rayidnimada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo rowere e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok ochopo tije mag oganda.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages residents of Kirinyaga County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kirinyaga inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay u yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo jogweng' Kirinyaga County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giluong kony mar thieth mar chuny maonge chudo.

English: Ministry of Education announces distribution of school laptops under the digital literacy programme to schools in Bungoma County this July.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu yatangaza usambazaji wa kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa shule za Kaunti ya Bungoma Julai hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa ku dhawaaqday qaybinta kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Bungoma bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok olando ni gibiro pogo kompyuta mag skul e bwo chenro mar somo gi somo e yore mag digital e skunde mag Bungoma County e dwe mar Julai.

English: HELB reminds schools in West Pokot County to strengthen anti-bullying measures this November.
Kiswahili: HELB inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuimarisha hatua za kupambana na uonevu Novemba hii.
Somali: HELB waxay xusuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada West Pokot inay xoojiyaan tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibaatada bisha November.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa skunde man West Pokot County mondo omed jiwo yore mag geng'o nindruok e dwe mar Novemba.

English: OGP reminds residents of Kitui County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: OGP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kitui kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya wilaya inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: OGP parone jogweng' Kitui County ni luwo dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: KEPHIS warns beans farmers in Uasin Gishu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawaonya wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuhusu maambukizi ya wadudu na kupendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay uga digtay beeraleyda Uasin Gishu County cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: KEPHIS chiwo siem ne jopur mag nyinyo e gweng ' mar Uasin Gishu kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni otim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Animal vaccination has commenced in dry regions.
Kiswahili: Chanjo ya wanyama imeanza katika maeneo kavu.
Somali: Tallaalka xayawaanka ayaa laga bilaabay gobollada qalalan.
Dholuo: Oseng'ad thieth ne le e gwenge motwo.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will train farmers in Uasin Gishu County on water harvesting this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu juu ya uvunaji wa maji Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa tababar siin doonta beeraleyda degmada Uasin Gishu ee ku saabsan goosashada biyaha bisha Ogosto.
Dholuo: Rapar: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro tiego jopur e County mar Uasin Gishu e wi ywayo pi e dwe mar Agost.

English: IEBC announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Murang'a County this October.
Kiswahili: IEBC inatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Oktoba hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta waxyaabaha barashada digitalka ah ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Murang'a bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: IEBC olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag digital maonge chudo e skunde man Murang'a County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: ODPP urges residents of Vihiga County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia simu ya EACC ya bure ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee EACC si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogweng' County mar Vihiga mondo ochiw ripode mag mibadhi kokalo kuom hotline mar EACC maonge chudo mondo giked gi mibadho e migepe mag sirkal.

English: Climate smart agriculture (CSA) is a means of dictating changes in food markets into profitability levels, governance and sustainability .
Kiswahili: Kilimo mahiri cha hali ya hewa (CSA) ni njia ya kuamuru mabadiliko katika masoko ya chakula katika viwango vya faida, utawala na uendelevu.
Somali: Beeraha caqli-galka cimilada (CSA) waa hab lagu qeexo isbeddelada suuqyada cuntada heerarka faa'iidada, maamulka iyo waara.
Dholuo: Tij pur mariek e bwo chal mar kor lwasi (Climate Smart Agriculture - CSA) en yo mar chiko lokruok e ohala mag chiemo e yore mag yudo pesa, locho e yo maber, kod bedo gi ngima maber.

English: The Salvation Army responds to major drought in Kenya
Kiswahili: Jeshi la Wokovu lakabiliana na ukame mkubwa nchini Kenya
Somali: Ciidanka Badbaadada oo ka jawaabay abaarta ba'an ee ka jirta Kenya
Dholuo: Jolweny mag Warruok dwoko wach kuom oro maduong’ ma ne otimore e piny Kenya

English: Launch of smartphone app to track daily steps, hydration, dietary intake, and stress levels with community leaderboards.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa programu ya simu mahiri ili kufuatilia hatua za kila siku, unyevu, ulaji wa chakula, na viwango vya msongo wa mawazo kwa kutumia ubao wa viongozi wa jamii.
Somali: Bilaabidda abka taleefannada casriga ah si loola socdo tallaabooyinka maalinlaha ah, fuuq-baxa, qaadashada cuntada, iyo heerarka walbahaarka iyadoo la adeegsanayo guddiyada bulshada.
Dholuo: Chako program mar simu mar ng'ato mar luwo okang' ma pile ka pile, bedo gi pi e del, chiemo ma ichamo, kod rang'iny mar parruok ka itiyo gi bod mag jotelo mag oganda.

English: IEBC designs interactive games to teach electoral processes.
Kiswahili: IEBC huunda michezo shirikishi ili kufundisha michakato ya uchaguzi.
Somali: IEBC waxay naqshadeysaa ciyaaro isdhexgal ah si ay u bartaan nidaamyada doorashada.
Dholuo: IEBC loso tuke ma konyo ji ng'eyo weche mag yiero.

English: KICD invites youth in Mombasa County to enroll for tailoring and design training this August.
Kiswahili: KICD inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni Agosti hii.
Somali: KICD waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Mombasa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka tailoring iyo naqshadeynta bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: KICD gwelo rowere e County mar Mombasa mondo odonj e tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko e dwe mar Agost.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges the public in Kiambu County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: Kenya Red Cross inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadweynaha degmada Kiambu inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ji duto e County mar Kiambu mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo ripode mag wuond gi SIM-swap.

English: Teachers Service Commission conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Vihiga County this April.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Aprili hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa bishii Abriil ku qabanaya madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan wareejinta Degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi tiego nyithindo e gweng' mar Vihiga e dwe mar April.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges youth in Tana River County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Elimu ya Msingi ya Jimbo inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka Tana River waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Tana River inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda ka hor inta aysan qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo rowere man Tana River County mondo onon weche ma giduto gikwongo ndiko kapok gitimo tije mag oganda.

English: Notice: NDMA issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa utambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ogaysiis: NDMA waxay soo saartaa digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan dhacda aqoonsiga oo saameyn ku leh dadka deggan degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NDMA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag sirkal kuom wach kuo mar ng'ato makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e county mar Siaya.

English: Notice: IPOA launches a theft prevention campaign in Nyandarua County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Julai hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: IPOA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada gobolka Nyandarua bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Rapar: IPOA chako kampen mar geng'o kuo e County mar Nyandarua e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: NTSA launches a fraud prevention campaign in Kericho County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NTSA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Kericho Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga khiyaamooyinka degmada Kericho bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NTSA chako kampen mar geng'o mibadhi e County mar Kericho e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: NCPB will conduct a greenhouse farming workshop for farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itafanya warsha ya kilimo cha chafu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo ee beeraleyda degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NCPB biro timo tiegruok mar pidho jopur e alwora mar Elgeyo-Marakwet e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: CBK reminds Kenyans that legitimate banks do not conduct promotions via Facebook inboxes. Ignore messages asking for account details to 'activate rewards'.
Kiswahili: CBK inawakumbusha Wakenya kwamba benki halali hazifanyi matangazo kupitia visanduku vya barua pepe vya Facebook. Puuza jumbe zinazouliza maelezo ya akaunti ili 'kuamsha zawadi'.
Somali: CBK waxay xasuusinaysaa dadka reer Kenya in bangiyada sharciga ah aysan ku sameynin xayaysiisyo sanduuqyada Facebook. Iska dhaaf fariimaha weydiisanaya faahfaahinta akoonka si loo 'hawlgeliyo abaalmarinnada'.
Dholuo: CBK paro ne jo Kenya ni bengi ma nigi ratiro ok tim lendo kokalo kuom boksi mag Facebook. Weri gi ote ma kwayo weche mag akaunt mondo 'itim mich'.

English: Notice: NPS activates an emergency response plan for drought in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NPS inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ukame katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo abaaraha ka dhan ah degmada Laikipia.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NPS tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne oro e County mar Laikipia.

English: Makueni County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Makueni: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Makueni: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Makueni: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Septemba 2022

English: Council of Governors urges eligible citizens in Trans Nzoia County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza raia wenye haki katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku boorinayaan muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo raia mar Trans Nzoia County mondo oriwre gi jogo madwaro donjo e riwruok mar oganda Jehova.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages mothers in Kericho County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kericho kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa hooyooyinka degmada Kericho inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo mine manie Kericho County mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: High job opportunities and therefore good revenue. Improve market access and improve products value. Even if it's true..
Kiswahili: fursa za kazi kubwa na kwa hiyo mapato mazuri. kuboresha upatikanaji wa soko na kuboresha thamani ya bidhaa. Hata kama ni kweli ..
Somali: Fursadaha shaqooyinka sare iyo dakhliga wanaagsan, hagaajinta helitaanka suuqa iyo hagaajidda qiimaha alaabada. xitaa haddii ay run tahay..
Dholuo: Bedo gi thuolo mag yudo tich kendo yudo pesa mang'eny, medo bedo gi thuolo mar yudo ohala, kendo medo kelo nengo mar ohala kata obedo ni mano en adier.

English: Notice: KEMRI will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Kisii County this September. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI itafanya kongamano la kurejesha matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Kisii Septemba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay qabaneysaa madasha dib u soo kabashada isticmaalka maandooriyaha ee degmada Kisii bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMRI biro timo chokruok mar chango joma tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero e taon mar Kisii e dwe mar Septemba.

English: A good sweet potatoes variety planted in Nakuru Kenya are eaten across East Africa. Maize has maintained as a core crop over time. However, it has been hit with diseases since then. This has brought about harvest losses and a threat to food security in Kenya. For this reason, from 2008, kenyan government decided to remove dependency on maize by adopting potatoes.
Kiswahili: Aina nzuri ya viazi vilivyopandwa huko Nakuru Kenya hutolewa kote Afrika Mashariki. Mahindi imeendelea kama mazao ya msingi kwa muda. Hata hivyo, imekuwa ikiathiriwa na magonjwa tangu wakati huo. Hii imesababisha hasara ya mavuno na tishio kwa usalama wa chakula nchini Kenya. Kwa sababu hii, kutoka 2008, serikali ya Kenya iliamua kuondoa utegemezi wa mahindi kwa kupitisha viazi.
Somali: Nooc wanaagsan oo baradho macaan ah oo laga beero Nakuru Kenya ayaa laga cunaa guud ahaan Bariga Afrika. Galleydu waxay sii haysatay dalagga aasaasiga ah muddo dheer. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, tan iyo markaas waxaa ku dhacay cudurro. Tani waxay keentay khasaaraha goosashada iyo khatar ku ah amniga cuntada ee Kenya. Sababtaas awgeed, laga bilaabo 2008, dowladda Kenya waxay go'aansatay inay ka saarto ku tiirsanaanta galleyda iyada oo la qaadanayo baradho.
Dholuo: Olembe mabeyo mag mbese ma imuoyo e piny Kenya e piny Afrika ma Ugwe. Kodhi osebedo ka bedo kodhi maduong' ahinya. Kata kamano, chakre kindeno, osebedo ka yudo tuoche. Mano osekelo tho mar keyo kod pek e weche mag chiemo e piny Kenya. Mano e momiyo, chakre higa mar 2008, sirkal mar Kenya nong'ado mar golo kodhi ma nigi kodhi kuom kawo mbese.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Kwale County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi diiwaangelinta beeraleyda loogu talagalay beeralayda Gobolka Kwale bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Rapar: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro timo rapar mar jopur e dwe mar Oktoba e kaunti mar Kwale.

English: Neighbors can come together and assist people suffering from mental health including those engaged in drugs and substance abuse in various ways
Kiswahili: Majirani wanaweza kukusanyika na kuwasaidia watu wenye matatizo ya akili, kutia ndani wale wanaotumia dawa za kulevya na dawa za kulewesha kwa njia mbalimbali
Somali: Dadka deriska ah waxay isu imaan karaan si ay u caawiyaan dadka qaba cudurka dhimirka oo ay ku jiraan kuwa ku hawlan daroogada iyo isticmaalka maandooriyaha siyaabo kala duwan
Dholuo: Joma odak machiegni nyalo chokore mondo gikony joma nigi tuoche mag obwongo moriwo nyaka joma tiyo gi yedhe mamero kod yedhe ma mero ji e yore mopogore opogore

English: KALRO urges cattle farmers in Taita-Taveta County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa Newcastle vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha gobolka iyagoo aan haysan rukhsad ka dib kiisaska cudurka Newcastle ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur mag jamni e County Taita-Taveta mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni ka giwuok e county maok giyudo rusa bang' yudo kit tuoche mag Newcastle.

English: DCI urges the community in Tharaka-Nithi County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: DCI inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ka warbixiyaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo shaki leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow si looga hortago xannibaadda lo'da.
Dholuo: DCI ojiwo ji duto manie Tharaka-Nithi County mondo onyis polis ma machiegni gi kanyo ni gitimo gik ma chando dhok.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Nakuru County this May. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Mei hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada ee degmada Nakuru bisha May. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Medical Association biro timo romo mar paro ne rowere e taon mar Nakuru e dwe mar Mei.

English: Public statement endorsing millet, sorghum and legumes for sustainability and dietary resilience.
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya umma inayounga mkono mtama, mtama na kunde kwa ajili ya uendelevu na ustahimilivu wa lishe.
Somali: Bayaan dadweyne oo taageeraya millet, sorghum iyo digirta si loo taageero waarta iyo adkeysiga cunto.
Dholuo: Weche ma ji wacho e wi chiem, sorghum kod mag magie mondo omi chiemo obed motegno kendo obed motegno.

English: Humanitarian Action for Children 2023 - Kenya
Kiswahili: Hatua za Kibinadamu kwa Watoto 2023 - Kenya
Somali: Waxqabadka Bani'aadamnimada ee Carruurta 2023 - Kenya
Dholuo: Tich mar konyo nyithindo higa mar 2023 - Kenya

English: OGP urges residents of Kisii County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight abuse of office.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia laini ya bure ya EACC ili kupambana na matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee EACC si looga hortago xadgudubka xilka.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogweng' Kisii County mondo ochiw ripode mag mibadhi kokalo kuom hotline mar EACC maonge chudo mondo giked gi timbe mag tiyo marach gi migepe.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges coffee growers in Nyeri County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
