English: NCPB advises farmers in Kirinyaga County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kirinyaga inay ka soo qayb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qaybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e County mar Kirinyaga mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: NPS urges anyone experiencing abuse in Nyamira County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: NPS inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Nyamira piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Nyamira inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: NPS ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e County mar Nyamira mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195 maonge chudo.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds livestock keepers in Embu County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Embu kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Embu inay ka fogaadaan in xoolaha ay ka gudbaan xadka degmada iyagoo aan haysan rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development parone jopur mag jamni e county mar Embu mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni kuonde mopogore opogore maok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Kajiado County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kajiado County kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo oti gi websaitno mar chiwo ripot mondo okel ng'ur mar kedo gi mibadhi e migepe mag sirkal.

English: Council of Governors reminds residents of Kisii County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii wanaohudhuria mkutano wa umma wa kusanyiko la kaunti kuimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Kisii ee ka qeybgalaya kalfadhiga guud ee shirka degmada ayaa xoojinaya maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch paronwa jogweng' Kisii ma biro e chokruok maduong' mar county assembly mondo omed jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Samburu County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda gobolka Samburu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kalfadhiga tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products jiwo jopur e county mar Samburu mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e tiego jopur mabiro.

English: KRA urges residents of Isiolo County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waendelee kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo inay la xiriiraan maamulaha qaybta maxalliga ah si ay uga warqabaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo jogweng' kaunti mar Isiolo mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jotend buchegi mondo ging'e chenro mar dongruok mar kaunti.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders in Kiambu Machakos Nakuru Nyandarua Nairobi and Mombasa are encouraged to engage in public participation regarding food taxes affecting their operations
Kiswahili: Wakulima na washikadau wa biashara ya kilimo Kiambu Machakos Nakuru Nyandarua Nairobi na Mombasa wamehimizwa kushiriki katika ushiriki wa umma kuhusu ushuru wa chakula unaoathiri shughuli zao.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo shirkadaha ganacsiga beeraha ee Kiambu, Machakos, Nakuru, Nyandarua, Nairobi iyo Mombasa waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay ka qayb qaataan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan canshuuraha cuntada ee saameeya hawlahooda
Dholuo: Jo-pidhni kod jo ohala mag agro e Kiambu Machakos Nakuru Nyandarua Nairobi kod Mombasa ijiwo mondo oriwgi e miyo ji duto thuolo mar yudo osuru mag chiemo makelo hinyruok e tijgi

English: IPOA reminds residents of Samburu County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Samburu in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan dhac ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogweng' mar Samburu County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar donjo e ot konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds expectant mothers in Mombasa County that access to postnatal check-ups is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba upatikanaji wa uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Mombasa in helitaanka baaritaannada dhalmada ka dib ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Mombasa ni dhi e nonro mag nyuol en gima onge chudo e kuonde duto mag oganda.

English: KEMSA appeals to caregivers in Machakos County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the May maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Mei.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Machakos inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta bukaanka ee la qorsheeyay iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee bisha Maajo.
Dholuo: KEMSA okwayo jorit e County ma Machakos mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar thieth ma ne otim e dwe mar Mei.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development encourages farmers in Taita-Taveta County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for milk.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kupata bei bora ya maziwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo caano ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur e Taita-Taveta County mondo oti gi nengo matin mar chak mondo omi chak obed maber.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges tea growers in Baringo County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Baringo kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Waxsoosaarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Baringo inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagyada si loo soo celiyo dhalaalka ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e gweng' mar Baringo mondo otim lokruok e pidho cham mondo piny obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: IEBC conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Siaya County this March.
Kiswahili: IEBC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Siaya Machi hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan wareejinta degmada Siaya bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: IEBC timo chokruok mar tiego ji e wi wach golo pesa e sirkal mar Siaya e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will be held in Nyamira County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu bila malipo iliyoandaliwa na Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo bilaash ah oo ay soo qabanqaabisay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Nyamira bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Rapar: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ochano ibiro tim e County mar Nyamira e dwe mar Jun.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds mobile money users in Samburu County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee Gobolka Samburu inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne jogo matiyo gi pesa mobil e county mar Samburu ni mondo ging'e kwayo margi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo gitang' gi chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Baringo County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuthibitisha kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea kupata huduma ya afya ya ruzuku.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay xaqiijiyaan in xaruntooda la aqoonsaday ka hor inta aysan booqan si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' Baringo County mondo ong'e ni kuondegi mag thieth oseyudo ratiro kapok gibiro mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Kiambu County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun iyo biyo nadiif ah si joogto ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit nyiso jogweng' Kiambu County mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Notice: AFA will open a fish collection centre in Narok County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itafungua kituo cha kukusanya samaki katika Kaunti ya Narok Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay ka furi doontaa xarun ururinta kalluunka ee Gobolka Narok bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: AFA biro chako choko rech e taon mar Narok e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: EACC launches county development projects in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya wilaya katika Wilaya ya Isiolo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay bilawday mashaariic horumarineed oo ka socda degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: EACC chako timo dongruok e alwora mar Isiolo County.

English: The Kenyan government is advocating for a review of the global funding system to better support Africa s agricultural needs Stakeholders are urged to collaborate on this initiative
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya inatetea mapitio ya mfumo wa ufadhili wa kimataifa ili kusaidia vyema mahitaji ya kilimo ya Afrika Wadau wanahimizwa kushirikiana katika mpango huu.
Somali: Dowladda Kenya waxay u ololeyneysaa dib-u-eegis nidaamka maalgelinta caalamiga ah si loo taageero baahiyaha beeraha ee Afrika. Daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay iska kaashadeen hindisahan
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya dwaro ni olos chenro mar chiwo pesa e piny mangima mondo omi Afrika odag maber gi gik mochuno e weche mag pur.

English: Provide shelters! Ensure safe spaces during floods.
Kiswahili: Weka mahali pa kujificha wakati wa mafuriko.
Somali: Goobaha lagu badbaadiyo inta lagu jiro fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: Chiw kuonde dak, kendo ikri ne kuonde ma ji nyalo dakie sama pi opong'o piny.

English: Notice: KEPHIS restricts movement of sheep in Narok County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS inazuia harakati za kondoo katika Kaunti ya Narok kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi wenye uvimbe.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa idaha ee Gobolka Narok sababtuna tahay faafitaanka cudurka maqaarka.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS ogeng'o wuoth mar rombe e gweng' mar Narok nikech tuwono mar pien.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges residents of Tana River County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpakani kwa vyombo vya usalama huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa wa ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya dadka deggan degmada Tana River County inay soo sheegaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaalla aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo onyis sirkande mag sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e alwora mar tong'gi e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya e loso kuwe e piny.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds schools in Turkana County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this September.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Septemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xusuusinaya dugsiyada degmada Turkana inay xoojiyaan adeegyada hagista iyo la-talinta bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne skunde mag Turkana County mondo omed jiwo kendo chiwo kony e dwe mar Septemba.

English: NCPB warns sweet potatoes farmers in Bungoma County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawaonya wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Bungoma juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: NCPB waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda baradho macaan ee degmada Bungoma cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa faragelinta waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: NCPB chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho kit olemo mag sweet potato e County mar Bungoma kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Uasin Gishu County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka waxay dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu kula talineysaa inay biyo cabbiyaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osiemo jogweng' Uasin Gishu County ni mondo gimadh pi modho kapok gitiyo kode mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Notice: IEBC opens the electoral calendar centres in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: IPOA conducts a community briefing on border security in Kakamega County this April.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha ee Gobolka Kakamega bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA dhi timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e taon mar Kakamega e dwe mar April.

English: Kenya Economic Update, Aiming High: Securing Education to Sustain the Recovery (June 2022) Edition No. 25
Kiswahili: Sasisho la Kiuchumi la Kenya, Linalolenga Juu: Kupata Elimu Ili Kudumisha Ufufuaji (Juni 2022) Toleo Na. 25
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta Dhaqaalaha Kenya, Hadafka Sare: Sugidda Waxbarashada si loo Sii Wado Soo Kabashada (Juun 2022) Daabacaadda No. 25

English: Notice from KEMSA: free antenatal care clinics will run every January at designated health centres in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa KEMSA: kliniki za bure za utunzaji wa ujauzito zitaendeshwa kila Januari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid KEMSA: rugta daryeelka dhalmada ee bilaashka ah waxaa lagu qaban doonaa Janaayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Chenro mar KEMSA: Klinike mag rito nyithindo kapok onyuol biro tiyo dwe ka dwe e dwe mar Januar e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Kirinyaga.

English: CDC reminds the public in Nyandarua County that access to subsidised dialysis is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba upatikanaji wa dialysis ya ruzuku sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Nyandarua in helitaanka dialysis-ka la taageeray hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji duto e County mar Nyandarua ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mar dialysis e kuonde moyier.

English: This research describes effects of change in agriculture production, trade,and food security. Research in books...
Kiswahili: Utafiti huu unaelezea athari za mabadiliko katika uzalishaji wa kilimo, biashara, na usalama wa chakula. Utafiti katika vitabu...
Somali: Cilmi-baaristan waxay sharxaysaa saameynta isbeddelka wax-soo-saarka beeraha, ganacsiga, iyo amniga cuntada. Cilmi-baaris buugaag...
Dholuo: Nonro ma otim e sulani lero kaka lokruok ma timore e weche mag pur, ohala, kod weche mag chiemo kelo lokruok.

English: Mandera County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Mandera: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2024
Somali: Degmada Mandheera: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Mandera: Oboke Mopinyo mar Oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2024

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Samburu County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan Gobolka Samburu inay biyo cabitaan ah ku kariyaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso jogweng' mar Samburu County ni mondo gimi pi omodhi kapok gitiyo kode mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche ma ok nyal geng'o.

English: KUCCPS reminds needy students in Uasin Gishu County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba maombi ya masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Uasin Gishu in deeqaha waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay codsiyada ardayda baahan ay dhowaan dhammaadaan.
Dholuo: KUCCPS paronwa jopuonjre man gi chan e Uasin Gishu County ni tuke mag somo ma konyo jopuonjre ma nigi chan biro rumo machiegni.

English: FAO announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for goats in Nyandarua County this June.
Kiswahili: FAO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Juni hii.
Somali: FAO waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo bilaash ah oo cudurka Newcastle ah oo loogu talagalay riyaha Gobolka Nyandarua bishii Juun.
Dholuo: FAO olando chenro mar thieth mar tuo mar Newcastle maonge chudo ne diek e County mar Nyandarua e dwe mar Jun.

English: OGP reminds the public in Nyamira County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Nyamira in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: OGP oparo ne ji duto e County mar Nyamira ni lando wach ketho migepe en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) updates residents of Kakamega County on progress of community-based development programmes this July.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega maendeleo ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii mwezi Julai.

Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chiwo ripot ne jogweng' Kakamega County kuom dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag oganda e dwe mar Julai.

English: EACC reminds voters in Migori County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Migori kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.

Dholuo: EACC parone jogweng' Migori County mondo olim kama ichanoe IEBC machiegni kodgi kapok itimo yiero.

English: IPOA warns residents of Nairobi County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: IPOA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi kororka khiyaamada SIM-swap waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax falin.
Dholuo: IPOA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nairobi County kuom medruok mar wuond mag SIM-swap kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: NTSA urges motorists and pedestrians in Nandi County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Nandi inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada daadadku ka da'ay si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira qaraxyada dabka.
Dholuo: NTSA ojiwo joidh mtokni kod jowuoth e county mar Nandi mondo kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o mondo kik mach chakore.

English: Waiting a minute before clamping the cord improves baby's iron levels and immunity.
Kiswahili: Kusubiri dakika moja kabla ya kubana kitovu huboresha viwango vya chuma na kinga ya mtoto.
Somali: Sugitaanka daqiiqad ka hor inta aan la xidhin xadhiggu waxay wanaajisaa heerarka birta iyo difaaca jirka ee ilmaha.
Dholuo: Ka irito dakika achiel kapok iketo ng’injo, mano miyo nyathi bedo gi iron kendo miyo ringre bedo gi teko mar geng’o tuoche.

English: A subsidy voucher is a delivery mechanism that provides farmers with access to agricultural ... market survey should be launched to probe the market in terms of ...
Kiswahili: Vocha ya ruzuku ni utaratibu wa utoaji unaowapa wakulima ufikiaji wa kilimo ... utafiti wa soko unapaswa kuzinduliwa ili kuchunguza soko kwa upande wa ...

English: Notice: EACC opens a new service point for national ID applications in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogaysiis: EACC waxay furaysaa barta adeegga cusub ee codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Nandi.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: EACC oseyawo kama itimee tije manyien ne kwayo mag ng'eyo nying' e piny mangima e county mar Nandi.

English: Cooperative CEOs are encouraged to adopt digital operations and ethical practices to enhance resilience amidst competition Take action now to strengthen your cooperative s growth
Kiswahili: Wakurugenzi Wakuu wa Vyama vya Ushirika wanahimizwa kufuata utendakazi wa kidijitali na mazoea ya kimaadili ili kuimarisha uthabiti huku kukiwa na ushindani. Chukua hatua sasa ili kuimarisha ukuaji wa ushirika wako.
Somali: Maamulayaasha iskaashatada waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay qaataan hawlgallada dijitaalka ah iyo hababka anshaxa si loo xoojiyo adkeysiga tartanka dhexdiisa Tallaabo qaado hadda si aad u xoojiso kobaca iskaashatadaada
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma gin jotelo mag riwruoge ma loso dhok gi dhok ma ji wacho jiwo jotelo mag riwruoge ma loso dhok gi dhok ma ji wacho mondo oti gi weche mag digital kod timbe mabeyo mondo omi gibed gi nyalo mar timo dongruok e winjruokgi gi Nyasaye.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Vihiga County to attend the public participation forum to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay ka qaybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si loo qaabeeyo habka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' County mar Vihiga mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar loso bajet mar county.

English: Additionally, the 110 community health promoters using the digital tool expressed optimism about incorporating it into other large-scale health campaigns, such as polio vaccination campaigns.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, waendelezaji wa afya ya jamii 110 wanaotumia zana ya kidijitali walionyesha matumaini kuhusu kuijumuisha katika kampeni nyingine kubwa za afya, kama vile kampeni za chanjo ya polio.
Somali: Intaa waxaa dheer, 110-ka qof ee dhiirrigeliya caafimaadka bulshada ee adeegsanaya qalabka dijitaalka ah ayaa muujiyay rajo wanaagsan oo ku saabsan ku darista ololayaasha kale ee caafimaadka ee baaxadda weyn, sida ololaha tallaalka dabaysha.
Dholuo: Bende, jogo 110 ma rito ngima mar oganda ma tiyo gi gige tich mag dijital nonyiso ni gin gi geno mar ketogi e kampen mamoko madongo mag thieth, kaka kampen mag chiwo chanjo mar polio.

English: DPP warns residents of Nyandarua County to prepare for possible road accidents this March.
Kiswahili: DPP anawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Machi hii.
Somali: DPP waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan gobolka Nyandarua inay u diyaargaroobaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: DPP osiemo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: KEMRI will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Mombasa County this March. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI itafanya kongamano la kurejesha matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Machi hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay qabaneysaa forum ka soo kabashada isticmaalka maandooriyaha gobolka Mombasa bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMRI biro timo chokruok mar chango joma tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero e dwe mar Mach e boma mar Mombasa.

Kiswahili: Kuanzishwa kwa MoreMilk 2, ambayo inalenga kuboresha usalama wa maziwa na mapato kupitia viwango, mafunzo, na upatikanaji wa soko katika Kenya ya kati/magharibi.
Somali: Soo bandhigidda MoreMilkâ€¯2, oo loogu talagalay in lagu horumariyo badbaadada caanaha iyo dakhliga iyada oo loo marayo heerarka, tababarka, iyo helitaanka suuqa ee bartamaha/galbeedka Kenya.
Dholuo: Oketo MoreMilkâ€ ̄2, ma ochung’ne bero rito mtoka kod yudo pesa kokalo kuom rang’iny, puonj, kod yudo chiro e piny Kenya ma diere/ma podho chieng’.

English: As we stay home & celebrate Easter holiday, we are reminded about our mental health. Be keen on what you consume as information during these troubled times, be mindful about your health & that of others. Share love, not panic & fear
Kiswahili: Tunapokaa nyumbani na kusherehekea sikukuu ya Pasaka, tunakumbushwa kuhusu afya yetu ya akili. Kuwa makini na kile unachotumia kama taarifa wakati huu wa matatizo, kuwa makini na afya yako na ya wengine. Shiriki upendo, si hofu na hofu.

Dholuo: Sama wan pacho kendo wamor gi nyasi mar Pasaka, waparo kaka ngimawa chalo e pachwa. Beduru motang' gi gik ma uchamo e kinde matekgi, beduru moikore ne ngimau koda mar jomamoko. Wuouru e wi hera, to kik ubed gi luoro kod luoro

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the public in Kilifi County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of identity theft.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unashauri umma katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya shacabka degmada Kilifi inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib markii la soo sheegay kiisaska la xaday aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ji duto manie County Kilifi mondo onyis jowetegi weche ma ok adier bang' weche mag kwalo kitgi.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges eligible citizens in Makueni County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawasihi wananchi wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Makueni kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Guddiga Garsoorka Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Makueni inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro mar yiero e county mar Makueni mondo oriwre gi jogo madwaro yiero.

English: KRA urges all licensed manufacturers, importers, distributors, retailers and general public that all bottled water beverages manufactured in or imported into Kenya from 13th November 2019 must be affixed with an Excise Stamp in compliance with the EGMS Regulations.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wazalishaji wote walioidhinishwa, waagizaji, wasambazaji, wauzaji rejareja na umma kwa ujumla kwamba vinywaji vyote vya maji ya chupa vinavyotengenezwa au kuingizwa nchini Kenya kuanzia tarehe 13 Novemba 2019 lazima viambatishwe na Stempu ya Ushuru kwa mujibu wa Kanuni za EGMS.
Somali: KRA waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhammaan soosaarayaasha, soo dejinta, qaybiyeyaasha, tafaariiqleyda iyo dadweynaha guud in dhammaan cabitaannada biyaha lagu dhalo ee laga soo saaro Kenya ama laga soo dhoofiyo Kenya laga bilaabo 13ka Nofeembar 2019 ay ku dhejiyaan Stamp excise si waafaqsan Xeerarka EGMS.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo josayans duto ma nigi ratiro mar loso gik moko, joma kelo gik moko e pinje mamoko, jomisonari, jolok ohala, kod ji duto ni gik moko duto mitimo e piny Kenya kata makelo e pinyno chakre tarik 13 dwe mar Novemba 2019 nyaka ketie Stamp mar Akcise kaluwore gi chike mag EGMS.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada ee degmada Nandi.
Dholuo: Rapar: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e county mar Nandi.

English: HELB calls on the community in Nakuru County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: HELB inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: HELB waxay bulshada degmada Nakuru ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyo.
Dholuo: HELB luongo oganda man Nakuru County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo omi skunde obed motegno.

English: Huduma Kenya advises residents of Nyeri County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya nyiso jogweng' Nyeri County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro kwayo mag ID.

English: COMESA reminds residents of Turkana County that water harvesting improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba uvunaji wa maji unaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Somali: COMESA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana in goosashada biyaha ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: COMESA paronwa jogweng' Turkana County ni choko pi kelo nyak e puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises milk producers in Meru County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inashauri wazalishaji wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Meru kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha caanaha ee degmada Meru inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development nyiso jopur mag chak e county mar Meru mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mabiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Kenya Gazette urges eligible citizens in Laikipia County to participate in voter education.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kushiriki katika elimu ya wapiga kura.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Laikipia inay ka qaybqaataan waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' mar Laikipia County mondo oriwgi e tiegruok mar joma oyier.

English: KUCCPS invites youth in Baringo County to enroll for ICT skills training this October.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Baringo kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT Oktoba hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Baringo inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka xirfadaha ICT bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KUCCPS gwelo rowere mag Baringo County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar ICT e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges residents of Embu County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Uhalifu unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya dadka deggan degmada Embu inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta deegaanka iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations ojiwo jogweng' Embu County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: DPP urges the community in Isiolo County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb theft.
Kiswahili: DPP anaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Isiolo inay ka warbixiyaan waxqabadka shakiga ah xarunta booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo ji duto manie gweng' mar Isiolo mondo ochiw ripot e stesen mar polise man machiegni mondo gikwed nekno.

English: Ministry of Health reminds expectant mothers in Lamu County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Lamu kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Lamu in helitaanka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Lamu ni thuolo mar yudo puonj mag chenro mag ngima joot en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag oganda.

Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Garissa: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Februari 2023

Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Turkana: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2022
Somali: Degmada Turkana: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Turkana: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar adek higa mar 2022

English: Farmers are encouraged to attend plant clinics for expert advice on crop pest and disease management Check with local agricultural extension services for clinic locations and schedules
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kuhudhuria kliniki za mimea kwa ushauri wa kitaalam kuhusu udhibiti wa wadudu waharibifu wa mazao na magonjwa.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qayb galaan rugaha dhirta si ay u helaan talo khubaro ku saabsan maaraynta cayayaanka dalagyada iyo cudurrada La xiriir adeegyada fidinta beeraha ee maxalliga ah goobaha iyo jadwalka rugaha
Dholuo: Josupni ijiwo mondo odhi e klinik mag yiende mondo giyud paro mag josayans e wi kaka ginyalo loyo tuoche kod tuoche mag yiende

English: Ministry of Health encourages mothers in Mandera County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Mandera kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Mandera inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health jiwo mine man Mandera County mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Universities Fund advises applicants in Busia County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Busia kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu kula talinayaa codsadayaasha degmada Busia inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e County mar Busia ni gidonj e tiegruok kapok ichopo e chokruok mabiro.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages mothers in Nyeri County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Nyeri inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo mine manie County mar Nyeri mondo olim kama giwuokie machiegni mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: The Ministry of Health and WHO are working to ensure these lessons translate into stronger emergency plans, better-resourced facilities, and more resilient communities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya na WHO zinafanya kazi ili kuhakikisha kuwa masomo haya yanatafsiriwa katika mipango thabiti ya dharura, vifaa vyenye rasilimali bora na jumuiya zinazostahimili zaidi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka iyo WHO waxay ka shaqeynayaan sidii loo hubin lahaa in casharradani ay noqdaan qorshayaal degdeg ah oo xooggan, xarumo kheyraad wanaagsan leh, iyo bulshooyin adkeysi badan leh.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Thieth kod WHO tiyo matek mondo gine ni gik ma wapuonjoregi olokore gi chenro motegno mag ng’ado bura mapiyo, kuonde ma nigi gik mabeyo, kod oganda ma nigi nyalo mar rito gik moko mapiyo.

English: Marsabit County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Marsabit: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Juni 2024
Somali: Degmada Marsabit: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2024
