English: UNICEF Kenya Humanitarian Situation Report No. 6, 10 August 2023 (January to June 2023)
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Hali ya Kibinadamu ya UNICEF Kenya No. 6, 10 Agosti 2023 (Januari hadi Juni 2023)
Somali: Warbixinta Xaaladda Bani'aadamnimada ee UNICEF Kenya Lambarka 6, 10 Agoosto 2023 (Janaayo ilaa Juun 2023)
Dholuo: Ripot mar chal mar konyo dhano mar UNICEF e Kenya namba 6, tarik 10 dwe mar aboro higa mar 2023 (dwe mar achiel nyaka dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2023)

English: IEBC invites youth in Vihiga County to enroll for catering and hospitality training this April.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu Aprili hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Vihiga inay iska diiwaangeliyaan tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: IEBC gwelo rowere e County mar Vihiga mondo odonj e tiegruok mar chiemo kod rwako welo e dwe mar April.

English: SHA reminds residents of Turkana County that access to national ID applications is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: SHA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Turkana kwamba kufikia maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana in helitaanka codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: SHA parone jogweng'o mag Turkana County ni yudo kwayo mag ID e piny mangima koro yot moloyo kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: KEMRI urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Embu County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Embu kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Embu inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e County mar Embu mondo odhi ir japuonj molony.

English: NTSA warns residents of Nyeri County to prepare for possible flooding this January.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa mafuriko Januari hii.
Somali: NTSA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay u diyaar garoobaan fatahaadaha iman kara bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nyeri County mondo giikre ne ataro manyalo timore e dwe mar Januar.

English: Universities Fund encourages residents of Kilifi County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya haki za kikatiba.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inay ka qaybgalaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada si ay uga warqabaan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo jogweng' Kilifi County mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar jopiny mar county mondo ging'e weche motudore gi ratiro mag chik.

English: Notice: IPOA conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Kisumu County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: IPOA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ku saabsan dhismaha nabadda qaranka ee degmada Kisumu bishii November.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IPOA timo romo mar oganda e wi loso kuwe e piny Kisumu County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Bomet County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the November planting season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Novemba.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Bomet inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beerto ee Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e county mar Bomet mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Novemba.

English: DPP urges the community in Vihiga County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb theft.
Kiswahili: DPP anaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Vihiga inay ka warbixiyaan waxqabadka shakiga ah xarunta booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: DPP ojiwo ji duto e County mar Vihiga mondo onyis polis ma machiegni gi kanyo ni gitimo gik ma chando ji.

English: Services to an organization with many people Kenya, have started awareness aimed at promoting foods rich in iron-folate to young people in Busia, Kiyui and nakuru regions
Kiswahili: Huduma kwa shirika na watu wengi Kenya, wameanza ufahamu lengo la kukuza vyakula tajiri ya chuma folate kwa vijana katika mikoa ya Busia, Kiyui na nakuru
Somali: Adeegyada hay'ad dad badan ku leh Kenya, waxay bilaabeen wacyi-gelinta ujeedadoodu tahay in lagu horumariyo cuntooyinka hodanka ku ah birta folatka dhalinyarada ku nool gobollada Busia, Kiyui iyo nakuru
Dholuo: Chenro mar konyo riwruok moro ma nigi ji mang'eny e piny Kenya, osechako konyo rowere e gwenge mag Busia, Kiyui kod nakuru mondo ong'e kaka ginyalo yudo chiemo ma nigi iron folate

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to invest in Africa as Tanzania achieves 128 food self sufficiency and begins exporting surplus
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wamehimizwa kuwekeza barani Afrika huku Tanzania ikifikia 128 ya kujitosheleza kwa chakula na kuanza kuuza ziada nje ya nchi.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha ayaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay maalgashi ku sameeyaan Afrika maadaama Tansaaniya ay gaarto 128 cunto oo is-hoosaysiiya waxayna bilaabaneysaa inay dhoofinto ka badan
Dholuo: Josupni kod joma nie weche mag ohala jiwo ji mondo otim ohala e Afrika nikech Tanzania chopo dwaro mar chiemo 128 kendo ochako oro ohala mar chiemo

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free youth mental wellness support is available through county health facilities in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa afya ya akili kwa vijana unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Kajiado County.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo ne rowere e weche thieth mar paro yudore maonge chudo kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e Kajiado County.

English: Kenya Gazette urges eligible citizens in Trans Nzoia County to participate in voter education.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kushiriki katika elimu ya wapiga kura.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka qaybqaataan waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jokanyo mag Trans Nzoia County mondo oriwgi e tiegruok mar joma oyier.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unafungua ofisi ya kijinsia inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa furaya xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya daryeel caafimaad ka dib rabshadaha degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oyawo ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony mar thieth bang' timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Kisii.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds mobile money users in Makueni County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha watumiaji wa fedha za simu katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Makueni in ay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e gweng' mar Makueni ni mondo ginyis jomisonari maggi weche maok adier mondo kik gitim kamano.

English: IPOA reminds the public in Kajiado County to remain vigilant on border security.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha umma katika Kajiado County kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kajiado inay ka feejignaadaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa ji duto e Kajiado County ni gibed motang' gi weche mag sirkal.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of West Pokot County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit nyiso ji duto modak e West Pokot County mondo odonjre e weche thieth mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges wheat growers in Bungoma County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Udhibiti wa Pest Products inawasihi wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa za kukabiliana na ukame ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda sarreenka ee degmada Bungoma inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si loo wanaajiyo wax soo saarkooda xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur mag ngano man Bungoma County mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo okony e medo nyak mar ngano e higani.

English: Farmers in Uganda are advised to note the recent decline in coffee prices Robusta FAQ now at UGX 10 000 11 000 Kiboko at UGX 5 000 5 500 and Arabica at UGX 14 000 15 000 Adjust your sales accordingly
Kiswahili: Wakulima nchini Uganda wanashauriwa kutambua kushuka kwa bei ya kahawa hivi majuzi.
Somali: Beeraleyda Uganda waxaa lagula talinayaa in ay ogaadaan hoos u dhackii dhawaan ee qiimaha kafeega Robusta FAQ hadda UGX 10 000 11 000 Kiboko 5 000 5 500 iyo Arabica UGX 14 000 15 000 Si loo habeeyo iibka sida ku habboon
Dholuo: Josupni e piny Uganda ijiwo mondo ong'e ni nengo mar kofi osedok chien e kinde mokalo Robusta FAQ sani e UGX 10 000 11 000 Kiboko e UGX 5 000 5 500 kod Arabica e UGX 14 000 15 000 Lokuru ohala maru kaluwore gi mano

English: NTSA calls on the community in Narok County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Narok kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Somali: NTSA waxay bulshada degmada Narok ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: NTSA luongo oganda man Narok County mondo owuo e wi timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo manyo kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Notice: IPOA issues a cybersecurity alert on phishing messages affecting residents of Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya ujumbe wa udanganyifu unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan fariimaha phishing ee saameeya dadka deggan gobolka Samburu.
Dholuo: Rapar: IPOA ogolo siem mar sirkal kuom weche mag phishing makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e county mar Samburu.

English: DPP urges the public in Nyeri County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: DPP inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: DPP waxay ugu baaqeysaa shacabka degmada Nyeri in ay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo ji duto e County mar Nyeri mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma osefweny kuom chenro mag ohala mag miriambo.

English: State Department for TVET invites youth in Kakamega County to enroll for ICT skills training this March.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT Machi hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku casuumaysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kakamega inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka xirfadaha ICT bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET ogwelo rowere man Kakamega County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar ICT e dwe mar Mach.

English: Exporters of maize to Kenya must provide certificates of conformity to confirm compliance with aflatoxin safety standards after recent bans due to contamination concerns
Kiswahili: Wasafirishaji wa mahindi hadi Kenya lazima watoe vyeti vya utiifu ili kuthibitisha kufuata viwango vya usalama vya aflatoxin baada ya kupigwa marufuku hivi majuzi kwa sababu ya uchafuzi.
Somali: Dhoofiyeyaasha galleyda ee Kenya waa inay bixiyaan shahaadooyin waafaqsanaan si ay u xaqiijiyaan u hoggaansanaanta heerarka badbaadada aflatoxin kadib mamnuucnitaankii dhawaan la xiriira walaaca wasakheynta
Dholuo: Joma ouso cham e piny Kenya nyaka chiw gik manyiso ni gichopo chike mag ritruok mag aflatoxin bang' ka noseketi marfuk ma nyocha otim nikech gik ma kelo hinyruok

English: Public notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will host a free diabetes screening outreach in Kirinyaga County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uchunguzi wa kisukari bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay martigelin doontaa baaritaanka bukaanka ee bilaashka ah ee Kirinyaga County bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuoche biro timo nonro mar thieth mar sukari maonge chudo e County mar Kirinyaga e dwe mar abich.

English: Notice: DPP opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Turkana County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa simu ya GBV ya bure katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ee degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DPP ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo simo maonge chudo mar GBV e County mar Turkana.

English: The complex and controversial global debate on GM technology seems to have steered some African countries to a more cautious attitude. For instance, in 2002, ...
Kiswahili: Majadiliano magumu na yenye utata ulimwenguni pote juu ya teknolojia ya GM yanaonekana kuwa yameelekeza baadhi ya nchi za Afrika kuwa na mtazamo wa tahadhari zaidi. Kwa mfano, katika mwaka wa 2002, ...
Somali: Dooda caalamiga ah ee adag oo muran leh ee ku saabsan tikniyoolajiyadda GM waxay u muuqataa inay u horseedtay qaar ka mid ah dalalka Afrika inay noqdaan kuwo taxaddar badan. Tusaale ahaan, 2002, ...
Dholuo: Kuom ranyisi, e higa mar 2002, ji mang'eny e pinje mag Afrika nochako bedo motang'.

English: WHO and Novo Nordisk Foundation partner to advance health workforce education in Kenya
Kiswahili: WHO na Novo Nordisk Foundation wanashirikiana kuendeleza elimu ya wafanyakazi wa afya nchini Kenya
Somali: WHO iyo Novo Nordisk Foundation oo iska kaashanaya horumarinta waxbarashada shaqaalaha caafimaadka ee Kenya
Dholuo: WHO kod Kawruok mar Novo Nordisk tiyo kanyakla mar dhi nyime gi somo mar jotich mag thieth e piny Kenya

English: Uganda declares Ebola outbreak after the Health Ministry confirmed a 24-year-old man showed symptoms and later died
Kiswahili: Uganda yatangaza mlipuko wa Ebola baada ya Wizara ya Afya kuthibitisha mwanamume mwenye umri wa miaka 24 alionyesha dalili na baadaye akafa
Somali: Uganda ayaa ku dhawaaqday cudurka Ebola kadib markii Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ay xaqiijisay in nin 24 jir ah uu muujiyay calaamado kadibna uu geeriyooday
Dholuo: Uganda olando ni Ebola osechakore bang' ka Ministri mar weche thieth osenyiso ni ng'at moro ma jahigni 24 ne nigi hinyruok mar tuwono kendo bang'e notho

English: Kenya Gazette invites residents of Mandera County to attend the public participation forum regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette gwelo jood Mandera County mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenro mag dongruok.

English: List of common mental disorders: anxiety, depression, bipolar disorder, PTSD, schizophrenia
Kiswahili: Orodha ya matatizo ya akili ya kawaida: wasiwasi, mfadhaiko, ugonjwa wa bipolar, PTSD, skizofrenia
Somali: Liiska cudurrada maskaxda ee caadiga ah: walwalka, niyadjabka, cudurka laba-geesoodka ah, PTSD, schizophrenia
Dholuo: Ng'eny tuoche mag parruok: parruok, chuny monyosore, tuwo mar bipolar, PTSD, schizophrenia

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Meru County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the January planting season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Januari.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Meru inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Janaayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur e county mar Meru mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro ka pok ochopo dwe mar Januar.

English: KALRO urges pigs farmers in Garissa County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wafugaji wa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa kufuatia kuripotiwa visa vya ugonjwa wa ngozi.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda doofaarka ee degmada Garissa inay xoolahooda tallaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo ka dib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur ma pidho anguro e County mar Garissa mondo ogeng'e legi e kuonde moketi mag chwoyo ng'ato bang' ka osenyis ni nitie tuoche mang'eny mag pien.

English: NTSA alerts residents of Kirinyaga County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: NTSA waxay dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga uga digtay kororka kiisaska tuugada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka warbixiyaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kirinyaga County e wi kwan mag joma oketho kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot e stesen mar polise man machiegni.

English: KEMSA urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pach e County mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ee gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura mar Kenya biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi weche siasa e Homa Bay County.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit confirms a HIV/AIDS outbreak alert for Kilifi County. Residents are advised to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa VVU/UKIMWI kwa Kaunti ya Kilifi. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa xaqiijisay feejignaanta cudurka HIV / AIDS ee Gobolka Kilifi. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isticmaalaan shabaqa cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Rieko: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osenyiso ni nitie siem mar tuo mar HIV/AIDS e gweng' mar Kilifi.

English: KALRO urges cattle farmers in Embu County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported rabies cases.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawataka wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Embu kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya kichaa cha mbwa vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da ee degmada Embu inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska xanaaqa la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur mag jamni e county mar Embu mondo onyis jamni matuwo e ofise mar thieth machiegni gigi bang' yudo weche mag rabies.

English: Young Kenyans call for urgent action on hunger crisis
Kiswahili: Vijana wa Kenya watoa wito wa kuchukuliwa hatua za haraka kukabiliana na baa la njaa
Somali: Dhalinyarada Kenya ayaa ku baaqay in si degdeg ah wax looga qabto dhibaatada gaajada.
Dholuo: Jo Kenya matindo dwaro ni mondo otimre mapiyo e wi chandruok mar kech

English: The recommended seed varieties are only guidelines; farmers are advised to contact local extension staff for other suitable varieties, since an area's climatic conditions can vary considerably.
Kiswahili: Aina za mbegu zilizopendekezwa ni miongozo tu; Wakulima wanashauriwa kuwasiliana na wafanyikazi wa ugani wa ndani kwa aina zingine zinazofaa, kwani hali ya hewa ya eneo inaweza kutofautiana sana.
Somali: Noocyada abuurka ee la soo jeediyay waa tilmaamo kaliya; Beeraleyda waxaa lagula talinayaa inay la xiriiraan shaqaalaha qaybinta maxalliga ah si ay u helaan noocyo kale oo ku habboon, maadaama xaaladaha cimilada ee deegaanka ay aad u kala duwanaan karaan.
Dholuo: Kodhi ma ji wacho ni onego okaw e yo maber gin mana chike ma tayo kaka onego okaw kodhi; omiyo, jodongo onego owuo gi joma tiyo e alwora ma gidhiye mondo giyud kodhi mamoko mowinjore nikech chal mar alwora nyalo pogore ahinya.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges residents of Kilifi County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Kilifi ku boorinayaa inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay si loo qaabeeyo wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General jiwo ji duto modak e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo ochiw ripot mondik kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso chenro mag chenro mag sirkal ochopo.

English: The government has waived packaging taxes to support the tea sector Farmers are encouraged to take advantage of this initiative
Kiswahili: Serikali imeondoa ushuru wa vifungashio kusaidia sekta ya chai Wakulima wanahimizwa kunufaika na mpango huu.
Somali: Dowladda ayaa ka dhaaftay canshuuraha baakadaha si loo taageero qaybta shaaha. Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay ka faa'iidaystaan hindisahan
Dholuo: Sirkal oseweyo chulo osuru kuom kembe mondo okony tich mar loso chai.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Marsabit County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi diiwaangelinta beeraleyda loogu talagalay beeralayda degmada Marsabit bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro timo rapar mar jopur e dwe mar Marsabit County.

English: Huduma Kenya warns public officers in Kajiado County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kajiado County dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Kajiado inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e Kajiado County ni kik giti marach gi migepegi.

English: KEMRI reminds expectant mothers in Nandi County that access to postnatal check-ups is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba ufikiaji wa uchunguzi wa baada ya kuzaa ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Nandi in helitaanka baaritaano ka dib dhalashada ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMRI parone mine ma nigi ich e County mar Nandi ni thuolo mar dhi e nonro bang' nyuol en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag sirkal.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kitui County that access to the GBV toll-free helpline is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba upatikanaji wa simu ya GBV ya bure ya msaada unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee Gobolka Kitui in helitaanka khadka caawimaadda ee GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah uu yahay mid lacag-la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Kitui ni gibiro yudo kony ma onge chudo mar GBV maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Nakuru County about the importance of hypertension awareness for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhusu umuhimu wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu dadka ku nool degmada Nakuru u xusuusinayaa muhiimadda ay leedahay wacyiga cadaadiska sare ee caafimaadka qoyska.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji duto e gweng' mar Nakuru kuom ber mar ng'eyo ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar hypertension e ngima joot.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will be held in Isiolo County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo bilaash ah oo ay soo qabanqaabisay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta Caafimada taranka ayaa lagu qabanqaabi doonaa Degmada Isiolo bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ochano ibiro tim e kaunti mar Isiolo e dwe mar Mach.

English: NPS warns residents of Tharaka-Nithi County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: NPS waxay ka digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi oo ku saabsan kororka khiyaamada SIM-swap waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: NPS osiemo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County kuom medruok mar wuond mag SIM-swap kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: DCI urges residents of Makueni County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: DCI inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaala aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ilaalinta ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo jogweng' Makueni County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar sirkal e wi gik ma ne timore e alwora mar tong'gi.

English: Universities Fund reminds parents in Nyamira County that bursary allocation registration is open this April.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba usajili wa ugawaji wa bursari umefunguliwa Aprili hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xusuusinayaa waalidiinta degmada Nyamira in diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ay furan tahay bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa jonyuol e County mar Nyamira ni ndiko kwayo mar yudo bursary osechakore e dwe mar April.

English: COMESA urges rice growers in Kajiado County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawataka wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda bariiska ee Gobolka Kajiado inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: COMESA ojiwo jopur ma pidho kodhi e Kajiado County mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Nyandarua County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo odonj e riwruok mar insuarans mar thieth mondo giyud thieth ma yudo kony.

English: HELB calls on the community in Baringo County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: HELB inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Baringo kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: HELB waxay bulshada degmada Baringo ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: HELB luongo oganda man Baringo County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Very effective vaccine for polio has been issued. Other women have complained for its bad effects. The Ministry of Health has said that all tjhose effects are normal
Kiswahili: Vaccine yenye ufanisi sana dhidi ya polio imetolewa.Wanawake wengine wamelalamika juu ya athari zake mbaya. Wizara ya Afya imesema kwamba athari zote ni za kawaida
Somali: Waxaa la soo saaray tallaal aad u wax ku ool ah oo ka dhan ah cudurka Polio. Haween kale ayaa ka cabanaya saameyntiisa xun. Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa sheegtay in dhammaan saameyntu ay yihiin kuwo caadi ah.
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine mang'eny oseneno ni thieth mar tuo mar polio en gima konyo ahinya.

English: TVET advises students in Vihiga County to register early to secure allocation to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Somali: TVET waxay ardayda degmada Vihiga kula talineysaa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan si ay u helaan deeq waxbarasho oo loogu talagalay ardayda u baahan.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jopuonjre e County mar Vihiga mondo odonj e skundno chon mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo osuru ne jopuonjre mochando.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds the public in Migori County that reporting embezzlement of public funds is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Migori kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa fedha za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka degmada Migori u xusuusinayaa in warbixinta xadgudubka lacagta dadweynaha ay tahay mid bilaash ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties paronwa ji duto manie County mar Migori ni lando wach ketho pesa mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'.

English: All deliveries should be conducted by skilled birth attendants at health facilities. This ensures safer births and immediate care in case of complications.
Kiswahili: Uzazi wote unapaswa kufanywa na wakunga wenye ujuzi katika vituo vya afya. Hii inahakikisha uzazi salama na huduma ya haraka iwapo kutatokea matatizo.
Somali: Dhammaan dhalmada waa in ay sameeyaan kalkaaliyayaal xirfadlayaal ah oo ka shaqeeya xarumaha caafimaadka. Tani waxay hubisaa dhalmada ammaan ah iyo daryeelka degdegga ah haddii ay dhacdo dhibaatooyin.
Dholuo: Twak duto onego otim gi jorit ma nigi lony e osiptal mar thieth. mano miyo nyuol bedo mayot kendo rito nyithindo mapiyo kapo ni giromo gi pek moko.

English: NCPB encourages farmers in Nyamira County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for milk.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za maziwa.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyamira inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan caanaha.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e Kaunti mar Nyamira mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro mondo omi ohala mar chak obed maber.

English: DRC - Learning Brief: Leveraging the Self-Reliance Index for Livelihoods Impact Assessment
Kiswahili: DRC - Muhtasari wa Mafunzo: Kutumia Fahirisi ya Kujitegemea kwa Tathmini ya Athari za Kipato
Somali: DRC - Warbixin Kooban oo ku saabsan Waxbarashada: Ka faa'iidaysiga Tusmada Isku-kalsoonida ee Qiimaynta Saamaynta Maciishadda
Dholuo: DRC - Somo machuok: Tiyo gi ranyisi mar ng’ato owuon mondo otim nonro mar gik ma nyalo ketho ngima

English: KMTC encourages out-of-school children in Nyandarua County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta dugsiga ka baxsan ee degmada Nyandarua inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee fasallada akhris-xisaabta dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: KMTC jiwo nyithindo maok dhi e skul e County mar Nyandarua mondo odonj e program mar somo kod somo mar joma dongo.

English: AFA reminds livestock keepers in Migori County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Migori kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa za kuponda ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Migori inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: AFA paronwa jorit jamni e county mar Migori mondo opidhgi gi tuoche e kuonde moketi mag chamo jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: Stay calm, call for help, and follow safe delivery steps if birth begins unexpectedly.
Kiswahili: Tulia, piga simu kuomba msaada, na fuata hatua salama za kujifungua ikiwa kujifungua kutaanza bila kutarajia.
Somali: Iska daaya, caawimaad u yeedha, oo raac tallaabooyinka badbaadada dhalmada haddii dhalmada ay bilaabato si lama filaan ah.
Dholuo: Bed ng'at mokuwe, ywak mondo okonyi, kendo tim kaka inyalo ka ichako nyuol e yo ma ok ing'eyo.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education opens applications for revision guides for learners in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka waxay furaysaa codsiyada hagaha dib u eegista ardayda degmada Meru.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Puonjruok ma Chakre e Piny owacho, oseyawo kwayo mag somo ne jopuonjre manie kaunti mar Meru.

English: Children aged 1-5 needs to be dewormed after every 6 months to prevent transmission, frequent hunger and deformed growth
Kiswahili: Watoto wenye umri wa miaka 1-5 wanahitaji kuondolewa wadudu kila baada ya miezi 6 ili kuzuia maambukizi, njaa ya mara kwa mara na ukuaji usio na umbo
Somali: Carruurta da'doodu tahay 1-5 sano waxay u baahan yihiin in 6dii biloodba mar la daaweeyo si looga hortago gudbinta, gaajada joogtada ah iyo koritaanka qaldan
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma johigni 1 nyaka 5 nyaka bed gi thieth mar golo tuoche bang ' dweche 6 ka dwe mondo gitang' gi tuwono, kech mapile, kod dongo marach

English: IPOA urges the public in Bungoma County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of identity theft.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Bungoma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha degmada Bungoma inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qof kasta oo ka dambeeya kiisaska la soo sheegay ee tuugista aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo ji duto e County mar Bungoma mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' weche mag kwalo kitgi.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the public in Siaya County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of identity theft.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa shacabka degmada Siaya inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarkooda M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee tuugista aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Communications Authority jiwo ji duto e county mar Siaya mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' weche mag kwalo kitgi.

English: County launches mass supplementation reaching over 12,000 children aged 6â€“59 months with Vitamin A and deworming to enhance immunity and nutrition.
Kiswahili: Kaunti yazindua virutubisho vingi vinavyowafikia zaidi ya watoto 12,000 wenye umri wa miezi 6-59 kwa kutumia Vitamini A na dawa za minyoo ili kuongeza kinga na lishe.
Somali: Degmadu waxay bilowday kaabis ballaaran oo gaareysa in ka badan 12,000 oo carruur ah oo da'doodu u dhaxayso 6-59 bilood iyadoo la adeegsanayo Fiitamiin A iyo dirxiga si loo xoojiyo difaaca jirka iyo nafaqada.
Dholuo: Kaunti ochako chiwo chiemo ma ji mang’eny nyalo chopo ne nyithindo mokalo 12,000 ma hikgi dweche 6 nyaka 59 ka gitiyo gi Vitamin A kod gik ma geng’o tuoche mondo gimed bedo gi teko mar geng’o tuoche kod chiemo.

English: EACC advises residents of Nyamira County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: EACC inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e- Citizen.
Somali: EACC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan diiwaangelinta e-citizen.
Dholuo: EACC nyiso jogweng' Nyamira County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom websait mar e-Citizen sama gidwaro dhi e e e - Citizen registration.

English: Flood Resilience Alliance - Impact Brief: Kenya
Kiswahili: Muungano wa Kustahimili Mafuriko - Muhtasari wa Athari: Kenya
Somali: Isbahaysiga U Adkeysiga Daadadka - Warbixinta Saamaynta: Kenya
Dholuo: Riwruok mar geng'o pi mang'eny - Oboke machuok: Kenya

English: Since 2019, the KCC has been continuously providing timely, life-saving cash assistance to communities across Kenya.
Kiswahili: Tangu 2019, KCC imekuwa ikitoa usaidizi wa pesa kwa wakati unaofaa kwa jamii kote nchini Kenya.
Somali: Tan iyo 2019, KCC waxay si joogto ah u bixinaysay gargaar lacageed oo waqtigeeda ku habboon oo nafta lagu badbaadinayo bulshooyinka ku nool Kenya oo dhan.
Dholuo: Chakre higa mar 2019, KCC osebedo ka chiwo kony mar omwom e kinde mowinjore kendo ma nyalo reso ngima ne oganda ma ni e piny Kenya duto.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will be held in Laikipia County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo bilaash ah oo ay qabanqaabisay qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada ayaa lagu qaban doonaa gobolka Laikipia bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma biro bedo e dwe mar Novemba ma biro e County mar Laikipia.

English: State Department for TVET encourages residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo ong'e weche ma giduto giduto giseyudogo mondo ging'e kaka ji duto biro tiyo gi pesa mag county.

English: Notice: NCPB will distribute certified sorghum seed to farmers in Mombasa County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Februari hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: NCPB waxay abuurka sorghum-ka ee shahaadada leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda gobolka Mombasa bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Rapar: NCPB biro pogo kodhi mag sorghum ne jopur e County mar Mombasa e dwe mar Februar.

English: NCTC and OAB (IOM-Japan) coordinated a community policing initiative in Lamu to strengthen early-warning and reporting systems.
Kiswahili: NCTC na OAB (IOM-Japan) walihariri mpango wa polisi wa jamii huko Lamu ili kuimarisha mifumo ya onyo la mapema na kuripoti.
Somali: NCTC iyo OAB (IOM-Japan) waxay isku xidhay dadaal ay ku sameeyeen ciidamada booliska bulshada ee Lamu si loo xoojiyo nidaamyada digniinta iyo warbixinta hore.
Dholuo: NCTC kod OAB (IOM-Japan) ne oriwo lwedo chenro mar polise e alwora mar Lamu mondo gijiw chenro mag chiwo siem chon kod chiwo ripot.

English: NDMA alerts residents of Garissa County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inaamsha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay shilalka waddooyinka ee gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chako tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony e masiche mag ndara e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) launches a June awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Juni juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa bilaabay olole wacyi galineed bishii Juun oo ku saabsan baaritaanka sonkorowga ee degmada Kiambu.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Jun e wi nonro mar thieth mar sukari e County duto mar Kiambu.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will train farmers in Murang'a County on soil conservation this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Murang'a juu ya uhifadhi wa udongo Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) ayaa tababar siin doonta beeraleyda degmada Murang'a ee ku saabsan ilaalinta ciidda bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro tiego jopur e County mar Murang'a e weche mag rito lowo e dwe mar Februar.

English: Samburu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Samburu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2022
Somali: Degmada Samburu: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Samburu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2022

English: Triggers for the nine arid counties were activated based on the standardized precipitation index and vegetation condition index, enabling counties and organizations to commence anticipatory actions.
Kiswahili: Vichochezi vya kaunti tisa zenye ukame viliamilishwa kwa kuzingatia faharasa sanifu ya kunyesha na hali ya uoto, kuwezesha kaunti na mashirika kuanza vitendo vya kutarajia.
Somali: Waxyaabaha kiciya sagaalka degmo ee abaarta ah ayaa la hawlgeliyay iyadoo lagu saleynayo tusmada roobabka caadiga ah iyo tusmada xaaladda dhirta, taasoo u suurtagelisay degmooyinka iyo ururada inay bilaabaan tallaabooyin saadaalin ah.
Dholuo: Gik ma ne omiyo ng’ato otho e kaunti 9 ma ne opong’ gi pi ne otimre kaluwore gi kwan mar koth ma ne chwee kod kwan mar yien ma ne odongo, ma ne omiyo kaunti kod riwruoge ochako timo gik ma ne gigeno.

English: Notice: KTDA will distribute certified maize seed to farmers in Tana River County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itasambaza mbegu za mahindi zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay abuurka hadhuudhka ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Tana River bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA biro pogo kodhi mag kodhi ne jopur man Tana River County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Makueni County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lugta lagu maro inta lagu jiro xilliyada dabka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne jogweng' Makueni County ni mondo giluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe e ndalo mag yiengni.

English: IGAD Promotes Country-level Actions in Nutrition Surveillance
Kiswahili: IGAD Inakuza Vitendo vya Kiwango cha Nchi katika Ufuatiliaji wa Lishe
Somali: IGAD oo kor u qaadaysa tallaabooyinka heer qaran ee la socodka nafaqada
Dholuo: IGAD Kelo Tije mag Piny e Rang’o mar Chiemo

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development invites farmers in Turkana County to a free training on pest and disease management this November.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Turkana kupata mafunzo ya bure juu ya udhibiti wa wadudu na magonjwa Novemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Turkana tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada bisha November.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ogwelo jopur e county mar Turkana e tiegruok ma onge chudo kod tuoche e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of Vihiga County to prepare for possible flooding this March.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa mafuriko Machi hii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay isu diyaariyaan fatahaadaha iman kara bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross osiemo jogweng' mar County mar Vihiga mondo oikre ne ataro manyalo timore e dwe mar Mach.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Siaya County that access to eye and dental camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za macho na meno sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya dadweynaha degmada Siaya in helitaanka xeryaha indhaha iyo ilkaha ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumo la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji duto e county mar Siaya ni koro ginyalo dhi e kambini mag thieth mar wang' kod lakteche mag laktech.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free depression awareness support is available through county health facilities in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa uhamasishaji wa unyogovu unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay wacyiga niyadjabku laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Laikipia County.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar parruok yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth man Laikipia County.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Machakos County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the January planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos kudhibiti wizi wa jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa za kuua wadudu zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Januari.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda Degmada Machakos inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka ciidanka dayrta iyagoo isticmaalaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beerashada ee Janaayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur e County ma Machakos ni mondo gikwed thuol mar piny ka gitiyo gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok kapok ochopo dwe mar Januar.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds the public in Tana River County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this July.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya Tana River kwamba ushiriki katika mashauriano ya sera za umma unakaribishwa Julai hii.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Tana River in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha July.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya oparo ne ji duto man Tana River County ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mag siasa e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will conduct a pest and disease management workshop for farmers in Marsabit County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itafanya warsha ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan xakamaynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada beeraleyda ee degmada Marsabit bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Dairy Board biro timo chokruok mar rieyo tuoche kod tuoche ne jopur e Marsabit County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: DPP urges the public in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: DPP inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu.
Somali: DPP waxay ugu baaqeysaa shacabka degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada iyada oo loo marayo kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada lacagta mobilada.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo ji duto e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo ong'e kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma osefweny kuom wuond mag pesa mitimo gi simo.

English: DCI reminds the public in Kakamega County to remain vigilant on counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: DCI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kakamega in ay sii joogaan feejignaanta ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: DCI parone ji duto e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni gibed motang' ne weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Kilifi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kilifi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2023
Somali: Degmada Kilifi: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kilifi: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Septemba 2023

English: NTSA warns residents of Kilifi County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi kuhusu kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa pesa za simu na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: NTSA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi kororka khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax falin.
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kilifi County e wi medruok mar timbe mag wuondo pesa mag simo kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: EACC advises residents of Kisumu County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: EACC inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: EACC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay qaataan dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado dib u dhac marka la raadinayo adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: EACC nyiso jogweng'o mag Kisumu County mondo oting'e buge duto madwarore mondo kik gideki sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport.

English: Notice: ODPP will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ee Gobolka Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: ODPP biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag siasa e County mar Kirinyaga.

English: Notice: HELB opens applications for textbooks and learning materials for learners in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB inafungua maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay ardayda degmada Migori u fureysaa codsiyada buugaagta waxbarasho iyo qalabka wax lagu barto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: HELB chako tiyo gi buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok ne jopuonjre manie kaunti mar Migori.

English: Teachers Service Commission encourages residents of Bomet County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya ugatuzi.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay ka qeybgalaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jogweng' County mar Bomet mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi kaka ibiro chiwgi.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) warns public officers in Laikipia County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia dhidi ya kupotosha fedha za umma.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Laikipia inay ka xishoodaan dhaqaalaha dawladda.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Laikipia ni kik giti gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo e yo marach.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges residents of Vihiga County to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility following a rise in reported cholera cases.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya kipindupindu.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow kadib kororka kiisaska cudurka kolera ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo jogweng' County mar Vihiga mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni nikech kwan mar joma nigi cholera osemedore.

English: Ministry of Health urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Busia County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Busia kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Busia inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e County mar Busia mondo odhi ir japuonj molony.

English: AFA urges cattle farmers in Kwale County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: AFA inawataka wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda xoolaha ee Gobolka Kwale inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha gobolka iyada oo aan la helin ruqsad ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee anthrax.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur mag jamni e county mar Kwale mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni kuonde mopogore opogore maok giyudo rusa bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag anthrax.

English: Notice: IPOA opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Narok County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafungua ofisi ya kijinsia inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Ogaysiis: IPOA waxay furaysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya daryeel caafimaad ka dib rabshadaha gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony e weche thieth bang' timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Narok.

English: Kwale County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kwale: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2024
Somali: Degmada Kwale: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kwale: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2024

English: Kenya Dairy Board encourages farmers in Nandi County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for milk.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya maziwa.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda degmada Nandi inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan caanaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur e county mar Nandi mondo ous chiembgi mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo chak mondo omi gibed gi nengo maber mar chak.

English: Huduma Kenya advises residents of Kwale County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay qaataan dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado dib u dhac marka la raadinayo shahaadada dhalashada.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya nyiso jogweng' mar Kwale County mondo oting'e buge duto madwarore mondo kik gideki sama gidwaro yudo barua mar nyuol.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages residents of Nyandarua County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya waxayna ku dhiirigelinayaan saaxiibka dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit jiwo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo kik gisandre gi muol kendo mondo gijiw osiepgi ma chandore omany kony.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages mothers in Taita-Taveta County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo mine manie Taita-Taveta County mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Notice: DPP activates an emergency response plan for fire outbreaks in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DPP inaamsha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa milipuko ya moto katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ku saabsan dabka ka kacay Gobolka Bungoma.
Dholuo: Rapar: DPP tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne masiche mag mach e County mar Bungoma.

English: NDMA urges motorists and pedestrians in Machakos County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Machakos kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa darawalada gawaarida iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Machakos inay guryahooda rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa dhacdooyinka abaarta la xiriira.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo derebe kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Machakos mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo giti matek mondo gikwed masiche mag oro.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Nakuru County about the importance of hand hygiene for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhusu umuhimu wa usafi wa mikono kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay dadka degmada Nakuru ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda nadaafadda gacmaha ay u leedahay caafimaadka qoyska.

Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa ku wargeliyay beeraleyda alaabada beeraha ee degmada Meru fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Oktoobar.

Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: e-Citizen biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e county mar Kisii.

Kiswahili: KICD inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Januari hii.

Dholuo: KICD gwelo rowere e County mar Laikipia mondo odonj e tiegruok mar keto sitima e dwe mar Januar.

English: KEMSA appeals to caregivers in Taita-Taveta County to visit their nearest maternity wing as part of the June maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Juni.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Taita-Taveta inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada bisha Juun.
Dholuo: KEMSA ogwelo jorit e Taita-Taveta County mondo odhi olimgi machiegni gi kama gibiro yudoe nyithindo e dwe mar Jun.

English: The government is constructing the Mwache Dam to provide water for irrigation benefiting 1 6 million people in Kwale and Mombasa Counties Completion is expected by August 2026
Kiswahili: Serikali inajenga Bwawa la Mwache ili kutoa maji kwa ajili ya umwagiliaji kunufaisha watu milioni 1 6 katika Kaunti za Kwale na Mombasa Kukamilika kunatarajiwa kufikia Agosti 2026.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay dhisaysaa biyo-xireenka Mwache si ay biyo ugu hesho waraabka, taasoo faa'iido u leh 16 milyan oo qof oo ku nool degmooyinka Kwale iyo Mombasa. Waxaa la filayaa in la dhameystiro bisha August 2026

English: The government has implemented reforms in the tea sub sector to support smallholder tea growers facing declining earnings stay informed about new policies and pricing updates
Kiswahili: Serikali imetekeleza mageuzi katika sekta ndogo ya chai ili kusaidia wakulima wadogo wa chai wanaokabiliwa na kupungua kwa mapato endelea kufahamishwa kuhusu sera mpya na masasisho ya bei.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay hirgelisay dib-u-habeyn ku saabsan qaybta shaaha si ay u taageerto beeraleyda yaryar ee shaaha ee la kulmaya hoos u dhaca dakhliga, la soco siyaasadaha cusub iyo cusbooneysiinta qiimaha
Dholuo: Sirkal osetiyo gi lokruok e migawono mar chai mondo okony jogedo matindo ma loso chai ma yudo yuto matin.

Kiswahili: Kuzungumza na kumwimbia mtoto wako mara kwa mara huimarisha ukuaji wa ubongo wake na ujuzi wake wa lugha ya awali.

Dholuo: Wuoyo gi nyathini kendo wer kode kinde ka kinde miyo obwongo nyathino medo dongo kendo miyo olony e wacho dhok manyien.

Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi yazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Embu.

Dholuo: Riwruok mar State Department for Basic Education chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe mahundu e skunde duto mag Embu County.

English: State Department for Basic Education reminds parents in Murang'a County that school feeding programme registration is open this May.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba usajili wa mpango wa kulisha shule umefunguliwa Mei hii.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kajiado County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kajiado County mwezi huu Oktoba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee Gobolka Kajiado bisha Oktoobar.

Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.

Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit nyiso jogweng'o mag Machakos County mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Farmers in Kenya are urged to adopt good agricultural practices to ensure safe food production Stay informed on best practices and standards to boost market competitiveness
Kiswahili: Wakulima nchini Kenya wamehimizwa kufuata kanuni bora za kilimo ili kuhakikisha uzalishaji salama wa chakula Endelea kufahamishwa kuhusu kanuni na taratibu bora ili kuongeza ushindani wa soko.

Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur e Kenya mondo oti gi timbe mabeyo mag pur mondo omi gibed gi chiemo ma nigi ritruok.

Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada ayaa ku boorinaya darawalada gaadiidka iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Nakuru inay u hoggaansamaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay adeegsadaan meelaha loo qoondeeyay dadka socodka ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira dhulgariirka.

Kiswahili: Wanawake na wasichana wanaokimbia ukame wa Somalia wanakabiliwa na unyanyasaji wa kijinsia katika kambi za wakimbizi za Daadab

Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka HIV / AIDS ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Nandi bishii Abriil.

Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inafungua maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.

Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Nandi kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.

Dholuo: Kenya Gazette paronwa jotelo e county mar Nandi mondo oting'e ID mar piny kata passport e odiechieng' mar yiero kapok kinde mag yiero ochopo.

Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya imeshirikiana na Pula Advisors kutoa mpango wa kibunifu wa bima unaolenga kuinua hali ya hewa kwa wakulima wadogo.
Somali: Dowladda Kenya ayaa iskaashi la sameysay Pula Advisors si ay u bixiso barnaamij caymis oo hal abuur leh oo loogu talagalay kor u qaadista adkeysiga cimilada ee beeraleyda yaryar
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya oseriwore gi Pula Advisors e chiwo chenro mar insuarans ma nigi lony mar medo geng'o chwanyruok mar kor lwasi ne jopur matindo

Kiswahili: Ilani: NPS inazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Mei hii.

Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NPS chako kampen mar geng'o mibadhi e county mar Uasin Gishu e dwe mar Mei.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Kiambu County this July.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Julai hii.

English: Kenya Red Cross advises residents of Tana River County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Laanta Cas ee Kenya waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun iyo biyo nadiif ah si joogto ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.

Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.

Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Marsabit: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Januari 2023

Kiswahili: AFA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.

Dholuo: AFA nyiso jopur e gweng' mar Kitui mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: The Ministry of Education increased funding for TVET institutions to support 2 million youth enrollments by the end of 2025.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu imeongeza fedha kwa taasisi za Elimu ya Televisheni kusaidia uandikishaji wa vijana milioni 2 ifikapo mwisho wa 2025.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa kordhisay maalgelinta hay'adaha TVET si ay u taageerto 2 milyan oo dhalinyaro ah oo diiwaangashan dhamaadka 2025.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Puonjruok ne omedo chiwo pesa ne riwruoge mag TVET mondo okony rowere ma dirom milion 2 kochopo giko higa mar 2025.
