Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda Jehova mar piny Kenya biro timo chenro mondo omed loso chak ma dirom lita bilion 10 kod chiemo ma biro miyo ngima odhi maber.

English: Sweet drinks icluding sodas are harmful to children, increases body weight and teeth decay
Kiswahili: Vinywaji vitamu kutia ndani soda ni hatari kwa watoto, huongeza uzito wa mwili na kusababisha kuoza kwa meno
Somali: Cabitaannada macaan oo ay ku jiraan cabitaannada qabow waxay waxyeeleeyaan carruurta, waxay kordhiyaan miisaanka jirka iyo ilkaha
Dholuo: Madho kong'o mamit moriwo pi mang'we ng'ar ok kel nyithindo hinyruok, omiyo ng'ato bedo gi pek mang'eny, kendo mano miyo lak bedo marach

English: KEPHIS reminds farmers in Busia County of the ongoing greenhouse farming training programme.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kilimo cha chafu.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Busia barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo.
Dholuo: KEPHIS parone jopur e county mar Busia chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime e weche mag pidho cham.

English: Notice: Universities Fund launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij lagu darayo ardayda naafada ah iskuulada guud ahaan gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: University Fund chako chenro mar keto japuonjre ma nigi midekre e skunde duto mag Homa Bay County.

English: IEBC updates residents of Vihiga County on progress of county development projects this October.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga juu ya maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo katika kaunti hii Oktoba.
Somali: IEBC waxay dadka deggan degmada Vihiga ku wargelineysaa horumarka mashaariicda horumarinta degmada bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: IEBC chiwo ripot ne jogweng' mar County mar Vihiga e wi dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mar county e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: DCI urges residents of Siaya County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: DCI inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay soo sheegaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo la sii xoojinayo amniga xuduudda.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo jogweng' County mar Siaya mondo onyis riwruok mag sirkal ma nono gik ma timore e alwora mar tong'gi e kinde ma sirkal medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom weche sirkal.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds residents of Nakuru County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Nakuru in warbixinta degdegga ah ee xoolaha lagu xado ay gacan ka geysaneyso in xaafadaha la ilaaliyo.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne jogweng' Nakuru County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo jamni konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Government annmounncing a National Nutrition Symposium to share strategies on universal health care (UHC) and community nutrition.
Kiswahili: Serikali yatangaza Kongamano la Kitaifa la Lishe ili kushiriki mikakati kuhusu huduma ya afya kwa wote (UHC) na lishe ya jamii.
Somali: Xukuumadda ayaa ku dhawaaqday in lagu qaban doono Shirweyne Qaran oo ku saabsan nafaqada si loo wadaago istaraatijiyadaha daryeelka caafimaadka ee caalamiga ah (UHC) iyo nafaqada bulshada.
Dholuo: Sirkal ogolo chokruok mar National Nutrition Symposium mar pogo yore mag thieth e piny mangima (UHC) kod chiemb chuny mar oganda.

English: Notice: NTSA issues a cybersecurity alert on mobile money scams affecting residents of Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya kashfa za pesa za rununu zinazoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khayaanada lacagta mobile ee saameeya dadka deggan gobolka Mombasa.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NTSA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity kuom timbe mag wuond mag pesa mitimo e simo ma mulo joma odak e county mar Mombasa.

English: In the past year, WHO has supported 14 of the 47 counties in Kenya to develop a pool of facility-based mentors of emergency obstetric and newborn care, helping ensure that more women can access skilled care during pregnancy and childbirth, even in the most hard-to-reach areas.
Kiswahili: Katika mwaka uliopita, WHO imesaidia kaunti 14 kati ya 47 nchini Kenya kuendeleza kundi la washauri wa dharura wa uzazi na watoto wanaozaliwa, na kusaidia kuhakikisha kwamba wanawake wengi zaidi wanaweza kupata huduma za ujuzi wakati wa ujauzito na kujifungua, hata katika maeneo magumu kufikiwa.
Somali: Sannadkii la soo dhaafay, WHO waxay taageertay 14 ka mid ah 47-ka degmo ee Kenya si ay u horumariyaan la-taliyayaal ku salaysan xarumaha daryeelka degdegga ah ee dhalmada iyo dhallaanka, taasoo gacan ka geysatay hubinta in haween badan ay heli karaan daryeel xirfad leh inta lagu jiro uurka iyo dhalmada, xitaa meelaha ugu adag in la gaaro.
Dholuo: E higa mokalo, WHO osekonyo gwenge 14 kuom gwenge 47 mag piny Kenya mondo olos riwruok mar jopuonj ma tiyo e kar thieth mag thieth mapiyo mar nyuol kod nyithindo ma pok onyuol, ma konyo neno ni mon mang’eny nyalo yudo thieth ma nigi lony e kinde ma gin gi ich kod nyuol, kata mana kuonde ma tek ahinya chopo.

English: Notification that Makueni county has been recognised  for efficient implementation of National Nutrition plan matched with national health priorities, with stunting reduced to 20%.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwamba Kaunti ya Makueni imetambuliwa kwa utekelezaji mzuri wa Mpango wa Kitaifa wa Chakula unaolingana na vipaumbele vya afya vya kitaifa, na upungufu wa kupunguza hadi 20%.
Somali: Ogeysiiska in degmada Makueni loo aqoonsaday hirgelinta hufan ee qorshaha nafaqada qaranka oo la jaan qaadaya mudnaanta caafimaadka qaranka, iyadoo dib u dhac lagu yareeyay 20%.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar alwora mar Makueni oseng'ere kuom tiyo gi chenro mar National Nutrition plan e yo mong'ith kaluwore gi dwaro mag thieth e piny mangima, kendo kwan mar ji modok chien osedok chien nyaka 20%.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds needy students in Homa Bay County that revision guides applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka ayaa xasuusinaya ardayda u baahan Gobolka Homa Bay in dib u eegista ay ku hagaajineyso codsiyada la soo gabagabeynayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e Homa Bay County ni lokruok ma ne otimno ne dhi konyo e tieko kwayo mag kwayo.

English: TSC reminds youth in Migori County that HELB funding is available for ICT skills training.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Migori kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT.
Somali: TSC waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Migori in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka xirfadaha ICT.
Dholuo: TSC parone rowere mag Migori County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar lony e yore mag ICT.

English: CDC urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Siaya County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: CDC inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Siaya kumtia moyo rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: CDC waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Siaya inuu dhiirrigeliyo saaxiibkiisa dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nyagore gi tuoche mag obwongo e county mar Siaya mondo ojiw osiepne moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: State Department for TVET advises students in Kirinyaga County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ardayda degmada Kirinyaga kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dijitaalka ah.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo jopuonjre e County mar Kirinyaga mondo okonygi kokalo kuom websait mar somo e yor intanet mondo giyud thuolo mar tiyo gi kompyuta mag skul e bwo chenro mar somo kod somo mar digital literacy.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free cholera screening is available at all public health centres in Kirinyaga County this May.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kipindupindu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Mei hii.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka fayraska ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Kirinyaga bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji ni nono tuo mar cholera onge chudo e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Kirinyaga e dwe mar Mei.

English: KEPHIS informs horticultural produce farmers in Kirinyaga County of new market linkage opportunities this September.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawafahamisha wakulima wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Septemba hii.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda wax soo saarka beeraha ee Gobolka Kirinyaga fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KEPHIS nyiso jopur ma loso puothe mag puothe e gweng' mar Kirinyaga e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone experiencing abuse in Garissa County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Garissa apigie simu ya simu ya GBV 1195.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Garissa inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo chandruok e gweng' mar Garissa County mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kushughulikia vyeti vya kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la hagaajiyay waqtiga wareejinta shahaadada dhalashada ee degmada Meru.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) olando lokruok e kinde mag timo nonro mar nyasi mar nyuol e county mar Meru.

English: DCI reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Bomet County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba upatikanaji wa maelekezo ya makazi salama unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan degmada Bomet in helitaanka tixraacyada hoyga ammaanka ah ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: DCI parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag nindruok e County mar Bomet ni ginyalo yudo kuonde dak maonge chudo.

English: Council of Governors encourages first-time voters in Mandera County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku dhiirigelinayaan codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Mandera inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo joma okwongo yiero e kaunti mar Mandera mondo onon weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: KICD announces distribution of school laptops under the digital literacy programme to schools in Nairobi County this November.
Kiswahili: KICD yatangaza usambazaji wa kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa shule za Kaunti ya Nairobi Novemba hii.
Somali: KICD waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Nairobi bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: KICD olando ni ibiro pog laptop mag skul e bwo program mar digital literacy e skunde man Nairobi County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: New mothers experiencing sadness, withdrawal, or hopelessness should seek mental health support. Postpartum depression is treatable.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wapya wanaopitia huzuni, kujitenga, au kukata tamaa wanapaswa kutafuta msaada wa afya ya akili. Mfadhaiko baada ya kujifungua unaweza kutibiwa.
Somali: Hooyooyinka cusub ee caloolxumo la kulma, oo ka baxsan, ama rajo la'aan ah waxay u baahan yihiin inay raadsadaan taageero caafimaad maskaxeed.
Dholuo: Min nyithindo mapok onyuol, ma chunygi onyosore, kata ma chunygi ool, onego omany kony mar rito pachgi.

English: OGP warns public officers in Tharaka-Nithi County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: OGP anaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: OGP waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay laaluush ka qaadaan xafiisyada dawladda.
Dholuo: OGP osiemo jotelo mag sirkal e Tharaka-Nithi County kuom kawo asoya e migepe mar sirkal.

English: KMTC advises students in West Pokot County to register early to secure allocation to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata maudhui ya ujifunzaji wa kidijitali bila malipo.
Somali: KMTC waxay ardayda ku nool degmada West Pokot kula talineysaa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan waqti hore si ay u helaan lacag la'aan ah oo waxbarasho digital ah.
Dholuo: KMTC jiwo jopuonjre e West Pokot County mondo odonj e tiegruok chon mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo somo mar digital maonge chudo.

English: Structural barriers further constrain access to work.
Kiswahili: Vizuizi vya kimuundo vinazuia zaidi ufikiaji wa kazi.
Somali: Caqabadaha qaab-dhismeedka ayaa sii adkeynaya helitaanka shaqada.
Dholuo: Obadho mag gedo medo geng’o yudo tich.

English: Huduma Kenya advises residents of Uasin Gishu County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya nyiso jogweng' Uasin Gishu County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro kwayo mag ID.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unafungua dawati la jinsia kutoa simu ya msaada ya GBV bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa furaya xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ee Gobolka Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Directorate of Criminal Investigations ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo chenro mar tiyo gi simo maonge chudo mar GBV e County ma Kirinyaga.

English: Kenya Food Security Outlook Update December 2022
Kiswahili: Mtazamo wa Usalama wa Chakula wa Kenya Usasishaji Desemba 2022
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta Aragtida Sugnaanta Cuntada Kenya Diseembar 2022
Dholuo: Neno mar Rieko mar Chiemo e Kenya dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2022

English: Packaging protects your produce and adds value Discover suitable packaging materials and methods for selling in local markets
Kiswahili: Ufungashaji hulinda mazao yako na huongeza thamani Gundua vifaa na mbinu zinazofaa za ufungashaji kwa ajili ya kuuza katika masoko ya ndani
Somali: Baakadaha waxay ilaalisaa wax soo saarkaaga waxayna kordhisaa qiimaha Soo hel agabka baakadaha iyo hababka ku habboon ee lagu iibiyo suuqyada maxalliga ah
Dholuo: Weche moting'o gik moko rito chiembgi kendo medo nengo ma gin-go.

English: Demand accountability! Ensure school funds are used wisely.
Kiswahili: Dai uwajibikaji! Hakikisha fedha za shule zinatumika kwa busara.
Somali: Ka codso xisaabtanka! Hubi in lacagaha dugsiga si caqli leh loo isticmaalo.
Dholuo: Keturu ting' mar chiwo paro, kendo timuru duto ma unyalo mondo uti gi pesago e yo mariek.

English: DPP urges residents of Machakos County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa umakini mkubwa wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda lagu saarayo nabadgelyada qaranka.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo jogweng'o mag Machakos County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi kuom loso kuwe.

English: Ministry of Health appeals to caregivers in Kiambu County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the February maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Februari.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Kiambu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha oo qayb ka ah ololaha caafimaadka hooyooyinka ee Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health okwayo jorit e County mar Kiambu mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi e dwe mar Februar.

English: Kitui County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kitui: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Mei 2024
Somali: Degmada Kitui: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kitui: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar abich 2024

English: Gov't extends nationwide curfew, ban on public gatherings until May 29
Kiswahili: Serikali yaongeza muda wa kutotoka nje nchini kote, kupiga marufuku mikusanyiko ya umma hadi Mei 29
Somali: Dowladdu waxay kordhisay bandowga dalka oo dhan, mamnuucidda isu imaatinka dadweynaha ilaa 29-ka May
Dholuo: Sirkal omedo kafiu e piny mangima, ogeng'o chokruok mag oganda nyaka tarik 29 dwe mar abich

English: Eastern Africa: El NiÃ±o Floods Impact Snapshot (May 2024)
Kiswahili: Afrika Mashariki: Picha ya Athari ya Mafuriko ya El NiÃ±o (Mei 2024)
Somali: Bariga Afrika: Sawir-qaadis Saamaynta Daadadka El Nió (May 2024)
Dholuo: Afrika ma Wuokchieng': Picha mar Pich mag El Nio (Mei 2024)

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMSA will be held in Kakamega County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMSA itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay KEMSA ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Gobolka Kakamega bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma KEMSA ochano biro timore e taon mar Kakamega e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Linking directly with food processors can offer stable markets. Learn how to meet processor requirements for meat.
Kiswahili: Kuunganisha moja kwa moja na wasindikaji wa chakula kunaweza kutoa masoko thabiti. Jifunze jinsi ya kukidhi mahitaji ya wasindikaji wa nyama.
Somali: Isku xirnaanta tooska ah ee shirkadaha wax soo saarka cuntada waxay bixin kartaa suuqyo xasilloon. Baro sida loo buuxiyo shuruudaha processing ee hilibka.
Dholuo: Puonjruok tudruok achiel kachiel gi masinde mag loso chiemo nyalo miyo ji obed gi ohala mosiko. Puonjri kaka inyalo chopo dwaro mag masinde ma loso ring'o.

English: TVETA upgrades the national online learning platform for TVET to include virtual labs and interactive assessments.
Kiswahili: TVETA inaboresha jukwaa la kitaifa la kujifunza mtandaoni kwa ajili ya TVET ili kujumuisha maabara virtual na tathmini za maingiliano.
Somali: TVETA waxay cusbooneysiineysaa barnaamijka barashada internetka ee TVET si ay ugu darto shaybaarro dalwad ah iyo qiimeyn isdhexgal ah.
Dholuo: TVETA medo timo dongruok e chenro mar tiegruok e yor intanet mar TVET mondo oriw laboratori mag virtual kod nonro mag tudruok.

English: Multi-sectoral cash transfer as a tool for empowerment and assistance to flood-affected communities in Mandera County
Kiswahili: Uhamisho wa pesa wa sekta nyingi kama zana ya kuwezesha na usaidizi kwa jamii zilizoathiriwa na mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Mandera
Somali: Lacag-wareejin dhinacyo badan leh oo loogu talagalay awood-siinta iyo caawinta bulshooyinka ay fatahaaduhu saameeyeen ee Degmada Mandheera
Dholuo: Ooro pesa e sekta mathoth kaka yo mar chiwo teko kod konyo jodak ma oyudo masira mag pi mang'eny e gweng' mar Mandera

English: This book targets economy and best strategies to safeguard climate smart agriculture (CSA) is possible and challenges associated with it's...
Kiswahili: Kitabu hiki kinalenga uchumi na mikakati bora ya kulinda kilimo mahiri cha hali ya hewa (CSA) inawezekana na changamoto zinazohusiana na...
Somali: Buugani wuxuu bartilmaameedsadaa dhaqaalaha iyo istaraatiijiyadaha ugu wanaagsan ee lagu badbaadinayo beeraha cimilada ee caqli-galka ah (CSA) waa suurtagal iyo caqabadaha la xiriira...
Dholuo: Bugni wuoyo kuom weche mag ohala kod yore mabeyo mag rito kit ohala mar timo ohala mariek e bwo chal mar kor lwasi (CSA) kendo pek ma nyalo bedoe nikech...

English: Notice: IEBC opens polling procedures centres in Mombasa County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa xarumaha nidaamyada codbixinta ee gobolka Mombasa bisha July.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IEBC chako tiyo gi kuonde ma itimoe yiero e County mar Mombasa e dwe mar Julai.

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief, December 2024
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP Kenya, Desemba 2024
Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya, Diseembar 2024
Dholuo: Wach machiek mar piny Kenya mar WFP, dwe mar apar gi ariyo 2024

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds expectant mothers in Mombasa County that access to postnatal check-ups is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba upatikanaji wa uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Mombasa in helitaanka baaritaannada dhalashada ka dib ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche paro ne mine ma biro bedo gi ich e county mar Mombasa ni thuolo mar dhi e nonro bang' nyuol en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag sirkal.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) advises residents of Garissa County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Garissa inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun iyo biyo nadiif ah si joogto ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Garissa mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: NTSA calls on residents of Bomet County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kusaidia tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: NTSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan kahortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: NTSA okwayo jogweng' kaunti mar Bomet mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde mitimoe chokruoge mag ji duto mondo okony e kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: IEBC reminds schools in Nyandarua County to strengthen child protection in schools this April.
Kiswahili: IEBC inazikumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuimarisha ulinzi wa watoto shuleni Aprili hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay xusuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Nyandarua inay xoojiyaan ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: IEBC parone skunde man Nyandarua County mondo omed jiwo rit mar nyithindo e skunde e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: KEMRI confirms a typhoid outbreak alert for Turkana County. Residents are advised to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa typhoid kwa Kaunti ya Turkana. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ku saabsan cudurka tifooska ee degmada Turkana. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMRI osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuwo mar typhoid e County mar Turkana. Ojiw ji mondo otim nonro mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni kodgi.

English: Sports and exercise offer a multifaceted approach to preventing substance use during school breaks. They provide structure, boost mental health, foster social connections and help students build healthy habits that protect against risky behaviors
Kiswahili: Michezo na mazoezi hutoa mbinu mbalimbali za kuzuia matumizi ya dawa za kulevya wakati wa mapumziko ya shule. Hutoa muundo, huimarisha afya ya akili, hukuza miunganisho ya kijamii na huwasaidia wanafunzi kujenga tabia zenye afya zinazowalinda dhidi ya tabia hatarishi.
Somali: Ciyaaraha iyo jimicsiga waxay bixiyaan hab dhinacyo badan leh oo looga hortago isticmaalka maadooyinka inta lagu jiro fasaxyada dugsiga. Waxay bixiyaan qaab dhismeedka, kor u qaadaan caafimaadka maskaxda, kobciyaan xiriirka bulshada waxayna ka caawiyaan ardayda inay abuuraan caadooyin caafimaad oo ka ilaalinaya dabeecadaha halista ah
Dholuo: Timbe mag tuke kod tuke mag nindruok konyo ahinya e geng'o tiyo gi yedhe mamero e kinde mag yueyo e skul.

English: NCPB reminds farmers in Kwale County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Somali: NCPB waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kwale barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada.
Dholuo: NCPB oparo ne jopur e county mar Kwale chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche.

English: Council of Governors reminds voters in Marsabit County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa xasuusinaya codbixiyayaasha degmada Marsabit in ay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor inta aan la helin nidaamyada doorashada.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch parone jogweng' mar Marsabit mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar timo yiero kapok itimo yiero.

English: Universities Fund invites youth in Garissa County to enroll for ICT skills training this February.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Garissa kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT Februari hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku casuumay dhalinyarada degmada Garissa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka xirfadaha ICT bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund gwelo rowere e County mar Garissa mondo odonj e tiegruok mar ICT e dwe mar Februar.

English: IEBC encourages out-of-school children in Garissa County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Garissa kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee Gobolka Garissa inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee waxbarashada dhexe ee maalinlaha ah ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e gweng' mar Garissa mondo odonj e program mar puonjo joma dongo somo mar sekondari.

English: The government plans to roll out more digital learning devices to primary schools to enhance technology integration.
Kiswahili: Serikali ina mpango wa kuzindua vifaa zaidi vya kujifunza digital kwa shule za msingi ili kuongeza ujumuishaji wa teknolojia.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay qorsheyneysaa in ay qalab waxbarasho oo dijitaal ah u fidiso dugsiyada hoose si loo xoojiyo isdhexgalka tikniyoolajiyadda.
Dholuo: Sirkal nigi chenro mar tiyo gi masinde mang'eny mag somo mag digital e skunde matindo mondo okony e medo tudruok gi teknoloji.

English: EACC ran a 40â€‘day public ethics education campaign.
Kiswahili: EACC iliendesha kampeni ya elimu ya maadili ya umma ya siku 40.
Somali: EACC waxay qabatay olole waxbarasho oo 40 maalmood ah oo ku saabsan anshaxa dadweynaha.
Dholuo: EACC notimo kampen mar puonjo ji e wi tim makare kuom ndalo 40.

English: Young parents are in need of mental health support, food an mecal care. Communities have been adviced to reduce their fear and to stand in solidarity with their communities.
Kiswahili: Wazazi vijana wanahitaji msaada wa afya ya akili, chakula na utunzaji wa mwili.
Somali: Waalidiinta dhalinyarada ah waxay u baahan yihiin taageero caafimaad maskaxeed, cunto iyo daryeel caafimaad.
Dholuo: Jonyuol ma rowere dwaro kony kuom weche thieth mar pachgi, chiemo, koda ritruok mar dendgi.

Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij lagu darayo ardayda naafada ah dugsiyada degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj chako chenro mar keto japuonj ma nigi midekre e skunde duto mag Bungoma County.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to engage with the Agri Preneurs Extension Model as discussed in the recent consultative workshop
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kushirikiana na Agri Preneurs Extension Model kama ilivyojadiliwa katika warsha ya mashauriano ya hivi majuzi.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay ku hawlan yihiin qaabka ballaarinta Agri Preneurs sida lagu wada hadlay aqoon isweydaarsiga la-tashiga ee dhowaan dhacay

English: Pest Control Products Board urges poultry farmers in Kakamega County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported rabies cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawataka wafugaji wa kuku katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya kichaa cha mbwa vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda digaagga ee degmada Kakamega inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska xayawaannada ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska xanaaqa la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Bura matayo gik makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok jiwo jopur ma pidho dhok e gweng' mar Kakamega mondo ochiw ripot ne jamni matuwo man machiegni gi kama thieth mar le yudoree bang' yudo joma nigi tuwo mar rabies.

English: IEBC advises residents of Samburu County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: IEBC inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: IEBC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Samburu inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: IEBC nyiso ji modak e county mar Samburu mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro kwayo mar bedo gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMRI will be held in Nandi County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMRI itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Nandi Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay KEMRI ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Nandi bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma KEMRI ochano biro timore e county mar Nandi e dwe mar Desemba.

English: KALRO informs avocado farmers in Laikipia County of new market linkage opportunities this October.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawafahamisha wakulima wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Oktoba hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda avocado ee degmada Laikipia fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KALRO nyiso jopur mag avocado e County mar Laikipia e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: DCI urges anyone experiencing abuse in Mandera County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: DCI inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Mandera piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Mandera inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: DCI ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e gweng' mar Mandera mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195 maonge chudo.

English: In fast changing world, science and technology are best catalysts especially in farming, it's said.
Kiswahili: Katika ulimwengu unaobadilika haraka, sayansi na teknolojia ni vichocheo bora hasa katika kilimo, kinasemekana.
Somali: Dunida si deg deg ah isbedelaysa, sayniska iyo tikniyoolajiyadu waa kuwa ugu wanaagsan ee kicinta gaar ahaan beeraha, sida la sheegay.
Dholuo: E piny ma sani lokore mapiyo, josayans gi teknoloji e gik makonyo ahinya e tij pur.

English: NCPB warns tea farmers in Homa Bay County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawaonya wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: NCPB waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee gobolka Homa Bay cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: NCPB chiwo siem ne jopur ma loso chai e Homa Bay County kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: NCPB urges farmers in Kwale County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kwale inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo lagu soo ururiyo biyaha beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e Kaunti mar Kwale mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok ma timore e kaka koth chue.

English: Kenya Red Cross advises residents of Kakamega County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Laanta Cas ee Kenya waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Kakamega County mondo odonj e riwruok mar insuarans mar thieth mondo giyud thieth makonyogi.

English: â€œPolitics is dynamicâ€ Boni Khalwale urges Senators to be objective when considering the IEBC amendment bill; so that they can create a roadmap that will be used to identify IEBC commissioners.
Kiswahili: Siasa ni yenye nguvu Boni Khalwale anawahimiza Seneta wawe waangalifu wakati wa kuzingatia muswada wa marekebisho ya IEBC; ili waweze kuunda ramani ya barabara ambayo itatumika kutambua wakimishna wa IebC.
Somali: "Siyaasadu waa mid firfircoon" Boni Khalwale wuxuu ku boorriyay Senator-ka inay noqdaan kuwo dhexdhexaad ah marka ay tixgelinayaan hindise-sharciyeedka wax-ka-beddelka IEBC; si ay u abuuraan khariidad khariidadeed oo loo isticmaali doono in lagu aqoonsado guddiyada IEBC.
Dholuo: â€œSiasa en gima nigi tekoâ€ Boni Khalwale okwayo jo-Senate mondo obed gi paro ma ok ng’iyo gimoro sama ginono chik mar loko chik mar IEBC; mondo gibed gi chenro mar yo ma biro tiyogo mar ng’eyo jotend IEBC.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission opens applications for revision guides for learners in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kitui.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka ayaa furaya codsiyada hagaha dib-u-eegista ardayda degmada Kitui.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj chako kwayo mondo jopuonjre ma Kitui County oyud weche ma gidwaro nono.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Murang'a County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah xilliyada fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogweng' mar County mar Murang'a mondo oluw chike mag golo ji moa e gweng'no.

English: Kwale County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kwale: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2023
Somali: Degmada Kwale: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kwale: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar apar 2023

English: Universities Fund urges youth in Garissa County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Garissa kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ugu baaqay dhalinyarada degmada Garissa inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo rowere e County mar Garissa mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gichako timo tije mag sirkal.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages mothers in Nyeri County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku dhiirigelisay hooyooyinka degmada Nyeri inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta caafimaad ee la qorsheeyay si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ojiwo mine e County mar Nyeri mondo odhi e klinik ma ne ochan mondo orit ngima nyithindgi.

English: USAID Announces Funding to Respond to Catastrophic Floods in Kenya
Kiswahili: USAID Yatangaza Ufadhili wa Kukabiliana na Maafa ya Mafuriko nchini Kenya
Somali: Hay'adda USAID oo ku dhawaaqday maalgelin lagu caawinayo daadadka ka dhashay fatahaadaha Kenya
Dholuo: USAID Olando Ni Obiro Chiwo Pesa Mar Tiyo gi Oganda Ma Opong’o Pi Ma Opong’o Piny Kenya

English: Universities Fund urges youth in Murang'a County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku boorinayaa dhalinyarada degmada Murang'a inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada rayidka ah ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada rayidnimada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo rowere e County mar Murang'a mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok gichako timo tije mag oganda.

English: Announced how youth-run school shops offer fortified porridge and snacks in partnership with health officials.
Kiswahili: Ilitangazwa jinsi maduka ya shule yanayoendeshwa na vijana yanavyotoa uji ulioongezewa virutubisho na vitafunio kwa ushirikiano na maafisa wa afya.
Somali: Waxaa la shaaciyay sida dukaamada iskuullada ee ay dhallinyaradu maamulaan ay u bixiyaan boorash iyo cunto fudud oo la xoojiyay iyadoo lala kaashanayo saraakiisha caafimaadka.
Dholuo: Ne olando kaka duka mag skul ma rowere tayo chiwo ngano moting'o teko kod chiemo mayom ka gitiyo kanyakla gi apisas mag thieth.

English: KEPHIS urges farmers in Trans Nzoia County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi weche mag pidho ji e yo mariek mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok e kaka koth chue.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa furaya xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya daryeel caafimaad ka dib rabshadaha degmada Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar weche motudore gi timbe mahundu chako tiyo gi ofis mar weche thieth e alwora mar Lamu County.

Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Migori kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.

Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.

English: Lamu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Lamu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2023

English: You can help prevent the spread of respiratory diseases like #COVID19 if you do the following. #StayHomeHero #KomeshaCorona

Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wafugaji wa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.

Dholuo: KALRO ojiwo jopur mag diek e County mar Vihiga mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni e tong county maok giyudo rusa bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag anthrax.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages residents of Homa Bay County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.

English: Kenya has confirmed high infection of Mpox virus, untill now, there are 137 confimed patients in Busia,Mombasa and Nakuru leading in the transmission rates
Kiswahili: Kenya imethibitisha maambukizi makubwa ya virusi vya Mpox, hadi sasa, kuna wagonjwa 137 waliothibitishwa kuwa na virusi hivyo huko Busia, Mombasa na Nakuru wanaoongoza kwa viwango vya maambukizi.
Somali: Kenya ayaa xaqiijisay cudurka Mpox oo aad u sarreeya, illaa iyo hadda, waxaa jira 137 bukaan oo la xakameeyay Busia, Mombasa iyo Nakuru oo hormuud ka ah heerarka gudbinta
Dholuo: Kenya oseyudo ni ji mang'eny nigi tuwo mar Mpox, to sani, nitie ji 137 ma nigi tuwo e Busia, Mombasa kod Nakuru.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds livestock keepers in Kisii County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.

English: ODPP reminds residents of Machakos County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.

Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhusu umuhimu wa udhibiti wa tumbaku kwa ustawi wa kaya.

English: Tharaka Nithi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for January 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Januari 2023

Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Embu juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za ulaghai na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.

English: Announcement to start a campaign "COMPLETE" aimed at reducing hunger among school children, ballanced farming
Kiswahili: Tangazo la kuanza kampeni "KAMILIZA" inayolenga kupunguza njaa kati ya watoto wa shule, kilimo cha usawa

Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itafanya warsha ya kisasa ya mbinu za umwagiliaji kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah ee beeraleyda Gobolka Kitui bisha Ogosto.

English: KTDA reminds residents of Kericho County that agroforestry improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba kilimo cha misitu kinaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.

English: We have no time to visit the hospital to get the COVID-19 vaccination." In a 10-day campaign targeting 11 of Kenya's 47 counties that had some of the lowest vaccination coverage, World Health Organization (WHO) along with the county governments, non-governmental organizations and other partners were determined that no one would be missed.
Kiswahili: Hatuna muda wa kutembelea hospitali ili kupata chanjo ya COVID-19." Katika kampeni ya siku 10 iliyolenga kaunti 11 kati ya 47 za Kenya ambazo zilikuwa na chanjo ya chini zaidi, Shirika la Afya Ulimwenguni (WHO) pamoja na serikali za kaunti, mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali na washirika wengine waliazimia kuwa hakuna mtu ambaye angekosa.
Somali: "Ma haysanno waqti aan ku booqanno isbitaalka si aan u helno tallaalka COVID-19." Olole 10 maalmood socday oo lagu bartilmaameedsanayay 11 ka mid ah 47-da degmo ee Kenya oo lahaa qaar ka mid ah kuwa ugu hooseeya ee tallaalka la bixiyo, Hay'adda Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO) oo ay weheliyaan dowladaha degmooyinka, ururada aan dowliga ahayn iyo la-hawlgalayaasha kale ayaa go'aansaday inaan cidna la waayi doonin.
Dholuo: Waonge gi thuolo mar dhi e osiptal mondo wayudi chanjo mar COVID-19." E kampen mar ndalo 10 ma ne ochung’ne gwenge 11 kuom gwenge 47 mag Kenya ma ne nigi moko kuom kwan mar chanjo ma pinyie moloyo, Riwruok mar Pinyruoth mar Thieth (WHO) kaachiel gi sirkande mag gwenge, riwruoge ma ok mag sirkal kod jowete mamoko ma ne dhi weyo.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Uasin Gishu County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.

Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne mine ma biro nyuolo e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni thuolo mar yudo nyithindo ma nigi lony en maonge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: Notice: e-Citizen opens voter registration centres in Taita-Taveta County this April.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inafungua vituo vya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta Aprili hii.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds the public in Mandera County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mkurugenzi Mkuu wa Ukaguzi hukumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na siri.

English: Teen mothers should be encouraged and supported to continue their education after childbirth.
Kiswahili: Akina mama vijana wanapaswa kutiwa moyo na kuungwa mkono ili kuendelea na masomo yao baada ya kujifungua.

Dholuo: KMTC oparo ne rowere man Kiambu County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko.

English: Notice from Division of Disease Surveillance and Response: free antenatal care clinics will run every July at designated health centres in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa: kliniki za bure za utunzaji wa ujauzito zitafanya kazi kila Julai katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka socda qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada: rugaha daryeelka dhalmada ee bilaashka ah waxaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Luulyo oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Kwale.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuwo: Klinike mag rito nyithindo kapok githo biro tiyo dwe mar Julai higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e county mar Kwale.

English: KEMRI reminds expectant mothers in Samburu County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Samburu in helitaanka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMRI parone mine ma biro bedo gi ich e county mar Samburu ni thuolo mar yudo kony mar chano ngima joot en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag oganda.

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Embu County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay biyo cabitaan ah ku kariyaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health nyiso jogweng'o mag Embu County mondo omak pi modho kapok gitiyo kode mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMRI will be held in Kakamega County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMRI itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay KEMRI ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Gobolka Kakamega bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma KEMRI ochano biro timore e taon mar Kakamega e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges farmers in Meru County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.

Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur e county mar Meru mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Farmers urged to adopt pest-resistant crops to curb yield losses.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wahimizwa kutumia mazao yanayostahimili wadudu ili kupunguza hasara ya mavuno.

Dholuo: Ne ojiw jopur mondo oti gi cham ma ok nyal chungo chwoyo mondo kik cham okethre.

English: Notice: SHA opens the electoral calendar centres in Meru County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: SHA inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Meru Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA waxay furaysaa xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee degmada Meru bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e kaunti mar Meru e dwe mar Mei.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Tana River County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Tana River juu ya umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages mothers in Bomet County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Bomet kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Bomet inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo mine man Bomet County mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Notice: KRA launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Bungoma County this August.
Kiswahili: KRA inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Agosti hii.

Dholuo: Ng'e ni KRA chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Bungoma e dwe mar Agost.

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Tana River County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo odonj e riwruok mar insuarans mar thieth mondo giyud thieth ma yudo kony.

English: Universities Fund reminds needy students in Nandi County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba vitabu vya kiada na matumizi ya vifaa vya kujifunzia hufungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xasuusinayaa ardayda u baahan degmada Nandi in buugaagta waxbarasho iyo codsiyada qalabka waxbarasho ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa jopuonjre man gi chan e County mar Nandi ni buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok biro rumo machiegni.

English: TSC encourages residents of Laikipia County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya ugatuzi.
Somali: TSC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabtaan wareejinta.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo jogweng' County mar Laikipia mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto giseyudo mondo ging'e weche duto ma biro timore.

English: FAO advises coffee producers in Taita-Taveta County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: FAO inashauri wazalishaji wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: FAO waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kafeega ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma loso chai e Taita-Taveta County mondo odonj e riwruok ma nigi ratiro mar tiyo gi tich makonyo ji kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

Kiswahili: Kufungua uidhinishaji wa kazi ya wakimbizi nchini Kenya: Mfumo wa vitendo wa ujumuishaji wa kiuchumi, upatanishi wa kitaasisi, na ukuaji wa kitaifa (Machi 2026)

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds residents of Tana River County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Tana River ku xasuusinayaa inay adeegaan amarada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah xilligan dhulgariirka.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations parone jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji e gweng'no e kinde mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: DCI urges motorists and pedestrians in Mombasa County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent landslides-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DCI inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Mombasa inay guryahooda rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dabka daminta iyo inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa dhacdooyinka la xiriira dhulgariirka.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo dereba kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Mombasa mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo gitim kinda mondo gikwed masiche mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: Gov't now calls for wearing of masks, vaccination as Kenya faces 6th COVID-19 wave
Kiswahili: Serikali sasa yatoa wito wa kuvaa barakoa na chanjo huku Kenya ikikabiliwa na wimbi la 6 la COVID-19
Somali: Dowladda ayaa hadda ku baaqeysa in la xidho maaskaro, la tallaalo maadaama Kenya ay wajahdo hirkii lixaad ee COVID-19

English: Ichungwah urges Kiambu residents to back government for continued development gains
Kiswahili: Ichungwah anawahimiza wakazi wa Kiambu kuunga mkono serikali kwa maendeleo yanayoendelea

English: Office of the Auditor-General advises residents of Nyeri County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay dalbadaan internetka iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General nyiso jogweng' County mar Nyeri mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro kwayo mag ID mar pinygi.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the community in Mandera County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb theft.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Mandera inay ka warbixiyaan waxqabadka shakiga ah saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto manie gweng' mar Mandera mondo onyis polis ma ni machiegni gi kanyo ni gitimo gik ma chando ji.

English: NCTC partnered with NGOs to educate youth on digital extremist threats and strategies to resist online radicalization.
Kiswahili: NCTC imeshirikiana na mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali kuelimisha vijana juu ya vitisho vya kigaidi na mikakati ya kupinga ukatili wa mtandaoni.
Somali: NCTC waxay iskaashi la sameysay ururada aan dawliga ahayn si ay u bartaan dhalinyarada ku saabsan hanjabaadaha xagjirnimada dhijitaalka ah iyo istaraatiijiyadaha looga hortago xagjirinta internetka.
Dholuo: NCTC oseriwore gi riwruoge maok mag sirkal mondo gipuonj rowere e wi gik makelo luoro kod yore mag kwedo timbe mahundu e intanet.

English: KEMSA urges residents of Samburu County to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers following a rise in reported cyclosporiasis cases.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya cyclosporiasis vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Samburu inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska loo maleynayo inay u sheegaan mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaskii la soo sheegay ee cyclosporiasis.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' Samburu County mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore mar rito ngima mar oganda nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuwo mar cyclosporiasis osemedore.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds residents of Embu County that terracing improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kwamba usafirishaji wa mipaka huboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu in dhulka lagu beerayo uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jogweng' mar Embu County ni terracing medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens a new service point for passport services in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya oseyawo kamachielo mar tiyo gi passport e county mar Baringo.

English: SHA urges residents of Marsabit County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: SHA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja wa kaunti.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jogweng' mar Marsabit County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mar dongruok e county.

English: Pest Control Products Board promotes water harvesting among farmers in Nakuru County as part of the February climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inakuza uvunaji wa maji miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Februari.
Somali: Guddiga Waxsoosaarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa goosashada biyaha beeraleyda degmada Nakuru iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka iska caabbinta cimilada ee Febraayo.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok mag Pest jiwo choko pi e kind jopur e Kaunti mar Nakuru kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo kinda mar kedo gi kit yamo e dwe mar Februar.

English: Public notice: KEMSA will host a free food safety outreach in Kwale County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMSA itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usalama wa chakula bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Kwale Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: KEMSA waxay marti gelineysaa dadaal bilaash ah oo ku saabsan badbaadada cuntada ee Gobolka Kwale bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMSA biro timo chenro mar chiwo kony maonge chudo e wi wach rito chiemo e taon mar Kwale e dwe mar Januar.

English: Our teams are continuing with the targeted testing exercise in areas we have identified as hotspots, such as Kawangware, Eastleigh & Mvita in Mombasa County to identify & isolate the infected in order to prevent further transmission. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Timu zetu zinaendelea na zoezi linalolengwa la upimaji katika maeneo ambayo tumetambua kuwa maeneo yanayovutia watu wengi, kama vile Kawangware, Eastleigh & Mvita katika Kaunti ya Mombasa ili kutambua na kuwatenga walioambukizwa ili kuzuia maambukizi zaidi. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Kooxaheenna ayaa sii wadaya tijaabada bartilmaameedka ah ee meelaha aan u aqoonsannay inay yihiin meelaha ugu daran, sida Kawangware, Eastleigh & Mvita ee Degmada Mombasa si loo aqoonsado loona kala saaro dadka cudurka qaba si looga hortago faafitaan dheeraad ah. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Tim magwa dhi nyime gi timo pim ma ochung’ne kuonde ma wasefwenyo ni gin kuonde ma ng’ato nyalo yudoe tuwo, kaka Kawangware, Eastleigh kod Mvita e gweng’ mar Mombasa mondo ong’e kendo oket oko jogo ma oyudo tuwono mondo ogeng’ lando tuwono. #KomeshaKorona

English: West Pokot Community Engagement Study on Climate Vulnerability and Capacity Analysis

Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Mandera.

Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa ugonjwa wa uti wa mgongo wakati wa ufikiaji wa Julai.

Dholuo: CDC kwayo jonyuol e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Julai.

English: All livestock in Kenya must be registered under new proposed regulations requiring identification devices for each animal before entering slaughterhouses
Kiswahili: Mifugo yote nchini Kenya lazima isajiliwe chini ya kanuni mpya zilizopendekezwa zinazohitaji vifaa vya utambulisho kwa kila mnyama kabla ya kuingia kwenye machinjio.

English: Notice: KRA opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay ka furaysaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay ka shaqeynta shahaadada dhalashada ee Gobolka Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KRA oseyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag loso nyasi mag nyuol e County mar Kirinyaga.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education opens a new ICT skills programme at the vocational centre in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inafungua programu mpya ya ujuzi wa ICT katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka waxay ka furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan xirfadaha ICT ee xarunta xirfadda ee degmada Nakuru.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State Department for Basic Education ochako chenro manyien mar lony e yore mag ICT e kar tiegruok e gweng' mar Nakuru.

English: Notice: ODPP opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Wananchi katika Kaunti ya Kitui.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay furaysaa goob adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee Gobolka Kitui.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: ODPP oseyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag e-Citizen registration e County mar Kitui.

English: KNEC encourages out-of-school children in Kwale County to register their children at the nearest public school under school feeding programme.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges residents of Wajir County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Uhalifu unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya dadka deggan degmada Wajir inay iskaashi la sameeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyadoo la sii xoojinayo amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo jogweng' mar Wajir County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'adoe bura e kinde ma sirkal medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom rito tong'.

English: You are six times more likely to get malaria if you visit Busia, Tana River, Kakamega, Bungoma, Kilifi, Kisumu, Trans Nzoia, Elgeyo Marakwet and Nandi counties, according to the latest data from the Ministry of Health.
Kiswahili: Una uwezekano mara sita zaidi wa kupata malaria ukitembelea kaunti za Busia, Tana River, Kakamega, Bungoma, Kilifi, Kisumu, Trans Nzoia, Elgeyo Marakwet na Nandi, kulingana na data ya hivi karibuni kutoka Wizara ya Afya.
Somali: Haddii aad booqato degmooyinka Busia, Tana River, Kakamega, Bungoma, Kilifi, Kisumu, Trans Nzoia, Elgeyo Marakwet iyo Nandi, waxaad lix jeer u badan tahay inaad qabato makaraayada, sida ku cad xogta ugu dambeysa ee Wasaaradda Caafimaadka.
Dholuo: Kaluwore gi weche manyien mag Ministry of Health, inyalo yudo malaria nyadi auchiel ka idhi e counties mag Busia, Tana River, Kakamega, Bungoma, Kilifi, Kisumu, Trans Nzoia, Elgeyo Marakwet kod Nandi.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on residents of Wajir County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of border security.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inatoa wito kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika kumbi za umma ili kuunga mkono usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ugu baaqay dadka deggan degmada Wajir inay la shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations okwayo jogweng' mar Wajir County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji nitie mondo okony sirkal rito tong'.

English: Notice from SHA (Social Health Authority): postnatal check-ups clinics will run every September at designated health centres in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Notisi kutoka kwa SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii): kliniki za uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa zitafanya kazi kila Septemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada): Xarumaha baaritaanka dhalmada ka dib waxaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Sebtember ee xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Rieko moa kuom SHA (Social Health Authority): klinik mag nonro bang' nyuol ibiro timie higa ka higa e dwe mar Septemba e kuonde thieth moyier e Kaunti mar Kisumu.

English: Promote resilience and climate-smart agricultural production in areas which depend on crop and livestock activities.

Kiswahili: Wakulima wamehimizwa kutathmini na kudhibiti mambo muhimu ya kufanikisha kilimo ikiwa ni pamoja na utayarishaji wa chaguo la ardhi matumizi ya mbolea na kanuni za ufugaji wa mazao.

Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Marsabit ape simu ya simu ya GBV 1195.

English: AFA announces a free anthrax vaccination exercise for cattle in Kisumu County this May.
Kiswahili: AFA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kimeta kwa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Mei hii.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free malaria screening is available at all public health centres in Isiolo County this May.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa malaria bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Mei hii.
Somali: Shirkadda SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka fayraska ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaad ee gobolka Isiolo bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji ni thieth mar malaria maonge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County Isiolo e dwe mar Mei.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Trans Nzoia County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia inay la yimaadaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Bura matayo gik makedo gi tuoche jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds the public in Kisumu County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this December.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba mchango juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka unakaribishwa Desemba hii.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa shacabka degmada Kisumu in talooyinka dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah la soo dhaweynayo bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General paronwa ji duto e County mar Kisumu ni ji duto mor gi chiwo mag paro e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e dwe mar Desemba.

English: KEMRI reminds expectant mothers in Makueni County that access to skilled birth attendance is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba upatikanaji wa mahudhurio ya uzazi wenye ujuzi ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Makueni in helitaanka daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfad leh ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMRI parone mine ma biro nyuolo nyithindo e gweng' mar Makueni ni thuolo mar yudo nyithindo ma nigi lony onge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: Announcement to provide free milk to primary schools inMigori and nakuru counties to encourage more entries of children to school
Kiswahili: Tangazo la kutoa maziwa ya bure kwa shule za msingi katika wilaya za Migori na nakuru ili kuhamasisha watoto wengi kuingia shule
Somali: Ogeysiis lagu siinayo caano bilaash ah dugsiyada hoose ee degmooyinka Migori iyo nakuru si loo dhiirrigeliyo in caruur badan ay iskuulka galaan
Dholuo: Lando mar chiwo chak maonge chudo ne skunde matindo e gwenge mag Migori kod nakuru mondo ojiw nyithindo omed dhi e skul
