English: Kilifi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kilifi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Juni 2023
Somali: Degmada Kilifi: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kilifi: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2023

English: KEPHIS reminds livestock keepers in Meru County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Meru kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Meru inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanada buka xafiiska xayawaanka ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KEPHIS paronwa jorit jamni e county mar Meru ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: Kenya Key Message Update September 2023: Flooding and high staple food prices are constraining drought recovery in pastoral and marginal agricultural areas
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Ujumbe Muhimu wa Kenya Septemba 2023: Mafuriko na bei ya juu ya chakula inazuia ukame katika maeneo ya wafugaji na maeneo ya mashambani.
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta Fariinta Muhiimka ah ee Kenya Sebtembar 2023: Daadadka iyo qiimaha sare ee cuntada aasaasiga ah ayaa caqabad ku ah soo kabashada abaarta ee ka jirta goobaha daaqsinka iyo beeraha ee liita.
Dholuo: Oda maduong’ mar Kenya Septemba 2023: Pi ma pong’o piny kod nengo mamalo mar chiemo madongo geng’o dokruok mar oro e kuonde ma jokwath kod kuonde ma ji pure

English: Office of the Auditor-General updates residents of Makueni County on progress of county development projects this May.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kuhusu maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti hii Mei.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Makueni ka warbixiyaa horumarka mashaariicda horumarinta degmada bisha May.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General chiwo ripot ne jogweng' Makueni e wi dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok e gweng'no e dwe mar Mei.

English: KNEC reminds youth in Kericho County that HELB funding is available for electrical installation training.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme.
Somali: KNEC waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kericho in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada.
Dholuo: KNEC oparo ne rowere man Kericho County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar loso sitima.

English: HELB reminds youth in Baringo County that HELB funding is available for electrical installation training.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa dhallinyarada degmada Baringo in maalgelinta HELD ay diyaar u tahay tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa rowere man Baringo County ni pesa ma giyudo kuom HELP yudore e tiegruok mar keto gik moko e kor lwasi.

English: DCI calls on the community in Nakuru County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: DCI waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Nakuru inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wici doonaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: DCI okwayo oganda man Nakuru County mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo oluong simo mar GBV 1195.

English: Notice: DPP issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Nyamira.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: DPP ogolo siem mar rito weche mag sirkal kuom chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Nyamira County.

English: E-Citizen urges eligible citizens in Kirinyaga County to participate in voter education.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wananchi wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kushiriki katika elimu ya wapiga kura.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kirinyaga inay ka qaybqaataan waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro e County mar Kirinyaga mondo oriwre e tiegruok mar josiasa.

English: Training requests must be accompanied by Human Resource Management Advisory Committee (HRMAC) minutes.
Kiswahili: Maombi ya mafunzo lazima yaambatane na dakika za Kamati ya Ushauri ya Usimamizi wa Rasilimali Watu (HRMAC).
Somali: Codsiyada tababarka waa inay la socdaan qoraallo Guddiga La-talinta Maareynta Kheyraadka Aadanaha (HRMAC).
Dholuo: Kwayo mag puonjruok nyaka bed kanyakla gi dakika mag Komiti mar Rieko mar Rieko mar Jotich (HRMAC).

English: Universities Fund reminds youth in Trans Nzoia County that HELB funding is available for welding and fabrication training.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xasuusinayaa dhalinyarada degmada Trans Nzoia in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa rowere man Trans Nzoia County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing.

English: EACC urges eligible citizens in Embu County to participate in polling procedures.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Embu kushiriki katika utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Embu inay ka qaybqaataan nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jokanyo mag county mar Embu mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag yiero.

English: E-Citizen encourages first-time voters in Siaya County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Siaya kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horeysay ee degmada Siaya inay soo booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo joma okwongo yiero e county mar Siaya mondo olim kama ichanoe ji ne IEBC.

English: NDMA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Murang'a County that access to post-violence medical care is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu zinapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Murang'a in la heli karo daryeel caafimaad oo rabshad ka dib oo lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag nindruok e County mar Murang'a ni yudo kony mar thieth ma iyudo bang' timno onge chudo.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Nyandarua County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya dadweynaha degmada Nyandarua in adeegyada bukaanka dibedda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji duto e County mar Nyandarua ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mag ambulatori e kuonde moyier.

English: TSC announces distribution of revision guides to schools in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this January.
Kiswahili: TSC inatangaza usambazaji wa miongozo ya marekebisho kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Januari hii.
Somali: TSC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta hagaha dib u eegista dugsiyada degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: TSC olando ni gibiro miyo skunde mag Elgeyo-Marakwet buge mag somo e dwe mar Januar.

English: ILO Brief - Constructing pathways: Enhancing employment and inclusion of host communities and urban refugees in Kenyaâ€™s construction sector (August 2025)
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa ILO - Kuunda njia: Kuimarisha ajira na kujumuisha jamii zinazowakaribisha na wakimbizi wa mijini katika sekta ya ujenzi nchini Kenya (Agosti 2025)
Somali: Warbixinta ILO - Dhisidda waddooyinka: Kobcinta shaqada iyo ka mid noqoshada bulshooyinka martida loo yahay iyo qaxootiga magaalooyinka ee qaybta dhismaha ee Kenya (Agoosto 2025)
Dholuo: ILO - Gedo yore: Medo tich kod keto jodak ma rwako jodak kod jolweny ma odak e taon e sekta mar gedo e piny Kenya (Agost 2025)

English: Socioeconomic data, evidence and action - Economic Inclusion Exchange East Africa, September 2023
Kiswahili: Data ya kijamii na kiuchumi, ushahidi na hatua - Ushirikishwaji wa Kiuchumi Afrika Mashariki, Septemba 2023
Somali: Xogta Dhaqaale-bulsheed, caddayn iyo ficil - Isweydaarsiga Ka-mid-noqoshada Dhaqaalaha Bariga Afrika, Sebtembar 2023
Dholuo: Data mag weche yuto mag oganda, neno motimore - Loch mar weche mag yuto Afrika ma Wuokchieng', Septemba 2023

English: Notice: SHA opens a new service point for national ID applications in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: SHA inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Shirkadda SHA waxay ka fureysaa barta adeegga cusub ee codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova (SHA) ochako tiyo gi kamachielo mar chiwo kwayo mag ng'eyo nying' e gweng' mar Kakamega.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development encourages residents of Nairobi County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on voter registration.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada Waxbarashada wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ojiwo jogweng' Nairobi County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda mondo ging'e weche duto motudore gi ndiko joma oyiero.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response launches an August awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Agosti juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay bilaabeysaa olole wacyi galineed bishii Agoosto oo ku saabsan wacyiga cadaadiska sare ee degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Agost e wi wach remo mang'eny e gweng' mar Vihiga.

English: Provide aids! Supply sign language tools for deaf students.
Kiswahili: Toa vifaa vya kusaidia! Toa vifaa vya lugha ya ishara kwa wanafunzi viziwi.
Somali: Ka caawi ardayda dhegaha la'aanta ah!
Dholuo: Kony jopuonjre ma itgi odino gi gige tiyo gi dho momni.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public in Bomet County about the importance of hypertension awareness for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuhusu umuhimu wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay dadka degmada Bomet ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay wacyiga cadaadiska sare ee caafimaadka qoyska.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji duto e county mar Bomet kuom ber mar miyo ji ong'e ni tuwo mar hypertension en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: IEBC invites youth in Isiolo County to enroll for ICT skills training this May.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT Mei hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Isiolo inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka xirfadaha ICT bisha May.
Dholuo: IEBC gwelo rowere e County mar Isiolo mondo odonj e tiegruok mar ICT e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service conducts a community briefing on border security in Kirinyaga County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Machi hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu qabtaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha ee Gobolka Kirinyaga bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Forest Service timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e County mar Kirinyaga e dwe mar Mach.

English: KTDA reminds farmers in Kitui County of the ongoing modern irrigation techniques training programme.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuhusu programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji.
Somali: KTDA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kitui barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah.
Dholuo: KTDA oparo ne jopur ma Kitui County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar yore mag lero pi.

English: Universities Fund encourages out-of-school children in Nyamira County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under free primary education.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Nyamira inay dalbadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga ugu dambeeya ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo nyithindo maok dhi e skul e County mar Nyamira mondo okonygi yudo konyno kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Teachers Service Commission advises students in Nairobi County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ardayda degmada Nairobi kula talinayaa inay dalbadaan bogga deeqda waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan waxyaabaha barashada dijitaalka ah ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jopuonjre e County mar Nairobi mondo okonygi kuom tiyo gi websait mar somo ma yudore e intanet mondo giyud thuolo mar somo weche mag digital maonge chudo.

English: Climate change already affects agriculture and food security, and if no urgent actions are taken, will put millions of people at risk of hunger and poverty.
Kiswahili: Mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa tayari yanaathiri kilimo na usalama wa chakula, na ikiwa hakuna hatua za haraka zitachukuliwa, zitaweka mamilioni ya watu katika hatari ya njaa na umaskini.
Somali: Isbeddelka cimilada ayaa durba saameyn ku leh beeraha iyo amniga cuntada, haddii aan la qaadin tallaabooyin degdeg ah, waxay halis ugu dhigi doontaa malaayiin qof gaajo iyo saboolnimo.
Dholuo: Lokruok mar alwora osechako chiko yore mag pur kod chiemo, kendo ka ok okaw okang' mapiyo, mano biro miyo ji tara gi tara obed gi chandruok mar kech kod dhier.

English: KNEC conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Meru County this October.
Kiswahili: KNEC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Meru Oktoba hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay Oktoobarkan ka qabaneysaa kulan waxbarasho oo ku saabsan dib u wareejinta gobolka Meru.
Dholuo: KNEC dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e dwe mar Oktoba e kaunti mar Meru.

English: NDMA reminds the public in Kiambu County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NDMA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kiambu inay ka feejignaadaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: NDMA parone ji duto e Kaunti mar Kiambu mondo omed bedo motang' ne loso kuwe e piny.

English: SHA urges eligible citizens in Narok County to participate in voter education.
Kiswahili: SHA inawasihi wananchi wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Narok kushiriki katika elimu ya wapiga kura.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Narok inay ka qaybqaataan waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro mar yiero e Narok County mondo oriwgi e tiegruok mar josiasa.

English: CDC advises residents of Kilifi County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: CDC inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: CDC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada la hortagi karo.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo jogweng' Kilifi County mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth ma onge chudo mar oganda mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET reminds citizens in Nyamira County about their rights regarding voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhusu haki zao kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Nyamira ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar State for TVET parone raia mag Nyamira County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar ndiko joma oyiero.

English: Farmers can access government subsidized fertilizer by dialing 707 to find their entitlements choosing a nearby Agrovet shop and paying Kshs 3 500 via Mpesa
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaweza kupata mbolea inayofadhiliwa na serikali kwa kupiga nambari 707 ili kupata stahili zao kuchagua duka la karibu la Agrovet na kulipa Kshs 3 500 kupitia Mpesa.
Somali: Beeraleydu waxay heli karaan bacriminta ay dowladda maalgeliso iyagoo wacaya 707 si ay u helaan xuquuqdooda, dooranaya dukaanka Agrovet ee ku dhow, kana bixin kara Kshs 3 500 iyada oo loo marayo Mpesa
Dholuo: Jo-Puriti nyalo yudo yiende ma sirkal chiwo kony kuom goyo namba 707 mondo giyud ratiro margi kuom yiero duka moro machiegni mar Agrovet kendo chulo Kshs 3,500 kokalo kuom Mpesa

English: Gov't increases SHA benefits for Cancer patients, adds real-time claims tracking
Kiswahili: Serikali haiongezi faida za SHA kwa wagonjwa wa Saratani, inaongeza ufuatiliaji wa madai ya wakati halisi
Somali: Dowladdu waxay kordhisay faa'iidooyinka SHA ee bukaanka Kansarka, waxay ku dartay raadinta sheegashada waqtiga dhabta ah
Dholuo: Sirkal medo gweth mag SHA ne jotuo mag Cancer, omedo timo nonro kuom weche mag yuto e kinde masie

English: UNICEF Kenya Humanitarian Situation Report No. 3, 11 April 2023 (Reporting Period 1 to 31 March 2023)
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Hali ya Kibinadamu ya UNICEF Kenya No. 3, 11 Aprili 2023 (Kipindi cha Kuripoti 1 hadi 31 Machi 2023)
Somali: Warbixinta Xaaladda Bani'aadamnimada ee UNICEF Kenya Lambarka 3, 11 Abriil 2023 (Muddada Warbixinta 1aad ilaa 31 Maarso 2023)
Dholuo: Ripot mar chal mar konyo dhano mar UNICEF e piny Kenya namba 3, tarik 11 dwe mar ang'wen higa mar 2023 (Kinde mar chiwo ripot chakre tarik 31 dwe mar adek higa mar 2023)

English: Laikipia County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Laikipia: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2023
Somali: Degmada Laikipia: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Laikipia: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2023

English: KEPHIS urges maize growers in Murang'a County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Murang'a inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka xilliga dayrta iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur mag kodhi e County mar Murang'a mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma ne oyiego mondo okonygi geng'o chwanyruok mar jolweny e kinde mondi ka gitiyo gi tuoche makelo tuoche mamero ji mondo gimi nyak e higani.

English: Foods like beans, greens, and liver prevent anemia and support child development.
Kiswahili: Vyakula kama vile maharagwe, mboga za majani, na ini huzuia upungufu wa damu na husaidia ukuaji wa mtoto.
Somali: Cuntada sida beelaha, khudradda iyo beerka waxay ka hortagaan dhiig yaraanta waxayna taageeraan horumarka ilmaha.
Dholuo: Chiemb chuny kaka bunde, alot, kod chiwogo geng'o remo kik medore kendo gimiyo nyathi bedo gi winjruok maber gi Nyasaye.

English: Consider therapy or counseling. A mental health professional can provide strategies to cope with stigma and help you develop a positive self-image
Kiswahili: Fikiria tiba au ushauri nasaha. Mtaalamu wa afya ya akili anaweza kutoa mikakati ya kukabiliana na unyanyapaa na kukusaidia kukuza taswira chanya ya wewe mwenyewe
Somali: Tixgeli daaweynta ama la talinta. Khabiir caafimaad maskaxeed ayaa ku siin kara xeelado lagu xakameyn karo cayayaanka oo kaa caawin kara inaad horumariso dareenka wanaagsan ee naftaada
Dholuo: Ng'at molony e weche thieth nyalo konyi ng'eyo kaka inyalo nyagori gi achaya kendo onyalo konyi bedo gi paro mowinjore e wi ngimani

English: Notice: KEPHIS will distribute certified millet seed to farmers in Kilifi County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KEPHIS itawapa wakulima katika Wilaya ya Kilifi mbegu zilizothibitishwa za millet mwezi Mei huu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay sii deyn doontaa abuurka miraha la shaaciyey beeraleyda Gobolka Kilifi bisha May ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEPHIS biro pogo kodhi mag millet ne jopur manie Kilifi County e dwe mar Mei.

English: Office of the Auditor-General announces improved turnaround times for e-Citizen registration in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujiandikisha kwa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la hagaajiyay waqtiga diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General olando lokruok e seche mag timo chenro mar dhi e e-Citizen registration e county mar Siaya.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges residents of Busia County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama katikati ya tahadhari kubwa ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Busia inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaala aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nabadgelyada qaranka.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo jogweng' mar Busia County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar sirkal kuom gik ma ne timore e alwora mar tong'gi nikech ji osebedo ka keto pachgi ahinya kuom loso kuwe e piny.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya launches a cattle rustling prevention campaign in Kiambu County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kiambu mwezi huu wa Machi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay bilaabaneysaa olole looga hortago xanta xoolaha ee Gobolka Kiambu bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chako kampen mar geng'o ywaruok mag jamni e taon mar Kiambu e dwe mar Mach.

English: TVET urges residents of Kajiado County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: TVET waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay isdiiwaangaliyaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan fasallada akhrista dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo odonj e program mar somo kod somo mar joma dongo mondo giyud konyruok kuom tiegruok mar somo gi somo.

English: IEBC reminds parents in Kajiado County that bursary allocation registration is open this July.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kwamba usajili wa ugawaji wa bursari umefunguliwa Julai hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Kajiado in diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ay furan tahay bisha July.
Dholuo: IEBC parone jonyuol man Kajiado County ni ndiko kwayo mar yudo osuru e dwe mar Julai.

English: KALRO informs avocado farmers in Nairobi County of new market linkage opportunities this April.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawafahamisha wakulima wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Aprili hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda avocado ee degmada Nairobi fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: KALRO nyiso jopur mag avocado e County mar Nairobi e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar April.

English: KICD advises students in Nairobi County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access revision guides.
Kiswahili: KICD inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata miongozo ya marekebisho.
Somali: KICD waxay kula talineysaa ardayda degmada Nairobi inay dalbadaan bogga waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan tilmaamaha dib u eegista.
Dholuo: KICD nyiso jopuonjre e County mar Nairobi mondo okonygi kuom tiyo gi websait mar somo ma yudore e intanet mondo giyud gweth mag somo.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties advises residents of Baringo County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay dalbadaan internetka iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties jiwo jogweng' Baringo County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro kwayo mag ID.

English: Ministry of Education advises applicants in Nakuru County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Nakuru inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo odonj e skundni kapok odonjogi.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Machakos County about the importance of hypertension awareness for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuhusu umuhimu wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu dadka degmada Machakos ku xasuusinayaa muhiimadda ay leedahay wacyiga cadaadiska dhiig karka ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji duto e County mar Machakos kuom ber mar ng'eyo ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar hypertension e ngima joot.

English: Council of Governors warns public officers in Garissa County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya madaraka.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ka digeen saraakiisha dawladda ee Gobolka Garissa inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e gweng' mar Garissa ni kik giti marach gi migawo ma gin-go.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges beans growers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet in ay horumariyaan cayayaanka ciidanka xilliga dayrta iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur molony e Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma giyudo e higa ka gitiyo gi tuoche makelo tuoche ma ok nyal geng'o kodhino.

English: cancer clinic has been launhed in Samburu County. Ten patients are recorded every month in samburu, and through public meeting this cancer center has been made known.
Kiswahili: kliniki ya saratani imezinduliwa katika Kaunti ya Samburu. Wagonjwa kumi huandikishwa kila mwezi katika samburu, na kupitia mkutano wa umma kituo hiki cha saratani kimejulikana.
Somali: xarunta kansarka ayaa laga bilaabay gobolka Samburu. toban bukaan ayaa lagu diiwaangeliyaa bil kasta samburu, waxaana kulanka dadweynaha lagu soo bandhigay xarunkan.
Dholuo: klinik mar tuo mar kansa osechak e county mar Samburu. Jotuo apar ikwano dwe ka dwe e samburu, kendo kokalo kuom romo mar ji duto, kesni mar kansa oseng'ere.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages mothers in Mombasa County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku dhiirigelisay hooyooyinka degmada Mombasa inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit jiwo mine manie County mar Mombasa mondo odhi olim ringregi machiegni mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: KMTC opens 12 new campuses for medical training nationwide.
Kiswahili: KMTC inafungua vyuo vikuu vipya 12 kwa ajili ya mafunzo ya matibabu kote nchini.
Somali: KMTC waxay fureysaa 12 xarumood oo cusub oo loogu talagalay tababarka caafimaadka dalka oo dhan.
Dholuo: KMTC oseyawo kambise 12 manyien mag tiegruok mar thieth e piny mangima.

English:
Always remember that Mental Health first aid is just as important as physical first aid.
St John Ambulance is here for you!
Kiswahili: Daima kumbuka kwamba matibabu ya kwanza ya afya ya akili ni muhimu kama matibabu za kwanza za kimwili. St John Ambulance ni hapa kwa ajili yenu!
Somali: Had iyo jeer xusuusnow in gargaarka koowaad ee Caafimaadka Maskaxda uu muhiim u yahay sida gargaarka ugu horreeya ee jirka.
Dholuo: Kinde duto ng'e ni konyruok mokwongo mar thieth mar parruok en gima duong' mana kaka kony mokwongo mar ringruok.

English: Notice: KICD announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta dugsiyada dugsiga dhexe ee maalin bilaash ah ee degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KICD lando tarik mag dhi e skul mag sekondari e piny Nyeri County.

English: EACC reminds the public in Lamu County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this October.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Lamu kwamba maoni juu ya mapitio ya utendaji wa kila mwaka yanakaribishwa Oktoba hii.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Lamu in talooyinka ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah la soo dhaweynayo bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: EACC paronwa ji duto e County mar Lamu ni ibiro yie gi chiwo mar chiwo paro e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages mothers in Busia County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Busia kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa hooyooyinka degmada Busia inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo mine manie county mar Busia mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges farmers in Samburu County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Samburu inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo soo-saarka biyaha ee beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan qaabka roobabka ee isbeddelaya.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur e county mar Samburu mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok mar koth.

English: KEPHIS informs maize farmers in Kisii County of new market linkage opportunities this October.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawafahamisha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Oktoba hii.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Kisii fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KEPHIS nyiso jopur mag kodhi e County mar Kisii e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public that free suicide prevention support is available through county health facilities in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kuzuia kujiua unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Tana River.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo ka hortagga ismiidaaminta laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Tana River County.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar geng'o ji kik donjre yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth e taon mar Tana River County.

English: KALRO informs avocado farmers in Makueni County of new market linkage opportunities this February.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawafahamisha wakulima wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Februari hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda avocado ee degmada Makueni fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: KALRO nyiso jopur mag avocado e gweng' mar Makueni thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Februar.

English: KEMRI advises residents of Bungoma County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: KEMRI waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma in ay biyo cabitaan ah ku kariyaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada la hortagi karo.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo omak pi modho kapok gitiyo kode mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: KRA updates residents of Mandera County on progress of county development projects this July.
Kiswahili: KRA inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kuhusu maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti hii mwezi Julai.
Somali: KRA waxay dadka deggan degmada Mandera ka wargelineysaa horumarka mashaariicda horumarinta degmada bisha July.
Dholuo: KRA osemiyo jogweng'o mag Mandera ong'eyo dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok e gweng'no e dwe mar Julai.

English: State Department for TVET announces distribution of revision guides to schools in Kirinyaga County this May.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yatangaza usambazaji wa miongozo ya marekebisho kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Mei hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhawaaqday in lagu qeybinayo hagaha dib u eegista dugsiyada Gobolka Kirinyaga bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag somo e skunde man Kirinyaga County e dwe mar abich.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds expectant mothers in Tharaka-Nithi County that access to childhood immunization is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwamba upatikanaji wa chanjo ya utotoni ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi in helitaanka tallaalka carruurta ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Tharaka-Nithi ni yudo thieth mar nyithindo onge chudo e kuonde duto ma ji yudoe thieth.

English: KALRO reminds livestock keepers in Taita-Taveta County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa za kuponda ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KALRO waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KALRO paronwa jorit jamni e Taita-Taveta County mondo ogeng'gi e kuonde moketi mag chwoyo jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: Public transport burn in Nairobi, Mombasa and Mandera will be extended for one more month. All bars to remain closed for the next more 30 days
Kiswahili: Moto wa usafiri wa umma katika Nairobi, Mombasa na Mandera utaongezwa kwa mwezi mmoja zaidi.
Somali: Dabka gaadiidka dadweynaha ee Nairobi, Mombasa iyo Mandera ayaa la kordhin doonaa hal bil oo dheeraad ah.
Dholuo: Yie mar wuoth e taonde mag Nairobi, Mombasa kod Mandera ibiro med kuom dwe achiel.

English: Isiolo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Isiolo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2023
Somali: Degmada Isiolo: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Isiolo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar 2023

English: KTDA advises coffee producers in Vihiga County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inashauri wazalishaji wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KTDA waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kafeega ee degmada Vihiga inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KTDA nyiso jopur ma loso chai e County mar Vihiga ni mondo gidonj e riwruok mar jokony tich moting'o ratiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Postpartum depression is real. Encourage new mothers to seek help and talk openly.
Kiswahili: Msongo wa mawazo baada ya kujifungua ni halisi. Wahimize akina mama wapya kutafuta msaada na kuzungumza waziwazi.
Somali: Dhibaatada dhalmada ka dib waa mid dhab ah. Hooyooyinka cusub ku dhiirigeliso inay caawimaad raadsadaan oo ay si furan u hadlaan.
Dholuo: Jiw mine manyien mondo omany kony kendo owuo ayanga.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya launches community-based development programmes in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inazindua mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay bilawday barnaamijyo horumarineed oo ku salaysan bulshada ee degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Huduma Kenya chako chenro mag dongruok e alwora mar Kericho County.

English: Farmers and food traders are urged to comply with municipal licensing and regulations to ensure food safety This is vital to protect public health and sustain urban food security
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wafanyabiashara wa chakula wamehimizwa kuzingatia leseni na kanuni za manispaa ili kuhakikisha usalama wa chakula. Hii ni muhimu ili kulinda afya ya jamii na kudumisha usalama wa chakula mijini.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo ganacsatada cuntada waxaa lagu booriyay inay u hoggaansamaan ruqsadaha degmooyinka iyo xeerarka si loo hubiyo badbaadada cuntada Tani waa mid muhiim u ah ilaalinta caafimaadka dadweynaha iyo ilaalinta amniga cuntada ee magaalooyinka
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma loso dhok kod dhok ma giwacho ni gihero ahinya loso dhok ma giwacho ni gihero ahinya.

English: Learn how farmers can participate in carbon credit programs by adopting practices that sequester carbon in poultry unit.
Kiswahili: Jifunze jinsi wakulima wanavyoweza kushiriki katika programu za mikopo ya kaboni kwa kutumia mbinu zinazotenga kaboni katika kitengo cha kuku.
Somali: Baro sida beeraleyda uga qaybqaadan karaan barnaamijyada deynta kaarboon iyagoo qaata dhaqanka ka soo saara kaarboon ee unugyada digaagga.
Dholuo: Puonjri kaka jopur nyalo konyo e chenro mag chiwo pesa kuom tiyo gi yore mag kano carbon e kitegi mag pidho dhok.

English: Alongside these trainings, the SHG members are participating in business development sessions designed to help them identify viable livelihood opportunities and strengthen their capacity to manage collective enterprises.
Kiswahili: Kando na mafunzo haya, wanachama wa SHG wanashiriki katika vikao vya maendeleo ya biashara vilivyoundwa ili kuwasaidia kutambua fursa zinazowezekana za maisha na kuimarisha uwezo wao wa kusimamia biashara za pamoja.
Somali: Marka laga soo tago tababarradan, xubnaha SHG waxay ka qayb qaadanayaan kalfadhiyada horumarinta ganacsiga ee loogu talagalay inay ka caawiyaan inay aqoonsadaan fursadaha nololeed ee la heli karo iyo inay xoojiyaan awooddooda ay ku maareeyaan ganacsiyada wadajirka ah.
Dholuo: Kaachiel gi puonjruok ma kamago, jokanyo mag SHG gin e chokruoge mag dongruok mar ohala ma olosi mondo okonygi ng’eyo thuolo ma nyalo konyogi e ngimagi kendo jiwo nyalo margi mar rito ohala ma gin-go kanyakla.

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Mandera County that access to free antenatal care is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma ya bure ya ujauzito ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Mandera in helitaanka daryeelka uurka ka hor ee bilaashka ah ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa mine madwaro nyuol e county mar Mandera ni thuolo mar yudo rit ma onge chudo mar nyuol en maonge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ee dugsiyada degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar State Department for TVET olando tarik ma jopuonjre biro donjoe e skul mag Bungoma County.

English: NPS urges the community in Garissa County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: NPS inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada Gobolka Garissa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha si looga hortago xannibaadda lo'da.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo ji duto manie County mar Garissa mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo kik gikwed kwalo jamni.

English: Notice: KMTC reminds citizens in Trans Nzoia County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Trans Nzoia ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC paronwa raia mag Trans Nzoia County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar konyo ji e weche mag pesa mag county.

English: DCI warns residents of Nairobi County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this July.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Julai hii.
Somali: DCI waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay u diyaar garoobaan qaraxyo dab ah oo dhici kara bishii July.
Dholuo: DCI osiemo jogweng' Nairobi mondo oikre ne yiengni manyalo timore e dwe mar Julai.

English: Feed the Future: Kenya USAID Stawi Fact Sheet 2023
Kiswahili: Lisha Wakati Ujao: Karatasi ya Ukweli ya USAID ya Kenya 2023
Somali: Quudinta Mustaqbalka: Kenya USAID Stawi Xaqiiqooyinka 2023
Dholuo: Chiemo kinde mabiro: Oboke mar adier mar USAID mar Kenya 2023

English: IEBC announces distribution of revision guides to schools in Tharaka-Nithi County this July.
Kiswahili: IEBC yatangaza usambazaji wa miongozo ya marekebisho kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Julai hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhawaaqday qaybinta hagaha dib u eegista dugsiyada Degmada Tharaka-Nithi bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: IEBC ong'ado mar pogo buge mag somo e skunde mag Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar Julai.

English: KRA reminds residents of Kiambu County that access to national ID applications is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba kufikia maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu in helitaanka codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: KRA parone jogweng' Kiambu County ni yudo kwayo mag ID mar piny sani yot moloyo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Nandi County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inazindua kampeni ya kupambana na ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nandi Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee Gobolka Nandi bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Rapar: Ofis mar Auditor General chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Nandi e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages residents of West Pokot County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot County inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay la xiriiraan lataliye la tababaran yahay.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo kik gisandgi gi ling'ling' kendo gitem manyo jang'ad rieko molony.

English: CDC urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Nairobi County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: CDC inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: CDC waxay ku boorineysaa qofkasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Nairobi inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar paro e County mar Nairobi mondo oluong simo mar thieth mar paro maonge chudo.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges residents of Kisumu County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia laini ya bure ya EACC ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Kisumu ku boorinayaa inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa khadka tooska ah ee lacag la'aanta ah ee EACC si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General jiwo jogweng' mar Kisumu County mondo ochiw ripode mag mibadhi kokalo kuom hotline mar EACC maonge chudo mondo giked gi mibadho e migepe mag sirkal.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Kericho County this February.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Kericho Februari hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada Waxbarashada wuxuu qabtaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha gobolka Kericho bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi migawo mar Ombudsman e County mar Kericho e dwe mar Februar.

English: Proper packaging ensure safety of products and good price. Find out diverse quality packages and sell in localmarket.
Kiswahili: Ufungashaji sahihi huhakikisha usalama wa bidhaa na bei nzuri.
Somali: Baakadaha saxda ah waxay damaanad qaadaan badbaadada badeecadaha iyo qiimaha wanaagsan.
Dholuo: Yiero mar loko gik moko e yo makare miyo gik moko bedo ma onge tuoche kendo kelo nengo maber.

English: AFA advises tea producers in Turkana County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: AFA inashauri wazalishaji wa chai katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: AFA waxay kula talineysaa soosaarayaasha shaaha ee degmada Turkana inay ka iibsadaan wax soo saarka kaliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: AFA nyiso jotelo mag chai e county mar Turkana ni gius gik ma giloso mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo gigo kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit confirms a HIV/AIDS outbreak alert for Kakamega County. Residents are advised to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi yathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa VVU/UKIMWI katika Kaunti ya Kakamega. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta Caafimada taranka ayaa xaqiijisay feejignaanta cudurka HIV / AIDS ee Gobolka Kakamega. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osenyiso ni nitie siem mar tuo mar HIV/AIDS e Kaunti mar Kakamega.

English: IEBC reminds the public in Mandera County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this March.
Kiswahili: IEBC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba maoni juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma ni kuwakaribisha Machi hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka gobolka Mandera in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: IEBC parone ji duto man Mandera County ni gibiro yie gi chiwo mag paro e wi chenro mag sirkal e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: nutrition supplementation for infants clinics will run every June at designated health centres in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi: nyongeza ya lishe kwa kliniki za watoto wachanga itaendeshwa kila Juni katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka: Kordhinta nafaqada ee dhallaanka xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Nandi ayaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Juun ee sanad kasta.
Dholuo: Rieko moa kuom Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: thieth mar chiemo ne nyithindo matindo ibiro tim dwe mar auchiel higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e county mar Nandi.

English: KEMRI advises residents of Nyandarua County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: KEMRI waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay yareeyaan qaadashada cusbada iyo sonkorta si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo omed chamo chumbi kod sukari mondo kik tuoche ma inyalo geng'e landre.

English: E-Citizen announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inatangaza nyakati bora za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Bomet.
Dholuo: E-Citizen olando lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mar yudo nying' mar ng'ato e piny mangima e county mar Bomet.

English: Judiciary of Kenya warns public officers in Lamu County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Lamu dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Lamu khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Lamu kuom timbe mag mibadhi.

English: Notice: OGP opens polling procedures centres in Murang'a County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay furaysaa xarumaha nidaamyada codbixinta ee degmada Murang'a bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: OGP ochako chenro mar timo yiero e County mar Murang'a e dwe mar Februar.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service warns sorghum farmers in Kisii County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa sorghum katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuhusu maambukizi ya wadudu na inapendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda sorghum ee degmada Kisii cudurrada cayayaanka ah wuxuuna kugula talinayaa faragelinta waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service chiwo siem ne jopur mag sorghum e County mar Kisii kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: NDMA urges the public in Taita-Taveta County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: NDMA inahimiza umma katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada lacagta mobilada.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo ji duto e Taita-Taveta County mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche mag wuond mag pesa mitimo gi simo.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free Rift Valley Fever screening is available at all public health centres in Meru County this May.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Meru Mei hii.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka bilaashka ah ee Rift Valley Fever laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynta ee degmada Meru bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji ni nonro mar Rift Valley Fever maonge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Meru e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: KICD reminds citizens in Nyandarua County about their rights regarding the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuhusu haki zao kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Nyandarua ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KICD parone raia mag Nyandarua County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo ombudsman.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will distribute certified sweet potatoes seed to farmers in Turkana County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itasambaza mbegu zilizothibitishwa za viazi tamu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Turkana Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Wax soo saarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu sii deyn doonaa abuurka baradho macaan oo la caddeeyay beeraleyda degmada Turkana County bishii Diseembar ee sannadkan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Chandruoge biro pogo kodhi mag le mamit ne jopur man Turkana County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: IPOA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Makueni County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: IPOA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Makueni kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Makueni inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e gweng' mar Makueni mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: West Pokot: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2024
Kiswahili: Pokot Magharibi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Februari 2024
Somali: Galbeedka Pokot: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2024
Dholuo: Pokot ma milambo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2024

English: Notice from Kenya Red Cross: postnatal check-ups clinics will run every February at designated health centres in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya: kliniki za uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa zitafanya kazi kila Februari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya: Caafimaadka baaritaanka dhalmada ka dib waxaa lagu qaban doonaa Febraayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee Magaalada Migori.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ripot Mamit mar Kenya: klinik mag nonro bang' nyuol biro dhi nyime e dwe mar ariyo higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e county mar Migori.

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief, April 2024
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP Kenya, Aprili 2024
Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya, Abriil 2024
Dholuo: Wach machuok mar piny Kenya mar WFP, dwe mar ang'wen 2024

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will open an avocado collection centre in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itafungua kituo cha kukusanya parachichi katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ka furi doontaa xarun ururinta avocado ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro yawo kama ichoko avocado e County mar Elgeyo-Marakwet e dwe mar Agost.

English: HELB calls on the community in Nandi County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: HELB inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Nandi kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: HELB waxay bulshada degmada Nandi ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan jawiga waxbarasho ee ka kooban si loo ilaaliyo nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: HELB luongo ji duto e county mar Nandi mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will distribute certified tea seed to farmers in Machakos County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itasambaza mbegu za chai zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay abuurka shaaha ee shahaadada leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Machakos bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro pogo kodhi mag chai ne jopur e gweng' mar Machakos e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: NCPB will distribute certified coffee seed to farmers in Vihiga County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NCPB itasambaza mbegu za kahawa zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga mwezi Mei huu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay abuurka kafeega ee shahaadada leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Vihiga County bisha May ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar NCPB biro pogo kodhi mag chai ne jopur e County mar Vihiga e dwe mar Mei.

English: Public notice: Kenya Red Cross will host a free hand hygiene outreach in Meru County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Meru Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay marti gelineysaa dhaqdhaqaaqa nadaafadda gacmaha ee bilaashka ah ee degmada Meru bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova mar Kenya Red Cross biro timo kampen mar rito ler mar lwete e dwe mar Agost e kaunti mar Meru.

English: Council of Governors reminds the public in Garissa County that input on development planning forums is welcome this April.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba mchango kwenye vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo unakaribishwa Aprili hii.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay xasuusinayaan shacabka degmada Garissa in talooyinka ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta la soo dhaweynayo bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch oparo ne ji duto e gweng' mar Garissa ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mag dongruok e dwe mar April.

English: Self protection is social protection. Take action to slow the spread of Coronavirus by wearing a face mask when you go out in the public following this advice by @janengoiri to #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Kujilinda ni ulinzi wa kijamii. Chukua hatua kupunguza kasi ya kuenea kwa Coronavirus kwa kuvaa barakoa unapoenda hadharani kwa kufuata ushauri huu wa @janengoiri kwa #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Is-ilaalinta naftu waa ilaalin bulsho. Qaado tallaabo aad ku yareyso faafitaanka Coronavirus adigoo xiran maaskaro wejiga marka aad dadweynaha ku dhex baxdo adigoo raacaya taladan uu @janengoiri u diray #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Rito ng’ato owuon en rito oganda. Kaw okang' mar geng'o landore mar midhusi mar Corona kuom rwako mask mar wang' sama idhi oko ei oganda ka iluwo paro ma @janengoiri ochiw ne #KomeshaCorona .

English: EACC urges residents of Taita-Taveta County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta watumie portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Taita-Taveta inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u soo gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo kwayo mar kedo gi mibadhi mar chulo pesa.

English: Council of Governors updates residents of Samburu County on progress of ward-level service delivery this January.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu juu ya maendeleo ya usambazaji wa huduma kwa kiwango cha wilaya Januari hii.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay dadka deggan degmada Samburu ku wargeliyaan horumarka la xiriira bixinta adeegyada heerka degmada bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch olero ne jogweng' Samburu County dongruok mar chiwo kony e wi ward e dwe mar Januar.

English:
