English: Embu (Mbeere) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Embu (Mbeere): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Februari 2023
Somali: Degmada Embu (Mbeere): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Embu (Mbeere): Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2023

English: Government publishes market price index for smallholder farmers.
Kiswahili: Serikali inachapisha fahirisi ya bei ya soko kwa wakulima wadogo.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay daabacday tusmada qiimaha suuqa ee beeraleyda yaryar.
Dholuo: Sirkal keto e lela ratiro mar nengo mar pesa e piny ne jopur matindo.

English: ODPP reminds voters in Marsabit County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Marsabit inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor inta aysan helin waxbarashada codbixinta.
Dholuo: ODPP paronwa jogweng' mar Marsabit mondo onyis weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom SMS ne ji 70000 kapok giyudo tiegruok.

English: NTSA reminds mobile money users in Narok County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Narok kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee Gobolka Narok inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado khiyaamada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: NTSA paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e gweng' mar Narok ni mondo ging'e kwayo mag pesa kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo kik gitim wuond mag SIM-swap.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges residents of Nakuru County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inay ka qeybgalaan kalfadhiga guud ee golaha gobolka si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda horumarinta gobolka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General jiwo jogweng' Nakuru County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo omed ng'eyo weche momedore e wi chenro mag dongruok mag county.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) invites residents of Busia County to attend the public participation forum regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Busia kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya wilaya.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Busia inay ka soo qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) gwelo joma odak e county mar Busia mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenro mar bajet mar county.

English: CS visits Litein Boys High School for renovations.
Kiswahili: CS hutembelea Litein Boys High School kwa ajili ya ukarabati.
Somali: CS waxay booqataa Dugsiga Sare ee Wiilasha ee Litein si loo dayactiro.
Dholuo: CS dhi limo skul mar Litein Boys High School mondo olose.

English: Kenya - Cholera outbreak (DG ECHO, Ministry of Health of Kenya, WHO) (ECHO Daily Flash of 09 April 2025)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Mlipuko wa Kipindupindu (DG ECHO, Wizara ya Afya ya Kenya, WHO) (ECHO Daily Flash ya 09 Aprili 2025)
Somali: Kenya - Cudurka daacuunka oo ka dillaacay (DG ECHO, Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Kenya, WHO) (ECHO Daily Flash ee 09 Abriil 2025)
Dholuo: Kenya - Tuwo mar kolera (DG ECHO, Od Romo mar Thieth mar Kenya, WHO)

English: Embu (Mbeere) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Embu (Mbeere): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Mei 2022
Somali: Degmada Embu (Mbeere): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Embu (Mbeere): Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar abich higa mar 2022

English: Stakeholders in Ecological Organic Agriculture are invited to utilize 100 acres of land allocated in Dodoma for organic farming activities
Kiswahili: Wadau wa Kilimo Hai cha Kiikolojia waalikwa kutumia ekari 100 za ardhi iliyotengwa Dodoma kwa shughuli za kilimo hai.
Somali: Daneeyayaasha Beeraha Deegaanka ee Organic waxaa lagu casuumay inay isticmaalaan 100 acres oo dhul ah oo loo qoondeeyay Dodoma hawlaha beeraleyda dabiiciga ah
Dholuo: Oganda ma nigi paro e weche mag pur gi pur, igwelo mondo oti gi puothe mag pur gi pur ma romo ekare 100 ma ne omi e dala mar Dodoma

English: The government advices ll people to wear masks and to be vaccinated, now that Kenya is covered with dark cloud of Covid 19
Kiswahili: Serikali yawashauri watu wote kuvaa barakoa na kupata chanjo, kwa kuwa sasa Kenya imefunikwa na wingu jeusi la Covid 19.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay dadka ku talineysaa inay xirtaan maaskaro iyo in la tallaalo, hadda oo Kenya ay ku jirto daruur madow oo COVID-19 ah
Dholuo: Sirkal osejiwo ji duto mondo orwak lewni mag geng'ruok kod thiethgi, sani ka Kenya opong' gi bor polo mar Covid 19

English: The government is supplying 781 800 seedlings including 40 000 cocoa seedlings to farmers in 17 counties to promote food security and crop diversification
Kiswahili: Serikali inasambaza miche 781 800 ikiwa ni pamoja na miche 40,000 ya kakao kwa wakulima katika kaunti 17 ili kukuza usalama wa chakula na mseto wa mazao.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay siisay 781,800 abuur oo ay ku jiraan 40,000 geedo kooko ah beeralayda ku nool 17 degmo si loo dhiirrigeliyo amniga cuntada iyo kala duwanaanshaha dalagyada
Dholuo: Sirkal chiwo kodhi 781,800 moriwo kodhi 40,000 mag kakao ne jopur e gwenge 17 mondo okony e miyo chiemo obedie maber kendo e miyo cham bedo mopogore opogore

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Machakos County about the importance of food safety for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuhusu umuhimu wa usalama wa chakula kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMSA waxay dadweynaha degmada Machakos ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda badbaadada cuntada ay u leedahay caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa ji duto e County ma Machakos kuom gimomiyo rito chiemo en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service restricts movement of cattle in Kwale County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya yazuia harakati za ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kwale kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi wenye uvimbe.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da Gobolka Kwale sababo la xiriira faafitaanka cudurka maqaarka.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok e county mar Kwale nikech tuwono mar pien.

English: Despite localized improvements following the Marchâ€“May rains, drought remains acute in northern counties such as Mandera and Wajir.
Kiswahili: Licha ya uboreshaji wa ndani kufuatia mvua ya Machi-Mei, ukame unaendelea kuwa mkali katika kaunti za kaskazini kama vile Mandera na Wajir.
Somali: Iyadoo ay jiraan horumarro ku yimid deegaannada ka dib roobabkii Maarso - Maajo - haddana abaartu waxay weli ka jirtaa gobollada waqooyi sida Mandheera iyo Wajeer.
Dholuo: Kata obedo ni ne otimre maber bang' koth ma ne oumo dwe mar adek nyaka dwe mar abich, oro pod nitie e gwenge ma yo nyandwat kaka Mandera kod Wajir.

English: KALRO urges farmers in Turkana County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Turkana kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Turkana inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e county mar Turkana mondo opidh olembe ma nyalo miyo lowo okethre mondo ginyagre gi lokruok e kaka koth chue.

English: Transform your raw grains into a higher-value honey wine. Discover simple processing methods and potential markets.
Kiswahili: Badilisha nafaka yako kuwa divai ya asali yenye thamani zaidi.
Somali: Beerahaaga ceyriinka ah u beddelo khamri macaan oo qiimo sare leh.
Dholuo: Tim nonro e wi cham ma in-go kendo ilosgi obed divai ma nigi mor mogundho. Tem ng'eyo yore mayot mag loso divai kod kuonde ma inyalo yudoe ohala.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Nakuru County that access to SHA registration is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba ufikiaji wa usajili wa SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya dadweynaha degmada Nakuru in helitaanka diiwaangelinta SHA ay hadda laga heli karaa xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji duto e gweng' mar Nakuru ni sani ginyalo yudo weche mag SHA e kuonde ma ji oseyiero.

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Samburu County that access to free antenatal care is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma ya bure ya ujauzito ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Samburu in helitaanka daryeelka uurka ka hor ee bilaashka ah ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMSA oparo ne mine ma biro nyuolo e county mar Samburu ni thuolo mar yudo rit ma onge chudo mar nywolo en maonge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: NPS urges residents of Kisii County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NPS inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama katikati ya umakini mkubwa wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga dhaqdhaqaaqa aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo jogweng' Kisii County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkande mag sirkal kuom timbe maok kare ma timore e alwora mar tong'gi e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi kuom loso kuwe e pinygi.

English: KICD reminds schools in Machakos County to strengthen child protection in schools this February.
Kiswahili: KICD inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuimarisha ulinzi wa watoto shuleni Februari hii.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Machakos inay xoojiyaan ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne skunde man Machakos County mondo omed jiwo rit mar nyithindo e skunde e dwe mar Februar.

English: KMTC conducts a civic education forum on voter registration in Embu County this August.
Kiswahili: KMTC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Embu Agosti hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee degmada Embu bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: KMTC dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi ndiko joma oyiero e county mar Embu e dwe mar Agost.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Laikipia County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuleta nambari yao ya usajili wa mkulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Laikipia inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qayb galaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e county mar Laikipia mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free Rift Valley Fever screening is available at all public health centres in Laikipia County this September.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Septemba hii.
Somali: Qeybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka bilaashka ah ee Rift Valley Fever laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynta ee Gobolka Laikipia bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji ni nono tuoche mag Rift Valley Fever en gima nono e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Laikipia e dwe mar Septemba.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Samburu County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Samburu in warbixinta degdegga ah ee jabsashada ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NDMA oparo ne jogweng' Samburu County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar donjo e ot konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Always wash and boil baby bottles and nipples to kill germs before each use
Kiswahili: Osha na chemsha chupa za watoto na chuchu kila wakati ili kuua vijidudu kabla ya kila matumizi.
Somali: Had iyo jeer maydho oo ku kari dhalooyinka ilmaha iyo naas-nuujinta si loo dilo bakteeriyada ka hor isticmaalka
Dholuo: Kinde duto lwok kendo iketh chai mag nyithindo kod nyigi mondo ineg kute kapok itiyogo

English: Horticulture exporters in Kajiado and Meru are facing double taxation Stakeholders are urged to report these taxation issues to the government for resolution
Kiswahili: Wauzaji wa mazao ya bustani huko Kajiado na Meru wanakabiliwa na kutozwa ushuru maradufu Wadau wanahimizwa kuripoti maswala haya ya ushuru kwa serikali ili kutatuliwa.
Somali: Dhoofiyeyaasha beeralayda ee Kajiado iyo Meru ayaa wajahaya canshuur laba-laab ah Daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay dowladda u soo gudbiyaan arrimadan canshuuraha si loo xalliyo
Dholuo: Jo ohala mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag Kajiado kod Meru yudo chulo osuru nyadiriyo Jo madwaro konyogi mondo ginyis sirkal mondo ong'e kaka ginyalo loyo pekgo

English: Mandera County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Mandera: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Mandheera: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Mandera: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar Septemba 2022

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages residents of Makueni County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay la xiriiraan lataliye la tababaran yahay.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Makueni County mondo kik gisandre aling' ling' kendo mondo giwuo gi jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Public health advisory: Kenya Red Cross warns of increased cholera risk in Trans Nzoia County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya kipindupindu katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia na kushauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Warbixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ka digeysaa kororka halista cudurka kolera ee Gobolka Trans Nzoia waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska loo maleynayo inay u yimaadaan mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Chenro mar thieth mar ji: Kenya Red Cross chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar cholera e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia County kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore mar konyo e thieth.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds livestock keepers in Nairobi County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Nairobi inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyaga oo aan haysan rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jorit jamni e County mar Nairobi ni kik giting' jamni ka ok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: Notice: NCPB will train farmers in Kwale County on agroforestry this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale juu ya kilimo cha misitu Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kwale ee ku saabsan beeraha kaynta bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Rapar: NCPB biro tiego jopur e Kwale County e weche mag agroforestry e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: DCI urges the community in Homa Bay County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb carjacking.
Kiswahili: DCI inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia utekaji nyara wa magari.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada gobolka Homa Bay inay ku biiraan mashaariicda booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo afduubka gawaarida.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo oganda manie Homa Bay County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polis mar oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o kwalo mtokni.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will train farmers in Nyamira County on water harvesting this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhusu uvunaji wa maji Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha Kenya wuxuu tababar siin doonaa beeraleyda degmada Nyamira oo ku saabsan goosashada biyaha bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Dairy Board biro tiego jopur e County mar Nyamira e wi choko pi e dwe mar Mei.

English: Teachers Service Commission calls on the community in Taita-Taveta County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu ugu baaqay bulshada degmada Taita-Taveta inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116 si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyada.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj kwayo ji duto manie Taita-Taveta County mondo omany namba mar 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: NPS urges residents of Busia County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: NPS inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: NPS ojiwo ji duto modak e county mar Busia mondo oriwgi lwedo e nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'adoe bura e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom weche mag rito tong'.

English: DPP urges the community in Kisumu County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb theft.
Kiswahili: DPP anaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Kisumu inay ka warbixiyaan waxqabadka shakiga ah xarunta booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: DPP okwayo ji duto manie gweng' mar Kisumu mondo onyis polis ma ni machiegni gi kanyo ni gitimo gik ma chando ji.

English: Garissa County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Garissa: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2024
Somali: Degmada Gaarisa: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Garissa: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar apar 2024

English: State Department for Basic Education urges parents and teachers in Nairobi County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Nairobi inay u soo sheegaan maamulka dugsiga wixii arrimo ah ee ku saabsan amniga.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Nairobi mondo onyis sirkal mar skul wach moro amora motudore gi ritruok.

English: NPS urges motorists and pedestrians in Mombasa County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NPS inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa gawaarida wadayaasha iyo dadka lugta leh ee degmada Mombasa inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay adeegsadaan meelaha lugta loo qoondeeyey si looga hortago dhacdooyinka abaarta la xiriira.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo joidh mtokni kod jowuoth e county mar Mombasa mondo oluw tong' mar wuoth kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe mondo gikwed masiche ma nyalo bedoe nikech oro.

English: Pest Control Products Board encourages farmers in Siaya County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for fish.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora ya samaki.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda degmada Siaya inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo kalluunka ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e county mar Siaya mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mondo omi rech obed gi nengo maber.

English: AFA reminds farmers in Kajiado County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kajiado juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kajiado barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada.
Dholuo: AFA parone jopur e Kajiado County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche.

English: NPS urges the public in Lamu County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of identity theft.
Kiswahili: NPS inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: NPS waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadweynaha degmada Lamu inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib dhacdooyinka la soo sheegay ee tuugista aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo ji duto e County mar Lamu mondo ochiw ripot mar ote manyalo kelo hinyruok ne jomisonari margi bang' weche mag kwalo kitgi.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges wheat growers in Busia County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Busia kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda wheat ee degmada Busia inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si kor loogu qaado wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur mag ngano e county mar Busia mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo okony e medo nyak mar cham e higani.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response appeals to caregivers in West Pokot County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the January maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Januari.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada West Pokot inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha ee qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka ee Janaayo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo kwayo jorit e West Pokot County mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathine kaka achiel kuom chenro mar January Maternal Health drive.

English: FAO urges maize growers in Machakos County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawasihi wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Machakos kudhibiti wizi wa jeshi la kuanguka mapema kwa kutumia dawa za kuua wadudu zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Machakos in ay horumariyaan weerarkii ciidanka ee dayrta iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaanka la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma pidho cham e gweng ' mar Machakos mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma oseyudo ratiro mar timo kamano chon ka gitiyo gi gik makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok mondo gimi nyak e higani.

English: KALRO urges beans growers in Migori County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Migori kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Migori inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobka si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur ma pidho keyo e county mar Migori mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue mondo omed kelo nyak e higani.

English: Office of the Auditor-General warns public officers in Mandera County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera dhidi ya udanganyifu wa fedha za umma.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Mandera inay ka xishoodaan lacagaha dawladda.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal man Mandera County ni kik giti gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo e yo marach.

English: IPOA urges motorists and pedestrians in Bungoma County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Bungoma inay guryahooda rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dabka daminta iyo inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa dhacdooyinka abaarta la xiriira.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo joidh mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Bungoma mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo giti matek mondo gikwed masiche motudore gi oro.

English: Agricultural market access and value addition. To enhance agricultural product development and marketing systems. Producers and market associations formed ...
Kiswahili: Ufikiaji wa soko la kilimo na uongezaji wa thamani. Ili kuboresha mifumo ya ukuzaji na uuzaji wa bidhaa za kilimo. Wazalishaji na vyama vya soko vilianzishwa ...
Somali: Helitaanka suuqa beeraha iyo qiimaha lagu kordhiyo. Si loo horumariyo nidaamyada horumarinta iyo suuqgeynta alaabta beeraha. Soo saarayaasha iyo ururada suuqyada ayaa la sameeyay ...
Dholuo: Tiego ohala mag puodho kod ohala mag puodho.

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit warns of increased cholera risk in Homa Bay County and advises the public to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya kipindupindu katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay na inashauri umma kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa ka digtay khatarta sii kordheysa ee cudurka kolera ee gobolka Homa Bay waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay isla markiiba baaritaan ka sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar oganda: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osiemo ji kuom medruok mar tuo mar cholera e Homa Bay County kendo ojiwo ji mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal mar thieth man machiegni kodgi.

English: Kitui County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for December 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kitui: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Desemba 2023
Somali: Degmada Kitui: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Diseembar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kitui: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2023

English: Nyeri (Kieni) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Nyeri (Kieni): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Oktoba 2024
Somali: Degmada Nyeri (Kieni): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Nyeri (Kieni): Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Oktoba 2024

English: SHA urges residents of Kericho County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: SHA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kericho mondo oriwre gi county's online participation portal e loso nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds residents of Turkana County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana ku xasuusinaya inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay adeegsadaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lugta lagu maro inta lagu jiro xilliyada shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations parone jogweng' County mar Turkana mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo oti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe e kinde masiche mag ndara.

English: Universities Fund reminds schools in Marsabit County to strengthen child protection in schools this June.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuimarisha ulinzi wa watoto shuleni Juni hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xusuusinayaa dugsiyada degmada Marsabit inay xoojiyaan ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa skunde mag Marsabit County mondo omed jiwo rit mar nyithindo e skunde e dwe mar Jun.

English: KICD announces distribution of textbooks and learning materials to schools in Tharaka-Nithi County this June.
Kiswahili: KICD inatangaza usambazaji wa vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Juni hii.
Somali: KICD waxay ku dhawaaqday qaybinta buugaagta waxbarasho iyo qalabka wax lagu barto dugsiyada degmada Tharaka-Nithi bishii Juun.
Dholuo: KICD ong'ado mar pogo buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok e skunde mag Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar Jun.

English: Feed poultry and swine during the cooler hours of early morning and late evening, and cool large livestock such as cattle, sheep, goats, and pigs by misting them with water or letting them wallow in shallow water.
Kiswahili: Lisha kuku na nguruwe wakati wa baridi asubuhi na mapema jioni, na upoze mifugo mikubwa kama vile ng'ombe, kondoo, mbuzi na nguruwe kwa kuwanyunyiza maji au kuwaacha waingie kwenye maji ya kina kifupi.
Somali: Hagaajinta digaagga iyo doofaarka saacadaha qabow ee subaxdii hore iyo fiidkii dambe, iyo xoolaha waaweyn sida lo'da, idaha, riyaha iyo doofaarka qaboojinta iyaga oo biyo ku qasiyay ama u oggolaanaya inay ku dhuumaalaan biyaha hooseeya.
Dholuo: Chiemuru le kod anguru e seche mag koyo mang'ich ahinya, ka okinyi kod odhiambo, kendo rituru jamni madongo kaka dhok, rombe, diek, kod anguru ka umogi gi pi kata ka uwegi mondo gipodhi e pi matin.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges residents of Garissa County to complete the full recommended vaccination dose following a rise in reported HIV/AIDS cases.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya VVU/UKIMWI.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Garissa inay dhammaystiraan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo ka dib kororka kiisaska HIV / AIDS ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Garissa mondo ochop e okang' moromo mar thieth ma gichiwo nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuo mar AYAKI/AIDS osemedore.

English: KTDA announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for poultry in Homa Bay County this June.
Kiswahili: KTDA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa kuku katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Juni hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee digaagga ee gobolka Homa Bay bishii Juun.
Dholuo: KTDA olando chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo e dwe mar Jun e Homa Bay County.

English: SHA urges residents of Kisumu County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: SHA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si loo qaabeeyo geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jogweng' mar Kisumu County mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso bajet mar county ochopo.

English: I have invoked the public health act after it was declared a pandemic. Thoroughly wash hands and use alcohol based sanitizers. Keep 1-meter distance from a person who is sneezing or coughing. A person who is coughing or sneezing should stay at home and avoid crowds
Kiswahili: Nimeitisha sheria ya afya ya umma baada ya kutangazwa kuwa janga. Osha mikono vizuri na utumie vitakasa mikono vyenye pombe. Weka umbali wa mita 1 kutoka kwa mtu anayepiga chafya au kukohoa. Mtu anayekohoa au kupiga chafya anapaswa kukaa nyumbani na kuepuka misongamano ya watu.
Somali: Waxaan ku baaqay sharciga caafimaadka dadweynaha ka dib markii lagu dhawaaqay cudurka faafa. Gacmaha si taxadar leh u maydho oo isticmaal daawooyinka nadiifinta khamriga ku saleysan. ka fogaada 1 mitir qofkii qiiqaya ama quuqaya. Qofka quuqa ama quuuqaya waa inuu guriga joogaa oo dad badan iska ilaaliyaa
Dholuo: Ne atiyo gi chik mar thieth mar oganda bang' kane oseng'ere ni en tuo mar tuoche. Lwok lweti adimba kendo iti gi yedhe malero remo moting'o kong'o. Ket tong' mar mita achiel gi ng'at ma chido kata chido. Ng'at machido kata machido onego odag e ot kendo otang' gi ji mang'eny

English: Garissa County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Garissa: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2023
Somali: Degmada Garissa: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Garissa: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar apar 2023

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of Homa Bay County about a rise in phishing messages and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: Kenya Red Cross inawaonya wakazi wa Wilaya ya Homa Bay juu ya kuongezeka kwa ujumbe wa udanganyifu na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay kororka farriimaha phishing waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax falin.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross osiemo jogweng' Homa Bay County kuom wach medruok mar weche mag phishing kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: Notice: KUCCPS launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay bilawday barnaamij ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada iskuulada guud ahaan Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KUCCPS chako chenro mar rito nyithindo e skul e skunde duto mag Wajir County.

English: Notice from KEMSA: free antenatal care clinics will run every September at designated health centres in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa KEMSA: kliniki za bure za utunzaji wa ujauzito zitaendeshwa kila Septemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid KEMSA: rugaha daryeelka dhalmada ee bilaashka ah waxaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Sebtember ee xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMSA: Klinike mag rito nyithindo kapok onyuol biro tiyo dwe mar ochiko higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e county mar Uasin Gishu.

English: State Department for TVET announces distribution of revision guides to schools in Isiolo County this August.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yatangaza usambazaji wa miongozo ya marekebisho kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Agosti hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhawaaqday qaybinta hagaha dib u eegista dugsiyada degmada Isiolo bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag somo e skunde man Isiolo County e dwe mar Agost.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges farmers in Samburu County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Guddiga xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda gobolka Samburu inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Chandruok jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Samburu mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi pur mar piny mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: Zambian farmers are urged to know how to identify the symptoms of cassava brown streak disease on infected cassava roots, stems, and leaves, and to know where to get disease-free cassava planting materials.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Zambia wanahimizwa kujua dalili za ugonjwa wa mhogo wa mhogo kwenye mizizi, mashina, na majani yaliyoambukizwa, na kujua mahali pa kupata vifaa visivyo na maradhi ya muhogo.
Somali: Beeraleyda Zambia waxaa lagu booriyaa inay ogaadaan sida loo aqoonsado calaamadaha cudurka cassava ee xididdada cassava, caleemaha iyo caleemaha uu ku dhacay, iyo meesha laga helo qalabka lagu beerayo cassava oo aan cudur lahayn.
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur ma Zambia mondo ong'e kaka ginyalo fwenyo tuwo mar manias ma bedo e tiendgi, tong'gi, kod kite ma nigi tuwo mar manias, kendo ging'e kama ginyalo yudoe gik ma ginyalo pidho manias ma onge tuoche.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds expectant mothers in Migori County that access to postnatal check-ups is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Migori kwamba upatikanaji wa uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Migori in helitaanka baaritaannada dhalmada ka dib ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne mine ma nigi ich e county mar Migori ni thuolo mar dhi e nonro bang' nyuol en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag sirkal.

English: Notice: NPS launches a carjacking prevention campaign in Busia County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NPS yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia utekaji nyara katika Kaunti ya Busia Januari hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: NPS waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga dhacda baabuurta degmada Busia bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar National Police (NPS) chako kampen mar geng'o joma kwalo mtokni e taon mar Busia e dwe mar Januar.

English: Turkana County is implementing flood based farming to combat food insecurity Farmers in the area should engage with the Kakong u project to improve agricultural productivity
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Turkana inatekeleza kilimo kulingana na mafuriko ili kukabiliana na uhaba wa chakula Wakulima katika eneo hilo wanapaswa kushirikiana na mradi wa Kakong u ili kuboresha uzalishaji wa kilimo.
Somali: Turkana County waxay hirgelinaysaa beeraley ku saleysan fatahaadaha si ay ula dagaallanto cunto la'aanta Beeraleyda deegaanka waa inay ka qayb qaataan mashruuca Kakongu u si loo kordhiyo wax-soosaarka beeraha
Dholuo: Turkana County tiyo gi yore mag pur mar pi e kedo gi yuto mar chiemo Jo-Farmer e alworano onego oti gi chenro mar Kakong u e medo nyak mar pur

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds residents of Marsabit County that terracing improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba usafirishaji wa mipaka huboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Marsabit in dhulka lagu beerayo uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board parone jogweng' mar Marsabit County ni terracing medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: KRA urges residents of Kisii County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kudai kutoa huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: KRA waxay dadka deggan degmada Kisii ugu baaqeysaa inay dalbadaan bixinta adeegyada aan la bixin laaluush si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kisii mondo ochiw kony maok ochulo asoya mondo giked gi asoya e migepe mag sirkal.

English: Notice from CDC: family planning counselling clinics will run every January at designated health centres in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa CDC: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Januari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Tana River.
Somali: Ogaysiis ka yimid CDC: rugta la talinta qorshaynta qoyska waxay ka shaqeyn doontaa Janaayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee lagu magacaabo degmada Tana River.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar yedhe ma thiedho tuoche (CDC): klinik mag chiwo paro e wi chenro mag ngima joot biro dhi nyime higa ka higa e dwe mar Januar e kuonde thieth moyier e taon mar Tana River County.

English: OGP reminds the public in Kirinyaga County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kirinyaga in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: OGP paronwa ji duto e County mar Kirinyaga ni chiwo ripot mar asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Feeling low? Reaching for alcohol won't lift you up â€” it's a depressant that can make things worse. Choose real healing: talk to a counselor, join a support group, or reach out for help.
Kiswahili: Kuhisi umekata tamaa? Kunywa pombe hakutakuinua - ni dawa ya kufadhaisha ambayo inaweza kufanya mambo kuwa mabaya zaidi. Chagua uponyaji halisi: zungumza na mshauri, jiunge na kikundi cha usaidizi, au wasiliana nasi kwa msaada.
Somali: Ma dareemaysaa hoos u dhac? Raacitaanka khamriga kor kuuma qaadi doono - waa niyad-jab niyad-jab leh oo wax ka sii dari kara. Dooro bogsiin dhab ah: la hadal la-taliye, ku biir koox taageero, ama la xiriir caawimo.
Dholuo: Be iwinjo ka in piny? Kuong’ruok mar madho kong’o ok bi ting’i malo â€” en gino ma kelo paro mang’eny ma nyalo medo rach moloyo. Yier thieth madier: wuo gi japuonj, donj e grup mar konyo, kata choporuok mar yudo kony.

English: KICD urges parents and teachers in Kilifi County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: KICD inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: KICD waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Kilifi inay u soo sheegaan mas'uuliyadda amniga dugsiga.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar skul e wi weche duto motudore gi ritruok.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges sorghum growers in Makueni County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Udhibiti wa Pest Products inawasihi wakulima wa sorghum katika Kaunti ya Makueni kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurudisha uzazi wa udongo ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda sorghum ee degmada Makueni in ay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarkii xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Pest Control Products Board jiwo jopur mag sorghum e kaunti mar Makueni mondo oti gi lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber kendo mondo omed nyak e higani.

English: ODPP reminds residents of Bungoma County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma in helitaanka adeegyada baasaboorka ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: ODPP oparo ne jogweng'o mag Bungoma County ni koro yot yudo passport kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will conduct a greenhouse farming workshop for farmers in Migori County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itafanya warsha ya kilimo cha chafu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo ee beeraleyda Degmada Migori bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro timo tiegruok mar pidho jopur e alwora mar Migori e dwe mar Agost e higani.

English: KALRO informs fish farmers in Embu County of new market linkage opportunities this September.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawafahamisha wakulima wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Embu kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Septemba hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku wargelineysaa kalluumeysatada degmada Embu fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KALRO nyiso jopur ma pidho rech e county mar Embu kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Septemba.

English: TVET urges youth in Laikipia County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: TVET waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Laikipia inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo rowere e County mar Laikipia mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok ochopo tije mag oganda.

English: KEPHIS urges farmers in Kwale County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kwale inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kwale mondo opidh cham mondo omi lowo okethre, mondo omi giritre kuom lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: Notice: KMTC opens applications for revision guides for learners in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay furaysaa codsiyada hagaha dib u eegista ardayda ku nool degmada Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC oseyawo kwayo mag somo mar somo e alwora mar Lamu County.

English: What Is Therapeutic Milk? Treating Severe Child Malnutrition
Kiswahili: Maziwa ya Tiba ni nini? Kutibu Utapiamlo Mkali wa Mtoto
Somali: Waa maxay Caanaha Daaweynta? Daaweynta Nafaqo-xumada Ba'an ee Carruurta
Dholuo: Ang’o ma En Milk ma Thieth? Chiwo thieth marach mar nyithindo ma nigi tuwo mar chiemo ma ok owinjore

English: Wajir County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Wajir: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Mei 2023
Somali: Degmada Wajeer: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Wajir: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar abich 2023

English: Official statement reaffirming Kenyaâ€™s commitment to front-of-pack labeling, food marketing restrictions, and cross-border policy coordination.
Kiswahili: Taarifa rasmi ikithibitisha tena kujitolea kwa Kenya kwa kutambulisha vifurushi vya mbele, vizuizi vya uuzaji wa chakula, na uratibu wa sera za mpakani.
Somali: War rasmi ah oo xaqiijinaya sida Kenya uga go'an tahay calaamadaynta badeecadaha, xayiraadaha suuqgeynta cuntada, iyo isuduwidda siyaasadda xuduudaha ka gudbeysa.
Dholuo: Oboke ma sirkal onyiso kendo ni piny Kenya ochung' motegno e keto lembâ€TM e nyim gik ma oting'o chiemo, geng'o chike mag uso chiemo, kod loso chenro mar loso chiemo e kind pinje mamoko.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will open a milk collection centre in Marsabit County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itafungua kituo cha kukusanya maziwa katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay bilaabi doontaa xarun ururinta caanaha ee degmada Marsabit bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro yawo kambi mar choko chak e Marsabit County e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: KALRO restricts movement of sheep in Baringo County due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO inazuia harakati za kondoo katika Kaunti ya Baringo kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Newcastle.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa idaha ee degmada Baringo sababtuna tahay cudurka Newcastle.
Dholuo: Rieko: KALRO ogeng'o wuoth mar rombe e taon mar Baringo nikech tuo mar Newcastle.

English: Public notice: KEMSA will host a free hypertension awareness outreach in Nandi County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMSA itakuwa mwenyeji wa uhamasishaji wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Nandi Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska Dadweynaha: KEMSA waxay marti gelineysaa wacyi-gelin bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cadaadiska dhiig karka ee gobolka Nandi bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMSA biro timo kampen mar konyo ji ng'eyo ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar hypertension maonge chudo e dwe mar Oktoba e county mar Nandi.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of West Pokot County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on community-based development programmes.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya West Pokot kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waendelee kuwa na habari juu ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot County inay la xiriiraan maamulayaashooda degmada si ay uga warqabaan barnaamijyada horumarinta ee ku saleysan bulshada.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jotelo mag gwenge ma gidakie mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi chenro mag dongruok mag oganda.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Kericho County that access to SHA registration is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba ufikiaji wa usajili wa SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kericho in gelitaanka diiwaangelinta SHA hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth parone ji duto e County mar Kericho ni sani ginyalo yudo weche mag SHA e kuonde ma oket.

English: Ministry of Education advises students in Kisii County to register early to secure allocation to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kisii kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata maudhui ya ujifunzaji wa kidijitali bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ardayda degmada Kisii kula talineysaa inay horay u diiwaangeliyaan si ay u helaan deeq loogu talagalay helitaanka waxyaabaha barashada dijitaalka ah ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jopuonjre manie Kisii County mondo odonj e tiegruok chon mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo somo mar digital maonge chudo.

English: Refugee-Led Organisations In East Africa: Community Perceptions In Kenya, Uganda, Ethiopia, And Tanzania
Kiswahili: Mashirika Yanayoongozwa na Wakimbizi Katika Afrika Mashariki: Maoni ya Jumuiya Nchini Kenya, Uganda, Ethiopia na Tanzania
Somali: Ururada ay Hormoodka ka yihiin Qaxootiga ee Bariga Afrika: Aragtida Bulshada ee Kenya, Uganda, Itoobiya, iyo Tansaaniya
Dholuo: Riwruoge Motelo kod Jolweny e Afrika ma Wuokchieng': Paro mag oganda e piny Kenya, Uganda, Ethiopia, kod Tanzania

English: KRA announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: KRA inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Somali: KRA waxay ku dhawaaqday waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee Degmada Tharaka-Nithi.
Dholuo: KRA oseng'ado ni ibiro med kinde mag timo kwayo mag ng'eyo ng'ato e kaunti mar Tharaka-Nithi.

English: Dr. Salim Hussein from the Ministry of Health gives you tips on how you can prevent yourself from getting COVID-19 infection. Please share with others to help prevent Coronavirus in Kenya. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Dk. Salim Hussein kutoka Wizara ya Afya anakupa vidokezo kuhusu jinsi unavyoweza kujikinga na maambukizi ya COVID-19. Tafadhali shiriki na wengine ili kusaidia kuzuia Virusi vya Corona nchini Kenya. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Dr. Salim Hussein oo ka socda Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ku siinaya talooyin ku saabsan sida aad iskaga ilaalin karto inaad qaaddo caabuqa COVID-19. Fadlan la wadaag dadka kale si aad uga hortagto Coronavirus-ka Kenya. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Laktar Salim Hussein mawuok e Od Romo mar Thieth miyi paro kaka inyalo geng'o yudo tuo mar COVID-19. Yie mondo ipar ne jomoko mondo okony e geng'o Corona e piny Kenya. #KomeshaKorona

English: Improving market access and infrastructure Invest in rural infrastructure such as roads and storage facilities and promote digital platforms
Kiswahili: Kuboresha upatikanaji wa soko na miundombinu Wekeza katika miundombinu ya vijijini kama vile barabara na vifaa vya kuhifadhia vitu na tangaza majukwaa ya kidijitali
Somali: Horumarinta helitaanka suuqyada iyo kaabayaasha Maalgelinta kaabayaasha miyiga sida waddooyinka iyo xarumaha kaydka iyo kor u qaadista madalaha dijitaalka ah
Dholuo: Medruok mar yudo thuolo mar tiyo gi yore mag ohala kod yore mag yudo kony mag ohala Tiyo gi yore mag ohala e gwenge mag gweng' kaka nderni kod kuonde ma okanie gik moko kendo jiwo yore mag digital

English: Fraudsters posing as election observers have been soliciting money from aspirants for fake clearance. IEBC does not charge for clearance forms.
Kiswahili: Walaghai wanaojifanya waangalizi wa uchaguzi wamekuwa wakiomba pesa kutoka kwa wagombea kwa ajili ya kibali bandia. IEBC haitozi ada kwa fomu za kibali.
Somali: Khiyaameeyayaasha iska dhigaya kormeerayaasha doorashada ayaa lacag ka dalbanayay musharixiinta si ay u helaan ogolaansho been abuur ah. IEBC lacag kama qaado foomamka ogolaanshaha.
Dholuo: Jowuondo ma timore kaka joneno mag yiero osebedo ka gikwayo pesa kuom jogo ma dwaro bedo jogo ma ng’ado bura mar miriambo. IEBC ok chul pesa kuom fom mag ng’ado bura.

English: HELB advises students in Bungoma County to register early to secure allocation to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: HELB inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali.
Somali: HELB waxay ardayda degmada Bungoma kula talineysaa inay horay u diiwaangeliyaan si ay u helaan kaalmo ay ku helaan kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jopuonjre mag Bungoma County mondo odonj e tiegruok chon mondo giyud pesa mar tiyo gi kompyuta mag skul kaluwore gi chenro mar somo gi somo.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Nyeri County about the importance of hand hygiene for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhusu umuhimu wa usafi wa mikono kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMSA waxay dadweynaha degmada Nyeri ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda nadaafadda gacmaha ay u leedahay caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa ji duto e County mar Nyeri gimomiyo rito ler mar lwedo en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: IEBC warns public officers in Homa Bay County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: IEBC inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Homa Bay County dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: IEBC waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee gobolka Homa Bay inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: IEBC chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e Homa Bay County ni kik giti marach gi migawo ma gin-go.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges motorists and pedestrians in Kericho County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Kericho inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay adeegsadaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee socodka si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo joidh mtokni kod jowuoth e County mar Kericho mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe mondo gikwed masiche ma nyalo bedoe nikech ataro.

English: Notice: TVET opens a new welding and fabrication programme at the vocational centre in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inafungua programu mpya ya kulehemu na utengenezaji katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan alxanka iyo soo saarista xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Migori.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: TVET chako chenro manyien mar loso kendo loso gik moko e skul mar tich e gweng' mar Migori.

Kiswahili: Wakulima nchini Uganda Wizara ya Kilimo itasaidia bidhaa muhimu msimu huu ikiwa ni pamoja na matunda ya chai mifugo na mbegu Kuwasiliana na ofisi za kilimo za ndani kwa maelezo juu ya rasilimali zilizopo
Somali: Beeraleyda Uganda Wasaaradda Beeraha ayaa taageeri doonta alaabada muhiimka ah xilli ciyaareedkan oo ay ku jiraan miraha shaaha xoolaha iyo miraha La xiriir xafiisyada beeraha ee deegaanka si aad u hesho faahfaahin ku saabsan kheyraadka la heli karo
Dholuo: Jo-Purie e Uganda Ministry of Agriculture biro konyo gik madongo e higani moriwo koda olembe mag chai jamni kod kodhi.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Meru County about the importance of safe water storage for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Meru kuhusu umuhimu wa uhifadhi wa maji salama kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMSA waxay dadka degmada Meru ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone ji duto e County mar Meru kuom ber mar kano pi maler e ngima joot.

English: State Department for TVET reminds schools in Turkana County to strengthen inclusion of learners with disabilities this January.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inazikumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuimarisha ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu Januari hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Turkana inay xoojiyaan ka mid noqoshada ardayda naafada ah bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET oparo ne skunde mag Turkana County mondo omed jiwo jopuonjre ma nigi midekre e dwe mar Januar.

English: Include deaf students! Provide sign language training.
Kiswahili: Waandikishe wanafunzi viziwi na uwafundishe lugha ya ishara.
Somali: Ardayda dhegaha la'aanta ah ka qaybqaada!
Dholuo: Kony jopuonjre ma itgi odino, kendo tieggi e tiyo gi dho momni.

English: State Department for TVET encourages out-of-school children in Nairobi County to register their children at the nearest public school under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza watoto wasio shuleni katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Nairobi inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State for TVET jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e County mar Nairobi mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni kodgi e bwo chenro mar chiemo e skul.

Kiswahili: Kukabiliana na Matatizo - Athari za Ukame kwa Mikakati Inayobadilika ya Riziki ya Vijana Wakimbizi Wenye Ulemavu wa Kimwili katika Kambi ya Wakimbizi ya Kakuma, Mada ya Kazi 4 - Desemba 2024
Somali: La qabsiga Dhibaatooyinka - Saamaynta Abaartu ku leedahay Hab-nololeedka Istaraatiijiyadaha La-qabsiga ee Dhalinyarada Qaxootiga ah ee Naafada Jirka ah ee Xerada Qaxootiga Kakuma, Warqadda Shaqada 4 - Diseembar 2024
Dholuo: Kuong’ruok e Masira - Ber mar Oro kuom Yore mag Kuong’ruok mag Jolweny ma nigi Nyawo mag Ringruok e Kambi mar Jolweny mag Kakuma, Oboke mar tich 4 - Desimba 2024

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission announces bursary allocation enrollment dates for schools in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa bursary kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu ku dhawaaqay taariikhda diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ee dugsiyada degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj ogolo chenro mar somo e skunde manie County mar Vihiga.

English: OGP urges residents of Nyeri County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: OGP ojiwo jogweng' Nyeri County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e loso chenro mag dongruok.

English: Kenya Gazette updates residents of Vihiga County on progress of ward-level service delivery this January.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawasilisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga juu ya maendeleo ya utoaji wa huduma kwa kiwango cha wilaya Januari hii.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Vihiga ku wargeliyay horumarka adeegga heerka degmada bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette osemiyo jodak e County mar Vihiga ng'eyo dongruok mar chiwo kony e wi ward e dwe mar Januar.

English: Public health advisory: CDC warns of increased tuberculosis risk in Murang'a County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: CDC inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya kifua kikuu katika Kaunti ya Murang'a na inashauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Talobixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: CDC waxay ka digeysaa kororka halista cudurka 'tuberculosis' ee degmada Murang'a waxayna ku talineysaa dadweynaha inay soo sheegaan kiisaska loo maleynayo inay u yimaadaan mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: CDC chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar kahera e county mar Murang'a kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore mar konyo e thieth.

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief, April 2023
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP Kenya, Aprili 2023
Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya, Abriil 2023
Dholuo: Wach machiek mar piny Kenya mar WFP, dwe mar ang'wen 2023

English: Notice: KNEC opens a new ICT skills programme at the vocational centre in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inafungua programu mpya ya ujuzi wa ICT katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan xirfadaha ICT ka furaysaa xarunta xirfadda ee gobolka Nandi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KNEC chako chenro manyien mar lony e yore mag ICT e kar tich e county mar Nandi.

English: Kilifi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kilifi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2024
Somali: Degmada Kilifi: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kilifi: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar apar 2024

English: Judiciary of Kenya announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku dhawaaqay waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee Gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya olando lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mar yudo ng'eyono e County mar Nyandarua.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission opens a new welding and fabrication programme at the vocational centre in Machakos County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafungua programu mpya ya kulehemu na utengenezaji katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Machakos.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ka furayaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan alxanka iyo soo saarista xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Machakos.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Tiego Jopuonj ochako chenro manyien mar loso kendo loso gik moko e skul mar tich e gweng' mar Machakos.

English: 36 cases of Mpox reported so far in Kenya, two persons admitted and one patient receiving home-based care.
Kiswahili: Visa 36 vya Mpox vimeripotiwa hadi sasa nchini Kenya, watu wawili waliolazwa na mgonjwa mmoja anayepatiwa huduma ya nyumbani.
Somali: 36 kiis oo Mpox ah ayaa illaa iyo hadda laga soo sheegay Kenya, labo qof ayaa la geliyey iyo hal bukaan oo daryeel guriga laga helayo.
Dholuo: Nyaka chil kawuono, ji 36 ma nigi Mpox osefweny e piny Kenya, ji ariyo ma ne odonjo e ot kod jatuo achiel ma ne yudo thieth e ot.

English: Public notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will host a free hand hygiene outreach in Vihiga County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mikono bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay marti gelineysaa wacyi galinta nadaafadda gacmaha ee bilaashka ah ee degmada Vihiga bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo kampen mar rito ler mar lwedo e County mar Vihiga e dwe mar Julai.

English: Societal gaps continue to limit the full participation of women, and other marginalised groups, and they suffer greater hurdles to recover from crises, including exclusion from assistance, especially material assistance.
Kiswahili: Mapengo ya kijamii yanaendelea kupunguza ushiriki kamili wa wanawake, na makundi mengine yaliyotengwa, na wanapata vikwazo vikubwa vya kujikwamua kutokana na matatizo, ikiwa ni pamoja na kutengwa na usaidizi, hasa msaada wa nyenzo.
Somali: Kala duwanaanshaha bulshada ayaa sii xaddidaya ka qaybgalka buuxa ee haweenka, iyo kooxaha kale ee la takooro, waxayna la kulmaan caqabado waaweyn si ay uga soo kabtaan dhibaatooyinka, oo ay ku jiraan ka saarista gargaarka, gaar ahaan gargaarka agabka.
Dholuo: Gik ma ng’ato nyalo ng’ado e kindgi dhi nyime gi geng’o donjo chuth mar mon, kod grube mamoko ma oket oko, kendo giyudo pek madongo mag dwoko piny masira, moriwo nyaka bedo ma ok giyudo kony, ahinya ahinya kony mar mwandu.

English: Ministry of Health encourages mothers in Laikipia County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Laikipia inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health jiwo mine e County mar Laikipia mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: KUCCPS conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Vihiga County this May.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Mei hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan wareejinta degmada Vihiga bisha May.
Dholuo: KUCCPS dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi wach golo pesa e gweng' mar Vihiga e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: HELB announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta dugsiyada dugsiga sare ee Kirinyaga County.
