English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of West Pokot County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo odonj e riwruok mar insuarans mar thieth mondo giyud thieth ma yudo kony.

English: AFA encourages farmers in Nyandarua County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for fish.
Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za samaki.
Somali: AFA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Nyandarua inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo kalluunka ah.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e kaunti mar Nyandarua mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro mondo omi rech obed gi nengo maber.

English: Laikipia County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Laikipia: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Mei 2022
Somali: Degmada Laikipia: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Laikipia: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar abich 2022

English: Universities Fund encourages out-of-school children in Marsabit County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya ugawaji wa bursary.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Marsabit inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga ugu dambeeya ee la siinayo deeqaha waxbarasho.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e Marsabit County mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: State Department for TVET urges parents and teachers in Nyeri County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi kwa watoto 116.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Nyeri inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Nyeri mondo omany namba mar kony mar nyithindo 116.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages residents of Lamu County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay ka qayb galaan kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo jogweng' Lamu County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Wajir County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Wajir: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2022
Somali: Degmada Wajeer: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Wajir: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar 2022

English: This underscores the severity of recurrent climate shocks, particularly flooding along the Tana River Basin, which continues to uproot families, disrupt livelihoods and strain host communities.
Kiswahili: Hii inasisitiza ukali wa majanga ya hali ya hewa yanayotokea mara kwa mara, hasa mafuriko kwenye Bonde la Mto Tana, ambayo yanaendelea kung'oa familia, kutatiza maisha na kuzorotesha jamii zinazowapokea.
Somali: Tani waxay hoosta ka xariiqaysaa darnaanta dhibaatooyinka cimilada ee soo noqnoqda, gaar ahaan daadadka ka dhaca Dooxada Wabiga Tana, kuwaas oo sii wada inay xididada u siibaan qoysaska, carqaladeeyaan hab-nololeedka iyo inay dhibaato ku keenaan bulshooyinka martida loo yahay.
Dholuo: Mano nyiso kaka ng’anjo mag piny bedo matek ahinya, ahinya-ahinya pi ma pong’o piny e dho nam mar Tana, ma dhi nyime ketho joot, ketho ngima mar oganda kendo keto pek ne oganda ma rwakogi.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds livestock keepers in Isiolo County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Isiolo inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanada buka xafiiska xayawaanka ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) paronwa jorit jamni e County mar Isiolo ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni kodgi.

English: Nyeri (Kieni) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for December 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Nyeri (Kieni): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Desemba 2023
Somali: Degmada Nyeri (Kieni): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Diseembar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Nyeri (Kieni): Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2023

English: UNICEF Kenya Humanitarian Situation Report No. 2 (Drought) - 1 June to 30 June 2022
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Hali ya Kibinadamu ya UNICEF Kenya No. 2 (Ukame) - 1 Juni hadi 30 Juni 2022
Somali: Warbixinta Xaaladda Bani'aadamnimada ee UNICEF Kenya Lambarka 2 (Abaarta) - 1 Juun ilaa 30 Juun 2022
Dholuo: Ripot mar chal mar konyo dhano mar UNICEF e piny Kenya namba 2 (Oro) - tarik 1 dwe mar auchiel nyaka tarik 30 dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2022

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response appeals to caregivers in Vihiga County to visit their nearest maternity wing as part of the November maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Novemba.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Vihiga inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka bisha Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo kwayo jorit e County mar Vihiga mondo olimgi machiegni gi kama giyudoe nyithindo e dwe mar Novemba.

English: KUCCPS urges youth in Nyandarua County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nyandarua inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo rowere e County mar Nyandarua mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gitimo tije mag oganda.

English: HELB reminds schools in Kitui County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this January.
Kiswahili: HELB inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Januari hii.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Kitui inay xoojiyaan adeegyada hagista iyo la-talinta bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa skunde man Kitui County mondo omed jiwo kendo chiwo kony e dwe mar Januar.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya alerts residents of Kakamega County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega juu ya kuongezeka kwa visa vya wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya ayaa dadka deggan degmada Kakamega uga digtay kororka kiisaska jabsashada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Communications Authority chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kakamega County kuom wach kwan mar joma odonjo e ot kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Isiolo County to remain vigilant on border security.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Isiolo inay ka feejignaadaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji duto manie Isiolo County ni gibed motang' gi weche mag sirkal.

English: FAO invites farmers in Nyandarua County to a free training on fertiliser application this April.
Kiswahili: FAO inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwa mafunzo ya bure juu ya matumizi ya mbolea Aprili hii.
Somali: FAO waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda gobolka Nyandarua tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan isticmaalka bacriminta bisha April.
Dholuo: FAO ogwelo jopur e County mar Nyandarua e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar tiyo gi yien e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will train farmers in Homa Bay County on soil conservation this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay juu ya uhifadhi wa udongo Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda gobolka Homa Bay ee ku saabsan ilaalinta ciidda bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro tiego jopur e Homa Bay County kuom rito lowo e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: KMTC opens a new catering and hospitality programme at the vocational centre in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inafungua mpango mpya wa upishi na ukarimu katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan cuntada iyo marti-gelinta xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KMTC chako chenro manyien mar chiemo kod rwako welo e otas mar tiegruok e gweng' mar Isiolo.

English: Breast milk contains nutrients vital for a baby_x0092_s brain development.
Kiswahili: Maziwa ya mama yana virutubisho muhimu kwa ukuzi wa ubongo wa mtoto.
Somali: Caanaha naaska waxay ka kooban yihiin nafaqooyin muhiim u ah horumarka maskaxda ilmaha_x0092_s.
Dholuo: Chak mar min nigi gik ma konyo e dongruok mar obwongo mar nyathi.

English: NDMA urges the community in Meru County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: NDMA inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Meru kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Meru inay ka warbixiyaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo shaki leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo xanta xoolaha.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo oganda manie County mar Meru mondo ochiw ripot mar gik maricho mosetimore e stesen mar polise man machiegni mondo omonjgo jamni mag jamni.

English: Notice: SHA launches ward-level service delivery in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Shirika la SHA linazindua huduma za huduma katika wilaya ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA waxay bilaabaysaa bixinta adeegyada heerka qaybta ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA chako chiwo kony e alwora mar Elgeyo-Marakwet County.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) promotes agroforestry among farmers in Kisumu County as part of the September climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inakuza kilimo cha misitu miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa Septemba.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay dhiirrigelisay beeraha iyo kaymaha beeraleyda degmada Kisumu iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka iska caabbinta cimilada ee Sebtember.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) konyo jopur ma Kisumu County mondo ong'e kaka ginyalo nyagore gi pek mag yuto e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya umetoa onyo la usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Kitui.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ripot Mamit mar Kenya ogolo siem e wi weche mag sirkande mag intanet kuom chenro mag gwelo pesa mag miriambo makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Kitui County.

English: COMESA advises farmers in Nakuru County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: COMESA waxay kula talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nakuru inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qaybqaataan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo okel namba mar pimo jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: Kiosks of Mombasa Covid 19: Testing kiosks without toutching is implemented in 6 elective counties in which there is no physical contact with the doctor and the patient. These kiosks test safely and with security, very fast and in plenty. These kiosks are build in this areas have become game changer
Kiswahili: Kioski za Mombasa COVID 19: Kujaribu kioski bila kuingiza ni kutekelezwa katika majimbo 6 ya uchaguzi ambapo hakuna mawasiliano ya mwili na daktari na mgonjwa. Kiosko hizi hujaribu salama na kwa usalama, haraka sana na kwa wingi. Kiosk hizi zinajengwa katika maeneo haya zimekuwa mabadiliko ya mchezo
Somali: Kioskii Mombasa Covid 19: Tijaabinta kioskii iyada oo aan la dhicin ayaa lagu hirgeliyaa 6 degmo oo doorasho ah oo aan lahayn xiriir jireed oo dhakhtar iyo bukaan ah. Kioskooyinkani waxay tijaabiyaan si nabadgelyo leh oo amni leh, si dhakhso leh oo badan.
Dholuo: Kiosks mag Mombasa Covid 19: Temo kiosks maonge toutching itimo e counties 6 mag yiero ma onge tudruok mar ringruok gi laktar kata jatuo.

English: NCPB urges pigs farmers in Nandi County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wafugaji wa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia kesi za ugonjwa wa Newcastle zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda doofaarka ee degmada Nandi inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xadka degmada iyagoo aan haysan rukhsad ka dib kiisaska cudurka Newcastle ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur puothe e county mar Nandi mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni e gwenge mamoko maok giyudo rusa bang' ka osenyis ni gin gi tuo mar Newcastle.

English: FAO warns beans farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: FAO inawaonya wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: FAO waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda ku nool gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda ah.
Dholuo: FAO chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho puothe e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Meru County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waendelee kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay la xiriiraan maamulaha degmada si ay uga warqabaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jogweng'o mag Meru County mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jotend buchegi mondo ging'e chenro mar dongruok mar county.

English: NPS calls on the community in Kwale County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaita jamii katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuongea dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: NPS waxay bulshada degmada Kwale ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: NPS okwayo ji duto e county mar Kwale mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo onyis ji weche mag mahundu e stesen mar polise.

English: Teachers Service Commission (TSC) to enhance teacher resource centres for continuous professional development.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu (TSC) kuimarisha vituo vya rasilimali za walimu kwa ajili ya maendeleo ya kitaaluma ya kuendelea.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macalimiinta (TSC) si loo xoojiyo xarumaha kheyraadka macalimiinta ee horumarinta xirfadeed ee joogtada ah.
Dholuo: Commission for Teachers Service (TSC) mondo oteg kuonde mitimoe tiegruok ne jopuonjwa.

English: IPOA warns residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya kuongezeka kwa kashfa za pesa za rununu na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: IPOA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in ay kordheen khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aanay wax ka qaban.
Dholuo: IPOA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County e wi medruok mar timbe mag wuondruok gi pesa mitimo e yor simo kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Kirinyaga County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kirinyaga inay ka feejignaadaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross parone ji duto e County mar Kirinyaga ni gibed motang' gi chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: Before 6 months, breast milk provides all the fluids a baby needs.
Kiswahili: Kabla ya miezi 6, maziwa ya mama hutoa maji yote ambayo mtoto anahitaji.
Somali: Ka hor inta aan la gaarin 6 bilood, caanaha hooyada wuxuu siinayaa dhallaanka dhammaan dareeraha uu u baahan yahay.
Dholuo: Ka nyathi pok ochopo dweche auchiel, kong'o miyoye gik moko duto madwarore.

English: Clean the grain and dry it to a moisture content of 11-12%; soybeans above 13% moisture are likely to mould, and grain dried below 11% is likely to crack.
Kiswahili: Ondoa uchafu kwenye mbegu na ukaushe hadi unyevu ufike asilimia 11-12; soya zenye unyevu zaidi ya asilimia 13% huenda zikaoza, na ukikausha zaidi ya asilimia 11 mbegu zitapasuka.
Somali: Nadiifi hadhuudhka oo qalaji ilaa qoyaan u dhexeeya 11-12%; Soybeans-ka ka sarreeya 13% qoyaan ayaa u badan inuu cadhigo, halka hadhuudhka la qalajiyay ee ka hooseeya 11% ay u badan tahay inay dillaacaan.
Dholuo: Ler cham kendo tur iye nyaka bed gi mor mar 11-12%; cham ma nigi mor mar soybe ma okalo 13% nyalo bedo gi muya, to cham ma nigi mor mar bedo matin moloyo 11% nyalo bedo gi ywaruok.

English: Tharaka Nithi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2024
Somali: Degmada Tharaka Nithi: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Tharaka Nithi: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2024

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens a new service point for passport services in Narok County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee Gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya oseyawo kamachielo mar tiyo gi passport e gweng' mar Narok.

English: TVET encourages out-of-school children in Meru County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Meru kutuma maombi ya bursari kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta dugsiga ka baxsan ee degmada Meru inay codsadaan deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga ugu dambeeya ee barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e county mar Meru mondo okonygi yudo konyno kapok kindeno ochopo kaluwore gi chenro mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: AFA encourages farmers in Taita-Taveta County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for milk.
Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora ya maziwa.
Somali: AFA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan caanaha.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e Taita-Taveta County mondo ous olemo mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo chak mondo omi ohala obed maber.

English: OGP reminds the public in Machakos County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Machakos in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: OGP paronwa ji duto e County mar Machakos ni lando wach tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Tharaka-Nithi County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi in warbixinta khiyaamooyinka si dhakhso leh ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NTSA oparo ne jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar wuond konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will host a free safe water storage outreach in Uasin Gishu County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa kuhifadhi maji salama katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska Dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka waxay martigelin doontaa adeegyo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee degmada Uasin Gishu bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo chenro mar chiwo pi moromo maonge chudo e Uasin Gishu County e dwe mar Jun.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges dairy cows farmers in Turkana County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported rabies cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya kichaa cha mbwa vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Turkana inay ka fogaadaan dhaqdhaqaaqa xoolaha xuduudaha degmada iyada oo aan la helin ruqsad ka dib kiisaska cadhada la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur mag dhok mag chak e County mar Turkana mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni e alwora mar county ka ok giyudo rusa bang' yudo joma nigi tuwo mar rabies.

English: CDC reminds expectant mothers in Kitui County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: CDC inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Kitui in helitaanka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: CDC parone mine ma biro bedo gi ich e gweng' mar Kitui ni thuolo mar yudo puonj mag chenro mag ngima joot en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag sirkal.

English: Council of Governors warns public officers in Kilifi County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Kilifi dhidi ya kupotosha fedha za umma.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ka digeen saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Kilifi inay ka faa'iideystaan dhaqaalaha dawladda.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e gweng' mar Kilifi ni kik giti gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo e yo marach.

English: Garissa County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Garissa: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2022
Somali: Degmada Garissa: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Garissa: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar 2022

English: KEMSA advises residents of Mandera County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kuthibitisha kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera inay xaqiijiyaan in xaruntooda la aqoonsaday ka hor inta aysan booqan si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMSA nyiso jogweng'o mag Mandera County mondo ong'e ni chenrogi oseyud ratiro kapok gibiro e chenrono mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Baringo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Baringo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2024
Somali: Degmada Baringo: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Baringo: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar adek higa mar 2024

English: ODPP urges eligible citizens in Kwale County to participate in voter education.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Kwale kushiriki katika elimu ya wapiga kura.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kwale inay ka qaybqaataan waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo raia mar Kwale County mondo oriwre e tiegruok mar joma yiero.

English: State Department for TVET invites youth in Baringo County to enroll for catering and hospitality training this July.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Baringo kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu Julai hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku casuumaysaa dhalinyarada degmada Baringo inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET ogwelo rowere man Baringo County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar chiemo kod rwako welo e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: NTSA activates an emergency response plan for landslides in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NTSA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ka dhan ah dhulgariirada gobolka Mandera.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NTSA tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne yiengni mag lowo e gweng' mar Mandera.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds residents of Isiolo County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya wilaya inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo in la socodsiinta horumarka mashruuca bogga internetka ee degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General parone jogweng' Isiolo County ni luwo dongruok mar tich kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will train farmers in Migori County on water harvesting this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori juu ya uvunaji wa maji Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Migori oo ku saabsan goosashada biyaha bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro tiego jopur e county mar Migori e dwe mar Julai.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges anyone experiencing abuse in Homa Bay County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unamhimiza mtu yeyote anayeona unyanyasaji katika Wilaya ya Homa Bay kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada wuxuu ku boorinayaa qofkasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka gobolka Homa Bay inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e Homa Bay County mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise.

English:
By recognizing the humanity of individuals with mental illnesses, we can cultivate a more compassionate and understanding society.
If you or someone you know needs psychosocial support, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at our toll-free number, 1199
Kiswahili: Kwa kutambua ubinadamu wa watu wenye magonjwa ya akili, tunaweza kukuza jamii yenye huruma zaidi na kuelewa. Ikiwa wewe au mtu unayemjua anahitaji msaada wa kisaikolojia, tafadhali usisite kuwasiliana nasi kwa nambari yetu ya bure, 1199
Somali: Marka aan aqoonsano bani'aadamnimada shakhsiyaadka qaba cudurrada maskaxda, waxaan horumarin karnaa bulsho naxariis iyo faham badan. Haddii adiga ama qof aad taqaanid u baahan tahay taageero maskaxeed, fadlan ha ka waaban inaad nala soo xiriirto lambarkayaga lacag la'aanta ah, 1199
Dholuo: Ka wang'eyo kaka joma nigi tuoche mag obwongo chalo, wanyalo bedo gi chuny mar kecho ji kendo winjo pachgi maber. Kapo ni in kata ng'at ming'eyo dwaro kony kuom weche mag pach ji, kik iluor tudori kodwa gi namba mar 1199 maonge chudo.

English: AFA advises farmers in Mombasa County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: AFA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: AFA waxay kula talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Mombasa inay ka soo qayb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e county mar Mombasa mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds expectant mothers in Kwale County that access to free antenatal care is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma ya ujauzito bila malipo ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Kwale in helitaanka daryeelka uurka ka hor ee bilaashka ah ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne mine ma biro nyuolo e county mar Kwale ni thuolo mar yudo thieth ma onge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal en maonge chudo.

English: KEMSA urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Murang'a County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kumtia moyo rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Murang'a inuu ku dhiirrigeliyo saaxiibkiisa dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar paro e County mar Murang'a mondo ojiw osiepne moro ma chandore omany kony.

English: I will not tire in reminding you of the basic containment measures. Namely: washing your hands with soap and running water, maintaining social and physical distance, wearing of face masks at all times when in public places & avoid all forms of gatherings; CS Mutahi Kagwe.
Kiswahili: Sitachoka kukukumbusha hatua za msingi za kuzuia. Yaani: kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji yanayotiririka, kudumisha umbali wa kijamii na kimwili, kuvaa vinyago wakati wote unapokuwa katika maeneo ya umma na kuepuka aina zote za mikusanyiko; CS Mutahi Kagwe.
Somali: Kama daali doono inaan ku xasuusiyo tallaabooyinka aasaasiga ah ee xakamaynta. Kuwaas waxaa ka mid ah: gacmahaaga ku dhaq saabuun iyo biyo socda, ilaalinta kala fogaanshaha bulshada iyo jirka, xirashada maaskaro wejiga mar walba marka aad joogto goobaha dadweynaha & ka fogow dhammaan noocyada isu imaatinka; CS Mutahi Kagwe.
Dholuo: Ok abi ol e paronu yore madongo mag geng’o tuoche. En: lwoko lweteni gi sabun kod pi ma ng’ich, rito thuolo e kind ji kod ng’ato gi ng’ato, rwako mask mag wang’ kinde duto ka in kuonde ma ji mang’eny romoe & weyo yore duto mag chokruok; CS Mutahi Kagwe.

English: The challenges facing Africa: climate change, conflict, and the after-effects of COVID-19
Kiswahili: Changamoto zinazoikabili Afrika: mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa, migogoro, na athari za COVID-19
Somali: Caqabadaha horyaalla Afrika: isbeddelka cimilada, iskahorimaadka, iyo saameynta COVID-19
Dholuo: Midhiero ma Afrika yudo: lokruok mag kor lwasi, lweny, kod gik mabiro bang’ COVID-19

English: I took that step for my five children who depend on me.
Kiswahili: Nilichukua hatua hiyo kwa watoto wangu watano wanaonitegemea.
Somali: Tallaabadaas waxaan u qaaday shan carruur ah oo aan dhalay kuwaas oo igu tiirsan.
Dholuo: Ne akawo okang’no ne nyithinda abich ma geno kuoma.

English: IPOA urges the public in Busia County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: IPOA inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Busia kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: IPOA waxay ugu baaqaysaa dadweynaha degmada Busia inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada iyada oo loo marayo kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo ji duto e County mar Busia mondo ong'e kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro bang' weche mag wuondruok ma ne otimore kuom SIM-swap.

English: ODPP reminds the public in Nyandarua County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Nyandarua in sheegashada khiyaamooyinka iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: ODPP paronwa ji duto e County mar Nyandarua ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag ohala en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: TSC advertises 24,000 intern teacher positions for junior secondary schools.
Kiswahili: TSC inatangaza nafasi 24,000 za walimu wa kati kwa shule za sekondari za chini.
Somali: TSC waxay xayeysiinaysaa 24,000 oo boos oo macalimiin ah oo ku takhasusay dugsiyada dhexe ee hoose.
Dholuo: TSC lando kar tiegruok mar jopuonj 24,000 e skunde matindo mag sekondari.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties urges eligible citizens in Samburu County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Samburu kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Samburu inay ka qaybqaataan jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro e county mar Samburu mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar yiero.

English: Notice: KICD launches a school infrastructure safety programme in schools across Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD yazindua mpango wa usalama wa miundombinu ya shule katika shule kote Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay bilawday barnaamij ku saabsan badbaadada kaabayaasha dugsiga ee dugsiyada gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KICD chako chenro mar rito kuonde tiegruok mag skul e skunde duto mag Wajir County.

English: OGP announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: OGP inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kugeuza kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: OGP waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay ka shaqeynta shahaadada dhalashada ee degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: OGP olando lokruok e seche mag timo nonro mar nyasi mar nyuol e County mar Bungoma.

English: FAO urges beans growers in Taita-Taveta County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawasihi wakulima wa maharagwe katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Taita-Taveta inay qaataan noocyo abuurka ah oo abaarta u adkaysta si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma pidho keyo e Taita-Taveta County mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed nyak e higani.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will hold a depression awareness forum in Garissa County this September. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanya kongamano la uhamasishaji wa unyogovu katika Kaunti ya Garissa Septemba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) waxay qabaneysaa madasha wacyi galinta niyadjabka ee Gobolka Garissa bisha Sebtember. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo chokruok mar chiwo paro e wi tuwo mar depression e taon mar Garissa e dwe mar Septemba.

English: KNEC encourages residents of Samburu County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Samburu inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jogweng' county mar Samburu mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda mondo gibed gi ng'eyo kuom kaka ji biro tiyo gi bajet mar county.

English: NCPB warns maize farmers in Kisii County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawaonya wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: NCPB waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Kisii faafitaanka cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: NCPB osiemo jopur mag kodhi e County mar Kisii kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Marsabit County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Marsabit: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Mei 2022
Somali: Degmada Marsabit: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Marsabit: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar abich higa mar 2022

English: Kwale County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kwale: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Juni 2022
Somali: Degmada Kwale: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kwale: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2022

English: Notice: KRA launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Homa Bay County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Wilaya ya Homa Bay mwezi huu wa Oktoba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa gobolka Homa Bay bishii Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KRA chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e Homa Bay County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: National Drought Early Warning Bulletin (May 2024)
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Tahadhari ya Mapema ya Kitaifa (Mei 2024)
Somali: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Qaranka (Maajo 2024)
Dholuo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro (Mei 2024)

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds voters in Mombasa County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa xasuusinaya codbixiyayaasha gobolka Mombasa in ay booqdaan xarunta ugu dhow ee isdiiwaangelinta IEBC ka hor jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties paronwa jotelo e county mar Mombasa mondo olim kama ichanoe IEBC machiegni kodgi kapok kinde mar yiero ochopo.

English: Notice from Division of Disease Surveillance and Response: family planning counselling clinics will run every March at designated health centres in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitafanya kazi kila Machi katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka socda qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada: rugaha la talinta qorshaynta qoyska waxay ku shaqeyn doonaan bishii Maarso oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Mandera.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuwo: Klinike mag chiwo paro e wi chenro mag ngima joot biro tiyo e dwe mar Mach higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Mandera.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) encourages first-time voters in Nyeri County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa codbixiyayaasha ugu horreeya ee degmada Nyeri inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogo matimoga yiero mokwongo e county mar Nyeri mondo oting'e ID kata pasi mar piny mangima e odiechieng'no mar timo yiero.

English: IEBC urges youth in Nairobi County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nairobi inay ka qaybqaataan munaasabadda dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo rowere manie County Nairobi mondo oriwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county ka pok ochopo chenro mag oganda.

English: Notice: COMESA will distribute certified tea seed to farmers in Busia County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itasambaza mbegu za chai zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay abuurka shaaha ee shahaadada leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Busia bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar COMESA biro pogo kodhi mag chai ne jopur manie County mar Busia e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross issues a cybersecurity alert on mobile money scams affecting residents of Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya umetoa onyo la usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu zinazoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaanooyinka lacagta mobile ee saameynaya dadka deggan gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ripot Mamit mar Kenya ogolo siem mar rito weche mag intanet e wi timbe mag wuondo joma odak e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu.

English: HELB urges residents of Kiambu County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: HELB inawataka wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: HELB waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay codsadaan deeqda waxbarasho ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga ugu dambeeya si ay uga faa'iideystaan barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo ji duto modak e gweng' mar Kiambu mondo okonygi gi chenrono kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission opens a new ICT skills programme at the vocational centre in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yafungua programu mpya ya ujuzi wa ICT katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan xirfadaha ICT ka furayaa xarunta xirfadda ee Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission for Teachers Service ochako chenro manyien mar lony e yore mag ICT e kar tiegruok mar tich e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: NTSA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kwale County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: NTSA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Kwale piga simu kwa simu ya msaada ya bure ya GBV 1195.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Kwale inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e Kaunti mar Kwale mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195 maonge chudo.

English: IEBC reminds the public in Kilifi County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this September.
Kiswahili: IEBC inakumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya Kilifi kwamba maoni juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka yanakaribishwa Septemba hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kilifi in talooyinka dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: IEBC parone ji duto manie County Kilifi ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice from SHA (Social Health Authority): childhood immunization clinics will run every August at designated health centres in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii): kliniki za chanjo za watoto zitaendeshwa kila Agosti katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada): rugaha tallaalka carruurta waxaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Ogosto oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Rieko moa kuom SHA (Social Health Authority): klinik mag thiedho nyithindo biro tiyo dwe mar Agost higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Kisii.

English: NPS warns residents of Isiolo County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: NPS waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo kororka khiyaamada lacagaha SIM-swap waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax falin.
Dholuo: NPS chiwo siem ne jogweng' Isiolo County e wi medruok mar wuond mar loko SIM kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges residents of Turkana County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Uhalifu unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations ojiwo jogweng' Turkana County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya e kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free HIV/AIDS screening is available at all public health centres in Kirinyaga County this December.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa VVU/UKIMWI unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Desemba hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka HIV / AIDS ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee Gobolka Kirinyaga bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji ni nonro ma onge chudo mar HIV/AIDS yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Kirinyaga e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: NDMA conducts a community briefing on border security in Nairobi County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha ee Gobolka Nairobi bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e Nairobi County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: KEMRI reminds expectant mothers in Kitui County that access to childhood immunization is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba upatikanaji wa chanjo ya utotoni ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Kitui in helitaanka tallaalka carruurta ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMRI parone mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County Kitui ni yudo thieth mar nyithindo onge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: DPP calls on residents of Kirinyaga County to support local peace-building committees in support of national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DPP inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za mitaa kusaidia kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: DPP waxay dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah si ay u caawiyaan nabadgelyada qaranka.
Dholuo: DPP okwayo ji duto modak e County mar Kirinyaga mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e pinygi.

English: IPOA calls on residents of Turkana County to support local peace-building committees in support of national peace-building.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za mitaa kusaidia kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah ee taageeraya nabadgelyada qaranka.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Turkana mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e pinygi.

English: IEBC reminds voters in Makueni County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Makueni kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IebC kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Makueni inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta ugu dhow ee Iebc ka hor inta aan la helin waxbarasho codbixinayaasha.
Dholuo: IEBC parone jogweng'o mag Makueni County ni mondo gidhi e kama ichanoe ji mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: Notice: IEBC opens a new ICT skills programme at the vocational centre in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inafungua programu mpya ya ujuzi wa ICT katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan xirfadaha ICT ee xarunta xirfadda ee degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IEBC chako chenro manyien mar lony e yore mag ICT e skul mar tiegruok e county mar Nyeri.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association confirms a tuberculosis outbreak alert for Busia County. Residents are advised to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari Kenya chathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa kifua kikuu katika Kaunti ya Busia. Wakazi wanashauriwa kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xaqiijiyay digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka TB ee degmada Busia. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Medical Association osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuberculosis e kaunti mar Busia.

English: TVET calls on the community in Tana River County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TVET inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TVET waxay ku baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Tana River County inay u wargeliyaan maamulka iskuulka wixii dhibaato ah ee ku saabsan amniga si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: TVET dwaro ni oganda manie Tana River County onyis sirkal mar skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: EACC encourages first-time voters in Kisii County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: EACC inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kisii kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC.
Somali: EACC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Kisii inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo joma okwongo yiero e county mar Kisii mondo odhi olim kama ichanoe ji ne IEBC machiegni kodgi.

English: Ministry of Education announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in Mombasa County this December.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu yatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika shule za Kaunti ya Mombasa Desemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa ku dhawaaqday qaybinta deeqaha waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan dugsiyada gobolka Mombasa bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok ogolo chiwo mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre man gi chan e skunde man Mombasa County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Nyeri (Kieni) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Nyeri (Kieni): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Mei 2023
Somali: Degmada Nyeri (Kieni): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Nyeri (Kieni): Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo kuom Oro mar Mei 2023

English: Ministry of Health launches a June awareness campaign on proper sanitation across Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Juni juu ya usafi wa mazingira katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay billowday olole wacyiga ah bishii Juun oo ku saabsan nadaafadda saxda ah ee degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health osechako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Jun e wi thieth maber e gweng' mar Kisumu.

English: EACC reminds residents of Kwale County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale ambao huhudhuria mkutano wa umma wa mkutano wa kaunti huimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale ee ka qeybgalaya kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada ayaa xoojinaya maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: EACC paronwa jogweng' mar Kwale County ma biro e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Kenya: Funds to help with teacher shortage at refugee camp
Kiswahili: Kenya: Fedha za kusaidia uhaba wa walimu katika kambi ya wakimbizi
Somali: Kenya: Lacago lagu caawinayo yaraanta macallimiinta ee xerada qaxootiga
Dholuo: Kenya: Omwom mar konyo e wi nok mar jopuonj e kambi mar jolweny

English: Notice: KTDA restricts movement of sheep in Garissa County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA inazuia harakati za kondoo katika Kaunti ya Garissa kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi wenye uvimbe.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa idaha ee Gobolka Garissa sababtuna tahay faafitaanka cudurka maqaarka.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA ogeng'o wuoth mar rombe e County mar Garissa nikech tuwo mar dhoho.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Homa Bay County that access to psychosocial support is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisaikolojia unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ee ka dhacay gobolka Homa Bay in helitaanka taageerada cilmu-nafsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e Homa Bay County ni ginyalo yudo kony maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Narok County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the February planting season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Februari.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda Gobolka Narok inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Febraayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur manie Narok County ni giti gi yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Februar.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the public in Migori County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of identity theft.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Migori wasijulishe PIN yao ya M-Pesa kwa mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa shacabka degmada Migori inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarkooda M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee tuugista aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto e county mar Migori mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' weche mag kwalo kitgi.

English: KNEC urges residents of Kitui County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kutuma maombi ya bursari hiyo kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kufaidika na mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo ji duto modak e gweng' mar Kitui mondo okonygi gi chenrono kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: TVET reminds schools in Kiambu County to strengthen school infrastructure safety this December.
Kiswahili: TVET inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuimarisha usalama wa miundombinu ya shule Desemba hii.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Kiambu inay xoojiyaan ammaanka kaabayaasha dugsiga bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa skunde e County mar Kiambu mondo omed jiwo ritruok mar chenro mag skul e dwe mar Desemba.

Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Haki ya COMESA imetoa uamuzi kuhusu matumizi ya hatua za ulinzi ikisisitiza kwamba nchi lazima ziepuke vikwazo vya biashara holela Wadau wanapaswa kukaa taarifa juu ya kanuni za biashara ili kuhakikisha zinafuatwa

Dholuo: Kot mar Bura mar COMESA oseyiero ni mondo oket chenro mar rito weche mag ohala, ne dwarore ni pinje kik ket tong' e weche mag ohala.

English: Notice: COMESA will conduct a post-harvest handling workshop for farmers in Isiolo County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itafanya warsha ya kushughulikia baada ya mavuno kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ka dib goosashada beeraleyda ee Degmada Isiolo bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA biro timo chokruok mar timo nonro bang' keyo ne jopur e kaunti mar Isiolo e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: KTDA will distribute certified sorghum seed to farmers in Kiambu County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KTDA itasambaza mbegu zilizothibitishwa za sorghum kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay abuurka sorghum ee shahaadada leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Kiambu bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KTDA biro pogo kodhi mag sorghum ne jopur manie County Kiambu e dwe mar Januar.

Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA inafanya mkutano wa jamii juu ya ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Mei hii.

Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA timo romo mar oganda e wi loso kuwe e piny mangima e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia e dwe mar Mei.

Somali: KRA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo jogweng' Makueni County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro kwayo mag ID mar piny.

Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Tahadhari ya Mapema ya Kitaifa (Desemba 2023)
Somali: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Qaranka (Diseembar 2023)
Dholuo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro (Dwe mar apar gi ariyo 2023)

English: KICD reminds needy students in Laikipia County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kwamba ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji maombi yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Laikipia in deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay codsiyada ardayda baahan ay dhowaan dhammaadaan.
Dholuo: KICD paronwa jopuonjre man gi chan e County mar Laikipia ni tuke mag somo ne jopuonjre ma nigi chan biro rumo machiegni.

English: KNEC announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Wajir County this May.
Kiswahili: KNEC inatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Wajir Mei hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta waxyaabaha barashada digitalka ah ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada Gobolka Wajir bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: KNEC olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag digital maonge chudo e skunde man Wajir County e dwe mar abich.

English: KEMRI urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Isiolo County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku boorineysaa qofkasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Isiolo inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e gweng' mar Isiolo mondo oluong simo mar thieth mar paro maonge chudo.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education announces school feeding programme enrollment dates for schools in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa programu ya kulisha shule kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiyada gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Education olando tarik mag somo e skunde mag Taita-Taveta County.

English: Those job ads for 'NGO agents hiring enumerators' without an interview are a scam. Verify with the actual NGO before sending money.
Kiswahili: Matangazo hayo ya kazi kwa 'mawakala wa mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali wanaoajiri wahesabuji' bila mahojiano ni ulaghai. Thibitisha na mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali kabla ya kutuma pesa.

English: KMTC urges residents of Kwale County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawataka wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na ugawaji wa bursary.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response launches a March awareness campaign on tobacco control across Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Machi juu ya udhibiti wa tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Maarso ee ka dhanka ah xakamaynta sigaarka ee Gobolka Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Mach e wi thieth mar ndawa e Trans Nzoia County.

English: KICD invites youth in Kilifi County to enroll for electrical installation training this February.
Kiswahili: KICD inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Februari hii.
Somali: KICD waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kilifi inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: KICD gwelo rowere manie County Kilifi mondo odonj e tiegruok mar keto sitima e dwe mar Februar.

English: KRA announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: KRA inatangaza nyakati bora za kurejesha huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: KRA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee Gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: KRA olando lokruok e seche mag tiyo gi passport e county mar Nyandarua.

English: Kenya aims to increase coffee production to 150 000 metric tonnes by 2028 encouraging farmers to participate in reforms and investments to enhance their earnings and market access
Kiswahili: Kenya inalenga kuongeza uzalishaji wa kahawa hadi tani 150,000 kufikia 2028 ili kuwahimiza wakulima kushiriki katika mageuzi na uwekezaji ili kuongeza mapato yao na upatikanaji wa soko.

Dholuo: Kenya dwaro medo loso chai nyaka 150 000 tonne nyaka 2028 kendo jiwo jopur mondo oriwre e lokruok kod gwelo pesa mondo omed yudo pesa kendo omed yudo pesa e ohala

Kiswahili: Jumuiya Zinazosimamia: Masomo kwa Mfuko wa Kimataifa wa Kukabiliana na Hasara na Uharibifu kutoka kwa mradi unaoongozwa na wenyeji nchini Kenya.

English: E-Citizen urges eligible citizens in Trans Nzoia County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wananchi wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka qaybqaataan jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo raia mag Trans Nzoia County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar yiero.

English: KALRO urges farmers in Mandera County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Mandera inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo lagu soo ururiyo biyaha beeraha si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KALRO ojiwo jopur man Mandera County mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok ma timore e kaka koth chue.

English: KNEC encourages out-of-school children in Kiambu County to register their children at the nearest public school under free primary education.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Kiambu inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan iskuulka guud ee ugu dhow ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo nyithindo maok dhi e skul e Kaunti mar Kiambu mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul ma ni machiegni gi kama ginyalo dhiyoe e skul.

English: OGP advises residents of Narok County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: OGP inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e- Citizen.
Somali: OGP waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Narok inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan diiwaangelinta e-citizen.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom websait mar e-Citizen sama gidwaro dhi e e e - Citizen registration.

English: DCI reminds residents of Narok County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kusakinisha na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi wakati wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Narok in ay guryahooda ku rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo shaqada inta lagu jiro xilliyada fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: DCI parone jogweng' Narok County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag nego ligek mach e utegi kendo giti e kinde mag koth.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds the public in Makueni County that input on the county budget process is welcome this March.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba mchango kwenye mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti unakaribishwa Machi hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) ayaa xasuusinaya shacabka degmada Makueni in talooyinka ku saabsan habka miisaaniyadda degmada ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone ji duto e county mar Makueni ni okwayo ji mondo ochiw paro e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: NCPB will distribute certified coffee seed to farmers in Baringo County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itasambaza mbegu za kahawa zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Baringo Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay abuurka kafeega ee shahaadada leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Baringo bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NCPB biro pogo kodhi mag chai ne jopur man Baringo County e dwe mar Mach.

English: IEBC announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in Homa Bay County this August.
Kiswahili: IEBC inatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Agosti hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta deeqaha waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan dugsiyada gobolka Homa Bay bishii Ogosto.
Dholuo: IEBC ogolo chiwo mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre man gi chan e skunde man Homa Bay County e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will open a tea collection centre in Lamu County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itafungua kituo cha kukusanya chai katika Kaunti ya Lamu Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xarun soo ururinta shaaha ka furi doontaa degmada Lamu bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro yawo ot mar choko chai e County mar Lamu e dwe mar Desemba.

Kiswahili: Wakulima wamehimizwa kufuata kanuni za kilimo zinazozingatia lishe ili kuboresha mapato ya uzalishaji wa chakula na uwezeshaji wa wanawake ili kukabiliana na utapiamlo katika jamii zao.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of West Pokot County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Utafiti wa Uhalifu inawaonya wakazi wa Wilaya ya West Pokot kuhusu kuongezeka kwa kashfa za pesa za rununu na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ka digaya dadka deggan degmada West Pokot oo ku saabsan kororka khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobilada waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan falin.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations osiemo jogweng' mar West Pokot County kuom wach medruok mar timbe mag wuondo pesa mag simo kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: KICD encourages residents of Meru County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: KICD inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: KICD waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Meru mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda mondo ging'e kaka ji duto biro tiyo gi bajet mar county.

English: IPOA urges the public in Murang'a County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: IPOA inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: IPOA waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadweynaha degmada Murang'a inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo ji duto e County mar Murang'a mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma osefweny kuom wuond mag SIM-swap.

English: Office of the Auditor-General announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kuajiri kwa ajili ya usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la hagaajiyay waqtiga wareejinta shahaadada dhalashada ee degmada Bungoma.

Kiswahili: Mpango wa Kukabiliana na Ukame nchini Kenya, Januari - Desemba 2023 (Imetolewa Januari 2023)

Kiswahili: IEBC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Juni hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee degmada Marsabit bishii Juun.
Dholuo: IEBC timo romo mar puonjo ji e wi ratiro mag sirkal e taon mar Marsabit e dwe mar Jun.

English: Public health advisory: KEMRI warns of increased cyclosporiasis risk in Meru County and advises the public to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMRI inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya cyclosporiasis katika Kaunti ya Meru na inashauri umma kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Talo-bixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: KEMRI waxay ka digeysaa khatarta sii kordheysa ee cyclosporiasis ee degmada Meru waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: KEMRI chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar cyclosporiasis e County mar Meru kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gitudre gi pi mochido.

English: KEPHIS advises farmers in Makueni County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Makueni inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qaybqaataan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Makueni mondo okel namba mar pimo jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: KEMSA encourages residents of Turkana County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay uga qayb galaan kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' Turkana County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: The application of biotechnology in Agriculture can however change the scenario: the application of genetic modification technology can be used to develop.
Kiswahili: Utumiaji wa teknolojia ya kibayoteknolojia katika Kilimo unaweza hata hivyo kubadilisha hali: matumizi ya teknolojia ya urekebishaji wa maumbile yanaweza kutumika kuendeleza.
Somali: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, codsiga bioteknoolojiga ee Beeraha ayaa beddeli kara xaaladda: adeegsiga tiknoolajiyada wax ka beddelka hidde-sideyaasha ayaa loo isticmaali karaa horumarka.

Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Baringo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2024
