Dholuo: Kaunti mar Baringo: Oboke machon mar oro mar Septemba 2024

English: Kenya Dairy Board promotes water harvesting among farmers in Vihiga County as part of the February climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inakuza uvunaji wa maji miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Februari.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa goosashada biyaha beeraleyda degmada Vihiga iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Febraayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo choko pi e kind jopur e County mar Vihiga kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo kinda mar kedo gi lokruok mar kor lwasi e dwe mar Februar.

English: Pest Control Products Board warns coffee farmers in Kitui County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawaonya wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Kitui juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa uga digaya beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Kitui cudurrada cayayaanta waxayna kugula talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok mar Pest, chiwo siem ne jopur ma loso chai e gweng' mar Kitui e wi tuoche ma kelo hinyruok, kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Hali ya Kenya: Kenya inapambana na vitisho kutoka kwa wanamgambo wa jumuiya na al-Shabaab | Novemba 2024

English: TSC urges residents of Kitui County to register their children at the nearest public school to benefit from free day secondary education.

English: KNEC urges residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to register their children at the nearest public school to benefit from free day secondary education.

Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud somo mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: Notice: NPS launches a theft prevention campaign in Kericho County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NPS yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Kericho Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada degmada Kericho bishii November.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NPS chako kampen mar geng'o kuo e taon mar Kericho e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds residents of Isiolo County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo in helitaanka adeegyada baasaboorka ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya parone jogweng' Isiolo County ni koro yot yudo passport kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: KNEC advises applicants in Lamu County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KNEC inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Lamu kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KNEC waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha gobolka Lamu inay dalbadaan booska TVET ee KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e Lamu County mondo oketgi e tiegruok mar TVET kokalo kuom KUCCPS.

English: Kenya Medical Association appeals to caregivers in Kakamega County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the August maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya harakati za afya ya uzazi za Agosti.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ka codsadaa daryeelayaasha degmada Kakamega inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha oo qayb ka ah ololaha caafimaadka hooyooyinka bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association okwayo jogo makonyo nyithindo e Kaunti mar Kakamega mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi e dwe mar Agost.

English: Nyeri (Kieni) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for December 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Nyeri (Kieni): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Desemba 2022

Dholuo: Kaunti mar Nyeri (Kieni): Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2022

English: State Department for TVET urges youth in Meru County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Meru kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Meru inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada rayidka ah ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada rayidnimada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET ojiwo rowere e county mar Meru mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok gichako timo tije mag oganda.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Kajiado County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Kajiado inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e Kajiado County mondo oluong kony mar thieth mar paro maonge chudo.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Nakuru County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nakuru juu ya umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay dadka degmada Nakuru ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay nadaafadda saxda ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne ji e Nakuru County kuom ber mar rito ler maler e ngima joot.

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Nandi County that access to skilled birth attendance is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba upatikanaji wa mahudhurio ya uzazi wenye ujuzi ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Nandi in helitaanka daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfad leh ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone mine madwaro nyuol e county mar Nandi ni thuolo mar yudo nyithindo ma nigi lony en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag oganda.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds farmers in Narok County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok juu ya utunzaji wa rekodi zinazoendelea kwa programu ya mafunzo ya wakulima.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Narok barnaamijka tababarka beeralayda ee socda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development parone jopur manie Narok County kuom chenro mar tiego jopur ma dhi nyime.

English: OGP warns public officers in Wajir County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: OGP inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Wajir dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: OGP waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee Gobolka Wajir khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: OGP chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e gweng' mar Wajir kuom timbe mag wuondruok.

English: ODPP urges residents of Meru County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia laini ya bure ya EACC ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee EACC si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogweng' mar Meru County mondo oland weche mag mibadhi kokalo kuom hotline mar EACC ma onge chudo mondo giked gi wuond mag yuto.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds schools in Murang'a County to strengthen inclusion of learners with disabilities this February.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuimarisha ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu Februari hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka ayaa xusuusinaya dugsiyada degmada Murang'a inay xoojiyaan ka mid noqoshada ardayda naafada ah bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne skunde man Murang'a County mondo omed tiego jopuonjre ma nigi midekre e dwe mar Februar.

English: Pest Control Products Board announces a free anthrax vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Samburu County this October.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kimeta kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Samburu Oktoba hii.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa ku dhawaaqaya jimicsi tallaal ah oo lacag la'aan ah oo loo sameeyo digaagga caanaha ah ee Gobolka Samburu bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products olando chenro mar thieth mar anthrax maonge chudo e dwe mar Oktoba e county mar Samburu.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds schools in Lamu County to strengthen anti-bullying measures this February.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuimarisha hatua za kupambana na uonevu Februari hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada Waxbarashada ayaa xusuusinaya dugsiyada degmada Lamu inay xoojiyaan tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibaatada bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne skunde man Lamu County mondo omed jiwo yore mag geng'o nindruok e dwe mar Februar.

English: IEBC reminds the public in Murang'a County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: IEBC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Murang'a in sheegashada khiyaamooyinka iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: IEBC parone ji duto e County mar Murang'a ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag yuto en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: Notice: KEMSA will hold a suicide prevention forum in Taita-Taveta County this June. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA itafanya kongamano la kuzuia kujiua katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta Juni hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMSA waxay qabaneysaa madasha ka hortagga ismiidaaminta ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMSA biro timo chokruok mar geng'o ji kik donjre e taon mar Taita-Taveta e dwe mar Jun. Ji duto mor.

English: KRA urges residents of Kericho County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada si ay uga warqabaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Kericho mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo omed ng'eyo chenro mar dongruok e gweng'no.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds the public in Vihiga County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Uhalifu unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada wuxuu dadka degmada Vihiga ku xasuusinayaa inay ka feejignaadaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations parone ji duto e County mar Vihiga ni gibed motang' gi chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: IEBC urges youth in Nyamira County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nyamira inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo rowere e County mar Nyamira mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto gikwongo tiyogo ka pok gichako timo tije mag sirkal.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) warns public officers in Narok County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Narok dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Narok khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e kaunti mar Narok kuom timbe mag mibadhi.

English: KEPHIS advises maize producers in Trans Nzoia County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawashauri wazalishaji wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha hadhuudhka ee degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka iibsadaan wax soo saarka kaliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KEPHIS nyiso jopur mag kodhi e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia ni giusgi mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo kodhi kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: MoH assures parents of vaccine safety after two children died from polio shot
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahakikishia wazazi usalama wa chanjo baada ya watoto wawili kufariki kutokana na chanjo ya polio
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa waalidiinta u xaqiijisay badbaadada tallaalka kadib markii laba carruur ah ay ku dhinteen tallaalka polio
Dholuo: Ministry of Health osemiyo jonyuol geno kuom thieth mar chan bang ' ka nyithindo ariyo osetho nikech tuo mar polio

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges anyone struggling with their mental health in West Pokot County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka West Pokot inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag obwongo e West Pokot County mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the public in Meru County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Meru kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadweynaha degmada Meru inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ji duto e County mar Meru mondo ochiw ripot mar ote mamulo pachgi ne jatendgi bang' yudo ripode mag ote mag phishing.

English: Adopt the One Health approach recognizing the link between human animal and environmental health in managing foodborne illnesses
Kiswahili: Tumia mbinu ya Afya Moja ukitambua uhusiano kati ya afya ya binadamu wanyama na mazingira katika kudhibiti magonjwa yanayosababishwa na chakula
Somali: Qaadashada habka One Health oo aqoonsanaysa xiriirka u dhexeeya xayawaanka aadanaha iyo caafimaadka deegaanka ee maareynta cudurrada ka dhasha cuntada
Dholuo: Ti gi chenro mar One Health mondo okony dhano gi le obed gi ngima maber e bwo tuoche mayudore e chiemo

English: TVET reminds schools in Bungoma County to strengthen school infrastructure safety this January.
Kiswahili: TVET inazikumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuimarisha usalama wa miundombinu ya shule Januari hii.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Bungoma inay xoojiyaan ammaanka kaabayaasha dugsiga bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa skunde mag Bungoma County mondo omed jiwo ritruok mar chenro mag skul e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) confirms a cyclosporiasis outbreak alert for Kitui County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa cyclosporiasis kwa Kaunti ya Kitui. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xaqiijineysaa feejignaanta cudurka cyclosporiasis ee Gobolka Kitui. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: SHA (Social Health Authority) osenyiso ni nitie masira mar cyclosporiasis e gweng' mar Kitui.

English: Notice: KMTC opens applications for textbooks and learning materials for learners in Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inafungua maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay u furaysaa codsiyada buugaagta waxbarasho iyo qalabka wax lagu barto ardayda degmada Kiambu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC chako tiyo gi buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok ne jopuonjre e gweng' mar Kiambu.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Nakuru County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Nakuru inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ng'ato ang'ata man Nakuru County ma nigi chandruok mar paro mondo odhi ir japuonj molony.

English: Beer and smocking increases blood warmth. When you are at home, reduce taking beer and smocking
Kiswahili: Pombe na pombe huongeza joto la damu.
Somali: Biirka iyo sigaarka ayaa kor u qaada heerkulka dhiigga. Markaad guriga joogtid, yaree qaadashada biirka iyo khamriga
Dholuo: Sama in pacho, ket tong' e madho kong'o kod madho ndawa

English: Certain foods can cause discomfort in babies. Monitor reactions and adjust your diet.
Kiswahili: Vyakula fulani vinaweza kusababisha matatizo kwa watoto wachanga.
Somali: Cunnooyinka qaarkood waxay ilmaha u keeni karaan xanuun.
Dholuo: Chiemo moko nyalo miyo nyithindo obed gi parruok.

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will host a free tobacco control outreach in Nyeri County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa udhibiti wa tumbaku bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska Dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta Caafimada taranka ayaa marti gelineysa dadaal ka dhan ah ka hortagga sigaarka oo lacag la'aan ah Gobolka Nyeri bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo kampen mar nono kong'o e County mar Nyeri e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education opens a new electrical installation programme at the vocational centre in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu yafungua programu mpya ya ufungaji wa umeme katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Kitui.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo lagu rakibo korontada xarunta xirfadaha ee Gobolka Kitui.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Puonjruok ochako chenro manyien mar keto sitima e otas mar tiegruok e gweng' mar Kitui.

English: Our nurses have been at the front line in this fight against COVID-19 as the first point of call in our health facilities. They tremendously sacrifice every day despite the risk of contracting the virus to ensure those infected are taken care of; Dr. Aman. #KomeshaCorona update
Kiswahili: Wauguzi wetu wamekuwa mstari wa mbele katika vita hivi dhidi ya COVID-19 kama hatua ya kwanza ya wito katika vituo vyetu vya afya. Wanajitolea sana kila siku licha ya hatari ya kuambukizwa virusi ili kuhakikisha walioambukizwa wanatunzwa; Dk Aman. #KomeshaCorona sasisho
Somali: Kalkaaliyayaasha caafimaadku waxay safka hore kaga jireen dagaalkan lagula jiro COVID-19 iyagoo ah barta ugu horreysa ee xarumaha caafimaadka. Waxay si weyn u huraan maalin kasta inkastoo ay halis ugu jiraan inay qaadaan fayraska si loo hubiyo in kuwa qaba la daryeelo; Dr. Aman. #KomeshaCorona update
Dholuo: Jotich magwa osebedo e nyim lwenyni mar kedo gi COVID-19 kaka ng’at ma okwongo luongo e kar thieth magwa. Gichiwo gik mang’eny ahinya pile ka pile kata obedo ni gin gi luoro mar yudo tuwo mar midhusi mondo gine ni jogo ma oyudo midhusi no orit maber; Dokta Aman. #KomeshaKorona ma manyien

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association confirms a malaria outbreak alert for Kirinyaga County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya chathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa malaria katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu xaqiijiyay digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka fayraska ee Gobolka Kirinyaga. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Medical Association osenyiso ni nitie masira mar malaria e County mar Kirinyaga.

English: Notice: NDMA issues a cybersecurity alert on phishing messages affecting residents of Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya ujumbe wa udanganyifu unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan fariimaha phishing ee saameeya dadka deggan Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NDMA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity kuom weche mag phishing makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' mar Wajir County.

English: COMESA reminds livestock keepers in Nairobi County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: COMESA waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Nairobi inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: COMESA parone jopur mag jamni e County mar Nairobi mondo opog jamni maggi e kuonde moketi mag chamo jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: Council of Governors reminds the public in Elgeyo-Marakwet County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay dadka degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet ku xasuusinayaan in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch oparo ne ji duto e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni chiwo ripot mar kawo asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Council of Governors announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kufanya kazi kwa ajili ya huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku dhawaaqeen waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee degmada Mombasa.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch olando lokruok e seche mag tiyo gi passport e county mar Mombasa.

English: Notice: IPOA issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa utambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogaysiis: IPOA waxay soo saartaa digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan xadiidka aqoonsiga ee saameeya dadka deggan gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IPOA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity e wi kuo mar ng'ato makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Taita-Taveta County.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) advises residents of Taita-Taveta County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuthibitisha kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea kupata huduma ya afya ya ruzuku.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Taita-Taveta in ay xaqiijiyaan in xaruntooda la aqoonsaday ka hor inta aysan booqan si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) nyiso jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo ong'e ni kuondegi mag thieth oseyudo ratiro kapok gibiro mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Kisumu County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on community-based development programmes.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia wavuti ya kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo jogweng' mar Kisumu County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mag dongruok e kind oganda.

English: Health CS Mutahi Kagwe says total lockdown on the table if coronavirus cases escalate, urges Kenyans to limit social interactions.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Afya Mutahi Kagwe anasema amri ya kutotoka nje ikiwa visa vya virusi vya corona vitaongezeka, anawahimiza Wakenya kupunguza mwingiliano wa kijamii.
Somali: CS Caafimaadka Mutahi Kagwe ayaa sheegay in xiritaanka guud ee miiska haddii kiisaska coronavirus ay sii kordhaan, wuxuu ugu baaqay dadka Kenya inay xaddidaan isdhexgalka bulshada.
Dholuo: CS Health Mutahi Kagwe wacho ni kwan mar ji duto ma nigi tuo mar Corona ok nyal chung', kendo ojiwo jo Kenya mondo ogeng' tudruok margi gi jowetegi.

English: DPP urges the community in Siaya County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb burglary.
Kiswahili: DPP anahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Siaya inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo ji duto e county mar Siaya mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds livestock keepers in Laikipia County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu xasuusinayaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Laikipia inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyaga oo aan haysan rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jorit jamni e County mar Laikipia ni kik giting' jamni ka ok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: Talking about mental heal contributes to reducing despising others and sets others free. Lets build helpful environment for all.
Kiswahili: Kuzungumzia kuhusu uponyaji wa akili kunachangia kupunguza kuwadharau wengine na kuwaweka wengine huru. Tujenge mazingira yenye manufaa kwa wote.
Somali: Markaad ka hadashid caafimaadka maskaxeed waxaad yareyn kartaa sida dadka kale loo quudhsado, dadka kalena waad xoraynaysaa.
Dholuo: Wuoyo e wi weche mag thieth konyo e tieko chayo jomoko kendo miyo jomoko bedo thuolo.

English: Notice: EACC opens a new service point for national ID applications in Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Somali: Ogaysiis: EACC waxay furaysaa goob adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Murang'a.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: EACC oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag kwayo nying' e gweng' mar Murang'a.

English: Notice: DCI opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DCI inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa marejeleo salama makazi katika Marsabit County.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay fureysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya talooyin ku saabsan hoyga badbaadada ee degmada Marsabit.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni DCI ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo weche ma nyalo konyo ng'ato yudo kar dak maber e taon mar Marsabit.

English:
Stressed about money? Don_x0092_t gamble with your mental health!
When finances feel overwhelming, it_x0092_s tempting to chase "quick fixes" like gambling or substance use_x0097_but these only make things worse. Instead, take control by seeking free financial counseling and building healthy money habits.
Your mental health matters. Choose smart solutions over short-term risks.
Kiswahili: Ukiwa na mkazo juu ya pesa? Usicheze kamari na afya yako ya akili! Wakati fedha zinapokuwa nyingi, ni kushawishi kutafuta "rekebisho la haraka" kama vile kucheza kamari au matumizi ya dawa za kulevya - lakini hizi huzidisha tu hali. Badala yake, chukua udhibiti kwa kutafuta ushauri wa kifedha wa bure na kujenga tabia nzuri za pesa. Afya yako ya kiakili ni muhimu. Chagua suluhisho za busara badala ya hatari za muda mfupi.
Somali:
Ma ka walwalsan tahay lacagta? Ma ku khamaaraysaa caafimaadkaaga maskaxda!
Marka dhaqaaluhu dareemo culays, waxay ku dayanaysaa inaad raadiso "hagaajin degdeg ah" sida khamaarka ama isticmaalka maandooriyaha_x0097_laakiin kuwani waxay ka sii darayaan oo keliya. Taa beddelkeeda, la wareeg xakamaynta adoo raadinaya la-talin dhaqaale oo bilaash ah oo aad dhisto caadooyin lacag oo caafimaad qaba.
Caafimaadkaaga maskaxeed waa muhiim. Dooro xalal caqli badan halkii aad ka dooran lahayd khataraha muddada-gaaban.
Dholuo:
Ibedo gi parruok kuom pesa? Kik ibed gi tuke gi ngimani mar paro!
Ka pesa winjo ka ng’eny ahinya, en gima kelo tem mar luwo “gik ma nyalo loso mapiyo” kaka tugo mar pesa kata tiyo kod gik ma mero ji, to gigo mana miyo gik moko bedo marach ahinya. Mopogore, kawo loch kuom manyo rieko ma onge chudo e wi pesa kendo bedo gi kido maber mar tiyo kod pesa.
Ngima mari mar paro en gima duong’. Yier yore mariek moloyo pek mag kinde machuok.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) calls on parents in Migori County to have children under five screened for cholera during the March outreach.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Migori kuwafanya watoto chini ya miaka mitano kupimwa kipindupindu wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Machi.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Migori in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka kolera intii lagu jiray bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) kwayo jonyuol e county mar Migori mondo otim nonro mar cholera ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will hold a trauma counselling forum in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this August. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanya kongamano la ushauri wa kiwewe katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Agosti hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) waxay qaban doontaa madasha la talinta dhaawaca ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet bisha Agoosto. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo romo mar chiwo paro e wi tuoche e taon mar Elgeyo-Marakwet e dwe mar Agost.

English: Investigate about mental health illness in your family, investigatiion have confirmed that it is rotational in a family, but is is preventable. Endelea kujifunza kuelewa zaidi kuhusu ugonjwa huu wa akili, jinsi mbaya ni gynecologically, katika makazi yako na katika mwili wako kuishi kwa mafanikio.
Somali: Baaritaan ku saabsan cudurka caafimaadka dhimirka ee qoyskaaga, baaritaannada ayaa xaqiijiyay in uu yahay mid wareegaya qoyska, laakiin waa la hortagi karaa. sii wad inaad wax badan ka ogaato cudurkan dhimirka, sida ay u xun tahay dhakhtarka haweenka, gurigaaga iyo jirkaaga si aad u noolaato si guul leh.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds livestock keepers in Garissa County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa xoolaha xoolaha ee Gobolka Garissa inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service parone jorit jamni e county mar Garissa ni mondo gimi jamnigi thieth e kuonde moyier mag chwoyo jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

Kiswahili: SHA inawasihi wananchi wanaostahiki katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.

Dholuo: SHA jiwo jokanyo mag county mar Vihiga mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar yiero.

Kiswahili: Mkutano wa uthibitishaji wa sekta mtambuka ulifanyika ili kuoanisha mikakati ya lishe ya kaunti na kitaifa chini ya KNAP.
Somali: Kulan xaqiijinta qaybaha kala duwan oo la qabtay si loo iswaafajiyo istaraatijiyadaha nafaqada ee gobollada iyo kuwa qaranka ee ku hoos jira KNAP.

Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Busia.

Kiswahili: KEPHIS inakuza kilimo cha misitu kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Aprili.

Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.

Kiswahili: KRA inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Meru kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu.

Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo rowere e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok ochopo tije mag oganda.

English: DCI calls on residents of Baringo County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.

Dholuo: DCI okwayo jogweng' Baringo County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji nitie mondo okony e gero kuwe e piny mangima.

Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jopur e County mar Nairobi chenro mar tiego jopur ma sani dhi nyime.

English: KALRO advises farmers in Nandi County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the March planting season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi kudhibiti wizi wa jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa za kuua wadudu zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Machi.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Nandi in ay ka hortagaan ciidamada ciidanka xilliga dayrta iyagoo isticmaalaya cayayaanka la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maarso.

Dholuo: NPS okwayo ji duto e county mar Siaya mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo mondo giyud kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit confirms a cyclosporiasis outbreak alert for Kirinyaga County. Residents are advised to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa cyclosporiasis kwa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa xaqiijisay digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka cyclosporiasis ee Gobolka Kirinyaga. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osenyiso ni nitie masira mar cyclosporiasis e kaunti mar Kirinyaga.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Makueni County that access to subsidised dialysis is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba upatikanaji wa dialysis ya ruzuku sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.

English: KEMRI announces free medical camps for residents of Homa Bay County starting this May.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuanzia Mei hii.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa xeryo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay laga bilaabo bisha May.
Dholuo: KEMRI ogolo kampen mag thieth maonge chudo ne jogweng' Homa Bay County kochakore e dwe mar Mei.

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Embu County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay haystaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health nyiso jogweng'o mag Embu County mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi maber sama gidwaro thieth mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa bilaabay bixinta adeegyada heerka degmada ee Degmada Mandera.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Bura mar Jaloch ochako chiwo kony e gwenge mopogore opogore e County mar Mandera.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds residents of Nyandarua County that organic farming improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba kilimo hai kinaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba la muda mrefu.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua in beeraha dabiiciga ah uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jogweng' Nyandarua County ni pur mar organic nyalo miyo puothe obed gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: Kenya Red Cross advises residents of Taita-Taveta County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Laanta Cas ee Kenya waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Taita-Taveta inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada la hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth ma onge chudo mar oganda mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: The Kenyan government is reviewing the Plant Protection Act to enhance plant health regulations Stakeholders are encouraged to provide comments on the Draft Plant Protection Bill 2021
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya inapitia Sheria ya Kulinda Mimea ili kuimarisha kanuni za afya ya mimea Wadau wanahimizwa kutoa maoni kuhusu Rasimu ya Mswada wa Kulinda Mimea 2021.
Somali: Dowladda Kenya ayaa dib u eegis ku sameynaysa Sharciga Ilaalinta Dhirta si loo xoojiyo xeerarka caafimaadka dhirta Dhinacyada daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiiri gelinayaa inay ka faalloodaan hindisaha Sharciga Ilaalinta Dhirta 2021
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya nono chike mag ritruok mag yien mondo omed jiwo chike mag thieth mag yien Jo ma ok gin Joneno ojiw mondo ochiw paro e wi Bill mar ritruok mag yien 2021

English: Yellowing of the skin and eyes in newborns should be checked by a health worker. Severe jaundice can affect brain development.
Kiswahili: Kuwa na rangi ya njano kwenye ngozi na macho kwa watoto wachanga kunapaswa kuchunguzwa na mfanyakazi wa afya. Homa kali ya manjano inaweza kuathiri ukuaji wa ubongo.
Somali: Dhalashada maqaarka iyo indhaha ee dhallaanka cusub waa in la hubiyaa shaqaalaha caafimaadka.
Dholuo: Ng'at matimo nonro kuom weche thieth onego one kaka pien nyathi kod wang'e bedo gi rangi ma jaber nikech tuwo marachno nyalo chiko kaka obwongo dongo.

English: Kenya Medical Association launches a September awareness campaign on tobacco control across Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kizindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Septemba juu ya udhibiti wa tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu bilaabay olole wacyi galineed bishii Sebtember ee ka dhanka ah xakamaynta sigaarka ee gobolka Nandi.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Septemba e wi thieth mar ndawa e County duto mar Nandi.

English: Notice: IEBC opens applications for school laptops under the digital literacy programme for learners in Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inafungua maombi ya kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa codsiyada laptop-yada dugsiga ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee ardayda degmada Tharaka-Nithi.
Dholuo: Rapar: IEBC oseyawo kwayo mag kompyuta mag skul e bwo chenro mar somo kod somo mar digital ne jopuonjre e Tharaka-Nithi County.

English: Notice: KEPHIS restricts movement of dairy cows in Kilifi County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS inazuia harakati za ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi wenye uvimbe.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Kilifi sababtuna tahay faafitaanka cudurka maqaarka.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok makwayo chak e gweng' mar Kilifi nikech tuwo mar dhoot.

English: Agribusiness stakeholders are invited to join the Inclusive Agribusiness Club to collaborate on strengthening inclusivity and sustainability in the sector
Kiswahili: Wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanakaribishwa kujiunga na Klabu ya Biashara ya Kilimo Shirikishi ili kushirikiana katika kuimarisha ushirikishwaji na uendelevu katika sekta hiyo.
Somali: Daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha waxaa lagu casuumay inay ku biiraan Naadiga Inclusive Agribusiness si ay uga shaqeeyaan xoojinta is-dhexgalka iyo joogtaynta ee qaybta
Dholuo: Oganda ma nigi paro e weche mag ohala kaachiel gi ohala bende igwelo mondo oriwre gi Club ma oriwo ohala kod ohala mondo giti kanyachiel e jiwo winjruok maber gi ohala e kind ohala gi ohala

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages mothers in Samburu County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Samburu kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Samburu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit jiwo mine e county mar Samburu mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Get the latest AATF news, impact stories, agricultural technology updates, industry feature analysis, field stories and much more.
Kiswahili: Pata habari za hivi punde za AATF, hadithi za athari, masasisho ya teknolojia ya kilimo, uchanganuzi wa vipengele vya tasnia, hadithi za shamba na mengi zaidi.
Somali: Hel wararkii ugu dambeeyay ee AATF, sheekooyinka saameynta, cusbooneysiinta tiknoolajiyada beeraha, falanqaynta astaamaha warshadaha, sheekooyinka goobaha iyo waxyaabo kale oo badan.
Dholuo: Yud weche manyien mag AATF, weche mag lokruok, weche manyien mag yore mag pur, nono weche mag ohala, weche mag pap kod weche mamoko.

English: Kajiado County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for November 2022

English: KUCCPS announces distribution of school laptops under the digital literacy programme to schools in Samburu County this January.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inatangaza usambazaji wa kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Samburu Januari hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku dhawaaqday qaybinta kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada gobolka Samburu bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: KUCCPS olando chiwo mag laptop mag skul e bwo chenro mar somo gi somo mar digital e skunde man Samburu County e dwe mar Januar.

English: SHA urges residents of Kisii County to attend the public participation forum to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: SHA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si ay u qaabeeyaan wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynta.

English: IPOA warns residents of Lamu County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this December.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Desemba hii.

English: SHA urges residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.

Kiswahili: Wakulima nchini Uganda tafadhali kumbuka kuwa tarehe rasmi ya mavuno ya vanila imetangazwa Hakikisha uvunaji bora zaidi ili kudumisha ubora na faida.

English: Notice: OGP opens voter education centres in Kirinyaga County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay furaysaa xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee Gobolka Kirinyaga bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: OGP ochako tiego josiasa e boma mar Kirinyaga e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education opens a new welding and fabrication programme at the vocational centre in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu inafungua programu mpya ya kulehemu na utengenezaji katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ka furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan alxanka iyo soo saarista xarunta xirfadaha ee gobolka Nandi.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Puonjruok ochako chenro manyien mar loso kendo loso gik moko e kar tiegruok ma yudore e county mar Nandi.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Nyamira County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa msaada wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow si ay uga caawiyaan helitaanka daryeelka caafimaad ee lacageed.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit nyiso jogweng' Nyamira County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni mondo giyud kony mar yudo thieth makonyo.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development calls on the community in Garissa County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Garissa kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada Waxbarashada wuxuu ugu baaqay bulshada Gobolka Garissa inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oluongo oganda man Garissa County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Keep sharp objects, poisons or things that break easily away from children
Kiswahili: Weka vitu vyenye makali, sumu, au vitu vinavyoweza kuvunjika kwa urahisi mbali na watoto

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Bomet County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Bomet inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e gweng' mar Bomet County mondo odhi ir japuonj molony.

English: KNEC advises applicants in Homa Bay County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KNEC inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kutembelea kituo cha mafunzo ya ufundi kilicho karibu kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku talineysaa codsadayaasha gobolka Homa Bay in ay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e gweng' mar Homa Bay mondo odhi e otas mar tiegruok matiyo ne Nyasaye man machiegni kodgi.

English: CDC reminds the public in Kilifi County that access to eye and dental camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kwamba ufikiaji wa kambi za macho na meno sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kilifi in helitaanka xeryaha indhaha iyo ilkaha ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji duto manie Kilifi County ni koro ginyalo dhi e kambini mag thieth mar wang' kod lakteche mag laktech.

English: Public notice: Kenya Medical Association will host a free food safety outreach in Marsabit County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa usalama wa chakula bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa barnaamij ammaanka cuntada oo lacag la'aan ah oo lagu qaban doono degmada Marsabit bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association biro timo chenro mar chiwo kony maonge chudo mar chiemo e boma mar Marsabit e dwe mar abich.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds residents of Homa Bay County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama mara moja.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay in warbixinta khiyaanada si deg deg ah ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations parone jogweng' Homa Bay County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar wuond konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: KMTC reminds parents in Elgeyo-Marakwet County that free primary education registration is open this October.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba usajili wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo umefunguliwa Oktoba hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in diiwaangelinta bilaashka ah ee waxbarashada hoose ay furan tahay bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KMTC parone jonyuol e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni somo mar pinyruoth ma onge chudo ochakore e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Announcement of free school milk program for primary pupils in Migori and Nakuru to improve child nutrition and school attendance.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la mpango wa maziwa ya bure kwa wanafunzi wa shule za msingi huko Migori na Nakuru ili kuboresha lishe ya watoto na mahudhurio shuleni.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida barnaamijka caanaha dugsiga ee bilaashka ah ee ardayda dugsiga hoose ee Migori iyo Nakuru si loo hagaajiyo nafaqada carruurta iyo ka qaybgalka dugsiga.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar jopuonjre mag skul mag Migori kod Nakuru biro timo chenro mar chiwo chak maonge chudo e skul mondo okony nyithindgi yudo chiemb chuny maber kendo dhi e skul.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free meningitis screening is available at all public health centres in Bomet County this July.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa uti wa mgongo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Bomet Julai hii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka meningitis-ka ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka guud ee degmada Bomet bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji ni nono tuo mar meningitis onge tich e kuonde thieth duto mag oganda e County mar Bomet e dwe mar Julai.

English: CDC encourages residents of Uasin Gishu County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.

Dholuo: CDC jiwo jogweng' Uasin Gishu County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giluong kony mar thieth mar chuny maonge chudo.

English: KUCCPS conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Kericho County this July.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Kericho Julai hii.

Dholuo: KUCCPS dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e dwe mar Julai e gweng' mar Kericho.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit launches an August awareness campaign on food safety across Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kizindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Agosti juu ya usalama wa chakula katika Kaunti ya Samburu.

Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Machi.

English: IEBC announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Embu County.
Kiswahili: IEBC inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kushughulikia vyeti vya kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay ka shaqeynta shahaadada dhalashada ee Gobolka Embu.
Dholuo: IEBC olando lokruok e seche mag timo nonro mag nyasi mag nyuol e county mar Embu.

English: A resident urges Taita Taveta County Government to impose high taxes on Muguka.
Kiswahili: Mkaaji mmoja anahimiza Serikali ya Wilaya ya Taita Taveta iweke kodi kubwa kwa Muguka.
Somali: Qof deggan ayaa ku booriyay Dawladda Gobolka Taita Taveta inay canshuur sare ku soo rogto Muguka.
Dholuo: Ng'at moro modak e gweng'no jiwo sirkal mar Taita Taveta mondo oket osuru mang'eny kuom Muguka.

English: IEBC reminds needy students in Murang'a County that school laptops under the digital literacy programme applications close soon.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya maombi ya programu ya kusoma na kuandika ya kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Murang'a in laptop-yada dugsiga ee barnaamijka codsiyada akhriska dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: IEBC parone jopuonjre man gi chandruok e County mar Murang'a ni kompyuta mag skul manie program mar somo kod somo mar digital biro rumo machiegni.

English: Kenya: Registered refugees and asylum-seekers (as of 31 October 2022)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Wakimbizi waliosajiliwa na wanaotafuta hifadhi (kuanzia tarehe 31 Oktoba 2022)
Somali: Kenya: Qaxootiga diiwaangashan iyo kuwa magangalyo doonka ah (laga bilaabo 31 Oktoobar 2022)
Dholuo: Kenya: Jolweny ma ondiki nyinggi kod jogo madwaro dak (chakre tarik 31 dwe mar apar higa mar 2022)

English: DCI urges the public in Tana River County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: DCI inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha degmada Tana River County inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada lacagta mobilada.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo ji duto manie Tana River County mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche mag wuond motudore gi pesa miting'o e simo.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response calls on parents in Lamu County to have children under five screened for cholera during the May outreach.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuwafanya watoto chini ya miaka mitano wachunguzwe kipindupindu wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Mei.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Lamu inay carruurta ka yar shan sano u sameeyaan baaritaanka cudurka kolera intii lagu jiray bisha May.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche kwayo jonyuol e County mar Lamu mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Mei.

English: Kenya Dairy Board urges cattle farmers in Nyandarua County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawataka wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa Newcastle vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda lo'da ee degmada Nyandarua inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo ka dib kiisaska cudurka Newcastle ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur mag jamni e County mar Nyandarua mondo ogeng'gi e kuonde moketi mag chwoyo jamni bang' ka osenyis ni nitie tuo mar Newcastle.
