English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties urges residents of Meru County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kudai usambazaji wa huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Meru ku boorinayaa inay dalbadaan bixinta adeegyada aan la bixin laaluush si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Meru mondo okonygi ka ok gichiwo asoya mondo giked gi mibadhi.

English: Research Terms of Reference: Actor, service and infrastructure mapping in Dadaab refugee camps, KEN2202, Kenya, January 2021, V1
Kiswahili: Masharti ya Marejeleo ya Utafiti: Muigizaji, huduma na ramani ya miundombinu katika kambi za wakimbizi za Dadaab, KEN2202, Kenya, Januari 2021, V1.
Somali: Shuruudaha Cilmi-baarista: Jilayaasha, adeegga iyo khariidaynta kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha ee xeryaha qaxootiga ee Dhadhaab, KEN2202, Kenya, Janaayo 2021, V1
Dholuo: Chike mag Nonro: Jatugo, tij kod map mar gedo e kambi mag jolweny mag Dadaab, KEN2202, Kenya, dwe mar achiel higa mar 2021, V1

English: Notice: e-Citizen launches ward-level service delivery in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inazindua utoaji wa huduma katika wilaya ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: e-Citizen waxay bilawday bixinta adeegyada heerka qaybta ee Gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: e-Citizen chako chiwo kony e alwora mar Uasin Gishu County.

English: Secretary-General's Press Conference in Nairobi, Kenya, 3 May 2023
Kiswahili: Mkutano wa Katibu Mkuu na Wanahabari jijini Nairobi, Kenya, 3 Mei 2023
Somali: Shirkii Saxaafadda ee Xoghayaha Guud ee ka dhacay Nairobi, Kenya, 3 Maajo 2023
Dholuo: Chokruok mar Jondiko Maduong' e Nairobi, Kenya, tarik 3 dwe mar abich higa mar 2023

English: Notice: KTDA will train farmers in Bomet County on conservation tillage this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet juu ya kilimo cha uhifadhi Julai hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: KTDA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda gobolka Bomet oo ku saabsan beerashada ilaalinta bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA biro tiego jopur e county mar Bomet e dwe mar Julai.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Vihiga County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the April planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Aprili.
Somali: Guddiga xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Vihiga in ay ka hortagaan xayawaanka ciidanka xilliga dayrta iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Vihiga mondo oti gi yedhe makelo hinyruok chon ka gitiyo gi tuoche maketho tong' kapok higa mar April ochopo.

English: Notice: NTSA opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogsoonow: NTSA waxay furaysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya daryeel caafimaad ka dib rabshadaha gobolka Nandi.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NTSA ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony mar thieth bang' timbe mahundu e county mar Nandi.

English: IEBC warns public officers in Mombasa County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: IEBC inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Mombasa County dhidi ya udanganyifu wa fedha za umma.
Somali: IEBC waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee gobolka Mombasa in ay ka faa'iideystaan dhaqaale dawladeed.
Dholuo: IEBC chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Mombasa ni kik giti gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo e yo marach.

English: Public notice: Kenya Red Cross will host a free proper sanitation outreach in Tana River County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mazingira bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Tana River Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay marti gelineysaa adeegyo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku yaal degmada Tana River bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova mar Kenya Red Cross biro timo kampen mar rito ler mar pi e taon mar Tana River e dwe mar Mach.

English: FAO reminds livestock keepers in Narok County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Narok kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Narok in ay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska xayawaanada ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: FAO parone jopur mag jamni e gweng' mar Narok mondo onyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo orit ngima jamni.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Wajir County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati wa msimu huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lugta ku mara inta lagu jiro xilliyada dhulgariirada.
Dholuo: NTSA parone jogweng' mar Wajir County mondo oluw tong' mar piyo kendo oti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe e kinde mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: SHA reminds voters in Isiolo County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: SHA inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Isiolo inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: SHA parone jogweng' Isiolo County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom SMS ne ji 70000 kapok kinde mar yiero ochopo.

English: Notice: IEBC launches community-based development programmes in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inazindua mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii katika Kajiado County.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay bilawday barnaamijyo horumarineed oo ku saleysan bulshada ee Gobolka Kajiado.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IEBC chako chenro mag dongruok e alwora mar Kajiado County.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development warns cassava farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Wanyama inawaonya wakulima wa manii katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya mlipuko wa wadudu na inapendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa uga digtay beeraleyda cassava ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysay in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho manija e Elgeyo-Marakwet County kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by SHA (Social Health Authority) will be held in Turkana County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Turkana Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Turkana bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma SHA (Social Health Authority) ochano biro timore e County mar Turkana e dwe mar Desemba.

English: KTDA announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for poultry in Murang'a County this January.
Kiswahili: KTDA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa kuku katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Januari hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ka dhan ah qabatinka digaagga ee Gobolka Murang'a bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: KTDA olando chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar rabies e kaunti mar Murang'a e dwe mar Januar.

English: Public notice: Kenya Medical Association will host a free hand hygiene outreach in Makueni County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Makueni Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa barnaamij ku saabsan nadaafadda gacmaha oo bilaash ah degmada Makueni bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association biro timo kampen mar rito ler mar lwedo e gweng' mar Makueni e dwe mar Februar.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Marsabit County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kukaa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inay ka qeybgalaan kalfadhiga guud ee golaha gobolka si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda horumarinta gobolka.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng' mar Marsabit County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo omed ng'eyo chenro mag dongruok mag county.

English: State Department for Basic Education advises applicants in Marsabit County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Marsabit inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Ofis mar State for Basic Education nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skund mar Marsabit County ni gidonj e skundno ka pok giyudo thuolo mar dhi nyime gi tiegruok.

English: CFK Africa Witnesses Devastating Effects in Kenya from End of U.S. Agency for International Development Support
Kiswahili: CFK Africa Yashuhudia Athari Mbaya Nchini Kenya Kutoka Mwisho wa Shirika la Marekani la Usaidizi wa Maendeleo ya Kimataifa
Somali: CFK Africa Markhaatiyaal Saameyn Ba'an ku Yeeshay Kenya Laga Soo Bilaabo Hay'adda Taageerada Horumarinta Caalamiga ah ee Mareykanka
Dholuo: CFK Afrika Neno Gik Makethore ahinya e piny Kenya kowuok e giko mar riwruok mar piny Amerka mar konyo dongruok mar piny mangima

English: When mixing urea into livestock feed, do not exceed 30% of the animal's digestible crude protein requirement from urea, as too much urea can overdose and harm the animal.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa kuchanganya urea kwenye malisho ya mifugo, usizidi 30% ya mahitaji ya protini ghafi ya mnyama kutoka kwa urea, kwani urea nyingi zinaweza kuzidisha na kumdhuru mnyama.
Somali: Marka urea lagu daro quudinta xoolaha, ha ka badin 30% baahida borotiinka ceeriin ee xayawaanka ee la dheefshiidi karo ee urea ah, maadaama urea badan ay xad-dhaaf u keeni karto oo ay waxyeello u geysan karto xayawaanka.
Dholuo: Sama iketo urea e chiemb dhok, kik idwokne kuom 30% mar protein ma le dwaro e ring'o nikech ng'injo mang'eny ahinya nyalo miyo ondiek obed marach.

English: KUCCPS reminds schools in Marsabit County to strengthen inclusion of learners with disabilities this November.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuimarisha ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu Novemba hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Marsabit inay xoojiyaan ka mid noqoshada ardayda naafada ah bisha November.
Dholuo: KUCCPS paronwa skunde mag Marsabit County mondo omed jiwo joma puonjore gi midekre e dwe mar Novemba.

English: KALRO urges cassava growers in Turkana County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawasihi wakulima wa manii katika Kaunti ya Turkana watumie viwango vinavyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda cassava ee degmada Turkana inay isticmaalaan sicirka bacriminta lagu taliyey roobka ka hor si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur ma pidho manasa e County mar Turkana mondo oti gi kwan mar yien molony kapok koth ochue mondo omed kelo nyak e higani.

English: Severe headache, swelling of the body or bleeding during pregnancy requires urgent medical attention
Kiswahili: Maumivu makali ya kichwa, uvimbe wa mwili au umwagikaji wa damu wakati wa ujauzito huhitaji matibabu ya haraka
Somali: Madax xanuun daran, bararka jirka ama dhiig-baxa uurka ah waxay u baahan yihiin daryeel caafimaad oo degdeg ah
Dholuo: Chandruok maduong' mar wiye, tuoche mag del, kata rem e kinde ma ng'ato nie ich dwaro thieth mapiyo

English: Kenya Price Bulletin, March 2024
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Bei ya Kenya, Machi 2024
Somali: War-saxaafadeedka Qiimaha Kenya, Maarso 2024
Dholuo: Oboke mar nengo mar piny Kenya, dwe mar adek higa mar 2024

English: DPP urges motorists and pedestrians in Mombasa County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DPP anawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa darawalada gawaarida iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Mombasa inay guryahooda rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dabka daminta iyo inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa dhacdooyinka la xiriira qaraxyada dabka.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo derebe mag mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Mombasa mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo gitim kinda mar geng'o hinyruok mag yiengni.

English: Public health advisory: CDC warns of increased dengue fever risk in Tharaka-Nithi County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: CDC inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya homa ya dengue katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi na inashauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Talobixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: CDC waxay ka digeysaa khatarta sii kordheysa ee hargabka dengue ee Degmada Tharaka-Nithi waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar ji: CDC osiemo ji kuom medruok mar tuwo mar dengue e Tharaka-Nithi County kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore e thieth.

English: 4th floor, Farmer's bank, 162 Independence Avenue, Abuja Nigeria telephone +234 94605480; for more information aatf@aatf-africa.
Kiswahili: 4th floor, Farmer's bank, 162 Independence Avenue, Abuja Nigeria simu +234 94605480; kwa habari zaidi aatf@aatf-africa.
Somali: dabaqa 4aad, Farmer's bank, 162 Independence Avenue, Abuja Nigeria telefoonka +234 94605480; macluumaad dheeraad ah aatf@aatf-africa.
Dholuo: E gorofa mar ang'wen, Farmer's bank, 162 Independence Avenue, Abuja Nigeria simo +234 94605480; mondo iyud weche momedore atf@aatf-africa.

English: KMTC reminds schools in Kericho County to strengthen inclusion of learners with disabilities this October.
Kiswahili: KMTC inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuimarisha ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu Oktoba hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Kericho inay xoojiyaan ka mid noqoshada ardayda naafada ah bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KMTC oparo ne skunde man Kericho County mondo omed tiego jopuonjre ma nigi midekre e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Farmers are urged to adopt better agronomic practices and improve the use of fertilizers and quality seeds to enhance potato yields and returns despite current challenges
Kiswahili: Wakulima wametakiwa kufuata kanuni bora za kilimo na kuboresha matumizi ya mbolea na mbegu bora ili kuongeza mavuno ya viazi na kurudi licha ya changamoto zilizopo.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu booriyay inay qaataan hababka beeraha ee ka wanaagsan iyo inay wanaajiyaan isticmaalka bacriminta iyo abuurka tayada leh si kor loogu qaado wax soo saarka baradho iyo soo-saarka inkastoo caqabadaha hadda jira
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur mondo oti gi yore mabeyo mag pur kendo oti gi yien kod kodhi mabeyo mondo okony e medo nyak mar olemo kata obedo ni nitie pek moko ma sani nitie

English: FAO urges cassava growers in Migori County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawasihi wakulima wa manii katika Kaunti ya Migori watumie viwango vinavyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda cassava ee degmada Migori in ay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma pidho cham e kaunti mar Migori mondo oti gi kwan mar yien molos kapok koth ochue mondo omed nyak e higani.

English: A legal ruling confirmed IPOAâ€™s exclusive authority to investigate police misconduct and rejected attempts to limit its jurisdiction.
Kiswahili: Uamuzi wa kisheria ulithibitisha mamlaka ya kipekee ya IPOA ya kuchunguza tabia mbaya ya polisi na kukataa majaribio ya kupunguza mamlaka yake.
Somali: Go'aan sharci ah ayaa xaqiijiyay awoodda gaarka ah ee IPOA ay u leedahay inay baarto anshax xumada booliiska waxayna diiday isku dayada lagu xaddidayo awooddeeda.
Dholuo: Chik ma ne ogol e chik nonyiso ni IPOA kende ema nigi ratiro mar nono tim marach ma jopolisi timo kendo ne okwedo temo mag keto giko kuom teko mare.

English: Farmers in Kenya s Arid and Semi Arid Lands are encouraged to adopt cassava cultivation as a resilient solution to food insecurity and climate change challenges
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Maeneo Kame na Nusu Kame nchini Kenya wamehimizwa kufuata kilimo cha muhogo kama suluhu la uhaba wa chakula na changamoto za mabadiliko ya tabia nchi.
Somali: Beeraleyda ku nool dhulalka qallalan iyo semi-qallalan ee Kenya waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyay inay qaataan beerista cassava si ay u noqdaan xal adkaysi leh oo la xiriira dhibaatooyinka cunto la'aanta iyo isbeddelka cimilada
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur e piny Kenya ma nigi pi ma ok nyal yiengni mondo oti gi puodho mar manias kaka yo mar loyo pek mag chiemo kod lokruok mar lokruok mar piny

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development promotes water harvesting among farmers in Lamu County as part of the May climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inakuza uvunaji wa maji miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Mei.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay kor u qaadeysaa goosashada biyaha beeraleyda degmada Lamu iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka u adkeynta cimilada bisha Maajo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo choko pi e kind jopur e County mar Lamu kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kit yamo e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: TSC opens a new catering and hospitality programme at the vocational centre in Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC inafungua mpango mpya wa upishi na ukarimu katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan cuntada iyo marti-gelinta ka furtay xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi.
Dholuo: Rapar: TSC ochako chenro manyien mar chiemo kod rwako welo e kar tich e Tharaka-Nithi County.

English: Notice: IEBC reminds citizens in Kajiado County about their rights regarding devolution.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: Ogsoonow: IEBC waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Kajiado xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC paronwa raia mag Kajiado County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar golo pesa.

English: HELB conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Trans Nzoia County this November.
Kiswahili: HELB inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Novemba hii.
Somali: HELB waxay bishii Nofeembar ee sannadkan ka qabaneysaa barashada bulshada ee ku saabsan wareejinta degmada Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: E dwe mar Novemba, HELB biro timo chokruok mar tiego ji e wi weche mag golo pesa e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia.

English: Ministry of Education advises applicants in Nandi County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Nandi kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Nandi inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jogo madwaro donjo e skundno e county mar Nandi mondo odonj e skundni ka pok giyudo thuolo mar dhi nyime gi tiegruok.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds residents of Machakos County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos in ka qaybgalka maamulaha qaybta deegaanka ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General parone jogweng'o mag County ma Machakos ni tudruok gi jaritgi mar ward jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: IGAD Secretariatâ€™s statement on the ongoing heavy rains and subsequent floods across the region particularly in Kenya
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Sekretarieti ya IGAD kuhusu mvua kubwa zinazoendelea kunyesha na mafuriko katika eneo zima hasa nchini Kenya.
Somali: War-saxaafadeedka Xoghayaha IGAD ee ku saabsan roobabka culus iyo daadadka ka socda gobolka gaar ahaan Kenya
Dholuo: Wach mar IGAD kuom koth mapek ma dhi nyime kod pi ma pong'o bang'e e alwora duto ahinya ahinya e piny Kenya

English: Comment by UN Human Rights Office spokesperson Jeremy Laurence on Kenya protests
Kiswahili: Maoni ya msemaji wa Ofisi ya Haki za Kibinadamu ya Umoja wa Mataifa Jeremy Laurence kuhusu maandamano ya Kenya
Somali: Faallo uu jeediyay afhayeenka xafiiska xuquuqda aadanaha ee Qaramada Midoobay Jeremy Laurence oo ku saabsan dibadbaxyada Kenya
Dholuo: Jalony mar Ofis mar Riwruok mar Pinyruoth mar Ratiro Dhano Jeremy Laurence owacho ewi kwedo ma ji timo e piny Kenya

English: Parents attend CBC sensitization forum on February 20 at county hall.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanahudhuria mkutano wa ufahamu wa CBC Februari 20 katika ukumbi wa wilaya.
Somali: Waalidiintu waxay ka qeybgalayaan madasha wacyiga ee CBC 20-ka Febraayo ee hoolka gobolka.
Dholuo: Jonyuol biro e chokruok mar CBC mar chiwo paro tarik 20 dwe mar Februar e od bura mar county.

English: KEMSA launches a March awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Machi juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: KEMSA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole wacyi galineed bishii Maarso oo ku saabsan baaritaanka sonkorowga gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: KEMSA chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Mach e wi nonro mar thieth mar sukari e Homa Bay County.

English: State Department for TVET advises applicants in Migori County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Migori kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Migori inay dalbadaan booska TVET iyada oo loo marayo KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Migori mondo okonygi yudo somo mar TVET kokalo kuom KUCCPS.

English: Kenya Forest Service alerts residents of Wajir County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir juu ya kuongezeka kwa visa vya wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ka digay dadka deggan Gobolka Wajir in ay kordhaan kiisaska burburka wuxuuna ku talinayaa dadweynaha inay ku biiraan mashaariicda booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service chiwo siem ne ji modak e County mar Wajir kuom wach kwan mar joma odonjo e dala kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Makueni County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Makueni: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2023
Somali: Degmada Makueni: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Makueni: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2023

English: USDA supports regenerative agriculture practices for livestock to enhance soil health.
Kiswahili: USDA hutegemeza mazoea ya kilimo ya kukuza upya mifugo ili kuboresha afya ya udongo.
Somali: USDA waxay taageertaa hababka beeraleyda dib-u-soo-nooleynta ee xoolaha si loo hagaajiyo caafimaadka ciidda.
Dholuo: USDA riwo lwedo yore mag pur ma ji timo e yor choko jamni mondo omi lowo obed gi ngima maber.

English: In 2026, the KCC, with support from the European Commission (DG ECHO), is implementing an action focused on providing Multipurpose Cash Assistance (MPCA) to crisisâ€“affected communities across Kenya.
Kiswahili: Mnamo 2026, KCC, kwa usaidizi wa Tume ya Ulaya (DG ECHO), inatekeleza hatua inayolenga kutoa Msaada wa Pesa Madhumuni (MPCA) kwa jamii zilizoathiriwa na shida kote nchini Kenya.
Somali: Sanadka 2026, KCC, oo taageero ka heleysa Guddiga Yurub (DG ECHO), ayaa hirgelinaysa tallaabo diiradda saareysa bixinta Kaalmo Lacageed oo Ujeeddo Badan leh (MPCA) bulshooyinka ay saameeyeen dhibaatooyinka ee ku baahsan Kenya.
Dholuo: E higa mar 2026, KCC, ka otiyo gi kony ma owuok kuom Komiti mar Pinyruoth (DG ECHO), keto e tim chenro ma ochung’ne chiwo kony mar pesa ma nyalo tiyo kuom gik mang’eny (MPCA) ne oganda ma oyudo masira e piny Kenya duto.

English: However, 32% of households still reported being unaware of available channels, highlighting the need for improved communication.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, asilimia 32 ya kaya bado ziliripoti kutofahamu njia zinazopatikana, na hivyo kuonyesha hitaji la kuboreshwa kwa mawasiliano.
Somali: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, 32% qoysaska ayaa wali soo sheegay inaysan ka warqabin kanaallada la heli karo, taasoo muujineysa baahida loo qabo in la hagaajiyo isgaarsiinta.
Dholuo: Kata kamano, 32% mar udi pod nonyiso ni ok ong’eyo yore ma nitie, ma nyiso ni dwarore ni otim tudruok maber.

English: KALRO urges sorghum growers in Vihiga County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda sorghum ee degmada Vihiga inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si loo wanaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur mag sorghum e County mar Vihiga mondo okaw kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo okony e medo nyak mar yien e higani.

English: Over the years, the KCC has developed tools, systems and mechanisms to provide targeted and timely multi-sectoral responses based on needs prioritisation and continuous market monitoring, enabling the consortium to offer assistance to over 500,000 individuals.
Kiswahili: Kwa miaka mingi, KCC imeunda zana, mifumo na mbinu za kutoa majibu yaliyolengwa na kwa wakati mwafaka ya sekta mbalimbali kulingana na kipaumbele cha mahitaji na ufuatiliaji endelevu wa soko, kuwezesha muungano huo kutoa usaidizi kwa zaidi ya watu 500,000.
Somali: Sannado badan, KCC waxay samaysay qalab, nidaamyo iyo farsamooyin lagu bixinayo jawaabo dhinacyo badan leh oo la beegsanayo oo waqtigooda ku habboon iyadoo lagu salaynayo mudnaanta baahiyaha iyo la socodka joogtada ah ee suuqa, taasoo u suurtagelinaysa isbahaysiga inuu caawimo siiyo in ka badan 500,000 oo qof.
Dholuo: E higini mosekalo, KCC oseloso gige tich, sistem kod yore mag chiwo dwoko ma ochung’ne kendo ma oromo e kinde ma owinjore, ma ochung’ne keto dwaro mokuongo kendo dhi nyime gi luwo chiro, ma miyo riwruokno nyalo chiwo kony ne ji mokalo 500,000.

English: DCI urges anyone experiencing abuse in Busia County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: DCI inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayetendewa vibaya katika Kaunti ya Busia kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Busia inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo tembe e gweng' mar Busia mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: TVET encourages residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda mondo gibed gi ng'eyo kuom kaka ji biro tiyo gi bajet mar county.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will train farmers in Embu County on organic farming this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu juu ya kilimo hai Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Embu ee beeraha dabiiciga ah bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro tiego jopur e county mar Embu e weche mag pur e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: OGP will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynta ee degmada Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: OGP biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag siasa e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will conduct a post-harvest handling workshop for farmers in Bungoma County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itafanya warsha ya kushughulikia baada ya mavuno kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi ka dib goosashada beeraleyda degmada Bungoma bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro timo tiegruok mar rito puothe mag puothe bang' keyo e dwe mar Februar e Bungoma County.

English: Notice: ODPP will hold a public participation forum on development planning forums in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta ee degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: ODPP biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag dongruok e gweng' mar Bungoma.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Trans Nzoia County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the April planting season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Wanyama inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa za kukabiliana na ukame kabla ya msimu wa kupanda Aprili.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia inay qaataan noocyo abuurka ah oo abaarta u adkaysta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development nyiso jopur mag Trans Nzoia County mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro ka pok ochopo higa mar April.

English: CDC advises residents of Kakamega County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: CDC inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: CDC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: CDC nyiso jogweng' Kakamega County mondo odonj e riwruok mar insuarans mar thieth mondo giyud thieth.

English: Notice: NPS opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Busia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa simu ya GBV ya bure katika Kaunti ya Busia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ee degmada Busia.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NPS ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo chenro mar konyo maonge chudo mar GBV e county mar Busia.

English: Council of Governors invites residents of Garissa County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kuwasilisha kumbukumbu za maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku martiqaadaan dadka deggan degmada Garissa inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee ku saabsan habka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch ogwelo jogweng' mar County mar Garissa mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso bajet mar county ochopo.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development informs maize farmers in Nyeri County of new market linkage opportunities this June.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inafahamisha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Juni hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Nyeri fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development olero ne jopur mar kodhi e County mar Nyeri thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Tharaka-Nithi County this March. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanya kongamano la kurejesha matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Machi hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay qaban doontaa madasha soo kabashada xadgudubka maandooriyaha ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi bishii Maarso. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo chokruok mar chango joma otiyo gi yedhe mamero e Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar Mach.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages residents of Taita-Taveta County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Taita-Taveta inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay la xiriiraan lataliye la tababaran yahay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo kik sandgi ka giol kendo mondo giwuo gi jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Pilot providing mobile seed kits and training to women's groups to grow nutritious food in informal settlements.
Kiswahili: Pilot akitoa vifaa vya mbegu vinavyohamishika na mafunzo kwa vikundi vya wanawake ili kukuza chakula chenye lishe katika makazi yasiyo rasmi.
Somali: Pilot oo bixisa qalabka abuurka moobilka ah iyo tababar kooxaha haweenka si ay u beeraan cunto nafaqo leh oo ku yaal deegaannada aan rasmi ahayn.
Dholuo: Pilot chiwo kit kodhi ma ne itiyogo e loso kodhi kendo tiego grube mag mon mondo opidh chiemo ma nigi ber e mier ma ok ochan.

English: Ministry of Education conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in Bungoma County this April.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Aprili hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay bishii Abriil ku qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi ratiro mag sirkal e County mar Bungoma e dwe mar April.

Somali: Sida laga soo xigtay warbixin dhowaan ka soo baxday Wasaaradda Caafimaadka, waxaa suurtagal ah in aad xanuunsato in ka badan 6 jeer si aad u cuduriso makaraayada, haddii aad joogtid xaafadaha usia,Tana River,Kakamega,Bungoma,Kilifi, Kisumu,Trans Nzoia,Elgeyo Marakwet na Nandi

English: Council of Governors reminds residents of Uasin Gishu County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba kufikia usajili wa e-Citizen sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.

Kiswahili: Tangazo kupitia maonyesho ya barabarani katika kaunti ambazo zinalenga kukuza ufahamu juu ya kuzaliwa salama, usafi wa nyumbani na lishe nzuri kwa watoto

English: TSC reminds youth in Homa Bay County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa upishi na mafunzo ya ukarimu.
Somali: TSC waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada ku nool gobolka Homa Bay in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta.

English: KICD reminds parents in Kiambu County that free day secondary education registration is open this December.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba usajili wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo umefunguliwa Desemba hii.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Kiambu in diiwaangelinta dugsiga dhexe ee bilaashka ah ay furan tahay bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne jonyuol e County mar Kiambu ni somo mar sekondari mar odiechieng' achiel ma onge chudo osechakore e dwe mar Desemba.

English: KEMRI advises residents of Homa Bay County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMRI waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo odonj e riwruok mar insuarans mar thieth mondo giyud thieth ma yudo kony.

English: Notice: DCI issues a cybersecurity alert on mobile money scams affecting residents of Turkana County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DCI inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu zinazoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana.
Somali: Ogaysiis: DCI waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khayaanada lacagta mobilada ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: DCI ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity kuom timbe mag wuond mag pesa mitimo gi simo ma mulo joma odak e county mar Turkana.

English: NTSA alerts residents of Kericho County to a rise in fraud cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za ulaghai na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Somali: NTSA waxay dadka deggan degmada Kericho uga digtay kororka kiisaska khiyaamooyinka waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kericho County kuom wach medruok mar weche mag wuondruok kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag ritruok gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the public in Trans Nzoia County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadweynaha degmada Trans Nzoia inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ji duto e Trans Nzoia County mondo ochiw ripot mar ote manyalo kelo hinyruok ne jomisonari margi bang' yudo ripode mag ote mag phishing.

English: The Young Girls at the Forefront of Climate Action in Kenya's Pastoralist Community

English: DCI urges residents of Taita-Taveta County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DCI inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama wakati wa umakini mkubwa wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Taita-Taveta inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: DCI ojiwo jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar sirkal e wi gik ma ne timore e alwora mar tong'gi nikech ji osebedo ka keto pachgi ahinya kuom loso kuwe e piny.

English: Taking different types of vaccines is not recommended. After being fully vaccinated you will obtain your COVID-19 certificate from the MOH website https://portal.health.go.ke.
Kiswahili: Kuchukua aina tofauti za chanjo haipendekezwi. Baada ya kuchanjwa kikamilifu utapata cheti chako cha COVID-19 kutoka kwa tovuti ya MOH https://portal.health.go.ke.

Dholuo: Tiyo gi yore mopogore opogore mag thieth ok owinjore. Bang' yudo thieth duto ibiro yudo singruok mari mar thieth mar COVID-19 e websait mar Ministry of Health (MOH) ma en https://portal.health.go.ke.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) advises residents of Vihiga County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa usaidizi wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow si ay uga caawiyaan helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ee lacageed.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) nyiso jogweng' mar County mar Vihiga mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni mondo giyud kony mar yudo kony kuom weche thieth.

English: Notice: IPOA conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Marsabit County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ku saabsan dhismaha nabadda qaranka ee degmada Marsabit bishii Maarso.

English: Universities Fund reminds needy students in Mandera County that revision guides applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho yanafungwa hivi karibuni.

Dholuo: Riwruok mar University Fund paronwa raia mag Nairobi County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo ombudsman.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education reminds citizens in Nairobi County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Nairobi xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of Baringo County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kutoteseka kimya kimya na kumhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.

Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa za kuponda ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.

Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB inafungua programu mpya ya kulehemu na utengenezaji katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi.

English: This provides a foundation for alternative policies to be costed to address these gaps and a true costâ€“benefit analysis to be conducted.

English: Ministry of Education advises students in Makueni County to register early to secure allocation to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Makueni kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata maudhui ya ujifunzaji wa kidijitali bila malipo.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Taita-Taveta County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta Desemba hii.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) restricts movement of cattle in Makueni County due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.

Dholuo: Riwruok mar Lemo kod Chiemo (AFA) ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok e county mar Makueni nikech tuo mar Newcastle.

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages mothers in Kisii County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kisii kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.

English: KUCCPS opened its portal for course revision for 2024/2025 placement targeting 2023 KCSE candidates and past candidates from 2000 to 2023.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds mobile money users in Kajiado County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha watumiaji wa fedha za simu za mkononi katika Kajiado County kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka kashfa za pesa za simu.

Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e Kajiado County mondo onon kwayo mag pesa e yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo gitang' gi mibadhi mag pesa mag simu.

English: KNEC advises applicants in Nairobi County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kutembelea kituo cha mafunzo ya ufundi kilicho karibu zaidi kwa ulaji ujao.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges residents of Baringo County to avoid contact with contaminated water sources following a rise in reported measles cases.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya surua vilivyoripotiwa.

Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' Baringo County mondo owe tudruok gi kuonde ma pi yudoree nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuwono osemedore.

English: Better market access: Strengthening cooperatives, promoting digital marketing, and developing fair trade systems enhance farmers' market ...
Kiswahili: Ufikiaji bora wa soko: Kuimarisha vyama vya ushirika, kukuza masoko ya kidijitali, na kuendeleza mifumo ya biashara ya haki huboresha soko la wakulima ...

English: Office of the Auditor-General updates residents of Trans Nzoia County on progress of ward-level service delivery this December.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia juu ya maendeleo ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya Desemba hii.

Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General chiwo ripot ne jogweng' mar Trans Nzoia kuom dongruok mar chiwo kony e wi ward e dwe mar Desemba.

English: When crops are damaged during or after harvest, they quickly spoil. You may not be able to sell your damaged produce, or you may be forced to sell at a reduced price. On the other hand, if you can reduce your losses, you can increase your income. At harvest time, when picking fruits, be careful not to knock them off the tree and onto the ground. If fruit falls, it gets bruised, disease and insects attack, and the fruit will quickly spoil. If you reduce the number of falls, you will have high quality produce to sell.

English: KEMSA appeals to caregivers in Isiolo County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the April maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya harakati za afya ya uzazi Aprili.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Isiolo inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka ee Abriil.
Dholuo: KEMSA okwayo jorit e County mar Isiolo mondo okwan kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi kaka achiel kuom chenro mar April Maternal Health Campaign.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board restricts movement of poultry in Turkana County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya yazuia harakati za kuku katika Kaunti ya Turkana kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa digaagga ee degmada Turkana sababtuna tahay faafitaanka cudurka maqaarka.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Dairy Board ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok e County mar Turkana nikech tuoche mag pien.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) informs tea farmers in West Pokot County of new market linkage opportunities this August.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawafahamisha wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Agosti hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee Gobolka West Pokot fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Ogosto.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nyiso jopur mag chai e West Pokot County e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Agost.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds farmers in Machakos County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos juu ya programu inayoendelea ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa wakulima.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa beeraleyda degmada Machakos in barnaamijka tababarka beeralayda uu socdo.

Kiswahili: TVET inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi kwa watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TVET waxay bulshada degmada Nyandarua ugu baaqeysaa inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116 si ay u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: TVET okwayo ji duto manie County mar Nyandarua mondo omany namba mar 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Universities Fund reminds youth in Tana River County that HELB funding is available for tailoring and design training.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Tana River kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xasuusinayaa dhalinyarada degmada Tana River in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka qaabeynta iyo naqshadeynta.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa rowere man Tana River County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Makueni County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Makueni inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kalfadhiga tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Makueni mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e chokruok mabiro.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Kericho County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia simu ya EACC ya bure ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee EACC si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo jogweng' Kericho County mondo ochiw ripode mag mibadhi kokalo kuom hotline mar EACC maonge chudo mondo giked gi wuond mag yuto.

English: Encourage establishment of community gardens and small livestock (especially poultry) systems to increase local availability of vegetables and animal-source foods.
Kiswahili: Kuhimiza uanzishwaji wa bustani za jamii na mifumo ya mifugo midogo (haswa kuku) ili kuongeza upatikanaji wa ndani wa mboga mboga na vyakula vya wanyama.

Dholuo: Jiwo loso puothe mag oganda kod yore mag rito jamni matindo (mak mana winy) mondo omi omed bedo gi cham ma nigi alot kod chiemo mowuok kuom le.

Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itasambaza mbegu za maharagwe zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni Machi hii.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations activates an emergency response plan for fire outbreaks in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inaamsha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa milipuko ya moto katika Kaunti ya Meru.

Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche motudore gi weche mag mahundu chako tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony mapiyo ne masiche mag mach e kaunti mar Meru.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Nairobi County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi diiwaangelinta beeraleyda loogu talagalay beeralayda Gobolka Nairobi bishii Febraayo.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of West Pokot County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.

Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo kik gitim kamano gi ling'ling' kendo mondo giwuo gi jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Working mothers can express and store breast milk to ensure continued breastfeeding support while away.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wanaofanya kazi wanaweza kukamua na kuhifadhi maziwa ya mama ili kuhakikisha unyonyeshaji unaoendelea wakiwa mbali.
Somali: Hooyooyinka shaqada ka shaqeeya waxay soo bandhigi karaan caanaha hooyada waxayna kaydin karaan si loo hubiyo in ay sii wadaan taageerada naasnuujinta inta ay maqnaadaan.
Dholuo: Minwa matiyo nyalo nyiso kendo kano chak mar min mare mondo omi odhi nyime miyogi chak ka gin mabor.

English: Despite many challenges, some countries have adopted HIV service delivery models for people from key populations that are entirely or partly financed domestically and that could be sustainable at scale.
Kiswahili: Licha ya changamoto nyingi, baadhi ya nchi zimetumia modeli za utoaji wa huduma za VVU kwa watu kutoka makundi muhimu ambayo yanafadhiliwa kwa kiasi kikubwa au kwa kiasi ndani na ambayo inaweza kuwa endelevu kwa kiwango kikubwa.
Somali: Iyadoo ay jiraan caqabado badan, waddamada qaar waxay qaateen qaabab bixinta adeegga HIV ee dadka ka soo jeeda dadka muhiimka ah kuwaas oo gebi ahaanba ama qayb ahaan lagu maalgeliyo gudaha dalka, kuwaas oo noqon kara kuwo waara marka la eego baaxadda.
Dholuo: Kata obedo ni nitie pek mang’eny, pinje moko osekawo yore mag chiwo kony mar HIV ne ji ma wuok e oganda madongo ma yudo pesa duto kata matin kuomgi e pinygi kendo ma nyalo bedo ma nyalo sikon e kwan maduong’.

English: The 32-year-old mother of five from Gatwekera in Kibera sub-county, Nairobi County, returned home to find everything submerged, including her children's vaccination records.
Kiswahili: Mama wa watoto watano mwenye umri wa miaka 32 kutoka Gatwekera katika kaunti ndogo ya Kibera, Kaunti ya Nairobi, alirejea nyumbani na kupata kila kitu kimezama, ikiwa ni pamoja na rekodi za chanjo za watoto wake.
Somali: Hooyada 32 jirka ah ee shan carruur ah dhashay kana soo jeeda Gatwekera oo ku taal degmada Kibera ee hoos timaada degmada Nairobi, ayaa gurigeeda ku soo laabatay iyadoo aragtay wax walba oo quusay, oo ay ku jiraan diiwaanka tallaalka carruurteeda.
Dholuo: Miyo ma jahigni 32 man nigi nyithindo abich mawuok Gatwekera e sumun mar Kibera, County mar Nairobi, nodok dacho noyudo gikmoko duto onimo pi, koriwo rekod mag chanjo mar nyithinde.

English: KTDA urges cassava growers in Nakuru County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawasihi wakulima wa manii katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kupitisha aina za mbegu zinazoshinda ukame ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda cassava ee degmada Nakuru inay qaataan noocyo abuurka ah oo abaarta u adkaysta si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur ma pidho cham e gweng ' mar Nakuru County mondo okaw kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed nyak e higani.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges residents of Kisii County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.

Dholuo: IPOA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e West Pokot County mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

Kiswahili: Jihadharini na programu za uwekezaji zinazotangazwa wakati wa mechi za mpira wa miguu kwenye matangazo yasiyo ya sheria.

Dholuo: Bed motang' gi gik mitimoga e tuke mag opira ma ji goyo e Intanet.

English: OGP reminds voters in Kisii County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: OGP inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kisii kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya kujiandikisha.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Kisii inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor diiwaangelinta codbixisayaasha.
Dholuo: OGP parone jogweng' Kisii mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero kapok gidonjo e register mar joma oyiero.

English: Notice: KICD reminds citizens in Bomet County about their rights regarding voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuhusu haki zao kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Bomet ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KICD paronwa raia mag Bomet County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar ndiko joma oyiero.

English: Ministry of Education urges youth in Tharaka-Nithi County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok ojiwo rowere e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oriwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gibedo gi chenro mar timo tije mag oganda.

Dholuo: Jatend pinyno, Dr. <2Zepa> 10:10, 11.

English: KNEC reminds needy students in Busia County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba ufadhili wa masomo kwa maombi ya wanafunzi wenye uhitaji utafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KNEC waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Busia in deeqaha waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay codsiyada ardayda baahan ay dhowaan soo gabagabeynayaan.
Dholuo: KNEC oparo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e County mar Busia ni tuke mag somo ma konyo jopuonjre ma nigi chan biro rumo machiegni.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Lamu County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa huzindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Lamu Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee Gobolka Lamu bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Lamu e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: IEBC opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inafungua maombi ya maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali bila malipo kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay u furaysaa codsiyada barashada digital-ka ah ee bilaashka ah ardayda ku nool gobolka West Pokot.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC oyawo kwayo mag somo maonge chudo mar digital ne jopuonjre man West Pokot County.

English: OGP reminds residents of Kisii County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: OGP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba upatikanaji wa utunzaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda ka sahlan tahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: OGP parone jogweng' mar Kisii County ni koro yot yudo weche mag loso nyasi mag nyuol ka gitiyo gi yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: KEPHIS informs maize farmers in Nakuru County of new market linkage opportunities this April.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawafahamisha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Aprili hii.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Nakuru fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: KEPHIS nyiso jopur mag kodhi e kaunti mar Nakuru e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar April.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on residents of Embu County to support local peace-building committees in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inatoa wito kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuunga mkono kamati za ujenzi wa amani katika kuunga mkono mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ugu baaqay dadka deggan degmada Embu inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee deegaanka si ay u taageerayaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oluongo jogweng' Embu County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gweng'no e siro chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: EACC reminds residents of Nyandarua County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua wanaohudhuria mkutano wa umma wa mkutano wa kaunti kuimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Nyandarua ee ka qeybgalaya kalfadhiga guud ee shirka gobolka inay xoojiyaan maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: EACC paronwa jogweng' Nyandarua County ma biro e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: KICD urges parents and teachers in Kirinyaga County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: KICD inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Somali: KICD waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta Gobolka Kirinyaga inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Kirinyaga mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto.

English: KUCCPS encourages residents of Nairobi County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on voter registration.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo jogweng' Nairobi County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda mondo ging'e weche duto motudore gi ndiko jogo madwaro yiero.

English: As a catalyst for self-reliance and health security, the strategy advances Kenya's strategic interests regionally, riding on the goodwill of the President's lead role as AU champion on Local Manufacturing.
Kiswahili: Maoni muhimu kutoka kwa uchanganuzi wa mazingira yanaonyesha mfumo ikolojia wa utengenezaji wa ndani uliogawanyika na changamoto mtambuka ambazo zinahusisha wizara na mashirika mengi, na hivyo kuzuia maendeleo kuelekea Huduma ya Afya kwa Wote.
Somali: Iyada oo ah kicinta isku-kalsoonida iyo amniga caafimaadka, istaraatiijiyaddani waxay horumarinaysaa danaha istaraatiijiyadeed ee Kenya ee gobolka, iyadoo ku saleysan niyad wanaagga doorka hoggaamineed ee Madaxweynaha ee ah horyaalnimada AU ee wax soo saarka maxalliga ah.
Dholuo: Kaka ng’at ma nyalo konyo e rito ngimane owuon kod rito ngimane, chenrono dhi nyime gi dwaro mag piny Kenya e alwora, ka ochung’ne gombo maber mar Jatend pinyno kaka jatelo mar AU e weche mag loso gikmoko e pinyno.

English: IPOA reminds the public in Embu County to remain vigilant on counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: IPOA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Embu kubaki macho juu ya umakini wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Embu in ay sii joogaan feejignaanta ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa ji duto e county mar Embu mondo gibed motang' gi weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education opens a new electrical installation programme at the vocational centre in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi yafungua programu mpya ya ufungaji wa umeme katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Dowladda waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan rakibidda korontada xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Nairobi.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State Department for Basic Education ochako chenro manyien mar keto sitima e kar tiegruok e taon mar Nairobi.

English: CDC urges residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to avoid contact with contaminated water sources following a rise in reported dengue fever cases.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya homa ya dengue.
Somali: CDC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ka fogaadaan inay la xiriiraan ilo biyo wasakheysan ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska cudurka dengue.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo owe tudruok gi kuonde ma pi yudoree nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuwo mar dengue osemedore.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds livestock keepers in Vihiga County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Vihiga inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska xoolaha ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) paronwa jorit jamni e County mar Vihiga ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Kisumu County this November. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya itafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Novemba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay qabaneysaa madasha caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhallinyarada ee degmada Kisumu bisha November. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Ministry of Health biro timo romo mar paro ne rowere e Kisumu County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in Busia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inafungua maombi ya maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali bila malipo kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Busia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay codsiyada u furaysaa bartayaasha degmada Busia si ay u helaan barasho digital ah oo lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar State Department for TVET oyawo kwayo mar yudo puonj mag digital maonge chudo ne jopuonjre man Busia County.

English: Teachers Service Commission encourages out-of-school children in Trans Nzoia County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya ugawaji wa bursary.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Trans Nzoia inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga ugu dambeeya ee la siinayo deeqda waxbarashada.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission jiwo nyithindo maok dhi e skul e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: The new board of the Kenya Planters Cooperative Union is operational and will manage the Coffee Cherry Advance Revolving Fund to support Kenyan coffee farmers
Kiswahili: Bodi mpya ya Kenya Planters Cooperative Union inafanya kazi na itasimamia Coffee Cherry Advance Revolving Fund kusaidia wakulima wa kahawa wa Kenya.
Somali: Guddiga cusub ee ururka wada shaqaynta beeraleyda Kenya ayaa shaqeynaya wuxuuna maamuli doonaa Sanduuqa Coffee Cherry Advance Revolving Fund si uu u taageero beeraleyda kafeega Kenya
Dholuo: Bura manyien mar Kenya Planters Cooperative Union koro tiyo kendo obiro tayo riwruok mar Coffee Cherry Advance Revolving Fund mondo okony jopur mag Kenya

English: Universities Fund advises students in Homa Bay County to register early to secure allocation to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata kompyuta ndogo za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa dijiti.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ardayda degmada Homa Bay kula talinayaa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan waqti hore si ay u helaan lacag ay ku heli karaan kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska digitalka.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo jopuonjre e Homa Bay County mondo odonj e tiegruok chon mondo giyud pesa mar donjo e kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar digital literacy.

English: Expectant mothers are strongly advised to avoid all alcohol. Drinking during pregnancy can lead to fetal alcohol syndrome and developmental delays.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wajawazito wanashauriwa sana kuepuka pombe kabisa. Kunywa pombe wakati wa ujauzito kunaweza kusababisha ugonjwa wa pombe ya fetasi na kuchelewa kwa ukuaji.
Somali: Hooyooyinka uurka leh waxaa si adag loogu talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan khamriga oo dhan.
Dholuo: Onego ojiw mon ma pod tindo ni kik gimadh kong'o e okang' moro amora nikech madho divai e kinde mag ich nyalo miyo nyathi obed gi tuwo miluongo ni alcohol syndrome kendo mano nyalo miyo chakruok mar nyathine odog chien.

English: State Dept. commitingto subsidizing solar-powered storage for perishable nutrient-rich crops.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo imejitolea kutoa ruzuku kwa hifadhi inayotumia nishati ya jua kwa mazao yanayoharibika na yenye virutubisho vingi.
Somali: Waaxda Gobolka oo ballanqaaday inay maalgeliso kaydinta tamarta qoraxda ee dalagyada nafaqo badan leh ee baabi'i kara.
Dholuo: Dwe mar Piny owacho. ma ne ochiwore mar chiwo pesa ne kuonde ma ne itiyogo e kano gik ma nigi teko mar chieng' ne cham ma ne nyalo kethore kendo ma ne nigi gik ma kelonegi ber.

English: Notice: IEBC opens a new motor vehicle mechanics programme at the vocational centre in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inafungua programu mpya ya ufundi wa magari katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan farsamada gawaarida gawaari ee xarunta xirfadaha ee gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IEBC chako chenro manyien mar tiyo gi masin mag mtokni e skul mar tich e Homa Bay County.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa simu ya GBV ya bure katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay furtay xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ee Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji ochako tiyo gi ofis mar weche nindruok e gweng' mar Kakamega.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds livestock keepers in Tana River County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa za kuponda ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xayawaanka ah ee degmada Tana River inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) paronwa jorit jamni e taon mar Tana River County mondo opidhgi gi tuoche e kuonde moyier mag chwoyo jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: KNEC conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Makueni County this July.
Kiswahili: KNEC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Makueni Julai hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha gobolka Makueni bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: KNEC dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi migawo mar Ombudsman e provins mar Makueni e dwe mar Julai.

English: Gender gains overshadowed by constitutional violation: An analysis of the situation for women in politics after the 2022 Kenya elections
Kiswahili: Mafanikio ya kijinsia yaliyogubikwa na ukiukaji wa katiba: Uchambuzi wa hali ya wanawake katika siasa baada ya uchaguzi wa 2022 Kenya
Somali: Faa'iidooyinka jinsiga oo ay hadheeyeen xadgudub dastuuri ah: Falanqayn ku saabsan xaaladda haweenka siyaasadda ka dib doorashadii Kenya ee 2022
Dholuo: Oboke mag chwo gi mon ma opong’ gi ketho chik piny: Nonro mar chal mar mon e weche siasa bang’ yiero mag Kenya e higa mar 2022
