English: For now, open bars and test social distancing. KCPE and KCSE are not a ticket to heaven
Kiswahili: Kwa sasa, fungua baa na jaribu umbali wa kijamii. KCPE na KCSE si tiketi ya kwenda mbinguni
Somali: Waqtigan xaadirka ah, baararka furan iyo imtixaanka masaafada bulshada. KCPE iyo KCSE ma aha tigidhka jannada
Dholuo: Kata kamano, gie sani, bar moket mondo oyaw, kendo tem mar rito ritruok e kind ji, KCPE kod KCSE ok gin gik mabiro dhi e polo.

English: Ministry of Education encourages residents of Meru County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabaan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jogweng' mar Meru County mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto giseyudo mondo ging'e ratiro ma sirkal nigo.

English: Tanzania s Agriculture Development Fund is now available to finance strategic agricultural projects Farmers and agribusinesses are encouraged to apply for support in infrastructure inputs and subsidies
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Maendeleo ya Kilimo Tanzania sasa unapatikana kufadhili miradi ya kimkakati ya kilimo Wakulima na wafanyabiashara wa kilimo wanahimizwa kuomba msaada wa pembejeo za miundombinu na ruzuku.
Somali: Sanduuqa Horumarinta Beeraha ee Tansaaniya ayaa hadda la heli karaa si loo maalgeliyo mashaariicda beeraha istiraatiijiyadeed Beeraleyda iyo ganacsiyada beeraha waxaa lagu dhiiri gelinayaa inay dalbadaan taageero ku saabsan waxyaabaha lagu daro kaabayaasha iyo deeqaha kaabayaasha
Dholuo: Pesa mar Tanzania Agriculture Development Fund koro yudore mondo oti gi yore mag pur mag piny

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) calls on parents in Mandera County to have children under five screened for cholera during the January outreach.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuwachunguza watoto chini ya miaka mitano kipindupindu wakati wa mawasiliano ya Januari.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta Degmada Mandera in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka kolera intii lagu jiray bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) dwaro ni jonyuol e county mar Mandera otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Januar.

English: Kenya Dairy Board encourages farmers in Migori County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for horticultural produce.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za mazao ya bustani.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda degmada Migori inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay alaabta beeraha.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur e county mar Migori mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony-tich ma nigi ratiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar olembe mag puodho.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens voter registration centres in Narok County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua vituo vya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Narok Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu furayaa xarumaha diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee Gobolka Narok bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya osechako tiyo gi chenro mar ndiko joma oyier e Narok County e dwe mar Agost.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges residents of Trans Nzoia County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia simu ya EACC ya bure ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa fedha za umma.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee EACC si looga hortago xadgudubka lacagta dawladda.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General jiwo jogweng' mar Trans Nzoia County mondo oland weche mag mibadhi kokalo kuom hotline mar EACC maonge chudo mondo giked gi ketho pesa mag sirkal.

English: Ministry of Education trains coordinators at county levels on management of special needs education to improve service delivery.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawazoeza wahariri katika ngazi ya wilaya juu ya usimamizi wa elimu ya mahitaji maalum ili kuboresha usambazaji wa huduma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay tababar u siineysaa isuduwaha heer degmo ku saabsan maareynta waxbarashada baahiyaha gaarka ah si loo hagaajiyo bixinta adeegyada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok tiego jokanyo e wi tiegruok mar tiego nyithindo ma nigi dwaro makende mondo okony e miyo ji migepe obed maber.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds the public in Trans Nzoia County to remain vigilant on counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Adeegga kaynta Kenya wuxuu dadka degmada Trans Nzoia ku xasuusinayaa inay ka feejignaadaan ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service parone ji duto e Trans Nzoia County ni mondo gisik ka girito weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: State Department for TVET urges parents and teachers in Kakamega County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta Gobolka Kakamega inay u soo sheegaan maamulka iskuulka wixii arrimo ah oo ku saabsan amniga.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e Kaunti mar Kakamega mondo onyis jotelo mag skul wach moro amora motudore gi ritruok.

English: KMTC urges youth in Kirinyaga County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kirinyaga inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KMTC jiwo rowere e County mar Kirinyaga mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gichako timo tije mag oganda.

English: NPS urges the public in Bomet County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: NPS inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Bomet wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Bomet inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo ji duto e county mar Bomet mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' weche mag wuond ma ne otimore kuom SIM-swap.

English: Kenya Red Cross launches an October awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Narok County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Oktoba juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa billowday olole October ah oo lagu wacyi gelinayo baaritaanka sonkorowga gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Oktoba e wi nonro mar thieth mar sukari e kaunti duto mar Narok.

English: Huduma Kenya warns public officers in Wajir County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Wajir dhidi ya udanganyifu wa fedha za umma.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee Gobolka Wajir in ay ka faa'iideystaan dhaqaale dawladeed.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e gweng' mar Wajir ni kik gitim mibadhi mar pesa.

English: IPOA reminds residents of Siaya County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya in si deg deg ah u soo sheegidda tuugada ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: IPOA parone jogweng'o mag Siaya County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar nek konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Wear protective gear (carts, boots, mouth and nose pads, hard hats, goggles, and gloves) to protect against the effects of pesticides.
Kiswahili: Vaa zana za kujikinga (ovaroli, buti, kiziba mdomo na pua, kofia ngumu, miwani na glavu) kwa ajili ya kukukinga dhidi ya athari za viua wadudu. Usitumie viua wadudu vya Daraja la I kulingana na WHO (vyenye alama nyekundu) kwa sababu ni hatari sana; uwe mwangalifu pia na vyenye alama ya njano.
Somali: Isku xir qalab difaaca (gaadiidka, kabaha, afka iyo sanka, koofiyadaha adag, muraayadaha, iyo gacmo gacmeedyada) si looga ilaaliyo saameynta cayayaanka.
Dholuo: Rwakri gi gik ma rito ngimani (kar, sanduk, tong' ma ok nyal tiyo gi dhogi, kata dhogi, kata yie wiye, ng'ieng'o, kata lwete) mondo kik ichandi gi tuoche ma nego ng'ato.

English: KTDA urges sorghum growers in Siaya County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawasihi wakulima wa sorghum katika Kaunti ya Siaya kupitisha aina za mbegu zinazoshinda ukame ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda sorghum ee degmada Siaya inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur mag sorghum e taon mar Siaya County mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed kelo nyak e higani.

English: AFA encourages farmers in Mandera County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for tea.
Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa ili kupata bei bora ya chai.
Somali: AFA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Mandera inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan shaaha.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e county mar Mandera mondo oti gi nengo matin mar chai mondo giyud nengo maber mar chai.

English: KEMRI calls on parents in Migori County to have children under five screened for typhoid during the July outreach.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Migori kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa matumbo wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Julai.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Migori in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka typhoid intii lagu jiray bisha July.
Dholuo: KEMRI okwayo jonyuol e county mar Migori mondo otim nonro mar tuo mar typhoid ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya - Floods, update (Kenya Met, media) (ECHO Daily Flash of 26 April 2024)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Mafuriko, sasisho (Kenya Met, vyombo vya habari) (ECHO Daily Flash ya 26 Aprili 2024)
Somali: Kenya - Daadad, cusbooneysiin (Kenya Met, warbaahinta) (ECHO Daily Flash ee 26 Abriil 2024)
Dholuo: Kenya - Pi mang'eny, duoko manyien (Kenya Oromo, yor mbui) (Rieny ma pile ka pile tarik 26 dwe mar ang'wen higa mar 2024)

English: Kenya Dairy Board encourages farmers in Mombasa County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for fish.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za samaki.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda degmada Mombasa inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo kalluunka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur e county mar Mombasa mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro mondo omi rech obed gi nengo maber.

English: State Department for Basic Education conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in Kitui County this September.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Kitui Septemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee Gobolka Kitui bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi ratiro mag sirkal e County mar Kitui e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) promotes organic farming among farmers in Migori County as part of the July climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inakuza kilimo hai miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Julai.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kor u qaadeysaa beeraha dabiiciga ah ee beeraleyda degmada Migori iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo tij pur e kind jopur e county mar Migori kaka achiel kuom chenro mar dwe mar Julai mar kedo gi lokruok e kit yamo.

English: KEMSA encourages residents of Kilifi County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay ka qayb galaan kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' Kilifi County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Teachers Service Commission encourages residents of Kakamega County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kakamega inay ka qeybgalaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jogweng' Kakamega County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi kaka ibiro chiwgi.

English: MoH to begin third round of polio vaccination in Mandera, Wajir and Garissa
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya kuanza awamu ya tatu ya chanjo ya polio huko Mandera, Wajir na Garissa
Somali: Wasaaradda caafimaadka ayaa bilaabi doonta wareegga saddexaad ee tallaalka cudurka Polio ee Mandera, Wajir iyo Garissa
Dholuo: MoH biro chako ng'ado mar adek mar thieth mar polio e Mandera, Wajir kod Garissa

English: Kenya Medical Association appeals to caregivers in Baringo County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the May maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Baringo kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya harakati za afya ya uzazi Mei.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ka codsadaa daryeelayaasha degmada Baringo inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka iyagoo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee bisha Maajo.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association okwayo jorit e County mar Baringo mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongruok kaka achiel kuom chenro mar Mayo Maternal Health Campaign.

English: Notice: IEBC opens a new motor vehicle mechanics programme at the vocational centre in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inafungua programu mpya ya ufundi wa magari katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan mashiinnada gawaarida gawaari ee xarunta xirfadaha ee gobolka Nandi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IEBC chako chenro manyien mar tiyo gi masinde mag riembo mtokni e kar tiegruok e county mar Nandi.

English: KICD reminds schools in Meru County to strengthen anti-bullying measures this November.
Kiswahili: KICD inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Meru kuimarisha hatua za kupambana na uonevu Novemba hii.
Somali: KICD waxay xusuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Meru inay xoojiyaan tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibaatada bisha November.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne skunde e County mar Meru mondo omed jiwo chenro mag kedo gi timbe mahundu e dwe mar Novemba.

English: AFA urges cattle farmers in Kisumu County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: AFA inawataka wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyoteuliwa kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa Newcastle vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da ee degmada Kisumu inay xoolahooda tallaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo ka dib kiisaska cudurka Newcastle ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur mag jamni e County ma Kisumu mondo ogeng' jamni maggi e kuonde moyier mag chamo jamni bang' yudo wach mar tuo mar Newcastle.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development encourages residents of Nandi County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: Machadka Horumarinta Manhajka Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nandi inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabaan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ojiwo jogweng' Nandi County mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto gikwongo tiyogo ka gidwaro ng'eyo weche duto.

English: ODPP invites residents of Machakos County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: ODPP gwelo ji duto modak e county mar Machakos mondo ochiw paro mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso chenro mag dongruok.

English: KNEC urges residents of Mombasa County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawataka wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kutuma maombi ya bursari kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kufaidika na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Mombasa mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Makueni County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Makueni: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Juni 2024
Somali: Degmada Makueni: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Makueni: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2024

English: TVET reminds parents in Busia County that bursary allocation registration is open this February.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba usajili wa ugawaji wa bursari umefunguliwa Februari hii.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Busia in diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ay furan tahay bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa jonyuol manie County mar Busia ni ndiko kwayo mag chiwo chiwo mag bursary osechakore e dwe mar Februar.

English: Kitui County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kitui: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Kitui: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kitui: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Septemba 2022

English: State Department for Basic Education advises students in Narok County to register early to secure allocation to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Narok kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali.
Somali: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Dowladda waxay ardayda degmada Narok kula talineysaa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan waqti hore si ay u helaan lacag ay ku helaan kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska digitalka.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo jopuonjre e Narok County mondo odonj e tiegruok chon mondo giyud pesa mar tiyo gi kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar digital literacy.

English: Universities Fund calls on the community in Wajir County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu bulshada degmada Wajir ugu baaqayaa inay u soo wargeliyaan maamulka dugsiga wixii dhibaato ah ee ku saabsan amniga si ay dugsiyada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund okwayo ji duto e gweng' mar Wajir mondo onyis sirkal mar skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skunde.

English: Notice: COMESA will train farmers in Kwale County on terracing this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale juu ya mashindano ya terracing Juni hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: COMESA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kwale ee ku saabsan dhulka dhulka ee Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA biro tiego jopur e gweng' mar Kwale e dwe mar Jun.

English: Climate smart agriculture (CSA) is an approach that helps to guide actions needed to transform and reorient agricultural systems to effectively support ...
Kiswahili: Kilimo mahiri cha hali ya hewa (CSA) ni mbinu inayosaidia kuongoza hatua zinazohitajika kubadilisha na kuelekeza upya mifumo ya kilimo ili kusaidia kwa ufanisi ...
Somali: Beeraha caqliga leh ee cimilada (CSA) waa hab ka caawiya hagidda tallaabooyinka loo baahan yahay si loo beddelo loona habeeyo nidaamyada beeraha si wax ku ool ah loo taageero ...
Dholuo: Chenro mar timo gik ma nyiso ni piny ok ber (Climate Smart Agriculture - CSA) en yo ma konyo e tayo gik madwarore mondo olok kendo ochak oyang yore mag timo gik ma kelo ber e ngima mar jopiny mondo omi ...

English: Public notice: KEMRI will host a free diabetes screening outreach in Kirinyaga County this December.
Kiswahili: Notisi kwa umma: KEMRI itakuwa mwenyeji wa uhamasishaji wa uchunguzi wa kisukari bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: KEMRI waxay marti gelineysaa baaritaano bukaan-socodka oo bilaash ah oo lagu ogaanayo cudurka macaanka ee degmada Kirinyaga bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMRI biro timo kampen mar nono tuo mar sukari maonge chudo e County mar Kirinyaga e dwe mar Desemba.

English: The Coffee Act 2023 has been enacted establishing the Coffee Board of Kenya as the primary regulator for the coffee sector All stakeholders should familiarize themselves with the new structure and regulations
Kiswahili: Sheria ya Kahawa 2023 imetungwa kuanzisha Bodi ya Kahawa ya Kenya kama mdhibiti mkuu wa sekta ya kahawa Wadau wote wanapaswa kujifahamisha na muundo na kanuni mpya.
Somali: Sharciga Qaadka 2023 ayaa la ansixiyay oo lagu aasaasay Guddiga Qaadka ee Kenya oo ah nidaamka ugu weyn ee nidaamka qaadka ee waaxda qaadka Dhammaan daneeyayaasha waa inay la kulmaan qaab dhismeedka iyo xeerarka cusub
Dholuo: Chik mar Coffee Act 2023 osegoyo mondo ochak Kenya Coffee Board kaka jatelo maduong' mar loso kodhi e piny Kenya.

English: KUCCPS advises applicants in Homa Bay County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha gobolka Homa Bay inay ku dalbadaan booska TVET iyada oo loo marayo KuCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e Homa Bay County mondo oketgi e tiegruok mar TVET kokalo kuom MUCCPS.

English: HBS & RELON: Policy Brief: Strengthening Gender-Sensitive Responsiveness among RLOs in Kenya and Uganda June 2024
Kiswahili: HBS & RELON: Muhtasari wa Sera: Kuimarisha Mwitikio wa Kijinsia kati ya RLOs nchini Kenya na Uganda Juni 2024
Somali: HBS & RELON: Warbixin Kooban oo ku saabsan Siyaasadda: Xoojinta Jawaab celinta Xasaasiga ah ee Jinsiga ee ka dhexaysa RLO-yada Kenya iyo Uganda Juun 2024
Dholuo: HBS & RELON: Oboke machuok mar Chike: Keto Teko mar Duoko Duoko Motudore gi Kido mar Kido mar Kido mar Chwo e kind jo RLO e piny Kenya kod Uganda dwe mar auchiel 2024

English: Kenya - Floods (Kenya Meteorological Department, media) (ECHO Daily Flash of 27 March 2023)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Mafuriko (Idara ya Hali ya Hewa ya Kenya, vyombo vya habari) (ECHO Daily Flash ya 27 Machi 2023)
Somali: Kenya - Daadadka (Waaxda Saadaasha Hawada Kenya, warbaahinta) (Falka Maalinlaha ah ee ECHO ee 27 Maarso 2023)
Dholuo: Kenya - Pi mang'eny (Ofis mar Kenya mar weche mag yamo, weche mag lando wach) (ECHO pile ka pile tarik 27 dwe mar adek higa mar 2023)

English: Huduma Kenya encourages first-time voters in Taita-Taveta County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Taita-Taveta inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jogo ma ne okwongo yiero e kaunti mar Taita-Taveta mondo oting'e ID kata pasi mar pinygi e odiechieng'no mar yiero.

English: Mandera County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for November 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Mandera: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Novemba 2023
Somali: Degmada Mandheera: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Noofambar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Mandera: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2023

English: IEBC urges residents of Lamu County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan fasallada aqoonta dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Lamu mondo odonj e program mar somo kod somo mar joma dongo mondo giyud ber kuom tiegruok mar somo gi somo.

English: Notice: COMESA will conduct a modern irrigation techniques workshop for farmers in Nyandarua County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itafanya warsha ya kisasa ya mbinu za umwagiliaji kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah ee beeraleyda gobolka Nyandarua bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Nonro: COMESA biro timo tiegruok mar yore mag ywayo pi ne jopur e County mar Nyandarua e dwe mar Mach.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges parents and teachers in Machakos County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Machakos kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Machakos inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e county mar Machakos mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto.

English: Kitui County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kitui: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Juni 2022
Somali: Degmada Kitui: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kitui: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2022

English: The second paper focuses on leadership and policies which resonates well with climate change in small holder farmers.
Kiswahili: Karatasi ya pili inazingatia uongozi na sera ambazo zinaonyesha mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa katika wakulima wadogo.
Somali: Warqadda labaad waxay diiradda saartaa hoggaaminta iyo siyaasadaha taasoo si wanaagsan ula jaanqaadaysa isbeddelka cimilada ee beeraleyda yaryar.
Dholuo: Gased mar ariyo wuoyo kuom telo kod chike ma chalre gi lokruok mar lokruok mar alwora e kind jopur matindo.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges eligible citizens in Nairobi County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawasihi wananchi wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Guddiga Garsoorka Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ugu baaqayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Nairobi inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro mar yiero e county mar Nairobi mondo oriwre gi jogo madwaro yiero.

English: Launch of Jifunze Lishe SMS service sending weekly nutrition and wellness tips to 2M subscribers.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa huduma ya Jifunze Lishe ya kutuma vidokezo vya lishe na ustawi wa kila wiki kwa wanachama milioni 2.
Somali: Daahfurka adeegga fariimaha qoraalka ah ee Jifunze Lishe oo talooyin nafaqo iyo fayoobi ah u diraya macaamiisha 2M ee toddobaadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Chako tich mar SMS mar Jifunze Lishe maoro riekni mag chiemo kod ngima maber juma ka juma ne jogo ma ondiko nyinge 2M.

English: Ministry of Health urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Meru County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Meru kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Meru inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e County mar Meru mondo odhi ir japuonj molony.

English: EACC warns public officers in Meru County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: EACC inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Meru dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: EACC waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Meru khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: EACC chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e County mar Meru kuom timbe mag wuondruok.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Kakamega County that access to eye and dental camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za macho na meno sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha Gobolka Kakamega in helitaanka xeryaha indhaha iyo ilkaha ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji duto e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni koro ginyalo dhi e kambi mag thieth mag wang' kod lakteche mag laktech.

English: On Tuesday, November 30, President Uhuru Kenyatta held a State of the Nation Address in Parliament. Read full speech by the Head of State below: Good Afternoon, It is my distinct honour and high privi...
Kiswahili: Siku ya Jumanne, Novemba 30, Rais Uhuru Kenyatta alitoa hotuba ya hali ya taifa katika Bunge.
Somali: Talaadada, November 30, Madaxweynaha Uhuru Kenyatta wuxuu ka jeediyay Khudbad ku saabsan Xaaladda Qaranka ee Baarlamaanka.
Dholuo: Chieng' Tich Ariyo tarik 30, Novemba, President Uhuru Kenyatta ne ogolo twak mar State of the Nation e Od Bura. Som weche duto ma jatelo mar piny owacho nowacho piny kae: Good afternoon, It's my distinct honor and high privilege...

English: NPS reminds residents of Murang'a County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah xilliyada dhulgariirada.
Dholuo: NPS parone ji duto modak e County mar Murang'a mondo oluw chike ma jotelo mag gweng'no ogolo e kinde mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: Murang a County is offering commercial mango farming support including contracts with juice manufacturers and cooperative formation Farmers are encouraged to participate for improved income
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Murang a inatoa msaada wa kilimo cha maembe kibiashara ikijumuisha kandarasi na watengenezaji wa juisi na uundaji wa vyama vya ushirika Wakulima wanahimizwa kushiriki ili kuboresha mapato.
Somali: Degmada Murang waxay bixisaa taageero ganacsi oo ku saabsan beerista mango-ga, oo ay ku jiraan heshiisyo lala galay soo saarayaasha casiirka iyo aasaaska iskaashatada. Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay ka qayb qaataan si dakhliga loo kordhiyo
Dholuo: Murang a County chiwo kony mar pur mango moriwo pinje singruoge gi jotelo mag juice kod loso riwruok mar jokony-tich

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageerada soo kabashada xadgudubka maandooriyaha ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Murang'a.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tiyo gi yedhe mamero yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Murang'a.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of Nakuru County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay ugu yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' Nakuru County mondo kik gisandre gi muol kendo mondo giluong kony mar thieth mar chuny maonge chudo.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit announces NHIF/SHA claims support for residents of Nairobi County starting this February.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinatangaza NHIF/SHA inadai msaada kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuanzia Februari hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa ku dhawaaqday in NHIF/SHA ay sheegatay taageero loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Nairobi laga bilaabo Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit olando ni NHIF/SHA dwaro kony ne jogweng' Nairobi County kochakore dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: e-Citizen will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: e-Citizen waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee degmada Kilifi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: e-Citizen biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e gweng' mar Kilifi.

English: Lamu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for January 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Lamu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Januari 2023
Somali: Degmada Lamu: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Janaayo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Lamu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar achiel higa mar 2023

English: Suggestions for seeds will be based on seeds that you know are marketable, produce well, and withstand drought.
Kiswahili: Mapendekezo ya mbegu yatategemea mbegu unazozifahamu kuwa na soko, uzaaji mzuri, na zinazostahimili ukame.
Somali: Talooyinka abuurka waxay ku salaysan doonaan abuur aad ogtahay in ay suuq geyn karo, si fiican u soo saara, oo u adkeysta abaaraha.
Dholuo: Weche mibiro tiyogo e chwoyo kodhi biro luwore gi kodhi ma ing'eyo ni inyalo uso, ma nyago olemo maber, kendo ma nyalo nano e kinde oro.

English: HELB encourages out-of-school children in Kirinyaga County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under free primary education.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: HELB waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Kirinyaga inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e gweng' mar Kirinyaga mondo odonj e program mar puonjo joma dongo somo ma onge chudo.

English: NCPB advises farmers in Lamu County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the March planting season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Machi.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Lamu inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka jiilaalka hore iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e County mar Lamu mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok chon kapok ochopo ndalo chwoyo e dwe mar Mach.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages mothers in Lamu County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Lamu kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa hooyooyinka degmada Lamu inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo mine manie County mar Lamu mondo olimgi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Ministry of Health calls on parents in Samburu County to have children under five screened for cyclosporiasis during the June outreach.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa cyclosporiasis wakati wa mawasiliano ya Juni.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta Gobolka Samburu in carruurta ka yar shan sano la baaro cudurka cyclosporiasis intii lagu jiray bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health okwayo jonyuol e county mar Samburu mondo otim nonro mar cyclosporiasis ne nyithindo ma hikgi tin ne abich e dwe mar Jun.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public that free stress management support is available through county health facilities in Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kudhibiti mafadhaiko unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero lacag la'aan ah oo lagu maareeyo walbahaarka laga helo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Murang'a.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar stress yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Murang'a.

English: KUCCPS conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Nyeri County this March.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Machi hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada ee degmada Nyeri bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: KUCCPS dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e dwe mar Mach e kaunti mar Nyeri.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds residents of Tharaka-Nithi County that agroforestry improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwamba kilimo cha misitu kinaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Somali: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi in kaynta beeraha ay hagaajineyso waxsoosaarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Bura mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County ni yien mag yien kelo nyak e puothe kuom kinde malach.

English:
Fuel your body, feed your mind!
What you eat, how you move, and what you avoid directly shapes your mental health.

Choose clean eating, stay active, and say NO to harmful substances.

Your future self will thank you!
Kiswahili: Chukulia mwili wako, kulisha akili yako! Unakula nini, unafanya nini, na unaepuka nini huathiri moja kwa moja afya yako ya akili. Chagua kula safi, uwe na shughuli nyingi, na usiseme hapana kwa vitu vyenye madhara.
Somali: Jirkaaga quudi, maskaxdaada quudi! waxa aad cuntid, sida aad u dhaqmayso, iyo waxa aad ka fogaato waxay si toos ah u qaabeeyaan caafimaadkaaga maskaxda. Cuntada nadiifka ah doorato, firfircoon noqo, oo waxyaabaha waxyeelada leh NO sheeg. naftaada mustaqbalka ayaa kugu mahadcelin doonta!
Dholuo: Bed gi paro mowinjore kuom gik ma ichamo, kaka iwuotho, kod gik ma itimo maok itimo. Yier chamo chiemo maler, bed modich, kendo wach ni ooyo gi gik makelo hinyruok.

English: TVET reminds youth in Nyeri County that HELB funding is available for ICT skills training.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nyeri in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka xirfadaha ICT.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa rowere man Nyeri County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar lony e yore mag ICT.

English: We are reminding you to strictly adhere to the containment measures as our first line of defence against this virus; wash hands regularly with soap & running water, wearing of face masks in public places, maintaining social & physical distance, & avoiding all forms of gatherings.
Kiswahili: Tunakukumbusha kuzingatia kwa dhati hatua za kuzuia kama safu yetu ya kwanza ya ulinzi dhidi ya virusi hivi; osha mikono mara kwa mara kwa sabuni na maji yanayotiririka, kuvaa barakoa katika maeneo ya umma, kudumisha umbali wa kijamii na kimwili, na kuepuka mikusanyiko ya aina zote.
Somali: Waxaan idin xasuusineynaa inaad si adag u raacdaan tallaabooyinka xakamaynta oo ah difaaca ugu horreeya ee ka dhanka ah fayraskan; si joogto ah gacmaha ugu dhaq saabuun iyo biyo socda, xirashada maaskaro wejiga goobaha dadweynaha, ilaalinta kala fogaanshaha bulshada iyo jirka, iyo inaad ka fogaato dhammaan noocyada isu imaatinka.
Dholuo: Waparoni mondo uluw matek okenge mag geng'o tuwo kaka yorwa mokwongo mar geng'ruok kuom midhusi ni; lwoko lwedo kinde ka kinde gi sabun & pi ma ng’ich, rwako mask mag wang’ kuonde ma ji mang’eny romoe, rito thuolo mar ng’ato gi ng’ato kod ng’ato, & weyo romo duto.

English: Install CCTV in schools 2020.
Kiswahili: Sakinisha CCTV shuleni 2020.
Somali: Ku rakib CCTV dugsiyada 2020.
Dholuo: Ket chenro mar keto CCTV e skunde e higa mar 2020.

English: Embu (Mbeere) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Embu (Mbeere): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2024
Somali: Degmada Embu (Mbeere): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2024

English: SHA updates residents of Kakamega County on progress of county development projects this May.
Kiswahili: SHA inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega juu ya maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo katika kaunti hii Mei.
Somali: SHA waxay dadka deggan degmada Kakamega ka wargelineysaa horumarka mashaariicda horumarinta degmada bisha May.
Dholuo: SHA osemiyo jogweng' Kakamega ong'eyo dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok e gweng'no e dwe mar Mei.

English: KTDA advises farmers in Meru County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the April planting season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Aprili.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Meru inay adeegsadaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: KTDA nyiso jopur e county mar Meru ni giti gi nengo mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar April.

English: Public notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will host a free food safety outreach in Marsabit County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usalama wa chakula bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay marti-gelin doontaa dadaal bilaash ah oo ku saabsan badbaadada cuntada ee degmada Marsabit bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo chenro mar chiwo kony maonge chudo mar chiemo e taon mar Marsabit e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: FAO promotes organic farming among farmers in Siaya County as part of the September climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: FAO inakuza kilimo hai kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Siaya kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Septemba.
Somali: FAO waxay dhiirrigelisay beeraha dabiiciga ah ee beeraleyda degmada Siaya iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e county mar Siaya kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi e dwe mar Septemba.

English: KNEC reminds youth in Tharaka-Nithi County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari.
Somali: KNEC waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Tharaka-Nithi in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka farsamada gawaarida gawaariyada.
Dholuo: KNEC oparo ne rowere man Tharaka-Nithi County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar mechanics mag mtokni.

English: Laikipia County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Laikipia: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2024
Somali: Degmada Laikipia: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Laikipia: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar adek higa mar 2024

English: Notice: NPS activates an emergency response plan for landslides in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NPS inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ka dhan ah dhulgariirada degmada Makueni.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NPS tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony mapiyo ne yiengni mag lowo e gweng' mar Makueni.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free stress management support is available through county health facilities in Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kudhibiti mafadhaiko unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero lacag la'aan ah oo la xiriirta maaraynta stress-ka laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Murang'a.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar stress yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Murang'a.

English: State Department for Basic Education conducts a civic education forum on voter registration in Kiambu County this October.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Oktoba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay qabanqaabinaysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha degmada Kiambu bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiegruok mar ji duto e dwe mar Oktoba e county mar Kiambu.

Kiswahili: Mpango wa nchi wa mtandao wa IFRC wa Kenya 2023 (MAAKE002)

English: Over the past three years, there has been an incremental reduction in services, food rations and cash support affecting the refugee population in Dadaab.
Kiswahili: Katika kipindi cha miaka mitatu iliyopita, kumekuwa na punguzo la ongezeko la huduma, mgao wa chakula na usaidizi wa fedha unaoathiri idadi ya wakimbizi huko Dadaab.
Somali: Saddexdii sano ee la soo dhaafay, waxaa si isa soo taraysa hoos ugu dhacay adeegyada, raashinka iyo taageerada lacagta caddaanka ah ee saameysay dadka qaxootiga ah ee ku nool Dhadhaab.
Dholuo: E higini adek mosekalo, osebedo gi dwoko piny ma medore e tich, chiemo ma imiyo ji kod pesa ma imiyogi ma ketho kwan mar jolweny ma Dadaab.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges residents of Bungoma County to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night following a rise in reported Rift Valley Fever cases.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na dawa za kuua wadudu kila usiku kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay isticmaalaan shabaqa cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska laga soo sheegay Cudurka Rift Valley.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo oti gi otamba molos gi yedhe makelo tuoche mag lum otieno ka otieno nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuwo mar Rift Valley Fever osemedore.

English: NCPB reminds farmers in Bomet County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Somali: NCPB waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Bomet barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee ka dambeeya goosashada.
Dholuo: NCPB parone jopur e county mar Bomet chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime bang' keyo.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties warns public officers in Taita-Taveta County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa ka digaya saraakiisha dawladda ee gobolka Taita-Taveta inay musuqmaasuqa ka qaataan xafiisyada dawladda.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal ma Taita-Taveta County ni kik giyud asoya e migepe ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: The Ministry of Health has assured the public that the Mpox situation in the country is not comparable to the COVID-19 pandemic.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya imewahakikishia umma kwamba hali ya Mpox nchini hailinganishwi na janga la COVID-19.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa shacabka u xaqiijisay in xaaladda Mpox ee dalka aysan la barbar dhigin cudurka faafa ee COVID-19.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth osesingore ne ji ni chal mar Mpox e piny ok nyal pim gi tuo mar COVID-19.

English: Kenya: Registered refugees and asylum-seekers (as of 31 December 2022)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Wakimbizi waliosajiliwa na wanaotafuta hifadhi (tangu 31 Desemba 2022)
Somali: Kenya: Qaxootiga diiwaangashan iyo kuwa magangalyo doonka ah (laga bilaabo 31 Diseembar 2022)
Dholuo: Kenya: Jolweny ma ondiki nyinggi kod jogo madwaro dak (chakre tarik 31 dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2022)

English: Notice: Council of Governors launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Narok County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Narok mwezi huu wa Septemba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee Gobolka Narok bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Jaloch chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Narok e dwe mar Septemba.

English: HELB reminds parents in Baringo County that adult literacy classes registration is open this January.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba usajili wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima umefunguliwa Januari hii.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Baringo in diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ay furan tahay bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa jonyuol e gweng' mar Baringo ni somo mar somo gi ndiko ne joma dongo chako e dwe mar Januar.

English: KEPHIS warns sorghum farmers in Mombasa County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawaonya wakulima wa sorghum katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhusu maambukizi ya wadudu na kupendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda sorghum ee gobolka Mombasa cudurrada cayayaanka ah waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyin waqtigeeda ah.
Dholuo: KEPHIS chiwo siem ne jopur mag sorghum e kaunti mar Mombasa kuom masiche ma nyalo kelo tuoche kendo ojiwo ni otim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: DCI urges motorists and pedestrians in Kitui County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DCI inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa wadayaasha gawaarida iyo dadka lugta leh ee degmada Kitui inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay adeegsadaan meelaha lugta loo qoondeeyey si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira qaraxyada dabka.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo joidh mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Kitui mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe mondo gikwed hinyruok mar yiengni.

English: KTDA advises farmers in Machakos County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Machakos inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kalfadhiga tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: KTDA nyiso jopur e county mar Machakos mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e tiego jopur mabiro.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds the public in Nakuru County that input on the county budget process is welcome this June.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba mchango kwenye mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti unakaribishwa Juni hii.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nakuru in talooyinka ku saabsan habka miisaaniyadda degmada ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya oparo ne ji duto e gweng' mar Nakuru ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mar bajet mar gweng'no e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: COMESA will distribute certified wheat seed to farmers in Homa Bay County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itasambaza mbegu za ngano zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Juni hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: COMESA waxay abuuraha gobolka Homa Bay u qaybin doontaa abuurka sarreenka ee shahaadada leh bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: COMESA biro pogo kodhi mag ngano ne jopur manie Homa Bay County e dwe mar Jun.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages residents of Tana River County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay la xiriiraan lataliye la tababaran yahay.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giwuo gi jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Kenya confirms three new Mpox cases from Nairobi, Nakuru and Mombasa counties, this brings the total to 17, Health CS Barasa says.
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha visa vitatu vipya vya Mpox kutoka kaunti za Nairobi, Nakuru na Mombasa, hii inafikisha jumla ya visa 17, Waziri wa Afya Barasa anasema.
Somali: Kenya ayaa xaqiijisay saddex kiis oo cusub oo Mpox ah oo ka yimid degmooyinka Nairobi, Nakuru iyo Mombasa, taasoo wadarta guud u kordhineysa 17, sida ay sheegtay Health CS Barasa.
Dholuo: Kenya osenyiso ni ji adek manyien ma nigi tuwo mar Mpox owuok Nairobi, Nakuru kod Mombasa, omiyo kwan mar ji duto osedok 17, Health CS Barasa wacho.

English: Garissa County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Garissa: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2023
Somali: Degmada Garissa: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Garissa: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2023

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the public in Murang'a County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadweynaha degmada Murang'a inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto e county mar Murang'a mondo onon kwayo mag ji kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma ne oland kuom wach manyo weche mag miriambo.

English: Kenya Red Cross alerts residents of Turkana County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana juu ya kuongezeka kwa visa vya wizi na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay uga digtay dadka deggan degmada Turkana in ay kordheen kiisaska tuugada waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross chiwo siem ne jogweng' Turkana County kuom wach kwan mar joma oketho gik moko kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne polis man machiegni.

English: KALRO advises farmers in Baringo County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuleta nambari yao ya usajili wa mkulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Baringo inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qaybqaataan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e County mar Baringo mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds schools in Nairobi County to strengthen child protection in schools this July.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuimarisha ulinzi wa watoto shuleni Julai hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada Waxbarashada ayaa xusuusinaya dugsiyada degmada Nairobi inay xoojiyaan ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne skunde man Nairobi County mondo omed jiwo rit mar nyithindo e skunde e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on the community in Garissa County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Garissa kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqayaa bulshada Gobolka Garissa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wacayaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service kwayo ji duto manie County mar Garissa mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General opens voter registration centres in Kwale County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inafungua vituo vya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kwale Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu furayaa xarumaha diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee Gobolka Kwale bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Jorit-Jaloch Maduong' ochako chenro mar chano joma biro donjo e sirkal mar Kwale e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health will host a free food safety outreach in Kisumu County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usalama wa chakula bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay marti gelineysaa adeeg bilaash ah oo ku saabsan badbaadada cuntada ee degmada Kisumu bisha May.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar piny owacho biro timo chenro mar chiwo chiemb chuny maonge chudo e kaunti mar Kisumu e dwe mar abich.

English: Notice: KTDA will distribute certified sweet potatoes seed to farmers in Samburu County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itasambaza mbegu za viazi vitamu zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay abuurka baradho macaan oo shahaado leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda Gobolka Samburu bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KTDA biro pogo kodhi mag le mamit ne jopur man Samburu County e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: DCI opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DCI inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa maelekezo salama ya makazi katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay fureysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya talooyin ku saabsan hoyga ammaanka ah ee gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni DCI osechako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony e wi kuonde dak e alwora mar Lamu County.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMSA will be held in Kilifi County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMSA itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay KEMSA ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Kilifi bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma KEMSA ochano biro bedo maonge chudo e gweng' mar Kilifi e dwe mar April.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Baringo County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Baringo in helitaanka adeegyada bukaanka dibedda hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMSA oparo ne ji duto e County mar Baringo ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mag thieth e kuonde moyier.

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on the community in Wajir County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Wajir kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwa ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqayaa bulshada degmada Wajir inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan oo ay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service kwayo ji duto manie County mar Wajir mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo ginyis joma chwo gi mon e stesen mar polise wachno.

English: Notice: DCI opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa simu ya GBV ya bure katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ee gobolka Bomet.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DCI chako tiyo gi ofis mar weche nindruok e taon mar Bomet.

English: NCPB urges maize growers in Kericho County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Kericho kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Kericho inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si kor loogu qaado wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur ma pidho cham e gweng' mar Kericho mondo okaw kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed kelo nyak e higani.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds residents of Kericho County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho in helitaanka adeegyada baasaboorka ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone jogweng' mar Kericho County ni koro yot yudo passport kokalo kuom chenro mag sirkal.

English: Farmers in Uganda can now access a locally developed anti tick vaccine to combat tick borne livestock diseases Visit the National Livestock Resources Research Institute for more information
Kiswahili: Wakulima nchini Uganda sasa wanaweza kupata chanjo ya kupe iliyotengenezwa nchini ili kukabiliana na magonjwa ya mifugo yanayoenezwa na kupe Tembelea Taasisi ya Kitaifa ya Utafiti wa Rasilimali za Mifugo kwa taarifa zaidi.
Somali: Beeraleyda Uganda hadda waxay heli karaan tallaal maxalli ah oo ka hortaga cayayaanka si loola dagaallamo cudurrada xayawaanka ay ka keenaan. Booqo Machadka Cilmi-baarista Kheyraadka Xoolaha Qaranka si aad u hesho macluumaad dheeraad ah
Dholuo: Koro jopur e piny Uganda nyalo yudo thieth mar kedo gi tuoche mag jamni makelo kuom jamni. Dhiuru e National Livestock Resources Research Institute mondo ung'e weche momedore.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on residents of Kwale County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utoa wito kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika kumbi za umma ili kuunga mkono ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross okwayo jogweng' Kwale County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji nitie mondo okony e loso kuwe e piny.

English: OGP reminds residents of Kakamega County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: OGP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kakamega in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo bogga degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.

Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Hali ya Kenya Januari 2024: Al-Shabaab, Wanamgambo wa Wafugaji, na M23

English: Council of Governors reminds residents of Kericho County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba upatikanaji wa usajili wa e-Citizen sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Kericho in helitaanka diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch oparo ne jogweng' Kericho County ni yudo e-Citizen registration koro yot ahinya kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal.

English: FAO urges goats farmers in Mombasa County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported rabies cases.
Kiswahili: FAO inawataka wafugaji wa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya kichaa cha mbwa vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda orgiga ee degmada Mombasa inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyaga oo aan haysan rukhsad ka dib kiisaska xanaaqa la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma pidho diek e County mar Mombasa mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni ka giwuok e county maok giyudo rusa bang' yudo weche mag rabies.

English: Kenyan farmers are encouraged to engage in partnerships that strengthen the agricultural sector For details contact your local agricultural office
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Kenya wanahimizwa kushiriki katika ushirikiano unaoimarisha sekta ya kilimo Kwa maelezo wasiliana na ofisi ya kilimo iliyo karibu nawe
Somali: Beeraleyda Kenya waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay ku biiraan iskaashiyo xoojinaya waaxda beeraha wixii faahfaahin ah la xiriir xafiiska beeraha ee deegaankaaga

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds residents of Kwale County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.

Kiswahili: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya juu ya kuongezeka kwa wizi wa kitambulisho na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.

Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada ku nool degmada Baringo in maalgelinta HELD ay diyaar u tahay tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds residents of Kakamega County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.

Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Mombasa.

Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa ajili ya mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu.

English: TSC encourages out-of-school children in Nyandarua County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.

English: Pest Control Products Board promotes soil conservation among farmers in Marsabit County as part of the April climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inakuza uhifadhi wa udongo kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Aprili.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds residents of Baringo County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.

Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Auditor-General inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya in ay ku hawlan yihiin maamulaha qaybta deegaanka si loo xoojiyo maamulka deegaanka.

English: Notice: IEBC launches a school infrastructure safety programme in schools across Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC yazindua mpango wa usalama wa miundombinu ya shule katika shule kote Kaunti ya Mandera.

English: Kenya Dairy Board encourages farmers in Kitui County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for milk.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora ya maziwa.

English: The initiative aims to ensure that one billion Africans are better protected from health emergencies by the end of 2025.
