Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba usajili wa mpango wa kulisha shule umefunguliwa Mei hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xusuusinaya waalidiinta degmada Bomet in diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga ay furan tahay bisha May.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne jonyuol e county mar Bomet ni chenro mar kwayo nyithindo chiemo e skul ochakore e dwe mar Mei.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges cassava growers in Bungoma County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda cassava ee degmada Bungoma inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si loo wanaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur ma pidho manias e County mar Bungoma mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed nyak e higani.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges residents of Laikipia County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti hiyo kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo jogweng' Laikipia County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county mar tiego ji e weche siasa.

English: OGP reminds the public in Uasin Gishu County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this April.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba maoni juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma yanakaribishwa Aprili hii.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Uasin Gishu in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: OGP oparo ne ji duto e County mar Uasin Gishu ni paro ma ji chiwo e wi chenro mag chenro mag oganda en gima owinjore e dwe mar April.

English: EACC updates residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County on progress of the county integrated development plan this March.
Kiswahili: EACC inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti hii Machi.
Somali: EACC waxay dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet ku wargelineysaa horumarka qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: EACC chiwo ripot ne jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet kuom dongruok mar chenro mar dongruok mar county e dwe mar Mach.

English: CDC reminds the public in Nairobi County that access to subsidised dialysis is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba upatikanaji wa dialysis ya ruzuku sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nairobi in helitaanka dialysis-ka la taageeray hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji duto e County mar Nairobi ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mar dialysis e kuonde moyier.

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief July 2025
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP wa Kenya Julai 2025
Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya Luulyo 2025
Dholuo: Wach machuok mar piny Kenya dwe mar abiriyo 2025

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Medical Association will be held in Samburu County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu bila malipo iliyoandaliwa na Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Samburu Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Gobolka Samburu bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma Kenya Medical Association ochano ibiro tim e taon mar Samburu e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: AFA restricts movement of poultry in Embu County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA inazuia harakati za kuku katika Kaunti ya Embu kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi wenye uvimbe.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa digaagga ee degmada Embu sababtuna tahay faafitaanka cudurka maqaarka.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: AFA ogeng'o wuoth mar le mag le e County mar Embu nikech tuwono mar pien.

English: AFA urges farmers in Nakuru County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: AFA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nakuru inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: AFA ojiwo jopur e Kaunti mar Nakuru mondo opidh cham mag choko lowo mondo omi piny okethre mondo omi giritre kuom lokruok mar koth.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Nairobi County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi mwezi huu Julai.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee ka socda degmada Nairobi bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: Kenya Gazette chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Nairobi e dwe mar Julai.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations alerts residents of Nairobi County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhusu kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara wa magari na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi uga digaya kororka kiisaska gaadiidka la xaday wuxuuna ku talinayaa shacabka inay ku biiraan mashaariicda booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar Nairobi County kuom wach medruok mar wach kwalo mtokni kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Schools will remain open even if Covic 19 transmission remains high
Kiswahili: Shule zitaendelea kufunguliwa hata ikiwa maambukizi ya Covid-19 yataendelea kuwa ya juu
Somali: Dugsiyada ayaa furmi doona xitaa haddii gudbinta COVID-19 ay sii ahaato mid sareysa
Dholuo: Skunde biro dhi nyime tiyo kata kapo ni tugo mar Covid-19 pod dhi nyime

English: Notice from Kenya Medical Association: nutrition supplementation for infants clinics will run every September at designated health centres in Turkana County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya: nyongeza ya lishe kwa kliniki za watoto wachanga itaendeshwa kila Septemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya: nafaqada dheeriga ah ee caafimaadka dhallaanka ayaa lagu sameyn doonaa bishii Sebtember ee xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association: thieth mar chiemo ne nyithindo matindo ibiro tim e dwe mar ochiko higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Turkana.

English: KUCCPS released a list of approved certificate courses for 2023 KCSE students with D+ and below at TVET institutions.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS ilitoa orodha ya kozi za vyeti vilivyoidhinishwa kwa wanafunzi wa 2023 wa KCSE walio na D + na chini katika taasisi za TVET.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay soo saartay liis koorsooyinka shahaadooyinka la ansixiyay ee loogu talagalay ardayda 2023 KCSE ee leh D + iyo ka hooseeya machadyada TVET.
Dholuo: KUCCPS osegoyo list mar tiegruok mag ratiro mar jopuonjre 2023 mag KCSE ma nigi D+ kata matin e skunde mag TVET.

English: Notice: e-Citizen launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kirinyaga County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Julai hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: e-Citizen waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee Gobolka Kirinyaga bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Rapar: e-Citizen chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Kirinyaga e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds youth in Nyamira County that HELB funding is available for ICT skills training.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka ayaa xasuusinaya dhalinyarada degmada Nyamira in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka xirfadaha ICT.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne rowere man Nyamira County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar lony e yore mag ICT.

English: TVET calls on the community in Siaya County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TVET inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TVET waxay bulshada degmada Siaya ugu baaqeysaa inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116, si loo ilaaliyo nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: TVET okwayo ji duto e county mar Siaya mondo omany namba mar 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

Kiswahili: Kati ya ukame mkali na mafuriko ya hapa na pale, sehemu kubwa ya Kenya inakabiliwa na majanga ya mara kwa mara au yanayoonekana kutoisha.
Somali: Inta u dhaxaysa abaaro daran iyo daadad goos goos ah, inta badan Kenya waxay wajaheysaa masiibooyin soo noqnoqda ama u muuqda kuwo aan dhammaad lahayn.

Kiswahili: Kanuni mpya zinahitaji leseni ya kuweka nyuki nchini Kenya Jiandikishe kama mfugaji nyuki wa kibiashara ili kumiliki mzinga wa nyuki au kukabiliwa na adhabu. Omba kwa CEC ya eneo lako kwa cheti cha mwaka mmoja
Somali: Xeerar cusub ayaa qasab ku ah in la helo ruqsad lagu hayo shinnida Kenya Iska diiwaangeli sidii beeraleyda shinnida ganacsi si ay u leedahay shinnida ama ciqaabo la kulmi doonta Codso CEC-gaaga deegaanka si aad u hesho shahaado hal sano ah
Dholuo: Chike manyien dwaro ni ng'ato omi ratiro mar pidho ong'oe e piny Kenya.

English: Pregnant women in their second trimester should receive deworming medication to improve nutrition and reduce complications.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito katika miezi mitatu yao ya pili ya ujauzito wanapaswa kupokea dawa za minyoo ili kuboresha lishe na kupunguza matatizo.
Somali: Haweenka uurka leh ee saddexda bilood ee labaad waa inay helaan daawooyinka ka hortagga cayayaanka si loo hagaajiyo nafaqada loona yareeyo dhibaatooyinka.
Dholuo: Mon ma nigi ich ma gin e kinde mar ariyo mar nyuol onego omi thieth mar tieko tuoche mondo omi gimed bedo gi chiemo maber kendo giduok chien chandruoge ma giromogo.

English: COMESA encourages farmers in Marsabit County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for avocado.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora za parachichi.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Marsabit inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan avocado.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Marsabit mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mondo giyud nengo maber mar avocado.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Samburu County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti hiyo ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja wa kaunti.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Samburu inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jood county mar Samburu mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mar dongruok e county.

English: KTDA promotes conservation tillage among farmers in Kilifi County as part of the October climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: KTDA inakuza kilimo cha uhifadhi kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Oktoba.
Somali: KTDA waxay dhiirrigelisay beerashada ilaalinta beeraleyda degmada Kilifi iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka adkeysiga cimilada ee Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo puodho mar ritruok e kind jopur e County mar Kilifi kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo kinda mar timo lokruok e kit yamo e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: KEMSA encourages mothers in Tharaka-Nithi County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo mine manie Tharaka-Nithi County mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: IEBC updates residents of Nyamira County on progress of county development projects this July.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira juu ya maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo katika kaunti hii mwezi Julai.
Somali: IEBC waxay dadka deggan degmada Nyamira ka wargelineysaa horumarka mashaariicda horumarinta degmada bisha July.
Dholuo: IEBC chiwo ripot ne jogweng' Nyamira County e wi dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok e gweng'no e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: NDMA activates an emergency response plan for fire outbreaks in Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa milipuko ya moto katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay dabka ka kacay degmada Marsabit.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony mapiyo ne masiche mag mach e gweng' mar Marsabit.

English: TSC calls on the community in Marsabit County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TSC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TSC waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Marsabit inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban si loo ilaaliyo nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo oganda mar Marsabit County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ngima maber e skunde.

Kiswahili: Kenya: Ukame - Muhtasari wa Nchi (13 Apr 2023)
Somali: Kenya: Abaaraha - Dulmar Guud oo ku saabsan Dalka (13 Abriil 2023)
Dholuo: Kenya: Oro - Neno matut mar piny (13 dwe mar Ang'wen higa mar 2023)

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges residents of Kisii County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa umakini mkubwa wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nabadgelyada qaranka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo jogweng' mar Kisii mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar rito weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'enyie nikech ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom loso kuwe e piny.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross will hold a depression awareness forum in Isiolo County this April. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utafanya kongamano la uhamasishaji wa unyogovu katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Aprili hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay qabaneysaa madasha wacyiga ah ee niyadjabka ee degmada Isiolo bishii Abriil. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Ripot mar Kenya Red Cross biro timo chokruok mar chiwo paro e wi tuwo mar depression e taon mar Isiolo e dwe mar April.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Uasin Gishu County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Uasin Gishu in si deg deg ah u soo sheegidda dhac ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne jogweng' Uasin Gishu County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar donjo e odno konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Kenya Red Cross announces eye and dental camps for residents of Bungoma County starting this April.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya watangaza kambi za macho na meno kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kuanzia Aprili hii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa ku dhawaaqday xeryo indhaha iyo ilkaha loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Bungoma laga bilaabo Abriil.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ogolo kambi mag thieth mag wang' kod lakteche mag laktech ne jogweng'e mag Bungoma County kochakore e dwe mar April.

Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Marsabit inay ku qoraan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee fasallada akhris-xisaabta dadka waaweyn.

English: SHA reminds residents of Marsabit County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: SHA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit in helitaanka adeegyada baasaboorka ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: SHA parone jogweng' mar Marsabit County ni koro yot yudo weche mag passport kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ee degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e kaunti mar Bungoma.

English: NPS warns residents of Kiambu County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu juu ya kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: NPS waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu kororka qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: NPS chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kiambu County e wi medruok mar chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok adier ne jatendgi.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds residents of Homa Bay County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay in ka qaybgalka maamulaha qaybta deegaanka ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone jogweng' Homa Bay County ni tudruok gi jarit mar ward margi jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Differentiate how yourmilk appears in the market by branding with permanent seal. Learn about branding and sales techniques.
Kiswahili: Tofautisha jinsi maziwa yako yanavyoonekana kwenye soko kwa kuweka alama na muhuri wa kudumu.
Somali: Isbarbar dhig sida caanahaagu suuqa ugu muuqdo adoo calaamadeynaya shaabadeynta joogtada ah.
Dholuo: Puonjri kaka yien mari nenore e chiro kitiyo gi kido ma ok ket tong'.

English: HELB urges residents of Kisumu County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: HELB inawataka wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kutuma maombi ya bursari kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kufaidika na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: HELB waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jogweng' mar Kisumu County mondo okonygi yudo konyno kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud konyruok kuom tiegruok mar somo gi ndiko ne joma dongo.

English: NPS alerts residents of Samburu County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka kwa kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: NPS waxay dadka deggan gobolka Samburu uga digtay kororka kiisaska tuugada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: NPS chiwo siem ne ji modak e county mar Samburu ni kwan mag ohala omedore kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne polis man machiegni.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds the public in Samburu County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuendelea kuwa macho katika ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Samburu inay ka feejignaadaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne ji duto e county mar Samburu ni mondo gibed motang' ne loso kuwe e piny.

English: Ministry of Education announces distribution of revision guides to schools in Nandi County this September.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inatangaza usambazaji wa miongozo ya marekebisho kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nandi Septemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhawaaqday qaybinta hagaha dib u eegista dugsiyada degmada Nandi bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok mar piny owacho olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag somo e skunde man Nandi County e dwe mar ochiko mar higani.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges anyone experiencing abuse in Marsabit County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kutafuta msaada katika nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Marsabit inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e Marsabit County mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: HELB urges youth in Kajiado County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: HELB waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kajiado inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo rowere man Kajiado County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok gichako timo tije mag oganda.

English: Tharaka Nithi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Mei 2022
Somali: Degmada Tharaka Nithi: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Tharaka Nithi: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar abich higa mar 2022

English: The Kenya Cash Consortium Alert-Based Cash Assistance to Disaster-Affected Communities in Garissa and Turkana Counties: Endline (May 2025)
Kiswahili: Msaada wa Tahadhari ya Kenya Cash Consortium kwa Jamii Zilizoathiriwa na Maafa katika Kaunti za Garissa na Turkana: Endline (Mei 2025)
Somali: Gargaarka Lacagta Caddaan ah ee ku salaysan Digniinta ee Ururka Lacagta Caddaan ah ee Kenya ee loogu talagalay Bulshooyinka ay Masiibadu Saameysay ee Degmooyinka Garissa iyo Turkana: Endline (Maajo 2025)
Dholuo: Kony mar pesa ma luwore gi luoro mar riwruok mar pesa mag piny Kenya ne jodak ma oyudo masira e gwenge mag Garissa kod Turkana: Giko (Mei 2025)

English: Ministry announcing awareness sessions to address stunting reduction  and new fortification and regulatory measures.
Kiswahili: Wizara ikitangaza vikao vya ufahamu ili kukabiliana na kupunguza upungufu na ujenzi mpya na hatua za udhibiti.
Somali: Wasaaradda oo ku dhawaaqday fadhiyada wacyiga si loo xaliyo hoos u dhaca daahfurka iyo tallaabooyinka cusub ee qalcadaha iyo xeerarka.
Dholuo: Migawo mar migawono ogolo twege mondo okony e tieko ywaruok kod gero ohinga kod chenro manyien mag chike.

English: Notice: SHA opens a new service point for passport services in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: SHA inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Wilaya ya Kitui.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Shirkadda SHA waxay furaysaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee Gobolka Kitui.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA oyawo kama itimee tije mag kawo kad e gweng' mar Kitui.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development restricts movement of sheep in Nandi County due to a foot and mouth disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inazuia harakati za kondoo katika Kaunti ya Nandi kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa idaha ee degmada Nandi sababtuna tahay faafitaanka cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: Rapar: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ogeng'o wuoth mar rombe e county mar Nandi nikech tuwo mar dhoho.

English: We urge Kenyans to double-check the legitimacy of any NGO requesting donations via mobile payment. Many have been flagged for fraud.
Kiswahili: Tunawahimiza Wakenya kuangalia upya uhalali wa shirika lolote lisilo la kiserikali linaloomba michango kupitia malipo ya simu. Mengi yametajwa kwa ulaghai.
Somali: Waxaan ku boorinaynaa dadka reer Kenya inay laba jeer hubiyaan sharci ahaanshaha hay'ad kasta oo NGO ah oo codsanaysa deeqo iyada oo loo marayo lacag bixinta moobaylka. Qaar badan ayaa lagu calaamadeeyay khiyaano.
Dholuo: Wakwayo jo Kenya mondo otim nonro nyadiriyo kuom chik moro amora mar NGO ma kwayo chiwo kokalo kuom chudo mar simu. Ji mang’eny oseketnegi bura nikech ne giwuondore.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response launches a January awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Januari juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Kericho kote Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Janaayo oo ku saabsan baaritaanka sonkorowga ee degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuoche chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Januar e wi nonro mar thieth mar sukari e County duto mar Kericho.

English: KUCCPS advises students in Siaya County to collect materials from the county education office to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Siaya kukusanya nyenzo kutoka kwa ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ardayda degmada Siaya kula talineysaa inay ka soo ururiyaan xogta xafiiska waxbarashada ee degmada si ay u helaan deeq waxbarasho ardayda u baahan.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo jopuonjre e county mar Siaya mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar tiegruok mar county mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo osuru ne jopuonjre mochando.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free depression awareness support is available through county health facilities in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa uhamasishaji wa unyogovu unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay wacyiga niyadjabku laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Kajiado County.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar parruok yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e Kajiado County.

English: Notice: Universities Fund announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku dhawaaqay taariikhda diiwaangelinta waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada Gobolka Samburu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Yunivasiti Fund olando tarik mag somo mar pinyruoth ma onge chudo e skunde mag Samburu County.

English: Grow tea even in limited space using container gardening methods on balconies terraces or small plots
Kiswahili: Panda chai hata katika nafasi ndogo kwa kutumia mbinu za bustani za vyombo kwenye balcony matuta au viwanja vidogo
Somali: Shaah ku beero xitaa meel xaddidan adigoo isticmaalaya hababka beerta weelasha ee balakoonka, barxadda ama dhul yaryar
Dholuo: Pidh chai kata mana e alwora matin ka itiyo gi yore mag pidho puothe e piende mag yiende

English: State Department for Basic Education advises applicants in Kakamega County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha Gobolka Kakamega inay dalbadaan booska TVET iyada oo loo marayo KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education nyiso jogo madwaro yudo tiegruok e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni mondo gikonygi e somo mar TVET kokalo kuom KUCCPS.

English: Notice: KALRO will distribute certified sorghum seed to farmers in West Pokot County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Februari hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: KALRO waxay abuurka sorghum ee shahaadada leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda gobolka West Pokot bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Rapar: KALRO biro pogo kodhi mag sorghum ne jopur e West Pokot County e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Tharaka-Nithi County this September. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Septemba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada Reproductive waxay qabaneysaa madasha caafimaadka maskaxda ee dhalinyarada ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi bisha Sebtember. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Rieko: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo romo mar paro ne rowere e Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: KEMSA will hold a stress management forum in Kisii County this November. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA itafanya kongamano la kudhibiti mafadhaiko katika Kaunti ya Kisii Novemba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMSA waxay qabaneysaa madasha xakamaynta stress ee degmada Kisii bisha November. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMSA biro timo romo mar kedo gi parruok e County mar Kisii e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Kenya Dairy Board urges goats farmers in Kajiado County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported rabies cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawataka wafugaji wa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya kichaa cha mbwa vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda orgiga ee degmada Kajiado inay ka fogaadaan in xoolaha lagu guuro xadka degmada iyada oo aan la helin ruqsad ka dib kiisaska xanaaqa la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur mag diek e Kajiado County mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni e gweng'no maok giyudo rusa bang' yudo weche mag rabies.

English: KEPHIS reminds livestock keepers in Samburu County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xayawaanka ah ee Gobolka Samburu inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanada xanuunsan xafiiska xoolaha ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KEPHIS paronwa jorit jamni e county mar Samburu ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya opens voter education centres in Bomet County this April.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Bomet Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay furaysaa xarumo waxbarasho oo codbixiyeyaal ah oo ka tirsan gobolka Bomet bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Huduma Kenya chako tiego josiasa e kaunti mar Bomet e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds citizens in Narok County about their rights regarding voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Narok kuhusu haki zao kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu muwaadiniinta degmada Narok u xusuusinayaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development parone raia mag Narok County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar ndiko joma oyiero.

English: Notice: FAO will open a tea collection centre in Narok County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya chai katika Kaunti ya Narok Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay xarun soo ururinta shaaha ka furi doontaa Gobolka Narok bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: FAO biro yawo ot mar choko chai e taon mar Narok e dwe mar Mach.

English: To manage black rot in brassica crops, rotate with non-Brassica plants and avoid replanting Brassica in the same field more than once every 2 years; control weeds around the farm, avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation, and plant only disease-free seeds or seedlings.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti kuoza kwa mimea ya shaba nyeupe, zunguka kwa mimea isiyo yaBrassica na uepuke kupanda tena Brassica katika shamba lilelile zaidi ya mara moja kila baada ya miaka 2, dhibiti magugu kuzunguka shamba, epuka unyunyizaji wa maji ulio juu ya ardhi, na upande mbegu au miche isiyo na maradhi.
Somali: Si loo xakameeyo burburka madow ee dalagga Brassica, la wareejiya dhirta aan Brassica ahayn oo ka fogaada dib u beerista Brassica isla beerta in ka badan 2 sanoba mar; xakameynta cawska agagaarka beerta, ka fogaada waraabinta buufinta sare, oo kaliya ku beeri abuurka ama geedo cudur-free.
Dholuo: Mondo omi ng'ato obed gi nyalo mar rito yadh-badhno, nyaka olok gi yiende mamoko maok gin mag Brassica kendo kik ochak odwar Brassica e puodho achielno nyading'eny bang' higni ariyo; onego oti gi yore mopogore opogore mag rito lum e alwora mar puodho, kik oti gi gik ma miyo ji pi, kendo onego odwar kodhi kata chamo kodhi ma onge tuoche.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds the public in Vihiga County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this February.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba maoni juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka yanakaribishwa Februari hii.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed ayaa xasuusinaya dadweynaha degmada Vihiga in talooyinka dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee Febraayo la soo dhaweynayo.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties oparo ne ji duto e County mar Vihiga ni paro ma ji chiwo e wi nonro mar tich mitimo higa ka higa en gima owinjore ahinya e dwe mar Februar.

English: E-Citizen reminds voters in Homa Bay County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha gobolka Homa Bay inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor taariikhda doorashada.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa jogedo e Homa Bay County mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar timo yiero kapok kinde mag yiero ochopo.

English: Garissa County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Garissa: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Aprili 2024
Somali: Degmada Garissa: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Garissa: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Ang'wen 2024

English: Notice: KEPHIS will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Meru County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi diiwaan-gelin ah oo loogu talagalay beeraleyda degmada Meru bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro timo rapar mar jopur e dwe mar ochiko mar higani.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development calls on the community in West Pokot County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Machadka Horumarinta Manhajka Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqayaa bulshada ku nool degmada West Pokot inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyo.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oluongo oganda man West Pokot County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: UNFPA hands over Kes 500 Million worth of contraceptives and reproductive health supplies to the Ministry of Health
Kiswahili: UNFPA yakabidhi msaada wa dawa za uzazi wa mpango na afya ya uzazi zenye thamani ya Kes Milioni 500 kwa Wizara ya Afya
Somali: UNFPA waxay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ku wareejisay Kes agab caafimaad oo qiimahoodu dhan yahay 500 Milyan oo ah ka hortagga uurka iyo taranka.
Dholuo: UNFPA ochiwo yore mag geng'o nyuol kod yore mag thieth mag nyuol ma romo milioni 500 ne Od Romo mar Thieth

English: EACC warns public officers in Embu County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: EACC inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Embu dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: EACC waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Embu inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: EACC chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Embu ni kik giti marach gi migepegi.

English: Factsheet: The Kenya Cash Consortium Alert-Based Cash Assistance to Disaster Affected Communities in Mandera County - Baseline and Endline (February 2026)

English: Brief bulletin from Agriculture: vision on procedures of clean farming in Kenya (CSA) 2017-2027 ni:progressive agriculture that maneuvers weather patterns, and low carbon production that affects climate change, to ensure food security and supporting government plans nationally. The main context is to enable transformative agriculture, which adds to inhibitions and production of bad emissions. Main aim of thus is to build resiliency and reduce ga s emission from earth and livestock, reduce production costs and firtify food intake for better livelihoods.
Kiswahili: Taarifa fupi kutoka Kilimo: maono juu ya taratibu za kilimo safi nchini Kenya (CSA) 2017-2027 ni:kilimo kinachoendelea ambacho kinaendesha mifumo ya hali ya hewa, na uzalishaji mdogo wa kaboni unaoathiri mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa, ili kuhakikisha usalama wa chakula na kusaidia mipango ya serikali kitaifa. Muktadha kuu ni kuwezesha kilimo cha mabadiliko, ambacho kinaongeza vizuizi na uzalishaji wa uzalishaji mbaya. Lengo kuu la hivyo ni kujenga uthabiti na kupunguza uzalishaji wa ga s kutoka kwa ardhi na mifugo, kupunguza gharama za uzalishaji na kuingiza ulaji wa chakula kwa maisha bora.
Somali: Warbixin kooban oo ka socota Beeraha: aragti ku saabsan habraacyada beeraleyda nadiifka ah ee Kenya (CSA) 2017-2027 ni: beeraha horumarsan ee ka shaqeeya hababka cimilada, iyo wax-soo-saarka kaarboonka hooseeya ee saameynta isbeddelka cimilada, si loo hubiyo amniga cuntada iyo taageeridda qorshayaasha dowladda ee qaran. Macnaha ugu weyn waa in la suurtageliyo beeraha isbeddelka leh, taasoo kordhisa xayiraadda iyo soo saarista qiiqa xun. Ujeeddada ugu weyn ee arrintan waa in la dhiso adkaysi iyo in la yareeyo qiiqa dhulka iyo xoolaha, la yareeyo kharashka wax-soo-saarka lana kordhiyo qaadashada cuntada si loo helo nolol wanaagsan.
Dholuo: Bulletin machuok moa e Agriculture: vision on procedures of clean farming in Kenya (CSA) 2017-2027 ni:progressive agriculture that maneuvers weather patterns, and low carbon production that affects climate change, to ensure food security and support government plans nationally.

English: If your maize is infected with downy mildew disease: uproot and bury infected plants promptly, avoid walking through infected areas to prevent spreading the disease, remove volunteer sorghum shoots from the field, and after harvest burn or bury crop residues from affected fields; consult your nearest agricultural extension officer for more guidance.

Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Busia Agosti hii.

Dholuo: Ng'e ni: DPP timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e County mar Busia e dwe mar Agost.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds needy students in Baringo County that revision guides applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka ayaa xasuusinaya ardayda u baahan degmada Baringo in dib u eegista ay ku hagaajineyso codsiyada la soo gabagabeynayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development parone jopuonjre man gi chan e Baringo County ni nonro mar weche mag kwayo biro rumo machiegni.

English: Council of Governors reminds the public in Tana River County that input on development planning forums is welcome this July.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linakumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya Tana River kwamba mchango kwenye vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo unakaribishwa Julai hii.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay xasuusinayaan dadweynaha degmada Tana River in talooyinka ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha July.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch oparo ne ji duto e taon mar Tana River County ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mag dongruok e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya Turkana County - Turkana West - General Reference Map (09/11/2023)
Kiswahili: Kenya Kaunti ya Turkana - Turkana Magharibi - Ramani ya Marejeleo ya Jumla (09/11/2023)
Somali: Kenya County Turkana - Galbeedka Turkana - Khariidadda Tixraaca Guud (09/11/2023)
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kenya - Turkana ma milambo - Map mar weche duto (09/11/2023)

English: AFA reminds farmers in Nyeri County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyeri barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada.
Dholuo: AFA oparo ne jopur e County mar Nyeri chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Samburu County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Samburu inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurka laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osiemo ji duto modak e county mar Samburu mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth mar oganda ma onge chudo mondo kik tuoche ma inyalo geng'e landre.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will open an avocado collection centre in Wajir County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itafungua kituo cha kukusanya parachichi katika Kaunti ya Wajir Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa furaya xarun lagu soo ururiyo avocado ee Gobolka Wajir bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Dairy Board biro yawo ot mar choko avocado e County mar Wajir e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations issues a cybersecurity alert on SIM-swap fraud affecting residents of Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM ambao unaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dambiyada ayaa soo saaray digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaamada SIM-swap ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations ogolo siem mar sirkal e wi wuond mar SIM-swap makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Uasin Gishu County.

English: OGP reminds the public in Nyandarua County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Nyandarua in sheegashada khiyaamooyinka iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: OGP paronwa ji duto e County mar Nyandarua ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag yuto en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds residents of Nairobi County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti huimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi in la socodsiinta horumarka mashruuca bogga internetka ee degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General parone jogweng' Nairobi County ni luwo dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Kakamega County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuhudhuria wakiwa na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kula talineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kakamega inay ka soo qayb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e Kaunti mar Kakamega mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Mandera County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Mandera: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Mei 2022
Somali: Degmada Mandheera: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Mandera: Oboke Mopinyo mar Oro mar Mei 2022

English: State Department for Basic Education advises applicants in Kiambu County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kutembelea kituo cha mafunzo ya ufundi kilicho karibu zaidi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Waaxda waxbarashada aasaasiga ah ee dowladda waxay ku talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Kiambu inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow si ay u helaan waxbarashada soo socota.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State for Basic Education jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e County mar Kiambu mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: State Department for TVET conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Turkana County this June.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Turkana Juni hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha gobolka Turkana bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State for TVET dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi migawo mar Ombudsman e taon mar Turkana e dwe mar Jun.

English: Kenya Medical Association appeals to caregivers in Kisumu County to visit their nearest maternity wing as part of the March maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Machi.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ka codsadaa daryeelayaasha degmada Kisumu inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow sida qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association ogwelo jorit e gweng' mar Kisumu mondo odhi olimgi ka gin machiegni gi kama giyudoe nyithindo e dwe mar Mach.

English: Magoha says Ksh.1B needed to buy masks for schools
Kiswahili: Magoha anasema Ksh.1B zinahitajika kununua barakoa kwa ajili ya shule
Somali: Magoha ayaa sheegay in Ksh.1B ay u baahan tahay inay iibsato maaskaro dugsiyada
Dholuo: Magoha wacho ni Ksh.1B ne nyaka ng'iew mask ne skunde

English: Land management that focuses on climate change depends on cooperation between invetors and other sector stakeholders..
Kiswahili: Usimamizi wa ardhi unaozingatia mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa unategemea ushirikiano kati ya wazalishaji na washirika wengine wa sekta.
Somali: Maareynta dhulka ee diiradda saareysa isbeddelka cimilada waxay kuxirantahay iskaashiga u dhexeeya dadka wax soo saarka iyo daneeyayaasha kale ee waaxda.
Dholuo: Chenro mar locho e wi lowo motudore gi lokruok mar lokruok mar kor lwasi, otenore kuom tiyo kanyachiel gi jomamoko.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds expectant mothers in Bomet County that access to free antenatal care is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma ya bure ya ujauzito ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Bomet in helitaanka daryeelka uurka ka hor ee bilaashka ah ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne mine ma biro nyuolo e county mar Bomet ni thuolo mar yudo rit ma onge chudo mar nyuol en maonge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Embu County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu watumie portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u soo gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo jogweng' Embu County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e yor intanet e chiwo ng'ur mar kedo gi mibadhi mar chulo pesa.

English: The Kenyan government has warned that 2.5 million citizens are at risk of severe hunger and water scarcity if the drought persists.
Kiswahili: Serikali na mashirika ya afya yaonya kuhusu hatari ya njaa na ukosefu wa maji, na kuhimiza usambazaji wa chakula na maji salama.
Somali: Dowladda Kenya ayaa ka digtay in 2.5 milyan oo muwaadiniin ah ay halis ugu jiraan gaajo daran iyo biyo yaraan haddii abaartu sii socoto.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya osejiwo ni jodak milion 2.5 ni e arita mar bedo gi kech maduong’ kendo bedo gi nok mar pi ka ng’ichno dhi nyime.

English: ACAPS Thematic Report - Kenya: Impact of drought on the arid and semi-arid regions (29 March 2022)
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Mada ya ACPS - Kenya: Athari za ukame kwenye maeneo kame na nusu kame (29 Machi 2022)
Somali: Warbixinta Mawduuca ACAPS - Kenya: Saamaynta abaartu ku yeelatay gobollada qalalan iyo kuwa nus-abeeysan (29 Maarso 2022)
Dholuo: Ripot maduong' mar ACAPS - Kenya: Ber mar oro kuom kuonde ma otuo kod kuonde ma otuo matin (29 dwe mar Adek 2022)

English: Scalable and sustainable primary HIV prevention models for people from key populations
Kiswahili: Mitindo ya kimsingi na endelevu ya kuzuia VVU kwa watu kutoka makundi muhimu
Somali: Moodooyinka ka hortagga HIV ee aasaasiga ah ee la cabbiri karo oo waara ee loogu talagalay dadka ka soo jeeda dadka muhiimka ah
Dholuo: Yore mag geng'o tuo mar HIV manyalo pimre kendo manyalo sikon ne ji mawuok e kwan maduong' mar oganda

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds voters in Taita-Taveta County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa codbixiyayaasha gobolka Taita-Taveta inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone jogweng'o e Taita-Taveta County mondo olim kama ichikoe ji ne IEBC motelo ne kalenda mar yiero.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds the public in Nairobi County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Hay'adda garsoorka Kenya waxay dadka degmada Nairobi ku xasuusineysaa in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone ji duto manie County mar Nairobi ni chiwo ripot mar kawo asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge ratiro, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Statement of preliminary findings: African Union and COMESA election observation mission to the 9 August 2022 general elections in the Republic of Kenya
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya matokeo ya awali: Ujumbe wa Umoja wa Afrika na waangalizi wa uchaguzi wa COMESA hadi uchaguzi mkuu wa tarehe 9 Agosti 2022 katika Jamhuri ya Kenya.
Somali: Bayaanka natiijooyinka hordhaca ah: Hawlgalka kormeerayaasha doorashada Midowga Afrika iyo COMESA ee doorashada guud ee 9-ka Agoosto 2022 ee Jamhuuriyadda Kenya
Dholuo: Wach mar duoko motelo: Riwruok mar Afrika kod COMESA notimo nonro mar yiero mabiro timore tarik 9 dwe mar aboro higa mar 2022 e piny Kenya

English: The Nyeri ELRC is closed from 24th August to 7th September 2020 due to two confirmed COVID-19 cases, with fumigation and staff self-quarantine underway. No certificates will be processed during this period. The court will reopen for virtual hearings on 21st September, with physical hearings expected to resume under the Presiding Judgeâ€™s supervision in early October.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha ELRC cha Nyeri kimefungwa kuanzia tarehe 24 Agosti hadi 7 Septemba 2020 kutokana na visa viwili vilivyothibitishwa vya COVID-19, huku dawa ya kufukiza na kujitenga kwa wafanyakazi kukiwa kunaendelea. Hakuna vyeti vitakavyoshughulikiwa katika kipindi hiki. Mahakama itafunguliwa tena kwa ajili ya vikao vya mtandaoni tarehe 21 Septemba, huku vikao vya kimwili vikitarajiwa kuanza tena chini ya usimamizi wa Jaji Mkuu mapema Oktoba.
Somali: Xarunta ELRC ee Nyeri waa la xiray laga bilaabo 24 Agoosto ilaa 7 Sebtembar 2020 sababo la xiriira laba kiis oo la xaqiijiyay oo COVID-19 ah, iyadoo la wado qalliin iyo karantiil shaqaalaha. Shahaadooyin lama qaban doono inta lagu jiro muddadan. Maxkamaddu waxay dib u furi doontaa dhageysiga internetka 21 Sebtembar, iyadoo la filayo in dhageysiga jireed dib loo bilaabo iyadoo la raacayo kormeerka Garsooraha Guddoonka horraanta Oktoobar.
Dholuo: ELRC mar Nyeri oloro chakre tarik 24 dwe mar aboro nyaka tarik 7 dwe mar apar higa mar 2020 nikech ji ariyo ma oyudre gi tuo mar COVID-19, ka fumigation kod keto jotich e kwanten giwegi pod dhi nyime. Onge oboke ma ibiro tiyogo e kindeno. Kot biro yawo kendo mondo owinj bura e yor virtual tarik 21 dwe mar apar, kendo winjo bura e yor mbui igeno ni biro chakore kendo e bwo rito mar Jatend bura e chakruok mar dwe mar apar.

English: KICD ensures that accessible textbooks and learning materials are available for learners with disabilities.
Kiswahili: KICD inahakikisha kuwa vitabu vya kusoma na vifaa vya kujifunza vinaweza kupatikana kwa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu.
Somali: KICD waxay hubisaa in buugaag waxbarasho iyo qalab waxbarasho oo la heli karo loo heli karo ardayda naafada ah.
Dholuo: KICD miyo jopuonjre ma nigi midekre thuolo mar somo buge kod gik mamoko ma nyalo konyogi.

English: Teachers Service Commission calls on the community in Narok County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Narok kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ugu baaqay bulshada degmada Narok inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyada.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo ji duto manie Narok County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Drugs to be kept safe from children to prevent unnecessary consumption
Kiswahili: Dawa za kulevya zinazopaswa kuhifadhiwa dhidi ya watoto ili kuzuia matumizi yasiyo ya lazima
Somali: Daawooyinka loo ilaaliyo carruurta si looga hortago isticmaalka aan loo baahnayn
Dholuo: Yore ma nyithindo onego otang'go mondo kik giti kodgi e yo mokalo tong'

English: NDMA urges the community in Embu County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: NDMA inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Embu kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Embu inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha si looga hortago xannibaadda lo'da.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo ji duto e county mar Embu mondo kik gipog weche mag rito ngimagi gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo kik gikwed kwalo jamni.

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health will host a free hypertension awareness outreach in Murang'a County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya itakuwa mwenyeji wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska Dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay marti gelineysaa wacyi-gelin bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cadaadiska dhiig karka ee degmada Murang'a bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth biro timo kampen mar konyo ji ng'eyo ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar hypertension maonge chudo e dwe mar Agost e kaunti mar Murang'a.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges the community in Kiambu County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb fraud.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua ili kuzuia udanganyifu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Kiambu inay ka fogaadaan in ay macluumaadka amniga shisheeyaha la wadaagaan si loo xakameeyo khiyaamooyinka.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ji duto manie County mar Kiambu mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo kik gitim mibadhi.

English: IPOA reminds residents of Vihiga County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga in warbixinta degdegga ah ee xanta xoolaha ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogweng' mar County mar Vihiga ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo jamni konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges parents and teachers in Kajiado County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka ayaa ku boorinaya waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Kajiado inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: Commission of Teachers Service jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e Kajiado County mondo omany namba mar kony mar nyithindo 116.

English: Dairy farmers in Nakuru County are encouraged to join cooperatives for better milk prices The County Government supports the formation of the Nakuru County Dairy Cooperatives Union
Kiswahili: Wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Nakuru wamehimizwa kujiunga na vyama vya ushirika ili kupata bei bora ya maziwa Serikali ya Kaunti yaunga mkono uundaji wa Muungano wa Vyama vya Ushirika vya Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Beeraleyda caanaha ee degmada Nakuru ayaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay ku biiraan iskaashiyada qiimaha caanaha ka wanaagsan Dowladda degmada ayaa taageeraysa sameynta Ururka iskaashiyada caanaha ee degmada Nakuru
Dholuo: Jo-pidh pi e gweng' mar Nakuru ijiwo mondo oriw lwedo riwruoge ma loso dhok mondo omi nengo mag pi obed maber

English: AFA encourages farmers in Narok County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora ya mahindi.
Somali: AFA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Narok inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay hadhuudhka.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Narok mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar kodhi.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Nakuru County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada la hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' Nakuru County mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth mar oganda ma onge chudo mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will host a free food safety outreach in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa usalama wa chakula bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska Dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafiminta taranka ayaa martigelin doonta dadaal bilaash ah oo ku saabsan badbaadada cuntada ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo chenro mar chiwo kony maonge chudo mar chiemo e County mar Elgeyo-Marakwet e dwe mar Februar.

English: HELB reminds needy students in Turkana County that school laptops under the digital literacy programme applications close soon.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya maombi ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika za kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Turkana in laptop-yada dugsiga ee barnaamijka codsiyada akhriska dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa jopuonjre modhier man Turkana County ni kompyuta mag skul manie program mar somo kod somo mar digital chiegni rumo.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development advises students in Isiolo County to collect materials from the county education office to access revision guides.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kukusanya vifaa kutoka ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata miongozo ya marekebisho.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ardayda degmada Isiolo kula talinayaa inay ka soo ururiyaan waxyaabo xafiiska waxbarashada degmada si ay u helaan hagaha dib u eegista.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development nyiso jopuonjre manie Isiolo County mondo ochok gik moko moa e ofis mar tiegruok mar county mondo giyud weche ma nyalo konyogi ng'eyo weche momedore.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds expectant mothers in Nyamira County that access to postnatal check-ups is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba upatikanaji wa uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Nyamira in helitaanka baaritaannada dhalmada ka dib ay yihiin lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne mine ma nigi ich e County mar Nyamira ni dhi e nonro bang' nyuol en gima onge chudo e kuonde duto ma ji yudoree.

English: Plant on time, when the soil is moist at the onset of the first rains; roots will not grow into dry soil and will not survive in water-logged soil.
Kiswahili: Panda kwa wakati ufaao, hakikisha mchanga una unyevu wa kutosha hasa wakati wa mvua za mwanzo. Mizizi ya soya haiwezi kustahimili mchanga mkavu ama mchanga wenye maji mengi.
Somali: Beerta waqtigeeda, marka ciiddu qoyan tahay marka roobka ugu horreeya bilowdo; xididdadu ma koraan dhul qalalan mana ku noolaan doonaan ciidda biyaha ku buuxdaan.
Dholuo: Ket yien e kinde mowinjore, sama lowo nigi pi mang'ich e kinde ma koth chakore; tiende ni mise ok bi dongo mobedo lowo motwo kendo ok gibi siko e lowo mopong' gi pi.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board restricts movement of dairy cows in Kilifi County due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inazuia harakati za ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Newcastle.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka ayaa xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da caanaha ah ee Gobolka Kilifi sababtuna tahay cudurka Newcastle.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok mag Pest (Pest Control Products Board) ogeng'o wuoth mag dhok makwayo chak e County of Kilifi nikech tuwo mar Newcastle.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds farmers in Nyandarua County of the ongoing fertiliser application training programme.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya matumizi ya mbolea.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyandarua barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee isticmaalka bacriminta.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jopur man Nyandarua County e wi program mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar tiyo gi yien.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Uasin Gishu County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Uasin Gishu kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ojiwo jogweng' Uasin Gishu County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: NPS reminds the public in West Pokot County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NPS inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kubaki macho juu ya ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka West Pokot inay ka feejignaadaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: NPS parone ji duto e West Pokot County mondo obed motang' ne loso kuwe e piny mangima.

English: 3 2 million kgs of subsidized maize flour have been supplied to the market Retailers are urged to sell at KES 100 00 per 2Kg packet to ensure accessibility for all
Kiswahili: Kilo milioni 3 2 za unga wa mahindi unaofadhiliwa zimetolewa sokoni

English: Kenya Medical Association announces outpatient services for residents of Embu County starting this January.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatangaza huduma za wagonjwa wa nje kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuanzia Januari hii.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu ku dhawaaqay adeegyada bukaanka dibedda ee dadka deggan degmada Embu laga bilaabo Janaayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association ogolo chenro mar konyo jotuo e gwenge mag Embu County kochakore Januar ma kawuono.

English: COMESA reminds residents of Mombasa County that agroforestry improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba kilimo cha misitu kinaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba la muda mrefu.
Somali: COMESA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa in beeraha kaynta ah uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: COMESA parone jogweng' Mombasa County ni yiende mag yiende konyo e medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.
