English: ODPP reminds residents of Nandi County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nandi in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: ODPP parone jogweng' Nandi County ni luwo dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kitui County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unashauri mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Kitui kutafuta msaada katika nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya qofkasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Kitui inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo tembe e gweng' mar Kitui mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit confirms a HIV/AIDS outbreak alert for Kwale County. Residents are advised to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa VVU/UKIMWI kwa Kaunti ya Kwale. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa xaqiijisay feejignaanta cudurka HIV / AIDS ee Gobolka Kwale. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osenyiso siem mar tuo mar HIV/AIDS e Kaunti mar Kwale.

English: Farmers in Northern Uganda can access the newly opened Regional Agricultural Mechanization Center in Agwata for irrigation and tractor maintenance services
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Kaskazini mwa Uganda wanaweza kufikia Kituo kipya cha Mitambo ya Kilimo cha Kanda kilichofunguliwa huko Agwata kwa huduma za umwagiliaji na matengenezo ya trekta.
Somali: Beeraleyda waqooyiga Uganda waxay heli karaan Xarunta cusub ee Regional Agricultural Mechanization Center ee Agwata si ay u helaan waraabka iyo dayactirka tractor-ka
Dholuo: Jo-Purie man yo nyandwat mar Uganda nyalo yudo thuolo mar tiyo gi Regional Agricultural Mechanization Center e Agwata, ma nyocha eka ochak manyien mondo giti gi yore mag ywayo pi kod rito traktori

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit calls on parents in Laikipia County to have children under five screened for cyclosporiasis during the April outreach.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuwafanya watoto chini ya miaka mitano wachunguzwe cyclosporiasis wakati wa mawasiliano ya Aprili.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Laikipia in carruurta ka yar shan sano la baaro cudurka cyclosporiasis inta lagu gudajiro bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit okwayo jonyuol e county mar Laikipia mondo otim nonro ne nyithindgi ma hikgi tin ne abich e dwe mar April.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds farmers in Nairobi County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi juu ya programu inayoendelea ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa mafunzo ya wakulima.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa beeraleyda degmada Nairobi barnaamijka joogtada ah ee diiwaangelinta tababarka beeralayda.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service parone jopur man Nairobi County kuom chenro mar tiego jopur ma dhi nyime.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges millet growers in Trans Nzoia County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda millet ee degmada Trans Nzoia inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalaalka ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur ma pidho millet e Trans Nzoia County mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: OGP advises residents of Nyandarua County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: OGP inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: OGP waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro kwayo mag ID mar piny.

English: KEPHIS encourages farmers in Nyandarua County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for fish.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya samaki.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Nyandarua inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo kalluunka ah.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e kaunti mar Nyandarua mondo ous olemo mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo rech mondo omi rech obed gi nengo maber.

English: Notice: AFA restricts movement of goats in Kisii County due to a foot and mouth disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA inazuia harakati za mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Kisii kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa riyaha ee degmada Kisii sababtuna tahay faafitaanka cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: AFA ogeng'o wuoth mar diek e County mar Kisii nikech tuwo mar dhoot.

English: NCPB reminds farmers in Uasin Gishu County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Somali: NCPB waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda ku nool gobolka Uasin Gishu barnaamijka tababarka ka dib goosashada ee socda.
Dholuo: NCPB parone jopur e county mar Uasin Gishu chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime bang' keyo.

English: NCPB reminds residents of Meru County that agroforestry improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kwamba kilimo cha misitu kinaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: NCPB waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru in beeraha iyo kaymaha ay hagaajinayaan wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: NCPB parone jogweng' mar Meru County ni agroforestry medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: WFP Kenya 2021 Annual Country Report
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Mwaka ya Nchi ya WFP Kenya 2021
Somali: Warbixinta Sanadlaha ah ee WFP Kenya 2021
Dholuo: Ripot mar Higa mar Piny mar WFP Kenya 2021

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will train farmers in Nyeri County on terracing this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri juu ya mashindano ya usafiri Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu tababar siin doonaa beeraleyda degmada Nyeri ee ku saabsan dhulka lagu beeray bisha Sebtember ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro tiego jopur e County mar Nyeri e wi terracing e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Lamu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Lamu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2023
Somali: Degmada Lamu: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Lamu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar apar 2023

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response calls on parents in Laikipia County to have children under five screened for Rift Valley Fever during the February outreach.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuwafanyia watoto chini ya miaka mitano uchunguzi wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa wakati wa ufikiaji wa Februari.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Laikipia inay carruurta ka yar shan sano u sameeyaan baaritaanka Cudurka Rift Valley inta lagu gudajiro bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuoche kwayo jonyuol e County mar Laikipia mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma hikgi tin mar abich kuom tuwo mar Rift Valley Fever e dwe mar Februar.

English: KICD announces distribution of school laptops under the digital literacy programme to schools in West Pokot County this December.
Kiswahili: KICD inatangaza usambazaji wa kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa shule za Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Desemba hii.
Somali: KICD waxay ku dhawaaqday qaybinta kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada degmada West Pokot bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: KICD ong'ado mar pogo kompyuta mag skul e bwo chenro mar somo gi somo mar digital e skunde man West Pokot County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: IEBC calls on the community in Tharaka-Nithi County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: IEBC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: IEBC waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay taageeraan jawiga barashada oo dhanka ah si loo ilaaliyo nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: IEBC okwayo ji duto e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: UNICEF Kenya Humanitarian Situation Report No. 4, 3 June 2023 (Reporting Period 1 to 30 April 2023)
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Hali ya Kibinadamu ya UNICEF Kenya No. 4, 3 Juni 2023 (Kipindi cha Kuripoti 1 hadi 30 Aprili 2023)
Somali: Warbixinta Xaaladda Bani'aadamnimada ee UNICEF Kenya Lambarka 4, 3 Juun 2023 (Muddada Warbixinta 1aad ilaa 30 Abriil 2023)
Dholuo: Ripot mar chal mar konyo dhano mar UNICEF e piny Kenya namba 4, tarik 3 dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2023 (Kinde mar chiwo ripot chakre tarik 3 nyaka tarik 30 dwe mar ang'wen higa mar 2023)

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Kilifi County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kilifi inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qaybqaataan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development nyiso jopur man Kilifi County mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro.

English: IEBC reminds youth in Samburu County that HELB funding is available for welding and fabrication training.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada gobolka Samburu in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista.
Dholuo: IEBC oparo ne rowere man Samburu County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing.

English: KNEC urges parents and teachers in Homa Bay County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta gobolka Homa Bay inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e Homa Bay County mondo omany simo mar kony ne nyithindo namba 116.

English: Notice: FAO will distribute certified millet seed to farmers in Nyamira County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay abuuraha degmada Nyamira u qaybin doontaa abuurka miraha ee la caddeeyay bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: FAO biro pogo kodhi mag millet ne jopur man Nyamira County e dwe mar Agost.

English: Climate-smart agriculture (CSA) is an approach that helps guide actions to transform agri-food systems towards green and climate resilient practices.
Kiswahili: Kilimo cha hali ya hewa (CSA) ni mbinu inayosaidia kuongoza hatua za kubadilisha mifumo ya chakula cha kilimo kuelekea mazoea ya kijani na yanayostahimili hali ya hewa.
Somali: Beeraha cimilada caqliga leh (CSA) waa hab ka caawiya hagista tallaabooyinka lagu beddelayo nidaamyada cuntada beeraha si ay u noqdaan dhaqamada cagaaran iyo kuwa cimilada u adkeysan.
Dholuo: Tij pur mariek e weche mag lokruok mar alwora (Climate-Smart Agriculture - CSA) en yo ma konyo e tayo gik mitimo e loko yore mag chiemo kod puothe mag chamo chiemo mondo obed gi timbe mabeyo kendo ma ok kethre gi lokruok mar alwora.

English: KMTC calls on the community in Turkana County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KMTC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: KMTC waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Turkana inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116 si ay u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: KMTC okwayo ji duto e county mar Turkana mondo omany namba mar 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of West Pokot County to attend the public participation forum to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya West Pokot kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay ka qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si ay u qaabeeyaan wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynta.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar loso chenro mag chenro mag oganda.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Embu County about the importance of tobacco control for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Embu kuhusu umuhimu wa udhibiti wa tumbaku kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay dadka degmada Embu ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay ka hortagga sigaarka ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji e county mar Embu kuom gimomiyo thieth mar madho ndawa en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Attention farmers and agribusiness stakeholders The Multi Sectoral Food Security and Nutrition Project is launching awareness competitions in 1 500 schools to promote nutrition through arts Participate to enhance community awareness
Kiswahili: Wakulima makini na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo Mradi wa Sekta mbalimbali wa Usalama wa Chakula na Lishe unazindua mashindano ya uhamasishaji katika shule 1,500 ili kukuza lishe kupitia sanaa Shiriki ili kuongeza uelewa kwa jamii.
Somali: Digniin, beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha, Mashruuca Amniga Cuntada iyo Nafaqada ee Qaybaha Badan ayaa bilaabaya tartamo wacyigelin ah oo ka dhacaya 1,500 dugsi si loo dhiirrigeliyo nafaqada iyada oo loo marayo farshaxanka. Ka qaybgalka kor u qaadista wacyiga bulshada
Dholuo: Chenro mar Chiemo kod Puonjruok e Weche Odhaka e Skunde 1,500 dhi nyime gi piem mar chiwo paro e wi wach chiemo kokalo kuom kitegi mar timo dongruok

English: SHA reminds residents of Kiambu County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: SHA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: SHA parone jogweng' Kiambu County ni luwo dongruok mar tich kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: IPOA reminds residents of Garissa County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this drought season.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati huu wa ukame.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Garissa inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada ay fatahan yihiin xilligan abaarta.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogweng' mar County mar Garissa ni kik giwuoth e wi borni kod aoche ma pi opong'o e kinde mar oro.

English: Ministry of Health encourages residents of Wajir County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya iyo inay ku dhiirigeliso saaxiibka dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health jiwo jogweng' mar Wajir County mondo kik gisandre gi muol kendo mondo gijiw osiepgi moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: Council of Governors announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linatangaza kuboresha nyakati za huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku dhawaaqeen waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee Gobolka Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch olando lokruok e seche mag tiyo gi passport e County mar Kirinyaga.

English: Kenya achieves elimination of human African trypanosomiasis or sleeping sickness as a public health problem
Kiswahili: Kenya inafanikisha uondoaji wa trypanosomiasis ya kibinadamu ya Kiafrika au ugonjwa wa kulala kama shida ya afya ya umma
Somali: Kenya waxay ku guuleysatay ciribtirka cudurka trypanosomiasis ee dadka Afrikaanka ah ama xanuunka hurdada oo ah dhibaato caafimaad oo dadweyne.
Dholuo: Kenya osechopo e tieko tuo mar nindo kata tuo mar nindo kaka chandruok mar thieth mar oganda

English: SHA reminds residents of Vihiga County that access to national ID applications is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: SHA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba kufikia maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga in helitaanka codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: SHA parone jogweng' mar County mar Vihiga ni yudo kwayo mag ID mar piny sani yot moloyo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal.

English: E-Citizen reminds residents of Kirinyaga County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba kuhudhuria mkutano wa umma wa mkutano wa kaunti huimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga ee ka qeybgalaya kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada ayaa xoojinaya maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa jogweng' Kirinyaga County ma biro e chokruok maduong' mar county assembly mondo omed jiwo sirkal.

English: OGP urges residents of Nairobi County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight abuse of office.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi wape huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay dalbadaan bixinta adeegyada iyada oo aan la bixin laaluush si looga hortago xadgudubka xilka.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogweng' Nairobi County mondo okonygi ka ok gichiwo asoya mondo gikwed timbe maricho mag tiyo gi migepegi e yo marach.

English: Notice: NDMA conducts a community briefing on border security in Bomet County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA inafanya mkutano wa jamii juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Bomet Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha degmada Bomet bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA dhi timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e county mar Bomet e dwe mar Desemba.

English: AFA reminds residents of Tana River County that terracing improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kwamba terracing inaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River in dhulka lagu beerayo uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: AFA paronwa jogweng' mar Tana River County ni timo terracing kelo nyak e puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: IPOA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kiambu County that access to psychosocial support is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisaikolojia unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee degmada Kiambu in helitaanka taageerada cilmu-nafsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e County mar Kiambu ni thuolo mar yudo kony kuom weche mag pach ji yudore maonge chudo.

English: A deconstructive approach to refugee self-reliance: the case of the Kalobeyei Integrated Settlement
Kiswahili: Mbinu mbovu ya kujitegemea kwa wakimbizi: kesi ya Makazi Jumuishi ya Kalobeyei
Somali: Hab dib-u-dhis ah oo loogu talagalay isku-kalsoonida qaxootiga: kiiska Degsiimada Isku-dhafan ee Kalobeyei
Dholuo: Yo ma ketho geno mar jolweny: wach mar Kalobeyei

English: NPS urges motorists and pedestrians in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NPS inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka lugta leh ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay adeegsadaan meelaha lugta loo qoondeeyey si looga hortago dhacdooyinka abaarta la xiriira.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo jorit mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe mondo gikonygi kik hinyre nikech oro.

English: In total, KRCS reports42,058 children under five provided with nutrition servicesto date under this drought response.
Kiswahili: Kwa jumla, KRCS inaripoti watoto 42,058 walio chini ya miaka mitano waliopewa huduma za lishe hadi sasa chini ya mwitikio huu wa ukame.
Somali: Guud ahaan, KRCS waxay soo sheegtay 42,058 carruur ah oo ka yar shan sano oo la siiyay adeegyo nafaqo ilaa hadda ka dib jawaabtan abaarta.
Dholuo: Kaka duto, KRCS ogolo ripot mar nyithindo 42,058 ma pok ochopo higni abich ma omiye kony mar chiemo nyaka sani e bwo dwoko mar oro.

English: Notice from Kenya Medical Association: family planning counselling clinics will run every July at designated health centres in Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Julai katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya: rugta la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ayaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Luulyo oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association: Klinike mag chiwo paro e wi chenro mag ngima joot biro tiyo e dwe mar Julai higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia.

English: KTDA urges farmers in Kiambu County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kiambu inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e Kaunti mar Kiambu mondo opidh olembe mag choko lowo mondo omi piny okethre.

English: EACC reminds the public in Kericho County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kericho in sheegashada khiyaamooyinka iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: EACC paronwa ji duto e County mar Kericho ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag yuto en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: KTDA urges pigs farmers in Kiambu County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawataka wafugaji wa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa ngozi ya uvimbe vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda doofaarka ee degmada Kiambu inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanada buka xafiiska xayawaanka ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur ma pidho anguro e County mar Kiambu mondo oland ne jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth machiegni gi kanyo bang' ka osenyis ni nitie tuoche mang'eny mag pien.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service invites farmers in Homa Bay County to a free training on greenhouse farming this May.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo cha chafu Mei hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku casuumay beeraleyda gobolka Homa Bay inay tababar bilaash ah ku helaan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo bisha May.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service ogwelo jopur e Homa Bay County e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar greenhouse agriculture e dwe mar Mei.

English: EACC urges residents of Nyamira County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia laini ya bure ya eACC ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee lacag la'aanta ah si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jogweng' Nyamira County mondo oland weche mag mibadhi kokalo kuom hotline mar EACc maonge chudo mondo giked gi wuond mag yuto.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board restricts movement of sheep in Nakuru County due to a rabies outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya yazuia harakati za kondoo katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kutokana na mlipuko wa kichaa cha mbwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa idaha degmada Nakuru sababo la xiriira cudurka cadho.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Dairy Board ogeng'o wuoth mar rombe e gweng' mar Nakuru nikech tuwo mar rabies.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Murang'a County that access to subsidised dialysis is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba upatikanaji wa dialysis ya ruzuku sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Murang'a in helitaanka dialysis-ka la taageeray hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMRI oparo ne ji duto e County mar Murang'a ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mar dialysis e kuonde moyier.

English: Kenya Gazette warns public officers in Migori County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Migori dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Migori inay musuqmaasuqa ka qaataan xafiisyada dawladda.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Migori kuom kawo asoya e migepe mag oganda.

English: TSC urges parents and teachers in Tharaka-Nithi County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: TSC inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: TSC waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay u soo sheegaan maamulka iskuulka wixii arrimo ah oo ku saabsan amniga.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo onyis sirkal mar skul wach moro amora motudore gi ritruok.

English: Notice: HELB announces bursary allocation enrollment dates for schools in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa mgao wa bursary kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ee dugsiyada degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: HELB landoga tarik ma ne idhi yiergo skul mag Bungoma County mondo giyud thuolo mar dhi e skundno.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Wananchi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu furayaa barta adeegga cusub ee diiwaangelinta e-Muwaadiniinta ee Gobolka Kilifi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties oyawo kamachielo mar e-Citizen registration e County ma Kilifi.

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Nyandarua County that access to free antenatal care is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma ya ujauzito bila malipo ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Nyandarua in helitaanka daryeelka uurka ka hor ee bilaashka ah ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMSA oparo ne mine ma biro nyuolo e County mar Nyandarua ni thuolo mar yudo rit ma onge chudo mar nyuol en maonge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: AFA advises avocado producers in Meru County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: AFA inawashauri wazalishaji wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Meru kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: AFA waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha avocado ee degmada Meru inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: AFA nyiso jopur ma loso avocado e county mar Meru mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Notice: KUCCPS opens a new motor vehicle mechanics programme at the vocational centre in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inafungua programu mpya ya ufundi wa magari katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay ka furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan farsamada gawaarida gaadiidka ee xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Meru.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KUCCPS ochako chenro manyien mar tiyo gi masin mag mtokni e kar tiegruok e county mar Meru.

English: You have to be registered to get the COVID-19 vaccine.  You can do this at the nearest health facility or be registering on the MOH_Kenya website (http://health.go.ke). All you need is your ID card. Kindly assist your elderly relatives to get registered
Kiswahili: Lazima uwe umesajiliwa ili kupata chanjo ya COVID-19. Unaweza kufanya hivi katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu au kujiandikisha kwenye tovuti ya MOH_Kenya (http://health.go.ke). Unachohitaji ni kitambulisho chako. Tafadhali wasaidie jamaa zako wazee kujiandikisha.
Somali: Waa inaad iska diiwaangelisaa si aad u hesho tallaalka COVID-19. Waxaad ku sameyn kartaa xarunta caafimaadka ee kuugu dhow ama waxaad iska diiwaangelin kartaa websaydhka MOH_Kenya (http://health.go.ke). Waxa kaliya ee aad u baahan tahay waa kaarka aqoonsigaaga. Fadlan ka caawi qaraabadaada waayeelka ah inay iska diiwaangeliyaan
Dholuo: Inyalo timo kamano e osiptal man machiegni kodi kata inyalo ndiko e websait mar MOH_Kenya (http://health.go.ke).

English: KEMRI advises residents of Marsabit County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa bure wa afya ya jamii ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: KEMRI waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada la hortagi karo.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng' mar Marsabit County mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth ma onge chudo mar oganda mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds farmers in Nakuru County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa xusuusinaya beeraleyda degmada Nakuru barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee ka dambeeya goosashada.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products oparo ne jopur man Nakuru County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime bang' keyo.

English: Notice: KNEC launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay bilawday barnaamij lagu darayo ardayda naafada ah dugsiyada gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KNEC chako chenro mar tiego nyithindo ma nigi midekre e skunde duto mag Homa Bay County.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa maelekezo ya makazi salama katika Kajiado County.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa furaya xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya tixraacyo magangelyo ammaan ah oo ku yaal degmada Kajiado.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Directorate of Criminal Investigations ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kuonde dak e alwora mar Kajiado County.

English: COMESA advises avocado producers in Meru County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inashauri wazalishaji wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Meru kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: COMESA waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha avocado ee degmada Meru inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: COMESA nyiso jopur ma loso avocado e county mar Meru mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Kilifi County this August.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Agosti hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada Waxbarashada ayaa qabanqaabaya madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha gobolka Kilifi bishii Ogosto.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi migawo mar Ombudsman e gweng' mar Kilifi e dwe mar Agost.

English: KNEC encourages out-of-school children in Taita-Taveta County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under free primary education.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e Taita-Taveta County mondo odonj e program mar puonjo joma dongo somo ma onge chudo.

English: KICD reminds needy students in Nyamira County that school laptops under the digital literacy programme applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya maombi ya programu ya kusoma na kuandika ya kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Nyamira in laptop-yada dugsiga ee barnaamijka codsiyada akhriska dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: KICD parone jopuonjre man gi chandruok e County mar Nyamira ni kompyuta mag skul manie program mar somo kod somo mar digital biro rumo machiegni.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service encourages farmers in Taita-Taveta County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya mahindi.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay hadhuudhka.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur e Taita-Taveta County mondo ous olembe mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo mondo omi olembe obed maber.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Kilifi County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Kilifi ku xasuusinayaa inay adeegaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah xilli ciyaareedkan dabka.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service parone jogweng' Kilifi County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji moa kuonde ma kamago ma jotelo mag gweng'no ogolo e kinde mag yiengni.

English: Notice: HELB opens a new catering and hospitality programme at the vocational centre in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB inafungua mpango mpya wa upishi na ukarimu katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay ka furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan cuntada iyo marti-gelinta xarunta xirfadaha ee gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: HELB chako chenro manyien mar chiemo kod rwako welo e kar tich e Homa Bay County.

English: Farming (UNDFF). Organizations can register in FO ... (3) make digital agriculture technics available to small farmers and not only the big agro-industries.
Kiswahili: Kilimo (UNDFF). Mashirika yanaweza kujiandikisha katika FO ... (3) kufanya mbinu za kilimo kidijitali zipatikane kwa wakulima wadogo na si tu viwanda vikubwa vya kilimo.
Somali: Beeraha (UNDFF). Ururadu waxay iska diiwaan gelin karaan FO ... (3) farsamooyinka dhijitaalka ah ee beeraha ee la heli karo beeraleyda yaryar ee aan kaliya ahayn warshadaha waaweyn ee beeraha.
Dholuo: Tij Lemo (UNDFF): Riwruok nyalo ndiko e FO ... (3) miyo yore mag pur mag digital bedo mayot ne jopur matindo to ok mana ne tije madongo mag pur.

English: Samburu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Samburu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Juni 2024
Somali: Degmada Samburu: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Samburu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2024

English: E-Citizen advises residents of Machakos County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: E-Citizen nyiso joma odak e County mar Machakos mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport.

English: Laikipia County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Laikipia: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2024
Somali: Degmada Laikipia: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Laikipia: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2024

English: State Department for Basic Education urges parents and teachers in Nyandarua County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Somali: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Dowladda waxay waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Nyandarua ugu baaqeysaa inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Nyandarua mondo omany namba mar kony mar nyithindo 116.

English: Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) for all bank and social media accounts.
Kiswahili: Kuwezesha uthibitisho wa sababu mbili (2FA) kwa akaunti zote za benki na media ya kijamii.
Somali: U oggolow xaqiijinta laba-factor (2FA) dhammaan xisaabaadka bangiyada iyo warbaahinta bulshada.
Dholuo: Miye thuolo mar nyiso adiera mar weche ariyo (2FA) ne weche duto mag bengi koda mag social media.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service informs milk farmers in Garissa County of new market linkage opportunities this March.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawafahamisha wakulima wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Garissa juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Machi hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku wargalinayaa beeraleyda caanaha ee Gobolka Garissa fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur mag chak e County mar Garissa thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Mach.

English: IEBC reminds the public in Nyandarua County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: IEBC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Nyandarua in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: IEBC paronwa ji duto e County mar Nyandarua ni lando wach tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'.

English: During the December campaign, WHO provided technical and financial support in the 11 counties to help accelerate the coverage of COVID-19 vaccine through strategic risk communication, community engagement and vaccination outreach teams.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa kampeni ya Desemba, WHO ilitoa usaidizi wa kiufundi na kifedha katika kaunti 11 ili kusaidia kuharakisha utoaji wa chanjo ya COVID-19 kupitia mawasiliano ya kimkakati ya hatari, ushiriki wa jamii na timu za kufikia chanjo.
Somali: Intii lagu jiray ololihii Diseembar, WHO waxay taageero farsamo iyo mid dhaqaale ka bixisay 11-ka degmo si ay gacan uga geysato dardargelinta daboolida tallaalka COVID-19 iyada oo loo marayo isgaarsiinta istaraatiijiyadeed ee khatarta, ka qaybgalka bulshada iyo kooxaha gaarsiinta tallaalka.
Dholuo: E kinde kampen mar dwe mar apar gi ariyo, WHO nomiyo kony mar lony kod pesa e kaunti 11 mondo okony e kelo mapiyo lando chanjo mar COVID-19 kokalo kuom tudruok mar risk, loso gi oganda kod timbe mag lando chanjo.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health confirms a meningitis outbreak alert for Meru County. Residents are advised to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa uti wa mgongo kwa Kaunti ya Meru. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ku saabsan cudurka meningitis ee degmada Meru. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuo mar meningitis e kaunti mar Meru.

English: KEMRI urges residents of Machakos County to complete the full recommended vaccination dose following a rise in reported dengue fever cases.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya homa ya dengue.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay dhammaystiraan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo kadib kororka kiisaska cudurka dengue ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng'o mag County ma Machakos mondo ochop e okang' malach mar thieth ma gichiwo bang' medruok mar joma ne nigi tuwo mar dengue.

English: Taita Taveta County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for January 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Taita Taveta: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Januari 2024
Somali: Degmada Taita Taveta: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Janaayo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Taita Taveta: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar achiel higa mar 2024

English: Judiciary of Kenya encourages first-time voters in Isiolo County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya ayaa ku dhiirigelinaya codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Isiolo inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo josiasa mokwongo e kaunti mar Isiolo mondo onyis weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: TSC announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Garissa County this April.
Kiswahili: TSC inatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Garissa Aprili hii.
Somali: TSC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta waxyaabaha barashada digitalka ah ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada Gobolka Garissa bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: TSC olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag digital maonge chudo e skunde man Garissa County e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission opens applications for school laptops under the digital literacy programme for learners in Machakos County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafungua maombi ya kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Machakos.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa furaya codsiyada kumbuyuutarrada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee ardayda degmada Machakos.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj chako tiyo gi kompyuta mag skul kaluwore gi chenro mar somo kod somo mar digital e kaunti mar Machakos.

English: NCPB promotes organic farming among farmers in Nandi County as part of the January climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: NCPB inakuza kilimo hai kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi kama sehemu ya harakati za ustahimilivu wa hali ya hewa ya Januari.
Somali: NCPB waxay kor u qaadeysaa beeraha dabiiciga ah ee beeraleyda gobolka Nandi iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Janaayo.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo tij pur e kind jopur e County mar Nandi kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi mar lokruok mar piny e dwe mar Januar.

English: KNEC reminds needy students in Tana River County that school laptops under the digital literacy programme applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Tana River kwamba kompyuta ndogo za shule chini ya maombi ya programu ya kusoma na kuandika ya dijiti zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KNEC waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Tana River in laptop-yada dugsiga ee barnaamijka codsiyada akhriska dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: KNEC parone jopuonjre man gi chandruok e taon mar Tana River County ni kompyuta mag skul manie program mar somo kod somo mar digital biro rumo machiegni.

English: DPP urges the community in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb theft.
Kiswahili: DPP anahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ka warbixiyaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo shaki leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo ji duto manie County mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo ochiw ripot e stesen mar polise man machiegni mondo gikwed nek.

English: Public launch of rice products fortified with iron, folic acid, B-vitamins, iodine and zinc, aligned with government fortification standards.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa umma wa bidhaa za mchele zilizoongezewa madini ya chuma, asidi ya foliki, vitamini B, iodini na zinki, unaoendana na viwango vya serikali vya urutubishaji.
Somali: Daahfurka dadweynaha ee badeecooyinka bariiska ee lagu xoojiyay birta, folic acid, fiitamiinnada B, iodine iyo zinc, oo la jaanqaadaya heerarka xoojinta dowladda.
Dholuo: Keto e wang' ji duto mwandu mag ngano moting'o chuma, asid mar folik, vitamin B, ayodin kod zinc, kaluwore kod rang'iny mar sirkal mar keto muonde.

English: NTSA calls on residents of Tana River County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of border security.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Tana River kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: NTSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: NTSA okwayo jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji nitie mondo okonygi rito sirkal.

English: Kenya Dairy Board invites farmers in Kericho County to a free training on greenhouse farming this April.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo cha chafu Aprili hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa ku casuumay beeraleyda degmada Kericho inay helaan tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo bisha April.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board ogwelo jopur e County mar Kericho e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar greenhouse agriculture e dwe mar April.

Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya Febraayo 2026

Kiswahili: Data mpya ya IRC: Ukame wa Pembe ya Afrika unaosababisha kuongezeka kwa ukatili dhidi ya wanawake na wasichana

English: Kitui County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kitui: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2023
Somali: Degmada Kitui: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kitui: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar 2023

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges motorists and pedestrians in Samburu County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Samburu kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Samburu inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo jorit mtokni kod joma wuotho gi tiendgi e county mar Samburu mondo oluw chike mag golo ji moa kuondego ma jotelo mag sirkal ogolo mondo gikwed masiche motudore gi apaka.

English: Responding to mental health issues for people with disabilities is critical.Do you know someone who would need someone to talk to?SMS support to 20767 to get access to a counsellor.
Kiswahili: Kushughulikia masuala ya afya ya akili kwa watu wenye ulemavu ni muhimu. Je, unamjua mtu ambaye atahitaji mtu wa kuzungumza naye? Tuma ujumbe mfupi wa usaidizi kwa 20767 ili kupata mshauri nasaha.
Somali: Ka jawaabista arrimaha caafimaadka maskaxda ee dadka naafada ah waa mid muhiim ah. Ma taqaanaa qof aad u baahan tahay qof aad la hadasho?
Dholuo: Dwoko kuom weche mag thieth mar pach joma nigi midekre en gima dwarore ahinya. Be ing'eyo ng'at manyalo dwaro ng'ato mondo owuo kode?

English: National Drought Early Warning Bulletin (July 2024)
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Tahadhari ya Mapema ya Kitaifa (Julai 2024)
Somali: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Qaranka (Luulyo 2024)
Dholuo: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro (Julaini 2024)

English: Garissa County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Garissa: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Julai 2024
Somali: Degmada Garissa: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Garissa: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Julaini 2024

English: Kenya Dairy Board announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for poultry in Wajir County this February.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya yatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa kuku katika Kaunti ya Wajir Februari hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhawaaqay jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee digaagga ee Gobolka Wajir bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board olando chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar dhoot e dwe mar Februar e kaunti mar Wajir.

English: FAO urges farmers in Kwale County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: FAO inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kwale inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e county mar Kwale mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e weche mag pur mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Notice: NPS launches a carjacking prevention campaign in Kericho County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NPS yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia utekaji nyara katika Kaunti ya Kericho Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: NPS waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga gaadiidka la xaday ee degmada Kericho bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NPS chako kampen mar geng'o joma kwalo mtokni e taon mar Kericho e dwe mar Desemba.

English: KEMRI advises residents of Tana River County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: KEMRI waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth mar oganda maonge chudo mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: DPP reminds mobile money users in Siaya County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Siaya inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: DPP paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e county mar Siaya mondo ochiw ripot mar ote mamulo pachgi ne jatendgi mondo kik gitim kamano.

Somali: NDMA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Taita-Taveta kororka qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan falin.
Dholuo: NDMA osiemo jogweng' Taita-Taveta County kuom medruok mar chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties urges residents of Taita-Taveta County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia simu ya EACC ya bure ili kupambana na matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Taita-Taveta inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee EACC si looga hortago xadgudubka xilka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties jiwo jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo oland weche mag mibadhi kokalo kuom hotline mar EACC maonge chudo mondo giked gi timbe mag tiyo marach gi migepe.

English: SHA urges eligible citizens in Marsabit County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: SHA inawasihi wananchi wanaostahiki katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Marsabit inay ka qaybqaataan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jogweng' mar Marsabit mondo ochiwre e ndiko joma oyiero.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit appeals to caregivers in Wajir County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the July maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Wajir kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Julai.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Wajir inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit okwayo jorit e county mar Wajir mondo okel nyithindgi mondo gine kaka nyithindgi dongo e dwe mar Julai.

English: KTDA informs milk farmers in Machakos County of new market linkage opportunities this July.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawafahamisha wakulima wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Julai hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda caanaha ee degmada Machakos fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: KTDA nyiso jopur mag chak e county mar Machakos kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Murang'a County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Murang'a inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e County mar Murang'a mondo oluong kony mar thieth mar paro maonge chudo.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit appeals to caregivers in Kilifi County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the May maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya mama ya Mei.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Kilifi inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka bisha Maajo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit okwayo jorit e County mar Kilifi mondo okwan kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathine kaka achiel kuom yore mag thieth ma miyo timo e dwe mar Mei.

English: KEPHIS advises farmers in Makueni County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the April planting season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni kufanya mazoezi ya kugeuza mazao ili kurejesha uzazi wa udongo kabla ya msimu wa kupanda Aprili.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Degmada Makueni inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda ka hor xilliga beerashada ee Abriil.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Makueni mondo otim lokruok e puothe mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber ka pok ochopo higa mar April.

English: Kenya Medical Association appeals to caregivers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the August maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya harakati za afya ya uzazi za Agosti.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ka codsadaa daryeelayaasha degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Agoosto.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association okwayo jorit e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo okel nyithindgi mondo onon dongruok margi kaka achiel kuom chenro mar August matayo ngima mar mine.

English: PSA on climateÃ¢â‚¬â€˜smart grazing techniques for dairy farmers.
Kiswahili: PSA juu ya hali ya hewa - mbinu za malisho smart kwa wakulima wa maziwa.
Somali: PSA oo ku saabsan farsamooyinka daaqsinta ee cimilo ee beeraleyda caanaha.
Dholuo: PSA kuom yore mag ng'ado le ma riek mag piny ne jopur ma ng'iewo chak.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties advises residents of Nandi County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Nandi kula talinayaa inay dalbadaan internetka iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties jiwo jogweng' County mar Nandi mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro kwayo mag ID mar piny.

English: Hand washing, sanitizing, where possible, maintaining social and physical distance, should become part of our daily lifestyles. #KomeshaCorona.
Kiswahili: Kuosha mikono, kusafisha, inapowezekana, kudumisha umbali wa kijamii na kimwili, inapaswa kuwa sehemu ya maisha yetu ya kila siku. #KomeshaCorona.
Somali: Dhaqidda gacmaha, nadiifinta, meesha ay suurtagal tahay, ilaalinta kala fogaanshaha bulshada iyo jirka, waa inay qayb ka noqotaa qaab nololeedkeenna maalinlaha ah. #KomeshaCorona.
Dholuo: Loso lwedo, keto gik moko ma ok ler, kama nyalore, rito thuolo e kind ji kod ng’ato gi ng’ato, onego obed achiel kuom yore ma watiyogo pile ka pile. #Korona.

English: Field services offer digitÃ l sensitization on farmers in Bungoma.
Kiswahili: Huduma za shambani hutoa uhamasishaji wa kidijitali kwa wakulima huko Bungoma.
Somali: Adeegyada beeraha waxay bixiyaan wacyigelin dhijitaal ah oo ku saabsan beeraleyda Bungoma.
Dholuo: Tich mag puoth miyo jopur ma Bungoma ng’eyo weche mag dijital.

English: ODPP reminds voters in Lamu County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Lamu kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha gobolka Lamu inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor inta aysan helin waxbarasho codbixinayaasha.
Dholuo: ODPP oparo ne josiasa man Lamu County mondo olim kama ichanoe ji mar IEBC machiegni kodgi kapok giyudo tiegruok.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will open a coffee collection centre in Embu County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itafungua kituo cha kukusanya kahawa katika Kaunti ya Embu Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay xarun soo uruurinta kafeega ka furi doontaa gobolka Embu bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro yawo kar choko chai e taon mar Embu e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: This advertisement is placed for general public information.
Kiswahili: Tangazo hili limewekwa kwa habari ya jumla ya umma.
Somali: Xayeysiintan waxaa loo dhigay macluumaad guud oo dadweyne.
Dholuo: Oboke maeni oket mondo ji duto ong’e.

English: Just like when you are going to hospital every year to consult with your doctor, your brain also needs a checkup.
Kiswahili: Kama vile unapoenda hospitalini kila mwaka ili kushauriana na daktari wako, ubongo wako pia unahitaji kupimwa.
Somali: Sida aad sanad walba u tagto isbitaalka si aad dhakhtarkaaga ula tashato, maskaxdaada sidoo kale waxay u baahan tahay baaritaan.
Dholuo: Mana kaka ihinyo dhi e osiptal higa ka higa mondo iwuo gi laktar, obwongo bende dwarore ni onon.

English: CS Mutahi Kagwe.Kakamega County has successfully managed its cases of malaria, achieved 80 percent coverage when it comes to immunization of children & managed to establish five treatment centers that have been prepared to handle the Covid-19 pandemic outbreak. @CountyKakamega
Kiswahili: Waziri Mutahi Kagwe.Kaunti ya Kakamega imefanikiwa kudhibiti visa vyake vya ugonjwa wa malaria, na kufikia asilimia 80 ya chanjo ya watoto na imeweza kuanzisha vituo vitano vya matibabu ambavyo vimetayarishwa kushughulikia janga la Covid-19. @KauntiKakamega
Somali: CS Mutahi Kagwe. Degmada Kakamega ayaa si guul leh u maareysay kiisaska duumada, waxayna gaartay 80 boqolkiiba caymiska tallaalka carruurta waxayna ku guuleysatay inay dhisto shan xarumood oo daaweyn ah oo loo diyaariyey inay wax ka qabtaan faafitaanka masiibada Covid-19. @CountyKakamega
Dholuo: CS Mutahi Kagwe.Kaunti mar Kakamega osebedo gi loch e geng’o tuoche mag maleria, osechopo e kwan mar 80 kuom mia achiel ka ochopo e chiwo chanjo ne nyithindo kendo osenyalo keto kuonde thieth abich ma oseik mar geng’o tuwo mar Covid-19. @KauntiKamega

English: KEMRI announces free medical camps for residents of Vihiga County starting this May.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kuanzia Mei hii.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa xeryo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Vihiga laga bilaabo bisha May.
Dholuo: KEMRI ogolo kampen mag thieth maonge chudo ne jogweng' mar County mar Vihiga kochakore dwe mar abich.

English: DPP reminds the public in Nairobi County to remain vigilant on border security.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Nairobi in ay ka feejignaadaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: DPP parone ji duto e County mar Nairobi mondo obed motang' gi weche mag sirkal.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Kisumu County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the December planting season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Desemba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kisumu inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur e County mar Kisumu mondo oti gi nengo mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Desemba.

English: KTDA advises farmers in Kisii County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the March planting season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji Machi.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kisii inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: KTDA nyiso jopur e County mar Kisii ni giti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Mach.

English: KEPHIS informs milk farmers in Lamu County of new market linkage opportunities this March.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawafahamisha wakulima wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Lamu juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Machi hii.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda caanaha ee degmada Lamu fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: KEPHIS nyiso jopur mag chak e County mar Lamu kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Mach.

English: Baringo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Baringo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Aprili 2023
Somali: Degmada Baringo: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Baringo: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar Ang'wen 2023

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds expectant mothers in Machakos County that access to free antenatal care is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma ya bure ya ujauzito ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Machakos in helitaanka daryeelka uurka ka hor ee bilaashka ah ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne mine ma biro nyuolo e gweng' mar Machakos ni thuolo mar yudo thieth ma onge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal en maonge chudo.

English: Notice: KNEC announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ee dugsiyada degmada Kilifi.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KNEC olando tarik ma jopuonjre biro donjoe e skunde mag Kilifi County.

English: HELB reminds youth in Kakamega County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada ku nool Gobolka Kakamega in maalgelinta HELD ay diyaar u tahay tababarka farsamada gawaarida.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa rowere manie Kaunti mar Kakamega ni pesa ma giyudo kuom HELP yudore ne tiegruok mar jomisonari mag mtokni.

English: Ministry of Health announces outpatient services for residents of Turkana County starting this February.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatangaza huduma za wagonjwa wa nje kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kuanzia Februari hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ku dhawaaqday adeegyada bukaanka ka baxsan dadka deggan degmada Turkana laga bilaabo Febraayo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth mar piny owacho ogolo chenro mar konyo jotuo mag Turkana County kochakore e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by CDC will be held in Laikipia County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na CDC itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabiyeen CDC ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Laikipia bisha August.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kampen mar thieth ma CDC ochano biro timore Laikipia County e dwe mar Agost.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay u dhiiri galiyaan saaxiibka dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo kik gisandre aling' ling' kendo mondo gijiw osiepgi moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross will hold a stress management forum in Wajir County this September. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utafanya kongamano la kudhibiti mafadhaiko katika Kaunti ya Wajir Septemba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay qabaneysaa madasha xakamaynta stress-ka ee Gobolka Wajir bisha Sebtember. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: 'Kenya Red Cross' biro timo romo mar kedo gi parruok e gweng' mar Wajir e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Public health advisory: CDC warns of increased cyclosporiasis risk in Laikipia County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: CDC inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya cyclosporiasis katika Kaunti ya Laikipia na inashauri umma kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: CDC waxay ka digeysaa khatarta sii kordheysa ee cyclosporiasis ee Gobolka Laikipia waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay isticmaalaan shabaqa cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: CDC siemo ji kuom medo bedo gi tuo mar cyclosporiasis e County mar Laikipia kendo osiemo ji mondo oti gi net mar kute ma otigo gi yedhe makelo tuoche mag lum otieno gotieno.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages residents of Kilifi County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inaysan ku xanuunsadaan si aamusan oo ay ugu yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' Kilifi County mondo kik gisandre gi muol kendo mondo giluong simo mar thieth mar chuny maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises fish producers in Laikipia County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inashauri wazalishaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa soo-saareyaasha kalluunka ee Gobolka Laikipia inay ka iibsadaan wax soo saarka kaliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur ma loso rech e County mar Laikipia mondo ous olembe mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo rech kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: The Ministry will launch a comprehensive plan in a follow up to good reports by KNAP 2019 - 2022, to be in line with various branches, in a bid to strengthen climate resistant farming among youth
Kiswahili: Wizara itazindua mpango kamili katika ufuatiliaji wa ripoti nzuri za KNAP 2019 - 2022, ili kuendana na matawi mbalimbali, kwa lengo la kuimarisha kilimo kinachostahimili mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa miongoni mwa vijana.
Somali: Wasaaraddu waxay bilaabi doontaa qorshe dhammaystiran oo dabagal ku sameeya warbixinnada wanaagsan ee ka soo baxaya KNAP 2019 - 2022, si ay ula jaanqaado laamaha kala duwan, si loo xoojiyo beeraha u adkaysta cimilada ee dhalinyarada.
Dholuo: 2019 - 2022, biro chako chenro matut e luwo ripot mabeyo ma KNAP ogolo e higa mar 2019 - 2022, mondo obed e winjruok gi migepe mopogore opogore, e temo mar jiwo pur ma ok nyal geng’o piny e kind joma tindo .

English: Notice: DPP issues a cybersecurity alert on phishing messages affecting residents of Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya ujumbe wa udanganyifu unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay soo saartaa digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan fariimaha phishing ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Mandera.
Dholuo: Rapar: DPP ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity e wi ote mag phishing makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Mandera County.
