English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will conduct a greenhouse farming workshop for farmers in Kiambu County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itafanya warsha ya kilimo cha chafu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo ee beeraleyda degmada Kiambu bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Dairy Board biro timo chokruok mar timo yien e alwora mar Kiambu County e dwe mar Mach.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties updates residents of Bungoma County on progress of ward-level service delivery this July.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma juu ya maendeleo ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya Julai hii.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Bungoma ka warbixiyaa horumarka adeegga heerka degmada bisha July.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties olero ne jogweng'o mag Bungoma County dongruok mar chiwo kony e wi ward e dwe mar Julai.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development invites farmers in Nyandarua County to a free training on post-harvest handling this September.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kupata mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno Septemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku casuumaysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyandarua inay helaan tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan ka shaqeynta goosashada ka dib bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ogwelo jopur e County mar Nyandarua e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi kaka inyalo ting'o cham bang' keyo e dwe mar Septemba.

English: The KCSE Chemistry practical will be on November 7, 2025.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo ya KCSE Chemistry yatakuwa Novemba 7, 2025.
Somali: Waxbarashada KCSE Chemistry waxay dhici doontaa Nofeembar 7, 2025.
Dholuo: Tiegruok mar KCSE Chemistry biro timore Novemba 7, 2025.

English: As drought tightens its grip on Kenya, a motorcycle ambulance is helping women to access critical health care
Kiswahili: Huku ukame ukizidi kushika kasi nchini Kenya, ambulensi ya pikipiki inawasaidia wanawake kupata huduma muhimu za afya
Somali: Iyadoo abaartu ay sii adkeyneyso xaaladda Kenya, ambalaas mootooyin ah ayaa haweenka ka caawinaya inay helaan daryeel caafimaad oo muhiim ah.
Dholuo: Kaka oro medo mako piny Kenya, ambulens mar pikipiki konyo mon mondo oyud thieth mapek

English: KUCCPS conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Siaya County this October.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Siaya Oktoba hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay Oktoobarkan ka qabaneysaa barashada shacabka ee ku saabsan wareejinta degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: KUCCPS dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi wach golo pesa e sirkal mar Siaya e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Nandi County that access to post-violence medical care is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu zinapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ee ka dhacay degmada Nandi in helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ka dib rabshaduhu uu yahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu mag nindruok e county mar Nandi ni yudo kony mar thieth ma iyudo bang' timno onge chudo.

English: FAO promotes conservation tillage among farmers in Mombasa County as part of the November climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: FAO inakuza kilimo cha uhifadhi kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Novemba.
Somali: FAO waxay dhiirrigelisay beerashada ilaalinta beeraleyda degmada Mombasa iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka u adkeynta cimilada ee bisha Nofeembar.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo tij chwoyo kodhi e kind jopur e county mar Mombasa e dwe mar Novemba kaka achiel kuom chenro mag kedo gi lokruok e kit yamo.

English: Kenya Red Cross launches a September awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Septemba juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Sebtember oo ku saabsan baaritaanka sonkorowga ee Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Septemba e wi nonro mar thieth mar sukari e Kaunti duto mar Kakamega.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Marsabit County about the importance of food safety for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya umuhimu wa usalama wa chakula kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay dadka degmada Marsabit ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda badbaadada cuntada ay u leedahay caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa ji duto e county mar Marsabit gimomiyo rito chiemo en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free suicide prevention support is available through county health facilities in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kuzuia kujiua unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Shirkadda SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo ka hortagga ismiidaaminta laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Nakuru.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar geng'o ji kik donjre yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth e gweng' mar Nakuru.

English: CDC advises residents of Vihiga County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: CDC inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kuthibitisha kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: CDC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay xaqiijiyaan in xaruntoodu la aqoonsaday ka hor inta aysan booqan si ay u helaan daryeelka caafimaadka ee lacageed.
Dholuo: CDC nyiso jogweng' mar County mar Vihiga ni mondo ging'e ni kuondegi mag thieth oseyudo ratiro kapok gibiro mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development announces bursary allocation enrollment dates for schools in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa bursary kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Horumarinta Manhajka Kenya wuxuu ku dhawaaqay taariikhda diiwaangelinta deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee dugsiyada Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development olando tarik mag somo e skunde mag Wajir County.

English: Notice: DPP opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafungua dawati la jinsia kutoa simu ya msaada ya GBV bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay furtay xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ee Gobolka Samburu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: DPP ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo chenro mar konyo maonge chudo mar GBV e county mar Samburu.

English: NPS reminds the public in Embu County to remain vigilant on border security.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Embu kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Embu inay ka feejignaadaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: NPS parone ji duto e county mar Embu ni gibed motang' e weche mag rito tong'.

English: Cervical cancer is one of the most preventable and treatable cancers when detected early. This month, letâ€™s join hands to raise awareness, encourage regular screenings, and support initiatives for prevention and early diagnosis
Kiswahili: Kansa ya shingo ya uzazi ni mojawapo ya aina za kansa zinazoweza kuepukwa na kutibiwa zaidi wakati zinapogunduliwa mapema.
Somali: Kansarka ilmo-galeenka waa mid ka mid ah kansarrada ugu badan ee laga hortagi karo lana daaweyn karo marka hore la ogaado. Bishan, aan gacmaha is qabsanno si aan u wacyigelino, u dhiirigelino baaritaannada joogtada ah, iyo aan u taageerno dadaallada ka hortagga iyo ogaanshaha hore.
Dholuo: Kansa mar dhot mar dhako en achiel kuom kansa ma inyalo geng’o kendo thiedho ka fwenyre mapiyo. E dwe ni, we mondo wabed kanyakla mondo wabed gi ng'eyo, jiwo ji mondo otimnegi nonro kinde ka kinde, kendo konyo chenro mag geng'o tuoche kod ng'eyo tuoche mapiyo

English: Announcement of STEPS survey findings showing increased intake of fresh produce and physical activity among adults.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la matokeo ya uchunguzi wa STEPS kuonyesha ongezeko la ulaji wa bidhaa safi na shughuli za kimwili miongoni mwa watu wazima.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida natiijooyinka sahanka STEPS oo muujinaya in dadka waaweyn ay kordheen isticmaalka badeecadaha cusub iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa jirka.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova e piny mangima

English: Kenya Price Bulletin, November 2023
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Bei ya Kenya, Novemba 2023
Somali: Warbixinta Qiimaha Kenya, Noofambar 2023
Dholuo: Oboke mar nengo mag piny Kenya, dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2023

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Tana River County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on community-based development programmes.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Tana River wajihusishe na msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waendelee kuwa na habari juu ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River County inay la xiriiraan maamulaha degmada si ay uga warqabaan barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jotend buchegi mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi chenro mag dongruok mag oganda.

English: Kenya - Severe weather and floods, update (Meteo Kenya, media) (ECHO Daily Flash of 25 March 2026)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Hali ya hewa kali na mafuriko, sasisha (Meteo Kenya, vyombo vya habari) (ECHO Daily Flash ya 25 Machi 2026)
Somali: Kenya - Cimilo daran iyo daadad, warbixin cusub (Meteo Kenya, warbaahinta) (ECHO Daily Flash ee 25 Maarso 2026)
Dholuo: Kenya - Weche mag kor lwasi mager kod pi mopong'o piny, manyien (Meteo Kenya, lendo) (Rieny mar pile ka pile tarik 25 dwe mar adek higa mar 2026)

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Siaya County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya juu ya umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay dadka degmada Siaya ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay nadaafadda saxda ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji e county mar Siaya kuom ber mar rito ler mar ngima mar joot.

English: Notice: NPS issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa utambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ogaysiis: NPS waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan xadiidka aqoonsiga ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Nyamira.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NPS ogolo siem mar sirkal mar rito weche mag intanet kuom wach kuo mar ng'ato kuom joma odak e kaunti mar Nyamira.

English: KNEC encourages residents of Trans Nzoia County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka qeybgalaan munaasabadda dadweynaha ee degmada si ay uga warqabaan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jogweng' mar Trans Nzoia County mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county mondo ging'e tich mar Ombudsman.

English: Annoucing lauch of National roadmap for nutrition interventions at county and national levels.
Kiswahili: Kutangaza mpango wa kitaifa wa uingiliaji kati wa lishe katika ngazi za kaunti na kitaifa.
Somali: Soo bandhigida khariidadda waddooyinka qaranka ee tallaabooyinka nafaqada ee heer gobol iyo heer qaran.
Dholuo: Weche ma ne oland e wi chenro mar piny mangima mar chiwo kony e weche mag chiemo e gwenge mag gwenge koda e pinje mamoko.

English: KALRO promotes conservation tillage among farmers in Baringo County as part of the June climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: KALRO inakuza kilimo cha uhifadhi kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Baringo kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Juni.
Somali: KALRO waxay kor u qaadeysaa beerashada ilaalinta beeraleyda degmada Baringo iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Juun.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo puodho mar ritruok e kind jopur e County mar Baringo kaka achiel kuom chenro mar dwe mar Jun mar kedo gi lokruok e kor lwasi.

English: We encourage people to seek treatment at health care facilities once they experience any symptoms.  When you seek treatment early, you protect yourself against severe malaria.
Kiswahili: Tunatia moyo watu wapate matibabu katika vituo vya afya mara tu wanapopata dalili zozote. Unapotafuta matibabu mapema, unajilinda dhidi ya malaria kali.
Somali: Waxaan dadka ku dhiirigelinaynaa inay daryeel caafimaad ka raadsadaan marka ay soo muuqdaan calaamado.
Dholuo: Wamiyo ji thuolo mar yudo thieth e ute thieth ka giseyudo tuwono.

English: COMESA informs coffee farmers in Kiambu County of new market linkage opportunities this September.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawafahamisha wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Septemba hii.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Kiambu fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: COMESA nyiso jopur mag chai e County mar Kiambu thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Septemba.

English: We must observe social distancing requirement, wash hands regularly, and stay at home, and only go out when absolutely necessary. Whenever out in a public place, one must wear the face mask. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Ni lazima tuzingatie mahitaji ya umbali wa kijamii, kunawa mikono mara kwa mara, na kukaa nyumbani, na kwenda nje inapobidi tu. Wakati wowote nje mahali pa umma, mtu lazima avae kinyago cha uso. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Waa inaan raacnaa shuruudaha kala fogaanshaha bulshada, aan si joogto ah gacmaha u dhaqno, oo aan guriga joogno, oo aan dibadda u baxno marka ay lagama maarmaan noqoto oo keliya. Markasta oo aan ka baxno meel dadweyne ah, waa in qofku xidhaa maaskaro wejiga. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Nyaka waluw chik mar bedo mabor gi jowetewa, lwoko lwedo kinde ka kinde, kendo wabed e ot, kendo wuok oko mana ka dwarore ahinya. Kinde duto ma ng’ato wuok oko e kama ji mang’eny romoe, nyaka orwak mask mar wang’. #KomeshaKorona

English: NCPB advises maize producers in Busia County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inashauri wazalishaji wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Busia kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: NCPB waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha hadhuudhka ee degmada Busia inay ka iibsadaan wax soo saarka kaliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: NCPB nyiso jopur mag cham e county mar Busia ni giusgi mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo cham kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Notice: FAO will conduct a pest and disease management workshop for farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itafanya warsha ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada beeraleyda ee Degmada Tharaka-Nithi bisha May.
Dholuo: Nonro: FAO biro timo chokruok mar rieyo tuoche kod tuoche ne jopur e Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar Mei.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public that free youth mental wellness support is available through county health facilities in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa ustawi wa akili wa vijana unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Garissa.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar pach rowere yudore maonge chudo kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e County mar Garissa.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya opens a new service point for national ID applications in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay ka furtay barta adeegga cusub ee codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Meru.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Huduma Kenya oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag kwayo nying' mar ng'ato e boma mar Meru County.

English: Kenya: Registered refugees and asylum-seekers (as of 31 August 2022)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Wakimbizi waliosajiliwa na wanaotafuta hifadhi (kuanzia tarehe 31 Agosti 2022)
Somali: Kenya: Qaxootiga diiwaangashan iyo kuwa magangalyo doonka ah (laga bilaabo 31 Agoosto 2022)
Dholuo: Kenya: Jolweny mondiki nyinggi kod jogo madwaro dak (chakre tarik 31 dwe mar aboro higa mar 2022)

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Embu County this April. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari Kenya kitafanya kongamano la kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Embu Aprili hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka soo kabashada isticmaalka maandooriyaha ee degmada Embu bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni Kenya Medical Association biro timo romo mar chango joma otiyo marach gi yedhe mamero e taon mar Embu e dwe mar April.

English: Tana River County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tana River: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Aprili 2024
Somali: Degmada Tana River: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Aora Tana: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Ang'wen 2024

English: NCPB advises farmers in Kajiado County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kajiado inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kalfadhiga tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e Kajiado County mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e tiego jopur mabiro.

English: OGP reminds voters in Tharaka-Nithi County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: OGP inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: OGP parone jogedo e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oting'e ID mar piny kata passport e odiechieng' mar yiero kapok kinde mar yiero ochopo.

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will host a free food safety outreach in Kisii County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa usalama wa chakula bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Kisii Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa soo qabanqaabi doonta dadaal bilaash ah oo ku saabsan badbaadada cuntada ee degmada Kisii bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo kampen mar rito ngima mar chiemo maonge chudo e County mar Kisii e dwe mar Januar.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Meru County that access to the GBV toll-free helpline is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Meru kwamba upatikanaji wa simu ya GBV ya bure ya msaada unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ee ka dhacay degmada Meru in helitaanka khadka caawimaadda ee GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah uu yahay mid lacag-la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Meru ni gibiro yudo kony ma onge chudo mar GBV maonge chudo.

English: DPP reminds residents of Embu County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada daadadka ka dhacay xilligan shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: DPP oparo ne jogweng' Embu County ni kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o e kinde masiche mag ndara.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit announces free medical camps for residents of Kwale County starting this June.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinatangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kuanzia Juni hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa ku dhawaaqday xeryo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Kwale laga bilaabo Juun.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ogolo kambi mag thieth ma onge chudo ne jogweng' Kwale County kochakore dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice from CDC: skilled birth attendance clinics will run every November at designated health centres in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa CDC: kliniki za mahudhurio ya uzazi zenye ujuzi zitaendeshwa kila Novemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid CDC: rugta caafimaad ee dhalashada xirfadlayaasha ah ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Nofeembar kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Meru.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar yedhe (CDC): kuonde thieth mag nyuol ma nigi lony biro timore e dwe mar Novemba higa ka higa e ute thieth moyier e county mar Meru.

English: Delayed. Denied: Legal and Administrative Bottlenecks to Effective and Efficient Delivery of Justice for Survivors of SGBV in Kenya
Kiswahili: Imechelewa. Imekataliwa: Vizuizi vya Kisheria na Kitawala kwa Utoaji Haki Ufanisi na Bora kwa Waathiriwa wa SGBV nchini Kenya.

Kiswahili: Kenya: Taarifa ya Pamoja kuhusu Maandamano ya Kitaifa

Dholuo: Kenya: Wach ma Riwre e wi Nyimbe mag Piny Duto

English: Kenya Medical Association launches an August awareness campaign on food safety across Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kizindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Agosti kuhusu usalama wa chakula katika Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu bilaabay olole wacyi galineed bishii Agoosto oo ku saabsan badbaadada cuntada ee Gobolka Kajiado.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Agost e wi wach rito ngima mar chiemo e Kajiado County.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the community in Migori County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb burglary.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Migori kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada Degmada Migori inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo oganda manie County mar Migori mondo oriwre gi chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o mibadhi.

English: NPS calls on the community in Trans Nzoia County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaita jamii katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Somali: NPS waxay bulshada degmada Trans Nzoia ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan waxayna taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: NPS okwayo oganda man Trans Nzoia County mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Kisumu County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Utafiti wa Uhalifu inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu juu ya kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ka digaya dadka deggan degmada Kisumu kororka qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah wuxuuna ku talinayaa shacabka inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar Kisumu County e wi medruok mar chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges sheep farmers in Busia County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported rabies cases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wafugaji wa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Busia kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa kufuatia visa vya kichaa cha mbwa vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda idaha ee degmada Busia inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo ka dib kiisaska xanaaqa la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur mag rombe e county mar Busia mondo ogeng'e legi e kuonde moyier mag ywayo rombe bang' yudo weche mag rabies.

English: Announcement of AI-based nutrition and wellness advice service tailored for elderly citizens and caregivers.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la huduma ya ushauri wa lishe na ustawi inayotegemea akili bandia iliyoundwa kwa ajili ya wazee na walezi.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida adeegga la talinta nafaqada iyo caafimaadka ee ku saleysan AI oo loogu talagalay muwaadiniinta waayeelka ah iyo daryeelayaasha.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar riwruok mar oganda Jehova mar Joneno mag Jehova biro timo chenro mar konyo joma oti kod jogo makonyogi.

English: State Department for TVET urges parents and teachers in Makueni County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Makueni kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Makueni inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e county mar Makueni mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya opens a gender desk offering free legal aid in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisheria bure katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Maamulka Isgaarsiinta Kenya wuxuu furayaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah Degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji ochako ofis ma chiwo kony ma onge chudo e wi weche mag chike e county mar Vihiga.

English: Always boil and cool the water, which you use to prepare for the child's food to prevent diseases.
Kiswahili: Daima chemsha maji na kuyafanya baridi, ambayo unatumia kutayarisha chakula cha mtoto ili kuzuia magonjwa.
Somali: Biyaha had iyo jeer ku kari oo qabooji, kaas oo aad u isticmaasho si aad u diyaargarowdo cuntada ilmaha si looga hortago cudurrada.
Dholuo: Kinde duto ting' pi mondo opong' kendo orie pi, ma itiyogo e loso chiemb nyathi mondo kik obed gi tuoche.

Kiswahili: Serikali ina uwezo wa kusaidia viwanda vidogo kuzalisha kwa ushindani kufikia masoko ya diaspora.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay awood u leedahay inay ka caawiso warshadaha yaryar inay soo saaraan si tartan rasmi ah si ay u gaaraan suuqyada kala duwanaanshaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal nigi nyalo mar konyo ohala matindo tindo mondo otim gik moko e yo makelo piem mondo giyud ohala e pinje mopogore opogore.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Makueni County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni watumie portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ili kupambana na matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago xadgudubka xilka.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng' Makueni County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo ng'ur mar kedo gi tiyo marach gi migepe.

English: Kenya Forest Service warns residents of Bomet County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ka digay dadka deggan degmada Bomet oo ku saabsan kororka khiyaamada SIM-swap wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service osiemo jogweng'o mag Bomet County kuom wach medruok mar mibadhi mar SIM swap kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: Notice from SHA (Social Health Authority): postnatal check-ups clinics will run every November at designated health centres in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii): kliniki za uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa zitafanya kazi kila Novemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada): Xarumaha baaritaanka dhalmada ka dib waxaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Nofeembar ee kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Rieko moa kuom SHA (Social Health Authority): klinik mag nonro bang' nyuol ibiro timie higa ka higa e dwe mar Novemba e kuonde thieth moyier e Kaunti mar Wajir.

English: Notice from CDC: family planning counselling clinics will run every August at designated health centres in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa CDC: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Agosti katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid CDC: rugta la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ayaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Agoosto oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar yedhe ma thiedho tuoche (CDC): klinik mag chiwo paro e wi chenro mag ngima joot biro tiyo e dwe mar Agost higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Kericho.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will open a coffee collection centre in Makueni County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itafungua kituo cha kukusanya kahawa katika Kaunti ya Makueni Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu bilaabi doonaa xarun ururinta kafeega ee degmada Makueni bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Komiti mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro yawo ot mar choko chai e gweng' mar Makueni e dwe mar Januar.

English: Regional Bureau for Eastern and Southern Africa | EAC region Population of concern to UNHCR - 31 March 2026
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Kanda ya Mashariki na Kusini mwa Afrika | Eneo la EAC Idadi ya watu inayotia wasiwasi UNHCR - 31 Machi 2026
Somali: Xafiiska Gobolka ee Bariga iyo Koonfurta Afrika | Gobolka EAC Dadka ka walaacsan UNHCR - 31 Maarso 2026
Dholuo: Ofis mar Riwruok mar Afrika ma Wuokchieng’ kod ma Nyanduat | Oganda ma UNHCR oting'o luoro - 31 dwe mar adek higa mar 2026

English: Kenya - Key Message Update: Drought recovery from previous above-average seasons cushions households during the lean season, September 2024
Kiswahili: Kenya - Taarifa Muhimu ya Ujumbe: Ahueni ya ukame kutoka kwa misimu ya hapo juu ya wastani huzuia kaya wakati wa msimu wa baridi, Septemba 2024
Somali: Kenya - Cusboonaysiinta Fariinta Muhiimka ah: Soo kabashada abaarta ee xilliyadii hore ee celceliska ka sarreeyay ayaa qoysaska u fududaynaysa xilliga caatada ah, Sebtembar 2024
Dholuo: Kenya - Oda Maduong’: Dongruok mar oro kowuok e kinde mokalo ma malo moloyo ma pile miyo udi bedo gi mor e kinde mag oro, dwe mar apar gi ariyo 2024

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges farmers in Nyamira County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kupitisha miundo ya uvunaji maji katika mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyamira inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo soo-saarka biyaha ee beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan qaababka roobka ee isbeddelaya.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur e County mar Nyamira mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission jiwo jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud somo mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: Building harmony: Rozina Junior School's practical approach to peacebuilding
Kiswahili: Kujenga maelewano: Mbinu ya vitendo ya Shule ya Rozina Junior katika ujenzi wa amani
Somali: Dhisidda is-waafajinta: Habka wax ku oolka ah ee Dugsiga Hoose ee Rozina ee dhismaha nabadda
Dholuo: Keto winjruok: Yo matiyo maber ma Skul Matin mar Rozina tiyogo mar gero kuwe

English: Universities Fund urges youth in Kiambu County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku boorinayaa dhalinyarada degmada Kiambu inay ka qeybgalaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo rowere e County mar Kiambu mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gitimo gik ma biro timore ne oganda.

English: A Kenyan court sentenced two men to thirty years for assisting al Shabaab in the 2019 DusitD2 attack.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya iliwahukumu wanaume wawili kifungo cha miaka 30 kwa kusaidia Al Shabaab katika mashambulizi ya DusitD2 ya 2019.
Somali: Maxkamad ku taal Kenya ayaa xukuntay laba nin soddon sano oo xabsi ah iyagoo ka caawiyay Al Shabaab weerarkii DusitD2 ee 2019.
Dholuo: Kot moro mar Kenya nong'ado ne ji ariyo buch tuech mar higini piero adek nikech ne gikonyo Al Shabaab e lweny mar DusitD2 e higa mar 2019.

English: Livelihoods, Resilience & Migration In the Context of Slow Onset Climate Change in the IGAD Region, Case Study of the Karamoja-Turkana Cross Border Area
Kiswahili: Riziki, Ustahimilivu na Uhamiaji Katika Muktadha wa Mabadiliko ya Hali ya Hewa ya Kuanza Polepole katika Mkoa wa IGAD, Uchunguzi Kifani wa Eneo la Mpakani la Karamoja-Turkana.
Somali: Nolol-maalmeed, Adkeysi & Tahriibin Marka la eego Isbeddelka Cimilada ee Gobolka IGAD oo si gaabis ah u bilaabmay, Daraasad Kiis ah oo ku saabsan Aagga Xuduudaha ee Karamoja-Turkana
Dholuo: Gik ma ng’ato nyalo timo mondo odagi, ng’ato nyalo ng’ado bura kendo owuok e pinje mamoko e piny ma ng’ato nyalo ng’iyogo gik moko e alwora mar IGAD.

English: NCPB warns beans farmers in Kisii County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawaonya wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Kisii juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: NCPB waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda ku nool degmada Kisii cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: NCPB chiwo siem ne jopur mag nyinyo e County mar Kisii kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: KUCCPS calls on the community in Kericho County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Kericho kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Kericho inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban si loo ilaaliyo nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: KUCCPS luongo oganda ma Kericho County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Kenya Red Cross launches a July awareness campaign on hand hygiene across Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Julai juu ya usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii July oo ku saabsan nadaafadda gacmaha ee Gobolka Samburu.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Julai e wi ler mar lwete e gweng' mar Samburu.

English: OGP urges residents of Machakos County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia wavuti ya kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan bixinta adeegyada heerka degmooyinka.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogweng'o mag Machakos County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono ka gitiyo gi websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche ma timore e wi tij lendo.

Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii): kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Julai katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.

Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, njaa ya wastani na ulaji wa chakula wa mipakani unaendelea, jambo linaloashiria kuendelea kuwepo kwa changamoto za usalama wa chakula kwa baadhi ya kaya.
Somali: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, gaajo dhexdhexaad ah iyo cunista cuntada ee xadka leh ayaa weli jirta, taasoo muujinaysa caqabado sii socda oo ku saabsan sugnaanta cuntada ee qoysaska qaar.

English: Ministry of Health launches an August awareness campaign on tobacco control across Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Agosti juu ya udhibiti wa tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Agoosto ee ka dhanka ah xakamaynta sigaarka gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health ochako kampen mar miyo ji ng'eyo e dwe mar Agost e wi thieth mar ndawa e County duto mar Lamu.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General will hold a public participation forum on development planning forums in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta ee degmada Mombasa.

English: NCPB urges farmers in Murang'a County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.

Dholuo: Kaunti mar Nyeri (Kieni): Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Julaini 2024

English: NTSA reminds residents of Narok County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kusakinisha na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi wakati wa msimu huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Narok inay guryahooda ku rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo shaqada inta lagu jiro xilliyada dhulgariirada.
Dholuo: NTSA parone jogweng' Narok County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo giti e kinde mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: Notice: DPP opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa marejeleo salama makazi katika Trans Nzoia County.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay fureysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya tixraacyo magangelyo ammaan ah oo ku yaal degmada Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DPP ochako ofis ma wuoyo e wi weche mag nindruok ma chiwo kuonde dak ma onge tuoche e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia.

English: Kenya Medical Association launches an August awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kizindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Agosti juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu bilaabay olole wacyi galineed bishii Agoosto oo ku saabsan wacyiga cadaadiska sare ee degmada Makueni.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Agost e wi wach remo mang'eny e gweng' mar Makueni.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges coffee growers in Samburu County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Samburu kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda kafeega ee Gobolka Samburu inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobka si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur ma pidho chai e county mar Samburu mondo oti gi ratiro mar chamo yien kapok koth ochue mondo okony e medo nyak mar yien e higani.

English: Teachers Service Commission announces distribution of revision guides to schools in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this January.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inatangaza usambazaji wa miongozo ya marekebisho kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Januari hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa ku dhawaaqay in lagu qeybinayo hagaha dib u eegista dugsiyada degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission ong'ado mar pogo buge mag somo e skunde man Elgeyo-Marakwet County e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education reminds citizens in Trans Nzoia County about their rights regarding the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuhusu haki zao kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Trans Nzoia ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State Department for Basic Education parone raia mag Trans Nzoia County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo ombudsman.

English: Provide agricultural extension services on proper grain handling and storage.
Kiswahili: Toa huduma za ugani wa kilimo juu ya utunzaji na uhifadhi sahihi wa nafaka.
Somali: Bixinta adeegyada ballaarinta beeraha ee ku saabsan maaraynta iyo kaydinta hadhuudhka si sax ah.
Dholuo: Chiw tije mag loso kod kano cham e yo makare.

English: FAO reminds livestock keepers in Marsabit County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Marsabit inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanada buka xafiiska xayawaanka ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: FAO parone jopur mag jamni e gweng' mar Marsabit ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni kodgi mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: Teachers Service Commission invites youth in Siaya County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this July.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Siaya kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Julai hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa ku casuumay dhalinyarada degmada Siaya inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj gwelo rowere e county mar Siaya mondo odonj e tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing e dwe mar Julai.

English: SHA reminds the public in Kiambu County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kiambu in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: SHA parone ji duto e County mar Kiambu ni chiwo ripot mar kawo asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge chudo, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: East Africa Seasonal Monitor: Increasing flood risk with forecasted above-average rains in parts of the northern sector (June 30, 2024)
Kiswahili: Ufuatiliaji wa Msimu wa Afrika Mashariki: Kuongezeka kwa hatari ya mafuriko kwa kutabiriwa kwa mvua za juu ya wastani katika sehemu za sekta ya kaskazini (Juni 30, 2024)
Somali: Kormeeraha Xilliyeedka Bariga Afrika: Khatarta fatahaadda oo sii kordheysa iyadoo la saadaalinayo roobab ka sarreeya celceliska qaybo ka mid ah qaybta waqooyi (Juun 30, 2024)
Dholuo: Rang'o Kinde mag Afrika ma Wuokchieng': Medo luoro mar pi mang'eny ka geno ni koth biro chwe moloyo pile e kuonde moko mag sektor ma nyandwat (30 dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2024)

English: Parents guide Grade 6 transition after KPSEA.
Kiswahili: Wazazi huongoza darasa la 6 baada ya KPSEA.
Somali: Waalidiintu waxay ku hagaajinayaan tallaabada fasalka 6 ka dib KPSEA.
Dholuo: Jonyuol tayo nyithindo e klas mar 6 bang' KPSEA.

English: KALRO reminds livestock keepers in Uasin Gishu County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KALRO waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Uasin Gishu inay xoolahooda tallaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KALRO parone jopur mag jamni e county mar Uasin Gishu ni gimi jamnigi thieth e kuonde moyier mag nego jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health warns of increased measles risk in Wajir County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya surua katika Kaunti ya Wajir na inashauri umma kutumia vyandarua vya mbu vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ka digtay kororka halista ah ee suuxdinta ee Gobolka Wajir waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay isticmaalaan shabaqa cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar oganda: Ministry of Health osiemo ji kuom medruok mar tuo mar masal e County mar Wajir kendo ojiwo ji mondo oti gi net mag kute ma otigo gi yedhe makelo tuoche.

English: Notice: KNEC announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ee dugsiyada degmada Migori.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KNEC olando tarik mag somo e skunde mag Migori County.

English: For now, let us not open bars, and also observe social distancing. KCPE and KCSE is not a ticket to heaven.
Kiswahili: Kwa sasa, hebu tusifungue baa, na pia tuzingatie umbali wa kijamii. KCPE na KCSE sio tiketi ya mbinguni.
Somali: Hadda, aan ka furno baararka, oo aan sidoo kale ilaalino masaafada bulshada. KCPE iyo KCSE ma aha tigidhka jannada.
Dholuo: Kuom sani, weuru waik bar, kendo watang' gi ji duto. KCPE kod KCSE ok en kar dhi e polo.

English: Notice: AFA will train farmers in Meru County on conservation tillage this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru juu ya kilimo cha uhifadhi Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Meru ee ku saabsan beerashada ilaalinta bisha November.
Dholuo: Rapar: AFA biro tiego jopur e kaunti mar Meru e wi puodho mar ritruok e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Households in droughtâ€‘affected Wajir, Mandera and Tana River counties are of particular concern.
Kiswahili: Kaya katika kaunti zilizoathiriwa na ukame za Wajir, Mandera na Tana River zina wasiwasi mkubwa.
Somali: Qoysaska ku nool degmooyinka Wajeer, Mandheera iyo Tana River ee ay abaartu saameysay ayaa walaac gaar ah leh.
Dholuo: Jo ot ma ni e gwenge mag Wajir, Mandera kod aora Tana ma oyudo pek mag oro gin jogo ma nigi parruok ahinya.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will distribute certified cassava seed to farmers in Migori County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itasambaza mbegu za mihogo zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu abuurka cassava ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doonaa beeraleyda Degmada Migori bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro pogo kodhi mag maniva ne jopur mag Migori County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Kenya: Cholera Outbreak - Operational update (MDRKE054)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Mlipuko wa Kipindupindu - Usasishaji wa Uendeshaji (MDRKE054)
Somali: Kenya: Cudurka Daacuunka oo ka dilaacay - Cusboonaysiinta Hawlgalka (MDRKE054)
Dholuo: Kenya: Tuwo mar Kolera - Losi mar tije (MDRKE054)

English: Pregnant women should eat small meals several times a day to manage nausea and maintain energy levels.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanapaswa kula milo midogo mara kadhaa kwa siku ili kudhibiti kichefuchefu na kudumisha viwango vya nishati.
Somali: Dumarka uurka leh waa inay cunaan cunto yar yar dhowr jeer maalintii si ay ula qabsadaan caloolxumada oo ay u ilaaliyaan heerarka tamarta.
Dholuo: Mon ma nigi ich onego ocham chiemo matindo tindo nyading'eny odiechieng' kodiechieng' mondo ginyagre gi ich wang' kendo gisik ka gin gi teko.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages residents of Kisii County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay uga qayb galaan kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ojiwo jogweng' Kisii County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro ne oganda maonge chudo.

English: Agriculture has been used as an important instrument in eradicating hunger, poverty, and all forms of malnutrition. Climate change however is expected to act as ...
Kiswahili: Kilimo kimetumika kama chombo muhimu katika kutokomeza njaa, umaskini, na aina zote za utapiamlo. Mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa hata hivyo yanatarajiwa kufanya kama ...
Somali: Beeraha waxaa loo adeegsaday qalab muhiim ah oo lagu baabi'iyo gaajada, saboolnimada, iyo dhammaan noocyada nafaqo-xumada. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, isbeddelka cimilada waxaa la filayaa inuu u shaqeeyo ...
Dholuo: Tij pur osetiyo gi yore mang'eny e tieko kech, dhier, kod kit chiemo duto ma ok mor. Kata kamano, lokruok mar lokruok mar piny biro kelo lokruok maduong' e yo ma...

English: Although pyrethrum is quite poisonous when freshly harvested, it breaks down very quickly when exposed to the sun; after a few days there will be no poisonous compounds left and the produce will be safe to eat, though waiting one week is recommended to be absolutely sure.
Kiswahili: Ingawa pyrethrum ni sumu kabisa inapovunwa hivi karibuni, huvunjika haraka sana inapofunuliwa na jua; Baada ya siku chache hakutakuwa na misombo yenye sumu iliyobaki na mazao yatakuwa salama kuliwa, ingawa kusubiri wiki moja kunapendekezwa kuwa na uhakika kabisa.
Somali: Inkastoo pyrethrum uu sun badan yahay marka si cusub loo goosto, haddana si dhaqso ah ayuu u burburaa marka qorraxda la taago; Maalmo yar kadib wax walxo sun ah ma jiri doonaan, khudaartuna waa ammaan in la cuno, inkastoo la sugayo hal usbuuc si aad si buuxda u hubto.
Dholuo: Kata obedo ni pyrethrum en gima nigi sum ahinya sama ogoye manyien, okethore mapiyo ahinya sama chieng' oyang'e; bang' ndalo matin, ok bi bedo gi sum moro amora kendo cham biro bedo maber, kata kamano, ber ka ng'ato rito juma achiel mondo obed gadier chuth.

English: Embu (Mbeere) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Embu (Mbeere): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Aprili 2023
Somali: Degmada Embu (Mbeere): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Embu (Mbeere): Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Ang'wen higa mar 2023

English: Wajir County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Wajir: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Juni 2024
Somali: Degmada Wajeer: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Wajir: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2024

English: Good yields have been noticed with mixing maize and desmodium for introducing shades, the push-pull approach.
Kiswahili: Tokeo nzuri limeonekana kwa kuchanganya mahindi na desmodium kwa ajili ya kuanzisha vivuli, mbinu push-pull.
Somali: Wax-soo-saarka wanaagsan ayaa la arkay marka la isku daro galley iyo desmodium si loo soo bandhigo shades, habka push-pull.
Dholuo: Osekonyore gi choko cham gi desmodium e loso rangi ma ne nyalo miyo ng'ato ogol cham.

English: NDMA calls on the community in Mandera County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Mandera kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu ya simu ya GBV 1195.
Somali: NDMA waxay bulshada degmada Mandera ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wici doonaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: NDMA okwayo oganda man Mandera County mondo owuo e wi timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo oluong simo mar GBV 1195.

English: IEBC warns public officers in Kilifi County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: IEBC inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Wilaya ya Kilifi dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: IEBC waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Kilifi inay musuqmaasuqa ka qaadaan xafiisyada dowladda.
Dholuo: IEBC chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e gweng' mar Kilifi kuom kawo asoya e migepe mar sirkal.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya calls on the community in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan isla markaana ay taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow ee aaminka ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji luongo joma odak e gweng' mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gidwar kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Kilifi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kilifi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2023
Somali: Degmada Kilifi: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kilifi: Oboke machon mar oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2023

English: KTDA announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Uasin Gishu County this January.
Kiswahili: KTDA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Januari hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo cudurka Newcastle ah oo loogu talagalay lo'da caanaha ah ee Gobolka Uasin Gishu bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: KTDA olando chenro mar thieth mar tuo mar Newcastle maonge chudo ne dhok mag yien e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu e dwe mar Januar.

English: Principal Secretary for Public Health and Professionals Standards, Mary Muthoni, urges the county government to ensure that the programs and activities implemented by the ministry reach the common mwananchi. She specifically singles out the Community Health Volunteers, who act as the primary household referral persons. She highlights their training and kitting, enabling them to effectively address preventive health issues.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu wa Afya ya Umma na Viwango vya Wataalamu, Mary Muthoni, anawahimiza serikali ya kaunti kuhakikisha kuwa mipango na shughuli zinazotekelezwa na wizara hufikia mwananchi wa kawaida.
Somali: Xoghayaha Guud ee Caafimaadka Dadweynaha iyo Heerka Xirfadlayaasha, Mary Muthoni, waxay ku boorineysaa dowladda gobolka inay hubiso in barnaamijyada iyo howlaha ay wasaaraddu hirgeliso ay gaaraan muwaadiniinta caadiga ah. Waxay si gaar ah u soo bandhigtaa mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada, kuwaas oo u dhaqma sidii dadka ugu horreeya ee loo gudbiyo guryaha. Waxay iftiiminaysaa tababarkooda iyo xirfadooda, taasoo awood u siinaysa inay si wax ku ool ah
Dholuo: Jatelo maduong' mar weche thieth mar oganda kod chike mag joma olony, Mary Muthoni, jiwo sirkal mar county mondo one ni program kod tije mitimo gi migao chopo e ngima mar mwananchi.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development opens a new welding and fabrication programme at the vocational centre in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yafungua programu mpya ya kulehemu na utengenezaji katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ka furayaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan alxanka iyo soo saarista xarunta xirfadaha ee Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ochako chenro manyien mar loso kendo loso gik moko e otas mar tiegruok e gweng' mar Kakamega.

English: NCPB announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for cattle in Homa Bay County this February.
Kiswahili: NCPB inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Februari hii.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee lo'da ee gobolka Homa Bay bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: NCPB ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar dhoot e Homa Bay County e dwe mar Februar.

English: By minding all those near you, it will be easier to safe your life. It is good pratice to have this in mind for your mental health, your wok place and those working with you. Mental disease does not choose or discriminate who to ttack. Where you work, take care of your mental health to enable you be productive and your hapiness at large.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwajali wale wote walio karibu nawe, itakuwa rahisi zaidi kulinda maisha yako. Ni mazoea mazuri kuwa na hili akilini kwa ajili ya afya yako ya akili, mahali pako pa kazi na wale wanaofanya kazi pamoja nawe. Ugonjwa wa akili hauwezi kuchagua au kutofautisha ni nani atakayemshambulia.
Somali: Markaad daryeesho dhammaan kuwa kugu dhow, way kuu fududaan doontaa inaad badbaadisid noloshaada. Waa dhaqan wanaagsan inaad tan maskaxda ku haysato caafimaadkaaga maskaxda, goobtaada shaqada iyo kuwa kula shaqeeya. Cudurrada maskaxda ma doortaan ama ma kala saaraan cidda aad ku dhufanayso. Meesha aad shaqeyneyso, daryeel caafimaadkaaga maskaxda si aad u noqotid mid wax soo saar leh iyo farxad guud ahaan.
Dholuo: Kuom paro jogo duto ma ni machiegni kodi, biro bedo mayot rito ngimani. En tim maber keto wachni e paro ne ngimani mar paro, kama itiye, koda jogo matiyo kodi. Tuoche mag paro ok yier kata pogo ng'ato gi ng'at monego omonj. Kama itiyoe, rit ngima mari mar paro mondo omi ibed gi nyak kendo ibed ma mor e okang' malach.

English: Government sponsors 95,000 students under affirmative action for marginalized areas.
Kiswahili: Serikali inawaunga mkono wanafunzi 95,000 chini ya hatua ya kuunga mkono maeneo yaliyoachwa kando.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay taageertaa 95,000 oo arday oo ku jira tallaabooyin xaqiijin ah oo loogu talagalay meelaha marginalized.
Dholuo: Sirkal chiwo kony ne jopuonjre 95,000 e alwora ma ji odakie.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health: postnatal check-ups clinics will run every October at designated health centres in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya: kliniki za uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa zitafanya kazi kila Oktoba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka: Xarumaha baaritaanka dhalmada kadib waxaa lagu qaban doonaa Oktoobar kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee lagu magacaabo degmada Nairobi.

Dholuo: WSWS ne ogolo weche matut kuom chokruok mar ji mang'eny bang' tho mar jandik-blog moro ma ne otho e od ang'ech, ma ne oting'o gas ma kelo pi wang', gik ma kelo pi, mako, kod ng'anjo mar jopuonj.

English: No room for corruption or laziness, _x009d_ CS Geoffrey Ruku has urged all public servants to uphold professionalism, report to work on time, and treat Kenyans with dignity and respect.
Kiswahili: Hakuna nafasi ya ufisadi au uvivu, " CS Geoffrey Ruku amewahimiza watumishi wote wa umma kudumisha utaalamu, kutoa ripoti kwa wakati, na kuwatendea Wakenya kwa heshima na heshima.
Somali: Ma jirto meel loogu talagalay musuqmaasuq ama caajisnimo, _x009d_ CS Geoffrey Ruku wuxuu ku boorriyay dhammaan shaqaalaha dowladda inay ilaaliyaan xirfadda, ay shaqada ku soo wargeliyaan waqtigii loogu talagalay, oo ay ula dhaqmaan dadka Kenya si sharaf iyo ixtiraam leh.
Dholuo: Onge kama ng’ato nyalo yudoe ng’anjo kata ng’anjo, CS Geoffrey Ruku osejiwo jotich duto mag sirkal mondo orit ng’eyo malong’o, ogol ripot e tich e kinde, kendo otim ne jo Kenya gi luor kod luor.

English: Kenya Forest Service warns residents of Kwale County to prepare for possible flooding this August.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kujiandaa kwa mafuriko yanayoweza kutokea Agosti hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ka digay dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay isu diyaariyaan fatahaadaha suurtagalka ah bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kwale County mondo giikre ne ataro manyalo timore e dwe mar Agost.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Kajiado County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa msaada wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow si ay uga caawiyaan helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ee lacageed.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni mondo giyud kony mar yudo kony kuom weche thieth.

English: Agriculture is the backbone of KenyaÃ¢â‚¬â„¢s economy,contributing to over 25%of the countryÃ¢â‚¬â„¢s Gross Domestic Product (GDP). Agriculture employs over 70% of the countryÃ¢â‚¬â„¢s workforce and plays a crucial role in the livelihoods of many Kenyans. Sustainable agriculture is an approach that can address these challenges, ensure food security and promote economic growth.
Kiswahili: Kilimo ni kipande cha nyuma cha uchumi wa Kenya, na kuchangia zaidi ya 25% ya bidhaa ya ndani ya nchi (GDP). Kilimo kinaajiri zaidi ya 70% ya nguvu za kazi za nchi na ina jukumu muhimu katika maisha ya Wakenya wengi. Walakini, mazoea yasiyo endelevu ya kilimo yamesababisha uharibifu wa ardhi, mavuno ya chini ya mazao, na kutokuwa na usalama wa chakula. Kilimo endelevu ni mbinu ambayo inaweza kushughulikia changamoto hizi, kuhakikisha usalama wa chakula na kukuza ukuaji wa kiuchumi.
Somali: Beeraha waa laf-dhabarta dhaqaalaha Kenya, taasoo gacan ka geysanaysa in ka badan 25% wax soo saarka guud ee gudaha dalka (GDP). Beeraha waxaa ka shaqeeya in ka badan 70% shaqaalaha dalka waxayna door muhiim ah ka ciyaaraan nolosha dad badan oo Kenyan ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, dhaqamada beeraha ee aan waara waxay keeneen burburka dhulka, wax soo saarka dalagga oo hooseeya, iyo amni-darrada cuntada. Beeraha waara waa hab wax ka qaban kara caqabadahan, hubin kara amniga cuntada iyo kor u qaadi kara kobaca dhaqaalaha.
Dholuo: Pur en ng’injo maduong’ e weche mag yuto mwandu mag piny Kenya, kendo okonyo gi kwan mokalo 25% mar mwandu duto ma pinyno yudo (GDP). mar jo Kenya mang’eny Kata kamano, yore mag pur ma ok nyal rito piny osemiyo piny odok piny, ng’eny cham osekethore, kendo onge chiemo ma nyalo rito piny en yo ma nyalo geng’o pek ma kamago, neno ni chiemo nitie kendo konyo e dongruok mar weche yuto.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Vihiga County that access to free medical camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za matibabu bila malipo sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya dadweynaha degmada Vihiga in helitaanka xeryaha caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha loo qoondeeyay.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji duto e County mar Vihiga ni koro ginyalo yudo kuonde thieth maonge chudo e kuonde moyier.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kwale County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Kwale apeleke simu ya simu ya GBV 1195.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Kwale inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e Kaunti mar Kwale mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195 maonge chudo.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Medical Association will be held in Kitui County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu bila malipo iliyoandaliwa na Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kitui Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Degmada Kitui bisha April.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma Kenya Medical Association ochano ibiro tim e County mar Kitui e dwe mar April.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Narok County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this drought season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati huu wa ukame.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Narok inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada fatahaada ah xilligan abaarta.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne jogweng' Narok County ni kik giwuoth e kind yiengni mag oro kod akuru ma pi opong'o.

English: Research has shown that empowering women in food agricultural markets increase sustainable revenues, putting their foundation on...
Kiswahili: Utafiti umeonyesha kuwa kuwawezesha wanawake katika masoko ya kilimo cha chakula huongeza mapato endelevu, na kuweka msingi wao kwenye...

Dholuo: Nonro osenyiso ni miyo mon teko e chiro chiemo kod puothe mag pur kelo pesa ma giyudo e piny, kendo mano miyo giketo mise mag...

English: Technology in use for registration before vaccination is a great asset for data compilation but with surged numbers, more solutions will support the efforts to reach more people through the Chanjo Platform.
Kiswahili: Teknolojia inayotumika kwa ajili ya usajili kabla ya chanjo ni nyenzo nzuri kwa utungaji wa data lakini kwa kuwa na nambari nyingi, masuluhisho zaidi yataunga mkono juhudi za kuwafikia watu wengi zaidi kupitia Mfumo wa Chanjo.
Somali: Tiknoolajiyada loo isticmaalo diiwaangelinta ka hor tallaalka waa hanti weyn oo loogu talagalay ururinta xogta laakiin iyadoo tirooyinku ay kordheen, xalal badan ayaa taageeri doona dadaallada lagu gaarayo dad badan iyada oo loo marayo Barnaamijka Chanjo.
Dholuo: Teknoloji ma itiyogo e ndiko nying’ kapok omiye chanjo en gino maduong’ ahinya e chokruok mar weche to nikech namba medore, yore mathoth mag yudo duoko biro konyo temo mar chopo ne ji mang’eny kokalo kuom Chanjo.

English: DPP warns residents of Kitui County to prepare for possible road accidents this September.
Kiswahili: DPP anawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Septemba hii.
Somali: DPP waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay u diyaar garoobaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: DPP osiemo jogweng' Kitui County mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Septemba.

English: DCI urges anyone experiencing abuse in Taita-Taveta County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: DCI inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Taita-Taveta inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e Taita-Taveta County mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: FAO advises avocado producers in Uasin Gishu County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawashauri wazalishaji wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: FAO waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha avocado ee degmada Uasin Gishu inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma loso avocado e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur ka pok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Water and land use systems and natural resources management in the multifunctional landscapes of Western Kenya
Kiswahili: Mifumo ya matumizi ya maji na ardhi na usimamizi wa maliasili katika mandhari mbalimbali za Magharibi mwa Kenya
