Dholuo: Yore mag tiyo kod pi kod piny kod rito mwandu mag piny e piny ma nigi gik mathoth e piny Kenya ma milambo

English: EACC announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: EACC inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: EACC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee Gobolka Kwale.
Dholuo: EACC olando lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mar yudo ng'eyono e provins mar Kwale.

English: KNEC invites youth in Migori County to enroll for electrical installation training this July.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Migori kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Julai hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Migori inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: KNEC gwelo rowere mag Migori County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar loso sitima e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development encourages residents of Meru County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on voter registration.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay ka qaybgalaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada si ay uga warqabaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo jogweng' mar Meru County mondo oriwgi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche duto motudore gi ndiko jogo madwaro yiero.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties launches county development projects in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa huzindua miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed ayaa bilaabay mashaariic horumarineed oo ka socda gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties chako tije mag timo dongruok e kaunti mar Nyandarua County.

English: EACC reminds the public in Embu County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: EACC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Embu kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Embu in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: EACC paronwa ji duto e county mar Embu ni lando wach tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges residents of Bungoma County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo kwayo mar kwedo mibadhi e migepe mag sirkal.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges motorists and pedestrians in Kiambu County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Kiambu inay u hoggaansamaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee socodka si looga hortago dhacdooyinka abaarta la xiriira.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo jorit mtokni kod joma wuotho e ndara e gweng' mar Kiambu mondo oluw tong' mar wuoth kendo oti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe mondo gikwed masiche ma nyalo bedoe nikech oro.

English: Public notice: CDC will host a free hypertension awareness outreach in Busia County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: CDC itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Busia Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: CDC waxay marti gelineysaa wacyi-gelin bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cadaadiska dhiig karka ee degmada Busia bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuoche (CDC) biro timo kampen mar konyo ji ng'eyo ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar hypertension maonge chudo e dwe mar Julai e taon mar Busia County.

English: DPP reminds residents of Makueni County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: DPP anawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni in si deg deg ah loo soo sheegayo in xoolaha la xaday ay gacan ka geysaneyso in xaafadaha la ilaaliyo.
Dholuo: DPP oparo ne jogweng' Makueni County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo jamni konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds residents of Wajir County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba wa muda mrefu.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Wajir in ilaalinta ciidda ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jogweng' mar Wajir County ni rito lowo miyo puodho bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: KEPHIS advises tea producers in Mandera County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawashauri wazalishaji wa chai katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha shaaha ee degmada Mandera inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KEPHIS nyiso jopur ma loso chai e county mar Mandera mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur ka pok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Notice: DPP activates an emergency response plan for flooding in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DPP awezesha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ku saabsan fatahaadaha gobolka Mombasa.
Dholuo: Rapar: DPP tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne ataro mar pi e County mar Mombasa.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free youth mental wellness support is available through county health facilities in Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa ustawi wa akili wa vijana unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Murang'a.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo ne rowere e weche thieth mar paro yudore maonge chudo kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Murang'a.

English: Notice: IPOA opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafungua ofisi ya kijinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay fureysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya taageero maskaxeed iyo bulsheed degmada Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA ochako ofis ma chiwo kony e weche mag paro e alwora mar Lamu County.

English: Teachers Service Commission announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this March.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Machi hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa ku dhawaaqay in bishii Maarso la qeybiyo deeq waxbarasho ardayda u baahan dugsiyada gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission ong'ado mar pogo tuke mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre man gi chandruok e skunde man Elgeyo-Marakwet County e dwe mar Mach.

English: Uasin Gishu entrepreneurs can now engage with proposed policy reforms and financing opportunities Stay informed on the Draft MSME Policy 2025 and the MSE Amendment Bill 2025
Kiswahili: Wajasiriamali wa Uasin Gishu sasa wanaweza kujihusisha na mapendekezo ya marekebisho ya sera na fursa za ufadhili Endelea kufahamishwa kuhusu Rasimu ya Sera ya MSME 2025 na Mswada wa Marekebisho ya MSE 2025.
Somali: Ganacsatada Uasin Gishu hadda waxay ka qayb qaadan karaan dib-u-habaynta siyaasadeed ee la soo jeediyay iyo fursadaha maalgelinta. La soco Draft MSME Policy 2025 iyo MSE Amendment Bill 2025
Dholuo: Uasin Gishu jonjore nyalo tiyo gi lokruok mag chike kod thuolo mag yudo pesa sani Bed gi weche mang'eny e wi chenro mar chike mag MSME 2025 kod chenro mar chike mag MSE 2025

English: HELB encourages residents of Machakos County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: HELB waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabtaan doorka garsoorka.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo ji modak e county mar Machakos mondo ong'e weche duto motudore gi ndiko joma oyiero mondo ging'e tich mar Ombudsman.

English: KNEC urges youth in Mombasa County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Mombasa inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo rowere e County mar Mombasa mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok gichako timo tije mag oganda.

English: Eighteen communities across the 3 countries, selected for their vulnerability to climate change and limited access to economic opportunities, are targeted.
Kiswahili: Jumuiya kumi na nane katika nchi 3, zilizochaguliwa kwa uwezekano wao wa kuathiriwa na mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa na ufikiaji mdogo wa fursa za kiuchumi, zinalengwa.
Somali: Siddeed iyo toban bulsho oo ku kala baahsan 3da waddan, oo loo xushay u nuglaanshaha isbeddelka cimilada iyo helitaanka fursadaha dhaqaale ee xaddidan, ayaa la bartilmaameedsaday.
Dholuo: Jodak apar gi aboro e pinje 3, ma oyier nikech bedo gi nyalo mar bedo gi pek e wi lokruok mag piny kod bedo gi thuolo matin mar yudo thuolo mag yudo mwandu, ochung’negi.

English: OGP urges residents of Isiolo County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waendelee kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya wilaya.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo inay la xiriiraan maamulaha degmada si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda horumarinta degmada.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogweng' kaunti mar Isiolo mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jotend buchegi mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche momedore e wi chenro mag dongruok mar kaunti.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages residents of Murang'a County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwahimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiiri geliyaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay dhiiri galiyaan saaxiibka dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo jogweng' Murang'a County mondo kik gisandre aling'a kendo mondo gijiw osiepgi moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMSA will be held in Baringo County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMSA itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Baringo Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay KEMSA ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Degmada Baringo bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KEMSA biro chano kampen mar thieth maonge chudo e taon mar Baringo e dwe mar Mei.

English: Ministry of Health launches a May awareness campaign on tobacco control across West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Mei juu ya udhibiti wa tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay billowday olole wacyiga ah bishii Maajo ee ka dhanka ah xakamaynta sigaarka gobolka Galbeedka Pokot.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health osechako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Mei e wi thieth mar ndawa e West Pokot County.

English: HELB announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Mandera County this November.
Kiswahili: HELB inatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Mandera Novemba hii.
Somali: HELB waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta waxyaabaha barashada digitalka ah ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada Degmada Mandera bisha November.
Dholuo: HELB ogolo chenro mar pogo buge mag digital maonge chudo e skunde man Mandera County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Kenya Gazette invites residents of Nyamira County to attend the public participation forum regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la xiriira wadatashiyada siyaasadda guud.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette gwelo jogweng' Kaunti mar Nyamira mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenrono.

English: FAO urges maize growers in Migori County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawahimiza wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Migori kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Migori in ay ka hortagaan cayayaanka xilliga dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma pidho cham e county mar Migori mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e kinde mag koth koth ka gitiyo gi thieth mag thieth ma giyiego mondo okony e medo nyak mar cham e higani.

English: Notice: CDC confirms a tuberculosis outbreak alert for Elgeyo-Marakwet County. Residents are advised to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ilani: CDC inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa kifua kikuu kwa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: CDC waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka hargabka ee gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar yedhe ma thiedho tuoche (CDC) nyiso ni nitie masira mar tuberculosis e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: ODPP advises residents of Migori County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: ODPP inashauri wakazi wa Wilaya ya Migori kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e-Citizen.
Somali: ODPP waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan Degmada Migori inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan diiwaangelinta e-Citizen.
Dholuo: ODPP nyiso jogweng' Migori County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro dhi e e-Citizen registration.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Vihiga County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Vihiga inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo ng'ato ang'ata man gi tuoche mag pach e County mar Vihiga mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges beans growers in Lamu County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Lamu kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Lamu inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey roobka ka hor si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur ma pidho puothe e County mar Lamu mondo oti gi ratiro mar chwoyo puothe kapok koth ochue mondo okony e medo nyak mar puothe.

English: Public participation is open for the new Warehouse Receipt System regulations Farmers and stakeholders are urged to submit their views to ensure effective implementation
Kiswahili: Ushirikishwaji wa wananchi uko wazi kwa kanuni mpya za Mfumo wa Stakabadhi Ghalani Wakulima na wadau wametakiwa kuwasilisha maoni yao ili kuhakikisha utekelezaji mzuri.
Somali: Ka qaybgalka dadweynaha waa furan yahay xeerarka cusub ee nidaamka Warehouse Receipt System Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay soo gudbiyaan aragtidooda si loo xaqiijiyo hirgelinta waxtarka leh
Dholuo: Ji duto nyalo dhi nyime gi timo dongruok e chike manyien mag sirkal mar chiwo pesa ne jopur kod joma nie bwoye mondo gichiw pachgi mondo gitiek chenrono

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Kakamega County starting this February.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kuanzia Februari hii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa ku dhawaaqday in laga bilaabo bishii Febraayo ee soo socota la siinayo dadka deggan degmada Kakamega.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) lando ni dhialisi mar ji duto modak e Kaunti mar Kakamega biro chakore e dwe mar Februar.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds residents of Kilifi County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi in helitaanka adeegyada baasaboorka ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone jogweng' Kilifi County ni koro yot yudo passport services kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: @DrMercyHealth A scaling of these joint investments has seen a further expansion of our immunization programs through the introduction of 6 new vaccines in the past decade, all of which are contributing to the reduction of childhood diseases and deaths. #
Kiswahili: @DrMercyHealth Kuongezeka kwa uwekezaji huu wa pamoja kumesaidia kupanuka zaidi kwa programu zetu za chanjo kupitia kuanzishwa kwa chanjo 6 mpya katika muongo mmoja uliopita, ambazo zote zinachangia kupunguza magonjwa na vifo vya watoto. Taarifa za #Coron
Somali: @DrMercyHealth Kordhinta maalgashigan wadajirka ah ayaa keentay ballaarin dheeraad ah oo lagu sameeyay barnaamijyadeenna tallaalka iyada oo la soo bandhigay 6 tallaal oo cusub tobankii sano ee la soo dhaafay, kuwaas oo dhammaantood gacan ka geysanaya yareynta cudurrada iyo dhimashada carruurta. #
Dholuo: @DrMercyHealth Oting’o ng’eny mar pesa ma ji keto e kindgi osemiyo chenro magwa mag chiwo thieth medore kokalo kuom keto thieth manyien 6 e higni apar mosekalo, ma duto konyo e duoko piny tuoche kod tho mag nyithindo. #

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds schools in Lamu County to strengthen child protection in schools this March.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuimarisha ulinzi wa watoto shuleni Machi hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada Waxbarashada ayaa xusuusinaya dugsiyada degmada Lamu inay xoojiyaan ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne skunde man Lamu County mondo omed jiwo rit mar nyithindo e skunde e dwe mar Mach.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) invites residents of Nyamira County to attend the public participation forum regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inay ka soo qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) gwelo jogweng' County mar Nyamira mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenro mar bajet mar county.

English: Notice: KALRO restricts movement of goats in Kilifi County due to a rabies outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO inazuia harakati za mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kutokana na mlipuko wa kichaa cha mbwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa riyaha ee Gobolka Kilifi sababtuna tahay cudurka qabyaalada.
Dholuo: Rapar: KALRO ogeng'o wuoth mar diek e County ma Kilifi nikech tuwo mar rabies.

English: Expectant mothers are urged to start antenatal care visits during the first trimester of pregnancy to monitor both mother and babyÂ’s health. Early check-ups help identify risks and ensure safe delivery.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wajawazito wanahimizwa kuanza ziara za utunzaji wa ujauzito wakati wa miezi mitatu ya kwanza ya ujauzito ili kufuatilia afya ya mama na mtoto. Uchunguzi wa mapema husaidia kutambua hatari na kuhakikisha kujifungua salama.
Somali: Hooyooyinka uurka leh waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay bilaabaan booqashooyinka daryeelka kahor dhalmada inta lagu jiro saddexda bilood ee ugu horreeya uurka si ay ula socdaan caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha labadaba. Baaritaannada hore waxay gacan ka geystaan ​​​​aqoonsiga khataraha iyo hubinta dhalmada badbaadada leh.
Dholuo: Joma nigi ich ojiw mondo ochak dhi e limo mag rito nyithindo kapok ginywolo e kinde ma gisebedo ka giyudo ich mondo girang’ kaka min kod nyathino chalo maber. Timo nonro mapiyo konyo e fwenyo gik ma nyalo kelo hinyruok kendo neno ni nyathi onyuol maber.

English: TVET calls on the community in Nakuru County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TVET inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi kwa watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TVET waxay bulshada degmada Nakuru ugu baaqeysaa inay la xiriirto khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116, si loo ilaaliyo nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: TVET okwayo ji duto e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo omany namba mar 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health will host a free hypertension awareness outreach in Lamu County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Lamu Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska Dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay martigelin doontaa wacyi-gelin bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cadaadiska dhiig karka ee gobolka Lamu bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth biro timo kampen mar konyo ji ng'eyo ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar hypertension maonge chudo e dwe mar ochiko e kaunti mar Lamu.

English: Notice: Council of Governors opens a new service point for passport services in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa furaya goob adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Jaloch ochako tich manyien mar tiyo gi passport e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: ODPP reminds the public in Migori County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Migori kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Migori in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: ODPP paronwa ji duto e County mar Migori ni chiwo ripot mar asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: Young Kenyan agricultural professionals can apply for a Master s degree in Resource Utilization and Plant Protection at China Agricultural University through KeFAAS Apply now
Kiswahili: Wataalamu wa kilimo vijana wa Kenya wanaweza kutuma maombi ya shahada ya Uzamili ya Utumiaji Rasilimali na Ulinzi wa Mimea katika Chuo Kikuu cha Kilimo cha China kupitia KeFAAS Tuma Ombi sasa
Somali: Dhalinyarada xirfadlayaasha beeraha Kenya waxay codsan karaan shahaadada Master-ka ee Isticmaalka Kheyraadka iyo Ilaalinta Dhirta ee Jaamacadda Beeraha Shiinaha iyada oo loo marayo KeFAAS Codso hadda
Dholuo: Rowere ma Kenya ma tiyo e weche mag pur nyalo kwayo mondo giyud digri mar Master e weche mag Resource Utilization and Plant Protection e China Agricultural University kokalo kuom KeFAAS

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Nairobi County about the importance of hypertension awareness for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhusu umuhimu wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu dadka ku nool Gobolka Nairobi u xusuusinayaa muhiimadda ay leedahay in la ogaado cadaadiska dhiig karka sare ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji duto e County mar Nairobi kuom ber mar ng'eyo ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar hypertension e ngima joot.

English: The government will establish a milk price stabilizing fund through New KCC with Kshs 3 billion allocated to manage excess milk and stabilize prices
Kiswahili: Serikali itaanzisha hazina ya kuleta utulivu wa bei ya maziwa kupitia New KCC na Kshs 3 bilioni zitatengwa kudhibiti maziwa ya ziada na kuleta utulivu wa bei.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay aasaasi doontaa sanduuq xasilinta qiimaha caanaha iyada oo loo marayo New KCC iyadoo Kshs 3 bilyan loo qoondeeyay si loo maareeyo caanaha dheeraadka ah loona xasiliyo qiimaha
Dholuo: Sirkal biro loso bengi mar loso nengo mar chak kokalo kuom KCC manyien ma biro chiwo Kshs bilionde 3 mondo oti gi mwandu mag chak ma ok nyal geng ' kendo mondo olos nengo mar chak

English: NPS reminds residents of Kirinyaga County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga in warbixinta soonka ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NPS oparo ne jogweng' Kirinyaga County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar nek konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Ministry of Education urges residents of Nairobi County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay ku biiraan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan barnaamijyada quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jogweng' mar Nairobi County mondo odonj e program mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo mondo giyud konyruok kuom program mar chiemo e skul.

English: With Makena's support and care, Leaungokiok safely delivered a healthy baby girl.
Kiswahili: Kwa usaidizi na utunzaji wa Makena, Leaungokiok alijifungua salama mtoto wa kike mwenye afya njema.
Somali: Iyada oo taageero iyo daryeel ka heleysa Makena, Leaungokiok si nabad ah ayay u dhashay gabadh caafimaad qabta.
Dholuo: Kokalo kuom kony kod rito mar Makena, Leaungokiok ne onyuolo nyathi ma nyako maber.

English: EACC updates residents of Kajiado County on progress of county development projects this July.
Kiswahili: EACC inawajulisha wakazi wa Kajiado County juu ya maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo katika jimbo hili mwezi Julai.
Somali: EACC waxay dadka deggan degmada Kajiado ka wargelineysaa horumarka mashaariicda horumarinta degmada bisha July.
Dholuo: EACC medo lero ne jogweng' Kajiado County dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok e gweng'no e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will open a horticultural produce collection centre in Nyandarua County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay bilaabi doontaa xarun ururinta wax soo saarka beeraha ee Gobolka Nyandarua bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro yawo kama ichokoe puothe mag puothe e County mar Nyandarua e dwe mar April.

English: CDC launches a January awareness campaign on proper sanitation across Tana River County.
Kiswahili: CDC inazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Januari juu ya usafi wa mazingira katika Kaunti ya Tana River.
Somali: CDC waxay billowday olole wacyigelin ah bishii Janaayo oo ku saabsan nadaafadda saxda ah ee Gobolka Tana River.
Dholuo: CDC chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Januar kuom weche mag thieth e alwora duto mar Tana River County.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises horticultural produce producers in Trans Nzoia County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wazalishaji wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa soo saarayaasha wax soo saarka beeraha ee degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur ma loso puothe e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur ka pok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Stakeholder interests disrupt climate finance coordination
Kiswahili: Maslahi ya wadau huvuruga uratibu wa fedha za hali ya hewa
Somali: Danaha daneeyayaasha ayaa carqaladeeya isuduwidda maaliyadda cimilada
Dholuo: Dwaro mag jogo ma nigi geno ketho tudruok mar omwom mar weche mag kor lwasi

English: KEMRI reminds the public that free typhoid screening is available at all public health centres in Baringo County this June.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa matumbo bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo Juni hii.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka tifooska ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynta ee degmada Baringo bishii Juun.
Dholuo: KEMRI oparo ne ji ni nono tuo mar typhoid maonge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e Baringo County e dwe mar Jun.

English: TSC advises applicants in Samburu County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: TSC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Samburu kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: TSC waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha Gobolka Samburu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: TSC nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Samburu ni gidonj e skundgi kapok ichopo e chokruok mabiro.

English: KRA reminds voters in Lamu County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya michakato ya uchaguzi.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha gobolka Lamu inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor inta aan la helin nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: KRA parone jogweng' Lamu County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom SMS ne ji 70000 kapok gitimo yiero.

English: Kenya Dairy Board announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for pigs in Machakos County this November.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Machakos Novemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhawaaqay jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee doofaarka ee Gobolka Machakos bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board olando chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo e dwe mar Novemba e kaunti mar Machakos.

English: Notice: KRA will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay qabaneysaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ee Gobolka Nairobi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KRA biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag siasa e taon mar Nairobi.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Murang'a County that access to eye and dental camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za macho na meno sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Murang'a in helitaanka xeryaha indhaha iyo ilkaha ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha loo qoondeeyay.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne ji duto e County mar Murang'a ni kuonde mitimoe nonro kod thieth mag lakteche sani yudore e kuonde moyier.

English: ODPP reminds residents of Kakamega County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega in helitaanka adeegyada baasaboorka ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: ODPP oparo ne jogweng' Kakamega County ni koro yot yudo passport kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Dual Shocks Threaten Durable Solutions for Refugees in Kenya
Kiswahili: Mishtuko Miwili Inatishia Suluhu za Kudumu kwa Wakimbizi nchini Kenya
Somali: Shoog laba-laab ah oo halis gelinaya xalalka waara ee qaxootiga Kenya
Dholuo: Gik ma kelo luoro ariyo keto luoro kuom gik ma nyalo geng’o jolweny e piny Kenya

English: Ministry of Health urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Mandera County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Mandera kumhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Degmada Mandera inuu ku dhiirrigeliyo saaxiibkiisa dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pachgi e County mar Mandera mondo ojiw osiepne moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will hold a trauma counselling forum in Kwale County this April. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitafanya kongamano la ushauri wa kiwewe katika Kaunti ya Kwale Aprili hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa qaban doonta madasha la talinta dhaawaca ee Gobolka Kwale bisha Abriil. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo chokruok mar chiwo paro e wi tuoche e dwe mar April e county mar Kwale.

English: Kenyan farmers are encouraged to participate in the new rice seed development initiative in partnership with South Korea aimed at boosting local production to meet rising demand
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Kenya wamehimizwa kushiriki katika mpango mpya wa ukuzaji mbegu za mpunga kwa ushirikiano na Korea Kusini unaolenga kuongeza uzalishaji wa ndani ili kukidhi mahitaji yanayoongezeka.
Somali: Beeraleyda Kenya ayaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay ka qaybqaataan dadaalka cusub ee horumarinta abuurka bariiska ee wada shaqeynta Koonfurta Kuuriya oo ujeedkiisu yahay kor u qaadista wax soo saarka maxalliga ah si loo daboolo baahida sii kordheysa
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur ma Kenya mondo oriw lwedo chenro manyien mar loso kodhi mag loso loso loso opur e kindgi gi South Korea ma dwaro ni ji omed nyago olembe e alworagi mondo giyud kaka gidwaro.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Migori County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia wavuti ya kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan Degmada Migori inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca bogga degmada si ay uga warqabtaan bixinta adeegyada degmada.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' Migori County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche ma timore e wi tij lendo.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Siaya County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurka laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: KEMSA nyiso ji duto modak e county mar Siaya mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth ma onge chudo mar oganda mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges motorists and pedestrians in Migori County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Migori kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Migori inay guryahooda ku rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dabka daminta iyo inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa dhacdooyinka abaarta la xiriira.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Forest Service jiwo derebe kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Migori mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo giti matek mondo gikwed masiche mag oro.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) opens voter education centres in Narok County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Narok Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu furayaa xarumo waxbarasho codbixiyeyaasha ah ee Gobolka Narok bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) yawo kuonde tiego josiasa e kaunti mar Narok e dwe mar Februar.

English: Kilifi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kilifi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Aprili 2023
Somali: Degmada Kilifi: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kilifi: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Ang'wen 2023

English: Kenya Medical Association urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Embu County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Embu kumhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Embu inuu ku dhiirrigeliyo saaxiibkiisa dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar paro e County mar Embu mondo ojiw osiepne moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: KALRO advises farmers in Mandera County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the May planting season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera kudhibiti wizi wa jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa za kuua wadudu zilizokubaliwa kabla ya msimu wa kupanda Mei.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Mandera inay ka hortagaan ciidamada ciidammada ee dayrta iyagoo isticmaalaya cayayaanka la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maajo.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e kaunti mar Mandera mondo oti gi yedhe mamero makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok chon kapok ochopo dwe mar Mei.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development informs maize farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County of new market linkage opportunities this March.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inafahamisha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Machi hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi ka wargelineysaa fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development olero ne jopur mar kodhi e Tharaka-Nithi County kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Mach.

English: TVET encourages out-of-school children in Kajiado County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under free primary education.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Kajiado inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e Kajiado County mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Campaign in Kenya regions to provide vitamin A to children under 5 years and prequent vaccination
Kiswahili: Kampeni katika mikoa ya Kenya kutoa vitamini A kwa watoto chini ya umri wa miaka 5 na chanjo ya mapema
Somali: Olole gobollada Kenya ah oo lagu siinayo fitamiin A carruurta da'doodu ka yar tahay 5 sano iyo tallaalka ka hor
Dholuo: Kampen e gwenge mag Kenya mar chiwo vitamin A ne nyithindo ma johigni 5 gi matin kod thieth motelo

English: Water Mission Responding to East Africa Flooding with Emergency Safe Water
Kiswahili: Ujumbe wa Maji Kukabiliana na Mafuriko ya Afrika Mashariki na Maji Salama ya Dharura
Somali: Hawlgalka Biyaha oo ka jawaabaya Daadadka Bariga Afrika iyadoo la adeegsanayo Biyo Ammaan ah oo Degdeg ah
Dholuo: Mison mar Pi Duoko Pi Ma Opong’o Afrika ma Wuokchieng’ gi Pi Maber Mapiyo

English: CDC calls on parents in Nyandarua County to have children under five screened for HIV/AIDS during the December outreach.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuwapima watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa VVU/UKIMWI wakati wa mawasiliano ya Desemba.
Somali: CDC waxay ku baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Nyandarua inay carruurta ka yar shan sano u sameeyaan baaritaanka HIV / AIDS inta lagu gudajiro bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: CDC kwayo jonyuol e County mar Nyandarua mondo otim nonro mar HIV/AIDS ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Kisii County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the May planting season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa kupanda Mei.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Kisii inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maajo.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur e County mar Kisii ni giti gi moko kuom yiendno kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Mei.

English: KICD calls on the community in Kiambu County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KICD inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: KICD waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Kiambu inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban iskuulada si ay u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyada iskuulada.
Dholuo: KICD luongo ji duto e County mar Kiambu mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: KRA reminds voters in Busia County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Busia kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Busia inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: KRA parone jogweng'o mag Busia County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go ka gitiyo gi sms e simo mar 70000 kapok kinde mar yiero ochopo.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Kakamega County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega inay yareeyaan qaadashada cusbada iyo sonkorta si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' Kakamega County mondo omed chamo chumbi kod sukari mondo kik tuoche ma inyalo geng'e landre.

English: 4K Clubs are being rolled out nationwide Primary schools should establish 4K clubs as directed by the Principal Secretary to the Directors of Education
Kiswahili: Vilabu vya 4K vinasambazwa kote nchini Shule za Msingi zinapaswa kuanzisha vilabu 4K kama ilivyoagizwa na Katibu Mkuu wa Wakurugenzi wa Elimu.
Somali: 4K Clubs ayaa la bilaabay dalka oo dhan Dugsiyada hoose waa inay sameeyaan 4K Clubs sida uu tilmaamay Xoghayaha Guud ee Agaasimayaasha Waxbarashada
Dholuo: 4K Clubs ni e piny mangima Primary schools onego ochak 4K clubs kaka jatend weche tiegruok mar Director of Education chiko

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit appeals to caregivers in Kilifi County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the November maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Novemba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Kilifi inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha ee qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka ee bisha Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit okwayo jorit e County mar Kilifi mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Universities Fund reminds schools in Vihiga County to strengthen child protection in schools this August.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuimarisha ulinzi wa watoto shuleni Agosti hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xusuusinayaa dugsiyada degmada Vihiga inay xoojiyaan ilaalinta carruurta ee iskuulada bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund oparo ne skunde man Vihiga County mondo omed jiwo rit mar nyithindo e skunde e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health confirms a dengue fever outbreak alert for Baringo County. Residents are advised to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa homa ya dengue kwa Kaunti ya Baringo. Wakazi wanashauriwa kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka hargabka dengue ee degmada Baringo. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagu taliyey.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth osenyiso ni nitie siem mar tuo mar dengue e gweng' mar Baringo.

English: Kenya Medical Association announces SHA registration for residents of Narok County starting this December.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatangaza usajili wa SHA kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuanzia Desemba hii.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu ku dhawaaqay diiwaangelinta SHA ee dadka deggan Gobolka Narok laga bilaabo Diseembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association ogolo chik mar SHA mar ndiko joma odak Narok County kochakore dwe mar Desemba.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations alerts residents of Kajiado County to a rise in fraud cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za ulaghai na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado uga digaya kororka kiisaska khiyaanada wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kajiado County kuom wach medruok mar weche mag wuondruok kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Public health advisory: Kenya Medical Association warns of increased HIV/AIDS risk in Laikipia County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya VVU/UKIMWI katika Kaunti ya Laikipia na kushauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Talobixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya wuxuu ka digay khatarta sii kordheysa ee HIV / AIDS ee Gobolka Laikipia wuxuuna ku talinayaa dadweynaha inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Rieko mar thieth mar ji: Kenya Medical Association chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar AYAKI/AIDS e County mar Laikipia kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore mar konyo e thieth.

English: Isiolo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Isiolo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Juni 2024
Somali: Degmada Isiolo: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Isiolo: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2024

English: COVID-19 is a respiratory illness caused by a new virus. Symptoms include fever, coughing, a sore throat and shortness of breath. This virus can spread from person to person, but good hygiene can prevent infection. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: COVID-19 ni ugonjwa wa kupumua unaosababishwa na virusi vipya. Dalili ni pamoja na homa, kukohoa, koo na upungufu wa kupumua. Virusi hivi vinaweza kuenea kutoka kwa mtu mmoja hadi mwingine, lakini usafi unaweza kuzuia maambukizi. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: COVID-19 waa cudur neef-mareenka ah oo uu keeno fayras cusub. Calaamadaha waxaa ka mid ah qandho, qufac, cuna xanuun iyo neef-qabatin. Fayraskani wuxuu ku faafi karaa qof ilaa qof, laakiin nadaafadda wanaagsani waxay ka hortagi kartaa caabuqa. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: COVID-19 en tuo mar tuo mar yweyo ma ikel gi midhusi manyien. Ranyisi gin kaka liet mapoya e del, ahonda, duol malit kod gamo muya. Virus ni nyalo landore kowuok kuom ng’ato ka ng’ato, kata kamano bedo gi ler maber nyalo geng’o yudo tuoche. #KomeshaKorona

English: NTSA warns residents of Homa Bay County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakazi wa Wilaya ya Homa Bay juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: NTSA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay kororka khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Homa Bay County e wi medruok mar timbe mag wuondo pesa mag simo kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok kare ne jatendgi.

English: The analysis projects that to meet the population's health needs, more than 114,000 additional health professionals across 31 different roles will need to be trained, employed, and retained within the health system by 2031.
Kiswahili: Miradi ya uchanganuzi ambayo ili kukidhi mahitaji ya afya ya idadi ya watu, zaidi ya wataalamu 114,000 wa ziada wa afya katika majukumu 31 tofauti watahitaji kufunzwa, kuajiriwa, na kubakizwa ndani ya mfumo wa afya ifikapo 2031.
Somali: Falanqaynta ayaa saadaalisay in si loo daboolo baahiyaha caafimaad ee dadweynaha, in ka badan 114,000 oo xirfadlayaal caafimaad oo dheeraad ah oo ka kooban 31 door oo kala duwan ayaa loo baahan doonaa in la tababaro, la shaqaaleeyo, lana sii hayo nidaamka caafimaadka marka la gaaro 2031.
Dholuo: Ong’iyono nyiso ni mondo ochop dwaro mag thieth mag oganda, jotich mamoko mag thieth mokalo 114,000 e migepe mopogore opogore 31 biro dwarore ni opuonj, omiye tich, kendo oritgi e chenro mar thieth nyaka higa mar 2031.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds the public in Tana River County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this October.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Tana River kwamba maoni juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka yanakaribishwa Oktoba hii.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Tana River in talooyinka dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah la soo dhaweynayo bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette parone ji duto manie Tana River County ni oketo pachgi kuom nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Kenya Inter-Agency Rapid Assessment (KIRA): Wajir County Floods Assessment Report 28th March â€“ 2nd April 2023
Kiswahili: Tathmini ya Haraka ya Mashirika ya Kenya (KIRA): Ripoti ya Tathmini ya Mafuriko ya Kaunti ya Wajir Machi 28 - 2 Aprili 2023
Somali: Qiimaynta Degdegga ah ee Hay'adaha Isku-dhafka ah ee Kenya (KIRA): Warbixinta Qiimaynta Fatahaadaha ee Degmada Wajeer 28 Maarso - 2 Abriil 2023
Dholuo: Kenya pim mapiyo mar duol mopogore opogore (KIRA): Ripot mar pim mar pi ma opong'o piny Wajir tarik 28 dwe mar adek - tarik 2 dwe mar ang'wen higa mar 2023

English: IPOA urges residents of Siaya County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo jogweng' County mar Siaya mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'adoe bura e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom weche sirkal.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) promotes organic farming among farmers in Nairobi County as part of the October climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inakuza kilimo hai miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Oktoba.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kor u qaadeysaa beeraha dabiiciga ah ee beeraleyda degmada Nairobi iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka iska caabbinta cimilada ee Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo tij pur e kind jopur e County mar Nairobi kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi mar lokruok mar piny e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: KMTC reminds parents in Homa Bay County that school feeding programme registration is open this May.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba usajili wa mpango wa kulisha shule umefunguliwa Mei hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta gobolka Homa Bay in diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga ay furan tahay bisha May.
Dholuo: KMTC parone jonyuol manie Homa Bay County ni chenro mar kwayo nyithindo chiemo e skul ochakore e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will train farmers in Narok County on conservation tillage this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok juu ya kilimo cha uhifadhi Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu tababar siin doonaa beeraleyda Gobolka Narok oo ku saabsan beerashada ilaalinta Oktoobarkan.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Dairy Board biro tiego jopur e Narok County e wi puodho mar ritruok e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Include deaf students! Provide sign language training.
Kiswahili: Wajumuishe wanafunzi viziwi! Toa mafunzo ya lugha ya ishara.
Somali: Ardayda dhegaha la'aanta ah ka qaybqaada!
Dholuo: Kony jopuonjre ma itgi odino, kendo tieggi e tiyo gi dho momni.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds expectant mothers in Nyandarua County that access to free antenatal care is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za ujauzito bila malipo ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Nyandarua in helitaanka daryeelka uurka ka hor ee bilaashka ah ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne mine ma nigi ich e County mar Nyandarua ni thuolo mar yudo rit ma onge chudo e kuonde duto mag sirkal en maonge chudo.

English: In fish farms, manage high water temperatures by exchanging at least 10-20% of pond water daily with cooler water, aerating the water, maintaining pond depth of at least 1-1.5m, shading ponds from direct sun, and reducing fish stocking density during hot weather.
Kiswahili: Katika mashamba ya samaki, dhibiti halijoto ya juu ya maji kwa kubadilishana angalau 10-20% ya maji ya bwawa kila siku na maji baridi, kuingiza maji, kudumisha kina cha bwawa cha angalau 1-1.5m, mabwawa ya kivuli kutoka kwa jua moja kwa moja, na kupunguza msongamano wa samaki wakati wa hali ya hewa ya joto.
Somali: Beeraha kalluunka, maareynta heerkulka sare ee biyaha adoo maalin kasta ugu yaraan 10-20% biyo ka beddelaya biyo qabow, hawo-mareynta biyaha, ilaalinta qoto dheer ee ugu yaraan 1-1.5m, hoos u dhigida kuwa ka soo baxa qorraxda tooska ah, iyo yareynta cufnaanta kalluunka inta lagu jiro cimilada kulul.
Dholuo: E puothe ma ji pidhoe rech, rituru liet mar pi ma malo kuom loko chakre pasent 10 nyaka 20 mar pi pi mar yawo pile ka pile gi pi mang'ich, rieyo pi, rito matut mar pi mar pwodhruok ma ok tin ne 1-1.5m, keto pi mar pi e bwo wang' chieng', kendo miyo rech obed mang'eny e seche mag liet.

English: TVET reminds needy students in Narok County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Narok kwamba maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan Gobolka Narok in deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay codsiyada ardayda baahan ay dhowaan dhammaadaan.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa jopuonjre ma nigi chan e Narok County ni tuke mag somo ne jopuonjre man gi chan biro rumo machiegni.

English: FAO invites farmers in Tana River County to a free training on pest and disease management this April.
Kiswahili: FAO inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River kwa mafunzo ya bure juu ya udhibiti wa wadudu na magonjwa Aprili hii.
Somali: FAO waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Tana River inay helaan tababar lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan xakamaynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: FAO gwelo jopur e taon mar Tana River County mondo otim tiegruok maonge chudo e wi thieth mar tuoche kod tuoche e dwe mar April.

English: Notice from SHA (Social Health Authority): postnatal check-ups clinics will run every June at designated health centres in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii): kliniki za uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa zitafanya kazi kila Juni katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada): rugaha baaritaanka dhalmada ka dib waxaa lagu qaban doonaa bil kasta Juun xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Kwale.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar SHA (Social Health Authority): klinik mag nono nyithindo bang' nyuol ibiro tim dwe mar auchiel higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e county mar Kwale.

English: State Department for TVET advises students in Kericho County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kericho kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ardayda degmada Kericho kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga deeqda waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan waxyaabaha barashada digitalka ah ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo jopuonjre e County mar Kericho mondo okonygi kokalo kuom websait mar somo ma yudore e Intanet mondo giyud thuolo mar somo e yor digital.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) encourages first-time voters in Busia County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Busia kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: Guddiga Garsoorka Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa codbixiyayaasha ugu horreeya ee degmada Busia inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogo matimoga yiero mokwongo e county mar Busia mondo oting'e ID kata pasi mar piny mangima e odiechieng'no mar timo yiero.

English: KALRO announces a free anthrax vaccination exercise for poultry in Nakuru County this April.
Kiswahili: KALRO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kimeta kwa kuku katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Aprili hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo lacag la'aan ah oo loo sameeyo digaagga gobolka Nakuru bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: KALRO ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar anthrax e gweng' mar Nakuru e dwe mar April.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) calls on parents in Nandi County to have children under five screened for Rift Valley Fever during the October outreach.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa wakati wa ufikiaji wa Oktoba.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Nandi in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro Cudurka Rift Valley inta lagu gudajiro bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) kwayo jonyuol e County mar Nandi mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma hikgi tin ne abich kuom tuwo mar Rift Valley Fever e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Public notice: Kenya Medical Association will host a free tobacco control outreach in Tharaka-Nithi County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa kudhibiti tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa dadaal lacag la'aan ah oo looga hortago sigaarka degmada Tharaka-Nithi bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association biro timo kampen mar golo ndawa maonge chudo e Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Project Brief Series - No. 3: Circular bio-economy innovations for resilient refugee and host communities in East Africa
Kiswahili: Mfululizo wa Muhtasari wa Mradi - Nambari 3: Ubunifu wa kiduara wa uchumi wa kibiolojia kwa wakimbizi na jamii zinazowakaribisha katika Afrika Mashariki
Somali: Taxanaha Kooban ee Mashruuca - Lambarka 3aad: Hal-abuurro dhaqaale-bayooloji oo wareeg ah oo loogu talagalay bulshooyinka qaxootiga iyo kuwa martida loo yahay ee Bariga Afrika
Dholuo: 3: Yore manyien mag weche yuto mag piny ne jolweny ma nigi chir kod oganda ma rwakogi e Afrika ma Wuokchieng'

English: KEMRI encourages residents of Meru County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kutoteseka kimya kimya na kumhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay u dhiiri galiyaan saaxiibo dhibaataysan inay caawimaad raadsadaan.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng' mar Meru County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo gijiw osiepgi moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: KICD reminds needy students in Tana River County that revision guides applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Tana River kwamba maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho yanafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Tana River in dib-u-eegista ay ku xiran tahay codsiyada dhowaan.
Dholuo: KICD paronwa jopuonjre man gi chan e taon mar Tana River County ni lokruok mar chike ma gidwaro tiyogo biro rumo machiegni.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will train farmers in Kwale County on terracing this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale juu ya mashindano ya terracing Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) ayaa tababar siin doonta beeraleyda Gobolka Kwale ee ku saabsan dhulka dhulka ee bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro tiego jopur e county mar Kwale e wi terracing e dwe mar Septemba.

English: AFA reminds farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Tharaka-Nithi barnaamijka tababarka ka dib goosashada ee socda.
Dholuo: AFA parone jopur e Tharaka-Nithi County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime bang' keyo.

English: Drug or alcohol addiction can exacerbate feelings of hopelessness, worsen mental health conditions, impair decision-making, and increase the risk of suicidal thoughts. Avoid drugs and substance abuse
Kiswahili: Uraibu wa dawa za kulevya au pombe unaweza kuzidisha hisia za kukata tamaa, kuzidisha hali ya afya ya akili, kudhoofisha uamuzi, na kuongeza hatari ya mawazo ya kujiua. Epuka dawa za kulevya na matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya.
Somali: Isticmaalka maandooriyaha ama khamriga waxay sii xoojin karaan niyad jabka, waxay sii xumeeyaan xaaladaha maskaxda, waxay saameyn ku yeeshaan go'aan qaadashada, waxayna kordhiyaan khatarta fikirka isdilka.
Dholuo: Bedo misumba yedhe mamero kata mer nyalo miyo ng'ato obed gi parruok mang'eny, onyalo ketho winjruokne gi Nyasaye, onyalo miyo kik otim yiero e yo maber, kendo onyalo miyo paro mar donjo e kend omedre.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of West Pokot County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya West Pokot watumie portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u soo gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo ng'ur mar kedo gi mibadhi mar chulo pesa.

English: KICD conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in Laikipia County this June.
Kiswahili: KICD inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Juni hii.
Somali: KICD waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee Gobolka Laikipia bishii Juun.
Dholuo: KICD otimo chokruok mar tiego ji e wi ratiro mag chik e County mar Laikipia e dwe mar Jun.

English: Pest Control Products Board encourages farmers in Garissa County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for horticultural produce.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za mazao ya bustani.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka ka hortagga cayayaanka wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda degmada Garissa inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay alaabta beeraha.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Garissa mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony-tich ma nigi ratiro mar timo kamano mondo giyud nengo mabeyo mag gik ma gipidho e puothe.

English: Slovakia and UNESCO Partnership: Access to clean, affordable Water in Turkana
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano wa Slovakia na UNESCO: Upatikanaji wa Maji safi na ya bei nafuu Turkana
Somali: Slovakia iyo Iskaashiga UNESCO: Helitaanka Biyo nadiif ah oo la awoodi karo oo Turkana ah
Dholuo: Riwruok mar piny Slovakia kod UNESCO: Yudo Pi maler kendo yot e piny Turkana

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development opens a new catering and hospitality programme at the vocational centre in Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inafungua mpango mpya wa upishi na ukarimu katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ka furayaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan cuntada iyo marti-gelinta xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ochako chenro manyien mar chiemo kod rwako welo e kar tich e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the public in Mandera County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa shacabka degmada Mandera inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto e county mar Mandera mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok adier ne jatendgi mar konyo ji bang' yudo weche ma nyiso ni nitie chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds the public in Mombasa County to remain vigilant on counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya umakini wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka degmada Mombasa ku xasuusinaya in ay sii joogaan feejignaanta ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne ji duto e county mar Mombasa ni gisik ka girito weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: DPP reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Nyamira County that access to post-violence medical care is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu zinapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Nyamira in helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ka dib rabshaduhu uu yahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: DPP oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e kaunti mar Nyamira ni yudo kony mar thieth ma iyudo bang' timbe mag mahundu en gima ng'ato nyalo timo maonge chudo.

English: Notice: COMESA will train farmers in Isiolo County on soil conservation this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo juu ya uhifadhi wa udongo Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Isiolo ee ku saabsan ilaalinta ciidda bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA biro tiego jopur e kaunti mar Isiolo e wi rito lowo e dwe mar April.

English: NTSA calls on residents of Kwale County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of border security.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: NTSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga waxqabadka aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal aagagga xuduudda si ay u taageeraan amniga xuduudka.
Dholuo: NTSA okwayo jogweng' mar Kwale County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma rito tong'o ni gitimo gik maok kare e alworano.

English: Every person deserves respect and help in his or her journey in mental health. Lets discourage dispising and to build our region by fronting development for each one of us
Kiswahili: Kila mtu anastahili heshima na msaada katika safari yake katika afya ya akili.
Somali: Qof kastaa wuxuu mudan yahay ixtiraam iyo caawimaad safarkiisa caafimaadka maskaxda.
Dholuo: Ng'ato ka ng'ato onego omi luor kendo okonyre e yorene mag ngima mar paro.

English: There were indicators while transporting products to markets and they're found. These was vivid enough about market search of agricultural produce..
Kiswahili: Kulikuwa na viashiria wakati wa kusafirisha bidhaa kwenye masoko na zinapatikana. Hizi zilikuwa wazi vya kutosha juu ya utaftaji wa soko la mazao ya kilimo..
Somali: Waxaa jiray tilmaamo marka alaabada la gaarsiinayo suuqyada, waxaana la helay, kuwaas oo ahaa kuwo aad u muuqda oo ku saabsan raadinta suuqa ee alaabta beeraha.
Dholuo: Ne nitie ranyisi moko ma ne nyiso ni ne idwaro manyo gik ma ne idhi chul e chiro.

English: Grade 6 transition after KPSEA results in December.
Kiswahili: Mpito wa Daraja la 6 baada ya matokeo ya KPSEA mwezi Desemba.
Somali: Kala guurka fasalka 6 ka dib natiijooyinka KPSEA bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: E dwe mar Desemba, ne idhi tim lokruok e okang' mar 6 bang' ka KPSEA osechopo.

English: IEBC reminds residents of Samburu County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Samburu in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo bogga gobolka ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: IEBC parone jogweng' Samburu County ni luwo dongruok mar tich kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: IPOA urges residents of Kilifi County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kuunga mkono kamati za kujenga amani huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa wa kukabiliana na ugaidi.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta deegaanka iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: IPOA ojiwo jogweng' Kilifi County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: ODPP urges residents of Nyeri County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya.

Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogweng' Nyeri County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono ka gitiyo gi websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche duto e wi tich mitimo e gwenge duto.

English: NPS reminds the public in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NPS inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kubaki macho juu ya mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii.
Somali: NPS waxay dadka degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet ku xasuusineysaa inay ka feejignaadaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
