English: SHA invites residents of Isiolo County to attend the public participation forum regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: SHA inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: SHA waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: SHA gwelo jogweng' Isiolo County mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenro mag dongruok.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of Nyamira County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay ugu yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' kaunti mar Nyamira mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giluong kony mar thieth mar chuny maonge chudo.

English: Public notice: Kenya Medical Association will host a free proper sanitation outreach in Turkana County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mazingira bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Turkana Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa adeegyo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku habboon degmada Turkana bisha May.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association biro timo chenro mar rito ngima maler e taon mar Turkana e dwe mar Mei.

English: An examination of patented technologies related to agricultural biotechnology illustrated the large in- crease in both public and private sector patents since.

English: Kenya faces crisis as Trumpâ€™s Executive Order to cut supply of HIV, malaria drugs
Kiswahili: Kenya inakabiliwa na mgogoro kama amri ya Trump ya kupunguza ugavi wa dawa za VVU, malaria

English: NPS alerts residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka kwa kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: NPS waxay dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi uga digtay kororka kiisaska gaadiidka la xaday waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka warbixiyaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: NPS chiwo siem ne jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County e wi medruok mar weche mag kwalo mtokni kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne polis ma machiegni.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges coffee growers in Marsabit County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawahimiza wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Marsabit inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalaalka ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur ma pidho kahera mar Marsabit County mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: Council of Governors reminds voters in Tharaka-Nithi County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyayaashu waxay xasuusiyaan codbixiyayaasha degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor inta aan la helin waxbarashada codbixinta.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch oparo ne jong'ad bura ma Tharaka-Nithi County mondo olim kama ichanoe IEBC machiegni kodgi kapok giyudo tiegruok.

English: IEBC reminds schools in Isiolo County to strengthen anti-bullying measures this November.
Kiswahili: IEBC inazikumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuimarisha hatua za kupambana na uonevu Novemba hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay xusuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Isiolo inay xoojiyaan tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibaatada bisha November.
Dholuo: IEBC parone skunde mag Isiolo County mondo omed jiwo yore mag kedo gi ichwanyruok e dwe mar Novemba.

English: TSC conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in Kwale County this February.
Kiswahili: TSC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Kwale Februari hii.
Somali: TSC waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee Gobolka Kwale bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: TSC timo romo mar tiego ji e wi ratiro mag chik e County mar Kwale e dwe mar Februar.

English: Public notice: CDC will host a free safe water storage outreach in Murang'a County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: CDC itaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa kuhifadhi maji salama katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: CDC waxay marti gelineysaa adeeg lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee degmada Murang'a bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuoche (CDC) biro timo chenro mar chiwo pi maonge chudo e dwe mar Julai e kaunti mar Murang'a.

English: Universities Fund urges parents and teachers in Meru County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Meru kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa usimamizi wa shule.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku boorinayaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Meru inay u soo sheegaan mas'uuliyadda amniga ee dugsiga.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e county mar Meru mondo onyis jotend skul wach moro amora motudore gi ritruok.

English: Notice from Division of Disease Surveillance and Response: childhood immunization clinics will run every May at designated health centres in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa: kliniki za chanjo za watoto zitafanya kazi kila Mei katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada: Xarumaha tallaalka carruurta ayaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Maajo ee kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuwo: Klinike mag thiedho nyithindo biro tiyo e dwe mar Mei higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Siaya.

English: IEBC reminds voters in Nandi County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha gobolka Nandi in ay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka ilaa 70000 ka hor inta aysan helin waxbarasho codbixinayaasha.
Dholuo: IEBC parone jogedo e county mar Nandi mondo onyis weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms ne ji 70000 kapok giyudo tiegruok.

English: KEMRI encourages residents of Nakuru County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay ka qayb galaan kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng' Nakuru County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Expectant mothers should eat some little food at a time in every day to [revent gallowing and to maintain the strengthe of their bodies
Kiswahili: Mama wajawazito wanapaswa kula chakula kidogo kwa wakati mmoja katika kila siku ili [kuzuia kushambuliwa na kudumisha nguvu ya miili yao
Somali: Hooyooyinka uurka leh waxay u baahan yihiin inay cunaan cunto yar hal mar maalin kasta si ay uga fogaadaan xidhitaanka iyo inay ilaaliyaan xoogga jidhkooda
Dholuo: Min nyithindo madwaro nyuol onego ocham chiemo matin e odiechieng ' kodiechieng ' mondo kik githo kendo giteg ringregi obed motegno.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds expectant mothers in Nairobi County that access to nutrition supplementation for infants is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba upatikanaji wa nyongeza ya lishe kwa watoto wachanga ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Nairobi in helitaanka cuntada lagu daro dhallaanka ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paro ne mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Nairobi ni yudo chiemo moromo ne nyithindo mayom en gima onge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges coffee growers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Wanyama inawasihi wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kudhibiti wizi wa jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa za kuua wadudu zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda kafeega ee gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet in ay ka hortagaan cayayaanka ciidanka xilligaan iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma giyudo e higa ka gitiyo gi tuoche makelo hinyruok mondo okony e loso olembe e higani.

English: The African Green Revolution Forum AGRF is taking place in Accra Ghana from September 3 6 Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to engage in discussions on digital transformation in agriculture
Kiswahili: Kongamano la Mapinduzi ya Kijani Afrika AGRF linafanyika Accra Ghana kuanzia Septemba 3 6 Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mijadala kuhusu mabadiliko ya kidijitali katika kilimo.
Somali: Madasha Kacaanka Cagaaran ee Afrika AGRF ayaa ka dhacaya Accra, Ghana laga bilaabo Sebtembar 3, 6 Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha ayaa lagu dhiirrigeliyay inay ka qayb qaataan doodaha ku saabsan isbeddelka dijitaalka ah ee beeraha
Dholuo: Forum mar Green Revolution ma Afrika AGRF biro timore e Accra Ghana chakre Septemba 3 6 Jo-Purie gi jo ohala mag agro-go jiwo mondo oriw lwedo mbaka e wi lokruok mar digital e weche mag pur

English: KALRO advises farmers in Nyeri County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyeri inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e County mar Nyeri mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) warns rice farmers in Marsabit County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaonya wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay uga digtay beeraleyda bariiska ee degmada Marsabit cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna kugula talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) chiwo siem ne jopur loso loso kodhi e county mar Marsabit kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: If rains are predicted as normal, apply organic fertilizer one to two weeks before planting in bunds or by spreading, followed by shallow tillage; if rains are below normal, apply organic fertilizer two to three weeks before planting.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mvua ni za kiwango cha kawaida, tumia mbolea ya asili wiki moja hadi mbili kabla ya kupanda kwenye malundo au kwa kusambaza kukifuatiwa na upaliliaji mwepesi; ikiwa mvua zinatabiriwa kunyesha chini ya kiwango cha kawaida, tumia mbolea ya asili wiki mbili hadi tatu kabla ya kupanda.
Somali: Haddii roobku si caadi ah u saadaaliyo, bacriminta organic ah ku mari hal ilaa laba toddobaad ka hor inta aan la beerin bunds ama adigoo faafinaya, kadibna beero si qoto dheer loo beero; Haddii roobku ka hooseeyo caadiga, isticmaal bacriminta organic laba ilaa saddex toddobaad ka hor beerta.
Dholuo: Kapo ni koth chue, onego iti gi yiendno jumbe achiel kata ariyo ka pok ipidho yiendni, kae to iti gi puodho matin.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges farmers in Trans Nzoia County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee beeraha cimilada ee caqli-galka ah si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur e Trans Nzoia County mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi pur mar piny mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Annoucing lauch of National roadmap for nutrition interventions at county and national levels.
Kiswahili: Kutangaza mpango wa kitaifa wa uingiliaji kati wa lishe katika ngazi za kaunti na kitaifa.
Somali: Soo bandhigida khariidadda waddooyinka qaranka ee tallaabooyinka nafaqada ee heer gobol iyo heer qaran.
Dholuo: Weche ma ne oland e wi chenro mar piny mangima mar chiwo kony e weche mag chiemo e gwenge mag gwenge koda e pinje mamoko.

English: Kenya Dairy Board encourages farmers in Narok County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for milk.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya maziwa.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda Gobolka Narok inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan caanaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur manie Narok County mondo ous olemo mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo chak mondo omi ohala obed maber.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will open a fish collection centre in Turkana County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itafungua kituo cha kukusanya samaki katika Kaunti ya Turkana Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ka furi doontaa xarun ururinta kalluunka ee degmada Turkana bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro yawo kama ichokoe rech e County mar Turkana e dwe mar Agost.

English: State Department for Basic Education advises applicants in Siaya County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Siaya kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Siaya inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State for Basic Education nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Siaya ni mondo gidonj e tiegruok kapok iketho skundno.

English: Notice: KMTC opens a new catering and hospitality programme at the vocational centre in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inafungua mpango mpya wa upishi na ukarimu katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay ka fureysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan cuntada iyo marti-gelinta xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KMTC chako chenro manyien mar chiemo kod rwako welo e skul mar tich e county mar Siaya.

English: Reviving Lake Victoria: a Regional Approach to Inclusive Sanitation
Kiswahili: Kufufua Ziwa Victoria: Mbinu ya Kikanda ya Usafi wa Mazingira Jumuishi
Somali: Dib u soo nooleynta Harada Victoria: Hab Goboleed oo loogu talagalay Nadaafad loo dhan yahay
Dholuo: Kuong'ruok kendo nam Victoria: Yor Miwuoro mar Keto Maler Maduto

English: Climate-Smart Agriculture for Resilient Livelihoods Empowering Farmers to Adapt, Thrive, and SustainAt Sustainable Solutions Kenya (SUSOK), we promote Climate-Smart Agriculture (CSA) to help smallholder farmers build resilience to climate change while increasing food security, protecting the environment, and improving livelihoods. Our approach emphasizes awareness creation, practical training, and ongoing farmer support to make sustainable farming accessible and effective.
Kiswahili: Katika Suluhisho endelevu Kenya (SUSOK), tunaendeleza Kilimo cha Hali ya Hewa-Kweli (CSA) kusaidia wakulima wadogo kujenga uimara dhidi ya mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa wakati wa kuongeza usalama wa chakula, kulinda mazingira, na kuboresha maisha. Njia yetu inasisitiza ufahamu, mafunzo ya vitendo, na msaada unaoendelea wa wakulima ili kufanya kilimo endelevu kupatikana na ufanisi.
Somali: Beeraha Cimilada-Climate-Smart ee Nolosha u adkaysta Xoolaha Beeraleyda u awood-bixinaya inay la qabsadaan, u koraan, u sii noolaadaan, iyo u sii noolaadaanSolutions Sustainable Kenya (SUSOK), waxaan kor u qaadnaa Beeraha Cimilada-Smart (CSA) si aan uga caawino beeraleyda yaryar inay u adkaystaan isbeddelka cimilada iyagoo kordhinaya amniga cuntada, ilaalinta deegaanka, iyo hagaajinta noloshooda. Qaabkeena wuxuu
Dholuo: E piny Kenya (SUSOK), wakonyo jopur matindo tindo mondo obed gi nyalo mar kedo gi lokruok mag piny ka gi medo rito weche mag chiemo, rito alwora, kendo medo ngima maber. Yo ma watiyogo jiwo chueyo pach ji, tiegruok, kod konyo jopur mondo obed gi nyalo mar timo dongruok e weche mag piny.

English: The Kenyan horticulture industry faces reduced international market share due to high production costs and logistics Stakeholders are urged to seek innovative solutions to remain competitive
Kiswahili: Sekta ya kilimo cha bustani ya Kenya inakabiliwa na kupungua kwa soko la kimataifa kutokana na gharama kubwa za uzalishaji na ugavi Wadau wanahimizwa kutafuta suluhu za kiubunifu ili kusalia na ushindani.
Somali: Warshadaha beeraha Kenya ayaa la kulmaya saamiga suuqa caalamiga ah ee hoos u dhacaysa sababtoo ah kharashyada wax soo saarka iyo saadka sare Dhinacyada daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu booriyay inay raadsadaan xalal hal abuur leh si ay u sii ahaadaan kuwo tartan badan
Dholuo: Oganda mar Kenya ma loso puothe gi puothe romo gi pek mang'eny e piny mangima nikech nengo mag chamo puothe mag puothego kod mag gik mitimo e pinyno.

English: Notice: TSC opens applications for revision guides for learners in Kajiado County.

Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay furaysaa codsiyada hagaha dib-u-eegista ardayda degmada Kajiado.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TSC oseyawo kwayo mag somo mar somo ne jopuonjre man Kajiado County.

English: Research on systemic barriers towards access and usage of housing finance in Kenya
Kiswahili: Utafiti kuhusu vikwazo vya kimfumo kuelekea upatikanaji na matumizi ya fedha za makazi nchini Kenya
Somali: Cilmi-baaris ku saabsan caqabadaha nidaamsan ee ku wajahan helitaanka iyo isticmaalka maaliyadda guryaha ee Kenya
Dholuo: Nonro kuom obadho madongo mag yudo kod tiyo kod pesa mag gedo e piny Kenya

English: CDC encourages mothers in Kilifi County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kilifi inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo mine man Kilifi County mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Kenyan youth can gain international farm experience by applying for the Seasonal Workers Scheme SWS in the UK Interested individuals should contact the Kenya School of Agriculture for details
Kiswahili: Vijana wa Kenya wanaweza kupata uzoefu wa shamba la kimataifa kwa kutuma ombi la Mpango wa Wafanyikazi wa Msimu SWS nchini Uingereza Watu wanaovutiwa wanapaswa kuwasiliana na Shule ya Kilimo ya Kenya kwa maelezo zaidi.
Somali: Dhalinyarada Kenya waxay heli karaan khibrad caalami ah oo beeraley ah iyagoo codsanaya Barnaamijka Shaqaalaha Xilliyada SWS ee UK. Dadka xiiseynaya waa inay la xiriiraan Kenya School of Agriculture si faahfaahin ah
Dholuo: Rowere mag Kenya nyalo yudo lony e tij pur e pinje mamoko kuom kwayo mondo giyud thuolo mar tiyo e program mar SWS mar Jotich ma Tiyo e Kinde Oganda e piny UK

English: Notice: NCPB restricts movement of cattle in Trans Nzoia County due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB inazuia harakati za ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Newcastle.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da Gobolka Trans Nzoia sababo la xiriira cudurka Newcastle.
Dholuo: Rapar: NCPB ogeng'o wuoth mar jamni e Trans Nzoia County nikech tuo mar Newcastle.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties encourages first-time voters in Kajiado County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kajiado County kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Kajiado inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties ojiwo joma okwongo yiero e Kajiado County mondo onon weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: SHA urges eligible citizens in Samburu County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawahimiza wananchi wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Samburu kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Samburu inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jokanyo mowinjore e county mar Samburu mondo oriwgi e kwedo josiasa.

English: Notice from Division of Disease Surveillance and Response: postnatal check-ups clinics will run every September at designated health centres in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa: kliniki za uchunguzi wa baada ya kuzaa zitafanya kazi kila Septemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka socda qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada: xarumaha baaritaanka dhalmada ka dib ayaa la qaban doonaa bishii Sebtember ee xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo: Klinike mag nonro bang' nyuol ibiro timie higa ka higa e dwe mar Septemba e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Baringo.

English: TVET advises students in Vihiga County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata vitabu vya kiada na nyenzo za kujifunzia.
Somali: TVET waxay ardayda degmada Vihiga kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan buugaag iyo qalab waxbarasho.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jopuonjre e County mar Vihiga mondo oketgi e intanet mondo giyud buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok.

English: Notice: KMTC opens applications for school laptops under the digital literacy programme for learners in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC yafungua maombi ya kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay furaysaa codsiyada kumbuyuutarrada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee ardayda degmada Nairobi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KMTC oyawo kwayo mag kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar somo kod somo mar digital ne jopuonjre man Nairobi County.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service opens a gender desk offering free legal aid in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafungua ofisi ya kijinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisheria bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu furayaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah degmada Meru.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Forest Service ochako ofis ma chiwo kony mar chike maonge chudo e county mar Meru.

English: KMTC conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Bomet County this October.
Kiswahili: KMTC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Bomet Oktoba hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda gobolka ee gobolka Bomet bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KMTC dhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda e dwe mar Oktoba e kaunti mar Bomet County.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inafungua maombi ya maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali bila malipo kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay u furaysaa codsiyada barashada bilaashka ah ee barayaasha degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar State Department for TVET oyawo kwayo mag somo mar digital maonge chudo ne jopuonjre e County mar Nyeri.

English: EACC encourages first-time voters in Siaya County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: EACC inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Siaya kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: EACC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Siaya inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jogo matimoga yiero mokwongo e county mar Siaya mondo oting'e ID kata pasi mar piny mangima e odiechieng'no mar timo yiero.

English: Let us heed the wise counsel by His Excellency the President to; wash our hands regularly, wear a face mask, maintain social distance #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Tuzingatie ushauri wa busara wa Mheshimiwa Rais; kunawa mikono mara kwa mara, kuvaa barakoa, kudumisha umbali wa kijamii #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Aan raacno talada xikmadda leh ee uu soo jeediyay Mudane Madaxweyne; in aan si joogto ah gacmaha u dhaqno, aan xirno maaskaro wejiga ah, aan ilaalino kala fogaanshaha bulshada #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Wawinjo rieko mar rieko ma Jatend Pinyruoth omiyowa ni; lwoko lwetewa kinde ka kinde, rwak mask mar wang', warit mabor gi jowetewa #KomeshaCorona

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee degmada Murang'a.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura mar Kenya biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e County mar Murang'a.

English: Notice: IPOA opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Turkana County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa simu ya GBV ya bure katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ee degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA oseyawo ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo chenro mar tiyo gi simo maonge chudo mar GBV e County mar Turkana.

English: Farmers and business people in Asia-Pacific have progressed their agriculture Through digital technology. IFSD and Grow Asia they recently released...
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wafanyabiashara katika Asia-Pasifiki wameendeleza kilimo chao Kupitia teknolojia ya dijiti. IFSD na Grow Asia walitoa hivi karibuni...
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo ganacsatada Asia-Pacific waxay horumariyeen beeraha iyagoo adeegsanaya tiknoolajiyada dijitaalka ah. IFSD iyo Grow Asia oo dhawaan la sii daayay...
Dholuo: Jo-Purasia kod jo ohala e piny Asia Pacific osejiwo tijgi mar pur kokalo kuom teknoloji mar digital.

English: Agriculture is one sector out to combart hunger, poverty, diseases which we encounter, if we don't feed enough nutrients into our bodies. Nevertheless, there's notable changes.
Kiswahili: Kilimo ni sekta moja ya kuchana njaa, umaskini, magonjwa ambayo tunakutana nayo, ikiwa hatutalisha virutubisho vya kutosha katika miili yetu. Hata hivyo, kuna mabadiliko makubwa.

Dholuo: Tij pur en achiel kuom yore mag kedo gi kech, dhier, kod tuoche ma waromogo, ka ok wamiyo ringrewa gik ma kelonwa chiemo moromo.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Red Cross will be held in Vihiga County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Degmada Vihiga bisha April.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kamp mar thieth ma Kenya Red Cross ochano ibiro tim e County mar Vihiga e dwe mar April.

English: NCPB promotes terracing among farmers in Nyandarua County as part of the November climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: NCPB inakuza usafirishaji kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Novemba.
Somali: NCPB waxay dhiirrigelisay dhulka beeraleyda gobolka Nyandarua iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka u adkeynta cimilada ee bisha Nofeembar.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo chamo puothe e kind jopur e County mar Nyandarua kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Council of Governors announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku dhawaaqeen waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch ogolo lokruok e seche mag kwayo kwayo mar yudo nying mar ng'at manie County mar Vihiga.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges residents of Nairobi County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Uhalifu unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa umakini mkubwa wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nabadgelyada qaranka.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo jogweng' mar Nairobi County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi kuom loso kuwe.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges residents of Turkana County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Turkana watumie portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Turkana mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo kwayo mar kwedo timbe mag mibadhi.

English: Notice: IEBC reminds citizens in Mombasa County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Mombasa xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC paronwa raia mag Mombasa County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo gi ratiro kaluwore gi chik.

English: DPP warns residents of Meru County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: DPP inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: DPP waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru kororka khiyaamada SIM-swap waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: DPP osiemo jogweng'o mag Meru County kuom wach medruok mar wuond mag SIM-swap kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: Taxes and rules which suppress farming like this way: government marginalizing other regions together with biasness,

English: Kenya: 2025 MSNI Bulletin, November 2025
Kiswahili: Kenya: 2025 MSNI Bulletin, Novemba 2025
Somali: Kenya: 2025 MSNI Bulletin, Noofambar 2025
Dholuo: Kenya: Oboke mar MSNI higa mar 2025, dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2025

English: NPS reminds mobile money users in Kakamega County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha watumiaji wa fedha za simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa pesa za simu.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee Gobolka Kakamega inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: NPS paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni mondo ginyis jomisonari maggi weche maok adier mondo kik gitim timbe mag mibadhi.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Tana River County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Tana River kumtia moyo rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Tana River in uu dhiirrigeliyo saaxiibkiisa dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi tuwo mar paro e taon mar Tana River County mondo ojiw osiepne moro ma chandore omany kony.

English: KEPHIS warns coffee farmers in Wajir County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawaonya wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Wajir juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda kafeega ee Gobolka Wajir cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda ah.
Dholuo: KEPHIS chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho chai e gweng' mar Wajir kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds the public in Machakos County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this March.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba ushiriki katika mashauriano ya sera za umma unakaribishwa Machi hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) ayaa xasuusinaya shacabka degmada Machakos in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha lagu soo dhaweynayo bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone ji duto e county mar Machakos ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mag sirkal e dwe mar Mach.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the community in Tana River County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb theft.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Tana River County inay ka warbixiyaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo shaki leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto manie taon mar Tana River County mondo ochiw ripot ne polis man machiegni mondo gikwed nek.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds expectant mothers in Uasin Gishu County that access to skilled birth attendance is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba ufikiaji wa mahudhurio ya uzazi wenye ujuzi ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Uasin Gishu in helitaanka daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfadlayaasha ah ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche parone mine ma biro nyuolo nyithindo e county mar Uasin Gishu ni thuolo mar yudo nyithindo ma nigi lony en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag sirkal.

English: NPS urges the public in Nyandarua County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: NPS inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: NPS waxay ugu baaqeysaa shacabka degmada Nyandarua inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qof kasta oo ka dambeeya kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: NPS ojiwo ji duto e County mar Nyandarua mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo weche ma nyiso ni ne giyudo ote mag phishing.

English: COMESA reminds residents of Garissa County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Somali: COMESA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Garissa in ilaalinta ciidda ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: COMESA paronwa jogweng' mar County mar Garissa ni rito lowo miyo puothe bedo gi nyak maber kuom kinde malach.

English: Notice: ODPP launches the county integrated development plan in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika Wilaya ya Tana River.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay bilawday qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Tana River.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: ODPP chako chenro mar timo dongruok e alwora mar Tana River County.

English: OGP urges eligible citizens in Vihiga County to participate in polling procedures.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kushiriki katika utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Vihiga inay ka qaybqaataan nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jokanyo mowinjore e county mar Vihiga mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag yiero.

English: Ministry of Health urges residents of West Pokot County to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility following a rise in reported malaria cases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya malaria vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay isla markiiba baaritaano ka sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow ka dib kororka kiisaska cudurka daacuunka.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health ojiwo jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal mar thieth man machiegni kodgi bang' medruok mar tuo mar malaria.

English: KEPHIS promotes soil conservation among farmers in Nyeri County as part of the September climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inakuza uhifadhi wa udongo miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Septemba.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay dhiirrigelisay ilaalinta ciidda beeraleyda degmada Nyeri iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo rito lowo e kind jopur e County mar Nyeri kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo kinda mar kedo gi tuoche mag yamo e dwe mar Septemba.

English: NTSA urges the public in Bomet County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of identity theft.
Kiswahili: NTSA inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha degmada Bomet inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee tuugista aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo ji duto e county mar Bomet mondo ochiw ripot mar ote manyalo kelo hinyruok ne jomisonari margi bang' weche mag kwalo kitgi.

English: DCI warns residents of Nandi County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: DCI inaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi juu ya kuongezeka kwa kashfa za pesa za rununu na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kutenda.
Somali: DCI waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan gobolka Nandi kororka khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobilada waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax qabanin.
Dholuo: DCI osiemo jogweng' Nandi County kuom medruok mar timbe mag wuondo pesa mag simo kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: Teachers Service Commission encourages residents of Samburu County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kukaa na habari juu ya jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Samburu inay ka qeybgalaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Samburu mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiego ji mondo ging'e tich mar Ombudsman.

English: KRA advises residents of Vihiga County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: KRA inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Somali: KRA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan shahaadada dhalashada.
Dholuo: KRA nyiso ji modak e County mar Vihiga mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro yudo barua mar nyuol.

English: Ministry of Education invites youth in Isiolo County to enroll for tailoring and design training this March.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni Machi hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Isiolo inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka tailoring iyo naqshadeynta bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok gwelo rowere e kaunti mar Isiolo mondo odonj e tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko e dwe mar Mach.

English: KICD advises students in Turkana County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access revision guides.
Kiswahili: KICD inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Turkana kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya udhamini mkondoni ili kupata miongozo ya marekebisho.
Somali: KICD waxay kula talineysaa ardayda degmada Turkana inay dalbadaan bogga waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan tilmaamaha dib-u-eegista.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo jopuonjre e County mar Turkana mondo oketgi e websait mar somo ma yudore e Intanet.

English: KEMRI advises residents of Turkana County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa usaidizi wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMRI waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow si ay uga caawiyaan helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ee lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMRI nyiso jogweng' Turkana County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni mondo giyud kony mar yudo kony kuom weche thieth.

English: Notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Garissa County this January. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Garissa Januari hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay qabaneysaa madasha caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada ee Gobolka Garissa bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuoche biro timo romo mar paro ne rowere e taon mar Garissa e dwe mar Januar.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Tana River County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Tana River inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e taon mar Tana River County mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: OGP announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: OGP inatangaza nyakati bora za kurejesha huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Somali: OGP waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee degmada Kiambu.
Dholuo: OGP olando lokruok e seche mag tiyo gi passport e County mar Kiambu.

English: KEMSA urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Kirinyaga County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Kirinyaga inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar tuoche mag pach e County mar Kirinyaga mondo oluong kony mar thieth mar pach maonge chudo.

English: Across many Kenyan communities, and within Africa at large, women hold the primary responsibility for managing essential family needs such as water, food, fuel and healthcare.
Kiswahili: Katika jamii nyingi za Kenya, na ndani ya Afrika kwa ujumla, wanawake wana jukumu la msingi la kusimamia mahitaji muhimu ya familia kama vile maji, chakula, mafuta na huduma za afya.
Somali: Bulshooyin badan oo Kenya ah, iyo guud ahaan Afrika, haweenku waxay mas'uul ka yihiin maaraynta baahiyaha qoyska ee muhiimka ah sida biyaha, cuntada, shidaalka iyo daryeelka caafimaadka.
Dholuo: E gwenge mang’eny mag Kenya, kendo e kind Afrika duto, mon ema nigi ting’ maduong’ mar rito dwaro madongo mag joot kaka pi, chiemo, mafuta kod thieth.

English: AFA advises milk producers in Garissa County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: AFA inashauri wazalishaji wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Garissa kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: AFA waxay kula talineysaa soosaarayaasha caanaha ee degmada Garissa inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: AFA nyiso jopur mag chak e gweng' mar Garissa mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: State Department for Basic Education reminds parents in Nyamira County that free day secondary education registration is open this December.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba usajili wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo umefunguliwa Desemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Nyamira in diiwaangelinta dugsiga dhexe ee bilaashka ah ay furan tahay bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education oparo ne jonyuol e County mar Nyamira ni somo mar sekondari mar odiechieng' maonge chudo osechakore e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Cerfical cancer is treatable once discovered one month early, lets unite to to amplify awareness, promote research and plans to prevent it
Kiswahili: Saratani ya utumbo inaweza kutibiwa mara tu kugunduliwa mwezi mmoja mapema, inaruhusu kuungana ili kuongeza ufahamu, kukuza utafiti na mipango ya kuzuia
Somali: Kansarka uurka ayaa la daaweyn karaa marka la ogaado bil ka hor, waxay u oggolaaneysaa in la mideeyo si loo kordhiyo wacyiga, horumarinta cilmi baarista iyo qorshayaasha looga hortago
Dholuo: Kanser mar obwongo inyalo thiedh bang ' fwenyore dwe achiel motelo, omiyo ji duto nyalo riwore mondo gimi ji ong'e, gitim nonro, kendo gitim chenro mar geng'o kansa.

English: NPS urges the community in Tana River County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb theft.
Kiswahili: NPS inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Tana River County inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo oganda man Tana River County mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo gikwed nek.

English: State Department for Basic Education calls on the community in Siaya County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa usimamizi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Siaya inay u soo wargeliyaan mas'uuliyadda iskuulka wixii dhibaato ah ee ku saabsan amniga si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education okwayo ji duto e county mar Siaya mondo onyis sirkal mar skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: The Nairobi Coffee Exchange reports that the recent auction sold 412 tonnes of coffee translating to a gross return of KES 129 per kilogram of cherry
Kiswahili: Soko la Kahawa la Nairobi linaripoti kwamba mnada wa hivi majuzi uliuza tani 412 za kahawa ikimaanisha kurudi kwa KES 129 kwa kila kilo ya cherry.
Somali: Nairobi Coffee Exchange ayaa soo warisay in xaraashkii dhawaan la iibiyay 412 tan oo kafeega ah, taasoo u dhiganta soo celin guud oo ah KES 129 halkii kiilo kiilo gaaban oo cherry ah
Dholuo: Nairobi Coffee Exchange wacho ni e chiro ma nyocha otim, ne ouso ton 412 mag chai, ma ne kelo pesa ma romo KES 129 kuom kilo achiel mar cilieny

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges motorists and pedestrians in Trans Nzoia County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Trans Nzoia inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo jorit mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo oluw chike mag golo ji moa kuonde ma ji odakie mondo gikwed masiche ma timore nikech ataro.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds residents of Trans Nzoia County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia in ka qaybgalka maamulaha degmada ay xoojinayaan maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette paronwa jogweng' Trans Nzoia County ni tudruok gi jorit mar gwenge maggi miyo sirkal bedo gi loch maber.

English: ASAL Humanitarian Network MPCT New Beneficiaries Baseline Assessment, Turkana County (January 2022)
Kiswahili: Mtandao wa Kibinadamu wa ASAL MPCT Tathmini ya Msingi ya Walengwa Wapya, Kaunti ya Turkana (Januari 2022)
Somali: Qiimaynta Aasaasiga ah ee Ka-faa'iideystayaasha Cusub ee Shabakadda Bani'aadamnimada ee ASAL MPCT, Degmada Turkana (Janaayo 2022)
Dholuo: Ranyisi mar jogo mabiro yudo ber manyien mag ASAL (Dwe mar achiel higa mar 2022)

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit announces eye and dental camps for residents of Makueni County starting this June.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inatangaza kambi za macho na meno kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kuanzia Juni hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa ku dhawaaqday xeryo indhaha iyo ilkaha loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Makueni laga bilaabo Juun.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ogolo kambi mag neno kendo thieth mag lakteche ne joma odak e Kaunti mar Makueni kochakore dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya opens polling procedures centres in Embu County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Embu Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay furaysaa xarumaha nidaamyada codbixinta ee degmada Embu bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Huduma Kenya chako timo yiero e dwe mar Januar e kaunti mar Embu.

English: Dadaab Future Vision: Enhancing Self-Reliance for Refugees and Hosting Communities in Garissa, Kenya (August 2022)
Kiswahili: Maono ya Baadaye ya Dadaab: Kuimarisha Kujitegemea kwa Wakimbizi na Jamii zinazowahifadhi huko Garissa, Kenya (Agosti 2022)
Somali: Aragtida Mustaqbalka ee Dadaab: Horumarinta Isku-kalsoonida Qaxootiga iyo Bulshooyinka Marti-gelinta ah ee Garissa, Kenya (Agoosto 2022)
Dholuo: Neno mar Dadaab mabiro: Medo geno mar jolweny kod oganda ma rwako jodak e garissa, Kenya (Agost 2022)

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free youth mental wellness support is available through county health facilities in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa afya ya akili ya vijana unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo ne rowere e weche mag thieth mar pach yudore maonge chudo kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Siaya.

English: Some cultural practices during pregnancy and childbirth may endanger lives. Communities are urged to adopt evidence-based health practices.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya desturi za kitamaduni wakati wa ujauzito na kujifungua zinaweza kuhatarisha maisha. Jamii zinahimizwa kufuata desturi za kiafya zinazotegemea ushahidi.
Somali: Caadooyinka dhaqanka qaarkood inta lagu jiro uurka iyo dhalmada ayaa khatar gelin kara nolosha. Bulshooyinka waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay qaataan caadooyin caafimaad oo ku saleysan caddaynta.
Dholuo: Moko kuom timbe ma ji timo e kinde mag ich kod nyuol nyalo miyo ngima ng'ato obed kama rach.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds residents of Murang'a County that agroforestry improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba kilimo cha misitu kinaboresha uzalishaji wa muda mrefu wa shamba.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a in beeraha beeraha ah uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board parone jogweng' mar Murang'a County ni agroforestry medo nyak mar pur kuom kinde malach.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Kilifi County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the February planting season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Februari.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kilifi inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka dayrta iyagoo isticmaalaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Febraayo.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e County mar Kilifi mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e chak higa kapok ndalo mar pidho kodhi ochopo e dwe mar Februar.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development encourages residents of Bomet County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Machadka Horumarinta Manhajka Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay ka qeybgalaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan kaqeybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo jogweng' County mar Bomet mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda mondo gibed gi ng'eyo kuom kaka ji biro tiyo gi bajet mar county.

English: TSC announces distribution of revision guides to schools in Kwale County this February.
Kiswahili: TSC inatangaza usambazaji wa miongozo ya marekebisho kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kwale Februari hii.
Somali: TSC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta hagaha dib u eegista dugsiyada Gobolka Kwale bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: TSC olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag somo e skunde man Kwale County e dwe mar Februar.

English: KRA reminds residents of Kitui County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kitui wanaohudhuria mkutano wa umma wa wilaya kuimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kitui ee ka qeybgalaya kalfadhiga guud ee shirka gobolka ayaa xoojinaya maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: KRA paronwa jogweng' Kitui County ma biro e chokruok maduong' mar county assembly mondo omed jiwo sirkal.

English: FAO advises avocado producers in Kisumu County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: FAO inashauri wazalishaji wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: FAO waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha avocado ee degmada Kisumu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma loso avocado e gweng' mar Kisumu mondo odonj e riwruok ma nigi ratiro mar tiyo gi ohala kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: EACC forms school clubs to nurture anti-corruption values.
Kiswahili: EACC inaunda vilabu vya shule ili kukuza maadili ya kupambana na ufisadi.
Somali: EACC waxay samaysaa kooxaha dugsiyada si ay u kobciyaan qiimaha la dagaalanka musuqmaasuqa.
Dholuo: EACC loso riwruoge mag skul mondo gipuonjre kedo gi mibadhi.

English: Notice: KUCCPS opens a new tailoring and design programme at the vocational centre in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inafungua programu mpya ya ushonaji na usanifu katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay ka furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan dharka iyo naqshadeynta xarunta xirfadaha ee gobolka Mombasa.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KUCCPS chako chenro manyien mar loso kendo loso gik moko e skul mar tich e county mar Mombasa.

English: As 2025 unfolded amid growing regional uncertainty and humanitarian challenges, the ICRC Nairobi Regional Delegation continued to work alongside partners and communities to uphold humanity where it was needed most.
Kiswahili: Mwaka wa 2025 ulipoendelea huku kukiwa na hali ya kutokuwa na uhakika na changamoto za kibinadamu zinazoongezeka kikanda, Ujumbe wa ICRC wa Mkoa wa Nairobi uliendelea kufanya kazi pamoja na washirika na jamii ili kudumisha ubinadamu mahali palipohitajika zaidi.
Somali: Iyadoo 2025 ay soo ifbaxday iyadoo ay sii kordheyso hubanti la'aanta gobolka iyo caqabadaha bani'aadamnimada, Ergada Gobolka ee ICRC Nairobi waxay sii wadeen inay la shaqeeyaan la-hawlgalayaasha iyo bulshooyinka si ay u taageeraan aadanaha meesha ugu baahida badan.
Dholuo: Ka higa mar 2025 ne dhi nyime e kind ng’anjo ma medore e alwora kod pek mag konyo dhano, Jotelo mag ICRC ma Nairobi ne dhi nyime tiyo kanyakla gi jowetegi kod oganda mondo orit dhano kama ne dwarore ahinya.

English: NPS reminds residents of Samburu County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Samburu in warbixinta degdegga ah ee xanta xoolaha ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NPS oparo ne jogweng' mar Samburu County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo jamni konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Nakuru County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti hiyo ili kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja wa kaunti.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng' Nakuru County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mar dongruok e county.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission reminds citizens in Kiambu County about their rights regarding the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhusu haki zao kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu muwaadiniinta degmada Kiambu xasuusinayaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj parone raia mag Kaunti mar Kiambu ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo ombudsman.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development invites farmers in Tana River County to a free training on record keeping for farmers this May.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River kwa mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima Mei hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku casuumaysaa beeraleyda degmada Tana River inay tababar lacag la'aan ah ku helaan diiwaangelinta beeralayda bisha May.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ogwelo jopur manie Tana River County mondo otim tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi rito rekod mag jopur e dwe mar Mei.

English: Wajir County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Wajir: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Mei 2024
Somali: Degmada Wajeer: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Wajir: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar abich 2024

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) launches an October awareness campaign on proper sanitation across Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Oktoba juu ya usafi wa mazingira katika Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa bilaabay olole wacyi galineed bishii Oktoobar oo ku saabsan nadaafadda saxda ah ee Gobolka Murang'a.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Oktoba e wi thieth mowinjore e County duto mar Murang'a.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Busia County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba ufikiaji wa msaada wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Busia in helitaanka taageerada sheegashada NHIF / SHA ay hadda ka heli karto xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne ji duto e County mar Busia ni kony mar kwayo kwayo mag NHIF/SHA sani yudore e kuonde moyier.

English: The Social and Economic Impact of COVID-19 Policy Responses on Women Working in the Informal Urban Economy in Kenya
Kiswahili: Athari za Kijamii na Kiuchumi za Majibu ya Sera ya COVID-19 kwa Wanawake Wanaofanya Kazi katika Uchumi Usio Rasmi wa Mijini nchini Kenya.
Somali: Saamaynta Bulshada iyo Dhaqaalaha ee Jawaabaha Siyaasadda ee COVID-19 ee Haweenka ka Shaqeeya Dhaqaalaha Magaalooyinka ee aan Rasmiga ahayn ee Kenya
Dholuo: Bedo gi weche mag ngima kod weche mag ohala mag duoko mag chike mag COVID-19 kuom mon matiyo e weche mag ohala ma ok owinjore mag boma e piny Kenya

English: CDC announces NHIF/SHA claims support for residents of Tana River County starting this November.
Kiswahili: CDC inatangaza NHIF/SHA inadai msaada kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kuanzia Novemba hii.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhawaaqday in NHIF/SHA ay sheegtay in ay taageero u tahay dadka deggan degmada Tana River County laga bilaabo bisha November.
Dholuo: CDC olando ni NHIF/SHA biro chiwo kony ne jogweng' mar Tana River County kochakore Novemba.

English: Notice: KUCCPS opens applications for school laptops under the digital literacy programme for learners in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inafungua maombi ya kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay ardayda degmada Isiolo u furaysaa codsiyada kumbuyuutarrada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska digitalka.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KUCCPS chako tiyo gi kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar somo kod somo mar digital ne jopuonjre man Isiolo County.

English: DCI reminds residents of Bungoma County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kufunga na kutunza vizima moto nyumbani na kazini wakati huu wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma in ay guryahooda ku rakibaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo shaqada inta lagu jiro xilliyada shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: DCI parone jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag nego ligek mach e utegi kendo giti e kinde masiche mag ndara.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds expectant mothers in Kakamega County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Kakamega in helitaanka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne mine ma biro bedo gi ich e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni thuolo mar yudo kony mar chano ngima joot en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag oganda.

English: Notice: TVET reminds citizens in Baringo County about their rights regarding the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuhusu haki zao kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Baringo ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET paronwa raia mag Baringo County ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo ombudsman.

English: Farmers using chemical pesticides against Fall armyworm should know when and how to use them safely, and how to store and clean the equipment and protective wear, to protect themselves, their families, and their communities.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaotumia kemikali za kuua wadudu dhidi ya minyoo aina ya Fall na jinsi ya kuzitumia kwa usalama, na jinsi ya kuhifadhi na kusafisha vifaa na nguo za kujikinga, kujilinda wenyewe, familia zao, na jumuiya zao.
Somali: Beeraleyda isticmaala sunta kiimikada ee ka hortagga cayayaan Fall armyworm waa inay ogaadaan goorta iyo sida loo isticmaalo si ammaan ah, iyo sida loo kaydiyo loona nadiifiyo qalabka iyo dharka ilaalinta, si ay naftooda, qoysaskooda, iyo bulshooyinkooda u ilaaliyaan.
Dholuo: Jo-Puriculture ma tiyo gi yedhe mamero mag choko yedhe mamero mag lweny onego ong'e kinde kod kaka ginyalo tiyo kodgi e yo makare, kendo kaka ginyalo kano kendo pwodho gik ma gilosogo kod lewni ma girwako mondo girit ngimagi, joodgi, koda ogandagi.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Ministry of Health will be held in Baringo County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Wizara ya Afya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Baringo Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ay soo qabanqaabisay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa lagu qabanqaabi doonaa Degmada Baringo bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma Ministry of Health ochano ibiro tim Baringo County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Manage agricultural waste responsibly through composting, recycling, or safe disposal methods to minimize environmental impact.
Kiswahili: Dhibiti taka za kilimo kwa uwajibikaji kupitia mboji, kuchakata tena, au njia salama za utupaji ili kupunguza athari za mazingira.
Somali: Si mas'uuliyad leh u maamusho qashinka beeraha adigoo adeegsanaya composting, dib-u-warshadayn, ama habab ammaan ah oo lagu tuuro si loo yareeyo saameynta deegaanka.
Dholuo: Ti gi yore mag choko gik mochido mag puodho e yo maber, ka itiyo gi yore mag choko gik mochido, tiyo gi yore mag choko gik mochido, kata tiyo gi yore mag choko gik mochido mondo omi okethre ahinya.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission opens a new motor vehicle mechanics programme at the vocational centre in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yafungua programu mpya ya ufundi wa magari katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ka furayaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan farsamada gawaarida gaadiidka ee xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Nairobi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj chako chenro manyien mar tiyo gi masinde mag riembo mtokni e kar tiegruok e taon mar Nairobi.

English: Notice: COMESA restricts movement of sheep in West Pokot County due to a rabies outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA inazuia harakati za kondoo katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kwa sababu ya mlipuko wa kichaa cha mbwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa idaha ee Gobolka West Pokot sababo la xiriira cudurka qabyaalada.
Dholuo: Rapar: COMESA ogeng'o wuoth mar rombe e West Pokot County nikech tuwo mar rabies.

English: DPP urges motorists and pedestrians in Kitui County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent landslides-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DPP anawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa gawaarida wadayaasha iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Kitui inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada fatahaada ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira dhulgariirka.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo joidh mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Kitui mondo kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o mondo kik gidonj e masiche mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will train farmers in Nandi County on soil conservation this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi juu ya uhifadhi wa udongo Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa tababar siin doonta beeraleyda gobolka Nandi ee ku saabsan ilaalinta ciidda bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ne: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro tiego jopur e County mar Nandi e wi rito lowo e dwe mar Januar.

English: Teenage mothers are at higher risk of complications. Encourage young girls to stay in school and delay pregnancy.
Kiswahili: Akina mama vijana wako katika hatari kubwa ya kupata matatizo. Wahimize wasichana wadogo kuendelea na shule na kuchelewesha ujauzito.
Somali: Hooyooyinka dhallinyarada ah waxay halis ugu jiraan inay qabaan dhibaatooyin badan. Gabdhaha yaryar ku dhiirigeliso inay iskuulka sii joogaan oo ay uurka dib u dhigaan.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma rowere nyalo bedo gi tuoche mang'eny, omiyo jiwuru mon matindo mondo odhi nyime gi dhi e skul kendo giter ich bang'e.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross issues a cybersecurity alert on mobile money scams affecting residents of Embu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya umetoa onyo la usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu zinazoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaanooyinka lacagta mobile ee saameynaya dadka deggan degmada Embu.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ripot Mamit mar Kenya ogolo siem e wi weche mag cybersecurity e wi timbe mag wuondo joma odak e county mar Embu.

English: Conflict-sensitive adaptation governance: Assessing Kenyaâ€™s County Climate Change Fund
Kiswahili: Utawala wa kukabiliana na mizozo: Kutathmini Hazina ya Kaunti ya Kenya ya Mabadiliko ya Tabianchi
Somali: Maamulka la qabsiga xasaasiga ah ee khilaafaadka: Qiimaynta Sanduuqa Isbeddelka Cimilada ee Degmada Kenya
Dholuo: Chik ma luwo lweny: Rango pesa mag loko kor piny e piny Kenya

Kiswahili: Kenya : IFRC imepata ufadhili wa milioni 15 wa hali ya hewa na hali ya hewa ambayo ni ya mamilioni ya watu au bord du gouffre. | IFRC
