English: Members contribute a portion of their savings toward the selected activity, while Acted provides matching support or the materials required, based on the needs outlined in the proposal.
Kiswahili: Wanachama huchangia sehemu ya akiba zao kwa shughuli iliyochaguliwa, huku Acted inatoa usaidizi unaolingana au nyenzo zinazohitajika, kulingana na mahitaji yaliyoainishwa katika pendekezo.
Somali: Xubnuhu waxay qayb ka mid ah keydkooda ku bixiyaan hawsha la doortay, halka Acted uu bixiyo taageero isku mid ah ama agabka loo baahan yahay, iyadoo lagu saleynayo baahiyaha lagu qeexay soo jeedinta.
Dholuo: Jokanyo chiwo pesa moko ma giserito mondo otimgo tich ma oyier, to Acted chiwo kony ma chalre kata gik ma dwarore, kaluwore gi dwaro ma ondik e paro.

English: IEBC urges youth in Murang'a County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Murang'a inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo rowere e County mar Murang'a mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gitimo gik ma biro timore ne oganda.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board restricts movement of cattle in Makueni County due to an anthrax outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inazuia harakati za ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Makueni kutokana na mlipuko wa kimeta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka ayaa xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da Gobolka Makueni sababo la xiriira cudurka anthrax.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Bura mar Locho e Wi Yien mag Chwero Gik Makelo Hinyruok (Pest Control Products Board) ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok e gweng' mar Makueni nikech tuwo mar anthrax.

English: Do you know that kenya Red Cross Society has free advisory services by calling 24/7? Call us through 1199 we are there because of you. Koru january-June 2019, our medical team on mental health and psychosocial baakeirwe chisimi 513
Kiswahili: Je, unajua kwamba Kenya Red Cross Society ina huduma za ushauri bure kwa kupiga 24/7? tupigie simu kupitia 1199 tuko hapo kwa sababu yako. Koru Januari-Juni 2019, timu yetu ya matibabu juu ya afya ya akili na psychosocial baakeirwe chisimi 513
Somali: Miyaad ogtahay in Kenya Red Cross Society ay leedahay adeegyo la-talin oo bilaash ah adoo wacaya 24/7? na soo wac 1199 waxaan halkaa u joognaa sababtoo ah Koru Janaayo-Juun 2019, kooxdeena caafimaad ee caafimaadka dhimirka iyo cilmu-nafsiga baakeirwe chisimi 513
Dholuo: Be ing'eyo ni Kenya Red Cross Society nigi kony ma onge chudo kuom goyo simu 24/7? luongwa e 1199 wan kanyo nikech in. Koru Januar-June 2019, timwa mar thieth e weche thieth mar pach kod paro mar ji baakeirwe chisimi 513

English: Nyeri County is privatizing its fish processing plant to enhance youth employment in fisheries Youth groups interested in aquaculture can access training and support for business development
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Nyeri inabinafsisha kiwanda chake cha kuchakata samaki ili kuongeza ajira kwa vijana katika uvuvi Vikundi vya vijana wanaopenda ufugaji wa samaki wanaweza kupata mafunzo na usaidizi kwa maendeleo ya biashara.
Somali: Gobolka Nyeri ayaa gaarka loo dhigayo warshadiisa ka baaraandegista kalluunka si loo kordhiyo shaqaalaynta dhalinyarada ee kalluumaysiga Kooxaha dhalinyarada ah ee xiiseynaya kalluumaysiga waxay heli karaan tababar iyo taageero horumarinta ganacsiga
Dholuo: County mar Nyeri dhiyo e kend mar kambi mar loso rech mondo okony rowere obed gi tich e weche mag rech Rowere mohero pur pi pi nyalo yudo tiegruok kod kony e timo dongruok mar ohala

English: Through this action, the KCC aims to reinforce its role as a provider of flexible, efficient humanitarian assistance, leveraging strong partnerships and coordination to maximise impact, strengthen resilience, and advance a more coherent and forward-looking response to recurrent crises in Kenya.
Kiswahili: Kupitia hatua hii, KCC inalenga kuimarisha jukumu lake kama mtoaji wa usaidizi wa kibinadamu unaobadilika na unaofaa, kutumia ushirikiano dhabiti na uratibu ili kuongeza athari, kuimarisha uthabiti, na kuendeleza mwitikio thabiti na unaotazamia mbele zaidi kwa mizozo ya mara kwa mara nchini Kenya.
Somali: Tallaabadan, KCC waxay higsaneysaa inay xoojiso doorkeeda ah inay bixiso gargaar bani'aadamnimo oo dabacsan oo hufan, iyadoo adeegsaneysa iskaashi xooggan iyo isku-dubarid si loo kordhiyo saameynta, loo xoojiyo adkeysiga, loona hormariyo jawaab isku xiran oo mustaqbalka fog ah oo loogu talagalay dhibaatooyinka soo noqnoqda ee ka jira Kenya.
Dholuo: Kokalo kuom timni, KCC nigi gombo mar keto teko kuom tich mare kaka jachiw kony ma nyalo lokore kendo matiyo maber, ka otiyo gi riwruok motegno kod riwruok mondo omed dwoko, ojing’ ng’iyo, kendo odhi nyime gi dwoko ma winjore kendo ma neno nyime kuom masira ma nyalo bedoe e piny Kenya.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Horumarinta Manhajka Kenya wuxuu ku dhawaaqay taariikhda diiwaangelinta dugsiyada dugsiga sare ee Kirinyaga County.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development olando tarik ma ji nyalo donjoe e skul mag Kirinyaga County.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Busia County about the importance of diabetes screening for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Busia kuhusu umuhimu wa uchunguzi wa kisukari kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya ayaa dadka degmada Busia ku xasuusinaya muhiimadda baaritaanka sonkorowga ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association parone ji duto e County mar Busia kuom gimomiyo thieth mar thieth ma thieth miyo ngima joot bedo maber.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross launches a burglary prevention campaign in Murang'a County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada gobolka Murang'a bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ripot Mamit mar Kenya chako kampen mar geng'o jokuoge odonj e boma mar Murang'a e dwe mar Mach.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) warns tea farmers in West Pokot County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaonya wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya West Pokot juu ya mlipuko wa wadudu na inapendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay uga digtay beeraleyda shaaha ee ku nool degmada West Pokot cudurrada cayayaanka, waxayna ku talineysaa in si sax ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho chai e West Pokot County kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) advises residents of Garissa County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Garissa inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Garissa mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom websait mar e-Citizen sama gidwaro yudo kwayo mag ID.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the public in Bungoma County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unashauri umma katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya shacabka degmada Bungoma inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda kadib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada lacagta mobilada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ji duto e Bungoma County mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok adier ne jatendgi mar konyo ji bang' yudo weche mag wuond motudore gi pesa mag simo.

English: Attention banana growers Training on banana value addition is now available to enhance income opportunities and food security Engage with established processing facilities in your area
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa ndizi Makini Mafunzo ya kuongeza thamani ya ndizi sasa yanapatikana ili kuongeza fursa za kipato na usalama wa chakula Shirikiana na vifaa vilivyoanzishwa vya usindikaji katika eneo lako.
Somali: Digniin beeralayda mooska Tababar ku saabsan kordhinta qiimaha mooska hadda waa la heli karaa si loo kordhiyo fursadaha dakhliga iyo amniga cuntada La shaqee xarumaha farsamaynta ee la aasaasay ee deegaankaaga
Dholuo: Chenro mar tiego joma pidho tong' sani yudore mondo omi giyud pesa momedore kendo gibed gi winjruok maber gi chiemo.

English: Stay calm, call for help, and follow safe delivery steps if birth begins unexpectedly.
Kiswahili: Tulia, piga simu kuomba msaada, na fuata hatua salama za kujifungua ikiwa kujifungua kutaanza bila kutarajia.
Somali: Iska daaya, caawimaad u yeedha, oo raac tallaabooyinka badbaadada dhalmada haddii dhalmada ay bilaabato si lama filaan ah.
Dholuo: Bed ng'at mokuwe, ywak mondo okonyi, kendo tim kaka inyalo ka ichako nyuol e yo ma ok ing'eyo.

English: KTDA urges farmers in Kilifi County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kilifi inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo opidh olembe ma nyalo miyo lowo okethre mondo omi girit lokruok e koth.

English: KEPHIS urges farmers in Uasin Gishu County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Uasin Gishu inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo lagu soo ururiyo biyaha beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit launches a January awareness campaign on safe water storage across Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kizindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Januari juu ya uhifadhi wa maji salama katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Janaayo oo ku saabsan kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osechako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Januar kuom wach kano pi maler e alwora mar Elgeyo-Marakwet County.

English: DCI reminds mobile money users in Nyeri County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka ujumbe wa udanganyifu.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Nyeri inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna si looga fogaado fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: DCI paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e County mar Nyeri ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo gitang' gi weche mag phishing.

English: SHA reminds residents of Kwale County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale wanaohudhuria mkutano wa umma wa kusanyiko la kaunti kuimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale ee ka qeybgalaya kalfadhiga guud ee shirka degmada ayaa xoojinaya maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: SHA paronwa jogweng' mar Kwale County ma biro e chokruok maduong' mar county Assembly mondo omed jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Ministry of health has confirmed the first coronavirus case in Kenya. The Kenyan citizen returning from the US to Nairobi via London on 5th March. She was confirmed positive by the national influenza lab. However, the patient is stable
Kiswahili: Wizara ya afya imethibitisha kisa cha kwanza cha virusi vya corona nchini Kenya. Raia huyo wa Kenya anarudi kutoka Marekani hadi Nairobi kupitia London mnamo Machi 5. Alithibitishwa kuwa na virusi hivyo na maabara ya kitaifa ya mafua. Hata hivyo, mgonjwa huyo yuko imara.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa xaqiijisay kiiskii ugu horreeyay ee cudurka Coronavirus ee Kenya. Muwaadinka reer Kenya ayaa ka soo laabtay Mareykanka oo ku soo laabatay Nairobi iyada oo loo marayo London 5-kii Maarso. Waxaa lagu xaqiijiyay in ay qabatay shaybaarka caabuqa ee qaranka. Si kastaba ha noqotee, bukaanku waa xasilloon yahay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth mar Kenya oseyudo ng'at ma nokwongo yudo tuo mar corona e piny Kenya. Nyaminwa ma Kenya duogo Nairobi koa Amerka koluwo London tarik 5 dwe mar Mach.

English: EACC advises residents of Embu County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: EACC inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: EACC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay dalbadaan internetka iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jogweng' Embu County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro kwayo mag ID mar piny.

English: Huduma Kenya warns public officers in Kirinyaga County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga dhidi ya udanganyifu wa fedha za umma.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Kirinyaga inay ka xishoodaan dhaqaale dawladeed.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e County mar Kirinyaga ni kik giti gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo e yo marach.

English: Marsabit County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Marsabit: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Aprili 2022
Somali: Degmada Marsabit: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Marsabit: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Ang'wen 2022

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds expectant mothers in Bomet County that access to skilled birth attendance is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba upatikanaji wa mahudhurio ya uzazi wenye ujuzi ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Bomet in helitaanka daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfad leh ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne mine ma biro nyuolo nyithindo e County mar Bomet ni thuolo mar yudo nyithindo ma nigi lony en maonge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges eligible citizens in Tharaka-Nithi County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro mar donjo e county mar Tharaka-Nithi mondo oriwgi e kwedo josiasa.

English: OGP advises residents of Marsabit County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: OGP inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: OGP waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inay qaataan dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado dib u dhac marka la raadinayo codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogweng' mar Marsabit County mondo oting'e buge duto madwarore mondo kik giketh seche ma gidwaro kwayo nying' mar ng'at manie pinygi.

English: Mandera County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Mandera: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2023
Somali: Degmada Mandheera: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Mandera: Oboke Mopinyo mar Oro mar Adek 2023

English: KTDA urges goats farmers in Bomet County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wafugaji wa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa Newcastle vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda orgiga ee degmada Bomet inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska cudurka Newcastle ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur ma pidho diek e county mar Bomet mondo ochiw ripot ne jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth machiegni gi kanyo bang' ka osenyis ni gin gi tuo mar Newcastle.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya launches a carjacking prevention campaign in Narok County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia utekaji nyara katika Kaunti ya Narok Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay bilaabaneysaa olole looga hortago gaadiidka la xaday Gobolka Narok bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chako kampen mar geng'o joma kwalo mtokni e taon mar Narok e dwe mar Desemba.

English: OGP urges residents of Kisii County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada si ay uga warqabaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kisii mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo omed ng'eyo chenro mar dongruok e county.

English: Avocado harvesting for export opens on March 1 2024 Exporters must apply for inspection at least three days prior to shipment and submit their supplier list by February 26 2024
Kiswahili: Uvunaji wa parachichi kwa ajili ya kuuza nje ya nchi utafunguliwa tarehe 1 Machi 2024 Wauzaji bidhaa nje lazima watume maombi ya kukaguliwa angalau siku tatu kabla ya kusafirishwa na kuwasilisha orodha yao ya wasambazaji kufikia tarehe 26 Februari 2024.
Somali: Goosashada avocado-ka ee dhoofinta ayaa furmaya 1da Maarso 2024 Dhoofiyeyaasha waa inay dalbadaan kormeerka ugu yaraan saddex maalmood ka hor rarka waxayna soo gudbiyaan liiska alaab-qeybiyeyaashooda 26ka Febraayo 2024
Dholuo: Yiero mar avocado mar oro oko chako tarik 1 dwe mar adek 2024 Jo ohala nyaka kwayo mondo otim nonro kata odiechienge adek kapok oorgi kendo nyaka gimi kwong'o kwong'o mar jo ohalagi nyaka tarik 26 dwe mar ariyo 2024

English: Communications Authority of Kenya calls on the community in Nyamira County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwa ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Nyamira inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji (Communications Authority of Kenya) dwaro ni ji duto modak e County mar Nyamira mondo owuo e wi timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako, kendo gichiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: KEPHIS reminds livestock keepers in Nyeri County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa za kuponda ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xayawaanka ah ee degmada Nyeri inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KEPHIS paronwa jopur mag jamni e County mar Nyeri mondo ogeng' jamni maggi e kuonde moketi mag nego jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: The 2025 update to the Prevention of Terrorism Act strengthens Kenyaâ€™s capacity to prosecute terrorism.
Kiswahili: Sasisho la 2025 la Sheria ya Kuzuia Ugaidi linaimarisha uwezo wa Kenya wa kushtaki ugaidi.
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta 2025 ee Xeerka Ka Hortagga Argagixisada waxay xoojinaysaa awoodda Kenya ee ay ku maxkamadeyn karto argagixisada.
Dholuo: 2025 ma oket lokruok e chik mar geng'o tim mag terruok miyo piny Kenya bedo gi nyalo mar ng'ado bura ne tim mag terruok.

English: Notice: KTDA will conduct a pest and disease management workshop for farmers in Busia County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itafanya warsha ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan xakamaynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada beeraleyda ee degmada Busia bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KTDA biro timo tiegruok mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche ne jopur e gweng' mar Busia e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service restricts movement of pigs in Nairobi County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya yazuia harakati za nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi wenye uvimbe.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa doofaarka ee Gobolka Nairobi sababo la xiriira faafitaanka cudurka maqaarka.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service ogeng'o wuoth mar le e County mar Nairobi nikech tuwo mar dhoho.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds residents of Mombasa County that reporting carjacking promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba kuripoti utekaji nyara mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan gobolka Mombasa in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan baabuurta la xaday ay gacan ka geystaan in xaafadaha ay nabad qabaan.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne jogweng' mar Mombasa County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo mtoka konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Garissa County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa msaada wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Garissa inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow si ay uga caawiyaan helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ee lacageed.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health nyiso jogweng' mar County mar Garissa mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni mondo giyud kony mar yudo kony kuom weche thieth.

English: Baringo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for December 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Baringo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Desemba 2023
Somali: Degmada Baringo: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Diseembar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Baringo: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2023

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Nyamira County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the September planting season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurudisha uzazi wa udongo kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Septemba.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Nyamira inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda ka hor xilliga beerashada bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e County mar Nyamira mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber kapok ochopo higa mar chwoyo e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Judiciary of Kenya announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya West Pokot.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku dhawaaqay waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee Gobolka West Pokot.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya olando lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mar yudo ng'eyono e West Pokot County.

English: The Galana Kulalu National Food Security Project will focus on producing maize on 10 000 acres starting in February Further preparations for an additional 10 000 acres will begin within 6 months
Kiswahili: Mradi wa Taifa wa Usalama wa Chakula wa Galana Kulalu utajikita katika kuzalisha mahindi kwenye ekari 10,000 kuanzia Februari Maandalizi zaidi ya ekari 10,000 zaidi yataanza ndani ya miezi 6.
Somali: Mashruuca Nabadgelyada Qaranka ee Galana Kulalu wuxuu diiradda saari doonaa soo saarista hadhuudhka 10 000 hektar laga bilaabo Febraayo Diyaarinta dheeriga ah ee 10 000 hektar oo dheeri ah ayaa bilaaban doonta lix bilood gudahood
Dholuo: Chenro mar National Food Security Project mar Galana Kulalu biro jiwo ahinya loso kodhi e wi hekta 10,000 kochakore e dwe mar Februar.

English: Strengthen livestock disease surveillance, vaccination, and treatment programmes to prevent disease outbreaks.
Kiswahili: Imarisha ufuatiliaji wa magonjwa ya mifugo, chanjo, na mipango ya matibabu ili kuzuia milipuko ya magonjwa.
Somali: Xoojinta nidaamyada kormeerka cudurrada xoolaha, tallaalka iyo daaweynta si looga hortago cudurrada cudurka.
Dholuo: Tego chenro mag rito, thiedho, kod thiedho tuoche mag jamni mondo kik tuoche chakore.

English: KEMRI appeals to caregivers in Samburu County to visit their nearest maternity wing as part of the September maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Samburu kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Septemba.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha gobolka Samburu inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KEMRI okwayo jorit e county mar Samburu mondo odhi olim ringregi man machiegni kodgi kaka achiel kuom chenro mar thieth mar mon ma timore e dwe mar Septemba.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) announces NHIF/SHA claims support for residents of Tana River County starting this November.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatangaza NHIF/SHA inadai msaada kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kuanzia Novemba hii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) wuxuu ku dhawaaqay in NHIF/SHA ay sheegtay taageero loogu talagalay dadka deggan Degmada Tana River laga bilaabo Nofeembar.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) lando ni NHIF/SHA dwaro kony ne joma odak Tana River County kochakore dwe mar Novemba.

English: Taita Taveta County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Taita Taveta: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Mei 2022
Somali: Degmada Taita Taveta: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Taita Taveta: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar abich higa mar 2022

English: Every day, we are vulnerable to a new outbreak, disease, pandemic or virus. Recent ones include the Marburg virus, Mpox, Ebola, Zika and the nightmarish experience we faced during the Covid-19 pandemic.
