Kiswahili: Hata kwa muda mfupi, kumwacha mtoto kitandani au mezani bila mtu anayemtunza kunaweza kusababisha kuanguka na majeraha.
Somali: Xitaa in yar oo ilmaha lagu daydo sariirta ama miiska iyada oo aan la kormeerin waxay keeni kartaa hoos u dhac iyo dhaawac.
Dholuo: Kata mana kuom kinde matin, weyo nyathi e otanda kata e mesa ka onge ng'ama rite nyalo miyo opodho kata hinyore.

English: Kenya continues to record increasing malaria as a result of change of environment. World Malaria Day was was celebrated recently is used to comemorate ?????
Kiswahili: Kenya inaendelea kurekodi ongezeko la malaria kutokana na mabadiliko ya mazingira. Siku ya Malaria Duniani ilisherehekewa hivi karibuni inatumika kuadhimisha ?????
Somali: Kenya waxay sii wadaysaa in ay diiwaangeliso kororka cudurka daacuunka sababtoo ah isbeddelka deegaanka. Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Daacuunka ayaa dhowaan lagu dabaaldegay waxaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu xuso ?????
Dholuo: Kenya dhi nyime nyiso kaka malaria medore nikech lokruok mar alwora.

English: Coffee farmers can now apply for debt waivers under the government s new program Ensure your cooperative submits claims honestly to qualify for the Ksh 6 7 billion support across all coffee growing regions
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa kahawa sasa wanaweza kutuma maombi ya kusamehewa deni chini ya mpango mpya wa serikali Hakikisha ushirika wako unawasilisha madai kwa uaminifu ili kupata usaidizi wa Ksh 6 7 bilioni katika mikoa yote inayolima kahawa.
Somali: Beeraleyda kafeega ayaa hadda codsan kara dib u bixinta deynta barnaamijka cusub ee dowladda Hubi in iskaashigaagu si daacad ah u gudbiyo codsiyada si uu u qalmo kaalmada Ksh 67 bilyan ee dhammaan gobollada kafeega
Dholuo: Jo-pidhro mag kahera nyalo kwayo mondo ogolgi kuom chenro manyien mar sirkal.

English: The Agriculture and Food Authority AFA is conducting a crackdown on unlicensed macadamia dealers across 14 counties All traders must register and obtain licenses to avoid legal action
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula AFA inaendesha msako dhidi ya wafanyabiashara wa makadamia wasio na leseni katika kaunti 14 Wafanyabiashara wote lazima wajisajili na kupata leseni ili kuepuka kuchukuliwa hatua za kisheria.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) ayaa fulinaysa cadaadis ku wajahan ganacsatada macadamia ee aan ruqsad lahayn 14 degmo Dhammaan ganacsatada waa inay is diiwaangeliyaan oo helaan ruqsad si ay uga fogaadaan tallaabo sharci
Dholuo: AFA, ma en riwruok mar weche mag pidho kod pur, chako timo kinda mondo omonj joma uso macadamia maok nigi ratiro e gwenge 14 mag Amerka.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on residents of Nairobi County to support local peace-building committees in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za eneo hilo katika kusaidia tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee deegaanka si ay u taageerayaan taxadarka ka dhanka ah argagixisada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross okwayo jogweng' Nairobi County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gwenge ma gidakie mondo gikony e kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Announcing roll out of countywide Vitamin A supplementation & deworming for 12,000+ children under five with outreach and ECD support in Kiambu County
Kiswahili: Kutangaza uzinduzi wa nyongeza ya Vitamini A na dawa za minyoo katika kaunti nzima kwa watoto zaidi ya 12,000 walio chini ya umri wa miaka mitano kwa usaidizi wa uhamasishaji na ECD katika Kaunti ya Kiambu
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida bixinta kaabista Vitamin A ee gobolka oo dhan & ka saarista cayayaanka 12,000 + caruur ah oo ka yar shan sano oo leh taageero wacyi galineed iyo ECD ee degmada Kiambu
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova e piny mangima ogolo chiwo mar Vitamin A ne nyithindo ma johigni 12 000 gi wiye ma hikgi okalo abich, kendo gichiwo kony e weche mag thieth kod thieth e gweng' mar Kiambu

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds livestock keepers in Kericho County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Kericho inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyaga oo aan haysan rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jopur mag jamni e County mar Kericho ni kik giwuoth gi jamni kuonde mopogore opogore maok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: It is the first food system and a child's first vaccine, offering unparalleled nutrition and immune protection.Importantly, breastfeeding is also climate-smart â€” a renewable, zero-waste, low-carbon act that benefits both people and the planet.
Kiswahili: Ni mfumo wa kwanza wa chakula na chanjo ya kwanza ya mtoto, inayotoa lishe isiyo na kifani na ulinzi wa kinga. Muhimu, kunyonyesha pia kunazingatia hali ya hewa - kitendo kinachoweza kurejeshwa, kisicho na sifuri, cha kaboni ya chini ambacho kinanufaisha watu na sayari.
Somali: Waa nidaamkii ugu horreeyay ee cunto iyo tallaalkii ugu horreeyay ee ilmaha, kaas oo bixiya nafaqo aan la barbar dhigi karin iyo difaac difaac. Waxaa muhiim ah in naas-nuujintu ay sidoo kale tahay mid caqli badan cimilada - waa fal la cusboonaysiin karo, aan qashin lahayn, oo kaarboon yar oo faa'iido u leh dadka iyo meeraha labadaba.
Dholuo: En sistem mokwongo mar chiemo kendo en chanjo mokwongo mar nyathi, ma chiwo chiemo ma ok nyal pimre kod rito ringruok.Gima duong’ en ni, chiwo chiemo bende en gima nyalo rito piny â€” tim ma nyalo dwokore, ma ok ketho gimoro, ma ok kelo carbon mang’eny ma konyo ji kod piny.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jopur e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet e wi program mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges residents of Mandera County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama katikati ya tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya dadka deggan degmada Mandera inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga waxqabadka aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah iyada oo la sii xoojinayo amniga xuduudda.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo jogweng'o mag Mandera County mondo onyis sirkande mag sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e alwora mar tong'gi.

English: Digital cash transfer and knowledge and climate change information can help farming a great deal.
Kiswahili: Uhamisho wa pesa za kidijitali na maarifa na taarifa za mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa zinaweza kusaidia kilimo sana.
Somali: Wareejinta lacagta dijitaalka ah iyo macluumaadka aqoonta iyo isbeddelka cimilada waxay si weyn uga caawin karaan beeralayda si weyn.
Dholuo: Weche mag pesa kod weche mag lokruok e alwora nyalo konyo ahinya e tij pur.

English: Judiciary of Kenya updates residents of Mandera County on progress of the county integrated development plan this May.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti hii Mei.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Mandera ka warbixiyaa horumarka qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada bisha May.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya osemiyo joma odak e county mar Mandera ng'eyo kaka chenro mar dongruok mar county integrated development dhi nyime e dwe mar abich.

English: Universities Fund announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in West Pokot County this March.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Machi hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku dhawaaqay qaybinta waxyaabaha barashada dijitaalka ah ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada Gobolka West Pokot bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund ogolo chiwo mar somo mar digital maonge chudo e skunde man West Pokot County e dwe mar Mach.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds voters in Kiambu County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya kujiandikisha.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya ayaa xusuusinaya codbixiyayaasha degmada Kiambu in ay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor diiwaangelinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone josiasa e County mar Kiambu ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom SMS ne ji 70000 kapok gidonjo e register mar yiero.

English: Notice: DPP issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay soo saartaa digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: DPP ogolo siem mar rito weche mag sirkal kuom chenro mag gwelo pesa mag miriambo makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Kisii County.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations launches a carjacking prevention campaign in Tharaka-Nithi County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia utekaji nyara katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dambiyada ayaa bilaabay olole looga hortago gaadiidka la xaday Degmada Tharaka-Nithi bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Rapar: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chako kampen mar geng'o wuodh mtokni e Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Kajiado County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Kajiado inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka maskaxeed ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pachgi e Kajiado County mondo oluong kony mar thieth mar pach maonge chudo.

English: The collective fight against #COVID19 gives hope that we shall overcome. A great future awaits us. Asante @magicalkenya for the inspiration. Let us believe and achieve. Stay home. Slow the spread. Save lives. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Mapambano ya pamoja dhidi ya #COVID19 yanatoa matumaini kwamba tutashinda. Wakati ujao mzuri unatungoja. Asante @magicalkenya kwa msukumo. Tuamini na tufanikiwe. Kaa nyumbani. Punguza kuenea. Okoa maisha. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Dagaalka wadajirka ah ee ka dhanka ah #COVID19 wuxuu siinayaa rajo ah inaan ka gudbi doonno. Mustaqbal wanaagsan ayaa na sugaya. Asante @magicalkenya dhiirigelinta. Aan rumaysanno oo aan gaarno. Guriga joog. Hoos u dhig faafitaanka. Badbaadi nolosha. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Kedo mar riwruok mar #COVID19 miyowa geno ni wabiro loyo. Okang’ mabiro maduong’ ogenowa. <2Zepa> 10:10, 11. 10 <2Zepa> 10:10, 11. Wabed gi yie kendo wabed gi geno. Bed e ot. Dwok lando wachno mos. Res ngima. #KomeshaKorona

English: Ministry of Health reminds expectant mothers in Nairobi County that access to postnatal check-ups is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba upatikanaji wa uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Nairobi in helitaanka baaritaannada dhalmada ka dib ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne mine ma biro nyuolo e County mar Nairobi ni dhi e nonro bang' nyuol en gima onge chudo e kuonde duto mag oganda.

English: KICD urges parents and teachers in Nyamira County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: KICD inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Somali: KICD waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Nyamira inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e Kaunti mar Nyamira mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto.

English: EACC reminds voters in Migori County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Migori kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Migori inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor waxbarashada codbixisayaasha.
Dholuo: EACC parone jogweng' Migori County mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero ka pok oyud tiegruok mar josiasa.

English: KICD reminds schools in Embu County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this October.
Kiswahili: KICD inazikumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Embu kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Oktoba hii.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Embu inay xoojiyaan adeegyada hagista iyo la-talinta bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KICD paronwa skunde mag Embu County mondo omed jiwo kendo chiwo kony e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: NPS issues a cybersecurity alert on phishing messages affecting residents of Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya ujumbe wa udanganyifu unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan fariimaha phishing ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi.
Dholuo: Rapar: NPS ogolo siem mar sirkal kuom weche mag phishing makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County.

English: Notice: e-Citizen launches the county integrated development plan in Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika wilaya ya Marsabit.
Somali: Ogeysiis: e-Citizen waxay bilaabaysaa qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Marsabit.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: e-Citizen chako chenro mar timo dongruok e alwora mar Marsabit County.

English: Notice: KRA will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada ee degmada Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KRA biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mar bajet mar gweng'no e gweng' mar Kirinyaga.

English: He added that a resilient health system must support women across the life course, not only during pregnancy and childbirth, central to the government's commitment to Universal Health Coverage.
Kiswahili: Aliongeza kuwa mfumo dhabiti wa afya lazima usaidie wanawake katika kipindi chote cha maisha, sio tu wakati wa ujauzito na kuzaa, kiini cha dhamira ya serikali ya Huduma ya Afya kwa Wote.
Somali: Wuxuu intaas ku daray in nidaam caafimaad oo adkaysi leh uu taageero haweenka inta ay nool yihiin, oo aan ahayn oo keliya xilliga uurka iyo dhalmada, oo ah udub-dhexaadka ballanqaadka dawladdu ee ku aaddan Caymiska Caafimaadka Caalamiga ah.
Dholuo: Omedo wacho ni sistem mar thieth ma nigi teko nyaka konyo mon e ngimagi duto, ok mana e kinde ma gin gi ich kod nyuol, ma en gima duong’ ahinya e ng’ado bura mar sirkal mar rito thieth mar piny mangima.

English: Kenya Food Security Outlook Update August 2022
Kiswahili: Mtazamo wa Usalama wa Chakula nchini Kenya Agosti 2022
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta Aragtida Sugnaanta Cuntada Kenya Ogosto 2022
Dholuo: Neno mar arita mar chiemo e piny Kenya dwe mar aboro higa mar 2022

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Laikipia County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia wape huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa fedha za umma.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay dalbadaan bixinta adeegyo aan la siinayo laaluush si looga hortago xadgudubka lacagta dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' Laikipia County mondo okonygi gi tij lendo maok gichiwo asoya mondo gikwed ketho pesa mag sirkal.

English: Notice: NDMA activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay shilalka waddooyinka ee gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Rapar: NDMA tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne masiche ma timore e nderni e County mar Lamu.

English: IPOA alerts residents of Nandi County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: IPOA waxay dadka deggan degmada Nandi uga digtay kororka kiisaska gaadiidka la xaday waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: IPOA chiwo siem ne jogweng' kaunti mar Nandi e wi medruok mar weche mag kwalo mtokni kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne polis ma machiegni.

English: Kenya Drought Response Dashboard (November 2022)
Kiswahili: Dashibodi ya Kukabiliana na Ukame Kenya (Novemba 2022)
Somali: Shaxda Jawaab celinta Abaaraha Kenya (Nofeembar 2022)
Dholuo: Dabod mar duoko mar oro e piny Kenya (Apar 2022)

English: Notice: KEPHIS restricts movement of dairy cows in Kirinyaga County due to an anthrax outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS inazuia harakati za ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kutokana na mlipuko wa kimeta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da caanaha ah ee Gobolka Kirinyaga sababo la xiriira cudurka anthrax.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok makwayo e gweng' mar Kirinyaga nikech tuwo mar anthrax.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will conduct a pest and disease management workshop for farmers in Migori County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itafanya warsha ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada beeraleyda degmada Migori bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro timo workshop mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche ne jopur e county mar Migori e dwe mar Mach.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Kisii County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu katika msimu huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lugta lagu maro inta lagu jiro xilliyada dhulgariirada.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service parone jogweng' mar Kisii County mondo oluw tong' mar piyo kendo oti gi yore mag wuotho e kinde mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: KRA reminds residents of Wajir County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir in ka qaybgalka maamulaha degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: KRA oparo ne jogweng' mar Wajir County ni tudruok gi jotelo mag gwenge maggi miyo sirkal bedo gi loch maber.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will distribute certified coffee seed to farmers in Mandera County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itasambaza mbegu za kahawa zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay abuurka kafeega ee shahaadada leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda Degmada Mandera bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Rieko: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro pogo kodhi mag kofi ne jopur man Mandera County e dwe mar April.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges sweet potatoes growers in Tharaka-Nithi County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ugu baaqeysaa beeraleyda baradho macaan ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi in ay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobka si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development osenyiso jopur mar sweet potato e Tharaka-Nithi County ni giti gi nengo mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue mondo gimi nyak maber e higani.

English: Universities Fund urges parents and teachers in Narok County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Narok kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku boorinayaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Narok inay u soo sheegaan arrimaha amniga maamulka dugsiga.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e gweng' mar Narok mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar skul e wi weche duto motudore gi ritruok.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay bilaabaneysaa barnaamij tallaabooyin looga hortago dhibaatada dugsiyada gobolka Baringo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State Department for TVET chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe mahundu e skunde duto mag Baringo County.

English: EACC reminds the public in West Pokot County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya West Pokot kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka West Pokot in sheegashada khiyaamooyinka iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: EACC paronwa ji duto e West Pokot County ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag yuto en gima onge nengo, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: KTDA promotes organic farming among farmers in Lamu County as part of the August climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: KTDA inakuza kilimo hai miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Agosti.
Somali: KTDA waxay dhiirrigelisay beeraha dabiiciga ah ee beeraleyda degmada Lamu iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Agoosto.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo pur mar yien e kind jopur e County mar Lamu kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi mar dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice from Kenya Medical Association: nutrition supplementation for infants clinics will run every October at designated health centres in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya: nyongeza ya lishe kwa kliniki za watoto wachanga itaendeshwa kila Oktoba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya: Kordhinta nafaqada ee dhallaanka ee xarumaha caafimaadka ee Magaalada Nairobi ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Oktoobar kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association wacho ni, e dwe mar Oktoba higa ka higa, ibiro tim thieth mar chiemb chuny ne nyithindo matindo e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Nairobi.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds the public in Mombasa County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this October.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba mchango juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka unakaribishwa Oktoba hii.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa shacabka degmada Mombasa in talooyinka dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah la soo dhaweynayo bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General parone ji duto e County mar Mombasa ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Kenya: IPC Acute Food Insecurity and Acute Malnutrition Analysis (February - June 2023) Published on 20 February 2023
Kiswahili: Kenya: IPC Ukosefu wa Chakula Mkali na Uchambuzi Mkali wa Utapiamlo (Februari - Juni 2023) Limechapishwa tarehe 20 Februari 2023
Somali: Kenya: Falanqaynta IPC ee Amniga Cuntada Degdegga ah iyo Nafaqada Ba'an (Febraayo - Juun 2023) La daabacay 20 Febraayo 2023
Dholuo: Kenya: Nonro mar IPC mar bedo maongee arita mar chiemo kod bedo gi chiemo ma ok oromo (dwe mar ariyo - dwe mar auchiel 2023) Ogoye tarik 20 dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2023

English: TSC reminds parents in Kwale County that school feeding programme registration is open this April.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba usajili wa mpango wa kulisha shule umefunguliwa Aprili hii.
Somali: TSC waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Kwale in diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga ay furan tahay bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: TSC oparo ne jonyuol e Kaunti mar Kwale ni chenro mar kwayo nyithindo chiemo e skul osechakore e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: IEBC opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Wananchi katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay ka furaysaa goob adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-muwaadiniinta ee degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IEBC oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag e-Citizen registration e county mar Siaya.

English: KUCCPS announced the opening of its portal for inter-institutional transfers for 2025/2026 placements targeting TVET and university students.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS ilitangaza kufunguliwa kwa lango lake la uhamisho wa taasisi mbalimbali kwa nafasi za 2025/2026 likiwalenga wanafunzi wa TVET na vyuo vikuu.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku dhawaaqday furitaanka boggeeda internetka ee wareejinta hay'adaha dhexdooda ee meelaynta 2025/2026 oo lagu beegsanayo ardayda TVET iyo jaamacadaha.
Dholuo: KUCCPS olando ni obiro yaro portal mare mar ng’ado bura e kind skul mopogore opogore mag 2025/2026 ma ochung’ ne jopuonjre mag TVET kod jopuonjre mag yunivasiti.

English: Amid a high cross-border risk from the ongoing Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, the Government, with support from UN agencies and partners, has initiated preparedness measures.
Kiswahili: Huku kukiwa na hatari kubwa ya kuvuka mpaka kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Ebola Bundibugyo unaoendelea katika Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Kongo na Uganda, Serikali, kwa msaada wa mashirika ya Umoja wa Mataifa na washirika, imeanzisha hatua za kujitayarisha.
Somali: Iyadoo ay jirto khatar sare oo ka jirta xuduudaha oo ka dhalatay cudurka Ebola ee Bundibugyo ee ka dillaacay Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo iyo Uganda, Dowladda, oo taageero ka heleysa hay'adaha Qaramada Midoobay iyo la-hawlgalayaasha, ayaa bilowday tallaabooyin diyaargarow ah.
Dholuo: E kind luoro maduong' mar ng'ado tong' mawuok kuom loyo midhusi mar Ebola Bundibugyo madhi nyime e piny Congo kod Uganda, Sirikal, ka kony kowuok kuom kethe mag UN kod jowetene, osechako rango mag ikruok.

English: Kenya Red Cross advises residents of Nyandarua County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Laanta Cas ee Kenya waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay haystaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi maber sama gidwaro thieth mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Kenya Gazette urges eligible citizens in Nyamira County to participate in polling procedures.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kushiriki katika utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Nyamira inay ka qeyb galaan nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro e County mar Nyamira mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag yiero.

English: A healthy mind drives workplace success. Prioritizing mental health boosts morale, reduces stress, and improves productivity
Kiswahili: Akili yenye afya huchochea mafanikio mahali pa kazi. Kuweka kipaumbele afya ya akili huongeza ari, hupunguza msongo wa mawazo, na huboresha tija
Somali: Maskax caafimaad qaba ayaa guusha ka dhigeysa goobta shaqada. Caafimaadka maskaxdu waxay kor u qaadeysaa niyadda, waxay yareyneysaa walwalka, waxayna hagaajineysaa wax soo saarka
Dholuo: Bedo gi paro makare miyo ng'ato bedo gi ngima maber e tich.

English: The next phase is to ensure that every patient benefits from the same standard of high-quality care.
Kiswahili: Awamu inayofuata ni kuhakikisha kwamba kila mgonjwa ananufaika na kiwango sawa cha utunzaji wa hali ya juu.
Somali: Marxaladda xigta waa in la hubiyo in bukaan kasta uu ka faa'iidaysto heer isku mid ah oo daryeel tayo sare leh.
Dholuo: Okang’ maluwo en neno ni ng’ato ka ng’ato ma tuo yudo ber kuom yo maromre mar thieth ma nigi rang’iny mamalo.

English: Teachers Service Commission conducts a civic education forum on voter registration in Turkana County this May.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Turkana Mei hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa bishii Maajo ee sannadkan ka qabanaya madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi weche mag ndiko joma oyiero e county mar Turkana e dwe mar Mei.

English: IEBC reminds parents in Nakuru County that adult literacy classes registration is open this June.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba usajili wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima umefunguliwa Juni hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Nakuru in diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ay furan tahay bisha Juun.
Dholuo: IEBC oparo ne jonyuol e gweng' mar Nakuru ni ikruok mar somo kod somo ne joma dongo osechakore e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay furtay xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya daryeel caafimaad ka dib rabshadaha degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji ochako ofis ma chiwo kony mar thieth bang' timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Kisii.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service encourages farmers in Meru County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for horticultural produce.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa ili kupata bei bora za mazao ya bustani.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda degmada Meru inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay wax soo saarka beeraha.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur e county mar Meru mondo oti gi nengo matin mar puodho mondo giyud nengo mabeyo mag puodho.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Meru County about the importance of hand hygiene for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Meru kuhusu umuhimu wa usafi wa mikono kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMSA waxay dadka degmada Meru ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda nadaafadda gacmaha ay u leedahay caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone ji duto e County mar Meru kuom ber mar rito ler mar lwedo e ngima joot.

English: Kenya - Floods (CatNat, media, NOAA-CPC) (ECHO Daily Flash of 26 March 2024)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Mafuriko (CatNat, vyombo vya habari, NOAA-CPC) (ECHO Daily Flash ya 26 Machi 2024)
Somali: Kenya - Daadad (CatNat, warbaahinta, NOAA-CPC) (ECHO Daily Flash ee 26 Maarso 2024)
Dholuo: Kenya - Pi mang'eny (catnat, yor mbui, NOAA-CPC) (Rieny ma pile ka pile tarik 26 dwe mar adek higa mar 2024)

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai hutoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa kitambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa soo saaray digniin amniga internetka ah oo ku saabsan tuugada aqoonsiga ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Garissa.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'ado Weche mag Mahundu ogolo ripot mar rito weche mag sirkal kuom wach kwalo nying' jogo modak e gweng' mar Garissa.

English: Universities Fund conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Kisii County this February.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Kisii Februari hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Jaamacadaha ayaa bishii Febraayo qabanqaabinaysa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha gobolka Kisii.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund otimo romo mar tiego ji e wi migawo mar Ombudsman e County mar Kisii e dwe mar Februar.

English: KNEC reminds needy students in Embu County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Embu kwamba vitabu vya kiada na matumizi ya vifaa vya kujifunzia vitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KNEC waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Embu in buugaagta waxbarasho iyo codsiyada qalabka waxbarasho ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: KNEC parone jopuonjre man gi chandruok e county mar Embu ni buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok biro rumo machiegni.

English: KEPHIS encourages farmers in Vihiga County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za mahindi.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Vihiga inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay hadhuudhka.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Vihiga mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro mondo omi ohala mar kodhi obed maber.

English: NPS calls on the community in Isiolo County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatia moyo jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: NPS waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Isiolo inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wacayaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: NPS okwayo ji duto manie gweng' mar Isiolo mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong simo mar GBV 1195.

English: DPP reminds mobile money users in Bungoma County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Bungoma inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: DPP paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mobil e County mar Bungoma mondo onon kwayo mag pesa kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal ka pok gitimo gimoro amora mondo gitang' gi chenro mag gwelo pesa mag miriambo.

English: AIRA Infodemic Trends Report - 4 -11 December 2023 (Weekly Brief #100 of 2023)
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Mitindo ya Taarifa ya AIRA - 4 -11 Desemba 2023 (Muhtasari wa Kila Wiki #100 wa 2023)
Somali: Warbixinta Isbeddellada Macluumaadka ee AIRA - 4 -11 Diseembar 2023 (Soo Koobidda Toddobaadlaha ah #100 ee 2023)
Dholuo: Ripot mar weche mag tuwo mag AIRA - 4 nyaka 11 dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2023 (Ripot machuok mar juma ka juma #100 mar higa mar 2023)

English: NCPB urges sweet potatoes growers in Wajir County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawasihi wakulima wa viazi baridi katika Kaunti ya Wajir kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurudisha uzazi wa udongo ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda baradho macaan ee Gobolka Wajir inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur ma pidho adundo e gweng ' mar Wajir County mondo oti gi lokruok mar chwoyo kodhi mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber kendo mondo omi nyak obed maber e higani.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay ka shaqeynta shahaadada dhalashada ee degmada Meru.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Jatelo Maduong' ochako kama itimee tije manyien mar loso nyasi mag nyuol e County mar Meru.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General launches ward-level service delivery in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu huzindua huduma za huduma katika wilaya ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu bilaabay bixinta adeegyada heerka qaybta ee Gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Auditor-General chako chiwo kony e ward level e county mar Uasin Gishu.

English: Call for small food vendors to reformulate products to meet nutrition standards and enter competition for rewards.
Kiswahili: Wito kwa wachuuzi wadogo wa vyakula kurekebisha bidhaa ili zikidhi viwango vya lishe na kuingia katika ushindani wa zawadi.
Somali: Ku baaqo alaab-qeybiyeyaasha cuntada yaryar inay dib u qaabeeyaan alaabada si ay u buuxiyaan heerarka nafaqada iyo inay tartamaan abaalmarinta.
Dholuo: Wuo gi jo ohala matindo e wi chiemo mondo ochak loso ohandgi e yo manyien mondo giwinj chike mag chiemo kendo mondo giriwre e piem mar yudo mich.

English: Talking about mental health breaks the stigma and helps others open up. Let's create a supportive environment for all.
Kiswahili: Kuzungumzia afya ya akili huvunja unyanyapaa na kuwasaidia wengine kufunguka. Tujenge mazingira ya usaidizi kwa wote.
Somali: Ka hadalka caafimaadka dhimirka wuxuu jebiyaa ceebta wuxuuna ka caawiyaa dadka kale inay furnaadaan. Aan abuurno jawi taageero u ah dhammaan.
Dholuo: Ka wawuoyo kuom tuwo mar paro, mano weyo ng’anjo ma ji nigo kendo konyo jomoko mondo oyawre. Wabed gi thuolo ma konyo ji duto.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Samburu County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen anawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili kuwajulisha juu ya utoaji wa huduma kwa kiwango cha wilaya.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Samburu inay la xiriiraan maamulaha qaybta maxalliga ah si ay uga warqabaan bixinta adeegga heerka qaybta.
Dholuo: E-Citizen ojiwo ji duto modak e county mar Samburu mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jotelo mag utegi mondo ging'e weche duto motudore gi tij lendo.

English: Lamu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for November 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Lamu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Novemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Lamu: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Noofambar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Lamu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2022

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will host a free tobacco control outreach in Narok County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa udhibiti wa tumbaku bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Narok Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska Dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa qaban doonta dadaal bilaash ah oo ka dhan ah ka hortagga sigaarka ee Gobolka Narok bisha Ogosto.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo kampen mar golo ndawa maonge chudo e Narok County e dwe mar Agost.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds expectant mothers in Kisumu County that access to free antenatal care is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma ya ujauzito bila malipo ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Kisumu in helitaanka daryeelka uurka ka hor ee bilaashka ah ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Kisumu ni thuolo mar yudo rit ma onge chudo mar nyuol en maonge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) invites residents of Embu County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kushiriki kupitia portal ya kushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Embu inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee la xiriira wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) gwelo jogweng' Embu County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e wi penjo mag chike mag sirkal.

English: DCI alerts residents of Bungoma County to a rise in fraud cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kuhusu kuongezeka kwa kesi za ulaghai na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: DCI waxay dadka deggan degmada Bungoma uga digtay kororka kiisaska khiyaamooyinka waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne jogweng'o mag Bungoma County kuom wach medruok mar weche mag wuondruok kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne polis man machiegni.

English: KICD advises applicants in Nyandarua County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KICD inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KICD waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Nyandarua inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: KICD nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Nyandarua ni mondo gidonj e tiegruok kapok ichopo e chokruok mabiro.

English: Kenya: Drought - Arid and Semi-Arid Lands (ASALs) (3 Jul 2023)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Ukame - Ardhi Kame na Nusu Kame (ASALs) (3 Jul 2023)
Somali: Kenya: Abaar - Dhul-gariir iyo Dhul-gariir Badh-Aaran (ASAL) (3 Luulyo 2023)
Dholuo: Kenya: Oro - Pinje ma Otuo kendo ma Otuo Matin (ASAL) (3 dwe mar Abiriyo higa mar 2023)

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds the public in Nandi County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this February.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba maoni juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma yanakaribishwa Februari hii.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud ayaa xasuusinaya shacabka degmada Nandi in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General oparo ne ji duto e County mar Nandi ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mag sirkal e dwe mar Februar.

English: Farmers and stakeholders in the coffee sector should stay informed on upcoming changes as the Coffee Sector Implementation Committee will be led by the Deputy President to revitalize the industry
Kiswahili: Wakulima na washikadau katika sekta ya kahawa wanapaswa kuhabarika kuhusu mabadiliko yajayo kwani Kamati ya Utekelezaji ya Sekta ya Kahawa itaongozwa na Naibu Rais ili kufufua sekta hiyo.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha qaybta kafee waa inay la socdaan isbeddelada soo socda maadaama Guddiga Hirgelinta Qaybta Kafeega uu hogaamin doono Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka si loo soo nooleeyo warshadaha
Dholuo: Jo-Purche kod joma nie migawono onego ong'e lokruok mabiro timore nikech Komiti mar Tiyo gi Migawono biro bedo e bwo loch mar Jatend Migawono mondo okaw okang ' mar kelo ngima manyien e migawono

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross will hold a depression awareness forum in Nyamira County this October. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utafanya kongamano la uhamasishaji wa unyogovu katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Oktoba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Xusuusin: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay qaban doontaa madasha wacyiga dhimirka ee degmada Nyamira bisha Oktoobar. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Red Cross biro timo chokruok mar chiwo paro e wi tuwo mar depression e taon mar Nyamira e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Nyamira County that access to SHA registration is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba ufikiaji wa usajili wa SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nyamira in helitaanka diiwaangelinta SHA ay hadda laga heli karaa xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji duto e County mar Nyamira ni koro ginyalo yudo weche mag SHA e kuonde moketi.

English: Notice: DPP conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Nandi County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Nandi Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ku saabsan ka hortagga argagixisada ee gobolka Nandi bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: DPP timo romo mar oganda e dwe mar Jun e kaunti mar Nandi.

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Nyeri County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Nyeri mondo odonj e riwruok mar insuarans mar thieth mondo giyud thieth makonyogi.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Medical Association will be held in Nandi County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu bila malipo iliyoandaliwa na Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Nandi Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Nandi bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma Kenya Medical Association ochano ibiro tim e taon mar Nandi e dwe mar Jun.

English: NDMA alerts residents of Makueni County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: NDMA waxay dadka deggan degmada Makueni uga digtay kororka kiisaska tuugada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: NDMA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Makueni County kuom wach kwan mar joma okwalo gik moko kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: The Kenya National Trading Corporation is buying excess rice from Kano Plains and Mwea Irrigation Schemes Farmers are encouraged to sell their surplus to avoid post harvest losses
Kiswahili: Shirika la Kitaifa la Biashara la Kenya linanunua mchele wa ziada kutoka kwa Kano Plains na Mwea Irrigation Schemes Wakulima wanahimizwa kuuza ziada yao ili kuepuka hasara baada ya mavuno.
Somali: Shirkadda Ganacsiga Qaranka Kenya ayaa ka iibsanaysa bariiska xad-dhaafka ah ee Kano Plains iyo Mwea Irrigation Schemes. Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay iibiyaan lacagtooda dheeraadka ah si looga fogaado khasaaraha ka dib goosashada
Dholuo: Kenya National Trading Corporation ong'iewo loso kodhi mang'eny moa e Kano Plains kod Mwea Irrigation Schemes

English: IEBC conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Uasin Gishu County this December.
Kiswahili: IEBC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Desemba hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan wareejinta degmada Uasin Gishu bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: IEBC dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi wach golo pesa e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Kenya Medical Association announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Kwale County starting this June.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kuanzia Juni hii.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya ayaa ku dhawaaqay in ay bilawdo bilawga dialysis-ka ee deeqda ah ee dadka deggan degmada Kwale laga bilaabo bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association olando thieth mar dialysis kuom joma odak Kwale County kochakore dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens polling procedures centres in Lamu County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Lamu mwezi huu wa Septemba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu furayaa xarumaha codbixinta ee gobolka Lamu bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya osechako tiyo gi chenro mar timo yiero e County mar Lamu e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Regional Bureau for Eastern Africa floods update #2 (30 June 2024)
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Kanda ya Afrika Mashariki kuhusu mafuriko #2 (30 Juni 2024)
Somali: Warbixin ku saabsan fatahaadaha ka dhacay Xafiiska Gobolka ee Bariga Afrika #2 (30 Juun 2024)
Dholuo: Ofis mar Pinyruoth mar Afrika ma Wuokchieng' odwoko #2 (30 dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2024)

English: Starting March 1 New KCC will pay farmers Kshs 50 per litre of milk Ensure you deliver your milk regularly to benefit from this program
Kiswahili: Kuanzia Machi 1 KCC Mpya itawalipa wakulima Kshs 50 kwa lita moja ya maziwa Hakikisha unapeleka maziwa yako mara kwa mara ili kufaidika na mpango huu.
Somali: Laga bilaabo 1da Maarso KCC cusub waxay beeraleyda siin doontaa 50 Kshs halkii litir oo caano ah Hubi inaad caano si joogto ah u bixiso si aad uga faa'iideysato barnaamijkan
Dholuo: Chakre Mach 1 KCC manyien biro chulo ne jopur Kshs 50 kuom lita achiel mar chak Temuru mondo uchiw chak maru pile mondo uyud konyruok kuom chenrono

English: NCPB urges coffee growers in Garissa County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Garissa kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda kafeega ee Gobolka Garissa inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si kor loogu qaado wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e gweng' mar Garissa mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed nyak e higani.

English: Early Action Protocol Activation: Kenya Drought (EAP â„–: EAP2022KE02, Operation â„–: MDRKE055)
Kiswahili: Uanzishaji wa Itifaki ya Hatua ya Mapema: Ukame nchini Kenya (EAP â„–: EAP2022KE02, Operesheni â„–: MDRKE055)
Somali: Hawlgalka Habraaca Hore ee Tallaabada: Abaarta Kenya (EAP â„–: EAP2022KE02, Hawlgalka â„–: MDRKE055)
Dholuo: Tiyo gi chenro mar timo gik moko mapiyo: Oro e piny Kenya (EAP: EAP2022KE02, Tich: MDRKE055)

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education reminds citizens in Bungoma County about their rights regarding the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuhusu haki zao kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Bungoma xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Puonjruok e Wi Chike Dhano parone raia mag Bungoma County ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo ombudsman.

English: NPS calls on residents of Kilifi County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaita wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: NPS waxay dadka deggan degmada Kilifi ugu baaqeysaa inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga dhaqdhaqaaq aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal aagagga xuduudaha si ay u taageeraan taxadarka ka dhanka ah argagixisada.
Dholuo: NPS okwayo jogweng' Kilifi County mondo onyis riwruok mag sirkal ma rito sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e alwora mar tong'gi mondo gikony e kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Homa Bay County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee gobolka Homa Bay inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e Homa Bay County mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Launch of Jifunze Lishe SMS service sending weekly nutrition and wellness tips to 2M subscribers.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa huduma ya Jifunze Lishe ya kutuma vidokezo vya lishe na ustawi wa kila wiki kwa wanachama milioni 2.
Somali: Daahfurka adeegga fariimaha qoraalka ah ee Jifunze Lishe oo talooyin nafaqo iyo fayoobi ah u diraya macaamiisha 2M ee toddobaadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Chako tich mar SMS mar Jifunze Lishe maoro riekni mag chiemo kod ngima maber juma ka juma ne jogo ma ondiko nyinge 2M.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties urges residents of Kitui County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay ka qeybgalaan kalfadhiga guud ee golaha gobolka si ay uga warqabaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee gobolka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties jiwo ji duto modak e County Kitui mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo ging'e chenro mar dongruok e county.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds needy students in Kisumu County that free digital learning content applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba programu za bure za maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya ardayda u baahan degmada Kisumu in codsiyada barnaamijyada barashada bilaashka ah ee dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e gweng' mar Kisumu ni chenro mag somo ma onge chudo mar digital biro rumo machiegni.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds residents of Nyeri County that access to national ID applications is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba kufikia maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri in helitaanka codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette parone jogweng' Nyeri County ni yudo kwayo mag ID e piny sani yot ahinya kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal.

English: Innovativeness, investment and teamwork is important in technology and does great in farming . Available technology among small scale farmers...
Kiswahili: Ubunifu, uwekezaji na kazi ya pamoja ni muhimu katika teknolojia na hufanya vizuri katika kilimo. Teknolojia inayopatikana kati ya wakulima wadogo...
Somali: Hal-abuurnimo, maalgelin iyo wada shaqeyn waa muhiim tiknoolajiyada waxayna si fiican uga shaqeeyaan beeraleyda. Tiknoolajiyada laga heli karo beeraleyda yaryar...
Dholuo: Bedo gi lony, timo ohala, kod tiyo kanyachiel konyo ahinya e weche mag teknoloji kendo konyo ahinya e weche mag pur.

English: Prudent group leadership focus on good rules and integrity of leaders. Learn on best farmer group practices.
Kiswahili: Uongozi wa kikundi wenye busara huzingatia sheria nzuri na uadilifu wa viongozi. Jifunze juu ya mazoea bora ya kikundi cha wakulima.
Somali: Hoggaaminta kooxaha ee taxaddarka leh waxay diiradda saaraan xeerar wanaagsan iyo daacadnimada hoggaamiyeyaasha. Baro hababka ugu wanaagsan ee kooxaha beeraleyda.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar grup ma nigi rieko keto pachgi kuom chike mabeyo kod tim makare mar jotelo.

English: IEBC reminds the public in Kisii County that reporting embezzlement of public funds is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: IEBC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa fedha za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kisii in warbixinta xadgudubka lacagaha dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: IEBC parone ji duto e County mar Kisii ni chiwo ripot mar ketho pesa mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: SEEDS shall conduct collective research and rules that support use of technology with small scale land owners.
Kiswahili: SEEDS itafanya utafiti wa pamoja na sheria zinazounga mkono matumizi ya teknolojia na wamiliki wa ardhi ndogo.
Somali: SEEDS waxay samayn doontaa cilmi-baaris wadajir ah iyo xeerar taageera isticmaalka tiknoolajiyada milkiilayaasha dhulka yaryar.
Dholuo: SEDS biro timo nonro kod chike ma siro tiyo gi teknoloji gi weg lowo matindo.

English: NTSA urges motorists and pedestrians in Migori County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Migori kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Migori inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha deegaanka si looga hortago dhacdooyinka abaarta la xiriira.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo derebe kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Migori mondo oluw chike mag golo ji ma sirkal ogolo mondo gikwed masiche motudore gi oro.

English: TSC calls on the community in Kilifi County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TSC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TSC waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Kilifi inay ka warbixiyaan walaacyada amniga ee ku saabsan maamulka dugsiga si ay u ilaaliyaan amniga dugsiyada.
Dholuo: TSC okwayo ji duto manie gweng' mar Kilifi mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar skul e wi weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: Secretary-General deeply concerned over reported deadly violence related to protests, street demonstrations in Kenya
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu amehuzunishwa sana na ghasia mbaya zilizoripotiwa kuhusiana na maandamano, maandamano ya mitaani nchini Kenya
Somali: Xoghayaha Guud ayaa si qoto dheer uga walaacsan rabshado dhimasho leh oo la soo sheegay oo la xiriira dibadbaxyada, dibadbaxyada waddooyinka ka socda Kenya
Dholuo: Jatend-alwora owinjo marach ahinya kuom tulo ma kelo tho mathoth ma tudruok gi ng’anjo, ng’anjo ma ji timo e yore mag piny Kenya

English: KUCCPS opened its portal for 2023 KCSE candidates to apply for Teacher Training College diploma programs with a deadline of April 21 2024.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS ilifungua lango lake kwa watahiniwa wa KCSE wa 2023 kutuma maombi ya programu za diploma za Chuo cha Mafunzo ya Ualimu zenye tarehe ya mwisho ya Aprili 21, 2024.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay albaabkeeda u furtay 2023 musharixiinta KCSE si ay ugu dalbadaan barnaamijyada shahaadada Koleejka Tababarka Macallinka iyadoo waqtigeedu yahay 21 Abriil 2024.
Dholuo: KUCCPS oseyawo dhoot mar jogo madwaro dhi e KCSE mar 2023 mondo oketgi e program mag diploma mar Teacher Training College gi giko tarik 21 dwe mar April 2024.

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit warns of increased Rift Valley Fever risk in Mandera County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa katika Kaunti ya Mandera na inashauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa ka digtay khatarta sii kordheysa ee Cudurka Rift Valley ee Degmada Mandera waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar oganda: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osiemo ji kuom medruok mar tuwo mar Rift Valley Fever e County mar Mandera kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore mar thieth.

English: KEPHIS reminds farmers in Nairobi County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi juu ya programu inayoendelea ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa mafunzo ya wakulima.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nairobi in barnaamijka tababarka beeralayda uu socdo.
Dholuo: KEPHIS parone jopur manie County Nairobi chenro mar tiego jopur ma sani dhi nyime.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health confirms a measles outbreak alert for Mombasa County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya yathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa surua katika Kaunti ya Mombasa. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka hargabka ee Gobolka Mombasa. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuwono e kaunti mar Mombasa. Ojiw ji mondo ochiw ripode ne joma ochiwore mar thieth.

English: HELB urges residents of Narok County to register their children at the nearest public school to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu ili kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: HELB waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Narok inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni kodgi mondo giyud somo mar sekondar maonge chudo.

English: Gov't now calls for wearing of masks, vaccination as Kenya faces 6th COVID-19 wave
Kiswahili: Serikali sasa yatoa wito wa kuvaa barakoa na chanjo huku Kenya ikikabiliwa na wimbi la 6 la COVID-19
Somali: Dowladda ayaa hadda ku baaqeysa in la xidho maaskaro, la tallaalo maadaama Kenya ay wajahdo hirkii lixaad ee COVID-19
Dholuo: Sirkal koro dwaro ni ng'ato orwak mask, oti gi thieth kaka Kenya romo gi masira mar 6 mar COVID-19

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Meru County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu huzindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Meru Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu bilaabay olole la dagaalanka musuqmaasuqa ee degmada Meru bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Auditor General chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Meru e dwe mar Mei.

English: Foods like beans, greens, and liver prevent anemia and support child development.
Kiswahili: Vyakula kama vile maharagwe, mboga za majani, na ini huzuia upungufu wa damu na husaidia ukuaji wa mtoto.
Somali: Cuntada sida beelaha, khudradda iyo beerka waxay ka hortagaan dhiig yaraanta waxayna taageeraan horumarka ilmaha.
Dholuo: Chiemb chuny kaka bunde, alot, kod chiwogo geng'o remo kik medore kendo gimiyo nyathi bedo gi winjruok maber gi Nyasaye.

English: Fthers are requested to learn on how to wash their babies and to cloth them and soft praising them as one way to confirm an organized family
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanaombwa wajifunze jinsi ya kuwaosha watoto wao na kuwavika nguo na kuwapongeza kwa upole kama njia moja ya kuimarisha familia iliyo na utaratibu
Somali: Dhalinyarada waxaa laga codsanayaa inay bartaan sida caruurtooda loo maydho iyo dharka loo xiro iyo inay si jilicsan u bogaadiyaan sida mid ka mid ah hababka lagu xaqiijinayo qoyska abaabulan
Dholuo: Inyalo kwayo nyithindo mamoko mondo opuonjre lwoko nyithindgi kendo rwakogi gi lewni, kendo gipwoyogi mamuol kaka yo achiel mar miyo joot obed gi winjruok maber

English: KICD reminds needy students in Kisii County that school laptops under the digital literacy programme applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya maombi ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Kisii in laptop-yada dugsiga ee ku jira codsiyada barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: KICD parone jopuonjre man gi chandruok e County mar Kisii ni kompyuta mag skul manie program mar somo kod somo mar digital biro rumo machiegni.

English: As we contain #COVID19, we remind you that Mosquitoes are not under quarantine or lockdown; they are still spreading Malaria. You need to protect yourself from mosquitos & be on lookout for symptoms like fever, headache, joint pains, nausea &vomiting. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa tuna #COVID19, tunakukumbusha kuwa Mbu hawako chini ya karantini au kufungwa; bado wanaeneza Malaria. Unahitaji kujikinga na mbu na kuwa mwangalifu kwa dalili kama vile homa, maumivu ya kichwa, maumivu ya viungo, kichefuchefu na kutapika. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Maadaama aan ku jirno #COVID19, waxaan ku xasuusineynaa in kaneecada aan lagu karantiilin ama la xakameyn; wali waxay faafinayaan duumada. Waa inaad iska ilaalisaa kaneecada oo aad ka fiirsataa calaamadaha sida qandhada, madax-xanuunka, xanuunka kala-goysyada, lallabbo iyo matag. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Kaka wan kod #COVID19, waparoni ni Suna ok ni e bwo kwantin kata geng'ruok; pod gimedo lando tuwo mar Malaria. Owinjore irit ng’ato kuom suna kendo ibed gi ritruok kuom ranyisi kaka liet, wich bar, rem mag ng’ut, ng’ol kod ng’ol. #KomeshaKorona

English: Kenya Red Cross advises residents of Turkana County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya washauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Laanta Cas ee Kenya waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross nyiso jogweng' County mar Turkana mondo odonj e riwruok mar insuarans mar thieth mondo giyud thieth makonyogi.

English: KUCCPS reminds youth in Makueni County that HELB funding is available for welding and fabrication training.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Makueni in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista.
Dholuo: KUCCPS oparo ne rowere man Makueni County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing.

English: KEMSA encourages residents of Tana River County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River County inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay u dhiiri galiyaan saaxiibo dhibaataysan inay caawimaad raadsadaan.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo joma odak e taon mar Tana River County mondo kik gisandre aling' ling' kendo ojiw osiepgi moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds residents of Nandi County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Nandi in helitaanka adeegyada baasaboorka ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone jogweng' County mar Nandi ni koro yot yudo weche mag passport kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Farmers are urged to remain vigilant and report any sightings of migratory pests or desert locusts to local agricultural authorities immediately
Kiswahili: Wakulima wamehimizwa kuwa waangalifu na kutoa taarifa kwa mamlaka za kilimo mara moja wanapoona wadudu wanaohama au nzige wa jangwani.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay feejignaadaan oo ay si degdeg ah ugu soo sheegaan aragtida cayayaanka socdaalka ama cayayaan lamadegaanka ah maamulka beeraha ee deegaanka
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur mondo obed motang' kendo ginyis jodongo mag gweng'no mapiyo ni giyudo akwede ma dhiga e pinje mamoko kata ni gin gi lum mag thim

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds needy students in Samburu County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka ayaa xasuusinaya ardayda u baahan Gobolka Samburu in deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay codsiyada ardayda baahan ay dhowaan dhammaadaan.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e county mar Samburu ni tuke mag somo mag jopuonjre ma nigi chan biro rumo machiegni.

English: Climate Change Turns African Rivers into Epicentres of Conflict
Kiswahili: Mabadiliko ya Tabianchi Yageuza Mito ya Kiafrika kuwa Vitovu vya Migogoro
Somali: Isbeddelka Cimiladu wuxuu Webiyada Afrika u rogaa xudunta khilaafaadka
Dholuo: Lokruok mar kor lwasi loko aora mag Afrika obed kuonde ma lweny keloe

English: Notice: IPOA issues a cybersecurity alert on mobile money scams affecting residents of Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya kashfa za pesa za rununu zinazoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Ogaysiis: IPOA waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Rapar: IPOA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity e wi timbe mag wuond mag pesa mitimo gi simo ma mulo joma odak Kisumu County.

English: KTDA reminds residents of Mandera County that conservation tillage improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba kilimo cha uhifadhi kinaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Somali: KTDA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera in beerashada ilaalinta ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: KTDA parone jogweng'o mag Mandera County ni choko puothe mag puothe medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Women enhance their tech skills in Kakuma refugee camp
Kiswahili: Wanawake huongeza ujuzi wao wa teknolojia katika kambi ya wakimbizi ya Kakuma
Somali: Haweenku waxay horumariyaan xirfadahooda tignoolajiyada ee xerada qaxootiga ee Kakuma
Dholuo: Mon medo lony margi mar teknoloji e kambi mar jolweny mag Kakuma
