English: These are exacerbated by factors such as limited data access, insufficient law enforcement resources, corruption, increasingly complex and digitalized supply chains, fragmented port processes, weak coordination between the public and private sectors and limited international cooperation.
Kiswahili: Hizo huzidishwa na sababu kama vile upungufu wa upatikanaji wa data, rasilimali za kutekeleza sheria zisizo za kutosha, ufisadi, minyororo ya usambazaji iliyozidi kuwa ngumu na ya dijiti, michakato ya bandari iliyogawanyika, ushirikiano dhaifu kati ya sekta za umma na za kibinafsi na ushirika mdogo wa kimataifa.
Somali: Arrimahan waxaa sii daraya arrimo ay ka mid yihiin helitaanka xogta oo xaddidan, ilaha sharci fulinta oo aan ku filnayn, musuqmaasuqa, silsiladaha sahayda ee sii kordheysa oo la dhijitaaliyey, geedi socodka dekedaha ee kala go'an, isuduwidda daciifka ah ee ka dhexeysa qaybaha dadweynaha iyo kuwa gaarka loo leeyahay iyo iskaashiga caalamiga ah ee xadidan.
Dholuo: Timbego medo bedo maricho nikech gik machalo kaka, yudo weche matin, rito chik, mibadhi, wuondruok ma medore e yore mag ng'iewo gik mochuno e ngima ji, ketho chenro mag tiyo gi yedhe ma yudore e dho wath, ketho winjruok e kind sirkal kod sirkal, koda bedo gi winjruok matin e kind pinje mamoko.

English: EACC urges eligible citizens in Busia County to participate in voter education.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Busia kushiriki katika elimu ya wapiga kura.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Busia inay ka qaybqaataan waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jokanyo mag county mar Busia mondo oriwre e tiegruok mar josiasa.

English: Notice from Kenya Medical Association: postnatal check-ups clinics will run every May at designated health centres in Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya: kliniki za uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa zitaendeshwa kila Mei katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya: Caafimaadka baaritaanka dhalmada ka dib waxaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Maajo ee kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo magacaabay ee degmada Kiambu.
Dholuo: Chenro mar Kenya Medical Association: klinik mag nonro bang' nyuol biro dhi nyime dwe mar Mei ka dwe e kuonde thieth moyier e Kaunti mar Kiambu.

English: Magoha says Ksh.1B needed to buy masks for schools
Kiswahili: Magoha anasema Ksh.1B zinahitajika kununua barakoa kwa ajili ya shule
Somali: Magoha ayaa sheegay in Ksh.1B ay u baahan tahay inay iibsato maaskaro dugsiyada
Dholuo: Magoha wacho ni Ksh.1B ne nyaka ng'iew mask ne skunde

English: NCPB advises tea producers in Tharaka-Nithi County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inashauri wazalishaji wa chai katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: NCPB waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha shaaha ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: NCPB nyiso jotelo mag chai e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association confirms a meningitis outbreak alert for Kirinyaga County. Residents are advised to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya chathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa uti wa mgongo katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xaqiijiyay digniin ku saabsan cudurka meningitis ee Gobolka Kirinyaga. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Medical Association osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuo mar meningitis e County mar Kirinyaga.

English: UNICEF Kenya Humanitarian Situation Report No. 01 Mid-Year 2024
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Hali ya Kibinadamu ya UNICEF Kenya Nambari 01 Katikati ya Mwaka 2024
Somali: Warbixinta Xaaladda Bani'aadamnimada ee UNICEF Kenya Lambarka 01 Bartamihii Sannadka 2024
Dholuo: Ripot mar chal mar konyo dhano mar UNICEF e piny Kenya namba 01 e kind higa mar 2024

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service encourages farmers in Samburu County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for coffee.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya kahawa.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda Gobolka Samburu inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan kafeega.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur e county mar Samburu mondo ous olembe mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo olembe mondo omi olembe mag chai obed maber.

English: The sugar sector is a vital economic pillar and source of livelihood for millions in western Kenya
Kiswahili: Sekta ya sukari ni nguzo muhimu ya kiuchumi na chanzo cha maisha kwa mamilioni ya watu magharibi mwa Kenya
Somali: Qaybta sonkorta waa tiir dhaqaale oo muhiim ah iyo il nolol oo malaayiin qof ku nool galbeedka Kenya
Dholuo: Tij loso sukari en gima duong' ahinya e ngima ji tara gi tara modak e piny Kenya

English: TVETA commences digitalization of TVET curricula to support e-learning modalities and wider access.
Kiswahili: TVETA huanza kubadilisha ramani za masomo ya TVET kusaidia njia za e-kujifunza na upatikanaji mpana.
Somali: TVETA waxay bilaabaneysaa dhijitaalka barnaamijyada waxbarasho ee TVET si ay u taageerto qaababka barashada elektaroonigga ah iyo helitaanka ballaaran.
Dholuo: TVETA chako keto chenro mag tiegruok mag TVET e digital mondo okony e tiego e yor e-learning kod yudo thuolo momedore.

English: The Ministry of Health has assured the public that the Mpox situation in the country is not comparable to the COVID-19 pandemic.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya imewahakikishia umma kwamba hali ya Mpox nchini hailinganishwi na janga la COVID-19.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa shacabka u xaqiijisay in xaaladda Mpox ee dalka aysan la barbar dhigin cudurka faafa ee COVID-19.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth osesingore ne ji ni chal mar Mpox e piny ok nyal pim gi tuo mar COVID-19.

English: Notice: NPS activates an emergency response plan for landslides in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NPS inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ka dhan ah dhulgariirada degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NPS tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony mapiyo ne yiengni mag lowo e County mar Kisii.

English: Kenya Dairy Board urges rice growers in Nairobi County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda bariiska ee Gobolka Nairobi inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalaalka ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur ma pidho kodhi e County mar Nairobi mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages mothers in Bomet County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Bomet kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa hooyooyinka degmada Bomet inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo mine manie county mar Bomet mondo olimgi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Uasin Gishu County to complete the full recommended vaccination dose following a rise in reported malaria cases.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya malaria vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu inay dhammaystiraan qiyaasta tallaalka oo dhan ee lagugula talinayo ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska fayraska ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ojiwo jogweng' Uasin Gishu County mondo otiek dose duto mar thieth nikech kwan mar joma nigi malaria osemedore.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will open a coffee collection centre in Kisii County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itafungua kituo cha kukusanya kahawa katika Kaunti ya Kisii Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu bilaabi doonaa xarun ururinta kafeega ee degmada Kisii bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro yawo ot mar choko chai e County mar Kisii e dwe mar Januar.

English: TSC urges residents of Laikipia County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa watu wazima ili kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: TSC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay iska diiwaangeliyaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Laikipia mondo odonj e program mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo mondo giyud somo mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: DPP reminds mobile money users in Nakuru County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid fake investment schemes.

Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) waxay qaban doontaa madasha wacyiga dhimirka ee degmada Isiolo bishii Maarso. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo chokruok mar chiwo paro e wi tuwo mar depression e taon mar Isiolo e dwe mar Mach.

English: By March 2021 all fishing vessels in Kenyan waters must land their catch at Kenyan Ports to avoid license revocation
Kiswahili: Kufikia Machi 2021 meli zote za uvuvi katika maji ya Kenya lazima zitue kwenye Bandari za Kenya ili kuepusha kufutiwa leseni.
Somali: Marka la gaaro Maarso 2021, dhammaan maraakiibta kalluumaysiga ee biyaha Kenya waa inay kalluumaystooda ku dejistaan dekedaha Kenya si looga fogaado in laysanka la joojiyo
Dholuo: E dwe mar Mach 2021, yiedhi duto mag rech manie pi Kenya nyaka chop e dho wath mag Kenya mondo kik gikwed rusa

English: While Kenya demonstrates sustained steady economic growth, the gains remain uneven.
Kiswahili: Huku Kenya ikionyesha ukuaji endelevu wa uchumi, mafanikio bado hayafanani.
Somali: Iyadoo Kenya ay muujinayso kobac dhaqaale oo joogto ah, haddana faa'iidooyinka ayaa weli aan sinnayn.
Dholuo: Kata obedo ni piny Kenya nyiso dongruok ma dhi nyime e weche yuto, ber ma yudore pod ok romre.

English: NPS urges the community in Trans Nzoia County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb burglary.
Kiswahili: NPS inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu usiowajua ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo oganda man Trans Nzoia County mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo kik gikwed nek.

English: AFA urges farmers in Bungoma County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: AFA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Bungoma inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Bungoma mondo opidh cham mondo omi lowo okethre, mondo omi giritre kuom lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: Notice: NDMA conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Bungoma County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Januari hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: NDMA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada oo ku saabsan ka hortagga argagixisada ee degmada Bungoma bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA timo romo mar oganda e dwe mar Januar e kaunti mar Bungoma.

English: Public notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will host a free tobacco control outreach in Nakuru County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa kudhibiti tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa qaban doonta dadaal lacag la'aan ah oo ka dhan ah xakamaynta sigaarka ee Gobolka Nakuru bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo kampen mar golo ndawa maonge chudo e kaunti mar Nakuru e dwe mar Februar.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds needy students in Kilifi County that free digital learning content applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kwamba maombi ya bure ya maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya ardayda u baahan degmada Kilifi in codsiyada barnaamijyada barashada bilaashka ah ee dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e gweng' mar Kilifi ni chenro mag somo mar digital ma onge chudo chiegni rumo.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMSA will be held in Kwale County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMSA itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kwale Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay KEMSA ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Kwale bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma KEMSA ochano ibiro tim e dwe mar Jun e county mar Kwale.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Kilifi County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun iyo biyo nadiif ah si joogto ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' Kilifi County mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: The Ministry has announced a plan of various quality foods for the body in a bid to maintain blood levels in the body and to promote safe birth
Kiswahili: Wizara imetangaza mpango wa vyakula mbalimbali bora kwa mwili kwa lengo la kudumisha viwango vya damu mwilini na kukuza uzazi salama.
Somali: Wasaaraddu waxay ku dhawaaqday qorshe cuntooyin kala duwan oo tayo leh oo loogu talagalay jirka si loo ilaaliyo heerarka dhiigga ee jirka iyo in la dhiirrigeliyo dhalmada badbaadada leh
Dholuo: Od tich oselando chenro mar chiemo mopogore opogore ma nigi ng’eyo maber ne ringruok e yor rito kwan mar remo e ringruok kendo mondo oket nyuol maber .

English: AFA encourages farmers in Nyandarua County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for coffee.
Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za kahawa.
Somali: AFA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyandarua inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan kafeega.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e kaunti mar Nyandarua mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro mondo omi ohala mar chai obed maber.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the public in Tana River County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inahimiza umma katika Wilaya ya Tana River kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadweynaha degmada Tana River inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Otendi mar Wuoyo jiwo ji duto e taon mar Tana River County mondo ong'e kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma ne oland kuom wuond ma ne otim gi SIM-swap.

English: Notice: Council of Governors launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kakamega County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Septemba hii.

Dholuo: Riwruok mar Jaloch chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Kakamega e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges motorists and pedestrians in Bomet County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent landslides-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Bomet kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya gawaarida iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Bomet inay u hoggaansamaan amarada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira dhulgariirka.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo dereche mag mtoka kod jowuoth e county mar Bomet mondo oluw chike mag golo ji ma sirkal ogolo mondo gikwed masiche ma timore nikech yiengni mag lowo.

English: FAO advises avocado producers in Kwale County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: FAO inashauri wazalishaji wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: FAO waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha avocado ee Gobolka Kwale inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur mag avocado e county mar Kwale mondo oti gi nengo mar piny moseketo kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Farmers are advised to implement a regular fungicide spray program to protect crops from diseases Choose between protectant fungicides for preventive measures or curative ones once diseases are spotted
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa kutekeleza programu ya mara kwa mara ya kunyunyiza viua kuvu ili kulinda mazao dhidi ya magonjwa Chagua kati ya dawa za kuzuia fangasi kwa ajili ya hatua za kuzuia au za kutibu mara magonjwa yanapoonekana.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagula talinayaa inay hirgeliyaan barnaamij buufin fungicide si joogto ah si looga ilaaliyo dalagga cudurrada kala doortaan fungicides ilaaliya si looga hortago ama loo daaweeyo marka cudurrada la arko
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur mondo oti gi program mar thiedho kitaya ma ok kare mondo orit cham kik hinyre gi tuoche.

English: KEMRI reminds the public that free trauma counselling support is available through county health facilities in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa ushauri wa kiwewe unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo la talinta dhaawaca laga helo xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: KEMRI oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tuoche yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Nyandarua.

English: No violence! Report student issues to school management.
Kiswahili: Hakuna vurugu! Ripoti masuala ya wanafunzi kwa usimamizi wa shule.

Dholuo: Onge timbe gero! Nyis jotelo mag skul weche mag jopuonjre.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education reminds citizens in Turkana County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.

Dholuo: NTSA okwayo ji duto manie Homa Bay County mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: Notice: AFA will train farmers in Nandi County on conservation tillage this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi juu ya kilimo cha uhifadhi Julai hii.

Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC yazindua mpango wa kupinga uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kakamega.

Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe gero e skunde duto e Kaunti mar Kakamega.

English: OGP urges residents of Nairobi County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waendelee kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja ya kaunti.

English: EACC warns public officers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: EACC inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: EACC waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet khiyaanooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: EACC chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet kuom timbe mag mibadhi.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages mothers in Narok County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Narok kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.

Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ojiwo mine manie Narok County mondo olimgi machiegni gi kama ginyuoloe nyithindo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: KEMRI encourages mothers in Mandera County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Mandera kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.

Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo mine man Mandera County mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) advises residents of Mandera County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kuthibitisha kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea kupata huduma ya afya ya ruzuku.

Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) nyiso jogweng'o mag Mandera County mondo ong'e ni kuondegi mag thieth oseyudo ratiro kapok gibiro mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Universities Fund announces distribution of textbooks and learning materials to schools in Narok County this July.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unatangaza usambazaji wa vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Narok Julai hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku dhawaaqay in bishii Luulyo uu qeybin doono buugaagta waxbarasho iyo qalabka wax lagu barto dugsiyada gobolka Narok.

English: Former refugee wins global Nansen award for championing education for displaced children

English: AMR is making infections harder to treat, increasing the risk of disease spread, severe illness and death, while placing growing pressure on health systems worldwide.
Kiswahili: AMR inafanya maambukizo kuwa magumu kutibu, na kuongeza hatari ya kuenea kwa magonjwa, ugonjwa mbaya na kifo, huku ikiweka shinikizo kubwa kwenye mifumo ya afya ulimwenguni.

Dholuo: AMR miyo tuoche ma nyalo mako ng’ato bedo matek thiedho, kendo medo nyalo mar lando tuoche, tuoche mager kod tho, ka en bende oketo pek ma medore kuom sistem mag thieth e piny mangima.

English: TVET urges parents and teachers in Kitui County to reach out to the child helpline 116.

Dholuo: TVET jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Kitui mondo omany simo mar kony ne nyithindo namba 116.

English: KNEC advises students in Kajiado County to collect materials from the county education office to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kukusanya vifaa kutoka kwa ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.

Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jopuonjre e Kajiado County mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar tiegruok mar county mondo giyud buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the community in Isiolo County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb carjacking.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia utekaji nyara wa gari.

Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuleta nambari yao ya usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.

English: Public notice: Kenya Medical Association will host a free tobacco control outreach in Turkana County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa udhibiti wa tumbaku bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Turkana Agosti hii.

Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Migori kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.

English: DPP urges residents of Taita-Taveta County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: DPP inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Taita-Taveta in ay iskaashi la sameeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji ng'enyie nikech ji medo neno yore mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Employers can identify signs of mental health issues in the workplace by observing changes in behavior, such as increased absenteeism, decreased productivity, or withdrawal from colleagues
Kiswahili: Waajiri wanaweza kutambua dalili za matatizo ya afya ya akili mahali pa kazi kwa kuona mabadiliko katika tabia, kama vile kuongezeka kwa kutokuwepo kazini, kupungua kwa tija, au kujiondoa kutoka kwa wafanyakazi wenzao.
Somali: Shaqo-bixiyeyaashu waxay aqoonsan karaan calaamadaha dhibaatooyinka caafimaadka maskaxda ee goobta shaqada iyagoo arki doona isbeddellada dabeecadda, sida kororka maqnaanshaha, hoos u dhaca wax soo saarka, ama ka bixitaanka asxaabta
Dholuo: Jotelo nyalo fwenyo ranyisi mag tuoche mag obwongo ka gin e tich kuom ng'iyo kaka tim ng'ato lokore, kaka bedo maonge, bedo gi nyak matin, kata weyo tiyo gi jotich wetene

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the public in Mombasa County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unashauri umma katika Kaunti ya Mombasa wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za ujumbe wa udanganyifu.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya shacabka degmada Mombasa inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qofna kadib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ji duto e county mar Mombasa mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo weche mag twege mag phishing.

English: Kenya Red Cross advises residents of Meru County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Kirinyaga County about the importance of tobacco control for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuhusu umuhimu wa udhibiti wa tumbaku kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay dadka degmada Kirinyaga ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay xakamaynta sigaarka ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne ji e County mar Kirinyaga gimomiyo thieth mar madho ndawa en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: KTDA warns beans farmers in Mombasa County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaonya wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Mombasa juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KTDA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda ku nool gobolka Mombasa cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa in si sax ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: KTDA chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho puothe e county mar Mombasa kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: TSC reminds youth in Tharaka-Nithi County that HELB funding is available for ICT skills training.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT.
Somali: TSC waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Tharaka-Nithi in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka xirfadaha ICT.
Dholuo: TSC oparo ne rowere man Tharaka-Nithi County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar lony e yore mag ICT.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages residents of Marsabit County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo jogweng' mar Marsabit County mondo kik gisandre aling' ling' kendo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Food Security Outlook June 2024 - January 2025: Despite flooding, above-average long rains support ongoing drought recovery
Kiswahili: Mtazamo wa Usalama wa Chakula nchini Kenya Juni 2024 - Januari 2025: Licha ya mafuriko, mvua ndefu zaidi ya wastani zinaweza kusaidia kukabiliana na ukame
Somali: Aragtida Sugnaanta Cuntada Kenya Juun 2024 - Janaayo 2025: Iyadoo ay jiraan daadad, roobabka dhaadheer ee ka sarreeya celceliska ayaa taageeraya soo kabashada abaarta ee socota
Dholuo: Neno mar Rieko mar Chiemo e Kenya dwe mar auchiel 2024 - dwe mar achiel 2025: Kata obedo ni pi opong'o piny, koth mabor ma malo moloyo pile konyo e dongruok mar oro

English: Neighbours who receive food bring us some, and others bring oil.
Kiswahili: Majirani wanaopokea chakula hutuletea, na wengine huleta mafuta.
Somali: Deriska cuntada qaata qaar baa noo keena, kuwa kalena saliid bay keenaan.
Dholuo: Joma ni machiegni ma yudo chiemo kelonwa moko, to jomoko kelonwa mo.

English: Starehe Boys Centre receives multi-agency security visit.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Wavulana cha Starehe hupokea ziara ya usalama ya mashirika mengi.
Somali: Xarunta wiilasha ee Starehe waxay heshay booqasho amni oo hay'ado badan leh.
Dholuo: Starehe Boys Centre yudo limbe mag sirkal mopogore opogore.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges residents of Samburu County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia laini ya bure ya EACC ili kupambana na matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Samburu ku boorinayaa inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee EACC si looga hortago xadgudubka xilka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General jiwo jogweng' mar Samburu County mondo oland weche mag mibadhi kokalo kuom simo mar EACC ma onge chudo mondo giked gi timbe mag tiyo marach gi migepe.

English: Notice from Division of Disease Surveillance and Response: nutrition supplementation for infants clinics will run every September at designated health centres in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa: nyongeza ya lishe kwa kliniki za watoto wachanga itaendeshwa kila Septemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka socda qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada: Kordhinta nafaqada ee rugta caafimaadka ee dhallaanka ayaa lagu sameyn doonaa bishii Sebtember ee xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Mombasa.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo wacho ni, thieth mag chiemo ne nyithindo matindo ibiro tim dwe mar ochiko higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Mombasa.

English: Isiolo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Isiolo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Mei 2023
Somali: Degmada Isiolo: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Isiolo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar abich higa mar 2023

English: Pest Control Products Board announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for cattle in Kiambu County this December.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Desemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa ku dhawaaqaya jimicsi tallaal oo bilaash ah oo cudurka Newcastle ah oo loogu talagalay lo'da degmada Kiambu bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok mar Pest olando ni ibiro tim kampen mar golo tuoche mag Newcastle maonge chudo ne dhok e County mar Kiambu e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: KEMSA will hold a depression awareness forum in Uasin Gishu County this October. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA itafanya kongamano la uhamasishaji wa unyogovu katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Oktoba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMSA waxay qaban doontaa madasha wacyiga dhimirka ee gobolka Uasin Gishu bisha Oktoobar. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMSA biro timo chokruok mar chiwo paro e wi tuwo mar depression e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: KICD opens a new motor vehicle mechanics programme at the vocational centre in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD yafungua programu mpya ya ufundi wa magari katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan farsamada gawaarida gawaari ee xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KICD chako chenro manyien mar tiyo gi masin mag mtokni e skul mar tiegruok e taon mar Nyeri.

English: KTDA reminds farmers in Lamu County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Somali: KTDA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Lamu barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee ka dambeeya goosashada.
Dholuo: KTDA parone jopur man Lamu County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime bang' keyo.

English: Notice: EACC will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay qabaneysaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda gobolka ee gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: EACC biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e county mar Uasin Gishu.

English: DCI urges the public in Kajiado County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: DCI inahimiza umma katika Kajiado County kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: DCI waxay ugu baaqeysaa shacabka degmada Kajiado inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada iyada oo loo marayo kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo ji duto e Kajiado County mondo ong'e kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma osefweny kuom chenro mag ohala mag miriambo.

English: Notice: NDMA conducts a community briefing on border security in Lamu County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA inafanya mkutano wa jamii juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Lamu Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha ee Gobolka Lamu bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e County mar Lamu e dwe mar Novemba.

English: NDMA reminds mobile money users in Mombasa County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid identity theft.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee gobolka Mombasa inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna si looga fogaado in la xado aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: NDMA paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e county mar Mombasa ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo kik gikwed kwalo kitgi.

English: Notice: CDC confirms a cholera outbreak alert for Baringo County. Residents are advised to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ilani: CDC inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa kipindupindu kwa Kaunti ya Baringo. Wakazi wanashauriwa kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: CDC waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ku saabsan cudurka faafa ee Baringo County. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagu taliyey.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar yedhe ma thiedho tuoche (CDC) osenyiso ni nitie masira mar cholera e gweng' mar Baringo.

English: KEMSA launches a December awareness campaign on tobacco control across Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Desemba juu ya udhibiti wa tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: KEMSA waxay bilaabeysaa olole wacyi galineed bishii Diseembar ee ka dhanka ah xakamaynta sigaarka ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: KEMSA chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Desemba e wi thieth mar ndawa e kaunti duto mar Taita-Taveta.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya calls on the community in Murang'a County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Murang'a inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan isla markaana ay taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow ee aaminka ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji (Communications Authority of Kenya) dwaro ni ji duto modak e County mar Murang'a ochiw pachgi mondo gikwed timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gidwar kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Kenya Price Bulletin, August 2023
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Bei ya Kenya, Agosti 2023
Somali: War-saxaafadeedka Qiimaha Kenya, Ogosto 2023
Dholuo: Oboke mar Nengo mar Kenya, dwe mar aboro higa mar 2023

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds the public in Kitui County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu xasuusinayaa shacabka degmada Kitui in warbixinta khayaanada iibsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone ji duto e County mar Kitui ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag ohala en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: KEPHIS informs milk farmers in Kwale County of new market linkage opportunities this May.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawafahamisha wakulima wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Mei hii.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda caanaha ee Gobolka Kwale fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha May.
Dholuo: KEPHIS nyiso jopur mag chak e county mar Kwale kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar abich.

English: Announcement about SNV pledging continued support to Kenya's food systems transformation during Nairobi National Summit.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kuhusu SNV kuahidi kuendelea kuunga mkono mabadiliko ya mifumo ya chakula nchini Kenya wakati wa Mkutano wa Kitaifa wa Nairobi.
Somali: Shaacinta ku saabsan SNV waxay ballanqaadaysaa inay sii wadi doonto taageerada isbeddelka nidaamyada cuntada ee Kenya intii lagu jiray Shir-madaxeedka Qaran ee Nairobi.
Dholuo: Oboke kuom SNV ma singo mar dhi nyime gi konyo e loko yore mag chiemo e piny Kenya e kinde mar chokruok maduong’ mar piny Nairobi.

English: Narok County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Narok: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2022
Somali: Degmada Narok: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Narok: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2022

English: Stay safe! Know your schoolÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬TMs flood safety zones.
Kiswahili: Uwe salama, ujue maeneo ya usalama wa mafuriko ya shule yako.
Somali: Nabadgelyo! Ogow meelaha badbaadada daadadka ee dugsigaaga.
Dholuo: Bed gi arita makare! Ng’e ni skul mari nyalo bedo gi arita ma nyalo geng’o pi mang’eny.

English: CDC reminds the public that free tuberculosis screening is available at all public health centres in Nairobi County this December.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kifua kikuu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Desemba hii.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka caabuqa ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhamaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadwaynaha ee degmada Nairobi bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji ni nonro mar thieth mar tuberculosis ma onge chudo yudore e ofise duto mag thieth e Nairobi County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: How does washing hands help prevent the spread of COVID-19? A - Soap rinses the virus off B - Soap destroys the virus C - Soap mutates the virus D - All of the above #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Je, kunawa mikono kunasaidia vipi kuzuia kuenea kwa COVID-19? A - Sabuni husafisha virusi B - Sabuni huharibu virusi C - Sabuni hubadilisha virusi D - Yote haya hapo juu #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Sidee bay gacmaha la dhaqayaa uga hortagaan faafitaanka COVID-19? A - Saabuuntu waxay ka nadiifisaa fayraska B - Saabuuntu waxay baabi'isaa fayraska C - Saabuuntu waxay beddeshaa fayraska D - Dhammaan kuwa kor ku xusan #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Ere kaka lwoko lwedo konyo e geng'o landruok mar COVID-19? A - Sabun weyo midhusi B - Sabun ketho midhusi C - Sabun loko midhusi D - Gik moko duto ma owach malo #KomeshaCorona

English: KICD reminds parents in Tana River County that free primary education registration is open this February.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Tana River kwamba usajili wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo umefunguliwa Februari hii.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Tana River in diiwaangelinta bilaashka ah ee waxbarashada hoose ay furan tahay bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne jonyuol e taon mar Tana River County ni chenro mar somo mar pinyruoth ma onge chudo osechakore e dwe mar Februar.

English: Peace Actors Forum Revives Coordination Activities to Address Conflict in Wajir
Kiswahili: Jukwaa la Waigizaji wa Amani Linafufua Shughuli za Uratibu ili Kushughulikia Migogoro huko Wajir
Somali: Golaha Jilayaasha Nabadda oo Dib u Soo nooleeyay Hawlaha Isku-dubaridka si wax looga qabto colaadda Wajeer
Dholuo: Forum mar Jotugo mag Kwe Kelo kendo Tije mag Riwruok mar Loso Lweny e Wajir

English: Taita Taveta County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Taita Taveta: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2024
Somali: Degmada Taita Taveta: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Taita Taveta: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar apar 2024

English: Ministry of Education encourages residents of Tana River County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on voter registration.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda mondo gibed molony e weche mag ndiko ji.

English: ASAL Humanitarian Network MPCT New Beneficiaries Endline Assessment, Mandera County, March 2022
Kiswahili: Tathmini ya Mwisho ya Mtandao wa Kibinadamu wa ASAL MPCT Wafaidika Wapya, Kaunti ya Mandera, Machi 2022
Somali: Qiimaynta Dhammaadka Ka-faa'iideystayaasha Cusub ee Shabakadda Bani'aadamnimada ee ASAL MPCT, Degmada Mandheera, Maarso 2022
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kony Dhano mar ASAL MPCT Rang'iny mogik mar jogo mabiro yudo ber manyien, gweng' mar Mandera, dwe mar adek higa mar 2022

English: There is good progress observed in Kenya among 12 countries of Africa in the fight against malaria targeted tio receive 18 million malaria vaccine dosses for the next 2 year
Kiswahili: Kuna maendeleo mazuri yaliyoonekana nchini Kenya kati ya nchi 12 za Afrika katika mapambano dhidi ya ugonjwa wa malaria ambao wanastahili kupokea dozi milioni 18 za chanjo ya malaria kwa miaka miwili ijayo
Somali: Waxaa jira horumar wanaagsan oo lagu arkay Kenya 12-ka dal ee Afrika ee la dagaalanka Cudurka Cudurrada Malaria, kuwaas oo helaya 18 milyan oo qiyaasood oo tallaal ah oo ka hortagga cudurka 2 sano ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Nitie dongruok maber mosetim e Kenya e kind pinje 12 mag Afrika e kedo gi malaria

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development warns maize farmers in Mombasa County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Wanyama inawaonya wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa dhidi ya mlipuko wa wadudu na kupendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa uga digtay beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Mombasa cudurrada cayayaanka, waxayna ku talineysay in si sax ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho kodhi e County mar Mombasa kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds expectant mothers in Wajir County that access to postnatal check-ups is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba upatikanaji wa uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Wajir in helitaanka baaritaannada dhalmada ka dib ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne mine ma biro nyuolo e gweng' mar Wajir ni dhi e nonro mag nyuol en gima onge chudo e ute duto.

English: HELB advises applicants in Embu County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: HELB inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Embu kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: HELB waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Embu inay dalbadaan booska TVET ee KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Embu mondo oketgi e tiegruok mar TVET kokalo kuom KUCCPS.

English: KTDA reminds residents of Bungoma County that organic farming improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba kilimo hai kinaboresha uzalishaji wa muda mrefu wa shamba.
Somali: KTDA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma in beeraha dabiiciga ah uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: KTDA paronwa jogweng'o mag Bungoma County ni pur ma nigi yien ma ok oketie yien miyo puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges residents of Taita-Taveta County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Uhalifu unawahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya dadka deggan degmada Taita-Taveta inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo la adeegsanayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo jogweng'o mag Taita-Taveta County mondo oriw lwedo weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'adoe bura nikech ji medo keto pachgi kuom chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: KALRO urges coffee growers in Garissa County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Garissa kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda kafeega ee Gobolka Garissa inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e gweng' mar Garissa mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue mondo okony e medo nyak mar koth e higani.

English: Public health advisory: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response warns of increased typhoid risk in Taita-Taveta County and advises the public to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya matumbo katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta na inashauri umma kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Somali: Talo-bixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay ka digtay kororka halista cudurka 'typhoid' ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: Migawo mar Nono kod Duoko ne Tuoche chiwo siem kuom nengo mar typhoid medore e Taita-Taveta County kendo ojiwo ji duto mondo otiek dose duto mar thiedho.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public that free stress management support is available through county health facilities in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kudhibiti mafadhaiko unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Tana River.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo lagu maareeyo walbahaarka laga helo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Tana River County.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar stress yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e Tana River County.

English: OGP invites residents of Wajir County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: OGP inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: OGP waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: OGP gwelo ji modak e County mar Wajir mondo oriwre kodgi kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e wi chenro mag dongruok.

English: NCPB encourages farmers in Kirinyaga County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for coffee.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya kahawa.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kirinyaga inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo kafee ah.

English: AFA promotes soil conservation among farmers in Nandi County as part of the March climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: AFA inakuza uhifadhi wa udongo kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Machi.
Somali: AFA waxay kor u qaadeysaa ilaalinta ciidda beeraleyda gobolka Nandi iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Maarso.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo rito lowo e kind jopur e county mar Nandi kaka achiel kuom chenro mar kedo gi lokruok mar kor lwasi e dwe mar Mach.

English: Ministry of Education reminds parents in Machakos County that school feeding programme registration is open this May.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba usajili wa programu ya kulisha shule umefunguliwa Mei hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Machakos in diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga ay furan tahay bisha May.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok parone jonyuol e county mar Machakos ni chenro mar kwayo nyithindo chiemo e skul ochakore e dwe mar abich.

English: Council of Governors urges residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandao wa kaunti ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku boorinayaan dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Council of Governors jiwo jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e loso chenro mag chenro mag sirkal.

English: NTSA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Bomet County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NTSA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuripoti kesi kwenye dawati la karibu la jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka gobolka Bomet inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e kaunti mar Bomet mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: NPS urges motorists and pedestrians in Busia County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NPS inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Busia kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Busia inay u hoggaansamaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay adeegsadaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee socodka si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo jorit mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Busia mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe mondo gitang' ne masiche motudore gi apaka.

English: TVET advises applicants in Machakos County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Machakos kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: TVET waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Machakos inay dalbadaan booska TVET iyada oo loo marayo KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e gweng' mar Machakos mondo oketgi e tiegruok mar TVET kokalo kuom KUCCPS.

English: CDC reminds the public that free dengue fever screening is available at all public health centres in Kisumu County this January.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa homa ya dengue unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Januari hii.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka hargabka dengue ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynta ee degmada Kisumu bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji ni nonro ma onge chudo mar dengue yudore e kuonde thieth duto mag Kisumu County e dwe mar Januar.

English: Samburu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Samburu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Mei 2023

English: Public notice: CDC will host a free safe water storage outreach in Nandi County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: CDC itakuwa mwenyeji wa ufikiaji wa bure wa uhifadhi wa maji salama katika Kaunti ya Nandi Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: CDC waxay marti gelineysaa adeeg lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee gobolka Nandi bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar yedhe (CDC) biro timo chenro mar choko pi maonge chudo e taon mar Nandi e dwe mar Januar.

Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Tahadhari ya Mapema ya Kitaifa (Septemba 2023)
Somali: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Qaranka (Sebtembar 2023)
Dholuo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro (Dwe mar Apar 2023)

English: KICD announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Nyandarua County this March.
Kiswahili: KICD yatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Machi hii.
Somali: KICD waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta waxyaabaha waxbarasho ee bilaashka ah ee dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada gobolka Nyandarua bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: KICD olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag digital maonge chudo e skunde man Nyandarua County e dwe mar Mach.

English: The Interior Minister restated the zero tolerance stance toward acts classified as terrorism and emphasized justice and public protection.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Mambo ya Ndani alisisitiza msimamo wa uvumilivu wa sifuri kuelekea vitendo vilivyoainishwa kama ugaidi na kusisitiza haki na ulinzi wa umma.
Somali: Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha ayaa ku celceliyay mowqifka dulqaadka eber ee ku saabsan falalka loo aqoonsan yahay argagixisada wuxuuna hoosta ka xariiqay caddaaladda iyo ilaalinta dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministri mar weche mag ot nojiwo ni ok ginyal yie gi timbe ma ji luongo ni timbe mahundu kendo ne ojiwo ni gibiro bedo gi timbe makare kod ritruok mar oganda.

English: Notice: e-Citizen launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Bomet County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Bomet mwezi huu Oktoba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: e-Citizen waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa gobolka Bomet bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Par ane ni e-Citizen chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Bomet e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Judiciary of Kenya invites residents of Homa Bay County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kushiriki kupitia portal ya kushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusu ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee gobolka ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya gwelo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo oriwre gi sirkal mar county kokalo kuom websait mar konyruok e weche mag nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: DCI urges the public in Garissa County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of identity theft.
Kiswahili: DCI inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Garissa inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qof kasta oo ka dambeeya kiisaska la soo sheegay ee tuugista aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo ji duto e County mar Garissa mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' weche mag kwalo kitgi.

English: Meru (Meru-North) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for December 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Meru (Meru-Kaskazini): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Desemba 2022

Dholuo: Kaunti mar Meru (Meru-Nyath): Oboke mar Chik Mapile mar Oro mar Disemba 2022

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Laikipia County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia in warbixinta khiyaamooyinka si dhakhso leh ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne jogweng' Laikipia County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar wuondruok konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: DPP urges the public in Nandi County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: DPP inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Nandi wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: DPP waxay ugu baaqeysaa shacabka degmada Nandi inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo ji duto e county mar Nandi mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' weche mag wuond ma ne otimore kuom SIM-swap.

English: KEPHIS encourages farmers in Homa Bay County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for coffee.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za kahawa.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Homa Bay inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo kafee ah.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e county mar Homa Bay mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro mondo omi ohala mar kofi obed maber.

English: CDC calls on parents in Wajir County to have children under five screened for malaria during the December outreach.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuwafanyia upimaji wa malaria watoto chini ya miaka mitano wakati wa mawasiliano ya Desemba.
Somali: CDC waxay ku baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Wajir inay carruurta ka yar shan sano u sameeyaan baaritaanka cudurka daacuunka inta lagu gudajiro bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: CDC kwayo jonyuol e County mar Wajir mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: NDMA activates an emergency response plan for drought in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ukame katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo abaaraha ku dhaca gobolka Mandera.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne oro e gweng' mar Mandera.

English: Notice: TSC opens a new welding and fabrication programme at the vocational centre in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC inafungua programu mpya ya kulehemu na utengenezaji katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan alxanka iyo soo saarista xarunta xirfadaha ee gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: TSC ochako chenro manyien mar loso kendo loso gik moko e kambi mar tiegruok e taon mar Lamu.

English: Notice: KTDA will open a milk collection centre in Kakamega County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itafungua kituo cha kukusanya maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay xarun u furan doontaa ururinta caanaha ee Gobolka Kakamega bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA biro yawo kambi mar choko chak e taon mar Kakamega e dwe mar Agost.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for sheep in Kilifi County this October.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Oktoba hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka Newcastle ee idaha ee Gobolka Kilifi bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) ogolo chenro mar goyo ne rombe thieth mar Newcastle disease maonge chudo e dwe mar Oktoba e gweng' mar Kilifi.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties advises residents of West Pokot County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya West Pokot kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka deggan degmada West Pokot kula talinayaa inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties nyiso jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro kwayo mar bedo gi kidono.

Kiswahili: Watoa Huduma za Ugani wa Kilimo nchini Uganda wanahimizwa kupitisha Kanuni mpya ya Maadili ili kuboresha utoaji wa huduma Fikia kanuni hapa.
