Dholuo: Ojiwo Jokanyo mag Tij Lemo e Piny Uganda mondo okaw Chik manyien mar Timbe Maler mondo omed miyo tij lendo bedo maber

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will distribute certified cassava seed to farmers in Uasin Gishu County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu zilizothibitishwa za manii kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu u qaybin doonaa abuurka cassava ee la caddeeyay beeraleyda ku nool gobolka Uasin Gishu bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Dairy Board biro pogo kodhi mag cassava ne jopur manie Uasin Gishu County e dwe mar Mach.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the public in Kwale County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of identity theft.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawahimiza raia wa Kaunti ya Kwale wasiishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya shacabka degmada Kwale inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee tuugada aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ji duto e county mar Kwale mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' weche mag kwalo kitgi.

English: Coughing for more than two weeks? Pregnant women should get tested for TB early.
Kiswahili: Kukohoa kwa zaidi ya wiki mbili? Wanawake wajawazito wanapaswa kupimwa kifua kikuu mapema.
Somali: Haweeneyda uurka leh waxay u baahan yihiin inay horay u sameeyaan baaritaanka cudurka TB.
Dholuo: Mon ma nigi ich onego otimnegi nonro chon mondo ging'e ka be gin gi tuwo mar TB.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Lamu County this November. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitafanya kongamano la kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Lamu Novemba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya wuxuu qabsan doonaa madasha dib u soo kabashada daroogada ee gobolka Lamu bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni Kenya Medical Association biro timo romo mar chango joma otiyo gi yedhe mamero e dwe mar Novemba e County mar Lamu.

English: Baringo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for November 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Baringo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Novemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Baringo: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Noofambar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Baringo: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2022

English: FAO warns millet farmers in Kitui County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: FAO inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Kitui juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: FAO waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda millet ee degmada Kitui cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: FAO chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho olemo mag millet e gweng' mar Kitui ni nitie tuoche ma nyalo landore kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: COMESA announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Meru County this November.
Kiswahili: COMESA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Meru Novemba hii.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo cudurka Newcastle ah oo loogu talagalay lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Meru bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: COMESA ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok ma nigi dhok ma chamo kong'o e dwe mar Novemba e kaunti mar Meru.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Migori County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi diiwaangelinta beeraleyda loogu talagalay beeralayda Degmada Migori bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Dairy Board biro timo rapar mar jopur e dwe mar April e kaunti mar Migori.

English: TSC invites youth in Isiolo County to enroll for ICT skills training this July.
Kiswahili: TSC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT Julai hii.
Somali: TSC waxay ku casuumaysaa dhalinyarada degmada Isiolo inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka xirfadaha ICT bisha July.
Dholuo: TSC gwelo rowere e kaunti mar Isiolo mondo odonj e tiegruok mar ICT e dwe mar Julai.

English: NTSA calls on residents of Nairobi County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: NTSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga dhaqdhaqaaq aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah si ay u taageeraan taxadarka ka dhanka ah argagixisada.
Dholuo: NTSA okwayo jogweng' Nairobi mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma rito sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e alwora mar tong'gi mondo gikony e kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Bridging the Healthcare Gap: Nawiri's Impact in Revitalizing Moite and Marsabitâ€™s Remote Communities
Kiswahili: Kuziba Pengo la Huduma ya Afya: Athari za Nawiri katika Kufufua Jumuiya za Mbali za Moite na Marsabit.
Somali: Buuxinta Farqiga Daryeelka Caafimaadka: Saamaynta Nawiri ee Dib-u-soo-noolaynta Bulshooyinka Fog ee Moite iyo Marsabit
Dholuo: Kuong'o pogruok mantie e kind thieth: Ber ma Nawiri oketo e dwoko teko kendo e gwenge mabor mag Moite kod Marsabit

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu ku dhawaaqay taariikhda diiwaangelinta dugsiyada dugsiga dhexe ee bilaashka ah ee degmada Laikipia.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj ogolo chenro mar somo mar sekondari maonge chudo e skunde man Laikipia County.

English: Climate-smart agriculture (CSA) is an approach for transforming and reorienting agricultural systems to support food security under the new realities of climate ...
Kiswahili: Kilimo kiakili kwa hali ya hewa (CSA) ni mbinu ya kubadilisha na kuelekeza upya mifumo ya kilimo kusaidia usalama wa chakula chini ya hali mpya za hali ya hewa ...
Somali: Beeraha cimilada caqli galka ah (Climate-smart agriculture - CSA) waa hab lagu beddelaysto iyo dib loogu habeeyo nidaamyada beeraha si loo taageero amniga cuntada iyadoo la raacayo xaqiiqda cusub ee cimilada ...
Dholuo: Tij pur mariek e weche mag lokruok mar alwora (Climate-Smart Agriculture - CSA) en yo mar loko kendo loko yore mag pur mondo okony e rito weche mag chiemo e bwo chal manyien mag lokruok mar piny ...

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Bomet County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kuthibitisha kuwa kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay xaqiijiyaan in xaruntooda la aqoonsaday ka hor inta aysan booqan si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso jogweng'o mag Bomet County ni mondo ging'e ni kuondegi mag thieth oseyudo ratiro kapok gibiro mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds residents of West Pokot County that organic farming improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kwamba kilimo hai kinaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot in beeraha dabiiciga ah uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development parone jogweng' mar West Pokot County ni pur mar organic kelo dongruok e pidho puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Kenya Medical Association launches a May awareness campaign on proper sanitation across Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kizindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Mei juu ya usafi wa mazingira katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu bilaabay olole wacyi galineed bishii Maajo oo ku saabsan nadaafadda saxda ah ee Gobolka Nyamira.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Mei e wi thieth mowinjore e County duto mar Nyamira.

English: Notice: ODPP opens the electoral calendar centres in Kericho County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Kericho Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay furaysaa xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee degmada Kericho bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: ODPP chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e taon mar Kericho e dwe mar Julai.

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief, March 2022
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP Kenya, Machi 2022
Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya, Maarso 2022
Dholuo: Wach machuok mar piny Kenya mar WFP, dwe mar adek 2022

English: Laikipia County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Laikipia: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2023
Somali: Degmada Laikipia: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Laikipia: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar 2023

English: Kenya Red Cross urges the community in Bungoma County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb burglary.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Bungoma inay ka warbixiyaan waxqabadka shakiga ah xarunta booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo oganda man Bungoma County mondo ochiw ripot mar gik maricho ma timore e od polise man machiegni mondo gimi ji kik donj e odno.

English: Government to equip community learning centers with resources to support out-of-school youth.
Kiswahili: Serikali kuandaa vituo vya elimu vya jumuiya na rasilimali za kusaidia vijana nje ya shule.
Somali: Dowladda inay xarumaha barashada bulshada ku qalabayso kheyraadka lagu taageero dhalinyarada ka baxsan dugsiga.
Dholuo: Sirkal mondo okony kuonde tiegruok mag oganda gi mwandu mag konyo rowere maok dhi e skul.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development invites farmers in Narok County to a free training on post-harvest handling this January.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno Januari hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Narok tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan maareynta goosashada ka dib bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ogwelo jopur manie Narok County e tiegruok ma onge chudo e dwe mar Januar.

English: Continue breastfeeding during the night to meet baby's nutrition needs and maintain milk supply.
Kiswahili: Endelea kunyonyesha usiku ili kukidhi mahitaji ya lishe ya mtoto na kudumisha utoaji wa maziwa.
Somali: Sii wad naasnuujinta habeenkii si aad u daboosho baahiyaha nafaqada ee ilmaha iyo inaad ilaaliso caanaha.
Dholuo: Dhi nyime gi chiwo chak e otieno mondo ichop dwaro mag nyathi mag chiemo kendo orit kaka chak bedoe.

English: KALRO reminds livestock keepers in Tana River County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KALRO waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xayawaanka ah ee degmada Tana River inay ka fogaadaan in xoolaha laga guuro xadka degmada iyada oo aan la helin rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KALRO parone jorit jamni e taon mar Tana River County ni kik giting' jamni ka ok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: Kenya Dairy Board urges farmers in Nairobi County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda degmada Nairobi inay ka qeybgalaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur e County mar Nairobi mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e weche mag pur mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will distribute certified millet seed to farmers in Nairobi County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KEPHIS itawapa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi mbegu zilizothibitishwa za millet mwezi huu wa Machi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay bishii Maarso u qaybin doontaa abuurka miraha la aqoonsan yahay beeraleyda degmada Nairobi.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEPHIS biro pogo kodhi mag millet ne jopur man Nairobi County e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay furaysaa codsiyada deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan ardayda ku jira gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar State for TVET oseyawo kwayo mag yudo osuru ne jopuonjre ma nigi chan e Taita-Taveta County.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges youth in Marsabit County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ugu baaqay dhalinyarada degmada Marsabit inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada rayidka ah ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada rayidnimada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo rowere e gweng' mar Marsabit mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok gichako timo tije mag oganda.

English: CDC encourages mothers in Makueni County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Makueni inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta caafimaad ee la qorsheeyay si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo mine manie gweng' mar Makueni mondo odhi e odiechieng'no mar thieth mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges sorghum growers in Nyamira County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kudhibiti minyoo mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Waxsoosaarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda sorghum ee degmada Nyamira in ay horumar ku sameeyaan xakamaynta ciidanka dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur mag sorghum e Kaunti mar Nyamira mondo oti gi yedhe makelo hinyruok e kinde machuok ka gitiyo gi tuoche makelo tuoche ma nyalo konyo e medo nyak mar yien e higani.

English: Notice: OGP launches community-based development programmes in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inazindua mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii katika Wilaya ya Tana River.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay bilawday barnaamijyo horumarineed oo ku saleysan bulshada ee degmada Tana River.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: OGP chako chenro mag dongruok e alwora mar Tana River County.

English: DCI urges the community in West Pokot County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: DCI inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada West Pokot in ay ka fogaadaan in ay macluumaadka amniga shisheeyaha la wadaagaan si ay u xakameyaan xannibaadda xoolaha.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo ji duto manie West Pokot County mondo kik gipog weche mag rito ngimagi gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo kik gikwed kwalo jamni.

English: FAO reminds residents of Bungoma County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma in ilaalinta ciidda ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: FAO parone jogweng'o mag Bungoma County ni rito lowo kelo nyak mar puodho kuom kinde malach.

English: Ensure that there is a secret line among your workforce through which they can seek for metal health without fear
Kiswahili: Hakikisha kwamba kuna mstari wa siri kati ya wafanyakazi wako kupitia ambayo wanaweza kutafuta afya ya chuma bila hofu
Somali: Hubi in ay jiraan khad qarsoodi ah oo shaqaalahaaga dhexdiisa ay ku raadin karaan caafimaadka birta cabsi la'aan
Dholuo: Tem neno ni nitie sirkal mopondo ma jotichni nyalo tiyogo e manyo mwandu mag lowo maonge luoro moro amora

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Nakuru County that access to skilled birth attendance is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba upatikanaji wa mahudhurio ya uzazi wenye ujuzi ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Nakuru in helitaanka daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfad leh ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone mine ma biro nyuolo nyithindo e gweng' mar Nakuru ni thuolo mar yudo nyithindo ma nigi lony en maonge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: KTDA urges millet growers in Nandi County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawasihi wakulima wa millet katika Kaunti ya Nandi watumie viwango vinavyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda khudradda ee gobolka Nandi in ay isticmaalaan sicirka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur ma pidho millet e County mar Nandi mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue mondo okony e loso cham e higani.

English: We are advising all health workers to ensure they are wearing masks and PPEs at all times. Please take all the measures we have announced seriously.
Kiswahili: Tunawashauri wafanyakazi wote wa afya kuhakikisha wamevaa barakoa na vifaa vya kujikinga wakati wote. Tafadhali chukua hatua zote ambazo tumetangaza kwa uzito.
Somali: Waxaan kula talineynaa dhammaan shaqaalaha caafimaadka inay hubiyaan inay mar walba xiran yihiin maaskaro iyo qalabka ilaalinta shaqsiga (PPE). Fadlan si dhab ah u qaado dhammaan tallaabooyinka aan ku dhawaaqnay.
Dholuo: Wachiwo paro ne jotich duto mag thieth mondo gine ni girwako masks kod PPEs kinde duto. Yie mondo ukaw okenge duto ma waselando kaka gik madongo.

English: TSC encourages out-of-school children in Narok County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Narok kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya mgao wa bursary.
Somali: TSC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Narok inay ku qoraan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee la siinayo deeq waxbarasho.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e gweng' mar Narok mondo odonj e program mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo e bwo mich mar chiwo osuru.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges residents of West Pokot County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya West Pokot kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General jiwo jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e loso nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: KEMRI advises residents of Migori County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: KEMRI waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Migori inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada la hortagi karo.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng' Migori County mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth ma onge chudo mar oganda mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds voters in Nyeri County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya kujiandikisha.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Nyeri in ay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor diiwaangelinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya oparo ne josiasa man Nyeri County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom SMS ne ji 70000 kapok gidonjo e register mar yiero.

English: NTSA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Uasin Gishu County that access to free legal aid is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba upatikanaji wa misaada ya kisheria ya bure unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Uasin Gishu in la heli karo caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah oo lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: NTSA oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu ni thuolo mar yudo kony mar chik onge chudo.

English: State Department for TVET reminds schools in Nandi County to strengthen anti-bullying measures this September.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inazikumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuimarisha hatua za kupambana na uonevu Septemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay xusuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Nandi inay xoojiyaan tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibaatada bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET oparo ne skunde man e county mar Nandi mondo omed jiwo chenro mag kedo gi timbe mahundu e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on the community in Lamu County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawataka jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuongea dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Lamu inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wacayaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross kwayo ji duto manie County mar Lamu mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: Yet this Emergency Appeal is only 9 per cent funded at a time when needs are rising, not receding.
Kiswahili: Uwekezaji wa wafadhili kwa wakati unaofaa sasa unaweza kuzuia kuzorota zaidi, kulinda maisha, na kuokoa maisha kwa kupunguza gharama kubwa zaidi za ongezeko la dharura baadaye mwakani ikiwa hatua itachelewa.
Somali: Haddana Codsigan Degdegga ah waxaa la maalgeliyaa 9 boqolkiiba oo keliya xilli baahiyadu ay sii kordhayaan, ee aysan hoos u dhacayn.
Dholuo: Kata kamano, Apil mar Mapiyo ni en mana pesa ma romo 9 kuom mia achiel ma imiye e kinde ma dwaro medore, to ok dok piny.

English: National Drought Early Warning Bulletin (January 2024)
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Tahadhari ya Mapema ya Kitaifa (Januari 2024)
Somali: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Qaranka (Janaayo 2024)
Dholuo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro (dwe mar achiel higa mar 2024)

English: KICD reminds needy students in Migori County that free digital learning content applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Migori kwamba programu za bure za maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Migori in codsiyada barashada digital-ka ee bilaashka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: KICD parone jopuonjre man Migori County ma nigi chandruok ni chenro mag somo maonge chudo mar digital chiegni rumo.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges residents of Wajir County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kuunga mkono kamati za kujenga amani huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa wa kukabiliana na ugaidi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta deegaanka iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Weche Dhano jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Wajir mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya e kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Yellowing of the skin and eyes in newborns should be checked by a health worker. Severe jaundice can affect brain development.
Kiswahili: Kuwa na rangi ya njano kwenye ngozi na macho kwa watoto wachanga kunapaswa kuchunguzwa na mfanyakazi wa afya. Homa kali ya manjano inaweza kuathiri ukuaji wa ubongo.
Somali: Dhalashada maqaarka iyo indhaha ee dhallaanka cusub waa in la hubiyaa shaqaalaha caafimaadka.
Dholuo: Ng'at matimo nonro kuom weche thieth onego one kaka pien nyathi kod wang'e bedo gi rangi ma jaber nikech tuwo marachno nyalo chiko kaka obwongo dongo.

English: Ministry of Education urges parents and teachers in Busia County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Busia kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Busia inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Busia mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto.

English: Features real civic action in Turkana
Kiswahili: Maonyesho halisi ya shughuli za kiraia katika Turkana
Somali: Waxay muujineysaa dhaqdhaqaaqa dhabta ah ee rayidka ah ee Turkana
Dholuo: Oting'o timbe mag raia madier e taon mar Turkana

English: Farmers in Busia County can access free BT cotton seeds and should consider intercropping with legumes to optimize land use For more information contact the Busia County Department of Agriculture
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia wanaweza kupata mbegu za pamba za BT bila malipo na wanapaswa kuzingatia kilimo mseto na mikunde ili kuboresha matumizi ya ardhi Kwa habari zaidi wasiliana na Idara ya Kilimo ya Kaunti ya Busia.
Somali: Beeraleyda degmada Busia waxay heli karaan abuurka suufka BT oo bilaash ah waxayna tixgelinayaan in la isku beero dalagyo si loo wanaajiyo isticmaalka dhulka Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah la xiriir Waaxda Beeraha ee degmada Busia
Dholuo: Jo-Puritan e County mar Busia nyalo yudo kodhi mag pamba maonge chudo kendo onego gipar ni ginyalo chwoyo kodhi mag le mag oko mondo giti gi lowo maber.

English: Kenya Forest Service warns residents of Garissa County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ka digay dadka deggan Gobolka Garissa in ay kordhaan khiyaanooyinka lacagaha SIM-swap wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar Garissa County e wi medruok mar wuond mar SIM swap kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: TVET reminds needy students in Busia County that free digital learning content applications close soon.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba programu za bure za maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Busia in codsiyada barnaamijyada barashada bilaashka ah ee digital-ka ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa jopuonjre modhier man Busia County ni chenro mag puonjruok mar digital maonge chudo chiegni rumo.

English: Kenya Flash Appeal at a glance (April - October 2022)
Kiswahili: Rufaa ya Kenya Flash kwa muhtasari (Aprili - Oktoba 2022)
Somali: Soo jeedinta Degdegga ah ee Kenya (Abriil - Oktoobar 2022)
Dholuo: Kenya Okwayo mapiyo (Dwe mar Ang'wen - Oktoba 2022)

English: Notice: Council of Governors launches county development projects in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya wilaya katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa bilaabay mashaariic horumarineed oo ka socda degmada Nandi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Jaloch ochako tich mar timo dongruok e alwora mar Nandi County.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Garissa County that access to SHA registration is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba ufikiaji wa usajili wa SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha Gobolka Garissa in helitaanka diiwaangelinta SHA ay hadda laga heli karaa xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji duto e County mar Garissa ni koro ginyalo yudo weche mag SHA e kuonde moketi.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges residents of Uasin Gishu County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Uasin Gishu kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandaoni ya wilaya ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General ojiwo jogweng' Uasin Gishu County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county mar konyo e loso chenro mag dongruok.

English: KEMSA encourages mothers in Kisumu County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kutembelea mrengo wa uzazi ulio karibu nao ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kisumu inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo mine manie County mar Kisumu mondo olim kama gibiro yudoe nyithindo machiegni mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: AFA promotes organic farming among farmers in Homa Bay County as part of the March climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: AFA inakuza kilimo hai kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Machi.
Somali: AFA waxay kor u qaadeysaa beeraha dabiiciga ah ee beeraleyda ku nool gobolka Homa Bay iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Maarso.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e county mar Homa Bay kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi mar dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ka furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay ka shaqeynta shahaadada dhalashada Gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Jorit Maduong' ochako tiyo gi ofis manyien mar rito nyasi mag nyuol e County mar Lamu.

English: Kenyan farmers are encouraged to continue exporting coffee as over 1 million kilograms were shipped in March 2026 with strong demand and prices from the U S and other international markets
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Kenya wanahimizwa kuendelea kuuza kahawa nje ya nchi kwani zaidi ya kilo milioni 1 zilisafirishwa Machi 2026 na mahitaji makubwa na bei kutoka Marekani na masoko mengine ya kimataifa.
Somali: Beeraleyda Kenya waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyay inay sii wadaan dhoofinta bunka maadaama in ka badan 1 milyan kiilo garaam la dhoofiyay bishii Maarso 2026, iyadoo baahi xooggan iyo qiimo ka yimid Maraykanka iyo suuqyada kale ee caalamiga ah
Dholuo: Jo-Kenya ma nigi puothe jiwo ahinya mondo gidhi nyime oro kofi e pinje mamoko nikech ne oter kilo mokalo milion achiel e dwe mar Mach 2026 ka kwan mar puothe mag Kenya medore kendo nengo mag puothe mag Amerka kod pinje mamoko bende medore

English: NTSA calls on residents of Embu County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NTSA inatoa wito kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida katika maeneo ya mpakani kwa vyombo vya usalama kuunga mkono ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: NTSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga dhaqdhaqaaq aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah si ay u taageeraan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: NTSA okwayo jogweng' Embu County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma rito kuwe e gwenge mag tong' mondo okony e loso kuwe e piny.

English: OGP encourages first-time voters in Nakuru County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: OGP inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu.
Somali: OGP waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Nakuru inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogo madwaro yiero mokwongo e kaunti mar Nakuru mondo olim kama ichanoe ji ne IEBC.

English: WHO African office releases commendatory brief supporting Kenyaâ€™s nutrition labeling reforms.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya WHO Afrika inatoa taarifa ya kupongeza inayounga mkono mageuzi ya Kenya katika utambulisho wa lishe.
Somali: Xafiiska WHO ee Afrika ayaa soo saaray warbixin ku saabsan bogaadin ah oo lagu taageerayo dib-u-habaynta calaamadaynta nafaqada ee Kenya.
Dholuo: Ofis mar WHO e Afrika ogolo oboke machuok mar duoko maber ma siro lokruok ma Kenya timo e wi keto lembâ€TM e wi chiemo ma ng'ato chamo.

English: From Climate Risk to Resilience: Unpacking the Economic Impacts of Climate Change in Kenya, November 2023
Kiswahili: Kutoka kwa Hatari ya Hali ya Hewa hadi Ustahimilivu: Kufungua Athari za Kiuchumi za Mabadiliko ya Tabianchi nchini Kenya, Novemba 2023
Somali: Laga bilaabo Khatarta Cimilada ilaa Adkeysiga: Soo saarista Saamaynta Dhaqaale ee Isbeddelka Cimilada ee Kenya, Noofambar 2023
Dholuo: Kowuok e Rieko mar Piny nyaka Kuong’ruok: Goyo Rach mar Loch mar Piny e Kenya, Apar mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2023

English: Ministry of Education invites youth in Narok County to enroll for catering and hospitality training this April.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Narok kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu Aprili hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku casuumaysaa dhalinyarada degmada Narok inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education ogwelo rowere e Narok County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar chiemo kod rwako welo e dwe mar April.

English: KRA reminds the public in Nyamira County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this October.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba ushiriki katika mashauriano ya sera za umma unakaribishwa Oktoba hii.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Nyamira in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KRA oparo ne ji duto e County mar Nyamira ni ji duto mor gi chiwo mag paro e wi chenro mag sirkal e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: State Department for TVET advises students in Laikipia County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ardayda degmada Laikipia kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan buugaagta waxbarasho iyo qalabka wax lagu barto.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo jopuonjre e County mar Laikipia mondo okonygi kokalo kuom websait mar scholarship mondo giyud buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations activates an emergency response plan for landslides in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inaamsha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dambiyada ayaa soo saaray qorshe deg-deg ah oo looga jawaabayo dhulgariirada ka dhaca degmada Kajiado.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Mumbni mag Criminal Investigations tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne yiengni mag lowo e Kajiado County.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya launches a fraud prevention campaign in Nakuru County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga khiyaamooyinka degmada Nakuru bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chako kampen mar geng'o mibadhi e gweng' mar Nakuru e dwe mar Julai.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Meru County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma ya afya ya ruzuku.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay haystaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Meru mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi maber sama gidwaro thieth mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: NPS urges residents of Isiolo County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NPS inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo jogweng' Isiolo County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji ng'enyie nikech ji medo keto pachgi kuom chenro mag chiwo siem motelo ne oganda.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Nandi County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nandi kukaa macho juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nandi inay ka feejignaadaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross parone ji duto e county mar Nandi mondo gibed motang' gi chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board restricts movement of goats in Mombasa County due to an anthrax outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya yazuia harakati za mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kutokana na mlipuko wa kimeta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa riyaha ee Gobolka Mombasa sababtoo ah cudurka Anthrax.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Dairy Board ogeng'o wuoth mar diek e County mar Mombasa nikech tuwo mar anthrax.

English: KEPHIS reminds livestock keepers in Kwale County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee Gobolka Kwale inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xadka gobolka iyada oo aan la helin rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KEPHIS paronwa jorit jamni e county mar Kwale mondo kik giting' jamni ka ok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah ee saameeya dadka deggan gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji ogolo siem e wi weche mag sirkande mag intanet kuom chenro mag gwelo pesa mag miriambo makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Uasin Gishu County.

English: Tea farmers are encouraged to stay informed about fluctuating tea prices and market trends to make better farming decisions Please monitor local updates for support and resources available
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa chai wanahimizwa kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu kubadilika-badilika kwa bei ya chai na mienendo ya soko ili kufanya maamuzi bora ya kilimo Tafadhali fuatilia masasisho ya ndani kwa usaidizi na rasilimali zinazopatikana.
Somali: Beeraleyda shaaha waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay ka warqabtaan sicirka shaaha iyo isbeddellada suuqa si ay u sameeyaan go'aano beeraha oo ka wanaagsan Fadlan la soco wararka maxalliga ah ee taageerada iyo kheyraadka la heli karo
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur mag chai mondo ong'e weche ma timore e wi nengo mag chai kod kaka piny chalo mondo omi ging'ad paro maber e wi tijgi mar pur.

English: TSC urges residents of Nyamira County to register their children at the nearest public school to benefit from bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: TSC inawataka wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu ili kufaidika na mgao wa bursary.
Somali: TSC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha si ay uga faa'iideystaan deeq lacageed.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Nyamira mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni kodgi mondo giyud kony mar yudo osuru.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) promotes organic farming among farmers in Kisii County as part of the January climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inakuza kilimo hai miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Januari.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kor u qaadeysaa beeraha dabiiciga ah ee beeraleyda degmada Kisii iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Janaayo.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo tij pur e kind jopur e County mar Kisii kaka achiel kuom chenro mar Januar mar kedo gi lokruok e kit yamo.

English: KALRO urges millet growers in Turkana County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Turkana kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda millet ee degmada Turkana inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka ciidanka dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur ma pidho millet e County mar Turkana mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e kinde machuok ka gitiyo gi tuoche maloso yiendgi e higani.

English: Mandera County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for January 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Mandera: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Januari 2023
Somali: Degmada Mandheera: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Janaayo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Mandera: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar achiel higa mar 2023

English: CDC reminds the public that free stress management support is available through county health facilities in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kudhibiti mafadhaiko unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero lacag la'aan ah ee maaraynta stress-ka laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Nandi County.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji ni kony mar thieth mar parruok ma onge chudo yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Nandi.

English: Nyeri (Kieni) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Nyeri (Kieni): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Machi 2022
Somali: Degmada Nyeri (Kieni): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Nyeri (Kieni): Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo kuom Oro mar Adek 2022

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response urges residents of Kisii County to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility following a rise in reported meningitis cases.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya homa ya uti wa mgongo.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay si dhakhso leh u raadsadaan baaritaanno xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow kadib kororka kiisaska meningitis ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Kisii mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni nikech kwan mar ji ma nigi tuwo mar meningitis osemedore.

English: KICD reminds youth in Machakos County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa dhallinyarada degmada Machakos in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka farsamada gawaarida gaadiidka.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne rowere man Machakos County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar masinde mag mtokni.

English: Lamu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Lamu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Mei 2022
Somali: Degmada Lamu: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Lamu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar abich 2022

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the public in Trans Nzoia County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadweynaha degmada Trans Nzoia inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aanay wax ka qaban dhacdooyinka la soo sheegay ee ku saabsan nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ji duto e Trans Nzoia County mondo ong'e kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma osefweny kuom chenro mag ohala mag miriambo.

English: The Kenyan government will distribute 500 million coffee seedlings to farmers this year Primary coffee cooperatives must submit proposals for the types of seedlings needed
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya itasambaza miche milioni 500 ya kahawa kwa wakulima mwaka huu Vyama vya ushirika vya msingi vya kahawa lazima viwasilishe mapendekezo ya aina ya miche inayohitajika.
Somali: Dowladda Kenya ayaa sanadkan beeraleyda u qaybin doonta 500 milyan oo geed qaxwo ah Iskaashatada kafee ee aasaasiga ah waa inay soo gudbiyaan soo jeedin ku saabsan noocyada geedaha loo baahan yahay
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya biro pogo kodhi mag kahwa milion 500 ne jopur e higani.

English: Explore loan schemes tailored for expansion of enterprise from Cooperative Bank Compare interest rates and terms
Kiswahili: Chunguza mipango ya mikopo iliyoundwa kwa ajili ya upanuzi wa biashara kutoka Benki ya Ushirika Linganisha viwango vya riba na masharti
Somali: Sahmiyo qorshayaasha amaahda ee loogu talagalay ballaarinta ganacsiga ee Cooperative Bank Isbarbar dhig heerka dulsaarka iyo shuruudaha
Dholuo: Non chenro mag gowi ma olos mondo okony e medo dongruok mar ohala mar bengi

English: Notice: HELB launches a school infrastructure safety programme in schools across Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB yazindua mpango wa usalama wa miundombinu ya shule katika shule kote Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay bilawday barnaamij ku saabsan badbaadada kaabayaasha dugsiga ee dugsiyada gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: HELB chako chenro mar rito kuonde tiegruok mag skul e skunde duto mag Homa Bay County.

English: Kenya: MAM Floods Report, May 2024
Kiswahili: Kenya: Ripoti ya Mafuriko ya MAM, Mei 2024
Somali: Kenya: Warbixinta Daadadka MAM, Maajo 2024
Dholuo: Kenya: Ripot mar Pi ma Opong'o piny, dwe mar abich higa mar 2024

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds mobile money users in Kisii County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Kisii wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kisii inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna si looga fogaado fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e County mar Kisii ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo gitang' gi weche mag phishing.

English: Campaign encouraging edible oil producers to reduce sodium content through voluntary pledge scheme.
Kiswahili: Kampeni ya kuwahimiza wazalishaji wa mafuta ya kula kupunguza kiwango cha sodiamu kupitia mpango wa ahadi ya hiari.
Somali: Olole lagu dhiirigelinayo soosaarayaasha saliida la cuno inay yareeyaan waxyaabaha ku jira sodium iyada oo loo marayo nidaamka ballanqaadka iskaa ah.
Dholuo: Loso kampen mar jiwo jopur molony e chamo mo mondo odwok chien kwan mar sodium kokalo kuom chenro mar chiwruok ma onge achune.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free tuberculosis screening is available at all public health centres in Kwale County this January.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kifua kikuu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kwale Januari hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka caabuqa ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynta ee Gobolka Kwale bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: KEMSA oparo ne ji ni thieth mar thieth ma onge nengo mar tuo mar tuberculosis yudore e kuonde thieth duto e county mar Kwale e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross confirms a tuberculosis outbreak alert for Kiambu County. Residents are advised to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya lathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa kifua kikuu katika Kaunti ya Kiambu. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka hargabka ee Gobolka Kiambu. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isticmaalaan shabaqa cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ripot Makwar mar Kenya osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuo mar tuberculosis e gweng' mar Kiambu.

English: Notice: NCPB will train farmers in Lamu County on soil conservation this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu juu ya uhifadhi wa udongo Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Lamu ee ku saabsan ilaalinta ciidda bisha November.
Dholuo: Rapar: NCPB biro tiego jopur e County mar Lamu e wi rito lowo e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Urgent food and shelter assistance priority in the ongoing flash floods in northern Kenya
Kiswahili: Kipaumbele cha dharura cha msaada wa chakula na malazi katika mafuriko yanayoendelea kaskazini mwa Kenya
Somali: Gargaarka degdegga ah ee cuntada iyo hoyga ayaa muhiimad gaar ah u leh daadadka ka socda waqooyiga Kenya
Dholuo: Kony mapiyo mar chiemo kod ot onego obed mokuongo e kinde ma pi ma pong’o piny Kenya ma nyandwat

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on the community in Kwale County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Kwale kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka kwa nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqayaa bulshada degmada Kwale inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan isla markaana ay taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service luongo oganda man Kwale County mondo owuo e wi timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo manyo kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds voters in Kirinyaga County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha Gobolka Kirinyaga inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor waxbarashada codbixisayaasha.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette paronwa jotelo e County mar Kirinyaga mondo oting'e ID mar piny kata pasi mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar timo yiero kapok giyudo tiegruok mar jotelo.

English: NPS alerts residents of Kisumu County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: NPS waxay dadka deggan degmada Kisumu uga digtay kororka kiisaska tuugada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: NPS chiwo siem ne Jo-Kisumu County kuom wach kwan mag jokuoge medore kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polis mar oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: KRA urges residents of Kitui County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kuwasilisha maandishi ya maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga kama dambaysta ah si loo qaabeeyo goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo jogweng' Kitui County mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso chenro mag dongruok.

English: DCI warns residents of Vihiga County to prepare for possible road accidents this June.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kujiandaa kwa ajali za barabarani zinazoweza kutokea Juni hii.
Somali: DCI waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay u diyaar garoobaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha Juun.
Dholuo: DCI osiemo jogweng' mar Vihiga County mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Jun.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free trauma counselling support is available through county health facilities in Migori County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa ushauri wa kiwewe unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo la talinta dhaawaca laga helo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Migori County.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tuoche yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Migori.

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of Narok County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this January.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Januari hii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan gobolka Narok inay u diyaar garoobaan qaraxyo dab ah oo dhici kara bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross osiemo jogweng' Narok County mondo oikre ne yiengni manyalo timore e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: KICD opens a new motor vehicle mechanics programme at the vocational centre in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD yafungua programu mpya ya ufundi wa magari katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Kitui.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan farsamada gawaarida gawaari ee xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Kitui.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KICD chako chenro manyien mar tiyo gi masin mag mtokni e kar tich e gweng' mar Kitui.

English: ArAre you worried of money? Stop gambling with your mental health. When you have plenty money, it compels to "different quick ideas" like gambling, indulging into drugs and substance abuse, but all which add more adversaries to you. Instead, seek for free financial advice which will help you in building good financial capacity for yourself
Kiswahili: Je, una wasiwasi kuhusu pesa? Acha kucheza kamari na afya yako ya akili. Unapokuwa na pesa nyingi, inakulazimisha "mawazo tofauti ya haraka" kama vile kamari, kujiingiza katika dawa za kulevya na matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya, lakini yote hayo yanaongeza maadui zaidi kwako. Badala yake, tafuta ushauri wa kifedha bila malipo ambao utakusaidia kujenga uwezo mzuri wa kifedha kwako mwenyewe.
Somali: Miyaad ka walwalsan tahay lacag? joojinta khamaarka caafimaadkaaga maskaxda. marka aad haysato lacag badan, waxay kugu qasbaysaa inaad "fekerro degdeg ah oo kala duwan" sida khamaarka, isticmaalka daroogada iyo maandooriyaha, laakiin dhammaantood waxay kuu kordhinayaan cadaawayaal badan. halkii, raadi la talin lacag la'aan ah oo dhaqaale oo kaa caawin doona inaad dhisto awoodda dhaqaalaha wanaagsan naftaada
Dholuo: Be in gi parruok e wi pesa? We tugo tuke mag loyo mich kuom hawi nikech ngima mari mar paro. Sama in gi pesa mang'eny, mano chuno ni itim "puonj mopogore opogore" kaka tugo, tiyo gi yedhe mamero kod tiyo marach gi gik ma mero ji, to magi duto miyo ibedo gi jowasigu momedore.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Kericho County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kericho inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur e County mar Kericho mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Laikipia County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia mwezi huu wa Novemba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu billaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa degmada Laikipia bishii November.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Gazette chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Laikipia e dwe mar Novemba.

English: President's Malaria Initiative: Kenya Country Profile (Last Updated: 06/20/2023)
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Rais wa Malaria: Wasifu wa Nchi ya Kenya (Ilisasishwa Mara ya Mwisho: 06/20/2023)
Somali: Hindisaha Madaxweynaha ee Duumada: Taariikhda Dalka Kenya (Ugu dambeyntii la cusbooneysiiyay: 06/20/2023)
Dholuo: Chenro mar Jatend Piny mar Maleria: Wach mar Piny Kenya (Oloki mogik: 20/06/2023)

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit confirms a typhoid outbreak alert for Busia County. Residents are advised to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa matumbo kwa Kaunti ya Busia. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa xaqiijisay feejignaanta cudurka tifooska ee degmada Busia. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isticmaalaan shabaqa cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Rieko: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osenyiso ni nitie masira mar typhoid e County mar Busia.

English: IPOA calls on the community in Homa Bay County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawatia moyo jamii katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: IPOA waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada gobolka Homa Bay inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: IPOA luongo ji duto manie Homa Bay County mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gichiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: There are ongoing assessments in Kenya s tea sector Stakeholders in the tea industry are encouraged to stay informed about developments and implement any necessary adjustments to improve productivity
Kiswahili: Kuna tathmini zinazoendelea katika sekta ya chai nchini Kenya Wadau katika tasnia ya chai wanahimizwa kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu maendeleo na kutekeleza marekebisho yoyote muhimu ili kuboresha uzalishaji.
Somali: Waxaa jira qiimeyn socda oo ku saabsan qaybta shaaha Kenya Dhinacyada daneeyayaasha ee warshadaha shaaha waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay ka warqabtaan horumarka iyo in ay hirgeliyaan wax ka beddelka lagama maarmaanka u ah kor u qaadista wax soo saarka
Dholuo: Nitie nonro ma dhi nyime e piny Kenya e wi ohala mar chai Oganda mohero ohala mar chai ijiwo mondo ong'e dongruok ma timore e ohala kendo otim lokruok madwarore mondo okony e medo nyak mar ohala

English: KEPHIS advises farmers in Kisii County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the July planting season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Julai.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kisii inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka xilliga dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: KEPHIS nyiso jopur e county mar Kisii mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e dwe mar Julai.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response calls on parents in Isiolo County to have children under five screened for HIV/AIDS during the June outreach.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuwafanya watoto chini ya miaka mitano wachunguzwe VVU/UKIMWI wakati wa mawasiliano ya Juni.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Isiolo inay carruurta ka yar shan sano u sameeyaan baaritaanka HIV / AIDS inta lagu gudajiro bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuoche kwayo jonyuol e County mar Isiolo mondo otim nonro mar HIV/AIDS ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Jun.

English: Kenya - Floods, update (Reliefweb, NOAA) (ECHO Daily Flash of 23 November 2023)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Mafuriko, sasisha (Reliefweb, NOAA) (ECHO Daily Flash ya 23 Novemba 2023)
Somali: Kenya - Daadad, cusbooneysiin (Reliefweb, NOAA) (ECHO Daily Flash ee 23 Noofambar 2023)

English: KTDA warns beans farmers in Busia County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KTDA inaonya wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Busia dhidi ya maambukizi ya wadudu na inapendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: KTDA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda ku nool degmada Busia cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: KTDA chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho puothe e County mar Busia kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free cyclosporiasis screening is available at all public health centres in Bomet County this December.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa cyclosporiasis unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Bomet Desemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka bilaashka ah ee cyclosporiasis laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Bomet bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji ni thieth mar cyclosporiasis en mar nono maonge chudo e kuonde thieth duto mag oganda e County mar Bomet e dwe mar Desemba.

English: KTDA encourages farmers in Busia County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for horticultural produce.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za mazao ya bustani.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Busia inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay waxyaabaha beeraha.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e county mar Busia mondo ous olemo mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo olemo mondo omi olemo mag puodho obed gi nengo maber.

English: TSC reminds youth in Meru County that HELB funding is available for tailoring and design training.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Meru kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni.
Somali: TSC waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Meru in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka qaabeynta iyo naqshadeynta.

English: To manage black Sigatoka in bananas, check your field weekly from planting until the tree matures. If you see an infected leaf, cut it carefully, bag it, and burn or bury it away from the field; if a whole tree is badly infected, cut it down and destroy it immediately. Always clean your tools with ethanol, bleach, or fire between uses.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti Sigatoka nyeusi katika ndizi, angalia shamba lako kila wiki tangu kupanda hadi mti ukomavu. Ikiwa unaona jani lenye maambukizi, likatikane kwa uangalifu, lifungue, na ulichome au ulilifiche mbali na shamba; ikiwa mti mzima umeambukizwa vibaya, ukate na kuharibu mara moja. Daima safisha zana zako kwa ethanol, beluch, au moto kati ya matumizi.
Somali: Si aad u maamusho Sigatoka madow ee mooska, hubi beertaada toddobaadle laga bilaabo beerista ilaa geedku bislaaado. Haddii aad aragto caleen cudur leh, si taxaddar leh u jar, bacda geli, oo gub ama ku aaso meel ka fog beerta; HADII GEED DHAN SI XUN U CAABUDO, JAR OO ISLA MARKIIBA BURBURI. Mar walba nadiifi qalabkaaga ethanol, bleach, ama dab inta u dhaxaysa isticmaalka.
Dholuo: Mondo iti gi Sigatoka ma rateng' e olembe, ne puodho juma ka juma chakre ipidho nyaka chop yadh ochop. Kapo ni ineno yath moro ma nigi tuwo, ng'iye maber, igole e bag, kendo wang'e kata ikwane oko; ka yath mangima nigi tuwo marach, ng'iye piny kendo iketh oko mapiyo. Kinde duto luok gige tich gi ethanol, whitewash, kata mach e kind kinde ma itiyogo.

Somali: IPOA waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Nyandarua inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wici doonaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: IPOA okwayo ji duto manie County mar Nyandarua mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: Universities Fund urges youth in Homa Bay County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku boorinayaa dhalinyarada degmada Homa Bay inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo rowere manie Homa Bay County mondo oriwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gichako timo tije mag sirkal.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Red Cross will be held in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma Kenya Red Cross ochano biro timore Elgeyo-Marakwet County e dwe mar Oktoba.

Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti ya Nakuru imepatia Ushirika wa Wafugaji Nyuki wa Markilanjo mizinga na vifaa vya kuimarisha uzalishaji wa asali Wanachama wa Ushirika wanahimizwa kutumia rasilimali hizi kuongeza uzalishaji na usindikaji.

English: Tana River County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tana River: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Oktoba 2022

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Wajir County this January. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utafanya kongamano la kurejesha matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Wajir Januari hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay qabaneysaa munaasabad dib u soo kabashada isticmaalka maandooriyaha ee Gobolka Wajir bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: 'Kenya Red Cross' biro timo chokruok mar loso winjruok e kind joma tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero e dwe mar Januar e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: DCI reminds the public in Nandi County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha watu katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuwa macho katika kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka gobolka Nandi in ay ka feejignaadaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: DCI parone ji duto e county mar Nandi mondo obed motang' e loso kuwe e piny mangima.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya alerts residents of Kajiado County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay uga digtay dadka deggan degmada Kajiado in ay ka badan yihiin kiisaska gaadiidka la afduubayo waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan mashaariicda booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Communications Authority chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kajiado County kuom wach medruok mar wuondo mtokni kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: NDMA reminds residents of Mombasa County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this drought season.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati huu wa ukame.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lugta ku mara inta lagu jiro xilliga abaarta.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogweng' County mar Mombasa mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo oti gi yore mag wuotho e kinde oro.

English: NPS urges the public in Kitui County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: NPS inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: NPS waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadweynaha degmada Kitui inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo ji duto e County mar Kitui mondo ochiw ripot mar ote mamulo pachgi ne jatendgi mar tich bang' ka osenyis ni nitie timbe mag mibadhi mar SIM-swap.

English: NTSA calls on the community in Kisii County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaita jamii katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: NTSA waxay bulshada degmada Kisii ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: NTSA okwayo ji duto manie County mar Kisii mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gichiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: NPS alerts residents of Kisii County to a rise in fraud cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za ulaghai na inashauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka kwa kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: NPS waxay dadka deggan degmada Kisii uga digtaa kororka kiisaska khiyaamada waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: NPS chiwo siem ne Jo-Kisii County kuom wach medruok mar weche mag wuondruok kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne polis man machiegni.

English: There is a toll free number 1199 for breast feeding mothers, for advise and timely help at any time.
Kiswahili: Kuna namba ya bure ya 1199 kwa akina mama wanaonyonyesha, kwa ushauri na msaada wa wakati wowote.
Somali: Waxaa jira lambarka lacag la'aanta ah ee 1199 ee loogu talagalay hooyooyinka naas nuujinaya, la talin iyo caawimaad waqtigeeda ah wakhti kasta.

English: KEPHIS invites farmers in Bungoma County to a free training on pest and disease management this June.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kupata mafunzo ya bure juu ya udhibiti wa wadudu na magonjwa Juni hii.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Bungoma tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan xakamaynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada bisha Juun.
Dholuo: KEPHIS ogwelo jopur e County mar Bungoma e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar tuoche kod tuoche e dwe mar Jun.

English: TVET reminds schools in Tharaka-Nithi County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this February.
Kiswahili: TVET inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Februari hii.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay xoojiyaan adeegyada hagista iyo la-talinta bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa skunde mag Tharaka-Nithi County mondo omed jiwo kendo chiwo kony e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET opens a new motor vehicle mechanics programme at the vocational centre in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yafungua programu mpya ya ufundi wa magari katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Qaranka ee TVET waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan farsamada gawaarida gaadiidka ee xarunta xirfadaha ee gobolka Mombasa.
