English: E-Citizen encourages first-time voters in Homa Bay County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee gobolka Homa Bay inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo joma okwongo yiero e Homa Bay County mondo onon weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: FAO warns millet farmers in Nairobi County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: FAO inawaonya wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhusu maambukizi ya wadudu na kupendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: FAO waxay uga digtay beeraleyda xashiishadda ee degmada Nairobi in ay jiraan cudurro cayayaanka ah waxayna ku talineysaa in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: FAO chiwo siem ne jopur mag millet e County mar Nairobi kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Meru County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi wakati wa msimu huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay guryahooda ku rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo shaqada inta lagu jiro xilliyada dhulgariirada.
Dholuo: NTSA parone jogweng' mar Meru County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo giti e kinde mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: EACC reminds voters in Murang'a County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Murang'a in ay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor inta aan la helin waxbarasho.
Dholuo: EACC parone jogweng' Murang'a mondo olim kama ichikoe ji ne IEBC motelo ne tiegruok mar josiasa.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Narok County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili kuwajulisha juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Narok inay la shaqeeyaan maamulayaashooda degmada si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda horumarinta degmada.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo oriwgi gi jarit mar ward margi mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mag dongruok mar county.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds farmers in Bungoma County of the ongoing modern irrigation techniques training programme.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuhusu programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa beeraleyda degmada Bungoma barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service parone jopur man Bungoma County kuom tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar yore mag lero pi.

English: Maize grains should be stored in a building without cracks where pests such as larger grain borers or rodents can hide or enter.
Kiswahili: Mbegu zilizosagwa zapasa kuhifadhiwa ndani ya jengo bila mianya ambapo wadudu kama vile wasagaji wa nafaka wakubwa zaidi au panya wanaweza kujificha au kuingia.
Somali: Hadhuudhka galleyda waa in lagu kaydiyaa dhismo aan lahayn dillaacyo halkaas oo cayayaanka sida qodista hadhuudhka waaweyn ama jiirka ay ku dhuuman karaan ama geli karaan.
Dholuo: Kodhi mag cham onego okan e ot ma onge buche ma nyalo miyo chwanyruok obedie, kama chwanyruok kaka chwanyruok madongo mag kodhi kata chwanyruok nyalo pondo kata donjoe.

English: KICD conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Siaya County this July.
Kiswahili: KICD inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Siaya Julai hii.
Somali: KICD waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada rayidka ah ee ku saabsan wareejinta degmada Siaya bishii Luulyo ee sannadkan.
Dholuo: KICD dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e dwe mar Julai e county mar Siaya.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay bilaabeysaa barnaamij tallaabooyin looga hortago dhibaatada dugsiyada gobolka Nakuru.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State Department for TVET chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe mahundu e skunde duto mag Nakuru County.

English: Notice: KMTC reminds citizens in Embu County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Embu kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Embu ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.

Somali: Ogaysiis: IPOA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ku saabsan ka hortagga argagixisada ee gobolka Nakuru bishii Agoosto.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board restricts movement of pigs in Tharaka-Nithi County due to a foot and mouth disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inazuia harakati za nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.

Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Chandruok mar Dhano ogeng'o wuoth mar le e County mar Tharaka-Nithi nikech tuoche mag dhoot.

English: The Kenyan government has developed the National Water and Sanitation Investment and Financing Plan NAWASIP for improving rural water and sanitation through infrastructure projects
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya imeandaa Mpango wa Kitaifa wa Uwekezaji na Ufadhili wa Maji na Usafi wa Mazingira NAWASIP kwa ajili ya kuboresha maji na usafi wa mazingira vijijini kupitia miradi ya miundombinu.

Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya osechako chenro mar National Water and Sanitation Investment and Financing Plan (NAWASIP) mar medo pi kod ngima maler e gweng'no kokalo kuom chenro mag gedo

English: Notice: Ministry of Health confirms a HIV/AIDS outbreak alert for Nandi County. Residents are advised to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa VVU/UKIMWI kwa Kaunti ya Nandi. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka HIV / AIDS ee degmada Nandi. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.

English: State Department for Basic Education encourages out-of-school children in Busia County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under free day secondary education.

English: CDC appeals to caregivers in Kisumu County to visit their nearest maternity wing as part of the January maternal health drive.

Dholuo: CDC okwayo jorit e County mar Kisumu mondo olimgi machiegni gi kama gibiro yudoe nyithindo e dwe mar Januar.

Kiswahili: NCIC huandaa vikao vya kujenga amani kupitia hafla za kitamaduni kati ya jamii.

Dholuo: NCIC timo chokruoge mag loso kuwe kokalo kuom chokruoge mag kit oganda.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Kiambu County about the importance of hand hygiene for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhusu umuhimu wa usafi wa mikono kwa ustawi wa kaya.

Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kitui County e wi medruok mar wuond mag SIM-swap kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

Dholuo: KRA jiwo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo omed ng'eyo weche momedore e wi chenro mag dongruok e county.

Kiswahili: Ilani: DPP yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Februari hii.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Taita-Taveta County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the June planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Juni.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Juun.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur manie Taita-Taveta County ni giti gi olembe ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: TVET launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET yazindua mpango wa kupinga uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay bilawday barnaamij tallaabooyin looga hortago dhibta dugsiyada degmada Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: TVET chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe mahundu e skunde duto mag Trans Nzoia County.

English: FAO warns millet farmers in Laikipia County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: FAO inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Laikipia juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: FAO waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda cawska ee degmada Laikipia cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: FAO chiwo siem ne jopur mag millet e County mar Laikipia kuom masiche ma nyalo timore kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages residents of Marsabit County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay ula xiriiraan lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' mar Marsabit County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo gitem manyo jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Kwale County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kuthibitisha kuwa kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay xaqiijiyaan in xaruntooda la aqoonsaday ka hor inta aysan booqan si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso jogweng' mar Kwale County ni mondo ging'e ni kuondegi mag thieth oseyudo ratiro kapok gibiro mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Mpox disease has been ditected in Mombasa, the county of Mombasa has reported ninty eight people to be infected with Mpox and two have died from the disease, and more people are getting infected.
Kiswahili: Ugonjwa wa Mpox umegunduliwa huko Mombasa, kaunti ya Mombsa imeripoti watu 98 wameambukizwa Mpox na wawili wamekufa kutokana na ugonjwa huo, na watu zaidi wanaambukishwa.
Somali: Cudurka Mpox ayaa laga helay magaalada Mombasa, degmada Mombsa ayaa soo sheegtay siddeed iyo toban qof oo ku dhacay Mpox iyo laba qof ayaa u dhintay cudurka, dad badan ayaa ku dhacay.
Dholuo: Tuo mar Mpox osefweny e Mombasa, county mar Mombsa osefwenyo ni ji 98 nigi Mpox kendo ariyo osetho nikech tuwono, kendo ji mang'eny medo bedo gi tuwono.

English: Urgent: 3.3 Million Kenyans face acute hunger as multi-year drought devastates ASAL counties: Urgent multisectoral action needed to save lives
Kiswahili: Haraka: Wakenya Milioni 3.3 wanakabiliwa na njaa kali huku ukame wa miaka mingi ukiharibu kaunti za ASAL: Hatua za haraka za kisekta mbalimbali zinahitajika kuokoa maisha
Somali: Degdeg: 3.3 Milyan oo Kenyan ah ayaa wajahaya gaajo daran iyadoo abaaro sannado badan socday ay burburiyeen degmooyinka ASAL: Tallaabo degdeg ah oo dhinacyo badan leh ayaa loo baahan yahay si loo badbaadiyo nolosha
Dholuo: Mapiyo: Jo Kenya milioni 3.3 yudo kech maduong’ kaka oro ma osebedo kuom higni mang’eny ketho gwenge mag ASAL: Owinjore otim gik mapiyo mondo ores ngima

English: Cracked bottles can harbor germs. Replace damaged feeding equipment promptly.
Kiswahili: Chupa zilizopasuka zinaweza kuhifadhi vijidudu. Badilisha vifaa vya kulishia vilivyoharibika haraka.
Somali: Dhalooyinka jeexjeexan waxay keeni karaan bakteeriyo, qalabka quudinta ee dhaawacmayna si dhakhso leh u beddela.
Dholuo: Bombe mokethore nyalo bedo gi tuwoche ma nyalo miyo ng'ato oyud chiemo.

English: COMESA advises farmers in Nyamira County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the August planting season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Agosti.
Somali: COMESA waxay kula talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyamira inay qaataan noocyo abuurka ah oo abaarta u adkaysta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: COMESA nyiso jopur e county mar Nyamira mondo oti gi kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochako chwoyo kodhi e dwe mar Agost.

English: NCPB announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for sheep in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this August.
Kiswahili: NCPB inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Agosti hii.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee idaha ee gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet bishii Ogosto.
Dholuo: NCPB olando chenro mar thiedho rombo e dwe mar Agost e kaunti mar Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: Survivors demand justice for digital gender-based violence
Kiswahili: Walionusurika wanadai haki kwa unyanyasaji wa kijinsia wa kidijitali
Somali: Badbaadayaasha ayaa dalbanaya caddaalad ku saabsan rabshadaha ku salaysan jinsiga ee dijitaalka ah
Dholuo: Joma otho dwaro tim makare mar tim ng’anjo ma luwore gi chwo gi mon

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on residents of Baringo County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan kahortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross okwayo jogweng' Baringo County mondo oriwgi lwedo e nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji nitie mondo gikony e kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: KTDA encourages farmers in Makueni County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for avocado.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za parachichi.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Makueni inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan avocado.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Makueni mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro mondo omi ohala mar avocado obed maber.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Nyamira County this January.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Januari hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada Waxbarashada wuxuu qabtaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha gobolka Nyamira bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi migawo mar Ombudsman e County mar Nyamira e dwe mar Januar.

English: Kenya and Zimbabwe invest in preventing violence against women and girls
Kiswahili: Kenya na Zimbabwe zinawekeza katika kuzuia ukatili dhidi ya wanawake na wasichana
Somali: Kenya iyo Zimbabwe waxay maalgashadaan ka hortagga rabshadaha ka dhanka ah haweenka iyo gabdhaha
Dholuo: Kenya kod Zimbabwe keto omwom e geng'o tim gero mitimo ne mon kod nyiri

English: Water Governance in Pastoralist Areas of Africa
Kiswahili: Utawala wa Maji katika Maeneo ya Wafugaji barani Afrika
Somali: Maamulka Biyaha ee Deegaannada Xoolo-dhaqatada ee Afrika
Dholuo: Loch mar Pi e Kuonde mag Jokwath e Afrika

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Kwale County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kuunga mkono halmashauri za ndani za kujenga amani wakati wa umakini mkubwa wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nabadgelyada qaranka.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Kwale County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano ka ji medo keto pachgi kuom loso kuwe.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds needy students in Kiambu County that school laptops under the digital literacy programme applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya maombi ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika za kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya ardayda u baahan degmada Kiambu in laptop-yada dugsiga ee ku jira codsiyada barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e Kaunti mar Kiambu ni kompyuta mag skul manie program mar somo gi somo mar digital biro rumo machiegni.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Uasin Gishu County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Uasin Gishu in si deg deg ah u soo sheegidda tuugada ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne jogweng' Uasin Gishu County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo kuom nek konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises tea producers in Kirinyaga County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inashauri wazalishaji wa chai katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha shaaha ee Gobolka Kirinyaga inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur ma loso chai e County mar Kirinyaga mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur ka pok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Judiciary of Kenya encourages first-time voters in Kwale County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kwale kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horeysay ee degmada Kwale inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo joma okwongo yiero e county mar Kwale mondo olim kama ichanoe ji mar IEBC machiegni kodgi.

English: Caregivers should wash hands with soap before handling babies, after changing diapers, and before feeding to prevent infections.
Kiswahili: Walezi wanapaswa kunawa mikono kwa sabuni kabla ya kuwashughulikia watoto, baada ya kubadilisha nepi, na kabla ya kuwalisha ili kuzuia maambukizi.
Somali: Daryeelayaashu waa inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun ka hor intaanay xidhin ilmaha, ka dib markay beddelaan boorsooyinka, iyo ka hor inta aan la quudin si looga hortago cudurrada.
Dholuo: Joma rito nyithindo onego olwok lwetegi gi sabun kapok gitiyo gi nyithindo, bang' loko piendgi, kendo kapok gichiemo mondo kik giyud tuoche.

English: DCI calls on residents of Lamu County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaomba wakazi wa Wilaya ya Lamu kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: DCI waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu inay u soo sheegaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaalla aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga si ay u taageeraan taxadarka ka dhanka ah argagixisada.
Dholuo: DCI okwayo jogweng' County mar Lamu mondo onyis riwruok mag sirkal ma rito sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e tong'gi mondo gikony e kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Kwale County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Kwale kumtia moyo rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Kwale inuu ku dhiirrigeliyo saaxiibkiisa dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pachgi e County mar Kwale mondo ojiw osiepne moro ma chandore omany kony.

English: KALRO advises farmers in Bomet County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Bomet inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e county mar Bomet mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Key points to stop Mpox spread: Avoid close contact with individuals showing symptoms. Do not share personal items like towels, utensils, or clothing. Maintain good hygiene by washing hands frequently.
Kiswahili: Mambo muhimu ya kuzuia kuenea kwa Mpox: Epuka kugusana kwa karibu na watu wanaoonyesha dalili. Usishiriki vitu vya kibinafsi kama vile taulo, vyombo, au nguo. Dumisha usafi mzuri kwa kunawa mikono mara kwa mara.
Somali: Waxyaabaha ugu muhiimsan ee lagu joojin karo faafitaanka Mpox: Ka fogow inaad xiriir dhow la yeelato dadka muujinaya calaamadaha cudurka. Ha la wadaagin waxyaabaha shakhsi ahaaneed sida tuulooyinka, weelasha, ama dharka.
Dholuo: Puonj madongo ma nyalo konyo e geng'o kaka Mpox landore: Kik ibed machiegni gi jogo ma nigi tuwono. Kik ipog gik moko e kindu kaka twanda, agulni, kata lewni. Bed gi timbe maler ka ilwoko lweti nyading'eny.

English: IEBC urges residents of Bomet County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na ugawaji wa bursary.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan deeq lacageed.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Bomet mondo odonj e program mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo mondo giyud konyruok kuom chenrono.

English: Let us all remember that our first line of defence to beat the virus still remains the containment measures. These are washing of hands with soap and running water, maintaining social and physical distance, wearing of face mask when in public places. #KomeshaCorona update.
Kiswahili: Sote tukumbuke kuwa safu yetu ya kwanza ya utetezi kupiga virusi bado inabaki kuwa hatua za kuzuia. Hizi ni kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji yanayotiririka, kudumisha umbali wa kijamii na kimwili, kuvaa barakoa unapokuwa katika maeneo ya umma. #KomeshaCorona sasisho.
Somali: Aan dhammaanteen xasuusanno in difaaceenna ugu horreeya ee ka hortagga fayraska uu weli yahay tallaabooyinka xakamaynta. Kuwaas waxaa ka mid ah gacmaha oo lagu dhaqo saabuun iyo biyo socda, ilaalinta kala fogaanshaha bulshada iyo jirka, xirashada maaskaro wejiga marka la joogo goobaha dadweynaha. #KomeshaCorona update.
Dholuo: Waduto wapare ni yorwa mokwongo mar geng'ruok mar loyo midhusi pod en yore mag geng'o midhusi. Gigi gin lwoko lwedo gi sabun kod pi ma ng’ich, rito thuolo e kind ji kod ng’ato, rwako mask e wang’ ka in kuonde ma ji mang’eny romoe. #KomeshaKorona ma manyien.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges motorists and pedestrians in Kitui County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Kitui kufunga na kutunza vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Kitui inay guryahooda ku rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa dhacdooyinka la xiriira dabka.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jowuoth kod joma wuotho e ndara e gweng' mar Kitui mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo gitim kinda mar geng'o hinyruok mag yiengni.

English: TSC urges residents of Narok County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: TSC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Narok inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo ji duto modak e Narok County mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud somo mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: IPOA urges the community in Kakamega County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb theft.
Kiswahili: IPOA inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada Gobolka Kakamega inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: IPOA ojiwo oganda man Kakamega County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polis mar oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o kuo.

English: Notice: DCI opens a gender desk offering free legal aid in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisheria bure katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya caawimaad sharci oo lacag la'aan ah Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DCI ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony ma onge chudo e koth Wajir.

English: OGP reminds residents of Nandi County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: OGP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wao wa wilaya huimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nandi in ka qaybgalka maamulaha degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: OGP parone jogweng' kaunti mar Nandi ni tudruok gi jotelo mag gwenge maggi miyo loch mar gweng'no bedo motegno.

English: Drug or alcohol addiction can exacerbate feelings of hopelessness, worsen mental health conditions, impair decision-making, and increase the risk of suicidal thoughts. Avoid drugs and substance abuse
Kiswahili: Uraibu wa dawa za kulevya au pombe unaweza kuzidisha hisia za kukata tamaa, kuzidisha hali ya afya ya akili, kudhoofisha uamuzi, na kuongeza hatari ya mawazo ya kujiua. Epuka dawa za kulevya na matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya.
Somali: Isticmaalka maandooriyaha ama khamriga waxay sii xoojin karaan niyad jabka, waxay sii xumeeyaan xaaladaha maskaxda, waxay saameyn ku yeeshaan go'aan qaadashada, waxayna kordhiyaan khatarta fikirka isdilka.
Dholuo: Bedo misumba yedhe mamero kata mer nyalo miyo ng'ato obed gi parruok mang'eny, onyalo ketho winjruokne gi Nyasaye, onyalo miyo kik otim yiero e yo maber, kendo onyalo miyo paro mar donjo e kend omedre.

English: Kenya suspends all public gatherings, games, events, and church crusades; inter school games banned after first covid-19 case in Nairobi
Kiswahili: Kenya yasimamisha mikusanyiko yote ya umma, michezo, matukio, na mikutano ya kanisa; michezo ya shule imepigwa marufuku baada ya kisa cha kwanza cha COVID-19 jijini Nairobi
Somali: Kenya ayaa joojisay dhammaan isu imaatinka dadweynaha, ciyaaraha, dhacdooyinka, iyo safarada iskutallaabta ee kaniisadda; Ciyaaraha iskuulada ayaa la mamnuucay kadib kiiska koowaad ee COVID-19 ee Nairobi
Dholuo: Kenya ogeng'o chokruok duto mag ji, tuke, gik moko, kod lwenje mag kanisa; tugo tuke e kind skunde ogo marfuk bang' wach Covid-19 mokwongo Nairobi

English: DPP reminds the public in Laikipia County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DPP inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Laikipia inay ka feejignaadaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: DPP parone ji duto e county mar Laikipia mondo omed bedo motang' ne loso kuwe e piny.

English: Training modules for the men include basic marketing strategies tailored to local markets; effective price negotiation techniques; customer engagement and relationship building; and, ethical and inclusive business practices.
Kiswahili: Moduli za mafunzo kwa wanaume ni pamoja na mikakati ya kimsingi ya uuzaji iliyoundwa na masoko ya ndani; mbinu bora za mazungumzo ya bei; ushiriki wa wateja na kujenga uhusiano; na, maadili na mazoea ya biashara jumuishi.
Somali: Qaybaha tababarka ee ragga waxaa ka mid ah istaraatiijiyadaha suuqgeynta aasaasiga ah ee loogu talagalay suuqyada maxalliga ah; farsamooyinka gorgortanka qiimaha wax ku oolka ah; ka qaybgalka macaamiisha iyo dhisidda xiriirka; iyo, dhaqamada ganacsiga ee anshaxa iyo kuwa loo dhan yahay.
Dholuo: Module mag puonjruok ne chwo oriwo yore madongo mag loso mwandu ma owinjore gi chiro mag alwora; yore mabeyo mag loso nengo; loso gi jonyiewo kod gero winjruok; kendo, yore mag ohala ma nigi tim makare kendo ma oriwo ji duto.

English: CS Machogu urges TVET principals to entrench dual training.
Kiswahili: CS Machogu anawahimiza wakuu wa TVET kuimarisha mafunzo mawili.
Somali: CS Machogu wuxuu ugu baaqayaa agaasimayaasha TVET inay xoojiyaan tababarka laba-geesoodka ah.
Dholuo: CS Machogu jiwo jotelo mag TVET mondo oriw tiegruok e yore ariyo.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response launches a May awareness campaign on tobacco control across Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Mei juu ya udhibiti wa tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay bilaabeysaa olole wacyiga ah bishii Maajo ee ka dhanka ah xakamaynta sigaarka ee Gobolka Kwale.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Mei e wi thieth mar ndawa e gweng' mar Kwale.

English: KRA reminds the public in Taita-Taveta County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka gobolka Taita-Taveta in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: KRA parone ji duto manie Taita-Taveta County ni chiwo ripot mar kawo asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: DPP alerts residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: DPP anawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: DPP waxay dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi uga digtay kororka kiisaska jabsashada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: DPP chiwo siem ne jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County e wi medruok mar ketho odiechienge kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Notice: KEMRI will hold a stress management forum in Lamu County this September. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI itafanya kongamano la kudhibiti mafadhaiko katika Kaunti ya Lamu Septemba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay qabaneysaa madasha xakamaynta stress ee degmada Lamu bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMRI biro timo romo mar kedo gi parruok e taon mar Lamu e dwe mar ochiko.

English: NCTC facilitated training in Kakamega to help security personnel counter youth radicalization and emerging extremist tactics.
Kiswahili: NCTC iliwezesha mafunzo huko Kakamega ili kuwasaidia wafanyakazi wa usalama kukabiliana na itikadi kali za vijana na mbinu zinazoibuka za itikadi kali.
Somali: NCTC waxay tababar ku fududeysay Kakamega si ay uga caawiso shaqaalaha amniga inay la dagaallamaan xagjirnimada dhalinyarada iyo istiraatiijiyadda xagjirka ah ee soo baxda.
Dholuo: NCTC ne otiyo gi tiegruok e Kakamega mondo okony jorit sirkal kedo gi timbe mahundu mag rowere.

English: Lagdera Sub-County Community Health Focal person Issa Hajj sensitizing herders on COVID-19 at Ohiyo water point. He also distributed masks & provided immunization services. #KomeshaCorona @garissacounty2
Kiswahili: Msimamizi wa Afya ya Jamii katika Kaunti Ndogo ya Lagdera Issa Hajj akiwahamasisha wafugaji kuhusu COVID-19 katika kituo cha maji cha Ohio. Pia alisambaza barakoa na kutoa huduma za chanjo. #KomeshaCorona @garissacounty2
Somali: Qofka ugu muhiimsan Caafimaadka Bulshada ee Degmada Lagdera Issa Hajj oo dareensiinaya xoolo dhaqatada COVID-19 ee goobta biyaha ee Ohiyo. Wuxuu sidoo kale qaybiyay maaskaro wuxuuna bixiyay adeegyo tallaal. #KomeshaCorona @garissacounty2
Dholuo: Jatend weche thieth mag oganda miluongo ni Lagdera, Issa Hajj, puonjo jokwath e wi COVID-19 e kar pi mar Ohiyo. Bende, ne omiyo masks kendo ne omiyo ji kony mar thieth. #KomeshaKorona @kaunti2020

English: NCPB promotes terracing among farmers in Trans Nzoia County as part of the October climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: NCPB inakuza ustahimilivu kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Oktoba.
Somali: NCPB waxay dhiirrigelisay dhulka beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka iska caabinta cimilada ee Oktoobar.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo kinda mar kedo gi lokruok e kit yamo e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on residents of Garissa County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inatoa wito kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika kumbi za umma ili kuunga mkono mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ugu baaqay dadka deggan degmada Garissa inay la shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations okwayo jogweng' mar County mar Garissa mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag rito sirkal e kuonde ma ji nitie mondo okony ji ong'e ni sirkal nigi chenro mar chiwo siem chon.

English: Funding a tuberculosis-free future: an investment case for screening and preventive treatment
Kiswahili: Kufadhili mustakabali usio na kifua kikuu: kesi ya uwekezaji kwa uchunguzi na matibabu ya kinga
Somali: Maalgelinta mustaqbal aan qaaxada lahayn: kiis maalgashi oo loogu talagalay baaritaanka iyo daaweynta ka hortagga
Dholuo: Chiwo omwom mar kinde mabiro maonge tuo mar TB: kes mar keto omwom mar pim kod thieth mar geng'o

Kiswahili: Mwisho utekelezaji: sera ya elimu ya pamoja sasa inashughulikia taasisi zote TVET - kila mwanafunzi kuwakaribisha!
Somali: Soo bandhigiddii ugu dambeysay: Siyaasadda waxbarashada loo dhan yahay hadda waxay daboolaysaa dhammaan machadyada TVET ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…â€œ arday kasta waa la soo dhaweynayaa!

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response launches a March awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Machi juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay bilaabeysaa olole wacyi galineed bishii Maarso oo ku saabsan baaritaanka sonkorowga gobolka Kilifi.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuoche chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Mach e wi nonro mar thieth mar sukari e gweng' mar Kilifi.

English: Embu (Mbeere) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Embu (Mbeere): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2023
Somali: Degmada Embu (Mbeere): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Embu (Mbeere): Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar 2023

English: Notice: KRA opens a new service point for passport services in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay ka furaysaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee Gobolka Laikipia.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KRA oseyawo kama itimee tije mag kawo kad e gweng' mar Laikipia.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges cassava growers in Kisii County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Kisii kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda cassava ee degmada Kisii inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka ciidanka xilliga dayrta iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur ma pidho manija e County mar Kisii mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma giyudo e higa mar 2020 mondo okonygi loyo kodhino chon ka gitiyo gi tuoche makelo tuoche ma ok nyal geng'o.

English: CDC reminds the public in Kirinyaga County about the importance of safe water storage for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga juu ya umuhimu wa uhifadhi wa maji salama kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: CDC waxay dadweynaha degmada Kirinyaga ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji duto e County mar Kirinyaga kuom ber mar kano pi maler e ngima joot.

English: Council of Governors warns public officers in Kitui County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linaonya maafisa wa umma katika Wilaya ya Kitui dhidi ya kupotosha fedha za umma.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ka digeen saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Kitui in la xadgudbo maalgashiga dawladda.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e gweng' mar Kitui ni kik giti gi pesa mag sirkandno e yo marach.

English: Narok County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Narok: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2022
Somali: Degmada Narok: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Narok: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar adek higa mar 2022

English: Kilifi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for January 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kilifi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Januari 2023
Somali: Degmada Kilifi: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Janaayo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kilifi: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar achiel higa mar 2023

English: Office of the Auditor-General warns public officers in Uasin Gishu County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee gobolka Uasin Gishu khiyaanooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Uasin Gishu kuom timbe mag wuondruok.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) appeals to caregivers in Baringo County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the May maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Mei.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Baringo inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta bukaanka ee la qorsheeyay qeyb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee bisha Maajo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) kwayo jorit e county mar Baringo mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar thieth ma ne otim e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: KTDA will conduct a fertiliser application workshop for farmers in Kisumu County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itafanya warsha ya maombi ya mbolea kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan codsiyada bacriminta beeraleyda degmada Kisumu bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Rapar: KTDA biro timo tiegruok mar tiyo gi yien mag yien ne jopur e gweng' mar Kisumu e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: e-Citizen launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Tana River County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Wilaya ya Tana River Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: e-Citizen waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa gobolka Tana River bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Par ane: e-Citizen chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Tana River e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) promotes terracing among farmers in Kitui County as part of the August climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inakuza uchungaji kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Agosti.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kor u qaadeysaa dhulka beeraleyda degmada Kitui iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Agoosto.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) konyo jopur ma Kitui County timo tij loso lowo e dwe mar Agost ka gitiyo gi chenrono.

English: Annoucement by Kenya National Commission on Human Rights  calling recognizing mental health as a universal human right.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la Tume ya Kitaifa ya Haki za Kibinadamu ya Kenya likiita kutambuliwa kwa afya ya akili kuwa haki ya kibinadamu ya kimataifa.
Somali: Warbixin ay soo saartay Guddiga Qaranka Kenya ee Xuquuqda Aadanaha oo ku baaqay in la aqoonsado caafimaadka dhimirka inuu yahay xuquuqda aadanaha ee caalamiga ah.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya National Commission on Human Rights nowacho ni ng'eyo ngima mar pach dhano en ratiro mar dhano.

English: Student talks on youth and civic power
Kiswahili: Mazungumzo ya Wanafunzi Kuhusu Vijana na Nguvu za Kiraia
Somali: Ardaydu waxay ka hadlaan dhalinyarada iyo awoodda bulshada
Dholuo: Puonj mag Jopuonjre e wi rowere kod teko mar oganda

English: Council of Governors announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kufanya kazi kwa ajili ya huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku dhawaaqeen waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch olando lokruok e seche mag tiyo gi passport e county mar Baringo.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Busia County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia in warbixinta khiyaamooyinka si deg deg ah ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross parone jogweng' County mar Busia ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar wuond konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Resettlement in Dadaab enables hundreds of refugee families to access services after years
Kiswahili: Makazi mapya katika Dadaab huwezesha mamia ya familia za wakimbizi kupata huduma baada ya miaka mingi
Somali: Dib-u-dejinta Dhadhaab waxay u suurta gelinaysaa boqolaal qoys oo qaxooti ah inay helaan adeegyo sannado kadib
Dholuo: Kaka ng’ato nyalo dak e Dadaab, mano miyo joot mang’eny ma jolweny yudo kony bang’ higni mang’eny

English: Kenya is implementing the National Agroecology Strategy for Food System Transformation 2024 2033 Stakeholders are urged to strengthen monitoring systems for sustainable results
Kiswahili: Kenya inatekeleza Mkakati wa Kitaifa wa Agroecology kwa Mabadiliko ya Mfumo wa Chakula 2024 2033 Wadau wahimizwa kuimarisha mifumo ya ufuatiliaji kwa matokeo endelevu.
Somali: Kenya waxay hirgelinaysaa Istaraatiijiyadda Qaran ee Agroecology ee Isbeddelka Nidaamka Cuntada 2024 2033. Daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay xoojiyaan nidaamyada kormeerka si loo helo natiijooyin waara
Dholuo: Kenya tiyo gi National Agroecology Strategy for Food System Transformation 2024 2033 Ojiwo jokanyo mondo omed jiwo chenro mag nono gik ma biro timore e ngima

English: COMESA urges maize growers in Wajir County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawasihi wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Wajir watumie viwango vinavyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee Gobolka Wajir inay isticmaalaan sicirka bacriminta lagu taliyey roobka ka hor si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur ma pidho kodhi e gweng ' mar Wajir County mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue mondo omed kelo nyak e higani.

English: E-Citizen urges eligible citizens in Tharaka-Nithi County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen anawahimiza raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ugu baaqaysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo jokanyo mowinjore e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oriwgi e kwedo jogo madwaro yiero.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises maize producers in Meru County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inashauri wazalishaji wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Meru kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa soo saarayaasha hadhuudhka ee degmada Meru inay ka iibsadaan wax soo saarka kaliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur mag cham e county mar Meru ni giusgi mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo cham kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Effective cooperative management relies on clear rules and good governance Learn the essentials for running a successful input group
Kiswahili: Usimamizi mzuri wa ushirikiano hutegemea sheria zilizo wazi na utawala bora Jifunze mambo muhimu ya kuendesha kikundi cha mchango chenye mafanikio
Somali: Maareynta iskaashi ee wax ku oolka ah waxay ku tiirsan tahay xeerar cad iyo maamul wanaagsan Baro aasaaska lagu maamulo koox soo gelin guul leh
Dholuo: Tiyo gi riwruok mar oganda Jehova e yo maber, kendo tiyo gi rieko e yo maber, en gima dwarore ahinya mondo ng'ato obed gi winjruok maber gi Nyasaye.

English: NDMA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kisumu County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: NDMA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Kisumu piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Kisumu inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: NDMA ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e County mar Kisumu mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195 maonge chudo.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds schools in Nyeri County to strengthen anti-bullying measures this July.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuimarisha hatua za kupambana na uonevu Julai hii.

Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.

English: State Department for Basic Education advises applicants in Makueni County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.

Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa beeraleyda degmada Siaya barnaamijka tababarka codsiga bacriminta ee socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service oparo ne jopur e county mar Siaya chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar tiyo gi yien.

Kiswahili: Wafadhili lazima watume fedha haraka huku hali ya kibinadamu inazidi kuzorota nchini Kenya

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for cattle in Isiolo County this November.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Novemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa ku dhawaaqday jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ka dhan ah qabyaalada lo'da ee Gobolka Isiolo bishii Nofeembar ee sannadkan.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development olando chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar rabies e kaunti mar Isiolo e dwe mar Novemba.

Kiswahili: IEBC inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations alerts residents of Kericho County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).

Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya cha karibu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya cyclosporiasis vilivyoripotiwa.

Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay marti gelineysaa adeeg lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee Gobolka Baringo bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo chenro mar choko pi maonge chudo e taon mar Baringo e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: COMESA will open a coffee collection centre in Mombasa County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itafungua kituo cha kukusanya kahawa katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay furaysaa xarun soo uruurinaysa kafeega gobolka Mombasa bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA biro yawo kar choko chai e County mar Mombasa e dwe mar Februar.

English: Investigate about mental health illness in your family, investigatiion have confirmed that it is rotational in a family, but is is preventable. Continue learning to understand more about this mental health disease, how bad it is gynaecologically, in your residence and in your body to live successfully.
Kiswahili: Chunguza kuhusu ugonjwa wa afya ya akili katika familia yako, uchunguzi umethibitisha kwamba ni wa mzunguko katika familia, lakini unaweza kuzuilika. Endelea kujifunza ili kuelewa zaidi kuhusu ugonjwa huu wa afya ya akili, jinsi ilivyo mbaya kwa wanawake, katika makazi yako na mwilini mwako kuishi kwa mafanikio.
Somali: Baaritaan ku saabsan cudurka caafimaadka dhimirka ee qoyskaaga, baaritaannada ayaa xaqiijiyay in uu yahay mid wareegaya qoyska, laakiin waa la hortagi karaa. sii wad inaad wax badan ka ogaato cudurkan dhimirka, sida ay u xun tahay dhakhtarka haweenka, gurigaaga iyo jirkaaga si aad u noolaato si guul leh.
Dholuo: Tim nonro e wi tuoche mag paro ei joodi, nonro osenyiso ni mano timore e ngima joot, kata kamano inyalo geng'e. Dhi nyime puonjori mondo ing'e weche momedore e wi tuwono mar paro, kaka tuwono nyalo bedo marach kuom weche mag nindruok, e odi koda e ringri mondo ngimani odhi maber.

English: COMESA reminds livestock keepers in Narok County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Narok kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa za kuponda ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: COMESA waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Narok inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: COMESA paronwa jorit jamni man Narok County mondo ogeng' jamni e kuonde moketi mondo orit ngima jamni.

English: KEPHIS advises horticultural produce producers in Vihiga County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inashauri wazalishaji wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha wax soo saarka beeraha ee degmada Vihiga inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KEPHIS nyiso jopur ma loso puothe e county mar Vihiga ni mondo oti gi nengo matin mar puodhono kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: SHA urges eligible citizens in Garissa County to participate in voter education.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawahimiza raia wenye haki katika Kaunti ya Garissa kushiriki katika elimu ya wapiga kura.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Garissa inay ka qaybqaataan waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro mar yiero e County mar Garissa mondo oriwre e tiegruok mar josiasa.

English: Council of Governors reminds residents of Kericho County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Kericho in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Council of Governors parone jogweng' Kericho County ni luwo dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Huduma Kenya warns public officers in Samburu County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Samburu dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee gobolka Samburu inay musuqmaasuqa ka qaataan xafiisyada dowladda.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Samburu kuom kawo asoya e migepe mag oganda.

English: NDMA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kilifi County that access to post-violence medical care is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kwamba huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu zinapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Kilifi in helitaanka daryeelka caafimaad ee rabshadda ka dib ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e County Kilifi ni yudo kony mar thieth bang' lweny en gima ng'ato nyalo yudo maonge chudo.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Embu County that access to the GBV toll-free helpline is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Embu kwamba upatikanaji wa simu ya msaada ya GBV ya bure unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ee ka dhacay degmada Embu in helitaanka khadka caawimaadda ee GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah uu yahay mid lacag-la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e county mar Embu ni gibiro yudo kony ma onge chudo mar GBV maonge chudo.

English: Did you know? Your sleep quality directly affects your mental health! 1.Aim for 7-9 hours of restful sleep each night. 2. Avoid stimulants like caffeine or drugs before bedâ€” they disrupt your Zzz's! Prioritize your rest, recharge your mind, and wake up refreshed!
Kiswahili: Ulijua? Ubora wa usingizi wako huathiri moja kwa moja afya yako ya akili! 1. Lenga kulala kwa saa 7-9 kila usiku. 2. Epuka vichocheo kama vile kafeini au dawa za kulevya kabla ya kulala - vinavyovuruga hisia zako za Zzz! Zipe kipaumbele pumziko lako, chaji akili yako, na uamke ukiwa umeburudika!
Somali: Ma ogtahay? Tayada hurdadaadu waxay si toos ah u saamaysaa caafimaadkaaga maskaxda! 1. Ku dadaal 7-9 saacadood oo hurdo nasasho leh habeen kasta. 2. Ka fogow waxyaabaha kiciya sida kafeyn ama daroogooyinka ka hor intaadan seexan - waxay carqaladeeyaan Zzz-kaaga! Mudnaanta sii nasashadaada, maskaxdaada dib u nasi, oo soo kac adigoo firfircoon!
Dholuo: Be ing’eyo? Kido mar nindo ma ibedogo mulo ngimani mar paro! 1.Bed gi gombo mar nindo kuom seche 7-9 otieno ka otieno. 2. Weri gi gik ma kelo gombo kaka kafein kata yath ma mero ji kapok idonjo e nindoâ€” giketho Zzz mari!

English: Notice: NDMA issues a cybersecurity alert on phishing messages affecting residents of Narok County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya ujumbe wa udanganyifu unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan fariimaha phishing ee saameeya dadka deggan gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Rapar: NDMA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity e wi ote mag phishing makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Narok County.

English: COMESA warns maize farmers in Nakuru County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawaonya wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: COMESA waxay uga digtay beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Nakuru cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: COMESA chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho kodhi e gweng' mar Nakuru kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: KEMRI reminds the public that free depression awareness support is available through county health facilities in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa uhamasishaji wa unyogovu unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay wacyiga niyadjabku laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Nairobi.
Dholuo: KEMRI paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar parruok yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county man Nairobi County.

English: They've begun working with local chambers of agriculture and trade through the government's Digital Agriculture Market portal, where they upload ...
Kiswahili: Wameanza kufanya kazi na vyumba vya kilimo na biashara vya ndani kupitia lango la serikali la Soko la Kilimo Dijitali, ambapo hupakia ...
Somali: Waxay bilaabeen inay la shaqeeyaan Rugta Beeraha iyo Ganacsiga ee Gobolka iyada oo loo marayo bogga Suuqa Beeraha Dijital ah ee Dowladda, halkaas oo ay ku soo dejiyaan ...
Dholuo: Gisebedo ka gitiyo gi kamera mag pur kod ohala e pinyno kokalo kuom chenro mar pinyruoth mar Digital Agriculture Market, kama gimiyo...

English: Comments are most helpful if they indicate the specific regulation or group of regulations to which they relate, contain a clear rationale , and where applicable provide a suggestion for alternative wording.
Kiswahili: Maoni husaidia sana ikiwa yanaonyesha kanuni mahususi au kundi la kanuni ambalo yanahusiana nayo, yana mantiki iliyo wazi , na inapotumika kutoa pendekezo la maneno mbadala.
Somali: Faallooyinku waxay aad waxtar u leeyihiin haddii ay tilmaamaan qawaaniinta gaarka ah ama kooxda xeerarka ay la xiriiraan, ay ku jiraan sabab cad, iyo haddii ay khuseyso, soo jeedi soo jeedin ku saabsan ereyo kale.
Dholuo: Gik ma ji ng’ado konyo ahinya ka ginyiso chik kata grup mar chike ma giwuoyogo, ka gin gi gimomiyo maler , kendo ka nyalore, gichiwo paro mar keto weche mamoko.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will distribute certified sweet potatoes seed to farmers in Migori County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KEPHIS itasambaza mbegu zilizothibitishwa za viazi tamu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori mwezi huu wa Novemba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay abuurka baradho macaan oo shahaado leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda Degmada Migori bisha November ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEPHIS biro pogo kodhi mag kitungu ne jopur manie Migori County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: KICD opens a new catering and hospitality programme at the vocational centre in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KICD inafungua mpango mpya wa upishi na ukarimu katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay ka furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan cuntada iyo marti-gelinta xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Laikipia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KICD chako chenro manyien mar chiemo kod rwako welo e kar tich e County mar Laikipia.

English: Turkana County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Turkana: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2024
Somali: Degmada Turkana: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Turkana: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2024

English: TSC announces distribution of textbooks and learning materials to schools in Vihiga County this January.
Kiswahili: TSC inatangaza usambazaji wa vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Januari hii.
Somali: TSC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta buugaagta iyo agabyada waxbarasho ee dugsiyada degmada Vihiga bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: TSC olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok e skunde man Vihiga County e dwe mar Januar.

English: OGP reminds voters in Makueni County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: OGP inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Makueni kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Makueni in ay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor nidaamyada doorashada.
Dholuo: OGP parone jogweng' Makueni mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero ka pok oyud thuolo mar timo yiero.

English: E-Citizen reminds the public in Samburu County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this July.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba maoni juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka yanakaribishwa Julai hii.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha Gobolka Samburu in talooyinka dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: E-Citizen oparo ne ji duto e county mar Samburu ni gik ma ji wacho e wi nonro mar tich mitimo higa ka higa en gimaber e dwe mar Julai.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in West Pokot County about the importance of diabetes screening for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuhusu umuhimu wa uchunguzi wa kisukari kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMSA waxay dadka degmada West Pokot ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda baaritaanka sonkorowga uu u leeyahay caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone ji e West Pokot County kuom ber mar nonro mar thieth mar sukari e ngima joot.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds the public in Kirinyaga County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this November.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba ushiriki katika mashauriano ya sera za umma unakaribishwa Novemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) ayaa xasuusinaya shacabka degmada Kirinyaga in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha la soo dhaweynayo bisha November.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone ji duto e County mar Kirinyaga ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mag sirkal e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Planting using planting line, helps during weeding. A new technology, worms and all that complement each other...
Kiswahili: Kupanda kwa kutumia mstari wa kupanda, husaidia wakati wa kupalilia. Teknolojia mpya, minyoo na yote yanayokamilishana...
Somali: Beerista iyadoo la adeegsanayo xariiqda beerta, waxay ka caawisaa inta lagu jiro cawska cawska. Tiknoolajiyad cusub, cayayaanka iyo dhammaan kuwaas oo is dhammaystira...
Dholuo: Tiyo gi yore mag pidho kodhi konyo e kinde ma ji yudogo lum.

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief, February 2024
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP Kenya, Februari 2024
Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya, Febraayo 2024
Dholuo: Wach machuok mar piny Kenya mar WFP, dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2024

English: Notice: IEBC launches county development projects in Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay bilowday mashaariic horumarineed oo ka socda gobolka Samburu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IEBC chako tije mag timo dongruok e gweng' mar Samburu County.

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will host a free proper sanitation outreach in Bungoma County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mazingira bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska Dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa martigelin doonta adeegyo nadaafadeed oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku habboon degmada Bungoma bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo chenro mar rito ngima maler maonge chudo e taon mar Bungoma County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Information on access to markets, factors of production including land and ... agricultural exports less competitive in global markets. Kenya Vision ...
Kiswahili: Habari kuhusu upatikanaji wa masoko, sababu za uzalishaji kutia ndani ardhi na...biashara za kilimo hazishindani sana katika masoko ya dunia. Kenya Vision ..........
Somali: Macluumaad ku saabsan helitaanka suuqyada, waxyaabaha wax soo saarka oo ay ku jiraan dhulka iyo ... dhoofinta beeraha ee ka yar tartanka suuqyada caalamiga ah. Kenya Vision ...
Dholuo: Weche ma nyiso kaka inyalo yudo ohala, gik ma kelo ohala moriwo lowo kod ohala mag puothe mag pur ma ok dhi maber e pinje duto.

English: Notice: IEBC opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa codsiyada deeqda waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan ardayda ku jira degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC oyawo kwayo mar yudo osuru ne jopuonjre man gi chan e Kericho County.

English: Notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Machakos County this June. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Machakos Juni hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay qabaneysaa madasha caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada ee Degmada Machakos bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo Tuoche biro timo romo mar paro ne rowere e taon mar Machakos e dwe mar Jun. Ji duto mor.

English: KTDA encourages farmers in Turkana County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for tea.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora za chai.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Turkana inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo shaaha ah.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e county mar Turkana mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mondo giyud nengo maber mar chai.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges farmers in Trans Nzoia County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur e Trans Nzoia County mondo opidh cham mondo omi lowo okethre mondo omi giritre kuom lokruok mar koth.

English: Rapid Review of Healthy Ageing and Long-term Care Systems in East and Southern Africa: Country Summary Report â€“ Kenya
Kiswahili: Mapitio ya Haraka ya Mifumo ya Kuzeeka Kiafya na ya Muda Mrefu katika Afrika Mashariki na Kusini: Ripoti ya Muhtasari wa Nchi - Kenya
Somali: Dib u eegis degdeg ah oo ku saabsan Nidaamyada Daryeelka Gabowga Caafimaadka qaba iyo Muddada Dheer ee Bariga iyo Koonfurta Afrika: Warbixinta Soo Koobidda Dalka - Kenya
Dholuo: Ong'iyo mapiyo mar ng'ado bura maber kod yore mag rito jogo ma oseti kuom kinde malach e Afrika ma Wuokchieng' kod ma milambo: Ripot ma ng'ato nyalo ng'eyogo piny â€“ Kenya

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will train farmers in Kajiado County on organic farming this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kajiado juu ya kilimo hai Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Kajiado ee beeraha dabiiciga ah bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro tiego jopur e Kajiado County e wi pur mar yien e dwe mar Jun.

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of West Pokot County about a rise in identity theft and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: Kenya Red Cross inawaonya wakazi wa Wilaya ya West Pokot juu ya kuongezeka kwa wizi wa kitambulisho na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ka digeysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot oo ku saabsan kororka xadgudubka aqoonsiga waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga leh bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross osiemo jogweng' mar West Pokot County kuom dongruok mar kwalo wang' ji kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok adier ne jatendgi.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds youth in Elgeyo-Marakwet County that HELB funding is available for welding and fabrication training.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya dhalinyarada degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne rowere man Elgeyo-Marakwet County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges anyone experiencing abuse in Laikipia County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Laikipia piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Laikipia inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ee 1195.

Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xayawaanka ah ee degmada Nyamira inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Makueni County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development invites farmers in Mandera County to a free training on greenhouse farming this November.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo cha chafu Novemba hii.

Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Garissa inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si loo wanaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.

English: CDC reminds the public that free suicide prevention support is available through county health facilities in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kuzuia kujiua unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo ka hortagga ismiidaaminta laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Garissa.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar geng'o ji kik nege yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Garissa.

English: Kenya is one among 12 African countries that will get 18 million malaria vaccine up to 2025, World Health International (WHI) will first issue the vaccine to countries with dire need.
Kiswahili: Kenya ni moja kati ya nchi 12 za Afrika zitakazopata chanjo ya malaria milioni 18 kufikia 2025, World Health International (WHI) itawapa kwanza chanjo hiyo nchi zilizo na uhitaji mkubwa.
Somali: Kenya waa mid ka mid ah 12 dal oo Afrikaan ah oo heli doona 18 milyan oo tallaal oo ka dhan ah malaria illaa iyo 2025, Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHI) ayaa marka hore u soo bandhigi doona tallaalka dalalka u baahan baahida daran.
Dholuo: Kenya en achiel kuom pinje 12 mag Afrika mabiro yudo chan mar malaria milion 18 nyaka higa mar 2025, World Health International (WHI) biro chiwo channo mokwongo ne pinje ma dwaro ahinya.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service issues a cybersecurity alert on mobile money scams affecting residents of Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya imetoa onyo la usalama wa mtandao juu ya kashfa za pesa za rununu zinazoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.

Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Forest Service ogolo siem mar sirkal mar cybersecurity e wi timbe mag wuond mag pesa mitimo gi simo ma mulo joma odak e Tharaka-Nithi County.

English: TSC reminds youth in Baringo County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari.
Somali: TSC waxay xasuusineysaa dhallinyarada degmada Baringo in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka farsamada gawaarida.
Dholuo: TSC oparo ne rowere man Baringo County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar masinde mag mtokni.

Dholuo: Lando kuom singo mar SNV mar dhi nyime konyo ji ng'eyo lokruok e kit chiemo e piny Kenya ka chokruok mar Bif timore Nairobi

English: ODPP urges residents of Uasin Gishu County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandaoni ya kaunti ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo oriwre gi county's online participation portal e loso nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: Kenya continues in boosting livestock health.
Kiswahili: Kenya inaendelea kuongeza afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Kenya waxay sii wadaa inay kor u qaaddo caafimaadka xoolaha.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development urges youth in Mombasa County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
