English: Teachers Service Commission reminds youth in Trans Nzoia County that HELB funding is available for tailoring and design training.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka ayaa xasuusinaya dhalinyarada degmada Trans Nzoia in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka qaabeynta iyo naqshadeynta.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne rowere man Trans Nzoia County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar loso piche.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Marsabit County about the importance of tobacco control for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya umuhimu wa udhibiti wa tumbaku kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay dadka degmada Marsabit ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay ka hortagga sigaarka ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa ji duto e county mar Marsabit gimomiyo thieth mar madho ndawa en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Training program on modern irrigation systems announced in Kitui.
Kiswahili: Programu ya mafunzo kuhusu mifumo ya kisasa ya umwagiliaji yatangazwa Kitui.
Somali: Barnaamij tababar ah oo ku saabsan nidaamyada waraabka casriga ah ayaa lagu dhawaaqay Kitui.

Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za macho na meno sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya dadweynaha degmada Kilifi in helitaanka xeryaha indhaha iyo ilkaha ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada iskuulada ku yaal degmada Murang'a.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development chako chenro mar rito nyithindo e skul e skunde duto mag County mar Murang'a.

English: KEPHIS encourages farmers in Kitui County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for horticultural produce.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa ili kupata bei bora za mazao ya bustani.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of West Pokot County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati wa msimu huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lugta lagu maro inta lagu jiro xilliyada dhulgariirada.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service parone jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo oluw tong' mar piyo kendo oti gi yore mag wuotho e kinde mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will open a maize collection centre in Embu County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mahindi katika Kaunti ya Embu Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Wax soo saarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ka furi doonaa xarun ururinta hadhuudhka degmada Embu bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro yawo ot mar choko kodhi e County mar Embu e dwe mar Novemba.

English: CBK is aware of mobile apps charging 'CRB clearance' fees upfront. CRB requests are processed through licensed bureaus only.
Kiswahili: CBK inafahamu kuhusu programu za simu zinazotoza ada za 'kibali cha CRB' mapema. Maombi ya CRB yanashughulikiwa kupitia ofisi zenye leseni pekee.
Somali: CBK way ka warqabtaa in barnaamijyada moobaylka ay hore u qaadaan khidmadaha 'CRB clearance'. Codsiyada CRB waxaa lagu farsameeyaa oo keliya xafiisyada shatiga haysta.
Dholuo: CBK ong’eyo ni apps mag simu ma ng’ado ne ng’ato pesa mag ‘CRB’ motelo. Kwayo mag CRB itimo kokalo kuom biro ma nigi laisens kende.

English: To control mango pulp weevil, harvest fruits earlier than usual (before fully ripe), and remove and bury fallen fruit debris at least 50cm deep (or compost it under at least 1m of other material) to stop weevils hatching and reinfesting the crop.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti weevil ya massa ya embe, vuna matunda mapema kuliko kawaida (kabla ya kuiva kabisa), na uondoe na uzike uchafu wa matunda ulioanguka kwa kina cha angalau 50cm (au uiweke mbolea chini ya angalau 1m ya nyenzo zingine) ili kuzuia wadudu kuanguliwa na kurejesha mazao.
Somali: Si loo xakameeyo weevil-ka mango pulp, goosto miraha ka hor inta aan caadiga ahayn (ka hor inta aysan si buuxda u bislaan), kadibna ka saar oo ku aaso qashinka miraha dhacay ugu yaraan 50cm qoto dheer (ama isku daro ugu yaraan 1m walxo kale) si looga joojiyo cayayaanka inay dillaacaan oo dib u faafidaan dalagga.
Dholuo: Mondo ng'ato otang' gi ng'injo mag mango, nyaka ochok olemo chon moloyo kaka ne itimo chon (ka pok ochie chuth), kendo nyaka ogol oko kendo oyike e bor mar chamo olemo ma osepodho ma dirom sentimita 50 (kata otere e bwo mita 1 mar gik mamoko) mondo ogeng'o ng'iendno kik yieng' kendo kik ochak oyud olemo kendo.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Kitui County that access to free medical camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za matibabu bila malipo sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kitui in helitaanka xeryaha caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMSA oparo ne ji duto e County mar Kitui ni thuolo mar yudo kuonde thieth maonge chudo koro yudore e kuonde moyier.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross will hold a stress management forum in Nyamira County this February. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utafanya kongamano la kudhibiti mafadhaiko katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Februari hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa qaban doonta madasha xakamaynta stress-ka ee degmada Nyamira bisha Febraayo. Dhammaantood waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Red Cross biro timo romo mar kedo gi parruok e taon mar Nyamira e dwe mar Februar.

English: Make proper application of fertiliser in beans cultivation, understanding soil nutrient requirements, selecting best seeds and fertizer application of correct ratio and timing.
Kiswahili: Fanya matumizi sahihi ya mbolea katika kilimo cha maharagwe, kuelewa mahitaji ya virutubisho vya udongo, kuchagua mbegu bora na matumizi ya mbolea ya uwiano sahihi na wakati.
Somali: Isticmaalka bacriminta ee saxda ah ee beeraha, fahamka baahida nafaqada ee ciidda, xulashada abuurka ugu fiican iyo isticmaalka bacriminta ee saamiga saxda ah iyo waqtiga.
Dholuo: Timuru kamano kuom tiyo gi yien e puodho mar nyinyo, ng'eyo gik ma lowo dwaro, yiero kodhi mabeyo, kendo tiyo gi yien e okang' mowinjore kendo e kinde mowinjore.

English: Pest Control Products Board announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for cattle in Kwale County this February.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kwale Februari hii.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa ku dhawaaqaya jimicsi tallaal oo bilaash ah oo cudurka Newcastle ee lo'da ee Gobolka Kwale bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok mar Pest olando ni ibiro tim kampen mar golo tuoche mag Newcastle maonge chudo ne dhok e County mar Kwale e dwe mar Februar.

English: Climate smart agriculture as ratified by FAO target three goals 1. Increase yields and income sustainably, 2. Incomes through current farming
Kiswahili: Kilimo cha hali ya hewa kama ilivyoidhinishwa na FAO kinalenga malengo matatu 1. Ongeza mavuno na mapato kwa uendelevu, 2. Mapato kupitia kilimo cha sasa
Somali: Beeraha caqli-galka ah ee cimilada sida ay ansixisay FAO waxay ujeeddooyin u yihiin saddex hadaf 1. Kordhinta wax soo saarka iyo dakhliga si joogto ah, 2. Dakhliga ka soo baxa beeraha hadda jira
Dholuo: Tij pur mariek mar piny kaluwore gi lokruok mar lokruok mar alwora kaluwore gi kaka FAO oseriwo chenrono, nigi chenro adek: 1. Medore mar nyak kod yuto e yo ma siko; 2. Yudo pesa kokalo kuom pur masani.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Embu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee degmada Embu.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya osechako tiyo gi ofis manyien mar e-Citizen Registration e county mar Embu.

English: OGP reminds the public in Kilifi County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this January.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kwamba mapendekezo juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka yanakaribishwa Januari hii.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kilifi in talooyinka dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: OGP oparo ne ji duto manie County Kilifi ni ji duto mor gi chiwo mar chiwo paro e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e dwe mar Januar.

English: Kenyan government must end illegal evictions of Ogiek in Mau Forest
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya lazima ikomeshe uondoaji haramu wa Ogiek katika Msitu wa Mau
Somali: Dowladda Kenya waa inay soo afjartaa ka saarista sharci darrada ah ee Ogiek ee ku taal Kaynta Mau
Dholuo: <2Zepa> Sirikal mar Kenya nyaka tiek golo Ogiek e bungu mar Mau e yo ma ok owinjore

English: Kenya Medical Association urges residents of Narok County to avoid contact with contaminated water sources following a rise in reported tuberculosis cases.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya kifua kikuu.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Narok inay ka fogaadaan inay la xiriiraan ilaha biyaha wasakheysan ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska cudurka 'tuberculosis'.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo kik giriwre gi pi mochido nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuberculosis osemedore.

English: DCI reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Nyeri County that access to post-violence medical care is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu zinapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee degmada Nyeri in helitaanka daryeelka caafimaad ee rabshadda ka dib ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: DCI oparo ne jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e County mar Nyeri ni yudo kony mar thieth bang' tim mahundu en gima ng'ato nyalo yudo nono.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Makueni County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the June planting season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Juni.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Makueni inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e county mar Makueni mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Jun.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on the community in Murang'a County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ugu baaqay bulshada degmada Murang'a inay ka soo horjeedaan rabshadaha jinsiga iyo inay taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oluongo ji duto e county mar Murang'a mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo mondo giyud kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: TSC advises students in Bomet County to collect materials from the county education office to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: TSC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Bomet kukusanya vifaa kutoka kwa ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali.
Somali: TSC waxay ardayda degmada Bomet kula talineysaa inay ka soo ururiyaan xogta xafiiska waxbarashada degmada si ay u helaan kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo jopuonjre e county mar Bomet mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar tiegruok mar county mondo giyud kompyuta mag skul e bwo chenro mar somo gi somo.

English: Scientist have confirmed that the mosquito that transmits malaria in East and Northern Africa, has become immune to medication that the fight to eliminate mosquitoes has been given priority in this regions.
Kiswahili: Wanasayansi wamethibitisha kwamba mbu anayeambukiza malaria katika Afrika Mashariki na Kaskazini, amekuwa na kinga dhidi ya madawa ya kulevya ambayo mapambano ya kuondoa mbu yamepewa kipaumbele katika mikoa hii.
Somali: Cilmi-baadhayaashu waxay xaqiijiyeen in cayayaanka u gudbiya Cudurka Cudurrada ee Bariga iyo Waqooyiga Afrika, uu ka hortag u noqday daawooyinka in la dagaalanka in la baabi'iyo cayayaanku uu mudnaanta la siiyo gobolladaas.
Dholuo: Josayans osenyiso ni kute ma kelo malaria e pinje mag Afrika ma Ugwe kod Ugwe, ok nyal thiedho ndawa.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages mothers in Bomet County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Bomet kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa hooyooyinka degmada Bomet inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo mine manie county mar Bomet mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Gov't calls for wearing of masks as country battles 6th Covid-19 wave
Kiswahili: Serikali yatoa wito wa kuvaa barakoa huku nchi ikipambana na wimbi la 6 la Covid-19
Somali: Dowladdu waxay ku baaqeysaa xirashada maaskaro maadaama waddanku la dagaallamo hirka lixaad ee COVID-19
Dholuo: Sirkal dwaro ni ji orwak lewni mag geng'ruok e kinde lweny mar 6 mar Covid-19

English: EACC reminds residents of Tana River County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Tana River kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River in ay ka qaybqaataan maamulaha qaybta deegaanka si ay u xoojiyaan maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: EACC paronwa jogweng' mar Tana River County ni tudruok gi jorit mar gwenge maggi miyo sirkal bedo gi loch maber.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) confirms a dengue fever outbreak alert for Nairobi County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) yathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa homa ya dengue katika Kaunti ya Nairobi. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka hargabka dengue ee Gobolka Nairobi. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: SHA (Social Health Authority) osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuwo mar dengue e County mar Nairobi.

English: Environmental Screening Report NEAT+, Dadaab, Kenya
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Uchunguzi wa Mazingira NEAT+, Dadaab, Kenya
Somali: Warbixinta Baaritaanka Deegaanka NEAT+, Dadaab, Kenya
Dholuo: Ripot mar Rango Alwora NEAT+, Dadab, Kenya

English: Pest Control Products Board informs coffee farmers in Baringo County of new market linkage opportunities this April.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawafahamisha wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Baringo juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Aprili hii.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa wargelinaya beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Baringo fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok mar Pest nyiso jopur mag chai e County mar Baringo e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar April.

English: Mozambique s new e Phyto system is now operational for agricultural exporters streamlining phytosanitary certifications Use the platform for faster processing and compliance with global trade standards
Kiswahili: Mfumo mpya wa e Phyto wa Msumbiji sasa unafanya kazi kwa wauzaji bidhaa za kilimo wanaoboresha udhibitisho wa mimea na mimea Tumia jukwaa kwa usindikaji wa haraka na kufuata viwango vya biashara ya kimataifa.
Somali: Nidaamka cusub ee e Phyto ee Mozambique ayaa hadda shaqeynaya dhoofiyeyaasha beeraha isagoo fududeynaya shahaadooyinka phytosanitary-ga Isticmaal madasha si loo dhaqso u sameeyo iyo u hoggaansanaanta heerarka ganacsiga caalamiga ah
Dholuo: E Mozambique e e Phyto system manyien sani tiyo ne jo ohala mag pur e yor yor thieth mar yien

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public in Turkana County that access to eye and dental camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za macho na meno sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Turkana in helitaanka xeryaha indhaha iyo ilkaha ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha loo qoondeeyay.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji duto e County mar Turkana ni koro ginyalo dhi e kambi mag thieth mag wang' kod lakteche mag laktech.

English: IEBC invites youth in Nairobi County to enroll for electrical installation training this April.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji umeme Aprili hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nairobi inay iska diiwaangeliyaan tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada bisha April.
Dholuo: IEBC gwelo rowere e County mar Nairobi mondo odonj e tiegruok mar keto sitima e dwe mar April.

English: To achieve mental health for those living with disabilites is of great importance. Now, do you know any person who needs counselling? Send an SMS to "support" to 20767 so that you can connect with a counsellor free of charge.
Kiswahili: Kufikia afya ya akili kwa wale wanaoishi na ulemavu ni muhimu sana. Sasa, je, unajua mtu yeyote ambaye anahitaji ushauri? Tuma SMS kwa "msaada" kwa 20767 ili uweze kuwasiliana na mshauri bila malipo.
Somali: Si loo gaaro caafimaadka maskaxda ee dadka naafada ah waa mid aad muhiim u ah. Hada, ma taqaan qof u baahan la-talin? u dir SMS "taageero" 20767 si aad ula xiriirto la-taliye lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Mondo joma nigi midekre obed gi ngima maber e pachgi, dwarore ahinya. Koro, be ing'eyo ng'ato ang'ata madwaro kony?

English: Notice: OGP launches the county integrated development plan in Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika wilaya ya Marsabit.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay bilawday qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Marsabit.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: OGP chako chenro mar dongruok e alwora mar Marsabit County.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free depression awareness support is available through county health facilities in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa uhamasishaji wa unyogovu unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay wacyiga niyadjabku laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Kisumu County.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar parruok yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth e gweng' mar Kisumu County.

English: Universities Fund reminds youth in Kericho County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xasuusinayaa dhalinyarada degmada Kericho in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa rowere man Kericho County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar chiemo kod mar rwako welo.

English: DCI reminds the public in Baringo County to remain vigilant on counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo kubaki macho juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Baringo in ay sii joogaan feejignaanta ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: DCI parone ji duto e County mar Baringo ni gibed motang' ne weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Notice: SHA opens a new service point for passport services in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: SHA inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Shirkadda SHA waxay furaysaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee Gobolka Mandera.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA oyawo kama itimee tije mag kawo kad e gweng' mar Mandera.

English: NCPB warns wheat farmers in Marsabit County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawaonya wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: NCPB waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda sarreenka ee degmada Marsabit cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: NCPB osiemo jopur mag ngano e county mar Marsabit kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: HELB urges youth in Vihiga County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: HELB waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Vihiga inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo rowere e County mar Vihiga mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gitimo gik ma biro timore ne oganda.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Red Cross will be held in Busia County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Busia Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Busia bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kamp mar thieth ma Kenya Red Cross ochano biro timore e taon mar Busia e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Tana River County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Wilaya ya Mto Tana mwezi huu Oktoba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ku saabsan dhismaha nabadda qaranka ee degmada Tana River bishii Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji (Communications Authority of Kenya) timo romo mar oganda e wi loso kuwe e piny mangima e taon mar Tana River County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone experiencing abuse in Tana River County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Wilaya ya Tana River kutafuta msaada katika nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Tana River inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e taon mar Tana River County mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya warns residents of Kajiado County about a rise in identity theft and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Kajiado County juu ya kuongezeka kwa wizi wa kitambulisho na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado kororka xadgudubka aqoonsiga waxayna kula talineysaa shacabka inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax falin.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Communications Authority chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kajiado County e wi medruok mar kuo mar ng'ato kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: Notice: KUCCPS opens applications for revision guides for learners in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay furaysaa codsiyada hagaha dib-u-eegista ardayda degmada Nakuru.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KUCCPS oyawo kwayo mag somo mondo okony jopuonjre e alwora mar Nakuru.

English: Notice: KEMSA confirms a measles outbreak alert for Samburu County. Residents are advised to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa surua kwa Kaunti ya Samburu. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMSA waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka suuxdinta ee Gobolka Samburu. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakhda leh.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KEMSA osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuwono e county mar Samburu.

English: NDMA urges residents of Kisumu County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay iskaashi la sameeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo jogweng' mar Kisumu County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'enyie nikech ji medo keto pachgi kuom weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Drought in Kenya: How the Kenya Cash Consortium is improving the well-being of affected families
Kiswahili: Ukame nchini Kenya: Jinsi Muungano wa Fedha wa Kenya unavyoboresha ustawi wa familia zilizoathirika
Somali: Abaaraha Kenya: Sida Ururka Lacagta Caashka ah ee Kenya uu u hagaajinayo fayoobaanta qoysaska ay dhibaatadu saameysey
Dholuo: Oro e piny Kenya: Kaka riwruok mar pesa ma Kenya kelo ber ne ngima mar joot ma oyudo masira

English: By contrast, in the drought-affected counties, body conditions were assessed to be poor in Mandera County and from poor to fair in Wajir, Garissa and Tana River counties, although aboveâ€‘average seasonal rains are supporting pasture and fodder regeneration, contributing to gradual improvements.
Kiswahili: Kinyume chake, katika kaunti zilizoathiriwa na ukame, hali ya mwili ilitathminiwa kuwa mbaya katika Kaunti ya Mandera na kutoka hali duni hadi ya haki katika kaunti za Wajir, Garissa na Tana River, ingawa mvua za msimu wa juu-wastani zinasaidia ufufuaji wa malisho na malisho, na kuchangia uboreshaji wa taratibu.
Somali: Taas bedelkeeda, degmooyinka ay abaartu saameysay, xaaladaha jirka waxaa lagu qiimeeyay inay liitaan Gobolka Mandheera iyo degmooyinka Wajeer, Garissa iyo Tana River oo liita, inkastoo roobab xilliyeed oo ka sarreeya celceliska ay taageerayaan dib u soo nooleynta daaqa iyo calafka, taasoo gacan ka geysaneysa horumarinta tartiib tartiib ah.
Dholuo: Ka ipimo, e gwenge ma ne oyudo oro, chal mar ringruok ne opim ni ok ber e gwenge mag Mandera kendo kowuok e gwenge ma ok beyo nyaka ma rach e gwenge mag Wajir, Garissa kod Aora Tana, kata obedo ni koth ma chwee e kinde mag higa ma ng’ato ka ng’ato nyalo bedogo, konyo e loso dongruok mogik.

English: IPOA reminds the public in Isiolo County to remain vigilant on border security.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya Isiolo kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Isiolo inay ka feejignaadaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa ji duto manie Isiolo County ni gibed motang' gi weche mag sirkal.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds voters in Mombasa County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha gobolka Mombasa inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya parone jogweng' Mombasa County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go ka gitiyo gi sms e simo mar 70000 kapok kinde mar yiero ochopo.

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages residents of Bungoma County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay uga qayb galaan kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Samburu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Samburu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2023
Somali: Degmada Samburu: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Samburu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2023

English: DCI urges the public in Busia County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: DCI inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Busia kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha degmada Busia inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo ji duto e County mar Busia mondo ochiw ripot ne jatendgi mar lendo kuom weche maok adier bang' yudo ripot mar ripot mag weche mag phishing.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa maelekezo ya makazi salama katika Wilaya ya Tana River.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa furaya xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya tixraacyo hoy amaan ah oo ku yaal degmada Tana River.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar weche motudore gi timbe mahundu chako tiyo gi ofis ma wuoyo e wi weche mag nindruok e taon mar Tana River County.

English: KEMRI advises residents of West Pokot County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMRI waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMRI nyiso jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo odonj e riwruok mar insuarans mar thieth mondo giyud thieth makonyogi.

English: Kajiado County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kajiado: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2023
Somali: Degmada Kajiado: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kajiado: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2023

English: Notice: AFA will conduct a greenhouse farming workshop for farmers in Vihiga County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itafanya warsha ya kilimo cha chafu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo ee beeraleyda degmada Vihiga bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: AFA biro timo chokruok mar timo tijno ne jopur e gweng' mar Vihiga e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Kenya: Heavy Rains and Flooding Update - Flash Update #3 (29 April 2024)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Mvua Kubwa na Taarifa ya Mafuriko - Sasisho la Flash #3 (29 Aprili 2024)
Somali: Kenya: Roobab Mahiigaan ah iyo Warbixin Daadad - Cusboonaysiinta Degdegga ah #3 (29 Abriil 2024)
Dholuo: Kenya: Koth Mapek kod Pi Opong'o Pi - Weche Mapiyo #3 (29 dwe mar ang'wen higa mar 2024)

English: New mothers are encouraged to discuss family planning options with health providers to allow proper spacing of pregnancies and ensure maternal recovery.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wapya wanahimizwa kujadili chaguzi za uzazi wa mpango na watoa huduma za afya ili kuruhusu nafasi nzuri ya ujauzito na kuhakikisha mama anaendelea kupona.
Somali: Hooyooyinka cusub waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka wada hadlaan fursadaha qorshaynta qoyska bixiyeyaasha caafimaadka si ay u oggolaadaan kala duwanaanshaha uurka si sax ah loona hubiyo soo kabashada hooyada.
Dholuo: Ijiwo mine manyien mondo owuo gi jothieth mag thieth e wi chenro mag ngima mar joot mondo omi gibed gi thuolo maber mar bedo gi ich kendo gibed gadier ni min-gi osechango.

English: Climate smart agriculture is a new approach aimed at increasing yields in a progressive wÃ y and have ideal harvests that are sustainable.
Kiswahili: Kilimo kiakili kwa ajili ya hali ya hewa ni mbinu mpya inayolenga kuongeza mavuno kwa njia ya maendeleo na kuwa na mavuno ya kimkakati ambayo ni endelevu.
Somali: Beeraha caqliga leh ee cimilada waa hab cusub oo loogu talagalay in lagu kordhiyo wax-soo-saarka wakhti horumarsan isla markaana la helo goosasho ku habboon oo waara.
Dholuo: Pur ma ng’ato nyalo ng’eyogo piny en yo manyien ma ochung’ne medo cham e yo ma dhi nyime kendo bedo gi cham maber ma nyalo sikon.

English: KICD announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in Migori County this February.
Kiswahili: KICD inatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Migori Februari hii.
Somali: KICD waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta deeqaha waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan dugsiyada degmada Migori bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: KICD ogolo chiwo mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre man gi chandruok e skunde man Migori County e dwe mar Februar.

English: Promote practices such as mulching and minimum tillage to maintain soil moisture, and promote the farming of drought-resistant crops such as millet and sorghum.
Kiswahili: Kuendeleza mazoea kama vile mulching na chini ya kulima ili kudumisha unyevu wa udongo, na kukuza kilimo cha mazao sugu na ukame kama vile millet na sorghum.
Somali: Waxay dhiirrigeliyaan dhaqamada sida mulching iyo beerista yaryar si loo ilaaliyo qoyaanka ciidda, iyo dhiirrigelinta beerista dalagyada u adkeysta abaaraha sida millet iyo sorghum.
Dholuo: Jiwo timbe kaka mag mulching kod timo tij pur matin mondo omi lowo obed gi muya, kendo jiwo pidho cham ma ok nyal yuso yiengni kaka millet kod sorghum.

English: KALRO encourages farmers in Bomet County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za mahindi.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Bomet inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay hadhuudhka.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e county mar Bomet mondo ous olembe mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo mondo omi olembe obed maber.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds parents in Nyeri County that school feeding programme registration is open this November.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba usajili wa mpango wa kulisha shule umefunguliwa Novemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xusuusinaya waalidiinta degmada Nyeri in diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga ay furan tahay bisha November.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne jonyuol e County mar Nyeri ni chenro mar kwayo nyithindo chiemo e skul osechakore e dwe mar Novemba.

English: NDMA reminds the public in Garissa County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Garissa in ay ka feejignaadaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: NDMA parone ji duto manie County mar Garissa ni gibed motang' gi gero kuwe e piny.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) calls on parents in Machakos County to have children under five screened for meningitis during the April outreach.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa ugonjwa wa uti wa mgongo wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Aprili.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Machakos in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro meningitis inta lagu jiro adeegga bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) kwayo jonyuol e County ma Machakos mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar April.

English: DCI alerts residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: DCI waxay uga digtay dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi in ay kordheen kiisaska jabsashada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County e wi medruok mar ketho odiechienge kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Notice: TVET opens a new catering and hospitality programme at the vocational centre in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET yafungua programu mpya ya upishi na ukarimu katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay ka furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan cuntada iyo marti-gelinta xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Nairobi.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET chako chenro manyien mar chiemo kod rwako welo e skul mar tiegruok e taon mar Nairobi.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations activates an emergency response plan for fire outbreaks in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa milipuko ya moto katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada ayaa soo saaray qorshe xaalad deg deg ah oo looga jawaabayo dabka ka kacay gobolka Nakuru.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Nonro Makelo Mahundu tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony mapiyo ne masiche mag mach e gweng' mar Nakuru.

English: Removing Red Tape to Get Kenyaâ€™s Refugee Act Right
Kiswahili: Kuondoa Mkanda Mwekundu ili Kupata Sheria ya Wakimbizi ya Kenya Sahihi
Somali: Ka saarista Cajaladda Cas si loo helo Sharciga Qaxootiga ee Kenya oo Sax ah
Dholuo: Ogolo Tape Makwar mondo oyud chik mar jolweny mag piny Kenya ma kare

English: Notice: FAO will distribute certified rice seed to farmers in Nyeri County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itasambaza mbegu za mpunga zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay abuurka bariiska ee shahaadada leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Nyeri bisha May.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: FAO biro pogo kodhi mag loso kodhi ne jopur man Nyeri County e dwe mar Mei.

English: TSC calls on the community in Nairobi County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TSC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TSC waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Nairobi inay la xiriirto khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116 si ay u ilaaliyaan amniga dugsiyada.
Dholuo: TSC okwayo ji duto manie County mar Nairobi mondo omany namba mar 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Kenya Dairy Board announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for goats in Murang'a County this February.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya yatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo kwa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Februari hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhawaaqay jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee riyaha ee Gobolka Murang'a bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board olando chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo e dwe mar Februar e kaunti mar Murang'a.

English: Kenya Dairy Board urges millet growers in Uasin Gishu County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kudhibiti minyoo mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda cawska ee gobolka Uasin Gishu inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka xilliga dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board ojiwo jopur mag millet e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e higa ka gitiyo gi tuoche mag thieth ma giyiego mondo okony e medo nyak mar yien e higani.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development invites farmers in Embu County to a free training on greenhouse farming this September.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo cha chafu Septemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Embu tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ogwelo jopur e county mar Embu e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar greenhouse agriculture e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties launches community-based development programmes in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inazindua mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed ayaa bilaabay barnaamijyo horumarineed oo ku salaysan bulshada ee degmada Nandi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties chako chenro mag dongruok e alwora mar Nandi County.

English: Kenya Dairy Board urges dairy cows farmers in Homa Bay County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawataka wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda lo'da caanaha ee gobolka Homa Bay inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha gobolka iyada oo aan la helin ruqsad ka dib kiisaska cudurka Anthrax ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur mag dhok ma loso dhok e Homa Bay County mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni e gweng'no maok giyudo rusa bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag anthrax.

English: Notice: KTDA will train farmers in Kwale County on conservation tillage this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale juu ya kilimo cha uhifadhi Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kwale ee ku saabsan beerashada ilaalinta Oktoobarkan.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA biro tiego jopur e Kaunti mar Kwale e wi puodho mar ritruok e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties advises residents of Kisumu County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e-Citizen.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Kisumu kula talinayaa inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan diiwaangelinta e-Citizen.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties nyiso jogweng' mar Kisumu County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro ndiko e-Citizen.

English: Do not download apps from random websites. Always use Google Play Store or Apple App Store. Unverified apps may contain malware.
Kiswahili: Usipakue programu kutoka kwa tovuti zisizo rasmi. Tumia Duka la Google Play au Duka la Programu la Apple kila wakati. Programu ambazo hazijathibitishwa zinaweza kuwa na programu hasidi.
Somali: Ha soo dejisan barnaamijyada mareegaha aan kala sooca lahayn. Had iyo jeer isticmaal Google Play Store ama Apple App Store. Barnaamijyada aan la xaqiijin waxaa ku jiri kara malware.
Dholuo: Okidwar ng’iewo program mag mbui e websait ma ok owinjore. Kinde duto ti kod duka mar Google kata duka mar app mag Apple. Program ma pok oyang’ nyalo bedo gi program ma okber.

English: Kenya: Registered refugees and asylum-seekers (as of 31 May 2024)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Wakimbizi waliosajiliwa na wanaotafuta hifadhi (kuanzia tarehe 31 Mei 2024)
Somali: Kenya: Qaxootiga diiwaangashan iyo kuwa magangalyo doonka ah (laga bilaabo 31 Maajo 2024)
Dholuo: Kenya: Jolweny ma ondiki nyinggi kod jogo madwaro dak (chakre tarik 31 dwe mar abich higa mar 2024)

English: Notice: NTSA launches a burglary prevention campaign in Garissa County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NTSA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Garissa Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga jabsashada Gobolka Garissa bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NTSA chako kampen mar geng'o mibadhi e gweng' mar Garissa e dwe mar Julai.

English: Council of Governors reminds the public in Vihiga County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay dadka degmada Vihiga ku xasuusinayaan in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch oparo ne ji e County mar Vihiga ni chiwo ripot mar kawo asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Kitui County that access to SHA registration is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba ufikiaji wa usajili wa SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Laanta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kitui in helitaanka diiwaangelinta SHA hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji duto e County mar Kitui ni koro ginyalo yudo weche mag SHA e kuonde moketi.

English: NDMA urges the public in Turkana County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Turkana wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: NDMA waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadweynaha degmada Turkana inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo ji duto e county mar Turkana mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo weche ma nyiso ni ne giyudo ote mag phishing.

English: We should adhere to the containment measures, which include washing of hands, wearing of face masks at all times, maintaining social & physical distance, & avoiding public gatherings, among others; Dr. Aman. #KomeshaCorona update.
Kiswahili: Tunapaswa kuzingatia hatua za kuzuia, ambazo ni pamoja na kuosha mikono, kuvaa barakoa wakati wote, kudumisha umbali wa kijamii na kimwili, na kuepuka mikusanyiko ya watu, miongoni mwa mengine; Dk Aman. #KomeshaCorona sasisho.
Somali: Waa inaan u hoggaansannaa tallaabooyinka xakamaynta, kuwaas oo ay ku jiraan dhaqidda gacmaha, xirashada maaskaro wejiga mar walba, ilaalinta kala fogaanshaha bulshada iyo jirka, iyo ka fogaanshaha isu imaatinka dadweynaha, iyo kuwa kale; Dr. Aman. #Warbixinta KomeshaCorona.
Dholuo: Owinjore waluw yore mag geng’o tuoche, ma oting’o lwoko lwedo, rwako mask mag wang’ kinde duto, rito thuolo e kind ji & ng’ato gi ng’ato, & weyo chokruok mag ji mang’eny, kod mamoko; Dokta Aman. #KomeshaKorona ma manyien.

English: DPP reminds mobile money users in Bomet County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Bomet wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka kashfa za fedha za simu.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Bomet inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qofna si looga fogaado khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: DPP paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mobil e County mar Bomet ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo kik gitim timbe mag wuondruok.

English: Announceent through SMS texts on foods and import, prepared specifically for young parents
Kiswahili: Tangazo kupitia maandishi ya SMS juu ya chakula na mauzo, iliyoandaliwa hasa kwa wazazi vijana
Somali: Warbixin ku saabsan cuntooyinka iyo soo dejinta, oo si gaar ah loogu diyaariyey waalidiinta yaryar
Dholuo: Joland wach kokalo kuom ote mag SMS e wi chiemo kod import, molos ne jonyuol ma rowere

English: Notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response confirms a Rift Valley Fever outbreak alert for Tharaka-Nithi County. Residents are advised to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa kwa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka baxsan faafitaanka Cudurka Rift Valley ee Degmada Tharaka-Nithi. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isticmaalaan shabaqa cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Rapar: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duoko ne Tuoche osenyiso ni Rift Valley Fever outbreak alert ne Tharaka-Nithi County.

English: CS Machogu lauds TVET CDACC for releasing CBET results.
Kiswahili: CS Machogu anapongeza CDACC ya TVET kwa kuchapisha matokeo ya CBET.
Somali: CS Machogu wuxuu bogaadiyaa TVET CDACC inay soo bandhigtay natiijooyinka CBET.
Dholuo: CS Machogu opwoyo CDACC mar TVET kuom chiwo nyak mag CBET.

English: Notice: NCPB will train farmers in Mombasa County on organic farming this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa juu ya kilimo hai Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda gobolka Mombasa ee beeraha dabiiciga ah bisha November.
Dholuo: Rapar: NCPB biro tiego jopur e County mar Mombasa e wi pur mar yien e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij lagu darayo ardayda naafada ah dugsiyada degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission of Teachers Service osechako chenro mar tiego nyithindo ma nigi midekre e skunde duto mag County mar Vihiga.

English: Ministry of Health appeals to caregivers in Siaya County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the September maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Siaya kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Septemba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Siaya inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health okwayo jorit e county mar Siaya mondo okel nyithindgi mondo gitim nonro e wi dongruok margi kaka achiel kuom chenro mar dwe mar Septemba mar weche thieth mar min.

English: Kenya confirms surge in Mpox cases, tally now at 137 with Busia, Mombasa and Nakuru counties leading with highest number of infections.
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha kuongezeka kwa visa vya Mpox, ambapo sasa vimefikia 137 huku kaunti za Busia, Mombasa na Nakuru zikiongoza kwa kuwa na idadi kubwa zaidi ya maambukizi.
Somali: Kenya waxay xaqiijineysaa kororka kiisaska Mpox, oo hadda gaaraya 137 iyadoo degmooyinka Busia, Mombasa iyo Nakuru ay hogaaminayaan tirada ugu badan ee cudurrada.
Dholuo: Kenya osenyiso ni ji mang'eny ma nigi Mpox osemedore, ka sani gichopo 137 gi county mag Busia, Mombasa kod Nakuru.

English: Use proper baby carriers to support baby's neck and hips. Always ensure baby's face is visible and uncovered.
Kiswahili: Tumia vifaa vya kubeba mtoto vinavyofaa ili kushikilia shingo na nyonga za mtoto. Hakikisha uso wa mtoto unaonekana na haujafunikwa.
Somali: Isticmaal qalabka ilmaha lagu qaado si aad u taageerto qoorta iyo miskaha ilmaha. Mar walba hubi in wejiga ilmaha la arki karo oo aan la dabooli karin.
Dholuo: Ti kod gik ma ng’ato nyalo ting’ogo nyithindo ma owinjore mondo orit ng’ut nyathi kod ng’ute. Kinde duto ne ni wang’ nyathi nenore kendo ok oumo.

English: Celebrate International Coffee Day on October 1st by supporting fair trade coffee and raising awareness of the challenges faced by coffee growers
Kiswahili: Sherehekea Siku ya Kimataifa ya Kahawa mnamo Oktoba 1 kwa kuunga mkono biashara ya haki kahawa na kuongeza ufahamu wa changamoto zinazowakabili wakulima wa kahawa.
Somali: U dabaaldeg Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Kafeega 1-da Oktoobar adigoo taageeraya kafeega ganacsiga cadaaladda ah iyo wacyiga ku saabsan caqabadaha ay wajahayaan beeraleyda qaxwaha
Dholuo: Rwakuru Odiechieng' Makende mar Coffee e Oktoba 1 kuom riwo lwedo ohala makare mar kofi kendo miyo jopur mag chai ong'e pek ma giromogo

English: All Grade 6 learners automatically placed in junior secondary Ã¢Â€Â“ no exam needed.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wote wa Darasa la 6 huwekwa kiotomatiki katika shule ya upili ya junior "hakuna mtihani unaohitajika.
Somali: Dhammaan ardayda fasalka 6aad si toos ah ayaa loogu darayaa dugsiga sare - imtixaan looma baahna.
Dholuo: Jopuonjre duto mag Kilasi mar 6 oketgi e sekondari matin Ã¢Â€Â“ onge penj ma dwarore.

English: NTSA urges motorists and pedestrians in Uasin Gishu County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka lugta leh ee ku nool gobolka Uasin Gishu inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay adeegsadaan meelaha lugta loo qoondeeyey si looga hortago shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo joidh mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu mondo oluw tong' mar wuoth kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe mondo gikwed hinyruok mag ndara.

English: State Department for Basic Education advises students in Nandi County to collect materials from the county education office to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nandi kukusanya vifaa kutoka kwa ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Somali: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Dowladda waxay ardayda degmada Nandi kula talineysaa inay ka soo ururiyaan agabyada xafiiska waxbarashada degmada si ay u helaan buugaagta waxbarasho iyo agab waxbarasho.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education nyiso jopuonjre e county mar Nandi mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar somo mar county mondo giyud buge mag somo kod gik mamoko ma ginyalo puonjore.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties warns public officers in Machakos County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Machakos dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa ka digaya saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Machakos khiyaanooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Machakos kuom timbe mag mibadhi.

English: CDC encourages mothers in Bomet County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Bomet kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Bomet inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo mine manie county mar Bomet mondo olimgi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: COMESA reminds residents of Kisumu County that conservation tillage improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba kilimo cha uhifadhi kinaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: COMESA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu in beerashada ilaalinta ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: COMESA paronwa jogweng'o mag Kisumu County ni chwoyo puothe mag choko puothe miyo puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: TVET announces distribution of revision guides to schools in Tana River County this November.
Kiswahili: TVET inatangaza usambazaji wa miongozo ya marekebisho kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Tana River Novemba hii.
Somali: TVET waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta hagaha dib u eegista dugsiyada degmada Tana River bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: TVET olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag somo e skunde man Tana River County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Public health advisory: KEMRI warns of increased measles risk in Turkana County and advises the public to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMRI inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya surua katika Kaunti ya Turkana na inashauri umma kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: KEMRI waxay ka digeysaa kororka halista ah ee suuxdinta ee degmada Turkana waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay dhammaystiraan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: KEMRI chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar nyol e county mar Turkana kendo ojiwo ji duto mondo otiek dose duto mag thieth ma gichiwo.

English: Notice: AFA will conduct a post-harvest handling workshop for farmers in Kwale County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi ka dib goosashada beeraleyda ee Gobolka Kwale bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: AFA biro timo chokruok mar timo nonro bang' keyo ne jopur e Kaunti mar Kwale e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) opens the electoral calendar centres in Kericho County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Kericho Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu furayaa xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee degmada Kericho bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e County mar Kericho e dwe mar Agost.

English: Kenya Dairy Board promotes soil conservation among farmers in Isiolo County as part of the July climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inakuza uhifadhi wa udongo miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Julai.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa ilaalinta ciidda beeraleyda degmada Isiolo iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee bisha July.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo rito lowo e kind jopur manie Isiolo County kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo kinda mar kedo gi kit yamo e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: AFA will conduct a post-harvest handling workshop for farmers in Meru County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itafanya warsha ya kushughulikia baada ya mavuno kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi ka dib goosashada beeraleyda degmada Meru bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Rapar: AFA biro timo tiegruok mar loso gik moko bang' keyo ne jopur e kaunti mar Meru e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds needy students in Migori County that free digital learning content applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Migori kwamba programu za bure za maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya ardayda u baahan degmada Migori in codsiyada barashada bilaashka ah ee barnaamijyada digital-ka ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne jopuonjre modhier e County mar Migori ni chenro mag somo mar digital maonge chudo chiegni rumo.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free youth mental wellness support is available through county health facilities in Narok County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa afya ya akili kwa vijana unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: KEMSA oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo ne rowere e weche thieth mar paro yudore maonge chudo kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Narok.

English: Kenya steps up national cholera preparedness and response
Kiswahili: Kenya yaongeza utayarishaji na mwitikio wa kipindupindu kitaifa
Somali: Kenya oo xoojinaysa diyaargarowga iyo ka hortagga cudurka daacuunka ee qaranka
Dholuo: Kenya omedo ikruok mar piny mangima kod duoko mar tuwo mar kolera

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds voters in Kitui County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kitui kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa xasuusinaya codbixiyayaasha degmada Kitui inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties parone jogweng'o e County mar Kitui mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero motelo ne kalenda mar yiero.

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Bomet County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma ya afya ya ruzuku.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health nyiso jogweng'o mag Bomet County mondo odonj e insuarans mar thieth mondo giyud thieth makonyogi yudo kony.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises milk producers in Siaya County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inashauri wazalishaji wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kula talineysaa soosaarayaasha caanaha ee degmada Siaya inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur mag chak e county mar Siaya mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur ma biro ka kinde keyo pok ochopo.

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will host a free hypertension awareness outreach in Kajiado County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Kajiado Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska Dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa qaban doonta wacyi-gelin bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cadaadiska dhiig karka ee degmada Kajiado bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo kampen mar konyo ji ng'eyo ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar hypertension maonge chudo e dwe mar Februar e Kajiado County.

English: Kenya Gazette updates residents of Kisii County on progress of community-based development programmes this September.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawasilisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii juu ya maendeleo ya programu za maendeleo ya jamii mwezi Septemba.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Kisii ka warbixiyaa horumarka barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada ee bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette osemiyo jogweng' Kisii ong'eyo dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag oganda e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Baringo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Baringo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Februari 2024
Somali: Degmada Baringo: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Baringo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2024

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds residents of Homa Bay County that water harvesting improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba uvunaji wa maji huboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay in goosashada biyaha ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development oparo ne jogweng' Homa Bay County ni choko pi miyo puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: Kenya aims to increase horticulture exports to Italy from 2 to 5 Farmers should explore opportunities to participate in this growth focusing on high demand products like Hass avocados
Kiswahili: Kenya inalenga kuongeza mauzo ya kilimo cha bustani hadi Italia kutoka 2 hadi 5 Wakulima wanapaswa kutafuta fursa za kushiriki katika ukuaji huu wakizingatia mahitaji ya juu ya bidhaa kama vile parachichi za Hass.
Somali: Kenya waxay ujeedkeedu yahay in ay kordhiso dhoofinta beeraha ee Talyaaniga 2 ilaa 5 Beeraleyda waa inay sahamin fursadaha ay ku qaybqaataan koritaankaas iyagoo diiradda saarey badeecooyinka baahida sare leh sida Hass avocados
Dholuo: Kenya dwaro medo ohala mar puodho mar puodho e piny Italy kochakore 2 nyaka 5 Jo-Purie onego onon thuolo mag bedo gi thuolo mar timo dongruok ma gineno ahinya gik ma dwarore ahinya kaka avocados mag Hass

English: The Ministry to fulfil its in reducing opoor eating habits in villages
Kiswahili: Wizara kutimiza wajibu wake katika kupunguza tabia mbaya ya kula katika vijiji
Somali: Wasaaraddu waxay fulinaysaa waajibaadkeeda yareynta caadooyinka cuntada ee tuulooyinka
Dholuo: Migawo mar lendo mondo ochop dwarone mar tieko timbe maricho mag chiemo e mier madongo

English: OGP reminds the public in Kirinyaga County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this February.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba ushiriki katika mashauriano ya sera za umma unakaribishwa Februari hii.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kirinyaga in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha lagu soo dhaweynayo bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: OGP oparo ne ji duto e County mar Kirinyaga ni paro ma ji chiwo e wi chenro mag sirkal en gima owinjore e dwe mar Februar.

English: KTDA urges coffee growers in Murang'a County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawataka wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Murang'a inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu talinayo roobka ka hor si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e County mar Murang'a mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue mondo okony e medo nyak mar koth e higani.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges the community in Nakuru County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb fraud.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu usiowajua ili kuzuia udanganyifu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Nakuru inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shisheeyaha si loo xakameeyo khiyaamooyinka.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo oganda man Nakuru County mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo gikwed mibadhi.

English: EACC invites residents of Homa Bay County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: EACC inakaribisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandaoni wa kaunti kuhusu ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: EACC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee gobolka ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: EACC gwelo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo oriwre kodgi e nono tich mitimo higa ka higa kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya launches community-based development programmes in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inazindua mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu bilaabay barnaamijyo horumarineed oo ku salaysan bulshada ee degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mag Kenya chako chenro mag dongruok e alwora mar Kisumu County.

English: NTSA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Machakos County that access to psychosocial support is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisaikolojia unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee Degmada Machakos in helitaanka taageerada cilmu-nafsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: NTSA parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e County ma Machakos ni thuolo mar yudo kony kuom weche mag pach ji yudore maonge chudo.

English: Teachers Service Commission calls on the community in Migori County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Migori kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa ugu baaqay bulshada Degmada Migori inay u soo sheegaan maamulka dugsiga wixii dhibaato ah ee ku saabsan amniga si ay dugsiyada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo ji duto manie County mar Migori mondo onyis sirkal mar skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: KEPHIS informs tea farmers in Kisumu County of new market linkage opportunities this May.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawafahamisha wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Mei hii.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Kisumu fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha May.
Dholuo: KEPHIS nyiso jopur mag chai e Kaunti mar Kisumu e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Mei.

English: Voicing Our Plight: Using Photovoice to Assess Perceptions of Mental Health Services for Survivors of Sexual Violence in Kenya
Kiswahili: Kueleza Shida Yetu: Kutumia Sauti ya Picha Kutathmini Maoni ya Huduma za Afya ya Akili kwa Waathiriwa wa Unyanyasaji wa Kijinsia nchini Kenya.
Somali: Ka hadalka xaaladdeenna: Isticmaalka Codka Sawirka si loo qiimeeyo aragtida adeegyada caafimaadka dhimirka ee dadka ka badbaaday rabshadaha galmada ee Kenya
Dholuo: Kuong’o Masira Marwa: Tiyo gi Picha mondo Ipim Kaka Ji Neno Tich mar Thieth mar Paro ne Joma Oyudo Okang’ mar Timbe mag Ndhiyo e piny Kenya

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds schools in Murang'a County to strengthen school infrastructure safety this March.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inazikumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuimarisha usalama wa miundombinu ya shule Machi hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka ayaa xusuusinaya dugsiyada degmada Murang'a inay xoojiyaan ammaanka kaabayaasha dugsiga bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne skunde manie County mar Murang'a mondo omed jiwo ritruok mar chenro mag skul e dwe mar Mach.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public in Bomet County about the importance of diabetes screening for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuhusu umuhimu wa uchunguzi wa kisukari kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay dadka degmada Bomet ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda baaritaanka sonkorowga ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji e county mar Bomet kuom ber mar nonro mar thieth mar sukari e ngima joot.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Meru County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa xasuusinaya dadweynaha in taageerada soo kabashada xadgudubka maandooriyaha ee bilaashka ah ay ka heli karto xarumaha caafimaadka degmada ee degmada Meru.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tiyo gi yedhe mamero yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Meru.

English: KUCCPS reminds youth in Kakamega County that HELB funding is available for welding and fabrication training.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kakamega in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista.
Dholuo: KUCCPS oparo ne rowere man Kakamega County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette opens voter education centres in Kakamega County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linafungua vituo vya elimu kwa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kakamega mwezi huu wa Oktoba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu furayaa xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee Gobolka Kakamega bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Gazette chako tiego josiasa e taon mar Kakamega e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Teachers Service Commission conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Migori County this October.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Migori Oktoba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu qabtaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada ee Degmada Migori bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission otimo chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda e dwe mar Oktoba e kaunti mar Migori.

English: Lamu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Lamu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Mei 2024
Somali: Degmada Lamu: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Lamu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar abich higa mar 2024

English: Council of Governors announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku dhawaaqeen waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch ogolo lokruok e seche mag kwayo mar yudo ID e gweng' mar Kisumu.
