English: Notice: IPOA launches a theft prevention campaign in Garissa County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Garissa Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada Gobolka Garissa bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: IPOA chako kampen mar geng'o kuo e taon mar Garissa e dwe mar Jun.

English: When raising goats: let them graze/browse freely rather than keeping them indoors, feed them three times daily with water always available, separate unhealthy goats from healthy ones, only breed goats when protein-rich feed is plentiful, and make sure newborn kids suckle colostrum for 20-30 minutes after birth.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa kufuga mbuzi: waache walishe/wavinjari kwa uhuru badala ya kuwaweka ndani ya nyumba, walishe mara tatu kila siku na maji yanapatikana kila wakati, tenganisha mbuzi wasio na afya kutoka kwa wenye afya, fuga mbuzi tu wakati malisho yenye protini ni nyingi, na uhakikishe watoto wachanga wananyonya kolostramu kwa dakika 20-30 baada ya kuzaliwa.
Somali: Marka la korinayo riyaha: u ogolow inay si xor ah u daaqsadaan/ku dhex dhex socdaan halkii ay guriga ku hayn lahaayeen, saddex jeer maalintii biyaha mar walba la heli karo, ri'da aan caafimaadka qabin kala sooc ri'da aan caafimaadka qabin iyo kuwa caafimaadka qaba, kaliya tarma riyaha marka cunto borotiin badan ay jirto, hubi in carruurta cusub ay nuujiyaan colostrum 20-30 daqiiqo kadib dhalashada.
Dholuo: Sama ipidho diek: wegi gicham le mag dhok ma ok giyiengni, miygi pi adek e odiechieng' kodiechieng' ka giyieng'o pi mapile, pog diek ma ok ler gi diek ma ngima, pidhi diek mana ka chiemo mopong' gi protein e iye, kendo rit ni nyithindo ma eka oa nyuol omodho colostrum kuom dakika 20-30 bang' nyuol.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Tharaka-Nithi County about the importance of hand hygiene for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya umuhimu wa usafi wa mikono kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay dadka degmada Tharaka-Nithi ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda nadaafadda gacmaha ay u leedahay caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne ji e Tharaka-Nithi County kuom ber mar rito ler mar lwedo e ngima joot.

English: We urge wananchi to report any person asking for 'expedited NHIF services' in exchange for cash. NHIF does not charge for processing.
Kiswahili: Tunawasihi wananchi kumripoti mtu yeyote anayeomba 'huduma za NHIF za haraka' badala ya pesa taslimu. NHIF haitozi malipo kwa ajili ya usindikaji.
Somali: Waxaan ku boorinaynaa dadka doonaya inay soo sheegaan qof kasta oo weydiista 'adeegyada degdegga ah ee NHIF' si loogu beddelo lacag caddaan ah. NHIF lacag kama qaado habaynta.
Dholuo: Wakwayo wananchi mondo ogol ripot kuom ng’ato ang’ata ma okwayo ‘tich mapiyo mar NHIF’ ka omiye pesa. NHIF ok chul pesa mar timo gik moko.

English: Universities Fund reminds needy students in Busia County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba vitabu vya kiada na matumizi ya vifaa vya kujifunzia hufungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xasuusinayaa ardayda u baahan degmada Busia in buugaagta waxbarasho iyo codsiyada qalabka waxbarasho ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa jopuonjre man Busia County ni buk mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok biro rumo machiegni.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya calls on the community in Tana River County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaalika jumuiya katika Wilaya ya Tana River kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Tana River County inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wacayaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto manie Tana River County mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong simo mar GBV 1195.

English: Child trafficking and unsafe migration between Kenya and Ethiopia: Transforming social norms and strengthening child protection in Marsabit
Kiswahili: Usafirishaji haramu wa watoto na uhamiaji usio salama kati ya Kenya na Ethiopia: Kubadilisha kanuni za kijamii na kuimarisha ulinzi wa watoto huko Marsabit
Somali: Ka ganacsiga carruurta iyo socdaalka aan amniga ahayn ee u dhexeeya Kenya iyo Itoobiya: Beddelidda caadooyinka bulshada iyo xoojinta ilaalinta carruurta ee Marsabit
Dholuo: Olos nyithindo kod wuotho ​​e pinje mamoko ma ok arita e kind piny Kenya kod Ethiopia: Loko yore mag oganda kendo jiwo arita mar nyithindo e piny Marsabit

Kiswahili: TSC hulipa Januari hadi Machi 2026 mshahara wa mapema kwa hundi ya benki ya Desemba 20!

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on residents of Kitui County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaomba wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kitui kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ku baaqayaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga si ay u taageeraan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service kwayo jogweng'o mag Kitui County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal mag ritruok ni gitimo gik maok kare e alwora mar tong'gi mondo okonygi gi chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne joma odak e alworano.

English: Ministry of Education advises students in Tharaka-Nithi County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza dijitali.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ardayda Degmada Tharaka-Nithi ku talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan waxyaabaha barashada ee bilaashka ah ee dijitaalka ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education ojiwo jopuonjre e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo okonygi kokalo kuom websait mar somo mar intanet mondo giyud thuolo mar somo weche mag digital maonge chudo.

English: DCI urges residents of Nyandarua County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: DCI inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gweng'no e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi kuom rito tong'.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: free antenatal care clinics will run every March at designated health centres in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi: kliniki za bure za huduma ya ujauzito zitaendeshwa kila mwezi Machi katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka: rugaha daryeelka dhalmada ee bilaashka ah ayaa bilaaban doona Maarso kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Nyamira.
Dholuo: Rieko moa e Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: Klinike mag rito nyithindo kapok ginyuol biro tiyo dwe mar Mach higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Nyamira.

English: Universities Fund invites youth in Kericho County to enroll for ICT skills training this November.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kericho kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT Novemba hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku casuumay dhalinyarada degmada Kericho inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka xirfadaha ICT bisha November.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund gwelo rowere man Kericho County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar ICT e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Health CS Mutahi Kagwe says total lockdown on the table if coronavirus cases escalate, urges Kenyans to limit social interactions.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Afya Mutahi Kagwe anasema amri ya kutotoka nje ikiwa visa vya virusi vya corona vitaongezeka, anawahimiza Wakenya kupunguza mwingiliano wa kijamii.
Somali: CS Caafimaadka Mutahi Kagwe ayaa sheegay in xiritaanka guud ee miiska haddii kiisaska coronavirus ay sii kordhaan, wuxuu ugu baaqay dadka Kenya inay xaddidaan isdhexgalka bulshada.
Dholuo: CS Health Mutahi Kagwe wacho ni kwan mar ji duto ma nigi tuo mar Corona ok nyal chung', kendo ojiwo jo Kenya mondo ogeng' tudruok margi gi jowetegi.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds parents in Mombasa County that adult literacy classes registration is open this January.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba usajili wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima umefunguliwa Januari hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu xasuusinayaa waalidiinta degmada Mombasa in diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ay furan tahay bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne jonyuol man Mombasa County ni ikruok mar somo mar jomatindo osechakore e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ee Gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi weche siasa e County mar Lamu.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Baringo County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Baringo Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa degmada Baringo bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: Kenya Gazette chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Baringo e dwe mar Desemba.

English: nairobi County will issue food during day time every day to 400 students by following new data to reduce hunger and to help farmers
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Nairobi itatoa chakula wakati wa mchana kila siku kwa wanafunzi 400 kwa kufuata data mpya ili kupunguza njaa na kuwasaidia wakulima
Somali: Nairobi County waxay maalin kasta cunto siin doontaa 400 arday maalintii iyadoo la raacayo xog cusub si loo yareeyo gaajada loona caawiyo beeraleyda
Dholuo: Nairobi County biro chiwo chiemo e odiechieng' ne jopuonjre 400 pile ka pile kuom luwo weche manyien mag chiemo mondo okony jopur

English: Farmers in Uasin Gishu Elgeyo Marakwet Bomet Nyandarua Nyeri and Taita Taveta can access 25 tons of free potato basic seed to produce certified seed
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Uasin Gishu Elgeyo Marakwet Bomet Nyandarua Nyeri na Taita Taveta wanaweza kupata tani 25 za mbegu za msingi za viazi ili kuzalisha mbegu zilizoidhinishwa.
Somali: Beeraleyda ku sugan Uasin Gishu, Elgeyo, Marakwet, Bomet, Nyandarua, Nyeri iyo Taita Taveta waxay heli karaan 25 tan oo abuur baradho ah oo bilaash ah si ay u soo saaraan abuur shahaado leh
Dholuo: Jo-Purie ma odak e Uasin Gishu Elgeyo Marakwet Bomet Nyandarua Nyeri kod Taita Taveta nyalo yudo tong' 25 mag kodhi mapile mag olemo mar olemo mar otese maonge chudo mondo gichopgo kodhi ma osenyisore

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMSA will be held in Nairobi County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu bila malipo iliyoandaliwa na KEMSA itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay KEMSA ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Nairobi bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni kambi mar thieth ma KEMSA ochano ibiro tim Nairobi County e dwe mar Mei.

English: KTDA announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for goats in Kakamega County this September.
Kiswahili: KTDA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Septemba hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo bilaash ah oo cudurka Newcastle ah oo loogu talagalay riyaha Gobolka Kakamega bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: KTDA olando chenro mar thieth mar tuo mar Newcastle ne diek maonge chudo e gweng' mar Kakamega e dwe mar Septemba.

English: DCI warns residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya kuongezeka kwa kashfa za pesa za rununu na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: DCI waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in ay kordheen khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County e wi medruok mar timbe mag wuondruok gi pesa mitimo e simo kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok kare ne jatendgi.

English: KEPHIS urges farmers in Kwale County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kwale inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo lagu soo ururiyo biyaha beeraha si ay ula qabsadaan isbedelka roobabka roobka.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e county mar Kwale mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok e kaka koth chue.

English: Take a deep breath and relax. Listen to your body. If you_x0092_re really tired, give yourself time to sleep. Without good sleep, our mental health suffers and our concentration goes downhill. Sometimes the world can wait.
Kiswahili: Chukua pumzi ya kina na kupumzika. Sikiliza mwili wako. Kama wewe ni kweli uchovu, kutoa mwenyewe muda wa kulala. bila usingizi mzuri, afya yetu ya akili inateseka na mkusanyiko wetu hupungua. Wakati mwingine ulimwengu unaweza kusubiri.
Somali: Neef qoto dheer qaado oo naso. Dhageyso jirkaaga. Haddii aad_x0092_aad daalan tahay, naftaada sii waqti aad ku seexato. Haddii aadan hurdo fiican haysan, caafimaadka maskaxdeenna ayaa xumaada, feejignaanteenuna hoos ayay u dhacdaa. Mararka qaar adduunku wuu sugi karaa.
Dholuo: Ywa muya matut kendo ibed gi mor. Winj kaka ringreni winjo. Kapo ni iol ahinya, miyi thuolo mar nindo. Ka ok wanindo maber, paro ma wan-go bedo marach kendo ok wanyal keto pachwa kuom gik moko. Seche moko piny nyalo rito.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations opens a gender desk offering free legal aid in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisheria bure katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa furaya xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah degmada Nakuru.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Directorate of Criminal Investigations ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony mar chike maonge chudo e gweng' mar Nakuru.

English: KMTC urges youth in Migori County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Migori kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Migori inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KMTC jiwo rowere e County mar Migori mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok ochopo tije mag oganda mabiro.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Kericho County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba ufikiaji wa usaidizi wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kericho in helitaanka taageerada sheegashada NHIF/SHA ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMSA oparo ne ji duto manie County mar Kericho ni koro ginyalo yudo kony mar kwayo mag NHIF/SHA e kuonde moyier.

English: SHA urges residents of Homa Bay County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on community-based development programmes.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Homa Bay kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waendelee kuwa na habari juu ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay la xiriiraan maamulaha qaybta maxalliga ah si ay uga warqabaan barnaamijyada horumarinta ee ku saleysan bulshada.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jotelo mag utegi mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi chenro mag dongruok mag oganda.

English: KMTC advises applicants in Kwale County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Kwale kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KMTC waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Kwale inay dalbadaan booska TVET iyada oo loo marayo KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: KMTC nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Kwale mondo oketgi e tich mar TVET kokalo kuom KUCCPS.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds mobile money users in Trans Nzoia County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa fedha za simu.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Trans Nzoia inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia ni mondo ginyis joritgi weche maok adier mondo kik gitim mibadhi mar pesa mag simu.

English: KICD reminds needy students in Vihiga County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba vitabu vya kiada na matumizi ya vifaa vya kujifunzia vitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Vihiga in buugaagta waxbarasho iyo codsiyada qalabka waxbarasho ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: KICD parone jopuonjre man gi chan e County mar Vihiga ni buge mag somo kod weche mag puonjruok biro rumo machiegni.

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of Machakos County to prepare for possible drought this July.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kujiandaa kwa ukame unaowezekana Julai hii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay isu diyaariyaan abaaraha iman kara bisha July.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross osiemo jogweng' ma Machakos County mondo oikre ne oro ma nyalo betie e dwe mar Julai.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds needy students in Kakamega County that school laptops under the digital literacy programme applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya maombi ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika za kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya ardayda u baahan degmada Kakamega in laptop-yada dugsiga ee barnaamijka codsiyada akhriska dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne jopuonjre modhier e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni kompyuta mag skul manie bwo program mar somo gi somo mar digital biro rumo machiegni.

English: Partner involvement during antenatal and postnatal care improves family health outcomes.
Kiswahili: Ushiriki wa mshirika wakati wa utunzaji wa ujauzito na baada ya kujifungua huboresha matokeo ya afya ya familia.
Somali: Ka qaybgalka lammaanaha inta lagu jiro daryeelka kahor iyo ka dib dhalashada waxay hagaajineysaa natiijooyinka caafimaadka qoyska.
Dholuo: Bedo gi osiepe e kinde mag rito nyathi kapok onyuolo koda bang' nyuolo miyo ngima joot bedo maber.

English: Notice: NPS opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa marejeleo salama ya makazi katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya tixraacyo hoy amaan ah oo ku yaal degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NPS ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kuonde dak e alwora mar Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges cattle farmers in Homa Bay County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za ugonjwa wa ngozi ya uvimbe.
Somali: Guddiga xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda xoolaha ee gobolka Homa Bay inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanada buka xafiiska xayawaanka ugu dhow kadib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur mag jamni e Homa Bay County mondo onyis jatuo matuwo e ofis mar thieth machiegni kodgi bang' ka osenyis ni gin gi tuoche mang'eny.

English: Research Terms of Reference: Baseline, Midline, and endline assessments for the Kenya Cash Consortium response to the unregistered refugees in Dadaab refugee camps, KEN2203 (May 2022, V1)
Kiswahili: Masharti ya Marejeleo ya Utafiti: Tathmini za Msingi, Mstari wa kati, na mwisho wa Muungano wa Kenya Cash Consortium kwa wakimbizi ambao hawajasajiliwa katika kambi za wakimbizi za Dadaab, KEN2203 (Mei 2022, V1)
Somali: Shuruudaha Cilmi-baarista: Qiimaynta Aasaaska, Khadka Dhexe, iyo dhammaadka ee jawaabta Ururka Lacagta Caddaan ee Kenya ee qaxootiga aan diiwaangashanayn ee xeryaha qaxootiga ee Dhadhaab, KEN2203 (Maajo 2022, V1)

English: KALRO urges dairy cows farmers in Migori County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported foot and mouth disease cases.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawataka wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Migori kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Migori inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyada oo aan la helin ruqsad ka dib kiisaska cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: KALRO ojiwo jopur mag dhok mag chak e county mar Migori mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni e tong county maok giyudo rusa bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag dhoot.

English: Heavy rainfall has been affecting a number of counties of Kenya since 21 April, causing rivers to overflow (particularly the Tana river).
Kiswahili: Mvua kubwa imekuwa ikiathiri kaunti kadhaa za Kenya tangu tarehe 21 Aprili, na kusababisha mito kufurika (haswa mto Tana).
Somali: Roobab xooggan ayaa saameeyay dhowr degmo oo Kenya ah tan iyo 21-kii Abriil, taasoo keentay in webiyadu ay buux dhaafaan (gaar ahaan webiga Tana).
Dholuo: Koth mang’eny osebedo ka mulo gwenge mang’eny e piny Kenya chakre tarik 21 dwe mar ang’wen, kendo osemiyo aora opong’o (ahinya ahinya aora Tana).

English: KEMRI advises residents of Kwale County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: KEMRI waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada la hortagi karo.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng' Kwale County mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth mar oganda ma onge chudo mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service invites farmers in Taita-Taveta County to a free training on modern irrigation techniques this March.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kwa mafunzo ya bure juu ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji Machi hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku casuumay beeraleyda Gobolka Taita-Taveta tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan farsamooyinka waraabinta casriga ah bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service ogwelo jopur e Taita-Taveta County e tiegruok maonge chudo e wi yore mag lero pi e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: NCPB will train farmers in Nairobi County on organic farming this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi juu ya kilimo hai Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Nairobi ee beeraha dabiiciga ah bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NCPB biro tiego jopur e County mar Nairobi e wi pur mar yien e dwe mar Mach.

English: Farmers affected by maize lethal necrosis disease MLND in Bomet County are encouraged to seek information on crop rotation and planting in new areas to prevent further losses
Kiswahili: Wakulima walioathiriwa na ugonjwa wa mahindi lethal necrosis MLND katika Kaunti ya Bomet wanahimizwa kutafuta habari kuhusu mzunguko wa mazao na upandaji katika maeneo mapya ili kuzuia hasara zaidi.
Somali: Beeraleyda ay saameeyeen cudurka dhimashada galleyda MLND ee Gobolka Bomet waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay raadiyaan macluumaad ku saabsan wareegga dalagyada iyo beerista meelaha cusub si looga hortago khasaare dheeraad ah
Dholuo: Jo-Purchasers ma nigi tuo mar nekrosis mar kodhi e gweng' mar Bomet, ijiwo mondo omany weche e wi kaka cham biro lokore kendo gipidho kuonde manyien mondo kik kethgi

English: Nationwide campaign to deliver Vitamin A to children under 5 and coordinate with routine immunization services.
Kiswahili: Kampeni ya kitaifa ya kutoa VitaminiA kwa watoto walio chini ya miaka 5 na kuratibu huduma za kawaida za chanjo.
Somali: Olole caalami ah oo loogu talagalay bixinta Vitamin A carruurta da'doodu ka yar tahay 5 sano iyo isku xirka adeegyada tallaalka caadiga ah.
Dholuo: Lendo e piny mangima mar chiwo vitamin A ne nyithindo ma johigni 5 gi matin kendo riwo lwedo tije mag thiedho nyithindo.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette opens polling procedures centres in Makueni County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Makueni Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Kenya Gazette waxay furaysaa xarumaha nidaamyada codbixinta ee degmada Makueni bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Gazette chako tiyo gi kuonde ma itimoe yiero e kaunti mar Makueni e dwe mar Agost.

English: Mothers and newborns should attend postnatal check-ups within 48 hours after birth to detect any complications and promote healthy recovery.
Kiswahili: Akina mama na watoto wachanga wanapaswa kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa baada ya kujifungua ndani ya saa 48 baada ya kujifungua ili kugundua matatizo yoyote na kukuza afya njema.
Somali: Hooyooyinka iyo dhallaanka cusub waa inay ka qeybgalaan baaritaano dhalashada kadib 48 saacadood ka dib dhalashada si loo ogaado wax dhibaato ah loona horumariyo soo kabashada caafimaad.
Dholuo: Min ji kod nyithindo mayom onego otim nonro bang' nyuol bang' seche 48 bang ' nyuolgi mondo gine ka nitie chandruok moro amora kendo gitim nonro maber.

English: DCI warns residents of Taita-Taveta County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaonya wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta juu ya kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: DCI waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Taita-Taveta in ay kordhaan qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne jogweng' Taita-Taveta County e wi medruok mar chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok kare ne jatendgi.

English: Ministry of Health launches a March awareness campaign on food safety across Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Machi juu ya usalama wa chakula katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed oo ku saabsan badbaadada cuntada bishii Maarso ee degmada Laikipia.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health osechako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Mach e wi wach ritruok mar chiemo e County duto mar Laikipia.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board restricts movement of goats in Tharaka-Nithi County due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya yazuia harakati za mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Newcastle.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa riyaha ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi sababtuna tahay cudurka Newcastle.
Dholuo: Rapar: Kenya Dairy Board ogeng'o wuoth mar diek e Tharaka-Nithi County nikech tuo mar Newcastle.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will distribute certified sweet potatoes seed to farmers in Machakos County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itasambaza mbegu za viazi vitamu zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay abuurka baradho macaan oo shahaado leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda Degmada Machakos bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Rieko: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro pogo kodhi mag sweet potato ne jopur e County ma Machakos e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Maximize your returns from beans by understanding market demands, reducing post-harvest losses, and exploring value addition opportunities.
Kiswahili: Ongeza faida yako kutokana na maharagwe kwa kuelewa mahitaji ya soko, kupunguza hasara baada ya mavuno, na kuchunguza fursa za kuongeza thamani.
Somali: Kordhi faa'iidooyinka aad ka hesho digirta adoo fahmaya baahida suuqa, yareynta khasaaraha goosashada kadib, iyo sahaminta fursadaha qiimaha lagu daro.
Dholuo: Meduru yudo nyak maber kuom chamo cham kuom ng'eyo dwaro mag ohala, kuom dwoko chien gik ma ne olal bang' keyo, kendo kuom nono thuolo ma ne inyalo bedogo mar medo nengo.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free Rift Valley Fever screening is available at all public health centres in Meru County this November.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Meru Novemba hii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka Cudurka Rift Valley ee lacag la'aanta ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka guud ee degmada Meru bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji ni nonro mar Rift Valley Fever maonge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Meru e dwe mar Novemba.

English: National Drought Early Warning Bulletin (May 2023)
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Tahadhari ya Mapema ya Kitaifa (Mei 2023)
Somali: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Qaranka (Maajo 2023)
Dholuo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro (Mei 2023)

English: New mothers experiencing sadness, withdrawal, or hopelessness should seek mental health support. Postpartum depression is treatable.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wapya wanaopitia huzuni, kujitenga, au kukata tamaa wanapaswa kutafuta msaada wa afya ya akili. Mfadhaiko baada ya kujifungua unaweza kutibiwa.
Somali: Hooyooyinka cusub ee caloolxumo la kulma, oo ka baxsan, ama rajo la'aan ah waxay u baahan yihiin inay raadsadaan taageero caafimaad maskaxeed.
Dholuo: Min nyithindo mapok onyuol, ma chunygi onyosore, kata ma chunygi ool, onego omany kony mar rito pachgi.

English: KICD advises applicants in Nakuru County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KICD inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KICD waxay ku talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Nakuru inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee la heli karo.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: KEMSA launches a November awareness campaign on food safety across Bomet County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Novemba juu ya usalama wa chakula katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: KEMSA waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii November oo ku saabsan amniga cuntada ee gobolka Bomet.
Dholuo: KEMSA chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Novemba e wi wach rito ngima mar chiemo e County duto mar Bomet.

English: Seasonal gains in water and pasture are uneven and shortâ€‘lived, while depleted herds, high food prices, and reduced assistance continue to push vulnerable households toward irreversible losses.

Kiswahili: IPOA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: IPOA waxay ka digtay dadka deggan degmada Turkana in ay kordheen kiisaska tuugada waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: IPOA chiwo siem ne jogweng' County mar Turkana ni kwan mag joma oketho odong' ka medore kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot e stesen mar polise man machiegni.

English: By paying attention to those around you, you might save a life! Prioritising mental health in the workplace is just as crucial for those working from home. Mental health challenges can affect anyone; they don't discriminate. Wherever you are working from, taking care of your mental health can improve your productivity and overall happiness. LetÂ’s break the stigma and make mental health a priority!
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwajali wale walio karibu nawe, unaweza kuokoa maisha! Kuweka kipaumbele katika afya ya akili mahali pa kazi ni muhimu vile vile kwa wale wanaofanya kazi kutoka nyumbani. Changamoto za afya ya akili zinaweza kumathiri mtu yeyote; hazibagui. Popote unapofanyia kazi, kutunza afya yako ya akili kunaweza kuboresha uzalishaji wako na furaha yako kwa ujumla. Tuvunje unyanyapaa na tufanye afya ya akili kuwa kipaumbele!
Somali: Markaad fiiro gaar ah u yeelato kuwa kugu xeeran, waxaad badbaadin kartaa nolol! Mudnaanta caafimaadka maskaxda ee goobta shaqada waa mid aad muhiim ugu ah kuwa ka shaqeeya guriga. Caqabadaha caafimaadka maskaxdu waxay saameyn karaan qof kasta; ma takooraan. Meel kasta oo aad ka shaqaynayso, daryeelka caafimaadkaaga maskaxeed waxay hagaajin kartaa wax soo saarkaaga iyo farxaddaada guud. Aan jebinno ceebta oo aan caafimaadka maskaxda ka dhigno mid mudnaan leh!
Dholuo: Ka iketo pach kuom joma ni machiegni kodi, inyalo reso ngima ng’ato! Keto ngima mar paro mokuongo e kar tich en gima duong’ mana kaka ne joma tiyo ka gin ot. Gik ma kelo pek mag paro nyalo mako ng’ato ang’ata; ok gibed gi pogruok. Kamoro amora ma itiyoe, rito ngimani mar paro nyalo miyo ibed gi tich maber kendo ibed gi mor duto. Waketh ng’anjo ma ji ng’ado kendo waket ngima mar paro obed gima duong’!

English: AFA invites farmers in Kiambu County to a free training on pest and disease management this March.
Kiswahili: AFA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kupata mafunzo ya bure juu ya udhibiti wa wadudu na magonjwa Machi hii.
Somali: AFA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Kiambu tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan xakamaynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: AFA ogwelo jopur e County mar Kiambu e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar tuoche kod tuoche e dwe mar Mach.

English: Public notice: KEMRI will host a free diabetes screening outreach in Marsabit County this September.
Kiswahili: Notisi kwa umma: KEMRI itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uchunguzi wa kisukari bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: KEMRI waxay martigelin doontaa baaritaan bukaan-socodka oo bilaash ah oo lagu ogaanayo cudurka macaanka ee degmada Marsabit bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMRI biro timo kampen mar nono tuo mar sukari maonge chudo e taon mar Marsabit e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds farmers in Makueni County of the ongoing greenhouse farming training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kilimo cha chafu.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa xusuusinaya beeraleyda degmada Makueni barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jopur e gweng' mar Makueni chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar timo pur.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Machakos County to prepare for possible landslides this September.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa maporomoko ya ardhi Septemba hii.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ka digaya dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay u diyaar garoobaan dhulgariir dhici kara bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations osiemo jogweng'o mag County ma Machakos mondo oikre ne yiengni mag lowo mabiro timore e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: nutrition supplementation for infants clinics will run every December at designated health centres in West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi: nyongeza ya lishe kwa kliniki za watoto wachanga itaendeshwa kila Desemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka: Kordhinta nafaqada ee dhallaanka ee xarumaha caafimaad ee lagu magacaabo Galbeedka Pokot County ayaa la qaban doonaa bishii Diseembar ee sannad kasta.
Dholuo: Rieko moa kuom Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: chiemo moromo mag nyithindo matindo biro dhi nyime e klinik dwe mar Desemba higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e West Pokot County.

English: DCI reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Turkana County that access to psychosocial support is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisaikolojia unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee degmada Turkana in helitaanka taageerada cilmu-nafsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: DCI parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Turkana ni ginyalo yudo kony mar paro maonge chudo.

English: A motherÂ’s diet during pregnancy influences her childÂ’s long-term health. Eat diverse, nutritious foods.
Kiswahili: Lishe ya mama wakati wa ujauzito huathiri afya ya muda mrefu ya mtoto wake. Kula vyakula mbalimbali vyenye lishe.
Somali: Cuntada hooyada xilliga uurka waxay saameyn ku leedahay caafimaadka ilmaha ee muddada dheer. Cun cuntooyin kala duwan oo nafaqo leh.
Dholuo: Chiemo ma min chamo e kinde ma en gi ich, mulo ngima mar nyathine kuom kinde malach. Cham chiemo mopogore opogore kendo ma nigi gik ma konyo ringruok.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Bomet County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuhudhuria kikao cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii bila malipo.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Bomet inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e gweng' mar Bomet County mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa kurejesha matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageerada soo kabashada xadgudubka maandooriyaha ee bilaashka ah ay ka heli karto xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada ee Degmada Tharaka-Nithi.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tiyo gi yedhe mamero yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e County mar Tharaka-Nithi.

English: Best farming practices aimed at reducing effects on climate change (CSL) and thereby increasing livestock yields and best environment use.
Kiswahili: Mazoezi bora ya kilimo yaliyolenga kupunguza athari za mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa (CSL) na hivyo kuongeza mavuno ya mifugo na matumizi bora ya mazingira.
Somali: Hababka ugu wanaagsan ee beeraha ee lagu yareeyo saameynta isbeddelka cimilada (CSL) iyo sidaas darteed kor u qaadista wax soo saarka xoolaha iyo isticmaalka deegaanka ee ugu fiican.
Dholuo: Tiego dhok e dhok ma ji ohero ahinya, kendo timo kamano miyo ji bedo gi mor kod chuny mar winjo tiend weche manie Muma.

English: The Lands and Environment Court at Nyeri will remain closed as from 24 Agust to 7 september 2020 after 2 patients of Covid 19 were detected, to allow fumification and indoor protocols continues. Certificates are not processed this time. Cour will comense their sessions through zoom asa fronm September 21, when this sessions will start as will be guided by the Chief magistrates, strating from October.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya ardhi na mazingira huko Nyeri itaendelea kufungwa kuanzia Agosti 24 hadi Septemba 7, 2020 baada ya wagonjwa 2 wa Covid 19 kugunduliwa, kuruhusu fumification na itifaki za ndani kuendelea. Vyeti havitashughulikiwa wakati huu. Mahakama itaanza vikao vyao kupitia zoom as kabla ya Septemba 21, wakati vikao hivi vitaanza kama itakavyoongozwa na mahakimu wakuu, kuanzia Oktoba.
Somali: Maxkamadda Dhulka iyo Deegaanka ee Nyeri waxay xirnaan doontaa laga bilaabo Ogosto 24 illaa Sebtember 7, 2020 ka dib markii 2 bukaan oo COVID-19 ah la ogaaday, si loo oggolaado foomaynta iyo nidaamyada gudaha inay sii socdaan. Shahaadooyinka looma farsameeyo markan. Maxkamaddu waxay ku bilaabi doontaa kalfadhigeeda iyada oo loo marayo zoom asa ka hor Sebtembar 21, marka kalfadhigan uu bilaabmi doono iyadoo ay hogaamin doonaan garsoorayaasha ugu waaweyn, oo bilaaban doona Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Kot mar Land and Environment e Nyeri biro dong' kochung' kochakore tarik 24 Agost nyaka tarik 7 Septemba 2020 bang' yudo jotuo 2 ma nigi tuo mar Covid-19, mondo omi thuolo mar dhi nyime gi thieth mar yiengni kod timo chenro mag ot.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya alerts residents of Busia County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay uga digtay dadka deggan degmada Busia in ay kordheen kiisaska tuugada waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan macluumaadka amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Communications Authority chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar County mar Busia ni kwan mag jokuoge medore kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Notice: OGP launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Marsabit County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Marsabit mwezi huu wa Julai.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhanka ah Degmada Marsabit bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Rapar: OGP chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Marsabit e dwe mar Julai.

English: Wajir County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Wajir: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Mei 2022
Somali: Degmada Wajeer: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Wajir: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar abich 2022

English: IEBC updates residents of Murang'a County on progress of community-based development programmes this July.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a juu ya maendeleo ya programu za maendeleo ya jamii mwezi huu Julai.
Somali: IEBC waxay dadka deggan degmada Murang'a ku wargelineysaa horumarka barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada ee bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: IEBC nyiso jood Murang'a County dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag oganda e dwe mar Julai.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges cassava growers in Makueni County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Udhibiti wa Pest Products inawasihi wakulima wa manii katika Kaunti ya Makueni kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa za kukabiliana na ukame ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda cassava ee degmada Makueni inay qaataan noocyo abuurka ah oo abaarta u adkaysta si loo hagaajiyo goosashada xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur ma pidho kassawa e gweng ' mar Makueni County mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo okony e medo nyak mar yien e higani.

English: Kenya among 12 African countries to get 18 million doses of malaria vaccine by 2025, WHO says priority will go to countries with the greatest need.
Kiswahili: Kenya miongoni mwa nchi 12 za Afrika kupata dozi milioni 18 za chanjo ya malaria ifikapo mwaka 2025, WHO inasema kipaumbele kitaelekezwa kwa nchi zenye uhitaji mkubwa zaidi.
Somali: Kenya ayaa ka mid ah 12 dal oo Afrikaan ah oo heli doona 18 milyan oo qiyaasood oo tallaal ah oo ka dhan ah cudurka fayraska sanadka 2025, WHO ayaa sheegtay in mudnaanta loo siin doono dalalka ugu baahan.
Dholuo: Kenya en achiel kuom pinje 12 mag Afrika mabiro yudo dose milion 18 mag thieth mar malaria e higa mar 2025, WHO wacho ni telo biro bedo ne pinje man gi dwaro maduong'.

English: Council of Governors encourages first-time voters in Lamu County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kaunti ya Lamu kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku dhiirigelinayaan codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Lamu inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo josiasa mokwongo e County mar Lamu mondo oting'e ID mar piny mangima kata pasipoti e odiechieng' mar yiero.

English: State Department for Basic Education reminds youth in Nyandarua County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nyandarua in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka mashiinnada gawaarida.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education oparo ne rowere man Nyandarua County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar mechanics mag mtokni.

English: Kenya - Floods, cholera update (UN OCHA, NOAA-CPC) (ECHO Daily Flash of 22 December 2023)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Mafuriko, sasisho la kipindupindu (UN OCHA, NOAA-CPC) (ECHO Daily Flash ya 22 Desemba 2023)
Somali: Kenya - Daadadka, warbixin ku saabsan daacuunka (UN OCHA, NOAA-CPC) (ECHO Daily Flash ee 22 Diseembar 2023)
Dholuo: Kenya - Muomruok, duoko manyien mar kolera (Rikruok mar UN OCHA, NOAA-CPC)

English: KALRO announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for cattle in Bungoma County this March.
Kiswahili: KALRO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Machi hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan qabyaalada lo'da ee Gobolka Bungoma bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: KALRO ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar rabies e dwe mar Mach e county mar Bungoma.

English: TSC calls on the community in Bomet County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TSC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Bomet kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TSC waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Bomet inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban si loo ilaaliyo nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: TSC okwayo ji duto manie County mar Bomet mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ngima maber e skunde.

English: Universities Fund urges residents of Kiambu County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na mgao wa bursary.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga ugu dambeeya si ay uga faa'iideystaan qaybinta deeqaha waxbarasho.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kiambu mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud michno.

English: Notice: COMESA will conduct a greenhouse farming workshop for farmers in Samburu County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itafanya warsha ya kilimo cha chafu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo ee beeraleyda gobolka Samburu bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Nonro: COMESA biro timo tiegruok mar timo tijno ne jopur e gweng' mar Samburu e dwe mar Februar.

English: Huduma Kenya advises residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya nyiso jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom websait mar e-Citizen sama gidwaro yudo kwayo mag ID.

English: KEPHIS urges cassava growers in Lamu County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Lamu kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda cassava ee degmada Lamu inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur ma pidho manias e County mar Lamu mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue mondo okony e medo nyak mar cham e higani.

English: NTSA reminds the public in Taita-Taveta County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NTSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kubaki macho juu ya ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: NTSA waxay dadka degmada Taita-Taveta ku xasuusineysaa inay ka feejignaadaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: NTSA parone ji duto manie Taita-Taveta County mondo omed bedo motang' ne loso kuwe e piny.

English: Public notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will host a free diabetes screening outreach in Turkana County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uchunguzi wa kisukari bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Turkana Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay marti-gelin doontaa baaritaanka bukaanka ee bilaashka ah ee degmada Turkana bisha May.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Rango Kendo Luwo Tuwo biro timo nonro mar thieth ma onge chudo e taon mar Turkana e dwe mar Mei.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kitui County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Kitui apeleke simu ya simu ya GBV 1195.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Kitui inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e County Kitui mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195 maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Situation Update | April 2024: Kenyan Security Forces Combating al-Shabaab, Pastoralist Militias, and Mob Violence
Kiswahili: Sasisho la Hali ya Kenya | Aprili 2024: Vikosi vya Usalama vya Kenya Kupambana na al-Shabaab, Wanamgambo wa Wafugaji, na Vurugu za Umati
Somali: Cusbooneysiinta Xaaladda Kenya | Abriil 2024: Ciidamada Amniga Kenya oo la dagaallamaya al-Shabaab, Maleeshiyada Xoolo-dhaqatada, iyo Rabshadaha Dadka Isku-soo-baxa
Dholuo: Oboke mar Kenya | Ang'wen 2024: Jolweny mag arita mag Kenya Kedo kod Al-Shabaab, Jolweny Jokwath, kod Tulo mag Oganda

English: NDMA reminds the public in Turkana County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuendelea kuwa macho katika kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Turkana inay ka feejignaadaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: NDMA parone ji duto e county mar Turkana ni mondo gisik ka girito weche mag loso kuwe e piny.

English: SHA encourages first-time voters in Garissa County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: SHA inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Garissa kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu.
Somali: SHA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha ugu horreeya ee degmada Garissa inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo joma okwongo yiero e county mar Garissa mondo olim kama ichanoe joma nie IEBC machiegni kodgi.

English: Notice: DPP conducts a community briefing on community early-warning systems in Siaya County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Siaya Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada oo ku saabsan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada ee degmada Siaya bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: DPP timo romo mar chiwo siem ne ji e wi chenro mag chiwo siem chon e taon mar Siaya e dwe mar Jun.

English: KNEC conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Baringo County this April.

English: Notice: DPP activates an emergency response plan for drought in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DPP inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ukame katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe falcelin deg deg ah oo abaaraha ka dhan ah degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: DPP tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne oro e County mar Vihiga.

English: By paying attention to those around you, you might save a life! Prioritising mental health in the workplace is just as crucial for those working from home. Mental health challenges can affect anyone; they don't discriminate. Wherever you are working from, taking care of your mental health can improve your productivity and overall happiness. Let's break the stigma and make mental health a priority!
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwajali wale walio karibu nawe, unaweza kuokoa maisha! Kuweka kipaumbele katika afya ya akili mahali pa kazi ni muhimu vile vile kwa wale wanaofanya kazi kutoka nyumbani. Changamoto za afya ya akili zinaweza kumathiri mtu yeyote; hazibagui. Popote unapofanyia kazi, kutunza afya yako ya akili kunaweza kuboresha uzalishaji wako na furaha yako kwa ujumla. Tuvunje unyanyapaa na tufanye afya ya akili kuwa kipaumbele!
Somali: Markaad fiiro gaar ah u yeelato kuwa kugu xeeran, waxaad badbaadin kartaa nolol! Mudnaanta caafimaadka maskaxda ee goobta shaqada waa mid aad muhiim ugu ah kuwa ka shaqeeya guriga. Caqabadaha caafimaadka maskaxdu waxay saameyn karaan qof kasta; ma takooraan. Meel kasta oo aad ka shaqaynayso, daryeelka caafimaadkaaga maskaxeed waxay hagaajin kartaa wax soo saarkaaga iyo farxaddaada guud. Aan jebinno ceebta oo aan caafimaadka maskaxda ka dhigno mid mudnaan leh!
Dholuo: Ka iketo pach kuom joma ni machiegni kodi, inyalo reso ngima ng’ato! Keto ngima mar paro mokuongo e kar tich en gima duong’ mana kaka ne joma tiyo ka gin ot. Gik ma kelo pek mag paro nyalo mako ng’ato ang’ata; ok gibed gi pogruok. Kamoro amora ma itiyoe, rito ngimani mar paro nyalo miyo ibed gi tich maber kendo ibed gi mor duto. Waketh ng’anjo ma ji ng’ado kendo waket ngima mar paro obed gima duong’!

English: Release of national media campaign explaining new front-of-pack labelling to consumers.
Kiswahili: Kuchapishwa kwa kampeni ya kitaifa ya vyombo vya habari inayoelezea watumiaji alama mpya za mbele za ufungaji.
Somali: Daabacaadda ololaha warbaahinta qaranka ee sharaxaya calaamadaha cusub ee xirmada hore ee macaamiisha.
Dholuo: Wuoyo e wi kampen mar lando wach maber e piny mangima ma lero kaka inyalo ket weche manyien e lela wang'e.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Murang'a County that access to eye and dental camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za macho na meno sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Murang'a in helitaanka xeryaha indhaha iyo ilkaha ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumo la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji duto e County mar Murang'a ni koro ginyalo dhi e kambi mag thieth mag wang' kod lakteche mag laktech e kuonde ma ji ketoe pachgi.

English: Experts from Kenya and Somalia started a program to fight polio. Many of the polio patuients are from Somalia
Kiswahili: Wataalam kutoka Kenya na Somalia walianzisha mpango wa kupambana na polio.
Somali: Khubarada Kenya iyo Soomaaliya waxay bilaabeen barnaamij la dagaalanka cudurka Polio.
Dholuo: Jotim nonro moa Kenya kod Somalia osechako chenro mar kedo gi tuo mar polio.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds farmers in Narok County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok juu ya programu inayoendelea ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa mafunzo ya wakulima.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa beeraleyda degmada Narok in barnaamijka tababarka beeralayda uu socdo.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board parone jopur man Narok County kuom chenro mar tiego jopur ma dhi nyime.

English: USAID/BHA Kenya Assistance Overview, August 2024
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Usaidizi wa USAID/BHA Kenya, Agosti 2024
Somali: Dulmar Guud oo ku saabsan Kaalmada USAID/BHA Kenya, Ogosto 2024
Dholuo: Oboke mar Kony mar USAID/BHA Kenya, dwe mar aboro higa mar 2024

English: Huduma Kenya reminds residents of Nairobi County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba upatikanaji wa utunzaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya parone jogweng' mar Nairobi County ni koro yot yudo weche mag nyuol kokalo kuom chenro mag sirkal.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds residents of Bungoma County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Bungoma in si deg deg ah loo soo sheegayo in xoolaha la xaday ay gacan ka geystaan in xaafadaha la ilaaliyo.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations parone jogweng'o mag Bungoma County ni lando piyo piyo weche mag kwalo jamni konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on residents of Lamu County to support local peace-building committees in support of border security.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Lamu kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani kusaidia usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqay dadka deggan degmada Lamu inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee deegaanka si ay u taageerayaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service kwayo jogweng'o mag Lamu County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gweng'no e siro sirkal mar boda.

English: TVETA conducts specialized training workshops for instructors to update skills and curriculum delivery methods.
Kiswahili: TVETA inafanya semina za mafunzo maalum kwa walimu ili kusasisha ujuzi na mbinu za utoaji wa mipango ya masomo.
Somali: TVETA waxay qabanqaabisaa aqoon isweydaarsiyo tababar oo khaas ah oo loogu talagalay macallimiinta si ay u cusbooneysiiyaan xirfadaha iyo hababka bixinta manhajka.
Dholuo: TVETA timo tiegruok makende mar tiego jopuonjwa mondo ging'e lony kod yore mag chiwo chenro mag somo.

English: IEBC reminds schools in Uasin Gishu County to strengthen anti-bullying measures this February.
Kiswahili: IEBC inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuimarisha hatua za kupambana na uonevu Februari hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay dib u xasuusineysaa dugsiyada gobolka Uasin Gishu inay xoojiyaan tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibaatada bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: IEBC oparo ne skunde man Uasin Gishu County mondo omed jiwo yore mag kedo gi timbe mahundu e dwe mar Februar.

English: Strong soaps can irritate babyÂ’s skin. Use mild, unscented options.
Kiswahili: Sabuni kali zinaweza kuwasha ngozi ya mtoto. Tumia chaguo laini, zisizo na harufu.
Somali: Saabuun adag ayaa cuncun ku keeni kara maqaarka ilmaha. Isticmaal ikhtiyaarro khafiif ah oo aan caraf lahayn.
Dholuo: Sabun ma nigi teko nyalo ketho dend nyathi. Ti kod gik ma ok ng’ich kendo ma onge ndhadhu.

English: Notice: KEMSA will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Embu County this December. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA itafanya kongamano la kurejesha matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Embu Desemba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMSA waxay qabaneysaa madasha dib u soo kabashada isticmaalka maandooriyaha degmada Embu bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMSA biro timo chokruok mar chango joma tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero e taon mar Embu e dwe mar Desemba.

English: ODPP urges residents of Migori County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Migori wape huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Migori inay dalbadaan adeeg bixinta iyaga oo aan bixin laaluush si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogweng' Migori County mondo okonygi gi tij lendo maok gichiwo asoya mondo gikwed asoya e migepe mag sirkal.

English: KEEPING THE DOCTOR AWAY Â¦ Free medical camp held in Machakos town Residents urged to go for frequent medical checks
Kiswahili: KUMWEKA DAKTARI MBALI ¦ Kambi ya matibabu ya bure yafanyika mjini Machakos Wakazi wahimizwa kwenda kwa uchunguzi wa kimatibabu mara kwa mara

Dholuo: KETO DOKTOR MAR GI GI GI GI Â¦ Kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma otim e taon mar Machakos Jodak ojiw mondo gidhi otim nonro mag thieth kinde ka kinde

English: KTDA reminds livestock keepers in Siaya County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KTDA waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xayawaanka ah ee degmada Siaya inay ka fogaadaan in xoolaha laga guuro xuduudka degmada iyada oo aan la helin rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KTDA parone jorit jamni e county mar Siaya ni kik giting' jamni ka ok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: IPOA calls on the community in Wajir County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaita jamii katika Kaunti ya Wajir kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: IPOA waxay bulshada degmada Wajir ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: IPOA luongo ji duto e gweng' mar Wajir mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gichiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Nyandarua County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuhusu umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMRI waxay dadka degmada Nyandarua ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay nadaafadda saxda ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMRI oparo ne ji e County mar Nyandarua kuom ber mar rito ler maler e ngima joot.

English: Government rolls out initiative to provide affordable internet access to all public schools.
Kiswahili: Serikali inaanzisha mpango wa kutoa ufikiaji wa internet kwa bei nafuu kwa shule zote za umma.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay soo saartay dadaal ay ku bixiso helitaanka internetka oo la awoodi karo dhammaan dugsiyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal tiyo gi chenro mar miyo skunde duto mag sirkal thuolo mar tiyo gi intanet e yo mayot.

English: Notice: DPP activates an emergency response plan for landslides in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DPP inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ka dhan ah dhulgariirada Gobolka Baringo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: DPP tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony mapiyo ne yiengni mag piny e taon mar Baringo.

English: Too many people are still left unprotected around the water. But drowning is preventable. Here are some practical water safety tips.
Kiswahili: Watu wengi bado hawajalindwa karibu na maji. Lakini kuzama majini kunaweza kuzuiwa. Hapa kuna dokezo za msingi za usalama wa majini.
Somali: Dad aad u badan ayaa weli ku haray biyaha agtooda iyagoo aan la ilaalin. Laakiin qarqidda waa laga hortagi karaa. Waa kuwan talooyin wax ku ool ah oo ku saabsan badbaadada biyaha.
Dholuo: Ji mang’eny ahinya pod odong’ ma onge ng’at ma ritogi e alwora mar pi. To ng’ato nyalo geng’o ng’ado pi. Magi gin yore moko ma nyalo konyowa mondo kik wabed gi pi.

English: Notice: SHA will hold a public participation forum on development planning forums in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: SHA itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta ee Degmada Migori.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: SHA biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag dongruok e county mar Migori.

English: NTSA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Busia County that access to the GBV toll-free helpline is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba upatikanaji wa simu ya GBV ya bure ya msaada unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Busia in helitaanka khadka caawimaadda ee GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah uu yahay mid lacag-la'aan ah.
Dholuo: NTSA parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e County mar Busia ni gibiro yudo kony ma onge chudo mar GBV maonge chudo.

English: "I pray we get rain by the mercy of God." - Crisis in Kenya: Children on the brink of catastrophe

Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kwale: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2022
Somali: Degmada Kwale: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kwale: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar adek higa mar 2022

English: KEPHIS warns millet farmers in Isiolo County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawaonya wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuhusu mlipuko wa wadudu na kupendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda xashiishadda ee degmada Isiolo cudurrada cayayaanka, waxayna ku talineysaa in si sax ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: KEPHIS chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho adundo e kaunti mar Isiolo kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni otim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds the public in Kisii County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba kuripoti matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka degmada Kisii u xusuusinayaa in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties paronwa ji duto e County mar Kisii ni lando wach tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'.

English: Humanitarian crisis deepens as flooding escalates in ASAL Kenya: AHN Call for Collective and Urgent Action
Kiswahili: Mgogoro wa kibinadamu unazidi kuongezeka huku mafuriko yakiongezeka katika ASAL Kenya: AHN Yataka Hatua za Pamoja na za Haraka
Somali: Dhibaatada bani'aadamnimada oo sii xoogaysanaysa iyadoo daadadku ay sii kordhayaan Kenya: AHN oo ku baaqday in la qaado tallaabo wadajir ah oo degdeg ah.
Dholuo: Midhiero mar dhano medore kaka pi medore e piny Kenya: AHN dwaro ni otim gik moko duto kendo mapiyo

English: IEBC reminds parents in Taita-Taveta County that free primary education registration is open this January.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kwamba usajili wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo umefunguliwa Januari hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta gobolka Taita-Taveta in diiwaangelinta bilaashka ah ee waxbarashada hoose ay furan tahay bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: IEBC paronwa jonyuol manie Taita-Taveta County ni kwan mar nyithindo maok ochuno e tiegruok mar piny ka dhi nyime e dwe mar Januar.

English: 25% of online farmers are women in Northern Sahara . IBAD has offered to support such online initiatives.
Kiswahili: 25% ya wakulima wa mtandaoni ni wanawake katika Sahara Kaskazini. IBAD imejitolea kusaidia mipango kama hiyo ya mtandaoni.
Somali: 25% beeraleyda online-ka ah waa haween ku nool Waqooyiga Sahara. IBAD waxay soo bandhigtay inay taageerto mashaariicda internetka ee noocan ah.
Dholuo: 25% mar jopur ma tiyo gi intanet gin mon e Northern Sahara. IBAD osechiwore mar siro chenrogo.

English: Teachers Service Commission conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Uasin Gishu County this August.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Agosti hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu qabanqaabiyaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda gobolka ee gobolka Uasin Gishu bishii Ogosto.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda e dwe mar Agost e kaunti mar Uasin Gishu.

English: YOUTH IN CRISIS: WHY PREVENTION CAN NOT WAIT Our youth are under attack. Mental health struggles. Substance abuse. Silent battles raging behind screens and closed doors. But there's HOPE. Prevention isn't just an optionâ€”it's the ONLY way to break the cycle. Early action = stronger futures. 1. Educate. 2.Support.

Mapigano ya kimya kimya yakiendelea nyuma ya skrini na milango imefungwa. Lakini kuna MATUMAINI. Kinga si chaguo tu - ni njia PEKEE ya kuvunja mzunguko. Hatua za mapema = mustakabali wenye nguvu. 1. Elimisha. 2. Saidia.

Ficilka hore = mustaqbal xooggan. 1. Waxbar. 2. Taageero.
