Lwenje ma ok oling’ ma timore bang’ skrini kod dhoudi ma olor. To nitie GENO. Kuong'ruok ok en mana yo ma ng'ato nyalo yieroâ€”en yo KENDE mar ketho ng'wech. Tiyo mapiyo = kinde mabiro ma nigi teko. 1. Chiwo puonj. 2. Chiwo kony.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Kilifi County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the August planting season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Agosti.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kilifi inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka dayrta iyagoo isticmaalaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur e County mar Kilifi mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok kapok ochako chwoyo kodhi e dwe mar Agost.

English: DCI calls on the community in Wajir County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatia moyo jamii katika Kaunti ya Wajir kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: DCI waxay bulshada degmada Wajir ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: DCI okwayo oganda mar Wajir County mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Public warning: PSC does not conduct interviews on WhatsApp. Any job ad asking for 'application fees' is fake and should be reported
Kiswahili: Tahadhari ya umma: PSC haitoi mahojiano kwenye WhatsApp. Matangazo yoyote ya kazi ambayo yanaomba 'malipo ya maombi' ni bandia na inapaswa kuripotiwa
Somali: Digniinta dadweynaha: Shirkadda PSC ma qabato wareysiyada WhatsApp. Xayeysiis kasta oo shaqo ah oo codsanaya 'biilasha codsiga' waa been abuur waana in la soo sheegaa
Dholuo: Siem ne ji duto: PSC ok tim mbaka e WhatsApp.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will distribute certified sweet potatoes seed to farmers in Baringo County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itasambaza mbegu za viazi vitamu zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Baringo Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu abuuraha degmada Baringo u qaybin doonaa abuurka baradho macaan ee la caddeeyay bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro pogo kodhi mag le mamit ne jopur man Baringo County e dwe mar Agost.

English: Public health advisory: KEMSA warns of increased Rift Valley Fever risk in Mandera County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMSA inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa katika Kaunti ya Mandera na inashauri umma kutumia vyandarua vya mbu vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Talobixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: KEMSA waxay ka digtay kororka halista Cudurka Rift Valley ee Gobolka Mandera waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay isticmaalaan shabaqa cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: KEMSA chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuwo mar Rift Valley Fever e county mar Mandera kendo ojiwo ji mondo oti gi net mag kute ma itiyogo e thiedho lum otieno ka otieno.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Kericho County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho in si dhakhso leh u soo sheegaan jabsashada ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NTSA parone jogweng' mar Kericho County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo odno konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Harvest the nuts when they are well ripe; Harvesting prematurely leads to a loss of yield, and late harvesting causes the nuts to become poisoned by the fungus (aflatoxin).
Kiswahili: Vuna karanga wakati zimekomaa vizuri; kuvuna kabla ya wakati kunasababisha kupoteza mavuno, na kuchelewa kuvuna kunasababisha karanga kuingiwa na sumu kuvu (aflatoxin).
Somali: Goosta lowska marka ay si fiican u bisilaan; Goosashada si degdeg ah waxay keentaa in la waayo wax-soo-saarka, goosashada dambe waxay keentaa in lowska ay sun ku dhacdo fangaska (aflatoxin).
Dholuo: Ka ipogo cham kapok ochopo e sa ma cham ochakoree, to cham biro lal, to ka ipogo cham mochopo bang'e, to cham biro bedo gi tuwo mar aflatoxin.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free stress management support is available through county health facilities in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa kudhibiti mafadhaiko unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Shirkadda SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo lagu maareeyo walbahaarka laga helo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar stress yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth e county mar Baringo County.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Machakos County to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility following a rise in reported malaria cases.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya malaria vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska fayraska ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Machakos County mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni nikech kwan mar joma nigi malaria osemedore.

English: Anticipatory Early Action: Considering Responsive Community Targeted Mental Health Intervention to Complex Climate Change Impacts
Kiswahili: Hatua ya Mapema ya Kutarajia: Kuzingatia Uingiliaji wa Jamii Yenye Mwitikio Unaolengwa wa Afya ya Akili ili Kuchanganya Athari za Mabadiliko ya Tabianchi.
Somali: Ficilka Hore ee La Filayo: Tixgelinta Faragelinta Caafimaadka Maskaxda ee Bulshada ee Bartilmaameedsan ee Saamaynta Adag ee Isbeddelka Cimilada
Dholuo: Tich ma Igeno Mapiyo: Paro kuom ng’ado bura ma ochung’ne thieth mar paro ma ochung’ne oganda ma dwoko ne pek mapek mag lokore mag kor lwasi

English: Announcement on human beings targeting rice farmers, flour and cooking fat â€¦
Kiswahili: Tangazo kuhusu wanadamu wakilenga wakulima wa mchele, unga na mafuta ya kupika ...
Somali: Ogeysiis ku saabsan bini'aadamka oo bartilmaameedsanaya beeraleyda bariiska, burka iyo dufanka karinta â€¦
Dholuo: Oboke kuom dhano ma ochung'ne jopur mag ngano, ngano kod mo mag tedo â€¦

English: State Department for TVET encourages residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on voter registration.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Gudaha ee TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabtaan diiwaangelinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo ong'e weche ma giduto giduto giseyudo mondo ging'e gik ma biro timore ne jogo madwaro dhi e skundno.

English: FAO urges dairy cows farmers in Nandi County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported foot and mouth disease cases.
Kiswahili: FAO inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Nandi inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma pidho dhok e county mar Nandi mondo ochiw ripot ne jamni matuwo e bad thieth man machiegni kodgi bang' yudo wach mar tuoche mag dhoot.

English: Writing of a book to guide on climate resilience, forests and fishery is an inclusive plan with experts from different parts..
Kiswahili: Kuandika kitabu cha kuongoza juu ya ustahimilivu wa hali ya hewa, misitu na uvuvi ni mpango unaojumuisha na wataalam kutoka sehemu tofauti..
Somali: Qorista buug hagitaan ku saabsan adkeysiga cimilada, kaymaha iyo kalluumaysiga waa qorshe dhamaystiran oo ay khubaro ka kala yimaadaan meelo kala duwan.
Dholuo: Ndiko buk mar tayo ji e wi geng'o chandruoge mag lokruok e kor lwasi, bunge kod rech en chenro mar konyo ji duto moriwo nyaka joma olony e weche mag yuto.

English: State Department for TVET encourages residents of Kitui County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay ka qaybgalaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET ojiwo jogweng' Kitui County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda mondo omi ji ong'e kaka gibiro tiyo gi bajet mar county.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) informs maize farmers in Embu County of new market linkage opportunities this June.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawafahamisha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Embu kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Juni hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Embu fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nyiso jopur mag cham e county mar Embu kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Jun.

English: KICD announces distribution of revision guides to schools in Murang'a County this November.
Kiswahili: KICD inatangaza usambazaji wa miongozo ya marekebisho kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Novemba hii.
Somali: KICD waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa in lagu qeybinayo buugaagta dib u eegista dugsiyada degmada Murang'a bisha November.
Dholuo: KICD ogolo ne skunde mag Murang'a e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the public in Trans Nzoia County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa shacabka degmada Trans Nzoia inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qof kasta oo ka dambeeya kiisaska la soo sheegay ee nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' ka osenyis ni gin gi chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo.

English: Notice: KRA opens a new service point for passport services in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay ka furaysaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KRA oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag tiyo gi passport e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: Mombasa, Your Voice Matters! Mombasa County invites all citizens to engage in the Finance Bill 2025, ADP, and CBROP discussions. Youth leaders and changemakers read, engage & influence decisions shaping our countyâ€™s future. Letâ€™s show up,speak up & build the Mombasa we deserve.
Kiswahili: Mombasa, Sauti Yako Ni Muhimu! Kaunti ya Mumbasa inawaalika raia wote kushiriki katika mjadala wa Muswada wa Fedha 2025, ADP, na CBROP. Viongozi wa vijana na watengenezaji wa mabadiliko wanasoma, wanahusika na kuathiri maamuzi yanayounda siku zijazo za kaunti yetu.
Somali: Mombasa, Codkaaga Ayaa Muhiim Ah! Degmada Mombasa waxay martiqaad u fidineysaa dhammaan muwaadiniinta inay ka qayb qaataan doodaha Hindise-sharciyeedka Maaliyadda 2025, ADP, iyo CBROP. Hoggaamiyeyaasha dhallinyarada iyo kuwa isbeddel doonka ah ayaa akhriya, ka qayb qaata oo saameyn ku yeesha go'aannada qaabeynaya mustaqbalka degmadeenna. Aan soo baxno, aan hadalno oo aan dhisno Mombasa aan u qalanno.
Dholuo: Mombasa, Duol Mari En Maduong'! Kaunti mar Mombasa rwako jodak duto mondo odonjre e mbaka mag chik mar pesa mag higa mar 2025, ADP, kod CBROP. Jotelo mag joma tindo kod joma kelo lokruok somo, donjo kendo kelo lokruok e yiero ma loso kinde mabiro mar kaunti marwa. <2Zepa> Wanyisre, wawuo kendo wager Mombasa ma owinjore gi wan.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Lamu County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Lamu inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nyagore gi tuoche mag obwongo e County mar Lamu mondo odhi ir japuonj molony.

English: New mothers may experience sadness or anxiety. Counseling and support groups can help.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wapya wanaweza kupata huzuni au wasiwasi. Ushauri nasaha na vikundi vya usaidizi vinaweza kusaidia.
Somali: Hooyooyinka cusub waxay dareemi karaan murugo ama walaac.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma pod tindo nyalo bedo gi kuyo kata bedo gi parruok.

English: Covid 19 injection are ideal for adults, women and those breast feeding as adiviced by WHO. They can get vaccinated through the Doctors prescriptions.
Kiswahili: Virutubisho vya COVID-19 ni bora kwa watu wazima, wanawake na wale wanaonyonyesha kama ilivyopendekezwa na WHO. Wanaweza kupata chanjo kupitia maagizo ya Madaktari.
Somali: Cirbadeynta COVID-19 waxay ku habboon tahay dadka waaweyn, haweenka iyo kuwa naas nuujinaya sida ay soo jeedisay WHO. Waxay tallaali karaan iyada oo loo marayo qodobbada dhakhaatiirta.
Dholuo: Covid 19 injection en gima ber ahinya ne joma dongo, mon kod jogo machiemo mana kaka osenyis gi WHO. Ginyalo yudo thieth kokalo kuom chike mag lakteche.

English: SHA urges residents of Kirinyaga County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga inay la shaqeeyaan maamulaha degmada si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda horumarinta degmada.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kirinyaga mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jorit-alwora mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi chenro mag dongruok mar county.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission announces school feeding programme enrollment dates for schools in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa programu ya kulisha shule kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku dhawaaqay taariikhda diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiyada gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj lando tarik mag dhi e skunde mag Homa Bay County.

English: Universities Fund reminds youth in Narok County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Narok kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa upishi na mafunzo ya ukarimu.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xasuusinayaa dhalinyarada degmada Narok in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa rowere man Narok County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar chiemo kod mar rwako welo.

English: Notice: SHA opens a new service point for national ID applications in Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: SHA inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Shirkadda SHA waxay furaysaa goob adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Kiambu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA chako tiyo gi ofis manyien mar Joneno mag Jehova e kaunti mar Kiambu.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties urges eligible citizens in Homa Bay County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawasihi wananchi wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma gobolka Homa Bay inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaan gelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties jiwo jokanyo mag Homa Bay County mondo oriwgi e ndiko joma oyier.

English: UN-Habitatâ€™s support to Preparedness and Response strategies in Kakuma-Kalobeyei, Kenya: Supporting COVID-19 Pandemic Efforts
Kiswahili: Usaidizi wa UN-Habitat kwa mikakati ya Maandalizi na Majibu huko Kakuma-Kalobeyei, Kenya: Kusaidia Juhudi za Janga la COVID-19
Somali: Taageerada UN-Habitat ee Istaraatiijiyadaha Diyaargarowga iyo Jawaab celinta ee Kakuma-Kalobeyei, Kenya: Taageeridda Dadaallada Faafidda COVID-19
Dholuo: Siro mar UN-Habitat chenro mag ikruok kod duoko e piny Kakuma-Kalobeyei, Kenya: Chiwo sir ne tem mag tuo mar COVID-19

English: Many households rely on basic measures such as fans, drinking more water and wearing lighter clothing.
Kiswahili: Kaya nyingi hutegemea hatua za kimsingi kama vile feni, kunywa maji zaidi na kuvaa nguo nyepesi.
Somali: Qoysas badan ayaa ku tiirsan tallaabooyinka aasaasiga ah sida marawaxadaha, cabitaanka biyo badan iyo xirashada dharka fudud.
Dholuo: Jo ot mang’eny geno kuom yore madongo kaka fan, madho pi mang’eny kod rwako lewni ma yot.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds youth in Isiolo County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada ayaa xasuusinaya dhalinyarada degmada Isiolo in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka farsamada gawaarida.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne rowere man Isiolo County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar masinde mag mtokni.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Garissa County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Garissa in adeegyada bukaanka dibedda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth parone ji duto e County mar Garissa ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mag thieth e kuonde moyier.

English: Free startup capital Ksh 200,000 for top 1,000 TVET graduates!
Kiswahili: Mtaji wa kuanzisha biashara bila malipo Ksh 200,000 kwa wahitimu 1,000 bora wa TVET!
Somali: Lacagaha bilowga ah ee bilaashka ah Ksh 200,000 oo loogu talagalay 1,000ka ugu sareeya ee ka qalin jabisay TVET!
Dholuo: Motelo ne mano, ibiro yudo Ksh 200,000 mag pesa maonge chudo ne joma oseyudo tiegruok mag TVET mokalo 1,000!

English: To manage bacterial black spot in mango, prune off and destroy diseased twigs (sterilizing your tools between cuts), spray copper oxychloride-based products as soon as the disease appears nearby - before it infects your trees. Avoid spraying during fruit set, and do not enter the orchard for at least a day after spraying.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti doa nyeusi la bakteria kwenye embe, kata na uharibu matawi yenye ugonjwa (kusafisha zana zako kati ya kupunguzwa), nyunyiza bidhaa za oksikloridi ya shaba mara tu ugonjwa unapoonekana karibu - kabla ya kuambukiza miti yako. Epuka kunyunyizia dawa wakati wa kuweka matunda, na usiingie kwenye bustani kwa angalau siku baada ya kunyunyizia dawa.
Somali: Si aad u maareyso dhibcaha madow ee bakteeriyada ee mango, gooyo iyo baabi'iyo laamo xanuunsan (oo qalabkaaga u dhigaya midho la'aan inta u dhaxaysa goynta), ku buufi waxyaabaha ku saleysan copper oxychloride isla marka cudurka uu soo muuqdo meel u dhow - ka hor inta uusan ku dhaawicin geedahaaga. Ka fogow buufinta inta lagu jiro go'aanka miraha, oo ha gelin beerta miraha ugu yaraan maalin ka dib buufinta.
Dholuo: Mondo itiek tuwo mar bakteria e mango, ng'ad oko bede ma nigi tuoche kendo ikethgi (tiyo gi yorego e kind tongego), ka tuoche ma kamago oneno machiegni, to piyo gi gik ma nigi copper oxychloride kapok gichako mako yiende.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges sweet potatoes growers in Homa Bay County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawahimiza wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda baradho macaan ee gobolka Homa Bay inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalaalka ciidda si loo hagaajiyo goosashada xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur ma pidho olemo mag sweet potato e Homa Bay County mondo otim lokruok e puothe mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: NPS reminds residents of Nyamira County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira in warbixinta khiyaanada si deg deg ah ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NPS oparo ne jogweng' Nyamira County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar wuond konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Turkana County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada ee degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura mar Kenya biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e county mar Turkana.

English: CDC launches a campaign promoting hand hygiene to prevent disease spread.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya kuhimiza usafi wa mikono ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa.
Somali: CDC waxay bilowday olole lagu dhiirigelinayo nadaafadda gacmaha si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada.
Dholuo: CDC ochako kampen mar jiwo ler mar lwedo mondo ogeng’ lalruok mar tuoche.

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Kilifi County that access to skilled birth attendance is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kwamba upatikanaji wa mahudhurio ya uzazi wenye ujuzi ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Kilifi in helitaanka daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfad leh ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone mine ma biro nyuolo nyithindo e gweng' mar Kilifi ni thuolo mar yudo nyithindo ma nigi lony en maonge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: KRA reminds residents of Laikipia County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kwamba upatikanaji wa usajili wa e-Citizen sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia in helitaanka diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: KRA oparo ne jogweng' Laikipia County ni yudo e-Citizen registration koro yot kokalo kuom yore mag tich.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to explore herb and spice propagation particularly thyme for their high demand and immunity boosting properties
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kuchunguza uenezaji wa mitishamba na viungo hasa thyme kwa ajili ya mahitaji yao makubwa na kuongeza kinga.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay sahaminayaan faafinta cawska iyo dhadhanka, gaar ahaan thyme, sababtoo ah baahida sare iyo sifooyinka kor u qaadista difaaca
Dholuo: Josupogo kaachiel gi joma nie ohala mag agro-go jiwo mondo onon yore mag pidho yiende kod le kod gik ma nigi suya mamit, to moloyo, thiam nikech gik ma gihero kendo ma jiwo teko mar geng'o tuoche

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Kericho County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurka laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health nyiso ji duto modak e County mar Kericho mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth ma onge chudo mar oganda mondo gikwed thieth mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Schools reopen January 6 Ã¢Â€Â“ no learner to be sent away for fees. Report violators to 0800721490 NOW!
Kiswahili: Shule zitafunguliwa tena Januari 6 Ã¢Â€Â“ hakuna mwanafunzi atakayefukuzwa kwa ajili ya karo. Waripoti wanaokiuka sheria kwa 0800721490 SASA!

English: State Department for Basic Education urges residents of Tana River County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Dowladda waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo ji duto modak e taon mar Tana River County mondo odonj e program mar puonjo jomadongo mondo giyud somo mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya warns residents of Nyeri County about a rise in phishing messages and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri juu ya kuongezeka kwa ujumbe wa phishing na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri kororka fariimaha phishing waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga leh bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Communications Authority chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nyeri County e wi medruok mar weche mag phishing kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar weche ma ok kare ne jatendgi.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages mothers in Nairobi County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Nairobi inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit jiwo mine man Nairobi County mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Farming that incorporates climate smart changes aims at attaining food security and climate changes, in reducing gas emisions. FAO..
Kiswahili: Kilimo kinachojumuisha mabadiliko mazuri ya hali ya hewa kinalenga kufikia usalama wa chakula na mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa, katika kupunguza utoaji wa gesi. FAO..
Somali: Beeralayda ku darta isbeddelada caqliga leh ee cimilada waxay ujeedadeedu tahay in la gaaro amniga cuntada iyo isbeddelka cimilada, iyo in la yareeyo soo saarista gaaska. FAO..
Dholuo: Tij pur moting'o lokruok mariek e kit ngima mar piny dwaro ni ji obed gi winjruok maber gi chiemo kod lokruok e kit ngima mar piny, kendo mondo omi ji odok chien e wi gik ma gimiyo gibedo gi ngima mochido.

English: KICD develops new engaging digital content tailored for early childhood education (ECDE).
Kiswahili: KICD huendeleza maudhui mapya ya kuvutia ya digital iliyoundwa kwa ajili ya elimu ya utotoni (ECDE).
Somali: KICD waxay soo saartaa waxyaalo cusub oo dhiirigelinaya oo loogu talagalay waxbarashada caruurta da'da yar (ECDE).
Dholuo: KICD loso gik manyien makonyo ji e weche mag digital mochanore ne tiegruok mar nyithindo ma tindo (ECDE).

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service informs tea farmers in Trans Nzoia County of new market linkage opportunities this September.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawafahamisha wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Septemba hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku wargalinayaa beeraleyda shaaha ee Gobolka Trans Nzoia fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur mag chai e Trans Nzoia County kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Announcement on government collaboration with NGOs to encourage schools and homes to on body and mouthe healthy and more advice
Kiswahili: Tangazo juu ya ushirikiano wa serikali na mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali ili kuhamasisha shule na nyumba kwa juu ya mwili na mdomo afya na ushauri zaidi
Somali: Ogeysiis ku saabsan wada shaqeynta dowladda ee ururada aan dawliga ahayn si loo dhiirrigeliyo dugsiyada iyo guryaha si ay u helaan talooyin caafimaad iyo badan oo ku saabsan jirka iyo afka
Dholuo: Lando mar riwruok mar sirkal gi riwruoge maok nie sirkal mondo ojiw skunde kod udi mondo ochiw paro e wi weche mag ringruok kod dhok

English: Notice: KUCCPS announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta dugsiyada dugsiga dhexe ee maalin bilaash ah ee gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KUCCPS ogolo chenro mar somo sekondari e skul mag Nyandarua County.

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Tana River County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kuthibitisha kuwa kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River County inay xaqiijiyaan in xaruntooda la aqoonsaday ka hor inta aysan booqan si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo ong'e ni kuondegi mag thieth oseyudo ratiro kapok gibiro mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health will host a free tobacco control outreach in Kakamega County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya itaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa kudhibiti tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay marti gelineysaa dadaal lacag la'aan ah oo ka dhan ah ka hortagga sigaarka ee Gobolka Kakamega bisha May.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth biro timo kampen mar golo ndawa maonge chudo e kaunti mar Kakamega e dwe mar Mei.

English: Kenya Gazette updates residents of Machakos County on progress of county development projects this April.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawasilisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kuhusu maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti hii Aprili.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Machakos ka warbixiyaa horumarka mashaariicda horumarinta degmada bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette osemiyo jood County ma Machakos ong'eyo kaka chenro mag dongruok mar county dhi nyime e dwe mar April.

English: FAO advises farmers in Taita-Taveta County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the December planting season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Desemba.
Somali: FAO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: FAO nyiso jopur manie Taita-Taveta County ni giti gi moko kuom yiendno kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Desemba.

English: NDMA alerts residents of Busia County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: NDMA waxay dadka deggan degmada Busia uga digtay kororka kiisaska gaadiidka la xaday waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: NDMA chiwo siem ne ji modak e County mar Busia e wi medruok mar wach kwalo mtokni kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: The Kenyan government will no longer buy maize or farm inputs from farmers Farmers can now use their produce as collateral for financing from financial organizations
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya haitanunua tena mahindi au pembejeo za kilimo kutoka kwa wakulima Wakulima sasa wanaweza kutumia mazao yao kama dhamana kwa ufadhili wa mashirika ya kifedha.
Somali: Dowladda Kenya mar dambe ma iibsan doonto galley ama alaab beereed oo ka yimaada beeraleyda, beeraleydu hadda waxay isticmaali karaan wax soo saarkooda sidii dammaanad maalgelin ururada maaliyadeed
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya ok bi nyiewo cham kata gik mamoko ma jopur nyalo chamo.

English: Huduma Kenya announces improved turnaround times for e-Citizen registration in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya yatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujiandikisha kwa e-Citizen katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku dhawaaqday waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya olando lokruok e seche mag dhi e e e-Citizen registration e Taita-Taveta County.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds mobile money users in Kisii County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid identity theft.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kisii inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado tuugada aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e County mar Kisii ni mondo ginyis jomisonari margi weche ma ok kare mondo kik gikwel nyingegi.

English: AFA warns wheat farmers in Murang'a County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: AFA inawaonya wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Murang'a juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: AFA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda wheat ee degmada Murang'a cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: AFA chiwo siem ne jopur mag ngano e County mar Murang'a kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Kenya Dairy Board warns cassava farmers in Siaya County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda cassava ee degmada Siaya cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka wuxuuna kugula talinayaa faragelinta waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board chiwo siem ne jopur mag maniva e county mar Siaya kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges youth in Homa Bay County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku boorinayaa dhalinyarada degmada Homa Bay inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo rowere manie Homa Bay County mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto gikwongo tiyogo ka pok gichako timo tije mag sirkal.

English: Kenya Dairy Board warns sweet potatoes farmers in Kilifi County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda baradho macaan ee Gobolka Kilifi cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna kugula talinayaan in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho olemo mag sweet potato e gweng' mar Kilifi kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Kwale County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kwale: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2023
Somali: Degmada Kwale: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kwale: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2023

English: Reaching Last Mile with Early Warning Information for Anticipatory Action
Kiswahili: Kufikia Maili ya Mwisho kwa Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kwa Hatua ya Kutarajia
Somali: Gaaritaanka Maylka Ugu Dambeeya Iyada oo la adeegsanayo Macluumaadka Digniinta Hore ee Tallaabada La Filayo
Dholuo: Chopo Mail Mogik ka itiyo gi weche mag siem motelo mar timo gik moko motelo

English: Announcement that hospitals to provide local vegetables to patients in wards as a move to improve their dietary
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwamba hospitali kutoa mboga za ndani kwa wagonjwa katika idara kama hatua ya kuboresha lishe yao
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida in isbitaalada ay siin doonaan khudradda maxalliga ah ee bukaanka ee qaybaha sida tallaabo si loo hagaajiyo cuntadooda
Dholuo: Owacho ni osiptal biro chiwo alode ne jotuo manie od thieth mondo gimed bedo gi chiemo maber

English: KALRO urges farmers in Migori County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Migori inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo lagu soo ururiyo biyaha beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e county mar Migori mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok e kaka koth chue.

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will host a free hypertension awareness outreach in Taita-Taveta County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska Dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa martigelin doonta wacyi-gelin bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cadaadiska dhiig karka ee gobolka Taita-Taveta bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo kampen mar konyo ji ng'eyo ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar hypertension maonge chudo e Taita-Taveta County e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will distribute certified wheat seed to farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itasambaza mbegu za ngano zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka ayaa abuurka sarreenka ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doona beeraleyda gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro pogo kodhi mag ngano ne jopur man Elgeyo-Marakwet County e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: DCI launches a fraud prevention campaign in Kiambu County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga khiyaamooyinka degmada Kiambu bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Rapar: DCI chako kampen mar geng'o wuondruok e County mar Kiambu e dwe mar Julai.

English: Refugee-Led Research Hub (RLRH) - Refugee-Led Organisations in East Africa: Community Perceptions in Kenya - November 2022
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Utafiti Unaoongozwa na Wakimbizi (RLRH) - Mashirika Yanayoongozwa na Wakimbizi katika Afrika Mashariki: Maoni ya Jamii nchini Kenya - Novemba 2022
Somali: Xarunta Cilmi-baarista ee ay Qaxootigu Hoggaaminayaan (RLRH) - Ururada ay Qaxootigu Hoggaaminayaan ee Bariga Afrika: Aragtida Bulshada ee Kenya - Noofambar 2022
Dholuo: Kambi mar Nonro ma Otelo gi Jolweny (RLRH) - Riwruoge ma Otelo gi Jolweny e Afrika ma Wuokchieng': Paro mag Oganda e piny Kenya - dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2022

English: Council of Governors encourages first-time voters in Kakamega County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyayaashu waxay ku dhiirigelinayaan codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee Gobolka Kakamega inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo josiasa mokwongo e Kaunti mar Kakamega mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar piny mangima e odiechieng' mar yiero.

English: Notice: DCI opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafungua ofisi ya ngono inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay furaysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya daryeel caafimaad ka dib rabshadaha gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni DCI ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony mar thieth bang' timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Taita-Taveta.

English: TVET urges residents of Turkana County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: TVET inawataka wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na mgao wa bursary.
Somali: TVET waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay codsadaan deeq waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Turkana mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud michno.

English: Notice: HELB opens applications for textbooks and learning materials for learners in Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB inafungua maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay ardayda degmada Trans Nzoia u furaysaa codsiyada buugaagta waxbarasho iyo qalabka wax lagu barto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: HELB chako tiyo gi buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok ne jopuonjre man Trans Nzoia County.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds mobile money users in Lamu County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Lamu wasiishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Lamu inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qofna si looga fogaado khiyaamada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne joma tiyo gi pesa mag simo e County mar Lamu ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo kik gitim wuond mar loko SIM.

English: COMESA advises farmers in Homa Bay County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the November planting season.

English: "Global guidance helps ensure that school food policies are informed by evidence and responsive to the nutritional needs of children at different stages of development." Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu na KUCCPS wanaalika maombi ya nafasi za masomo na kutoa ushauri wa taaluma kwa wanafunzi.

Kenya hadda waxay cunto bilaash ah siineysaa qiyaastii 2.6 milyan oo carruur ah, iyadoo bartilmaameed qaran uu yahay in la gaaro 10 milyan oo carruur ah marka la gaaro 2030, sida ay sheegtay Wasaaradda Waxbarashada.

Kenya sani chiwo chiemo ma nono e skul ne nyithindo madirom milion 2.6, kendo pinyno nigi gombo mar chopo nyithindo milion 10 nyaka higa mar 2030, kaluwore gi ng’at ma rito somo.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Meru County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo jogweng' mar Meru County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e loso chenro mag chenro mag oganda.

English: UNICEF Kenya Humanitarian Situation Report (Year End) - 01 January to 31 December 2024
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Hali ya Kibinadamu ya UNICEF Kenya (Mwisho wa Mwaka) - 01 Januari hadi 31 Desemba 2024
Somali: Warbixinta Xaaladda Bani'aadamnimada ee UNICEF Kenya (Dhammaadka Sannadka) - 01 Janaayo ilaa 31 Diseembar 2024
Dholuo: Ripot mar chal mar konyo dhano mar UNICEF e piny Kenya (Giko Higa) - tarik 01 dwe mar achiel nyaka tarik 31 dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2024

English: Midline findings for the Kenya cash consortium response to drought in arid and semi-arid lands (ASAL) counties of Kenya
Kiswahili: Matokeo ya katikati ya mwitikio wa muungano wa pesa wa Kenya kwa ukame katika kaunti kame na nusu kame (ASAL) za Kenya.
Somali: Natiijooyinka dhexe ee ururka lacagta caddaanka ah ee Kenya ee ka jawaabaya abaaraha ka jira degmooyinka dhulalka qalalan iyo kuwa nus-aroorka ah (ASAL) ee Kenya
Dholuo: Duoko ma diere mag riwruok mar pesa mag Kenya dwoko mar oro e piny ma otuo kod ma otuo matin (ASAL) e piny Kenya

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kwale County that access to psychosocial support is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisaikolojia unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay Gobolka Kwale in helitaanka taageerada cilmu-nafsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Kwale ni ginyalo yudo kony maonge chudo.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education announces school feeding programme enrollment dates for schools in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa programu ya kulisha shule kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka ayaa ku dhawaaqday taariikhda diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiyada degmada Kajiado.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Puonjruok ma Chakruok mar Piny owacho landoga tarik mag dhi e skunde mag Kajiado County mondo giyud thuolo mar dhi e program mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will open a fish collection centre in Turkana County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itafungua kituo cha kukusanya samaki katika Kaunti ya Turkana Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha Kenya ayaa furaya xarun lagu soo uruurinayo kalluunka degmada Turkana bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Dairy Board biro yawo kama ichokoe rech e County mar Turkana e dwe mar Februar.

English: Nyeri (Kieni) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Nyeri (Kieni): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Februari 2023
Somali: Degmada Nyeri (Kieni): War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Nyeri (Kieni): Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2023

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the public in Trans Nzoia County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadweynaha degmada Trans Nzoia inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ji duto e Trans Nzoia County mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo weche mag phishing.

English: Notice from Kenya Red Cross: childhood immunization clinics will run every July at designated health centres in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya: kliniki za chanjo za watoto zitaendeshwa kila Julai katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya: Caafimaadka tallaalka carruurta waxaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Luulyo oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee Magaalada Migori.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ripot Mamit mar Kenya: Klinike mag thiedho nyithindo ibiro tiyoe higa ka higa e dwe mar Julai e kuonde thieth moyier e county mar Migori.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Ministry of Health will be held in Isiolo County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Wizara ya Afya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ay soo qabanqaabisay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa lagu qabanqaabi doonaa Degmada Isiolo bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni kampen mar thieth ma onge chudo mitimo gi Ministry of Health ibiro tim e kaunti mar Isiolo e dwe mar Julai.

English: PATH is currently reaching out to vulnerable Adolescent Girls & Young Women, in 51 wards covering the counties of Kisumu, HomaBay & Migori in partnership with @MOH_Kenya @PoliceKE to provide COVID-19 basic information on curfew, social distance, handwash #KomeshaCorona update
Kiswahili: PATH kwa sasa inawafikia Wasichana na Vijana wa Kike walio katika mazingira magumu, katika wadi 51 zinazojumuisha kaunti za Kisumu, HomaBay na Migori kwa ushirikiano na @MOH_Kenya @PoliceKE kutoa taarifa za kimsingi kuhusu COVID-19 kuhusu amri ya kutotoka nje, umbali wa kijamii, unawaji mikono #KomeshaCorona sasisho.
Somali: PATH waxay hadda la xiriireysaa Gabdhaha iyo Haweenka Da'da Yar ee nugul, oo ku kala yaal 51 waaxood oo ka shaqeeya degmooyinka Kisumu, HomaBay & Migori iyadoo lala kaashanayo @MOH_Kenya @PoliceKE si loo bixiyo macluumaad aasaasi ah oo ku saabsan COVID-19 oo ku saabsan bandowga, masaafada bulshada, iyo dhaqidda gacmaha #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: PATH sani chopo nyithind nyiri kod mon matindo ma nigi pek, e ward 51 moting'o kaunti mag Kisumu, HomaBay kod Migori ka oriwre gi @MOH_Kenya @PoliceKE mondo omi weche madongo mag COVID-19 ewi kafiu, bedo mabor gi jowetegi, lwoko lwedo #KomeshaCorona update

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya activates an emergency response plan for flooding in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya yaanzisha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay hirgelinaysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ku saabsan fatahaadaha Gobolka Kwale.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chako tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne ataro mar pi e gweng' mar Kwale.

English: An Analysis on Cyclic Variations that Indicate a Catastrophic Famine Event in East Africa in 2028-2035
Kiswahili: Uchambuzi wa Tofauti za Baiskeli ambazo Zinaonyesha Tukio la Janga la Njaa katika Afrika Mashariki mnamo 2028-2035
Somali: Falanqayn ku saabsan Isbeddellada Wareegga ah ee Tilmaamaya Dhacdo Macaluul ah oo ka Dhacday Bariga Afrika 2028-2035
Dholuo: Nonro kuom pogruok ma timore e kinde ma nyiso ni kech maduong’ biro timore e Afrika ma Wuokchieng’ e higa mar 2028-2035

English: Train on climate education 2023.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo juu ya elimu ya hali ya hewa 2023.
Somali: Tababar ku saabsan waxbarashada cimilada 2023.
Dholuo: Chenro mar tiego ji e wi tiegruok e wi weche mag lokruok e kor lwasi e higa mar 2023.

English: E-Citizen reminds residents of Nyamira County that access to national ID applications is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba kufikia maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira in helitaanka codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa jogweng' Nyamira County ni yudo kwayo mag ID mar piny sani yot moloyo kokalo kuom yore mag tich.

English: SHA urges eligible citizens in Bomet County to participate in voter education.
Kiswahili: SHA inawasihi wananchi wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Bomet kushiriki katika elimu ya wapiga kura.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Bomet inay ka qaybqaataan waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jokanyo mag county mar Bomet mondo oriwre e tiegruok mar josiasa.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges millet growers in Vihiga County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawasihi wakulima wa millet katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurudisha uzazi wa udongo ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda dhirta ee degmada Vihiga inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalaalka ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur ma pidho millet e County mar Vihiga mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber mondo omi nyak obed maber e higani.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties warns public officers in Samburu County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Samburu dhidi ya kutumia vibaya mamlaka.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa ka digaya saraakiisha dowladda ee gobolka Samburu inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Samburu ni kik giti marach gi migepegi.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds mobile money users in Tharaka-Nithi County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e gweng' mar Tharaka-Nithi ni mondo ging'e kwayo mag pesa kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo kik giyud weche mag phishing.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya launches county development projects in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya wilaya katika Wilaya ya Kitui.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay bilowday mashaariic horumarineed oo ka socda degmada Kitui.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Huduma Kenya chako tije mag dongruok e gweng' mar Kitui County.

English: Clean thoughts, brings forth good working relationship at work. Lets cultivate good working relationships where we work in support of mental health care in contribution to a working force that is clean in all ways.
Kiswahili: Mawazo safi, huleta uhusiano mzuri wa kazi kazini. Hebu kukuza mahusiano mazuri ya kazi ambapo tunafanya kazi katika kusaidia huduma ya afya ya akili katika mchango kwa nguvu ya kazi ambayo ni safi kwa njia zote.
Somali: Fikradaha nadiifka ah waxay soo saaraan xiriir shaqo oo wanaagsan oo shaqada ah, waxaanu horumarin karnaa xiriiro shaqo oo fiican oo aan ka shaqeyno taageerada daryeelka caafimaadka dhimirka si aan u gacan ka geysano shaqaale si buuxda u nadiif ah.
Dholuo: Parruok maler kelo winjruok maber e tich, kendo miyo wabedo gi winjruok maber mar tich, ka watiyo e siro weche thieth mar pach mondo omi jotich obed maler e yore duto.

English: The export ban on macadamia remains in effect Farmers are advised to stay updated on any future changes regarding this policy
Kiswahili: Marufuku ya kuuza nje ya makadamia bado inatumika Wakulima wanashauriwa kusasishwa kuhusu mabadiliko yoyote yajayo kuhusu sera hii
Somali: Xayiraadda dhoofinta macadamia ayaa weli dhaqan galka ah Beeraleyda waxaa lagula talinayaa inay sii joogaan wararka ku saabsan isbeddellada mustaqbalka ee ku saabsan siyaasaddan
Dholuo: Oganda mar Jo-Farmer ma ne ogolo chik mar golo macadamia e pinje mamoko, ne oketo chik mondo kik giketh chenrono.

English: Public health advisory: CDC warns of increased HIV/AIDS risk in Marsabit County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: CDC inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya VVU/UKIMWI katika Kaunti ya Marsabit na inashauri umma kutumia vyandarua vya mbu vilivyotibiwa na dawa kila usiku.
Somali: Talooyinka caafimaadka dadweynaha: CDC waxay ka digeysaa khatarta sii kordheysa ee HIV / AIDS ee degmada Marsabit waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: CDC chiwo siem kuom wach medo bedo gi tuo mar AYAKI/SIDA e taon mar Marsabit County kendo ojiwo ji mondo oti gi gige ywayo le otieno ka otieno.

English: Judiciary of Kenya warns public officers in Migori County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Migori dhidi ya kutumia vibaya mamlaka yao.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Migori inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e kaunti mar Migori ni kik giti marach gi migepegi.

English: Tiaty worst hit with 40% of residents affected. 2 people lost their lives last month due to Malaria. Govt distributing long-lasting treated mosquito nets
Kiswahili: Tiaty imeathiriwa zaidi na 40% ya wakazi walioathiriwa. Watu 2 walipoteza maisha yao mwezi uliopita kutokana na Malaria. Serikali yasambaza vyandarua vilivyotibiwa kwa muda mrefu
Somali: Tiaty ayaa ah tii ugu daran ee ay saameysay 40% dadka deggan. Laba qof ayaa ku dhintay bishii la soo dhaafay sababtoo ah Malaria. Dowladda ayaa qeybinaysa shabagyada cayayaanka ee muddo dheer lagu daaweeyey
Dholuo: Ji ariyo ne otho dwe mokalo nikech malaria.

English: Kenya Medical Association appeals to caregivers in Kisumu County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the October maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari Kenya kinatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi Oktoba.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ka codsadaa daryeelayaasha degmada Kisumu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka ee Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association okwayo jorit e County mar Kisumu mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Laikipia County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Laikipia inuu ka qayb galo kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pachgi e County mar Laikipia mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: KICD urges residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: KICD inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: KICD waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay codsadaan deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KICD ojiwo ji duto modak e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud somo mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: Register your child_x0092_s birth early to secure legal identity and access to services.
Kiswahili: Kuandikisha kuzaliwa kwa mtoto wako mapema ili kupata utambulisho wa kisheria na upatikanaji wa huduma.
Somali: Diiwaangeli dhalashada ilmaha_x0092_s goor hore si aad u hesho aqoonsi sharci iyo helitaanka adeegyada.
Dholuo: Ndik nyuol mar nyathini_x0092_mapile mondo iyud ranyisi mar chik kendo yudo kony.

English: Public notice: CDC will host a free diabetes screening outreach in Narok County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: CDC itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uchunguzi wa kisukari bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Narok Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: CDC waxay martigelin doontaa baaritaano bukaan-socod ah oo bilaash ah oo lagu ogaanayo cudurka macaanka ee gobolka Narok bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth miluongo ni CDC biro timo nonro ma onge chudo mar kansa e taon mar Narok e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association confirms a Rift Valley Fever outbreak alert for Murang'a County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari Kenya chathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa katika Kaunti ya Murang'a. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu xaqiijiyay digniin ku saabsan cudurka Cudurka Rift Valley ee Gobolka Murang'a. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Medical Association osenyiso ni nitie masira mar Rift Valley Fever e kaunti mar Murang'a.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Nyandarua County this July.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Julai hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhawaaqay jimicsi tallaal oo bilaash ah oo cudurka Newcastle ee lo'da caanaha ah ee Gobolka Nyandarua bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service olando chenro mar thieth mar tuo mar Newcastle ma onge chudo ne dhok makwayo chak e County mar Nyandarua e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will conduct a modern irrigation techniques workshop for farmers in Bungoma County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itafanya warsha ya kisasa ya mbinu za umwagiliaji kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Machi hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah ee beeraleyda degmada Bungoma bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Bura mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro timo chokruok mar timo nonro e wi yore mag lero pi ne jopur e County mar Bungoma e dwe mar Mach.

English: E-Citizen reminds residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba upatikanaji wa usajili wa raia wa elektroniki sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in hadda helitaanka diiwaangelinta e-muwaadiniinta ay ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County ni yudo e e-C citizen registration koro yot ahinya kokalo kuom chenro mag sirkal.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds needy students in Homa Bay County that school laptops under the digital literacy programme applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya maombi ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika za kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya ardayda u baahan gobolka Homa Bay in laptop-yada dugsiga ee ku jira codsiyada barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne jopuonjre modhier man Homa Bay County ni kompyuta mag skul manie bwo program mar somo gi somo mar digital chiegni rumo.

English: Notice: KRA opens the electoral calendar centres in Uasin Gishu County this April.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay furaysaa xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee gobolka Uasin Gishu bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KRA chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e kaunti mar Uasin Gishu e dwe mar April.

English: KNEC advises applicants in Migori County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KNEC inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Migori kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KNEC waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Migori inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: KNEC nyiso jogo madwaro donjo e sirkal mar Migori ni gidonj e skundno kapok gichopo e chokruok mabiro.

English: IPOA reminds residents of Siaya County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah inta lagu jiro xilliyada dabka.
Dholuo: IPOA parone jogweng'o mag Siaya County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji moa e sirkandno e kinde mag yiengni.

English: Notice: KEMRI confirms a meningitis outbreak alert for Kisii County. Residents are advised to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa uti wa mgongo kwa Kaunti ya Kisii. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ku saabsan cudurka meningitis ee degmada Kisii. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KEMRI osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuo mar meningitis e gweng' mar Kisii. Ojiwo jogweng'no mondo kik giriwre gi pi mochido.

English: NCPB informs maize farmers in Embu County of new market linkage opportunities this January.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawafahamisha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Embu kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Januari hii.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Embu fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: NCPB ong'eyo jopur mag kodhi e county mar Embu kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: COMESA will conduct a post-harvest handling workshop for farmers in Kwale County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ka dib goosashada beeraleyda ee Gobolka Kwale bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA biro timo chokruok mar timo nonro bang' keyo ne jopur e taon mar Kwale e dwe mar Jun.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Busia County about the importance of hypertension awareness for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Busia juu ya umuhimu wa ufahamu wa shinikizo la damu kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMRI waxay dadka degmada Busia ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay wacyiga cadaadiska dhiig karka ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMRI parone ji duto e County mar Busia kuom ber mar miyo ji ong'e ni tuwo mar hypertension en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: FAO advises farmers in Nandi County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: FAO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuleta nambari yao ya usajili wa mkulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: FAO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nandi inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qayb galaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e county mar Nandi mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: HELB reminds youth in Tana River County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Tana River kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Tana River in maalgelinta HELD ay diyaar u tahay tababarka farsamada gawaarida gawaarista.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa rowere manie taon mar Tana River County ni pesa ma giyudo kuom riwruokno yudore ne tiegruok mar jomisonari mag mtokni.

English: For low birth weight babies, Kangaroo Mother Care â€” skin-to-skin contact â€” is recommended to regulate body temperature, improve breastfeeding, and boost survival.
Kiswahili: Kwa watoto waliozaliwa na uzito mdogo, Huduma ya Mama ya Kangaroo - mguso wa ngozi kwa ngozi - unapendekezwa ili kudhibiti joto la mwili, kuboresha unyonyeshaji, na kuongeza maisha.
Somali: Carruurta miisaankoodu hooseeyo, Kangaroo Mother Care - taabashada maqaarka - ayaa lagula talinayaa inay xakameyso heerkulka jirka, hagaajiso naasnuujinta, iyo inay kor u qaaddo badbaadada.
Dholuo: Kuom nyithindo ma nigi kilo matin e kinde ma ginyuolo, ipuonjo ni ng’ato otim gik ma rito ng’ato ka ng’ato â€” mondo orit ng’ich mar ringre, ober ng’ado ng’ut nyathi, kendo omed ng’ado ngima.

English: A triple emergency in Kenya amid malaria and measles outbreaks
Kiswahili: Dharura mara tatu nchini Kenya huku kukiwa na milipuko ya malaria na surua
Somali: Xaalad degdeg ah oo saddex jibaaran oo ka jirta Kenya xilli ay jiraan cudurro ka dillaacay duumada iyo jadeecada
Dholuo: Masira adek e piny Kenya e kind tuoche mag maleria kod tuo mag otho

English: Huduma Kenya reminds residents of Samburu County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba upatikanaji wa utunzaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Samburu in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya parone ji modak e county mar Samburu ni koro nyalo bedo mayot yudo barua mar nyuol ka gitiyo gi yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Public notice: KEMRI will host a free hypertension awareness outreach in Vihiga County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMRI itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis dadweyne: KEMRI waxay qaban doonta wacyi-gelin bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cadaadiska dhiig karka ee Degmada Vihiga bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar ji duto: KEMRI biro timo kampen mar chiwo paro ne ji kuom wach rembe mang'eny e dwe mar Januar e kaunti mar Vihiga.
