English: Notice from SHA (Social Health Authority): nutrition supplementation for infants clinics will run every February at designated health centres in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii): nyongeza ya lishe kwa kliniki za watoto wachanga itaendeshwa kila Februari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada): Kordhinta nafaqada ee rugta caafimaadka ee dhallaanka ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Febraayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Rieko moa kuom SHA (Social Health Authority): chiemo moromo mag nyithindo mayom biro dhi nyime higa ka higa e dwe mar Februar e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Kirinyaga.

English: Keeping newborns in skin-to-skin contact with mothers helps regulate temperature, heartbeat, and supports immune development.
Kiswahili: Kuwaweka watoto wachanga katika mgusano wa ngozi na mama husaidia kudhibiti halijoto, mapigo ya moyo, na kusaidia ukuaji wa kinga mwilini.
Somali: Marka ilmaha cusub la xiriiro hooyooyinka maqaarka ilaa maqaarka waxay ka caawisaa xakamaynta heerkulka, garaaca wadnaha, waxayna taageertaa horumarinta difaaca jirka.
Dholuo: Bedo machiegni gi min nyathi ma eka oa nyuol konyo e chiko liet mar dende, goyo mar chuny, kendo miyo ng'ato bedo gi teko mar geng'o tuoche.

English: Notice: DPP opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay furaysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya taageero maskaxeed ee Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DPP ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony e weche mag pach ji e gweng' mar Kakamega.

English: It_x0092_s important to take care of your mental health because it can impact every aspect of your life, including your relationships, your academic performance, and your physical health.
Kiswahili: Ni muhimu kutunza afya yako ya akili kwa sababu inaweza kuathiri kila nyanja ya maisha yako, ikiwa ni pamoja na uhusiano wako, utendaji wako wa kitaaluma, na afya yako.
Somali: Waa muhiim inaad daryeesho caafimaadkaaga maskaxda sababtoo ah waxay saameyn kartaa dhinac kasta oo noloshaada ah, oo ay ku jiraan xiriirkaaga, waxqabadkaaga waxbarasho, iyo caafimaadkaaga jireed.
Dholuo: En gima duong’ mondo ibed gi ritruok e wi ngimani mar paro nikech mano nyalo ketho gik moko duto e ngimani, moriwo nyaka osiepni, kaka isomo maber e somo, kod ngimani mar ringruok.

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health will host a free hand hygiene outreach in West Pokot County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mikono bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay martigelin doontaa barnaamij caafimaad oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan nadaafadda gacmaha ee Gobolka West Pokot bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth biro timo kampen mar rito ler mar lwedo e West Pokot County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: KTDA informs maize farmers in Kitui County of new market linkage opportunities this August.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawafahamisha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Agosti hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Kitui fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Ogosto.
Dholuo: KTDA nyiso jopur mag kodhi e gweng' mar Kitui kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Agost.

English: Universities Fund invites youth in Bungoma County to enroll for electrical installation training this February.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Februari hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku casuumay dhalinyarada degmada Bungoma inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund gwelo rowere mag Bungoma County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar keto sitima e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Trans Nzoia County this July. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitafanya kongamano la kurejesha matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Julai hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa qaban doonta madasha soo kabashada isticmaalka maandooriyaha ee Gobolka Trans Nzoia bishii Luulyo. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo chokruok mar reso joma tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero e Trans Nzoia County e dwe mar Julai.

English: KNEC advises applicants in Migori County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Migori kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Migori inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee la heli karo.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Migori mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: Teachers Service Commission advises students in Nyeri County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kufikia kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ardayda degmada Nyeri kula talinayaa inay dalbadaan bogga waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jopuonjre e Kaunti mar Nyeri mondo okonygi tiyo gi websait mar somo e yor intanet mondo giyud thuolo mar tiyo gi kompyuta mag skul e bwo chenro mar somo gi somo mar digital.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education opens a new tailoring and design programme at the vocational centre in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu inafungua programu mpya ya ushonaji na muundo katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ka furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan dharka iyo naqshadeynta xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Mandera.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Puonjruok chako chenro manyien mar loso kendo loso gik moko e kambi mar tiegruok e taon mar Mandera.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development restricts movement of pigs in Bungoma County due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo yazuia harakati za nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Newcastle.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa doofaarka degmada Bungoma sababo la xiriira cudurka Newcastle.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ogeng'o wuoth mar le e County mar Bungoma nikech tuo mar Newcastle.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Vihiga County this January. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitafanya kongamano la kurejesha matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Januari hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa qaban doonta madasha soo kabashada xadgudubka maandooriyaha ee Degmada Vihiga bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo chokruok mar reso joma tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero e County mar Vihiga e dwe mar Januar.

English: Proponents argue that genetic engineering has the capability to resolve or mitigate many of the most critical problems facing agriculture: conservation of ...
Kiswahili: Watetezi wanasema kwamba uhandisi wa kijenetiki una uwezo wa kutatua au kupunguza matatizo mengi muhimu yanayokabili kilimo: uhifadhi wa ...
Somali: Taageerayaashu waxay ku doodayaan in injineerinka hidde-sideyaasha uu awood u leeyahay inuu xalliyo ama yareeyo dhibaatooyinka ugu muhiimsan ee wajahaya beeraha: ilaalinta ...
Dholuo: Joma riwo lwedo weche mag gene wacho ni injinia mar del nigi nyalo mar tieko kata tieko chandruoge madongo ma jopur romogo: rito ...

English: COMESA reminds farmers in Samburu County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu juu ya programu inayoendelea ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa wakulima.
Somali: COMESA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Samburu in barnaamijka tababarka beeralayda uu socdo.
Dholuo: COMESA oparo ne jopur manie county mar Samburu chenro mar tiego jopur ma sani dhi nyime.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises fish producers in Garissa County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inashauri wazalishaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kalluunka ee Gobolka Garissa inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development nyiso jopur ma loso rech e County mar Garissa mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mabiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: NDMA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Homa Bay County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba upatikanaji wa maelekezo ya makazi salama unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay gobolka Homa Bay in helitaanka tixraacyada magangelyo ammaan ah ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e Homa Bay County ni thuolo mar yudo kuonde ma ginyalo dakie en gima ng'ato nyalo yudo maonge chudo.

English: DPP calls on the community in Bungoma County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: DPP inawatia moyo jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: DPP waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Bungoma inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wacayaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: DPP okwayo ji duto manie Bungoma County mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong simo mar GBV 1195.

English: COMESA urges farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo lagu soo uruuriyo biyaha beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges the public in Kirinyaga County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Kenya Red Cross inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kirinyaga inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda kadib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ji duto e County mar Kirinyaga mondo ochiw ripot mar ote ma ok kare ne jatendgi mar tich bang' yudo ripot mag chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo.

English: HELB urges youth in Kitui County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Kitui kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: HELB waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kitui inay ka qaybqaataan munaasabadda dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo rowere ma Kitui County mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gitimo gik ma biro timore ne oganda.

English: Notice: KUCCPS opens a new welding and fabrication programme at the vocational centre in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inafungua programu mpya ya kulehemu na utengenezaji katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan alxanka iyo soo saarista xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KUCCPS ochako chenro manyien mar loso kendo loso gik moko e kambi mar tiegruok e gweng' mar Kisii.

English: 100 Christian, Muslim and Hindu religious leaders join the fight against new HIV infections, teenage pregnancies, and gender-based violence
Kiswahili: Viongozi 100 wa dini za Kikristo, Kiislamu na Kihindu washiriki katika mapambano dhidi ya maambukizi mapya ya VVU, mimba za utotoni na ukatili wa kijinsia.
Somali: 100 hoggaamiye diimeed oo Masiixiyiin, Muslimiin iyo Hindu ah ayaa ku biiray dagaalka ka dhanka ah caabuqyada cusub ee HIV, uurka dhallinyarada, iyo rabshadaha ku salaysan jinsiga.
Dholuo: Jotelo 100 mag dinde mag Jokristo, Jo-Muslam kod Jo-Hindu oriwre e lweny mar kedo gi twoche manyien mag HIV, nyuol mag rowere, kod tuke mitimore ne ji chuech

English: Notice: e-Citizen opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa ajili ya usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kitui County.
Somali: Ogeysiis: e-Citizen waxay ka furaysaa xarun adeeg cusub oo lagu shaqeynayo shahaadada dhalashada ee Gobolka Kitui.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: e-Citizen oseyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag loso nyasi mag nyuol e gweng' mar Kitui.

English: SHA encourages first-time voters in Mombasa County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: SHA inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: SHA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Mombasa inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo joma okwongo yiero e county mar Mombasa mondo onon weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: Pre-crisis Market Mapping and Analysis Report for the Counties of West Pokot and Kitui (Sept - Oct 2021)
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Ramani ya Masoko na Uchambuzi wa kabla ya mgogoro kwa Kaunti za Pokot Magharibi na Kitui (Sep - Okt 2021)
Somali: Warbixinta Falanqaynta iyo Khariidaynta Suuqa ee Kahor Dhibaatada ee Degmooyinka Galbeedka Pokot iyo Kitui (Sebtembar - Oktoobar 2021)
Dholuo: Ripot mar loso map mar chiro kapok masira ochopo kod nono mag kaunti mag Pokot ma milambo kod kitui (Swetemba - Oktoba 2021)

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Kajiado County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wakazi wa Kajiado County kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili kuwajulisha juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika kiwango cha wilaya.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay la xiriiraan maamulaha qaybta maxalliga ah si ay uga warqabaan bixinta adeegga heerka qaybta.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo ji duto modak Kajiado County mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jotelo mag utegi mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche duto e wi tij lendo ma itimo e utegi.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges youth in Siaya County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Siaya inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada rayidka ah ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada rayidnimada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education ojiwo rowere e county mar Siaya mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok ochopo gik ma biro timore e kind oganda.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kwale County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba upatikanaji wa kumbukumbu za makazi salama zinapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee Gobolka Kwale in helitaanka tixraacyada magangelyo ammaan ah la heli karo lacag la'aan.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Kwale ni thuolo mar yudo kuonde mag dak ma onge tuoche yudore nono.

English: KEMRI reminds the public that free dengue fever screening is available at all public health centres in Kakamega County this July.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa homa ya dengue bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Julai hii.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka xanuunka dengue ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynta ee Gobolka Kakamega bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: KEMRI parone ji ni thieth ma onge chudo mar dengue yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County Kakamega e dwe mar Julai.

English: NTSA warns residents of Marsabit County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: NTSA waxay ka digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit oo ku saabsan kororka khiyaamada SIM-swap waxayna ku talineysaa dadweynaha inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban.
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar Marsabit County e wi medruok mar wuond mar loko SIM kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for goats in Marsabit County this May.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Mei hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku dhawaaqday jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan cadhada lo'da ee Gobolka Marsabit bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) ogolo chenro mar thiedho diek maonge chudo mar rabies e Marsabit County e dwe mar abich.

English: TVET conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Trans Nzoia County this September.
Kiswahili: TVET inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Septemba hii.
Somali: TVET waxay bishii Sebtember ku qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan wareejinta degmada Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: E dwe mar Septemba, TVET dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi weche mag golo pesa e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia.

English: Ministry of Health urges residents of Kiambu County to complete the full recommended vaccination dose following a rise in reported malaria cases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya malaria vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay dhammaystiraan qiyaasta tallaalka oo dhan ee lagula talinayo ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska fayraska ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Kiambu mondo ochop e okang' moromo mar thieth ma gichiwo bang' medruok mar tuo mar malaria.

English: WFP and UNESCO welcome funding from the Netherlands to boost food security for communities living along the shores of Lake Turkana
Kiswahili: WFP na UNESCO wanakaribisha ufadhili kutoka Uholanzi ili kuimarisha usalama wa chakula kwa jamii zinazoishi kando ya ziwa Turkana.
Somali: Hay'adda WFP iyo UNESCO ayaa soo dhaweeyay maalgelinta ka timid Netherlands si kor loogu qaado amniga cuntada ee bulshooyinka ku nool xeebaha Harada Turkana.
Dholuo: WFP kod UNESCO rwako pesa ma piny Netherlands chiwo mondo omed yudo chiemo ne oganda ma odak e dho nam Turkana .

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development encourages farmers in Vihiga County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for avocado.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kupata bei bora ya parachichi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Vihiga inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan avocado.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur e county mar Vihiga mondo oti gi nengo matin mar avocado mondo giyud nengo maber.

English: Always lock doors and windows when leaving home, even for short periods.
Kiswahili: Daima funga milango na madirisha unapoondoka nyumbani, hata kwa muda mfupi.
Somali: Had iyo jeer albaabada iyo daaqadaha xidh markaad guriga ka baxdo, xitaa muddo gaaban.
Dholuo: Kinde duto ing'i dhoudi koda dirise sama iwuok e ot, kata mana kuom kinde machuok.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Kakamega County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kakamega in adeegyada bukaanka dibedda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMRI oparo ne ji duto e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni koro ginyalo yudo kony mag thieth e kuonde moketi.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will conduct a fertiliser application workshop for farmers in Kisii County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itaendesha warsha ya maombi ya mbolea kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan isticmaalka bacriminta beeraleyda degmada Kisii bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEPHIS biro timo chokruok mar tiyo gi yien mag yien ne jopur e County mar Kisii e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges residents of Turkana County to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility following a rise in reported cyclosporiasis cases.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kutafuta uchunguzi wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya cyclosporiasis.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow kadib kororka kiisaska cyclosporiasis ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo jogweng' Turkana County mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni nikech kwan mar joma nigi cyclosporiasis osemedore.

English: Teachers Service Commission encourages residents of Kisii County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay ka qeybgalaan madasha dadweynaha degmada si ay uga warqabaan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jogweng' mar Kisii mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county mondo ging'e tich mar Ombudsman.

English: KEPHIS encourages farmers in Wajir County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for horticultural produce.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za mazao ya bustani.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Wajir inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay wax soo saarka beeraha.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Wajir mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro mar chulo osuru mondo omi ohala obed maber.

English: Notice: Universities Fund reminds citizens in Tharaka-Nithi County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu muwaadiniinta degmada Tharaka-Nithi xusuusinayaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: Rapar: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa raia mag Tharaka-Nithi County kuom ratiro ma gin-go e wi ratiro mag chik.

English: Notice: KUCCPS announces bursary allocation enrollment dates for schools in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa ugawaji wa bursary kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ee dugsiyada gobolka Bomet.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KUCCPS landoga tarik ma ne idhi yiergo skunde mag Bomet County mondo giyud bursary.

English: Mpox symptoms include fever, rash, and swollen lymph nodes. Seek medical care immediately if you notice any of these.
Kiswahili: Dalili za Mpox ni pamoja na homa, upele, na uvimbe wa tezi za limfu. Tafuta huduma ya matibabu mara moja ikiwa utagundua yoyote kati ya haya.
Somali: Calaamadaha Mpox waxaa ka mid ah hargabka, ciribtirka, iyo qanjirka lymph node ee bararka.
Dholuo: Ranyisi mag tuwo mar Mpox oriwo bedo gi tuwo mar muoch, tuwo mar apaka, kod ng'injo mar lymph nodes. Tem manyo thieth mapiyo kapo ni ineno gimoro kuomgi.

English: Notice: IPOA activates an emergency response plan for drought in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ukame katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay hirgelinaysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo abaaraha ku dhaca gobolka Kwale.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA chako tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony e kinde ma kech nobedie e gweng' mar Kwale.

English: IEBC advises applicants in Nyamira County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kutembelea kituo cha mafunzo ya ufundi kilicho karibu zaidi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Nyamira inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee la heli karo.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Nyamira mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: State Department for TVET urges youth in Uasin Gishu County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Uasin Gishu inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda ka hor dhacdooyinka bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET ojiwo rowere manie Uasin Gishu County mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto giseyudo kapok gitimo tije mag oganda.

English: Notice: KICD reminds citizens in Baringo County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Baringo ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KICD paronwa raia mag Baringo County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar konyo ji e weche mag pesa mag county.

English: The CS also met with EU Head of Mission Ambassador Simon Mordue who also paid him.a courtesy call at his office.
Kiswahili: Waziri huyo pia alikutana na Mkuu wa Balozi wa Umoja wa Ulaya Simon Mordue ambaye pia alimtembelea ofisini kwake.
Somali: Xoghayaha guud wuxuu sidoo kale la kulmay Safiirka Midowga Yurub ee Arrimaha Soomaaliya Simon Mordue oo isna xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay.
Dholuo: CS bende ne oromo gi Jatend Misango mar EU, Simon Mordue ma bende nomiyogi chudo.
