Kiswahili: Kutahiriwa ni hatua yenye maumivu ambayo huacha mawazo ya kudumu nyuma, na inaweza kusababisha afya ya akili
Somali: Gudniinka waa tallaabo xanuun badan oo ka dambeeya fikradaha joogtada ah, waxayna sababi kartaa caafimaadka maskaxda
Dholuo: Terruok en gima lit ma miyo ng'ato bedo gi paro maok kare, kendo mano nyalo miyo obed gi parruok mang'eny

English: Notice: KEPHIS restricts movement of poultry in Kajiado County due to a foot and mouth disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS inazuia harakati za kuku katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa digaagga ee Gobolka Kajiado sababo la xiriira faafitaanka cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS ogeng'o wuoth mar le mag dhok e Kajiado County nikech tuwo mar dhoho.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on the community in Kajiado County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawaalika jamii katika Kajiado County kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwa ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Kajiado inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross okwayo ji duto manie Kajiado County mondo owuo e wi timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo onyis ji weche ma kamago e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: DCI reminds mobile money users in Garissa County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee Gobolka Garissa inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: DCI paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e gweng' mar Garissa ni mondo ging'e kwayo mag pesa kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo gitang' gi weche mag phishing.

English: Notice: NTSA opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: Ogsoonow: NTSA waxay furaysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya taageero maskaxeed iyo bulsheed degmada Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NTSA ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony e weche mag pach ji e kaunti mar Nyandarua.

English: SHA urges residents of Makueni County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight abuse of office.
Kiswahili: SHA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia simu ya EACC ya bure ili kupambana na matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee EACC si looga hortago xadgudubka xilka.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jogweng' Makueni County mondo oland weche mag mibadhi kokalo kuom simo mar EACC maonge chudo mondo giked gi timbe mag tiyo marach gi migepe.

English: Nyeri (Kieni) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Nyeri (Kieni): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Aprili 2023
Somali: Degmada Nyeri (Kieni): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Nyeri (Kieni): Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro dwe mar Ang'wen 2023

English: All pregnant women are urged to attend health clinics every month for medical checkups to ensure their safety and the safety of their unborn babies until delivery.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wote wajawazito wanaombwa kuhudhuria kliniki ya afya kila mwezi ili kupata uchunguzi na kuhakikisha usalama wao na wa watoto wao hadi wakati wa kujifungua.
Somali: Dhammaan haweenka uurka leh waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay bil kasta tagaan xarumaha caafimaadka si ay u sameeyaan baaritaanno caafimaad si loo hubiyo badqabkooda iyo badqabka ilmahooda uurka ku jira ilaa ay ka dhalayaan.
Dholuo: Mond duto ma nigi ich ojiw mondo odhi e klinik mag thieth dwe ka dwe mondo otimnegi nonro mar thieth mondo gine ni gin gi arita maber kendo gine ni nyithindgi ma pok onyuol nigi arita maber nyaka ginyuol.
resource: Ministry of Health & Kisii County Health Public Service Announcements

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Red Cross will be held in Embu County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Embu Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Degmada Embu bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kamp mar thieth ma Kenya Red Cross ochano biro timore e taon mar Embu e dwe mar Jun.

English: Kenya Medical Association announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County starting this May.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuanzia Mei hii.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya ayaa ku dhawaaqay in laga bilaabo bisha May ee soo socota la siinayo dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association olando thieth mar dialysis kuom joma odak e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet kochakore dwe mar abich.

English: KNEC has released the 2025 KCSE examination timetable for all candidates.
Kiswahili: KNEC imechapisha ratiba ya mitihani ya KCSE ya 2025 kwa wagombea wote.
Somali: KNEC waxay soo saartay jadwalka imtixaanka KCSE ee 2025 dhammaan musharixiinta.
Dholuo: KNEC osegoyo chenro mar penj mar KCSE mar 2025 ne jokanyo duto.

English: KUCCPS advises students in Machakos County to collect materials from the county education office to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Machakos kukusanya vifaa kutoka kwa ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ardayda degmada Machakos kula talineysaa inay ka soo ururiyaan waxyaabo xafiiska waxbarashada degmada si ay u helaan buugaag waxbarasho iyo qalab waxbarasho.
Dholuo: KUCCPS nyiso jopuonjre e county mar Machakos mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar tiegruok mar county mondo giyud buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok.

English: KTDA reminds farmers in Nyeri County of the ongoing fertiliser application training programme.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya matumizi ya mbolea.
Somali: KTDA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyeri barnaamijka tababarka codsiga bacriminta ee socda.
Dholuo: KTDA parone jopur man Nyeri County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar tiyo gi yien.

English: IPOA alerts residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Somali: IPOA waxay ka digtay dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in ay kordheen kiisaska gaadiidka la xaday waxayna dadka ku talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan in ay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: IPOA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County e wi medruok mar wach kwalo mtokni kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag ritruok gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: NTSA urges anyone experiencing abuse in West Pokot County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NTSA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Wilaya ya West Pokot kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka gobolka West Pokot inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e West Pokot County mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: â€œYou can recover from COVID-19,â€ President Uhuru Kenyatta assures Kenyans in a video conferencing call with two recoveries Brenda and Brain at Afya House today. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Unaweza kupona COVID-19," Rais Uhuru Kenyatta awahakikishia Wakenya kwenye simu ya video na waliopona Brenda na Brain katika Afya House leo. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: "Waad ka soo kaban kartaa COVID-19," ayuu Madaxweyne Uhuru Kenyatta ku xaqiijiyay dadka reer Kenya shir muuqaal ah oo uu la yeeshay Brenda iyo Brain oo ka soo kabanaya cudurka maanta oo ay ku kulmeen Afya House. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: â€œInyalo chango kuom tuo mar COVID-19,â€ Jatend piny owacho Uhuru Kenyatta ojiwo jo Kenya e mbui mar video gi jogo ariyo ma osechango Brenda kod Brain e ot mar Afya kawuono. #KomeshaKorona

English: KEMSA urges residents of Siaya County to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night following a rise in reported malaria cases.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya malaria vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta ka dib kororka kiisaska fayraska ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' county mar Siaya mondo oti gi otamba molos gi ndawa otieno ka otieno nikech kwan mar joma nigi malaria osemedore.

English: Notice: FAO will train farmers in Embu County on agroforestry this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu juu ya kilimo cha misitu Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Embu ee beeraha iyo kaymaha bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: FAO biro tiego jopur e county mar Embu e weche mag yiengni mag bunge e dwe mar Februar.

English: National Drought Early Warning Bulletin (July 2023)
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Tahadhari ya Mapema ya Kitaifa (Julai 2023)
Somali: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Qaranka (Luulyo 2023)
Dholuo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro (abiriyo 2023)

English: Announcement setting national target to increase milk production to 10 billion liters, supporting dairy livelihoods and nutrition.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la kuweka lengo la kitaifa la kuongeza uzalishaji wa maziwa hadi lita bilioni 10, kusaidia maisha ya maziwa na lishe.
Somali: Ogeysiis dejinaya bartilmaameed qaran oo ah in la kordhiyo wax soo saarka caanaha ilaa 10 bilyan litir, taasoo taageeraysa nolosha caanaha iyo nafaqada.
Dholuo: Owacho ni chenro mar piny mangima mar medo yien mar chak nyaka lita bilion 10 biro konyo e miyo ji ngima maber kendo e miyo ji chiemo maber.

English: The government has authorized the duty free importation of 500 000 metric tonnes of rice impacting local farmers Urgent action is needed to clear unsold rice stock before imports begin
Kiswahili: Serikali imeidhinisha uingizaji wa tani 500,000 za mchele bila kutozwa ushuru unaoathiri wakulima wa ndani Hatua za haraka zinahitajika ili kuondoa mchele ambao haujauzwa kabla ya kuanza kuagiza.
Somali: Dowladda ayaa oggolaatay in la soo dhoofiyo 500 000 ton oo bariis ah oo canshuur la'aan ah, taas oo saameyn ku yeelanaysa beeraleyda deegaanka waxaa loo baahan yahay tallaabo deg deg ah si loo tirtiro kaydka bariiska aan la iibin ka hor inta aan la bilaabin soo dejinta
Dholuo: Sirkal oseyie mondo oket tenge tenge mzabibu ma romo ton 500 000 maok ochul tenge, kendo mano mulo jopur manie alworano. Dwarore ni otim mapiyo mondo otiek ohala ma ne ok ong'iew kapok ohala ochakore

English: Council of Governors invites residents of Samburu County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku martiqaadaan dadka deggan degmada Samburu inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch ogwelo ji duto modak e county mar Samburu mondo oriwre gi county's online participation portal e wi chenro mag dongruok.

English: Refugees in Dadaab currently receive limited water, healthcare, and education services, but continuing food and cash assistance remain central to their survival.
Kiswahili: Wakimbizi katika Dadaab kwa sasa wanapokea huduma chache za maji, afya, na elimu, lakini msaada wa chakula na pesa taslimu unaoendelea unasalia kuwa msingi wa maisha yao.
Somali: Qaxootiga ku nool Dhadhaab hadda waxay helaan biyo xaddidan, daryeel caafimaad, iyo adeegyo waxbarasho, laakiin gargaarka cuntada iyo lacagta caddaanka ah ee sii socda ayaa weli ah udub-dhexaadka badbaadadooda.
Dholuo: Jolweny ma Dadaab sani yudo pi matin, thieth, kod somo, kata kamano, dhi nyime gi yudo chiemo kod kony mar pesa pod en gima duong’ ahinya e ngimagi.

English: For low birth weight babies, Kangaroo Mother Care Â— skin-to-skin contact Â— is recommended to regulate body temperature, improve breastfeeding, and boost survival.
Kiswahili: Kwa watoto waliozaliwa na uzito mdogo, Huduma ya Mama ya Kangaroo â— mguso wa ngozi kwa ngozi â— inapendekezwa ili kudhibiti joto la mwili, kuboresha unyonyeshaji, na kuongeza maisha.
Somali: Carruurta miisaankoodu hooseeyo, Daryeelka Hooyada Kangaroo - taabashada maqaarka - ayaa lagu talinayaa si loo xakameeyo heerkulka jidhka, loo wanaajiyo naasnuujinta, loona kordhiyo badbaadada.
Dholuo: Kuom nyithindo ma nigi pek matin e nyuol, ipuonjo ni ng’ato otim gik ma nyalo konyo e rito ng’ato gi ng’ato e del— mondo orit ng’ich mar ringre, ober ng’ado ng’ato thuolo mar ng’ado thuno, kendo omed ng’ado ngima.

English: Long-term exposure can lead to persistent heat stress and exhaustion, worsen cardiovascular and respiratory conditions, increase mental health challenges and contribute to the development of chronic kidney disease.
Kiswahili: Mfiduo wa muda mrefu unaweza kusababisha mfadhaiko wa joto na uchovu unaoendelea, hali mbaya ya moyo na mishipa na kupumua, kuongeza changamoto za afya ya akili na kuchangia ukuaji wa ugonjwa sugu wa figo.
Somali: Soo-gaadhista muddada dheer waxay keeni kartaa walbahaar kulayl iyo daal joogto ah, waxay ka sii dari kartaa xaaladaha wadnaha iyo xididdada dhiigga, waxay kordhin kartaa caqabadaha caafimaadka maskaxda waxayna gacan ka geysan kartaa horumarinta cudurrada kelyaha ee daba-dheeraada.
Dholuo: Ka ng’ato ochung’ e piny kuom kinde malach, mano nyalo miyo obed gi parruok ma ok rum mar liet kendo bedo gi ng’ol, nyalo medo bedo gi tuwo mag adundo kod mag muya, medo pek mag paro kendo nyalo miyo obed gi tuoche ma ok rum mag ng’ut.

English: Immediate skin-to-skin contact after birth helps regulate baby_x0092_s temperature and encourages bonding.
Kiswahili: Mawasiliano ya haraka ya ngozi na ngozi baada ya kuzaliwa husaidia kudhibiti joto la mtoto na kuchochea uhusiano.
Somali: Taabasho degdeg ah oo maqaarka-ilaa-maqaarka ah ka dib dhalashada ayaa ka caawisa nidaaminta heerkulka ilmaha_x0092_s waxayna dhiirigelisaa isku xirnaanta.
Dholuo: Ka ng’ato ochung’ mapiyo bang’ nyuol, mano konyo e rito liet mar nyathi kendo jiwo winjruok.

English:
Mombasa Covid-19 Booths: 
Contactless testing booths to be distributed in 6 constituencies. Booths have zero contact between the medic and patient. Contactless booths allow for safer, faster mass testing. The locally assembled booths are a game changer
Kiswahili: Mombasa Covid-19 Booths: Contactless mtihani booths kugawanywa katika 6 constituencies. Booths kuwa hakuna mawasiliano kati ya daktari na mgonjwa. Contactless boots kuruhusu salama, haraka wingi mtihani.
Somali: Mombasa COVID-19 Booths: Goobaha tijaabada ah ee aan xiriir laheyn ayaa lagu qaybin doonaa 6 goobood. Booths waxay leeyihiin xiriir la'aan u dhexeeya dhakhtarka iyo bukaanka. Goobta isgaarsiinta la'aanta waxay u oggolaaneysaa baaritaano badan oo ammaan ah, oo dhakhso badan. Goobooyinka lagu soo ururiyay deegaanka ayaa beddelaya ciyaarta
Dholuo: Mombasa Covid-19 Booths: Booths mag nonro maonge tudruok ibiro pog e alwora auchiel. Booths onge tudruok e kind laktar kod jatuo. Booth ma onge tudrruok miyo ji thuolo mar timo nonro e okang' mapiyo kendo ma nigi ritruok.

English: KTDA advises farmers in Baringo County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the September planting season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Baringo kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Septemba.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Baringo inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka ciidanka xilliga dayrta iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KTDA nyiso jopur e gweng' mar Baringo mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok chon kapok ochako chwoyo kodhi e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Public health advisory: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response warns of increased typhoid risk in Tana River County and advises the public to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya matumbo katika Kaunti ya Tana River na inashauri umma kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Talo-bixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay ka digtay kororka halista cudurka 'typhoid' ee Gobolka Tana River waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar typhoid e taon mar Tana River County kendo osiemo ji mondo kik giriwre gi pi mochido.

English: State Department for TVET encourages residents of Kajiado County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabaan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo ong'e weche ma gin-go e wi register mar joma oyiero mondo ging'e tich mar ombudsman.

English: Notice: KNEC announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta dugsiyada dugsiga sare ee Isikolo ee degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KNEC olando tarik mag somo mar sekondari ma onge chudo e skunde mag Isiolo County.

English: Postpartum women should take deworming medication to improve nutrition and milk quality.
Kiswahili: Wanawake baada ya kujifungua wanapaswa kutumia dawa za minyoo ili kuboresha lishe na ubora wa maziwa.
Somali: Haweenka dhalmada ka dib waa inay qaataan daawooyinka ka hortagga cayayaanka si loo hagaajiyo nafaqada iyo tayada caanaha.
Dholuo: Mon ma ne onyuol bang' nyuol onego oti gi yedhe ma geng'o ich mondo omi gimed bedo gi chiemo maber kendo gimi chak obed maber.

English: Notice: NTSA launches a theft prevention campaign in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NTSA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet bishii November.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NTSA chako kampen mar geng'o kuo e taon mar Elgeyo-Marakwet e dwe mar Novemba.

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Migori County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Migori kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Migori in helitaanka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Migori ni thuolo mar yudo kony mar chano ngima joot en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag oganda.

English: Kenya Medical Association launches a November awareness campaign on tobacco control across West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kizindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Novemba kuhusu udhibiti wa tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu bilaabay olole wacyi galineed bishii November ee ka dhanka ah xakamaynta sigaarka gobolka West Pokot.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Novemba e wi thieth mar ndawa e West Pokot County.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for cattle in Makueni County this June.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Makueni Juni hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa ku dhawaaqday jimicsi tallaal oo bilaash ah oo cudurka Newcastle ee lo'da ee Gobolka Makueni bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development olando chenro mar thieth mar tuo mar Newcastle maonge chudo ne jamni e county mar Makueni e dwe mar Jun.

English: Download KJSEA samples from CBA portal now.
Kiswahili: Pakua sampuli KJSEA kutoka CBA portal sasa.
Somali: Ka soo dejiso shaybaarka KJSEA bogga CBA hadda.
Dholuo: Gol ranyisi mag KJSEA e websait mar CBA sani.

English: OGP reminds residents of Bomet County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: OGP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet in helitaanka adeegyada baasaboorka ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: OGP oparo ne jogweng'o mag Bomet County ni koro yot yudo passport kokalo kuom chenro mag sirkal.

English: TSC reminds youth in Vihiga County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari.
Somali: TSC waxay xasuusineysaa dhallinyarada degmada Vihiga in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka farsamada gawaarida.
Dholuo: TSC oparo ne rowere man Vihiga County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar mechanics mag mtokni.

English: FAO reminds farmers in Wajir County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir juu ya programu inayoendelea ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa wakulima.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Wajir in barnaamijka tababarka beeralayda uu socdo.
Dholuo: FAO parone jopur e gweng' mar Wajir chenro mar tiego jopur ma dhi nyime.

English: Marsabit County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Marsabit: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Juni 2022
Somali: Degmada Marsabit: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Marsabit: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar auchiel 2022

English: Notice: IEBC launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC yazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay bilowday barnaamij ka dhan ah tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibta dugsiyada gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Rapar: IEBC chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe mahundu e skunde duto mag Uasin Gishu County.

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit warns of increased meningitis risk in Nyandarua County and advises the public to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya homa ya uti wa mgongo katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua na kushauri umma kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa ka digtay khatarta sii kordheysa ee meningitis ee degmada Nyandarua waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar oganda: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osiemo ji kuom medruok mar tuo mar meningitis e County mar Nyandarua kendo ojiwo ji mondo otang' gi tudruok gi pi mochido.

English: KNEC conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Busia County this June.
Kiswahili: KNEC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Busia Juni hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda gobolka ee degmada Busia bishii Juun.
Dholuo: KNEC dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e dwe mar Jun e kaunti mar Busia.

English: Notice: NPS issues a cybersecurity alert on mobile money scams affecting residents of Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu zinazoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khayaanada lacagta mobile ee saameynaya dadka deggan degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NPS ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity kuom timbe mag wuond mag pesa mitimo ne jood Bungoma County.

English: Ministry of Health announces eye and dental camps for residents of Kilifi County starting this November.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatangaza kambi za macho na meno kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kuanzia Novemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ku dhawaaqday xeryo indhaha iyo ilkaha loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Kilifi laga bilaabo bisha November.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health olando kambi mag thieth mag wang' kod lak mag lak mag joma odak e gweng' mar Kilifi kochakore dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: KICD reminds citizens in Kajiado County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Kajiado ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KICD paronwa raia mag Kajiado County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo gi ji duto e bajet mar county.

English: CDC urges residents of Marsabit County to complete the full recommended vaccination dose following a rise in reported measles cases.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya surua vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: CDC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inay dhammaystiraan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo ka dib kororka kiisaska suuxdinta ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo jogweng' mar Marsabit County mondo ochop e okang' malach mar thieth ma ji osechiwo bang' ka kwan mar joma nigi tuwono osemedore.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit launches a January awareness campaign on food safety across Narok County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Januari juu ya usalama wa chakula katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa billowday olole wacyigelin ah bishii Janaayo oo ku saabsan badbaadada cuntada ee gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Januar e wi ritruok mar chiemo e kaunti duto mar Narok.

English: State Department for Basic Education calls on the community in Mombasa County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Mombasa inay u soo sheegaan mas'uuliyadda amniga dugsiyada si ay u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyada iskuulada.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education okwayo ji duto manie county mar Mombasa mondo onyis sirkal mar skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: TSC calls on the community in Nakuru County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TSC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TSC waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Nakuru inay taageeraan jawiga waxbarasho ee ka kooban si loo ilaaliyo nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: TSC okwayo ji duto e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: DPP reminds residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: DPP anawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah inta lagu jiro xilliyada shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji e nderni ma sirkal ogolo e kinde masiche mag ndara.

English: Notice: e-Citizen launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Samburu County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Samburu mwezi Novemba huu.
Somali: Ogsoonow: e-Citizen waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa gobolka Samburu bishii November.
Dholuo: Par ane: e-Citizen chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e county mar Samburu e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: DPP conducts a community briefing on community early-warning systems in West Pokot County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jumuiya katika Kaunti ya West Pokot Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada oo ku saabsan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada ee Gobolka West Pokot bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: DPP timo romo mar oganda e wi chenro mag chiwo siem motelo e alwora mar West Pokot County e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMRI will be held in Meru County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMRI itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Meru Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay KEMRI ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Meru bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni kambi mar thieth ma KEMRI ochano ibiro tim e dwe mar Mei e county mar Meru.

English: Place a mark on your clinical card as a reminder when your clinical check up is next
Kiswahili: Weka alama kwenye kadi yako ya kliniki kama ukumbusho wakati uchunguzi wako ujao wa kliniki utakapofanyika
Somali: Calaamad ku qor kaarkaaga caafimaad si aad u xasuusato marka baaritaankaada caafimaad ee soo socota ay dhacdo
Dholuo: Ket alama e kad mari mar thieth kaka rapar mar kinde ma ibiro timie thieth machielo

English: State Department for Basic Education announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in Kwale County this August.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kwale Agosti hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku dhawaaqday qaybinta deeqaha waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan dugsiyada Gobolka Kwale bishii Ogosto.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education ogolo chiwo mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre man gi chan e skul man Kwale County e dwe mar Agost.

English: AFA encourages farmers in Murang'a County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora ya mahindi.
Somali: AFA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Murang'a inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay hadhuudhka.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e county mar Murang'a mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar kodhi.

English: Public notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will host a free proper sanitation outreach in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mazingira bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay martigelin doontaa adeegyo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku habboon Degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche biro timo chenro mar chiwo kony ma onge chudo e alwora mar Elgeyo-Marakwet e dwe mar Mei.

English: Kenya Key Message Update: Declining livestock body conditions and high maize prices continue to reduce household purchasing power, September 2022
Kiswahili: Taarifa Muhimu ya Kenya: Kupungua kwa hali ya mifugo na bei ya juu ya mahindi kunaendelea kupunguza uwezo wa kununua kaya, Septemba 2022
Somali: Cusbooneysiinta Fariinta Muhiimka ah ee Kenya: Xaaladaha jidhka xoolaha oo hoos u dhacaya iyo qiimaha galleyda oo sarreeya ayaa sii wadaya inay yareeyaan awoodda wax iibsiga ee qoysaska, Sebtembar 2022
Dholuo: Oda maduong' mar piny Kenya: Dok piny e chal mar ringre le kod nengo mamalo mar cham pod dhi nyime gi duoko piny teko mar nyiewo mar udi, Septemba 2022

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development opens a new catering and hospitality programme at the vocational centre in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yafungua mpango mpya wa upishi na ukarimu katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ka furayaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan cuntada iyo marti-gelinta xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Nakuru.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ochako chenro manyien mar chiemo kod rwako welo e skul mar tiegruok e gweng' mar Nakuru.

English: Mental health is essential for everyone; if you feel stressed or depressed, please speak to a counselor or trusted person to get support.
Kiswahili: Afya ya akili ni muhimu kwa kila mtu; ikiwa unahisi msongo wa mawazo au huzuni, tafadhali zungumza na mshauri wa afya au mtu unayemwamini ili kupata msaada.
Somali: Caafimaadka maskaxdu waa muhiim u ah qof walba; haddii aad dareento walbahaar ama niyad jab, fadlan la hadal la-taliye ama qof aad ku kalsoon tahay si aad taageero u hesho.
Dholuo: Bedo gi ngima maber e paro en gima dwarore ne ng’ato ka ng’ato; ka iwinjo ka in gi parruok kata ka in gi paro mang’eny, yie mondo iwuo gi ng’at ma chiwo paro kata ng’at ma igeno mondo iyud kony.
resource: Ministry of Health Mental Health Advisory

English: Ministry of Health encourages mothers in Garissa County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Garissa kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Garissa inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health ojiwo mine manie County mar Garissa mondo olim kama gibiro yudoe nyithindo machiegni mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: KNEC invites youth in Vihiga County to enroll for ICT skills training this May.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT Mei hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku casuumaysaa dhalinyarada degmada Vihiga inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka xirfadaha ICT bisha May.
Dholuo: KNEC gwelo rowere e County mar Vihiga mondo odonj e tiegruok mar ICT e dwe mar Mei.

English: Kenya - Demographic and Displacement Calculator in Wajir Round #4 (12 February 2025)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Kikokotoo cha Idadi ya Watu na Uhamisho katika Wajir Awamu ya #4 (12 Februari 2025)
Somali: Kenya - Xisaabiyaha Dadweynaha iyo Barakacayaasha Wareega 4aad ee Wajeer #4 (12 Febraayo 2025)
Dholuo: Kenya - Kwan mar Oganda kod Jogo ma Owuok e Udi ma Wajir #4 (12 dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2025)

English: Embu (Mbeere) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Embu (Mbeere): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2023
Somali: Degmada Embu (Mbeere): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Embu (Mbeere): Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2023

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Garissa County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itafanya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa warsha ya wakulima kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi diiwaangelinta beeraleyda loogu talagalay beeralayda Gobolka Garissa bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro timo rapar mar jopur e dwe mar Mach e gweng' mar Garissa.

English: Huduma Kenya advises residents of Murang'a County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya nyiso jogweng' Murang'a County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport.

English: Ecpectant mothers are advized not to drink beer. Getting drunk when you are expectant can cause sickness and affect the unborn baby
Kiswahili: Mama wanaotarajia kuzaa wanaonywa wasile bia.
Somali: Hooyooyinka uurka leh waxaa lagula talinayaa inaysan cabin biya.
Dholuo: Onego ojiw mine ma nigi ich ni kik gimadh divai nikech madho kong'o ahinya sama gin gi ich nyalo miyo gibed matuwo kendo nyalo mulo nyathi mapok onyuol

English: KALRO warns maize farmers in Migori County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaonya wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Migori kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KALRO waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Migori cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: KALRO chiwo siem ne jopur mogoyo kodhi e county mar Migori kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: OGP updates residents of Kwale County on progress of ward-level service delivery this March.
Kiswahili: OGP inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale juu ya maendeleo ya usambazaji wa huduma katika darasa mwezi Machi.
Somali: OGP waxay dadka deggan degmada Kwale ku wargelineysaa horumarka adeegga heerka degmada bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: OGP osemiyo jogweng' Kwale ong'eyo dongruok mar tij lendo mar ward e dwe mar Mach.

English: Self-help-groups in Thika, Kiambu county have received posho mills from well wishers in collaboration with local leaders. This was in a bid to help the cluster groups comprising youths and women start generating income. #NTVAtOne
Kiswahili: Vikundi vya kujisaidia huko Thika, kaunti ya Kiambu vimepokea vinu vya posho kutoka kwa wasamaria wema kwa ushirikiano na viongozi wa eneo hilo. Hii ilikuwa katika juhudi za kusaidia vikundi vya makundi vinavyojumuisha vijana na wanawake kuanza kupata mapato. #NTVAtOne
Somali: Kooxaha is caawinta ee degmada Thika, degmada Kiambu waxay ka heleen warshado posho oo ay ka helaan dadka doonaya inay ka faa'iideystaan wada shaqeynta hoggaamiyeyaasha degaanka. Tani waxay ahayd dadaal ay ku caawiso kooxaha isku dhafan ee ka kooban dhalinyarada iyo haweenka inay bilaabaan inay helaan dakhli. #NTVAtOne
Dholuo: Grup mag konyruok giwegi e Thika, Kaunti mar Kiambu oseyudo ohala mag posho kowuok kuom jogo madwaro konyruok gi jotelo mag gweng'no. Mano ne en mondo okony grube moting'o rowere kod mon ochak yudo pesa. #NTVAtOne

English: Republic of Kenya: 2024 - 2025 Drought Severity (25 Jan 2026)
Kiswahili: Jamhuri ya Kenya: 2024 - 2025 Ukali wa Ukame (25 Januari 2026)
Somali: Jamhuuriyadda Kenya: 2024 - 2025 Darajada Abaarta (25 Jannaayo 2026)
Dholuo: Piny mar Kenya: Oro Matek higa mar 2024 - 2025 (25 dwe mar achiel higa mar 2026)

English: AU-COMESA launch a Joint Election Observer Mission to the 2022 Kenya General Elections
Kiswahili: AU-COMESA yazindua Ujumbe wa Pamoja wa Waangalizi wa Uchaguzi katika Uchaguzi Mkuu wa 2022 Kenya
Somali: AU-COMESA oo Bilaabeysa Hawlgal Wadajir ah oo Kormeerayaal Doorasho ah oo loogu Diyaargaroobayo Doorashada Guud ee Kenya 2022.
Dholuo: AU-COMESA ochako chenro mar neno yiero mabiro timore e higa mar 2022 e piny Kenya

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of Nyamira County to prepare for possible landslides this March.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa maporomoko ya ardhi mwezi huu Machi.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inay u diyaar garoobaan dhulgariir dhici kara bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross osiemo jogweng' Nyamira County mondo oikre ne yiengni mag lowo mabiro timore e dwe mar Mach.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds residents of Bomet County that water harvesting improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba uvunaji wa maji huboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Bomet in soo-saarka biyaha uu hagaajinayo waxsoosaarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jogweng' County mar Bomet ni choko pi miyo puothe bedo gi nyak maber e kinde mabiro.

English: Notice: NTSA launches a burglary prevention campaign in Taita-Taveta County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NTSA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga jabsashada gobolka Taita-Taveta bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NTSA chako kampen mar geng'o jomecho e gweng' mar Taita-Taveta e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: State Department for TVET reminds schools in Nyandarua County to strengthen child protection in schools this June.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inazikumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuimarisha ulinzi wa watoto shuleni Juni hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay xusuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Nyandarua inay xoojiyaan ilaalinta carruurta dugsiyada bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET oparo ne skunde man Nyandarua County mondo omed jiwo rit mar nyithindo e skunde e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: TSC opens applications for revision guides for learners in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay furaysaa codsiyada hagaha dib-u-eegista ardayda degmada Nairobi.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TSC oyawo kwayo mag somo mondo okony jopuonjre e County mar Nairobi.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Bungoma County this June. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Juni hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay qabaneysaa madasha caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada ee degmada Bungoma bisha Juun. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo romo mar paro ne rowere e taon mar Bungoma e dwe mar Jun. Ji duto mor.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges motorists and pedestrians in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent landslides-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa gawaarida iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay adeegsadaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee socodka si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira dhulgariirka.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo joidh mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe mondo gikwed masiche ma timore nikech yiengni mag lowo.

English: Notice: IEBC launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay bilawday barnaamij lagu darayo ardayda naafada ah dugsiyada gobolka Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IEBC chako chenro mar tiego nyithindo ma nigi midekre e skunde duto mag Bungoma County.

English: KRA advises residents of Mandera County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: KRA inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Somali: KRA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan shahaadada dhalashada.
Dholuo: KRA nyiso jogweng'o mag Mandera County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro yudo barua mar nyuol.

English: COMESA advises coffee producers in Marsabit County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inashauri wazalishaji wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: COMESA waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kafeega ee degmada Marsabit inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: COMESA nyiso jopur ma loso chai e gweng' mar Marsabit mondo oti gi nengo maromo nade kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Notice: KRA will hold a public participation forum on development planning forums in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta ee degmada Kilifi.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KRA biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag dongruok e gweng' mar Kilifi.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will train farmers in Kericho County on conservation tillage this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho juu ya kilimo cha uhifadhi Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Kericho ee ku saabsan beerashada ilaalinta bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro tiego jopur e County mar Kericho e wi puodho mar conservation e dwe mar Jun.

English: Managing risks in apiculture requires planning. Learn strategies for diversification, contracts, and coping with specific risks like livestock disease.
Kiswahili: Kusimamia hatari katika apiculture kunahitaji kupanga. Jifunze mikakati ya mseto, mikataba, na kukabiliana na hatari maalum kama ugonjwa wa mifugo.
Somali: Maareynta khataraha xayawaanka tiknida waxay u baahan tahay qorsheyn. Baro xeelado kala duwanaansho, heshiisyo, iyo la tacaal khataro gaar ah sida cudurrada xoolaha.
Dholuo: Puonjruok yore mag kelo pek e tij pidho winy dwaro ni ng'ato otim chenro maber, opuonjre yore mag kelo pek mopogore opogore, tiyo gi yore mag loso winjruok, kendo loyo pek moko kaka tuoche mag jamni.

English: Kenya - Floods, update (Kenya Met, media) (ECHO Daily Flash of 15 November 2023)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Mafuriko, sasisho (Kenya Met, media) (ECHO Daily Flash ya 15 Novemba 2023)
Somali: Kenya - Daadad, cusbooneysiin (Kenya Met, warbaahinta) (ECHO Daily Flash ee 15 Noofambar 2023)
Dholuo: Kenya - Pi mang'eny, duoko manyien (Kenya Oromo, yor mbui) (Rieny ma pile ka pile tarik 15 dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2023)

English: Notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response confirms a malaria outbreak alert for Wajir County. Residents are advised to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa malaria kwa Kaunti ya Wajir. Wakazi wanashauriwa kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka Cudurka Cudurada ee Gobolka Wajir. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche nyiso ni koro nitie masira mar malaria e kaunti mar Wajir.

English: KTDA urges dairy cows farmers in Embu County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Embu kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa Newcastle vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Embu inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyagoo aan haysan rukhsad ka dib kiisaska cudurka Newcastle ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KTDA ojiwo jopur mag dhok mag chak e county mar Embu mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni e tong county maok giyudo rusa bang' ka osenyis ni gin gi tuo mar Newcastle.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds the public in Mandera County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu dadka degmada Mandera ku xasuustaa inay ka feejignaadaan nabadgelyada qaranka.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service parone ji duto man Mandera County ni mondo gibed motang' ne loso kuwe e piny.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges motorists and pedestrians in Kitui County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Kitui kufunga na kutunza vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Kitui inay guryahooda rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa dhacdooyinka fatahaadaha la xiriira.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Forest Service jiwo derebe kod joma wuotho e ndara e gweng' mar Kitui mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko mach e utegi kendo giti matek mondo gikwed masiche ma nyalo bedoe nikech ataro.

English: Ministry of Education encourages residents of Meru County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya ugatuzi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay ka qaybgalaan madasha dadweynaha degmada si ay uga warqabaan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jogweng' mar Meru County mondo oriwgi e chokruok mar oganda mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche ma biro timore.

English: Notice: IEBC opens voter registration centres in Nyeri County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inafungua vituo vya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa xarumaha diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee degmada Nyeri bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC chako timo chenro mar chano joma biro yiero e county mar Nyeri e dwe mar Mei.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Tharaka-Nithi County that access to the GBV toll-free helpline is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Utafiti wa Jinai inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwamba upatikanaji wa simu ya msaada ya GBV bila malipo unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Tharaka-Nithi in helitaanka khadka caawimaadda ee GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah uu yahay mid bilaash ah.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e Tharaka-Nithi County ni gibiro yudo kony ma onge chudo mar GBV maonge chudo.

English: Primary HIV prevention programmes are vital for reducing new HIV infections and saving domestic resources which otherwise would be expended on treatment and support services if HIV transmission is not curbed.
Kiswahili: Mipango ya kimsingi ya kuzuia VVU ni muhimu katika kupunguza maambukizi mapya ya VVU na kuokoa rasilimali za nyumbani ambazo zingetumika katika matibabu na huduma za usaidizi ikiwa maambukizi ya VVU hayatazuiliwa.
Somali: Barnaamijyada aasaasiga ah ee ka hortagga HIV waa kuwo muhiim u ah yareynta caabuqyada cusub ee HIV iyo badbaadinta kheyraadka gudaha kuwaas oo haddii kale lagu bixin lahaa adeegyada daaweynta iyo taageerada haddii aan la xakameyn gudbinta HIV.
Dholuo: Program mokwongo mag geng’o tuo mar HIV gin gik ma dwarore ahinya e duoko piny tuoche manyien mag HIV kendo rito mwandu mag ot ma ka ok kamano to ne dhi tiyogo e thieth kod tich mar konyo ka ok ogeng’ lando tuo mar HIV.

English: Notice: COMESA will train farmers in Turkana County on soil conservation this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Turkana juu ya uhifadhi wa udongo Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Turkana ee ku saabsan ilaalinta ciidda bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA biro tiego jopur e County mar Turkana e wi rito lowo e dwe mar Septemba.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Nyeri County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Nyeri inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag obwongo e County mar Nyeri mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Isiolo County that access to eye and dental camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za macho na meno sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Isiolo in helitaanka xeryaha indhaha iyo ilkaha ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumo la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMSA oparo ne ji duto man Isiolo County ni koro ginyalo dhi e kambini mag thieth mag wang' kod lakteche.

English: Microfinance for WASH in Kenya
Kiswahili: Fedha ndogo za WASH nchini Kenya
Somali: Maalgelinta yar yar ee WASH ee Kenya
Dholuo: Chiwo pesa matin mag WASH e piny Kenya

English: EACC advises residents of Busia County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: EACC inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: EACC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jogweng' County mar Busia mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom websait mar e-Citizen sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport.

English: AFA invites farmers in Turkana County to a free training on greenhouse farming this July.
Kiswahili: AFA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Turkana kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo cha chafu Julai hii.
Somali: AFA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Turkana tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo bisha July.
Dholuo: AFA gwelo jopur e county mar Turkana e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar greenhouse agriculture e dwe mar Julai.

English: HELB calls on the community in Murang'a County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: HELB inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: HELB waxay bulshada degmada Murang'a ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyo.
Dholuo: HELB luongo ji duto manie County mar Murang'a mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ngima maber e skunde.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by CDC will be held in Kitui County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na CDC itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kitui Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: xerada caafimaad ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabiyeen CDC ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Kitui bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kampen mar thieth ma CDC ochano biro timore e dwe mar Agost e taon mar Kitui County.

English: Kenyaâ€™s Push To Promote Traditional Food Is Good For Nutrition And Cultural Heritage
Kiswahili: Kenya's Push To Promote Traditional Food Is Good For Nutrition And Cultural Heritage
Somali: Dadaallada Kenya ee lagu dhiirigelinayo Cuntada Dhaqanka ayaa u wanaagsan Nafaqada iyo Dhaxalka Dhaqanka.
Dholuo: Push mar Kenya Mar Keto Chiemo Maduong' En Maber Ne Chiemo Mapile Kod Kido mar Kido

English: Notice: Ministry of Education opens applications for revision guides for learners in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay furaysaa codsiyada hagaha dib u eegista ardayda Baringo County.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Ofis mar Puonjruok oseyawo kwayo mag somo mondo okony jopuonjre e alwora mar Baringo County.

English: It's evident that farmers trained on digital information on quality standards, increase yields, income and sustainability.
Kiswahili: Ni dhahiri kwamba wakulima wamezoezwa juu ya habari ya digital juu ya viwango vya ubora, kuongeza mavuno, mapato na uendelevu.
Somali: Waa wax iska cad in beeralayda ay ku tababartay macluumaadka dhijitaalka ah ee ku saabsan heerarka tayada, kordhinta wax soo saarka, dakhliga iyo waara.
Dholuo: En gima nenore maler ni jopur ne tiego ji e weche mag digital e wi chike mag ber, medruok mar nyak, yuto, kod bedo gi ngima maber.

English: Ministry of Education reminds youth in Samburu County that HELB funding is available for electrical installation training.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada gobolka Samburu in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka rakibidda korontada.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education oparo ne rowere e county mar Samburu ni pesa mag HELB yudore e tiegruok mar keto sitima.

English: Kenya FY 2025 Country Roadmap
Kiswahili: Ramani ya Nchi ya Kenya FY 2025
Somali: Khariidadda Waddan ee Sannad-guurada 2025 ee Kenya
Dholuo: Map mar yo mar piny Kenya higa mar 2025

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay furtay xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya daryeel caafimaad ka dib rabshadaha degmada Meru.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Red Cross oyawo ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony mar thieth bang' timbe mahundu e county mar Meru.

English: IPOA urges residents of Kilifi County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo jogweng' Kilifi County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'iyoe weche mag lweny e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Notice: KTDA will train farmers in Machakos County on water harvesting this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos juu ya uvunaji wa maji Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Machakos oo ku saabsan goosashada biyaha bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA biro tiego jopur e gweng' mar Machakos e wi ywayo pi e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: FAO warns cassava farmers in Kakamega County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: FAO inawaonya wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: FAO waxay uga digtay beeraleyda cassava ee Gobolka Kakamega cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: FAO chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho manias e gweng' mar Kakamega kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone experiencing abuse in Embu County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Embu kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya ngono katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Embu inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e county mar Embu mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: CDC encourages residents of Meru County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inaysan ku xanuunsadaan aamusnaan iyo inay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo jogweng' mar Meru County mondo kik gisandre gi muol kendo mondo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: TSC urges residents of West Pokot County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa watu wazima ili kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: TSC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay iska diiwaangeliyaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo ji duto modak e West Pokot County mondo odonj e program mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo mondo giyud somo mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: Government issues advisory on animal feed quality to prevent aflatoxin contamination.
Kiswahili: Serikali yatoa ushauri kuhusu ubora wa chakula cha mifugo ili kuzuia uchafuzi wa sumu ya aflatoxin.
Somali: Dowladda waxay soo saartay talooyin ku saabsan tayada quudinta xayawaanka si looga hortago wasakheynta aflatoxin
Dholuo: Sirkal chiwo paro e wi kit chiemb le mondo kik gilal gi aflatoxin

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds residents of Uasin Gishu County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Uasin Gishu kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan gobolka Uasin Gishu in helitaanka adeegyada baasaboorka ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone jogweng' Uasin Gishu County ni koro yot yudo passport kokalo kuom chenro mag sirkal.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations launches a carjacking prevention campaign in Turkana County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia utekaji nyara katika Kaunti ya Turkana Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa bilaabay olole looga hortago baabuurta la xaday degmada Turkana bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Joneno mag Jehova chako kampen mar geng'o mibadhi mag mtokni e taon mar Turkana e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Isiolo County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the May planting season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Mei.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Isiolo inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka dayrta iyagoo isticmaalaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maajo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development nyiso jopur manie Isiolo County mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok chon ka gitiyo gi thieth mag thieth moting'o yedhe mamero e dwe mar Mei.

English: IPOA urges the public in Laikipia County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: IPOA inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha degmada Laikipia inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo ji duto e County mar Laikipia mondo ochiw ripot mar ote manyalo kelo hinyruok ne jatendgi mar tich ka luwore gi weche ma osefweny kuom chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo.

English: KALRO informs maize farmers in Nyamira County of new market linkage opportunities this July.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawafahamisha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Julai hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Nyamira fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: KALRO nyiso jopur mag cham e County mar Nyamira e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: NTSA issues a cybersecurity alert on mobile money scams affecting residents of Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu zinazoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khayaanada lacagta mobile ee saameeya dadka deggan Gobolka Garissa.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NTSA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity kuom timbe mag wuond mag pesa mitimo gi simo ma mulo joma odak e County mar Garissa.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the public in Machakos County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa shacabka degmada Machakos inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada lacagta mobilada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto e gweng' mar Machakos mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro bang' yudo weche ma nyiso ni nitie timbe mag wuondruok gi pesa mag simo.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens a new service point for national ID applications in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu ka furayaa barta adeegga cusub ee codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties oyawo kama itimee tije manyien ne kwayo mag ID e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: Thousands attend blue caravan tours Nyanza region. Tour aims at educating Kenyans on good nutrition. Roadshow is partnership between RMS and Blue Band
Kiswahili: Maelfu huhudhuria ziara za msafara wa bluu katika mkoa wa Nyanza. Ziara hiyo inakusudia kuelimisha Wakenya juu ya lishe nzuri.
Somali: Kumanaan qof ayaa ka qeybgalaya safarada gaadiidka buluugga ah ee gobolka Nyanza. Dalxiisku wuxuu ujeedkiisu yahay barashada dadka Kenya ee ku saabsan nafaqada wanaagsan. Roadshow waa iskaashi u dhexeeya RMS iyo Blue Band
Dholuo: Ji gana gi gana dhi e wuoth mar Blue Caravan e gweng' mar Nyanza.

English: CDC encourages residents of Kiambu County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay u dhiiri galiyaan saaxiibo dhibaataysan inay caawimaad raadsadaan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth jiwo jogweng' Kiambu County mondo kik gisandre aling' ling' kendo mondo gijiw osiepgi moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: KNEC advises applicants in Kilifi County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Kilifi inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee la heli karo.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: Announcement of new SMS service sending weekly nutrition tips, food safety alerts and diet guidance to subscribers.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la huduma mpya ya SMS inayotuma vidokezo vya lishe vya kila wiki, arifa za usalama wa chakula na mwongozo wa lishe kwa waliojisajili.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida adeeg cusub oo SMS ah oo soo diraya talooyinka nafaqada toddobaadlaha ah, digniinta badbaadada cuntada iyo tilmaamaha cuntada macaamiisha.
Dholuo: Riwruok manyien mar SMS mar oro paro mag chiemo juma ka juma, siem e wi ritruok mar chiemo, kod puonj e wi chiemo ne joma ne ondike.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response calls on parents in Makueni County to have children under five screened for cholera during the December outreach.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuwafanya watoto chini ya miaka mitano wachunguzwe kipindupindu wakati wa mawasiliano ya Desemba.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Makueni in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka kolera inta lagu jiro bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche kwayo jonyuol e County mar Makueni mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Desemba.

English: NDMA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kitui County that access to free legal aid is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisheria wa bure unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee Gobolka Kitui in helitaanka caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.

English: Drought leaves over two million vulnerable to health and nutrition crises in Kenya
Kiswahili: Ukame unaacha zaidi ya milioni mbili katika hatari ya matatizo ya afya na lishe nchini Kenya

English: West Pokot: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2023
Kiswahili: Pokot Magharibi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2023

English: Going to get tested for HIV/AIDS is not shameful; visit nearby health centers to get tested and receive free counseling and treatment.
Kiswahili: Kwenda kupimwa virusi vya UKIMWI (HIV) si aibu; tembelea vituo vya afya vilivyo karibu ili kupimwa na kupata ushauri nasaha na matibabu bila malipo.
Somali: Inaad iska baarto HIV/AIDS ma aha wax ceeb ah; booqo xarumaha caafimaadka ee u dhow si aad u hesho baaritaan oo aad u hesho la-talin iyo daaweyn bilaash ah.
Dholuo: Goyo pim mar HIV/AIDS ok en gima kelo wich kuot; dhi e kar thieth man machiegni mondo otimnegi pim kendo yudo rieko kod thieth ma nono.
resource: NASCOP & Ministry of Health HIV Prevention Campaign

English: FAO warns rice farmers in Nyamira County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: FAO inawaonya wakulima wa mchele katika Kaunti ya Nyamira dhidi ya mlipuko wa wadudu na inapendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: FAO waxay uga digtay beeraleyda bariiska ee gobolka Nyamira in ay jiraan cudurro cayayaanka ah waxayna ku talineysaa in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: FAO chiwo siem ne jopur loso loso loso kodhi e County mar Nyamira kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni otim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) invites farmers in Murang'a County to a free training on pest and disease management this December.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya udhibiti wa wadudu na magonjwa Desemba hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Murang'a tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) ogwelo jopur e county mar Murang'a e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar tuoche kod tuoche e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: IPOA launches a cattle rustling prevention campaign in Kisumu County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: IPOA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga xanta xoolaha ee degmada Kisumu bishii Ogosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IPOA chako kampen mar geng'o kwalo jamni e gweng' mar Kisumu e dwe mar Agost.

English: Huduma Kenya advises residents of Mandera County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan shahaadada dhalashada.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya nyiso jogweng'o mag Mandera County mondo odhi e Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro yudo barua mar nyuol.

English: Ministry of Education reminds needy students in Mandera County that school laptops under the digital literacy programme applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya maombi ya programu ya kusoma na kuandika ya dijiti zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Mandera in laptop-yada dugsiga ee barnaamijka codsiyada akhriska dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Puonjruok parone jopuonjre man e bwo chandruok man Mandera County ni kompyuta mag skul manie bwo program mar somo gi somo mar digital biro rumo machiegni.

English: The Sugar Act 2024 is now active it regulates the sugar industry and establishes the Kenya Sugar Board and Kenya Sugar Research and Training Institute Transition processes for staff are in place
Kiswahili: Sheria ya Sukari ya 2024 sasa inafanya kazi inasimamia sekta ya sukari na kuanzisha Bodi ya Sukari ya Kenya na Taasisi ya Utafiti na Mafunzo ya Taasisi ya Utafiti wa Sukari ya Kenya michakato ya mpito kwa wafanyikazi iko tayari.
Somali: Sharciga Sonkorta 2024 ayaa hadda shaqeynaya wuxuu xakameynayaa warshadaha sonkorta wuxuuna aasaasay Guddiga Sonkorta Kenya iyo Machadka Cilmi-baarista iyo Tababarka Sonkorta Kenya Nidaamyada kala guurka shaqaalaha ayaa jira
