English: Inspect your maize field often while plants are young; uproot infected plants as soon as they show disease signs and put the whole plant in a sack so leafhoppers do not spread to healthy plants, then plant a resistant maize variety next season.
Kiswahili: Kagua shamba lako la mahindi mara nyingi wakati mimea ni mchanga; Ng'oa mimea iliyoambukizwa mara tu inapoonyesha dalili za magonjwa na kuweka mmea mzima kwenye gunia ili majani yasienee kwa mimea yenye afya, kisha panda aina ya mahindi sugu msimu ujao.
Somali: Marar badan baadh beertaada galleyda inta geedu yar yihiin; Dhirta cudurka qabta ka saar marka ay calaamadaha cudurka muujiyaan, geedka oo dhan ku rid bac si leafhoppers aysan ugu faafin dhirta caafimaad qaba, ka dibna beer nooc galley ah oo adkaysi leh xilliga dambe.
Dholuo: Non puothe mag cham kinde mang'eny ka yienego pod tindo; gol yien ma nigi tuwo ka giseneno ni gikwongo bedo gi tuwo kendo iketgi e sanduk mondo yienego kik landre e yien ma nigi ngima maber, kae to ipidh kit yien ma nigi tuwo e kinde mabiro.

English: KEPHIS advises maize producers in Kilifi County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inashauri wazalishaji wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha hadhuudhka ee degmada Kilifi inay ka iibsadaan wax soo saarka kaliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KEPHIS nyiso jopur ma loso kodhi e gweng' mar Kilifi ni gius olembegi mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo kodhi kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Notice: Council of Governors will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana litafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha waxay qaban doonaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada ee degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Jaloch biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mar bajet mar kaunti e kaunti mar Nyeri.

English: Kenya - Ethiopia Bi-National Simulation Exercise on the Protection of People Displaced across Borders in Disaster
Kiswahili: Kenya - Ethiopia Zoezi la Kuiga la Kitaifa Binafsi kuhusu Ulinzi wa Watu Waliohamishwa Kuvuka Mipaka Katika Maafa
Somali: Layli Jilitaan Laba-Qaran ah oo ku saabsan Ilaalinta Dadka ka Barakacay Xuduudaha ee Masiibooyinka ku jira
Dholuo: Kenya - Ethiopia timo ranyisi mar rito ji ma owuok e udigi e kinde ma masira

English: NPS urges residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: NPS inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuunga mkono kamati za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: NPS waxay ugu baaqaysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay taageeraan guddiyada nabad-dhiska ee maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: NPS ojiwo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi kuom rito tong'.

English: HELB announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in Kiambu County this June.
Kiswahili: HELB inatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Juni hii.
Somali: HELB waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta deeqaha waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan dugsiyada degmada Kiambu bishii Juun.
Dholuo: HELB ogolo chiwo mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre man gi chan e skunde man Kiambu County e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: EACC launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Nyandarua County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhanka ah gobolka Nyandarua bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Rapar: EACC chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Nyandarua e dwe mar Julai.

English: Climbing bean varieties yield more per unit of land than bush varieties but need staking for support; the highest yields come from stakes at least 175cm long, using at least 20,000 stakes per hectare, started two weeks after germination.
Kiswahili: Aina ya maharagwe ya kupanda huzaa zaidi kwa kila kitengo cha ardhi kuliko aina za kichaka lakini zinahitaji staking kwa msaada; mavuno ya juu huja kutoka kwa stakes angalau 175cm ya urefu, kwa kutumia stakes angalau 20,000 kwa hekta, ilianza wiki mbili baada ya kilimo.
Somali: Noocyada digirta kor u kaca waxay helaan wax ka badan noocyada bush halkii unug dhul ah balse waxay u baahan yihiin in la garaaco si loo taageero; Wax-soosaarka ugu sarreeya wuxuu ka yimaadaa tiirarka ugu yaraan 175cm dheer, iyadoo la isticmaalayo ugu yaraan 20,000 stake halkii hektar, taasoo bilaabatay laba toddobaad kadib dhalasha.
Dholuo: Yien mag nyinyo ma wuok e puothe mag goro ma ng'ato nyalo wuothogo e puothe mar lowo ng'eny moloyo mag puothe mag bungu, kata kamano dwarore ni okonygi gi yien; yien ma nigi nyalo mar romo sentimita 175 kende, ma nigi tong' 20,000 e hekta, chakore bang' jumbe ariyo ka gisechwo.

English: The meeting which was graced by His Excellency the President, Uhuru Kenyatta, noted the increasing significance of a viable vaccine in the containment of the spread of Covid-19.
Kiswahili: Mkutano huo ambao ulihudhuriwa na Mheshimiwa Rais, Uhuru Kenyatta, ulibainisha ongezeko la umuhimu wa chanjo inayoweza kutumika katika kuzuia kuenea kwa Covid-19.
Somali: Kulanka oo uu si heer sare ah u soo agaasimay Madaxweynaha dalka Uhuru Kenyatta, ayaa lagu xusay muhiimadda sii kordheysa ee tallaalka suurtagalka ah ee lagu xakameynayo faafitaanka Covid-19.
Dholuo: Kombe mane oting'o Jatend Pinyruoth, Uhuru Kenyatta, nofwenyo ber mar chanjo manyalo tiyo e geng'o lando mar Covid-19.

Kiswahili: Taarifa: Shirika la SHA linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu ya kupambana na ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu mwezi huu wa Septemba.

Dholuo: Ng'eyo: SHA chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Kiambu e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the community in Siaya County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb theft.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu usiowajua ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Siaya inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto e county mar Siaya mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo kik gikwed nek.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Nyandarua County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inazindua kampeni ya kupambana na ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua mwezi huu wa Novemba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhanka ah gobolka Nyandarua bishii November.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e kaunti mar Nyandarua e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: ODPP will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Turkana County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee degmada Turkana.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds residents of Uasin Gishu County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu wanaohudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.

English: State Department for Basic Education encourages out-of-school children in Busia County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Busia kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.

Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e county mar Busia mondo odonj e program mar somo kod somo mar joma dongo.

Kiswahili: Vijana wakulima katika kilimo wanakabiliwa na changamoto za kupata mikopo Mikakati ya kuboresha upatikanaji wa mikopo ni muhimu kwa ajili ya kununua pembejeo na kuwekeza katika kilimo biashara.

Kiswahili: KEMRI inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma ya ujauzito bila malipo ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.

Dholuo: KEMRI oparo ne mine ma biro nyuolo e gweng' mar Nakuru ni thuolo mar yudo thieth ma onge chudo mar nyuol en maonge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development announces distribution of revision guides to schools in Kilifi County this March.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yatangaza usambazaji wa miongozo ya marekebisho kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Machi hii.

English: FAO informs tea farmers in Bungoma County of new market linkage opportunities this July.
Kiswahili: FAO inawafahamisha wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Julai hii.
Somali: FAO waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Bungoma fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Luulyo.

Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuleta nambari yao ya usajili wa mkulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Vihiga inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qaybqaataan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds farmers in Nyeri County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Somali: Guddiga alaabada xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa xusuusinaya beeraleyda degmada Nyeri barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee xakamaynta cayayaannada iyo cudurrada.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products oparo ne jopur e County mar Nyeri chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are invited to the KALRO Fourth Annual Open Week and Exhibition to explore new agricultural technologies and innovations that enhance productivity
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wamealikwa kwenye Wiki ya Nne ya Uwazi ya Kila Mwaka na Maonyesho ya KALRO ili kuchunguza teknolojia mpya za kilimo na ubunifu unaoongeza tija.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha waxaa lagu casuumay Toddobaadka Furan ee Afaraad ee KALRO iyo Bandhigga si ay u baaraan teknoolojiyada cusub ee beeraha iyo hal-abuurka kor u qaada wax-soosaarka
Dholuo: Oganda ma loso gik moko e yore mag jopur kod jopur mag weche mag jopur, kaachiel gi jomamoko, igwelo e KALRO mar Ang'wen mar Juma mar Ohala mar Jo-KALRO mondo gipuonjre e wi teknoloji manyien mag jopur kod gik manyien ma miyo ji bedo gi nyak maber

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Embu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya waanzisha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay shilalka waddooyinka ee degmada Embu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Red Cross tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne masiche ma timore e nderni e county mar Embu.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross conducts a community briefing on border security in Narok County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Narok Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha ee Gobolka Narok bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ripot Mamit mar Kenya timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e Narok County e dwe mar Julai.

English: Huduma Kenya updates residents of Lamu County on progress of ward-level service delivery this March.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu juu ya maendeleo ya usambazaji wa huduma katika darasa mwezi Machi.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay dadka deggan degmada Lamu ku wargelineysaa horumarka adeegga heerka degmada bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya osemiyo jogweng' mar Lamu County ong'eyo dongruok mar tich mitimo e gwenge mopogore opogore e dwe mar Mach.

English: FAO urges sorghum growers in Garissa County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawataka wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Garissa kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda sorghum ee degmada Garissa inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey roobka ka hor si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur mag sorghum e gweng' mar Garissa mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue mondo okony e medo nyak e higani.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces free medical camps for residents of Uasin Gishu County starting this March.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuanzia Machi hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhawaaqday xeryo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan gobolka Uasin Gishu laga bilaabo bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche ogolo kambi mag thieth maonge chudo ne jogweng' Uasin Gishu County kochakore dwe mar Mach.

English: Universities Fund urges parents and teachers in Kericho County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku boorinayaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Kericho inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Kericho mondo omany namba mar kony mar nyithindo 116.

English: KICD calls on the community in Siaya County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KICD inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: KICD waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Siaya inay ka warbixiyaan walaacyada amniga ee ku saabsan maamulka dugsiga si ay u ilaaliyaan amniga dugsiyada.
Dholuo: KICD okwayo ji duto e county mar Siaya mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar skul e wi weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: DCI warns residents of Kilifi County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaonya wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: DCI waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi kororka khiyaamada SIM-swap waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kilifi County e wi medruok mar wuond mag SIM-swap kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya will hold a public participation forum on development planning forums in West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo katika Kaunti ya West Pokot.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta ee Gobolka West Pokot.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Huduma Kenya biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag dongruok e West Pokot County.

English: The US governmentâ€™s freeze on foreign aid, especially through USAid has caused major disruptions in Kenyaâ€™s health sector, particularly in HIV, malaria, and tuberculosis programmes that heavily rely on donor support.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Marekani imefunga misaada ya kigeni, hasa kupitia USAid imesababisha mapungufu makubwa katika sekta ya afya ya Kenya, hasa katika programu za VVU, malaria, na kifua kikuu ambazo zinategemea sana msaada wa wafadhili.
Somali: Joojinta dowladda Mareykanka ee gargaarka dibadda, gaar ahaan iyada oo loo marayo USAID, ayaa carqalad weyn ku keentay waaxda caafimaadka ee Kenya, gaar ahaan barnaamijyada HIV, duumada, iyo qaaxada oo si weyn ugu tiirsan taageerada deeq-bixiyeyaasha.
Dholuo: Ka sirkal mar Amerka ogengâ€TM kony ma wuok e pinje ma oko, ahinya ahinya kokalo kuom USAid, osekelo ywak maduongâ e sekta mar thieth e piny Kenya, ahinya ahinya e chenro mag HIV, maleria, kod tuoche mag ngâ€TMol ma geno ahinya kuom kony mar jochiw kony.

English: Wajir County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Wajir: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2024
Somali: Degmada Wajeer: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Wajir: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar adek higa mar 2024

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief, May 2023
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP wa Kenya, Mei 2023
Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya, Maajo 2023
Dholuo: Wach machiek mar piny Kenya mar WFP, Mei 2023

English: Kenya Gazette urges eligible citizens in Kitui County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Kitui kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kitui inay ka qaybqaataan jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro e County mar Kitui mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar yiero.

English: SHA updates residents of Nakuru County on progress of the county integrated development plan this June.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawasilisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja ya kaunti hii mwezi Juni.
Somali: SHA waxay dadka deggan degmada Nakuru ku wargelineysaa horumarka qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada bisha Juun.
Dholuo: SHA osemiyo jogweng' Nakuru ong'eyo kaka chenro mar dongruok mar county integrated development dhi nyime e dwe mar Jun.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges residents of Narok County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa watu wazima ili kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Narok inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo odonj e program mar somo kod somo mar joma dongo mondo giyud somo mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: Universities Fund urges residents of Samburu County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kufaidika na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan Gobolka Samburu inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo jogweng' mar Samburu County mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud konyruok kuom tiegruok mar somo kod somo mar jomoti.

English: TVET advises applicants in Nakuru County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: TVET waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Nakuru inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: TVET nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e gweng' mar Nakuru ni mondo gidonj e tiegruok kapok ichopo e chokruogno.

English: As global aid budgets shrink, refugees and host communities are increasingly competing in the same thin markets and relying on the same underâ€‘resourced schools, clinics, roads, and water systems, raising the stakes for local livelihoods.
Kiswahili: Kadiri bajeti za misaada ya kimataifa zinavyopungua, wakimbizi na jumuiya zinazowapokea wanazidi kushindana katika masoko nyembamba sawa na kutegemea shule zisizo na rasilimali, zahanati, barabara na mifumo ya maji, hivyo basi kuinua hali ya maisha ya wenyeji.
Somali: Iyadoo miisaaniyadda gargaarka caalamiga ah ay sii yaraanayso, qaxootiga iyo bulshooyinka martigelinaya ayaa si isa soo taraysa ugu tartamaya suuqyo isku mid ah oo khafiif ah waxayna ku tiirsan yihiin iskuullo, xarumo caafimaad, waddooyin, iyo nidaamyada biyaha oo aan dhaqaale ku filan lahayn, taasoo kor u qaadaysa khatarta ku imaan karta hab-nololeedka maxalliga ah.
Dholuo: Kaka pesa mag kony mag piny mangima medore, jolweny kod oganda ma rwakogi medo ng’anjo e chiro matin maromre kendo gigeno skul, klinik, yore, kod sistem mag pi maromre ma onge gik ma dwarore, ma medo pesa ma nyalo konyogi e ngimagi.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free trauma counselling support is available through county health facilities in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa ushauri wa kiwewe unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kitui.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo la talinta dhaawaca laga helo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Kitui County.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth e gweng' mar Kitui.

English: TVET reminds parents in Nyeri County that school feeding programme registration is open this January.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba usajili wa programu ya kulisha shule umefunguliwa Januari hii.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Nyeri in diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga ay furan tahay bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: TVET parone jonyuol manie County mar Nyeri ni chenro mar somo e skul mar chiemo osechakore e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice from SHA (Social Health Authority): nutrition supplementation for infants clinics will run every December at designated health centres in Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii): nyongeza ya lishe kwa kliniki za watoto wachanga itaendeshwa kila Desemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada): Kordhinta nafaqada ee bukaannada dhallaanka ayaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Diseembar ee kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Degmada Tharaka-Nithi.
Dholuo: Rieko moa kuom SHA (Social Health Authority): thieth mar chiemo ne nyithindo matindo ibiro tim e dwe mar Desemba higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e Tharaka-Nithi County.

English: SHA updates residents of Mombasa County on progress of community-based development programmes this November.
Kiswahili: SHA inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa juu ya maendeleo ya programu za maendeleo ya jamii mwezi huu wa Novemba.
Somali: SHA waxay dadka deggan degmada Mombasa ku wargelineysaa horumarka barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada ee bisha November.
Dholuo: SHA chiwo ripot ne Jo-Mombasa County kuom dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag oganda e dwe mar Novemba.

English: DPP urges anyone experiencing abuse in Nyamira County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: DPP inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kutafuta msaada katika nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Nyamira inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e County mar Nyamira mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: KICD urges youth in Samburu County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KICD inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Samburu kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KICD waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Samburu inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo rowere e county mar Samburu mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gitimo tije mag oganda.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises avocado producers in Trans Nzoia County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inashauri wazalishaji wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha avocado ee degmada Trans Nzoia inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nyiso jopur ma loso avocado e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia ni mondo gidonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: SHA urges residents of Mombasa County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa watumie portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: SHA waxay dadka deggan degmada Mombasa ugu baaqeysaa inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jogweng' Mombasa County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo kwayo mar kwedo mibadhi e migepe mag sirkal.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages residents of Tharaka-Nithi County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inaysan ku xanuunsadaan si aamusnaan ah oo ay ugu yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo giluong kony mar thieth mar paro maonge chudo.

English: Based on the seasonal rainfall forecast, adopt appropriate soil and water conservation measures: if rains are predicted above normal, focus on controlling erosion, protecting crops from flooding, and water harvesting; if below normal, focus on conserving soil moisture. If your land is sloping, add contour bunds to prevent soil erosion.
Kiswahili: Kulingana na utabiri wa msimu wa mvua, zingatia mbinu sahihi za kuhifadhi udongo na maji: ikiwa mvua zinatarajiwa kuwa nyingi kuliko kawaida, zingatia kudhibiti mmomonyoko wa udongo, kulinda mazao dhidi ya mafuriko, na kuvuna maji; ikiwa mvua zitakuwa chini ya kawaida, zingatia kuhifadhi unyevu wa udongo. Ikiwa ardhi yako iko mteremkoni, jenga matuta ili kuzuia mmomonyoko wa udongo.
Somali: Marka la eego saadaasha roobabka xilliyeedka, qaado tallaabooyinka saxda ah ee ilaalinta ciidda iyo biyaha: haddii roobabka la saadaaliyo ay ka sarreeyaan caadiga ah, diiradda saar xakamaynta burburka, ilaalinta dalagga fatahaadaha, iyo goosashada biyaha; haddii caadiga ka hooseeyo, diiradda saar ilaalinta qoyaanada ciidda. Haddii dhulku u jiifsan yahay, ku dar xidhmo xidhmo si looga hortago burburka ciidda.
Dholuo: Kaluwore gi kaka koth biro chue e kinde mag oro, kaw chenro mar rito lowo kod pi: ka koth chue moloyo kaka ne iparo, ket pachi kuom rito yien mondo kik kethre, rit cham kik chue, kendo ket pachi kuom choko pi; ka ok ochue, ket pachi kuom rito yuto mar lowo.

English: Tharaka Nithi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Mei 2024
Somali: Degmada Tharaka Nithi: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Tharaka Nithi: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar abich higa mar 2024

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Wajir County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa mkulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kula talineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Wajir inay keenaan lambarka diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qayb galaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e county mar Wajir mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: HELB reminds parents in Kilifi County that bursary allocation registration is open this June.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kwamba usajili wa ugawaji wa bursari umefunguliwa Juni hii.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Kilifi in diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ay furan tahay bisha Juun.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa jonyuol manie County ma Kilifi ni kad mar chiwo mich mag tiegruok osechakore e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will train farmers in Trans Nzoia County on water harvesting this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia juu ya uvunaji wa maji Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia oo ku saabsan goosashada biyaha bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro tiego jopur e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia e weche mag choko pi e dwe mar Februar.

English: NDMA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Makueni County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba upatikanaji wa maelekezo ya makazi salama unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee degmada Makueni in helitaanka tixraacyada magangelyo ammaan ah ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e County Makueni ni thuolo mar yudo kuonde mag dak ma onge tuoche yudore nono.

English: E-Citizen reminds voters in Mandera County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya michakato ya uchaguzi.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha gobolka Mandera inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor inta aan la helin nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa jogweng'o mag Mandera County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom SMS ne ji 70000 kapok gitimo yiero.

English: DCI reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Siaya County that access to the GBV toll-free helpline is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba upatikanaji wa simu ya GBV ya bure ya msaada unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Siaya in helitaanka khadka caawimaadda ee GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah uu yahay mid lacag-la'aan ah.
Dholuo: DCI parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e County mar Siaya ni gibiro yudo kony ma onge chudo mar GBV maonge chudo.

English: Notice: KEMRI will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Kitui County this June. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI itafanya kongamano la kurejesha matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Kitui Juni hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay qabaneysaa madasha dib u soo kabashada isticmaalka maandooriyaha ee Gobolka Kitui bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMRI biro timo chokruok mar chango joma tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero e dwe mar Jun e taon mar Kitui.

English: Notice from Kenya Red Cross: postnatal check-ups clinics will run every November at designated health centres in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya: kliniki za uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa zitafanya kazi kila Novemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya: Caafimaadka baaritaanka dhalmada ka dib waxaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Nofeembar ee dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka ee Gobolka Bungoma.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ripot Mamit mar Kenya: klinik mag nonro bang' nyuol biro dhi nyime dwe mar Novemba higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Bungoma.

English: KEPHIS urges farmers in Kirinyaga County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kirinyaga inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kirinyaga mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi pur mar piny mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: Notice: KMTC reminds citizens in Vihiga County about their rights regarding devolution.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Vihiga ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC paronwa raia mag Kaunti mar Vihiga e wi ratiro ma gin-go mar golo pesa.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free measles screening is available at all public health centres in Kisumu County this May.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa surua bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Mei hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka fayraska ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Kisumu bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: KEMSA oparo ne ji ni nonro mar thieth mar midho ma onge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Kisumu e dwe mar abich.

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages residents of Samburu County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Samburu inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay u dhiiri galiyaan saaxiibo dhibaataysan inay caawimaad raadsadaan.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Samburu County mondo kik gisandre aling' ling' kendo mondo gijiw osiepgi moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Nyandarua County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia simu ya EACC ya bure ili kupambana na matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee EACC si looga hortago xadgudubka xilka.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo oland weche mag mibadhi ka gitiyo gi simo mar EACC ma onge chudo mondo giked gi timbe maricho mag tiyo gi migepe.

English: How the Climate Crisis Threatens Farming in Rural Kenya
Kiswahili: Jinsi Mgogoro wa Hali ya Hewa Unavyotishia Kilimo Vijijini Kenya
Somali: Sidee Xiisadda Cimiladu Halis ugu tahay Beeraha Miyiga Kenya
Dholuo: Kaka Pek mar Piny Oketo Puoth e Mier mag Kenya

English: COVID-19 posters printed by USAID/MSP have been delivered to various counties to enhance awareness to prevent the spread of the virus #KomeshaCorona update.
Kiswahili: Mabango ya COVID-19 yaliyochapishwa na USAID/MSP yamewasilishwa katika kaunti mbalimbali ili kuongeza uhamasishaji wa kuzuia kuenea kwa virusi vya #KomeshaCorona sasisho.
Somali: Boodhadhka COVID-19 oo ay daabacday USAID/MSP ayaa la geeyay degmooyin kala duwan si kor loogu qaado wacyigelinta si looga hortago faafitaanka fayraska #KomeshaCorona.
Dholuo: Poster mag COVID-19 ma ogoyo gi riwruok mar USAID/MSP oseter e kaunti mopogore opogore mondo omed ng’eyo mar geng’o lando mar korona #KomeshaCorona update.

English: Tharaka Nithi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Aprili 2023
Somali: Degmada Tharaka Nithi: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Tharaka Nithi: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar Ang'wen higa mar 2023

English: Notice: DPP conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Nandi County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Nandi Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ku saabsan ka hortagga argagixisada ee gobolka Nandi bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: DPP timo romo mar oganda e dwe mar Mach e kaunti mar Nandi.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will distribute certified coffee seed to farmers in Murang'a County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itasambaza mbegu za kahawa zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay abuurka kafeega ee shahaadada leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Murang'a bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro pogo kodhi mag kahawa ne jopur e County mar Murang'a e dwe mar Desemba.

English: County Government warns stakeholders about to improve service provision and urges them to submit comments on.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti inawaonya wadau kuhusu kuboresha utoaji wa huduma na inawasihi watoe maoni yao kuhusu.
Somali: Maamulka degmada ayaa uga digaya daneeyayaasha ku saabsan hagaajinta bixinta adeegyada wuxuuna ku boorinayaa inay soo gudbiyaan faallooyin ku saabsan.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar County chiwo siem ne joma nigi paro e wi dongruok mar tij lendo kendo ojiwogi mondo gichiw paro kuom wachni.

English: NDMA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Migori County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Migori kwamba upatikanaji wa maelekezo ya makazi salama unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee Degmada Migori in helitaanka tixraacyada magangelyo ammaan ah ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu motudore gi dichwo gi dhako e County mar Migori ni ginyalo yudo kuonde ma ginyalo dakie maonge chudo.

English: Council of Governors urges residents of Kericho County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaskazini.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha waxay ku boorinayaan dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan mashaariicda horumarinta degmada.
Dholuo: Council of Governors jiwo jogweng' Kericho County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche momedore e wi chenrogo mag dongruok.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages residents of Isiolo County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay ugu yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ojiwo jogweng' Isiolo County mondo kik gisandgi gi muolo kendo giluong kony mar thieth mar chuny maonge chudo.

English: KALRO informs maize farmers in Nyandarua County of new market linkage opportunities this January.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawafahamisha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Januari hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee gobolka Nyandarua fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: KALRO nyiso jopur mag cham e Kaunti mar Nyandarua e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Januar.

English: NTSA warns residents of Mombasa County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhusu ongezeko la udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: NTSA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa kororka khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga leh bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Mombasa County e wi medruok mar timbe mag wuondo pesa mag simo kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok kare ne jatendgi.

English: Ministry of Education launches mobile learning units to reach out-of-school children in remote rural locations.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu yazindua vitengo vya kujifunza vinavyohamishika ili kuwafikia watoto walio nje ya shule katika maeneo ya vijijini ya mbali.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa bilowday cutubyo waxbarasho oo guurguura si loo gaaro carruurta aan waxbarashada dhigan ee ku nool miyiga fog.
Dholuo: Od tich mar somo ochako chenro mag somo ma wuotho ​​mondo ochop ne nyithindo ma ok dhi skul e gwenge mabor mag gwenge.

English: Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority (TVETA) emphasizes the importance of TVET for youth employment.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Elimu na Mafunzo ya Ufundi na Ufundi (TVETA) inasisitiza umuhimu wa TVET kwa ajili ya ajira ya vijana.
Somali: Hay'adda waxbarashada iyo tababarka farsamada iyo xirfadaha (TVETA) waxay xoojineysaa muhiimadda TVET u leedahay shaqada dhalinyarada.
Dholuo: Puonjruok kod tiegruok e weche mag teknoloji kod tich (TVETA) jiwo ahinya gimomiyo tiegruogno konyo rowere yudo tich.

English: Notice: FAO will open a tea collection centre in Garissa County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya chai katika Kaunti ya Garissa Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay xarun soo ururinta shaaha ka furi doontaa Gobolka Garissa bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: FAO biro yawo ot mar choko chai e taon mar Garissa e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Children exposed to smoke are more likely to develop asthma and respiratory infections.
Kiswahili: Watoto wanaovuta moshi wana uwezekano mkubwa wa kupata pumu na maambukizi ya njia ya upumuaji.
Somali: Carruurta qiiqa la taaban karo waxay u badan yihiin inay qabaan asthma iyo cudurrada neefsashada.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma madho ndawa nyalo bedo gi tuwo mar asthma kod tuoche mag muya.

English: Strengthen surveillance, vaccination, and control of livestock diseases such as Foot and Mouth Disease and Lumpy Skin Disease, while supporting fodder conservation and pasture management.
Kiswahili: Imarisha ufuatiliaji, chanjo, na udhibiti wa magonjwa ya mifugo kama vile Ugonjwa wa Miguu na Mdomo na Ugonjwa wa Ngozi ya Uvimbe, huku ukisaidia uhifadhi wa malisho na usimamizi wa malisho.
Somali: Xoojinta kormeerka, tallaalka iyo xakamaynta cudurrada xoolaha sida Cudurrada Cagta iyo Afka iyo Cudurrada maqaarka ee Lumpy, iyadoo la taageerayo ilaalinta hilibka iyo maaraynta daaqsinada.
Dholuo: Tego chenro mar rito, goyo osuru, kod geng'o tuoche mag jamni kaka tuoche mag tiende kod dho dhogi kod tuoche mag pien ma ok rum, ka gijiwo rito le kod yiende.

English: IPOA urges the public in Kakamega County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: IPOA inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za kashfa za pesa za rununu.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha Gobolka Kakamega inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda kadib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada lacagta mobilada.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo ji duto e Kaunti mar Kakamega mondo ochiw ripot mar ote manyalo kelo hinyruok ne jomisonari margi bang' yudo ripot mag timbe mag wuondo pesa e simo.

English: Social distance is an essential way to slow down the spread of COVID-19. And it is important that you follow the social distancing recommendations in your community whether yourâ€™re in one of the high-risk groups or not. #KomeshaCorona campaign
Kiswahili: Umbali wa kijamii ni njia muhimu ya kupunguza kasi ya kuenea kwa COVID-19. Na ni muhimu kufuata mapendekezo ya umbali wa kijamii katika jamii yako iwe uko katika moja ya vikundi vilivyo hatarini au la. Kampeni ya #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Fogaanshaha bulshadu waa hab muhiim ah oo lagu yareeyo faafitaanka COVID-19. Waana muhiim inaad raacdo talooyinka kala fogaanshaha bulshada ee bulshadaada haddii aad ka mid tahay kooxaha khatarta sare leh iyo haddii kaleba. Ololaha #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Bedo mabor gi ji en yo maduong' mar duoko piny lalruok mar COVID-19. Kendo en gima duong' ni iluw yore mag bedo mabor gi ji e alworau kata bed ni in e achiel kuom grup ma nigi luoro maduong' kata ok. Kampen mar #KomeshaKorona

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free malaria screening is available at all public health centres in Laikipia County this November.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa malaria bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Novemba hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka malaria ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee Gobolka Laikipia bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone ji ni nonro mar malaria maonge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Laikipia e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development announces distribution of revision guides to schools in Laikipia County this February.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inatangaza usambazaji wa miongozo ya marekebisho kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Februari hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku dhawaaqay qaybinta hagaha dib u eegista dugsiyada degmada Laikipia bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag somo e skunde man Laikipia County e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: AFA will distribute certified beans seed to farmers in Taita-Taveta County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: AFA itawapa wakulima katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta mbegu zilizothibitishwa za maharagwe mwezi Novemba huu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay u qaybin doontaa abuurka xashiishadda ee la shaaciyey beeraleyda ku nool Gobolka Taita-Taveta bisha November ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: AFA biro pogo kodhi molony mag nyinyo ne jopur manie Taita-Taveta County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds the public in Baringo County that reporting embezzlement of public funds is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa fedha za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu dadka degmada Baringo ku xasuusinayaa in warbixinta xadgudubka lacagaha dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette parone ji duto e County mar Baringo ni chiwo ripot mar ketho pesa mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: NDMA alerts residents of Bomet County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka kwa kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: NDMA waxay dadka deggan degmada Bomet uga digtay kororka kiisaska gaadiidka la xaday waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: NDMA chiwo siem ne jogweng' County mar Bomet e wi medruok mar kwan mag joma oketho mtokni kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot e stesen mar polise man machiegni.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service conducts a community briefing on border security in Kakamega County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Mei hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu qabtaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha ee Gobolka Kakamega bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Forest Service timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e gweng' mar Kakamega e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Busia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafungua ofisi ya kijinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Kaunti ya Busia.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu furayaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya taageero maskaxeed ee gobolka Busia.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Forest Service oyawo ofis ma chiwo kony ne joma chwo gi mon e gweng' mar Busia.

English: IPOA urges motorists and pedestrians in Machakos County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka lugta leh ee degmada Machakos inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha lugta ah ee loo qoondeeyay si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo joidh mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Machakos mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo giti gi kuonde ma wuothoe mondo gikwed masiche motudore gi koth.

English: Mandera County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Mandera: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2023
Somali: Degmada Mandheera: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Mandera: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar Septemba 2023

English: HELB conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Kwale County this August.
Kiswahili: HELB inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Kwale Agosti hii.
Somali: HELB waxay qabanqaabinaysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha gobolka Kwale bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: HELB timo romo mar tiego ji e wi migawo mar ombudsman e county mar Kwale e dwe mar Agost.

English: IPOA calls on the community in Marsabit County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawatia moyo jamii katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: IPOA waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Marsabit inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: IPOA luongo oganda mar Marsabit County mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo ochiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Notice: FAO restricts movement of dairy cows in Samburu County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO inazuia harakati za ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Samburu kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi wenye uvimbe.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da caanaha ah ee Gobolka Samburu sababo la xiriira faafitaanka cudurka maqaarka.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: FAO ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok makwayo chak e county mar Samburu nikech tuoche mag pien.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Embu County this April.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Embu Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu qabtaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan dhismaha nabadda qaranka ee degmada Embu bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Forest Service dhi nyime gi romo mar oganda kuom wach loso kuwe e gweng' mar Embu e dwe mar April.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development advises applicants in Kajiado County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kutembelea kituo cha mafunzo ya ufundi kilicho karibu zaidi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee horumarinta manhajka wuxuu kula talinayaa codsadayaasha degmada Kajiado inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee loogu talagalay gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e Kajiado County mondo odhi e kar tiegruok mar tich machiegni kodgi.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Kericho County that access to subsidised dialysis is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba upatikanaji wa dialysis ya ruzuku sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kericho in helitaanka dialysis-ka la taageeray hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMSA oparo ne ji duto manie County mar Kericho ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mar dialysis e kuonde moyier.

English: Warehouse Receipt Systems WRS allow you to store produce and use receipts as collateral for loans Learn how WRS works for fruits
Kiswahili: Mifumo ya Risiti za Ghalani WRS hukuruhusu kuhifadhi mazao na kutumia risiti kama dhamana ya mikopo Jifunze jinsi WRS inavyofanya kazi kwa matunda
Somali: Nidaamyada Warehouse Receipt Systems WRS waxay kuu oggolaanayaan inaad kaydsato wax soo saarka oo aad isticmaasho rasiidhka sidii dammaanad amaah Baro sida WRS u shaqeyso miraha
Dholuo: WRS ma en chenro mar chiwo pesa e wi gik ma osechoki kendo ma oketi mondo okonygo ng'ato yudo pesa ma en-go mar chiwo pesa

English: KMTC advises applicants in Busia County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KMTC inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Busia kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KMTC waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Busia inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: KMTC nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Busia ni gidonj e skundni ka pok giyudo thuolo mar donjo e chokruogno.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges eligible citizens in Turkana County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi raia wenye haki katika Kaunti ya Turkana kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Turkana inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo jokanyo mag Turkana County mondo oriwgi e ndiko joma oyier.

English: Ministry of Health appeals to caregivers in Kitui County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the September maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuhudhuria siku iliyopangwa ya kliniki kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Septemba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Kitui inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta bukaanka ee la qorsheeyay iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health okwayo jorit e County mar Kitui mondo obi e odiechieng' mar klinik ma ne ochan mar dwe mar ochiko mar weche thieth mar mine.

English: Universities Fund reminds youth in West Pokot County that HELB funding is available for welding and fabrication training.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xasuusinayaa dhalinyarada degmada West Pokot in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa rowere man West Pokot County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free suicide prevention support is available through county health facilities in Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kuzuia kujiua unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo ka hortagga ismiidaaminta laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Murang'a.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar geng'o ji kik donjre yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Murang'a.

English: Floods Impact and Interventions, 2024, as of 17.04.2024
Kiswahili: Athari na Afua za Mafuriko, 2024, kuanzia tarehe 17.04.2024
Somali: Saamaynta iyo Faragelinta Daadadka, 2024, laga bilaabo 17.04.2024
Dholuo: Gik ma Opong’o Pi Kelo kod yore mag donjo e higa mar 2024, chakre tarik 17 dwe mar 2024

English: Tharaka Nithi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2022
Somali: Degmada Tharaka Nithi: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Tharaka Nithi: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar adek higa mar 2022

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Siaya County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurka laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health nyiso ji duto modak e county mar Siaya mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth mar oganda ma onge chudo mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: State Department for TVET reminds parents in Kajiado County that free primary education registration is open this March.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kwamba usajili wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo umefunguliwa Machi hii.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Kajiado in diiwaangelinta bilaashka ah ee waxbarashada hoose ay furan tahay bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET parone janyuol e Kajiado County ni somo mar pinyruoth ma onge chudo ochakore e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens a new service point for national ID applications in Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu ka furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag kwayo nying' e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia.

English: Notice: AFA will distribute certified cassava seed to farmers in Kitui County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itasambaza mbegu za mihogo zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: AFA waxay abuuraha degmada Kitui u qaybin doontaa abuurka cassava ee la caddeeyay bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: AFA biro pogo kodhi mag cassava ne jopur man Kitui County e dwe mar Agost.

English: A mother_x0092_s diet during pregnancy influences her child_x0092_s long-term health. Eat diverse, nutritious foods.
Kiswahili: Chakula cha mama wakati wa ujauzito huathiri afya ya mtoto wake kwa muda mrefu.
Somali: Cunto hooyada_x0092_s ah xilliga uurka waxay saameyn ku leedahay caafimaadka ilmaha_x0092_s muddada dheer. Cun cuntooyin kala duwan oo nafaqo leh.
Dholuo: Chiemo ma min chamo e kinde ma en gi ich, nyalo ketho ngima mar nyathine kuom kinde malach. Cham chiemo mopogore opogore kendo ma nigi gik ma konyo ringruok.

English: We are advising members of the public to put on masks when getting into a matatu one is advised to put on a mask. Local production of masks and PPEs has began
Kiswahili: Tunawashauri wananchi kuvaa barakoa wanapoingia kwenye matatu, mtu anashauriwa kuvaa barakoa. Uzalishaji wa barakoa na vifaa vya kujikinga umeanza.
Somali: Waxaan kula talineynaa shacabka inay xirtaan maaskaro marka ay soo galaan matatu waxaa lagula talinayaa in la xirto maaskari.
Dholuo: Wachiwo siem ne ji mondo orwak mask sama gidonjo e matatu.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Garissa County about the importance of hand hygiene for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa juu ya umuhimu wa usafi wa mikono kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay dadka degmada Garissa ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda nadaafadda gacmaha ay u leedahay caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa ji duto e County mar Garissa gimomiyo rito ler mar lwedo en gima dwarore ahinya e ngima joot.

English: TSC invites youth in Lamu County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this August.
Kiswahili: TSC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Lamu kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Agosti hii.
Somali: TSC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Lamu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: TSC gwelo rowere e County mar Lamu mondo odonj e tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing e dwe mar Agost.

English: The EU and Kenya are collaborating to enhance sustainable agriculture driven by youth Stay tuned for upcoming programs and opportunities to engage in this initiative
Kiswahili: EU na Kenya zinashirikiana kuimarisha kilimo endelevu kinachoendeshwa na vijana. Endelea kuwa tayari kwa programu na fursa zijazo za kushiriki katika mpango huu.
Somali: EU iyo Kenya waxay iska kaashanayaan kor u qaadista beeraha waara ee ay hogaaminayaan dhalinyarada. La soco barnaamijyada soo socda iyo fursadaha lagu ka qayb qaadan karo hindisahan
Dholuo: EU kod Kenya tiyo kanyachiel mondo gimed timo dongruok e yore mag pur ma ok nyal geng'o rowere.

English: Public notice: Kenya Medical Association will host a free tobacco control outreach in Tana River County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa kudhibiti tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Tana River Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu martiqaadi doonaa dadaal lacag la'aan ah oo ka dhan ah ka hortagga sigaarka degmada Tana River bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association biro timo kampen mar golo ndawa maonge chudo e taon mar Tana River County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: NCPB will open a horticultural produce collection centre in Trans Nzoia County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay ka furi doontaa xarun ururinta alaabada beeraha ee Gobolka Trans Nzoia bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NCPB biro yawo ot mar choko puothe mag puothe e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service conducts a community briefing on border security in Turkana County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Turkana Julai hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu qabtaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha ee degmada Turkana bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Forest Service timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e County mar Turkana e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit confirms a HIV/AIDS outbreak alert for Bomet County. Residents are advised to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa VVU/UKIMWI kwa Kaunti ya Bomet. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta Caafimada taranka ayaa xaqiijisay feejignaanta cudurka HIV / AIDS ee degmada Bomet. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osenyiso ni nitie siem mar tuo mar HIV/AIDS e county mar Bomet.

English: NPS warns residents of Nairobi County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi juu ya kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: NPS waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi kororka qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban.
Dholuo: NPS chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nairobi County kuom medruok mar chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET opens applications for revision guides for learners in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay furaysaa codsiyada hagaha dib-u-eegista ardayda degmada Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar State Department for TVET oseyawo kwayo mag somo e wi weche mag somo ne jopuonjre man Lamu County.

English: IEBC educates public on new reforms in electoral systems.
Kiswahili: IEBC inaelimisha umma juu ya mageuzi mapya katika mifumo ya uchaguzi.
Somali: IEBC waxay dadweynaha u baraysaa isbeddellada cusub ee nidaamyada doorashooyinka.
Dholuo: IEBC puonjo ji e wi lokruok manyien e yore mag yiero.

English: NTSA calls on the community in Migori County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawatia moyo jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Migori kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu ya simu ya GBV 1195.
Somali: NTSA waxay bulshada degmada Migori ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wici doonaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: NTSA luongo ji duto manie Migori County mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: America continues vaccination to control diarrhoea amongst livestock.
Kiswahili: Amerika inaendelea chanjo kudhibiti kuhara kati ya mifugo.
Somali: Maraykanka ayaa sii wadaya tallaalka si loo xakameeyo ciribta xoolaha.
Dholuo: Amerka dhi nyime gi thiedho dhok mondo gimi ji kik hinyre.

English: NPS warns residents of Kiambu County to prepare for possible road accidents this December.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Desemba hii.
Somali: NPS waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay u diyaar garoobaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: NPS osiemo jogweng' Kiambu County mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Government department, has commited to use solar power in food preservation in more secure manner
Kiswahili: Idara ya Serikali imejitolea kutumia nishati ya jua katika kuhifadhi chakula kwa njia salama zaidi
Somali: Waaxda Dowladda, ayaa ballanqaaday in la isticmaalo tamarta qoraxda ee ilaalinta cuntada si ammaan ah
Dholuo: Riwruok mar sirkal osesingore mar tiyo gi teko mar chieng' e rito chiemo e yo makare

English: Notice: KICD opens applications for revision guides for learners in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay furaysaa codsiyada hagaha dib u eegista ardayda ku nool gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KICD oseyawo kwayo mag somo mondo okony jopuonjre e Homa Bay County.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds residents of Kajiado County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kajiado County kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette paronwa jogweng' Kajiado County ni luwo dongruok mar tich kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: KTDA invites farmers in Vihiga County to a free training on post-harvest handling this June.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno Juni hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Vihiga tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan maaraynta goosashada ka dib bisha Juun.
Dholuo: KTDA ogwelo jopur e County mar Vihiga e tiegruok ma onge chudo e dwe mar Jun.

English: KICD reminds needy students in Kiambu County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Kiambu in deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay codsiyada ardayda baahan ay dhowaan dhammaadaan.
Dholuo: KICD paronwa jopuonjre man gi chan e County mar Kiambu ni tuke mag somo ne jopuonjre ma nigi chan biro rumo machiegni.

English: COMESA reminds livestock keepers in Meru County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Meru kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: COMESA waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Meru inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha ka gudbaan xadka degmada iyagoo aan haysan rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: COMESA parone jorit jamni e county mar Meru mondo kik giting' jamni ka ok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: Teachers Service Commission advises students in Nakuru County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza dijitali.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ardayda degmada Nakuru kula talinayaa inay dalbadaan bogga deeqda waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan waxyaabaha barashada dijitaalka ah ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jopuonjre e Kaunti mar Nakuru mondo oketgi e intanet mondo giyud thuolo mar somo weche mag digital maonge chudo.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kudai kutoa huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na ufisadi wa fedha za umma.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay dalbadaan bixinta adeegyo aan la siinayo laaluush si looga hortago xadgudubka lacagta dawladda.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo okonygi ka ok gichiwo asoya.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free malaria screening is available at all public health centres in Kakamega County this May.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa malaria bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Mei hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka malaria ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee Gobolka Kakamega bisha May.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone ji ni thieth mar malaria maonge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e Kaunti mar Kakamega e dwe mar Mei.

English: KALRO warns wheat farmers in Bungoma County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaonya wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KALRO waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda wheat ee degmada Bungoma cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: KALRO chiwo siem ne jopur mag ngano e County mar Bungoma kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: KNEC reminds schools in Tana River County to strengthen school infrastructure safety this September.
Kiswahili: KNEC inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuimarisha usalama wa miundombinu ya shule Septemba hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay xusuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Tana River inay xoojiyaan ammaanka kaabayaasha dugsiga bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KNEC oparo ne skunde man Tana River County mondo omed jiwo ritruok mar chenro mag skul e dwe mar Septemba.

English: IPOA alerts residents of Kirinyaga County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: IPOA waxay dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga uga digtay kororka kiisaska tuugada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: IPOA chiwo siem ne ji modak e County mar Kirinyaga kuom wach kwan mag jokuoge medore kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polis mar oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: State Department for Basic Education reminds schools in Kisumu County to strengthen anti-bullying measures this March.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inazikumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuimarisha hatua za kupambana na uonevu Machi hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay dib u xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Kisumu inay xoojiyaan tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibaatada bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education oparo ne skunde mag Kisumu County mondo omed jiwo yore mag kedo gi timbe mahundu e dwe mar Mach.

English: IEBC advises residents of Baringo County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: IEBC inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e-Citizen.
Somali: IEBC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan diiwaangelinta e-Citizen.
Dholuo: IEBC nyiso jogweng' Baringo County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro dhi e e-Citizen registration.

English: Universities Fund encourages residents of Garissa County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Garissa inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabaan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Garissa mondo onon weche ma giduto gikwongo tiyogo mondo ging'e tich mar ombudsman.

English: TSC reminds needy students in Kiambu County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: TSC waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Kiambu in buugaagta waxbarasho iyo codsiyada qalabka wax lagu barto ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: TSC paronwa jopuonjre man gi chandruok e County mar Kiambu ni buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok biro rumo machiegni.

English: IPOA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Isiolo County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: IPOA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayeona unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Isiolo piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Isiolo inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: IPOA ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo chandruok mar nindruok e kaunti mar Isiolo mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service promotes agroforestry among farmers in Kakamega County as part of the October climate resilience drive.
