Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inakuza kilimo cha misitu miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Oktoba.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa beeraleyda beeraha ee Gobolka Kakamega iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka adkeysiga cimilada ee Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo yiende mag yiende e kind jopur e Kaunti mar Kakamega kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi mar lokruok mar kit yamo e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: FAO encourages farmers in Migori County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for tea.
Kiswahili: FAO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya chai.
Somali: FAO waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Migori inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan shaaha.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e county mar Migori mondo ous olemo mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo chai mondo omi ohala mar chai obed maber.

English: Notice: COMESA restricts movement of goats in Embu County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA inazuia harakati za mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Embu kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi wenye uvimbe.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa riyaha ee Gobolka Embu sababtuna tahay faafitaanka cudurka maqaarka.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: COMESA ogeng'o wuoth mar diek e County mar Embu nikech tuoche mag pien.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds needy students in Nyeri County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya ardayda u baahan degmada Nyeri in dalabka buugaagta waxbarasho iyo qalabka waxbarasho uu dhowaan soo gabagabeyn doono.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne jopuonjre man Nyeri County ni buk mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok biro rumo machiegni.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on residents of Kitui County to support local peace-building committees in support of national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kitui kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani kusaidia kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee maxalliga ah si ay uga caawiyaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross okwayo jogweng' Kitui County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e pinyno.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges sweet potatoes growers in Kwale County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Kwale kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Waxsoosaarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda baradho macaan ee Gobolka Kwale inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalaalka ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur ma pidho olemo mag sweet potato e Kaunti mar Kwale mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e kinde machuok.

English: SHA encourages first-time voters in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: SHA inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: SHA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo josiasa ma ne okwongo yiero e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero.

English: If you are riding a bodaboda, make sure the driver has a helmet and a reflective jacket.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa unaendesha bodaboda, hakikisha dereva ana kofia na koti la kuangazia.
Somali: Haddii aad wado bodaboda, hubso in darawalka uu haysto koofiyad iyo jaaketi iftiiminaysa.
Dholuo: Kapo ni idwaro riembo bodaboda, tem neno ni dereba oting'o ofuko mar aseru kod jaket ma rieny.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the community in Garissa County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb carjacking.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Garissa kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia utekaji nyara wa magari.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya bulshada gobolka Garissa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo afduubka gawaarida.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ji duto manie County mar Garissa mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o kwalo mtokni.

English: "Set up 2FA (Two-Factor Authentication) for all your accounts. If your password is stolen, you will still be protected."
Kiswahili: "Weka 2FA (Two-Factor Authentication) kwa akaunti zako zote. Kama password yako ni kuibiwa, bado utakuwa ulinzi".
Somali: "Adeegso 2FA (Two-Factor Authentication) dhammaan xisaabaadkaaga. Haddii lambarkaaga sirta ah lagaa xado, wali waa lagaa ilaalin doonaa".
Dholuo: "Chiko weche mag 2FA (Two-Factor Authentication) ne gik moko duto ma in-go. Kapo ni oyud weche mitiyogo, pod ibiro ritogi. "

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya launches a cattle rustling prevention campaign in Meru County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Meru Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay billaabaneysaa olole looga hortago xanta xoolaha ee gobolka Meru bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chako kampen mar geng'o ywaruok mag dhok e taon mar Meru e dwe mar Mach.

English: Introduction of MoreMilk 2, aimed at improving milk safety and incomes via standards, training, and market access in central/western Kenya.
Kiswahili: Utangulizi wa MoreMilk2, unaolenga kuboresha usalama wa maziwa na mapato kupitia viwango, mafunzo, na ufikiaji wa soko katikati/magharibi mwa Kenya.
Somali: Soo bandhigida MoreMilk 2, oo ujeedkeedu yahay hagaajinta badbaadada caanaha iyo dakhliga iyada oo loo marayo heerarka, tababarka iyo marin u helka suuqa bartamaha / galbeedka Kenya.
Dholuo: Chiwruok mar MoreMilk 2, ma dwaro ni ji omed bedo gi ngima maber e chakruok mar piny Kenya kokalo kuom chike, tiegruok, kod thuolo mar yudo ohala e pinyno.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Busia County about the importance of safe water storage for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Busia juu ya umuhimu wa uhifadhi wa maji salama kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMRI waxay dadka degmada Busia ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMRI parone ji duto e County mar Busia kuom ber mar kano pi maler e ngima joot.

English: Teachers Service Commission advises applicants in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kutembelea kituo cha mafunzo ya ufundi kilicho karibu kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku talinayaa codsadayaasha degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow si ay u helaan waxbarashada soo socota.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e gweng' mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) urges poultry farmers in Bomet County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawahimiza wafugaji wa kuku katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa ngozi wa uvimbe.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda digaagga ee degmada Bomet inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyada oo aan la helin rukhsad ka dib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur ma pidho dhok e county mar Bomet mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni e gweng'no maok giyudo rusa bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag dhoot.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds livestock keepers in Laikipia County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya xoolaha Laikipia County inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board parone jorit jamni e county mar Laikipia ni gimi jamnigi thieth e kuonde moyier mag nego jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kericho County that access to post-violence medical care is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu zinapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ee ka dhacay degmada Kericho in helitaanka daryeelka caafimaad ee rabshadda ka dib ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Kericho ni yudo kony mar thieth ma iyudo bang' lweny en gima ng'ato nyalo timo ma onge chudo.

English: Notice from Division of Disease Surveillance and Response: family planning counselling clinics will run every November at designated health centres in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitafanya kazi kila Novemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka socda qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada: rugaha la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ayaa la qaban doonaa bishii Nofeembar ee kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Mandera.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuwo: Klinike mag chiwo paro e wi chenro mag ngima joot biro tiyo e dwe mar Novemba higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Mandera.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Uasin Gishu County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu juu ya umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay dadka degmada Uasin Gishu ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay nadaafadda saxda ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji duto e county mar Uasin Gishu kuom ber mar rito ler maler e ngima joot.

English: NPS reminds residents of Machakos County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada daadadka ka dhacay xilligan dabka.
Dholuo: NPS parone jogweng'o mag Machakos County ni kik giwuoth e kind yiengni mag mach e kinde ma pi opong'o ponde kod aoche.

English: Notice: KEMSA confirms a measles outbreak alert for Bungoma County. Residents are advised to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA yathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa surua katika Kaunti ya Bungoma. Wakazi wanashauriwa kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMSA waxay xaqiijineysaa feejignaan ku saabsan faafitaanka cudurka hargabka ee degmada Bungoma. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMSA osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuwono e County mar Bungoma. Ojiwo jogweng'no mondo ochop dose duto mar thieth ma gichiwo.

English: NTSA calls on the community in Nairobi County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawatia moyo jamii katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka kwa nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Somali: NTSA waxay bulshada degmada Nairobi ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan waxayna taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: NTSA luongo oganda man Nairobi County mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo manyo kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will hold a suicide prevention forum in Embu County this March. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitafanya kongamano la kuzuia kujiua katika Kaunti ya Embu Machi hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa qaban doonta madasha ka hortagga ismiidaaminta ee degmada Embu bishii Maarso. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo chokruok mar geng'o ji kik donjre e Embu County e dwe mar Mach. Ji duto mor.

English: KNEC reminds parents in Bomet County that free day secondary education registration is open this January.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba usajili wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo umefunguliwa Januari hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Bomet in diiwaangelinta dugsiga dhexe ee bilaashka ah ay furan tahay bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: KNEC paronwa jonyuol e County mar Bomet ni somo mar sekondari mar odiechieng' achiel ma onge chudo osechakore e dwe mar Januar.

English: NPS calls on residents of Kajiado County to support local peace-building committees in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaita wakazi wa Kajiado County kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani kwa msaada wa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: NPS waxay dadka deggan degmada Kajiado ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee deegaanka si ay u taageerayaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: NPS okwayo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gwenge ma gidakie mondo gikony e chiwo siem motelo ne oganda.

English: Farmers in mango producing counties are encouraged to adopt improved planting materials and enhance their skills to boost production and market access following the National Mango Conference
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika kaunti zinazozalisha miembe wamehimizwa kutumia nyenzo bora za upanzi na kuongeza ujuzi wao ili kukuza uzalishaji na upatikanaji wa soko kufuatia Kongamano la Kitaifa la Mango.
Somali: Beeraleyda ku nool gobollada soo saara mango-ga waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay qaataan agabyo beereed oo la hagaajiyay oo ay horumariyaan xirfadahooda si ay u xoojiyaan wax-soo-saarka iyo helitaanka suuqa kadib Shirweynaha Qaranka ee Mango-ga
Dholuo: Jo-Purchasing e gwenge ma loso mango ijiwo jopur mondo oti gi gik mabeyo mag pidho mango kendo omed lony e timo dongruok e tijgi mar loso kendo yudo ohala bang' chokruok mar National Mango Conference

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds residents of Garissa County that terracing improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba usafirishaji wa mipaka huboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan Gobolka Garissa in dhulka lagu beerayo uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board parone jogweng' mar County mar Garissa ni terracing medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Government partners with NGOs to provide internet access points and digital devices to marginalized children for e-learning.
Kiswahili: Serikali inashirikiana na mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali kutoa vituo vya ufikiaji wa mtandao na vifaa vya dijiti kwa watoto walioachwa kando kwa ajili ya kujifunza kwa njia ya elektroniki.
Somali: Dowladaha waxay iskaashi la sameeyaan ururada aan dawliga ahayn si ay u siiyaan barashada internetka iyo aaladaha dhijitaalka ah ee carruurta marginalized.
Dholuo: Sirkal noriwore gi riwruoge maok mag sirkal e chiwo kuonde mag yudo weche mag intanet kod gik mamoko mag digital ne nyithindo manie bwo loch mondo giyud thuolo mar puonjore e yor intanet.

English: Notice from SHA (Social Health Authority): childhood immunization clinics will run every September at designated health centres in Embu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii): kliniki za chanjo za watoto zitafanya kazi kila Septemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada): xarumaha tallaalka caruurta ayaa ka shaqeyn doona Sebtember kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Embu.
Dholuo: Rieko moa kuom SHA (Social Health Authority): klinik mag thieth mar nyithindo biro tiyo e dwe mar ochiko higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e county mar Embu.

English: Religious leaders under World Council of Churches urge governments and donor countries to increase Global Fund support, to aid sustainable responses to HIV, tuberculosis, and malaria.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa kidini chini ya Baraza la Makanisa Duniani wanahimiza serikali na nchi wafadhili kuongeza usaidizi wa Mfuko wa Dunia, ili kusaidia majibu endelevu kwa VVU, kifua kikuu, na malaria.
Somali: Hogaamiyaasha Diimaha ee Golaha Kaniisadaha Adduunka waxay dowladaha iyo dalalka deeqda bixiya ku boorinayaan inay kordhiyaan taageerada Hay'adda Global Fund, si ay u caawiyaan jawaab celinta joogtada ah ee HIV, cudurka hargabka, iyo makaraayada.
Dholuo: Jotend dinde manie bwo World Council of Churches jiwo sirkande kod pinje ma chiwo chiwo chiwo mondo omed konyo riwruok miluongo ni Global Fund e tieko tuo mar AYAKI, kahera, kod malaria.

English: Kenya Medical Association calls on parents in Nyandarua County to have children under five screened for dengue fever during the November outreach.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuwapima watoto chini ya miaka mitano homa ya dengue wakati wa mawasiliano ya Novemba.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqay waalidiinta degmada Nyandarua in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baarayo cudurka dengue inta lagu jiro bisha November.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association okwayo jonyuol e County mar Nyandarua mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Novemba.

English: KRA reminds residents of Bomet County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Bomet wanaohudhuria mkutano wa umma wa wilaya kuimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet ee ka qeybgalaya kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada waxay xoojineysaa maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: KRA paronwa jogweng' County ma biro e chokruok maduong' mar county Assembly mondo omed jiwo sirkal.

English: Notice: DCI launches a fraud prevention campaign in Homa Bay County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI inazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga khiyaamooyinka gobolka Homa Bay bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Paro: DCI chako kampen mar geng'o mibadhi e Homa Bay County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: KEMSA announces outpatient services for residents of Wajir County starting this November.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatangaza huduma za wagonjwa wa nje kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kuanzia Novemba hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa adeegyada bukaanka dibedda ee dadka deggan Gobolka Wajir laga bilaabo Nofeembar.
Dholuo: KEMSA ogolo chenro mar konyo jotuo e gwenge mag Wajir County kochakore dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Narok County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yazindua mpango wa kupinga uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka ayaa bilaabay barnaamij ka dhan ah tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibbanaha dugsiyada gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe mahundu e skunde duto mag Narok County.

English: Ministry of Health appeals to caregivers in Nairobi County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the December maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhudhuria siku iliyopangwa ya kliniki kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Desemba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Nairobi inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta bukaanka ee la qorsheeyay iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health okwayo jorit e County mar Nairobi mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar klinik mane ochan e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds youth in Busia County that HELB funding is available for electrical installation training.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya dhalinyarada degmada Busia in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne rowere man Busia County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar loso sitima.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages mothers in Turkana County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa hooyooyinka degmada Turkana inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo mine manie County mar Turkana mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds residents of Laikipia County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Somali: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Laikipia ku xasuusinayaa inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee maamulayaasha maxalliga ah ay soo saareen xilliyada fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne jogweng' Laikipia County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji moa e gweng'no.

English: Bleeding, headache and poor sight, sek for medical attention
Kiswahili: Damu, maumivu ya kichwa na upofu wa macho, sek kwa matibabu
Somali: Dhiig, madax xanuun iyo aragti darro, sek daryeel caafimaad
Dholuo: Remo, lit e wiye, neno marach, kendo dwaro thieth

English: KEMSA advises residents of Murang'a County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa usaidizi wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow si ay uga caawiyaan helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ee lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMSA nyiso ji duto modak e County mar Murang'a mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni mondo giyud kony mar yudo kony kuom weche thieth.

English: KUCCPS encourages out-of-school children in Meru County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under free primary education.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Meru kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Meru inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e county mar Meru mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service launches a cattle rustling prevention campaign in Bomet County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Bomet Julai hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu bilaabay olole looga hortago xanta xoolaha ee Gobolka Bomet bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Forest Service chako kampen mar geng'o ywaruok mag dhok e taon mar Bomet e dwe mar Julai.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Marsabit County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inay haystaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit nyiso jogweng' mar Marsabit County mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi maber sama gidwaro thieth mondo giyud thieth makonyogi.

English: SHA reminds residents of Turkana County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: SHA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Turkana kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya wilaya inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: SHA parone jogweng' Turkana County ni luwo dongruok mar tich kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Notice: IEBC launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC yazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay bilawday barnaamij tallaabooyin ka dhan ah dhibaatada dugsiyada gobolka Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IEBC chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe gero e skunde duto e County mar Kirinyaga.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by SHA (Social Health Authority) will be held in Turkana County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Turkana Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Turkana bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma SHA (Social Health Authority) ochano biro timore e taon mar Turkana e dwe mar Mei.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Nyamira County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira in warbixinta degdegga ah ee xanta xoolaha ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne jogweng' Nyamira County ni ka ng'ato owacho mapiyo ni jamni omako jamni, mano konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Meru County that access to postnatal check-ups is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Meru kwamba ufikiaji wa uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Meru in helitaanka baaritaano ka dib dhalashada ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa mine ma biro nyuolo e county mar Meru ni dhi e nonro bang' nyuol en gima onge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: NPS urges motorists and pedestrians in Kiambu County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NPS inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Kiambu inay guryahooda rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab damiska iyo inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo jowuoth kod joma wuotho e ndara e gweng' mar Kiambu mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo gitim kinda mar geng'o hinyruok mag ndara.

English: Notice: e-Citizen launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Nyandarua County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: e-Citizen waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhanka ah gobolka Nyandarua bishii November.
Dholuo: Par ane: e-Citizen chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Nyandarua e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Kenya Dairy Board announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for poultry in Kitui County this October.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya yatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa kuku katika Kaunti ya Kitui Oktoba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhawaaqay jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee digaagga ee Gobolka Kitui bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board ong'ado mar timo chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar dhoot kod dhoot e dwe mar Oktoba e kaunti mar Kitui.

English: Kenya has issued a warning on a bad mosquito that has come. Anopheles Stephensis causes bad malaria. All health workers have detected this mosquitoe at Mandera. Mosquitos transimit malaria among people and villages
Kiswahili: Kenya imetoa onyo kuhusu mbu mbaya aliyekuja. Anopheles Stephensis husababisha malaria mbaya. Wafanyakazi wote wa afya wamegundua mbu huyu huko Mandera. Mbu hueneza malaria miongoni mwa watu na vijiji
Somali: Kenya waxay soo saartay digniin ku saabsan cayayaanka xun ee yimid. Anopheles Stephensis waxay sababeysaa makaraariya xun. Dhammaan shaqaalaha caafimaadka ayaa ogaaday cayayaankan Mandera.
Dholuo: Kenya osechiwo siem e wi lum moro marach ma osechopo. Anopheles Stephensis kelo malaria marach. Jorit thieth duto osefwenyo lum man Mandera.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development opens a new catering and hospitality programme at the vocational centre in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inafungua mpango mpya wa upishi na ukarimu katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ka furayaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan cuntada iyo marti-gelinta xarunta xirfadaha ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ochako chenro manyien mar chiemo kod rwako welo e kar tich e Taita-Taveta County.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will distribute certified maize seed to farmers in Vihiga County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itasambaza mbegu zilizothibitishwa za mahindi kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay abuurka hadhuudhka ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda Degmada Vihiga bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Tij Lemo kod Chiemo (AFA) biro pogo kodhi mag cham ne jopur e County mar Vihiga e dwe mar Februar.

English: NPS calls on residents of Meru County to support local peace-building committees in support of border security.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za mitaa kusaidia usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: NPS waxay dadka deggan degmada Meru ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee deegaanka si ay u taageerayaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: NPS okwayo ji duto modak e county mar Meru mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gweng'no.

English: NDMA calls on the community in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatia moyo jamii katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka kwa nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Somali: NDMA waxay bulshada degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: NDMA luongo ji duto e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gidwar kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: State Department for Basic Education reminds parents in Kilifi County that free primary education registration is open this December.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kwamba usajili wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo umefunguliwa Desemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Kilifi in diiwaangelinta bilaashka ah ee waxbarashada hoose ay furan tahay bisha December.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education oparo ne jonyuol e County mar Kilifi ni somo mar pinyruoth en mar nono e dwe mar Desemba.

English: State Department for Basic Education calls on the community in Marsabit County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Marsabit inay u soo wargeliyaan mas'uuliyadda amniga dugsiyada si ay u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyada iskuulada.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education okwayo oganda mar Marsabit County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar skul kuom weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: E-Citizen urges eligible citizens in Laikipia County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wananchi wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Laikipia inay ka qaybqaataan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro e County mar Laikipia mondo oriwgi e ndiko joma oyiero.

English: FAO promotes terracing among farmers in Kwale County as part of the June climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: FAO inakuza usafirishaji kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale kama sehemu ya harakati za ustahimilivu wa hali ya hewa Juni.
Somali: FAO waxay dhiirrigelisay dhulka beeraleyda degmada Kwale iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar FAO jiwo tij loso puothe e kind jopur e county mar Kwale kaka achiel kuom chenro mar dwe mar Jun mar kedo gi lokruok e kit yamo.

English: CDC encourages mothers in Kakamega County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kakamega inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo mine man Kakamega County mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges motorists and pedestrians in Makueni County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawataka madereva wa magari na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Makueni kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Makueni inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ojiwo jowuoth kod joma wuotho e ndara e gweng' mar Makueni mondo oluw chik ma sirkal ochiwo mar golo ji mondo kik gitim aksident mag ndara.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public in Kirinyaga County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba upatikanaji wa usaidizi wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha Gobolka Kirinyaga in helitaanka taageerada sheegashada NHIF/SHA hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji duto man Kirinyaga County ni kony mar kwayo kwayo kuom NHIF/SHA sani yudore e kuonde moyier.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges residents of West Pokot County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on community-based development programmes.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya West Pokot kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waendelee kuwa na habari juu ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot County inay la xiriiraan maamulaha degmada si ay uga warqabaan barnaamijyada horumarinta ee ku saleysan bulshada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jotend buchegi mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi chenro mag dongruok mag oganda.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service encourages farmers in Kiambu County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora ya mahindi.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda degmada Kiambu inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay hadhuudhka.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur e County mar Kiambu mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar kodhi.

English: NTSA warns residents of Laikipia County to prepare for possible landslides this November.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa maporomoko ya ardhi Novemba hii.
Somali: NTSA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay u diyaar garoobaan dhulgariir dhici kara bisha November.
Dholuo: NTSA osiemo jogweng' Laikipia County mondo oikre ne yiengni mag lowo mabiro timore e dwe mar Novemba.

English: HELB encourages out-of-school children in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under free primary education.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: HELB waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Notice: NCPB restricts movement of poultry in Nyamira County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB yazuia harakati za kuku katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi wenye uvimbe.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa digaagga degmada Nyamira sababtuna tahay faafitaanka cudurka maqaarka.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NCPB ogeng'o wuoth mar le mag le e County ma Nyamira nikech tuwo mar dhoot.

English: ODPP invites residents of Meru County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: ODPP ogwelo jogweng' mar County mar Meru mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ochopo giko mar chenro mag chenro mag sirkal.

English: Ministry of Health calls on parents in Taita-Taveta County to have children under five screened for tuberculosis during the May outreach.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuwafanya watoto chini ya miaka mitano wachunguzwe kifua kikuu wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Mei.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta Gobolka Taita-Taveta in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka 'tuberculosis' inta lagu jiro adeegga bisha Maajo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health okwayo jonyuol e Taita-Taveta County mondo otim nonro mar tuo mar tuberculosis ne nyithindgi ma hikgi tin ne abich e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: DCI opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DCI inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa maelekezo ya makazi salama katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay fureysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya talooyin ku saabsan magangelyo ammaan ah gobolka Nandi.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DCI oseyawo ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kuonde dak e alwora mar Nandi County.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Laikipia County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this March.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Machi hii.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ka digaya dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay u diyaar garoobaan qaraxyo dab ah oo dhici kara bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations osiemo jogweng' Laikipia County mondo oikre ne yiengni manyalo timore e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafungua dawati la jinsia kutoa simu ya msaada ya GBV bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu furayaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Forest Service oyawo kama itiyogo gi weche mag dichwo gi dhako e chiwo chenro mar konyo maonge chudo mar GBV e County mar Tharaka-Nithi.

English: DCI urges motorists and pedestrians in Taita-Taveta County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent landslides-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DCI inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kusakinisha na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Taita-Taveta inay guryahooda rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dabka daminta iyo inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa dhacdooyinka la xiriira dhulgariirrada.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo dereba kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Taita-Taveta mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo gitim kinda mondo gikwed masiche mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: KEMRI urges residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to avoid contact with contaminated water sources following a rise in reported malaria cases.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya malaria vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ka fogaadaan inay la xiriiraan ilaha biyaha wasakhda ah ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska fayraska ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo owe tudruok gi kuonde ma pi yudoree nikech kwan mar ji ma nigi malaria osemedore.

English: Announcement on collaboration with th county of Makueni with the World Organization on foods through awareness policy
Kiswahili: Tangazo juu ya ushirikiano na Kaunti ya Makueni na Shirika la Dunia juu ya vyakula kupitia sera ya ufahamu
Somali: Ogeysiis ku saabsan iskaashi la leh degmada Makueni iyo Ururka Adduunka ee Cuntada iyada oo loo marayo siyaasadda wacyiga
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Oganda mar Piny Mangima (WHO) gi county mar Makueni e weche mag chiemb chuny kokalo kuom chenro mar miyo ji ong'e

English: IEBC reminds parents in Siaya County that bursary allocation registration is open this January.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba usajili wa ugawaji wa bursari umefunguliwa Januari hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Siaya in diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ay furan tahay bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: IEBC parone jonyuol e county mar Siaya ni kad mar chiwo mich mag tiegruok osechakore e dwe mar Januar.

English: Universities Fund encourages residents of Kiambu County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya ugatuzi.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay ka qeybgalaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo jogweng' Kiambu County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda mondo gibed gi ng'eyo e wi weche mag chiwruok.

English: To prevent Fall Armyworm infestation, use high-quality, disease-free seed, avoid late or staggered planting, and increase plant diversity in your plots (for example intercropping) to make maize less attractive to armyworm moths.
Kiswahili: Ili kuzuia uvamizi wa minyoo ya Fall Armyworm, tumia mbegu za hali ya juu, zisizo na magonjwa, epuka kupanda kwa kuchelewa au kwa kuyumba, na uongeze utofauti wa mimea katika mashamba yako (kwa mfano kilimo kiingiliano) ili kufanya mahindi yasivutie nondo za jeshi.
Somali: Si looga hortago cayayaanka Fall Armyworm, isticmaal abuurka tayada sare leh, cudur-free, ka fogow beerashada gaabis ah ama la kala go'ay, iyo kordhinta kala duwanaanta dhirta ee dhulkaaga (tusaale ahaan beeraha isku dhafan) si ay u sameeyaan hadhuudh ka yar soo jiidasho leh u armyworm moots.
Dholuo: Mondo kik cham cham ma ok nyal chango, ti gi kodhi ma nigi ber kendo ma onge tuoche, kik ipidh cham ma ok imedo kata ma ok imedo chwoyo, kendo meduru pidho yien mopogore opogore e puotheu (e ranyisi, ka ipidhgi e kind yien) mondo cham ma cham ok bed maber ne le mag cham.

English: KRA reminds voters in Isiolo County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya usajili wa wapiga Kura.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Isiolo inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor diiwaangelinta codbixisayaasha.
Dholuo: KRA parone jogedo mag Isiolo County mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero kapok gidonjo e register mar joma oyiero.

English: FAO advises farmers in Vihiga County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the February planting season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Februari.
Somali: FAO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Vihiga inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagyada si loo soo celiyo miraha ciidda ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Febraayo.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e county mar Vihiga mondo otim lokruok e puothe mondo omi lowo odok maber kapok ochako chuoyo e dwe mar Februar.

English: FAO warns maize farmers in Meru County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: FAO inawaonya wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Meru juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: FAO waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Meru cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: FAO chiwo siem ne jopur mogoyo kodhi e county mar Meru kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: KEPHIS urges coffee growers in Nyeri County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Nyeri in ay ka hortagaan cayayaanka xilliga dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur ma pidho kahawa e County mar Nyeri mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma giyudo e higa mondo okonygi loyo chwanyruok mar jolweny e kinde machuok ka gitiyo gi tuoche makelo hinyruok mondo gimi nyak e higani.

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health will host a free hypertension awareness outreach in Siaya County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Siaya Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska Dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay marti gelineysaa wacyi-gelin bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cadaadiska dhiig karka ee degmada Siaya bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar piny owacho biro timo kampen mar konyo ji ng'eyo ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar hypertension maonge chudo e dwe mar Agost e county mar Siaya.

English: ODPP invites residents of Embu County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuwasilisha kumbukumbu za maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: ODPP gwelo joma odak e county mar Embu mondo ochiw paro mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso bajet mar county.

English: DCI warns residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: DCI waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in ay kordheen khiyaamooyinka lacagaha SIM-swap waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax falin.
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County e wi medruok mar wuond mag SIM-swap kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: Agriculture not only suffers the impacts of climate change, it is also responsible for 14 percent of global greenhouse gas emissions. But agriculture has the ...
Kiswahili: Kilimo si tu mateso athari za mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa, ni pia kuwajibika kwa asilimia 14 ya kimataifa ya uzalishaji wa gesi chafu. Lakini kilimo ina ...
Somali: Beeraha ma aha oo kaliya inay la kulmaan saameynta isbeddelka cimilada, sidoo kale waxay mas'uul ka yihiin 14 boqolkiiba qiiqa gaaska aqalka dhirta ee caalamka. Laakiin beeraha waxay leedahay ...
Dholuo: Tij pur ok en mana mar lokruok mar alwora kende, to bende en gi ting' mar golo gas mag greenhouse gas e piny mangima ma romo pasent 14.

English: Notice from CDC: family planning counselling clinics will run every July at designated health centres in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa CDC: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Julai katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid CDC: Caafimaadka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska waxaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Luulyo oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar yedhe ma thiedho tuoche (CDC): kuonde thieth mag chenro mag ngima joot ibiro timie higa ka higa e dwe mar Julai e kuonde ma thieth yudoree e county mar Uasin Gishu.

English: COMESA announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for poultry in Homa Bay County this September.
Kiswahili: COMESA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa kuku katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Septemba hii.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee digaagga ee gobolka Homa Bay bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: COMESA ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar dhoot kod dhoot ne dhok e Homa Bay County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by SHA (Social Health Authority) will be held in Kisii County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kisii Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ay soo qabanqaabisay SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Kisii bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth maonge chudo ma olos gi SHA (Social Health Authority) ibiro tim e County mar Kisii e dwe mar Mach.

English: Provide vegetable seeds to vulnerable households.
Kiswahili: Toa mbegu za mboga kwa kaya zilizo hatarini.
Somali: Bixi biqilo khudaar ah qoysaska nugul.
Dholuo: Chiw kodhi mag alot ne udi ma nigi chandruok.

English: KTDA reminds residents of Nyandarua County that terracing improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba terracing inaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba la muda mrefu.
Somali: KTDA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Nyandarua in dhulka lagu beerayo uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: KTDA parone jogweng' Nyandarua County ni terracing medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Public health advisory: SHA (Social Health Authority) warns of increased tuberculosis risk in Embu County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya kifua kikuu katika Kaunti ya Embu na inashauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ka digeysaa kororka halista cudurka 'tuberculosis' ee degmada Embu waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga ah mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar oganda: SHA (Social Health Authority) chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar kahera e county mar Embu kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore mar thieth.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Mandera County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Degmada Mandera inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nyagore gi tuoche mag obwongo e county mar Mandera mondo odhi ir japuonj molony.

English: DPP calls on the community in Busia County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: DPP inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Busia kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka kwa nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: DPP waxay bulshada degmada Busia ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan isla markaana ay taageero ka raadsadaan hoyga ugu dhow.
Dholuo: DPP okwayo ji duto e county mar Busia mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gidwar kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds expectant mothers in Wajir County that access to free antenatal care is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma ya bure ya ujauzito ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Wajir in helitaanka daryeelka uurka ka hor ee bilaashka ah ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne mine ma nigi ich e county mar Wajir ni thuolo mar yudo rit ma onge chudo mar nyuol en maonge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: Notice from Kenya Medical Association: free antenatal care clinics will run every March at designated health centres in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya: kliniki za bure za huduma ya ujauzito zitaendeshwa kila Machi katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya: rugta daryeelka dhalmada ee bilaashka ah ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Maarso kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo magacaabay ee Gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association: Klinike mag rito nyithindo kapok ginyuolo biro tiyo dwe mar Mach higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e Homa Bay County.

English: Ministry of Education urges residents of Siaya County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kutuma maombi ya bursari hiyo kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Siaya mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud somo mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges motorists and pedestrians in Taita-Taveta County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent landslides-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Taita-Taveta inay guryahooda rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa dhacdooyinka la xiriira dhulgariirrada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo jorit mtokni kod joma wuotho gi tiendgi e gweng' mar Taita-Taveta mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo gitim kinda mar geng'o masiche mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development encourages residents of Bungoma County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya ugatuzi.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay ka qaybgalaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada si ay uga warqabaan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo oriwgi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche ma biro timore.

English: NPS calls on residents of Homa Bay County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: NPS waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan kahortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: NPS okwayo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'adoe bura mondo okony e kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: KNEC advises students in Trans Nzoia County to collect materials from the county education office to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kukusanya vifaa kutoka kwa ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Somali: KNEC waxay ardayda degmada Trans Nzoia kula talineysaa inay ka soo ururiyaan xogta xafiiska waxbarashada ee degmada si ay u helaan buugaag waxbarasho iyo waxyaabo waxbarasho.
Dholuo: KNEC nyiso jopuonjre e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo ochok buge e ofis mar tiegruok mar gweng'no mondo giyud buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok.

English: EACC invites residents of Nandi County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: EACC inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kuwasilisha maadhimisho ya maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: EACC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nandi inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: EACC gwelo joma odak e county mar Nandi mondo ochiw paro mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on the community in Nairobi County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawataka jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Nairobi inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wacayaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross okwayo ji duto manie Nairobi County mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: DCI urges anyone experiencing abuse in Nairobi County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: DCI inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Nairobi inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e County mar Nairobi mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Nairobi County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inazindua kampeni ya kupambana na ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Februari hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ka hortagga degmada Nairobi bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Rapar: Huduma Kenya chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Nairobi e dwe mar Februar.

English: IEBC urges residents of Kitui County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kitui kudai usambazaji wa huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay dalbadaan adeeg bixinta iyaga oo aan bixin laaluush si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogweng'o mag Kitui County mondo okonygi ka ok gichulo asoya mondo giked gi asoya e migepe mag sirkal.

English: SHA urges residents of Kajiado County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawahimiza wakazi wa Kajiado County kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waendelee kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay la xiriiraan maamulaha degmada si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda horumarinta degmada.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jotelo mag gwenge ma gidakie mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi chenro mag dongruok mar gwenge.

English: Public health advisory: CDC warns of increased typhoid risk in Nyandarua County and advises the public to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: CDC inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya matumbo katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua na kushauri umma kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Talobixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: CDC waxay ka digeysaa khatarta sii kordheysa ee cudurka 'typhoid' ee gobolka Nyandarua waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: CDC chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar typhoid e County mar Nyandarua kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gitudre gi pi mochido.

English: IPOA reminds residents of Kiambu County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada daadadka ku dhacay xilligan fatahaadda.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogweng' Kiambu County mondo kik giwuoth e wi borni kod aoche ma pi opong'o.

English: KNCHR hosts county dialogues on justice and equity.
Kiswahili: KNCHR huandaa mazungumzo ya wilaya juu ya haki na usawa.
Somali: KNCHR waxay martigelisaa wadahadallada gobollada ku saabsan cadaaladda iyo sinnaanta.
Dholuo: KNCHR loso mbaka e wi weche mag bura kod tim makare.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free stress management support is available through county health facilities in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa kudhibiti mafadhaiko unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero lacag la'aan ah oo la xiriirta maaraynta stress-ka laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar stress yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e Taita-Taveta County.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages mothers in Kwale County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kwale kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kwale inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo mine manie Kaunti mar Kwale mondo olim kama giwuokie machiegni mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Nandi County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kuthibitisha kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nandi inay xaqiijiyaan in xaruntooda la aqoonsaday ka hor inta aysan booqan si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health nyiso ji duto modak e county mar Nandi mondo ong'e ni kuondegi mag thieth oseyudo ratiro kapok gibiro mondo giyud thieth.

English: CDC calls on parents in Kiambu County to have children under five screened for HIV/AIDS during the September outreach.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuwafanyia uchunguzi wa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa VVU/UKIMWI wakati wa mawasiliano ya Septemba.
Somali: CDC waxay ku baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Kiambu in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro HIV / AIDS inta lagu jiro adeegga bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: CDC kwayo jonyuol e County mar Kiambu mondo otim nonro mar HIV/AIDS ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Septemba.

English: ODPP reminds voters in Samburu County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Samburu kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha Gobolka Samburu inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor waxbarashada codbixinta.
Dholuo: ODPP paronwa jogedo e county mar Samburu mondo oting'e ID mar piny kata passport ma nigi ratiro e odiechieng' mar goyo ombulu motelo ne tiegruok.

English: Farmers in Kiambu County can access training on improved maize production techniques and early maturing varieties through the Village Based Advisors program
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu wanaweza kupata mafunzo kuhusu mbinu bora za uzalishaji wa mahindi na aina zinazokomaa mapema kupitia mpango wa Washauri wa Kijiji.
Somali: Beeraleyda Kiambu County waxay heli karaan tababar ku saabsan farsamooyinka wax-soo-saarka galleyda ee la hagaajiyay iyo noocyada bislaaadda hore iyada oo loo marayo barnaamijka Village Based Advisors
Dholuo: Jo-Purie e County mar Kiambu nyalo yudo tiegruok e wi yore mag loso kodhi ma osemedore kod kit olembe ma koro ok ti e kinde ma gichiekogi kokalo kuom chenro mar Village Based Advisors

English: KICD urges residents of Isiolo County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: KICD inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa watu wazima ili kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: KICD waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo inay iska diiwaangeliyaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo ji duto modak e kaunti mar Isiolo mondo odonj e program mar puonjo joma dongo mondo giyud somo mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: KTDA urges farmers in Migori County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Migori inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddelka qaabka roobabka.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e county mar Migori mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e weche mag pur mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok e kaka koth chue.

English: SHA encourages first-time voters in Garissa County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: SHA inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Garissa kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: SHA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha ugu horreeya ee degmada Garissa inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jogo matimoga yiero mokwongo e County mar Garissa mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi kata pasipoti e odiechieng'no mar timo yiero.

English: Notice: KUCCPS announces bursary allocation enrollment dates for schools in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa mgao wa bursary kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ee dugsiyada gobolka Nyamira.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KUCCPS ogolo chenro mar somo e skunde mag Nyamira County.

English: DCI urges motorists and pedestrians in Homa Bay County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent landslides-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DCI inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee gobolka Homa Bay inay guryahooda rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dabka daminta iyo inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa dhacdooyinka la xiriira dhulgariirka.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo dereba kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Homa Bay mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo gitim kinda mondo gikwed masiche mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: OGP reminds the public in Kakamega County that input on the county budget process is welcome this June.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba mchango kwenye mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti unakaribishwa Juni hii.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha Gobolka Kakamega in talooyinka ku saabsan habka miisaaniyadda gobolka ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Juun.
Dholuo: OGP oparo ne ji duto e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni gibiro yie gi chiwo mag pesa e dwe mar Jun.

English: KTDA informs fish farmers in Busia County of new market linkage opportunities this November.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawafahamisha wakulima wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Busia kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Novemba hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku wargelineysaa kalluumeysatada ku nool gobolka Busia fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha November.
Dholuo: KTDA nyiso jopur ma pidho rech e county mar Busia thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Novemba.

English: NPS calls on the community in Kisumu County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatia moyo jamii katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: NPS waxay bulshada degmada Kisumu ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: NPS okwayo ji duto manie gweng' mar Kisumu mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gichiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: To incorporate digital technology farming in crop production..IFAD 13 has to prepare IFAD responsibility of innovativeness.
Kiswahili: Ili kuingiza teknolojia ya digital kilimo katika uzalishaji wa mazao..IFAD 13 lazima kuandaa IFAD wajibu wa ubunifu.
Somali: In lagu daro beeralayda tiknoolajiyada dijitaalka ah ee soo saarista dalagga.. IFAD 13 waa inay diyaarisaa mas'uuliyadda hal-abuurnimada IFAD.
Dholuo: Mondo mi mi migao mar timo dongruok e yore mag pidho kodhi obed gi teknoloji mar digital, IFAD 13 nyaka iket chenro mar timo dongruok e yore mag timo dongruok.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kurejesha matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageerada soo kabashada xadgudubka maandooriyaha ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka degmada ee degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tiyo gi yedhe mamero yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth e County ma Kisumu County.

English: DCI reminds residents of Wajir County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Wajir in warbixinta dhacda si deg deg ah ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: DCI oparo ne jogweng' mar Wajir County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar nek konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: KRA warns public officers in Isiolo County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: KRA inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Wilaya ya Isiolo dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: KRA waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Isiolo inay musuqmaasuqa ka qaataan xafiisyada dawladda.
Dholuo: KRA chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e kaunti mar Isiolo kuom kawo asoya e migepe mar sirkal.

English: IEBC urges residents of Migori County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Migori kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya wilaya ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja wa wilaya.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Migori inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca bogga shabakadda degmada si ay uga warqabaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogweng' Migori County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mar dongruok e county.
