English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds residents of Homa Bay County that water harvesting improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba uvunaji wa maji unaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay in goosashada biyaha ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jogweng' Homa Bay County ni choko pi miyo puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: AFA urges farmers in Mombasa County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: AFA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Mombasa inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo lagu soo ururiyo biyaha beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e county mar Mombasa mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Drugs and substace abuse is a bad habit that can contribute to suicide, because drugs and substance abuse increase mental burdens in your health and in decision-making. The fight against drugs and substance abuse as thiose contributing to self suicide, and also reduce the immunity f the body including mental health
Kiswahili: Dawa za kulevya na matumizi mabaya ya dawa ni tabia mbaya ambayo inaweza kuchangia kujiua, kwa sababu dawa na dawa zinaongeza mzigo wa akili katika afya yako na katika kufanya maamuzi.
Somali: Daawooyinka iyo xadgudubka maandooriyaha waa caado xun oo gacan ka geysan kara ismiidaaminta, sababtoo ah daroogada iyo isticmaalka maadooyinka waxay kordhiyaan culeyska maskaxda ee caafimaadkaaga iyo go'aan qaadashada.
Dholuo: Tiyo gi yedhe mamero kod tiyo marach gi gik makelo hinyruok en tim marach manyalo miyo ng'ato odonj e timbego, nikech yedhe ma mero ji kod tiyo gi gik mamero ji medo ting' mar ng'eyo kit ngima ng'atno koda kaka onyalo kawo okang' mar timo yiero.

English: CDC reminds the public that free depression awareness support is available through county health facilities in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa uhamasishaji wa unyogovu unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay wacyiga niyadjabku laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Mandera.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar parruok yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county man Mandera County.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya opens polling procedures centres in Kisumu County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Mei hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay furaysaa xarumaha nidaamyada codbixinta ee degmada Kisumu bisha May.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Huduma Kenya chako timo yiero e dwe mar Mei e kaunti mar Kisumu.

English: KTDA reminds residents of Lamu County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha tija ya shamba la muda mrefu.
Somali: KTDA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Lamu in ilaalinta ciidda ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: KTDA paronwa jogweng' Lamu County ni rito lowo miyo puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: NGEC supports women through mentorship in political processes.
Kiswahili: NGEC huwategemeza wanawake kupitia ushauri katika michakato ya kisiasa.
Somali: NGEC waxay haweenka taageertaa iyada oo loo marayo tababbarka geedi socodka siyaasadeed.
Dholuo: NGEC konyo mon kokalo kuom tiegruok e weche siasa.

English: Council of Governors updates residents of Migori County on progress of ward-level service delivery this January.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawasilisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Migori juu ya maendeleo ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya Januari hii.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay dadka deggan Degmada Migori ku wargeliyaan horumarka adeegyada lagu bixiyo degmooyinka bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch chiwo ripot ne jogweng' Migori County kuom dongruok mar chiwo kony e wi ward e dwe mar Januar.

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on the community in Murang'a County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwa ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqayaa bulshada degmada Murang'a inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan oo ay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service okwayo ji duto manie county mar Murang'a mondo owuo e wi timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo onyis ji weche ma kamago e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynta ee degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Huduma Kenya biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag siasa e County mar Nyeri.

English: All public gatherings meetings, games, events, church crusades have been suspended. Churches can have services as long as they have sanitizer. Schools to remain open but inter school games are cancelled
Kiswahili: Mikutano yote ya hadhara, michezo, matukio, mikutano ya kanisa imesimamishwa. Makanisa yanaweza kuwa na ibada mradi tu yana vitakasa mikono. Shule zitaendelea kufunguliwa lakini michezo kati ya shule imefutwa
Somali: Dhammaan shirarka dadweynaha, kulamada, dhacdooyinka, ciidamada kaniisadda ayaa la joojiyay. Kaniisadaha waxay qaban karaan adeegyadooda illaa inta ay haystaan nadiifinta. Iskuullada ayaa la furay laakiin ciyaaraha iskuulada ayaa la baajiyay
Dholuo: Chokruoge duto mag ji duto, tuke, chokruoge mag kanisa, kod lwenje mag kanisa ne ogol oko. kanise ne nyalo bedo gi lamo ka gin gi sanitizer. skunde ne dhi siko ka oyawore to tuke mag kind skul ne ok dhi bedoe.

English: KNEC reminds needy students in Migori County that school laptops under the digital literacy programme applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Migori kwamba kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya maombi ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika za kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KNEC waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Migori in laptop-yada dugsiga ee ku jira codsiyada barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: KNEC paronwa jopuonjre man gi chandruok e County mar Migori ni kompyuta mag skul manie program mar somo kod somo mar digital chiegni rumo.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds schools in Kitui County to strengthen inclusion of learners with disabilities this December.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuimarisha ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu Desemba hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu xusuusinayaa dugsiyada degmada Kitui inay xoojiyaan ka mid noqoshada ardayda naafada ah bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne skunde man Kitui County mondo omed jiwo jopuonjre ma nigi midekre e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development urges youth in Kirinyaga County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku boorinayaa dhalinyarada degmada Kirinyaga inay ka qeybgalaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo rowere e County mar Kirinyaga mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county ka pok ochopo chenro mag oganda.

English: NDMA calls on residents of Mombasa County to support local peace-building committees in support of border security.
Kiswahili: NDMA inatoa wito kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kuunga mkono kamati za ujenzi wa amani katika kuunga mkono usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: NDMA waxay dadka deggan degmada Mombasa ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee deegaanka si ay u taageerayaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: NDMA okwayo jogweng' Mombasa County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gweng'no e siro sirkal mar tong'.

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages residents of Nyandarua County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Forest Service warns residents of Kericho County to prepare for possible flooding this February.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa mafuriko Februari hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ka digay dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay isu diyaariyaan fatahaadaha iman kara bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service osiemo jogweng' mar Kericho County mondo oikre ne koth maduong' ma biro timore e dwe mar Februar.

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuthibitisha kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay xaqiijiyaan in xaruntooda la aqoonsaday ka hor inta aysan booqan si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo ong'e ni kuondegi mag thieth oseyudo ratiro kapok gibiro mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Feed students! Provide meals in drought-affected schools.
Kiswahili: Lisha wanafunzi! Toa milo katika shule zilizoathiriwa na ukame.
Somali: Ardayda quudiya, dugsiyada ay abaartu saameysay cuntada siiya.
Dholuo: Mi jopuonjre chiemo, kendo chiemuru e skunde ma yiengni omako.

English: This talk about digital agriculture and its potential to reduce rural poverty featured Prof. Michael Kremer, 2019 winner of the Nobel Memorial Prize in ...
Kiswahili: Mazungumzo haya kuhusu kilimo cha kidijitali na uwezo wake wa kupunguza umaskini vijijini yalimhusisha Profesa Michael Kremer, mshindi wa Tuzo ya Nobel ya 2019 katika ...
Somali: Hadalkan oo ku saabsan beeraha dhijitaalka ah iyo awooddeeda yareynta saboolnimada miyiga ayaa waxaa ka mid ahaa Prof. Michael Kremer, oo ku guuleystay abaalmarinta Nobel Memorial Prize ee 2019 ee ...
Dholuo: Puonjni ma ne ogo e wi pur mar digital kod nyalo mar tieko dhier e gweng'no ne omako Prof. Michael Kremer, ma ne oyudo mich mar Nobel mar 2019 e ...

English: Kenya Forest Service alerts residents of Samburu County to a rise in fraud cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za ulaghai na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu uga digay dadka deggan degmada Samburu in ay kordheen kiisaska khiyaamooyinka wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service chiwo siem ne jogweng' Samburu County kuom wach medruok mar weche mag wuondruok kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne polis man machiegni.

English: Notice from KEMRI: family planning counselling clinics will run every December at designated health centres in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka KEMRI: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitafanya kazi kila Desemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid KEMRI: rugta la talinta qorshaynta qoyska waxay ka shaqeyn doontaa bishii Diseembar kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Mombasa.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMRI: Klinike mag chiwo paro e wi chenro mag ngima joot biro tiyo e dwe mar Desemba higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Mombasa.

English: Notice: KICD opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay furaysaa codsiyada deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan ardayda ku jira degmada Nairobi.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KICD oyawo kwayo mag somo ne jopuonjre man Nairobi County.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unafungua ofisi ya kijinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa furaya xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya taageero maskaxeed ee gobolka Mandera.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar weche motudore gi timbe mahundu oseyawo ofis ma konyo joma ok gin rowere e alwora mar Mandera County.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu qabsan doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e Kaunti mar Kakamega.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds the public in Turkana County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this May.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba maoni juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka yanakaribishwa Mei hii.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Turkana in talooyinka dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha May.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette oparo ne ji duto e County mar Turkana ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e dwe mar Mei.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges sheep farmers in Embu County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported foot and mouth disease cases.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawahimiza wafugaji wa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Embu kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kuripotiwa visa vya ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda idaha ee degmada Embu inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib markii la soo sheegay kiisaska cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur ma pidho rombe e county mar Embu mondo ochiw ripot ne jamni matuwo man machiegni gi kama thieth mar dhok nitie bang' yudo wach mar tuoche mag dhoot.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit confirms a typhoid outbreak alert for Turkana County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa typhoid kwa Kaunti ya Turkana. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa xaqiijisay feejignaanta cudurka tifooska ee degmada Turkana. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osenyiso ni tuo mar typhoid osechakore e County mar Turkana.

English: Notice: KTDA will train farmers in Kericho County on conservation tillage this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho juu ya kilimo cha uhifadhi Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Kericho ee ku saabsan beerashada ilaalinta bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA biro tiego jopur e County mar Kericho e weche mag pidho puothe e dwe mar Novemba.

English: DPP reminds residents of Wajir County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lugta ku mara inta lagu jiro xilliyada dabka.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogweng' mar Wajir County mondo oluw tong' mar piyo kendo oti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe e ndalo mag yiengni.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by SHA (Social Health Authority) will be held in Tharaka-Nithi County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa lagu qabanqaabi doonaa Degmada Tharaka-Nithi bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Rapar: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma olos gi SHA (Social Health Authority) ibiro tim e Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Meru County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Meru Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa degmada Meru bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: Kenya Gazette chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e kaunti mar Meru e dwe mar Februar.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Nairobi County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ka digaya dadka deggan degmada Nairobi oo ku saabsan kororka khiyaanada lacagaha SIM-swap wuxuuna kula talinayaa shacabka inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nairobi County e wi medruok mar wuond mag SIM-swap kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: Notice from KEMRI: skilled birth attendance clinics will run every October at designated health centres in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa KEMRI: kliniki za mahudhurio ya uzazi zenye ujuzi zitaendeshwa kila Oktoba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid KEMRI: xarumaha caafimaadka ee ku takhasusay daryeelka dhalmada ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Oktoobar kasta xarumaha caafimaad ee lagu magacaabo degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMRI: Klinike mag rito nyuol ma nigi lony biro tiyo dwe mar Oktoba higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Nyeri.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will train farmers in Kiambu County on organic farming this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhusu kilimo hai Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu tababar siin doonaa beeraleyda degmada Kiambu ee beeraha dabiiciga ah bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Dairy Board biro tiego jopur e County mar Kiambu e wi pur mar yien e dwe mar Novemba.

English: OGP encourages first-time voters in Busia County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: OGP inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Busia kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu.
Somali: OGP waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Busia inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo joma okwongo yiero e county mar Busia mondo olim kama ichanoe ji mar IEBC machiegni kodgi.

English: KALRO encourages farmers in Murang'a County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for tea.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za chai.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Murang'a inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan shaaha.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e county mar Murang'a mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro mondo omi ohala mar chai obed maber.

English: Notice: KUCCPS launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay bilawday barnaamij lagu darayo ardayda naafada ah dugsiyada degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KUCCPS chako chenro mar tiego nyithindo ma nigi midekre e skunde duto mag Kisumu County.

English: Notice: NPS launches a cattle rustling prevention campaign in Nakuru County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NPS yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay bilaabaneysaa olole looga hortago xanta xoolaha ee gobolka Nakuru bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NPS chako kampen mar geng'o ywaruok mag jamni e gweng' mar Nakuru e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: FAO will distribute certified rice seed to farmers in Laikipia County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: FAO itagawanya mbegu za mchele zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Laikipia mwezi Juni huu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay abuuri doontaa abuurka bariiska ee la caddeeyay beeraleyda ku nool gobolka Laikipia bisha Juun ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Rieko: FAO biro pogo kodhi mag loso kodhi ne jopur man Laikipia County e dwe mar Jun.

English: Young parent may be scared or fear. Dialogue with community assistance groups can be of great help to delink those fears
Kiswahili: Mazungumzo pamoja na vikundi vya misaada ya jamii yanaweza kusaidia sana kuondoa hofu hizo
Somali: Waalidiinta dhalinyarada ah waxaa laga yaabaa inay cabsadaan ama cabsanayaan.
Dholuo: Bedo gi mbaka gi riwruoge ma konyo jonyuol ma rowere nyalo konyo ahinya e tieko luoro ma kamago

English: KICD encourages residents of Busia County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: KICD inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: KICD waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabtaan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo ji modak e county mar Busia mondo onon weche ma gin-go e wi register mar joma oyiero mondo ging'e tich mar ombudsman.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds residents of Kiambu County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone jogweng' Kiambu County ni luwo dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: IEBC reminds schools in Vihiga County to strengthen school infrastructure safety this February.
Kiswahili: IEBC inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuimarisha usalama wa miundombinu ya shule Februari hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Vihiga inay xoojiyaan ammaanka kaabayaasha dugsiga bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: IEBC parone skunde e County mar Vihiga mondo omed jiwo ritruok mar chenro mag skul e dwe mar Februar.

English: Provide internet in schools 2024.
Kiswahili: Kutoa intaneti shuleni 2024.
Somali: Bixinta internetka dugsiyada 2024.
Dholuo: Chiw intanet e skunde e higa mar 2024.

English: DPP urges the public in Nairobi County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: DPP inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: DPP waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadweynaha degmada Nairobi inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo ji duto e County mar Nairobi mondo ochiw ripot mar ote mamulo pachgi ne jatendgi mar tich bang' ka osenyis ni gin gi chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo.

English: Keep the umbilical cord stump dry and clean to prevent infection.
Kiswahili: Weka kisiki cha kitovu kikavu na kisafi ili kuzuia maambukizi.
Somali: Si looga hortago infekshanka u ilaali qolofka xarkaha qolofta oo qalalan oo nadiif ah.
Dholuo: Mondo kik ng'ato bed gi tuwo moro amora, beduru maler kendo kik ubed gi tuo moro amora.

English: AFA advises farmers in Kilifi County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: AFA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: AFA waxay kula talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kilifi inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qaybqaataan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: AFA nyiso jopur e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: IEBC urges parents and teachers in West Pokot County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada West Pokot inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e West Pokot County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto.

English: TB is caused by poor diet, HIV AIDS, drunkenness of beer, smokingan diabatis. Spread this word!In unity we can finish TB
Kiswahili: Uvimbe husababishwa na lishe mbaya, UKIMWI, ulevi wa bia, ugonjwa wa sukari.
Somali: Cudurka TB waxaa sababi kara cunto xun, HIV AIDS, sakhraanka biya, sigaarka sigaarka.
Dholuo: Tuo mar TB en gima timore nikech chiemo marach, tuo mar HIV kod AYAKI, mer mar kong'o, madho ndawa, kod tuo mar diyabeti.

English: Notice: NCPB will open a horticultural produce collection centre in Nakuru County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay ka furi doontaa xarun ururinta wax soo saarka beeraha ee degmada Nakuru bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NCPB biro yawo kama ichokoe puothe mag puothe e taon mar Nakuru e dwe mar Septemba.

English: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Council of Governors are forming a technical team to review agricultural policies Farmers and stakeholders can expect updates in four weeks
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Baraza la Magavana wanaunda timu ya kiufundi kukagua sera za kilimo Wakulima na wadau wanaweza kutarajia sasisho katika wiki nne.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa sameynaysa koox farsamo si ay dib u eegis ugu sameeyaan siyaasadaha beeraha Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ayaa filan kara cusbooneysiinta afar toddobaad gudahood
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture kod Council of Governors loso grup mar tiegruok mar nono chike mag pur Joma puodho kod joma nie bwoye nyalo geno yudo weche manyien bang ' jumbe ang'wen

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Nyandarua County that access to psychosocial support is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisaikolojia unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Nyandarua in helitaanka taageerada cilmu-nafsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e kaunti mar Nyandarua ni ginyalo yudo kony ma onge chudo.

English: KICD urges youth in Murang'a County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KICD inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KICD waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Murang'a inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda ka hor inta aysan qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo rowere e County mar Murang'a mondo onon weche ma gin-go ma nyiso ni gidwaro donjo e sirkal kapok gitimo gik ma biro timore.

English: EACC urges residents of Wajir County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia laini ya bure ya eACC ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa fedha za umma.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee lacag la'aanta ah si ay ula dagaallamaan xadgudubka maalgashiga dadweynaha.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jogweng' mar Wajir County mondo oland weche mag mibadhi ka gitiyo gi simo mar e-EACC ma onge chudo mondo giked gi ketho pesa mag sirkal.

English: KICD urges residents of Migori County to register their children at the nearest public school to benefit from free primary education.
Kiswahili: KICD inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu ili kufaidika na elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: KICD waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Migori inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo jogweng' Migori County mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni kodgi mondo giyud tiegruok ma onge chudo.

English: KTDA encourages farmers in Turkana County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora ya mahindi.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Turkana inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay hadhuudhka.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e county mar Turkana mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar kodhi.

English: Kenya Forest Service warns residents of Marsabit County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya kuongezeka kwa kashfa za pesa za rununu na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ka digay dadka deggan degmada Marsabit oo ka soo horjeeda kororka khayaanada lacagta mobilada wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar Marsabit County e wi medruok mar timbe mag wuondo pesa mag simo kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds the public in Mombasa County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Mombasa in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid bilaash ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya parone ji duto e county mar Mombasa ni lando wach tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: HELB calls on the community in Tana River County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: HELB inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: HELB waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Tana River County inay u soo sheegaan arrimaha amniga maamulka dugsiga si ay u ilaaliyaan amniga dugsiyada.
Dholuo: HELB dwaro ni ji duto manie taon mar Tana River County ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar skul e wi weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: COMESA invites farmers in Kwale County to a free training on record keeping for farmers this March.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima Machi hii.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kwale tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan diiwaangelinta beeralayda bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: COMESA ogwelo jopur e county mar Kwale e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi rito rekod mag jopur dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: NTSA opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Ogsoonow: NTSA waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya taageero maskaxeed ee gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NTSA ochako ofis ma konyo ji e weche mag nindruok e gweng' mar Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Bungoma County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan jabsashada ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne jogweng' Bungoma County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo odno konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will train farmers in Laikipia County on water harvesting this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Laikipia juu ya uvunaji wa maji Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka ayaa tababar siin doona beeraleyda degmada Laikipia ee ku saabsan goosashada biyaha bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro tiego jopur e County mar Laikipia e wi ywayo pi e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges residents of Migori County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Uhalifu unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya dadka deggan degmada Migori inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo jogweng' Migori County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'adoe bura e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: OGP updates residents of Nairobi County on progress of county development projects this November.
Kiswahili: OGP inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhusu maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti hii mwezi Novemba.
Somali: OGP waxay dadka deggan degmada Nairobi ka wargelineysaa horumarka mashaariicda horumarinta degmada bisha November.
Dholuo: OGP osemiyo jogweng' Nairobi ong'eyo dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok e gweng'no e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Huduma Kenya announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya yatangaza uboreshaji wa nyakati za kurejea kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku dhawaaqday waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee Degmada Tharaka-Nithi.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya lando lokruok e seche mag tiyo gi passport e Tharaka-Nithi County.

English: Kenya is drafting a National Marine Spatial Plan to guide sustainable ocean resource use and promote the Blue Economy completion is expected by June 2026
Kiswahili: Kenya inatayarisha Mpango wa Kitaifa wa Maeneo ya Baharini ili kuongoza matumizi endelevu ya rasilimali za bahari na kukuza kukamilika kwa Uchumi wa Bluu kunatarajiwa kufikia Juni 2026.
Somali: Kenya waxay diyaarinaysaa Qorshe Qaran oo Badda ah si loo hago isticmaalka kheyraadka badda ee waara loona dhiirrigeliyo dhamaystirka Blue Economy la filayo in la dhammeeyo Juun 2026
Dholuo: Kenya loso chenro mar piny mangima mar chueyo gik manie nam mondo ota yo ma gitiyogo gi mwandu mag nam e yo makare kendo jiwo chenro mar Blue Economy ma biro rumo e dwe mar Jun 2026

English: Farming via digital technology eases growth and increase yield & subsequent value and diverse benefits..
Kiswahili: Kilimo kupitia teknolojia ya dijiti hurahisisha ukuaji na kuongeza mavuno na thamani inayofuata na faida anuwai..
Somali: Beeralayda iyadoo la adeegsanayo tiknoolajiyada dijitaalka ah waxay fududeysaa kobaca waxayna kordhisaa wax-soo-saarka iyo qiimaha xiga iyo faa'iidooyinka kala duwan..
Dholuo: Tij pur ka itiyo gi teknoloji mar digital miyo dongruok bedo mayot kendo medo nyak mar yien kod ber ma giyudo bang'e.

English: COMESA advises farmers in Vihiga County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the August planting season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Agosti.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Vihiga in ay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta ee la caddeeyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e County mar Vihiga mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochopo dwe mar Agost.

English: Announcement of SMS service sending tailored postpartum diet and wellness tips to new mothers.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la huduma ya SMS inayotuma vidokezo vya lishe na ustawi vilivyoundwa mahususi kwa akina mama wapya.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida adeegga SMS-ka ee u diraya hooyooyinka cusub talooyin nafaqo iyo caafimaad oo loogu talagalay dhalmada ka dib.
Dholuo: Owacho ni tiyo gi sms biro miyo mine ma pod tindo puonj mag chiemo kod weche mag thieth.

English: IPOA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Embu County that access to the GBV toll-free helpline is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Embu kwamba upatikanaji wa simu ya GBV ya bure ya msaada unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Embu in helitaanka khadka caawimaadda ee GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah uu yahay mid lacag-la'aan ah.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e county mar Embu ni ginyalo yudo kony ma onge chudo mar GBV maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Marsabit County that reporting carjacking promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba kuripoti utekaji nyara mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan baabuurta la xaday ay gacan ka geystaan ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne jogweng' mar Marsabit County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo mtoka konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: KEMRI urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Kericho County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Kericho inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e gweng' mar Kericho mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: NTSA calls on residents of Machakos County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of border security.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: NTSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga waxqabadka aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah si ay u taageeraan amniga xuduudda.
Dholuo: NTSA okwayo jogweng' ma Machakos County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma rito tong'o ni gitimo gik maok kare e alworano.

English: The Aquaculture Business Development Programme ABDP is now active providing support for fish farming Fish farmers and stakeholders are encouraged to engage with their local implementing counties
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Maendeleo ya Biashara ya Kilimo cha Majini ABDP sasa unaendelea kutoa usaidizi kwa ufugaji wa samaki Wafugaji wa samaki na washikadau wanahimizwa kushirikiana na kaunti zao za utekelezaji.
Somali: Barnaamijka Horumarinta Ganacsiga Aquaculture ABDP hadda waa mid firfircoon isagoo taageero siinaya beeralayda kalluunka iyo daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay la shaqeeyaan degmooyinka fulinaya ee deegaanka
Dholuo: Chenro mar Dongruok mar Tij Migawo mar Aquaculture Business Program ABDP sani tiyo gi yore mang'eny mar konyo ji e pidho rech

English: Canisius Kanangire Kenya's Agriculture and Livestock Development Cabinet Secretary Mthika Linturi in March 2023 asked Kenyans to feed on rice, sweet potatoes ..
Kiswahili: Canisius Kanangire Waziri wa Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo wa Kenya Mthika Linturi mnamo Machi 2023 aliwataka Wakenya kulisha mchele, viazi vitamu ..
Somali: Canisius Kanangire, Xoghayaha Horumarinta Beeraha iyo Xoolaha Kenya, Mthika Linturi, ayaa bishii Maarso 2023 ka codsaday dadka Kenya inay ku quudiyaan bariis, baradho macaan ..
Dholuo: Canisius Kanangire Kenya's Agriculture and Livestock Development Cabinet Secretary Mthika Linturi e dwe mar Mach 2023 ne okwayo jo Kenya mondo ochiem gi loso kod kit olembe mag olembe mag olembe mag pinyno.

English: KNEC reminds needy students in Vihiga County that free digital learning content applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba programu za bure za maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KNEC waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Vihiga in codsiyada barnaamijyada barashada bilaashka ah ee dijitaalka ah ay dhowaan soo gabagabeyn doonaan.
Dholuo: KNEC oparo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e County mar Vihiga ni chenro mag somo ma onge chudo mar digital biro rumo machiegni.

English: E-Citizen advises residents of Homa Bay County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inashauri wakazi wa Wilaya ya Homa Bay kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e- Citizen.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay qaataan dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado dib u dhac marka la raadinayo diiwaangelinta e-C citizen.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo oting'e buge duto madwarore mondo kik gimi ng'ato odeko bang' kwayo mondo oket nyinge e e - Citizen.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development advises applicants in Kiambu County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee horumarinta manhajka wuxuu kula talinayaa codsadayaasha degmada Kiambu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Kiambu mondo gidonj e tiegruok kapok ichopo.

English: When using legume seed inoculant: use the correct inoculant for each legume species and check the expiration date; protect it from sun and heat, storing between 4-26C; and keep it in tightly closed bags, removing it only with clean utensils.
Kiswahili: Unapotumia chanjo ya mbegu za mikunde: tumia chanjo ifaayo kwa kila aina ya mikunde na angalia muda wa kuharibika; kinga chanjo kutoka kwa jua na joto, ihifadhi kwa joto la 4-26C; na iweke kwenye mkoba uliofungwa kikamilifu, ukiondoa kwa chombo kisafi tu.
Somali: Marka la isticmaalayo inoculant-ka abuurka digirta: isticmaal inoculant-ka saxda ah ee nooc kasta oo digirta ah oo hubi taariikhda dhicidda; ilaalinaya qorraxda iyo kulaylka, iyadoo kaydinaysa inta u dhaxaysa 4-26C; oo ku hay baco si adag loo xiray, oo kaliya ka saar qalabka nadiifka ah.
Dholuo: Sama itiyo gi yath mar inoculant mar kodhi mag legume: ti gi yath mar inoculant mowinjore ne kit legume ka kitego kendo ne tarik ma gitiyogo otieko; ritogi kuom chieng' kod liet, ka girito e kind 4-26C; kendo ketgi e bags moket e dhogi, ka gigologi mana gi agulni maler.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Homa Bay County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay in warbixinta degdegga ah ee xanta xoolaha ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne jogweng' Homa Bay County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo jamni konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Drip irrigation delivers water directly to plant roots, saving water and improving efficiency for goats.
Kiswahili: Umwagiliaji wa matone hutoa maji moja kwa moja kwenye mizizi ya mimea, na hivyo kuokoa maji na kuboresha ufanisi kwa mbuzi.
Somali: Waraabka dhuunta ayaa si toos ah biyaha ugu gudbiya xididdada dhirta, taasoo badbaadisa biyaha iyo waxtarka ri'yaha.
Dholuo: Pi ma pi ochido gi pi ma pi ochido kelo kelo pi achiel kachiel e tiend yien, omiyo pi tedo kendo mano miyo diek bedo gi teko mar tiyo maber.

English: Kenya Red Cross announces subsidised dialysis for residents of West Pokot County starting this December.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuanzia Desemba hii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa in la siinayo deebaajiyo loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada West Pokot laga bilaabo bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross olando ni dhialisi mar ji duto modak West Pokot County biro chakore e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of Kisumu County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: Kenya Red Cross inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu kororka khiyaamada SIM-swap waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax falin.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross chiwo siem ne Jo-Kisumu County e wi medruok mar mibadhi mar SIM-swap kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Nairobi County this January. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utafanya kongamano la kurejesha matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Januari hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay qabaneysaa munaasabad dib u soo kabashada isticmaalka maandooriyaha degmada Nairobi bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Ripot mar Kenya Red Cross biro timo chokruok mar chango joma tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero e taon mar Nairobi e dwe mar Januar.

English: AFA urges sheep farmers in Kericho County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wafugaji wa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa ngozi ya uvimbe vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda idaha ee degmada Kericho inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur ma pidho rombe e gweng' mar Kericho mondo ochiw ripot ne jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth machiegni kodgi bang' ka osenyis ni nitie tuoche mang'eny mag pien.

English: Teachers Service Commission conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Nyamira County this October.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Oktoba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa bishii Oktoobar qabanaya madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha gobolka Nyamira.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission otimo chokruok mar tiego ji e wi migawo mar Ombudsman e County mar Nyamira e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: IEBC reminds needy students in Tharaka-Nithi County that free digital learning content applications close soon.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwamba programu za bure za maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Tharaka-Nithi in codsiyada barnaamijka barashada bilaashka ah ee dijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: IEBC oparo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e Tharaka-Nithi County ni chenro mag somo ma onge chudo mar digital biro rumo machiegni.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free tuberculosis screening is available at all public health centres in Kilifi County this May.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kifua kikuu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Mei hii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka caabuqa ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Kilifi bisha May.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji ni thieth mar thieth ma onge choke mar tuo mar tuberculosis yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County Kilifi e dwe mar Mei.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Bungoma County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati huu wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lugta lagu maro inta lagu jiro xilliyada dabka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji paroga jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo oluw tong' mar piyo kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe e ndalo mag yiengni.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the community in Nyeri County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb burglary.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya bulshada degmada Nyeri inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ji duto manie County mar Nyeri mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Universities Fund announces distribution of school laptops under the digital literacy programme to schools in Kwale County this April.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unatangaza usambazaji wa kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa shule za Kaunti ya Kwale Aprili hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku dhawaaqay qaybinta kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Kwale bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund ong'ado mar pogo kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar digital literacy ne skunde man Kwale County e dwe mar April.

English: EACC invites residents of Trans Nzoia County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: EACC inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Trans Nzoia kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: EACC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: EACC gwelo joma odak e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo ochiw ripot mondik kapok ndalo ochopo mar nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: KICD reminds needy students in Murang'a County that revision guides applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba maombi ya marekebisho yanafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Murang'a in dib-u-eegista ay ku xiran tahay codsiyada dhowaan.
Dholuo: KICD parone jopuonjre man gi chandruok e County mar Murang'a ni lokruok mar chike mag kwayo mag kwayo biro rumo machiegni.

English: NPS urges residents of Samburu County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NPS inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Samburu inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: NPS ojiwo jogweng' Samburu County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi kuom chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: Notice: AFA will train farmers in Trans Nzoia County on terracing this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia juu ya mashindano ya mwezi Juni hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: AFA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia oo ku saabsan dhulka lagu beeray bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: AFA biro tiego jopur e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia e dwe mar Jun.

English: KEMSA urges residents of Makueni County to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night following a rise in reported measles cases.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kutumia vyandarua vilivyotiwa dawa ya kuua wadudu kila usiku kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya surua vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta ka dib kororka kiisaska suuxdinta ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' Makueni County mondo oti gi otamba molos gi yedhe makelo tuoche mag lum otieno ka otieno nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuwono osemedore.

English: Office of the Auditor-General warns public officers in Trans Nzoia County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Trans Nzoia inay musuqmaasuqa ka qaataan xafiisyada dawladda.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia ni kik giyud asoya e migepe ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: A new study has confirmed that cultivating transgenic Pod Borer Resistant PBR Cowpea does not harm ecological species or disrupt biodiversity
Kiswahili: Utafiti mpya umethibitisha kwamba kukuza kunde zenye vimelea sugu kwa vimelea vya Pod Borer PBR havidhuru spishi za ikolojia au kuharibu bayoanuwai
Somali: Daraasad cusub ayaa xaqiijisay in beerista PBR Cowpea ee transgenic Pod Borer Resistant aysan waxyeello u geysan noocyada deegaanka ama aysan carqaladeynin noocyada noolaha
Dholuo: Nonro manyien osenyiso ni pidho PBR Cowpea ma nigi teko mar pod Borer ok nyal ketho kit ngima dhano kata ketho kit ngima ji

English: Kenya Dairy Board invites farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County to a free training on greenhouse farming this January.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwa mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo cha chafu Januari hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku casuumay beeraleyda degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay tababar bilaash ah ku helaan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board ogwelo jopur e Tharaka-Nithi County e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar greenhouse agriculture e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kisumu County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu billaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa degmada Kisumu bishii Ogosto.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Auditor General chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e Kisumu County e dwe mar Agost.

English: NCPB informs milk farmers in Nandi County of new market linkage opportunities this June.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawafahamisha wakulima wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Juni hii.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku wargelisaa beeraleyda caanaha ee degmada Nandi fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Juun.
Dholuo: NCPB nyiso jopur mag chak e county mar Nandi kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Jun.

English: Food supply is stable in Kenya Farmers are advised to continue operations without panic buying as transport of farm produce is unrestricted
Kiswahili: Ugavi wa chakula uko dhabiti nchini Kenya Wakulima wanashauriwa kuendelea na shughuli zao bila hofu ya kununua kwani usafirishaji wa mazao ya shambani hauzuiliwi.

Dholuo: Chiemo osiko e piny Kenya Jo-Purie ijiwo mondo odhi nyime gi tijgi mar puodho maok giparre gi gik ma gichulo nikech onge tong' ma inyalo ting'e e wuoth mar yien

Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waendelee kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu inay la xiriiraan maamulaha degmada si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda horumarinta degmada.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' County mar Lamu mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jotelo mag gwenge ma gidakie mondo ging'e weche duto e wi chenro mag dongruok mar county.

English: 2,014 permanent and pensionable posts for secondary school teachers.
Kiswahili: Nafasi 2,014 za kudumu na za kustaafu kwa walimu wa shule za upili.

Dholuo: Tije 2,014 mag tiego jopuonj mag sekondari.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) warns public officers in Machakos County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Machakos dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya madaraka.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Machakos inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Machakos ni kik giti marach gi migepegi.

English: NPS urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kisumu County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NPS inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kutafuta msaada katika nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Kisumu inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e gweng' mar Kisumu mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: KICD reminds youth in Kiambu County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa dhallinyarada degmada Kiambu in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka farsamada gawaarida.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne rowere man Kiambu County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar masinde mag mtokni.

English: Ministry of Health encourages mothers in Migori County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Migori kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Migori inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health jiwo mine e County mar Migori mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Notice: TVET opens applications for school laptops under the digital literacy programme for learners in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inafungua maombi ya kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay u furaysaa barnaamijyada barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee ardayda degmada Kwale codsiyada kumbuyuutarada iskuulka.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET chako tiyo gi kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar somo kod somo mar digital ne jopuonjre man Kwale County.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Homa Bay County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay in warbixinta degdegga ah ee xanta xoolaha ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NDMA oparo ne jogweng' Homa Bay County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo jamni konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: All public university students to get free data bundles for e-learning Ã¢Â€Â“ Safaricom partners.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wote wa vyuo vikuu vya umma watapata vifurushi vya data bila malipo kwa ajili ya kujifunza mtandaoni "Washirika wa Safaricom.
Somali: Dhammaan ardayda jaamacadaha dowladda si ay u helaan xirmooyin xog bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay waxbarashada elektaroonigga ah - iskaashiga Safaricom.
Dholuo: Jopuonjre duto mag yunivasiti mag piny owacho mondo oyud data ma nono mar somo e yor mbui.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges residents of Murang'a County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na ugawaji wa bursary.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan qaybinta deeqaha waxbarasho.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Murang'a mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud michno.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages residents of Embu County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay la xiriiraan lataliye la tababaran yahay.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo jogweng' Embu County mondo kik gisandre aling' ling' kendo gitem manyo jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Mombasa County this August. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Agosti hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa qaban doonta madasha caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada ee degmada Mombasa bisha Ogosto. Dhammaan waa soo dhaweynayaan.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo romo mar paro ne rowere e Mombasa County e dwe mar Agost.

English: TVET advises applicants in Isiolo County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kutembelea kituo cha mafunzo ya ufundi kilicho karibu zaidi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: TVET waxay ku talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Isiolo inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow si ay u helaan waxbarashada soo socota.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e gweng' mar Isiolo mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds residents of Homa Bay County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay in la socodsiinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka gobolka ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone jogweng' Homa Bay County ni luwo dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges anyone experiencing abuse in Wajir County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unashauri mtu yeyote anayeona unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Wajir kutafuta msaada katika nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Wajir inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e gweng' mar Wajir mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Engage in activities that promote mental health awareness and advocacy. This can help create a sense of belonging and purpose.
Kiswahili: Shiriki katika shughuli zinazokuza ufahamu na utetezi wa afya ya akili. Hii inaweza kusaidia kujenga hisia ya kuwa wa kipekee na kusudi.
Somali: Ka qaybqaad hawlaha kor u qaadaya wacyiga caafimaadka dhimirka iyo u doodida. Tani waxay kaa caawin kartaa inaad dareento inaad ka tirsan tahay iyo ujeedo.
Dholuo: Tim gik makonyo ji mondo ong'e kaka ginyalo bedo gi winjruok maber gi Nyasaye, kendo timo kamano biro miyo ng'ato obed gi paro mowinjore.

English: IEBC encourages out-of-school children in Tana River County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Tana River kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya ugawaji wa bursary.

Dholuo: IEBC jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e taon mar Tana River County mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds needy students in Lamu County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Lamu kwamba vitabu vya kiada na maombi ya vifaa vya kujifunzia hufungwa hivi karibuni.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free stress management support is available through county health facilities in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kudhibiti mafadhaiko unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero lacag la'aan ah oo lagu maareynayo walbahaarka laga helo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Nyamira.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar stress yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Nyamira.

English: SHA urges residents of Makueni County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: SHA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.

Dholuo: SHA jiwo jogweng' Makueni County mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso chenro mar bajet mar county ochopo.

English: Notice: COMESA will train farmers in Vihiga County on organic farming this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga juu ya kilimo hai Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Vihiga ee beeraha dabiiciga ah bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA biro tiego jopur e County mar Vihiga e wi pur mar yien e dwe mar Mach.

English: EACC urges residents of Nyeri County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia simu ya EECC ya bure ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee lacag la'aanta ah si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jogweng' Nyeri County mondo ochiw ripode mag mibadhi kokalo kuom hotline mar e-ACC ma onge chudo mondo giked gi asoya e migepe mag sirkal.

English: Mothers who express breast milk should ensure clean containers, proper refrigeration, and correct warming procedures to prevent contamination.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wanaokamua maziwa ya mama wanapaswa kuhakikisha vyombo vinasafishwa, vinahifadhiwa vizuri kwenye jokofu, na taratibu sahihi za kupasha joto ili kuzuia uchafuzi.
Somali: Hooyooyinka nuujinaya caano hooyadeed waa inay hubiyaan in weelasha ay yihiin kuwo nadiif ah, qaboojinta saxda ah, iyo nidaamyada kuleylka ee habboon si looga hortago wasakheynta.
Dholuo: Min nyithindo madho kong'o onego one ni gige ting'o pi opong' gi gik maler, oting'gi e friji, kendo gitiyo gi yore mowinjore mag chungo pi mondo kik gibed gi tuoche.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Marsabit County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Marsabit inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e alworau mar Marsabit County mondo oluong kony mar thieth mar paro maonge chudo.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free depression awareness support is available through county health facilities in Narok County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa uhamasishaji wa unyogovu unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay wacyiga niyadjabku laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar parruok yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth e gweng' mar Narok.

English: Ministry of Education conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in Bungoma County this March.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Machi hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay bishii Maarso ku qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi ratiro mag sirkal e County mar Bungoma e dwe mar Mach.

English: State launches Kenya National Public Health Institute to bolster disease prevention
Kiswahili: Serikali yazindua Taasisi ya Kitaifa ya Afya ya Umma ya Kenya ili kuimarisha kinga dhidi ya magonjwa
Somali: Dowladda Kenya ayaa daahfurtay Machadka Caafimaadka Dadweynaha ee Qaranka si loo xoojiyo ka hortagga cudurrada

English: IEBC invites residents of Embu County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: IEBC gwelo joma odak e county mar Embu mondo ochiw ripot mondik kapok ndalo ochopo mar wuoyo e wi chenro mag sirkal ochopo.

English: State Department for Basic Education advises students in Makueni County to collect materials from the county education office to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Makueni kukusanya vifaa kutoka kwa ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ardayda degmada Makueni kula talineysaa inay ka soo ururiyaan agabyada xafiiska waxbarashada ee degmada si ay u helaan buugaag iyo agab waxbarasho.

English: DPP calls on residents of Nyeri County to support local peace-building committees in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: DPP inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za mitaa katika kusaidia tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: DPP waxay dadka deggan degmada Nyeri ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee deegaanka si ay u taageerayaan taxadarka ka dhanka ah argagixisada.
Dholuo: DPP okwayo jogweng' Nyeri County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gweng'no e siro tij kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Notice: DPP conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Samburu County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Samburu Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ku saabsan ka hortagga argagixisada ee Gobolka Samburu bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: DPP timo romo mar oganda e dwe mar Oktoba e county mar Samburu.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds farmers in Murang'a County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Murang'a juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Murang'a barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development oparo ne jopur e County mar Murang'a chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free youth mental wellness support is available through county health facilities in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa afya ya akili kwa vijana unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Bungoma County.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar paro mar rowere yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e Bungoma County.

Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu yatangaza usambazaji wa miongozo ya marekebisho kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Desemba hii.
