Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag somo e skunde man Nyandarua County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: KEPHIS announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for cattle in Bungoma County this October.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Oktoba hii.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan qabyaalada lo'da ee Gobolka Bungoma bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KEPHIS ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar rabies e dwe mar Oktoba e county mar Bungoma.

Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Garissa: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2022

Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaonya wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Tana River juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay uga digtay beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Tana River in ay jiraan cudurro cayayaanka ah waxayna kugula talineysaa in si sax ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) chiwo siem ne jopur ma loso chai e taon mar Tana River County kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Laikipia County that access to subsidised dialysis is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kwamba upatikanaji wa dialysis ya ruzuku sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Laikipia in helitaanka dialysis-ka la taageeray hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone ji duto e County of Laikipia ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mar dialysis e kuonde moyier.

English: Notice: COMESA will distribute certified sorghum seed to farmers in Homa Bay County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: COMESA itasambaza mbegu zilizothibitishwa za sorghum kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay mwezi huu wa Machi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay u qaybin doontaa abuurka sorghum-ka ee la caddeeyay beeraleyda gobolka Homa Bay bishii Maarso.

Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha katika shule kote Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay bilawday barnaamij adeegyo hagis iyo la-talin ah oo ku yaal dugsiyada gobolka Taita-Taveta.

Kiswahili: KTDA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kitui Mei hii.

Dholuo: KTDA olando chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar rabies e County mar Kitui e dwe mar Mei.

Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo jogweng' Makueni County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'adoe bura nikech ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne ji.

English: DPP urges the public in Tharaka-Nithi County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: DPP inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu.

Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yafungua programu mpya ya ufungaji wa umeme katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Kitui.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges residents of Kakamega County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti hiyo kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kakamega inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha.

English: DCI urges residents of Kisumu County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: DCI inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.

Dholuo: DCI ojiwo jogweng' mar Kisumu County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi kuom rito tong'.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Kisii County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kudai kutoa huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na ufisadi wa fedha za umma.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay dalbadaan bixinta adeegyada iyada oo aan la bixin laaluush si looga hortago xadgudubka lacagaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Kisii mondo okonygi gi tij lendo maok gichiwo asoya mondo giked gi ketho pesa mag sirkal.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association will hold a stress management forum in Siaya County this April. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitafanya kongamano la kudhibiti mafadhaiko katika Kaunti ya Siaya Aprili hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha xakamaynta stress-ka ee degmada Siaya bisha April. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni Kenya Medical Association biro timo romo mar kedo gi parruok e taon mar Siaya e dwe mar April.

English: KRA warns public officers in Kiambu County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: KRA inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: KRA waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Kiambu inay musuqmaasuqa ka qaataan xafiisyada dawladda.
Dholuo: KRA chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e Kaunti mar Kiambu kuom kawo asoya e migepe mar sirkal.

English: Responding to mental health issues for people with disabilities is critical.Do you know someone who would need someone to talk to?SMS support to 20767 to get access to a counsellor.
Kiswahili: Kushughulikia masuala ya afya ya akili kwa watu wenye ulemavu ni muhimu. Je, unamjua mtu ambaye atahitaji mtu wa kuzungumza naye? Tuma ujumbe mfupi wa usaidizi kwa 20767 ili kupata mshauri nasaha.

Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kitui: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2022

English: KRA reminds the public in Kakamega County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this February.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba maoni juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka ni ya kukaribishwa Februari hii.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha Gobolka Kakamega in talooyinka dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: KRA oparo ne ji duto e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e dwe mar Februar.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Nyamira County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhusu umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMRI waxay dadka degmada Nyamira ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay nadaafadda saxda ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMRI oparo ne ji e County mar Nyamira kuom ber mar rito ler maler e ngima joot.

English: Government introduces fair pricing guidelines for fresh produce markets
Kiswahili: Serikali yaanzisha miongozo ya bei nzuri kwa masoko ya mazao mabichi
Somali: Dowladda waxay soo bandhigtay tilmaamo ku saabsan qiimaha cadaalada ah ee suuqyada alaabta cusub
Dholuo: Sirkal chako keto chike ma tayo chudo e yo makare ne ohala mag chamo chiemo manyien

English: Ministry of Health launches a September awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Septemba juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Sebtember ee baaritaanka sonkorowga ee gobolka Nyamira.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health osechako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Septemba e wi nonro mar thieth mar sukari e kaunti duto mar Nyamira.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Homa Bay County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba ufikiaji wa usaidizi wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Homa Bay in helitaanka taageerada sheegashada NHIF/SHA ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMRI parone ji duto manie Homa Bay County ni kony mar kwayo kwayo kuom NHIF/SHA sani yudore e kuonde moyier.

Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KTDA waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanada buka xafiiska xayawaanka ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.

English: KTDA advises farmers in Vihiga County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.

English: DPP reminds mobile money users in Garissa County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.

Dholuo: DPP paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e gweng' mar Garissa mondo ochiw ripot mar ote mamulo pachgi ne jatendgi mondo kik gitim mibadhi mar SIM-swap.

Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa msaada wa kisheria bure katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah degmada Siaya.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health: free antenatal care clinics will run every November at designated health centres in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya: kliniki za bure za utunzaji wa ujauzito zitafanya kazi kila Novemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Baringo.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in Isiolo County this June.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika shule katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Juni hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku dhawaaqay qaybinta deeqaha waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan dugsiyada degmada Isiolo bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ogolo chiwo mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre man gi chandruok e skunde man Isiolo County e dwe mar Jun.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds residents of Garissa County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan Gobolka Garissa in helitaanka adeegyada baasaboorka ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone jogweng' mar County mar Garissa ni koro yot yudo passport kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: "We urge Kenyans to confirm job offers from airlines, especially Emirates and Qatar Airways. Multiple scams promising airport jobs have been flagged.
Kiswahili: "Tunawahimiza Wakenya kuthibitisha matoleo ya kazi kutoka kwa mashirika ya ndege, haswa Emirates na Qatar Airways.

English: Notice from CDC: childhood immunization clinics will run every August at designated health centres in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa CDC: kliniki za chanjo za watoto zitaendeshwa kila Agosti katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid CDC: rugta tallaalka carruurta ayaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Agoosto oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Kisii.

English: Kenya confirms three new Mpox cases in Busia; Health Ministry warns of a high risk of importing Marburg and Ebola viruses from neighboring Tanzania and Sudan.
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha visa vitatu vipya vya Mpox huko Busia; Wizara ya Afya yaonya kuhusu hatari kubwa ya kuagiza virusi vya Marburg na Ebola kutoka nchi jirani za Tanzania na Sudan.
Somali: Kenya ayaa xaqiijisay saddex kiis oo cusub oo Mpox ah oo ka dhacay Busia; Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ka digtay khatarta sare ee soo dejinta fayrasyada Marburg iyo Ebola ee ka imanaya Tanzania iyo Suudaan ee deriska ah.
Dholuo: Kenya osenyiso ji adek manyien ma nigi tuwo mar Mpox e piny Busia; Ministry of Health osiemo ni nitie nengo maduong' mar kelo tuoche mar Marburg kod Ebola e piny Tanzania kod Sudan.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET announces bursary allocation enrollment dates for schools in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa mgao wa bursary kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhawaaqday taariikhda diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ee dugsiyada ku yaal gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar State for TVET olando tarik mag somo e skunde mag Uasin Gishu County.

English: HELB urges youth in Kisumu County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: HELB inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: HELB waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kisumu inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo rowere e County mar Kisumu mondo onyis weche ma gin-go mar ndiko ji e ka gitim gik ma biro timore ne oganda.

English: IEBC advises residents of Kilifi County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: IEBC inashauri wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: IEBC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: IEBC nyiso jogweng' Kilifi County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds voters in Kwale County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya kujiandikisha.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu xasuusinayaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Kwale inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor diiwaangelinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone jogweng' Kwale County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom SMS ne 70000 kapok gidonjo e register mar joma oyiero.

English: Did you know suicide is the 3rd leading cause of death among 15_x0096_-29 year olds? It_x0092_s time to raise awareness and support mental health.
Kiswahili: Je, unajua kujiua ni sababu ya tatu inayoongoza ya kifo kati ya watu wenye umri wa miaka 15-29? Ni wakati wa kuongeza ufahamu na kusaidia afya ya akili.
Somali: Ma ogtahay in isdilku uu yahay sababta 3aad ee ugu badan ee dhimashada dadka da'doodu u dhaxayso 15_x0096_-29 sano? Waa waqtigii la wacyigelin lahaa lana taageeri lahaa caafimaadka dhimirka.
Dholuo: Be ing'eyo ni nek ng'ato en gima kelo tho mar adek e kind joma hikgi 15_x0096_-29? En kinde mar keto ji ong’e kendo siro thieth mar paro.

English: KEPHIS urges farmers in Baringo County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo cha hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Baringo inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Baringo mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e weche mag pur mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok e kaka koth chue.

English: ODPP urges residents of Homa Bay County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti hiyo ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja wa kaunti.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka gobolka si ay uga warqabtaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee gobolka.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mar dongruok e county.

English: KMTC calls on the community in Bomet County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KMTC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Bomet kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: KMTC waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Bomet inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban si loo ilaaliyo nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: KMTC luongo ji duto manie County mar Bomet mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: SHA reminds residents of Marsabit County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.
