Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha ee qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyadda ee Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health okwayo jorit e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi e dwe mar Novemba.

English: KUCCPS reminds schools in Samburu County to strengthen inclusion of learners with disabilities this July.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuimarisha ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu Julai hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada Gobolka Samburu inay xoojiyaan ka mid noqoshada ardayda naafada ah bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: KUCCPS oparo ne skunde e county mar Samburu mondo omed tiego jopuonjre ma nigi midekre e dwe mar Julai.

English: Meru (Meru-North) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Meru (Meru-Kaskazini): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2022
Somali: Degmada Meru (Meru-Waqooyi): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Meru (Meru-Nyath): Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Julaini 2022

English: Announcing the lauch of Country plan that prioritizes maternal-child nutrition, agricultureâ€‘education integration and multisector tracking.
Kiswahili: Kutangaza uzinduzi wa mpango wa Nchi unaoweka kipaumbele lishe ya mama na mtoto, ujumuishaji wa elimu ya kilimo na ufuatiliaji wa sekta nyingi.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqista qorshaha Dalka oo mudnaanta siinaya nafaqada hooyada iyo ilmaha, isdhexgalka waxbarashada beeraha iyo la socodka qaybaha badan.
Dholuo: Kuong'o chakruok mar chenro mar piny ma keto mokuongo chiemo mar min gi nyathi, riwruok mar somo mar pur kod luwo sektor mang'eny.

English: KEPHIS advises farmers in Nyamira County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyamira inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e County mar Nyamira mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by CDC will be held in Kirinyaga County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na CDC itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Juni hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabiyeen CDC ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Kirinyaga bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kampen mar thieth ma onge chudo ma CDC ochano biro timore e County mar Kirinyaga e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya activates an emergency response plan for flooding in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya yaanzisha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay hirgelinaysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ku saabsan fatahaadaha degmada Makueni.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chako tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne ataro mar pi e gweng' mar Makueni.

English: "Let's close the care gap and ensure every birth is safe and supported." Dr.
Kiswahili: "Hebu tuzibe pengo la utunzaji na kuhakikisha kila kuzaliwa ni salama na kuungwa mkono." Dk.
Somali: "Aan xirno farqiga daryeelka oo aan hubinno in dhalmo kasta ay ammaan tahay oo la taageerayo." Dr.
Dholuo: Wek wageng' gap mar rito kendo wane ni nyuol ka nyuol nigi arita kendo ochung'ne. Dokta.

English: KALRO urges dairy cows farmers in Nandi County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa ngozi vya uvimbe vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Nandi inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyada oo aan la helin ruqsad ka dib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KALRO ojiwo jopur mag dhok mag chak e county mar Nandi mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni e tong county maok giyudo rusa bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag dhoot.

English: Be cautious of business mentorship programs advertised by influencers that ask for hefty registration fees. Many lack legal registration.
Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu na programu za ushauri wa biashara zinazotangazwa na watu wenye ushawishi wanaoomba ada kubwa za usajili. Nyingi hazina usajili wa kisheria.
Somali: Ka digtoonow barnaamijyada hagista ganacsiga ee ay xayeysiiyaan dadka saamaynta ku leh ee weydiista kharashyo badan oo diiwaangelin ah. Qaar badan oo ka mid ah ma haystaan ​​​​diiwaangelin sharci ah.
Dholuo: Bed gi ritruok e wi chenro mag puonjo ji e weche mag ohala ma joma nigi teko mar timo ohala lando ma dwaro ni ichul pesa mang’eny mag ndiko nying’. Thothgi onge gi ndiko ma chik oyiego.

English: KICD advises applicants in Laikipia County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KICD inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KICD waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Laikipia inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: KICD nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Laikipia ni mondo gidonj e tiegruok kapok ichopo e chokruok mabiro.

English: Isiolo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Isiolo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Aprili 2024
Somali: Degmada Isiolo: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Isiolo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Ang'wen 2024

English: Taita Taveta County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Taita Taveta: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Mei 2024
Somali: Degmada Taita Taveta: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Taita Taveta: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar abich higa mar 2024

English: State Department for TVET encourages residents of Samburu County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Samburu inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabaan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET ojiwo jogweng' Samburu County mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto giseyudo mondo ging'e weche duto ma biro timore.

English: Notice: COMESA will distribute certified millet seed to farmers in Kitui County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay abuuraha degmada Kitui u qaybin doontaa abuurka miiska ee la caddeeyay bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA biro pogo kodhi mag millet ne jopur man Kitui County e dwe mar Agost.

English: Kenya Gazette advises residents of Nakuru County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inay qaataan dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado dib u dhac marka la raadinayo adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette nyiso jogweng' Nakuru County mondo oting'e buge duto madwarore mondo kik giketh seche ma gidwaro tiyo gi passport.

English: Kenya Medical Association calls on parents in Isiolo County to have children under five screened for Rift Valley Fever during the December outreach.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuwafanyia uchunguzi watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Desemba.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqayaa waalidiinta degmada Isiolo in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro Cudurka Rift Valley inta lagu gudajiro bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association dwaro ni jonyuol manie Isiolo County otim nonro ne nyithindo ma hikgi tin ne abich kuom tuwo mar Rift Valley Fever e dwe mar Desemba.

English: [DigiSchool Project] Connected 21 schools to the Internet, including 6 schools for children with special educational needs through UNESCO/Huawei partnership
Kiswahili: [Mradi wa DigiSchool] Uunganisho wa shule 21 kwenye mtandao, ikiwa ni pamoja na shule 6 kwa watoto wenye mahitaji maalum ya elimu kupitia ushirikiano wa UNESCO/Huawei
Somali: [Mashruuca DigiSchool] 21 dugsi ayaa ku xiran internetka, oo ay ku jiraan 6 dugsi oo loogu talagalay carruurta leh baahiyo waxbarasho oo gaar ah iyada oo loo marayo wada shaqeynta UNESCO/Huawei
Dholuo: [DigiSchool Project] Oseriwo skunde 21 e Intanet, moriwo nyaka skunde 6 mag nyithindo ma nigi dwaro makende mag somo kokalo kuom riwruok mar UNESCO/Huawei

English: Notice: KALRO will open a maize collection centre in Kirinyaga County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mahindi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay bilaabi doontaa xarun ururinta hadhuudhka ee Gobolka Kirinyaga bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KALRO biro yawo kambi mar choko cham e gweng' mar Kirinyaga e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: NDMA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Narok County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NDMA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Narok kuripoti kesi kwenye dawati la karibu la jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka gobolka Narok inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e gweng' mar Narok mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Tharaka Nithi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Aprili 2022
Somali: Degmada Tharaka Nithi: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Tharaka Nithi: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Ang'wen 2022

English: NTSA warns residents of Busia County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia juu ya kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: NTSA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia kororka nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' County mar Busia e wi medruok mar chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: KEPHIS advises coffee producers in Samburu County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inashauri wazalishaji wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kafeega ee Gobolka Samburu inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KEPHIS nyiso jopur ma loso chai e county mar Samburu ni mondo giti gi nengo maromo nade kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: To encourage community-wide ownership and create an enabling environment for women's economic empowerment, young men and male relatives of SHG members participate in complementary livelihood skills training alongside the women's groups.
Kiswahili: Ili kuhimiza umiliki wa jamii nzima na kuweka mazingira wezeshi kwa uwezeshaji wa wanawake kiuchumi, vijana wa kiume na wa kiume wa wanachama wa SHG hushiriki katika mafunzo ya stadi za kujikimu kimaisha pamoja na vikundi vya wanawake.
Somali: Si loo dhiirrigeliyo lahaanshaha bulshada oo dhan loona abuuro jawi suurtagal ah oo loogu talagalay awoodsiinta dhaqaalaha haweenka, ragga dhallinyarada ah iyo qaraabada ragga ah ee xubnaha SHG waxay ka qayb qaataan tababar xirfadeed oo dhammaystiran oo ku saabsan hab-nololeedka iyagoo la socda kooxaha haweenka.
Dholuo: Mondo ojiw bedo gi mwandu e kind oganda duto kendo olos yo ma nyalo miyo mon obed gi teko mar yudo mwandu, yawuowi matindo kod anyuola ma chwo mag jokanyo mag SHG kawo thuolo mar puonjruok mar ng’eyo yore mag dak ma konyogi kanyakla gi grup mag mon.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the public in Kitui County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of identity theft.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadweynaha degmada Kitui inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee tuugista aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ji duto e County mar Kitui mondo ong'e kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro bang' weche mag kwalo kitgi.

English: Taita Taveta County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Taita Taveta: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Taita Taveta: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Taita Taveta: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar Septemba 2022

English: IEBC urges residents of West Pokot County to attend the public participation forum to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya West Pokot kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay ka qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si loo qaabeeyo habka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo ji duto modak e West Pokot County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar loso bajet mar county.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development informs fish farmers in Murang'a County of new market linkage opportunities this January.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inafahamisha wafugaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Januari hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku wargelineysaa kalluumeysatada degmada Murang'a fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development nyiso jopur rech e County mar Murang'a kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Januar.

English: Full details of those removed and the reasons were not available for this report.
Kiswahili: Maelezo kamili ya walioondolewa na sababu hazikupatikana kwa ripoti hii.
Somali: Faahfaahin buuxda oo ku saabsan kuwa la saaray iyo sababaha looma helin warbixintan.
Dholuo: Weche duto mag jogo ma ne ogol oko kod gik ma ne omiyo otimo kamano ne ok yudre e ripotni.

English: ODPP encourages first-time voters in Samburu County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Samburu kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Samburu inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo josiasa mokwongo e county mar Samburu mondo oting'e ID kata pasipoti mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) advises residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay yareeyaan qaadashada cusbada iyo sonkorta si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo omed chamo mor kod sukari mondo kik thiedh tuoche.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya umetoa onyo la usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ripot Mamit mar Kenya ogolo siem mar rito weche mag intanet kuom chenro mag ohala ma ketho joma odak Bungoma County.

English: KALRO warns sweet potatoes farmers in Homa Bay County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaonya wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KALRO waxay uga digtay beeraleyda baradho macaan ee gobolka Homa Bay cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: KALRO chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho adundo e Homa Bay County kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the community in Garissa County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb theft.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Garissa kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya bulshada degmada Garissa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ji duto manie County mar Garissa mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o kuo.

English: Notice: NDMA opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inafungua ofisi ya kijinsia inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Ogaysiis: NDMA waxay furaysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya daryeel caafimaad ka dib rabshadaha Degmada Nakuru.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA oseyawo ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony e weche thieth bang' timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Nakuru.

English: KICD reminds parents in Kisumu County that bursary allocation registration is open this March.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba usajili wa ugawaji wa bursari umefunguliwa Machi hii.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Kisumu in diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ay furan tahay bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne jonyuol e County mar Kisumu ni kad mar chiwo mich mag tiegruok osechakore e dwe mar Mach.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages residents of Kiambu County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kutoteseka kimya kimya na kumhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiiri geliyaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay u dhiiri galiyaan saaxiibo dhibaataysan inay caawimaad raadsadaan.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo jogweng' Kiambu County mondo kik gisandre aling' ling' kendo mondo gijiw osiepgi moro ma chandore omany kony.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties invites residents of Kirinyaga County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusu ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties ogwelo jogweng' Kirinyaga County mondo oriwre kodgi e nono tich mitimo higa ka higa kokalo kuom websait mar county.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges residents of Marsabit County to avoid contact with contaminated water sources following a rise in reported measles cases.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya surua vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inay ka fogaadaan inay la xiriiraan ilo biyo oo wasakheysan ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska suuxdinta ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' mar Marsabit County mondo owe tudruok gi kuonde ma pi yudoree nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuwono osemedore.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds mobile money users in Marsabit County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid identity theft.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Marsabit inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegga si looga fogaado tuugada aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e Marsabit County ni mondo ginyis joritgi weche maok adier mondo kik gikwed kwalo nyingegi.

English: Ministry of Education encourages out-of-school children in Vihiga County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under free primary education.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Vihiga inay dalbadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo nyithindo maok dhi e skul e County mar Vihiga mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: IEBC advises residents of Wajir County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: IEBC inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: IEBC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Wajir inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: IEBC nyiso jogweng' mar Wajir County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) advises residents of Busia County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun iyo biyo nadiif ah si joogto ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' County mar Busia mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Notice: NTSA conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Kisii County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Kisii Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada oo ku saabsan ka hortagga argagixisada ee degmada Kisii bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Riwruok mar National Security Agency (NTSA) timo romo mar oganda e dwe mar Desemba e gweng' mar Kisii.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Murang'a County about the importance of tobacco control for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhusu umuhimu wa udhibiti wa tumbaku kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya ayaa dadka degmada Murang'a ku xasuusinaya muhiimadda ay leedahay ka hortagga sigaarka caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association parone ji duto manie County mar Murang'a kuom gimomiyo thieth mar madho ndawa en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: OGP advises residents of Kajiado County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: OGP inashauri wakazi wa Kajiado County kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: OGP waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport services.

English: Notice from KEMSA: childhood immunization clinics will run every September at designated health centres in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa KEMSA: kliniki za chanjo za watoto zitaendeshwa kila Septemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid KEMSA: Xarumaha tallaalka carruurta waxaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Sebtember ee xarumaha caafimaadka ee lagu magacaabo gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Chenro mar KEMSA: Klinike mag thiedho nyithindo biro tiyo e dwe mar ochiko higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e Homa Bay County.

English: KNEC urges youth in West Pokot County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada West Pokot inay ka qeybgalaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo rowere man West Pokot County mondo oriwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county ka pok ochopo chenro mag oganda.

English: Notice: e-Citizen launches ward-level service delivery in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen huzindua huduma za huduma katika wilaya ya Garissa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: e-Citizen waxay bilawday bixinta adeegyada heerka qaybta ee Gobolka Garissa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni e-Citizen chako chiwo kony e gwenge mopogore opogore e County mar Garissa.

English: NCPB advises farmers in Embu County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa mkulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Embu inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qaybqaataan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e county mar Embu mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: Kitui County residents have been urged to take advantage of the projected El-Nino rains to plant more trees to increase the tree cover in the arid and semi-arid county.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kitui wameombwa kuchukua faida ya mvua za El-Nino ili kupanda miti zaidi ili kuongeza kufunika kwa miti katika wilaya kavu na nusu kavu.
Somali: Dadka deggan Gobolka Kitui ayaa lagu booriyay inay ka faa'iideystaan roobabka El-Nino ee la saadaalinayo si ay u beeraan geedo badan si loo kordhiyo daboolka geedaha gobolka qalalan iyo kuwa nus-qalalan.
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine modak e gweng' mar Kitui County osenyisgi ni gitiek yiende mang'eny ka gitiyo gi koth mar El-Nino mondo omed pong'o yiende e alwora ma onge yiende.

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of Baringo County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: Kenya Red Cross inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo kororka khiyaamada SIM-swap waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax falin.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross osiemo jogweng'o mag Baringo County kuom wach medruok mar wuond mag SIM-swap kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: TSC reminds parents in Nyandarua County that free primary education registration is open this April.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba usajili wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo umefunguliwa Aprili hii.
Somali: TSC waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta gobolka Nyandarua in diiwaangelinta bilaashka ah ee waxbarashada hoose ay furan tahay bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: TSC oparo ne jonyuol manie County mar Nyandarua ni chenro mar somo mar pinyruoth ma onge chudo osechakore e dwe mar April.

English: Ministry of Health urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Siaya County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Siaya kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Siaya inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pachgi e County mar Siaya mondo oluong kony mar thieth mar pach maonge chudo.

English: War on malaria gets a major boost. New drug Argesun deployed in Nyanza. Drug to help ICU patients, children with Malaria
Kiswahili: Vita dhidi ya malaria vyaongezeka sana. Dawa mpya ya Argesun yatumika Nyanza. Dawa ya kuwasaidia wagonjwa wa ICU, watoto wenye Malaria
Somali: Dagaalka ka dhanka ah Cudurka Cudurada Cudurrada Malaria ayaa si weyn loo xoojiyay. Daawo cusub oo loo yaqaan 'Argesun' ayaa laga soo saaray magaalada Nyanza.
Dholuo: Lweny motudore gi malaria yudo teko maduong'. yedhe manyien miluongo ni Argesun oland e Nyanza. yedhe makonyo jotuo mag ICU, nyithindo ma nigi malaria

English: OGP advises residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: OGP inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: OGP waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport services.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds expectant mothers in Kakamega County that access to free antenatal care is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za ujauzito bila malipo ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Kakamega in helitaanka daryeelka uurka ka hor ee bilaashka ah ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne mine ma nigi ich e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni thuolo mar yudo rit mar nyuol ma onge chudo yudore maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag sirkal.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will hold a depression awareness forum in Tana River County this August. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanya kongamano la uhamasishaji wa unyogovu katika Kaunti ya Tana River Agosti hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) waxay qaban doontaa madasha wacyiga dhimirka ee degmada Tana River bisha Agoosto. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo chokruok mar chiwo paro e wi tuwo mar depression e taon mar Tana River County e dwe mar Agost.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges millet growers in Nandi County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Nandi kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda millet ee degmada Nandi inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka ciidanka xilliga dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur mag millet e county mar Nandi mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e kinde machuok.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Nyeri County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit nyiso jogweng' Nyeri County mondo odonj e insuarans mar thieth mondo giyud thieth makonyo.

English: KEMRI reminds the public that free Rift Valley Fever screening is available at all public health centres in Tharaka-Nithi County this September.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Septemba hii.
Somali: KEMRI waxay dadweynaha xasuusineysaa in baaritaanka hargabka Rift Valley ee lacag la'aanta ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka guud ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KEMRI oparo ne ji ni nonro mar Rift Valley Fever ma onge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: CDC launches an August awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Agosti juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Somali: CDC waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Agoosto oo ku saabsan wacyi-gelinta cadaadiska sare ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi.
Dholuo: CDC osechako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Agost e wi tuo mar adundo mar remo e Tharaka-Nithi County duto.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay furtay xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya daryeel caafimaad ka dib rabshadaha degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji ochako ofis ma chiwo kony mar thieth bang' timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Isiolo.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges parents and teachers in Nandi County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Somali: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka Nandi waxay waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta ugu baaqeysaa inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education ojiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e county mar Nandi mondo omany namba mar kony mar nyithindo 116.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross launches a burglary prevention campaign in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ripot Mamit mar Kenya chako kampen mar geng'o jokuoge odonj e gweng' mar Elgeyo-Marakwet e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages residents of Mombasa County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Mombasa County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Keeping physical distance is paramount in ensuring we #KomeshaCorona with overall behavior change during this pandemic times #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Kuweka umbali wa mwili ni jambo la msingi katika kuhakikisha sisi #KomeshaCorona na mabadiliko ya tabia kwa ujumla wakati huu wa janga #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Fogaanta jirka waa muhiim si loo hubiyo in aan #KomeshaCorona la yeelanno isbeddel guud oo ku yimaada hab-dhaqanka inta lagu jiro xilligan masiibada ah #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Keto thuolo mar bedo mabor gi jowetewa en gima duong' ahinya e neno ni wabedo gi #KomeshaCorona gi lokruok e timbe duto e kinde mag tuwo marachni #KomeshaCorona

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges motorists and pedestrians in Tharaka-Nithi County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada daadad ku soo daatay si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Weche Dhano jiwo derebe kod joma wuotho e ndara e gweng' mar Tharaka-Nithi mondo kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o mondo kik gitim aksident mag ndara.

English: Farmers and stakeholders are invited to submit their views on five new agricultural reform bills within 21 days Get involved to help shape the future of key crop value chains
Kiswahili: Wakulima na washikadau wanaalikwa kuwasilisha maoni yao kuhusu miswada mitano mipya ya mageuzi ya kilimo ndani ya siku 21 Jihusishe kusaidia kuunda mustakabali wa minyororo muhimu ya thamani ya mazao
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu casuumay inay soo gudbiyaan aragtidooda ku saabsan shan sharci oo cusub oo dib-u-habeyn beeraha ah muddo 21 maalmood gudahood ah Ka qayb qaadashada si loo qaabeeyo mustaqbalka silsiladaha qiimaha dalagyada muhiimka ah
Dholuo: Oganda mar jopur kod joma nie bwo loch ogwel mondo ochiw pachgi kuom chike manyien abich mag lokruok e weche mag pur e kinde mar ndalo 21

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development invites youth in Baringo County to enroll for electrical installation training this November.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Baringo kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Novemba hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka ayaa ku casuumay dhalinyarada degmada Baringo inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka rakibidda korontada bisha November.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ogwelo rowere man Baringo County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar keto sitima e dwe mar Novemba.

English:
Be safe from coronavirus.Washing your hands is the most important way to stop transmission.
1.Wet hands
2.Apply enough soap
3.Scrub all surfaces of the hands for 20-30 seconds.
4.Rinse thoroughly with running water
5.Dry hands with a clean cloth or single-use towel
Kiswahili: Kuwa salama kutokana na virusi vya corona.Kuosha mikono yako ni njia muhimu zaidi ya kuzuia maambukizi. 1.Kunyunyizia mikono 2.Tumia sabuni ya kutosha 3.Kunyunyiza uso wote wa mikono kwa sekunde 20-30. 4.Kunausha vizuri kwa maji yanayotiririka 5.Kunyuna mikono kwa kitambaa safi au towel ya matumizi ya mara moja
Somali: Iska ilaali cudurka Coronavirus. Gacmahaada maydhka ayaa ah habka ugu muhiimsan ee lagu joojin karo gudbinta. 1. Gacmaha qoyan 2.Sabayl ku filan ku dheji 3.Dadka oo dhan 20-30 ilbidhiqsi ku tirtir. 4. Biyaha qulqulaya si fiican u maydho 5. Gacmaha qalalan dhar nadiif ah ama tuulo hal mar loo isticmaalo
Dholuo: Bed motang' gi tuo mar Coronavirus.Lwoko lweti e yo maduong'ie moloyo mar geng'o tugo mar tuoche. 1.Lwoko lweteni. 2.Tigo sabun moromo. 3.Loso lweti duto kuom sekond 20-30. 4.Lwok lweti maber gi pi ma ringo. 5.Lwok lweteni gi lewni maler kata lewni ma itiyogo dichiel.

English: UNHCR Kenya: 2023 Funding Update (as of 28 February 2023)
Kiswahili: UNHCR Kenya: Taarifa ya Ufadhili ya 2023 (kuanzia tarehe 28 Februari 2023)
Somali: UNHCR Kenya: Cusboonaysiinta Maalgelinta 2023 (laga bilaabo 28 Febraayo 2023)
Dholuo: UNHCR Kenya: Loso mar Chiwo Omwom mar 2023 (chakre tarik 28 dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2023)

English: KALRO reminds farmers in Mandera County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera juu ya programu inayoendelea ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa wakulima.
Somali: KALRO waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Mandera in barnaamijka tababarka beeralayda uu socdo.
Dholuo: KALRO oparo ne jopur man Mandera County chenro mar tiego jopur ma dhi nyime.

English: Teachers Service Commission calls on the community in Samburu County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Samburu kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu bulshada degmada Samburu ugu baaqayaa inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyo.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj kwayo ji duto e gweng' mar Samburu mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo omi skul obed gi ritruok.

English: The second part of the paper surveys institutional and policy options available to promote the transition to climateÃ¢â‚¬_x0090_smart agriculture at the smallholder level.
Kiswahili: Sehemu ya pili ya karatasi inachunguza chaguzi za kitaasisi na sera zinazopatikana ili kukuza mpito wa kilimo cha hali ya hewa katika kiwango cha wakulima wadogo.
Somali: Qaybta labaad ee warqadda waxay sahaminaysaa fursadaha hay'adaha iyo siyaasadda ee la heli karo si kor loogu qaado u gudubka cimilada - beeraha caqliga leh ee heerka beeralayda yaryar.
Dholuo: Okang’ mar ariyo mar oboke no ng’iyo yore mag riwruok kod chike ma nitie mar keto lokruok e pur ma riek mar piny e rang’iny mar jopur matindo.

English: COMESA informs milk farmers in Nandi County of new market linkage opportunities this March.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawafahamisha wakulima wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Nandi juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Machi hii.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda caanaha ee gobolka Nandi fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: COMESA nyiso jopur mag chak e county mar Nandi kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Mach.

English: OGP reminds the public in Makueni County that reporting embezzlement of public funds is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa fedha za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Makueni in warbixinta xadgudubka lacagta dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: OGP parone ji duto e gweng' mar Makueni ni chiwo ripot mar ketho pesa mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageerada soo kabashada xadgudubka maandooriyaha ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Nairobi.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth e county ma Nairobi County.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges anyone experiencing abuse in Mandera County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Mandera kutafuta msaada katika nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Mandera inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e County mar Mandera mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Ministry releasing comprehensive strategy following success of KNAP 2018â€“2022, targeting multisectoral interventions to further reduce malnutrition rates.
Kiswahili: Wizara ikitoa mkakati kamili kufuatia mafanikio ya KNAP 2018â€“2022, ikilenga uingiliaji kati wa sekta mbalimbali ili kupunguza zaidi viwango vya utapiamlo.
Somali: Wasaaraddu waxay soo saartay istiraatiijiyad dhammaystiran ka dib guushii KNAP 2018-2022, iyadoo bartilmaameedsanaysa waxqabadyo badan oo waaxyo kala duwan leh si loo sii yareeyo heerarka nafaqo-xumada.
Dholuo: Od tich ma golo chenro matut bang' yudo loch mar KNAP 2018-2022, ma ochung'ne loso gik mathoth mondo omed dwoko piny kwan mar jogo ma nigi chiemo ma ok owinjore.

English: KRA invites residents of Machakos County to attend the public participation forum regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: KRA inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: KRA waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: KRA gwelo ji duto modak e county mar Machakos mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenro mag dongruok.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Turkana County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Turkana inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e county mar Turkana mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: EACC invites residents of Migori County to attend the public participation forum regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: EACC inakaribisha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Migori kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: EACC waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Migori inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: EACC gwelo jogweng' Migori County mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi nonro mar tich mitimo higa ka higa.

English: Tana River County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tana River: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Septemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Tana River: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Aora Tana: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Septemba 2022

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) advises residents of Embu County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay biyo cabitaan ah ku kariyaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' mar Embu County mondo omak pi modho kapok gitiyo kode mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: KEMSA urges residents of Murang'a County to avoid contact with contaminated water sources following a rise in reported malaria cases.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya malaria vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay ka fogaadaan inay la xiriiraan ilo biyo ah oo wasakheysan ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska fayraska ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng'o e County mar Murang'a mondo kik giriwre gi kuonde ma pi yudoree nikech kwan mar joma nigi malaria osemedore.

English: Notice: TVET opens a new welding and fabrication programme at the vocational centre in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET yafungua programu mpya ya kulehemu na utengenezaji katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan alxanka iyo soo saarista xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Kilifi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: TVET chako chenro manyien mar loso kendo loso gik moko e kambi mar tiegruok e gweng' mar Kilifi.

English: ODPP reminds voters in Busia County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Busia kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Busia inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor nidaamyada doorashada.
Dholuo: ODPP parone jogweng' Busia mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero ka pok oyud thuolo mar timo yiero.

English: Isiolo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Isiolo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Juni 2022
Somali: Degmada Isiolo: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Isiolo: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2022

English: KALRO warns rice farmers in Kiambu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaonya wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KALRO waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda bariiska ee degmada Kiambu cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: KALRO chiwo siem ne jopur loso kodhi e gweng' mar Kiambu kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Kenya Medical Association launches a March awareness campaign on safe water storage across Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kizindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Machi juu ya uhifadhi wa maji salama katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu bilaabay olole wacyi galineed oo ku saabsan kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee Maarso ee Gobolka Nairobi.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Mach kuom wach kano pi maler e alwora duto mar Nairobi County.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges residents of Taita-Taveta County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Taita-Taveta inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee deegaanka iyada oo la adeegsanayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano nikech ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: To get insight what technology in agriculture about China provides in Africa, AATF did research to discover what technology is found...
Kiswahili: Ili kupata ufahamu wa teknolojia katika kilimo kuhusu China inatoa katika Afrika, AATF alifanya utafiti ili kugundua nini teknolojia ni kupatikana ...
Somali: Si loo fahmo waxa tiknoolajiyada beeraha ee Shiinaha ay ka bixiso Afrika, AATF waxay samaysay cilmi-baaris si loo ogaado tiknoolajiyada la helo...
Dholuo: Mondo ong'e gik ma teknoloji e weche mag pur miyo e Afrika, AATF notimo nonro mondo ofweny gik ma teknoloji yudo...

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds livestock keepers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa za kuponda ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa xasuusinaya xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products paronwa jorit jamni e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo opidh legi e kuonde moyier mag nego jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: Notice: COMESA will distribute certified rice seed to farmers in Kilifi County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itasambaza mbegu za mpunga zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay abuurka bariiska ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kilifi bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: COMESA biro pogo kodhi mag loso kodhi ne jopur manie County Kilifi e dwe mar April.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit appeals to caregivers in Kisumu County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the June maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Juni.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa ugu baaqay daryeelayaasha degmada Kisumu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha ee qeyb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka ee bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit okwayo jorit e County mar Kisumu mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi e dwe mar Jun.

English: CDC reminds the public that free meningitis screening is available at all public health centres in Mandera County this June.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa uti wa mgongo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera Juni hii.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka meningitis ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Mandera bishii Juun.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji ni nono tuo mar meningitis en gima onge chudo e kuonde thieth duto man Mandera County e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: AFA will open an avocado collection centre in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itafungua kituo cha kukusanya parachichi katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay furi doontaa xarun ururinta avocado ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: AFA biro yawo ot mar choko avocado e taon mar Elgeyo-Marakwet e dwe mar Mei.

English: TSC conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Kajiado County this November.
Kiswahili: TSC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Kajiado Novemba hii.
Somali: TSC waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan wareejinta degmada Kajiado bishii November ee sannadkan.
Dholuo: TSC dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi wach golo pesa e Kajiado County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: IEBC will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IEBC biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e taon mar Baringo.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Nyeri County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa degmada Nyeri bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Rieko: Huduma Kenya chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Nyeri e dwe mar Desemba.

English: KNEC announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Tharaka-Nithi County this February.
Kiswahili: KNEC inatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Februari hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku dhawaaqday qeybinta waxyaabaha waxbarasho ee bilaashka ah ee dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Tharaka-Nithi bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: KNEC ong'ado mar pogo buge mag digital maonge chudo e skunde mag Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: NCPB restricts movement of pigs in Laikipia County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB inazuia harakati za nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kwa sababu ya mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa doofaarka degmada Laikipia sababo la xiriira faafitaanka cudurka maqaarka.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NCPB ogeng'o wuoth mar le e County mar Laikipia nikech tuwono mar pien.

English: Kenya confirms 12 more COVID-19 cases bringing total number to 246. Health CS Mutahi Kagwe says 5 of them are hotel workers.
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha visa 12 zaidi vya COVID-19 na kufanya jumla ya idadi kufikia 246. Waziri wa Afya Mutahi Kagwe anasema 5 kati yao ni wafanyakazi wa hoteli.
Somali: Kenya ayaa xaqiijisay 12 kiis oo kale oo COVID-19 ah, taasoo wadarta tirada ay gaartay 246. CS Caafimaadka Mutahi Kagwe ayaa sheegay in 5 ka mid ah ay yihiin shaqaale hoteel ah.
Dholuo: Kenya osenyiso ni nitie ji 12 mamoko ma nigi tuo mar COVID-19 kendo kwan mar jogo osedok 246. Jatend weche thieth miluongo ni Mutahi Kagwe wacho ni ji 5 kuomgi gin joma tiyo e otel.

English: OGP reminds residents of Nairobi County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: OGP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: OGP parone jogweng' Nairobi County ni luwo dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free youth mental wellness support is available through county health facilities in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa afya ya akili kwa vijana unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Nyamira.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar pach rowere yudore maonge chudo kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Nyamira.

English: Kenya territories tackle drought crisis
Kiswahili: Maeneo ya Kenya yakabiliana na janga la ukame
Somali: Deegaannada Kenya oo wax ka qabanaya dhibaatada abaarta
Dholuo: Migao mag Kenya geng'o masira mar oro

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free suicide prevention support is available through county health facilities in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kuzuia kujiua unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo ka hortagga ismiidaaminta laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar geng'o ji kik nege yudore maonge chudo kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: Kenya Gazette encourages first-time voters in Busia County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawatia moyo wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kaunti ya Busia kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horeysay ee degmada Busia inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo joma okwongo yiero e county mar Busia mondo olim kama ichanoe ji mar IEBC machiegni kodgi.

Kwa maswali yoyote yanayohusiana na COVID-19, tafadhali piga simu kwa Wizara ya Afya kwa nambari za simu zifuatazo: 0800721316, 0732353535, 0729471414. x.com/DanielN6184157 Ã¢Â€Â¦
Somali: Dadweynaha waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan gudbinta macluumaad aan la xaqiijin oo ku jira baraha bulshada. Wixii su'aalo ah ee la xiriira COVID-19, fadlan wac Wasaaradda Caafimaadka taleefannada soo socda: 0800721316, 0732353535, 0729471414. x.com/DanielN6184157 Ã¢Â€¦
Dholuo: Jokanyo mag piny ogolo paro ni kik gior weche ma onge adier e mbui mag mbui. Ka idwaro penjo moro amora motudore gi COVID-19, yie mondo igoyo simu ne Od Romo mar Thieth e namba maluwogi: 0800721316, 0729471414.

English: On September 10 2021 KUCCPS released placement results for 2020 KCSE candidates with 130000 placed in TVET diploma and certificate courses.
Kiswahili: Mnamo Septemba 10, 2021, KUCCPS ilitoa matokeo ya nafasi kwa wagombea wa KCSE 2020 na 130000 waliwekwa katika kozi za diploma na cheti cha TVET.
Somali: Bishii Sebtember 10, 2021 KUCCPS waxay soo saartay natiijooyinka booska loogu talagalay musharixiinta 2020 ee KCSE iyadoo 130000 lagu meeleeyay koorsooyinka shahaadada iyo shahaadooyinka TVET.
Dholuo: Tarik 10 dwe mar ochiko 2021 KUCCPS ne ogolo nyak mar jogo ma ne dhi yudo somo mar KCSE e higa mar 2020 ma kwan-gi ne en 130000 ma ne odhi yudo somo e tiegruok mar diploma kod certificate mar TVET.

English: KALRO urges farmers in Kajiado County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kajiado inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KALRO ojiwo jopur e Kajiado County mondo opidh cham ma opong'o lowo mondo okonygi loyo lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: Notice: NDMA opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Turkana County.

Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima Februari hii.

Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na CDC itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Aprili hii.

Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya yatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Meru Aprili hii.

Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Baringo.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds mobile money users in Nyeri County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid identity theft.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Uhalifu unakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka wizi wa kitambulisho.

Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e County mar Nyeri ni mondo ging'e kwayo mag pesa kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal ka pok gitimo gimoro mondo kik gikwed nek mar ng'ato.

English: ODPP urges residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kudai utoaji wa huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: ODPP waxay ugu baaqaysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay dalbadaan bixinta adeegyada aan la siinayo laaluush si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: ODPP okwayo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo omany tich maok ochulo asoya mondo giked gi asoya e migepe mag sirkal.

English: Government annmounncing a National Nutrition Symposium to share strategies on universal health care (UHC) and community nutrition.
Kiswahili: Serikali yatangaza Kongamano la Kitaifa la Lishe ili kushiriki mikakati kuhusu huduma ya afya kwa wote (UHC) na lishe ya jamii.
Somali: Xukuumadda ayaa ku dhawaaqday in lagu qaban doono Shirweyne Qaran oo ku saabsan nafaqada si loo wadaago istaraatijiyadaha daryeelka caafimaadka ee caalamiga ah (UHC) iyo nafaqada bulshada.

English: KRA invites residents of Siaya County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: KRA inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na mashauriano ya sera za umma.

Dholuo: KRA gwelo joma odak e county mar Siaya mondo ochiw barua mondik kapok ndalo ochopo mar wuoyo e wi chenro mag sirkal ochopo.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds the public in Nyandarua County that reporting embezzlement of public funds is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa fedha za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Hay'adda garsoorka Kenya waxay dadka degmada Nyandarua ku xasuusineysaa in warbixinta xadgudubka lacagaha dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone ji duto manie County mar Nyandarua ni lando miriambo mag pesa mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: The launch of the plan to defend digital services, to promote good encouragement through nowardays organizations to leverage foods from FOP, and policy change.

English: Notice: KUCCPS launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Siaya County.

English: E-Citizen reminds the public in Homa Bay County that reporting embezzlement of public funds is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen anakumbusha umma katika Homa Bay County kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa fedha za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.

English: COMESA urges farmers in Taita-Taveta County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.

Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Agosti.

Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e County mar Nairobi mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochako chwoyo kodhi e dwe mar Agost.

English: KMTC reminds parents in Makueni County that bursary allocation registration is open this October.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba usajili wa ugawaji wa bursary umefunguliwa Oktoba hii.

Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na elimu ya msingi bila malipo.

English: TVET encourages out-of-school children in Vihiga County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.

Kiswahili: Ilani: NPS inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Narok.

English: KRA encourages first-time voters in Kilifi County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: KRA inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu.
