English: Ministry of Health reminds the public that free suicide prevention support is available through county health facilities in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kuzuia kujiua unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo ka hortagga ismiidaaminta laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Kakamega County.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar geng'o ji kik donjre yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e County Kakamega.

English: NPS reminds residents of Baringo County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kusakinisha na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kazini wakati wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta guriga iyo shaqada inta lagu jiro xilliyada fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: NPS paronwa jogweng' Baringo County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo giti e kinde mag koth.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds youth in Bomet County that HELB funding is available for welding and fabrication training.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya dhalinyarada degmada Bomet in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne rowere man Bomet County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko.

English: To realize these objectives, special focus will continue to be placed on five pillars with the highest impact to drive and sustain economic recovery as well as household welfare: Agricultural Transformation; Micro, Small and Medium Enterprise s (MSME) Economy; Housing and Settlement; Healthcare; and Digital Superhighway and Creative Economy .
Kiswahili: Ili kufikia malengo haya, mkazo maalum utaendelea kuwekwa kwenye nguzo tano zenye matokeo ya juu zaidi ya kuendesha na kuendeleza ufufuaji wa uchumi pamoja na ustawi wa kaya: Mabadiliko ya Kilimo; Uchumi wa Biashara Ndogo, Ndogo na za Kati (MSME); Makazi na Makazi; Huduma ya afya; na Barabara kuu ya Dijiti na Uchumi Ubunifu.
Somali: Si loo xaqiijiyo yoolalkan, waxaa diiradda la saari doonaa shan tiir oo leh saameynta ugu sareysa ee lagu horumarinayo laguna joogteynayo soo kabashada dhaqaalaha iyo sidoo kale daryeelka qoyska: Isbeddelka Beeraha; Dhaqaalaha Ganacsiga Yaryar, Yaryar iyo Dhexdhexaadka ah (MSME); Guryaha iyo Dejinta; Daryeelka Caafimaadka; iyo Wadada Weyn ee Dijital ah iyo Dhaqaalaha Hal-abuurka leh.
Dholuo: Mondo ochop dwaro ma kamago, ibiro dhi nyime keto pach makende kuom gik abich ma nigi teko maduong’ ahinya e riembo kendo rito dongruok mar weche yuto kaachiel gi rito ngima mar joot: Lokiruok mar Pur; Ohala matin, matin kod madongo (MSME); Udi kod Kuonde mag Odak; Chiwruok mar thieth; kendo Yo Maduong’ mar Dijital kod Ekonomi mar Gik Motudore .

English: Notice: DCI activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay shilalka waddooyinka ee degmada Murang'a.
Dholuo: Rapar: DCI tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne masiche ma timore e nderni e County mar Murang'a.

English: FAO advises farmers in Kilifi County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: FAO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: FAO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kilifi inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Pest Control Products Board warns sorghum farmers in Meru County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawaonya wakulima wa sorghum katika Kaunti ya Meru juu ya kuzuka kwa wadudu na inapendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda sorghum ee degmada Meru cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanada wuxuuna ku talinayaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda ah.
Dholuo: Pest Control Products Board chiwo siem ne jopur mag sorghum e kaunti mar Meru kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges rice growers in Baringo County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Baringo kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Wax soo saarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda bariiska ee degmada Baringo inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagula talinayo roobka ka hor si loo hagaajiyo waxsoosaarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur ma pidho kodhi e gweng' mar Baringo mondo oti gi ratiro ma gichiwo mar chwoyo kodhi kapok koth ochue mondo omed kelo nyak e higani.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties launches ward-level service delivery in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa huanza kutoa huduma katika eneo la Wilaya ya Kisumu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed ayaa bilaabay bixinta adeegyada heerka qaybta ee degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties chako chiwo kony e ward level e Kisumu County.

English: Elgon Kenya and SMACHS Foundation have established a model farm and vertical gardens at Nyanjega School to support 4K Clubs promoting agribusiness among young students
Kiswahili: Elgon Kenya na SMACHS Foundation wameanzisha shamba la mfano na bustani wima katika Shule ya Nyanjega ili kusaidia Vilabu vya 4K vinavyokuza biashara ya kilimo miongoni mwa wanafunzi wachanga.
Somali: Elgon Kenya iyo SMACHS Foundation waxay aasaaseen beero tusaale ah iyo beero toosan oo ku yaal Iskuulka Nyanjega si ay u taageeraan naadiyada 4K ee kor u qaada ganacsiga beeraha ee ardayda da'da yar
Dholuo: Elgon Kenya kod SMACHS Foundation osechako puodho mar ranyisi kod puothe mag piende e Nyanjega School mondo gichiw kony ne 4K Clubs ma jiwo ohala mag jopur e kind jopuonjre matindo

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service opens a gender desk offering free legal aid in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafungua ofisi ya kijinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisheria bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu furayaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah Gobolka Garissa.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Forest Service ochako ofis ma chiwo kony mar chike maonge chudo e gweng' mar Garissa.

English: NTSA warns residents of Uasin Gishu County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu juu ya kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: NTSA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu in ay kordhaan qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: NTSA osiemo jogweng' Uasin Gishu County kuom medruok mar chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: IEBC advises applicants in Nyandarua County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Nyandarua inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee la heli karo.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Nyandarua mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: DPP urges residents of Taita-Taveta County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DPP anawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuunga mkono kamati za ujenzi wa amani huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa wa ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Taita-Taveta inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda lagu saarayo nabadgelyada qaranka.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo jogweng'o mag Taita-Taveta County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi kuom loso kuwe.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to adopt research driven technologies to improve livelihoods and achieve food security Stay informed on innovations following the KALRO conference
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kutumia teknolojia zinazoendeshwa na utafiti ili kuboresha maisha na kufikia usalama wa chakula Endelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ubunifu kufuatia mkutano wa KALRO
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay qaataan tiknoolajiyado cilmi-baaris ku saleysan si loo horumariyo nolosha loona gaaro amniga cuntada. La soco hal-abuurnimada ka dib shirweynaha KALRO
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur koda jogo motudore gi weche mag ohala mondo oti gi teknoloji ma itiyogo e timo nonro mondo okony e medo ngima ji kendo chopo weche mag chiemo.

English: FAO advises farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: FAO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: FAO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Deworming children every six months improves their growth, energy levels, and school performance.
Kiswahili: Kutoa dawa za minyoo kwa watoto kila baada ya miezi sita huboresha ukuaji wao, viwango vya nishati, na utendaji wao shuleni.
Somali: Carruurta lixdii biloodba mar in la baabi'iyo cayayaanka waxay kordhiyaan koritaanka, tamarta, iyo waxqabadka dugsiga.
Dholuo: Nyithindo mang'eny medo bedo gi teko mar timo kamano bang' dweche auchiel, kendo timo kamano miyo gibedo gi nyak maber e skul.

English: Samburu and Baringo Rapid Needs Assessment, July 2023
Kiswahili: Tathmini ya Mahitaji ya Haraka ya Samburu na Baringo, Julai 2023
Somali: Qiimaynta Baahiyaha Degdegga ah ee Samburu iyo Baringo, Luulyo 2023
Dholuo: Nonro Mapiyo Dwaro Dwe mar Samburu kod Baringo, dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2023

Dholuo: TSC chudo mar dwe mar apar gi ariyo + 15% mar bonus ma ochul mapiyo.

English: AFA advises farmers in Mandera County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the August planting season.
Kiswahili: AFA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Agosti.
Somali: AFA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Mandera inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagyada si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: AFA nyiso jopur e county mar Mandera mondo otim lokruok e puothe mag puothe mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak kapok ochopo dwe mar Agost.

English: Kenya Red Cross launches a May awareness campaign on tobacco control across Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Mei juu ya udhibiti wa tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii May ee ka dhanka ah xakamaynta sigaarka ee gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Mei e wi thieth mar ndawa e alwora mar Elgeyo-Marakwet County.

English: Kwale County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kwale: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Juni 2023
Somali: Degmada Kwale: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kwale: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2023

English: Notice from KEMRI: free antenatal care clinics will run every October at designated health centres in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa KEMRI: kliniki za bure za utunzaji wa ujauzito zitaendeshwa kila Oktoba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid KEMRI: rugta daryeelka dhalmada ee bilaashka ah ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Oktoobar kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMRI: Klinike mag rito nyithindo kapok onyuol biro tiyo dwe mar Oktoba higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e Kaunti mar Nyandarua.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service issues a cybersecurity alert on phishing messages affecting residents of Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya imetoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya ujumbe wa udanganyifu unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu soo saaray digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan fariimaha phishing ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Forest Service ogolo siem mar sirkal mar cybersecurity e wi ote mag phishing makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Baringo County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuwasilisha hati za maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga loo dhigay si loo qaabeeyo dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jogweng' Baringo County mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: The World Bank is collaborating with the Ministry of Agriculture to advance the Digital Agriculture Roadmap Stay informed for updates on program opportunities
Kiswahili: Benki ya Dunia inashirikiana na Wizara ya Kilimo kuendeleza Mwongozo wa Kilimo wa Kidijitali Kaa na taarifa kuhusu fursa za programu.
Somali: Bangiga Adduunka wuxuu la shaqeynayaa Wasaaradda Beeraha si loo horumariyo Khariidadda Beeraha Dijitaalka ah La soco si aad u hesho warar cusub oo ku saabsan fursadaha barnaamijyada
Dholuo: Banki mar Piny tiyo gi migawo mar Agriculture mondo okony e loso chenro mar timo dongruok e yore mag digital agriculture

English: Try sweet potatoes farmjng in new hydroponic technology that uses water and other containers in small spaces especially town dwellers.
Kiswahili: Jaribu kukuza viazi tamu katika teknolojia mpya ya hydroponic ambayo hutumia maji na vyombo vingine katika maeneo madogo hasa wenyeji wa miji.
Somali: Isku day beerashada baradho macaan oo leh tikniyoolajiyad cusub oo hydroponic ah oo isticmaala biyaha iyo weelasha kale ee meelaha yaryar gaar ahaan dadka deggan magaalooyinka.
Dholuo: Tem timo puothe mamit gi teknoloji manyien mar hydroponic ma tiyo gi pi kod gik mamoko e kuonde matindo tindo, to moloyo joma odak e taonde.

English: Young girls who get early pregancy should be encouraged and be supported to carry one with their studies once they deliver
Kiswahili: Wasichana wachanga wanaopata ujauzito mapema wapaswa kutiwa moyo na kutegemezwa kubeba mimba zao baada ya kujifungua
Somali: Gabdhaha dhallinyarada ah ee uurka ka qaata waa in lagu dhiiri galiyaa loona taageeraa inay waxbarashadooda ku qaataan marka ay dhalmaan
Dholuo: Onego ojiw kendo ojiw nyiri ma nigi ich motelo mondo oting ' nyathi e skul bang ' nyuol

English: MSF Responds to Mpox outbreak in Mombasa, Kenya
Kiswahili: MSF Yajibu Mlipuko wa Mpox huko Mombasa, Kenya
Somali: MSF waxay ka jawaabtay cudurka Mpox ee ka dillaacay Mombasa, Kenya
Dholuo: MSF Oduoko Tuo Maduong' kuom Kuong'ruok mar Mpox e boma Mombasa, Kenya

English: CDC appeals to caregivers in Kilifi County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the September maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Septemba.
Somali: CDC waxay u baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Kilifi inay ka qeybgalaan maalinta bukaanka ee la qorsheeyay qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Sebtember.
Dholuo: CDC kwayo jorit e County mar Kilifi mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar klinik kaka achiel kuom chenro mar thieth mar mine e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Farmers are encouraged to participate in training programs focused on growing French beans to enhance food security Please seek local agricultural offices for training schedules and enrollment details
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kushiriki katika programu za mafunzo zinazolenga kukuza maharagwe ya Kifaransa ili kuimarisha usalama wa chakula Tafadhali tafuta ofisi za kilimo za ndani kwa ratiba za mafunzo na maelezo ya uandikishaji.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay ka qaybqaataan barnaamijyada tababarka ee diiradda lagu saaray beerashada canabka Faransiiska si loo xoojiyo amniga cuntada Fadlan la xiriir xafiisyada beeraha ee deegaanka si aad u hesho jadwalka tababarka iyo faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur mondo oriwre e tiegruok ma jiwo pidho puothe mag French mondo okony e miyo chiemo obed maber.

English: Office of the Auditor-General warns public officers in Mandera County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Mandera inay musuqmaasuq ku sameeyaan xafiisyada dowladda.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal man Mandera County ni kik giyud asoya e migepe ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds the public in Kirinyaga County that input on the county budget process is welcome this May.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba mchango katika mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti unakaribishwa Mei hii.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Kirinyaga in talooyinka ku saabsan habka miisaaniyadda gobolka ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha May.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette oparo ne ji duto e County mar Kirinyaga ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e dwe mar Mei.

English: State Department for TVET conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Kirinyaga County this July.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Julai hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha gobolka Kirinyaga bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State for TVET dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi migawo mar ombudsman e County ma Kirinyaga e dwe mar Julai.

English: Ministry of Education encourages residents of Narok County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Narok inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabtaan doorka garsoorka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo onon weche ma gin-go mar ndiko ji mondo ging'e tich mar ombudsman.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds the public in Busia County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Busia kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu dadka degmada Busia ku xasuusinayaa inay ka feejignaadaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service parone ji duto e county mar Busia ni mondo gibed motang' ne loso kuwe e piny.

English: Notice from KEMSA: skilled birth attendance clinics will run every December at designated health centres in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa KEMSA: kliniki za mahudhurio ya uzazi zenye ujuzi zitaendeshwa kila Desemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Tana River.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid KEMSA: rugta caafimaadka ee dhallaanka ee xirfadlayaasha ah ayaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Diseembar ee kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo magacaabay ee degmada Tana River.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMSA: Klinike mag rito nyuol ma nigi lony biro tiyo e dwe mar Desemba higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e taon mar Tana River County.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development promotes water harvesting among farmers in Nyamira County as part of the July climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inakuza uvunaji wa maji miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Julai.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa kor u qaadeysa goosashada biyaha beeraleyda degmada Nyamira iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka u adkeynta cimilada ee bisha July.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo choko pi e kind jopur e County mar Nyamira kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi mar dwe mar Julai.

English: EACC urges eligible citizens in Tana River County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Wilaya ya Tana River kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Tana River inay ka qaybqaataan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro mar yiero e taon mar Tana River County mondo oriwre gi jogo madwaro yiero.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges motorists and pedestrians in Mandera County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Mandera inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay adeegsadaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee socodka si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira qaraxyada dabka.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo joidh mtokni kod jowuoth e county mar Mandera mondo oluw tong' mar wuoth kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe mondo gikwed hinyruok mar mach.

English: Prepare your children about the child are are about to deliver comimg so as to reduce wrangles and bond their relationship
Kiswahili: Kuandaa watoto wako kuhusu mtoto wako ni karibu kutoa comimg ili kupunguza ugomvi na kuunganisha uhusiano wao
Somali: Diyaari caruurtaada ku saabsan ilmaha ayaa ku saabsan in ay bixiyaan comimg si loo yareeyo khilaafaadka iyo xidhiidhka xiriirka
Dholuo: Ikri nyithindi ne nyathi ma biro nyuolo mondo kik gibed gi ywaruok e kindgi kendo gibed gi winjruok maber gi nyawadgi

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds residents of Busia County that water harvesting improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kwamba uvunaji wa maji unaboresha uzalishaji wa muda mrefu wa shamba.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Busia in goosashada biyaha ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service parone jogweng' mar County mar Busia ni yuto mar pi kelo nyak mar puodho kuom kinde malach.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public in Nyandarua County about the importance of hypertension awareness for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuhusu umuhimu wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Nyandarua muhiimadda ay leedahay wacyiga cadaadiska dhiig karka ee caafimaadka guryaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji duto e County mar Nyandarua kuom ber mar miyo ji ong'e ni tuwo mar hypertension en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges motorists and pedestrians in Vihiga County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kufunga na kutunza vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Vihiga inay guryahooda rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa dhacdooyinka la xiriira qaraxyada dabka.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo dereba mag mtoka kod joma wuotho gi tiende e gweng' mar Vihiga mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko mach e utegi kendo giti matek mondo gikwed hinyruok mag yiengni.

English: UK promotes bovine tuberculosis vaccination to protect cattle.
Kiswahili: Uingereza inakuza chanjo ya kifua kikuu cha ng'ombe ili kulinda ng'ombe.
Somali: UK waxay dhiirrigelisay tallaalka cudurka 'tuberculosis bovine' si loo ilaaliyo lo'da.
Dholuo: Piny mar UK jiwo thieth mar tuo mar dhoho mar dhok mondo orit dhok.

English: Huduma Kenya warns public officers in Garissa County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa dhidi ya udanganyifu wa fedha za umma.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee gobolka Garissa inay ka xishoodaan dhaqaale dawladeed.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Garissa ni kik giti gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo e yo marach.

English: Kenya Medical Association calls on parents in Homa Bay County to have children under five screened for measles during the November outreach.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuwapima watoto chini ya miaka mitano surua wakati wa mawasiliano ya Novemba.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqayaa waalidiinta gobolka Homa Bay in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cirbadaha inta lagu gudajiro bisha November.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association okwayo jonyuol e Homa Bay County mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Novemba.

English: HELB reminds parents in Samburu County that free day secondary education registration is open this August.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba usajili wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo umefunguliwa Agosti hii.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta gobolka Samburu in diiwaangelinta dugsiga dhexe ee bilaashka ah ay furan tahay bisha August.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa jonyuol e county mar Samburu ni somo mar sekondari mar odiechieng' maonge chudo osechakore e dwe mar Agost.

English: State Department for TVET encourages residents of Mandera County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on voter registration.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabtaan diiwaangelinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo jogweng'o mag Mandera County mondo onyisgi weche ma giduto giduto giseyudo mondo ging'e weche duto motudore gi kad mar josiasa.

English: Kenya Red Cross announces NHIF/SHA claims support for residents of Wajir County starting this July.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya watangaza NHIF/SHA kudai msaada kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kuanzia Julai hii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa ku dhawaaqday in NHIF/SHA ay sheegato taageero loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Wajir laga bilaabo bisha July.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross olando ni NHIF/SHA dwaro kony ne jogweng' mar Wajir County kochakore Julai.

English: EACC reminds the public in Turkana County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: EACC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Turkana in sheegashada xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid bilaash ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: EACC paronwa ji duto e County mar Turkana ni lando wach tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'.

English: KALRO reminds residents of Kakamega County that organic farming improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba kilimo hai kinaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba la muda mrefu.
Somali: KALRO waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega in beeraha dabiiciga ah uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: KALRO paronwa jogweng' Kakamega County ni pur ma nigi yien ma ok oketie yien miyo puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: Universities Fund reminds needy students in Kilifi County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kwamba maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xasuusinayaa ardayda u baahan degmada Kilifi in deeqaha waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay codsiyada ardayda baahan ay dhowaan dhammaadaan.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa jopuonjre man gi chan e gweng' mar Kilifi ni tuke mag somo ne jopuonjre ma nigi chan biro rumo machiegni.

English: KEPHIS reminds livestock keepers in Tana River County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha ee degmada Tana River in ay u soo sheegaan xayawaanada buka xafiiska xayawaanka ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KEPHIS parone jorit jamni e taon mar Tana River County ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo kama thieth mar jamni nitie mondo girit ngima jamni.

English:
It's Okay to Talk. June is Men_x0092_'s Mental Health Month.

Men, it's okay to talk about your mental health. Sharing your feelings can be the first step toward healing
Kiswahili: Wanaume, ni sawa kuzungumza juu ya afya yako ya akili. Kushiriki hisia zako inaweza kuwa hatua ya kwanza kuelekea uponyaji
Somali:
Waa caadi in la hadlo. Juun waa Bisha Caafimaadka Dhimirka ee Men_x0092_.

Rag, waa caadi inaad ka hadasho caafimaadkaaga dhimirka. La wadaagista dareenkaaga waxay noqon kartaa tallaabada ugu horreysa ee bogsashada.
Dholuo:
Ok en gimaber mondo wawuo. Dwe mar Jun en dwe mar Rieko mar Paro mar Chwo.

Jomachuwo, ok en gima rach wuoyo kuom ngima mar paro. Chiwo kaka iwinjo nyalo bedo okang’ mokwongo mar yudo thieth

English: Notice: State Department for TVET opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay furaysaa codsiyada deeqda waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan ardayda ku jira degmada Nairobi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar State Department for TVET oyawo kwayo mag somo ne jopuonjre man gi dwaro mag somo e County mar Nairobi.

English: KMTC reminds schools in Nyamira County to strengthen child protection in schools this July.
Kiswahili: KMTC inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuimarisha ulinzi wa watoto shuleni Julai hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Nyamira inay xoojiyaan ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: KMTC oparo ne skunde man Nyamira County mondo oteg rit mar nyithindo e skunde e dwe mar Julai.

English: Marsabit County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Marsabit: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2022
Somali: Degmada Marsabit: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Marsabit: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar adek higa mar 2022

English: Kenya Medical Association appeals to caregivers in Isiolo County to visit their nearest maternity wing as part of the March maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Machi.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ka codsadaa daryeelayaasha degmada Isiolo inay soo booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow sida qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association ogwelo jorit e gweng' mar Isiolo mondo odhi olimgi ka gin machiegni gi kama giyudoe nyithindo e dwe mar Mach.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds schools in Kajiado County to strengthen school infrastructure safety this April.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuimarisha usalama wa miundombinu ya shule Aprili hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa iskuulada degmada Kajiado ku xasuusinaya inay xoojiyaan ammaanka kaabayaasha dugsiga bisha April.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne skunde mag Kajiado County mondo omed jiwo ritruok mar chenro mag tiegruok mag skul e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: NTSA opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Wilaya ya West Pokot.
Somali: Ogsoonow: NTSA waxay furaysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya taageero maskaxeed iyo bulsho Galbeedka Gobolka Pokot.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NTSA ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony e weche mag pach ji e West Pokot County.

English: KEPHIS reminds residents of Machakos County that conservation tillage improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba kilimo cha uhifadhi kinaboresha tija ya shamba la muda mrefu.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos in beerashada ilaalinta ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: KEPHIS paronwa jogweng'o mag Machakos County ni chwoyo puothe e yor ritruok medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health warns of increased cholera risk in Lamu County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya kipindupindu katika Kaunti ya Lamu na inashauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ka digtay kororka halista cudurka kolera ee Gobolka Lamu waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar oganda: Ministry of Health osiemo ji kuom medruok mar tuo mar cholera e County mar Lamu kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore mar thieth.

English: TVET advises students in Wajir County to collect materials from the county education office to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Wajir kukusanya vifaa kutoka ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Somali: TVET waxay ardayda degmada Wajir kula talineysaa inay ka soo ururiyaan xogta xafiiska waxbarashada ee degmada si ay u helaan buugaag waxbarasho iyo waxyaabo waxbarasho.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jopuonjre e gweng' mar Wajir mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar tiegruok mar gweng'no mondo giyud buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok.

English: DPP urges the public in Garissa County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: DPP inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: DPP waxay ugu baaqeysaa shacabka degmada Garissa inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qof kasta oo ka dambeeya kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo ji duto e County mar Garissa mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo weche ma nyiso ni ne nitie weche mag phishing.

English: KNEC urges parents and teachers in Busia County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Busia kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Busia inay u soo sheegaan maamulka iskuulka wixii arrimo ah oo ku saabsan amniga.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e gweng' mar Busia mondo onyis jotend skul wach moro amora motudore gi ritruok.

English: KRA reminds voters in Kwale County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kwale kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya kusajili wapiga Kura.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Kwale inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor diiwaangelintii codbixisayaasha.
Dholuo: KRA oparo ne josiasa man Kwale County ni mondo gidhi e centre man machiegni ahinya mar IEBC kapok gidonjo e register mar joma oyiero.

English: Notice: KICD announces school feeding programme enrollment dates for schools in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa programu ya kulisha shule kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiyada degmada Nandi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KICD olando tarik mag dhi e skunde mag Nandi County.

English: The government could explore supporting nascent industries to produce competitive products that can access the export market. This could include investing in ...
Kiswahili: Serikali inaweza kuchunguza kusaidia viwanda vichanga ili kuzalisha bidhaa shindani zinazoweza kufikia soko la nje. Hii inaweza kujumuisha kuwekeza katika ...
Somali: Dowladdu waxay sahamin kartaa taageerada warshadaha soo koraya si ay u soo saaraan badeecooyin tartan rasmi ah oo marin u heli kara suuqa dhoofinta.
Dholuo: Sirkal nyalo manyo yore mag konyo ohala manyien mag loso gik makelo piem ma nyalo chopo e ohala mag ohala.

English: Notice: IEBC announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Kilifi.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IEBC ogolo chenro mar dhi e skunde mag Kilifi mondo giyud tiegruok ma onge chudo.

English: COMESA informs maize farmers in Isiolo County of new market linkage opportunities this April.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawafahamisha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Aprili hii.
Somali: COMESA waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Isiolo fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: COMESA nyiso jopur mag kodhi e gweng' mar Isiolo e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar April.

English: Celebrations as Kenya surpasses the WHO target with exclusive breastfeeding rates rising above 50%; commitment extended to sustain improvements.
Kiswahili: Sherehe huku Kenya ikizidi lengo la WHO huku viwango vya unyonyeshaji pekee vikiongezeka zaidi ya 50%; ahadi imeongezwa ili kudumisha maboresho.
Somali: Xafladaha Kenya ayaa ka sarreeya bartilmaameedka WHO iyadoo heerarka naasnuujinta gaarka loo leeyahay ay kor u kacayso 50%; ballanqaadka la kordhiyay si loo sii wado hagaajinta.
Dholuo: Nyasi mag Kenya medo kalo tong' mar WHO ka kwan mar nyithindo makedo gi nyithindo makwayo gi minegi osemedore mokalo 50%; iketo chenro mar timo dongruok mosiko.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Turkana County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay yareeyaan qaadashada cusbada iyo sonkorta si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osiemo jogweng' Turkana County mondo giketh chamo mor kod sukari mondo kik tuoche ma inyalo geng'e landre.

English: KALRO urges cattle farmers in Kilifi County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawataka wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa Newcastle vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da ee degmada Kilifi inay xoolahooda tallaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo ka dib kiisaska cudurka Newcastle ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur mag jamni e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo ogeng'gi e kuonde moketi mag chwoyo jamni bang' ka osenyis ni gin gi tuo mar Newcastle.

English: OGP advises residents of Nairobi County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: OGP inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: OGP waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogweng' Nairobi County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport services.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development invites youth in Narok County to enroll for tailoring and design training this September.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Narok kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni Septemba hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada ayaa ku casuumay dhalinyarada degmada Narok inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka qaabeynta iyo naqshadeynta bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ogwelo rowere manie Narok County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko e dwe mar Septemba.

English: State Department for TVET urges residents of Nandi County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nandi inay isdiiwaangaliyaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan fasallada akhrista dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Nandi mondo odonj e program mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo mondo giyud konyruok kuom tiegruok mar somo kod somo.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Machakos County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu soo saaray digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Machakos.
Dholuo: Rapar: Kenya Forest Service ogolo siem mar sirkal e wi weche mag cybersecurity e wi chenro mag ohala ma ketho joma odak e county mar Machakos.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Isiolo County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya wilaya ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya ua.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan bixinta adeegyada degmada.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng' Isiolo County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche ma timore e wi tij lendo.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges residents of Kericho County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta deegaanka iyada oo la adeegsanayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo jogweng' Kericho County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano nikech ji medo keto pachgi kuom chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: NDMA reminds the public in Garissa County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Garissa inay ka feejignaadaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: NDMA parone ji duto e County mar Garissa ni gibed motang' gi chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: Notice: TVET opens applications for textbooks and learning materials for learners in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inafungua maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay u furaysaa codsiyada buugaagta iyo qalabka wax lagu barto ardayda degmada Garissa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET chako tiyo gi buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok ne joma puonjore e gweng' mar Garissa.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will distribute certified coffee seed to farmers in Trans Nzoia County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Wanyama itagawanya mbegu za kahawa zilizothibitishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia mwezi huu wa Julai.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa qeybin doonta abuurka kafeega ee la caddeeyay beeraleyda Gobolka Trans Nzoia bisha Luulyo ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Mumbego biro pogo kodhi molony ne jopur e Trans Nzoia County e dwe mar Julai.

English: State Department for TVET reminds needy students in Kakamega County that school laptops under the digital literacy programme applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya maombi ya programu ya kusoma na kuandika ya kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan Gobolka Kakamega in barnaamijyada laptop-yada dugsiga ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET oparo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni kompyuta mag skul manie program mar digital literacy application chiegni rumo.

English: Kenya Dairy Board urges dairy cows farmers in Baringo County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported rabies cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawataka wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya kichaa cha mbwa vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Baringo inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska cadho la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur ma pidho dhok e gweng' mar Baringo mondo ochiw ripot ne jamni matuo man machiegni gi kama thieth mar dhok yudoree bang'e.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds the public in Laikipia County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay dadka degmada Laikipia ku xasuusineysaa inay ka feejignaadaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne ji duto e county mar Laikipia ni gibed motang' gi chenro mag chiwo siem ne ji chon.

English: It is good not to be good!
Kiswahili: Ni vizuri kuwa si mzuri!
Somali: Way fiicantahay inaadan fiicnayn!
Dholuo: En gima ber ka ng'ato ok tim maber!

English: Teachers Service Commission encourages residents of Nyeri County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kukaa na habari juu ya ugatuzi.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay ka qaybgalaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada si ay uga warqabaan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jogweng' Nyeri County mondo oriwgi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi kaka ibiro chiwgi.

English: DPP urges the community in Nairobi County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb fraud.
Kiswahili: DPP anaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia udanganyifu.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Nairobi inay ka warbixiyaan waxqabadka shakiga ah xarunta booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo khiyaamooyinka.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo oganda man Nairobi County mondo ochiw ripot mar gik ma chando ji e stesen mar polise man machiegni mondo omonj joma wuondore.

English: Enhance vaccination and treatment against reported livestock diseases, and strengthen disease surveillance.
Kiswahili: Kuimarisha chanjo na matibabu dhidi ya magonjwa ya mifugo yaliyoripotiwa, na kuimarisha ufuatiliaji wa magonjwa.
Somali: Kordhinta tallaalka iyo daaweynta cudurrada xoolaha ee la soo sheegay, iyo xoojinta kormeerka cudurrada.
Dholuo: Medore thieth kod thieth mar tuoche mag jamni ma osehul, kendo medo jiwo rito tuoche.

English: SHA reminds the public in Kisumu County that reporting embezzlement of public funds is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa fedha za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kisumu in warbixinta xadgudubka lacagaha dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: SHA paronwa ji duto e County mar Kisumu ni lando miriambo mag pesa mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Kenya Gazette advises residents of Mombasa County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e- Citizen.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan diiwaangelinta e-citizen.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette nyiso ji modak e County mar Mombasa mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro dhi e e - Citizen registration.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces NHIF/SHA claims support for residents of Makueni County starting this July.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatangaza NHIF/SHA inadai msaada kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kuanzia Julai hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhawaaqday in NHIF/SHA ay taageero u sheegtay dadka deggan degmada Makueni laga bilaabo bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche lando ni NHIF/SHA biro chiwo kony ne jogweng' Makueni County kochakore dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will conduct a pest and disease management workshop for farmers in Bungoma County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itafanya warsha ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan xakamaynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada beeraleyda degmada Bungoma bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Dairy Board biro timo chokruok mar rieyo tuoche kod tuoche ne jopur man Bungoma County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: In 2024, the Marchâ€“Aprilâ€“May floods affected around 410,000 people, claimed 315 lives, and caused damage amounting to 187 billion Kenyan ShillingsÂ¹.
Kiswahili: Mnamo 2024, mafuriko ya Machi-Aprili-Mei yaliathiri takriban watu 410,000, na kupoteza maisha ya 315, na kusababisha uharibifu wa Shilingi bilioni 187 za KenyaÂ¹.
Somali: Sanadkii 2024, daadadkii bishii Maarso - Abriil - waxay saameeyeen qiyaastii 410,000 oo qof, waxayna galaafteen nolosha 315 qof, waxayna sababeen burbur gaaray 187 bilyan oo Shilinka Kenya ah.
Dholuo: E higa mar 2024, pi ma ne oumo piny e dwe mar adek nyaka dwe mar abich ne oketho ji madirom 410,000, ne onego ji 315, kendo ne okelo ketho ma romo dola bilionde 187 mag Kenya.

English: Ministry of Education announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Kisii County this January.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kisii Januari hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta waxyaabaha barashada digitalka ah ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Kisii bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok mar piny owacho olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag digital maonge chudo e skunde man Kisii County e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada iskuulada guud ahaan Degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj chako chenro mar rito nyithindo e skunde e skul duto e County mar Vihiga.

English: Drought and conflict force 80,000 to flee Somalia for Kenyaâ€™s Dadaab refugee camps
Kiswahili: Ukame na migogoro yawalazimu watu 80,000 kutoroka Somalia na kuelekea katika kambi za wakimbizi za Dadaab nchini Kenya.
Somali: Abaaraha iyo colaadaha ayaa ku qasbay 80,000 oo qof inay ka cararaan Soomaaliya una gudbaan xeryaha qaxootiga ee Dhadhaab ee Kenya
Dholuo: Oro kod lweny omiyo ji 80,000 oringo owuok e piny Somalia mondo gidhi e kambi mag jolweny ma iluongo ni Dadaab e piny Kenya

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds schools in Embu County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this September.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inakumbusha shule za Kaunti ya Embu kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Septemba hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada Waxbarashada ayaa xusuusinaya dugsiyada degmada Embu inay xoojiyaan adeegyada hagista iyo la-talinta bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne skunde mag Embu County mondo omed jiwo kendo chiwo kony e dwe mar Septemba.

English: E-Citizen reminds voters in Kisii County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kisii kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha usajili wa IEBC kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Kisii inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa jogweng' Kisii mondo olim kama ichikoe ji ne IEBC motelo ne kalenda mar yiero.

English: Kenya Dairy Board promotes conservation tillage among farmers in Turkana County as part of the April climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inakuza kilimo cha uhifadhi miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Turkana kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Aprili.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa beerashada ilaalinta beeraleyda degmada Turkana iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka adkeysiga cimilada ee Abriil.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo puodho mar ritruok e kind jopur e county mar Turkana kaka achiel kuom chenro mar April mar kedo gi lokruok e kit yamo.

English: DCI warns residents of Laikipia County about a rise in identity theft and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia juu ya kuongezeka kwa wizi wa kitambulisho na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: DCI waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia kororka xadgudubka aqoonsiga waxayna kula talineysaa shacabka inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax falin.
Dholuo: DCI osiemo jogweng' Laikipia County kuom dongruok mar kuo mar kitgi kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: Farmers are advised to stay informed on shifting agricultural market trends driven by emerging economies particularly in oilseeds as outlined in the OECD FAO Agricultural Outlook 2024 2033 report
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa kuwa na habari kuhusu mabadiliko ya mwelekeo wa soko la kilimo unaotokana na uchumi unaoibukia hasa katika mbegu za mafuta kama ilivyoainishwa katika ripoti ya OECD FAO Agricultural Outlook 2024 2033.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagula talinayaa inay la socdaan isbeddelada suuqa beeraha ee ay sababayaan dhaqaalaha soo koraya, gaar ahaan abuurka saliidda, sida lagu qeexay warbixinta OECD FAO Agricultural Outlook 2024 2033
Dholuo: Ojiwo jopur mondo omed ng'eyo lokruok ma timore e ohala mag jopur ma wuok e pinje ma dongo, to moloyo e olembe mag mo kaka ma oket e ripot mar FAO Agricultural Outlook 2024 2033 mar OECD

English: Absorbing Climate Shocks and Easing Conflict in Kenyaâ€™s Rift Valley
Kiswahili: Kuchukua Mishtuko ya Hali ya Hewa na Kupunguza Migogoro katika Bonde la Ufa la Kenya
Somali: Qaadashada Musiibooyinka Cimilada iyo Yaraynta Khilaafaadka Dooxada Rift ee Kenya
Dholuo: Kuong'ruok mar Kido mar Piny kod Kuong'ruok mar Lweny e Gode mar Rift e piny Kenya

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds schools in Nyamira County to strengthen inclusion of learners with disabilities this March.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inazikumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuimarisha ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu mwezi huu wa Machi.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu iskuulada degmada Nyamira xusuusinayaa inay xoojiyaan ka mid noqoshada ardayda naafada ah bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne skunde man Nyamira County mondo omed jiwo jopuonjre ma nigi midekre e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: EACC opens voter registration centres in Narok County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inafungua vituo vya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Narok Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay furaysaa xarumaha diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee Gobolka Narok bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: EACC chako timo chenro mar ndiko ji e kaunti mar Narok e dwe mar Mach.

English: Ministry of Health launches a December awareness campaign on food safety across Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Desemba juu ya usalama wa chakula katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay billowday olole wacyiga ah bishii Diseembar oo ku saabsan badbaadada cuntada ee degmada Laikipia.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health osechako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Desemba e wi ritruok mar chiemo e County duto mar Laikipia.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageerada soo kabashada xadgudubka maandooriyaha ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Kwale.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tiyo gi yedhe mamero yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Kwale.

English: Upgraded polio vaccine being administered. Some mothers complain of â€˜seriousâ€™ symptoms. Ministry says symptoms, reactions are normal
Kiswahili: Maambukizi ya chanjo ya polio yameboreshwa. Baadhi ya akina mama wanalalamika juu ya dalili mbaya. Wizara inasema dalili, athari ni ya kawaida
Somali: Tallaalka dabaysha oo la casriyeeyay ayaa la bixinayaa. Hooyooyinka qaar ayaa ka cabanaya "calaamado halis ah". Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay in calaamadaha iyo falcelintu ay caadi yihiin
Dholuo: Chanjo mar polio ma olosi maber imiyo ji. Moko kuom mon ngâ€TMur gi ranyisi mag â€ ̃mapekâ€TM. Od tich wacho ni ranyisi kod dwoko gin gik ma kare

English: Huduma Kenya reminds the public in Lamu County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this October.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Lamu kwamba ushiriki katika mashauriano ya sera za umma unakaribishwa Oktoba hii.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Lamu in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya oparo ne ji duto e County mar Lamu ni ji duto nyalo chiwo paro e wi chenro mag siasa e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: OGP reminds residents of Kisii County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: OGP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii in ka qaybgalka maamulaha degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: OGP oparo ne jogweng' Kisii County ni tudruok gi jotelo mag gwenge maggi miyo sirkal bedo gi loch maber.

English: HELB encourages out-of-school children in Bomet County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under free primary education.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Bomet kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: HELB waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Bomet inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e county mar Bomet mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Embu County that access to free legal aid is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Embu kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisheria wa bure unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ee ka dhacay degmada Embu in la heli karo caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah oo lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe gero mag nindruok e county mar Embu ni thuolo mar yudo kony ma onge chudo yudore maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds residents of Vihiga County that conservation tillage improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba kilimo cha uhifadhi kinaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba la muda mrefu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga in beerashada ilaalinta ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service parone jogweng' mar County mar Vihiga ni chwoyo puothe e yor ritruok medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Turkana County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay biyo cabbiyaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit nyiso jogweng'o mag Turkana County mondo omak pi modho kapok gitiyo kode mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will open a coffee collection centre in Migori County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itafungua kituo cha kukusanya kahawa katika Kaunti ya Migori Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka ayaa furaya xarun lagu soo uruurinayo kafeega Degmada Migori bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Komiti mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro yawo ot mar choko chai e taon mar Migori e dwe mar Agost.

English: World Water Day: Salesian Missions highlights water projects that make clean, fresh water available in communities
Kiswahili: Siku ya Maji Duniani: Misheni za Salesian zinaangazia miradi ya maji ambayo hufanya maji safi na safi kupatikana katika jamii
Somali: Maalinta Biyaha Adduunka: Hawlgallada Salesian waxay iftiiminayaan mashaariicda biyaha ee ka dhigaya biyo nadiif ah oo cusub oo laga heli karo bulshooyinka

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties updates residents of Tana River County on progress of ward-level service delivery this July.

Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itasambaza mbegu za kahawa zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Desemba hii.

Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inafungua maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kwale.

English: By recognizing the humanity of individuals with mental illnesses, we can cultivate a more compassionate and understanding society. If you or someone you know needs psychosocial support, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at our toll-free number, 1199
Kiswahili: Kwa kutambua ubinadamu wa watu wenye magonjwa ya akili, tunaweza kukuza jamii yenye huruma na uelewa zaidi. Ikiwa wewe au mtu unayemjua anahitaji usaidizi wa kisaikolojia, tafadhali usisite kuwasiliana nasi kwa nambari yetu ya simu isiyolipishwa, 1199.

Dholuo: Ka wang'eyo kaka joma nigi tuoche mag obwongo chalo, wanyalo bedo gi chuny mar kecho ji kendo winjo pachgi maber. Kapo ni in kata ng'at ming'eyo dwaro kony kuom weche mag pach ji, kik iluor tudori kodwa gi namba mar 1199 maonge chudo.

English: Public health advisory: KEMSA warns of increased typhoid risk in Lamu County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMSA inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya matumbo katika Kaunti ya Lamu na inashauri umma kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na dawa kila usiku.

English: KNEC encourages residents of Samburu County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.

Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jogweng' county mar Samburu mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county mondo ging'e kaka ji biro tiyo gi bajet mag county.

Kiswahili: NPS inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kuunga mkono kamati za ujenzi wa amani huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa katika ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.

English: IEBC announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: IEBC inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kushughulikia vyeti vya kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Nandi.

Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Vihiga County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the June planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Juni.

Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur e County mar Vihiga mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochako chuoyo e dwe mar Jun.

English: KNEC urges youth in Bungoma County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Bungoma inay ka qaybqaataan munaasabadda dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo rowere mag Bungoma County mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gitimo gik ma biro timore ne oganda.

English: Notice: ODPP launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Taita-Taveta County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhanka ah gobolka Taita-Taveta bisha Agoosto.

English: CDC advises residents of Murang'a County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: CDC inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: CDC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay qaataan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: CDC nyiso jogweng' mar County mar Murang'a mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi ka gidwaro thieth mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development informs fish farmers in Marsabit County of new market linkage opportunities this December.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inafahamisha wakulima wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Desemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku wargelineysaa kalluumeysatada degmada Marsabit fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development olero ne jopur rech e county mar Marsabit thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: TVET reminds citizens in Kilifi County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Somali: Xusuusin: TVET waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Kilifi ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET paronwa raia mag Kilifi County e wi ratiro ma gin-go kaluwore gi chike mag sirkal.

English: Leaving common bean roots in the soil after harvest adds an extra 20-60kg of nitrogen per hectare, available for the next crop - equivalent to 3/4-2 free bags of urea. With good agricultural practices, common bean can yield over 800kg per acre.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuvuna, mizizi ya maharage hubakia kwenye udongo na huongeza kilo 20-60 zaidi za nitrojeni kwenye udongo kwa hekta moja, ambayo itatumika kwa zao litakalofuata - sawa na mifuko 3/4-2 zaidi ya urea. Kwa kutumia mbinu sahihi za kilimo bora cha maharage, mavuno yanaweza kuwa zaidi ya kilo 800 kwa ekari.
Somali: Marka la tago xididdada caadiga ah ee caanaha ee ciidda ka dib goosashada waxay ku dartaa 20-60 kg oo nitrogen ah halkii hektar, oo loo heli karo goosashada soo socota - oo u dhiganta 3/4-2 bacaha bilaashka ah ee urea.
Dholuo: Ka ng'ato oweyo tiend nyinyo e lowo bang' keyo, to omedo nitrogen ma romo kilo 20 - 60 e hekta ka hekta, ma nyalo yudore e cham ma biro - ma romre gi ng'injo mag urea ma romo 3/4 - 2.

English: Kenya Gazette advises residents of Kitui County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e- Citizen.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan diiwaangelinta e-citizen.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette nyiso jogweng' Kitui County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom websait mar e-Citizen sama gikwayo mondo gidonj e e - Citizen.

English: KEPHIS urges goats farmers in Isiolo County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported rabies cases.

Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur ma pidho diek e gweng' mar Isiolo mondo ogeng'e legi e kuonde moyier mag chwoyo diek bang' yudo weche mag rabies.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay bilawday barnaamij ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada iskuulada guud ahaan gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Education chako chenro mar rito nyithindo e skul e skunde duto mag Elgeyo-Marakwet County.

English: Notice: ODPP will hold a public participation forum on development planning forums in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta ee Gobolka Kwale.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: ODPP biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag dongruok e gweng' mar Kwale.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Samburu County about the importance of safe water storage for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuhusu umuhimu wa uhifadhi wa maji salama kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMSA waxay dadka degmada Samburu ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMSA oparo ne ji e county mar Samburu kuom ber mar kano pi maler e ngima joot.

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages residents of Homa Bay County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.

Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: FAO advises coffee producers in Baringo County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: FAO inashauri wazalishaji wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: FAO waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kafeega ee degmada Baringo inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: FAO nyiso jopur ma loso chai e gweng' mar Baringo mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur ka pok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds livestock keepers in Migori County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Migori kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu xasuusinayaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Migori inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska xayawaanada ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jorit jamni e county mar Migori ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni kodgi.

English: Office of the Auditor-General warns public officers in Makueni County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Makueni dhidi ya udanganyifu wa fedha za umma.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Makueni inay ka xishoodaan dhaqaale dawladeed.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Makueni ni kik giti gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo e yo marach.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds residents of Kisumu County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
