Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne jogweng' Kisumu County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo giti e kinde mag yiengni.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Kisii County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.

Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji duto e County mar Kisii ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mag ambulatori e kuonde moyier.

English: Teachers Service Commission conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in West Pokot County this April.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Aprili hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu qabtaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda gobolka ee Gobolka West Pokot bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda e dwe mar ang'wen mar higani e kaunti mar West Pokot County.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Lamu County about a rise in phishing messages and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inawaonya wakazi wa Wilaya ya Lamu juu ya kuongezeka kwa ujumbe wa udanganyifu na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ka digaya dadka deggan degmada Lamu in ay kordhaan fariimaha phishing waxayna dadka kula talinayaan inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng' Lamu County kuom wach medruok mar ote mag phishing kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development announces a free anthrax vaccination exercise for goats in Kakamega County this July.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo yatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kimeta kwa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Julai hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa ku dhawaaqday jimicsi tallaal ah oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay geedaha Gobolka Kakamega bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development olando chenro mar golo thieth mar anthrax ne diek e boma mar Kakamega e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: KRA opens a new service point for passport services in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: KRA inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogaysiis: KRA waxay furaysaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee Gobolka Kakamega.

English: Kenya Gazette updates residents of Wajir County on progress of ward-level service delivery this May.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawasilisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir juu ya maendeleo ya utoaji wa huduma kwa kiwango cha wilaya Mei hii.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Wajir ku wargeliyay horumarka adeegga degmooyinka bisha May.

Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Nairobi xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KUCCPS paronwa raia mag Nairobi County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo gi ji duto e bajet mar county.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds schools in Siaya County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this February.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Februari hii.

English: Kenya Medical Association announces SHA registration for residents of Kakamega County starting this May.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatangaza usajili wa SHA kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kuanzia Mei hii.

Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties launches the county integrated development plan in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa huzindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika Wilaya ya Tana River.

English: Public notice: KEMRI will host a free hand hygiene outreach in Kisumu County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMRI itaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Februari hii.

Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMRI biro timo kampen mar rito ler mar lwedo e gweng' mar Kisumu e dwe mar Februar.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties announces improved turnaround times for e-Citizen registration in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujiandikisha kwa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.

English: Notice: NDMA launches a cattle rustling prevention campaign in Tharaka-Nithi County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Februari hii.

English: Universities Fund encourages residents of Garissa County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kukaa na habari juu ya ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.

English: ODPP advises residents of Embu County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: ODPP inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations conducts a community briefing on community early-warning systems in Nyandarua County this January.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages mothers in Kisii County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kisii kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.

English: KUCCPS invites youth in Kitui County to enroll for electrical installation training this May.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kitui kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Mei hii.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General opens a new service point for passport services in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee Gobolka Mandera.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Jatelo Maduong' ochako tiyo gi ofis manyien mar Passport Services e gweng' mar Mandera.

English: Colombia is best livestock rearing techniques that reduces damage on climate.
Kiswahili: Colombia ni mbinu bora za ufugaji ambazo hupunguza uharibifu wa hali ya hewa.
Somali: Colombia waa farsamooyinka ugu fiican ee korinta xoolaha ee yareeya waxyeelada cimilada.
Dholuo: Piny Colombia en piny maberie moloyo e pidho jamni kendo mano miyo oketh alwora.

English: Notice: ODPP opens the electoral calendar centres in Bomet County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Bomet Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay furaysaa xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee degmada Bomet bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: ODPP chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e taon mar Bomet e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: FAO restricts movement of pigs in Nyamira County due to an anthrax outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO yazuia harakati za nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kutokana na mlipuko wa kimeta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa doofaarka degmada Nyamira sababo la xiriira cudurka anthrax.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: FAO ogeng'o wuoth mar le e County ma Nyamira nikech tuwo mar anthrax.

English: Malaria's gendered burden: Recent floods heighten risk for women, girls
Kiswahili: Mzigo wa Malaria kwa jinsia: Mafuriko ya hivi karibuni yaongeza hatari kwa wanawake na wasichana
Somali: Culeyska galmada ee Cudurka Malaria: Daadadkii ugu dambeeyay ayaa kordhinaya halista haweenka iyo gabdhaha
Dholuo: Chandruok mar tuo mar malaria nikech dichwo gi dhako: Ataro ma nyocha otimore miyo mon kod nyiri bedo gi hinyruok mang'eny

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Lamu County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Lamu Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhanka ah gobolka Lamu bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Lamu e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will conduct a pest and disease management workshop for farmers in Garissa County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itafanya warsha ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan xakamaynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada beeraleyda ee Gobolka Garissa bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEPHIS biro timo chokruok mar rieyo tuoche kod tuoche ne jopur e taon mar Garissa e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Kenya: Registered refugees and asylum-seekers (as of 30 June 2025)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Wakimbizi waliosajiliwa na wanaotafuta hifadhi (tangu 30 Juni 2025)
Somali: Kenya: Qaxootiga diiwaangashan iyo kuwa magangalyo doonka ah (laga bilaabo 30 Juun 2025)
Dholuo: Kenya: Jolweny ma ondiki nyinggi kod jogo madwaro dak (chakre tarik 30 dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2025)

English: KEMSA appeals to caregivers in Narok County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the May maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Narok kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya gari la afya ya uzazi la Mei.
Somali: KEMSA waxay u baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Narok inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee bisha Maajo.
Dholuo: KEMSA okwayo jorit e gweng' mar Narok mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongruok kaka achiel kuom chenro mar Mayo Maternal Health Drive.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations activates an emergency response plan for drought in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ukame katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada wuxuu soo saaray qorshe xaalad degdeg ah oo looga jawaabayo abaaraha gobolka Siaya.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Mumbni mag Criminal Investigations tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo nikech oro ma ne otimore e gweng' mar Siaya.

English: NTSA reminds mobile money users in Nandi County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid identity theft.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Nandi inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado in la xado aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: NTSA paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e county mar Nandi mondo ochiw ripot mar ote makelo hinyruok ne jatendgi mar tich mondo kik gikwed kwalo kitgi.

English: TVET encourages residents of Bungoma County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabtaan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo ong'e weche duto motudore gi ndiko joma oyiero mondo ging'e tich mar ombudsman.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises fish producers in Mandera County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inashauri wazalishaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kalluunka ee degmada Mandera inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur ma loso rech e county mar Mandera mondo oti gi nengo mar piny mosingi kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: State Department for TVET urges youth in Isiolo County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Isiolo inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada rayidka ah ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada rayidnimada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET ojiwo rowere man Isiolo County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok ochopo tije mag oganda.

English: IEBC announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: IEBC inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kuajiri kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa in la hagaajiyo waqtiga wareejinta shahaadada dhalashada ee degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: IEBC olando lokruok e seche mag timo tij loso barua mag nyuol e County mar Kericho.

English: Notice: NCPB will open a fish collection centre in Bomet County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itafungua kituo cha kukusanya samaki katika Kaunti ya Bomet Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay ka furi doontaa xarun ururinta kalluunka gobolka Bomet bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NCPB biro yawo kama ichokoe rech e taon mar Bomet e dwe mar Mei.

English: State Department for TVET urges parents and teachers in West Pokot County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta gobolka West Pokot inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e West Pokot County mondo omany namba mar kony mar nyithindo 116.

English: IEBC warns public officers in Siaya County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: IEBC inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: IEBC waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Siaya inay musuqmaasuqa ka qaataan xafiisyada dawladda.
Dholuo: IEBC chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Siaya kuom kawo asoya e migepe mag oganda.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges the public in Narok County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Kenya Red Cross inawasihi watu katika Kaunti ya Narok wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa shacabka degmada Narok inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada lacagta mobilada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ji duto e Narok County mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' weche mag wuondo pesa e simo.

English: COMESA advises farmers in Machakos County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: COMESA waxay kula talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Machakos inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e County ma Machakos mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: KUCCPS advises applicants in Mombasa County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kutembelea kituo cha mafunzo ya ufundi kilicho karibu zaidi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Mombasa inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee la heli karo.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Mombasa mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) confirms a cyclosporiasis outbreak alert for Tana River County. Residents are advised to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa cyclosporiasis kwa Kaunti ya Tana River. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ku saabsan faafitaanka cudurka cyclosporiasis ee degmada Tana River. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isticmaalaan shabaqa cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: SHA (Social Health Authority) osenyiso ni koro nitie masira mar cyclosporiasis e taon mar Tana River County.

English: COMESA advises fish producers in Siaya County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inashauri wazalishaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: COMESA waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kalluunka ee degmada Siaya inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: COMESA nyiso jopur ma loso rech e county mar Siaya mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur ka pok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Set boundaries and fuel your mind with positive vibes
Kiswahili: Weka mipaka na uchochee akili yako kuwa na hisia nzuri
Somali: Xaddido xuduudahaaga oo maskaxdaada ku dhiirrigeliya dareen wanaagsan
Dholuo: Ket tong' kendo ket pachi obed gi paro mowinjore

English: DCI urges the community in Vihiga County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb theft.
Kiswahili: DCI inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Vihiga inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shisheeyaha si looga hortago tuugada.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo ji duto manie County mar Vihiga mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo gikwed nek.

English: Announcement of launch of â€œENOUGHâ€ campaign which aims to end child hunger by expanding school meals, climate-smart agriculture, and nutrition advocacy.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la uzinduzi wa kampeni ya "INATOSHA" ambayo inalenga kukomesha njaa ya watoto kwa kupanua milo shuleni, kilimo kinachozingatia hali ya hewa, na utetezi wa lishe.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqista daahfurka ololaha "KU WANAAGSAN" kaas oo ujeedadiisu tahay in la soo afjaro gaajada carruurta iyadoo la ballaarinayo cuntada dugsiga, beeraha cimilada ku habboon, iyo u doodista nafaqada.
Dholuo: Olando mar chako kampen mar â€œENOUGHâ€ ma nigi gombo mar tieko kech mar nyithindo kuom medo chiemo mag skul, pur ma rito piny, kod lando chiemo ma nigi gik ma konyo e ringruok.

English: Effective management encompasses climate-resilient cities, sustainable farming, better water systems, and stronger regional cooperation to support communities in hotter conditions.
Kiswahili: Usimamizi unaofaa unajumuisha miji inayostahimili hali ya hewa, kilimo endelevu, mifumo bora ya maji, na ushirikiano thabiti wa kikanda ili kusaidia jamii zilizo katika hali ya joto zaidi.
Somali: Maareynta wax ku oolka ah waxay ka kooban tahay magaalooyin u adkeysan kara cimilada, beerashada waarta, nidaamyada biyaha oo wanaagsan, iyo iskaashi goboleed oo xooggan si loo taageero bulshooyinka ku jira xaaladaha kulul.
Dholuo: Oboke mabeyo oriwo bombe ma nyalo geng’o ng’ich mar piny, pur ma nyalo rito piny, yore mabeyo mag pi, kod riwruok motegno e kind kuonde mopogore opogore mondo okony jodak ma ni e piny ma ng’ich ahinya.

English: I am grateful to have delivered safely and to have a healthy baby," says Leaungokiok, cradling her daughter.
Kiswahili: Ninashukuru kujifungua salama na kupata mtoto mwenye afya njema," anasema Leaungokiok, akimkumbatia bintiye.
Somali: "Aad ayaan ugu mahadcelinayaa inaan si nabad ah u dhalay iyo inaan ilmo caafimaad qaba dhalo," ayay tiri Leaungokiok, iyadoo korsanaysa gabadheeda.
Dholuo: Amor mar nyuolo maber kendo bedo gi nyathi mangima," Leaungokiok wacho, ka oting'o nyare.

English: IEBC reminds the public in Isiolo County that reporting embezzlement of public funds is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: IEBC inakumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya Isiolo kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa fedha za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Isiolo in warbixinta xadgudubka lacagaha dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: IEBC parone ji duto manie Isiolo County ni chiwo ripot mar ketho pesa mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Notice: TSC launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay bilawday barnaamij ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada iskuulada guud ahaan degmada Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: TSC chako chenro mar rito nyithindo e skunde e skul duto mag Lamu County.

English: Pregnant women should consume a balanced diet rich in iron, protein, and vitamins to support fetal development and maternal health.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanapaswa kula lishe bora yenye madini ya chuma, protini, na vitamini ili kusaidia ukuaji wa fetasi na afya ya mama.
Somali: Dumarka uurka leh waa inay cuntaan cunto isku dheelitiran oo hodan ku ah birta, borotiinka, iyo fitamiinada si ay u taageeraan horumarka ilmaha iyo caafimaadka hooyada.
Dholuo: Mon ma nigi ich onego obed gi chiemo moromo ma oting'o chuma, protini, kod vitamin mang'eny mondo gimi nyathi odag maber kendo obed gi ngima maber.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Horumarinta Manhajka Kenya wuxuu ku dhawaaqay taariikhda diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ee dugsiyada degmada Nandi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development olando tarik mag somo e skunde mag Nandi County.

English: Sunken eyes, dry body and inadequate urine is sign of dehydration. Gige children water, and seek for medical attention
Kiswahili: Macho yaliyoshuka, mwili uliokauka na mkojo usiofaa ni ishara ya kutokuwa na maji.
Somali: Indhaha ku dhuuman, jirka qalalan iyo cirbadda aan ku filnayn waxay calaamad u yihiin biyo la'aanta.
Dholuo: Wenge mopong' gi pi, ringruok ma otwo, kod del ma onge pi nyiso ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar dehydration.

English: The Ministry of ICT reminds citizens that all eCitizen payments are automated. Do not send money to personal numbers for services.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya TEHAMA inawakumbusha raia kwamba malipo yote ya kielektroniki ni otomatiki. Usitume pesa kwa nambari za kibinafsi kwa huduma.
Somali: Wasaaradda ICT waxay xasuusinaysaa muwaadiniinta in dhammaan lacagaha eCitizen-ka si otomaatig ah loo bixiyo. Ha u dirin lacag lambarrada shaqsiga ah adeegyada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar ICT paro ne jopiny ni chudo duto mag eCitizen itimo gi otomatik. Ok onego ior pesa e namba mag ng’ato ka ng’ato mondo otimnegi gik moko.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kiambu County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kutafuta msaada katika nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu zaidi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Kiambu inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e gweng' mar Kiambu mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: COMESA urges dairy cows farmers in Marsabit County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported rabies cases.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawataka wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya kichaa cha mbwa vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Marsabit inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow kadib kiisaska xanaaqa la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur ma pidho dhok e gweng' mar Marsabit mondo ochiw ripot ne jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar dhok man machiegni kodgi bang' yudo weche mag rabies.

English: All cooperative societies must file their annual returns by June 30 2025 to avoid deregistration Compliance is mandatory as per the Cooperative Societies Act
Kiswahili: Vyama vyote vya ushirika lazima viwasilishe marejesho yao ya kila mwaka kabla ya tarehe 30 Juni 2025 ili kuepuka kufutwa kwa usajili. Uzingatiaji ni lazima kulingana na Sheria ya Vyama vya Ushirika.
Somali: Dhammaan ururada iskaashatada waa inay soo gudbijiyaan soo celintooda sanadlaha ah ka hor Juun 30, 2025 si looga fogaado in la joojiyo diiwaangelinta. U hoggaansanaanta waa waajib sida ku cad Xeerka Ururada Iskaashatada
Dholuo: Riwruok duto mag riwruoge ma loso ohala nyaka chop tarik 30 dwe mar Jun 2025 mondo kik gikwed weyo riwruok mar oganda ma loso ohala.

English: IEBC reminds voters in Kisii County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kisii kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu zaidi cha IebC kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Kisii in ay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta Iebc ee ugu dhow ka hor inta aan la helin nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: IEBC parone jogweng' Kisii mondo olim kama ichikoe ji mondo okonygi ka pok giyudo thuolo mar timo yiero.

English: A key part of this progress has been the transition to individual-level reporting through the WHO Global Antimicrobial Resistance and Use Surveillance System (GLASS).
Kiswahili: Sehemu muhimu ya maendeleo haya imekuwa mpito kwa kuripoti kwa kiwango cha mtu binafsi kupitia Mfumo wa Ufuatiliaji wa Kimataifa wa Kupambana na Viini na Utumiaji wa WHO (GLASS).
Somali: Qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah horumarkan ayaa ahayd u ​​gudubka warbixinta heerka shaqsiyeed iyada oo loo marayo Nidaamka Ilaalinta Caalamiga ah ee Ka-hortagga iyo Isticmaalka Antimicrobial-ka ee WHO (GLASS).
Dholuo: Kidieny maduong’ mar dongruokni osebedo lokore mar chiwo ripot e rang’iny mar ng’ato ka ng’ato kokalo kuom chenro mar WHO mar ng’iyo kaka gik moko nyalo geng’o tuoche ma nyalo ketho ngima dhano (GLASS).

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will train farmers in Bomet County on terracing this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet juu ya terracing Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) ayaa tababar siin doonta beeraleyda degmada Bomet ee ku saabsan dhulka lagu beeray bisha July ee sannadkan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro tiego jopur e county mar Bomet e wi terracing e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya: Health and environment scorecard
Kiswahili: Kenya: Kadi ya afya na mazingira
Somali: Kenya: Kaadhka dhibcaha caafimaadka iyo deegaanka
Dholuo: Kenya: Kad mar kwan mar thieth kod alwora

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will conduct a post-harvest handling workshop for farmers in Embu County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itafanya warsha ya kushughulikia baada ya mavuno kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi ka dib goosashada beeraleyda degmada Embu bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Rieko: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro timo tiegruok ne jopur e County mar Embu bang' keyo e dwe mar Februar.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds mobile money users in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa fedha za simu.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni mondo ginyis jomisonari maggi weche maok adier mondo kik gitim mibadhi mar pesa mag simu.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone experiencing abuse in Lamu County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Lamu apeleke simu ya simu ya GBV 1195.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Lamu inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e County mar Lamu mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: Ministry of Education calls on the community in Homa Bay County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada gobolka Homa Bay inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116 si ay u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Puonjruok kwayo ji duto manie Homa Bay County mondo omany namba mar 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Notice: ODPP launches county development projects in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti katika kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay bilawday mashaariic horumarineed oo ka socda gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: ODPP chako chenro mag dongruok mar county e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: TVET encourages residents of Wajir County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Somali: TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabaan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Wajir mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto gikwongo tiyogo mondo ging'e ratiro ma sirkal nigo.

English: Universities Fund conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Kitui County this May.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Kitui Mei hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu qabtaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha gobolka Kitui bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund timo romo mar tiego ji e wi migawo mar Ombudsman e County mar Kitui e dwe mar Mei.

English: KUCCPS advises students in Mandera County to register early to secure allocation to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Mandera kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata maudhui ya kujifunza dijitali bila malipo.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay kula talineysaa ardayda Degmada Mandera inay isdiiwaangaliyaan si ay u helaan lacag la'aan ah oo barashada digital ah.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo jopuonjre man Mandera County mondo odonj e tiegruok chon mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo somo mar digital maonge chudo.

English: Judiciary of Kenya announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kushughulikia vyeti vya kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Kitui.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la hagaajiyay waqtiga wareejinta shahaadada dhalashada ee Gobolka Kitui.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya olando lokruok e seche mag timo nonro mar nyuol e County mar Kitui.

English: NPS warns residents of Kericho County to prepare for possible flooding this October.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa mafuriko Oktoba hii.
Somali: NPS waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay isu diyaariyaan fatahaadaha iman kara bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: NPS osiemo jogweng' mar Kericho mondo oikre ne koth maduong' mabiro timore e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages residents of Bungoma County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inaysan ku xanuunsadaan si aamusnaan ah oo ay ugu yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ojiwo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo kik gisandre gi muolo kendo mondo giluong kony mar thieth mar chuny maonge chudo.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges residents of Migori County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Migori kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Migori inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago xadgudubka xilka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo jogweng' Migori County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo kwayo mar kedo gi timbe mag tiyo marach gi migepe.

English: CDC appeals to caregivers in Turkana County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the February maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Februari.
Somali: CDC waxay u baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Turkana inay ka qeybgalaan maalinta bukaanka ee la qorsheeyay qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Febraayo.
Dholuo: CDC kwayo jorit e County mar Turkana mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar klinik ma ne ochano mar Februar kaka achiel kuom chenro mag thieth mar mine.

English: Notice: COMESA will distribute certified maize seed to farmers in Garissa County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: COMESA itasambaza mbegu zilizothibitishwa za mahindi kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay abuurka hadhuudhka ee la shaaciyay u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda Gobolka Garissa bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Rieko: COMESA biro pogo kodhi mag kodhi mar kodhi ne jopur manie County mar Garissa e dwe mar Februar.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges residents of Garissa County to attend the public participation forum to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Garissa inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si loo qaabeeyo dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Garissa mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mondo oket chenro mar nono tich mitimo higa ka higa.

English: Announcement to farmers to use certified seeds and harvest big nationally.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwa wakulima la kutumia mbegu zilizothibitishwa na kuvuna mbegu kubwa za kitaifa.
Somali: Ogeysiis loo dirayo beeraleyda in la isticmaalo abuur shahaado leh oo si weyn loo goosto guud ahaan dalka.
Dholuo: Owacho ni jopur oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar chamo kodhi kendo ogolo cham madongo e piny mangima.

English: FAO urges coffee growers in Nakuru County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawataka wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Nakuru inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo miraha ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: Notice: DPP conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Kitui County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Kitui Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho oo ku saabsan dhismaha nabadda qaranka ee Gobolka Kitui bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: DPP timo romo mar oganda e wi loso kuwe e gweng' mar Kitui e dwe mar Mei.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) informs maize farmers in Nyeri County of new market linkage opportunities this June.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawafahamisha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Juni hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Nyeri fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nyiso jopur mag kodhi e County mar Nyeri thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Jun.

English: The government has distributed three million bags of fertilizer at KSh 2 500 per bag to support seven million farmers in preparation for the upcoming long rains
Kiswahili: Serikali imesambaza magunia milioni tatu ya mbolea kwa KSh 2 500 kwa kila gunia kusaidia wakulima milioni saba kujiandaa na mvua ndefu zijazo.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay qaybisay saddex milyan oo bac ah oo bacriminta ah KSh 2,500 bac kasta si ay u taageerto toddoba milyan oo beeraley ah diyaar garowga roobabka dheer ee soo socda
Dholuo: Sirkal osesiro ji milion adek mag yien e nengo mar KSh 2,500 e ng'ato ka ng'ato mondo okony jopur milion abiriyo e ikruok ne koth ma biro.

English: NPS alerts residents of Nyamira County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua.
Somali: NPS waxay dadka deggan degmada Nyamira uga digtay kororka kiisaska tuugada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: NPS chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nyamira County ni kwan mag joma ok oluoro Nyasaye medore kendo ojiwo oganda mondo kik gipog weche mag ritruok gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: KNEC announces distribution of school laptops under the digital literacy programme to schools in Homa Bay County this October.
Kiswahili: KNEC inatangaza usambazaji wa kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Oktoba hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada gobolka Homa Bay bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KNEC olando ni ibiro mi skunde mag Homa Bay laptop e dwe mar Oktoba e bwo program mar digital literacy.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) encourages first-time voters in Kwale County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kwale kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa codbixiyayaasha ugu horreeya ee degmada Kwale inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogo matimoga yiero mokwongo e county mar Kwale mondo oting'e ID kata pasi mar piny mangima e odiechieng'no mar timo yiero.

English: OGP reminds residents of Nyeri County that access to national ID applications is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: OGP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba kufikia maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri in helitaanka codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: OGP parone jogweng' Nyeri County ni yudo kwayo mag ID mar piny sani yot moloyo kokalo kuom yore mag tich.

English: EACC invites residents of Homa Bay County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: EACC inakaribisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: EACC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee gobolka ee la xiriira wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: EACC gwelo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county mar chiwo paro e wi chenro mag oganda.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds mobile money users in Narok County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Narok wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee gobolka Narok inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN ee M-Pesa qofna si looga fogaado nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e Narok County ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo kik gitim chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Lamu County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma ya afya ya ruzuku.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu inay haystaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Lamu mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi ka gidwaro thieth mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Test the seeds for germination and plant only when germination is above 80%.
Kiswahili: Jaribu mbegu ya soya kama inamea kabla ya kupanda ili kuthibitisha kwamba asilimia zaidi ya 80 inamea.
Somali: Tijaabi abuurka si loo ogaado in uu dhirta ku soo baxaa iyo dhirta kaliya marka dhirta ay ka sarreyso 80%.
Dholuo: Tem ane mondo ine kodhi kod yien ka gisewuok gi nyak mokalo 80%.

English: Training farmers on droughtÃ¢â‚¬â€˜resistant maize varieties.
Kiswahili: Kuzoeza wakulima juu ya ukameÃ¢ faida za aina mbalimbali za mahindi.
Somali: Beeralayda ku tababar noocyada galleyda u adkaysta abaaraha.
Dholuo: Opuonjo jopur kuom kit cham ma ok nyal geng'o oro.

English: DPP warns residents of Kiambu County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: DPP inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: DPP waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu kororka khiyaamooyinka SIM-swap waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax falin.
Dholuo: DPP chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kiambu County e wi medruok mar timbe mag wuond mar loko SIM kendo ojiwo ji mondo ong'e kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: SHA advises residents of Meru County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: SHA inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e- Citizen.
Somali: SHA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan diiwaangelinta e-citizen.
Dholuo: SHA nyiso jogweng'o mag Meru County mondo oketgi e intanet kokalo kuom websait mar e-Citizen sama gidwaro dhi e e e - Citizen registration.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free stress management support is available through county health facilities in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kudhibiti mafadhaiko unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kitui.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero lacag la'aan ah oo lagu maareeyo walbahaarka laga helo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Kitui County.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar parruok yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth e gweng' mar Kitui.

English: IPOA warns residents of Nandi County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: IPOA inaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: IPOA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nandi kororka khiyaamada SIM-swap waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban.
Dholuo: IPOA chiwo siem ne Jo-Nandi County e wi medruok mar wuond mar SIM-swap kendo ojiwo ji mondo ong'e kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: Whenever possible, it is advised not to sell immediately after harvest when prices are low; harvest appropriately, store correctly, and sell when prices are higher.
Kiswahili: Inashauriwa, inapowezekana, kutouza mara tu baada ya mavuno wakati bei ziko chini; vuna ipasavyo, hifadhi vizuri, na uuze wakati bei ziko juu.
Somali: Mar kasta oo ay suurtagal tahay, waxaa lagugula talinayaa inaadan iibin isla markiiba goosashada kadib marka qiimaha ay hooseeyaan; goosashada si habboon, kaydinta si sax ah, iyo iibinta marka qiimaha ay sareeyaan.
Dholuo: Kinde duto, ok onego ohala mapiyo bang' keyo ka nengo piny; onego ohala e yo mowinjore, kendo onego okan kare, kendo ohala ka nengo ng'eny.

English: KUCCPS reminds needy students in Baringo County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji maombi yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Baringo in deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay codsiyada ardayda baahan ay dhowaan dhammaadaan.
Dholuo: KUCCPS paronwa jopuonjre man gi chan e taon mar Baringo ni tuke mag somo ne jopuonjre ma nigi chan biro rumo machiegni.

English: AFA reminds residents of Kitui County that agroforestry improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba kilimo cha misitu kinaboresha uzalishaji wa muda mrefu wa shamba.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kitui in beeraha kaynta ah uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: AFA parone jogweng' Kitui County ni agroforestry medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: NTSA calls on the community in Nakuru County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: NTSA waxay bulshada degmada Nakuru ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan oo ay taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: NTSA luongo oganda man Nakuru County mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo manyo kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages residents of Tana River County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay ula xiriiraan lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit jiwo jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo kik gisandgi gi ling'ling' kendo mondo giwuo gi jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response urges residents of Kericho County to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility following a rise in reported HIV/AIDS cases.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya VVU/UKIMWI.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay si dhakhso leh u raadsadaan baaritaanka xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow ka dib kororka kiisaska HIV / AIDS ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Kericho mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuo mar HIV/AIDS osemedore.

English: By protecting livestock health and supporting families with cash transfers, FAO and partners will help 6 000 pastoral households survive the drought and preserve their resilience and dignity in the face of disasters and climate shocks.
Kiswahili: Kwa kulinda afya ya mifugo na kusaidia familia kwa uhamisho wa fedha, FAO na washirika watasaidia kaya 6,000 za wafugaji kustahimili ukame na kuhifadhi ustahimilivu na heshima yao katika kukabiliana na majanga na majanga ya hali ya hewa.
Somali: Iyadoo la ilaalinayo caafimaadka xoolaha iyo taageeridda qoysaska lacagaha xawilaadda, FAO iyo la-hawlgalayaasheeda ayaa ka caawin doona 6,000 oo qoys oo xoolo-dhaqato ah inay ka badbaadaan abaarta oo ay ilaaliyaan adkeysigooda iyo sharaftooda marka ay wajahayaan masiibooyinka iyo dhibaatooyinka cimilada.
Dholuo: Ka rito ngima mar le kendo konyo joot gi pesa ma ioro, FAO kod jowetegi biro konyo joot 6 000 ma nigi jokwath mondo odagi e kinde mar oro kendo orit nyalo margi kod luor margi e kinde ma giyudo masira kod ng’anjo mag piny.

English: KEMSA calls on parents in Tharaka-Nithi County to have children under five screened for tuberculosis during the May outreach.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuwachunguza watoto chini ya miaka mitano kifua kikuu wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Mei.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Tharaka-Nithi in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka 'tuberculosis' inta lagu gudajiro bisha May.
Dholuo: KEMSA okwayo jonyuol e County mar Tharaka-Nithi mondo otim nonro mar tuo mar tuberculosis ne nyithindo ma hikgi tin ne abich e dwe mar Mei.

English: Kenya | Drought and Hunger Crisis - Operation Update (6 months), DREF Operation nÂ° MDRKE049

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) encourages farmers in Meru County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora ya mahindi.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Meru inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay hadhuudhka.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e county mar Meru mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar kodhi.

English: Teachers Service Commission invites youth in Kwale County to enroll for motor vehicle mechanics training this October.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kwale kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari Oktoba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka ayaa ku casuumay dhalinyarada degmada Kwale inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka mashiinnada gawaarida ee bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission ogwelo rowere e gweng' mar Kwale mondo odhi e tiegruok mar jomatindo mag mtokni e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: ODPP encourages first-time voters in Tana River County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Tana River inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogo ma ne okwongo yiero e taon mar Tana River County mondo onon weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: Notice: EACC will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ee degmada Kilifi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: EACC biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag siasa e gweng' mar Kilifi.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Taita-Taveta County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.

Kiswahili: TSC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Januari hii.

Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inatangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuanzia Julai hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhawaaqday xeryo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Nairobi laga bilaabo bishii Luulyo.

Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na CDC itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Agosti hii.

English: Kenya Gazette advises residents of Bungoma County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e- Citizen.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan diiwaangelinta e-citizen.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette nyiso jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro dhi e e - Citizen registration.

English: KUCCPS advises applicants in Lamu County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Lamu kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Lamu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: KUCCPS nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e County mar Lamu ni mondo gidonj e tiegruok kapok ichopo e chokruok mabiro.

English: NTSA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kisii County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: NTSA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Kisii piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Kisii inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: NTSA ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e County mar Kisii mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: Notice: KTDA restricts movement of dairy cows in Busia County due to a foot and mouth disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA inazuia harakati za ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Busia kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Busia sababo la xiriira faafitaanka cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KTDA ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok makwayo pi e gweng' mar Busia nikech tuwo mar dhoho.

English: A small number of vaccinated people may get infected with COVID-19 after vaccination; this is called a breakthrough infection, but they are likely to have milder symptoms than if they were not vaccinated.
Kiswahili: Idadi ndogo ya watu waliochanjwa wanaweza kuambukizwa COVID-19 baada ya chanjo; hii inaitwa maambukizi ya mafanikio, lakini kuna uwezekano wa kuwa na dalili ndogo kuliko kama hawakuchanjwa.
Somali: Tirada yar ee dadka la tallaalay ayaa laga yaabaa inay ku dhacaan COVID-19 tallaalka ka dib; tani waxaa loo yaqaan cudurka horumarinta, laakiin waxay u badan tahay inay la kulmaan calaamado fudud marka loo eego haddii aan la tallaalin.
Dholuo: Kwan matin mar joma osetiyo gi chanjo nyalo mako tuwo mar COVID-19 bang' yudo chanjo; mano iluongo ni tuwo makelo ywaruok, kata kamano nyalo bedo ni gibedo gi tuoche mang'eny matin moloyo ka ok gisechiwgi.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the public in Nairobi County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unashauri umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa SIM-swap.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya shacabka degmada Nairobi inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ji duto e County mar Nairobi mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche mag wuond motudore gi SIM-swap.

English: Refugee camps must prioritize safety planning, adequate lighting, and womenâ€™s participation in governance.
Kiswahili: Kambi za wakimbizi zinapaswa kuweka kipaumbele mipango ya usalama, taa ya kutosha, na ushiriki wa wanawake katika utawala.
Somali: Xeryaha qaxootiga waa inay mudnaanta siiyaan qorsheynta badbaadada, nalalka ku filan, iyo ka qaybgalka haweenka ee maamulka.
Dholuo: Kambi mag jolweny nyaka keto chenro mag arita, ler moromo, kod bedo gi mon e loch obed mokuongo.

English: Notice: Universities Fund announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku dhawaaqay taariikhda diiwaangelinta dugsiyada dugsiga dhexe ee bilaashka ah ee degmada Kakamega.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Yunivasiti Fund olando tarik mag somo mar sekondari ma onge chudo e skunde man Kakamega County.

English: EACC encourages first-time voters in Kitui County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: EACC inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kitui kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: EACC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Kitui inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jogo matimoga yiero mokwongo e kaunti mar Kitui mondo oting'e ID kata pasi mar piny mangima e odiechieng'no mar timo yiero.

English: Public health advisory: KEMSA warns of increased meningitis risk in Isiolo County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMSA inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya homa ya uti wa mgongo katika Kaunti ya Isiolo na inashauri umma kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na dawa za wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: KEMSA waxay ka digtay khatarta sii kordheysa ee meningitis ee degmada Isiolo waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay isticmaalaan shabakadaha cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: KEMSA chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar meningitis e kaunti mar Isiolo kendo ojiwo ji mondo oti gi net mag lum ma otigo gi yedhe makelo tuoche mag kute otieno ka otieno.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will distribute certified sweet potatoes seed to farmers in Bomet County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu za viazi vitamu zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu abuuraha degmada Bomet u qaybin doonaa abuurka baradho macaan ee la caddeeyay bishii Luulyo ee sannadkan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro pogo kodhi mag le mamit ne jopur man Bomet County e dwe mar Julai.

English: NTSA calls on residents of Isiolo County to support local peace-building committees in support of border security.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaita wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kusaidia halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani kusaidia usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: NTSA waxay dadka deggan degmada Isiolo ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee deegaanka si ay u taageerayaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: NTSA okwayo jogweng' Isiolo County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gwenge ma giwuokie mondo gikony e rito tong'.

Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu furayaa xarumaha nidaamyada codbixinta ee degmada Trans Nzoia bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura Matayo (Ombudsman) chako tiyo gi chenro mar timo yiero e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia e dwe mar Januar.

Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS inazuia harakati za kuku katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa digaagga ee Gobolka Kilifi sababtuna tahay faafitaanka cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok e County Kilifi nikech tuwo mar dhoho.

English: Detailed research done in Northern Nigeria with AATF and partners has borne great perspective among maize farmers .
Kiswahili: Utafiti mwingi uliofanywa Kaskazini mwa Nigeria na AATF na washirika wake umekuwa na mtazamo mzuri sana miongoni mwa wakulima wa mahindi .
Somali: Cilmi baaris faahfaahsan oo lagu sameeyay Waqooyiga Nigeria iyadoo lala kaashanayo AATF iyo la-hawlgalayaal ayaa u keenay aragti weyn beeraleyda hadhuudhka .
Dholuo: Nonro matut mosetim e Northern Nigeria gi AATF kod jowetene osemiyo jopur mag cham obedo gi paro maber .

English: Judiciary of Kenya updates residents of Baringo County on progress of community-based development programmes this December.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuhusu maendeleo ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii mwezi Desemba.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Baringo ka warbixiyaa horumarka barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada bishii Diseembar.

English: NTSA reminds the public in Makueni County to remain vigilant on counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: NTSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Makueni in ay sii joogaan feejignaanta ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: NTSA oparo ne ji duto e gweng' mar Makueni ni mondo gisik ka girito weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Secondhand smoke harms both the mother and the unborn baby. Keep homes and public spaces smoke-free.
Kiswahili: Moshi wa mtu mwingine hudhuru mama na mtoto ambaye hajazaliwa. Weka nyumba na maeneo ya umma bila moshi.

Kiswahili: Wakfu wa Bill & Melinda Gates na Benki ya Uwekezaji ya Ulaya Wazindua Majaribio barani Afrika ili Kuboresha Upatikanaji wa Wajasiriamali Wanawake kwa Mitaji.

English: Elgeyo Marakwet County officially rolls out CNAP targeting a reduction of child stunting from 30% to 22%.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Elgeyo Marakwet yazindua rasmi mpango wa CNAP unaolenga kupunguza udumavu wa watoto kutoka 30% hadi 22%.

English: Chlorophyll Africa Sustainable farming has become an essential focus in modern agriculture, especially in regions like Kenya, where farming is not just a livelihood but a way of life. As global populations rise and environmental challenges intensify, the need for sustainable agricultural practices has never been more urgent. Chlorophyll Africa is at the forefront of this movement, implementing innovative and eco-friendly farming techniques that not only protect the environment but also empower local communities.
Kiswahili: Chlorophyll Africa Kilimo endelevu kimekuwa lengo muhimu katika kilimo cha kisasa, haswa katika mikoa kama Kenya, ambapo kilimo sio tu riziki bali njia ya maisha. Kadiri idadi ya watu ulimwenguni inavyoongezeka na changamoto za mazingira zinaongezeka, hitaji la mazoea endelevu ya kilimo halijawahi kuwa la dharura zaidi. Chlorophyll Africa iko mstari wa mbele katika harakati hii, ikitekeleza mbinu za kilimo za ubunifu na rafiki wa mazingira ambazo sio tu zinalinda mazingira lakini pia zinawezesha jamii za wenyeji.
Somali: Chlorophyll Africa Beeraha joogtada ah wuxuu noqday diiradda muhiimka ah ee beeraha casriga ah, gaar ahaan gobollada sida Kenya, halkaas oo beeraha aysan ahayn nolol kaliya laakiin hab nololeed. Iyada oo tirada dadka adduunka ay kor u kacdo iyo caqabadaha deegaanka ay sii xoogeystaan, baahida loo qabo hababka beeraha ee joogtada ah waligiis ma aysan ahayn mid degdeg ah. Chlorophyll Africa waxay hormuudka u tahay dhaqdhaqaaqankan, iyadoo hirgelineysa farsamooyin beeraha
Dholuo: Chlorophyll Africa Tije mag pur ma nigi nyak osedoko gima duong' ahinya e tij pur ma sani, to moloyo e pinje kaka Kenya, kama pur ok en mana yor ngima kende, to en yo mar ngima. Kaka kwan mar ji e piny medo medore kendo chandruoge mag alwora medo medore, dwarore ni tije mag pur ma nigi nyak osemedore mapiyo. Chlorophyll Africa en achiel kuom joma osekawo okang' mokwongo e tijno, kendo otiyo gi yore mag pur ma ok kal tong' kendo ma ok kal tong' ma ok kel ne alwora, to bende miyo ji bedo
