English: Notice: Huduma Kenya opens the electoral calendar centres in Tana River County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Wilaya ya Tana River Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay furaysaa xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee degmada Tana River bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Huduma Kenya biro yawo kalenda mar yiero e taon mar Tana River County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: DPP calls on residents of Kiambu County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DPP inawaomba wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: DPP waxay dadka deggan degmada Kiambu ugu baaqeysaa inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga dhaqdhaqaaq aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah si ay u taageeraan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: DPP okwayo jogweng' mar County mar Kiambu mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma rito kuwe e gwenge mag tong' mondo okony e loso kuwe e piny.

English: ODPP reminds residents of Kwale County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba upatikanaji wa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: ODPP oparo ne jogweng' Kwale County ni yudo weche mag nyasi mar nyuol koro yot moloyo kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Samburu County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Samburu inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e gweng' mar Samburu mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Notice: Council of Governors opens the electoral calendar centres in Taita-Taveta County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa furaya xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Bura mar Jaloch chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e kaunti mar Taita-Taveta e dwe mar Mach.

English: KEPHIS reminds farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee xakamaynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada.
Dholuo: KEPHIS parone jopur e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche.

English: Notice: IEBC opens applications for school laptops under the digital literacy programme for learners in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inafungua maombi ya kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa codsiyada loogu talagalay laptops-ka dugsiga iyada oo loo marayo barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee ardayda degmada Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC oyawo kwayo mag kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar somo kod somo mar digital ne jopuonjre man Kirinyaga County.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya laanzisha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay shilalka waddooyinka ee degmada Kiambu.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova e piny Kenya, miluongo ni Kenya Red Cross, tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony mapiyo ne masira mar ndara e gweng' mar Kiambu.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will train farmers in Tana River County on conservation tillage this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River juu ya kilimo cha uhifadhi Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu tababar siin doonaa beeraleyda Gobolka Tana River oo ku saabsan beerashada ilaalinta bisha November.
Dholuo: Rapar: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro tiego jopur e taon mar Tana River County e weche mag rito puodho e dwe mar Novemba.

English: DPP alerts residents of Tana River County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: DPP anawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Somali: DPP waxay ka digtay dadka deggan degmada Tana River in ay kordheen kiisaska tuugada waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan macluumaadka amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: DPP chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar Tana River County ni kwan mag joma odonjo e odno biro medore kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Nakuru County that access to eye and dental camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za macho na meno sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nakuru in helitaanka xeryaha indhaha iyo ilkaha ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumo la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMSA oparo ne ji duto e gweng' mar Nakuru ni koro ginyalo dhi e kambini mag thieth mar wang' kod lakteche.

English: KEMRI encourages mothers in Kitui County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kitui kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kitui inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo mine man Kitui County mondo odhi olimgi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Red Cross will be held in Kwale County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kwale Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Kwale bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kamp mar thieth ma Kenya Red Cross ochano biro timore e dwe mar Novemba e kaunti mar Kwale.

English: TVET advises applicants in Kisumu County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: TVET waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Kisumu inay dalbadaan booska TVET iyada oo loo marayo KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: TVET nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e County mar Kisumu mondo oketgi e tiegruok mar TVET kokalo kuom KUCCPS.

English: Kenya Gazette announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Narok County.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linatangaza uboreshaji wa nyakati za kusindika vyeti vya kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku dhawaaqay in la hagaajiyay waqtiga wareejinta shahaadada dhalashada ee gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette olando lokruok e seche mag timo nonro mag nyasi mag nyuol e County mar Narok.

English: Notice: HELB opens applications for revision guides for learners in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay furaysaa codsiyada hagaha dib u eegista ardayda degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: HELB oyawo kwayo mag somo mondo okony jopuonjre e County mar Bungoma.

English: NDMA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Nyamira County that access to psychosocial support is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisaikolojia unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Nyamira in helitaanka taageerada cilmu-nafsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e county mar Nyamira ni ginyalo yudo kony kuom weche mag pach ji maonge chudo.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will hold a depression awareness forum in Siaya County this April. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitafanya kongamano la uhamasishaji wa unyogovu katika Kaunti ya Siaya Aprili hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa qaban doonta madasha wacyiga niyadjabka ee degmada Siaya bisha Abriil. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo chokruok mar chiwo paro e wi tuoche mag depression e county mar Siaya e dwe mar April.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) invites residents of Narok County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandao wa kaunti kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Narok inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) gwelo jogweng' Narok County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e wi chenro mar bajet mar countya.

English: KNEC urges residents of Kisii County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa watu wazima ili kufaidika na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay isdiiwaangaliyaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan fasallada akhrista dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kisii mondo odonj e program mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo mondo giyud konyruok kuom tiegruok mar somo kod somo.

English: Notice: TVET announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET olando tarik mag somo mar pinyruoth ma onge chudo e skunde mag Nyandarua County.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Mombasa County about the importance of safe water storage for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhusu umuhimu wa uhifadhi wa maji salama kwa ajili ya ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay dadka degmada Mombasa ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health parone ji duto e County mar Mombasa kuom ber mar kano pi maler e ngima joot.

English: NPS urges anyone experiencing abuse in Mombasa County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NPS inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuripoti kesi kwenye dawati la karibu la jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka gobolka Mombasa inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e county mar Mombasa mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: UNICEF Kenya Humanitarian Situation Report No. 4 (Drought): 31 August 2022
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Hali ya Kibinadamu ya UNICEF Kenya Nambari 4 (Ukame): 31 Agosti 2022
Somali: Warbixinta Xaaladda Bani'aadamnimada ee UNICEF Kenya Lambarka 4 (Abaarta): 31 Agoosto 2022
Dholuo: Ripot mar chal mar konyo dhano mar UNICEF e piny Kenya namba 4 (Oro): tarik 31 dwe mar aboro higa mar 2022

English: Notice: FAO will distribute certified cassava seed to farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itasambaza mbegu za muhogo zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: FAO waxay abuuraha Degmada Tharaka-Nithi u qaybin doontaa abuurka cassava ee la caddeeyay bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: FAO biro pogo kodhi mag cassava ne jopur man Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar Agost.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges sorghum growers in Kisumu County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Waxsoosaarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda sorghum ee degmada Kisumu inay qaataan noocyo abuurka ah oo u adkaysta abaarta si loo wanaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur mag sorghum e gweng' mar Kisumu mondo okaw kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed kelo nyak e higani.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Gobolka ee TVET waxay bilowday barnaamij lagu daro ardayda naafada ah dugsiyada guud ahaan Degmada Tharaka-Nithi.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State Department for TVET chako chenro mar tiego nyithindo ma nigi midekre e skunde e Tharaka-Nithi County.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will conduct a post-harvest handling workshop for farmers in Wajir County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi ka dib goosashada beeraleyda degmada Wajir bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura matayo gik makelo tuoche mag tuoche biro timo tiegruok ne jopur e gweng' mar Wajir bang' keyo e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Kajiado County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kajiado County kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan bixinta adeegyada heerka qaybta.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo ging'e weche duto e wi tiegruok mar gwenge.

English: If food is removed, there is a serious problem.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa chakula kinaondolewa, kuna shida kubwa.
Somali: Haddii cuntada laga saaro, waxaa jirta dhibaato halis ah.
Dholuo: Kapo ni chiemo ogol oko, nitie chandruok maduong’ ahinya.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in West Pokot County about the importance of safe water storage for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi juu ya umuhimu wa uhifadhi wa maji salama kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay dadka ku nool degmada West Pokot ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health parone ji e West Pokot County kuom ber mar kano pi maler e ngima joot.

English: Judiciary of Kenya warns public officers in Nandi County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Nandi dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dawladda ee gobolka Nandi inay ka hantiyaan laaluushka xafiisyada dawladda.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Nandi kuom kawo asoya e migepe ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kilifi County that access to psychosocial support is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisaikolojia unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Kilifi in la heli karo taageero maskaxeed oo lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Kilifi ni ginyalo yudo kony maonge chudo.

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief, January 2023
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP Kenya, Januari 2023
Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya, Janaayo 2023
Dholuo: Wach machiek mar piny Kenya mar WFP, dwe mar achiel higa mar 2023

English: CDC advises residents of Kiambu County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: CDC inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: CDC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay biyo cabitaan ah ku kariyaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuoche (CDC) jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Kiambu mondo omak pi modho kapok gitiyo kode e geng'o tuoche ma ok nyal geng'e.

English: DCI urges residents of Taita-Taveta County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: DCI inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Taita-Taveta inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaala aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ilaalinta ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar sirkal e wi gik ma ne timore e alwora mar tong'gi nikech ji osebedo ka kawo okang' mar kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: AFA warns wheat farmers in Homa Bay County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: AFA inawaonya wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: AFA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda sarreenka ee gobolka Homa Bay cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: AFA chiwo siem ne jopur mag ngano e Homa Bay County kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ochiwo paro mar kawo okang' mapiyo.

English: Notice: COMESA will train farmers in Trans Nzoia County on agroforestry this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia juu ya kilimo cha misitu Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia ku saabsan beeraha kaynta bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA biro tiego jopur e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia e weche mag yiende mag yien e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by CDC will be held in Nyamira County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na CDC itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Februari hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabiyeen CDC ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Nyamira bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma CDC ochano ibiro tim e County mar Nyamira e dwe mar Februar.

English: COMESA advises maize producers in Samburu County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wazalishaji wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: COMESA waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha hadhuudhka ee Gobolka Samburu inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur mag cham e county mar Samburu mondo oti gi nengo mar piny moseketo kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Notice: IEBC launches community-based development programmes in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inazindua mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay bilowday barnaamijyo horumarineed oo ku salaysan bulshada ee Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IEBC chako chenro mag dongruok e alwora mar Kakamega County.

Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Medical Association osenyiso ni nitie masira mar malaria e county mar Samburu. Ojiw ji mondo otim nonro mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni kodgi.

Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaonya wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Narok juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.

Kiswahili: Ubunifu huu huwezesha huduma za kitaifa za hali ya hewa kutoa utabiri sahihi, kwa wakati ufaao kwa kutumia kompyuta ya kibinafsi pekeeâ€”kuondoa hitaji la kompyuta kubwa za gharama kubwa na kufungua uwezekano mpya wa hatua za kutazamia katika maeneo yenye mazingira magumu ya hali ya hewa.

English: KNEC advises students in West Pokot County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kufikia kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali.
Somali: KNEC waxay ardayda degmada West Pokot kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah.

English: WHO experts worked with county health teams to coordinate operations at the grassroots so that local authorities took ownership of the efforts to boost COVID-19 vaccination.
Kiswahili: Wataalamu wa WHO walifanya kazi na timu za afya za kaunti kuratibu shughuli mashinani ili mamlaka za mitaa zichukue umiliki wa juhudi za kuimarisha chanjo ya COVID-19.
Somali: Khubarada WHO waxay la shaqeeyeen kooxaha caafimaadka ee degmada si ay isugu dubbaridaan hawlgallada ka socda degmooyinka hoose si maamullada deegaanku ay ula wareegaan dadaallada lagu xoojinayo tallaalka COVID-19.
Dholuo: Jolony mag WHO notiyo kanyakla gi riwruoge mag thieth mag kaunti mondo gilos tije e piny mondo jotelo mag gwenge okaw okang’ mar temo mar medo chiwo chanjo mar COVID-19.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on residents of Baringo County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawaomba wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ka socda aagagga xuduudda hay'adaha amniga si ay u taageeraan taxadarka ka dhanka ah argagixisada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross okwayo jogweng' Baringo County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma rito sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e tong'gi mondo gikony e kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties warns public officers in Tana River County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Wilaya ya Tana River dhidi ya kupotosha fedha za umma.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Tana River in ay ka faa'iideystaan dhaqaale dawladeed.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e taon mar Tana River County ni kik gitim ohala marach gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: AFA advises fish producers in Isiolo County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: AFA inashauri wazalishaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: AFA waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kalluunka ee degmada Isiolo inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: AFA nyiso jopur ma loso rech e gweng' mar Isiolo ni gidonj e riwruok mar jokony - tich ma nigi ratiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Notice: SHA launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kiambu County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Shirika la SHA linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Desemba hii.

Kiswahili: FAO inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Julai.
Somali: FAO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Bungoma in ay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta ee la xaqiijiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka July.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e Bungoma County mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochopo dwe mar Julai.

English: OGP warns public officers in Samburu County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: OGP anaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Samburu dhidi ya udanganyifu wa fedha za umma.
Somali: OGP waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee gobolka Samburu inay ka xishoodaan dhaqaale dawladeed.
Dholuo: OGP chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Samburu ni kik gitim mibadhi mar pesa.

Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kitui: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Januari 2023

Kiswahili: COMESA inawasihi wakulima wa manii katika Kaunti ya Kwale kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.

Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Turkana kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Turkana in ay dhagaystaan amarada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Weche Dhano jiwo jorit mtokni kod joma wuotho gi tiendegi e gweng' mar Turkana mondo oluw chike ma sirkande mag gweng'no ogolo mondo gikwed hinyruok mag ndara.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Homa Bay County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Wilaya ya Homa Bay mwezi Juni huu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Kenya Gazette waxay billowday olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee gobolka Homa Bay bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Gazette chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e Homa Bay County e dwe mar Jun.

English: KICD calls on the community in Kwale County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KICD inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Kwale kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: KICD waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Kwale inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban iskuulada si ay u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyada iskuulada.
Dholuo: KICD luongo oganda man Kwale County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo omi skunde obed maonge tuoche.

English: EACC encourages first-time voters in Wajir County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: EACC inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Wajir kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: EACC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Wajir inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jogo matimoga yiero mokwongo e County mar Wajir mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi kata pasipoti e odiechieng' mar timo yiero.

Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar geng'o ji kik nege yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Migori.

Kiswahili:
Mwezi huu wa Uhamasishaji wa Afya ya Akili kwa Wanaume, hebu tuvunje ukimya. Mara nyingi jamii huwaambia wanaume "kuwa imara," lakini nguvu halisi iko katika kutambua mapambano yako na kufikia lengo.

1. Kuzungumza si udhaifu—ni ujasiri.

2. Hisia zako ni halali.

3. Huna haja ya kukabiliana nayo peke yako.

Iwe ni msongo wa mawazo, wasiwasi, mfadhaiko, au kuhisi tu kuzidiwa— afya yako ya akili ni muhimu. Zungumza na rafiki, mshauri, au kikundi cha usaidizi. Kuomba msaada ni ishara ya nguvu, si kushindwa.

Wewe ni binadamu. Unastahili usaidizi. Hauko peke yako.
Somali:
Bishan Wacyigelinta Caafimaadka Dhimirka ee Ragga, aan aamusnaanta jebinno. Bulshadu waxay inta badan ragga ku tiraahdaa "xoog yeesha," laakiin xoogga dhabta ah wuxuu ku jiraa qirashada dhibaatooyinkaaga iyo gaaritaanka.

1. Hadalku ma aha daciifnimo - waa geesinimo.
2. Dareenkaagu waa sax.
3. Uma baahnid inaad kaligaa wajahdo.

Hadday tahay walbahaar, walaac, niyad-jab, ama inaad dareento culeys - caafimaadkaaga maskaxdu waa muhiim. La hadal saaxiib, la-taliye, ama koox taageero. Codsashada caawimo waa calaamad muujinaysa xoog, ee maaha guuldarro.

Adigu waa bini'aadam. Waxaad mudan tahay taageero. Keligaa ma tihid.
Dholuo:
E dwe mar ng'eyo weche mag ngima mar paro mag chwo, we mondo watur ling'ling'. Oganda thoro nyiso chwo ni "bed motegno," to teko mar adier nitie kuom yie gi pek ma itemogo kendo chopo e lweny.

1. Wuoyo gi ng’ato ok en bedo gi olo—en chir.
2. Gik ma iwinjo gin gik ma kare.
3.Ok onego ibed gi paro ma kamano kendi.

Kata obedo ni en parruok, parruok, paro mang’eny, kata winjo mana ni in gi pek mang’eny— ngimani mar paro en gima duong’. Wuo kod osiep, japuonj, kata grup ma konyo. Kwayo kony en ranyisi mar teko, to ok en ranyisi mar ketho. 
In dhano. Owinjore iyud kony. Ok in kendi.

English: ODPP reminds the public in Kisii County that input on development planning forums is welcome this July.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba mchango kwenye vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo unakaribishwa Julai hii.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kisii in talooyinka ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha July.
Dholuo: ODPP oparo ne ji duto e County mar Kisii ni gibiro yie gi weche ma gichiwo e wi chenro mag dongruok e dwe mar Julai.

English: The country's progress has been supported by strong governance structures, standardized data collection tools, laboratory information systems, regular data quality reviews and multidisciplinary collaboration involving laboratory, data and informatics teams.
Kiswahili: Maendeleo ya nchi yameungwa mkono na miundo thabiti ya utawala, zana sanifu za ukusanyaji wa takwimu, mifumo ya taarifa za maabara, ukaguzi wa mara kwa mara wa ubora wa data na ushirikiano wa fani mbalimbali unaohusisha timu za maabara, data na taarifa.
Somali: Horumarka dalka waxaa taageeray qaab-dhismeedyo maamul oo xooggan, qalab ururin xog oo heer sare ah, nidaamyada macluumaadka shaybaarka, dib u eegista tayada xogta joogtada ah iyo iskaashi dhinacyo badan leh oo ay ku lug leeyihiin kooxaha shaybaarka, xogta iyo macluumaadka.
Dholuo: Dhi nyime e pinyno osebedo ka konyo gi chenro motegno mag loch, gige choko weche ma ng’ato nyalo ng’eyo, sistem mag ng’eyo weche mag laboratori, ng’iyo weche ma ng’ato timo pile ka pile kod riwruok mar ng’ato ka ng’ato ma nigi ng’eyo mang’eny ma oriwo jotich mag laboratori, weche ma ng’ato nyalo ng’eyo kod weche ma ng’ato nyalo ng’eyo.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Tharaka-Nithi County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan Degmada Tharaka-Nithi in warbixinta degdegga ah ee xanta xoolaha ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Forest Service parone jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County ni ka ng'ato owacho mapiyo ni jamni omako jamni, mano konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Pest Control Products Board warns cassava farmers in Nakuru County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawaonya wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Nakuru juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza uingiliaji kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda cassava ee degmada Nakuru cudurrada cayayaanta waxayna kugula talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok, chiwo siem ne jopur man Nakuru County kuom masiche mag hinyruok mar tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Nakuru County to attend the public participation forum to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inay ka qayb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si ay u qaabeeyaan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya ojiwo jogweng' Nakuru County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar loso chenro mar dongruok.

English: Notice: Universities Fund reminds citizens in Samburu County about their rights regarding the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuhusu haki zao kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu muwaadiniinta degmada Samburu xusuusinayaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Yunivasiti Fund parone raia e county mar Samburu kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo ombudsman.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds mobile money users in Migori County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Migori wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa fedha za simu.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Migori inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN ee M-Pesa si looga fogaado khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e county mar Migori ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo kik gitim timbe mag wuondo pesa mag simu.

English: DPP warns residents of Kakamega County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this September.
Kiswahili: DPP anawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Septemba hii.
Somali: DPP waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kakamega inay u diyaar garoobaan qaraxyo dab ah oo dhici kara bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: DPP chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kakamega County mondo giikre ne yiengni manyalo timore e dwe mar Septemba.

English: DPP reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Marsabit County that access to free legal aid is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisheria wa bure unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Marsabit in helitaanka caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: DPP paronwa joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Marsabit ni thuolo mar yudo kony ma onge chudo yudore maonge chudo.

English: DCI reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kericho County that access to free legal aid is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisheria wa bure unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee degmada Kericho in helitaanka caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: DCI paronwa jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Kericho ni thuolo mar yudo kony ma onge chudo en gima ok ochuno.

English: 6 Years on: how a water access project impacted lives in Churo, Kenya
Kiswahili: Miaka 6: jinsi mradi wa upatikanaji wa maji ulivyoathiri maisha katika Churo, Kenya
Somali: 6 Sano kadib: sida mashruuc biyo marin ah u saameeyay nolosha Churo, Kenya

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMRI will be held in Nairobi County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu bila malipo iliyoandaliwa na KEMRI itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay KEMRI ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Gobolka Nairobi bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni kambi mar thieth ma KEMRI ochano biro timore Nairobi County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free depression awareness support is available through county health facilities in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa uhamasishaji wa unyogovu unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay wacyiga niyadjabku laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar parruok yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth e kaunti mar Isiolo.

English: KEPHIS promotes soil conservation among farmers in Trans Nzoia County as part of the June climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inakuza uhifadhi wa udongo miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa za Juni.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay kor u qaadeysaa ilaalinta ciidda beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee bisha Juun.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo rito lowo e kind jopur e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia kaka achiel kuom chenro mar dwe mar Jun mar kedo gi tuoche.

English: Kilifi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for December 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kilifi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Desemba 2023
Somali: Degmada Kilifi: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Diseembar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kilifi: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2023

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Busia County that access to the GBV toll-free helpline is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba upatikanaji wa simu ya msaada ya GBV ya bure unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee degmada Busia in helitaanka khadka caawimaadda ee GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah uu yahay mid bilaash ah.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Busia ni gibiro yudo kony ma onge chudo mar GBV maonge chudo.

English: HELB calls on the community in Trans Nzoia County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: HELB inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: HELB waxay bulshada degmada Trans Nzoia ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ku lug leh si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: HELB luongo oganda man Trans Nzoia County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ngima maber e skunde.

English: NTSA urges the community in Kilifi County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: NTSA inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Kilifi inay ka warbixiyaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo shaki leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow si loo joojiyo xanta xoolaha.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo ji e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo ochiw ripot e stesen mar polise man machiegni mondo gikwed kwalo jamni.

English: Kenya Red Cross appeals to caregivers in Taita-Taveta County to visit their nearest maternity wing as part of the July maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya watoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Julai.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Taita-Taveta inay soo booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada bisha July.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ogwelo jorit e Taita-Taveta County mondo odhi olim ringregi man machiegni kodgi e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: KALRO will distribute certified tea seed to farmers in Narok County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itasambaza mbegu za chai zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay abuurka shaaha ee shahaadada leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda gobolka Narok bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Rapar: KALRO biro pogo kodhi mag chai ne jopur manie Narok County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free tuberculosis screening is available at all public health centres in Kilifi County this November.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kifua kikuu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Novemba hii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka caabuqa ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynta ee degmada Kilifi bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji ni nonro mar thieth mar tuberculosis onge chudo e kuonde thieth duto e County Kilifi e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Taita-Taveta County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this drought season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati huu wa ukame.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay dhagaystaan amarada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha deegaanka xilligan abaarta.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji moa e gweng'no e kinde mar oro.

English: TSC encourages out-of-school children in Kiambu County to register their children at the nearest public school under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: TSC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Kiambu inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo nyithindo maok dhi e skul e Kaunti mar Kiambu mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni kodgi kaluwore gi chenro mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Lamu County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu inay haystaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMSA nyiso jogweng' County mar Lamu mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi ka gidwaro thieth mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Notice from CDC: family planning counselling clinics will run every April at designated health centres in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa CDC: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Aprili katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid CDC: rugta la talinta qorshaynta qoyska waxay ka shaqeyn doontaa Abriil kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Bomet.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth miluongo ni CDC: Klinike mag chiwo paro e wi chenro mag ngima joot biro dhi nyime April ka April e kuonde thieth moyier e county mar Bomet.

English: Notice: e-Citizen opens a new service point for passport services in Embu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: Ogaysiis: e-Citizen waxay furaysaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee degmada Embu.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: e-Citizen oseyawo kama tiyo gi passport e county mar Embu.

English: The ODPP issued guidance explaining Kenyaâ€™s legal definition of terrorism under the Prevention of Terrorism Act.
Kiswahili: ODPP ilitoa mwongozo unaoelezea ufafanuzi wa kisheria wa ugaidi nchini Kenya chini ya Sheria ya Kuzuia Ugaidi.
Somali: ODPP waxay soo saartay hagitaan sharraxaya qeexitaanka sharciga ah ee Kenya ee argagixisada iyadoo la raacayo Xeerka Ka Hortagga Argagixisada.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMRI will be held in Kericho County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMRI itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kericho Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay KEMRI ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Kericho bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma KEMRI ochano biro timore e taon mar Kericho e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on the community in Nakuru County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuongea dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwa ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ugu baaqay bulshada degmada Nakuru inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan oo ay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oluongo oganda man Nakuru County mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo ochiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Lamu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Lamu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2022
Somali: Degmada Lamu: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Lamu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2022

English: These technologies range from precision farming and satellite imaging to drone technology and artificial intelligence, digital tools and can ...
Kiswahili: Teknolojia hizi zinaanzia kilimo sahihi na upigaji picha wa setilaiti hadi teknolojia ya ndege zisizo na rubani na akili bandia, zana za kidijitali na zinaweza ...

English: KALRO invites farmers in West Pokot County to a free training on fertiliser application this September.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utumiaji wa mbolea Septemba hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda gobolka West Pokot tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan isticmaalka bacriminta bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KALRO ogwelo jopur e West Pokot County e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi tiyo gi yien e dwe mar Septemba.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds expectant mothers in Embu County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Embu kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Embu in helitaanka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone mine ma biro bedo gi ich e county mar Embu ni thuolo mar yudo puonj mag chenro mag ngima joot en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag oganda.

English: NPS alerts residents of Isiolo County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: NPS waxay dadka deggan degmada Isiolo uga digtay kororka kiisaska xoolaha lagu xado waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan mashaariicda booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: NPS chiwo siem ne jogweng' Isiolo County e wi medruok mar weche mag kwalo jamni kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Ksh 22,244 capitation per day-scholar released Ã¢Â€Â“ principals must NOT ask for extra money!

English: Kenyan Ambassador to Rwanda Philip Githiora urged Kenyan citizens registered as voters who live in Rwanda to use the opportunity to verify their details
Kiswahili: Balozi wa Kenya nchini Rwanda Philip Githiora aliwahimiza raia wa Kenya walioandikishwa kuwa wapiga kura wanaoishi Rwanda kutumia fursa hiyo kuthibitisha maelezo yao
Somali: Safiirka Kenya ee Rwanda Philip Githiora ayaa ku booriyay muwaadiniinta Kenya ee diiwaangashan codbixiyayaasha ah ee ku nool Rwanda inay isticmaalaan fursadda si ay u xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda
Dholuo: Jakom Kenya e Rwanda Philip Githiora nojiwo raia mag Kenya mosendik kaka josiasa modak Rwanda mondo oti gi thuolo mar nono weche ma gin-go

English: Pest Control Products Board urges farmers in Kiambu County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda degmada Kiambu inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddelada roobabka.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kiambu mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi pur mar piny mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok e kaka koth chue.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds residents of Bungoma County that access to national ID applications is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba kufikia maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Bungoma in helitaanka codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties parone jogweng'o mag Bungoma County ni yudo kwayo mag ID mar piny sani yot ahinya kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds expectant mothers in Kirinyaga County that access to postnatal check-ups is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba upatikanaji wa uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Kirinyaga in helitaanka baaritaannada dhalmada ka dib ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne mine ma nigi ich e County mar Kirinyaga ni dhi e nonro bang' nyuol en gima onge chudo e kuonde duto mag oganda.

English: UNICEF Kenya Humanitarian Situation Report No. 1 (Level 3 Mpox), 31 July to 03 October 2024
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Hali ya Kibinadamu ya UNICEF Kenya No. 1 (Level 3 Mpox), 31 Julai hadi 03 Oktoba 2024
Somali: Warbixinta Xaaladda Bani'aadamnimada ee UNICEF Kenya Lambarka 1 (Heerka 3 Mpox), 31 Luulyo ilaa 03 Oktoobar 2024
Dholuo: Ripot mar chal mar konyo dhano mar UNICEF e piny Kenya namba 1 (Okang' mar 3 mar tuwo mar pox), tarik 31 dwe mar abiriyo nyaka tarik 03 dwe mar apar higa mar 2024

English: NTSA reminds residents of Bomet County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet in warbixinta degdegga ah ee xanta xoolaha ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NTSA parone jogweng'o mag County mar Bomet ni lando piyo piyo mag jamni konyo rito gwenge.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service informs fish farmers in Nakuru County of new market linkage opportunities this June.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawafahamisha wafugaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Juni hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku wargalinayaa kalluumeysatada kalluunka ee Gobolka Nakuru fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur ma pidho rech e gweng' mar Nakuru thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Jun.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds needy students in Nandi County that free digital learning content applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba maombi ya bure ya maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka ayaa xasuusinaya ardayda u baahan degmada Nandi in codsiyada barnaamijyada barashada bilaashka ah ee dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e county mar Nandi ni chenro mag somo mar digital ma onge chudo chiegni rumo.

English: Ensure safety! Schools, address unrest causes promptly.
Kiswahili: Hakikisha usalama! Shule, shughulikia visababishi vya machafuko haraka.
Somali: Iskuullada, si deg deg ah wax uga qabso sababaha rabshadaha.
Dholuo: Sikuru ka utiyo gi skunde e tieko gik makelo ywaruok mapiyo kaka nyalore.

English: KALRO advises milk producers in Kisii County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inashauri wazalishaji wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kisii kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KALRO waxay kula talineysaa soosaarayaasha caanaha ee degmada Kisii inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KALRO nyiso jopur mag chak e gweng' mar Kisii ni gidonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Bungoma County that access to subsidised dialysis is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba upatikanaji wa dialysis ya ruzuku sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya dadweynaha degmada Bungoma in helitaanka dialysis-ka la taageeray ay hadda laga heli karaa xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji duto e County mar Bungoma ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mar dialysis e kuonde moyier.

English: Ministry of Education advises applicants in Isiolo County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Isiolo inay dalbadaan booska TVET ee KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e taon mar Isiolo mondo oketgi e tiegruok mar TVET kokalo kuom KUCCPS.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will train farmers in Murang'a County on conservation tillage this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Murang'a juu ya kilimo cha uhifadhi Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa tababar siin doonta beeraleyda degmada Murang'a ku saabsan beerashada ilaalinta bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Rapar: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro tiego jopur e County mar Murang'a e weche mag pidho puothe e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: KALRO will train farmers in Samburu County on organic farming this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu juu ya kilimo hai Septemba hii.
Somali: Xusuusin: KALRO waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda gobolka Samburu ee beeraha dabiiciga ah bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Rapar: KALRO biro tiego jopur e county mar Samburu e wi pur mar yien e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Keep the umbilical cord stump dry and clean to prevent infection.
Kiswahili: Weka kisiki cha kitovu kikavu na kisafi ili kuzuia maambukizi.
Somali: Si looga hortago infekshanka u ilaali qolofka xarkaha qolofta oo qalalan oo nadiif ah.
Dholuo: Mondo kik ng'ato bed gi tuwo moro amora, beduru maler kendo kik ubed gi tuo moro amora.

English: KTDA encourages farmers in Kitui County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for avocado.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa ili kupata bei bora ya parachichi.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kitui inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan avocado.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kitui mondo oti gi nengo matin mar avocado mondo giyud nengo maber moloyo.

English: Kenya: Impacts of climatic shocks on communities - April 2024
Kiswahili: Kenya: Athari za majanga ya hali ya hewa kwa jamii - Aprili 2024
Somali: Kenya: Saamaynta ay ku yeelatay shoogga cimilada ee bulshooyinka - Abriil 2024
Dholuo: Kenya: Ber mag yamo mag kor lwasi kuom oganda - Ang'wen higa mar 2024

English: KRA reminds voters in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet in ay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor inta aan la helin waxbarasho.
Dholuo: KRA oparo ne josiasa e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni mondo gidhi e centre man machiegni mar IEBC kapok giyudo tiegruok.

English: Notice: HELB launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay bilawday barnaamij adeegyo hagis iyo la-talin ah oo ku yaal dugsiyada degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: HELB chako chenro mar konyo kendo chiwo paro e skunde duto e gweng' mar Kisumu.

English: Isiolo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Isiolo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Juni 2023
Somali: Degmada Isiolo: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Isiolo: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2023

English: Notice: KUCCPS reminds citizens in Kisumu County about their rights regarding devolution.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: Xusuusin: KUCCPS waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Kisumu xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KUCCPS paronwa raia mag Kisumu County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar golo pesa.

English: CDC encourages mothers in Mombasa County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Mombasa inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo mine manie county mar Mombasa mondo olimgi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Notice: FAO will train farmers in Bungoma County on water harvesting this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma juu ya uvunaji wa maji Machi hii.
Somali: Xusuusin: FAO waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Bungoma oo ku saabsan goosashada biyaha bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: FAO biro tiego jopur e gweng' mar Bungoma e dwe mar Mach.

English: NPS reminds mobile money users in Taita-Taveta County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: NPS paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e Taita-Taveta County mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo gitang' gi weche mag phishing.

English: TVET calls on the community in Kwale County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TVET inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TVET waxay bulshada degmada Kwale ugu baaqeysaa inay u wargeliyaan maamulka iskuulka wixii dhibaato ah ee ku saabsan amniga si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: TVET dwaro ni oganda mar Kwale County ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar skul kuom weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skunde.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health will hold a trauma counselling forum in Wajir County this December. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya itafanya kongamano la ushauri wa kiwewe katika Kaunti ya Wajir Desemba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay qaban doontaa madasha la-talinta dhaawaca ee Gobolka Wajir bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth biro timo romo mar chiwo paro e wi tuoche e dwe mar Desemba e kaunti mar Wajir.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Wajir County about the importance of safe water storage for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Wajir juu ya umuhimu wa uhifadhi wa maji salama kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay dadka degmada Wajir ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne ji e County mar Wajir kuom ber mar kano pi maler e ngima joot.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds residents of Kiambu County that conservation tillage improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba kilimo cha uhifadhi kinaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba la muda mrefu.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu in beerashada ilaalinta ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jogweng' mar County mar Kiambu ni chwoyo puothe e yor ritruok medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: The organization for most dpendent medicine, will suspent distribution of this important drugs from USAID, whose decision will affect distribution of malaria and HIV AIDS drugs
Kiswahili: Shirika kwa ajili ya dawa zaidi kutegemea, kusimamisha usambazaji wa dawa hii muhimu kutoka USAID, ambaye uamuzi wake kuathiri usambazo wa malaria na HIV AIDS dawa
Somali: Ururka daaweynta ugu badan ee ku tiirsan, wuxuu joojin doonaa qaybinta daawooyinka muhiimka ah ee USAID, go'aankaasoo saameyn ku yeelan doona qaybinta daroogada malaria iyo HIV AIDS
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth madwaro thieth mang'eny, biro chungo thieth maduong'ni mar USAID, ma yiero mare biro mulo thieth mar malaria kod tuoche mag HIV kod AIDS.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kitui.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu furayaa codsiyada deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan ardayda ku jira Gobolka Kitui.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj chako kwayo mondo jopuonjre modhier oyud osik e alwora mar Kitui County.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges the public in Bomet County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Kenya Red Cross inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha degmada Bomet inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada lacagta mobilada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ji duto e county mar Bomet mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche mag wuond motudore gi pesa mitimo gi simo.

Dholuo: Riwruok mar State for TVET jiwo jogo madwaro yudo tiegruok e kaunti mar Nyandarua mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud thuolo mar dhi e skundno.

Dholuo: NDMA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo tembe e gweng' mar Turkana mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

Kiswahili: KEMSA yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Desemba juu ya uhifadhi wa maji salama katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.

Dholuo: KEMSA chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Desemba kuom wach kano pi maler e County duto mar Vihiga.
