English: CDC appeals to caregivers in Vihiga County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the May maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya harakati za afya ya uzazi ya Mei.
Somali: CDC waxay u baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Vihiga inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka bisha Maajo.
Dholuo: CDC kwayo jorit e County mar Vihiga mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathine kaka achiel kuom chenro mar Mayo Maternal Health drive.

English: EACC announces improved turnaround times for e-Citizen registration in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: EACC inatangaza nyakati bora za kujiandikisha kwa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: EACC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee Gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: EACC olando lokruok e seche mag kwayo ji mondo odonj e e-Citizen registration e County mar Nyandarua.

English: ODPP urges residents of Nyamira County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: ODPP ojiwo jogweng' Nyamira County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e loso nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: Non-compliant schools to close after safety audit.
Kiswahili: Shule zisizofuata sheria zitafungwa baada ya ukaguzi wa usalama.
Somali: Dugsiyada aan u hoggaansamin in la xiro ka dib baaritaanka ammaanka.
Dholuo: Skunde ma ok luw chike mag sirkal ibiro gol bang' timo nonro mar ritruok.

English: KTDA promotes water harvesting among farmers in Trans Nzoia County as part of the June climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: KTDA inakuza uvunaji wa maji miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Juni.
Somali: KTDA waxay dhiirrigelisay goosashada biyaha beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Juun.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo choko pi e kind jopur e Trans Nzoia County kaka achiel kuom chenro mar dwe mar Jun mar kedo gi tuoche.

English: Ministry of Education invites youth in Kiambu County to enroll for electrical installation training this April.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Aprili hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku casuumaysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kiambu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok gwelo rowere e Kaunti mar Kiambu mondo odonj e tiegruok mar keto sitima e dwe mar April.

English: AFA urges rice growers in Turkana County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Turkana kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda bariiska ee degmada Turkana inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobka si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur ma pidho kodhi e County mar Turkana mondo oti gi nengo ma gichiwo mar yien kapok koth ochue mondo omed kelo nyak e higani.

English: Council of Governors warns public officers in Tana River County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linaonya maafisa wa umma katika Wilaya ya Tana River dhidi ya kupotosha fedha za umma.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ka digeen saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Tana River in ay ka faa'iideystaan dhaqaale dawladeed.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e taon mar Tana River County ni kik giti gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo e yo marach.

English: Public notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will host a free food safety outreach in Kericho County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itakuwa mwenyeji wa uhamasishaji wa usalama wa chakula bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Kericho Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay marti gelineysaa adeeg bilaash ah oo ku saabsan badbaadada cuntada ee degmada Kericho bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo chenro mar chiwo kony maonge chudo mar chiemo e County mar Kericho e dwe mar April.

English: NDMA urges motorists and pedestrians in Mandera County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa wadayaasha gawaarida iyo dadka lugta leh ee degmada Mandera inay u hoggaansamaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay adeegsadaan meelaha lugta loo qoondeeyey si looga hortago dhacdooyinka abaarta la xiriira.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo jorit mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Mandera mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe mondo gikwed masiche mag oro.

English: IPOA urges motorists and pedestrians in Baringo County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Baringo inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada fatahaada ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo joidh mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Baringo mondo kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o mondo kik gitim aksident mag ndara.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds schools in Nakuru County to strengthen anti-bullying measures this October.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuimarisha hatua za kupambana na uonevu Oktoba hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada Waxbarashada ayaa xusuusinaya dugsiyada degmada Nakuru inay xoojiyaan tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibaatada bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne skunde man Nakuru County mondo omed jiwo yore mag kedo gi nindruok e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Isiolo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Isiolo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2023
Somali: Degmada Isiolo: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Isiolo: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Julaini 2023

English: TVET reminds youth in Mombasa County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Mombasa in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa rowere man Mombasa County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar chiemo kod mar rwako welo.

English: CDC reminds the public in Laikipia County about the importance of tobacco control for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia juu ya umuhimu wa udhibiti wa tumbaku kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: CDC waxay dadweynaha degmada Laikipia ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay xakamaynta sigaarka caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji duto e County mar Laikipia kuom gimomiyo thieth mar madho ndawa en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Ministry of Education distributes tablets equipped with preloaded curriculum content for youth in community learning centers.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu hutoa vidonge vyenye maudhui ya mafunzo yaliyopakiwa mapema kwa vijana katika vituo vya elimu vya jumuiya.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay u qaybiso xarumaha waxbarashada bulshada kiniiniyo leh waxyaabaha ku jira barnaamijyada waxbarasho ee horay loo soo dejiyey dhalinyarada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok chiwo tablet moting'o weche mag tiegruok ne rowere e kuonde ma ji puonjoree.

English: Notice: DCI issues a cybersecurity alert on mobile money scams affecting residents of Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu zinazoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile ee saameynaya dadka deggan degmada Bomet.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: DCI ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity e wi timbe mag wuondruok ma timore ne joma odak e alwora mar Bomet County.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Narok County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Narok kumtia moyo rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Narok inuu dhiirrigeliyo saaxiibkiisa dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit jiwo ng'ato ang'ata man Narok County ma nigi chandruok mar paro mondo ojiw osiepne moro ma chandore omany kony.

English: Kenya Dairy Board informs horticultural produce farmers in Laikipia County of new market linkage opportunities this April.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawafahamisha wakulima wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Aprili hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku wargalinayaa beeraleyda wax soo saarka beeraha ee Gobolka Laikipia fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur ma loso puothe e county mar Laikipia thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar April.

English: The Financial Action Task Force commended Kenya for expanding efforts to counter terrorism financing.
Kiswahili: Kikundi cha Kazi cha Utekelezaji wa Fedha kilimsifu Kenya kwa kupanua juhudi za kupambana na ufadhili wa ugaidi.
Somali: Kooxda Waxqabadka Maaliyadeed ayaa bogaadisay Kenya dadaalkeeda ballaaran ee la dagaalanka maalgelinta argagixisada.
Dholuo: Riwruogno ne opwoyo Kenya kuom timo kinda mar kedo gi pesa ma siro timbe mahundu.

English: E-Citizen updates residents of Migori County on progress of community-based development programmes this January.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawajulisha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Migori juu ya maendeleo ya mipango ya maendeleo katika jumuiya mwezi huu wa Januari.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay dadka deggan degmada Migori ka wargelineysaa horumarka barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada ee bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: E-Citizen miyo jodak mag Migori County ng'eyo dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag oganda e dwe mar Januar.

English: Investment and skills integration are crucial for unlocking Africa s agrifood potential Stakeholders are urged to engage in reforms and seek financing solutions to address existing challenges
Kiswahili: Uwekezaji na ushirikiano wa ujuzi ni muhimu kwa kufungua uwezo wa kilimo wa Afrika Wadau wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mageuzi na kutafuta ufumbuzi wa kifedha ili kutatua changamoto zilizopo.
Somali: Maalgashiga iyo isdhexgalka xirfadaha ayaa muhiim u ah furitaanka awoodda cuntada beeraha ee Afrika Dhinacyada daneeyayaasha ah ayaa lagu booriyay inay ku hawlan yihiin isbeddellada iyo raadinida xalal maalgelin ah si looga hortago caqabadaha jira
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma nigi paro makare onego otim lokruok mondo gimi ji thuolo mar timo dongruok e yore mag chiemo e piny Afrika

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of Kisii County about a rise in identity theft and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: Kenya Red Cross inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii juu ya kuongezeka kwa wizi wa kitambulisho na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii kororka xadgudubka aqoonsiga waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kisii County kuom dongruok mar kwalo kitgi kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will open a tea collection centre in Kitui County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itafungua kituo cha kukusanya chai katika Kaunti ya Kitui Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xarun soo ururinta shaaha ka furi doontaa Gobolka Kitui bisha May.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro yawo ot mar choko chai e County mar Kitui e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will train farmers in Nyamira County on conservation tillage this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira juu ya kilimo cha uhifadhi Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka ayaa tababar siin doona beeraleyda degmada Nyamira ee ku saabsan beerashada ilaalinta bisha Ogosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro tiego jopur e County mar Nyamira e wi puodho mar ritruok e dwe mar Agost.

English: All COVID-19 vaccines are safe for use by adults, breastfeeding mothers and as per current WHO guidelines, can also be used by pregnant women upon recommendation by a qualified physician.
Kiswahili: Chanjo zote za COVID-19 ni salama kwa matumizi ya watu wazima, akina mama wanaonyonyesha na kulingana na miongozo ya sasa ya WHO, zinaweza pia kutumiwa na wanawake wajawazito kwa mapendekezo ya daktari aliyehitimu.
Somali: Dhammaan tallaallada COVID-19 waxay ammaan u yihiin dadka waaweyn, hooyooyinka naas nuujinaya iyo sida ku cad tilmaamaha WHO ee hadda jira, haweenka uurka leh ayaa sidoo kale isticmaali kara talobixinta dhakhtarka aqoonta leh.
Dholuo: Yore duto mag thieth mar COVID-19 gin mag ritruok ne joma dongo, mine machiemo kendo kaluwore gi chike mag sani mag WHO, mon ma nigi ich bende nyalo tiyo kodgi ka laktar molony onyisi.

English: DCI urges the community in Mombasa County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb fraud.
Kiswahili: DCI inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu usiowajua ili kuzuia udanganyifu.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Mombasa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha si loo xakameeyo khiyaamooyinka.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo ji duto manie County mar Mombasa mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo gikwed mibadhi.

English: State Department for TVET reminds parents in Baringo County that adult literacy classes registration is open this October.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba usajili wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima umefunguliwa Oktoba hii.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Baringo in diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ay furan tahay bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET oparo ne jonyuol man Baringo County ni ikruok mar somo mar jomatindo osechakore e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Kenya: Drought Response - Operational Presence (As of November 2022)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Mwitikio wa Ukame - Uwepo wa Kiutendaji (Kuanzia Novemba 2022)
Somali: Kenya: Jawaabta Abaaraha - Joogitaanka Hawlgalka (Laga bilaabo Noofambar 2022)
Dholuo: Kenya: Duoko mar Oro - Bedo e Tich (Chakre dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2022)

English: KALRO urges farmers in Nakuru County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nakuru inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo lagu soo ururiyo biyaha beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: Kenya Red Cross launches a July awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Julai juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay bilaabeysaa olole wacyi galineed bishii July oo ku saabsan wacyiga cadaadiska sare ee Gobolka Kwale.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Julai e wi wach remo mang'eny e gweng' mar Kwale.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response appeals to caregivers in Lamu County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the September maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Lamu kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Septemba.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Lamu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka ee Sebtember.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo kwayo jorit e County mar Lamu mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi kaka achiel kuom chenro mag thieth ma timore e dwe mar Septemba.

English: IPOA alerts residents of Kakamega County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega juu ya kuongezeka kwa visa vya wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: IPOA waxay uga digtay dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega kororka kiisaska xoolaha lagu xado waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: IPOA chiwo siem ne ji modak e Kaunti mar Kakamega kuom medruok mar weche mag kwalo jamni kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Kenya Lamu - Population Movement: DREF Operation (MDRKE064)
Kiswahili: Kenya Lamu - Harakati za Idadi ya Watu: Operesheni ya DREF (MDRKE064)
Somali: Kenya Lamu - Dhaqdhaqaaqa Dadweynaha: Hawlgalka DREF (MDRKE064)
Dholuo: Kenya Lamu - Riwruok mar Kwan Oganda: Tich mar DREF (MDRKE064)

English: TVET advises students in Taita-Taveta County to register early to secure allocation to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali.
Somali: TVET waxay ardayda degmada Taita-Taveta kula talineysaa inay horay u diiwaangeliyaan si ay u helaan kaalmo ay ku helaan kombiyuutarada iskuulka barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jopuonjre manie Taita-Taveta County mondo odonj e tiegruok chon mondo giyud thuolo mar tiyo gi kompyuta mag skul kaluwore gi chenro mar somo gi somo mar digital.

English: Ministry of Health urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Mandera County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Degmada Mandera inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pachgi e County mar Mandera mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Continue extension services and agricultural advisories to farmers, and encourage close monitoring of weekly weather forecasts.
Kiswahili: Endelea huduma za upanuzi na ushauri wa kilimo kwa wakulima, na uhamasishe ufuatiliaji wa karibu wa utabiri wa hali ya hewa wa kila wiki.
Somali: Sii wad adeegyada fidinta iyo talo-bixinta beeraha ee beeraleyda, iyo dhiirrigelinta kormeerka dhow ee saadaasha cimilada toddobaadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Dhi nyime chiwo kony e weche mag pidho kod tiego jopur e weche mag pur, kendo jiwo mondo omany matut weche ma timore juma ka juma.

English: The newly elected KTDA board is urged to implement reforms that will enhance support for over 600 000 smallholder tea farmers Immediate action is required to prioritize farmers interests
Kiswahili: Bodi mpya ya KTDA imehimizwa kutekeleza mageuzi ambayo yataongeza uungwaji mkono kwa wakulima wadogo wa chai zaidi ya 600,000. Hatua za haraka zinahitajika ili kutanguliza maslahi ya wakulima.
Somali: Guddiga cusub ee KTDA ayaa lagu baaqay in la fuliyo isbeddelo si loo xoojiyo taageerada in ka badan 600 000 beeraleyda shaaha yaryar ee beeraleyda ah waxaa loo baahan yahay tallaabo deg deg ah si loo mudnaado danaha beeraleyda
Dholuo: Oganda manyien mar KTDA, ma ne oyud yiero, ogwel mondo otim lokruok mabiro miyo oteg jolup chai matindo makalo 600,000, kendo dwarore ni otim mapiyo mondo omi ber mar jopur obed mokwongo

English: State Department for Basic Education encourages residents of Garissa County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on voter registration.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kukaa na habari juu ya usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Dowladda waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Garissa inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada si ay uga warqabaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Garissa mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county mondo ging'e weche duto motudore gi kad mar josiasa.

English: IEBC updates residents of Nakuru County on progress of community-based development programmes this April.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru juu ya maendeleo ya programu za maendeleo ya jamii Aprili hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay dadka deggan degmada Nakuru ka wargelineysaa horumarka barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada ee bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: IEBC osemiyo jogweng' Nakuru ong'eyo dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag oganda e dwe mar April.

English: EACC reminds residents of Embu County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu wanaohudhuria mkutano wa umma wa kusanyiko la kaunti kuimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu ee ka qeybgalaya kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada ayaa xoojinaya maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: EACC paronwa jogweng' Embu County ma biro e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo omed jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Murang'a County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Murang'a inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kalfadhiga tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e county mar Murang'a mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e chokruok mabiro.

English: Huduma Kenya encourages first-time voters in Nairobi County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku dhiirigelisay codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Nairobi inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya ojiwo josiasa mokwongo e Nairobi County mondo onyis weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: HELB advises students in Nakuru County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: HELB inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kufikia kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali.
Somali: HELB waxay ardayda degmada Nakuru kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jopuonjre e kaunti mar Nakuru mondo okonygi gi chenro mar somo e intanet mondo giyud thuolo mar tiyo gi kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar somo kod somo mar digital.

English: Kenya Red Cross alerts residents of Tana River County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara wa magari na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay uga digtay dadka deggan degmada Tana River in ay kordheen kiisaska gaadiidka la xaday waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar Tana River County kuom wach medruok mar wuondo mtokni kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Turkana County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Turkana: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Februari 2024
Somali: Degmada Turkana: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Turkana: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2024

English: Notice: IEBC opens applications for revision guides for learners in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay u furaysaa codsiyada hagaha dib u eegista ardayda degmada Kakamega.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC oyawo kwayo mag somo mondo okony jopuonjre e alwora mar Kakamega.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association will hold a trauma counselling forum in Kisii County this March. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitafanya kongamano la ushauri nasaha wa kiwewe katika Kaunti ya Kisii Machi hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha la talinta dhaawaca ee degmada Kisii bishii Maarso. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni Kenya Medical Association biro timo chokruok mar chiwo paro e wi tuoche e dwe mar Mach e gweng' mar Kisii.

English: KEMRI urges residents of Nyamira County to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night following a rise in reported Rift Valley Fever cases.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na dawa za kuua wadudu kila usiku kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska laga soo sheegay Cudurka Rift Valley.
Dholuo: KEMRI ojiwo jogweng' Nyamira County mondo oti gi net mag choke molos gi yedhe maketho ring'o otieno ka otieno nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuwo mar Rift Valley Fever osemedore.

English: KTDA reminds farmers in Kilifi County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Somali: KTDA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kilifi barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee ka dambeeya goosashada.
Dholuo: KTDA parone jopur manie County Kilifi chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime bang' keyo.

English: CDC encourages residents of Nyeri County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay u dhiiri galiyaan saaxiibo dhibaataysan inay caawimaad raadsadaan.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo jogweng' Nyeri County mondo kik gisandre aling' ling' kendo mondo gijiw osiepgi moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: EACC urges residents of Kiambu County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia laini ya bure ya kupigia simu ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee lacag la'aanta ah si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jogweng' Kiambu County mondo ochiw ripot kuom weche mag mibadhi kokalo kuom simo ma onge chudo mar EACc mondo giked gi timbe mag wuondruok e weche mag yuto.

English: KRA urges residents of Kisumu County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u soo gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo jogweng'o mag Kisumu County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet mondo gidonj e ywaruok mag yuto.

English: Market accessibility and guidelines in agricultural activity is important. Let it remembered farmers adjacentvyo markets, reap big...
Kiswahili: Upatikanaji wa soko na miongozo katika shughuli za kilimo ni muhimu. Wacha ikumbuke wakulima karibu na masoko, wavune kubwa...
Somali: Suuqa la heli karo iyo tilmaamaha shaqada beeraha waa muhiim. ha xusuusato beeraleyda ku dhow suuqyada, goosashada weyn ...
Dholuo: Mondo omi ji obed thuolo mar dhi e ohala, dwarore ni giket pachgi kuom tijgi mag pur, kendo mondo giket pachgi kuom jopur ma ne ni machiegni gi ohalago, kendo ne gichop gik ma ne gigolo e ohalago.

English: KMTC urges residents of Isiolo County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo inay iska diiwaangeliyaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KMTC jiwo jogweng' Isiolo County mondo odonj e program mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo mondo giyud somo mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education opens a new tailoring and design programme at the vocational centre in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inafungua programu mpya ya ushonaji na kubuni katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka waxay ka furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo loogu talagalay qaabeynta iyo naqshadeynta xarunta xirfadeed ee degmada Nakuru.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Puonjruok ma Chakre e Piny owacho ochako chenro manyien mar loso piche kendo loso gik moko e otas mar tiegruok e gweng' mar Nakuru.

English: OGP invites residents of Wajir County to attend the public participation forum regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: OGP inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: OGP waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir inay ka qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan habka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: OGP gwelo ji duto modak e county mar Wajir mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenro mar bajet mar county.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit launches a November awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Novemba juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa billowday olole wacyigelin ah bishii Nofeembar oo ku saabsan baaritaanka sonkorowga gobolka Garissa.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Novemba e wi nonro mar thieth mar sukari e gweng' mar Garissa.

English: ODPP announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: ODPP inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee Gobolka Kilifi.
Dholuo: ODPP olando lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mag ng'eyo nying' e gweng' mar Kilifi.

English: E-Citizen encourages first-time voters in Turkana County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Turkana kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horeysay ee degmada Turkana inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo joma okwongo yiero e county mar Turkana mondo olim kama ichanoe ji ne IEBC.

English: Mpox outbreak in Mombasa. Two people have died from Monkey Pox disease. Mombasa County has reported 98 Monkey Pox cases. There is a lot of active community transmission
Kiswahili: Mlipuko wa Mpox Mombasa. Watu wawili wamefariki kutokana na ugonjwa wa Tumbili. Kaunti ya Mombasa imeripoti visa 98 vya Tumbili. Kuna maambukizi mengi ya kijamii yanayoendelea
Somali: Faafaha Mpox ee Mombasa. Labo qof ayaa u dhintay cudurka Monkey Pox. Gobolka Mombsa ayaa soo sheegay 98 kiis oo Monkeypox ah. Waxaa jira tiro badan oo ka mid ah gudbinta bulshada ee firfircoon
Dholuo: Ng'ato ariyo osetho nikech tuwo mar Monkey Pox. County mar Mombasa osewacho ni nitie ji 98 ma nigi tuwo mar monkey pox.

English: EACC invites residents of Marsabit County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: EACC inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Marsabit kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya wilaya.
Somali: EACC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: EACC gwelo jogweng' mar Marsabit County mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso bajet mar county ochopo.

English: DREF Operation Kenya Complex Emergency 2025
Kiswahili: Operesheni ya DREF ya Dharura Changamano ya Kenya 2025
Somali: Hawlgalka DREF ee Xarunta Kenya ee Degdegga ah 2025
Dholuo: Tich mar DREF e piny Kenya mapek mar masira 2025

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit calls on parents in Nyeri County to have children under five screened for cyclosporiasis during the November outreach.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuwafanyia uchunguzi wa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa cyclosporiasis wakati wa mawasiliano ya Novemba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Nyeri in carruurta ka yar shan sano la baaro cudurka cyclosporiasis inta lagu gudajiro bisha Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit okwayo jonyuol e County mar Nyeri mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Novemba.

English: As Kenya records rising malaria cases due to climate variability, the just ended World Malaria Day serves as a critical reminder of the need to transform public health initiatives to meet these evolving challenges
Kiswahili: Huku Kenya ikirekodi ongezeko la visa vya malaria kutokana na mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa, Siku ya Malaria Duniani iliyomalizika hivi punde inatumika kama ukumbusho muhimu wa hitaji la kubadilisha mipango ya afya ya umma ili kukabiliana na changamoto hizi zinazoendelea.
Somali: Iyada oo Kenya ay diiwaangeliso kiisaska cudurka daacuunka oo sii kordhaya sababo la xiriira kala duwanaanshaha cimilada, Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Dacuumada oo dhowaan la soo gabagabeeyay waxay u adeegtaa sidii xasuusin muhiim ah oo ku saabsan baahida loo qabo in la beddelo hindisaha caafimaadka dadweynaha si loo daboolo caqabadahaas isbeddelaya
Dholuo: Kaka Kenya medo neno kwan mag ji ma nigi malaria nikech lokruok e kit yamo, Chieng' mar Maleria e Piny Mangima ma nyocha eka orumo, en gima paronwa ahinya ni dwarore ni walok chenro mag thieth mar oganda mondo omi warom gi pek ma kamago.

English: Mental health conditions like depression can lead to physical symptoms such as fatigue and illness, highlighting the strong mind-body connection
Kiswahili: Hali za afya ya akili kama vile mfadhaiko zinaweza kusababisha dalili za kimwili kama vile uchovu na ugonjwa, na hivyo kuonyesha uhusiano mkubwa kati ya akili na mwili.
Somali: Xaaladaha caafimaadka maskaxda sida niyadjabku waxay keeni karaan calaamado jireed sida daal iyo cudur, taas oo muujineysa xiriirka xooggan ee maskaxda iyo jirka
Dholuo: Tuoche kaka depression nyalo miyo ng'ato obed gi parruok mang'eny, to mano nyiso ni nitie tudruok e kind ringre gi pache

English: Farmers are advised to prepare for a potential decrease in fertilizer prices with an announcement expected this week from the Ministry of Agriculture
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa kupungua kwa bei ya mbolea huku tangazo linalotarajiwa wiki hii kutoka kwa Wizara ya Kilimo
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isu diyaariyaan hoos u dhac suurtagal ah oo qiimaha bacriminta ah, iyadoo la filayo in toddobaadkan laga soo saaro Wasaaradda Beeraha
Dholuo: Jo-Purie ne ojiw mondo oikre ne nengo mag yien mag yien ma nyalo dok chien, kendo ne ochan mondo mi Ministry of Agriculture oland wachno e juma mar abich.

English: KMTC reminds needy students in Taita-Taveta County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kwamba vitabu vya kiada na matumizi ya vifaa vya kujifunzia vitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KMTC waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan Gobolka Taita-Taveta in buugaagta waxbarasho iyo codsiyada qalabka waxbarasho ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: KMTC parone jopuonjre man Taita-Taveta County ni buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok biro rumo machiegni.

English: TSC reminds youth in Wajir County that HELB funding is available for tailoring and design training.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni.
Somali: TSC waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Wajir in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka qaabeynta iyo naqshadeynta.
Dholuo: TSC oparo ne rowere e gweng' mar Wajir ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko.

English: FAO encourages farmers in Busia County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for avocado.
Kiswahili: FAO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora za parachichi.
Somali: FAO waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Busia inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan avocado.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e county mar Busia mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mondo giyud nengo maber mar avocado.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Kericho County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati huu wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee socotada inta lagu jiro xilliyada fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji paroga jogweng' mar Kericho mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo oti gi yore mag wuotho e kinde ma pi opong'o piny.

English: Kenya Gazette warns public officers in Taita-Taveta County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linaonya maafisa wa umma katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta dhidi ya kutumia vibaya mamlaka.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dawladda ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal man Taita-Taveta County ni kik giti marach gi migepegi.

English: Improved basic infrastructure, storage facilities and market access, reduces costs to be affordable food. Good roads accelerate farming always..
Kiswahili: Miundombinu ya msingi iliyoboreshwa, vifaa vya kuhifadhi na upatikanaji wa soko, hupunguza gharama za kuwa chakula cha bei nafuu. Barabara nzuri huharakisha kilimo kila wakati..
Somali: Kaabayaasha aasaasiga ah ee la hagaajiyay, xarumaha kaydka iyo helitaanka suuqa, waxay yareeyaan kharashaadka si cunto la awoodi karo. Waddooyinka wanaagsan waxay mar walba dedejiyaan beeraha..
Dholuo: Yo maber mar dhi e yore mag pur miyo tij pur medore.

English: Free menstrual cups for 1 million schoolgirls ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…â€œ collect from health center this week!
Kiswahili: Kikombe cha hedhi cha bure kwa wasichana wa shule milioni moja wanapokea kutoka kituo cha afya wiki hii!
Somali: Koobabka caadada oo bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay 1 milyan oo gabdho dugsile ah ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…â€œ waxay ka soo ururiyaan xarunta caafimaadka toddobaadkan!
Dholuo: Kopo mag dwe ma nono ne nyithindo ma nyiri ma skul milion achiel ma ibiro chok e kar thieth jumani ka!

English: The Emergency Hub will also oversee a variety of sub-regional activities in Eastern Africa, including maintaining stockpiles of medical and logistical supplies and stationing WHO staff to ensure quick deployment during emergencies.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Dharura pia kitasimamia shughuli mbalimbali za kanda ndogo katika Afrika Mashariki, ikiwa ni pamoja na kutunza akiba ya vifaa vya matibabu na vifaa na kuweka vituo vya wafanyakazi wa WHO ili kuhakikisha kupelekwa kwa haraka wakati wa dharura.
Somali: Xarunta Gurmadka Degdegga ah waxay sidoo kale kormeeri doontaa hawlo kala duwan oo ka socda gobollo hoosaadyada Bariga Afrika, oo ay ku jiraan ilaalinta kaydka sahayda caafimaadka iyo saadka iyo meelaynta shaqaalaha WHO si loo hubiyo in si degdeg ah loo hawlgeliyo inta lagu jiro xaaladaha degdegga ah.
Dholuo: Hub mar Emergency bende biro rito tije mopogore opogore mag ng’om matin e Afrika ma Wuokchieng’, moriwo nyaka rito gik ma oting’o mag thieth kod gik ma dwarore kendo keto jotich mag WHO mondo gine ni giorogi mapiyo e kinde mag masira.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges residents of Siaya County to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility following a rise in reported cholera cases.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya kipindupindu vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow kadib kororka kiisaska cudurka kolera ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Siaya mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal ma machiegni nikech kwan mar ji ma nigi tuwo mar cholera osemedore.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Kisii County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku boorrinaysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Kisii inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pachgi e County mar Kisii mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: KALRO advises farmers in Kitui County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kitui inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kitui mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: KEMSA announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Bungoma County starting this June.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kuanzia Juni hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa in laga bilaabo bisha Juun ee la soo dhaafay la siinayo dadka deggan degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: KEMSA olando thieth mar dialysis mar joma odak Bungoma County kochakore dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: CDC will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Kisumu County this May. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: CDC itafanya kongamano la kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Mei hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: CDC waxay qaban doontaa madal dib u soo kabashada isticmaalka maandooriyaha degmada Kisumu bisha May. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni CDC biro timo chokruok mar chango joma tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero e gweng' mar Kisumu e dwe mar Mei.

English: KALRO announces a free lumpy skin disease vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Uasin Gishu County this June.
Kiswahili: KALRO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa ngozi kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Juni hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhawaaqday jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan cudurka maqaarka qanjirka ah ee lo'da caanaha ah ee gobolka Uasin Gishu bishii Juun.
Dholuo: KALRO ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok ma nigi pien maonge choke e dwe mar Jun e kaunti mar Uasin Gishu.

English: Acting immediately, Lucy administered lifesaving medicine to control the bleeding.
Kiswahili: Kuchukua hatua mara moja, Lucy alitoa dawa ya kuokoa maisha ili kudhibiti damu.
Somali: Isla markiiba ayay Lucy si degdeg ah u maareysay daawo badbaadinaysa nolosha si loo xakameeyo dhiigbaxa.
Dholuo: Ka ne otimo gik mapiyo, Lucy nomiyogi yath ma ne nyalo reso ngimane mondo ogeng’ remo ma ne odhi wuok.

English: While KEMRI continues to collaborate with Astra-Zeneca and Oxford university in the trials for this vaccine, the Government remains open to other collaborative opportunities.
Kiswahili: Huku KEMRI ikiendelea kushirikiana na Astra-Zeneca na chuo kikuu cha Oxford katika majaribio ya chanjo hii, Serikali inasalia wazi kwa fursa nyingine za ushirikiano.
Somali: In kasta oo KEMRI ay sii waddo inay la shaqeyso Astra-Zeneca iyo jaamacadda Oxford tijaabooyinka tallaalkan, haddana Dowladdu waxay u furan tahay fursado kale oo iskaashi ah.
Dholuo: E seche ma KEMRI pod dhi nyime tiyo kanyakla gi Astra-Zeneca kod yunivasiti mar Oxford e tembe mag thieth ni, Sirkal pod oyawo thuolo mamoko mag tiyo kanyakla.

English: Notice from Kenya Red Cross: family planning counselling clinics will run every December at designated health centres in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Desemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya: Caafimaadka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska waxaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Diseembar oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee lagu magacaabo degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ripot Mamit mar Kenya: Klinike mag chiwo paro e wi chenro mag ngima joot biro tiyo dwe mar Desemba higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e gweng' mar Kisumu.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges youth in Homa Bay County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa ku boorinaya dhalinyarada gobolka Homa Bay inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada rayidka ah ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada rayidnimada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo rowere manie Homa Bay County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiego ji kapok gitimo tije mag oganda.

English: IEBC urges residents of Kirinyaga County to register their children at the nearest public school to benefit from adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawataka wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu ili kufaidika na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kirinyaga inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha si ay uga faa'iideystaan fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kirinyaga mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul mar sirkal man machiegni kodgi mondo giyud konyruok kuom tiegruok mar somo kod somo mar joma dongo.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will distribute certified tea seed to farmers in Mombasa County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu za chai zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu abuurka shaaha ee shahaadada leh u qaybin doonaa beeraleyda gobolka Mombasa bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Dairy Board biro pogo kodhi mag chai ne jopur e County mar Mombasa e dwe mar Februar.

English: KNEC reminds schools in Nandi County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this October.
Kiswahili: KNEC inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Oktoba hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada gobolka Nandi inay xoojiyaan adeegyada hagista iyo la talinta bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KNEC oparo ne skunde man e county mar Nandi mondo omed jiwo kendo chiwo kony e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: NTSA activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NTSA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay shilalka waddooyinka ee degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NTSA tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony e masiche mag ndara e taon mar Baringo.

English: Embu (Mbeere) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for November 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Embu (Mbeere): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Novemba 2023
Somali: Degmada Embu (Mbeere): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Noofambar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Embu (Mbeere): Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar gi achiel dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2023

English: NCPB invites farmers in Kirinyaga County to a free training on greenhouse farming this November.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo cha chafu Novemba hii.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda gobolka Kirinyaga tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo bisha November.
Dholuo: NCPB ogwelo jopur e County mar Kirinyaga e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar greenhouse agriculture e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: KUCCPS opens a new ICT skills programme at the vocational centre in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inafungua programu mpya ya ujuzi wa ICT katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay ka furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan aqoonta ICT xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Laikipia.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KUCCPS chako chenro manyien mar lony e yore mag ICT e skul mar tiegruok e county mar Laikipia.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development warns maize farmers in Samburu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawaonya wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay uga digtay beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee Gobolka Samburu cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysay inay gacan ka geystaan waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ochiwo siem ne jopur mag kodhi e county mar Samburu kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ochiwo paro mar kawo okang' e kinde mowinjore.

English: Provide first aid kits 2020.
Kiswahili: Toa vifaa vya huduma ya kwanza 2020.
Somali: Bixinta qalabka gargaarka koowaad ee 2020.
Dholuo: Chiw gige konyruok mokwongo 2020.

English: E-Citizen invites residents of Nyamira County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandaoni wa kaunti kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: E-Citizen gwelo joma odak e County mar Nyamira mondo oriwre gi county's online participation portal e wi chenro mar bajet mar county.

English: Ministry of Education urges residents of Nairobi County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kutuma maombi ya bursari hiyo kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jogweng' mar Nairobi County mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud somo mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service invites farmers in Marsabit County to a free training on fertiliser application this July.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kupata mafunzo ya bure juu ya matumizi ya mbolea Julai hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku casuumay beeraleyda degmada Marsabit inay tababar bilaash ah ku helaan isticmaalka Bacriminta bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service ogwelo jopur e County mar Marsabit e tiegruok maonge chudo e dwe mar Julai.

English: Coughing! Fever! Night sweats! Chest pains! Weight loss! You could have TB. Testing and treatment are free at all public hospitals!Get tested today!
Kiswahili: Kikohozi! Homa! Jasho la usiku! Maumivu ya kifua! Kupunguza uzito! Unaweza kuwa na TB. Upimaji na matibabu ni bure katika hospitali zote za umma! Pima leo!
Somali: Duufaanta, hargabka, dareenka, xanuunka laabta, miisaanka luminta, cudurka TB-ga, baaritaanka iyo daaweynta waa lacag la'aan dhamaan isbitaalada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ng'ato nyalo bedo gi tuwo mar TB, thieth kod thieth gin maonge chudo e osiptal duto mag sirkal, tim nonro kawuono!

English: Office of the Auditor-General updates residents of Mombasa County on progress of ward-level service delivery this July.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa juu ya maendeleo ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya mwezi huu Julai.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Mombasa ka warbixiyaa horumarka adeegyada lagu bixiyo degmooyinka bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General miyo ji duto modak e County mar Mombasa ng'eyo dongruok mar tich mitimo e gwenge mopogore opogore e dwe mar Julai.

English: NDMA warns residents of Siaya County to prepare for possible road accidents this September.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kujiandaa kwa ajali zinazowezekana za barabarani Septemba hii.
Somali: NDMA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay u diyaargaroobaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: NDMA osiemo jogweng' mar Siaya County mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Septemba.

English: The IRC, LEGO Foundation, and Grundfos Foundation launch a new $27 million program aimed at enhancing teaching and learning experiences among refugee and host community children in Kenya
Kiswahili: IRC, LEGO Foundation, na Grundfos Foundation yazindua mpango mpya wa dola milioni 27 unaolenga kuimarisha uzoefu wa kufundisha na kujifunza miongoni mwa wakimbizi na watoto wa jamii wanaowakaribisha nchini Kenya.
Somali: Hay'adda IRC, Hay'adda LEGO, iyo Hay'adda Grundfos waxay bilaabeen barnaamij cusub oo $27 milyan ah oo loogu talagalay in lagu horumariyo khibradaha waxbaridda iyo waxbarashada ee carruurta qaxootiga iyo bulshada martida loo yahay ee Kenya.
Dholuo: IRC, LEGO, kod Grundfos ochako chenro manyien mar dola milion 27 ma nigi gino mar medo puonj kod somo e kind nyithindo ma jolweny kod nyithindo ma odak e piny Kenya .

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will train farmers in Mombasa County on terracing this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa juu ya mashindano ya terracing Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa tababar siin doona beeraleyda gobolka Mombasa ku saabsan dhulka lagu beeray bisha May ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Dairy Board biro tiego jopur e county mar Mombasa e wi terracing e dwe mar Mei.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds the public in Narok County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Narok kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu dadka degmada Narok ku xasuusinayaa in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone ji duto manie Narok County ni chiwo ripot mar kawo asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.
