English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Trans Nzoia County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the February planting season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kupitisha aina zilizothibitishwa za mbegu zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Februari.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda Trans Nzoia County inay qaataan noocyo abuurka ah oo abaarta u adkaysta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Febraayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur e Trans Nzoia County mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro ka pok ochopo ndalo mag pidho kodhi e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: IEBC opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa codsiyada deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan ardayda ku jira gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC oyawo kwayo mag yudo riekni mag somo ne jopuonjre man gi dwaro mag somo e county mar Nyandarua.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public in Vihiga County that access to SHA registration is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba ufikiaji wa usajili wa SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Vihiga in diiwaangelinta SHA ay hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji duto e County mar Vihiga ni somo SHA sani yudore e kuonde moyier.

English: A good business plan is ideal like cereal production. Learn basic tips and how to progress.
Kiswahili: Mkakati mzuri wa biashara ni mzuri kama uzalishaji wa nafaka. Jifunze vidokezo vya msingi na jinsi ya kufanya maendeleo.
Somali: Qorshe ganacsi oo wanaagsan waa mid aad u fiican sida wax soo saarka hadhuudhka. Baro talooyinka aasaasiga ah iyo sida loo horumariyo.
Dholuo: Bedo gi chenro maber mar timo ohala en gima ber mana kaka loso cham. Puonjri puonj madongo kod kaka inyalo timo dongruok.

English: Ministry of Education reminds youth in Mombasa County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Mombasa in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka farsamada gawaarida gawaariyada.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Puonjruok parone rowere e County mar Mombasa ni pesa ma HELB chiwo yudore ne tiegruok mar masinde mag mtokni.

English: Notice: TVET launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay bilaabaysaa barnaamij lagu daro ardayda naafada ah dugsiyada guud ahaan degmada Tharaka-Nithi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: TVET chako chenro mar tiego nyithindo ma nigi midekre e skunde duto mag Tharaka-Nithi County.

English: TSC calls on the community in Nyamira County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TSC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TSC waxay bulshada degmada Nyamira ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyada.
Dholuo: TSC okwayo ji duto manie County mar Nyamira mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: KNEC reminds parents in Marsabit County that bursary allocation registration is open this January.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba usajili wa ugawaji wa bursari umefunguliwa Januari hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Marsabit in diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ay furan tahay bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: KNEC parone jonyuol e gweng' mar Marsabit ni kad mar chiwo mich mag tiegruok osechakore e dwe mar Januar.

English: DPP urges anyone experiencing abuse in West Pokot County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: DPP inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kuripoti kesi hiyo kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka gobolka West Pokot inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e West Pokot County mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response launches a September awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Migori County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Septemba juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Sebtember oo ku saabsan baaritaanka sonkorowga ee degmada Migori.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuoche chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Septemba e wi nonro mar thieth mar sukari e kaunti duto mar Migori.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Nakuru County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nakuru inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qaybqaataan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur e county mar Nakuru mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will conduct a greenhouse farming workshop for farmers in Embu County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itafanya warsha ya kilimo cha chafu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo ee beeraleyda degmada Embu bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro timo tiegruok mar timo tijno ne jopur e taon mar Embu County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Kenya Red Cross announces SHA registration for residents of Busia County starting this October.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unatangaza usajili wa SHA kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kuanzia Oktoba hii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa ku dhawaaqday diiwaangelinta SHA ee dadka deggan degmada Busia laga bilaabo Oktoobarkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ogolo chik mar SHA mar ndiko joma odak e County mar Busia kochakore dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development promotes terracing among farmers in Nyeri County as part of the January climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inakuza usafirishaji kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Januari.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa kor u qaadeysa dhulka beeraleyda degmada Nyeri iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development (MARD) konyo jopur e gwenge mag Nyeri mondo odag e lowo e dwe mar Januar ka gitiyo gi chenrono.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) appeals to caregivers in Nakuru County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the April maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhudhuria siku iliyopangwa ya kliniki kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi Aprili.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Nakuru inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta bukaanka ee la qorsheeyay qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Abriil.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) kwayo jorit e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar thieth ma ne otim e dwe mar April.

English: DCI urges residents of Kwale County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DCI inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa umakini mkubwa wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nabadgelyada qaranka.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo jogweng' mar Kwale County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano ka ji medo keto pachgi kuom loso kuwe.

English: New mothers experiencing sadness, withdrawal, or hopelessness should seek mental health support. Postpartum depression is treatable.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wapya wanaopitia huzuni, kujitenga, au kukata tamaa wanapaswa kutafuta msaada wa afya ya akili. Mfadhaiko baada ya kujifungua unaweza kutibiwa.
Somali: Hooyooyinka cusub ee caloolxumo la kulma, oo ka baxsan, ama rajo la'aan ah waxay u baahan yihiin inay raadsadaan taageero caafimaad maskaxeed.
Dholuo: Min nyithindo mapok onyuol, ma chunygi onyosore, kata ma chunygi ool, onego omany kony mar rito pachgi.

English: AFA advises maize producers in Nandi County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: AFA inashauri wazalishaji wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: AFA waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha hadhuudhka ee gobolka Nandi inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: AFA nyiso jopur mag cham e county mar Nandi mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur ma biro ka kinde keyo pok ochopo.

English: Council of Governors advises residents of Machakos County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyayaashu waxay kula talinayaan dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay dalbadaan internetka iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo jogweng'o mag Machakos County mondo oketgi e intanet kokalo kuom websait mar e-Citizen sama gikwayo kwayo mag ID mar pinygi.

English: Demand accountability! Ensure school funds are used wisely.
Kiswahili: Hakikisha fedha za shule zinatumiwa kwa busara.
Somali: Ka codso xisaabtanka! Hubi in lacagaha dugsiga si caqli leh loo isticmaalo.
Dholuo: Keturu ting' mar chiwo paro, kendo timuru duto ma unyalo mondo uti gi pesago e yo mariek.

English: CDC announces free medical camps for residents of West Pokot County starting this September.
Kiswahili: CDC inatangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuanzia Septemba hii.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa xeryo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada West Pokot laga bilaabo Sebtember.
Dholuo: CDC ogolo kampen mag thieth maonge chudo ne jogweng' mar West Pokot County kochakore Septemba.

English: KMTC reminds parents in Vihiga County that free primary education registration is open this December.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba usajili wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo umefunguliwa Desemba hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Vihiga in diiwaangelinta bilaashka ah ee waxbarashada hoose ay furan tahay bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: KMTC oparo ne jonyuol e County mar Vihiga ni somo mar pinyruoth ma onge chudo osechakore e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka ayaa bilowday barnaamij lagu darayo ardayda naafada ah dugsiyada guud ahaan Degmada Tharaka-Nithi.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State for Basic Education chako chenro mar tiego nyithindo ma nigi midekre e skunde e Tharaka-Nithi County.

English: DPP alerts residents of Homa Bay County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: DPP anawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: DPP waxay dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay uga digtay kororka kiisaska gaadiidka la afduubayo waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: DPP chiwo siem ne jogweng' Homa Bay County e wi medruok mar wach kwalo mtokni kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Council of Governors reminds the public in Uasin Gishu County that input on development planning forums is welcome this November.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba mchango kwenye vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo unakaribishwa Novemba hii.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay xasuusinayaan shacabka gobolka Uasin Gishu in talooyinka ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha November.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch oparo ne ji duto e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mag dongruok e dwe mar Novemba.

English: The government is piloting an Animal Identification and Traceability System ANTITRAC to improve livestock management Expect nationwide rollout soon ensure your animals are registered
Kiswahili: Serikali inafanya majaribio ya Mfumo wa Utambulisho wa Wanyama na Ufuatiliaji wa ANTITRAC ili kuboresha usimamizi wa mifugo Tarajia usambaaji nchi nzima hivi karibuni hakikisha mifugo yako imesajiliwa.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay tijaabinaysaa Nidaamka Aqoonsiga iyo Raadraaca Xayawaanka ANTITRAC si loo hagaajiyo maaraynta xoolaha. Fil in si dhow loo bilaabo in la bilaabo in la bilaabo guud ahaan dalka hubi in xayawaankaaga la diiwaangeliyo
Dholuo: Sirkal chako tiyo gi chenro mar ANTITRAC mar fwenyo le kendo luwogi mondo okony e rito jamni.

English: KEMRI advises residents of Kisii County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuthibitisha kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMRI waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay xaqiijiyaan in xaruntooda la aqoonsaday ka hor inta aysan booqan si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMRI nyiso jogweng' Kisii County mondo ong'e ni kuondegi mag thieth oseyudo ratiro kapok gibiro e kuondego mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: EACC stresses multiâ€‘sector participation, using technology to strengthen antiâ€‘corruption action.
Kiswahili: EACC inasisitiza ushiriki wa sekta nyingi, kwa kutumia teknolojia ili kuimarisha hatua za kupambana na ufisadi.
Somali: EACC waxay xoogga saareysaa ka qaybgalka qaybaha kala duwan, iyadoo adeegsaneysa tignoolajiyada si loo xoojiyo ficillada ka dhanka ah musuqmaasuqa.
Dholuo: EACC keto geno kuom sektor mang'eny mondo odonjre, ka otiyo gi teknolojia mondo ojing'o tich mar kedo kod ketho chik.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free meningitis screening is available at all public health centres in Nakuru County this March.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa uti wa mgongo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Machi hii.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya dadweynaha in baaritaanka meningitis-ka ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Nakuru bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji ni nono tuo mar meningitis en gima onge chudo e kuonde thieth mag ji duto e gweng' mar Nakuru e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Ministry of Health will be held in Kirinyaga County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Wizara ya Afya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ay soo qabanqaabisay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa lagu qabanqaabi doonaa Gobolka Kirinyaga bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo mitimo gi Ministry of Health ibiro tim Kirinyaga County e dwe mar Agost.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free depression awareness support is available through county health facilities in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa uhamasishaji wa unyogovu unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay wacyiga niyadjabku laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Migori County.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar parruok yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth e county ma Migori County.

English: KYPA partners with IEBC for youth parliamentarian voter registration in schools.
Kiswahili: KYPA inashirikiana na IEBC kwa ajili ya usajili wa wapiga kura wa vijana wa bunge katika shule.
Somali: KYPA waxay iskaashi la yeelatay IEBC diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha dhalinyarada ee baarlamaanka ee dugsiyada.
Dholuo: KYPA noriwore gi IEBC e ndiko jong'ad bura e skunde.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission announces bursary allocation enrollment dates for schools in Busia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa bursary kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Busia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu ku dhawaaqay taariikhda diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ee dugsiyada degmada Busia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj olando tarik mag somo e skunde mag Busia County.

English: Ministry of Health hosts forum with media partners to promote breastfeeding benefits for working parents.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya huandaa jukwaa na washirika wa vyombo vya habari ili kutangaza faida za kunyonyesha kwa wazazi wanaofanya kazi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa martigelinaysa madal ay la wadaagaan warbaahinta si loo dhiirrigeliyo faa'iidooyinka naas nuujinta ee waalidiinta shaqeeya.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar piny owacho timo chokruok gi jowuoth matiyo gi weche midhiero mondo okony jonyuolgo yudo kony kuom pidho nyithindo gi minegi.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the community in Marsabit County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb fraud.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia udanganyifu.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Marsabit inay ka warbixiyaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo shaki leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo khiyaamooyinka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto manie gweng' mar Marsabit mondo onyis polis ma ni machiegni kodgi ni gitimo gik ma chwanyo ji.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Makueni County to prepare for possible road accidents this February.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Februari hii.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ka digaya dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay u diyaar garoobaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations osiemo jogweng' Makueni County ni giikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ee degmada Kiambu.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Jarit Maduong' biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi weche siasa e County mar Kiambu.

English: To trap snails away from your vegetables, place piles of fresh pawpaw leaves or cassava peels (about the size of a football) near your plots in the evening, about half a metre to a metre from the plants; collect and destroy the snails gathered on the traps early the next morning.
Kiswahili: Ili kunasa konokono mbali na mboga zako, weka marundo ya majani safi ya pawpaw au maganda ya mihogo (karibu saizi ya mpira wa miguu) karibu na viwanja vyako jioni, karibu nusu mita hadi mita kutoka kwa mimea; kukusanya na kuharibu konokono waliokusanyika kwenye mitego mapema asubuhi iliyofuata.
Somali: Si aad u qabsato qaboojiyaha ka fog khudaartaada, ku rid xidhmooyinka caleemaha cusub ee pawpaw ama qolofka cassava (oo qiyaastii u weyn kubada cagta) agagaarka dhulkaaga fiidkii, qiyaastii nus mitir ilaa mitir ka fog dhirta; soo uruuri oo baabi'i qaboojiyaha laga soo ururiyay dabinada subaxdii dambe.
Dholuo: Mondo iket tong' mabor gi cham, ket tong' mag yien manyien mag pawpaw kata tong' mag manias (ma dirom fut) machiegni gi puothego godhiambo, kama borne romo mita achiel gi nus; kendo chok kendo iketh tong' ma ichoko e tong'go gokinyi mang'ich.

English: Notice: NCPB will distribute certified beans seed to farmers in Narok County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NCPB itasambaza mbegu zilizothibitishwa za maharagwe kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay u qaybin doontaa abuurka xayawaanada la shaaciyey beeraleyda gobolka Narok bishii Maarso ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar NCPB biro pogo kodhi mag nyinyo ne jopur manie Narok County e dwe mar Mach.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds residents of Kakamega County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kakamega in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya parone jogweng' Kakamega County ni luwo dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief, July 2024
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP wa Kenya, Julai 2024
Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya, Luulyo 2024
Dholuo: Wach machuok mar piny Kenya mar WFP, dwe mar abiriyo 2024

English: TVET reminds parents in Embu County that school feeding programme registration is open this September.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Embu kwamba usajili wa programu ya kulisha shule umefunguliwa Septemba hii.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Embu in diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga ay furan tahay bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: TVET parone janyuol e county mar Embu ni chenro mar chamo nyithindo e skul osechakore e dwe mar Septemba.

English: DCI urges the community in Bungoma County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: DCI inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Bungoma inay ka fogaadaan in ay faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyadeed la wadaagaan shisheeyaha si looga hortago xannibaadda lo'da.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo ji duto manie Bungoma County mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo kik gikwed kwalo jamni.

English: Kenya identified gaps related to laboratory information system interoperability, missing patient variables, workforce capacity for data validation and initial concerns around data privacy.
Kiswahili: Kenya ilitambua mapengo yanayohusiana na ushirikiano wa mfumo wa taarifa za maabara, vigezo vinavyokosekana kwa wagonjwa, uwezo wa wafanyakazi wa kuthibitisha data na masuala ya awali kuhusu faragha ya data.
Somali: Kenya waxay aqoonsatay farqiga u dhexeeya is-dhexgalka nidaamka macluumaadka shaybaarka, isbeddellada bukaanka ee maqan, awoodda shaqaalaha ee xaqiijinta xogta iyo walaacyada bilowga ah ee ku saabsan asturnaanta xogta.
Dholuo: Kenya nofwenyo gap ma tudruok gi tiyo kanyakla mar sistem mar weche mag laboratori, gik ma nyalo lokore mag jotuwo ma onge, nyalo mar jotich mar ng’ado bura kuom weche kod parruok mokwongo e wi rito weche mag siri.

English: NDMA urges the community in Nyeri County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb carjacking.
Kiswahili: NDMA inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia utekaji nyara wa magari.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Nyeri inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo afduubka gawaarida.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo oganda manie County mar Nyeri mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polis mar oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o kwalo mtokni.

English: Beware of emails pretending to be from banks asking for account verification.
Kiswahili: Jihadharini na barua-pepe zinazodai kuwa kutoka kwa benki zinazoomba uthibitisho wa akaunti.
Somali: Ka digtoonow emails u muuqda inay ka yimaadaan bangiyada oo weydiinaya xaqiijinta xisaabta.
Dholuo: Tang' gi barupe mag e-mail ma wuondore ni gin mag bengi ka gikwayo mondo okony ng'ato ong'e ka be en gi pesa.

English: The Kenya Cash Consortium's Locally Led Multi-Purpose Cash Response to Flood-Affected Refugees in Kenya: Endline - Garissa, Mandera, Tana River and Wajir Counties, March, 2024
Kiswahili: Mwitikio wa Pesa wa Malengo Mbalimbali wa Kenya Cash Consortium kwa Wakimbizi Walioathiriwa na Mafuriko nchini Kenya: Endline - Kaunti za Garissa, Mandera, Tana River na Wajir, Machi, 2024
Somali: Jawaab celinta Lacag-bixinta ee Ururka Lacagta Kenya ee Ujeeddooyin badan leh ee ay Maxalligu Hoggaaminayaan ee Qaxootiga ay Fatahaaduhu saameeyeen ee Kenya: Dhammaadka - Degmooyinka Garissa, Mandheera, Tana River iyo Wajeer, Maarso, 2024
Dholuo: Odruok mar pesa mang'eny ma otelo ne jolweny ma oyudo hinyruok nikech pi mang'eny e piny Kenya: Giko - Garissa, Mandera, Aora Tana kod Wajir, dwe mar adek, higa mar 2024

English: The Kenya National Drought Management Authority (NDMA) classified both counties among the hardest-hit regions in Kenya, with severe food and water shortages exacerbating the crisis.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kitaifa ya Kukabiliana na Ukame nchini (NDMA) iliainisha kaunti zote mbili miongoni mwa mikoa iliyoathirika zaidi nchini Kenya, huku uhaba mkubwa wa chakula na maji ukizidisha mgogoro huo.
Somali: Hay'adda Maareynta Abaaraha Qaranka ee Kenya (NDMA) ayaa labada degmo u kala saartay gobollada ugu daran ee ay saameysay Kenya, iyadoo cunto yaraanta iyo biyaha oo daran ay sii xumeysay dhibaatada.
Dholuo: Ofis ma rito piny Kenya ma rito oro (NDMA) noketo gwenge ariyogo e kind kuonde ma oyudo masira ahinya e piny Kenya, nikech nok maduong’ mar chiemo kod pi ma ne omedo masirano.

English: Sexual Violence Trends before and after Rollout of COVID-19 Mitigation Measures, Kenya
Kiswahili: Mitindo ya Unyanyasaji wa Kijinsia kabla na baada ya Kuzinduliwa kwa Hatua za Kukabiliana na COVID-19, Kenya

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds youth in Nyandarua County that HELB funding is available for tailoring and design training.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka ayaa xasuusinaya dhalinyarada degmada Nyandarua in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka qaabeynta iyo naqshadeynta.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne rowere man Nyandarua County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds expectant mothers in Bomet County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Bomet in helitaanka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa mine ma biro bedo gi ich e county mar Bomet ni thuolo mar yudo puonj mag chenro mag ngima joot en maonge chudo e kuonde duto ma ji yudoree.

English: Notice: DPP conducts a community briefing on community early-warning systems in Kericho County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Kericho Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada oo ku saabsan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada ee degmada Kericho bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: DPP timo romo mar chiwo siem ne ji e wi chenro mag chiwo siem chon e taon mar Kericho e dwe mar Februar.

English: Kwale County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kwale: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Kwale: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kwale: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Septemba 2022

English: NTSA reminds residents of Kitui County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lugta ku mara inta lagu jiro xilliyada dabka.
Dholuo: NTSA parone jogweng' Kitui County mondo oluw tong' mar piyo kendo oti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe e kinde mag yiengni.

Kiswahili: SHE-GROW (ufupisho wa "Uwezeshaji Endelevu wa Kijumla: Kukua Fursa za Kustahimili Kiuchumi kwa Wanawake katika Afrika Vijijini") ni mpango wa miezi 18 unaolenga kuimarisha uthabiti wa kiuchumi wa wanawake na jumuiya zao nchini Kenya, CÃ´te d'Ivoire na Morocco.
Somali: SHE-GROW (oo ah "Awood-siin Joogto ah oo Dhammaystiran: Kobcinta Fursadaha Dhaqaale ee Adkeysiga Haweenka ee Miyiga Afrika") waa hindise 18 bilood ah oo loogu talagalay in lagu xoojiyo adkeysiga dhaqaale ee haweenka iyo bulshooyinkooda Kenya, CÃ´te d'Ivoire iyo Morocco.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on residents of Kisumu County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawaomba wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga si ay u taageeraan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross okwayo jogweng' mar Kisumu County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma rito sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e alwora mar tong'gi.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds residents of Lamu County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Lamu kwamba kufikia utunzaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Lamu in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette parone jogweng'o mag Lamu County ni koro yot yudo weche mag nyuol kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds farmers in Marsabit County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa beeraleyda degmada Marsabit barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service oparo ne jopur e county mar Marsabit chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche.

English: OGP urges residents of Kericho County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee golaha gobolka si ay uga warqabtaan bixinta adeegyada heerka degmada.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kericho mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo ging'e weche ma biro timore e wi tiegruok mar migawono.

English: NTSA urges the community in Meru County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: NTSA inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Meru kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Meru inay ka warbixiyaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo shaki leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo xanta xoolaha.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo oganda manie County mar Meru mondo ochiw ripot mar gik maricho ma timore e od polise man machiegni mondo gikwed kwalo jamni.

English: Be safe from coronavirus.Washing your hands is the most important way to stop transmission. 1.Wet hands 2.Apply enough soap 3.Scrub all surfaces of the hands for 20-30 seconds. 4.Rinse thoroughly with running water 5.Dry hands with a clean cloth or single-use towel
Kiswahili: Kuwa salama kutokana na virusi vya corona. Kuosha mikono yako ndiyo njia muhimu zaidi ya kuzuia maambukizi. 1. Lowesha mikono 2. Paka sabuni ya kutosha 3. Sugua sehemu zote za mikono kwa sekunde 20-30. 4. Suuza vizuri na maji yanayotiririka 5. Kausha mikono kwa kitambaa safi au taulo ya matumizi moja
Somali: Iska ilaali cudurka Coronavirus. Gacmahaada maydhka ayaa ah habka ugu muhiimsan ee lagu joojin karo gudbinta. 1. Gacmaha qoyan 2.Sabayl ku filan ku dheji 3.Dadka oo dhan 20-30 ilbidhiqsi ku tirtir. 4. Biyaha qulqulaya si fiican u maydho 5. Gacmaha qalalan dhar nadiif ah ama tuulo hal mar loo isticmaalo
Dholuo: Bed motang' gi tuo mar Coronavirus.Lwoko lweti e yo maduong'ie moloyo mar geng'o tugo mar tuoche. 1.Lwoko lweteni. 2.Tigo sabun moromo. 3.Loso lweti duto kuom sekond 20-30. 4.Lwok lweti maber gi pi ma ringo. 5.Lwok lweteni gi lewni maler kata lewni ma itiyogo dichiel.

English: Digital Horticultural yields. The project will help the ministry of finance formulating policies on digital scale. The result...
Kiswahili: Mavuno ya kilimo cha bustani ya dijiti. Mradi huo utasaidia wizara ya fedha kuunda sera kwa kiwango cha dijiti. Matokeo...

Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mijadala ya uuzaji wa kahawa ili kuelewa vyema bei na haki za umiliki kusasishwa na kushiriki kikamilifu katika maamuzi ya ushirika.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay ku lug yeeshaan wadahadalada suuqgeynta kafeega si ay u fahmaan qiimaha iyo xuquuqda lahaanshaha si ka sii fiican u sii ogaadaan oo ay si firfircoon uga qaybqaataan go'aamada iskaashiga
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur mondo oriw lwedo mbaka mag loso ohala mar kong'o mondo ging'e maber nengo kod ratiro mag bedo gi ohala, gibed molony kendo gibed gi thuolo mar timo yiero e kindgi giwegi

English: IEBC encourages residents of Kakamega County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabtaan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda gobolka.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogweng' Kakamega County mondo ong'e weche ma gin-go mag ndiko joma oyiero mondo gisik ka ging'eyo kaka jopiny biro tiyo gi bajet mar county.

English: KICD advises students in Kirinyaga County to register early to secure allocation to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: KICD inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali.

English: NPS calls on the community in Embu County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatia moyo jamii katika Kaunti ya Embu kuongea dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages mothers in Laikipia County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Laikipia inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo mine manie County mar Laikipia mondo olim kama gibiro nyuolie machiegni mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: AFA urges cattle farmers in Marsabit County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda xoolaha ee degmada Marsabit inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyaga oo aan haysan rukhsad ka dib kiisaska cudurka Anthrax ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur mag jamni e county mar Marsabit mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni kuonde mopogore opogore maok giyudo rusa bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag anthrax.

English: KEMRI reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero lacag la'aan ah oo dib u soo kabashada isticmaalka maandooriyaha laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Nairobi.
Dholuo: KEMRI paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county man Nairobi County.

English: Kenya to release genetically modified mosquitoes to fight malaria
Kiswahili: Kenya kutoa mbu waliobadilishwa vinasaba ili kupambana na malaria
Somali: Kenya ayaa sii dayn doonta cayayaanka lagu beddelay genetically si looga hortago Cudurka Maleriya
Dholuo: Kenya biro gonyo alode molos gi yedhe mamero mondo giked gi malaria

English: HELB reminds youth in Vihiga County that HELB funding is available for welding and fabrication training.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Vihiga in maalgelinta HELD ay diyaar u tahay tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa rowere man Vihiga County ni pesa mag HELP yudore e tiegruok mag welding kod manufacturing.

English: Research Terms of Reference: Multi-Sectoral Needs Assessment KEN2206, Dadaab and Kakuma refugee camps, Kenya (October 2022, V1)
Kiswahili: Masharti ya Utafiti: Tathmini ya Mahitaji ya Kisekta KEN2206, kambi za wakimbizi za Dadaab na Kakuma, Kenya (Oktoba 2022, V1)
Somali: Shuruudaha Tixraaca Cilmi-baarista: Qiimaynta Baahiyaha Qaybaha Badan KEN2206, Xeryaha Qaxootiga ee Dadaab iyo Kakuma, Kenya (Oktoobar 2022, V1)
Dholuo: Chike mag Tiyo gi Nonro: Rang'o Dwaro mag Sektor Mang'eny KEN2206, kambi mag jolweny mag Dadaab kod Kakuma, Kenya (Apar 2022, V1)

English: State Dept. promoting millet and sorghum blends as pilot menu in adaptation to climate-resilient diets.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo inakuza mchanganyiko wa mtama na mtama kama menyu ya majaribio katika kukabiliana na lishe zinazostahimili mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa.
Somali: Waaxda Gobolka oo dhiirrigelinaysa isku-darka millet iyo sorghum sida menu-ga tijaabada ah ee la qabsiga cuntooyinka cimilada u adkeysan.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Piny owacho jiwo choko ngano gi sorghum kaka chiemo ma ok nyal geng'o kit ngima mar piny.

English: ODPP urges residents of Nyandarua County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waendelee kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay la xiriiraan maamulaha degmada si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda horumarinta degmada.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo oriwgi gi jarit mar ward margi mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mag dongruok mar county.

English: Public notice: KEMRI will host a free hypertension awareness outreach in Kwale County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMRI itakuwa mwenyeji wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Kwale Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: KEMRI waxay marti gelineysaa wacyi-gelin bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cadaadiska dhiig karka ee Gobolka Kwale bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMRI biro timo kampen mar konyo ji ng'eyo ni tuwo mar hypertension en gima onge chudo e dwe mar Februar e kaunti mar Kwale.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds voters in Kitui County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kitui kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Kitui inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General parone jogweng'o e County Kitui mondo olim kama ichanoe IEBC machiegni kodgi kapok kinde mar yiero ochopo.

English: KEMSA calls on parents in Uasin Gishu County to have children under five screened for malaria during the November outreach.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuwapima watoto chini ya miaka mitano wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Novemba.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta gobolka Uasin Gishu in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka malariyada inta lagu gudajiro bisha November.
Dholuo: KEMSA okwayo jonyuol e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo otim nonro mar malaria ne nyithindo ma hikgi tin ne abich e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Kajiado County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kajiado: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Mei 2023
Somali: Degmada Kajiado: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kajiado: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar abich higa mar 2023

English: IPOA warns residents of Migori County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Migori juu ya kuongezeka kwa kashfa za pesa za rununu na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: IPOA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Migori kororka khayaanada lacagta mobile waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax falin.
Dholuo: IPOA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Migori County e wi medruok mar timbe mag wuondruok gi pesa mitimo e yor simo kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku dhawaaqay waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee Gobolka Laikipia.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) olando lokruok e seche mag tiyo gi passport e county mar Laikipia.

English: Ministry of Education announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Machakos County this April.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Machakos Aprili hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta waxyaabaha waxbarasho ee bilaashka ah ee dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada Degmada Machakos bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag digital maonge chudo e skunde man Machakos County e dwe mar April.

English: KALRO announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for cattle in Mandera County this July.
Kiswahili: KALRO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Mandera Julai hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee lo'da ee Gobolka Mandera bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: KALRO ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar dhoot e dwe mar Julai e county mar Mandera.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Turkana County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Turkana Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu billaabayaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ka dhanka ah degmada Turkana bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Rieko: Ofis mar Auditor General chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Turkana e dwe mar Januar.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya warns residents of Nakuru County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhusu kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa pesa za simu na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru kororka khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobilada waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Communications Authority chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nakuru County e wi medruok mar timbe mag wuondo pesa mag simo kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok kare ne jatendgi.

English: E-Citizen reminds the public in Homa Bay County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this July.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen anakumbusha umma katika Homa Bay County kwamba maoni juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma ni kuwakaribisha Julai hii.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Homa Bay in talobixinta la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ay tahay mid lagu soo dhaweynayo bisha July.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa ji duto manie Homa Bay County ni ji duto mor gi chiwo mag paro e wi chenro mag oganda e dwe mar Julai.

English: IEBC advises applicants in Siaya County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Siaya kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: IEBC waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Siaya inay dalbadaan booska TVET iyada oo loo marayo KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Siaya mondo oketgi e tiegruok mar TVET kokalo kuom KUCCPS.

English: New mobile platform launched to connect farmers directly to buyers.
Kiswahili: Jukwaa jipya la simu limezinduliwa ili kuwaunganisha wakulima moja kwa moja na wanunuzi.
Somali: Madal cusub oo moobayl ah oo la bilaabay si beeralayda si toos ah ugu xidho iibsadayaasha.
Dholuo: Ochalo yo manyien mar mbui mondo otud jopur achiel kachiel gi jonyiewo.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kiambu County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kutafuta msaada katika nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Kiambu inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e County mar Kiambu mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: KUCCPS encourages out-of-school children in Garissa County to register their children at the nearest public school under free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Garissa kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee Gobolka Garissa inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha ee waxbarashada dhexe ee maalinlaha ah ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e gweng' mar Garissa mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni kodgi e skul mar sekondari.

English: Kenya Dairy Board informs maize farmers in Garissa County of new market linkage opportunities this February.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawafahamisha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Februari hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku wargalinayaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee Gobolka Garissa fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur mag cham e County mar Garissa kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Februar.

English: Without deliberate investments in childcare, skills, and safe work opportunities, women risk exclusion from the gains of integration.
Kiswahili: Bila uwekezaji wa kimakusudi katika malezi ya watoto, ujuzi, na fursa salama za kazi, wanawake wanahatarisha kutengwa kutoka kwa mafanikio ya ujumuishaji.
Somali: Haddii aan la maalgelin si ula kac ah loogu sameyn daryeelka carruurta, xirfadaha, iyo fursadaha shaqo ee badbaadada leh, haweenku waxay halis ugu jiraan in laga saaro faa'iidooyinka isdhexgalka.
Dholuo: Ka onge pesa ma iketo e rito nyithindo, ng’eyo, kod thuolo mag tich ma nigi arita, mon bedo e arita mar bedo mabor gi ber ma yudore kuom riwruok.

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief, September 2023
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP wa Kenya, Septemba 2023
Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya, Sebtembar 2023
Dholuo: Wach machiek mar piny Kenya mar WFP, dwe mar apar gi ariyo 2023

English: Pest Control Products Board promotes conservation tillage among farmers in Trans Nzoia County as part of the May climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inakuza kilimo cha uhifadhi kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Mei.
Somali: Guddiga Wax soo saarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa beerashada ilaalinta beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka iska caabbinta cimilada ee bisha Maajo.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok mag Pest jiwo tij puodho e kind jopur e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo kinda mar geng'o lokruok e kit yamo e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will hold a suicide prevention forum in Kiambu County this November. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanya kongamano la kuzuia kujiua katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Novemba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) waxay qabaneysaa madasha ka hortagga ismiidaaminta ee degmada Kiambu bisha November. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo chokruok mar geng'o ji kik donjre e dwe mar Novemba e County mar Kiambu.

English: We shall not tire in reminding you of the need to wash your hands with soap and water, wearing of face masks at all times in public places, maintaining social and physical distance and more important avoiding all public gatherings be they social or political.
Kiswahili: Hatutachoka kukukumbusha hitaji la kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji, kuvaa barakoa kila wakati mahali pa umma, kudumisha umbali wa kijamii na kimwili na muhimu zaidi kuepuka mikusanyiko yote ya umma iwe ya kijamii au ya kisiasa.
Somali: Kama daali doonno inaan ku xasuusino baahida loo qabo inaad gacmahaaga ku dhaqdo saabuun iyo biyo, inaad mar walba xirato maaskaro wejiga ah goobaha dadweynaha, inaad ilaaliso kala fogaanshaha bulshada iyo jirka iyo sidoo kale in ka sii muhiimsan inaad iska ilaaliso dhammaan isu imaatinka dadweynaha ha ahaadaan kuwo bulsho ama siyaasadeed.
Dholuo: Ok wabi ol e paroni dwaro mar lwoko lweteu gi sabun kod pi, rwako mask mag wang’ kinde duto e kuonde ma ji mang’eny romoe, rito thuolo e kind ji kod ng’ato ka ng’ato kendo gima duong’ moloyo en weyo chokruok duto mag ji mang’eny bed ni gin mag riwruok kata mag siasa.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Murang'a County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMSA nyiso joma odak e County mar Murang'a mondo odonj e riwruok mar insuarans mar thieth mondo giyud thieth makonyogi.

English: Inhaling cigarette smoke cause cancer to people even if they are smokers
Kiswahili: Kupumua moshi wa sigara husababisha kansa kwa watu hata ikiwa wao ni wavutaji sigareti
Somali: Qaadka sigaarka oo neefsanaya ayaa dadka u keena kansar xitaa haddii ay sigaar cabayaan
Dholuo: Ng'ato nyalo bedo gi kansa sama omadho ndawa kata ka en ng'at madho ndawa

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross confirms a dengue fever outbreak alert for Samburu County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa homa ya dengue katika Kaunti ya Samburu. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa xaqiijisay digniin ku saabsan cudurka hargabka dengue ee Gobolka Samburu. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Red Cross osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuwo mar dengue e county mar Samburu.

English: National Drought Early Warning Bulletin (November 2022)
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Tahadhari ya Mapema ya Kitaifa (Novemba 2022)
Somali: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Qaranka (Noofambar 2022)
Dholuo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro (Apar 2022)

English: NPS alerts residents of Kitui County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: NPS waxay dadka deggan degmada Kitui uga digtay kororka kiisaska xoolaha lagu xado waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan mashaariicda booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: NPS chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kitui County kuom medruok mar weche mag kwalo jamni kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Ministry of Education calls on the community in Kisumu County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay bulshada degmada Kisumu ugu baaqeysaa inay u soo wargeliyaan maamulka dugsiga wixii dhibaato ah ee ku saabsan amniga si ay dugsiyada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok dwaro ni ji duto modak e gweng' mar Kisumu onyis sirkal mar skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skunde.

English: Kenyans quarantined in Kenyatta University, Jomo Kenyatta University of Agriculture and Technology (JKUA), KMTC (Kanu Hostel), KMTC (MG Hostel) and Kenya Water Institute will have to endure another 14...
Kiswahili: Wakenya waliowekwa karantini katika Chuo Kikuu cha Kenyatta, Chuo Kikuu cha Kilimo na Teknolojia cha Jomo Kenyatta (JKUA), KMTC (Hosteli ya Kanu), KMTC (Hosteli ya MG) na Taasisi ya Maji ya Kenya watalazimika kuvumilia mengine 14...
Somali: Kenyan-ka ku jira karantiilka Jaamacadda Kenyatta, Jaamacadda Beeraha iyo Tiknoolajiyada Jomo Kenyatta (JKUA), KMTC (Kanu Hostel), KMTC (MG Hostel) iyo Machadka Biyaha Kenya ayaa la kulmi doona 14 kale...
Dholuo: Jo Kenya ma osetue e karantin e Kenyatta University, Jomo Kenyatta University of Agriculture and Technology (JKUA), KMTC (Kanu Hostel), KMTC (MG Hostel) kod Kenya Water Institute biro romo gi 14 mamoko...

English: NDMA reminds mobile money users in Samburu County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee Gobolka Samburu inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: NDMA paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mobil e county mar Samburu mondo onon kwayo mag pesa kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo kik gitim chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo.

English: Teachers Service Commission advises applicants in Laikipia County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.

Kiswahili: Kilimo cha hali ya hewa ni mbinu ya ubunifu ya kufanya kilimo kuwa cha uzalishaji na endelevu zaidi, kuongeza ufanisi na kujenga uimara kwa ...

English: NPS urges anyone experiencing abuse in Meru County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: NPS inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Meru apeleke simu ya simu ya GBV 1195.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages mothers in Kilifi County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuhudhuria siku iliyopangwa ya kliniki ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kilifi inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta caafimaad ee la qorsheeyay si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo mine manie gweng' mar Kilifi mondo odhi e odiechieng'no mar thieth mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations alerts residents of Garissa County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka deggan degmada Garissa uga digaya kororka kiisaska tuugada wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan macluumaadka amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar County mar Garissa ni kwan mag joma ok oluoro sirkal biro medore kendo ojiwo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Notice: KEMRI will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Busia County this December. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI itafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Busia Desemba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay qabaneysaa madasha caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada ee degmada Busia bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMRI biro timo chokruok mar paro ne rowere e taon mar Busia e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Teachers Service Commission invites youth in Turkana County to enroll for ICT skills training this June.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT Juni hii.

Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj ogwelo rowere e County mar Turkana mondo odonj e tiegruok mar ICT e dwe mar Jun.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) advises residents of Siaya County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay yareeyaan qaadashada cusbada iyo sonkorta si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar County mar Siaya mondo giduog chien e chamo chamo mor kod sukari mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Bleeding, severe headaches, blurred vision, or swelling are danger signs _x0097_seek care immediately.
Kiswahili: Kutokwa na damu, maumivu makali ya kichwa, kuona vibaya, au kuvimba ni ishara za hatari - tafuta matibabu mara moja.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development informs coffee farmers in Bomet County of new market linkage opportunities this November.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawafahamisha wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Bomet juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Novemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Bomet fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha November.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development olero ne jopur mag chai e county mar Bomet thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Novemba.

English: However, excessively high rainfall amounts may also raise the risk of waterlogging and localized crop stress, potentially affecting early crop development in poorly drained areas.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, kiasi cha mvua nyingi kupita kiasi kinaweza pia kuongeza hatari ya kujaa maji na mkazo wa mimea iliyojanibishwa, ambayo inaweza kuathiri maendeleo ya mapema ya mazao katika maeneo yenye unyevu hafifu.
Somali: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, roobab aad u badan ayaa sidoo kale kordhin kara khatarta ah in biyuhu ay daataan iyo cadaadiska dalagga ee deegaanka, taasoo saameyn karta horumarinta dalagga hore ee meelaha aan si fiican u daadan.
Dholuo: Kata kamano, koth mang’eny ahinya bende nyalo medo luoro mar pong’o pi kod pek mag cham e alwora, ma nyalo ketho dongruok mapiyo mar cham e kuonde ma pi ok ng’ich maber.

English: PS Kipsang meets Tecla Loroupe Foundation for remedial teaching.
Kiswahili: PS Kipsang kukutana Tecla Loroupe Foundation kwa ajili ya mafundisho ya kurekebisha.

Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Nyandarua inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.

Kiswahili: E-Citizen inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-C citizen wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.

Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo jogweng' mar Wajir County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-C citizen portal sama gidwaro yudo barua mar nyuol.

English: KALRO encourages farmers in Makueni County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for coffee.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa ili kupata bei bora ya kahawa.

Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP wa Kenya, Mei 2025

Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itafanya warsha ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Novemba hii.

Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises avocado producers in Kirinyaga County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inashauri wazalishaji wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu kula talinayaa soo saarayaasha avocado ee degmada Kirinyaga inay ka soo qeybgalaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.

Kiswahili: Migogoro ya Hali ya Hewa kuhusu Afya na Riziki: Hadithi Zisizosikika za Jumuiya ya Garfasa huko Isiolo

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the community in Trans Nzoia County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb fraud.

Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya bulshada degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha si loo xakameeyo khiyaamooyinka.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of Bomet County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.

Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda orgiga ee degmada Murang'a inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyaga oo aan haysan rukhsad ka dib kiisaska cudurka Newcastle ee la soo sheegay.
