Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji duto e county mar Samburu gimomiyo rito ler mar lwedo en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Vanilla farmers in registered farmer groups are reminded to harvest within 9 months of pollination starting from the official harvest date of January 15 2020 for optimal quality
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa vanilla katika vikundi vya wakulima waliosajiliwa wanakumbushwa kuvuna ndani ya miezi 9 ya uchavushaji kuanzia tarehe rasmi ya mavuno ya Januari 15 2020 kwa ubora zaidi.
Somali: Beeraleyda vanilla ee ku jira kooxaha beeralayda diiwaangashan waxaa lagu xasuusinayaa inay goosaan 9 bilood gudahood laga bilaabo maalinta rasmiga ah ee goosashada Janaayo 15, 2020 si tayada ugu wanaagsan
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma nie grube mag jopur ma osegoyo nyingegi e chik paronegi ni mondo gichop e ndalo 9 bang' chwoyo puodho chakre tarik 15 Januar 2020 ma en odiechieng' ma ne ochakgo chamo puodho.

English: IEBC invites youth in Marsabit County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this July.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Julai hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Marsabit inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: IEBC gwelo rowere mag Marsabit County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing e dwe mar Julai.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Baringo County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit nyiso jogweng'o mag Baringo County mondo odonj e weche thieth mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Keep hot drinks and cooking pots away from children_x0092_s reach to prevent burn injuries.
Kiswahili: Weka vinywaji vya moto na sufuria mbali na watoto ili kuepuka majeraha ya kuchomwa.
Somali: Cabitaannada kulul iyo dheriyada wax lagu karsado ka fogee carruurta_x0092_s si looga hortago dhaawacyada gubashada.
Dholuo: Ket math ma liet kod gik ma itiyogo e tedo mabor gi kama nyithindo_x0092_nyalo chopoe mondo kik giyud hinyruok mag wang’.

English: Notice: NDMA launches a theft prevention campaign in Bomet County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Bomet Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: NDMA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada gobolka Bomet bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA chako kampen mar geng'o kuo e taon mar Bomet e dwe mar April.

English: FAO informs coffee farmers in Kajiado County of new market linkage opportunities this May.
Kiswahili: FAO inawafahamisha wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Kajiado juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Mei hii.
Somali: FAO waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Kajiado fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha May.
Dholuo: FAO nyiso jopur mag chai e Kajiado County e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Mei.

English: Council of Governors reminds residents of Makueni County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni wanaohudhuria mkutano wa umma wa kusanyiko la kaunti kuimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Makueni ee ka qeybgalaya kalfadhiga guud ee shirka degmada ayaa xoojinaya maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Council of Governors paronwa jogweng' Makueni County ma biro e chokruok maduong' mar county assembly mondo omed jiwo sirkal.

English: KEMSA urges residents of Uasin Gishu County to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility following a rise in reported measles cases.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya surua vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow ka dib kororka kiisaska suuxdinta ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' Uasin Gishu County mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni nikech kwan mar ji ma nigi tuwono osemedore.

English: Submission to the UN Special Rapporteur on the Human Rights of Internally Displaced Persons - Climate Change and Internal Displacement
Kiswahili: Kuwasilisha kwa Mwandishi Maalum wa Umoja wa Mataifa kuhusu Haki za Kibinadamu za Watu Waliohamishwa Ndani - Mabadiliko ya Tabianchi na Uhamisho wa Ndani.
Somali: U gudbinta Ergeyga Gaarka ah ee Qaramada Midoobay ee Xuquuqda Aadanaha ee Dadka Gudaha Ku Barakacay - Isbeddelka Cimilada iyo Barakaca Gudaha
Dholuo: Oboke ne Jalony Maduong’ mar UN e wi Ratiro mag Dhano mag Joma Owuok e Pinygi - Lokruok mar Piny kod Joma Owuok e Pinygi

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development encourages farmers in Kitui County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for coffee.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei nzuri ya kahawa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kitui inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo kafee ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur e County mar Kitui mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar chai.

English: DPP reminds residents of Homa Bay County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lugta ku mara inta lagu jiro xilliyada fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo oti gi yore mag wuotho e kinde mag koth.

English: CDC calls on parents in Wajir County to have children under five screened for meningitis during the July outreach.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa ugonjwa wa uti wa mgongo wakati wa ufikiaji wa Julai.
Somali: CDC waxay ku baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Wajir in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro meningitis intii lagu jiray bisha July.
Dholuo: CDC dwaro ni jonyuol e gweng' mar Wajir otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: SHA opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: SHA inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Wananchi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Shirkadda SHA waxay ka furaysaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee degmada Nyamira.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag e-Citizen registration e county mar Nyamira.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) announces a free lumpy skin disease vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Kwale County this July.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa ngozi kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kwale Julai hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku dhawaaqday jimicsi tallaal oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka maqaarka ee lo'da caanaha ah ee Gobolka Kwale bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok makwayo pi e dwe mar Julai e kaunti mar Kwale.

English: NCPB invites farmers in Bomet County to a free training on modern irrigation techniques this February.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji Februari hii.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku casuumaysaa beeraleyda gobolka Bomet inay tababar lacag la'aan ah ku helaan farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: NCPB ogwelo jopur e county mar Bomet e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi yore mag lero pi e dwe mar Februar.

English: State Department for Basic Education announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Marsabit County this April.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Aprili hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta waxyaabaha barashada digitalka ah ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Marsabit bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag digital maonge chudo e skunde mag Marsabit County e dwe mar April.

English: C-HERP project is designed to assist countries to prevent, detect and respond to the threat posed by COVID-19, and to strengthen the national systems for public health preparedness and responsiveness. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Mradi wa C-HERP umeundwa ili kusaidia nchi kuzuia, kugundua na kukabiliana na tishio linaloletwa na COVID-19, na kuimarisha mifumo ya kitaifa ya kujiandaa na kuitikia afya ya umma. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Mashruuca C-HERP waxaa loogu talagalay inuu ka caawiyo waddamada inay ka hortagaan, ogaadaan oo ay ka jawaabaan khatarta ka dhalan karta COVID-19, iyo in la xoojiyo nidaamyada qaranka ee u diyaargarowga iyo jawaab celinta caafimaadka dadweynaha. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Projekt mar C-HERP olosi mondo okony pinje mondo ogeng’, ong’e kendo odwoko luoro ma COVID-19 kelo, kendo mondo ojing’ chenro mag piny mag ikruok kod dwoko mar thieth mar oganda. #KomeshaKorona

English: KMTC encourages residents of Kakamega County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kakamega inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: KMTC jiwo jogweng' Kakamega County mondo ong'e weche ma giduto giduto giseyiego mondo ging'e kaka ji duto biro tiyo gi bajet mar county.

English: NPS urges the community in Busia County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb burglary.
Kiswahili: NPS inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Busia kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Busia inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo ji duto e county mar Busia mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Migori County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Wilaya ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa soo saaray digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Migori.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations ogolo siem e wi weche mag cybersecurity e wi chenro mag gwelo pesa mag miriambo makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Migori County.

English: Notice: TSC opens applications for school laptops under the digital literacy programme for learners in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC inafungua maombi ya kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay furaysaa codsiyada loogu talagalay laptops-ka dugsiga iyada oo loo marayo barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee ardayda degmada Nakuru.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TSC yawo kwayo mag kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar somo kod somo mar digital ne jopuonjre man Nakuru County.

English: The Rockefeller Foundation is partnering with Kenya to enhance food security and promote agricultural innovation Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders should stay updated on new initiatives
Kiswahili: Rockefeller Foundation inashirikiana na Kenya kuimarisha usalama wa chakula na kukuza uvumbuzi wa kilimo Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanapaswa kusasishwa kuhusu mipango mipya.
Somali: Hay'adda Rockefeller Foundation waxay la shaqeyneysaa Kenya si loo xoojiyo amniga cuntada iyo kor u qaadista hal-abuurnimada beeraha Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha waa inay sii joogaan warar ku saabsan dadaallada cusub
Dholuo: Rockefeller Foundation tiyo gi Kenya e jiwo weche mag chiemo kod timo dongruok e weche mag pur Jo puothe gi jo ohala mag weche mag pur onego omed ng'eyo weche manyien

English: KRA urges residents of Kisumu County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na ufisadi wa fedha za umma.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u soo gudbiyaan cabasho si ay ula dagaallamaan xadgudubka maalgashiga dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo jogweng'o mag Kisumu County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo ng'ur mar kedo gi ketho pesa mag sirkal.

English: AustraliaÃƒâ€šÃ¢â‚¬â„¢s Premier announced a historic agreement to fully fund all WA public schools up to the Schooling Resource Standard by 2026.
Kiswahili: Waziri Mkuu wa Australia alitangaza makubaliano ya kihistoria ya kufadhili kikamilifu shule zote za umma za WA hadi Kiwango cha Rasilimali za Shule ifikapo mwaka wa 2026.
Somali: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Australia ayaa ku dhawaaqay heshiis taariikhi ah oo lagu maalgelinayo dhammaan dugsiyada dadweynaha ee WA ilaa Heerka Kheyraadka Waxbarashada marka la gaaro 2026.
Dholuo: Jatend piny Australia nolando winjruok maduong’ mar chiwo omwom chuth ne skul duto mag sirkal mag WA nyaka chop e higa mar 2026.

English: Turkana County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Turkana: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Aprili 2024
Somali: Degmada Turkana: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Turkana: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Ang'wen 2024

English: KEMSA advises residents of Kericho County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuthibitisha kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay xaqiijiyaan in xaruntooda la aqoonsaday ka hor inta aysan booqan si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMSA nyiso jogweng' Kericho County mondo ong'e ni kuondegi mag thieth oseyudo ratiro kapok gilimo kuondego mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Wajir County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Wajir: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Aprili 2022
Somali: Degmada Wajeer: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Wajir: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar ang'wen 2022

English: KNEC calls on the community in Busia County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KNEC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Busia kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: KNEC waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Busia inay la xiriirto khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116, si loo ilaaliyo nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: KNEC okwayo ji duto e county mar Busia mondo omany namba mar 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: State Department for TVET urges youth in Kitui County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Jimbo la TVET inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kitui inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda ka hor inta aysan qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET ojiwo rowere ma Kitui County mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto gikwongo tiyogo ka pok gichako timo tije mag sirkal.

English: Kenya Gazette encourages first-time voters in Kwale County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawatia moyo wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kwale kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Kwale inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogo madwaro yiero mokwongo e Kaunti mar Kwale mondo oting'e ID kata pasi mar pinygi e odiechieng'no mar yiero.

English: KICD encourages out-of-school children in Mombasa County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: KICD inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya mgao wa bursary.
Somali: KICD waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Mombasa inay ku qoraan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee la siinayo deeq waxbarasho.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e county mar Mombasa mondo odonj e program mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo e bwo mich mar chiwo kony.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the public in Bungoma County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya shacabka degmada Bungoma inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aanay wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ji duto e County mar Bungoma mondo ong'e kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma ne oland kuom weche mag phishing.

English: IPOA reminds residents of Machakos County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada daadadka ku dhacay xilligan shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: IPOA parone jogweng'o mag Machakos County ni kik giwuoth e wi borni kod aoche ma pi opong'o e kinde masiche mag ndara.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Machakos County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kuunga mkono kamati za kujenga amani huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng'o mag Machakos County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi kuom chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: Council of Governors updates residents of Tharaka-Nithi County on progress of county development projects this April.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo katika kaunti hii Aprili.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi ku wargeliyaan horumarka mashaariicda horumarinta degmada bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Council of Governors osemiyo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi ong'eyo dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok e gweng'no e dwe mar April.

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of Garissa County to prepare for possible flooding this April.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa mafuriko Aprili hii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan gobolka Garissa inay isu diyaariyaan fatahaadaha iman kara bisha April.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross osiemo jogweng' mar Garissa County mondo oikre ne ataro manyalo timore e dwe mar April.

English: Kwale County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kwale: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2024
Somali: Degmada Kwale: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kwale: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2024

English: Notice: KALRO will distribute certified cassava seed to farmers in Trans Nzoia County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itasambaza mbegu za mihogo zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay abuurka cassava ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KALRO biro pogo kodhi mag manija ma nigi ratiro ne jopur e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia e dwe mar Januar.

English: KTDA urges cattle farmers in Laikipia County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported foot and mouth disease cases.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizoteuliwa kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da ee degmada Laikipia inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur mag jamni e County mar Laikipia mondo ogeng' jamni maggi e kuonde moketi mag chamo jamni bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag dhoot.

English: E-Citizen warns public officers in Laikipia County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Laikipia inay musuqmaasuq ku sameeyaan xafiisyada dawladda.
Dholuo: E-Citizen chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Laikipia kuom kawo asoya e migepe mar sirkal.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds the public in Kilifi County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this February.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kwamba mchango juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka unakaribishwa Februari hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) ayaa xasuusinaya shacabka degmada Kilifi in laga soo dhaweynayo soo gudbinta dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone ji duto e County Kilifi ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e dwe mar Februar.

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will host a free food safety outreach in Busia County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa usalama wa chakula bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Busia Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa marti gelineysa dadaal bilaash ah oo ku saabsan badbaadada cuntada ee degmada Busia bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo chenro mar chiwo kony maonge chudo mar chiemo e County mar Busia e dwe mar Jun.

English: CPJ calls on Kenyan authorities to respect press freedom amid ongoing protests
Kiswahili: CPJ inatoa wito kwa mamlaka za Kenya kuheshimu uhuru wa vyombo vya habari huku kukiwa na maandamano yanayoendelea
Somali: CPJ oo ugu baaqday mas'uuliyiinta Kenya inay ixtiraamaan xorriyadda saxaafadda xilli ay socdaan dibadbaxyo socda
Dholuo: CPJ okwayo jotelo mag piny Kenya mondo omi thuolo mar jondiko luor e kind gik ma dhi nyime mag kwedo

English: Ministry of Education procures and distributes Braille learning devices to schools catering to visually impaired learners.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu hupata na kusambaza vifaa vya kujifunza maandishi ya vipofu kwa shule zinazohudumia wanafunzi walio na matatizo ya kuona.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay alaabada barashada Braille u iibsataa oo u qaybiso dugsiyada u adeega ardayda aragti la'aanta leh.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education yudo kendo pogo gige puonjruok mar Braille ne skunde ma konyo japuonjre ma nigi midekre mar neno.

English: DPP reminds the public in Nairobi County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DPP anawakumbusha wananchi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kubaki macho katika ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Nairobi in ay ka feejignaadaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: DPP parone ji duto e County mar Nairobi mondo omed bedo motang' ne loso kuwe e piny.

English: Farmers and tea producers are encouraged to develop a Kenyan tea brand to enhance market visibility and prices Aim for at least 60 of exports to be processed and branded within 3 5 years
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wazalishaji wa chai wanahimizwa kubuni chapa ya chai ya Kenya ili kuongeza mwonekano wa soko na bei Inalenga angalau 60 ya bidhaa zinazouzwa nje zichakatwa na kuwekwa chapa ndani ya miaka 3 5.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo soosaarayaasha shaaha waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay horumariyaan nooc shaah Kenyan ah si loo kordhiyo muuqaalka suuqa iyo qiimaha. Ujeedadoodu waa in ugu yaraan 60 ka mid ah dhoofinta la farsameeyo lana calaamadeeyo 35 sano gudahood
Dholuo: Josomo gi jopur loso chai ijiwo mondo olos ng'at ma loso chai mar Kenya mondo omed neno nengo mag chai e pinyno.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises tea producers in Nakuru County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inashauri wazalishaji wa chai katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha shaaha ee degmada Nakuru inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development nyiso jopur ma loso chai e kaunti mar Nakuru mondo odonj e riwruok ma nigi ratiro mar tich makonyo ji kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Fast breathing, wlking or staying outside, are instruments of managing daily mind/thoughts
Kiswahili: Kupumua haraka, kulala au kukaa nje, ni zana za kudhibiti akili / mawazo ya kila siku
Somali: Neefsashada degdegga ah, iska caabinta ama joogitaanka banaanka, waa qalab lagu maareynayo maskaxda / fikradaha maalinlaha ah
Dholuo: Yueyo gi muya mapiyo, kata bedo oko, gin gik manyalo konyo ng'ato mondo obed gi paro mowinjore e ngimane mapile

English: KNEC encourages residents of Kitui County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabaan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jogweng'o mag Kitui County mondo onon weche ma gin-go e wi register mar joma oyiero mondo ging'e weche duto motudore gi ratiro mag chik.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Mombasa County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kuthibitisha kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa inay xaqiijiyaan in xaruntooda la aqoonsaday ka hor inta aysan booqan si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit nyiso ji duto modak e county mar Mombasa mondo ong'e ni kuondegi mag thieth oseyudo ratiro kapok gibiro mondo giyud thieth.

English: Avocado farmers in Nyeri County are encouraged to form farmer groups to enhance sustainability and improve feedback from extension officers Join a group today for better support
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri wamehimizwa kuunda vikundi vya wakulima ili kuimarisha uendelevu na kuboresha maoni kutoka kwa maafisa ugani Jiunge na kikundi leo kwa usaidizi bora.
Somali: Beeraleyda avocado ee degmada Nyeri waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay sameeyaan kooxo beeraley ah si loo xoojiyo cimri dhererka iyo hagaajinta jawaabta ka timid saraakiisha kordhinta Ku biir koox maanta si aad u hesho taageero wanaagsan
Dholuo: Jo-pidh avocado e County mar Nyeri ijiwo mondo ochak grube mag jopidh mondo omed bedo gi ngima maber kendo omed chiwo paro moa kuom jotelo mag dongruok.

English: KEPHIS reminds farmers in West Pokot County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda gobolka West Pokot barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada.
Dholuo: KEPHIS parone jopur e West Pokot County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public in Tana River County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Tana River juu ya umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay dadka degmada Tana River ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay nadaafadda saxda ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji duto e taon mar Tana River County kuom ber mar rito ler mar pi e ngima joot.

English: Kenya Key Message Update: High staple prices keep household purchasing power lower than normal (July 2023)
Kiswahili: Sasisho la Ujumbe Muhimu wa Kenya: Bei za juu za bidhaa kuu huweka nguvu ya ununuzi ya kaya kuwa chini kuliko kawaida (Julai 2023)
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta Fariinta Muhiimka ah ee Kenya: Qiimaha sare ee guryaha ayaa ka dhigaya awoodda wax iibsiga guryaha mid ka hooseysa sidii caadiga ahayd (Luulyo 2023)
Dholuo: Oda Maduong' Maduong' mar Kenya: Nengo mamalo mar gik madongo miyo teko mar nyieo mar ot bedo piny moloyo kaka pile (Julaini 2023)

English: Ensure that every client entering the establishment wears a face mask. All food handlers wear face masks. Provision for social and physical distancing. All restaurant workers must be tested. #KomeshaCorona update.
Kiswahili: Hakikisha kuwa kila mteja anayeingia kwenye biashara amevaa kinyago. Wahudumu wote wa chakula huvaa vinyago vya uso. Utoaji wa umbali wa kijamii na kimwili. Wafanyikazi wote wa mikahawa lazima wajaribiwe. #KomeshaCorona sasisho.
Somali: Hubi in macaamiil kasta oo soo galaya xarunta uu xidho maaskaro wejiga ah. Dhammaan shaqaalaha cuntada qabta waxay xidhaan maaskaro wejiga ah. Qodobo loogu talagalay kala fogaanshaha bulshada iyo jirka. Dhammaan shaqaalaha makhaayadaha waa in la baaraa. #CusbooneysiintaKomeshaCorona.
Dholuo: Ne ni klayent moro amora ma donjo e dukano rwako mask mar wang’. Jogo duto ma rito chiemo rwako mask mag wang’. Okenge mag bedo mabor gi ji kod bedo mabor gi jowetegi. Jotich duto mag restoran nyaka timnegi pim. #KomeshaKorona ma manyien.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges residents of Tana River County to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility following a rise in reported HIV/AIDS cases.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya VVU/UKIMWI.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River County inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow kadib kororka kiisaska HIV / AIDS ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal mar thieth machiegni nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuo mar HIV/AIDS osemedore.

English: A UN factsheet outlines rights during counter terrorism operations and stresses oversight.
Kiswahili: Karatasi ya habari ya Umoja wa Mataifa inaonyesha haki wakati wa shughuli za kupambana na ugaidi na kusisitiza usimamizi.
Somali: Warqadda macluumaadka ee Qaramada Midoobay waxay qeexdaa xuquuqda inta lagu jiro howlgallada la dagaalanka argagixisada waxayna xooga saartaa kormeerka.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Pinje (UN) oting'o weche ma nyiso ratiro ma ng'ato nigo mar kedo gi timbe mahundu kendo ojiwo ni onego oketne tong'.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response calls on parents in Migori County to have children under five screened for tuberculosis during the December outreach.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Migori kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kifua kikuu wakati wa mawasiliano ya Desemba.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku baaqeysaa waalidiinta Degmada Migori inay carruurta ka yar shan sano u sameeyaan baaritaanka cudurka 'tuberculosis' inta lagu jiro bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche kwayo jonyuol e County mar Migori mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Desemba.

English: TVET reminds schools in Tana River County to strengthen anti-bullying measures this February.
Kiswahili: TVET inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuimarisha hatua za kupambana na uonevu Februari hii.
Somali: TVET waxay xusuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Tana River inay xoojiyaan tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibaatada bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa skunde mag Tana River County mondo omed jiwo yore mag kedo gi timbe mahundu e dwe mar Februar.

English: Council of Governors invites residents of Kakamega County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandaoni wa kaunti kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku martiqaadaan dadka deggan degmada Kakamega inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch ogwelo jogweng' Kakamega County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e wi chenro mar bajet.

English: OGP warns public officers in Murang'a County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: OGP inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: OGP waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Murang'a inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: OGP chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e County mar Murang'a ni kik giti marach gi migepegi.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds livestock keepers in Trans Nzoia County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Trans Nzoia inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanada buka xafiiska xayawaanka ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jopur mag jamni e county mar Trans Nzoia ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni kodgi.

English: KEMRI urges residents of Homa Bay County to complete the full recommended vaccination dose following a rise in reported HIV/AIDS cases.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya VVU/UKIMWI.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo kadib kororka kiisaska HIV / AIDS ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo ochop e okang' moromo mar thieth ma gichiwo bang' medruok mar joma nigi tuo mar AYAKI/AIDS.

English: KEPHIS reminds livestock keepers in Siaya County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xayawaanka ah ee degmada Siaya inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xadka degmada iyada oo aan la helin rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KEPHIS paronwa jorit jamni e county mar Siaya ni kik giting' jamni ka ok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Narok County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok wapewe huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Narok ku boorinayaa inay dalbadaan adeegyo aan la bixin laaluush si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo oket pachgi kuom tij lendo maok gichiwo asoya mondo giked gi asoya e migepe mag sirkal.

English: Kenya among 12 African countries to get 18 million doses of malaria vaccine by 2025, WHO says priority will go to countries with the greatest need.
Kiswahili: Kenya miongoni mwa nchi 12 za Afrika kupata dozi milioni 18 za chanjo ya malaria ifikapo mwaka 2025, WHO inasema kipaumbele kitaelekezwa kwa nchi zenye uhitaji mkubwa zaidi.
Somali: Kenya ayaa ka mid ah 12 dal oo Afrikaan ah oo heli doona 18 milyan oo qiyaasood oo tallaal ah oo ka dhan ah cudurka fayraska sanadka 2025, WHO ayaa sheegtay in mudnaanta loo siin doono dalalka ugu baahan.
Dholuo: Kenya en achiel kuom pinje 12 mag Afrika mabiro yudo dose milion 18 mag thieth mar malaria e higa mar 2025, WHO wacho ni telo biro bedo ne pinje man gi dwaro maduong'.

English: Healthy minds create healthy workplaces. LetÂ’s foster environments that prioritize mental health and support employeesÂ’ well-being
Kiswahili: Akili zenye afya huunda sehemu za kazi zenye afya. Tukuze mazingira yanayopa kipaumbele afya ya akili na kusaidia ustawi wa wafanyakazi
Somali: Maskaxda caafimaadka qabta waxay abuurtaa goobo shaqo oo caafimaad qaba. Aan kobcino jawi mudnaanta siiya caafimaadka maskaxda oo aan taageerno fayoobaanta shaqaalaha.
Dholuo: Paro ma nigi ngima maber loso kuonde tich ma nigi ngima maber. Wabed gi alwora ma keto ngima mar paro bedo mokuongo kendo konyo ngima maber mar jotich

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages residents of Isiolo County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay ugu yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' Isiolo County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo giluong simo mar thieth mar paro maonge chudo.

English: Public notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will host a free safe water storage outreach in Machakos County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itakuwa mwenyeji wa ufikiaji wa bure wa kuhifadhi maji salama katika Kaunti ya Machakos Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa qaban doonta adeeg lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee Degmada Machakos bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo chenro mar choko pi maonge chudo e boma mar Machakos e dwe mar abich.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds youth in Mombasa County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya dhalinyarada degmada Mombasa in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne rowere man Mombasa County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar chiemo kod mar rwako welo.

English: KMTC urges parents and teachers in Isiolo County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Isiolo inay u soo sheegaan maamulka iskuulka wixii arrimo ah oo ku saabsan amniga.
Dholuo: KMTC jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e kaunti mar Isiolo mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar skul e wi weche duto motudore gi ritruok.

English: Huduma Kenya announces improved turnaround times for e-Citizen registration in Busia County.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya yatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujiandikisha kwa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Busia.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku dhawaaqday waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee degmada Busia.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya olando lokruok e seche mag timo chenro mar e-Citizen registration e county mar Busia.

English: Notice: IEBC announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta dugsiyada dugsiga dhexe ee bilaashka ah ee degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IEBC ogolo chenro mar dhi e skul mag sekondari e odiechieng' maonge chudo e kaunti mar Bungoma.

English: Announcement of millet and sorghum adoption to promote climate-smart, nutrient-rich diets at national policy forum.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la kupitishwa kwa mtama na mtama ili kukuza lishe bora na zenye virutubisho vinavyozingatia hali ya hewa katika jukwaa la kitaifa la sera.
Somali: Ogeysiiska qaadashada millet iyo sorghum si loo dhiirrigeliyo cuntooyinka cimilada ku habboon iyo nafaqo hodan, shirweynaha siyaasadda qaranka.

English: Ministry of Health encourages mothers in Siaya County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Siaya inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta caafimaad ee la qorsheeyay si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health ojiwo mine e County mar Siaya mondo odhi e odiechieng'no mar klinik mondo orit ngima nyathigi.

English: NDMA warns residents of Kirinyaga County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga juu ya kuongezeka kwa kashfa za pesa za rununu na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: NDMA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kirinyaga kororka khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobilada waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: NDMA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kirinyaga County e wi medruok mar timbe mag wuondo pesa e simo kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges sorghum growers in Samburu County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Samburu kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda sorghum ee Gobolka Samburu inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si loo wanaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur mag sorghum e county mar Samburu mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed kelo nyak e higani.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for pigs in Bomet County this June.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Bomet Juni hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhawaaqay jimicsi tallaal oo bilaash ah oo cudurka Newcastle ee doofaarka ee gobolka Bomet bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service olando chenro mar thieth mar tuo mar Newcastle maonge chudo e dwe mar Jun e county mar Bomet.

English: KEMRI encourages mothers in Garissa County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Garissa inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta caafimaad ee la qorsheeyay si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo mine manie County mar Garissa mondo odhi e odiechieng'no mar thieth mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: FAO promotes conservation tillage among farmers in Trans Nzoia County as part of the November climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: FAO inakuza kilimo cha uhifadhi kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Novemba.
Somali: FAO waxay dhiirrigelisay beerashada ilaalinta beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee bisha Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar FAO jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo okonygi e choko puothe e dwe mar Novemba.

English: KOICA in partnership with Kajiado County Government and UNOPS hand over critical ICU equipment and medical supplies to Kitengela Sub-County Hospital
Kiswahili: KOICA kwa ushirikiano na Serikali ya Kaunti ya Kajiado na UNOPS wakabidhi vifaa muhimu vya ICU na vifaa vya matibabu kwa Hospitali ya Kaunti Ndogo ya Kitengela.
Somali: KOICA oo kaashanaysa Dowladda Gobolka Kajiado iyo UNOPS ayaa qalabka muhiimka ah ee ICU iyo agabka caafimaadka ku wareejisay Isbitaalka Degaanka Kitengela.
Dholuo: KOICA ka oriwre gi Sirkal mar Kajiado kod UNOPS chiwo gige ICU madongo kod gigo mag thieth ne Od thieth ma Kitengela

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for pigs in Kajiado County this November.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Kajiado Novemba hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhawaaqay jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan rabshadaha doofaarka ee Gobolka Kajiado bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service olando chenro mar thieth mar rabies maonge chudo mar dhok e Kajiado County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Kenya: Registered refugees and asylum-seekers (as of 30 September 2022)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Wakimbizi waliosajiliwa na wanaotafuta hifadhi (kuanzia tarehe 30 Septemba 2022)
Somali: Kenya: Qaxootiga diiwaangashan iyo kuwa magangalyo doonka ah (laga bilaabo 30 Sebtembar 2022)
Dholuo: Kenya: Jolweny ma ondiki nyinggi kod jogo madwaro resruok (chakre tarik 30 dwe mar apar higa mar 2022)

English: Notice: SHA will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: SHA itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: SHA biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e Homa Bay County.

English: KICD conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in West Pokot County this December.
Kiswahili: KICD inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Desemba hii.
Somali: KICD waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee Gobolka West Pokot bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: KICD timo romo mar tiego ji e wi ratiro mag chik e West Pokot County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit launches a June awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Juni juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Juun oo ku saabsan wacyiga cadaadiska sare ee gobolka Kajiado.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osechako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Jun e wi wach ng'eyo ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar hypertension e Kajiado County duto.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit appeals to caregivers in Tana River County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the March maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Machi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Tana River inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta rugta caafimaadka ee la qorsheeyay oo qayb ka ah ololaha caafimaadka hooyada ee Maarso.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit okwayo jorit e taon mar Tana River County mondo odhi e klinik ma ne otim e dwe mar Mach.

English: AFA urges sheep farmers in Nandi County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported rabies cases.
Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wafugaji wa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa kufuatia visa vya kichaa cha mbwa vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda idaha ee degmada Nandi inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo ka dib kiisaska xanaaqa la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur mag rombe e county mar Nandi mondo ogeng'e legi e kuonde moyier mag nego rombe bang' ka osenyis ni gin gi tuo mar rabies.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free HIV/AIDS screening is available at all public health centres in Laikipia County this April.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa VVU/UKIMWI unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Aprili hii.
Somali: Laanta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka HIV / AIDS ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee Gobolka Laikipia bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji ni nonro mar HIV/AIDS onge chudo e mier duto mag thieth e County mar Laikipia e dwe mar April.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Kwale County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this drought season.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati huu wa ukame.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lugta lagu maro xilligan abaarta.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross parone jogweng' mar Kwale County mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo oti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe e kinde oro.

English: Promote fodder harvesting upon maturity and proper storage.
Kiswahili: Kukuza uvunaji wa lishe wakati wa kukomaa na uhifadhi sahihi.
Somali: Kor u qaad goosashada cuntooyinka marka ay bislaan tahay oo kaydinta saxda ah.
Dholuo: Jiw tij choko ring'o ka gisechopo e kinde ma gisechopo e yien kendo kano ring'o e yo makare.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kurejesha matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa xasuusinaya dadweynaha in taageero dib u soo kabashada xadgudubka maadooyinka bilaashka ah laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Nyeri.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tiyo gi yedhe mamero yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth e kaunti mar Nyeri.

English: NGEC organizes county-level events on gender inclusivity.
Kiswahili: NGEC huandaa matukio ya kiwango cha wilaya juu ya ujumuishaji wa jinsia.
Somali: NGEC waxay qabanqaabisaa dhacdooyin heer degmo ah oo ku saabsan isdhexgalka jinsiga.
Dholuo: NGEC chano gik ma timore e gweng' ka gweng' e wi weche motudore gi weche mag nindruok.

English: KTDA informs maize farmers in Kilifi County of new market linkage opportunities this February.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawafahamisha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Februari hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Kilifi fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: KTDA nyiso jopur mag kodhi e gweng' mar Kilifi kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Februar.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds residents of Homa Bay County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Homa Bay kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay in ay ka qaybqaataan maamulaha xaafadaha deegaanka si ay u xoojiyaan maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya paronwa jogweng' Homa Bay County ni tudruok e kind jorit mar gwenge maggi miyo sirkal bedo gi loch maber.

English: Notice: DPP launches a theft prevention campaign in Homa Bay County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DPP yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada gobolka Homa Bay bishii Ogosto.
Dholuo: Rapar: DPP chako kampen mar geng'o kuo e Homa Bay County e dwe mar Agost.

English: Wajir County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for December 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Wajir: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Desemba 2023
Somali: Degmada Wajeer: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Diseembar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Wajir: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar gi ariyo 2023

English: Kitui County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kitui: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Februari 2023
Somali: Degmada Kitui: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kitui: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2023

English: AFA invites farmers in Tana River County to a free training on pest and disease management this September.
Kiswahili: AFA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River kwa mafunzo ya bure juu ya udhibiti wa wadudu na magonjwa Septemba hii.
Somali: AFA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Tana River inay helaan tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan xakamaynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: AFA ogwelo jopur e taon mar Tana River County e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar tuoche kod tuoche e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: COMESA will train farmers in Migori County on conservation tillage this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori juu ya kilimo cha uhifadhi Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Migori ee ku saabsan beerashada ilaalinta bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA biro tiego jopur e county mar Migori e dwe mar Jun.

English: E-Citizen reminds voters in Kakamega County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha Gobolka Kakamega in ay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor inta aan la helin waxbarasho.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa jogweng' kaunti mar Kakamega mondo olim kama ioroe ji e IEBC kapok gipuonjore ji.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges eligible citizens in Migori County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Migori kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Xafiiska tijaabiyaha guud wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Migori inay ka qaybqaataan jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General jiwo raia mar Migori County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar yiero.

English: Republic of Korea rice donation provides critical boost to WFPâ€™s emergency response for refugees in Kenya
Kiswahili: Mchango wa mchele wa Jamhuri ya Korea unatoa msukumo muhimu kwa mwitikio wa dharura wa WFP kwa wakimbizi nchini Kenya
Somali: Deeqda bariiska ee Jamhuuriyadda Kuuriya ayaa si weyn u kordhinaysa gargaarka degdegga ah ee WFP ay u fidiso qaxootiga ku nool Kenya.
Dholuo: Chiwo mar mzabibu ma piny Korea chiwo konyo maduong' ahinya e dwoko mapiyo mar WFP ne jolweny ma ni Kenya

English: KEMSA announces NHIF/SHA claims support for residents of West Pokot County starting this January.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatangaza NHIF/SHA inadai msaada kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuanzia Januari hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taageerada sheegashada NHIF / SHA ee dadka deggan degmada West Pokot laga bilaabo Janaayo.
Dholuo: KEMSA olando kony ma NHIF/SHA chiwo ne joma odak e West Pokot County kochakore Januar ma kawuono.

English: Notice: e-Citizen launches county development projects in Embu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya wilaya katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: e-Citizen waxay bilawday mashaariic horumarineed oo ka socda degmada Embu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni e-Citizen chako timo dongruok e county mar Embu County.

English: AFA advises farmers in Migori County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the October planting season.
Kiswahili: AFA inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori kupitisha aina zilizothibitishwa za mbegu zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Oktoba.
Somali: AFA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Degmada Migori inay qaataan noocyo abuurka ah oo abaarta u adkaysta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Oktoobar.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e Migori County mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochopo dwe mar Oktoba.

English: NPS urges residents of Migori County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NPS inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika kumbi za umma huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Migori inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo jogweng' Migori County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji ng'enyie nikech ji medo keto pachgi kuom chenro mag chiwo siem motelo ne oganda.

English: Notice: e-Citizen opens voter education centres in Kakamega County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: e-Citizen waxay furaysaa xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee Gobolka Kakamega bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni e-Citizen biro yawo kuonde tiego josiasa e kaunti mar Kakamega e dwe mar Januar.

English: KICD reminds schools in Tharaka-Nithi County to strengthen school infrastructure safety this March.
Kiswahili: KICD inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuimarisha usalama wa miundombinu ya shule Machi hii.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay xoojiyaan ammaanka kaabayaasha dugsiga bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne skunde man Tharaka-Nithi County mondo omed jiwo ritruok mar chenro mag skul e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by SHA (Social Health Authority) will be held in Bungoma County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Bungoma bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth maonge chudo ma olos gi SHA (Social Health Authority) ibiro tim Bungoma County e dwe mar April.

English: Midline findings for the Kenya Cash Consortium response to drought in Arid and Semi-Arid Lands (ASAL) counties of Kenya (June 2022)
Kiswahili: Matokeo ya katikati ya Mwitikio wa Kenya Cash Consortium kwa ukame katika Kaunti za Ardhi Kame na Nusu Kame (ASAL) za Kenya (Juni 2022)
Somali: Natiijooyinka dhexe ee Ururka Lacagta Caddaan ee Kenya ee ka jawaabaya abaarta ka jirta degmooyinka Dhulka Aaran iyo Nus-Aaran (ASAL) ee Kenya (Juun 2022)
Dholuo: Duoko ma diere mag duoko mar riwruok mar pesa mag Kenya kuom oro e gwenge mag Kenya (Adweche 2022)

English: Refugee Debt and Livelihoods in Northern Kenya
Kiswahili: Madeni ya Wakimbizi na Riziki Kaskazini mwa Kenya
Somali: Deynta Qaxootiga iyo Nolol-maalmeedka Waqooyiga Kenya
Dholuo: Gowi mag Jolweny kod Yore mag Dak e Piny Kenya ma Nyanduat

English: TVETA initiates development of comprehensive digital literacy modules tailored for TVET learners.
Kiswahili: TVETA huanzisha maendeleo ya moduli kamili za elimu ya digital iliyoundwa kwa ajili ya wanafunzi wa TVET.
Somali: TVETA waxay bilaabaneysaa horumarinta koorsooyin dhamaystiran oo akhriska digital ah oo loogu talagalay ardayda barta TVET.
Dholuo: TVETA chako timo chenro mar loso modules duto mag digital literacy mochan ne jopuonjre mag TVET.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Trans Nzoia County to attend the public participation forum to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka qayb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si loo qaabeeyo dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo ji duto modak e Trans Nzoia County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar timo nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: Some cultural practices during pregnancy and childbirth may endanger lives. Communities are urged to adopt evidence-based health practices.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya desturi za kitamaduni wakati wa ujauzito na kujifungua zinaweza kuhatarisha maisha. Jamii zinahimizwa kufuata desturi za kiafya zinazotegemea ushahidi.
Somali: Caadooyinka dhaqanka qaarkood inta lagu jiro uurka iyo dhalmada ayaa khatar gelin kara nolosha. Bulshooyinka waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay qaataan caadooyin caafimaad oo ku saleysan caddaynta.
Dholuo: Moko kuom timbe ma ji timo e kinde mag ich kod nyuol nyalo miyo ngima ng'ato obed kama rach.

English: KTDA invites farmers in Laikipia County to a free training on record keeping for farmers this October.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa wakulima Oktoba hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Laikipia tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan diiwaangelinta beeralayda bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KTDA ogwelo jopur e county mar Laikipia e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar rito rekod mag jopur dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Narok County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Narok: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Juni 2024
Somali: Degmada Narok: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Narok: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2024

English: CDC launches a July awareness campaign on hand hygiene across Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Julai juu ya usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: CDC waxay bilaabaneysaa olole wacyi galineed bishii July oo ku saabsan nadaafadda gacmaha gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: CDC chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Julai e wi ler mar lwete e alwora mar Elgeyo-Marakwet County.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Uasin Gishu County starting this December.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuanzia Desemba hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka jawaabista Cudurrada waxay ku dhawaaqday in laga bilaabo bisha Diseembar ee sannadkan la siinayo dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche ogolo chik mar keto thieth mar dialysis kuom joma odak e county mar Uasin Gishu kochakore dwe mar Desemba.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds the public in Mombasa County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this February.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba mchango juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka unakaribishwa Februari hii.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa shacabka degmada Mombasa in laga soo dhaweynayo soo gudbinta dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General parone ji duto e County mar Mombasa ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e dwe mar Februar.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) advises residents of Busia County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada la hortagi karo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Busia mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth ma onge chudo mar oganda mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: To avoid buying counterfeit maize seed, look for the scratch-code sticker on the seed packet, scratch it, and send the code to the toll-free verification number to confirm authenticity before planting - as KEPHIS Deputy Director for Seed Certification Ephraim Wachira put it, 'This sticker is what helps farmers distinguish between genuine and fake seed.'
Kiswahili: Ili kuepuka kununua mbegu ghushi za mahindi, tafuta kibandiko cha msimbo wa mwanzo kwenye pakiti ya mbegu, uikwaruze, na utume msimbo kwa nambari ya uthibitishaji isiyolipishwa ili kuthibitisha uhalisi kabla ya kupanda - kama Naibu Mkurugenzi wa KEPHIS wa Udhibitisho wa Mbegu Ephraim Wachira alivyosema, 'Kibandiko hiki ndicho kinachowasaidia wakulima kutofautisha kati ya mbegu halisi na bandia.'
Somali: Si looga fogaado iibsashada abuurka hadhuudhka been abuurka ah, raadi isku dhejinta lambarka qasacadaysan ee ku yaal baakada abuurka, qasacday, oo u dir lambarka lambarka xaqiijinta lacag la'aanta ah si aad u xaqiijiso xaqiiqda ka hor intaadan beerin - sida ku xigeenka agaasimaha KEPHIS ee shahaadada abuurka Ephraim Wachira uu yidhi, 'Stikhaarkan ayaa ka caawiya beeraleyda inay kala gartaan abuurka dhabta ah iyo kuwa been
Dholuo: Mondo kik ing'iew kodhi mag cham ma ok adier, ne ane kido mar kodhi ma ne ondik e paket kodhi, ndik kode, kendo or kode e namba mar ng'eyo kodhi ma onge chudo mondo ing'e ni kodhi ma ne idwaro chwoyo gin adier - mana kaka Ephraim Wachira ma en jalup mar KEPHIS ma ne tayo tij chwoyo kodhi nowacho niya: 'Kidoni konyo jopur mondo ong'e kodhi ma adier kod kodhi ma ok adier.'

English: TVET conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Wajir County this January.
Kiswahili: TVET inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Wajir Januari hii.
Somali: TVET waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha gobolka Wajir bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: TVET timo romo mar tiego ji e wi migawo mar Ombudsman e gweng' mar Wajir e dwe mar Januar.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds youth in Tana River County that HELB funding is available for electrical installation training.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Tana River kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya dhalinyarada degmada Tana River in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne rowere man Tana River County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar loso sitima.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette will hold a public participation forum on development planning forums in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya litafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Kenya Gazette waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta ee Gobolka Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Gazette biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag dongruok e County mar Kirinyaga.

English: Makueni County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Makueni: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2023
Somali: Degmada Makueni: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Makueni: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Septemba 2023

English: Turkana County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Turkana: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2022
Somali: Degmada Turkana: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Turkana: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2022

English: Building on this foundation, C-PEACE applies an integrated approach to deliver environmental, livelihood and peacebuilding outcomes in fragile settings.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuzingatia msingi huu, C-PEACE inatumia mbinu jumuishi ili kutoa matokeo ya kimazingira, maisha na kujenga amani katika mazingira tete.
Somali: Iyada oo lagu salaynayo aasaaskan, C-PEACE waxay isticmaashaa hab isku dhafan si ay u keento natiijooyin deegaan, nolol iyo nabad-dhis ah goobaha nugul.
Dholuo: Ka ochung’ne fundament ma kamano, C-PEACE tiyo kod yo ma oting’o gik moko duto mondo okel gik ma nyalo konyo e rito alwora, ngima kod kuwe e alwora ma nyalo kethore.

English: Notice: KUCCPS launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay bilawday barnaamij lagu darayo ardayda naafada ah dugsiyada gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KUCCPS chako chenro mar tiego nyithindo ma nigi midekre e skunde duto mag Nyandarua County.

English: Notice from Division of Disease Surveillance and Response: family planning counselling clinics will run every January at designated health centres in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Januari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kitui.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka socda qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada: rugaha la talinta qorshaynta qoyska waxaa lagu qaban doonaa Janaayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Kitui.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuwo: Klinike mag chiwo paro e wi chenro mag ngima joot biro tiyo e dwe mar Januar higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e gweng' mar Kitui.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service warns sorghum farmers in Homa Bay County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa sorghum katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay juu ya maambukizi ya wadudu na inapendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda sorghum ee gobolka Homa Bay oo ku saabsan cudurrada cayayaanka waxaana uu ku talinayaa in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service chiwo siem ne jopur mag sorghum e Homa Bay County kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Farmers are advised to consider professional seedling raising services to ensure healthy seedlings and optimize transplanting conditions For best results assess local service availability
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa kuzingatia huduma za kitaalamu za upandishaji miche ili kuhakikisha miche yenye afya na kuboresha hali ya upanzi Kwa matokeo bora zaidi tathmini upatikanaji wa huduma za ndani.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagula talinayaa inay tixgeliyaan adeegyada xirfadeed ee korinta geedo si loo hubiyo geedo caafimaad qaba iyo in la wanaajiyo xaaladaha geedka si natiijooyinka ugu wanaagsan loo qiimeeyo helitaanka adeegga maxalliga ah
Dholuo: Josupni ijiwo mondo onon tije mag pidho kodhi mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mondo omi puothe mag puothe obed gi ngima maber kendo mondo omi gimed timo lokruok e kit ngima mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag pu

Kiswahili: Mama wajawazito huhitaji kalsiamu ili kuimarisha mifupa na meno yao, kutia ndani watoto wao ambao hawajazaliwa
Somali: Hooyooyinka uurka leh waxay u baahan yihiin kalsiyum si ay u xoojiyaan lafahooda iyo ilkahooda oo ay ku jiraan carruurtooda aan dhalan
Dholuo: Min nyithindo madwaro nyuol dwaro calcium mondo omed tego choke koda lakgi moriwo nyaka nyithindgi mapok onyuol
