English: KNEC urges residents of Nyeri County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa watu wazima ili kufaidika na mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay ku biiraan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan barnaamijyada quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Nyeri mondo odonj e program mar puonjo joma dongo somo gi somo mondo giyud konyruok kuom program mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: Notice: SHA launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kwale County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Shirika la SHA linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kwale Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee Gobolka Kwale bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e gweng' mar Kwale e dwe mar Mach.

English: Taita Taveta County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Taita Taveta: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Juni 2022
Somali: Degmada Taita Taveta: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Taita Taveta: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar auchiel 2022

English: Senior school fee guidelines: No increase in boarding fees for 2025.
Kiswahili: Miongozo ya ada ya shule ya upili: Hakuna ongezeko la ada ya bweni kwa mwaka wa 2025.
Somali: Tilmaamaha khidmadaha dugsiga sare: Looma kordhin doono khidmadda degenaanshaha sanadka 2025.
Dholuo: Chenro mar chulo osuru mag skul madongo: Onge medruok mar osuru mar dhi e skul e higa mar 2025.

English: State Department for TVET encourages out-of-school children in Kiambu County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta dugsiga ka baxsan ee degmada Kiambu inay codsadaan deeq waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e County mar Kiambu mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: DCI urges the public in Machakos County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: DCI inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Machakos wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: DCI waxay ugu baaqaysaa shacabka degmada Machakos inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qof kasta oo ka dambeeya kiisaska la soo sheegay ee nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo ji duto e County mar Machakos mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo weche ma nyiso ni gin gi chenro mag gwelo pesa mag miriambo.

English: OGP announces improved turnaround times for e-Citizen registration in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: OGP inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujiandikisha kwa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: OGP waxay ku dhawaaqday waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee Gobolka Nakuru.
Dholuo: OGP olando lokruok e seche mag ndiko e e-Citizen e Kaunti mar Nakuru.

English: Notice: CDC will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Turkana County this June. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: CDC itafanya kongamano la kurejesha matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Turkana Juni hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: CDC waxay qabaneysaa forum ka soo kabashada isticmaalka maandooriyaha degmada Turkana bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni CDC biro timo romo mar chango joma otiyo gi yedhe mamero e dwe mar Jun e taon mar Turkana.

English: Kenya Dairy Board encourages farmers in Garissa County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for tea.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya chai.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda Gobolka Garissa inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan shaaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur e county mar Garissa mondo ous olembe mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo chai mondo omi nengo chai obed maber.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Kisumu County that access to SHA registration is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba ufikiaji wa usajili wa SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Laanta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kisumu in helitaanka diiwaangelinta SHA hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji duto e County mar Kisumu ni koro ginyalo yudo weche mag SHA e kuonde moketi.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Tharaka-Nithi County that access to post-violence medical care is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Tharaka-Nithi in la heli karo daryeel caafimaad oo rabshad ka dib oo lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e Tharaka-Nithi County ni yudo kony mar thieth ma iyudo bang' timno onge chudo.

English: AFA reminds residents of Nyeri County that organic farming improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba kilimo hai kinaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri in beeraha dabiiciga ah uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: AFA paronwa jogweng' Nyeri County ni pur ma nigi gik mochido kelo nyak e puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Kenya Red Cross announces NHIF/SHA claims support for residents of Kiambu County starting this February.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya watangaza NHIF/SHA kudai msaada kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kuanzia Februari hii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa ku dhawaaqday in NHIF/SHA ay sheegato taageero loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Kiambu laga bilaabo Febraayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross olando ni NHIF/SHA dwaro kony ne jogweng' Kiambu County kochakore dwe mar Februar.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds voters in Makueni County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya kujiandikisha.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaan-hayaha xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa xasuusinaya codbixiyayaasha degmada Makueni in ay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor diiwaangelinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties parone jogweng' Makueni County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom SMS ne 70000 kapok gidonjo e register mar joma biro yiero.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges goats farmers in Makueni County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wafugaji wa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa Newcastle vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda orgiga ee degmada Makueni inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyada oo aan la helin ruqsad ka dib kiisaska cudurka Newcastle ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Tuoche jiwo jopur mag diek e gweng' mar Makueni mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni e gwenge mamoko maok giyudo rusa bang' yudo kit tuoche mag Newcastle.

English: E-Citizen invites residents of Kajiado County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawaalika wakazi wa Kajiado County kuwasilisha kumbukumbu za maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay soo gudbiyaan warbixin qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: E-Citizen gwelo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar nono tich mitimo higa ka higa.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit launches a July awareness campaign on tobacco control across Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Julai juu ya udhibiti wa tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Luulyo ee ka dhanka ah xakamaynta sigaarka ee gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osechako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Julai e wi thieth mar ndawa e County duto mar Nyandarua.

English: TVET calls on the community in Baringo County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TVET inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi kwa watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TVET waxay bulshada degmada Baringo ugu baaqeysaa inay la xiriirto khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116, si loo ilaaliyo nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: TVET okwayo ji duto manie Baringo County mondo omany namba mar 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Notice: KRA launches ward-level service delivery in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.

Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne jogweng' Nyeri County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo kuom nek konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders in Kenya s livestock sector are encouraged to engage in market coordination and investment opportunities to enhance competitiveness and boost exports
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo katika sekta ya mifugo nchini Kenya wamehimizwa kushiriki katika uratibu wa soko na fursa za uwekezaji ili kuongeza ushindani na kuongeza mauzo ya nje.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha ee qaybta xoolaha Kenya waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay ka qaybqaataan isku-duwidda suuqyada iyo fursadaha maalgelinta si loo xoojiyo tartanka loona xoojiyo dhoofinta
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma tiyo gi yore mag manyo mwandu e piny Kenya jiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag timo dongruok e ohala kod timo dongruok e ohala

English: Notice: KRA launches county development projects in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay bilawday mashaariic horumarineed oo ka socda degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KRA chako timo dongruok e alwora mar Kisumu County.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will distribute certified sweet potatoes seed to farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itasambaza mbegu za viazi vitamu zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay abuuraha degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet u qaybin doontaa abuurka baradho macaan ee la caddeeyay bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro pogo kodhi mag sweet potato ne jopur man Elgeyo-Marakwet County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: The indicators for SMI align with the Inter-Agency Standing Committee's (IASC) Framework for Durable Solutions and integrates data from IOM's Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM) to ensure a comprehensive, evidence-based approach.
Kiswahili: Ardhi kame na nusu kame (ASAL) kaskazini mwa Kenya, haswa kaunti za Marsabit, Mandera, Wajir, Turkana na Garissa, zinaendelea kupata mahitaji ya kibinadamu ya pande nyingi zinazoendeshwa na makutano ya majanga ya hali ya hewa, mazingira magumu sugu, na kutengwa kwa kijamii na kiuchumi.
Somali: Tilmaamayaasha SMI waxay la jaan qaadayaan Qaab-dhismeedka Guddiga Joogtada ah ee Hay'adaha Isku-dhafka ah (IASC) ee Xallinta Waarta waxayna isku daraan xogta laga helay Matrix-ka Raad-raaca Barakaca (DTM) ee IOM si loo hubiyo hab dhammaystiran oo ku salaysan caddayn.
Dholuo: Gik ma nyiso ni SMI luwore gi chenro mar Komiti ma ochung’ motegno (IASC) mar loso gik ma nyalo sikon kendo oting’o weche ma IOM oting’o e chenro mar luwo jogo ma osewuok e ot (DTM) mondo one ni yo ma owinjore kendo ma nigi gik ma nyiso adier.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds mobile money users in Nyeri County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa fedha za simu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Nyeri inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN ee M-Pesa si looga fogaado khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mobil e County mar Nyeri ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo kik gitim timbe mag wuondruok.

English: IEBC reminds the public in Turkana County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Turkana in sheegashada khiyaamooyinka iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: IEBC paronwa ji duto e County mar Turkana ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag yuto en gima onge nengo, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: FAO reminds residents of Mombasa County that conservation tillage improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba kilimo cha uhifadhi kinaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Mombasa in beerashada ilaalinta ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: FAO parone jogweng' Mombasa County ni chwoyo puothe e yor ritruok medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: State Department for Basic Education encourages residents of Kirinyaga County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabtaan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo jogweng' Kirinyaga County mondo ong'e weche ma gin-go e wi register mar joma oyiero mondo ging'e tich mar ombudsman.

English: NPS reminds residents of Nyeri County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri in warbixinta degdegga ah ee xanta xoolaha ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NPS oparo ne jogweng' Nyeri County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo jamni konyo rito kuonde modakie.

English: IFAD launches innovative financing mechanism to support small-scale food producers to adapt to climate change in Eastern Africa
Kiswahili: IFAD yazindua utaratibu wa kibunifu wa ufadhili kusaidia wazalishaji wadogo wa chakula ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa katika Afrika Mashariki.
Somali: IFAD waxay billowday farsamo maalgelin oo cusub si ay u taageerto soo saarayaasha cuntada yar yar si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddelka cimilada ee Bariga Afrika
Dholuo: IFAD ochako yore manyien mag chiwo omwom mar konyo jopur matindo mag chiemo mondo gibed gi nyalo mar luwo lokruok mag piny e Afrika ma Wuokchieng’

English: Notice: DCI issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Busia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DCI inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay soo saartaa digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Busia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: DCI ogolo siem e wi weche mag sirkal mag cybersecurity e wi chenro mag gwelo pesa mag miriambo makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e county mar Busia.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges cattle farmers in Mombasa County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa kufuatia kuripotiwa kwa magonjwa ya ngozi ya uvimbe.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda xoolaha ee degmada Mombasa inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo ka dib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products jiwo jopur mag jamni e county mar Mombasa mondo ogeng'gi e kuonde moyier mag chamo jamni bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag dhoot.

English: Ministry of Health encourages mothers in Isiolo County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Isiolo inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta caafimaadka ee la qorsheeyay si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health ojiwo mine manie Isiolo County mondo odhi e odiechieng'no mar klinik mondo orit ngima nyathigi.

English: Marsabit County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Marsabit: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2024
Somali: Degmada Marsabit: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Marsabit: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2024

English: FAO reminds residents of Bungoma County that agroforestry improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba kilimo cha misitu kinaboresha uzalishaji wa muda mrefu wa shamba.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma in kaynta beeraha ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: FAO parone jogweng'o mag Bungoma County ni yiende mag yiende konyo e medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: DCI warns residents of Busia County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this August.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Agosti hii.
Somali: DCI waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia inay u diyaar garoobaan qaraxyo dab ah oo dhici kara bisha August.
Dholuo: DCI osiemo jogweng' mar Busia County mondo oikre ne masiche manyalo timore e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: IPOA launches a carjacking prevention campaign in Kisii County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia utekaji nyara katika Kaunti ya Kisii Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: IPOA waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga baabuurta la xaday ee degmada Kisii bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA chako kampen mar geng'o wuondo mtokni e gweng' mar Kisii e dwe mar Agost.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free suicide prevention support is available through county health facilities in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kuzuia kujiua unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo ka hortagga ismiidaaminta laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Nakuru.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar geng'o ji kik donjre yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth e county ma Nakuru County.

English: Council of Governors warns public officers in Kwale County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Kwale dhidi ya udanganyifu wa fedha za umma.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ka digeen saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Kwale in ay ku xadgudbaan maalgashiga dawladda.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Kwale ni kik giti gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo e yo marach.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Isiolo County that access to the GBV toll-free helpline is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kwamba upatikanaji wa simu ya GBV ya bure ya msaada unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Isiolo in helitaanka khadka caawimaadda ee GBV ee lacag la'aan ah uu yahay mid lacag la 'aan ah.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Isiolo ni gibiro yudo kony ma onge chudo mar GBV maonge chudo.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya warns residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to prepare for possible drought this July.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kujiandaa kwa ukame unaowezekana Julai hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay isu diyaariyaan abaaraha iman kara bisha July.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji osiemo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi mondo oikre ne oro ma nyalo bedoe e dwe mar Julai.

English: NPS urges anyone experiencing abuse in Busia County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NPS inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Busia kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Busia inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e gweng' mar Busia mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Kenya: Drought Snapshot (February 2026)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Picha ya Ukame (Februari 2026)
Somali: Kenya: Sawir-qaadis Abaaraha (Febraayo 2026)
Dholuo: Kenya: Picha mar Oro (Dwe mar Ariyo 2026)

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Machakos County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa simu ya GBV ya bure katika Kaunti ya Machakos.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu furayaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ee degmada Machakos.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Forest Service oyawo ofis mar weche mag nindruok ma chiwo chenro mar konyo maonge chudo mar GBV e County ma Machakos.

English: Universities Fund reminds parents in Meru County that free primary education registration is open this July.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Meru kwamba usajili wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo umefunguliwa Julai hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xusuusinayaa waalidiinta degmada Meru in diiwaangelinta bilaashka ah ee waxbarashada hoose ay furan tahay bisha July.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa jonyuol e County mar Meru ni somo mar pinyruoth en mar nono e dwe mar Julai.

English: Wajir County Drought Rapid Assessment Report, December 2025
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Tathmini ya Haraka ya Ukame ya Kaunti ya Wajir, Desemba 2025
Somali: Warbixinta Qiimaynta Degdegga ah ee Abaarta ee Degmada Wajeer, Diseembar 2025
Dholuo: Ripot mar Pim Mapiyo mar Oro e Kaunti mar Wajir, dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2025

English: Pest Control Products Board urges farmers in Taita-Taveta County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa ku boorinaya beeraleyda gobolka Taita-Taveta inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo soo-saarka biyaha ee beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Taita-Taveta mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Goal-setting is subjective. It is important to create goals that make sense for you during your recovery journey. If you need assistance in creating realistic and achievable goals, reach out to your mentor, peer, or another mental health professional for guidance and tips
Kiswahili: Kuweka malengo ni jambo la kibinafsi. Ni muhimu kuunda malengo yanayokufaa wakati wa safari yako ya kupona. Ikiwa unahitaji usaidizi katika kuunda malengo halisi na yanayoweza kufikiwa, wasiliana na mshauri wako, mwenzako, au mtaalamu mwingine wa afya ya akili kwa mwongozo na vidokezo.
Somali: Hadafku waa mid madax banaan. Waa muhiim in la abuuro himilooyin macno leh inta lagu jiro safarkaaga soo kabashada. Haddii aad u baahan tahay caawimaad sameynta himilooyinka macquulka ah ee la gaari karo, la xiriir tababarahaaga, asxaabtaada ama xirfadle kale oo caafimaadka dhimirka ah si aad u hesho hagitaan iyo talooyin
Dholuo: Keto chenro en gima ng'ato owuon ema nyalo timo. Dwarore ahinya ni ichak keto chenro maber e ngimani. Kapo ni idwaro ni okonyi keto chenro ma inyalo chopo, inyalo kwayo japuonjni, osiepni moro, kata ng'at machielo molony e weche thieth mar paro mondo okonyi.

English: Universities Fund reminds needy students in Murang'a County that school laptops under the digital literacy programme applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya maombi ya programu ya kusoma na kuandika ya kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xasuusinayaa ardayda u baahan degmada Murang'a in laptop-yada dugsiga ee ku jira codsiyada barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa jopuonjre man gi chandruok e County mar Murang'a ni kompyuta mag skul manie program mar digital literacy application chiegni rumo.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET opens applications for school laptops under the digital literacy programme for learners in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inafungua maombi ya kompyuta ndogo za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay furaysaa codsiyada kumbuyuutarrada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee ardayda degmada Garissa.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State Department for TVET oyawo kwayo mag kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar somo kod somo mar digital ne jopuonjre man e county mar Garissa.

English: KICD advises students in Embu County to register early to secure allocation to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: KICD inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Embu kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali.
Somali: KICD waxay ardayda degmada Embu kula talineysaa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan waqti hore si ay u helaan kaalmo ay ku helaan kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo jopuonjre e county mar Embu mondo odonj e tiegruok chon mondo giyud pesa mar tiyo gi kompyuta mag skul kaluwore gi chenro mar somo gi somo mar digital.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds the public in Wajir County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this February.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba mchango juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka unakaribishwa Februari hii.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa shacabka degmada Wajir in laga soo dhaweynayo soo gudbinta dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General parone ji duto e County mar Wajir ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e dwe mar Februar.

English: NPS reminds mobile money users in Taita-Taveta County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Taita-Taveta inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado khiyaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: NPS paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e Taita-Taveta County mondo ochiw ripot mar ote maok kare ne jatendgi mondo kik gitim wuond mar loko SIM.

English: KICD urges youth in Trans Nzoia County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KICD inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KICD waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka qeybgalaan munaasabadda dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo rowere e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo oriwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar gweng'no ka pok ochopo tije mag oganda.

English: Office of the Auditor-General warns public officers in Taita-Taveta County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya madaraka.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dawladda ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal man Taita-Taveta County ni kik giti marach gi migepegi.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Kirinyaga County this July. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Julai hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay qabaneysaa madasha caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada ee Gobolka Kirinyaga bisha July.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Red Cross biro timo chokruok mar paro ne rowere e gweng' mar Kirinyaga e dwe mar Julai.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds the public in West Pokot County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this October.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kwamba mapendekezo juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka yanakaribishwa Oktoba hii.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadweynaha gobolka West Pokot in talooyinka dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone ji duto e West Pokot County ni gibiro yie gi chiwo mar paro e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e dwe mar Oktoba.

Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji ni thieth mar malaria maonge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County Kilifi e dwe mar Jun.

English: NDMA calls on the community in Samburu County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Samburu kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu ya simu ya GBV 1195.
Somali: NDMA waxay bulshada degmada Samburu ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wici doonaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: NDMA okwayo ji duto manie county mar Samburu mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195 maonge chudo.

English: TSC urges residents of Samburu County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kutuma maombi ya bursari hiyo kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: TSC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Samburu inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Samburu mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud somo mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Gazette encourages first-time voters in Kiambu County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Kiambu inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogo ma ne okwongo yiero e Kaunti mar Kiambu mondo onon weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: Notice: NDMA issues a cybersecurity alert on phishing messages affecting residents of Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya ujumbe wa udanganyifu unaowaathiri wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan farriimaha phishing ee saameeya dadka deggan Gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NDMA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity e wi ote mag phishing makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Taita-Taveta County.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development urges residents of Baringo County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay iska diiwaangeliyaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo jogweng' Baringo County mondo ondikgi e program mar somo mar joma dongo mondo giyud somo mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Bungoma County this July. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanya kongamano la kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Julai hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) waxay qabaneysaa madasha dib u soo kabashada isticmaalka maandooriyaha ee degmada Bungoma bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo romo mar chango joma tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero e taon mar Bungoma e dwe mar Julai.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Isiolo County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inawaonya wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ka digaya dadka deggan degmada Isiolo kororka khiyaamada lacagaha SIM-swap wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga leh bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng' Isiolo County e wi medruok mar timbe mag wuondo ji gi SIM-swap kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok adier ne jatendgi.

English: Ministry of Education encourages out-of-school children in Migori County to register their children at the nearest public school under free primary education.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Migori kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Migori inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan iskuulka guud ee ugu dhow ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e County mar Migori mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni gi skul maduong' mar piny ka gipuonjore somo mapile maonge chudo.

English: Public health advisory: CDC warns of increased cholera risk in Uasin Gishu County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: CDC inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya kipindupindu katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu na inashauri umma kutumia vyandarua vya mbu vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Talooyinka Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: CDC waxay ka digeysaa khatarta sii kordheysa ee cudurka kolera ee Gobolka Uasin Gishu waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay isticmaalaan shabaqa cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: CDC chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar cholera e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu County kendo ojiwo ji mondo oti gi net mag lum ma nigi yedhe makelo tuoche mag kute otieno ka otieno.

English: No violence! Report student issues to school management.
Kiswahili: Hakuna vurugu! Ripoti masuala ya wanafunzi kwa usimamizi wa shule.
Somali: Dhibaatooyinka ardayda u sheeg maamulka dugsiga.
Dholuo: Onge timbe gero! Nyis jotelo mag skul weche mag jopuonjre.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association confirms a typhoid outbreak alert for Machakos County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari Kenya chathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa typhoid katika Kaunti ya Machakos. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu xaqiijiyay digniin ku saabsan cudurka tifooska ee degmada Machakos. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Medical Association osenyiso ni nitie masira mar thieth mar typhoid e County ma Machakos.

English: DPP reminds mobile money users in Wajir County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee Gobolka Wajir inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: DPP paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e County mar Wajir mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo gitang' gi chenro mag pesa mag miriambo.

English: Key points to stop Mpox spread: Avoid close contact with individuals showing symptoms. Do not share personal items like towels, utensils, or clothing. Maintain good hygiene by washing hands frequently.
Kiswahili: Mambo muhimu ya kuzuia kuenea kwa Mpox: Epuka kugusana kwa karibu na watu wanaoonyesha dalili. Usishiriki vitu vya kibinafsi kama vile taulo, vyombo, au nguo. Dumisha usafi mzuri kwa kunawa mikono mara kwa mara.
Somali: Waxyaabaha ugu muhiimsan ee lagu joojin karo faafitaanka Mpox: Ka fogow inaad xiriir dhow la yeelato dadka muujinaya calaamadaha cudurka. Ha la wadaagin waxyaabaha shakhsi ahaaneed sida tuulooyinka, weelasha, ama dharka.
Dholuo: Puonj madongo ma nyalo konyo e geng'o kaka Mpox landore: Kik ibed machiegni gi jogo ma nigi tuwono. Kik ipog gik moko e kindu kaka twanda, agulni, kata lewni. Bed gi timbe maler ka ilwoko lweti nyading'eny.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds farmers in Isiolo County of the ongoing fertiliser application training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuhusu programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya matumizi ya mbolea.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa beeraleyda degmada Isiolo barnaamijka tababarka codsiga bacriminta ee socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board oparo ne jopur man Isiolo County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar tiyo gi yien mag yien.

English: Taking vaccines to these communities also meant that vaccination teams would set up vaccination stations at watering points.
Kiswahili: Kupeleka chanjo kwa jumuiya hizi pia kulimaanisha kuwa timu za chanjo zingeweka vituo vya chanjo katika maeneo ya kunyweshea maji.
Somali: Tallaallada loo qaaday bulshooyinkan waxay sidoo kale la macno tahay in kooxaha tallaalka ay ka dhisi doonaan goobo tallaal oo ku yaal meelaha biyaha laga cabbo.
Dholuo: Ka ne itero chanjo e gwenge ma kamago, bende ne tiende en ni jogo ma ne chiwo chanjo ne dhi keto kuonde ma ne imiye chanjo e kuonde ma ne imiye pi.

English: Increasingly, the example by leaders like him who have vaccinated, wears masks and insists on keeping distance rubs off on the 14,000-members of community.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuongezeka, mfano wa viongozi kama yeye ambao wamechanja, huvaa vinyago na kusisitiza kuwaweka mbali watu 14,000 wa jamii.
Somali: Waxaa sii kordhaya, tusaalaha hoggaamiyeyaasha sida isaga oo kale ah ee tallaalay, xirta maaskaro oo ku adkeysta inay masaafada ilaaliyaan ayaa saameyn ku yeelanaya 14,000 oo xubnood oo bulshada ka tirsan.
Dholuo: Kaka ng’ato medore, ranyisi ma jotelo ma chal kode ma osemiyogi chanjo, ma rwako mask kendo ma dwaro ni ji obed mabor gi jowetegi, mulo jokanyo 14,000 mag oganda.

English: TVET invites youth in Makueni County to enroll for tailoring and design training this February.
Kiswahili: TVET inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Makueni kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni Februari hii.
Somali: TVET waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Makueni inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka dharka iyo naqshadeynta bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: TVET gwelo rowere mag Makueni County mondo odonjre e tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko e dwe mar Februar.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) announces improved turnaround times for e-Citizen registration in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujiandikisha kwa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la hagaajiyay waqtiga diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) olando lokruok e kinde mag dhi e e-Citizen registration e County mar Wajir.

English: ODPP reminds the public in Elgeyo-Marakwet County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: ODPP oparo ne ji duto e County mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni lando wach tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: It is best to harvest tomatoes in the morning to avoid excessive heat.
Kiswahili: Ni bora kuvuna nyanya asubuhi ili kuepuka joto kupita kiasi.
Somali: Waxaa ugu fiican in yaanyo la goosto subaxdii si looga fogaado kulaylka xad-dhaafka ah.
Dholuo: Ber ka ipogo pomade gokinyi mondo kik ng'ich ahinya.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya opens the electoral calendar centres in Homa Bay County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay mwezi huu wa Oktoba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay furaysaa xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee gobolka Homa Bay bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Huduma Kenya chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e Homa Bay County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya launches a theft prevention campaign in Nakuru County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Maamulka Isgaarsiinta Kenya wuxuu bilaabay olole ka hortagga tuugada degmada Nakuru bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chako kampen mar geng'o kuo e gweng' mar Nakuru e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice from KEMRI: childhood immunization clinics will run every August at designated health centres in Busia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa KEMRI: kliniki za chanjo za watoto zitaendeshwa kila Agosti katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Busia.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid KEMRI: rugta tallaalka carruurta ayaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Agoosto oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee lagu magacaabo degmada Busia.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMRI: Klinike mag thiedho nyithindo biro tiyo dwe mar Agost higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e county mar Busia.

English: DPP reminds residents of Kajiado County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada daadadka ka dhacay xilligan dhulgariirka.
Dholuo: DPP oparo ne jogweng' Kajiado County ni kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o e kinde mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: KEMSA announces free medical camps for residents of Busia County starting this October.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kuanzia Oktoba hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa xeryo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Busia laga bilaabo Oktoobarkan.
Dholuo: KEMSA ogolo kampen mag thieth maonge chudo ne joma odak e County mar Busia kochakore Oktoba.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Makueni County this August. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Makueni Agosti hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa qaban doonta madasha caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada ee degmada Makueni bisha Agoosto. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo romo mar paro ne rowere e kaunti mar Makueni e dwe mar Agost.

English: IEBC warns public officers in Siaya County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: IEBC inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: IEBC waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Siaya inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: IEBC chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Siaya ni kik giti marach gi migepegi.

English: A Kenyan Peacebuilder Explains Whatâ€™s at Stake in Her Countryâ€™s Elections
Kiswahili: Mjenzi wa Amani wa Kenya Aeleza Kilicho Hatarini Katika Uchaguzi wa Nchi Yake
Somali: Nabad-dhisaha Kenya oo Sharaxay Waxa ku Jira Doorashada Dalkeeda
Dholuo: Ja Kenya ma Kelo Kelo Kelo Kwe Olero Gima Nitie E Rieko e Yiero ma Pinyre Otimore

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges eligible citizens in Embu County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Embu kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Xafiiska tijaabiyaha guud wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Embu inay ka qeyb galaan jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General jiwo raia mowinjore e county mar Embu mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar yiero.

English: NDMA warns residents of Marsabit County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kuhusu ongezeko la kashfa za pesa za simu na inashauri umma wasiishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: NDMA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit in ay kordheen khiyaamada lacagta mobile waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: NDMA chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar Marsabit County kuom wach medruok mar wuond mag pesa mitimo e simo kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: [KUCCPS Portal] KUCCPS portal will open in March 2025 for university placement and course selection for 2024 KCSE candidates
Kiswahili: [Lango la KUCCPS] Lango la KUCCPS litafunguliwa Machi 2025 kwa nafasi za chuo kikuu na uteuzi wa kozi kwa watahiniwa wa KCSE wa 2024
Somali: [KCCPS Portal] Bogga KUCCPS wuxuu furmi doonaa bishii Maarso 2025 si loo helo booska jaamacadaha iyo xulashada koorsooyinka loogu talagalay musharixiinta 2024 ee KCSE
Dholuo: [KuCCPS Portal] KUCCPS portal biro yawore e dwe mar Mach 2025 ne jogo madwaro dhi e KCSE mar 2024 e yunivasiti kod yiero somo.

English: KUCCPS calls on the community in Isiolo County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa wasimamizi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Isiolo inay u soo wargeliyaan maamulka iskuulka wixii dhibaato ah ee ku saabsan amniga si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: KUCCPS okwayo ji duto manie gweng' mar Isiolo mondo onyis sirkal mar skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: TSC invites youth in Murang'a County to enroll for electrical installation training this July.
Kiswahili: TSC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Julai hii.
Somali: TSC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Murang'a inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada bisha July.
Dholuo: TSC gwelo rowere e County mar Murang'a mondo odonj e tiegruok mar keto sitima e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by CDC will be held in Homa Bay County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na CDC itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Januari hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabiyeen CDC ayaa lagu qaban doonaa gobolka Homa Bay bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kampen mar thieth ma onge chudo ma CDC ochano biro timore e Homa Bay County e dwe mar Januar.

English: OGP urges residents of Nandi County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha kusanyiko la kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nandi inay ka qayb galaan kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee golaha gobolka si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda horumarinta gobolka.
Dholuo: OGP ojiwo ji duto modak e county mar Nandi County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo gibed gi ng'eyo kuom chenro mag dongruok mag county.

English: KNEC calls on the community in Mandera County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KNEC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: KNEC waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Mandera inay u soo wargeliyaan mas'uuliyadda iskuulka wixii dhibaato ah ee ku saabsan amniga si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: KNEC dwaro ni oganda man Mandera County ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar skul kuom weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone experiencing abuse in Turkana County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya ngono katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qofkasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Turkana inuu ka warbixiyo kiisaska xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow saldhigga booliska.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e county mar Turkana mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development encourages farmers in Mombasa County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora ya mahindi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Mombasa inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay hadhuudhka.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur e county mar Mombasa mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar kodhi.

Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nandi in ka qaybgalka maamulaha qaybta deegaanka ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone jogweng' kaunti mar Nandi ni tudruok gi jarit mar ward margi jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: After Successful Year, CFK Africa Launches 2024 with New Partnership to Support Best Schools Initiative in Kenya
Kiswahili: Baada ya Mwaka wa Mafanikio, CFK Africa Yazindua 2024 kwa Ubia Mpya wa Kusaidia Mpango wa Shule Bora nchini Kenya.
Somali: Ka dib Sanad Guuleed, CFK Africa waxay Bilaabaysaa 2024 iyadoo la kaashanaysa Iskaashi Cusub si loo Taageero Hindisaha Iskuulada ugu Fiican Kenya
Dholuo: Bang’ higa ma ne odhi maber, CFK Afrika ochako higa mar 2024 gi riwruok manyien mar konyo chenro mar skul mabeyo e piny Kenya

English: Notice: KNEC opens applications for textbooks and learning materials for learners in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inafungua maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay u furaysaa codsiyada buugaagta waxbarasho iyo qalabka wax lagu barto ardayda degmada Wajir.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KNEC chako tiyo gi buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok ne jopuonjre e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: The draft Kenya Leather Development Policy has been developed to guide the growth of the leather sector Stakeholders are encouraged to review and provide feedback on the draft
Kiswahili: Rasimu ya Sera ya Maendeleo ya Ngozi ya Kenya imetengenezwa ili kuongoza ukuaji wa sekta ya ngozi Wadau wanahimizwa kuhakiki na kutoa maoni kuhusu rasimu hiyo.
Somali: Qoraalka Siyaasadda Horumarinta Maqaarka Kenya ayaa loo sameeyay si loo hago kobaca warshadda maqaarka. Daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay dib u eegaan oo bixiyaan jawaab celin ku saabsan qoraalka
Dholuo: Chenro mar Kenya Leather Development Policy osechak mondo ota dongruok mar leather sector

English: Teachers Service Commission urges parents and teachers in Garissa County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu ku boorinayaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Garissa inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: Commission Service of Teachers Commission jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Garissa mondo omany namba mar kony mar nyithindo 116.

English: HELB invites youth in Nyandarua County to enroll for tailoring and design training this October.
Kiswahili: HELB inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni Oktoba hii.
Somali: HELB waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nyandarua inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka dharka iyo naqshadeynta bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: HELB gwelo rowere e County mar Nyandarua mondo odonj e tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: This analysis passes through present research effects and digital space among youths in the sector of education, agriculture, finance and employment. Research...
Kiswahili: Uchambuzi huu unapitia athari za sasa za utafiti na nafasi ya dijiti kati ya vijana katika sekta ya elimu, kilimo, fedha na ajira. Utafiti...
Somali: Falanqayntani waxay dhex martaa saameynta cilmi-baarista ee hadda jirta iyo meelaha dijitaalka ah ee dhalinyarada ku jira qaybaha waxbarashada, beeraha, maaliyadda iyo shaqada. Cilmi-baaris...
Dholuo: Nonro ma otimono nono gik ma timore e kindegi e wi timo nonro kod thuolo mar bedo gi rowere e yore mag somo, pur, pesa, koda tich.

English: Notice: KMTC opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay furaysaa codsiyada deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan ardayda barta degmada Tharaka-Nithi.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC oseyawo kwayo mag yudo riekni mag somo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e Tharaka-Nithi County.

English: Kenya - Northern Kenya: Drought Severity and Population Exposure in Turkana County (28 Jan 2026)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Kaskazini mwa Kenya: Ukali wa Ukame na Mfichuo wa Idadi ya Watu katika Kaunti ya Turkana (28 Januari 2026)
Somali: Kenya - Waqooyiga Kenya: Darajada Abaaraha iyo Soo-gaadhista Dadweynaha ee Degmada Turkana (28 Jannaayo 2026)
Dholuo: Kenya - Kenya ma Nyanduat: Oro Matek kod Kwan mar Oganda e Guoth mar Turkana (28 dwe mar achiel higa mar 2026)

English: Ministry of Education encourages out-of-school children in Uasin Gishu County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under free primary education.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Uasin Gishu inay dalbadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo nyithindo maok dhi e skul e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo.

Kiswahili: KUCCPS hufungua mwisho kozi ya mabadiliko dirisha kabla ya seva kuanguka!
Somali: KUCCPS waxay furaysaa daaqadda ugu dambeysa ee isbeddelka koorsada ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…â€œ beddel shahaadada ka hor inta aysan server-yadu dhicin!
