English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges poultry farmers in Bomet County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported foot and mouth disease cases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wafugaji wa kuku katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda digaagga ee degmada Bomet inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xadka degmada iyagoo aan haysan rukhsad kadib kiisaska cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur ma pidho dhok e county mar Bomet mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni kuonde mopogore opogore ka ok giyudo rusa bang' yudo tuoche mag dhoot.

English: State Department for TVET conducts a civic education forum on voter registration in Migori County this June.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Migori Juni hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha Degmada Migori bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET dhi e chokruok mar tiego ji e wi weche mag ndiko ji e kaunti mar Migori e dwe mar Jun.

English: KEPHIS advises farmers in Marsabit County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the June planting season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Juni.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Marsabit inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Juun.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e county mar Marsabit mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Jun.

English: FAO advises farmers in Busia County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the April planting season.
Kiswahili: FAO inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia kudhibiti wizi wa jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa za kuua wadudu zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa kupanda Aprili.
Somali: FAO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda ku nool degmada Busia in ay ka hortagaan cayayaanka ciidanka dayrta iyagoo isticmaalaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e gweng ' mar Busia County mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma oseyudo ratiro mar chango jolweny e dwe mar April.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges sheep farmers in Makueni County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wafugaji wa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda idaha ee degmada Makueni inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee anthrax.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur mag rombe e county mar Makueni mondo onyis le matuwo e ofise mar thieth machiegni gi kanyo bang' yudo weche mag anthrax.

English: Vegetable farmers should buy certified and treated seeds, unless growing organically, in which case seeds cannot be treated.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa mboga wanapaswa kununua mbegu zilizoidhinishwa na kutibiwa, isipokuwa kukua kikaboni, katika hali ambayo mbegu haziwezi kutibiwa.
Somali: Beeraleyda khudaarta waa inay iibsadaan abuur shahaado leh oo la daweeyay, haddii aysan si organic ah u korin, markaas abuurka lama daweyn karo.
Dholuo: Jogi onego ong'iew kodhi ma oseti gi ratiro kendo ma oselony, mak mana ka gipidhogi gi yien ma ok ochwe, kendo mano ok nyal miyo kodhi osetigo.

English: KEMRI appeals to caregivers in Makueni County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the February maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Makueni kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya harakati za afya ya uzazi za Februari.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Makueni inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Febraayo.
Dholuo: KEMRI okwayo jorit e gweng' mar Makueni mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongruok kaka achiel kuom chenro mar Februar mar rito ngima mar mine.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development encourages out-of-school children in West Pokot County to register their children at the nearest public school under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Ukuzaji wa Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee Gobolka West Pokot inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e West Pokot County mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni e bwo chenro mar chiemo e skul.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the public in Nairobi County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nairobi inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada iyada oo loo marayo kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto e County mar Nairobi mondo ong'e kwayo mag ji kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro bang' yudo weche ma ji wacho e wi weche mag phishing.

English: KRA urges residents of Kitui County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan bixinta adeegyada heerka degmooyinka.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo jogweng' Kitui County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono ka gitiyo gi websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche ma timore e wi tiegruok mar gwenge.

English: According to data provided by the National Agency for Campaign Against Drug Abuse (NACADA), about 50 per cent of the youth in Embu County, use the stimulant abandoning and breaking all social distance rules, put in place to contain the spread of Covid-19.
Kiswahili: Kulingana na data iliyotolewa na Shirika la Kitaifa la Kampeni Dhidi ya Matumizi Mabaya ya Dawa za Kulevya (NACADA), takriban asilimia 50 ya vijana katika Kaunti ya Embu, wanatumia kichocheo cha kutelekeza na kuvunja sheria zote za umbali wa kijamii, zilizowekwa ili kudhibiti kuenea kwa Covid-19.
Somali: Sida laga soo xigtay xogta ay bixisay Hay'adda Qaranka ee Ololaha Ka-hortagga Xadgudubka Daroogada (NACADA), qiyaastii 50 boqolkiiba dhallinyarada ku nool Degmada Embu, ayaa isticmaala kicinta iyagoo ka tagaya oo jebinaya dhammaan xeerarka fogaanshaha bulshada, ee loo dejiyay si loo xakameeyo faafitaanka Covid-19.
Dholuo: Kaluwore gi data ma ochiw gi riwruok mar piny mangima mar kedo kod yath ma mero ji (NACADA), madirom 50 kuom mia achiel mag joma tindo e gweng’ mar Embu, tiyo kod yath ma kelo gombo mar weyo kendo ketho chike duto mag bedo mabor gi jowetegi, ma ne oket mondo ogeng’ lando mar Covid-19.

English: DPP reminds mobile money users in Uasin Gishu County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid identity theft.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee gobolka Uasin Gishu inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado in la xado aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: DPP oparo ne jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e county mar Uasin Gishu ni mondo ginyis jomisonari maggi weche maok kare mondo kik gidonj e wuond mar ng'ato.

English: Narok County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Narok: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2024
Somali: Degmada Narok: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Narok: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2024

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Isiolo County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kazini wakati wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo inay guryahooda ku rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo shaqada inta lagu jiro xilliyada fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service paronwa jogweng' Isiolo County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo giti e kinde mag koth.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds expectant mothers in Kisii County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Laanta Cas ee Kenya waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Kisii in helitaanka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Kisii ni thuolo mar yudo puonj mag chenro mag ngima joot en maonge chudo e kuonde duto ma ji yudoree.

English: KUCCPS invites youth in Siaya County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this September.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Siaya kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Septemba hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Siaya inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KUCCPS gwelo rowere e county mar Siaya mondo odonj e tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing e dwe mar Septemba.

English: KRA advises residents of Nairobi County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: KRA inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Somali: KRA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay qaataan dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado dib u dhac marka la raadinayo shahaadada dhalashada.
Dholuo: KRA nyiso jogweng' mar Nairobi County mondo oting'e buge duto madwarore mondo kik gikel hinyruok sama gidwaro yudo barua mar nyuol.

English: NTSA reminds mobile money users in Embu County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Embu kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: NTSA waxay xusuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobile ee degmada Embu inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada iyada oo loo marayo kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado khiyaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: NTSA paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e county mar Embu mondo onyis ni giketo pachgi kuom kwayo mag pesa e yor sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo kik gitim mibadhi mar SIM-swap.

English: Teachers Service Commission advises students in Tana River County to collect materials from the county education office to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Tana River kukusanya vifaa kutoka kwa ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ardayda degmada Tana River ku talinayaa inay ka soo ururiyaan waxyaabo xafiiska waxbarashada degmada si ay u helaan buugaagta waxbarasho iyo qalabka wax lagu barto.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jopuonjre e taon mar Tana River County mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar tiegruok mar county mondo giyud buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds livestock keepers in Kwale County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu xasuusinayaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Kwale inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka lo'da.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jorit jamni e county mar Kwale ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the community in Isiolo County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb fraud.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua ili kuzuia udanganyifu.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa bulshada degmada Isiolo inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shisheeyaha si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo oganda manie Isiolo County mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo gikwed mibadhi.

English: Kenya: Anticipatory Actions On Ebola Virus Disease DREF Final Report (MDRKE052)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Hatua za Kutarajia Kuhusu Ugonjwa wa Virusi vya Ebola Ripoti ya Mwisho ya DREF (MDRKE052)
Somali: Kenya: Tallaabooyinka La Filayo Ee Ku Saabsan Cudurka Fayraska Ebola Warbixinta Ugu Dambeysa ee DREF (MDRKE052)
Dholuo: Kenya: Timbe mag geno kuom tuo mar Ebola Ripot mogik mar DREF (MDRKE052)

English: IFAD President and President of Kenya agree to accelerate agriculture and adapt to climate crisis
Kiswahili: Rais wa IFAD na Rais wa Kenya wakubali kuharakisha kilimo na kukabiliana na hali ya hewa
Somali: Madaxweynaha IFAD iyo Madaxweynaha Kenya ayaa ku heshiiyay in la dardargeliyo beeraha lana waafajiyo dhibaatooyinka cimilada.
Dholuo: Jatend IFAD kod Jatend piny Kenya oyie mondo gitim pur mapiyo kendo gilokre gi pek mag piny

English: NTSA reminds residents of Mombasa County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Mombasa in warbixinta degdegga ah ee xanta xoolaha ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NTSA oparo ne jogweng' Mombasa County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo jamni konyo rito kuonde modakie.

English: COMESA urges farmers in Wajir County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Wajir inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Wajir mondo opidh olembe ma ok nyal geng'o lowo kethore mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: SHA urges residents of Samburu County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandaoni wa kaunti ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Samburu inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jogweng' county mar Samburu mondo oriwre gi county's online participation portal e loso chenro mar bajet mar county.

English: E-Citizen updates residents of Makueni County on progress of the county integrated development plan this November.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti hii Novemba.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay dadka deggan degmada Makueni ku wargelineysaa horumarka qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada bisha November.
Dholuo: E-Citizen medo lero ne jogweng' Makueni kaka chenro mar dongruok mar county integrated development dhi nyime e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges motorists and pedestrians in Nandi County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Somali: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada wuxuu ku boorinayaa gawaarida wadayaasha iyo dadka lugta leh ee degmada Nandi inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay adeegsadaan meelaha lugta ah ee loo qoondeeyay si looga hortago shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo dereche mag mtoka kod joma wuotho e ndara e county mar Nandi mondo oluw tong' mar ng'ado mar mtoka kendo oti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe mondo gikwed hinyruok mag ndara.

English: DCI reminds mobile money users in Kilifi County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kilifi inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna si looga fogaado nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: DCI paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e County mar Kilifi ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo gitang' gi chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo.

English: IEBC reminds the public in Siaya County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this August.
Kiswahili: IEBC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba maoni juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma ni kuwakaribisha Agosti hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Siaya in talooyin ku saabsan wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: IEBC parone ji duto e county mar Siaya ni okwayo ji mondo ochiw paro e wi chenro mag sirkal e dwe mar Agost.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds residents of Uasin Gishu County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this drought season.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati huu wa ukame.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu ku xasuusinaya inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada fatahaada ah xilliyada abaarta.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne jogweng' Uasin Gishu County ni kik ging'ad pi e kind yiengni mag oro.

English: NPS calls on the community in Kilifi County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatia moyo jamii katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: NPS waxay bulshada degmada Kilifi ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: NPS okwayo ji duto manie gweng' mar Kilifi mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gichiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Samburu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Samburu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Juni 2022
Somali: Degmada Samburu: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Samburu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2022

English: SHA urges residents of Homa Bay County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: SHA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee gobolka si ay u qaabeeyaan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county mar chiwo paro e wi tich ma gitimo higa ka higa.

English: Notice: NCPB will open a coffee collection centre in Nyandarua County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itafungua kituo cha kukusanya kahawa katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay ka furi doontaa xarun ururinta kafeega ee gobolka Nyandarua bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NCPB biro yawo kama ichokoe chai e kaunti mar Nyandarua e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Agriculture Sector Development Support Programme (ASDSP II) was approved for implementation by the. Government of Kenya and Government of Sweden on 17th ...
Kiswahili: Programu ya Msaada kwa Maendeleo ya Sekta ya Kilimo (ASDSP II) iliidhinishwa kwa utekelezaji na Serikali ya Kenya na Serikali ya Sweden siku ya 17 ...
Somali: Barnaamijka Taageerada Horumarinta Sector-ka Beeraha (ASDSP II) ayaa la ansixiyay in la hirgeliyo. Dowladda Kenya iyo Dowladda Sweden 17-kii ...
Dholuo: Chenro mar Siro Ji e Locho mar Soko mar Soko mar Soko mar Ngima (ASDSP II) ne oyie mondo otimre gi sirkal mar Kenya kod sirkal mar Sweden tarik 17 ...

English: Notice: DCI activates an emergency response plan for fire outbreaks in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa milipuko ya moto katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay hirgelinaysaa qorshe xaalad deg deg ah oo looga jawaabayo dabka ka kacay degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Rapar: DCI tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony mapiyo ne masiche mag mach e County mar Vihiga.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges parents and teachers in Uasin Gishu County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macalimiinta wuxuu ugu baaqay waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Uasin Gishu inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e kaunti mar Uasin Gishu mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto.

English: Universities Fund conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Kakamega County this March.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Machi hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Jaamacadaha ayaa bishii Maarso ku qaban doonta madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan wareejinta gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda e dwe mar Mach e kaunti mar Kakamega.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages mothers in Trans Nzoia County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta bukaanka ee la qorsheeyay si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo mine man Trans Nzoia County mondo odhi e odiechieng'no mar thieth mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: FAO advises farmers in Nakuru County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: FAO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: FAO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nakuru inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: COMESA announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for sheep in Embu County this January.
Kiswahili: COMESA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Embu Januari hii.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo cudurka Newcastle ah oo loogu talagalay idaha Gobolka Embu bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: COMESA olando chenro mar goyo rombe mar thieth mar tuo mar Newcastle maonge chudo e dwe mar Januar e county mar Embu.

English: There are new agricultural partnerships under discussion that may benefit Kenyan farmers Stay informed about developments and opportunities related to these initiatives
Kiswahili: Kuna ubia mpya wa kilimo unaojadiliwa ambao unaweza kufaidisha wakulima wa Kenya Endelea kufahamishwa kuhusu maendeleo na fursa zinazohusiana na mipango hii.
Somali: Waxaa jira wada-shaqeyn cusub oo beeraha ah oo laga wada hadlayo oo faa'iido u yeelan kara beeraleyda Kenya Fadlan ka wargaliso horumarka iyo fursadaha la xiriira dadaalladaas
Dholuo: Nitie chenro manyien mag timo ohala mag pur ma biro konyo jopur Kenya dhi nyime bedo gi ng'eyo kuom dongruok kod thuolo ma gin - go e kind chenrogo

English: State Department for Basic Education reminds needy students in Mombasa County that revision guides applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Mombasa in dib-u-eegista ay ku hagaajineyso codsiyada la soo gabagabeynayo.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education oparo ne jopuonjre modhier man Mombasa County ni lokruok ma ne otimno ne tayo kwayo mag ng'ado mar donjo e skundno.

English: TSC calls on the community in Bungoma County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TSC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TSC waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Bungoma inay ka warbixiyaan walaacyada amniga ee maamulka dugsiga si ay u ilaaliyaan amniga dugsiyada.
Dholuo: TSC kwayo ji duto manie Bungoma County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar skul e wi weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education opens a new electrical installation programme at the vocational centre in Narok County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu inafungua programu mpya ya ufungaji wa umeme katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo lagu rakibo korontada xarunta xirfadaha ee gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Puonjruok chako chenro manyien mar keto sitima e kar tiegruok e gweng' mar Narok.

English: Kenya: Registered refugees and asylum-seekers (as of 31 October 2024)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Wakimbizi waliosajiliwa na wanaotafuta hifadhi (kuanzia tarehe 31 Oktoba 2024)
Somali: Kenya: Qaxootiga diiwaangashan iyo kuwa magangalyo doonka ah (laga bilaabo 31 Oktoobar 2024)
Dholuo: Kenya: Jolweny ma ondiki nyinggi kod jogo madwaro resruok (chakre tarik 31 dwe mar apar higa mar 2024)

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kitui County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kitui Januari hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa degmada Kitui bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Rieko: Huduma Kenya chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e gweng' mar Kitui e dwe mar Januar.

English: NTSA urges motorists and pedestrians in Nairobi County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa wadayaasha gawaarida iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Nairobi inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira qaraxyada dabka.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo dereba mag mtokni kod joma wuotho e ndara e County mar Nairobi mondo oluw chike mag golo ji ma sirkal ogolo mondo gikwed hinyruok mag yiengni.

English: COMESA urges maize growers in Kitui County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawataka wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Kitui kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee Gobolka Kitui inay qaataan noocyo abuurka ah oo u adkaysta abaarta si loo wanaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur ma pidho kodhi e gweng' mar Kitui mondo okaw kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed kelo nyak e higani.

English: All university students get free 50GB data bundle Ã¢Â€Â“ activate with .ac.ke email now!
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wote wa vyuo vikuu wanapata kifurushi cha data cha 50GB bila malipo 'Ã‚Â¢' Ã¢Â€Â” anzisha kwa barua pepe ya .ac.ke sasa!
Somali: Dhammaan ardayda jaamacadda waxay helaan xirmo xog ah oo 50GB ah oo bilaash ah - ku shaqee emaylka .ac.ke hadda!
Dholuo: Jopuonjre duto mag yunivasiti yudo data ma romo 50GB ma nono kendo inyalo tiyogo gi e-mail mar .ac.ke sani!

English: TSC advises applicants in Samburu County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: TSC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Samburu kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: TSC waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha Gobolka Samburu inay dalbadaan booska TVET ee KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Samburu mondo oketgi e tiegruok mar TVET kokalo kuom KUCCPS.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds mobile money users in Kakamega County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kakamega inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni mondo gichiw ripot mar weche ma ok kare ne jatendgi mondo kik gitim chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo.

English: FAO advises farmers in Garissa County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the March planting season.
Kiswahili: FAO inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Machi.
Somali: FAO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Garissa inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta ee la caddeeyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e gweng ' mar Garissa County mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochopo dwe mar Mach.

English: Do not leave a burning charcoal stove (jiko) inside a closed room at night; charcoal fumes can cause suffocation and death.
Kiswahili: Usiku usiwache jiko la mkaa likiwaka ndani ya nyumba iliyofungwa; moshi wa mkaa unaweza kusababisha vifo kwa kukosa hewa.
Somali: Ha ku dhaafin shoolad dhuxul oo gubanaysa (jiko) qol xiran habeenkii; qiiqa dhuxushu wuxuu sababi karaa neef qabatin iyo dhimasho.
Dholuo: Ok onego iwe jiko mar makaa mawang' (jiko) ei ot ma olor gotieno; muya mar makaa nyalo kelo ng’ol kendo tho.
resource: Kenya Red Cross Household Safety Advisory

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages residents of Trans Nzoia County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay wacaan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo jogweng'o mag Trans Nzoia County mondo kik gisandgi ka giol kendo giluong kony mar thieth mar parruok maonge chudo.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kitui County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu huzindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kitui Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee Gobolka Kitui bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Auditor General chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Kitui e dwe mar Julai.

English: Health Cabinet Secretary Mutahi Kagwe today met with Kenya High Commissioner to United Republic of Tanzania Ambassador Dan Kasungu who paid him a courtesy call at his Afya house office @DanMKazungu
Kiswahili: Katibu wa Baraza la Mawaziri wa Afya Mutahi Kagwe leo amekutana na Kamishna Mkuu wa Kenya katika Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania Balozi Dan Kasungu ambaye alimtembelea katika ofisi yake ya Afya house @DanMKazungu
Somali: Xoghayaha Golaha Caafimaadka Mutahi Kagwe ayaa maanta la kulmay Safiirka Kenya u fadhiya Jamhuuriyadda Midawga Afrika Dan Kasungu oo booqasho sharafeed ku tagay xafiiskiisa @DanMKazungu.
Dholuo: Jatend kabinet mar thieth Mutahi Kagwe kawuono ne oromo gi Jatend piny Kenya e piny Tanzania ma en Ambasada Dan Kasungu mane omiye limo mar ng’uono e ofis mare mar Afya @DanMKazungu

English: OGP urges residents of Taita-Taveta County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight abuse of office.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta watumie portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Taita-Taveta inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago xadgudubka xilka.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo kwayo mar kedo gi timbe mag ketho migepe.

English: KEPHIS urges beans growers in Kilifi County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kilifi inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka xilliga dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur ma pidho puothe e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma giyudo e higa ka gitiyo gi tuoche makelo hinyruok mondo gimi nyak e higani.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will train farmers in Laikipia County on water harvesting this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Laikipia juu ya uvunaji wa maji Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka ayaa tababar siin doona beeraleyda Gobolka Laikipia ee ku saabsan goosashada biyaha bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro tiego jopur e County mar Laikipia e wi yudho pi e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: DCI urges the community in Homa Bay County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb carjacking.
Kiswahili: DCI inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni ili kuzuia utekaji nyara wa gari.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada gobolka Homa Bay inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shisheeyaha si looga hortago afduubka baabuurta.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo ji duto manie Homa Bay County mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo kik gikwed kwalo mtokni.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.

English: IEBC reminds voters in Taita-Taveta County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha gobolka Taita-Taveta in ay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor inta aysan helin waxbarashada codbixinta.
Dholuo: IEBC parone jogweng'o e Taita-Taveta County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom SMS ne ji 70000 kapok giyudo tiegruok.

English: KUCCPS reminds needy students in Narok County that school laptops under the digital literacy programme applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Narok kwamba kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya maombi ya programu ya kusoma na kuandika ya dijiti zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Narok in laptop-yada dugsiga ee barnaamijka codsiyada akhriska dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: KUCCPS parone jopuonjre man gi chandruok e Narok County ni kompyuta mag skul manie program mar somo kod somo mar digital biro rumo machiegni.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free tuberculosis screening is available at all public health centres in Murang'a County this October.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kifua kikuu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Oktoba hii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka caabuqa ee bilaashka ah lagu heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Murang'a bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji ni thieth mar tuo mar tuberculosis onge chudo e kuonde thieth duto e county mar Murang'a e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public that free measles screening is available at all public health centres in Vihiga County this August.

Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne ji ni nonro mar thieth mar midho ma onge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto mag ji e County mar Vihiga e dwe mar Agost.

English: NPS urges motorists and pedestrians in Kisii County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NPS inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Kisii inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada daadadku ka da'ay si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo joidh mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Kisii mondo kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o mondo kik gitim aksident mag ndara.

English: KMTC encourages out-of-school children in Siaya County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Siaya kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya ugawaji wa bursary.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Siaya inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga ugu dambeeya ee la siinayo deeqda waxbarashada.
Dholuo: KMTC jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e county mar Siaya mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: NCPB advises farmers in Samburu County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the September planting season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Septemba.

Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e county mar Samburu mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok chon kapok ochopo higa mar Septemba.

Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jogweng' mar County mar Mombasa ni rito lowo kelo nyak mar puodho kuom kinde malach.

Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa uhamasishaji wa unyogovu unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.

Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar parruok yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e County Kilifi.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds residents of Murang'a County that terracing improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba usafirishaji wa wadudu huboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Murang'a in dhulka lagu beerayo uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarkii beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jogweng' Murang'a County ni tiyo gi puodho mar terracing miyo puodho bedo maber kuom kinde malach.

Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mipango inayolenga kukuza uzalishaji wa mpunga nchini Kenya ili kujitosheleza Kushiriki na programu za kilimo za ndani kwa msaada na rasilimali.

Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku boorinayaa dhalinyarada degmada Nairobi inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.

English: NTSA warns residents of Nandi County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: NTSA inaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi juu ya kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: NTSA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nandi kororka nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan falin.

Kiswahili: KALRO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Mei hii.

Dholuo: KALRO ogolo chenro mar thiedho rombo e dwe mar Mei e gweng' mar Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: Office of the Auditor-General encourages first-time voters in Nyeri County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.

English: Ministry of Education urges youth in Busia County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Busia kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.

Kiswahili: DCI inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Busia wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa shacabka degmada Busia inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qof kasta oo ka dambeeya kiisaska la soo sheegay ee nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo ji duto e County mar Busia mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo weche ma nyiso ni gin gi chenro mag gwoko pesa mag miriambo.

English: KTDA urges sheep farmers in Vihiga County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported foot and mouth disease cases.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wafugaji wa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda idaha ee degmada Vihiga inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: KTDA ojiwo jopur mag rombe e County mar Vihiga mondo ogeng'e legi e kuonde moketi mag nego rombe bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag dhoot kod dhoot.

English: KALRO advises horticultural produce producers in Nakuru County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inashauri wazalishaji wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.

Dholuo: KALRO nyiso jopur ma loso puothe e gweng' mar Nakuru ni giusgi mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo puothego kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Machakos County about the importance of diabetes screening for household wellbeing.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds residents of Nyandarua County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.

Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora za parachichi.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda gobolka West Pokot inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan avocado.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e West Pokot County mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar avocado.

English: Ministry of Education encourages residents of Taita-Taveta County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Taita-Taveta inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabtaan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo onon weche ma gin-go mag ndiko joma oyiero mondo ging'e tich mar Ombudsman.

English: Civic education now a compulsory subject in all teacher training colleges.
Kiswahili: Elimu ya uraia sasa ni somo la lazima katika vyuo vyote vya mafunzo ya ualimu.
Somali: Waxbarashada shacabka ayaa hadda waajib ku ah dhammaan iskuulada tababarka macalimiinta.
Dholuo: Puonjruok e weche mag sirkal sani en gima ochuno e skunde duto mag tiego jopuonj.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Homa Bay County that access to SHA registration is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba ufikiaji wa usajili wa SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa xasuusinaya dadweynaha gobolka Homa Bay in gelitaanka diiwaangelinta SHA ay hadda laga heli karaa xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji duto manie Homa Bay County ni sani ginyalo yudo weche mag SHA e kuonde moketi.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of West Pokot County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha deegaanka xilliyada dhulgariirada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji paroga jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji moa kuondego ma jotelo mag sirkal ogolo e kinde mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: Notice: KICD reminds citizens in Nyandarua County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Nyandarua ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KICD paronwa raia mag Nyandarua County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar konyo ji e weche mag pesa mag county.

English: Notice: e-Citizen will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: e-Citizen waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada ee degmada Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: e-Citizen biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e County ma Kirinyaga.

English: Deploy climate-smart agricultural practices to enhance yields of both crops and fodder, especially methods that effectively manage excess rainfall.
Kiswahili: Kutumia mazoea ya kilimo ya hali ya hewa ya busara ili kuongeza mavuno ya mazao na wanyama, hasa njia ambazo zinasimamia kwa ufanisi mvua nyingi.
Somali: Isticmaal habab beereed oo cimilada ku habboon si loo kordhiyo dalagyada iyo cuntooyinka, gaar ahaan hababka si wax ku ool ah u maareeya roobka xad-dhaafka ah.
Dholuo: Ti gi yore mag pur manyiso rieko e wi lokruok mar alwora mondo omi cham kod le mag chamo ring'o omed nyak maber, to moloyo, tiyo gi yore ma nyalo konyo e loyo koth mang'eny.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa ajili ya usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu ka furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo lagu shaqeynayo shahaadada dhalashada ee degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mar loso nyasi mag nyuol e taon mar Baringo.

English: IPOA alerts residents of Trans Nzoia County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka kwa kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: IPOA waxay ka digtay dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia in ay kordheen kiisaska burburka waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: IPOA chiwo siem ne jogweng'o mag Trans Nzoia County kuom wach kwan mar joma odonjo e ot kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne polis ma machiegni.

English: Notice: KALRO will open an avocado collection centre in Uasin Gishu County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya parachichi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay xarun ururinta avocado ka furi doontaa gobolka Uasin Gishu bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KALRO biro yawo kama ichokoe avocado e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu e dwe mar April.

English: Pest Control Products Board announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for goats in Tana River County this September.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Tana River Septemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa ku dhawaaqaya jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan qabyaaladda lo'da ee Gobolka Tana River bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok mar Pest olando chenro mar thiedho diek maonge chudo mar rabies e taon mar Tana River County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Council of Governors updates residents of Trans Nzoia County on progress of community-based development programmes this July.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawasilisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia juu ya maendeleo ya mipango ya maendeleo katika jumuiya mwezi huu Julai.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia ku wargeliyaan horumarka barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada ee bisha July.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch chiwo ripot ne jogweng' mar Trans Nzoia kuom dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag oganda e dwe mar Julai.

English: Teachers Service Commission invites youth in Embu County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this January.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Embu kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Januari hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa ku casuumay dhalinyarada degmada Embu inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Commission of Teachers Service Commission ogwelo rowere e county mar Embu mondo odonj e tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing e dwe mar Januar.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Baringo County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay dadka degmada Baringo kula talineysaa inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun iyo biyo nadiif ah si joogto ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit nyiso jogweng' Baringo County mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development invites farmers in Nyandarua County to a free training on modern irrigation techniques this February.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji Februari hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku casuumaysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyandarua inay tababar bilaash ah ku helaan farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ogwelo jopur e County mar Nyandarua e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi yore mag lero pi e dwe mar Februar.

English: NCPB advises farmers in Kitui County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kitui inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kalfadhiga tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e County Kitui mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e tiego jopur mabiro.

English: Kenya confirms three cases of Covid-19 Omicron variant; Health CS Kagwe says it has been detected among travelers who have been quarantined
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha visa vitatu vya Covid-19 Omicron; Waziri wa Afya Kagwe anasema imegunduliwa miongoni mwa wasafiri ambao wametengwa
Somali: Kenya ayaa xaqiijisay saddex kiis oo ka mid ah noocyada Covid-19 Omicron; Health CS Kagwe ayaa sheegtay in lagu ogaaday dadka safarka ah ee ku jiray karantiil
Dholuo: Kenya osenyiso ni nitie ji adek ma nigi tuwo mar Covid-19 Omicron; Health CS Kagwe wacho ni ne ofwenyore e kind jowuoth ma ne ogol kar kendgi

English: Announcing about millet farming as climate tolerant food, ahead of other regions
Kiswahili: Kutangaza kuhusu kilimo cha mtama kama chakula kinachostahimili hali ya hewa, mbele ya mikoa mingine
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida beerista miiska sida cunto u dulqaadanaya cimilada, ka hor gobollada kale
Dholuo: Lando wach pidho millet kaka chiemo ma nyalo geng'o kit yamo, ka pok oland ne pinje mamoko

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free stress management support is available through county health facilities in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kudhibiti mafadhaiko unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo lagu maareynayo walbahaarka laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Wajir County.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar stress yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Wajir.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds the public in Kericho County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu dadka degmada Kericho ku xasuusinayaa in warbixinta khayaanada iibsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, amaan ah oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone ji duto e County mar Kericho ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag yuto en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kiambu County that access to psychosocial support is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisaikolojia unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Kiambu in helitaanka taageerada cilmu-nafsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e County mar Kiambu ni ginyalo yudo kony maonge chudo.

English: To dry rice seed without spoiling it, build a simple raised table from wood or bamboo instead of drying on the ground; air moves freely under the seed so it dries faster and stays clean, and the table can be quickly carried indoors when it rains.
Kiswahili: Ili kukausha mbegu ya mchele bila kuiharibu, jenga meza iliyoinuliwa kutoka kwa mbao au mianzi badala ya kukaushwa ardhini; hewa husonga kwa uhuru chini ya mbegu hiyo ili iwe kavu zaidi na kubaki ikiwa safi, na meza yaweza kubebwa upesi ndani ya nyumba inaponyesha.
Somali: Si aad u qalajiso abuurka bariiska adigoon u kharribin, ka dhig miis fudud oo kor loo qaaday qoryo ama bambood halkii aad dhulka ku qalajin lahayd; hawadu waxay ku dhaqdhaqaaqi doontaa dhulka hoostiisa si ay u qalajiso si dhakhso badan oo ay u nadiifiso, miiskuna si dhakhso leh ayuu guriga ugu qaadi karaa roobka.
Dholuo: Mondo ipwodh kodhi mar opur ma ok kethre, ti gi yien kata bao e loso mesa ma oting'o gik moko malo kar tedo e lowo; kor lwasi wuotho e yo mayot mondo kodhi obed motegno kendo obed maler, kendo inyalo ting'o mesa mapiyo e ot sama koth chue.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds voters in Lamu County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) ayaa xasuusinaya codbixiyayaasha degmada Lamu inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor taariikhda doorashada.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone jogweng'o mag Lamu County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom SMS ne 70000 kapok kinde mar yiero ochopo.

English: Notice: KEMSA will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Tana River County this February. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA itafanya kongamano la kurejesha matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Tana River Februari hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMSA waxay qabaneysaa forum ka soo kabashada xadgudubka maandooriyaha degmada Tana River bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMSA biro timo chokruok mar chango joma tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero e taon mar Tana River e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: COMESA will distribute certified maize seed to farmers in Bungoma County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itasambaza mbegu za mahindi zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay abuuraha degmada Bungoma u qaybin doontaa abuurka hadhuudhka ee la caddeeyay bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: COMESA biro pogo kodhi mag kodhi mar kodhi ne jopur man Bungoma County e dwe mar Agost.

English: CDC reminds the public that free suicide prevention support is available through county health facilities in Narok County.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kuzuia kujiua unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageerada ka hortagga ismiidaaminta ee bilaashka ah ay ka heli karto xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar geng'o ji kik donjre yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth e gweng' mar Narok.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kirinyaga County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya ngono katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Kirinyaga inuu ka warbixiyo kiisaska xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e County mar Kirinyaga mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on parents in Nyandarua County to have children under five screened for cholera during the October outreach.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuwapima watoto chini ya miaka mitano kipindupindu wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Oktoba.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Nyandarua in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka kolera intii lagu jiray tallaabada bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross kwayo jonyuol e County mar Nyandarua mondo otim nonro mar cholera ne nyithindo ma hikgi tin ne abich e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Government plans on subsidised farm inputs..market surveys need to be done..
Kiswahili: Mipango ya serikali juu ya pembejeo za shamba zinazofadhiliwa.. Uchunguzi wa soko unahitaji kufanywa..
Somali: Qorshayaasha dowladda ee ku saabsan gelinta beeraleyda la taageero.. Sahannada suuqa waa in la sameeyaa..
Dholuo: Dwarore ni otim chenro mag sirkal kuom gik ma ji nyalo chamo e puothe mag puothe.

English: Ministry of Education encourages out-of-school children in Migori County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Migori kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya ugawaji wa bursary.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Migori inay codsadaan deeqda waxbarasho ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga ugu dambeeya ee loo qoondeeyay deeqaha waxbarasho.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e County mar Migori mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Bungoma County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kuzingatia mipaka ya mwendo kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu katika msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lugta ku mara inta lagu jiro xilliyada shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo oluw tong' mar piyo kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe e kinde masiche mag ndara.

English: Notice: KALRO will open a tea collection centre in Tharaka-Nithi County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya chai katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: KALRO waxay xarun soo ururinta shaaha ka furi doontaa degmada Tharaka-Nithi bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Rapar: KALRO biro yawo kar choko chai e Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar April.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Samburu County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya dadweynaha Gobolka Samburu in adeegyada bukaanka dibedda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji duto e county mar Samburu ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mag ambulatori e kuonde moyier.

English: Mothers and newborns should attend postnatal check-ups within 48 hours after birth to detect any complications and promote healthy recovery.
Kiswahili: Akina mama na watoto wachanga wanapaswa kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa baada ya kujifungua ndani ya saa 48 baada ya kujifungua ili kugundua matatizo yoyote na kukuza afya njema.
Somali: Hooyooyinka iyo dhallaanka cusub waa inay ka qeybgalaan baaritaano dhalashada kadib 48 saacadood ka dib dhalashada si loo ogaado wax dhibaato ah loona horumariyo soo kabashada caafimaad.
Dholuo: Min ji kod nyithindo mayom onego otim nonro bang' nyuol bang' seche 48 bang ' nyuolgi mondo gine ka nitie chandruok moro amora kendo gitim nonro maber.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges residents of Embu County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from free primary education.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Embu mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud somo ma onge chudo.

English: Notice: KUCCPS opens a new tailoring and design programme at the vocational centre in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inafungua programu mpya ya ushonaji na muundo katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan dharka iyo naqshadeynta xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KUCCPS ochako chenro manyien mar loso gik moko kendo loso gik mopogore opogore e skul mar tiegruok ma yudore e gweng' mar Kericho.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges anyone experiencing abuse in Tana River County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
