Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qofkasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Tana River in uu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e taon mar Tana River County mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Notice: TVET opens a new catering and hospitality programme at the vocational centre in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET yafungua programu mpya ya upishi na ukarimu katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay ka furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan cuntada iyo marti-gelinta xarunta xirfadaha ee Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET chako chenro manyien mar chiemo kod rwako welo e skul mar tiegruok e gweng' mar Kakamega.

English: DCI warns residents of Makueni County to prepare for possible landslides this March.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa maporomoko ya ardhi Machi hii.
Somali: DCI waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay u diyaar garoobaan dhulgariir dhici kara bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: DCI osiemo jogweng' Makueni mondo oikre ne yiengni mag lowo mabiro timore e dwe mar Mach.

English: Empowering Kenyan farmers: Building financial resilience
Kiswahili: Kuwawezesha wakulima wa Kenya: Kujenga uwezo wa kifedha
Somali: Xoojinta Beeralayda Kenya: Dhisidda adkeysiga dhaqaale
Dholuo: Gimiyo jopur mag piny Kenya teko: Keto nyalo mar rito pesa

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Kenya Gazette waxay furaysaa goob adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Gazette oseyawo kar lendo manyien mar e-Citizen registration e County mar Kericho.

English: This shift from cash to accrual accounting represents a milestone in Kenya's efforts to align its financial reporting with global standards.
Kiswahili: Mabadiliko haya kutoka pesa taslimu hadi uhasibu wa ziada yanawakilisha hatua muhimu katika juhudi za Kenya kuoanisha ripoti yake ya kifedha na viwango vya kimataifa.
Somali: Isbeddelkan laga sameeyay lacagta caddaanka ah una gudbay xisaabinta accrual wuxuu ka dhigan yahay tallaabo muhiim ah oo ka mid ah dadaallada Kenya ay ku waafajinayso warbixinteeda maaliyadeed heerarka caalamiga ah.
Dholuo: Okang’ ma kamano mar loko pesa ma ng’ato oting’o nyaka e kwan mar pesa ma ng’ato oting’o, nyiso gima duong’ ahinya e tembe mag piny Kenya mar keto ripot mare mar pesa obed kaka owinjore gi chike mag piny mangima.

English: KEMRI reminds expectant mothers in Uasin Gishu County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Uasin Gishu in helitaanka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMRI parone mine ma biro bedo gi ich e county mar Uasin Gishu ni thuolo mar yudo puonj mag chenro mag ngima joot en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag oganda.

English: Universities Fund reminds parents in Nyandarua County that free primary education registration is open this August.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba usajili wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo umefunguliwa Agosti hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xusuusinayaa waalidiinta degmada Nyandarua in diiwaangelinta bilaashka ah ee waxbarashada hoose ay furan tahay bisha August.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa jonyuol e County mar Nyandarua ni somo mar pinyruoth obed maonge chudo e dwe mar Agost.

English: Kenya Gazette invites residents of Lamu County to attend the public participation forum regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Lamu inay ka qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan habka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette gwelo jogweng' County mar Lamu mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenro mar bajet mar county.

English: ODPP reminds the public in Mandera County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Mandera in sheegashada khiyaamooyinka iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: ODPP paronwa ji duto man Mandera County ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag yuto en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: Notice: IPOA issues a cybersecurity alert on phishing messages affecting residents of Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya ujumbe wa udanganyifu unaoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay soo saartaa digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan fariimaha phishing ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity e wi ote mag phishing ma mulo joma odak e County mar Vihiga.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges motorists and pedestrians in Migori County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Migori kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya darawalada iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Migori inay u hoggaansamaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo dereche mag mtokni kod joma wuotho e ndara e county mar Migori mondo oluw chike mag golo ji ma sirkal ogolo mondo gikwed hinyruok ma timore e nderni.

English: Notice: DCI launches a cattle rustling prevention campaign in Kajiado County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kajiado Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga xanta xoolaha ee degmada Kajiado bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Rapar: DCI chako kampen mar geng'o kwalo jamni e kaunti mar Kajiado e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: KRA launches community-based development programmes in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inazindua mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay bilawday barnaamijyo horumarineed oo ku saleysan bulshada ee Gobolka Laikipia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KRA chako chenro mag dongruok e alwora mar Laikipia County.

English: E-Citizen announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Migori County.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inatangaza nyakati bora za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Migori.
Dholuo: E-Citizen olando lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mag ng'eyo ng'ato e gweng' mar Migori.

English: KTDA advises farmers in Mandera County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the April planting season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji Aprili.
Somali: KTDA waxay kula talineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Mandera inay qaataan noocyo abuurka ah oo abaarta u adkaysta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: KTDA nyiso jopur e county mar Mandera mondo okaw kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochako chwoyo kodhi e dwe mar April.

English: NPS urges motorists and pedestrians in Kirinyaga County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NPS inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka lugta leh ee degmada Kirinyaga inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha lugta ah ee loo qoondeeyay si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo joidh mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Kirinyaga mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo giti gi kuonde ma wuothoe mondo gikwed masiche motudore gi koth.

English: Notice from KEMRI: family planning counselling clinics will run every May at designated health centres in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa KEMRI: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Mei katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid KEMRI: rugta la talinta qorshaynta qoyska waxay ka shaqeyn doontaa bishii Maajo oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMRI: Klinike mag chiwo paro e wi chenro mar joot biro tiyo e dwe mar Mei higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Baringo.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds residents of Marsabit County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba kufikia utunzaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Marsabit in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties parone jogweng' mar Marsabit County ni koro yot yudo weche mag nyuol ka gitiyo gi yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Notice: Council of Governors opens voter education centres in Uasin Gishu County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa furaya xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee Gobolka Uasin Gishu bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Bura mar Jaloch biro yawo kuonde tiego josiasa e kaunti mar Uasin Gishu e dwe mar Februar.

English: State Department for Basic Education calls on the community in Kisumu County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Kisumu inay u soo wargeliyaan maamulka dugsiga wixii dhibaato ah ee ku saabsan amniga si ay dugsiyada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education okwayo ji duto manie Kisumu County mondo onyis sirkal mar skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: KTDA urges rice growers in Marsabit County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda bariiska ee degmada Marsabit inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si kor loogu qaado wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur ma pidho kodhi mar Marsabit County mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed nyak e higani.

English: Kenya Dairy Board announces a free anthrax vaccination exercise for pigs in Nandi County this October.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kimeta kwa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Nandi Oktoba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa ku dhawaaqay jimicsi tallaal ah oo lacag la'aan ah oo loo sameeyo digaagga gobolka Nandi bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board ong'ado mar timo chenro mar thieth mar anthrax maonge chudo e dwe mar Oktoba e kaunti mar Nandi.

English: Kenya steps up surveillance, response measures to curb mpox
Kiswahili: Kenya yaongeza uangalizi, hatua za kukabiliana na ugonjwa huo
Somali: Kenya oo xoojinaysa la socodka iyo tallaabooyinka ka hortagga cudurka 'pox'
Dholuo: Kenya omedo rang'iny mar rang'iny kod okenge mag duoko mar geng'o tuwo mar mpox

English: KALRO reminds livestock keepers in Kilifi County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KALRO waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Kilifi inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanada buka xafiiska xayawaanka ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KALRO parone jorit jamni e gweng' mar Kilifi ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations launches a fraud prevention campaign in Nakuru County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka Cilmi baarista dambiyada ayaa bilaabay olole ka hortagga khiyaamooyinka degmada Nakuru bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar weche motudore gi timbe mahundu chako kampen mar geng'o mibadhi e gweng' mar Nakuru e dwe mar Septemba.

English: CDC advises residents of West Pokot County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: CDC inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: CDC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay yareeyaan qaadashada cusbada iyo sonkorta si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: CDC nyiso jogweng' mar West Pokot County ni giduog chien e chamo mor kod sukari mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Public health advisory: SHA (Social Health Authority) warns of increased HIV/AIDS risk in Bungoma County and advises the public to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya VVU/UKIMWI katika Kaunti ya Bungoma na kushauri umma kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ka digtay kororka halista HIV / AIDS ee degmada Bungoma waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar oganda: SHA (Social Health Authority) chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar AYAKI/AIDS e County mar Bungoma kendo osiemo ji mondo kik giriwre gi pi mochido.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) urges farmers in Kitui County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kitui inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kitui mondo opidh olembe ma nyalo miyo lowo okethre mondo omi giritre kuom lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: WHO Africa, UNICEF and Partners poised to advance implementation of Baby-Friendly Hospital Initiative in countries
Kiswahili: WHO Africa, UNICEF na Washirika wako tayari kuendeleza utekelezaji wa Mpango wa Hospitali ya Mtoto katika nchi
Somali: WHO Africa, UNICEF iyo La-hawlgalayaasha ayaa diyaar u ah inay horumariyaan hirgelinta Hindisaha Isbitaalka ee u-habboon Carruurta ee dalalka
Dholuo: WHO Afrika, UNICEF kod jowetegi oikruok mar dhi nyime e keto chenro mar thieth ma nyalo konyo nyithindo e pinje mamoko

English: Notice: NDMA opens a gender desk offering free legal aid in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: NDMA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisheria bure katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah Gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony mar chike maonge chudo e County mar Lamu.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) warns public officers in Siaya County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Siaya khiyaanooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Siaya kuom timbe mag mibadhi.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development calls on the community in Wajir County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka ayaa ugu baaqay bulshada degmada Wajir inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116 si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyada.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oluongo oganda mar Wajir County mondo omany namba mar 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo omi skunde obed maber.

English: Notice: Universities Fund announces bursary allocation enrollment dates for schools in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa mgao wa bursary kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku dhawaaqay taariikhda diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ee dugsiyada Gobolka Garissa.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Yunivasiti Fund olando tarik ma ne inyalo chiw ne skunde mag Garissa mondo gidonj e skundno.

English: Notice: COMESA will train farmers in Taita-Taveta County on soil conservation this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta juu ya uhifadhi wa udongo Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda Gobolka Taita-Taveta ee ku saabsan ilaalinta ciidda bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA biro tiego jopur manie Taita-Taveta County e weche mag rito lowo e dwe mar Oktoba.

Kiswahili: ... Rasilimali za Kilimo; Kutoa Kilimo ... Dhamira "Kutoa huduma za usaidizi kwa wakati unaofaa zinazoongeza tija, kuongeza thamani na ufikiaji wa soko kwa ...

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kwale County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Kwale piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Kwale inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo chandruok e gweng' mar Kwale mondo oluong simo mar GBV 1195.

English: KEPHIS reminds livestock keepers in Wajir County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee Gobolka Wajir in ay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska xayawaanada ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KEPHIS paronwa jorit jamni e gweng' mar Wajir ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds voters in Kirinyaga County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu xusuusinayaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Kirinyaga inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone jogweng' Kirinyaga County mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar timo yiero kapok kinde mag yiero ochopo.

English: Public notice: Kenya Medical Association will host a free diabetes screening outreach in Busia County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa uchunguzi wa kisukari bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Busia Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu martiqaadi doonaa baaritaan bukaan-socodka oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka macaanka ee degmada Busia bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association biro timo nonro mar thieth mar sukari maonge chudo e County mar Busia e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: TVET calls on the community in Turkana County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TVET inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi kwa watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TVET waxay bulshada degmada Turkana ugu baaqeysaa inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116, si loo ilaaliyo nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: TVET kwayo ji duto e County mar Turkana mondo omany namba mar 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Saccos in Kenya have reached KSh1 8 trillion in total assets ensuring members funds are safe Members are encouraged to continue leveraging cooperative financial services
Kiswahili: Saccos nchini Kenya imefikia KSh1 8 trilioni katika jumla ya mali ili kuhakikisha fedha za wanachama ziko salama Wanachama wanahimizwa kuendelea kutumia huduma za kifedha za ushirika.
Somali: Saccos ee Kenya waxay gaareen KSh1 8 trillion hantida guud taasoo hubinaysa in lacagaha xubnaha ay ammaan yihiin. Xubnaha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay sii wadaan ka faa'iideysiga adeegyada maaliyadeed ee iskaashiga
Dholuo: Oganda mar Saccos e Kenya oseneno ni mwandu duto mag owetegi chopo KSh1 8 trilionde ma miyo gibedo gi ritruok mar pesa ma jowetegi tiyogo

English: Effective November 18 2021 sugarcane prices will increase to Ksh 4 112 per tonne Farmers receiving less should report to the Agriculture and Food Authority AFA
Kiswahili: Kuanzia Novemba 18 2021 bei ya miwa itaongezeka hadi Ksh 4 112 kwa tani Wakulima wanaopokea kidogo wanapaswa kuripoti kwa Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula AFA
Somali: Laga bilaabo 18 Nofeembar 2021 qiimaha caanaha sonkorta ayaa kor u kacaya 4 112 Ksh halkii ton Beeraleyda ka helaya wax ka yar waa inay u soo sheegaan Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada AFA
Dholuo: Chakre Novemba 18, 2021 nengo mag sukari biro medore mochopo Ksh 4 112 e tonne ka tonne Jogo ma yudo pesa matin onego ochiw ripode ne Agriculture and Food Authority AFA

English: CAS, Dr. Rashid.A report by @WHO indicates that, the number of suicides cases reported in the Country rose by 58 % between 2008 & 2017. 317 suicide cases reported every year.The increased reported cases of suicide in Kenya needs urgent measures to prevent suicide.
Kiswahili: CAS, Dk. Rashid.Ripoti ya @WHO inaonyesha kwamba, idadi ya visa vya watu kujitoa mhanga vilivyoripotiwa Nchini iliongezeka kwa 58% kati ya 2008 na 2017. Visa 317 vya kujitoa mhanga viliripotiwa kila mwaka. Kuongezeka kwa visa vya kujiua vilivyoripotiwa nchini Kenya vinahitaji hatua za haraka ili kuzuia kujiua.
Somali: CAS, Dr. Rashid. Warbixin ay soo saartay @WHO ayaa tilmaamaysa in tirada kiisaska ismiidaaminta ee laga soo sheegay Dalka ay kor u kacday 58% intii u dhaxaysay 2008 iyo 2017. 317 kiis oo ismiidaamin ah ayaa la soo sheegaa sannad kasta. Kiisaska ismiidaaminta ee sii kordhaya ee la soo sheegay ee Kenya waxay u baahan yihiin tallaabooyin degdeg ah si looga hortago ismiidaaminta.
Dholuo: Rashid.Ripot ma @WHO ogolo nyiso ni, kwan mar jogo ma ne onegore giwegi ma ne ondiki e pinyno ne omedore gi 58 % e kind higa mar 2008 & 2017.

English: Notice: KEMRI confirms a meningitis outbreak alert for Kakamega County. Residents are advised to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa homa ya uti wa mgongo kwa Kaunti ya Kakamega. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ku saabsan cudurka meningitis ee Gobolka Kakamega. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KEMRI osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuo mar meningitis e Kaunti mar Kakamega. Ojiw ji mondo otim nonro mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni kodgi.

English: Always boil and cool water used for preparing baby formula to avoid infections.
Kiswahili: Chemsha na upoeze maji yanayotumika kutayarisha maziwa ya mtoto ili kuepuka maambukizi.
Somali: Had iyo jeer ku kari oo ku qabooji biyaha loo isticmaalo diyaarinta cuntada ilmaha si looga fogaado cudurrada.
Dholuo: Kinde duto cham gi pi mang'ich ma itiyogo e loso chiemo mag nyithindo mondo kik yud tuoche.

English: KICD invites youth in Kakamega County to enroll for ICT skills training this October.
Kiswahili: KICD inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT Oktoba hii.
Somali: KICD waxay ku casuumaysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kakamega inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka xirfadaha ICT bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KICD gwelo rowere e Kaunti mar Kakamega mondo odonj e tiegruok mar ICT e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: NPS reminds mobile money users in Homa Bay County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee gobolka Homa Bay inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: NPS paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mobil e Homa Bay County mondo onon kwayo mag pesa kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo gitang' gi chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo.

English: Huduma Kenya urges eligible citizens in Kitui County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inahimiza wananchi wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Kitui kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kitui inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jokanyo mowinjore e County mar Kitui mondo oriwgi e kwedo josiasa.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: free antenatal care clinics will run every September at designated health centres in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi: kliniki za bure za utunzaji wa ujauzito zitafanya kazi kila Septemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka: rugta daryeelka dhalmada ee bilaashka ah waxaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Sebtember ee xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Rieko moa kuom Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: Klinike mag rito nyithindo kapok ginyuol biro tiyo dwe mar ochiko higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Bungoma.

English: KEPHIS reminds residents of Kericho County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho in ilaalinta ciidda ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: KEPHIS paronwa ji duto modak e gweng' mar Kericho ni rito lowo kelo nyak e puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Kenya Price Bulletin, October 2024
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Bei ya Kenya, Oktoba 2024
Somali: War-saxaafadeedka Qiimaha Kenya, Oktoobar 2024
Dholuo: Oboke mar Nengo mar Kenya, Oktoba 2024

English: MoH dispatches 10 Cuban experts to Kakamega, Siaya, Kisumu, Bungoma, Busia, Vihiga, Homa Bay and Migori counties in the fight against malaria with biological methods.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yatuma wataalamu 10 wa Cuba katika kaunti za Kakamega, Siaya, Kisumu, Bungoma, Busia, Vihiga, Homa Bay na Migori katika mapambano dhidi ya malaria kwa njia za kibiolojia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa 10 khabiir oo reer Cuba ah u dirtay degmooyinka Kakamega, Siaya, Kisumu, Bungoma, Busia, Vihiga, Homa Bay iyo Migori si ay ula dagaallamaan bakteeriyada iyadoo la adeegsanayo hababka noolaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health ooro josayans 10 moa e piny Cuba e gwenge mag Kakamega, Siaya, Kisumu, Bungoma, Busia, Vihiga, Homa Bay kod Migori e kedo gi malaria kotiyo gi yore mag ngima.

English: NPS reminds mobile money users in Kilifi County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kilifi inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna si looga fogaado nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: NPS paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e gweng' mar Kilifi ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo gitang' gi chenro mag gwelo pesa mag miriambo.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are urged to prepare for impending food shortages as global supply chains face significant disruptions Take action now to secure resources and plan accordingly
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wamehimizwa kujiandaa kukabiliana na uhaba wa chakula huku misururu ya ugavi duniani ikikabiliwa na usumbufu mkubwa Chukua hatua sasa ili kupata rasilimali na kupanga ipasavyo.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay isu diyaariyaan yaraanta cuntada ee soo socota iyadoo silsiladaha sahayda caalamiga ah ay la kulmaan carqalado waaweyn. Tallaabo qaado hadda si aad u hesho kheyraadka oo qorsheyneyso sidaas
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma tiyo e weche mag pidho kod loso cham, kaachiel gi jomamoko ma tiyo e weche mag ohala, ijiwo mondo oikre ne yuto ma biro nikech yuto ma piny ngima yudo ka okethore.

English: Parents are required to register their new borns after birth with births and death office. The certificate of birth complements the law and enables the government to plan for service delivery.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanatakiwa kuwasajili watoto wao wachanga baada ya kuzaliwa katika ofisi ya vizazi na vifo. Cheti cha kuzaliwa kinakamilisha sheria na kinawezesha serikali kupanga utoaji wa huduma.
Somali: Waalidiinta waxaa looga baahan yahay inay diiwaangeliyaan dhalashadooda cusub ka dib dhalashada xafiiska dhalashada iyo dhimashada. Shahaadada dhalashada waxay ku dartaa sharciga waxayna u oggolaaneysaa dowladda inay qorsheyso bixinta adeegyada.
Dholuo: Jonyuol onego ondik nyithindgi manyien bang' nyuol e ofis mar nyuol kod tho.

English: KICD conducts a civic education forum on voter registration in Migori County this July.
Kiswahili: KICD inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Migori Julai hii.
Somali: KICD waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee Degmada Migori bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: KICD dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e dwe mar Julai e kaunti mar Migori.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit announces eye and dental camps for residents of Kiambu County starting this November.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinatangaza kambi za macho na meno kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kuanzia Novemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa ku dhawaaqday xeryo indhaha iyo ilkaha loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Kiambu laga bilaabo Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ogolo kambi mag neno kendo thieth mag lakteche ne joma odak e County mar Kiambu kochakore dwe mar Novemba.

English: FAO advises farmers in Kisumu County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the August planting season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Agosti.
Somali: FAO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kisumu inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka xilliga dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kisumu mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e dwe mar Agost.

English: USAID/BHA Kenya Assistance Overview, February 2024
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Usaidizi wa USAID/BHA Kenya, Februari 2024
Somali: Dulmar Guud oo ku saabsan Kaalmada USAID/BHA Kenya, Febraayo 2024
Dholuo: Oboke mar Kony mar USAID/BHA Kenya, dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2024

English: As part of Zambia's national drought response, affected agro-pastoral communities are receiving livestock disease surveillance and management support, supplementary animal feed, and rehabilitated dams, boreholes, and weirs to secure water access for irrigation and livestock.
Kiswahili: Kama sehemu ya kukabiliana na ukame wa taifa nchini Zambia, jamii za kilimo na malisho zilizoathiriwa zinapata msaada wa ufuatiliaji na usimamizi wa magonjwa ya mifugo, chakula cha ziada cha wanyama, na madaraja yaliyosafishwa, mashimo, na vibanda vya maji ili kuhakikisha upatikanaji wa maji kwa ajili ya umwagiliaji na mifugo.
Somali: Qayb ka mid ah jawaabta abaaraha qaran ee Zambia, bulshooyinka agro-xoolo-dhaqato ee saameysay ayaa helaya taageero la socodka iyo maareynta cudurrada xoolaha, quudinta xayawaanka oo dheeraad ah, iyo biyo-xireenno dib loo hagaajiyay si loo hubiyo helitaanka biyaha ee waraabka iyo xoolaha.
Dholuo: E bwo chandruok mar kech e piny Zambia, joma odak e alwora ma ji ohero tiyogo e rito kod rito jowadgi, yudo kony mar rito jowadgi, chiwo chiembgi ne jowadgi, kendo loso kuonde ma ji nyalo yudogo pi, kuonde ma ji nyalo yudogo pi, kod kuonde ma ji nyalo yudogo pi.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free trauma counselling support is available through county health facilities in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa ushauri wa kiwewe unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kitui.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo la talinta dhaawaca laga helo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Kitui County.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e County Kitui.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens a new service point for national ID applications in Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ka furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Marsabit.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya osechako tiyo gi ofis manyien mar Joneno mag Jehova e alwora mar Marsabit County.

English: HELB reminds needy students in Narok County that free digital learning content applications close soon.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Narok kwamba programu za bure za maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Narok in codsiyada barnaamijyada barashada bilaashka ah ee digital-ka ah ay dhowaan soo gabagabeyn doonaan.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa jopuonjre modhier man Narok County ni chenro mag puonjo ji Muma maonge chudo chiegni rumo.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Machakos County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Degmada Machakos inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e gweng' mar Machakos mondo odhi ir japuonj molony.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges dairy cows farmers in Nakuru County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Nakuru inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib markii la soo sheegay kiisaska anthrax.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur ma pidho dhok e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo onyis le matuwo e ofise mar thieth machiegni gi kanyo bang' yudo tuoche mag anthrax.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) invites residents of Turkana County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee la xiriira wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) gwelo joma odak e County mar Turkana mondo oriwre kodgi kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e wi penjo mag chike mag sirkal.

English: Ensure you boil drinking water or use water treatment chemicals to protect yourself against typhoid fever.
Kiswahili: Hakikisha unachemsha maji ya kunywa au kutumia dawa ya kutasa maji ili kujikinga na ugonjwa wa homa ya matumbo (typhoid).
Somali: Hubi inaad karkariso biyaha la cabbo ama aad isticmaasho kiimikooyinka daaweynta biyaha si aad iskaga ilaaliso qandhada typhoid.
Dholuo: Ne ni ibolo pi ma inyalo madho kata itiyo gi kemikol mag loso pi mondo igeng’ri kuom tuo mar typhoid.

English: Notice: NDMA launches a theft prevention campaign in Machakos County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Machakos Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada degmada Machakos bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA chako kampen mar geng'o kuo e gweng' mar Machakos e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Mandera County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the March planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Machi.
Somali: Guddiga Waxsoosaarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda Gobolka Mandera inay qaataan noocyo abuurka ah oo u adkaysta abaarta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur man Mandera County mondo okaw kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochako chwoyo kodhi e dwe mar Mach.

English: Kenya advances to integrate climate action and disaster risk reduction
Kiswahili: Kenya inasonga mbele kuunganisha hatua za hali ya hewa na kupunguza hatari za majanga
Somali: Kenya oo horumar ka samaysay sidii ay u midayn lahayd wax ka qabashada cimilada iyo yareynta khatarta masiibooyinka
Dholuo: Kenya dhi nyime e keto kanyakla chenro mar loko kor lwasi kod duoko piny luoro mar masira

English: FAO promotes agroforestry among farmers in Kitui County as part of the June climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: FAO inakuza kilimo cha misitu kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui kama sehemu ya harakati za ustahimilivu wa hali ya hewa ya Juni.
Somali: FAO waxay dhiirrigelisay beeraha beeraha ee degmada Kitui iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee bisha Juun.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo yiende mag yiende e kind jopur e gweng' mar Kitui kaka achiel kuom chenro mar dwe mar Jun mar kedo gi lokruok e kor lwasi.

English: State Department for TVET reminds needy students in Laikipia County that revision guides applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kwamba maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Laikipia in dib u eegista ay ku hagaajineyso codsiyada la xiro dhowaan.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET oparo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e County mar Laikipia ni lokruok mar gwelo kwayo mag tiegruok biro rumo machiegni.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone experiencing abuse in Migori County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Migori kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya ngono katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qofkasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Degmada Migori inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e kaunti mar Migori mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Notice: OGP opens voter education centres in Kisii County this July.

Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur ma loso chai e county mar Makueni mondo ous olembe mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo olembe kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Coughing! Fever! Night sweats! Chest pains! Weight loss! You could have TB. Testing and treatment are free at all public hospitals!Get tested today!
Kiswahili: Kikohozi! Homa! Jasho la usiku! Maumivu ya kifua! Kupunguza uzito! Unaweza kuwa na TB. Upimaji na matibabu ni bure katika hospitali zote za umma! Pima leo!

Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inazuia harakati za mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Newcastle.

English: It's okay not to be okay! There is no health without mental health!

Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Siaya juu ya kilimo cha misitu Januari hii.

Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya malaria vilivyoripotiwa.

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on residents of Taita-Taveta County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of border security.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kusaidia usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Adeegga kaynta Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqay dadka deggan gobolka Taita-Taveta inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service okwayo jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji nitie mondo okony sirkal rito tong'.

English: Be alert in parking lots - have keys ready and check backseat before entering.
Kiswahili: Uwe macho katika maegesho - uwe na funguo tayari na uangalie kiti cha nyuma kabla ya kuingia.
Somali: Ka taxaddar meelaha loo dhigto baabuurta - furayaasha diyaar u dhig oo ka hubi kursiyada dambe ka hor intaadan soo gelin.
Dholuo: Bed motang' e kuonde ma idhiyee mtokni - ket kiyi kendo ikri gi kom chien kapok idonjo.

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Laikipia County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurka laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health nyiso jogweng' County mar Laikipia mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth mar oganda ma onge chudo mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: For the last 24 hours, more tha 300 people have been tested, among these, 22 people have been cinfirmed positive (12 men and 9 females). Among these 22 patients, 21 are those already quarantined to prevent infections.
Kiswahili: Katika kipindi cha saa 24 zilizopita, watu zaidi ya 300 wamechunguzwa, kati yao 22 wamethibitishwa kuwa na athari (12 wanaume na 9 wanawake). Kati ya wagonjwa hawa 22, 21 ni wale ambao tayari wamewekwa katika karantini ili kuzuia maambukizo.
Somali: 24kii saac ee la soo dhaafay, in ka badan 300 oo qof ayaa la tijaabiyey, kuwaas oo 22 qof lagu xaqiijiyay inay yihiin kuwo wanaagsan (12 rag iyo 9 dumar).
Dholuo: Kuom seche 24 mosekalo, ji mokalo 300 osetimo nonro, kuom jogo, ji 22 osenwang'o ni gin gi tuoche (12 chwo kod 9 mon).

English: CDC announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Turkana County starting this January.
Kiswahili: CDC inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kuanzia Januari hii.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa in tallaabada la siiyay dadka deggan degmada Turkana laga bilaabo Janaayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuoche mag tuoche (CDC) ogolo chenro mar thiedho dialysis ne joma odak e county mar Turkana kochakore Januar ma kawuono.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Samburu County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan Gobolka Samburu in warbixinta khiyaamooyinka si deg deg ah ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service oparo ne jogweng' Samburu County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar wuond konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Enhance surveillance of crop pests and diseases in agro-pastoral areas.
Kiswahili: Kuimarisha ufuatiliaji wa wadudu wa mazao na magonjwa katika maeneo ya kilimo-mchungaji.
Somali: Kordhinta kormeerka cayayaanka iyo cudurrada dalagga ee ku yaala aagagga beeraha.
Dholuo: Tiego maber kuonde ma ji yudoe tuoche kod tuoche mag yiende e alwora mag pur.

English: Kenya: FAJ Strongly Condemns Assaults on Kenyan Journalists, Calls for Immediate Action
Kiswahili: Kenya: FAJ Yalaani Vikali Mashambulio dhidi ya Waandishi wa Habari wa Kenya, Yataka Hatua za Haraka
Somali: Kenya: FAJ waxay si adag u cambaareysay weerarrada lagu hayo saxafiyiinta Kenya, waxayna ku baaqday in tallaabo degdeg ah la qaado.
Dholuo: Kenya: FAJ Odagi Matek Gik ma Otimore ne Jondiko mag Kenya, Okwayo ni Otimre Mapiyo

English: Ignore messages like 'Youve won Safaricom Jackpot!'_x009d_Theyre scams.
Kiswahili: Puuza ujumbe kama 'Wewe umeshinda Safaricom Jackpot!'
Somali: Iska ilow fariimaha sida 'Waxaad ku guuleysatay Safaricom Jackpot!'_x009d_Waa khiyaamo.
Dholuo: <2Zepa> Weri gi ote kaka 'Iseloyo pok maduong' mar Safaricom!'

English: KALRO advises coffee producers in West Pokot County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inashauri wazalishaji wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KALRO waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kafeega ee degmada West Pokot inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KALRO nyiso jopur ma loso chai e West Pokot County mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur ka pok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Universities Fund advises applicants in Wajir County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Wajir kutembelea kituo cha mafunzo ya ufundi kilicho karibu kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku talinayaa codsadayaasha degmada Wajir inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee la heli karo.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundni e gweng' mar Wajir mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: KMTC urges youth in Kajiado County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kajiado inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda ka hor inta aysan qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KMTC jiwo rowere e Kajiado County mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto gikwongo tiyogo ka pok gichako timo tije mag sirkal.

English: KMTC advises students in Marsabit County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Somali: KMTC waxay ardayda degmada Marsabit kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga deeqda waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan deeq waxbarasho ardayda u baahan.
Dholuo: KMTC nyiso jopuonjre mag Marsabit County mondo okonygi kuom tiyo gi websait mar somo ma yudore e Intanet mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo chiwo mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre mochando.

English: NTSA calls on residents of Trans Nzoia County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: NTSA luongo jogweng' Trans Nzoia County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag rito sirkal e kuonde ma ji nitie mondo okonygi gi chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: Notice: KTDA will train farmers in Taita-Taveta County on water harvesting this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta juu ya uvunaji wa maji Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda Gobolka Taita-Taveta oo ku saabsan goosashada biyaha bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA biro tiego jopur manie Taita-Taveta County e nono pi e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Practice environmental stewardship by adopting methods that protect soil, water, and biodiversity in your dairy farm.
Kiswahili: Fanya mazoezi ya utunzaji wa mazingira kwa kutumia mbinu zinazolinda udongo, maji, na bioanuwai katika shamba lako la maziwa.
Somali: Ku dhaqan ilaalinta deegaanka adigoo qaadanaya habab ilaaliya ciidda, biyaha, iyo noocyada kala duwan ee beertaada caanaha.
Dholuo: Tim kinda mondo irit alwora ma idakie kuom tiyo gi yore ma rito lowo, pi, kod kit ngima mopogore opogore e puotheni.

English: HELB urges parents and teachers in Kwale County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: HELB inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: HELB waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Kwale inay u soo sheegaan maamulka iskuulka wixii arrimo ah oo ku saabsan amniga.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e gweng' mar Kwale mondo onyis sirkal mar skul wach moro amora motudore gi ritruok.

English: KEPHIS promotes agroforestry among farmers in Vihiga County as part of the January climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inakuza kilimo cha misitu kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kama sehemu ya harakati za ustahimilivu wa hali ya hewa ya Januari.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay dhiirrigelisay beeraleyda kaymaha beeraha ee degmada Vihiga iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka horumarka cimilada ee Janaayo.
Dholuo: KEPHIS miyo jopur mag gweng' mar Vihiga thuolo mar timo dongruok e weche mag yiengni e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Samburu County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Samburu Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu qabtaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan ka hortagga argagixisada ee Gobolka Samburu bishii Ogosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Forest Service timo romo mar oganda e dwe mar Agost e county mar Samburu.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges residents of Kirinyaga County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Uhalifu unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo jogweng' Kirinyaga County mondo oriwgi lwedo e nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'iyoe weche mag mahundu.

English: CDC appeals to caregivers in Nyeri County to visit their nearest maternity wing as part of the July maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Julai.
Somali: CDC waxay u baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Nyeri inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada bisha July.
Dholuo: CDC okwayo jorit e County mar Nyeri mondo olimgi machiegni gi kama gibiro yudoe nyithindo e dwe mar Julai.

English: FAO reminds livestock keepers in Kisii County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xayawaanka ah ee degmada Kisii inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: FAO parone jopur mag jamni e County mar Kisii mondo opidhgi gi tuoche e kuonde moketi mag chwoyo jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: Health Ministry mandating provision of fruit-based snacks instead of sugary options in public primary schools by 2026.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya ikiagiza utoaji wa vitafunio vyenye matunda badala ya vyakula vyenye sukari katika shule za msingi za umma ifikapo mwaka 2026.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka oo amar ku bixisay bixinta cuntooyinka khafiifka ah ee ku saleysan miraha halkii laga heli lahaa xulashooyinka sonkorta ah ee dugsiyada hoose ee dadweynaha sanadka 2026.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth dwaro ni nyaka chop higa mar 2026 ochiw chiemo ma nigi olemo e kar chiemo mamit e skunde matindo mag sirkal.

English: IEBC announces distribution of school laptops under the digital literacy programme to schools in Kericho County this March.
Kiswahili: IEBC inatangaza usambazaji wa kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa shule za Kaunti ya Kericho Machi hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Kericho bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: IEBC olando ni ibiro pog laptop mag skul e bwo program mar digital literacy e skunde man Kericho County e dwe mar Mach.

English: KNEC urges residents of Vihiga County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na ugawaji wa bursary.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan qaybinta deeqaha waxbarasho.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Vihiga mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud michno.

English: Huduma Kenya urges eligible citizens in Tharaka-Nithi County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ka qaybqaataan jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jokanyo mag Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar yiero.

English: The plan to start announcements to strengthen food availability during drought and war
Kiswahili: Mpango wa kuanza matangazo ya kuimarisha upatikanaji wa chakula wakati wa ukame na vita
Somali: Qorshaha bilowga ogeysiisyada si loo xoojiyo helitaanka cuntada xilliga abaarta iyo dagaalka
Dholuo: Chenro mar chako lando wach chiemo e kinde kech kod lweny

English: KNEC announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in Kwale County this October.
Kiswahili: KNEC inatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kwale Oktoba hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta deeqaha waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan dugsiyada Gobolka Kwale bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KNEC ogolo chiwo mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre man gi chan e skunde man Kwale County e dwe mar Oktoba.
