English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development encourages out-of-school children in Homa Bay County to register their children at the nearest public school under free primary education.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza watoto wasio shuleni katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee gobolka Homa Bay inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e Homa Bay County mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni gi skul mar piny ka gipuonjore somo mapile maonge chudo.

English: Heavy rains with flooding in Sudan has caused suffering to 1.4 million people and more than 379,000 have been displaced as disclosed by the world organization which has issued alerts on increasing malaria
Kiswahili: Mvua kubwa na mafuriko nchini Sudan yamesababisha mateso kwa watu milioni 1.4 na zaidi ya watu 379,000 wametoroka makao yao, kama ilivyoripotiwa na shirika la kimataifa ambalo limetoa tahadhari juu ya kuongezeka kwa malaria
Somali: Roobabka xoogga leh iyo fatahaadaha Sudan ayaa sababay in 1.4 milyan oo qof ay ku xanuunsadaan in ka badan 379,000 oo qof ayaa barakacay sida ay shaacisay ururka caalamiga ah ee soo saaray digniino ku saabsan sii kordhaya cudurka daacuunka
Dholuo: koth maduong' kod ataro e Sudan osekelo chandruok ne ji milion 1.4 kendo ji mokalo 379,000 osewuok e miechgi kaluwore gi riwruok mar piny mangima ma osechiwo siem e wi medruok mar malaria

English: Marsabit County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Marsabit: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2022
Somali: Degmada Marsabit: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Marsabit: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2022

English: Isiolo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Isiolo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Oktoba 2022
Somali: Degmada Isiolo: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2022
Dholuo: Kaun mar Isiolo: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Oktoba 2022

English: NCPB advises farmers in Mandera County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the August planting season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera watumie viwango vinavyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa kupanda mwezi Agosti.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Degmada Mandera inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e Mandera County mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Agost.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds farmers in Kericho County of the ongoing greenhouse farming training programme.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kilimo cha chafu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa beeraleyda degmada Kericho barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service parone jopur e county mar Kericho e wi program mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar timo ohala mar yien.

English: DPP warns residents of Kiambu County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this December.
Kiswahili: DPP anawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Desemba hii.
Somali: DPP waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay u diyaargaroobaan qaraxyo dab ah oo dhici kara bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: DPP osiemo jogweng' mar Kiambu County mondo oikre ne yiengni manyalo timore e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Announcement that food suppliees to all school to be done locally to benefit local farmers. Also, farmers are encouraged to plant food crops that are climate resistant
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwamba ugavi wa chakula kwa shule zote lazima ufanyike ndani ili kusaidia wakulima wa ndani. Pia, wakulima wanahimizwa kupanda mazao ya chakula ambayo ni sugu kwa hali ya hewa
Somali: Ogeysiis ah in sahayda cuntada ee dhammaan dugsiyada lagu qaban doono si maxalli ah si loo faa'iido siiyo beeraleyda deegaanka. Sidoo kale, beeralayda waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay beeraan dalagyo cunto ah oo cimilada u adkeysan
Dholuo: Owacho ni chiemo onego ochiw ne skul duto e alwora ma gidakie mondo okony jopur ma kuno.

English: SHA urges eligible citizens in Kiambu County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawahimiza raia wanaostahiki katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kiambu inay ka qaybqaataan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro mar yiero e county mar Kiambu mondo oriwre gi jogo madwaro yiero.

English: KEMSA calls on parents in Lamu County to have children under five screened for cyclosporiasis during the March outreach.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuwachunguza watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa cyclosporiasis wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Machi.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Lamu in carruurta ka yar shan sano la baaro cudurka cyclosporiasis inta lagu jiro adeegga bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: KEMSA okwayo jonyuol e County mar Lamu mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma hikgi tin ne abich kuom wach cyclosporiasis e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha katika shule kote Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij ku saabsan hagitaan iyo adeegyo la-talin ah dugsiyada gobolka Nakuru.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj chako chenro mar tiego kendo chiwo paro e skunde duto e gweng' mar Nakuru.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the community in Isiolo County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb fraud.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua ili kuzuia udanganyifu.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Isiolo inay ka fogaadaan in ay macluumaadka amniga shisheeyaha la wadaagaan si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto manie gweng' mar Isiolo mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo kik gitim mibadhi.

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Kiambu County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay haystaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health nyiso jogweng' County mar Kiambu mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi ka gidwaro yudo thieth mondo giyud thieth makonyogi.

English: Children exposed to smoke are more likely to develop asthma and respiratory infections.
Kiswahili: Watoto wanaovuta moshi wana uwezekano mkubwa wa kupata pumu na maambukizi ya njia ya upumuaji.
Somali: Carruurta qiiqa la taaban karo waxay u badan yihiin inay qabaan asthma iyo cudurrada neefsashada.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma madho ndawa nyalo bedo gi tuwo mar asthma kod tuoche mag muya.

English: Sauti Trade Insights COVID-19 Bulletin Q4 2021/Q1 2022 (April 2022)
Kiswahili: Sauti Trade Insights COVID-19 Bulletin Q4 2021/Q1 2022 (Aprili 2022)
Somali: Warbixinta Ganacsiga ee Sauti ee COVID-19 Q4 2021/Q1 2022 (Abriil 2022)
Dholuo: Oboke mar Ohala mar Sauti mar COVID-19 dwe mar ang'wen 2021/dwe mar ang'wen 2022 (dwe mar ang'wen 2022)

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds residents of Narok County that terracing improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kwamba terracing inaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Narok in dhulka lagu beerayo uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jogweng' Narok County ni terracing medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: AFA urges farmers in Wajir County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: AFA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Wajir inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Wajir mondo opidh olembe ma ok nyal geng'o lowo kethore mondo okonygi nyagruok gi lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: COMESA reminds farmers in Kajiado County of the ongoing fertiliser application training programme.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kajiado juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya matumizi ya mbolea.
Somali: COMESA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kajiado barnaamijka tababarka ee hadda socda ee ku saabsan isticmaalka bacriminta.
Dholuo: COMESA oparo ne jopur man Kajiado County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar tiyo gi yien.

English: State Department for TVET advises applicants in Mombasa County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Mombasa inay dalbadaan booska TVET iyada oo loo marayo KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET nyiso jogo madwaro yudo tiegruok e county mar Mombasa mondo okonygi gi KUCCPS mondo giyud tiegruogno.

English: Public health advisory: KEMSA warns of increased cyclosporiasis risk in Tharaka-Nithi County and advises the public to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMSA inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya cyclosporiasis katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi na inashauri umma kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Somali: Talo-bixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: KEMSA waxay ka digtay kororka halista cyclosporiasis ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay dhammaystiraan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar ji: KEMSA osiemo ji kuom medruok mar masira mar cyclosporiasis e Tharaka-Nithi County kendo ojiwo ji mondo otiek dose duto mar thiedho.

English: Packaging protects beans and adds value Find out what types of packaging are suitable for selling in export markets
Kiswahili: Ufungashaji hulinda maharagwe na huongeza thamani Tafuta ni aina gani za vifungashio vinavyofaa kuuzwa katika masoko ya nje
Somali: Baakadaha waxay ilaaliyaan xajmiga iyo qiimaha lagu daro Soo ogow nooca baakadaha ku habboon iibinta suuqyada dhoofinta
Dholuo: Yien ma gipoyo rito cham kendo medo nengo mar cham.

English: Surviving the Drought: The Struggle and Resilience of Pastoralist Communities in Northern Kenya
Kiswahili: Kunusurika na Ukame: Mapambano na Ustahimilivu wa Jumuiya za Wafugaji Kaskazini mwa Kenya.
Somali: Ka Badbaadidda Abaarta: Halganka iyo Adkeysiga Bulshooyinka Xoolo-dhaqatada ah ee Waqooyiga Kenya
Dholuo: Kuong’ruok e kinde mar oro: Kedo kod Kinda mar Jokwath e Piny Kenya ma Nyanduat

English: Breast feeding mothers should milk their milk and keep it safe to enable the child have milk to feed on while its mother is away.
Kiswahili: Mama wanaonyonyesha wanapaswa kunyonya maziwa yao na kuyahifadhi salama ili mtoto aweze kupata maziwa ya kula wakati mama yake akiwa mbali.
Somali: Hooyooyinka naas nuujinaya waa inay caanaha u cabaan oo ay ilaaliyaan si ay ilmaha u helaan caano uu ku quudiyo inta hooyadiis maqnaato.
Dholuo: Min nyithindo madho kong'o onego omadh kendo oritgi maber mondo omi nyathi obed gi chak ma onyalo pidho ka min-gi onge.

English: COMESA urges farmers in Kericho County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kericho inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo lagu soo ururiyo biyaha beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kericho mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok ma timore e kaka koth chue.

English: Brief: El NiÃƒÂ±o floods worsen humanitarian needs in Kenya (March 2024)
Kiswahili: Kwa kifupi: Mafuriko ya El NiÃƒÂ±o yanazidisha mahitaji ya kibinadamu nchini Kenya (Machi 2024)
Somali: Warbixin Kooban: Daadadka El NiƒÂ±o oo sii xumeeyay baahiyaha bani'aadamnimada ee Kenya (Maarso 2024)
Dholuo: Machiek: Pi ma pong’o piny El Nio medo rach mar dwaro mag dhano e piny Kenya (Dwe mar Adek 2024)

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on the community in Embu County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Embu kuongea dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa bulshada degmada Embu ugu baaqaya inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga iyo inay taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow ee aaminka ah.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oluongo ji duto e county mar Embu mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gidwar kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Embu County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa msaada wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow si ay uga caawiyaan helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ee lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMSA nyiso jogweng' Embu County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni mondo giyud kony mar yudo kony kuom weche thieth.

English: Notice: KEMRI confirms a tuberculosis outbreak alert for Kirinyaga County. Residents are advised to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa kifua kikuu kwa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka hargabka ee Gobolka Kirinyaga. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakhda leh.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KEMRI osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuberculosis e gweng' mar Kirinyaga.

English: AFA urges farmers in Kajiado County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: AFA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kajiado inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e Kajiado County mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e weche mag pur mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the public in Isiolo County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa shacabka degmada Isiolo inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto e kaunti mar Isiolo mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma osefweny ni gin gi chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Homa Bay County starting this September.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuanzia Septemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa ku dhawaaqday in laga bilaabo bisha Sebtember ee soo socota la siinayo dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit olando dhialusi mar joma odak e Homa Bay County kochakore Septemba.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha katika shule kote Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay bilawday barnaamij hagitaan iyo adeegyo la-talin ah oo lagu sameeyo dugsiyada gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State Department for TVET chako chenro mar tayo kendo chiwo paro e skunde e alwora mar Lamu County.

English: Samburu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Samburu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Samburu: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Samburu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Septemba 2022

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Kiambu County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Kiambu inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur e County mar Kiambu mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Laikipia County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Laikipia: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Juni 2022
Somali: Degmada Laikipia: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Laikipia: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar auchiel 2022

English: CADIS and Tzu Chi Deliver Relief to Flood-Hit Communities in Kenya
Kiswahili: CADIS na Tzu Chi Zawasilisha Msaada kwa Jamii Zilizokumbwa na Mafuriko nchini Kenya
Somali: CADIS iyo Tzu Chi ayaa gargaar u fidiyay bulshooyinka ay fatahaaduhu saameeyeen ee Kenya.
Dholuo: CADIS kod Tzu Chi Ochiwo Kony Ne Joma Oyudo Obadho Pi Ma Opong'o E piny Kenya

English: COMESA reminds farmers in Nyamira County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Somali: COMESA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyamira barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee ka dambeeya goosashada.
Dholuo: COMESA parone jopur e County mar Nyamira chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime bang' keyo.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kisii County this April.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: Gazeti la Kenya linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kisii Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu billaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee ka socda degmada Kisii bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: Kenya Gazette chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e gweng' mar Kisii e dwe mar April.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds residents of Homa Bay County that access to national ID applications is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba kufikia maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay in helitaanka codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties parone jogweng' Homa Bay County ni yudo kwayo mag ID e piny mangima koro yot ahinya kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Notice: TVET launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET yazindua mpango wa kupinga uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay bilawday barnaamij ka dhan ah tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibta dugsiyada degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe mahundu e skunde duto mag Baringo County.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service informs horticultural produce farmers in Isiolo County of new market linkage opportunities this September.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawafahamisha wakulima wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Septemba hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku wargalinayaa beeraleyda wax soo saarka beeraha ee degmada Isiolo fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur ma loso puothe e kaunti mar Isiolo thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Conflict-Sensitive Social Protection: Kenya Country Report 2022
Kiswahili: Ulinzi wa Jamii Nyeti kwa Migogoro: Ripoti ya Nchi ya Kenya 2022
Somali: Ilaalinta Bulshada ee Xasaasiga ah ee Khilaafaadka: Warbixinta Dalka Kenya 2022
Dholuo: Rito mar Oganda Ma Owinjore gi Lweny: Ripot mar Piny Kenya 2022

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties updates residents of Siaya County on progress of ward-level service delivery this June.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya juu ya maendeleo ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya mwezi Juni.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya ku wargelinaya horumarka adeegyada lagu bixiyo degmooyinka bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties olero ne jogweng' mar County mar Siaya dongruok mar tich mitimo e gwenge mopogore opogore e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) launches the county integrated development plan in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika wilaya ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Garsoorka Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu bilaabay qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chako chenro mar dongruok mar county e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: Notice: IPOA opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa marejeleo salama makazi katika Meru County.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay fureysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya talooyin ku saabsan hoyga ammaanka ah ee degmada Meru.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo weche ma nyiso ni ng'ato nyalo yudo kar dak e alwora mar Meru County.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya warns residents of Narok County to prepare for possible road accidents this May.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Mei hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan gobolka Narok inay u diyaargaroobaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha May.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji osiemo jogweng' Narok mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General launches the county integrated development plan in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu huzindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika wilaya ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud ayaa bilaabay qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Jarit Maduong' chako chenro mar dongruok mar county e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: Ministry of ICT and KICD conduct training for teachers on effective utilization of e-learning tools and platforms.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya ICT na KICD huandaa mafunzo kwa walimu juu ya matumizi yenye ufanisi ya zana na majukwaa ya e-kujifunza.
Somali: Wasaaradda ICT iyo KICD waxay macallimiinta u qabtaan tababar ku saabsan isticmaalka wax ku oolka ah ee qalabka iyo barashada elektaroonigga ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of ICT kod KICD timo tiegruok ne jopuonj e wi tiyo gi yore mag somo e yo maber.

English: Notice: KALRO will conduct a fertiliser application workshop for farmers in Nandi County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafanya warsha ya maombi ya mbolea kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan codsiyada bacriminta beeraleyda gobolka Nandi bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Rapar: KALRO biro timo tiegruok mar tiyo gi yien mag yien ne jopur e kaunti mar Nandi e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: EACC will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay qabaneysaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: EACC biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e county mar Siaya.

English: DCI reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Nakuru County that access to the GBV toll-free helpline is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba upatikanaji wa simu ya GBV ya bure ya msaada unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee degmada Nakuru in helitaanka khadka caawimaadda ee GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ay tahay mid lacag la 'aan ah.
Dholuo: DCI oparo ne jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Nakuru ni gibiro yudo kony ma onge chudo mar GBV maonge chudo.

English: Models of social payments through Inua Jamii
Kiswahili: Miundo ya malipo ya kijamii kupitia Inua Jamii
Somali: Moodooyinka lacagaha bulshada ee loo maro Inua Jamii
Dholuo: Ranyisi mag chudo mag oganda kokalo kuom Inua Jamii

English: NTSA warns residents of Lamu County to prepare for possible road accidents this April.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Aprili hii.
Somali: NTSA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu inay u diyaargaroobaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: NTSA osiemo jogweng' Lamu County mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar April.

English: NDMA urges the community in Busia County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb burglary.
Kiswahili: NDMA inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Busia kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Busia inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo oganda man Busia County mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Free national digital library launched Ã¢Â€Â“ 100,000 books, no login required!
Kiswahili: Maktaba ya kitaifa ya kidijitali ya bure yazinduliwa Ã¢Â€Â“ Vitabu 100,000, hakuna kuingia kunakohitajika!
Somali: Maktabadda dhijitaalka ah ee qaranka oo bilaash ah ayaa la bilaabay - 100,000 oo buug, looma baahna gal!
Dholuo: Laibri mar piny mangima ma onge chudo noloso buge 100,000, onge dwaro mar donjo!

English: With the newer threat by Omicron and rising numbers of infections â€“ 3,286 new confirmed COVID-19 cases as of December 30 - the need to sustain vaccination and preventive and protective measures by all, has become as urgent as ever.
Kiswahili: Kukiwa na tishio jipya zaidi la Omicron na kuongezeka kwa idadi ya maambukizo - kesi 3,286 mpya zilizothibitishwa za COVID-19 kufikia Desemba 30 - hitaji la kudumisha chanjo na hatua za kinga na kinga na wote, imekuwa haraka kama zamani.
Somali: Iyadoo khatarta cusub ee Omicron iyo tirada sii kordheysa ee caabuqyada - 3,286 kiis oo cusub oo la xaqiijiyay oo COVID-19 ah laga bilaabo Diseembar 30 - baahida loo qabo in la sii wado tallaalka iyo tallaabooyinka ka hortagga iyo ilaalinta ee dhammaan, ayaa noqotay mid degdeg ah sidii hore.
Dholuo: Kaluwore gi luoro manyien mar Omicron kod medo kwan mar jogo ma oyudo tuo â€“ 3,286 manyien ma oyudo tuo mar COVID-19 nyaka tarik 30 dwe mar apar gi ariyo - dwaro mar dhi nyime gi chiwo chanjo kod yore mag geng’o kod rito tuo kuom ji duto, osebedo gima dwarore mapiyo kaka chon.

English: Ministry of Education reminds youth in Nakuru County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nakuru in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok parone rowere man Nakuru County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar chiemo kod mar rwako welo.

English: Kenya suspends all public gatherings, games, events, and church crusades; inter school games banned after first covid-19 case in Nairobi
Kiswahili: Kenya yasimamisha mikusanyiko yote ya umma, michezo, matukio, na mikutano ya kanisa; michezo ya shule imepigwa marufuku baada ya kisa cha kwanza cha COVID-19 jijini Nairobi
Somali: Kenya ayaa joojisay dhammaan isu imaatinka dadweynaha, ciyaaraha, dhacdooyinka, iyo safarada iskutallaabta ee kaniisadda; Ciyaaraha iskuulada ayaa la mamnuucay kadib kiiska koowaad ee COVID-19 ee Nairobi
Dholuo: Kenya ogeng'o chokruok duto mag ji, tuke, gik moko, kod lwenje mag kanisa; tugo tuke e kind skunde ogo marfuk bang' wach Covid-19 mokwongo Nairobi

English: A judicial ruling found former officers guilty of murder, reinforcing accountability for serious misconduct.
Kiswahili: Uamuzi wa mahakama ulibaini maafisa wa zamani kuwa na hatia ya mauaji, na hivyo kuimarisha uwajibikaji kwa utovu mkubwa wa nidhamu.
Somali: Go'aan maxkamadeed ayaa ciidamada hore ku helay dil, taasoo xoojineysa mas'uuliyadda xadgudubyada culus.
Dholuo: Kot nong'ado bura ma nyiso ni joma chon ne tiyo e sirkal ne nigi ketho mar nego ng'ato, kendo mano nojiwo okang' ma ne okaw nikech timbegi maricho.

English: Notice: KRA will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KRA biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e County mar Nyeri.

English: Ministry of Education conducts a civic education forum on voter registration in Nyeri County this March.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Machi hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa bishii Maarso ee sannadkan ka qaban doonta madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiegruok mar ji duto e dwe mar Mach e county mar Nyeri.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free malaria screening is available at all public health centres in Kitui County this December.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa malaria bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kitui Desemba hii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka malaria ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Kitui bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji ni thieth mar malaria maonge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County Kitui e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: KTDA restricts movement of sheep in Taita-Taveta County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA inazuia harakati za kondoo katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi wenye uvimbe.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa idaha Gobolka Taita-Taveta sababo la xiriira faafitaanka cudurka maqaarka.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA ogeng'o wuoth mar rombe e Taita-Taveta County nikech tuoche mag pien.

English: Notice: KTDA will train farmers in Makueni County on soil conservation this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni juu ya uhifadhi wa udongo Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Makueni ee ku saabsan ilaalinta ciidda bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA biro tiego jopur e gweng' mar Makueni e wi rito lowo e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations launches a theft prevention campaign in Bungoma County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa bilaabay olole ka hortagga tuugada degmada Bungoma bishii May.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova chako kampen mar geng'o kuo e taon mar Bungoma e dwe mar Mei.

English: Mobile health clinics bring vital prenatal and postnatal services closer to remote communities.
Kiswahili: Kliniki za afya zinazohamishika huleta huduma muhimu za ujauzito na baada ya kujifungua karibu na jamii za mbali.
Somali: Rugta caafimaadka ee mobile-ka ah waxay adeegyada muhiimka ah ee dhalmada ka hor iyo dhalmada kadib u keenaan bulshooyinka fog.
Dholuo: Klinike mag thieth makonyo ji chopo machiegni gi joma odak mabor.

English: Notice: Universities Fund opens a new motor vehicle mechanics programme at the vocational centre in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unafungua programu mpya ya ufundi wa magari katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ka furayaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan farsamada gawaarida mootada ee xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Yunivasiti Fund chako chenro manyien mar tiyo gi masinde mag riembo mtokni e skul mar tich e gweng' mar Isiolo.

English: Important message to prevent Mpox. Keep distace from a person with symptoms of TB. Do not share personal items like towels, utensils neither cloths. Ensure washing your hands all the times.
Kiswahili: Ujumbe muhimu wa kuzuia Mpox: Jitenge na mtu aliye na dalili za kifua kikuu. Usishiriki vitu vya kibinafsi kama vile vidole, vyombo wala vitambaa. Hakikisha unaosha mikono yako kila wakati.
Somali: Fariin muhiim ah oo looga hortago Mpox. Qofka qaba calaamadaha cudurka TB ka fogaada. Ha la wadaagin alaabada shakhsiyeed sida towels, weelasha ama dharka. Hubi inaad gacmahaaga si joogto ah u maydho.
Dholuo: Puonj maduong' manyalo konyo e geng'o tuo mar Mpox. Ketri mabor gi ng'at ma nigi tuo mar TB. Kik ipog gik moko mag ng'ato gi nyawadgi kaka twanda, gige tich, kata lewni.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kiambu County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unashauri mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kutafuta msaada katika nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada wuxuu ku boorinayaa qofkasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Kiambu inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e County mar Kiambu mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Huduma Kenya invites residents of Mombasa County to attend the public participation forum regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya gwelo jogweng' Mombasa County mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenro mag dongruok.

English: Public health advisory: Kenya Red Cross warns of increased malaria risk in Bomet County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya malaria katika Kaunti ya Bomet na kushauri umma kutumia vyandarua vilivyotiwa dawa ya wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Warbixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ka digtay khatarta sii kordheysa ee Cudurka Daacuunka ee Gobolka Bomet waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova e piny Kenya, miluongo ni Kenya Red Cross, chiwo siem e wi kaka tuwo mar malaria nyalo medore e gweng' mar Bomet County, kendo ojiwo ji mondo oti gi gige choko kute ma otigo gi yedhe makelo tuoche.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Nyamira County this January.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Januari hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada ayaa bishii Janaayo ku qabanaya madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan wareejinta degmada Nyamira.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development dhi nyime gi chenro mar tiegruok mar ji duto e dwe mar Januar e kaunti mar Nyamira.

English: Council of Governors tests local centers for devolution learning.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Watawala hujaribu vituo vya ndani kwa ajili ya kujifunza devolution.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha waxay tijaabiyaan xarumaha deegaanka ee barashada wareejinta.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch timo nonro e wi kuonde ma ji puonjoree weche mopogore opogore.

English: KICD invites youth in Marsabit County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this August.
Kiswahili: KICD inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Agosti hii.
Somali: KICD waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Marsabit inay iska diiwaangeliyaan tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: KICD gwelo rowere mag Marsabit County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: TSC announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada Gobolka Kwale.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TSC ogolo chenro mar dhi e skunde mag Kwale County.

English: Public notice: KEMSA will host a free safe water storage outreach in Taita-Taveta County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMSA itakuwa mwenyeji wa ufikiaji wa bure wa uhifadhi wa maji salama katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: KEMSA waxay marti gelineysaa adeeg lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMSA biro timo kampen mar choko pi maonge chudo e taon mar Taita-Taveta e dwe mar Jun.

English: CLUSTER/ SECTOR MINISTRIES, DEPARTMENTS AND AGENCIES Date for Submission Time for submission VENUE FOR SUBMISSION Kenya Veterinary Vaccines Promotion Institute 19.08.2024 9:30 a.m. - 10:00 a.m.
Kiswahili: WIZARA/ SEKTA WIZARA, IDARA NA MAWAKALA Tarehe ya Kuwasilisha Muda wa kuwasilisha ENEO LA KUWASILISHA Taasisi ya Kukuza Chanjo za Mifugo Kenya 19.08.2024 9:30 a.m. - 10:00 a.m.
Somali: WASARADDA, WAAXAHA IYO WAKIILADA GUDDIGA/QAYBAHA Taariikhda Gudbinta Waqtiga Gudbinta Goobta Gudbinta Machadka Horumarinta Tallaallada Xoolaha ee Kenya 19.08.2024 9:30 subaxnimo - 10:00 subaxnimo

English: FAO warns cassava farmers in Mombasa County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: FAO inawaonya wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Mombasa juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: FAO waxay uga digtay beeraleyda cassava ee degmada Mombasa cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: FAO chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho manias e county mar Mombasa kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Notice: NPS issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Narok County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay soo saartaa digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah ee saameeya dadka deggan gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NPS ogolo siem mar rito weche mag intanet e wi chenro mag gwelo pesa mag miriambo makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Narok County.

English: Kitui County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kitui: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2023
Somali: Degmada Kitui: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kitui: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2023

English: Laikipia County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Laikipia: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2023
Somali: Degmada Laikipia: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Laikipia: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar adek higa mar 2023

English: CDC urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Nyeri County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: CDC inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: CDC waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Nyeri inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nyagore gi tuoche mag obwongo e County mar Nyeri mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will distribute certified millet seed to farmers in Machakos County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka ayaa abuurka miiraha la caddeeyay u qaybin doona beeraleyda Degmada Machakos bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro pogo kodhi mag millet ne jopur manie County ma Machakos e dwe mar April.

English: NCPB reminds residents of Mombasa County that water harvesting improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba uvunaji wa maji unaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: NCPB waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Mombasa in soo-saarka biyaha uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: NCPB parone jogweng' mar County mar Mombasa ni yudho pi kelo nyak mar puodho kuom kinde malach.

English: SHA encourages first-time voters in Machakos County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: SHA inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Machakos kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: SHA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Machakos inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo josiasa ma ne okwongo yiero e county mar Machakos mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free HIV/AIDS screening is available at all public health centres in Taita-Taveta County this November.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa VVU/UKIMWI unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta Novemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka HIV / AIDS ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji ni nonro mar HIV/AIDS onge chudo e kuonde thieth duto e Taita-Taveta County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Council of Governors updates residents of Kilifi County on progress of the county integrated development plan this December.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawasilisha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya ya pamoja mwezi Desemba.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay dadka deggan degmada Kilifi ku wargeliyaan horumarka qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch olero ne Jo-Kilifi County dongruok mar chenro mar dongruok mar gweng'no e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Narok County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for January 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Narok: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Januari 2023
Somali: Degmada Narok: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Janaayo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Narok: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar achiel higa mar 2023

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of Mandera County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay u yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng'o mag Mandera County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giluong kony mar thieth mar chuny maonge chudo.

English: NPS reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kirinyaga County that access to psychosocial support is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisaikolojia unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee Gobolka Kirinyaga in helitaanka taageerada cilmu-nafsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: NPS oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Kirinyaga ni ginyalo yudo kony ma onge chudo.

English: Notice: TSC announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta dugsiyada dugsiga dhexe ee bilaashka ah ee degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TSC ogolo chenro mar somo mar sekondari e skul mag Bungoma County.

English: Council of Governors reminds the public in Embu County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this March.

Dholuo: KEMRI oparo ne ji ni nono tuo mar typhoid maonge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Busia e dwe mar Septemba.

English: NCPB advises farmers in Nakuru County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.

English: Judiciary of Kenya invites residents of Bungoma County to attend the public participation forum regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.

Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya gwelo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi weche siasa.

English: ODPP urges residents of Baringo County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kudai kutoa huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay dalbadaan bixinta adeegyada iyada oo aan la bixin laaluush si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogweng'o mag Baringo County mondo okonygi gi tij lendo maok gichiwo asoya mondo giked gi asoya e migepe mag sirkal.

English: Notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will hold a depression awareness forum in Kwale County this May. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanya kongamano la uhamasishaji wa unyogovu katika Kaunti ya Kwale Mei hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay qabaneysaa madasha wacyi galinta niyadjabka ee Gobolka Kwale bisha May. Dhammaantood waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Migawo mar Neno Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo biro timo chokruok mar chiwo paro e wi tuwo mar depression e taon mar Kwale e dwe mar Mei.

English: Kenya has comnfirmed that 384 people have been infected with Covid 19. Among these, 109 of them are from Mombasa and 1 from nairobi
Kiswahili: Kenya imethibitisha kuwa watu 384 wameambukizwa COVID 19. Kati yao, 109 ni kutoka Mombasa na 1 kutoka Nairobi
Somali: Kenya ayaa xaqiijisay in 384 qof ay ku dhaawacmeen cudurka Covid 19. Kuwaas oo ka mid ah, 109 qof ayaa ka yimid Mombasa iyo 1 qof oo ka yimid Nairobi.
Dholuo: Kenya osenyiso ni ji 384 oseyud tuo mar Covid 19. Kuom jogo, 109 kuomgi gin jo Mombasa to 1 en jo Nairobi.

English: Notice: COMESA will train farmers in Machakos County on conservation tillage this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos juu ya kilimo cha uhifadhi Januari hii.

English: Notice: HELB opens a new catering and hospitality programme at the vocational centre in Mombasa County.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges maize growers in Tharaka-Nithi County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Wanyama inawasihi wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi watumie viwango vinavyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.

Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur ma pidho kodhi e County mar Tharaka-Nithi mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue mondo omed kelo nyak e higani.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the community in Uasin Gishu County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada ku nool gobolka Uasin Gishu inay ka fogaadaan in ay faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyadeed la wadaagaan shisheeyaha si looga hortago xannibaadda lo'da.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto manie gweng' mar Uasin Gishu mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: IEBC reminds the public in Kwale County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kwale in sheegashada khiyaamooyinka iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: IEBC parone ji duto e Kaunti mar Kwale ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag yuto en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response launches an October awareness campaign on proper sanitation across Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Oktoba juu ya usafi wa mazingira katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Oktoobar oo ku saabsan nadaafadda saxda ah ee Gobolka Samburu.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Oktoba e wi thieth mowinjore e gweng' mar Samburu.

English: State Department for Basic Education announces distribution of school laptops under the digital literacy programme to schools in Murang'a County this August.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inatangaza usambazaji wa kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Agosti hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku dhawaaqday qaybinta kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Murang'a bishii Ogosto.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education olando chiwo mag laptop mag skul e bwo program mar digital literacy ne skunde man Murang'a County e dwe mar Agost.

English: KTDA reminds livestock keepers in Samburu County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KTDA waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xayawaanka ah ee Gobolka Samburu inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KTDA paronwa jorit jamni e county mar Samburu mondo ogeng' jamni maggi e kuonde moketi mag nego jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free depression awareness support is available through county health facilities in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa uhamasishaji wa unyogovu unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay wacyiga niyadjabku laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Nandi County.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar parruok yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Nandi.

English: NDMA warns residents of Uasin Gishu County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuhusu kuongezeka kwa kashfa za pesa za simu na inashauri umma wasiishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.

Dholuo: NDMA osiemo jogweng' Uasin Gishu County kuom wach medruok mar timbe mag wuondo pesa mag simo kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KRA chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar Jun.

English: CDC appeals to caregivers in Bomet County to visit their nearest maternity wing as part of the April maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Bomet kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Aprili.

Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Machakos kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.

Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Msajili wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kitui kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages mothers in Marsabit County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.

Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo mine man Marsabit County mondo odhi olim ringregi machiegni mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: NCPB reminds residents of Migori County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: NCPB waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Migori in ilaalinta ciidda ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: NCPB parone jogweng' Migori County ni rito lowo miyo puodho bedo maber e kinde mabiro.

English: State Department for Basic Education advises students in Baringo County to register early to secure allocation to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Baringo kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ardayda degmada Baringo kula talineysaa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan si ay u helaan deeq waxbarasho oo loogu talagalay ardayda u baahan.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education nyiso jopuonjre man Baringo County ni gidonj e skundno chon mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo osuru ne jopuonjre mochando.

English: Children who develop speaking difficulties or in pronouncing words can also lead to difficulties in reading thereafter. Seek for urgent medical attention from children's doctor
Kiswahili: Watoto ambao wana matatizo ya kuzungumza au ya kutamka maneno yanaweza pia kusababisha matatizo ya kusoma baadaye.
Somali: Carruurta qaba dhibaatooyinka hadalka ama hadalka ayaa sidoo kale dhibaatooyinka akhriska u keeni kara ka dib.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma nigi chandruok mar wuoyo kata wacho weche nyalo bedo gi chandruok mar somo bang'e.

English: AFA encourages farmers in Kiambu County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for coffee.
Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za kahawa.
Somali: AFA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kiambu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan kafeega.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kiambu mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro mondo omi ohala mar kofi obed maber.

English: Kenya Gazette announces improved turnaround times for e-Citizen registration in Narok County.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujiandikisha kwa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku dhawaaqay in la hagaajiyay waqtiga wareejinta ee diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee Gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette olando lokruok e seche mag dhi e e e-Citizen registration e Narok County.

English: Government announces scaling of biofortified crop distribution to schools and households for improved maternal-child nutrition.
Kiswahili: Serikali yatangaza kuongeza usambazaji wa mazao biofuti kwa shule na kaya kwa ajili ya kuboresha lishe ya mama na mtoto.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay ku dhawaaqday kordhinta qaybinta dalagyada la xoojiyay ee dugsiyada iyo qoysaska si loo horumariyo nafaqada hooyada iyo dhallaanka.
Dholuo: Sirkal ogolo lendo mar medo ng’eny mar chiwo cham ma nigi gik ma nyalo ketho ngima mar ng’ato e skul kod udi mondo ober chiemo ma ng’ato nyalo yudo kuom min gi nyathi.

English: Notice: IEBC announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay ku dhawaaqday taariikhda diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ee dugsiyada Gobolka Samburu.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IEBC ogolo chenro mar somo e skunde mag Samburu County.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) urges beans growers in Kericho County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawahimiza wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Kericho kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Kericho inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
