English: NTSA reminds the public in Tharaka-Nithi County to remain vigilant on border security.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: NTSA waxay dadka degmada Tharaka-Nithi ku xasuusineysaa inay ka feejignaadaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: NTSA parone ji duto e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo obed motang' e weche mag rito tong'.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds the public in Kwale County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kwale in sheegashada khiyaamooyinka iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya parone ji duto man Kwale County ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag ohala en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: A Path to Self-Reliance for Displacement-Affected People: Economic Inclusion Barriers and Market Assessments in Kenya and South Sudan
Kiswahili: Njia ya Kujitegemea kwa Watu Walioathiriwa na Uhamisho: Vizuizi vya Ushirikishwaji wa Kiuchumi na Tathmini ya Soko nchini Kenya na Sudan Kusini.
Somali: Waddo loo maro isku-kalsoonaanta dadka ay saameeyeen barakacayaasha: Ka mid noqoshada dhaqaalaha Caqabadaha iyo Qiimaynta Suuqa ee Kenya iyo Koonfurta Suudaan
Dholuo: Yo mar Riembo Joma Oyudo Masira: Obadho mag Keto Gik Motudore kod Nonro mag Chiro e Kenya kod Sudan ma milambo

English: To minimize aflatoxin contamination in groundnut and maize and prevent losses, farmers can apply a biocontrol product called Aflasafe, which cuts aflatoxin levels by 96-100% down to safe levels for consumption, from the moment of harvest all the way through storage until the food is eaten.
Kiswahili: Ili kupunguza uchafuzi wa aflatoxin katika karanga na mahindi na kuzuia hasara, wakulima wanaweza kutumia bidhaa ya kudhibiti kibaiolojia inayoitwa Aflasafe, ambayo hupunguza viwango vya aflatoxin kwa 96-100% hadi viwango salama kwa matumizi, kutoka wakati wa mavuno hadi kuhifadhi hadi chakula kinakula.
Somali: Si loo yareeyo wasakheynta aflatoxin ee lowska dhulka iyo galleyda loona hortago khasaaraha, beeraleydu waxay isticmaali karaan badeecad biocontrol ah oo la yiraahdo Aflasafe, taasoo hoos u dhigta heerka aflatoxin 96-100% ilaa heerar ammaan ah oo la cuno, laga bilaabo goosashada ilaa kaydinta ilaa cuntada la cuno.
Dholuo: Mondo omi joma pidho cham okethre gi aflatoxin e lowo kod kod kodhi, kendo kik gikethgi, jopur nyalo tiyo gi yath mar thieth miluongo ni Aflasafe, ma miyo aflatoxin bedo kama ber kuom 96-100% nyaka chop kama cham nyalo betie, chakre kinde ma gichamoe cham nyaka kinde ma gichamoe chiemo.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service informs fish farmers in Nyeri County of new market linkage opportunities this October.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawafahamisha wakulima wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Oktoba hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku wargalinayaa kalluumeysatada kalluunka ee degmada Nyeri fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur ma pidho rech e County mar Nyeri thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: NPS calls on residents of Nyeri County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: NPS waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga si ay u taageeraan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: NPS okwayo jogweng' Nyeri County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma rito sirkal gik ma timore e alwora mar tong'gi mondo okonygi gi chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne ji.

English: ODPP warns public officers in Kisii County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: ODPP inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Kisii dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: ODPP waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Kisii inay musuqmaasuqa ka qaataan xafiisyada dowladda.
Dholuo: ODPP chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e County mar Kisii kuom kawo asoya e migepe mag oganda.

English: NDMA alerts residents of Kirinyaga County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: NDMA waxay uga digtay dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga kororka kiisaska gaadiidka la xaday waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan mashaariicda booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: NDMA chiwo siem ne ji modak e County mar Kirinyaga e wi medruok mar wach kwalo mtokni kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polis mar oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds citizens in Trans Nzoia County about their rights regarding the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuhusu haki zao kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Horumarinta Barnaamijyada Kenya wuxuu muwaadiniinta degmada Trans Nzoia xusuusinayaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development parone raia mag Trans Nzoia County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo ombudsman.

English: Farmers can now benefit from the government s decision to allow duty free importation of 500 000 metric tonnes of animal feed
Kiswahili: Wakulima sasa wanaweza kufaidika na uamuzi wa serikali wa kuruhusu uingizaji wa tani 500,000 za chakula cha mifugo bila kutozwa ushuru.
Somali: Beeralayda ayaa hadda ka faa'iideysan kara go'aanka dowladda ee ah in la oggolaado in 500 000 ton oo quudin xayawaanka ah laga soo dhoofiyo canshuur la'aan
Dholuo: Jo-Puritan koro nyalo yudo ber kuom yiero mar sirkal mar weyo ni gigol chiemb dhok ma romo ton 500 000 maok ochul chudo

English: E-Citizen urges eligible citizens in Lamu County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wananchi wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Lamu kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Lamu inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo jokanyo mowinjore e County mar Lamu mondo oriwgi e kwedo josiasa.

English: KTDA warns tea farmers in Lamu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaonya wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KTDA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Lamu faafitaanka cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa faragelinta waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: KTDA chiwo siem ne jopur ma loso chai e County mar Lamu kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will be held in Siaya County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Siaya Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo bilaash ah oo ay soo qabanqaabisay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Siaya bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Rapar: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo mitimo gi Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ibiro tim e county mar Siaya e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free measles screening is available at all public health centres in Kisii County this August.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa surua bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kisii Agosti hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka muraayadda ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Kisii bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji ni nonro mar thieth mar midhoho ma onge chudo yudore e ofise duto mag thieth e County mar Kisii e dwe mar Agost.

English: The idea of climate smart agriculture has been centralized in between scientific regulations. CSA has talks with..
Kiswahili: Wazo la kilimo smart imekuwa centralized kati ya kanuni kisayansi.
Somali: Fikradda beeraleyda caqliga leh ee cimilada ayaa lagu dhex daray xeerarka sayniska. CSA waxay wadahadallo la leedahay..
Dholuo: Puonj mar timo pur mariek e bwo chal mar kor lwasi oselokore e kind chike mag sayans.

English: ODPP advises residents of Embu County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: ODPP inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e- Citizen.
Somali: ODPP waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan diiwaangelinta e-citizen.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogweng' Embu County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom websait mar e-Citizen sama gidwaro dhi e e e - Citizen registration.

English: NDMA alerts residents of Nandi County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: NDMA waxay dadka deggan degmada Nandi uga digtay kororka kiisaska xoolaha lagu xado waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: NDMA chiwo siem ne ji modak e county mar Nandi kuom medruok mar weche mag kwalo jamni kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: ODPP reminds the public in Baringo County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this December.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba maoni juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka ni ya kukaribishwa Desemba hii.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Baringo in talooyinka dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: ODPP paronwa ji duto e County mar Baringo ni dwokogi e nonro mar tich mar higa ka higa en gima owinjore ahinya e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka ayaa furaysa codsiyada deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay ardayda u baahan ardayda ku jira Degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Puonjruok ma Chakre e Pinje chako kwayo jopuonjre ma nigi chan e wi tiegruok mag skul e gweng' mar Vihiga.

English: Huduma Kenya warns public officers in Turkana County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Turkana dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Turkana inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e County mar Turkana ni kik giti marach gi migepegi.

English: Kenya Dairy Board urges cattle farmers in Nyeri County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa ngozi wa uvimbe ulioripotiwa.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda lo'da ee degmada Nyeri inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyada oo aan la helin ruqsad ka dib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur mag jamni e County mar Nyeri mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni ka giwuok e county maok giyudo rusa bang' yudo ripode mag tuoche mag dhoot.

English: Notice: NCPB will train farmers in Machakos County on soil conservation this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos juu ya uhifadhi wa udongo Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Machakos ee ku saabsan ilaalinta ciidda bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Rapar: NCPB biro tiego jopur e County ma Machakos e wi rito lowo e dwe mar April.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Uasin Gishu County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan gobolka Uasin Gishu in warbixinta degdegga ah ee xanta xoolaha ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Forest Service parone jogweng' Uasin Gishu County ni ka ng'ato owacho mapiyo ni jamni omako jamni, mano konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Enable 'Find My Device' on phones to track them if lost or stolen.
Kiswahili: Weka "Tazama Kifaa Changu" kwenye simu ili kuzifuatilia ikiwa zimepotea au kuibiwa.
Somali: Awood u yeelo 'Find My Device' taleefanada si aad u raadiso haddii la waayay ama la xaday.
Dholuo: Miye teko mar 'Find My Device' e simo mondo omanygo gik ma olal kata mokwal.

English: KALRO promotes agroforestry among farmers in Embu County as part of the December climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: KALRO inakuza kilimo cha misitu kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Desemba.
Somali: KALRO waxay dhiirrigelisay beeraleyda beeraha ee degmada Embu iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka iska caabinta cimilada ee Diseembar.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo yiende mag yiende e kind jopur e county mar Embu kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi e dwe mar Desemba.

English: HELB conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Embu County this March.
Kiswahili: HELB inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Embu Machi hii.
Somali: HELB waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada ee degmada Embu bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: HELB timo romo mar tiegruok mar oganda e dwe mar Mach e kaunti mar Embu.

English: ODPP encourages first-time voters in Tana River County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Tana River kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Tana River inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo josiasa ma ne okwongo yiero e taon mar Tana River County mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng'no mar yiero.

English: Notice: IPOA activates an emergency response plan for landslides in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ka dhan ah dhulgariirada gobolka Kisii.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA chako tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony e masiche mag yiengni mag piny e gweng' mar Kisii.

English: NCPB advises maize producers in Kericho County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inashauri wazalishaji wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: NCPB waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha hadhuudhka ee degmada Kericho inay ka iibsadaan wax soo saarka kaliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: NCPB nyiso jopur mag mahinya e County mar Kericho ni gius chiembgi mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo mach kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Office of the Auditor-General encourages first-time voters in Tana River County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Wilaya ya Tana River kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa codbixiyayaasha ugu horreeya ee degmada Tana River inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Jorit Maduong' jiwo jogo matimoga yiero mokwongo e taon mar Tana River County mondo onon weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Mombasa County about the importance of food safety for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhusu umuhimu wa usalama wa chakula kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMSA waxay dadka degmada Mombasa ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda badbaadada cuntada ay u leedahay caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone ji duto e county mar Mombasa gimomiyo rito chiemo en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response launches an October awareness campaign on tobacco control across Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Oktoba juu ya udhibiti wa tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay bilaabeysaa olole wacyi galineed bishii Oktoobar ee ka dhanka ah xakamaynta sigaarka ee degmada Kiambu.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Oktoba e wi thieth mar ndawa e County duto mar Kiambu.

English: HELB reminds schools in Homa Bay County to strengthen anti-bullying measures this December.
Kiswahili: HELB inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuimarisha hatua za kupambana na uonevu Desemba hii.
Somali: HELB waxay xusuusineysaa dugsiyada gobolka Homa Bay inay xoojiyaan tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibta bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa skunde mag Homa Bay County mondo omed jiwo yore mag geng'o nindruok e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Ministry of Health urges residents of Bungoma County to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers following a rise in reported Rift Valley Fever cases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska loo maleynayo inay u sheegaan mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaskii lagu soo sheegay ee Cudurka Rift Valley.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health jiwo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo ochiw ripode ne joma ochiwore mar rito ngima mar oganda bang' medruok mar joma nigi Rift Valley Fever.

English: Council of Governors invites residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusu ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku martiqaadaan dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ka qeybgalaan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch ogwelo jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo oriwre kodgi e nono tich ma gitimo higa ka higa kokalo kuom websait mar county.

English: Notice: KUCCPS reminds citizens in Narok County about their rights regarding voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Narok kuhusu haki zao kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Narok ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KUCCPS paronwa raia mag Narok County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar ndiko joma oyiero.

English: Kenya signs six Global Fund grants amounting to Sh59.7 billion to support HIV, TB and malaria interventions; funding to strengthen health and community systems over three years.
Kiswahili: Kenya yasaini ruzuku sita za Mfuko wa Kimataifa zenye thamani ya Sh59.7 bilioni kusaidia uingiliaji kati wa VVU, Kifua Kikuu na malaria; ufadhili wa kuimarisha mifumo ya afya na jamii kwa miaka mitatu.
Somali: Kenya waxay saxiixday lix deeq oo ka timid Sanduuqa Caalamiga ah oo dhan Sh59.7 bilyan si ay u taageerto talaabooyinka HIV, TB iyo malaria; maalgelinta si loo xoojiyo nidaamyada caafimaadka iyo bulshada muddo saddex sano ah.
Dholuo: Kenya oseyie gi chiwo auchiel mag Global Fund ma romo Sh59.7 bilion mondo okony e tieko tuoche mag HIV, TB kod malaria; pesa mar tego chenro mag thieth kod oganda kuom higini adek.

English: FAO encourages farmers in Lamu County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for fish.
Kiswahili: FAO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora ya samaki.
Somali: FAO waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Lamu inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo kalluunka ah.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e county mar Lamu mondo ous olemo mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo rech mondo omi rech obed gi nengo maber.

English: Notice: EACC opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Wananchi katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogaysiis: EACC waxay furaysaa goob adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-muwaadiniinta ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: EACC oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag kwayo ji mondo obed raia e Taita-Taveta County.

English: Learn how corruption affects services and educate your community to prevent it
Kiswahili: Jifunze jinsi ufisadi unavyoathiri huduma na ufundishe jumuiya yako kuizuia
Somali: Baro sida musuqmaasuqa u saameynayo adeegyada iyo barta bulshadaada si looga hortago
Dholuo: Puonjri kaka mibadhi chiko tije mag sirkal, kendo ikony joma odak e alworau mondo kik gitim kamano

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds residents of Busia County that agroforestry improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kwamba kilimo cha misitu kinaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia in kaynta beeraha ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jogweng' mar County mar Busia ni agroforestry kelo dongruok e pidho puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: KEMRI encourages mothers in Makueni County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Makueni kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Makueni inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo mine man Makueni County mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Mandera County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Mandera: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Mei 2023
Somali: Degmada Mandheera: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Mandera: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar abich higa mar 2023

English: COMESA urges dairy cows farmers in Kajiado County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported rabies cases.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya kichaa cha mbwa vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Kajiado inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyada oo aan la helin ruqsad ka dib kiisaska xanaaqa la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: COMESA ojiwo jopur mag dhok mag chak e Kajiado County mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni e tong county maok giyudo rusa bang' yudo weche mag rabies.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka ayaa ku dhawaaqday taariikhaha diiwaangelinta waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada gobolka Nyamira.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Puonjruok ma Chakre e Piny owacho, olando tarik ma nyithindo nyalo donjoe e skul mag Nyamira County maonge chudo.

English: Parents should register the birth of their child at the nearest civil registration office. A birth certificate secures a childÂ’s legal identity and access to services.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanapaswa kusajili kuzaliwa kwa mtoto wao katika ofisi ya usajili wa kiraia iliyo karibu. Cheti cha kuzaliwa huhakikisha utambulisho wa kisheria wa mtoto na upatikanaji wa huduma.
Somali: Waalidiintu waa inay dhalashada ilmahooda ka diiwaan geliyaan xafiiska diiwaangelinta madaniga ah ee ugu dhow. Shahaadada dhalashada waxay xaqiijinaysaa aqoonsiga sharciga ah ee ilmaha iyo helitaanka adeegyada.
Dholuo: Jonyuol onego ondiki nyuol mar nyathigi e ofis man machiegni ahinya mar ndiko nying’ nyathigi. Oboke mar nyuol miyo nyathi bedo gi ng’eyo mar chik kendo yudo kony.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response urges residents of Bomet County to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers following a rise in reported malaria cases.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya malaria vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska laga shakiyo mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaskii la soo sheegay ee malaria.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo jogweng' County mar Bomet mondo onyis jorit malony mag thieth mar oganda ni giparo ni gin gi tuoche mag malaria bang' ka kwan mar joma nigi malaria osemedore.

English: NTSA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Taita-Taveta County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NTSA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa qofkasta oo la kulma xadgudubka Gobolka Taita-Taveta inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e Taita-Taveta County mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: KTDA invites farmers in Embu County to a free training on modern irrigation techniques this July.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji Julai hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Embu tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: KTDA ogwelo jopur e county mar Embu e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi yore mag lero pi e dwe mar Julai.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges parents and teachers in West Pokot County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu ku boorinayaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada West Pokot inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e West Pokot County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) launches an August awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Wajir County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Agosti juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa bilaabay olole wacyi galineed bishii Agoosto oo ku saabsan wacyiga cadaadiska sare ee gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Agost e wi wach ng'eyo ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar hypertension e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: NPS urges the community in Makueni County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb burglary.
Kiswahili: NPS inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Makueni inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo oganda manie Makueni County mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo kik gikwed nek.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission reminds citizens in Laikipia County about their rights regarding the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuhusu haki zao kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu muwaadiniinta degmada Laikipia xusuusinayaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj parone raia e County mar Laikipia kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo ombudsman.

English: Kenya Dairy Board urges wheat growers in Nakuru County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawasihi wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kudhibiti wizi wa kijeshi wa kuanguka mapema kwa kutumia dawa za kuua wadudu zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda sarreenka ee gobolka Nakuru in ay horumariyaan weerarkii ciidammada ee dayrta iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaanka la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur mag ngano e gweng ' mar Nakuru County mondo oti gi yedhe mamero molos chon mondo okonygi loyo chwanyruok mar armyworm ka gitiyo gi gik makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok.

English: Notice: ODPP opens the electoral calendar centres in Mandera County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Mandera Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay furaysaa xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee degmada Mandera bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: ODPP chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e kaunti mar Mandera e dwe mar Februar.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds residents of Kajiado County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kajiado County kwamba upatikanaji wa usajili wa e-Citizen sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado in helitaanka diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone jogweng' Kajiado County ni koro nyalo bedo mayot donjo e e-Citizen registration kokalo kuom chenro mag sirkal.

English: Notice: KRA opens voter registration centres in Narok County this December.
Kiswahili: KRA inafungua vituo vya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Narok Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay dib u furaysaa xarumaha diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha degmada Narok bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KRA biro yawo kuonde ma ji dhiyoe ne joma oyiero yiero e kaunti mar Narok e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Taita Taveta County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for December 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Taita Taveta: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Desemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Taita Taveta: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Diseembar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Taita Taveta: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2022

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Murang'a County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja wa kaunti.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca bogga shabakadda degmada si ay uga warqabtaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng'o mag County mar Murang'a mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mar dongruok e county.

English: Leaving the child alone even for a short time, a child can fall down and sustain injuries
Kiswahili: Mtoto akiachwa peke yake hata kwa muda mfupi, anaweza kuanguka na kujeruhiwa
Somali: Haddii ilmaha kaligiis la tago xitaa in yar, ilmaha ayaa dhici kara oo dhaawac u geysan kara
Dholuo: Ka ng'ato oweyo nyathine kende kata mana kuom kinde matin, onyalo podho kendo hinyore

English: State Department for TVET urges parents and teachers in Tharaka-Nithi County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Tharaka-Nithi ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State for TVET jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto.

English: The National Biosafety Authority will host its 13th Annual Biosafety Conference in two and a half weeks to discuss GMOs and biotechnology safety All stakeholders are encouraged to participate
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kitaifa ya Usalama wa viumbe itakuwa mwenyeji wa Mkutano wake wa 13 wa Mwaka wa Usalama wa Kihai katika muda wa wiki mbili na nusu ili kujadili GMO na usalama wa teknolojia ya kibayoteknolojia Wadau wote wanahimizwa kushiriki.
Somali: Hay'adda Qaranka ee Badbaadada Bayoolojiga ayaa martigelin doonta Shirweynaheeda 13-aad ee Sanadlaha ah ee Biosafety laba toddobaad iyo badh gudahood si looga hadlo GMO-yada iyo badbaadada bayoteknoolajiyada. Dhammaan daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan
Dholuo: National Biosafety Authority biro bedo jakanyo mar romo mar 13 mar Biosafety Conference e jumbe ariyo gi nus mabiro wuoyo kuom GMO kod weche mag biotechnology

English: Notice: CDC confirms a Rift Valley Fever outbreak alert for Lamu County. Residents are advised to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ilani: CDC inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa kwa Kaunti ya Lamu. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: CDC waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ku saabsan cudurka Rift Valley Fever ee Gobolka Lamu. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha ee wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuoche mar Rift Valley Fever, riwo ji mondo otang' gi pi mochido.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Trans Nzoia County that access to post-violence medical care is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu zinapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Trans Nzoia in helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ka dib rabshad ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia ni ginyalo yudo kony mar thieth maonge chudo.

English: Notice: KMTC reminds citizens in Mandera County about their rights regarding voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuhusu haki zao kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Mandera xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC paronwa raia mag Mandera County e wi ratiro ma gin-go mar ndiko joma oyiero.

English: Notice: IPOA opens a gender desk offering free legal aid in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisheria bure katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah gobolka Nandi.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony ma onge chudo e koth Nandi.

English: Announcement that MoH and SUNCSA coalition will launch public health campaign integrating sanitation and nutrition messaging.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwamba muungano wa Wizara ya Afya na SUNCSA utazindua kampeni ya afya ya umma inayojumuisha ujumbe wa usafi na lishe.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqista in isbahaysiga Wasaaradda Caafimaadka iyo SUNCSA ay bilaabi doonaan olole caafimaad dadweyne oo isku dhafan oo ku saabsan fariimaha nadaafadda iyo nafaqada.
Dholuo: Onyiso ni MoH kod riwruok mar SUNCSA biro chako kampen mar thieth mar oganda ma riwo ote mag ler kod chiemo.

English: OGP urges residents of Samburu County to attend the public participation forum to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Samburu inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si ay u qaabeeyaan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Samburu mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar loso chenro mar dongruok.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds expectant mothers in Tana River County that access to nutrition supplementation for infants is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Tana River kwamba upatikanaji wa nyongeza ya lishe kwa watoto wachanga ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Tana River in helitaanka nafaqada cuntada ee dhallaanka ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne mine ma nigi ich e taon mar Tana River County ni thuolo mar yudo chiemo moromo ne nyithindo mayom en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag oganda.

English: Notice: TSC announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ee dugsiyada degmada Nairobi.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TSC olando tarik mag somo e skunde mag Nairobi.

English: Council of Governors urges eligible citizens in Makueni County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linawahimiza raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Makueni kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku boorinayaan muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Makueni inay ka qaybqaataan jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo raia mag Makueni County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar yiero.

English: Notice: KRA launches ward-level service delivery in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inazindua huduma za huduma katika wilaya ya Garissa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay bilaabaysaa bixinta adeegyada heerka qaybta ee Gobolka Garissa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KRA chako chiwo kony e alwora mar Garissa County.

English: Millers must purchase locally grown wheat from farmers at Kshs 5 300 for Grade 1 and Kshs 5 200 for Grade 2 Farmers are encouraged to report any lower offers
Kiswahili: Wasagaji lazima wanunue ngano inayokuzwa nchini kutoka kwa wakulima kwa Kshs 5 300 kwa Daraja la 1 na Kshs 5 200 kwa Daraja la 2 Wakulima wanahimizwa kuripoti matoleo yoyote ya chini.
Somali: Warshadleyda waa inay ka iibsadaan qamadiga maxalliga ah beeraleyda qiimo dhan Kshs 5,300 oo ah Grade 1 iyo Kshs 5,200 ee Grade 2. Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay soo sheegaan dalabyo hoose
Dholuo: Joma loso ngano nyaka ng'iew ngano ma ipidho e alwora margi kuom jopur e nengo mar Kshs 5 300 mar klas 1 kod Kshs 5 200 mar klas 2

English: Kenya Medical Association urges residents of Turkana County to avoid contact with contaminated water sources following a rise in reported cyclosporiasis cases.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya cyclosporiasis vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay ka fogaadaan inay la xiriiraan ilo biyo oo wasakheysan kadib kororka kiisaska cyclosporiasis ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo jogweng' Turkana County mondo kik giriwre gi pi mochido nikech kwan mar joma nigi cyclosporiasis osemedore.

English: AFA reminds residents of Mombasa County that terracing improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba usafirishaji wa mipaka huboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Mombasa in dhulka lagu beerayo uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: AFA paronwa jogweng' mar Mombasa County ni terracing medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Cross border Household Multisector Survey Kenya and Somalia (June, 2025)
Kiswahili: Utafiti wa Sekta Mbalimbali wa Kaya mpakani Kenya na Somalia (Juni, 2025)
Somali: Sahaminta Qoysaska Xuduudaha Ka Gudba Kenya iyo Soomaaliya (Juun, 2025)
Dholuo: Nonro mar Udi mathoth e piny Kenya kod Somalia (Adweche, higa mar 2025)

English: Kenya Gazette reminds residents of Machakos County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba upatikanaji wa utunzaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette parone jogweng'o mag County ma Machakos ni koro yot yudo barua mar nyuol ka gitiyo gi yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Universities Fund reminds youth in Kitui County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.

English: KRA urges residents of Nairobi County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo jogweng' Nairobi County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e loso chenro mag dongruok.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service promotes agroforestry among farmers in Embu County as part of the June climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inakuza kilimo cha misitu kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Juni.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa beeraleyda beeraha ee degmada Embu oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Juun.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service miyo jopur e county mar Embu ong'eyo kaka ginyalo loso yien e dwe mar Jun.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public in Kisumu County that access to subsidised dialysis is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba upatikanaji wa dialysis ya ruzuku sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kisumu in helitaanka dialysis-ka la taageeray ay hadda ka heli karto xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji duto e County mar Kisumu ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mar dialysis e kuonde moyier.

English: HELB reminds youth in Kiambu County that HELB funding is available for tailoring and design training.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada ku nool degmada Kiambu in maalgelinta HELD ay diyaar u tahay tababarka qaabeynta iyo naqshadeynta.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa rowere man Kiambu County ni pesa mag HELP yudore ne tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko.

English: Kenya to release genetically modified mosquitoes to fight malaria
Kiswahili: Kenya kutoa mbu waliobadilishwa vinasaba ili kupambana na malaria
Somali: Kenya ayaa sii dayn doonta cayayaanka lagu beddelay genetically si looga hortago Cudurka Maleriya
Dholuo: Kenya biro gonyo alode molos gi yedhe mamero mondo giked gi malaria

English: Baringo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Baringo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Mei 2023
Somali: Degmada Baringo: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Baringo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar abich 2023

English: DPP urges motorists and pedestrians in Wajir County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DPP anawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka lugta leh ee degmada Wajir inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay adeegsadaan meelaha lugta loo qoondeeyey si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo joidh mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Wajir mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe mondo gikwed hinyruok motudore gi aksident mag ndara.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET opens applications for revision guides for learners in Machakos County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Machakos.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay furaysaa codsiyada hagaha dib-u-eegista ardayda degmada Machakos.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar State Department for TVET oseyawo kwayo mag somo mar somo mar Muma ne jopuonjre manie gweng' mar Machakos.

English: CDC encourages mothers in Mandera County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Mandera kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Mandera inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo mine man Mandera County mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on the community in West Pokot County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwa ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqayaa bulshada degmada West Pokot County inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan oo ay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service kwayo ji duto manie West Pokot County mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gichiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Reprieve for girls as school gets water storage facilities
Kiswahili: Ahueni kwa wasichana kwani shule inapata vifaa vya kuhifadhia maji
Somali: Gabdhaha oo u nasta maadaama iskuulku uu helayo xarumo lagu kaydiyo biyaha
Dholuo: Owe ne nyiri kaka skul yudo kuonde mag kano pi

English: Notice: e-Citizen launches county development projects in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya wilaya katika Wilaya ya Isiolo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: e-Citizen waxay bilawday mashaariic horumarineed oo ka socda degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni e-Citizen chako timo dongruok e kaunti mar Isiolo.

English: Attention women in the livestock trade Seek financial literacy training and customized advisory services to improve access to credit and resources Expand your business and overcome gender based barriers
Kiswahili: Wanawake makini katika biashara ya mifugo Tafuta mafunzo ya ujuzi wa kifedha na huduma za ushauri zilizoboreshwa ili kuboresha upatikanaji wa mikopo na rasilimali Panua biashara yako na kuondokana na vikwazo vya kijinsia.
Somali: Digniin dumarka ku jira ganacsiga xoolaha Raadi tababarka akhriska maaliyadeed iyo adeegyo talo-bixin gaar ah si loo hagaajiyo helitaanka amaahda iyo kheyraadka Ballaarin ganacsigaaga oo ka gudub caqabadaha ku saleysan jinsiga
Dholuo: Ji mang'eny ma tiyo gi dhok e tij rito dhok, onego otim kinda mondo ging'e weche pesa kendo gibed gi lony e weche mag pesa, kendo mondo gikonygi yudo pesa momedore.

English: FAO advises maize producers in Laikipia County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: FAO inashauri wazalishaji wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: FAO waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha hadhuudhka ee degmada Laikipia inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: FAO nyiso jopur mag cham e County mar Laikipia mondo oti gi nengo mar piny mosingi kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: COMESA urges maize growers in Lamu County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawataka wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Lamu kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee gobolka Lamu inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagyada si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda si loo hagaajiyo goosashada xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur ma pidho cham e gweng' mar Lamu mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: KEMSA encourages mothers in Kakamega County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kakamega inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo mine e Kaunti mar Kakamega mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Marsabit County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Marsabit in helitaanka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa mine ma biro bedo gi ich e county mar Marsabit ni thuolo mar yudo puonj mag chenro mag ngima joot en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag sirkal.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the community in Machakos County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb carjacking.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua ili kuzuia utekaji nyara wa gari.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Machakos inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha si loo xakameeyo afduubka gawaarida.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto manie gweng' mar Machakos mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo kik gikwed kwalo mtokni.

English: TVET announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in Kilifi County this November.
Kiswahili: TVET inatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika shule za Kaunti ya Kilifi Novemba hii.
Somali: TVET waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta deeqaha waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan dugsiyada degmada Kilifi bisha November.
Dholuo: TVET ogolo chiwo mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre man gi chan e skunde man Kilifi County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: FAO informs fish farmers in Turkana County of new market linkage opportunities this July.
Kiswahili: FAO inawafahamisha wakulima wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Turkana juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Julai hii.
Somali: FAO waxay ku wargelineysaa kalluumeysatada kalluunka ee degmada Turkana fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: FAO nyiso jopur ma pidho rech e county mar Turkana thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kitui County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kitui: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2023
Somali: Degmada Kitui: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kitui: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Septemba 2023

English: EACC updates residents of Wajir County on progress of ward-level service delivery this November.
Kiswahili: EACC inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir juu ya maendeleo ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya mwezi huu wa Novemba.
Somali: EACC waxay cusbooneysiineysaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir ku saabsan horumarka bixinta adeegyada heerka degmada bisha Nofeembar.
Dholuo: EACC osemiyo jodak e County mar Wajir ng'eyo dongruok mar tij chiwo kony e wi ward e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Huduma Kenya urges eligible citizens in Kisii County to participate in polling procedures.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Kisii kushiriki katika utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kisii inay ka qeyb galaan nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo raia mag Kisii County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag yiero.

English: Kenyan women lead peace efforts in longstanding conflicts
Kiswahili: Wanawake wa Kenya wanaongoza juhudi za amani katika migogoro ya muda mrefu
Somali: Haweenka Kenya ayaa hormuud ka ah dadaallada nabadda ee khilaafaadka muddada dheer soo jiitamayay
Dholuo: Mon jo Kenya otelo ne lwenje mag kelo kwe e lwenje mosebedo kuom kinde malach

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku dhawaaqay taariikhda diiwaangelinta bilaashka ah ee waxbarashada hoose ee dugsiyada Gobolka Kwale.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development olando tarik mag somo ma onge chudo e skul mag Kwale County.

English: Notice: ODPP opens polling procedures centres in Kericho County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Kericho Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay furaysaa xarumaha nidaamyada codbixinta ee degmada Kericho bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: ODPP chako tiyo gi kuonde ma itimoe yiero e County mar Kericho e dwe mar Mei.

English: WHAT is the state of acute malnutrition in Marsabit and Isiolo Counties, and WHO is at risk?
Kiswahili: JE, hali ya utapiamlo ikoje katika Kaunti za Marsabit na Isiolo, na WHO iko hatarini?
Somali: Waa sidee xaaladda nafaqo-xumada ba'an ee ka jirta degmooyinka Marsabit iyo Isiolo, iyo cidda halis ugu jirta?
Dholuo: EN ANG’O ma nyalo miyo ng’ato obed gi chiemo ma ok oromo e alwora mar Marsabit kod Isiolo, to ng’ano ma ni e arita?

English: KALRO urges beans growers in Kajiado County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Kajiado inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo miraha ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KALRO ojiwo jopur molony e Kajiado County mondo otim lokruok e puothe mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber kendo mondo omed nyak maber e higani.

English: KNEC invites youth in Homa Bay County to enroll for motor vehicle mechanics training this September.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari Septemba hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada gobolka Homa Bay inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka mashiinka gawaarida ee bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KNEC gwelo rowere manie Homa Bay County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar jomisonari mag mtokni e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds residents of Kisii County that access to national ID applications is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba kufikia maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii in helitaanka codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General parone jogweng' mar Kisii County ni koro yot yudo kwayo mag ID e piny mangima kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces NHIF/SHA claims support for residents of Garissa County starting this September.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatangaza NHIF/SHA inadai msaada kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kuanzia Septemba hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taageerada sheegashada NHIF / SHA ee dadka deggan Gobolka Garissa laga bilaabo Sebtember.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche lando ni NHIF/SHA biro chiwo kony ne joma odak e County mar Garissa kochakore Septemba.

English: Ministry of ICT organizes nationwide ICT week with focus on education technology innovations and digital skills training.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya ICT inaandaa wiki ya ICT kote nchini kwa kuzingatia ubunifu wa teknolojia ya elimu na mafunzo ya ujuzi wa dijiti.
Somali: Wasaaradda ICT waxay qabanqaabisaa toddobaadka ICT ee dalka oo dhan iyada oo diiradda la saarayo hal-abuurnimada tikniyoolajiyadda waxbarashada iyo tababarka xirfadaha dhijitaalka ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of ICT ochano juma mar ICT e piny mangima ka oketo pachgi ahinya kuom dongruok e teknoloji mag somo kod tiegruok e weche mag digital skills.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Bungoma County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi diiwaangelinta beeraleyda loogu talagalay beeralayda degmada Bungoma bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro timo rapar mar jopur e dwe mar Desemba e kaunti mar Bungoma.

English: Achieve maize yields of over 50 bags per acre by using certified seeds adjusting spacing and providing adequate nutrition to plants
Kiswahili: Pata mavuno ya mahindi zaidi ya gunia 50 kwa ekari kwa kutumia mbegu zilizothibitishwa kurekebisha nafasi na kutoa lishe ya kutosha kwa mimea.
Somali: Gaadh wax soo saarka galleyda oo ka badan 50 bac halkii acre adigoo isticmaalaya abuur shahaado leh oo la hagaajiyo kala fogaanshaha iyo bixinta nafaqo ku filan dhirta.
Dholuo: Mondo cham mar cham ma romo bag 50 e hekta achiel, oti gi kodhi molony ma oketo tong' e kindgi kendo miyogi chiemo moromo

English: COMESA invites farmers in Kisii County to a free training on post-harvest handling this August.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno Agosti hii.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Kisii tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan maareynta goosashada ka dib bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: COMESA ogwelo jopur e gweng' mar Kisii mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya activates an emergency response plan for landslides in Busia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inaamsha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika Kaunti ya Busia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ka dhan ah dhulgariirada gobolka Busia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chako tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony e masiche mag yiengni mag piny e gweng' mar Busia.

English: KEMRI calls on parents in Turkana County to have children under five screened for cyclosporiasis during the September outreach.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa cyclosporiasis wakati wa mawasiliano ya Septemba.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Turkana in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka cyclosporiasis inta lagu jiro adeegga bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KEMRI okwayo jonyuol e County mar Turkana mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Septemba mondo ging'e ni gin gi tuwo mar cyclosporiasis.
