English: Hit by multiple crises, tens of thousands of Somalis flock to refugee camps in Kenya
Kiswahili: Huku wakikumbwa na migogoro mingi, makumi ya maelfu ya Wasomali wanamiminika kwenye kambi za wakimbizi nchini Kenya
Somali: Kumanaan kun oo Soomaali ah oo ku qulqulaya xeryaha qaxootiga ee Kenya oo ay saameeyeen dhibaatooyin badan
Dholuo: Ka giyudo masira mang’eny, Jo-Somalia gana gi gana apar biro e kambi mag jolweny e piny Kenya

English: CDC launches a June awareness campaign on tobacco control across Turkana County.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Juni juu ya udhibiti wa tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Somali: CDC waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Juun ee ka dhanka ah xakamaynta sigaarka ee degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: CDC chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Jun e wi thieth mar ndawa e County duto mar Turkana.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya activates an emergency response plan for flooding in Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya yaanzisha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ku saabsan fatahaadaha Gobolka Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chako tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne pi e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia.

English: NDMA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Homa Bay County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: NDMA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka gobolka Homa Bay inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo chandruok e Homa Bay County mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195 maonge chudo.

English: Notice: KTDA will distribute certified maize seed to farmers in Meru County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KTDA itasambaza mbegu zilizothibitishwa za mahindi kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru mwezi Mei huu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay abuurka hadhuudhka ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Meru County bisha May ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA biro pogo kodhi mag kodhi mar kodhi ne jopur manie Meru County e dwe mar Mei.

English: Wajir County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Wajir: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Februari 2024
Somali: Degmada Wajeer: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Wajir: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2024

English: FAO encourages farmers in Kisii County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: FAO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya mahindi.
Somali: FAO waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kisii inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay hadhuudhka.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kisii mondo odonj e riwruok mar riwruok ma nigi ratiro mar tiyo gi kodhi mondo giyud nengo maber mar kodhi.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association confirms a typhoid outbreak alert for Murang'a County. Residents are advised to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari Kenya chathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa matumbo katika Kaunti ya Murang'a. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu xaqiijiyay digniin ku saabsan cudurka tifooska ee degmada Murang'a. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Medical Association osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuwo mar typhoid e kaunti mar Murang'a.

English: KEMSA urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Nyamira County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Nyamira inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo ji duto ma chandore gi tuoche mag pachgi e County mar Nyamira mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Notice: KMTC reminds citizens in Kiambu County about their rights regarding the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhusu haki zao kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Kiambu ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC paronwa raia mag Kaunti mar Kiambu e wi ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo ombudsman.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the public in Taita-Taveta County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi umma katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha degmada Taita-Taveta inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada lacagta mobilada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto manie Taita-Taveta County mondo ochiw ripot mar ote mamulo pachgi ne jatendgi bang' yudo ripot mag timbe mag wuondo pesa e simo.

English: FAO advises farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: FAO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo ya bure ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: FAO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kalfadhiga tababarka ee bilaashka ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e tiego jopur mabiro.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds livestock keepers in Trans Nzoia County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa xoolaha xayawaanka ah ee degmada Trans Nzoia inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service oparo ne jorit jamni e Trans Nzoia County ni mondo gimi jamnigi thieth e kuonde moket mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: KUCCPS urges youth in Bungoma County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Bungoma inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada rayidka ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada rayidka ah ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo rowere mag Bungoma County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok ochopo gik ma biro timore e kind oganda.

English: Characteristics of skizofrenia, which brings, symptoms, instruments for testing diseases
Kiswahili: Sifa za skizofrenia, ambazo huleta, dalili, vifaa vya kupima magonjwa
Somali: Tilmaamaha cudurka skizofrenia, kaas oo keena, calaamadaha, qalabka baaritaanka cudurrada
Dholuo: Ranyisi mag skizofrenia, makelo tuoche, tuoche kod ranyisi mag tuoche

English: Strengthening Self-reliance among drought-affected communities in Eastern Africa
Kiswahili: Kuimarisha Kujitegemea miongoni mwa jamii zilizoathiriwa na ukame katika Afrika Mashariki
Somali: Xoojinta Isku-tiirsanaanta Bulshooyinka ay abaartu saameysay ee Bariga Afrika
Dholuo: Keto teko mar rito ng’ato owuon e kind oganda ma oyudo masira mag oro e piny Afrika ma Wuokchieng’

English: Kenya: Heavy Rains and Flooding Update - Flash Update #7 (19 June 2024)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Mvua Kubwa na Taarifa ya Mafuriko - Sasisho la Flash #7 (19 Juni 2024)
Somali: Kenya: Roobab Mahiigaan ah iyo Warbixin Daadad - Cusboonaysiinta Degdegga ah #7 (19 Juun 2024)
Dholuo: Kenya: Koth Mapek kod Pi Opong'o Pi - Oboke Mapiyo #7 (19 Auchiel 2024)

English: Public launch of irrigated crop and fodder production in Naoros, where malnutrition cases among under-fives declined by 41% thanks to integrated agricultural-nutrition interventions.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa umma wa uzalishaji wa mazao ya umwagiliaji na malisho ya mifugo huko Naoros, ambapo visa vya utapiamlo miongoni mwa watoto walio chini ya umri wa miaka mitano vilipungua kwa 41% kutokana na hatua jumuishi za kilimo na lishe.
Somali: Daahfurka dadweynaha ee wax soo saarka dalagyada waraabka iyo calafka ee Naoros, halkaas oo kiisaska nafaqo-darrada ee carruurta da'doodu ka yar tahay shan sano ay hoos u dhaceen 41% iyada oo ay ugu wacan tahay waxqabadyada isku dhafan ee nafaqada beeraha iyo beeraha.
Dholuo: Ochako loso cham ma itiyogo gi pi kod chiemo mag le e piny Naoros, kama kes mag chiemo ma ok oromo e kind nyithindo ma hikgi pok ochopo abich ne dok piny gi 41% nikech ng’ado bura ma oriw mar pur kod chiemo.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds farmers in Kitui County of the ongoing modern irrigation techniques training programme.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya mbinu za umwagiliaji za kisasa.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kitui barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service parone jopur man Kitui County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar yore mag lero pi.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Turkana County about the importance of hypertension awareness for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuhusu umuhimu wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay dadka degmada Turkana ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay wacyiga cadaadiska sare ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji duto e County mar Turkana kuom ber mar bedo gi ng'eyo kuom tuo mar hypertension e ngima joot.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qaybqaataan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur manie Tharaka-Nithi County mondo okel namba mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: IPOA urges residents of Bomet County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika kumbi za umma huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo jogweng' County mar Bomet mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji ng'enyie nikech ji medo keto pachgi kuom chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: Notice: KUCCPS announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Machakos County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Machakos.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta dugsiyada dugsiga dhexe ee Machakos County.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KUCCPS ogolo chenro mar dhi e sekondari e skul mag Machakos County.

English: KALRO advises maize producers in Narok County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wazalishaji wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Narok kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KALRO waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha hadhuudhka ee gobolka Narok inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KALRO nyiso jopur ma loso kodhi e gweng' mar Narok mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mabiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: FAO advises fish producers in Bomet County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: FAO inashauri wazalishaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Bomet kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: FAO waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kalluunka ee degmada Bomet inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: FAO nyiso jopur ma loso rech e county mar Bomet ni gidonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: COMESA invites farmers in Nyandarua County to a free training on fertiliser application this May.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwa mafunzo ya bure juu ya matumizi ya mbolea Mei hii.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda gobolka Nyandarua tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan isticmaalka bacriminta bisha May.
Dholuo: COMESA ogwelo jopur e County mar Nyandarua e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi tiyo gi yien e dwe mar Mei.

English: Courts will continue to handle certificates of urgency and taking plea for serious cases.
Kiswahili: Mahakama zitaendelea kushughulikia vyeti vya dharura na kupokea malalamiko ya kesi kubwa.
Somali: Maxkamaduhu waxay sii wadi doonaan in ay wax ka qabtaan shahaadooyinka xaaladaha degdegga ah iyo in ay ka jawaabaan kiisaska culus.
Dholuo: Kot biro dhi nyime tiyo gi weche manyiso ni gik moko timore mapiyo kendo biro kawo okang' mar ng'ado bura e weche madongo.

English: COMESA reminds residents of Nyandarua County that conservation tillage improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba kilimo cha uhifadhi kinaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba la muda mrefu.
Somali: COMESA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Nyandarua in beerashada ilaalinta ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: COMESA oparo ne jogweng' Nyandarua County ni chwoyo puothe e yor ritruok medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: NTSA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kakamega County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NTSA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kutafuta msaada katika nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Kakamega inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e Kaunti mar Kakamega mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Identifying and measuring the effectiveness of socio-technical innovation bundles on empowerment and resilience in Kenya: A baseline report
Kiswahili: Kutambua na kupima ufanisi wa vifurushi vya uvumbuzi wa kijamii na kiufundi juu ya uwezeshaji na ustahimilivu nchini Kenya: Ripoti ya msingi.
Somali: Aqoonsiga iyo cabbiraadda waxtarka xirmooyinka hal-abuurka bulsho-farsamo ee ku saabsan awoodsiinta iyo adkeysiga Kenya: Warbixin aasaasi ah
Dholuo: Ng’eyo kendo pim ber mar loso gik manyien mag teknoloji e weche mag miyo ji teko kendo bedo gi chir e piny Kenya: Ripot mar chakruok

English: AidEx Nairobi 2024 conference and exhibition opens on June 12
Kiswahili: Kongamano na maonyesho ya AidEx Nairobi 2024 yatafunguliwa Juni 12
Somali: Shir iyo bandhig ka dhacaya Nairobi 2024 oo furmaya Juun 12
Dholuo: Chokruok kod nyiso mar AidEx Nairobi higa mar 2024 oyabere tarik 12 dwe mar auchiel

English: Notice: NDMA activates an emergency response plan for landslides in Turkana County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ka dhan ah dhulgariirada degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne yiengni mag lowo e County mar Turkana.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General opens voter education centres in Nairobi County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud ayaa bilaabaya xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee Gobolka Nairobi bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Auditor General oseyawo kuonde tiego josiasa e Nairobi County e dwe mar Mach.

English: KEMSA launches an October awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Oktoba juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Somali: KEMSA waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Oktoobar oo ku saabsan baaritaanka sonkorowga ee degmada Marsabit.
Dholuo: KEMSA chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Oktoba e wi nonro mar thieth mar sukari e alwora mar Marsabit County.

English: KTDA invites farmers in Mombasa County to a free training on pest and disease management this May.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya udhibiti wa wadudu na magonjwa Mei hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda gobolka Mombasa tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan xakamaynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada bisha May.
Dholuo: KTDA ogwelo jopur e county mar Mombasa e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar tuoche kod tuoche e dwe mar Mei.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges farmers in Mandera County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa ku boorinaya beeraleyda gobolka Mandera inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddelada roobabka roobka.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Mandera mondo opidh olembe mondo omi piny okethre mondo omi giritre kuom lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds expectant mothers in Bungoma County that access to nutrition supplementation for infants is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba upatikanaji wa nyongeza ya lishe kwa watoto wachanga ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Bungoma in helitaanka cuntada lagu daro dhallaanka ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Bungoma ni yudo chiemo moromo ne nyithindo mayom en gima onge chudo e ute duto.

English: SHA urges residents of Uasin Gishu County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga lagu soo gabagabeeyay si loo qaabeeyo wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jogweng' Uasin Gishu County mondo ochiw paro mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso chenro mag chenro mag sirkal.

English: COMESA encourages farmers in Meru County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for tea.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kupata bei bora ya chai.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Meru inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan shaaha.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e county mar Meru mondo oti gi nengo mar chamo chai e yo maber moloyo.

English: IPOA urges motorists and pedestrians in Kirinyaga County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Kirinyaga inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada ay fatahan yihiin si looga hortago dhacdooyinka abaarta la xiriira.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo joidh mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Kirinyaga mondo kik ging'ad ponde kod aoche ma pi opong'o mondo kik gitim gik makelo kech.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will open a milk collection centre in Kwale County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itafungua kituo cha kukusanya maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kwale Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay bilaabi doontaa xarun ururinta caanaha ee Gobolka Kwale bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro yawo kambi mar choko chak e county mar Kwale e dwe mar Julai.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises fish producers in West Pokot County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inashauri wazalishaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu kula talinayaa soo saarayaasha kalluunka ee degmada West Pokot inay ka soo qeybgalaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur ma loso rech e West Pokot County mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mabiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Turkana County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Wananchi katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu furayaa goob adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta muwaadiniinta elektaroonigga ah ee degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag e-Citizen registration e County mar Turkana.

Somali: Dadweynaha waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan gudbinta macluumaad aan la xaqiijin oo ku jira baraha bulshada. Wixii su'aalo ah ee la xiriira COVID-19, fadlan wac Wasaaradda Caafimaadka taleefannada soo socda: 0800721316, 0732353535, 0729471414. x.com/DanielN6184157 â€¦

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds farmers in Taita-Taveta County of the ongoing greenhouse farming training programme.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kilimo cha chafu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Taita-Taveta barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development oparo ne jopur manie Taita-Taveta County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar timo pur.

English: TSC invites youth in Kilifi County to enroll for electrical installation training this October.
Kiswahili: TSC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Oktoba hii.
Somali: TSC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kilifi inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: TSC gwelo rowere e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo odonj e tiegruok mar keto sitima e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges goats farmers in Nyandarua County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawataka wafugaji wa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa Newcastle vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda orgiga ee gobolka Nyandarua inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha gobolka iyada oo aan la helin ruqsad ka dib kiisaska cudurka Newcastle ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur mag diek e County mar Nyandarua mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni e alwora mar county ka ok giyudo rusa bang' yudo kit tuoche mag Newcastle.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Kwale County to prepare for possible drought this April.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kujiandaa kwa ukame unaowezekana Aprili hii.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ka digaya dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay isu diyaariyaan abaaraha iman kara bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations osiemo jogweng' mar Kwale County mondo oikre ne oro ma nyalo bedoe e dwe mar April.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds residents of Kilifi County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi kwamba upatikanaji wa usajili wa e-Citizen sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi in helitaanka diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone jogweng' Kilifi County ni koro nyalo bedo mayot donjo e e-Citizen registration ka gitiyo gi yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges dairy cows farmers in Kajiado County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported foot and mouth disease cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: Guddiga xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Kajiado inay ka fogaadaan in xoolaha lagu guuro xadka degmada iyada oo aan la helin ruqsad ka dib kiisaska cudurka afka iyo afka la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur mag dhok e Kajiado County mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni e alwora mar county ka ok giyudo rusa bang' yudo tuoche mag dhoot.

English: State Department for Basic Education advises applicants in Kisii County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Kisii kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Kisii inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State for Basic Education nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Kisii ni mondo gidonj e tiegruok kapok iketho skundno.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds residents of Vihiga County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga wanaohudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaanka xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga ee ka qeybgalaya kalfadhiga guud ee shirka degmada ayaa xoojinaya maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties paronwa jogweng' mar County mar Vihiga ma biro e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly jiwo sirkal.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges motorists and pedestrians in Bungoma County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Bungoma inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada daadadka ku dhacay si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo joidh mtoka kod jowuoth e County mar Bungoma mondo kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o mondo kik yud masiche makelo ataro.

English: NPS calls on the community in Nyandarua County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatia moyo jamii katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuongea dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: NPS waxay bulshada degmada Nyandarua ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: NPS okwayo ji duto manie County mar Nyandarua mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gichiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: KMTC reminds parents in Samburu County that adult literacy classes registration is open this October.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba usajili wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima umefunguliwa Oktoba hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta gobolka Samburu in diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ay furan tahay bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KMTC oparo ne jonyuol e county mar Samburu ni ikruok mar somo kod somo ne joma dongo osechakore e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: ODPP urges residents of Kisumu County to attend the public participation forum to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay ka qayb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si loo qaabeeyo dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kisumu mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar timo nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: KUCCPS announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Embu County this March.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Embu Machi hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta waxyaabaha barashada digitalka ah ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Embu bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: KUCCPS ogolo chenro mar pogo buge mag digital maonge chudo e skunde mag Embu County e dwe mar Mach.

English: Its not unmanly to struggle.Check on the men in your life.
Kiswahili: Si jambo la kiume kujitahidi. Waangalie wanaume katika maisha yako.
Somali: Ma aha wax aan ragga ahayn in la dagaallamo. Fiiri ragga noloshaada ku jira.
Dholuo: Ok en gima rach mondo ng'ato oked. Non ane chwo manie ngimani.

English: NTSA warns residents of Nandi County to prepare for possible drought this October.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kujiandaa kwa ukame unaowezekana Oktoba hii.
Somali: NTSA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan gobolka Nandi inay u diyaargaroobaan abaaraha iman kara bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: NTSA osiemo jogweng' kaunti mar Nandi mondo oikre ne oro ma nyalo betie e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: This is attributed to various challenges, among them ; increase in tax incentives, low tax compliance, continued effects of COVID -19 pandemic, growth of the informal sector and increased use of technology in contemporary business models, both of which are difficult to tax.
Kiswahili: Hii inachangiwa na changamoto mbalimbali, miongoni mwao; ongezeko la vivutio vya kodi, uzingatiaji mdogo wa kodi, kuendelea kwa athari za janga la COVID-19, ukuaji wa sekta isiyo rasmi na kuongezeka kwa matumizi ya teknolojia katika miundo ya kisasa ya biashara, ambayo ni vigumu kutozwa kodi.
Somali: Tan waxaa loo aaneynayaa caqabado kala duwan, oo ay ka mid yihiin; kororka dhiirigelinta canshuuraha, u hoggaansanaanta canshuurta oo hooseysa, saameynta sii socota ee masiibada COVID-19, kobaca qaybta aan rasmiga ahayn iyo isticmaalka tiknoolajiyada oo kordhay ee moodooyinka ganacsiga casriga ah, kuwaas oo labaduba ay adag tahay in la canshuuro.
Dholuo: Mano ochung’ne pek mopogore opogore, moko kuomgi ; medo kwan mar jiwo osuru, luwo osuru matin, dhi nyime gi gik ma kelo tuwo mar COVID -19, dongruok mar sektor ma ok owinjore kod medo tiyo kod teknoloji e yore mag ohala ma sani, ma gin gik ma tek chulo osuru.

English: KTDA warns sorghum farmers in Nakuru County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Nakuru juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza uingiliaji kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KTDA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda sorghum ee degmada Nakuru faafitaanka cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa faragelinta waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: KTDA chiwo siem ne jopur mag sorghum e gweng' mar Nakuru kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Notice: FAO will train farmers in Nyeri County on organic farming this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri juu ya kilimo hai Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Nyeri ee beeraha dabiiciga ah bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: FAO biro tiego jopur e County mar Nyeri e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Promote fodder conservation by constructing hay storage facilities and prepositioning silage-baling machines.
Kiswahili: Kukuza uhifadhi wa lishe kwa kujenga vifaa vya kuhifadhi nyasi na kuweka mapema mashine za silage-baling.
Somali: Kor u qaad ilaalinta cunto xamaasadda iyadoo la dhisayo xarumo kaydinta cawska iyo mashiinnada silage-baling-ka hore loo dhigay.
Dholuo: Jiw ritruok mar chiemo kuom gero kuonde ma kano cham kendo keto masin mag choko chiemo.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will distribute certified maize seed to farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu za mahindi zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu abuuraha Degmada Tharaka-Nithi u qaybin doonaa abuurka hadhuudhka ee la caddeeyay bisha Nofeembar ee sannadkan.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro pogo kodhi mag kodhi ne jopur e Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: KTDA will conduct a greenhouse farming workshop for farmers in Kiambu County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itaendesha warsha ya kilimo cha chafu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo ee beeraleyda degmada Kiambu bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA biro timo chokruok mar timo tijno ne jopur e gweng' mar Kiambu e dwe mar April.

English: Rwanda's experience highlights the importance of collaboration in building stronger surveillance systems.
Kiswahili: Uzoefu wa Rwanda unaonyesha umuhimu wa ushirikiano katika kujenga mifumo imara ya ufuatiliaji.
Somali: Waayo-aragnimada Rwanda waxay iftiiminaysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay iskaashiga dhismaha nidaamyada dabagalka ee xooggan.
Dholuo: Gima otimore e piny Rwanda nyiso ber mar tiyo kanyakla e gero sistem motegno mag rang'iny mar piny.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Siaya County about the importance of diabetes screening for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuhusu umuhimu wa uchunguzi wa kisukari kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Siaya muhiimadda ay leedahay baaritaanka sonkorowga ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji duto e County mar Siaya kuom gimomiyo thieth mar thieth mag ndhoga en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: KEMSA encourages residents of West Pokot County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay la xiriiraan lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giwuo gi jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Mekaela built a digital studio for online learning called Shule Pepe.
Kiswahili: Mekaela alijenga studio ya digital ya kujifunza mtandaoni inayoitwa Shule Pepe.
Somali: Mekaela waxay dhistay studio digital ah oo loogu talagalay barashada internetka oo lagu magacaabo Shule Pepe.
Dholuo: Mekaela nogero studio mar somo e intanet miluongo ni Shule Pepe.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds the public in Turkana County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu dadka degmada Turkana ku xasuusinayaa inay ka feejignaadaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service parone ji duto e County mar Turkana ni mondo gibed motang' ne loso kuwe e piny.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds mobile money users in Mandera County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Mandera inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado khiyaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e county mar Mandera ni mondo ging'e kwayo mag pesa kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo gitang' gi wuond mag SIM-swap.

English: Good feeds management on livestock is vital. Tips on feeds, manure and nutritious feeds is important.
Kiswahili: Usimamizi mzuri wa malisho kwa mifugo ni muhimu. Vidokezo juu ya malisho, mbolea na malisho ya lishe ni muhimu.
Somali: Maareynta saxda ah ee quudinta xoolaha waa mid muhiim ah. Talooyinka quudinta, bacriminta iyo quudinta nafaqada leh waa muhiim.
Dholuo: Puonj ma yudore e Muma ma nyiso ni ng'ato onego obed gi chiemb chuny maber, nyalo konyo ahinya e rito chiemb chuny, kod chiemb chuny.

English: Strategy for Swedenâ€™s development cooperation with Kenya 2021â€“2025
Kiswahili: Mkakati wa ushirikiano wa maendeleo wa Uswidi na Kenya 2021-2025
Somali: Istaraatiijiyadda iskaashiga horumarinta ee Sweden la leedahay Kenya 2021-2025
Dholuo: Yor riwruok mar piny Sweden mar dongruok gi piny Kenya higa mar 2021 nyaka 2025

English: Farmers in Eastern Africa are urged to adopt resilient agricultural practices to combat the ongoing food crises as over 27 million people face acute food insecurity in the region
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Afrika Mashariki wamehimizwa kufuata mazoea ya kilimo ili kukabiliana na janga la chakula kwani zaidi ya watu milioni 27 wanakabiliwa na uhaba mkubwa wa chakula katika eneo hilo.
Somali: Beeraleyda Bariga Afrika waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyay inay qaataan habab beereed oo adkaysi leh si ay ula dagaallamaan dhibaatooyinka cuntada ee socda maadaama in ka badan 27 milyan oo qof ay la kulmayaan cunto la'aan daran gobolka.
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma wuok e pinje mag Afrika ma Ugwe, jiwo ahinya mondo oti gi yore mag pur ma nigi teko e kedo gi chandruoge mag chiemo ma sani timore nikech ji mokalo milion 27 romo gi pek mar chiemo e alworano

English: IEBC invites residents of Migori County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Migori kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandaoni ya wilaya kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Migori inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: IEBC gwelo jogweng' Migori County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e wi chenro mag dongruok.

English: Kenya Dairy Board encourages farmers in Kakamega County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora ya mahindi.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kakamega inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay hadhuudhka.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur e Kaunti mar Kakamega mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar kodhi.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development informs avocado farmers in Vihiga County of new market linkage opportunities this February.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inafahamisha wakulima wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Februari hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay uga warrameysaa beeraleyda avocado ee degmada Vihiga fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development nyiso jopur mag avocado e County mar Vihiga kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens polling procedures centres in Bomet County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Bomet Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu furayaa xarumaha nidaamyada codbixinta ee Gobolka Bomet bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties ochako chenro mar timo yiero e taon mar Bomet e dwe mar Jun.

English: Banana poultry breeders in Kenya are facing significant losses due to cheap day old chick imports Stakeholders are urged to assess their operations and adapt accordingly
Kiswahili: Wafugaji wa kuku wa ndizi nchini Kenya wanakabiliwa na hasara kubwa kutokana na uagizaji wa vifaranga kwa bei nafuu Wadau waombwa kutathmini shughuli zao na kuzoea ipasavyo.
Somali: Beeraleyda digaagga ee banana ee Kenya ayaa la kulmaya khasaaro weyn sababtoo ah soo dejinta digaagga da'da yar ee maalmaha ka mid ah ee la soo saaray
Dholuo: Jochiwo mag udi ma pidho udi e piny Kenya yudo lit mang'eny nikech ohala ma pinyno kelo e pinje mamoko mag pinje ma ne gipidhogi gi chamo chiek ma ne ok nyal nyiewo ahinya

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds the public in Kwale County to remain vigilant on border security.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay dadka degmada Kwale ku xasuusineysaa inay ka feejignaadaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne ji duto e county mar Kwale ni gibed motang' ne sirkal mar boda.

English: CDC reminds the public in Nairobi County that access to free medical camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za matibabu bila malipo sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nairobi in helitaanka xeryaha caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha loo qoondeeyay.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji duto man Nairobi County ni koro ginyalo yudo kuonde thieth maonge chudo e kuonde ma ji oseyiero.

English: ODPP reminds the public in Bomet County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Bomet in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid bilaash ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: ODPP paronwa ji duto e County mar Bomet ni lando wach tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'.

English: Notice: IPOA conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Kisumu County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Januari hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: IPOA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ku saabsan ka hortagga argagixisada ee degmada Kisumu bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IPOA timo romo mar oganda e dwe mar Januar e Kisumu County.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will train farmers in Mombasa County on water harvesting this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa juu ya uvunaji wa maji Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa tababar siin doonta beeraleyda gobolka Mombasa ee ku saabsan goosashada biyaha bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Rapar: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro tiego jopur e county mar Mombasa e wi ywayo pi e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: COMESA will open a horticultural produce collection centre in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay bilaabi doontaa xarun ururinta alaabada beeraha ee gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: COMESA biro yawo ot mar choko olemo mag puodho e taon mar Elgeyo-Marakwet e dwe mar abich.

English: Notice: KMTC opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay furaysaa codsiyada deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan ardayda ku jira degmada Marsabit.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC oyawo kwayo mar yudo riekni mag somo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e taon mar Marsabit.

English: IEBC reminds voters in Turkana County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya michakato ya uchaguzi.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Turkana inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor inta aan la helin nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: IEBC parone jogweng' Turkana mondo onyis weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom SMS ne ji 70000 kapok gitimo yiero.

English: Notice: OGP opens a new service point for national ID applications in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay fureysaa barta adeegga cusub ee codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: OGP oseyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag kwayo nying' mar ng'ato e gweng' mar Vihiga.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Nyandarua County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the January planting season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Januari.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyandarua inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka jiilaalka hore iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beerto ee Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development nyiso jopur e County mar Nyandarua mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e chak higa ka gitiyo gi thieth mag thieth moting'o yedhe mamero e dwe mar Januar.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) advises residents of Nakuru County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan shahaadada dhalashada.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng' Nakuru County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro yudo barua mar nyuol.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board restricts movement of cattle in Bomet County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya yazuia harakati za ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Bomet kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da ee Gobolka Bomet sababtuna tahay faafitaanka cudurka maqaarka.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Dairy Board ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok e county mar Bomet nikech tuoche mag pien.

English: Pest Control Products Board warns millet farmers in Turkana County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Turkana juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda xashiishadda ee degmada Turkana cudurrada faafa iyo wuxuu kugula talinayaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Bura mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok mar Pest, chiwo siem ne jopur mag millet e county mar Turkana kuom masiche ma nyalo kelo hinyruok, kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: To manage boron deficiency in pawpaw, apply 5-10kg of well-decomposed manure per plant annually at the start of the rainy season, and apply 0.5-5g of Borax fertilizer around the base of young plants; for mature plants, a foliar spray of water-soluble boron corrects the deficiency faster than soil application.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti upungufu wa boroni katika pawpaw, tumia 5-10kg ya mbolea iliyoharibika vizuri kwa kila mmea kila mwaka mwanzoni mwa msimu wa mvua, na tumia 0.5-5g ya mbolea ya Borax karibu na msingi wa mimea ya vijana; kwa mimea ya kukomaa, dawa ya majani ya boroni ya maji huondoa upungufu haraka kuliko matumizi ya udongo.
Somali: Si loo xakameeyo yaraanta boron ee pawpaw, isticmaal 5-10kg oo baashin si fiican u burburay geedkiiba sannadkii bilowga xilliga roobka, iyo 0.5-5g bacriminta Borax ah salka dhirta da'da yar; Dhirta bisil, buufin caleen ah oo boron biyaha ku milma ayaa si dhakhso ah u saxda yaraanta marka loo eego isticmaalka ciidda.
Dholuo: Mondo omi yadh boron orum e pawpaw, onego iti gi yien moro ka moro ma nigi choke mag boron kuom kilo 5-10 e higa ka higa e chakruok mar kinde koth, kendo iti gi yien moro mar borax kuom kilo 0.5-5 e bwo tiend yien matindo; kuom yien motegno, yath ma nigi boron ma nyalo lokore e pi loso yadh boron mapiyo moloyo kaka itiyogo e lowo.

English: Kenya Defence Forces and National Police collaborate on youth engagement and de radicalization.
Kiswahili: Majeshi ya Ulinzi ya Kenya na Polisi ya Kitaifa wanashirikiana katika ushirikiano wa vijana na de radicalisation.
Somali: Ciidamada Difaaca Kenya iyo Booliska Qaranka ayaa iskaashi ku sameeya ka qaybgalka dhalinyarada iyo ka hortagga xagjirnimada.
Dholuo: Kenya Defence Forces kod National Police tiyo kanyachiel e konyo rowere mondo oriwgi lwedo kendo gimi ji bedo gi paro mopogore opogore.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Kenya Gazette waxay furaysaa goob adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Gazette oseyawo kar lendo manyien mar e-Citizen registration e Bungoma County.

English: COMESA advises farmers in Marsabit County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Marsabit inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qaybqaataan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e county mar Marsabit mondo okel namba mar pimo jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET announces bursary allocation enrollment dates for schools in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa mgao wa bursary kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhawaaqday taariikhda diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ee dugsiyada degmada Laikipia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar State for TVET olando tarik mag somo e skunde mag Laikipia County.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya umetoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao kuhusu wizi wa kitambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan xadaysiga aqoonsiga ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Wajir.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ripot Makwar mar Kenya ogolo siem mar rito weche mag intanet e wi kuo mar ng'ato makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: Notice: e-Citizen will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: e-Citizen waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada ee degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: e-Citizen biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi weche mag bajet mar county e county mar Baringo.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Marsabit County about the importance of food safety for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya umuhimu wa usalama wa chakula kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Marsabit muhiimada ay u leedahay badbaadada cuntada caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji e Marsabit County kuom gimomiyo rito chiemo en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: "Tobacco growing farmers must be given the necessary support to switch to alternative crops that have the potential to improve their health and livelihoods as well as reduce the supply of tobacco," says Dr.
Kiswahili: "Wakulima wanaolima tumbaku ni lazima wapewe msaada unaohitajika ili kubadili mazao mbadala yenye uwezo wa kuboresha afya na maisha yao pamoja na kupunguza upatikanaji wa tumbaku," anasema Dk.
Somali: "Beeraleyda beera tubaakada waa in la siiyaa taageerada lagama maarmaanka ah si ay ugu wareegaan dalagyo kale oo awood u leh inay horumariyaan caafimaadkooda iyo noloshooda iyo sidoo kale inay yareeyaan sahayda tubaakada," ayuu yiri Dr.
Dholuo: Jopur ma pidho taba nyaka yud kony ma owinjore mondo gilokre gi cham mamoko ma nigi nyalo mar bero ngimagi kod ngimagi kaachiel gi dwoko piny kwan mar taba, Dr.

Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Marsabit: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Marsabit: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Marsabit: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Septemba 2022

English: DCI calls on the community in Lamu County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatia moyo jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: DCI waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Lamu inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wici doonaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: DCI okwayo ji duto manie County mar Lamu mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: ArAre you worried of money? Stop gambling with your mental health. When you have plenty money, it compels to "different quick ideas" like gambling, indulging into drugs and substance abuse, but all which add more adversaries to you. Instead, seek for free financial advice which will help you in building good financial capacity for yourself
Kiswahili: Je, una wasiwasi kuhusu pesa? Acha kucheza kamari kwa sababu ya afya yako ya akili. Unapokuwa na pesa nyingi, inakuchochea "mawazo tofauti ya haraka" kama vile kucheza kamari, kutumia dawa za kulevya na matumizi mabaya ya dawa, lakini yote hayo yanaongeza wapinzani zaidi kwako. Badala yake, tafuta ushauri wa kifedha wa bure ambao utakusaidia kujenga uwezo mzuri wa kiuchumi kwa ajili yako mwenyewe
Somali: Miyaad ka walwalsan tahay lacag? joojinta khamaarka caafimaadkaaga maskaxda. marka aad haysato lacag badan, waxay kugu qasbaysaa inaad "fekerro degdeg ah oo kala duwan" sida khamaarka, isticmaalka daroogada iyo maandooriyaha, laakiin dhammaantood waxay kuu kordhinayaan cadaawayaal badan. halkii, raadi la talin lacag la'aan ah oo dhaqaale oo kaa caawin doona inaad dhisto awoodda dhaqaalaha wanaagsan naftaada
Dholuo: Be in gi parruok e wi pesa? We tugo tuke mag loyo mich kuom hawi nikech ngima mari mar paro. Sama in gi pesa mang'eny, mano chuno ni itim "puonj mopogore opogore" kaka tugo, tiyo gi yedhe mamero kod tiyo marach gi gik ma mero ji, to magi duto miyo ibedo gi jowasigu momedore.

English: NCPB reminds farmers in Vihiga County of the ongoing fertiliser application training programme.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya matumizi ya mbolea.
Somali: NCPB waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Vihiga barnaamijka tababarka isticmaalka bacriminta ee socda.
Dholuo: NCPB oparo ne jopur e County mar Vihiga chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar tiyo gi yien.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties warns public officers in Garissa County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa dhidi ya kupotosha fedha za umma.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa ka digaya saraakiisha dowladda ee gobolka Garissa in ay ka faa'iideystaan dhaqaale dawladeed.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e gweng' mar Garissa ni kik giti gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo e yo marach.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds residents of Kirinyaga County that access to national ID applications is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba kufikia maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga in helitaanka codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone jogweng' ma Kirinyaga County ni koro yot yudo kwayo mag ID e pinyno kokalo kuom chenro mag sirkal.

Kiswahili: Pokot Magharibi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2022
Somali: Galbeedka Pokot: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2022

English: In addition to public education, the teams would announce the location and dates where the community could access the vaccination.
Kiswahili: Mbali na elimu kwa umma, timu hizo zingetangaza mahali na tarehe ambapo jumuiya inaweza kupata chanjo.
Somali: Marka laga soo tago waxbarashada dadweynaha, kooxuhu waxay ku dhawaaqi lahaayeen goobta iyo taariikhaha ay bulshadu ka heli karto tallaalka.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds livestock keepers in Uasin Gishu County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Uasin Gishu inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska xoolaha ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jopur mag jamni e county mar Uasin Gishu ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni kodgi.

English: Notice: Universities Fund launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu wazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij ka dhan ah tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibta dugsiyada gobolka Kajiado.
Dholuo: Rapar: Yunivasiti Fund chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe mahundu e skunde duto mag Kajiado County.

English: HELB encourages out-of-school children in Murang'a County to register their children at the nearest public school under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: HELB waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Murang'a inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga dadweynaha ee ugu dhow fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.

English: To control cassava mosaic disease, check plants weekly for the first 2-3 months after planting; when you find diseased plants, uproot them by hand once a week, replace them immediately with healthy cuttings, and burn the uprooted diseased plants after sun-drying them away from the field.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti ugonjwa wa mosaic ya muhogo, angalia mimea kila wiki kwa miezi 2-3 ya kwanza baada ya kupanda; Unapopata mimea yenye ugonjwa, ing'oa kwa mkono mara moja kwa wiki, ubadilishe mara moja na vipandikizi vyenye afya, na uchome mimea iliyong'olewa baada ya kukausha jua mbali na shamba.
Somali: Si aad u xakameyso cudurka cassava mosaic, hubi dhirta toddobaadkii inta ugu horreysa 2-3 bilood ka dib markaad beertid; markaad hesho dhirta buka, gacmaha ku qodbo toddobaadkii hal mar, isla markiiba ku beddelo goosashada caafimaad leh, oo ku gub dhirta buka ee qodbo ka dib qorraxda ka qodista iyaga ka baxsan beerta.
Dholuo: Mondo ikwed tuo mar manias mosaic, nonuru yien juma ka juma kuom dweche ariyo kata adek mokwongo bang' pidho; ka uyudo yien ma nigi tuoche, ting'gi oko gi lwete dichiel e juma, ketgi kargi gi yien ma nigi tuoche, kendo wang'gi ka chieng' osepwodhgi oko.

Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: NCPB waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Isiolo inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanada buka xafiiska xayawaanka ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: NCPB paronwa jorit jamni e kaunti mar Isiolo ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: Kenya - Floods, update (Kenya Meteorological Department, media, International Charter) (ECHO Daily Flash of 14 May 2024)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Mafuriko, sasisho (Idara ya Hali ya Hewa ya Kenya, vyombo vya habari, Mkataba wa Kimataifa) (ECHO Daily Flash ya 14 Mei 2024)
Somali: Kenya - Daadadka, cusbooneysiinta (Waaxda Saadaasha Hawada Kenya, warbaahinta, Axdiga Caalamiga ah) (Flash Daily ECHO ee 14 Maajo 2024)
Dholuo: Kenya - Pi mang'eny, lendo (Ofis mar Kenya mar weche mag yamo, weche mag mbui, chik mar piny mangima) (ECHO pile ka pile tarik 14 dwe mar abich 2024)

English: KUCCPS announces distribution of school laptops under the digital literacy programme to schools in Bomet County this March.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inatangaza usambazaji wa kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Bomet Machi hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Bomet bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: KUCCPS olando ni ibiro pog laptop mag skul e bwo chenro mar somo gi somo e yore mag digital e skunde man Bomet County e dwe mar Mach.

English: KICD reminds parents in Kirinyaga County that school feeding programme registration is open this February.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba usajili wa mpango wa kulisha shuleni umefunguliwa Februari hii.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Kirinyaga in diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga ay furan tahay bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne jonyuol e County mar Kirinyaga ni chenro mar kwayo nyithindo chiemo e skul ochakore e dwe mar Februar.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges residents of Siaya County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on community-based development programmes.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waendelee kuwa na habari juu ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay la xiriiraan maamulaha degmada si ay uga warqabaan barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Siaya mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jotend buchegi mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi chenro mag dongruok mag oganda.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges youth in Garissa County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Garissa inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaasha ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education ojiwo rowere e County mar Garissa mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto gikwongo tiyogo ka pok gichako timo tije mag sirkal.

English: DCI urges the public in Kiambu County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: DCI inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kiambu inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aanay wax ka qabanin ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo ji duto e County mar Kiambu mondo ong'e kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma osefweny kuom wuond mag SIM-swap.

English: KTDA urges farmers in Trans Nzoia County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo opidh olembe ma nyalo miyo lowo okethre mondo ginyagre gi lokruok e kaka koth chue.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Makueni County to remain vigilant on border security.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Makueni inay ka feejignaadaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji duto e county mar Makueni ni gibed motang' gi weche mag sirkal.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross confirms a meningitis outbreak alert for Turkana County. Residents are advised to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa uti wa mgongo katika Kaunti ya Turkana. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ku saabsan cudurka meningitis ee degmada Turkana. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isticmaalaan shabaqa cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ripot Mamit mar Kenya osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuo mar meningitis e gweng' mar Turkana.

English: E-Citizen invites residents of Busia County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Busia kuwasilisha maandishi ya kumbukumbu kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: E-Citizen gwelo joma odak e county mar Busia mondo ochiw paro mondik kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso chenro mag dongruok.

English: FAO reminds livestock keepers in Turkana County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa za kuponda ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Turkana inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: FAO parone jopur mag jamni e county mar Turkana mondo ogeng'gi e kuonde moyier mag chwoyo jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.
