English: Ministry of Education encourages residents of Isiolo County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jogweng' Isiolo County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda mondo gibed gi ng'eyo matut kuom weche mag chiwo.

English: By paying attention to those around you, you might save a life! Prioritising mental health in the workplace is just as crucial for those working from home. Mental health challenges can affect anyone; they don't discriminate. Wherever you are working from, taking care of your mental health can improve your productivity and overall happiness. Let_x0092_s break the stigma and make mental health a priority!
Kiswahili: Kwa kuzingatia wale walio karibu nawe, unaweza kuokoa maisha! Kuweka kipaumbele afya ya akili mahali pa kazi ni muhimu sana kwa wale wanaofanya kazi kutoka nyumbani. Changamoto za kiafya cha akili zinaweza kuathiri mtu yeyote; hazionyeshi ubaguzi.
Somali: Markaad fiiro gaar ah u yeelato kuwa kugu xeeran, waxaad badbaadin kartaa nolol! Mudnaanta caafimaadka maskaxda ee goobta shaqada waa mid aad muhiim ugu ah kuwa ka shaqeeya guriga. Caqabadaha caafimaadka maskaxdu waxay saameyn karaan qof kasta; ma takooraan. Meel kasta oo aad ka shaqaynayso, daryeelka caafimaadkaaga maskaxda waxay hagaajin kartaa wax soo saarkaaga iyo farxaddaada guud. Aan_x0092_s jebino ceebta oo aan caafimaadka maskaxda ka dhigno mid mudnaan leh!
Dholuo: Ka iketo pach kuom joma ni machiegni kodi, inyalo reso ngima ng’ato! Keto ngima mar paro mokuongo e kar tich en gima duong’ mana kaka ne joma tiyo ka gin ot. Gik ma kelo pek mag paro nyalo mako ng’ato ang’ata; ok gibed gi pogruok. Kamoro amora ma itiyoe, rito ngimani mar paro nyalo miyo ibed gi tich maber kendo ibed gi mor duto. <2Zepa> Wa_x0092_s ketho ng’anjo kendo keto ngima mar paro obed gima duong’!

English: TSC urges youth in Laikipia County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: TSC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Laikipia inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo rowere e county mar Laikipia mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gitimo tije mag oganda.

English: Managing risks in livestock is essential. Learn about diversification, contracts, and risk mitigation strategies specific to your activity.
Kiswahili: Kusimamia hatari katika mifugo ni muhimu. Jifunze kuhusu mseto, mikataba, na mikakati ya kupunguza hatari mahususi kwa shughuli yako.
Somali: Maareynta khataraha xoolaha waa muhiim. Baro kala duwanaansho, heshiisyada, iyo xeeladaha yareynta khatarta ee gaarka ah ee hawshaada.
Dholuo: Puonjruok yore mopogore opogore mag rito ngima mar jamni, singruoge, kod yore mag geng'o hinyruok mag jamni en gima dwarore ahinya.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Laikipia County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Laikipia inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e gweng' mar Laikipia mondo odhi ir japuonj molony.

English: HELB reminds needy students in Elgeyo-Marakwet County that revision guides applications close soon.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho yanafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in dib-u-eegista ay ku xiran tahay codsiyada dhowaan.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa jopuonjre modhier e County mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni lokruok ma ne otimno nyiso ni okayo machiegni.

English: HELB advises applicants in Kisii County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: HELB inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Kisii kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: HELB waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Kisii inay dalbadaan booska TVET ee KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e County mar Kisii mondo oketgi e tiegruok mar TVET kokalo kuom KUCCPS.

English: Learn on field extension services in your area at County level on trainings and knowledge.
Kiswahili: Jifunze kuhusu huduma za upanuzi wa uwanja katika eneo lako katika ngazi ya Wilaya juu ya mafunzo na maarifa.
Somali: Wax ka baro adeegyada ballaarinta goobta deegaankaaga heer degmo oo ku saabsan tababarka iyo aqoonta.
Dholuo: Puonjri weche momedore e wi tij lendo e alworau e wi tiegruok kod ng'eyo.

English: EACC announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: EACC inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: EACC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: EACC olando lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mag ng'eyo ng'ato e gweng' mar Kericho.

English: FAO announces a free lumpy skin disease vaccination exercise for sheep in Kakamega County this April.
Kiswahili: FAO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa ngozi kwa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Aprili hii.
Somali: FAO waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan cudurka maqaarka ee lo'da ee Gobolka Kakamega bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: FAO olando chenro mar thiedho rombe maonge chudo mar dhoot e dwe mar April e kaunti mar Kakamega.

English: Scientists have found that a mosquito species blamed for malaria transmission in eastern and southern Africa has developed resistance to a long-used insecticide in the region.
Kiswahili: Wanasayansi wamegundua kwamba aina ya mbu inayolaumiwa kwa maambukizi ya malaria mashariki na kusini mwa Afrika imekua na upinzani dhidi ya dawa ya kuua wadudu ambayo imekuwa ikitumika kwa muda mrefu katika eneo hilo.
Somali: Cilmi-baadhayaashu waxay ogaadeen in nooc ka mid ah cayayaanka lagu eedeeyay in ay keenaan cudurka maleriya ee bariga iyo koonfurta Afrika ay ka hortageen difaac u yeelashada jeermis cayayaan ah oo muddo dheer loo isticmaalo gobolka.
Dholuo: Josayans osefwenyo ni kit lum moro ma ji wacho ni kelo malaria e pinje mag Afrika ma yo wuok chieng' kod ma milambo, osedok chien ma ok nyal thiedho ndawa ma ji tiyogo kuom higni mang'eny e alworano.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges residents of Siaya County to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility following a rise in reported HIV/AIDS cases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya VVU/UKIMWI.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay si dhakhso leh u raadsadaan baaritaanka xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow ka dib kororka kiisaska HIV / AIDS ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ojiwo ji duto modak e county mar Siaya mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuo mar HIV/AIDS osemedore.

English: Ministry of Education reminds schools in Nyeri County to strengthen inclusion of learners with disabilities this February.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuimarisha ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu Februari hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa dib u xasuusineysa dugsiyada degmada Nyeri inay xoojiyaan ka mid noqoshada ardayda naafada ah bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok oparo ne skunde man Nyeri County mondo omed tiego jopuonjre ma nigi midekre e dwe mar Februar.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free malaria screening is available at all public health centres in Uasin Gishu County this April.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa malaria bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Aprili hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka fayraska ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Uasin Gishu bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji ni thieth mar malaria onge nengo e kuonde thieth duto mag oganda e Uasin Gishu County e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: DPP opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogaysiis: DPP waxay furaysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya daryeel caafimaad ka dib rabshadaha gobolka Mombasa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: DPP ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony mar thieth bang' timbe mahundu e county mar Mombasa.

English: Notice: ODPP launches ward-level service delivery in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inazindua huduma za huduma katika wilaya ya Kitui.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay bilawday bixinta adeegyada heerka qaybta ee Gobolka Kitui.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: ODPP chako chiwo kony e alwora mar Kitui County.

English: Announcement of free school milk program for primary pupils in Migori and Nakuru to improve child nutrition and school attendance.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la mpango wa maziwa ya bure kwa wanafunzi wa shule za msingi huko Migori na Nakuru ili kuboresha lishe ya watoto na mahudhurio shuleni.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida barnaamijka caanaha dugsiga ee bilaashka ah ee ardayda dugsiga hoose ee Migori iyo Nakuru si loo hagaajiyo nafaqada carruurta iyo ka qaybgalka dugsiga.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar jopuonjre mag skul mag Migori kod Nakuru biro timo chenro mar chiwo chak maonge chudo e skul mondo okony nyithindgi yudo chiemb chuny maber kendo dhi e skul.

English: TVET conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Nyeri County this October.
Kiswahili: TVET inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Oktoba hii.
Somali: TVET waxay qabaneysaa munaasabadda waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha gobolka Nyeri bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: TVET timo romo mar tiego ji e wi migawo mar Ombudsman e County mar Nyeri e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: KEPHIS promotes conservation tillage among farmers in Kiambu County as part of the August climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inakuza kilimo cha uhifadhi miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Agosti.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay kor u qaadeysaa beerashada ilaalinta beeraleyda degmada Kiambu iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka iska caabinta cimilada ee Agoosto.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo puodho mar ritruok e kind jopur e County mar Kiambu e dwe mar Agost kaka achiel kuom chenro mar kedo gi lokruok e kit yamo.

English: TSC conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in Vihiga County this September.
Kiswahili: TSC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Septemba hii.
Somali: TSC waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee degmada Vihiga bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: TSC timo romo mar tiego ji e wi ratiro mag chik e County mar Vihiga e dwe mar Septemba.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free tuberculosis screening is available at all public health centres in Vihiga County this December.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kifua kikuu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Desemba hii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka caabuqa ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhamaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadwaynaha ee degmada Vihiga bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji ni thieth mar tuo mar tuberculosis onge nengo e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Vihiga e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations launches a carjacking prevention campaign in Lamu County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia utekaji nyara katika Kaunti ya Lamu Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa bilaabay olole looga hortago gaadiidka la xaday Gobolka Lamu bishii Ogosto.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche motudore gi weche mag mahundu chako kampen mar geng'o mibadhi mag mtokni e taon mar Lamu e dwe mar Agost.

English: Ministry of Education expands online platforms offering STEM career counseling and resources for secondary school students.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inaongeza majukwaa ya mtandaoni ambayo hutoa ushauri wa kazi ya STEM na rasilimali kwa wanafunzi wa shule ya sekondari.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ballaarineysaa barnaamijyada internetka ee bixiya la-talinta xirfadaha STEM iyo khayraadka loogu talagalay ardayda dugsiga sare.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok medo timo dongruok e chenro mag intanet mar chiwo puonj koda mwandu mag tije mag STEM ne jopuonjre mag sekondari.

English: Office of the Auditor-General announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kurejea kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la hagaajiyay waqtiga wareejinta ee adeegyada baasaboorka ee gobolka Bomet.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General olando lokruok e seche mag tiyo gi passport e county mar Bomet.

English: ODPP reminds the public in Elgeyo-Marakwet County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet in sheegashada khiyaamooyinka iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: ODPP paronwa ji duto e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag yuto en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: KNEC encourages out-of-school children in Nyandarua County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya ugawaji wa bursary.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta dugsiga ka baxsan ee degmada Nyandarua inay codsadaan deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga ugu dambeeya ee loo qoondeeyo deeqaha waxbarasho.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e county mar Nyandarua mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: OGP encourages first-time voters in Kilifi County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: OGP inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu.
Somali: OGP waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Kilifi inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogo ma ne okwongo yiero e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo olim kama ichikoe ji ne IEBC.

English: Notice: NCPB restricts movement of dairy cows in Nyandarua County due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB inazuia harakati za ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Newcastle.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da caanaha ah ee Gobolka Nyandarua sababo la xiriira cudurka Newcastle.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NCPB ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok makwayo chak e County mar Nyandarua nikech tuo mar Newcastle.

English: Notice: NTSA opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inafungua dawati la jinsia kutoa simu ya msaada ya GBV bila malipo katika Kaunti ya West Pokot.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya khadka caawimaadda ee GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ee Galbeedka Pokot County.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NTSA ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo chenro mar tiyo gi simo maonge chudo mar GBV e West Pokot County.

English: DPP reminds residents of Meru County that reporting carjacking promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: DPP anawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kwamba kuripoti utekaji nyara mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan baabuurta la xaday ay gacan ka geystaan ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogweng'o mag Meru County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo mtokni konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: KEMRI launches an August awareness campaign on tobacco control across Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: KEMRI yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Agosti kuhusu udhibiti wa tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: KEMRI waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Agoosto ee ka dhanka ah xakamaynta sigaarka ee Gobolka Nairobi.
Dholuo: KEMRI chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Agost e wi thieth mar ndawa e County duto mar Nairobi.

English: TSC reminds schools in Isiolo County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this July.
Kiswahili: TSC inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Julai hii.
Somali: TSC waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Isiolo inay xoojiyaan adeegyada hagista iyo la-talinta bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: TSC paronwa skunde mag Isiolo County mondo omed jiwo kendo chiwo kony e dwe mar Julai.

English: NDMA urges motorists and pedestrians in Tharaka-Nithi County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada daadadka ku dhacay si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo jorit mtokni kod joma wuotho e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o mondo kik gitim aksident mag ndara.

English: DCI reminds mobile money users in Machakos County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za simu katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka kashfa za pesa za mkononi.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Machakos inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: DCI paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e gweng' mar Machakos mondo ochiw ripot mar ote manyalo kelo hinyruok ne jatendgi mondo kik gitim timbe mag mibadhi.

English: Ministry of Education encourages residents of Embu County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay ka qaybgalaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadwaynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jogweng' Embu County mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county mondo ging'e kaka ji duto biro tiyo gi bajet mag county.

English: Notice: KICD launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD yazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay bilawday barnaamij tallaabooyin ka dhan ah dhibaataynta dugsiyada degmada Marsabit.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KICD chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe mahundu e skunde duto mag Marsabit County.

English: Public health advisory: Kenya Medical Association warns of increased tuberculosis risk in Samburu County and advises the public to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya kifua kikuu katika Kaunti ya Samburu na kushauri umma kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ka digay khatarta sii kordheysa ee cudurka 'tuberculosis' ee Gobolka Samburu wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo.
Dholuo: Rieko mar thieth mar ji: Kenya Medical Association chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar tuberculosis e county mar Samburu kendo ojiwo ji duto mondo otiek dose duto mar thiedho.

English: SHA encourages first-time voters in Nairobi County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: SHA inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: SHA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Nairobi inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jogo ma ne okwongo yiero e County mar Nairobi mondo onon weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: IEBC reminds youth in Makueni County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Makueni in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka mashiinka gawaarida.
Dholuo: IEBC oparo ne rowere man Makueni County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar masinde mag mtokni.

English: Notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response confirms a cyclosporiasis outbreak alert for Wajir County. Residents are advised to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa cyclosporiasis kwa Kaunti ya Wajir. Wakazi wanashauriwa kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka cyclosporiasis ee Gobolka Wajir. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duoko ne Tuoche osenyiso ni oseng'ado mar chungo tuwo mar cyclosporiasis e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: KEPHIS encourages farmers in Wajir County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for coffee.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei nzuri ya kahawa.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Wajir inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo kafee ah.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Wajir mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mondo giyud nengo maber mar kofi.

English: Public health advisory: CDC warns of increased cyclosporiasis risk in Nyamira County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: CDC inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya cyclosporiasis katika Kaunti ya Nyamira na inashauri umma kutumia vyandarua vya mbu vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: CDC waxay ka digeysaa kororka halista cyclosporiasis ee degmada Nyamira waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: CDC siemo ji kuom medo nengo mar cyclosporiasis e county mar Nyamira kendo osiemo ji mondo oti gi net mag kute mitiyogo e thiedho lum otieno ka otieno.

English: SHA urges residents of Uasin Gishu County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu watumie portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na ufisadi wa fedha za umma.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u soo gudbiyaan cabasho si ay ula dagaallamaan xadgudubka lacagta dadweynaha.
Dholuo: SHA ojiwo jogweng' Uasin Gishu County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e loso ng'ur mar kedo gi ketho pesa mag sirkal.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Narok County to prepare for possible flooding this February.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa mafuriko Februari hii.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ka digaya dadka deggan degmada Narok inay u diyaar garoobaan fatahaadaha suurtagalka ah bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng' Narok County ni giikre ne koth maduong' ma biro timore e dwe mar Februar.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Kisii County to attend the public participation forum to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay ka qaybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si loo qaabeeyo madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette ojiwo jogweng' Kisii County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar loso chenro mar dongruok.

English: KEPHIS informs maize farmers in Wajir County of new market linkage opportunities this October.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawafahamisha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Oktoba hii.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee Gobolka Wajir fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KEPHIS nyiso jopur mag kodhi e gweng' mar Wajir e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: EACC advises residents of Kakamega County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: EACC inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e- Citizen.
Somali: EACC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kakamega inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan diiwaangelinta e-citizen.
Dholuo: EACC nyiso ji modak e Kaunti mar Kakamega mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom websait mar e-Citizen sama gikwayo mondo gidonj e e - Citizen registration.

English: NTSA warns residents of Homa Bay County to prepare for possible drought this August.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kujiandaa kwa ukame unaowezekana Agosti hii.
Somali: NTSA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay isu diyaariyaan abaaraha iman kara bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: NTSA osiemo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo oikre ne oro ma nyalo betie e dwe mar Agost.

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health warns of increased dengue fever risk in Vihiga County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya homa ya dengue katika Kaunti ya Vihiga na inashauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Talo-bixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ka digtay khatarta sii kordheysa ee hargabka dengue ee degmada Vihiga waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar oganda: Ministry of Health osiemo ji kuom medruok mar tuwo mar dengue e County mar Vihiga kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore mar thieth.

English: AFA reminds farmers in Kitui County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kitui barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada.
Dholuo: AFA parone jopur e County Kitui chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche.

English: UK promotes bovine tuberculosis vaccination.
Kiswahili: Uingereza inakuza chanjo ya kifua kikuu cha ng'ombe.
Somali: Boqortooyada Midowday waxay dhiirrigelisay tallaalka TB ee lo'da.
Dholuo: Piny mar UK jiwo thieth mar tuo mar tho mar dhok.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay bilowday barnaamij ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada iskuulada guud ahaan gobolka Nandi.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Puonjruok chako chenro mar rito nyithindo e skul e skunde duto e County mar Nandi.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties urges residents of Wajir County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kuwaajiri wasimamizi wa wilaya zao ili waendelee kuwa na habari juu ya utoaji wa huduma kwa kiwango cha wilaya.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir inay la shaqeeyaan maamulaha degmada si ay uga warqabaan bixinta adeegyada heerka degmada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties jiwo jogweng' mar Wajir County mondo oriwgi gi jaritgi mar ward mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche duto motudore gi tij lendo mar ward.

English: Kenyan farmers are encouraged to engage with the Kenya Denmark partnership to improve food safety and agricultural development
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Kenya wanahimizwa kushirikiana na ushirikiano wa Kenya Denmark ili kuboresha usalama wa chakula na maendeleo ya kilimo
Somali: Beeraleyda Kenya waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay la shaqeeyaan wada-shaqeynta Kenya Denmark si loo wanaajiyo ammaanka cuntada iyo horumarinta beeraha
Dholuo: Ojiwo jopur ma Kenya mondo oriwre gi Kenya Denmark mondo gimed loso chiemo kod dongruok e pur

English: State Department for Basic Education advises students in Kirinyaga County to register early to secure allocation to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Elimu ya Msingi inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ardayda degmada Kirinyaga kula talineysaa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan waqti hore si ay u helaan kaalmo ay ku helaan kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education nyiso jopuonjre e County mar Kirinyaga ni gidonj e skundno chon mondo giyud pesa mar yudo kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar digital literacy.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Homa Bay County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the December planting season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kupitisha aina zilizothibitishwa za mbegu zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Desemba.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda gobolka Homa Bay inay qaataan noocyo abuurka ah oo abaarta u adkaysta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur manie Homa Bay County mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro ka pok ochopo dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: KUCCPS launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay bilawday barnaamij ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada iskuulada guud ahaan degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KUCCPS chako chenro mar rito nyithindo e skunde e skul duto mag Siaya County.

English: Kenya has confirmed high infection of Mpox virus, untill now, there are 137 confimed patients in Busia,Mombasa and Nakuru leading in the transmission rates
Kiswahili: Kenya imethibitisha kuambukizwa sana kwa virusi vya Mpox, hadi sasa, kuna wagonjwa 137 waliokamatwa huko Busia, Mombasa na Nakuru wakiongoza katika viwango vya maambukizi
Somali: Kenya ayaa xaqiijisay cudurka Mpox oo aad u sarreeya, illaa iyo hadda, waxaa jira 137 bukaan oo la xakameeyay Busia, Mombasa iyo Nakuru oo hormuud ka ah heerarka gudbinta
Dholuo: Kenya oseyudo ni ji mang'eny nigi tuwo mar Mpox, to sani, nitie ji 137 ma nigi tuwo e Busia, Mombasa kod Nakuru.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development opens applications for school laptops under the digital literacy programme for learners in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yafungua maombi ya kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka ayaa furaya codsiyada kumbuyuutarrada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee ardayda degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oyawo kwayo mag kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar somo kod somo mar digital ne jopuonjre man Kisumu County.

English: HELB calls on the community in Samburu County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: HELB inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: HELB waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada gobolka Samburu inay u soo wargeliyaan maamulka iskuulka wixii arrimo ah oo ku saabsan amniga si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: HELB kwayo ji duto manie county mar Samburu mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar skul e wi weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: Notice: OGP launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Migori County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Migori Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee Degmada Migori bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: OGP chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e county mar Migori e dwe mar Mei.

English: KTDA encourages farmers in Tana River County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for coffee.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa ili kupata bei bora ya kahawa.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Tana River inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan kafeega.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e taon mar Tana River County mondo oti maber gi nengo mar moromo mar loso chai.

English: EACC reminds residents of Kisumu County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: EACC parone jogweng' mar Kisumu County ni luwo dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Laikipia County about the importance of food safety for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuhusu umuhimu wa usalama wa chakula kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay dadka degmada Laikipia ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda badbaadada cuntada ay u leedahay caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji duto e County mar Laikipia gimomiyo rito chiemo en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Long-term substance use can impair cognitive functions such as memory and decision-making, which can further complicate mental health issues and affect daily functioning
Kiswahili: Matumizi ya dawa za kulevya kwa muda mrefu yanaweza kuathiri utendaji kazi wa utambuzi kama vile kumbukumbu na kufanya maamuzi, ambayo yanaweza kuzidisha matatizo ya afya ya akili na kuathiri utendaji kazi wa kila siku.
Somali: Isticmaalka daroogada muddada dheer waxay saameyn ku yeelan kartaa howlaha garashada sida xusuusta iyo go'aan qaadashada, taas oo sii adkeyn karta arrimaha caafimaadka dhimirka waxayna saameyn kartaa shaqada maalinlaha ah
Dholuo: Tiyo gi yedhe mamero kuom kinde malach nyalo ketho tije mag ng'eyo kaka paro kod timo yiero, kendo mano nyalo miyo weche mag ngima mar pach dhano omed bedo matek kendo nyalo mulo ngima mar ji pile ka pile.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public in Mandera County that access to eye and dental camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za macho na meno sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha Degmada Mandera in helitaanka xeryaha indhaha iyo ilkaha ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche parone ji duto man Mandera County ni koro ginyalo dhi e kambi mag thieth mag wang' kod lakteche mag laktech e kuonde moyier.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free meningitis screening is available at all public health centres in Bungoma County this December.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa uti wa mgongo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Desemba hii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka meningitis ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka guud ee degmada Bungoma bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji ni nono tuo mar meningitis en gima nono e kuonde thieth duto mag ji e County mar Bungoma e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Pregnant women should eat small meals several times a day to manage nausea and maintain energy levels.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanapaswa kula milo midogo mara kadhaa kwa siku ili kudhibiti kichefuchefu na kudumisha viwango vya nishati.
Somali: Dumarka uurka leh waa inay cunaan cunto yar yar dhowr jeer maalintii si ay ula qabsadaan caloolxumada oo ay u ilaaliyaan heerarka tamarta.
Dholuo: Mon ma nigi ich onego ocham chiemo matindo tindo nyading'eny odiechieng' kodiechieng' mondo ginyagre gi ich wang' kendo gisik ka gin gi teko.

English: Teachers Service Commission invites youth in Isiolo County to enroll for catering and hospitality training this December.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu Desemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa ku casuumay dhalinyarada degmada Isiolo inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj gwelo rowere e gweng' mar Isiolo mondo odonj e tiegruok mar chiemo kod rwako welo e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Bridge the gap! Build more schools in rural areas like Kitui.
Kiswahili: Ziba pengo! Jenga shule zaidi katika maeneo ya vijijini kama Kitui.
Somali: Dhis dugsiyo badan oo ku yaal degaanada miyiga ah sida Kitui.
Dholuo: Gero skunde mang'eny e gwenge ma ji odakie kaka Kitui.

English: KMTC reminds needy students in Nakuru County that free digital learning content applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba programu za bure za maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KMTC waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Nakuru in codsiyada barashada bilaashka ah ee barnaamijyada ay dhowaan soo gabagabeynayaan.
Dholuo: KMTC oparo ne jopuonjre man Nakuru County ni chenro mag puonjruok mar digital maonge chudo chiegni rumo.

English: Notice: IEBC announces bursary allocation enrollment dates for schools in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa bursary kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ee dugsiyada gobolka Kajiado.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC olando tarik mag dhi e skunde mag Kajiado County.

English: Notice: CDC confirms a cyclosporiasis outbreak alert for Nyandarua County. Residents are advised to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ilani: CDC inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa cyclosporiasis kwa Kaunti ya Nyandarua. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: CDC waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ku saabsan cudurka cyclosporiasis ee gobolka Nyandarua. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth (CDC) osenyiso ni nitie masira mar cyclosporiasis e kaunti mar Nyandarua. Ojiw ji mondo otim nonro mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni kodgi.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds the public in Samburu County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka gobolka Samburu xusuusinayaa in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties paronwa ji duto e county mar Samburu ni lando wach tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'.

English: KTDA warns tea farmers in Kirinyaga County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaonya wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza uingiliaji kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KTDA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee Gobolka Kirinyaga cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna kugula talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: KTDA chiwo siem ne jopur ma loso chai e County mar Kirinyaga kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: NDMA urges motorists and pedestrians in Siaya County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa wadayaasha baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Siaya inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada ay fatahaadu ka dhacdo si looga hortago dhacdooyinka fatahaadda.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo joidh mtokni kod jowuoth e county mar Siaya mondo kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o mondo gikwed masiche motudore gi pi.

English: Ministry of Education curates digital literature libraries available for all secondary school students.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu huandaa maktaba za fasihi za dijiti zinazopatikana kwa wanafunzi wote wa shule za sekondari.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay haysataa maktabadaha suugaanta dhijitaalka ah ee loo heli karo dhammaan ardayda dugsiga sare.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok tayo buge mag digital ma yudore ne jopuonjre duto mag sekondari.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Kisii County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen anawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kudai kutoa huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa fedha za umma.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay dadka deggan degmada Kisii ugu baaqeysaa inay dalbadaan adeegyo aan la siinayo laaluush si looga hortago xadgudubka lacagta dadweynaha.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kisii mondo ochiw kony maok ochulo asoya mondo giked gi ketho pesa mag sirkal.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Nyamira County to attend the public participation forum to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inay ka qayb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si loo qaabeeyo habka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' Nyamira County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar loso bajet mar county.

English: KUCCPS reminds parents in Kisii County that free day secondary education registration is open this May.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba usajili wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo umefunguliwa Mei hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Kisii in diiwaangelinta dugsiga dhexe ee bilaashka ah ay furan tahay bisha May.
Dholuo: KUCCPS paronwa jonyuol e County mar Kisii ni somo mar sekondari mar odiechieng' maonge chudo chako e dwe mar abich.

English: TSC urges parents and teachers in Uasin Gishu County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Somali: TSC waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Uasin Gishu inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto.

English: Notice: DCI opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafungua ofisi ya ngono inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay fureysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya daryeel caafimaad ka dib rabshadaha degmada Meru.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DCI ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony mar thieth bang' timbe mahundu e county mar Meru.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds farmers in Nyeri County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri juu ya programu inayoendelea ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa mafunzo ya wakulima.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa beeraleyda degmada Nyeri barnaamijka tababarka beeralayda ee socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service oparo ne jopur e County mar Nyeri chenro mar tiego jopur ma sani dhi nyime.

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Tana River County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay haystaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi ka gidwaro thieth mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages residents of Murang'a County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay u dhiiri galiyaan saaxiibka dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit jiwo jogweng' Murang'a County mondo kik gisandre gi muol kendo mondo gijiw osiepgi moro ma chandore omany kony.

English: The CSA approach builds on the concepts, technologies and experience of sustainable agriculture, but explicitly focuses on integrating the impacts of and on ...
Kiswahili: Mbinu ya CSA inajengwa juu ya dhana, teknolojia na uzoefu wa kilimo endelevu, lakini inazingatia kwa uwazi katika kuunganisha athari za na kwenye ...
Somali: Habka CSA wuxuu ku dhisan yahay fikradaha, tiknoolajiyada iyo waayo-aragnimada beeraha waara, laakiin si cad ayuu diiradda u saarayaa isku-darka saameynta iyo ...
Dholuo: Yo ma ji tiyogo e timo dongruok e weche mag manyo mwandu, kod manyo mwandu, otenore kuom paro, teknoloji, kod lony ma ji nigo e weche mag timo dongruok e yore mag manyo mwandu, to ok kuom keto pachgi duto e weche mag manyo mwandu.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will distribute certified maize seed to farmers in Nyandarua County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itasambaza mbegu za mahindi zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay abuuraha gobolka Nyandarua u qaybin doontaa abuurka hadhuudhka ee la caddeeyay bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KEPHIS biro pogo kodhi mag kodhi mar kodhi ne jopur man Nyandarua County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: HELB reminds parents in Kitui County that free primary education registration is open this June.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba usajili wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo umefunguliwa Juni hii.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Kitui in diiwaangelinta bilaashka ah ee waxbarashada hoose ay furan tahay bisha Juun.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa jonyuol e gweng' mar Kitui ni dwe mar Jun e higani, ibiro chako somo e skundni maonge chudo.

English: KEPHIS promotes organic farming among farmers in Uasin Gishu County as part of the July climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inakuza kilimo hai miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kama sehemu ya harakati za Julai za kustahimili hali ya hewa.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay kor u qaadeysaa beeraha dabiiciga ah ee beeraleyda degmada Uasin Gishu iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka u adkeynta cimilada bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi e dwe mar Julai.

English: Universities Fund announces distribution of school laptops under the digital literacy programme to schools in Wajir County this March.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unatangaza usambazaji wa kompyuta ndogo za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa shule za Kaunti ya Wajir Machi hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku dhawaaqay qaybinta kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Wajir bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund ong'ado mar pogo kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar digital literacy ne skunde mag Wajir County e dwe mar Mach.

English: Kenya Dairy Board urges dairy cows farmers in Kirinyaga County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawataka wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda lo'da caanaha ah ee Gobolka Kirinyaga inay ka fogaadaan in xoolaha lagu guuro xadka gobolka iyada oo aan la helin ruqsad ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee anthrax.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur mag dhok ma loso dhok e County ma Kirinyaga mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni ka giwuok e county maok giyudo rusa bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag anthrax.

English: TSC advises students in Migori County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: TSC inashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Migori kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya udhamini mtandaoni ili kufikia maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza dijitali.
Somali: TSC waxay ardayda Degmada Migori kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga deeqda waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan waxyaabo waxbarasho digital ah oo bilaash ah.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo jopuonjre mag Migori County mondo oketgi e intanet mondo giyud thuolo mar somo weche mag digital maonge chudo.

English: TVET conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Kajiado County this December.
Kiswahili: TVET inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Kajiado Desemba hii.
Somali: TVET waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan wareejinta degmada Kajiado bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: E dwe mar Desemba, TVET dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e kaunti mar Kajiado.

English: E-Citizen reminds voters in Bungoma County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Bungoma in ay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor inta aysan helin waxbarasho codbixinayaasha.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa jogweng'o mag Bungoma County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom SMS ne ji 70000 kapok giyudo tiegruok.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) encourages first-time voters in Kisii County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kisii kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu zaidi.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa codbixiyayaasha ugu horreeya ee degmada Kisii inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo joma okwongo yiero e county mar Kisii mondo olim kama ichanoe joma nie IEBC machiegni kodgi.

English: COMESA encourages farmers in Siaya County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for fish.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora za samaki.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Siaya inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo kalluunka ah.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e county mar Siaya mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mondo omi rech obed gi nengo maber.

English: ODPP reminds the public in Kiambu County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this April.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba mapendekezo juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka yanakaribishwa Aprili hii.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kiambu in talooyinka dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: ODPP oparo ne ji duto e County mar Kiambu ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi nonro mar tich ma higa ka higa e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: IEBC reminds citizens in Taita-Taveta County about their rights regarding devolution.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Taita-Taveta ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC paronwa raia mag Taita-Taveta County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar golo pesa.

English: Public notice: CDC will host a free hypertension awareness outreach in Baringo County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: CDC itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Baringo Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: CDC waxay marti gelineysaa wacyi-gelin bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cadaadiska sare ee Baringo County bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuoche (CDC) biro timo kampen mar konyo ji ong'e ni nitie tuwo mar hypertension e taon mar Baringo e dwe mar Julai.

English: NTSA urges the community in Migori County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb carjacking.
Kiswahili: NTSA inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Migori kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni ili kuzuia utekaji nyara wa gari.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada Degmada Migori inay ka fogaadaan inay macluumaadka amniga shaqsiyeed la wadaagaan shisheeyaha si loo xakameeyo afduubka gawaarida.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo oganda manie Migori County mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo gikwed kwalo mtokni.

English: Notice from CDC: nutrition supplementation for infants clinics will run every February at designated health centres in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa CDC: nyongeza ya lishe kwa kliniki za watoto wachanga itaendeshwa kila Februari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid CDC: Kordhinta nafaqada ee dhallaanka caafimaadku waxay ka shaqeyn doonaan Febraayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee lagu magacaabo degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar yedhe ma thiedho tuoche (CDC): thieth mag chiemo ne nyithindo matindo biro timore e dwe mar Februar higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e kaunti mar Isiolo.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free meningitis screening is available at all public health centres in Lamu County this March.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa uti wa mgongo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Lamu Machi hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka meningitis ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Lamu bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji ni nono tuo mar meningitis en gima nono e kuonde thieth duto mag oganda e County mar Lamu e dwe mar Mach.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds voters in Laikipia County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya michakato ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu xusuusinayaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Laikipia inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor inta aan la helin nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General parone jogweng' Laikipia mondo ong'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom SMS ne 70000 kapok gitimo yiero.

English: TVET conducts a civic education forum on voter registration in Turkana County this April.
Kiswahili: TVET inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Turkana Aprili hii.
Somali: TVET waxay bishii Abriil ku qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: E dwe mar April, TVET dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji mondo ging'e weche motudore gi ndiko joma oyier e Turkana County.

English: Notice: KEMRI will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Tharaka-Nithi County this January. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI itafanya kongamano la kurejesha matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Januari hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay qabaneysaa munaasabad dib u soo kabashada maandooriyaha ee Degmada Tharaka-Nithi bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMRI biro timo chokruok mar chango joma tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero e Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar Januar.

English: TVET urges parents and teachers in Turkana County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: TVET inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Turkana kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Somali: TVET waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Turkana inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Turkana mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto.

English: Notice: KUCCPS announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ee dugsiyada degmada Makueni.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KUCCPS ogolo chenro mar somo e skul mag Makueni County.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free youth mental wellness support is available through county health facilities in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa afya ya akili ya vijana unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Kajiado County.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo ne rowere yudo kokalo kuom kuonde thieth e Kajiado County.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Baringo County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the October planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Baringo kutumia viwango vinavyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Oktoba.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda Baringo County inay isticmaalaan sicirka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur e Baringo County mondo oti gi kwan mar yien molony kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: AFA informs milk farmers in Taita-Taveta County of new market linkage opportunities this June.
Kiswahili: AFA inawafahamisha wakulima wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Juni hii.
Somali: AFA waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda caanaha ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Juun.
Dholuo: AFA nyiso jopur mag chak e Taita-Taveta County e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Jun.

English: KMTC calls on the community in Isiolo County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KMTC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: KMTC waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Isiolo inay taageeraan jawiga waxbarasho ee ka kooban si loo ilaaliyo nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: KMTC luongo ji duto e gweng' mar Isiolo mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Public notice: CDC will host a free tobacco control outreach in Murang'a County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: CDC itaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa kudhibiti tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: CDC waxay marti gelineysaa dadaal lacag la'aan ah oo ka dhan ah ka hortagga sigaarka degmada Murang'a bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar yedhe ma thiedho ndawa (CDC) biro timo kampen mar tieko madho ndawa maonge chudo e dwe mar Agost e County mar Murang'a.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada ay daadadka ka da'an yihiin xilliyada dab-damiska.
Dholuo: NDMA oparo ne jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County ni kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o e kinde mag yiengni.

English: Sunken eyes, dry mouth, and less urine may indicate dehydration. Give fluids and seek care.
Kiswahili: Macho yaliyozama, mdomo mkavu, na mkojo mdogo vinaweza kuonyesha upungufu wa maji mwilini. Mpe maji na utafute huduma.
Somali: Indhaha hoos u dhaca, afka qalalan iyo urin yar ayaa calaamad u noqon kara biyo la'aanta.
Dholuo: Kapo ni wang'i onyosore, dhogi otwo, kendo idho pi matin, mano nyalo nyiso ni ng'ato onge pi.

English: Council of Governors warns public officers in Tharaka-Nithi County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi dhidi ya rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ka digeen saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay laaluush ka qaadaan xafiisyada dawladda.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e Tharaka-Nithi County kuom kawo asoya e migepe mar sirkal.

English: DCI reminds residents of Kwale County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale in warbixinta khiyaanada si deg deg ah ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: DCI parone jogweng' Kwale County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar wuondruok konyo rito alwora.

English: Notice: DPP opens a gender desk offering free legal aid in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisheria bure katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DPP ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony ma onge chudo e kaunti mar Uasin Gishu.

English:
Be safe from coronavirus.Washing your hands is the most important way to stop transmission.
1.Wet hands
2.Apply enough soap
3.Scrub all surfaces of the hands for 20-30 seconds.
4.Rinse thoroughly with running water
5.Dry hands with a clean cloth or single-use towel
Kiswahili:
Kuwa salama kutokana na virusi vya corona. Kuosha mikono yako ndiyo njia muhimu zaidi ya kuzuia maambukizi.

1. Lowesha mikono
2. Paka sabuni ya kutosha
3. Sugua sehemu zote za mikono kwa sekunde 20-30.

4. Suuza vizuri na maji yanayotiririka
5. Kausha mikono kwa kitambaa safi au taulo ya matumizi moja
Somali: Iska ilaali cudurka Coronavirus. Gacmahaada maydhka ayaa ah habka ugu muhiimsan ee lagu joojin karo gudbinta. 1. Gacmaha qoyan 2.Sabayl ku filan ku dheji 3.Dadka oo dhan 20-30 ilbidhiqsi ku tirtir. 4. Biyaha qulqulaya si fiican u maydho 5. Gacmaha qalalan dhar nadiif ah ama tuulo hal mar loo isticmaalo
Dholuo: Bed motang' gi tuo mar Coronavirus.Lwoko lweti e yo maduong'ie moloyo mar geng'o tugo mar tuoche. 1.Lwoko lweteni. 2.Tigo sabun moromo. 3.Loso lweti duto kuom sekond 20-30. 4.Lwok lweti maber gi pi ma ringo. 5.Lwok lweteni gi lewni maler kata lewni ma itiyogo dichiel.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds mobile money users in Uasin Gishu County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee gobolka Uasin Gishu in ay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne jogo matiyo gi pesa mobil e county mar Uasin Gishu ni mondo ging'e kwayo margi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo gitang' gi chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo.

English: KUCCPS reminds needy students in Meru County that revision guides applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Meru kwamba maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho yanafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Meru in codsiyada dib-u-eegista ay dhowaan soo gabagabeyn doonaan.
Dholuo: KUCCPS paronwa jopuonjre man gi chandruok e County mar Meru ni lokruok mar chike mag kwayo biro rumo machiegni.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Wananchi katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu ka furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay Diiwaangelinta e-Muwaadiniinta ee Gobolka Garissa.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag e-Citizen registration e County mar Garissa.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds the public in Nairobi County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this December.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba maoni juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka yanakaribishwa Desemba hii.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nairobi in talooyinka dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette oparo ne ji duto e County mar Nairobi ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds the public in Nyandarua County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mkurugenzi Mkuu wa Ukaguzi hukumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu dadka ku xasuustaa gobolka Nyandarua in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General paronwa ji duto e County mar Nyandarua ni lando wach tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General opens the electoral calendar centres in Kwale County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Kwale Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu furayaa xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee Gobolka Kwale bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Auditor General chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e county mar Kwale e dwe mar Mach.

English: NCPB advises farmers in Kisumu County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kisumu inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qaybqaataan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e County mar Kisumu mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds residents of Nyamira County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba upatikanaji wa usajili wa e-Citizen sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira in helitaanka diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone jogweng' mar Nyamira County ni yudo e-Citizen registration koro yot ahinya kokalo kuom chenro mag sirkal.

English: HELB calls on the community in Isiolo County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: HELB inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: HELB waxay bulshada degmada Isiolo ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyo.
Dholuo: HELB luongo oganda manie Isiolo County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: During Uganda's May rains, farmers and communities are advised to monitor weather updates and early warnings, harvest rainwater to maximize agricultural production, secure roofs and structures before storms, and clear drainage channels to reduce flood damage to crops and property.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa mvua za Mei za Uganda, wakulima na jamii wanashauriwa kufuatilia sasisho za hali ya hewa na maonyo ya mapema, kuvuna maji ya mvua ili kuongeza uzalishaji wa kilimo, kulinda paa na miundo kabla ya dhoruba, na kusafisha mifereji ya maji ili kupunguza uharibifu wa mafuriko kwa mazao na mali.
Somali: Inta lagu jiro roobabka May ee Uganda, beeraleyda iyo bulshooyinka waxaa lagu talinayaa inay la socdaan cusbooneysiinta cimilada iyo digniino hore, ay urursadaan biyaha roobka si loo kordhiyo wax soo saarka beeraha, la sugo saqafyada iyo dhismayaasha ka hor duufaannada, iyo inay nadiifiyaan kanaalada biyo-mareenka si loo yareeyo waxyeelada daadadka ee dalagyada iyo hantida.
Dholuo: E kinde koth ma koth chue e dwe mar Mei e piny Uganda, ijiwo jopur kod oganda mondo onon weche mag yamo kod siem ma ne ochiw chon, gichop pi koth mondo omi tij pur omed bedo maber, girit ute koda ute ma ne ok nyal yiengni, kendo gipuonj ji mondo oketh yore mag ywayo pi mondo omi koth kod gik moko okethre.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Nyamira County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kumtia moyo rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Nyamira inuu ku dhiirrigeliyo saaxiibkiisa dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar paro e County mar Nyamira mondo ojiw osiepne moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: NPS urges the public in Tharaka-Nithi County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of identity theft.
Kiswahili: NPS inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi za wizi wa kitambulisho zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: NPS waxay ugu baaqaysaa shacabka degmada Tharaka-Nithi inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee tuugista aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: NPS okwayo ji duto e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' weche mag kwalo kitgi.

English: Teachers Service Commission invites youth in Kilifi County to enroll for tailoring and design training this March.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni Machi hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa ku casuumay dhalinyarada degmada Kilifi inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka dharka iyo naqshadeynta bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj gwelo rowere e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo odonj e tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko e dwe mar Mach.

English: TVET conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Kajiado County this September.
Kiswahili: TVET inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Kajiado Septemba hii.
Somali: TVET waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha gobolka Kajiado bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: TVET timo romo mar tiego ji e wi migawo mar Ombudsman e Kajiado County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Keep  mosquito repellent at home, especially during the rainy season.
Kiswahili: Weka dawa ya kuzuia mbu nyumbani, hasa wakati wa mvua.
Somali: Guriga ku hay cayayaanka, gaar ahaan xilliyada roobka.
Dholuo: Bed gi yath ma geng'o kute e odi, to ahinya ahinya e kinde koth.

English: Daily activity checklist to improve mental health
Kiswahili: Orodha ya shughuli za kila siku ili kuboresha afya ya akili
Somali: Liiska waxqabadyada maalinlaha ah si loo hagaajiyo caafimaadka maskaxda
Dholuo: Chenro mar timo gik moko pile ka pile mondo okony ng'ato obed gi paro mowinjore

English: FAO advises farmers in West Pokot County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: FAO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: FAO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada West Pokot inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e West Pokot County mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Nyandarua County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun iyo biyo nadiif ah si joogto ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health nyiso jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Universities Fund urges parents and teachers in Wajir County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku boorinayaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Wajir inay u soo sheegaan maamulka dugsiga wixii arrimo ah oo ku saabsan amniga.
