Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Wajir mondo onyis jotend skul wach moro amora motudore gi ritruok.

English: Notice: Council of Governors launches county development projects in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa bilaabay mashaariic horumarineed oo ka socda gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Jaloch ochako tich mar timo dongruok e kaunti mar Nyandarua.

English: Government funds expansion of Early Childhood Development centers to increase access to foundational education.
Kiswahili: Serikali hufadhili upanuzi wa vituo vya Maendeleo ya Utoto wa Mapema ili kuongeza upatikanaji wa elimu ya msingi.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay maalgelisaa ballaarinta xarumaha Horumarinta Carruurta Hore si loo kordhiyo helitaanka waxbarashada aasaasiga ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal chulo pesa mag yaro kuonde mitimoe dongruok mar nyithindo ma tindo mondo omed yudo tiegruok.

English: NTSA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kakamega County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba upatikanaji wa maelekezo ya makazi salama unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee Gobolka Kakamega in helitaanka tixraacyada magangelyo ammaan ah ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: NTSA parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni thuolo mar yudo kuonde mag dak ma onge tuoche yudore nono.

English: Notice: FAO will train farmers in Meru County on terracing this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru juu ya terracing Januari hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: FAO waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Meru ee ku saabsan dhulka lagu beeray bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: FAO biro tiego jopur e county mar Meru e dwe mar Januar.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Isiolo County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this drought season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi wakati huu wa ukame.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo inay guryahooda ku rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo shaqada xilliyada abaarta.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service paronwa jogweng' Isiolo County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo giti e kinde mar oro.

English: Teachers Service Commission calls on the community in Nyeri County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ugu baaqay bulshada degmada Nyeri inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban si loo ilaaliyo nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo ji duto manie County mar Nyeri mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo omi skunde obed ma onge tuoche.

English: KEMSA encourages residents of Bungoma County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay ka qayb galaan kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Mandera County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurka laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health nyiso jogweng'o mag Mandera County mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth mar oganda ma onge chudo mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will conduct a fertiliser application workshop for farmers in Machakos County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itafanya warsha ya maombi ya mbolea kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan isticmaalka bacriminta beeraleyda degmada Machakos bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro timo tiegruok mar tiyo gi yien mag yien ne jopur e kaunti mar Machakos e dwe mar Agost.

English: Postpartum depression is real. Encourage new mothers to seek help and talk openly.
Kiswahili: Msongo wa mawazo baada ya kujifungua ni halisi. Wahimize akina mama wapya kutafuta msaada na kuzungumza waziwazi.
Somali: Dhibaatada dhalmada ka dib waa mid dhab ah. Hooyooyinka cusub ku dhiirigeliso inay caawimaad raadsadaan oo ay si furan u hadlaan.
Dholuo: Jiw mine manyien mondo omany kony kendo owuo ayanga.

English: TVET encourages out-of-school children in Mandera County to register their children at the nearest public school under free primary education.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Mandera kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Mandera inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan iskuulka guud ee ugu dhow ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e county mar Mandera mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni gi skul mar sirkal ka gin gi tiegruok ma onge chudo.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages residents of Nyeri County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay ku dhiiri galiyaan saaxiibka dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo jogweng' Nyeri County mondo kik gisandre aling' ling' kendo mondo gijiw osiepgi moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: Pipe up! Enroll in plumbing vocational courses.
Kiswahili: Jiunge nasi! Jiandikishe katika kozi za ufundi za mabomba.
Somali: Isku qor koorsooyinka xirfadeed ee biyaha.
Dholuo: Dhi e tiegruok mar tiyo gi pi.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will distribute certified rice seed to farmers in Trans Nzoia County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itasambaza mbegu za mpunga zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka ayaa abuurka bariiska ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doona beeraleyda Gobolka Trans Nzoia bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro pogo kodhi mag loso kodhi ne jopur e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia e dwe mar Julai.

English: NDMA urges residents of Siaya County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay iskaashi la sameeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyadoo la xoojinayo amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo jogweng' county mar Siaya mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji ng'enyie e bwo sirkal.

English: NPS urges residents of Kisii County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NPS inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa umakini mkubwa kwa ujenzi wa amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay iskaashi ku sameeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kisii mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji ng'enyie e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi kuom loso kuwe e piny.

English: KEMRI encourages mothers in Lamu County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Lamu kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Lamu inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo mine e County mar Lamu mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) invites residents of Turkana County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kuwasilisha maandishi ya kumbukumbu kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Guddiga Garsoorka Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) gwelo joma odak e County mar Turkana mondo ochiw ripot mondik kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso chenro mag dongruok ochopo.

English: FAO urges beans growers in Kisii County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawataka wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Kisii kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Kisii inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si loo wanaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma pidho keyo e gweng' mar Kisii mondo oti gi kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo okony e medo nyak mar cham e higani.

English: IGAD commits to improving food and nutrition security in Africa. Data shows 21% of people across IGAD member states are food insecure
Kiswahili: IGAD imejitolea kuboresha usalama wa chakula na lishe barani Afrika. Takwimu zinaonyesha 21% ya watu katika nchi wanachama wa IGAD hawana uhakika wa chakula
Somali: IGAD waxay ka go'an tahay in la wanaajiyo ammaanka cuntada iyo nafaqada ee Afrika.
Dholuo: IGAD ochiwore mondo otim dongruok e weche mag chiemo kod chiemb chuny e Afrika.

English: KEPHIS reminds livestock keepers in Nandi County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha Nandi County inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska xayawaanada ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KEPHIS paronwa jorit jamni e county mar Nandi ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free trauma counselling support is available through county health facilities in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa ushauri wa kiwewe unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Tana River.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah ee la talinta dhaawaca laga helo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Tana River County.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo yudore maonge chudo kokalo kuom kuonde thieth e taon mar Tana River County.

English: Notice from KEMRI: childhood immunization clinics will run every February at designated health centres in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa KEMRI: kliniki za chanjo za watoto zitafanya kazi kila Februari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid KEMRI: rugta tallaalka carruurta ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Febraayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee lagu magacaabo degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMRI: Klinike mag thiedho nyithindo biro tiyo e dwe mar Februar e kuonde thieth moyier e kaunti mar Isiolo.

English: TSC advises applicants in Isiolo County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: TSC inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: TSC waxay ku talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Isiolo inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee la heli karo.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e gweng' mar Isiolo mondo odhi e otas mar tiegruok matiyo ne Nyasaye man machiegni kodgi.

English: Kenya has confirmed 3 people infected with MPOX the county of Busia. The Minstry of Health has issued alerts on MPOX transimission.
Kiswahili: Kenya imethibitisha watu 3 wameambukizwa virusi vya MPOX katika wilaya ya Busia. Wizara ya Afya imetoa tahadhari juu ya maambukizi ya mpOX.
Somali: Kenya ayaa xaqiijisay 3 qof oo ku dhaawacmay cudurka MPOX ee gobolka Busia. Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa soo saartay digniino ku saabsan gudbinta mpOX.
Dholuo: Kenya oseyudo ni ji adek nigi tuo mar MPOX e county mar Busia.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Kisumu County this May.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Mei hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa ku dhawaaqday jimicsi tallaal oo bilaash ah oo cudurka Newcastle ee lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Kisumu bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development olando chenro mar yudo chanjo mar tuo mar Newcastle maonge chudo ne dhok mag Kisumu County e dwe mar abich.

English: Communities should educate and support adolescents to avoid early pregnancies through life skills, counseling, and access to reproductive health services.
Kiswahili: Jamii zinapaswa kuwaelimisha na kuwasaidia vijana kuepuka mimba za mapema kupitia ujuzi wa maisha, ushauri nasaha, na upatikanaji wa huduma za afya ya uzazi.
Somali: Bulshooyinka waa inay bartaan oo taageeraan dhalinyarada si ay uga fogaadaan uurka hore iyada oo loo marayo xirfadaha nolosha, la talinta, iyo helitaanka adeegyada caafimaadka taranka.
Dholuo: Oganda onego opuonj kendo okony rowere ma rowere mondo kik ginyuol chon ka gitiyo gi lony ma gin-go e ngima, chiwo puonj, kendo tiyo gi yore mag thieth mar nyuol.

English: Rwandan farmers and agricultural stakeholders are advised to enhance their desert locust preparedness following recent training from FAO Stay informed on control operations and preventive measures
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Rwanda na wadau wa kilimo wanashauriwa kuimarisha utayarishaji wao wa nzige wa jangwani kufuatia mafunzo ya hivi majuzi kutoka FAO Kaa na taarifa juu ya shughuli za udhibiti na hatua za kuzuia.
Somali: Beeraleyda Rwanda iyo daneeyayaasha beeraha waxaa lagula talinayaa inay kor u qaadaan diyaar garowga cayayaanka lamadegaanka kadib tababarkii dhawaan ee FAO. La soco hawlgallada xakamaynta iyo tallaabooyinka ka hortagga
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma tiyo e tije mag pur e piny Rwanda, kendo ma nigi paro mopogore opogore, ijiwo mondo omed bedo moikore ne thuonde mag thim bang' tiegruok ma FAO otimo e kinde mokalo.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds residents of Busia County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Busia in si deg deg ah loo soo sheegayo tuugada ay gacan ka geysaneyso in xaafadaha la ilaaliyo.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne jogweng' mar Busia County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo kuom nek konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: IEBC urges youth in Bomet County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Bomet inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada rayidka ah ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada rayidnimada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo rowere e county mar Bomet mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok gichako timo tije mag oganda.

English: NDMA warns residents of Kitui County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: NDMA inaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui juu ya kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: NDMA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui kororka qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: NDMA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kitui County e wi medruok mar chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok kare ne jatendgi.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free youth mental wellness support is available through county health facilities in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa ustawi wa akili wa vijana unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Wajir.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo ne rowere e weche thieth mar paro yudore maonge chudo kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Wajir.

English: OGP updates residents of Migori County on progress of ward-level service delivery this April.
Kiswahili: OGP inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Migori juu ya maendeleo ya utoaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya Aprili hii.
Somali: OGP waxay dadka deggan degmada Migori ka wargelineysaa horumarka adeegga heerka degmada bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: OGP osemiyo jodak mag Migori County ng'eyo dongruok mar chiwo kony e wi ward e dwe mar April.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) urges cattle farmers in Samburu County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported foot and mouth disease cases.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawataka wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da ee Gobolka Samburu inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha gobolka iyaga oo aan haysan rukhsad ka dib kiisaska cudurka afka iyo afka la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur mag jamni e county mar Samburu mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni kuonde mopogore opogore ka ok giyudo rusa bang' yudo tuoche mag dhoot.

English: KUCCPS urges youth in Tharaka-Nithi County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ugu baaqaysaa dhalinyarada degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KUCCPS ojiwo rowere e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oriwre e chokruok mar oganda mar county ka pok ochopo tije mag oganda.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) urges beans growers in Embu County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawahimiza wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Embu kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Embu inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobka si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur mag cham e county mar Embu mondo oti gi ratiro ma gichiwogo mag yien kapok koth ochue mondo okony e medo nyak mar yien e higani.

English: KTDA urges rice growers in Kilifi County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawasihi wakulima wa mchele katika Wilaya ya Kilifi kufanya mazoezi ya kugeuza mazao ili kurejesha uzazi wa udongo ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda bariiska ee degmada Kilifi inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur ma pidho opur e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber kendo mondo omi nyak obed maber e higani.

English: Public notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will host a free hand hygiene outreach in Uasin Gishu County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mikono bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska Dadweynaha: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay marti gelineysaa adeegga nadaafadda gacmaha ee bilaashka ah ee Gobolka Uasin Gishu bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Rango Kendo Luwo Tuwo biro timo chenro mar rito ler mar lwedo e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu e dwe mar Jun.

English: Transform your raw grains into a higher value honey wine Discover simple processing methods and potential markets
Kiswahili: Badilisha nafaka zako mbichi kuwa divai ya asali yenye thamani kubwa Gundua mbinu rahisi za usindikaji na masoko yanayowezekana
Somali: U beddela hadhuudhkaaga ceeriin khamri macaan oo qiimo sare leh Soo ogaada hababka wax lagu baaraandego fudud iyo suuqyada suurtagalka ah
Dholuo: Lok cham ma ok chamgo obed divai ma nigi mor mogundho mar mor kich Fwenyo yore mayot mag loso kod kuonde ma inyalo yudoe ohala

English: Sleeping under treated nets helps in preventing expectant mothers and their unborn babies from malaria infections
Kiswahili: Kulala chini ya nyavu zinazotunzwa husaidia kuwalinda akina mama wajawazito na watoto wao wasijazaliwa kutokana na maambukizo ya malaria
Somali: Hooyooyinka uurka leh iyo carruurtooda aan dhalan waxay ka hortagaan cudurrada malaria marka ay ku seexdaan shabagyada lagu daaweeyo
Dholuo: Nindo e bwo gogo konyo mon ma nigi ich kod nyithindgi ma pok onyuol yudo tuwo mar malaria

English: The government has approved the leasing of five state owned sugar factories for at least 20 years to revitalize the sugar sector Interested parties should prepare for engagement under the new leasing model
Kiswahili: Serikali imeidhinisha kukodisha viwanda vitano vya sukari vinavyomilikiwa na serikali kwa angalau miaka 20 ili kufufua sekta ya sukari Wahusika wanaovutiwa wanapaswa kujiandaa kwa ushirikiano chini ya mtindo mpya wa kukodisha.
Somali: Dowladda ayaa ansixisay in shan warshadood oo sonkor ah oo ay leedahay dawladda ay kireystaan ugu yaraan 20 sano si loo noolaado waaxda sonkorta Dhinacyada daneeyayaashu waa inay u diyaariyaan ka qaybgalka qaabka cusub ee kireysiga
Dholuo: Sirkal oseyie gi keto e leasing yiende mag sukari abich ma gin mag sirkal kuom higni 20 mondo omi ji oduog e ngima mar ohala

English: AFA encourages farmers in Makueni County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for milk.
Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora ya maziwa.
Somali: AFA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Makueni inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo caano ah.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Makueni mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro mondo omi ohala mar chak obed maber.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) restricts movement of sheep in Narok County due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inazuia harakati za kondoo katika Kaunti ya Narok kwa sababu ya mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Newcastle.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Maamulka Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) wuxuu xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa idaha ee Gobolka Narok sababtuna tahay cudurka Newcastle.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Lemo kod Chiemo (AFA) ogeng'o wuoth mar rombe e kaunti mar Narok nikech tuo mar Newcastle.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on residents of Wajir County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Uhalifu unawaomba wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ugu baaqay dadka deggan degmada Wajir inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga dhaqdhaqaaqa aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah si ay u taageeraan taxadarka ka dhanka ah argagixisada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations okwayo jogweng' mar Wajir County mondo onyis sirkal mag sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e gwenge man machiegni gi tong'gi.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will distribute certified tea seed to farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu za chai zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu abuurka shaaha ee shahaadada la siiyo beeraleyda degmada Tharaka-Nithi bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Dairy Board biro pogo kodhi mag chai ne jopur e Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar Januar.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Marsabit County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba ufikiaji wa usaidizi wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Marsabit in helitaanka taageerada sheegashada NHIF/SHA ay hadda ka heli karto xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa ji duto e county mar Marsabit ni koro ginyalo yudo kony mar kwayo kwayo kuom NHIF/SHA e kuonde moyier.

English: NDMA urges residents of Kajiado County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida katika maeneo ya mpakani kwa vyombo vya usalama huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa wa ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay soo sheegaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar sirkal e wi gik ma ne timore e alwora mar tong'gi nikech ji osebedo ka keto pachgi ahinya kuom loso kuwe e piny.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Bomet County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Uhalifu unafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Bomet Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada wuxuu qabtaa aqoon-isweydaarsiga bulshada ee ka dhanka ah ka hortagga argagixisada degmada Bomet bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Directorate of Criminal Investigations dhi e romo mar oganda e dwe mar Desemba e kaunti mar Bomet.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds the public in Turkana County that reporting embezzlement of public funds is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa fedha za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu dadweynaha degmada Turkana ku xasuusinayaa in warbixinta xadgudubka lacagaha dawladda ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette paronwa ji duto e County mar Turkana ni golo ripot mar ketho pesa mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: Branding helps differentiate your vegetables. Learn how to create a simple brand identity and market your vegetables effectively.
Kiswahili: Utambulisho wa chapa husaidia kutofautisha mboga zako. Jifunze jinsi ya kuunda utambulisho rahisi wa chapa na kuuza mboga zako kwa ufanisi.
Somali: Calaamadeynta waxay kaa caawineysaa inaad kala soocdo khudaartaada. Baro sida loo abuuro aqoonsi calaamadeysan oo si wax ku ool ah loogu suuqgeeyo khudaarkaaga.
Dholuo: Tiyo gi ranyisi mar ng'ato e loso olembe mopogore opogore biro konyi ng'eyo kaka inyalo loso nying' mar olembe e yo mayot kendo tiyo gi olembego e yo mong'ith.

English: KTDA invites farmers in Kirinyaga County to a free training on record keeping for farmers this March.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima Machi hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kirinyaga tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan diiwaangelinta beeralayda bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: KTDA ogwelo jopur e gweng' mar Kirinyaga e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar rito rekod mag jopur dwe mar Mach.

English: National Plant Protection Organizations in 12 African countries are being equipped with tools and training to combat Potato Cyst Nematodes Early detection is crucial for protecting potato crops and livelihoods
Kiswahili: Mashirika ya Kitaifa ya Kulinda Mimea katika nchi 12 za Afrika yanapewa zana na mafunzo ya kukabiliana na Nematodi ya Viazi Kugunduliwa mapema ni muhimu ili kulinda mazao ya viazi na maisha.
Somali: Ururada Qaranka ee Ilaalinta Dhirta ee 12 dal oo Afrika ah ayaa lagu qalabeeyay qalab iyo tababar lagula dagaalanka Potato Cyst Nematodes. Ogaanshaha hore waa muhiim si loo ilaaliyo dalagyada baradhada iyo nolosha
Dholuo: Riwruoge mag National Plant Protection Organization e pinje 12 mag Afrika yudo gige tich kod tiegruok mar kedo gi kitaya mag Potato Cyst Nematodes

English: Monitor pasture, water, body condition, and disease among livestock.
Kiswahili: Fuatilia malisho, maji, hali ya mwili, na magonjwa kati ya mifugo.
Somali: La soco daaqsiga, biyaha, xaaladda jirka, iyo cudurrada xoolaha.
Dholuo: Nonuru kuonde ma ji yudoe yiende, pi, chal mar dendgi, kod tuoche ma bedoe e kind jamni.

English: COMESA advises farmers in Turkana County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Turkana inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e county mar Turkana mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: As climate change impacts corn production, hybrid seed technology could help improve yields and combat food insecurity around the world.
Kiswahili: Mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa yanapoathiri uzalishaji wa mahindi, teknolojia ya mbegu mseto inaweza kusaidia kuboresha mavuno na kupambana na uhaba wa chakula duniani kote.
Somali: Maaddaama isbeddelka cimilada uu saameyn ku yeesho wax soo saarka hadhuudhka, tikniyoolajiyadda abuurka isku dhafan waxay gacan ka geysan kartaa hagaajinta wax soo saarka iyo la dagaalanka amaanka cuntada adduunka oo dhan.
Dholuo: Nikech lokruok mar alwora chiko kaka cham nyago cham, teknoloji mar pidho kodhi ma nigi kodhi mopogore opogore nyalo konyo e medo nyak mar cham kendo kedo gi tuoche mag chiemo e piny mangima.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will distribute certified beans seed to farmers in Trans Nzoia County this April.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu zilizothibitishwa za maharagwe kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu abuuraha Trans Nzoia County u qaybin doonaa abuurka xoolaha ee la caddeeyay bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro pogo kodhi mag nyinyo ne jopur e Trans Nzoia County e dwe mar April.

English: EU and Kenya partnership supports effective implementation of NSCVE.
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano wa EU na Kenya unaunga mkono utekelezaji mzuri wa NSCVE.
Somali: Wadashaqeynta Midowga Yurub iyo Kenya waxay taageertaa hirgelinta wax ku oolka ah ee NSCVE.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar pinje mag EU kod Kenya konyo e chopo chenro mar NSCVE e yo maber.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response urges residents of Tana River County to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers following a rise in reported HIV/AIDS cases.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya VVU/UKIMWI.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River County inay soo sheegaan kiisas kasta oo laga shakiyo mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada ka dib kororka kiisaska HIV / AIDS ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo onyis jorit malony mag thieth mar oganda ni giparo ni gin gi tuoche nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuoche mag HIV/AIDS osemedore.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges residents of Busia County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida katika maeneo ya mpakani kwa vyombo vya usalama huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa wa ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya dadka deggan degmada Busia inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga dhaqdhaqaaq aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal aagagga xuduudka ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nabadgelyada qaranka.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo jogweng' County mar Busia mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkande mag sirkal e wi gik ma ne timore e alwora mar tong'gi nikech ji osebedo ka keto pachgi ahinya kuom loso kuwe e pinygi.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges youth in Bomet County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Bomet kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ugu baaqay dhalinyarada degmada Bomet inay ka qeybgalaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo rowere e county mar Bomet mondo oriwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gitimo tije mag oganda.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service conducts a community briefing on border security in Kwale County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Kwale Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu qabtaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha degmada Kwale bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Forest Service timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e Kwale County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: KUCCPS reminds needy students in Nyeri County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba vitabu vya kiada na matumizi ya vifaa vya kujifunzia hufungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Nyeri in buugaagta waxbarasho iyo codsiyada qalabka wax lagu barto ay dhowaan soo gabagabeyn doonaan.
Dholuo: KUCCPS paronwa jopuonjre man Nyeri County ni buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok biro rumo machiegni.

English: NTSA urges residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay soo sheegaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkande mag sirkal e wi gik ma ne timore e alwora mar tong'gi nikech ji osebedo ka kawo okang' mar kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Climate smart agriculture is an approach that helps to guide actions needed to transform and reorient agricultural systems effectively support...
Kiswahili: Kilimo kiakili cha hali ya hewa ni mbinu ambayo husaidia kuongoza hatua zinazohitajika kubadilisha na kuelekeza upya mifumo ya kilimo kwa ufanisi kusaidia ...
Somali: Beeraha caqli-galka ah ee cimilada waa habka ka caawiya hagaajinta tallaabooyinka loo baahan yahay si loo beddelo loona habeeyo nidaamyada beeraha si wax ku ool ah u taageero...
Dholuo: Chenro mar timo gik ma kelo lokruok e alwora ma ngima dhano odakie konyo e tayo gik madwarore e loko kendo rieyo yore mag timo gik moko e yo maber mondo okony...

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public that free cholera screening is available at all public health centres in Lamu County this December.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kipindupindu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Lamu Desemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka fayraska ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Lamu bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health parone ji ni nonro ma onge cholera yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Lamu e dwe mar Desemba.

English: The Nairobi Coffee Exchange remains under the Coffee Directorate s oversight the Capital Markets Authority is advised to refrain from licensing it as an auction
Kiswahili: Soko la Kahawa la Nairobi limesalia chini ya usimamizi wa Kurugenzi ya Kahawa.
Somali: Nairobi Coffee Exchange waxay weli hoos timaadaa kormeerka Directorate-ka Kafeega, Capital Markets Authority waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaato ruqsad u qaadista sida xaraash
Dholuo: Nairobi Coffee Exchange pod ni e bwo teko mar Directorate of Coffee.

English: There is no shyness when you are looking for help when you have a problem. Seeking for help is not weakness, but a sign of strengtht. If you know someone in proplems, reach out to him or her for help
Kiswahili: Hakuna aibu kumtafuta msaada unapokuwa na tatizo. Kutafuta msaada si udhaifu bali ni ishara ya nguvu.
Somali: Ma jiro ceeb markaad caawimaad raadineyso markaad dhibaato qabtid, caawimaadda raadinta ma aha daciifnimo balse waa calaamad xoog leh, haddii aad taqaano qof dhibaataysan, u tag caawimaada.
Dholuo: Ka ng'ato dwaro kony sama en gi chandruok, ok onego obed maluor, nimar kwayo kony ok en nyawo, to en gima nyiso ni en gi teko.

English: Notice: IPOA launches a fraud prevention campaign in Kitui County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Kitui Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga khiyaamooyinka degmada Kitui bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA chako kampen mar geng'o wuondruok e taon mar Kitui e dwe mar Januar.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service invites farmers in Vihiga County to a free training on post-harvest handling this February.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno Februari hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku casuumay beeraleyda degmada Vihiga tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan maareynta goosashada ka dib bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service ogwelo jopur e County mar Vihiga e tiegruok ma onge chudo e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: NDMA issues a cybersecurity alert on SIM-swap fraud affecting residents of Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaanooyinka SIM-swap ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Mombasa.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NDMA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag intanet kuom wuond mag SIM-swap makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e County mar Mombasa.

English: Washington Post highlighted unresolved disappearances tied to protest crackdowns, intensifying calls for investigative transparency.
Kiswahili: Washington Post iliangazia kutoweka bila kutatuliwa kuhusiana na mapigano ya maandamano, ikiongeza wito kwa ufunuo wa uchunguzi.
Somali: Wargeyska Washington Post ayaa soo bandhigay la'aanta aan la xallin ee la xidhiidha ciqaabada banaanbaxa, taasoo xoojineysa baaqa loo qabo in baaritaanka la caddeeyo.
Dholuo: Washington Post nojiwo wach ywaruok ma ne nitie e kind joma ne olal ma ne ok nyal geng'o gik ma ne timore, kendo mano nomiyo omedo jiwo ji mondo otim nonro e yo ma winjore maler.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges residents of Baringo County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika kumbi za umma huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa katika ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay iskaashi la sameeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saaray dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo jogweng' Baringo County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar rito weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'enyie nikech ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom loso kuwe e piny.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges poultry farmers in West Pokot County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inahimiza wafugaji wa kuku katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda digaagga ee degmada West Pokot inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska cudurka anthrax ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur ma pidho dhok e West Pokot County mondo ochiw ripot ne jamni matuwo man machiegni gi kama thieth thiedho dhok nitie bang' yudo kit tuoche mag anthrax.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Bungoma County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the April planting season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kudhibiti minyoo mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji Aprili.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Bungoma inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur manie Bungoma County mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e dwe mar April.

Kiswahili: Wasichana wanapofaulu, jamii nzima hubadilika": Makazi ya mashambani nchini Kenya yanayowapa wasichana matumaini zaidi ya ukeketaji

English: IEBC invites youth in Mombasa County to enroll for tailoring and design training this July.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni Julai hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Mombasa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka tailoring iyo naqshadeynta bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: IEBC gwelo rowere e County mar Mombasa mondo odonj e tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko e dwe mar Julai.

English: Ministry of Youth Affairs, Education partners implement digital literacy programs targeted at out-of-school youth.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Mambo ya Vijana, Washirika wa Elimu wanazindua mipango ya elimu ya dijiti inayolenga vijana nje ya shule.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dhallinyarada, Wada-hawlgalayaasha Waxbarashada waxay hirgeliyaan barnaamijyo akhriska dhijitaalka ah oo loogu talagalay dhalinyarada ka baxsan dugsiga.
Dholuo: Ministry of Youth Affairs, Education partners tiyo gi chenro mag somo gi somo e yor digital ma konyo rowere maok dhi e skul.

English: IEBC reminds voters in Samburu County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Samburu kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha gobolka Samburu inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor nidaamyada doorashada.
Dholuo: IEBC paronwa jogedo e county mar Samburu mondo oting'e ID mar piny kata passport e odiechieng' mar yiero ka pok itimo yiero.

English: KALRO announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for sheep in Wajir County this October.
Kiswahili: KALRO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Wajir Oktoba hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee idaha ee Gobolka Wajir bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KALRO ogolo chenro mar thiedho rombo e dwe mar Oktoba e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: Notice: DPP activates an emergency response plan for flooding in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DPP inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ku saabsan fatahaadaha Gobolka Laikipia.
Dholuo: Rapar: DPP tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne ataro e gweng' mar Laikipia.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free meningitis screening is available at all public health centres in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this January.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa uti wa mgongo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Januari hii.
Somali: Laanta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka meningitis ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross parone ji ni nono tuo mar meningitis en gima onge chudo e kuonde thieth duto e County Elgeyo-Marakwet e dwe mar Januar.

English: Amref Health Africa Launches â€˜Tucheze Tustawiâ€™ Project to Support Early Childhood Development in Refugee and Host Communities in Turkana West Sub-county
Kiswahili: Amref Health Africa Yazindua Mradi wa â€˜Tucheze Tustawiâ€™ wa Kusaidia Ukuaji wa Utotoni katika Jumuiya za Wakimbizi na Wenyeji katika Kaunti Ndogo ya Turkana Magharibi.
Somali: Amref Health Africa waxay Bilaabaysaa Mashruuca "Tucheze Tustawi" si loo Taageero Horumarinta Carruurnimada Hore ee Bulshada Qaxootiga iyo Martigelinta ee Degmo-hoosaadka Galbeedka Turkana
Dholuo: Amref Thieth Afrika Ochako chenro mar konyo dongruok mar nyithindo matindo e gwenge ma jolweny kod jolweny ma rwakogi e gwenge matin mar Turkana ma milambo

English: NDMA warns residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County about a rise in phishing messages and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya kuongezeka kwa ujumbe wa phishing na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: NDMA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in ay kordheen fariimaha phishing waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga leh bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: NDMA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County e wi medruok mar ote mag phishing kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar ote manyalo kelo hinyruok ne jatendgi.

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health warns of increased HIV/AIDS risk in Elgeyo-Marakwet County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya VVU/UKIMWI katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet na inashauri umma kutumia vyandarua vya mbu vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Talada caafimaadka dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ka digtay khatarta sii kordheysa ee HIV/AIDS ee gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Rieko mar thieth mar ji: Ministry of Health osiemo ji kuom medo bedo gi tuo mar AYAKI/AIDS e County mar Elgeyo-Marakwet kendo ojiwo ji mondo oti gi net mag kute ma otigo gi yedhe makelo tuoche mag kute otieno ka otieno.

English: Leveraging new opportunities Malaria vaccination visits are also creating new opportunities for healthcare workers to see children who might not otherwise come to health centers or hospitalsâ€”and screen them for any other missed vaccinations.
Kiswahili: Kutumia fursa mpya Ziara za chanjo ya Malaria pia zinaunda fursa mpya kwa wahudumu wa afya kuwaona watoto ambao pengine wasije kwenye vituo vya afya au hospitaliâ€”na kuwapima ili kubaini chanjo nyingine zozote walizokosa.
Somali: Ka faa'iidaysiga fursadaha cusub Booqashooyinka tallaalka duumada ayaa sidoo kale abuuraya fursado cusub oo shaqaalaha daryeelka caafimaadka ay ku arki karaan carruurta aan haddii kale imaan karin xarumaha caafimaadka ama isbitaallada - oo ay ka baari karaan tallaallada kale ee la seegay.
Dholuo: Kuom tiyo kod thuolo manyien Limo mag ng'ado chanjo mar malaria bende kelo thuolo manyien ne jotich mag thieth mondo gine nyithindo ma nyalo bedo ni ok bi e kar thieth kata e osiptalâ€” kendo ng'iyogi mondo gine ni nitie chanjo mamoko ma ne giweyo.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: skilled birth attendance clinics will run every January at designated health centres in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi: kliniki za mahudhurio ya uzazi zenye ujuzi zitaendeshwa kila Januari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka: rugaha dhalmada ee xirfadlayaasha ah waxaa lagu qaban doonaa Janaayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee lagu magacaabo degmada Laikipia.
Dholuo: Rieko moa e Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: Klinike ma nigi lony mar rito nyuol ibiro tiyoe e dwe mar Januar e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Laikipia.

English: Notice: ODPP launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Bungoma County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ka dhanka ah degmada Bungoma bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Rapar: ODPP chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Bungoma e dwe mar Julai.

English: State Department for TVET urges youth in Kakamega County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kakamega inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda ka hor inta aysan qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET ojiwo rowere man Kakamega County mondo onyis weche ma gin-go mar ndiko ji kapok gitimo tije mag oganda.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Migori County to attend the public participation forum to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Migori kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Migori inay ka qayb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si loo qaabeeyo madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' Migori County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar loso chenro mar dongruok.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Turkana County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Adeegga kaynta Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan khiyaamooyinka ay gacan ka geystaan ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service parone jogweng' Turkana County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar wuondruok konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: KUCCPS opened its portal for inter-institutional transfers for 2025/2026 placements targeting TVET and university students.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS ilifungua portal yake ya uhamisho wa kati ya taasisi kwa ajili ya mafunzo ya 2025/2026 ambayo yanalenga wanafunzi wa TVET na vyuo vikuu.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay furtay boggeeda kala iibsiga hay'adaha ee loogu talagalay booska 2025/2026, oo loogu talagalay ardayda TVET iyo jaamacadaha.
Dholuo: KUCCPS ne oyawo dhoot mare mar golo pesa e kind riwruoge mopogore opogore e higa mar 2025/2026 ne jopuonjre mag TVET kod mag yunivasiti.

English: Always keep your childÂ’s health card and birth certificate safe for school, healthcare, and legal needs.
Kiswahili: Daima weka kadi ya afya ya mtoto wako na cheti cha kuzaliwa salama kwa mahitaji ya shule, huduma ya afya, na kisheria.
Somali: Had iyo jeer kaarka caafimaadka iyo shahaadada dhalashada ilmahaaga u ilaali inay ku badbaadaan iskuulka, daryeelka caafimaadka, iyo baahiyaha sharciga.
Dholuo: Kinde duto, rit kad mar thieth mar nyathini kod oboke mar nyuol maber mondo otigodo e skul, thieth, kod dwaro mag chik.

English: To achieve the optimal planting density for groundnut, sow one seed per hole at an inter-row spacing of 30cm and intra-row spacing of 15cm (or 45cm inter-row and 10cm intra-row for easier weeding); do the first weeding between 20 and 50 days after planting, depending on local weed growth.
Kiswahili: Ili kufikia msongamano bora wa upandaji wa karanga, panda mbegu moja kwa kila shimo kwa nafasi ya kati ya safu ya 30cm na nafasi ya ndani ya safu ya 15cm (au 45cm kati ya safu na 10cm ndani ya safu kwa kupalilia kwa urahisi); Fanya kupalilia kwanza kati ya siku 20 na 50 baada ya kupanda, kulingana na ukuaji wa magugu ya ndani.
Somali: Si loo gaaro cufnaanta ugu habboon ee beerta lowska, hal abuur ku beer dalool kasta oo leh masaafo u dhexeysa safka 30cm iyo dhexda safka 15cm (ama 45cm dhexda safka iyo 10cm dhexda safka si loo fududeeyo cawska cawska); Ka saar cawska ugu horreeya inta u dhaxaysa 20 ilaa 50 maalmood kadib beerista, iyadoo ku xiran koritaanka cawska deegaanka.

English: NPS urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kericho County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NPS inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuripoti kesi kwenye dawati la karibu la jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Kericho inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e gweng' mar Kericho mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Applying tradical medicine on soft parts of a child is harmful. It should stop
Kiswahili: Kutumia dawa za kitamaduni kwenye sehemu nyembamba za mtoto ni hatari.
Somali: Isticmaalka daawooyinka caadiga ah qaybaha jilicsan ee ilmaha waa waxyeello. Waa in la joojiyaa
Dholuo: Tiyo gi yedhe mapile e thieth ne nyithindo mayom kelo hinyruok.

English: Notice from SHA (Social Health Authority): nutrition supplementation for infants clinics will run every May at designated health centres in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii): nyongeza ya lishe kwa kliniki za watoto wachanga itaendeshwa kila Mei katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada): Kordhinta nafaqada ee rugta caafimaadka ee dhallaanka ayaa lagu sameyn doonaa bishii Maajo ee kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Rieko moa kuom SHA (Social Health Authority): chiemo moromo mag nyithindo mayom biro dhi nyime e klinik dwe mar abich higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Kirinyaga.

English: Despite this responsibility, they frequently have less control and more insecure access to resources; influenced by various interconnected cultural, ecological, economic, political and gendered aspects.
Kiswahili: Licha ya jukumu hili, mara nyingi wana udhibiti mdogo na ufikiaji usio salama wa rasilimali; kuathiriwa na nyanja mbalimbali zilizounganishwa za kitamaduni, ikolojia, kiuchumi, kisiasa na kijinsia.
Somali: Iyadoo ay jirto mas'uuliyaddan, haddana waxay inta badan leeyihiin xakameyn yar iyo marin aan ammaan ahayn oo ay u helaan kheyraadka; oo ay saameeyaan dhinacyo kala duwan oo isku xiran oo dhaqan, deegaan, dhaqaale, siyaasadeed iyo jinsi.
Dholuo: Kata obedo ni gin gi ting’ ma kamano, kinde ka kinde gin gi teko matin kendo ok gin gi geno mar yudo mwandu; ng’ato ka ng’ato nyalo ng’ado bura kuom gik mopogore opogore ma tudruokgi nitie e kindgi mag kit oganda, gik ma nyalo ketho piny, weche mag ohala, siasa kod gik ma mulo kido mar chuech.

English: ODPP urges eligible citizens in Mombasa County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Mombasa inay ka qaybqaataan jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro mar yiero e county mar Mombasa mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar yiero.

English: DCI calls on residents of Isiolo County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaita wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: DCI waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan kahortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: DCI okwayo jogweng' Isiolo County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji nitie mondo okony tich mar kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: FAO reminds farmers in Makueni County of the ongoing modern irrigation techniques training programme.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya mbinu za umwagiliaji wa kisasa.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Makueni barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah.
Dholuo: FAO parone jopur e gweng' mar Makueni e wi chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar yore mag lero pi.

English: Notice: NCPB will conduct a modern irrigation techniques workshop for farmers in Kitui County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itafanya warsha ya kisasa ya mbinu za umwagiliaji kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah ee beeraleyda Gobolka Kitui bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Rapar: NCPB biro timo tiegruok mar yore mag ywayo pi ne jopur e County mar Kitui e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: All COVID-19 vaccines are safe for use by adults, breastfeeding mothers and as per current WHO guidelines, can also be used by pregnant women upon recommendation by a qualified physician.
Kiswahili: Chanjo zote za COVID-19 ni salama kwa matumizi ya watu wazima, akina mama wanaonyonyesha na kulingana na miongozo ya sasa ya WHO, zinaweza pia kutumiwa na wanawake wajawazito kwa mapendekezo ya daktari aliyehitimu.
Somali: Dhammaan tallaallada COVID-19 waxay ammaan u yihiin dadka waaweyn, hooyooyinka naas nuujinaya iyo sida ku cad tilmaamaha WHO ee hadda jira, haweenka uurka leh ayaa sidoo kale isticmaali kara talobixinta dhakhtarka aqoonta leh.
Dholuo: Yore duto mag thieth mar COVID-19 gin mag ritruok ne joma dongo, mine machiemo kendo kaluwore gi chike mag sani mag WHO, mon ma nigi ich bende nyalo tiyo kodgi ka laktar molony onyisi.

English: IEBC reminds the public in Kakamega County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: IEBC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha Gobolka Kakamega in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: IEBC paronwa ji duto e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni lando wach tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'.

English: State Department for Basic Education invites youth in Murang'a County to enroll for tailoring and design training this November.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni Novemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku casuumaysaa dhalinyarada degmada Murang'a inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka tailoring iyo naqshadeynta bisha November.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education ogwelo rowere e County mar Murang'a mondo odonj e tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Effective vegetable farming and fruits to increase revenues. Search better approaches and available markets.
Kiswahili: Kilimo bora cha mboga na matunda ili kuongeza mapato. Tafuta njia bora na masoko yanayopatikana.
Somali: Waxtarka beeraha khudaarta iyo miraha si loo kordhiyo dakhliga. Raadinta hababka wanaagsan iyo suuqyada la heli karo.
Dholuo: Tiyo gi yore mag pidho cham gi cham e yo maber mondo omi ng'ato oyud pesa momedore.

English: NDMA urges motorists and pedestrians in Makueni County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa wadayaasha baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Makueni inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada ay fatahaadu ka dhacdo si looga hortago dhacdooyinka fatahaadda.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo joidh mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Makueni mondo kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o mondo kik yud masira mar pi.

English: Advocacy Brief: Enhancing Policy Responses to Addressing Child Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (CSEA) in Kenya (January 2023)
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Utetezi: Kuimarisha Majibu ya Sera ya Kushughulikia Unyanyasaji na Unyanyasaji wa Kijinsia kwa Watoto (CSEA) nchini Kenya (Januari 2023)
Somali: Warbixinta Kooban ee U-doodista: Kobcinta Jawaabaha Siyaasadda ee wax ka qabashada Xadgudubka iyo Xadgudubka Galmada Carruurta (CSEA) ee Kenya (Janaayo 2023)
Dholuo: Oboke machuok mar puonj: Medo dwoko mag chike mag geng’o weche mag ketho nyithindo e yor nindruok (CSEA) e piny Kenya (dwe mar achiel 2023)

English: Navigating the City - The Internal Migration of Refugees from Kakuma and Dadaab Refugee Camps to Nairobi, Working paper 3 - December 2024
Kiswahili: Kupitia Jiji - Uhamiaji wa Ndani wa Wakimbizi kutoka Kambi za Wakimbizi za Kakuma na Dadaab hadi Nairobi, Mada ya Kazi 3 - Desemba 2024
Somali: U Socodka Magaalada - Socdaalka Gudaha ee Qaxootiga ka imaanaya Xeryaha Qaxootiga Kakuma iyo Dadaab una socda Nairobi, Warqadda Shaqada 3 - Diseembar 2024
Dholuo: Odhi e boma - Wuoth ma iye mar jolweny kowuok e kambi mag jolweny mag Kakuma kod Dadaab nyaka Nairobi, Oboke mar tich 3 - Desimba 2024

English: ODPP urges eligible citizens in Busia County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi raia wanaostahiki katika Kaunti ya Busia kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Busia inay ka qaybqaataan jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Busia mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar yiero.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) warns public officers in Kericho County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Kericho dhidi ya kupotosha fedha za umma.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Kericho inay ka xishoodaan dhaqaale dawladeed.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Kericho ni kik giti gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo e yo marach.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties warns public officers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet dhidi ya kupotosha fedha za umma.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet in la xakameeyo maalgashiga dowladda.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni kik giti gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo e yo marach.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) urges pigs farmers in Taita-Taveta County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawahimiza wafugaji wa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda doofaarka ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha lagu burburiyo ee loo qoondeeyay ka dib kiisaska cudurka Anthrax ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Jatelo mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur puothe e Taita-Taveta County mondo ogeng'e legi e kuonde moketi mag chwoyo puothe mag puothe bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag anthrax.

English: KNEC reminds schools in Nyamira County to strengthen inclusion of learners with disabilities this June.
Kiswahili: KNEC inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuimarisha ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu Juni hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay xusuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Nyamira inay xoojiyaan ka mid noqoshada ardayda naafada ah bisha Juun.
Dholuo: KNEC oparo ne skunde man Nyamira County mondo omed jiwo jopuonjre ma nigi midekre e dwe mar Jun.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Baringo County to attend the public participation forum to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si ay u qaabeeyaan wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynta.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya ojiwo jogweng' Baringo County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar loso chenro mag chenro mag oganda.

English: OGP encourages first-time voters in Samburu County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: OGP inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Samburu kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu.
Somali: OGP waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Samburu inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogo madwaro yiero mokwongo e county mar Samburu mondo olim kama ichanoe IEBC machiegni kodgi.

English: FAO announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for poultry in Laikipia County this March.
Kiswahili: FAO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa kuku katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Machi hii.
Somali: FAO waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee digaagga ee Gobolka Laikipia bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: FAO olando chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar dhoot e dwe mar Mach e county mar Laikipia.

English: DPP reminds residents of Machakos County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada daadadka ka dhacay xilliyada dabka.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogweng'o mag Machakos County ni kik giwuoth e kind yiengni mag mach e kinde ma pi opong'o ponde kod aoche.

English: KICD urges residents of Nyandarua County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from free primary education.
Kiswahili: KICD inawataka wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: KICD waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo odonj e program mar somo gi somo mar jomoti mondo giyud somo ma onge chudo.

English: Public launch event held to introduce the MoreMilkâ€¯2 initiative intended to enhance milk handling and market access in key milk-producing counties.
Kiswahili: Hafla ya uzinduzi wa hadhara ilifanyika ili kutambulisha mpango wa MoreMilk2 unaolenga kuboresha utunzaji wa maziwa na upatikanaji wa soko katika kaunti muhimu zinazozalisha maziwa.
Somali: Munaasabad lagu daah-furayay dadweynaha ayaa loo qabtay si loogu soo bandhigo hindisaha MoreMilkâ€2 oo loogu talagalay in lagu xoojiyo maaraynta caanaha iyo helitaanka suuqa ee degmooyinka muhiimka ah ee soo saara caanaha.
Dholuo: Ne otim chenro mar keto chak e wang' ji duto mondo oket chenro mar MoreMilkâ€ ̄2 ma ne ochung'ne loso chenro mar rito chak kod yudo chiro e gwenge madongo ma loso chak.

English: KALRO advises farmers in Makueni County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the October planting season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Oktoba.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Makueni inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Makueni mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Bungoma County about the importance of hand hygiene for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuhusu umuhimu wa usafi wa mikono kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya ayaa dadka degmada Bungoma ku xasuusinaya muhiimadda nadaafadda gacmaha ay u leeyihiin caafimaadka qoyska.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association parone ji duto e County mar Bungoma kuom ber mar rito ler mar lwedo e ngima joot.

English: Kenya: Registered refugees and asylum-seekers (as of 30 April 2022)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Wakimbizi waliosajiliwa na wanaotafuta hifadhi (kuanzia tarehe 30 Aprili 2022)

Dholuo: Kenya: Jolweny ma ondiki nyinggi kod jogo madwaro dak (chakre tarik 30 dwe mar ang'wen higa mar 2022)

English: IEBC updates residents of Nairobi County on progress of ward-level service delivery this June.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi juu ya maendeleo ya usambazaji wa huduma katika darasa mwezi Juni huu.
Somali: IEBC waxay cusbooneysiineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi ku saabsan horumarka bixinta adeegyada heerka degmada bisha Juun.
Dholuo: IEBC medo lero ne jogweng' mar Nairobi County dongruok mar chiwo kony e wi ward e dwe mar Jun.

English: "DCI confirms arrests of fake NGO representatives claiming to partner with World Food Programme in Northern Kenya. Always verify through official NGO registry."
Kiswahili: "DCI inathibitisha kukamatwa kwa wawakilishi bandia wa mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali wakidai kushirikiana na Programu ya Chakula Duniani kaskazini mwa Kenya.
Somali: "DCI waxay xaqiijineysaa in la xiray wakiilo been abuur ah oo NGO ah oo sheegta inay iskaashi la yeeshaan Barnaamijka Cuntada Adduunka ee Waqooyiga Kenya. Had iyo jeer hubi diiwaanka rasmiga ah ee NGO-yada".
Dholuo: "DCI osenyiso ni ne omak joma wuondore ni gin jokanyo mag riwruok mar NGO ma ne wacho ni gin osiepe mar World Food Programme e piny Kenya ma masawa.

English: Ministry of Education reminds schools in Uasin Gishu County to strengthen child protection in schools this July.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuimarisha ulinzi wa watoto shuleni Julai hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay dib u xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Uasin Gishu inay xoojiyaan ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education oparo ne skunde man Uasin Gishu County mondo omed jiwo rit mar nyithindo e skunde e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya Forest Service warns residents of Laikipia County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this February.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Februari hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ka digay dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay u diyaargaroobaan dabka dhici kara bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service osiemo jogweng' Laikipia County mondo oikre ne yiengni manyalo timore e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ka furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay ka shaqeynta shahaadada dhalashada ee Gobolka Nairobi.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya osechako tiyo gi ofis manyien mar rito nyasi mag nyuol e taon mar Nairobi.

English: DPP calls on the community in Tharaka-Nithi County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: DPP inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka kwa nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: DPP waxay bulshada degmada Tharaka-Nithi ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga iyo inay kaalmo ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: DPP okwayo oganda man Tharaka-Nithi County mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Notice: DCI opens a gender desk offering free legal aid in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisheria bure katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya caawimaad sharci oo lacag la'aan ah degmada Nakuru.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: DCI ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony ma onge chudo e kaunti mar Nakuru.

English: Teachers Service Commission encourages out-of-school children in Nyandarua County to register their children at the nearest public school under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya mgao wa bursary.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Nyandarua inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha iyada oo la siinayo deeq waxbarasho.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo nyithindo maok dhi e skul e County mar Nyandarua mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni gi skul mar sirkal.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds farmers in Nandi County of the ongoing fertiliser application training programme.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya matumizi ya mbolea.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Nandi barnaamijka tababarka codsiga bacriminta ee socda.
Dholuo: Jatelo mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jopur e county mar Nandi kuom chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar tiyo gi yien.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General launches the county integrated development plan in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu huzindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika wilaya ya Vihiga.
