English: Notice: KUCCPS opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inafungua maombi ya maudhui ya kujifunza dijitali bila malipo kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay codsiyada u furaysaa bartayaasha Baringo County si ay u helaan barasho digital ah oo lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KUCCPS yawo kwayo mag somo mar digital maonge chudo ne jopuonjre man Baringo County.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Kakamega County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the October planting season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kutumia viwango vilivyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Oktoba.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will conduct a fertiliser application workshop for farmers in Kisii County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itafanya warsha ya maombi ya mbolea kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan isticmaalka Bacriminta beeraleyda ee degmada Kisii bisha Juun.

English: NCPB urges cattle farmers in Kirinyaga County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported foot and mouth disease cases.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawataka wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo kuripotiwa.

English: IPOA calls on residents of Makueni County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.

Dholuo: IPOA kwayo jogweng' Makueni County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji nitie mondo okony e kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education opens a new ICT skills programme at the vocational centre in Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inafungua programu mpya ya ujuzi wa ICT katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Murang'a.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges anyone experiencing abuse in Bungoma County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya ngono katika kituo cha polisi.

Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e gweng' mar Bungoma mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) advises residents of Kiambu County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay yareeyaan qaadashada cusbada iyo sonkorta si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Kiambu mondo oket tong' e chamo chamo mor kod sukari mondo kik tuoche ma inyalo geng'e landre.

English: Nakuru County is implementing a land rehabilitation program to restore degraded land and improve agricultural productivity Farmers are encouraged to participate in soil management training and tree planting initiatives
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Nakuru inatekeleza mpango wa ukarabati wa ardhi ili kurejesha ardhi iliyoharibiwa na kuboresha uzalishaji wa kilimo Wakulima wahimizwa kushiriki katika mafunzo ya usimamizi wa udongo na mipango ya upandaji miti
Somali: Degmada Nakuru waxay hirgelinaysaa barnaamij dib-u-habeyn dhul si loo soo celiyo dhul burburay loona kordhiyo wax-soosaarka beeraha. Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay ka qaybqaataan tababarka maareynta ciidda iyo mashaariicda beerista geedaha
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Nakuru tiyo gi chenro mar loso lowo mondo ochak oduok lowo ma ne okethore kendo okony e timo tijno maber.

English: Ministry of Health encourages residents of West Pokot County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inaysan ku xanuunsadaan si aamusnaan ah oo ay uga qayb galaan kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health jiwo jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Notice: DPP opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa simu ya GBV ya bure katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ee gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DPP ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo chenro mar tiyo gi simo maonge chudo mar GBV e County mar Lamu.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Narok County starting this September.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuanzia Septemba hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa in dadka deggan gobolka Narok ay la socdaan dialysis lacageed laga bilaabo bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche lando ni ji duto modak e Narok County biro yudo thieth mar dialysis kochakore Septemba.

English: Notice: KMTC launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay bilowday barnaamij lagu daro ardayda naafada ah dugsiyada guud ahaan degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KMTC chako chenro mar tiego nyithindo ma nigi midekre e skunde duto mag Kisumu County.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages mothers in Narok County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Narok kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Narok inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta caafimaad ee la qorsheeyay si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo mine manie Narok County mondo odhi e odiechienge moketi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Ensure safety! Comply with fire standards in school dormitories.
Kiswahili: Hakikisha usalama! Fuata viwango vya moto katika vyumba vya kulala vya shule.
Somali: Nabadgelyada hubi! Raac shuruudaha dab-damiska ee hoyga dugsiga.
Dholuo: Rituru ritruok! Luw chike mag mach e ute skul.

English: Notice: KEMSA confirms a malaria outbreak alert for Lamu County. Residents are advised to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa malaria kwa Kaunti ya Lamu. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMSA waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ku saabsan cudurka Cudurka Cudurrada ee Gobolka Lamu. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KEMSA osenyiso ni nitie masira mar malaria e County mar Lamu.

English: All 142 tea factories in Kenya will soon be allowed to sell directly to international buyers boosting earnings for tea farmers Stay informed for further details on implementation
Kiswahili: Viwanda vyote 142 vya chai nchini Kenya hivi karibuni vitaruhusiwa kuuza moja kwa moja kwa wanunuzi wa kimataifa ili kuongeza mapato kwa wakulima wa chai Endelea kufahamishwa kwa maelezo zaidi kuhusu utekelezaji.
Somali: Dhammaan 142-ka warshadood ee shaaha ee Kenya ayaa dhawaan loo oggolaan doonaa inay si toos ah ugu iibiyaan iibsadayaal caalami ah taasoo kor u qaadanaysa dakhliga beeraleyda shaaha. La soco faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan hirgelinta
Dholuo: Masinde duto mag chai 142 e Kenya biro yudo thuolo mar uso gik moko ne jolok ohala ma wuok e pinje mamoko, kendo mano biro miyo jopur mag chai oyud pesa momedore.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu ku dhawaaqay taariikhda diiwaangelinta waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada gobolka Nyamira.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj ogolo chenro mar somo mar pinyruoth maonge chudo e skunde man Nyamira County.

English: Notice: IEBC announces school feeding programme enrollment dates for schools in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa programu ya kulisha shule kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiyada degmada Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC ogolo chenro mar chamo chiemo e skunde mag Lamu County.

English: Transform street childrenâ€™s lives through shelter programs.
Kiswahili: Kubadilisha maisha ya watoto wa barabarani kupitia mipango ya makao.
Somali: Wax ka beddel nolosha carruurta darbi-jiifka ah iyada oo loo marayo barnaamijyada hoyga.
Dholuo: Loki ngima mar nyithindo ma ni e yore kokalo kuom chenro mag yudo kar dak.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kitui.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka ayaa ku dhawaaqday taariikhda diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ee dugsiyada Gobolka Kitui.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Puonjruok ma Chakruok mar Piny owacho ogolo chenro mar somo e skunde mag Kitui County.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds residents of West Pokot County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot in ilaalinta ciidda ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service parone jogweng' mar West Pokot County ni rito lowo miyo puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: Notice: NDMA launches a cattle rustling prevention campaign in Kisii County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kisii Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga xanta xoolaha ee degmada Kisii bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA chako kampen mar geng'o ywaruok mag jamni e gweng' mar Kisii e dwe mar April.

English: If you you are getting sick with #COVID19, follow this step-by-step guide to prevent spreading the virus to others @CDCKenya @WHOKenya @UNICEFKenya @KNH_hospital @PDUDelivery @KEMRI_Kenya @SpokespersonGoK @RedCrossKe @EduMinKenya
Kiswahili: Ikiwa unaugua na #COVID19, fuata mwongozo huu wa hatua kwa hatua ili kuzuia kueneza virusi kwa wengine @CDCKenya @WHOKenya @UNICEFKenya @KNH_hospital @PDUDelivery @KEMRI_Kenya @SpokespersonGoK @RedCrossKe @EduMinKenya

Dholuo: Ka in ibedo gi tuo mar #COVID19, luwo yo ma luwo okang' ka okang' mar geng'o lando tuo mar #COVID19

English: Farmers in Rift Valley and Western regions are encouraged to diversify by growing coffee alongside maize to enhance household income while ensuring food security
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Bonde la Ufa na mikoa ya Magharibi wamehimizwa kujikita katika kilimo cha kahawa pamoja na mahindi ili kuongeza kipato cha kaya huku wakihakikisha usalama wa chakula.
Somali: Beeraleyda gobollada Rift Valley iyo Galbeedka waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay kala duwanaadaan iyagoo beera kafeega iyo hadhuudhka si kor loogu qaado dakhliga qoysaska iyagoo damaanad qaada amniga cuntada
Dholuo: Josupni manie Rift Valley kod pinje mag Western jiwo ji mondo opidhgi gi loso chai kaachiel gi cham mar cham mondo omi joot obed gi mwandu momedore kendo gibed gi chiemo moromo.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Tharaka-Nithi County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuendelea kuwa macho katika kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay dadka degmada Tharaka-Nithi ku xasuusineysaa inay ka feejignaadaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji duto e Tharaka-Nithi County ni gibed motang' ne loso kuwe e piny.

English: COMESA informs tea farmers in Bungoma County of new market linkage opportunities this September.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawafahamisha wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Septemba hii.
Somali: COMESA waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Bungoma fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: COMESA nyiso jopur mag chai e county mar Bungoma thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Septemba.

English: E-Citizen urges eligible citizens in West Pokot County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wananchi wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada West Pokot inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro e West Pokot County mondo oriwre e kwedo josiasa.

English: AFA announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Kirinyaga County this November.
Kiswahili: AFA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Novemba hii.
Somali: AFA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan qabyaalada lo'da caanaha ah ee Gobolka Kirinyaga bisha November.
Dholuo: AFA olando chenro mar thiedho dhok makwayo pi e dwe mar Novemba e kaunti mar Kirinyaga.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: nutrition supplementation for infants clinics will run every November at designated health centres in Machakos County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi: nyongeza ya lishe kwa kliniki za watoto wachanga itaendeshwa kila Novemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Machakos.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka: Kordhinta nafaqada ee dhallaanka ee xarumaha caafimaad ee lagu magacaabo degmada Machakos ayaa la qaban doonaa bishii Nofeembar ee sannad kasta.
Dholuo: Rieko moa kuom Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: chiemo moromo mag nyithindo matindo biro dhi nyime gi thieth e dwe mar Novemba higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County ma Machakos.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds needy students in Murang'a County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia hufungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya ardayda u baahan degmada Murang'a in buugaagta waxbarasho iyo codsiyada qalabka waxbarasho ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne jopuonjre modhier e County mar Murang'a ni buk mag somo kod weche mag puonjruok biro rumo machiegni.

English: Ministry of Education reminds youth in Kiambu County that HELB funding is available for welding and fabrication training.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kiambu in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Puonjruok parone rowere e Kaunti mar Kiambu ni pesa mag HELB yudore e tiegruok mag welding kod manufacturing.

English: To achieve mental health for those living with disabilites is of great importance. Now, do you know any person who needs counselling? Send an SMS to "support" to 20767 so that you can connect with a counsellor free of charge.
Kiswahili: Kufikia afya ya akili kwa wale wanaoishi na ulemavu ni muhimu sana. Sasa, je, unamjua mtu yeyote anayehitaji ushauri nasaha? Tuma ujumbe mfupi kwa "msaada" kwa 20767 ili uweze kuwasiliana na mshauri nasaha bila malipo.
Somali: Si loo gaaro caafimaadka maskaxda ee dadka naafada ah waa mid aad muhiim u ah. Hada, ma taqaan qof u baahan la-talin? u dir SMS "taageero" 20767 si aad ula xiriirto la-taliye lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Mondo joma nigi midekre obed gi ngima maber e pachgi, dwarore ahinya. Koro, be ing'eyo ng'ato ang'ata madwaro kony?

English: Ministry of Health urges residents of Nyandarua County to complete the full recommended vaccination dose following a rise in reported tuberculosis cases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya kifua kikuu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay dhammaystiraan qiyaasta tallaalka oo dhan ee lagugula talinayo ka dib kororka kiisaska cudurka 'tuberculosis' ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health ojiwo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo otiek dose duto mar thieth ma ichiko nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuberculosis osemedore.

English: Notice: Council of Governors launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kirinyaga County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa billaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ka dhanka ah Gobolka Kirinyaga bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Jaloch chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Kirinyaga e dwe mar Jun.

English: Kenya Red Cross launches a May awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Narok County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Mei juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii May oo ku saabsan baaritaanka sonkorowga gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Mei e wi nonro mar thieth mar sukari e gweng' mar Narok.

English: IEBC reminds residents of Mombasa County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Mombasa County ambao huhudhuria mkutano wa umma wa mkutano wa wilaya huimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa ee ka qeybgalaya kalfadhiga guud ee shirka degmada inay xoojiyaan maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: IEBC paronwa jogweng' Mombasa County ma biro e chokruok maduong' mar county assembly mondo omed jiwo sirkal.

English: This world day to comemorate mental health, stop fronting mental health in work! Good environment is important for good mental health, in work places. Talk to people.
Kiswahili: Siku hii ya dunia ya kuadhimisha afya ya akili, acha kutaja afya ya akili kuwa muhimu kazini! Mazingira mazuri ni muhimu kwa afya njema ya akili, mahali pa kazi. Zungumza na watu.
Somali: Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Caafimaadka Maskaxda, joojinta ka hortagga caafimaadka maskaxda shaqada! Jawi wanaagsan ayaa muhiim u ah caafimaad maskaxeed oo wanaagsan, meelaha shaqada. La hadal dadka.
Dholuo: Mano e odiechieng' ma ji duto timoe rapar mar bedo gi ngima maber e pachgi, omiyo weuru bedo gi paro maok kare e wi ngima mar ng'ato e tich!

English: KNEC reminds parents in Kwale County that free primary education registration is open this August.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba usajili wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo umefunguliwa Agosti hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Kwale in diiwaangelinta bilaashka ah ee waxbarashada hoose ay furan tahay bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: KNEC oparo ne jonyuol e county mar Kwale ni chenro mar somo mar pinyruoth ma onge chudo ochakore e dwe mar Agost.

Kiswahili: Mustakabali wetu ni mzuri": Wanawake wakulima nchini Kenya wanakabiliana na ukame
Somali: "Mustaqbalkeennu waa mid ifaya": Haweenka beeraleyda ah ee Kenya ayaa la daalaa dhacaya abaarta

English: Notice: Council of Governors launches county development projects in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa bilaabay mashaariic horumarineed oo ka socda degmada Wajir.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Jaloch ochako tich mar timo dongruok e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: KEMSA encourages mothers in Kilifi County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kilifi inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo mine man Kilifi County mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Notice from CDC: childhood immunization clinics will run every February at designated health centres in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa CDC: kliniki za chanjo ya watoto zitafanya kazi kila Februari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid CDC: rugta tallaalka carruurta ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Febraayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee la magacaabay ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuoche (CDC): klinik mag thiedho nyithindo biro tiyo e dwe mar Februar e kuonde thieth moyier e Taita-Taveta County.

English: Pest Control Products Board warns sorghum farmers in Wajir County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Wajir juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda xoolaha ee degmada Wajir cudurrada cayayaanta waxayna kugula talineysaa faragelinta waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Bura mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok mar Pest, chiwo siem ne jopur mag sorghum e gweng' mar Wajir e wi tuoche ma kelo hinyruok kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Taita-Taveta County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Nairobi County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free measles screening is available at all public health centres in Uasin Gishu County this January.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa surua unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Januari hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka xanuunka oo bilaash ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee gobolka Uasin Gishu bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: KEMSA oparo ne ji ni nonro mar thieth mar midho ma onge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e county mar Uasin Gishu e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General opens the electoral calendar centres in Nakuru County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud ayaa furaya xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee degmada Nakuru bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Auditor General chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e kaunti mar Nakuru e dwe mar Mei.

English: KICD encourages out-of-school children in Kisii County to register their children at the nearest public school under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: KICD inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Kisii kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya mgao wa bursary.
Somali: KICD waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Kisii inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha iyada oo la siinayo deeq waxbarasho.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e County mar Kisii mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul ma ni machiegni kodgi.

English: Led by Acted in partnership with the ASAL Humanitarian Network, Oxfam Kenya, Concern Worldwide and IMPACT Initiatives, the KCC's objective is to deliver timely cash assistance to communities affected by various shocks including natural disasters, conflict and displacement.
Kiswahili: Ikiongozwa na Kutenda kwa ushirikiano na Mtandao wa Kibinadamu wa ASAL, Oxfam Kenya, Concern Worldwide na IMPACT Initiatives, lengo la KCC ni kutoa usaidizi wa pesa taslimu kwa wakati kwa jamii zilizoathiriwa na majanga mbalimbali ikiwa ni pamoja na majanga ya asili, migogoro na kuhama makazi yao.
Somali: Ujeedada KCC waa in la gaarsiiyo gargaar lacageed oo waqtigeeda ku habboon bulshooyinka ay saameeyeen masiibooyinka dabiiciga ah oo ay ku jiraan masiibooyinka dabiiciga ah, iskahorimaadyada iyo barakaca, iyadoo lala kaashanayo Shabakadda Bani'aadamnimada ee ASAL, Oxfam Kenya, Concern Worldwide iyo IMPACT Initiatives.
Dholuo: Ka otelne gi Acted ka oriwre gi kawruok mar ASAL, Oxfam Kenya, Concern World Wide kod chenro mar IMPACT, chenro mar KCC en mar chiwo kony mar omwom e kinde mowinjore ne oganda ma oyudo midhiero mopogre opogre oriwo masiche mag piny, lweny kod weyo udi.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Garissa County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa huzindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Garissa Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee Gobolka Garissa bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Garissa e dwe mar Mach.

English: Kenya and Indonesia held a NairobiÃ¢Â€Â“Mombasa workshop to share community based approaches and draft a memorandum of understanding on PCVE collaboration.
Kiswahili: Kenya na Indonesia zilifanya warsha ya Nairobi-Mombasa ili kushiriki mbinu zinazotegemea jamii na kuandaa hati ya makubaliano kuhusu ushirikiano wa PCVE.
Somali: Kenya iyo Indonesia waxay qabteen aqoon-is-weydaarsi Nairobi ah oo lagu wadaagayo hababka bulshada ku salaysan iyo diyaarinta heshiis is-afgarad ah oo ku saabsan iskaashiga PCVE.
Dholuo: Kenya kod Indonesia ne otimo romo e NairobiÃ¢Â€Â“Mombasa mar lando yore moluorore e oganda kendo ndiko oboke mar winjruok ewi riwruok e kind PCVE.

English: To lower cases of HIV/AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria, and enhance the vaccines and immunisation programme in the country, I have proposed Sh28.7bn for the Global Fund and Sh4.6bn for vaccines and immunisation programmes.
Kiswahili: Ili kupunguza visa vya VVU/UKIMWI, Kifua Kikuu na Malaria, na kuboresha mpango wa chanjo na chanjo nchini, nimependekeza Sh28.7 bilioni kwa ajili ya Mfuko wa Dunia na Sh4.6 bilioni kwa ajili ya chanjo na programu za chanjo.
Somali: Si loo yareeyo kiisaska HIV/AIDS, Tuberculosis iyo Malaria, loona xoojiyo barnaamijka tallaalka iyo tallaalka ee dalka, waxaan u soo jeediyay Sh28.7bn ee Sanduuqa Caalamiga ah iyo Sh4.6bn ee tallaallada iyo barnaamijyada tallaalka.
Dholuo: Mondo anyis ni anyalo dwoko chien tuoche mag HIV/AIDS, Tuberculosis kod malaria, kendo amedo jiwo chenro mar yudo chan kod thieth e pinyno, asechiwo Sh28.7 bilion ne Global Fund kod Sh4.6 bilion ne chenro mag yudo chan kendo thieth.

English: Notice: KMTC opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inafungua maombi ya maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay u furaysaa codsiyada barashada bilaashka ah ee barashada digital-ka ee ardayda ku nool gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC oyawo kwayo mag somo maonge chudo mar digital ne jopuonjre manie Homa Bay County.

English: Announcing Nationwide training to improve acute malnutrition treatment protocols across counties.
Kiswahili: Kutangaza mafunzo ya Kitaifa kote ili kuboresha itifaki za matibabu ya utapiamlo mkali katika kaunti zote.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida tababar caalami ah si loo hagaajiyo nidaamyada daaweynta nafaqada xun ee degmooyinka.
Dholuo: Wuoyo kuom tiegruok e piny mangima mar medo lony e yore mag thieth mar tuoche makelo tuoche mang'eny e gwenge mopogore opogore.

English: TSC urges parents and teachers in Kitui County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Kitui kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Somali: TSC waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta Gobolka Kitui inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Kitui mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka waxay ku dhawaaqday taariikhaha diiwaangelinta waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada Degmada Tharaka-Nithi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Puonjruok ma Chakruok mar Piny owacho ogolo chenro mar somo mapile ma onge chudo e skunde mag Tharaka-Nithi County.

English: The Ministry of Fireign Affairs, has tried to introduce a voucher in digital services to promote planting, cereal improt and harvestâ€¦..
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Mambo ya Moto, imejaribu kuanzisha voucher katika huduma za digital ili kukuza kupanda, mbegu za nafaka na mavuno.....

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds needy students in Marsabit County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba vitabu vya kiada na matumizi ya vifaa vya kujifunzia vitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya ardayda u baahan degmada Marsabit in buugaagta waxbarasho iyo codsiyada qalabka waxbarasho ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission parone jopuonjre modhier man Marsabit County ni buk mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok biro rumo machiegni.

English: Notice: FAO will conduct a modern irrigation techniques workshop for farmers in Garissa County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itafanya warsha ya kisasa ya mbinu za umwagiliaji kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah ee beeraleyda ee Gobolka Garissa bisha May.
Dholuo: Nonro: FAO biro timo chokruok mar timo nonro e wi yore mag lero pi e dwe mar Mei ne jopur e gweng' mar Garissa.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds the public in Kisumu County that reporting embezzlement of public funds is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa fedha za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu dadka degmada Kisumu ku xasuusinayaa in warbixinta xadgudubka lacagaha dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone ji duto e County mar Kisumu ni chiwo ripot mar ketho pesa mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages mothers in Turkana County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Turkana inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit jiwo mine e County mar Turkana mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET announces school feeding programme enrollment dates for schools in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa programu ya kulisha shule kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiyada degmada Mandera.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar State for TVET olando tarik mag dhi e skunde mag Mandera County mondo giyud thuolo mar dhi e program mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: Notice from Kenya Red Cross: nutrition supplementation for infants clinics will run every July at designated health centres in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya: nyongeza ya lishe kwa kliniki za watoto wachanga itaendeshwa kila Julai katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya: Kordhinta nafaqada ee dhallaanka ee xarumaha caafimaadka ee lagu magacaabo degmada Kericho ayaa la qaban doonaa bishii Luulyo ee sanad kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ripot Mamit mar Kenya: thieth mar chiemo ne nyithindo mayom ibiro tim e dwe mar Julai higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Kericho.

English: AFA reminds livestock keepers in Marsabit County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa za kuponda ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Marsabit inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: AFA paronwa jorit jamni e marsabit county mondo opidhgi gi tuoche e kuonde moketi mag chamo jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: KTDA urges cattle farmers in Kericho County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa ngozi ya uvimbe.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda xoolaha ee degmada Kericho inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanada buka xafiiska xayawaanka ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur mag jamni e County mar Kericho mondo onyis jamni matuwo e ofise mar thieth machiegni gi kanyo bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag dhoot.

English: KNEC encourages residents of Narok County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kukaa na habari juu ya jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Narok inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan doorka garsoorka.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiego ji mondo ging'e tich mar Ombudsman.

English: Building Strong Systems to Improve Health and Nutrition in Kenya
Kiswahili: Kujenga Mifumo Imara ya Kuboresha Afya na Lishe nchini Kenya
Somali: Dhisidda Nidaamyo Xoog leh si loo Horumariyo Caafimaadka iyo Nafaqada Kenya
Dholuo: Gero chenro motegno mag bero ngima kod chiemo e piny Kenya

English: NTSA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Busia County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NTSA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Busia kuripoti kesi kwenye dawati la karibu la jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Busia inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e County mar Busia mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Nyandarua County this June.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Juni hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku dhawaaqay qaybinta waxyaabaha waxbarasho ee dijitaalka ah ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Nyandarua bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag digital maonge chudo e skunde man Nyandarua County e dwe mar Jun.

English: TVET reminds parents in Trans Nzoia County that adult literacy classes registration is open this May.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba usajili wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima umefunguliwa Mei hii.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Trans Nzoia in diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ay furan tahay bisha May.
Dholuo: TVET parone jonyuol e Trans Nzoia County ni ikruok mar somo mar jomatindo osechakore e dwe mar Mei.

English: Due to outbureak of Covid 19, I have issued nationakl guidelins to control it. Clean your hands wiyth sanitiser. Keep 1 meter distance from a coughing and sneezing person,A persomn coughing and sneezing should stay in inddors and not attend meetings
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya kuzuka kwa Covid 19, nimechapisha miongozo ya kitaifa ya kudhibiti.
Somali: Sababta oo ah cudurka Covid-19 waxaan soo saaray tilmaamo qaran oo lagu xakameynayo. gacmahaada ku nadiifi daawooyinka nadaafadda. ka fogaada qof qallalan iyo qallalaysan 1 mitir, qof qullalan iyo qaxli badan waa inuu ku jiraa gurigiisa oo uusan ka qeyb qaadan shirarka
Dholuo: Nikech tuo mar Covid 19 ne onya ahinya, asechiwo chike mag piny mangima mar geng'o tuochego. Lwok lweti gi gik makelo ler. Bed mabor gi ng'at ma yuso kendo yuso mita achiel, ng'ato ang'ata yuso kata yuso nyaka bed e ot kendo kik odhi e chokruok.

English: OGP reminds voters in Laikipia County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: OGP inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuwa na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Laikipia inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor waxbarashada codbixisayaasha.
Dholuo: OGP parone jogedo e County mar Laikipia mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero kapok giyudo tiegruok.

English: Kenya Gazette updates residents of Laikipia County on progress of ward-level service delivery this October.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawasilisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia juu ya maendeleo ya utoaji wa huduma kwa kiwango cha wilaya mwezi huu wa Oktoba.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Laikipia ku wargeliyay horumarka adeegga heerka degmada bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette osemiyo jodak e County mar Laikipia ng'eyo dongruok mar chiwo kony e wi ward e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: NTSA warns residents of Vihiga County about a rise in identity theft and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga juu ya kuongezeka kwa wizi wa kitambulisho na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: NTSA waxay ka digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga oo ku saabsan kororka xadgudubka aqoonsiga waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne ji modak e County mar Vihiga e wi medruok mar kuo mar ng'ato kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok adier ne jatendgi.

English: E-Citizen announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inatangaza nyakati bora za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Mombasa.
Dholuo: E-Citizen olando lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mar yudo ID e County mar Mombasa.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will be held in Samburu County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Samburu Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Gobolka Samburu bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Rapar: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo mitimo gi Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ibiro tim e county mar Samburu e dwe mar Jun.

English: KNEC urges youth in Laikipia County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Laikipia inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo rowere e County mar Laikipia mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok ochopo gik ma biro timore e kind oganda.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will distribute certified coffee seed to farmers in Narok County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu za kahawa zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu abuurka kafeega ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doonaa beeraleyda Gobolka Narok bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro pogo kodhi mag kofi ne jopur manie Narok County e dwe mar Agost.

English: Kenya Dairy Board encourages farmers in Meru County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for tea.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za chai.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda degmada Meru inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan shaaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur e county mar Meru mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro mar loso chai mondo giyud nengo maber mar chai.

English: Notice: SHA will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: SHA itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya West Pokot.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee Gobolka West Pokot.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: SHA biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e West Pokot County.

English: NDMA reminds the public in Nyamira County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jumuiya.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nyamira inay ka feejignaadaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: NDMA parone ji duto e County mar Nyamira ni gibed motang' gi chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: FAO reminds livestock keepers in Meru County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Meru kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa za kuponda ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Meru inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: FAO parone jopur mag jamni e County mar Meru mondo ogeng' jamni maggi e kuonde moketi mag chwoyo jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: To control striga weed, pull it out by hand as soon as it starts flowering and before it produces new seeds; pull carefully so the stem doesn't break, then put the plants in a plastic bag and burn them immediately - do not leave them on the ground, as the tiny seeds will fall and spread. Combine hand-pulling with crop rotation and soil fertilization for better control.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti magugu ya striga, ivute kwa mkono mara tu inapoanza kuchanua na kabla ya kutoa mbegu mpya; Vuta kwa uangalifu ili shina lisivunjike, kisha weka mimea kwenye mfuko wa plastiki na uichome mara moja - usiwaache chini, kwani mbegu ndogo zitaanguka na kuenea. Changanya kuvuta kwa mkono na mzunguko wa mazao na mbolea ya udongo kwa udhibiti bora.
Somali: Si loo xakameeyo cawska striga, gacanta ku soo saar marka uu bilaabo ubaxa iyo ka hor inta uusan abuur cusub soo saarin; Si taxaddar leh u jiid si geedka uusan u jabin, ka dibna geedka geli bac caag ah oo isla markiiba gub - ha ka tagin dhulka, maadaama abuurka yaryar ay dhici doonaan oo faafi doonaan. Isku dar jiidashada gacanta iyo wareegga dalagyada iyo bacriminta ciidda si loo xakameeyo si wanaagsan.
Dholuo: Mondo idwok lum mar Striga e bwo teko, yudgi gi lweti mapiyo kaka gichako ywayo kendo kapok ginyago kodhi manyien; yudgi maber mondo yadhno kik kethre, kae to iketgi e besen molos gi plastik kendo wang'gi mapiyo - kik iwegi e lowo, nimar kodhi matin biro podho kendo landore.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges rice growers in Kwale County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawahimiza wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Kwale kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda bariiska ee Gobolka Kwale inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si loo wanaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur ma pidho kodhi e county mar Kwale mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed nyak e higani.

English: Meru (Meru-North) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Meru (Meru-Kaskazini): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Oktoba 2024
Somali: Degmada Meru (Meru-Waqooyi): War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Meru (Meru-Nyath): Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Oktoba 2024

English: HELB advises applicants in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: HELB inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: HELB waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: HELB nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni mondo gidonj e skundni ka pok giyudo thuolo mar dhi e chokruok.

English: DPP warns residents of Tharaka-Nithi County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: DPP inaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: DPP waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi kororka khiyaamada SIM-swap waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: DPP osiemo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County kuom medruok mar wuond mag SIM-swap kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar weche ma ok kare ne jatendgi.

English: Teachers receive training on effective use of digital learning tools and platforms in classrooms
Kiswahili: Walimu hupokea mafunzo ya kutumia kwa ufanisi zana na majukwaa ya kujifunza digital katika madarasa
Somali: Macalimiinta waxaa lagu tababarayaa isticmaalka wax ku oolka ah ee aaladaha barashada iyo barnaamijyada dhijitaalka ah ee fasallada
Dholuo: Jopuonj yudo tiegruok kuom kaka ginyalo tiyo gi gige puonjruok kod piche mag digital e klas

English: Ministry of ICT launches training programs on digital safety and privacy targeted at secondary school students.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya TEHAMA yazindua programu za mafunzo kuhusu usalama wa kidijitali na faragha zinazolenga wanafunzi wa shule za upili.
Somali: Wasaaradda ICT-ga waxay bilowday barnaamijyo tababar oo ku saabsan badbaadada dijitaalka ah iyo asturnaanta oo loogu talagalay ardayda dugsiga sare.
Dholuo: Od tich mar ICT ochako chenro mag puonjo kuom rito gik moko e yor mbui kod rito weche mag ng’ato ka ng’ato ma ochung’ ne jopuonjre mag skul ma malo.

English: NDMA warns residents of Laikipia County to prepare for possible flooding this November.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa mafuriko Novemba hii.
Somali: NDMA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay isu diyaariyaan fatahaadaha iman kara bisha November.
Dholuo: NDMA osiemo jogweng' mar Laikipia County mondo oikre ne ataro manyalo timore e dwe mar Novemba.

English: ODPP urges eligible citizens in Laikipia County to participate in voter education.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kushiriki katika elimu ya wapiga kura.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Laikipia inay ka qaybqaataan waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro mar yiero e county mar Laikipia mondo oriwre e tiegruok mar josiasa.

English: NCPB advises farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ka soo qayb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar piny mangima.

English: Health facilities offer family planning counseling to couples and individuals to support informed decisions about spacing and limiting births.
Kiswahili: Vituo vya afya hutoa ushauri nasaha wa uzazi wa mpango kwa wanandoa na watu binafsi ili kusaidia maamuzi sahihi kuhusu nafasi na kupunguza uzazi.
Somali: Xarumaha caafimaadka waxay la talin ku bixiyaan qorsheynta qoyska lamaanaha iyo shakhsiyaadka si ay u taageeraan go'aamada la og yahay ee ku saabsan kala duwanaanshaha iyo xaddidaadda dhalmada.
Dholuo: Ofise mag thieth chiwo kony e wi kaka inyalo chano ngima joot ne joma okendore koda ne joma nie kend mondo okonygi ng'ado paro e yo mong'ith kuom wach pogo nyuol gi nyuol.

English: KICD advises students in Narok County to register early to secure allocation to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: KICD inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Narok kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata maudhui ya kujifunza ya kidijitali bila malipo.
Somali: KICD waxay kula talineysaa ardayda degmada Narok inay isdiiwaangaliyaan si ay u helaan lacag la'aan ah oo barashada digital ah.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo jopuonjre manie Narok County mondo odonj e skundno chon mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo somo maonge chudo.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the community in Mombasa County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb carjacking.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia utekaji nyara wa gari.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya bulshada gobolka Mombasa inay ka warbixiyaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo shaki leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo afduubka gawaarida.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ji duto manie county mar Mombasa mondo onyis polis ma ni machiegni gi kama gibiro tiyogo e geng'o mibadhi mar mtoka.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will open a fish collection centre in Bomet County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itafungua kituo cha kukusanya samaki katika Kaunti ya Bomet Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu furi doonaa xarun ururinta kalluunka ee Gobolka Bomet bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro yawo kama ichokoe rech e County mar Bomet e dwe mar Julai.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties urges residents of Nandi County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia laini ya bure ya EACC ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Nandi ku boorinayaa inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa khadka tooska ah ee EACC si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties ojiwo jogweng' Nandi County mondo ochiw ripode mag mibadhi kokalo kuom hotline mar EACC maonge chudo mondo giked gi wuond mag chulo pesa.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development warns beans farmers in Kakamega County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawaonya wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay uga digtay beeraleyda Gobolka Kakamega cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna kugula talineysaa faragelinta waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ochiwo siem ne jopur mag nyinyo e Kaunti mar Kakamega kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ochiwo paro mar kawo okang' e kinde mowinjore.

English: Nyeri (Kieni) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Nyeri (Kieni): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Aprili 2022
Somali: Degmada Nyeri (Kieni): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Nyeri (Kieni): Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro dwe mar ang'wen 2022

English: IEBC reminds residents of Kilifi County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi kwamba kufikia utunzaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda ka sahlan tahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: IEBC oparo ne Jo-Kilifi County ni koro nyalo bedo mayot yudo barua mar nyuol ka gitiyo gi yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: USAID Keneya Nieta (Household and Community Health)
Kiswahili: USAID Keneya Nieta (Afya ya Kaya na Jamii)
Somali: USAID Keneya Nieta (Caafimaadka Qoyska iyo Bulshada)
Dholuo: USAID Kenya Nieta (Thieth mar Pat kod Oganda)

English: Notice: State Department for TVET opens a new motor vehicle mechanics programme at the vocational centre in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yafungua programu mpya ya ufundi wa magari katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Qaranka ee TVET waxay ka furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan farsamada gawaarida gaadiidka ee xarunta xirfadaha ee Gobolka Kwale.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar State for TVET ochako chenro manyien mar tiyo gi masinde mag riembo mtokni e skul mar tich e county mar Kwale.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges youth in Lamu County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Lamu kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ugu baaqay dhalinyarada degmada Lamu inay ka qeybgalaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission jiwo rowere e County mar Lamu mondo oriwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gichako timo tije mag sirkal.

English: COMESA announces a free anthrax vaccination exercise for poultry in Mandera County this March.
Kiswahili: COMESA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kimeta kwa kuku katika Kaunti ya Mandera Machi hii.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo lacag la'aan ah oo loo sameeyo digaagga ee Gobolka Mandera bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: COMESA ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar anthrax e taon mar Mandera e dwe mar Mach.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges residents of Laikipia County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia laini ya bure ya EACC ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee EACC si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Laikipia mondo oland weche mag mibadhi kokalo kuom hotline mar EACC maonge chudo mondo giked gi wuond mag yuto.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on the community in Isiolo County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwa ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa bulshada degmada Isiolo ugu baaqay inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan oo ay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oluongo ji duto manie Isiolo County mondo owuo e wi timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo ginyis ji weche ma kamago e stesen mar polise.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds expectant mothers in Nyandarua County that access to skilled birth attendance is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba upatikanaji wa mahudhurio ya uzazi wenye ujuzi ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Nyandarua in helitaanka daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfad leh ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche parone mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Nyandarua ni thuolo mar yudo nyithindo ma nigi lony en gima onge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: KEMRI advises residents of Wajir County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: KEMRI waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun iyo biyo nadiif ah si joogto ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng' mar Wajir County mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Kenya: Drought - Population Density (3 Jul 2023)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Ukame - Msongamano wa Watu (3 Jul 2023)
Somali: Kenya: Abaaraha - Cufnaanta Dadweynaha (3 Luulyo 2023)
Dholuo: Kenya: Oro - Kwan mar Oganda (3 dwe mar Jula 2023)

English: Laikipia County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Laikipia: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Laikipia: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Laikipia: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Septemba 2022

English: Protect yourself & others from getting sick. Washing your hands with soap & running water or using an alcohol-based sanitizer is the cheapest and best way to stop coronavirus transmission. Remember: Be safe by avoiding Kissing Hugging Shaking hands. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Jilinde na wengine dhidi ya magonjwa. Kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji yanayotiririka au kutumia sanitizer yenye pombe ndio njia ya bei nafuu na bora zaidi ya kukomesha maambukizi ya virusi vya corona. Kumbuka: Kuwa salama kwa kuepuka Kubusu Kukumbatiana Kupeana mikono. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Ka ilaali naftaada iyo dadka kale inay xanuunsadaan. Ku dhaq gacmahaaga saabuun iyo biyo socda ama isticmaalka nadiifiye ku salaysan aalkolo waa habka ugu jaban uguna wanaagsan ee lagu joojin karo faafitaanka fayraska korona. Xusuusnow: Badbaado adiga oo iska ilaaliya dhunkashada dhunkashada gacmo-qabsiga. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Riek in iwuon & jomoko mondo kik giyud tuoche. Loso lweteni gi sabun kod pi ma ng’ich kata tiyo kod gino ma nigi alkol en yo mayot kendo maber moloyo mar geng’o lando mar korona. Par niya: Bed gi ritruok kuom weyo ng’ado lwedo ng’ado lwedo. #KomeshaKorona

English: Learn on how farmers can get carbon payments and to foÄºlow new meansof reducing climate damage..
Kiswahili: Jifunze jinsi wakulima wanaweza kupata malipo ya kaboni na kupata njia mpyaza kupunguza uharibifu wa hali ya hewa..
Somali: Baro sida beeraleydu u heli karaan lacagaha kaarboonka iyo sida loo yareeyo waxyeelada cimilada.
Dholuo: Fweny kaka jopur nyalo yudo chudo mag carbon kendo luwo yore manyien mag duoko piny ketho mag piny.

English: EACC warns public officers in Nakuru County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: EACC inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Nakuru dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: EACC waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Nakuru khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: EACC chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e kaunti mar Nakuru kuom timbe mag mibadhi.

English: Onion farmers are encouraged to establish a consistent planting schedule to ensure a steady income and supply throughout the year Aim for high yields of 20 to 40 tons per acre for better profitability
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa viazi wanahimizwa kuanzisha ratiba ya kupanda kwa usawa ili kuhakikisha mapato na ugavi thabiti mwaka mzima Lengo la mavuno ya juu ya tani 20 hadi 40 kwa ekari kwa faida bora
Somali: Beeraleyda basasha waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay sameeyaan jadwal beereed joogto ah si loo hubiyo dakhli joogto ah iyo sahay sanadka oo dhan. Ujeedada dalag sare ee 20 ilaa 40 tan halkii acre si faa'iido wanaagsan loo helo
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur mag adundo mondo oket chenro mar pidho adundo mondo omi giyud pesa koda chiwo mosiko e higa mangima.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Vihiga County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba upatikanaji wa maelekezo ya makazi salama unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Vihiga in helitaanka tixraacyada hoyga ammaanka ah ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e County mar Vihiga ni ng'ato nyalo yudo kuonde modakie maonge chudo.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of Tharaka-Nithi County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay la xiriiraan lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo kik gisandgi gi ling'ling' kendo mondo giwuo gi jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Notice: DCI activates an emergency response plan for fire outbreaks in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa milipuko ya moto katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ku saabsan dabka ka kacay Gobolka Laikipia.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: DCI chako tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne masiche mag mach e County mar Laikipia.

English: Kenya - Floods, update (NOAA-CPC, media) (ECHO Daily Flash of 16 March 2026)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Mafuriko, sasisho (NOAA-CPC, vyombo vya habari) (ECHO Daily Flash ya 16 Machi 2026)
Somali: Kenya - Daadad, cusbooneysiin (NOAA-CPC, warbaahinta) (ECHO Daily Flash ee 16 Maarso 2026)
Dholuo: Kenya - Pi mang'eny, duoko manyien (NOAA-CPC, lendo) (Rieny ma pile pile tarik 16 dwe mar adek higa mar 2026)

English: Notice: Ministry of Health confirms a malaria outbreak alert for Nyeri County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya yathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa malaria kwa Kaunti ya Nyeri. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka Cudurka Malaria ee Gobolka Nyeri. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth osenyiso ni nitie masira mar malaria e kaunti mar Nyeri.

English: Notice: TSC announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Busia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Busia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta dugsiyada dugsiga dhexe ee bilaashka ah ee degmada Busia.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TSC ogolo chenro mar dhi e skul mag Busia County mondo giyud thuolo mar somo e sekondari.

English: West Pokot: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2023
Kiswahili: Pokot Magharibi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Juni 2023
Somali: Galbeedka Pokot: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2023
Dholuo: Pokot ma milambo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar dwe mar auchiel 2023

English: UNICEF Kenya Flash Situation Report No. 6 (Drought): October 2022
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya UNICEF Kenya Flash Situation No. 6 (Ukame): Oktoba 2022
Somali: Warbixinta Xaaladda Degdegga ah ee UNICEF Kenya Lambarka 6 (Abaarta): Oktoobar 2022
Dholuo: Ripot mar chal mar piny Kenya mar UNICEF namba 6 (Oro): Oktoba higa mar 2022

English: I appeal to those in quarantined facilities to keep physical distance. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Ninatoa wito kwa wale walio katika vituo vilivyowekwa karantini kuweka umbali wa kimwili. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Waxaan ka codsanayaa kuwa ku jira xarumaha karantiilka inay ilaaliyaan kala fogaanshaha jirka. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Akwayo jogo ma ni e kuonde ma ji oketoe kwanten mondo orit thuolo mar ng’ato gi ng’ato. #KomeshaKorona

English: State Department for TVET conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in Kajiado County this March.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Kajiado Machi hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee Gobolka Kajiado bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET timo romo mar tiego ji e wi ratiro mag sirkal e kaunti mar Kajiado e dwe mar Mach.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Narok County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati huu wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Narok inay dhagaystaan amarada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha deegaanka xilliyada fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross parone jogweng' Narok County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji e gweng'no.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Marsabit County about the importance of safe water storage for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya umuhimu wa uhifadhi wa maji salama kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMSA waxay dadweynaha degmada Marsabit ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa ji duto e gweng' mar Marsabit gimomiyo kano pi maler en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: FAO warns cassava farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: FAO inawaonya wakulima wa manii katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya kuzuka kwa wadudu na inapendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: FAO waxay uga digtay beeraleyda cassava ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: FAO chiwo siem ne jopur mag manias e Tharaka-Nithi County kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni otim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: State Department for TVET advises students in Kisumu County to collect materials from the county education office to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kukusanya vifaa kutoka ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ardayda degmada Kisumu kula talineysaa inay ka soo ururiyaan waxyaabo xafiiska waxbarashada degmada si ay u helaan buugaagta waxbarasho iyo qalabka wax lagu barto.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET nyiso jopuonjre ma Kisumu County mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar tiegruok mar county mondo giyud buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok.

English: Public health advisory: KEMRI warns of increased measles risk in Baringo County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMRI inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya surua katika Kaunti ya Baringo na inashauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Talobixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: KEMRI waxay ka digtay kororka halista suuxdinta ee Gobolka Baringo waxayna ku talineysaa dadweynaha inay soo sheegaan kiisaska loo maleynayo inay u sheegaan mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar ji: KEMRI chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar nyol e County mar Baringo kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore mar thiedho ji ka giparo ni nitie hinyruok moro amora.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross issues a cybersecurity alert on SIM-swap fraud affecting residents of Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya umetoa onyo la usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM unaoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaamada SIM-swap ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Makueni.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ripot Mamit mar Kenya ogolo siem mar sirkal kuom wach wuondo joma odak e gweng' mar Makueni.

English: Continue seeking knowledge and aim at new seedlings that's relevant your dairy farming.
Kiswahili: Endelea kutafuta maarifa na ulenge miche mipya ambayo inafaa kwa ufugaji wako wa maziwa.
Somali: Sii wad raadinta aqoonta iyo bartilmaameedka geedo cusub oo ku saabsan beeraha caanahaaga.
Dholuo: Dhi nyime manyo rieko kendo manyo yien manyien ma nyalo konyo e pidho yien.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds citizens in Homa Bay County about their rights regarding the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuhusu haki zao kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Horumarinta Manhajka Kenya wuxuu muwaadiniinta degmada Homa Bay xusuusinayaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development parone raia mag Homa Bay County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo ombudsman.
