English: Kenya Forest Service urges anyone experiencing abuse in Garissa County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya ngono katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Garissa inuu ka warbixiyo kiisaska xafiiska jinsiga ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e gweng' mar Garissa County mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development encourages out-of-school children in Uasin Gishu County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza watoto wasio shuleni katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya mgao wa bursary.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Uasin Gishu inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee la siinayo deeq waxbarasho.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo odonj e program mar somo kod somo mar joma dongo e bwo mich mar bursary.

English: NCPB warns rice farmers in Kwale County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawaonya wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Kwale juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: NCPB waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda bariiska ee Gobolka Kwale faafitaanka cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: NCPB chiwo siem ne jopur loso kodhi e county mar Kwale kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ochiwo paro mar kawo okang' e kinde mowinjore.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds the public in Nyandarua County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) ayaa xasuusinaya shacabka degmada Nyandarua in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, amaan ah oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone ji duto e County mar Nyandarua ni chiwo ripot mar mibadhi e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Kenya: IPC Food Security & Malnutrition Snapshot - Acute Food Insecurity: February - June 2023; Acute Malnutrition: February - May 2023
Kiswahili: Kenya: Usalama wa Chakula na Utapiamlo wa IPC - Ukosefu Mkubwa wa Chakula: Februari - Juni 2023; Utapiamlo Mkali: Februari - Mei 2023
Somali: Kenya: Sawir-qaadis Amniga Cuntada iyo Nafaqada ee IPC - Amniga Cuntada ee Ba'an: Febraayo - Juun 2023; Nafaqo-xumada Ba'an: Febraayo - Maajo 2023
Dholuo: Kenya: Picha mar IPC mar Rieko mar Chiemo kod Chiemo ma ok oromo - Rieko mar Chiemo mapek: dwe mar ariyo nyaka dwe mar auchiel 2023; Chiemo mowinjore ahinya: dwe mar ariyo - dwe mar abich 2023

English: Gaps in nutrition service coverage further compound these risks.
Kiswahili: Mapungufu katika utoaji wa huduma ya lishe huongeza zaidi hatari hizi.
Somali: Farqiga u dhexeeya daboolida adeegyada nafaqada ayaa sii kordhinaya khatarahaas.
Dholuo: Gaps e kwan mar pesa ma ji yudo kuom chiemo ma nigi gik ma konyo e ringruok medo medo luoro ma kamago.

English: Notice: SHA opens the electoral calendar centres in Nyandarua County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: SHA inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA waxay furaysaa xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee gobolka Nyandarua bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e kaunti mar Nyandarua e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: FAO restricts movement of dairy cows in Kisumu County due to a rabies outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO inazuia harakati za ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kutokana na mlipuko wa kichaa cha mbwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Kisumu sababo la xiriira cudurka cadho.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: FAO ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok makwayo e gweng' mar Kisumu nikech tuwo mar rabies.

English: DPP reminds the public in Homa Bay County to remain vigilant on counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: DPP inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kubaki macho juu ya umakini wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka gobolka Homa Bay in ay sii joogaan feejignaanta ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: DPP parone ji duto manie Homa Bay County mondo omed bedo motang' e weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: KEMRI launches a January awareness campaign on tobacco control across Wajir County.
Kiswahili: KEMRI yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Januari juu ya udhibiti wa tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: KEMRI waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Janaayo ee ka dhanka ah xakamaynta sigaarka ee Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: KEMRI chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Januar e wi thieth mar ndawa e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: ODPP urges residents of Kajiado County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kajiado County kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia EACC hotline ya bure ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa khadka tooska ah ee EACC si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo ochiw ripode mag mibadhi kokalo kuom hotline mar EACC maonge chudo mondo giked gi mibadho e migepe mag sirkal.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response calls on parents in Kilifi County to have children under five screened for cholera during the July outreach.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuwachunguza watoto chini ya miaka mitano kipindupindu wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Julai.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Kilifi in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka kolera intii lagu jiray bisha July.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche kwayo jonyuol e County mar Kilifi mondo otim nonro mar cholera ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Julai.

English: DPP calls on the community in Nyamira County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: DPP inawatia moyo jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: DPP waxay bulshada degmada Nyamira ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: DPP okwayo ji duto manie kaunti mar Nyamira mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo onyis ji weche mag mahundu e stesen mar polise.

English: Kenya - Floods and landslides, update (media, Kenya Meteorological Department) (ECHO Daily Flash of 4 May 2026)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Mafuriko na maporomoko ya ardhi, sasisho (vyombo vya habari, Idara ya Hali ya Hewa ya Kenya) (ECHO Daily Flash ya 4 Mei 2026)
Somali: Kenya - Daadad iyo dhul-go', warbixin (warbaahinta, Waaxda Saadaasha Hawada Kenya) (ECHO Daily Flash of 4 May 2026)
Dholuo: Kenya - Pi ma pong'o piny kod ng'anjo mag piny, manyien (oganda, Ofis mar Kenya mar weche mag kor lwasi) (ECHO pile ka pile tarik 4 dwe mar abich higa mar 2026)

English: Curbing impacts of drought in the Eastern African Subregion
Kiswahili: Kupunguza athari za ukame katika Ukanda wa Afrika Mashariki
Somali: Yaraynta saameynta abaarta ee gobolka Bariga Afrika
Dholuo: Kuong’o pek mag oro e alwora matin mar Afrika ma Wuokchieng’

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Nairobi County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama katikati ya tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaala aagagga xuduudka hay'adaha amniga iyada oo la sii xoojinayo amniga xuduudda.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Nairobi County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma rito tong'gi ni gitimo gik maok kare e alworagi.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges anyone experiencing abuse in Samburu County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Samburu apeleke simu ya simu ya GBV 1195.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Samburu inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ee 1195.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e county mar Samburu mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195 maonge chudo.

English: DCI urges motorists and pedestrians in Vihiga County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DCI inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Vihiga inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira qaraxyada dabka.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo dereba kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Vihiga mondo oluw chike mag wuotho ma jotelo mag gweng'no ogolo mondo gikwed hinyruok mag yiengni.

English: SHA announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: SHA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: SHA olando lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mag ng'eyo nying' e gweng' mar Kisii.

English: NCPB reminds residents of Kirinyaga County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Somali: NCPB waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kirinyaga in ilaalinta ciidda ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: NCPB paronwa jogweng' Kirinyaga County ni rito lowo miyo puodho bedo maber e kinde mabiro.

English: KEMRI reminds the public that free measles screening is available at all public health centres in Lamu County this December.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa surua unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Lamu Desemba hii.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka fayraska ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynta ee Gobolka Lamu bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: KEMRI oparo ne ji ni nonro mar thieth mar midho ma onge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Lamu e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Wajir County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Wajir: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2023
Somali: Degmada Wajeer: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Wajir: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2023

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds farmers in Narok County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Narok barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development oparo ne jopur manie Narok County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free HIV/AIDS screening is available at all public health centres in Wajir County this March.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa VVU/UKIMWI unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Wajir Machi hii.
Somali: Laanta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka HIV / AIDS ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee Gobolka Wajir bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji ni thieth mar HIV/AIDS maonge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Wajir e dwe mar Mach.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges anyone experiencing abuse in Turkana County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Turkana piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Turkana inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e County mar Turkana mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: Ministry of Health urges anyone struggling with their mental health in West Pokot County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kumtia moyo rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka West Pokot inuu ku dhiirrigeliyo saaxiibkiisa dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar paro e West Pokot County mondo ojiw osiepne moro ma chandore omany kony.

English: Notice: KNEC opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KNEC inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay furaysaa codsiyada deeqda waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan ardayda barta gobolka Bomet.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KNEC oseyawo kwayo mag yudo siko mar somo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e gweng' mar Bomet.

English: EACC urges eligible citizens in Bomet County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: EACC inahimiza wananchi wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Bomet kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Bomet inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jokanyo mowinjore e county mar Bomet mondo oriwre e ndiko joma oyiero.

English: IGAD Regional Roadmap for Anticipatory Action
Kiswahili: Ramani ya Kanda ya IGAD ya Hatua ya Kutarajia
Somali: Khariidadda Gobolka ee IGAD ee Hawlgalka La Filayo
Dholuo: Map mar yo mar IGAD mar kidieny mar timo gik ma ogeno

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces outpatient services for residents of Nyandarua County starting this January.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatangaza huduma za wagonjwa wa nje kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuanzia Januari hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay ku dhawaaqday adeegyada bukaanka ka baxsan dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua laga bilaabo Janaayo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche ogolo chenro mar konyo jotuo mag Nyandarua County kochakore Januar.

English: KMTC reminds needy students in Nairobi County that free digital learning content applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba programu za bure za maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KMTC waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Nairobi in codsiyada barnaamijyada barashada bilaashka ah ee dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan soo gabagabeyn doonaan.
Dholuo: KMTC oparo ne jopuonjre man Nairobi County ni chenro mag somo maonge chudo mar digital chiegni rumo.

English: Notice: KRA opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Wananchi katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay ka furaysaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-muwaadiniinta ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KRA oseyawo kama itimee tije mag e-Citizen registration e Taita-Taveta County.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds voters in Laikipia County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC cha karibu kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu xasuusinayaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Laikipia inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone jogweng' Laikipia mondo olim kama ichanoe IEBC machiegni kodgi kapok kinde mar yiero ochopo.

English: KALRO urges pigs farmers in Isiolo County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wafugaji wa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za ugonjwa wa ngozi ya uvimbe.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda doofaarka ee degmada Isiolo inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur ma pidho anguro e gweng' mar Isiolo mondo ochiw ripot ne jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth man machiegni gi kanyo bang' ka osenyis ni nitie tuoche mang'eny mag pien.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges the public in Kakamega County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: Kenya Red Cross inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha Gobolka Kakamega inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ji duto e Kaunti mar Kakamega mondo ochiw ripot mar ote mamulo pachgi ne jatendgi bang' yudo ripode mag wuond gi SIM-swap.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces NHIF/SHA claims support for residents of Lamu County starting this December.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatangaza NHIF/SHA inadai msaada kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kuanzia Desemba hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhawaaqday taageerada sheegashada NHIF / SHA ee dadka deggan Gobolka Lamu laga bilaabo Diseembar.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche lando ni NHIF/SHA biro chiwo kony ne joma odak e County mar Lamu kochakore dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Nyandarua County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inazindua kampeni ya kupambana na ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhanka ah gobolka Nyandarua bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Nyandarua e dwe mar Februar.

English: Cash transfers helping communities cope with climate shocks
Kiswahili: Uhamisho wa pesa unasaidia jamii kukabiliana na majanga ya hali ya hewa
Somali: Xawilaadaha lacagta caddaanka ah oo ka caawinaya bulshooyinka inay la qabsadaan dhibaatooyinka cimilada
Dholuo: Oboke mag omwom konyo oganda mondo otemre gi masira mag kor lwasi

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya utunzaji wa rekodi zinazoendelea kwa programu ya mafunzo ya wakulima.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa beeraleyda degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in barnaamijka tababarka beeralayda uu socdo.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service parone jopur e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet kuom chenro mar tiego jopur ma dhi nyime.

English: AFA urges goats farmers in Nyeri County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported foot and mouth disease cases.
Kiswahili: AFA inawataka wafugaji wa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda orgiga ee degmada Nyeri inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyagoo aan haysan rukhsad ka dib kiisaska cudurka afka iyo afka la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur mag diek e County mar Nyeri mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni e tong county maok giyudo rusa bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag dhoot.

English: SHA reminds voters in Samburu County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: SHA inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Samburu kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha gobolka Samburu inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor nidaamyada doorashada.
Dholuo: SHA parone jogedo e county mar Samburu mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero ka pok oyud thuolo mar timo yiero.

English: Notice: DCI issues a cybersecurity alert on mobile money scams affecting residents of Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DCI inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu zinazoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile ee saameynaya dadka deggan degmada Kwale.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: DCI ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity kuom timbe mag wuond mag pesa mitimo ne jood Kwale County.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission launches a school infrastructure safety programme in schools across Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yazindua mpango wa usalama wa miundombinu ya shule katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij ku saabsan badbaadada kaabayaasha dugsiga ee dugsiyada degmada Kilifi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj chako chenro mar rito kuonde tiegruok mag skul e skunde duto mag Kilifi County.

English: DPP calls on the community in Tana River County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: DPP inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Wilaya ya Tana River kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: DPP waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Tana River County inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan oo ay taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: DPP okwayo ji duto e taon mar Tana River County mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gidwar kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public in Kiambu County that access to SHA registration is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba ufikiaji wa usajili wa SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kiambu in helitaanka diiwaangelinta SHA ay hadda ka heli karto xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo parone ji duto e County mar Kiambu ni sani ginyalo yudo weche mag SHA e kuonde moketi.

English: HELB urges parents and teachers in Nyandarua County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: HELB inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: HELB waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Nyandarua inay u soo sheegaan maamulka iskuulka wixii arrimo ah oo ku saabsan amniga.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Nyandarua mondo onyis sirkal mar skul wach moro amora motudore gi ritruok.

English: SHA announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kushughulikia vyeti vya kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Shirkadda SHA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa in la hagaajiyo waqtiga wareejinta shahaadada dhalashada ee gobolka Bomet.
Dholuo: SHA olando lokruok e seche mag timo tij loso barua mag nyuol e county mar Bomet.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges millet growers in Samburu County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Samburu kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Waxsoosaarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka ayaa ku booriyay beeraleyda miiska ee Gobolka Samburu inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products jiwo jopur ma pidho millet e county mar Samburu mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: Even for a moment, leaving a baby on a bed or table unattended can lead to falls and injuries.
Kiswahili: Hata kwa muda mfupi, kumwacha mtoto kitandani au mezani bila mtu anayemtunza kunaweza kusababisha kuanguka na majeraha.
Somali: Xitaa in yar oo ilmaha lagu daydo sariirta ama miiska iyada oo aan la kormeerin waxay keeni kartaa hoos u dhac iyo dhaawac.
Dholuo: Kata mana kuom kinde matin, weyo nyathi e otanda kata e mesa ka onge ng'ama rite nyalo miyo opodho kata hinyore.

English: Kwale County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for November 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kwale: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Novemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Kwale: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Noofambar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kwale: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar gi achiel dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2022

English: Never shake a baby. It can cause brain injury or death. Comfort them gently instead.
Kiswahili: Usimtikise mtoto kamwe. Inaweza kusababisha jeraha la ubongo au kifo. Badala yake mfariji kwa upole.
Somali: Weligaa ha gariirin ilmaha, wuxuu keeni karaa dhaawac maskaxeed ama geeri.
Dholuo: Kik igeng' nyathi nikech onyalo hinyore e obwongo kata thone.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Garissa County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Garissa inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e gweng' mar Garissa County mondo odhi ir japuonj molony.

English: Within East Africa, Kenya is a country of origin, transit, and destination for people on the move, with Nairobi serving as the capital and economic hub of the country.
Kiswahili: Ndani ya Afrika Mashariki, Kenya ni nchi ya asili, usafiri, na marudio ya watu wanaohama, huku Nairobi ikitumika kama mji mkuu na kitovu cha uchumi wa nchi.
Somali: Bariga Afrika, Kenya waa waddan ay asal ahaan ka soo jeedaan, ku safraan, iyo meel ay u socdaan dadka safarka ku jira, iyadoo Nairobi ay tahay caasimadda iyo xarunta dhaqaalaha dalka.
Dholuo: E piny ma Wuokchieng' mar Afrika, Kenya en piny ma oganda wuokye, kaloe, kod kama gidhie ne joma nitie wuoth, ka Nairobi ema bedo boma maduong' kendo kar lamo mar weche yuto e pinyno.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Kiambu County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu wape huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay dalbadaan adeegyo aan la bixin laaluush si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jogweng' mar Kiambu County mondo okonygi gi tich maok gichiwo asoya mondo giked gi asoya e migepe mag sirkal.

English: Notice: DCI issues a cybersecurity alert on mobile money scams affecting residents of Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DCI inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya kashfa za pesa za rununu zinazoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile ee saameynaya dadka deggan gobolka Mombasa.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: DCI ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity kuom timbe mag wuond mag pesa mitimo ne jood Mombasa County.

English: Breaking down stigmas and barriers to care in Mombasa, Kenya
Kiswahili: Kuondoa unyanyapaa na vizuizi vya matunzo huko Mombasa, Kenya
Somali: Jabinta ceebaha iyo caqabadaha daryeelka ee Mombasa, Kenya
Dholuo: Ketho akwede kod obadho mag rito jotuwo e Mombasa man Kenya

English: Global growth is projected at 3.2 percent in 2024 and 3.3 percent in 2025 from 3.3 percent in 2023.
Kiswahili: Ukuaji wa kimataifa unakadiriwa kuwa asilimia 3.2 mwaka 2024 na asilimia 3.3 mwaka 2025 kutoka asilimia 3.3 mwaka 2023.
Somali: Kobaca caalamiga ah waxaa la saadaalinayaa inuu gaari doono 3.2 boqolkiiba sanadka 2024 iyo 3.3 boqolkiiba sanadka 2025 laga bilaabo 3.3 boqolkiiba sanadka 2023.
Dholuo: Igeno ni dongruok mar piny mangima biro bedo 3.2 kuom mia achiel e higa mar 2024 kod 3.3 kuom mia achiel e higa mar 2025 ka 3.3 kuom mia achiel e higa mar 2023.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds youth in Trans Nzoia County that HELB funding is available for electrical installation training.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya dhalinyarada degmada Trans Nzoia in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka rakibidda korontada.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne rowere man Trans Nzoia County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar loso sitima.

English: KRA advises residents of Nairobi County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: KRA inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e- Citizen.
Somali: KRA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan diiwaangelinta e-citizen.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo jogweng' Nairobi County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro dhi e e e - Citizen registration.

English: Kenya | Joint Market Monitoring Initiative (JMMI) Market Overview, Q2 (April - June, 2024)
Kiswahili: Kenya | Muhtasari wa Soko wa Mpango wa Pamoja wa Ufuatiliaji wa Soko (JMMI), Q2 (Aprili - Juni, 2024)
Somali: Kenya | Guudmarka Suuqa ee Hindisaha La-socodka Suuqa Wadajirka ah (JMMI), Q2 (Abriil - Juun, 2024)
Dholuo: Kenya | Chenro mar Rang'o Chiro Maduong' (JMMI) Neno Maduong' mar Chiro, Q2 (Dwe mar Ang'wen - Auchiel, 2024)

English: Want to export your milk? Learn about the specific requirements, certifications, and contacts needed to enter the Middle East.
Kiswahili: Je, ungependa kusafirisha maziwa yako nje? Jifunze kuhusu mahitaji hususa, vyeti, na mawasiliano yanayohitajika ili kuingia Mashariki ya Kati.
Somali: Haddii aad rabto inaad caano u dhoofinto dalkaas, baro shuruudaha gaarka ah, shahaadooyinka iyo xiriirada loo baahan yahay si aad u soo gasho Bariga Dhexe.
Dholuo: Inyalo ng'eyo gik ma dwarore mondo ng'ato odonj e pinje mag Middle East.

English: SHA reminds residents of Kirinyaga County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: SHA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: SHA parone jogweng' Kirinyaga County ni luwo dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Kenya Gazette invites residents of Nyeri County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandaoni wa kaunti kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette gwelo jogweng' Nyeri County mondo oriwre gi county's online participation portal e wi chenro mar bajet mar county.

English: CDC reminds the public that free HIV/AIDS screening is available at all public health centres in Embu County this September.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa VVU/UKIMWI unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Embu Septemba hii.
Somali: CDC waxay dadka xasuusineysaa in baaritaanka HIV / AIDS ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Embu bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji ni nonro ma onge chudo mar HIV/AIDS yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Embu e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) advises residents of Vihiga County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Vihiga mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport services.

English: As Kenya records rising malaria cases due to climate variability, the just ended World Malaria Day serves as a critical reminder of the need to transform public health initiatives to meet these evolving challenges
Kiswahili: Huku Kenya ikirekodi ongezeko la visa vya malaria kutokana na mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa, Siku ya Malaria Duniani iliyomalizika hivi punde inatumika kama ukumbusho muhimu wa hitaji la kubadilisha mipango ya afya ya umma ili kukabiliana na changamoto hizi zinazoendelea.
Somali: Iyada oo Kenya ay diiwaangeliso kiisaska cudurka daacuunka oo sii kordhaya sababo la xiriira kala duwanaanshaha cimilada, Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Dacuumada oo dhowaan la soo gabagabeeyay waxay u adeegtaa sidii xasuusin muhiim ah oo ku saabsan baahida loo qabo in la beddelo hindisaha caafimaadka dadweynaha si loo daboolo caqabadahaas isbeddelaya
Dholuo: Kaka Kenya medo neno kwan mag ji ma nigi malaria nikech lokruok e kit yamo, Chieng' mar Maleria e Piny Mangima ma nyocha eka orumo, en gima paronwa ahinya ni dwarore ni walok chenro mag thieth mar oganda mondo omi warom gi pek ma kamago.

English: CDC urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Makueni County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: CDC inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: CDC waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Makueni inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nyagore gi tuoche mag obwongo e gweng' mar Makueni mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: DPP urges the public in Bomet County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: DPP inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha degmada Bomet inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo ji duto e county mar Bomet mondo ong'e kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma ji osefwenyo e wi weche mag phishing.

English: Meeting announcement to sign a plan by UNSDCF to promote vbarious sector
Kiswahili: Tangazo la mkutano wa kutia saini mpango wa UNSDCF wa kukuza sekta mbalimbali
Somali: Ogeysiiska kulanka si loo saxiixo qorshe ay UNSDCF u dhiirrigeliso qaybaha kala duwan
Dholuo: Riwruok mar UNSDCF biro ndiko e wi chenro mar jiwo yore mopogore opogore mag tich

English: KICD endorses various online learning platforms to supplement classroom instruction for students.
Kiswahili: KICD inakubaliana na majukwaa mbalimbali ya kujifunza mtandaoni ili kuongeza mafunzo ya darasa kwa wanafunzi.
Somali: KICD waxay taageertaa barnaamijyo waxbarasho oo kala duwan oo internetka ah si ay u dhammaystiraan casharrada fasalka ardayda.
Dholuo: KICD oyie gi chenro mopogore opogore mag puonjruok e intanet mondo omed puonjo jopuonjre e klas.

English: To manage mango bacterial black spot, plant tolerant varieties such as Heidi or Sensation, plant windbreaks to reduce rain splash, burn infected fruits and dead branches, prune to improve airflow and light in the canopy, and apply copper sprays or fungicides regularly.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti doa nyeusi la bakteria ya embe, panda aina zinazostahimili kama vile Heidi au Sensation, panda vizuizi vya upepo ili kupunguza mvua, kuchoma matunda yaliyoambukizwa na matawi yaliyokufa, kupogoa ili kuboresha mtiririko wa hewa na mwanga kwenye dari, na kupaka dawa za shaba au fungicides mara kwa mara.
Somali: Si loo maareeyo barta madow ee bakteeriyada mango, noocyada u dulqaadata dhirta sida Heidi ama Sensation, si loo yareeyo dabaylaha dhirta si loo yareeyo roobka, gubista miraha cudurka leh iyo laamaha dhintay, jarjar si loo hagaajiyo socodka hawada iyo iftiinka saqafka, iyo isticmaal buufin copper ama fungicides si joogto ah.
Dholuo: Mondo omi ng'ato obed gi kido mar mango, onego otim nonro kuom kit yien ma ok nyal yie gi kit yien ma chalo gi Heidi kata Sensation, omed timo yien ma ok nyal yie gi pi, mondo omi koth kik chwer, owang'o olemo kod bede motho ma nigi tuwo, omed timo nonro mondo omi yamo omed rieny kendo ler obedie e kor yien, kendo onego oti gi yedhe ma konyo chwoyo kod mag thieth mag ng'owo e yo mapile.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges residents of Kakamega County to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers following a rise in reported tuberculosis cases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya kifua kikuu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku boorrinaysaa dadka deggan degmada Kakamega inay soo sheegaan kiisaska loo maleynayo inay u sheegaan mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaskii la sheegay ee cudurka hargabka.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit jiwo jogweng' Kakamega County mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore e weche thieth nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuberculosis osemedore.

English: KRA reminds voters in Trans Nzoia County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Trans Nzoia inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor inta aan la helin waxbarasho.
Dholuo: KRA parone jogweng'o mag Trans Nzoia County mondo olim kama ichikoe ji ne IEBC kapok giyudo tiegruok.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service informs tea farmers in Kisumu County of new market linkage opportunities this November.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawafahamisha wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Novemba hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku wargalinayaa beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Kisumu fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha November.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur mag chai e County mar Kisumu thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Novemba.

English: E-Citizen reminds voters in Kericho County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kericho kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya kusajili wapiga Kura.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Kericho inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor diiwaangelista codbixisayaasha.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa jogweng' Kericho mondo olim kama ioroe ji e IEBC kapok gidonjo e skundno.

English: IEBC advises applicants in Murang'a County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: IEBC waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Murang'a inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: IEBC nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Murang'a ni mondo gidonj e tiegruok kapok ichopo e chokruok mabiro.

English: In this context, the humanitarian situation in northern Kenya has become increasingly dynamic due to the overlapping impacts of drought and flooding.
Kiswahili: Katika muktadha huu, hali ya kibinadamu kaskazini mwa Kenya imezidi kubadilika kutokana na athari zinazoingiliana za ukame na mafuriko.
Somali: Xaaladdan oo kale, xaaladda bani'aadamnimada ee waqooyiga Kenya ayaa noqotay mid sii kordheysa oo isbeddelaysa sababtoo ah saameynta is dulsaaran ee abaarta iyo daadadka.
Dholuo: E ranyisi maeni, chal mar dhano e piny Kenya ma nyandwat osebedo ka medore ahinya nikech gik ma ng’ato nyalo timo nikech oro kod pi ma pong’o piny.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) encourages first-time voters in Kilifi County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Wilaya ya Kilifi kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Kilifi inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogo matimoga yiero mokwongo e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo oting'e ID kata pasi mar piny mangima e odiechieng'no mar timo yiero.

English: Tharaka Nithi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Mei 2023
Somali: Degmada Tharaka Nithi: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Tharaka Nithi: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar abich higa mar 2023

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health will host a free proper sanitation outreach in Wajir County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mazingira bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Wajir Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska Dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay marti gelineysaa adeegyo nadaafadeed oo bilaash ah oo ku habboon Degmada Wajir bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar piny owacho biro timo chenro mar chiwo kony ma onge chudo e alwora mar Wajir County e dwe mar Julai.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Kericho County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia simu ya bure ya EACC ili kupambana na matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee EACC si looga hortago xadgudubka xilka.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jogweng' Kericho County mondo oland weche mag mibadhi ka gitiyo gi simo mar EACC ma onge chudo mondo giked gi timbe maricho mag tiyo gi migepe.

English: Restaurants must; ensure quality & safety of food, rinse &sanitize food contact surfaces, disinfect surfaces, floors & counters. Install adequate portable running water & accessible washing basins for hand washing purposes, at the entrance & exit points. #KomeshaCorona update
Kiswahili: Migahawa lazima; hakikisha ubora na usalama wa chakula, suuza na usafishe sehemu zinazogusa chakula, kuua viini kwenye nyuso, sakafu na kaunta. Sakinisha maji ya bomba ya kutosha na beseni za kunawia zinazoweza kufikiwa kwa madhumuni ya kunawa mikono, kwenye lango la kuingilia na kutoka. #KomeshaCorona sasisho
Somali: Makhaayadaha waa inay; hubiyaan tayada iyo badbaadada cuntada, raaciyaan oo nadiifiyaan meelaha cuntada taabato, jeermiska ka dilaan meelaha, sagxadaha iyo miisaska. Ku rakib biyo ku filan oo la qaadi karo iyo weelal dhaqid oo la heli karo si loogu isticmaalo gacmo dhaqidda, meelaha laga soo galo iyo meelaha laga baxo. #Cusboonaysiinta KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Restoran nyaka bed ni; ng’e ni chiemo nigi ber kendo nigi arita, ng’ad kendo ng’ad kuonde ma chiemo oromoe, ng’ad kuonde ma chiemo oromoe, dier ot kod kaunta. Ket pi moromo ma ng’ato nyalo ting’o kod besin mag lwoko ma ng’ato nyalo yudoe mar lwoko lwete, e dhoot mar donjo kod wuok. #KomeshaKorona ma manyien

English: There is no local transmission of malaria in Nairobi. If you have been a full time resident of Nairobi and you get sick with fever the probability that it is malaria is close to zero.
Kiswahili: Hakuna maambukizi ya malaria jijini Nairobi. Kama umekuwa mkazi wa Nairobi kwa muda wote na unaugua homa, uwezekano kwamba ni malaria ni karibu sifuri.
Somali: Haddii aad joogtay magaalada Nairobi waqti buuxa oo aad ku xanuunsato hargabka, suurtagalnimada in ay tahay malaria waxay u dhow tahay eber.
Dholuo: Kapo ni ng'ato osedak Nairobi kuom thuolone duto kendo obedo matuwo nikech tuwo mar malaria, nyalo bedo ni en malaria.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds the public in Vihiga County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu dadka degmada Vihiga xusuusinayaa in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone ji duto e county mar Vihiga ni chiwo ripot mar kawo asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Notice: KALRO will conduct a fertiliser application workshop for farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafanya warsha ya maombi ya mbolea kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan isticmaalka bacriminta beeraleyda degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KALRO biro timo chokruok mar tiyo gi yien mag yien ne jopur e County mar Elgeyo-Marakwet e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) updates residents of Samburu County on progress of county development projects this February.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti hii Februari.
Somali: Guddiga Garsoorka Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Samburu ka warbixiyaa horumarka mashaariicda horumarinta degmada bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chiwo ripot ne jogweng' Samburu County kuom dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag county e dwe mar Februar.

English: Farmers and stakeholders are invited to engage in discussions on significant coffee reforms on December 6 2024
Kiswahili: Wakulima na washikadau wanaalikwa kushiriki katika mijadala kuhusu mageuzi muhimu ya kahawa mnamo Desemba 6 2024
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu casuumay inay ka qayb qaataan doodaha ku saabsan dib-u-habeynta waaweyn ee bunka 6-da Diseembar, 2024
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine mowuok e ogendni mopogore opogore ogwel mondo owuo e wi lokruok madongo mitimo e loso chai e dwe mar Desemba 6, 2024.

English: CDC urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Homa Bay County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: CDC inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: CDC waxay ku boorineysaa qofkasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee gobolka Homa Bay inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nyagore gi tuoche mag obwongo e Homa Bay County mondo oluong simo mar thieth mar obwongo maonge chudo.

English: FAO informs horticultural produce farmers in Laikipia County of new market linkage opportunities this September.
Kiswahili: FAO inawafahamisha wakulima wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Laikipia juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Septemba hii.
Somali: FAO waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda wax soo saarka beeraha ee degmada Laikipia fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: FAO nyiso jopur ma loso puothe mag puothe e County mar Laikipia thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Septemba.

English: KICD urges residents of Siaya County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: KICD inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kufaidika na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: KICD waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Siaya mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Meru (Meru-North) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Meru (Meru-Kaskazini): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Februari 2024
Somali: Degmada Meru (Meru-Waqooyi): War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Meru (Meru-Nyath): Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2024

English: Pest Control Products Board urges millet growers in Nyamira County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Waxsoosaarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka ayaa ku booriyay beeraleyda miiska ee degmada Nyamira inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products jiwo jopur mag millet e Kaunti mar Nyamira mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: NTSA urges the public in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: NTSA inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: NTSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadweynaha degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo ji duto e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo ochiw ripot ne jatendgi mar tij lendo kuom weche mag wuondruok ma ne otim gi SIM-swap.

English: Mothers who express breast milk should ensure clean containers, proper refrigeration, and correct warming procedures to prevent contamination.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wanaokamua maziwa ya mama wanapaswa kuhakikisha vyombo vinasafishwa, vinahifadhiwa vizuri kwenye jokofu, na taratibu sahihi za kupasha joto ili kuzuia uchafuzi.
Somali: Hooyooyinka nuujinaya caano hooyadeed waa inay hubiyaan in weelasha ay yihiin kuwo nadiif ah, qaboojinta saxda ah, iyo nidaamyada kuleylka ee habboon si looga hortago wasakheynta.
Dholuo: Min nyithindo madho kong'o onego one ni gige ting'o pi opong' gi gik maler, oting'gi e friji, kendo gitiyo gi yore mowinjore mag chungo pi mondo kik gibed gi tuoche.

English: Refugees in Kenya at risk of worsening hunger as WFP faces critical funding shortfall
Kiswahili: Wakimbizi nchini Kenya wako hatarini kukumbwa na njaa huku WFP ikikabiliwa na uhaba mkubwa wa fedha
Somali: Qaxootiga ku sugan Kenya oo halis ugu jira inay gaajada ka sii darto iyadoo WFP ay wajahayso yaraanta maalgelinta
Dholuo: Jolweny ma ni Kenya ni e arita mar bedo gi kech ma medore nikech WFP yudo pek maduong’ mar nok mar omwom

English: Notice: Council of Governors will hold a public participation forum on development planning forums in Embu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana litafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha waxay qaban doonaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta ee degmada Embu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Jaloch biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag dongruok e county mar Embu.

English: Competyetion for all on traditional foods cooking competition
Kiswahili: Ushindani kwa wote katika mashindano ya kupika chakula cha kitamaduni
Somali: Tartanka dadka oo dhan ee ku saabsan tartanka karinta cuntooyinka dhaqanka
Dholuo: Kwed ne Ji Duto e Migawo mar Tedo Chiemb Rapar

English: SHA advises residents of Migori County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: SHA inashauri wakazi wa Wilaya ya Migori kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e-Citizen.
Somali: SHA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan Degmada Migori inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan diiwaangelinta e-Citizen.
Dholuo: SHA nyiso jogweng' Migori County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro dhi e e-Citizen registration.

English: Official launch of biofertilizer to increase micronutrient content in crops grown in six counties.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi rasmi wa mbolea ya kibiolojia ili kuongeza kiwango cha virutubisho katika mazao yanayolimwa katika kaunti sita.
Somali: Daahfurka rasmiga ah ee bacriminta noolaha si loo kordhiyo nafaqada yar yar ee dalagyada laga beero lix degmo.
Dholuo: Ochako loso gik ma dongo dongo mondo omed kwan mar gik ma konyo e cham ma opidhi e kaunti auchiel.

English: Ministry of Health appeals to caregivers in Kirinyaga County to visit their nearest maternity wing as part of the September maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Septemba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Kirinyaga inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health okwayo jorit e County mar Kirinyaga mondo odhi olimgi machiegni gi kama gibiro yudoe nyithindo e dwe mar Septemba.

English: KTDA encourages farmers in Migori County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for tea.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya chai.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Migori inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan shaaha.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e county mar Migori mondo ous olembe mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo chai mondo giyud nengo maber mar chai.

English: State Department for Basic Education advises students in Homa Bay County to collect materials from the county education office to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kukusanya vifaa kutoka kwa ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata kompyuta ndogo za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa dijiti.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ardayda degmada Homa Bay kula talineysaa inay ka soo ururiyaan agabyada xafiiska waxbarashada degmada si ay u helaan kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska digitalka.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education nyiso jopuonjre e Homa Bay County mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar tiegruok mar county mondo giyud kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar somo kod somo mar digital.

English: State Department for TVET encourages out-of-school children in Turkana County to register their children at the nearest public school under free primary education.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Turkana kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Turkana inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e county mar Turkana mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni gi skul maduong' mar piny ka gipuonjore somo ma onge chudo.

English: Waste Management & Reverse Logistics of Used Packaging in Kenya (WFP)
Kiswahili: Udhibiti wa Taka na Urekebishaji wa Ufungaji Uliotumika nchini Kenya (WFP)
Somali: Maareynta Qashinka & Saadka Dib-u-eegista Baakadaha La Isticmaalay ee Kenya (WFP)
Dholuo: Tiyo gi yugi kod dwoko chien mag gik ma otigodo e paket e piny Kenya (WFP)

English: Kenya Gazette encourages first-time voters in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogo ma ne okwongo yiero e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo onon weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: SHA urges residents of Mombasa County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan bixinta adeegyada heerka qaybta.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jogweng' county mar Mombasa mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono ka gitiyo gi websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche duto e wi tich mitimo e gwenge duto.

English: E-Citizen invites residents of Turkana County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kushiriki kupitia portal ya kushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee la xiriira wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: E-Citizen gwelo joma odak e county mar Turkana mondo oriwre gi county's online participation portal e wi penjo mag chike mag sirkal.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Embu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhawaaqday taariikhda diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ee dugsiyada degmada Embu.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ministry of Education olando tarik ma jopuonjre biro donjoe e skunde mag Embu County.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds farmers in Kilifi County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kilifi barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jopur e county mar Kilifi chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche.

English: Notice: NTSA activates an emergency response plan for fire outbreaks in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NTSA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa milipuko ya moto katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay dabka ka kacay gobolka Meru.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NTSA tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony mapiyo ne masiche mag mach e County mar Meru.

English: KUCCPS encourages residents of Kilifi County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan wareejinta.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo jogweng' Kilifi County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi chiwruok.

English: Pest Control Products Board informs horticultural produce farmers in Nyeri County of new market linkage opportunities this October.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawafahamisha wakulima wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Nyeri juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Oktoba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Waxsoosaarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku wargalinayaa beeraleyda wax soo saarka beeraha ee degmada Nyeri fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products nyiso jopur ma loso puothe e County mar Nyeri thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Busia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Busia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka Busia waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Busia.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Puonjruok ma Chakre e Piny owacho, olando tarik ma nyithindo nyalo donjoe e skul mag Busia County maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Garissa County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha Gobolka Garissa in helitaanka adeegyada bukaanka dibedda hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji duto e County mar Garissa ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mag thieth e kuonde moyier.

English: IPOA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kisii County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: IPOA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Kisii kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Kisii inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e gweng' mar Kisii mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) urges farmers in Kirinyaga County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kirinyaga inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee beeraha cimilada ee caqli-galka ah si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e County mar Kirinyaga mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e weche mag pur mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok mar koth.

English: KMTC reminds needy students in Mombasa County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia vinafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KMTC waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Mombasa in buugaagta waxbarasho iyo codsiyada qalabka waxbarasho ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: KMTC oparo ne jopuonjre man Mombasa County ni buge mag somo kod weche mag puonjruok biro rumo machiegni.

English: Kenya: IPC Acute Food Insecurity and Acute Malnutrition Analysis (July 2025 - January 2026) Published on 8 September 2025
Kiswahili: Kenya: IPC Ukosefu wa Chakula Mkali na Uchanganuzi Mkali wa Utapiamlo (Julai 2025 - Januari 2026) Limechapishwa tarehe 8 Septemba 2025
Somali: Kenya: Falanqaynta IPC ee Amniga Cuntada Degdegga ah iyo Nafaqada Ba'an (Luulyo 2025 - Janaayo 2026) La daabacay 8 Sebtembar 2025
Dholuo: Kenya: Nonro mar IPC mar bedo maongee arita mar chiemo kod bedo gi chiemo ma ok oromo (abiriyo 2025 - dwe mar achiel 2026) Ogoye tarik 8 dwe mar apar higa mar 2025

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders in the tea sector are encouraged to engage with Dr Kipronoh Ronoh to discuss strategies for strengthening the sector and boosting earnings
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo katika sekta ya chai wanahimizwa kushirikiana na Dkt Kipronoh Ronoh kujadili mikakati ya kuimarisha sekta hiyo na kuongeza mapato.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha ee qaybta shaaha waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay la shaqeeyaan Dr Kipronoh Ronoh si ay uga wada hadlaan xeeladaha lagu xoojinayo qaybta iyo kordhinta dakhliga
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma tiyo e tij loso chai kaachiel gi joma tiyo e weche mag uso chai ijiwo mondo owuo gi Dr. Kipronoh Ronoh e wi yore mag jiwo tijno kendo medo pesa ma giyudo

English: KEMRI announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Kakamega County starting this September.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kuanzia Septemba hii.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa in laga bilaabo bisha Sebtember ee soo socota la siinayo dadka deggan degmada Kakamega.
Dholuo: KEMRI olando thieth mar dialysis kuom joma odak e Kaunti mar Kakamega kochakore Septemba.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public that free suicide prevention support is available through county health facilities in Machakos County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kuzuia kujiua unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Machakos.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo ka hortagga ismiidaaminta laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Machakos.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar geng'o ji kik donjre yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Machakos.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties advises residents of Turkana County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Turkana kula talinayaa inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties nyiso jogweng' Turkana County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro kwayo mar bedo gi kidono.

English: The National Counter Terrorism Centre continues nationwide coordination of security and awareness programs.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Kupambana na Ugaidi kinaendelea kuunganisha mipango ya usalama na ufahamu katika nchi nzima.
Somali: Xarunta Qaranka ee la dagaalanka Argagixisada waxay sii wadaa isuduwidda barnaamijyada amniga iyo wacyiga ee dalka oo dhan.
Dholuo: National Counter-Terrorism Centre dhi nyime tiyo gi chenro mar rito weche mag sirkal kod chiwo pach ji e wi timbe mahundu e piny mangima.

English: Notice: COMESA will conduct a fertiliser application workshop for farmers in Wajir County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itafanya warsha ya maombi ya mbolea kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan isticmaalka bacriminta beeraleyda degmada Wajir bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: COMESA biro timo tiegruok mar tiyo gi yien mag yien ne jopur e gweng' mar Wajir e dwe mar Februar.

English: TVET encourages out-of-school children in Bungoma County to register their children at the nearest public school under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza watoto wasio shuleni katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta dugsiga ka baxsan ee degmada Bungoma inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga dadweynaha ee ugu dhow fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo nyithindo maok dhi e skul e County mar Bungoma mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni gi skul mar ji duto.

English: IPOA warns residents of Turkana County to prepare for possible flooding this July.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa mafuriko Julai hii.
Somali: IPOA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay isu diyaariyaan fatahaadaha iman kara bisha July.
Dholuo: IPOA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Turkana County ni giikre ne koth maduong' mabiro timore e dwe mar Julai.

English: NPS reminds residents of Nyandarua County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah xilliyada dhulgariirada.
Dholuo: NPS parone jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji moa e gweng'no e kinde mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will be held in Murang'a County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ay soo qabanqaabisay qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Murang'a bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma biro bedoe e dwe mar Agost ma biro e county mar Murang'a ma ibiro chano gi Division of Disease Surveillance and Response.

English: Kenya Medical Association launches a May awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kizindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Mei juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu bilaabay olole wacyi galineed bishii May oo ku saabsan baaritaanka sonkorowga gobolka Siaya.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Mei e wi thieth mar thieth e County duto mar Siaya.

English: Should a health emergency arise, the same platform can be rapidly redirected to produce a response, shortening the time it takes for effective countermeasures to reach affected populations.
Kiswahili: Iwapo dharura ya kiafya itatokea, jukwaa sawa linaweza kuelekezwa kwingine kwa haraka ili kutoa jibu, na kufupisha muda unaochukua kwa hatua madhubuti za kukabiliana na hali hiyo kufikia watu walioathirika.
Somali: Haddii xaalad degdeg ah oo caafimaad ay soo baxdo, isla goobtaas si dhakhso ah ayaa loo wareejin karaa si loo soo saaro jawaab celin, taasoo soo gaabinaysa waqtiga ay qaadato tallaabooyin wax ku ool ah oo wax looga qabanayo si loo gaaro dadka ay dhibaatadu saameysey.
Dholuo: Kapo ni ng’ato oyudo masira mar thieth, yo ma kamano nyalo dwokore mapiyo mondo okel dwoko, ma dwoko piny kinde ma okawo mondo oket yore mabeyo mag geng’o masira mondo ochop e kind oganda ma oyudo masira.

English: Announcement of a national corporate steps challenge using apps/trackers to promote physical activity, team cohesion, and reduced absenteeism.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la changamoto ya hatua za kitaifa za kampuni kutumia programu/vifuatiliaji ili kukuza shughuli za kimwili, ushirikiano wa timu, na kupunguza ukosefu wa kazi.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida tallaabooyinka shirkadaha qaranka ee ku saabsan isticmaalka barnaamijyada / raadraaca si kor loogu qaado dhaqdhaqaaqa jireed, isku xirnaanta kooxda, iyo yareynta maqnaanshaha.
Dholuo: Lando chenro mar tiyo gi app/trackers mondo okony tich mitimo e yor ringruok, winjruok e kind joma tiyo e tich, kendo okony joma onge tich.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Kisii County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii in warbixinta khiyaanada si deg deg ah ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne jogweng' Kisii County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar wuond konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: KTDA urges millet growers in Nyandarua County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda millet ee gobolka Nyandarua inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si loo wanaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur mag millet e County mar Nyandarua mondo okaw kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo okony e medo nyak mar yien e higani.

English: Kwale County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for January 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kwale: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Januari 2024
