English: For a nutritious home-made feed for local chickens (about 8-10 months old), mix roughly: 40% maize or sorghum, 27% bran, 20% oilseed cake (sesame, cotton, or groundnut), plus smaller amounts of fish meal, salt, and mineral premix. Chickens raised on natural feed (not commercial feed with medication) fetch better prices from consumers.
Kiswahili: Kwa chakula chenye lishe cha kuku wa nyumbani (karibu miezi 8-10), changanya hivi: 40% mahindi au sorghum, 27% ya matope, 20% ya keki ya mafuta (sesamu, pamba, au karanga), pamoja na kiasi kidogo cha unga wa samaki, chumvi, na pre-mix ya madini. Kuku zilizolelewa kwa chakula cha asili (sio chakula cha kibiashara na dawa) huleta bei bora kutoka kwa watumiaji.
Somali: Si aad u hesho cunto nafaqo leh oo guriga lagu sameeyo oo loogu talagalay digaagga maxalliga ah (qiyaastii 8-10 bilood jir), isku qas qiyaastii: 40% galley ama sorghum, 27% bran, 20% keeg saliid ah (sesame, suuf, ama lows), iyo qadar yar oo cunto kalluun, milix, iyo macdanta hore. Digaagga lagu koriyo cunto dabiici ah (ma aha cunto ganacsi oo daawo leh) waxay ka helaan qiimo ka wanaagsan macaamiisha.
Dholuo: Kuom chiemb dhok ma nigi chiemo maber ma itiyogo e ot (higni 8-10), chokuru: cham mar cham ma romo 40% kata sorghum, 27% mar cham ma nigi suya mamit, 20% mar oilseed cake (sesam, koth, kata groundnut), kaachiel gi rech ma nigi makati matin, chumbi, kod gik ma yudore e lowo.

English: NPS alerts residents of Migori County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Migori juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Somali: NPS waxay dadka deggan degmada Migori uga digtay kororka kiisaska jabsashada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan wadaagista faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: NPS chiwo siem ne jogweng' Migori County ni kwan mag joma odonjo e ot biro medore kendo ojiwo oganda mondo kik gipog weche mag ritruok gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Uasin Gishu County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo katika msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Uasin Gishu inay dhagaystaan amarada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha deegaanka xilligan shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross parone jogweng' Uasin Gishu County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji e nderni ma jotelo mag gweng'no ogolo e kinde mag masiche mag ndara.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds parents in Kitui County that adult literacy classes registration is open this May.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba usajili wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima umefunguliwa Mei hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu xasuusinayaa waalidiinta Gobolka Kitui in diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ay furan tahay bisha May.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne jonyuol ma Kitui County ni ikruok mar somo mar jomatindo osechakore e dwe mar Mei.

English: KALRO reminds residents of Baringo County that organic farming improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba kilimo hai kinaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: KALRO waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo in beeraha dabiiciga ah uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: KALRO paronwa jogweng' Baringo County ni pur ma nigi gik mochido kelo nyak e puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: KMTC reminds youth in Bomet County that HELB funding is available for welding and fabrication training.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji.
Somali: KMTC waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Bomet in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista.
Dholuo: KMTC oparo ne rowere man Bomet County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing.

English: Subsidized fertilizer is now available for farmers in counties planting during the short rains Visit NCPB depots to access up to 100 bags per farmer starting September 19 2022
Kiswahili: Mbolea ya ruzuku sasa inapatikana kwa wakulima katika kaunti zinazopanda wakati wa mvua fupi Tembelea bohari za NCPB ili kupata hadi mifuko 100 kwa kila mkulima kuanzia Septemba 19 2022
Somali: Bacriminta deeqda ayaa hadda la heli karaa beeraleyda degmooyinka ku beera roobabka gaaban booqdaan bakhaarada NCPB si ay u helaan ilaa 100 boorsooyin beeraleyda kasta laga bilaabo September 19, 2022
Dholuo: Sani nitie yiende ma nigi kony ne jopur ma pidho puothe e kinde koth machuok.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Kitui County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waweze kufahamika juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay la xiriiraan maamulaha degmada si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda horumarinta degmada.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jogweng'o mag Kitui County mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jotend buchegi mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche momedore e wi chenro mag dongruok mar buchego.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development encourages farmers in Trans Nzoia County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for tea.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishiwa kupata bei bora ya chai.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan shaaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur e county mar Trans Nzoia mondo oti gi nengo matin mar chai mondo giyud nengo maber mar chai.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations alerts residents of Vihiga County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka kwa kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada ayaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga uga digayaa kororka kiisaska xoolaha lagu xado wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne ji modak e County mar Vihiga kuom wach medruok mar weche mag kwalo jamni kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne polis ma machiegni.

English: KTDA warns maize farmers in Kisumu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaonya wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhusu maambukizi ya wadudu na kupendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: KTDA waxay uga digtaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Kisumu cudurrada cayayaanka, waxayna ku talineysaa in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: KTDA chiwo siem ne jopur mogoyo kodhi e gweng' mar Kisumu kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: In November 2025, Kenya transitioned to a single-dose HPV vaccination schedule , in line with WHO recommendations, to simplify delivery and improve coverage.
Kiswahili: Mnamo Novemba 2025, Kenya ilibadilika hadi ratiba ya chanjo ya HPV ya dozi moja, kulingana na mapendekezo ya WHO, ili kurahisisha utoaji na kuboresha huduma.
Somali: Bishii Nofeembar 2025, Kenya waxay u gudubtay jadwalka tallaalka HPV oo hal mar la qaato, iyadoo la raacayo talooyinka WHO, si loo fududeeyo gaarsiinta iyo horumarinta caymiska.
Dholuo: E dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2025, piny Kenya noloko chenro mar chiwo chanjo mar HPV ma ng’ato nyalo tiyogo achiel , kaluwore gi kaka WHO ne ogolo paro, mondo oket chanjo obed mayot kendo ober kwan mar jogo ma ne oyudo chanjo.

English: Learn how corruption affects services and educate your community to prevent it
Kiswahili: Jifunze jinsi rushwa inavyoathiri huduma na uelimishe jamii yako ili kuizuia
Somali: Baro sida musuqmaasuqa u saameynayo adeegyada iyo barta bulshadaada si looga hortago
Dholuo: Puonjri kaka mibadhi chiko tije mag sirkal, kendo ikony joma odak e alworau mondo kik gitim kamano

English: IEBC conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Turkana County this April.
Kiswahili: IEBC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Turkana Aprili hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada ee degmada Turkana bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: IEBC dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e dwe mar April e kaunti mar Turkana.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges residents of Nairobi County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama katikati ya tahadhari kubwa ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nabadgelyada qaranka.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo jogweng' Nairobi County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar sirkal e wi gik ma timore e alwora mar tong'gi nikech ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom loso kuwe e piny.

English: Notice: EACC will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Tana River.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay qabaneysaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada ee degmada Tana River.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: EACC biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi weche mag bajet e taon mar Tana River County.

English: Council of Governors reminds the public in Embu County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Embu kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay dadka degmada Embu ku xasuusinayaan in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch oparo ne ji duto e County mar Embu ni chiwo ripot mar tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: UNAIDS and the World Health Organization therefore continue to advocate for differentiated service delivery models for people from key populations, including through community-led services.
Kiswahili: UNAIDS na Shirika la Afya Duniani kwa hiyo wanaendelea kutetea mifumo tofauti ya utoaji huduma kwa watu kutoka makundi muhimu, ikiwa ni pamoja na kupitia huduma zinazoongozwa na jamii.
Somali: Sidaa darteed, UNAIDS iyo Ururka Caafimaadka Adduunka waxay sii wadaan inay u doodaan qaababka bixinta adeegga ee kala duwan ee loogu talagalay dadka ka soo jeeda dadka muhiimka ah, oo ay ku jiraan adeegyada ay bulshadu hoggaamiso.
Dholuo: Omiyo, UNAIDS kod Riwruok mar Pinyruoth mar Thieth dhi nyime gi siro yore mopogore opogore mag chiwo kony ne ji ma wuok e oganda madongo, moriwo nyaka kokalo kuom kony ma ji otelne.

English: Teachers Service Commission announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in Busia County this June.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Busia Juni hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa ku dhawaaqay in bishii Juun la qeybiyo deeq waxbarasho oo loogu talagalay ardayda u baahan dugsiyada degmada Busia.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission ong'ado mar pogo tuke mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre man gi chandruok e skunde man Busia County e dwe mar Jun.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service encourages farmers in Kericho County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kupata bei bora ya mahindi.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda degmada Kericho inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay hadhuudhka.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur e county mar Kericho mondo oti gi nengo mar piny moseketo mar loso kodhi.

English: Notice: DPP launches a burglary prevention campaign in Lamu County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DPP yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Lamu Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada gobolka Lamu bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DPP chako kampen mar geng'o jomecho odonjo e dala mar Lamu e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Join or start a neighborhood watch program in your area.
Kiswahili: Jiunge au uanze programu ya kutunza majirani katika eneo lenu.
Somali: Ku biir ama bilow barnaamij lagu ilaaliyo xaafadaada.
Dholuo: Bed achiel kuomgi kata chak chenro mar bedo jarit alwora e alworau.

English: Ministry of Education advises applicants in Homa Bay County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha gobolka Homa Bay inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e Homa Bay County mondo odonj e skundgi kapok iketho skundno.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Kiambu County this June. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Juni hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhallinyarada ee degmada Kiambu bisha June. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Medical Association biro timo romo mar paro ne rowere e taon mar Kiambu e dwe mar Jun. Ji duto mor.

English: Announinng meeting where the country  formally signs UNSDCF Nutrition Joint Programme to support multisector work.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la mkutano ambapo nchi inasaini rasmi Programu ya Pamoja ya Lishe ya UNSDCF kusaidia kazi ya sekta nyingi.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida kulan ay dalku si rasmi ah u saxiixdo Barnaamijka wadajirka ah ee UNSDCF ee nafaqada si loo taageero hawlaha qaybaha badan.
Dholuo: Walando romo moro ma pinyno oseketogo sei mar UNSDCF Joint Programme for Nutrition mondo oriw lwedo tije ma itimo e yore mang'eny.

English: The entry of mobile telephony and accurate information availability at the right time has made it much easier and more easier on farmers..
Kiswahili: Uingizaji wa simu za mkononi na habari sahihi kwa wakati ufaao umefanya iwe rahisi zaidi na rahisi zaidi kwa wakulima.
Somali: Gelitaanka taleefanka gacanta iyo helitaanka macluumaadka saxda ah waqtiga saxda ah ayaa ka dhigtay mid aad u fudud oo sahlan beeraleyda..
Dholuo: Bedo ni simo mar lwedo ne yudore e yo mayot kendo weche ma ne ipuonjo ne yudore e sa mowinjore, osemiyo tijno obedo mayot ne jopur.

English: Announcement that Kenya is tracking midterm progress in five food system transformation pathways ahead of UNFSS+4.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwamba Kenya inafuatilia maendeleo ya katikati ya muhula katika njia tano za mabadiliko ya mfumo wa chakula kabla ya UNFSS+4.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida in Kenya ay raadineyso horumarka dhexdhexaadka ah ee shan siyaabood oo loogu talagalay isbeddelka nidaamka cuntada ka hor UNFSS+4.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda Jehova mar Kenya ne owacho ni Kenya ne dhi timo dongruok e yore abich mag loko chenro mag chiemo e kinde ma UNFSS+4 ne dhi chakore.

English: Kenya - Landslide and floods (media, Kenya Met Department)(ECHO Daily Flash of 16 May 2024)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Maporomoko ya ardhi na mafuriko (vyombo vya habari, Kenya Met Department)(ECHO Daily Flash ya 16 Mei 2024)
Somali: Kenya - Dhul-go' iyo daadad (warbaahinta, Waaxda Met-ka Kenya) (ECHO Daily Flash ee 16 Maajo 2024)
Dholuo: Kenya - Opodho mar piny kod pi mang'eny (yondo mar lando wach, Ofis mar Pinyruoth mar Kenya) (Rieny ma pile ka pile tarik 16 dwe mar abich 2024)

English: Teachers Service Commission announces distribution of revision guides to schools in Baringo County this August.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inatangaza usambazaji wa miongozo ya marekebisho kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Baringo Agosti hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa ku dhawaaqay in lagu qeybinayo hagaha dib u eegista dugsiyada degmada Baringo bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission ogolo chenro mar pogo buge mag somo e skunde mag Baringo County e dwe mar Agost.

English: IEBC advises residents of Kiambu County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: IEBC inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e-Citizen.
Somali: IEBC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay qaataan dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado dib u dhac marka la raadinayo diiwaangelinta e-Citizen.
Dholuo: IEBC nyiso jogweng' mar County mar Kiambu mondo oting'e buge duto madwarore mondo kik gikel hinyruok sama gidwaro dhi e e-Citizen registration.

English: KEMRI launches an April awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: KEMRI yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Aprili kuhusu uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: KEMRI waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Abriil oo ku saabsan baaritaanka sonkorowga gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: KEMRI chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar April e wi nonro mar thieth mar sukari e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu.

English: Maintain soil health through testing organic matter addition and avoiding harmful practices for better sweet potatoes growth
Kiswahili: Dumisha afya ya udongo kupitia upimaji uongezaji wa vitu vya kikaboni na kuepuka mbinu hatarishi kwa ukuaji bora wa viazi vitamu
Somali: Badbaadi caafimaadka ciidda adoo tijaabinaya waxyaabaha lagu daro organic iyo ka fogaanshaha dhaqanka waxyeelada leh si koritaanka baradho macaan u hagaagto
Dholuo: Dhi nyime rito ngima maber mar lowo kokalo kuom timo nonro kuom gik mochwe kendo weyo timbe manyalo hinyo lowo mondo omed dongo maber

English: KMTC calls on the community in Kirinyaga County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KMTC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: KMTC waxay bulshada degmada Kirinyaga ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyo.
Dholuo: KMTC luongo ji duto manie County mar Kirinyaga mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Kenya DREF Application Anticipatory Actions - EVD Outbreak (MDRKE052)
Kiswahili: Vitendo vya Kutarajia Maombi ya Kenya DREF - Mlipuko wa EVD (MDRKE052)
Somali: Tallaabooyinka La Filayo ee Codsiga DREF ee Kenya - Cudurka Faafa ee EVD (MDRKE052)
Dholuo: Tiyo gi DREF mar piny Kenya - Tuwo mar EVD (MDRKE052)

English: Notice: SHA launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Laikipia County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Shirika la SHA linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Shirkadda SHA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa oo lagu wacyi gelinayo gobolka Laikipia bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Rapar: SHA chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Laikipia e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: KRA opens polling procedures centres in West Pokot County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika Wilaya ya West Pokot mwezi huu wa Novemba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay furaysaa xarumaha nidaamyada codbixinta ee Gobolka West Pokot bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KRA chako tiyo gi chenro mag yiero e West Pokot County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Office of the Auditor-General advises residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Somali: Xafiiska tijaabiyaha guud wuxuu ku talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan shahaadada dhalashada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General nyiso jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro yudo barua mar nyuol.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Tana River County this December.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Tana River Desemba hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada ayaa qabanaya madasha waxbarasho ee bulshada ee ku saabsan wareejinta degmada Tana River bishii Diseembar ee sannadkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi somo e taon mar Tana River County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Enhancing reproductive health services through on-site mentorship in Kenya
Kiswahili: Kuimarisha huduma za afya ya uzazi kupitia ushauri wa tovuti nchini Kenya
Somali: Horumarinta adeegyada caafimaadka taranka iyada oo loo marayo la-talin goobta ah oo ka dhacda Kenya
Dholuo: Medo dongo tich mar thieth mar nyuol kokalo kuom puonj ma itimo e kar tich e piny Kenya

English: KEMSA announces eye and dental camps for residents of Lamu County starting this December.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatangaza kambi za macho na meno kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kuanzia Desemba hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa xeryaha indhaha iyo ilkaha ee dadka deggan degmada Lamu laga bilaabo bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: KEMSA ogolo kambi mag thieth mag wang' kod lak mag lak mag jood Lamu County kochakore Desemba.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges eligible citizens in Kisii County to participate in voter education.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Kisii kushiriki katika elimu ya wapiga kura.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kisii inay ka qaybqaataan waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo raia mag Kisii County mondo oriwre e tiegruok mar joma yiero.

English: KUCCPS conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Nyandarua County this March.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Machi hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay bishii Maarso ku qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda gobolka ee gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: KUCCPS dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda e dwe mar Mach e kaunti mar Nyandarua.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises coffee producers in Trans Nzoia County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inashauri wazalishaji wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kafeega ee degmada Trans Nzoia inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur ma loso chai e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: NPS reminds mobile money users in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna si looga fogaado fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: NPS paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo gitang' gi weche mag phishing.

English: Office of the Auditor-General warns public officers in Nandi County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Nandi dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Nandi khiyaanooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Nandi kuom timbe mag mibadhi.

English: COMESA warns wheat farmers in Marsabit County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawaonya wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuhusu maambukizi ya wadudu na inapendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: COMESA waxay uga digtaa beeraleyda sarreenka ee degmada Marsabit cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: COMESA chiwo siem ne jopur mag ngano e County mar Marsabit kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Help children understand the arrival of a new sibling to reduce jealousy and promote bonding.
Kiswahili: Wasaidie watoto kuelewa ujio wa ndugu mpya ili kupunguza wivu na kukuza uhusiano wa karibu.
Somali: Carruurta ka caawi inay fahmaan in walaal cusub yimaado si ay u yareeyaan hinaasta oo ay u horumariyaan xidhiidhka.
Dholuo: Kony nyithindo ong'e ka owadgi kata nyamin-gi ochopo mondo kik gibed gi nyiego kendo gibed gi winjruok maber.

English: Though the overall coverage was higher than the national average, it was limited by availability of commodities; therefore addressing procurement inefficiencies to ensure regular availability of all necessary HPV screening commodities is necessary for an effective HPV-based cervical cancer screening program rollout.
Kiswahili: Ingawa huduma ya jumla ilikuwa kubwa kuliko wastani wa kitaifa, ilipunguzwa na upatikanaji wa bidhaa; kwa hivyo kushughulikia upungufu wa manunuzi ili kuhakikisha upatikanaji wa mara kwa mara wa bidhaa zote muhimu za uchunguzi wa HPV ni muhimu kwa ajili ya uanzishaji wa mpango wa uchunguzi wa saratani ya shingo ya kizazi unaozingatia HPV.
Somali: In kasta oo guud ahaan daboolku uu ka sarreeyay celceliska qaranka, haddana waxaa xaddidnaa helitaanka badeecadaha; sidaas darteed wax ka qabashada wax-qabad la'aanta wax iibsiga si loo hubiyo in si joogto ah loo helo dhammaan badeecadaha lagama maarmaanka u ah baaritaanka HPV ayaa lagama maarmaan u ah barnaamijka wax ku oolka ah ee baaritaanka kansarka ilmo-galeenka ee ku salaysan HPV.
Dholuo: Kata obedo ni kwan mar jogo ma ne ochung’ ne tichno ne ni malo moloyo kwan mar jogo ma ne ochung’ne pinyno, ne en gi giko nikech ne nitie gik ma ne itiyogo; kuom mano, loso gik ma ok nyalo konyo e ng’iewo gikmoko mondo ine ni nitie gik moko duto ma dwarore mag ng’iyo HPV kinde ka kinde en gima dwarore mondo oket chenro maber mar ng’iyo kansa mar dhot dhako ma ochung’ne HPV.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will open a coffee collection centre in Vihiga County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itafungua kituo cha kukusanya kahawa katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ka furi doontaa xarun ururinta kafeega ee degmada Vihiga bisha Ogosto.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro yawo kama ichokoe chai e County mar Vihiga e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds citizens in Uasin Gishu County about their rights regarding voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuhusu haki zao kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Horumarinta Manhajka Kenya wuxuu muwaadiniinta degmada Uasin Gishu ku xasuusinayaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development parone raia mag Uasin Gishu County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar ndiko joma oyiero.

English: Notice: EACC launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Nyeri County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Juni hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: EACC waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhanka ah gobolka Nyeri bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Rapar: EACC chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Nyeri e dwe mar Jun.

English: TVET encourages out-of-school children in Uasin Gishu County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under free primary education.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta dugsiga ka baxsan ee degmada Uasin Gishu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo odonj e program mar puonjo jomadongo somo ma onge chudo.

English: A digital program and technology inclusively with new discoveries in agriculture, can help realize yields...all of them...
Kiswahili: Programu ya digital na teknolojia pamoja na uvumbuzi mpya katika kilimo, inaweza kusaidia kufikia mavuno... wote wao...
Somali: Barnaamij dijitaal ah iyo tiknoolajiyad oo ay ku jiraan helitaanno cusub oo beeraha ah, ayaa ka caawin kara in la helo wax soo saarka... Dhammaantood...
Dholuo: Chenro mar digital kod teknoloji moriwo nyaka gik manyien ma osetimore e weche mag pur, nyalo konyo e chopo nyak...

English: OGP warns public officers in Nairobi County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: OGP inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: OGP waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Nairobi inay musuqmaasuqa ka qaataan xafiisyada dowladda.
Dholuo: OGP chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e County mar Nairobi kuom kawo asoya e migepe mar sirkal.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds voters in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa xasuusinaya codbixiyayaasha gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet in ay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor inta aan la helin nidaamyada cod bixinta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties paronwa jotelo e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar piny mangima e odiechieng' mar timo yiero kapok itimo yiero.

English: Rapid Gender Analysis and Protection Assessment of Drought Situation in Marsabit County
Kiswahili: Uchambuzi wa Haraka wa Jinsia na Tathmini ya Ulinzi wa Hali ya Ukame katika Kaunti ya Marsabit
Somali: Falanqaynta Degdegga ah ee Jinsiga iyo Qiimaynta Ilaalinta ee Xaaladda Abaaraha ee Degmada Marsabit
Dholuo: Nonro mapiyo mar kido mar chuech kod pim mar rito chal mar oro e gweng' mar Marsabit

English: Universities Fund conducts a civic education forum on voter registration in Busia County this June.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu hufanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Busia Juni hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha ayaa bishii Juun ku qabanaya madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha degmada Busia.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund dhi nyime gi chenro mar tiego ji e dwe mar Jun e county mar Busia.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Kisii County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Kisii Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu qabtaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan dhismaha nabadda qaranka ee degmada Kisii bishii Ogosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Forest Service timo romo mar oganda e dwe mar Agost e wi loso kuwe e gweng' mar Kisii.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds youth in Meru County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Meru kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya dhalinyarada degmada Meru in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne rowere man e County mar Meru ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar chiemo kod mar rwako welo.

English: Kenya Gazette urges eligible citizens in Taita-Taveta County to participate in polling procedures.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza raia wanaostahili katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kushiriki katika utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Taita-Taveta inay ka qeyb galaan nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jokanyo mag Taita-Taveta County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag yiero.

Kiswahili: Dashibodi ya Kukabiliana na Ukame Kenya (Septemba 2022)

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public in Tana River County that access to subsidised dialysis is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Tana River kwamba upatikanaji wa dialysis ya ruzuku sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Tana River in helitaanka dialysis-ka la taageeray hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche parone ji duto e taon mar Tana River County ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mar dialysis e kuonde moyier.

English: NPS warns residents of Taita-Taveta County to prepare for possible landslides this March.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa maporomoko ya ardhi Machi hii.
Somali: NPS waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan gobolka Taita-Taveta inay u diyaar garoobaan dhulgariir dhici kara bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: NPS osiemo jogweng' Taita-Taveta mondo oikre ne yiengni mag lowo mabiro timore e dwe mar Mach.

English: Council of Governors partners with journalists for devolution news.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana hushirikiana na waandishi wa habari kwa habari za uhamisho.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay iskaashi la sameeyaan suxufiyiinta wararka ku saabsan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch tiyo kanyachiel gi jondiko e lando weche mag golo chiwo.

English: Notice: KMTC opens a new electrical installation programme at the vocational centre in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inafungua programu mpya ya ufungaji wa umeme katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo lagu rakibo korontada xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Mandera.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KMTC chako chenro manyien mar keto sitima e kambi mar tiegruok e taon mar Mandera.

English: Baringo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Baringo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2024
Somali: Degmada Baringo: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Baringo: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2024

English: Notice: KALRO restricts movement of dairy cows in Trans Nzoia County due to an anthrax outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO inazuia harakati za ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kutokana na mlipuko wa kimeta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da caanaha ah ee Gobolka Trans Nzoia sababo la xiriira cudurka anthrax.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KALRO ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok makwayo e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia nikech tuwo mar anthrax.

English: State Department for Basic Education encourages out-of-school children in West Pokot County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under free primary education.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada West Pokot inay dalbadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e West Pokot County mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok giko mar tiegruok ma onge chudo ochopo.

English: KUCCPS urges residents of Wajir County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from free primary education.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo ji duto modak e gweng' mar Wajir mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud somo ma onge chudo.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu ku dhawaaqay taariikhda diiwaangelinta waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj ogolo chenro mar somo mar pinyruoth ma onge chudo e skunde mag Trans Nzoia County.

English: CS Kagwe: @KisumuCountyKE did well on the use of technology through platforms such as bulk SMSs & 24-hrs call centres as an effective means of raising awareness on COVID-19 & a vehicle that offers the Community the much needed support during emergencies.
Kiswahili: CS Kagwe: @KisumuCountyKE ilifanya vyema katika matumizi ya teknolojia kupitia majukwaa kama vile SMS nyingi na vituo vya simu vya saa 24 kama njia mwafaka ya kuhamasisha watu kuhusu COVID-19 na gari linaloipa Jumuiya usaidizi unaohitajika wakati wa dharura.
Somali: CS Kagwe: @KisumuCountyKE si fiican ayuu uga shaqeeyay isticmaalka tignoolajiyada iyada oo loo marayo goobo sida fariimaha qoraalka ah ee badan iyo xarumaha wicitaanka ee 24-saacadood ah si ay u noqdaan hab wax ku ool ah oo lagu wacyigelinayo COVID-19 iyo gaari siiya bulshada taageerada aadka loogu baahan yahay xilliyada xaaladaha degdegga ah.
Dholuo: CS Kagwe: @KisumuCountyKE notimo maber e tiyo kod teknoloji kokalo kuom yore kaka SMS mang’eny kod kuonde goyo simu kuom seche 24 kaka yo maber mar medo ng’eyo kuom COVID-19 kod gari ma miyo oganda kony ma dwarore ahinya e kinde mag masira.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free dengue fever screening is available at all public health centres in Mandera County this October.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa homa ya dengue bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera Oktoba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka hargabka dengue ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee Degmada Mandera bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji ni nono tuwo mar dengue maonge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto mag oganda man Mandera County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: 2,169 people test positive for COVID-19 from 9,428 samples, positivity rate at 23pc; MoH says no death recorded
Kiswahili: Watu 2,169 wamepatikana na virusi vya COVID-19 kutoka kwa sampuli 9,428, kiwango cha walioambukizwa kikiwa asilimia 23; Wizara ya Afya yasema hakuna kifo kilichorekodiwa
Somali: 2,169 qof ayaa laga helay COVID-19 9,428 muunad, heerka cudurka ayaa ahaa 23 boqolkiiba; Wasiirka Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa sheegay in aan la diiwaangelin dhimashada

Dholuo: HELB timo romo mar tiego ji e wi migawo mar Ombudsman e gweng' mar Wajir e dwe mar Agost.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Busia County about a rise in phishing messages and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia juu ya kuongezeka kwa ujumbe wa udanganyifu na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ka digaya dadka deggan degmada Busia kororka farriimaha phishing wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga leh bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar County mar Busia kuom wach medruok mar ote mag phishing kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar ote manyalo kelo hinyruok ne jatendgi.

English: KRA urges residents of Uasin Gishu County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia laini ya bure ya EACC ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee EACC si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo jogweng' Uasin Gishu County mondo ochiw ripode mag mibadhi kokalo kuom hotline mar EACC maonge chudo mondo giked gi wuond mag yuto.

English: CDC reminds the public in Kisii County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kisii in helitaanka adeegyada bukaanka dibedda hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji duto e County mar Kisii ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mag ambulatori e kuonde moyier.

English: All deliveries should be conducted by skilled birth attendants at health facilities. This ensures safer births and immediate care in case of complications.
Kiswahili: Uzazi wote unapaswa kufanywa na wakunga wenye ujuzi katika vituo vya afya. Hii inahakikisha uzazi salama na huduma ya haraka iwapo kutatokea matatizo.
Somali: Dhammaan dhalmada waa in ay sameeyaan kalkaaliyayaal xirfadlayaal ah oo ka shaqeeya xarumaha caafimaadka. Tani waxay hubisaa dhalmada ammaan ah iyo daryeelka degdegga ah haddii ay dhacdo dhibaatooyin.
Dholuo: Twak duto onego otim gi jorit ma nigi lony e osiptal mar thieth. mano miyo nyuol bedo mayot kendo rito nyithindo mapiyo kapo ni giromo gi pek moko.

English: TSC advises applicants in Kisii County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: TSC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Kisii kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: TSC waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Kisii inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: TSC nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Kisii ni mondo gidonj e skundgi ka pok giyudo thuolo mar dhi nyime gi skundno.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds residents of Migori County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Migori kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya wilaya inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Migori in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone jogweng' Migori County ni luwo dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Pest Control Products Board encourages farmers in Bungoma County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for fish.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya samaki.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda degmada Bungoma inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo kalluunka ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Bungoma mondo odonj e riwruok mar riwruok ma nigi ratiro mar timo gik makelo hinyruok mondo omi rech obed gi nengo maber.

English: The app offers technical content on farming practices, up-to-date information on weather and other events, recordkeeping tools to manage and ...
Kiswahili: Programu hutoa maudhui ya kiufundi juu ya mazoea ya kilimo, habari ya sasa juu ya hali ya hewa na matukio mengine, zana za kuhifadhi rekodi za kusimamia na ...
Somali: App-ku wuxuu bixiyaa macluumaad farsamo oo ku saabsan hababka beeraha, macluumaad casri ah oo ku saabsan cimilada iyo dhacdooyinka kale, qalabka diiwaangelinta si loo maareeyo iyo ...
Dholuo: Appno chiwo weche mag tiegruok e weche mag pur, weche ma sani yudore e wi kit yamo kod gik mamoko, gik ma nyalo konyo e rito weche mag ngima kod...

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces SHA registration for residents of Kisumu County starting this December.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inatangaza usajili wa SHA kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kuanzia Desemba hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhawaaqday diiwaangelinta SHA ee dadka deggan degmada Kisumu laga bilaabo bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche ogolo chik mar SHA mar ndiko joma odak e County mar Kisumu kochakore dwe mar Desemba.

English: KNEC conducts a civic education forum on voter registration in Vihiga County this October.
Kiswahili: KNEC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Oktoba hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay Oktoobarkan ka qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: KNEC timo chokruok mar tiego ji e wi ndiko joma oyiero e County mar Vihiga e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Busia County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Busia in helitaanka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Busia ni thuolo mar yudo puonj mag chenro mag ngima joot en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag oganda.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya warns residents of Kirinyaga County to prepare for possible road accidents this October.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Oktoba hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga inay u diyaar garoobaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji osiemo jogweng' Kirinyaga County mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Kenya Price Bulletin, June 2024
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Bei ya Kenya, Juni 2024
Somali: War-saxaafadeedka Qiimaha Kenya, Juun 2024
Dholuo: Oboke mar nengo mag piny Kenya, dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2024

English: DCI calls on residents of Samburu County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: DCI waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Samburu inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: DCI okwayo jogweng' Samburu County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde mitimoe chokruoge mag ji duto e siro chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: Uganda has announced the outbust of Ebola, when the Monistry of Health confirmed one man aged 24 ifected and who later on died.
Kiswahili: Uganda imetangaza kuzuka kwa Ebola, wakati Baraza la Afya lilithibitisha mwanamume mmoja mwenye umri wa miaka 24 ameambukizwa na ambaye baadaye alifariki.
Somali: Dowladda Uganda ayaa ku dhawaaqday inuu cudurka Ebola uu ka dilaacay, iyadoo Hay'adda Caafimaadka ee Dalkaas ay xaqiijisay in hal nin oo 24 jir ah uu u geeriyooday cudurka, kaasoo markii dambe u geeriyooday.
Dholuo: Uganda oselando ng’anjo mar Ebola, ka ng’at achiel ma ja higni 24 noyudo tuwono kendo bang’e notho.

English: Kenya Gazette warns public officers in Nandi County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Nandi dhidi ya kutumia vibaya mamlaka.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee gobolka Nandi in ay ka faa'iideystaan xilka.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Nandi ni kik giti marach gi migepegi.

English: America suspending its international assistance through its USAID facility, has strained service delivery in the Kenyan health sector, more espevcially in HIV AIDS care, TB and malaria all depended on America's responsibility
Kiswahili: Marekani imesimamisha misaada yake ya kimataifa kupitia kituo chake cha USAID, imekanusha utoaji wa huduma katika sekta ya afya ya Kenya, haswa katika huduma za VVU, UKIMWI, kifua kikuu na malaria yote yalitegemea jukumu la Marekani
Somali: Maraykanku wuxuu joojinayaa caawimaaddiisa caalamiga ah iyada oo loo marayo xarunteeda USAID, wuxuu ku adkeeyay bixinta adeegyada waaxda caafimaadka ee Kenya, gaar ahaan daryeelka HIV AIDS, TB iyo malaria oo dhan waxay ku xiran yihiin masuuliyadda Maraykanka
Dholuo: Amerka oseng'ado mar chungo kony mar pinje mang'eny kokalo kuom chenro mar USAID, osemiyo tij thieth mar Kenya, to moloyo e weche mag HIV, AIDS, TB kod malaria, odoko matek kaluwore gi ting' mar Amerka.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response launches a February awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Februari juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Febraayo oo ku saabsan baaritaanka sonkorowga gobolka Samburu.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Februar e wi nonro mar thieth mar sukari e gweng' mar Samburu.

English: President William Ruto urges Parliament to expedite the Conflict of Interest Bill to allow EACC to keep government officers in check.
Kiswahili: Rais William Ruto anahimiza Bunge kuharakisha muswada wa mgogoro wa maslahi ili kuruhusu EACC kuweka maafisa wa serikali chini ya udhibiti.
Somali: Madaxweyne William Ruto ayaa Baarlamaanka ugu baaqay in uu dardar geliyo Sharciga Khilaafka Danta si loo oggolaado EACC in ay shaqaalaha dowladda gacanta ku hayso.
Dholuo: President William Ruto jiwo Bura mar piny mondo oketh mapiyo chik makelo ywaruok mar dwaro mondo omi EACC thuolo mar rito jotelo mag sirkal.

English: Narok County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Narok: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Juni 2023
Somali: Degmada Narok: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Narok: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2023

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service restricts movement of pigs in Baringo County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya yazuia harakati za nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Baringo kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi wenye uvimbe.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa doofaarka Gobolka Baringo sababo la xiriira faafitaanka cudurka maqaarka.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service ogeng'o wuoth mar le e County mar Baringo nikech tuoche mag pien.

English: Notice: KALRO will conduct a greenhouse farming workshop for farmers in Kakamega County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itaendesha warsha ya kilimo cha chafu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo ee beeraleyda Gobolka Kakamega bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Rapar: KALRO biro timo tiegruok mar timo tijno ne jopur e gweng' mar Kakamega e dwe mar April.

English: KMTC announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Kiambu County this December.
Kiswahili: KMTC inatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Desemba hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta waxyaabaha barashada digitalka ah ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Kiambu bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: KMTC ogolo chenro mar pogo buge mag digital maonge chudo e skunde man Kiambu County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Kenya: 2024 MSNI Bulletin, December 2024
Kiswahili: Kenya: 2024 MSNI Bulletin, Desemba 2024
Somali: Kenya: 2024 MSNI Bulletin, Disembar 2024
Dholuo: Kenya: Oboke mar MSNI higa mar 2024, dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2024

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Red Cross will be held in West Pokot County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada West Pokot bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma Kenya Red Cross ochano biro timore e West Pokot County e dwe mar Januar.

English: Anyone coughing for more than two weeks should go to the hospital to get tested for tuberculosis (TB) and start free treatment.
Kiswahili: Mtu yeyote anayekohoa kwa zaidi ya wiki mbili anapaswa kwenda hospitalini kupimwa ugonjwa wa kifua kikuu (TB) na kuanza matibabu bila malipo.
Somali: Qof kasta oo qufacaya in ka badan laba toddobaad waa inuu aadaa isbitaalka si looga baaro cudurka qaaxada (TB) loona bilaabo daaweyn bilaash ah.
Dholuo: Ng’at ang’ata ma ng’ich kuom juma ariyo mokalo onego odhi e od thieth mondo otimne pim mar tuo mar TB kendo ochaki thieth ma nono.
resource: Ministry of Health TB Prevention Campaign

English: Pest Control Products Board promotes conservation tillage among farmers in Kitui County as part of the June climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inakuza kilimo cha uhifadhi miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Juni.
Somali: Guddiga Wax soo saarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa beerashada ilaalinta beeraleyda degmada Kitui iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka adkeysiga cimilada ee Juun.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok mag Pest jiwo puodho mar ritruok e kind jopur e County mar Kitui kaka achiel kuom chenro mar dwe mar Jun mar kedo gi lokruok e kor lwasi.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Mandera County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ka digaya dadka deggan degmada Mandera kororka khiyaamada lacagaha SIM-swap wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga leh bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng'o mag Mandera County e wi medruok mar wuond mar SIM-swap kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok adier ne jatendgi.

English: Notice: IEBC opens voter education centres in Marsabit County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika wilaya ya Marsabit mwezi huu wa Novemba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee degmada Marsabit bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC chako tiego josiasa e taon mar Marsabit e dwe mar Novemba.

English: KNEC encourages residents of Nyamira County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan wareejinta.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jogweng' Nyamira County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda mondo ging'e weche duto e wi chiwruok.

English: Public health advisory: CDC warns of increased cholera risk in Marsabit County and advises the public to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: CDC inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya kipindupindu katika Kaunti ya Marsabit na inashauri umma kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: CDC waxay ka digtay khatarta kororka cudurka kolera ee degmada Marsabit waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakhda leh.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: CDC chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar cholera e taon mar Marsabit County kendo osiemo ji mondo kik giriwre gi pi mochido.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Meru County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Meru inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qayb galaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur e county mar Meru mondo okel namba mar pimo jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: Notice: KALRO will train farmers in Kisumu County on organic farming this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhusu kilimo hai Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Kisumu ee beeraha dabiiciga ah bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Rapar: KALRO biro tiego jopur e gweng' mar Kisumu e weche mag pur e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya launches the county integrated development plan in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu bilaabay qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Laikipia.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura mar Kenya chako chenro mar dongruok mar county e county mar Laikipia.

English: Baringo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Baringo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Baringo: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Baringo: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar Septemba 2022

English: Navigating Cultural and Traditional Barriers in Qualitative Data Collection
Kiswahili: Kuelekeza Vizuizi vya Kitamaduni na Kijadi katika Ukusanyaji wa Data Bora
Somali: Hagaajinta Caqabadaha Dhaqanka iyo Dhaqanka ee Ururinta Xogta Tayada leh
Dholuo: Kuong’o obadho mag kit oganda kod kit oganda e chokruok mar weche mabeyo

English: NPS warns residents of Trans Nzoia County about a rise in identity theft and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia juu ya kuongezeka kwa wizi wa kitambulisho na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: NPS waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia kororka xadgudubka aqoonsiga waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: NPS chiwo siem ne jogweng'o mag Trans Nzoia County e wi medruok mar kuo mar kitgi kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: EACC reminds voters in Kwale County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Kwale inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: EACC parone jogweng' Kwale County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000 kapok kinde mar yiero ochopo.

English: Judiciary of Kenya announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kushughulikia vyeti vya kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya ayaa ku dhawaaqay in lagu hagaajinayo waqtiga wareejinta shahaadada dhalashada ee Gobolka Samburu.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya olando lokruok e seche mag timo nonro mar nyuol e county mar Samburu.

English: Notice: NPS conducts a community briefing on border security in Kericho County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Kericho Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha degmada Kericho bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Riwruok mar NPS timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e County mar Kericho e dwe mar Desemba.

English: ODPP reminds the public in Murang'a County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Murang'a in sheegashada khiyaamooyinka iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: ODPP paronwa ji duto e County mar Murang'a ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag ohala en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: Now meet Julius Kareno Ole Menye, from Narok county, a prime example using comedy to remind his community to stay home, wash hands & to continue keeping distance to prevent the spread of Covid-19. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Sasa kutana na Julius Kareno Ole Menye, kutoka kaunti ya Narok, mfano bora wa kutumia vichekesho kukumbusha jamii yake kukaa nyumbani, kunawa mikono na kuendelea kuweka umbali ili kuzuia kuenea kwa Covid-19. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Hadda la kulan Julius Kareno Ole Menye, oo ka soo jeeda degmada Narok, tusaale wanaagsan oo isticmaalaya majaajillo si uu bulshadiisa ugu xasuusiyo inay guriga joogaan, gacmaha dhaqdaan & inay sii wadaan fogaanshaha si looga hortago faafitaanka Covid-19. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Koro romo gi Julius Kareno Ole Menye, mawuok e gweng' mar Narok, ranyisi maduong' mar tiyo gi sinema mag nyiero mar paro ne oganda mage mondo odong' pacho, olos lwedo kendo odhi nyime gi keto mabor mar geng'o lando mar Covid-19. #KomeshaKorona

English: Kenya Medical Association urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Migori County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Migori kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Degmada Migori inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e gweng' mar Migori County mondo odhi ir japuonj molony.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds mobile money users in Tharaka-Nithi County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Utafiti wa Jinai inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qofna si looga fogaado khiyaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e Tharaka-Nithi County ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo kik gitim mibadhi mar SIM.

English: Farmers in Embu are encouraged to explore value addition opportunities for mangoes to reduce waste consider joining local processing groups for support and training
Kiswahili: Wakulima huko Embu wanahimizwa kutafuta fursa za uongezaji thamani wa maembe ili kupunguza taka kufikiria kujiunga na vikundi vya usindikaji wa eneo hilo kwa msaada na mafunzo.
Somali: Beeraleyda Embu waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyay inay sahamiyaan fursadaha qiimaha lagu kordhiyo ee mango-yada si loo yareeyo qashinka, tixgeli inay ku biiraan kooxaha habaynta maxalliga ah si ay u taageeraan loona tababaraan
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma tiyo e alwora mar Embu jiwo mondo onon yore mag medo nengo mag mango mondo gikony e tieko chido mag chido, kendo gipar matut kuom tudruok gi grube ma loso cham e alworagi mondo giyud kony kod tiegruok

English: Notice: ODPP opens voter registration centres in Garissa County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inafungua vituo vya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Garissa Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay furaysaa xarumaha diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee Gobolka Garissa bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: ODPP ochako chenro mar chano joma biro yiero e county mar Garissa e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development invites youth in Samburu County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this February.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Samburu kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Februari hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku casuumay dhalinyarada degmada Samburu inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ogwelo rowere e county mar Samburu mondo odonj e tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service conducts a community briefing on community early-warning systems in Kilifi County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu qabtaa warbixin bulsho oo ku saabsan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada ee degmada Kilifi bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Forest Service timo romo mar oganda e dwe mar Jun e wi chenro mag chiwo siem chon e gweng' mar Kilifi.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Wajir County about the importance of diabetes screening for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuhusu umuhimu wa uchunguzi wa kisukari kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay dadka degmada Wajir ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda baaritaanka sonkorowga uu u leeyahay caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji e gweng' mar Wajir kuom ber mar nonro mar thieth mar sukari e ngima joot.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Taita-Taveta County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia laini ya bure ya EACC ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Taita-Taveta inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee EACC ee lacag la'aanta ah si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo oland weche mag mibadhi kokalo kuom hotline mar EACC maok chulo chudo mondo giked gi asoya e migepe mag sirkal.

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Busia County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Busia inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso jogweng' mar County mar Busia mondo odonj e riwruok mar insuarans mar thieth mondo giyud thieth ma yudo kony.

English: IEBC reminds youth in Kericho County that HELB funding is available for welding and fabrication training.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kericho in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista.
Dholuo: IEBC oparo ne rowere man Kericho County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public that free meningitis screening is available at all public health centres in Uasin Gishu County this August.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa uti wa mgongo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Agosti hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka meningitis ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Uasin Gishu bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne ji ni nono tuo mar meningitis en gima nono e kuonde thieth duto mag oganda e Uasin Gishu County e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: COMESA will distribute certified millet seed to farmers in Kisii County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay abuuraha degmada Kisii u qaybin doontaa abuurka miiska ee la caddeeyay bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: COMESA biro pogo kodhi mag millet ne jopur manie County mar Kisii e dwe mar Januar.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations alerts residents of Machakos County to a rise in fraud cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za ulaghai na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos uga digaya kororka kiisaska khiyaamooyinka wuxuuna bulshada kula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng' ma Machakos County kuom wach medruok mar weche mag wuondruok kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Undertake active disease surveillance, run livestock vaccination campaigns, and promote fodder storage.
Kiswahili: Fanya ufuatiliaji hai wa magonjwa, endesha kampeni za chanjo ya mifugo, na kukuza uhifadhi wa malisho.
Somali: Waxay fuliyaan kormeer firfircoon oo cudurrada ah, wad ololeyaal tallaalka xoolaha, iyo dhiirrigeliya kaydinta cuntooyinka.
Dholuo: Tim chenro mar rito tuoche, timo kampen mar chulo osuru ne jamni, kendo jiwo choko ring'o.

English: Notice: ODPP launches the county integrated development plan in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay bilawday qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: ODPP chako chenro mar dongruok e alwora mar Kakamega County.

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Murang'a County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Murang'a in helitaanka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Murang'a ni thuolo mar yudo puonj mag chenro mag ngima joot en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag oganda.

English: Kenya Red Cross appeals to caregivers in Makueni County to visit their nearest maternity wing as part of the September maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya watoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Makueni kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Septemba.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Makueni inay soo booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross okwayo jorit e county mar Makueni mondo olimgi ka gin machiegni gi kama giyudoe nyithindo e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Uneven rains, unequal impact: Drought and hunger in Northern Kenya
Kiswahili: Mvua zisizo sawa, athari zisizo sawa: Ukame na njaa Kaskazini mwa Kenya
Somali: Roobab aan sinnayn, saameyn aan sinnayn: Abaaro iyo gaajo ka jira Waqooyiga Kenya
Dholuo: Koth ma ok romre, gik ma ok romre: Oro kod kech e piny Kenya ma Nyanduat

English: Laikipia County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Laikipia: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Oktoba 2022
Somali: Degmada Laikipia: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Laikipia: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar apar 2022

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of Kiambu County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay u dhiiri galiyaan saaxiibka dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' Kiambu County mondo kik gisandre aling' ling' kendo mondo gijiw osiepgi moro ma chandore omany kony.

Kiswahili: Masks ni kizuizi rahisi kusaidia kuzuia matone yako ya kupumua kuwafikia wengine. Uchunguzi unaonyesha kuwa masks hupunguza dawa ya matone wakati huvaliwa juu ya pua na mdomo. #KomeshaCorona #WearAMask x.com/ExplainerKE/st Ã¢Â€Â¦
Somali: Maaskaradu waa caqabad fudud oo kaa caawin karta ka hortagga dhibcaha neefsashadaada inay gaaraan kuwa kale. Daraasaduhu waxay muujinayaan in maaskaradu ay yareeyaan buufinta dhibcaha marka la mariyo sanka iyo afka. #KomeshaCorona #WearAMask x.com/ExplainerKE/st Ã¢Â€Â¦
