Kiswahili: Serikali yamwagiza Mama Mbogas kuacha kukata mboga kwa ajili ya wateja kutokana na hofu ya COVID-19
Somali: Dowladdu waxay Mama Mbogas ku amartay inay joojiso jarista khudaarta macaamiisha cabsi laga qabo COVID-19 awgeed
Dholuo: Sirkal ok omi Mama Mbogas chik mondo ogeng' ng'ado alode ne jonyiewo nikech luoro mar COVID-19

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to embrace unified agricultural extension services as discussed in the National Agricultural Extension Conference held on September 16 17 2025
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wamehimizwa kukumbatia huduma za ugani za kilimo kama ilivyojadiliwa katika Mkutano wa Kitaifa wa Ugani wa Kilimo uliofanyika Septemba 16 17 2025.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay qaataan adeegyada kordhinta beeraha ee isku midka ah sida laga wada hadlay Shirkii Qaranka ee kordhinta beeraha ee la qabtay 16-17 Sebtember 2025
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma tiyo gi yore mag loso puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free suicide prevention support is available through county health facilities in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kuzuia kujiua unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo ka hortagga ismiidaaminta laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Mandera County.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar geng'o ji kik nege yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Mandera.

English: Mothers should return for postnatal checkups within 48 hours, 7 days, and 6 weeks after delivery.
Kiswahili: Mama wanapaswa kurudi kwa uchunguzi wa baada ya kuzaliwa ndani ya masaa 48, siku 7, na wiki 6 baada ya kujifungua.
Somali: Hooyooyinka waa inay dib ugu soo noqdaan baaritaanka dhalmada kadib 48 saacadood, 7 maalmood, iyo 6 toddobaad ka dib dhalmada.
Dholuo: Min onego oduog e nonro bang ' nyuol bang ' seche 48, odiechienge 7, kod jumbe 6 bang' nyuol.

English: Ministry of Education provides tablets loaded with offline digital libraries to schools in Arid and Semi-Arid Lands.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu hutoa vidonge vilivyojaa maktaba za dijiti nje ya mtandao kwa shule katika nchi kavu na nchi kavu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay maktabadaha ku yaalla dhulka qalalan iyo kuwa semi-qalalan siineysaa kiniiniyo la buuxiyey maktabado dhijitaal ah oo aan khadka tooska ahayn.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok chiwo tablet moting'o kitepe mag digital maok nie Intanet ne skunde man kuonde mokethore kod kuonde ma nokethore.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public in Kisii County about the importance of tobacco control for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuhusu umuhimu wa udhibiti wa tumbaku kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa dadka degmada Kisii ku xasuusineysa muhiimadda ay leedahay xakamaynta sigaarka ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji duto e County mar Kisii gimomiyo thieth mar madho ndawa en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: State Department for Basic Education reminds youth in Bungoma County that HELB funding is available for electrical installation training.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Bungoma in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka rakibidda korontada.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education oparo ne rowere man Bungoma County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar loso sitima.

English: By harnessing digital technology in agriculture and food systems, the ... IFAD 13 must pave the way for IFAD's role in innovative agri-.
Kiswahili: Kwa kutumia teknolojia ya kidijitali katika kilimo na mifumo ya chakula, ... IFAD 13 lazima iandae njia kwa ajili ya jukumu la IFAD katika kilimo bunifu.
Somali: Iyadoo la adeegsanayo tiknoolajiyada dijittaalka ah ee beeraha iyo nidaamyada cuntada, ... IFAD 13 waa inay waddada u furtaa doorka IFAD ee beeraha hal-abuurka leh.
Dholuo: Kuom tiyo gi teknoloji mar digital e weche mag pur kod chiemo, IFAD 13 onego oyaw yo ne migawo mar IFAD e weche mag pur.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu furayaa goob adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee degmada Kilifi.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura mar Kenya oseyawo kamachielo mar e-Citizen registration e County Kilifi.

English: SHA reminds residents of Nakuru County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru in ay ku hawlan yihiin maamulahooda degmada si ay u xoojiyaan maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: SHA paronwa jogweng' Nakuru County ni tudruok gi jotelo mag gwenge maggi miyo sirkal bedo gi loch maber.

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of Marsabit County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: Kenya Red Cross inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kuhusu kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit kororka qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan falin.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar Marsabit County e wi medruok mar chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: Students finally return to school as six-hour daily water fetching duty comes to an end
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi hatimaye wanarejea shuleni huku kazi ya kuchota maji ya saa sita kila siku ikikamilika
Somali: Ardaydu waxay ugu dambeyntii ku soo laabteen dugsiga iyadoo lix saacadood oo shaqo ah oo biyo soo dhaansi ah maalintii ay dhammaatay
Dholuo: Nyithind sikul gikone dok e skul ka tich mar ywayo pi ma kawo seche auchiel pile ka pile chopo e giko

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) informs tea farmers in Narok County of new market linkage opportunities this June.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawafahamisha wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Narok juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Juni hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee Gobolka Narok fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nyiso jopur ma loso chai e kaunti mar Narok thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Jun.

English: To manage tomato wilt (kiwotoka), rotate tomatoes with maize, beans, or sweet potatoes for several years, plant tomatoes in a different plot each year, try different varieties to find resistant ones, and pull up and burn any wilting plant you find.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti mnyauko wa nyanya (kiwotoka), zungusha nyanya na mahindi, maharagwe, au viazi vitamu kwa miaka kadhaa, panda nyanya katika shamba tofauti kila mwaka, jaribu aina tofauti ili kupata sugu, na uvute na uchome mmea wowote unaonyauka unaopata.
Somali: Si aad u maareysid daadka (kiwotoka), ku wareejiya yaanyada hadhuudhka, xajmiga, ama baradho macaan dhowr sano, ku beeri yaanyada dhul kala duwan sanad kasta, isku day noocyo kala duwan si aad u hesho kuwa u adkaysta, iyo soo qaado oo gubanaya dhirta kasta oo daadka ah aad ka hesho.
Dholuo: Mondo omi ng'ato obed gi nyalo mar geng'o koth pomade (kiwotoka), nyaka ochak chwoyo pomade gi kodhi, nyinyo, kata kit pomade mamit kuom higni mang'eny, kendo pidhe e puothe mopogore opogore higa ka higa, tem kit pomade mopogore opogore mondo iyud moko ma nyalo geng'o kodhino, kendo igolie kendo wang'o yien moro amora ma omako.

English: COVID-19 is spreading very first in our community. Today we have 22 new cases. Let us quarantine ourselves and stay home to protect each other; CS Mutahi. #KomeshaCorona update
Kiswahili: COVID-19 inaenea kwanza kabisa katika jamii yetu. Leo tuna kesi 22 mpya. Tujiweke karantini na tukae nyumbani kulindana; CS Mutahi. #KomeshaCorona sasisho
Somali: COVID-19 ayaa markii ugu horreysay ku faafaya bulshadeenna. Maanta waxaan haynaa 22 kiis oo cusub. Aan is karantiilno oo aan guriga joogno si aan isu ilaalinno; CS Mutahi. #Warbixinta #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: COVID-19 landore mokuongo ahinya e alworawa. Kawuono wan gi kes manyien 22. Waketre e quarantine kendo wabed pacho mondo warit jowetewa; CS Mutahi. #KomeshaKorona ma manyien

English: Postpartum women should take deworming medication to improve nutrition and milk quality.
Kiswahili: Wanawake baada ya kujifungua wanapaswa kutumia dawa za minyoo ili kuboresha lishe na ubora wa maziwa.
Somali: Haweenka dhalmada ka dib waa inay qaataan daawooyinka ka hortagga cayayaanka si loo hagaajiyo nafaqada iyo tayada caanaha.
Dholuo: Mon ma ne onyuol bang' nyuol onego oti gi yedhe ma geng'o ich mondo omi gimed bedo gi chiemo maber kendo gimi chak obed maber.

English: Farmers livestock keepers and fishermen in Tanzania can expect lower production costs and higher incomes under the 2050 Master Plan Stay informed on how to participate in this initiative
Kiswahili: Wakulima wafugaji na wavuvi nchini Tanzania watarajie gharama ndogo za uzalishaji na mapato ya juu chini ya Mpango Kabambe wa 2050 Endelea kufahamishwa jinsi ya kushiriki katika mpango huu.
Somali: Beeraleyda, xoolo-dhaqatada iyo kalluumaysatada Tanzania waxay filan karaan kharashka wax-soo-saarka oo hoos u dhaca iyo dakhliga sare ee Qorshaha Guud ee 2050. La soco sida looga qayb qaadan karo hindisahan
Dholuo: jopur mag jamni kod jolupo mag rech e Tanzania nyalo geno ni nengo mag chamo jamni biro bedo piny kendo gibiro yudo pesa momedore e bwo chenro maduong ' mar higa 2050

English: SHA invites residents of Narok County to attend the public participation forum regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: SHA inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: SHA waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Narok inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: SHA gwelo jogweng' Narok County mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenro mag dongruok.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will conduct a modern irrigation techniques workshop for farmers in Kiambu County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itafanya warsha ya kisasa ya mbinu za umwagiliaji kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah ee beeraleyda degmada Kiambu bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro timo tiegruok e wi yore mag lero pi e dwe mar Agost mabiro ne jopur e County mar Kiambu.

English: Agricultural stakeholders are encouraged to pursue an all inclusive agri financing system to better support smallholder farmers and women producers
Kiswahili: Wadau wa kilimo wanahimizwa kufuata mfumo wa ufadhili wa kilimo unaojumuisha wote ili kusaidia vyema wakulima wadogo na wazalishaji wanawake.
Somali: Daneeyayaasha beeraha waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay raacaan nidaam maalgelin beeraha oo dhamaystiran si loo taageero beeraleyda yaryar iyo haweenka soo saara
Dholuo: Ojiwo joma nie weche mag pur mondo oti gi chenro mar chiwo pesa ne jopur matindo kod jopur ma mon

English: State Department for TVET urges residents of Murang'a County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from free primary education.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay iska diiwaangeliyaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Murang'a mondo odonj e program mar puonjo joma dongo mondo giyud tiegruok ma onge chudo.

English: OGP reminds voters in Nyeri County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: OGP inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya kujiandikisha.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Nyeri in ay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor diiwaangelinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: OGP parone jogweng' Nyeri County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go ka gitiyo gi sms ne ji 70000 kapok gidonjo e register mar joma biro yiero.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuwasilisha kumbukumbu za maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga loo dhigay si loo qaabeeyo goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso chenro mag dongruok.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service promotes conservation tillage among farmers in Siaya County as part of the January climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inakuza kilimo cha uhifadhi kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Siaya kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Januari.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa beerashada ilaalinta beeraleyda degmada Siaya iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Janaayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service miyo jopur e county mar Siaya thuolo mar timo tijno e dwe mar Januar.

English: KALRO advises farmers in Turkana County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Turkana inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kalfadhiga tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e county mar Turkana mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e chokruok mabiro.

English: TSC encourages residents of Vihiga County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: TSC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabaan doorka garsoorka.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo ji modak e County mar Vihiga mondo onon weche ma gin-go e wi register mar joma oyiero mondo ging'e tich mar ombudsman.

English: KEMRI urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Busia County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Busia kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Busia inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nyagore gi tuoche mag obwongo e County mar Busia mondo odhi ir japuonj molony.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) opens voter registration centres in Lamu County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inafungua vituo vya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Lamu Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu furayaa xarumaha diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee Gobolka Lamu bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) ochako chenro mar chano joma biro yiero e county mar Lamu e dwe mar Mach.

English: Water Missionâ€™s Disaster Response Team Responds to Flooding in East Africa
Kiswahili: Timu ya Kukabiliana na Maafa ya Water Mission Yajibu Mafuriko Afrika Mashariki
Somali: Kooxda Ka Jawaabista Musiibooyinka ee Howlgalka Biyaha ayaa ka jawaabtay Daadad ka dhacay Bariga Afrika.
Dholuo: Tim mar Rieko mar Pi Odwoko e kinde ma pi opong'o e piny Afrika ma Wuokchieng'

English: E-Citizen advises residents of Meru County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-C citizen wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e- Citizen marka ay raadinayaan adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: E-Citizen nyiso jogweng' mar Meru County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-C citizen portal sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport services.

English: The Kimalel Goat Auction will take place on December 17 2024 to support the livestock sector Farmers are encouraged to participate
Kiswahili: Mnada wa Mbuzi wa Kimalel utafanyika Desemba 17 2024 kusaidia sekta ya mifugo Wakulima wanahimizwa kushiriki.
Somali: Xaraashka Ri'da Kimalel ayaa dhici doona 17-ka Diseembar, 2024 si loo taageero qaybta xoolaha. Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay ka qayb qaataan
Dholuo: Ng'ato ka ng'ato kuomwa biro yudo thuolo mar dhi e ng'iewo dhok e yor pesa e dwe mar Desemba 17 2024 mondo okonygo tij rito jamni.

English: CFK Africa conducts early childhood development teacher training in Kenya on supporting children with disabilities
Kiswahili: CFK Africa inaendesha mafunzo ya ualimu wa maendeleo ya utotoni nchini Kenya kuhusu kusaidia watoto wenye ulemavu
Somali: CFK Africa waxay tababar macallimiinta horumarinta carruurnimada hore ku qabataa Kenya oo ku saabsan taageeridda carruurta naafada ah.
Dholuo: CFK Afrika timo puonjruok mar jopuonj mag dongruok mar nyithindo matindo e piny Kenya kuom konyo nyithindo ma nigi nyalruok

English: When harvesting and drying groundnuts, do not harvest in the rain or pile the pods into heaps that stay damp, since this encourages mould and dangerous aflatoxin contamination; handle pods carefully to avoid splitting the seeds, which lowers their sale value.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa kuvuna na kukausha karanga, usivune kwenye mvua au kurundika maganda kwenye lundo ambalo hukaa unyevunyevu, kwani hii inahimiza ukungu na uchafuzi hatari wa aflatoxin; Shughulikia maganda kwa uangalifu ili kuepuka kugawanya mbegu, ambayo hupunguza thamani yao ya mauzo.
Somali: Marka la goosto oo la qalajiyo lowska dhulka, ha goosan roobka ama ha isku ururin qolofka qoyan, maadaama tani ay dhiirrigelinayso caaryada iyo wasakheynta halista ah ee aflatoxin; Si taxaddar leh u maareeya qaybaha si aan abuurka u kala go'in, taasoo hoos u dhigaysa qiimaha iibka.
Dholuo: Sama ichoko kod tugo cham, kik ichok cham e koth kata kik iketgi e bunde ma ok rum nikech mano miyo ichido kod gik ma kelo hinyruok e dendgi.

English: NTSA alerts residents of Nyandarua County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: NTSA waxay dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua uga digtay kororka kiisaska tuugada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka warbixiyaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nyandarua County kuom wach kwan mar joma okwalo gik moko kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot e stesen mar polise man machiegni.

English: Council of Governors urges eligible citizens in Kwale County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linawahimiza raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Kwale kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku boorinayaan muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kwale inay ka qaybqaataan jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo raia mag Kwale County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar yiero.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Samburu County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen anawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kuwasilisha kumbukumbu za maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Samburu inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga loo dhigay si loo qaabeeyo wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: E-Citizen ojiwo jogweng' Samburu County mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso chenro mag chenro mag sirkal.

English: Public health advisory: SHA (Social Health Authority) warns of increased Rift Valley Fever risk in Kiambu County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa katika Kaunti ya Kiambu na inashauri umma kutumia vyandarua vya mbu vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) wuxuu ka digay khatarta sii kordheysa ee Cudurka Rift Valley ee Gobolka Kiambu wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay isticmaalaan shabaqa cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar oganda: SHA (Social Health Authority) chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuwo mar Rift Valley Fever e County mar Kiambu kendo ojiwo ji mondo oti gi net mar kute ma otigo gi yedhe makelo tuoche.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) opens a new service point for passport services in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ka furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) oyawo kamachielo manyien mar tiyo gi passport e county mar Homa Bay.

English: KEMRI encourages mothers in Nyeri County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Nyeri inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo mine manie County mar Nyeri mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Isiolo County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the March planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji Machi.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Isiolo inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur manie Isiolo County mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochako chwoyo kodhi e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: e-Citizen launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Garissa County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Garissa Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: e-Citizen waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa gobolka Garissa bishii November.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: e-Citizen chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Garissa e dwe mar Novemba.

English: A review detailed IPOAâ€™s achievements, challenges, and strategic direction and outlined next steps in police accountability reform.
Kiswahili: Mapitio yalielezea mafanikio, changamoto, na mwelekeo wa kimkakati wa IPOA na kuelezea hatua zinazofuata katika mageuzi ya uwajibikaji wa polisi.
Somali: Dib-u-eegis ayaa faahfaahin ka bixisay guulaha IPOA, caqabadaha, iyo jihada istaraatiijiyadeed waxayna qeexday tallaabooyinka xiga ee dib-u-habaynta isla xisaabtanka booliiska.
Dholuo: Oboke moro nonyiso matut gik ma IPOA osetimo, pek ma ne en-go, kod yore ma ne odhi luwo kendo ne ogolo yore mabiro bang’e e loso lokruok e weche mag ng’ado bura ne jopolisi.

English: Pest Control Products Board encourages farmers in Uasin Gishu County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for milk.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya maziwa.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda degmada Uasin Gishu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan caanaha.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu mondo odonj e riwruok mar riwruok ma nigi ratiro mar loso gik makelo hinyruok mondo omi chak obed gi nengo maber.

English: DCI urges the community in Laikipia County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb carjacking.
Kiswahili: DCI inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia utekaji nyara wa magari.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Laikipia inay ku biiraan mashaariicda booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si looga hortago afduubka gawaarida.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo ji duto e County mar Laikipia mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polis mar oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o wuondo mtokni.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds parents in Wajir County that free day secondary education registration is open this September.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba usajili wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo umefunguliwa Septemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya waalidiinta Gobolka Wajir in diiwaangelinta dugsiga dhexe ee maalin bilaash ah ay furan tahay bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne jonyuol e gweng' mar Wajir ni somo mar sekondari mar odiechieng' maonge chudo osechakore e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds residents of Isiolo County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu kuwakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo in ay ku hawlan yihiin maamulaha qaybta deegaanka si loo xoojiyo maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General parone jogweng' Isiolo County ni tiyo gi jarit mar ward margi e jiwo sirkal.

English: Farmers have accepted to reach out..results shows reaching markets is one way in bee keeping.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wamekubali kufikia.. matokeo yanaonyesha kufikia masoko ni njia moja katika ufugaji nyuki.
Somali: Beeraleyda ayaa aqbalay inay la xiriiraan.. Natiijooyinku waxay muujinayaan in suuqyada la gaaro ay tahay mid ka mid ah hababka ilaalinta shinnida.
Dholuo: Jo-Puritan ne oyie mondo omigi kony.

English: Notice: OGP opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa ajili ya usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Wilaya ya Tana River.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay fureysaa goob adeeg cusub oo lagu shaqeynayo shahaadada dhalashada ee degmada Tana River.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: OGP oseyawo kama itimee tije manyien mar loso barua mag nyuol e taon mar Tana River County.

Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Kiuchumi ya Kenya, Desemba 2023 (Toleo #28)
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta Dhaqaalaha Kenya, Diseembar 2023 (Daabacaadda #28)
Dholuo: Wach manyien mar weche yuto mag piny Kenya, dwe mar apar gi ariyo 2023 (Oboke #28)

English: IsraAID Kenya supports displaced communities following tribal violence
Kiswahili: IsraAID Kenya inaunga mkono jamii zilizohamishwa kufuatia ghasia za kikabila
Somali: IsraaAID Kenya waxay taageertaa bulshooyinka barakacay ka dib rabshado qabiil
Dholuo: IsraAID Kenya siro oganda ma oweyo udigi bang' tulo mar dho ut oganda

English: KRA invites residents of Embu County to attend the public participation forum regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: KRA inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: KRA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan wadatashiyada siyaasadda guud.
Dholuo: KRA gwelo joma odak e county mar Embu mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenrono.

English: Babies born before 37 weeks require warmth, feeding support, and regular health checkups for proper development.
Kiswahili: Watoto waliozaliwa kabla ya wiki 37 wanahitaji kupashwa joto, usaidizi wa kulisha, na uchunguzi wa afya mara kwa mara kwa ajili ya ukuaji sahihi.
Somali: Carruurta 37 toddobaad ka hor dhashay waxay u baahan yihiin diirimaad, taageero quudinta, iyo baaritaano caafimaad oo joogto ah si ay u horumariyaan si sax ah.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma inyuolo ka pok ochopo jumbe 37 mag pidho nyathi dwarore ni omiye liet, omiye chiemo, kendo otimnegi nonro kinde ka kinde mondo gibed gi ngima maber.

English: Notice: EACC launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kirinyaga County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa degmada Kirinyaga bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Rapar: EACC chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Kirinyaga e dwe mar Desemba.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free meningitis screening is available at all public health centres in Murang'a County this August.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa uti wa mgongo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Agosti hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka meningitis ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Murang'a bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: KEMSA oparo ne ji ni nono tuo mar meningitis en gima nono e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Murang'a e dwe mar Agost.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds the public in Nyeri County to remain vigilant on counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Uhalifu unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka degmada Nyeri ku xasuusinaya inay ka feejignaadaan ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne ji duto e county mar Nyeri ni gibed motang' e weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: KALRO warns cassava farmers in Nairobi County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaonya wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Nairobi juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KALRO waxay uga digtay beeraleyda cassava ee degmada Nairobi cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: KALRO chiwo siem ne jopur mag manias e County mar Nairobi kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: EACC urges residents of Vihiga County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandao wa kaunti ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jogweng' County mar Vihiga mondo oriwre gi county's online participation portal e loso chenro mar bajet mar county.

English: KUCCPS urges parents and teachers in Kiambu County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Kiambu inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Kiambu mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto.

English: OGP invites residents of Nakuru County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: OGP inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kuwasilisha maandishi ya maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: OGP waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: OGP gwelo jogweng' Nakuru County mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ogik mar chenro mar dongruok ochopo.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Uasin Gishu County about the importance of hand hygiene for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuhusu umuhimu wa usafi wa mikono kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMSA waxay dadka degmada Uasin Gishu ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda nadaafadda gacmaha ay u leedahay caafimaadka qoyska.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa ji duto e county mar Uasin Gishu gimomiyo rito ler mar lwedo en gima dwarore ahinya e ngima joot.

English: NCPB advises farmers in Lamu County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Lamu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kalfadhiga tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e County mar Lamu mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e tiego jopur mabiro.

English: NTSA calls on the community in Turkana County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaita jamii katika Kaunti ya Turkana kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwa ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: NTSA waxay bulshada degmada Turkana ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: NTSA luongo oganda man Turkana County mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo ochiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Launching of Kenyaâ€™s national Nutrient Profiling Model to guide labeling and regulation of unhealthy packaged foods.
Kiswahili: Kuzindua mtindo wa kitaifa wa kutambulisha virutubishi nchini Kenya ili kuongoza utambulisho na udhibiti wa vyakula visivyo na afya vilivyopakiwa.
Somali: Daahfurka Qaabka Qaran ee Nafaqada ee Kenya si loo hago calaamadaynta iyo nidaaminta cuntooyinka aan caafimaadka qabin ee baakadaha lagu sameeyay.
Dholuo: Ochako chenro mar piny Kenya mar ngâ€TMado kwan mar gik ma konyo e ringruok mondo otelne keto lembâ€TM kod chike mag chiemo ma ok ber e paket.

English: DPP urges residents of Kiambu County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: DPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: DPP ojiwo jogweng' Kiambu County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'adoe bura e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom weche mag rito tong'.

English: KNEC urges residents of Bomet County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa watu wazima ili kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Bomet mondo odonj e program mar puonjo joma dongo mondo giyud somo mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: Refugee-led business provides clean energy to camp residents
Kiswahili: Biashara inayoongozwa na wakimbizi hutoa nishati safi kwa wakaazi wa kambi
Somali: Ganacsi ay hormuud ka yihiin qaxootigu wuxuu tamar nadiif ah siiyaa dadka deggan xerada
Dholuo: Ohala ma jolweny otelo miyo jodak mag kambi teko maler

English: Meru (Meru-North) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Meru (Meru-Kaskazini): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Mei 2024
Somali: Degmada Meru (Meru-Waqooyi): War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Meru (Meru-Nyath): Oboke mar Chik Mapile mar Mei 2024

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Siaya County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Siaya in helitaanka adeegyada bukaanka dibedda hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMRI parone ji duto e county mar Siaya ni koro ginyalo yudo kony mag thieth mag ambulatori e kuonde moyier.

English: Kenya: Climate Change Country Profile (November 2023)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Wasifu wa Nchi kuhusu Mabadiliko ya Tabianchi (Novemba 2023)
Somali: Kenya: Taariikhda Dalka ee Isbeddelka Cimilada (Nofeembar 2023)
Dholuo: Kenya: Oboke mar Piny motudore gi lokruok mag kor lwasi (Apar apar gi achiel 2023)

English: Notice: FAO restricts movement of poultry in Tharaka-Nithi County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO inazuia harakati za kuku katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa digaagga ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi sababtuna tahay faafitaanka cudurka maqaarka.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: FAO ogeng'o wuoth mar le e Tharaka-Nithi County nikech tuoche mag pien.

English: Smart agricultural practice (SFSA)is a group that offers consultancy, knowledge and aÅµareness, working under agriculture sector in kenya and other part in Africa. We are present to oversee this perspective in agriculture, to ensure profits from farming and agribusiness, to facilitate production of resources for generations to come.
Kiswahili: Mazoezi mahiri ya kilimo (SFSA)ni kikundi kinachotoa ushauri, maarifa na ujuzi, kinachofanya kazi chini ya sekta ya kilimo nchini kenya na sehemu nyingine barani Afrika. Tupo kusimamia mtazamo huu katika kilimo, kuhakikisha faida kutoka kwa kilimo na biashara ya kilimo, kuwezesha uzalishaji wa rasilimali kwa vizazi vijavyo.
Somali: Dhaqanka beeraha ee caqliga badan (SFSA) waa koox bixisa la-talin, aqoon iyo aÅareness, oo ka shaqeysa waaxda beeraha ee Kenya iyo qaybo kale oo Afrika ah. Waxaan joognaa si aan u kormeerno aragtidan beeraha, si aan u hubinno faa'iidada beeraha iyo ganacsiga beeraha, si loo fududeeyo soo saarista kheyraadka jiilalka soo socda.
Dholuo: <2Zepa> SFSA en grup ma chiwo paro, rieko kod ng’eyo, ma tiyo e bwo sektor mar pur e piny Kenya kod kuonde mamoko e Afrika. Wabedo kanyo mar rito paro ma kamano e pur, mondo wane ni yudo ohala kuom pur kod ohala mar pur, mondo wakony e loso mwandu mag piny ne anyuola mabiro.

English: KEMRI advises residents of Nandi County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa msaada wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMRI waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nandi inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow si ay uga caawiyaan helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ee lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMRI nyiso ji duto modak e county mar Nandi mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni mondo giyud kony mar yudo kony kuom weche thieth.

English: School Health & Nutrition Facility Progress Report 2024 (August-December)
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Maendeleo ya Kituo cha Afya na Lishe 2024 (Agosti-Desemba)
Somali: Warbixinta Horumarka Xarunta Caafimaadka Dugsiga iyo Nafaqada 2024 (Agoosto-Diseembar)
Dholuo: Ripot mar dhi nyime mar kar thieth kod chiemo mag skul 2024 (Agost-Apar)

English: NDMA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Garissa County that access to the GBV toll-free helpline is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba upatikanaji wa simu ya GBV ya bure ya msaada unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee Gobolka Garissa in helitaanka khadka caawimaadda ee GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah uu yahay mid lacag-la'aan ah.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Garissa County ni gibiro yudo kony ma onge chudo mar GBV maonge chudo.

English: Lamu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Lamu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Aprili 2023
Somali: Degmada Lamu: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Lamu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar ang'wen 2023

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Vihiga County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kuthibitisha kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay xaqiijiyaan in xaruntooda la aqoonsaday ka hor inta aysan booqan si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Vihiga mondo ong'e ni kuondegi mag thieth oseyudo ratiro kapok gibiro mondo giyud thieth.

English: Caregivers are advised to keep the umbilical cord clean and dry. Do not apply substances like ash or herbs as they may cause infections.
Kiswahili: Walezi wanashauriwa kuweka kitovu kikiwa safi na kikavu. Usipake vitu kama majivu au mimea kwani vinaweza kusababisha maambukizi.
Somali: Daryeelada waxaa lagula talinayaa in xadhkaha burburka uu ahaado mid nadiif ah oo qalalan. Ha isticmaalin waxyaabo sida dambas ama dalagyo sababtoo ah waxay sababi karaan cudurro.
Dholuo: Ojiwo jorit mondo orit dhogi kik kethre kendo kik giti gi gik machalo kaka buru kata yien nikech ginyalo kelo tuoche.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of Bomet County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay uga qayb galaan kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' County mar Bomet mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: January is #CervicalHealthAwareness Month as Kenya joins the call to eradicate cervical cancer. In Kenya cervical cancer is a leading cause of morbidity & mortality with 9 women dying of cervical cancer every day yet it is a completely preventable cancer. Get screened. Regularly.
Kiswahili: Januari ni Mwezi wa #Mwezi wa Uhamasishaji wa Afya ya Kizazi huku Kenya ikijiunga na mwito wa kutokomeza saratani ya mlango wa kizazi. Nchini Kenya saratani ya shingo ya kizazi ndiyo inayoongoza kwa magonjwa na vifo huku wanawake 9 wakifariki kila siku kwa saratani ya shingo ya kizazi ilhali ni saratani inayoweza kuzuilika kabisa. Kaguliwa. Mara kwa mara.
Somali: Bisha Janaayo waa #Bisha Wacyigelinta Caafimaadka Makaanka iyadoo Kenya ay ku biirtay baaqa lagu ciribtirayo kansarka makaanka. Kenya kansarka makaanka waa sababta ugu weyn ee keenta cudurrada iyo dhimashada iyadoo 9 dumar ah ay u dhintaan kansarka makaanka maalin kasta haddana waa kansar gebi ahaanba laga hortagi karo. Baaritaan samee. Si joogto ah u samee.
Dholuo: Dwe mar achiel en # dwe mar ng’eyo weche mag thieth mar ng’ut dhako ka piny Kenya oriwore gi ywak mar tieko kansa mar ng’ut dhako. E piny Kenya, kansa mar dhot dhako en tuwo maduong’ ma kelo tuoche kod tho kendo mon 9 tho nikech kansa mar dhot dhako pile ka pile kata kamano en kansa ma inyalo geng’ chuth. Iyud skrin. Mapile.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations activates an emergency response plan for flooding in West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inaamsha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada wuxuu soo saaray qorshe xaalad deg deg ah oo looga jawaabayo fatahaadaha ka jira degmada West Pokot.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Mumbni mag Criminal Investigations chako tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne ataro mar pi e West Pokot County.

English: AFA promotes organic farming among farmers in Isiolo County as part of the October climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: AFA inakuza kilimo hai miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Oktoba.
Somali: AFA waxay kor u qaadeysaa beeraha dabiiciga ah ee beeraleyda degmada Isiolo iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka iska caabinta cimilada ee Oktoobar.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo pur mar yien e kind jopur e kaunti mar Isiolo kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Machakos County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kudai kutoa huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay dalbadaan adeegyo aan la bixin laaluush si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jogweng'o mag Machakos County mondo okonygi ka ok gichulo asoya mondo giked gi asoya e migepe mag sirkal.

English: DCI alerts residents of Meru County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: DCI waxay dadka deggan degmada Meru uga digtay kororka kiisaska burburka waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar County mar Meru ni kwan mag joma odonjo e ot biro medore kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: NTSA urges the community in Makueni County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb theft.
Kiswahili: NTSA inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Makueni inay ka warbixiyaan waxqabadka shakiga ah xarunta booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo ji duto manie gweng' mar Makueni mondo onyis polis ma ni machiegni gi kanyo ni gitimo gik ma chando ji.

English: KRA encourages first-time voters in Machakos County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: KRA inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Machakos kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: KRA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Machakos inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo joma okwongo yiero e county mar Machakos mondo oting'e ID kata pasi mar pinygi e odiechieng'no mar yiero.

English: Flexible new announcement, sensitization on distress that requires good rest to allow good service delivery in public offices
Kiswahili: Tangazo jipya rahisi, ufahamu juu ya shida ambayo inahitaji kupumzika vizuri ili kuwezesha utoaji mzuri wa huduma katika ofisi za umma
Somali: Ogeysiis cusub oo dabacsanaan leh, wacyi galinta dhibaatada oo u baahan nasasho wanaagsan si loo oggolaado bixinta adeegyada wanaagsan ee xafiisyada dadweynaha
Dholuo: Chenro manyien mar lando wach maber, keto ji obed motang' gi chandruok madwarore mondo giyud yueyo maber e tije mag sirkal

English: Ministry of Health encourages residents of Nyandarua County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Nyandarua inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay la xiriiraan lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health ojiwo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giwuo gi jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Regularly talking and singing to your baby strengthens their brain development and early language skills.
Kiswahili: Kuzungumza na kumwimbia mtoto wako mara kwa mara huimarisha ukuaji wa ubongo wake na ujuzi wake wa lugha ya awali.
Somali: Markaad ilmahaaga si joogto ah ula hadasho oo u gabyi waxaad xoojineysaa horumarka maskaxda iyo aqoonta luqadda hore.
Dholuo: Wuoyo gi nyathini kendo wer kode kinde ka kinde miyo obwongo nyathino medo dongo kendo miyo olony e wacho dhok manyien.

English: Kenya Dairy Board urges coffee growers in Kilifi County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawasihi wakulima wa kahawa katika Wilaya ya Kilifi watumie viwango vinavyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Kilifi inay isticmaalaan sicirka bacriminta lagu taliyey roobka ka hor si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e gweng ' mar Kilifi County mondo oti gi nengo mar yien molony kapok koth ochue mondo omed nyak e higani.

English: KTDA announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for goats in Bungoma County this April.
Kiswahili: KTDA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Aprili hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee riyaha ee Gobolka Bungoma bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: KTDA olando chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar dhoot ne diek e County mar Bungoma e dwe mar April.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds residents of Laikipia County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this drought season.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa ukame.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia ku xasuusinaya inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada fatahaada ah xilligan abaarta.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne jogweng' mar Laikipia County ni kik giwuoth e wi borni kod aoche ma pi opong'o e kinde mar oro.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the community in Kisii County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb carjacking.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua ili kuzuia utekaji nyara wa gari.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Kisii inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha si loo xakameeyo afduubka gawaarida.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto manie County mar Kisii mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo kik gikwed kwalo mtokni.

English: Public health advisory: KEMSA warns of increased meningitis risk in Nairobi County and advises the public to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMSA yaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya homa ya uti wa mgongo katika Kaunti ya Nairobi na inashauri umma kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: KEMSA waxay ka digtay khatarta sii kordheysa ee meningitis ee Gobolka Nairobi waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar oganda: KEMSA chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar meningitis e County mar Nairobi kendo osiemo ji mondo kik giriwre gi pi mochido.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations alerts residents of Laikipia County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia uga digaya kororka kiisaska tuugada wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng' Laikipia County ni kwan mag joma ok oluoro Nyasaye medore kendo ojiwo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag ritruok gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Notice: HELB reminds citizens in Laikipia County about their rights regarding voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuhusu haki zao kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Laikipia xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: HELB paronwa raia mag Laikipia County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar ndiko joma oyiero.

English: KEPHIS advises farmers in Nyeri County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the June planting season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Juni.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyeri inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka xilliga dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Juun.
Dholuo: KEPHIS nyiso jopur e county mar Nyeri mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e dwe mar Jun.

English: GIEWS Country Brief: Kenya 04-May-2026
Kiswahili: GIEWS Muhtasari wa Nchi: Kenya 04-May-2026
Somali: Warbixinta Dalka ee GIEWS: Kenya 04-May-2026
Dholuo: Wach machuok mar piny: Kenya tarik 04 dwe mar abich 2026

English: Kenya: Restoring food security through provision of cash transfers
Kiswahili: Kenya: Kurejesha usalama wa chakula kupitia utoaji wa fedha taslimu
Somali: Kenya: Soo celinta amniga cuntada iyada oo loo marayo bixinta lacagaha xawilaadaha
Dholuo: Kenya: Duoko arita mar chiemo kokalo kuom chiwo pesa ma ioro

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties advises residents of Kirinyaga County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga kula talinayaa inay qaataan dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado dib u dhac marka la raadinayo shahaadada dhalashada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties nyiso jogweng' Kirinyaga County mondo oting'e buge duto madwarore mondo kik gimi ng'ato odog chien sama odwaro yudo barua mar nyuol.

English: NCPB reminds livestock keepers in Homa Bay County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa za kuponda ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: NCPB waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee gobolka Homa Bay inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: NCPB paronwa jopur mag jamni e Homa Bay County ni mondo gimi jamnigi thieth e kuonde moyier mag nego jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: Kenya: Research Terms of Reference - 2026 Multi-Sectoral Needs Assessment, KEN2601 (May 2026, 01)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Masharti ya Marejeleo ya Utafiti - Tathmini ya Mahitaji ya Kisekta Mbalimbali ya 2026, KEN2601 (Mei 2026, 01)
Somali: Kenya: Shuruudaha Tixraaca Cilmi-baarista - Qiimaynta Baahiyaha Qaybaha Badan ee 2026, KEN2601 (Maajo 2026, 01)
Dholuo: Kenya: Chike mag Tiyo gi Nonro - Rang'o mar Dwaro mag Migepe Mang'eny mag Higa 2026, KEN2601 (Mei 2026, 01)

English: Notice: Ministry of Education launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu yazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay bilowday barnaamij ka dhan ah tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibta dugsiyada degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Education chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe mahundu e skunde duto mag Isiolo County.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya warns residents of Kakamega County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kuhusu ongezeko la udanganyifu wa fedha za simu na inashauri umma wasiishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay ka digtay dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega kororka khayaanada lacagta mobilada waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Communications Authority chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kakamega County e wi medruok mar timbe mag wuondo pesa mag simo kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Isiolo County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kwamba ufikiaji wa usaidizi wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Isiolo in helitaanka taageerada sheegashada NHIF/SHA ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMRI oparo ne ji duto man Isiolo County ni koro ginyalo yudo kony mag kwayo mag NHIF/SHA e kuonde moyier.

English: State Department for TVET conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in Nyeri County this August.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Agosti hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay qabanqaabinaysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee degmada Nyeri bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi ratiro mag sirkal e County mar Nyeri e dwe mar Agost.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds the public in Mandera County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Mandera inay ka feejignaadaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne ji duto man Mandera County ni gibed motang' gi chenro mag chiwo siem ne ji chon.

English: Kenya Dairy Board warns coffee farmers in Isiolo County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Isiolo juu ya mlipuko wa wadudu na inapendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Isiolo cudurrada cayayaanka waxaana uu ku talinayaa in si ku habboon wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho kong'o e kaunti mar Isiolo e wi tuoche ma nyalo kelo tuoche kendo ojiwo ni otim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: HELB urges residents of Marsabit County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kufaidika na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: HELB waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jogweng' mar Marsabit County mondo okonygi yudo konyno kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: IPOA urges the community in Nakuru County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb theft.
Kiswahili: IPOA inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Nakuru inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: IPOA ojiwo ji duto modak e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo oriwre gi chenro mag polis (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o kuo.

English: KEMRI appeals to caregivers in Bomet County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the January maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Bomet kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Januari.
Somali: KEMRI waxay u baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Bomet inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Janaayo.
Dholuo: KEMRI okwayo jorit e county mar Bomet mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongruok kaka achiel kuom chenro mar Januar mar rito ngima mar mine.

English: TVET advises students in Makueni County to register early to secure allocation to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Makueni kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Somali: TVET waxay ardayda degmada Makueni kula talineysaa inay horay u diiwaangeliyaan si ay u helaan buugaag iyo qalab waxbarasho.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jopuonjre e gweng' mar Makueni mondo odonj e skundno chon mondo giyud thuolo mar somo buge koda gik mamoko.

English: Kenya - Garissa County - Dadaab - Hagadera Refugee Camp - Administration offices, Financial Institutions, Markets and Community Facilities Infrastructure - as of May 2022
Kiswahili: Kenya - Kaunti ya Garissa - Dadaab - Kambi ya Wakimbizi ya Hagadera - Ofisi za Utawala, Taasisi za Kifedha, Miundombinu ya Masoko na Vifaa vya Jamii - kufikia Mei 2022
Somali: Kenya - Degmada Garissa - Dadaab - Xerada Qaxootiga Hagadera - Xafiisyada maamulka, Hay'adaha Maaliyadda, Suuqyada iyo Kaabayaasha Adeegyada Bulshada - laga bilaabo Maajo 2022
Dholuo: Kenya - Oganda mar Garissa - Dadaab - Kambi mar Jolweny mag Hagadera - Apis mag loch, Kuonde mag pesa, chiro kod kuonde mag oganda - chakre dwe mar abich higa mar 2022

English: The Horticultural Crops Directorate has closed the Hass and Fuerte avocado harvesting season from November 15 to March 15 2020 Notify the directorate in writing within 7 days if harvesting off season avocados
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Mazao ya bustani imefunga msimu wa uvunaji wa parachichi wa Hass na Fuerte kuanzia Novemba 15 hadi Machi 15 2020 Ifahamishe kurugenzi kwa maandishi ndani ya siku 7 ikiwa utavuna parachichi za msimu.
Somali: Agaasinka Beeraha Beeraha ayaa xiray xilliyada goosashada Hass iyo Fuerte ee laga bilaabo 15-ka Nofeembar ilaa 15-ka Maarso 2020 si qoraal ah ugu wargeli agaasinka 7 maalmood gudahood haddii la goosto abaqado xilli ciyaareed ka baxsan
Dholuo: Directorate of Horticultural Crops oseweyo tij keyo mar avocado Hass and Fuerte chakre Novemba 15 nyaka Mach 15, 2020 Nyis directorate e yor ndiko e kinde mar ndalo 7 ka ipogo avocado e kinde ma ok ochopo

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will host a free food safety outreach in Marsabit County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa usalama wa chakula bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa martigelin doonta dadaal bilaash ah oo ku saabsan badbaadada cuntada ee degmada Marsabit bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo kampen mar rito ngima mar chiemo maonge chudo e Marsabit County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges tea growers in Samburu County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Samburu kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee Gobolka Samburu inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si loo wanaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e county mar Samburu mondo okaw kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo okony e medo nyak mar yien e higani.

English: EACC advises residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: EACC inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: EACC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: EACC nyiso jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport.

English: KUCCPS advises applicants in Tana River County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Tana River kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Tana River inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee la heli karo.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e taon mar Tana River County mondo odhi e skul man machiegni kodgi.

English: ODPP reminds residents of Taita-Taveta County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Taita-Taveta in helitaanka adeegyada baasaboorka ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: ODPP oparo ne jogweng' Taita-Taveta County ni koro yot yudo passport kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response calls on parents in Nyandarua County to have children under five screened for measles during the February outreach.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuwachunguza watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa surua wakati wa mawasiliano ya Februari.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Nyandarua in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cirbadeynta bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo kwayo jonyuol e County mar Nyandarua mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Februar.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadweynaha in taageero lacag la'aan ah oo soo kabashada isticmaalka maandooriyaha laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Mandera.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tiyo gi yedhe mamero yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county man Mandera County.

English: Up-scale agricultural extension and monitoring services, and support irrigated agriculture through farm inputs and capacity building.
Kiswahili: Huduma za upanuzi wa kilimo na ufuatiliaji wa ukubwa, na kusaidia kilimo cha umwagiliaji kupitia bidhaa za kilimo na kujenga uwezo.
Somali: Adeegyada ballaarinta beeraha iyo kormeerka, iyo taageerada beeraha waraabinta leh iyada oo loo marayo alaabada beeraha iyo dhismaha awoodaha.
Dholuo: Tiyo gi yore mag medo yaro yore mag pur kod rito tijno, kendo konyo tijno kokalo kuom gik ma itiyogo e puothe mag pur kod gero nyalo.

English: Notice: DPP launches a fraud prevention campaign in Kwale County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DPP yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Kwale Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga khiyaamooyinka Gobolka Kwale bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Rapar: DPP chako kampen mar geng'o mibadhi e provins mar Kwale e dwe mar Julai.

English: AFA announces a free lumpy skin disease vaccination exercise for sheep in Tana River County this September.
Kiswahili: AFA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa ngozi kwa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Tana River Septemba hii.
Somali: AFA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan cudurka maqaarka ee lo'da ee gobolka Tana River bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: AFA olando ni ibiro tim kampen mar goyo rombe e dwe mar Septemba e taon mar Tana River County.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages mothers in Meru County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Meru kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Meru inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo mine manie County mar Meru mondo olim kama gibiro nyuolie machiegni kodgi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will hold a suicide prevention forum in Bomet County this November. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanya kongamano la kuzuia kujiua katika Kaunti ya Bomet Novemba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay qabaneysaa madasha ka hortagga ismiidaaminta ee gobolka Bomet bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Riwruok mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo biro timo romo mar geng'o ji kik nege e dwe mar Novemba e taon mar Bomet County.

English: Kenya Gazette advises residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette nyiso jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom websait mar e-Citizen sama gidwaro yudo kwayo mag ID.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Kericho County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Kericho inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kalfadhiga tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kericho mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e chokruok mabiro.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kalfadhiga tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development nyiso jopur e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e tiego jopur mabiro.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges parents and teachers in Nakuru County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi kwa watoto 116.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macalimiinta wuxuu ugu baaqay waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Nakuru inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e kaunti mar Nakuru mondo omany namba mar 116 mar kony ne nyithindo.

English: Make sure employees are aware of resources available to them, such as Employee Assistance Programs (EAPs), mental health hotlines, or counseling services
Kiswahili: Hakikisha wafanyakazi wanafahamu rasilimali zinazopatikana kwao, kama vile Programu za Usaidizi kwa Wafanyakazi (EAPs), simu za dharura za afya ya akili, au huduma za ushauri nasaha.
Somali: Hubi in shaqaalaha ay yaqaanaan kheyraadka ay heli karaan, sida Barnaamijyada Caawimaadda Shaqaalaha (EAPs), khadadka tooska ah ee caafimaadka dhimirka, ama adeegyada la talinta
Dholuo: Tem neno ni jotich ong'eyo gik ma ginyalo tiyogo, kaka chenro mag konyo jotich (EAPs), weche thieth mag chuny, kata chiwo paro

English: CS MUTAHI KAGWE: We must take individual responsibility to #KomeshaCorona #Washhands #WearMasks #keepsocialdistance #sanitize
Kiswahili: CS MUTAHI KAGWE: Lazima tuchukue jukumu la kibinafsi kwa #KomeshaCorona #Kunawa Mikono #VaaMasks #weka umbali wa kijamii #kusafisha
Somali: CS MUTAHI KAGWE: Waa inaan qaadnaa mas'uuliyad shaqsiyeed si aan u ilaalino #KomeshaCorona #Dhaqashada gacmaha #XirtoMaaskaro #ka fogow bulshada #nadiifin
