English: Notice: KNEC reminds citizens in Busia County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Busia kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Busia ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KNEC paronwa raia mag County mar Busia kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo gi ji duto e bajet mar county.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds farmers in Kirinyaga County of the ongoing greenhouse farming training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kilimo cha chafu.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa xusuusinaya beeraleyda degmada Kirinyaga barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jopur e gweng' mar Kirinyaga chenro mar tiegruok ma sani dhi nyime e weche mag pur.

English: FAO reminds farmers in Kisumu County of the ongoing modern irrigation techniques training programme.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhusu programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kisumu barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah.
Dholuo: FAO oparo ne jopur e gweng' mar Kisumu chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar yore mag lero pi.

English: 36 cases of Mpox reported so far in Kenya, two persons admitted and one patient receiving home-based care.
Kiswahili: Visa 36 vya Mpox vimeripotiwa hadi sasa nchini Kenya, watu wawili waliolazwa na mgonjwa mmoja anayepatiwa huduma ya nyumbani.
Somali: 36 kiis oo Mpox ah ayaa illaa iyo hadda laga soo sheegay Kenya, labo qof ayaa la geliyey iyo hal bukaan oo daryeel guriga laga helayo.
Dholuo: Nyaka chil kawuono, ji 36 ma nigi Mpox osefweny e piny Kenya, ji ariyo ma ne odonjo e ot kod jatuo achiel ma ne yudo thieth e ot.

English: COMESA warns sorghum farmers in Mandera County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Mandera juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: COMESA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda sorghum ee degmada Mandera cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: COMESA chiwo siem ne jopur mag sorghum e county mar Mandera kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: In the event that one's condition deteriorates, then they should call 719, or send a SMS to *719#, or, notify the designated health care worker. #KomeshaCorona update.
Kiswahili: Katika tukio ambalo hali ya mtu inazorota, basi wanapaswa kupiga simu 719, au kutuma SMS kwa *719#, au, kumjulisha mfanyakazi wa afya aliyeteuliwa. #KomeshaCorona sasisho.
Somali: Haddii xaaladdu ka sii darto, waa inay wacaan 719, ama ay SMS u diraan *719#, ama, ay ogeysiiyaan shaqaalaha daryeelka caafimaadka ee loo xilsaaray. #KomeshaCorona update.
Dholuo: Kapo ni tuwo mar ng’ato medore marach, to onego ogol simu ne namba 719, kata oor SMS ne *719#, kata, onyis ng’at ma ochung’ne thieth. #KomeshaKorona ma manyien.

English: AFA promotes organic farming among farmers in Kericho County as part of the October climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: AFA inakuza kilimo hai miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Oktoba.
Somali: AFA waxay kor u qaadeysaa beeraha dabiiciga ah ee beeraleyda degmada Kericho iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka iska caabinta cimilada ee Oktoobar.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kericho kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Trans Nzoia County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada la hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health nyiso jogweng'o mag Trans Nzoia County mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth mar oganda maonge chudo mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: DPP reminds mobile money users in Nyeri County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka ujumbe wa udanganyifu.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Nyeri inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna si looga fogaado fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: DPP paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e County mar Nyeri ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo kik gichiw ote mag phishing.

English: DCI urges residents of Kajiado County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: DCI inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika kumbi za umma huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay iskaashi la sameeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyadoo la sii xoojinayo amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'adoe bura e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom weche mag rito tong'.

English: A bill proposes a 10â€‘year ban on corrupt firms from public tenders.
Kiswahili: Mradi mmoja wa sheria unapendekeza marufuku ya miaka 10 ya makampuni yenye ufisadi kutoka kwa zabuni za umma.
Somali: Hindise sharciyeed ayaa soo jeedinaya in muddo 10 sano ah shirkadaha musuqmaasuqa ah laga mamnuuco qandaraasyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Bill moro ogolo paro mar geng'o ng'ato kuom higni 10 kuom ng'ato ka ng'ato mondo kik otim tender mag sirkal.

English: Attention coffee farmers The Nairobi Coffee Exchange is implementing new regulations affecting coffee sales Ensure you are familiar with the Coffee General Regulations 2019 and the Capital Markets Coffee Exchange Regulations 2020
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa kahawa makini Soko la Kahawa la Nairobi linatekeleza kanuni mpya zinazoathiri uuzaji wa kahawa Hakikisha kuwa unafahamu Kanuni za Jumla za Kahawa 2019 na Kanuni za Soko la Mitaji la Kahawa 2020.
Somali: Fiiro gaar ah u yeelo beeraleyda kafeega Nairobi Coffee Exchange ayaa fulineysa xeerarro cusub oo saameyn ku leh iibinta kafeega Hubi inaad ka warqabto Xeerarka Guud ee Kafeega 2019 iyo Xeerarka Suuqyada Caasimada ee Kafee Exchange 2020
Dholuo: Chenro ne jopur loso chai Nairobi Coffee Exchange tiyo gi chike manyien makonyo e uso chai Tem neno ni ing'eyo chike mag loso chai e higa mar 2019 kod chike mag choko chai e taon mar Capital Markets Coffee Exchange 2020.

English: E-Citizen encourages first-time voters in Nandi County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Nandi inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo joma okwongo yiero e county mar Nandi mondo ong'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: Turkana County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Turkana: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Mei 2022
Somali: Degmada Turkana: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Turkana: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar abich higa mar 2022

English: Pest Control Products Board urges farmers in Uasin Gishu County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Guddiga xakamaynta cayayaanka ayaa ku booriyay beeraleyda degmada Uasin Gishu inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu mondo opidh olembe ma nyalo miyo lowo okethre mondo ginyagre gi lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: KALRO advises farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the May planting season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Mei.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagyada si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maajo.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo otim lokruok e puothe mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber kapok ochopo higa mar chwoyo e dwe mar Mei.

English: KEMSA calls on parents in Machakos County to have children under five screened for cyclosporiasis during the September outreach.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa cyclosporiasis wakati wa mawasiliano ya Septemba.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Machakos in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka cyclosporiasis inta lagu jiro adeegga bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KEMSA okwayo jonyuol e County ma Machakos mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e wi cyclosporiasis e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Partner involvement during antenatal and postnatal care improves family health outcomes.
Kiswahili: Ushiriki wa mshirika wakati wa utunzaji wa ujauzito na baada ya kujifungua huboresha matokeo ya afya ya familia.
Somali: Ka qaybgalka lammaanaha inta lagu jiro daryeelka kahor iyo ka dib dhalashada waxay hagaajineysaa natiijooyinka caafimaadka qoyska.
Dholuo: Bedo gi osiepe e kinde mag rito nyathi kapok onyuolo koda bang' nyuolo miyo ngima joot bedo maber.

English: Integrate trees into your vegetable garden agroforestry for multiple benefits like shade windbreaks fruits timber and improved soil health
Kiswahili: Jumuisha miti kwenye bustani yako ya mboga kilimo mseto kwa faida nyingi kama vile kivuli vizuizi vya upepo matunda mbao na afya bora ya udongo
Somali: Ku dar geedaha beertaada khudaarta agroforestry si aad u hesho faa'iidooyin badan sida hooska, dabaysha jebinta miraha, alwaaxda iyo caafimaadka ciidda oo la hagaajiyay
Dholuo: Ti gi yiende e puodho mar yiende mondo omiyi ber mang'eny kaka yiende ma yamo ywayo, yiende ma ting'o tipo, kod lowo maber

English: Ministry of Education advises applicants in Makueni County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Makueni kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Makueni inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e gweng' mar Makueni mondo odonj e skundni ka pok giyudo thuolo mar dhi nyime gi tiegruok.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Ministry of Education olando tarik mag somo mar pinyruoth ma onge chudo e skunde mag Nyeri County.

English: TSC urges youth in Makueni County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Makueni kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: TSC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Makueni inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo rowere mag Makueni County mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gichako timo tije mag oganda.

English: Notice: KRA launches county development projects in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay bilawday mashaariic horumarineed oo ka socda degmada Laikipia.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KRA chako timo dongruok e alwora mar Laikipia County.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds the public in Samburu County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this September.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba mchango juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka unakaribishwa Septemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) ayaa xasuusinaya dadweynaha Gobolka Samburu in talooyinka dib-u-eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone ji duto e county mar Samburu ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi nonro mar tich mitimo higa ka higa e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: TVET announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ee dugsiyada gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET olando tarik mag somo e skunde mag Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges residents of Turkana County to avoid contact with contaminated water sources following a rise in reported typhoid cases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya matumbo vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha ee wasakheysan ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska cudurka tifooska ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ojiwo jogweng' Turkana County mondo owe tudruok gi kuonde ma pi yudoree nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuwo mar typhoid osemedore.

English: TVET reminds needy students in Kirinyaga County that free digital learning content applications close soon.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba programu za bure za maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda baahsan ee degmada Kirinyaga in codsiyada barashada bilaashka ah ee barnaamijyada digital-ka ay dhowaan soo gabagabeyn doonaan.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa jopuonjre man gi chandruok e County mar Kirinyaga ni chenro mag somo maonge chudo mar digital chiegni rumo.

English: Training on efficient fertilizer use to improve soil health launched in Machakos.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo kuhusu matumizi bora ya mbolea ili kuboresha afya ya udongo yazinduliwa Machakos.
Somali: Tababar ku saabsan isticmaalka bacriminta hufan si loo horumariyo caafimaadka carrada oo laga bilaabay Machakos.
Dholuo: Ne ochako puonjo e wi tiyo maber gi lum mar lowo mondo ober ngima mar lowo.

Kiswahili: Nchi barani Afrika ziko hatarini kukosa chakula cha Ã¢Â€Â˜maajabuÃ¢Â€Â™ katika muda wa miezi 3 ijayo kutokana na kupunguzwa kwa misaada
Somali: Dalalka Afrika oo halis ugu jira inay waayaan cuntada saddexda bilood ee soo socota sababo la xiriira dhimista gargaarka.
Dholuo: Pinje mantie e Afrika ni e arita mar bedo gi chiemo ma ng’ato ok nyal ng’iewo e dweche adek mabiro nikech ng’eny kony ma ji chiwo

English: There is family life lessons in hospitals for couples to help them plan about their birth spacing
Kiswahili: Kuna masomo ya maisha ya familia katika hospitali kwa ajili ya wenzi wa ndoa ili kuwasaidia kupanga wakati wa kujifungua
Somali: Isbitaalada waxaa ku jira casharro ku saabsan nolosha qoyska lamaanaha si ay uga caawiyaan inay qorsheeyaan inta ay dhalanayaan
Dholuo: Nitie puonj mag ngima joot e osiptal ne joma okendore mondo okonygi chano kinde ma gibiro nyuologo

English: KICD announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in Kisii County this September.
Kiswahili: KICD yatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa shule za Kaunti ya Kisii Septemba hii.
Somali: KICD waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta deeqaha waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan dugsiyada degmada Kisii bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: KICD ogolo chiwo mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre man gi chan e skunde man Kisii County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Council of Governors urges eligible citizens in Siaya County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linawahimiza raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Siaya kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku boorinayaan muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Siaya inay ka qaybqaataan jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro mar yiero e county mar Siaya mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar yiero.

English: Notice: NPS activates an emergency response plan for fire outbreaks in Embu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NPS inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa milipuko ya moto katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay qaraxyada dabka ee degmada Embu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NPS tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne masiche mag mach e County mar Embu.

English: Special Presidential Envoy for Climate John Kerry Announces $4 Million to Address Climate Mobility in Kenya
Kiswahili: Mjumbe Maalumu wa Rais wa Hali ya Hewa John Kerry Atangaza Dola Milioni 4 Kushughulikia Uhamaji wa Hali ya Hewa nchini Kenya
Somali: Ergeyga Gaarka ah ee Madaxweynaha ee Cimilada John Kerry oo ku dhawaaqay $4 Milyan oo wax looga qabanayo dhaqdhaqaaqa cimilada ee Kenya
Dholuo: Jaote Maduong’ mar Jatend Pinyruoth John Kerry Olando ni dola milion ang’wen biro geng’o weche mag piny e piny Kenya

English: Teachers Service Commission conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in Turkana County this November.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya kiraia juu ya haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Turkana Novemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa bishii November ku qabanaya madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission otimo chokruok mar tiego ji e wi chike mag sirkal e County mar Turkana e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Nyamira County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya dadweynaha degmada Nyamira in helitaanka adeegyada bukaanka dibedda hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji duto e County mar Nyamira ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mag ambulatori e kuonde moyier.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds expectant mothers in Mandera County that access to childhood immunization is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba upatikanaji wa chanjo ya watoto ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xusuusinaysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Mandera in helitaanka tallaalka carruurta ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne mine ma nigi ich e County mar Mandera ni yudo thieth mar nyithindo onge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will train farmers in Nandi County on conservation tillage this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi juu ya kilimo cha uhifadhi Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga xakamaynta cayayaanka ayaa tababar siin doona beeraleyda gobolka Nandi ee ku saabsan beerashada ilaalinta bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ne: Bura mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro tiego jopur e County mar Nandi e weche mag pidho puothe e dwe mar Januar.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges sweet potatoes growers in Mombasa County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Udhibiti wa Pest Products inawasihi wakulima wa viazi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kudhibiti wizi wa jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa za kuua wadudu zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda baradhada macaan ee degmada Mombasa inay ka hortagaan weerarka ciidanka dayrta ee hore iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarkooda xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Pest Control Products Board jiwo jopur ma pidho kitungu e Mombasa County mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma giyudo ka gitiyo gi gik makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok mondo gimed nyak e higani.

English: National Drought Early Warning Bulletin (March 2023)
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Tahadhari ya Mapema ya Kitaifa (Machi 2023)
Somali: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Qaranka (Maarso 2023)
Dholuo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro (Dwe mar Adek 2023)

English: Create inclusive spaces! Train teachers to support diverse learners.
Kiswahili: Wazoeze walimu kusaidia wanafunzi mbalimbali.
Somali: Abuur meelaha isku dhafan! Tababar barayaasha si ay u taageeraan ardayda kala duwan.
Dholuo: Tieg jopuonj mondo okony jopuonjre mopogore opogore.

English: COMESA announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for cattle in Laikipia County this March.
Kiswahili: COMESA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Machi hii.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan qabyaaladda lo'da ee Gobolka Laikipia bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: COMESA olando chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar rabies e County mar Laikipia e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will train farmers in Nyandarua County on organic farming this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua juu ya kilimo hai Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu tababar siin doonaa beeraleyda Gobolka Nyandarua ee beeraha dabiiciga ah bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro tiego jopur e County mar Nyandarua e wi pur mar yien e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by CDC will be held in Kericho County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na CDC itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kericho Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabiyeen CDC ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Kericho bishii November.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kampen mar thieth ma onge chudo ma CDC ochano ibiro tim Kericho County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: CDC advises residents of Busia County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: CDC inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: CDC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun iyo biyo nadiif ah si joogto ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo jogweng' County mar Busia mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds expectant mothers in Bungoma County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Bungoma in helitaanka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Bungoma ni thuolo mar yudo puonj mag chenro mag ngima joot en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag sirkal.

English: IPOA warns residents of Lamu County to prepare for possible road accidents this November.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Novemba hii.
Somali: IPOA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan gobolka Lamu inay u diyaar garoobaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha November.
Dholuo: IPOA osiemo jogweng' Lamu County mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds residents of Baringo County that terracing improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba usafirishaji huboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Baringo in dhulka lagu beerayo uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarkii beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jogweng' Baringo County ni loso puothe mag lowo miyo puothego bedo gi nyak maber e kinde mabiro.

English: Just like your annual doctors visit, your mind deserves a check-up too
Kiswahili: Sawa na ziara yako ya kila mwaka ya madaktari, akili yako pia inastahili kupimwa
Somali: Sidii dhakhaatiirtaada sanadlaha ah ay booqdaan, maskaxdaada ayaa sidoo kale u qalma in la hubiyo
Dholuo: Mana kaka lakteche ma limogi higa ka higa, paroni bende onego onon.

English: To promote this program, through cropping, like desmodium, insect repellant and others, like napoier grass, which attract them, it has..
Kiswahili: Kuendeleza mpango huu, kwa njia ya kuvuna, kama desmodium, dawa ya kuua wadudu na wengine, kama napoier nyasi, ambayo huvutia yao, ina ..
Somali: Si loo horumariyo barnaamijkan, iyada oo loo marayo goosashada, sida desmodium, cayayaanka iyo kuwa kale, sida cawska napoier, taas oo soo jiidata, waxay leedahay ..
Dholuo: Mondo gijiw chenrono, gitiyo gi puothe kaka Desmodium, insect repellent kod mamoko kaka nyinyo mar napoier, ma ywayo ji, mano osemiyo...

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the public in Taita-Taveta County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inahimiza umma katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadweynaha Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban dhacdooyinka la soo sheegay ee ku saabsan nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ji duto e Taita-Taveta County mondo ong'e kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma osefweny kuom chenro mag ohala.

English: There is no shame in seeking help for depression. In fact, seeking help is a sign of strength, not weakness. If you or someone you know is struggling with depression, please reach out to a mental health professional or a crisis hotline
Kiswahili: Hakuna aibu kutafuta msaada kwa ajili ya mfadhaiko. Kwa kweli, kutafuta msaada ni ishara ya nguvu, si udhaifu. Ikiwa wewe au mtu unayemjua anapambana na mfadhaiko, tafadhali wasiliana na mtaalamu wa afya ya akili au simu ya dharura ya dharura.
Somali: Haddii adiga ama qof aad taqaanid uu la halgamayo niyadjab, fadlan la xiriir xirfadle caafimaad maskaxeed ama khadka tooska ah ee xaaladaha dhibaatada.
Dholuo: Ka in kata ng'ato ing'eyo ma nyagore gi tuwo mar depression, tudri gi laktar molony e weche thieth mar paro kata achiel kuom joma wuoyo gi ji e simo.

English: KEMSA announces SHA registration for residents of Samburu County starting this November.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatangaza usajili wa SHA kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kuanzia Novemba hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhawaaqday diiwaangelinta SHA ee dadka deggan Gobolka Samburu laga bilaabo Nofeembar.
Dholuo: KEMSA ogolo chik mar SHA ne joma odak e county mar Samburu kochakore dwe mar Novemba.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds residents of Tharaka-Nithi County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi in warbixinta khiyaamooyinka si deg deg ah ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar wuond konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Donâ€™t believe the myth that a vaccine for COVID-19 is available #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Usiamini imani potofu kwamba chanjo ya COVID-19 inapatikana #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Ha rumaysan khuraafaadka ah in tallaal loogu talagalay COVID-19 la heli karo #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Kik iyie gi miriambo ni chanjo mar COVID-19 nitie #KomeshaCorona

English: Office of the Auditor-General advises residents of Mombasa County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa inay qaataan dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado dib u dhac marka la raadinayo adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General nyiso jogweng' mar County mar Mombasa mondo oting'e buge duto madwarore mondo kik gideki sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport.

English: Over recent decades, droughts and floods have severely impacted communities, particularly in the Arid and Semi-Arid Lands (ASAL) regions.
Kiswahili: Katika miongo ya hivi majuzi, ukame na mafuriko yameathiri sana jamii, hasa katika maeneo ya Ardhi Kame na Nusu Kame (ASAL).
Somali: Tobanaankii sano ee la soo dhaafay, abaaraha iyo daadadku waxay si xun u saameeyeen bulshooyinka, gaar ahaan gobollada Dhulka Aaran iyo Badh-Aaran (ASAL).
Dholuo: E higini apar mosekalo, oro kod oro ma pong’o piny osekethore ahinya e alwora, ahinya ahinya e kuonde ma ng’ich kod ma ng’ich ahinya (ASAL).

English: SHA reminds voters in Makueni County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: SHA inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Makueni kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Makueni inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor taariikhda doorashada.
Dholuo: SHA parone jogweng' Makueni mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar timo yiero kapok kinde mag yiero ochopo.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Vihiga County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the May planting season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Mei.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kula talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Vihiga inay qaataan noocyo abuurka ah oo abaarta u adkaysta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maajo.
Dholuo: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e County mar Vihiga mondo okaw kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochako chwoyo kodhi e dwe mar Mei.

English: Series follows group of student voters
Kiswahili: Mfululizo unafuata kikundi cha wapiga kura wanafunzi
Somali: Taxanaha ayaa raacaya koox ka mid ah ardayda codbixiyayaasha ah
Dholuo: Sulani wuoyo e wi grup mar jopuonjre ma ne dhi yiero

English: Notice: EACC opens voter education centres in Taita-Taveta County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay furaysaa xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: EACC chako tiego josiasa e taon mar Taita-Taveta e dwe mar Agost.

English: The Ministry of Agriculture plans to hire 3 000 youth extension workers to improve support for farmers Stay informed about recruitment updates and training opportunities
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo ina mpango wa kuajiri vijana 3,000 wa ugani ili kuboresha msaada kwa wakulima Endelea kufahamishwa kuhusu taarifa za uajiri na fursa za mafunzo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha waxay qorsheyneysaa in ay shaqaaleysiiso 3 000 shaqaale dhalinyaro ah oo ku shaqeeya kordhinta si loo wanaajiyo taageerada beeraleyda Fadlan la soco wararka ku saabsan shaqaaleysiinta iyo fursadaha tababarka
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture ochano mar tiyo gi jotich 3 000 ma tiyo gi rowere e tij lendo mondo okony jopur

English: Deworming children every six months improves their growth, energy levels, and school performance.
Kiswahili: Kutoa dawa za minyoo kwa watoto kila baada ya miezi sita huboresha ukuaji wao, viwango vya nishati, na utendaji wao shuleni.
Somali: Carruurta lixdii biloodba mar in la baabi'iyo cayayaanka waxay kordhiyaan koritaanka, tamarta, iyo waxqabadka dugsiga.
Dholuo: Nyithindo mang'eny medo bedo gi teko mar timo kamano bang' dweche auchiel, kendo timo kamano miyo gibedo gi nyak maber e skul.

English: We are advising all health workers to ensure they are wearing masks and PPEs at all times. Please take all the measures we have announced seriously.
Kiswahili: Tunawashauri wafanyakazi wote wa afya kuhakikisha wamevaa barakoa na vifaa vya kujikinga wakati wote. Tafadhali chukua hatua zote ambazo tumetangaza kwa uzito.
Somali: Waxaan kula talineynaa dhammaan shaqaalaha caafimaadka inay hubiyaan inay mar walba xiran yihiin maaskaro iyo qalabka ilaalinta shaqsiga (PPE). Fadlan si dhab ah u qaado dhammaan tallaabooyinka aan ku dhawaaqnay.
Dholuo: Wachiwo paro ne jotich duto mag thieth mondo gine ni girwako masks kod PPEs kinde duto. Yie mondo ukaw okenge duto ma waselando kaka gik madongo.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Laikipia County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kwamba upatikanaji wa usaidizi wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya dadweynaha degmada Laikipia in helitaanka taageerada sheegashada NHIF/SHA ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji duto man Laikipia County ni kony mar kwayo mag NHIF/SHA sani yudore e kuonde moyier.

English: Sante planetaire et experiences vecues des femmes handicapees face aux impacts du climat sur lâ€™equite en sante au Kenya et en Ouganda (Janvier 2026)
Kiswahili: Sante planetaire et uzoefu vecues des femmes handicapees wanakabiliwa na athari aux du climat sur l'equite en sante au Kenya et en Ouganda (Janvier 2026)

Dholuo: Piny mangima kod gik ma mon ma nigi nyawo mag del yudo ka giyudo pek mag piny ma ok ng’iyo piny e piny Kenya kod Ouganda (dwe mar apar gi ariyo 2026)

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kakamega County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya ngono katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qofkasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Kakamega inuu ka warbixiyo kiisaska xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e Kaunti mar Kakamega mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Announcement of AI-based nutrition and wellness advice service tailored for elderly citizens and caregivers.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la huduma ya ushauri wa lishe na ustawi inayotegemea akili bandia iliyoundwa kwa ajili ya wazee na walezi.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida adeegga la talinta nafaqada iyo caafimaadka ee ku saleysan AI oo loogu talagalay muwaadiniinta waayeelka ah iyo daryeelayaasha.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar riwruok mar oganda Jehova mar Joneno mag Jehova biro timo chenro mar konyo joma oti kod jogo makonyogi.

English: DPP calls on residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: DPP inawaomba wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: DPP waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga si ay u taageeraan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: DPP okwayo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma rito sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e alwora mar tong'gi.

English: Notice: NCPB will open a milk collection centre in Lamu County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itafungua kituo cha kukusanya maziwa katika Kaunti ya Lamu Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay ka furi doontaa xarun ururinta caanaha degmada Lamu bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NCPB biro yawo kambi mar choko chak e County mar Lamu e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: social media to help farmers access information about market prices, weather patterns, and other critical market information. In addition, support ...
Kiswahili: mitandao ya kijamii ili kuwasaidia wakulima kupata taarifa kuhusu bei za soko, mifumo ya hali ya hewa, na taarifa nyingine muhimu za soko. Zaidi ya hayo, msaada ...
Somali: Warbaahinta bulshada si ay u caawiyaan beeraleyda inay helaan macluumaad ku saabsan qiimaha suuqa, qaababka cimilada, iyo xog kale oo muhiim ah oo suuq ah. Intaa waxaa dheer, taageero ...
Dholuo: Oganda mar oganda dhano biro konyo jopur mondo oyud weche e wi nengo mar ohala, kit yamo, kod weche mamoko madongo e wi ohala.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Kwale County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuhusu umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu dadka degmada Kwale ku xasuusinayaa muhiimadda ay leedahay nadaafadda saxda ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association parone ji duto e Kwale County kuom ber mar rito ler mar ngima e ot.

English: IPOA calls on the community in Samburu County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: IPOA waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Samburu inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wici doonaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: IPOA okwayo ji duto manie county mar Samburu mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195 maonge chudo.

English: KALRO informs tea farmers in Nakuru County of new market linkage opportunities this April.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawafahamisha wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Aprili hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Nakuru fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: KALRO nyiso jopur chai e Kaunti mar Nakuru thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar April.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Machakos County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Machakos inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur e county mar Machakos mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service activates an emergency response plan for flooding in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya yaanzisha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu hirgeliyaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ku saabsan fatahaadaha Degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Forest Service tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne pi opong'o gweng' mar Vihiga.

English: KICD reminds parents in Vihiga County that adult literacy classes registration is open this July.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba usajili wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima umefunguliwa Julai hii.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Vihiga in diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ay furan tahay bisha July.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne jonyuol e County mar Vihiga ni somo mar somo gi somo mar jomoti osechakore e dwe mar Julai.

English: Dairy farmers in Nairobi are successfully using modern methods such as zero grazing and feed from urban byproducts Explore local resources and connect with other farmers for best practices
Kiswahili: Wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa jijini Nairobi wanafaulu kutumia mbinu za kisasa kama vile malisho ya sifuri na malisho kutoka kwa mazao ya mijini Chunguza rasilimali za ndani na ungana na wafugaji wengine kwa mbinu bora.
Somali: Beeraleyda caanaha ee Nairobi waxay si guul leh u isticmaalayaan hababka casriga ah sida zero graging iyo quudinta ka yimaada alaabta magaalo Sahamin kheyraadka deegaanka oo la xiriir beeralayda kale si aad u hesho hababka ugu wanaagsan
Dholuo: Jo-pidh piende mag Nairobi tiyo gi yore mag kindegi kaka dhiyo gi dhok maonge kod pidho chiembgi e taonde.

English: Kenya Dairy Board invites farmers in Kiambu County to a free training on greenhouse farming this September.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo cha chafu Septemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa ku casuumay beeraleyda degmada Kiambu tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board ogwelo jopur e County mar Kiambu e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar greenhouse agriculture e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: COMESA restricts movement of pigs in Baringo County due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA inazuia harakati za nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Baringo kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Newcastle.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay xaddidayso dhaqdhaqaaqa doofaarka ee Gobolka Baringo sababo la xiriira cudurka Newcastle.
Dholuo: Paro: COMESA ogeng'o wuoth mar le e County Baringo nikech tuo mar Newcastle.

English: While floods in parts of Kenya demand urgent response, drought affected communities are facing a quieter emergency that unfolds over months rather than days.

Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.

Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wafugaji wa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa Newcastle vilivyoripotiwa.

English: Notice: KALRO will distribute certified coffee seed to farmers in Bungoma County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itasambaza mbegu za kahawa zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Julai hii.

English: Notice: Universities Fund opens a new catering and hospitality programme at the vocational centre in Tana River County.

Kiswahili: Je kuna fursa za kuuza nje matunda yako Jifunze kuhusu viwango vya kimataifa vyeti na wanunuzi watarajiwa wa mazao ya Kenya
Somali: Ma jiraan fursado dhoofin ah oo mirahaaga ah Baro heerarka caalamiga ah, shahaadooyinka iyo iibsadayaasha suurtagalka ah ee wax soo saarka Kenya
Dholuo: Be nitie thuolo mag oro olembe mag olembe mag misango? Puonjri kuom chike mag pinje mamoko kod joma nyalo nyiewo olembe mag Kenya

English: KEMSA announces SHA registration for residents of Tharaka-Nithi County starting this August.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatangaza usajili wa SHA kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuanzia Agosti hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhawaaqday diiwaangelinta SHA ee dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi laga bilaabo bisha Ogosto.
Dholuo: KEMSA ong'ado mar chulo nying SHA ne jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County kochakore Agost ma kawuono.

English: Isiolo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Isiolo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Mei 2022
Somali: Degmada Isiolo: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Isiolo: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Mei 2022

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development encourages farmers in Mandera County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for coffee.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei nzuri ya kahawa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda Degmada Mandera inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo kafee ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur man Mandera County mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar chai.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji ogolo siem e wi weche mag sirkande mag intanet e wi chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County.

English: Public notice: CDC will host a free diabetes screening outreach in Tharaka-Nithi County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: CDC itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uchunguzi wa kisukari bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: CDC waxay martigelin doontaa baaritaan bukaan-socodka bukaanka oo bilaash ah Degmada Tharaka-Nithi bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuoche (CDC) biro timo nonro ma onge chudo e Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar Agost.

English: Universities Fund urges parents and teachers in Siaya County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku boorinayaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Siaya inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e county mar Siaya mondo omany namba mar kony mar nyithindo 116.

English: Notice: KMTC announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada ku yaal gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC ogolo chenro mar dhi e skunde mag Uasin Gishu County mondo giyud tiegruok ma onge chudo.

English: Notice: FAO will conduct a fertiliser application workshop for farmers in Kiambu County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itafanya warsha ya maombi ya mbolea kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan isticmaalka bacriminta beeraleyda ee degmada Kiambu bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: FAO biro timo chokruok mar tiyo gi yien mag lowo ne jopur e taon mar Kiambu e dwe mar Jun.

English: NTSA calls on the community in Busia County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaita jamii katika Kaunti ya Busia kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: NTSA waxay bulshada degmada Busia ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan waxayna taageero ka raadsadaan hoyga ugu dhow.
Dholuo: NTSA luongo oganda man Busia County mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will train farmers in Marsabit County on terracing this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya mashindano Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) ayaa tababar siin doonta beeraleyda degmada Marsabit ee ku saabsan dhulka lagu beeray bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro tiego jopur e county mar Marsabit e wi terracing e dwe mar April.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County that reporting carjacking promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba kuripoti utekaji nyara mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan baabuurta la xaday ay gacan ka geystaan ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo mtoka konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: TVET invites youth in Samburu County to enroll for motor vehicle mechanics training this November.
Kiswahili: TVET inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Samburu kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari Novemba hii.
Somali: TVET waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada gobolka Samburu inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka mashiinka gawaarida ee bisha November.
Dholuo: TVET gwelo rowere e county mar Samburu mondo odonj e tiegruok mar mechanics mag mtokni e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Narok County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Narok: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Mei 2023
Somali: Degmada Narok: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Narok: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar abich higa mar 2023

English: Public health advisory: Kenya Red Cross warns of increased typhoid risk in Kisii County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya matumbo katika Kaunti ya Kisii na kushauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Warbixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ka digtay khatarta sii kordheysa ee cudurka 'typhoid' ee degmada Kisii waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Chenro mar thieth mar ji: Kenya Red Cross osiemo ji kuom medruok mar tuo mar typhoid e County mar Kisii kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore mar konyo e thieth.

English: Kenya Dairy Board urges coffee growers in Embu County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawataka wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Embu kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Embu inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda si loo hagaajiyo goosashada xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e county mar Embu mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: Kenya Gazette updates residents of Kakamega County on progress of ward-level service delivery this June.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawasilisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega juu ya maendeleo ya usambazaji wa huduma katika darasa mwezi Juni.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Kakamega ka warbixiyaa horumarka adeegga heerka degmada bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette osemiyo jodak e Kaunti mar Kakamega ng'eyo kaka tij lendo dhi nyime e dwe mar Jun.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the community in Machakos County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb burglary.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya bulshada degmada Machakos inay ka warbixiyaan waxqabadka shakiga ah xarunta booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ji duto manie county mar Machakos mondo onyis polis ma ni machiegni gi kanyo ni gitimo gimoro marach mondo kik jokuoge odonj e odno.

English: E-Citizen advises residents of Kiambu County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: E-Citizen nyiso jogweng' Kiambu County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport.

English: Turkana County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Turkana: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Mei 2023
Somali: Degmada Turkana: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Turkana: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar abich 2023

English: OGP reminds the public in Tana River County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this July.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya Tana River kwamba maoni juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma yanakaribishwa Julai hii.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Tana River in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha July.
Dholuo: OGP oparo ne ji duto e taon mar Tana River County ni gibiro yie gi chiwo mag paro e wi chenro mag sirkal e dwe mar Julai.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges residents of Nyandarua County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama katikati ya tahadhari kubwa ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ka socda aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo sidii loo dhisi lahaa nabadgelyada qaranka.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkande mag sirkal kuom gik ma ne timore e alwora mar tong'gi nikech ji osebedo ka keto pachgi ahinya kuom loso kuwe e piny.

English: Mandatory wearing of masks in public and open spaces is now lifted
Kiswahili: Uvaaji wa lazima wa barakoa katika maeneo ya umma na wazi sasa umeondolewa
Somali: Qasabka ah ee xirashada maaskaro meelaha dadweynaha iyo bannaanka ayaa hadda la joojiyay
Dholuo: Tiyo gi mask e lela koda kuonde ma ji yudoree koro ok ochuno

English: Notice: TVET reminds citizens in Wajir County about their rights regarding devolution.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: Ogsoonow: TVET waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Wajir ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET paronwa raia mag Kaunti mar Wajir e wi ratiro ma gin-go mar golo pesa.

English: A GAIN-led campaign in Mombasa that improves access to affordable fruits and vegetables in urban market zones.
Kiswahili: Kampeni inayoongozwa na GAIN huko Mombasa ambayo inaboresha upatikanaji wa matunda na mboga za bei nafuu katika maeneo ya soko la mijini.
Somali: Olole ay hogaaminayaan GAIN oo ka socda Mombasa oo hagaajinaysa helitaanka miraha iyo khudaarta la awoodi karo ee ku yaal meelaha suuqyada magaalooyinka.
Dholuo: Kampen mar GAIN e Mombasa ma konyo ji yudo olemo kod alot ma nengogi yot e gwenge mag taon.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free depression awareness support is available through county health facilities in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa uhamasishaji wa unyogovu unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay wacyiga niyadjabku laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Lamu County.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar parruok yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e County mar Lamu.

English: Teachers Service Commission invites youth in Kitui County to enroll for ICT skills training this April.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kitui kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT Aprili hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa ku casuumay dhalinyarada degmada Kitui inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka xirfadaha ICT bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Commission of Teachers Service Commission ogwelo rowere ma Kitui County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar ICT e dwe mar April.

English: Council of Governors urges residents of Nandi County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi waombe msimamizi wa wilaya yao wa eneo hilo kuwajulisha juu ya huduma za kiwango cha wilaya.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku boorinayaan dadka deggan degmada Nandi inay la shaqeeyaan maamulaha qaybta maxalliga ah si ay uga warqabaan bixinta adeegga heerka qaybta.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Nandi mondo omany jatend buchgi mondo ong'e weche duto motudore gi tich mitimo e buchno.

English: Notice: DCI opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DCI inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa simu ya GBV ya bure katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ee Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: DCI ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo chenro mar konyo maonge chudo mar GBV e gweng' mar Wajir.

Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu ku dhawaaqay taariikhda diiwaangelinta waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj ogolo chenro mar somo mar pinyruoth maonge chudo e skunde man Nyandarua County.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development urges parents and teachers in Isiolo County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.

Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e Isiolo County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok.

Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Garissa: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Mei 2023

Somali: Biyaha kulul u isticmaal markaad cunto u diyaarinayso ilmaha si looga hortago ciribta
Dholuo: Ti gi pi maliet e loso chiemo ne nyathi mondo kik obed gi dhoho

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service opens a gender desk offering free legal aid in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafungua ofisi ya kijinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisheria bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu furayaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah degmada Bomet.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Forest Service ochako ofis ma chiwo kony mar chike maonge chudo e county mar Bomet.

English: Heatstroke Prevention: Resources to help educate parents and caregivers about the dangers of hot cars, including children getting trapped in an unlocked vehicle, being forgotten or left.
Kiswahili: Kuzuia Mlipuko wa Joto (Heatstroke): Rasilimali za kuelimisha wazazi na walezi kuhusu hatari za magari yenye joto kali, ikiwa ni pamoja na watoto kukwama kwenye gari lililo wazi, kusahaulika au kuachwa ndani.
Somali: Ka Hortagga Kuleylka: Agab lagu caawinayo waalidiinta iyo daryeelayaasha inay wax ka bartaan khataraha baabuurta kulul, oo ay ku jiraan carruurta oo ku xayiran gaari aan la furin, la iloobo ama laga tago.

English: KICD conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Vihiga County this April.
Kiswahili: KICD inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Aprili hii.
Somali: KICD waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha degmada Vihiga bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: KICD otimo romo mar tiego ji e wi migawo mar Ombudsman e County mar Vihiga e dwe mar April.

English: DCI urges motorists and pedestrians in Tharaka-Nithi County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DCI inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada daadadku ka da'ay si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira qaraxyada dabka.
