Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi watumie portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ili kupambana na matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nandi inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u soo gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago xadgudubka xilka.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jogweng' kaunti mar Nandi mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo ng'ur mar kedo gi tiyo marach gi migepe.

English: Notice: NPS conducts a community briefing on border security in Vihiga County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha degmada Vihiga bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NPS timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e County mar Vihiga e dwe mar Januar.

English: Judiciary of Kenya encourages first-time voters in Trans Nzoia County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Trans Nzoia inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo josiasa mokwongo e county mar Trans Nzoia mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero.

English: Ministry of Education urges youth in Meru County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Meru kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Meru inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo rowere e County mar Meru mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok ochopo chenro mag oganda.

English: Climate-smart agriculture (CSA) is an approach that helps guide actions to transform agrifood systems towards more productive, sustainable and resilient ...
Kiswahili: Kilimo cha hali ya hewa-akili (CSA) ni mbinu ambayo husaidia kuongoza hatua za kubadilisha mifumo ya kilimo ya chakula kuelekea uzalishaji zaidi, endelevu na kuhimili ...
Somali: Beeraha cimilada caqliga leh (CSA) waa hab hagida tallaabooyinka lagu beddelayo nidaamyada cuntada beeraha si ay u noqdaan kuwo wax soo saar leh, waara oo adkaysi leh ...
Dholuo: Tij pur mariek e weche mag lokruok e kor lwasi (Climate-Smart Agriculture - CSA) en yo ma konyo e tayo gik mitimo mondo olok yore mag loso chiemo e yore mag pur obed gi nyak, ma ok dhiga nyime kendo ma nigi teko mar geng'o chandruoge.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association confirms a typhoid outbreak alert for Nyandarua County. Residents are advised to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya chathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa matumbo katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xaqiijiyay digniin ku saabsan cudurka tifooska ee gobolka Nyandarua. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Medical Association osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuwo mar typhoid e kaunti mar Nyandarua.

English: NCPB advises avocado producers in Kakamega County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wazalishaji wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: NCPB waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha avocado ee Gobolka Kakamega inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: NCPB nyiso jopur mag avocado e Kaunti mar Kakamega mondo oti gi nengo mar piny mosingi kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Kenya Medical Association appeals to caregivers in Murang'a County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the January maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Januari.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ka codsadaa daryeelayaasha degmada Murang'a inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Janaayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association okwayo jorit e county mar Murang'a mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongruok kaka achiel kuom chenro mar Januar mar rito ngima mar mine.

English: State Department for TVET calls on the community in Samburu County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada gobolka Samburu inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116, si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyada.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET kwayo ji duto e county mar Samburu mondo omany namba 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Connect with institutional buyers like hotels to supply your milk regularly Understand their quality quantity and delivery requirements
Kiswahili: Ungana na wanunuzi wa taasisi kama vile hoteli ili kusambaza maziwa yako mara kwa mara Elewa ubora wingi na mahitaji yao ya utoaji
Somali: La xiriir iibsadayaasha hay'adaha sida hoteelada si aad caano u siiso si joogto ah Fahmaan shuruudaha tayada iyo bixinta
Dholuo: Wuo gi jolok ohala kaka kuonde nindo mag ot mondo omiyi chak e yo mapile Ng'e gik ma gidwaro ni itim kod kaka gibiro chiwo

English: AFA advises farmers in Migori County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: AFA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: AFA waxay kula talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Migori inay ka soo qayb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: AFA nyiso jopur e county mar Migori mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: DPP reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Uasin Gishu County that access to free legal aid is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisheria ni bure.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Uasin Gishu in la heli karo caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah oo lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: DPP oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu ni thuolo mar yudo kony ma onge chudo yudore maonge chudo.

English: DCI reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Taita-Taveta County that access to post-violence medical care is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kwamba huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu zinapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay Gobolka Taita-Taveta in helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ka dib rabshaduhu uu yahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: DCI parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e Taita-Taveta County ni yudo kony mar thieth ma iyudo bang' timno onge chudo.

English: NPS urges motorists and pedestrians in Kwale County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NPS inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Kwale kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa darawalada gawaarida iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Kwale inay guryahooda rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dabka daminta iyo inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa dhacdooyinka fatahaadaha la xiriira.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo derebe kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Kwale mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo gitim kinda mar geng'o masiche motudore gi apaka.

English: Garissa County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Garissa: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Juni 2023
Somali: Degmada Garissa: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Garissa: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar auchiel 2023

English: Families are encouraged to identify emergency transport options in advance, in case labor begins unexpectedly. Delays in reaching the hospital can lead to complications.
Kiswahili: Familia zinahimizwa kutambua njia za usafiri wa dharura mapema, iwapo uchungu wa kujifungua utaanza bila kutarajia. Kuchelewa kufika hospitalini kunaweza kusababisha matatizo.
Somali: Qoysaska waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay horay u ogaadaan xulashooyinka gaadiidka xaaladaha degdegga ah, haddii dhalmada ay bilaabato si lama filaan ah.
Dholuo: Ijiwo joot mondo ong'e chon kaka ginyalo ting'o mtokni e seche mag masira, kapo ni ich chakore apoya.

English: Notice: TSC reminds citizens in Kwale County about their rights regarding devolution.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Kwale xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TSC paronwa raia mag Kwale County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar golo pesa.

English: IEBC encourages residents of Kilifi County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogweng' Kilifi County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda mondo ging'e weche motudore gi ratiro mag chik.

English: Regional Report 2024: Regional Program on Enhancing the Investment Climate for the Economic Empowerment of Refugee, Returnee and Host/Return Community Women in the East and Horn of Africa and Great Lakes Region
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Kanda ya 2024: Programu ya Kikanda ya Kuimarisha Hali ya Hewa ya Uwekezaji kwa Uwezeshaji wa Kiuchumi kwa Wakimbizi, Waliorudishwa na Mwenyeji/Wanawake wa Jumuiya ya Kurudi Mashariki na Pembe ya Afrika na Ukanda wa Maziwa Makuu.
Somali: Warbixinta Gobolka 2024: Barnaamijka Gobolka ee ku saabsan Kobcinta Jawiga Maalgashiga ee Awoodsiinta Dhaqaalaha ee Haweenka Qaxootiga, Dadka Soo Laabtay iyo Bulshada Martigelinta/Dhinaca ah ee Bariga iyo Geeska Afrika iyo Gobolka Harooyinka Weyn
Dholuo: Ripot mar 2024: Chenro mar 2024: Program mar 2024: Program mar 2024 kuom medo ng’iyo mar keto pesa mondo omi teko mar weche yuto ne mon ma jodak e pinje mamoko, jogo ma osedok e pinje mamoko kod jogo ma odak e pinje mamoko e piny ma Wuokchieng’ kod Tung’ mar Afrika kod e gwenge mag Nam Maduong’

English: IEBC urges eligible citizens in Kilifi County to participate in polling procedures.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kushiriki katika utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kilifi inay ka qeyb galaan nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro e County mar Kilifi mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag yiero.

English: Only bill(s)/claim (s) submitted in the prescribed formats will be accepted.
Kiswahili: Mswada/dai (ma) pekee iliyowasilishwa katika muundo uliowekwa ndio utakaokubaliwa.
Somali: Kaliya biilka/sheegashooyinka lagu soo gudbiyay qaababka loo qoondeeyay ayaa la aqbali doonaa.
Dholuo: Gin mana bill/klaim ma ooro e fomat ma oket kende e ma ibiro yie.

English: KEPHIS announces a free anthrax vaccination exercise for goats in Nyandarua County this September.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kimeta kwa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Septemba hii.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay geedaha gobolka Nyandarua bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: KEPHIS ogolo chenro mar thiedho diek e dwe mar ochiko mar higani ne diek mag Nyandarua County.

English: COMESA promotes terracing among farmers in West Pokot County as part of the July climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: COMESA inakuza usafirishaji kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Julai.
Somali: COMESA waxay dhiirrigelisay dhulka beeraleyda ku nool gobolka West Pokot iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee bishii July.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo puodho e kind jopur e West Pokot County kaka achiel kuom chenro mar dwe mar Julai mar kedo gi lokruok e kit yamo.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds residents of Murang'a County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Murang'a in warbixinta khiyaamooyinka si deg deg ah ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne jogweng' mar Murang'a County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar wuond konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the public in Meru County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Meru kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadweynaha degmada Meru inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto e county mar Meru mondo ochiw ripot mar ote mamulo pachgi ne jatendgi bang' yudo ripode mag ote mag phishing.

English: Farmers can now receive 50 of insurance premiums funded by the Government for crop losses covering farms from 1 2 to 20 acres Purchase your insurance to qualify
Kiswahili: Wakulima sasa wanaweza kupokea malipo 50 ya bima inayofadhiliwa na Serikali kwa hasara ya mazao kutoka kwa mashamba kutoka ekari 1 2 hadi 20 Nunua bima yako ili uhitimu.
Somali: Beeraleydu hadda waxay heli karaan 50 caymis oo ay maalgeliso dowladda si loogu isticmaalo khasaaraha dalagga, kuwaas oo daboolaya beeraha u dhexeeya 12 ilaa 20 acre. Iibso caymiskaaga si aad u qalanto
Dholuo: Jo-Purie sani nyalo yudo chudo mar 50 mar insuarans ma sirkal chiwo kuom chudo mar cham ma opong ' gi puothe mag puothe mag akra 12 nyaka 20

English: Here's a popular misconception we need to talk about. Inflatables don't keep children safe in the water. Inflatable armbands, neck floaties, and other inflatable toys tend to give a false sense of security. They can slip off, deflate, disrupt balance, and are not designed to prevent drowning. The real protection is constant, active adult supervision, always within arm's reach https://bit.ly/4yEIAgY DrowningPrevention WorldDrowningPreventionDay : Getty Images
Kiswahili: Huu hapa ni ufahamu potofu unaofaa kuzungumziwa: Vifaa vya kupuliza hewa havimlindi mtoto majini. Vitambaa vya mikononi na vinyago vya kuogelea vinatoa usalama wa uongo. Vinaweza kuvuka, kupoteza upepo, na havijatengenezwa kuzuia kuzama. Ulinzi wa kweli ni usimamizi wa karibu wa mtu mzima wakati wote.
Somali: Waa kan fikrad khaldan oo caan ah oo aan u baahanahay inaan ka hadalno. Qalabka la buufiyo carruurta kuma ilaaliyaan biyaha. Gacanta la buufiyo, qoorta la sabbeeyo, iyo alaabta kale ee la buufiyo waxay u muuqdaan inay bixiyaan dareen ammaan oo been ah. Way ka bixi karaan, way daadan karaan, way carqaladeyn karaan dheelitirka, looma qorsheynin inay ka hortagaan qarqidda. Ilaalinta dhabta ah waa kormeer joogto ah oo firfircoon oo qof weyn ah, oo had iyo jeer gacanta lagu gaari karo https://bit.ly/4yEIAgY DrowningPrevention WorldDrowningPreventionDay: Getty Images
Dholuo: Mae en paro ma ok kare ma ji mang’eny nigo ma dwarore ni wawuo kuome. Gik ma ng’ato nyalo pong’o gi yamo ok keto nyithindo obed maber e pi. Gik ma ng’ato nyalo pong’o e lwete, gik ma ng’ato nyalo pong’o e ng’ute, kod gik mamoko ma ng’ato nyalo pong’o gi yamo, nyalo miyo ng’ato obed gi paro ma miriambo ni en gi arita. Ginyalo ng’injo, weyo muya, ketho ng’injo, kendo ok olosi mondo kik ng’ato odonj e pi. Gima adier mar rito ng’ato en rito jodongo ma kinde ka kinde kendo ma tiyo matek, ma kinde duto nyalo chopo e lwet ng’ato.

English: Kenya: Heavy Rains and Flooding Update - Flash Update #6 (17 May 2024)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Mvua Kubwa na Taarifa ya Mafuriko - Sasisho la Flash #6 (17 Mei 2024)
Somali: Kenya: Roobab Mahiigaan ah iyo Warbixin Daadad - Cusboonaysiinta Degdegga ah #6 (17 Maajo 2024)
Dholuo: Kenya: Koth Mapek kod Pi Opong'o Ong'ere - Oboke Mapiyo #6 (17 Mei 2024)

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds livestock keepers in Tana River County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xayawaanka ee degmada Tana River inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyaga oo aan haysan rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development oparo ne jorit jamni e Tana River County ni kik giting' jamni ka ok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: KICD announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Baringo County this January.
Kiswahili: KICD inatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Baringo Januari hii.
Somali: KICD waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta waxyaabaha barashada digitalka ah ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Baringo bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: KICD olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag digital maonge chudo e skunde mag Baringo County e dwe mar Januar.

English: Kenya - Food insecurity and malnutrition (DG ECHO, IPC) (ECHO Daily Flash of 28 March 2025)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Uhaba wa chakula na utapiamlo (DG ECHO, IPC) (ECHO Daily Flash ya 28 Machi 2025)
Somali: Kenya - Cunto la'aan iyo nafaqo-xumo (DG ECHO, IPC) (ECHO Daily Flash ee 28 Maarso 2025)
Dholuo: Kenya - Bedo gi arita mar chiemo kod bedo maongee chiemo (DG ECHO, IPC)

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties invites residents of Nyandarua County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties ogwelo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county mar konyo e chenro mag dongruok.

English: DPP calls on residents of Kisumu County to support local peace-building committees in support of national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DPP atoa wito kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kuunga mkono kamati za ujenzi wa amani za mitaa kuunga mkono ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: DPP waxay dadka deggan degmada Kisumu ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah ee taageeraya nabadgelyada qaranka.
Dholuo: DPP okwayo ji duto modak Kisumu County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e pinygi.

English: KTDA advises farmers in Machakos County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the March planting season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Machi.
Somali: KTDA waxay kula talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Machakos inay qaataan noocyo abuurka ah oo u adkaysta abaarta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: KTDA nyiso jopur e county mar Machakos mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochako chwoyo kodhi e dwe mar Mach.

English: Boost productivity in poultry farming through improved breeds, feeding, housing, and healthcare practices.
Kiswahili: Kuongeza tija katika ufugaji wa kuku kupitia aina bora za kuku, ufugaji, malazi, na mbinu za afya.
Somali: Kordhi wax-soosaarka beerta digaagga iyada oo la hagaajinayo noocyada, quudinta, hoyga, iyo hababka caafimaadka.
Dholuo: Med timo dongruok e pidho dhok kokalo kuom kit udi, chiemo, kuonde dak, kod yore mag thieth.

English: KEMRI reminds expectant mothers in Mandera County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Mandera in helitaanka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMRI parone mine ma biro bedo gi ich e county mar Mandera ni thuolo mar yudo puonj mag chenro mag ngima joot en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag sirkal.

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of Baringo County to prepare for possible road accidents this July.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Julai hii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay isu diyaariyaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha July.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross osiemo jogweng' Baringo County mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Julai.

English: HELB announces distribution of revision guides to schools in Nandi County this February.
Kiswahili: HELB inatangaza usambazaji wa miongozo ya marekebisho kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nandi Februari hii.
Somali: HELB waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta hagaha dib u eegista dugsiyada degmada Nandi bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: HELB olando ni gibiro pogo buge malero weche manyien e skunde man Nandi County e dwe mar Februar.

English: Mandera County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Mandera: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2024
Somali: Degmada Mandheera: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Mandera: Oboke Mopinyo mar Oro mar Adek 2024

English: ODPP urges eligible citizens in Machakos County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Machakos kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Machakos inay ka qaybqaataan jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro mar yiero e county mar Machakos mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar yiero.

English: Notice: FAO will distribute certified sorghum seed to farmers in Turkana County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Turkana Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay abuurka sorghum-ka ee shahaadada leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Turkana bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: FAO biro pogo kodhi mag sorghum ne jopur man Turkana County e dwe mar April.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response calls on parents in Migori County to have children under five screened for typhoid during the December outreach.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Migori kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa typhoid wakati wa mawasiliano ya Desemba.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku baaqeysaa waalidiinta Degmada Migori inay carruurta ka yar shan sano u sameeyaan baaritaanka cudurka 'typhoid' inta lagu gudajiro bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo kwayo jonyuol e County mar Migori mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Desemba mondo ging'e ni gin gi tuwo mar typhoid.

English: KICD reminds parents in Narok County that school feeding programme registration is open this December.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Narok kwamba usajili wa mpango wa kulisha shule umefunguliwa Desemba hii.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Narok in diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga ay furan tahay bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: KICD parone jonyuol manie Narok County ni chenro mar kwayo nyithindo chiemo e skul osechakore e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will train farmers in Marsabit County on conservation tillage this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya kilimo cha uhifadhi Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu tababar siin doonaa beeraleyda degmada Marsabit ku saabsan beerashada ilaalinta bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro tiego jopur e Marsabit County e weche mag pidho puothe e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: AFA will train farmers in Baringo County on soil conservation this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Baringo juu ya uhifadhi wa udongo Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Baringo ee ku saabsan ilaalinta ciidda bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: AFA biro tiego jopur e taon mar Baringo e wi rito lowo e dwe mar Januar.

English: KEPHIS urges sheep farmers in Trans Nzoia County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wafugaji wa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa Newcastle vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda idaha ee degmada Trans Nzoia inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo ka dib kiisaska cudurka Newcastle ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur mag rombe e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo ogeng'e legi e kuonde moyier mag chwoyo rombe bang' yudo weche mag tuo mar Newcastle.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Tharaka-Nithi County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Mei hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho oo ku saabsan ka hortagga argagixisada Degmada Tharaka-Nithi bishii May.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Red Cross timo romo mar oganda kuom wach kedo gi timbe mahundu e Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar Mei.

English: Tanzanian and Malawian trade in agricultural products will resume on May 2 2025 Stakeholders should prepare for this reopening of commercial ties
Kiswahili: Biashara ya Tanzania na Malawi ya bidhaa za kilimo itaanza tena Mei 2 2025 Wadau wajiandae kwa ufunguzi huu wa mahusiano ya kibiashara.
Somali: Ganacsiga Tanzania iyo Malawi ee alaabta beeraha ayaa dib u bilaaban doona May 2, 2025. Daneeyayaasha waa inay isu diyaariyaan dib u furitaanka xiriirka ganacsiga
Dholuo: Oganda mar Tanzania kod Malawi biro chako ohala gi gik ma gitiyogo e pur e dwe mar Mei tarik 2 higa mar 2025

English: Encourage mindset change among farmers to stock more of their harvest and sell less.
Kiswahili: Kuhimiza mabadiliko ya mawazo kati ya wakulima kuhifadhi mavuno yao zaidi na kuuza kidogo.
Somali: Dhiirrigeliya isbeddelka maskaxda beeraleyda inay kaydiyaan dalaggooda oo ay iibiyaan wax yar.
Dholuo: Jiw jopur mondo olok pachgi mondo gichiw cham mang'eny kendo giusgi matin.

Somali: Xaaladaha qaarkood, soo sheegista musuqmaasuqu waa wax ka badan waajib oo keliya; waa waajib sharci ah: Xeerka Ka-hortagga iyo La-dagaallanka Hawlaha Musuqmaasuqa wuxuu u baahan yahay dadka ku jira â€šÂ¬Ã…â€œjagooyinka awooddaâ€œ _x009d_ ee qaybaha dadweynaha iyo kuwa gaarka loo leeyahay inay booliska u soo sheegaan musuqmaasuqa iyo dambiyada kale ee ku qoran Xeerka oo ay ku jiraan in ka badan R100Ãƒâ€š 000.

English: TSC encourages out-of-school children in Homa Bay County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under free primary education.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: TSC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee gobolka Homa Bay inay dalbadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e Homa Bay County mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Select a groundnut variety suited to your agro-ecological zone; in Nigeria, the Sahel, Sudan, and Northern and Southern Guinea savanna zones are the main groundnut-growing regions, so choose a variety adapted to your zone's maturity period and market preferences.
Kiswahili: Chagua aina ya karanga inayofaa kwa eneo lako la kilimo-ikolojia; nchini Nigeria, Sahel, Sudan, na maeneo ya savanna ya Kaskazini na Kusini mwa Guinea ndio maeneo makuu ya kukuza karanga, kwa hivyo chagua aina iliyobadilishwa kulingana na kipindi cha ukomavu wa eneo lako na mapendeleo ya soko.
Somali: Dooro nooc lowska dhulka ah oo ku habboon aaggaaga deegaanka; Nigeria, savannada Sahel, Sudan, iyo Northern iyo Southern Guinea ayaa ah gobollada ugu waaweyn ee lowska lagu beero, sidaas darteed dooro nooc la jaanqaado xilliga bisaylka iyo doorashada suuqa ee aaggaaga.
Dholuo: Yier kit olemo mar goro ma owinjore gi alwora midakie; e piny Nigeria, e alwora mar Sahel, Sudan, kod e alwora mar Northern and Southern Guinea, e ma gipidhoga goro madongo, omiyo yier kit olemo ma owinjore gi kinde ma olemo dongo kod kaka chuech ohero.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross launches a fraud prevention campaign in Wajir County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Wajir Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga khiyaamooyinka Gobolka Wajir bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ripot Mamit mar Kenya chako kampen mar geng'o wuond e gweng' mar Wajir e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will distribute certified beans seed to farmers in Uasin Gishu County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itasambaza mbegu za maharagwe zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay abuurka xoolaha ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Uasin Gishu bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Rieko: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro pogo kodhi mag nyinyo ne jopur e Uasin Gishu County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: KALRO announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for dairy cows in West Pokot County this December.
Kiswahili: KALRO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Desemba hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan qabyaalada lo'da caanaha ah ee Gobolka West Pokot bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: KALRO ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok ma chamo dhok e West Pokot County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice from SHA (Social Health Authority): free antenatal care clinics will run every January at designated health centres in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii): kliniki za bure za huduma za ujauzito zitaendeshwa kila Januari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada): rugaha daryeelka dhalmada ee bilaashka ah waxaa lagu qaban doonaa Janaayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Nairobi.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar SHA (Social Health Authority): ibiro ti gi klinike maonge chudo e dwe mar Januar higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Nairobi.

English: KNEC announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Kisii County this March.
Kiswahili: KNEC inatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya kujifunza dijitali bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kisii Machi hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta waxyaabaha barashada digitalka ah ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Kisii bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: KNEC olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag digital maonge chudo e skunde man Kisii County e dwe mar Mach.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds expectant mothers in Siaya County that access to skilled birth attendance is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba upatikanaji wa mahudhurio ya uzazi wenye ujuzi ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Siaya in helitaanka daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfad leh ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne mine madwaro nyuol e county mar Siaya ni thuolo mar yudo nyithindo ma nigi lony en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag oganda.

English: IEBC urges residents of Nyeri County to attend the public participation forum to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si loo qaabeeyo habka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogweng' County mar Nyeri mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar loso chenro mar bajet mar county.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Kiambu County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu watumie portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na ufisadi wa fedha za umma.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u soo gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago xadgudubka lacagaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Kiambu mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo ng'ur mar kedo gi ketho pesa mag sirkal.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Siaya County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Siaya Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ku saabsan ka hortagga argagixisada ee degmada Siaya bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji (Communications Authority of Kenya) timo romo mar oganda e dwe mar Agost e county mar Siaya.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds the public in Nyandarua County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba kuripoti matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka ku xasuustaa gobolka Nyandarua in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties paronwa ji duto e County mar Nyandarua ni lando wach tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds mobile money users in Embu County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Embu kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa pesa ya rununu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Embu inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado khayaanada lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne joma tiyo gi pesa mobil e county mar Embu ni mondo ging'e kwayo margi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo gitang' gi mibadhi mag pesa mobilu.

English: KMTC advises applicants in Marsabit County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KMTC inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KMTC waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Marsabit inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: KMTC nyiso jogo madwaro donjo e sirkal mar Marsabit mondo odonj e skundno kapok ichopo e chokruok mabiro.

English: KTDA reminds residents of Kisii County that terracing improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba terracing inaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: KTDA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii in dhulka lagu beerayo uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: KTDA parone jogweng' Kisii County ni terracing miyo puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: Judiciary of Kenya updates residents of Nandi County on progress of ward-level service delivery this December.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi juu ya maendeleo ya usambazaji wa huduma katika darasa mwezi Desemba.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Nandi ka warbixiyaa horumarka adeegga heerka degmada bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya osemiyo jodak e county mar Nandi ng'eyo kaka tij lendo dhi nyime e dwe mar Desemba.

English: KEMSA urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Samburu County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Samburu inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pach e county mar Samburu mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Kakamega County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Kakamega inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e gweng' mar Kakamega mondo odhi ir japuonj molony.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges the community in Vihiga County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb burglary.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu usiowajua ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Vihiga inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo oganda man Vihiga County mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo kik gikwed nek.

English: Notice from SHA (Social Health Authority): postnatal check-ups clinics will run every September at designated health centres in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii): kliniki za uchunguzi wa baada ya kuzaa zitafanya kazi kila Septemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada): Xarumaha baaritaanka dhalmada ka dib ayaa la qaban doonaa bishii Sebtember ee xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Siem moa kuom SHA (Social Health Authority): klinik mag nonro bang' nyuol ibiro timie higa ka higa e dwe mar Septemba e kuonde thieth moyier e Homa Bay County.

English: Notice: HELB launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay bilawday barnaamij lagu darayo ardayda naafada ah dugsiyada gobolka Kilifi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: HELB chako chenro mar tiego nyithindo ma nigi midekre e skunde duto mag Kilifi County.

English: Al Jazeera reported at least eleven protesters killed during Saba Saba Day demonstrations, citing police use of live ammunition.
Kiswahili: Al Jazeera iliripoti angalau waandamanaji 11 waliuawa wakati wa maandamano ya Siku ya Saba Saba, ikitaja matumizi ya polisi ya risasi halisi.
Somali: Al Jazeera ayaa soo sheegtay in ugu yaraan 11 qof oo mudaaharaadayaal ah ay ku dhinteen intii lagu jiray banaanbaxyada Maalinta Saba Saba, iyagoo ku tilmaamay in booliska ay isticmaaleen rasaas dhab ah.
Dholuo: Al Jazeera ne onyiso ni ji apar gachiel ne onegi e kinde mar nyasi mar Saba Saba Day, kowacho ni polise ne tiyo gi bunde.

English: NPS urges motorists and pedestrians in Siaya County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NPS inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Siaya inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay adeegsadaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee socodka si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo joidh mtokni kod jowuoth e county mar Siaya mondo oluw tong' mar wuoth kendo giti gi kuonde ma wuothoe mondo gikwed masiche ma timore nikech ataro.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Kilifi County to prepare for possible landslides this June.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa maporomoko ya ardhi Juni hii.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ka digaya dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inay u diyaar garoobaan dhulgariir dhici kara bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations osiemo jogweng' Kilifi County mondo oikre ne yiengni mag lowo mabiro timore e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: KEMRI confirms a cyclosporiasis outbreak alert for Kisumu County. Residents are advised to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa cyclosporiasis kwa Kaunti ya Kisumu. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka cyclosporiasis ee degmada Kisumu. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KEMRI osenyiso ni nitie masira mar cyclosporiasis e gweng' mar Kisumu.

English: COMESA informs tea farmers in Isiolo County of new market linkage opportunities this September.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawafahamisha wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Septemba hii.
Somali: COMESA waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Isiolo fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: COMESA nyiso jopur mag chai e gweng' mar Isiolo e dwe mar Septemba e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala.

English: IPOA reminds residents of Tana River County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River in warbixinta degdegga ah ee xanta xoolaha ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogweng' mar Tana River County ni lando piyo piyo mag jamni konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Kitui County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kitui: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2022
Somali: Degmada Kitui: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kitui: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar adek higa mar 2022

English: KEMRI reminds the public that free trauma counselling support is available through county health facilities in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa ushauri wa kiwewe unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo la talinta dhaawaca laga helo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Kajiado County.
Dholuo: KEMRI oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tuoche yudore maonge chudo kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e Kajiado County.

English: UNHCR Kenya Operational Update #9 (September 2023)
Kiswahili: Sasisho la Uendeshaji la UNHCR Kenya #9 (Septemba 2023)
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta Hawlgalka UNHCR Kenya #9 (Sebtembar 2023)
Dholuo: Wach manyien mar tije mag UNHCR e piny Kenya #9 (Dwe mar Apar 2023)

English: Universities Fund encourages out-of-school children in Bungoma County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa carruurta dugsiga ka baxsan ee degmada Bungoma inay codsadaan deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e County mar Bungoma mondo okonygi yudo konyno kapok kindeno ochopo kaluwore gi chenro mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: African marigold (Tagetes erecta) â€“ mbangimwitu. Use against: bacteria, fungi, nematodes, insects (ants, beetles and many others). Preparation: crush 100-200g of the leaves, roots or flowers, pour on 1 litre of boiling water, stir, and soak for 24 hours, then add 1 litre of cold water. Spray on plants or into the soil.
Kiswahili: African marigold / Mbangimwitu (Tagetes erecta). Inazuia: bacteria, fungi, nematodes, wadudu (ants, beetles na wadudu wengine wengi). Kutayarisha: ponda gramu 100-200 ya matawi, mizizi na maua; mwaga kwa lita moja ya maji yaliyochemka; lowa kwa masaa ishirini na nne; ongeza lita moja ya maji baridi; nyunyiza kwa mimea au mchanga.
Somali: Marigold Afrikaan ah (Tagetes erecta) - mbangimwitu. Loo isticmaalo: bakteeriyada, fangaska, nematodes, cayayaanka (qudhaanjada, kuwa lamid ah iyo kuwa kale oo badan). Diyaarinta: burburi 100-200g oo caleenta, xididdada ama ubaxa ah, ku shub 1 litir oo biyo karkaraya ah, walaaq, oo qooy 24 saacadood, ka dibna ku dar 1 litir oo biyo qabow ah. Ku buufi dhirta ama ciidda.
Dholuo: Ti kode e lweny gi: kwiri, owinyo, winyo kod mamoko mang'eny. Yore mar loso: ng'ad 100-200g mar it oboke, muende kata maua, ol ewi lita 1 mar pi maliel, irudi, kendo ng'ad ng’ado pi e wi yien kata e lowo.

English: Safeguarding in practice: anticipating, minimising and mitigating risk in teenage pregnancy research in urban informal settlements in Nairobi, Kenya
Kiswahili: Kulinda kwa vitendo: kutarajia, kupunguza na kupunguza hatari katika utafiti wa ujauzito wa vijana katika makazi yasiyo rasmi ya mijini huko Nairobi, Kenya.
Somali: Ilaalinta ficil ahaan: saadaalinta, yaraynta iyo yaraynta khatarta cilmi-baarista uurka ee dhallinyarada ee degsiimooyinka aan rasmiga ahayn ee magaalooyinka ee Nairobi, Kenya
Dholuo: Kuong’ruok e tim: geno, duoko piny kendo duoko piny luoro e nonro mar bedo gi ich e kind joma hikgi tin e bombe ma ok owinjore e boma ma Nairobi, Kenya

English: Notice: AFA will train farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County on soil conservation this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya uhifadhi wa udongo Aprili hii.
Somali: Xusuusin: AFA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Tharaka-Nithi ee ku saabsan ilaalinta ciidda bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Ne: AFA biro tiego jopur e Tharaka-Nithi County e wi rito lowo e dwe mar April.

English: KEMRI reminds the public that free depression awareness support is available through county health facilities in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa uhamasishaji wa unyogovu unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay wacyiga niyadjabku laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Kajiado County.
Dholuo: KEMRI paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar parruok yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e Kajiado County.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges residents of Kisumu County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na ugawaji wa bursary.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan qaybinta deeqaha waxbarasho.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kisumu mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud michno.

English: Notice: DPP launches a theft prevention campaign in Kericho County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DPP yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Kericho Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada degmada Kericho bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: DPP chako kampen mar geng'o kuo e taon mar Kericho e dwe mar April.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Bomet County that access to SHA registration is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba ufikiaji wa usajili wa SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Bomet in gelitaanka diiwaangelinta SHA ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth parone ji duto e county mar Bomet ni thuolo mar yudo weche mag SHA sani yudore e kuonde moyier.

English: Notice: ODPP will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ee degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: ODPP biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag siasa e County mar Nyeri.

English: Rainfall will vary across Kenya, with lower amounts in western regions and the Rift Valley, higher rainfall at the Coast, and minimal rain in eastern and north-eastern areas, while temperatures will remain above average nationwide.
Kiswahili: Mvua zitatofautiana kote nchini Kenya, na kiasi cha chini katika mikoa ya magharibi na Bonde la Ufa, mvua nyingi zaidi Pwani, na mvua kidogo katika maeneo ya mashariki na kaskazini-mashariki, huku halijoto ikisalia kuwa juu ya wastani nchini kote.
Somali: Roobabku way ku kala duwanaan doonaan guud ahaan Kenya, iyadoo ay yar yihiin gobollada galbeedka iyo Dooxada Rift, roobab badan oo ka da'a Xeebta, iyo roobab yar oo ka da'a meelaha bari iyo waqooyi-bari, halka heerkulku uu ka sarreyn doono celceliska guud ahaan dalka oo dhan.
Dholuo: Koth biro bedo mopogore opogore e piny Kenya duto, ka koth biro bedo matin e kuonde ma yo podho chieng’ kod Rift Valley, koth biro bedo mang’eny e Coast, kendo koth biro bedo matin ahinya e kuonde ma yo wuokchieng’ kod ma nyandwat-ugwe, to ng’ich biro bedo ma malo moloyo pile e piny mangima.

English: HELB urges residents of Mombasa County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa watu wazima ili kufaidika na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: HELB waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan fasallada aqoonta dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Mombasa mondo odonj e program mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo mondo giyud konyruok kuom tiegruok mar somo kod somo.

English: IEBC warns public officers in Murang'a County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: IEBC inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: IEBC waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Murang'a khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: IEBC chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e kaunti mar Murang'a kuom timbe mag wuondruok.

English: KTDA warns sorghum farmers in Lamu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaonya wakulima wa sorghum katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuhusu kuzuka kwa wadudu na kupendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: KTDA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda sorghum ee degmada Lamu cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyin waqtigeeda ah.
Dholuo: KTDA chiwo siem ne jopur mag sorghum e County mar Lamu kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: FAO reminds livestock keepers in Murang'a County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Murang'a inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyaga oo aan haysan rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: FAO parone jorit jamni e county mar Murang'a ni kik giwuoth gi jamni ka ok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: CDC reminds the public in Machakos County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Machakos juu ya umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: CDC waxay dadka degmada Machakos ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay nadaafadda saxda ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji duto e County mar Machakos kuom ber mar rito ler mar pi e ngima joot.

English: IOM Monthly Programmatic Highlights Kenya | April 2024
Kiswahili: Muhimu wa Kiprogramu wa Kila Mwezi wa IOM Kenya | Aprili 2024
Somali: Waxyaabaha ugu Muhiimsan ee Barnaamijka Bilaha ah ee IOM ee Kenya | Abriil 2024
Dholuo: IOM Dwe ka dwe, gik madongo ma timore e piny Kenya | Ang'wen higa mar 2024

English: Notice from Kenya Medical Association: family planning counselling clinics will run every July at designated health centres in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Julai katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya: rugta la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ayaa ka shaqeyn doonta July kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo magacaabay ee degmada Makueni.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association: Klinike mag chiwo paro e wi chenro mag ngima joot biro dhi nyime dwe mar Julai higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e gweng' mar Makueni.

English: TSC encourages residents of West Pokot County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Somali: TSC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay ka qeybgalaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiego ji mondo ging'e weche motudore gi ratiro mag chik.

English: IPOA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Baringo County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: IPOA inamhimiza mtu yeyote ambaye ana uzoefu wa unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuripoti kesi kwenye dawati la karibu la jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Baringo inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e taon mar Baringo mondo onyis wachno e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Universities Fund urges parents and teachers in Nandi County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Nandi ku boorinayaa inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e county mar Nandi mondo omany namba mar kony mar nyithindo 116.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) warns public officers in Nakuru County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Nakuru dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya madaraka.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Nakuru inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e kaunti mar Nakuru ni kik giti marach gi migepegi.

English: An IPOA warning stated that silence within the police force enables impunity and called for cultural reforms and safe reporting.
Kiswahili: Onyo la IPOA lilisema kwamba ukimya ndani ya jeshi la polisi huwezesha kutokujali na lilitaka mageuzi ya kitamaduni na kuripoti kwa usalama.
Somali: Digniinta IPOA waxay sheegtay in aaminnimada ciidamada booliska ay ka dhigeyso ciqaab la'aan waxayna ku baaqday isbeddellada dhaqanka iyo warbixinta ammaanka ah.
Dholuo: Siem moro mar IPOA nowacho ni ling'ling' ei polise miyo ji bedo maonge bura kendo ne okwayo ni otim lokruok e kit ngima ji kendo mondo okonygi goyo ripot e yo makare.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds residents of Bungoma County that agroforestry improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba kilimo cha misitu kinaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma in beeraha iyo kaymaha ay hagaajinayaan wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development parone jogweng'o mag Bungoma County ni agroforestry medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Judiciary of Kenya encourages first-time voters in Laikipia County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya ayaa ku dhiirigelinaya codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Laikipia inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo josiasa ma ne okwongo yiero e county mar Laikipia mondo ong'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Isiolo County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyadoo la sii xoojinayo feejignaanta ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Isiolo County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'adoe bura e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi kuom weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Notice: TVET opens a new electrical installation programme at the vocational centre in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inafungua programu mpya ya ufungaji wa umeme katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan rakibidda korontada xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: TVET chako chenro manyien mar keto sitima e kar tiegruok e taon mar Baringo.

English: Official announcement of adolescent ironâ€“folic acid supplementation program reaching over 160,000 youth.
Kiswahili: Tangazo rasmi la mpango wa kuongeza asidi ya chuma-foliki kwa vijana linawafikia zaidi ya vijana 160,000.
Somali: Ku dhawaaq rasmi ah oo ku saabsan barnaamijka kaabista birta ee dhallinyarada - folic acid - oo gaaraya in ka badan 160,000 oo dhallinyaro ah.
Dholuo: 160,000, ng’ato nyalo ng’eyo ni ng’ato nyalo ng’eyo ni ng’ato nyalo bedo gi ng’eyo matut kuom ng’ato.

English: NTSA reminds the public in Makueni County to remain vigilant on border security.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Makueni in ay ka feejignaadaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: NTSA oparo ne ji duto e gweng' mar Makueni ni gibed motang' ne sirkal mar boda.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) appeals to caregivers in Kitui County to visit their nearest maternity wing as part of the December maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kitui kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Desemba.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Kitui inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) okwayo jorit e County mar Kitui mondo olimgi ka giwuotho gi jonyuolgi machiegni kodgi e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Mapping of climate security adaptations at community level in the Horn of Africa
Kiswahili: Kuchora ramani ya marekebisho ya usalama wa hali ya hewa katika ngazi ya jamii katika Pembe ya Afrika
Somali: Khariidaynta la qabsiga amniga cimilada ee heer bulsho ee Geeska Afrika

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Meru County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the April planting season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru kudhibiti minyoo mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji Aprili.

English: Notice: KTDA will train farmers in Meru County on water harvesting this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru juu ya uvunaji wa maji Mei hii.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds expectant mothers in Samburu County that access to nutrition supplementation for infants is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba upatikanaji wa nyongeza ya lishe kwa watoto wachanga ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.

English: Section 23 (1) of the Wildlife Conservation and Management Act, 2013 (as amended) establishes the Wildlife Conservation Trust Fund.
Kiswahili: Kifungu cha 23 (1) cha Sheria ya Uhifadhi na Usimamizi wa Wanyamapori, 2013 (kama ilivyorekebishwa) kinaanzisha Mfuko wa Udhamini wa Uhifadhi wa Wanyamapori.
Somali: Qaybta 23 (1) ee Xeerka Ilaalinta iyo Maareynta Duurjoogta, 2013 (sida wax looga beddelay) ayaa aasaasay Sanduuqa Kalsoonida Ilaalinta Duurjoogta.
Dholuo: Kidieny mar 23 (1) mar chik mar rito kendo rito lee mag bungu, higa mar 2013 (kaka oselok) oketo pesa ma rito lee mag bungu.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to explore new export opportunities as CS Dr Andrew Karanja meets with AMCHAM Kenya to enhance U S Kenya agricultural collaboration
Kiswahili: Wakulima na washikadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kutafuta fursa mpya za mauzo ya nje huku Waziri Dkt Andrew Karanja akikutana na AMCHAM Kenya ili kuimarisha ushirikiano wa kilimo nchini Kenya.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha ayaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay sahamiyaan fursadaha cusub ee dhoofinta maadaama CS Dr Andrew Karanja uu la kulmay AMCHAM Kenya si loo xoojiyo iskaashiga beeraha ee Mareykanka Kenya
Dholuo: Jo-Purcho gi jo ohala mag agro-go jiwo mondo onon thuolo manyien mag oro ohala kaka CS Dr Andrew Karanja romo gi AMCHAM Kenya mondo omed jiwo winjruok e kind US Kenya gi jopur

English: KALRO invites farmers in Mandera County to a free training on modern irrigation techniques this March.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji Machi hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda gobolka Mandera tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: KALRO ogwelo jopur man Mandera County e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi yore mag lero pi e dwe mar Mach.

English: E-Citizen announces improved turnaround times for e-Citizen registration in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujiandikisha kwa raia katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-Dadku ee Gobolka Nyamira.
Dholuo: E-Citizen olando lokruok e seche mag dhi e tij e-Cityzen e County mar Nyamira.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds the public in Homa Bay County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadweynaha gobolka Homa Bay in warbixinta khayaanada iibsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) paronwa ji duto e Homa Bay County ni lando miriambo mag yuto en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds the public in Tana River County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mkurugenzi Mkuu wa Ukaguzi hukumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya Tana River kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa shacabka degmada Tana River in warbixinta khayaanada iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General parone ji duto e taon mar Tana River County ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag yuto en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Public notice: KEMRI will host a free proper sanitation outreach in Uasin Gishu County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMRI itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mazingira bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: KEMRI waxay marti gelineysaa adeegyo nadaafadeed oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku habboon degmada Uasin Gishu bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar ji duto: KEMRI biro chano chenro mar rito ler mar pi e dwe mar Julai e kaunti mar Uasin Gishu.

English: Manyatta MP Mukunji urges transparent IEBC selection to safeguard election integrity
Kiswahili: Bunge la Manyatta Mukunji anataka uchaguzi wa IEBC uwe wazi ili kulinda uadilifu wa uchaguzi
Somali: Xildhibaanka Manyatta Mukunji ayaa ku booriyay doorashada IEBC ee hufan si loo ilaaliyo daacadnimada doorashada
Dholuo: MP Manyatta Mukunji jiwo yiero mar IEBC e yo maler mondo orit ratiro mar yiero

English: Announcement of launch of "ENOUGH" campaign which aims to end child hunger by expanding school meals, climate-smart agriculture, and nutrition advocacy.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la uzinduzi wa kampeni ya "INATOSHA" ambayo inalenga kukomesha njaa ya watoto kwa kupanua milo shuleni, kilimo kinachozingatia hali ya hewa, na utetezi wa lishe.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqista bilaabista ololaha "KU WANAAGSAN" kaas oo ujeedadiisu tahay in la joojiyo gaajada carruurta iyadoo la ballaarinayo cuntada dugsiga, beeraha cimilada ku habboon, iyo u doodista nafaqada.
Dholuo: Olando mar chako kampen mar "ENOUGH" ma nigi gombo mar tieko kech mar nyithindo kuom medo chiemo mag skul, pur ma rito piny, kod lando weche mag chiemo ma nigi gik ma konyo e ringruok.

English: Pest Control Products Board encourages farmers in Nyandarua County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for tea.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya chai.
Somali: Guddiga xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku dhiiri geliyaa beeraleyda gobolka Nyandarua inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo shaaha ah.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e County mar Nyandarua mondo ous chiembgi mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo chai mondo giyud nengo maber mar chai.

English: CDC reminds the public in Taita-Taveta County about the importance of tobacco control for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta juu ya umuhimu wa udhibiti wa tumbaku kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: CDC waxay dadweynaha degmada Taita-Taveta ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay xakamaynta sigaarka ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji duto e Taita-Taveta County kuom gimomiyo thieth mar madho ndawa en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: "As the county health team, we shall continue to work with partners in increasing access to COVID-19 vaccination and support this noble idea in ensuring that all segments of the population are vaccinated, including the vulnerable and marginalized persons," said Florence Aketch, Kisumu County Coordinator for the Expanded Programme on Immunization.
Kiswahili: "Kama timu ya afya ya kaunti, tutaendelea kufanya kazi na washirika katika kuongeza ufikiaji wa chanjo ya COVID-19 na kuunga mkono wazo hili zuri katika kuhakikisha kuwa makundi yote ya watu yamechanjwa, ikiwa ni pamoja na watu walio katika mazingira magumu na waliotengwa," alisema Florence Aketch, Mratibu wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kwa Mpango wa Kupanua wa Chanjo.
Somali: "Annagoo ah kooxda caafimaadka ee degmada, waxaan sii wadi doonnaa inaan la shaqeyno la-hawlgalayaasha si loo kordhiyo helitaanka tallaalka COVID-19, waxaanan taageereynaa fikraddan sharafta leh si loo hubiyo in dhammaan qaybaha dadweynaha la tallaalo, oo ay ku jiraan dadka nugul iyo kuwa la takooro," ayay tiri Florence Aketch, Isuduwaha Gobolka Kisumu ee Barnaamijka Ballaarinta ee Tallaalka.
Dholuo: Kaka duol mar thieth mar kaunti, wabiro dhi nyime tiyo kanyakla gi jowetewa e medo yudo chanjo mar COVID-19 kendo siro paro maberni e neno ni kidienje duto mag oganda oyudo chanjo, moting'o joma ochando kod joma oket oko, Florence Aketch, Jatend Kaunti mar Kisumu ne owacho.

English: Huduma Kenya invites residents of Kakamega County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kushiriki kupitia portal ya kushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Kakamega inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya gwelo jogweng' Kakamega County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county mar tiego ji e weche mag chenro mag dongruok.

English: NTSA alerts residents of Kwale County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: NTSA waxay dadka deggan degmada Kwale uga digtay kororka kiisaska burburka waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kwale County e wi medruok mar weche mag kwalo odiechienge kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: KNEC reminds parents in Nyamira County that free day secondary education registration is open this March.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba usajili wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo umefunguliwa Machi hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Nyamira in diiwaangelinta dugsiga dhexe ee bilaashka ah ay furan tahay bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: KNEC oparo ne jonyuol e County mar Nyamira ni somo mar sekondari mar odiechieng' maonge chudo osechakore e dwe mar Mach.

English: MTRH conducts its first Stereotactic Radiosurgery on brain cancer patient
Kiswahili: MTRH yafanya upasuaji wake wa kwanza wa mionzi wa stereotactic kwa mgonjwa wa saratani ya ubongo
Somali: MTRH waxay sameysay qalliinka ugu horeeya ee loo yaqaan 'Stereotactic Radiosurgery' ee bukaanka qaba kansarka maskaxda
Dholuo: MTRH timo nonro mare mokwongo mar Stereotactic Radiosurgery kuom jatuo ma nigi kansa mar obwongo

English: KICD announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Tharaka-Nithi County this January.
Kiswahili: KICD inatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya kujifunza dijitali bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Januari hii.
Somali: KICD waxay ku dhawaaqday qaybinta waxyaabaha barashada dijitaalka ah ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Tharaka-Nithi bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: KICD ong'ado mar pogo buge mag digital maonge chudo e skunde mag Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar Januar.

English: Isiolo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Isiolo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2023
Somali: Degmada Isiolo: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Isiolo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar adek higa mar 2023

English: KRA announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: KRA inatangaza nyakati bora za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Somali: KRA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Kiambu.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova (KRA) olando lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mar yudo ng'eyono e kaunti mar Kiambu.
