English: TVET urges youth in Bungoma County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: TVET inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: TVET waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Bungoma inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo rowere mag Bungoma County mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gichako timo tije mag oganda.

English: Never share OTPs._x009d_Even with 'bank staff'. Legit banks wont ask for them.
Kiswahili: Kamwe usishiriki OTP. "Hata na "wafanyikazi wa benki". benki halali hawatauliza kwa ajili yao.
Somali: Waligaa ha la wadaagin OTP-yada._x009d_Xitaa 'shaqaalaha bangiga'. Bangiyada sharciga ah ma weydiisan doonaan.
Dholuo: Okidwar ng’ado OTPs kata gi ‘jotich mag bang’. Bengi ma nigi ratiro ok bi penjogi.

English: CDC encourages residents of Siaya County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay ugu yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo jogweng' County mar Siaya mondo kik gisandre gi muol kendo mondo giluong kony mar thieth mar chuny maonge chudo.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties urges residents of Nandi County to attend the public participation forum to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Nandi ku boorinayaa inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si loo qaabeeyo habka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Nandi mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar loso bajet mar county.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds parents in Siaya County that free primary education registration is open this September.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba usajili wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo umefunguliwa Septemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya waalidiinta degmada Siaya in diiwaangelinta bilaashka ah ee waxbarashada hoose ay furan tahay bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne jonyuol e county mar Siaya ni kwan mar nyithindo ma ne dhi yudo tiegruok e pinyno ne ochakore e dwe mar ochiko.

English: The prefernce of people dying from malaria has reduced more tha its preference before the outbreak of Covid 19, WHO has confirmed Wednesday, but has appealed to expedite the fight against disease, tha caused 97,000 people to lose their life last year.
Kiswahili: Mapendeleo ya watu kufa kutokana na malaria yamepunguza zaidi upendeleo wake kabla ya kuzuka kwa Covid 19, WHO ilithibitisha Jumatano, lakini iliomba kuharakisha mapambano dhidi ya ugonjwa huo, na kusababisha watu 97,000 kupoteza maisha yao mwaka jana.
Somali: Doorashada dadka u dhimanaya malaria ayaa hoos u dhigtay doorashadeeda kahor faafitaanka COVID-19, WHO ayaa xaqiijisay Arbacadii, laakiin waxay ku baaqday in si dhakhso leh looga hortago cudurka, taas oo sababtay in 97,000 oo qof ay naftooda ku dhintaan sanadkii la soo dhaafay.
Dholuo: Dwaro mar ji tho nikech malaria osedok chien moloyo kane pok Covid 19 ochakore, WHO oseramo chieng' Tich Adek, kata kamano osekwayo ji mondo omed kedo gi tuwono, ma ne omiyo ji 97,000 olalo ngimagi e higa mokalo.

English: HELB urges youth in Bungoma County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: HELB inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: HELB waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Bungoma inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo rowere man Bungoma County mondo onon weche ma gin-go mar ndiko ji kapok gitimo tije mag sirkal.

English: Ministry of Health launches a September awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Septemba juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Sebtember oo ku saabsan wacyiga cadaadiska sare ee gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health osechako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Septemba e wi wach medo ng'eyo ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar hypertension e Homa Bay County duto.

English: New members appointed to the Board of Directors of New Kenya Co operative Creameries Limited are Ndemo Nyachae Dr Rawlynce Bett Naisula Keko and Sarah Keino effective August 6 2024
Kiswahili: Wanachama wapya walioteuliwa katika Bodi ya Wakurugenzi ya New Kenya Co operative Creameries Limited ni Ndemo Nyachae Dkt Rawlynce Bett Naisula Keko na Sarah Keino kuanzia Agosti 6 2024.
Somali: Xubnaha cusub ee loo magacaabay Guddiga Agaasimayaasha ee New Kenya Co operative Creameries Limited waa Ndemo Nyachae, Dr Rawlynce, Bett Naisula Keko, iyo Sarah Keino, laga bilaabo 6-da Agoosto, 2024
Dholuo: Jokanyo manyien moyier e Bura mar Jorich mar New Kenya Co ma tiyo kaka Creameries Limited gin Ndemo Nyachae Dr Rawlynce Bett Naisula Keko kod Sarah Keino kochakore Agost 6 2024

English: ODPP invites residents of Trans Nzoia County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: ODPP inakaribisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kushiriki kupitia portal ya kushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusu ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: ODPP gwelo ji modak e Trans Nzoia County mondo oriwre kodgi kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Vihiga County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah inta lagu jiro xilliyada dabka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji parone jogweng' mar Vihiga County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji moa e gweng'no ma jotelo mag sirkal ogolo e kinde mag yiengni.

English: Applying herbs or substances to the baby_x0092_s soft spot is dangerous and should be avoided.
Kiswahili: Kutumia mimea au vitu kwenye sehemu dhaifu ya mtoto ni hatari na inapaswa kuepukwa.
Somali: Dhir ama walxo lagu mariyo meesha jilicsan ee ilmaha_x0092_s waa khatar waana in laga fogaadaa.
Dholuo: Ka itiyo gi yath kata gik moko e kama nyathino ng’ich, mano nyalo kelo hinyruok kendo owinjore kik itim kamano.

English: Laikipia County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Laikipia: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Juni 2023
Somali: Degmada Laikipia: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Laikipia: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2023

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Samburu County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Samburu kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Samburu inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pach e county mar Samburu mondo oluong kony mar thieth mar pach maonge chudo.

English: NDMA warns residents of Nandi County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this February.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Februari hii.
Somali: NDMA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan gobolka Nandi inay u diyaar garoobaan dabka dhici kara bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: NDMA osiemo jogweng' kaunti mar Nandi mondo oikre ne yiengni manyalo timore e dwe mar Februar.

English: Your mental health care is of great meaning just lijke bodily cure. Take time and investigate yourself. 1. How does your hear feel? 2. Question, do you get enough time to rest? 3. Question, do you eat well? 4. Question, have you taken exercise in the most recent? 5. Question, Are you in need to have a conversation with a counsellor? It is good to remember that, it is great to seek for assistance when you need it. Your good mental health is of great importance to you.
Kiswahili: Huduma yako ya afya ya akili ina maana kubwa kama tiba ya mwili. Chukua muda na ujichunguze. 1. Usikivu wako unahisije? 2. Swali, unapata muda wa kutosha kupumzika? 3. Swali, unakula vizuri? 4. Swali, je, umefanya mazoezi hivi karibuni? 5. Swali, Je, unahitaji kuzungumza na mshauri nasaha? Ni vizuri kukumbuka kwamba, ni vizuri kutafuta msaada unapouhitaji. Afya yako nzuri ya akili ni muhimu sana kwako.
Somali: Daryeelkaaga caafimaadka dhimirka waa mid aad u muhiim ah oo kaliya sida daaweynta jirka. Waqti qaado oo naftaada baar. 1. Sidee dareemeysaa dhegahaaga? 2. Su'aal, ma haysataa waqti ku filan si aad u nasato? 3. Su'aasha, ma si fiican u cuntaa? 4. Su'aan, jimicsi ma qabatay ugu dambeeyay? 5. Su'aaha, ma u baahan tahay inaad la hadasho lataliye? Waa wanaagsan tahay inaad xusuusato in ay fiican tahay inaad caawimaad raadiso marka aad u baahanta
Dholuo: Penjo: Be iyudo thuolo moromo mar yueyo? 3. Penjo, be ichiemo e yo maber? 4. Penjo - be isetimoga tiegruok e kinde mokalo? 5. Penjo; Be dwarore ni iwuo gi jang'ad rieko? Ber paro ni en gima ber manyo kony sama idwaro.

English: OGP urges eligible citizens in Mandera County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Mandera kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Mandera inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro mar donjo e county mar Mandera mondo oriwgi e kwedo josiasa.

English: Notice: IPOA issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa utambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay soo saartaa digniin amniga internetka ah oo ku saabsan xadiidka aqoonsiga ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IPOA golo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity e wi kuo mar ng'ato makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Kirinyaga County.

English: Farmers are encouraged to participate in the sugarcane ethanol initiative to help lower fuel prices and boost the sugar sector
Kiswahili: Wakulima wamehimizwa kushiriki katika mpango wa ethanol ya miwa ili kusaidia kupunguza bei ya mafuta na kukuza sekta ya sukari.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay ka qayb qaataan hindisaha ethanol-ka sonkorta si loo yareeyo qiimaha shidaalka loona xoojiyo qaybta sonkorta
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar keto mar keto mar keto mar ethanol e tong' mar sukari mondo okony e dwoko piny nengo mag petrol kendo jiwo ohala mar sukari

English: COMESA announces a free anthrax vaccination exercise for cattle in Kisii County this June.
Kiswahili: COMESA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kimeta kwa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kisii Juni hii.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan antrax ee lo'da ee Gobolka Kisii bishii Juun.
Dholuo: COMESA ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar anthrax e boma mar Kisii e dwe mar Jun.

English: KICD advises applicants in Mandera County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KICD inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Mandera kutembelea kituo cha mafunzo ya ufundi kilicho karibu kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KICD waxay ku talineysaa codsadayaasha gobolka Mandera inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee la heli karo.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Mandera mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: KMTC announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Narok County this June.
Kiswahili: KMTC inatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Narok Juni hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta waxyaabaha waxbarasho ee bilaashka ah ee dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Narok bishii Juun.
Dholuo: KMTC ogolo chenro mar pogo buge mag digital maonge chudo e skunde mag Narok County e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will train farmers in Kirinyaga County on water harvesting this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga juu ya uvunaji wa maji Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa tababar siin doonta beeraleyda Gobolka Kirinyaga oo ku saabsan goosashada biyaha bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Rapar: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro tiego jopur e County mar Kirinyaga e wi choko pi e dwe mar April.

English: EACC reminds the public in Mandera County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: EACC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka gobolka Mandera in sheegashada xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid bilaash ah, ammaan ah, iyo mid qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: EACC paronwa ji duto e County mar Mandera ni chiwo ripot mar tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: Office of the Auditor-General announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mkurugenzi Mkuu wa Ukaguzi inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kuajiri kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la hagaajiyay waqtiga wareejinta adeegyada baasaboorka ee Gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General olando lokruok e seche mag tiyo gi passport e county mar Uasin Gishu.

English: DPP urges anyone experiencing abuse in Mombasa County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: DPP inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kutafuta msaada katika nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka gobolka Mombasa inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e County mar Mombasa mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges residents of Narok County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama katikati ya tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya dadka deggan degmada Narok inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaala aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ilaalinta ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo onyis riwruok mag sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e alwora mar tong'gi nikech ji osebedo ka kawo okang' mar kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Be alert in parking lots - have keys ready and check backseat before entering.
Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu katika maegesho ya magari - uwe na funguo tayari na uangalie kiti cha nyuma kabla ya kuingia.
Somali: Ka taxaddar meelaha loo dhigto baabuurta - furayaasha diyaar u dhig oo ka hubi kursiyada dambe ka hor intaadan soo gelin.
Dholuo: Bed motang' e kuonde ma idhiyee mtokni - ket kiyi kendo ikri gi kom chien kapok idonjo.

English: Communications Authority has warned of fake WiFi installers operating in residential estates. Confirm service providers through the CA licensed list
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano imeonya kuhusu wafungaji bandia wa WiFi wanaofanya kazi katika maeneo ya makazi. Thibitisha watoa huduma kupitia orodha iliyoidhinishwa ya CA
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ayaa ka digtay rakibayaasha WiFi-ga been abuurka ah ee ka shaqeeya degmooyinka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Weche Dhano osechiwo siem e wi jomisonari mag WiFi mag miriambo matiyo e udi.

English: State Department for TVET urges residents of Baringo County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kutuma maombi ya bursari hiyo kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kufaidika na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State for TVET jiwo jogweng' Baringo County mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud tiegruok mar somo gi somo mar jomoti.

English: Notice: KMTC opens applications for revision guides for learners in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay u furaysaa codsiyada hagaha dib u eegista ardayda degmada Kakamega.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC oseyawo kwayo mag somo mar somo e kaunti mar Kakamega.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response appeals to caregivers in Bomet County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the October maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Bomet kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Oktoba.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Bomet inay ilmahooda u keenaan kormeerka koritaanka iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo kwayo jorit e county mar Bomet mondo okel nyithindgi e timo nonro mar dongo kaka achiel kuom chenro mar October mar rito ngima mar mine.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds residents of Kwale County that water harvesting improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba uvunaji wa maji unaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale in goosashada biyaha ay hagaajineyso waxsoosaarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jogweng' mar Kwale County ni choko pi kelo nyak mar puodho kuom kinde malach.

English: Kitui County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kitui: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2024
Somali: Degmada Kitui: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kitui: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Septemba 2024

English: AFA urges farmers in Kajiado County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: AFA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kajiado inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyada soo-saarka biyaha ee beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e Kajiado County mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Notice from CDC: family planning counselling clinics will run every May at designated health centres in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa CDC: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Mei katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid CDC: rugta la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ayaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Maajo oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar yedhe (CDC): klinik mag chiwo paro e wi chenro mag ngima joot biro tiyo e dwe mar Mei higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e Kaunti mar Kakamega.

English: Notice: NPS issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa utambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni.
Somali: Ogaysiis: NPS waxay soo saartaa digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan dhacda aqoonsiga oo saameyn ku leh dadka deggan degmada Makueni.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NPS ogolo siem mar rito weche mag sirkal kuom wach kuo mar ng'ato makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Makueni County.

English: Universities Fund advises students in Kwale County to collect materials from the county education office to access revision guides.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kwale kukusanya vifaa kutoka kwa ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata miongozo ya marekebisho.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ardayda degmada Kwale kula talinayaa inay ka soo ururiyaan waxyaabo xafiiska waxbarashada degmada si ay u helaan hagaha dib u eegista.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund nyiso jopuonjre man Kwale County mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar tiegruok mar county mondo giyud weche ma nyalo konyogi ng'eyo weche momedore.

English: Ministry of Education urges parents and teachers in Kakamega County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi kwa watoto 116.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Kakamega inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e Kaunti mar Kakamega mondo omany namba mar kony mar nyithindo 116.

English: Import export and transit of live animals and animal products in Uganda requires authorization from the Commissioner for Animal Health Ensure compliance with disease control guidelines
Kiswahili: Kuagiza nje na kusafirisha wanyama hai na bidhaa za wanyama nchini Uganda kunahitaji idhini kutoka kwa Kamishna wa Afya ya Wanyama Hakikisha uzingatiaji wa miongozo ya kudhibiti magonjwa.
Somali: Soo dejinta, dhoofinta iyo maraakiibta xayawaanka nool iyo alaabta xayawaanka ee Uganda waxay u baahan tahay oggolaansho ka timaada Guddoomiyaha Caafimaadka Xayawaanka Hubi u hoggaansanaanta tilmaamaha xakamaynta cudurrada
Dholuo: Mondo ng'ato oter le mangima kod gik ma wuok e le e piny Uganda, nyaka omi jatelo mar weche thieth mar le thuolo mar nyiewo kod dhigo e pinje mamoko

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Meru County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Meru kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Meru inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka maskaxeed ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pachgi e county mar Meru mondo oluong kony mar thieth mar pach maonge chudo.

English: Transformative water and sanitation project brings lasting benefits to Siaya County, Kenya
Kiswahili: Mradi wa mageuzi wa maji na usafi wa mazingira huleta manufaa ya kudumu katika Kaunti ya Siaya, Kenya
Somali: Mashruuca biyaha iyo fayadhowrka ee isbeddelka leh wuxuu faa'iidooyin waara u keenayaa Degmada Siaya, Kenya
Dholuo: Chenro mar loko pi kod ler kelo ber ma nyaka chieng' e gweng' mar Siaya, Kenya

English: Notice from Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: free antenatal care clinics will run every October at designated health centres in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi: kliniki za bure za utunzaji wa ujauzito zitafanya kazi kila Oktoba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka: rugta daryeelka dhalmada ee bilaashka ah waxaa lagu qaban doonaa Oktoobar kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Rieko moa e Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: Klinike mag rito nyithindo kapok ginyuolo biro tiyo dwe mar Oktoba higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e Taita-Taveta County.

English: Kajiado County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kajiado: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Mei 2022
Somali: Degmada Kajiado: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kajiado: Oboke machon mar oro mar abich dwe mar abich 2022

English: EACC advises residents of Kisii County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: EACC inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: EACC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay qaataan dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado dib u dhac marka la raadinayo codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: EACC nyiso joma odak e County mar Kisii mondo oting'e buge duto madwarore mondo kik gikethre sama gidwaro kwayo mar bedo gi kidono.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds farmers in Busia County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia juu ya programu inayoendelea ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa wakulima.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Busia in barnaamijka tababarka beeralayda uu socdo.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jopur e county mar Busia e wi chenro mar tiego jopur ma sani dhi nyime.

English: TVET advises students in Machakos County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Machakos kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kufikia maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali.
Somali: TVET waxay ardayda Degmada Machakos kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga deeqda waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan waxyaabaha barashada dijitaalka ah ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jopuonjre e County ma Machakos mondo oketgi e intanet mondo giyud thuolo mar somo weche mag digital maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Food Security Outlook Update December 2025 - Historic low October-December rainfall drives widespread Crisis (IPC Phase 3)
Kiswahili: Mtazamo wa Usalama wa Chakula Kenya Usasishaji Desemba 2025 - Mvua ya kihistoria ya Oktoba-Desemba yasababisha Mgogoro mkubwa (IPC Awamu ya 3)
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta Aragtida Sugnaanta Cuntada Kenya Diseembar 2025 - Roobabkii Oktoobar-Diseembar ee ugu hooseeyay taariikhda ayaa sababay Xiisad baahsan (IPC Wajiga 3aad)
Dholuo: Oboke mar Rieko mar Chiemo e Kenya dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2025 - Koth matin ahinya e dwe mar apar gi apar nyaka apar gi ariyo kelo masira mang'eny (IPC Kidieny mar adek)

English: KEPHIS urges farmers in Kwale County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kwale inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e county mar Kwale mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e weche mag pur mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok e kaka koth chue.

English: HELB reminds youth in Garissa County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa upishi na mafunzo ya ukarimu.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada ku nool gobolka Garissa in maalgelinta HELD ay diyaar u tahay tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa rowere man e County mar Garissa ni pesa ma giyudo kuom HELP yudore ne tiegruok e weche mag chiemo kod rwako welo.

English: E-Citizen encourages first-time voters in Kericho County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kericho kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horeysay ee degmada Kericho inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo joma okwongo yiero e county mar Kericho mondo olim kama ichanoe ji ne IEBC.

English: KEMSA calls on parents in Taita-Taveta County to have children under five screened for cholera during the October outreach.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuwachunguza watoto chini ya miaka mitano kipindupindu wakati wa mawasiliano ya Oktoba.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta gobolka Taita-Taveta in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka kolera inta lagu jiro tallaalka Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KEMSA dwaro ni jonyuol e Taita-Taveta County otim nonro mar cholera ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Morning s3ssion.utilizing a project by world bank to expand data and digital technology in agriculture.

Kiswahili: Utambulisho wa chapa husaidia kutofautisha mboga zako Jifunze jinsi ya kuunda utambulisho rahisi wa chapa na kuuza mboga zako kwa ufanisi

English: Judiciary of Kenya announces improved turnaround times for e-Citizen registration in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujiandikisha kwa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Baringo.

Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Samburu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Desemba 2023

Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Lamu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Desemba 2022

Dholuo: Kaunti mar Lamu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar gi ariyo 2022

English: NTSA warns residents of Meru County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: NTSA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru kororka khiyaamada SIM-swap waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga leh bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar Meru County kuom wach medruok mar wuond mar SIM-swap kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar ote ma ok kare ne jatendgi.

English: New number added to printed materials
Kiswahili: Nambari mpya iliyoongezwa kwa vifaa vya kuchapisha

English: Notice: NCPB will open a maize collection centre in Kirinyaga County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mahindi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay ka furi doontaa xarun ururinta hadhuudhka ee Gobolka Kirinyaga bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NCPB biro yawo kambi mar choko cham e County mar Kirinyaga e dwe mar ochiko.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Kiambu County that access to SHA registration is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba ufikiaji wa usajili wa SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kiambu in helitaanka diiwaangelinta SHA hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa ji duto e County mar Kiambu ni sani ginyalo yudo weche mag SHA e kuonde moketi.

English: KRA urges residents of Meru County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight abuse of office.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia simu ya bure ya EACC ili kupambana na matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee EACC si looga hortago xadgudubka xilka.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Meru mondo oland weche mag mibadhi kokalo kuom simo mar EACC maonge chudo mondo giked gi timbe mag tiyo marach gi migepe.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay ka furtay xarun adeeg cusub oo lagu shaqeynayo shahaadada dhalashada ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Huduma Kenya oseyawo kama itimee tije manyien mar loso nyasi mag nyuol e gweng' mar Taita-Taveta.

English: Kenya Gazette encourages first-time voters in Kajiado County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kajiado County kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Kajiado inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.

English: Baringo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Baringo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Juni 2024
Somali: Degmada Baringo: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Baringo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar auchiel 2024

English: OGP urges residents of Baringo County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti hiyo ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja wa kaunti.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogweng' Baringo County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono ka gitiyo gi websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mar dongruok e county.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health confirms a measles outbreak alert for Nakuru County. Residents are advised to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa surua kwa Kaunti ya Nakuru. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka hargabka ee Gobolka Nakuru. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuwono e gweng' mar Nakuru. Ojiwo jogweng'no mondo kik giriwre gi pi mochido.

English: Farmers and stakeholders in the potato value chain are encouraged to familiarize themselves with the recently passed potato regulations by the National Potato Council of Kenya NPCK
Kiswahili: Wakulima na washikadau katika msururu wa thamani ya viazi wanahimizwa kujifahamisha kuhusu kanuni za viazi zilizopitishwa hivi majuzi na Baraza la Kitaifa la Viazi Kenya NPCK.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha silsiladda qiimaha baradhada waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay la bartaan xeerarka baradho ee dhawaan la ansixiyay ee ay ansixiyeen Golaha Qaranka ee Baradhada Kenya NPCK
Dholuo: Jo-Pambon kod jogo motudore gi ket mar nengo mar lewni mag loti jiwo ji mondo ong'e chike mag loti ma nyocha ochiw gi National Potato Council of Kenya NPCK

English: KALRO urges maize growers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KALRO ojiwo jopur mag kodhi e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: Notice: IPOA activates an emergency response plan for drought in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ukame katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay hirgelinaysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo abaaraha ku dhaca degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA chako tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony e kinde ma kech nobedie e county mar Siaya.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development announces a free lumpy skin disease vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Uasin Gishu County this August.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa ngozi kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Agosti hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa ku dhawaaqday jimicsi tallaal oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka maqaarka ee lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Uasin Gishu bishii Ogosto.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development olando chenro mar thiedho dhok makwayo dhok e dwe mar Agost e Uasin Gishu County.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development warns sorghum farmers in Embu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Embu kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay uga digtay beeraleyda xoolaha ee degmada Embu cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna kugula talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development osiemo jopur mag sorghum e county mar Embu kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim gik moko e kinde mowinjore.

English: NCIC trains local mediators for conflict resolution.
Kiswahili: NCIC huzoeza wasuluhishi wa ndani kwa ajili ya kutatua migogoro.
Somali: NCIC waxay tababartaa dhexdhexaadiyeyaasha maxalliga ah ee xalinta khilaafaadka.
Dholuo: NCIC tiego jomisonari e alworano e tieko ywaruok.

English: ODPP invites residents of Samburu County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandao wa kaunti kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Samburu inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: ODPP gwelo ji modak e county mar Samburu mondo oriwre gi county's online participation portal e wi chenro mar bajet mar county.

English: KTDA warns millet farmers in Migori County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Migori juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza uingiliaji kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KTDA waxay uga digtay beeraleyda millet ee degmada Migori cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: KTDA chiwo siem ne jopur mag millet e county mar Migori kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ochiwo paro mar kawo okang' mapiyo.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds farmers in Samburu County of the ongoing fertiliser application training programme.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya matumizi ya mbolea.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Samburu barnaamijka tababarka codsiga bacriminta ee socda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development oparo ne jopur manie county mar Samburu chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar tiyo gi yien.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu ku dhawaaqay taariikhda diiwaangelinta waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Laikipia.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj ogolo chenro mar somo mar pinyruoth ma onge chudo e skunde man Laikipia County.

English: Laikipia County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Laikipia: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Februari 2024
Somali: Degmada Laikipia: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Laikipia: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2024

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds farmers in Garissa County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka ka hortagga cayayaanka ayaa xasuusinaya beeraleyda degmada Garissa barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee ka dambeeya goosashada.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jopur e gweng' mar Garissa chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime bang' keyo.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya opens voter education centres in Makueni County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Makueni mwezi huu wa Novemba.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay bilaabaneysaa xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee degmada Makueni bishii November.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Huduma Kenya oseyawo kuonde tiego josiasa e kaunti mar Makueni e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit calls on parents in Mandera County to have children under five screened for typhoid during the November outreach.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuwafanya watoto chini ya miaka mitano wachunguzwe typhoid wakati wa mawasiliano ya Novemba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa ugu baaqay waalidiinta gobolka Mandera in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka tifooska inta lagu gudajiro bisha Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit okwayo jonyuol e county mar Mandera mondo otim nonro mar tuo mar typhoid ne nyithindgi ma hikgi tin ne abich e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health will hold a stress management forum in Lamu County this August. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya itafanya kongamano la kudhibiti mafadhaiko katika Kaunti ya Lamu Agosti hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa qaban doonta madasha xakamaynta stress ee degmada Lamu bisha August.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth biro timo romo mar kedo gi parruok e taon mar Lamu e dwe mar Agost.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges residents of Kiambu County to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers following a rise in reported cyclosporiasis cases.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya cyclosporiasis vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay soo sheegaan kiisas kasta oo loo maleynayo inay ku dhacaan mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska la soo sheegay ee cyclosporiasis.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Kiambu mondo onyis jorit malony e weche thieth nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuwo mar cyclosporiasis osemedore.

English: DPP calls on residents of Kisii County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DPP inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: DPP waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: DPP okwayo jogweng' Kisii mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji nitie mondo okony e loso kuwe e piny.

English: Notice: HELB reminds citizens in Taita-Taveta County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Taita-Taveta ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: HELB paronwa raia mag Taita-Taveta County e wi ratiro ma gin-go kaluwore gi chike mag sirkal.

English: Judiciary of Kenya warns public officers in Murang'a County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a dhidi ya kutumia vibaya mamlaka yao.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Murang'a inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e kaunti mar Murang'a ni kik giti marach gi migawo ma gin-go.

English: Notice: KRA will hold a public participation forum on development planning forums in Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta ee degmada Marsabit.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KRA biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag dongruok e taon mar Marsabit.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free depression awareness support is available through county health facilities in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa uhamasishaji wa unyogovu unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay wacyiga niyadjabku laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Kakamega County.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar parruok yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county man Kakamega County.

English: Notice: NDMA issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Makueni.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NDMA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag intanet kuom chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Makueni County.

English: Public notice: KEMRI will host a free proper sanitation outreach in Baringo County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMRI itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mazingira bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Baringo Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: KEMRI waxay marti gelineysaa adeegyo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan gobolka Baringo bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar ji duto: KEMRI biro timo chenro mar rito ler mar pi e taon mar Baringo e dwe mar Oktoba.

English:

English: In a visit to vaccination sites in February by the WHO Director of Immunization, Vaccines and Biologicals Dr Kate O'Brien, she said: "I note that this vaccine has generated a lot of enthusiasm and excitement in communities, and the high demand for it is bringing caregivers and children to the clinics where children can also catch up on other vaccines and child interventions for protection.
Kiswahili: Katika ziara yake katika maeneo ya chanjo mwezi Februari na Mkurugenzi wa Chanjo, Chanjo na Biolojia wa WHO, Dk Kate O'Brien, alisema: "Ninatambua kuwa chanjo hii imeleta shauku na msisimko mkubwa katika jamii, na mahitaji yake makubwa yanaleta walezi na watoto kwenye kliniki ambapo watoto wanaweza pia kupata chanjo nyingine kwa ajili ya ulinzi na watoto.

Dholuo: E limbe mane otimo kuonde mag chanjo e dwe mar ariyo gi Jatend WHO mar chanjo, chanjo kod gik ma ngima Dr Kate O'Brien, nowacho niya: "Afwenyo ni chanjo ni osekelo gombo mang'eny kod mor e alwora, kendo dwaro maduong' mar chanjo kelo jorit kod nyithindo e klinik ma nyithindo mamoko bende nyalo yudoe chanjo.

Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Laikipia: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Aprili 2023
Somali: Degmada Laikipia: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Laikipia: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar ang'wen 2023

English: Notice: KALRO will distribute certified maize seed to farmers in Mandera County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KALRO itasambaza mbegu zilizothibitishwa za mahindi kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay abuurka hadhuudhka ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda Degmada Mandera bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KALRO biro pogo kodhi mag kodhi mar kodhi ne jopur man Mandera County e dwe mar Februar.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges residents of Nyeri County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma katikati ya umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo la adeegsanayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo jogweng' Nyeri County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji ng'enyie nikech ji medo keto pachgi kuom chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne ji.

English: CDC urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Narok County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: CDC inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Narok kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: CDC waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee gobolka Narok inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e gweng' mar Narok mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges anyone experiencing abuse in Nakuru County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unashauri mtu yeyote anayeona unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kutafuta msaada katika nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya qofkasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Nakuru inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) invites residents of Isiolo County to attend the public participation forum regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Guddiga Garsoorka Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Isiolo inay ka soo qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan wadatashiyada siyaasadda guud.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) gwelo jogweng' kaunti mar Isiolo mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi weche siasa.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Kajiado County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati wa msimu huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lugta lagu maro inta lagu jiro xilliyada dhulgariirada.
Dholuo: NTSA parone jogweng' Kajiado County mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo oti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe e kinde mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: Attention farmers and agribusiness stakeholders World food prices have risen significantly as of November impacting costs for meat and vegetable oils Monitor pricing trends closely to adjust strategies
Kiswahili: Wakulima makini na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo Bei za vyakula duniani zimepanda kwa kiasi kikubwa kufikia Novemba na kuathiri gharama za mafuta ya nyama na mboga Fuatilia mwenendo wa bei kwa karibu ili kurekebisha mikakati.
Somali: Fiiro gaar ah beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha Qiimaha cuntada adduunka ayaa si weyn u koray tan iyo bishii Nofeembar taas oo saameyn ku yeelatay kharashka hilibka iyo saliidaha dhirta si dhow ula socoto isbeddellada qiimaha si loo habeeyo istaraatiijiyadaha
Dholuo: Chenro mar jopur kod joma nie weche mag ohala mag agro-go e piny mangima, nengo mag chiemo osedongo ahinya chakre Novemba, kendo mano osekelo yuto ne le gi le mag chamo cham.

English: KTDA advises farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the August planting season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Agosti.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochopo dwe mar Agost.

English: TVET urges youth in Embu County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: TVET inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Embu kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: TVET waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Embu inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo rowere e county mar Embu mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok ochopo tije mag oganda.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges residents of Kisii County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kisii mondo odonj e program mar puonjo joma dongo mondo giyud somo mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: Huduma Kenya announces improved turnaround times for e-Citizen registration in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya yatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujiandikisha kwa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku dhawaaqday waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee degmada Meru.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya olando lokruok e seche mag dhi e tij e-Citizen e county mar Meru.

English: Tune in to EduTV Channel daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM for CBC lessons.
Kiswahili: Fuatilia EduTV Channel kila siku kuanzia saa 8:00 asubuhi hadi saa 10:00 asubuhi kwa masomo ya CBC.
Somali: Dhageyso kanaalka EduTV maalin kasta 8:00 AM ilaa 10:00 AM casharrada CBC.
Dholuo: Wuo gi EduTV Channel pile ka pile chakre sa aboro okinyi nyaka sa apar okinyi mondo iyud puonj mag CBC.

English: AFA warns coffee farmers in Nandi County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: AFA inawaonya wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Nandi juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza uingiliaji kati kwa wakati.
Somali: AFA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Nandi cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: AFA chiwo siem ne jopur ma loso chai e county mar Nandi kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ochiwo paro mar kawo okang' e kinde mowinjore.

English: Notice: OGP opens the electoral calendar centres in Kitui County this April.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Kitui Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay furaysaa xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee Gobolka Kitui bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: OGP chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e County mar Kitui e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: KMTC launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC yazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay bilowday barnaamij tallaabooyin looga hortago dhibta dugsiyada degmada Murang'a.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KMTC chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe mahundu e skunde duto e County mar Murang'a.

English: Religious leaders under World Council of Churches urge governments and donor countries to increase Global Fund support, to aid sustainable responses to HIV, tuberculosis, and malaria.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa kidini chini ya Baraza la Makanisa Duniani wanahimiza serikali na nchi wafadhili kuongeza usaidizi wa Mfuko wa Dunia, ili kusaidia majibu endelevu kwa VVU, kifua kikuu, na malaria.
Somali: Hogaamiyaasha Diimaha ee Golaha Kaniisadaha Adduunka waxay dowladaha iyo dalalka deeqda bixiya ku boorinayaan inay kordhiyaan taageerada Hay'adda Global Fund, si ay u caawiyaan jawaab celinta joogtada ah ee HIV, cudurka hargabka, iyo makaraayada.
Dholuo: Jotend dinde manie bwo World Council of Churches jiwo sirkande kod pinje ma chiwo chiwo chiwo mondo omed konyo riwruok miluongo ni Global Fund e tieko tuo mar AYAKI, kahera, kod malaria.

English: Notice: SHA launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Nakuru County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Shirika la SHA linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Februari hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: SHA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa oo lagu wacyi gelinayo gobolka Nakuru bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Rapar: SHA chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Nakuru e dwe mar Februar.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds needy students in Kiambu County that school laptops under the digital literacy programme applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya maombi ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika za kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka ayaa xasuusinaya ardayda u baahan degmada Kiambu in laptop-yada dugsiga ee ku jira codsiyada barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e County mar Kiambu ni kompyuta mag skul manie program mar digital literacy program chiegni rumo.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Kakamega County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi wakati wa msimu huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega in ay guryahooda ku rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dabka daminta iyo shaqada inta lagu jiro xilliyada dhulgariirada.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogweng' Kakamega County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag nego ligek mach e utegi kendo giti e kinde mag yiengni mag lowo.
