English: Farmers are encouraged to engage in the production of palm oil sunflower and soya to reduce reliance on edible oil imports Your participation is vital for achieving self sufficiency in edible oils
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kujihusisha na uzalishaji wa alizeti na soya ili kupunguza utegemezi wa mafuta ya kula kutoka nje Ushiriki wako ni muhimu katika kufikia utoshelevu wa mafuta ya kula.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay ku hawlan yihiin soo saarista saliida qorrax-dhimista iyo soy si loo yareeyo ku tiirsanida saliida la cuno ee laga soo dhoofiyo.
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur mondo oti gi mafuta mag sunflower kod soya e loso mafuta ma inyalo chamo mondo omi okonygi yudo mafuta ma ginyalo chamo

English: Ministry of Education urges residents of Mombasa County to register their children at the nearest public school to benefit from bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu ili kufaidika na ugawaji wa bursary.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha si ay uga faa'iideystaan deeq lacageed.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Mombasa mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni kodgi mondo giyud kony mar yudo osuru.

English: NPS reminds residents of Nakuru County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada daadadka ku dhacay xilligan shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: NPS oparo ne jogweng' Nakuru County ni kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o e kinde masiche mag ndara.

English: Provide assistive devices 2020.
Kiswahili: Toa vifaa vya usaidizi 2020.
Somali: Bixinta qalabka taageerada 2020.
Dholuo: Chiw gik makonyo e higa mar 2020.

English: Pest Control Products Board warns tea farmers in Kiambu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawaonya wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Kiambu juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa uga digaya beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Kiambu cudurrada cayayaanta waxayna kugula talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok mag Pests, chiwo siem ne jopur chai e County mar Kiambu kuom masiche mag hinyruok mar tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Families are encouraged to identify emergency transport options in advance, in case labor begins unexpectedly. Delays in reaching the hospital can lead to complications.
Kiswahili: Familia zinahimizwa kutambua njia za usafiri wa dharura mapema, iwapo uchungu wa kujifungua utaanza bila kutarajia. Kuchelewa kufika hospitalini kunaweza kusababisha matatizo.
Somali: Qoysaska waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay horay u ogaadaan xulashooyinka gaadiidka xaaladaha degdegga ah, haddii dhalmada ay bilaabato si lama filaan ah.
Dholuo: Ijiwo joot mondo ong'e chon kaka ginyalo ting'o mtokni e seche mag masira, kapo ni ich chakore apoya.

English: NDMA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Nyandarua County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: NDMA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka gobolka Nyandarua inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: NDMA ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e County mar Nyandarua mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195 maonge chudo.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General launches the county integrated development plan in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu huzindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud ayaa bilaabay qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Nandi.
Dholuo: Rapar: Ofis mar Jatelo Maduong' chako chenro mar dongruok mar county integrated development e county mar Nandi.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Nakuru County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Nakuru inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag obwongo e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges residents of Machakos County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Machakos mondo oriwgi lwedo e nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'adoe bura nikech ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne ji.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will conduct a pest and disease management workshop for farmers in Embu County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itafanya warsha ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada beeraleyda ee degmada Embu bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Rapar: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro timo chokruok mar rieyo tuoche kod tuoche ne jopur e County mar Embu e dwe mar Julai.

English: CDC launches an August awareness campaign on tobacco control across Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Agosti juu ya udhibiti wa tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Somali: CDC waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Agoosto ee ka dhanka ah xakamaynta sigaarka ee degmada Kiambu.
Dholuo: CDC chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Agost e wi thieth mar ndawa e County duto mar Kiambu.

English: TSC urges parents and teachers in Tharaka-Nithi County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Somali: TSC waxay ugu baaqaysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo omany namba mar kony mar nyithindo 116.

English: KNEC invites youth in Kisii County to enroll for motor vehicle mechanics training this April.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kisii kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari Aprili hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kisii inay iska diiwaangeliyaan tababarka mashiinnada gawaarida gaadiidka bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: KNEC gwelo rowere e County mar Kisii mondo odonj e tiegruok mar jomisonari mag mtokni e dwe mar April.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges the community in Embu County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb carjacking.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Embu kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia utekaji nyara wa gari.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Embu inay ka warbixiyaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo shaki leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo afduubka gawaarida.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ji duto e county mar Embu mondo onyis polis ma machiegni ahinya ni gitimo gik ma chando mtokni.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa furaya xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya daryeel caafimaad ka dib rabshadaha Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Directorate of Criminal Investigations ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony mar thieth bang' timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Kakamega.

English: Notice: e-Citizen launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Busia County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu ya kupambana na ufisadi katika Wilaya ya Busia mwezi huu wa Septemba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: e-Citizen waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa gobolka Busia bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Rapar: e-Citizen chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Busia e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Others think, the health information should have been left to religious leaders who are better trusted.
Kiswahili: Wengine wanafikiri, taarifa za afya zilipaswa kuachiwa viongozi wa kidini ambao wanaaminika zaidi.
Somali: Kuwa kale waxay u maleynayaan, in macluumaadka caafimaadka loo dayn lahaa hoggaamiyeyaasha diinta ee si fiican loogu kalsoon yahay.
Dholuo: Jomoko paro ni, weche mag thieth ne onego owe ne jotelo mag dini ma ji nyalo yiego maber moloyo.

English: The Ministry of Health has confirmed that MPOX is severe than Corona virus
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya imethibitisha kuwa MPOX ni mbaya kuliko virusi vya Corona
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa xaqiijisay in MPOX ay ka daran tahay cudurka Corona
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oseyie ni MPOX en tuwo marach moloyo mar Corona virus

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises fish producers in Kiambu County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inashauri wazalishaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa soo-saareyaasha kalluunka ee degmada Kiambu inay ka iibsadaan wax soo saarka kaliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur ma loso rech e County mar Kiambu ni gius rech mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo rech kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public in Machakos County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba upatikanaji wa usaidizi wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Machakos in helitaanka taageerada sheegashada NHIF / SHA ay hadda ka heli karto xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji duto e County ma Machakos ni koro ginyalo yudo kony kuom kwayo mag NHIF/SHA e kuonde moketi.

English: Cumulative Satellite Detected Waters and Impact in Kenya between 24 to 28 April 2024
Kiswahili: Maji na Athari za Setilaiti Zilizogunduliwa nchini Kenya kati ya tarehe 24 hadi 28 Aprili 2024
Somali: Dayax-gacmeedka oo laga helay biyaha iyo saameynta Kenya inta u dhaxaysa 24 ilaa 28 Abriil 2024
Dholuo: Pi kod gik ma ne otimore e piny Kenya e kind tarik 24 nyaka 28 dwe mar ang'wen higa mar 2024

English: Mandera County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Mandera: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Oktoba 2023
Somali: Degmada Mandheera: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Mandera: Oboke machon mar oro mar apar higa mar 2023

English: COVID-19 is real & it is here with us. There is hope because we have four recoveries. We must therefore play our part. Stay Home. Practice Physical distancing. Wash your hands often. Cover your coughs & sneezes. Clean & disinfect surfaces. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: COVID-19 ni halisi na iko hapa pamoja nasi. Kuna matumaini kwa sababu tumepona mara nne. Kwa hiyo ni lazima tutekeleze sehemu yetu. Kaa Nyumbani. Fanya mazoezi ya umbali wa Kimwili. Osha mikono yako mara kwa mara. Funika kikohozi chako na chafya. Safisha na kuua vijidudu kwenye nyuso. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: COVID-19 waa dhab waana halkan nala joogtaa. Waxaa jirta rajo sababtoo ah waxaan haynaa afar bogsasho. Sidaa darteed waa inaan doorkeena qaadannaa. Joog Guriga. Ku celceli kala fogaanshaha jirka. Gacmahaaga si joogto ah u dhaq. Dabool qufacaaga iyo hindhisadaada. Nadiifi oo jeermis dile meelaha dushooda. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: COVID-19 en adier kendo en kanyo gi wan. Nitie geno nikech wan gi jogo ang’wen ma osechango. Omiyo nyaka watim tich marwa. Bed e ot. Praktis bedo mabor gi jowetegi. Los lweteni kinde ka kinde. Ufuko akweda kod ng’ich mari. Los kendo ketho gik ma nyalo ketho piny. #KomeshaKorona

English: Supply farm inputs, including drought-tolerant seeds, pesticides, insecticides, and fungicides, to farmers along the irrigated belt.
Kiswahili: Sambaza pembejeo za shamba, ikiwa ni pamoja na mbegu zinazostahimili ukame, dawa za kuulia wadudu, na dawa za kuvu, kwa wakulima kando ya ukanda wa umwagiliaji.
Somali: Keen alaabaha beeraha, oo ay ku jiraan abuurka u adkaysta abaaraha, sunta cayayaanka, cayayaanka, iyo fungicides, beeraleyda ku nool aagga waraabka.
Dholuo: Chiw chiemb puodho moriwo kodhi ma nyalo geng'o oro, yedhe makelo tuoche, yedhe makelo tuoche mag chwoyo le, kod yedhe makelo thowi ne jopur manie alworano.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders The Senate Committee on Agriculture recommends increased budget allocations to the Ministry of Agriculture to support the sector
Kiswahili: Wakulima na washikadau wa biashara ya kilimo Kamati ya Seneti kuhusu Kilimo inapendekeza kuongezwa kwa bajeti kwa Wizara ya Kilimo kusaidia sekta hiyo.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha Guddiga Senate ee Beeraha ayaa ku talinaya in la kordhiyo miisaaniyadda loogu qoondeeyo Wasaaradda Beeraha si loo taageero waaxda
Dholuo: Jo-Purche kod Jo-Agro-Business Jokonyo Komiti mar Senate e Weche mag Tij Lemo jiwo medo pesa ma ibiro chiw ne Ministry of Agriculture mondo okony e siro tijno

English: Urban gardening allows city dwellers to grow food. Explore techniques like container gardening and vertical growing for goats.
Kiswahili: Ulimaji wa bustani mijini huwawezesha wakazi wa mijini kulima chakula. Chunguza mbinu kama vile ulimaji wa vyombo na ulimaji wa mbuzi wima.
Somali: Beeraha magaalooyinka waxay u oggolaanayaan dadka deggan magaalooyinka inay koraan cuntada. Baro farsamooyinka sida beeraha weelka iyo koritaanka tooska ah ee orgiyada.
Dholuo: Tij loso puothe e taonde miyo ji thuolo mar pidho chiembgi.

English: Tea (Camellia sinensis) â€“ chai. Use against: fungal diseases, insects, snails (woolly aphid, squash bug, termite mounds). Preparation: the used leaves can be spread around plants to repel snails. The liquid (tea), when cool, can be sprayed on plants.
Kiswahili: Tea / Chai (Camellia sinensis). Inazuia: magonjwa ya ukungu, wadudu, konokono (wooly aphid, squash bug, mchwa). Kutayarisha: matawi ambayo yametumika yaweza kutawanywa karibu na mimea kufukuza dudu makamasi (konokono). Maji baridi yaweza kunyunyiziwa kwa mimea.
Somali: Shaah (Camellia sinensis) - chai. Loo isticmaalo: cudurada fungal, cayayaanka, snails (aphid dhogor leh, cayayaanka bocorka, tuulmooyinka termite). Diyaarinta: caleenta la isticmaalay waxaa lagu faafin karaa dhirta si looga hortago snails-ka. Dareeraha (shaaha), marka uu qaboobo, waxaa lagu buufin karaa dhirta.
Dholuo: Chai (Camellia sinensis) â€“ chai. Ti kode e lweny mar: tuoche mag fungi, okinde, ogwande (owinyo mag yier, ogonde mag squash, gode mag ogole). Yore mar loso: oboke ma otigodo inyalo yarre e alwora mag yien mondo ogol ogoyo. Gima pi (chai), ka oling' e wi yien, inyalo ng'ad e wi yien.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response appeals to caregivers in Meru County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the July maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Meru kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Julai.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Meru inay ilmahooda u keenaan kormeerka koritaanka iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo kwayo jorit e County mar Meru mondo okel nyithindgi mondo gitim nonro e wi dongruok margi kaka achiel kuom chenro mar dwe mar Julai mar weche thieth mar min.

English: Martial arts used to instill discipline and offer career paths.
Kiswahili: Sanaa za kupigana zilitumiwa kufundisha nidhamu na kutoa njia za kazi.
Somali: Farshaxanka Dagaalka waxaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu fuliyo cilmiga iyo in la bixiyo wadooyin xirfadeed.
Dholuo: Lony mag kedo ne itiyogo e puonjo ji mondo gibed gi timbe manyiso ritruok kendo mondo giyud thuolo mar tiyo ne Nyasaye.

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages residents of Migori County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan Degmada Migori inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay la xiriiraan lataliye la tababaran yahay.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Migori County mondo kik gisandre aling' ling' kendo mondo giwuo gi jang'ad rieko molony.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free tuberculosis screening is available at all public health centres in West Pokot County this September.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kifua kikuu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Septemba hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka caabuqa ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee Gobolka West Pokot bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone ji ni nonro mar thieth mar tuberculosis ma onge chudo yudore e ofise duto mag thieth e West Pokot County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges anyone experiencing abuse in Migori County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Migori kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya qofkasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Migori inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e kaunti mar Migori mondo ochiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Notice: IEBC opens a new service point for national ID applications in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Mombasa County.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay ka furaysaa barta adeegga cusub ee codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee gobolka Mombasa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag kwayo nying' mar ng'ato e gweng' mar Mombasa.

English: KEMRI reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa kurejesha matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageerada soo kabashada xadgudubka maandooriyaha ee lacag la'aanta ah ay ka heli karto xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Kwale.
Dholuo: KEMRI paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tiyo gi yedhe mamero yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Kwale.

English: KMTC reminds needy students in Kisumu County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KMTC waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Kisumu in deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay codsiyada ardayda baahan ay dhowaan dhammaadaan.
Dholuo: KMTC parone jopuonjre man gi chan e County mar Kisumu ni tuke mag somo ne jopuonjre ma nigi chan biro rumo machiegni.

English: KICD urges youth in Kajiado County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KICD inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KICD waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kajiado inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada rayidka ah ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada rayidnimada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo rowere e Kajiado County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok gichako timo tije mag oganda.

English: TVET reminds needy students in Kirinyaga County that school laptops under the digital literacy programme applications close soon.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya maombi ya programu ya kusoma na kuandika ya kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Kirinyaga in laptop-yada dugsiga ee barnaamijka codsiyada akhriska dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa jopuonjre man gi chandruok e County mar Kirinyaga ni kompyuta mag skul manie program mar somo kod somo mar digital biro rumo machiegni.

English: Notice: ODPP launches community-based development programmes in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inazindua mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay bilawday barnaamijyo horumarineed oo ku salaysan bulshada ee Gobolka Garissa.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: ODPP chako chenro mag dongruok e alwora mar Garissa County.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development announces distribution of school laptops under the digital literacy programme to schools in Vihiga County this April.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inatangaza usambazaji wa kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Aprili hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku dhawaaqay qaybinta kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Vihiga bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development olando ni gibiro pogo kompyuta mag skul e bwo chenro mar somo gi somo mar digital e skunde man Vihiga County e dwe mar April.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges sorghum growers in Baringo County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Baringo kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda sorghum ee degmada Baringo inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey roobka ka hor si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur mag sorghum e County mar Baringo mondo oti gi ratiro ma gichiwo mar pidho yien kapok koth ochue mondo omed kelo nyak e higani.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will hold a depression awareness forum in Embu County this January. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanya kongamano la uhamasishaji wa unyogovu katika Kaunti ya Embu Januari hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Hay'adda Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) waxay qabaneysaa madasha wacyiga dhimirka ee degmada Embu bishii Janaayo. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo chokruok mar chiwo paro e wi tuwo mar depression e taon mar Embu e dwe mar Januar.

English: AFA reminds farmers in Busia County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Busia barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee ka dambeeya goosashada.
Dholuo: AFA parone jopur e county mar Busia chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime bang' keyo.

English: IEBC urges residents of Baringo County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: IEBC inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuwasilisha maandishi ya maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay si loo qaabeeyo goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogweng' Baringo County mondo ochiw paro mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso chenro mag dongruok.

English: TSC conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Kitui County this September.
Kiswahili: TSC inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Kitui Septemba hii.
Somali: TSC waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan wareejinta Gobolka Kitui bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: TSC dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi wach golo pesa e gweng' mar Kitui e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Narok County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Narok: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2024
Somali: Degmada Narok: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Narok: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2024

English: Due to good weather patterns towards farming, government subsidies and ease in market entry, on agricultural inputs. Contributions in this sector...
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya hali nzuri ya hewa kuelekea kilimo, ruzuku ya serikali na urahisi wa kuingia sokoni, kwenye pembejeo za kilimo. Michango katika sekta hii...
Somali: Sababo la xiriira hababka cimilada wanaagsan ee ku habboon beeraha, taageerada dowladda iyo fududeynta gelitaanka suuqa, marka la eego alaabta beeraha. Waxqabadka qaybtaan...
Dholuo: Nikech chal mar kor lwasi ne dhi bedo maber e weche mag pur, sirkal ne dhi chiwo kony, kendo ne dhi bedo mayot donjo e ohala, ne dhi bedo mayot ne gik ma ji timo e tijno.

English: State Perspectives on Early Warning, Anticipatory Action, Emergency Response, and Social Protection in Pastoral Areas: Desk Study 2 in the Diverse Perspectives on Humanitarian Action in the Pastoral Drylands Series
Kiswahili: Mitazamo ya Serikali kuhusu Onyo la Mapema, Hatua ya Kutarajia, Mwitikio wa Dharura, na Ulinzi wa Kijamii katika Maeneo ya Kichungaji: Dawati Somo la 2 katika Mitazamo Mbalimbali ya Hatua za Kibinadamu katika Msururu wa Maeneo Kavu ya Kichungaji.
Somali: Aragtida Dowladda ee Digniinta Hore, Ficilka La Filayo, Jawaabta Degdegga ah, iyo Ilaalinta Bulshada ee Deegaannada Xoolo-dhaqatada: Daraasadda Miiska 2aad ee Aragtiyada Kala Duwan ee Ficillada Bani'aadamnimada ee Taxanaha Dhul-daaqsimeedka Xoolo-dhaqatada
Dholuo: Paro mag piny e wi ng’ado bura mapiyo, timo gik moko motelo, dwoko mapiyo, kod rito oganda e kuonde ma nigi jokwath: Nonro mar Desk 2 e paro mopogore opogore mag timo gik moko mag konyo dhano e kuonde ma jokwath othoe

English: Notice from SHA (Social Health Authority): free antenatal care clinics will run every August at designated health centres in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii): kliniki za bure za utunzaji wa ujauzito zitaendeshwa kila Agosti katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada): rugaha daryeelka dhalmada ee bilaashka ah waxaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Agoosto oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Bomet.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar SHA (Social Health Authority): ibiro ti gi klinik mag rito nyithindo kapok githo e dwe mar Agost higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e county mar Bomet.

English: Ministry of Education advises students in Busia County to register early to secure allocation to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Busia kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ardayda degmada Busia kula talineysaa inay horay u diiwaangeliyaan si ay u helaan deeq deeq waxbarasho oo loogu talagalay ardayda u baahan.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jopuonjre e county mar Busia mondo odonj e skundno chon mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo osuru ne jopuonjre mochando.

English: All church leaders under the world council of churches, have appeale to governments to provide assistance by contributing to the their account to enable them in the fight against HIV AIDS and malaria
Kiswahili: Viongozi wote wa kanisa chini ya baraza la kimataifa la makanisa, wameomba serikali kutoa msaada kwa kuchangia katika akaunti yao kuwawezesha katika vita dhidi ya UKIMWI na malaria
Somali: Dhammaan hoggaamiyeyaasha kaniisadaha ee hoos yimaada golaha caalamiga ah ee kiniisadaha, waxay ugu baaqeen dowladaha inay bixiyaan caawimaad iyagoo gacan ka geysanaya xisaabtooda si ay u awood u yeeshaan dagaalka ka dhanka ah HIV AIDS iyo malaria
Dholuo: Jotend kanise duto manie bwo bura mar kanise e piny mangima, osebedo ka kwayo sirkande mondo okonygi kuom chiwo kony ne riwruogegi mar konyo ji kedo gi tuo mar AYAKI kod malaria

English:
Mental Health Check-Up Time!Mental Health Check-Up Time!
Your mental health is just as important as your physical health. Take a moment to check in with yourself today.
1. How are you feeling emotionally?
2. Are you getting enough rest?
3. Are you eating well?
4. Have you been active lately?
5. Do you need to talk to someone?
Remember, it's okay to seek help if you need it. Your mental well-being matters!
Kiswahili: Wakati wa Kuchunguza Afya ya Akili! Wakati wa Uchunguzi wa Afya za Akili. Afya yako ya akili ni muhimu kama afya yako ya kimwili. Chukua dakika ya kuchunguza mwenyewe leo. 1. Somali: Wadashaqeynta Midowga Yurub iyo Kenya ee taageeraya hirgelinta Istaraatiijiyadda Qaranka ee la dagaalanka xagjirnimada rabshadaha.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar pinje mag Ulaya kod Kenya e siro tich mar National Strategy for Countering Violent Extremism.

English: Huduma Kenya invites residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kushiriki kupitia portal ya kushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya gwelo jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e wi chenro mag dongruok.

English: DCI urges residents of Turkana County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: DCI inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Turkana kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta deegaanka iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Turkana mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano ka ji medo keto pachgi duto e kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: For Makena, moments like this reflect the importance of reaching women wherever they are.
Kiswahili: Kwa Makena, nyakati kama hizi zinaonyesha umuhimu wa kuwafikia wanawake popote walipo.
Somali: Makena, waqtiyadan oo kale waxay muujinayaan muhiimadda ay leedahay in la gaaro haweenka meel kasta oo ay joogaan.
Dholuo: Kuom Makena, kinde ma kamago nyiso ber mar chopo mon kamoro amora ma gintie.

English: NPS reminds residents of Homa Bay County that reporting carjacking promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba kuripoti utekaji nyara mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan baabuurta la xaday ay gacan ka geystaan ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NPS paronwa jogweng' Homa Bay County ni nyiso ji mapiyo kaka ne oyak mtoka konyo rito alwora.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties advises residents of Wajir County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Wajir kula talinayaa inay qaataan dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado dib u dhac marka la raadinayo adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties nyiso jogweng' mar County mar Wajir ni giting'e buge duto madwarore mondo kik giketh seche ma gidwaro tiyo gi passport.

English: Wrap babies in warm clothes and avoid exposing them to cold air, especially in early months.
Kiswahili: Wafunge watoto nguo za joto na epuka kuwaweka kwenye hewa baridi, hasa katika miezi ya mwanzo.
Somali: Carruurta dhar kulul ku duub oo iska ilaali hawada qabow, gaar ahaan bilaha ugu horreeya.
Dholuo: Rwak nyithindo gi lewni mang'ich kendo kik iketgi e muya maliet, to ahinya wuon e dweche mokwongo.

English: TVET reminds needy students in Nandi County that free digital learning content applications close soon.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba programu za bure za maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Nandi in codsiyada barnaamijyada barashada bilaashka ah ee dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa jopuonjre man gi chan e County mar Nandi ni chenro mag somo mar digital maonge chudo chiegni rumo.

English: Media report, as of 4 May, 18 fatalities, of whom nine are in the Eastern region, three in the central region, and two each in Coast, Nairobi and Rift Valley regions.
Kiswahili: Vyombo vya habari viliripoti, kufikia tarehe 4 Mei, vifo 18, kati yao tisa viko katika eneo la Mashariki, vitatu katika eneo la kati, na viwili kila kimoja katika mikoa ya Pwani, Nairobi na Bonde la Ufa.
Somali: Warbixin ay warbaahintu soo saartay, ilaa 4tii Maajo, 18 qof ayaa ku dhintay, kuwaas oo sagaal ka mid ah ay ku dhinteen gobolka Bari, saddex ka mid ah waxay ku dhinteen gobolka dhexe, laba kalena waxay ku dhinteen gobollada Xeebta, Nairobi iyo Rift Valley.
Dholuo: Ripot mar jotudo mag mbui, nyaka tarik 4 dwe mar Mei, ji 18 otho, kuomgi 9 e ong'ere mag Wuokchieng', adek e ong'ere ma diere, to ariyo e ong'ere ka piny mar Coast, Nairobi kod Rift Valley.

English: All tea in Kenya will be sold electronically at the Mombasa Auction starting next month Organizers must prepare for inspection by ICT experts to ensure compliance with the Tea Act 2020
Kiswahili: Chai yote nchini Kenya itauzwa kielektroniki katika Mnada wa Mombasa kuanzia mwezi ujao Waandaaji lazima wajiandae kukaguliwa na wataalam wa ICT ili kuhakikisha kuwa kunafuata Sheria ya Chai 2020.
Somali: Dhammaan shaaha Kenya waxaa si elektaroonik ah loogu iibin doonaa xaraashka Mombasa oo bilaabanaya bisha soo socota. Qabanqaabiyeyaashu waa inay isu diyaariyaan kormeerka khubarada ICT si loo hubiyo u hoggaansanaanta Xeerka Shaaha 2020
Dholuo: Thayi duto e Kenya ibiro ng'iew e yor kompyuta e Mombasa Auction kochakore dwe mabiro Joriw-chano onego oikre ne nono gi joma olony e yore mag ICT mondo gine ni chik mar Tea Act 2020 oluwore

English: Machakos University graduates 2,039 students in 47th ceremony.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Machakos kinahitimu wanafunzi 2,039 katika sherehe ya 47.
Somali: Jaamacadda Machakos waxay ka qalin jebisay 2,039 arday xafladdii 47aad.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti mar Machakos tieko jopuonjre 2,039 e nyasi mar 47.

English: DCI reminds residents of Kajiado County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado in warbixinta degdegga ah ee xanta xoolaha ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: DCI oparo ne jogweng' Kajiado County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo jamni konyo rito alwora.

English: Notice: FAO will train farmers in Machakos County on agroforestry this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos juu ya kilimo cha misitu Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Machakos ku saabsan beeraha kaynta Oktoobarkan.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: FAO biro tiego jopur e gweng' mar Machakos e weche mag yiengni mag bunge e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Pest Control Products Board encourages farmers in Nakuru County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for horticultural produce.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora za mazao ya bustani.
Somali: Guddiga xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda degmada Nakuru inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan wax soo saarka beeraha.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo mabeyo mag gik mopidho e puothe mag puothe.

English: EACC encourages first-time voters in Embu County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: EACC inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Embu kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: EACC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Embu inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jogo madwaro yiero mokwongo e county mar Embu mondo ong'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges residents of Kwale County to attend the public participation forum to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay ka qaybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si loo qaabeeyo habka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo jogweng' mar Kwale County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar loso bajet mar county.

English: Operational Update: Preparing for Cyclone Hidaya in Kenya as Medical Aid Departs for 13 Countries This Week
Kiswahili: Sasisho la Utendaji: Kujitayarisha kwa Kimbunga Hidaya nchini Kenya huku Msaada wa Kimatibabu Ukiondoka kwa Nchi 13 Wiki Hii
Somali: Cusbooneysiinta Hawlgalka: Diyaargarowga Duufaanta Hidaya ee Kenya iyadoo Gargaarka Caafimaad uu Todobaadkan u ambabaxayo 13 Dal
Dholuo: Oboke mar Tich: Iiko ne yamo mapek mar Hidaya e piny Kenya ka kony mar thieth dhi e pinje 13 e juma ni

English: Facilitating knowledge sharing: A step-by-step process, February 2024
Kiswahili: Kuwezesha kushiriki maarifa: Mchakato wa hatua kwa hatua, Februari 2024
Somali: Fududeynta wadaagga aqoonta: Geeddi-socod tallaabo-tallaabo ah, Febraayo 2024
Dholuo: Konyo lando rieko: Yor timo gik moko e okang' ka okang', dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2024

English: Nyeri (Kieni) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Nyeri (Kieni): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2024
Somali: Degmada Nyeri (Kieni): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Nyeri (Kieni): Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo kuom Septemba 2024

English: NPS urges anyone experiencing abuse in Machakos County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: NPS inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Machakos piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa qofkasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Degmada Machakos inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: NPS ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e County ma Machakos mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195 maonge chudo.

English: KMTC encourages out-of-school children in Nakuru County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya ugawaji wa bursary.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Nakuru inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee loo qoondeeyay deeqaha waxbarasho.
Dholuo: KMTC jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: KRA urges residents of Trans Nzoia County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka qeybgalaan kalfadhiga guud ee golaha gobolka si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda horumarinta gobolka.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo ji duto modak e Trans Nzoia County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi chenro mag dongruok e county.

English: FAO urges tea growers in Lamu County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawahimiza wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Lamu kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee Gobolka Lamu inay si hore u xakameeyaan cayayaanka jiilaalka iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e gweng' mar Lamu mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e kinde mag koth ka gitiyo gi tuoche ma thieth oyiego mondo okony e medo nyak mar yien e higani.

English: Excessive bleeding after childbirth is life-threatening. Seek immediate emergency care.
Kiswahili: Kutokwa na damu nyingi baada ya kujifungua kunahatarisha maisha. Tafuta huduma ya dharura mara moja.
Somali: Dhiigxinta xad dhaafka ah ee dhalashada ka dib waxay khatar ku tahay nolosha.
Dholuo: Bedo gi remo mang'eny bang' nyuol nyalo miyo ng'ato otho.

English: Samburu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Samburu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Juni 2023
Somali: Degmada Samburu: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Samburu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2023

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public in Laikipia County about the importance of food safety for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuhusu umuhimu wa usalama wa chakula kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay dadka degmada Laikipia ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda badbaadada cuntada ay u leedahay caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji duto e County mar Laikipia gimomiyo rito chiemo en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: CBC sensitization forums held in all counties.
Kiswahili: Mkutano wa ufahamu wa CBC uliofanyika katika wilaya zote.
Somali: Madasha wacyi galinta ee CBC ayaa lagu qabtay dhammaan degmooyinka.
Dholuo: Chokruoge ma ne itimo e gwenge duto ne miyo ji ng'eyo weche e wi riwruok mar oganda Jehova.

English: NDMA reminds the public in Makueni County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NDMA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Makueni in ay ka feejignaadaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: NDMA oparo ne ji duto e gweng' mar Makueni mondo gibed motang' gi chenro mag chiwo siem motelo ne oganda.

English: KEPHIS urges cattle farmers in Lamu County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa Newcastle vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da ee degmada Lamu inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyagoo aan haysan rukhsad ka dib kiisaska cudurka Newcastle ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur mag jamni e County mar Lamu mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni kuonde mopogore opogore e county maok giyudo rusa bang' yudo weche mag tuo mar Newcastle.

English: NTSA warns residents of Kiambu County to prepare for possible drought this July.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kujiandaa kwa ukame unaowezekana Julai hii.
Somali: NTSA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay u diyaar garoobaan abaaraha iman kara bisha July.
Dholuo: NTSA osiemo jogweng' Kiambu County mondo oikre ne oro ma nyalo betie e dwe mar Julai.

English: Ministry of Education reminds needy students in Nyeri County that free digital learning content applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba maombi ya bure ya maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Nyeri in codsiyada barnaamijyada barashada bilaashka ah ee dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok parone jopuonjre man Nyeri County ma nigi chan ni chenro mag somo maonge chudo mag digital biro rumo machiegni.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties advises residents of Garissa County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e-Citizen.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Garissa kula talinayaa inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan diiwaangelintooda e-Citizen.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties nyiso jogweng' mar County mar Garissa mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro ndiko e-Citizen.

English: Case Study On Financing Loss And Damage - Kenya
Kiswahili: Uchunguzi Kifani Kuhusu Kufadhili Hasara na Uharibifu - Kenya
Somali: Daraasad Kiis ah oo ku saabsan Maalgelinta Khasaaraha iyo Khasaaraha - Kenya
Dholuo: Nonro mar pesa kuom ketho kod ketho - Kenya

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds the public in Murang'a County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni huru, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu dadka degmada Murang'a ku xasuusinayaa in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone ji duto manie County mar Murang'a ni golo ripot mar tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: This is the reason why you should adhere to the social and physical distance measures. #KomeshaCorona updates.
Kiswahili: Hii ndiyo sababu unapaswa kuzingatia hatua za umbali wa kijamii na kimwili. #KomeshaCorona sasisho.
Somali: Tani waa sababta aad u raacdo tallaabooyinka fogaanshaha bulshada iyo jirka. #KomeshaCorona updates.
Dholuo: Mano e momiyo onego uluw chike mag bedo mabor gi ji kod bedo mabor gi ji. Oboke mag #KomeshaKorona.

English: KEMSA encourages residents of Machakos County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' Machakos County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education opens applications for revision guides for learners in Machakos County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Machakos.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay furaysaa codsiyada hagaha dib u eegista ardayda Degmada Machakos.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Ministry of Education oyawo kwayo mag somo mondo okony jopuonjre e County ma Machakos.

English: A crackdown is ongoing against traders and transporters packaging Irish potatoes in bags exceeding 50 kg Compliance is mandatory in Nyandarua Nakuru Narok Elgeyo Marakwet Uasin Gishu Meru and West Pokot counties
Kiswahili: Msako mkali unaendelea dhidi ya wafanyabiashara na wasafirishaji wanaopakia viazi vya Ireland kwenye mifuko inayozidi kilo 50. Utiifu ni lazima katika kaunti za Nyandarua Nakuru Narok Elgeyo Marakwet Uasin Gishu Meru na Pokot Magharibi.
Somali: Cadaadis ayaa socota oo ka dhan ah ganacsatada iyo gaadiidka oo baakadaya baradhada Irish-ka ee bacaha ka badan 50 kg. U hoggaansanaanta waa khasab degmooyinka Nyandarua, Nakuru, Naro, Elgeyo, Marakwet, Uasin, Gishu, Meru iyo West Pokot
Dholuo: Tembe ma dhi nyime e kind jolok ohala kod jolos ohala ma pako potasi mag Ireland e bags mokalo kilo 50 Chik dwaro ni ng'ato oluw chike mag Nyandarua Nakuru Narok Elgeyo Marakwet Uasin Gishu Meru kod West Pokot counties

English: Research Terms of Reference: Actor and service mapping in Kakuma refugee camps, KEN 2007a, Kenya (July 2022, V1)
Kiswahili: Masharti ya Marejeleo ya Utafiti: Muigizaji na uchoraji ramani wa huduma katika kambi za wakimbizi za Kakuma, KEN 2007a, Kenya (Julai 2022, V1)
Somali: Shuruudaha Tixraaca Cilmi-baarista: Jilayaasha iyo khariidaynta adeegga xeryaha qaxootiga Kakuma, KEN 2007a, Kenya (Luulyo 2022, V1)
Dholuo: Chike mag timo nonro: Map mar jatugo kod tich e kambi mag jolweny mag Kakuma, Ken 2007a, Kenya (Abiriyo 2022, V1)

English: KMTC invites youth in Makueni County to enroll for ICT skills training this February.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Makueni kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT Februari hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Makueni inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka xirfadaha ICT bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: KMTC gwelo rowere mag Makueni County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar ICT e dwe mar Februar.

English: AFA urges farmers in Mombasa County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: AFA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Mombasa inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e county mar Mombasa mondo opidh olembe ma ok nyal geng'o lowo kethore mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will train farmers in Nyamira County on agroforestry this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhusu kilimo cha misitu Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay tababar ku siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Nyamira ee beeraha iyo kaymaha bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro tiego jopur e County mar Nyamira e weche mag agroforestry e dwe mar Februar.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit appeals to caregivers in Mandera County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the November maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuhudhuria siku iliyopangwa ya kliniki kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Novemba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Mandera inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta rugta caafimaadka ee la qorsheeyay ee bisha Nofeembar ee dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit okwayo jorit e county mar Mandera mondo odhi e klinik ma ne ochan e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Kilifi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kilifi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Februari 2023
Somali: Degmada Kilifi: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kilifi: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2023

English: The Association of Kenya Mango Traders AKMT represents local mango stakeholders and supports farmers in accessing markets Join now to enhance your participation in the mango value chain
Kiswahili: Chama cha Wafanyabiashara wa Maembe nchini Kenya AKMT kinawakilisha wadau wa eneo la maembe na kusaidia wakulima katika kufikia masoko Jiunge sasa ili kuboresha ushiriki wako katika mnyororo wa thamani wa embe.
Somali: Ururka Ganacsatada Mango-ga Kenya AKMT waxay matashaa daneeyayaasha mango-ga ee deegaanka waxayna taageertaa beeraleyda inay helaan suuqyada. Ku biir hadda si aad u xoojiso ka qaybgalkaaga silsiladda qiimaha mango-ga
Dholuo: Association of Kenya Mango Traders AKMT ochung'ne joma oketo pachgi kuom mango kendo konyo jopur e yudo ohala.

English: KTDA advises farmers in Samburu County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Samburu inay ka soo qayb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qaybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e county mar Samburu mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: INEE Guidance Note on Teacher Wellbeing in Emergency Settings: Domain 3 - Teaching and Learning, Kakuma Refugee Camp Contextualization
Kiswahili: Mwongozo wa INEE kuhusu Ustawi wa Walimu katika Mipangilio ya Dharura: Kikoa cha 3 - Kufundisha na Kujifunza, Muktadha wa Kambi ya Wakimbizi ya Kakuma.
Somali: Qoraalka Tilmaamaha INEE ee ku saabsan Fayoobida Macallimiinta ee Xaaladaha Degdegga ah: Qaybta 3 - Waxbaridda iyo Barashada, Macnaha Xerada Qaxootiga Kakuma
Dholuo: INEE Oboke mar Chik e wi Bedo Maber mar Japuonj e Kidienje mag Masira: Kidieny mar 3 - Puonjruok kod Somo, Kambi mar Jolweny mag Kakuma

English: Public notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will host a free food safety outreach in Nyandarua County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usalama wa chakula bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay martigelin doontaa adeeg bilaash ah oo ku saabsan badbaadada cuntada ee Gobolka Nyandarua bisha May.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Rango Kendo Luwo Tuwo biro timo chenro mar chiwo kony maonge chudo mar chiemo e kaunti mar Nyandarua e dwe mar abich.

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on the community in Nyeri County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqayaa bulshada degmada Nyeri inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan oo ay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service kwayo ji duto manie County mar Nyeri mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gichiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Moi referal hospital, conducted its firt surgery on brain surgey through radio stereotatic rays
Kiswahili: Moi referal hospitali, kufanyika upasuaji wake wa kwanza juu ya ubongo upasuajo kupitia redio stereotatic mionzi
Somali: Isbitaalka Moi, wuxuu sameeyay qaliinka ugu horeeya ee qalliinka maskaxda iyada oo loo marayo shaashadda raadiyaha
Dholuo: E osiptal mar Moi, ne itimo yeng'o mokwongo mar obwongo kotiyo gi radio stereo

English: AFA warns sorghum farmers in Kiambu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: AFA inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: AFA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda sorghum ee degmada Kiambu faafitaanka cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: AFA chiwo siem ne jopur mag sorghum e County mar Kiambu kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ochiwo paro mar kawo okang' mapiyo.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges residents of Vihiga County to attend the public participation forum to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay ka qaybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si loo qaabeeyo habka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Vihiga mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar loso bajet mar county.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are reminded to ensure compliance with safety and quality standards for pest control products Stay informed on regulations from the Pest Control Products Board PCPB
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanakumbushwa kuhakikisha uzingatiaji wa viwango vya usalama na ubora wa bidhaa za kudhibiti wadudu Endelea kufahamishwa kuhusu kanuni kutoka kwa Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu PCPB.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha ayaa lagu xasuusiyaa inay hubiyaan in la buuxiyo heerarka badbaadada iyo tayada ee alaabada xakameynta cayayaanka La socodsiinta ka wargalinta xeerarka ka socda Guddiga Xakameynta cayayaanka PCPB
Dholuo: Onego oparnegi jopur koda jogo motudore gi ohala mag agro mondo one ni gikonyore gi chike mag ritruok kod ber mar gik makedo gi tuoche.

English: The Kenya Injectable Free Regimens policy speaks to the rollout of a regimen for treatment of MDR-TB that is devoid of injections in line with the WHOâ€™s call to eliminate injectables from the MDR-TB treatment regimen to improve treatment outcomes. @WHOKenya @NTLDKenya
Kiswahili: Sera ya Kenya Sindano Bure Regimens inazungumzia kuanzishwa kwa regimen ya matibabu ya MDR-TB ambayo haina sindano kulingana na wito wa WHO wa kuondoa sindano kutoka kwa regimen ya matibabu ya MDR-TB ili kuboresha matokeo ya matibabu. @WHOKenya @NTLDKenya
Somali: Siyaasadda Kenya Injectable Free Regimens waxay ka hadlaysaa soo saarista nidaam lagu daaweynayo MDR-TB kaas oo aan lahayn irbado iyadoo la raacayo baaqa WHO ee ah in laga saaro irbadaha lagu duro nidaamka daaweynta MDR-TB si loo hagaajiyo natiijooyinka daaweynta. @WHOKenya @NTLDKenya

English: Public health advisory: KEMSA warns of increased typhoid risk in Narok County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMSA inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya matumbo katika Kaunti ya Narok na inashauri umma kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Talo-bixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: KEMSA waxay ka digtay khatarta sii kordheysa ee cudurka 'typhoid' ee Gobolka Narok waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar oganda: KEMSA chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar typhoid e kaunti mar Narok kendo ojiwo ji mondo oti gi net mag kute ma otigo gi yedhe makelo tuoche.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will distribute certified tea seed to farmers in Kisii County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itasambaza mbegu za chai zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay abuurka shahaadada leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Kisii bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Rieko: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro pogo kodhi mag chai ne jopur e County mar Kisii e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: PSA about the weather. Good animal husbandy.
Kiswahili: PSA kuhusu hali ya hewa.
Somali: Warbixin ku saabsan cimilada, xoolaha wanaagsan.
Dholuo: Wuoyo e wi chal mar kor lwasi, rito le maber.

English: Public health advisory: Kenya Red Cross warns of increased dengue fever risk in Bomet County and advises the public to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya homa ya dengue katika Kaunti ya Bomet na kushauri umma kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa.
Somali: Talo-bixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ka digeysaa khatarta sii kordheysa ee hargabka dengue ee Gobolka Bomet waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo.
Dholuo: Chenro mar thieth mar ji: Kenya Red Cross chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuwo mar dengue e county mar Bomet kendo ojiwo ji duto mondo otiek dose duto mag thieth.

English: Kenya Medical Association appeals to caregivers in Bungoma County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the December maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Desemba.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ka codsadaa daryeelayaasha degmada Bungoma inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka ee Diseembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association okwayo jorit e County mar Bungoma mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Huduma Kenya urges eligible citizens in Laikipia County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inahimiza wananchi wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Laikipia inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro mar donjo e county mar Laikipia mondo oriwgi e ndiko joma oyiero.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development encourages out-of-school children in West Pokot County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Ukuzaji wa Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza watoto wasio shuleni katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee horumarinta manhajka wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada West Pokot inay dalbadaan deeq waxbarasho kahor waqtiga ugu dambeeya ee barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e West Pokot County mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo kaluwore gi chenro mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Taita-Taveta County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Rapar: Kenya Gazette chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e Taita-Taveta County e dwe mar Februar.

English: Pest Control Products Board announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for pigs in Kisumu County this March.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Machi hii.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa ku dhawaaqaya jimicsi tallaal oo bilaash ah oo cudurka Newcastle ee doofaarka ee Gobolka Kisumu bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok mar Pest Owacho ni ibiro tim kampen mar golo tuoche mag Newcastle ne le e dwe mar Mach e gweng' mar Kisumu.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Kiambu County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati huu wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada daadadka ka dhacay xilligan shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross parone ji duto modak Kiambu County ni kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o e kinde masiche mag ndara.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges anyone experiencing abuse in Nyandarua County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kutafuta msaada katika nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Nyandarua inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee aaminka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e County mar Nyandarua mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) urges maize growers in Trans Nzoia County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawataka wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Trans Nzoia inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si loo wanaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur ma pidho cham e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo oti gi kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo okony e medo nyak mar cham e higani.

English: Republic of Korea rice donation provides critical boost to WFP's emergency response for refugees in Kenya | World Food Programme
Kiswahili: Mchango wa mchele wa Jamhuri ya Korea unatoa msukumo muhimu kwa mwitikio wa dharura wa WFP kwa wakimbizi nchini Kenya | Mpango wa Chakula Duniani
Somali: Deeqda bariiska ee Jamhuuriyadda Kuuriya ayaa si weyn u kordhinaysa waxqabadka degdegga ah ee WFP ee qaxootiga ku nool Kenya | Barnaamijka Cuntada Adduunka
Dholuo: <2Zepa> Chiwo mar mzabibu ma piny Korea chiwo miyo kony maduong’ ahinya e dwoko ma WFP chiwo mapiyo ne jolweny ma ni Kenya | Chenro mar Chiemo mar Piny

English: IPOA reminds residents of Murang'a County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah xilliyada dhulgariirada.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogweng'o mag County mar Murang'a mondo oluw chike mag golo ji moa e gweng'no e kinde mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: Governor Joho has constructed mobile toilets for pedesterians in Mombasa
Kiswahili: Gavana Joho amejenga vyoo vya kuogelea kwa watoto wa miguu huko Mombasa
Somali: Guddoomiye Joho ayaa dhisay musqusha dhaqdhaqaaqa ee dadka socotada ah ee Mombasa
Dholuo: Jaloch Joho oseloso kuonde tedo moting'o piende ne jowuoth e Mombasa

English: Notice: KNEC opens a new electrical installation programme at the vocational centre in Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inafungua programu mpya ya ufungaji wa umeme katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo lagu rakibo korontada xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Kiambu.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KNEC ochako chenro manyien mar keto sitima e kambi mar tiegruok e gweng' mar Kiambu.

English: As pertains market access, targetting harvests, production techniques and getting loans is slim, something that deter youths inclusivity. .
Kiswahili: Kuhusu upatikanaji wa soko, kulenga mavuno, mbinu za uzalishaji na kupata mikopo ni ndogo, jambo ambalo linazuia vijana ujumuishaji. .

Dholuo: E weche mag yudo ohala, choko olemo, yore mag loso olemo kod yudo ohala, ok yot, kendo mano miyo rowere ok nyal riwo lwedo ohala.

English: This time, all convicted and remanded people will not appear court
Kiswahili: Wakati huu, watu wote waliohukumiwa na waliowekwa kizuizini hawatasimama mahakamani

English: E-Citizen reminds voters in West Pokot County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya kujiandikisha.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha gobolka West Pokot in ay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor diiwaangelinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa jotelo e West Pokot County mondo onyisgi weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom SMS ne 70000 kapok gidonjo e register mar jotelo.

English: Overall, the WHO Kenya 10-day and follow-up support raised vaccination numbers by an estimate 300,000.
Kiswahili: Kwa jumla, usaidizi wa WHO Kenya wa siku 10 na ufuatiliaji uliongeza idadi ya chanjo kwa makadirio 300,000.
Somali: Guud ahaan, taageerada WHO ee 10-ka maalmood ah iyo dabagalka ee Kenya waxay kordhisay tirada tallaalka iyadoo lagu qiyaasay 300,000.
Dholuo: Kuom duto, kony ma ne omiye gi WHO kuom ndalo 10 kod luwo bang’e, ne omiyo kwan mar jogo ma ne omiye chanjo omedore gi kwan mar 300,000.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education reminds citizens in Narok County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Narok kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka Narok waxay muwaadiniinta ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda gobolka.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Puonjruok ma Chakre e Piny owacho parone raia mag Narok County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo gi ji duto e bajet mar county.

English: Kenya Dairy Board promotes conservation tillage among farmers in Bomet County as part of the June climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inakuza kilimo cha uhifadhi kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Juni.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa beerashada ilaalinta beeraleyda degmada Bomet iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Juun.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo puodho mar ritruok e kind jopur e county mar Bomet kaka achiel kuom chenro mar dwe mar Jun mar kedo gi lokruok e kor lwasi.

English: Ministry of Education reminds youth in Mandera County that HELB funding is available for welding and fabrication training.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Mandera in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education oparo ne rowere man Mandera County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mag welding kod manufacturing.

English: Ministry of Health hosts forum with media partners to promote breastfeeding benefits for working parents.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya huandaa jukwaa na washirika wa vyombo vya habari ili kutangaza faida za kunyonyesha kwa wazazi wanaofanya kazi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa martigelinaysa madal ay la wadaagaan warbaahinta si loo dhiirrigeliyo faa'iidooyinka naas nuujinta ee waalidiinta shaqeeya.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar piny owacho timo chokruok gi jowuoth matiyo gi weche midhiero mondo okony jonyuolgo yudo kony kuom pidho nyithindo gi minegi.

English: WHO approves second malaria jab for children, to cost as low as Sh300
Kiswahili: WHO yaidhinisha chanjo ya pili ya malaria kwa watoto, kuwa na gharama ya chini ya Sh300
Somali: WHO waxay oggolaatay tallaalka labaad ee daaweynta malaria ee carruurta, oo qiimihiisu noqon doono ilaa Sh300
Dholuo: WHO oyie gi thieth mar ariyo mar malaria ne nyithindo, ma biro chulo siling' 300

English: Universities Fund reminds parents in Kitui County that bursary allocation registration is open this January.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba usajili wa ugawaji wa bursari umefunguliwa Januari hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xusuusinayaa waalidiinta degmada Kitui in diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ay furan tahay bisha Janaayo.
