English: OGP reminds residents of Kisii County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: OGP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: OGP parone jogweng' Kisii County ni luwo dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Notice: COMESA will distribute certified beans seed to farmers in Garissa County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itasambaza mbegu za maharagwe zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay abuuraha gobolka Garissa u qaybin doontaa abuurka xoolaha ee la caddeeyay bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA biro pogo kodhi mag nyinyo ne jopur e gweng' mar Garissa e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: NTSA warns residents of Lamu County to prepare for possible flooding this August.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kujiandaa kwa mafuriko yanayoweza kutokea Agosti hii.
Somali: NTSA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu inay isu diyaariyaan fatahaadaha suurtagalka ah bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: NTSA osiemo jogweng' Lamu County mondo oikre ne koth maduong' ma biro timore e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: COMESA will train farmers in Siaya County on conservation tillage this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Siaya juu ya kilimo cha uhifadhi Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Siaya ee ku saabsan beerashada ilaalinta Oktoobarkan.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: COMESA biro tiego jopur e county mar Siaya e weche mag pidho puothe e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: KNEC launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KNEC yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay bilawday barnaamij ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada iskuulada ee degmada Mandera.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KNEC chako chenro mar rito nyithindo e skul e skunde duto man Mandera County.

English: KTDA reminds farmers in Nyeri County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Somali: KTDA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyeri barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee ka dambeeya goosashada.
Dholuo: KTDA parone jopur e County mar Nyeri chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime bang' keyo.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) warns public officers in Nyamira County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Nyamira dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Nyamira khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Nyamira kuom timbe mag wuondruok.

English: KALRO invites farmers in Homa Bay County to a free training on fertiliser application this August.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya matumizi ya mbolea Agosti hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda gobolka Homa Bay tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan isticmaalka bacriminta bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: KALRO ogwelo jopur e Homa Bay County e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi tiyo gi yien e dwe mar Agost.

English: HELB encourages residents of Turkana County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya ugatuzi.
Somali: HELB waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabtaan wareejinta.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo ji modak e County mar Turkana mondo onon weche duto motudore gi ndiko joma oyiero mondo ging'e weche ma biro timore bang'e.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Kajiado County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kajiado juu ya umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMSA waxay dadka degmada Kajiado ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay nadaafadda saxda ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone ji duto e Kajiado County kuom ber mar rito ler mar ngima e ot.

Kiswahili: Sasisho la Hali ya Kenya | Aprili 2023: Kuongezeka kwa Matatizo Huku Upinzani Unapofanya Maandamano Makubwa

English: Office of the Auditor-General warns public officers in Tharaka-Nithi County against abuse of office.

Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e Tharaka-Nithi County ni kik giti marach gi migepegi.

Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya West Pokot juu ya kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: NPS waxay ka digeysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot oo ku saabsan kororka qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga leh bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: NPS osiemo jogweng' mar West Pokot County kuom medruok mar chenro mag gwelo pesa mag miriambo kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar weche ma ok kare ne jatendgi.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will distribute certified sorghum seed to farmers in Machakos County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu abuuraha Degmada Machakos u qaybin doonaa abuurka sorghum ee la caddeeyay bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro pogo kodhi mag sorghum ne jopur e County ma Machakos e dwe mar Agost.

English: E-Citizen urges eligible citizens in Garissa County to participate in voter education.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wananchi wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Garissa kushiriki katika elimu ya wapiga kura.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Garissa inay ka qaybqaataan waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free suicide prevention support is available through county health facilities in Embu County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kuzuia kujiua unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo ka hortagga ismiidaaminta laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Embu County.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar geng'o ji kik nege yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Embu.

Kiswahili: Orodha ya utendaji wa kila siku ili kuboresha afya ya akili
Somali: Liiska waxqabadyada maalinlaha ah si loo hagaajiyo caafimaadka maskaxda
Dholuo: Chenro mar timo gik moko pile ka pile mondo okony ng'ato obed gi paro mowinjore

English: NTSA urges the public in Taita-Taveta County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: NTSA inahimiza umma katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha degmada Taita-Taveta inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo ji duto manie Taita-Taveta County mondo ong'e kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma osefweny kuom wuond mag SIM-swap.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri katika shule kote Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay bilawday barnaamij adeegyo hagis iyo la-talin ah oo lagu sameeyo dugsiyada gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Education chako chenro mar tayo kendo chiwo paro e skunde duto mag Nyandarua County.

English: Universities Fund urges youth in Busia County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Busia kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku boorinayaa dhalinyarada degmada Busia inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada rayidka ah ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada rayidnimada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo rowere e county mar Busia mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok gichako timo tije mag oganda.

English: Notice: DCI conducts a community briefing on community early-warning systems in Mandera County this January.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Mandera Januari hii.

Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DCI timo romo mar chiwo siem ne ji e wi chenro mag chiwo siem chon e taon mar Mandera e dwe mar Januar.

English: NCPB urges rice growers in Isiolo County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda bariiska ee degmada Isiolo inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo miraha ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur loso opur e kaunti mar Isiolo mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

We are advising members of the public to put on masks when getting into a matatu one is advised to put on a mask.

Kiswahili: Tunawashauri watu wajivae kinyago wakati wa kuingia kwenye matatu.

Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu za chai zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River Juni hii.

Kiswahili: Kupitia Ghala lake Kuu la Data, nchi sasa inaunganisha ufuatiliaji wa AMR, matumizi ya dawa za kuua viini na data ya matumizi ya antimicrobial, ikitoa picha ya kina zaidi ya mifumo ya kitaifa ya AMR.

English: KEMSA appeals to caregivers in Busia County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the April maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Busia kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Aprili.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Busia inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta bukaanka ee la qorsheeyay iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Abriil.
Dholuo: KEMSA okwayo jorit e county mar Busia mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar thieth ma ne otim e dwe mar April.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Laikipia County that access to eye and dental camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kwamba ufikiaji wa kambi za macho na meno sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Laikipia in helitaanka xeryaha indhaha iyo ilkaha ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone ji duto e County mar Laikipia ni koro ginyalo dhi e kambi mag thieth mag wang' kod lakteche mag laktech.

English: Notice: SHA launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Nyamira County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Shirika la SHA linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Januari hii.

Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Ujumbe Muhimu wa Kenya Mei 2024: Athari mbalimbali za mvua katika maeneo ya ufugaji na upandaji mazao huku mvua ndefu inapoisha.
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta Fariinta Muhiimka ah ee Kenya Maajo 2024: Roobab kala duwan ayaa saameeyay goobaha xoolo-dhaqatada iyo beeraha iyadoo roobabka dhaadheer ay dhammaadaan
Dholuo: Oda Maduong’ mar Kenya Mei 2024: Bedo gi pek mopogore opogore mag koth e kuonde mag le kod cham kaka koth mabor chopo e giko

English: Climate Risk Perception and Adoption of Sustainable Agricultural Practices: Insights from Kenyaâ€™s Central Highlands (December 2025)
Kiswahili: Mtazamo wa Hatari ya Hali ya Hewa na Kupitishwa kwa Mbinu Endelevu za Kilimo: Maarifa kutoka Nyanda za Juu za Kenya (Desemba 2025)
Somali: Aragtida Khatarta Cimilada iyo Qaadashada Dhaqamada Beeraha ee Waara: Aragtiyo laga helay Buuraha Dhexe ee Kenya (Diseembar 2025)
Dholuo: Kuong'ruok mar Risiko mar Piny kod Kawo yore mag Pur ma nyalo siko: Fwenyo kowuok e got madongo mag piny Kenya (Desemba 2025)

English: DCI reminds the public in Wajir County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: DCI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Wajir inay ka feejignaadaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: DCI paronwa ji duto e gweng' mar Wajir ni gibed motang' gi chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: Notice: AFA restricts movement of poultry in Bomet County due to an anthrax outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA inazuia harakati za kuku katika Kaunti ya Bomet kwa sababu ya mlipuko wa kimeta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa digaagga gobolka Bomet sababo la xiriira cudurka anthrax.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: AFA ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok e County mar Bomet nikech tuwo mar anthrax.

English: Kenya Dairy Board promotes water harvesting among farmers in Mandera County as part of the March climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inakuza uvunaji wa maji miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Machi.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa goosashada biyaha beeraleyda gobolka Mandera iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo choko pi e kind jopur man Mandera County kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo kinda mar geng'o lokruok e kit yamo e dwe mar Mach.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds residents of Trans Nzoia County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba kufikia usajili wa e-Citizen sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia in helitaanka diiwaangelin e-muwaadin ah ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties parone jogweng'o mag Trans Nzoia County ni koro ginyalo yudo e e-Citizen registration kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Nandi County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nandi in ay guryahooda ku rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo shaqada inta lagu jiro xilliyada dabka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji parone jogweng' kaunti mar Nandi mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo giti e kinde mag yiengni.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Kajiado County.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu soo saaray digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Kajiado.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Forest Service ogolo siem mar sirkal e wi weche mag cybersecurity e wi chenro mag gwelo pesa mag miriambo makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Kajiado County.

English: KALRO warns rice farmers in Nakuru County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaonya wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Nakuru juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza uingiliaji kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KALRO waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda bariiska ee degmada Nakuru cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: KALRO chiwo siem ne jopur loso kodhi e gweng' mar Nakuru kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises tea producers in Nyeri County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inashauri wazalishaji wa chai katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha shaaha ee degmada Nyeri inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nyiso jopur ma loso chai e county mar Nyeri mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur ka pok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Notice: KALRO will distribute certified millet seed to farmers in Wajir County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay abuuraha degmada Wajir u qaybin doontaa abuurka miraha ee la caddeeyay bishii Luulyo ee sannadkan.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KALRO biro pogo kodhi mag millet ne jopur e gweng' mar Wajir e dwe mar Julai.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public in Nakuru County about the importance of tobacco control for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nakuru juu ya umuhimu wa udhibiti wa tumbaku kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Waaxda Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay dadka degmada Nakuru xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay xakamaynta sigaarka ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo Tuoche parone ji duto e gweng' mar Nakuru kuom gimomiyo thieth mar madho ndawa en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on the community in Bungoma County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwa ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa bulshada degmada Bungoma ugu baaqay inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan oo ay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oluongo oganda man Bungoma County mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo ochiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Kenya Medical Association launches a July awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kizindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Julai juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Kajiado.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu bilaabay olole wacyi galineed bishii July oo ku saabsan baaritaanka sonkorowga gobolka Kajiado.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Julai e wi nonro mar thieth mar sukari e Kajiado County duto.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds livestock keepers in Narok County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Narok kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee Gobolka Narok inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha ka guuraan xadka gobolka iyada oo aan la helin rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jopur mag jamni e Narok County ni kik giwuoth gi jamni ka ok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: IPOA urges motorists and pedestrians in Kilifi County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Kilifi inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada daadadku ka da'ay si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo jowuoth kod joma wuotho e ndara e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o mondo kik gitim aksident mag ndara.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Kilifi County that reporting carjacking promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kwamba kuripoti utekaji nyara mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan baabuurta la xaday ay gacan ka geystaan ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne jogweng' Kilifi County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo mtoka konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Public health advisory: KEMRI warns of increased HIV/AIDS risk in Nakuru County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMRI inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya VVU/UKIMWI katika Kaunti ya Nakuru na inashauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Talobixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: KEMRI waxay ka digeysaa kororka halista HIV / AIDS ee Gobolka Nakuru waxayna ku talineysaa dadweynaha inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga ah mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: KEMRI chiwo siem e wi medruok mar AYAKI/AIDS e County mar Nakuru kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore e thieth.

English: Notice: Council of Governors will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana litafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Kitui.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha waxay qaban doonaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee Gobolka Kitui.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Bura mar Jaloch biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e gweng' mar Kitui.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) announces eye and dental camps for residents of Trans Nzoia County starting this October.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatangaza kambi za macho na meno kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuanzia Oktoba hii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa ku dhawaaqaya xeryaha indhaha iyo ilkaha ee dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia laga bilaabo Oktoobarkan.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) ogolo kambi mag thieth mag wang' kod lak mag lak mag jood Trans Nzoia County kochakore Oktoba.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Kakamega County to attend the public participation forum to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kakamega inay ka qayb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si loo qaabeeyo dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya ojiwo jogweng' Kakamega County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar timo nonro mar tich higa ka higa.

English: AFA urges dairy cows farmers in Isiolo County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: AFA inawataka wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa Newcastle vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Isiolo inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyada oo aan la helin ruqsad ka dib kiisaska cudurka Newcastle ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur mag dhok ma loso dhok e kaunti mar Isiolo mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni e gweng'no maok giyudo rusa bang' yudo kit tuoche mag Newcastle.

English: HELB urges residents of Meru County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa watu wazima ili kufaidika na mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: HELB waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay ku biiraan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan barnaamijyada quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Meru mondo odonj e program mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo mondo giyud konyruok kuom program mar chiemo e skul.

English: The RTS,S/AS01 (RTS,S) malaria vaccine is the first vaccine recommended to prevent malaria in children.
Kiswahili: Chanjo ya malaria ya RTS,S/AS01 (RTS,S) ni chanjo ya kwanza inayopendekezwa kuzuia malaria kwa watoto.
Somali: Tallaalka duumada ee RTS,S/AS01 (RTS,S) waa tallaalkii ugu horreeyay ee lagu taliyay in looga hortago duumada carruurta.
Dholuo: Chanjo mar maleria mar RTS,S/AS01 (RTS,S) en chanjo mokwongo ma ji ogolo paro mar geng’o maleria kuom nyithindo.

English: CDC advises residents of Marsabit County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: CDC inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma ya afya ya ruzuku.
Somali: CDC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inay qaataan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo jogweng' mar Marsabit County mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi ka gidwaro thieth mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: KEPHIS reminds livestock keepers in Marsabit County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa za kuponda ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xayawaanka ah ee degmada Marsabit inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KEPHIS paronwa jopur mag jamni e gweng' mar Marsabit mondo opidhgi gi tuoche e kuonde moyier mag nego jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: TSC encourages out-of-school children in Turkana County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Turkana kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: TSC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Turkana inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo nyithindo maok dhi e skul e county mar Turkana mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Huduma Kenya updates residents of Kisii County on progress of the county integrated development plan this September.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja ya kaunti hii mwezi Septemba.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay dadka deggan degmada Kisii ku wargelineysaa horumarka qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya osemiyo jogweng' mar Kisii ong'eyo dongruok mar chenro mar dongruok mar county e dwe mar Septemba.

English: HELB encourages residents of Mombasa County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya ugatuzi.
Somali: HELB waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha degmada si ay uga warqabaan wareejinta.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jogweng' county mar Mombasa mondo oriwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county mondo gibed molony e weche mag golo pesa.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges motorists and pedestrians in Homa Bay County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawataka madereva wa magari na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee gobolka Homa Bay inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo joidh mtokni kod joma wuotho gi tiendegi e Homa Bay County mondo oluw chike ma sirkande mag pinyno ogolo mar golo ji mondo kik pi opong'gi.

English: TVET urges youth in Nairobi County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: TVET inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: TVET waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nairobi inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo rowere man Nairobi County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok ochopo tije mag oganda.

English: KUCCPS opens final course change window Ã¢Â€Â“ switch degree before servers crash!
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inafungua dirisha la mwisho la kubadilisha kozi Ã¢Â€Â“ shahada ya kubadili kabla ya seva kuanguka!
Somali: KUCCPS waxay furaysaa daaqadda ugu dambeysa ee beddelka koorsada - beddelka shahaadada ka hor inta aysan server-yadu dhicin!
Dholuo: KUCCPS oyawo dirisa mogik mar loko kos Ã¢Â€Â“ loko digri kapok sava okethore!

English: Huduma Kenya reminds the public in Vihiga County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this April.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba maoni juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka yanakaribishwa Aprili hii.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Vihiga in talooyinka dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya oparo ne ji duto e County mar Vihiga ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e dwe mar April.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) warns public officers in Kiambu County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Kiambu khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e County mar Kiambu kuom timbe mag mibadhi.

English: Notice: SHA opens a new service point for national ID applications in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: SHA inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Shirkadda SHA waxay ka fureysaa barta adeegga cusub ee codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: SHA oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag kwayo nying' mar ng'ato e gweng' mar Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: HELB reminds youth in Trans Nzoia County that HELB funding is available for welding and fabrication training.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa dhallinyarada degmada Trans Nzoia in maalgelinta HELD ay diyaar u tahay tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa rowere manie gweng' mar Trans Nzoia ni pesa ma giyudo kuom riwruokno konyo e tiego rowere e weche mag welding kod manufacturing.

English: Human Appeal issues red alert for aid to Horn of Africa - Catastrophic famine conditions leading to one death every 48 seconds in Somalia and Kenya
Kiswahili: Rufaa ya Kibinadamu yatoa tahadhari nyekundu ya msaada kwa Pembe ya Afrika - Hali mbaya ya njaa na kusababisha kifo cha mtu mmoja kila baada ya sekunde 48 nchini Somalia na Kenya
Somali: Human Appeal ayaa soo saartay digniin cas oo loogu talagalay gargaar loo fidiyo Geeska Afrika - Xaalado macluul oo halis ah oo horseedaya hal dhimasho 48 ilbiriqsi kasta oo ka dhacda Soomaaliya iyo Kenya.
Dholuo: Od bura mar dhano ogolo siem marachar mar yudo kony e Tung' mar Afrika - Kido mar kech marach kelo tho achiel bang' sekon 48 e piny Somalia kod Kenya

English: SHA urges residents of Siaya County to attend the public participation forum to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: SHA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si ay u qaabeeyaan wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynta.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Siaya mondo odhi e chokruok mitimo gi ji mondo okony e loso chenro mag chenro mag oganda.

English: Kenya | Joint Market Monitoring Initiative (JMMI) Market Overview, Q4 (October - December, 2024)
Kiswahili: Kenya | Muhtasari wa Soko wa Mpango wa Pamoja wa Ufuatiliaji wa Soko (JMMI), Q4 (Oktoba - Desemba, 2024)
Somali: Kenya | Guudmarka Suuqa ee Hindisaha La-socodka Suuqa Wadajirka ah (JMMI), Q4 (Oktoobar - Diseembar, 2024)
Dholuo: Kenya | Chenro mar Luoro Soro Riwre (JMMI) Neno Maduong' mar Soro, Q4 (Apar - Desimba, 2024)

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Dowladda waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta dugsiyada dugsiga sare ee maalin bilaash ah ee degmada Nairobi.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Puonjruok ma Chakre e Piny owacho ogolo chenro mar somo sekondari e skunde man Nairobi County.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) launches the county integrated development plan in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika Wilaya ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Garsoorka Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu bilaabay qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Migori.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chako chenro mar dongruok mar county integrated development e county mar Migori.

English: NDMA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in West Pokot County that access to psychosocial support is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisaikolojia unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada West Pokot in helitaanka taageerada cilmu-nafsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag nindruok e West Pokot County ni ginyalo yudo kony mar paro maonge chudo.

English: Communications Authority has warned of fake WiFi installers operating in residential estates. Confirm service providers through the CA licensed list
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano imetoa onyo dhidi ya watengenezaji wa WiFi bandia wanaofanya kazi katika mali za makazi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ayaa ka digtay rakibayaasha WiFi-ga been abuurka ah ee ka shaqeeya degmooyinka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Weche Dhano osechiwo siem e wi jomisonari mag WiFi mag miriambo matiyo e udi.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds mobile money users in Kiambu County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka kashfa za fedha za simu.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kiambu inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarkooda M-Pesa qofna si looga fogaado khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e County mar Kiambu ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo kik gitim timbe mag wuondo pesa mag simu.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development calls on the community in Laikipia County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka ayaa ugu baaqay bulshada degmada Laikipia inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116 si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyada.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oluongo oganda man Laikipia County mondo omany namba 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo orit ngima skul.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Trans Nzoia County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the February planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Udhibiti wa Pest Products inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kupitisha aina zilizothibitishwa za mbegu zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Februari.
Somali: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Febraayo.
Dholuo: Pest Control Products Board jiwo jopur e Trans Nzoia County mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro ka pok ochopo ndalo mag pidho kodhi e dwe mar Februar.

English: IPOA calls on residents of Kwale County to support local peace-building committees in support of national peace-building.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za mitaa kusaidia kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah ee taageeraya nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: IPOA luongo jogweng' Kwale County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e pinygi.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds mobile money users in Kisumu County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid identity theft.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kisumu inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado tuugada aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e gweng' mar Kisumu ni mondo ging'e kwayo mag pesa kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo kik jokuoge okwel nyingegi.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Homa Bay County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma ya afya ya ruzuku.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay haystaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi ka gidwaro thieth mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds the public in Laikipia County that reporting embezzlement of public funds is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa fedha za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Hay'adda garsoorka Kenya waxay dadka degmada Laikipia ku xasuusineysaa in warbixinta xadgudubka lacagaha dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone ji duto e county mar Laikipia ni golo ripot mar ketho pesa mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Nyamira County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira mwezi huu wa Julai.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ka dhanka ah degmada Nyamira bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Rieko: Huduma Kenya chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Nyamira e dwe mar Julai.

English: NTSA warns residents of Turkana County to prepare for possible flooding this November.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandaa kwa mafuriko yanayoweza kutokea Novemba hii.
Somali: NTSA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay u diyaar garoobaan fatahaadaha iman kara bisha November.
Dholuo: NTSA osiemo jogweng' mar Turkana County mondo oikre ne koth maduong' ma biro timore e dwe mar Novemba.

English: EACC invites residents of Kilifi County to attend the public participation forum regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: EACC inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya wilaya.
Somali: EACC waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inay ka qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan habka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: EACC gwelo ji duto modak e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenro mar bajet mar gweng'no.

English: FAO reminds farmers in Nyamira County of the ongoing modern irrigation techniques training programme.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya mbinu za umwagiliaji.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyamira barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah.
Dholuo: FAO parone jopur e County mar Nyamira chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar yore mag lero pi.

English: Keep information on water and placing equipments for drip irrigation on sweet potatoes. Learn how each function and maintenance.
Kiswahili: Weka habari juu ya maji na kuweka vifaa vya umwagiliaji wa matone kwenye viazi vitamu. Jifunze jinsi kila kazi na matengenezo.
Somali: Hayso macluumaadka biyaha iyo meelaynta qalabka waraabka dhibcaha ee baradhada macaan. Baro sida mid walba u shaqeeyo iyo dayactir.
Dholuo: Ket weche moko e wi pi kod gik ma inyalo tigo e loyo kit yien.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ka furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay ka shaqeynta shahaadada dhalashada degmada Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya osechako tiyo gi ofis manyien mar loso nyasi mag nyuol e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMRI will be held in Homa Bay County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMRI itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay KEMRI ayaa lagu qaban doonaa gobolka Homa Bay bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma KEMRI ochano biro timore Homa Bay County e dwe mar April.

English: Notice from Kenya Medical Association: skilled birth attendance clinics will run every January at designated health centres in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya: kliniki za mahudhurio ya uzazi zenye ujuzi zitaendeshwa kila Januari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya: rugta daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfadlayaasha ah ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Janaayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee lagu magacaabo degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association: Klinike mag rito nyuol ma nigi lony biro tiyo e dwe mar Januar higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e kaunti mar Isiolo.

English: Kisumu Governor Nyong'o orders all restaurants shut in the county for failing to adhere to MoH measures against Covid-19.
Kiswahili: Gavana wa Kisumu Nyong'o aamuru migahawa yote ifungwe katika kaunti hiyo kwa kushindwa kufuata sheria za Wizara ya Afya dhidi ya Covid-19.
Somali: Guddoomiyaha Kisumu Nyong'o ayaa amar ku bixiyay in dhammaan makhaayadaha gobolka la xiro sababtoo ah ma raacaan tallaabooyinka Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ee ka dhanka ah COVID-19.
Dholuo: Gavana ma Kisumu Nyong'o ogolo chik mondo oting'o ute duto mag chiemo e county nikech ok giluw chenro mag Ministry of Health mar kedo gi Covid-19.

English: @GarissaGov is an example of successful implementation & institutionalization of MPDSR, that focuses on linking information & response, ensuring responses are taken based on data to prevent avoidable maternal & perinatal mortality happening in the future.
Kiswahili: @GarissaGov ni kielelezo cha ufanisi wa utekelezaji na kuanzishwa kwa MPDSR, ambayo inalenga katika kuunganisha taarifa na majibu, kuhakikisha kuwa majibu yanachukuliwa kulingana na data ili kuzuia vifo vinavyoepukika vya uzazi na uzazi kutokea katika sik
Somali: @GarissaGov waa tusaale ku saabsan hirgelinta guusha leh iyo hay'adeynta MPDSR, kaas oo diiradda saaraya isku xirka macluumaadka iyo jawaabta, hubinta in jawaabaha la qaato iyadoo lagu saleynayo xogta si looga hortago dhimashada hooyada iyo dhalmada ee laga hortagi karo mustaqbalka.
Dholuo: @GarissaGov en ranyisi mar keto MPDSR e tim maber, ma keto pach kuom tudruok mar weche kod dwoko, neno ni dwoko okawe kaluwore gi weche ma yudore mondo ogeng’ tho ma nyalo geng’ore mar min gi nyithindo ma pod onyuol e kinde mabiro.

English: NDMA urges the community in Tharaka-Nithi County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb fraud.
Kiswahili: NDMA inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia udanganyifu.
Somali: NDMA waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo khiyaamooyinka.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo oganda man Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polis mar oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o mibadhi.

English: KEMSA urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Kwale County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Kwale inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag obwongo e county mar Kwale mondo odhi ir japuonj molony.

English: KMTC invites youth in Bungoma County to enroll for motor vehicle mechanics training this February.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari Februari hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Bungoma inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka mashiinka gawaarida gaadiidka bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: KMTC gwelo rowere mag Bungoma County mondo odonjre e tiegruok mar mechanics mag mtokni e dwe mar Februar.

English: Floods in Kenya raise the risk of waterborne diseases
Kiswahili: Mafuriko nchini Kenya huongeza hatari ya magonjwa yatokanayo na maji
Somali: Daadadka ka dhacay Kenya ayaa kor u qaadaya khatarta cudurrada biyaha ka dhasha
Dholuo: Pi ma pong’o piny Kenya medo luoro mar tuoche ma yudore kuom pi

English: Notice: COMESA will open a milk collection centre in Migori County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itafungua kituo cha kukusanya maziwa katika Kaunti ya Migori Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay bilaabi doontaa xarun lagu soo ururiyo caanaha Degmada Migori bisha April.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA biro yawo kambi mar choko chak e taon mar Migori e dwe mar April.

English: Include all! Provide ramps and resources for disabled students.
Kiswahili: Waandae wanafunzi wenye ulemavu vijia na rasilimali.
Somali: Dhammaantood ka qaybqaada, ardayda naafada ah u siiya xarumo iyo kheyraad.
Dholuo: Mi jopuonjre ma nigi midekre thuolo mar dhi e skundno.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds residents of Busia County that conservation tillage improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kwamba kilimo cha uhifadhi kinaboresha tija ya shamba la muda mrefu.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Busia in beerashada ilaalinta ay hagaajineyso waxsoosaarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jogweng' mar County mar Busia ni chwoyo puothe e yor ritruok kelo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: NDMA reminds mobile money users in Kiambu County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kiambu inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: NDMA paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e Kaunti mar Kiambu mondo ochiw ripot mar ote manyalo kelo hinyruok ne jatendgi mar tich mondo kik gitim chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo.

English: The Association for Microfinance Institutions in Kenya and Habitat for Humanity International partner to unlock affordable housing finance solutions in Kenya
Kiswahili: Chama cha Taasisi Ndogo za Fedha nchini Kenya na Habitat for Humanity International hushirikiana kufungua masuluhisho ya ufadhili wa nyumba nafuu nchini Kenya.
Somali: Ururka Hay'adaha Maalgelinta Yaryar ee Kenya iyo Habitat for Humanity International ayaa iska kaashanaya sidii loo furi lahaa xalal maaliyadeed oo la awoodi karo oo ku yaal Kenya.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Riwruoge mag Chiwo omwom matindo e piny Kenya kod riwruok mar piny mangima mar dak ne dhano loso kanyakla mar yawo yore mag chudo mag udi ma ng'ato nyalo ng'iewo e piny Kenya

English: Teachers Service Commission urges parents and teachers in Kilifi County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku boorinayaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Kilifi inay u soo sheegaan mas'uuliyadda amniga dugsiga.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo onyis sirkal mar skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok.

English: Farmers are urged to increase productivity by extending working hours and adopting technology to improve yields Embrace innovative practices for better food security and market access
Kiswahili: Wakulima wamehimizwa kuongeza tija kwa kuongeza muda wa saa za kazi na kutumia teknolojia ili kuboresha mavuno.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu booriyay in ay kordhiyaan wax soo saarka iyagoo kordhinaya saacadaha shaqada iyo qaataynta tiknoolajiyada si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka Qaadashada hababka hal-abuurka ah ee lagu hagaajinayo amniga cuntada iyo marin u helka suuqa
Dholuo: Ojiwo jopur mondo omed timo dongruok kuom medo seche mag tich kod tiyo gi teknoloji mondo okony e medo nyak mar cham.

English: KEMSA announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Uasin Gishu County starting this January.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuanzia Januari hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa in laga bilaabo bishii Janaayo ee sannadkan la siin doono dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: KEMSA olando thieth mar dialysis kuom joma odak e county mar Uasin Gishu kochakore Januar ma kawuono.

English: Swollen legs, thin legs that feel tired all the time for children can be sign of sickness. Seek timely help
Kiswahili: Miguu iliyovimba, miguu nyembamba ambayo huhisi uchovu kila wakati kwa watoto inaweza kuwa ishara ya ugonjwa.
Somali: Lugaha barwaaqoobay, lugta khafiifka ah ee carruurta si joogto ah u daalan waxay calaamad u noqon karaan cudur.
Dholuo: Nyithindo nyalo bedo gi tiendegi motuwo, tiendegi maboyo kendo ma chunygi ool kinde duto.

English: Kenya is set to enhance cotton production and the textile industry Farmers and stakeholders should prepare for upcoming initiatives
Kiswahili: Kenya imedhamiria kuimarisha uzalishaji wa pamba na sekta ya nguo Wakulima na washikadau wanapaswa kujiandaa kwa mipango ijayo
Somali: Kenya ayaa lagu wadaa inay xoojiso wax soo saarka suufka iyo warshadaha dharka Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha waa inay isu diyaariyaan dadaallada soo socda
Dholuo: Kenya biro medo timo dongruok e loso puodho kod ohala mag le mag le mag ot.

English: Public health advisory: KEMSA warns of increased typhoid risk in West Pokot County and advises the public to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMSA inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya typhoid katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi na inashauri umma kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji vilivyochafuliwa.
Somali: Talobixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: KEMSA waxay ka digtay kororka halista cudurka 'typhoid' ee Gobolka West Pokot waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakhda leh.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar oganda: KEMSA chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar typhoid e West Pokot County kendo osiemo ji mondo kik giriwre gi pi mochido.

English: Women have a bigger role to play, have market access like men in agricultural wealth...(2020). To access agriculture markets and differences in feeds in Kenya.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wana jukumu kubwa la kutekeleza, wana ufikiaji wa soko kama wanaume katika utajiri wa kilimo... (2020). Kupata masoko ya kilimo na tofauti za malisho nchini Kenya.

Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone ji duto e county mar Kwale ni chiwo ripot mar asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds the public in Isiolo County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni huru, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu dadka degmada Isiolo ku xasuusinayaa in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone ji duto manie kaunti mar Isiolo ni golo ripot mar tiyo marach gi migepe en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Kilifi County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inay haystaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' Kilifi County mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi ka gidwaro thieth mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Kenya Forest Service warns residents of Tana River County about a rise in phishing messages and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Wilaya ya Tana River juu ya kuongezeka kwa ujumbe wa udanganyifu na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ka digay dadka deggan degmada Tana River oo ku saabsan kororka farriimaha phishing wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service osiemo jogweng' mar Tana River County kuom medruok mar weche mag phishing kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: Kenya confirms surge in Mpox cases, tally now at 137 with Busia, Mombasa and Nakuru counties leading with highest number of infections.
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha kuongezeka kwa visa vya Mpox, ambapo sasa vimefikia 137 huku kaunti za Busia, Mombasa na Nakuru zikiongoza kwa kuwa na idadi kubwa zaidi ya maambukizi.
Somali: Kenya waxay xaqiijineysaa kororka kiisaska Mpox, oo hadda gaaraya 137 iyadoo degmooyinka Busia, Mombasa iyo Nakuru ay hogaaminayaan tirada ugu badan ee cudurrada.
Dholuo: Kenya osenyiso ni ji mang'eny ma nigi Mpox osemedore, ka sani gichopo 137 gi county mag Busia, Mombasa kod Nakuru.

English: Public notice: Kenya Red Cross will host a free proper sanitation outreach in Isiolo County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mazingira bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay martigelin doontaa adeegyo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan Degmada Isiolo bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova mar Kenya Red Cross biro timo kampen mar rito ler mar alwora e dwe mar Februar e kaunti mar Isiolo.
