Kiswahili: Elimu ya kiraia sasa hubeba 20% uzito katika Grade 9 tathmini kujifunza kwa bidii.
Somali: Waxbarashada madaniga ah hadda waxay leedahay miisaan dhan 20% qiimaynta Fasalka 9aad ÃƒÆ’ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…â€œ si adag u darso.
Dholuo: Somo mar oganda sani oting’o pek mar 20% e puonjruok matek ma itimo e klas mar 9.

English: Kenya Red Cross advises residents of West Pokot County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay biyo cabitaan ah ku kariyaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross nyiso jogweng' mar West Pokot County ni mondo omak pi modho kapok gitiyo kode mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will distribute certified wheat seed to farmers in Makueni County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu za ngano zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu abuuraha Degmada Makueni u qaybin doonaa abuurka sarreenka ee shahaadooyinka leh bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro pogo kodhi mag ngano ne jopur manie Makueni County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: KEMRI will hold a depression awareness forum in Nyeri County this December. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI itafanya kongamano la uhamasishaji wa unyogovu katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Desemba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay qaban doontaa madasha wacyiga dhibta ee degmada Nyeri bishii Diseembar. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMRI biro timo chokruok mar chiwo paro e wi tuwo mar depression e taon mar Nyeri e dwe mar Desemba.

English: IEBC urges eligible citizens in Kericho County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Kericho kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kericho inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jokanyo mag Kericho County mondo oriwre gi jogo madwaro donjo e skundno.

English: Notice: KMTC opens a new catering and hospitality programme at the vocational centre in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inafungua mpango mpya wa upishi na ukarimu katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan cuntada iyo marti-gelinta xarunta xirfadaha ee gobolka Bomet.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KMTC chako chenro manyien mar chamo chiemo kod rwako welo e kar tich e county mar Bomet.

English: Young entrepreneurs in agriculture are facing barriers beyond just access to finance Stakeholders are urged to provide targeted investment and support to help youth led agribusinesses thrive
Kiswahili: Wajasiriamali vijana katika kilimo wanakabiliwa na vikwazo zaidi ya upatikanaji wa fedha tu
Somali: Ganacsatada dhalinyarada ah ee beeraha ayaa la kulma caqabado ka baxsan helitaanka dhaqaalaha oo kaliya Dhinacyada daneeyayaasha ah ayaa lagu booriyay inay bixiyaan maalgashiyo iyo taageero bartilmaameedsan si ay uga caawiyaan horumarinta ganacsiyada beeraha ee dhalinyarada hogaaminaya
Dholuo: Owete ma rowere e weche mag pur romo gi pek mamoko maok mana yudo pesa kende.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kudai usambazaji wa huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa fedha za umma.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay dalbadaan bixinta adeegyada aan la bixin laaluush si looga hortago xadgudubka dhaqaalaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette ojiwo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo okonygi gi tij lendo maok gichiwo asoya mondo giked gi ketho pesa mag sirkal.

English: NTSA urges motorists and pedestrians in Nyamira County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Nyamira inay guryahooda rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dabka daminta iyo inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa dhacdooyinka fatahaadaha la xiriira.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo dereba mag mtokni kod joma wuotho gi tiendgi e kaunti mar Nyamira mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko yiengni e utegi kendo gitim kinda mar geng'o masiche motudore gi apaka.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Busia County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti hiyo ili kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja wa kaunti.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jogweng' County mar Busia mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mar dongruok e county.

English: KUCCPS announces distribution of school laptops under the digital literacy programme to schools in Kajiado County this February.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inatangaza usambazaji wa kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kajiado Februari hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku dhawaaqday qaybinta kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Kajiado bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: KUCCPS olando ni gibiro pogo kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar somo gi somo mar digital e skunde mag Kajiado County e dwe mar Februar.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Machakos County that access to free medical camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za matibabu bila malipo sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Machakos in helitaanka xeryaha caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha loo qoondeeyay.
Dholuo: KEMSA oparo ne ji duto e County ma Machakos ni koro ginyalo yudo kuonde thieth maonge chudo e kuonde moketi.

English: NCPB advises farmers in Uasin Gishu County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the March planting season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Machi.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Uasin Gishu inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka jiilaalka hore iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok chon ka pok ochopo ndalo chwoyo e dwe mar Mach.

English: Invest in cold storage to significantly extend the shelf life of perishable fruits, allowing you to sell at better prices and reduce waste.
Kiswahili: Wekeza katika hifadhi ya baridi ili kuongeza muda wa matumizi ya matunda yanayoharibika, na kukuwezesha kuuza kwa bei nzuri na kupunguza upotevu.
Somali: Maalgelinta kaydinta qaboojiyaha si aad u kordhiso cimriga cimilada miraha burburka ah, taasoo kuu oggolaaneysa inaad ku iibiso qiimo ka wanaagsan oo aad yareyso qashinka.
Dholuo: Golo pesa e choko olembe mang'ich mondo omi olembe ma nyalo kethore omed bedo mangima, kendo mano biro miyo ng'ato ong'iewgi e nengo maber moloyo kendo oketh gik mochido.

English: Farmers planting Hass avocado seedlings should follow these steps space seedlings 6 10 meters apart dig 2x2 feet holes mix top soil manure and DAP fertilizer and water in dry weather
Kiswahili: Wakulima wakipanda miche ya miparachichi ya Hass wafuate hatua hizi miche ya nafasi ya mita 6 na 10 chimba mashimo ya futi 2x2 changanya samadi ya juu ya udongo na mbolea ya DAP na maji wakati wa kiangazi.
Somali: Beeraleyda beerta geedaha Hass avocado waa inay raacaan tallaabooyinkan: geedaha meelaha 6 10 mitir kala fog, qod godad 2x2 feet isku dar, bacriminta dusha sare iyo bacriminta DAP iyo biyo xilliga cimilada qalalan
Dholuo: Jolup puothe ma pidho cham mag avocado mag Hass onego oluw yoregi mag timo kamano.

English: E-Citizen reminds residents of Siaya County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa jogweng' County mar Siaya ni luwo dongruok mar tich kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross confirms a cyclosporiasis outbreak alert for Kwale County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa cyclosporiasis kwa Kaunti ya Kwale. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka cyclosporiasis ee Gobolka Kwale. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Red Cross osenyiso ni nitie masira mar cyclosporiasis e kaunti mar Kwale.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Narok County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya litafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Kenya Gazette waxay qabaneysaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda gobolka ee gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Gazette biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e county mar Narok.

English: Kenya Dairy Board urges tea growers in Nakuru County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Nakuru inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka xilliga dayrta iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e higa ka gitiyo gi tuoche mag thieth molony mondo okony e medo nyak mar yien e higani.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges goats farmers in Tana River County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawahimiza wafugaji wa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa kufuatia kesi za ugonjwa wa Newcastle zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda orgiga ee degmada Tana River inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo ka dib kiisaska cudurka Newcastle ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur ma pidho diek e Tana River County mondo opidhgi gi legi e kuonde moketi mag chwoyo diek bang' ka osenyis ni gin gi tuo mar Newcastle.

English: KMTC calls on the community in Nandi County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KMTC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: KMTC waxay bulshada degmada Nandi ugu baaqeysaa inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116 si ay u ilaaliyaan iskuulada.
Dholuo: KMTC okwayo ji duto e county mar Nandi mondo omany namba mar 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: KUCCPS encourages out-of-school children in Isiolo County to register their children at the nearest public school under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta dugsiga ka baxsan ee degmada Isiolo inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e gweng' mar Isiolo mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul ma ni machiegni kodgi e bwo chenro mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General opens the electoral calendar centres in Nairobi County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud ayaa furaya xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee Gobolka Nairobi bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Auditor General chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e Nairobi County e dwe mar Mei.

English: Kenya Forest Service alerts residents of Meru County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru juu ya kuongezeka kwa visa vya wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ka digay dadka deggan degmada Meru in ay kordhaan kiisaska tuugada wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan in ay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar County mar Meru ni kwan mag joma odonjo e kambi biro medore kendo ochiwo siem ne ji mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Teachers Service Commission encourages residents of Kericho County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya ugatuzi.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabaan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Kericho mondo onon weche motudore gi kad mar joma oyiero mondo ging'e weche duto.

English: Nairobi, Kajiado, Machakos, Kiambu & Nakuru counties are individually and collectively declared a disease infected area. There shall be a cessation of movement by road, rail, air in to & out of these areas effective midnight
Kiswahili: Kaunti za Nairobi, Kajiado, Machakos, Kiambu na Nakuru zimetangazwa kuwa eneo lililoathiriwa na magonjwa moja moja na kwa pamoja. Kutakuwa na kusimamishwa kwa usafiri kwa barabara, reli, hewa kuingia na kutoka katika maeneo haya kuanzia saa sita usiku.
Somali: Gobollada Nairobi, Kajiado, Machakos, Kiambu & Nakuru ayaa si gaar ah iyo si wadajir ah loogu dhawaaqay inay yihiin aagag cudurku ku dhacay.
Dholuo: Sirkande mag Nairobi, Kajiado, Machakos, Kiambu & Nakuru ne oler achiel kachiel kendo kanyachiel ni gin kuonde ma tuwono nitie.

English: Teachers Service Commission encourages out-of-school children in Makueni County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Makueni kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya elimu ya sekondari ya siku ya bure.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Makueni inay dalbadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission jiwo nyithindo maok dhi e skul e gweng' mar Makueni mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: CDC urges residents of Uasin Gishu County to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night following a rise in reported dengue fever cases.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na dawa kila usiku kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya homa ya dengue.
Somali: CDC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka ee lagu daaweeyo cayayaannada habeen kasta ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska cudurka dengue ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo jogweng' Uasin Gishu County mondo oti gi otamba molos gi yedhe makelo tuoche mag lum otieno ka otieno nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuwo mar dengue osemedore.

English: IEBC urges youth in Garissa County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Garissa inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo rowere e County mar Garissa mondo onyis weche ma gin-go e wi joma oyierogi kapok gitimo gik ma biro timore ne oganda.

English: Teachers Service Commission advises students in Narok County to collect materials from the county education office to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Narok kukusanya nyenzo kutoka kwa ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata maudhui ya kujifunza ya kidijitali bila malipo.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ardayda degmada Narok kula talinayaa inay ka soo ururiyaan waxyaabo xafiiska waxbarashada degmada si ay u helaan waxyaabaha barashada digitalka ah ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jopuonjre e gweng' mar Narok mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar tiegruok mar gweng'no mondo giyud thuolo mar somo weche mag digital maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds expectant mothers in Busia County that access to childhood immunization is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba upatikanaji wa chanjo ya watoto ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Busia in helitaanka tallaalka carruurta ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Busia ni thuolo mar yudo thieth mar nyithindo en maonge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: FAO advises farmers in Bungoma County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the September planting season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Septemba.
Somali: FAO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Bungoma inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: FAO nyiso jopur manie Bungoma County mondo oti gi kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochako chwoyo kodhi e dwe mar Septemba.

English: You are six times more likely to get malaria if you visit Busia, Tana River, Kakamega, Bungoma, Kilifi, Kisumu, Trans Nzoia, Elgeyo Marakwet and Nandi counties, according to the latest data from the Ministry of Health.
Kiswahili: Una uwezekano mara sita zaidi wa kupata malaria ukitembelea kaunti za Busia, Tana River, Kakamega, Bungoma, Kilifi, Kisumu, Trans Nzoia, Elgeyo Marakwet na Nandi, kulingana na data ya hivi karibuni kutoka Wizara ya Afya.
Somali: Haddii aad booqato degmooyinka Busia, Tana River, Kakamega, Bungoma, Kilifi, Kisumu, Trans Nzoia, Elgeyo Marakwet iyo Nandi, waxaad lix jeer u badan tahay inaad qabato makaraayada, sida ku cad xogta ugu dambeysa ee Wasaaradda Caafimaadka.
Dholuo: Kaluwore gi weche manyien mag Ministry of Health, inyalo yudo malaria nyadi auchiel ka idhi e counties mag Busia, Tana River, Kakamega, Bungoma, Kilifi, Kisumu, Trans Nzoia, Elgeyo Marakwet kod Nandi.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Turkana County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u soo gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo jogweng' Turkana County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo ng'ur mar kedo gi timbe mag wuondruok.

English: Procure veterinary drugs and vaccines, and strengthen active livestock disease surveillance.
Kiswahili: Nunua dawa za mifugo na chanjo, na uimarishe ufuatiliaji wa magonjwa ya mifugo.
Somali: Helitaanka daawooyinka xoolaha iyo tallaalada, iyo xoojinta kormeerka cudurrada xoolaha ee firfircoon.
Dholuo: Yudo yedhe mamero kod thieth mag dhok, kendo jiwo rito tuoche mag jamni.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds youth in Murang'a County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya dhalinyarada degmada Murang'a in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka farsamada gawaarida.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne rowere e County mar Murang'a ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar masinde mag mtokni.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Laikipia County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na ufisadi wa fedha za umma.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u soo gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago xadgudubka lacagta dawladda.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Laikipia mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e yor intanet e chiwo ng'ur mar kedo gi ketho pesa mag sirkal.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds voters in Tana River County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Tana River kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu xasuusinayaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Tana River inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor inta aan la samayn nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette paronwa jogweng' Tana River County mondo olim kama ioroe ji e IEBC kapok itimo yiero.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges residents of Mandera County to attend the public participation forum to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si loo qaabeeyo wadatashiyada siyaasadda guud.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Mandera mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mondo okony e loso chenro mag chenro mag oganda.

English: State Department for Basic Education announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Tharaka-Nithi County this March.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Machi hii.
Somali: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Dowladda ayaa ku dhawaaqday in lagu qeybinayo waxyaabaha waxbarasho ee bilaashka ah ee dhijitaalka ah dugsiyada Degmada Tharaka-Nithi bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education (Department of Basic Education) ogolo chenro mar pogo buge mag digital maonge chudo e skunde mag Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: KMTC launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC yazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay bilowday barnaamij tallaabooyin looga hortago dhibaatada dugsiyada degmada Laikipia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KMTC chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe mahundu e skunde duto e County mar Laikipia.

English: Notice: KMTC reminds citizens in Samburu County about their rights regarding voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuhusu haki zao kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Samburu xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC paronwa raia e county mar Samburu kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar ndiko joma oyiero.

English: Announcing the plan in counties of Kenya on foods and also in the whole world
Kiswahili: Kutangaza mpango katika wilaya za Kenya juu ya chakula na pia katika dunia nzima
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida qorshaha cuntada ee degmooyinka Kenya iyo sidoo kale adduunka oo dhan
Dholuo: Lando chenro mar chiemo e gwenge mag Kenya koda e piny mangima

English: KEMSA appeals to caregivers in Laikipia County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the October maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Oktoba.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Laikipia inay ka qeybgalaan maalinta bukaanka ee la qorsheeyay qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KEMSA okwayo jorit e county mar Laikipia mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar thieth ma ne otim e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Public notice: KEMSA will host a free diabetes screening outreach in Mombasa County this November.
Kiswahili: Notisi kwa umma: KEMSA itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uchunguzi wa kisukari bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: KEMSA waxay martigelin doontaa baaritaan bukaan-socod oo bilaash ah oo lagu ogaanayo cudurka macaanka ee gobolka Mombasa bisha November.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMSA biro timo kampen mar nono tuo mar sukari maonge chudo e dwe mar Novemba e County mar Mombasa.

English: DCI urges residents of Nyeri County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DCI inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama katikati ya umakini mkubwa wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay soo sheegaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo jogweng' Kaunti mar Nyeri mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e alwora mar tong'gi e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya e loso kuwe e piny.

English: Ministry of Health reminds expectant mothers in Embu County that access to postnatal check-ups is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Embu kwamba upatikanaji wa uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Embu in helitaanka baaritaannada dhalmada ka dib ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne mine ma nigi ich e county mar Embu ni thuolo mar dhi e nonro bang' nyuol en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag sirkal.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds livestock keepers in Kirinyaga County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Kirinyaga inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanada buka xafiiska xayawaanka ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) paronwa jorit jamni e County mar Kirinyaga ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: OGP reminds the public in Kajiado County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha umma katika Kajiado County kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kajiado in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: OGP paronwa ji duto e Kajiado County ni lando wach tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'.

English: NDMA urges the public in Meru County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of identity theft.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Meru wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: NDMA waxay ugu baaqeysaa shacabka degmada Meru inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarkooda M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee tuugista aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo ji duto e County mar Meru mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' weche mag kwalo nying.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Kiambu County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhusu umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMSA waxay dadka degmada Kiambu ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay nadaafadda saxda ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone ji duto e County mar Kiambu kuom ber mar rito ler maler e ngima joot.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu furayaa codsiyada deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan ardayda ku jira degmada Murang'a.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oyawo kwayo mag somo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e Murang'a County.

English: Kenya Quarterly Update, (January â€“ March 2023)
Kiswahili: Sasisho la Robo la Kenya, (Januari - Machi 2023)
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta Saddex-biloodlaha ah ee Kenya, (Janaayo - Maarso 2023)
Dholuo: Oboke ma dwe ka dweche adek, (dwe mar achiel - dwe mar adek 2023)

English: National Drought Early Warning Bulletin (February 2024)
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Tahadhari ya Mapema ya Kitaifa (Februari 2024)
Somali: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Qaranka (Febraayo 2024)
Dholuo: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Pinyruoth mar Oro (Dwe mar Arar 2024)

English: The experiences of Kenya and Rwanda demonstrate how better data can help countries stay ahead of one of the most significant public health threats of our time.
Kiswahili: Matukio ya Kenya na Rwanda yanaonyesha jinsi data bora inaweza kusaidia nchi kusalia mbele ya matishio makubwa zaidi ya afya ya umma katika wakati wetu.
Somali: Waaya-aragnimada Kenya iyo Rwanda waxay muujinayaan sida xog wanaagsan ay uga caawin karto waddamada inay ka hormaraan mid ka mid ah khataraha ugu waaweyn ee caafimaadka dadweynaha ee waqtigeenna.
Dholuo: Gik ma ne otimore e piny Kenya kod Rwanda nyiso kaka weche mabeyo nyalo konyo pinje mondo obed e nyim achiel kuom gik madongo ma nyalo kelo hinyruok e ngima mar oganda e kindegi.

English: Notice: KTDA will conduct a pest and disease management workshop for farmers in Nakuru County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itafanya warsha ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada beeraleyda ee degmada Nakuru bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KTDA biro timo chokruok mar rieyo tuoche kod tuoche ne jopur e kaunti mar Nakuru e dwe mar Februar.

English: Universities Fund announces distribution of textbooks and learning materials to schools in Nandi County this October.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unatangaza usambazaji wa vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nandi Oktoba hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku dhawaaqay in bishii Oktoobar la qeybiyo buugaag iyo qalab waxbarasho dugsiyada gobolka Nandi.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund ong'ado mar pogo buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok e skunde man Nandi County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: KEMRI reminds expectant mothers in Murang'a County that access to free antenatal care is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma ya ujauzito bila malipo ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Murang'a in helitaanka daryeelka uurka ka hor ee bilaashka ah ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMRI paronwa mine madwaro nyuol e County mar Murang'a ni thuolo mar yudo rit ma onge chudo mar nyuol en maonge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: Prolonged drugs and substance abuse interfers with your capcity to work and make you forgetful and to make decisions, and incapacitates your capacity to do your daily work
Kiswahili: Kutumia dawa za kulevya na dawa za kulewesha kwa muda mrefu huathiri uwezo wako wa kufanya kazi na kukusababisha kusahau na kufanya maamuzi, na kukosa uwezo wako kufanya kazi yako ya kila siku
Somali: Daawadaha iyo isticmaalka maandooriyaha ee muddo dheer soconaya waxay saameyn ku yeeshaan awoodda aad u leedahay inaad shaqeyso, waxay kaa dhigeysaa mid iloobaan ah oo aad go'aan ka gaarto, waxayna awood u laheyd inaad qabato shaqadaada maalinlaha ah
Dholuo: Medruok mosiko mar tiyo gi yedhe mamero kod yedhe ma mero ji miyo ok idwar tiyo, kendo mano miyo wiyi wil gi yiero mitimo, kendo miyo ok inyal timo tije mapile

English: Notice: IEBC opens a new tailoring and design programme at the vocational centre in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inafungua programu mpya ya ushonaji na muundo katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan dharka iyo naqshadeynta xarunta xirfadaha ee gobolka Nandi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IEBC chako chenro manyien mar loso kendo loso gik moko e kar tich e county mar Nandi.

English: Tharaka-Nithi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2024
Somali: Degmada Tharaka-Nithi: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Tharaka-Nithi: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar Septemba 2024

English: Taita Taveta County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Taita Taveta: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Aprili 2023
Somali: Degmada Taita Taveta: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Taita Taveta: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar Ang'wen 2023

English: AFA reminds residents of Tana River County that conservation tillage improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kwamba kilimo cha uhifadhi kinaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River in beerashada ilaalinta ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: AFA paronwa jogweng' mar Tana River County ni chwoyo puothe e yor ritruok medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Breast feeding always is allowed. Employers should. Employers should provide breast feeding mothers humble time to breast feed their children
Kiswahili: Waajiri wanapaswa kuwapa akina mama wanaonyonyesha wakati wa kuwapa watoto wao matiti kwa unyenyekevu
Somali: Hooyooyinka naas nuujinaya waa la oggol yahay. Shaqo-bixiyeyaashu waa in ay u siiyaan hooyooyinka naaska nuujinta waqti aad u hooseeya si ay u quudiyaan carruurtooda
Dholuo: Joma tiyo tijegi onego omi min nyithindo thuolo mar pidho nyithindgi gi madhoth

English: KNEC reminds needy students in Laikipia County that free digital learning content applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kwamba programu za bure za maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KNEC waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Laikipia in codsiyada barnaamijyada barashada bilaashka ah ee digital-ka ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: KNEC parone jopuonjre man Laikipia County ma nigi chandruok ni chenro mag somo maonge chudo mar digital chiegni rumo.

English: Notice: KRA launches the county integrated development plan in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay bilaabaysaa qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Nandi.
Dholuo: Rapar: KRA chako chenro mar dongruok mar county e county mar Nandi.

English: AIRA Infodemic Trends Report 29 July - 5 August 2024 (Weekly Brief #130)
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Mitindo ya Habari ya AIRA 29 Julai - 5 Agosti 2024 (Muhtasari wa Kila Wiki #130)
Somali: Warbixinta Isbeddellada AIRA Infodemic 29 Luulyo - 5 Agoosto 2024 (Warbixinta Todobaadlaha ah #130)
Dholuo: Ripot mar weche mag tuwo mag AIRA tarik 29 dwe mar abiriyo - tarik 5 dwe mar aboro higa mar 2024 (Ripot machuok mar juma ka juma #130)

English: Notice: NDMA conducts a community briefing on border security in Meru County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Meru Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha degmada Meru bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e County mar Meru e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Turkana County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Turkana: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Juni 2023
Somali: Degmada Turkana: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Turkana: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2023

English: Judiciary of Kenya updates residents of Kajiado County on progress of county development projects this November.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawajulisha wakazi wa Kajiado County kuhusu maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti hii Novemba.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Kajiado ka warbixiyaa horumarka mashaariicda horumarinta degmada bisha November.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya chiwo ripot ne jogweng' Kajiado County kuom dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok e gweng'no e dwe mar Novemba.

English: KRA urges residents of Kajiado County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kajiado County kudai usambazaji wa huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: KRA waxay dadka deggan degmada Kajiado ugu baaqeysaa inay dalbadaan adeeg bixinta iyaga oo aan bixin laaluush si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo okonygi gi tij lendo maok gichiwo asoya mondo gikwed asoya e migepe mag sirkal.

English: Integrating livestock climate adaptation and peacebuilding: The Climate Security Sensitivity Tool for Livestock Systems (CSSTxLS)
Kiswahili: Kuunganisha makabiliano ya hali ya hewa ya mifugo na kujenga amani: Zana ya Unyeti wa Usalama wa Hali ya Hewa kwa Mifumo ya Mifugo (CSSTxLS)

Dholuo: Kuong’ruok mar ng’iyo piny kod loso kuwe: Gima itiyogo mar ng’eyo kaka piny nyalo bedo maber (CSSTxLS)

English: KICD encourages out-of-school children in Laikipia County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under free primary education.
Kiswahili: KICD inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: KICD waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Laikipia inay ku qoraan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo nyithindo maok dhi e skul e county mar Laikipia mondo odonj e program mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo e bwo tiegruok ma onge chudo.

English: EACC urges residents of Isiolo County to attend the public participation forum to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: EACC inahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si ay u qaabeeyaan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: EACC ojiwo jogweng' Isiolo County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar loso chenro mar dongruok.

English: To manage Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus, remove and burn diseased plants, plant resistant varieties, intercrop with maize to reduce whitefly access to the crop, and control whiteflies with oil sprays or insecticides while always wearing protective clothing and following the product label.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti Virusi vya Majani ya Njano ya Nyanya, ondoa na uchome mimea yenye magonjwa, aina sugu za mimea, kuingiliana na mahindi ili kupunguza upatikanaji wa nzi weupe kwenye mazao, na kudhibiti nzi weupe kwa dawa za kunyunyizia mafuta au dawa za kuua wadudu huku kila wakati ukivaa nguo za kinga na kufuata lebo ya bidhaa.
Somali: Si loo maareeyo fayraska Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus, ka saar oo gubo dhirta cudurka leh, noocyada adkeysiga dhirta, isku darka galleyda si loo yareeyo helitaanka shinnida cad ee dalagga, iyo xakameynta shinnida cad adigoo adeegsanaya buufin saliid ama cayayaanka oo mar walba xiran dhar ilaalin ah oo raacaya calaamadda alaabta.
Dholuo: Mondo oti gi tuoche mag Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus, onego ogol kendo owang'e yiende ma nigi tuoche, kod kit yiende ma ok nyal geng'o yiende, kendo onego ogolgi gi cham mar cham mondo omi lumbe mag cham kik donj e cham, kendo onego oti gi thieth mag oil spray kata ndawa makelo tuoche mag kute ka kinde duto girwako lewni ma geng'o kod ka giluwo weche ma ondik e kalatas mar yiendno.

English: Kenya Red Cross advises residents of Taita-Taveta County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuthibitisha kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Laanta Cas ee Kenya waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Taita-Taveta inay xaqiijiyaan in xaruntoodu la aqoonsaday ka hor inta aysan booqan si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross nyiso jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo ong'e ni kuondegi mag thieth oseyudo ratiro kapok gibiro mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Harvest tomatoes in the early morning or late evening when the temperature is around 20C and the weather is dry. For storage, keep tomatoes at 12C and 86-90% relative humidity - they spoil if kept below 10C for over 2 weeks, or below 5C for more than 6-8 days, but can last 2-3 weeks at 10C or above.
Kiswahili: Vuna nyanya asubuhi na mapema au jioni wakati joto ni karibu 20C na hali ya hewa ni kavu. Kwa kuhifadhi, weka nyanya kwa 12C na unyevu wa jamaa wa 86-90% - huharibika ikiwa zimehifadhiwa chini ya 10C kwa zaidi ya wiki 2, au chini ya 5C kwa zaidi ya siku 6-8, lakini zinaweza kudumu wiki 2-3 kwa 10C au zaidi.
Somali: Goosashada yaanyada subaxdii hore ama galabtii dambe marka heerkulku yahay qiyaastii 20C iyo cimiladauna ay qalalan tahay. Kaydinta, yaanyada ku hay 12C iyo 86-90% qoyaan isbarbardhig ah - way burburayaan haddii la hayo ka hooseeya 10C muddo ka badan 2 toddobaad, ama ka hooseeya 5C muddo ka badan 6-8 maalmood, laakiin waxay socon karaan 2-3 toddobaad 10C ama ka sarreeya.
Dholuo: Tego pomade gokinyi mang'ich kata godhiambo ka liet mar piny chiegni 20C kendo yamo riyo.

English: Notice: KMTC opens a new ICT skills programme at the vocational centre in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inafungua programu mpya ya ujuzi wa ICT katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay ka furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan xirfadaha ICT ee xarunta xirfadda ee degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KMTC chako chenro manyien mar lony e yore mag ICT e skul mar tiegruok e county mar Nyeri.

English: If you use improved fallows (planting a cover crop/shrub to rest and restore land) to improve soil fertility, remember to replace the phosphorus removed when you cut the shrubs before you plant your next crop - add compost or manure, or for best results apply a phosphate fertilizer (such as DAP, SSP, TSP, or rock phosphate).
Kiswahili: Ikiwa unatumia magugu yaliyoboreshwa (kupanda mazao ya kufunika/mimea ya miche ili kupumzika na kurudisha udongo) ili kuboresha uzazi wa udongo, kumbuka kuchukua nafasi ya fosforasi iliyotolewa unapokatua miche kabla ya kupanda mazao yako ya pili - ongeza mbolea au uchafu, au kwa matokeo bora tumia mbolea ya phosphate (kama vile DAP, SSP, TSP, au phosphate ya mwamba).
Somali: Haddii aad isticmaasho fallows la hagaajiyay (beerista dhir daboolan/geed si loo nasto loona soo celiyo dhulka) si aad u kordhiso bacrinta ciidda, xasuuso inaad beddesho fosfooraska laga saaray markaad jarjarayso dhirta ka hor intaadan beerin dalagga xiga - ku dar compost ama bakhaar, ama natiijada ugu wanaagsan waxaad isticmaashaa bacriminta fosfoofate (sida DAP, SSP, TSP, ama rock phosphate).
Dholuo: Kapo ni itiyo gi yien ma osedok chien (tiyo gi yien ma opong'o lowo mondo omi lowo obed maber kendo obed maber), par ni inyalo kawo kar phosphorus ma ne igolo ka itieko yien ma ne idhi chwoyo kapok ichwoyo yien ma biro biro.

Kiswahili: Maelfu ya watoto wanarudi shuleni baada ya miezi tisa kufungwa.

Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.

Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba upatikanaji wa maelekezo ya makazi salama unapatikana bila malipo.

Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB inazuia harakati za ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi wenye uvimbe.

Kiswahili: Akina mama wanaofanya kazi wanaweza kukamua na kuhifadhi maziwa ya mama ili kuhakikisha unyonyeshaji unaoendelea wakiwa mbali.

English: CDC urges residents of Kericho County to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers following a rise in reported tuberculosis cases.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya kifua kikuu vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: CDC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska loo maleynayo inay u sheegaan mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaskii la sheegay ee cudurka 'tuberculosis'.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Kericho mondo onyis jorit malony mag thieth mar oganda ka luwore gi kaka kwan mar joma nigi tuberculosis osemedore.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Laikipia County starting this November.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kuanzia Novemba hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa in laga bilaabo Nofeembar la siinayo dadka deggan degmada Laikipia.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche lando ni dhialisi mar ji duto modak e County mar Laikipia biro chakore e dwe mar Novemba.

English: KNCHR broadcasts legal advice and civic topics on radio.
Kiswahili: KNCHR inatangaza ushauri wa kisheria na mada za kiraia kwenye redio.
Somali: KNCHR waxay raadiyaha ku baahineysaa la-talin sharci iyo mawduucyo bulshada.
Dholuo: KNCHR lando weche mag chike kod weche mag oganda e redio.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) appeals to caregivers in Mombasa County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the September maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhudhuria siku iliyopangwa ya kliniki kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi Septemba.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Mombasa inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta bukaanka ee la qorsheeyay qeyb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Sebtember.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) kwayo jorit e county mar Mombasa mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar thieth ma ne otim e dwe mar Septemba.

English: KTDA invites farmers in Busia County to a free training on post-harvest handling this January.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno Januari hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Busia tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan maareynta goosashada ka dib bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: KTDA gwelo jopur e county mar Busia e tiegruok ma onge chudo e dwe mar Januar.

English: SHA urges residents of Narok County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: SHA inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuwasilisha kumbukumbu za maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Narok inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay si loo qaabeeyo geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jogweng' kaunti mar Narok mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso bajet mar county ochopo.

English: Kenya led the 9th African Antiâ€‘Corruption Day urging unified action.
Kiswahili: Kenya iliongoza siku ya tisa ya kupambana na ufisadi barani Afrika ikihimiza hatua za umoja.
Somali: Kenya ayaa hormuud ka ahayd Maalinta 9-aad ee La-dagaallanka Musuqmaasuqa Afrika, iyadoo ku boorrisay in tallaabo mideysan la qaado.
Dholuo: Kenya ne otelo ne Odiechieng' mar 9 mar Afrika mar Kedo kod Misadhi ka jiwo ni ji otim gik moko e achiel.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Siaya County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya in si deg deg ah u soo sheegidda dhac ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne jogweng' Siaya County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo odno konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) advises residents of Turkana County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay biyo cabitaan ah ku kariyaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' County mar Turkana mondo omak pi modho kapok gitiyo kode mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Trans Nzoia County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia in warbixinta khiyaanada si deg deg ah ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogweng' mar Trans Nzoia County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar wuondruok konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Kenya: Integrated Vector Borne Diseases Outbreak - DREF nÂ° MDRKE050 - Operation update nÂ° 1
Kiswahili: Kenya: Mlipuko wa Magonjwa Yanayoenezwa na Vekta - DREF nÂ° MDRKE050 - Usasishaji wa operesheni nÂ° 1
Somali: Kenya: Cudurka Isku-dhafan ee Cudurrada Raaxada ee Vektor-ka - DREF nÂ° MDRKE050 - Cusboonaysiinta Hawlgalka nÂ° 1
Dholuo: Kenya: Tuoche ma oting'o tuoche ma kelo tuoche - DREF namba 1

English: KEMSA announces eye and dental camps for residents of Nairobi County starting this March.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatangaza kambi za macho na meno kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuanzia Machi hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa xeryaha indhaha iyo ilkaha ee dadka deggan degmada Nairobi laga bilaabo bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: KEMSA ogolo kambi mag thieth mag wang' kod lakteche mag laktech ne joma odak Nairobi County kochakore dwe mar Mach.

English: Kenya Dairy Board promotes agroforestry among farmers in Kisii County as part of the July climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inakuza kilimo cha misitu miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Julai.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa beeraleyda kaynta beeraha ee degmada Kisii iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka iska caabinta cimilada ee bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo yiende mag agroforestry e kind jopur e County mar Kisii kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi mar dwe mar Julai.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges residents of Narok County to register their children at the nearest public school to benefit from free primary education.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu ili kufaidika na elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Narok inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education ojiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni kodgi mondo giyud somo ma onge chudo.

English: AFA encourages farmers in Kirinyaga County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya mahindi.
Somali: AFA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Kirinyaga inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay hadhuudhka.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kirinyaga mondo ous olembe mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo, mondo omi olembe obed maber.

English: Be vigilant! Report school fee fraud to authorities.
Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu! Ripoti udanganyifu wa ada ya shule kwa mamlaka.
Somali: Ka taxaddar, u sheeg mas'uuliyiinta khiyaamooyinka lacagta iskuulka.
Dholuo: Bed motang', nyis jodong-kanyakla wach mibadhi mar skul.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges sweet potatoes growers in Murang'a County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda baradho macaan ee degmada Murang'a inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagula talinayo ka hor roobka si loo hagaajiyo goosashada xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur ma pidho olemo mag sweet potato e kaunti mar Murang'a mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue mondo omed kelo nyak e higani.

English: KMTC invites youth in Machakos County to enroll for tailoring and design training this March.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Machakos kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni Machi hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Machakos inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka tailoring iyo naqshadeynta bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: KMTC gwelo rowere e county mar Machakos mondo odonj e tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko e dwe mar Mach.

English: Recover learning! Join remedial classes after floods.
Kiswahili: Jiunge na madarasa ya kurekebisha baada ya mafuriko.
Somali: Waxbarashada dib u soo celinta! Ku biir fasallada dayactirka ka dib fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: Dhi e tiegruok mar konyo ji bang' koth maduong'.

English: This is due to the enhanced trade links between Kampala and different major cities in Kenya and the high-volume cross-border movement.
Kiswahili: Hii ni kutokana na kuimarishwa kwa uhusiano wa kibiashara kati ya Kampala na miji mikuu tofauti nchini Kenya na harakati za juu za kuvuka mpaka.
Somali: Tani waxay sabab u tahay xiriirka ganacsi ee sii kordhaya ee u dhexeeya Kampala iyo magaalooyinka waaweyn ee kala duwan ee Kenya iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa xaduudaha ee aadka u badan.
Dholuo: Mae en nikech tudruok ma medore mar ohala e kind Kampala kod mier madongo mopogre e piny Kenya kod kwan maduong' mar wuotho ​​mokalo tong'.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges residents of Nairobi County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on community-based development programmes.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waendelee kuwa na habari juu ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay la xiriiraan maamulayaasha degmooyinkooda si ay uga warqabaan barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General jiwo jogweng' mar Nairobi County mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jarit mar ward margi mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche momedore e wi chenro mag dongruok mag oganda.

English: Let us continue to observe the containment measures of hand washing, maintaining social and physical distance and wearing of face masks among others. #KomeshaCorona update.
Kiswahili: Wacha tuendelee kuzingatia hatua za kuzuia za kunawa mikono, kudumisha umbali wa kijamii na mwili na uvaaji wa barakoa kati ya zingine. #KomeshaCorona sasisho.
Somali: Aan sii wadno ilaalinta tallaabooyinka xakamaynta ee dhaqidda gacmaha, ilaalinta kala fogaanshaha bulshada iyo jirka iyo xirashada maaskaro wejiga iyo kuwa kale. #Cusbooneysiinta KomeshaCorona.
Dholuo: Wadhi nyime gi luwo yore mag geng’o tuoche mag lwoko lwedo, rito thuolo e kind ji kod rwako mask mag wang’ kod mamoko. #KomeshaKorona ma manyien.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Makueni County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the June planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Juni.
Somali: Guddiga Waxsoosaarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Makueni inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Makueni mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Jun.

English: TB is caused by poor diet, HIV AIDS, drunkenness of beer, smokingan diabatis. Spread this word!In unity we can finish TB
Kiswahili: Kifua kikuu husababishwa na lishe duni, UKIMWI, ulevi wa bia, uvutaji sigara na kisukari. Eneza habari hii! Kwa umoja tunaweza kumaliza Kifua kikuu
Somali: Cudurka TB waxaa sababi kara cunto xun, HIV AIDS, sakhraanka biya, sigaarka sigaarka.
Dholuo: Tuo mar TB en gima timore nikech chiemo marach, tuo mar HIV kod AYAKI, mer mar kong'o, madho ndawa, kod tuo mar diyabeti.

English: Ministry of Health encourages residents of Machakos County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inaysan ku xanuunsadaan aamusnaan iyo inay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health ojiwo jogweng' Machakos County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: KICD calls on the community in Nairobi County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KICD inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: KICD waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Nairobi inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: KICD luongo oganda man Nairobi County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo omi skunde obed ma onge tuoche.

English: KEMRI advises residents of Makueni County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa usaidizi wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMRI waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow si ay uga caawiyaan helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ee lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMRI nyiso jogweng' Makueni County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni mondo giyud kony mar yudo kony kuom weche thieth.

English: Notice: TSC opens a new tailoring and design programme at the vocational centre in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC inafungua programu mpya ya ushonaji na kubuni katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan dharka iyo naqshadeynta xarunta xirfadaha ee gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: TSC ochako chenro manyien mar loso kendo loso gik moko e otas mar tiegruok e gweng' mar Nyandarua.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public in Vihiga County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Vihiga juu ya umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay dadka degmada Vihiga ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay nadaafadda saxda ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji duto e County mar Vihiga kuom ber mar rito ler maler e ngima joot.
