English: The Ministry of Health has started substracting people and advicing people to keep distance to prevent themselves from Monkeypox in our country
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya imeanza kuwaondoa watu na kuwapa ushauri wa kuweka umbali ili kujiepusha na Monkeypox katika nchi yetu
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa bilowday in ay dadka ka dhigto kuwa aan caadi ahayn, waxayna dadka kula talineysaa in ay fogaadaan si looga hortago cudurka Monkeypox ee dalkeena.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth osechako chiko ji mondo kik gidonj e tuwo mar Monkeypox e pinywa.

English: Notice: EACC will hold a public participation forum on development planning forums in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta ee degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar EACC biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag dongruok e gweng' mar Kericho.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit announces NHIF/SHA claims support for residents of Makueni County starting this July.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinatangaza NHIF/SHA inadai msaada kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kuanzia Julai hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa ku dhawaaqday in NHIF/SHA ay sheegatay taageero loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Makueni laga bilaabo bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit olando ni NHIF/SHA dwaro kony ne jogweng' Makueni County kochakore Julai.

English: Protect rangelands and introduce management systems that protect feeding sources for livestock.
Kiswahili: Linda maeneo ya mbuga na kuanzisha mifumo ya usimamizi inayolinda chakula kwa ajili ya mifugo.
Somali: Ilaalinta dhul-goobaha iyo in la soo bandhigo nidaamyada maamulka ee ilaaliya ilaha quudinta xoolaha.
Dholuo: Rit kuonde ma ji ne dhi dakie kendo ket chenro mag rito kuonde ma ne ginyalo pidho jamni.

English: SHA advises residents of Vihiga County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: SHA inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: SHA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay qaataan dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado dib u dhac marka la raadinayo adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: SHA nyiso jogweng' mar County mar Vihiga mondo oting'e buge duto madwarore mondo kik gikel hinyruok sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport.

English: IPOA calls on residents of Nyeri County to support local peace-building committees in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: IPOA inatoa wito kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuunga mkono kamati za ujenzi wa amani katika kuunga mkono umakini wa kukabiliana na ugaidi.
Somali: IPOA waxay dadka deggan degmada Nyeri ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee deegaanka si ay u taageerayaan taxadarka ka dhanka ah argagixisada.
Dholuo: IPOA okwayo jogweng' Nyeri County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gweng'no e siro tich mar kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Notice: NTSA opens a gender desk offering free legal aid in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa msaada wa kisheria bure katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah degmada Nyamira.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NTSA ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony mar chike maonge chudo e County mar Nyamira.

English: State Department for Basic Education encourages residents of Nandi County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya ugatuzi.
Somali: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka Nandi waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabtaan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education ojiwo ji duto modak e county mar Nandi mondo ong'e weche ma giduto giduto giseyudo mondo ging'e kaka ibiro dwokgi.

English: KUCCPS opened applications for artisan certificate courses for 2016 KCSE candidates with D- and below at TVET institutions closing May 31 2017.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS ilifungua maombi ya kozi za vyeti vya ufundi kwa wagombea 2016 wa KCSE wenye D- na chini katika taasisi za TVET zilizofungwa Mei 31, 2017.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay codsiyada u furtay koorsooyinka shahaadooyinka farsamada ee 2016 musharixiinta KCSE ee leh D- iyo ka hooseeya machadyada TVET oo xirmaya 31 May 2017.
Dholuo: KUCCPS ne ochako kwayo mag tiegruok mag tij lwedo ne jokanyo mag KCSE mar 2016 ma nigi digri mar D kata matin ne mano e riwruoge mag TVET kochopo tarik 31 dwe mar abich 2017.

English: KNEC advises students in Kiambu County to collect materials from the county education office to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kukusanya vifaa kutoka kwa ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Somali: KNEC waxay ardayda degmada Kiambu kula talineysaa inay ka soo ururiyaan xogta xafiiska waxbarashada degmada si ay u helaan deeq waxbarasho ardayda u baahan.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jopuonjre e County mar Kiambu mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar somo mar county mondo giyud kony mar somo ne jopuonjre mochando.

English: Kenya confirms three cases of Covid-19 Omicron variant; Health CS Kagwe says it has been detected among travelers who have been quarantined
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha visa vitatu vya Covid-19 Omicron; Waziri wa Afya Kagwe anasema imegunduliwa miongoni mwa wasafiri ambao wametengwa
Somali: Kenya ayaa xaqiijisay saddex kiis oo ka mid ah noocyada Covid-19 Omicron; Health CS Kagwe ayaa sheegtay in lagu ogaaday dadka safarka ah ee ku jiray karantiil
Dholuo: Kenya osenyiso ni nitie ji adek ma nigi tuwo mar Covid-19 Omicron; Health CS Kagwe wacho ni ne ofwenyore e kind jowuoth ma ne ogol kar kendgi

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on residents of Laikipia County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of border security.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utoa wito kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida katika maeneo ya mpakani kwa vyombo vya usalama ili kuunga mkono usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga waxqabadka aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah si ay u taageeraan amniga xuduudda.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross okwayo jogweng' County mar Laikipia mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma rito tong'o ni gitimo gik maok kare e alworano.

English: CDC calls on parents in Siaya County to have children under five screened for meningitis during the June outreach.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa ugonjwa wa uti wa mgongo wakati wa ufikiaji wa Juni.
Somali: CDC waxay ku baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Siaya in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro meningitis intii lagu jiray bisha Juun.
Dholuo: CDC kwayo jonyuol e county mar Siaya mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Jun.

English: HELB urges parents and teachers in Homa Bay County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa usimamizi wa shule.
Somali: HELB waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta gobolka Homa Bay inay u soo sheegaan maamulka iskuulka wixii arrimo ah oo ku saabsan amniga.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj manie Homa Bay County mondo onyis sirkal mar skul weche duto ma chando ngima nyithindo.

English: COMESA advises farmers in Garissa County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuleta nambari yao ya usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Garissa inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qaybqaataan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Garissa mondo okel namba mar pimo jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges tea growers in Nakuru County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Nakuru inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagyada si loo soo celiyo miraha ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e county mar Nakuru mondo otim lokruok e pidho cham mondo piny obed gi nyak maber e kinde machuok.

English: OGP urges residents of Trans Nzoia County to attend the public participation forum to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si ay u qaabeeyaan wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynta.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo ji duto modak e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo odhi e chokruok mar konyo ji mondo ong'e kaka ginyalo loso chenro mag siasa.

English: DCI reminds the public in West Pokot County to remain vigilant on counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya West Pokot kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka gobolka West Pokot in ay sii joogaan feejignaanta ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: DCI parone ji duto e West Pokot County ni gibed motang' ne weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: KALRO urges farmers in Uasin Gishu County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Uasin Gishu inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KALRO ojiwo jopur e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo opidh cham ma opong'o lowo mondo okonygi loyo lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: Notice: TVET reminds citizens in Nyeri County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Somali: Ogsoonow: TVET waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Nyeri ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET paronwa raia mag Nyeri County kuom ratiro ma gin-go e wi ratiro mag chik.

English: CDC advises residents of Nairobi County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: CDC inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: CDC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay biyo cabitaan ah ku kariyaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: CDC nyiso jogweng' mar Nairobi County ni mondo omak pi modho kapok gitiyo kode mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Notice: TSC reminds citizens in Kitui County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Kitui ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TSC paronwa raia mag Kitui County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo gi ji duto e bajet mag county.

English: SHA reminds residents of Mandera County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: SHA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera in helitaanka adeegyada baasaboorka ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: SHA parone jogweng'o mag Mandera County ni koro ginyalo yudo weche mag passport e yo mayot ka gitiyo gi yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Kenya Dairy Board warns rice farmers in Tana River County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa mchele katika Wilaya ya Tana River juu ya mlipuko wa wadudu na inapendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda bariiska ee degmada Tana River cudurrada cayayaanka waxaana uu ku talinayaa in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho kodhi e taon mar Tana River County kuom masiche ma nyalo kelo tuoche, kendo ojiwo ni otim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: He said while he had nothing against vaccination, he had not found time to visit the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Alisema ingawa hakuwa na chochote dhidi ya chanjo, hajapata muda wa kutembelea kituo cha afya kilicho karibu naye.
Somali: Wuxuu sheegay in inkastoo uusan haysan wax ka dhan ah tallaalka, haddana uusan helin waqti uu ku booqdo xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Owacho ni kata obedo ni onge gima onyalo kwedo ng’ado chanjo, pok oyudo thuolo mar dhi e kar thieth man machiegni.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges residents of Embu County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuunga mkono halmashauri za ndani za kujenga amani wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo jogweng'o mag Embu County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi kuom rito tong'.

English: TVET announces distribution of school laptops under the digital literacy programme to schools in Tharaka-Nithi County this January.
Kiswahili: TVET inatangaza usambazaji wa kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa shule za Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Januari hii.
Somali: TVET waxay ku dhawaaqday qaybinta laptops-ka dugsiga barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Tharaka-Nithi bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: TVET ong'ado mar pogo kompyuta mag skul e bwo chenro mar somo gi somo mar digital e skunde mag Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar Januar.

English: NPS reminds mobile money users in Migori County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Migori wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Migori inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna si looga fogaado nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: NPS paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mobil e county mar Migori ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo gitang' gi chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development advises students in Samburu County to collect materials from the county education office to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Samburu kukusanya vifaa kutoka ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata kompyuta ndogo za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali.
Somali: Machadka Horumarinta Manhajka Kenya wuxuu ardayda degmada Samburu kula talinayaa inay ka soo ururiyaan waxyaabo xafiiska waxbarashada degmada si ay u helaan kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development nyiso jopuonjre e county mar Samburu mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar somo mar county mondo giyud kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar somo gi somo.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free cholera screening is available at all public health centres in Nandi County this October.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kipindupindu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Nandi Oktoba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka fayraska ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Nandi bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji ni nono tuo mar cholera onge tich e kuonde thieth duto mag oganda e County mar Nandi e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: NTSA alerts residents of Garissa County to a rise in fraud cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za ulaghai na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: NTSA waxay dadka deggan degmada Garissa uga wargelineysaa kororka kiisaska khiyaamada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar County mar Garissa kuom medruok mar weche mag wuondruok kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: KEPHIS advises fish producers in Mombasa County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawashauri wazalishaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kalluunka ee gobolka Mombasa inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur ma loso rech e county mar Mombasa mondo oti gi nengo matin mosing kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges residents of Lamu County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya dadka deggan degmada Lamu inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo jogweng' Lamu County mondo oriw lwedo weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'adoe bura nikech ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne ji.

English: DCI urges the public in Meru County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: DCI inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Meru kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha degmada Meru inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo ji duto e County mar Meru mondo ochiw ripot mar ote ma ok kare ne jatendgi mar tich bang' yudo weche manyiso wuond motudore gi SIM-swap.

English: TSC encourages out-of-school children in Nakuru County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under free primary education.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: TSC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Nakuru inay dalbadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Go outside! Take a walk, run, jog, or hike. Get some fresh air. BeActive. Spend time enjoying sunrises and sunsets to put your mind at ease. It might be difficult at the start but patience and
Kiswahili: Nenda nje! Nenda kutembea, kukimbia, kuendesha gari, au kutembea. Pata hewa safi. Uwe na shughuli nyingi. Tumia wakati kufurahia kuchomoza jua na machweo ya jua ili kuutuliza akili yako.
Somali: Tag dibadda, socod, ordi, orod, ama socod. Hawo nadiif ah qaato. BeActive. Waqti ku qaato raaxaysan qorrax ka soo baxda iyo qorrax dhaca si aad maskaxdaada u sii raaxeysato. Waxay noqon kartaa mid adag bilowgii, laakiin samir iyo
Dholuo: Wuog oko, dhi bayo, ringo, kata wuoth, yud muya moromo. Bed gi chuny mar tiyo gi thuolo moromo e neno ka chieng' wuok kendo ka chieng ' podho mondo chunyi obed mokuwe.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service issues a cybersecurity alert on mobile money scams affecting residents of Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu zinazoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu soo saaray digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khayaanada lacagta mobile ee saameyn ku leh dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Forest Service ogolo siem mar sirkal mar cybersecurity kuom timbe mag wuond mag pesa mitimo gi simo ma mulo joma odak e Homa Bay County.

English: NCPB urges sweet potatoes growers in Trans Nzoia County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda baradho macaan ee degmada Trans Nzoia inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si loo wanaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur ma pidho adundo e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo okaw kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed kelo nyak e higani.

Kiswahili: Mpito 100%: Kila Darasa la 6 lazima aripoti kwa JSS "hakuna kukaa nyumbani!
Somali: Kala-guur 100% ah: Fasal kasta oo 6 jir ah waa inuu u soo sheegaa JSS - ha joogin guriga!
Dholuo: 100% loko: Ng’ato ka ng’ato ma ni e klas mar 6 nyaka ogol ripot ne JSS Ã¢Â€Â“ ok onego odong’ e ot!

English: FAO promotes soil conservation among farmers in Kilifi County as part of the September climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: FAO inakuza uhifadhi wa udongo miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa Septemba.
Somali: FAO waxay dhiirrigelisay ilaalinta ciidda beeraleyda degmada Kilifi iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo rito lowo e kind jopur e gweng' mar Kilifi kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo kinda mar kedo gi lokruok e kor lwasi e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya alerts residents of Mombasa County to a rise in fraud cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za ulaghai na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay uga digtay dadka deggan degmada Mombasa in ay kordheen kiisaska khiyaamooyinka waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Communications Authority chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar County mar Mombasa kuom medruok mar kes mag wuondruok kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Tana River County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuleta nambari yao ya usajili wa mkulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Guddiga xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Tana River inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qaybqaataan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e taon mar Tana River County mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: KEMSA launches a March awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Makueni County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Machi juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Somali: KEMSA waxay bilowday olole wacyi galineed oo ku saabsan cadaadiska dhiig karka ee Maarso ee degmada Makueni.
Dholuo: KEMSA ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Mach e wi wach ng'eyo ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar hypertension e gweng' mar Makueni.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) warns public officers in Nandi County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Nandi dhidi ya rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Nandi inay musuqmaasuqa ka qaataan xafiisyada dowladda.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Nandi kuom kawo asoya e migepe mar sirkal.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will hold a stress management forum in Taita-Taveta County this February. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanya kongamano la kudhibiti mafadhaiko katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta Februari hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay qaban doontaa madasha maareynta stress-ka ee Taita-Taveta County bisha Febraayo. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo romo mar kedo gi parruok e taon mar Taita-Taveta e dwe mar Februar.

English: Laikipia County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for November 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Laikipia: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Novemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Laikipia: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Noofambar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Laikipia: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2022

English: Provide livestock supplementary feeds to cattle, sheep, and goats at risk in drought hotspots, and enhance livestock health through deworming and treatment.
Kiswahili: Toa malisho ya ziada ya mifugo kwa ng'ombe, kondoo, na mbuzi walio hatarini katika maeneo ya ukame, na kuimarisha afya ya mifugo kupitia dawa ya minyoo na matibabu.
Somali: Bixinta xoolo-dhaqameedka xoolo-dheeraadka ah ee lo'da, idaha, iyo riyaha halista ku jira meelaha abaaraha, iyo kor u qaadista caafimaadka xoolaha iyada oo loo marayo cayayaanka iyo daaweynta.
Dholuo: Chiw chiemo momedore ne dhok, rombe, kod diek ma nyalo bedo e bwo chandruok mar oro, kendo medo tuoche mag jamni kokalo kuom thieth kod thieth.

English: Notice from Kenya Red Cross: postnatal check-ups clinics will run every March at designated health centres in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya: kliniki za uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa zitaendeshwa kila Machi katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya: Caafimaadka baaritaanka dhalmada ka dib waxaa lagu sameyn doonaa bishii Maarso xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ripot Mamit mar Kenya: Klinike mag nonro bang' nyuol ibiro timie higa ka higa e dwe mar Mach e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Baringo.

English: KNEC conducts national training to equip schools and educators on new online e-assessment tools.
Kiswahili: KNEC inafanya mafunzo ya kitaifa ili kuwawezesha shule na walimu kutumia zana mpya za tathmini za mtandaoni.
Somali: KNEC waxay qabaneysaa tababar qaran oo loogu talagalay in lagu qalabeeyo dugsiyada iyo macallimiinta qalabka cusub ee qiimeynta elektaroonigga ah ee internetka.
Dholuo: KNEC timo tiegruok e piny mangima mondo otieg skunde kod jopuonj gi gige timo nonro manyien e intanet.

English: CDC urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Mombasa County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: CDC inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: CDC waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee gobolka Mombasa inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nyagore gi tuoche mag obwongo e county mar Mombasa mondo odhi ir japuonj molony.

English: NTSA reminds mobile money users in Machakos County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Machakos inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado khiyaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: NTSA paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e County ma Machakos ni mondo ging'e kwayo mag pesa kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo kik gitim mibadhi mar SIM-swap.

English: Notice: e-Citizen opens voter education centres in Vihiga County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: e-Citizen waxay furaysaa xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee degmada Vihiga bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni e-Citizen biro yawo kuonde tiego josiasa e kaunti mar Vihiga e dwe mar Februar.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Nyandarua County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta deegaanka iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ojiwo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: AFA urges farmers in Kericho County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kericho inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddelka qaabka roobabka.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kericho mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e weche mag pur mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Announcing the launch of Kenya Market Assessment highlighting need for warning labels under new nutrient profiling model.
Kiswahili: Kutangaza uzinduzi wa Tathmini ya Soko la Kenya ikiangazia hitaji la lebo za tahadhari chini ya mfumo mpya wa uainishaji wa virutubisho.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqista daahfurka Qiimaynta Suuqa Kenya oo muujinaysa baahida loo qabo calaamadaha digniinta ee qaabka cusub ee lagu soo bandhigayo nafaqada.
Dholuo: Olando chakruok mar Rang’o mar Chiro mar Kenya ma nyiso dwaro mar keto lebel mag riembo e bwo yo manyien mar ng’iyo gik ma konyo e ringruok.

English: KEMRI advises residents of Bomet County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: KEMRI waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun iyo biyo nadiif ah si joogto ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng' County mar Bomet mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Kenya Red Cross launches a March awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Machi juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed oo ku saabsan cadaadiska dhiig karka ee Maarso ee ku baahsan degmada Makueni.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross osechako kampen mar chiwo paro e wi tuwo mar hypertension e dwe mar Mach e gweng' mar Makueni.

English: DPP alerts residents of Uasin Gishu County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: DPP anawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: DPP waxay dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu uga digtay kororka kiisaska xoolaha lagu xado waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: DPP chiwo siem ne jogweng' Uasin Gishu County e wi medruok mar weche mag kwalo jamni kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Kenyan Deputy President, development partners, meet in support of food security in Kenya
Kiswahili: Naibu Rais wa Kenya, washirika wa maendeleo, wakutana kuunga mkono usalama wa chakula nchini Kenya
Somali: Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka Kenya iyo la-hawlgalayaasha horumarinta, ayaa kulan ku yeeshay taageerada amniga cuntada ee Kenya
Dholuo: Jatend piny Kenya, jowete mag dongruok, romo mar konyo bedo gi chiemo e piny Kenya

English: Adaptive Management in Refugee Programming: Lessons from Re:Build, June 2023
Kiswahili: Usimamizi Inayobadilika katika Utayarishaji wa Wakimbizi: Masomo kutoka kwa Re:Build, Juni 2023
Somali: Maareynta La Qabsiga ee Barnaamijyada Qaxootiga: Casharrada laga soo qaatay Dib-u-dhiska, Juun 2023
Dholuo: Chiwruok mowinjore e chenro mar jolweny: Gik ma wapuonjore kowuok kuom gero kendo, dwe mar auchiel 2023

English: Huduma Kenya encourages first-time voters in Turkana County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Turkana kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku dhiirigelisay codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Turkana inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jogo ma ne okwongo yiero e county mar Turkana mondo olim kama ichikoe ji ne IEBC.

English: Narok County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Narok: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Narok: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Narok: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Septemba 2022

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ee degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Huduma Kenya biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e kaunti mar Isiolo.

English: KICD calls on the community in Machakos County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KICD inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Machakos kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: KICD waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Machakos inay taageeraan jawiga waxbarasho ee ka kooban si loo ilaaliyo nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: KICD luongo ji duto manie County ma Machakos mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Notice: KUCCPS launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri katika shule kote Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay bilawday barnaamij adeegyo hagis iyo la-talin ah oo ku yaal dugsiyada gobolka Nairobi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KUCCPS chako chenro mar tiego kendo chiwo paro e skunde duto mag Nairobi County.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges youth in Laikipia County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ugu baaqay dhalinyarada degmada Laikipia inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda ka hor inta aysan qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo rowere e Kaunti mar Laikipia mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto gikwongo tiyogo ka pok gichako timo tije mag sirkal.

English: KICD advises students in Nyamira County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: KICD inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Somali: KICD waxay ardayda degmada Nyamira kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan buugaag iyo qalab waxbarasho.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo jopuonjre e County mar Nyamira mondo oketgi e websait mar somo e yor intanet mondo giyud buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok.

English: DPP urges the public in Tana River County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: DPP inawasihi raia wa Wilaya ya Tana River wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za ujumbe wa udanganyifu.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa shacabka degmada Tana River County inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo ji duto manie Tana River County mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo weche mag twege mag phishing.

English: Taita Taveta County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Taita Taveta: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Februari 2024
Somali: Degmada Taita Taveta: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Taita Taveta: Oboke machon mar goyo oro mar dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2024

English: EACC urges residents of Nyeri County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: EACC inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si loo qaabeeyo dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Nyeri mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar nono tich ma gitimo higa ka higa.

English: NTSA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Murang'a County that access to free legal aid is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisheria wa bure unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Murang'a in la heli karo caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah oo lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: NTSA paronwa jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Murang'a ni ginyalo yudo kony ma onge chudo.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces SHA registration for residents of Kilifi County starting this July.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatangaza usajili wa SHA kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kuanzia Julai hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa diiwaangelinta SHA ee dadka deggan degmada Kilifi laga bilaabo bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche ogolo chik mar SHA mar ndiko joma odak e County mar Kilifi kochakore dwe mar Julai.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response appeals to caregivers in Turkana County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the April maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Aprili.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Turkana inay ka soo qeybgalaan maalinta bukaanka ee la qorsheeyay iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Abriil.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo kwayo jorit e County mar Turkana mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar thieth ma ne otim e dwe mar April.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Kakamega County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada ay fatahaadu ka dhacdo inta lagu jiro xilliyada shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross parone jogweng' Kakamega County ni kik ging'ad kor lwasi ma pi opong'o yiedhi e nderni.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET reminds citizens in Mombasa County about their rights regarding devolution.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda TVET waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Mombasa xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar State for TVET paronwa raia mag Mombasa County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar golo pesa.

English: IEBC reminds residents of Kiambu County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: IEBC parone jogweng' Kiambu County ni luwo dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Kenya: Humanitarian impact of heavy rains and flooding - Flash Update #1 (8 November 2023)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Athari za kibinadamu za mvua kubwa na mafuriko - Sasisho la Flash #1 (8 Novemba 2023)
Somali: Kenya: Saamaynta Bani'aadamnimada ee Roobabka Mahiigaanka ah iyo Daadadka - Cusboonaysiinta Degdegga ah #1 (8 Noofambar 2023)
Dholuo: Kenya: Midhiero mag koth mang'eny kod pi mopong'o ne dhano - Oboke mapiyo #1 (8 dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2023)

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will distribute certified millet seed to farmers in Kilifi County this April.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu zilizothibitishwa za millet kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu abuuraha degmada Kilifi u qaybin doonaa abuurka miraha loo yaqaan 'millet seed' bishii Abriil ee sannadkan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro pogo kodhi mag millet ne jopur manie Kilifi County e dwe mar April.

English: DCI calls on residents of Laikipia County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: DCI waxay ku baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: DCI okwayo jogweng' County mar Laikipia mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji nitie mondo okony chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne joma odak e alworano.

English: Societal pressures and gender-based discrimination can contribute to stress and mental health challenges.
Kiswahili: Shinikizo la kijamii na ubaguzi wa kijinsia vinaweza kuchangia msongo wa mawazo na changamoto za afya ya akili.
Somali: Dhibaatooyinka bulshada iyo takoorka jinsiga ku salaysan waxay gacan ka geysan karaan stress iyo dhibaatooyinka caafimaadka dhimirka.
Dholuo: Tembe mag oganda koda buono ji nikech dichwo gi dhako nyalo miyo ng'ato obed gi parruok mang'eny koda chandruok mag paro.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges residents of Kwale County to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night following a rise in reported measles cases.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kutumia vyandarua vilivyotiwa dawa ya kuua wadudu kila usiku kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya surua.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka ee lagu daaweeyo jeermiska habeen kasta ka dib kororka kiisaska suuxdinta ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo jogweng' mar Kwale County mondo oti gi otamba molos gi ndawa otieno ka otieno nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuwono osemedore.

English: KNEC invites youth in Nyamira County to enroll for electrical installation training this December.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Desemba hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nyamira inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: KNEC gwelo rowere e County mar Nyamira mondo odonj e tiegruok mar keto sitima e dwe mar Desemba.

English: SHA urges residents of Baringo County to attend the public participation forum to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: SHA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si ay u qaabeeyaan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jogweng' Baringo County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar timo chenro mar dongruok.

English: Govâ€™t activates public health emergency operation centres across the country after case of Monkeypox confirmed in Taita Taveta County
Kiswahili: Serikali inazindua vituo vya huduma za dharura za afya ya umma kote nchini baada ya kesi ya Monkeypox kuthibitishwa katika Kaunti ya Taita Taveta

Dholuo: <2Zepa> Sirkal ok oketo tich kuom kuonde thieth mapiyo mag oganda e piny mangima bang' yudo tuwo mar ng'ut ng'ato e gweng' mar Taita Taveta

English: Notice: KMTC reminds citizens in Kirinyaga County about their rights regarding the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuhusu haki zao kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Kirinyaga ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC paronwa raia mag Kirinyaga County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo ombudsman.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya launches a theft prevention campaign in Nandi County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Nandi Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada gobolka Nandi bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chako kampen mar geng'o kuo e taon mar Nandi e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: TSC opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Narok County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay furaysaa codsiyada deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan ardayda barta gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TSC oseyawo kwayo mag yudo riekni mag somo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e gweng' mar Narok.

English: FAO urges poultry farmers in Bungoma County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: FAO inawataka wafugaji wa kuku katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa Newcastle vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda digaagga ee degmada Bungoma inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo ka dib kiisaska cudurka Newcastle ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma pidho dhok e county mar Bungoma mondo ogeng' legi e kuonde moketi mag chamo le bang' yudo weche mag tuo mar Newcastle.

English: ACLED Regional Overview Africa: September 2024
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Kikanda wa ACLED Afrika: Septemba 2024
Somali: Dulmar Goboleed oo ACLED ah Afrika: Sebtembar 2024
Dholuo: ACLED Oboke mar Afrika: Septemba 2024

English: @MOH_Kenya CAS Dr Rashid Aman flags off the National Cervical Cancer Awareness walk in Makueni County. 34% of girls have received HPV vaccine in county & target is 100% by March #StopCervicalCancer @WHOKenya @Cancerinkenya @Women4Cancer @KancoKE @BeyondZe
Kiswahili: @MOH_Kenya CAS Dkt Rashid Aman akipeperusha bendera ya matembezi ya Kitaifa ya Kuelimisha Saratani ya Shingo ya Kizazi katika Kaunti ya Makueni. Asilimia 34 ya wasichana wamepokea chanjo ya HPV katika kaunti na lengo ni 100% kufikia Machi #StopCervicalCan
Somali: @MOH_Kenya CAS Dr Rashid Aman ayaa ka hadlay socodkii wacyigelinta kansarka ilmo-galeenka ee Degmada Makueni. 34% gabdhaha ayaa qaatay tallaalka HPV ee degmada, bartilmaameedkuna waa 100% Maarso #JoojiCervicalCervicalCervicalCervical @WHOKenya @Cancerinkenya @Women4Cancer @KancoKE @BeyondZe

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inaamsha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada wuxuu soo saaraa qorshe falcelin deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay shilalka waddooyinka ee degmada Mandera.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche motudore gi weche mag mahundu chako tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony e masiche mag ndara e gweng' mar Mandera.

English: AFA promotes agroforestry among farmers in Samburu County as part of the July climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: AFA inakuza kilimo cha misitu kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Julai.
Somali: AFA waxay kor u qaadeysaa beeraleyda kaynta beeraha ee Gobolka Samburu iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka u adkaysiga cimilada ee bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo yiende mag yiende e kind jopur e county mar Samburu kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi e dwe mar Julai.

English: Ministry of Education reminds youth in Wajir County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa upishi na mafunzo ya ukarimu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Wajir in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Puonjruok parone rowere e gweng' mar Wajir ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar chiemo kod mar rwako welo.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Nairobi County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the January planting season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Januari.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Nairobi inay si dhaqso leh u xakameeyaan cayayaanka dayrta iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development nyiso jopur e County mar Nairobi mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e chak higa ka gitiyo gi thieth mag thieth moting'o yedhe mamero e dwe mar Januar.

English: State of the Climate Kenya 2022
Kiswahili: Hali ya Hali ya Hewa Kenya 2022
Somali: Xaaladda Cimilada Kenya 2022
Dholuo: Kido mar kor lwasi e piny Kenya 2022

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development opens a new catering and hospitality programme at the vocational centre in West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yafungua mpango mpya wa upishi na ukarimu katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ka furayaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan cuntada iyo marti-gelinta xarunta xirfadaha ee Gobolka West Pokot.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ochako chenro manyien mar chiemo kod rwako welo e kar tich e West Pokot County.

English: DPP reminds the public in Vihiga County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: DPP inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Vihiga inay ka feejignaadaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: DPP parone ji duto e County mar Vihiga mondo obed motang' gi chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: IPOA reminds the public in Wajir County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: IPOA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Wajir inay ka feejignaadaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa ji duto e gweng' mar Wajir mondo obed motang' gi chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: Kwale County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for December 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kwale: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Desemba 2023
Somali: Degmada Kwale: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Diseembar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kwale: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2023

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the community in Embu County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb carjacking.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Embu kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua ili kuzuia utekaji nyara wa gari.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya bulshada degmada Embu inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha si loo xakameeyo afduubka gawaarida.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ji duto e county mar Embu mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Kwale County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Kwale in helitaanka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone mine ma biro bedo gi ich e county mar Kwale ni thuolo mar yudo puonj mag chenro mag ngima joot en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag oganda.

English: Isiolo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Isiolo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2024
Somali: Degmada Isiolo: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Isiolo: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Oktoba 2024

English: Kenya: IPC Acute Food Insecurity and Acute Malnutrition Analysis (March - June 2022) Published on June 10, 2022
Kiswahili: Kenya: IPC Ukosefu wa Chakula Mkali na Uchambuzi Mkali wa Utapiamlo (Machi - Juni 2022) Limechapishwa mnamo Juni 10, 2022
Somali: Kenya: Falanqaynta IPC ee Amniga Cuntada Degdegga ah iyo Nafaqada Ba'an (Maarso - Juun 2022) La daabacay Juun 10, 2022
Dholuo: Kenya: Nonro mar IPC mar bedo maongee arita mar chiemo kod bedo gi chiemo mowinjore (Dwe mar Adek - Auchiel 2022) Ogoye tarik 10 dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2022

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds livestock keepers in Narok County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Narok kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya xoolaha ka shaqeeya Gobolka Narok in ay xoolahooda tallaalaan goobaha lagu burburiyo ee loo qoondeeyay si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board paronwa jorit jamni e Narok County ni mondo gimi jamnigi thieth e kuonde moyier mag nego jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: KICD encourages out-of-school children in Mombasa County to register their children at the nearest public school under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: KICD inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: KICD waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Mombasa inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga dadweynaha ee ugu dhow fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e county mar Mombasa mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni gi skul mar ji duto.

English: TSC encourages out-of-school children in Kiambu County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya mgao wa bursary.
Somali: TSC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Kiambu inay codsadaan deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga ugu dambeeya ee loo qoondeeyay deeqda waxbarashada.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo nyithindo maok dhi e skul e Kaunti mar Kiambu mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) updates residents of Kisumu County on progress of community-based development programmes this October.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu maendeleo ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii mwezi Oktoba.
Somali: Guddiga Garsoorka Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Kisumu ka warbixiyaa horumarka barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada ee bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chiwo ripot ne Jo-Kisumu County kuom dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag oganda e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: State Department for TVET urges youth in Garissa County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Garissa inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo rowere man e County mar Garissa mondo onon weche ma gin-go mar ndiko ji kapok gitimo tije mag sirkal.

English: Gachagua Urges International Community to Pressure President Ruto Over IEBC Appointment
Kiswahili: Gachagua aomba jumuiya ya kimataifa kushinikiza Rais Ruto juu ya uteuzi wa IEBC
Somali: Gachagua oo Beesha Caalamiga ah ugu baaqay in ay cadaadis ku saaraan Madaxweyne Ruto magacaabista IEBC
Dholuo: Gachagua Ojiwo Riwruok mar Piny Mangima Mondo Oket Masira ne Jatelo Ruto Kuom Yiero mar IEBC

English: KRA reminds the public in Makueni County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this January.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba ushiriki katika mashauriano ya sera za umma unakaribishwa Januari hii.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Makueni in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: KRA oparo ne ji duto e gweng' mar Makueni ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mag chenro mag sirkal e dwe mar Januar.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Kajiado County about the importance of diabetes screening for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuhusu umuhimu wa uchunguzi wa kisukari kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay dadka degmada Kajiado ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda baaritaanka sonkorowga uu u leeyahay caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji duto e Kajiado County kuom ber mar nonro mar thieth mar sukari e ngima joot.

English: KEPHIS informs maize farmers in Nairobi County of new market linkage opportunities this November.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawafahamisha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Novemba hii.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Nairobi fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha November.
Dholuo: KEPHIS nyiso jopur mag kodhi e County mar Nairobi e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Novemba.

English: NPS reminds residents of Meru County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kusakinisha na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay guryahooda ku rakibaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo shaqada inta lagu jiro xilliyada dabka.
Dholuo: NPS parone jogweng' mar Meru County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo giti e kinde mag yiengni.

English: Farmers in Kitale are invited to explore seedling propagation opportunities to recover from financial losses in agriculture Take action to diversify your agribusiness today
Kiswahili: Wakulima mjini Kitale wamealikwa kuchunguza fursa za uenezaji wa miche ili kupata nafuu kutokana na hasara za kifedha katika kilimo Chukua hatua kubadilisha kilimo biashara yako leo.
Somali: Beeraleyda Kitale waxaa lagu casuumay inay sahmiyaan fursadaha taranka abuurka si ay uga soo kabtaan khasaaraha dhaqaale ee beeraha. Tallaabo qaado si aad u kala duwanaato ganacsigaaga beeraha maanta
Dholuo: Josupni e Kitale igwelo mondo onon thuolo mag pidho kodhi mondo giyud pesa ma ginyalo yudo kuom gik ma ne olal e tij pur.

English: Vaccinate shoats against PPR and CCPP, and cattle against FMD and LSD, to reduce livestock disease outbreaks.
Kiswahili: Vacinate shoats dhidi ya PPR na CCPPP, na ng'ombe dhidi ya FMD na LSD, ili kupunguza mweneo wa magonjwa ya mifugo.
Somali: Tallaal ku qaado shoats si ay uga hortagaan PPR iyo CCPP, iyo lo'da si looga hortago FMD iyo LSD, si loo yareeyo faafitaanka cudurrada xoolaha.
Dholuo: Tigo mar thieth mar tuoche mag dhok e tieko tuoche mag PPR kod CCPP, kod tuoche mag FMD kod LSD.

English: Kenya 2022 Drought Response in Review
Kiswahili: Mwitikio wa Ukame wa Kenya 2022 Katika Uhakiki
Somali: Dib u Eegis ku saabsan Jawaab celinta Abaarta Kenya 2022
Dholuo: Duoko mar oro higa mar 2022 e piny Kenya

English: Notice: IEBC opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Wananchi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa goob adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-muwaadiniinta degmada Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag e-Citizen registration e Trans Nzoia County.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette opens voter education centres in Vihiga County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Kenya Gazette waxay dib u furaysaa xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee degmada Vihiga bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Gazette chako tiego josiasa e kaunti mar Vihiga e dwe mar Desemba.

English: TSC advises applicants in Meru County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: TSC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Meru kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: TSC waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Meru inay dalbadaan booska TVET iyada oo loo marayo KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: TSC nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Meru mondo oketgi e tiegruok mar TVET kokalo kuom KUCCPS.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Bomet County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Bomet inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kalfadhiga tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur e county mar Bomet mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e tiego jopur mabiro.

English: KICD develops new digital learning content specifically tailored for Early Childhood Development Education (ECDE).
Kiswahili: KICD huendeleza maudhui mapya ya kujifunza ya digital iliyoundwa hasa kwa ajili ya Elimu ya Maendeleo ya Utoto wa Mapema (ECDE).
Somali: KICD waxay soo saartaa waxyaabaha cusub ee barashada dhijitaalka ah ee si gaar ah loogu talagalay Waxbarashada Horumarinta Carruurta Hore (ECDE).
Dholuo: KICD loso weche manyien mag puonjruok mar digital mochan e yo malong'o ahinya ne tiegruok mar dongruok mar nyithindo matindo (ECDE).

English: Teachers Service Commission encourages out-of-school children in Isiolo County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Isiolo inay codsadaan deeq waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e gweng' mar Isiolo mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: State Department for Basic Education reminds schools in Vihiga County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this April.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Aprili hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay xusuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Vihiga inay xoojiyaan adeegyada hagista iyo la-talinta bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education oparo ne skunde e County mar Vihiga mondo omed jiwo kendo chiwo kony e dwe mar April.

English: MSF: Test and treat approach: How communities lead in malaria treatment
Kiswahili: MSF: Mbinu ya kupima na kutibu: Jinsi jamii zinavyoongoza katika matibabu ya malaria

Dholuo: MSF: Yo mar timo pim kendo thiedho: Kaka oganda telo e thieth mar maleria

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa simu ya GBV ya bure katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya ayaa furtay xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya khadka caawimaadda GBV ee bilaashka ah ee gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji ochako tiyo gi ofis mar joma ok gin rowere e gwenge mag Nyandarua County.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya calls on residents of Machakos County to support local peace-building committees in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za mitaa kusaidia tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee deegaanka si ay u taageerayaan taxadarka ka dhanka ah argagixisada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji (Communications Authority of Kenya) kwayo jogweng' ma Machakos County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gweng'no mondo gikony e kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Notice: IEBC launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay bilawday barnaamij ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada iskuulada guud ahaan degmada Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IEBC chako chenro mar rito nyithindo e skul e skunde duto mag Trans Nzoia County.

English: Breast milk contains nutrients vital for a baby's brain development.
Kiswahili: Maziwa ya mama yana virutubisho muhimu kwa ukuaji wa ubongo wa mtoto.
Somali: Caanaha naaska waxay ka kooban yihiin nafaqooyin muhiim u ah horumarka maskaxda ilmaha.
Dholuo: Chak mar min nigi gik ma konyo e dongruok mar obwongo mar nyathi.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Kakamega County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kukaa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kakamega inay ka qeybgalaan kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada si ay uga warqabaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo ji duto modak e Kaunti mar Kakamega mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar kaunti mondo omed ng'eyo chenro mar dongruok e kaunti.

English: Notice: AFA restricts movement of dairy cows in Kakamega County due to a rabies outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA inazuia harakati za ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kutokana na mlipuko wa kichaa cha mbwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da caanaha ah ee Gobolka Kakamega sababtuna tahay cudurka Cudurka.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: AFA ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok makwayo chak e Kaunti mar Kakamega nikech tuwo mar rabies.

English: Drops of hope in drought stricken Garissa
Kiswahili: Matone ya matumaini katika ukame wakumba Garissa
Somali: Rajo xumo ka jirta Garissa oo abaartu saameysay
Dholuo: Dhoge mag geno e oro ma omako Garissa

English: Status of mobility of livestock in Kenya: Mapping of livestock routes and case studies on mobility blockages
Kiswahili: Hali ya uhamaji wa mifugo nchini Kenya: Kuchora ramani ya njia za mifugo na tafiti kuhusu vizuizi vya uhamaji
Somali: Xaaladda dhaqdhaqaaqa xoolaha ee Kenya: Khariidaynta waddooyinka xoolaha iyo daraasadaha kiisaska ee ku saabsan xannibaadaha dhaqdhaqaaqa
Dholuo: Kido mar wuotho ​​mar le e piny Kenya: Mapo mar yore mag le kod nonro mag gik ma geng’o wuotho

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by CDC will be held in Nyamira County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na CDC itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabiyeen CDC ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Nyamira bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kampen mar thieth ma onge chudo ma CDC ochano biro timore Nyamira County e dwe mar Agost.

English: KTDA warns millet farmers in Kajiado County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Kajiado juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KTDA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda cawska ee degmada Kajiado cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: KTDA chiwo siem ne jopur mag millet e Kajiado County kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: DPP reminds residents of Kisumu County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: DPP anawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu in si dhakhso leh u soo sheegaan jabsashada ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogweng' mar Kisumu County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar donjo e ot konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges residents of Meru County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education ojiwo ji duto modak e county mar Meru mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud somo mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: Notice: IPOA issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa utambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka ah oo ku saabsan dhacda aqoonsiga oo saameyn ku leh dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Rapar: IPOA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity e wi kuo mar ng'ato makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e county mar Uasin Gishu.

English: AFA advises farmers in Kwale County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: AFA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: AFA waxay kula talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kwale inay ka soo qayb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e county mar Kwale mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Gov't calls for wearing of masks as country battles 6th Covid-19 wave
Kiswahili: Serikali yatoa wito wa kuvaa barakoa huku nchi ikipambana na wimbi la 6 la Covid-19
Somali: Dowladdu waxay ku baaqeysaa xirashada maaskaro maadaama waddanku la dagaallamo hirka lixaad ee COVID-19
Dholuo: Sirkal dwaro ni ji orwak lewni mag geng'ruok e kinde lweny mar 6 mar Covid-19

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service launches a cattle rustling prevention campaign in Lamu County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Lamu Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu billaabay olole looga hortago xanta xoolaha ee Gobolka Lamu bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Forest Service chako kampen mar geng'o ywaruok mag dhok e taon mar Lamu e dwe mar Januar.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds livestock keepers in Kajiado County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Kajiado inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development oparo ne jopur mag jamni e Kajiado County ni mondo gimi jamnigi thieth e kuonde moyier mag chwoyo jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.
