English: OGP invites residents of Tana River County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: OGP inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Tana River kuwasilisha maandishi ya kumbukumbu kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: OGP waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: OGP gwelo ji duto modak e taon mar Tana River County mondo ochiw paro mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar wuoyo e wi chenro mag sirkal.

English: Notice: KRA will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ee gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KRA biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag siasa e kaunti mar Uasin Gishu.

English: FAO urges cassava growers in Kisumu County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawahimiza wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda cassava ee degmada Kisumu inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka xilliga dayrta iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaannada la oggolaaday si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma pidho manias e gweng' mar Kisumu mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e kinde mag koth ka gitiyo gi tuoche maloso yiendgi e higani.

English: TSC January 2026 salary paid early + 25% housing allowance ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…â€œ check bank!
Kiswahili: TSC Januari 2026 mshahara kulipwa mapema + 25% nyumba allowance check bank!
Somali: Mushaharka TSC Janaayo 2026 ayaa la bixiyay hore + 25% gunnada guryaha ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…â€œ jeeg bangiga!
Dholuo: TSC dwe mar achiel higa mar 2026 chudo ochul motelo + 25% mar pesa mag gedo mag ot.

English: The Nairobi Coffee Exchange auction occurs every Tuesday open to the public Coffee is traded in 50kg bags with current prices available for interested stakeholders
Kiswahili: Mnada wa Soko la Kahawa Nairobi hufanyika kila Jumanne wazi kwa umma Kahawa inauzwa kwa magunia ya kilo 50 na bei ya sasa inapatikana kwa washikadau wanaopenda.
Somali: Kulanka qandaraaska ee Nairobi Coffee Exchange ayaa dhacda Talaado kasta oo u furan dadweynaha. Qaafka waxaa lagu ganacsadaa 50kg bacda qiimaha hadda la heli karo daneeyayaasha daneynaya
Dholuo: Ohala mar Nairobi Coffee Exchange timore Tich Ariyo ka Tich Ariyo ma ne open ne ji duto.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Narok County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Narok inay yareeyaan qaadashada cusbada iyo sonkorta si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo oketh chamo mor kod sukari mondo kik tuoche ma inyalo geng'e landre.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Embu County about the importance of food safety for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Embu kuhusu umuhimu wa usalama wa chakula kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya ayaa dadka degmada Embu ku xasuusinaya muhiimadda badbaadada cuntada ay u leedahay caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association parone ji duto e county mar Embu kuom gimomiyo rito chiemo en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges wheat growers in Wajir County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawahimiza wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Wajir kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda wheat ee Gobolka Wajir inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si loo wanaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur mag ngano e gweng' mar Wajir mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed kelo nyak e higani.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds the public in Taita-Taveta County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this August.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inakumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kwamba maoni juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma yanakaribishwa Agosti hii.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa xasuusinaya shacabka degmada Taita-Taveta in talobixinta la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha lagu soo dhaweynayo bisha August.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties parone ji duto e Taita-Taveta County ni ji duto nyalo chiwo paro e wi chenro mag siasa e dwe mar Agost.

English: As a free, locally-available pesticide for pests and diseases in beans, some farmers grind the leaves of Tephrosia vogelii (known locally by various names), soak them in water for several hours, filter the water, and spray it on both infected and healthy bean plants. Note this method hasn't been scientifically tested for safety, so use with care.
Kiswahili: Wakiwa huru, baadhi ya wakulima husaga majani ya Tephrosia vogelii (yajulikanayo kwa majina mbalimbali), hulowesha maji kwa muda wa saa kadhaa, huchuja maji, na kuyanyunyiza kwenye mimea iliyoambukizwa na inayofaa.
Somali: Sida cayayaanka cayayaanka iyo cudurrada cayayaanka ee bilaashka ah ee laga heli karo deegaanka, beeraleyda qaarkood waxay ku dhufanayaan caleemaha Tephrosia vogelii (oo lagu yaqaan magacyo kala duwan oo deegaanka ah), ku qoyaan biyo dhowr saacadood, sifeyn biyo, oo ku buufi dhirta cayayaanka ee cudurka qaba iyo kuwa caafimaad qababa.
Dholuo: Kaka yath ma thiedho kute ma onge chudo kod tuoche ma yudore e puothe, jopur moko chwoyo yien mag Tephrosia vogelii (ma iluongo ni tephrosia vogelii) e alwora margi, gimiyogi pi kuom seche mang'eny, gipogo pi, kendo gipong'o yien ma nigi tuwo kod ma nigi ngima maber.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Laikipia County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the October planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Oktoba.
Somali: Guddiga Waxsoosaarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Laikipia inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e County mar Laikipia mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will conduct a fertiliser application workshop for farmers in Samburu County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itafanya warsha ya maombi ya mbolea kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan codsiga Bacriminta beeraleyda Gobolka Samburu bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Rapar: Bura matayo gik makelo tuoche mag tuoche biro timo tiegruok mar tiyo gi yien mag yien ne jopur e county mar Samburu e dwe mar Mach.

English: E-Citizen warns public officers in Baringo County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya madaraka.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Baringo inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: E-Citizen chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e gweng' mar Baringo ni kik giti marach gi migawo ma gin-go.

English: FAO reminds livestock keepers in Tharaka-Nithi County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa za kuponda ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: FAO parone jopur mag jamni e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo ogeng' jamni maggi e kuonde moketi mag chamo jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service launches a theft prevention campaign in Nyandarua County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu bilaabay olole ka hortagga tuugada Degmada Nyandarua bishii May.
Dholuo: Rapar: Kenya Forest Service chako kampen mar geng'o kuo e County mar Nyandarua e dwe mar Mei.

English: Learn about diverse crops health policies and new formula of improved maize.
Kiswahili: Jifunze kuhusu sera mbalimbali za afya ya mazao na fomula mpya ya mahindi yaliyoboreshwa.
Somali: Baro siyaasadaha caafimaadka dalagyada kala duwan iyo formula cusub ee galleyda la hagaajiyay.
Dholuo: Puonjri weche momedore e wi kit ngima kod puodho mopogore opogore kod kaka inyalo med loso cham maber.

English: SHA reminds residents of Nyamira County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: SHA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba upatikanaji wa usajili wa e-Citizen sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira in helitaanka diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: SHA parone jogweng' Nyamira County ni yudo e-Citizen registration koro yot kokalo kuom yore mag tich.

English: There before, that program is aimed at supporting the government of Kenya to attain her objectives in agriculture. To achieve the first..
Kiswahili: Hapo awali, mpango huo unalenga kusaidia serikali ya Kenya kufikia malengo yake katika kilimo. Ili kufikia ya kwanza..
Somali: Horta, barnaamijkan waxaa loogu talagalay in lagu taageero dowladda Kenya si ay u gaarto ujeeddooyinkeeda beeraha.
Dholuo: E kinde mokalo, chenrono ne dwaro konyo sirkal mar Kenya chopo chenro mage mag pur.

English: KNEC urges parents and teachers in Nyeri County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Nyeri inay u soo sheegaan maamulka iskuulka wixii arrimo ah oo ku saabsan amniga.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Nyeri mondo onyis sirkal mar skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok.

English: A GAIN-led campaign in Mombasa that improves access to affordable fruits and vegetables in urban market zones.
Kiswahili: Kampeni inayoongozwa na GAIN huko Mombasa ambayo inaboresha upatikanaji wa matunda na mboga za bei nafuu katika maeneo ya soko la mijini.
Somali: Olole ay hogaaminayaan GAIN oo ka socda Mombasa oo hagaajinaysa helitaanka miraha iyo khudaarta la awoodi karo ee ku yaal meelaha suuqyada magaalooyinka.
Dholuo: Kampen mar GAIN e Mombasa ma konyo ji yudo olemo kod alot ma nengogi yot e gwenge mag taon.

English: Notice: NDMA conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Kilifi County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Julai hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: NDMA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan ka hortagga argagixisada ee Gobolka Kilifi bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA timo romo mar oganda e dwe mar Julai e gweng' mar Kilifi.

English: Teachers Service Commission conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Kakamega County this August.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Agosti hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa bishii Agoosto ee sannadkan ka qabanaya barashada bulshada ee ku saabsan wareejinta gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e dwe mar Agost e kaunti mar Kakamega.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of Siaya County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay ugu yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' County mar Siaya mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giluong kony mar thieth mar chuny maonge chudo.

English: Notice: KICD announces bursary allocation enrollment dates for schools in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa mgao wa bursary kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ee dugsiyada degmada Makueni.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KICD landoga tarik mag dhi e skunde mag Makueni County.

English: CDC launches a March awareness campaign on safe water storage across Migori County.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Machi juu ya uhifadhi wa maji salama katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: CDC waxay bilowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Maarso oo ku saabsan kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee degmada Migori.
Dholuo: CDC chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Mach kuom wach kano pi maler e kaunti duto mar Migori.

English: KEPHIS advises farmers in Kiambu County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the May planting season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa kupanda Mei.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kiambu inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maajo.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e County mar Kiambu mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Mei.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Vihiga County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati huu wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Vihiga ku xasuusinayaa inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada daadadka ka dhacay xilligan fatahaadda.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service parone jogweng' County mar Vihiga ni kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o e kinde mag pi.

English: EACC warns public officers in Isiolo County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: EACC inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Wilaya ya Isiolo dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: EACC waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Isiolo inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: EACC chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e kaunti mar Isiolo ni kik giti marach gi migepegi.

English: KEMRI urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Garissa County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Garissa inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e gweng' mar Garissa County mondo odhi ir japuonj molony.

English: How should I put on and take off a face mask? Before putting on the mask, wash your hands with soap & water or an alcohol-based hand rub. Cover your mouth and nose with the mask ensuring that it is intact and it fits snugly to your face. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Je, nivae na kuvua vipi barakoa ya uso? Kabla ya kuvaa barakoa, osha mikono yako kwa sabuni na maji au kusugua mikono iliyo na pombe. Funika mdomo na pua yako na barakoa ili kuhakikisha kwamba ni safi na inalingana vyema na uso wako. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Sideen u xidhaa oo aan iska bixiyaa maaskaro wejiga ah? Kahor intaadan xirin maaskaro, gacmahaaga ku dhaq saabuun iyo biyo ama maro gacmaha lagu masaxo oo khamri ku salaysan. Afkaaga iyo sankaaga ku dabool maaskaro adigoo hubinaya inuu nadiif yahay oo uu si fiican ugu habboon yahay wejigaaga. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Ere kaka onego aket kendo agol mask mar wang’? Kapok iketo mask, lwok lweteni gi sabun kod pi kata gi gimoro ma nigi alkol. Ofuko dhok kod um gi mask mondo ine ni ok okethore kendo odonjo maber e wang’i. #KomeshaKorona

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Medical Association will be held in Kilifi County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Kilifi bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma Kenya Medical Association ochano ibiro tim e gweng' mar Kilifi e dwe mar Novemba.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Busia County about the importance of food safety for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Busia juu ya umuhimu wa usalama wa chakula kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMRI waxay dadka degmada Busia ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda badbaadada cuntada ay u leedahay caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMRI paronwa ji duto e County mar Busia gimomiyo rito chiemo en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: In most countries, these key populations face stigma and discrimination in public health settings, which impair their access to and use of HIV and other health services.
Kiswahili: Katika nchi nyingi, watu hawa wakuu wanakabiliwa na unyanyapaa na ubaguzi katika mazingira ya afya ya umma, ambayo inadhoofisha upatikanaji na matumizi yao ya VVU na huduma nyingine za afya.
Somali: Inta badan waddamada, dadkan muhiimka ah waxay la kulmaan dhaleeceyn iyo takoor goobaha caafimaadka dadweynaha, taas oo wiiqaysa marin u helidda iyo isticmaalka HIV iyo adeegyada kale ee caafimaadka.
Dholuo: E pinje mang’eny, oganda madongogi yudo ng’anjo kod ng’anjo e kuonde thieth mag oganda, ma ketho kaka ginyalo yudo kendo tiyo kod HIV kod thieth mamoko.

English: CDC launches a February awareness campaign on food safety across Turkana County.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Februari juu ya usalama wa chakula katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Somali: CDC waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Febraayo oo ku saabsan badbaadada cuntada ee degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: CDC chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Februar e wi wach ritruok mar chiemo e County duto mar Turkana.

English: NDMA urges the public in Garissa County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: NDMA inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: NDMA waxay ugu baaqeysaa shacabka degmada Garissa inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qof kasta oo ka dambeeya kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo ji duto e County mar Garissa mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo weche mag twege mag phishing.

English:
What do you do to prioritize mental health?
Talking about it is a great first step.
Kiswahili: Unafanya nini ili kutanguliza afya ya akili? Kuzungumza juu yake ni hatua nzuri ya kwanza.
Somali: Waa maxay waxa aad sameyneyso si aad u mudnaato caafimaadka maskaxda?
Dholuo: Ang'o minyalo timo mondo iket ngima mar ng'ato obed motelo?

English: DPP reminds mobile money users in Marsabit County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid identity theft.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Marsabit wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Marsabit inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna si looga fogaado in la xado aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: DPP paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e gweng' mar Marsabit ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo kik gikwed kwalo kitgi.

English: Kwale County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kwale: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2022
Somali: Degmada Kwale: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kwale: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2022

English: The 24-Hour Risk City: A Framework for Thinking About Building Infrastructures of Climate Repair in Nairobi and Karachi
Kiswahili: Jiji la Hatari la Saa 24: Mfumo wa Kufikiria Juu ya Kujenga Miundombinu ya Urekebishaji wa Hali ya Hewa Nairobi na Karachi.
Somali: Magaalada Khatarta 24-ka Saacadood ah: Qaab-dhismeedka lagu Fikiro Dhismaha Kaabayaasha Dayactirka Cimilada ee Nairobi iyo Karachi
Dholuo: Boma ma nigi luoro kuom seche 24: Yor paro kuom gero gik ma nyalo konyo e loso piny e Nairobi kod Karachi

English: FAO advises horticultural produce producers in Wajir County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: FAO inashauri wazalishaji wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: FAO waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha wax soo saarka beeraha ee Gobolka Wajir inay wax soo saarkooda ku iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma loso puothe e gweng' mar Wajir mondo ousgi mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo puothego kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Official launch of $5â€¯billion FNRP to support food security across 24 ASAL counties, targeting 5M vulnerable Kenyans.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi rasmi wa FNRP ya dola bilioni 5 ili kusaidia usalama wa chakula katika kaunti 24 za ASAL, ukilenga Wakenya milioni 5 walio katika mazingira magumu.
Somali: Daahfur rasmi ah oo $5 bilyan oo FNRP ah si loo taageero amniga cuntada ee 24 degmo oo ASAL ah, kaas oo lagu beegsanayo 5 milyan oo Kenyan ah oo nugul.
Dholuo: Ochako loso FNRP ma romo dola bilionde 5 mar konyo rito chiemo e gwenge 24 mag ASAL, ma ochung’ne jo Kenya ma romo 5M ma nigi pek.

English: TSC urges youth in Embu County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Embu kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: TSC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Embu inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo rowere e county mar Embu mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok ochopo tije mag oganda.

English: Ministry of Education advises students in Baringo County to collect materials from the county education office to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Baringo kukusanya nyenzo kutoka kwa ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kufikia maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ardayda degmada Baringo kula talineysaa inay ka soo ururiyaan waxyaabo ka socda xafiiska waxbarashada degmada si ay u helaan waxyaabaha barashada digitalka ah ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jopuonjre man Baringo County mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar tiegruok mar county mondo giyud thuolo mar somo weche mag digital maonge chudo.

English: Notice: Council of Governors launches ward-level service delivery in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linazindua huduma za huduma katika Wilaya ya Kisumu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa bilaabay bixinta adeegyada heerka degmada ee degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Jaloch ochako chiwo kony e alwora mar Kisumu County.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya issues a cybersecurity alert on phishing messages affecting residents of Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya hutoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya ujumbe wa udanganyifu unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Maamulka Isgaarsiinta Kenya wuxuu soo saaray digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan fariimaha phishing ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji ogolo siem e wi weche mag cybersecurity e wi ote mag phishing makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e County mar Kisii.

English: Teachers Service Commission advises applicants in Lamu County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Lamu kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu kula talinayaa codsadayaasha degmada Lamu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e County mar Lamu ni mondo gidonj e tiegruok kapok ichopo e chokruok mabiro.

English: KEMRI urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Garissa County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Garissa inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo ng'ato ang'ata man gi tuoche mag pach e County mar Garissa mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: State Department for TVET reminds youth in Marsabit County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Marsabit in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET oparo ne rowere man Marsabit County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar chiemo kod mar rwako welo.

English: Embu (Mbeere) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Embu (Mbeere): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2023
Somali: Degmada Embu (Mbeere): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Embu (Mbeere): Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Septemba 2023

English: Ministry of Health announces free medical camps for residents of Kericho County starting this September.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuanzia Septemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ku dhawaaqday xeryo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Kericho laga bilaabo Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health olando kambi mag thieth maonge chudo ne jogweng' Kericho County kochakore Septemba.

English: Farmers in Uasin Gishu are encouraged to participate in National Farmers Day celebrations aimed at highlighting agricultural transformation
Kiswahili: Wakulima huko Uasin Gishu wamehimizwa kushiriki katika sherehe za Kitaifa za Siku ya Wakulima zinazolenga kuangazia mabadiliko ya kilimo.
Somali: Beeraleyda Uasin Gishu waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay ka qayb qaataan dabaaldegga Maalinta Qaran ee Beeraleyda oo lagu muujiyo isbeddelka beeraha
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma odak Uasin Gishu ijiwo mondo oriw lwedo nyasi mar National Farmers Day ma jiwo lokruok e yore mag pur

English: Lung cancer or tumors originating in the lung, is one of the leading causes of cancer-related deaths globally. Poisonous residue from smoking, asbestos, carcinogenic substances and even environmental hazards have been singled out as major risk factors contributing directly or indirectly to lung cancer. However, the case studies we interacted with for a period of two months cast a shadow of uncertainty over what really causes cancer
Kiswahili: Kansa ya mapafu au tumors originating katika mapafu, ni moja ya sababu kuu za vifo kuhusiana na kansa duniani kote. residues sumu kutoka sigara, asbestos, virutubisho kansa na hata mazingira hatari zimewekwa nje kama sababu kubwa ya hatari kuchangia moja kwa moja au kwa njia isiyo ya moja kwa mmoja kwa kansa ya mapawa. Hata hivyo, masomo ya kesi sisi kuingiliana kwa kipindi cha miezi miwili kutupa kivuli cha kutokuwa na uhakika juu ya nini hasa husababisha kansa
Somali: Kansarka sanbabada ama unugyada ka soo jeeda sanbabadda, waa mid ka mid ah sababaha ugu waaweyn ee dhimashada kansarka ee la xiriira adduunka. Hantida sunta ah ee sigaarka, asbestos, walxaha kansar-darrada ah iyo xitaa khataraha deegaanka ayaa loo aqoonsaday inay yihiin arrimo khatar ah oo si toos ah ama si aan toos ahayn u gacan ka geysanaya kansarkaaga sanbabka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, daraasadaha kiiska ee aan la macaamiloonnay muddo laba
Dholuo: Tuo mar obo kata tuoche mawuok e obo, en achiel kuom gik madongo makelo tho nikech tuoche e piny mangima.

English: AFA informs horticultural produce farmers in Mombasa County of new market linkage opportunities this January.
Kiswahili: AFA inawafahamisha wakulima wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Januari hii.
Somali: AFA waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda wax soo saarka beeraha ee gobolka Mombasa fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: AFA nyiso jopur ma loso puothe e county mar Mombasa e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Januar.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Wajir County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Wajir kumtia moyo rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Wajir inuu dhiirrigeliyo saaxiibkiisa dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pach e County mar Wajir mondo ojiw osiepne moro ma chandore omany kony.

English: HELB advises students in Kericho County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: HELB inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kericho kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kufikia kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali.
Somali: HELB waxay ardayda degmada Kericho kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jopuonjre man Kericho County mondo okonygi kokalo kuom websait mar somo e yor intanet mondo giyud kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar somo gi somo mar digital.

English: KEPHIS advises farmers in Bungoma County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the December planting season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kufanya mazoezi ya kugeuza mazao ili kurejesha uzazi wa udongo kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Desemba.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Bungoma County inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo miraha ciidda ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e gweng ' mar Bungoma County mondo otim lokruok e puothe mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber ka pok ochopo dwe mar Desemba.

English: DCI alerts residents of Kericho County to a rise in fraud cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za ulaghai na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka kwa kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: DCI waxay uga digtay dadka deggan degmada Kericho kororka kiisaska khiyaamooyinka waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kericho County kuom wach medruok mar weche mag wuondruok kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne polis man machiegni.

English: CDC reminds expectant mothers in Taita-Taveta County that access to nutrition supplementation for infants is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: CDC inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kwamba upatikanaji wa nyongeza ya lishe kwa watoto wachanga ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Taita-Taveta in helitaanka nafaqada ee dhallaanka ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: CDC parone mine ma biro bedo gi ich e Taita-Taveta County ni yudo chiemo moromo ne nyithindo mayom en gima onge chudo e ute duto.

English: DPP reminds residents of Kakamega County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: DPP anawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega inay guryahooda ku rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo shaqada inta lagu jiro xilliyada dabka.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogweng' Kakamega County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo giti e kinde mag yiengni.

English: We have very many uncollected IDs in our Huduma Centres. I want to strongly urge all Kenyans who have not yet collected their IDs to do so without delay, as it is the first step towards registering for the Social Health Authority (SHA) and accessing vital government services.â€ Geoffrey Ruku, Cabinet Secretary for Public Service, Human Capital Development and Special Programmes
Kiswahili: Tunayo vitambulisho vingi ambavyo havijakusanywa katika vituo vyetu vya Huduma. Napenda kuwahimiza sana Wakenya wote ambao bado hawajakusanya vitamblisho vyao wafanye hivyo bila kuchelewa, kwani ni hatua ya kwanza kuelekea kujiandikisha kwa Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii (SHA) na kupata huduma muhimu za serikali. Geoffrey Ruku, Katibu wa Baraza la Waziri wa Huduma, Maendeleo ya Msingi wa Binadamu na Programu Maalum
Somali: Waxaan haynaa aqoonsiyo badan oo aan la ururin oo ku yaal Xarumaheena Huduma. Waxaan si xooggan ugu boorinayaa dhammaan dadka reer Kenya ee aan weli qaadan aqoonsiyadooda inay sidaas sameeyaan iyagoon dib u dhac ku imaan, maadaama ay tahay tallaabadii ugu horreysay ee loo qaaday iska diiwaangelinta Hay'adda Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) iyo helitaanka adeegyada muhiimka ah ee dowladda. Geoffrey Ruku, Xoghayaha Golaha Wasiirrada ee Adeegga Dadweynaha, Horumarinta Raasumaalka Aadanaha iyo Barnaamijyada Gaarka ah.
Dholuo: Wabedo gi ID mang’eny ahinya ma pok ochoki e Senta magwa mag Huduma. <2Zepa> Adwaro nyiso matek jo Kenya duto ma pok okawo ID maggi mondo otim kamano ma ok odhi nyime, nikech en okang’ mokwongo mar ndiko nying’gi e duol mar thieth mar oganda (SHA) kendo yudo kony madongo mag sirkal.

English: All medications should be kept out of reach to prevent accidental poisoning in children.
Kiswahili: Dawa zote zinapaswa kuwekwa mbali na watoto ili kuzuia sumu ya bahati mbaya.
Somali: Dhammaan daawooyinka waa in la ilaaliyaa meel aan la gaari karin si looga hortago sunta shilka ah ee carruurta.
Dholuo: Mondo nyithindo kik bed gi tuoche ma nyalo hinyogi apoya, dwarore ni kik giti gi yedhe duto.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development urges residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from free primary education.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ojiwo jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo okonygi kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud tiegruok ma onge chudo.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General launches community-based development programmes in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu huzindua mipango ya maendeleo ya jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu bilaabay barnaamijyo horumarineed oo ku salaysan bulshada ee degmada Makueni.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Jatelo Maduong' chako chenro mag dongruok e alwora mar Makueni County.

English: Notice: HELB opens applications for school laptops under the digital literacy programme for learners in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB inafungua maombi ya kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kitui.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay furaysaa codsiyada kumbuyuutarrada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee ardayda degmada Kitui.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: HELB chako tiyo gi kompyuta e skul kaluwore gi program mar somo kod somo e kitui county.

English: Notice from Division of Disease Surveillance and Response: nutrition supplementation for infants clinics will run every April at designated health centres in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa: nyongeza ya lishe kwa kliniki za watoto wachanga itaendeshwa kila Aprili katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka socda qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada: Kordhinta nafaqada ee rugta caafimaadka ee dhallaanka ayaa lagu sameyn doonaa Abriil kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo wacho ni: Yore mag thieth ne nyithindo matindo ibiro tim dwe mar ang'wen higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Nyeri.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds residents of Meru County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kwamba kufikia usajili wa e-Citizen sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Meru in helitaanka diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General parone jogweng' mar County mar Meru ni koro yot yudo e-Citizen registration kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: IEBC uses social media influencers to reach young voters.
Kiswahili: IEBC hutumia washawishi wa media ya kijamii kufikia wapiga kura vijana.
Somali: IEBC waxay isticmaashaa dadka saameynta ku leh warbaahinta bulshada si ay u gaarto codbixiyayaasha dhalinyarada ah.
Dholuo: IEBC tiyo gi joma nigi teko e social media mondo ochop ne joma tindo.

English: TVET invites youth in Machakos County to enroll for ICT skills training this November.
Kiswahili: TVET inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Machakos kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT Novemba hii.
Somali: TVET waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Machakos inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka xirfadaha ICT bisha November.
Dholuo: TVET gwelo rowere e County ma Machakos mondo odonj e tiegruok mar ICT e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Ministry issues drought adaptation tips for sustainable water use
Kiswahili: Wizara yatoa vidokezo vya kukabiliana na ukame kwa matumizi endelevu ya maji
Somali: Wasaaradda ayaa soo saartay talooyin ku saabsan la qabsashada abaarta si loo isticmaalo biyaha joogtada ah
Dholuo: Migawo ochiwo paro mag kedo gi oro mondo omi oti gi pi e yo maber

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development encourages farmers in Makueni County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for avocado.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri za parachichi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Makueni inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan avocado.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur e county mar Makueni mondo odonj e riwruok ma nigi ratiro mar timo ohala mondo giyud nengo maber mar avocado.

English: NPS urges residents of Murang'a County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NPS inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kuunga mkono kamati za ujenzi wa amani huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo jogweng'o mag County mar Murang'a mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gweng'no e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi kuom chenro mag chiwo siem motelo ne oganda.

English: KTDA urges farmers in Kericho County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kericho inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo lagu soo ururiyo biyaha beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kericho mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Universities Fund reminds youth in Wajir County that HELB funding is available for electrical installation training.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xasuusinayaa dhalinyarada degmada Wajir in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa rowere e gweng' mar Wajir ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar keto sitima.

English: Use sunscreen and avoid the sun between 10 am and 4 pm.
Kiswahili: Tumia mafuta ya kuzuia jua na epuka jua kati ya saa 10 asubuhi na saa 4 jioni.
Somali: Isticmaal muraayadda qorraxda oo ka fogaada qorraxdu inta u dhaxaysa 10 subaxnimo ilaa 4 galabnimo.
Dholuo: Ti gi yien mar geng'o wang' chieng' kendo tang' gi chieng' chakre sa apar okinyi nyaka sa ang'wen odhiambo.

English: Universities Fund reminds youth in Bomet County that HELB funding is available for ICT skills training.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xasuusinayaa dhalinyarada degmada Bomet in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka xirfadaha ICT.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa rowere man Bomet County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar lony e yore mag ICT.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette opens a new service point for passport services in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Gazette oseyawo kama itimee tije mag kawo kad e gweng' mar Kakamega.

English: Caregivers are advised to keep the umbilical cord clean and dry. Do not apply substances like ash or herbs as they may cause infections.
Kiswahili: Walezi wanashauriwa kuweka kitovu kikiwa safi na kikavu. Usipake vitu kama majivu au mimea kwani vinaweza kusababisha maambukizi.
Somali: Daryeelada waxaa lagula talinayaa in xadhkaha burburka uu ahaado mid nadiif ah oo qalalan. Ha isticmaalin waxyaabo sida dambas ama dalagyo sababtoo ah waxay sababi karaan cudurro.
Dholuo: Ojiwo jorit mondo orit dhogi kik kethre kendo kik giti gi gik machalo kaka buru kata yien nikech ginyalo kelo tuoche.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Marsabit County about the importance of tobacco control for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya umuhimu wa udhibiti wa tumbaku kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay dadka degmada Marsabit ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay ka hortagga sigaarka ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross parone oganda mar Marsabit County kuom gimomiyo thieth mar madho ndawa en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: FAO advises farmers in Nairobi County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: FAO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: FAO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nairobi inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kalfadhiga tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e County mar Nairobi mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e chokruok mabiro.

English: NCCK urges swift reconstitution of IEBC to empower electorates in MP recall efforts
Kiswahili: NCCK inashauri kuanzishwa upya kwa haraka kwa IEBC ili kuwapa nguvu wapiga kura katika jitihada za kuwakumbusha MEP
Somali: NCCK waxay ku boorineysaa dib-u-dhiska degdegga ah ee IEBC si loo xoojiyo codbixiyeyaasha dadaallada dib u soo celinta xildhibaanada
Dholuo: NCCK okwayo mondo olos IEBC mapiyo mondo omi josiasa teko mar duoko ji e bunge

English: OGP urges residents of Wajir County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia wavuti ya kaunti hiyo ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja wa kaunti.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada.
Dholuo: OGP ojiwo jogweng' mar Wajir County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mar dongruok e county.

English: Kenya Gazette encourages first-time voters in Kirinyaga County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Kirinyaga inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogo ma ne okwongo yiero e boma mar Kirinyaga County mondo onon weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: KNEC advises applicants in Narok County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Narok kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KNEC waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha gobolka Narok inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada ee soo socota.
Dholuo: KNEC nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e gweng' mar Narok ni mondo gidonj e tiegruok kapok ichopo e chokruok mabiro.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Mombasa County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun iyo biyo nadiif ah si joogto ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: KEMSA nyiso ji modak e County mar Mombasa mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties warns public officers in Wajir County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Wajir dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa ka digaya saraakiisha dowladda ee gobolka Wajir khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Wajir kuom timbe mag wuondruok.

English: NPS urges anyone experiencing abuse in Migori County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NPS inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Migori kuripoti kesi kwenye dawati la karibu la jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Migori inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e kaunti mar Migori mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: The Kenya Cash Consortium Alert-Based Cash Assistance to Disaster-Affected Communities in Garissa and Marsabit Counties: Baseline (August 2025)
Kiswahili: Msaada wa Tahadhari ya Kenya Cash Consortium kwa Jamii Zilizoathiriwa na Maafa katika Kaunti za Garissa na Marsabit: Msingi (Agosti 2025)
Somali: Gargaarka Lacagta Caddaan ah ee ku salaysan Digniinta ee Ururka Lacagta Caddaan ah ee Kenya ee loogu talagalay Bulshooyinka ay Masiibadu Saameysay ee Degmooyinka Garissa iyo Marsabit: Saldhigga (Agoosto 2025)
Dholuo: Kony mar pesa ma luwore gi luoro mar riwruoge mar pesa mag piny Kenya ne jodak ma oyudo masira e gwenge mag Garissa kod Marsabit: Chakruok (Agost 2025)

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) urges sheep farmers in Kilifi County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawataka wafugaji wa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa Newcastle vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda idaha ee degmada Kilifi inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska cudurka Newcastle ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur mag rombe e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo ochiw ripot ne jamni matuwo man machiegni gi kama thieth mar le yudoree bang' ka osenyis ni nitie tuo mar Newcastle.

English: Did you know suicide is the 3rd leading cause of death among 15Â–-29 year olds? ItÂ’s time to raise awareness and support mental health.
Kiswahili: Je, unajua kujiua ni chanzo cha tatu cha vifo miongoni mwa vijana wenye umri wa miaka 15–29? Ni wakati wa kuongeza uelewa na kusaidia afya ya akili.
Somali: Ma ogtahay in is-dilku uu yahay sababta saddexaad ee ugu badan ee dhimashada dadka da'doodu u dhaxayso 15-29 sano? Waa waqtigii la wacyigelin lahaa oo la taageeri lahaa caafimaadka dhimirka.
Dholuo: Be ing’eyo ni nek ng’ato en gima kelo tho mar adek e kind joma hikgi 15Â–-29? En kinde mar keto ji ong’e kendo siro thieth mar paro.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuwasilisha hati za maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si loo qaabeeyo geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso bajet mar county.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) promotes organic farming among farmers in Kakamega County as part of the July climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inakuza kilimo hai miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Julai.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kor u qaadeysaa beeraha dabiiciga ah ee beeraleyda Gobolka Kakamega iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo tij pur e kind jopur e Kaunti mar Kakamega kaka achiel kuom chenro mar dwe mar Julai mar kedo gi lokruok e kor lwasi.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Garissa County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kuthibitisha kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea kupata huduma ya afya ya ruzuku.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Garissa inay xaqiijiyaan in xaruntooda la aqoonsaday ka hor inta aysan booqan si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Garissa mondo ong'e ni kuondegi mag thieth oseyudo ratiro kapok gibiro mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Notice: KMTC opens applications for textbooks and learning materials for learners in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inafungua maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay u furaysaa codsiyada buugaagta iyo qalabka wax lagu barto ardayda degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC chako tiyo gi buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok ne jopuonjre man Bungoma County.

English: Notice: FAO restricts movement of pigs in Nandi County due to an anthrax outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO inazuia harakati za nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Nandi kutokana na mlipuko wa kimeta.
Somali: Ogaysiis: FAO waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa doofaarka ee Gobolka Nandi sababtuna tahay faafitaanka cudurka anthrax.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: FAO ogeng'o wuoth mar le e county mar Nandi nikech tuwo mar anthrax.

English: Ministry of Education collaborates with stakeholders to produce interactive digital content targeting home-based learners.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inashirikiana na wanaohusika katika kutengeneza maudhui ya dijiti ya maingiliano kwa wanafunzi wa nyumbani.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay la shaqeyneysaa daneeyayaasha si ay u soo saarto waxyaabaha dhijitaalka ah ee isdhexgalka leh ee bartayaasha guriga ku salaysan.

English: One protracted Grade 2 emergency (Mpox, Clade 1b) and several other priority events are ongoing, including measles outbreaks in three counties, widespread flooding from the MAM long rains, and a severe food security and nutrition crisis in arid and semi-arid (ASAL) counties.
Kiswahili: Moja ya dharura ya muda mrefu ya darasa la 2 (Mpox, Clade 1b) na matukio mengine kadhaa ya kipaumbele yanaendelea, ikiwa ni pamoja na milipuko ya surua katika kaunti tatu, mafuriko yaliyoenea kutokana na mvua ndefu za MAM, na shida kubwa ya usalama wa chakula na lishe katika kaunti kame na nusu kame (ASAL).
Somali: Hal xaalad degdeg ah oo heerka 2aad ah (Mpox, Clade 1b) iyo dhowr dhacdo oo kale oo mudnaan leh ayaa socda, oo ay ku jiraan faafitaanka jadeecada ee saddex degmo, daadad baahsan oo ka dhashay roobabkii dheeraa ee MAM, iyo dhibaato ba'an oo ku saabsan sugnaanta cuntada iyo nafaqada oo ka jirta degmooyinka qalalan iyo kuwa qalalan (ASAL).
Dholuo: Achiel kuom gik ma nyalo kelo hinyruok ma ng’ato nyalo bedogo kuom kinde malach (Mpox, Clade 1b) kod gik mamoko ma ng’ato nyalo timo mokuongo pod dhi nyime, moriwo nyaka tuoche mag ng’ut ng’ato e gwenge adek, pi ma pong’o piny mathoth nikech koth mabor ma MAM, kod chandruok maduong’ mar yudo chiemo kod chiemo ma nigi ng’ol e gwenge ma ng’ich ahinya kod ma ng’ich ahinya (ASAL).

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free trauma counselling support is available through county health facilities in Busia County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa ushauri wa kiwewe unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Busia.
Somali: Shirkadda SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo latalin ah oo ku saabsan dhaawacyada ay ka heli karto xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Busia County.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tuoche yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Busia.

English: Public notice: Kenya Red Cross will host a free food safety outreach in Lamu County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utaandaa uhamasishaji wa usalama wa chakula bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Lamu Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay marti gelineysaa dadaal bilaash ah oo ku saabsan badbaadada cuntada ee Gobolka Lamu bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova mar Kenya Red Cross biro timo kampen mar chiwo chiemb chuny maonge chudo e taon mar Lamu e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties advises residents of Makueni County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e-Citizen.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Makueni kula talinayaa inay soo booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan diiwaan gelinta e-Citizen.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties nyiso jogweng' Makueni County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro ndiko e-Citizen.

English: Partner involvement during antenatal and postnatal care improves family health outcomes.
Kiswahili: Ushiriki wa mshirika wakati wa utunzaji wa ujauzito na baada ya kujifungua huboresha matokeo ya afya ya familia.
Somali: Ka qaybgalka lammaanaha inta lagu jiro daryeelka kahor iyo ka dib dhalashada waxay hagaajineysaa natiijooyinka caafimaadka qoyska.
Dholuo: Bedo gi osiepe e kinde mag rito nyathi kapok onyuolo koda bang' nyuolo miyo ngima joot bedo maber.

English: Weekly Bulletin on Outbreaks and other Emergencies: Week 44: 28 October - 3 November 2024 Data as reported by: 17:00; 3 November 2024
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Kila Wiki kuhusu Milipuko na Dharura Nyingine: Wiki 44: 28 Oktoba - 3 Novemba 2024 Data kama ilivyoripotiwa na: 17:00; 3 Novemba 2024
Somali: War-saxaafadeed Todobaadle ah oo ku saabsan Cudurrada faafa iyo Xaaladaha kale ee Degdegga ah: Toddobaadka 44: 28 Oktoobar - 3 Noofambar 2024 Xogta sida lagu soo warramey: 17:00; 3 Noofambar 2024

English: KEMSA calls on parents in Narok County to have children under five screened for Rift Valley Fever during the July outreach.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Narok kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa wakati wa mawasiliano ya Julai.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Narok in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro Cudurka Rift Valley inta lagu gudajiro bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: KEMSA dwaro ni jonyuol e Narok County otim nonro ne nyithindo ma hikgi tin ne abich kuom tuwo mar Rift Valley Fever e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya Key Message Update March 2024: Staple food prices are gradually declining but remain higher than the five-year average
Kiswahili: Sasisho la Ujumbe Muhimu wa Kenya Machi 2024: Bei kuu za vyakula zinapungua polepole lakini zinaendelea kuwa juu kuliko wastani wa miaka mitano.
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta Fariinta Muhiimka ah ee Kenya Maarso 2024: Qiimaha cuntada ee aasaasiga ah ayaa si tartiib tartiib ah hoos ugu dhacaya laakiin wali wuu ka sarreeyaa celceliska shanta sano
Dholuo: Oda Maduong’ mar Kenya Maduek 2024: Nengo mag chiemo madongo dok piny mos e kinde kata kamano pod ni malo moloyo nengo ma ne oting’o kuom higni abich

English: Notice: OGP opens voter registration centres in Kericho County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inafungua vituo vya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kericho Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay dib u furaysaa xarumaha diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee degmada Kericho bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: OGP ochako chenro mar ndiko joma oyier e County mar Kericho e dwe mar Desemba.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) appeals to caregivers in Kericho County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the June maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kericho kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Juni.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa ka codsaday daryeelayaasha degmada Kericho inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka ee bisha Juun.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) kwayo jorit e County mar Kericho mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi e dwe mar Jun.

English: OGP encourages first-time voters in Lamu County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: OGP inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Lamu kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu.
Somali: OGP waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Lamu inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogo madwaro yiero e kinde mokwongo e County mar Lamu mondo olim kama ichanoe ji ne IEBC.

English: The Kenya Cash Consortium Alert-Based Cash Assistance to Disaster-Affected Communities in Dadaab and Kakuma Refugee Camps: Baseline (January 2025)
Kiswahili: Tahadhari ya Muungano wa Fedha wa Kenya Msaada wa Pesa kwa Jamii Zilizoathiriwa na Maafa katika Kambi za Wakimbizi za Dadaab na Kakuma: Msingi (Januari 2025)
Somali: Gargaarka Lacagta Caddaan ah ee ku salaysan Digniinta ee Ururka Lacagta Caddaan ee Kenya ee loogu talagalay Bulshooyinka ay Masiibadu Saameysay ee Xeryaha Qaxootiga ee Dhadhaab iyo Kakuma: Saldhigga (Janaayo 2025)
Dholuo: Kony mar pesa ma ochung’ne ng’eyo mar pesa ma Kenya chiwo ne jodak ma oyudo masira e kambi mag jolweny mag Dadaab kod Kakuma: Ranyisi mar chakruok (dwe mar achiel higa mar 2025)

English: NDMA urges the public in Tharaka-Nithi County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za ujumbe wa udanganyifu.
Somali: NDMA waxay ugu baaqaysaa shacabka degmada Tharaka-Nithi inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo ji duto e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo weche mag phishing.

English: Physical activity can help prevent diabetes and its complications. Have you and your family had at least 30 minutes of physical activity today?
Kiswahili: Shughuli za kimwili zinaweza kusaidia kuzuia ugonjwa wa kisukari na matatizo yake. Je, wewe na familia yako mmekuwa na angalau dakika 30 za mazoezi ya viungo leo?
Somali: Dhaqdhaqaaqa jirka ayaa kaa caawin kara ka hortagga sonkorowga iyo dhibaatooyinkiisa. Ma adiga iyo qoyskaagaba maanta ma sameysannay ugu yaraan 30 daqiiqo oo jimicsi jireed ah?
Dholuo: Tiyo gi del nyalo konyo e geng’o tuo mar sukari kod pek ma nyalo kelo. Be in kaachiel gi joodu usebedo gi gik ma nyalo miyo ibed gi teko mar timo gik moko kuom dakika 30 e odiechieng’no?

English: Farmers in Nakuru are invited to participate in the revival of the pyrethrum sector The county government has invested Kshs 70 million to provide clean planting material
Kiswahili: Wakulima mjini Nakuru waalikwa kushiriki katika ufufuaji wa sekta ya pareto Serikali ya kaunti imewekeza Kshs 70 milioni kutoa nyenzo safi za upanzi.
Somali: Beeraleyda Nakuru ayaa lagu casuumay inay ka qayb qaataan dib u soo nooleynta qaybta pyrethrum-ka Dowladda gobolka ayaa maalgelisay Kshs 70 milyan si loo helo agab beereed nadiif ah
Dholuo: Jo-Pyrethrum ma Nakuru ogwel mondo oriw lwedo tij gero ohala mar pyrethrum sirkal mar county osetiyo gi Ksh 70 million e chiwo gik maler mag pidho

English: DPP urges residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: DPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi imeongezeka.
Somali: DPP waxay dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: DPP ojiwo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya e kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Ministry of Education conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Marsabit County this July.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Julai hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan wareejinta degmada Marsabit bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Puonjruok dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e dwe mar Julai e kaunti mar Marsabit.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds mobile money users in Laikipia County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa fedha za simu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Laikipia inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e County mar Laikipia ni mondo ginyis jochiwogi weche maok kare mondo kik gikwed timbe mag wuondo pesa mag simu.

English: TVET advises students in Uasin Gishu County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access revision guides.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kufikia miongozo ya marekebisho.
Somali: TVET waxay ardayda degmada Uasin Gishu kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan hagaha dib u eegista.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jopuonjre manie Uasin Gishu County mondo oketgi e intanet mondo giyud gweth mag somo.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds livestock keepers in Samburu County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya xoolaha reer Samburu County inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanada buka xafiiska xayawaanka ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board parone jorit jamni e county mar Samburu mondo onyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo orit ngima jamni.

English: EHAGL Region: Community Feedback Analysis Report, July - September 2024
Kiswahili: Eneo la EHAGL: Ripoti ya Uchambuzi wa Maoni ya Jamii, Julai - Septemba 2024
Somali: Gobolka EHAGL: Warbixinta Falanqaynta Jawaab celinta Bulshada, Luulyo - Sebtembar 2024
Dholuo: Kidieny mar EHAGL: Ripot mar Nonro Duoko mag Oganda, dwe mar abiriyo - dwe mar apar gi ariyo 2024

English: Help children understand the arrival of a new sibling to reduce jealousy and promote bonding.
Kiswahili: Wasaidie watoto kuelewa ujio wa ndugu mpya ili kupunguza wivu na kukuza uhusiano wa karibu.
Somali: Carruurta ka caawi inay fahmaan in walaal cusub yimaado si ay u yareeyaan hinaasta oo ay u horumariyaan xidhiidhka.
Dholuo: Kony nyithindo ong'e ka owadgi kata nyamin-gi ochopo mondo kik gibed gi nyiego kendo gibed gi winjruok maber.

English: Council of Governors advises residents of Marsabit County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay kula talinayaan dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo jogweng' mar Marsabit County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro kwayo mar bedo gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMSA will be held in Samburu County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMSA itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Samburu Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay KEMSA ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Gobolka Samburu bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma KEMSA ochano biro timore e county mar Samburu e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: KEMSA confirms a HIV/AIDS outbreak alert for Mombasa County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA yathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa VVU/UKIMWI katika Kaunti ya Mombasa. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMSA waxay xaqiijineysaa feejignaanta cudurka HIV / AIDS ee gobolka Mombasa. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMSA osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuo mar HIV/AIDS e kaunti mar Mombasa.

English: IEBC urges residents of Nyeri County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kufaidika na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Nyeri mondo oketnegi kwayo mar yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud tiegruok mar somo gi somo ne joma dongo.

English: Council of Governors invites residents of Uasin Gishu County to attend the public participation forum regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu inay ka soo qaybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch ogwelo ji duto modak e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi nonro mar tich mitimo higa ka higa.

English: Notice: HELB launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay bilawday barnaamij ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada iskuulada guud ahaan gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Rapar: HELB chako chenro mar rito nyithindo e skul e skunde duto mag Uasin Gishu County.

English: E-Citizen encourages first-time voters in West Pokot County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada West Pokot inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo joma okwongo yiero e West Pokot County mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng'no mar yiero.

English: Universities Fund reminds parents in Busia County that free primary education registration is open this September.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba usajili wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo umefunguliwa Septemba hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xusuusinayaa waalidiinta degmada Busia in diiwaangelinta bilaashka ah ee waxbarashada hoose ay furan tahay bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa jonyuol e county mar Busia ni chenro mar somo mar pinyruoth ma onge chudo ochakore e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: DCI opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay furaysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya taageero maskaxeed iyo bulsheed degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni DCI ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony e weche mag pach ji e gweng' mar Kisii.

English: Public notice: Kenya Medical Association will host a free hand hygiene outreach in Kiambu County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mikono bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu marti gelin doonaa dhaqdhaqaaqa nadaafadda gacmaha ee bilaashka ah ee degmada Kiambu bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association biro timo kampen mar rito ler mar lwedo e County mar Kiambu e dwe mar Mach.

English: Farmers in Naivasha are advised to check the NCPB store for updates on the fertilizer subsidy distribution
Kiswahili: Wakulima huko Naivasha wanashauriwa kuangalia duka la NCPB ili kupata sasisho kuhusu usambazaji wa ruzuku ya mbolea
Somali: Beeraleyda Naivasha waxaa lagula talinayaa inay hubiyaan dukaanka NCPB si ay u helaan warar ku saabsan qaybinta canshuurta bacriminta
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma ni Naivasha, ojiw mondo onon e duka mar NCPB mondo gine weche manyien e wi pogo chiemb chuny mar chamo puothe mag yien

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Wajir County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa msaada wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow si ay uga caawiyaan helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ee lacageed.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso jogweng' mar Wajir County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni mondo giyud kony mar yudo kony kuom weche thieth.

English: Do not open the 'Free Movies' USB on your computer! It may contain a virus.
Kiswahili: Usifungue USB ya 'Free Movies' kwenye kompyuta yako! Inaweza kuwa na virusi.
Somali: Ha furin USB-ga 'Movies Free' ee kumbuyuutarkaaga! Waxay ku jiri kartaa fayras.
