English: Notice: ODPP opens polling procedures centres in Kitui County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika Wilaya ya Kitui Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay furaysaa xarumaha nidaamyada codbixinta ee Gobolka Kitui bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: ODPP chako tiyo gi kuonde ma itimoe yiero e kaunti mar Kitui e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Teachers Service Commission invites youth in Wajir County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this November.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Wajir kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Novemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa ku casuumay dhalinyarada degmada Wajir inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista bisha November.
Dholuo: Commission of Teachers Service Commission ogwelo rowere e gweng' mar Wajir mondo odonj e tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges beans growers in Turkana County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawasihi wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Turkana kudhibiti wizi wa jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa za kuua wadudu zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda gobolka Turkana County inay ka hortagaan ciidamada ciidanka ee hoos u dhaca iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaanka la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur ma pidho keyo e County mar Turkana mondo otiek monj mar armyworm chon ka gitiyo gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok mondo omed nyak e higani.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) announces a free anthrax vaccination exercise for cattle in Meru County this July.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kimeta kwa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Meru Julai hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) ayaa ku dhawaaqday jimicsi tallaal ah oo lacag la'aan ah oo loo sameeyo lo'da ee Gobolka Meru bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok e dwe mar Julai e kaunti mar Meru.

English: State Department for Basic Education conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in Taita-Taveta County this September.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta Septemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi ratiro mag sirkal e Taita-Taveta County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public in Kirinyaga County about the importance of tobacco control for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuhusu umuhimu wa udhibiti wa tumbaku kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Waaxda Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay dadka degmada Kirinyaga ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay xakamaynta sigaarka ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji duto e County mar Kirinyaga kuom gimomiyo thieth mar madho ndawa en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Notice: FAO will open a milk collection centre in Murang'a County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya maziwa katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay bilaabi doontaa xarun ururinta caanaha ee Gobolka Murang'a bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: FAO biro yawo kambi mar choko chak e County mar Murang'a e dwe mar Mach.

English: KTDA urges cattle farmers in Nyeri County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawataka wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa ngozi ya uvimbe.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da ee degmada Nyeri inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur mag jamni e County mar Nyeri mondo onyis jamni matuwo e ofise mar thieth machiegni gi kanyo bang' ka osenyis ni gin gi tuoche mang'eny.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges residents of Trans Nzoia County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka qeybgalaan kalfadhiga guud ee golaha gobolka si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda horumarinta gobolka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo jogweng'o mag Trans Nzoia County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo gibed molony e wi chenro mag dongruok mag county.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the public in Kwale County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unashauri umma katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya shacabka degmada Kwale inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda kadib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada lacagta mobilada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ji duto e county mar Kwale mondo ochiw ripot mar ote manyalo kelo hinyruok ne jomisonari margi bang' yudo ripot mag timbe mag wuondo pesa e simo.

English: State Department for TVET advises students in Kisumu County to register early to secure allocation to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata maudhui ya ujifunzaji wa kidijitali bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ardayda degmada Kisumu kula talineysaa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan si ay u helaan qeyb lacag la'aan ah oo waxbarasho digital ah.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo jopuonjre e County mar Kisumu mondo odonj e skundno chon mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo somo mar digital maonge chudo.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMSA will be held in Marsabit County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMSA itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay KEMSA ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Marsabit bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KEMSA biro chano kampen mar thieth maonge chudo e taon mar Marsabit e dwe mar Mei.

English: E-Citizen reminds residents of Kilifi County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi kwamba kufikia utunzaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda ka sahlan tahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa jogweng' Kilifi County ni koro yot yudo barua mar nyuol kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: KEMSA encourages residents of Trans Nzoia County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay la xiriiraan lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' mar Trans Nzoia County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo gitem manyo jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Notice: KALRO will conduct a post-harvest handling workshop for farmers in Nyamira County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafanya warsha ya kushughulikia baada ya mavuno kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi ka dib goosashada beeraleyda degmada Nyamira bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KALRO biro timo chokruok mar timo nonro bang' keyo ne jopur e kaunti mar Nyamira e dwe mar Februar.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Uasin Gishu County this October.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Oktoba hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu qabanqaabiyaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda gobolka ee Gobolka Uasin Gishu bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development dhi nyime gi chenro mar tiegruok mar oganda e dwe mar Oktoba e kaunti mar Uasin Gishu.

English: Notice: COMESA restricts movement of goats in Bungoma County due to a rabies outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA yazuia harakati za mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kutokana na mlipuko wa kichaa cha mbwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa riyaha ee degmada Bungoma sababo la xiriira cudurka cadhada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: COMESA ogeng'o wuoth mar diek e County mar Bungoma nikech tuwo mar rabies.

English: Swollen feet, thin limbs, or constant fatigue in a child may be signs of malnutrition. Seek help immediately.
Kiswahili: Miguu iliyovimba, miguu myembamba, au uchovu wa kila mara kwa mtoto inaweza kuwa dalili za utapiamlo. Tafuta msaada mara moja.
Somali: Cunuga cagihiisa oo caabuqa, xubnihiisa khafiifka ah ama daalka joogtada ah ayaa calaamad u noqon kara nafaqo la'aanta.
Dholuo: Nyathi nyalo bedo gi tiende motur, tiendene yom, kata ool kinde duto.

English: NCPB urges farmers in Kajiado County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kajiado inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: NCPB ojiwo jopur e Kajiado County mondo opidh cham ma opong'o lowo mondo okonygi loyo lokruok e koth.

Kiswahili: KUCCPS hufungua kuingia moja kwa moja chuo kikuu kwa wahitimu wa TVET kuomba kabla ya Desemba 31!
Somali: KUCCPS waxay si toos ah u furaysaa gelitaanka jaamacadda ee ardayda ka qalin jabisay TVET ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…â€œ codso ka hor Diseembar 31!
Dholuo: KUCCPS oyawo donjo e yunivasiti achiel kachiel ne jogo ma otieko somo mar TVET.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds residents of Mandera County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera in ka qaybgalka maamulaha degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette paronwa jogweng'o mag Mandera County ni tudruok gi jotelo mag gwenge maggi miyo sirkal bedo gi loch maber.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the public in Mombasa County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya shacabka degmada Mombasa inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ji duto e county mar Mombasa mondo ong'e kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma osefweny kuom chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo.

English: Pest Control Products Board warns sorghum farmers in Kakamega County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda cawska ee Gobolka Kakamega faafitaanka cayayaannada wuxuuna kugula talinayaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Bura mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok mar Pest, chiwo siem ne jopur mag sorghum e Kaunti mar Kakamega e wi tuoche ma kelo hinyruok kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: CBK reminds Kenyans that any investment requiring you to recruit others to earn returns is likely a pyramid scheme. Report such activities immediately.
Kiswahili: CBK inawakumbusha Wakenya kwamba uwekezaji wowote unaokuhitaji kuajiri wengine ili kupata faida huenda ni mpango wa piramidi. Ripoti shughuli kama hizo mara moja.
Somali: CBK waxay xasuusineysaa dadka Kenyaanka ah in maalgashi kasta oo kugu qasbaya inaad qorto dadka kale si aad faa'iido u hesho ay u badan tahay inuu yahay qorshe haram ah. Isla markiiba soo sheeg hawlahaas.
Dholuo: CBK paro ne jo Kenya ni pesa moro amora ma iketo ma dwaro ni ibed gi jomoko mondo iyud pesa, nyalo bedo ni en chenro mar piramid. Chiw ripot mar gik ma kamago mapiyo.

English: DCI urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kisii County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: DCI inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Kisii piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Kisii inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: DCI ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo chandruok mar nindruok e County mar Kisii mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Wajir County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Wajir juu ya umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay dadka degmada Wajir ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay nadaafadda saxda ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne ji duto e County mar Wajir kuom ber mar rito ler mar pi e ngima joot.

English: All children under 5 months needs Vitamin A through a drop into their mouth in every 6 months, for good growth of the child and to reduce premature deaths
Kiswahili: Watoto wote chini ya miezi 5 wanahitaji vitamini A kupitia tone moja katika kinywa chao kila baada ya miezi 6, kwa ajili ya ukuaji mzuri wa mtoto na kupunguza vifo vya mapema
Somali: Dhammaan carruurta ka yar 5 bilood waxay u baahan yihiin fitamiin A oo 6 biloodba mar afka lagu dhigo, si ay u koraan si wanaagsan oo ay u yareeyaan dhimashada hore
Dholuo: Nyithindo duto ma hikgi tin ne dweche abich dwaro ni vitamin A odonj e dhogi bang ' dweche auchiel ka dwechegi auchiel, mondo gitim dongruok maber e nyathi kendo giduog chien tho ma ok ochopo chon.

English: The ongong campaigns on meastle-rubela vaccination, disease caused by donkey and tetenus innjection has reached its 4th day
Kiswahili: Kampeni ya ongong juu ya chanjo ya meastle-rubela, ugonjwa unaosababishwa na punda na sindano ya tetenus imefikia siku yake ya 4
Somali: Ololaha ongong ee ku saabsan tallaalka cudurka miiska-rubella, cudurka ay keenaan dameerka iyo duritaanka tetenus ayaa gaadhay maalinta afaraad
Dholuo: Kampen mar ongong e wi thieth mar mize-rubela, tuoche makelo gi punda, kod thieth mag tetenus osedonjo e odiechieng' mar ang'wen

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds the public in Nandi County to remain vigilant on border security.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu dadka degmada Nandi ku xasuusinayaa inay ka feejignaadaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service parone ji duto e county mar Nandi ni gibed motang' e weche mag rito tong'.

English: KICD reminds schools in Taita-Taveta County to strengthen inclusion of learners with disabilities this July.
Kiswahili: KICD inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuimarisha ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu Julai hii.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay xoojiyaan ka mid noqoshada ardayda naafada ah bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: KICD paronwa skunde mag Taita-Taveta County mondo omed tiego jopuonjre ma nigi midekre e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages residents of Migori County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Migori inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo jogweng' Migori County mondo kik gisandre aling' ling' kendo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds mobile money users in Tana River County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Wilaya ya Tana River wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Tana River inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna si looga fogaado nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne joma tiyo gi pesa mag simo e taon mar Tana River County ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo kik gitim chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo.

English: Coughing to a period of two weeks? Expentant mothers should should be tested for TB withiout delay
Kiswahili: Kuhofu kwa muda wa wiki mbili? Mama wanaozunguka wanapaswa kuchunguzwa kwa ugonjwa wa kifua kikuu bila kuchelewa
Somali: Qoyaanka muddo laba toddobaad ah? Hooyooyinka dhallinyarada ah waa in la tijaabiyaa haddii ay qabaan xanuunka TB
Dholuo: Be in gi tuo mar dhoho kuom jumbe ariyo?

English: Laikipia County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Laikipia: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Aprili 2024
Somali: Degmada Laikipia: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Laikipia: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar Ang'wen 2024

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Nakuru County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Nakuru inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.

Dholuo: Gik ma jogo ma ne otho e ngimagi yudo kuom yudo kony mag thieth mar paro bang' tim ng'anjo mar nindruok kod tim ng'anjo e piny Kenya

English: KTDA invites farmers in Nyeri County to a free training on greenhouse farming this November.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo cha chafu Novemba hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyeri tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo bisha November.
Dholuo: KTDA ogwelo jopur e Kaunti mar Nyeri e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar yien e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Kenya: Registered refugees and asylum-seekers (as of 30 June 2022)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Wakimbizi waliosajiliwa na wanaotafuta hifadhi (kuanzia tarehe 30 Juni 2022)
Somali: Kenya: Qaxootiga diiwaangashan iyo kuwa magangalyo doonka ah (laga bilaabo 30 Juun 2022)
Dholuo: Kenya: Jolweny ma ondiki nyinggi kod jogo madwaro dak (chakre tarik 30 dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2022)

English: Take a deep breath and relax. Listen to your body. If you're really tired, give yourself time to sleep. Without good sleep, our mental health suffers and our concentration goes downhill. Sometimes the world can wait.
Kiswahili: Vuta pumzi ndefu na upumzike. Sikiliza mwili wako. Ikiwa umechoka sana, jipe â€‹â€‹muda wa kulala. Bila usingizi mzuri, afya yetu ya akili huharibika na umakini wetu hupungua. Wakati mwingine ulimwengu unaweza kusubiri.
Somali: Neef qoto dheer qaado oo naso. Dhageyso jirkaaga. Haddii aad daalan tahay, naftaada sii waqti aad ku seexato. Haddii aadan hurdo fiican haysan, caafimaadka maskaxdeenna ayaa xumaada, feejignaanteenuna hoos ayay u dhacdaa. Mararka qaar adduunku wuu sugi karaa.
Dholuo: Ywa muya matut kendo ibed gi mor. Winj kaka ringreni winjo. Kapo ni iol ahinya, miyi thuolo mar nindo. Ka ok wanindo maber, paro ma wan-go bedo marach kendo ok wanyal keto pachwa kuom gik moko. Seche moko piny nyalo rito.

English: IEBC reminds voters in Tharaka-Nithi County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IebC kabla ya kusajili wapiga Kura.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Tharaka-Nithi in ay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta Iebc ee ugu dhow ka hor diiwaangelin.
Dholuo: IEBC parone jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo odhi e kama ichano dhigo e nyim joma biro kwayo mondo gidonj e skundno.

English: National Drought Early Warning Bulletin (April 2022)
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Tahadhari ya Mapema ya Kitaifa (Aprili 2022)
Somali: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Qaranka (Abriil 2022)
Dholuo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro (dwe mar Ang'wen 2022)

English: IEBC urges parents and teachers in Makueni County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Makueni inay u sheegaan maamulka iskuulka wixii arrimo ah oo ku saabsan amniga.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e gweng' mar Makueni mondo onyis sirkal mar skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok.

English: Supporting pastoralist adaptation to climate change in Kenya: Beyond a â€œone-size-fits allâ€ approach
Kiswahili: Kusaidia kukabiliana na wafugaji kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa nchini Kenya: Zaidi ya mbinu ya "ukubwa mmoja inafaa wote".
Somali: Taageeridda la qabsiga xoolo-dhaqatada ee isbeddelka cimilada ee Kenya: Ka baxsan habka "hal-cabbir-ku-habboon dhammaan"
Dholuo: Chiwo siro puonj mar jokwath mondo odonjre e lokruok mag piny e piny Kenya: Okalo yo mar â€œng'ato achiel ma nyalo rwako ji dutoâ€

English: COMESA advises farmers in Nakuru County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the January planting season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Januari.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nakuru inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagyada si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda ka hor xilliga beerashada ee Janaayo.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo otim lokruok e puothe mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak kapok ochopo dwe mar Januar.

English: Livestock for Health in Kenya: Resilience good practice - Nutrition and resilience
Kiswahili: Mifugo kwa ajili ya Afya nchini Kenya: Kustahimili utendaji mzuri - Lishe na ustahimilivu
Somali: Xoolaha Caafimaadka ee Kenya: Dhaqan wanaagsan oo adkeysi leh - Nafaqada iyo adkeysiga
Dholuo: Gik ma ng’ato nyalo timo mondo obed gi ngima maber e piny Kenya: Yo maber mar rito ngima - Chiemo kod rito ngima

English: Kenya Gazette reminds voters in Nakuru County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Nakuru inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette parone jogweng' Nakuru County mondo olim kama ichanoe IEBC machiegni kodgi kapok kinde mag yiero ochopo.

English: KICD urges youth in Laikipia County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KICD inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KICD waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Laikipia inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda ka hor inta aysan qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo rowere e County mar Laikipia mondo onyis weche ma gin-go mar ndiko ji kapok gitimo gik ma biro timore ne oganda.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds schools in Taita-Taveta County to strengthen anti-bullying measures this July.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuimarisha hatua za kupambana na uonevu Julai hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada Waxbarashada ayaa xusuusinaya dugsiyada Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay xoojiyaan tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibaatada bisha July.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne skunde man Taita-Taveta County mondo omed jiwo yore mag geng'o nindruok e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay qabaneysaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ee Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Huduma Kenya biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag siasa e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free youth mental wellness support is available through county health facilities in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa afya ya akili kwa vijana unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Mandera.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo ne rowere yudo kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county man Mandera County.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Kericho County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan bixinta adeegyada heerka degmada.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kericho mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo omed ng'eyo weche momedore e wi tij lendo e gwenge duto.

English: Kilifi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kilifi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2022
Somali: Degmada Kilifi: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kilifi: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2022

English: KEMRI urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Kericho County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Kericho kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Kericho inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pachgi e County mar Kericho mondo oluong kony mar thieth mar pach maonge chudo.

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief, February 2023
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP Kenya, Februari 2023
Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya, Febraayo 2023
Dholuo: Wach machuok mar piny Kenya mar WFP, dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2023

English: Ministry of Health launches a February awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Februari juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Febraayo oo ku saabsan wacyiga cadaadiska sare ee gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health osechako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Februar e wi wach ng'eyo ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar hypertension e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu.

English: NCPB urges sheep farmers in Kilifi County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawataka wafugaji wa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa ngozi wa uvimbe ulioripotiwa.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda idaha ee degmada Kilifi inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyada oo aan la helin ruqsad ka dib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur ma pidho rombe e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni e tong' mar gweng'no ka ok giyudo rusa bang' yudo weche ma nyiso ni nitie tuoche mag dhoho.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Medical Association will be held in Mandera County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu bila malipo iliyoandaliwa na Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Mandera Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Degmada Mandera bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma Kenya Medical Association ochano ibiro tim e taon mar Mandera e dwe mar Julai.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties warns public officers in Migori County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Migori dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Migori khiyaanooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Migori kuom timbe mag mibadhi.

English: Public health advisory: SHA (Social Health Authority) warns of increased Rift Valley Fever risk in Taita-Taveta County and advises the public to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta na inashauri umma kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ka digtay kororka halista Cudurka Rift Valley ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay isla markiiba baaritaano ka sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Chenro mar thieth mar oganda: SHA (Social Health Authority) chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuwo mar Rift Valley Fever e Taita-Taveta County kendo ojiwo ji mondo omany thieth mapiyo e kama thieth nitie machiegni kodgi.

English: The government has imposed a raft of new drastic measures after cases of the new coronavirus in Kenya jumped to 15 in the last 72 hours. The new directives came after eight more people tested positive for COVID-19
Kiswahili: Serikali imeweka hatua kadhaa kali baada ya visa vya virusi vipya vya korona nchini Kenya kupanda hadi 15 katika saa 72 zilizopita. Maagizo hayo mapya yalikuja baada ya watu wengine wanane kupimwa na kupatikana na COVID-19.
Somali: Dowladda Kenya ayaa soo saartay tallaabooyin cusub oo adag kadib markii kiisaska coronavirus-ka cusub ee Kenya ay kor u kaceen 15 saacadood ee la soo dhaafay. Tilmaamaha cusub waxay yimaadeen ka dib markii siddeed qof oo kale ay ku baareen COVID-19
Dholuo: Sirkal oseketho chenro manyien mag thieth bang' ka kwan mar ji ma nigi tuo mar corona e piny Kenya osemedore mochopo 15 e seche 72 mokalo.

English: Climate Change Impacts on Food Security and Nutrition in Kenya's Arid and Semi-Arid Lands: A Brief Literature Review
Kiswahili: Athari za Mabadiliko ya Tabianchi kwa Usalama wa Chakula na Lishe katika Nchi Kame na Nusu Kame nchini Kenya: Mapitio Mafupi ya Fasihi.
Somali: Saamaynta Isbeddelka Cimiladu ku leeyahay Sugnaanta Cuntada iyo Nafaqada Dhulka Oomanaha iyo Badh-Aaran ee Kenya: Dib-u-eegis Suugaaneed oo Kooban
Dholuo: Gik ma Lokruok mar Piny Kelo Kelo Rieko mar Chiemo kod Chiemo e Pinje ma Otuo kod ma Otuo Ma Kenya: Nonro Machuok mar Oboke

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service warns tea farmers in Bungoma County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Bungoma cudurrada cayayaanka waxaana uu ku talinayaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service chiwo siem ne jopur ma loso chai e County mar Bungoma kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: KICD encourages residents of Embu County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: KICD inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kukaa na habari juu ya ugatuzi.
Somali: KICD waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan wareejinta.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo jogweng' Embu County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi kaka ibiro chiwgi.

English: Universities Fund urges parents and teachers in Meru County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Meru kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku boorinayaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Meru inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e county mar Meru mondo omany namba mar kony mar nyithindo 116.

English: Kenya Red Cross announces outpatient services for residents of Marsabit County starting this June.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unatangaza huduma za wagonjwa wa nje kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kuanzia Juni hii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa ku dhawaaqday adeegyo bukaan-socodka ah oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Marsabit laga bilaabo Juun.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ogolo chenro mar konyo jotuo mag Marsabit County kochakore dwe mar Jun.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) invites farmers in Taita-Taveta County to a free training on post-harvest handling this February.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kwa mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno Februari hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Taita-Taveta tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan maaraynta goosashada ka dib bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) ogwelo jopur manie Taita-Taveta County mondo otim tiegruok maonge chudo e dwe mar Februar.

English: Kitui County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kitui: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Aprili 2024
Somali: Degmada Kitui: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kitui: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro dwe mar Ang'wen 2024

English: Notice: KALRO will distribute certified beans seed to farmers in Nandi County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itasambaza mbegu za maharagwe zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay abuurka xoolaha ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda gobolka Nandi bisha November.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KALRO biro pogo kodhi mag nyinyo ne jopur man Nandi County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds livestock keepers in Wajir County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee Gobolka Wajir inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha ka guuraan xadka gobolka iyaga oo aan haysan rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development paronwa jorit jamni e county mar Wajir mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni kuonde mopogore opogore maok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission opens a new ICT skills programme at the vocational centre in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yafungua programu mpya ya ujuzi wa ICT katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ka furayaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan xirfadaha ICT ee xarunta xirfadda ee degmada Makueni.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj chako chenro manyien mar lony e yore mag ICT e kar tich e gweng' mar Makueni.

English: State Department for Basic Education encourages out-of-school children in Baringo County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Baringo kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka Baringo waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta dugsiga ka baxsan inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee barnaamijyada quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e County mar Baringo mondo odonj e program mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo e bwo program mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: Learn how farmers can participate in carbon credit programs by adopting practices that sequester carbon in dairy farm.
Kiswahili: Jifunze jinsi wakulima wanavyoweza kushiriki katika programu za mikopo ya kaboni kwa kutumia mbinu zinazotenga kaboni katika shamba la ng'ombe wa maziwa.
Somali: Baro sida beeraleydu uga qayb qaadan karaan barnaamijyada kaarboonka amaahda iyagoo qaadanaya hababka ku xayira kaarboonka beerta caanaha.
Dholuo: Puonjri kaka jopur nyalo konyo e chenro mag chiwo pesa kuom tiyo gi yore mag choko carbon e puothe mag chak.

English: Notice: NTSA issues a cybersecurity alert on phishing messages affecting residents of Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya ujumbe wa phishing unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay soo saartaa digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan fariimaha phishing ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NTSA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity e wi ote mag phishing makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e Trans Nzoia County.

English: COMESA urges farmers in Narok County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Narok inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo lagu soo ururiyo biyaha beeraha si ay ula qabsadaan isbedelka roobabka roobaa.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Narok mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok ma timore e kaka koth chue.

English: IPOA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kilifi County that access to free legal aid is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisheria ni bure.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Kilifi in la heli karo caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah oo lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Kilifi ni thuolo mar yudo kony ma onge chudo en gima ok ochuno.

English: KICD advises applicants in Narok County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KICD inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Narok kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KICD waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha gobolka Narok inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: KICD nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e gweng' mar Narok ni mondo gidonj e tiegruok kapok ichopo e chokruok mabiro.

English: OGP urges residents of Makueni County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogweng' Makueni County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e loso chenro mag chenro mag oganda.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kericho County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Kericho kutafuta msaada katika nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Kericho inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e County mar Kericho mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Turkana County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for December 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Turkana: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Desemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Turkana: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Diseembar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Turkana: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2022

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the public in Embu County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawahimiza raia wa Kaunti ya Embu wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa shacabka degmada Embu inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ji duto e county mar Embu mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo weche mag phishing.

English: IEBC encourages first-time voters in Nairobi County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IebC.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Nairobi inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta Iebc ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogo ma ne okwongo yiero e County mar Nairobi mondo olim kama ichikoe ji mondo okonygi.

English: Marsabit County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for November 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Marsabit: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Novemba 2023
Somali: Degmada Marsabit: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Noofambar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Marsabit: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2023

English: Notice: NPS issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa utambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay soo saartaa digniin amniga internetka ah oo ku saabsan tuugada aqoonsiga ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Marsabit.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NPS ogolo siem mar rito weche mag sirkal kuom wach kwalo nying' jogo modak e taon mar Marsabit County.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) calls on parents in Kakamega County to have children under five screened for cholera during the November outreach.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuwafanyia watoto chini ya miaka mitano uchunguzi wa kipindupindupindu wakati wa mawasiliano ya Novemba.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta Gobolka Kakamega in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka kolera intii lagu jiray bisha November.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) dwaro ni jonyuol e Kaunti mar Kakamega otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will train farmers in Samburu County on water harvesting this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuhusu uvunaji wa maji Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha Kenya wuxuu tababar siin doonaa beeraleyda Gobolka Samburu oo ku saabsan goosashada biyaha bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Dairy Board biro tiego jopur e county mar Samburu e wi choko pi e dwe mar April.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) appeals to caregivers in Murang'a County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the June maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhudhuria siku iliyopangwa ya kliniki kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Juni.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Murang'a inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta bukaanka ee la qorsheeyay iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee bisha Juun.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) kwayo jorit e county mar Murang'a mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar thieth ma ne otim e dwe mar Jun.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Taita-Taveta County that access to free medical camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za matibabu bila malipo sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Taita-Taveta in helitaanka xeryaha caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji duto e Taita-Taveta County ni koro ginyalo yudo kuonde thieth maonge chudo e kuonde moyier.

English: Kenya: Worsening climate shocks exacerbate food shortages
Kiswahili: Kenya: Majanga ya hali ya hewa yanazidisha uhaba wa chakula
Somali: Kenya: Dhibaatooyinka cimilada oo sii kordhaya ayaa sii xumeynaya cunto yaraanta
Dholuo: Kenya: Midhiero mag kor lwasi ma medore medo nok mar chiemo

English: Use proper baby carriers to support baby's neck and hips. Always ensure baby's face is visible and uncovered.
Kiswahili: Tumia vifaa vya kubeba mtoto vinavyofaa ili kushikilia shingo na nyonga za mtoto. Hakikisha uso wa mtoto unaonekana na haujafunikwa.
Somali: Isticmaal qalabka ilmaha lagu qaado si aad u taageerto qoorta iyo miskaha ilmaha. Mar walba hubi in wejiga ilmaha la arki karo oo aan la dabooli karin.
Dholuo: Ti kod gik ma ng’ato nyalo ting’ogo nyithindo ma owinjore mondo orit ng’ut nyathi kod ng’ute. Kinde duto ne ni wang’ nyathi nenore kendo ok oumo.

English: IEBC encourages residents of Garissa County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Garissa inay ka qeybgalaan madasha dadweynaha degmada si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadwaynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Garissa mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county mondo ging'e kaka ji duto biro tiyo gi bajet mag county.

English: Kenya Flash Appeal at a glance (Oct 21 - Dec 22)
Kiswahili: Rufaa ya Kenya Flash kwa muhtasari (Okt 21 - Des 22)
Somali: Soo jeedinta Degdegga ah ee Kenya (Oktoobar 21 - Diseembar 22)
Dholuo: Kenya Okwayo mapiyo (21 Oktoba - 22 Desemba)

English: KUCCPS encourages out-of-school children in Marsabit County to register their children at the nearest public school under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Marsabit inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga dadweynaha ee ugu dhow fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e gweng' mar Marsabit mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul ma ni machiegni gi kama gidakie.

English: Universities Fund advises applicants in Kitui County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Kitui kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku talinayaa codsadayaasha degmada Kitui inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee la heli karo.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e gweng' mar Kitui mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Migori County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa usaidizi wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Migori inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow si ay uga caawiyaan helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ee lacageed.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso jogweng' Migori County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni mondo giyud kony mar yudo kony kuom weche thieth.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will open a maize collection centre in West Pokot County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mahindi katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ka furi doonaa xarun ururinta hadhuudhka ee Gobolka West Pokot bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro yawo kambi mar choko cham e West Pokot County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Simone Sala. Quick thinking on the content. Check changes in digital and technology among farmers.
Kiswahili: Simone Sala, kufikiri haraka juu ya maudhui, kuangalia mabadiliko katika digital na teknolojia miongoni mwa wakulima.
Somali: Simone Sala, si dhakhso leh u fikir waxyaabaha ku jira, hubi isbeddellada dhijitaalka ah iyo tikniyoolajiyadda ee beeraleyda.
Dholuo: Simone Sala, ng'i ane mapiyo lokruok ma timore e yore mag digital kod teknoloji e kind jopur.

English: AFA announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for poultry in Kilifi County this November.
Kiswahili: AFA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa kuku katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Novemba hii.
Somali: AFA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee digaagga ee Gobolka Kilifi bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: AFA olando chenro mar thiedho dhok gi tuoche mag dhoot maonge chudo e dwe mar Novemba e gweng' mar Kilifi.

English: Notice: TVET opens applications for school laptops under the digital literacy programme for learners in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inafungua maombi ya kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay furaysaa codsiyada kumbuyuutarrada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee ardayda degmada Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET chako tiyo gi kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar somo kod somo mar digital ne jopuonjre man Lamu County.

English: Judiciary of Kenya advises residents of Nyamira County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan shahaadada dhalashada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya nyiso jogweng' Nyamira County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro yudo barua mar nyuol.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges farmers in Narok County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Narok inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo soo-saarka biyaha ee beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan qaababka roobka ee isbeddelaya.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur manie Narok County mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds residents of Mandera County that water harvesting improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba uvunaji wa maji unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Degmada Mandera in soo-saarka biyaha uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development oparo ne Jo Mandera County ni choko pi miyo puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: Government published market price index for small holder farmers.
Kiswahili: Serikali ilichapisha orodha ya bei ya wakulima wadogo.
Somali: Dowladda ayaa daabacday tusmada qiimaha suuqa ee beeraleyda yaryar.
Dholuo: Sirkal ne oloso nonro mar nengo mar pesa e pinyno ne jopur matindo.

English: Universities Fund advises students in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to register early to secure allocation to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ardayda degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet kula talinayaa inay horay u diiwaangeliyaan si ay u helaan lacag la'aan barashada dijitaalka ah.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund nyiso jopuonjre e County mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni gidonj e skundno chon mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo somo mar digital maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the community in Lamu County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb fraud.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia udanganyifu.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa bulshada degmada Lamu inay ka warbixiyaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo shaki leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo khiyaamooyinka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Forest Service jiwo oganda man Lamu County mondo onyis polis ma ni machiegni gi kanyo ni gitimo gik ma chando ji.

English: Notice: Council of Governors opens voter education centres in Trans Nzoia County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia mwezi huu wa Septemba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa furaya xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee degmada Trans Nzoia bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Jaloch biro yawo kuonde tiego josiasa e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds expectant mothers in Tharaka-Nithi County that access to nutrition supplementation for infants is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwamba upatikanaji wa nyongeza ya lishe kwa watoto wachanga ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi in helitaanka cuntada lagu daro dhallaanka ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne mine ma biro nyuolo nyithindo e Tharaka-Nithi County ni nyithindo nyalo yudo chiemb chuny maonge chudo e ute duto.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Mombasa County that reporting carjacking promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba kuripoti utekaji nyara mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Adeegga kaynta Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan gobolka Mombasa in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan baabuurta la xaday ay gacan ka geystaan ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service oparo ne jogweng' Mombasa County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar wuondo mtokni konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service launches a burglary prevention campaign in Kirinyaga County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu bilaabay olole ka hortagga tuugada degmada Kirinyaga bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: Kenya Forest Service chako kampen mar geng'o jokuoge kik donj e gweng' mar Kirinyaga e dwe mar Desemba.

English: E-Citizen invites residents of Vihiga County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kushiriki kupitia portal ya kushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee la xiriira wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: E-Citizen gwelo ji modak e County mar Vihiga mondo oriwre kodgi kokalo kuom websait mar county mar chiwo paro e wi chenro mag sirkal.

English: ODPP warns public officers in Marsabit County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: ODPP inaonya maafisa wa umma katika wilaya ya Marsabit dhidi ya kupotosha fedha za umma.
Somali: ODPP waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Marsabit inay ka xishoodaan dhaqaalaha dawladda.
Dholuo: ODPP chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal mar Marsabit County ni kik giti gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo e yo marach.

English: The New Refugee Act in Kenya and What it Means for Refugees
Kiswahili: Sheria Mpya ya Wakimbizi nchini Kenya na Maana yake kwa Wakimbizi
Somali: Xeerka Cusub ee Qaxootiga ee Kenya iyo Macnaha uu u leeyahay Qaxootiga
Dholuo: Chik Manyien mar Jolweny e piny Kenya kod gima onyiso ne jolweny

English: Pest Control Products Board urges farmers in Samburu County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda gobolka Samburu inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo lagu soo uruuriyo biyaha beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: Bura mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Samburu mondo oti gi yore mag yudho pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok e kaka koth chue.

English: By analyzing access to essential services, livelihoods, and social cohesion, the SMI identifies gaps in recovery efforts and informs targeted interventions.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuchanganua ufikiaji wa huduma muhimu, riziki, na uwiano wa kijamii, SMI inatambua mapungufu katika juhudi za kurejesha na kuarifu afua zinazolengwa.
Somali: Iyadoo la falanqeynayo helitaanka adeegyada lagama maarmaanka ah, hab-nololeedka, iyo isku-xidhka bulshada, SMI waxay aqoonsataa farqiga u dhexeeya dadaallada soo kabashada waxayna wargelisaa faragelinta la beegsanayo.
Dholuo: Ka ng’ato otimo nonro kuom yudo kony ma dwarore, yore mag dak, kod winjruok e kind oganda, SMI fwenyo gap ma nitie e tich mar dwoko piny kendo onyiso yore ma ochung’ne.

English: Notice: KRA opens voter registration centres in Mombasa County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inafungua vituo vya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay furaysaa xarumaha diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee gobolka Mombasa bisha July.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KRA osechako chenro mar chano joma biro yiero e county mar Mombasa e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inaamsha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada wuxuu soo saaraa qorshe falcelin deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay shilalka waddooyinka ee Gobolka Garissa.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche motudore gi timbe mahundu chako tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony e masiche ma timore e nderni e gweng' mar Garissa.

English: Announcement of new policies for government office bearers and private offices must ensure that there are rooms for breatfeeding onthers to breast feed their children and to rest.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la sera mpya kwa watumiaji wa ofisi za serikali na ofisi binafsi lazima kuhakikisha kwamba kuna vyumba kwa ajili ya kuwalisha watoto kwa kunyonyesha watoto wao na kupumzika.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida siyaasadaha cusub ee loogu talagalay kuwa haysta xafiisyada dawladda iyo xafiiska gaarka loo leeyahay waa in la hubiyaa in ay jiraan qolal ay ku quudiyaan caruurtooda si ay u nuujiyaan oo ay u nastaan.
Dholuo: Lando chike manyien ne joma nigi migepe mag sirkal kod tije mag dhano onego omi gibed gadier ni nitie kuonde ma joma pidhogi gi muya nyalo pidhogo nyithindgi kendo yueyo.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges maize growers in Lamu County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Wanyama inawasihi wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Lamu watumie viwango vinavyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Lamu inay isticmaalaan sicirka bacriminta lagu taliyey roobka ka hor si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur ma pidho cham e County mar Lamu mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue mondo okony nyak mar cham e higani.

English: Council of Governors invites residents of Makueni County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kuwasilisha maandishi ya kumbukumbu kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku martiqaadaan dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch ogwelo jogweng' Makueni mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso bajet mar county ochopo.

English: Push-pull systems, involving a plant, such as desmodium, that repels insects, and another, such as Napier grass, that attracts them, have ...
Kiswahili: Mifumo ya kushinikiza-kuvuta, inayohusisha mimea, kama vile desmodium, ambayo inawafukuza wadudu, na nyingine, kama nyasi ya Napier, ambayo huwavutia, ina ...
Somali: Nidaamyada riix-raaca, oo ku lug leh dhirta, sida desmodium, oo ka carareysa cayayaanka, iyo mid kale, sida cawska Napier, oo soo jiidata, waxay leeyihiin ...
Dholuo: Chenro mag riembo kod riembo, ma gin kaka Desmodium ma riembo choke, kod machielo kaka Napier, ma ywayo chokego, nigi...

English: This World Mental Health Day, let's prioritize mental well-being at work! A supportive environment is key to a healthy workplace. Check in on your colleagues today!
Kiswahili: Siku hii ya Afya ya Akili Duniani, hebu tuweke kipaumbele ustawi wa akili kazini! Mazingira yanayounga mkono ni muhimu kwa afya mahali pa kazi. Wasiliana na wenzako leo!
Somali: Maalintan Caafimaadka Dhimirka Adduunka, aan mudnaanta siino fayoobaanta maskaxda ee goobta shaqada! Deegaan taageero leh ayaa fure u ah goob shaqo oo caafimaad qabta. Maanta la xiriir asxaabtaada!
Dholuo: Odiechieng’ mar piny mangima mar thieth mar paro, we mondo waket bedo maber mar paro e kar tich obed mokuongo! Kabedo ma konyo ji en gima duong’ ahinya e miyo ng’ato obed gi ngima maber e kar tich. Inyalo ng’iyo jotich weteni sani!

English: Government to provide science laboratory equipment to secondary schools to boost practical learning.
Kiswahili: Serikali kutoa vifaa vya maabara ya sayansi kwa shule za sekondari ili kuongeza kujifunza kwa vitendo.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay siineysaa qalabka shaybaarka sayniska dugsiyada dhexe si kor loogu qaado barashada wax ku oolka ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mondo ochiw gige thieth mag sayans ne skunde mag sekondari mondo okony ji opuonjre e yore mopogore opogore.

English: Council of Governors reminds residents of Kajiado County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kajiado County ambao wanahudhuria mkutano wa umma wa kusanyiko la kaunti kuimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Kajiado in ka qaybgalka kalfadhiga guud ee shirka degmada uu xoojiyo maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch parone jogweng' Kajiado County ni dhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: KTDA urges beans growers in Isiolo County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawasihi wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kufanya mazoezi ya kugeuza mazao ili kurejesha uzazi wa udongo ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Isiolo inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalaalka ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur ma pidho keyo e kaunti mar Isiolo mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber kendo mondo omi nyak obed maber e higani.

English: NCPB urges beans growers in Kitui County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Kitui kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kitui inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalaalka ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur molony e gweng' mar Kitui mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: Introduction of postpartum exercise and nutrition support groups led by physiotherapists and dietitians.
Kiswahili: Utangulizi wa mazoezi ya baada ya kujifungua na vikundi vya usaidizi wa lishe vinavyoongozwa na wataalamu wa tiba ya viungo na wataalamu wa lishe.
Somali: Soo bandhigida jimicsiga dhalmada ka dib iyo kooxaha taageerada nafaqada ee ay hogaamiyaan dhakhaatiirta jirka iyo nafaqada.
Dholuo: Tiyo gi tuke mag nindruok kod riwruoge ma siro ji e weche mag chiemo e kinde nyuol, e bwo loch mar jothieth mag thieth kod joma nono chiemo.

English: NPS urges residents of Nairobi County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NPS inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama katikati ya umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay soo sheegaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo la adeegsanayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo jogweng' Nairobi County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar sirkal e wi gik ma ne timore e alwora mar tong'gi nikech ji osebedo ka chiwo siem motelo ne oganda.

English: Between 2020 and 2024, Tana River County experienced alternating cycles of drought and flooding, exacerbating displacement patterns.
Kiswahili: Kati ya 2020 na 2024, Kaunti ya Tana River ilikumbwa na mizunguko ya ukame na mafuriko, na hivyo kuzidisha mwelekeo wa watu kuhama makazi yao.
Somali: Intii u dhaxaysay 2020 iyo 2024, Degmada Tana River waxay la kulantay wareegyo abaar iyo daadad oo isbedbeddelaya, taasoo sii xumeysay qaababka barakaca.
Dholuo: E kind higa mar 2020 gi 2024, Aora Tana ne oyudo oro kod oro ma ne opong’o piny, ma ne omedo ng’anjo mar weyo udigi.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Bungoma County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this drought season.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati huu wa ukame.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada daadadka ka dhacay xilligan abaarta.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross parone jogweng'o mag Bungoma County ni kik ging'ad kor lwasi mag pi kod pi e kinde oro.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will open a maize collection centre in Marsabit County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mahindi katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xarun ururinta hadhuudhka ka furi doontaa degmada Marsabit bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro yawo kama ichokoe cham e Marsabit County e dwe mar Mach.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development encourages residents of Kericho County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo jogweng' Kericho County mondo ong'e weche ma giduto giduto gikwongo tiyogo ka gidwaro ng'eyo kaka jopiny biro tiyo gi bajet mar county.

English: Universities Fund conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in Taita-Taveta County this February.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta Februari hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu bishii Febraayo ku qabtaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund timo romo mar tiego ji e wi ratiro mag sirkal e Taita-Taveta County e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: Council of Governors opens polling procedures centres in Samburu County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Samburu mwezi Juni huu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa furaya xarumaha nidaamyada codbixinta ee Gobolka Samburu bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Bura mar Jaloch ochako tiyo gi kuonde ma itimoe yiero e taon mar Samburu e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: e-Citizen launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Nairobi County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu ya kupambana na ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi mwezi huu wa Oktoba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: e-Citizen waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa gobolka Nairobi bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Rapar: e-Citizen chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Nairobi e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: NTSA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Nyamira County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: NTSA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Nyamira piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Nyamira inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: NTSA ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e County mar Nyamira mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: Kenya: Pastoralist communities grow vegetables that resist the drought
Kiswahili: Kenya: Jamii za wafugaji hupanda mboga zinazostahimili ukame
Somali: Kenya: Bulshooyinka xoolo-dhaqatada ah waxay beeraan khudaar iska caabisa abaarta
Dholuo: Kenya: Oganda ma nigi jokwath pidho alode ma ok nyal bedo gi oro

English: Ministry of Education to strengthen career guidance and counseling services in secondary schools.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu kuimarisha miongozo ya kazi na huduma za ushauri katika shule za sekondari.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada si loo xoojiyo hagida xirfadeedka iyo adeegyada la talinta dugsiyada dhexe.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Puonjruok mondo omed jiwo tiegruok kod tiego nyithindo e skunde mag sekondari.

English: Government plans deployment of solar-powered computer labs to increase ICT access in remote rural schools.
Kiswahili: Serikali ina mipango ya kutekeleza maabara ya kompyuta inayoendeshwa na nishati ya jua ili kuongeza upatikanaji wa ICT katika shule za vijijini za mbali.
Somali: Dowladda waxay qorsheyneysaa in la hirgeliyo shaybaarro kombiyuutar oo ku shaqeeya qorraxda si loo kordhiyo helitaanka ICT dugsiyada miyiga ee fog.
Dholuo: Sirkal nigi chenro mar tiyo gi kembe mag kompyuta matiyo gi teko mar chieng' mondo omed miyo skunde manie gwenge mosokore obed gi thuolo mar yudo weche modok korka weche mag teknoloji.

English: To prevent maize downy mildew disease (locally called 'nanzikambe' in Chichewa): till the field deeply before planting, use certified seed from licensed sellers, avoid planting maize near sugarcane, use recommended plant spacing for good airflow, rotate maize with legume crops, and treat seed with Metalaxyl fungicide (6g per kg of seed).
Kiswahili: Ili kuzuia ugonjwa wa ukungu wa mahindi (unaojulikana Malawi kama 'nanzikambe'): lima shamba kwa kina kabla ya kupanda, tumia mbegu zilizothibitishwa kutoka kwa wauzaji walioidhinishwa, epuka kupanda mahindi karibu na miwa, panda kwa nafasi inayopendekezwa ili hewa ipite vizuri, badilisha mahindi na mazao ya jamii ya mikunde, na tibu mbegu kwa dawa ya kuvu ya Metalaxyl (gramu 6 kwa kilo ya mbegu).
Somali: Si looga hortago cudurka caleemada galleyda (oo si maxalli ah loogu yeero 'nanzikambe' Chichewa): beerta si qoto dheer u beero ka hor inta aan la beerin, isticmaal abuur shahaado leh oo ka yimid iibiyeyaasha ruqsad leh, ka fogow beerista galleyda agagaarka sonkorta, isticmaal kala fogaanshaha dhirta ee la taliyay si hawadu u socoto wanaagsan, beddel galleyda iyo dalagyada digirta, iyo daaweynta abuurka Metalaxyl fungicide (6g halkii kiilo abuur).
Dholuo: Mondo igeng' thieth mar mildew (ma iluongo ni 'nanzikambe' e dho Chichewa): ka pok ipidho puodho, ti gi kodhi molony gi jolok ohala molony, kik ipidhi machiegni gi sukari, iti gi tong' molony mondo omi yien obed gi muya maber, lwok kodhi gi olembe mag legume, kendo thiedhe gi Methalaxyl fungicide (6g kuom kg mag kodhi).

Kiswahili: Kenya | Mafuriko ya Mto - Uanzishaji wa Itifaki ya Hatua ya Mapema (10 Novemba2023) Operesheni â„–: MDRKE053
