English: Farmers are urged to prioritize soil health to improve agricultural productivity
Kiswahili: Wakulima wamehimizwa kuweka kipaumbele katika afya ya udongo ili kuboresha uzalishaji wa kilimo
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu booriyay inay mudnaanta siiyaan caafimaadka ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka beeraha
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur mondo oket ngima lowo obed motelo mondo omi gimi puothe obed gi nyak maber

English: Notice: DCI opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa simu ya GBV ya bure katika Wilaya ya Isiolo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ee degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DCI chako tiyo gi ofis mar weche nindruok e gweng' mar Isiolo.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) launches a January awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Tana River County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Januari juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Tana River.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa bilaabay olole wacyi galineed bishii Janaayo oo ku saabsan baaritaanka sonkorowga gobolka Tana River.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Januar e wi thieth mar sukari e taon duto mar Tana River County.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free depression awareness support is available through county health facilities in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa uhamasishaji wa unyogovu unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay wacyiga niyadjabku laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Kirinyaga County.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar parruok yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth e County ma Kirinyaga County.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kakamega County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu billaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee Gobolka Kakamega bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Rapar: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e Kaunti mar Kakamega e dwe mar Jun.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free typhoid screening is available at all public health centres in Makueni County this June.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa matumbo wa matumbo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Makueni Juni hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka tifooska ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Makueni bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche parone ji ni nono tuo mar typhoid onge tich e kuonde thieth duto e County Makueni e dwe mar Jun.

English: Public health advisory: Kenya Medical Association warns of increased malaria risk in Siaya County and advises the public to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya malaria katika Kaunti ya Siaya na kushauri umma kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu ka digay khatarta sii kordheysa ee malaria ee degmada Siaya wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagula talinayo.
Dholuo: Rieko mar thieth mar ji: Kenya Medical Association chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar malaria e county mar Siaya kendo ojiwo ji duto mondo otiek dose duto mag thieth.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Elgeyo-Marakwet County that access to free medical camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za matibabu bila malipo sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in helitaanka xeryaha caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha loo qoondeeyay.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji duto e County mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni koro ginyalo yudo kuonde thieth maonge chudo e kuonde moyier.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET reminds citizens in Garissa County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda TVET waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Garissa ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar State for TVET parone raia mag County mar Garissa kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo gi ji duto e bajet mar county.

English: Monitor cyberbullying 2023.
Kiswahili: Fuatilia unyanyasaji wa mtandao mwaka 2023.
Somali: La soco dhibaatada internetka sanadka 2023.
Dholuo: Tim nonro mar cyberbullying e higa mar 2023.

English: OGP urges residents of Garissa County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Garissa inay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada si ay uga warqabaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Garissa mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo omed ng'eyo chenro mar dongruok e gweng'no.

English: Every day, we are at risk to witness new disease, or emerging new disease, or any other disease. In the most recent include MPOX, Ebola, Zika and more especially the problem we went Covid 19
Kiswahili: Kila siku, tunakabiliwa na hatari ya kushuhudia magonjwa mapya, au ugonjwa mpya unaoibuka, au magonjwa mengine yoyote. Katika ya hivi karibuni ni pamoja na MPOX, Ebola, Zika na haswa shida tuliyoipata COVID 19
Somali: Maalin kasta, waxaan halis ugu jirnaa inaan aragno cudurro cusub, ama cudur cusub oo soo ifbaxaya, ama mid kale oo cudur ah. Kuwa ugu dambeeyay waxaa ka mid ah MPOX, Ebola, Zika iyo gaar ahaan dhibaatada aan ku jirnay COVID 19
Dholuo: Odiechieng' kodiechieng', wan e bwo chandruok mar yudo tuoche manyien, kata tuoche mapod owuok, kata tuwo moro amora.

English: Farmers are facing increased costs due to high animal feed prices driven by a concentrated market Stay informed about market changes and seek alternative suppliers to manage costs effectively
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanakabiliwa na ongezeko la gharama kutokana na kupanda kwa bei ya vyakula vya mifugo kutokana na soko lililokolea. Endelea kufahamishwa kuhusu mabadiliko ya soko na utafute wasambazaji bidhaa mbadala ili kudhibiti gharama kwa ufanisi.
Somali: Beeraleyda ayaa wajahaya kharashyo kordhaya sababo la xiriira qiimaha sare ee quudka xoolaha oo ay sabab u tahay suuq xooggan La soco isbeddelada suuqa oo raadi alaab-qeybiyeyaasha kale si ay si hufan u maareeyaan kharashaadka
Dholuo: Jo-Puritani romo gi nengo momedore nikech nengo mag chiemo mag le ma ng'ato nyalo chamo nikech piny ma ji odakie ng'enyie.

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages residents of Bungoma County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay ugu yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giluong kony mar thieth mar parruok maonge chudo.

English: Notice: CDC will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Bomet County this October. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: CDC itafanya kongamano la kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Bomet Oktoba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: CDC waxay qabaneysaa forum ka soo kabashada xadgudubka maandooriyaha gobolka Bomet bisha Oktoobar. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni CDC biro timo chokruok mar chango joma tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero e taon mar Bomet e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: OGP updates residents of West Pokot County on progress of community-based development programmes this April.
Kiswahili: OGP inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya West Pokot juu ya maendeleo ya mipango ya maendeleo katika jumuiya mwezi Aprili.
Somali: OGP waxay dadka deggan degmada West Pokot ku wargelineysaa horumarka barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada ee bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: OGP osemiyo jodak mag West Pokot County ng'eyo dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag oganda e dwe mar April.

English: The Agricultural Sector Transformation and Growth Strategy 2019 2029 is now in effect guiding farmers and agribusiness stakeholders to align with national agricultural policies
Kiswahili: Mkakati wa Mabadiliko na Ukuaji wa Sekta ya Kilimo 2019 2029 sasa unaanza kuwaelekeza wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo ili kuendana na sera za kitaifa za kilimo.
Somali: Istaraatiijiyadda Isbeddelka iyo Kobaca Qaybta Beeraha 2019 2029 hadda waa mid dhaqan gelinaysa iyadoo hagaysa beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha inay la jaanqaadaan siyaasadaha beeraha ee qaranka
Dholuo: Chenro mar loko kendo medo dongruok e weche mag pur 2019-2029 sani tiyo kendo konyo jopur kod joma okendore e weche mag pur mondo oluw chike mag piny mangima.

English: To control tomato red spider mite, avoid continuous tomato cropping, remove and destroy crop residues before replanting, wash and sun-dry stakes and twine before reuse, inspect crop borders regularly, and spray water on plants to reduce the dust that mites thrive in.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti utitiri wa buibui nyekundu wa nyanya, epuka kupanda nyanya kuendelea, ondoa na uharibu mabaki ya mazao kabla ya kupanda tena, osha na kausha vigingi na kamba kabla ya kutumia tena, kagua mipaka ya mazao mara kwa mara, na nyunyiza maji kwenye mimea ili kupunguza vumbi ambalo utitiri hustawi.
Somali: Si loo xakameeyo cayayaanka cas ee yaanyada, ka fogow goynta joogtada ah ee yaanyada, ka saar oo baabi'i wixii dalagga ka hor inta aan dib loo beerin, ku dhaq oo qalaj qorraxda ka hor inta aan dib loo isticmaalin, si joogto ah u eeg xuduudaha dalagga, oo biyo ku buufi dhirta si loo yareeyo boodhka ay ku nool yihiin canka.
Dholuo: Mondo omi kik ng'ato chamo cham mag tomato, nyaka oketh kodhi ma ok dhi nyime, nyaka ogol kodhi modong' kapok opidhogi kendo, nyaka olwok kendo otiek yiende kod yiende kapok oti kodgi kendo, onego onon tong' mag yiende kinde ka kinde, kendo onego opong' yiende gi pi mondo omi oketh buru ma yiende dongoe.

English: HELB reminds needy students in Nyandarua County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Nyandarua in deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay codsiyada ardayda baahan ay dhowaan dhammaadaan.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa jopuonjre mochando e County mar Nyandarua ni tuke mag somo ne jopuonjre ma nigi chan biro rumo machiegni.

English: Notice: KTDA will distribute certified maize seed to farmers in Kirinyaga County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itasambaza mbegu za mahindi zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay abuurka hadhuudhka ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kirinyaga bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KTDA biro pogo kodhi mag kodhi mar kodhi ne jopur man Kirinyaga County e dwe mar Julai.

English: KALRO reminds livestock keepers in Laikipia County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KALRO waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha Laikipia County inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanada buka xafiiska xayawaanka ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KALRO parone jorit jamni e county mar Laikipia ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds mobile money users in West Pokot County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid identity theft.
Kiswahili: Kenya Red Cross inawakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee Gobolka West Pokot in ay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qabanin si looga fogaado tuugada aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e West Pokot County ni mondo ging'e kwayo mag pesa kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo kik jokuoge okwel nyingegi.

English: KEMRI study shows ivermectin significantly reduces malaria transmission
Kiswahili: Utafiti wa KEMRI unaonyesha ivermectin hupunguza kwa kiasi kikubwa maambukizi ya malaria
Somali: Daraasad KEMRI ah ayaa muujineysa in ivermectin ay si weyn u yareyneyso gudbinta malaria
Dholuo: Nonro mar KEMRI nyiso ni ivermectin nyalo miyo midekre mag malaria odog chien

English: COMESA advises farmers in Wajir County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the February planting season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Februari.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Wajir inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Febraayo.
Dholuo: COMESA nyiso jopur e gweng' mar Wajir ni giti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Februar.

English: NTSA urges motorists and pedestrians in Wajir County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Wajir kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Wajir inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka abaarta la xiriira.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo derebe kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Wajir mondo oluw chike mag wuoth ma jotelo mag gweng'no ogolo mondo gikwed masiche motudore gi oro.

English: Public notice: CDC will host a free diabetes screening outreach in Kilifi County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: CDC itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uchunguzi wa kisukari bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: CDC waxay martigelin doontaa baaritaan bukaan-socodka oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka macaanka ee degmada Kilifi bisha November.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuoche (CDC) biro timo nonro ma onge chudo mar tuwo mar sukari e gweng' mar Kilifi e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Remember: â€œIf youâ€™re exhibiting symptoms, call 719 and let them know and decide on a course of action #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: "Ikiwa unaonyesha dalili, piga 719 na uwajulishe na uamue hatua ya kuchukua #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Xusuusnow: "Haddii aad muujinayso astaamo, wac 719 oo u sheeg oo go'aan ka gaar tallaabada aad qaadayso #KomeshaCorona"
Dholuo: Par niya: â€œKa inyiso ranyisi mag tuo, goch namba 719 kendo inyisgi kendo iyier yo ma ibiro tiyogo #KomeshaCorona

English: Kenya Forest Service urges residents of Kiambu County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyadoo la sii xoojinayo feejignaanta ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service ojiwo jogweng' Kiambu County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar rito kuonde ma ji yudore e alworano e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: KEMRI advises residents of Meru County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: KEMRI waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: KEMRI nyiso jogweng' mar County mar Meru mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth ma onge chudo mar oganda mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Farmers are urged to take immediate action against the False Coddling Moth FCM to prevent export rejections to the EU Increased checks may result in up to 50 of rose consignments being inspected
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kuchukua hatua za haraka dhidi ya False Coddling Moth FCM ili kuzuia kukataliwa kwa mauzo ya nje kwa EU. Kuongezeka kwa hundi kunaweza kusababisha hadi shehena 50 za waridi kukaguliwa.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay si degdeg ah tallaabo uga qaadaan False Coddling Moth FCM si looga hortago diidmada dhoofinta ee EU. Hubinta kordhinta waxay keeni kartaa in ilaa 50 ubax la baaro
Dholuo: Ojiwo jopur mondo otim mapiyo e wi FCM mar Fake Coddling Moth mondo kik neg owetegi e pinje ma gigolo oko mar pinje ma gigolo e pinje ma gigolo e pinje maboyo

English: Notice: COMESA restricts movement of pigs in Kisumu County due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA inazuia harakati za nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Newcastle.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa doofaarka ee degmada Kisumu sababo la xiriira cudurka Newcastle.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: COMESA ogeng'o wuoth mar le e County Kisumu nikech tuo mar Newcastle.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds farmers in Samburu County of the ongoing greenhouse farming training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu mpango unaoendelea wa mafunzo ya kilimo cha chafu.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa beeraleyda Gobolka Samburu barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board oparo ne jopur e county mar Samburu chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar pur.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone experiencing abuse in Bomet County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Bomet apeleke simu ya simu ya GBV 1195.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Bomet inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e County mar Bomet mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will distribute certified wheat seed to farmers in Isiolo County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu za ngano zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu abuuraha Degmada Isiolo u qaybin doonaa abuurka sarreenka ee shahaadooyinka leh bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro pogo kodhi mag ngano ne jopur manie Isiolo County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: TSC encourages residents of Nyamira County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on voter registration.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: TSC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo jogweng' Nyamira County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda mondo ging'e weche duto motudore gi ndiko joma oyiero.

English: CDC encourages residents of Lamu County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Lamu inaysan ku xanuunsadaan si aamusnaan ah oo ay ugu yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo jogweng' County mar Lamu mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giluong simo mar thieth mar paro maonge chudo.

English: DPP urges motorists and pedestrians in Lamu County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DPP anawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Lamu kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Lamu inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo derebe kod joma wuotho e ndara e County mar Lamu mondo oluw chike mag wuotho ma jotelo mag gweng'no ogolo mondo gikwed hinyruok mag ndara.

English: Notice: KNEC launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay bilawday barnaamij ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada iskuulada guud ahaan Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KNEC chako chenro mar rito nyithindo e skunde e skul duto mag Kaunti mar Kakamega.

English: E-Citizen advises residents of Kericho County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-C citizen wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e-citizen.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e- Citizen marka ay raadinayaan diiwaangelinta e-Ciidamada.
Dholuo: E-Citizen nyiso ji duto modak e County mar Kericho mondo oketgi e intanet ka gitiyo gi e-C citizen portal sama gidwaro dhi e e-citizen registration.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Nandi County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Nandi in warbixinta soonka ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NTSA parone jogweng'o mag Nandi County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo kuom nek konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: World Malaria Day: Kenya Joins the World in Commemorating Malaria Day.
Kiswahili: Siku ya Malaria Duniani: Kenya Yaungana na Dunia Kuadhimisha Siku ya Malaria.
Somali: Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Cudurka Malaria: Kenya ayaa ku biirtay maalinta caalamiga ee xuska cudurka.
Dholuo: Odiechieng Malieria e Piny Ngima: Kenya Riwore gi Piny Mangima e Paro Odiechieng' Malieria.

English: EACC reminds the public in Nyandarua County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: EACC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka gobolka Nyandarua in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: EACC parone ji duto e County mar Nyandarua ni chiwo ripot mar kawo asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Kenya Food Security Outlook Update, December 2023
Kiswahili: Sasisho la Mtazamo wa Usalama wa Chakula Kenya, Desemba 2023
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta Aragtida Amniga Cuntada Kenya, Diseembar 2023
Dholuo: Oboke mar Kenya mar Rieko mar Chiemo, dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2023

English: KRA advises residents of Isiolo County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: KRA inashauri wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: KRA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo inay qaataan dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado dib u dhac marka la raadinayo codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo jogweng' Isiolo County mondo oting'e buge duto madwarore mondo kik giketh kinde mang'eny sama gidwaro kwayo mar bedo gi kidono.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) advises residents of Narok County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Narok inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth ma onge chudo mar oganda mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) warns sorghum farmers in Murang'a County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaonya wakulima wa sorghum katika Kaunti ya Murang'a juu ya mlipuko wa wadudu na inapendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: Maamulka Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda dalagga ee degmada Murang'a cudurrada cayayaanka, wuxuuna ku talinayaa in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) chiwo siem ne jopur mag sorghum e kaunti mar Murang'a kuom masiche ma nyalo kelo tuoche, kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Kilifi County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati huu wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.

English: There is no local transmission of malaria in Nairobi. If you have been a full time resident of Nairobi and you get sick with fever the probability that it is malaria is close to zero.

Dholuo: Kapo ni ng'ato osedak Nairobi kuom thuolone duto kendo obedo matuwo nikech tuwo mar malaria, nyalo bedo ni en malaria.

English: To reduce post-harvest maize losses: harvest when the stalk withers and grains harden; if rain delays harvest, break the maize stem below the cob so it hangs down and doesn't absorb rainwater; dry maize on tarpaulins, mats, or raised racks (not on the ground) and keep animals away; and shell only when moisture content reaches 13-14%.
Kiswahili: Ili kupunguza hasara za mahindi baada ya mavuno: kuvuna wakati bua linapokauka; mvua ikikawia kunyesha, vunja shina la mahindi chini ya hindi ili lining'inia na kutofyonza maji ya mvua; mahindi makavu kwenye vitambaa, mikeka, au maboga yaliyoinuliwa (si kwenye ardhi) na kuzuia wanyama wasiingie; na kombe tu wakati unyevu unapofikia asilimia 13-14.
Somali: Si loo yareeyo khasaaraha galleyda ka dib goosashada: goos marka geedka uu engecdo oo hadhuudhku adkaado; haddii roobku dib u dhaco goosashada, jebiso geedka galleyda hoosta si uu hoos ugu dhaco oo uusan nuugin biyaha roobka; galleyda qalalan ee tarpaulin, gogosha, ama racks kor loo qaaday (aan dhulka yaalin) oo xayawaanka ka fogeeyo; qolofka oo kaliya marka qoyaan uu gaaro 13-14%.
Dholuo: Mondo ng'ato odwok chien kethruok ma koth biro kelo: keyo ka yiend koth ochwe kendo cham bedo matek; ka koth ochwe, ket tong' mar koth piny e bwo tong' mondo ogur piny kendo kik omak pi koth; keyo ma otwo e pi, pi ma otwo, kata pi ma otwo (ok e lowo) kendo rit le mabor; kendo yienego mana ka pi ma otwo chopo 13-14%.

English: OGP reminds residents of Turkana County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: OGP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana in ka qaybgalka maamulaha degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: OGP parone jogweng'o mag Turkana County ni tudruok gi jotelo mag gwenge maggi miyo sirkal bedo gi loch maber.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages mothers in Taita-Taveta County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku dhiirigelisay hooyooyinka degmada Taita-Taveta inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta caafimaad ee la qorsheeyay si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ojiwo mine e Taita-Taveta County mondo odhi e klinik ma ne ochan mondo orit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Kenya Forest Service warns residents of Lamu County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kuhusu ongezeko la udanganyifu wa pesa za simu na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ka digay dadka deggan gobolka Lamu kororka khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobilada wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga leh bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service chiwo siem ne jogweng' Lamu County e wi medruok mar timbe mag wuondo pesa mag simo kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok kare ne jatendgi.

English: KTDA warns beans farmers in Kisii County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaonya wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Kisii juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza uingiliaji kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KTDA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda ku nool degmada Kisii cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: KTDA chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho puothe e gweng' mar Kisii kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Notice: e-Citizen launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in West Pokot County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya West Pokot mwezi Juni huu.
Somali: Ogsoonow: e-Citizen waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa gobolka West Pokot bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Rapar: e-Citizen chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e West Pokot County e dwe mar Jun.

English: NDMA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kajiado County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kajiado County kwamba upatikanaji wa kumbukumbu za makazi salama zinapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee Gobolka Kajiado in helitaanka tixraacyada magangelyo ammaan ah ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e Kajiado County ni thuolo mar yudo kuonde mag dak ma nigi ritruok onge chudo.

English: Notice: NDMA issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa utambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka ah oo ku saabsan dhacda aqoonsiga oo saameyn ku leh dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NDMA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag sirkal kuom wach kuo mar ng'ato makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e Kaunti mar Kakamega.

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health will host a free safe water storage outreach in Kwale County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya itaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa kuhifadhi maji salama katika Kaunti ya Kwale Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay martigelin doontaa adeeg lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee Gobolka Kwale bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth biro timo chenro mar choko pi maonge chudo e taon mar Kwale e dwe mar April.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges rice growers in Kajiado County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawasihi wakulima wa mchele katika Kajiado County kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa za kukabiliana na ukame ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda bariiska ee degmada Kajiado inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur ma pidho kodhi e Kajiado County mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed nyak e higani.

English: KEPHIS urges sheep farmers in Kilifi County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawataka wafugaji wa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa ngozi ya uvimbe vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda idaha ee degmada Kilifi inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur ma pidho rombe e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo ochiw ripot ne jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth machiegni kodgi bang' ka osenyis ni nitie tuoche mang'eny.

English: Tharaka Nithi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Aprili 2024
Somali: Degmada Tharaka Nithi: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Tharaka Nithi: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar Ang'wen 2024

English: Discover from your small scale farming how you cÃ n supply faster from slaughter house your meat to hospital ( schhols or hospitals) dictated by their feeding timetable.
Kiswahili: Gundua kutoka kwa kilimo chako kidogo jinsi unavyosambaza haraka kutoka kwa machinjio nyama yako hadi hospitali (schhols au hospitali) iliyoamriwa na ratiba yao ya kulisha.
Somali: Ka baro beerahaaga yar yar sida aad si dhakhso leh ugu bixin karto hilibkaaga laga bilaabo goobta hilibka lagu qalo ilaa isbitaalka (dugsiyada ama isbitaallada) iyadoo lagu saleynayo jadwalka quudinta.
Dholuo: Fweny kuom puodho mari matin kaka inyalo chiwo ring’o mari mapiyo kowuok e kar ng’ado ring’o nyaka e osiptal (skul kata osiptal) kaluwore gi chenro margi mar chiemo.

English: Public notice: CDC will host a free tobacco control outreach in Busia County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: CDC itaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa kudhibiti tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Busia Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: CDC waxay marti gelineysaa dadaal lacag la'aan ah oo ka dhan ah ka hortagga sigaarka degmada Busia bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar yedhe ma thiedho ndawa (CDC) biro timo kampen mar tieko madho ndawa maonge chudo e taon mar Busia e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: KUCCPS launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay bilawday barnaamij ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada iskuulada ku yaal degmada West Pokot.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KUCCPS chako chenro mar rito nyithindo e skunde e skul duto mag West Pokot County.

English: Public notice: KEMRI will host a free food safety outreach in Nyamira County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMRI itakuwa mwenyeji wa uhamasishaji wa usalama wa chakula bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: KEMRI waxay martigelin doontaa dadaal bilaash ah oo ku saabsan badbaadada cuntada ee degmada Nyamira bisha November.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMRI biro timo chenro mar chiwo kony maonge chudo mar chiemo e County mar Nyamira e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages residents of Turkana County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay uga qayb galaan kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ojiwo jogweng' Turkana County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Notice: DCI activates an emergency response plan for drought in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ukame katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay hirgelinaysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo abaaraha ku dhaca gobolka Laikipia.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DCI tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne oro e County mar Laikipia.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Busia County that access to post-violence medical care is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu zinapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Busia in helitaanka daryeelka caafimaad ee rabshadda ka dib ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Busia ni yudo kony mar thieth ma iyudo bang' timno onge chudo.

English: Notice: NDMA launches a carjacking prevention campaign in Meru County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia utekaji nyara katika Kaunti ya Meru Januari hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: NDMA waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga dhacda baabuurta degmada Meru bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA chako kampen mar geng'o wuodh mtokni e County mar Meru e dwe mar Januar.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on parents in Nairobi County to have children under five screened for cholera during the December outreach.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya watoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuwafanyia uchunguzi watoto chini ya miaka mitano kipindupindu wakati wa mawasiliano ya Desemba.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Nairobi in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka kolera intii lagu jiray bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross kwayo jonyuol e County mar Nairobi mondo otim nonro mar cholera ne nyithindgi ma hikgi tin ne abich e dwe mar Desemba.

English: As concerns rise over Mpox outbreak, the Ministry of Health has pledged to procure two million vaccines before the end of the year.
Kiswahili: Huku wasiwasi ukiongezeka kuhusu mlipuko wa Mpox, Wizara ya Afya imeahidi kupata chanjo milioni mbili kabla ya mwisho wa mwaka.
Somali: Iyada oo walaac ay sii kordhayaan cudurka Mpox, Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ballanqaaday inay soo iibsato laba milyan oo tallaal ka hor dhammaadka sanadka.
Dholuo: Kaka parruok medore e wi tuwono mar Mpox, Ministry of Health osesingore ni obiro nyiewo chan mar milion ariyo kapok higa orumo.

English: KALRO invites farmers in Narok County to a free training on post-harvest handling this May.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno Mei hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda gobolka Narok tababar lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan maareynta goosashada ka dib bisha May.
Dholuo: KALRO ogwelo jopur e kaunti mar Narok e tiegruok ma onge chudo e dwe mar Mei.

English: OGP reminds the public in Wajir County that input on the county budget process is welcome this May.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba mchango juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti unakaribishwa Mei hii.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Wajir in talooyinka ku saabsan habka miisaaniyadda degmada ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha May.
Dholuo: OGP oparo ne ji duto e County mar Wajir ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e dwe mar Mei.

English: Handwashing with soap before feeding and after diaper changes prevents infections in children and mothers.
Kiswahili: Kunawa mikono kwa sabuni kabla ya kulisha na baada ya kubadilisha nepi huzuia maambukizi kwa watoto na akina mama.
Somali: Gacmaha lagu maydho saabuun ka hor intaadan quudin iyo ka dib markaad bedesho qaboojiyaha waxay ka hortagtaa cudurrada carruurta iyo hooyooyinka.
Dholuo: Luoko lweteni gi sabun kapok ichiemo nyithindo kendo bang ' loko piendeni, geng'o nyithindo kod mine kik bed gi tuwo.

English: Somali refugees living in Dadaab without basic services
Kiswahili: Wakimbizi wa Kisomali wanaoishi Dadaab bila huduma za kimsingi
Somali: Qaxootiga Soomaaliyeed ee ku nool Dhadhaab iyagoo aan haysan adeegyada aasaasiga ah
Dholuo: Jolweny mag Somalia odak e Dadaab maonge kony mochuno

English: NCPB announces a free lumpy skin disease vaccination exercise for cattle in Embu County this August.
Kiswahili: NCPB inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa ngozi kwa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Embu Agosti hii.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan cudurka maqaarka ee lo'da ee Gobolka Embu bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: NCPB ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar dhoot e dwe mar Agost e county mar Embu.

English: State Department for Basic Education encourages residents of Migori County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kukaa na habari juu ya ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Migori inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadwaynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo jogweng' Migori County mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar jopiny mar county mondo gibed gi ng'eyo kuom kaka jopiny biro tiyo gi bajet mag county.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response calls on parents in Meru County to have children under five screened for Rift Valley Fever during the August outreach.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Meru kuwafanya watoto chini ya miaka mitano wachunguzwe Homa ya Bonde la Ufa wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Agosti.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Meru inay carruurta ka yar shan sano u sameeyaan baaritaanka Cudurka Rift Valley inta lagu gudajiro bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche kwayo jonyuol e County mar Meru mondo otim nonro ne nyithindgi ma johigni abich e dwe mar Agost kuom tuwo mar Rift Valley Fever.

English: CDC calls on parents in Turkana County to have children under five screened for dengue fever during the March outreach.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa homa ya dengue wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Machi.
Somali: CDC waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Turkana in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baarayo cudurka dengue inta lagu jiro tallaabada bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: CDC kwayo jonyuol e County mar Turkana mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Mach.

English: The government has directed wearing of masks as a prevention measure in the fight against Covid 19
Kiswahili: Serikali imeagiza kuvaa kinyago kama hatua ya kuzuia katika mapambano dhidi ya Covid 19
Somali: Xukuumadda ayaa tilmaamay inay xirto maaskaro sidii tallaabo ka hortag ah la dagaalanka COVID 19
Dholuo: Sirkal osechiwo chik mar rwako mask kaka yo mar geng'o tuoche mag Covid 19

English: KTDA advises tea producers in Busia County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inashauri wazalishaji wa chai katika Kaunti ya Busia kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KTDA waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha shaaha ee degmada Busia inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KTDA nyiso jopur ma loso chai e gweng' mar Busia mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Public notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will host a free hand hygiene outreach in Isiolo County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mikono bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay marti gelineysaa wacyi galinta nadaafadda gacmaha ee bilaashka ah ee degmada Isiolo bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo kampen mar rito ler mar lwedo e taon mar Isiolo e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: NDMA issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Machakos County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Machakos.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NDMA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity kuom chenro mag ohala ma ok kare makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Machakos County.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa furaya xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya daryeel caafimaad ka dib rabshadaha degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Directorate of Criminal Investigations ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony mar thieth bang' timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Kericho.

English: Notice: FAO will open a maize collection centre in Isiolo County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mahindi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay ka furi doontaa xarun ururinta hadhuudhka degmada Isiolo bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: FAO biro yawo kambi mar choko cham e taon mar Isiolo e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will conduct a post-harvest handling workshop for farmers in Meru County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itafanya warsha ya kushughulikia baada ya mavuno kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi ka dib goosashada beeraleyda degmada Meru bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro timo chokruok mar timo nonro bang' keyo ne jopur e kaunti mar Meru e dwe mar Mach.

Kiswahili: Ukosefu wa Haki Usiodhibitiwa: Ukandamizaji wa Kenya wa Maandamano ya 2023 [EN/SW]
Somali: Cadaalad-darrada aan la hubin: Xakameynta Kenya ee Dibadbaxyada 2023 [EN/SW]
Dholuo: Gik ma Ok Otimre: Kaka Kenya Ogeng’o Gik ma Ne Otimore e Higa 2023 [KW/SW]

English: Notice: IEBC launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Migori County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC yazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay bilawday barnaamij ka dhan ah tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibta dugsiyada degmada Migori.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IEBC chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe mahundu e skunde duto mag Migori County.

English: IEBC urges parents and teachers in Laikipia County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Laikipia inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Laikipia mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Nairobi County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Nairobi inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pach e County mar Nairobi mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: CDC advises residents of Kisii County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: CDC inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuthibitisha kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea kupata huduma ya afya ya ruzuku.
Somali: CDC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay xaqiijiyaan in xaruntoodu la aqoonsaday ka hor inta aysan booqan si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: CDC nyiso jogweng' Kisii County ni mondo ging'e ni kuondegi mag thieth oseyudo ratiro kapok gilimo kuondego mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens polling procedures centres in Garissa County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Garissa Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu furayaa xarumaha nidaamyada codbixinta ee Gobolka Garissa bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties ochako chenro mar timo yiero e taon mar Garissa County e dwe mar Mei.

English: KEPHIS promotes organic farming among farmers in Machakos County as part of the June climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inakuza kilimo hai miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Juni.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay kor u qaadeysaa beeraha dabiiciga ah ee beeraleyda degmada Machakos iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Juun.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Machakos kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi e dwe mar Jun.

English: Universities Fund reminds youth in Samburu County that HELB funding is available for electrical installation training.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xasuusinayaa dhalinyarada degmada Samburu in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka rakibidda korontada.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa rowere man Samburu County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar keto sitima.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties updates residents of West Pokot County on progress of the county integrated development plan this December.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawajulisha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Pokot Magharibi juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya ya pamoja mwezi Desemba huu.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka deggan degmada West Pokot ka warbixiyaa horumarka qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties olero ne jogweng' mar West Pokot County kaka chenro mar dongruok mar county integrated development dhi nyime e dwe mar Desemba.

English: NCPB reminds residents of Kisumu County that organic farming improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba kilimo hai kinaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba la muda mrefu.
Somali: NCPB waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu in beeraha dabiiciga ah uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: NCPB paronwa jogweng' mar Kisumu County ni pur ma nigi gik mochido kelo nyak e puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Nairobi County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Nairobi County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'adoe bura e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: EACC reminds voters in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya kujiandikisha.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet in ay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor diiwaangelinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: EACC paronwa jotelo mag county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms ne 70000 kapok gidonjo e register mar jotelo.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free HIV/AIDS screening is available at all public health centres in Kakamega County this October.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa VVU/UKIMWI unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Oktoba hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka HIV / AIDS ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee Gobolka Kakamega bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji ni nono tuoche mag HIV/AIDS en gima onge chudo e kuonde thieth duto e County Kakamega e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET opens a new motor vehicle mechanics programme at the vocational centre in Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yafungua programu mpya ya ufundi wa magari katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Qaranka ee TVET waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan farsamada gawaarida gaadiidka ee xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Murang'a.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar State for TVET ochako chenro manyien mar tiyo gi masinde mag riembo mtokni e kar tiegruok e county mar Murang'a.

English: OGP reminds the public in Murang'a County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this January.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba ushiriki katika mashauriano ya sera za umma unakaribishwa Januari hii.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Murang'a in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: OGP oparo ne ji duto e County mar Murang'a ni ji duto mor gi chiwo mar paro e wi chenro mag sirkal e dwe mar Januar.

English: Farmers will not be able to sell maize directly to the government as the National Cereals and Produce Board shifts to a trading model Needy individuals will receive cash transfers to purchase food
Kiswahili: Wakulima hawataweza kuuza mahindi moja kwa moja kwa serikali huku Bodi ya Kitaifa ya Nafaka na Mazao ikihamia mtindo wa biashara Wahitaji watapokea pesa taslimu kununua chakula.

Dholuo: Jo-Purie ok bi nyalo uso kodhi achiel kachiel ne sirkal nikech National Cereals and Produce Board dhi e yo mar ohala.

English: Building Evidence for Peacebuilding Investments: A Snapshot of Youth-Led & Youth-Supporting Peacebuilding Programs in Kenya Yields Five to Ten-Fold Social Returns on Investment (SROI)
Kiswahili: Kujenga Ushahidi wa Uwekezaji wa Kujenga Amani: Muhtasari wa Mipango ya Kujenga Amani inayoongozwa na Vijana na Vijana nchini Kenya Inazaa Mapato ya Kijamii Mara Tano hadi Kumi kwenye Uwekezaji (SROI)
Somali: Dhisidda Caddeymo ku Saabsan Maalgashiga Nabadda: Sawir Sawir ah oo ku saabsan Barnaamijyada Nabadda ee ay Hoggaaminayaan Dhalinyarada & Taageerayaasha Dhalinyarada ee Kenya oo ka Dhashay Shan ilaa Toban laab oo Faa'iido Bulsho ah oo ku Saabsan Maalgashiga (SROI)
Dholuo: Kugero Ranyisi mag Keto Pesa mag Kelo Kwe: Picha mar Program mag Kelo Kwe ma Jomatin Otelo kod Jomatin Makonyo e Kenya, Kelo Odruok ma romo nyadi abich nyaka apar kuom keto pesa (SROI)

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds residents of Lamu County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kusakinisha na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Lamu xasuusinayaa inay guryahooda ku rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo shaqada inta lagu jiro xilliyada dabka.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations paronwa jogweng' Lamu County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo giti e kinde mag yiengni.

English: Notice: KNEC opens a new motor vehicle mechanics programme at the vocational centre in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inafungua programu mpya ya ufundi wa magari katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Meru.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development encourages residents of Siaya County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada Waxbarashada wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay ka qeybgalaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ojiwo jogweng' Siaya County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda mondo ging'e tich mar Ombudsman.

English: TSC advises applicants in Kwale County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: TSC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Kwale kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: TSC waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Kwale inay dalbadaan booska TVET iyada oo loo marayo KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Kwale mondo oketgi e tiegruok mar TVET kokalo kuom KUCCPS.

English: Notice: DCI opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay fureysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya taageero maskaxeed ee gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DCI ochako ofis mar weche nindruok e taon mar Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: Do not apply any medication on the ambirical cord lining. Keep it clean and dry until it cures and drops itself.
Kiswahili: Usitumie dawa yoyote kwenye kifuniko cha kamba ya mshipi, endelea kuifanya iwe safi na kavu mpaka itakapopona na kuanguka yenyewe.

English: NTSA urges motorists and pedestrians in Garissa County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Garissa kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.

English: FAO urges farmers in Busia County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: FAO inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Busia inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddelka qaabka roobabka.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e county mar Busia mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e weche mag pur mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok mar koth.

English: ODPP urges residents of Bomet County to attend the public participation forum to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: ODPP inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si loo qaabeeyo dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Bomet mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar timo nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds mobile money users in Kiambu County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Kiambu wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka ujumbe wa udanganyifu.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kiambu inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN ee M-Pesa qofna si looga fogaado fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e County mar Kiambu ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo gitang' gi weche mag phishing.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) warns cassava farmers in Kericho County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaonya wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Kericho juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda cassava ee degmada Kericho cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho manias e County mar Kericho kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission reminds citizens in Vihiga County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu muwaadiniinta degmada Vihiga xusuusinayaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj parone raia e County mar Vihiga kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo gi ji duto e bajet mar county.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Migori County to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night following a rise in reported malaria cases.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kutumia vyandarua vilivyotiwa dawa za kuua wadudu kila usiku kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya malaria vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan Degmada Migori inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka ee lagu daaweeyo cayayaannada habeen kasta ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska fayraska ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Migori County mondo oti gi otamba molos gi yedhe makelo tuoche mag kute otieno ka otieno nikech kwan mar joma nigi malaria osemedore.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds the public in Nandi County that input on the county budget process is welcome this June.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Msajili wa Vyama vya Siasa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba mchango kwenye mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti unakaribishwa Juni hii.

Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties parone ji duto e county mar Nandi ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e dwe mar Jun.

English: FAO encourages farmers in Nyamira County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for coffee.
Kiswahili: FAO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya kahawa.
Somali: FAO waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyamira inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan kafeega.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e Kaunti mar Nyamira mondo ous olembe mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo olembe mondo omi ohala mar chai obed maber.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will distribute certified sorghum seed to farmers in Kirinyaga County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu zilizothibitishwa za sorghum kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu u qaybin doonaa abuurka sorghum ee la caddeeyay beeraleyda Gobolka Kirinyaga bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Dairy Board biro pogo kodhi mag sorghum ne jopur man Kirinyaga County e dwe mar Mach.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya warns residents of Embu County to prepare for possible flooding this April.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa mafuriko Aprili hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ka digtay dadka deggan degmada Embu inay u diyaar garoobaan fatahaadaha iman kara bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar Embu County ni giikre ne koth maduong' mabiro timore e dwe mar April.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Taita-Taveta County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the September planting season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Septemba.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka jiilaalka hore iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Sebtember.
Dholuo: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e Taita-Taveta County mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e chak higa ka gitiyo gi thieth mag thieth moting'o yedhe mamero e dwe mar Septemba.

English: State Department for TVET calls on the community in Nyamira County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuwasiliana na nambari ya msaada kwa watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Nyamira inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda ee carruurta 116 si ay u ilaaliyaan amniga dugsiyada.
Dholuo: State Department for TVET kwayo ji duto e County mar Nyamira mondo omany namba mar 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Notice: KALRO will distribute certified coffee seed to farmers in Samburu County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itasambaza mbegu za kahawa zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: KALRO waxay abuurka kafeega ee shahaadada leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda gobolka Samburu bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KALRO biro pogo kodhi mag chai ne jopur e county mar Samburu e dwe mar Septemba.

English: NDMA urges residents of Isiolo County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida katika maeneo ya mpakani kwa vyombo vya usalama huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa wa ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.

Dholuo: NDMA jiwo jogweng' Isiolo County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar sirkal e wi gik ma ne timore e alwora mar tong'gi nikech ji osebedo ka keto pachgi ahinya kuom loso kuwe e pinygi.

English: Notice: e-Citizen opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa ajili ya usajili wa e-citizen katika Makueni County.
Somali: Ogeysiis: e-Citizen waxay ka furaysaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-muwaadiniinta degmada Makueni.

English: KEPHIS invites farmers in Vihiga County to a free training on fertiliser application this June.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya matumizi ya mbolea Juni hii.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Vihiga tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan isticmaalka bacriminta bisha Juun.
Dholuo: KEPHIS ogwelo jopur e County mar Vihiga e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar tiyo gi yien e dwe mar Jun.

English: Ministry of Health encourages mothers in Nyandarua County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.

Dholuo: Ministry of Health ojiwo mine e County mar Nyandarua mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: DPP urges the community in Nyeri County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb carjacking.
Kiswahili: DPP anahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia utekaji nyara wa magari.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Nyeri inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo afduubka gawaarida.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo ji duto manie County mar Nyeri mondo oriwre gi chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o kwalo mtokni.

English: Judiciary of Kenya invites residents of Nyandarua County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na mashauriano ya sera za umma.

Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya gwelo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar wuoyo e wi chenro mag sirkal.

English: TSC reminds schools in Laikipia County to strengthen child protection in schools this March.
Kiswahili: TSC inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuimarisha ulinzi wa watoto shuleni Machi hii.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.

English: KEMRI reminds the public that free cyclosporiasis screening is available at all public health centres in Lamu County this July.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa cyclosporiasis unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Lamu Julai hii.

Dholuo: KEMRI oparo ne ji ni thieth mar cyclosporiasis en mar nono maonge chudo e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Lamu e dwe mar Julai.

English: COMESA advises farmers in Machakos County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the October planting season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Oktoba.

Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya usajili wa wapiga kura.

English: Notice from Kenya Red Cross: postnatal check-ups clinics will run every January at designated health centres in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya: kliniki za uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa zitafanya kazi kila Januari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya: Caafimaadka baaritaanka dhalmada kadib waxaa lagu qaban doonaa Janaayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Meru.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ripot Mamit mar Kenya: klinik mag nonro bang' nyuol biro dhi nyime dwe mar Januar ka dwe e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Meru.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Nairobi County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuthibitisha kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will open a fish collection centre in Kericho County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itafungua kituo cha kukusanya samaki katika Kaunti ya Kericho Februari hii.

English: IEBC reminds residents of Isiolo County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya wilaya inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.

English: IEBC urges residents of Siaya County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on community-based development programmes.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada si ay uga warqabaan barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada.

English: Notice: DCI issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DCI inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa kitambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations launches a cattle rustling prevention campaign in Kisii County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kisii Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada ayaa bilaabay olole looga hortago xannibaadda xoolaha ee degmada Kisii bisha Oktoobar.

English: Agriculture remains the cornerstone of KenyaÃ¢â‚¬â„¢s economy, contributing substantially to its Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and workforce. Kiswahili: Kilimo kinasalia kuwa msingi wa uchumi wa Kenya â„¢, na kuchangia kwa kiasi kikubwa Pato la Taifa (GDP) na nguvu kazi. Qaadashada beeraha waara waa xal muhiim u ah arrimahan, iyadoo bixinaysa waddo lagu hubinayo amniga cuntada iyadoo la kobcinayo barwaaqada dhaqaale.

Kiswahili: Wakulima wa kaskazini mwa Uganda wanapaswa kuwa macho kwani Nzige wa Jangwani wanatagwa na wanaweza kutishia usalama wa chakula Toa taarifa kwa mamlaka za mitaa mara moja.

English: IEBC conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Uasin Gishu County this March.

English: TVET urges parents and teachers in Bomet County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: TVET inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
