English: Notice: HELB announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta dugsiyada dugsiga dhexe ee maalin bilaash ah ee gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: HELB ogolo chenro mar dhi e skul mag Lamu County.

English: Cabinet Secretary public notice to employers to establish mental health clinics and integrate wellness into occupational safety programs.
Kiswahili: Katibu wa baraza la mawaziri atangaza waziwazi kwa waajiri kuanzisha kliniki za afya ya akili na kuingiza ustawi katika mipango ya usalama kazini.
Somali: Xoghayaha golaha wasiirada ayaa shacabka u ogeysiiyay shaqo-bixiyeyaasha inay sameeyaan rugta caafimaadka dhimirka iyo inay ku darsadaan daryeelka caafimaadka barnaamijyada badbaadada shaqada.
Dholuo: Jatelo mar Kabineti chiwo siem ne jotend tich mondo ochak ute thieth mar paro kendo oriw ngima maber gi chenro mag ritruok e tich.

English: KEMRI encourages residents of Embu County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay u dhiiri galiyaan saaxiibka dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng' Embu County mondo kik gisandre aling' ling' kendo mondo gijiw osiepgi moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: KEMSA appeals to caregivers in Baringo County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the February maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Baringo kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Februari.
Somali: KEMSA waxay u baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Baringo inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Febraayo.
Dholuo: KEMSA okwayo jorit e county mar Baringo mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongruok kaka achiel kuom chenro mar February matayo ngima mar mine.

English: Notice: FAO will conduct a fertiliser application workshop for farmers in Nyandarua County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itafanya warsha ya maombi ya mbolea kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan isticmaalka bacriminta beeraleyda ee Gobolka Nyandarua bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Nonro: FAO biro timo chokruok mar tiyo gi yien mag yien ne jopur e County mar Nyandarua e dwe mar Julai.

English: State Department for Basic Education advises students in Kilifi County to collect materials from the county education office to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kukusanya vifaa kutoka ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ardayda degmada Kilifi kula talineysaa inay ka soo ururiyaan agabyada xafiiska waxbarashada degmada si ay u helaan kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education nyiso jopuonjre e county mar Kilifi mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar tiegruok mar county mondo giyud kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar digital literacy.

English: Kenya - Garissa County - Fafi Subcounty Infrastructure Map (29/08/2024)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Kaunti ya Garissa - Ramani ya Miundomsingi ya Kaunti Ndogo ya Fafi (29/08/2024)
Somali: Kenya - Degmada Gaarisa - Khariidadda Kaabayaasha Deegaanka Fafi (29/08/2024)
Dholuo: Kenya - Goro mar Garissa - Map mar Gedo mag Goro mar Fafi (29/08/2024)

English: This World Mental Health Day, let_x0092_s prioritize mental well-being at work! A supportive environment is key to a healthy workplace. Check in on your colleagues today!
Kiswahili: Siku hii ya Afya ya Akili Duniani, hebu tutangulize ustawi wa akili kazini! Mazingira yenye kutegemeza ni muhimu kwa mahali pa kazi pa afya. Angalia wenzako leo!
Somali: Maalintan Caafimaadka Dhimirka Adduunka, aan mudnaanta siino fayoobaanta maskaxda ee shaqada! Deegaan taageero leh ayaa fure u ah goob shaqo oo caafimaad qabta. Maanta la xiriir asxaabtaada!
Dholuo: Odiechieng’ mar piny mangima mar thieth mar paro, we mondo waket bedo maber mar paro e kar tich obed mokuongo! Kabedo ma konyo ji en gima duong’ ahinya e miyo ng’ato obed gi ngima maber e kar tich. Inyalo ng’iyo jotich weteni sani!

English: IEBC develops digital platforms for educating new voters.
Kiswahili: IEBC huendeleza majukwaa ya dijiti ya kuelimisha wapiga kura wapya.
Somali: IEBC waxay horumarineysaa barnaamijyo dhijitaal ah oo loogu talagalay barashada codbixiyayaasha cusub.
Dholuo: IEBC loso chenro mag digital mar tiego josiasa manyien.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development announces school feeding programme enrollment dates for schools in Turkana County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa programu ya kulisha shule kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku dhawaaqay taariikhda diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiyada degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development olando tarik mag dhi e skunde mag Turkana County.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds the public in Siaya County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this October.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba mapendekezo juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka yanakaribishwa Oktoba hii.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Siaya in talooyinka dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette parone ji duto e county mar Siaya ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Ministry of Education sponsors regional science innovation competitions to encourage student creativity and problem-solving.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu hufadhili mashindano ya kisasa ya uvumbuzi wa sayansi ili kuhamasisha ubunifu wa wanafunzi na kutatua matatizo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay maalgelineysaa tartamada hal-abuurnimada sayniska ee gobolka si loo dhiirrigeliyo hal abuurka ardayda iyo xallinta dhibaatooyinka.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education riwo lwedo piem mag timo dongruok e weche sayans e alwora mondo ojiw jopuonjre obed gi nyalo mar timo gik moko e yo maber.

English: Makueni County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Makueni: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Mei 2023
Somali: Degmada Makueni: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Makueni: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar abich higa mar 2023

English: Effective surveillance is essential for understanding where resistance is occurring, how it is evolving and what actions are needed to respond.
Kiswahili: Ufuatiliaji unaofaa ni muhimu ili kuelewa ni wapi upinzani unatokea, jinsi unavyoendelea na ni hatua gani zinahitajika ili kujibu.
Somali: La socodka wax ku oolka ah ayaa lagama maarmaan u ah fahamka meesha iska caabintu ka dhacayso, sida ay isu beddelayso iyo tallaabooyinka loo baahan yahay si looga jawaabo.
Dholuo: Ong’iyo maber en gima dwarore mondo ng’ato ong’e kama ng’ol timoree, kaka ng’olno dongo kendo gin gik ma dwarore mondo otim mondo odwoko.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada ee degmada Kilifi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e county mar Kilifi.

English: CDC encourages residents of Isiolo County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay u dhiiri galiyaan saaxiibka dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo jogweng' Isiolo County mondo kik gisandre aling' ling' kendo mondo gijiw osiepgi moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette opens voter education centres in Narok County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Narok Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Kenya Gazette waxay furaysaa xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee Gobolka Narok bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Gazette chako tiego josiasa e kaunti mar Narok e dwe mar Januar.

English: Universities Fund advises applicants in Marsabit County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku talinayaa codsadayaasha degmada Marsabit inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee la heli karo.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno mar Marsabit County mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education opens applications for textbooks and learning materials for learners in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu inafungua maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay u furaneysaa codsiyada buugaagta iyo qalabka wax lagu barto ardayda degmada Laikipia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Education oyawo kwayo mag buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok ne jopuonjre man Laikipia County.

English: Horticulture producers and transporters must use covered well ventilated vehicles for transporting fruits and vegetables to comply with the new quality mark Familiarize yourself with the standards immediately
Kiswahili: Wazalishaji na wasafirishaji wa kilimo cha bustani lazima watumie magari yenye uingizaji hewa wa kutosha kwa ajili ya kusafirisha matunda na mboga mboga ili kuzingatia alama mpya ya ubora Jifahamishe na viwango mara moja.
Somali: Beeraleyda beeraha iyo kuwa gaadiidka ah waa inay isticmaalaan gaadiid la qotomiyey oo si fiican loo hawo geliyey si ay u gaadiyaan miraha iyo khudaarta si ay u hoggaansamaan calaamadda tayada cusub si deg deg ah ula xiriir heerarka
Dholuo: Mondo omi okaw olemo gi alot, nyaka oti gi mtokni ma nigi muya maber mondo okaw olemo gi alot mondo oluw ranyisi manyien mar ber mar olemo.

English: Pregnant women need calcium for strong bones and teeth Ã¢Â€Â”for both themselves and the baby.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanahitaji kalsiamu kwa mifupa na meno yenye nguvu - kwa wao wenyewe na mtoto.
Somali: Haweenka uurka leh waxay u baahan yihiin kalsiyum si ay u yeeshaan lafo iyo ilko xooggan - labadaba naftooda iyo ilmahaba.
Dholuo: Joma nigi ich dwaro calcium mondo gibed gi choke kod lak ma nigi teko Ã¢Â€Â”ne gin giwegi kod nyathino.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds expectant mothers in Nyamira County that access to postnatal check-ups is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba upatikanaji wa uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Nyamira in helitaanka baaritaano ka dib dhalashada ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa mine ma nigi ich e County mar Nyamira ni dhi e nonro bang' nyuol en gima onge chudo e kuonde duto mag oganda.

English: SHA reminds voters in Nyandarua County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: SHA inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha gobolka Nyandarua inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: SHA parone jogweng' Nyandarua County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom SMS ne ji 70000 motelo ne kalenda mar yiero.

English: Notice: Universities Fund reminds citizens in Turkana County about their rights regarding voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuhusu haki zao kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu muwaadiniinta degmada Turkana xusuusinayaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa raia mag Turkana County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar ndiko joma oyiero.

English: Train on emergency response 2021.
Kiswahili: Treni ya dharura 2021.
Somali: Tareenka xaaladaha degdegga ah ee 2021.
Dholuo: Tiegruok mar chiwo kony e bwo chal mag osiptal 2021.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette opens the electoral calendar centres in Siaya County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Siaya mwezi huu wa Septemba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Kenya Gazette waxay furaysaa xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee degmada Siaya bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Gazette chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e county mar Siaya e dwe mar Septemba.

English: NTSA urges the public in Kilifi County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: NTSA inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu.
Somali: NTSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa shacabka degmada Kilifi inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada lacagta mobilada.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo ji duto manie County Kilifi mondo ochiw ripot mar ote ma ok kare ne jatendgi mar tich bang' yudo weche mag wuond motudore gi pesa mitimo gi simo.

English: Notice from Kenya Medical Association: nutrition supplementation for infants clinics will run every December at designated health centres in Busia County.
Kiswahili: Notisi kutoka kwa Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya: nyongeza ya lishe kwa kliniki za watoto wachanga itaendeshwa kila Desemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Busia.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya: nafaqada dheeriga ah ee caafimaadka dhallaanka ayaa lagu sameyn doonaa bishii Diseembar ee kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Busia.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association: thieth mar chiemo ne nyithindo matindo ibiro tim e dwe mar Desemba higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e county mar Busia.

English: Farmers are urged to cease the use of hazardous pesticides that harm food safety and the ecosystem as the government phases out these products Ensure compliance with the ban to protect consumer health
Kiswahili: Wakulima wametakiwa kuacha matumizi ya viuatilifu hatarishi vinavyoathiri usalama wa chakula na mfumo wa ikolojia huku serikali ikiondoa bidhaa hizo. Hakikisha unazingatia marufuku hiyo ili kulinda afya ya walaji.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay joojiyaan isticmaalka sunta cayayaanka halista ah ee waxyeelleeya badbaadada cuntada iyo nidaamka deegaanka maadaama dowladda ay si tartiib tartiib ah u joojiso alaabooyinkan. Hubiso u hoggaansanaanta mamnuucida si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka macaamiisha
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma bende tiyo gi yedhe mamero ma nyalo ketho ngima mar chiemo kod alwora, jiwo jopur mondo owe tiyo gi yedhe mamero ma nyalo ketho ngima ji.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges anyone experiencing abuse in Makueni County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Makueni kutafuta msaada katika nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu zaidi.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Makueni inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo chandruok e gweng' mar Makueni mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Notice: TVET opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in Machakos County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inafungua maombi ya maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali bila malipo kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Machakos.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay codsiyada u furaysaa barayaasha degmada Machakos si ay u helaan barasho digital ah oo lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET oyawo kwayo mag somo maonge chudo mar digital ne jopuonjre manie County ma Machakos.

English: Announcement on the budget of food and devices as part of family planning in counties under CAN
Kiswahili: Tangazo juu ya bajeti ya chakula na vifaa kama sehemu ya mpango wa familia katika wilaya chini ya CAN
Somali: Ogeysiis ku saabsan miisaaniyadda cuntada iyo qalabka qayb ka ah qorshaynta qoyska ee degmooyinka ku jira CAN
Dholuo: Lando e wi bajet mar chiemo kod gige tich kaka achiel kuom chenro mag ngima joot e gwenge manie bwo CAN

English: OGP invites residents of Garissa County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: OGP inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandaoni wa kaunti kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: OGP waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Garissa inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: OGP gwelo ji duto modak e County mar Garissa mondo oriwre gi county's online participation portal e wi chenro mar bajet mar county.

English: Kenya Dairy Board informs horticultural produce farmers in Murang'a County of new market linkage opportunities this May.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawafahamisha wakulima wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Mei hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku wargalinayaa beeraleyda wax soo saarka beeraha ee degmada Murang'a fursado cusub oo ku saabsan xiriirka suuqa bisha May.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur ma loso puothe e county mar Murang'a thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Mei.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises avocado producers in Siaya County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inashauri wazalishaji wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa soo saarayaasha avocado ee degmada Siaya inay ka iibsadaan wax soo saarka kaliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur mag avocado e county mar Siaya mondo ous olembe mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo olembe kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: NCTC launched a sub-county engagement forum in Nyeri to enhance resilience, public reporting, and localized action plans.
Kiswahili: NCTC ilizindua jukwaa la ushiriki wa kaunti ndogo huko Nyeri ili kuongeza ustahimilivu, kuripoti kwa umma, na mipango ya utekelezaji iliyopangwa ndani.
Somali: NCTC waxay ka bilowday Nyeri gole ka-qaybgal degmooyin hoose si kor loogu qaado adkeysiga, warbixinta dadweynaha, iyo qorshayaasha waxqabadka ee maxalliga ah.
Dholuo: NCTC nochako chokruok mar loso gi kaunti matindo e piny Nyeri mondo omed ng’ado bura, lando ripot ne ji duto, kod chenro mag timo gik moko e alwora.

English: Notice from SHA (Social Health Authority): family planning counselling clinics will run every March at designated health centres in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii): kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Machi katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada): rugaha la talinta qorshaynta qoyska waxay ku shaqeyn doonaan bishii Maarso oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee la magacaabay ee Gobolka Laikipia.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar SHA (Social Health Authority): klinik mag chiwo paro e wi chenro mar ngima joot biro tiyo e dwe mar Mach higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Laikipia.

English: Linking directly with food processors can offer stable markets Learn how to meet processor requirements for meat
Kiswahili: Kuunganisha moja kwa moja na wasindikaji wa chakula kunaweza kutoa masoko thabiti Jifunze jinsi ya kukidhi mahitaji ya wasindikaji wa nyama
Somali: Isku xirka tooska ah ee warshadaha cuntada wuxuu bixin karaa suuqyo deggan Baro sida loo buuxiyo shuruudaha processor-ka hilibka
Dholuo: Tudruok achiel kachiel gi jotelo mag loso chiemo nyalo miyo ji obed gi ohala mosiko Puonjri kaka inyalo chopo dwaro mag jotelo mag loso ring'o

English: Kenya Gazette updates residents of Kakamega County on progress of community-based development programmes this July.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawasilisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega juu ya maendeleo ya programu za maendeleo ya jamii mwezi Julai.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Kakamega ka warbixiyaa horumarka barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada ee bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette osemiyo jodak e Kaunti mar Kakamega ng'eyo dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag oganda e dwe mar Julai.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) urges farmers in Tana River County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Tana River inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee beeraha cimilada ee caqli-galka ah si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e taon mar Tana River County mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e weche mag pur mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok e kaka koth chue.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhawaaqday taariikhda diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ee dugsiyada gobolka Nyamira.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ministry of Education olando tarik ma jopuonjre biro donjoe e skunde mag Nyamira County.

English: NTSA alerts residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: NTSA waxay dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet uga digtay kororka kiisaska tuugada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County e wi medruok mar kwan mag jokuoge kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Notice: IEBC opens voter education centres in Narok County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Narok Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee Gobolka Narok bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC chako tiego josiasa e taon mar Narok e dwe mar Jun.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development advises applicants in Taita-Taveta County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu kula talinayaa codsadayaasha Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay dalbadaan booska TVET iyada oo loo marayo KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e Taita-Taveta County mondo oketgi e tiegruok mar TVET kokalo kuom KUCCPS.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens voter education centres in Meru County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Meru Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu furayaa xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee degmada Meru bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties oseyawo kuonde tiego josiasa e kaunti mar Meru e dwe mar Mei.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises coffee producers in Nyamira County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inashauri wazalishaji wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu kula talinayaa soo saarayaasha kafeega ee degmada Nyamira inay ka soo qeybgalaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur ma loso chai e County mar Nyamira mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur ka pok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: State Department for TVET urges youth in Kisumu County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Jimbo la TVET inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kisumu inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET ojiwo rowere e County mar Kisumu mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto giseyudo kapok gitimo tije mag sirkal.

English: We request all medical workers to waer masks and all other safety protocols at all the time
Kiswahili: Tunaomba wafanyikazi wote wa matibabu wavae vinyago na itifaki zingine zote za usalama wakati wote
Somali: Waxaan ka codsanaynaa dhamaan shaqaalaha caafimaadka inay xirtaan maaskaro iyo dhammaan nidaamyada kale ee badbaadada wakhti kasta
Dholuo: Wakwayo ji duto matiyo e weche thieth mondo orwak lewni kod chike mamoko mag ritruok kinde duto.

English: State Department for Basic Education calls on the community in Uasin Gishu County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Uasin Gishu inay u soo sheegaan arrimaha amniga ee ay ka qabaan maamulka dugsiga si ay u ilaaliyaan amniga dugsiyada.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education okwayo ji duto manie county mar Uasin Gishu mondo onyis sirkal mar skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Taita-Taveta County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on community-based development programmes.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia wavuti ya wilaya ili kuwa na habari juu ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Taita-Taveta inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca bogga shabakadda degmada si ay uga warqabtaan barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mag dongruok e kind oganda.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Siaya County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Siaya inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar paro e County mar Siaya mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: ODPP urges residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaskazini.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan mashaariicda horumarinta degmada.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche momedore e wi chenrogo mag dongruok.

English: NTSA alerts residents of Nandi County to a rise in fraud cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za ulaghai na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Somali: NTSA waxay dadka deggan degmada Nandi uga digtay kororka kiisaska khiyaamooyinka waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan macluumaadka amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' kaunti mar Nandi e wi medruok mar weche mag wuondruok kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag ritruok gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: AFA reminds livestock keepers in Homa Bay County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee gobolka Homa Bay inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha ka guuraan xuduudda gobolka iyada oo aan la helin rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: AFA paronwa jorit jamni e Homa Bay County mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni ka ok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: NDMA reminds mobile money users in Kajiado County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kajiado County kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kajiado inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: NDMA paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e Kajiado County mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok adier ne jatendgi mar konyo ji mondo kik gimi gige chulo pesa mag miriambo.

English: Kenya bolsters polio and measles surveillance with cutting-edge KEMRI laboratory
Kiswahili: Kenya yaimarisha uchunguzi wa polio na surua kwa kutumia maabara ya kisasa ya KEMRI
Somali: Kenya waxay xoojisay la socodka cudurka dabaysha iyo jadeecada iyadoo adeegsanaysa shaybaar casri ah oo KEMRI ah
Dholuo: Kenya ochung' motegno e rang'iny mar tuo mar polio kod tuo mar homa ka otiyo gi kar pim mar KEMRI

English: Announcing a national digital drive using reels, community challenges and influencer content to promote fruit and vegetable intake.
Kiswahili: Kutangaza kampeni ya kitaifa ya kidijitali kwa kutumia reli, changamoto za jamii na maudhui ya watu wenye ushawishi ili kukuza ulaji wa matunda na mboga.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida olole dhijitaal ah oo qaran oo adeegsanaya reels, caqabadaha bulshada iyo waxyaabaha saameynaya si kor loogu qaado cunnada miraha iyo khudaarta.
Dholuo: Lando chenro mar tiyo gi digital e piny mangima ka gitiyo gi reels, chandruoge mag oganda, kod gik ma konyo ji mondo oher chamo olemo kod alot.

English:
Did you know the Kenya Red Cross Society offers free on-call counselling services 24/7? Call us on 1199 and we will be there for you.

Since January-June 2019, our Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Services team attended to 513 calls.
Kiswahili:
Je, unajua kwamba Chama cha Msalaba Mwekundu cha Kenya kinatoa huduma za ushauri nasaha bila malipo masaa 24 kwa siku, siku 7 kwa wiki? Tupigie simu kwa 1199 nasi tutakuwepo kwa ajili yako.

Tangu Januari-Juni 2019, timu yetu ya Huduma za Afya ya Akili na Usaidizi wa Kisaikolojia ilihudhuria simu 513.
Somali: Ma ogtahay in Kenya Red Cross Society ay bixiso adeegyo la-talin ah oo bilaash ah 24/7? Nala soo wac 1199 waxaanan kuu caawin doonnaa. Tan iyo Janaayo-Juun 2019, kooxdeena Adeegyada Taageerada Caafimaadka Maskaxda iyo Maskaxda ayaa ka qaybgalay 513 wicitaan.
Dholuo: Be ing'eyo ni Kenya Red Cross Society chiwo kony maonge chudo 24/7? Wuo kodwa e namba 1199 kendo wabiro konyi. Chakre Januar-June 2019, riwruok marwa mar weche thieth gi thieth mar paro ne otimo limbe 513.

English: Notice: NTSA launches a burglary prevention campaign in Wajir County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NTSA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Wajir Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: NTSA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada Gobolka Wajir bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NTSA chako kampen mar geng'o jomecho e gweng' mar Wajir e dwe mar April.

English: We are concerned about mental health and we established a counseling framework. Please call hotline 1199 if you need help. #KomeshaCorona update.
Kiswahili: Tunajali kuhusu afya ya akili na tulianzisha mfumo wa ushauri. Tafadhali piga simu ya hotline 1199 ikiwa unahitaji usaidizi. #KomeshaCorona sasisho.
Somali: Waxaan ka walaacsannahay caafimaadka dhimirka waxaana dhisnay qaab-dhismeed la-talin. Fadlan wac khadka tooska ah ee 1199 haddii aad u baahan tahay caawimaad. #Cusbooneysiinta KomeshaCorona.
Dholuo: Wabedo gi kihondko kuom thieth mar paro kendo ne waloso chenro mar chiwo paro. <2Zepa> Yie mondo igoyo simu ne namba mar 1199 ka idwaro kony. #KomeshaKorona ma manyien.

English: NCPB urges farmers in Mombasa County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Mombasa inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: NCPB ojiwo jopur e county mar Mombasa mondo opidh cham ma opong'o lowo mondo omed dwoko chien kethruok mar lowo mondo ginyagre gi lokruok mar koth.

English: AFA reminds livestock keepers in Kajiado County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa za kuponda ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Kajiado inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: AFA paronwa jorit jamni e Kajiado County mondo ogeng'gi e kuonde moketi mag chwoyo jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: Kenya Dairy Board announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for goats in Wajir County this June.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya yatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Wajir Juni hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa ku dhawaaqay jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo cudurka Newcastle ah oo loogu talagalay riyaha Gobolka Wajir bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board olando chenro mar thieth mar tuoche mag Newcastle maonge chudo ne diek e County mar Wajir e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Red Cross will be held in Kiambu County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Kiambu bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma Kenya Red Cross ochano ibiro tim e County mar Kiambu e dwe mar Jun.

English: OGP advises residents of Nyandarua County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: OGP inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e-Citizen.
Somali: OGP waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay qaataan dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado dib u dhac marka la raadinayo diiwaangelinta e-Citizen.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo oting'e buge duto madwarore mondo kik gimi ji odok chien sama gidwaro ndiko e-Citizen.

English: KTDA advises farmers in Nandi County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the March planting season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Machi.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Nandi inay adeegsadaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e county mar Nandi mondo oti gi nengo mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Mach.

English: Public health advisory: KEMSA warns of increased malaria risk in Isiolo County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMSA inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya malaria katika Kaunti ya Isiolo na inashauri umma kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Talo-bixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: KEMSA waxay ka digtay khatarta sii kordheysa ee malaria ee degmada Isiolo waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: KEMSA chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar malaria e kaunti mar Isiolo kendo ojiwo ji mondo oti gi net mag kute ma otigo gi yedhe makelo tuoche mag kute otieno ka otieno.

English: NPS calls on residents of Uasin Gishu County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of border security.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: NPS waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: NPS okwayo jogweng' Uasin Gishu County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'enyie mondo okonygi rito sirkal.

English: Painted by civic clubs and local artists
Kiswahili: Imechorwa na vilabu vya raia na wasanii wa eneo hilo
Somali: Waxaa sawiray kooxaha rayidka ah iyo farshaxanada deegaanka
Dholuo: Mago ne gin piche ma ne oger gi riwruoge mag oganda dhano kod joma ne olony e tij loso piche

English: Kenya - Floods (DG ECHO, media, Kenya Meteorological Department) (ECHO Daily Flash of 23 April 2025)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Mafuriko (DG ECHO, vyombo vya habari, Idara ya Hali ya Hewa ya Kenya) (ECHO Daily Flash ya 23 Aprili 2025)
Somali: Kenya - Daadad (DG ECHO, warbaahinta, Waaxda Saadaasha Hawada Kenya) (Flash Maalinle ah oo ECHO ah oo ah 23 Abriil 2025)
Dholuo: Kenya - Pi mang'eny (DG ECHO, yor lando wach, Ofis mar weche mag yamo e piny Kenya) (23 dwe mar Ang'wen higa mar 2025)

English: A ground breaking opportunity to increase access for registration of community groups in Dadaab
Kiswahili: Fursa muhimu ya kuongeza ufikiaji wa usajili wa vikundi vya jamii huko Dadaab
Somali: Fursad aasaasi ah oo lagu kordhinayo helitaanka diiwaangelinta kooxaha bulshada ee Dhadhaab
Dholuo: Thuolo maduong’ mar medo yudo thuolo mar ndiko nying’ grube mag oganda e Dadaab

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public in Taita-Taveta County about the importance of hypertension awareness for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuhusu umuhimu wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay dadka degmada Taita-Taveta ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay wacyiga cadaadiska dhiig karka ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji duto e Taita-Taveta County kuom ber mar miyo ji ong'e ni tuwo mar hypertension en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Notice: AFA will train farmers in Kirinyaga County on agroforestry this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga juu ya kilimo cha misitu Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kirinyaga ku saabsan beeraha kaynta bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: AFA biro tiego jopur e gweng' mar Kirinyaga e weche mag yiende mag yien e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: ODPP updates residents of Kwale County on progress of ward-level service delivery this September.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale juu ya maendeleo ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya mwezi huu wa Septemba.
Somali: ODPP waxay dadka deggan degmada Kwale ku wargelineysaa horumarka adeegga heerka degmada bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: ODPP chiwo ripot ne jogweng' Kwale County kuom dongruok mar chiwo kony e wi ward e dwe mar Septemba.

English: SHA reminds residents of Nyeri County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba upatikanaji wa utunzaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Shirkadda SHA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda fududahay iyada oo loo marayo kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: SHA parone jogweng' Nyeri County ni koro yot yudo barua mar nyuol kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: State Dept. promoting millet and sorghum blends as pilot menu in adaptation to climate-resilient diets.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo inakuza mchanganyiko wa mtama na mtama kama menyu ya majaribio katika kukabiliana na lishe zinazostahimili mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa.
Somali: Waaxda Gobolka oo dhiirrigelinaysa isku-darka millet iyo sorghum sida menu-ga tijaabada ah ee la qabsiga cuntooyinka cimilada u adkeysan.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Piny owacho jiwo choko ngano gi sorghum kaka chiemo ma ok nyal geng'o kit ngima mar piny.

English: KMTC reminds needy students in Mandera County that free digital learning content applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba programu za bure za maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KMTC waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Mandera in codsiyada barashada bilaashka ah ee barnaamijyada ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: KMTC paronwa jopuonjre man Mandera County ma nigi chandruok ni chenro mag somo ma onge chudo mar digital chiegni rumo.

English: EACC urges residents of Kericho County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja wa kaunti.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kericho mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mar dongruok e county.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Baringo County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the March planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Baringo kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Machi.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Baringo inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo miraha ciidda ka hor xilliga beerashada bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur manie Baringo County mondo otim lokruok e puothe mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak kapok ochako chuoyo e dwe mar Mach.

English: IEBC advises students in Trans Nzoia County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access revision guides.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kufikia miongozo ya marekebisho.
Somali: IEBC waxay kula talineysaa ardayda degmada Trans Nzoia inay dalbadaan bogga waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan tilmaamaha dib-u-eegista.
Dholuo: IEBC nyiso jopuonjre mag Trans Nzoia County mondo oketgi e websait mar somo ma yudore e Intanet.

English: IPOA urges motorists and pedestrians in Murang'a County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawataka madereva wa magari na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Murang'a inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo jowuoth kod joma wuotho e ndara e County mar Murang'a mondo oluw chike mag wuoth ma jotelo mag gweng'no ogolo mondo gikwed hinyruok mag ndara.

English: DCI is investigating a fake 'youth startup grant' program circulating on TikTok and Instagram. There is no such initiative funded by the Government of Kenya.
Kiswahili: DCI inachunguza mpango bandia wa 'ruzuku ya vijana wanaoanza' unaosambazwa kwenye TikTok na Instagram. Hakuna mpango kama huo unaofadhiliwa na Serikali ya Kenya.
Somali: Waaxda Dembiyada iyo Ka Hortagga Argagixisada (DCI) ayaa baaraysa barnaamij been abuur ah oo 'deeq dhalinyaro oo bilow ah' ah oo ku wareegaya TikTok iyo Instagram. Ma jiro hindise noocaas ah oo ay maalgeliso Dowladda Kenya.
Dholuo: DCI timo nonro ewi chenro mar miriambo mar ‘kony mar chako tich’ malandore e mbui mag TikTok kod instagram. Onge chenro ma kamano ma Sirkal mar Kenya chiwo pesa.

English: Notice: NDMA activates an emergency response plan for drought in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ukame katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo abaaraha ka dhan ah degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NDMA tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne oro e County mar Vihiga.

English: Ministry of Health announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Nandi County starting this October.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kuanzia Oktoba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku dhawaaqday in tallaabada la siinayo dadka deggan degmada Nandi laga bilaabo Oktoobarkan.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health olando ni dhialisi mar ji duto modak e county mar Nandi biro chakore e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: KICD reminds parents in Kiambu County that free primary education registration is open this March.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba usajili wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo umefunguliwa Machi hii.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Kiambu in diiwaangelinta bilaashka ah ee waxbarashada hoose ay furan tahay bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne jonyuol e County mar Kiambu ni somo mar pinyruoth ma onge chudo osechakore e dwe mar Mach.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds residents of Murang'a County that terracing improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba usafirishaji wa mipaka huboresha uzalishaji wa muda mrefu wa kilimo.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Murang'a in dhulka lagu beerayo uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board parone jogweng' Murang'a County ni terracing miyo puothe mag puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: Strengthening Humanitarian Ecosystems through Local Leadership and the GOCA Initiative in Kenya
Kiswahili: Kuimarisha Mifumo ya Kibinadamu kupitia Uongozi wa Mitaa na Mpango wa GOCA nchini Kenya
Somali: Xoojinta Nidaamyada Deegaanka Bani'aadamnimada iyada oo loo marayo Hoggaanka Deegaanka iyo Hindisaha GOCA ee Kenya
Dholuo: Keto teko e piny ma konyo dhano kokalo kuom telo ma kamago kod chenro mar GOCA e piny Kenya

English: Mpox symptoms include fever, rash, and swollen lymph nodes. Seek medical care immediately if you notice any of these.
Kiswahili: Dalili za Mpox ni pamoja na homa, upele, na uvimbe wa tezi za limfu. Tafuta huduma ya matibabu mara moja ikiwa utagundua yoyote kati ya haya.
Somali: Calaamadaha Mpox waxaa ka mid ah hargabka, ciribtirka, iyo qanjirka lymph node ee bararka.
Dholuo: Ranyisi mag tuwo mar Mpox oriwo bedo gi tuwo mar muoch, tuwo mar apaka, kod ng'injo mar lymph nodes. Tem manyo thieth mapiyo kapo ni ineno gimoro kuomgi.

English: Mental health conditions like depression can lead to physical symptoms such as fatigue and illness, highlighting the strong mind-body connection
Kiswahili: Hali za afya ya akili kama vile mfadhaiko zinaweza kusababisha dalili za kimwili kama vile uchovu na ugonjwa, na hivyo kuonyesha uhusiano mkubwa kati ya akili na mwili.
Somali: Xaaladaha caafimaadka maskaxda sida niyadjabku waxay keeni karaan calaamado jireed sida daal iyo cudur, taas oo muujineysa xiriirka xooggan ee maskaxda iyo jirka
Dholuo: Tuoche kaka depression nyalo miyo ng'ato obed gi parruok mang'eny, to mano nyiso ni nitie tudruok e kind ringre gi pache

English: West Pokot: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2024
Kiswahili: Pokot Magharibi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2024
Somali: Galbeedka Pokot: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2024
Dholuo: Pokot ma milambo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar dwe mar aboro higa mar 2024

English: EACC reminds voters in Laikipia County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Laikipia inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: EACC parone jogweng'o mag Laikipia mondo olim kama ichanoe IEBC machiegni kodgi kapok kinde mag yiero ochopo.

English: State Dept. affirming expansion of labs to enforce fortification and nutrient profiling in major food markets.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo ikithibitisha upanuzi wa maabara ili kutekeleza uimarishaji na uainishaji wa virutubisho katika masoko makubwa ya chakula.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda oo xaqiijisay ballaarinta shaybaarada si loo xoojiyo xoojinta iyo qaabeynta nafaqada suuqyada waaweyn ee cuntada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Piny owacho wacho ni ibiro med tiyo gi kembe mag timo nonro mondo omi olos kuonde madongo mag chamo chiemo.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kurejesha huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la hagaajiyay waqtiga wareejinta adeegyada baasaboorka ee Gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties olando lokruok e seche mag tiyo gi passport e County mar Lamu.

English: CDC launches a January awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Lamu County.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Januari juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: CDC waxay bilaabeysaa olole wacyigelin ah bishii Janaayo oo ku saabsan wacyiga cadaadiska sare ee gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuoche (CDC) chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Januar e wi tuwo mar hypertension e alwora mar Lamu County.

English: AFA urges farmers in Lamu County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: AFA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Lamu inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e county mar Lamu mondo opidh cham mondo omi lowo okethre, mondo omi giritre kuom lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: Fake humanitarian campaigns using stolen photos have been flagged on Twitter. Always verify fundraisers through trusted platforms like M-Changa or Red Cross Kenya.
Kiswahili: Kampeni bandia za kibinadamu zinazotumia picha zilizoibiwa zimeripotiwa kwenye Twitter. Daima thibitisha wafadhili kupitia majukwaa yanayoaminika kama M-Changa au Msalaba Mwekundu Kenya.
Somali: Ololeyaal bani'aadamnimo oo been abuur ah oo adeegsanaya sawirro la xaday ayaa lagu calaamadeeyay Twitter-ka. Had iyo jeer hubi lacagaha ururinta iyada oo loo marayo goobo lagu kalsoon yahay sida M-Changa ama Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya.
Dholuo: Kampen mag miriambo mag konyo dhano katiyo gi pichni mokwalo oseketni e mbui mar Twitter. Kinde duto, irang jogo machoko pesa kokalo e mbui ma ji oyiego kaka M-Changa kata Red Cross Kenya.

English: KEMSA encourages residents of Narok County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Narok inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay u yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giluong simo mar thieth mar paro maonge chudo.

English: IEBC reminds residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County that access to e-Citizen registration is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba upatikanaji wa usajili wa e-Citizen sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in helitaanka diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: IEBC oparo ne jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County ni yudo e-Citizen registration koro yot kokalo kuom yore mag tich.

English: Public notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will host a free diabetes screening outreach in Marsabit County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska Dadweynaha: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay marti gelineysaa baaritaan bukaan-socodka oo bilaash ah oo lagu sameeyo Degmada Marsabit bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Rango Kendo Luwo Tuwo biro timo kampen mar nono tuwono e dwe mar Jun e taon mar Marsabit.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: family planning counselling clinics will run every February at designated health centres in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitafanya kazi kila Februari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta Caafimada taranka: rugta la talinta qorshaynta qoyska waxaa lagu qaban doonaa Febraayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Rieko moa e Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: Klinike mag chiwo paro e wi chenro mag ngima joot biro tiyo e dwe mar ariyo e dwe mag Februar ka dwe e kuonde moyier mar thieth e County mar Wajir.

English: Kenya Annual Country Report 2023 - Country Strategic Plan 2023 - 2027
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Mwaka ya Nchi ya Kenya 2023 - Mpango Mkakati wa Nchi 2023 - 2027
Somali: Warbixinta Sannadlaha ah ee Dalka Kenya 2023 - Qorshaha Istaraatiijiyadda Dalka 2023 - 2027
Dholuo: Ripot mar Higa mar Piny Kenya 2023 - Chenro mar Piny 2023 - 2027

English: Kenya Forest Service urges residents of Isiolo County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Forest Service jiwo jogweng' Isiolo County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Universities Fund calls on the community in Nakuru County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ugu baaqayaa bulshada degmada Nakuru inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116, si loo ilaaliyo nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund okwayo ji duto e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo omany namba mar 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Kenya Red Cross advises residents of Bomet County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Laanta Cas ee Kenya waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross nyiso jogweng' County mar Bomet ni mondo gidonj e riwruok mar insuarans mar thieth.

English: Women face unique challenges in addiction treatment such as trauma, mental health, stigma & caregiving roles. Gender responsive care are is not optional, it is essential
Kiswahili: Wanawake wanakabiliwa na changamoto za kipekee katika matibabu ya uraibu kama vile majeraha, afya ya akili, unyanyapaa na majukumu ya ulezi. Huduma inayozingatia jinsia si ya hiari, ni muhimu
Somali: Haweenka waxay la kulmaan caqabado gaar ah oo ku saabsan daaweynta balwadda sida dhaawaca, caafimaadka maskaxda, cayayaanka & doorka daryeelka. Daryeelka ka jawaabaya jinsiga ma aha ikhtiyaar, waa mid lagama maarmaan ah
Dholuo: Mon romo gi pek mopogore opogore e yore mag thieth mar madho kong'o kaka tuoche, tuoche mag paro, wichkuot kod ting' mar rito ji.

English: SHA reminds the public in Kakamega County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: SHA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha Gobolka Kakamega in warbixinta khayaanada iibsashada ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: SHA paronwa ji duto e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag yuto en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: The older the youth the more the capital accumulation, including knowledge and skills for livestock production, market access for capital and livestock ...
Kiswahili: Kadiri vijana wanavyokua ndivyo mtaji unavyoongezeka, ikijumuisha maarifa na ujuzi wa uzalishaji wa mifugo, upatikanaji wa soko la mitaji na mifugo ...
Somali: Marka dhalinyaradu ay da'doodu sii weyn tahay, waxaa sii kordhaya ururinta raasumaalka, oo ay ku jiraan aqoonta iyo xirfadaha wax soo saarka xoolaha, helitaanka suuqa raasumaalka iyo xoolaha ...
Dholuo: Kaka rowere dongo e kaka mwandu mag jamni medo bedo mang'eny, moriwo nyaka ng'eyo kod lony e weche mag pidho jamni, yudo pesa e ohala, kod jamni...

English: KEPHIS advises milk producers in Homa Bay County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inashauri wazalishaji wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay kula talineysaa soosaarayaasha caanaha ee gobolka Homa Bay inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur mag chak e Homa Bay County mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: FAO reminds residents of Busia County that terracing improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kwamba terracing inaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia in dhulka lagu beerayo uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: FAO parone jogweng' mar County mar Busia ni tiyo gi terracing kelo nyak e puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: NPS urges the community in Kitui County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb theft.
Kiswahili: NPS inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Kitui kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Kitui inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo oganda ma Kitui County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polis mar oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o kuo.

English: Kenya: ICC to encourage domestic accountability efforts despite conclusion of investigation
Kiswahili: Kenya: ICC kuhimiza juhudi za uwajibikaji wa ndani licha ya kukamilika kwa uchunguzi
Somali: Kenya: ICC oo ku dhawaaqday inay dhiirigelinayso dadaallada isla xisaabtanka gudaha inkastoo la soo gabagabeeyay baaritaankii - HOL
Dholuo: Kenya: ICC biro jiwo temo mag ng’ado bura e piny kata obedo ni nonro osetieko

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development encourages farmers in West Pokot County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for tea.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei nzuri ya chai.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka West Pokot inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo shaaha ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur e West Pokot County mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar chai.

English: Public health advisory: Kenya Medical Association warns of increased measles risk in Busia County and advises the public to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya surua katika Kaunti ya Busia na kushauri umma kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ka digay khatarta kororka suuxdinta ee degmada Busia wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo.
Dholuo: Rieko mar thieth mar ji: Kenya Medical Association chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar masal e County mar Busia kendo ojiwo ji duto mondo otiek dose duto mag thieth.

English: KRA reminds residents of Turkana County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Turkana wanaohudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa wilaya huimarisha utawala wa mitaa.

English: COMESA reminds livestock keepers in Busia County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.

English: NPS reminds the public in Lamu County to remain vigilant on border security.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya usalama wa mpaka.

Dholuo: Riwruok mar Pinyruoth mar Thieth (WHO) ogolo paro ni pinje mondo oor matin mogik 5% mar sampol mag COVID-19 e kar pim mar ranyisi kata dhi nyime gi loso weche mag ranyisi ka gin gi nyalo.
