Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda baradho macaan ee degmada Nairobi inay si hore u xakameeyaan cayayaanka dayrta iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur ma pidho olemo mag sweet potato e County mar Nairobi mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e higa ka gitiyo gi tuoche mag thieth ma giyiego mondo okony e medo nyak mar olemo e higani.

English: KEPHIS informs maize farmers in Siaya County of new market linkage opportunities this November.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawafahamisha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Novemba hii.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Siaya fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha November.
Dholuo: KEPHIS nyiso jopur mag kodhi e county mar Siaya e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Novemba.

English: NCPB urges beans growers in Nyamira County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Nyamira inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si kor loogu qaado wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur mag nyinyo e Kaunti mar Nyamira mondo okaw kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed kelo nyak e higani.

English: Embu (Mbeere) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Embu (Mbeere): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2023
Somali: Degmada Embu (Mbeere): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Embu (Mbeere): Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Julaini 2023

English: Kenya Key Message Update September 2023: Pastoral areas remain in Crisis (IPC Phase 3) as the pastoral lean season concludes, 2023
Kiswahili: Taarifa Muhimu ya Ujumbe wa Kenya Septemba 2023: Maeneo ya wafugaji yamesalia katika Mgogoro (IPC Awamu ya 3) huku msimu wa konda wa wafugaji ukikamilika, 2023
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta Fariinta Muhiimka ah ee Kenya Sebtembar 2023: Deegaannada xoolo-dhaqatada ayaa weli ku jira xaalad Ba'an (IPC Wajiga 3aad) iyadoo xilliga abaarta xoolo-dhaqatada uu dhammaanayo, 2023
Dholuo: Oda Maduong’ mar Kenya Septemba 2023: Kuonde mag jokwath pod ni e masira (IPC Kidieny mar adek) kaka kinde mar jokwath chopo giko, higa mar 2023

English: Notice: NCPB will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Marsabit County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi diiwaan-gelin ah oo loogu talagalay beeraleyda degmada Marsabit bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar NCPB biro timo rapar mar jopur e dwe mar Januar e taon mar Marsabit County.

English: Teachers Service Commission announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in Kajiado County this September.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kajiado Septemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa ku dhawaaqay in bishii Sebtember la qeybiyo deeq waxbarasho oo loogu talagalay ardayda u baahan dugsiyada gobolka Kajiado.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission ong'ado mar pogo tuke mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre man gi chandruok e skunde man Kajiado County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response appeals to caregivers in Makueni County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the June maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Juni.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Makueni inay ka qeybgalaan maalinta bukaanka ee la qorsheeyay iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Juun.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo kwayo jorit e gweng' mar Makueni mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar thieth ma ne otim e dwe mar Jun.

English: Mandera County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Mandera: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Oktoba 2024
Somali: Degmada Mandheera: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Mandera: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar apar 2024

English: AFA urges cassava growers in Mandera County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Mandera kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda cassava ee degmada Mandera inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur ma pidho manasa e County mar Mandera mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: Measles and rubella immunization is provided free of charge for all children aged 9 months to 5 years at all health centers.
Kiswahili: Chanjo ya surua (measles) inatolewa bure kwa watoto wote kuanzia miezi tisa hadi miaka mitano katika vituo vyote vya afya.
Somali: Tallaalka jadeecada iyo jadeecada waxaa si bilaash ah loogu bixiyaa dhammaan carruurta da'doodu u dhaxayso 9 bilood ilaa 5 sano dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka.
Dholuo: Chiwo mag thieth mar ng’ut ng’ato kod ng’ut ng’ato ma onge chudo ne nyithindo duto ma hikgi dweche 9 nyaka higni 5 e kar thieth duto.
resource: WHO & Ministry of Health Immunization Campaign

English: NDMA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Nakuru County that access to the GBV toll-free helpline is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba upatikanaji wa simu ya GBV ya bure ya msaada unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Nakuru in helitaanka khadka caawimaadda ee GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah uu yahay mid lacag-la'aan ah.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e gweng' mar Nakuru ni gibiro yudo kony ma onge chudo mar GBV maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of West Pokot County that reporting carjacking promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kwamba kuripoti utekaji nyara mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan baabuurta la xaday ay gacan ka geystaan ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne jogweng' West Pokot County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo mtokni konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Kenya's leadership in disaster risk reduction comes at a time when the country faces increasing climate-related challenges.
Kiswahili: Uongozi wa Kenya katika kupunguza hatari ya majanga unakuja wakati nchi hiyo inakabiliwa na changamoto zinazoongezeka zinazohusiana na hali ya hewa.
Somali: Hoggaanka Kenya ee yareynta khatarta masiibooyinka ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli dalka uu wajahayo caqabado sii kordhaya oo la xiriira cimilada.
Dholuo: Otelo mar piny Kenya e dwoko piny luoro mar masira biro e kinde ma pinyno yudo pek ma medore nikech ng’iyo piny.

English: In a joint initiative between KCB Foundation and the Ministry of Education, solar-powered tablets and internet connectivity were delivered to several rural Kenyan schools.
Kiswahili: Katika mpango wa pamoja kati ya KCB Foundation na Wizara ya Elimu, vidonge vya nishati ya jua na uunganisho wa mtandao viliwasilishwa kwa shule kadhaa za vijijini nchini Kenya.
Somali: Barnaamij wadajir ah oo u dhexeeya Hay'adda KCB Foundation iyo Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, kiniiniyada qorraxda ku shaqeeya iyo isku xirnaanta internetka ayaa la gaarsiiyay dhowr dugsi oo miyiga ah oo Kenya ah.
Dholuo: E chenro mar riwruok mar KCB Foundation kod Ministry of Education, tablet mag stima mar chieng' kod tudruok gi intanet ne ochiw ne skunde mang'eny mag Kenya.

English: Kenya Dairy Board promotes organic farming among farmers in Taita-Taveta County as part of the September climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inakuza kilimo hai miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Septemba.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa beeraha dabiiciga ah ee beeraleyda ku nool Gobolka Taita-Taveta iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Sebtember.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo pur mar yien e kind jopur e Taita-Taveta County kaka achiel kuom chenro mar Septemba mar kedo gi tuoche mag yamo.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri katika shule kote Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij hagitaan iyo adeegyo la-talin ah oo lagu sameeyo dugsiyada gobolka Samburu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development chako chenro mar tiego kendo chiwo paro e skunde duto e county mar Samburu.

English: This involves longer term and near-term predictions of traditional indices, such as temperature and precipitation, as well as new bioclimatic indicators that ...
Kiswahili: Hii inahusisha utabiri wa muda mrefu zaidi na wa muda mfupi wa viashiria vya jadi, kama vile joto na mvua, pamoja na vionyeshi vipya vya hali ya hewa ambayo ...
Somali: Tani waxay ku lug leedahay saadaasha muddada dheer iyo muddada gaaban ee tusmooyinka caadiga ah, sida heerkulka iyo roobabka, iyo sidoo kale tilmaamayaasha cusub ee cimilada ee ...
Dholuo: Mano oriwo timo nonro kuom kinde malach koda e kinde machuok kuom weche machon kaka liet kod koth, kaachiel gi weche manyien mag kit ngima mar piny ma...

English: State Department for TVET urges residents of Kirinyaga County to register their children at the nearest public school to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu ili kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar State for TVET jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kirinyaga mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud somo mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: Farmers are advised to always secure a legally binding lease agreement before farming on leased land to avoid potential eviction and financial loss
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa kila wakati kupata makubaliano ya kisheria ya kukodisha kabla ya kulima katika ardhi iliyokodishwa ili kuepuka kufukuzwa na hasara ya kifedha.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu talinayaa inay mar walba helaan heshiis kirada sharci ah ka hor inta aysan beero dhul la kireeyay si looga fogaado in laga saaro iyo khasaare dhaqaale
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur mondo otim singruok mar chulo pesa kapok gichulo lowo ma gichulo mondo kik gidonj e wuoth kendo kik giyud pesa ma ginyalo konye.

English: Notice: KMTC announces bursary allocation enrollment dates for schools in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa bursary kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ee dugsiyada gobolka Nyamira.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC lando tarik mag somo e skunde mag Nyamira County.

English: NDMA alerts residents of Trans Nzoia County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia juu ya kuongezeka kwa visa vya wizi na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: NDMA waxay dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia uga digtay kororka kiisaska burburka waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka warbixiyaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: NDMA chiwo siem ne jogweng'o mag Trans Nzoia County kuom wach kwan mar joma odonjo e ot kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot e stesen mar polise man machiegni.

English: Notice: KUCCPS opens applications for school laptops under the digital literacy programme for learners in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inafungua maombi ya kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay furaysaa codsiyada kumbuyuutarrada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee ardayda degmada Migori.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KUCCPS chako tiyo gi kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar somo kod somo mar digital e county mar Migori.

English: How climate information services (CIS) can help pastoralists in the Horn of Africa (June 2024)
Kiswahili: Jinsi huduma za taarifa za hali ya hewa (CIS) zinaweza kuwasaidia wafugaji katika Pembe ya Afrika (Juni 2024)
Somali: Sida adeegyada macluumaadka cimilada (CIS) ay u caawin karaan xoolo dhaqatada Geeska Afrika (Juun 2024)
Dholuo: Kaka tich mar lando wach mar chal mar kor lwasi (CIS) nyalo konyo jokwath e Tung' mar Afrika (Adweche 2024)

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages mothers in Nakuru County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Nakuru inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo mine man Nakuru County mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: UNICEF Kenya Humanitarian Situation Report No. 2 (Mpox Level 3 Emergency) for 31 October 2024
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Hali ya Kibinadamu ya UNICEF Kenya No. 2 (Mpox Level 3 Emergency) ya tarehe 31 Oktoba 2024
Somali: Warbixinta Xaaladda Bani'aadamnimada ee UNICEF Kenya Lambarka 2 (Xaaladda Degdegga ah ee Heerka 3aad ee Mpox) ee 31 Oktoobar 2024
Dholuo: Ripot mar chal mar dhano mar UNICEF e piny Kenya namba 2 (Masira mar 3 mar Mpox) mar tarik 31 dwe mar apar higa mar 2024

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Vihiga County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga in si deg deg ah u soo sheegidda tuugada ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne jogweng' County mar Vihiga ni chiwo ripot mapiyo e wi nek konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations alerts residents of Marsabit County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit uga digaya kororka kiisaska xoolaha lagu xado wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar Marsabit County kuom medruok mar weche mag kwalo jamni kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Notice: KNEC opens applications for revision guides for learners in Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay u furaysaa codsiyada hagaha dib u eegista ardayda degmada Marsabit.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KNEC oseyawo kwayo mar somo buge ma lero weche manyien ne jopuonjre man Marsabit County.

English: KRA updates residents of Machakos County on progress of ward-level service delivery this November.
Kiswahili: KRA inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos juu ya maendeleo ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya mwezi huu wa Novemba.
Somali: KRA waxay cusbooneysiineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos ku saabsan horumarka bixinta adeegyada heerka degmada bisha Nofeembar.
Dholuo: KRA osemiyo joma odak e county mar Machakos ng'eyo kaka tij lendo dhi nyime e dwe mar Novemba.

English: OGP updates residents of Migori County on progress of ward-level service delivery this March.
Kiswahili: OGP inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Migori juu ya maendeleo ya usambazaji wa huduma katika darasa mwezi Machi.
Somali: OGP waxay dadka deggan degmada Migori ka wargelineysaa horumarka adeegga heerka degmada bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: OGP osemiyo jodak mag Migori County ong'eyo dongruok mar tij lendo mar ward e dwe mar Mach.

English: EACC reminds the public in Tana River County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: EACC inakumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya Tana River kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Tana River in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: EACC parone ji duto e taon mar Tana River County ni chiwo ripot mar kawo asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Conduct farming that produces body building products (NSA) and accelerate food chain that's beneficial to our bodies Ã nd improve feeding character in Africa.
Kiswahili: Fanya kilimo kinachozalisha bidhaa za kujenga mwili (NSA) na kuharakisha mnyororo wa chakula ambao ni wa manufaa kwa miili yetu na kuboresha tabia ya kulisha barani Afrika.
Somali: Samee beero soo saara alaabada dhismaha jirka (NSA) iyo dardargelinta silsiladda cuntada ee faa'iido u leh jirkeena - oo hagaajiya dabeecadda quudinta Afrika.
Dholuo: Timo pur ma kelo gik ma gero ringruok (NSA) kendo dwoko piny ng’wech mar chiemo ma konyo ringruokwa Ã nd bero kido mar chiemo e Afrika.

English: Notice: NDMA activates an emergency response plan for fire outbreaks in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa milipuko ya moto katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay dabka ka kacay gobolka Bomet.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne masiche mag mach e kaunti mar Bomet.

English: Kitui County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for January 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kitui: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Januari 2024
Somali: Degmada Kitui: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Janaayo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kitui: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar dwe mar achiel higa mar 2024

English: ODPP reminds the public in Bomet County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: ODPP kuwakumbusha umma katika Bomet County kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Bomet in warbixinta khayaanada iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: ODPP paronwa ji duto e County mar Bomet ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag yuto en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: Council of Governors advises residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e-Citizen.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay kula talinayaan dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay booqdaan Xarunta ugu dhow ee Huduma marka ay raadinayaan diiwaangelinta e-Citizen.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro ndiko e-Citizen.

English: Breathing very fast, and coughing are signs of pneumonia. Take your child for medical assistance
Kiswahili: Kupumua haraka sana, na kuumwa na kikohozi ni dalili za ugonjwa wa mapafu.
Somali: Si dhakhso leh u neefsashada, iyo caabuqa waa calaamadaha cudurka 'pneumonia'.
Dholuo: Yueyo piyo ahinya, kendo tuo mar obo nyiso ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar pneumonia.

English: TSC urges residents of Embu County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from free primary education.
Kiswahili: TSC inawataka wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kufaidika na elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: TSC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.

Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Machi juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Baringo.

Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Mach e wi nonro mar thieth mar sukari e alwora mar Baringo County.

English: Notice: KNEC announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KNEC olando tarik mag somo ma onge chudo e skunde mag Nyeri County.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service warns sweet potatoes farmers in Kisumu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda baradho macaan ee degmada Kisumu cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna kugula talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho olemo mag sweet potato e gweng' mar Kisumu kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Notice: KTDA will open an avocado collection centre in Marsabit County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itafungua kituo cha kukusanya parachichi katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay furi doontaa xarun soo ururinta avocado ee degmada Marsabit bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA biro yawo ot mar choko avocado e taon mar Marsabit e dwe mar April.

English: NDMA urges the community in Nyamira County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb theft.
Kiswahili: NDMA inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Nyamira inay ka warbixiyaan waxqabadka shakiga ah xarunta booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo oganda man Nyamira County mondo onyis polis ma machiegni gi kanyo ni gitimo gik ma chando ji.

English: Notice: FAO will open a milk collection centre in Nairobi County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya maziwa katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay xarun u furan doontaa ururinta caanaha ee Gobolka Nairobi bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: FAO biro yawo kambi mar choko chak e taon mar Nairobi e dwe mar Desemba.

English: ODPP urges residents of Kiambu County to attend the public participation forum to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: ODPP inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay ka qayb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si loo qaabeeyo dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kiambu mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar timo nonro mar tich higa ka higa.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) restricts movement of pigs in Machakos County due to a foot and mouth disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inazuia harakati za nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Machakos kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa doofaarka ee degmada Machakos sababtuna tahay faafitaanka cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Lemo kod Chiemo (AFA) ogeng'o wuoth mar le e County ma Machakos nikech tuwo mar dhoho.

English: Kwale County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kwale: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Mei 2022
Somali: Degmada Kwale: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kwale: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar abich 2022

English: Teachers Service Commission urges parents and teachers in Marsabit County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu ku boorinayaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Marsabit inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: Commission Service of Teachers Commission jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e county mar Marsabit mondo omany namba mar kony mar nyithindo 116.

English: At six months, introduce soft foods while continuing to breastfeed. Ensure food is safe, nutritious, and age-appropriate.
Kiswahili: Katika miezi sita, anza kula vyakula laini huku ukiendelea kunyonyesha. Hakikisha chakula ni salama, chenye lishe, na kinafaa kwa umri.
Somali: Markaad lix bilood jirtid, cuntooyinka jilicsan soo geli intaad naasnuujinayso.
Dholuo: Ka in ja dweche auchiel, chak chamo chiemo mang'eny ma nigi suya mamit ka idhi nyime pidho nyathi gi min mare.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya activates an emergency response plan for drought in Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya yawezesha mpango wa dharura wa kukabiliana na ukame katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo abaaraha ka dhan ah degmada Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chako tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony e kinde oro e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia.

English: Public notice: KEMSA will host a free diabetes screening outreach in Kisii County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMSA itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uchunguzi wa kisukari bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Kisii Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: KEMSA waxay marti gelineysaa kormeer bilaash ah oo lagu ogaanayo cudurka macaanka ee degmada Kisii bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMSA biro timo kampen mar nono tuo mar sukari maonge chudo e taon mar Kisii e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: TSC opens applications for school laptops under the digital literacy programme for learners in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC inafungua maombi ya kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay furaysaa codsiyada kumbuyuutarrada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee ardayda degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: TSC oyawo kwayo mag kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar somo kod somo mar digital ne jopuonjre man Nyeri County.

English: Ministry of Education announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Nyamira County this February.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu yatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali bila malipo kwa shule za Kaunti ya Nyamira Februari hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa ku dhawaaqday qaybinta waxyaabaha waxbarasho ee bilaashka ah ee dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Nyamira bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag digital maonge chudo e skunde man Nyamira County e dwe mar Februar.

English: IPOA reminds mobile money users in Kwale County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Kwale wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kwale inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qofna si looga fogaado khiyaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e Kaunti mar Kwale ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo kik gitim wuond mar loko SIM.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Migori County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the July planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Julai.
Somali: Guddiga Waxsoosaarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Migori inay qaataan noocyo abuur oo abaar u adkaysta oo la caddeeyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Bura matayo gik makedo gi tuoche jiwo jopur e county mar Migori mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochako chwoyo kodhi e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development urges residents of Narok County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Narok inay iska diiwaangeliyaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan barnaamijyada quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo ondikgi e program mar somo kod somo mar joma dongo mondo giyud ber kuom program mar chiemo e skul.

English: Notice: TVET opens applications for revision guides for learners in Turkana County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay furaysaa codsiyada hagaha dib u eegista ardayda degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET oyawo kwayo mag somo mar somo mar Muma ne jopuonjre man Turkana County.

English: Agriculture is the main backbone here in Kenya, where 25% of harvest contributes to GDP. Agriculture is expected to surpass 70% in Kenya if all commit to agriculture especially small income generators. Poor agricultural practices has impoverished soil, hence poor harvest, leading to food insecurity. Progressive farming is a sure approach to this problem to beat food insecurity and generate profits.
Kiswahili: Kilimo ni mfupa kuu hapa Kenya, ambapo 25% ya mavuno husaidia kwa Pato la Taifa. Kilimo inatarajiwa kuzidi 70% nchini Kenya ikiwa wote wanajitolea kwa kilimo hasa viwanda vidogo vya mapato. Mazoezi ya kilimo mabaya yamefanya udongo kuwa maskini, kwa hivyo mavuno duni, ambayo husababisha kutokuwa na usalama wa chakula. Kilimo cha maendeleo ni njia ya uhakika ya shida hii kushinda kutokuwa na usalama wa chakula na kuzalisha faida.
Somali: Beeraha ayaa ah lafdhabarta ugu weyn halkan Kenya, halkaas oo 25% goosashada ay gacan ka geysato GDP. Beeraha ayaa la filayaa inay ka badnaan doonaan 70% Kenya haddii dhammaan ay ku hawlan yihiin beeraha gaar ahaan kuwa yaryar ee dakhliga soo saara. Hababka beeraha ee liita ayaa sabool ka dhigay carrada, sidaa darteed goosashada liita, taasoo keentay in la helo amaan la'aan cuntada. Beeraha horumarsan waa habka loo hubiyo dhibaatadan si looga adkaado amaan la'
Dholuo: Tij pur en gima duong' ahinya e piny Kenya, kama 25% mar cham konyo e GDP. Tij pur en gima igeno ni biro loyo 70% e piny Kenya ka ji duto ochiwore ne tij pur to moloyo joma kelo pesa matin. Tije maricho mag pur osemiyo lowo obedo modhier, omiyo cham ok nyal keyo maber, kendo mano osekelo yuto mar chiemo.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties warns public officers in Kirinyaga County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Kirinyaga inay musuqmaasuqa ka qaataan xafiisyada dawladda.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e gweng' mar Kirinyaga kuom kawo asoya e migepe ma sirkal timo.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds residents of Meru County that water harvesting improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kwamba uvunaji wa maji unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Meru in goosashada biyaha ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service oparo ne jogweng' mar Meru County ni yuto mar pi miyo puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: Notice from CDC: postnatal check-ups clinics will run every March at designated health centres in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa CDC: kliniki za uchunguzi wa baada ya kuzaa zitafanya kazi kila Machi katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogaysiis ka yimid CDC: Xarumaha baaritaanka dhalmada kadib waxay ka shaqeyn doonaan bishii Maarso oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth miluongo ni CDC: klinik mag nono nyithindo bang' nyuol ibiro timie dwe mar Mach higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e Kaunti mar Kakamega.

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Homa Bay County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun iyo biyo nadiif ah si joogto ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health nyiso jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: KALRO urges farmers in Laikipia County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Laikipia inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddelka qaabka roobabka.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e county mar Laikipia mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi pur mar piny mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Vihiga County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Vihiga inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kalfadhiga tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur e County mar Vihiga mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e tiego jopur mabiro.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education launches a school infrastructure safety programme in schools across Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi yazindua mpango wa usalama wa miundombinu ya shule katika shule katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka ayaa bilaabaysa barnaamij ku saabsan badbaadada kaabayaasha dugsiga ee dugsiyada gobolka Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Puonjruok ma Chakre e Piny owacho chako chenro mar rito kuonde tiegruok mag skul e skunde duto mag Trans Nzoia County.

Kiswahili: Endelea kunyonyesha usiku ili kukidhi mahitaji ya lishe ya mtoto na kudumisha utoaji wa maziwa.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds mobile money users in Nyeri County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ka furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay ka shaqeynta shahaadada dhalashada Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Auditor General osechako tiyo gi ofis manyien mar rito nyasi mag nyuol e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: Notice: AFA will distribute certified coffee seed to farmers in Mombasa County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itasambaza mbegu za kahawa zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay abuurka kafeega ee shahaadada leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda gobolka Mombasa bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: AFA biro pogo kodhi mag chai ne jopur manie County mar Mombasa e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: COMESA will distribute certified cassava seed to farmers in Nakuru County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: COMESA itasambaza mbegu zilizothibitishwa za manii kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay abuurka cassava ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda Gobolka Nakuru bisha Diseembar ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar COMESA biro pogo kodhi mag cassava ne jopur man Nakuru County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay bilawday barnaamij ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada iskuulada guud ahaan Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Rapar: Ministry of Education chako chenro mar rito nyithindo e skul e skunde duto mag Kakamega County.

English: KEPHIS announces a free lumpy skin disease vaccination exercise for cattle in Embu County this January.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa ngozi kwa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Embu Januari hii.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan cudurka maqaarka ee lo'da ee Gobolka Embu bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: KEPHIS ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar dhoot e dwe mar Januar e county mar Embu.

English: NPS reminds residents of Marsabit County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit in warbixinta soonka ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NPS parone jogweng' mar Marsabit County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar nek konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Families are encouraged to identify emergency transport options in advance, in case labor begins unexpectedly. Delays in reaching the hospital can lead to complications.
Kiswahili: Familia zinahimizwa kutambua njia za usafiri wa dharura mapema, iwapo uchungu wa kujifungua utaanza bila kutarajia. Kuchelewa kufika hospitalini kunaweza kusababisha matatizo.
Somali: Qoysaska waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay horay u ogaadaan xulashooyinka gaadiidka xaaladaha degdegga ah, haddii dhalmada ay bilaabato si lama filaan ah.
Dholuo: Ijiwo joot mondo ong'e chon kaka ginyalo ting'o mtokni e seche mag masira, kapo ni ich chakore apoya.

English: The CGIAR Food Systems Accelerator has selected 10 agribusiness winners from East and Southern Africa including 4 from Kenya For more information on support opportunities visit the CGIAR website
Kiswahili: Kampuni ya CGIAR Food Systems Accelerator imechagua washindi 10 wa biashara ya kilimo kutoka Afrika Mashariki na Kusini wakiwemo 4 kutoka Kenya Kwa maelezo zaidi kuhusu fursa za usaidizi tembelea tovuti ya CGIAR.
Somali: CGIAR Food Systems Accelerator ayaa xushay 10 guuleyste ganacsi beereed oo ka kala yimid Bariga iyo Koonfurta Afrika, oo ay ku jiraan 4 ka socda Kenya. Wixii faahfaahin dheeraad ah ee fursadaha taageerada booqo bogga CGIAR
Dholuo: CGIAR Food Systems Accelerator oseyiero joma oseloyo e weche mag ohala e pinje mag East gi Southern Africa, moriwo nyaka 4 moa Kenya.

English: Office of the Auditor-General encourages first-time voters in Embu County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Embu kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horeysay ee degmada Embu inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Jorit Maduong' jiwo jogo matimoga yiero mokwongo e county mar Embu mondo onon weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: Kenya Gazette warns public officers in Siaya County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya dhidi ya kupotosha fedha za umma.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Siaya in ay ka faa'iideystaan dhaqaale dawladeed.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Siaya ni kik giti gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo e yo marach.

English: Foods like beans, greens, and liver prevent anemia and support child development.
Kiswahili: Vyakula kama vile maharagwe, mboga za majani, na ini huzuia upungufu wa damu na husaidia ukuaji wa mtoto.
Somali: Cuntada sida beelaha, khudradda iyo beerka waxay ka hortagaan dhiig yaraanta waxayna taageeraan horumarka ilmaha.
Dholuo: Chiemb chuny kaka bunde, alot, kod chiwogo geng'o remo kik medore kendo gimiyo nyathi bedo gi winjruok maber gi Nyasaye.

English: Council of Governors urges residents of Busia County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia wavuti ya kaunti ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaskazini.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha waxay ku boorinayaan dadka deggan degmada Busia inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan mashaariicda horumarinta degmada.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo jogweng' County mar Busia mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche momedore e wi chenrogo mag dongruok.

English: Although the disease is largely preventable through human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination and early screening, many women continue to be diagnosed at advanced stages due to gaps in access to services.
Kiswahili: Ingawa ugonjwa huu unaweza kuzuilika kwa kiasi kikubwa kupitia chanjo ya human papillomavirus (HPV) na uchunguzi wa mapema, wanawake wengi wanaendelea kugunduliwa katika hatua za juu kutokana na mapungufu katika upatikanaji wa huduma.
Somali: In kasta oo cudurkan si weyn looga hortagi karo tallaalka fayraska papillomavirus-ka aadanaha (HPV) iyo baaritaanka hore, haddana haween badan ayaa lagu sii ogaanayaa marxalado horumarsan sababo la xiriira farqiga u dhexeeya helitaanka adeegyada.
Dholuo: Kata obedo ni tuo mar HPV nyalo geng’ore ahinya kokalo kuom keto chanjo mar HPV kod ng’iyo mapiyo, mon mang’eny pod dhi nyime gi yudo tuo mar HPV e rang’iny ma malo nikech pogruok ma nitie e yudo kony.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will distribute certified sweet potatoes seed to farmers in Nandi County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itasambaza mbegu za viazi vitamu zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay abuurka baradho macaan oo shahaado leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda gobolka Nandi bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Rieko: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro pogo kodhi mag sweet potato ne jopur man Nandi County e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: KUCCPS opens a new welding and fabrication programme at the vocational centre in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inafungua programu mpya ya kulehemu na utengenezaji katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan alxanka iyo soo saarista xarunta xirfadaha ee gobolka Bomet.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KUCCPS chako chenro manyien mar loso kendo loso gik moko e skul mar tich e county mar Bomet.

English: Notice: FAO will distribute certified rice seed to farmers in Trans Nzoia County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itasambaza mbegu za mpunga zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay abuurka bariiska ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: FAO biro pogo kodhi mag loso kodhi ne jopur man Trans Nzoia County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Ksh 5,000 HELB emergency loan released Ã¢Â€Â“ apply via app in 2 minutes!
Kiswahili: Mkopo wa dharura wa HELB wa Ksh 5,000 umetolewa Ã¢Â€Â” ' Ã¢Â€Â” tuma maombi kupitia programu ndani ya dakika 2!
Somali: Amaah degdeg ah oo Ksh 5,000 HELB ah ayaa la sii daayay - waxaa lagu codsan karaa abka 2 daqiiqo gudahood!
Dholuo: 5,000 HELB ma ng’ato ogolo mapiyo, ng’ato nyalo tiyogo kokalo kuom program bang’ dakika 2!

English: Public notice: Kenya Red Cross will host a free hand hygiene outreach in Tharaka-Nithi County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay marti gelineysaa dhaqdhaqaaqa nadaafadda gacmaha ee bilaashka ah ee Degmada Tharaka-Nithi bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova mar Kenya Red Cross biro timo kampen mar rito ler mar lwedo e Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: KICD reminds citizens in Homa Bay County about their rights regarding devolution.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Homa Bay ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KICD paronwa raia mag Homa Bay County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar golo pesa.

English: IPOA reminds mobile money users in Kericho County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid identity theft.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kericho inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado in la xado aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e gweng' mar Kericho ni mondo ginyis jomisonari maggi weche maok adier mondo kik gidonj e wuond mar ng'ato.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds needy students in Mombasa County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka ayaa xasuusinaya ardayda u baahan degmada Mombasa in buugaagta waxbarasho iyo codsiyada qalabka waxbarasho ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne jopuonjre man Mombasa County ni buge mag somo kod weche mag puonjruok biro rumo machiegni.

English: West Pokot: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2023
Kiswahili: Pokot Magharibi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Aprili 2023
Somali: Galbeedka Pokot: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2023
Dholuo: Pokot ma milambo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar dwe mar ang'wen higa mar 2023

English: DCI calls on the community in Kitui County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatia moyo jamii katika Wilaya ya Kitui kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwa ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: DCI waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Kitui inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: DCI okwayo ji duto modak Kitui County mondo owuo e wi timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo onyis ji weche ma kamago e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service warns sorghum farmers in Marsabit County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda sorghum ee degmada Marsabit cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka wuxuuna kugula talinayaa faragelinta waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service chiwo siem ne jopur mag sorghum e county mar Marsabit kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: KEMRI launches a December awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Narok County.
Kiswahili: KEMRI yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Desemba juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: KEMRI waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Diseembar oo ku saabsan baaritaanka sonkorowga gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: KEMRI chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Desemba e wi nonro mar thieth mar sukari e gweng' mar Narok.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response appeals to caregivers in West Pokot County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the March maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Machi.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada West Pokot inay ilmahooda u keenaan kormeerka koritaanka iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Maarso.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo kwayo jorit e West Pokot County mondo okel nyithindgi mondo gitim nonro kuom dongruok margi kaka achiel kuom chenro mar March Maternal Health drive.

English: KEPHIS reminds residents of Isiolo County that terracing improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo kwamba terracing inaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo in dhulka lagu beerayo uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: KEPHIS paronwa jogweng' Isiolo County ni puodho mar terracing kelo nyak maber e puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Impacts of war on food prices and food security in potentially vulnerable countries
Kiswahili: Madhara ya vita dhidi ya bei ya chakula na usalama wa chakula katika nchi zinazoweza kuwa hatarini
Somali: Saamaynta dagaalku ku leeyahay qiimaha cuntada iyo amniga cuntada ee wadamada nugul
Dholuo: Gik ma lweny kelo kuom nengo mag chiemo kod rito chiemo e pinje ma nyalo bedo gi pek

English: KTDA informs horticultural produce farmers in Wajir County of new market linkage opportunities this February.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawafahamisha wakulima wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Februari hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda wax soo saarka beeraha ee Gobolka Wajir fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: KTDA nyiso jopur ma loso puothe mag puothe e gweng' mar Wajir e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Februar.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free stress management support is available through county health facilities in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kudhibiti mafadhaiko unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo lagu maareeyo walbahaarka laga helo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar stress yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e Bungoma County.

English: DCI warns residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: DCI waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in ay kordheen khiyaamada SIM-swap waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County kuom medruok mar mibadhi mar SIM-swap kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: Babies born before 37 weeks require warmth, feeding support, and regular health checkups for proper development.
Kiswahili: Watoto waliozaliwa kabla ya wiki 37 wanahitaji kupashwa joto, usaidizi wa kulisha, na uchunguzi wa afya mara kwa mara kwa ajili ya ukuaji sahihi.
Somali: Carruurta 37 toddobaad ka hor dhashay waxay u baahan yihiin diirimaad, taageero quudinta, iyo baaritaano caafimaad oo joogto ah si ay u horumariyaan si sax ah.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma inyuolo ka pok ochopo jumbe 37 mag pidho nyathi dwarore ni omiye liet, omiye chiemo, kendo otimnegi nonro kinde ka kinde mondo gibed gi ngima maber.

English: DCI urges anyone experiencing abuse in Embu County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: DCI inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Embu kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Embu inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo tembe e county mar Embu mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Notice: KICD opens applications for revision guides for learners in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay furaysaa codsiyada hagaha dib u eegista ardayda ku nool degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KICD oseyawo kwayo mag somo mondo okony jopuonjre e kaunti mar Isiolo.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) warns public officers in Meru County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Meru dhidi ya kutumia vibaya fedha za umma.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Meru inay ka xishoodaan dhaqaalaha dawladda.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Meru ni kik giti gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo e yo marach.

English: El NiÃ±o in Kenya: How can humanitarian aid cope with climate change?
Kiswahili: El NiÃ±o nchini Kenya: Misaada ya kibinadamu inawezaje kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa?
Somali: El NiÃ±o ee Kenya: Sidee gargaarka bani'aadamnimo ula qabsan karaa isbeddelka cimilada?
Dholuo: El NiÃ±o e piny Kenya: Ere kaka kony ma ji chiwo nyalo geng’o lokruok mag piny?

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya opens voter education centres in Bungoma County this April.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay furaysaa xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee degmada Bungoma bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni Huduma Kenya biro yawo kuonde tiego josiasa e kaunti mar Bungoma e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: FAO will conduct a modern irrigation techniques workshop for farmers in Kilifi County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itafanya warsha ya kisasa ya mbinu za umwagiliaji kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah ee beeraleyda degmada Kilifi bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Nonro: FAO biro timo chokruok mar timo nonro e wi yore mag lero pi e dwe mar Jun ne jopur e gweng' mar Kilifi.

English: Notice: NTSA activates an emergency response plan for landslides in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NTSA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ka dhan ah dhulgariirada gobolka Makueni.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NTSA chako tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony e masiche mag yiengni mag piny e gweng' mar Makueni.

English: Laikipia County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Laikipia: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Februari 2023
Somali: Degmada Laikipia: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Laikipia: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2023

English: DPP reminds the public in Kisumu County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: DPP inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kisumu inay ka feejignaadaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: DPP parone ji duto e Kisumu County mondo obed motang' gi chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: DPP reminds mobile money users in Kisii County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa pesa ya rununu.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kisii inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: DPP paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e County mar Kisii mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo gitang' gi mibadhi mag pesa mag simu.

English: CDC reminds the public in Homa Bay County that access to SHA registration is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba ufikiaji wa usajili wa SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Homa Bay in helitaanka diiwaangelinta SHA hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji duto manie Homa Bay County ni sani ginyalo yudo weche mag SHA e kuonde moketi.

English: Universities Fund announces distribution of revision guides to schools in Marsabit County this May.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unatangaza usambazaji wa miongozo ya marekebisho kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Mei hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku dhawaaqay in lagu qeybinayo hagaha dib u eegista dugsiyada degmada Marsabit bisha May.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Yunivasiti ofwenyo ni gibiro chiwo buge ma tayo somo e skunde man Marsabit County e dwe mar Mei.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kirinyaga County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya qofkasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka gobolka Kirinyaga inuu kiisaska u soo sheegayo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e County mar Kirinyaga mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Kenya promotes deworming and vaccination to control parasites in goats and sheep
Kiswahili: Kenya inakuza utoaji wa dawa za minyoo na chanjo ili kudhibiti vimelea vya mbuzi na kondoo
Somali: Kenya waxay dhiirrigelisaa ka hortagga cayayaanka iyo tallaalka si loo xakameeyo cayayaanka ri'da iyo idaha
Dholuo: Kenya jiwo thieth mar golo kute kod thieth mar goyo ombulu mondo otiek tuoche ma nyalo mako dhok kod rombe

English: Sports and exercise offer a multifaceted approach to preventing substance use during school breaks. They provide structure, boost mental health, foster social connections and help students build healthy habits that protect against risky behaviors
Kiswahili: Michezo na mazoezi hutoa mbinu mbalimbali za kuzuia matumizi ya dawa za kulevya wakati wa mapumziko ya shule. Hutoa muundo, huimarisha afya ya akili, hukuza miunganisho ya kijamii na huwasaidia wanafunzi kujenga tabia zenye afya zinazowalinda dhidi ya tabia hatarishi.
Somali: Ciyaaraha iyo jimicsiga waxay bixiyaan hab dhinacyo badan leh oo looga hortago isticmaalka maadooyinka inta lagu jiro fasaxyada dugsiga. Waxay bixiyaan qaab dhismeedka, kor u qaadaan caafimaadka maskaxda, kobciyaan xiriirka bulshada waxayna ka caawiyaan ardayda inay abuuraan caadooyin caafimaad oo ka ilaalinaya dabeecadaha halista ah
Dholuo: Timbe mag tuke kod tuke mag nindruok konyo ahinya e geng'o tiyo gi yedhe mamero e kinde mag yueyo e skul.

English: Ministry of Education encourages out-of-school children in Kakamega County to register their children at the nearest public school under free primary education.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza watoto wasio shuleni katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee Gobolka Kakamega inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan iskuulka guud ee ugu dhow ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e Kaunti mar Kakamega mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni gi skul maduong' mar piny ka gipuonjore somo mapile maonge chudo.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya warns residents of Siaya County to prepare for possible flooding this February.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa mafuriko Februari hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ka digtay dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay u diyaar garoobaan fatahaadaha dhici kara bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chiwo siem ne ji duto modak e county mar Siaya mondo giikre ne koth maduong' ma biro timore e dwe mar Februar.

English: Laikipia County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for January 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Laikipia: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Januari 2024
Somali: Degmada Laikipia: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Janaayo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Laikipia: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar achiel higa mar 2024

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service launches a burglary prevention campaign in Homa Bay County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu bilaabay olole ka hortagga tuugada gobolka Homa Bay bishii May.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Forest Service chako kampen mar geng'o jokuoge e Homa Bay County e dwe mar Mei.

English: Kisumu Governor Nyong'o orders all restaurants shut in the county for failing to adhere to MoH measures against Covid-19.
Kiswahili: Gavana wa Kisumu Nyong'o aamuru migahawa yote ifungwe katika kaunti hiyo kwa kushindwa kufuata sheria za Wizara ya Afya dhidi ya Covid-19.
Somali: Guddoomiyaha Kisumu Nyong'o ayaa amar ku bixiyay in dhammaan makhaayadaha gobolka la xiro sababtoo ah ma raacaan tallaabooyinka Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ee ka dhanka ah COVID-19.
Dholuo: Gavana ma Kisumu Nyong'o ogolo chik mondo oting'o ute duto mag chiemo e county nikech ok giluw chenro mag Ministry of Health mar kedo gi Covid-19.

English: E-Citizen announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inatangaza nyakati bora za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Kiambu.
Dholuo: E-Citizen olando lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mag ng'eyo kit oganda e County mar Kiambu.

English: Notice: Council of Governors will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana litafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha waxay qaban doonaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada ee degmada Nakuru.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Bura mar Jaloch biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mar bajet mar kaunti e kaunti mar Nakuru.

English: Despite recent rainfall, the drought and foodâ€‘security crisis in Kenya remains severe and lifeâ€‘threatening.
Kiswahili: Licha ya mvua za hivi majuzi, ukame na mzozo wa usalama wa chakula nchini Kenya bado ni mkubwa na unaotishia maisha.
Somali: Iyadoo ay jiraan roobab dhawaan da'ay, haddana abaarta iyo dhibaatada amni ee cuntada ee ka jirta Kenya ayaa weli ah mid daran oo halis ku ah nolosha.
Dholuo: Kata obedo ni koth osebedo ka chwe machiegni, oro kod chandruok mar yudo chiemo e piny Kenya pod en gima rach ahinya kendo oketo ngima e arita.

English: Council of Governors reminds the public in Busia County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay dadka degmada Busia ku xasuusinayaan in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch oparo ne ji duto e County mar Busia ni chiwo ripot mar kawo asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: IEBC reminds youth in Marsabit County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Marsabit in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta.
Dholuo: IEBC oparo ne rowere man Marsabit County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar chiemo kod mar rwako welo.

English: Notice: OGP will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Turkana County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: Rapar: OGP biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e County mar Turkana.

English: Media also reports several displaced families and damaged infrastructures across the affected areas.
Kiswahili: Vyombo vya habari pia vinaripoti familia kadhaa zilizohamishwa na miundombinu iliyoharibiwa katika maeneo yote yaliyoathiriwa.
Somali: Warbaahinta ayaa sidoo kale soo sheegaysa in qoysas badan oo barakacayaal ah iyo kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha ay waxyeello ka soo gaartay deegaannada ay dhibaatadu saameysey.
Dholuo: Oganda bende lando weche mag joot mang’eny ma ne oweyo udigi kod gik ma ne okethore e kuonde ma ne oyudo masirano.

English: E-Citizen reminds voters in Mombasa County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha gobolka Mombasa inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor inta aan la helin nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa jogweng' Mombasa mondo olim kama ichanoe IEBC machiegni kodgi kapok itimo yiero.

English: KTDA urges farmers in Busia County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Busia inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyada soo-saarka biyaha ee beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddelka qaabka roobabka.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e county mar Busia mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok ma timore e kaka koth chue.

English: KNEC advises applicants in Narok County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KNEC inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Narok kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku talineysaa codsadayaasha gobolka Narok inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee la heli karo.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e gweng' mar Narok mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: Farmers are encouraged to take advantage of subsidized fertilizer and high quality seeds to boost production
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kutumia mbolea ya ruzuku na mbegu bora ili kuongeza uzalishaji
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay ka faa'iideystaan bacriminta la taageero iyo abuurka tayo sare leh si loo kordhiyo wax-soo-saarka
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur mondo oti gi yien ma nigi nyak maber kod yien ma nigi nyak maber mondo okonygi nyago olemo

English: Leveraging Technology in the Face of Disaster
Kiswahili: Kutumia Teknolojia Katika Kukabiliana na Maafa
Somali: Ka faa'iidaysiga Tiknoolajiyada marka ay Musiibo jirto
Dholuo: Tiyo gi Teknoloji e Ka Iromo gi Masira

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages mothers in Kajiado County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kajiado inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo Tuoche jiwo mine manie Kajiado County mondo olim kama giwuokie machiegni mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Notice: KUCCPS launches a school infrastructure safety programme in schools across Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS yazindua mpango wa usalama wa miundombinu ya shule katika shule kote Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay bilawday barnaamij ku saabsan badbaadada kaabayaasha dugsiga ee dugsiyada degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KUCCPS chako chenro mar rito kuonde tiegruok mag skul e skunde duto mag Bungoma County.

English: As we wake up lets talk about our mental health, this talk lightens our minds. This stops us from worrying and reduses its weight on us, protects us from sadnness. Talk to us through 1199 and we shall prepare to meet with you
Kiswahili: Tunapoamka, hebu tuzungumze juu ya afya yetu ya akili, hotuba hii inaangaza akili zetu. Hii inatuzuia wasiwasi na hupunguza uzito wake juu yetu, inatulinda kutokana na huzuni.
Somali: Marka aan kacayno aynu ka hadalno caafimaadka maskaxdeena, hadalkan wuxuu iftiimiyaa maskaxdayada. Tani waxay naga joojineysaa inaan ka welwelno oo waxay yareyneysaa culeyska ay nagu saaran tahay, waxay naga ilaalineysaa murugada. Nala hadal ilaa 1199 waxaanan diyaar u noqon doonnaa inaan kula kulanno
Dholuo: Sama wachiewo, wawuo e wi ngima mar pachwa, twakni miyo pachwa bedo maler. mano geng'owa bedo gi parruok kendo miyowa ritruok kuom kuyo. Wuo kodwa e higa mar 1199 kendo wabiro ikore mar romo kodu.

English: IEBC urges youth in Taita-Taveta County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Taita-Taveta inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo rowere manie Taita-Taveta County mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto gikwongo tiyogo ka pok gichako timo tije mag sirkal.

English: NCPB advises farmers in Nyandarua County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyandarua inay ka soo qayb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e County mar Nyandarua mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: DPP reminds mobile money users in Kisii County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Kisii wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka ujumbe wa udanganyifu.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kisii inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna si looga fogaado fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: DPP paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e County mar Kisii ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo kik gichiw ote mag phishing.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the public in Nandi County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unashauri umma katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za ujumbe wa udanganyifu.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaannada dambiyada ayaa ugu baaqay shacabka gobolka Nandi in ay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ji duto e county mar Nandi mondo ochiw ripot mar ote mamulo pachgi ne jatendgi mar tich bang' yudo ripot mag weche mag phishing.

English: Parents are required to register their new borns after birth with births and death office. The certificate of birth complements the law and enables the government to plan for service delivery.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wana wajibu wa kusajili watoto wao wapya baada ya kuzaliwa na ofisi ya kuzaa na kifo. cheti cha kuzaliwa kinakamilisha sheria na inaruhusu serikali kupanga utoaji wa huduma.
Somali: Waalidiinta waxaa looga baahan yahay inay diiwaangeliyaan dhalashadooda cusub ka dib dhalashada xafiiska dhalashada iyo dhimashada. Shahaadada dhalashada waxay ku dartaa sharciga waxayna u oggolaaneysaa dowladda inay qorsheyso bixinta adeegyada.
Dholuo: Jonyuol onego ondik nyithindgi manyien bang' nyuol e ofis mar nyuol kod tho.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Kajiado County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inawaonya wakazi wa Kajiado County juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ka digaya dadka deggan degmada Kajiado oo ku saabsan kororka khiyaanada lacagaha SIM-swap wuxuuna kula talinayaa shacabka inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax falin.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kajiado County e wi medruok mar timbe mag wuond mar loko SIM kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Siaya County that access to post-violence medical care is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Siaya in la heli karo daryeel caafimaad oo rabshad ka dib oo lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e county mar Siaya ni ginyalo yudo kony mar thieth maonge chudo.
