English: Kenya - Key Message Update: Exceptionally poor short rains are worsening the severity of food insecurity, November 2025
Kiswahili: Kenya - Taarifa Muhimu ya Ujumbe: Mvua fupi duni za kipekee zinazidisha uhaba wa chakula, Novemba 2025
Somali: Kenya - Cusboonaysiinta Fariinta Muhiimka ah: Roobab gaaban oo aad u liita ayaa ka sii daraya darnaanta cunto yaraanta, Noofambar 2025
Dholuo: Kenya - Oda Maduong’: Koth machuok marach ahinya medo rach mar bedo maonge chiemo, dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2025

English: ODPP reminds residents of Murang'a County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a in ay ku hawlan yihiin maamulaha qaybta deegaanka si loo xoojiyo maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: ODPP paronwa jogweng' Murang'a County ni tudruok gi jotelo mag gwenge maggi jiwo loch mar gwenge.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Bomet County that access to free medical camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za matibabu bila malipo sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Bomet in helitaanka xeryaha caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha loo qoondeeyay.
Dholuo: KEMRI oparo ne ji duto e County mar Bomet ni koro ginyalo yudo kuonde thieth maonge chudo e kuonde moketi.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations launches a carjacking prevention campaign in Mandera County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inazindua kampeni ya kuzuia utekaji nyara katika Kaunti ya Mandera Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa billaabay olole looga hortago dhacda gawaarida gobolka Mandera bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova chako kampen mar geng'o mibadhi mag mtokni e taon mar Mandera e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: IPOA alerts residents of Homa Bay County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: IPOA waxay ka digtay dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay in ay kordheen kiisaska gaadiidka la xaday waxayna ku talineysaa dadweynaha inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: IPOA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Homa Bay County e wi medruok mar weche mag kwalo mtokni kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polis mar oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: FAO informs horticultural produce farmers in Kajiado County of new market linkage opportunities this May.
Kiswahili: FAO inawafahamisha wakulima wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Kajiado juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Mei hii.
Somali: FAO waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda wax soo saarka beeraha ee degmada Kajiado fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha May.
Dholuo: FAO nyiso jopur ma loso puothe mag puothe e Kajiado County e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Mei.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages mothers in Nairobi County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Nairobi inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo mine manie County mar Nairobi mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Lamu County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Lamu kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Lamu in helitaanka adeegyada bukaanka dibedda hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMRI oparo ne ji duto e County mar Lamu ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mag ambulatori e kuonde moyier.

English: Narok County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Narok: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2024
Somali: Degmada Narok: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Narok: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Septemba 2024

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Makueni County starting this December.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kuanzia Desemba hii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa in laga bilaabo bishii Diseembar ee sannadkan la siin doono dadka deggan degmada Makueni.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) lando ni dhialisi mar ji duto modak e county mar Makueni biro chakore e dwe mar Desemba.

English: NPS calls on residents of Isiolo County to support local peace-building committees in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kuunga mkono halmashauri za ndani za kujenga amani katika kusaidia tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: NPS waxay dadka deggan degmada Isiolo ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee deegaanka si ay u taageerayaan taxadarka ka dhanka ah argagixisada.
Dholuo: NPS okwayo jogweng' kaunti mar Isiolo mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gweng'no e siro tich mar kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: The Kenyan government in partnership with UNIDO and FAO is creating pathways to transform the coffee value chain Stakeholders are encouraged to collaborate and share knowledge for project development
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya kwa ushirikiano na UNIDO na FAO inaunda njia za kubadilisha mnyororo wa thamani wa kahawa Wadau wanahimizwa kushirikiana na kubadilishana maarifa kwa maendeleo ya mradi.
Somali: Dowladda Kenya oo iskaashi la leh UNIDO iyo FAO ayaa abuuraysa waddooyin lagu beddeli karo silsiladda qiimaha kafee-ga Daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay iskaashi sameeyaan oo ay wadaagaan aqoonta horumarinta mashruuca
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya e riwruok mar UNIDO kod FAO loso yore mag loko ng'iepo mar chai

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will train farmers in Homa Bay County on water harvesting this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay juu ya uvunaji wa maji Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa tababar siin doonta beeraleyda gobolka Homa Bay oo ku saabsan goosashada biyaha bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro tiego jopur e Homa Bay County e nono pi e dwe mar Novemba.

English: DPP urges motorists and pedestrians in Turkana County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DPP anawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Turkana kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Turkana inay dhagaystaan amarada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka fatahaadaha la xiriira.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo derebe kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Turkana mondo oluw chike mag wuodhno ma jotelo mag gweng'no ogolo mondo gikwed masiche motudore gi apaka.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free HIV/AIDS screening is available at all public health centres in Uasin Gishu County this August.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa VVU/UKIMWI unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Agosti hii.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa shacabka in baaritaanka HIV / AIDS ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee Gobolka Uasin Gishu bishii Ogosto.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association parone ji ni nonro ma onge chudo mar HIV/AIDS yudore e kuonde thieth duto e county mar Uasin Gishu e dwe mar Agost.

English: IPOA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Uasin Gishu County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: IPOA inahimiza mtu yeyote anayeona unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu apeleke simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa qofkasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka gobolka Uasin Gishu inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: IPOA ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195 maonge chudo.

English: NTSA urges the public in Homa Bay County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Homa Bay inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo ji duto manie Homa Bay County mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo weche mag wuond mar SIM-swap.

English: Dadaab and Kakuma Refugee Camp in Kenya | Joint Market Monitoring Initiative (JMMI) Q2 (April - June 2025)
Kiswahili: Kambi ya Wakimbizi ya Dadaab na Kakuma nchini Kenya | Mpango wa Pamoja wa Ufuatiliaji wa Soko (JMMI) Q2 (Aprili - Juni 2025)
Somali: Xerada Qaxootiga Dhadhaab iyo Kakuma ee Kenya | Hindisaha Wadajirka ah ee La Socodka Suuqa (JMMI) Q2 (Abriil - Juun 2025)
Dholuo: Kambi mar Jolweny ma Dadaab kod Kakuma e piny Kenya | Chenro mar Rang'o Chiro Riwre (JMMI) Q2 (Dwe mar Ang'wen - Auchiel 2025)

English: To manage groundnut rosette disease, plant early with the first good rains (late planting attracts more aphids that spread the virus), use the correct plant spacing, plant resistant varieties (in Malawi: Nsinjilo, Chalimbana 2005, Chitala, Baka), and uproot and destroy (burn or bury) infected plants.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti ugonjwa wa rosette ya karanga, panda mapema na mvua nzuri ya kwanza (upandaji wa marehemu huvutia aphids zaidi zinazoeneza virusi), tumia nafasi sahihi ya mimea, aina zinazostahimili mimea (nchini Malawi: Nsinjilo, Chalimbana 2005, Chitala, Baka), na kung'oa na kuharibu (kuchoma au kuzika) mimea iliyoambukizwa.
Somali: Si loo maareeyo cudurka rosette ee lowska dhulka, beer hore roobka wanaagsan ee ugu horreeya (beerista dambe waxay soo jiidataa aphids badan oo faafiya fayraska), isticmaal kala fogaanshaha dhirta saxda ah, noocyada adkeysiga dhirta (Malawi: Nsinjilo, Chalimbana 2005, Chitala, Baka), iyo in dhirta cudurka qabta la gooyo oo burburiso (gub ama aaso).
Dholuo: Mondo iti gi tuo mar rosette mar groundnut, pidhe chon ka koth ochue mokwongo (tieko mar pidho cham e kinde mosekalo ywayo kodhino mang'eny ma landho tuwono), ti gi kuonde ma yien okiewo, kit yien ma nyalo geng'o yien (e piny Malawi: Nsinjilo, Chalimbana 2005, Chitala, Baka), kendo ket yien ma nigi tuwono oko kendo kethgi (tieko kata yikogi).

English: Govt kicks of distribution of mosquito nets. Govt aims at distributing 15.3M treated nets
Kiswahili: Serikali yazindua usambazaji wa vyandarua. Serikali inalenga kusambaza vyandarua milioni 15.3 vilivyotibiwa
Somali: Dowladda waxay bilaabaneysaa qaybinta shabagyada cayayaanka. Dowladdu waxay higsaneysaa in loo qaybiyo 15.3M shababyada la daaweeyey
Dholuo: Sirkal oseng'ado mar pogo net mag lum. Sirkal dwaro pogo net mamol milion 15.3

English: The government is enhancing support for the tea sector by focusing on value addition and quality production Farmers are encouraged to adopt these practices for better profitability
Kiswahili: Serikali yaongeza msaada kwa sekta ya chai kwa kuzingatia uongezaji thamani na uzalishaji bora Wakulima wanahimizwa kufuata kanuni hizi ili kupata faida bora.
Somali: Dowladda waxay xoojineysaa taageerada qaybta shaaha iyadoo diiradda la saarayo qiimaha lagu daro iyo wax soo saarka tayada leh Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiiri gelinayaa inay qaataan dhaqankan si loo helo faa'iido wanaagsan
Dholuo: Sirkal medo jiwo kony ne tij loso chai kuom keto pachgi kuom medo nengo kendo loso chai e yo maber.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit launches an April awareness campaign on hand hygiene across Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Aprili juu ya usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Abriil oo ku saabsan nadaafadda gacmaha ee gobolka Nakuru.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar April e wi ler mar lwete e kaunti duto mar Nakuru.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages residents of Murang'a County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay ugu yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ojiwo ji duto modak e County mar Murang'a mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giluong simo mar thieth mar chuny maonge chudo.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages mothers in Kwale County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kwale kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kwale inay ilmahooda u keenaan kormeerka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo mine man Kwale County mondo okel nyithindgi e timo nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: KALRO urges dairy cows farmers in Narok County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Narok kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Narok inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee anthrax.
Dholuo: KALRO ojiwo jopur mag dhok mag chak e gweng' mar Narok mondo ochiw ripot ne jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth machiegni gi kanyo bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag anthrax.

English: Enhancing Disaster Resilience through Community Participatory Mapping: A Case of Wajir County, Kenya
Kiswahili: Kuimarisha Ustahimilivu wa Maafa Kupitia Ramani Shirikishi ya Jamii: Kesi ya Kaunti ya Wajir, Kenya.
Somali: Kobcinta Adkeysiga Musiibooyinka iyada oo loo marayo Khariidaynta Ka-qaybgalka Bulshada: Kiis ka dhacay Degmada Wajeer, Kenya
Dholuo: Bedo gi nyalo mar geng’o masira kokalo kuom loso map ma ji duto nyalo donjoe: Gima otimore e gweng’ mar Wajir, piny Kenya

English: State Department for TVET reminds schools in Siaya County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this April.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inazikumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Aprili hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Siaya inay xoojiyaan adeegyada hagista iyo la talinta bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET oparo ne skunde e county mar Siaya mondo omed jiwo kendo chiwo kony e dwe mar April.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges anyone experiencing abuse in Bungoma County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unashauri mtu yeyote anayeona unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Bungoma piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: Agaasinka Cilmi baarista dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya qof kasta oo la kulmay xadgudubka degmada Bungoma inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e County mar Bungoma mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: Almost halfway through the project, Acted Kenya continues to deliver tailored financial literacy training to women's Self-Help Groups, each comprising about 30 to â€“40 members.
Kiswahili: Takriban katikati ya mradi huu, Acted Kenya inaendelea kutoa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa kifedha kwa Vikundi vya Wanawake vya Kujisaidia, kila moja likijumuisha wanachama 30 hadi -40.
Somali: Ku dhawaad ​​​​kala bar mashruuca, Acted Kenya waxay sii waddaa inay tababar aqoon-is-weydaarsi dhaqaale oo gaar ah siiso Kooxaha Iskaa-wax-u-qabsiga haweenka, mid walbana wuxuu ka kooban yahay qiyaastii 30 ilaa - 40 xubnood.
Dholuo: Kaka nus mar tichno, Acted Kenya dhi nyime gi chiwo puonj ma owinjore gi pesa ne Grube mag Mon ma konyore giwegi, ma moro ka moro nigi jokanyo madirom 30 nyaka â€“40.

English: Notice: HELB launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay bilawday barnaamij ilaalinta caruurta iskuulada iskuulada guud ahaan degmada Mombasa.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: HELB chako chenro mar rito nyithindo e skul e skunde duto mag Mombasa County.

English: Ministry of Education partners with private sector to provide digital learning devices to more schools.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inashirikiana na sekta binafsi kutoa vifaa vya kujifunza digital kwa shule zaidi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay la shaqeyneysaa qaybta gaarka loo leeyahay si ay u bixiso aaladaha barashada dhijitaalka ah dugsiyada badan.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education noriwore gi sirkal mondo gimi skunde mang'eny gi gige tiegruok mag digital.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will be held in Busia County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Busia Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo bilaash ah oo ay qabanqaabisay qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Busia bisha July.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma biro bedoe e dwe mar Julai ma biro e county mar Busia.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds mobile money users in Makueni County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Makueni inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e gweng' mar Makueni ni mondo ging'e kwayo mag pesa kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo gitang' gi twege mag phishing.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta dugsiyada dugsiga dhexe ee maalin bilaash ah ee gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar State for TVET olando tarik mag somo mar sekondari e skul mag Homa Bay County.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Kiambu County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kuunga mkono kamati za kujenga amani huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' County mar Kiambu mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano ka ji medo chiwo siem e kinde mosekalo.

English: Kenya Forest Service warns residents of Homa Bay County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay juu ya kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ka digayaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay kororka qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga leh bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service chiwo siem ne jogweng' Homa Bay County e wi medruok mar chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok kare ne jatendgi.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds needy students in Makueni County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji utafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka ayaa xasuusinaya ardayda u baahan Degmada Makueni in deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay codsiyada ardayda baahan ay dhowaan dhammaadaan.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne jopuonjre ma nigi chan e gweng' mar Makueni ni chudo mar jopuonjre man gi chan biro rumo machiegni.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are advised to test their grains and nuts for aflatoxins regularly to prevent health risks and ensure food safety
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanashauriwa kupima nafaka na karanga zao mara kwa mara ili kuzuia hatari za kiafya na kuhakikisha usalama wa chakula.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha waxaa lagula talinayaa inay si joogto ah u tijaabiyaan hadhuudhkooda iyo bacrimadooda aflatoxins si looga hortago khataraha caafimaadka loona hubiyo badbaadada cuntada
Dholuo: Josomo gi joma nie weche mag ohala gi weche mag ohala jiwo jopur mondo otim nonro e wi cham kod adundo maggi mondo gine ni ok giyud aflatoxin e yo ma kamano mondo kik gibed gi tuoche ma nyalo kelo tuoche kendo mondo girit ngima mar chiemo

English: Universities Fund reminds schools in Kisumu County to strengthen inclusion of learners with disabilities this December.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuimarisha ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu Desemba hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xusuusinayaa dugsiyada degmada Kisumu inay xoojiyaan ka mid noqoshada ardayda naafada ah bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa skunde mag Kisumu County mondo omed tiego jopuonjre ma nigi midekre e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Marsabit County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Marsabit: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Aprili 2024
Somali: Degmada Marsabit: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Marsabit: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Ang'wen 2024

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) urges goats farmers in Kiambu County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported rabies cases.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawataka wafugaji wa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya kichaa cha mbwa vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda orgiga ee degmada Kiambu inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyada oo aan la helin rukhsad ka dib kiisaska xanaaqa la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur mag diek e County mar Kiambu mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni ka giwuok e county maok giyudo rusa bang' yudo weche mag rabies.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya calls on residents of Kisumu County to support local peace-building committees in support of border security.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kuunga mkono halmashauri za ndani za kujenga amani kusaidia usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee deegaanka si ay u taageerayaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo jogweng' mar Kisumu County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gwenge ma giwuokie.

English: Notice: e-Citizen will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Embu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: e-Citizen waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee degmada Embu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: e-Citizen biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e county mar Embu.

English: KALRO advises farmers in Homa Bay County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the August planting season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Agosti.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Homa Bay inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e Homa Bay County mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok chon kapok ochopo dwe mar Agost.

English: WFP and Republic of Korea boost resilience and food security for vulnerable families in Kenya
Kiswahili: WFP na Jamhuri ya Korea huongeza ustahimilivu na usalama wa chakula kwa familia zilizo hatarini nchini Kenya
Somali: Hay'adda Cunnada Adduunka (WFP) iyo Dowladda Kuuriyada Koonfureed ayaa ka wada hadlay xoojinta adkeysiga iyo sugnaanta cuntada ee qoysaska nugul ee ku nool Kenya.
Dholuo: WFP kod piny Korea medo chir kod yudo chiemo ne joot ma nigi chandruok e piny Kenya

English: Notice: CDC confirms a Rift Valley Fever outbreak alert for Trans Nzoia County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: CDC inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa kwa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: CDC waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka Rift Valley Fever ee Gobolka Trans Nzoia. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar yedhe (CDC) osenyiso ni nitie masira mar Rift Valley Fever e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public in Mombasa County about the importance of safe water storage for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhusu umuhimu wa uhifadhi wa maji salama kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay dadka degmada Mombasa ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji duto e county mar Mombasa kuom ber mar kano pi maler e ngima joot.

English: Notice: DCI opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay fureysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya taageero maskaxeed ee gobolka Mandera.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni DCI ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony e weche mag pach ji e gweng' mar Mandera.

English: KEPHIS urges goats farmers in Wajir County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawataka wafugaji wa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyoteuliwa kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda orgiga ee Gobolka Wajir inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee anthrax.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur ma pidho diek e gweng' mar Wajir mondo ogeng'e legi e kuonde moyier mag chwoyo diek bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag anthrax.

English: Kilifi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kilifi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2023
Somali: Degmada Kilifi: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kilifi: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar 2023

English: We encourage you to lower your risk of Coronavirus. practice social distancing Wash your hands with soap & running water often for 20 seconds stay at home avoid public places regularly clean & sanitize all spaces - doorknobs, phones... #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Tunakuhimiza kupunguza hatari yako ya virusi vya corona. fanya mazoezi ya umbali wa kijamii Osha mikono yako kwa sabuni na maji yanayotiririka mara kwa mara kwa sekunde 20 kaa nyumbani epuka maeneo ya umma safisha mara kwa mara na usafishe nafasi zote - vitasa vya milango, simu... #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Waxaan kugu dhiirigelinaynaa inaad yareyso khatartaada Coronavirus. Ku dhaqan kala fogaanshaha bulshada Gacmahaaga ku dhaq saabuun iyo biyo socda 20 ilbiriqsi guriga joog oo iska ilaali meelaha dadweynaha si joogto ah u nadiifi oo nadiifi dhammaan meelaha - albaabada, taleefannada... #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Wajiwo ni mondo iduok piny nyalo mar yudo tuwo mar Korona. <2Zepa> puonj mar bedo mabor gi joweteni Los lweteni gi sabun kod pi mang'ich kinde ka kinde kuom sekon 20 bed e ot, geng' kuonde ma ji mang'eny romoe, ler kendo ilos kuonde duto - ng'ut dhoot, simu... #KomeshaCorona

English: Kenya and Rwanda have reached an important milestone in the fight against antimicrobial resistance (AMR), strengthening their ability to track where drug-resistant infections are emerging, and how they are spreading.
Kiswahili: Kenya na Rwanda zimefikia hatua muhimu katika mapambano dhidi ya ukinzani wa viua vijidudu (AMR), kuimarisha uwezo wao wa kufuatilia ni wapi magonjwa sugu ya dawa yanajitokeza, na jinsi yanavyoenea.
Somali: Kenya iyo Rwanda waxay gaareen guul muhiim ah oo ku aaddan la dagaallanka iska caabbinta jeermiska dila (AMR), iyagoo xoojinaya awooddooda ay ku raadraaci karaan meelaha ay ka soo baxayaan caabuqyada daawada u adkaysta, iyo sida ay u faafayaan.
Dholuo: Kenya kod Rwanda osechopo okang’ maduong’ ahinya e lweny mar kedo gi tuoche ma nyalo geng’o tuoche ma nyalo geng’o tuoche (AMR), kendo gimedo miyo nyalo margi mar luwo kama tuoche ma nyalo geng’o tuoche ma nyalo geng’o tuoche mag yath wuokie, kod kaka gimedo landore.

English: FAO promotes conservation tillage among farmers in Meru County as part of the June climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: FAO inakuza kilimo cha uhifadhi kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Juni.
Somali: FAO waxay dhiirrigelisay beerashada ilaalinta beeraleyda degmada Meru iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee bisha Juun.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo tij chwoyo kodhi e kind jopur e county mar Meru kaka achiel kuom chenro mar dwe mar Jun mar kedo gi lokruok e kit yamo.

English: FAO warns coffee farmers in Murang'a County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: FAO inawaonya wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Murang'a juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: FAO waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Murang'a cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: FAO chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho chai e County mar Murang'a ni nitie tuoche ma nyalo kelo tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Notice: NDMA opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inafungua ofisi ya kijinsia inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogaysiis: NDMA waxay furaysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya daryeel caafimaad ka dib rabshadaha degmada Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony mar thieth bang' timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Kirinyaga.

English: not only limits access to credit by women for start-up or expansion, but also limits access to other agricultural aspects including market and market contracts.
Kiswahili: si tu kupunguza upatikanaji wa mikopo kwa wanawake kwa ajili ya kuanza au upanuzi, lakini pia kupunguza upatikanaji wa nyanja nyingine za kilimo, ikiwa ni pamoja na soko na mikataba ya soko.
Somali: ma aha oo kaliya in la xaddido helitaanka amaahda haweenka ee bilowga ama ballaarinta, laakiin sidoo kale in la xaddido helitaanka dhinacyada kale ee beeraha oo ay ku jiraan heshiisyada suuqa iyo suuqa.
Dholuo: ok oket mana tong' ne yudo pesa mag konyo mon e chako tich kata e medo tiyo ne Nyasaye, to bende oket tong' ne yudo pesa mamoko mag pur moriwo nyaka pesa ma yudore e chiro kod chiro.

English: KICD invites youth in Homa Bay County to enroll for electrical installation training this December.
Kiswahili: KICD inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Desemba hii.
Somali: KICD waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada gobolka Homa Bay inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: KICD gwelo rowere manie Homa Bay County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar keto sitima e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: TVET opens a new electrical installation programme at the vocational centre in Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET yafungua programu mpya ya ufungaji wa umeme katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo lagu rakibo korontada xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi.
Dholuo: Rapar: TVET ochako chenro manyien mar keto sitima e kar tiegruok e Tharaka-Nithi County.

English: Baringo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Baringo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Juni 2023
Somali: Degmada Baringo: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Baringo: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2023

English: Ear disease can cause deafness, seek for medical attention without delay.
Kiswahili: Magonjwa ya sikio yanaweza kusababisha upotevu, tafuta matibabu bila kuchelewa.
Somali: Cudurada dhegaha waxay sababi karaan dhega la'aan, si deg deg ah u raadi daryeel caafimaad.
Dholuo: Tuoche mag it nyalo miyo ng'ato obed momo, omiyo dwarore ni omany thieth mapiyo.

English: Notice: KICD launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Tana River.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay bilawday barnaamij ilaalinta caruurta iskuulada iskuulada guud ahaan degmada Tana River.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KICD chako chenro mar rito nyithindo e skul e skunde duto mag Tana River County.

English: CDC advises residents of Kwale County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: CDC inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: CDC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: CDC nyiso jogweng' mar Kwale County mondo odonj e riwruok mar insuarans mar thieth mondo giyud thieth ma yudo kony.

English: Reduce post-harvest losses for fruits through better handling, storage, and processing techniques from harvest to market.
Kiswahili: Punguza upotevu wa matunda baada ya mavuno kupitia mbinu bora za utunzaji, uhifadhi, na usindikaji kuanzia mavuno hadi sokoni.
Somali: Yaree khasaaraha miraha kadib goosashada iyada oo loo marayo farsamooyinka maareynta, kaydinta, iyo farsamaynta laga bilaabo goosashada ilaa suuqa.
Dholuo: Meduru kethruok ma nyak nyak biro yudo bang' keyo kuom tiyo gi yore mabeyo mag tiyo gi olembe, kano olembe, kod loso olembe.

English: Kenya confirms surge in Mpox cases, tally now at 137 with Busia, Mombasa and Nakuru counties leading with highest number of infections.
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha kuongezeka kwa visa vya Mpox, ambapo sasa vimefikia 137 huku kaunti za Busia, Mombasa na Nakuru zikiongoza kwa kuwa na idadi kubwa zaidi ya maambukizi.
Somali: Kenya waxay xaqiijineysaa kororka kiisaska Mpox, oo hadda gaaraya 137 iyadoo degmooyinka Busia, Mombasa iyo Nakuru ay hogaaminayaan tirada ugu badan ee cudurrada.
Dholuo: Kenya osenyiso ni ji mang'eny ma nigi Mpox osemedore, ka sani gichopo 137 gi county mag Busia, Mombasa kod Nakuru.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds voters in Murang'a County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya kujiandikisha.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Murang'a inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor diiwaangelinta codbixisayaasha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone jogweng'o e county mar Murang'a mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero ka pok gidonj e register mar joma oyiero.

English: KEMSA appeals to caregivers in Nandi County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the January maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Nandi kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Januari.
Somali: KEMSA waxay u baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Nandi inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyadda ee Janaayo.
Dholuo: KEMSA okwayo jorit e county mar Nandi mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi e dwe mar Januar.

English: NCPB reminds farmers in Siaya County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Siaya juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Somali: NCPB waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Siaya barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee ka dambeeya goosashada.
Dholuo: NCPB oparo ne jopur e county mar Siaya chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime bang' keyo.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties urges residents of Meru County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Meru ku boorinayaa inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u soo gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties ojiwo jogweng' mar Meru County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripode e intanet e chiwo kwayo mar kwedo mibadhi e migepe mag sirkal.

English: E-commerce, agri-digital financial services, climate-smart agriculture and other digital tools could make agricultural value chains more efficient and inclusive ...
Kiswahili: E-commerce, huduma za kifedha za kilimo-dijiti, kilimo cha hali ya hewa na zana zingine za dijiti zinaweza kufanya minyororo ya thamani ya kilimo kuwa bora zaidi na jumuishi ...
Somali: Ganacsiga elektaroonigga ah, adeegyada maaliyadeed ee beeraha iyo dhijitaalka ah, beeraha cimilada ee caqli-galka leh iyo aaladaha kale ee dhijitaalka ah waxay ka dhigi karaan silsiladaha qiimaha beeraha inay noqdaan kuwo wax ku ool ah oo ka mid ah ...
Dholuo: Ohala mar intanet, tije mag pesa mag agro-digital, timo pur mar piny kod piny kod gik mamoko ma nyalo miyo nengo mag ohala mag pur obed maber kendo moriwo ji duto.

English: FAO advises milk producers in Marsabit County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: FAO inashauri wazalishaji wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: FAO waxay ku talineysaa soosaarayaasha caanaha ee degmada Marsabit inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur mag chak e gweng' mar Marsabit mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds livestock keepers in Samburu County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xayawaanka ah ee Gobolka Samburu inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jopur mag jamni e county mar Samburu ni gimi jamnigi thieth e kuonde moyier mag chwoyo jamni mondo girit ngima mar jamni.

English: Economic Inclusion of Refugees and Host Communities in Kenya: A market analysis
Kiswahili: Ujumuisho wa Kiuchumi wa Wakimbizi na Jumuiya Wenyeji nchini Kenya: Uchanganuzi wa soko
Somali: Ka mid noqoshada Dhaqaalaha ee Qaxootiga iyo Bulshooyinka Martigelinta ah ee Kenya: Falanqayn suuq
Dholuo: Oting’o weche mag ohala mag jolweny kod oganda ma rwakogi e piny Kenya: Nonro mar chiro

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will hold a suicide prevention forum in Kajiado County this August. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitafanya kongamano la kuzuia kujiua katika Kaunti ya Kajiado Agosti hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa qaban doonta madasha ka hortagga is-miidaaminta ee degmada Kajiado bisha Agoosto. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Rieko: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo chokruok mar geng'o ji kik nege e Kajiado County e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: KRA launches county development projects in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: KRA inazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya wilaya katika Wilaya ya Tana River.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay bilawday mashaariic horumarineed oo ka socda degmada Tana River County.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KRA chako timo dongruok e taon mar Tana River County.

English: Ministry of Education advises applicants in Nyamira County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kutembelea kituo cha mafunzo ya ufundi kilicho karibu kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Nyamira inay booqdaan xarunta ugu dhow ee tababarka xirfadeed ee loogu talagalay gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e kaunti mar Nyamira mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: TVET urges youth in West Pokot County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: TVET inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: TVET waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada West Pokot inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: TVET ojiwo rowere e West Pokot County mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto giseyudo kapok gitimo tije mag oganda.

English: Notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response confirms a cyclosporiasis outbreak alert for Bomet County. Residents are advised to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa cyclosporiasis kwa Kaunti ya Bomet. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ku saabsan cudurka cyclosporiasis ee Gobolka Bomet. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo nyiso ni koro nitie masira mar cyclosporiasis e kaunti mar Bomet.

English: Kwale County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kwale: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2023
Somali: Degmada Kwale: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kwale: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2023

English: Kenya Medical Association urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Turkana County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Turkana kumtia moyo rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Turkana inuu ku dhiirrigeliyo saaxiibkiisa dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi tuoche mag obwongo e County mar Turkana mondo ojiw osiepne moro ma chandore omany kony.

English: Notice: DPP opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Wilaya ya Isiolo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay fureysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya daryeel caafimaad ka dib rabshadaha degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DPP ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo thieth bang' timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Isiolo.

English: The Ministry of Education elevated 19 TVET colleges to national polytechnic status to enhance vocational training capacity.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu iliongeza uwezo wa mafunzo ya kitaaluma katika vyuo vikuu 19 vya TVET kuwa polytechnic za kitaifa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa 19 kulliyadood oo TVET ah u kordhisay xaaladda polytechnic ee qaranka si loo xoojiyo awoodda tababarka xirfadeed.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education osemiyo kolej 19 mag TVET ratiro mar bedo polytechnic e piny mangima mondo omed jiwo nyalo mar tiegruok e weche mag tich.

English: Notice: Council of Governors will hold a public participation forum on development planning forums in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana litafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha waxay qaban doonaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta ee degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Jaloch biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag dongruok e gweng' mar Kisii.

English: KRA warns public officers in Nandi County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: KRA inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Nandi dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: KRA waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee gobolka Nandi inay musuqmaasuqa ka qaataan xafiisyada dowladda.
Dholuo: KRA chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Nandi kuom kawo asoya e migepe mar sirkal.

English: KALRO advises horticultural produce producers in Kisumu County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wazalishaji wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KALRO waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha wax soo saarka beeraha ee degmada Kisumu inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday ka hor xilliga goosashada.

Kiswahili: Kampuni ya Nigeria itaanza kutengeneza magonjwa ya UKIMWI na malaria kufuatia uamuzi wa Amerika wa kuacha msaada wao

Kiswahili: Gazeti Times of India lilisema kwamba zaidi ya watu 300 walijeruhiwa wakati wa maandamano yaliyoongozwa na vijana, na wanaharakati wa Kizazi cha Z wakishutumu ukatili wa polisi na ukandamizaji wa serikali.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response urges residents of Migori County to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers following a rise in reported cyclosporiasis cases.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya cyclosporiasis vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan Degmada Migori inay soo sheegaan kiisas kasta oo laga shakiyo inay u sheegaan mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada ka dib kororka kiisaska loo soo sheegay ee cyclosporiasis.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' Migori County mondo onyis joma ochiwore ne thieth mar oganda ni giparo ni gin gi tuwono nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuwono mar cyclosporiasis osemedore.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Mombasa County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' Mombasa County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e loso chenro mag chenro mag sirkal.

English: KEMRI appeals to caregivers in Mombasa County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the January maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya harakati za afya ya uzazi za Januari.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Mombasa inay ilmahooda u keenaan kormeerka koritaanka iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Janaayo.
Dholuo: KEMRI okwayo jorit e County mar Mombasa mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongruok kaka achiel kuom chenro mar Januar mar rito ngima mar mine.

English: AFA announces a free lumpy skin disease vaccination exercise for sheep in Kiambu County this October.
Kiswahili: AFA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa ngozi kwa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Oktoba hii.
Somali: AFA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka maqaarka ee lo'da ee gobolka Kiambu bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: AFA olando chenro mar thiedho rombe e dwe mar Oktoba e gweng' mar Kiambu.

English: Ministry of Health launches a November awareness campaign on safe water storage across Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Novemba juu ya uhifadhi wa maji salama katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii November oo ku saabsan kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Novemba kuom wach kano pi maler e County duto mar Kisii.

English: Ministry of Education launches interactive portal providing digital lessons and assessments for primary learners.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu yazindua lango shirikishi linalotoa masomo na tathmini za kidijitali kwa wanafunzi wa shule ya msingi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa furtay bog internet oo is-dhexgal ah oo bixiya casharro dhijitaal ah iyo qiimeyn loogu talagalay ardayda dugsiyada hoose.
Dholuo: Od tich mar somo ochako mbui matiyo gi mbui machiwo somo kod pim mag dijital ne jopuonjre mag primary.

English: KICD reminds parents in Kiambu County that bursary allocation registration is open this March.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba usajili wa ugawaji wa bursary umefunguliwa Machi hii.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Kiambu in diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ay furan tahay bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne jonyuol e County mar Kiambu ni kad mar chiwo mich mag tiegruok osechakore e dwe mar Mach.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds mobile money users in Kajiado County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha watumiaji wa fedha za simu za mkononi katika Kajiado County wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa pesa za simu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kajiado inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna si looga fogaado khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e Kajiado County ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo kik gitim timbe mag wuondo pesa mag simu.

English: KEPHIS invites farmers in Turkana County to a free training on record keeping for farmers this April.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Turkana kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima Aprili hii.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Turkana tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan diiwaangelinta beeralayda bisha April.
Dholuo: KEPHIS ogwelo jopur e gweng' mar Turkana e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar rito rekod mag jopur dwe mar April.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit announces SHA registration for residents of Laikipia County starting this December.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinatangaza usajili wa SHA kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kuanzia Desemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa ku dhawaaqday diiwaangelinta SHA ee dadka deggan degmada Laikipia laga bilaabo bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit of Laikipia County ogolo chik mar SHA ne joma odak e kaunti mar Laikipie kochakore e dwe mar Desemba.

English: NDMA urges the public in Kirinyaga County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: NDMA waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadweynaha gobolka Kirinyaga inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qof kasta oo ka dambeeya kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo ji duto e County mar Kirinyaga ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo weche ma nyiso ni ne nitie weche mag phishing.

English: New mothers may experience sadness or anxiety. Counseling and support groups can help.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wapya wanaweza kupata huzuni au wasiwasi. Ushauri nasaha na vikundi vya usaidizi vinaweza kusaidia.
Somali: Hooyooyinka cusub waxay dareemi karaan murugo ama walaac.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma pod tindo nyalo bedo gi kuyo kata bedo gi parruok.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations alerts residents of Samburu County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka deggan degmada Samburu uga digaya kororka kiisaska jabsashada, wuxuuna bulshada kula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne ji modak e county mar Samburu ni kwan mag joma odonjo e ot biro medore kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Announces how Community clubs in multiple counties share recipes and nutrition tips using fortified cereals and snacks.
Kiswahili: Hutangaza jinsi vilabu vya Jumuiya katika kaunti nyingi vinavyoshiriki mapishi na vidokezo vya lishe kwa kutumia nafaka zilizoongezwa virutubisho na vitafunio.
Somali: Waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa sida naadiyada bulshada ee degmooyin badan ay u wadaagaan cuntooyinka iyo talooyinka nafaqada iyagoo adeegsanaya badarka la xoojiyey iyo cunto fudud.
Dholuo: Olando kaka klab mag oganda e kaunti mang’eny lando yore mag chiemo kod riekni mag chiemo ka gitiyo gi cham ma nigi ng’injo kod chiemo matin.

English: Notice: EACC launches ward-level service delivery in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inazindua huduma za huduma katika wilaya ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay bilawday bixinta adeegyada heerka qaybta ee degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: EACC chako chiwo kony e alwora mar Bungoma County.

English: Notice: ODPP will hold a public participation forum on development planning forums in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta ee degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: ODPP biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag dongruok e gweng' mar Isiolo.

English: KICD reminds schools in Lamu County to strengthen anti-bullying measures this May.
Kiswahili: KICD inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuimarisha hatua za kupambana na uonevu Mei hii.
Somali: KICD waxay xusuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Lamu inay xoojiyaan tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibta bisha May.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne skunde man Lamu County mondo omed jiwo yore mag kedo gi ichwanyruok e dwe mar Mei.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Nyeri County about a rise in identity theft and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Utafiti wa Uhalifu inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhusu kuongezeka kwa wizi wa kitambulisho na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ka digaya dadka deggan degmada Nyeri kororka dhacda aqoonsiga wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nyeri County kuom dongruok mar kuo mar kitgi kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: East Africa Regional Maize Supply and Market Outlook, 29 November 2023
Kiswahili: Mtazamo wa Ugavi wa Mahindi katika Kanda ya Afrika Mashariki na soko, tarehe 29 Novemba 2023
Somali: Aragtida Suuqa iyo Sahayda Galleyda Gobolka ee Bariga Afrika, 29 Noofambar 2023
Dholuo: Chiwruok mar cham e Kidieny mar Afrika ma Wuokchieng' kod neno mar chiro, tarik 29 dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2023

English: KALRO promotes water harvesting among farmers in Samburu County as part of the November climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: KALRO inakuza uvunaji wa maji miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Novemba.
Somali: KALRO waxay dhiirrigelisay goosashada biyaha beeraleyda gobolka Samburu iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka u adkeynta cimilada ee bisha Nofeembar.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo tij choko pi e kind jopur e county mar Samburu e dwe mar Novemba kaka achiel kuom chenro mag timo lokruok e kit yamo.

English: TVET urges parents and teachers in Bungoma County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: TVET inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi kwa watoto 116.
Somali: TVET waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Bungoma inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Bungoma mondo omany simo mar kony ne nyithindo namba 116.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Garissa County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inazindua kampeni ya kupambana na ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Garissa Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa degmada Garissa bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Rapar: Bura mar Kenya chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Garissa e dwe mar Desemba.

Kiswahili: Kenya | Mafuriko ya Mto - Uanzishaji wa Itifaki ya Hatua ya Mapema (10 Novemba2023) Operesheni Ã¢Â„Â–: MDRKE053
Somali: Kenya | Daadadka Webiga - Hawlgalka Hore ee Habraaca (10 Noofambar 2023) Hawlgalka - MDRKE053

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises fish producers in Machakos County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inashauri wazalishaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kalluunka ee degmada Machakos inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur ma loso rech e county mar Machakos mondo oti gi nengo mar piny mosingi kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Laikipia County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Laikipia: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Mei 2023
Somali: Degmada Laikipia: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Laikipia: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar abich higa mar 2023

English: IPOA urges the community in Makueni County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: IPOA inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Makueni inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha si looga hortago xannibaadda lo'da.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo ji duto e gweng' mar Makueni mondo kik gipog weche mag rito ngimagi gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo kik gikwed kwalo jamni.

English: Brief: El NiÃ±o floods worsen humanitarian needs in Kenya (March 2024)
Kiswahili: Kwa kifupi: Mafuriko ya El NiÃ±o yanazidisha mahitaji ya kibinadamu nchini Kenya (Machi 2024)
Somali: Warbixin Kooban: Daadadka El Nió oo sii xumeeyay baahiyaha bani'aadamnimada ee Kenya (Maarso 2024)
Dholuo: Machuok: Pi ma pong’o piny El NiÃ±o medo rach mar dwaro mag dhano e piny Kenya (Dwe mar Adek 2024)

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Narok County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Narok kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Narok inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e gweng' mar Narok mondo oluong simo mar thieth mar paro maonge chudo.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will be held in Siaya County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Siaya Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo bilaash ah oo ay soo qabanqaabisay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Siaya bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Rapar: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo mitimo gi Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ibiro tim e county mar Siaya e dwe mar Mach.

English: Kenya Gazette invites residents of Kakamega County to attend the public participation forum regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Kakamega inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette gwelo jogweng' Kakamega County mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenro mag dongruok.

English: Embu (Mbeere) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Embu (Mbeere): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Mei 2024
Somali: Degmada Embu (Mbeere): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Embu (Mbeere): Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo kuom Oro mar Mei 2024

English: Teachers Service Commission urges parents and teachers in West Pokot County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macalimiinta wuxuu ugu baaqay waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada West Pokot inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e West Pokot County mondo omany namba mar kony mar nyithindo 116.

English: EACC advises residents of Taita-Taveta County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: EACC inashauri wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: EACC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: EACC nyiso jogweng'o mag Taita-Taveta County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro kwayo mar bedo gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises coffee producers in Narok County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inashauri wazalishaji wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Narok kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kafeega ee Gobolka Narok inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nyiso jopur ma loso chai e county mar Narok mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur ka pok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Kenya Medical Association calls on parents in Nyandarua County to have children under five screened for HIV/AIDS during the January outreach.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuwafanyia uchunguzi wa watoto chini ya miaka mitano wa VVU/UKIMWI wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Januari.
Somali: Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya ayaa ugu baaqay waalidiinta degmada Nyandarua in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro HIV/AIDS intii lagu jiray bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association okwayo jonyuol e County mar Nyandarua mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Januar.

English: KALRO announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for goats in Nyamira County this May.
Kiswahili: KALRO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Mei hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan rabshadaha lo'da ee gobolka Nyamira bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: KALRO ogolo chenro mar thiedho diek maonge chudo mar rabies ne diek e County mar Nyamira e dwe mar abich.

English: TSC advises students in Lamu County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: TSC inashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Lamu kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya udhamini mkondoni kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wanaohitaji.
Somali: TSC waxay ardayda degmada Lamu kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga deeqda waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan deeq waxbarasho ardayda u baahan.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo jopuonjre e County mar Lamu mondo okonygi kokalo kuom websait mar somo ma yudore e Intanet mondo giyud kony kuom jopuonjre man gi chan.

English: Public launch of rice products fortified with iron, folic acid, B-vitamins, iodine and zinc, aligned with government fortification standards.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa umma wa bidhaa za mchele zilizoongezewa madini ya chuma, asidi ya foliki, vitamini B, iodini na zinki, unaoendana na viwango vya serikali vya urutubishaji.
Somali: Daahfurka dadweynaha ee badeecooyinka bariiska ee lagu xoojiyay birta, folic acid, fiitamiinnada B, iodine iyo zinc, oo la jaanqaadaya heerarka xoojinta dowladda.
Dholuo: Keto e wang' ji duto mwandu mag ngano moting'o chuma, asid mar folik, vitamin B, ayodin kod zinc, kaluwore kod rang'iny mar sirkal mar keto muonde.

English: Teachers Service Commission advises applicants in Narok County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Narok kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa ku talinaya codsadayaasha degmada Narok inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow si ay u helaan waxbarashada soo socota.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e gweng' mar Narok mondo odhi e skul man machiegni kodgi.

English: Marsabit County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Marsabit: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Februari 2024
Somali: Degmada Marsabit: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Marsabit: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2024

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Machakos County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.

Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa bursary kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka Wajir waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee dugsiyada degmada Wajir.

Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito katika miezi mitatu yao ya pili ya ujauzito wanapaswa kupokea dawa za minyoo ili kuboresha lishe na kupunguza matatizo.
Somali: Haweenka uurka leh ee saddexda bilood ee labaad waa inay helaan daawooyinka ka hortagga cayayaanka si loo hagaajiyo nafaqada loona yareeyo dhibaatooyinka.
Dholuo: Mon ma nigi ich ma gin e kinde mar ariyo mar nyuol onego omi thieth mar tieko tuoche mondo omi gimed bedo gi chiemo maber kendo giduok chien chandruoge ma giromogo.

English: NTSA warns residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: NTSA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in ay kordhaan qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County e wi medruok mar chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: KNEC calls on the community in Nairobi County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KNEC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: KNEC waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Nairobi inay u soo wargeliyaan maamulka iskuulka wixii dhibaato ah ee ku saabsan amniga si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: KNEC okwayo oganda man Nairobi County mondo onyis sirkal mar skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya calls on the community in Tana River County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaalika jamii katika Wilaya ya Tana River kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwa ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Tana River County inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji (Communications Authority of Kenya) dwaro ni ji duto manie taon mar Tana River County, owuo e wi timbe mahundu motudore gi dichwo gi dhako kod dhako, kendo gichiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni kodgi.

Kiswahili: Hatari ya kuhama kwa maafa nchini Kenya: Muhtasari wa hatari ya kuhama kwa siku zijazo kutokana na mafuriko ya mito, mawimbi ya dhoruba, upepo wa kimbunga na ukame katika viwango vya kitaifa na vya kitaifa.

Dholuo: Risiko mar weyo udigi e piny Kenya: Ranyisi matut mar risiko mar weyo udigi e kinde mabiro nikech pi ma pong’o aora, yamo mapek, yamo mapek kod oro e rang’iny mar pinyno kod pinyno

English: COMESA urges farmers in Kilifi County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kilifi inay ka qeyb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e weche mag pur mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok ma timore e kit koth.

English: Notice: KICD reminds citizens in Migori County about their rights regarding voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Migori kuhusu haki zao kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Migori ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KICD paronwa raia mag Migori County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar ndiko joma oyiero.

English: Attention young farmers Explore opportunities in coffee value addition and learn about processing methods and by products Engage with local coffee estates for hands on experience today
Kiswahili: Angalizo kwa wakulima vijana Chunguza fursa katika kuongeza thamani ya kahawa na ujifunze kuhusu mbinu za usindikaji na bidhaa Shirikiana na mashamba ya kahawa ya ndani ili kupata uzoefu leo.

English: Notice: IEBC reminds citizens in Kajiado County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Kajiado ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC paronwa raia mag Kajiado County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo gi ji duto e bajet mar county.

English: More than four out of five refugees in Kakuma, Kalobeyei, and Dadaab are multidimensionally poor, experiencing overlapping deprivations in education, employment, housing, water, and nutrition.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya wakimbizi wanne kati ya watano huko Kakuma, Kalobeyei, na Dadaab ni masikini wa pande nyingi, wanakabiliwa na kunyimwa kwa elimu, ajira, makazi, maji na lishe.
Somali: In ka badan afar ka mid ah shan qaxooti ah oo ku nool Kakuma, Kalobeyei, iyo Dadaab ayaa ah kuwo sabool ah oo dhinacyo badan leh, iyagoo la kulma dhibaatooyin is barbar socda oo ku saabsan waxbarashada, shaqada, guryaha, biyaha, iyo nafaqada.
Dholuo: Jolweny mokalo ang’wen kuom abich ma wuok e piny Kakuma, Kalobeyei, kod Dadaab gin jodhier mathoth, ka giyudo pek mathoth mag somo, tich, udi, pi, kod chiemo.

English: Universities Fund encourages out-of-school children in Bungoma County to register their children at the nearest public school under free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa carruurta dugsiga ka baxsan ee degmada Bungoma inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha ee waxbarashada dhexe ee maalinlaha ah ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e County mar Bungoma mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni gi skul mar ji duto e tiegruok mar sekondari.

English: MoH to begin third round of polio vaccination in Mandera, Wajir and Garissa
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya kuanza awamu ya tatu ya chanjo ya polio huko Mandera, Wajir na Garissa
Somali: Wasaaradda caafimaadka ayaa bilaabi doonta wareegga saddexaad ee tallaalka cudurka Polio ee Mandera, Wajir iyo Garissa
Dholuo: MoH biro chako ng'ado mar adek mar thieth mar polio e Mandera, Wajir kod Garissa

English: Locally Led, Adaptive Cash Assistance for Disaster-Affected Communities Across Kenya
Kiswahili: Usaidizi wa Pesa Unaoongozwa na Nchi, Unaobadilika kwa Jamii Zilizoathiriwa na Maafa Kote Kenya.
