Dholuo: Kony mar omwom ma otelo ne jopiny ma oyudo masira e piny Kenya duto

English: Kenya Dairy Board urges farmers in Nyeri County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda degmada Nyeri inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur e County mar Nyeri mondo opidh olembe mondo omi piny okethre mondo omi giritre kuom lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: Regular weight checks at clinics help detect growth issues early. Caregivers are encouraged to attend monthly child welfare clinics.
Kiswahili: Kupima uzito mara kwa mara katika kliniki husaidia kugundua matatizo ya ukuaji mapema. Walezi wanahimizwa kuhudhuria kliniki za ustawi wa watoto kila mwezi.
Somali: Imtixaanka miisaanka ee joogtada ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka ayaa gacan ka geysanaya in la ogaado dhibaatooyinka koritaanka ka hor.
Dholuo: Nono dendi pile ka pile e osiptal konyo ng'ato fwenyo ni en gi chandruok mar dongo chon, kendo ijiwo jorit mondo odhi e klinik mag rito nyithindo dwe ka dwe.

English: State Department for TVET reminds needy students in Kakamega County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan Gobolka Kakamega in buugaagta waxbarasho iyo codsiyada qalabka waxbarasho ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET oparo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni buk mag somo kod weche mag puonjruok mag somo chiegni rumo.

English: DCI reminds residents of Machakos County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah xilliyada fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: DCI parone jogweng'o mag Machakos County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji moa e gweng'no.

English: KEMSA launches a March awareness campaign on proper sanitation across Lamu County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Machi juu ya usafi wa mazingira katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: KEMSA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole wacyi galineed bishii Maarso oo ku saabsan nadaafadda saxda ah ee Gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: KEMSA ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Mach kuom weche mag thieth e alwora duto mar Lamu County.

English: Kenya Red Cross announces free medical camps for residents of Uasin Gishu County starting this March.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya latangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuanzia Machi hii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa ku dhawaaqday xeryo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan gobolka Uasin Gishu laga bilaabo bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ogolo kampen mag thieth maonge chudo ne joma odak e county mar Uasin Gishu kochakore dwe mar Mach.

English: NTSA calls on the community in Embu County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaita jamii katika Kaunti ya Embu kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Somali: NTSA waxay bulshada degmada Embu ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: NTSA luongo ji duto e county mar Embu mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gidwar kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Understand the risks of Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) and practice the responsible use of antibiotics in apiculture (e.g., poultry).
Kiswahili: Kuelewa hatari za Upinzani wa Antimicrobial (AMR) na ufanye mazoezi ya matumizi ya uwajibikaji wa antibiotics katika apiculture (kwa mfano, kuku).
Somali: Fahmaan khatarta ka jirta iska caabinada jeermiska (AMR) iyo isticmaalka mas'uuliyadda leh ee antibiyootikada beeraha (tusaale ahaan digaagga).
Dholuo: Ng'e rach ma bedoe nikech geng'o tuoche mag tuoche (AMR) kendo iti gi yedhe mamero e yo mariek e pidho nyithi odugini (e ranyisi, le mag udi).

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya umetoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao kuhusu wizi wa kitambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan xadaysiga aqoonsiga ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Nakuru.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ripot Makwar mar Kenya ogolo siem mar rito weche mag intanet e wi kuo mar ng'ato makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Nakuru County.

English: To manage bacterial wilt in enset, sterilize cutting tools with 70% alcohol or bleach (or heat them until red-hot) before and after each plant, dig out and bury diseased plants deep in a pit, use disease-free seedlings, rotate with cereal or pulse crops (not banana), and fence the field to keep out animals that can spread the disease.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti kuharibika kwa bakteria katika enset, sterilize zana za kukata na 70% ya pombe au bleach (au joto yao hadi moto nyekundu) kabla na baada ya kila mmea, kuchimba nje na kuzikwa mimea wagonjwa kina kirefu katika shimo, kutumia mbegu zisizo na ugonjwa, kugeuka na nafaka au pulse mazao (si banana), na fence shamba ili kuweka nje wanyama ambao wanaweza kueneza ugonjwa.
Somali: Si loo xakameeyo qallaalka bakteeriyada, nadiifi qalabka goynta iyadoo la adeegsanayo 70% aalkolo ama bleach (ama kululeyso ilaa kulul) ka hor iyo ka dib geed kasta, qod oo ku aaso dhirta cudurka leh god qoto dheer, isticmaal geedo aan cudur lahayn, ku beddel dalagyada quraaca ama bakhaarka (ma aha moos), iyo xayndaabka beerta si xayawaanka looga ilaaliyo faafin kara cudurka.
Dholuo: Mondo omi ng'ato obed gi tuwo mar bakteria, nyaka oti gi yedhe ma nyap ma romo 70% mar kong'o kata lewni ma loso rangi (kata oti kodgi nyaka gibed maliet) kapok ochako chwoyo kod bang' chwoyo yien, nyaka oyud kendo oyik yien ma nigi tuoche e bur matut, oti gi yien ma onge tuoche, kendo olok yien mag cham kata mag pulse (ok ni gi banana), kendo ogeng' puodho mondo kik onyal kelo tuoche.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Kisii County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Kisii inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qayb galaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur e County mar Kisii mondo okel namba mar pimo jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Makueni County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Makueni inay ka soo qayb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur manie Makueni County mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Their role is also to convey health messages on the need to continue other malaria prevention measures, such as sleeping under bednets (ITNs), and benefits of other routine vaccines for children.
Kiswahili: Jukumu lao pia ni kuwasilisha ujumbe wa afya juu ya haja ya kuendelea na hatua nyingine za kuzuia malaria, kama vile kulala chini ya vyandarua (ITNs), na manufaa ya chanjo nyingine za kawaida kwa watoto.
Somali: Doorkoodu sidoo kale waa inay gudbiyaan farriimo caafimaad oo ku saabsan baahida loo qabo in la sii wado tallaabooyinka kale ee ka hortagga duumada, sida in lagu seexdo shabaqyada sariirta (ITNs), iyo faa'iidooyinka tallaallada kale ee caadiga ah ee carruurta.
Dholuo: Tichgi bende en mar lando ote mag thieth kuom dwaro mar dhi nyime gi yore mamoko mag geng’o maleria, kaka nindo e bwo mtoka (ITNs), kod ber mag thieth mamoko ma pile ka pile ne nyithindo.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds residents of Kwale County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale wanaohudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale ee ka qeybgalaya kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada ayaa xoojinaya maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) paronwa jogweng' mar Kwale County ma biro e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo omed jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: State Department for TVET calls on the community in Trans Nzoia County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Trans Nzoia inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116 si ay u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State for TVET kwayo ji duto e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo omany namba mar 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Farmers and agribusinesses are encouraged to engage with KNCCI and KALRO to access and commercialize agricultural innovations that can boost productivity and income
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wafanyabiashara wa kilimo wanahimizwa kushirikiana na KNCCI na KALRO ili kupata na kufanya biashara ya ubunifu wa kilimo ambao unaweza kuongeza tija na mapato.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo ganacsiyada beeraha waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay la shaqeeyaan KNCCI iyo KALRO si ay u helaan oo ay u ganacsiyeeyaan hal-abuurnimada beeraha ee kordhin kara wax soo saarka iyo dakhliga
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma tiyo e tije mag pur jiwo jopur koda ohala mag pur mondo oti gi KNCCI kod KALRO e yudo kendo tiyo gi yore mag pur ma nyalo miyo ji omed bedo gi nyak kod pesa ma giyudo

English: Notice: TVET announces school feeding programme enrollment dates for schools in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa programu ya kulisha shule kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiyada gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET lando tarik mag dhi e skunde mag Taita-Taveta.

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Kilifi County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inay yareeyaan qaadashada cusbada iyo sonkorta si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth jiwo jogweng' Kilifi County mondo oket chien chamo mor kod sukari mondo kik tuoche ma inyalo geng'e landre.

English: Ministry releasing comprehensive strategy following success of KNAP 2018Ã¢Â€Â“2022, targeting multisectoral interventions to further reduce malnutrition rates.
Kiswahili: Wizara ikitoa mkakati kamili kufuatia mafanikio ya KNAP 2018Ã¢Â€Â“2022, ikilenga uingiliaji kati wa sekta mbalimbali ili kupunguza zaidi viwango vya utapiamlo.
Somali: Wasaaraddu waxay soo saartay istiraatiijiyad dhammaystiran ka dib guushii KNAP 2018-2022, iyadoo bartilmaameedsanaysa waxqabadyo badan oo waaxyo kala duwan leh si loo sii yareeyo heerarka nafaqo-xumada.
Dholuo: Od tich ma golo chenro matut bang’ yudo ber mar KNAP 2018Ã¢Â€Â“2022, ma ochung’ne ng’ado bura e kind sektor mang’eny mondo omed dwoko piny kwan mar jogo ma nigi chiemo ma ok owinjore.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds residents of Nyeri County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri in helitaanka adeegyada baasaboorka ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone jogweng' Nyeri County ni koro yot yudo passport kokalo kuom chenro mag sirkal.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges youth in Vihiga County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu ugu baaqay dhalinyarada degmada Vihiga inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo rowere man e County mar Vihiga mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto gikwongo tiyogo ka pok gichako timo tije mag sirkal.

English: The free launch of body test sports among their employees
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa bure wa michezo ya majaribio ya mwili miongoni mwa wafanyakazi wao
Somali: Bilaabidda bilaashka ah ee ciyaaraha tijaabada jirka ee shaqaalahooda
Dholuo: Ochako tuke mag timo pim mag ringruok maonge chudo e kind jotichgi

English: Ministry of Health encourages residents of Wajir County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay la xiriiraan lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth jiwo jogweng' mar Wajir County mondo kik gisandre gi muol kendo gitem manyo jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Meru (Meru-North) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Meru (Meru-Kaskazini): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2023
Somali: Degmada Meru (Meru-Waqooyi): War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Agoosto 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Meru (Meru-Nyath): Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Agost 2023

English: Kenya | Complex Emergency - 6 Month Operational Update - MDRKE068
Kiswahili: Kenya | Dharura Changamano - Usasishaji wa Uendeshaji wa Miezi 6 - MDRKE068
Somali: Kenya | Xaalad Degdeg ah oo Adag - Cusboonaysiinta Hawlgalka 6 Bilood - MDRKE068
Dholuo: Kenya | Masira mapek - Dweche 6 mag Tich - MDRKE068

English: Notice: KTDA will conduct a modern irrigation techniques workshop for farmers in West Pokot County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itafanya warsha ya kisasa ya mbinu za umwagiliaji kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah ee beeraleyda gobolka West Pokot bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Rapar: KTDA biro timo tiegruok mar yore mag ywayo pi ne jopur e West Pokot County e dwe mar Februar.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development encourages out-of-school children in Turkana County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Turkana inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee fasallada akhrista dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo nyithindo maok dhi e skul e County mar Turkana mondo odonj e program mar somo kod somo mar joma dongo.

English: EACC reminds residents of Laikipia County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia in helitaanka adeegyada baasaboorka ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: EACC parone jogweng' mar Laikipia County ni koro yot yudo passport services kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: NTSA urges the community in Kakamega County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb carjacking.
Kiswahili: NTSA inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia utekaji nyara wa gari.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada Gobolka Kakamega inay ka warbixiyaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo shaki leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo afduubka gawaarida.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo oganda man Kakamega County mondo ochiw ripot mar gik ma chando ji e stesen mar polise man machiegni mondo gikwed kwalo mtokni.

English: NDMA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Laikipia County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kwamba upatikanaji wa maelekezo ya makazi salama unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee Gobolka Laikipia in helitaanka tixraacyada magangelyo ammaan ah la heli karo lacag la'aan.
Dholuo: NDMA paronwa jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu motudore gi dichwo gi dhako e County mar Laikipia ni thuolo mar yudo kuonde mag dak ma onge tuoche yudore nono.

English: Kenya Gazette updates residents of Bomet County on progress of the county integrated development plan this January.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawasilisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja ya kaunti hii Januari.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Bomet ku wargeliyay horumarka qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette osemiyo jood county mar Bomet ong'eyo dongruok mar chenro mar dongruok mar county e dwe mar Januar.

English: KRA encourages first-time voters in Trans Nzoia County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: KRA inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: KRA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha ugu horreeya ee degmada Trans Nzoia inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo jogo matimoga yiero mokwongo e Trans Nzoia County mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi kata pasipoti e odiechieng'no mar timo yiero.

English: Ministry of Education reminds schools in Lamu County to strengthen anti-bullying measures this October.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuimarisha hatua za kupambana na uonevu Oktoba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa dib u xasuusineysa dugsiyada degmada Lamu inay xoojiyaan tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibta bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok oparo ne skunde mag Lamu County mondo omed jiwo yore mag geng'o nindruok e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Bungoma County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the October planting season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Wanyama inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa za kukabiliana na ukame kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Oktoba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Bungoma inay qaataan noocyo abuurka ah oo abaarta u adkaysta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development nyiso jopur mag Bungoma County mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochopo dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in ilaalinta ciidda ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board parone jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County ni rito lowo miyo puodho bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: The Astellas Global Health Foundation Provides $2.6 Million in New Funding to Address Urgent Health Needs in Africa, South America, and the Middle East
Kiswahili: Wakfu wa Afya wa Kimataifa wa Astellas Watoa Dola Milioni 2.6 katika Ufadhili Mpya wa Kushughulikia Mahitaji ya Haraka ya Kiafya barani Afrika, Amerika Kusini, na Mashariki ya Kati.
Somali: Hay'adda Astellas Global Health Foundation waxay bixisaa $2.6 Milyan oo maalgelin cusub ah si wax looga qabto baahiyaha caafimaad ee degdegga ah ee ka jira Afrika, Koonfurta Ameerika, iyo Bariga Dhexe.
Dholuo: Oganda ma Astellas ma rito thieth e piny mangima chiwo dola milion 2.6 mag pesa manyien mondo ochop dwaro mapiyo mag thieth e Afrika, Amerka ma milambo, kod Wuokchieng’ ma Diere

English: State Department for Basic Education encourages residents of Busia County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kukaa na habari juu ya ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education ojiwo ji duto modak e county mar Busia mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar jopiny mondo ging'e kaka ji biro tiyo gi bajet mar county.

English: COMESA advises farmers in Mandera County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the July planting season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera kufanya mazoezi ya kugeuza mazao ili kurejesha uzazi wa udongo kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Julai.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Degmada Mandera inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagyada si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda ka hor xilliga beeritaanka July.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e gweng ' mar Mandera mondo otim lokruok e puothe mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak kapok ochopo dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Busia County that access to free medical camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za matibabu bila malipo sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Busia in helitaanka xeryaha caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji duto e County mar Busia ni koro ginyalo yudo kuonde thieth maonge chudo e kuonde moketi.

English: IPOA reminds the public in Kwale County to remain vigilant on border security.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kwale inay ka feejignaadaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa ji duto e county mar Kwale mondo gibed motang' gi weche mag sirkal.

English: Their group's progress is stirring interest from other community members, inspiring them to learn from the Kariamakeris Women's group.
Kiswahili: Maendeleo ya kikundi chao yanachochea shauku kutoka kwa wanajamii wengine, na kuwatia moyo kujifunza kutoka kwa kikundi cha Wanawake cha Kariamakeris.
Somali: Horumarka kooxdoodu wuxuu kicinayaa xiisaha xubnaha kale ee bulshada, taasoo ku dhiirrigelinaysa inay wax ka bartaan kooxda Haweenka Kariamakeris.
Dholuo: Dhi nyime mar grup margi kelo gombo kuom jokanyo mamoko mag kanyo, kendo miyo gibedo gi gombo mar puonjore kowuok kuom grup mar Mon mar Kariamakeris.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free Rift Valley Fever screening is available at all public health centres in Mandera County this February.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera Februari hii.
Somali: Shirkadda SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka Cudurka Rift Valley ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadwaynaha ee Degmada Mandera bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji ni nonro mar Rift Valley Fever maonge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County Mandera e dwe mar Februar.

English: HELB advises applicants in Baringo County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: HELB inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Baringo kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: HELB waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Baringo inay dalbadaan booska TVET ee KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e gweng' mar Baringo mondo oketgi e tiegruok mar TVET kokalo kuom KUCCPS.

English: Kenya Red Cross advises residents of Narok County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Laanta Cas ee Kenya waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Narok inay haystaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi maber sama gidwaro thieth mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: KEPHIS encourages farmers in Machakos County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for fish.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini ya uhakika ili kupata bei bora ya samaki.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Machakos inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo kalluunka ah.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Machakos mondo oti gi nengo mar rech e yo maber moloyo.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Medical Association will be held in Homa Bay County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa gobolka Homa Bay bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma Kenya Medical Association ochano ibiro tim Homa Bay County e dwe mar Jun.

English: UNDP Unveils Digital Public Infrastructure Portfolio and Signs MOU to Drive Inclusive Digital Transformation
Kiswahili: UNDP Yafichua Mkoba wa Miundombinu ya Umma ya Kidijitali na Kutia sahihi MOU ili Kuendesha Ubadilishaji Jumuishi wa Dijitali
Somali: UNDP oo soo bandhigtay faylalka kaabayaasha bulshada ee dijitaalka ah waxayna saxiixday heshiis is-afgarad si loo dardargeliyo isbeddelka dijitaalka ah ee loo dhan yahay
Dholuo: UNDP Ogolo Oboke mar Gedo mag Dijital kendo Oketo Siende Mou mar Kelo Lokruok mar Dijital ma oriwo ji duto

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public that free suicide prevention support is available through county health facilities in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kuzuia kujiua unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo ka hortagga ismiidaaminta laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Vihiga County.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar geng'o ji kik donjre yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Vihiga.

English: IPOA warns residents of Vihiga County to prepare for possible drought this January.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kujiandaa kwa ukame unaowezekana Januari hii.
Somali: IPOA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay u diyaar garoobaan abaaraha iman kara bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: IPOA osiemo jogweng' mar Vihiga County mondo oikre ne oro ma nyalo betie e dwe mar Januar.

English: TSC encourages residents of Meru County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: TSC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabtaan wareejinta.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Meru mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto giseyudo mondo ging'e weche duto ma biro timore.

English: Notice: KUCCPS opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay furaysaa codsiyada deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan ardayda ku jira degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KUCCPS oseyawo kwayo mag somo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e gweng' mar Kisii.

English: Measles jab drive: Immunization drive to focus on children aged between 9-18 months
Kiswahili: Kichocheo cha chanjo dhidi ya surua: Kichocheo cha chanjo kitalenga watoto wenye umri kati ya miezi 9-18
Somali: Dhiirrigelinta tallaalka: Immunization drive si loo diiradda saaro carruurta da'doodu u dhaxayso 9-18 bilood
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar nyol: riwo mar thiedho nyithindo ma hikgi nie kind dweche 9 kod 18

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association confirms a meningitis outbreak alert for Kakamega County. Residents are advised to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya chathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa uti wa mgongo katika Kaunti ya Kakamega. Wakazi wanashauriwa kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xaqiijiyay digniin ku saabsan cudurka meningitis ee Gobolka Kakamega. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Medical Association osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuo mar meningitis e Kaunti mar Kakamega.

English: Art, music, and writing provide powerful, nonverbal avenues for processing complex emotions and fostering mental clarity. These creative outlets can serve as effective tools for emotional regulation and psychological well-being.
Kiswahili: Sanaa, muziki, na uandishi hutoa njia zenye nguvu, zisizo za maneno za kushughulikia hisia tata na kukuza uwazi wa kiakili. Njia hizi za ubunifu zinaweza kutumika kama zana bora za udhibiti wa kihisia na ustawi wa kisaikolojia.
Somali: Farshaxanka, muusikada, iyo qorista waxay bixiyaan habab xoog leh oo aan hadal ahayn oo lagu maareeyo shucuurta adag iyo kor u qaadista caddaaladda maskaxda.
Dholuo: Tic ki diro, wer, ki coyo waraga miyowa yo maber me tic ki cwiny ma rwatte ki jami ma watye kwede ki i cwinywa kacel ki yo me cuko cwinywa.

English: To mass-trap mango fruit flies, cut a plastic bottle in half, fill the lower half with fermented fruit juice, invert the top half as a funnel into it, and hang at least 10 traps per 100 square metres in the lower canopy of mango and guava trees - this only works if farmers in the area do it together.
Kiswahili: Ili kunasa nzi wa matunda ya embe, kata chupa ya plastiki katikati, jaza nusu ya chini na juisi ya matunda iliyochacha, geuza nusu ya juu kama faneli ndani yake, na utundike angalau mitego 10 kwa mita za mraba 100 kwenye dari ya chini ya miti ya embe na mapera - hii inafanya kazi tu ikiwa wakulima katika eneo hilo watafanya pamoja.
Somali: Si aad u qabato duqsiyada miraha mango-ga, dhalo caag ah kala gooy, qaybta hoose ku buuxi casiirka miraha khamiirka ah, badhka sare u rog sida tuulo, ugu yaraan 10 dabinno 100 mitir laba jibbaaran ah geedaha hoose ee geedaha mango iyo guava - tani waxay shaqaysaa oo kaliya haddii beeraleyda deegaanka ay wada sameeyaan.
Dholuo: Mondo ng'ato omak yadh mango, ng'ad piende mag plastik e bathgi ariyo, opong'gi gi pi mar yadh mang'we ng'ich, olorgi gi piende ma nigi suya, kendo ogurgi gi yadh mang'we ng'ich ma malo, kendo ogurgi gi yadh 10 e mita 100 kargi e bwo yiende mag mango kod guava.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya launches ward-level service delivery in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inazindua huduma za huduma katika wilaya ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu bilaabay bixinta adeegyada heerka qaybta ee Gobolka Laikipia.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya ochako chiwo kony e alwora mar Laikipia County.

English: KALRO announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Machakos County this May.
Kiswahili: KALRO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Machakos Mei hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee lo'da caanaha ah ee Degmada Machakos bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: KALRO ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok ma nigi dhogi gi dhogi maonge chudo e dwe mar abich e kaunti mar Machakos.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges motorists and pedestrians in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya gawaarida iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay guryahooda ku rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dabka daminta iyo inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa dhacdooyinka la xiriira qaraxyada dabka.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo dereche mag mtoka kod jowuoth e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo gitim kinda mar geng'o hinyruok mag mach.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations launches a burglary prevention campaign in Kericho County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Kericho Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa bilaabay olole ka hortagga tuugada degmada Kericho bishii Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Mumbni mag Criminal Investigations chako kampen mar geng'o jokuoge odonj e boma mar Kericho e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: CDC appeals to caregivers in Lamu County to visit their nearest maternity wing as part of the May maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Lamu kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Mei.
Somali: CDC waxay u baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Lamu inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ugu dhow qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee bisha Maajo.
Dholuo: CDC kwayo jorit e County mar Lamu mondo olimgi machiegni gi kama giyudoe nyithindo e dwe mar Mei.

English: CDC launches an August awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Agosti juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: CDC waxay bilowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Agoosto oo ku saabsan baaritaanka sonkorowga ee gobolka Nyamira.
Dholuo: CDC chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Agost e wi thieth mar sukari e County duto mar Nyamira.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will distribute certified maize seed to farmers in Nyeri County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu za mahindi zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu abuurka hadhuudhka ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doonaa beeraleyda degmada Nyeri bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro pogo kodhi mag kodhi mar kodhi ne jopur manie County mar Nyeri e dwe mar Novemba.

English: DPP urges the public in Kiambu County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: DPP inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: DPP waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadweynaha degmada Kiambu inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aanay wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo ji duto e County mar Kiambu mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma ne oland kuom weche mag phishing.

English: Huduma Kenya invites residents of Siaya County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya gwelo ji modak e county mar Siaya mondo ochiw weche mondik motudore gi nonro mar tich mitimo higa ka higa kapok ndalo ochopo.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages residents of Baringo County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay u dhiiri galiyaan saaxiibka dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit jiwo jogweng' Baringo County mondo kik gisandre gi muol kendo mondo gijiw osiepgi moro ma chandore omany kony.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by CDC will be held in Mombasa County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya bure ya matibabu iliyoandaliwa na CDC itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabiyeen CDC ayaa lagu qaban doonaa gobolka Mombasa bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kampen mar thieth ma onge chudo ma CDC ochano biro timore e County mar Mombasa e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Communications Authority has launched a hotline for reporting impersonation scams involving fake mobile providers. Dial 0800 222 777 to report.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano imezindua simu ya dharura kwa ajili ya kuripoti ulaghai wa uigaji unaohusisha watoa huduma bandia za simu. Piga 0800 222 777 ili kuripoti.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ayaa bilowday khad taleefan oo loogu talagalay soo sheegidda khiyaamooyinka been abuurka ah ee ku lug leh shirkadaha moobaylka ee been abuurka ah. Wac 0800 222 777 si aad u soo sheegto.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Tudruok osechako namba mar lando wach mar wuondore ma oriwo jogo ma chiwo simu ma miriambo. Goyo namba 0800 222 777 mondo igol ripot.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya launches a burglary prevention campaign in Kiambu County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga jabsashada degmada Kiambu bishii November.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chako kampen mar geng'o jokuoge odonj e boma mar Kiambu e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Huduma Kenya invites residents of Bungoma County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya gwelo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: Notice: Council of Governors launches the county integrated development plan in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika wilaya ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa bilaabay qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Jaloch chako chenro mar dongruok e alwora mar Lamu County.

English: Notice: COMESA restricts movement of goats in Narok County due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA inazuia harakati za mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Narok kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Newcastle.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa riyaha ee Gobolka Narok sababo la xiriira cudurka Newcastle.
Dholuo: Rieko: COMESA ogeng'o wuoth mar diek e County Narok nikech tuo mar Newcastle.

English: In settings where complications can go unrecognized and timely care is often out of reach, skilled support can mean the difference between life and death.
Kiswahili: Katika mazingira ambapo matatizo yanaweza kwenda bila kutambuliwa na huduma ya wakati mara nyingi haipatikani, usaidizi wenye ujuzi unaweza kumaanisha tofauti kati ya maisha na kifo.
Somali: Meelaha ay dhibaatooyinku ka dhici karaan iyagoon la aqoonsan oo daryeelka waqtigiisu socdo badanaa aan la gaari karin, taageerada xirfadda leh waxay macnaheedu noqon kartaa farqiga u dhexeeya nolosha iyo dhimashada.
Dholuo: E kuonde ma pek nyalo bedoe ma ok ong’ere kendo ma kinde mang’eny ok nyalre rito ng’ato e kinde mowinjore, konyo ma nigi lony nyalo nyiso pogruok e kind ngima kod tho.

English: Notice: KNEC announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KNEC olando tarik mag somo mar pinyruoth ma onge chudo e skunde mag Wajir County.

English: Notice: KUCCPS launches a school infrastructure safety programme in schools across Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS yazindua mpango wa usalama wa miundombinu ya shule katika shule kote Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay bilawday barnaamij ku saabsan badbaadada kaabayaasha dugsiga ee dugsiyada gobolka Nyeri.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KUCCPS chako chenro mar rito kuonde tiegruok mag skul e skunde duto mag Nyeri County.

English: ODPP urges residents of Kitui County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay si loo qaabeeyo wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogweng'o mag Kitui County mondo ochiw paro mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso chenro mag chenro mag sirkal.

English: Notice: KMTC opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay furaysaa codsiyada deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay ardayda u baahan ardayda ku jira gobolka Mombasa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC oyawo kwayo mag yudo riekni mag somo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e county mar Mombasa.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free depression awareness support is available through county health facilities in Embu County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa uhamasishaji wa unyogovu unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay wacyiga niyadjabku laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Embu County.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar parruok yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Embu.

English: Nonprofit CFK Africa Raises Funds to Aid Tradesmen Displaced by Toi Market Fire in Kenya
Kiswahili: Shirika lisilo la faida la CFK Africa Yachangisha Pesa Kuwasaidia Wafanyabiashara Waliohamishwa na Toi Market Fire nchini Kenya
Somali: Hay'adda aan faa'iido doonka ahayn ee CFK Africa ayaa lacag u ururisay ganacsatada ku barakacay dabkii ka kacay suuqa Toi ee Kenya.
Dholuo: CFK Afrika ma ok yudo ohala, ochoko pesa mar konyo jo ohala ma oweyo udigi nikech mach ma ne owang' e chiro mar Toi e piny Kenya

English: DCI reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Homa Bay County that access to psychosocial support is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisaikolojia unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay gobolka Homa Bay in helitaanka taageerada cilmu-nafsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: DCI parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag nindruok e Homa Bay County ni ginyalo yudo kony mar paro maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges residents of Kisumu County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama katikati ya tahadhari kubwa ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Forest Service jiwo jogweng' mar Kisumu County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e alwora mar tong'gi nikech ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom loso kuwe e piny.

English: Notice: KNEC launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay bilawday barnaamij lagu darayo ardayda naafada ah dugsiyada gobolka Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KNEC chako chenro mar tiego nyithindo ma nigi midekre e skunde duto mag Trans Nzoia County.

English: State Department for TVET advises applicants in Baringo County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Baringo kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Baringo inay dalbadaan booska TVET iyada oo loo marayo KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e baringo county mondo okonygi gi KUCCPS mondo giyud thuolo mar dhi e tiegruok mar TVET.

English: Africa Zero Hunger: The empowering journey of Mtakuja's women farmers
Kiswahili: Africa Zero Hunger: Safari ya kuwawezesha wanawake wakulima wa Mtakuja
Somali: Gaajada Afrika oo aan la saadaalin karin: Safarka awoodsiinta leh ee beeralayda haweenka ah ee Mtakuja
Dholuo: Afrika Onge Kech: Safar mar miyo mon ma jopur mag Mtakuja teko

English: KICD reminds schools in Nandi County to strengthen school infrastructure safety this July.
Kiswahili: KICD inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuimarisha usalama wa miundombinu ya shule Julai hii.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Nandi inay xoojiyaan ammaanka kaabayaasha dugsiga bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne skunde man Nandi County mondo omed jiwo ritruok mar chenro mag skul e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: NDMA conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Uasin Gishu County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ku saabsan dhismaha nabadda qaranka ee gobolka Uasin Gishu bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA timo romo mar oganda e wi loso kuwe e piny mangima e county mar Uasin Gishu e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: IEBC opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa codsiyada deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay ardayda u baahan ardayda ku jira gobolka Nyamira.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC oyawo kwayo mag somo ne jopuonjre ma nigi dwaro mag somo e kaunti mar Nyamira.

English: SHA reminds the public in West Pokot County that input on development planning forums is welcome this May.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kwamba maoni juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo yanakaribishwa Mei hii.
Somali: Shirkadda SHA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka West Pokot in talooyinka ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha May.
Dholuo: SHA oparo ne ji duto e West Pokot County ni ji mor ahinya gi weche ma gichiwo e wi chenro mag dongruok e dwe mar Mei.

English: KALRO urges tea growers in Kisumu County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Kisumu inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si kor loogu qaado wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e gweng' mar Kisumu mondo okaw kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed nyak e higani.

English: Kenya now faces both flood emergency and drought crisis, country braces for cholera risk
Kiswahili: Kenya sasa inakabiliwa na dharura ya mafuriko na janga la ukame, nchi inajiandaa kwa hatari ya kipindupindu
Somali: Kenya hadda waxay wajahaysaa xaalad degdeg ah oo daadad iyo abaar ah, iyadoo dalka uu isku diyaarinayo khatarta daacuunka
Dholuo: Kenya sani yudo masira mag pi mang'eny kod oro, pinyno ikruok mar geng'o luoro mar kolera

English: Makueni County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for November 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Makueni: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Novemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Makueni: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Noofambar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Makueni: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2022

English: NPS alerts residents of Makueni County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: NPS waxay dadka deggan degmada Makueni uga digtay kororka kiisaska tuugada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: NPS chiwo siem ne jogweng' Makueni County kuom wach kwan mar joma okwalo gik moko kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Homa Bay County this February. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Februari hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa qaban doonta madasha caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada ee gobolka Homa Bay bishii Febraayo. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo romo mar paro ne rowere e Homa Bay County e dwe mar Februar.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on the community in Kajiado County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawaita watu wa Kajiado County wazungumze dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa bulshada degmada Kajiado ugu baaqaya inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga iyo inay taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oluongo oganda man Kajiado County ni mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Notice: SHA opens voter registration centres in Trans Nzoia County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: SHA inafungua vituo vya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA waxay furaysaa xarumaha diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee degmada Trans Nzoia bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: SHA chako timo chenro mar ndiko joma biro yiero e county mar Trans Nzoia e dwe mar Julai.

English: KICD prioritizes the development of inclusive digital learning resources for all learners.
Kiswahili: KICD inaweka kipaumbele maendeleo ya rasilimali za kujifunza za dijiti zinazojumuisha kwa wanafunzi wote.
Somali: KICD waxay mudnaanta u siineysaa horumarinta kheyraadka barashada dhijitaalka ah ee ka kooban dhammaan ardayda.
Dholuo: KICD keto motelo dongruok mar yore mag puonjruok mag digital ma oriwo ji duto.

English: Notice: IEBC reminds citizens in Samburu County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Samburu xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC paronwa jogweng' kaunti mar Samburu kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar miyo ji duto thuolo mar tiyo gi bajet mar county.

English: CDC encourages mothers in Busia County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Busia kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Busia inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta caafimaad ee la qorsheeyay si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo mine manie county mar Busia mondo odhi e odiechieng'no mar thieth mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: NCPB reminds farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Somali: NCPB waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada.
Dholuo: NCPB oparo ne jopur e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche.

English: KUCCPS reminds schools in Makueni County to strengthen school infrastructure safety this July.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuimarisha usalama wa miundombinu ya shule Julai hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Makueni inay xoojiyaan ammaanka kaabayaasha dugsiga bisha July.
Dholuo: KUCCPS parone skunde mag Makueni County mondo omed jiwo ritruok mar chenro mag skul e dwe mar Julai.

English: 5-step game plan to defeat coronavirus Please wash your hands frequently. Pleaae cover your nose & mouth if you sneeze or cough Avoid touching your eyes , nose & mouth Keep 1 metre distance from everyone that coughs If you feel unwell, stay home #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Mpango wa mchezo wa hatua 5 wa kushinda coronavirus Tafadhali osha mikono yako mara kwa mara. Tafadhali funika pua na mdomo ukipiga chafya au kukohoa Epuka kugusa macho, pua na mdomo Weka umbali wa mita 1 kutoka kwa kila anayekohoa Kama unajisikia vibaya, kaa nyumbani #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Qorshe ciyaar oo 5-tallaabo ah si looga hortago coronavirus Fadlan gacmahaaga si joogto ah u dhaq. Fadlan dabool sankaaga iyo afkaaga haddii aad hindhisto ama aad qufacdo. Ka fogow taabashada indhahaaga, sankaaga iyo afkaaga. 1 mitir u jir qof kasta oo qufaca. Haddii aad dareento xanuun, guriga joog #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Chenro mar tugo manigi okang' 5 mar loyo korona Yie mondo ilok lweteni kinde ka kinde. <2Zepa> Yie mondo uum um kod dhok ka igolo ng’ich kata igolo ng’ich Kik imulo wang’i , um kod dhok mari.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission opens a new welding and fabrication programme at the vocational centre in Embu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yafungua programu mpya ya kulehemu na utengenezaji katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ka furayaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan alxanka iyo soo saarista xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Embu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj chako chenro manyien mar loso kendo loso gik moko e kambi mar tiegruok e county mar Embu.

English: Notice: NDMA conducts a community briefing on community early-warning systems in Kilifi County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada oo ku saabsan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada ee degmada Kilifi bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA timo romo mar oganda e wi chenro mag chiwo siem motelo e gweng' mar Kilifi e dwe mar Septemba.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Samburu County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Samburu in warbixinta khiyaamooyinka si dhakhso leh ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NTSA parone jogweng' Samburu County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar wuond konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development advises students in Nandi County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nandi kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mkondoni ili kupata yaliyomo kwenye ujifunzaji wa dijiti bila malipo.
Somali: Machadka Horumarinta Manhajka Kenya wuxuu ardayda degmada Nandi kula talinayaa inay dalbadaan bogga deeqda waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan waxyaabaha barashada digitalka ah ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development nyiso jopuonjre e county mar Nandi mondo okonygi kokalo kuom websait mar somo mar intanet mondo giyud somo mar digital maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges the public in Nyamira County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Kenya Red Cross inawasihi watu katika Kaunti ya Nyamira wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya mashtaka ya ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa shacabka degmada Nyamira inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ojiwo ji duto e County mar Nyamira ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo weche ma nyiso ni ne giyudo ote mag phishing.

English: NDMA calls on the community in Narok County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatia moyo jamii katika Kaunti ya Narok kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka kwa nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Somali: NDMA waxay bulshada degmada Narok ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: NDMA luongo oganda man Narok County mondo owuo e wi timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo manyo kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges sweet potatoes growers in West Pokot County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawahimiza wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda baradho macaan ee Gobolka West Pokot inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalaalka ciidda si loo hagaajiyo goosashada xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur ma pidho olemo mag sweet potato e West Pokot County mondo otim lokruok e puothe mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: KEMSA announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Murang'a County starting this March.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kuanzia Machi hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa in laga bilaabo bishii Maarso ee soo socota la siinayo dadka deggan degmada Murang'a.
Dholuo: KEMSA olando thieth mar dialysis kuom joma odak e County mar Murang'a kochakore dwe mar Mach.

English: Over three million people are still facing Crisis or Emergency levels of hunger, malnutrition rates remain critically high among children and pregnant and lactating women, and fragile livelihoods have not recovered.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya watu milioni tatu bado wanakabiliwa na Mgogoro au viwango vya Dharura vya njaa, viwango vya utapiamlo vimesalia kuwa juu sana miongoni mwa watoto na wanawake wajawazito na wanaonyonyesha, na maisha duni hayajapona.
Somali: In ka badan saddex milyan oo qof ayaa weli wajahaya heer gaajo oo degdeg ah ama xaalad degdeg ah, heerarka nafaqo-xumada ayaa weli aad ugu sarreeya carruurta iyo haweenka uurka leh iyo kuwa nuujinaya, iyo hab-nololeedka nugul ma soo kaban.
Dholuo: Ji mokalo milion adek pod yudo kech ma kelo masira kata ma kelo masira, kwan mar joma ok yudo chiemo ma ok owinjore pod ni malo ahinya e kind nyithindo kod mon ma nigi ich kod ma miyo nyithindo matin, kendo ngima ma ok tek pok odok maber.

English: "It is not enough to send them messages, it must be accompanied with a lot of hard work like driving many kilometres on a bad roads to get people vaccinated." Engaging local communities to support the COVID-19 response and accept the vaccine has been a core part of how the government, with WHO inputs, has worked to protect the country.
Kiswahili: "Haitoshi kuwatumia ujumbe, lazima iambatane na kazi ngumu kama vile kuendesha kilomita nyingi kwenye barabara mbovu ili kupata watu chanjo." Kushirikisha jumuiya za wenyeji kuunga mkono mwitikio wa COVID-19 na kukubali chanjo imekuwa sehemu ya msingi ya jinsi serikali, ikiwa na pembejeo za WHO, imefanya kazi kulinda nchi.
Somali: "Kuma filna in loo diro farriimo, waa inay la socotaa shaqo adag sida wadista kiiloomitir badan oo waddooyin xun lagu maro si dadka loo tallaalo." Ka qaybgalka bulshooyinka maxalliga ah si loo taageero jawaabta COVID-19 iyo aqbalaadda tallaalka ayaa qayb muhiim ah ka ahayd sida dawladdu, iyadoo WHO ay wax ka qabatay, ay uga shaqaysay ilaalinta dalka.
Dholuo: Ok oromo mana orogi ote, nyaka odhi kanyakla gi tich matek mang'eny kaka riembo gari kilomita mang'eny e yore ma ok beyo mondo ji oyud chanjo. Keto jodak mag alwora mondo okony dwoko mar COVID-19 kendo yie gi chanjo osebedo achiel kuom kaka sirkal, ka otiyo gi paro mag WHO, osetiyo mar rito piny.

English: Farmers and agribusinesses should prepare for increased onion imports from Tanzania as border trade activities resume between Kenya and Tanzania
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wafanyabiashara wa kilimo wajiandae kwa ongezeko la uagizaji wa vitunguu kutoka Tanzania huku shughuli za biashara ya mpakani kati ya Kenya na Tanzania zikiendelea.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo ganacsiga beeraleyda waa inay isu diyaariyaan soo dejinta basasha ee ka imanaysa Tanzania maadaama hawlaha ganacsiga xuduudaha ee u dhexeeya Kenya iyo Tanzania dib u bilaabanaya
Dholuo: Jo-Purcho gi jo ohala mag agro-go onego oikre ne medruok mar ohala mar adundo moa Tanzania kaka tij ohala e tong'o chakore kendo e kind Kenya gi Tanzania

English: Such activities can be included with the push-pull technology where antelopes are...Science and technology in animal feeds, 18
Kiswahili: Shughuli kama hizo zinaweza kujumuishwa na teknolojia ya kushinikiza-kuvuta ambapo antelopes ni...Sayansi na teknolojia katika malisho ya wanyama, 18
Somali: Waxqabadyada noocan oo kale ah waxaa lagu dari karaa tikniyoolajiyadda riixinta iyo jiidista halkaas oo antelopes ay yihiin... Sayniska iyo tiknoolajiyada quudinta xayawaanka, 18
Dholuo: Tije ma kamago inyalo tigo e tiyo gi teknoloji mar push-pull to mano nyiso ni ng'ato nyalo tiyo gi...Science and technology in animal feeds, 18

English: NPS urges the public in Nyeri County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: NPS inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: NPS waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadweynaha degmada Nyeri inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo ji duto e County mar Nyeri mondo ochiw ripot mar ote mamulo pachgi ne jatendgi mar tich bang' yudo ripode mag wuond gi SIM-swap.

English: Those in quarantine are advised to keep physical distance #KomeshaCorona update
Kiswahili: Walio kwenye karantini wanashauriwa kuweka umbali wa kimwili #KomeshaCorona update
Somali: Dadka karantiilka ku jira waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ilaaliyaan kala fogaanshaha jirka #Warbixinta KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Jogo mantie e kar kwanten golo rieko mar rito mabor gi jowetegi # KomeshaCorona update

English: Apply for the KSh 2 2 billion ENABLE Kenya agribusiness fund to receive interest free loans and training designed to empower 10 000 youths in agribusiness
Kiswahili: Tuma ombi la KSh 2 2 bilioni WEZESHA hazina ya kilimo cha Kenya kupokea mikopo na mafunzo bila riba yaliyoundwa kuwawezesha vijana 10,000 katika biashara ya kilimo.
Somali: Codso sanduuqa KSh 2 2 bilyan ee ENABLE Kenya agribusiness si aad u hesho deyn dulsaar la'aan ah iyo tababaro loogu talagalay in lagu xoojiyo 10,000 dhalinyaro ah oo ku jira ganacsiga beeraha
Dholuo: Kwa mondo omiyi kony mar yudo pesa ma ok ochulo ohala kod tiegruok ma konyo rowere 10,000 e weche mag ohala

English: NCPB urges coffee growers in Laikipia County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Laikipia inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si kor loogu qaado wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e county mar Laikipia mondo okaw kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo okony e medo nyak mar koth e higani.

English: The rise of Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) in Kenya represents a shift toward a more practical and inclusive approach to education. By focusing on skills development that directly responds to the needs of the labor market, TVET programs are helping to bridge the gap between education and employment, reduce youth unemployment, and drive economic growth.
Kiswahili: Kuongezeka kwa elimu na mafunzo ya kiufundi na kitaaluma (TVET) nchini Kenya inawakilisha mabadiliko kuelekea njia ya mazoezi na ya pamoja zaidi ya elimu. Kwa kuzingatia maendeleo ya ujuzi ambayo yanajibu moja kwa moja mahitaji ya soko la kazi, programu za TVET zinasaidia kuziba pengo kati ya elimu na ajira, kupunguza ukosefu wa ajira kati ya vijana, na kuendesha ukuaji wa uchumi.
Somali: Kordhinta waxbarashada farsamada iyo xirfadaha iyo tababarka (TVET) ee Kenya waxay ka dhigan tahay isbeddel ku aaddan habka waxbarasho ee wax ku oolka ah oo ka mid ah. Iyada oo diiradda la saarayo horumarinta xirfadaha oo si toos ah uga jawaabaya baahiyaha suuqa shaqada, barnaamijyada TVET waxay gacan ka geystaan buuxinta farqiga u dhexeeya waxbarashada iyo shaqada, yareynta shaqo la'aanta dhalinyarada, iyo koritaanka dhaqaalaha.
Dholuo: Medruok mar tiegruok e weche mag teknoloji kod tich (TVET) e piny Kenya ochung'ne lokruok ma timore e yore mag tiego ji e yo makare kendo moriwo ji duto. Kuom keto pachgi kuom dongruok mar lony ma nyalo chopo dwaro mag ohala, program mag TVET konyo e tieko pogruok mantie e kind somo kod tich, tieko yuto mar rowere, kendo jiwo dongruok mar ohala.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages mothers in Taita-Taveta County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Taita-Taveta inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta bukaanka ee la qorsheeyay si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo mine manie Taita-Taveta County mondo odhi e odiechienge mag thieth mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: ODPP reminds the public in Nairobi County that reporting embezzlement of public funds is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa fedha za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Nairobi in warbixinta xadgudubka lacagta dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: ODPP oparo ne ji duto e County mar Nairobi ni lando miriambo mag pesa mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Universities Fund reminds needy students in West Pokot County that free digital learning content applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kwamba maombi ya bure ya maudhui ya ujifunzaji wa kidijitali yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xasuusinayaa ardayda u baahan degmada West Pokot in codsiyada barashada bilaashka ah ee barnaamijyada ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa jopuonjre man West Pokot County ma nigi chan ni chenro mag somo ma onge chudo mar digital biro rumo machiegni.

English: Announcement of multi-sector collaboration to support school nutrition and small-scale dairy livelihoods through public procurement.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la ushirikiano wa sekta mbalimbali ili kusaidia lishe shuleni na riziki ndogo za maziwa kupitia ununuzi wa umma.
Somali: Ogeysiis iskaashi dhowr qaybood ah si loo taageero nafaqada dugsiyada iyo nolosha caanaha yaryar iyada oo loo marayo iibsashada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar pinje mang'eny biro timo chenro mar konyo e siro chiemo ma yudore e skunde kod ngima mar nyithindo matindo e yore mag loso chak kokalo kuom chenro mag loso gik moko.

English: Members pool savings to provide micro-loans, share skills and provide mutual social support, providing a vital vehicle for financial inclusion and poverty reduction in many communities.
Kiswahili: Wanachama hukusanya akiba ili kutoa mikopo midogo midogo, ujuzi wa kubadilishana na kutoa usaidizi wa kijamii, kutoa chombo muhimu cha ushirikishwaji wa kifedha na kupunguza umaskini katika jamii nyingi.
Somali: Xubnuhu waxay ururiyaan keydka si ay u bixiyaan amaah yar, u wadaagaan xirfadaha iyo inay bixiyaan taageero bulsho oo wadajir ah, iyagoo siinaya gaadiid muhiim u ah ka mid noqoshada maaliyadeed iyo yaraynta saboolnimada bulshooyin badan.
Dholuo: Jokanyo loso pesa ma giseting’o mondo omigi loan matindo, gipogo nyalo kendo gichiw kony mar oganda, ma miyogi yo maduong’ mar keto pesa e kindgi kendo duoko piny chandruok e alwora mang’eny.

English: Teachers Service Commission conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Samburu County this May.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Samburu Mei hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu qabtaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda gobolka ee Gobolka Samburu bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda e dwe mar abich e kaunti mar Samburu.

English: KEMSA appeals to caregivers in Tharaka-Nithi County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the May maternal health drive.

English: KTDA reminds farmers in Marsabit County of the ongoing greenhouse farming training programme.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kilimo cha chafu.

English: TSC urges parents and teachers in Kakamega County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: TSC inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.

Dholuo: KRA chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e gweng' mar Kitui kuom kawo asoya e migepe mar sirkal.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education announces school feeding programme enrollment dates for schools in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa programu ya kulisha shule kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kajiado.

Kiswahili: Tangazo kutoka Wizara ya Afya, sekta binafsi na mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali yamethibitisha kutekeleza ahadi zao za kuhakikisha vyakula vyenye ubora katika shule, masoko na utoaji nyumbani
Somali: Ogeysiis ka soo baxay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka, qaybta gaarka loo leeyahay iyo ururada aan dowliga ahayn ayaa xaqiijiyay in ay fulin doonaan ballanqaadyadooda si loo hubiyo cuntooyinka tayada leh ee iskuulada, suuqyada iyo gaarsiinta guriga

Kiswahili: DPP anawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama mara moja.

Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit nyiso ji duto modak e county mar Mombasa mondo odonj e insuarans mar thieth mondo giyud thieth makonyogi.

English: Notice: IPOA opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Narok County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa simu ya GBV ya bure katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Ogsoonow: IPOA waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ee gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA oseyawo ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo chenro mar tiyo gi simo maonge chudo mar GBV e taon mar Narok.

English: TVET invites youth in Mandera County to enroll for electrical installation training this May.
Kiswahili: TVET inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Mandera kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Mei hii.
Somali: TVET waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Mandera inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada bisha May.
Dholuo: TVET gwelo rowere man Mandera County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar keto sitima e dwe mar Mei.

English: Mandera County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for December 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Mandera: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Desemba 2023
