English: Notice: IPOA conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Kajiado County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kajiado County Julai hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: IPOA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada oo ku saabsan ka hortagga argagixisada ee Gobolka Kajiado bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA dhi timo romo mar oganda e dwe mar Julai e kaunti mar Kajiado.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Medical Association will be held in Bungoma County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu bila malipo iliyoandaliwa na Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Bungoma bisha July.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma Kenya Medical Association ochano ibiro tim e County mar Bungoma e dwe mar Julai.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds the public in Marsabit County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka degmada Marsabit ku xasuusinayaa in warbixinta khayaanada iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties paronwa ji duto manie Marsabit County ni lando miriambo mag yuto en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development encourages residents of Mandera County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera inay ka qeybgalaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadwaynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ojiwo jogweng' Mandera County mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county mondo ging'e kaka ji biro tiyo gi bajet mag county.

English: Form 1Ã¢Â€Â“4: Register as voters this week or miss 2027 elections!
Kiswahili: Kidato cha 1Ã¢Â€Â“4: Jiandikishe kama wapiga kura wiki hii au ukose uchaguzi wa 2027!

Dholuo: Fom mar 1Ã¢Â€Â“4: Ndikri kaka jogo mabiro goyo ombulu jumani kae kata kik idhi e yiero mag higa mar 2027!

English: KEPHIS reminds residents of Kirinyaga County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kirinyaga in ilaalinta ciidda ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: KEPHIS paronwa jogweng' Kirinyaga County ni rito lowo miyo puothe bedo gi nyak maber kuom kinde malach.

English: IPOA urges motorists and pedestrians in Kirinyaga County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa darawalada gawaarida iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Kirinyaga inay guryahooda rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dabka daminta iyo inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa dhacdooyinka la xiriira dabka.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo dereba mag mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Kirinyaga mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo gitim kinda mar geng'o hinyruok mag yiengni.

English: Notice: DCI activates an emergency response plan for fire outbreaks in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa milipuko ya moto katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay hirgelinaysaa qorshe falcelin deg deg ah oo ku saabsan dabka ka kacay gobolka Nandi.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DCI tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne masiche mag mach e kaunti mar Nandi.

English: KRA urges residents of Kisii County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kudai utoaji wa huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay dalbadaan bixinta adeegyada iyada oo aan la bixin laaluush si looga hortago khiyaanada iibsiga.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kisii mondo ochiw kony maok ochulo asoya mondo giked gi mibadhi.

English: NAIROBI, Kenyaâ€” Kenya is entering a decisive moment in its response to forced displacement.
Kiswahili: NAIROBI, Kenya- Kenya inaingia katika wakati madhubuti katika kukabiliana na kulazimishwa kuhama makazi yao.

Dholuo: NAIROBI, piny Kenyaâ€” Kenya donjo e kinde mapek ahinya e kaka odwoko ne ji ma ne odhi e pinygi gi teko.

English: Kenya Dairy Board invites farmers in Kilifi County to a free training on post-harvest handling this November.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kwa mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno Novemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa ku casuumay beeraleyda degmada Kilifi inay tababar lacag la'aan ah ku helaan ka dib goosashada bisha November.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board ogwelo jopur man Kilifi County e tiegruok ma onge chudo e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Public health advisory: Kenya Medical Association warns of increased typhoid risk in Bomet County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya matumbo katika Kaunti ya Bomet na kushauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Talobixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya wuxuu ka digay khatarta sii kordheysa ee cudurka 'typhoid' ee Gobolka Bomet wuxuuna ku talinayaa dadweynaha inay soo sheegaan kiisaska loo maleynayo inay u yimaadaan mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Rieko mar thieth mar ji: Kenya Medical Association chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar typhoid e county mar Bomet kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore mar konyo e thieth.

English: TVET calls on the community in Busia County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TVET inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Busia kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TVET waxay bulshada degmada Busia ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyo.
Dholuo: TVET luongo ji duto manie County mar Busia mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ngima maber e skunde.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) informs avocado farmers in Kitui County of new market linkage opportunities this November.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawafahamisha wakulima wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Novemba hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda avocado ee Gobolka Kitui fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha November.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nyiso jopur mag avocado e County mar Kitui thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Novemba.

English: DCI reminds the public in Kiambu County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jumuiya.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kiambu in ay ka feejignaadaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: DCI parone ji duto e County mar Kiambu ni gibed motang' gi chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Nairobi County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi mwezi huu Julai.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed ayaa bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee Gobolka Nairobi bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Nairobi e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds livestock keepers in West Pokot County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya xoolaha reer Galbeedka Gobolka Pokot in ay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka lo'da.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board paronwa jorit jamni e West Pokot County ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: KEMRI encourages residents of Meru County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay la xiriiraan lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng' mar Meru County mondo kik gisandre ka giling' kendo gitem manyo jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Kitui.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ka furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay ka shaqeynta shahaadada dhalashada ee Gobolka Kitui.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Sirkal mar Kenya oseyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag loso barua mag nyuol e County mar Kitui.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds mobile money users in Siaya County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Siaya wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka ujumbe wa udanganyifu.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Siaya inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarkooda M-Pesa cidna si looga fogaado fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e county mar Siaya ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo gitang' gi weche mag phishing.

English: The Nyeri ELRC is closed from 24th August to 7th September 2020 due to two confirmed COVID-19 cases, with fumigation and staff self-quarantine underway. No certificates will be processed during this period. The court will reopen for virtual hearings on 21st September, with physical hearings expected to resume under the Presiding Judge's supervision in early October.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha ELRC cha Nyeri kimefungwa kuanzia tarehe 24 Agosti hadi 7 Septemba 2020 kutokana na visa viwili vilivyothibitishwa vya COVID-19, huku dawa ya kufukiza na kujitenga kwa wafanyakazi kukiwa kunaendelea. Hakuna vyeti vitakavyoshughulikiwa katika kipindi hiki. Mahakama itafunguliwa tena kwa ajili ya vikao vya mtandaoni tarehe 21 Septemba, huku vikao vya kimwili vikitarajiwa kuanza tena chini ya usimamizi wa Jaji Mkuu mapema Oktoba.
Somali: Xarunta ELRC ee Nyeri waa la xiray laga bilaabo 24 Agoosto ilaa 7 Sebtembar 2020 sababo la xiriira laba kiis oo la xaqiijiyay oo COVID-19 ah, iyadoo la wado qalliin iyo karantiil shaqaalaha. Ma jiraan wax shahaadooyin ah oo la farsameyn doono muddadan. Maxkamaddu waxay dib u furi doontaa dhageysiga internetka 21 Sebtembar, iyadoo la filayo in dhageysiga jireed dib loo bilaabo iyadoo la raacayo kormeerka Garsooraha Guddoonka horraanta Oktoobar.
Dholuo: ELRC mar Nyeri oloro chakre tarik 24 dwe mar aboro nyaka tarik 7 dwe mar apar higa mar 2020 nikech ji ariyo ma oyudre gi tuo mar COVID-19, ka fumigation kod keto jotich e kwanten giwegi pod dhi nyime. Onge oboke ma ibiro tiyogo e kindeno. Kot biro yawo kendo mondo otim winjo bura e yor mbui tarik 21 dwe mar apar, kendo winjo bura e yor mbui biro chakore kendo e bwo rito mar Jatend Bura e chakruok mar dwe mar apar.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Isiolo County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the December planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Desemba.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Isiolo inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur manie Isiolo County mondo okaw kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochako chwoyo kodhi e dwe mar Desemba.

English: KEMSA encourages residents of Kakamega County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' Kakamega County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) opens a new service point for national ID applications in Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Garsoorka Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ka furayaa barta adeegga cusub ee codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chako tiyo gi ofis manyien mar Joneno mag Jehova e alwora mar Trans Nzoia County.

English: KEMSA launches a January awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Januari juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: KEMSA waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Janaayo oo ku saabsan wacyiga cadaadiska sare ee degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: KEMSA ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Januar e wi wach ng'eyo ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar hypertension e gweng' mar Kisumu.

Kiswahili: Kenya mkakati wa usalama wa mtandao wa kulinda miundombinu muhimu ya habari na kuongeza usalama wa umma mtandaoni.
Somali: Istaraatiijiyadda amniga internetka ee Kenya si loo ilaaliyo kaabayaasha macluumaadka muhiimka ah loona xoojiyo amniga internetka ee dadweynaha.

Kiswahili: Ilani: NPS inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Migori.

Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NPS tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne pi opong'o Migori County.

English: NTSA alerts residents of Nandi County to a rise in fraud cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za ulaghai na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: NTSA waxay dadka deggan degmada Nandi uga digtay kororka kiisaska khiyaamooyinka waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' kaunti mar Nandi e wi medruok mar weche mag wuondruok kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: IEBC urges parents and teachers in Nandi County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Nandi inay u sheegaan maamulka iskuulka wixii arrimo ah oo ku saabsan amniga.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e county mar Nandi mondo onyis sirkal mar skul wach moro amora motudore gi ritruok.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response appeals to caregivers in Vihiga County to visit their nearest maternity wing as part of the December maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Desemba.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Vihiga inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo kwayo jorit e County mar Vihiga mondo olimgi machiegni gi kama giyudoe nyithindo e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit warns of increased cholera risk in Nyeri County and advises the public to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya kipindupindu katika Kaunti ya Nyeri na kushauri umma kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa ka digtay khatarta sii kordheysa ee cudurka kolera ee degmada Nyeri waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar oganda: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osiemo ji kuom medruok mar tuo mar cholera e County mar Nyeri kendo ojiwo ji mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni kodgi.

English: Public notice: CDC will host a free food safety outreach in Kisumu County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: CDC itaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa usalama wa chakula katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: CDC waxay marti gelineysaa adeeg bilaash ah oo ku saabsan badbaadada cuntada ee degmada Kisumu bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuoche (CDC) biro timo kampen mar rito ngima mar chiemo maonge chudo e gweng' mar Kisumu e dwe mar Februar.

English: TVET calls on the community in Kwale County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TVET inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Kwale kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TVET waxay bulshada degmada Kwale ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyo.
Dholuo: TVET luongo ji duto e Kaunti mar Kwale mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Recent reductions in humanitarian assistance, including food ration cuts and differentiated assistance approaches based on household vulnerability status, are likely to have significant implications for food consumption, indebtedness, coping strategies, social cohesion, and overall household well-being.
Kiswahili: Kupungua kwa hivi majuzi kwa usaidizi wa kibinadamu, ikiwa ni pamoja na kupunguzwa kwa mgao wa chakula na mbinu tofauti za usaidizi kulingana na hali ya hatari ya kaya, kuna uwezekano wa kuwa na athari kubwa kwa matumizi ya chakula, madeni, mikakati ya kukabiliana, uwiano wa kijamii, na ustawi wa kaya kwa ujumla.
Somali: Hoos u dhacii dhawaan ku yimid gargaarka bani'aadamnimada, oo ay ku jiraan dhimista raashinka iyo hababka gargaarka ee kala duwan oo ku salaysan xaaladda nuglaanta qoyska, waxay u badan tahay inay saameyn weyn ku yeelan doonaan isticmaalka cuntada, deynta, xeeladaha la qabsiga, isku xirnaanta bulshada, iyo guud ahaan fayoobaanta qoyska.
Dholuo: Kuong’ruok ma osetimre machiegni e kony mar dhano, moriwo nyaka ng’ado piny kwan mar chiemo kod yore mopogore opogore mag konyo kaluwore gi chal mar joot ma nigi pek, nyalo bedo gi dwoko maduong’ kuom tiyo kod chiemo, bedo gi gowi, yore mag ng’ado bura, winjruok e kind oganda, kod bedo maber mar joot duto.

English: Kenya: Polio outbreak - DREF Final Report (MDRKE062)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Mlipuko wa Polio - Ripoti ya Mwisho ya DREF (MDRKE062)

Dholuo: Kenya: Two mar polio - Ripot mogik mar DREF (MDRKE062)

English: KEMRI appeals to caregivers in Migori County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the December maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Migori kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Desemba.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Migori inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka ee Diseembar.
Dholuo: KEMRI okwayo jorit e county mar Migori mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi e dwe mar Desemba.

English: ODPP urges eligible citizens in Kajiado County to participate in voter education.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kajiado County kushiriki katika elimu ya wapiga kura.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kajiado inay ka qaybqaataan waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro mar yiero e Kajiado County mondo oriwgi e tiegruok mar joma oyier.

English: Talking about mental health breaks the stigma and helps others open up. Let's create a supportive environment for all.
Kiswahili: Kuzungumzia afya ya akili huvunja unyanyapaa na kuwasaidia wengine kufunguka. Tujenge mazingira ya usaidizi kwa wote.

Dholuo: Ka wawuoyo kuom tuwo mar paro, mano weyo ng’anjo ma ji nigo kendo konyo jomoko mondo oyawre. Wabed gi thuolo ma konyo ji duto.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Kakamega County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the June planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Juni.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Kakamega inay ka hortagaan xayawaanka ciidanka xilliga dayrta iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kakamega mondo oti gi yedhe makelo hinyruok e kinde machuok ka gitiyo gi tuoche maketho tong' kapok dwe mar auchiel ochopo.

English: Revert to the old tales that contributed to brain building and mental health care. This can be of help to build â€” ..
Kiswahili: Rudi kwenye hadithi za zamani zilizochangia ujenzi wa ubongo na huduma ya afya ya akili. Hii inaweza kusaidia kujenga - ..

Dholuo: Dwoki e weche machon ma ne okonyo e gero obwongo kod rito ngima mar paro. Mano nyalo konyo e gero â€” ..

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission opens a new electrical installation programme at the vocational centre in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yafungua programu mpya ya ufungaji wa umeme katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu furayaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan rakibidda korontada xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Tiego Jopuonj ochako chenro manyien mar keto sitima e skul mar tiegruok e gweng' mar Kisii.

English: Kenya Medical Association calls on parents in Tana River County to have children under five screened for dengue fever during the April outreach.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuwapima watoto chini ya miaka mitano homa ya dengue wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Aprili.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqayaa waalidiinta degmada Tana River in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro heerkulka dengue inta lagu gudajiro bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association okwayo jonyuol e Tana River County mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma hikgi tin ne abich kuom tuwo mar dengue e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education opens applications for textbooks and learning materials for learners in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inafungua maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka ayaa furaysa codsiyada buugaagta iyo qalabka wax lagu barto ee ardayda ku nool Gobolka Garissa.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Puonjruok ma Chakre e Piny owacho oseyawo kwayo mar somo buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok ne jopuonjre man e gweng' mar Garissa.

English: Notice: KALRO will distribute certified millet seed to farmers in Meru County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay abuuraha degmada Meru u qaybin doontaa abuurka miraha ee la caddeeyay bisha Oktoobar ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KALRO biro pogo kodhi mag millet ne jopur manie County mar Meru e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: KUCCPS reminds schools in Nyeri County to strengthen child protection in schools this March.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuimarisha ulinzi wa watoto shuleni Machi hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Nyeri inay xoojiyaan ilaalinta carruurta ee iskuulada bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: KUCCPS oparo ne skunde man Nyeri County mondo omed jiwo rit mar nyithindo e skunde e dwe mar Mach.

English: KTDA reminds livestock keepers in Tana River County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KTDA waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Tana River inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanada buka xafiiska xayawaanka ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KTDA parone jorit mag jamni e taon mar Tana River County ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: KUCCPS conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Embu County this September.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Embu Septemba hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda gobolka ee degmada Embu bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: KUCCPS dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi riwruok mar oganda e weche mag pesa mag county e county mar Embu e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Govâ€™t extends nationwide curfew, ban on public gatherings until May 29
Kiswahili: Serikali yaongeza muda wa kuondoka nchini kote, kupiga marufuku mikutano ya umma hadi Mei 29
Somali: Dowladdu waxay kordhisay bandowga dalka oo dhan, waxayna mamnuucday isu imaatinka dadweynaha ilaa 29-ka May
Dholuo: Sirkal ok medo kafiu e piny mangima, chik mar geng'o chokruok mag ji nyaka tarik 29 dwe mar Mei

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Tharaka-Nithi County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi in warbixinta soonka ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service oparo ne jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo kuom nek konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: NDMA reminds mobile money users in Busia County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Busia kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa pesa ya rununu.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Busia inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: NDMA paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mobil e county mar Busia ni mondo ginyis jomisonari maggi weche ma ok kare mondo kik gitim timbe mag mibadhi.

Kiswahili: Karatasi ya Ukweli: Usaidizi wa Fedha wa Tahadhari ya Kenya Cash Consortium kwa Jamii Zilizoathiriwa na Maafa huko Dadaab na Kakuma-Kalobeyei eneo la kuhifadhi wakimbizi: Endline (Februari 2026)
Somali: Xaqiiqooyinka: Hay'adda Lacagta Cadaanka ah ee Kenya oo ku saleysan Digniinta Gargaarka Lacagta Cadaanka ah ee loogu talagalay Bulshooyinka ay Masiibadu Saameysay ee ku nool Dhadhaab iyo Kakuma - aagga marti-gelinta qaxootiga ee Kalobeyei: Endline (Febraayo 2026)
Dholuo: Oboke mar adier: Kony mar pesa ma ochung’ne ng’eyo mar pesa ma Kenya chiwo ne jodak ma oyudo masira e Dadaab kod Kakuma-Kalobeyei ma orwako jolweny: Giko (Dwe mar Ariyo 2026)

English: A journey of reconciliation and hope through farming in Yabicho, Mandera County, Kenya
Kiswahili: Safari ya upatanisho na matumaini kupitia kilimo huko Yabicho, Kaunti ya Mandera, Kenya
Somali: Safar dib-u-heshiisiin iyo rajo ah oo loo marayo beerashada Yabicho, Degmada Mandheera, Kenya
Dholuo: Wuoth mar loso ngirruok kod geno kokalo kuom pur e puothe e piny Yabicho, Kaunti mar Mandera, piny Kenya

English: TVET reminds youth in Narok County that HELB funding is available for welding and fabrication training.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Narok kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Narok in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa rowere man Narok County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Embu County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Embu inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur e county mar Embu mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Isiolo County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Isiolo in adeegyada bukaanka dibedda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth parone ji duto e kaunti mar Isiolo ni koro ginyalo yudo kony mag thieth e kuonde moketi.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges millet growers in Homa Bay County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Wanyama inawasihi wakulima wa millet katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda xashiishadda ee gobolka Homa Bay inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur ma pidho millet e Homa Bay County mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed nyak e higani.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will conduct a modern irrigation techniques workshop for farmers in Bungoma County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itafanya warsha ya kisasa ya mbinu za umwagiliaji kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah ee beeraleyda degmada Bungoma bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Dairy Board biro timo chokruok mar timo nonro mar yore mag lero pi ne jopur e County mar Bungoma e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General opens a new service point for passport services in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Auditor General oseyawo kama itimee tije mag passport e gweng' mar Kisumu.

English: E-Citizen reminds the public in Turkana County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Turkana in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa ji duto e County mar Turkana ni lando wach tiyo marach gi migepe en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Notice: KALRO restricts movement of poultry in Murang'a County due to a foot and mouth disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO inazuia harakati za kuku katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa digaagga ee degmada Murang'a sababtuna tahay faafitaanka cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KALRO ogeng'o wuoth mar le mag dhok e County mar Murang'a nikech tuwo mar dhoho.

English: A meeting to explore ways and plans on foods before 2025
Kiswahili: Mkutano wa kuchunguza njia na mipango juu ya vyakula kabla ya 2025
Somali: Kulan lagu falanqeeyo hababka iyo qorshayaasha cuntada ka hor 2025.
Dholuo: Chokruok mar nono yore kod chenro mag chiemo kapok higa mar 2025 ochopo

English: DPP urges residents of Makueni County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: DPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaala aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo la sii xoojinayo taxaddarka ka dhanka ah argagixisada.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo jogweng' Makueni County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar sirkal e wi gik ma ne timore e alwora mar tong'gi.

English: DCI urges motorists and pedestrians in Trans Nzoia County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DCI inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa wadayaasha baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka fogaadaan inay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada daadadku ka da'ay si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo joidh mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o mondo gikwed masiche motudore gi pi.

English: CDC announces subsidised dialysis for residents of West Pokot County starting this January.
Kiswahili: CDC inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuanzia Januari hii.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa in la siinayo deebaajiga dadka deggan gobolka West Pokot laga bilaabo Janaayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuoche mag tuoche (CDC) ogolo chenro mar thiedho ji ma odak West Pokot County kochakore e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: NPS opens a gender desk offering free legal aid in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa msaada wa kisheria bure katika Wilaya ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah Degmada Migori.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NPS ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony ma onge chudo e kaunti mar Migori.

English: Narok County has provided 10 motorcycles to extension officers in designated wards to enhance agricultural services Farmers in these areas will benefit from improved access to extension support
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Narok imetoa pikipiki 10 kwa maafisa ugani katika wadi zilizoteuliwa ili kuimarisha huduma za kilimo Wakulima katika maeneo haya watanufaika kwa kuboreshwa kwa usaidizi wa ugani.
Somali: Gobolka Narok wuxuu 10 baaskiil siinayaa saraakiisha ballaarinta ee ku sugan degmooyinka la magacaabay si loo xoojiyo adeegyada beeraha Beeraleyda ku nool aagagan waxay ka faa'iideysan doonaan helitaanka taageero ballaarinta
Dholuo: Narok County osemiyo jorit mag tij lendo mag alwora 10 mag mtokni mondo omed konyo tijno. Jo-Purie e alworago biro yudo kony kuom yudo kony maber mar yudo kony mar lendo

English: Tiaty worst hit with 40% of residents affected. 2 people lost their lives last month due to Malaria. Govt distributing long-lasting treated mosquito nets
Kiswahili: Tiaty imeathiriwa zaidi na 40% ya wakazi walioathiriwa. Watu 2 walipoteza maisha yao mwezi uliopita kutokana na Malaria. Serikali yasambaza vyandarua vilivyotibiwa kwa muda mrefu
Somali: Tiaty ayaa ah tii ugu daran ee ay saameysay 40% dadka deggan. Laba qof ayaa ku dhintay bishii la soo dhaafay sababtoo ah Malaria. Dowladda ayaa qeybinaysa shabagyada cayayaanka ee muddo dheer lagu daaweeyey
Dholuo: Ji ariyo ne otho dwe mokalo nikech malaria.

English: Kenya: Salesian Missions provides funding for new bathrooms at Don Bosco
Kiswahili: Kenya: Misheni za Salesian hutoa ufadhili wa bafu mpya huko Don Bosco

Dholuo: Kenya: Riwruoge mag Jo-Salesian chiwo omwom mar gedo mar baf manyien e Don Bosco

English: It is cross-cutting in nature, designed to be multi-hazard and multi-sector, and encompasses gender equality and social inclusion.
Kiswahili: UNDRR pia iliunga mkono Hazina ya Kitaifa katika kuandaa mfumo wa kupunguza hatari ya maafa na mfumo wa kuweka alama za bajeti ya kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya tabianchi (DCBT), ambao ulisaidia Kenya kuimarisha uwezo wake wa kufuatilia na kutenga rasilimali kwa ajili ya kustahimili.
Somali: Waa mid isku dhafan, oo loogu talagalay inay noqoto mid khatar badan leh oo dhinacyo badan leh, waxayna ka kooban tahay sinnaanta jinsiga iyo ka mid noqoshada bulshada.
Dholuo: En gik ma ng’ato nyalo ng’ado e piny mangima, ma olosi mondo obed gi gik ma nyalo kelo hinyruok mang’eny kendo ma nigi sektor mang’eny, kendo oriwo bedo maromre mar chwo gi mon kod bedo gi ng’ato ka ng’ato e kindgi.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges residents of Kwale County to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers following a rise in reported malaria cases.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya malaria vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay soo sheegaan kiisaska loo maleynayo inay u sheegaan mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaskii la sheegay ee malaria.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo jogweng' Kwale County mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore mar rito ngima mar oganda nikech kwan mar joma nigi malaria osemedore.

English: SHA reminds voters in Nakuru County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: SHA inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Nakuru inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor inta aan la helin nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: SHA parone jogweng' Nakuru mondo onyis weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom SMS ne ji 70000 kapok gitimo yiero.

English: CDC appeals to caregivers in Taita-Taveta County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the February maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Februari.
Somali: CDC waxay u baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Taita-Taveta inay ka qeybgalaan maalinta bukaanka ee la qorsheeyay qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Febraayo.
Dholuo: CDC kwayo jorit e Taita-Taveta County mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar klinik ma ne ochan e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit confirms a cyclosporiasis outbreak alert for Narok County. Residents are advised to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa cyclosporiasis kwa Kaunti ya Narok. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa xaqiijisay feejignaanta cudurka cyclosporiasis ee Gobolka Narok. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Rieko: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osenyiso ni nitie siem mar tuo mar cyclosporiasis e kaunti mar Narok.

English: USDA promotes regenerative agriculture for grazing.
Kiswahili: USDA inakuza kilimo cha kuzalisha kwa ajili ya malisho.
Somali: USDA waxay dhiirrigelisaa beeraha dib-u-soo-nooleynta ee daaqashada.
Dholuo: USDA jiwo tij chwoyo kod chwoyo.

English: IPOA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Samburu County that access to psychosocial support is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisaikolojia unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay Gobolka Samburu in helitaanka taageerada cilmu-nafsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e county mar Samburu ni thuolo mar yudo kony kuom weche mag pach ji yudore maonge chudo.

English: Mandera County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Mandera: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Juni 2023
Somali: Degmada Mandheera: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Mandera: Oboke Mapiyo Mapiyo Mar Oro Duwe mar Auchiel 2023

English: Kenya Gazette reminds the public in Mandera County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this August.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba ushiriki katika mashauriano ya sera za umma unakaribishwa Agosti hii.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette ayaa xasuusinaya shacabka degmada Mandera in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette oparo ne ji duto man Mandera County ni ji duto mor gi chiwo mag paro e wi chenro mag sirkal e dwe mar Agost.

English: Kenya Gazette announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linatangaza uboreshaji wa nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku dhawaaqay waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Meru.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette olando lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mag ng'eyo ng'ato e County mar Meru.

English: Notice: e-Citizen opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogsoonow: e-Citizen waxay ka furaysaa goob adeeg cusub oo lagu shaqeynayo shahaadada dhalashada ee Gobolka Laikipia.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: e-Citizen oseyawo kama itimee tije manyien mar loso nyasi mag nyuol e County mar Laikipia.

English: Notice: FAO will distribute certified sweet potatoes seed to farmers in Machakos County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: FAO itawapa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos mbegu zilizothibitishwa za viazi tamu mwezi Desemba huu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay u qaybin doontaa abuurka baradho macaan oo shahaado leh beeraleyda Degmada Machakos bishii Diseembar ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Rieko: FAO biro pogo kodhi mag le mamit ne jopur man Machakos County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Wajir County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Wajir: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2022
Somali: Degmada Wajeer: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Wajir: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Julaini 2022

English: Council of Governors reminds the public in Kitui County that input on development planning forums is welcome this May.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba mchango kwenye vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo unakaribishwa Mei hii.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay xasuusinayaan shacabka degmada Kitui in talooyinka ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta la soo dhaweynayo bisha May.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch oparo ne ji duto e County mar Kitui ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mag dongruok e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: FAO restricts movement of poultry in Homa Bay County due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO inazuia harakati za kuku katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwa sababu ya mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Newcastle.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa digaagga ee gobolka Homa Bay sababtuna tahay cudurka Newcastle.
Dholuo: Nonro: FAO ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok e Homa Bay County nikech tuo mar Newcastle.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Nairobi County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen anawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: E-Citizen ojiwo jogweng' Nairobi County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo ng'ur mar kedo gi mibadhi mar chulo pesa.

English: Creating a Gender-Equitable and Inclusive Response to Gender-Based Violence in Kenya
Kiswahili: Kuunda Mwitikio wa Kijinsia na Jumuishi kwa Unyanyasaji wa Kijinsia nchini Kenya
Somali: Abuuritaanka Jawaab Sinnaan Jinsi iyo Midnimo leh oo ku wajahan Rabshadaha ku Salaysan Jinsiga ee ka dhaca Kenya
Dholuo: Loso dwoko maromre kendo ma oting’o ji duto e wi tim ng’anjo ma timore e kind chwo gi mon e piny Kenya

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit launches a December awareness campaign on food safety across Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Desemba juu ya usalama wa chakula katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa bilaabay olole wacyi galineed bishii Diseembar oo ku saabsan badbaadada cuntada ee gobolka Samburu.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit chako kampen mar miyo ji ng'eyo kuom wach ritruok mar chiemo e dwe mar Desemba e gweng' mar Samburu.

English: EACC reminds the public in Marsabit County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: EACC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Marsabit in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: EACC paronwa ji duto manie Marsabit County ni lando wach tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'.

English: KALRO invites farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County to a free training on greenhouse farming this March.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo cha chafu Machi hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku casuumaysaa beeraleyda degmada Tharaka-Nithi si ay u helaan tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: KALRO ogwelo jopur e Tharaka-Nithi County e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar greenhouse agriculture e dwe mar Mach.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on residents of Bomet County to support local peace-building committees in support of national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za mitaa kusaidia kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ugu baaqay dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah ee taageeraya nabadgelyada qaranka.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations kwayo jogweng'o mag County mar Bomet mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gweng'no.

English: State Department for Basic Education invites youth in Nyeri County to enroll for ICT skills training this October.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT Oktoba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku casuumaysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nyeri inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka xirfadaha ICT bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education ogwelo rowere man Nyeri County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar ICT e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: DCI opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay fureysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya taageero maskaxeed ee degmada Meru.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DCI ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony e weche mag pach ji e county mar Meru.

English: COMESA advises farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the November planting season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Novemba.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Nofeembar.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e dwe mar Novemba.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds expectant mothers in Makueni County that access to childhood immunization is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba upatikanaji wa chanjo ya watoto ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Makueni in helitaanka tallaalka carruurta ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone mine ma biro bedo gi ich e county mar Makueni ni thuolo mar yudo thieth mar nyithindo en maonge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public in Tharaka-Nithi County about the importance of tobacco control for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuhusu umuhimu wa udhibiti wa tumbaku kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay dadka degmada Tharaka-Nithi ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay xakamaynta sigaarka ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji e Tharaka-Nithi County kuom ber mar thieth mar ndawa ne ngima joot.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya opens a new service point for national ID applications in Busia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Busia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay ka furtay barta adeegga cusub ee codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Busia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Huduma Kenya oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag kwayo nying' mar ng'ato e gweng' mar Busia.

English: Notice: DPP activates an emergency response plan for fire outbreaks in Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DPP inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa milipuko ya moto katika Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ku saabsan dabka ka kacay Gobolka Murang'a.
Dholuo: Rapar: DPP tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne masiche mag mach e County mar Murang'a.

English: ODPP reminds the public in Uasin Gishu County that reporting embezzlement of public funds is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa fedha za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka ku nool gobolka Uasin Gishu in warbixinta xadgudubka lacagaha dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: ODPP parone ji duto e county mar Uasin Gishu ni chiwo ripot mar ketho pesa mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Kisumu Governor Nyong'o orders all restaurants shut in the county for failing to adhere to MoH measures against Covid-19.
Kiswahili: Gavana wa Kisumu Nyong'o aamuru migahawa yote ifungwe katika kaunti hiyo kwa kushindwa kufuata sheria za Wizara ya Afya dhidi ya Covid-19.
Somali: Guddoomiyaha Kisumu Nyong'o ayaa amar ku bixiyay in dhammaan makhaayadaha gobolka la xiro sababtoo ah ma raacaan tallaabooyinka Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ee ka dhanka ah COVID-19.
Dholuo: Gavana ma Kisumu Nyong'o ogolo chik mondo oting'o ute duto mag chiemo e county nikech ok giluw chenro mag Ministry of Health mar kedo gi Covid-19.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will train farmers in Busia County on terracing this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia juu ya mashindano ya wadudu Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka ayaa tababar siin doona beeraleyda degmada Busia ee ku saabsan dhulka lagu beeray bisha Sebtember ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Komiti mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro tiego jopur e gweng' mar Busia e dwe mar Septemba.

English: KALRO encourages farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora ya mahindi.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay hadhuudhka.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro mondo omi ohala mar kodhi obed maber.

English: IEBC reminds the public in West Pokot County that input on the county budget process is welcome this January.
Kiswahili: IEBC anakumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya West Pokot kwamba mapendekezo juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya wilaya ni kuwakaribisha Januari hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka West Pokot in talooyinka ku saabsan habka miisaaniyadda gobolka ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: IEBC parone ji duto manie West Pokot County ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e dwe mar Januar.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Makueni County that reporting carjacking promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba kuripoti utekaji nyara mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan baabuurta la xaday ay gacan ka geystaan ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne jogweng' Makueni County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo mtokni konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Elgeyo Marakwet County officially rolls out CNAP targeting a reduction of child stunting from 30% to 22%.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Elgeyo Marakwet yazindua rasmi mpango wa CNAP unaolenga kupunguza udumavu wa watoto kutoka 30% hadi 22%.
Somali: Degmada Elgeyo Marakwet ayaa si rasmi ah u soo bandhigtay CNAP oo ujeedkeedu yahay in la yareeyo yaraanta yaraanta 30% ilaa 22%.
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Elgeyo Marakwet osechako tiyo gi chenro mar CNAP mar dwoko chien kwan mar nyithindo maok nyal wuokie kuom 30% nyaka 22%.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds farmers in Busia County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka ka hortagga cayayaanka ayaa xasuusinaya beeraleyda degmada Busia barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee ka dambeeya goosashada.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jopur e county mar Busia chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime bang' keyo.

English: COMESA informs fish farmers in Kisii County of new market linkage opportunities this June.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawafahamisha wafugaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Juni hii.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku wargelineysaa kalluumeysatada ku nool degmada Kisii fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Juun.
Dholuo: COMESA nyiso jopur ma pidho rech e gweng' mar Kisii thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Jun.

English: CDC launches a March awareness campaign on food safety across Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Machi juu ya usalama wa chakula katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: CDC waxay bilowday olole wacyi galineed oo ku saabsan badbaadada cuntada bishii Maarso ee gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: CDC chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Mach e wi wach rito chiemo e alwora duto mar Nyandarua County.

English: NCPB advises farmers in Taita-Taveta County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: NCPB waxay kula talineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Taita-Taveta inay ka soo qayb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qayb galayaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur manie Taita-Taveta County mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Free laptops for all KCSE 2025 candidates who register as voters Ã¢Â€Â“ IEBC incentive.
Kiswahili: Pata kompyuta mpakato bila malipo kwa wagombea wote wa KCSE 2025 wanaojiandikisha kama wapiga kura Ã¢Â€Â“ motisha ya IEBC.
Somali: Laptop-yo bilaash ah dhammaan musharixiinta KCSE 2025 ee iska diiwaangeliya codbixiyeyaasha - dhiirigelinta IEBC.
Dholuo: Laptop ma nono ne jogo duto ma dhi e KCSE 2025 ma ndikore kaka jogo ma dhi goyo ombulu.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Mandera County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu huzindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Mandera Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee Gobolka Mandera bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Rieko: Ofis mar Auditor General chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e kaunti mar Mandera e dwe mar Februar.

English: Farmers planning to grow onions on an acre should prepare a nursery of 9 beds each 50m long to accommodate 375 000 seeds Ensure seedlings are graded and ready for transplanting
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaopanga kulima vitunguu kwenye ekari waandae kitalu chenye vitanda 9 kila chenye urefu wa mita 50 ili kuchukua mbegu 375,000 Hakikisha miche imepangwa na iko tayari kupandwa
Somali: Beeraleyda qorsheynaya inay basal ku beeraan acre waa inay diyaariyaan beerta 9 sariirood oo midkiiba 50m dhererkeedu yahay si loogu qaado 375,000 abuur. Hubi in abuurka la siiyo oo diyaar u yahay beerista

English: To maintain healthy soil in conservation agriculture, cover at least 30% of your land with crop residues or cover crops; this reduces weeds, prevents erosion of fertile topsoil, and conserves soil moisture, especially in dry regions. Leguminous cover crops like mucuna, sun hemp, and lablab beans can also cut chemical fertilizer use by 60-80% without lowering yields.
Kiswahili: Ili kutunza udongo vizuri katika kilimo hifadhi, funika angalau asilimia 30 ya shamba lako kwa mabaki ya mazao au mazao funika; hii hupunguza magugu, huzuia mmomonyoko wa udongo wenye rutuba, na kuhifadhi unyevu wa udongo, hasa katika maeneo yenye ukame. Mazao funika ya jamii ya mikunde kama mukuna, sunhemp, na lablab pia yanaweza kupunguza matumizi ya mbolea za kemikali kwa asilimia 60-80 bila kupunguza mavuno.
Somali: Si aad u ilaaliso ciid caafimaad qaba ee beeraha ilaalinta, ugu yaraan 30% dhulkaaga ku dabool hadhaaga dalagga ama dalagyada daboolaya; Tani waxay yareysaa cawska, waxay ka hortagtaa nabaadaad-guurka ciidda bacrin ah, waxayna ilaalisaa qoyaanka ciidda, gaar ahaan meelaha qalalan. Dalagyada digirta sida mucuna, sun hemp, iyo digirta lablab ayaa sidoo kale yareyn kara isticmaalka bacriminta kiimikada 60-80% iyada oo aan hoos u dhigin wax-soo-saarka.
Dholuo: Mondo omi lowo obed maber e tij pur, onego ipidh 30% mar lowo mari gi yiende modong' kata yiende modong'. mano miyo ogolo bedo matin, geng'o lowo ma nigi lowo maber, kendo rito lowo obed maler, to ahinya ahinya kuonde ma lowo otwo. Yiende ma nigi suya mamit kaka mucuna, sun hemp, kod lablab beans bende nyalo miyo yiende mag kembe odog chien gi nus kata nus mar piero auchiel maok ochuno ni cham odog chien.

English: Did you know the Kenya Red Cross Society offers free on-call counselling services 24/7? Call us on 1199 and we will be there for you. Since January-June 2019, our Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Services team attended to 513 calls.

Somali: Ma ogtahay in Kenya Red Cross Society ay bixiso adeegyo la-talin ah oo bilaash ah 24/7? Nala soo wac 1199 waxaanan kuu caawin doonnaa. Tan iyo Janaayo-Juun 2019, kooxdeena Adeegyada Taageerada Caafimaadka Maskaxda iyo Maskaxda ayaa ka qaybgalay 513 wicitaan.

Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya caawimaad sharci oo lacag la'aan ah Gobolka Narok.
