English: KUCCPS invites youth in Murang'a County to enroll for motor vehicle mechanics training this April.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari Aprili hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Murang'a inay iska diiwaangeliyaan tababarka mashiinnada gawaarida gaadiidka bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: KUCCPS gwelo rowere manie County mar Murang'a mondo odonj e tiegruok mar jomisonari mag mtokni e dwe mar April.

English: Notice from Division of Disease Surveillance and Response: free antenatal care clinics will run every January at designated health centres in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa: kliniki za bure za utunzaji wa ujauzito zitaendeshwa kila Januari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka socda qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada: rugta daryeelka dhalmada ee bilaashka ah waxaa lagu qaban doonaa Janaayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee la magacaabay ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuwo: Klinike mag rito nyithindo kapok ginyuolo biro tiyo dwe ka dwe e dwe mar Januar e kuonde thieth moyier e Taita-Taveta County.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds expectant mothers in Isiolo County that access to childhood immunization is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kwamba upatikanaji wa chanjo ya utotoni ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Isiolo in helitaanka tallaalka carruurta ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Isiolo ni yudo thieth mar nyithindo onge chudo e kuonde duto mag sirkal.

English: Ministry of Health reminds expectant mothers in Machakos County that access to childhood immunization is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba upatikanaji wa chanjo ya utotoni ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Machakos in helitaanka tallaalka carruurta ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County ma Machakos ni thuolo mar yudo thieth mar nyithindo en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag sirkal.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) announces free medical camps for residents of Bomet County starting this March.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kuanzia Machi hii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa ku dhawaaqday xeryo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Bomet laga bilaabo bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) ogolo kampen mag thieth maonge chudo ne joma odak e county mar Bomet kochakore dwe mar Mach.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service warns tea farmers in Isiolo County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Isiolo cudurrada cayayaanka waxaana uu ku talinayaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service chiwo siem ne jopur ma loso chai e kaunti mar Isiolo kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Notice: FAO restricts movement of goats in Machakos County due to a rabies outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO inazuia harakati za mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Machakos kwa sababu ya mlipuko wa kichaa cha mbwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa riyaha ee degmada Machakos sababtuna tahay cudurka cadhada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: FAO ogeng'o wuoth mar diek e County ma Machakos nikech tuwo mar rabies.

English: COMESA advises farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the December planting season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Desemba.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: COMESA nyiso jopur e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni giti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Kenya Red Cross launches a March awareness campaign on proper sanitation across Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Machi juu ya usafi wa mazingira katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa bilaabay olole wacyi galineed bishii Maarso oo ku saabsan nadaafadda saxda ah ee degmada Marsabit.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Mach kuom weche mag thieth e alwora mar Marsabit County.

English: Fake job offers like 'Earn KSh 50k daily from home' are scams.Ã‚ÂAvoid upfront payments.
Kiswahili: Ofa bandia za kazi kama vile 'Pata KSh 50k kila siku kutoka nyumbani' ni ulaghai. Epuka malipo ya awali.
Somali: Dalabyada shaqada been abuurka ah sida 'Kasbado KSh 50k maalintii guriga' waa khiyaanooyin. Ka fogow lacagaha hore loo bixiyo.
Dholuo: Tich ma miriambo kaka ‘Yud KSh 50k pile ka pile ka in ot’ gin miriambo.

English: Sarah's journey: empowering women through high iron beans
Kiswahili: Safari ya Sarah: kuwawezesha wanawake kupitia maharagwe mengi ya chuma
Somali: Safarka Sarah: awoodsiinta haweenka iyada oo loo marayo digirta birta badan
Dholuo: Safar mar Sarah: miyo mon teko kokalo kuom ng’injo ma malo

English: IPOA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Marsabit County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: IPOA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayeona unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Marsabit piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Marsabit inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: IPOA ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo chandruok mar timbe maricho e gweng' mar Marsabit mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: KALRO advises fish producers in Siaya County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wazalishaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KALRO waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kalluunka ee degmada Siaya inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur ma loso rech e county mar Siaya mondo oti maber gi nengo matin mosing kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: IPOA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Samburu County that access to free legal aid is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisheria wa bure unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay Gobolka Samburu in la heli karo caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah oo lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e county mar Samburu ni thuolo mar yudo kony mar chik ma onge chudo yudore maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Forest Service alerts residents of Kwale County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale juu ya kuongezeka kwa visa vya wizi na kuwashauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ka digay dadka deggan degmada Kwale in ay kordhaan kiisaska tuugada wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kwale County ni kwan mag jokuoge medore kendo ojiwo oganda mondo kik gipog weche mag ritruok gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: IEBC encourages out-of-school children in Kericho County to register their children at the nearest public school under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Kericho kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Kericho inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha ee ku jira fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e County mar Kericho mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni gi skul mar ji duto e klas mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo.

English: Policy Brief: From Stateless to Citizens: the journey of the Shona community in Kenya
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Sera: Kutoka kwa Wasio na Uraia hadi kwa Raia: safari ya jumuiya ya Washona nchini Kenya
Somali: Soo Koobidda Siyaasadda: Laga bilaabo Dadka Aan Dal lahayn ilaa Muwaadiniinta: safarka bulshada Shona ee Kenya
Dholuo: Oboke machuok mar chik: Kowuok kuom joma onge piny nyaka joma gin jodak: wuoth mar oganda Shona e piny Kenya

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development warns millet farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza uingiliaji kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda miiska ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyin waqtigeeda ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development osiemo jopur mag millet e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ochiwo paro mar kawo okang' e kinde mowinjore.

English: CDC appeals to caregivers in Kirinyaga County to visit their nearest maternity wing as part of the July maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Julai.
Somali: CDC waxay ku baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Kirinyaga inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada bisha July.
Dholuo: CDC okwayo jorit e County mar Kirinyaga mondo olimgi machiegni gi kama gibiro yudoe nyithindo e dwe mar Julai.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) calls on parents in Nyamira County to have children under five screened for cholera during the February outreach.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuwafanyia uchunguzi watoto chini ya miaka mitano kipindupindu wakati wa mawasiliano ya Februari.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Nyamira in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka kolera inta lagu jiro bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) kwayo jonyuol e County mar Nyamira mondo otim nonro mar cholera ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will train farmers in Kiambu County on agroforestry this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu juu ya kilimo cha misitu Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) ayaa tababar siin doonta beeraleyda degmada Kiambu ee beeraha iyo kaymaha bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro tiego jopur e gweng' mar Kiambu e wi yiengni mag yien e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya: Epidemic - 04-2024 - Cholera Outbreak (2024-05-22)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Janga - 04-2024 - Mlipuko wa Kipindupindu (2024-05-22)
Somali: Kenya: Cudur faafa - 04-2024 - Cudurka Daacuunka oo ka dilaacay (2024-05-22)
Dholuo: Kenya: Tuwo Maduong' - 04-2024 - Tuwo mar Kolera (22-05-2024)

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kisii County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Kisii kutafuta msaada katika nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Kisii inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e County mar Kisii mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Notice: NCPB will open a horticultural produce collection centre in Kiambu County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay ka furi doontaa xarun ururinta alaabada beeraha ee degmada Kiambu bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NCPB biro yawo kama ichokoe puothe mag puothe gi puothe e County mar Kiambu e dwe mar Novemba.

English: IEBC reminds voters in Mandera County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Mandera kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu zaidi kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha gobolka Mandera inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta ee ugu dhow ka hor jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: IEBC parone jogweng'o mag Mandera County mondo olim kama ichikoe ji mondo okonygi ka pok kinde mag yiero ochopo.

English: KTDA advises horticultural produce producers in Vihiga County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inashauri wazalishaji wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KTDA waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha wax soo saarka beeraha ee degmada Vihiga inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KTDA nyiso jopur ma loso puothe mag puothe e County mar Vihiga mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mabiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Kilifi residents urged  to register for SHA
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Kilifi wanahitajika kujiandikisha kwa SHA
Somali: Dadka deggan Kilifi ayaa lagu booriyay inay iska diiwaangeliyaan SHA
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma odak e alwora mar Kilifi ojiw mondo odonj e program mar SHA

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will hold a suicide prevention forum in Uasin Gishu County this September. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitafanya kongamano la kuzuia kujiua katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Septemba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa qaban doonta madasha ka hortagga is-miidaaminta ee gobolka Uasin Gishu bisha Sebtember. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Rieko: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo chokruok mar geng'o ji kik nege e Uasin Gishu County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: HELB advises applicants in Bomet County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: HELB inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Bomet kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: HELB waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha gobolka Bomet inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: HELB nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Bomet ni mondo gidonj e tiegruok kapok ichopo e chokruok mabiro.

English: Notice: DPP issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay soo saartaa digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: DPP ogolo siem mar rito weche mag sirkal kuom chenro mag gweth mag miriambo makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Baringo County.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will be held in Homa Bay County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ay soo qabanqaabisay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa lagu qaban doonaa gobolka Homa Bay bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ochano ibiro tim Homa Bay County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds livestock keepers in Machakos County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Machakos inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanada buka xafiiska xayawaanka ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board parone jorit jamni e county mar Machakos ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: Kenya - Garissa County - Dadaab - Dagahaley Refugee Camp - Water Infrastructure - as of May 2022
Kiswahili: Kenya - Kaunti ya Garissa - Dadaab - Kambi ya Wakimbizi ya Dagahaley - Miundombinu ya Maji - kuanzia Mei 2022
Somali: Kenya - Degmada Gaarisa - Dhadhaab - Xerada Qaxootiga Dhagaxley - Kaabayaasha Biyaha - laga bilaabo May 2022
Dholuo: Kenya - Kambi mar Garissa - Dadaab - Kambi mar Jolweny - Gedo mag Pi - chakre Mei 2022

English: Notice: TSC reminds citizens in Trans Nzoia County about their rights regarding the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuhusu haki zao kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Trans Nzoia ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: TSC parone raia mag Trans Nzoia County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo ombudsman.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Kisii County about the importance of hypertension awareness for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuhusu umuhimu wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMSA waxay dadweynaha degmada Kisii ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay wacyiga cadaadiska sare ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa ji duto e County mar Kisii kuom ber mar miyo ji ong'e ni tuwo mar hypertension en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Farmers are urged to follow the 4 Rs for safe pesticide use the Right chemical at the Right time in the Right manner to prevent health risks
Kiswahili: Wakulima wamehimizwa kufuata 4 Rs kwa dawa salama kutumia kemikali Sahihi kwa wakati sahihi kwa njia sahihi ili kuzuia hatari za kiafya.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu baaqay inay raacaan 4 rupee oo loogu talagalay isticmaalka cayayaanka badbaadada leh kiimikada saxda ah waqtiga saxda ah si looga hortago khataraha caafimaadka
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma bende timo dongruok e wach thieth, jiwo jolendo mondo oluw puonj mar Rs 4 mondo giti gi yedhe mamero mag kute e yo makare e kinde mowinjore mondo gikwed hinyruok mag ngima

English: OGP announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: OGP inatangaza nyakati bora za kurejesha huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: OGP waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee degmada Nakuru.
Dholuo: OGP olando lokruok e seche mag tiyo gi passport e kaunti mar Nakuru.

English: Some cultural practices during pregnancy and childbirth may endanger lives. Communities are urged to adopt evidence-based health practices.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya desturi za kitamaduni wakati wa ujauzito na kujifungua zinaweza kuhatarisha maisha. Jamii zinahimizwa kufuata desturi za kiafya zinazotegemea ushahidi.
Somali: Caadooyinka dhaqanka qaarkood inta lagu jiro uurka iyo dhalmada ayaa khatar gelin kara nolosha. Bulshooyinka waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay qaataan caadooyin caafimaad oo ku saleysan caddaynta.
Dholuo: Moko kuom timbe ma ji timo e kinde mag ich kod nyuol nyalo miyo ngima ng'ato obed kama rach.

English: ODPP advises residents of Homa Bay County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: ODPP inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: ODPP waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay qaataan dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado dib u dhac marka la raadinayo codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo oting'e buge duto madwarore mondo kik giketh seche ma gidwaro kwayo nying' mar ng'at manie pinygi.

English: Embu (Mbeere) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for December 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Embu (Mbeere): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Desemba 2023
Somali: Degmada Embu (Mbeere): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Diseembar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Embu (Mbeere): Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2023

English: Notice: NPS issues a cybersecurity alert on SIM-swap fraud affecting residents of Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa SIM-swap inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogaysiis: NPS waxay soo saartaa digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaanooyinka SIM-swap ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NPS ogolo siem mar rito weche mag intanet kuom wuond mar loko SIM ma mulo joma odak e County mar Bungoma.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Homa Bay County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu huzindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee gobolka Homa Bay bishii Ogosto.
Dholuo: Rieko: Ofis mar Auditor General chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e Homa Bay County e dwe mar Agost.

English: IEBC urges parents and teachers in Nyandarua County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Nyandarua inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e Kaunti mar Nyandarua mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto.

English: NPS reminds mobile money users in Kericho County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha watumiaji wa fedha za simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa pesa za simu.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kericho inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: NPS paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e County mar Kericho ni mondo ginyis jochiwogi weche maok kare mondo kik gikwed timbe mag wuondo pesa mag simu.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Bungoma County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this September.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Septemba hii.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ka digaya dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay u diyaar garoobaan qaraxyo dab ah oo dhici kara bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations osiemo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo oikre ne yiengni manyalo timore e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Kenya Gazette warns public officers in Embu County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Embu dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Embu inay musuqmaasuqa ka qaataan xafiisyada dawladda.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Embu kuom kawo asoya e migepe mag oganda.

English: Teachers Service Commission advises applicants in Kirinyaga County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu kula talinayaa codsadayaasha Gobolka Kirinyaga inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e gweng' mar Kirinyaga mondo odonj e tiegruok kapok iketho skundno.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya warns residents of Baringo County about a rise in phishing messages and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo juu ya kuongezeka kwa ujumbe wa udanganyifu na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ka digtay dadka deggan degmada Baringo kororka fariimaha phishing waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga leh bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Communications Authority chiwo siem ne jogweng' Baringo County e wi medruok mar weche mag phishing kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne jatendgi.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will distribute certified tea seed to farmers in Kwale County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu za chai zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu abuurka shaaha ee shahaadada leh u qaybin doonaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kwale bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Dairy Board biro pogo kodhi mag chai ne jopur man Kwale County e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: IPOA conducts a community briefing on border security in Kirinyaga County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Februari hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: IPOA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha ee Gobolka Kirinyaga bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IPOA timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e County mar Kirinyaga e dwe mar Februar.

English: Agroforestry systems provide shade and improve microclimates for livestock, enhancing welfare and productivity.
Kiswahili: Mifumo ya kilimo cha misitu hutoa kivuli na kuboresha hali ya hewa ndogo kwa mifugo, na hivyo kuongeza ustawi na tija.
Somali: Nidaamyada agroforestry waxay bixiyaan hooska iyo hagaajinta microclimates ee xoolaha, taasoo kor u qaadaysa daryeelka iyo wax-soosaarka.
Dholuo: Sisitem mag agroforestry chiwo tipo kendo medo bero alwora mar kit ngima mag jamni, kendo mano miyo ngima mar jamni kod nyak mar jamni bedo maber.

English: AFA urges tea growers in Kiambu County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: AFA inawataka wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Kiambu inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu talinayo roobabka ka hor si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e Kaunti mar Kiambu mondo oti gi kwan mar yiende ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue mondo okony e medo nyak mar yiendno e higani.

English: State Department for TVET reminds youth in Bungoma County that HELB funding is available for tailoring and design training.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Bungoma in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka qaabeynta iyo naqshadeynta.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET oparo ne rowere man Bungoma County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Kirinyaga County that access to eye and dental camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za macho na meno sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kirinyaga in helitaanka xeryaha indhaha iyo ilkaha ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumo la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMRI oparo ne ji duto e County mar Kirinyaga ni koro ginyalo dhi e kambini mag thieth mar wang' kod lakteche mag laktech e kuonde moyier.

English: Legumes should be harvested when they are well dried; Harvest by picking the stumps or plucking the stems after all the stumps have dried.
Kiswahili: Kunde zivunwe wakati zimekauka vizuri; vuna kwa kuchuma vitumba au kung'oa mashina baada ya vitumba vyote kukauka.
Somali: Digirta waa in la goosaa marka ay si fiican u qalageen; Goosashada adigoo gooyaa stumps-ka ama la gooyaa laamaha ka dib marka dhammaan stumps-ka ay engegaan.
Dholuo: Olembe onego okwang' ka oseyueyo maber; onego okwang'gi ka ichoko yiende kata ka ichoko yiende bang' ka yiende duto oseyueyo.

English: State Department for TVET invites youth in Laikipia County to enroll for catering and hospitality training this September.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu Septemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku casuumaysaa dhalinyarada degmada Laikipia inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET ogwelo rowere man Laikipia County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar chiemo kod rwako welo e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Judiciary of Kenya warns public officers in Murang'a County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Murang'a inay musuqmaasuqa ka qaataan xafiisyada dawladda.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e kaunti mar Murang'a ni kik giyud asoya e migepe ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: CDC launches a February awareness campaign on proper sanitation across Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Februari juu ya usafi wa mazingira katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Somali: CDC waxay bilawday olole wacyi galineed bishii Febraayo oo ku saabsan nadaafadda saxda ah ee degmada Marsabit.
Dholuo: CDC chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Februar kuom weche mag thieth e alwora mar Marsabit County.

English: AFA reminds livestock keepers in Kilifi County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Kilifi inay ka fogaadaan in xoolaha ay ka gudbaan xadka degmada iyada oo aan la helin rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: AFA parone jorit jamni e gweng' mar Kilifi ni kik giting' jamni ka ok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: Notice: TVET opens a new tailoring and design programme at the vocational centre in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inafungua programu mpya ya ushonaji na kubuni katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan dharka iyo naqshadeynta xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET chako chenro manyien mar loso kendo loso gik moko e skul mar Kisumu County.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free cyclosporiasis screening is available at all public health centres in Kilifi County this December.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa cyclosporiasis unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Desemba hii.
Somali: Laanta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka cyclosporiasis ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Kilifi bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji ni thieth mar cyclosporiasis onge nengo e kuonde thieth duto e County Kilifi e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice from Kenya Red Cross: postnatal check-ups clinics will run every May at designated health centres in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya: kliniki za uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa zitafanya kazi kila Mei katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya: Caafimaadka baaritaanka dhalmada ka dib waxaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Maajo ee kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ripot Mamit mar Kenya: Klinike mag nonro mag nyuol biro dhi nyime dwe mar Mei higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Kirinyaga.

English: Differentiate your free range eggs in the market by creating a strong brand identity Learn basic branding principles and marketing techniques
Kiswahili: Tofautisha mayai yako ya biashara huria sokoni kwa kuunda utambulisho imara wa chapa Jifunze kanuni za msingi za chapa na mbinu za uuzaji
Somali: Kala saar ukuntaada xorta ah ee suuqa adigoo abuuraya aqoonsi sumad xooggan Baro mabaadi'da aasaasiga ah ee sumadda iyo farsamooyinka suuq-geynta
Dholuo: Puonjri keto tong' mag brand e wi gik ma itimo e piny mangima

English: E-Citizen reminds voters in Homa Bay County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha gobolka Homa Bay inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor waxbarashada codbixisayaasha.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa jogedo e Homa Bay County mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar timo yiero ka pok giyudo tiegruok.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) encourages first-time voters in Busia County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Busia kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu zaidi.
Somali: Guddiga Garsoorka Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa codbixiyayaasha ugu horreeya ee degmada Busia inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo joma okwongo yiero e county mar Busia mondo olim kama ichikoe ji ne IEBC.

English: KUCCPS urges residents of Migori County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na ugawaji wa bursary.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Migori inay codsadaan deeq waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo jogweng' Migori County mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud michno.

English: Council of Governors urges residents of Kisii County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia wavuti ya kaunti ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja wa kaunti.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha waxay ku boorinayaan dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca bogga shabakadda degmada si ay uga warqabaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada.
Dholuo: Council of Governors jiwo jogweng' Kisii County mondo ong'e dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mar dongruok e county.

English: KEMRI encourages residents of Machakos County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay la xiriiraan lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng'o mag Machakos County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giwuo gi jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku dhawaaqay taariikhda diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ee dugsiyada degmada Makueni.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development olando tarik mag dhi e skul mag Makueni County.

English: To manage cassava mosaic disease: plant only cuttings showing no signs of infection, taken from a clean disease-free field; uproot and bury any plant that develops symptoms as soon as you see them; plant tolerant varieties (in Malawi: Sauti, Sagonja, Yizaso, Chamandanda); and rotate crops to prevent the disease building up in the soil.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti ugonjwa wa mosaic ya muhogo: panda vipandikizi tu visivyo na dalili za maambukizi, vilivyochukuliwa kutoka kwa shamba safi lisilo na magonjwa; kung'oa na kuzika mmea wowote unaopata dalili mara tu unapoziona; aina zinazostahimili mimea (nchini Malawi: Sauti, Sagonja, Yizaso, Chamandanda); na kuzungusha mazao ili kuzuia ugonjwa kuongezeka kwenye udongo.
Somali: Si loo xakameeyo cudurka cassava mosaic: ku beero kaliya geedo aan lahayn calaamado cudur, laga soo qaatay dhul nadiif ah oo aan cudur lahayn; xidid iyo aaska dhirta kasta oo horumariya calaamadaha sida ugu dhakhsaha badan ee aad aragto; noocyada u dulqaadanaya dhirta (Malawi: Sauti, Sagonja, Yizaso, Chamandanda); iyo goosashada dalagga si looga hortago in cudurka uu ku soo kordho ciidda.
Dholuo: Mondo iti gi tuo mar manias: pidh mana yiende ma onge ranyisi mar tuwo, ma ogol e puodho maler maonge tuoche; gol kendo yik yien moro amora ma nigi hinyruok mapiyo kaka iseneno; kit yien ma nigi nyalo mar geng'o tuoche (e piny Malawi: Sauti, Sagonja, Yizaso, Chamandanda); kendo ti gi yien mopogore opogore mondo kik tuoche omedre e lowo.

English: Marsabit County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Marsabit: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2024
Somali: Degmada Marsabit: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Marsabit: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2024

English: KTDA urges farmers in Nyamira County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyamira inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e Kaunti mar Nyamira mondo opidh olembe mag choko lowo mondo okonygi kedo gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges poultry farmers in Nyeri County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inahimiza wafugaji wa kuku katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda digaagga ee degmada Nyeri inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyaga oo aan haysan rukhsad ka dib kiisaska cudurka Anthrax ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur mag le mag Nyeri County mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni e gweng'no maok giyudo rusa bang' yudo weche mag anthrax.

English: Transform rwa grains into a higher- value honey wine. Discover simple processing methods and potential markets.
Kiswahili: Kubadilisha nafaka yake kuwa divai ya asali yenye thamani kubwa.
Somali: Beeraha RWA ka beddelo khamri macaan oo qiimo sare leh. Soo ogow hababka processing fudud iyo suuqyada suurtagalka ah.
Dholuo: Lok cham mag RWA obed divai mar mor kich ma nigi nengo mamalo.

English: All tea factories managed by KTDA must comply with new tea regulations by 31st March 2021 or face penalties including license suspension or legal charges
Kiswahili: Viwanda vyote vya chai vinavyosimamiwa na KTDA lazima vizingatie kanuni mpya za chai kufikia tarehe 31 Machi 2021 au vikabiliane na adhabu ikijumuisha kusimamishwa kwa leseni au mashtaka ya kisheria.
Somali: Dhamaan warshadaha shaaha ee ay maamusho KTDA waa inay u hoggaansamaan xeerarka shaaha cusub 31 -ka Maarso 2021 ama waxay la kulmi doonaan ganaaxyo ay ka mid yihiin joojinta ruqsadda ama khidmadaha sharciga ah
Dholuo: Migepe duto mag loso chai ma KTDA tayo nyaka luw chike manyien mag loso chai nyaka tarik 31 dwe mar adek 2021 kata ginyalo yudo kum moriwo nyaka weyo chulo ratiro mag loso chai kata chulo pesa mag chik

English: Kenya Population Movement - DREF Final Report (MDRKE067)
Kiswahili: Harakati za Idadi ya Watu Kenya - Ripoti ya Mwisho ya DREF (MDRKE067)
Somali: Dhaqdhaqaaqa Dadweynaha Kenya - Warbixinta kama dambaysta ah ee DREF (MDRKE067)
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kwan Oganda ma Kenya - Ripot mogik mar DREF (MDRKE067)

English: FAO urges farmers in Trans Nzoia County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: FAO inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo opidh cham mondo omi lowo okethre.

English: Notice: EACC launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Mombasa County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa mwezi huu wa Novemba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhanka ah gobolka Mombasa bishii November.
Dholuo: Rapar: EACC chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Mombasa e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Kiambu County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the March planting season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji Machi.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Kiambu inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur manie County mar Kiambu mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochako chwoyo kodhi e dwe mar Mach.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages mothers in Nandi County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Nandi kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Nandi inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo mine e county mar Nandi mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Farmers in Zambia are encouraged to adopt rotational grazing practices to boost livestock productivity by 20 and reduce mortality rates by 30
Kiswahili: Wakulima nchini Zambia wamehimizwa kufuata kanuni za malisho kwa mzunguko ili kuongeza tija ya mifugo ifikapo 20 na kupunguza vifo kwa 30.
Somali: Beeraleyda Zambia waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay qaataan hababka daaqsinimada wareegga si loo kordhiyo wax soo saarka xoolaha 20 iyo in la yareeyo heerarka dhimashada 30
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur e piny Zambia mondo oti gi yore mag kwayo mag dhok e yo ma ok ochuno mondo omed miyo dhok obed gi nyak gi pasent 20 kendo mondo omed kelo tho gi pasent 30

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds livestock keepers in Kitui County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Kitui inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyaga oo aan haysan rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jorit jamni e County Kitui ni kik giting' jamni ka ok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Taita-Taveta County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia wavuti ya wilaya ili kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja wa wilaya.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Taita-Taveta inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca bogga degmada si ay uga warqabaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo jogweng'o mag Taita-Taveta County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mar dongruok e county.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Kisii County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na ufisadi wa fedha za umma.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u soo gudbiyaan cabasho si ay ula dagaallamaan xadgudubka lacagaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kisii mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo kwayo mar kedo gi ketho pesa mag sirkal.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit launches an April awareness campaign on tobacco control across Turkana County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Aprili juu ya udhibiti wa tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Abriil ee ka dhanka ah xakamaynta sigaarka ee degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar April e wi thieth mar ndawa e County duto mar Turkana.

English: Government promoting daily exercise challenge across all counties, emphasizing movement for health.
Kiswahili: Serikali inakuza changamoto ya mazoezi ya kila siku katika kaunti zote, ikisisitiza harakati za afya.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay horumarineysaa caqabadda jimicsiga maalinlaha ah ee dhammaan degmooyinka, iyadoo lagu adkeynayo dhaqdhaqaaqa caafimaadka.
Dholuo: Sirkal jiwo kinda mar timo tiegruok pile ka pile e gwenge duto, koketo pek ahinya kuom riwruok mar oganda Jehova.

English: â€œMy mom does good workâ€: In Kenya, community health volunteers show mothers how to detect child malnutrition at home
Kiswahili: Mama yangu anafanya kazi nzuri": Nchini Kenya, wafanyakazi wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii huwaonyesha akina mama jinsi ya kutambua utapiamlo wa watoto nyumbani.
Somali: "Hooyaday shaqo wanaagsan ayay qabataa": Kenya, mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada ayaa hooyooyinka tusaya sida loo ogaado nafaqo-darrada carruurta guriga ku haysa.
Dholuo: â€œMama timo tich maberâ€: E piny Kenya, jotich mag thieth mag gwenge nyiso mon kaka ginyalo fwenyo ka nyithindo ok chamo chiemo maber e ot .

English: @NationMediaGrp CEO Stephen Gitagama today paid a courtesy call on the Cabinet Secretary for Health, Mutahi Kagwe & launched a program to give frontline health workers a free subscription of the Daily Nation for a period of two months #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Mkurugenzi Mtendaji wa @NationMediaGrp Stephen Gitagama leo amemtembelea Katibu wa Baraza la Mawaziri wa Afya, Mutahi Kagwe na kuzindua mpango wa kuwapa wafanyikazi wa afya walio mstari wa mbele kujiandikisha bila malipo katika Daily Nation kwa muda wa miezi miwili #KomeshaCorona.
Somali: Madaxa fulinta ee @NationMediaGrp Stephen Gitagama ayaa maanta booqasho sharafeed ku tagay Xoghayaha Golaha Wasiirada ee Caafimaadka, Mutahi Kagwe, wuxuuna bilaabay barnaamij shaqaalaha caafimaadka ee safka hore loogu siinayo rukhsad bilaash ah oo Daily Nation ah muddo laba bilood ah #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: <2Zepa> Jatend piny owacho, Stephen Gitagama, kawuono nooro limbe mar ng’wono ne jatend piny owacho mar piny owacho, Mutahi Kagwe kendo ochako chenro mar miyo jotich mag piny owacho ma ni e nyim piny thuolo mar ndiko nying’ ma nono mar gaset mar piny mangima kuom dweche ariyo #KomeshaCorona

English: IEBC reminds parents in Nyeri County that free day secondary education registration is open this March.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba usajili wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo umefunguliwa Machi hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Nyeri in diiwaangelinta dugsiga sare ee bilaashka ah ay furan tahay bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: IEBC paronwa jonyuol manie County mar Nyeri ni somo mar sekondari mar odiechieng' achiel en mar dwe mar Mach.

English: Kenya Medical Association appeals to caregivers in Vihiga County to visit their nearest maternity wing as part of the April maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi kama sehemu ya harakati za afya ya uzazi Aprili.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqayaa daryeelayaasha degmada Vihiga inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow sida qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association ogwelo jorit e county mar Vihiga mondo odhi olim ringregi man machiegni kodgi kaka achiel kuom chenro mar April Maternal Health Campaign.

English: Kenya: Cash transfers bringing relief to drought prone communities
Kiswahili: Kenya: Uhamisho wa pesa unaleta ahueni kwa jamii zinazokabiliwa na ukame
Somali: Kenya: Lacago xawilaad ah oo gargaar u keenaya bulshooyinka abaarta ku habsatay
Dholuo: Kenya: Oor mar omwom kelo kony ne gwenge ma oyudo oro

English: NPS warns residents of Kitui County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui juu ya kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: NPS waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui kororka qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: NPS chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kitui County e wi medruok mar chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: NDMA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Uasin Gishu County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba upatikanaji wa maelekezo ya makazi salama unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Uasin Gishu in helitaanka tixraacyada magangelyo ammaan ah ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: NDMA oparo ne jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu County ni ginyalo yudo kuonde ma ginyalo dakie maonge chudo.

English: National Drought Early Warning Bulletin ( June 2022)
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Tahadhari ya Mapema ya Kitaifa (Juni 2022)
Somali: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Qaranka (Juun 2022)
Dholuo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro ( dwe mar auchiel 2022)

English: Communications Authority of Kenya calls on residents of Makueni County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay iskaashi la sameeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo jogweng' Makueni County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji nitie mondo okonygi gi chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne joma odak e alworano.

English: Scaling Up Disruptive Technologies for Agricultural Productivity in Kenya
Kiswahili: Kuongeza Teknolojia Zinazosumbua kwa Tija ya Kilimo nchini Kenya
Somali: Kor u qaadista Tiknoolajiyada Khalkhalka ku ah Waxsoosaarka Beeraha ee Kenya
Dholuo: Medo Teknoloji ma Ketho Nyalo mar Pur e piny Kenya

English: Public declaration of stress management, substance abuse, workplace safety, and wellness training for employers via FKE curriculum.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la umma la usimamizi wa msongo wa mawazo, matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya, usalama mahali pa kazi, na mafunzo ya ustawi kwa waajiri kupitia mtaala wa FKE.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha ee maareynta stress, xadgudubka maadooyinka, ammaanka goobta shaqada, iyo tababarka caafimaadka ee loo shaqeeyaha iyada oo loo marayo manhajka FKE.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda mang'ongo mar weche thieth mag stress, tiyo marach gi yedhe ma mero ji, ritruok e tich, kod tiegruok mar ngima maber ne jotelo mag tich kokalo kuom chenro mar somo mar FKE.

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages mothers in Kisumu County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kisumu inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo mine manie Kisumu County mondo odhi olimgi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: It's okay not to be okay! There is no health without mental health!
Kiswahili: Ni sawa kutokuwa sawa! Hakuna afya bila afya ya akili!
Somali: Ma jirto caafimaad caafimaad la'aan caafimaadka maskaxda!
Dholuo: Onge gima rach ka ng'ato ok bed gi ngima maber!

English: OGP reminds the public in Lamu County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this October.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Lamu kwamba mapendekezo juu ya mapitio ya utendaji wa kila mwaka yanakaribishwa Oktoba hii.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Lamu in talooyinka dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: OGP oparo ne ji duto e County mar Lamu ni gik ma ji wacho e wi nonro mar tich mitimo higa ka higa ibiro rwak e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: ODPP encourages first-time voters in Kwale County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Kwale inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogo ma ne okwongo yiero e county mar Kwale mondo ong'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: HELB urges youth in Nyandarua County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: HELB inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: HELB waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nyandarua inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda ka hor inta aysan qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo rowere e County mar Nyandarua mondo onon weche ma gin-go mag ndiko joma oyier kapok gitimo gik ma biro timore ne oganda.

English: Teachers Service Commission establishes online forums for continuous professional support and resource sharing.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inaanzisha vikao vya mtandaoni kwa ajili ya msaada wa kuendelea wa kitaaluma na ushiriki wa rasilimali.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu aasaasayaa madalo internetka ah oo loogu talagalay taageero xirfadeed oo joogto ah iyo wadaagista kheyraadka.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission ochako chenro mar loso kuonde mitimoe chokruoge e intanet mondo okony ji obed gi lony e weche mag tiegruok.

English: Notice: IPOA activates an emergency response plan for drought in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ukame katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay hirgelinaysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo abaaraha ku dhaca gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA chako tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony e kinde oro e alwora mar Lamu County.

English: KEMRI reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa kurejesha matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageerada soo kabashada xadgudubka maandooriyaha ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: KEMRI paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tiyo gi yedhe mamero yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e Taita-Taveta County.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Homa Bay County that access to post-violence medical care is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu zinapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay gobolka Homa Bay in helitaanka daryeelka caafimaad ee rabshadda ka dib ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Homa Bay ni yudo kony mar thieth ma iyudo bang' timno onge chudo.

English: DPP warns residents of Turkana County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this July.
Kiswahili: DPP anawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Julai hii.
Somali: DPP waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay u diyaar garoobaan qaraxyo dab ah oo dhici kara bishii July.
Dholuo: DPP osiemo jogweng' mar Turkana County mondo oikre ne yiengni manyalo timore e dwe mar Julai.

English: AFA advises milk producers in Bungoma County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: AFA inashauri wazalishaji wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walio na leseni kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: AFA waxay kula talineysaa soosaarayaasha caanaha ee degmada Bungoma inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: AFA nyiso jopur mag chak e County mar Bungoma ni giusgi mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo chakre kinde keyo.

English: IPOA reminds residents of Bomet County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet in si deg deg ah u soo sheegidda dhac ay gacan ka geysaneyso in xaafadaha la ilaaliyo.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogweng'o mag Bomet County ni nyiso ji mapiyo ni ne gidonjo e odno konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds residents of Garissa County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Garissa in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone jogweng' mar County mar Garissa ni luwo dongruok mar tijno kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds expectant mothers in Laikipia County that access to skilled birth attendance is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kwamba upatikanaji wa mahudhurio ya uzazi wa ujuzi ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Laikipia in helitaanka daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfadlayaasha ah ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne mine ma biro nyuolo e County mar Laikipia ni thuolo mar yudo nyithindo ma nigi lony onge chudo e kuonde duto ma ji yudoree.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Taita-Taveta County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia laini ya bure ya EACC ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Taita-Taveta inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee EACC ee lacag la'aanta ah si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo oland weche mag mibadhi kokalo kuom hotline mar EACC maonge chudo mondo giked gi wuond mag yuto.

English: SHA urges eligible citizens in Nakuru County to participate in polling procedures.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawahimiza raia wanaostahiki katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kushiriki katika utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Nakuru inay ka qaybqaataan nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro mar donjo e kes mar Nakuru County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag yiero.

English: Notice: DCI conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Wajir County this December.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Wajir Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ku saabsan ka hortagga argagixisada degmada Wajir bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni DCI dhi timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Wajir e dwe mar Desemba.

English: IEBC updates residents of Migori County on progress of ward-level service delivery this May.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Migori juu ya maendeleo ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya Mei hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay dadka deggan degmada Migori ka wargelineysaa horumarka adeegga heerka degmada bisha May.
Dholuo: IEBC chiwo ripot ne jogweng' Migori County e wi dongruok mar chiwo kony e wi ward e dwe mar Mei.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds the public in Kilifi County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha raia wa Wilaya ya Kilifi kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Hay'adda garsoorka Kenya waxay dadka degmada Kilifi ku xasuusineysaa in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone ji duto manie gweng' mar Kilifi ni chiwo ripot mar kawo asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima yot, kendo en gima opondo.

English: IEBC advises residents of Siaya County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: IEBC inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: IEBC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay dalbadaan internetka iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogweng' County mar Siaya mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro kwayo mag ID mar piny.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by SHA (Social Health Authority) will be held in Nairobi County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu bila malipo iliyoandaliwa na SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ay soo qabanqaabisay SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Gobolka Nairobi bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth maonge chudo ma olos gi SHA (Social Health Authority) ibiro tim Nairobi County e dwe mar Mach.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Siaya County that access to SHA registration is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba ufikiaji wa usajili wa SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Siaya in helitaanka diiwaangelinta SHA hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone ji duto e county mar Siaya ni sani ginyalo yudo weche mag SHA e kuonde moketi.

English: Strong soaps can irritate baby's skin. Use mild, unscented options.
Kiswahili: Sabuni kali zinaweza kuwasha ngozi ya mtoto. Tumia chaguo laini, zisizo na harufu.
Somali: Saabuun adag ayaa cuncun ku keeni kara maqaarka ilmaha. Isticmaal ikhtiyaarro khafiif ah oo aan caraf lahayn.
Dholuo: Sabun ma nigi teko nyalo ketho dend nyathi. Ti kod gik ma ok ng’ich kendo ma onge ndhadhu.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will distribute certified sweet potatoes seed to farmers in Taita-Taveta County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu za viazi vitamu zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu abuurka baradho macaan oo shahaado leh u qaybin doonaa beeraleyda Gobolka Taita-Taveta bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Dairy Board biro pogo kodhi mag sweet potato ne jopur manie Taita-Taveta County e dwe mar Julai.

English: E-Citizen reminds residents of Machakos County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa jogweng' ma Machakos County ni luwo dongruok mar tich kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Notice: TVET launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET yazindua mpango wa kupinga uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay bilawday barnaamij ka dhan ah tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibta dugsiyada gobolka Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe mahundu e skunde duto e County mar Kirinyaga.

English: KNEC reminds needy students in Nakuru County that revision guides applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KNEC waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Nakuru in codsiyada dib-u-eegista ay dhowaan soo gabagabeyn doonaan.
Dholuo: KNEC parone jopuonjre man Nakuru County ma nigi chandruok ni lokruok mar gwelo kwayo mag kwayo mar dhi e skundno chiegni rumo.

English: ODPP reminds the public in Narok County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this December.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Narok kwamba maoni juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka ni ya kukaribishwa Desemba hii.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Narok in talooyinka dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: ODPP paronwa ji duto manie Narok County ni ji duto mor gi chiwo mar paro e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e dwe mar Desemba.
