English: Pest Control Products Board urges farmers in Kilifi County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa ku boorinaya beeraleyda degmada Kilifi inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo opidh cham mondo omi lowo okethre.

English: Notice: IPOA opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa marejeleo ya makazi salama katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay fureysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya talooyin ku saabsan magangelyo ammaan ah degmada Nyamira.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kuonde dak ma ji nyalo dakie e alwora mar Nyamira.

English: COMESA urges farmers in West Pokot County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka West Pokot inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo lagu soo ururiyo biyaha beeraha si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e West Pokot County mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok mar koth.

English: AATF trust that the technological awareness shall transform farming in Africa as demonstrated in other parts of the world.
Kiswahili: AATF huamini kwamba ufahamu wa kitekinolojia utabadili ukulima katika Afrika kama ionyeshwavyo katika sehemu nyinginezo za ulimwengu.
Somali: AATF waxay aaminsan tahay in wacyiga tiknoolajiyadeed uu beddeli doono beeraha Afrika sida lagu muujiyey qaybaha kale ee adduunka.
Dholuo: AATF oyie ni dongruok mar teknoloji biro loko ngima mar pur e Afrika mana kaka osenyisore e pinje mamoko e piny.

English: KRA advises residents of Narok County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: KRA inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e- Citizen.
Somali: KRA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Narok inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan diiwaangelinta e-citizen.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro dhi e e e - Citizen registration.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Kitui County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandaoni wa kaunti ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo ji duto modak Kitui County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county mar chiwo paro e wi tich mitimo higa ka higa.

English: KEPSSI partnered with NPS to train community policing committees across six Mombasa subÃ¢â‚¬â€˜counties combatting youth crime
Kiswahili: KEPSSI imeshirikiana na NPS kuzoeza halmashauri za polisi wa jamii katika wilaya sita za Mombasa kupambana na uhalifu wa vijana
Somali: KEPSSI waxay iskaashi la samaysay NPS si ay u tababarto guddiyada booliiska bulshada ee lix degmo oo hoos yimaada Mombasa si ay ula dagaallamaan dambiyada dhalinyarada.
Dholuo: KEPSSI notiyo kanyakla gi NPS mar puonjo komiti mag polisi mag gwenge e gwenge auchiel mag Mombasa ma kedo kod ketho mag joma tindo

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Migori County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Migori kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Migori in adeegyada bukaanka dibedda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa ji duto manie County mar Migori ni sani nitie kuonde ma ji yudoe thieth mag ambulatori.

English: ODPP urges residents of Kisumu County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waendelee kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja ya kaunti.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay la xiriiraan maamulaha qaybta maxalliga ah si ay uga warqabaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogweng'o mag Kisumu County mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jotelo mag gwenge ma gidakie mondo ging'e chenro mar dongruok mar gwenge duto.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free suicide prevention support is available through county health facilities in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kuzuia kujiua unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo ka hortagga ismiidaaminta laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Nyeri.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar geng'o ji kik donjre yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Nyeri.

English: Notice: KMTC launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Narok County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay bilawday barnaamij ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada iskuulada guud ahaan gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KMTC chako chenro mar rito nyithindo e skunde e skul duto mag Narok County.

English: NTSA calls on residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga dhaqdhaqaaq aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah si ay u taageeraan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: NTSA okwayo jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma rito sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e alwora mar tong'gi.

English: KRA reminds residents of Taita-Taveta County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kwamba upatikanaji wa utunzaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Taita-Taveta in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: KRA oparo ne jogweng' Taita-Taveta County ni koro yot yudo weche mag nyasi mar nyuol kokalo kuom chenro mag sirkal.

English: KTDA informs milk farmers in West Pokot County of new market linkage opportunities this September.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawafahamisha wakulima wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Septemba hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda caanaha ee Gobolka West Pokot fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KTDA nyiso jopur mag chak e West Pokot County kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Public notice: KEMSA will host a free diabetes screening outreach in Kwale County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMSA itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uchunguzi wa kisukari bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Kwale Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: KEMSA waxay martigelin doontaa baaritaanka bukaanka ee bilaashka ah ee degmada Kwale bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMSA biro timo kampen mar nono tuo mar sukari maonge chudo e provins mar Kwale e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: KEMSA confirms a dengue fever outbreak alert for Kirinyaga County. Residents are advised to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa homa ya dengue kwa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga. Wakazi wanashauriwa kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMSA waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka hargabka dengue ee Gobolka Kirinyaga. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagu taliyey.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KEMSA osenyiso ni nitie siem mar tuo mar dengue e kaunti mar Kirinyaga.

English: Notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will hold a depression awareness forum in Lamu County this October. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanya kongamano la uhamasishaji wa unyogovu katika Kaunti ya Lamu Oktoba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay qaban doontaa madasha wacyi galinta niyadjabka ee Gobolka Lamu bisha Oktoobar. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Rango Kendo Luwo Tuwo biro timo chokruok mar chiwo paro e wi tuoche e taon mar Lamu e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: NDMA urges the public in Kisii County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Kisii wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: NDMA waxay ugu baaqeysaa shacabka degmada Kisii inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo ji duto e County mar Kisii mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' weche mag wuond ma ne otimore e wi SIM-swap.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will open a tea collection centre in Samburu County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itafungua kituo cha kukusanya chai katika Kaunti ya Samburu Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xarun soo ururinta shaaha ka furi doontaa Gobolka Samburu bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Rapar: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro yawo soko mar chamo chai e county mar Samburu e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: NDMA opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa marejeleo salama makazi katika Bomet County.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay fureysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya talooyin ku saabsan magangelyo ammaan ah gobolka Bomet.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA ochako ofis ma wuoyo e wi weche mag nindruok, kendo ochiwo kony e wi kuonde dak e alwora mar Bomet County.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay furtay xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya daryeel caafimaad ka dib rabshadaha Degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony e weche thieth bang' timbe mahundu e county mar Vihiga.

English: KEPHIS advises fish producers in Murang'a County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inashauri wazalishaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kalluunka ee degmada Murang'a inay ka iibsadaan wax soo saarka kaliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KEPHIS nyiso jopur ma loso rech e County mar Murang'a ni gius rech mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo rech kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada iskuulada guud ahaan gobolka Nandi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission of Teachers Service chako chenro mar rito nyithindo e skunde e skul e alwora duto mar Nandi County.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds residents of Machakos County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba la muda mrefu.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan Degmada Machakos in ilaalinta ciidda ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board parone jopiny ma Machakos County ni rito lowo miyo puodho bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

Kiswahili: Ilitangazwa kwamba shule zilizo chini ya uongozi wa watu wa Yopung na jinsi wanavyoandaa uji...
Somali: Waxaa lagu dhawaaqay in iskuulada ay hogaaminayaan dadka yopung iyo sida ay u diyaariyaan bocorkaâ€¦.
Dholuo: Ne olando ni skul ma ni e bwo telo mar jo yopung kod kaka giloso poridgeâ€¦.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) urges millet growers in Isiolo County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda millet ee degmada Isiolo inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo miraha ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur ma pidho millet e County mar Isiolo mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: CDC launches a March awareness campaign on food safety across Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Machi juu ya usalama wa chakula katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: CDC waxay bilowday olole wacyi galineed oo ku saabsan badbaadada cuntada bishii Maarso ee Trans Nzoia County.
Dholuo: CDC chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Mach e wi wach rito chiemo e alwora duto mar Trans Nzoia County.

English: Pest Control Products Board warns wheat farmers in Embu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawaonya wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Embu juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa uga digaya beeraleyda wheat ee degmada Embu cudurrada cayayaanta waxayna kugula talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok, chiwo siem ne jopur mag ngano e county mar Embu kuom masiche mag hinyruok mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: IPOA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Taita-Taveta County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: IPOA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa qofkasta oo la kulmay xadgudubka Gobolka Taita-Taveta inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e Taita-Taveta County mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya litafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Kenya Gazette waxay qabaneysaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada ee degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Gazette biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e county mar Kericho.

English: CDC urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Taita-Taveta County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: CDC inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kumhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: CDC waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta inuu ku dhiirrigeliyo saaxiibkiisa dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag obwongo e Taita-Taveta County mondo ojiw osiepne moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: IEBC urges residents of Kajiado County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi wakazi wa Kajiado County kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha kusanyiko la kaunti ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada si ay uga warqabaan bixinta adeegyada heerka degmada.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo ji duto modak e Kajiado County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo ging'e weche ma biro timore e wi tiegruok mar migawono.

English: Men,its okay to talk about your mental health.Speaking up is a sign of strength.
Kiswahili: Wanaume, ni sawa kuzungumzia afya yako ya akili. Kuzungumza ni ishara ya nguvu.
Somali: Ragga, waa hagaag inaad ka hadasho caafimaadkaaga maskaxda. Hadalka waa calaamad xoog leh.
Dholuo: Un chwo, wuoyo e wi ngimau mar paro ok en gima rach. Wuoyo e wi wachno nyiso ni un gi teko.

English: OGP urges residents of Kericho County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda horumarinta degmada.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kericho mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo ging'e gik ma biro timore e wi dongruok mag county.

English: DPP alerts residents of Migori County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: DPP anawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Migori juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: DPP waxay dadka deggan degmada Migori uga digtay kororka kiisaska burburka waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: DPP chiwo siem ne jogweng' Migori County e wi medruok mar buch tho kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the public in Nyeri County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawahimiza raia wa Kaunti ya Nyeri wasiishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya shacabka degmada Nyeri inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ji duto e County mar Nyeri mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo weche mag chulo pesa mag miriambo.

English: Tharaka Nithi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Juni 2022
Somali: Degmada Tharaka Nithi: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Tharaka Nithi: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2022

English: Notice: NCPB will conduct a modern irrigation techniques workshop for farmers in Siaya County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itafanya warsha ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Siaya Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah ee beeraleyda degmada Siaya bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Rapar: NCPB biro timo tiegruok mar yore mag ywayo pi e kindegi ne jopur e county mar Siaya e dwe mar Septemba.

English: KICD encourages residents of Kakamega County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: KICD inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Somali: KICD waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kakamega inay ka qaybgalaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada si ay uga warqabaan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo jogweng' Kakamega County mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county mondo gibed molony e weche motudore gi ratiro mag chik.

English: Notice: KEMSA will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Nyandarua County this June. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA itafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Juni hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMSA waxay qabaneysaa madasha caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada ee gobolka Nyandarua bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMSA biro timo chokruok mar paro ne rowere e taon mar Nyandarua e dwe mar Jun. Ji duto mor.

English: Assessing partner alignment in support of the health information system in Kenya
Kiswahili: Kutathmini upatanishi wa washirika katika kuunga mkono mfumo wa taarifa za afya nchini Kenya
Somali: Qiimaynta iswaafajinta la-hawlgalayaasha si loo taageero nidaamka macluumaadka caafimaadka ee Kenya
Dholuo: Kuong’o tudruok mar jowete mondo okony sistem mar weche mag thieth e piny Kenya

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross issues a cybersecurity alert on SIM-swap fraud affecting residents of Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya umetoa onyo la usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM unaoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaamada SIM-swap ee saameeya dadka deggan Gobolka Samburu.
Dholuo: Rapar: Kenya Red Cross ogolo siem mar sirkal kuom wach wuond mar SIM-swap makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e county mar Samburu.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Kakamega County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kakamega inay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan bixinta adeegyada heerka degmada.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya ojiwo jogweng' Kakamega County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo omed ng'eyo weche ma timore e wi tiegruok mar gwenge.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Embu County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the July planting season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji Julai.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Embu inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur e county mar Embu mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e dwe mar Julai.

English: KALRO announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for poultry in Laikipia County this October.
Kiswahili: KALRO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa kuku katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Oktoba hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo bilaash ah oo cudurka Newcastle ah ee digaagga ee Gobolka Laikipia bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KALRO olando chenro mar thieth mar tuo mar Newcastle maonge chudo mar dhok e taon mar Laikipia e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free youth mental wellness support is available through county health facilities in Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa ustawi wa akili wa vijana unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Marsabit County.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar paro mar rowere yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Marsabit.

English: Did you know suicide is the 3rd leading cause of death among 15â€“-29 year olds? It's time to raise awareness and support mental health.
Kiswahili: Je, unajua kujiua ni chanzo cha tatu cha vifo miongoni mwa vijana wa miaka 15-29? Ni wakati wa kuongeza uelewa na kusaidia afya ya akili.
Somali: Ma ogtahay in is-dilku uu yahay sababta saddexaad ee ugu badan ee dhimashada dadka da'doodu u dhaxayso 15-29 sano? Waa waqtigii la wacyigelin lahaa oo la taageeri lahaa caafimaadka dhimirka.
Dholuo: Be ing'eyo ni nek ng'ato en gima kelo tho mar adek e kind joma hikgi 15â€“-29? En kinde mar keto ji e paro kendo siro thieth mar paro.

English: Notice: DPP opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Kajiado County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa simu ya GBV ya bure katika Kajiado County.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay furtay xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ee degmada Kajiado.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: DPP ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo simo maonge chudo mar GBV e Kajiado County.

English: KUCCPS invites youth in Nyandarua County to enroll for catering and hospitality training this September.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu Septemba hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nyandarua inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KUCCPS gwelo rowere e County mar Nyandarua mondo odonj e tiegruok mar chiemo kod rwako welo e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Kenya Dairy Board invites farmers in Nandi County to a free training on record keeping for farmers this April.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi kwa mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima Aprili hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa ku casuumay beeraleyda gobolka Nandi inay tababar bilaash ah ku sameeyaan diiwaangelinta beeralayda bisha April.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board ogwelo jopur e county mar Nandi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi rito rekod mag jopur dwe mar April.

English: KNEC conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in Nyeri County this March.
Kiswahili: KNEC inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Machi hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay bishii Maarso ku qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: KNEC timo romo mar tiego ji e wi ratiro mag chik e County mar Nyeri e dwe mar Mach.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Lamu County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada daadadka ka dhacay xilligan fatahaadda.
Dholuo: NDMA oparo ne jogweng' Lamu County ni kik giwuoth e kor yiedhi kod aoche ma pi opong'o.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges residents of Bomet County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Bomet wapewe huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya ayaa ku booriyay dadka deggan degmada Bomet in ay dalbadaan adeegyo aan la bixin laaluush si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo jogweng'o mag Bomet County mondo okonygi gi tij lendo maok gichulo asoya mondo giked gi asoya e migepe mag sirkal.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Busia County about the importance of hand hygiene for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Busia juu ya umuhimu wa usafi wa mikono kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay dadka degmada Busia ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda nadaafadda gacmaha ay u leedahay caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa ji duto e County mar Busia gimomiyo rito ler mar lwedo en gima dwarore ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Notice: AFA will train farmers in Kwale County on soil conservation this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale juu ya uhifadhi wa udongo Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kwale ee ku saabsan ilaalinta ciidda bisha Ogosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: AFA biro tiego jopur e Kaunti mar Kwale e wi rito lowo e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will open a tea collection centre in Bungoma County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itafungua kituo cha kukusanya chai katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay xarun soo uruurinaysa shaaha ka furi doontaa degmada Bungoma bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro chako loso chai e taon mar Bungoma e dwe mar Jun.

English: HELB urges youth in Marsabit County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: HELB waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Marsabit inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo rowere e county mar Marsabit mondo oriwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gichako timo tije mag sirkal.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Homa Bay County that access to post-violence medical care is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu zinapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ee ka dhacay gobolka Homa Bay in helitaanka daryeelka caafimaad ee rabshadda ka dib ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Homa Bay ni yudo kony mar thieth ma iyudo bang' timno onge chudo.

English: Expectant mothers should pack a clean birth kit by the 7th month of pregnancy for emergencies.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wajawazito wanapaswa kufunga vifaa vya kujifungulia vilivyo safi ifikapo mwezi wa 7 wa ujauzito kwa dharura.
Somali: Hooyooyinka uurka leh waxay u baahan yihiin inay xirtaan xirmo dhalashada nadiif ah bisha 7aad ee uurka ee xaaladaha degdegga ah.
Dholuo: Min nyithindo madwaro nyuol onego okaw kit nyuol maler e dwe mar abiriyo mar ichne mondo okonygi e kinde mag chandruok.

English: DPP calls on the community in Nyeri County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: DPP inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka kwa nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: DPP waxay bulshada degmada Nyeri ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan waxayna taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: DPP okwayo ji duto manie County mar Nyeri mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gidwar kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Notice: KEMSA will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Kitui County this May. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA itafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Kitui Mei hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMSA waxay qabaneysaa madasha caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada ee degmada Kitui bisha May. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMSA biro timo chokruok mar paro ne rowere e taon mar Kitui e dwe mar Mei.

English: National Drought Early Warning Bulletin (August 2023)
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Tahadhari ya Mapema ya Kitaifa (Agosti 2023)
Somali: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Qaranka (Ogosto 2023)
Dholuo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro (Agost 2023)

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) urges farmers in Kiambu County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kiambu inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e county mar Kiambu mondo opidh cham ma nyalo miyo lowo okethre mondo ginyagre gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Search where avocado is largely grown and mostly sold. This reduces transport cost and market availability among women farmers.
Kiswahili: Tafuta ambapo parachichi hupandwa kwa kiasi kikubwa na kuuzwa zaidi. Hii inapunguza gharama ya usafirishaji na upatikanaji wa soko kati ya wakulima wanawake.
Somali: Raadi meelaha ay ugu badan tahay in la beero avocado oo inta badan la iibiyo. Tani waxay yareyneysaa kharashka gaadiidka iyo helitaanka suuqa ee haweenka beeraleyda ah.
Dholuo: Many kuonde ma ipidhogo avocado kendo ma ng'enygi iusoe, mano miyo pesa ma itiyogo e wuoth koda ma jopur ma mon nyalo yudo e ohala odok chien.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges maize growers in Nyandarua County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kudhibiti minyoo mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee Gobolka Nyandarua inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka xilliga dayrta iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service ojiwo jopur mag mahinya e County mar Nyandarua mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma giyudo e higa mar 2020 mondo okony jolweny mag piny mondo oked gi kodhino chon ka gitiyo gi gik makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok.

English: Kenya Dairy Board invites farmers in Migori County to a free training on greenhouse farming this August.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo cha chafu Agosti hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa ku casuumay beeraleyda degmada Migori inay tababar lacag la'aan ah ku helaan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board ogwelo jopur mag Migori County e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar greenhouse agriculture e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will distribute certified rice seed to farmers in Lamu County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itasambaza mbegu za mpunga zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay abuurka bariiska ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda gobolka Lamu bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro pogo kodhi mag loso kodhi ne jopur e County mar Lamu e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: NDMA launches a fraud prevention campaign in Uasin Gishu County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga khiyaamooyinka degmada Uasin Gishu bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Rapar: NDMA chako kampen mar geng'o mibadhi e county mar Uasin Gishu e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: OGP announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: OGP inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kushughulikia vyeti vya kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: OGP waxay ku dhawaaqday waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay ka shaqeynta shahaadada dhalashada ee Gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: OGP olando lokruok e seche mag timo nonro mar nyuol e county mar Uasin Gishu.

English: KMTC encourages residents of Kirinyaga County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: KMTC jiwo jogweng' County mar Kirinyaga mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto giseyudo mondo ging'e kaka ji duto biro tiyo gi pesa mag county.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Kwale County about the importance of safe water storage for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kwale juu ya umuhimu wa uhifadhi wa maji salama kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMRI waxay dadka degmada Kwale ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMRI parone ji duto e county mar Kwale kuom ber mar kano pi maler e ngima joot.

English: KUCCPS urges youth in Migori County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Migori kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Migori inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo rowere mag Migori County mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gitimo gik ma biro timore ne oganda.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar paro e County mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Universities Fund urges residents of Kericho County to register their children at the nearest public school to benefit from adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu ili kufaidika na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha si ay uga faa'iideystaan fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo jogweng' mar Kericho County mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul mar sirkal man machiegni kodgi mondo giyud konyruok kuom tiegruok mar somo kod somo mar joma dongo.

English: Lamu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Lamu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2023
Somali: Degmada Lamu: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Lamu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Septemba 2023

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission launches a school infrastructure safety programme in schools across Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yazindua mpango wa usalama wa miundombinu ya shule katika shule kote Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij ku saabsan badbaadada kaabayaasha dugsiga ee dugsiyada gobolka Nyamira.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj chako chenro mar rito kuonde tiegruok mag skul e skunde duto e County mar Nyamira.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit appeals to caregivers in Taita-Taveta County to visit their nearest maternity wing as part of the December maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Desemba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha gobolka Taita-Taveta inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit okwayo jorit e Taita-Taveta County mondo olimgi machiegni gi kama gibiro yudoe nyithindo e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges motorists and pedestrians in Kajiado County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kufunga na kutunza vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Kajiado inay guryahooda rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa dhacdooyinka la xiriira qaraxyada dabka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo jorit mtokni kod joma wuotho gi tiendegi e Kajiado County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo gitim kinda mar geng'o hinyruok mag yiengni.

English: Notice: NTSA opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Narok County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa marejeleo salama ya makazi katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay fureysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya talooyin ku saabsan magangelyo ammaan ah Gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Riwruok ma nono weche mag nindruok (NTSA) oseyawo ofis mar weche weche nindruok ma chiwo kony e wi kuonde dak e alwora mar Narok County.

English: Notice: KTDA will conduct a greenhouse farming workshop for farmers in Kwale County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itafanya warsha ya kilimo cha chafu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo ee beeraleyda ee Gobolka Kwale bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA biro timo chokruok mar timo tijno ne jopur e gweng' mar Kwale e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds residents of Murang'a County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a in helitaanka adeegyada baasaboorka ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone jogweng' mar County mar Murang'a ni koro yot yudo passport services kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: IEBC invites youth in Meru County to enroll for electrical installation training this April.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Meru kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Aprili hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Meru inay iska diiwaangeliyaan tababarka rakibidda korontada bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: IEBC gwelo rowere e County mar Meru mondo odonj e tiegruok mar keto sitima e dwe mar April.

English: Council of Governors encourages first-time voters in Lamu County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawatia moyo wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku dhiirigelinayaan codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Lamu inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo jogo madwaro yiero e kinde mokwongo e County mar Lamu mondo onon weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: Notice: KEMRI confirms a measles outbreak alert for Wajir County. Residents are advised to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa surua kwa Kaunti ya Wajir. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka suuxdinta ee Gobolka Wajir. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakhda leh.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMRI osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuwono e gweng' mar Wajir. Ojiwo jogweng'no mondo otang' gi kuonde ma pi yudoree.

English: Kenya: Population Movement - 01-2024 - Baringo Insecurity (2024-03-27)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Harakati za Idadi ya Watu - 01-2024 - Ukosefu wa Usalama Baringo (2024-03-27)
Somali: Kenya: Dhaqdhaqaaqa Dadweynaha - 01-2024 - Baringo amni-darro (2024-03-27)
Dholuo: Kenya: Rieko mar kwan mar oganda - 01-2024 - Bedo gi arita mar Baringo (27-03-2024)

English: COMESA advises farmers in Kajiado County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kajiado inay iska diiwaangeliyaan tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qeybgalaan waxbarashada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e Kajiado County mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e tiego jopur mabiro.

English: FAO warns sweet potatoes farmers in Bomet County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: FAO inawaonya wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Bomet juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: FAO waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda baradho macaan ee degmada Bomet cudurrada cayayaanka ah waxayna ku talineysaa in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: FAO chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho adundo e county mar Bomet kuom masiche ma nyalo kelo tuoche kendo ojiwo ni otim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Ministry of Health announces SHA registration for residents of Kwale County starting this September.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatangaza usajili wa SHA kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kuanzia Septemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ku dhawaaqday diiwaangelinta SHA ee dadka deggan Gobolka Kwale laga bilaabo Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health olando SHA kad mar joma odak e county mar Kwale kochakore Septemba.

English: TSC reminds parents in Makueni County that school feeding programme registration is open this November.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba usajili wa mpango wa kulisha shule umefunguliwa Novemba hii.
Somali: TSC waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Makueni in diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga ay furan tahay bisha November.
Dholuo: TSC oparo ne jonyuol e gweng' mar Makueni ni chenro mar kwayo nyithindo chiemo e skul osechakore e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds farmers in Kiambu County of the ongoing modern irrigation techniques training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya mbinu za umwagiliaji za kisasa.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa xusuusinaya beeraleyda degmada Kiambu barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jopur e gweng' mar Kiambu chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar yore mag lero pi.

English: Ministry of Health reminds expectant mothers in Kericho County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Kericho in helitaanka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Kericho ni thuolo mar yudo puonj mag chenro mag ngima joot en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag oganda.

English: With no transport available and a six-hour journey on foot to reach care, she had no choice but to give birth at home, assisted only by a traditional birth attendant.
Kiswahili: Kwa kuwa hakukuwa na usafiri na mwendo wa saa sita kwa miguu kufika kwenye huduma, hakuwa na budi ila kujifungulia nyumbani, akisaidiwa na mkunga wa jadi pekee.
Somali: Iyada oo aan lahayn gaadiid iyo safar lix saacadood ah oo lug ah si ay u gaarto daryeelka, ma aysan haysan wax doorasho ah oo aan ahayn inay guriga ku umusho, iyadoo ay caawinayso oo keliya umuliso dhaqameed.
Dholuo: Kaka ne onge mtoka ma ne nyalo konye kendo ne okawo wuoth mar seche auchiel gi tiende mondo ochop kama ne omiye thieth, ne onge gima ne nyalo timo mak mana nyuolo nyathi e ot, kendo ne okonye mana gi ng’at ma ne konyogi e nyuolo nyathi kaka pile.

English: KEMSA announces outpatient services for residents of Embu County starting this February.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatangaza huduma za wagonjwa wa nje kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuanzia Februari hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa adeegyada bukaanka dibedda ee dadka deggan degmada Embu laga bilaabo Febraayo.
Dholuo: KEMSA ogolo chenro mar konyo jotuo e gwenge mag Embu County kochakore e dwe mar Februar.

English: HELB advises students in Meru County to collect materials from the county education office to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: HELB inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Meru kukusanya vifaa kutoka kwa ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Somali: HELB waxay ardayda degmada Meru kula talineysaa inay ka soo ururiyaan xogta xafiiska waxbarashada degmada si ay u helaan deeq waxbarasho ardayda u baahan.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jopuonjre manie County mar Meru mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar somo mar county mondo omi jopuonjre ma nigi chan oyud kony.

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages mothers in Mombasa County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Mombasa inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo mine man Mombasa County mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges youth in Samburu County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka Samburu waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Samburu inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda ka hor inta aysan qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education ojiwo rowere e county mar Samburu mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto gikwongo tiyogo ka pok gichako timo tije mag sirkal.

English: Notice: SHA launches the county integrated development plan in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Shirika la SHA linazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika wilaya ya Nakuru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Shirkadda SHA waxay bilawday qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Nakuru.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA chako chenro mar dongruok e alwora mar Nakuru County.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages residents of Turkana County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay u dhiiri galiyaan saaxiibo dhibaataysan inay caawimaad raadsadaan.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo jogweng' mar Turkana County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo gijiw osiepgi moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: Nyeri (Kieni) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Nyeri (Kieni): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Aprili 2024
Somali: Gobolka Nyeri (Kieni): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Nyeri (Kieni): Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Ang'wen higa mar 2024

English: Notice: AFA will train farmers in Lamu County on terracing this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu juu ya terracing Mei hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: AFA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda gobolka Lamu ku saabsan dhulka lagu beerayo bisha May ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: AFA biro tiego jopur e County mar Lamu e tiego lowo e dwe mar Mei.

English: KALRO reminds farmers in Bungoma County of the ongoing modern irrigation techniques training programme.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya mbinu za umwagiliaji.
Somali: KALRO waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Bungoma barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah.
Dholuo: KALRO parone jopur e County mar Bungoma chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar yore mag lero pi.

English: Nutritional Status of Refugees and Host children in Kenya (2025): Survey findings on child nutrition and immunization among refugee and host communities in Turkana Country and urban areas of Nairobi
Kiswahili: Hali ya Lishe ya Wakimbizi na Watoto Wahifadhi nchini Kenya (2025): Matokeo ya utafiti kuhusu lishe ya watoto na chanjo kati ya wakimbizi na jamii zinazowahifadhi katika Nchi ya Turkana na maeneo ya mijini ya Nairobi.
Somali: Xaaladda Nafaqada ee Qaxootiga iyo Carruurta Marti-gelinta ah ee Kenya (2025): Natiijooyinka sahanka ee ku saabsan nafaqada iyo tallaalka carruurta ee bulshooyinka qaxootiga iyo kuwa martida loo yahay ee ku nool Dalka Turkana iyo magaalooyinka Nairobi
Dholuo: 2025: Gik ma noyudore e nonro kuom chiemo ma nyithindo chamo kod chiwo thieth e kind jolweny kod jolweny ma rwakogi e piny Turkana kod kuonde ma nigi boma mag Nairobi

English: IPOA alerts residents of Busia County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Somali: IPOA waxay dadka deggan degmada Busia uga digtay kororka kiisaska tuugada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: IPOA chiwo siem ne ji modak e County mar Busia ni kwan mag joma ok oluor biro medore kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds residents of Kiambu County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti huimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu in raadinta horumarka mashruuca bogga degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone jogweng' Kiambu County ni luwo dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: NPS alerts residents of Bungoma County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Somali: NPS waxay dadka deggan degmada Bungoma uga digtay kororka kiisaska jabsashada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: NPS chiwo siem ne jogweng'o mag Bungoma County ni kwan mag joma odonjo e ot biro medore kendo ojiwo oganda mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: KEPHIS advises avocado producers in Embu County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawashauri wazalishaji wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Embu kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha avocado ee degmada Embu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur mag avocado e county mar Embu mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Tana River County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida katika maeneo ya mpakani kwa vyombo vya usalama huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa wa kukabiliana na ugaidi.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River County inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ilaalinta ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e alwora mar tong'gi e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi kuom weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

Kiswahili: Kenya | Mafuriko ya Mto - Ripoti ya Mwaka ya Itifaki ya Hatua ya Mapema (8-09-2023) Operesheni Ã¢Â„Â–: MDRKE053
Somali: Kenya | Daadadka Webiga - Warbixinta Sannadlaha ah ee Habraaca Tallaabada Hore (8-09-2023) Hawlgalka - MDRKE053
