English: Turkana County has introduced market days Kakuma on Tuesdays Lodwar on Thursdays and Lokichar Lokiriama on Saturdays to enhance market access and trade
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Turkana imeanzisha siku za soko za Kakuma Jumanne Lodwar siku ya Alhamisi na Lokichar Lokiriama siku ya Jumamosi ili kuimarisha ufikiaji wa soko na biashara.
Somali: Gobolka Turkana wuxuu soo bandhigay maalmaha suuqa ee Kakuma Talaadada Lodwar Khamiista iyo Lokichar Lokiriama Sabtida si loo xoojiyo helitaanka suuqa iyo ganacsiga
Dholuo: Turkana County osechako timo ohala e otas mar Kakuma e odiechienge mar Tich Ariyo Lodwar e odiechienge mar Tich Ariyo kod Lokichar Lokiriama e odiechienge mag Ngeso mondo okonyie yudo ohala kod ohala

English: Notice: DCI activates an emergency response plan for flooding in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ku saabsan fatahaadaha gobolka Bomet.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: DCI chako tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony ne pi e gweng' mar Bomet.

English: Beyond the numbers: the real-world impact of the malaria vaccine in Kenya
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya idadi: athari halisi ya dunia ya chanjo ya malaria nchini Kenya
Somali: Ka baxsan tirooyinka: saameynta dhabta ah ee tallaalka duumada ee Kenya
Dholuo: Ka ok okalo namba: ber mar chanjo mar maleria e piny Kenya

English: COMESA promotes water harvesting among farmers in Siaya County as part of the July climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: COMESA inakuza uvunaji wa maji miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Siaya kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Julai.
Somali: COMESA waxay dhiirrigelisay goosashada biyaha beeraleyda degmada Siaya iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee bisha July.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo tij choko pi e kind jopur e county mar Siaya kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo kinda mar timo lokruok e kit yamo e dwe mar Julai.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) announces free medical camps for residents of Trans Nzoia County starting this April.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuanzia Aprili hii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa ku dhawaaqday xeryo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia laga bilaabo Abriil.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) ogolo kampen mag thieth maonge chudo ne jogweng' Trans Nzoia County kochakore April.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Kitui County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui in si deg deg ah u soo sheegidda tuugada ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne jogweng' Kitui County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo kuom nek konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: NTSA urges motorists and pedestrians in Bungoma County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa wadayaasha gawaarida iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Bungoma inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay adeegsadaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee socodka si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira qaraxyada dabka.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo jorit mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Bungoma mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe mondo gikwed hinyruok mar yiengni.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on the community in Tharaka-Nithi County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka kwa nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan isla markaana ay taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oluongo oganda man Tharaka-Nithi County mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: KEMSA launches a May awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Kisii County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Mei juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Maajo oo ku saabsan wacyiga cadaadiska sare ee degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: KEMSA ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Mei e wi wach remo mang'eny e gweng' mar Kisii.

English: KICD reminds youth in Taita-Taveta County that HELB funding is available for welding and fabrication training.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Taita-Taveta in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne rowere man Taita-Taveta County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing.

English: "Fake humanitarian campaigns using stolen photos have been flagged on Twitter. Always verify fundraisers through trusted platforms like M-Changa or Red Cross Kenya."
Kiswahili: "Kampeni bandia za kibinadamu zinazotumia picha zilizoibwa zimewekwa alama kwenye Twitter. Daima uthibitishe misaada kupitia majukwaa ya kuaminika kama M-Changa au Msalaba Mwekundu Kenya".
Somali: "Waxaa Twitter-ka lagu calaamadeeyay ololeyo bani'aadamnimo oo been abuur ah oo isticmaalaya sawirro la xaday. Had iyo jeer xaqiiji ururinta maalgelinta iyada oo loo marayo barnaamijyo la isku halleyn karo sida M-Changa ama Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya".
Dholuo: "Kampen mag konyo ji ma ok kare ma gitiyo gi piche mokwal osekethi e Twitter. Kinde duto tim nonro kuom joma choko pesa kokalo kuom kuonde ma igeno kaka M-Changa kata Red Cross Kenya".

English: Council of Governors encourages first-time voters in Nakuru County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku dhiirigelinayaan codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Nakuru inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo joma okwongo yiero e Kaunti mar Nakuru mondo onon weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: Kenya celebrates immunization as more children are reached with RTS,S | WHO | Regional Office for Africa Kenya celebrates immunization as more children are reached with RTS,S Kenya this week joins the world to commemorate the African Vaccination week (World Immunization Week) as well as the World Malaria Day on April 25, 2023.
Kiswahili: Kenya inasherehekea chanjo huku watoto zaidi wakifikiwa na RTS,S | WHO | Ofisi ya Kanda ya Afrika Kenya inaadhimisha chanjo huku watoto zaidi wakifikiwa na RTS,S Kenya wiki hii inaungana na ulimwengu kuadhimisha wiki ya Chanjo ya Afrika (Wiki ya Chanjo Duniani) pamoja na Siku ya Malaria Duniani mnamo Aprili 25, 2023.
Somali: Kenya waxay u dabaaldegtay tallaalka iyadoo carruur badan la gaarsiiyay RTS,S | WHO | Xafiiska Gobolka ee Afrika Kenya ayaa u dabaaldegtay tallaalka iyadoo carruur badan la gaarsiiyay RTS,S Kenya toddobaadkan waxay ku biirtay adduunka si loo xuso toddobaadka Tallaalka Afrika (Toddobaadka Tallaalka Adduunka) iyo sidoo kale Maalinta Duumada Adduunka ee Abriil 25, 2023.
Dholuo: Kenya timo nyasi mar chiwo thieth mar thieth kaka nyithindo mang’eny chopo gi RTS,S | NG’ANO | Ofis mar piny Afrika Kenya timo nyasi mar chiwo chanjo kaka nyithindo mang’eny yudore gi RTS. Kenya jumani kae oriwore gi piny mangima mar paro juma mar chiwo chanjo e piny Afrika (Jumapil mar chiwo chanjo e piny mangima) kaachiel gi odiechieng’ mar chiwo chanjo e piny mangima tarik 25 dwe mar ang’wen higa mar 2023.

English: IEBC invites youth in Kitui County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this July.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kitui kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Julai hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kitui inay iska diiwaangeliyaan tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: IEBC gwelo rowere ma Kitui County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya - Flash floods (Kenya Met, media) (ECHO Daily Flash of 06 April 2023)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Mafuriko makubwa (Kenya Met, vyombo vya habari) (ECHO Daily Flash ya 06 Aprili 2023)
Somali: Kenya - Daadad xooggan (Kenya Met, warbaahinta) (ECHO Daily Flash ee 06 Abriil 2023)
Dholuo: Kenya - Pi ma pong'o piny (Kenya, weche mag mbui) (ECHO mapong'o piny tarik 06 dwe mar ang'wen higa mar 2023)

English: Notice: CDC confirms a Rift Valley Fever outbreak alert for Narok County. Residents are advised to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ilani: CDC inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa kwa Kaunti ya Narok. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Ogaysiis: CDC waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ku saabsan cudurka Rift Valley Fever ee Gobolka Narok. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuoche mar Rift Valley Fever (Rift Valley fever) wacho ni joma odak e gweng' mar Narok onego oti gi gige tuoche mag kute otieno ka otieno.

English: Council of Governors reminds the public in Elgeyo-Marakwet County that reporting embezzlement of public funds is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa fedha za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay dadweynaha degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet ku xasuusinayaan in warbixinta xadgudubka lacagaha dawladda ay tahay mid bilaash ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch parone ji duto e County mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni chiwo ripot mar ketho pesa mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Notice: TVET launches a school infrastructure safety programme in schools across Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET yazindua mpango wa usalama wa miundombinu ya shule katika shule kote Kaunti ya Tana River.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay bilawday barnaamij ku saabsan badbaadada kaabayaasha dugsiga ee dugsiyada gobolka Tana River.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET chako chenro mar rito kuonde tiegruok mag skul e skunde duto mag Tana River County.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Homa Bay County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the June planting season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Juni.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Homa Bay inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagyada si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda ka hor xilliga beerashada Juun.
Dholuo: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e county mar Homa Bay mondo otim lokruok e puothe mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak e dwe mar Jun.

English: Kwale County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kwale: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Mei 2024
Somali: Degmada Kwale: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kwale: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar Mei 2024

English: TVET advises applicants in Nairobi County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: TVET waxay ku talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Nairobi inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee la heli karo.
Dholuo: TVET nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e taon mar Nairobi ni mondo gidhi e skul man machiegni kodgi mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: Announcing roll out of countywide Vitamin A supplementation & deworming for 12,000+ children under five with outreach and ECD support in Kiambu County
Kiswahili: Kutangaza uzinduzi wa nyongeza ya Vitamini A na dawa za minyoo katika kaunti nzima kwa watoto zaidi ya 12,000 walio chini ya umri wa miaka mitano kwa usaidizi wa uhamasishaji na ECD katika Kaunti ya Kiambu
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida bixinta kaabista Vitamin A ee gobolka oo dhan & ka saarista cayayaanka 12,000 + caruur ah oo ka yar shan sano oo leh taageero wacyi galineed iyo ECD ee degmada Kiambu
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova e piny mangima ogolo chiwo mar Vitamin A ne nyithindo ma johigni 12 000 gi wiye ma hikgi okalo abich, kendo gichiwo kony e weche mag thieth kod thieth e gweng' mar Kiambu

English: Ministry of Health announces subsidised dialysis for residents of West Pokot County starting this January.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuanzia Januari hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ku dhawaaqday in laga bilaabo Janaayo la siinayo deebaajiyo loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada West Pokot.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health olando thieth mar dialysis makonyo jokanyo mag West Pokot County kochakore Januar ma kawuono.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds expectant mothers in Tharaka-Nithi County that access to free antenatal care is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma ya ujauzito bila malipo ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi in helitaanka daryeelka dhalmada ee bilaashka ah ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne mine ma nigi ich e Tharaka-Nithi County ni yudo rit ma onge chudo e nyim nyuol en gima nono e kuonde duto mag oganda.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association will hold a trauma counselling forum in Narok County this February. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitafanya kongamano la ushauri wa kiwewe katika Kaunti ya Narok Februari hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha la talinta dhaawaca ee Gobolka Narok bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni Kenya Medical Association biro timo chokruok mar chiwo paro e wi tuoche e taon mar Narok e dwe mar Februar.

English: Currently there is no vaccine to prevent COVID-19 infection. The only way to prevent it, is to avoid being exposed to the virus. avoid touching your eyes, nose & mouth. cough & sneeze into your elbow avoid handshaking stay home & wash your hands often #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Kwa sasa hakuna chanjo ya kuzuia maambukizi ya COVID-19. Njia pekee ya kuzuia, ni kuepuka kuwa wazi kwa virusi. epuka kugusa macho, pua na mdomo wako. kohoa na kupiga chafya kwenye kiwiko cha mkono epuka kupeana mikono kaa nyumbani na osha mikono yako mara kwa mara #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Hadda ma jiro tallaal looga hortago caabuqa COVID-19. Sida kaliya ee looga hortagi karo waa inaad ka fogaato inaad la kulanto fayraska. Iska ilaali inaad taabato indhahaaga, sankaaga iyo afkaaga. Ku qufac oo ku hindhiso xusulkaaga iska ilaali inaad gacan qaaddo. Joog guriga oo gacmahaaga si joogto ah u dhaq #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Kuom sani onge chanjo mar geng'o tuo mar COVID-19. Yo achiel kende mar geng’o, en bedo mabor gi bedo gi midhusi. weyo mulo wang’i, um kod dhok. ahonda kod ichot ei goki mari geng' goyo lwedo bed pacho kendo lok lweti kinde ka kinde # KomeshaCorona

English: Nyeri (Kieni) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Nyeri (Kieni): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Mei 2024
Somali: Degmada Nyeri (Kieni): War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Nyeri (Kieni): Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar abich higa mar 2024

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds the public in Siaya County to remain vigilant on counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay dadka degmada Siaya ku xasuusineysaa inay ka feejignaadaan ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne ji duto e county mar Siaya ni mondo gisik ka girito weche makedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Ministry of Education encourages residents of Kitui County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jogweng' Kitui County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda mondo ging'e weche motudore gi ratiro mag chik.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public in Nyandarua County that access to subsidised dialysis is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba upatikanaji wa dialysis ya ruzuku sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nyandarua in helitaanka dialysis-ka la taageeray hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche parone ji duto e County mar Nyandarua ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mar dialysis e kuonde moyier.

English: Interactive learning spaces
Kiswahili: Mazingira ya kujifunza ya maingiliano
Somali: Meelaha waxbarasho ee isdhexgalka leh
Dholuo: Puonjruok e yore mopogore opogore

English: COMESA reminds residents of Nyandarua County that organic farming improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba kilimo hai kinaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba la muda mrefu.
Somali: COMESA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Nyandarua in beeraha dabiiciga ah uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: COMESA paronwa jogweng' Nyandarua County ni pur ma nigi yien ma ok oketie yien miyo puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: COMESA announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for sheep in Homa Bay County this November.
Kiswahili: COMESA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Novemba hii.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee idaha ee gobolka Homa Bay bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: COMESA ogolo chenro mar thiedho rombo e dwe mar Novemba e Homa Bay County.

English: Notice: IEBC announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Machakos County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Machakos.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta dugsiyada dugsiga sare ee Machakos County.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IEBC ogolo chenro mar dhi e sekondari e odiechieng' maonge chudo e skunde mag Machakos County.

English: IPOA alerts residents of Nakuru County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: IPOA waxay uga digtay dadka deggan degmada Nakuru kororka kiisaska gaadiidka la xaday waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: IPOA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nakuru County e wi medruok mar wach kwalo mtokni kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: To treat fodder tree seeds such as Leucaena using the hot-water method, pour plenty of boiling water over the seeds and stir gently for 2-5 minutes - do not soak too long, as hot water can kill the seeds - then pour off the hot water, replace it with cool water, and let the seeds soak for 12 hours until they swell visibly.
Kiswahili: Ili kutibu mbegu za miti ya lishe kama vile Leucaena kwa kutumia njia ya maji ya moto, mimina maji mengi ya moto juu ya mbegu na koroga kwa upole kwa dakika 2-5 - usiloweke kwa muda mrefu, kwani maji ya moto yanaweza kuua mbegu - kisha mimina maji ya moto, ubadilishe na maji baridi, na uache mbegu ziloweke kwa masaa 12 hadi zivimbe wazionekane.
Somali: Si aad u daaweyso miraha geedaha quudinta sida Leucaena adoo isticmaalaya habka biyaha kulul, ku shubi biyo badan oo kulayl badan oo ku dul daadinaya miraha oo si tartiib tartiib ah u dhaqdhaqaaqo 2-5 daqiiqo - ha ku qoyaan waqti dheer, maadaama biyo kulul ay dili karaan miraha - ka dibna ku shubi biyo kulul, ku beddelo biyo qabow, oo u oggolow miraha inay qoyaan 12 saacadood ilaa ay si muuqata u dhoofiyaan.
Dholuo: Mondo iti gi pi mang'ich e loso kodhi mag yiende ma loso chiemo kaka Leucaena, ket pi mang'eny ma ng'ich e wi kodhi kendo ilosgi mos kuom dakika 2-5 - kik iket pi mang'eny ahinya nikech pi mang'ich nyalo nego kodhi - kae to ilos pi mang'ich, ilos gi pi mang'ich, kae to iwe kodhi mondo omol kuom seche 12 nyaka chop kama pi mang'ichno bedo marach.

English: State Department for Basic Education advises students in Bomet County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access revision guides.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Bomet kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kufikia miongozo ya marekebisho.
Somali: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka Bomet waxay ardayda ku talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan hagaha dib-u-eegista.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education nyiso jopuonjre e county mar Bomet mondo oketgi e intanet mondo giyud gweth mar somo.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya launches ward-level service delivery in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inazindua huduma za huduma katika wilaya ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay bilawday bixinta adeegyada heerka degmada ee gobolka Mombasa.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Huduma Kenya chako chiwo kony e alwora mar Mombasa County.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Kericho County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda horumarinta degmada.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kericho mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo omed ng'eyo weche momedore e wi chenro mag dongruok e county.

English: TVET urges residents of Kakamega County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: TVET waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo ji duto modak e Kaunti mar Kakamega mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud somo mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette opens a new service point for passport services in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Kenya Gazette waxay furaysaa goob adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Gazette oseyawo kama itimoe tije mag kawo kad e County mar Bungoma.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association confirms a tuberculosis outbreak alert for Nyandarua County. Residents are advised to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari Kenya chathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa kifua kikuu katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xaqiijiyay digniin ku saabsan faafitaanka cudurka 'tuberculosis' ee Gobolka Nyandarua. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isticmaalaan shabaqa cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Medical Association osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuberculosis e kaunti mar Nyandarua.

English: Climate-smart agriculture (CSA) is agriculture that sustainably increases productivity, resilience (adaptation), reduces/removes green house gases ...
Kiswahili: Kilimo cha hali ya hewa (CSA) ni kilimo ambacho huongeza tija, uthabiti (kukabiliana na hali ya hewa), hupunguza/kuondoa gesi za kijani kibichi ...
Somali: Beeraha cimilada ku saleysan (CSA) waa beeraha si joogto ah u kordhiya wax-soo-saarka, adkeysiga (la qabsashada), yareeya/ka saara gaasaska aqalka dhirta ...
Dholuo: Tij pur mariek e weche mag lokruok e kor lwasi (Climate-Smart Agriculture - CSA) en tich ma miyo ji bedo gi nyak, ginyalo nyagore gi pek mag yuto, ginyalo tieko chwero gas mag greenhouse gas...

English: CDC advises residents of Kirinyaga County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: CDC inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: CDC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun iyo biyo nadiif ah si joogto ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo jogweng' Kirinyaga County mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Nandi County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kuunga mkono halmashauri za ndani za kujenga amani wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nandi inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng'o mag Nandi County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi kuom rito tong'.

English: HELB advises students in Busia County to register early to secure allocation to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: HELB inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Busia kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Somali: HELB waxay ardayda degmada Busia kula talineysaa inay horay u diiwaangeliyaan si ay u helaan deeq deeq waxbarasho oo loogu talagalay ardayda u baahan.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jopuonjre e County mar Busia mondo odonj e skundno chon mondo giyud pesa ma ginyalo tiyogo e yudo osuru ne jopuonjre ma nigi chan.

English: Notice: DCI activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay shilalka waddooyinka ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Rapar: DCI tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne masiche ma timore e ndara e gweng' mar Taita-Taveta.

English: The US government's freeze on foreign aid, especially through USAid has caused major disruptions in Kenya's health sector, particularly in HIV, malaria, and tuberculosis programmes that heavily rely on donor support.
Kiswahili: Kusitishwa kwa misaada ya kigeni na serikali ya Marekani, hasa kupitia USAid, kumesababisha usumbufu mkubwa katika sekta ya afya ya Kenya, hasa katika programu za VVU, malaria, na kifua kikuu ambazo hutegemea sana msaada wa wafadhili.
Somali: Joojinta dowladda Mareykanka ee gargaarka dibadda, gaar ahaan iyada oo loo marayo USAID, ayaa carqalad weyn ku keentay waaxda caafimaadka ee Kenya, gaar ahaan barnaamijyada HIV, duumada, iyo qaaxada oo si weyn ugu tiirsan taageerada deeq-bixiyeyaasha.
Dholuo: Kaka sirkal mar Amerka ogeng’o kony ma wuok e pinje ma oko, ahinya ahinya kokalo kuom USAid, osekelo ywak maduong’ e sekta mar thieth e piny Kenya, ahinya ahinya e chenro mag HIV, maleria, kod tuoche mag ng’ut ma geno ahinya kuom kony ma jochiw kony.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages mothers in Siaya County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Siaya kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku dhiirigelisay hooyooyinka degmada Siaya inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit jiwo mine e county mar Siaya mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya alerts residents of Isiolo County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo kuhusu kuongezeka kwa visa vya wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya ayaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo uga digtay kororka kiisaska burcad-badeedda waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Communications Authority chiwo siem ne jogweng' Isiolo County ni kwan mag joma odonjo e odno medore kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Kenya - Key Message Update: Persistent food insecurity in pastoral areas ahead of below-average short rains season, September 2025
Kiswahili: Kenya - Taarifa Muhimu ya Ujumbe: Uhaba wa chakula unaoendelea katika maeneo ya wafugaji kabla ya msimu wa mvua fupi za chini ya wastani, Septemba 2025
Somali: Kenya - Cusbooneysiinta Fariinta Muhiimka ah: Cunto la'aan joogto ah oo ka jirta meelaha daaqsinka ah ka hor xilliga roobka gaaban ee ka hooseeya celceliska, Sebtembar 2025
Dholuo: Kenya - Oda Maduong’: Bedo gi chiemo ma ok orum e gwenge mag jokwath kapok kinde mag koth machuok ma ok okalo pile, Septemba 2025

English: KRA urges residents of Kwale County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia wavuti ya kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya utoaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan bixinta adeegyada heerka degmooyinka.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo jogweng' Kwale County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono ka gitiyo gi websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche ma timore e wi tiegruok mar gwenge.

English: FAO urges sorghum growers in West Pokot County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda sorghum ee degmada West Pokot in ay horumariyaan cayayaanka xilliga dayrta iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma pidho sorghum e West Pokot County mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma giyudo e higa mar 2015 mondo okony e loyo chwanyruok mar jolweny e kinde machuok ka gitiyo gi tuoche makelo hinyruok mondo gimi nyak e higani.

English: Substance abuse is a significant factor that can increase the risk of suicide,as it often exacerbates mental health issues and impairs judgment. Addressing substance abuse can significantly reduce the risk of suicide and improve overall mental health outcomes.
Kiswahili: Matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya ni sababu muhimu ambayo inaweza kuongeza hatari ya kujiua, kwani mara nyingi huzidisha matatizo ya afya ya akili na kuharibu hukumu.
Somali: Isticmaalka maandooriyaha waa arrin muhiim ah oo kordhin karta halista isdilka,maadaama ay inta badan sii xoojineyso arrimaha caafimaadka dhimirka iyo xukumada.Ka hortagga isticmaalka daroogada ayaa si weyn u yareyn kara halista isku dilka isla markaana hagaajin kara natiijooyinka guud ee caafimaadka maskaxda.
Dholuo: Tiyo marach gi yedhe ma mero ji en gima duong' manyalo miyo ng'ato odonj e timbego, nimar kinde mang'eny mano miyo weche mag thieth mar paro omedo bedo maricho kendo ketho ng'ado bura.

English: COMESA advises farmers in West Pokot County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuleta nambari yao ya usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda gobolka West Pokot inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qayb galaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e West Pokot County mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: Maize farmers are urged to inspect their fields regularly and spray recommended pesticides upon detecting fall armyworm larvae.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa mahindi wanaombwa kukagua mashamba yao mara kwa mara na kupiga dawa sahihi mara wanapoona mabuu ya viwavi jeshi (armyworms).
Somali: Beeralayda galleyda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay si joogto ah u baaraan beerahooda oo ay ku buufiyaan sunta cayayaanka ee lagu taliyay marka ay ogaadaan dirxiga gooryaanka dayrta.
Dholuo: Jopur mag cham ojiw mondo otim nonro e puothegi kinde ka kinde kendo opur yath ma ji dwaro ni otigodo ka gifwenyo ni nitie winyo ma ng’ato nyalo ng’ado.

English: Notice: KALRO will open an avocado collection centre in Machakos County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya parachichi katika Kaunti ya Machakos Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay ka furi doontaa xarun ururinta avocado ee degmada Machakos bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KALRO biro yawo ot mar choko avocado e gweng' mar Machakos e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Kenya: El Nino Flash Floods Rapid Needs Assessment - November 2023
Kiswahili: Kenya: Tathmini ya Mahitaji ya Haraka ya El Nino - Novemba 2023
Somali: Kenya: Qiimaynta Baahida Degdegga ah ee El Nino ee Daadadka - Noofambar 2023
Dholuo: Kenya: Rang'o Dwaro Mapiyo Mapiyo mar El Nino - Apar mar Apar 2023

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette opens voter registration centres in Taita-Taveta County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linafungua vituo vya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Kenya Gazette waxay furaysaa xarumaha diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Gazette biro yawo kuonde ma ji dhiyoe ne joma oyier e Taita-Taveta County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Kajiado County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for December 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kajiado: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Desemba 2023
Somali: Degmada Kajiado: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Diseembar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kajiado: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2023

English: SHA announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kushughulikia vyeti vya kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Shirkadda SHA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa in la hagaajiyo waqtiga wareejinta shahaadada dhalashada ee degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: SHA olando lokruok e seche mag timo nonro mag nyasi mag nyuol e taon mar Baringo.

English: NPS reminds mobile money users in Kisumu County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kisumu inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: NPS paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e County mar Kisumu ni mondo ging'e kwayo mag pesa kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo gitang' gi weche mag phishing.

English: KALRO encourages farmers in Bungoma County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for horticultural produce.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za mazao ya bustani.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Bungoma inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay wax soo saarka beeraha.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Bungoma mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar olembe mag puodho.

English: State Department for Basic Education advises students in Nakuru County to collect materials from the county education office to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kukusanya vifaa kutoka ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ardayda degmada Nakuru kula talineysaa inay ka soo ururiyaan agabyada xafiiska waxbarashada ee degmada si ay u helaan buugaag iyo agab waxbarasho.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education nyiso jopuonjre e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar somo mar gweng'no mondo giyud buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok.

English: Equal Partnerships: African Intermediary Cities as Actors and Partners in Urban Migration Governance - City Report: Garissa, Kenya
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano Sawa: Miji ya Kati ya Afrika kama Watendaji na Washirika katika Utawala wa Uhamiaji Mijini - Ripoti ya Jiji: Garissa, Kenya
Somali: Iskaashiga Sinnaanta: Magaalooyinka Dhexdhexaadinta Afrika sida Jilayaasha iyo La-hawlgalayaasha Maamulka Socdaalka Magaalooyinka - Warbixinta Magaalada: Garissa, Kenya
Dholuo: <2Zepa> Ripot mar Bombe maromre: Bombe ma Afrika kaka Jotugo kendo Jokonyruok e Loch mar Jodak e Bombe - Ripot mar Bombe: Garissa, Kenya

English: Notice: COMESA will open a maize collection centre in Kajiado County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mahindi katika Kaunti ya Kajiado Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay ka furi doontaa xarun ururinta hadhuudhka ee Gobolka Kajiado bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA biro yawo kambi mar choko cham e Kajiado County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Isiolo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Isiolo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2024
Somali: Degmada Isiolo: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Isiolo: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Septemba 2024

English: TVET reminds schools in Uasin Gishu County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this August.
Kiswahili: TVET inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Agosti hii.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada gobolka Uasin Gishu inay xoojiyaan adeegyada hagista iyo la-talinta bisha Ogosto.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa skunde mag Uasin Gishu County mondo omed jiwo kendo chiwo kony e dwe mar Agost.

English: Malaria's gendered burden: Recent floods heighten risk for women, girls
Kiswahili: Mzigo wa Malaria kwa jinsia: Mafuriko ya hivi karibuni yaongeza hatari kwa wanawake na wasichana
Somali: Culeyska galmada ee Cudurka Malaria: Daadadkii ugu dambeeyay ayaa kordhinaya halista haweenka iyo gabdhaha
Dholuo: Chandruok mar tuo mar malaria nikech dichwo gi dhako: Ataro ma nyocha otimore miyo mon kod nyiri bedo gi hinyruok mang'eny

English: Communications Authority of Kenya alerts residents of Siaya County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya juu ya kuongezeka kwa visa vya wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya ayaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya uga digtay kororka kiisaska xoolaha lagu xado waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya maloso weche mag tudruok chiwo siem ne ji modak e county mar Siaya e wi medruok mar weche mag kwalo jamni kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot e stesen mar polise man machiegni.

English: E-Citizen reminds the public in Kisumu County that reporting embezzlement of public funds is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa fedha za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kisumu in warbixinta xadgudubka lacagaha dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa ji duto e County mar Kisumu ni chiwo ripot mar ketho pesa mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: SHA warns public officers in Laikipia County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: SHA inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia dhidi ya kupotosha fedha za umma.
Somali: SHA waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Laikipia inay ka xishoodaan dhaqaale dawladeed.
Dholuo: SHA chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Laikipia ni kik giti gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo e yo marach.

English: Information archiving in a technology is important for farmers to reach other farmers, potentcal buyers, and influential sellers and buyers of their products., good living...
Kiswahili: Uhifadhi wa habari katika teknolojia ni muhimu kwa wakulima kufikia wakulima wengine, wanunuzi wenye nguvu, na wauzaji na wanunuzi wenye ushawishi wa bidhaa zao., maisha mazuri...
Somali: Kaydinta macluumaadka ee tiknoolajiyada waa muhiim beeraleyda si ay u gaaraan beeraleyda kale, iibsadayaal awood leh, iyo iibiyeyaasha iyo iibsadayaasha saameynta leh ee alaabtooda., nolol wanaagsan...
Dholuo: Weche ma ji yudo ka gitiyo gi teknoloji konyo ahinya e konyo jopur mondo obed gi thuolo mar yudo pesa moa kuom jopur mamoko, joma nyalo nyiewo gik moko, koda joma nigi teko e uso gik ma giuso.

English: Kenya Medical Association calls on parents in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to have children under five screened for malaria during the November outreach.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuwafanyia watoto chini ya miaka mitano uchunguzi wa malaria wakati wa mawasiliano ya Novemba.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqay waalidiinta degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka malaria inta lagu gudajiro bisha November.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association kwayo jonyuol e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo onyis nyithindo ma hikgi tin ne abich ni gin gi malaria e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Meru County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa usaidizi wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow si ay uga caawiyaan helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ee lacageed.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso jogweng' mar County mar Meru mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni mondo giyud kony mar yudo kony kuom weche thieth.

English: Ministry of Education reminds parents in Uasin Gishu County that bursary allocation registration is open this June.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba usajili wa ugawaji wa bursari umefunguliwa Juni hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta gobolka Uasin Gishu in diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ay furan tahay bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok oparo ne jonyuol e county mar Uasin Gishu ni kad mar yudo mich mag tiegruok osechakore e dwe mar Jun.

English: ODPP warns public officers in Nairobi County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: ODPP inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: ODPP waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Nairobi khiyaanooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: ODPP chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e County mar Nairobi kuom timbe mag mibadhi.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges youth in Embu County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Embu kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa ku boorinaya dhalinyarada degmada Embu inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada rayidka ah ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada rayidnimada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo rowere e county mar Embu mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok ochopo tije mag oganda.

English: Proving that disability is not inability: Creating job opportunities in agriculture for youth with disabilities in Kenya [EN/AR/RU/ZH]
Kiswahili: Kuthibitisha kwamba ulemavu sio kutokuwa na uwezo: Kuunda nafasi za kazi katika kilimo kwa vijana wenye ulemavu nchini Kenya [EN/AR/RU/ZH]
Somali: Caddeynta in naafanimadu aysan ahayn awood la'aan: Abuuritaanka fursado shaqo oo beeraha ah oo loogu talagalay dhalinyarada naafada ah ee Kenya [EN/AR/RU/ZH]
Dholuo: Kuong’o ni bedo gi nyalruok ok en bedo maonge nyalo: Loso thuolo mag tich e pur ne joma tindo ma nigi nyalruok e piny Kenya.

English: COMESA reminds residents of Busia County that agroforestry improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kwamba kilimo cha misitu kinaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: COMESA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia in beeraha kaynta ah uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: COMESA paronwa jogweng' mar Busia County ni yien mag yien kelo nyak e puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: CSPM leads to effective and cost-efficient management of new and existing crop pests, thereby reducing crop losses and increasing both food security and farmers ...
Kiswahili: CSPM inaongoza katika usimamizi mzuri na wa gharama nafuu wa wadudu waharibifu wa mazao wapya na waliopo, na hivyo kupunguza upotevu wa mazao na kuongeza usalama wa chakula na wakulima ...
Somali: CSPM waxay keentaa maareyn wax ku ool ah oo qiimo leh oo cayayaanka dalagyada cusub iyo kuwa jira, taasoo yareysa khasaaraha dalagyada iyo kor u qaadista amniga cuntada iyo beeraleyda ...
Dholuo: CSPM miyo joma nyago cham kod joma nyago cham bedo gi teko mar rito kodhino e yo maber kendo ma ok okelo nengo, mano miyo ji ok nyal chamo cham kendo miyo chiemo obed maber kendo miyo jopur bedo gi ngima maber.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges cattle farmers in Busia County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Busia kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kuripotiwa visa vya ugonjwa wa ngozi ya uvimbe.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da ee degmada Busia inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur mag jamni e county mar Busia mondo onyis jamni matuwo e ofise mar thieth machiegni gigi bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag dhoot.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of Kirinyaga County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay u yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' Kirinyaga County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giluong kony mar thieth mar chuny maonge chudo.

English: Counties selected for the pilot program on mainstreaming land use planning in County Integrated Development Plans include Elgeyo Marakwet Vihiga Narok and Makueni
Kiswahili: Kaunti zilizochaguliwa kwa mpango wa majaribio wa kujumuisha upangaji wa matumizi ya ardhi katika Mipango Jumuishi ya Maendeleo ya Kaunti ni pamoja na Elgeyo Marakwet Vihiga Narok na Makueni.
Somali: Degmooyinka loo doortay barnaamijka tijaabada ah ee ku saabsan isku-darka qorsheynta isticmaalka dhulka ee Qorshaha Horumarinta Isku-darka ee Degmooyinka waxaa ka mid ah Elgeyo Marakwet Vihiga Narok iyo Makueni
Dholuo: Alwora ma ne oyier mondo oluw chenro mar tiyo gi lowo e chenro mag dongruok moriwo Elgeyo Marakwet Vihiga Narok kod Makueni

English: To protect yourself from mosquitoes spreading malaria, make sure you sleep under a treated mosquito net every night.
Kiswahili: Ili kujikinga na mbu wanaoeneza homa ya malaria, hakikisha unalala ndani ya neti iliyotiwa dawa kila usiku.
Somali: Si aad naftaada uga ilaaliso kaneecada faafisa duumada, hubi inaad habeenkii seexato maro kaneeco la daweeyay.
Dholuo: Mondo orit ng’ato kuom suna ma lando maleria, ne ni inindo e bwo ng’injo ma osetimne thieth odiechieng’ ka odiechieng’.
resource: Ministry of Health & Kisii County Health Public Service Announcements

English: Workshops held in 6 high-tension counties
Kiswahili: Warsha zilizofanyika katika wilaya 6 zenye shinikizo kubwa
Somali: Tababarro lagu qabtay 6 degmo oo xiisad sare leh
Dholuo: Chokruoge ma ne itimo e gwenge 6 ma ne nigi pek mag yuto

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds the public in Marsabit County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba kuripoti matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka degmada Marsabit ku xasuusinayaa in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid bilaash ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties paronwa ji duto e taon mar Marsabit ni golo ripot mar tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Drugs and substance abuse is a danger to mental health for women and can be ancestrial
Kiswahili: Matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya na dawa za kulewesha ni hatari kwa afya ya akili ya wanawake na inaweza kuwa ya kizazi
Somali: Daawooyinka iyo isticmaalka maandooriyaha ayaa khatar ku ah caafimaadka maskaxda ee haweenka waxaana laga yaabaa inay ka yimaadaan awoowayaashood
Dholuo: Medruok mar tiyo gi yedhe mamero kod yedhe ma mero ji kelo hinyruok ne ngima mar chuny mon, kendo mano nyalo bedo gima ne otimore chon

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service activates an emergency response plan for fire outbreaks in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya yaanzisha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa milipuko ya moto katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu hirgeliyaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay dabka ka kacay Gobolka Nairobi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Forest Service tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony mapiyo ne masiche mag mach e County mar Nairobi.

English: KNEC conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Bomet County this September.
Kiswahili: KNEC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Bomet Septemba hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda gobolka ee gobolka Bomet bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: KNEC timo chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda e dwe mar ochiko mar higani e county mar Bomet County.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Murang'a County that reporting carjacking promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba kuripoti utekaji nyara mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan baabuurta la xaday ay gacan ka geystaan ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NDMA oparo ne jogweng' Murang'a County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo mtoka konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Nyamira County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nyamira in helitaanka taageerada sheegashada NHIF/SHA ay hadda laga heli karaa xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji duto e County mar Nyamira ni kony mar kwayo mag NHIF/SHA sani yudore e kuonde moyier.

English: Public notice: CDC will host a free food safety outreach in Kericho County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: CDC itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usalama wa chakula bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Kericho Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: CDC waxay marti gelineysaa adeeg bilaash ah oo ku saabsan badbaadada cuntada ee degmada Kericho bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuoche (CDC) biro timo chenro mar chiwo kony ne ji e wi wach rito chiemo e dwe mar Januar e taon mar Kericho.

English: Notice: IPOA activates an emergency response plan for drought in Turkana County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ukame katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay hirgelinaysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo abaaraha ka dhan ah degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: IPOA tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne oro e County mar Turkana.

English: Notice: EACC opens voter education centres in Meru County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Meru Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay furaysaa xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee degmada Meru bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: EACC chako tiego josiasa e kaunti mar Meru e dwe mar Januar.

English: Additionally, 400 000 animals will be dewormed, treated against internal and external parasites and given multivitamins to sustain milk and meat production and survive through this period, directly preserving the livelihoods and nutritional well-being of 4 000 vulnerable households.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, wanyama 400,000 watatiwa dawa ya minyoo, watatibiwa dhidi ya vimelea vya ndani na nje na kupewa multivitamini ili kuendeleza uzalishaji wa maziwa na nyama na kuishi katika kipindi hiki, kuhifadhi moja kwa moja maisha na ustawi wa lishe wa kaya 4,000 zilizo katika mazingira magumu.
Somali: Intaa waxaa dheer, 400,000 oo xayawaan ah ayaa laga jari doonaa gooryaanka, laga daweyn doonaa dulin gudaha iyo dibaddaba ah, waxaana la siin doonaa fiitamiinno badan si loo ilaaliyo wax soo saarka caanaha iyo hilibka loona noolaado muddadan, iyadoo si toos ah loo ilaalin doono hab-nololeedka iyo fayoobaanta nafaqada ee 4,000 oo qoys oo nugul ah.
Dholuo: Kaachiel gi mago, le 400 000 ibiro ng’adnegi bura, ibiro yudo thieth mar geng’o tuoche ma ng’ato yudo e iye kod ma oko kendo ibiro migi gik ma nyalo konyogi mondo gimedo loso chak kod ring’o kendo gibed mangima kuom kindeni, ma biro rito ngima kod chiemo maber mar udi 4 000 ma nigi pek.

English: NCPB reminds farmers in Homa Bay County of the ongoing modern irrigation techniques training programme.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji.
Somali: NCPB waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Homa Bay barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah.
Dholuo: NCPB oparo ne jopur manie Homa Bay County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar yore mag lero pi.

English: ODPP reminds the public in Isiolo County that input on development planning forums is welcome this February.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kwamba mchango kwenye vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo unakaribishwa Februari hii.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Isiolo in talooyinka ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta la soo dhaweynayo bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: ODPP oparo ne ji duto e gweng' mar Isiolo ni paro ma ji chiwo e wi chenro mag dongruok en gima owinjore e dwe mar Februar.

English: FAO advises farmers in Nyandarua County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the April planting season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo kabla ya msimu wa upandaji Aprili.
Somali: FAO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Nyandarua inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagyada si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda ka hor xilliga beerashada bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e county mar Nyandarua mondo otim lokruok e puothe mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak e dwe mar April.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Kilifi County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa usaidizi wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow si ay uga caawiyaan helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ee lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMSA nyiso jogweng' Kilifi County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni mondo giyud kony mar yudo kony kuom weche thieth.

English: OGP reminds the public in Kitui County that input on the county budget process is welcome this April.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya Kitui kwamba mchango juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya wilaya unakaribishwa Aprili hii.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kitui in talooyinka ku saabsan habka miisaaniyadda degmada ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: OGP oparo ne ji duto e County Kitui ni gibiro yie gi chiwo e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e dwe mar April.

English: Kenya Red Cross launches a July awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Julai kuhusu uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii July oo ku saabsan baaritaanka sonkorowga ee degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Julai e wi nonro mar thieth mar sukari e gweng' mar Kisumu.

English: Launched in Marsabit and Isiolo
Kiswahili: Ilizinduliwa Marsabit na Isiolo
Somali: Waxaa laga bilaabay Marsabit iyo Isiolo
Dholuo: Ne ochak e boma mar Marsabit kod Isiolo

English: CDC advises residents of West Pokot County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: CDC inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: CDC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay qaataan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: CDC nyiso jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi ka gidwaro thieth mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Notice: IPOA issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa utambulisho ambao unaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay soo saartaa digniin amniga internetka ah oo ku saabsan dhacda aqoonsiga oo saameyn ku leh dadka deggan degmada Bomet.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IPOA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity e wi kuo mar ng'ato makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e county mar Bomet.

English: Farmers are encouraged to move animals to higher ground to avoid flooding and reduce the risk of waterborne diseases, and to ensure animals are well-housed and hygienic to prevent disease outbreaks.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kuhamisha wanyama hadi maeneo ya juu ili kuepuka mafuriko na kupunguza hatari ya magonjwa yanayosababishwa na maji, na kuhakikisha wanyama wanakaa vizuri na wanasafi ili kuzuia milipuko ya magonjwa.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay xayawaanka u raro dhul sare si looga fogaado fatahaadaha loona yareeyo khatarta cudurrada biyaha ka baxa, iyo in xayawaanka si wanaagsan loo hoy iyo nadaafad leh si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada.
Dholuo: Josupni ijiwo mondo oter le e lowo maboyo mondo kik pi opong'gi kendo mondo gikony e tieko tuoche mayudore e pi, kendo mondo omi le obed gi kuonde dak maber kendo gibed gi ngima maler mondo kik tuoche landre.

English: This publication presents an assessment and mapping of CSA-SDG interlinkages. These provide entry points for targeted CSA planning to enhance synergies.
Kiswahili: Chapisho hili linatoa tathmini na ramani ya miunganisho ya CSA-SDG. Hizi hutoa sehemu za kuanzia kwa mipango ya CSA inayolengwa ili kuongeza ushirikiano.
Somali: Daabacaadani waxay soo bandhigeysaa qiimeyn iyo khariidad ku saabsan isku xirnaanta CSA-SDG. Kuwani waxay bixiyaan meelaha gelitaanka qorsheynta CSA ee bartilmaameedka ah si loo xoojiyo isdhexgalka.
Dholuo: Gasedni oting'o nonro kod nonro mar tudruok e kind CSA kod SDG. Gigo chiwo weche ma nyalo konyo e loso chenro mar CSA mondo omed kelo winjruok.

English: Harmful practices such as female genital mutilation and forced marriage are human rights violations. Kenya has committed significant investment to prevention and response.
Kiswahili: Mazoea yenye madhara kama vile kuharibu viungo vya uzazi vya wanawake na ndoa za kulazimishwa ni ukiukaji wa haki za binadamu. Kenya imefanya uwekezaji mkubwa katika kuzuia na kukabiliana na hali hiyo.
Somali: Dhaqdhaqaaqa waxyeelada leh sida dhaawaca xubnaha taranka haweenka iyo guurka qasabka ah waa xadgudubyo xuquuqda aadanaha. Kenya waxay maalgashiyo badan ku sameysay ka hortagga iyo ka jawaab celinta.
Dholuo: Timbe maricho kaka ketho fuonni mag nindruok mag mon kod donjo e kend kuom thuon gin ketho chike mag dhano. Kenya osetiyo gi pesa mang'eny e geng'o kendo kawo okang'.

English: Notice: DCI issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DCI inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa kitambulisho unaoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Somali: Ogaysiis: DCI waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan xadiidka aqoonsiga ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Kiambu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: DCI ogolo siem mar rito weche mag sirkal kuom wach kwalo nying' jogo modak e County mar Kiambu.

English: KTDA announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for dairy cows in West Pokot County this November.
Kiswahili: KTDA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Novemba hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan qabyaalada lo'da caanaha ah ee gobolka West Pokot bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: KTDA olando chenro mar thiedho dhok makwayo pi e dwe mar Novemba e West Pokot County.

English: State Department for TVET advises students in Trans Nzoia County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata maudhui ya kujifunza dijitali bila malipo.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ardayda degmada Trans Nzoia kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan waxyaabo waxbarasho oo lacag la'aan ah oo dijitaal ah.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo jopuonjre e Trans Nzoia County mondo oketgi e intanet mondo giyud thuolo mar somo weche mag digital maonge chudo.

English: Nationwide campaign to deliver Vitamin A to children under 5 and coordinate with routine immunization services.
Kiswahili: Kampeni ya kitaifa ya kutoa VitaminiA kwa watoto walio chini ya miaka 5 na kuratibu huduma za kawaida za chanjo.
Somali: Olole caalami ah oo loogu talagalay bixinta Vitamin A carruurta da'doodu ka yar tahay 5 sano iyo isku xirka adeegyada tallaalka caadiga ah.
Dholuo: Lendo e piny mangima mar chiwo vitamin A ne nyithindo ma johigni 5 gi matin kendo riwo lwedo tije mag thiedho nyithindo.

English: DPP alerts residents of Kisii County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: DPP anawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua.
Somali: DPP waxay dadka deggan degmada Kisii uga digtay kororka kiisaska lo'da lagu xado waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: DPP chiwo siem ne ji modak e County mar Kisii e wi medruok mar weche mag kwalo jamni kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag rito ngimagi gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Did you know that all KRA Services are free?  You can receive our services from our contact centre, KRA offices or Huduma Center near you  Find out more here
Kiswahili: Unaweza kupokea huduma zetu kutoka kituo chetu cha mawasiliano, ofisi za KRA au Huduma Center karibu nawe Tafuta maelezo zaidi hapa
Somali: Ma ogtahay in dhammaan Adeegyada KRA ay yihiin lacag la'aan? Waxaad ka heli kartaa adeegyadeena xarunteena xiriirka, xafiisyada KRA ama Xarunta Huduma ee kuugu dhow Halkan ka sii aqri
Dholuo: Be ing'eyo ni tije duto mag KRA gin maonge chudo?

English: State Department for TVET urges residents of Kirinyaga County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kutuma maombi ya bursari hiyo kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kufaidika na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State Department for TVET jiwo jogweng' Kirinyaga County mondo okonygi gi chenrono kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud tiegruok mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kisii County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kisii Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu billaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ka dhanka ah degmada Kisii bishii May.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: Kenya Gazette chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e gweng' mar Kisii e dwe mar Mei.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free youth mental wellness support is available through county health facilities in Meru County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa ustawi wa akili wa vijana unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Meru.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo ne rowere ma nigi tuoche mag obwongo yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Meru.

English: Notice: IPOA opens a gender desk offering free legal aid in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisheria bure katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah Degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony ma onge chudo e County mar Vihiga.

English: Marsabit County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Marsabit: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2023
Somali: Degmada Marsabit: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2023
