English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay haystaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi maber sama gidwaro yudo thieth mar yudo kony mar thieth.

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Nyandarua County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurka laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health osiemo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth mar oganda ma onge chudo mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages residents of Kisii County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay u dhiiri galiyaan saaxiibka dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Kisii mondo kik gisandre aling' ling' kendo mondo gijiw osiepgi moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: High blood pressure in pregnancy can lead to preeclampsia. Regular check-ups are essential for early detection.
Kiswahili: Shinikizo la damu kubwa wakati wa ujauzito linaweza kusababisha preeclampsia. Uchunguzi wa mara kwa mara ni muhimu kwa ugunduzi wa mapema.
Somali: Cadaadiska dhiigga sare ee uurka ayaa keeni kara preeclampsia. baaritaano joogto ah ayaa lagama maarmaan u ah ogaanshaha hore.
Dholuo: Medruok mar remo e kinde mag ich nyalo miyo ng'ato obed gi tuwo mar preeclampsia.

English: DCI warns residents of Tana River County to prepare for possible road accidents this February.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kujiandaa kwa ajali zinazowezekana za barabarani Februari hii.
Somali: DCI waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay u diyaargaroobaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: DCI osiemo jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya launches county development projects in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya ayaa bilaabay mashaariic horumarineed oo ka socda gobolka Nyeri.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya chako timo dongruok e alwora mar Nyeri County.

English: IEBC reminds youth in Nyandarua County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nyandarua in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka mashiinka gawaarida.
Dholuo: IEBC oparo ne rowere man Nyandarua County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar masinde mag mtokni.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: free antenatal care clinics will run every August at designated health centres in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi: kliniki za bure za utunzaji wa ujauzito zitafanya kazi kila Agosti katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka: rugta daryeelka dhalmada ee bilaashka ah ayaa laga bilaabi doonaa bishii Ogosto oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Rieko moa e Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: Klinike mag rito nyithindo kapok ginyuolo biro tiyo dwe mar Agost higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Wajir.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds voters in Kakamega County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed ayaa xasuusinaya codbixiyayaasha Gobolka Kakamega inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta ee ugu dhow ee IEBC ka hor inta aan la helin waxbarashada codbixinta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties parone jogweng' Kakamega County ni mondo gidhi e centre mar IEBC man machiegni kodgi kapok giyudo tiegruok.

English: Kenya â€“ Mobility Tracking and Multi-sectoral Location Assessment in Samburu County Round 1 (February 2023)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Ufuatiliaji wa Uhamaji na Tathmini ya Mahali ya Sekta mbalimbali katika Kaunti ya Samburu Awamu ya 1 (Februari 2023)
Somali: Kenya - Raadinta Dhaqdhaqaaqa iyo Qiimaynta Goobaha Kala Duwan ee Wareegga 1aad ee Degmada Samburu (Febraayo 2023)
Dholuo: Kenya - Luwo wuotho ​​kod pim mar kuonde mathoth e gweng' mar Samburu Raun 1 (Dwe mar Ariyo 2023)

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of Nyandarua County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay la xiriiraan lataliye la tababaran yahay.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giwuo gi jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds expectant mothers in Vihiga County that access to free antenatal care is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma ya ujauzito bila malipo ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Vihiga in helitaanka daryeelka uurka ka hor ee bilaashka ah ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne mine ma biro nyuolo e county mar Vihiga ni thuolo mar yudo thieth ma onge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal en maonge chudo.

English: Announcing the lauch of Country plan that prioritizes maternal-child nutrition, agricultureâ€‘education integration and multisector tracking.
Kiswahili: Kutangaza uzinduzi wa mpango wa Nchi unaoweka kipaumbele lishe ya mama na mtoto, ujumuishaji wa elimu ya kilimo na ufuatiliaji wa sekta nyingi.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqista qorshaha Dalka oo mudnaanta siinaya nafaqada hooyada iyo ilmaha, isdhexgalka waxbarashada beeraha iyo la socodka qaybaha badan.
Dholuo: Kuong'o chakruok mar chenro mar piny ma keto mokuongo chiemo mar min gi nyathi, riwruok mar somo mar pur kod luwo sektor mang'eny.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Taita-Taveta County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on community-based development programmes.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya wilaya ili kuwa na habari juu ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Taita-Taveta inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca bogga degmada si ay uga warqabtaan barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo jogweng'o mag Taita-Taveta County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mag dongruok e kind oganda.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) advises residents of Kilifi County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inay biyo cabitaan ah ku kariyaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' Kilifi County mondo omak pi modho kapok gitiyo kode mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: IEBC reminds voters in Nyandarua County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha gobolka Nyandarua inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor jadwalka doorashada.

English: Notice: KEMSA confirms a tuberculosis outbreak alert for Turkana County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa kifua kikuu kwa Kaunti ya Turkana. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMSA waxay xaqiijineysaa feejignaanta faafitaanka cudurka 'tuberculosis' ee degmada Turkana. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KEMSA osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuberculosis e county mar Turkana.

English: Explore opportunities for your small farm or cooperative to supply fresh meat to hospitals (schools, hospitals) for their feeding programs.

English: Notice: KEMSA will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Tharaka-Nithi County this November. All are welcome.

Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kuhusu kuongezeka kwa visa vya wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.

Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kutuma maombi ya bursari hiyo kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: HELB waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jogweng'o mag Taita-Taveta County mondo okonygi yudo konyno kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: AFA warns coffee farmers in Kirinyaga County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: AFA inawaonya wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: AFA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda kafeega ee Gobolka Kirinyaga cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: AFA chiwo siem ne jopur ma loso chai e County mar Kirinyaga kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free trauma counselling support is available through county health facilities in Siaya County.

English: KALRO urges rice growers in Homa Bay County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda bariiska ee gobolka Homa Bay inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo miraha ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur ma pidho kodhi e Homa Bay County mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: Public notice: Kenya Medical Association will host a free hand hygiene outreach in Nandi County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mikono bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Nandi Agosti hii.

Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association biro timo kampen mar rito ler mar lwedo e taon mar Nandi County e dwe mar Agost.

English: IEBC reminds the public in Narok County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this December.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Narok kwamba mapendekezo juu ya mapitio ya utendaji wa kila mwaka ni kuwakaribisha Desemba hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Narok in talooyinka dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: IEBC parone ji duto manie Narok County ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e dwe mar Desemba.

English: COMESA encourages farmers in Bungoma County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei nzuri ya mahindi.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Bungoma inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay hadhuudhka.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Bungoma mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar kodhi.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa simu ya GBV ya bure katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu furayaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ee degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Forest Service oyawo ofis mar joma chwo gi mon ma tiyo gi simo mar GBV maonge chudo e county mar Siaya.

English: Notice: ODPP launches ward-level service delivery in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inazindua huduma za huduma katika wilaya ya Kilifi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay bilawday bixinta adeegyada heerka qaybta ee degmada Kilifi.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: ODPP chako chiwo kony e alwora mar Kilifi County.

English: Citizen TV, owned by Royal Media Services (RMS), boasts of top-rated talent. Over the years, the media personalities have earned recognition for their storytelling skills and award-winning shows. Alth...
Kiswahili: Citizen TV, inayomilikiwa na Royal Media Services (RMS), ina talanta za juu. Kwa miaka mingi, watu wa vyombo vya habari wamepata kutambuliwa kwa ustadi wao wa kusimulia hadithi na maonyesho ya kushinda tuzo.
Somali: Citizen TV, oo ay leedahay shirkadda Royal Media Services (RMS), waxay ku faantaa khibradaha ugu sarreeya. Sanadihii la soo dhaafay, jilayaasha warbaahinta ayaa lagu aqoonsaday xirfadooda sheekaynta iyo barnaamijyada abaalmarinta leh.
Dholuo: TELEVISION mar Citizen, ma en riwruok mar Royal Media Services (RMS), opong' gi joma olony ahinya.

English: Makueni County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Makueni: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Juni 2022
Somali: Degmada Makueni: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Makueni: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2022

English: We encourage people to go for medication to their nearest health facilities any time they feel unwell. When you seek for timely medical attension, you prevent yopurelf from serious infections.
Kiswahili: Tunatia moyo watu waende kupata dawa kwenye vituo vya afya vilivyo karibu nao wakati wowote wanapohisi vibaya. Unapotafuta msaada wa kitiba kwa wakati unaofaa, unajilinda kutokana na maambukizo mazito.
Somali: Waxaan dadka ku dhiirigelinaynaa inay daawada u tagaan xarumaha caafimaadka ee ugu dhow mar kasta oo ay dareemaan inay xanuunsan yihiin.
Dholuo: Wajiwo ji mondo odhi oyud thieth e osiptal man machiegni kodgi sa asaya ma giwinjo marach.

English: Notice: CDC confirms a measles outbreak alert for Taita-Taveta County. Residents are advised to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ilani: CDC inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa surua kwa Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Ogaysiis: CDC waxay xaqiijineysaa feejignaan ku saabsan cudurka guduudka ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isticmaalaan shabaqa cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar yedhe ma thiedho tuoche (CDC) osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuwono e gweng' mar Taita-Taveta.

English: NPS warns residents of Busia County to prepare for possible drought this September.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kujiandaa kwa ukame unaowezekana Septemba hii.
Somali: NPS waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia inay u diyaar garoobaan abaaraha iman kara bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: NPS osiemo jogweng' mar Busia County mondo oikre ne oro ma nyalo betie e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Medical Association will be held in Kisumu County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu bila malipo iliyoandaliwa na Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Januari hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Kisumu bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma Kenya Medical Association ochano ibiro tim e County Kisumu e dwe mar Januar.

English: State Department for Basic Education encourages residents of Kwale County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Dowladda waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education ojiwo jogweng' Kwale County mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto gikwongo tiyogo ka gidwaro ng'eyo kaka ji riwo lwedo bajet mar county.

English: Notice from Kenya Medical Association: free antenatal care clinics will run every March at designated health centres in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya: kliniki za bure za utunzaji wa ujauzito zitaendeshwa kila Machi katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya: rugta daryeelka dhalmada ee bilaashka ah ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Maarso kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee lagu magacaabo degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association: klinik mag rito nyithindo kapok ginyuolo biro tiyo dwe mar Mach higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Nyeri.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) confirms a dengue fever outbreak alert for Nandi County. Residents are advised to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa homa ya dengue kwa Kaunti ya Nandi. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa xaqiijisay digniin ku saabsan cudurka hargabka dengue ee degmada Nandi. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: SHA (Social Health Authority) osenyiso ni nitie siem mar tuo mar dengue e county mar Nandi.

English: NCPB urges farmers in Baringo County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Baringo inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddelka qaabka roobabka.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e Baringo County mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi pur mar piny mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok mar koth.

English: CDC encourages mothers in Siaya County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Siaya inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta caafimaad ee la qorsheeyay si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo mine manie county mar Siaya mondo odhi e odiechieng'no mar thieth mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Universities Fund reminds youth in Narok County that HELB funding is available for tailoring and design training.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Narok kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xasuusinayaa dhalinyarada degmada Narok in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka qaabeynta iyo naqshadeynta.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa rowere man Narok County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko.

Somali: Dowladdu waxay soo saartay qiimo wanaagsan oo ku saabsan wax soo saarka beeraha cusub.
Dholuo: Sirkal ogolo nengo maber e chiro mar gik ma dongo e puodho ma nyasani .

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Embu County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kufunga na kutunza vizima moto nyumbani na kazini wakati huu wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu in ay guryahooda ku rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo shaqada inta lagu jiro xilliyada shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji paroga jogweng' mar Embu County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi koda e tijegi e kinde masiche mag ndara.

English: Kenya Dairy Board urges millet growers in Siaya County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Siaya kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda cawska ee degmada Siaya inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur mag millet e county mar Siaya mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Bungoma County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay haystaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health nyiso jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi maber sama gidwaro thieth mondo giyud thieth makonyogi.

English: Universities Fund encourages residents of Embu County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya ugatuzi.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabaan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo jogweng' Embu County mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto gikwongo tiyogo mondo ging'e weche duto.

English: TSC conducts a civic education forum on voter registration in Uasin Gishu County this February.
Kiswahili: TSC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Februari hii.
Somali: TSC waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha degmada Uasin Gishu bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: TSC dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi ndiko joma oyiero e county mar Uasin Gishu e dwe mar Februar.

English: Kenya Forest Service alerts residents of Garissa County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa juu ya kuongezeka kwa visa vya wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ka digay dadka deggan degmada Garissa in ay kordhaan kiisaska tuugada wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar County mar Garissa ni kwan mag jokuoge medore kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag ritruok gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Kenya Population Movement, DREF Operation No: MDRKE064 Final Report
Kiswahili: Kenya Population Movement, DREF Operesheni No: MDRKE064 Ripoti ya Mwisho
Somali: Dhaqdhaqaaqa Dadweynaha Kenya, Lambarka Hawlgalka DREF: Warbixinta Kama Dambeysta ah ee MDRKE064
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Oganda ma Kenya, Namba mar Tich mar DREF: Ripot mogik mar MDRKE064

English: IPOA calls on residents of Turkana County to support local peace-building committees in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za mitaa katika kusaidia tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: IPOA waxay dadka deggan degmada Turkana ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee deegaanka si ay u taageerayaan taxadarka ka dhanka ah argagixisada.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Turkana mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gweng'no mondo gikony e kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Kenya Red Cross advises residents of Nairobi County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay biyo cabitaan ah ku kariyaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Nairobi County mondo omak pi modho kapok gitiyo kode mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: ODPP warns public officers in Mombasa County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: ODPP inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Mombasa dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: ODPP waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Mombasa khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: ODPP chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Mombasa kuom timbe mag wuondruok.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds youth in Kisumu County that HELB funding is available for tailoring and design training.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya dhalinyarada degmada Kisumu in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka qaabeynta iyo naqshadeynta.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne rowere ma Kisumu County ni pesa mag HELB yudore e tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds residents of Kiambu County that access to national ID applications is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba kufikia maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu in helitaanka codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone jogweng' mar County mar Kiambu ni koro yot yudo kwayo mag ng'eyo kit oganda kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: E-Citizen urges eligible citizens in Taita-Taveta County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wananchi wanaostahili katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Taita-Taveta inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo jokanyo mag Taita-Taveta County mondo oriwgi e ndiko joma oyier.

English: SHA announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: SHA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Nyamira.
Dholuo: SHA olando lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mag ng'eyo ng'ato e kaunti mar Nyamira.

English: Provide access! Supply braille digital tools for students.
Kiswahili: Wape wanafunzi vifaa vya kielektroniki vya maandishi ya vipofu.
Somali: Soo bandhig qalab dhijitaal ah oo loogu talagalay ardayda.
Dholuo: Mi jopuonjre thuolo mar somo Muma gi dho Braille.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ka furayaa barta adeegga cusub ee diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee Gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag e-Citizen registration e County mar Lamu.

English: KMTC announces distribution of revision guides to schools in Nakuru County this December.
Kiswahili: KMTC inatangaza usambazaji wa miongozo ya marekebisho kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Desemba hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa in dib-u-eegis lagu qeybinayo dugsiyada degmada Nakuru bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: KMTC olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag somo e skunde man Nakuru County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Kenya: Addressing sexual violence in communities displaced by conflict
Kiswahili: Kenya: Kushughulikia unyanyasaji wa kijinsia katika jamii zilizohamishwa na migogoro
Somali: Kenya: Wax ka qabashada rabshadaha galmada ee ka dhaca bulshooyinka ay colaaduhu barakiciyeen
Dholuo: Kenya: Tiyo gi tim gero mag nindruok e gwenge ma lweny oweyo udigi

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds expectant mothers in Trans Nzoia County that access to free antenatal care is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma ya ujauzito bila malipo ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Trans Nzoia in helitaanka daryeelka uurka ka hor ee bilaashka ah uu yahay mid lacag la'aan ah dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa mine ma biro bedo gi ich e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia ni thuolo mar yudo rit ma onge chudo mar nyuol en maonge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross issues a cybersecurity alert on SIM-swap fraud affecting residents of Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya umetoa onyo la usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM unaoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaanooyinka SIM-swap ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Wajir.
Dholuo: Rapar: Kenya Red Cross ogolo siem mar sirkal e wi wuond mar SIM-swap makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: Wajir County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Wajir: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2024
Somali: Degmada Wajeer: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Wajir: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2024

English: KRA warns public officers in Migori County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: KRA inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Migori dhidi ya kupotosha fedha za umma.
Somali: KRA waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Migori in ay ka faa'iideystaan dhaqaale dawladeed.
Dholuo: KRA chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e kaunti mar Migori ni kik gimi ji pesa.

English: Rapid response brings relief to flood-affected communities in Kenya
Kiswahili: Mwitikio wa haraka huleta ahueni kwa jamii zilizoathiriwa na mafuriko nchini Kenya
Somali: Jawaab degdeg ah ayaa gargaar u fidisay bulshooyinka ay fatahaaduhu saameeyeen ee Kenya
Dholuo: Dwoko mapiyo kelo kony ne gwenge ma oyudo masira mag pi mang’eny e piny Kenya

English: Announcement on food education and addition in everu week as indicated on iron advertisement on T/shits for all youth in Busia, Kitui and nakuru counties
Kiswahili: Tangazo juu ya elimu ya chakula na kuongeza katika kila wiki kama inavyoonyeshwa kwenye matangazo ya chuma juu ya T / shit kwa vijana wote katika Busia, Kitui na Nakuru counties
Somali: Ogeysiis ku saabsan waxbarashada cuntada iyo ku darista toddobaadka kasta sida lagu muujiyey xayeysiinta birta ah ee T/shits loogu talagalay dhamaan dhalinyarada degmooyinka Busia, Kitui iyo nakuru
Dholuo: Lando e wi somo kod medo chiemo e juma ka juma kaka onyis e sanduk molos gi chuma mar T/shit ne rowere duto e gwenge mag Busia, Kitui kod nakuru

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public in Narok County about the importance of safe water storage for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Narok juu ya umuhimu wa uhifadhi wa maji salama kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay dadka degmada Narok ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji e Narok County kuom ber mar kano pi maler e ngima joot.

English: Notice: EACC launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Laikipia County this April.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: EACC waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ka dhanka ah gobolka Laikipia bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Rapar: EACC chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Laikipia e dwe mar April.

English: These clinics operate from off-road trucks fitted with a consultation room, patient beds, a small laboratory, and a pharmacy, designed to bring essential care directly to communities far from any permanent facility.
Kiswahili: Kliniki hizi zinafanya kazi kutoka kwa malori ya nje ya barabara yaliyo na chumba cha mashauriano, vitanda vya wagonjwa, maabara ndogo, na duka la dawa, iliyoundwa kuleta huduma muhimu moja kwa moja kwa jamii zilizo mbali na kituo chochote cha kudumu.
Somali: Rugaha caafimaadku waxay ka shaqeeyaan gawaarida xamuulka qaada ee ka baxsan waddooyinka oo lagu rakibay qol la-talin, sariiro bukaan, shaybaar yar, iyo farmashiye, oo loogu talagalay in daryeelka lagama maarmaanka ah si toos ah loogu geeyo bulshooyinka ka fog xarun kasta oo joogto ah.
Dholuo: Klinik ma kamago tiyo ka gitiyo gi lori ma ok wuotho ​​e yo ma nigi ot ma inyalo ng’adoe bura, otanda mag jotuwo, ot matin mar timo nonro, kod duka mar ng’iewo yath, ma olosi mondo okel thieth ma dwarore achiel kachiel e gwenge mabor gi kar thieth moro amora ma nyaka chieng’.

English: Notice: EACC will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Turkana County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ee degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: EACC biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi weche siasa e County mar Turkana.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will distribute certified millet seed to farmers in Wajir County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu abuuraha degmada Wajir u qaybin doonaa abuurka miiska ee la caddeeyay bisha May ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Dairy Board biro pogo kodhi mag millet ne jopur manie County mar Wajir e dwe mar Mei.

English: KEMRI announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Uasin Gishu County starting this December.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuanzia Desemba hii.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa in laga bilaabo bishii Diseembar ee sannadkan la siinayo deebaajiga loogu talagalay dadka deggan gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: KEMRI olando thieth mar dialysis kuom joma odak e county mar Uasin Gishu kochakore dwe mar Desemba.

English: KEMSA advises residents of West Pokot County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot in ay biyo cabitaan ah ku kariyaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: KEMSA nyiso jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo omak pi modho kapok gitiyo kode mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: KNEC calls on the community in Kilifi County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KNEC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: KNEC waxay bulshada degmada Kilifi ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyada.
Dholuo: KNEC okwayo ji duto manie gweng' mar Kilifi mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Notice: NPS conducts a community briefing on border security in Meru County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Meru Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha degmada Meru bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NPS timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e County mar Meru e dwe mar Desemba.

English: KTDA warns sweet potatoes farmers in Kisumu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaonya wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Kisumu juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KTDA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda baradho macaan ee degmada Kisumu cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: KTDA chiwo siem ne jopur mag le mag kisumu kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: President Ruto In Kiambu: President s tour of Mt. Kenya marred by local politics Kiambu Governor calls for respect among local leaders President Tuto says Kenya on path of economic recovery
Kiswahili: Rais Ruto In Kiambu: Ziara ya Rais ya Mlima Kenya imechafuliwa na siasa za mitaa Kiambu Gavana anaomba kuheshimiwa na viongozi wa mitaa Rais Tuto anasema Kenya iko kwenye njia ya kupona kiuchumi
Somali: Madaxweyne Ruto In Kiambu: Booqashada Madaxweynaha ee Buurta Kenya oo ay ku dhacday Siyaasadda Deegaanka Kiambu Guddoomiyaha ayaa ku baaqay in hoggaamiyeyaasha deegaanka ay ixtiraamaan Madaxweyne Tuto ayaa sheegay in Kenya ay ku sii socoto wadada soo kabashada dhaqaalaha
Dholuo: President Ruto In Kiambu: Lendo mar President mar Mount Kenya okethore gi siasa mar piny Kiambu Jaloch okwayo mondo jotelo mag piny omiye luor President Tuto wacho ni Kenya ni e yo mar chango ohala

English: KEPHIS urges farmers in Embu County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Embu inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddelada roobabka.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e county mar Embu mondo opidh cham mondo omi lowo okethre, mondo omi giritre kuom lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: ODPP updates residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County on progress of ward-level service delivery this May.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya maendeleo ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya Mei hii.
Somali: ODPP waxay dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet ku wargelineysaa horumarka bixinta adeegyada heerka degmada bisha May.
Dholuo: ODPP osemiyo jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet ong'eyo dongruok mar tij lendo mar ward e dwe mar abich.

English: Notice: OGP launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Nyeri County this April.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhanka ah gobolka Nyeri bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: OGP chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Nyeri e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by SHA (Social Health Authority) will be held in Tana River County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Tana River Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Degmada Tana River bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth maonge chudo ma olos gi SHA (Social Health Authority) ibiro tim e taon mar Tana River County e dwe mar Mei.

English: Narok County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Narok: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2022
Somali: Degmada Narok: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2022
Dholuo: Kaun mar Narok: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar apar 2022

English: KEMRI reminds expectant mothers in Turkana County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Turkana in helitaanka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMRI parone mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Turkana ni thuolo mar yudo puonj mag chenro mag ngima joot en maonge chudo e kuonde duto ma ji yudoree.

English: Always keep your child's health card and birth certificate safe for school, healthcare, and legal needs.
Kiswahili: Daima weka kadi ya afya ya mtoto wako na cheti cha kuzaliwa salama kwa mahitaji ya shule, huduma ya afya, na kisheria.
Somali: Had iyo jeer kaarka caafimaadka ilmahaaga iyo shahaadada dhalashada u ilaali si ammaan ah dugsiga, daryeelka caafimaadka, iyo baahiyaha sharciga.
Dholuo: Kinde duto, rit kad mar thieth kod oboke mar nyuol mar nyathini maber mondo otigodo e skul, thieth, kod dwaro mag chik.

English: IPOA calls on the community in West Pokot County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaalika jamii katika Wilaya ya West Pokot kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: IPOA waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada gobolka West Pokot inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan oo ay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: IPOA luongo ji duto manie West Pokot County mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gichiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief, March 2023
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP wa Kenya, Machi 2023
Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya, Maarso 2023
Dholuo: Wach machuok mar piny Kenya mar WFP, dwe mar adek 2023

English: Notice: TSC launches a school infrastructure safety programme in schools across Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC yazindua mpango wa usalama wa miundombinu ya shule katika shule kote Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay bilawday barnaamij ku saabsan badbaadada kaabayaasha dugsiga ee dugsiyada guud ahaan degmada Nairobi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: TSC chako chenro mar rito weche mag tiegruok mag skul e skunde duto mag Nairobi County.

English: TVET urges residents of Mombasa County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kutuma maombi ya bursari hiyo kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kufaidika na mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: TVET waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Mombasa mondo okonygi gi chenrono kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Marsabit County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na ufisadi wa fedha za umma.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u soo gudbiyaan cabasho si ay ula dagaallamaan xadgudubka lacagaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo jogweng' mar Marsabit County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo kwayo mar kedo gi ketho pesa mag sirkal.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education reminds citizens in Baringo County about their rights regarding devolution.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka Baringo waxay muwaadiniinta ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Puonjruok ma Chakre e Piny owacho parone raia mag Baringo County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar golo pesa.

English: Notice: DPP issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Embu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa utambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay soo saartaa digniin amniga internetka ah oo ku saabsan tuugada aqoonsiga ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Embu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: DPP ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity kuom kuo mar ng'ato makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e county mar Embu.

English: Ministry of Health encourages mothers in Wajir County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Wajir kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Wajir inay ilmahooda u keenaan kormeerka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health ojiwo mine e County mar Wajir mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Girls and young women bear the brunt of El NiÃƒÂ±o rains in Kenya
Kiswahili: Wasichana na wanawake vijana wanabeba mzigo mkubwa wa mvua za El NiÃƒÂ±o nchini Kenya

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on the community in Murang'a County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.

Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross okwayo ji duto manie County mar Murang'a mondo owuo e wi timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gichiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: EHAGL Knowledge summary - Kenya, World Bank - UNHCR data and evidence collaboration (2016 - 2023)
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Maarifa ya EHAGL - Kenya, Benki ya Dunia - UNHCR data na ushirikiano wa ushahidi (2016 - 2023)

Dholuo: EHAGL Lero machuok mar rieko - Kenya, Bengi mar Piny mangima - data mag UNHCR kod riwruok mar neno neno (2016 - 2023)

English: OGP encourages first-time voters in Lamu County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: OGP inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Lamu kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: OGP waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Lamu inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogo matimoga yiero mokwongo e County mar Lamu mondo oting'e ID mar piny kata pasipoti e odiechieng' mar yiero.

English: KALRO invites farmers in Kirinyaga County to a free training on record keeping for farmers this November.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwa mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima Novemba hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kirinyaga tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan diiwaangelinta beeralayda bisha November.
Dholuo: KALRO ogwelo jopur e gweng' mar Kirinyaga e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi rito rekod mag jopur dwe mar Novemba.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Nyamira County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nyamira in helitaanka taageerada dalabka NHIF/SHA ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa ji duto e County mar Nyamira ni kony mar kwayo kuom NHIF/SHA sani yudore e kuonde moyier.

English: CDC calls on parents in Busia County to have children under five screened for cholera during the August outreach.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Busia kuwafanya watoto chini ya miaka mitano wachunguzwe kipindupindu wakati wa ufikiaji wa Agosti.
Somali: CDC waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Busia in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka kolera inta lagu jiro bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuoche (CDC) dwaro ni jonyuol e gweng' mar Busia otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Agost mondo one kabe gin gi tuwo mar cholera.

English: Notice: KALRO will conduct a fertiliser application workshop for farmers in Kericho County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafanya warsha ya maombi ya mbolea kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan isticmaalka bacriminta beeraleyda ee degmada Kericho bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KALRO biro timo tiegruok mar tiyo gi yien mag yien ne jopur e taon mar Kericho e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Kenya Forest Service warns residents of Kisii County about a rise in phishing messages and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii juu ya kuongezeka kwa ujumbe wa udanganyifu na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ka digay dadka deggan degmada Kisii kororka farriimaha phishing wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga leh bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service osiemo jogweng' Kisii County kuom wach medruok mar weche mag phishing kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok kare ne jatendgi.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) restricts movement of dairy cows in Mandera County due to an anthrax outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inazuia harakati za ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Mandera kutokana na mlipuko wa kimeta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da caanaha ah ee Gobolka Mandera sababo la xiriira cudurka Anthrax.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok makwayo chak e county mar Mandera nikech tuwo mar anthrax.

English: CDC announces free medical camps for residents of Nyamira County starting this May.
Kiswahili: CDC inatangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kuanzia Mei hii.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa xeryo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Nyamira laga bilaabo bisha May.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar yedhe (CDC) ogolo kampen mag thieth maonge chudo ne jogweng' Nyamira County kochakore e dwe mar Mei.
