English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties advises residents of Samburu County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Samburu inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties nyiso jogweng' Samburu County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages residents of Kwale County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga la talinta bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo jogweng' mar Kwale County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Notice: NPS launches a burglary prevention campaign in Kilifi County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NPS yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada degmada Kilifi bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar National Police (NPS) chako kampen mar geng'o jokuoge e gweng' mar Kilifi e dwe mar Mach.

English: Aiming to contribute to the creation of opportunities for women in Kenya, and women in similar contexts in Morocco and Cote d'Ivoire, Acted, with the support of The Coca-Cola Foundation (TCCF), launched the SHE-GROW Africa Project.
Kiswahili: Ikilenga kuchangia katika uundaji wa fursa kwa wanawake nchini Kenya, na wanawake katika mazingira sawa nchini Morocco na Cote d'Ivoire, Acted, kwa usaidizi wa Wakfu wa Coca-Cola (TCCF), ilizindua Mradi wa SHE-GROW Afrika.
Somali: Iyadoo ujeedadu tahay in ay gacan ka geysato abuurista fursado loogu talagalay haweenka Kenya, iyo haweenka xaaladaha la midka ah ee Morocco iyo Cote d'Ivoire, Acted, oo taageero ka helaya Hay'adda Coca-Cola (TCCF), ayaa daah-furtay Mashruuca SHE-GROW Africa.
Dholuo: Ka ne gidwaro konyo e loso thuolo ne mon e piny Kenya, kod mon ma ni e chal machalre e piny Morocco kod Cote d’Ivoire, ne gichako chenro mar SHE-GROW Afrika.

English: Notice: Council of Governors launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kericho County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kericho Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha waxay bilaabeen olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa degmada Kericho bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Jaloch chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Kericho e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds the public in Kiambu County that input on development planning forums is welcome this June.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba mchango kwenye vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo unakaribishwa Juni hii.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kiambu in talooyinka ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta la soo dhaweynayo bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya oparo ne ji duto e County mar Kiambu ni gik ma ji wacho e wi chenro mag dongruok en gima owinjore e dwe mar Jun.

English: NGEC educates public on GBV reporting and legal remedies.
Kiswahili: NGEC huwaelimisha watu kuhusu taarifa za GBV na njia za kisheria.
Somali: NGEC waxay dadweynaha u baraysaa warbixinta GBV iyo caqabadaha sharciga.
Dholuo: NGEC puonjo ji e wi weche mag GBV kod yore mag thieth.

English: Everyone using Commuter Train must follow measures at the Railway Station. A brand new ferry has been introduced at Likoni Ferry to ensure social distance. Flower export will be sustained by adding 12 more airlines; CS Macharia. #KomeshaCorona update.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu anayetumia Treni ya Kusafiria lazima afuate hatua katika Kituo cha Reli. Feri mpya kabisa imetambulishwa katika Feri ya Likoni ili kuhakikisha umbali wa kijamii. Usafirishaji wa maua utadumishwa kwa kuongeza mashirika 12 zaidi ya ndege; CS Macharia. #KomeshaCorona sasisho.
Somali: Qof kasta oo isticmaala Tareenka Gaadiidka waa inuu raacaa tallaabooyinka Saldhigga Tareenka. Doon cusub ayaa lagu soo bandhigay Likoni Ferry si loo hubiyo kala fogaanshaha bulshada. Dhoofinta ubaxa waxaa lagu sii wadi doonaa iyadoo lagu darayo 12 diyaaradood oo kale; CS Macharia. #Cusbooneysiinta KomeshaCorona.
Dholuo: Ng’ato ka ng’ato ma tiyo gi Tren mar Jolendo nyaka luwo chike ma oket e Stesen mar Tren. Oket yie manyien ahinya e yie mar Likoni mondo oket thuolo mabor gi jowetegi. Oganda ma ng’iewo maua e pinje ma oko biro dhi nyime kuom medo ndege mamoko 12; CS Makaria. #KomeshaKorona ma manyien.

English: TVET advises students in Siaya County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Siaya kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata maudhui ya kujifunza dijitali bila malipo.
Somali: TVET waxay ardayda degmada Siaya kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga deeqda waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan waxyaabaha barashada dijitaalka ah ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jopuonjre e county mar Siaya mondo oketgi e intanet mondo giyud thuolo mar somo e yor digital maonge chudo.

English: Notice: AFA will distribute certified rice seed to farmers in Taita-Taveta County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: AFA itawapa wakulima wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta mbegu za mchele zilizoidhinishwa mwezi Desemba huu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay u qaybin doontaa abuurka bariiska ee shahaadada leh beeraleyda ku nool Gobolka Taita-Taveta bisha Diseembar ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Inyisowa kama: AFA biro pogo kodhi mag loso kodhi ne jopur manie Taita-Taveta County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to advocate for data governance policies that prioritize collective benefit for African agriculture to enhance innovation and resilience
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kutetea sera za usimamizi wa data ambazo zinatanguliza manufaa ya pamoja kwa kilimo cha Kiafrika ili kuongeza ubunifu na ustahimilivu.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay u doodaan siyaasadaha maamulka xogta ee mudnaanta siinaya faa'iidada guud ee beeraha Afrika si loo xoojiyo hal-abuurka iyo adkeysiga
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma tiyo e tije mag pur gi pur jiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag chike mag sirkal ma tayo weche mag digital ma keto ber mar oganda e ngima jopur e Afrika obed motelo mondo omi dongruok kod teko mar timo dongruok obedie.

English: Notice: KMTC launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay bilawday barnaamij adeegyo hagis iyo la-talin ah oo lagu sameeyo dugsiyada degmada Kilifi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KMTC chako chenro mar tayo kendo chiwo paro e skunde duto mag Kilifi County.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) advises residents of Nyamira County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun iyo biyo nadiif ah si joogto ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' Nyamira County mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free suicide prevention support is available through county health facilities in Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kuzuia kujiua unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo ka hortagga ismiidaaminta laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Kiambu.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar geng'o ji kik nege yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth e county ma Kiambu County.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the community in Baringo County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb carjacking.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia utekaji nyara wa gari.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Baringo inay ka warbixiyaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo shaki leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo afduubka gawaarida.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto modak Baringo County mondo onyis polis ma ni machiegni kodgi ni gitimo gik maok kare mondo kik gikwed kwalo mtokni.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unafungua ofisi ya kijinsia inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa furaya xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya daryeel caafimaad ka dib rabshadaha gobolka Mandera.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar weche motudore gi timbe mahundu chako tiyo gi ofis mar weche thieth e alwora mar Mandera.

English: Ministry of Education advises applicants in Taita-Taveta County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e gweng' mar Taita-Taveta mondo odonj e tiegruok kapok ichopo e chokruok mabiro.

English: Notice: KMTC announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Narok County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ee dugsiyada gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KMTC lando tarik mag somo e skunde mag Narok County.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free suicide prevention support is available through county health facilities in Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kuzuia kujiua unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo ka hortagga ismiidaaminta laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Marsabit County.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar geng'o ng'ato kik nege yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Marsabit.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Homa Bay County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka waxay dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay kula talineysaa inay biyo cabbiyaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit nyiso jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo omak pi modho kapok gitiyo kode mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: The most Important measure for epidemic prevention is to adjust social etiquette and lifestyle to reduce the chance of infection e.g. wearing a face mask should be part of normal lifestyle. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Hatua Muhimu zaidi ya kuzuia janga ni kurekebisha adabu za kijamii na mtindo wa maisha ili kupunguza uwezekano wa kuambukizwa k.m. kuvaa barakoa inapaswa kuwa sehemu ya maisha ya kawaida. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Tallaabada ugu muhiimsan ee looga hortagayo cudurrada faafa waa in la hagaajiyo anshaxa bulshada iyo qaab nololeedka si loo yareeyo fursadda caabuqa tusaale ahaan xirashada maaskaro wejiga waa inay qayb ka noqotaa qaab nololeedka caadiga ah. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Okang’ maduong’ ahinya mar geng’o tuwo ma loyo en loko yore mag oganda kod yore mag ngima mondo ogeng’ thuolo mar yudo tuwo e.g. rwako mask mar wang’ onego obed achiel kuom yore mag ngima ma pile. #KomeshaKorona

English: AFA promotes soil conservation among farmers in Nyamira County as part of the January climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: AFA inakuza uhifadhi wa udongo miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Januari.
Somali: AFA waxay dhiirrigelisay ilaalinta ciidda beeraleyda degmada Nyamira iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Janaayo.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo rito lowo e kind jopur e Kaunti mar Nyamira kaka achiel kuom chenro mar Januar mar kedo gi lokruok e kor lwasi.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit calls on parents in Nandi County to have children under five screened for tuberculosis during the November outreach.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuwafanyia watoto chini ya miaka mitano uchunguzi wa kifua kikuu wakati wa mawasiliano ya Novemba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Nandi in carruurta ka yar shan sano la sameeyo baaritaanka cudurka 'tuberculosis' inta lagu gudajiro bisha Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit okwayo jonyuol e county mar Nandi mondo otim nonro mar tuo mar TB ne nyithindgi ma hikgi tin ne abich e dwe mar Novemba.

English: The effects of climatic and non-climatic factors on malaria mortality at different spatial scales in western Kenya, 2008-2019
Kiswahili: Athari za hali ya hewa na zisizo za hali ya hewa juu ya vifo vya malaria katika viwango tofauti vya anga magharibi mwa Kenya, 2008-2019
Somali: Saamaynta arrimaha cimilada iyo kuwa aan cimilada ahayn ee dhimashada duumada ee heerarka kala duwan ee meelaha galbeedka Kenya, 2008-2019
Dholuo: Bedo gi weche mag kor lwasi kod gik ma ok mag kor lwasi kuom tho mag maleria e rang'iny mopogore opogore mag piny Kenya ma milambo, 2008-2019

English: KRA encourages first-time voters in Tana River County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: KRA inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Wilaya ya Tana River kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: KRA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Tana River inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo josiasa ma ne okwongo yiero e taon mar Tana River County mondo oting'e ID kata pasi mar pinygi e odiechieng'no mar yiero.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynta ee Degmada Migori.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Huduma Kenya biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag siasa e county mar Migori.

English: CDC encourages mothers in Turkana County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Turkana kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Turkana inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo mine manie County mar Turkana mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Notice: FAO will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Kilifi County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi diiwaangelinta beeraleyda loogu talagalay beeralayda degmada Kilifi bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Nonro: FAO biro timo rapar mar jopur e dwe mar Februar e gweng' mar Kilifi.

English: Kenya Red Cross advises residents of Wajir County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Laanta Cas ee Kenya waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir inay qaataan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' mar Wajir County mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi ka gidwaro yudo thieth mondo giyud thieth makonyogi.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the June planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kutumia viwango vinavyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa kupanda mwezi Juni.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda Degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay dalbadaan sicirka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur e County mar Tharaka-Nithi ni mondo giti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Jun.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises milk producers in Nairobi County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inashauri wazalishaji wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kula talineysaa soosaarayaasha caanaha ee degmada Nairobi inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur mag chak e County mar Nairobi mondo oti gi nengo mar piny mosingi kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: More so, economic affairs like market prices and availability of loans, awareness and field expertise also, have great impact on production.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, mambo ya kiuchumi kama vile bei za soko na upatikanaji wa mikopo, ufahamu na ujuzi wa uwanja pia, huathiri sana uzalishaji.
Somali: Intaas waxaa sii dheer, arrimaha dhaqaalaha sida qiimaha suuqa iyo helitaanka amaahda, wacyiga iyo aqoonta goobta ayaa sidoo kale saameyn weyn ku leh wax soo saarka.
Dholuo: E wi mano, weche mag ohala kaka nengo mar ohala kod nyalo mar yudo pesago, ng'eyo wach ohala, kod lony e weche mag tich, bende kelo ber mang'eny ne ohala.

English: KTDA urges farmers in Bomet County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Bomet inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e county mar Bomet mondo opidh olembe mag choko lowo mondo okonygi loyo lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: Notice: e-Citizen opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa ajili ya usajili wa e-citizen katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ogeysiis: e-Citizen waxay ka furaysaa goob adeeg oo cusub oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-citizen-ka ee degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: e-Citizen oseyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag kwayo ji mondo odonj e e - Citizen e County mar Siaya.

English: CONTENTS 0 Financial Year 2024/25 Budget THEME: Sustaining Bottom-Up Economic Transformation Agenda, Fiscal Consolidation and investing in Climate Change Mitigation and Adaptation for Improved Livelihoods.
Kiswahili: YALIYOMO 0 Mwaka wa Fedha wa 2024/25 MANdhari ya Bajeti: Kudumisha Ajenda ya Mabadiliko ya Kiuchumi ya Chini-juu, Uimarishaji wa Fedha na kuwekeza katika Kukabiliana na Mabadiliko ya Tabianchi na Marekebisho kwa ajili ya Maisha Bora.
Somali: TUSMADA 0 Sannad Maaliyadeed 2024/25 MUUQAALKA Miisaaniyadda: Joogteynta Ajandaha Isbeddelka Dhaqaalaha ee Hoose-Kor u kaca, Isu-duwidda Maaliyadda iyo maalgelinta Yaraynta Isbeddelka Cimilada iyo La-qabsiga Hab-nololeedka Hagaajinta.
Dholuo: GIMO MOTIMORE 0 Higa mar pesa 2024/25 Bajet THEM: Keto Ajenda mar loko weche mag ohala kowuok piny nyaka malo, Keto pesa e piny kendo keto pesa e dwoko piny lokruok mag piny kod loso gik moko mondo obed gi ngima maber.

English: Synthesis report on the co-design of agroecological innovations in the Agroecological Living Landscapes (ALLs) in Kenya
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya muhtasari wa muundo-shirikishi wa ubunifu wa ikolojia ya kilimo katika Mandhari Hai ya Kilimo (ALLs) nchini Kenya.
Somali: Warbixin ku saabsan qaabaynta wadajirka ah ee hal-abuurka beeraha ee muuqaalka noolaha beeraha (ALLs) ee Kenya
Dholuo: Ripot mar loso gik moko duto ewi loso kanyakla mar gik manyien ma mulo piny ma dongo dongo (ALLs) e piny Kenya

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds voters in Bungoma County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mkurugenzi Mkuu wa Uchaguzi anakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya kujiandikisha.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu xusuusinayaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Bungoma inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor diiwaangelinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General parone jogweng'o mag Bungoma County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom SMS ne 70000 kapok gidonjo e register mar joma oyiero.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the public in Kirinyaga County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadweynaha Gobolka Kirinyaga inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ji duto e County mar Kirinyaga mondo ochiw ripot mar ote mamulo pachgi ne jatendgi bang' yudo ripode mag wuond mar SIM-swap.

English: KRA reminds the public in Isiolo County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Isiolo in warbixinta laaluushyada xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: KRA parone ji duto e kaunti mar Isiolo ni chiwo ripot mar kawo asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: This initial training will focus on the key concepts and approaches associated with climate action in the agricultural sectors, especially Climate-Smart ...
Kiswahili: Mafunzo haya ya kwanza yatakazia dhana muhimu na mifikio inayohusiana na hatua za hali ya hewa katika sekta za kilimo, hasa hali ya hewa ......
Somali: Tababarkan bilowga ah wuxuu diiradda saari doonaa fikradaha muhiimka ah iyo hababka la xiriira tallaabooyinka cimilada ee qaybaha beeraha, gaar ahaan Climate-Smart ...
Dholuo: Tiegruok ma ne otimno ne dhi wuoyo kuom paro kod yore madongo ma ne itiyogo e timo lokruok e alwora mar piny e yore mag pur, to moloyo e weche mag lokruok e yo ma piny chalo.

English: Gov't activates public health emergency operation centres across the country after case of Monkeypox confirmed in Taita Taveta County
Kiswahili: Serikali yazindua vituo vya dharura vya afya ya umma kote nchini baada ya kisa cha Monkeypox kuthibitishwa katika Kaunti ya Taita Taveta
Somali: Dowladdu waxay hawlgelisay xarumaha gurmadka degdegga ah ee caafimaadka dadweynaha ee dalka oo dhan ka dib markii kiiskii Monkeypox laga xaqiijiyay Degmada Taita Taveta
Dholuo: <2Zepa> Sirkal oketo kar tich mag thieth mapiyo e piny mangima bang' yudo tuo mar ng'uono e gweng' mar Taita Taveta

English: NTSA urges residents of Mombasa County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama katikati ya tahadhari kubwa ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaala aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nabadgelyada qaranka.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo jogweng' Mombasa County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar sirkal e wi gik ma ne timore e alwora mar tong'gi nikech ji osebedo ka keto pachgi ahinya kuom loso kuwe e piny.

English: IEBC invites residents of Bomet County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: IEBC gwelo joma odak e county mar Bomet mondo ochiw ripot mondik kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso chenro mar dongruok ochopo.

English: Kenya: the cost of inaction (May 2023)
Kiswahili: Kenya: gharama ya kutochukua hatua (Mei 2023)
Somali: Kenya: Qiimaha Waxqabad la'aanta (Maajo 2023)
Dholuo: Kenya: nengo mar bedo maonge gimoro (Mei 2023)

English: State Department for TVET invites youth in Kwale County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this April.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kwale kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Aprili hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku casuumaysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kwale inay iska diiwaangeliyaan tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET ogwelo rowere man Kwale County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing e dwe mar April.

English: OGP urges residents of Kajiado County to attend the public participation forum to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kajiado County kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay ka qayb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si ay u qaabeeyaan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo ji duto modak e Kajiado County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar loso chenro mar dongruok.

English: KEPHIS encourages farmers in Marsabit County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for tea.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora ya chai.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Marsabit inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo shaaha ah.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Marsabit mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar chai.

English: Ministry of Education encourages residents of Kirinyaga County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education ojiwo jogweng' Kirinyaga County mondo ong'e weche ma gidonjogo e register mar joma oyiero mondo ging'e kaka ji duto biro tiyo gi bajet mar county.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds residents of Nakuru County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba upatikanaji wa utunzaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaan-hayaha xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Nakuru in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda fududahay iyada oo loo marayo kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties parone jogweng' Nakuru County ni koro yot yudo weche mag nyuol ka gitiyo gi yore mag sirkal.

English: HELB reminds parents in Taita-Taveta County that adult literacy classes registration is open this April.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kwamba usajili wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima umefunguliwa Aprili hii.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta gobolka Taita-Taveta in diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ay furan tahay bisha April.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa jonyuol man Taita-Taveta County ni chenro mar dhi e klas mar somo gi ndiko ne joma dongo osechakore e dwe mar April.

English: Deputy President William Ruto on Wednesday ordered the Ministry of Education to purchase a new generator for the Kenya Technical Trainers College (KTTC). The directive by Ruto came after his speech, w...
Kiswahili: Naibu Rais William Ruto Jumatano aliamuru Wizara ya Elimu kununua jenereta mpya kwa ajili ya Chuo cha Wakufunzi wa Ufundi cha Kenya (KTTC). Agizo hilo la Ruto lilitolewa baada ya hotuba yake, w...
Somali: Madaxweyne ku xigeenka William Ruto ayaa Arbacadii ku amray Wasaaradda Waxbarashada inay iibsato matoor cusub oo loogu talagalay Kulliyadda Tababarayaasha Farsamada Kenya (KTTC).
Dholuo: Jatend piny, William Ruto, ne ochiko migawo mar tiegruok mar piny Kenya mondo ong'iew generator manyien mar Kenya Technical Trainers College (KTTC).

English: Notice: TVET reminds citizens in Meru County about their rights regarding devolution.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Meru kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: Ogsoonow: TVET waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Meru ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET paronwa raia mag Meru County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar golo pesa.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education reminds citizens in Marsabit County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Marsabit ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Puonjruok parone raia mag Marsabit County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo gi ji duto e bajet mar county.

English: KALRO informs coffee farmers in Kakamega County of new market linkage opportunities this November.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawafahamisha wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Novemba hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda kafeega ee Gobolka Kakamega fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha November.
Dholuo: KALRO chiwo ripot ne jopur mag chai e Kaunti mar Kakamega kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens voter education centres in Uasin Gishu County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed ayaa furaya xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee Gobolka Uasin Gishu bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties oyawo kuonde tiego josiasa e kaunti mar Uasin Gishu e dwe mar Januar.

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health warns of increased typhoid risk in Homa Bay County and advises the public to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya typhoid katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay na inashauri umma kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ka digtay kororka halista cudurka 'typhoid' ee gobolka Homa Bay waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Chenro mar thieth mar ji: Ministry of Health osiemo ji kuom medo bedo gi tuo mar typhoid e Homa Bay County kendo ojiwo ji mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni kodgi.

English: KEPHIS advises fish producers in Samburu County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawashauri wazalishaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kalluunka ee Gobolka Samburu inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KEPHIS nyiso jopur ma loso rech e county mar Samburu mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur ka pok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health warns of increased cyclosporiasis risk in Busia County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya cyclosporiasis katika Kaunti ya Busia na inashauri umma kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na dawa kila usiku.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ka digtay kororka halista cyclosporiasis ee degmada Busia waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay isticmaalaan shabaqa cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar oganda: Ministry of Health osiemo ji kuom wach yudo tuo mar cyclosporiasis e County mar Busia kendo ojiwo ji mondo oti gi net mag choke molos gi yedhe makelo tuoche mag kute otieno ka otieno.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMSA will be held in Murang'a County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMSA itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay KEMSA ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Murang'a bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma KEMSA ochano biro timore e County mar Murang'a e dwe mar Julai.

English: The H.E. will also engage on the importance of accelarating local manufacturing of vaccines & access to a future Covid-19 vaccine. #KomeshaCorona update.
Kiswahili: H.E. pia itahusisha umuhimu wa kuongeza kasi ya utengenezaji wa chanjo nchini na upatikanaji wa chanjo ya baadaye ya Covid-19. #KomeshaCorona sasisho.
Somali: Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale ka hadli doona muhiimadda ay leedahay dardargelinta wax soo saarka maxalliga ah ee tallaallada iyo helitaanka tallaalka Covid-19 ee mustaqbalka. #KomeshaCorona update.
Dholuo: Od bura mar H.E. bende biro wuoyo kuom ber mar loso mapiyo yath mag geng’o tuo mar Covid-19 kendo yudo yath mar geng’o tuo mar Covid-19 e kinde mabiro. #KomeshaKorona ma manyien.

English: NPS urges anyone experiencing abuse in Nakuru County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: NPS inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Nakuru piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa qofkasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Nakuru inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: NPS ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195 maonge chudo.

English: CDC launches a December awareness campaign on safe water storage across Embu County.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Desemba juu ya uhifadhi wa maji salama katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: CDC waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Diseembar oo ku saabsan kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee gobolka Embu.
Dholuo: CDC chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Desemba kuom wach kano pi maler e alwora mar Embu County.

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on the community in Lamu County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Lamu kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqayaa bulshada degmada Lamu inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan isla markaana ay taageero ka raadsadaan hoyga ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service luongo oganda man Lamu County mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Impact Evaluation of Cash-Based Transfers and Gender in Kenya, July 2023
Kiswahili: Tathmini ya Athari za Uhamisho na Jinsia Kulingana na Pesa nchini Kenya, Julai 2023
Somali: Qiimaynta Saamaynta Lacag-bixinta Ku-saleysan iyo Jinsiga ee Kenya, Luulyo 2023
Dholuo: Nonro mar ber mar oro mwandu moluwo pesa kod kido mar chuech e piny Kenya, dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2023

English: Notice: TVET reminds citizens in Marsabit County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Marsabit ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET paronwa jogweng' mar Marsabit kuom ratiro ma gin-go e weche motudore gi chike mag sirkal.

English: The Kenya Cash Consortium's Locally Led Alert-Based Cash Assistance to Disaster Affected Households in Dadaab Refugee camp: Baseline, May, 2024
Kiswahili: Usaidizi wa Pesa wa Tahadhari Uliowekwa Ndani ya Kenya Cash Consortium kwa Kaya Zilizoathiriwa na Maafa katika kambi ya Wakimbizi ya Dadaab: Msingi, Mei, 2024.
Somali: Gargaarka Lacageed ee ku salaysan Digniinta ee Hay'adda Lacagta ee Kenya ee Deegaanka u qaabilsan qoysaska ay saameeyeen masiibooyinka ee xerada qaxootiga ee Dhadhaab: Saldhigga, Maajo, 2024
Dholuo: Kony mar pesa ma Kenya otelo ne jodak ma oyudo masira e kambi mar jolweny mag Dadaab: Chakruok, dwe mar abich, higa mar 2024

English: Notice: Council of Governors opens voter education centres in Homa Bay County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa furaya xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee gobolka Homa Bay bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Bura mar Jaloch biro yawo kuonde tiego josiasa e Homa Bay County e dwe mar Agost.

English: KMTC announces distribution of textbooks and learning materials to schools in Kisii County this June.
Kiswahili: KMTC inatangaza usambazaji wa vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kisii Juni hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta buugaagta waxbarasho iyo qalabka wax lagu barto dugsiyada degmada Kisii bishii Juun.
Dholuo: KMTC olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok e skunde man Kisii County e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice from Kenya Medical Association: skilled birth attendance clinics will run every December at designated health centres in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya: kliniki za mahudhurio ya uzazi zenye ujuzi zitaendeshwa kila Desemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya: rugaha daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfadlayaasha ah waxaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Diseembar ee kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association: Klinike mag rito nyuol ma nigi lony biro tiyo e dwe mar Desemba higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Kisii.

English: Notice: KALRO will train farmers in Embu County on terracing this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu juu ya mashindano Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: KALRO waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Embu oo ku saabsan dhulka lagu beeray bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KALRO biro tiego jopur e county mar Embu e wi tiyo gi lowo e dwe mar April.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Bomet County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Bomet inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kalfadhiga tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Bura matayo gik makedo gi tuoche jiwo jopur e county mar Bomet mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e chokruok mabiro.

English: Nairobi, Kajiado, Machakos, Kiambu & Nakuru counties are individually and collectively declared a disease infected area. There shall be a cessation of movement by road, rail, air in to & out of these areas effective midnight
Kiswahili: Kaunti za Nairobi, Kajiado, Machakos, Kiambu na Nakuru zimetangazwa kuwa eneo lililoathiriwa na magonjwa moja moja na kwa pamoja. Kutakuwa na kusimamishwa kwa usafiri kwa barabara, reli, hewa kuingia na kutoka katika maeneo haya kuanzia saa sita usiku.
Somali: Gobollada Nairobi, Kajiado, Machakos, Kiambu & Nakuru ayaa si gaar ah iyo si wadajir ah loogu dhawaaqay inay yihiin aagag cudurku ku dhacay.
Dholuo: Sirkande mag Nairobi, Kajiado, Machakos, Kiambu & Nakuru ne oler achiel kachiel kendo kanyachiel ni gin kuonde ma tuwono nitie.

English: Marsabit County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for January 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Marsabit: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Januari 2024
Somali: Degmada Marsabit: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Janaayo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Marsabit: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar achiel higa mar 2024

English: KJSEA ends today; KCSE written exams begin tomorrow.
Kiswahili: KJSEA huisha leo; mitihani ya KCSE huanza kesho.
Somali: KJSEA waxay dhammaaneysaa maanta; Imtixaannada qoraalka ah ee KCSE waxay bilaabmayaan berrito.
Dholuo: KJSEA tieko kawuono; penj mag KCSE chakore kiny.

English: OGP urges residents of Bungoma County to attend the public participation forum to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si ay u qaabeeyaan wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynta.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar loso chenro mag chenro mag oganda.

English: KRA urges residents of Marsabit County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on community-based development programmes.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waendelee kuwa na habari juu ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inay la xiriiraan maamulayaasha degmooyinkooda si ay uga warqabaan barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo jogweng' mar Marsabit County mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jotelo mag utegi mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi chenro mag dongruok mag oganda.

English: The Solutions and Mobility Index (SMI) for Wajir and Mandera aims to assess progress toward durable solutions for displaced populations (IDPs and IDP returnees).
Kiswahili: Kielezo cha Suluhu na Uhamaji (SMI) cha Wajir na Mandera kinalenga kutathmini maendeleo kuelekea suluhu za kudumu kwa watu waliohamishwa makazi yao (IDPs na wanaorejea IDP).
Somali: Tusmada Xalalka iyo Dhaqdhaqaaqa (SMI) ee Wajeer iyo Mandheera waxay higsaneysaa in lagu qiimeeyo horumarka loo marayo xalalka waara ee dadka barakacay (IDPs iyo dadka soo laabtay).
Dholuo: Oboke mar ng’ado bura (SMI) mar Wajir kod Mandera nigi gombo mar nono kaka osedhi nyime e ng’ado bura ma nyalo tiyo kuom kinde malach ne jogo ma osewuok e udigi (joma osewuok e udigi kod jogo ma oseduogo).

English: NCPB reminds farmers in Kiambu County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Somali: NCPB waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kiambu barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee ka dambeeya goosashada.
Dholuo: NCPB parone jopur e County mar Kiambu chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime bang' keyo.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET opens a new electrical installation programme at the vocational centre in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yafungua programu mpya ya ufungaji wa umeme katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Qaranka ee TVET waxay barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan rakibidda korontada ka fureysaa xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State Department for TVET ochako chenro manyien mar keto sitima e kar tiegruok e taon mar Baringo.

English: DPP reminds residents of Marsabit County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada ay fatahaadu ka dhacdo xilligan.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogweng' mar Marsabit County ni kik giwuoth e wi borni kod aoche ma pi opong'o.

English: Latest publication A. ACAT 2025 has called on great investment in solutions of agriculture technology in Africa. A. Malawi farmers...
Kiswahili: Chapisho la hivi punde A. ACAT 2025 limetoa wito wa uwekezaji mkubwa katika suluhu za teknolojia ya kilimo barani Afrika. A. Wakulima wa Malawi...
Somali: Daabacaaddii ugu dambeysay A. ACAT 2025 waxay ku baaqday maalgelin weyn oo lagu sameynayo xalalka tiknoolajiyada beeraha ee Afrika. A. Beeraleyda Malawi...
Dholuo: Gaset mar A. ACAT 2025 oseluongo ji mondo oti gi yore mag timo dongruok e yore mag pur e Afrika.

English: Postpartum depression is real. Encourage new mothers to seek help and talk openly.
Kiswahili: Msongo wa mawazo baada ya kujifungua ni halisi. Wahimize akina mama wapya kutafuta msaada na kuzungumza waziwazi.
Somali: Dhibaatada dhalmada ka dib waa mid dhab ah. Hooyooyinka cusub ku dhiirigeliso inay caawimaad raadsadaan oo ay si furan u hadlaan.
Dholuo: Jiw mine manyien mondo omany kony kendo owuo ayanga.

English: Ministry of Health urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Vihiga County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kumhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Vihiga inuu ku dhiirrigeliyo saaxiibkiisa dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pachgi e County mar Vihiga mondo ojiw osiepne moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: NDMA urges residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay iskaashi la sameeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo la sii xoojinayo amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'adoe bura e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya kuom weche mag rito tong'.

English: Notice: NPS activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NPS inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay shilalka waddooyinka ee gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NPS tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony e masiche mag ndara e Homa Bay County.

English: Malnutrition remains high as drought continues in Kenya
Kiswahili: Utapiamlo umesalia kuwa juu huku ukame ukiendelea nchini Kenya
Somali: Nafaqo-darradu wali way sarreysaa iyadoo abaartu ay ka sii socoto Kenya
Dholuo: Chiemo ma ok oromo pod ni malo e seche ma oro dhi nyime e piny Kenya

English: DCI reminds residents of Turkana County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana in warbixinta degdegga ah ee xanta xoolaha ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: DCI parone jogweng'o mag Turkana County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo jamni konyo rito alwora.

English: IEBC updates residents of Kwale County on progress of community-based development programmes this May.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale juu ya maendeleo ya mipango ya maendeleo inayotegemea jamii Mei hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay dadka deggan degmada Kwale ku wargelineysaa horumarka barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada ee bisha May.
Dholuo: IEBC chiwo ripot ne jogweng' mar Kwale County kuom dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag oganda e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by SHA (Social Health Authority) will be held in Kisumu County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Kisumu bisha July.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma olos gi SHA (Social Health Authority) ibiro tim Kisumu County e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the August planting season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Agosti.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagyada si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda ka hor xilliga beerashada ee Agoosto.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni gitim lokruok e puothe mondo omi lowo odok maber kapok ochako chuoyo e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will conduct a post-harvest handling workshop for farmers in Busia County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi ka dib goosashada beeraleyda degmada Busia bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro timo chokruok mar timo nonro bang' keyo ne jopur e taon mar Busia e dwe mar Agost.

English: Council of Governors invites residents of Homa Bay County to attend the public participation forum regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku martiqaadaan dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay ka soo qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan wadatashiyada siyaasadda guud.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch ogwelo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi weche siasa.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kurejesha huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la hagaajiyay waqtiga wareejinta adeegyada baasaboorka ee degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties olando lokruok e seche mag tiyo gi passport e County mar Kericho.

English: Notice: TSC announces school feeding programme enrollment dates for schools in Embu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC inatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa programu ya kulisha shule kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiyada degmada Embu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: TSC olando tarik mag dhi e skunde mag Embu County.

English: Notice: KALRO will open a maize collection centre in Isiolo County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mahindi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay bilaabi doontaa xarun ururinta hadhuudhka ee degmada Isiolo bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KALRO biro yawo kambi mar choko cham e taon mar Isiolo e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit launches a May awareness campaign on hand hygiene across Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Mei juu ya usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Maajo oo ku saabsan nadaafadda gacmaha gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osechako kampen mar miyo ji ng'eyo e wi ler mar lwetgi e dwe mar Mei e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will open a tea collection centre in Turkana County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itafungua kituo cha kukusanya chai katika Kaunti ya Turkana Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay xarun soo uruurinaysa shaaha ka furi doontaa degmada Turkana bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro chako choko chai e taon mar Turkana e dwe mar Septemba.

English: TVET calls on the community in Meru County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TVET inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Meru kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TVET waxay bulshada degmada Meru ugu baaqeysaa inay u soo wargeliyaan maamulka dugsiga wixii dhibaato ah ee ku saabsan amniga si ay dugsiyada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: TVET kwayo ji duto manie County mar Meru mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar skul e wi weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Kakamega County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kakamega inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kalfadhiga tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni gidonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mondo gidhi gipuonjre weche mag pur.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will open a fish collection centre in Garissa County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itafungua kituo cha kukusanya samaki katika Kaunti ya Garissa Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu furi doonaa xarun lagu soo ururiyo kalluunka Gobolka Garissa bisha May.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: Kenya Dairy Board biro yawo kambi mar choko rech e taon mar Garissa e dwe mar Mei.

English: To control Kapinga (Bermuda grass) in maize fields, spray glyphosate on actively growing weeds a few days after rain (240ml per 16L water) before planting, then plant maize a day or more later; before or after maize germinates, spray Atrazine over moist soil (320ml per 16L water). Always follow label instructions and wear protective equipment.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti Kapinga (nyasi za Bermuda) katika mashamba ya mahindi, nyunyiza glyphosate kwenye magugu yanayokua kikamilifu siku chache baada ya mvua (240ml kwa maji 16L) kabla ya kupanda, kisha panda mahindi siku moja au zaidi baadaye; kabla au baada ya mahindi kuota, nyunyiza Atrazine juu ya udongo wenye unyevunyevu (320ml kwa maji 16L). Daima fuata maagizo ya lebo na uvaa vifaa vya kinga.
Somali: Si loo xakameeyo Kapinga (cawska Bermuda) ee beeraha galleyda, ku buufi glyphosate cawska firfircoon koraya dhowr maalmood kadib roobka (240ml halkii 16L biyo) ka hor inta aan la beerin, kadibna galleyda beer maalin ama ka badan kadib; ka hor ama ka dib dhalashada galleyda, ku buufi Atrazine dhul qoyan (320ml biyo kasta oo 16L ah). Had iyo jeer raac tilmaamaha calaamadda oo xiro qalabka ilaalinta.
Dholuo: Mondo omi kik cham mar Kapinga (Bermuda grass) chakre e puothe mag kodhi, ng'ato onego okaw glyphosate e lum ma dongo e yo ma ratiro bang' ka koth osechwe (240 ml kuom pi 16L) bang' ndalo matin kapok ochwoyo, kae to ogol kodhi bang' odiechieng' achiel kata mokalo kanyo; kapok kodhi owuok, kata bang'e, ng'ato onego okaw Atrazine e lowo motwo (320 ml kuom pi 16L).

English: Learning event in coastal counties brought religious leaders and civil society together to strengthen local prevention efforts.
Kiswahili: Tukio la kujifunza katika wilaya za pwani liliwaunganisha viongozi wa kidini na jamii ya kiraia ili kuimarisha jitihada za kuzuia.
Somali: Dhacdo waxbarasho oo ka dhacday degmooyinka xeebaha ayaa isu keenay hoggaamiyeyaasha diinta iyo bulshada rayidka ah si loo xoojiyo dadaallada ka hortagga deegaanka.
Dholuo: Puonjruok ma ne otim e gwenge ma ne ni e dho nam ne oriwo jotend din kod riwruok mar oganda mondo omed jiwo kinda ma ne itimo mar geng'o tuoche.

English: IPOA urges residents of Kwale County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo jogweng' Kwale County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'enyie e bwo weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Kwale County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kwale: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2023
Somali: Degmada Kwale: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kwale: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar adek higa mar 2023

English: COMESA announces a free lumpy skin disease vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Kirinyaga County this April.
Kiswahili: COMESA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa ngozi kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Aprili hii.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan cudurka maqaarka oo loogu talagalay lo'da caanaha ah ee Gobolka Kirinyaga bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: COMESA ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok makwayo pi e dwe mar April e gweng' mar Kirinyaga.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public that free stress management support is available through county health facilities in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kudhibiti mafadhaiko unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo lagu maareeyo walbahaarka laga helo xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar stress yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Nyandarua.

English: Notice: EACC launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kisii County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kisii Oktoba hii.

English: IEBC advises residents of Garissa County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: IEBC inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.

English: Taita Taveta County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Taita Taveta: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2023

English: AFA urges sorghum growers in Wajir County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: AFA inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Wajir kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda sorghum ee Gobolka Wajir inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka ciidanka xilliga dayrta iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur mag sorghum e gweng' mar Wajir mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e kinde machuok ka gitiyo gi tuoche mag thieth ma giyiego mondo okony e medo nyak mar yien e higani.

English: Daily iron supplements help prevent anemia in pregnancy and ensure healthy fetal development.
Kiswahili: Virutubisho vya chuma vya kila siku husaidia kuzuia upungufu wa damu wakati wa ujauzito na kuhakikisha ukuaji mzuri wa fetasi.
Somali: Kaabista birta maalinlaha ah waxay ka caawineysaa ka hortagga dhiigla'aanta uurka iyo in la hubiyo horumarka uurka ee caafimaad qaba.
Dholuo: Medruok mar ting'o chuma pile ka pile konyo e geng'o tuwo mar rem e kinde mag ich kendo miyo nyathi dongo e yo maber.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Marsabit County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Marsabit inay ka soo qayb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur e county mar Marsabit mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will open a maize collection centre in Bomet County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mahindi katika Kaunti ya Bomet Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xarun ururinta hadhuudhka ka furi doontaa gobolka Bomet bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Tij Lemo kod Chiemo (AFA) biro yawo kama ichokoe cham e County mar Bomet e dwe mar Septemba.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages mothers in Kilifi County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kilifi inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo mine man Kilifi County mondo okel nyithindgi e timo nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds the public in Lamu County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this February.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mkurugenzi-Mchunguzi Mkuu anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Lamu kwamba mapendekezo juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka yanakaribishwa Februari hii.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadweynaha degmada Lamu in talooyinka dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee Febraayo la soo dhaweynayo.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General parone ji duto e County mar Lamu ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e dwe mar Februar.

English: DCI reminds residents of Nyandarua County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay dhagaystaan amarada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah inta lagu jiro xilliyada shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: DCI parone jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji e nderni ma sirkal ogolo e kinde masiche mag ndara.

English: Crisis in Kenya: Urgent action needed as 3.5 million face drought-induced hunger
Kiswahili: Mgogoro nchini Kenya: Hatua za haraka zinahitajika kwani milioni 3.5 wanakabiliwa na njaa inayosababishwa na ukame

Kiswahili: Kabla ya kipindi cha ukame kinachotabiriwa, Idara ya Hali ya Hewa na wizara ya kilimo ya Kenya wanawashauri wakulima wa mashamba yao waweke mashamba mengi, wafanye kazi ya kulima, wajenge vilima vilivyofungwa, na wawekeze katika miundo ya kukusanya maji ya mvua ili kuhifadhi unyevu wa udongo.

English: IEBC urges residents of Isiolo County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya wilaya ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.

English: Notice: TSC opens applications for revision guides for learners in Taita-Taveta County.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on the community in Narok County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Narok kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Narok inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan waxayna ka raadsadaan taageero guriga ugu dhow.

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health will host a free hypertension awareness outreach in Isiolo County this December.

English: ODPP encourages first-time voters in Taita-Taveta County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.

English: Provide integrated farm advisory services to all farmers engaged in food crop production.
