Somali: Kenya: Deeqaha waxbarasho ayaa ka caawiya ardayda nugul inay dhammaystiraan waxbarashada dugsiga sare
Dholuo: Kenya: Chuny mag somo konyo nyithind skul ma nigi pek mondo otim somo ma malo

English: Food prices also remain a persistent stressor, while excessive rainfall and flooding in 2024 disrupted livelihoods and damaged infrastructure, particularly affecting host communities reliant on agriculture and livestock.
Kiswahili: Bei ya vyakula pia inasalia kuwa mkazo unaoendelea, wakati mvua nyingi na mafuriko katika 2024 yalitatiza maisha na miundombinu iliyoharibiwa, haswa kuathiri jamii zinazotegemea kilimo na mifugo.
Somali: Qiimaha cuntadu sidoo kale waa walaac joogto ah, halka roobabkii xad-dhaafka ahaa iyo daadadkii 2024 ay carqaladeeyeen hab-nololeedka waxayna waxyeeleeyeen kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha, gaar ahaan waxay saameeyeen bulshooyinka martida loo yahay ee ku tiirsan beeraha iyo xoolaha.
Dholuo: Nengo mar chiemo bende pod en gima kelo pek ma ok rum, e seche ma koth mang’eny ahinya kod pi ma ne oumo piny e higa mar 2024 ne oketho ngima mar ji kendo ne oketho gik ma ne itiyogo, ahinya ahinya ne oketho jodak ma ne okawo jodak ma ne geno pur kod le.

English: KTDA urges pigs farmers in Vihiga County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wafugaji wa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa ngozi ya uvimbe vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda doofaarka ee degmada Vihiga inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyada oo aan la helin ruqsad ka dib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur puothe e County mar Vihiga mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni ka giwuok e county maok giyudo rusa bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag del.

English: Countries are collaborating to enhance access to agricultural mechanization services Farmers in Kenya Tanzania Ethiopia Zambia Ghana and Uganda may benefit from this initiative
Kiswahili: Nchi zinashirikiana kuimarisha upatikanaji wa huduma za mashine za kilimo Wakulima nchini Kenya Tanzania Ethiopia Zambia Ghana na Uganda wanaweza kunufaika na mpango huu
Somali: Wadamada ayaa iskaashi la sameeya si loo xoojiyo helitaanka adeegyada mashiinka beeraha Beeraleyda Kenya Tanzania Ethiopia Zambia Ghana iyo Uganda ayaa laga yaabaa inay ka faa'iideystaan dadaalkan
Dholuo: Pinje tiyo kanyachiel mondo gimed yudo tije mag timo tigo mag pur Jo-Purni Kenya Tanzania Ethiopia Zambia Ghana kod Uganda nyalo yudo ber kuom chenrono

English: Bungoma County has established a Sh230 million Agriculture Institutions Development Corporation to modernize and finance key agricultural institutions Farmers are encouraged to engage with this new body for support in agricultural development
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Bungoma imeanzisha Shirika la Maendeleo la Taasisi za Kilimo la Sh230 milioni ili kufanya kisasa na kufadhili taasisi muhimu za kilimo Wakulima wanahimizwa kushirikiana na chombo hiki kipya kwa msaada katika maendeleo ya kilimo.
Somali: Gobolka Bungoma wuxuu aasaasay Sh230 milyan Shirkadda Horumarinta Hay'adaha Beeraha si loo casriyeeyo loona maalgeliyo hay'adaha beeraha ee muhiimka ah Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay la shaqeeyaan hay'addan cusub si ay u taageeraan horumarinta beeraha
Dholuo: Bungoma County osechako Sh230 million Agriculture Institutions Development Corporation mondo otigo e loso kendo siro tije madongo mag pur.

English: Mandera County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for January 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Mandera: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Januari 2024
Somali: Degmada Mandheera: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Janaayo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Mandera: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar achiel higa mar 2024

English: Notice from Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: childhood immunization clinics will run every March at designated health centres in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi: kliniki za chanjo za watoto zitafanya kazi kila Machi katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta Caafimada taranka: rugta tallaalka carruurta ayaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Maarso oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Rieko moa kuom Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: Klinike mag thiedho nyithindo biro tiyo e dwe mar Mach higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Kisii.

English: DCI reminds residents of Baringo County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this drought season.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa ukame.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada ay fatahan yihiin xilligan abaarta.
Dholuo: DCI parone jogweng' Baringo County ni kik giwuoth e kor yiengni kod aoche ma pi opong'o e kinde mar oro.

English: Busia farmers have received 17 tonnes of Bt cotton seeds and fertilizer from the National government to revive cotton production Utilize these resources for better yields and income
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Busia wamepokea tani 17 za mbegu za pamba Bt na mbolea kutoka kwa serikali ya Kitaifa ili kufufua uzalishaji wa pamba Tumia rasilimali hizi kwa mavuno bora na mapato.
Somali: Beeraleyda Busia waxay ka heleen 17 tan oo Bt oo abuurka suufka iyo bacriminta Dowladda Qaranka si ay u soo celiyaan wax soo saarka suufka Isticmaal kheyraadkaas si aad u hesho wax soo saar iyo dakhli wanaagsan
Dholuo: Jo-Busia osenwang'o ton 17 mag kodhi mag pamba kod yien mag Bt e lwet sirkal mar piny mondo gimi puodho odog manyien. Ti gi mwandugo e kelo nyak kod pesa maber

English: In some cases, reporting corruption is more than just a duty; it is a legal obligation: The Prevention and Combating of Corrupt Activities Act requires people in ÃƒÂ¢ ' Ã¢Â€Â” "positions of authorityÃƒÂ¢ 'Ã‚Â¬ Ã‚Â in the public and private sectors to report corruption and other crimes listed in the Act involving more than R100 000, to the police.
Kiswahili: Katika baadhi ya matukio, kuripoti ufisadi ni zaidi ya wajibu tu; ni wajibu wa kisheria: Sheria ya Kuzuia na Kupambana na Shughuli za Rushwa inawataka watu katika nafasi za mamlaka katika sekta za umma na binafsi kuripoti ufisadi na uhalifu mwingine ulioorodheshwa katika Sheria hiyo unaohusisha zaidi ya R100,000, kwa polisi.
Somali: Xaaladaha qaarkood, soo sheegista musuqmaasuqu waa wax ka badan waajib oo keliya; waa waajib sharci ah: Xeerka Ka-hortagga iyo La-dagaallanka Hawlaha Musuqmaasuqa wuxuu u baahan yahay dadka ku jira jagooyinka awoodda ee qaybaha dadweynaha iyo kuwa gaarka loo leeyahay inay booliska u soo sheegaan musuqmaasuqa iyo dambiyada kale ee ku qoran Xeerka oo ay ku jiraan in ka badan R100 000.
Dholuo: E kinde moko, goyo ripot mar ketho chik en gima duong’ moloyo mana bedo gi ting’; en ting’ ma chik dwaro: Chik mar geng’o kendo kedo gi timbe mag ketho chik dwaro ni ji ma ni e rang’iny mar loch ma ng’ato ka ng’ato odonjoe e sektor mag piny owacho kod mag ng’ato ka ng’ato onyis tim mag ketho chik moloyo 000, ne jopolisi.

English: KUCCPS advises students in Nairobi County to collect materials from the county education office to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kukusanya vifaa kutoka ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ardayda degmada Nairobi kula talineysaa inay ka soo ururiyaan agabyada xafiiska waxbarashada degmada si ay u helaan deeq waxbarasho ardayda u baahan.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo jopuonjre e County Nairobi mondo ochok gik moko moa e ofis mar tiegruok mar county mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo osuru ne jopuonjre mochando.

English: KALRO reminds livestock keepers in Kisumu County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KALRO waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xayawaanka ah ee degmada Kisumu inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KALRO parone jopur mag jamni e gweng' mar Kisumu mondo opidhgi gi tuoche e kuonde moyier mag chwoyo jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by SHA (Social Health Authority) will be held in Turkana County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Turkana Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Turkana bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo kampen mar thieth maonge chudo e taon mar Turkana e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: KALRO will distribute certified millet seed to farmers in Marsabit County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay abuuraha degmada Marsabit u qaybin doontaa abuurka miraha ee la caddeeyay bisha Sebtember ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KALRO biro pogo kodhi mag millet ne jopur man Marsabit County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Judiciary of Kenya invites residents of Kisii County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kushiriki kupitia portal ya kushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee la xiriira la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya gwelo jogweng' Kisii County mondo oriwre kodgi kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e wi chenro mag chike mag sirkal.

English: Notice: NDMA conducts a community briefing on community early-warning systems in Nyamira County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Nyamira mwezi huu wa Oktoba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada oo ku saabsan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada ee degmada Nyamira bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA timo romo mar oganda e wi chenro mag chiwo siem motelo e alwora mar Nyamira County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: NCPB advises farmers in Lamu County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuleta nambari yao ya usajili wa mkulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Lamu inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qaybqaataan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e County mar Lamu mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: Kenya floods: Damaged schools mean over 15,000 children will be unable to return to learning next week
Kiswahili: Mafuriko Kenya: Shule zilizoharibiwa zinamaanisha zaidi ya watoto 15,000 hawataweza kurudi kujifunza wiki ijayo
Somali: Daadadka Kenya: Iskuulada burburay waxay la macno tahay in in ka badan 15,000 oo carruur ah aysan awoodin inay ku laabtaan waxbarashada toddobaadka soo socda
Dholuo: Opong’o piny Kenya: Sukuru ma okethore nyiso ni nyithindo mokalo 15,000 ok bi nyalo dok e somo juma mabiro

English: Council of Governors invites residents of Kisumu County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku martiqaadaan dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch ogwelo jogweng' mar Kisumu County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county mar tiego ji e weche mag chenro mag dongruok.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will train farmers in Mandera County on agroforestry this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera juu ya kilimo cha misitu Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa tababar siin doonta beeraleyda Degmada Mandera ku saabsan beeraha iyo kaymaha bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Rapar: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro tiego jopur man Mandera County e weche mag agroforestry e dwe mar Jun.

English: Mpox outbreak in Mombasa. Two people have died from Monkey Pox disease. Mombasa County has reported 98 Monkey Pox cases. There is a lot of active community transmission
Kiswahili: Mlipuko wa Mpox Mombasa. Watu wawili wamefariki kutokana na ugonjwa wa Tumbili. Kaunti ya Mombasa imeripoti visa 98 vya Tumbili. Kuna maambukizi mengi ya kijamii yanayoendelea
Somali: Faafaha Mpox ee Mombasa. Labo qof ayaa u dhintay cudurka Monkey Pox. Gobolka Mombsa ayaa soo sheegay 98 kiis oo Monkeypox ah. Waxaa jira tiro badan oo ka mid ah gudbinta bulshada ee firfircoon
Dholuo: Ng'ato ariyo osetho nikech tuwo mar Monkey Pox. County mar Mombasa osewacho ni nitie ji 98 ma nigi tuwo mar monkey pox.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds needy students in Vihiga County that school laptops under the digital literacy programme applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya maombi ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika za kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya ardayda u baahan degmada Vihiga in laptop-yada dugsiga ee ku jira codsiyada barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e County mar Vihiga ni kompyuta mag skul manie bwo program mar somo gi somo mar digital biro rumo machiegni.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will be held in Nyamira County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu bila malipo iliyoandaliwa na Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Nyamira bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Rapar: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ochano ibiro tim e County mar Nyamira e dwe mar Agost.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges motorists and pedestrians in Homa Bay County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kufunga na kutunza vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee gobolka Homa Bay inay guryahooda rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Weche Dhano jiwo jorit mtokni kod joma wuotho gi tiendgi e Homa Bay County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo gitim kinda mar geng'o aksident mag ndara.

English: IEBC uses boda boda networks to spread voter registration info.
Kiswahili: IEBC hutumia mitandao ya boda boda kusambaza habari za usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: IEBC waxay isticmaashaa shabakadaha boda boda si ay u faafiyaan macluumaadka diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: IEBC tiyo gi Intanet mar boda boda mondo oland weche mag ndiko ji.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadweynaha in taageerada soo kabashada xadgudubka maandooriyaha ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Kirinyaga County.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tiyo gi yedhe mamero yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth e gweng' mar Kirinyaga County.

English: Kenya Forest Service warns residents of Kisumu County to prepare for possible flooding this September.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa mafuriko Septemba hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ka digay dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay isu diyaariyaan fatahaadaha iman kara bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service osiemo ji duto modak Kisumu County mondo oikre ne koth maduong' mabiro timore e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Partnerships Create Solutions to Drought in Africa
Kiswahili: Ubia Hutengeneza Suluhu kwa Ukame Barani Afrika
Somali: Iskaashiga ayaa Xal u Abuuraya Abaaraha Afrika
Dholuo: Riwruok Kelo Yore mag Tieko Oro e Afrika

English: Notice: KEMSA confirms a Rift Valley Fever outbreak alert for Embu County. Residents are advised to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa kwa Kaunti ya Embu. Wakazi wanashauriwa kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMSA waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka Rift Valley Fever ee Gobolka Embu. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagu taliyey.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KEMSA osenyiso ni Rift Valley Fever osechakore e county mar Embu.

English: KTDA invites farmers in Lamu County to a free training on pest and disease management this October.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya udhibiti wa wadudu na magonjwa Oktoba hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda gobolka Lamu tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan xakamaynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KTDA gwelo jopur e County mar Lamu e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar tuoche kod tuoche e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: EACC reminds the public in Bomet County that input on development planning forums is welcome this February.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba maoni juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo ni kuwakaribisha Februari hii.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Bomet in talooyinka ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta la soo dhaweynayo bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: EACC paronwa ji duto e County mar Bomet ni ji mor ahinya gi weche ma ji wacho e wi chenro mag dongruok e dwe mar Februar.

English: Baringo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Baringo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Juni 2022
Somali: Degmada Baringo: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Baringo: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2022

English: KEMRI urges residents of Kilifi County to complete the full recommended vaccination dose following a rise in reported Rift Valley Fever cases.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inay dhammaystiraan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo ka dib kororka kiisaska laga soo sheegay Cudurka Rift Valley.
Dholuo: KEMRI ojiwo jogweng' Kilifi County mondo otiek dose duto mar thieth ma ji osechiwo bang' medruok mar tuo mar Rift Valley Fever.

English: Kenya Tsetse and Trypanasomiasis Eradication Council 19.08.2024 10:00 a.m. - 10:30 a.m.
Kiswahili: Kenya Tsetse na Baraza la Kutokomeza Trypanasomiasis 19.08.2024 10:00 a.m. - 10:30 a.m.
Somali: Golaha Ciribtirka Tsetse iyo Tripanasomiasis ee Kenya 19.08.2024 10:00 subaxnimo - 10:30 subaxnimo
Dholuo: 19.08.2024 saa 10:00 nyaka 10:30 odhiambo.

English: NDMA warns residents of Embu County to prepare for possible road accidents this December.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Desemba hii.
Somali: NDMA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay u diyaargaroobaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: NDMA osiemo jogweng' Embu County mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: OGP opens a new service point for passport services in Embu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay furaysaa goob adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee degmada Embu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: OGP oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag tiyo gi passport e County mar Embu.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kushughulikia vyeti vya kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la hagaajiyay waqtiga wareejinta shahaadada dhalashada ee gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) olando lokruok e seche mag timo nonro kuom weche mag nyuol e county mar Homa Bay.

English: NDMA alerts residents of Kirinyaga County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: NDMA waxay dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga uga digtay kororka kiisaska tuugada waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: NDMA chiwo siem ne ji modak e County mar Kirinyaga e wi medruok mar kwan mag jokuoge kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polis mar oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: IPOA warns residents of Laikipia County to prepare for possible landslides this November.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa maporomoko ya ardhi Novemba hii.
Somali: IPOA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay u diyaar garoobaan dhulgariir dhici kara bisha November.
Dholuo: IPOA osiemo jogweng' Laikipia County mondo oikre ne yiengni mag lowo mabiro timore e dwe mar Novemba.

English: After six months, introduce light foods to the child while you continue with breast feeding. Ensure that the food is kept safely and in a clean container, good quantity according to the age of the child
Kiswahili: Baada ya miezi sita, mlishe mtoto chakula kidogo huku ukiendelea kumnyonyesha. Hakikisha kwamba chakula hicho kinahifadhiwa kwa usalama na katika chombo safi, kiasi kinachofaa kulingana na umri wa mtoto
Somali: Lix bilood ka dib, cunto fudud u soo qaado ilmaha intaad naasnuujinayso. Hubi in cuntada si nabadgelyo leh loo hayaa weel nadiif ah oo tiro fiican ah iyadoo ku xiran da'da ilmaha
Dholuo: Bang' dweche auchiel, ket ne nyathini chiemo mayot sama idhi nyime pidho nyathi gi min mare.

English: Garissa County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Garissa: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Aprili 2023
Somali: Degmada Garissa: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Garissa: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar ang'wen 2023

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the public in Meru County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawahimiza raia wa Kaunti ya Meru wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadweynaha degmada Meru inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada lacagta mobilada.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ji duto e County mar Meru mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo weche mag wuond mag pesa mitimo e simo.

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief, April 2022
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP Kenya, Aprili 2022
Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya, Abriil 2022
Dholuo: Wach machuok mar piny Kenya mar WFP, dwe mar ang'wen 2022

English: WomenÂ’s mental health can be influenced by hormonal changes related to the menstrual cycle, pregnancy, and menopause. Substance use can disrupt these hormonal balances, potentially intensifying mental health symptoms
Kiswahili: Afya ya akili ya wanawake inaweza kuathiriwa na mabadiliko ya homoni yanayohusiana na mzunguko wa hedhi, ujauzito, na kukoma hedhi. Matumizi ya dawa za kulevya yanaweza kuvuruga mizania hii ya homoni, na hivyo kuongeza dalili za afya ya akili.
Somali: Caafimaadka maskaxda ee haweenka waxaa saameyn kara isbeddellada hoormoonka ee la xiriira wareegga caadada, uurka, iyo dhalmo-joojinta. Isticmaalka maandooriyaha ayaa carqaladeyn kara dheelitirka hoormoonnadan, taasoo laga yaabo inay sii xoojiso calaamadaha caafimaadka maskaxda.
Dholuo: <2Zepa> Kido mar paro mar mon nyalo bedo gi teko nikech lokruok ma timore e hormone ma tudruok gi kinde mar dwe, bedo gi ich, kod bedo gi dwe. Tiyo gi yath ma mero ji nyalo ketho ng’iyo mar homon ma kamago, ma nyalo medo ranyisi mag tuoche mag paro

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Siaya County about the importance of tobacco control for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya juu ya umuhimu wa udhibiti wa tumbaku kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay dadka degmada Siaya ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay ka hortagga sigaarka ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji duto e county mar Siaya kuom gimomiyo thieth mar madho ndawa en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: NDMA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Nandi County that access to the GBV toll-free helpline is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba upatikanaji wa simu ya msaada ya GBV bila malipo unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee Gobolka Nandi in helitaanka khadka caawimaadda ee GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ay tahay mid lacag la 'aan ah.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e county mar Nandi ni gibiro yudo kony ma onge chudo mar GBV maonge chudo.

English: KEMRI calls on parents in Busia County to have children under five screened for Rift Valley Fever during the May outreach.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Busia kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Mei.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Busia inay caruurta ka yar shan sano u sameeyaan baaritaano cudurka Rift Valley Fever inta lagu jiro adeegga bisha Maajo.
Dholuo: KEMRI okwayo jonyuol e county mar Busia mondo otim nonro mar tuo mar Rift Valley Fever ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: NCPB will open a fish collection centre in Narok County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itafungua kituo cha kukusanya samaki katika Kaunti ya Narok Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay xarun ururinta kalluunka ka furi doontaa gobolka Narok bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NCPB biro yawo kama ichokoe rech e taon mar Narok e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya opens voter education centres in Kakamega County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kakamega mwezi Juni huu.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay billaabaneysaa xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee Gobolka Kakamega bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Huduma Kenya chako tiego josiasa e taon mar Kakamega e dwe mar Jun.

English: DCI reminds residents of Embu County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu in warbixinta tuugada si deg deg ah ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: DCI parone jogweng'o mag Embu County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar nek konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Smallholder tea farmers are urged to stay informed about this year s bonus payments which have been affected by external market conditions
Kiswahili: Wakulima wadogo wa chai wanahimizwa kuwa na taarifa kuhusu malipo ya bonasi ya mwaka huu ambayo yameathiriwa na hali ya soko la nje

English: Pest Control Products Board urges farmers in Trans Nzoia County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi weche mag pur mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok ma timore e kaka koth chue.

English: State Department for Basic Education reminds youth in Nyeri County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nyeri in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education oparo ne rowere man Nyeri County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar chiemo kod mar rwako welo.

English: Notice: Universities Fund reminds citizens in Kilifi County about their rights regarding the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuhusu haki zao kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu muwaadiniinta degmada Kilifi xusuusinayaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar University Fund paronwa raia mag Kilifi County e wi ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo ombudsman.

English: NPS alerts residents of Embu County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Embu juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Somali: NPS waxay dadka deggan degmada Embu uga digtay kororka kiisaska xoolaha lagu xado waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: NPS chiwo siem ne jogweng' Embu County kuom medruok mar weche mag kwalo jamni kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag ritruok gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: DCI urges the community in Tharaka-Nithi County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: DCI inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha si looga hortago xannibaadda lo'da.
Dholuo: DCI ojiwo oganda man Tharaka-Nithi County mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo gikwed kwalo jamni.

English: DPP warns residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this November.
Kiswahili: DPP anawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Novemba hii.
Somali: DPP waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay u diyaar garoobaan qaraxyo dab ah oo dhici kara bisha November.
Dholuo: DPP osiemo jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo oikre ne yiengni manyalo timore e dwe mar Novemba.

English: CDC encourages residents of Tharaka-Nithi County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay u dhiiri galiyaan saaxiibo dhibaataysan inay caawimaad raadsadaan.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo kik gisandre gi muol kendo mondo gijiw osiepgi ma chandore odwar kony.

English: Contact tracing is key. Hot spots in NAIROBI county; Kawangware 13 cases Kilimani 6 cases... You need to keep distance, stay home, wear mask and wash your hands. #KomeshaCorona update
Kiswahili: Ufuatiliaji wa anwani ni muhimu. Sehemu za moto katika kaunti ya NAIROBI; Kawangware Kesi 13 Kilimani Kesi 6... Unahitaji kujiweka mbali, kukaa nyumbani, kuvaa barakoa na kunawa mikono. #KomeshaCorona sasisho

English: NPS urges motorists and pedestrians in Tharaka-Nithi County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NPS inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kusakinisha na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay guryahooda ku rakibaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dabka daminta iyo inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: NPS ojiwo joidh mtokni kod jowuoth e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo giti matek mondo gikwed hinyruok mag ndara.

English: To free cassava cuttings of mealybugs before planting, heat water until it is too hot to hold a finger in for more than five seconds (about 60C), then dip the cuttings in this hot water for one minute only - do not soak longer, as this can kill the cuttings too.
Kiswahili: Ili kuachilia vipandikizi vya mihogo ya mealybugs kabla ya kupanda, joto maji hadi iwe moto sana kushikilia kidole kwa zaidi ya sekunde tano (karibu 60C), kisha chovya vipandikizi kwenye maji haya ya moto kwa dakika moja tu - usiloweke kwa muda mrefu, kwani hii inaweza kuua vipandikizi pia.
Somali: Si aad u sii dayso goosashada cassava ee beeraha ka hor intaadan beerin, biyo ku kululeeya ilaa ay aad u kulul tahay in aad faraha ku haysato in ka badan shan ilbiriqsi (qiyaastii 60 C), ka dibna goosashada biyo kulul ku qooyso hal daqiiqo oo keliya - ha sii qooyina, maxaa yeelay tani waxay sidoo kale dilaan kartaa goosashada.
Dholuo: Mondo omi ng'ato ogol tong' mag ng'owo kapok ochwoyo, nyaka oyang' pi mochwe ahinya ma ok onyal mako lith lwete kuom dakika mokalo abich (karomo 60oC), kae to omwodh tong'go e pi ma lietno mana kuom dakika achiel kende - kik omed pi, nimar mano nyalo nego tong'go bende.

English: KEMRI encourages mothers in Tana River County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Tana River kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Tana River inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo mine manie taon mar Tana River County mondo olimgi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Embu County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuwaomba wasimamizi wa wilaya zao waendelee kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay la xiriiraan maamulaha qaybta maxalliga ah si ay uga warqabaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo jogweng' Embu County mondo omany thuolo mar wuoyo gi jatend buchegi mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mar dongruok mar county.

English: NTSA urges residents of Migori County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Migori kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Migori inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo jogweng' Migori County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gweng'no nikech ji medo keto pachgi kuom chenro mag chiwo siem motelo ne oganda.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds the public in Migori County that input on development planning forums is welcome this March.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Migori kwamba mchango kwenye vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo unakaribishwa Machi hii.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Migori in talooyinka laga bixiyo goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta lagu soo dhaweynayo bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya oparo ne ji duto e County mar Migori ni paro ma ji chiwo e wi chenro mag dongruok en gima ogwedhi e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMRI will be held in Makueni County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMRI itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Makueni Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay KEMRI ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Makueni bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma KEMRI ochano ibiro tim e dwe mar Agost e kaunti mar Makueni.

English: CDC encourages mothers in Kericho County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kericho inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta caafimaad ee la qorsheeyay si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo mine manie Kericho County mondo odhi e odiechieng'no mar thieth mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health warns of increased typhoid risk in Bungoma County and advises the public to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya matumbo katika Kaunti ya Bungoma na kushauri umma kutafuta uchunguzi wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ka digtay kororka halista cudurka 'typhoid' ee degmada Bungoma waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay isla markiiba baaritaan ka sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Chenro mar thieth mar ji: Ministry of Health osiemo ji kuom medo bedo gi tuo mar typhoid e County mar Bungoma kendo ojiwo ji mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni kodgi.

English: FAO and the World Union of Wholesale Markets are enhancing efforts to reduce food loss and waste globally Stakeholders in agriculture should engage with local wholesale markets to improve food distribution
Kiswahili: FAO na Umoja wa Dunia wa Masoko ya Jumla wanaongeza juhudi za kupunguza upotevu wa chakula na upotevu duniani Wadau wa kilimo wanapaswa kushirikiana na masoko ya jumla ya ndani ili kuboresha usambazaji wa chakula.
Somali: FAO iyo Midowga Suuqyada Jumlada ee Adduunka ayaa xoojinaya dadaallada lagu yareynayo luminta cuntada iyo qashinka adduunka oo dhan Dhinacyada daneeyayaasha beeraha waa inay la shaqeeyaan suuqyada jumlada ee maxalliga ah si loo hagaajiyo qaybinta cuntada
Dholuo: FAO kod riwruok mar World Union of Wholesale Markets medo kinda mar tieko chudo kod kethruok mar chiemo e piny mangima.

English: Tharaka Nithi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for December 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Desemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Tharaka Nithi: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Diseembar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Tharaka Nithi: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2022

English: IPOA reminds residents of Murang'a County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada daadadka ku dhacay xilligan shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: IPOA parone jogweng'o mag County mar Murang'a ni kik giwuoth e wi borni kod aoche ma pi opong'o e kinde masiche mag ndara.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta dugsiyada dugsiga dhexe ee maalinta bilaashka ah ee degmada Kiambu.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar State Department for TVET olando tarik mag somo mar sekondari e skul man Kiambu County.

English: Adoption of Mobile Technology in A Humanitarian Response To Drought Ravaged Communities in Northern Kenya
Kiswahili: Kupitishwa kwa Teknolojia ya Simu katika Mwitikio wa Kibinadamu kwa Jamii Zilizoharibiwa na Ukame Kaskazini mwa Kenya.
Somali: La qabsiga Tiknoolajiyada Moobaylka si wax looga qabto arrimaha bani'aadamnimada ee bulshooyinka abaartu saameysay ee Waqooyiga Kenya
Dholuo: Tiyo gi Teknoloji mar Simu e Duoko mar Dhano Ne Oganda ma Okethore gi Oro e Nyanduat mar Kenya

English: FAO reminds residents of Mandera County that conservation tillage improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba kilimo cha uhifadhi kinaboresha tija ya shamba la muda mrefu.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Mandera in beerashada ilaalinta ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: FAO parone jogweng'o mag Mandera County ni chwoyo puothe mag puothe e yor ritruok kelo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Harvest early when 90-100% of pods are brown and dry, but before they become brittle and shatter.
Kiswahili: Vuna mapema wakati asilimia 90 hadi 100 ya mizoga imekauka na kubadilika kuwa rangi ya hudhurungi, lakini kabla haijaanza kupasuka.
Somali: Goosto hore marka 90-100% xayawaanka ay yihiin bunni oo qalalan yihiin, laakiin ka hor inta aysan jabin oo burburin.
Dholuo: Ikayo cham chon ka pasent 90 nyaka 100 mag puothe gin makwar kendo maboyo, to kapok gibedo motuwo kendo maboyo.

English: Rural youth are bringing agriculture into the digital age. Meet three young rural people in Asia who've cracked the irrigation code!
Kiswahili: Vijana wa vijijini wanaleta kilimo katika enzi ya kidijitali. Kutana na vijana watatu wa vijijini barani Asia ambao wamevunja kanuni za umwagiliaji!
Somali: Dhalinyarada miyiga ah ayaa beeraha gelinaya xilligii dijitaalka ah. La kulan saddex dhalinyaro reer miyiga ah oo ku nool Aasiya kuwaas oo jebiyay koodhka waraabka!
Dholuo: Rowere ma wuok e gwenge mag gweng'no kelo tij pur e kinde mag digital.

English: IEBC advises residents of Kitui County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: IEBC inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: IEBC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogweng' Kitui County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro kwayo mag ID mar piny.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will be held in Nandi County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Nandi Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo bilaash ah oo ay qabanqaabisay qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada ayaa lagu qaban doonaa gobolka Nandi bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo mitimo e dwe mar Jun e County mar Nandi ibiro chano.

English: Tharaka-Nithi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2024
Somali: Degmada Tharaka-Nithi: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Tharaka-Nithi: Oboke machon mar oro mar apar higa mar 2024

English: KEMSA calls on parents in Kericho County to have children under five screened for HIV/AIDS during the May outreach.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuwachunguza watoto chini ya miaka mitano VVU/UKIMWI wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Mei.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Kericho inay caruurta ka yar shan sano u sameeyaan baaritaanka HIV/AIDS inta lagu gudajiro bisha May.
Dholuo: KEMSA kwayo jonyuol e County mar Kericho mondo otim nonro mar HIV/AIDS ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Mei.

English: DCI warns residents of Lamu County about a rise in identity theft and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaonya wakazi wa Wilaya ya Lamu juu ya kuongezeka kwa wizi wa kitambulisho na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: DCI waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan gobolka Lamu kororka xadgudubka aqoonsiga waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne jogweng' Lamu County e wi medruok mar kuo mar kitgi kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages mothers in Trans Nzoia County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kutembelea mrengo wa uzazi ulio karibu nao ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku dhiirigelisay hooyooyinka degmada Trans Nzoia inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit jiwo mine manie Trans Nzoia County mondo odhi olimgi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross issues a cybersecurity alert on SIM-swap fraud affecting residents of Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya umetoa onyo la usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM unaoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaamada SIM-swap ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ripot Mamit mar Kenya ogolo siem mar rito weche mag intanet e wi wuond mag SIM-swap makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e County mar Vihiga.

English: Judiciary of Kenya announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kutekeleza huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la hagaajiyay waqtiga wareejinta adeegyada baasaboorka ee degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya olando lokruok e seche mag tiyo gi passport e county mar Baringo.

English: This Acceleration Plan focuses on women and newborns who already reach health facilities, where the potential for rapid and measurable impact is greatest.
Kiswahili: Mpango huu wa Kuongeza Kasi unalenga wanawake na watoto wachanga ambao tayari wanafika kwenye vituo vya afya, ambapo uwezekano wa athari za haraka na zinazoweza kupimika ni kubwa zaidi.
Somali: Qorshahan Dardargelinta wuxuu diiradda saarayaa haweenka iyo dhallaanka cusub ee durba gaaray xarumaha caafimaadka, halkaas oo ay ugu badan tahay suurtagalnimada saameyn degdeg ah oo la qiyaasi karo.
Dholuo: Pango mar Kelo Gik Moko mapiyo ni keto pach kuom mon kod nyithindo ma pok onyuol ma osechopo e kar thieth, kama nyalo mar kelo gik mapiyo kendo manyalo pimre en maduong’ie moloyo.

English: Kenya: Vaccine Shortages Endanger Childrenâ€™s Lives in Remote and Humanitarian Settings
Kiswahili: Kenya: Uhaba wa Chanjo Unahatarisha Maisha ya Watoto katika Mipangilio ya Mbali na ya Kibinadamu
Somali: Kenya: Yaraanta Tallaalka oo Halis ku ah Nolosha Carruurta ee Goobaha Fog iyo kuwa Bani'aadamnimada.
Dholuo: Kenya: Nok mar Chanjo Keto Ngima mag Nyithindo e Luoro e Kuonde Mabor kendo Kuonde ma Ji Odak

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development encourages out-of-school children in Uasin Gishu County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya ugawaji wa bursary.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Uasin Gishu inay dalbadaan deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga ugu dambeeya ee loo qoondeeyo deeqaha waxbarasho.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development announces distribution of textbooks and learning materials to schools in Siaya County this March.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inatangaza usambazaji wa vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Siaya Machi hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada Waxbarashada ayaa ku dhawaaqay in bishii Maarso la qeybiyo buugaagta waxbarasho iyo qalabka wax lagu barto dugsiyada degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok e skunde man Siaya County e dwe mar Mach.

English: KEMSA encourages mothers in Kwale County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kwale inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta caafimaad ee la qorsheeyay si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo mine manie Kaunti mar Kwale mondo odhi e odiechieng'no mar thieth mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Universities Fund reminds parents in Bungoma County that free primary education registration is open this April.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba usajili wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo umefunguliwa Aprili hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xusuusinayaa waalidiinta degmada Bungoma in diiwaangelinta bilaashka ah ee waxbarashada hoose ay furan tahay bisha April.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa jonyuol e County mar Bungoma ni somo mar pinyruoth ma onge chudo osechakore e dwe mar April.

English: KEMSA appeals to caregivers in Makueni County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the August maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Makueni kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Agosti.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Makueni inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha oo qayb ka ah ololaha caafimaadka hooyadda ee Agoosto.
Dholuo: KEMSA okwayo jorit e county mar Makueni mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi e dwe mar Agost.

English: Office of the Auditor-General advises residents of Kilifi County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inashauri wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e-Citizen.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan diiwaangelinta e-Citizen.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General nyiso jogweng' Kilifi County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro dhi e e-Citizen registration.

English: TSC advises applicants in Nyandarua County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: TSC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: TSC waxay ku talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Nyandarua inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee la heli karo.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Nyandarua mondo odhi e skul man machiegni kodgi.

English: KEMSA encourages residents of Bomet County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay la xiriiraan lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' County mar Bomet mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giwuo gi jang'ad rieko molony.

English: EACC reminds voters in Nandi County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Nandi kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha gobolka Nandi inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor inta aan la samayn nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: EACC parone jogweng' kaunti mar Nandi mondo olim kama ichanoe IEBC machiegni kodgi kapok itimo yiero.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Siaya County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay dadka deggan degmada Siaya kula talineysaa inay yareeyaan qaadashada cusbada iyo sonkorta si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit nyiso jogweng'o mag County mar Siaya ni mondo giduog chien e chamo chamo mor kod sukari mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: DPP warns residents of Homa Bay County about a rise in phishing messages and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: DPP inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay juu ya kuongezeka kwa ujumbe wa phishing na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: DPP waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay kororka farriimaha phishing waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax falin.
Dholuo: DPP chiwo siem ne jogweng' Homa Bay County e wi medruok mar ote mag phishing kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: To limit the spread of eucalyptus gall wasp, never transport or distribute seedlings from an infected nursery to disease-free areas, remove and burn affected plant parts and fallen leaves (especially September-November), and be aware that registered chemical treatments for this pest are not yet available in Ethiopia.
Kiswahili: Ili kupunguza kuenea kwa nyumbu ya gall ya eucalyptus, kamwe usafirishe au usambaze miche kutoka kwa kiota cha watoto kilichoambukizwa kwenda maeneo yasiyo na magonjwa, ondoa na kuchoma sehemu za mimea iliyoathiriwa na majani yaliyoanguka (haswa Septemba-Novemba), na ujue kuwa matibabu ya kemikali yaliyoorodheshwa kwa wadudu hawa bado hayapatikani Ethiopia.
Somali: Si loo xaddido faafitaanka eucalyptus gall wasp, marnaba u soo gudbi ama u qaybi geedo ka soo jeeda xanaanada cudurka ku dhacay meelaha aan cudurka lahayn, ka saar oo gub qaybaha dhirta ee saameeyay iyo caleemaha dhacay (gaar ahaan Sebtember-Noofembar), iyo inaad ogaato in daaweynta kiimikada ee diiwaangashan ee cayayaanka aan weli laga heli karin Itoobiya.
Dholuo: Mondo omi thieth mar eucalyptus gall wasp kik medre, kik idhi gi kodhi mag yiende ma nigi tuoche kata kik ipoggi kuonde ma onge tuoche, gol oko kendo wang'o kuonde ma yiende osedwarore kod yiende ma osepodho (e wi mago duto, Septemba kod Novemba), kendo ng'e ni e piny Ethiopia pok nitie yore mag thieth ma nigi kemia ma ok oket e bwo chik.

English: Extension on the burn of large gatherings to the month of May 29th, in a bid to reduce Covid infections.
Kiswahili: Kuongezewa kwa kuungua kwa makusanyiko makubwa hadi mwezi wa Mei 29, katika jitihada za kupunguza maambukizo ya Covid.
Somali: Kordhinta gubashada shirarka waaweyn illaa bishii Maajo 29, si loo yareeyo cudurrada COVID.
Dholuo: Medruok mar chungo chokruogegi madongo nyaka tarik 29 dwe mar Mei, e kinda mar tieko tuoche mag Covid.

English: Notice: KNEC announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KNEC olando tarik mag somo mar pinyruoth ma onge chudo e skunde mag Lamu County.

English: KMTC advises students in Migori County to register early to secure allocation to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Migori kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Somali: KMTC waxay ardayda Degmada Migori kula talineysaa inay horay u diiwaangeliyaan si ay u helaan lacag ay ku helaan buugaagta waxbarasho iyo qalabka wax lagu barto.
Dholuo: KMTC jiwo jopuonjre mag Migori County mondo odonj e skundno chon mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inafungua maombi ya maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali bila malipo kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay codsiyada u furaysaa bartayaasha degmada Kisii si ay u helaan barasho digital ah oo lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar State Department for TVET oyawo kwayo mag somo mar digital maonge chudo ne jopuonjre e County mar Kisii.

English: FAO advises farmers in Isiolo County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the March planting season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Machi.
Somali: FAO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Isiolo inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Isiolo mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Mach.

English: Huduma Kenya warns public officers in Murang'a County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a dhidi ya kupotosha fedha za umma.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Murang'a in ay ka faa'iideystaan dhaqaale dawladeed.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e kaunti mar Murang'a ni kik giti gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo e yo marach.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will be held in Uasin Gishu County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ay qabanqaabisay qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada ayaa lagu qaban doonaa gobolka Uasin Gishu bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma biro bedo e dwe mar Julai ma biro e county mar Uasin Gishu, ibiro chano gi Division of Disease Surveillance and Response.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health: childhood immunization clinics will run every May at designated health centres in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya: kliniki za chanjo ya watoto zitafanya kazi kila Mei katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka: rugta tallaalka carruurta ayaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Maajo ee kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth: klinik mag thieth mar nyithindo biro tiyo e dwe mar Mei higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e Homa Bay County.

English: Turkana County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Turkana: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2023
Somali: Degmada Turkana: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Turkana: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar adek higa mar 2023

English: Kenya Flood and Cholera Outbreak 2025 - DREF Operation (Appeal: MDRKE066)
Kiswahili: Mlipuko wa Mafuriko na Kipindupindu Kenya 2025 - Operesheni ya DREF (Rufaa: MDRKE066)
Somali: Daadadkii iyo Daacuunka Kenya oo ka dillaacay 2025 - Hawlgalka DREF (Rafcaan: MDRKE066)
Dholuo: Pi ma Opong'o piny Kenya kod Tuwo mar Kolera 2025 - Tich mar DREF (kwayo: MDRKE066)

English: Huduma Kenya urges eligible citizens in Kwale County to participate in voter education.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inahimiza wananchi wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Kwale kushiriki katika elimu ya wapiga kura.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kwale inay ka qaybqaataan waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jokanyo mag Kwale County mondo oriwgi e tiegruok mar joma yiero.

English: Implement strict biosecurity measures on your poultry unit to prevent the introduction and spread of pests and diseases affecting poultry.
Kiswahili: Tekeleza hatua kali za usalama wa kibiolojia kwenye kitengo chako cha kuku ili kuzuia kuanzishwa na kuenea kwa wadudu na magonjwa yanayoathiri kuku.
Somali: Ku dhaqan tallaabooyin adag oo biyo-amniga ah unuggaaga digaagga si looga hortago soo gelitaanka iyo faafitaanka cayayaanka iyo cudurrada saameeya digaagga.
Dholuo: Ket chenro mar rito ngima kod ngima mag udi e yor rito kitegi duto mondo kik giketh kod landruok mar tuoche kod tuoche makelo tuoche.

English: KRA invites residents of Bomet County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: KRA inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: KRA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: KRA gwelo joma odak e county mar Bomet mondo ochiw ripot mondik kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso bajet mar county ochopo.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges cattle farmers in Garissa County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda lo'da ee Gobolka Garissa inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo ka dib kiisaska cudurka Anthrax ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur mag jamni e County mar Garissa mondo ogeng'gi e kuonde moyier mag chwoyo jamni bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag anthrax.

English: Notice: AFA will conduct a post-harvest handling workshop for farmers in Marsabit County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi ka dib goosashada beeraleyda degmada Marsabit bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: AFA biro timo chokruok mar timo nonro ne jopur bang' keyo e Marsabit County e dwe mar Februar.

English: Teachers Service Commission invites youth in Nairobi County to enroll for tailoring and design training this May.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni Mei hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa ku casuumay dhalinyarada degmada Nairobi inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka tailoring iyo naqshadeynta bisha May.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj gwelo rowere e County mar Nairobi mondo odonj e tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko e dwe mar Mei.

English: HELB calls on the community in Kirinyaga County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: HELB inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: HELB waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada Gobolka Kirinyaga inay u soo sheegaan maamulka dugsiga wixii dhibaato ah ee ku saabsan amniga si ay dugsiyada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: HELB kwayo ji duto manie County mar Kirinyaga mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar skul e wi weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: We have cases in kitengele, Kumulu, tana River, ongata rongai among others. Let us continue practicing social distance to prevent the spread of Coronavirus in our communities. Stay encouraged and stay safe. #KomeshaCorona update.
Kiswahili: Tuna kesi katika kitengele, Kumulu, tana River, ongata rongai miongoni mwa zingine. Tuendelee kufanya mazoezi ya umbali wa kijamii ili kuzuia kuenea kwa Coronavirus katika jamii zetu. Jipe moyo na ubaki salama. #KomeshaCorona sasisho.
Somali: Waxaan ku haynaa kiisas cudurka Kitengele, Kumulu, Tana River, Ongata rongai iyo kuwo kale. Aan sii wadno ku celcelinta kala fogaanshaha bulshada si aan uga hortagno faafitaanka Coronavirus ee bulshooyinkeenna. Dhiirrigeli oo badqab. #WarbixintaKomeshaCorona.
Dholuo: Wabedo gi kes ei kitengele, Kumulu, aora tana, ongata rongai kod mamoko. Wadhi nyime gi timo kido mar bedo mabor gi jowetewa mondo wageng' lando mar Coronavirus e alworawa. Bed gi jip kendo bed gi geno. #KomeshaKorona ma manyien.

English: Notice: IPOA issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay soo saartaa digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Nandi.
Dholuo: Rapar: IPOA ogolo siem e wi weche mag sirkal mar weche mag intanet kuom chenro mag ohala ma ok kare makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e county mar Nandi.

English: Kenya continues with a system of preventing livestock diseases.
Kiswahili: Kenya inaendelea na mfumo wa kuzuia magonjwa ya mifugo.
Somali: Kenya waxay sii wadaa nidaamka ka hortagga cudurrada xoolaha.
Dholuo: Kenya dhi nyime gi chenro mar geng'o tuoche mag jamni.

English: KUCCPS conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Kiambu County this January.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Januari hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada ee degmada Kiambu bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: KUCCPS dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi riwruok mar oganda e bajet mar county e County mar Kiambu e dwe mar Januar.

English: If the Shirika Plan can translate integration into real economic opportunity, Kenya can chart a shared development pathway in which refugees and host communities both thrive.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa Mpango wa Shirika unaweza kutafsiri ushirikiano katika fursa halisi ya kiuchumi, Kenya inaweza kupanga njia ya pamoja ya maendeleo ambapo wakimbizi na jamii zinazowahifadhi zitastawi.
Somali: Haddii Qorshaha Shirika uu is-dhexgalka u rogi karo fursad dhaqaale oo dhab ah, Kenya waxay qeexi kartaa waddo horumarineed oo wadajir ah oo ay qaxootiga iyo bulshooyinka martida loo yahay labaduba ku horumaraan.
Dholuo: Kapo ni chenro mar Shirika nyalo loko riwruok obed thuolo mar adier mar weche yuto, piny Kenya nyalo keto yo mar dongruok ma jolweny kod oganda ma rwakogi duto nyalo dongo maber.

English: Notice: NTSA launches a fraud prevention campaign in Kisii County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NTSA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Kisii Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga khiyaamooyinka degmada Kisii bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NTSA chako kampen mar geng'o mibadhi e County mar Kisii e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Announcement on the year 2025 plan to promote sports among groups to enable continuity
Kiswahili: Tangazo kuhusu mpango wa mwaka wa 2025 wa kukuza michezo kati ya vikundi ili kuwezesha kuendelea
Somali: Ogeysiis ku saabsan qorshaha sanadka 2025 ee lagu dhiirrigelinayo isboortiga kooxaha si loo fududeeyo joogteynta

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will be held in Nyamira County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu bila malipo iliyoandaliwa na Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Machi hii.

Dholuo: Rapar: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ochano ibiro tim e County mar Nyamira e dwe mar Mach.

English: Kenya: IPC Acute Food Insecurity and Acute Malnutrition Analysis (February - June 2024) Published on 26 March 2024
Kiswahili: Kenya: IPC Ukosefu wa Chakula Mkali na Uchanganuzi Mkali wa Utapiamlo (Februari - Juni 2024) Limechapishwa tarehe 26 Machi 2024
Somali: Kenya: Falanqaynta IPC ee Amniga Cuntada Degdegga ah iyo Nafaqada Ba'an (Febraayo - Juun 2024) La daabacay 26 Maarso 2024

English: KTDA advises farmers in Nyamira County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the December planting season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Desemba.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyamira inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: KTDA nyiso jopur e County mar Nyamira ni giti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Desemba.

English: KICD calls on the community in Makueni County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KICD inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: KICD waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Makueni inay la xiriirto khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116, si loo ilaaliyo nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: KICD okwayo ji duto e gweng' mar Makueni mondo omany namba mar 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by SHA (Social Health Authority) will be held in Laikipia County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Gobolka Laikipia bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth maonge chudo ma olos gi SHA (Social Health Authority) ibiro tim Laikipia County e dwe mar Mach.

English: KALRO advises farmers in Narok County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the October planting season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Oktoba.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Narok inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur manie Narok County mondo oti gi ratiro mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Machakos County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun iyo biyo nadiif ah si joogto ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: KEMSA nyiso jogweng'o mag Machakos County mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Notice from CDC: skilled birth attendance clinics will run every October at designated health centres in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa CDC: kliniki za mahudhurio ya uzazi zenye ujuzi zitaendeshwa kila Oktoba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid CDC: rugta caafimaad ee dhalmada ee xirfadlayaasha ah ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Oktoobar kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth miluongo ni CDC: Klinike mag thieth mar nyuol ma nigi lony biro tiyo dwe mar Oktoba higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e Kaunti mar Kakamega.

English: SHA updates residents of Tharaka-Nithi County on progress of the county integrated development plan this February.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawasilisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja ya kaunti hii Februari.
Somali: SHA waxay dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi ku wargelineysaa horumarka qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: SHA osemiyo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi ong'eyo dongruok mar chenro mar dongruok mar county integrated development e dwe mar Februar.

English: The governor of Kisumu, Nyongo has issued a directive to close all eateries after failing to obey guidelines from the MoH in Covic control
Kiswahili: Gavana wa Kisumu, Nyongo ametoa agizo la kufunga migahawa yote baada ya kushindwa kutii miongozo kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya kuhusu udhibiti wa virusi vya corona.
Somali: Guddoomiyaha gobolka Kisumu ee magaalada Nyongo ayaa soo saaray tilmaam uu ku xiray dhammaan makhaayadaha cuntada kadib markii uu ku guuldareystay inuu u hoggaansamo tilmaamaha Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ee xakamaynta COVID
Dholuo: Jatelo mar Kisumu, Nyongo osegolo chik mar tieko kuonde chiemo duto nikech ok oluwo chike mag Ministry of Health e weche mag Covid.

Somali: Cusboonaysiinta #covid19kenya Xarun wicitaan ayaa la sameeyay si kor loogu qaado isgaarsiinta COVID-19. Dadweynaha waxay la xiriiri karaan iyagoo garaacaya 719 si ay u helaan farriimaha maqalka ah ama *719# si ay u helaan farriimaha gaagaaban. Tani waxay khuseyn doontaa dhammaan shabakadaha @SpokespersonGoK @KNH_hospital @WHOKenya @CDCKenya

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds livestock keepers in Kericho County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Guddiga xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu xasuusinayaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Kericho inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyada oo aan la helin rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.

English: KICD advises students in Machakos County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: KICD inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Machakos kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Somali: KICD waxay kula talineysaa ardayda Degmada Machakos inay dalbadaan bogga deeqda waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan deeq waxbarasho ardayda u baahan.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo jopuonjre e County ma Machakos mondo oketgi e intanet mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo chiwo mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre mochando.

English: Notice: FAO restricts movement of sheep in Garissa County due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO inazuia harakati za kondoo katika Kaunti ya Garissa kwa sababu ya mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Newcastle.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa idaha ee Gobolka Garissa sababo la xiriira faafitaanka cudurka Newcastle.
Dholuo: Rieko: FAO ogeng'o wuoth mar rombe e County mar Garissa nikech tuo mar Newcastle.

Kiswahili: TVET inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.

Somali: Wax ka qabashada waxyaabaha sababa nuglaanta iyo taageeridda hab-nololeedka waxay ka caawin kartaa bulshooyinka inay xoojiyaan adkeysigooda iyo inay horumariyaan waxtarka la qabsiga kulaylka iyo dadaallada maaraynta.
