English: Notice: DPP activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DPP anawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay shilalka waddooyinka ee degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: DPP tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne masiche ma timore e nderni e County mar Bungoma.

English: Notice: ODPP opens a new service point for passport services in Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay ka fureysaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee Gobolka Samburu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: ODPP oyawo kama tiyo gi passport e county mar Samburu.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit calls on parents in Baringo County to have children under five screened for HIV/AIDS during the March outreach.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuwapima watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa VVU/UKIMWI wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Machi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Baringo inay carruurta ka yar shan sano u sameeyaan baaritaanka HIV / AIDS inta lagu gudajiro bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit okwayo jonyuol e County mar Baringo mondo otim nonro mar HIV/AIDS ne nyithindgi ma hikgi tin ne abich e dwe mar Mach.

English: ODPP urges eligible citizens in Makueni County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wananchi wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Makueni kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Makueni inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jokanyo mag Makueni County mondo oriwgi e kwedo jogo madwaro yiero.

English: IEBC reminds residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet wanaohudhuria mkutano wa umma wa mkutano wa kaunti kuimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet ee ka qeybgalaya kalfadhiga guud ee shirka degmada oo xoojinaya maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: IEBC paronwa jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet ma biro e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo omed jiwo sirkal.

English: Exploring the Nexus between Climate hazards and Conflict in Lamu County: Implications for Community Adaptation Action Plans
Kiswahili: Kuchunguza Uhusiano kati ya Hatari za Hali ya Hewa na Migogoro katika Kaunti ya Lamu: Athari kwa Mipango ya Kitendo ya Kukabiliana na Jamii.
Somali: Sahaminta Khatarta u dhaxaysa Khataraha Cimilada iyo Khilaafaadka Degmada Lamu: Saamaynta Qorshayaasha Waxqabadka La Qabsiga Bulshada
Dholuo: Kaka ng’ato nyalo ng’eyo tudruok mantie e kind gik ma nyalo kelo hinyruok e piny kod lweny e gweng’ mar Lamu: Gik ma nyalo timore e chenro mag timo gik moko e kind oganda

English: NTSA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Narok County that access to psychosocial support is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Narok kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisaikolojia unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee Gobolka Narok in helitaanka taageerada cilmu-nafsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: NTSA paronwa jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Narok ni ginyalo yudo kony mar paro maonge chudo.

English: AFA advises farmers in Garissa County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the December planting season.
Kiswahili: AFA inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa kudhibiti wizi wa jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa za kuua wadudu zilizokubaliwa kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Desemba.
Somali: AFA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Garissa in ay ka hortagaan ciidamada ciidanka xilliga dayrta iyagoo isticmaalaya cayayaanka la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e gweng ' mar Garissa County mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma oseyudo ratiro mar chango jolweny e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens a new service point for national ID applications in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ka furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya osechako tiyo gi ofis manyien mar Joneno mag Jehova e kaunti mar Kericho.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges residents of Kisumu County to complete the full recommended vaccination dose following a rise in reported dengue fever cases.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya homa ya dengue.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay dhammaystiraan qiyaasta tallaalka oo dhan ee lagugula talinayo ka dib kororka kiisaska cudurka dengue ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' mar Kisumu County mondo ochop e okang' moromo mar thieth ma gichiwo bang' medruok mar tuo mar dengue.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya alerts residents of Vihiga County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga juu ya kuongezeka kwa visa vya utekaji nyara wa magari na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay uga digtay dadka deggan degmada Vihiga in ay kordheen kiisaska gaadiidka la xaday waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Weche Dhano chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar County mar Vihiga ni kwan mag joma oketho mtokni biro medore kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne polis man machiegni kodgi.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will conduct a greenhouse farming workshop for farmers in Tana River County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itafanya semina ya kilimo cha chafu kwa wakulima katika Wilaya ya Tana River Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo ee beeraleyda degmada Tana River ee bisha Diseembar ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Tij Lemo kod Chiemo (AFA) biro timo tiegruok mar timo yien e alwora mar Tana River County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Tharaka Nithi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2023
Somali: Degmada Tharaka Nithi: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Tharaka Nithi: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar adek higa mar 2023

English: For rainfed agriculture, land should ideally be prepared at least two weeks before planting, with timing depending on when the rainy season is forecast to start, the crops being grown, and the topography.
Kiswahili: Kwa kilimo kinachotegemea mvua, shamba linapaswa kutayarishwa angalau wiki mbili kabla ya kupanda, kulingana na wakati msimu wa mvua unatarajiwa kuanza, zao litakalopandwa, na hali ya ardhi.
Somali: Beeraha roobka leh, dhulku waa in si fiican loo diyaariyaa ugu yaraan laba toddobaad ka hor beerista, iyadoo waqtiga ay kuxirantahay marka xilli roobku la saadaalinayo inuu bilaabo, dalagga la beero, iyo topography.
Dholuo: Kuom wach pur, lowo onego obed moik kata mana jumbe ariyo kapok ochwoyo, kendo onego ochak chwoyo ka ok ochuno ni ochak koth, kodhi ma ipidho, kod alwora ma koth ochakoree.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay bilowday barnaamij lagu darayo ardayda naafada ah dugsiyada gobolka Nyeri.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State Department for TVET chako chenro mar tiego japuonjre ma nigi midekre e skunde duto mag Nyeri County.

English: CDC launches a November awareness campaign on safe water storage across Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Novemba juu ya uhifadhi wa maji salama katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Somali: CDC waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Nofeembar oo ku saabsan kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi.
Dholuo: CDC ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Novemba kuom wach kano pi maler e Tharaka-Nithi County.

English: Notice: COMESA will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Migori County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa wakulima kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi diiwaangelinta beeraleyda loogu talagalay beeralayda Degmada Migori bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA biro timo rapar mar jopur e dwe mar Novemba e kaunti mar Migori.

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Meru County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada la hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso jogweng' mar County mar Meru mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth mar oganda maonge chudo mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: State Department for TVET urges parents and teachers in Kilifi County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Kilifi inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County Kilifi mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages residents of Busia County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Busia inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo jogweng' County mar Busia mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: DPP reminds residents of Kakamega County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: DPP anawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega in warbixinta degdegga ah ee jabsashada ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogweng' Kakamega County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar donjo e ot konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: State Department for Basic Education advises applicants in Kirinyaga County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha Gobolka Kirinyaga inay dalbadaan booska TVET ee KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education nyiso jogo madwaro somo e County mar Kirinyaga mondo oketgi e tiegruok mar TVET kokalo kuom KUCCPS.

English: Universities Fund encourages out-of-school children in Nakuru County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Nakuru inay codsadaan deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga ugu dambeeya ee barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo okonygi yudo konyno kapok kindeno ochopo kaluwore gi chenro mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: Notice: DCI activates an emergency response plan for landslides in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay hirgelinaysaa qorshe xaalad deg deg ah oo looga jawaabayo dhulgariirada gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DCI chako tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony e kinde mag yiengni mag lowo e Homa Bay County.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Nakuru County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' Nakuru County mondo odonj e riwruok mar insuarans mar thieth mondo giyud thieth makonyogi.

English: Caregivers should wash hands with soap before handling babies, after changing diapers, and before feeding to prevent infections.
Kiswahili: Walezi wanapaswa kunawa mikono kwa sabuni kabla ya kuwashughulikia watoto, baada ya kubadilisha nepi, na kabla ya kuwalisha ili kuzuia maambukizi.
Somali: Daryeelayaashu waa inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun ka hor intaanay xidhin ilmaha, ka dib markay beddelaan boorsooyinka, iyo ka hor inta aan la quudin si looga hortago cudurrada.
Dholuo: Joma rito nyithindo onego olwok lwetegi gi sabun kapok gitiyo gi nyithindo, bang' loko piendgi, kendo kapok gichiemo mondo kik giyud tuoche.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Uasin Gishu County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Uasin Gishu kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya wilaya ili kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya Wilaya.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan mashaariicda horumarinta degmada.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jogweng' Uasin Gishu County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche momedore e wi chenrogo mag dongruok.

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages mothers in Turkana County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Turkana kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Turkana inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo mine e County mar Turkana mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Garissa County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Garissa inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar paro e County mar Garissa mondo odhi ir japuonj molony.

English: SHA reminds residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: SHA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in ay ku hawlan yihiin maamulaha qaybta deegaanka si loo xoojiyo maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: SHA parone jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County ni ka gitiyo gi jaritgi mar alwora, mano biro miyo sirkal obed gi loch maber.

English: In this month as a moth of amplifying awareness on mental care for men, lets open up, speak out. We are used to say that men must stay strong,, but we need to know that to be strong is to accept our problems and seeking for help
Kiswahili: Katika mwezi huu kama moth ya kuongeza ufahamu juu ya utunzaji wa akili kwa wanaume, hebu kufungua, kuzungumza.
Somali: Bishaan waxaan u isticmaali jirnaa inaan nidhaahno raggu waa inay sii ahaadaan kuwo xoog badan, laakiin waxaan u baahanahay inaan ogaano in xooggu yahay in la aqbalo dhibaatooyinkeena oo la raadiyo caawimaad.
Dholuo: E dweni, mondo omi ji ong'e weche momedore e wi wach rito chwo e yor chuny, weuru wawuo, wawuo. Wasebedo ka wawacho ni chwo nyaka bed gi teko, kata kamano nyaka wang'e ni bedo gi teko tiende en yie gi chandruogewa kendo manyo kony.

English: Children aged 1 to 5 should be dewormed every six months to prevent worm infections that can lead to malnutrition and stunted growth.
Kiswahili: Watoto wenye umri wa miaka 1 hadi 5 wanapaswa kusafishwa minyoo kila baada ya miezi sita ili kuzuia maambukizi ya minyoo ambayo yanaweza kusababisha utapiamlo na ukuaji wa kudumaa.
Somali: Carruurta da'doodu u dhaxayso 1 illaa 5 sano waa in la daaweeyaa lixdii biloodba mar si looga hortago cudurrada cayayaanka ee keeni kara nafaqo la'aanta iyo koritaanka gaabis ah.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma johigni 1 nyaka 5 onego oti gi thieth mar thieth kuom dweche auchiel ka dwe mondo kik giyud tuoche ma nyalo miyo gibed gi tuoche mag midekre.

English: Do you know? When you sleep good toutches cure of your mental health. 1. Try to have good sleep 7-9 hours every day. 2. Prevent yourself from taling drugs and drinks like coffee before you sleep, which hardens your sleep. Prioritize your sleep, as a way of recharging your brain, so that you wake up feeling strong
Kiswahili: Unajuaje? Usingizi mzuri huchangia afya yako ya akili. 1. Jaribu kulala vizuri kwa saa 7 hadi 9 kila siku. 2. Epuka kutumia dawa za kulevya na vinywaji kama vile kahawa kabla ya kulala, ambavyo huongeza usingizi wako.
Somali: Ma taqaan? Markaad si fiican u seexato waa daawo caafimaadkaaga maskaxda. 1. Isku day inaad seexato 7-9 saacadood maalintii. 2. Ka fogow inaad daroogo iyo cabitaanno sida kafeega ka hor intaadan seexan, taasoo hurdadaada adkaysa. Mudnaanta u samee hurdadaada, si aad maskaxdaada dib ugu soo celiso, si aad u toosto adigoo xoog leh
Dholuo: Be ing'eyo ni nindo maber konyo e chango ng'ato e yor chuny? 1. Tem nindo maber kuom seche 7-9 odiechieng' kodiechieng'. 2. Tamri kik imadh kong'o kod gik ma imadho kaka kong'o kapok ichako nindo, nikech mano miyo nindo bedo matek. Ket tong' mokwongo e nindo, mondo omi ichiew ka in gi teko.

English: DCI warns residents of Bungoma County to prepare for possible landslides this April.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa maporomoko ya ardhi Aprili hii.
Somali: DCI waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay u diyaargaroobaan dhulgariir dhici kara bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: DCI osiemo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo oikre ne yiengni mag lowo mabiro timore e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: EACC launches ward-level service delivery in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inazindua huduma za huduma katika wilaya ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay bilawday bixinta adeegyada heerka qaybta ee degmada Bomet.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: EACC chako chiwo kony e alwora mar Bomet County.

English: Notice: NCPB will train farmers in Taita-Taveta County on soil conservation this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta juu ya uhifadhi wa udongo Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda gobolka Taita-Taveta ee ku saabsan ilaalinta ciidda bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Rapar: NCPB biro tiego jopur e Taita-Taveta County kuom rito lowo e dwe mar Februar.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges residents of Meru County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na ufisadi wa fedha za umma.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u soo gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago xadgudubka maaliyadeed ee dawladda.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Meru mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo kwayo mar kedo gi ketho pesa mag sirkal.

English: Farmer groups can start savings and loan each other internally to grow their economy and governance. Learn how you lÃ unch one.
Kiswahili: Vikundi vya wakulima vinaweza kuanza kuweka akiba na kukopeana ndani ili kukuza uchumi na utawala wao. Jifunze jinsi unavyopata moja.
Somali: Kooxaha beeralayda waxay bilaabi karaan keydin waxayna isku amaahin karaan si ay u kobciyaan dhaqaalahooda iyo maamulkooda. Baro sida aad mid u barato.
Dholuo: Grube mag jopur nyalo chako kano mwandu kendo ng’iewo mwandu e kindgi mondo gimed dongo e weche mag yuto mwandu kod loch margi. Ipuonjori kaka inyalo ng’ado achiel kuomgi.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises milk producers in Vihiga County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inashauri wazalishaji wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu kula talinayaa soosaarayaasha caanaha ee degmada Vihiga inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products nyiso jopur mag chak e county mar Vihiga mondo oti gi nengo mar piny mosingi kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Notice: NPS conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Mombasa County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ku saabsan ka hortagga argagixisada ee gobolka Mombasa bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NPS timo romo mar oganda e dwe mar Mei e county mar Mombasa.

English: Covid-19 variant from India detected in Kenya, MoH says the case was reported in Kisumu.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inasema kisa hicho kiliripotiwa Kisumu, aina ya Covid-19 kutoka India ikigunduliwa nchini Kenya.
Somali: Kala duwanaanta COVID-19 ee ka timid Hindiya ayaa laga helay Kenya, Wasiirka Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa sheegay in kiiska laga soo sheegay Kisumu.
Dholuo: Covid-19 ma ne owuok e piny India ne ofweny e piny Kenya, Ministry of Health wacho ni ne onyis wachno e Kisumu.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations launches a theft prevention campaign in Nairobi County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa bilaabay olole ka hortagga tuugada Gobolka Nairobi bishii May.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Joneno mag Jehova chako kampen mar geng'o kuo e taon mar Nairobi e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by CDC will be held in Murang'a County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na CDC itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabiyeen CDC ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Murang'a bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kampen mar thieth ma onge chudo ma CDC ochano biro timore e County mar Murang'a e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: DPP reminds residents of Makueni County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni in ay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah xilligan shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogweng' Makueni County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji e nderni ma sirkal ogolo e kinde masiche mag ndara.

English: DPP calls on residents of Bomet County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: DPP inawaomba wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: DPP waxay dadka deggan degmada Bomet ugu baaqeysaa inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga dhaqdhaqaaq aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah si ay u taageeraan taxadarka ka dhanka ah argagixisada.
Dholuo: DPP okwayo ji duto modak e county mar Bomet mondo onyis riwruok mag sirkal ma rito sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e alwora mar tong'gi mondo gikony e kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development urges youth in West Pokot County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Machadka Horumarinta Manhajka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dhalinyarada degmada West Pokot inay ka qeybgalaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo rowere e West Pokot County mondo oriwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gitimo tije mag oganda.

English: Kenya: Epidemic - 04-2024 - Cholera Outbreak #2 (2024-05-29)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Janga - 04-2024 - Mlipuko wa Kipindupindu #2 (2024-05-29)
Somali: Kenya: Cudur faafa - 04-2024 - Cudurka Daacuunka #2 (2024-05-29)
Dholuo: Kenya: Tuwo Maduong' - 04-2024 - Tuwo mar Kolera #2 (29-05-2024)

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will distribute certified millet seed to farmers in Taita-Taveta County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itasambaza mbegu zilizothibitishwa za millet kwa wakulima katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay abuuraha ku nool Gobolka Taita-Taveta u qaybin doontaa abuurka miraha la caddeeyay bishii Sebtember ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Tij Lemo kod Chiemo (AFA) biro pogo kodhi mag millet ne jopur manie Taita-Taveta County e dwe mar ochiko.

English: The FINAS 2024 conference on agricultural financing is ongoing stakeholders are encouraged to engage and explore funding options for the agricultural sector
Kiswahili: Mkutano wa FINAS 2024 kuhusu ufadhili wa kilimo unaendelea wadau wanahimizwa kushiriki na kutafuta chaguzi za ufadhili kwa sekta ya kilimo.
Somali: Shirka FINAS 2024 ee maalgelinta beeraha ayaa weli socda, daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan oo baaraan xulashooyinka maalgelinta ee qaybta beeraha
Dholuo: Chokruok mar FINAS 2024 e wi tiegruok mar pesa e weche mag pur dhi nyime.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free tuberculosis screening is available at all public health centres in Kitui County this November.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kifua kikuu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kitui Novemba hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka caabuqa ee bilaashka ah lagu heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaad ee gobolka Kitui bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji ni nonro mar thieth mar tuberculosis ma onge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County Kitui e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Public notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will host a free hand hygiene outreach in Tana River County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itakuwa mwenyeji wa uhamasishaji wa bure wa usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Tana River Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay martigelin doontaa dhaqdhaqaaqa nadaafadda gacmaha ee bilaashka ah ee degmada Tana River bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo kampen mar rito ler mar lwedo e taon mar Tana River County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: To manage potato bacterial wilt, uproot and remove infected plants from the field, buy certified disease-free seed potatoes, rotate potatoes/tomatoes/peppers/eggplants with maize, bananas, beans, cassava, or millet, remove all volunteer potato tubers after harvest, and keep field tools clean.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti mnyauko wa bakteria ya viazi, kung'oa na kuondoa mimea iliyoambukizwa shambani, nunua viazi vya mbegu vilivyoidhinishwa visivyo na magonjwa, zungusha viazi/nyanya/pilipili/biringanya na mahindi, ndizi, maharagwe, mihogo, au mtama, ondoa mizizi yote ya viazi ya kujitolea baada ya kuvuna, na kuweka zana za shambani safi.
Somali: Si loo maareeyo bakteeriyada baradho ee baradho, la baabi'iyo iyo in laga saaro dhirta cudurka ku dhacay beerta, iibso baradho abuurka oo la caddeeyay inay ka xor yihiin cudurrada, baradho / yaanyada / qumbaha / ukumaha ku wareejiya hadhuudh, basasha, hariimada, cassava, ama miir, ka saar dhammaan baradho baradho ah ka dib goosashada, iyo qalabka beerta nadiif ah.
Dholuo: Mondo omi oting'o yien mag yien ma nigi tuwoche mag adundo, ogol oko kendo ogol oko yien ma nigi tuwono, ng'iew yien ma onge tuoche, ket yien mag adundo/tomato/pepper/yath kod kod kodhi, diemo, choko kodhi, kod kodhi, kendo golo yien mag adundo duto bang' keyo, kendo rito gige tich mag puodho obed maler.

English: KICD advises applicants in Siaya County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KICD inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Siaya kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KICD waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Siaya inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: KICD nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Siaya ni mondo gidonj e tiegruok kapok ichopo e chokruok mabiro.

English: Notice from Kenya Red Cross: free antenatal care clinics will run every February at designated health centres in Machakos County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya: kliniki za bure za utunzaji wa ujauzito zitaendeshwa kila Februari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Machakos.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya: rugta daryeelka dhalmada ee bilaashka ah waxaa lagu qaban doonaa Febraayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Degmada Machakos.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ripot Mamit mar Kenya: Klinike mag rito nyithindo kapok ginyuolo biro tiyo dwe mar ariyo ka dwe e kuonde thieth moyier e county mar Machakos.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response appeals to caregivers in Kakamega County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the September maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuhudhuria siku iliyopangwa ya kliniki kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Septemba.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Kakamega inay ka qeybgalaan maalinta bukaanka ee la qorsheeyay iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Sebtember.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo kwayo jorit e Kaunti mar Kakamega mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar thieth ma ne otim e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice from CDC: childhood immunization clinics will run every January at designated health centres in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa CDC: kliniki za chanjo za watoto zitaendeshwa kila Januari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid CDC: rugta tallaalka carruurta ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Janaayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar yedhe ma thiedho tuoche (CDC): klinik mag thieth ne nyithindo biro tiyo dwe mar Januar higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Kericho.

English: Kenya Medical Association calls on parents in Uasin Gishu County to have children under five screened for malaria during the December outreach.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuwapima watoto chini ya miaka mitano wakati wa mawasiliano ya Desemba.
Somali: Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya ayaa ugu baaqay waalidiinta degmada Uasin Gishu in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka daacuunka inta lagu gudajiro bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association okwayo jonyuol e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo otim nonro mar malaria ne nyithindo ma hikgi tin ne abich e dwe mar Desemba.

English: KEMRI urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pach e County mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: CDC encourages mothers in Isiolo County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Isiolo inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo mine man Isiolo County mondo olim kama gibiro yudoe nyithindo machiegni mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: ODPP urges residents of Tana River County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Tana River kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia simu ya EACC ya bure ili kupambana na ufisaji wa fedha za umma.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee EACC si ay ula dagaallamaan xadgudubka lacagta dadweynaha.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo ochiw ripode mag mibadhi kokalo kuom hotline mar EACC maonge chudo mondo giked gi ketho pesa mag sirkal.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Machakos County that access to psychosocial support is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisaikolojia unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay Degmada Machakos in helitaanka taageerada cilmu-nafsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Machakos ni ginyalo yudo kony maonge chudo.

English: labour opportunities at higher levels and therefore better pay. Improve access to markets and value addition on agricultural produce. Despite the fact that ...
Kiswahili: fursa za kazi katika viwango vya juu na kwa hivyo malipo bora. Kuboresha upatikanaji wa masoko na kuongeza thamani kwenye mazao ya kilimo. Licha ya ukweli kwamba ...
Somali: Fursadaha shaqo heerar sare iyo mushahar wanaagsan. Hagaajinta helitaanka suuqyada iyo kordhinta qiimaha wax-soo-saarka beeraha. Inkasta oo ay jirto ...
Dholuo: Timo dongruok e yore mag manyo tich, kendo mano miyo giyudo chudo maber, medo bedo gi thuolo mar yudo ohala e pinje mamoko, medo bedo gi nyak e ohala, kendo medo kelo nengo ne gik ma giloso e piny.

English: Over 120,000 KCPE 2025 candidates to get full secondary scholarships.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya wagombea 120,000 wa KCPE 2025 kupata usomi kamili wa sekondari.
Somali: In ka badan 120,000 oo musharixiinta KCPE 2025 si ay u helaan deeq waxbarasho oo dhameystiran.
Dholuo: Jokanyo mokalo 120,000 mag KCPE 2025 biro yudo siko mar sekondari.

English: This Men's Mental Health Awareness Month, let's break the silence. Society often tells men to "be strong," but real strength lies in acknowledging your struggles and reaching out. 1. Speaking up isn't weaknessâ€”it's courage. 2. Your feelings are valid. 3.You don't have to face it alone. Whether it's stress, anxiety, depression, or just feeling overwhelmedâ€” your mental health matters. Talk to a friend, a counselor, or a support group. Asking for help is a sign of strength, not failure. You are human. You deserve support. You are not alone.
Kiswahili: Mwezi huu wa Uhamasishaji wa Afya ya Akili ya Wanaume, hebu tuvunje ukimya. Mara nyingi jamii huwaambia wanaume "kuwa imara," lakini nguvu halisi iko katika kutambua mapambano yako na kufikia lengo. 1. Kuzungumza si udhaifu - ni ujasiri. 2. Hisia zako ni halali. 3. Huna haja ya kukabiliana nayo peke yako. Iwe ni msongo wa mawazo, wasiwasi, mfadhaiko, au kuhisi tu kuzidiwa - afya yako ya akili ni muhimu. Zungumza na rafiki, mshauri, au kikundi cha usaidizi. Kuomba msaada ni ishara ya nguvu, si kushindwa. Wewe ni binadamu. Unastahili usaidizi. Hauko peke yako.
Somali: Bishan Wacyigelinta Caafimaadka Dhimirka ee Ragga, aan aamusnaanta jebinno. Bulshadu waxay inta badan ragga ku tiraahdaa "xoog yeesha," laakiin xoogga dhabta ah wuxuu ku jiraa qirashada dhibaatooyinkaaga iyo gaaritaanka. 1. Hadalka oo la sheego ma aha daciifnimo - waa geesinimo. 2. Dareenkaagu waa sax. 3. Uma baahnid inaad kaligaa wajahdo. Hadday tahay walbahaar, walaac, niyad-jab, ama inaad dareento culeys - caafimaadkaaga dhimirka ayaa muhiim ah. La hadal saaxiib, la-taliye, ama koox taageero. Codsashada caawimo waa calaamad muujinaysa xoog, ee maaha guuldarro. Aad baad u tahay bini'aadam. Waxaad mudan tahay taageero. Keligaa ma tihid.
Dholuo: Dwe mar ng’eyo weche mag thieth mar paro mag chwo ni, we mondo watur ling’ling’. Kinde mang’eny, oganda nyiso chwo ni "bed motegno," to teko mar adier nitie kuom yie gi pek ma itemogo kendo chopo e lweny. 1. Wuoyo ok en oloâ€”en chir. 2. Paro mari nigi adier. 3.Ok onego ichung’ne kendi. Kata obedo ni en parruok, parruok, paro mang’eny, kata mana winjo ni in gi pek mang’enyâ€” ngima mari mar paro en gima duong’. Wuo kod osiep, japuonj, kata grup ma konyo. Kwayo kony en ranyisi mar teko, to ok en ranyisi mar ketho. In dhano. Owinjore iyud kony. Ok in kendi.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations alerts residents of Kwale County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale uga digaya kororka kiisaska tuugada wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar Kwale County kuom wach kwan mag jokuoge medore kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Teachers Service Commission conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Nyeri County this April.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Aprili hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa bishii Abriil ku qabanaya madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan wareejinta degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e dwe mar April e kaunti mar Nyeri.

English: NCPB advises avocado producers in Mombasa County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inashauri wazalishaji wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: NCPB waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha avocado ee degmada Mombasa inay ka iibsadaan wax soo saarka kaliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: NCPB nyiso jopur mag avocado e county mar Mombasa ni gius olembegi mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo olembe kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: To control Tuta absoluta in tomatoes, begin control measures in the nursery and continue in the field: set out pheromone traps, or basins of water with a suspended attractant, at least one week before transplanting.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti Tuta absoluta katika nyanya, kuanza hatua za kudhibiti katika nursery na kuendelea katika uwanja: kuweka mitego pheromone, au basins ya maji na suspended attractant, angalau wiki moja kabla ya transplantation.
Somali: Si loo xakameeyo Tuta absoluta ee yaanyada, bilow tallaabooyinka xakamaynta ee qolka beerta kadibna sii wad beerta: dhig dabinno pheromone ah, ama barkado biyo ah oo leh soo jiidasho la supendeeyay, ugu yaraan hal toddobaad ka hor beerista.
Dholuo: Mondo ichik Tuta absoluta e tomato, chak timo kamano e ot mar nyithindo kendo idhi nyime e pap: ketie oboke mag pheromone, kata pi ma nigi gimoro ma ywayo pi, kata bed ni en kamano, kata matin, jumbe achiel kapok ichiko.

English: Ministry of Education collaborates with stakeholders to produce interactive digital content targeting home-based learners.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inashirikiana na wadau kutengeneza maudhui shirikishi ya kidijitali yanayolenga wanafunzi wanaosoma nyumbani.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay la shaqeyneysaa daneeyayaasha si ay u soo saarto waxyaabaha dhijitaalka ah ee isdhexgalka leh ee bartayaasha guriga ku salaysan.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok tiyo kanyachiel gi jogo makonyo e loso weche mag digital ma konyo japuonjre modak e ot.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Mombasa County.

Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur puothe e county mar Kwale mondo ochiw ripot ne jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth machiegni bang' ka osenyis ni nitie tuoche mang'eny mag pien.

English: Kenya has not reported circulating variant poliovirus type 2 (cVDPV2) cases in the past 15 months, and continued surveillance and Kenya's strengthened laboratory capacity will help sustain this momentum and ensure no resurgence.
Kiswahili: Kenya haijaripoti visa vya virusi vya polio aina ya 2 (cVDPV2) vinavyozunguka katika muda wa miezi 15 iliyopita, na ufuatiliaji unaoendelea na kuimarishwa kwa uwezo wa maabara nchini Kenya kutasaidia kuendeleza kasi hii na kuhakikisha hakuna kuzuka tena.
Somali: Kenya ma soo sheegin kiisas kala duwan oo ah nooca 2aad ee fayraska dabaysha (cVDPV2) oo wareegaya 15-kii bilood ee la soo dhaafay, kormeerka joogtada ah iyo awoodda shaybaarka ee la xoojiyay ee Kenya ayaa gacan ka geysan doona sii wadista xawaarahan oo aan la hubin in dib loo soo kabto.
Dholuo: Kenya pok ogolo ripot mar ng’at ma nigi tuo mar polio ma opogore opogore (cVDPV2) e dweche 15 mosekalo, kendo dhi nyime gi ng’iyo kendo keto teko mar laboratori e piny Kenya biro konyo e rito ng’wechni kendo neno ni onge tuo mar ng’iyo kendo.

English: FAO advises farmers in Vihiga County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the June planting season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Juni.
Somali: FAO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Vihiga inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Juun.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e county mar Vihiga mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Jun.

English: Luigi D'Acquino, Chief of Health for UNICEF Kenya, also underscored his organization's commitment to the cause: "UNICEF stands with WHO and the Ministry of Health to ensure every child's right to life is upheld.
Kiswahili: Luigi D'Acquino, Mkuu wa Afya wa UNICEF Kenya, pia alisisitiza dhamira ya shirika lake katika suala hili: "UNICEF inasimama na WHO na Wizara ya Afya kuhakikisha haki ya kila mtoto ya kuishi inazingatiwa.
Somali: Luigi D'Acquino, Madaxa Caafimaadka ee UNICEF Kenya, ayaa sidoo kale hoosta ka xariiqay sida ururkiisu uga go'an yahay qadiyadda: "UNICEF waxay la garab taagan tahay WHO iyo Wasaaradda Caafimaadka si loo hubiyo in la ilaaliyo xuquuqda ilmo kasta ee nolosha."
Dholuo: Luigi D'Acquino, Jatend Thieth e UNICEF Kenya, bende nonyiso chiwruok mar owruogno ne tijno: "UNICEF ochung' kanyakla gi WHO kod Od Thieth mar neno ni ratiro mar nyathi ka nyathi mar ngima orito.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu furayaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya daryeel caafimaad ka dib rabshadaha Degmada Mandera.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Forest Service ochako ofis mar weche thieth mar joma chwo gi mon e county mar Mandera.

English: KICD encourages out-of-school children in Isiolo County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: KICD inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: KICD waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Isiolo inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee fasallada akhris-xisaabta dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo nyithindo maok dhi e skul e kaunti mar Isiolo mondo odonj e program mar somo kod somo mar joma dongo.

English: NPS calls on the community in Trans Nzoia County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu ya simu ya GBV 1195.
Somali: NPS waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wacayaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: NPS okwayo ji duto e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: While Hunger Threatens Millions of Lives in Horn of Africa, Funding Falls Short
Kiswahili: Wakati Njaa Inatishia Mamilioni ya Maisha katika Pembe ya Afrika, Ufadhili Unapungua
Somali: Iyadoo Gaajadu ay Halis ku tahay Malaayiin Nolol ah Geeska Afrika, Maalgelintu way yaraanaysaa
Dholuo: Kaka Kech Oketo Ngima Milyon Mang’eny e Tung’ mar Afrika e Luoro, Pesa Ok Odhier

Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yaanza tena chanjo ya polio kwa mara ya pili huko Mandera, Waziri na Garisa
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa dib u bilaabi doonta tallaalka cudurka Polio markii labaad Mandera, Wajiri iyo Garisa
Dholuo: Ministry of Health biro chako kendo thieth mar polio e kinde mar ariyo e Mandera, Wajiri kod Garisa

English: Gov't extends nationwide curfew, ban on public gatherings until May 29
Kiswahili: Serikali yaongeza muda wa kutotoka nje nchini kote, kupiga marufuku mikusanyiko ya umma hadi Mei 29
Somali: Dowladdu waxay kordhisay bandowga dalka oo dhan, mamnuucidda isu imaatinka dadweynaha ilaa 29-ka May
Dholuo: Sirkal omedo kafiu e piny mangima, ogeng'o chokruok mag oganda nyaka tarik 29 dwe mar abich

English: Deputy President William Ruto on Thursday, June 30, launched his manifesto that was anchored on seven pillars aimed at transforming the country's economy using his bottom-up model. Here is the breakdo...
Kiswahili: Naibu Rais William Ruto siku ya Alhamisi, Juni 30, alizindua manifesto yake ambayo ilijikita katika nguzo saba zinazolenga kubadilisha uchumi wa nchi kwa kutumia mfumo wake wa kuanzia chini hadi juu. Hapa kuna uvunjaji...
Somali: Madaxweyne ku xigeenka William Ruto ayaa Khamiistii, Juun 30, bilaabay bayaankiisa oo ku qotoma toddobo tiir oo loogu talagalay in lagu beddelo dhaqaalaha dalka iyadoo la adeegsanayo qaabkiisa hoose ilaa sare. Waa kan jabkii...
Dholuo: Jatend pinyno William Ruto e odiechieng’ mar ang’wen tarik 30 dwe mar auchiel, nogolo chenro mare ma ne ochung’ne gik abiriyo ma ne ochung’ne loko weche mag pinyno ka otiyo gi yo mare mar ng’ado bura kowuok piny nyaka malo. Mae e giko...

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens a new service point for national ID applications in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu furayaa goob adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee Gobolka Nakuru.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag kwayo nying' e gweng' mar Nakuru.

English: Notice: NTSA conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Isiolo County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NTSA inafanya muhtasari wa jamii juu ya ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada oo ku saabsan dhismaha nabadda qaranka ee degmada Isiolo bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NTSA timo romo mar oganda e wi loso kuwe e gweng' mar Isiolo e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: AFA will open a tea collection centre in Narok County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itafungua kituo cha kukusanya chai katika Kaunti ya Narok Januari hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: AFA waxay xarun soo uruurinaysa shaaha ka furi doontaa gobolka Narok bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: AFA biro chako choko chai e taon mar Narok e dwe mar Januar.

English: TSC urges youth in Nairobi County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: TSC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nairobi inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo rowere e County mar Nairobi mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok gichako timo tije mag oganda.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by CDC will be held in Nyamira County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na CDC itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: xerada caafimaad ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabiyeen CDC ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Nyamira bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kampen mar thieth ma onge chudo ma CDC ochano biro timore e County mar Nyamira e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by CDC will be held in Samburu County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na CDC itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Samburu Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabiyeen CDC ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Samburu bisha August.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma CDC ochano biro timore e county mar Samburu e dwe mar Agost.

English: Kenya Gazette encourages first-time voters in Machakos County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Machakos inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogo ma ne okwongo yiero e county mar Machakos mondo onon weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds voters in Kisii County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kisii kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Kisii inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor inta aan la samayn nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya oparo ne josiasa man Kisii County mondo olim kama ichanoe ji mar IEBC machiegni kodgi kapok itimo yiero.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Kirinyaga County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuthibitisha kuwa kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga inay xaqiijiyaan in xaruntooda la aqoonsaday ka hor inta aysan booqan si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMSA nyiso jogweng' Kirinyaga County mondo ong'e ni kuondegi mag thieth oseyudo ratiro kapok gibiro mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free HIV/AIDS screening is available at all public health centres in Nyandarua County this July.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa VVU/UKIMWI unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Julai hii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka HIV / AIDS ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee Gobolka Nyandarua bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji ni nonro ma onge chudo mar HIV/AIDS yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Nyandarua e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Embu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ee degmada Embu.
Dholuo: Paro: Ofis mar Jadir Jaloch biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag siasa e county mar Embu.

English: IPOA warns residents of Busia County to prepare for possible road accidents this August.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Agosti hii.
Somali: IPOA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia inay u diyaar garoobaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: IPOA osiemo jogweng' mar County mar Busia mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Agost.

English: Egerton University is revitalizing 4K Clubs in ten schools in Njoro Sub County offering training in sustainable agriculture for students and school administrators
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Egerton kinafufua Vilabu vya 4K katika shule kumi katika Kaunti Ndogo ya Njoro zinazotoa mafunzo ya kilimo endelevu kwa wanafunzi na wasimamizi wa shule.
Somali: Jaamacadda Egerton waxay dib u soo nooleyneysaa naadiyada 4K ee toban dugsi oo ku yaal Njoro Subcounty, iyagoo bixiya tababar ku saabsan beeraha waara ardayda iyo maamulayaasha dugsiyada
Dholuo: Yunivasiti mar Egerton chako loso kuonde mitimoe tuke mag 4K e skunde apar man e Njoro Sub County, kendo chiwo tiegruok e wi pur ma dhi nyime ne jopuonjre kod jotelo mag skul

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development promotes agroforestry among farmers in Vihiga County as part of the April climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inakuza kilimo cha misitu kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Aprili.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa kor u qaadeysa beeraleyda deegaanka ee degmada Vihiga iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka adkeysiga cimilada ee bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development dhi nyime jiwo yiende mag yiende e kind jopur e County mar Vihiga kaka achiel kuom chenro mar April mar kedo gi kit yamo.

English: Notice: ODPP opens the electoral calendar centres in Kisumu County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay furaysaa xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee degmada Kisumu bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: ODPP chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e County Kisumu e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Today, we have received 447 patients from among 3803 people tested, totaling to 8,975 patients nationwide from more than 200,000 people tested
Kiswahili: Leo, tumepokea wagonjwa 447 kutoka kati ya watu 3803 waliochunguzwa, jumla ya wagonjwa 8,975 kote nchini kutoka kwa watu zaidi ya 200,000 waliojaribiwa
Somali: Maanta, waxaan helnay 447 bukaan oo ka mid ah 3,803 qof oo la tijaabiyay, taasoo wadarta guud ee 8,975 bukaan ah oo ka tirsan in ka badan 200,000 oo qof oo laga sameeyay baaritaanka
Dholuo: Kawuono, wayudo jotuo 447 kuom ji 3,803 ma ne otimnegi nonro, ma romo ji 8,975 e piny mangima kuom ji mokalo 200,000 ma notimo nonro.

English: KRA invites residents of Kisumu County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: KRA inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: KRA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee la xiriira la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KRA gwelo joma odak e County mar Kisumu mondo oriwre gi county's online participation portal e wi chenro mag chike mag sirkal.

English: IEBC conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Kisii County this August.
Kiswahili: IEBC inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Kisii Agosti hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay qabanqaabinaysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan wareejinta degmada Kisii bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: IEBC dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e dwe mar Agost e kaunti mar Kisii.

English: KEPHIS encourages farmers in Nyandarua County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for horticultural produce.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora za mazao ya bustani.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyandarua inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay alaabta beeraha.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e county mar Nyandarua mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar puothe mag puothe.

English: KNEC encourages residents of Homa Bay County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya haki za kikatiba.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiego ji mondo ging'e weche motudore gi ratiro mag chik.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service warns beans farmers in Bomet County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuhusu maambukizi ya wadudu na inapendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda xayawaanka ee degmada Bomet cudurrada cayayaanka ah wuxuuna kugula talinayaa faragelinta waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho puothe e kaunti mar Bomet kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: CDC reminds the public in Meru County about the importance of tobacco control for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Meru juu ya umuhimu wa udhibiti wa tumbaku kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: CDC waxay dadweynaha degmada Meru ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay xakamaynta sigaarka ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuoche (CDC) parone ji duto e county mar Meru gimomiyo thieth mag ndawa konyo ahinya e ngima joot.

English: NPS urges the community in Siaya County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb theft.
Kiswahili: NPS inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Siaya kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Siaya inay ku biiraan mashaariicda booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo ji duto e county mar Siaya mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o kuo.

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health warns of increased meningitis risk in Lamu County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya homa ya uti wa mgongo katika Kaunti ya Lamu na inashauri umma kutumia vyandarua vya mbu vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ka digtay khatarta sii kordheysa ee meningitis ee Gobolka Lamu waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay isticmaalaan shabaqa cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: Ministry of Health osiemo ji kuom medruok mar tuo mar meningitis e County mar Lamu kendo ojiwo ji mondo oti gi net mag kute ma itiyogo e thiedho lum otieno ka otieno.

English: Kenya: Hundreds of lives saved as an innovative bead necklace helps diagnose pneumonia among children
Kiswahili: Kenya: Mamia ya maisha yaliyookolewa kwa kutumia shanga za kibunifu husaidia kutambua nimonia miongoni mwa watoto
Somali: Kenya: Boqolaal qof ayaa la badbaadiyay iyadoo loo sameeyay silsilad luul oo cusub oo ka caawisa in lagu ogaado oof-wareenka carruurta.
Dholuo: Kenya: Ji mia mang’eny oresi kaka ng’injo ma nigi ng’injo ma ng’injo konyo e fwenyo tuo mar ng’injo e kind nyithindo

English: Notice: HELB announces school feeding programme enrollment dates for schools in Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa programu ya kulisha shule kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiyada degmada Kiambu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: HELB landoga tarik mag dhi e skunde mag Kiambu County.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development promotes agroforestry among farmers in Marsabit County as part of the August climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inakuza kilimo cha misitu kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Agosti.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa kor u qaadeysa beeraleyda kaynta beeraha ee degmada Marsabit iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka iska caabbinta cimilada ee Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development dhi nyime jiwo yiende mag yiende e kind jopur e county mar Marsabit kaka achiel kuom chenro mar Agost mar kedo gi lokruok e kor lwasi.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Ministry of Health will be held in Siaya County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Wizara ya Afya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Siaya Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ay soo qabanqaabisay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa lagu qabanqaabi doonaa degmada Siaya bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo mitimo gi Ministry of Health ibiro tim e County mar Siaya e dwe mar Februar.

English: The transition to individual-level data reporting was not without challenges.
Kiswahili: Mpito kwa kuripoti data kwa kiwango cha mtu binafsi haukuwa na changamoto.
Somali: U gudubka warbixinta xogta heerka shakhsi ahaaneed ma ahayn mid aan lahayn caqabado.
Dholuo: Okang’ ma ne olokorego mondo ogol ripot mag data mag ng’ato ka ng’ato ne ok obedo maonge gi pek.

English: Notice: KALRO will conduct a greenhouse farming workshop for farmers in Migori County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafanya warsha ya kilimo cha chafu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo ee beeraleyda degmada Migori bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KALRO biro timo tiegruok mar timo tijno ne jopur e gweng' mar Migori e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education opens applications for scholarships for needy students for learners in Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu inafungua maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay furaysaa codsiyada deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay ardayda u baahan ardayda degmada Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Ofis mar Puonjruok oseyawo kwayo mag somo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia.

English: KNEC reminds needy students in Homa Bay County that revision guides applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KNEC waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan gobolka Homa Bay in dib-u-eegista ay ku xiran tahay codsiyada dhowaan.
Dholuo: KNEC paronwa jopuonjre man gi chandruok e Homa Bay County ni lokruok mar gwelo kwayo mag kwayo biro rumo machiegnini.

English: Youths in villages have brgan farming with digital backround. Meet three youths from Asia who have discovered a new way of irrigating farms. Try goodnews A. IFAD..
Kiswahili: Vijana katika vijiji wana kilimo cha brgan na backround ya dijiti. Kutana na vijana watatu kutoka Asia ambao wamegundua njia mpya ya kumwagilia mashamba. Jaribu habari njema A. IFAD..
Somali: Dhalinyarada tuulooyinka waxay leeyihiin beeralayda brgan oo leh digital backround. La kulan saddex dhalinyaro ah oo ka yimid Aasiya oo helay hab cusub oo lagu waraabiyo beeraha. Isku day warka wanaagsan A. IFAD..
Dholuo: Rowere manie gweng' moro nigi tij pur moting'o digital.

English: Kenya suspends all public gatherings, games, events, and church crusades; inter school games banned after first covid-19 case in Nairobi
Kiswahili: Kenya yasimamisha mikusanyiko yote ya umma, michezo, matukio, na mikutano ya kanisa; michezo ya shule imepigwa marufuku baada ya kisa cha kwanza cha COVID-19 jijini Nairobi
Somali: Kenya ayaa joojisay dhammaan isu imaatinka dadweynaha, ciyaaraha, dhacdooyinka, iyo safarada iskutallaabta ee kaniisadda; Ciyaaraha iskuulada ayaa la mamnuucay kadib kiiska koowaad ee COVID-19 ee Nairobi
Dholuo: Kenya ogeng'o chokruok duto mag ji, tuke, gik moko, kod lwenje mag kanisa; tugo tuke e kind skunde ogo marfuk bang' wach Covid-19 mokwongo Nairobi

English: Judiciary of Kenya announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kusindika vyeti vya kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya ayaa ku dhawaaqay in lagu hagaajinayo waqtiga wareejinta shahaadada dhalashada ee degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya olando lokruok e seche mag timo nonro mar nyuol e County mar Kisumu.

English: #COVID19 Myth Vs Fact. Myth Eating garlic helps prevent infection with the coronavirus. Fact Garlic is a healthy food that may have some antimicrobial properties. However, there is no evidence that eating garlic has protected people from #COVID19. #KomeshaCorona update.
Kiswahili: Hadithi za #COVID19 Vs Ukweli. Hadithi Kula kitunguu saumu husaidia kuzuia maambukizi ya virusi vya corona. Ukweli Kitunguu saumu ni chakula chenye afya ambacho kinaweza kuwa na mali ya antimicrobial. Walakini, hakuna ushahidi kwamba kula kitunguu saumu kumewalinda watu dhidi ya #COVID19. #KomeshaCorona sasisho.
Somali: #Khuraafaad iyo Xaqiiqo. Khuraafaad Cunista toonta waxay ka hortagtaa caabuqa fayraska korona. Xaqiiqo Toontu waa cunto caafimaad leh oo laga yaabo inay leedahay sifooyin jeermis dile ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, ma jirto caddayn muujinaysa in cunista toontu ay dadka ka ilaalisay #COVID19. Cusbooneysiinta #KomeshaCorona.
Dholuo: #KOVID19 Miriambo Koda Adier. Miriambo Chamo chiel oko konyo e geng'o yudo midhusi mar korona. Adier Garlic en chiemo ma nigi ng’iyo maber ma nyalo bedo gi gik moko ma nyalo geng’o tuoche madongo. Kata kamano, onge ranyisi manyiso ni chamo alode oserito ji mondo kik oyud #COVID19. #KomeshaKorona ma manyien.

English: Villages in baringo to fight with malaria through their local best practices and use of nets
Kiswahili: Vijiji vya baringo kupambana na malaria kupitia mazoea yao bora ya ndani na matumizi ya mitaro
Somali: Tuulooyinka baringo si ay ula dagaallamaan malaria iyada oo loo marayo dhaqankooda ugu wanaagsan ee maxalliga ah iyo isticmaalka shabagyada
Dholuo: Gwenge mag baringo kedo gi malaria kokalo kuom timbe mabeyo ma gin - go e alworagi kod tiyo gi gogo

English: Notice: FAO will distribute certified wheat seed to farmers in Uasin Gishu County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itasambaza mbegu za ngano zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay u qaybin doontaa abuurka sarreenka ee la caddeeyay beeraleyda gobolka Uasin Gishu bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: FAO biro pogo kodhi mag ngano ne jopur man Uasin Gishu County e dwe mar Mach.

English: KICD conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Embu County this December.
Kiswahili: KICD inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Embu Desemba hii.
Somali: KICD waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda gobolka ee degmada Embu bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: KICD dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi riwruok mar oganda e bajet mar county e county mar Embu e dwe mar Desemba.

English: State Department for TVET advises applicants in Kakamega County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kutuma maombi ya kuwekwa kwa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha Gobolka Kakamega inay dalbadaan booska TVET iyada oo loo marayo KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET nyiso jogo madwaro yudo tiegruok e kaunti mar Kakamega mondo okonygi gi KUCCPS.

English: Kenya Gazette warns public officers in West Pokot County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya West Pokot dhidi ya kutumia vibaya mamlaka.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee gobolka West Pokot inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e West Pokot County ni kik giti marach gi migepegi.

English: NCPB informs horticultural produce farmers in Kirinyaga County of new market linkage opportunities this July.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawafahamisha wakulima wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Julai hii.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda wax soo saarka beeraha ee degmada Kirinyaga fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: NCPB nyiso jopur ma loso puothe mag puothe e County mar Kirinyaga e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Julai.

English: "Hunger Can Kill": With Nearly 2 million Kenyans Facing Food Insecurity, Children Bear the Brunt of Malnutrition
Kiswahili: "Njaa Inaweza Kuua": Huku takriban Wakenya milioni 2 Wanakabiliwa na Uhaba wa Chakula, Watoto Wamebeba Ngumu ya Utapiamlo
Somali: "Gaajadu way dili kartaa": Iyadoo ku dhawaad ​​2 milyan oo Kenyan ah ay wajahayaan amni-darro cunto, carruurtu waxay la ildaran yihiin nafaqo-xumada.
Dholuo: Kech Nyalo Nego: Ka Jo Kenya Chiegni milioni 2 Oromo gi Pek mar Bedo gi Chiemo, Nyithindo Oting'o Pek mar Bedo gi Chiemo ma Owinjore

English: Public health advisory: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response warns of increased Rift Valley Fever risk in Turkana County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa katika Kaunti ya Turkana na inashauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Talobixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay ka digtay kororka halista Cudurka Rift Valley ee Gobolka Turkana waxayna ku talineysaa dadweynaha inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga ah mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Rift Valley Fever e County mar Turkana, kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore e weche thieth.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations launches a burglary prevention campaign in Nandi County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Nandi Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada ayaa bilaabay olole ka hortagga jabsashada gobolka Nandi bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chako kampen mar geng'o kwalo e taon mar Nandi e dwe mar Februar.

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Tharaka-Nithi County that access to skilled birth attendance is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwamba upatikanaji wa mahudhurio ya uzazi wenye ujuzi ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi in helitaanka daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfad leh ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone mine ma biro nyuolo nyithindo e Tharaka-Nithi County ni thuolo mar yudo nyithindo ma nigi lony en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag oganda.

English: NPS urges the community in Tana River County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb carjacking.
Kiswahili: NPS inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Tana River kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) kuzuia utekaji nyara wa gari.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Tana River County inay ku biiraan mashaariicda booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo afduubka gawaarida.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo oganda manie Tana River County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o kwalo mtokni.

English: CDC reminds the public in Uasin Gishu County that access to free medical camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za matibabu bila malipo sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Uasin Gishu in helitaanka xeryaha caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha loo qoondeeyay.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji duto e county mar Uasin Gishu ni thuolo mar dhi e kambi mag thieth ma onge chudo koro yudore e kuonde moketi.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages mothers in Kakamega County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka Gobolka Kakamega inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo mine man Kakamega County mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: FAO advises farmers in Meru County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the November planting season.
Kiswahili: FAO inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru watumie viwango vilivyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa kupanda mwezi Novemba.
Somali: FAO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Meru inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beerto ee bisha November.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur manie Meru County mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Taita Taveta County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for January 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Taita Taveta: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Januari 2023
Somali: Degmada Taita Taveta: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Janaayo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Taita Taveta: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar achiel higa mar 2023
