English: COMESA reminds farmers in Bungoma County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Somali: COMESA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Bungoma barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee ka dambeeya goosashada.
Dholuo: COMESA parone jopur man Bungoma County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime bang' keyo.

English: Supporting a human rights economy in Kenya
Kiswahili: Kusaidia uchumi wa haki za binadamu nchini Kenya
Somali: Taageeridda dhaqaalaha xuquuqda aadanaha ee Kenya
Dholuo: Chiwo siro weche mag yuto mar ratiro mag dhano e piny Kenya

English: ODPP urges residents of Narok County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on community-based development programmes.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Narok inay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada si ay uga warqabaan barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi chenro mag dongruok mag oganda.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service launches a cattle rustling prevention campaign in Kitui County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kitui Juni hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu billaabay olole looga hortago xanta xoolaha ee Gobolka Kitui bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Forest Service chako kampen mar geng'o yadh jamni e taon mar Kitui e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: KRA will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ee gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KRA biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e kaunti mar Homa Bay.

English: NCPB reminds residents of Vihiga County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Somali: NCPB waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga in ilaalinta ciidda ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: NCPB paronwa jogweng' mar County mar Vihiga ni rito lowo miyo puodho bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: KEMSA encourages mothers in Vihiga County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Vihiga inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo mine manie County mar Vihiga mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Caregivers should wash hands with soap before handling babies, after changing diapers, and before feeding to prevent infections.
Kiswahili: Walezi wanapaswa kunawa mikono kwa sabuni kabla ya kuwashughulikia watoto, baada ya kubadilisha nepi, na kabla ya kuwalisha ili kuzuia maambukizi.
Somali: Daryeelayaashu waa inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun ka hor intaanay xidhin ilmaha, ka dib markay beddelaan boorsooyinka, iyo ka hor inta aan la quudin si looga hortago cudurrada.
Dholuo: Joma rito nyithindo onego olwok lwetegi gi sabun kapok gitiyo gi nyithindo, bang' loko piendgi, kendo kapok gichiemo mondo kik giyud tuoche.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) launches a June awareness campaign on diabetes screening across West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Juni juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Juun oo ku saabsan baaritaanka sonkorowga gobolka West Pokot.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Jun e wi nonro mar thieth mar sukari e West Pokot County.

English: DCI alerts residents of Busia County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: DCI waxay dadka deggan degmada Busia uga digtay kororka kiisaska burburka waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne ji modak e County mar Busia ni kwan mag joma odonjo e ot biro medore kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit launches a June awareness campaign on hand hygiene across Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Juni juu ya usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Juun oo ku saabsan nadaafadda gacmaha ee gobolka Nyamira.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Jun e wi ler mar lwedo e County duto mar Nyamira.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by CDC will be held in Kajiado County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na CDC itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kajiado Mei hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabiyeen CDC ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Kajiado bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kampen mar thieth ma onge chudo ma CDC ochano biro timore Kajiado County e dwe mar Mei.

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief, March 2024
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP Kenya, Machi 2024
Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya, Maarso 2024
Dholuo: Wach machuok mar piny Kenya mar WFP, dwe mar adek 2024

English: Notice: NDMA activates an emergency response plan for drought in Machakos County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ukame katika Kaunti ya Machakos.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo abaaraha ka dhan ah degmada Machakos.
Dholuo: Rapar: NDMA tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony e kinde oro e gweng' mar Machakos.

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on residents of Uasin Gishu County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Uasin Gishu kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqayaa dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service okwayo jogweng' Uasin Gishu County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji nitie mondo okony ji ng'eyo chon.

English: DCI alerts residents of Baringo County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: DCI waxay uga digtay dadka deggan degmada Baringo kororka kiisaska burburka waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne jogweng' Baringo County kuom wach kwan mar joma odonjo e ot kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Flooding Displaces More than 200,000 in Kenya, Fueling Hunger
Kiswahili: Mafuriko Yawahamisha Zaidi ya 200,000 nchini Kenya, Na Kuchochea Njaa
Somali: Daadad ka barakacay in ka badan 200,000 oo qof oo ku nool Kenya, taasoo sii hurinaysa gaajada.
Dholuo: Pi Opong'o Oganda Ogolo Ji Mahingo 200,000 e Udigi E Piny Kenya, Ma Medo Kech

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development encourages residents of Nyandarua County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada Waxbarashada wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabtaan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo ong'e weche ma gidonjogo e register mar joma oyiero mondo ging'e kaka ibiro dwokgi.

English: TSC calls on the community in Homa Bay County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TSC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TSC waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada gobolka Homa Bay inay taageeraan jawiga waxbarasho ee ka kooban si loo ilaaliyo nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: TSC okwayo ji duto manie Homa Bay County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ngima maber e skunde.

English: KEMRI encourages mothers in Homa Bay County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka gobolka Homa Bay inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo mine manie Homa Bay County mondo olim kama gibiro yudoe nyithindo machiegni mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public in Wajir County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Wajir in adeegyada bukaanka dibedda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji duto e County mar Wajir ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mag ambulatori e kuonde moyier.

English: Kenya Red Cross launches an October awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Oktoba juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Oktoobar oo ku saabsan baaritaanka sonkorowga ee degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Oktoba e wi nonro mar thieth mar sukari e gweng' mar Kisumu.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in West Pokot County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi diiwaangelinta beeraleyda loogu talagalay beeralayda Gobolka West Pokot bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro timo rapar mar jopur e dwe mar Julai e West Pokot County.

English: ODPP reminds residents of Taita-Taveta County that access to national ID applications is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kwamba kufikia maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Taita-Taveta in helitaanka codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: ODPP parone jogweng' Taita-Taveta County ni yudo kwayo mag ID mar piny sani yot moloyo kokalo kuom yore mag tich.

English: ODPP updates residents of Nyandarua County on progress of community-based development programmes this May.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua juu ya maendeleo ya programu za maendeleo ya jamii mwezi Mei.
Somali: ODPP waxay dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua ku wargelineysaa horumarka barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada ee bisha May.
Dholuo: ODPP chiwo ripot ne jogweng' Nyandarua County kuom dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag oganda e dwe mar abich.

English: The Kenya Food Systems Conference identified critical recommendations for enhancing the science policy interface in agriculture Stakeholders are encouraged to engage with proposed mechanisms for innovation
Kiswahili: Kongamano la Mifumo ya Chakula nchini Kenya lilibainisha mapendekezo muhimu ya kuimarisha kiolesura cha sera ya sayansi katika kilimo Wadau wanahimizwa kujihusisha na mbinu zinazopendekezwa za uvumbuzi.
Somali: Shirkii Kenya ee Nidaamyada Cuntada ayaa lagu aqoonsaday talooyin muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo isdhexgalka siyaasadda sayniska ee beeraha.
Dholuo: Chokruok mar Kenya Food Systems Conference ne ofwenyo paro madongo mag medo dongruok e weche mag sayans e weche mag pur.

English: IEBC advises applicants in Samburu County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Samburu kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: IEBC waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha Gobolka Samburu inay dalbadaan booska TVET ee KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: IEBC nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Samburu mondo oketgi e tiegruok mar TVET kokalo kuom KUCCPS.

English: NCPB informs milk farmers in Nyeri County of new market linkage opportunities this March.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawafahamisha wakulima wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Machi hii.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda caanaha ee degmada Nyeri fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: NCPB nyiso jopur mag chak e County mar Nyeri kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Mach.

English: Attention youth in agriculture Engage with FAO s Hand in Hand initiative to access resources and support aimed at achieving food security and Sustainable Development Goal 2
Kiswahili: Vijana makini katika kilimo Kushiriki katika mpango wa FAO wa Kushikana mikono ili kupata rasilimali na usaidizi unaolenga kufikia usalama wa chakula na Lengo la 2 la Maendeleo Endelevu.
Somali: Digniin, dhalinyarada ku jira beeraha Ka qaybgal mashruuca FAO ee Hand in Hand si loo helo kheyraad iyo taageero lagu gaarayo amniga cuntada iyo Yoolka Horumarinta Waara 2
Dholuo: Chenro mar rowere e weche mag pur Riw lwedo chenro mar FAO mar yudo mwandu kod kony mabiro konyo e chopo weche mag chiemo kod chenro mar dongruok mosiko 2

English: IPOA reminds residents of Kirinyaga County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga in si deg deg ah u soo sheegidda dhac ay gacan ka geysaneyso in xaafadaha la ilaaliyo.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogweng' Kirinyaga County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar donjo e ot konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds the public in Kisii County to remain vigilant on border security.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu dadka degmada Kisii ku xasuusinayaa inay ka feejignaadaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service parone ji duto e County mar Kisii ni gibed motang' gi weche mag sirkal.

English: Huduma Kenya urges eligible citizens in Kisii County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inahimiza wananchi wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Kisii kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kisii inay ka qaybqaataan jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo raia mag Kisii County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar yiero.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds mobile money users in Turkana County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid identity theft.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Turkana inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado tuugada aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e County mar Turkana ni mondo ging'e kwayo margi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo kik gikwed nek mar ng'ato.

English: NTSA reminds the public in Marsabit County to remain vigilant on border security.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Marsabit inay ka feejignaadaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: NTSA paronwa ji duto manie Marsabit County ni gibed motang' gi weche mag rito tong'.

English: Ministry of Education reminds needy students in Mandera County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji utafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Mandera in deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay codsiyada ardayda loo baahan yahay ay dhowaan dhammaadaan.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok parone jopuonjre man gi chan e County mar Mandera ni chiwo mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre ma nigi chan biro rumo machiegni.

English: Public notice: Kenya Red Cross will host a free hand hygiene outreach in Bomet County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Bomet Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay marti gelineysaa dhaqdhaqaaqa nadaafadda gacmaha ee bilaashka ah ee degmada Bomet bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova mar Kenya Red Cross biro timo kampen mar rito ler mar lwedo e taon mar Bomet e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board restricts movement of cattle in West Pokot County due to a rabies outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya yazuia harakati za ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kutokana na mlipuko wa kichaa cha mbwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha Kenya ayaa xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da Gobolka West Pokot sababo la xiriira cudurka Cudurka.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Dairy Board ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok e West Pokot County nikech tuwo mar rabies.

English: Teachers Service Commission invites youth in Migori County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this November.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Migori kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Novemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa ku casuumay dhalinyarada degmada Migori inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista bisha November.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj gwelo rowere mag Migori County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges residents of Nyandarua County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili kuwajulisha juu ya usambazaji wa huduma kwa kiwango cha wilaya.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay la xiriiraan maamulaha qaybta maxalliga ah si ay uga warqabaan bixinta adeegyada heerka qaybta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General jiwo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jorit mar ward margi mondo ging'e weche duto e wi tich mitimo e ward.

English: Notice: IEBC reminds citizens in Murang'a County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Somali: Ogsoonow: IEBC waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Murang'a xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC paronwa raia mag County mar Murang'a e wi ratiro ma gin-go kaluwore gi chike mag sirkal.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board restricts movement of dairy cows in Garissa County due to a foot and mouth disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inazuia harakati za ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Garissa kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka ayaa xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da caanaha ah ee Gobolka Garissa sababo la xiriira faafitaanka cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Locho e Wi Yien mag Chwero Gik Makelo Hinyruok, ogeng'o wuoth mag dhok ma nigi dhok ma imayo e gweng' mar Garissa nikech tuwo mar dhoho.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds the public in Bomet County that reporting embezzlement of public funds is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa fedha za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Bomet in warbixinta xadgudubka lacagta dawladda ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya paronwa ji duto e County mar Bomet ni lando miriambo mag pesa mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Notice: KUCCPS announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta dugsiyada dugsiga dhexe ee maalin bilaash ah ee degmada Nyamira.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KUCCPS ogolo chenro mar somo mar sekondari maonge chudo e skunde man Nyamira County.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development opens a new motor vehicle mechanics programme at the vocational centre in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yafungua programu mpya ya ufundi wa magari katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee horumarinta manhajka wuxuu ka furayaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan mashiinka gawaarida gawaari ee xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ochako chenro manyien mar tiyo gi masinde mag riembo mtokni e skul mar tiegruok e boma mar Kericho.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General launches ward-level service delivery in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu huzindua huduma za huduma katika wilaya ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu bilaabay bixinta adeegyada heerka qaybta ee Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Auditor-General chako chiwo kony e ward level e County mar Wajir.

English: Keep hot drinks and cooking pots away from childrenÂ’s reach to prevent burn injuries.
Kiswahili: Weka vinywaji vya moto na vyungu vya kupikia mbali na watoto ili kuzuia majeraha ya kuungua.
Somali: Cabitaannada kulul iyo dheriyada wax lagu karsado ka fogee carruurta si looga hortago dhaawacyada gubashada.

English: AFA urges farmers in Nyamira County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: AFA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachozingatia hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyamira inay ka qeyb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e Kaunti mar Nyamira mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi pur mar piny mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok mar koth.

English: UN expresses solidarity with Kenya following deadly floods
Kiswahili: Umoja wa Mataifa unaonyesha mshikamano wake na Kenya kufuatia mafuriko makubwa

Dholuo: UN nyiso winjruok mare gi piny Kenya bang' pi mang'eny mane onego ji mang'eny

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will conduct a greenhouse farming workshop for farmers in Siaya County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itafanya warsha ya kilimo cha chafu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Siaya Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo ee beeraleyda degmada Siaya bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro timo tiegruok mar timo tijno ne jopur e alwora mar Siaya e dwe mar Mach.

English: EACC updates residents of Isiolo County on progress of community-based development programmes this September.
Kiswahili: EACC inawajulisha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo juu ya maendeleo ya mipango ya maendeleo katika jumuiya mwezi huu wa Septemba.
Somali: EACC waxay dadka deggan degmada Isiolo ka wargelineysaa horumarka barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada ee bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: EACC medo lero ne jogweng' Isiolo County dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag oganda e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: COMESA will distribute certified sorghum seed to farmers in Baringo County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Baringo Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay abuuraha degmada Baringo u qaybin doontaa abuurka sorghum ee la caddeeyay bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA biro pogo kodhi mag sorghum ne jopur man Baringo County e dwe mar Agost.

English: NCPB encourages farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for horticultural produce.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za mazao ya bustani.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay alaabta beeraha.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo ous olemo mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo olemo mondo giyud nengo maber mar olemo mag puodho.

English: Kenya Price Bulletin, June 2023
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Bei ya Kenya, Juni 2023
Somali: Warbixinta Qiimaha Kenya, Juun 2023
Dholuo: Oboke mar Nengo mar Kenya, dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2023

English: Public health advisory: KEMRI warns of increased dengue fever risk in Tana River County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMRI inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya homa ya dengue katika Kaunti ya Tana River na inashauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Talobixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: KEMRI waxay ka digeysaa khatarta sii kordheysa ee hargabka dengue ee degmada Tana River waxayna ku talineysaa dadweynaha inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: KEMRI osiemo ji kuom medruok mar tuwo mar dengue e taon mar Tana River County kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore e thieth.

English: Notice: NPS opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inafungua dawati la jinsia kutoa simu ya msaada ya GBV bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ee degmada Murang'a.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NPS oseyawo ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo chenro mar tiyo gi simo maonge chudo mar GBV e County mar Murang'a.

English: The 2021 Political Declaration on HIV and AIDS specified that community-led organizations should be delivering 80% of HIV prevention services for populations at high risk of HIV infection by 2025.
Kiswahili: Azimio la Kisiasa la 2021 kuhusu VVU na UKIMWI lilibainisha kuwa mashirika yanayoongozwa na jamii yanapaswa kuwa yanatoa 80% ya huduma za kuzuia VVU kwa watu walio katika hatari kubwa ya kuambukizwa VVU ifikapo 2025.
Somali: Baaqa Siyaasadeed ee 2021 ee ku saabsan HIV iyo AIDS wuxuu qeexay in ururada bulshadu ay tahay inay bixiyaan 80% adeegyada ka hortagga HIV ee loogu talagalay dadka khatarta sare ugu jira infekshanka HIV marka la gaaro 2025.
Dholuo: Oboke mar siasa mar 2021 kuom HIV kod AIDS ne owacho ni riwruoge ma ji otelone onego obed ka chiwo 80% mar kony mag geng'o tuo mar HIV ne oganda ma ni e arita maduong' mar yudo tuo mar HIV nyaka higa mar 2025 ochopo.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Baringo County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the May planting season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Baringo kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Mei.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Baringo inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maajo.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e county mar Baringo mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Mei.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds the public in Kajiado County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kubaki macho juu ya ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka degmada Kajiado ku xasuusinaya inay ka feejignaadaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne ji duto e Kajiado County ni gibed motang' ne loso kuwe e piny mangima.

English: Government announces scaling of biofortified crop distribution to schools and households for improved maternal-child nutrition.
Kiswahili: Serikali yatangaza kuongeza usambazaji wa mazao biofuti kwa shule na kaya kwa ajili ya kuboresha lishe ya mama na mtoto.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay ku dhawaaqday kordhinta qaybinta dalagyada la xoojiyay ee dugsiyada iyo qoysaska si loo horumariyo nafaqada hooyada iyo dhallaanka.
Dholuo: Sirkal ogolo lendo mar medo ng’eny mar chiwo cham ma nigi gik ma nyalo ketho ngima mar ng’ato e skul kod udi mondo ober chiemo ma ng’ato nyalo yudo kuom min gi nyathi.

English: Kwale County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kwale: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Aprili 2024
Somali: Degmada Kwale: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kwale: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar ang'wen 2024

English: For maize, support grain filling and monitor ear development to manage low pollination stress.
Kiswahili: Kwa mahindi, saidia kujaza nafaka na kufuatilia ukuaji wa sikio ili kudhibiti mkazo mdogo wa uchavushaji.
Somali: Macdanta, taageero buuxinta hadhuudhka iyo kormeerka horumarinta dhegaha si loo maareeyo xiisadda duurka ee hooseeya.
Dholuo: Kuom kodhi, siro pong'o kodhi kendo rit dongruok mar ite mondo iti gi teko mar chwoyo.

English: IPOA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Garissa County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: IPOA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayeona unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuripoti kesi kwenye dawati la karibu la jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Garissa inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo chandruok mar nindruok e gweng' mar Garissa County mondo ochiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service conducts a community briefing on border security in Nairobi County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Nairobi mwezi huu Julai.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu qabtaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha ee Gobolka Nairobi bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Forest Service timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e Nairobi County e dwe mar Julai.

English: Tana River County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tana River: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Juni 2024
Somali: Degmada Tana River: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Aora Tana: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2024

English: Kenya faces crisis as Trump's Executive Order to cut supply of HIV, malaria drugs
Kiswahili: Kenya inakabiliwa na mgogoro huku amri ya Trump ikipunguza usambazaji wa dawa za HIV na malaria
Somali: Kenya waxay wajahaysaa xaalad adag iyadoo Trump uu amray in la dhimo isticmaalka daawooyinka HIV iyo duumada
Dholuo: Kenya yudo masira kaka chik mar Trump noketo mar duoko piny chiwo mag HIV kod yath mag maleria

English: Notice: DPP activates an emergency response plan for landslides in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DPP inaamsha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ka dhan ah dhulgariirada gobolka Nakuru.
Dholuo: Rapar: DPP tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne yiengni mag lowo e gweng' mar Nakuru.

English: KMTC conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Kwale County this October.
Kiswahili: KMTC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kwale Oktoba hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan kaqeybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda gobolka ee Gobolka Kwale bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KMTC otimo chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda e dwe mar Oktoba e kaunti mar Kwale.

English: Council of Governors encourages first-time voters in Nairobi County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyayaashu waxay ku dhiirigelinayaan codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Nairobi inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo josiasa ma ne okwongo yiero e County mar Nairobi mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero.

English: The planet-friendly approach to school feeding will be at the heart of the scale up and focus of the coalition
Kiswahili: Njia ya sayari-kirafiki ya kulisha shule itakuwa katika moyo wa kupanua na lengo la muungano
Somali: Qaab-dhismeedka saaxiibtinimada adduunka ee quudinta dugsiga ayaa noqon doona bartamaha ballaarinta iyo diiradda isbahaysiga
Dholuo: Riwruok mar riwruok mar oganda Jehova biro keto pachgi ahinya kuom miyo nyithindo chiemo e skunde

English: Partnerships and training helped prevent election violence
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano na mafunzo vilisaidia kuzuia ghasia za uchaguzi
Somali: Iskaashiga iyo tababarku waxay gacan ka geysteen ka hortagga rabshadaha doorashada
Dholuo: Riwruok kod puonj ne okonyo e geng'o tulo mag yiero

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Mombasa County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee gobolka Mombasa inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pach e County mar Mombasa mondo omany japuonj molony.

English: Kenya Dairy Board invites farmers in West Pokot County to a free training on post-harvest handling this August.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kwa mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno Agosti hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa ku casuumay beeraleyda Gobolka West Pokot inay tababar lacag la'aan ah ku helaan maareynta goosashada ka dib bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board ogwelo jopur e West Pokot County e tiegruok ma onge chudo e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: KICD announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ee dugsiyada gobolka Nyamira.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KICD olando tarik mag somo e skunde mag Nyamira County.

English: KTDA reminds residents of Marsabit County that conservation tillage improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba kilimo cha uhifadhi kinaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: KTDA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit in beerashada ilaalinta ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: KTDA paronwa jogweng' mar Marsabit County ni choko puothe mag puothe medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Deworming infants in every 6 months promotes body development, intellectual growth and academic capacity
Kiswahili: Kuondoa wadudu kila baada ya miezi 6 huendeleza maendeleo ya mwili, ukuaji wa akili na uwezo wa kitaaluma
Somali: Dhalashada dhallaanka lixdii biloodba mar waxay kor u qaadeysaa horumarka jirka, koritaanka garashada iyo awoodda waxbarashada
Dholuo: Nyithindo madhi nyuol bang ' dweche auchiel duto jiwo dongruok mar dendgi, dongo mar pachgi, kod nyalo mar puonjruok.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service promotes terracing among farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County as part of the October climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inakuza uchungaji kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Oktoba.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa beeraleyda ku nool Degmada Tharaka-Nithi iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka adkeysiga cimilada ee Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo terracing e kind jopur e Tharaka-Nithi County kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Those of us who have recovered from COVID-19, please be our ambassadors to the rest of the country. Pass a message of hope, while also instilling a sense of caution to the rest of the country. Wash hands. Sanitize. Keep social distance. Stay at home. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Wale ambao tumepona COVID-19, tafadhali tuwe mabalozi wetu kote nchini. Pitisha ujumbe wa matumaini, huku pia ukisisitiza hali ya tahadhari kwa nchi nzima. Osha mikono. Safisha. Weka umbali wa kijamii. Kaa nyumbani. #KomeshaCorona

English: WHO approves second malaria jab for children, to cost as low as Sh300
Kiswahili: WHO yaidhinisha chanjo ya pili ya malaria kwa watoto, kuwa na gharama ya chini ya Sh300
Somali: WHO waxay oggolaatay tallaalka labaad ee daaweynta malaria ee carruurta, oo qiimihiisu noqon doono ilaa Sh300
Dholuo: WHO oyie gi thieth mar ariyo mar malaria ne nyithindo, ma biro chulo siling' 300

English: Notice: NDMA activates an emergency response plan for fire outbreaks in Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa milipuko ya moto katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ku saabsan dabka ka kacay Gobolka Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony mapiyo ne masiche mag mach e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Embu County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Embu kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qofkasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Embu inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e County mar Embu mondo oluong simo mar kony mar thieth mar paro maonge chudo.

English: NDMA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NDMA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kutafuta msaada katika nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e gweng' mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone experiencing abuse in Laikipia County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Laikipia apigie simu ya simu ya GBV 1195.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Laikipia inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e County mar Laikipia mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195 maonge chudo.

English: HELB reminds youth in Meru County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Meru kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Meru in maalgelinta HELD ay diyaar u tahay tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa rowere manie County mar Meru ni pesa mag HELP yudore e tiegruok mag chiemo kod mar rwako welo.

English: KRA encourages first-time voters in Uasin Gishu County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: KRA inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: KRA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Uasin Gishu inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo joma okwongo yiero e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo oting'e ID kata pasi mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero.

English: In summary. Most strategies on agricultural markets are ongoing especially to reduce costs of production and various taxes.
Kiswahili: Kwa muhtasari. Mikakati mingi kwenye masoko ya kilimo inaendelea haswa kupunguza gharama za uzalishaji na ushuru anuwai.
Somali: Marka la soo koobo, istaraatiijiyadaha badankood ee suuqyada beeraha ayaa socda gaar ahaan si loo yareeyo kharashka wax soo saarka iyo canshuuraha kala duwan.
Dholuo: Kuom ranyisi, thoth yore mag timo ohala e yore mag pur dhi nyime, to moloyo, mondo okony e dwoko chien nengo mag ohala kod osuru mopogore opogore.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free depression awareness support is available through county health facilities in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa uhamasishaji wa unyogovu unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay wacyiga niyadjabku laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Kwale County.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar parruok yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Kwale.

English: These groups are referred through key protection and referral actors in Kenya to receive MPCA as an additional layer to support recovery.
Kiswahili: Makundi haya yanarejelewa kupitia wahusika wakuu wa ulinzi na rufaa nchini Kenya ili kupokea MPCA kama safu ya ziada ya kusaidia uokoaji.
Somali: Kooxahan waxaa loo gudbiyaa iyada oo loo marayo ilaalinta muhiimka ah iyo kuwa loo gudbiyo Kenya si ay u helaan MPCA oo ah lakab dheeraad ah si loo taageero soo kabashada.
Dholuo: Grube gi iorogi kokalo kuom jogo madongo mag rito kendo oorogi e piny Kenya mondo giyud MPCA kaka ng’injo ma medore mar konyo e dwoko piny.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on the community in Mombasa County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa bulshada degmada Mombasa ugu baaqaya inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga iyo inay taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow ee aaminka ah.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oluongo ji duto e county mar Mombasa mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gidwar kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Taita Taveta County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Taita Taveta: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Machi 2023
Somali: Degmada Taita Taveta: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Taita Taveta: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar adek higa mar 2023

English: Notice: KNEC opens applications for revision guides for learners in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay furaysaa codsiyada hagaha dib u eegista ardayda degmada Kilifi.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KNEC oseyawo kwayo mag somo e wi weche mag lokruok ne jopuonjre manie gweng' mar Kilifi.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service promotes organic farming among farmers in Mombasa County as part of the June climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inakuza kilimo hai miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Juni.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa beeraha dabiiciga ah ee beeraleyda degmada Mombasa iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Juun.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo pur mar yien e kind jopur e county mar Mombasa kaka achiel kuom chenro mar dwe mar Jun.
