English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) invites farmers in Kiambu County to a free training on record keeping for farmers this January.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kupata mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima Januari hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Kiambu tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan diiwaangelinta beeralayda bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) ogwelo jopur e county mar Kiambu e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar rito rekod mag jopur dwe mar Januar.

English: Ministry of Health encourages residents of Wajir County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth jiwo jogweng' mar Wajir County mondo kik gisandre gi muol kendo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Medical Association will be held in Migori County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Migori Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Degmada Migori bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma Kenya Medical Association ochano ibiro tim e County mar Migori e dwe mar Agost.

English: NTSA urges residents of Kisii County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika kumbi za umma huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa katika ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo jogweng' Kisii County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'enyie nikech ji medo keto pachgi kuom loso kuwe e piny.

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on the community in Makueni County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Makueni kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqayaa bulshada degmada Makueni inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wacayaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service oluongo oganda manie Makueni County mondo owuo e wi timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: Videos show how youth practice civic actions
Kiswahili: Video zinaonyesha jinsi vijana wanavyofanya matendo ya kiraia
Somali: Fiidiyowyada ayaa muujinaya sida dhalinyaradu u dhaqmaan dhaqdhaqaaqyada bulshada
Dholuo: Vidio nyiso kaka rowere timo timbe mabeyo

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Marsabit County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kumtia moyo rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Marsabit inuu ku dhiirrigeliyo saaxiibkiisa dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar paro e taon mar Marsabit mondo ojiw osiepne moro ma chandore omany kony.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Kisii County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii in si deg deg ah u soo sheegidda tuugada ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne jogweng' Kisii County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo kuom nek konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: KALRO urges cassava growers in Homa Bay County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda cassava ee gobolka Homa Bay inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si loo wanaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur ma pidho maniva e Homa Bay County mondo okaw kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed kelo nyak e higani.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Baringo County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Baringo mwezi Juni huu.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ka dhanka ah degmada Baringo bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Huduma Kenya chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Baringo e dwe mar Jun.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET opens applications for textbooks and learning materials for learners in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inafungua maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay furaysaa codsiyada buugaagta iyo qalabka wax lagu barto ee ardayda ku nool degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar State for TVET oseyawo kwayo mar somo buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok ne jopuonjre man Kisii County.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya activates an emergency response plan for flooding in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya yaanzisha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay hirgelinaysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ku saabsan fatahaadaha Gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chako tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne ataro mar pi e gweng' mar Lamu.

English: Notice: CDC confirms a Rift Valley Fever outbreak alert for Kericho County. Residents are advised to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ilani: CDC inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa kwa Kaunti ya Kericho. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: CDC waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ku saabsan cudurka Rift Valley Fever ee degmada Kericho. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar yedhe (CDC) osenyiso ni Rift Valley Fever osechakore e gweng' mar Kericho, kendo ojiwo jogweng'no mondo otim nonro mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni kodgi.

English: DCI reminds mobile money users in Uasin Gishu County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee gobolka Uasin Gishu inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna si looga fogaado khiyaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: DCI paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e county mar Uasin Gishu ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo kik gitim wuond mar loko SIM.

English: IEBC encourages out-of-school children in Mandera County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Mandera kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Mandera inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e county mar Mandera mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Notice: DCI conducts a community briefing on border security in Uasin Gishu County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DCI inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Wilaya ya Uasin Gishu Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha ee gobolka Uasin Gishu bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: DCI timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Tana River County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the June planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Udhibiti wa Pest Products inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa za kukabiliana na ukame kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Juni.
Somali: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Tana River County inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta ee la caddeeyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Pest Control Products Board nyiso jopur manie Tana River County mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochopo dwe mar Jun.

English: For grains and legumes, harvest when the crop is completely dry; do not dry the harvest on bare soil, but spread a mat and store it in a dry, cool place. If rains are predicted, consider harvesting early and drying quickly.
Kiswahili: Kwa nafaka na mikunde, ni muhimu kuvuna wakati mazao yamekauka kabisa; usikaushe kwenye mchanga, bali tandaza mkeka na hifadhi mavuno katika sehemu kavu na baridi. Ikiwa mvua zinategemewa kunyesha, fikiria kuvuna mapema na kukausha haraka.
Somali: Beeraha iyo dhirta layslaado goosashada markaad dhimanayso, hana ku qalajin dhulka oo aan waxba lahayn, laakiin ku dheji sariir, oo meel qallalan oo qabow ku kaydi.
Dholuo: Ka cham kod yiende otwo, keyo ka cham otwo chuth; kik ipwodhgi e lowo maonge gik moko, to ketgi e lowo motwo kendo iketgi kama ng'ich.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ka furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay ka shaqeynta shahaadada dhalashada degmada Migori.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mar loso nyasi mag nyuol e County mar Migori.

English: Council of Governors encourages first-time voters in Kericho County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawatia moyo wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku dhiirigelinayaan codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Kericho inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo jogweng' mokwongo e County mar Kericho mondo onyis weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: Kenya Price Bulletin, February 2024
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Bei ya Kenya, Februari 2024
Somali: War-saxaafadeedka Qiimaha Kenya, Febraayo 2024
Dholuo: Oboke mar Nengo mar Kenya, dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2024

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages residents of Embu County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay la xiriiraan lataliye la tababaran yahay.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Embu County mondo kik gisandgi gi ling'ling' kendo mondo giwuo gi jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Increase agricultural production in regions less affected by drought to stabilize overall food supply.
Kiswahili: Kuongeza uzalishaji wa kilimo katika mikoa isiyoathiriwa sana na ukame ili kuleta utulivu wa usambazaji wa chakula kwa ujumla.
Somali: Kordhi wax-soo-saarka beeraha ee gobollada aan abaalaha saameyn ku yeelan si loo xasiliyo sahayda guud ee cuntada.
Dholuo: Medruok mar tij pur e gwenge ma kech okethie ahinya mondo omi chiemo obedie e okang' momedore.

English: AFA reminds livestock keepers in Kakamega County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee Gobolka Kakamega inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xadka gobolka iyada oo aan la helin rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: AFA parone jorit jamni e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni kik giting' jamni ka ok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: Notice: IPOA launches a theft prevention campaign in Wajir County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Wajir Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada Gobolka Wajir bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA chako kampen mar geng'o kuo e gweng' mar Wajir e dwe mar Septemba.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Trans Nzoia County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' mar Trans Nzoia County mondo odonj e riwruok mar insuarans mar thieth mondo giyud thieth ma yudo kony.

English: KTDA reminds residents of Kakamega County that conservation tillage improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba kilimo cha uhifadhi kinaboresha tija ya shamba la muda mrefu.
Somali: KTDA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega in beerashada ilaalinta ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: KTDA paronjo jogweng' Kakamega County ni chwoyo puothe e yor ritruok medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Notice: SHA will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: SHA itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: SHA biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag siasa e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: Mosiria urges residents to boycott clubs defying noise rules.
Kiswahili: Mosiria anawahimiza wakazi wa mji huo kughushi vilabu vinavyopinga sheria za kelele.
Somali: Mosiria waxay dadka deggan ugu baaqeysaa inay booykoodaan kooxaha ku xadgudba xeerarka buuqyada.
Dholuo: Mosiria jiwo jogweng'no mondo oriw lwedo weche ma ok luw chike mag goyo koko.

English: EACC urges residents of Kisii County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u soo gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jogweng' Kisii County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo ng'ur mar kedo gi mibadhi mar chulo pesa.

English: Mobile health clinics bring vital prenatal and postnatal services closer to remote communities.
Kiswahili: Kliniki za afya zinazohamishika huleta huduma muhimu za ujauzito na baada ya kujifungua karibu na jamii za mbali.
Somali: Rugta caafimaadka ee mobile-ka ah waxay adeegyada muhiimka ah ee dhalmada ka hor iyo dhalmada kadib u keenaan bulshooyinka fog.
Dholuo: Klinike mag thieth makonyo ji chopo machiegni gi joma odak mabor.

English: Kenya will continue to import fish to address an annual deficit of 350 000 metric tonnes Stakeholders are encouraged to invest in the aquaculture value chain to boost local production
Kiswahili: Kenya itaendelea kuagiza samaki kutoka nje ili kukabiliana na nakisi ya kila mwaka ya tani 350,000 za metric.
Somali: Kenya waxay sii wadi doontaa soo dejinta kalluunka si loo daboolo yaraanta sanadlaha ah ee 350 000 ton metric waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa daneeyayaasha inay maalgashadaan silsiladda qiimaha aquaculture si kor loogu qaado wax soo saarka maxalliga ah
Dholuo: Kenya biro dhi nyime gi kelo rech mondo otiek yuto mar higa ka higa mar ton 350 000

English: Notice: KEMRI will hold a suicide prevention forum in Kajiado County this September. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI itafanya kongamano la kuzuia kujiua katika Kaunti ya Kajiado Septemba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay qabaneysaa madasha ka hortagga ismiidaaminta ee Gobolka Kajiado bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMRI biro timo chokruok mar geng'o ji kik donjre e dwe mar Septemba e Kajiado County.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges eligible citizens in Busia County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Busia kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Guddiga Garsoorka Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Busia inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jokanyo mag county mar Busia mondo oriwre e ndiko joma oyier.

English: Excessive bleeding after childbirth is life-threatening. Seek immediate emergency care.
Kiswahili: Kutokwa na damu nyingi baada ya kujifungua kunahatarisha maisha. Tafuta huduma ya dharura mara moja.
Somali: Dhiigxinta xad dhaafka ah ee dhalashada ka dib waxay khatar ku tahay nolosha.
Dholuo: Bedo gi remo mang'eny bang' nyuol nyalo miyo ng'ato otho.

English: TSC urges youth in Homa Bay County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: TSC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada gobolka Homa Bay inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo rowere manie Homa Bay County mondo onon weche ma gin-go mar ndiko ji kapok gitimo gik ma biro timore ne oganda.

English: Announcement that CHV-led malnutrition screenings will now include mental wellbeing checks.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwamba uchunguzi wa utapiamlo unaoongozwa na CHV sasa utajumuisha uchunguzi wa ustawi wa akili.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida in baaritaannada nafaqada xun ee uu hoggaaminayo CHV ay hadda ku jiri doonaan baaritaano caafimaad maskaxeed.
Dholuo: Owacho ni nonro mar tuoche mag tuoche makelo tuoche ma miyo ng'ato bedo gi tuoche maok thiedhre koro oriwo nono chal mar ng'at ma nigi tuoche mamalo mag obwongo.

English: TSC advises students in Migori County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: TSC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Migori kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya udhamini mtandaoni ili kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Somali: TSC waxay ardayda Degmada Migori kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga deeqda waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan deeq waxbarasho oo loogu talagalay ardayda u baahan.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo jopuonjre mag Migori County mondo oketgi e intanet mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo chiwo mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre mochando.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya launches a fraud prevention campaign in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Maamulka Isgaarsiinta Kenya wuxuu bilaabay olole ka hortagga khiyaamooyinka degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chako kampen mar geng'o mibadhi e taon mar Elgeyo-Marakwet e dwe mar Februar.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit appeals to caregivers in Samburu County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the June maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Samburu kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Juni.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha gobolka Samburu inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka iyada oo qayb ka ah ololaha caafimaadka hooyada ee bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit okwayo jorit e county mar Samburu mondo okel nyithindgi mondo gitim nonro kuom dongruok margi kaka achiel kuom gik ma timore e dwe mar Jun e weche thieth mar mine.

English: KALRO warns maize farmers in Garissa County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaonya wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Garissa juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KALRO waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee Gobolka Garissa cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda ah.
Dholuo: KALRO chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho cham e County mar Garissa kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds youth in Nyamira County that HELB funding is available for ICT skills training.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya dhalinyarada degmada Nyamira in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka xirfadaha ICT.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne rowere man Nyamira County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar lony e yore mag ICT.

English: Notice: NDMA issues a cybersecurity alert on SIM-swap fraud affecting residents of Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogaysiis: NDMA waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaamada SIM-swap ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NDMA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag intanet kuom wuond mag SIM-swap makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e County mar Vihiga.

English: Council of Governors updates residents of Nyandarua County on progress of county development projects this April.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawasilisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua juu ya maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo katika kaunti hii Aprili.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua ku wargeliyaan horumarka mashaariicda horumarinta degmada bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch olero ne jogweng' Nyandarua County dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag county e dwe mar April.

English: E-Citizen updates residents of Samburu County on progress of the county integrated development plan this June.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja ya kaunti hii mwezi Juni.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay dadka deggan degmada Samburu ku wargelineysaa horumarka qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee gobolka bisha Juun.
Dholuo: E-Citizen medo lero ne jood county mar Samburu kaka chenro mar dongruok mar county integrated development dhi nyime e dwe mar Jun.

English: FAO announces a free lumpy skin disease vaccination exercise for poultry in Kitui County this September.
Kiswahili: FAO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa ngozi kwa kuku katika Kaunti ya Kitui Septemba hii.
Somali: FAO waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka maqaarka ee digaagga ee Gobolka Kitui bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: FAO olando ni ibiro tim kampen mar golo tugo mar tuoche mag dhoot e dwe mar Septemba e gweng' mar Kitui.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Tana River County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River in warbixinta degdegga ah ee jabsashada ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross parone jogweng' mar Tana River County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar donjo e odno konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Measles jab drive: Immunization drive to focus on children aged between 9-18 months
Kiswahili: Kichocheo cha chanjo dhidi ya surua: Kichocheo cha chanjo kitalenga watoto wenye umri kati ya miezi 9-18
Somali: Dhiirrigelinta tallaalka: Immunization drive si loo diiradda saaro carruurta da'doodu u dhaxayso 9-18 bilood
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar nyol: riwo mar thiedho nyithindo ma hikgi nie kind dweche 9 kod 18

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds residents of Narok County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan gobolka Narok in ay ka qaybqaataan maamulaha qaybta deegaanka si ay u xoojiyaan maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone jogweng' Narok County ni tudruok gi jotelo mag gwenge maggi miyo sirkal bedo gi loch maber.

English: SHA reminds the public in West Pokot County that input on development planning forums is welcome this February.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kwamba maoni juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo yanakaribishwa Februari hii.
Somali: Shirkadda SHA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka West Pokot in talooyinka ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: SHA oparo ne ji duto e West Pokot County ni paro ma ji chiwo e wi chenro mag dongruok en gima owinjore e dwe mar Februar.

English: NDMA urges residents of Embu County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama katikati ya tahadhari kubwa ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay soo sheegaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo jogweng' Embu County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar sirkal e wi gik ma ne timore e alwora mar tong'gi nikech ji osebedo ka keto pachgi ahinya kuom loso kuwe e piny.

English: Promote moisture conservation technologies, climate-smart agriculture, integrated pest management, post-harvest management, and crop insurance to mitigate the effects of dry conditions and pest infestations.
Kiswahili: Kukuza teknolojia za kuhifadhi unyevu, kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa, udhibiti jumuishi wa wadudu, usimamizi wa baada ya mavuno, na bima ya mazao ili kupunguza athari za hali kavu na mashambulizi ya wadudu.
Somali: Dhiirrigelinta tiknoolajiyada ilaalinta qoyaanka, beeraha cimilada ku habboon, maaraynta cayayaanka isku dhafan, maaraynta goosashada kadib, iyo caymiska dalagga si loo yareeyo saameynta xaaladaha qalalan iyo cayayaanka.
Dholuo: Jiwo teknoloji mag rito yuto, timo pur motudore gi kit yamo, tiyo gi yore mopogore opogore mag rito kodhi, rito kodhi, kod rito kodhi bang' keyo, mondo omi ji okethre gi tuoche ma yudo ji nikech kodhi ma nigi kodhi ma yweyo.

English: KTDA urges farmers in Machakos County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Machakos inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo lagu soo ururiyo biyaha beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Machakos mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: Notice: Universities Fund opens a new electrical installation programme at the vocational centre in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unafungua mpango mpya wa ufungaji wa umeme katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu furayaa barnaamij cusub oo lagu rakibo korontada xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Makueni.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Yunivasiti Fund chako chenro manyien mar keto sitima e kar tiegruok e gweng' mar Makueni.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces outpatient services for residents of Kitui County starting this February.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inatangaza huduma za wagonjwa wa nje kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kuanzia Februari hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay ku dhawaaqday adeegyada bukaanka dibedda ee dadka deggan Gobolka Kitui laga bilaabo Febraayo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche ogolo chenro mar konyo joma odak Kitui County chakre dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: KTDA will distribute certified sweet potatoes seed to farmers in Nyeri County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KTDA itasambaza mbegu zilizothibitishwa za viazi tamu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri mwezi huu wa Novemba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay abuurka baradho macaan oo shahaado leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Nyeri County bisha November ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA biro pogo kodhi mag le mamit ne jopur manie Nyeri County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: TVET announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta dugsiyada bartilmaameedka dhexe ee bilaashka ah ee Baringo County.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET lando tarik mag dhi e tiegruok mar sekondari e skul mag Baringo County.

English: KUCCPS reminds youth in Nairobi County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nairobi in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka mashiinka gawaarida.
Dholuo: KUCCPS oparo ne rowere man Nairobi County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar jomisonari mag mtokni.

English: NPS urges motorists and pedestrians in Kakamega County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NPS inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Kakamega inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada ay fatahan yihiin si looga hortago dhacdooyinka abaarta la xiriira.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo derebe kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Kakamega mondo kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o mondo kik gibed gi masira mar oro.

English: NPS warns residents of Nyeri County to prepare for possible flooding this November.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa mafuriko Novemba hii.
Somali: NPS waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay isu diyaariyaan fatahaadaha iman kara bisha November.
Dholuo: NPS chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nyeri County mondo giikre ne koth maduong' mabiro timore e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on the community in Nyeri County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Nyeri inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross okwayo ji duto manie County mar Nyeri mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gichiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Fertilizer e vouchers for the Long Rain Season are now being distributed Farmers are encouraged to collect their vouchers promptly to ensure timely access to fertilizers
Kiswahili: Vocha za Mbolea za Msimu wa Mvua Mrefu sasa zinasambazwa Wakulima wanahimizwa kukusanya vocha zao mara moja ili kuhakikisha upatikanaji wa mbolea kwa wakati.
Somali: Baucadaha Bacriminta ee xilliyada roobka dheer ayaa hadda la qaybiyaa Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay si dhakhso leh u soo ururiyaan baucusyada si loo hubiyo helitaanka bacriminta waqtigeeda
Dholuo: Yien e voucher mag kinde mag koth maboyo koro ichiwo ne jopur mondo giyud voucher maggi mapiyo mondo omi giyud yien e kinde mowinjore

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Nairobi County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the June planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Juni.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda Gobolka Nairobi inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda ka hor xilliga beerashada Juun.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur e County mar Nairobi mondo otim lokruok e puothe mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber kapok dwe mar auchiel ochopo.

English: KEMSA launches an October awareness campaign on proper sanitation across Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Oktoba juu ya usafi wa mazingira katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: KEMSA waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Oktoobar oo ku saabsan nadaafadda saxda ah ee Gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: KEMSA chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Oktoba e wi thieth mowinjore e County duto mar Nyandarua.

English: KICD calls on the community in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KICD inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: KICD waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: KICD luongo ji duto e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ngima maber e skunde.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) announces eye and dental camps for residents of Kajiado County starting this November.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatangaza kambi za macho na meno kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kuanzia Novemba hii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa ku dhawaaqday xeryo indhaha iyo ilkaha loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Kajiado laga bilaabo bisha November.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) ogolo kambi mag thieth mag wang' kod lak mag lak mag jood Kajiado County kochakore dwe mar Novemba.

English: HELB conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Nandi County this January.
Kiswahili: HELB inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Nandi Januari hii.
Somali: HELB waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan wareejinta gobolka Nandi bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: HELB dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi weche mag golo pesa e gweng' mar Nandi e dwe mar Januar.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Kakamega County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan dhac lagu badbaadinayo xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service oparo ne jogweng' Kakamega County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar nek konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by CDC will be held in Murang'a County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na CDC itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Februari hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabiyeen CDC ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Murang'a bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kampen mar thieth ma onge chudo ma CDC ochano biro timore e County mar Murang'a e dwe mar Februar.

English: TSC advises students in Makueni County to collect materials from the county education office to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: TSC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Makueni kukusanya vifaa kutoka kwa ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali.
Somali: TSC waxay ardayda degmada Makueni kula talineysaa inay ka soo ururiyaan xogta xafiiska waxbarashada degmada si ay u helaan kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah.
Dholuo: TSC nyiso jopuonjre e gweng' mar Makueni mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar tiegruok mar gweng'no mondo gibed gi nyalo mar tiyo gi kompyuta mag skul e bwo chenro mar somo gi somo.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Homa Bay County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kula talineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Homa Bay inay ka soo qayb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e county mar Homa Bay mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English:
How to boost your immune system against the COVID-19;
1. Stay hydrated - drink 3-4 litres of water daily.
2. Take antioxidant-rich diet - amla, guava, green leafy veggies, spinach, garlic, green tea, peppers, turmeric
3. Exercise
4. Meditation
5. Quality sleep
Kiswahili:
Jinsi ya kuimarisha kinga yako dhidi ya COVID-19;
1. Endelea kuwa na maji mwilini - kunywa lita 3-4 za maji kila siku.
2. Chukua lishe yenye vioksidishaji vingi - amla, guava, mboga za majani mabichi, mchicha, kitunguu saumu, chai ya kijani, pilipili hoho, manjano
3. Mazoezi
4. Kutafakari
5. Usingizi bora
Somali: Sida loo xoojiyo nidaamka difaaca jirka ee ka dhanka ah COVID-19; 1. Noqo mid qoyan - cab 3-4 litir oo biyo ah maalin kasta. 2. Qaado cunto antioxidant hodan ah - amla, guava, khudradda caleemaha cagaaran, spinach, basasha, shaaha cagaarka ah, qajaarka, turmeric 3. Jimicsiga 4. Fadhiga 5. Hurdo tayo leh
Dholuo: Kaka inyalo jiwo tuoche mag COVID-19; 1. Bed gi pi mang'we ng'ich - metho gi pi lita 3-4 odiechieng' kodiechieng'. 2. Bed gi chiemo mopong' gi antioxidant - amla, guava, leafy green vegetables, spinach, adundo, green tea, peppers, turmeric 3. Tim tiegruok 4. Meditation 5. Bed gi nindo maber.

English: Notice: TVET announces school feeding programme enrollment dates for schools in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET yatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa programu ya kulisha shule kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiyada degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET landoga tarik mag dhi e skunde mag Kericho mondo giyud thuolo mar dhi e program mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: Notice: IPOA conducts a community briefing on community early-warning systems in Nandi County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Nandi Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho oo ku saabsan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada ee degmada Nandi bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IPOA timo romo mar oganda e wi chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda e kaunti mar Nandi e dwe mar Mei.

English: Reforms at the National Cereals Produce Board NCPB have begun focusing on improving grain storage and stabilizing food supply Stay informed for further updates on these changes
Kiswahili: Marekebisho katika Bodi ya Kitaifa ya Uzalishaji wa Nafaka NCPB yameanza kulenga kuboresha hifadhi ya nafaka na kuleta utulivu wa usambazaji wa chakula Endelea kupata taarifa zaidi kuhusu mabadiliko haya.
Somali: Dib-u-habaynta Guddiga Soo-saarka Badarka Qaranka ee NCPB ayaa bilaabay inay diiradda saarto hagaajinta kaydinta hadhuudhka iyo xasilinta sahayda cuntada. La soco warar dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan isbeddelladan
Dholuo: Lokruoge e National Cereals Produce Board NCPB osechako keto pachgi kuom medo kelo cham e kar kano kod miyo chiemo bedo maber.

English: KMTC invites youth in Kiambu County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this June.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Juni hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kiambu inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista bisha Juun.
Dholuo: KMTC gwelo rowere e Kaunti mar Kiambu mondo odonj e tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing e dwe mar Jun.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Garissa County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Garissa inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur e County mar Garissa mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Notice: KTDA will conduct a greenhouse farming workshop for farmers in Nyandarua County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itafanya warsha ya kilimo cha chafu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo ee beeraleyda gobolka Nyandarua bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA biro timo chokruok mar timo yien e alwora mar Nyandarua County e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service restricts movement of goats in Mandera County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya yazuia harakati za mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Mandera kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa riyaha ee Gobolka Mandera sababtuna tahay faafitaanka cudurka maqaarka.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service ogeng'o wuoth mar diek e county mar Mandera nikech tuwono mar pien.

English: KNEC encourages out-of-school children in Kitui County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Kitui kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Kitui inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee fasallada akhris-xisaabta dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo nyithindo maok dhi e skul e gweng' mar Kitui mondo odonj e program mar somo kod somo mar joma dongo.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will be held in Kiambu County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ay qabanqaabisay qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Kiambu bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma biro bedoe e dwe mar Septemba ma biro e county mar Kiambu.

English: Public notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will host a free food safety outreach in Mandera County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usalama wa chakula bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Mandera Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa qaban doonta barnaamij ammaanka cuntada oo bilaash ah oo lagu qaban doono Degmada Mandera bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo chenro mar chiwo kony maonge chudo mar chiemo e taon mar Mandera e dwe mar Januar.

English: In addition, it also improves timeliness of agricultural operations, increases resource-use efficiency, enhances market access and contributes to mitigating ...
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, pia inaboresha utendakazi wa shughuli za kilimo kwa wakati, huongeza ufanisi wa matumizi ya rasilimali, huongeza upatikanaji wa soko na huchangia kupunguza ...
Somali: Waxa kale oo ay hagaajineysaa waqtiga hawlgallada beeraha, waxay kordhineysaa waxtarka isticmaalka kheyraadka, waxay xoojineysaa helitaanka suuqa waxayna gacan ka geysaneysaa yareynta ...
Dholuo: E wi mano, okonyo e miyo tije mag pur otimre e sa mowinjore, medo tiyo gi mwandu e yo maber, medo yudo thuolo mar dhi e chiro, kendo konyo e geng'o...

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds residents of Tana River County that agroforestry improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kwamba kilimo cha misitu kinaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River in kaynta beeraha ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board parone jogweng' mar Tana River County ni agroforestry miyo puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Kirinyaga County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia laini ya bure ya EACC ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee EACC si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' Kirinyaga County mondo ochiw ripode mag mibadhi kokalo kuom hotline mar EACC maonge chudo mondo giked gi wuond mag yuto.

English: Ministry of Health urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Homa Bay County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kumhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee gobolka Homa Bay inuu ku dhiirrigeliyo saaxiibkiisa dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar paro e Homa Bay County mondo ojiw osiepne moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: Notice: IPOA activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay shilalka waddooyinka ee Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IPOA tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne masiche mag ndara e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: Public notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will host a free tobacco control outreach in Kakamega County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itakuwa mwenyeji wa uhamasishaji wa bure wa kudhibiti tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa qaban doonta dadaal lacag la'aan ah oo ka dhan ah ka hortagga sigaarka ee Gobolka Kakamega bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda: SHA (Social Health Authority) biro timo kampen mar golo ndawa maonge chudo e taon mar Kakamega e dwe mar Januar.

English: KEMRI encourages residents of Garissa County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Garissa inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay u yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Garissa mondo kik gisandgi ka giol kendo giluong kony mar thieth mar paro maonge chudo.

English: Huduma Kenya warns public officers in Kilifi County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Kilifi dhidi ya kutumia vibaya mamlaka.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Kilifi inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e gweng' mar Kilifi ni kik giti marach gi migepegi.

English: Notice: KTDA restricts movement of dairy cows in Taita-Taveta County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA inazuia harakati za ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi wenye uvimbe.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da caanaha ah ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta sababo la xiriira faafitaanka cudurka maqaarka.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok makwayo pi e gweng' mar Taita-Taveta nikech tuoche mag pien.

English: Notice: KTDA will distribute certified sorghum seed to farmers in West Pokot County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: KTDA waxay abuurka sorghum ee shahaadada leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda gobolka West Pokot bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Rapar: KTDA biro pogo kodhi mag sorghum ne jopur e West Pokot County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee maamulayaasha maxalliga ah ay soo saareen xilligan shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji parone jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji e nderni ma sirkal ogolo e kinde masiche mag ndara.

English: FAO urges dairy cows farmers in Mandera County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported foot and mouth disease cases.
Kiswahili: FAO inawataka wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Mandera inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma pidho dhok mag chak e county mar Mandera mondo ochiw ripot ne jamni matuo man machiegni gi kama thieth mar dhok yudoree bang' ka osenyis ni nitie tuoche mag dhoot.

English: SHA reminds the public in Meru County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this February.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Meru kwamba ushiriki katika mashauriano ya sera za umma unakaribishwa Februari hii.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Meru in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: SHA paronwa ji duto manie County mar Meru ni ji duto mor gi chiwo mar paro e wi chenro mag sirkal e dwe mar Februar.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds residents of Busia County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia in ilaalinta ciidda ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jogweng' mar County mar Busia ni rito lowo miyo puodho bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: HELB encourages residents of West Pokot County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: HELB waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan doorka garsoorka.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiego ji mondo ging'e tich mar Ombudsman.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds mobile money users in Narok County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Narok kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee Gobolka Narok in ay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne joma tiyo gi pesa mobil e Narok County ni mondo ging'e kwayo margi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo gitang' gi chenro mag ohala ma miriambo.

English: IEBC announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: IEBC inatangaza nyakati bora za kurejesha huduma za pasipoti katika Wilaya ya Tana River.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee degmada Tana River.
Dholuo: IEBC olando lokruok e seche mag tiyo gi passport e taon mar Tana River County.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health: free antenatal care clinics will run every May at designated health centres in Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya: kliniki za bure za utunzaji wa ujauzito zitaendeshwa kila Mei katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka: rugaha daryeelka dhalmada ee bilaashka ah ayaa laga bilaabi doonaa bishii Maajo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Murang'a.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth: Klinike mag thieth ma onge chudo biro tiyo e dwe mar Mei higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Murang'a.

English: NCPB warns cassava farmers in Kisumu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawaonya wakulima wa manii katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhusu maambukizi ya wadudu na kupendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: NCPB waxay uga digtaa beeraleyda cassava ee degmada Kisumu cudurrada cayayaanka iyo waxay ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: NCPB chiwo siem ne jopur mag cassava e gweng ' mar Kisumu kuom masiche makelo tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Notice: IEBC will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada ee Degmada Migori.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e county mar Migori.
