Kiswahili: Maoni na Ufahamu wa Hivi Karibuni. Maoni na Ufahamu. Kuchunguza juhudi za kilimo cha kidijitali za IFAD katika eneo la Asia-Pasifiki. Kilimo cha kidijitali ni ...
Somali: Fikradaha ugu dambeeyay & aragtiyo. Fikrado & aragtiyaha. Xisaabinta dadaallada beeraha dhijitaalka ah ee IFAD ee gobolka Aasiya iyo Baasifigga. Beeraha dhijitalka ah waa ...
Dholuo: Paro kod weche manyien. Paro kod paro. Ng'ado paro kuom kinda ma IFAD timo e weche mag pur e Asia Pacific.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Nandi County that access to the GBV toll-free helpline is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba upatikanaji wa simu ya GBV ya bure ya msaada unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee Gobolka Nandi in helitaanka khadka caawimaadda ee GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah uu yahay mid bilaash ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu mag nindruok e county mar Nandi ni gibiro yudo kony ma onge chudo mar GBV maonge chudo.

English: NDMA warns residents of Kiambu County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhusu ongezeko la kashfa za pesa za simu na inashauri umma wasiishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: NDMA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu kororka khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobilada waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: NDMA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kiambu County kuom wach medruok mar timbe mag wuondruok gi pesa mag simo kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges beans growers in Migori County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Wanyama inawasihi wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Migori kudhibiti wizi wa jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa za wadudu zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda Degmada Migori in ay horumariyaan weerarkii ciidanka xilliga dayrta iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaanka la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur ma pidho keyo e County mar Migori mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma giyudo ka gitiyo gi tuoche makelo hinyruok mondo okony e loso cham e higani.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone experiencing abuse in Wajir County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Wajir apeleke simu ya simu ya GBV 1195.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Wajir inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo chandruok e gweng' mar Wajir mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: IPOA urges residents of Kirinyaga County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama katikati ya umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga inay soo sheegaan dhaqdhaqaaq aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo la adeegsanayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo jogweng' Kirinyaga County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkande mag sirkal kuom timbe maok kare ma timore e alwora mar tong'gi e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi kuom chenro mag chiwo siem chon.

English: HELB announces distribution of school laptops under the digital literacy programme to schools in Narok County this June.
Kiswahili: HELB inatangaza usambazaji wa kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Narok Juni hii.
Somali: HELB waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada Gobolka Narok bishii Juun.
Dholuo: HELB ogolo chiwo mag laptop mag skul e bwo chenro mar somo gi somo e yore mag digital e skunde mag Narok County e dwe mar Jun.

English: KEMRI announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Marsabit County starting this November.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kuanzia Novemba hii.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa in laga bilaabo bisha November ee la soo dhaafay la siinayo dadka deggan degmada Marsabit.
Dholuo: KEMRI lando ni dhialisi mar ji duto modak Marsabit County biro chakore e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Bomet County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia simu ya EACC ya bure ili kupambana na matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa khadka tooska ah ee EACC si looga hortago xadgudubka xilka.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng' County mar Bomet mondo ochiw ripot kuom weche mag mibadhi kokalo kuom hotline mar EACC maonge chudo mondo giked gi timbe mag tiyo marach gi migepe.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will conduct a modern irrigation techniques workshop for farmers in Nyeri County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itafanya warsha ya kisasa ya mbinu za umwagiliaji kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah ee beeraleyda degmada Nyeri bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Dairy Board biro timo chokruok mar timo nonro e wi yore mag lero pi ne jopur e County mar Nyeri e dwe mar Jun.

English: It is important for expectant mothers to prepare for the coming child to avoid any eventualities
Kiswahili: Ni muhimu kwa akina mama wajawazito kujitayarisha kwa ajili ya mtoto anayekuja ili kuepuka uwezekano wowote
Somali: Hooyooyinka uurka leh waxay u baahan yihiin inay u diyaariyaan ilmaha imanaya si ay uga fogaadaan wax kasta oo dhici kara
Dholuo: Dwarore ni mine ma nigi ich otim ikruok ne nyuol ma biro mondo gitang' gi gimoro amora manyalo timore

English: CDC advises residents of Busia County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: CDC inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma ya afya ya ruzuku.
Somali: CDC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia inay qaataan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo jogweng' County mar Busia mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi ka gidwaro thieth mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai hutoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa soo saaray digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Kwale.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity e wi chenro mag gwelo pesa mag miriambo makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' mar Kwale County.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kisii County that access to psychosocial support is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisaikolojia unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee degmada Kisii in helitaanka taageerada cilmu-nafsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Kisii ni ginyalo yudo kony maonge chudo.

English: TSC reminds parents in Embu County that school feeding programme registration is open this April.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Embu kwamba usajili wa mpango wa kulisha shule umefunguliwa Aprili hii.
Somali: TSC waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Embu in diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga ay furan tahay bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: TSC parone jonyuol e county mar Embu ni chenro mar kwayo nyithindo chiemo e skul ochakore e dwe mar April.

English: EACC reminds the public in Nakuru County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this March.
Kiswahili: EACC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba maoni juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka yanakaribishwa Machi hii.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nakuru in talooyinka dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: EACC oparo ne ji duto e gweng' mar Nakuru ni gik ma ji wacho e wi nonro mar tich mitimo higa ka higa ibiro rwak e dwe mar Mach.

English: ODPP encourages first-time voters in Trans Nzoia County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Trans Nzoia inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo joma okwongo yiero e county mar Trans Nzoia mondo olim kama ichanoe ji ne IEBC machiegni kodgi.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free cyclosporiasis screening is available at all public health centres in Nyeri County this June.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa cyclosporiasis unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Juni hii.
Somali: Shirkadda SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka bilaashka ah ee cyclosporiasis laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaad ee gobolka Nyeri bishii Juun.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji ni nono cyclosporiasis onge tich e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Nyeri e dwe mar Jun.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Wajir County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir inay soo gudbiyaan qoraallo qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga loo dhigay si loo qaabeeyo habka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Wajir mondo ochiw weche mondik kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso bajet mar county ochopo.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will open a coffee collection centre in Vihiga County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itafungua kituo cha kukusanya kahawa katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ka furi doontaa xarun ururinta kafeega degmada Vihiga bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro yawo kama ichokoe chai e County mar Vihiga e dwe mar Desemba.

English: IEBC reminds parents in Nyandarua County that free primary education registration is open this November.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba usajili wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo umefunguliwa Novemba hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Nyandarua in diiwaangelinta bilaashka ah ee waxbarashada hoose ay furan tahay bisha November.
Dholuo: IEBC paronwa jonyuol e County mar Nyandarua ni somo ma piny ne dhi bedo maonge chudo e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Machakos County that access to SHA registration is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba ufikiaji wa usajili wa SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Machakos in hadda la heli karo diiwaangelinta SHA xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth parone ji duto e county mar Machakos ni thuolo mar yudo weche mag SHA sani yudore e kuonde moyier.

English: The PS MoH will issue treated nets in the County of Busia. Increase of malaria in Busia county has reduced by 39%. 22 more Counties are targeted in this campaign in the near future
Kiswahili: Wizara ya afya ya umma itatoa mitandao ya matibabu katika Kaunti ya Busia. Ongezeko la malaria katika kaunti ya busia limepungua kwa 39%. Kaunti nyingine 22 zinalenga katika kampeni hii katika siku zijazo
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Qaranka ayaa soo saari doonta shabagyada lagu daaweeyo Gobolka Busia. Kordhinta Cudurka Cudurrada Busia ayaa hoos u dhacday 39%. 22 Gobol oo kale ayaa lagu beegsanayaa ololahan mustaqbalka dhow
Dholuo: PS Ministry of Health biro golo net mag thieth e County of Busia. medruok mar malaria e county mar Busia osedok chien gi 39%.

English: Kenya Medical Association launches a June awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kizindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Juni juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu bilaabay olole wacyi galineed bishii Juun oo ku saabsan wacyiga cadaadiska sare ee Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Jun e wi wach ng'eyo ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar hypertension e gweng' mar Kakamega.

English: AFA invites farmers in Bomet County to a free training on fertiliser application this April.
Kiswahili: AFA inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya matumizi ya mbolea Aprili hii.
Somali: AFA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda gobolka Bomet tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan isticmaalka bacriminta bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: AFA ogwelo jopur e county mar Bomet e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi tiyo gi yien e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: COMESA will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Baringo County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Baringo Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi diiwaangelinta beeraleyda loogu talagalay beeralayda degmada Baringo bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ranyisi: COMESA biro timo rapar mar jopur e baringo county e dwe mar Januar.

English: KALRO urges sorghum growers in Lamu County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Lamu kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda sorghum ee degmada Lamu inay qaataan noocyo abuurka ah oo abaarta u adkaysta si loo wanaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur mag sorghum e County mar Lamu mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo okony e medo nyak mar yien e higani.

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on residents of Nyamira County to support local peace-building committees in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani kwa msaada wa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Nyamira ugu baaqayaa inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta deegaanka si ay u taageerayaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service okwayo jogweng' Nyamira County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gwenge ma gidakie mondo giriw lwedo chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: Notice: TVET launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay bilawday barnaamij lagu darayo ardayda naafada ah dugsiyada gobolka Laikipia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: TVET chako chenro mar tiego japuonjre ma nigi midekre e skunde duto mag Laikipia County.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds voters in Kwale County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu kuwakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kwale kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya usajili wa wapiga Kura.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa codbixiyayaasha Gobolka Kwale inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor diiwaangelinta codbixisayaasha.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Jorit Maduong' parone jogweng' mar Kwale mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar piny mangima e odiechieng' mar timo yiero ka pok gidonj e register mar joma oyiero.

English: IPOA calls on the community in Nandi County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaita jamii katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Somali: IPOA waxay bulshada degmada Nandi ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow ee aaminka ah.
Dholuo: IPOA okwayo ji duto e county mar Nandi mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gidwar kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: OGP encourages first-time voters in Bomet County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: OGP inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Bomet kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu.
Somali: OGP waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Bomet inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo joma okwongo yiero e county mar Bomet mondo olim kama ichikoe ji ne IEBC.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties urges residents of Homa Bay County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandaoni wa kaunti ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee gobolka si ay u qaabeeyaan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda gobolka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties jiwo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county mar konyo e loso bajet.

English: DCI urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kirinyaga County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: DCI inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Kirinyaga inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: DCI ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e County mar Kirinyaga mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: IEBC encourages first-time voters in Bungoma County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Bungoma inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo josiasa ma ne okwongo yiero e county mar Bungoma mondo oting'e ID kata pasi mar piny mangima e odiechieng' mar yiero.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit announces SHA registration for residents of Taita-Taveta County starting this February.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinatangaza usajili wa SHA kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuanzia Februari hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa ku dhawaaqday diiwaangelinta SHA ee dadka deggan gobolka Taita-Taveta laga bilaabo Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit olando SHA registration ne jogweng' Taita-Taveta County kochakore e dwe mar Februar.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Samburu County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the April planting season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji Aprili.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Samburu inay qaataan noocyo abuurka ah oo abaarta u adkaysta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur e county mar Samburu mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro ka pok ochopo higa mar April.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Garissa County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Garissa inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e gweng' mar Garissa County mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: DCI urges residents of Nairobi County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: DCI inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika kumbi za umma huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa wa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: DCI ojiwo jogweng' Nairobi County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'enyie e bwo sirkal.

English: IEBC encourages out-of-school children in Samburu County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Samburu kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee Gobolka Samburu inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee barnaamijyada quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo nyithindo maok dhi e skul e county mar Samburu mondo odonj e program mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo e bwo program mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: Sore throat, formiting, coughing, body and weight reduction and for an expectant mother, seek for medical attention.
Kiswahili: Maumivu ya mgongo, kutokwa, kikohozi, kupunguza uzito na mwili na kwa mama anayetarajia, tafuta matibabu.
Somali: Xanuunka qoorta, qaniinyada, harqoodka, jirka iyo miisaanka dhimista iyo hooyada uurka leh, raadi daryeel caafimaad.
Dholuo: Nyalo bedo ni ng'ato nigi lit e dhoge, onyalo bedo gi ich, onyalo yuso, onyalo lalo ringre kendo nyalo bedo ni opong' gi pek mang'eny.

English: World Heal Organization in African Region has has thanked WHO in its plan to promote eating well.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Afya Ulimwenguni katika Mkoa wa Afrika limemshukuru WHO katika mpango wake wa kukuza kula vizuri.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Adduunka ee Gobolka Afrika ayaa uga mahadceliyay WHO qorshihiisa kor u qaadista cunto caafimaad.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Piny Mangima Mochung'ne Chango Ji e Piny Afrika osegoyo erokamano ne riwruok mar WHO e chenro mare mar jiwo chiemo maber.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges parents and teachers in Kiambu County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku boorinayaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Kiambu inay u sheegaan maamulka dugsiga wixii dhibaato ah ee ku saabsan amniga.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Kiambu mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar skul e wi weche duto motudore gi ritruok.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Isiolo County this October. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitafanya kongamano la kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Oktoba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa munaasabad dib u soo kabashada isticmaalka maandooriyaha degmada Isiolo bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni Kenya Medical Association biro timo chokruok mar chango joma tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero e taon mar Isiolo e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Tana River County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mto Tana kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada ay fatahaadu ka dhacdo xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne jogweng' mar Tana River County ni kik giwuoth e kind yiengni mag pi kod orujre ma pi opong'o.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Samburu County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the July planting season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Wanyama inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu kudhibiti wizi wa jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa za kuua wadudu zilizokubaliwa kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Julai.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Samburu inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka ciidanka dayrta iyagoo isticmaalaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka July.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development nyiso jopur manie Samburu County mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma giyudo e dwe mar Julai mondo omakgi chon.

English: Government calling on employers to integrate mental wellness supports into occupational safety standards.
Kiswahili: Serikali inatoa wito kwa waajiri kuunganisha usaidizi wa afya ya akili katika viwango vya usalama kazini.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay shaqo-bixiyeyaasha ugu baaqeysaa inay ku darsadaan taageerada caafimaadka maskaxda heerarka badbaadada shaqada.
Dholuo: Sirkal dwaro ni jotelo omed tiyo gi yore mag thieth mar chuny e weche mag ritruok e tich.

English: Two hundred ten Kenyan trainees have been selected for the 2023 Mashav Agricultural Training Program in Israel focusing on practical skills in agriculture
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi mia mbili na kumi wa Kenya wamechaguliwa kwa Mpango wa Mafunzo ya Kilimo wa Mashav wa 2023 nchini Israeli unaozingatia ujuzi wa vitendo katika kilimo.
Somali: Laba boqol iyo toban tababarayaal Kenyan ah ayaa loo doortay Barnaamijka Tababarka Beeraha ee Mashav ee 2023 ee Israel, kaas oo diiradda saaraya xirfadaha dhaqanka ee beeraha
Dholuo: Ji 200 gi 10 ma Kenya oseyier mondo odhi e program mar Mashav Agricultural Training Program e Israel mar 2023 ma jiwo lony e tij pur

English: Ministry of Education announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Turkana County this March.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Turkana Machi hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa ku dhawaaqday qaybinta waxyaabaha waxbarasho ee bilaashka ah ee dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Turkana bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok mar piny owacho olando ni e dwe mar Mach higani ibiro mi skunde mag Turkana thuolo mar somo e yore mag digital.

English: Ministry of Education invites youth in West Pokot County to enroll for electrical installation training this February.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Februari hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku casuumaysaa dhalinyarada degmada West Pokot inay iska diiwaangeliyaan tababarka rakibidda korontada bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education ogwelo rowere e West Pokot County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar keto sitima e dwe mar Februar.

English: TSC encourages out-of-school children in Taita-Taveta County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: TSC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e Taita-Taveta County mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds youth in Tharaka-Nithi County that HELB funding is available for electrical installation training.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka ayaa xasuusinaya dhalinyarada Degmada Tharaka-Nithi in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka rakibidda korontada.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne rowere man Tharaka-Nithi County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar keto sitima.

English: E-Citizen announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inatangaza nyakati bora za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: E-Citizen olando lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mar yudo ID e County mar Kisii.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service conducts a community briefing on community early-warning systems in Makueni County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Makueni mwezi huu wa Novemba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu qabtaa warbixin bulsho ku saabsan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada ee degmada Makueni bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Forest Service timo romo mar oganda e wi chenro mag chiwo siem motelo e alwora mar Makueni County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: IEBC invites youth in Kericho County to enroll for motor vehicle mechanics training this July.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kericho kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari Julai hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kericho inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka mashiinka gawaarida bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: IEBC gwelo rowere e County mar Kericho mondo odonj e tiegruok mar jomisonari mag mtokni e dwe mar Julai.

English: Teachers Service Commission encourages residents of Tana River County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kukaa na habari juu ya jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay ka soo qaybgalaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiego ji mondo ging'e tich mar Ombudsman.

English: KALRO announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for pigs in Kericho County this July.
Kiswahili: KALRO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Kericho Julai hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ka dhan ah qabatinka doofaarka ee Gobolka Kericho bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: KALRO ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar rabies e dwe mar Julai e gweng' mar Kericho.

English: Your mental health care is of great meaning just lijke bodily cure. Take time and investigate yourself. 1. How does your hear feel? 2. Question, do you get enough time to rest? 3. Question, do you eat well? 4. Question, have you taken exercise in the most recent? 5. Question, Are you in need to have a conversation with a counsellor? It is good to remember that, it is great to seek for assistance when you need it. Your good mental health is of great importance to you.
Kiswahili: Huduma yako ya afya ya akili ina maana kubwa tu kama tiba ya kimwili. Chukua wakati na ujichunguze. 1. kusikia kwako huhisije? 2. Swali, unapata muda wa kutosha wa kupumzika? 3. Swala, unakula vizuri? 4. Suala, umefanya mazoezi hivi karibuni? 5. Swali: Je, unahitaji kuzungumza na mshauri? Ni vizuri kukumbuka kwamba ni vizuri kutafuta msaada unapohitaji. Afya yako nzuri ya akili ni muhimu sana kwako.
Somali: Daryeelkaaga caafimaadka dhimirka waa mid aad u muhiim ah oo kaliya sida daaweynta jirka. Waqti qaado oo naftaada baar. 1. Sidee dareemeysaa dhegahaaga? 2. Su'aal, ma haysataa waqti ku filan si aad u nasato? 3. Su'aasha, ma si fiican u cuntaa? 4. Su'aan, jimicsi ma qabatay ugu dambeeyay? 5. Su'aaha, ma u baahan tahay inaad la hadasho lataliye? Waa wanaagsan tahay inaad xusuusato in ay fiican tahay inaad caawimaad raadiso marka aad u baahanta
Dholuo: Penjo: Be iyudo thuolo moromo mar yueyo? 3. Penjo, be ichiemo e yo maber? 4. Penjo - be isetimoga tiegruok e kinde mokalo? 5. Penjo; Be dwarore ni iwuo gi jang'ad rieko? Ber paro ni en gima ber manyo kony sama idwaro.

English: COMESA informs milk farmers in Mandera County of new market linkage opportunities this September.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawafahamisha wakulima wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Mandera juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Septemba hii.
Somali: COMESA waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda caanaha ee degmada Mandera fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: COMESA nyiso jopur mag chak e county mar Mandera thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on the community in Meru County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawataka jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Meru kuongea dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Meru inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wacayaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross kwayo ji duto manie County mar Meru mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: Universities Fund advises students in Nairobi County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ardayda degmada Nairobi kula talinayaa inay dalbadaan bogga deeqda waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan deeq waxbarasho oo loogu talagalay ardayda u baahan.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund nyiso jopuonjre e County mar Nairobi mondo okonygi kokalo kuom websait mar somo ma yudore e intanet mondo giyud kony kuom jopuonjre mochando.

English: Kenya Gazette advises residents of Makueni County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette nyiso jogweng' Makueni County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom websait mar e-Citizen sama gidwaro kwayo mag ID.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the community in Baringo County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb theft.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Baringo inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto manie Baringo County mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo kik gikwed nek.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Narok County that access to subsidised dialysis is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Narok kwamba upatikanaji wa dialysis ya ruzuku sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Narok in helitaanka dialysis-ka la taageeray ay hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone ji duto manie Narok County ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mar dialysis e kuonde moyier.

English: NTSA urges residents of Bungoma County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gweng'no e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi kuom rito tong'.

English: Blue band has started a campaign in Nairobi Town
Kiswahili: Blue Band imeanza kampeni mjini Nairobi
Somali: Kooxda Blue Band waxay bilaabeen olole magaalada Nairobi
Dholuo: Blue Band osechako kampen e taon mar Nairobi

English: The government has imposed a raft of new drastic measures after cases of the new coronavirus in Kenya jumped to 15 in the last 72 hours. The new directives came after eight more people tested positive for COVID-19
Kiswahili: Serikali imeweka hatua kadhaa kali baada ya visa vya virusi vipya vya korona nchini Kenya kupanda hadi 15 katika saa 72 zilizopita. Maagizo hayo mapya yalikuja baada ya watu wengine wanane kupimwa na kupatikana na COVID-19.
Somali: Dowladda Kenya ayaa soo saartay tallaabooyin cusub oo adag kadib markii kiisaska coronavirus-ka cusub ee Kenya ay kor u kaceen 15 saacadood ee la soo dhaafay. Tilmaamaha cusub waxay yimaadeen ka dib markii siddeed qof oo kale ay ku baareen COVID-19
Dholuo: Sirkal oseketho chenro manyien mag thieth bang' ka kwan mar ji ma nigi tuo mar corona e piny Kenya osemedore mochopo 15 e seche 72 mokalo.

English: Notice: DCI conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this August.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada ku saabsan dhismaha nabadda qaranka ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni DCI dhi timo romo mar oganda e dwe mar Agost e Elgeyo-Marakwet County.

English: Daily activities plan for brain building
Kiswahili: Mpango wa utendaji wa kila siku wa kujenga ubongo
Somali: Qorshaha waxqabadka maalinlaha ah ee dhismaha maskaxda
Dholuo: Chenro mar timo gik moko e odiechieng' kodiechieng' mondo okony ng'ato obed gi obwongo maber

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges residents of Homa Bay County to avoid contact with contaminated water sources following a rise in reported cholera cases.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya kipindupindu vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha ee wasakheysan ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska cudurka kolera ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo owe tudruok gi kuonde ma pi yudoree nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuwo mar cholera osemedore.

English: Governor Joho has constructed mobile toilets for pedesterians in Mombasa
Kiswahili: Gavana Joho amejenga vyoo vinavyohamishika kwa ajili ya watembea kwa miguu mjini Mombasa
Somali: Guddoomiye Joho ayaa dhisay musqusha dhaqdhaqaaqa ee dadka socotada ah ee Mombasa
Dholuo: Jaloch Joho oseloso kuonde tedo moting'o piende ne jowuoth e Mombasa

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Kisumu County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Kisumu inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pach e County mar Kisumu mondo omany japuonj molony.

English: DPP calls on the community in Nandi County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: DPP inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Nandi kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Somali: DPP waxay bulshada degmada Nandi ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga iyo inay kaalmo ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: DPP okwayo ji duto e county mar Nandi mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gidwar kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Public notice: KEMSA will host a free diabetes screening outreach in Wajir County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMSA itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uchunguzi wa kisukari bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Wajir Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: KEMSA waxay marti gelineysaa baaritaan bukaan-socodka oo bilaash ah oo lagu ogaanayo cudurka macaanka ee Gobolka Wajir bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMSA biro timo kampen mar nono tuo mar sukari maonge chudo e dwe mar Agost e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: Notice: KUCCPS announces school feeding programme enrollment dates for schools in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa programu ya kulisha shule kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiyada degmada Bomet.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KUCCPS ogolo chenro mar somo e skunde mag Bomet County.

English: Notice: DPP activates an emergency response plan for flooding in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DPP inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ku saabsan fatahaadaha ka jira degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Rapar: DPP tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne pi opong'o gweng' mar Siaya.

English: Notice: FAO will distribute certified beans seed to farmers in Kajiado County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itasambaza mbegu za maharagwe zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kajiado Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay abuurka xoolaha ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda gobolka Kajiado bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: FAO biro pogo kodhi mag nyinyo ne jopur man Kajiado County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free suicide prevention support is available through county health facilities in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kuzuia kujiua unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageerada ka hortagga ismiidaaminta ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji ni kony mar geng'o ji kik donj e kend yudore nono kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e Kisumu County.

English: Kenya Gazette invites residents of Kisii County to attend the public participation forum regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay ka qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la xiriira wadatashiyada siyaasadda guud.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette gwelo ji duto modak e County mar Kisii mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi weche siasa.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges cattle farmers in Kajiado County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda lo'da ee degmada Kajiado inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha lagu burburiyo ee loo qoondeeyay ka dib kiisaska cudurka anthrax ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products jiwo jopur mag jamni e Kajiado County mondo ogeng'gi e kuonde moyier mag chwoyo jamni bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag anthrax.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free typhoid screening is available at all public health centres in Nyandarua County this May.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa matumbo bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Mei hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka tifooska ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee Gobolka Nyandarua bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: KEMSA oparo ne ji ni thieth mar typhoid ma onge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Nyandarua e dwe mar abich.

English: FAO reminds livestock keepers in Makueni County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Makueni inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyaga oo aan haysan rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: FAO parone jopur mag jamni e gweng' mar Makueni mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni kuonde mopogore opogore maok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: NDMA reminds mobile money users in Machakos County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Machakos wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Machakos inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna si looga fogaado fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: NDMA paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e gweng' mar Machakos ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo gitang' gi weche mag phishing.

English: IEBC reminds residents of Narok County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Narok in ay ku hawlan yihiin maamulaha qaybta deegaanka si ay u xoojiyaan maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: IEBC parone jokanyo mag Narok County ni tiyo gi jorit kargi e jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: DPP warns residents of Lamu County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: DPP inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu juu ya kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: DPP waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu kororka qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: DPP chiwo siem ne jogweng' Lamu County e wi medruok mar chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok kare ne jatendgi.

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages residents of Taita-Taveta County not to suffer in silence and to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Taita-Taveta inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay la xiriiraan lataliye la tababaran yahay.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo kik gisandre aling' ling' kendo mondo giwuo gi jang'ad rieko molony.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET reminds citizens in West Pokot County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda TVET waxay muwaadiniinta gobolka West Pokot ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar State for TVET parone raia mag West Pokot County kuom ratiro ma gin-go e wi ratiro mag chik.

English: IPOA urges residents of Nandi County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida katika maeneo ya mpakani kwa vyombo vya usalama huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa katika ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nandi inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo jogweng' kaunti mar Nandi mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar sirkal e wi gik ma ne timore e alwora mar tong'gi nikech ji osebedo ka keto pachgi ahinya kuom loso kuwe e piny.

English: Notice: FAO will open a milk collection centre in Vihiga County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya maziwa katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay furaysaa xarun lagu uruurinayo caanaha degmada Vihiga bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: FAO biro yawo kama ichokoe chak e County mar Vihiga e dwe mar Februar.

English: Council of Governors urges residents of Murang'a County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on community-based development programmes.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waweze kuwa na habari juu ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku boorinayaan dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay la shaqeeyaan maamulayaasha degmooyinkooda si ay uga warqabaan barnaamijyada horumarinta ee ku saleysan bulshada.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Murang'a mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jotelo mag utegi mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi chenro mag dongruok mag oganda.

English: NDMA warns residents of Embu County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu juu ya kuongezeka kwa kashfa za pesa za rununu na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: NDMA waxay ka digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu oo ku saabsan kororka khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga leh bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: NDMA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Embu County e wi medruok mar timbe mag wuondo pesa e yor simo kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok kare ne jatendgi.

English: KRA reminds residents of Migori County that access to national ID applications is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Migori kwamba kufikia maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Migori in helitaanka codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: KRA parone jogweng' Migori County ni yudo kwayo mag ID mar piny sani yot moloyo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges residents of Kwale County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca bogga internetka ee degmada si ay uga warqabaan bixinta adeegyada degmada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General jiwo jogweng' Kwale County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche ma timore e wi tij lendo.

English: Kenya Dairy Board invites farmers in Meru County to a free training on fertiliser application this November.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru kutoa mafunzo ya bure juu ya matumizi ya mbolea Novemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa ku casuumay beeraleyda degmada Meru inay tababar lacag la'aan ah ku helaan isticmaalka bacriminta bisha November.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board ogwelo jopur e county mar Meru e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi tiyo gi yien e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Council of Governors urges residents of Embu County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandaoni wa kaunti ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha waxay ku boorinayaan dadka deggan degmada Embu inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Council of Governors jiwo jood county mar Embu mondo oriwre gi county's online participation portal e loso chenro mar bajet mar county.

English: Notice: NDMA launches a theft prevention campaign in Lamu County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Lamu Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada degmada Lamu bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA chako kampen mar geng'o kuo e County mar Lamu e dwe mar Desemba.

English: KUCCPS urges youth in Laikipia County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Laikipia inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada rayidka ah ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada rayidnimada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo rowere e County mar Laikipia mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok ochopo tije mag oganda.

English: OGP encourages first-time voters in Nyeri County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: OGP inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu.
Somali: OGP waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Nyeri inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogo madwaro yiero mokwongo e county mar Nyeri mondo olim kama ichanoe ji mar IEBC machiegni kodgi.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kericho County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kericho Mei hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ka dhanka ah degmada Kericho bisha May.
Dholuo: Rieko: Huduma Kenya chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Kericho e dwe mar Mei.

English: E-Citizen reminds voters in Bungoma County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya kujiandikisha.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Bungoma inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor diiwaangelinta codbixisayaasha.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero kapok gidonjo e register mar joma oyiero.

English: Notice: AFA will open an avocado collection centre in Kitui County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itafungua kituo cha kukusanya parachichi katika Kaunti ya Kitui Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay ka furi doontaa xarun ururinta avocado ee Gobolka Kitui bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: AFA biro yawo ot mar choko avocado e gweng' mar Kitui e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: State Department for TVET reminds parents in Makueni County that free day secondary education registration is open this September.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba usajili wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo umefunguliwa Septemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Makueni in diiwaangelinta dugsiga dhexe ee bilaashka ah ay furan tahay bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET oparo ne jonyuol manie Makueni County ni somo mar sekondari mar odiechieng' ma onge chudo osechakore e dwe mar Septemba.

English: NPS reminds residents of Garissa County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Garissa inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada daadadka ka dhacay xilligan fatahaadda.
Dholuo: NPS parone jogweng' mar County mar Garissa ni kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o e kinde mag koth.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on residents of Siaya County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of border security.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inatoa wito kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika kumbi za umma ili kuunga mkono usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ugu baaqay dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay la shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations okwayo ji duto modak e county mar Siaya mondo oriwgi lwedo e nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'adoe bura.

English: IPOA urges the public in Lamu County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: IPOA inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za kashfa za pesa za rununu.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Lamu inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada lacagta mobilada.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo ji duto e County mar Lamu mondo onyis kwayo margi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma ne oland kuom wuond mag pesa mitimo gi simo.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds residents of Uasin Gishu County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu in ilaalinta ciidda ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development oparo ne jogweng' Uasin Gishu County ni rito lowo miyo puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: OGP reminds residents of Makueni County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: OGP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: OGP parone jogweng' Makueni County ni luwo dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Kenya Medical Association launches an October awareness campaign on hand hygiene across West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kizindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Oktoba juu ya usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi.
Somali: Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya ayaa bilaabay olole Oktoobar ah oo wacyiga ah oo ku saabsan nadaafadda gacmaha ee Gobolka West Pokot.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Oktoba e wi ler mar lwete e West Pokot County.

English: KEMRI launches a December awareness campaign on safe water storage across Mandera County.
Kiswahili: KEMRI yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Desemba juu ya uhifadhi wa maji salama katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: KEMRI waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Diseembar oo ku saabsan kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee Gobolka Mandera.
Dholuo: KEMRI chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Desemba kuom wach kano pi maler e gweng' mar Mandera.

English: Honor innovators 2025.
Kiswahili: Waheshimu Wabunifu 2025.
Somali: Maamulitaanka hal-abuurnimada sanadka 2025.
Dholuo: Chiw luor ne joma loso gik manyien e higa mar 2025.

English: FAO advises farmers in Garissa County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: FAO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: FAO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Garissa inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kalfadhiga tababarka ee bilaashka ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Garissa mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e tiego jopur mabiro.

English: NCPB announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for sheep in Kisii County this July.
Kiswahili: NCPB inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Kisii Julai hii.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ka dhan ah qabyaalada idaha ee degmada Kisii bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: NCPB olando chenro mar goyo rombe thieth mar rabies maonge chudo e dwe mar Julai e County mar Kisii.

English: Community health volunteers gather with social distancing measures to receive training on how to prevent COVID-19 in their communities, in Nyamira county courtesy of County Public Health promotion team. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Wafanyakazi wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii hukusanyika kwa hatua za umbali wa kijamii kupokea mafunzo kuhusu jinsi ya kuzuia COVID-19 katika jamii zao, katika kaunti ya Nyamira kwa hisani ya timu ya uhamasishaji ya Afya ya Umma ya Kaunti. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada ayaa isugu yimaada tallaabooyin kala fogeyn bulsho si ay u helaan tababar ku saabsan sida looga hortago COVID-19 bulshooyinkooda, degmada Nyamira oo ay soo qabanqaabisay kooxda horumarinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha ee Degmada. #KomeshaCorona

English: Notice: NDMA issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA imetoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa utambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka ah oo ku saabsan xadgudubka aqoonsiga ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi.
Dholuo: Rapar: NDMA ogolo siem mar ritruok mar weche mag intanet kuom wach kuo mar ng'ato makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e Tharaka-Nithi County.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development urges residents of Tana River County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River County inay iska diiwaangeliyaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan barnaamijyada quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo odonj e program mar puonjo jomadongo mondo giyud ber kuom program mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: Kilifi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kilifi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2022
Somali: Degmada Kilifi: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kilifi: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar adek higa mar 2022

English: NCPB advises farmers in Marsabit County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the November planting season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Novemba.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Marsabit inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Nofeembar.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e county mar Marsabit mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochopo dwe mar Novemba.

English: Educate students! Teach fire safety in schools.
Kiswahili: Waelimishe wanafunzi! Wafundishe usalama wa moto shuleni.
Somali: Waxbarashada ardayda! Waxbaridda badbaadada dabka ee dugsiyada.
Dholuo: Pwony lutino kwan! Pwony gwok i kom mac i cukul.

English: Pest Control Products Board invites farmers in Isiolo County to a free training on modern irrigation techniques this January.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji Januari hii.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka waxay ku casuumaysaa beeraleyda degmada Isiolo tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok Golo gwelo jopur e gweng' mar Isiolo e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi yore mag lero pi e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Kwale County.
