Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Kericho Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ku saabsan ka hortagga argagixisada ee degmada Kericho bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji (Communications Authority of Kenya) timo romo mar oganda e dwe mar April e gweng' mar Kericho.

English: KRA invites residents of West Pokot County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: KRA inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya West Pokot kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: KRA waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee la xiriira wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KRA gwelo ji modak e West Pokot County mondo oriwre kodgi ka gitiyo gi websait mar county's online participation portal e wi chenro mag siasa.

English: KEPHIS warns sweet potatoes farmers in Siaya County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawaonya wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Siaya juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay uga digtay beeraleyda baradho macaan ee degmada Siaya cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda ah.
Dholuo: KEPHIS chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho adundo e county mar Siaya kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Nakuru County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on community-based development programmes.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' Nakuru County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono ka gitiyo gi websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mag dongruok mag oganda.

English: NGEC promotes public dialogue on gender equality and anti-discrimination laws.
Kiswahili: NGEC huendeleza mazungumzo ya umma juu ya usawa wa kijinsia na sheria za kupambana na ubaguzi.
Somali: NGEC waxay dhiirrigelisaa wadahadalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan sinnaanta jinsiga iyo sharciyada ka hortagga takoorka.
Dholuo: NGEC jiwo ji mondo owuo e wi wach bedo machal e kind dichwo gi dhako kod chike makedo gi timbe mag buono ji.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Kisumu County starting this August.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kuanzia Agosti hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa in laga bilaabo bisha Agoosto ee soo socota la siinayo dadka deggan degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche ogolo chik mar keto thieth mar dialysis kuom joma odak e County mar Kisumu kochakore Agost ma kawuono.

English: District Commissioners and Agricultural officials in Arusha Kilimanjaro Manyara and Tanga regions must identify areas for productive agriculture livestock and fisheries
Kiswahili: Wakuu wa Wilaya na Maafisa Kilimo mkoani Arusha Kilimanjaro Manyara na Tanga waainishe maeneo ya kilimo chenye tija mifugo na uvuvi.
Somali: Guddoomiyeyaasha degmooyinka iyo mas'uuliyiinta beeraha ee gobollada Arusha, Kilimanjaro, Manyara iyo Tanga waa inay aqoonsadaan meelaha wax soo saarka beeraha, xoolaha iyo kalluumaysiga
Dholuo: Jokomiseche mag Distrikt kod jotelo mag Tij Lemo e Arusha Kilimanjaro Manyara kod Tanga onego oyier kuonde ma ginyalo pidhogo jamni kod rech

English: NDMA calls on residents of Kwale County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of border security.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: NDMA waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga waxqabadka aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah si ay u taageeraan amniga xuduudda.
Dholuo: NDMA okwayo jogweng' mar Kwale County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ma rito tong'o ni gitimo gik maok kare e alworano.

English: IEBC urges parents and teachers in Nandi County to support inclusive learning environments.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Nandi kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Nandi inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban dadka.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Nandi mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto.

English: Notice: AFA will train farmers in Murang'a County on terracing this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Murang'a juu ya terracing Machi hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: AFA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Murang'a ku saabsan dhulka ku yaal bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: AFA biro tiego jopur e County mar Murang'a e wi terracing e dwe mar Mach.

English: Never shake a baby. It can cause brain injury or death. Comfort them gently instead.
Kiswahili: Usimtikise mtoto kamwe. Inaweza kusababisha jeraha la ubongo au kifo. Badala yake mfariji kwa upole.
Somali: Weligaa ha gariirin ilmaha, wuxuu keeni karaa dhaawac maskaxeed ama geeri.
Dholuo: Kik igeng' nyathi nikech onyalo hinyore e obwongo kata thone.

English: KTDA advises farmers in Nyeri County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the October planting season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri watumie viwango vinavyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa kupanda Oktoba.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Degmada Nyeri inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e County mar Nyeri mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Oktoba.

English:
What do you do to prioritize mental health?
Talking about it is a great first step.
Kiswahili:
Unafanya nini ili kuweka kipaumbele afya ya akili?
Kuzungumzia kuhusu hilo ni hatua nzuri ya kwanza.
Somali: Waa maxay waxa aad sameyneyso si aad u mudnaato caafimaadka maskaxda?
Dholuo: Ang'o minyalo timo mondo iket ngima mar ng'ato obed motelo?

English: NCPB reminds farmers in Nakuru County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Somali: NCPB waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nakuru barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada.
Dholuo: NCPB oparo ne jopur e Kaunti mar Nakuru chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche.

English: Geographic prioritisation in Kenya and Uganda: a power analysis of donor transition
Kiswahili: Uwekaji kipaumbele wa kijiografia nchini Kenya na Uganda: uchanganuzi wa nguvu wa mpito wa wafadhili
Somali: Mudnaanta Juqraafiyeed ee Kenya iyo Uganda: falanqayn awoodeed oo ku saabsan kala-guurka deeq-bixiyeyaasha
Dholuo: Keto mokuongo e piny Kenya kod Uganda: nonro mar teko mar lokore mar jochiw kony

English: Notice: NCPB will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Nandi County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi loogu talagalay beeraleyda ku nool gobolka Nandi bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Nonro: NCPB biro timo rapar mar jokwang'o puothe mag jopur e kaunti mar Nandi e dwe mar Januar.

English: NTSA calls on the community in Embu County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Embu kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: NTSA waxay bulshada degmada Embu ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: NTSA luongo ji duto e county mar Embu mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gichiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: COMESA promotes water harvesting among farmers in Laikipia County as part of the December climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: COMESA inakuza uvunaji wa maji miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Desemba.
Somali: COMESA waxay dhiirrigelisay goosashada biyaha beeraleyda degmada Laikipia iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka iska caabinta cimilada ee Diseembar.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo tij choko pi e kind jopur e County mar Laikipia kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo kinda mar kedo gi lokruok e kit yamo e dwe mar Desemba.

English: NTSA alerts residents of Bomet County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: NTSA waxay dadka deggan degmada Bomet uga digtay kororka kiisaska tuugada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne ji modak e County mar Bomet kuom wach kwan mar joma okwalo gik moko kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: The failure of the short rains, combined with reduced assistance, constrained livelihoods, reliance on expensive markets, has significantly deteriorated food security across ASAL counties.
Kiswahili: Kushindwa kwa mvua fupi, pamoja na usaidizi uliopunguzwa, maisha duni, kutegemea masoko ya bei ghali, kumezorotesha sana usalama wa chakula katika kaunti zote za ASAL.
Somali: Roobabkii gaabnaa ee da'ay, oo ay weheliso gargaarkii oo yaraada, maciishada oo yaraaday, ku tiirsanaanta suuqyada qaaliga ah, ayaa si weyn u xumeeyay amniga cuntada ee degmooyinka ASAL.
Dholuo: Kuong’ruok mar koth machuok, kaachiel gi dwoko piny kony, geng’ruok mar ngima, geno kuom chiro ma nigi nengo mamalo, osemiyo yudo chiemo odok piny ahinya e gwenge duto mag ASAL.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds needy students in Migori County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Migori kwamba maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya ardayda u baahan Degmada Migori in deeqaha waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay codsiyada ardayda baahan ay dhowaan dhammaadaan.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne jopuonjre modhier e County mar Migori ni tuke mag somo ma konyo jopuonjre madwaro dhi e tiegruok biro rumo machiegni.

English: Notice: e-Citizen launches the county integrated development plan in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika wilaya ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis: e-Citizen waxay bilawday qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Migori.
Dholuo: Rapar: e-Citizen chako chenro mar dongruok mar county integrated development e county mar Migori.

English: NCPB advises farmers in Nandi County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuleta nambari yao ya usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nandi inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qaybqaataan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur manie County Nandi mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: Hypertention during pregnancy can cause multiple medical complications. Frequent clinical check ups is important in understanding any developing problem for timely management
Kiswahili: Mkazo wa shinikizo la damu wakati wa ujauzito unaweza kusababisha matatizo mengi ya kitiba. Uchunguzi wa kliniki wa mara kwa mara ni muhimu ili kuelewa tatizo lolote linalotokea kwa ajili ya matibabu ya wakati unaofaa
Somali: Cadaadiska dhiig karka inta lagu jiro uurka wuxuu sababi karaa dhibaatooyin caafimaad oo badan.
Dholuo: Medruok mar remo e kinde mag ich nyalo kelo chandruoge mang'eny mag thieth.

English: Isiolo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Isiolo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Mei 2024
Somali: Degmada Isiolo: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maajo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Isiolo: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Mei 2024

English: Climate shocks, including recurring droughts and floods, are intensifying existing vulnerabilities and eroding household resilience.
Kiswahili: Matukio ya hali ya hewa, ikiwa ni pamoja na ukame na mafuriko ya mara kwa mara, yanazidisha udhaifu uliopo na kumomonyoa ustahimilivu wa kaya.
Somali: Dhibaatooyinka cimilada, oo ay ku jiraan abaaraha soo noqnoqda iyo daadadka, ayaa sii xoojinaya nuglaanta jirta waxayna baabi'inayaan adkeysiga qoysaska.
Dholuo: Gik ma kelo luoro e piny, moriwo nyaka oro kod yamo ma pong’o piny, medo bedo gi pek ma osebedo ka nitie kendo ketho nyalo mar udi mondo kik ochung’ motegno.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds residents of West Pokot County that water harvesting improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kwamba uvunaji wa maji unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot in soo-saarka biyaha uu hagaajinayo waxsoosaarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service parone jogweng' mar West Pokot County ni choko pi miyo puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: NCPB warns coffee farmers in Makueni County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawaonya wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuhusu maambukizi ya wadudu na kupendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: NCPB waxay uga digtaa beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Makueni cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyin waqtigeeda ah.
Dholuo: NCPB chiwo siem ne jopur ma loso chai e kaunti mar Makueni kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni otim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Huduma Kenya updates residents of Baringo County on progress of community-based development programmes this May.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuhusu maendeleo ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii mwezi Mei huu.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay dadka deggan degmada Baringo ku wargelineysaa horumarka barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada ee bisha May.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya osemiyo jogweng' Baringo ong'eyo dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag oganda e dwe mar abich.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) launches an October awareness campaign on food safety across Busia County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Oktoba juu ya usalama wa chakula katika Kaunti ya Busia.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Oktoobar oo ku saabsan amniga cuntada ee degmada Busia.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Oktoba e wi wach ritruok mar chiemo e gweng' mar Busia.

English: Households in East and Southern Africa are experiencing persistent high cooking oil prices due to market concentration and weak competition regulation Stakeholders are advised to monitor market conditions and advocate for improved regulatory frameworks
Kiswahili: Kaya katika Afrika Mashariki na Kusini mwa Afrika zinakabiliwa na bei ya juu ya mafuta ya kupikia kutokana na mkusanyiko wa soko na udhibiti dhaifu wa ushindani Wadau wanashauriwa kufuatilia hali ya soko na kutetea kuboreshwa kwa mifumo ya udhibiti.
Somali: Guriyada Bariga iyo Koonfurta Afrika waxay la kulmaan qiimaha sare ee saliidda karinta ee joogtada ah sababtoo ah xaddidaadda suuqa iyo xakameynta tartanka ee daciifka ah.
Dholuo: Joot e pinje mag East kod Southern Africa yudo nengo mag mafuta ma ng'ato nyalo chamo nikech chungo mar ohandgi kod chike mag piem ma ok kare.

English: COMESA advises maize producers in Meru County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inashauri wazalishaji wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Meru kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: COMESA waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha hadhuudhka ee degmada Meru inay ka iibsadaan wax soo saarka kaliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: COMESA nyiso jopur mag cham e county mar Meru ni giusgi mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo cham kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Kilifi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for November 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kilifi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Novemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Kilifi: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Noofambar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kilifi: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2022

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public in Kwale County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kwale in adeegyada bukaanka dibedda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji duto man Kwale County ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mag ambulatori e kuonde moyier.

English: SHA reminds residents of Tana River County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: SHA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Tana River ambao huhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa wilaya huimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River in ka qaybgalka kalfadhiga guud ee shirka degmada uu xoojiyo maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: SHA paronwa jogweng' mar Tana River County ni dhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly jiwo sirkal.

English: NCPB advises farmers in Nairobi County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nairobi inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qayb galaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e County mar Nairobi mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: Samburu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Samburu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2024
Somali: Degmada Samburu: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Samburu: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar apar 2024

English: Tana River County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for December 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tana River: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Desemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Tana River: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Diseembar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Aora Tana: Oboke mar Chik Motelo kuom Oro mar Desemba 2022

English: KALRO invites farmers in Samburu County to a free training on post-harvest handling this February.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno Februari hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda gobolka Samburu tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan ka shaqeynta goosashada ka dib bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: KALRO ogwelo jopur e county mar Samburu e tiegruok ma onge chudo e dwe mar Februar.

English: NTSA warns residents of Turkana County about a rise in identity theft and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana juu ya kuongezeka kwa wizi wa kitambulisho na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: NTSA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana in ay ka badan yihiin dhacda aqoonsiga waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Turkana County e wi medruok mar kuo mar kitgi kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English:
How to boost your immune system against the COVID-19;
1. Stay hydrated - drink 3-4 litres of water daily.
2. Take antioxidant-rich diet - amla, guava, green leafy veggies, spinach, garlic, green tea, peppers, turmeric
3. Exercise
4. Meditation
5. Quality sleep
Kiswahili: Jinsi ya kuimarisha mfumo wako wa kinga dhidi ya COVID-19; 1. Kaa unyenyekevu - kunywa lita 3-4 za maji kila siku. 2. Chukua lishe yenye utajiri wa antioxidant - amla, guava, mboga za majani ya kijani, spinach, vitunguu, chai ya kijivu, pilipili, turmeric 3. Mazoezi 4. Kutafakari 5. Usingizi wa ubora
Somali: Sida loo xoojiyo nidaamka difaaca jirka ee ka dhanka ah COVID-19; 1. Noqo mid qoyan - cab 3-4 litir oo biyo ah maalin kasta. 2. Qaado cunto antioxidant hodan ah - amla, guava, khudradda caleemaha cagaaran, spinach, basasha, shaaha cagaarka ah, qajaarka, turmeric 3. Jimicsiga 4. Fadhiga 5. Hurdo tayo leh

English: DCI urges anyone experiencing abuse in Machakos County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: DCI inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.

Dholuo: DCI jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e gweng' mar Machakos mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: E-Citizen reminds the public in Nyamira County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this January.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba ushiriki katika mashauriano ya sera za umma unakaribishwa Januari hii.

Dholuo: E-Citizen oparo ne ji duto e County mar Nyamira ni ji duto mor gi chiwo mag paro e wi chenro mag sirkal e dwe mar Januar.

English: Even when failures are not sudden or catastrophic, prolonged heat can gradually weaken thereliability, efficiency and resilienceof essential services.
Kiswahili: Hata kama kushindwa si kwa ghafla au janga, joto la muda mrefu linaweza kudhoofisha utegemezi, ufanisi na uthabiti wa huduma muhimu hatua kwa hatua.

English: Public health advisory: Kenya Red Cross warns of increased typhoid risk in Mombasa County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya homa ya matumbo katika Kaunti ya Mombasa na kushauri umma kutumia vyandarua vilivyotiwa dawa za kuua wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Warbixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ka digeysaa khatarta sii kordheysa ee cudurka 'typhoid' ee gobolka Mombasa waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Chenro mar thieth mar oganda: Kenya Red Cross chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar typhoid e county mar Mombasa kendo ojiwo ji mondo oti gi net mag kute ma otigo gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo tho.

English: SHA announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linatangaza uboreshaji wa nyakati za kuajiri kwa ajili ya usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Mandera.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds the public in Kwale County that input on development planning forums is welcome this November.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba mchango kwenye vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo unakaribishwa Novemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) ayaa xasuusinaya shacabka degmada Kwale in talooyinka ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha November.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) paronwa ji duto e county mar Kwale ni ji mor ahinya gi weche ma gichiwo e wi chenro mag dongruok e dwe mar Novemba.

English: OGP invites residents of Taita-Taveta County to attend the public participation forum regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: OGP inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: OGP waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Taita-Taveta inay ka qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: OGP gwelo jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenro mag dongruok.

English: KALRO advises farmers in Kwale County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the September planting season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale kudhibiti wizi wa jeshi la vuli mapema kwa kutumia dawa za kuua wadudu zilizokubaliwa kabla ya msimu wa kupanda Septemba.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kwale in ay ka hortagaan ciidamada ciidanka xilliga dayrta iyagoo isticmaalaya cayayaanka la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e gweng ' mar Kwale County mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma oseyudo ratiro mar chango jolweny e dwe mar Septemba.

English: IEBC urges residents of Meru County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on community-based development programmes.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Meru mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche momedore e wi chenro mag dongruok mag oganda.

English: NDMA urges motorists and pedestrians in West Pokot County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa wadayaasha gawaarida iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada West Pokot inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira qaraxyada dabka.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo derebe mag mtokni kod joma wuotho e West Pokot County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji moa kuondego ma sirkande mag gweng'no ogolo mondo gikwed hinyruok mag yiengni.

English: Show how quickly accidents happen when distracted; stay focused.

English: NPS urges residents of Nyeri County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NPS inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo jogweng' Nyeri County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji ng'enyie nikech ji medo keto pachgi kuom chenro mag chiwo siem motelo ne oganda.

English: Taita Taveta County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Taita Taveta: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Machi 2024
Somali: Degmada Taita Taveta: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Taita Taveta: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar adek higa mar 2024

English: NDMA urges residents of Kajiado County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawasihi wakazi wa Kajiado County kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa umakini mkubwa wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay iskaashi ku sameeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'enyie nikech ji medo keto pachgi kuom loso kuwe e piny.

English: One large consortium in Africa ( ACAT) is preparing one major event and effects, beyond one year..
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano mmoja mkubwa katika Afrika (ACAT) ni kuandaa tukio moja kubwa na athari, zaidi ya mwaka mmoja ..

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Kiambu County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the November planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Novemba.
Somali: Guddiga Waxsoosaarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Kiambu inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beerto ee Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e County mar Kiambu mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Bomet County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia wavuti ya kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaskazini.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan mashaariicda horumarinta degmada.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' County mar Bomet mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche momedore e wi chenrogo mag dongruok.

English: Teachers Service Commission invites youth in Migori County to enroll for motor vehicle mechanics training this August.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Migori kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari Agosti hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka ayaa ku casuumay dhalinyarada Degmada Migori inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka mashiinnada gawaarida gaadiidka bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj gwelo rowere mag Migori County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar jomisonari mag mtokni e dwe mar Agost.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds the public in Samburu County that input on development planning forums is welcome this December.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba mchango kwenye vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo unakaribishwa Desemba hii.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette ayaa xasuusinaya shacabka degmada Samburu in talooyinka ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta lagu soo dhaweynayo bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette oparo ne ji duto e county mar Samburu ni paro ma ji chiwo e wi chenro mag dongruok en gima owinjore e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the community in Nakuru County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb theft.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Nakuru inay ka warbixiyaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo shaki leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto manie gweng' mar Nakuru mondo onyis polis ma ni machiegni gi kanyo ni gitimo gimoro marach mondo kik jokuoge okwelgi.

English: Focused cow and calf vaccinations quality colostrum and herd specific programs improve calf health and reduce mortality
Kiswahili: Chanjo maalum za ng ombe na ndama kolostramu bora na programu maalum za kundi huboresha afya ya ndama na kupunguza vifo
Somali: Tallaalka lo'da iyo dibiga ee diiradda lagu saaray Barnaamijyada tayada leh ee colostrum iyo hilibka gaarka ah waxay hagaajinayaan caafimaadka dibiga waxayna yareeyaan dhimashada

English: TSC encourages out-of-school children in Marsabit County to register their children at the nearest public school under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: TSC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Marsabit inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e Marsabit County mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul ma ni machiegni kodgi e klas mar somo gi somo mar jomadongo.

English: Children struggling to speak or recognize sounds may have learning difficulties. Seek assessment from child specialists early.
Kiswahili: Watoto wanaojitahidi kuzungumza au kutambua sauti wanaweza kuwa na matatizo ya kujifunza. Tafuta tathmini kutoka kwa wataalamu wa watoto mapema.
Somali: Carruurta ku dhibtoonaya inay hadlaan ama ay aqoonsadaan dhawaaqyada waxay la kulmi karaan dhibaatooyin barashada.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma ok nyal wuoyo kata ng'eyo dwol nyalo bedo gi pek e puonjruok.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) informs fish farmers in Kitui County of new market linkage opportunities this April.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawafahamisha wafugaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Aprili hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku wargelisaa kalluumeysatada kalluunka ee Gobolka Kitui fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nyiso jopur ma pidho rech e County mar Kitui thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development restricts movement of poultry in Kisii County due to a rabies outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inazuia harakati za kuku katika Kaunti ya Kisii kutokana na mlipuko wa kichaa cha mbwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa digaagga ee degmada Kisii sababo la xiriira cudurka cadhada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok e County mar Kisii nikech tuwo mar rabies.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free Rift Valley Fever screening is available at all public health centres in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this March.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Machi hii.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka bilaashka ah ee Rift Valley Fever laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynta ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji ni nonro mar Rift Valley Fever ma onge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet e dwe mar Mach.

English: KRA reminds the public in Garissa County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Garissa in sheegashada khiyaamooyinka iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: KRA parone ji duto e gweng' mar Garissa ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag yuto en gima onge nengo, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Official launch of biofertilizer to increase micronutrient content in crops grown in six counties.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi rasmi wa mbolea ya kibiolojia ili kuongeza kiwango cha virutubisho katika mazao yanayolimwa katika kaunti sita.
Somali: Daahfurka rasmiga ah ee bacriminta noolaha si loo kordhiyo nafaqada yar yar ee dalagyada laga beero lix degmo.
Dholuo: Ochako loso gik ma dongo dongo mondo omed kwan mar gik ma konyo e cham ma opidhi e kaunti auchiel.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Kiambu County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the December planting season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Desemba.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kiambu inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e County mar Kiambu mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok chon ka pok ochopo dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: COMESA will train farmers in Marsabit County on soil conservation this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya uhifadhi wa udongo Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Marsabit ee ku saabsan ilaalinta ciidda bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA biro tiego jopur e taon mar Marsabit e wi rito lowo e dwe mar Januar.

English: KEMRI urges residents of Kisumu County to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility following a rise in reported meningitis cases.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya homa ya uti wa mgongo.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow kadib kororka kiisaska meningitis ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KEMRI ojiwo jogweng' mar Kisumu County mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni nikech kwan mar ji ma nigi tuwo mar meningitis osemedore.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Uasin Gishu County about the importance of food safety for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu juu ya umuhimu wa usalama wa chakula kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMSA waxay dadka ku nool gobolka Uasin Gishu ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda badbaadada cuntada ay u leedahay caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa ji duto e county mar Uasin Gishu gimomiyo rito chiemo en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Notice: NCPB will distribute certified sweet potatoes seed to farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itasambaza mbegu za viazi vitamu zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay abuurka baradho macaan oo shahaado leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NCPB biro pogo kodhi mag le mamit ne jopur e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet e dwe mar abich.

English: To treat vegetable seeds against disease before sowing, submerge them in water heated to the recommended temperature for the recommended time (for example, spinach, cabbage, pepper, tomato and eggplant: 50Â°C for 30 minutes; lettuce and celery: 47Â°C for 30 minutes), then cool the seeds immediately in clean water and dry them before sowing or storing.
Kiswahili: Ili kutibu mbegu za mboga dhidi ya magonjwa kabla ya kupanda, zitumbukize kwenye maji yenye joto kali kwa joto lililopendekezwa kwa wakati uliopendekezwa (kwa mfano, mchicha, kabichi, pilipili, nyanya na biringanya: 50 Â° C kwa dakika 30; lettuce na celery: 47 Â° C kwa dakika 30), kisha upoe mbegu mara moja kwenye maji safi na uikaushe kabla ya kupanda au kuhifadhi.
Somali: Si iniinyaha khudaarta looga daweeyo cudurrada ka hor inta aan la beerin, ku dhex geli biyo lagu kululeeyay heerkulka lagu taliyay wakhtiga lagu taliyay (tusaale ahaan, isbinaajka, kaabajka, basbaaska, yaanyada iyo ukunta: 50°C muddo 30 daqiiqo ah; salaar iyo seleri: 47°C muddo 30 daqiiqo ah), ka dibna isla markiiba ku qabooji iniinyaha biyo nadiif ah oo qalaji ka hor inta aadan beerin ama kaydin.
Dholuo: Mondo ogeng’ kodhi mag alode mondo kik giyud tuoche kapok ipidhi, ng’adgi e pi ma ng’ich nyaka e rang’iny ma owinjore kuom kinde ma owinjore (kaka ranyisi, ng’injo, kabichi, apilo, nyanya kod mzabibu: 50°C kuom dakika 30; ng’injo kod celery: 47°C kuom dakika 30). ng’iewo pi kendo ng’iewogi kapok ipidho kata iketogi.

English: Be inspired by the story of Kitale Growers Group a successful example of secured financing in Taita Taveta
Kiswahili: Pata msukumo kutoka kwa hadithi ya Kitale Growers Group mfano mzuri wa ufadhili uliohakikishwa huko Taita Taveta
Somali: Ka hel dhiirigelin sheekada Kitale Growers Group oo ah tusaale guul leh oo maalgelin la xaqiijiyay ee Taita Taveta
Dholuo: Ne ane kaka sigand Kitale Growers Group ne okelo mor e piny Taita Taveta

English: Notice from Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: free antenatal care clinics will run every April at designated health centres in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Notisi kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi: kliniki za bure za utunzaji wa ujauzito zitafanya kazi kila Aprili katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka: rugaha daryeelka dhalmada ee bilaashka ah ayaa bilaaban doona Abriil kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Nairobi.
Dholuo: Rieko moa e Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: Klinike mag rito nyithindo kapok ginyuol biro tiyo dwe mar April higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Nairobi.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response urges residents of Kirinyaga County to complete the full recommended vaccination dose following a rise in reported cholera cases.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya kipindupindu vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kirinyaga inay dhammaystiraan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagula talinayo ka dib kororka kiisaska cudurka kolera ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Kirinyaga mondo ochop e okang' malach mar thieth ma gichiwo bang' ka kwan mar joma ne nigi tuwono osemedore.

English: Before seasonal planning and planting, ask yourself: What do my soil test results say? Do I understand the recommendations and where I can source the recommended inputs? What inputs do I need to apply? Do I have a crop rotation calendar or plan? Better yields can only be achieved through proper soil management.
Kiswahili: Kabla ya kupanga na kupanda msimu, jiulize: Matokeo yangu ya mtihani wa udongo yanasema nini? Je, ninaelewa mapendekezo na wapi ninaweza kupata pembejeo zilizopendekezwa? Je, ni pembejeo gani ninahitaji kuomba? Je, nina kalenda au mpango wa mzunguko wa mazao? Mavuno bora yanaweza kupatikana tu kupitia usimamizi sahihi wa udongo.
Somali: Kahor qorsheynta xilliyeedka iyo beerista, is weydii: Maxay natiijooyinka tijaabada ciidda sheegayaan? Ma fahamsanahay talooyinka iyo meesha aan ka heli karo xogaha la soo jeediyay? Waa maxay xogaha aan u baahanahay si aan u dabaqo? Ma hayaa jadwal ama qorshe dalagga? Dalag ka wanaagsan waxaa lagu gaari karaa kaliya maareynta saxda ah ee ciidda.
Dholuo: Kapok ichano kod chwoyo yien e kinde mar higa, penjri ane kama: Be awinjoga e wi gik ma asepuonjora e wi lowo? Be ang'eyo paro ma ji chiwo koda kama anyalo yudoe gik ma dwarore? Gin gik mage monego atiyogo? Be an gi chenro mar chwoyo yien?

English: Notice: ODPP launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kwale County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kwale Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga musuqmaasuqa ee Gobolka Kwale bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: ODPP chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e provins mar Kwale e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will open a fish collection centre in Wajir County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itafungua kituo cha kukusanya samaki katika Kaunti ya Wajir Septemba hii.

Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya matumizi ya mbolea.

Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Embu (Mbeere): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2022

Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kuzuia kujiua unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.

Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Migori kushiriki katika elimu ya wapiga kura.

Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori juu ya uvunaji wa maji Januari hii.

Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro tiego jopur mag Migori County e tij choko pi e dwe mar Januar.

English: NDMA warns residents of Kilifi County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kuhusu ongezeko la mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.

Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Trans Nzoia in talooyin ku saabsan wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha la soo dhaweynayo bisha Janaayo.

Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok Desemba hii.

Dholuo: Migawo mar Rito Kendo Duogo Tuoche jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nyagore gi tuoche mag pach e county mar Embu mondo odhi ir japuonj molony.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public that free HIV/AIDS screening is available at all public health centres in Garissa County this July.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa VVU/UKIMWI unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa Julai hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka HIV / AIDS ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee Gobolka Garissa bishii Luulyo.

Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya: kliniki za mahudhurio ya uzazi zenye ujuzi zitaendeshwa kila Machi katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Migori.

Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi wakati huu wa ukame.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka deggan degmada Embu ku xasuusinaya inay guryahooda ku rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo shaqada xilliyada abaarta.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations paronwa jogweng' Embu County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag nego ligek mach e utegi kendo giti e kinde mar oro.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds the public in Nyandarua County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this July.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba mchango juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka unakaribishwa Julai hii.

English: Ministry of Education conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Migori County this August.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Migori Agosti hii.

Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwahimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.

Dholuo: NPS osiemo jogweng' mar Kericho mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Mei.

Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Murang'a in helitaanka taageerada sheegashada NHIF/SHA ay hadda laga heli karaa xarumaha la magacaabay.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds the public in Kisumu County that input on development planning forums is welcome this January.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba mapendekezo juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo yanakaribishwa Januari hii.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed ayaa xasuusinaya shacabka degmada Kisumu in talooyinka ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta la soo dhaweynayo bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties oparo ne ji duto e County mar Kisumu ni paro ma ji chiwo e wi chenro mag dongruok en gima owinjore e dwe mar Januar.

English: In mosques, churches, community social halls, schools, transport terminus, street corners, football fields and the local dispensary, tens and hundreds of people turned up to be vaccinated.
Kiswahili: Katika misikiti, makanisa, kumbi za kijamii za jamii, shule, kituo cha usafiri, kona za barabara, uwanja wa mpira na zahanati ya eneo hilo, makumi na mamia ya watu walijitokeza kupata chanjo.
Somali: Masaajidada, kaniisadaha, hoolalka bulshada, iskuulada, xarumaha gaadiidka, geesaha waddooyinka, garoomada kubadda cagta iyo farmashiyaha maxalliga ah, tobanaan iyo boqolaal qof ayaa soo xaadiray si loo tallaalo.
Dholuo: E masikiti, kanisa, ute romo mag oganda, skul, kuonde ma ji ng’adoe gari, kona mag yore, kuonde tuke mag opira kod kar thieth ma ne ni e alwora, ji apar gi mia achiel ne obiro mondo omigi chanjo.

English: NCPB encourages farmers in Turkana County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for fish.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za samaki.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Turkana inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo kalluunka ah.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e county mar Turkana mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro mondo omi rech obed gi nengo maber.

English: Ministry of Health encourages mothers in Kiambu County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhudhuria siku iliyopangwa ya kliniki ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kiambu inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta caafimaad ee la qorsheeyay si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health jiwo mine manie County mar Kiambu mondo odhi e odiechieng'no mar thieth mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds farmers in Trans Nzoia County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee ka dambeeya goosashada.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service parone jopur man Trans Nzoia County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime bang' keyo.

English: EACC updates residents of Kisii County on progress of the county integrated development plan this February.
Kiswahili: EACC inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti hii Februari.
Somali: EACC waxay dadka deggan degmada Kisii ku wargelineysaa horumarka qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: EACC chiwo ripot ne jogweng' Kisii kuom dongruok mar chenro mar dongruok mar county e dwe mar Februar.

English: KEMSA launches an August awareness campaign on food safety across Siaya County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Agosti juu ya usalama wa chakula katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: KEMSA waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Agoosto oo ku saabsan amniga cuntada ee degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: KEMSA chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Agost e wi wach rito ngima mar chiemo e County duto mar Siaya.

English: Teachers Service Commission advises students in Lamu County to register early to secure allocation to access revision guides.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Lamu kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata miongozo ya marekebisho.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ardayda degmada Lamu kula talinayaa inay horay u diiwaangeliyaan si ay u helaan gudbinta helitaanka hagaha dib-u-eegista.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission jiwo jopuonjre e County mar Lamu mondo odonj e skundno chon mondo giyud thuolo mar somo buge ma tayo ji.

English: Council of Governors reminds the public in Meru County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this August.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Meru kwamba maoni juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma yanakaribishwa Agosti hii.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay xasuusinayaan shacabka degmada Meru in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch oparo ne ji duto e County mar Meru ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mag sirkal e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay ka shaqeynta shahaadada dhalashada ee degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Jarit Maduong' ochako tiyo gi ofis manyien mar rito nyasi mag nyuol e gweng' mar Kericho.

English: KUCCPS conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Kitui County this April.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kitui Aprili hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda gobolka ee Gobolka Kitui bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: KUCCPS dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi riwruok mar oganda mang'ongo e bajet mag kaunti mar Kitui e dwe mar April.

English: Notice from KEMSA: postnatal check-ups clinics will run every October at designated health centres in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa KEMSA: kliniki za uchunguzi wa baada ya kuzaa zitafanya kazi kila Oktoba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid KEMSA: Caafimaadka baaritaanka dhalmada kadib waxaa lagu qaban doonaa Oktoobar kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMSA: Klinike mag nonro bang' nyuol biro dhi nyime e dwe mar Oktoba higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Kericho.

English: Notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response confirms a cholera outbreak alert for Garissa County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa kipindupindu kwa Kaunti ya Garissa. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay xaqiijineysaa feejignaanta cudurka faafa ee Gobolka Garissa. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo nyiso ni nitie masira mar cholera e County mar Garissa.
