English: Notice: KNEC launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay bilawday barnaamij lagu darayo ardayda naafada ah dugsiyada gobolka Nairobi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KNEC chako chenro mar tiego nyithindo ma nigi midekre e skunde duto mag Nairobi County.

English: FAO advises milk producers in Siaya County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: FAO inashauri wazalishaji wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: FAO waxay ku talineysaa soosaarayaasha caanaha ee degmada Siaya inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur mag chak e county mar Siaya mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur ma biro ka kinde keyo pok ochopo.

English: EACC reminds the public in Trans Nzoia County that input on development planning forums is welcome this August.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba maoni juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo ni kuwakaribisha Agosti hii.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Trans Nzoia in talooyinka ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta la soo dhaweynayo bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: EACC parone ji duto manie Trans Nzoia County ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mag dongruok e dwe mar Agost.

English: Kenya Gazette reminds residents of Kisumu County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette paronwa jogweng'o mag Kisumu County ni luwo dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: ODPP reminds the public in Nakuru County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Nakuru in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: ODPP paronwa ji duto e gweng' mar Nakuru ni chiwo ripot mar kawo asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Tharaka Nithi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Februari 2023
Somali: Degmada Tharaka Nithi: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Tharaka Nithi: Oboke machon mar goyo oro mar dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2023

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will open a maize collection centre in Garissa County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mahindi katika Kaunti ya Garissa Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xarun ururinta hadhuudhka ka furi doontaa Gobolka Garissa bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro yawo kambi mar choko cham e County mar Garissa e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Treasury introduces online tools for public finance monitoring.
Kiswahili: Hazina yaanzisha zana za mtandaoni za ufuatiliaji wa fedha za umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Maaliyadda waxay soo bandhigtay qalab internetka ah oo lagu maareynayo maaliyadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Ohala chako tiyo gi gik ma yudore e Intanet e rito weche mag pesa mag sirkal.

English: WFP welcomes US$37 million from US government to support refugees in Kenya and moves to prioritise food assistance for the most vulnerable
Kiswahili: WFP inakaribisha dola za Marekani milioni 37 kutoka kwa serikali ya Marekani kusaidia wakimbizi nchini Kenya na kuchukua hatua ya kutanguliza msaada wa chakula kwa walio hatarini zaidi.
Somali: WFP waxay soo dhaweysay $37 milyan oo ka timid dowladda Mareykanka si ay u taageerto qaxootiga ku sugan Kenya, waxayna u dhaqaaqday inay mudnaanta siiso gargaarka cuntada ee dadka ugu nugul.
Dholuo: WFP rwako dola milion 37 mag Amerka ma owuok kuom sirkal mar Amerka mondo okony jolweny ma ni Kenya kendo odhi nyime gi keto kony mar chiemo ne jogo ma nigi pek ahinya e kar mokuongo .

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Makueni County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaskazini.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng' Makueni County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e loso chenro mar bajet.

English: Universities Fund reminds needy students in Kwale County that free digital learning content applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba maombi ya bure ya yaliyomo kwenye ujifunzaji wa dijiti hufungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xasuusinayaa ardayda u baahan degmada Kwale in codsiyada barashada bilaashka ah ee barnaamijyada digital-ka ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund paronwa jopuonjre man Kwale County ma nigi chandruok ni chenro mag somo mar digital maonge chudo chiegni rumo.

English: Kenya Price Bulletin, January 2024
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Bei ya Kenya, Januari 2024
Somali: Warbixinta Qiimaha Kenya, Janaayo 2024
Dholuo: Oboke mar Nengo mar Kenya, dwe mar achiel higa mar 2024

English: Kenya Medical Association urges residents of Narok County to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers following a rise in reported dengue fever cases.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya homa ya dengue.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Narok inay soo sheegaan kiisaska loo maleynayo inay u sheegaan mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaskii lagu soo sheegay cudurka hargabka dengue.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore mar rito ngima mar oganda nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuwo mar dengue osemedore.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Garissa County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waendelee kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Garissa inay la xiriiraan maamulaha degmada si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda horumarinta degmada.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Garissa mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jotend buchegi mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi chenro mag dongruok mar county.

English: CDC urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Garissa County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: CDC inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Garissa kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: CDC waxay ku boorineysaa qofkasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Garissa inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nyagore gi tuoche mag obwongo e County mar Garissa mondo oluong simo mar thieth mar obwongo maonge chudo.

English: CDC appeals to caregivers in Kilifi County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the May maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya mama ya Mei.
Somali: CDC waxay u baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Kilifi inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka bisha Maajo.
Dholuo: CDC kwayo jorit e County mar Kilifi mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi kaka achiel kuom chenro mar Mayo Maternal Health Campaign.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Uasin Gishu County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Uasin Gishu inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag obwongo e County mar Uasin Gishu mondo omany japuonj molony.

English: KEPHIS encourages farmers in Meru County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora ya mahindi.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Meru inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay hadhuudhka.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e county mar Meru mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mondo giyud nengo maber mar kodhi.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Medical Association will be held in Tharaka-Nithi County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu bila malipo iliyoandaliwa na Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Degmada Tharaka-Nithi bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma Kenya Medical Association ochano ibiro tim e Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar April.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations alerts residents of Lamu County to a rise in fraud cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za ulaghai na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka kwa kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu uga digaya kororka kiisaska khiyaamooyinka wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng' Lamu County kuom wach medruok mar weche mag wuondruok kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne polis ma machiegni.

English: Notice: KEMRI confirms a Rift Valley Fever outbreak alert for Mandera County. Residents are advised to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa kwa Kaunti ya Mandera. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka Rift Valley Fever ee Gobolka Mandera. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KEMRI osenyiso ni nitie masira mar Rift Valley Fever e kaunti mar Mandera.

English: KTDA warns coffee farmers in Laikipia County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaonya wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Laikipia juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KTDA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Laikipia cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: KTDA chiwo siem ne jopur mag chai e County mar Laikipia kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the community in Laikipia County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb fraud.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia udanganyifu.
Somali: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada ayaa ku boorinaya bulshada degmada Laikipia inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo khiyaamooyinka.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo oganda e County mar Laikipia mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polis mar oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o mibadhi.

English: Notice: KNEC opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inafungua maombi ya maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay codsiyada u furaysaa bartayaasha degmada Mandera si ay u helaan barasho digital ah oo lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KNEC chako tiyo gi weche mag tiegruok mag digital maonge chudo ne jopuonjre man Mandera County.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free depression awareness support is available through county health facilities in West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa uhamasishaji wa unyogovu unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay wacyiga niyadjabku laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Galbeedka Pokot.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar parruok yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e West Pokot County.

English: Lamu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Lamu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2024
Somali: Degmada Lamu: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Lamu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2024

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Vihiga County about the importance of diabetes screening for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuhusu umuhimu wa uchunguzi wa kisukari kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay dadka degmada Vihiga ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda baaritaanka sonkorowga uu u leeyahay caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji e County mar Vihiga kuom ber mar nonro mar thieth mar sukari e ngima joot.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development encourages farmers in Nandi County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for avocado.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za parachichi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Nandi inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay avocado.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur e county mar Nandi mondo ous olembe mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo mondo omi olembe mag avocado obed maber.

English: Kenya Dairy Board warns wheat farmers in Homa Bay County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda sarreenka ee gobolka Homa Bay cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna kugula talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board chiwo siem ne jopur mag ngano e Homa Bay County kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief May 2026
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP wa Kenya Mei 2026
Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya Maajo 2026
Dholuo: Wach machiek mar piny Kenya dwe mar abich 2026

English: Teachers Service Commission encourages residents of Nyamira County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on voter registration.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabaan diiwaangelinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Commission of Teachers Service ojiwo jogweng' Nyamira County mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto gikwongo tiyogo ka gidwaro ng'eyo weche duto.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds the public in Turkana County to remain vigilant on border security.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay dadka degmada Turkana ku xasuusineysaa in ay ka feejignaadaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne ji duto e county mar Turkana ni gibed motang' ne sirkal mar boda.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds livestock keepers in Meru County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Meru kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu xasuusinayaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Meru inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska xayawaanada ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jorit jamni e county mar Meru ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: Episcopal Relief & Development receives grant from Conrad N. Hilton Foundation for early childhood development work
Kiswahili: Usaidizi wa Maaskofu & Maendeleo hupokea ruzuku kutoka kwa Wakfu wa Conrad N. Hilton kwa kazi ya makuzi ya utotoni.
Somali: Episcopal Relief & Development waxay deeq ka heshay Conrad N. Hilton Foundation si loogu caawiyo shaqada horumarinta carruurnimada hore
Dholuo: Oganda ma Episkop mar konyo kod dongruok yudo kony kowuok kuom riwruok mar Conrad N. Hilton mar tich mar dongruok mar nyithindo matindo

English: Notice: KUCCPS opens a new tailoring and design programme at the vocational centre in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inafungua programu mpya ya ushonaji na kubuni katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan dharka iyo naqshadeynta xarunta xirfadaha ee gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KUCCPS chako chenro manyien mar loso kendo loso gik moko e skul mar tich e Homa Bay County.

English: Notice: DPP opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Wilaya ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay fureysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya taageero maskaxeed ee gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DPP ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony e weche mag pach ji e Homa Bay County.

English: Notice: SHA opens the electoral calendar centres in Kwale County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: SHA inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Kwale Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA waxay furaysaa xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee Gobolka Kwale bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: SHA chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e kaunti mar Kwale e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: HELB opens applications for revision guides for learners in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay furaysaa codsiyada hagaha dib u eegista ardayda degmada Migori.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: HELB yawo kwayo mag somo mondo okony jopuonjre e County mar Migori.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Kitui County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Kitui inuu ka qayb galo kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag obwongo e County mar Kitui mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education reminds citizens in Isiolo County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka Isiolo waxay muwaadiniinta ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda gobolka.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Puonjruok ma Chakre e Piny owacho parone raia mag Isiolo County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo gi ji duto e bajet mar county.

English: TVET advises students in Baringo County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Baringo kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata vitabu vya kiada na nyenzo za kujifunzia.
Somali: TVET waxay ardayda degmada Baringo kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan buugaag iyo qalab waxbarasho.
Dholuo: TVET nyiso jopuonjre man Baringo County mondo oketgi e intanet mondo giyud buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok.

English: SHA reminds the public in Lamu County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Lamu kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka gobolka Lamu in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: SHA parone ji duto e County mar Lamu ni chiwo ripot mar kawo asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: Notice: NDMA launches a burglary prevention campaign in Nyamira County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada gobolka Nyamira bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA chako kampen mar geng'o jomecho odonjo e dala mar Nyamira e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will open a fish collection centre in Bomet County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itafungua kituo cha kukusanya samaki katika Kaunti ya Bomet Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu furi doonaa xarun ururinta kalluunka ee Gobolka Bomet bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Bura mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro yawo kama ichokoe rech e taon mar Bomet e dwe mar Julai.

English: The Ministry has insrtructed its community wokers through SUNCSA to plan on feeding well among all residents and to observe cleanliness. Stay safe from
Kiswahili: Wizara imewaamuru watunzaji wake wa jumuiya kupitia SUNCSA kupanga kulisha vizuri kati ya wakazi wote na kutunza usafi.
Somali: Wasaaradda ayaa shaqaalaheeda bulshada u dirtay iyada oo loo marayo SUNCSA si ay u qorsheeyaan inay si fiican u quudiyaan dhammaan dadka deggan iyo inay ilaaliyaan nadaafadda.
Dholuo: Migawo mar piny owacho osenyiso jolendo mage kokalo kuom SUNCSA mondo otim chenro mar pidho ji duto e yo maber kendo rito ler.

English: NPS urges the community in Tharaka-Nithi County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb theft.
Kiswahili: NPS inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: NPS waxay ugu baaqaysaa bulshada degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: NPS ojiwo oganda man Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polis mar oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o kuo.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces free medical camps for residents of West Pokot County starting this January.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuanzia Januari hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhawaaqday xeryo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada West Pokot laga bilaabo Janaayo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche ogolo kambi mag thieth maonge chudo ne jogweng' mar West Pokot County kochakore Januar.

English: Kenya: WASH-related Needs Assessment in Schools and Health Facilities in Turkana County - July 2024 | Turkana Host and Refugee Community
Kiswahili: Kenya: Tathmini Ya Mahitaji Yanayohusiana na WASH katika Shule na Vifaa vya Afya katika Kaunti ya Turkana - Julai 2024 | Mwenyeji wa Turkana na Jumuiya ya Wakimbizi
Somali: Kenya: Qiimaynta Baahiyaha la xiriira WASH ee Dugsiyada iyo Xarumaha Caafimaadka ee Degmada Turkana - Luulyo 2024 | Bulshada Martigelinta iyo Qaxootiga ee Turkana
Dholuo: Kenya: Rang’o Dwaro ma tudruok gi WASH e Skunde kod Kuonde mag Thieth e gwenge mag Turkana - Julaini 2024 | Oganda ma Turkana ma rwako welo kod jolweny

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds livestock keepers in Nyandarua County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa xasuusinaya xoolaha ee degmada Nyandarua inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska xoolaha ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jorit jamni e kaunti mar Nyandarua ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Isiolo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Februari 2023
Somali: Degmada Isiolo: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Isiolo: Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Ariyo higa mar 2023

English: KNEC invites youth in Mombasa County to enroll for electrical installation training this June.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Juni hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Mombasa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada bisha Juun.
Dholuo: KNEC gwelo rowere e county mar Mombasa mondo odonj e tiegruok mar keto sitima e dwe mar Jun.

English: ODPP urges residents of Uasin Gishu County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha kusanyiko la kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu inay ka qeybgalaan kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee golaha gobolka si ay uga warqabaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee gobolka.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo gibed ka ging'eyo chenro mar dongruok.

English: Pest Control Products Board announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for goats in Nairobi County this April.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Aprili hii.
Somali: Guddiga xakamaynta cayayaanka ayaa ku dhawaaqaya jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee riyaha ee Gobolka Nairobi bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok mag Pest olando chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar dhoot ne diek e County mar Nairobi e dwe mar April.

English: Kenya Red Cross announces outpatient services for residents of Kisumu County starting this October.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unatangaza huduma za wagonjwa wa nje kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kuanzia Oktoba hii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa ku dhawaaqday adeegyo bukaan-socodka ah oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Kisumu laga bilaabo Oktoobarkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ogolo chenro mar konyo jotuo mag Kisumu County chakre dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya launches a burglary prevention campaign in Migori County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Migori Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada Degmada Migori bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chako kampen mar geng'o jokuoge odonj e gweng' mar Migori e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ee degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Jarit Maduong' biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi weche siasa e gweng' mar Kisii.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone experiencing abuse in Nyandarua County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kutafuta msaada katika nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Nyandarua inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e County mar Nyandarua mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Judiciary of Kenya encourages first-time voters in Kisumu County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya ayaa ku dhiirigelinaya codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horeysay ee degmada Kisumu inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo joma okwongo yiero e counties mar Kisumu mondo olim kama ichikoe ji ne IEBC.

English: Environmental Screening Report NEAT+, Community Water Supply Project, Kalobeyei Refugee Settlement, Kakuma, Kenya
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Uchunguzi wa Mazingira NEAT+, Mradi wa Ugavi wa Maji kwa Jamii, Makazi ya Wakimbizi ya Kalobeyei, Kakuma, Kenya
Somali: Warbixinta Baaritaanka Deegaanka NEAT+, Mashruuca Bixinta Biyaha Bulshada, Dejinta Qaxootiga Kalobeyei, Kakuma, Kenya
Dholuo: Ripot mar Rango Alwora NEAT+, Chenro mar Chiwo Pi ne Oganda, Kambi mar Jolweny mag Kalobeyei, Kakuma, Kenya

English: IPOA calls on residents of Makueni County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: IPOA inatoa wito kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika kumbi za umma ili kuunga mkono mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: IPOA luongo jogweng' Makueni County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji nitie mondo okony ji ng'eyo chon.

English: ODPP advises residents of Kilifi County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: ODPP inashauri wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e-Citizen.
Somali: ODPP waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inay qaataan dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado dib u dhac marka ay raadinayaan diiwaangelinta e-Citizen.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogweng' Kilifi County mondo oting'e buge duto madwarore mondo kik gimi ng'ato odog chien ka gidwaro dhi e e-Citizen registration.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges youth in Busia County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Busia kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Busia inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada rayidka ah ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada rayidnimada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education ojiwo rowere e county mar Busia mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok ochopo tije mag oganda.

English: Notice: DCI launches a fraud prevention campaign in Bungoma County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga khiyaamooyinka degmada Bungoma bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Paro: DCI chako kampen mar geng'o mibadhi e taon mar Bungoma e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Kenya El Nino Response Plan: Emergency Flood Alert - October 2023
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Kukabiliana na El Nino wa Kenya: Arifa kuhusu Mafuriko ya Dharura - Oktoba 2023
Somali: Qorshaha Jawaab celinta El Nino ee Kenya: Digniin Degdeg ah oo ku saabsan Daadadka - Oktoobar 2023
Dholuo: Chenro mar Duoko mar El Nino e Kenya: Chik mar Pi Mapoya Mapiyo - Oktoba 2023

English: Notice: NTSA conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Kisii County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Kisii Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan ka hortagga argagixisada ee degmada Kisii bishii November.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NTSA timo romo mar oganda e dwe mar Novemba e County mar Kisii.

English: There is no health without mental health
Kiswahili: Hakuna afya bila afya ya akili
Somali: Caafimaad la'aan caafimaad maskaxeed ma jirto.
Dholuo: Onge ng'ato manyalo bedo gi ngima maber ka onge tuoche mag chuny.

English: CSA is the new way identified to progress and accustom farming in a transformative trajectory benefiting yields and natural resources in a progressive wÃ y.
Kiswahili: CSA ni njia mpya iliyotambuliwa ya maendeleo na tabia ya kilimo katika trajectory ya mabadiliko kufaidika mavuno na rasilimali za asili kwa njia ya hatua kwa hatua.
Somali: CSA waa habka cusub ee loo aqoonsaday in lagu hormariyo laguna dhaqmo beeraha waddo isbeddel leh oo ka faa'iideysanaysa wax-soo-saarka iyo kheyraadka dabiiciga ah ee heer horusocod ah.
Dholuo: CSA en yo manyien ma ong’ere mar dhi nyime kendo puonjo pur e yo ma kelo lokruok ma kelo ber ne cham kod mwandu mag piny e yo ma dhi nyime.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Nakuru County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kazini wakati wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inay guryahooda ku rakibaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo shaqada inta lagu jiro xilliyada shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogweng' Nakuru County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag nego ligek mach e utegi kendo giti e kinde masiche mag ndara.

English: Ministry of Education reminds schools in Kirinyaga County to strengthen anti-bullying measures this January.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuimarisha hatua za kupambana na uonevu Januari hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa dib u xasuusineysa dugsiyada Gobolka Kirinyaga inay xoojiyaan tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibaatada bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok oparo ne skunde man Kirinyaga County mondo omed jiwo yore mag geng'o nindruok e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) confirms a typhoid outbreak alert for Kisumu County. Residents are advised to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa matumbo kwa Kaunti ya Kisumu. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xaqiijineysaa feejignaanta cudurka tifooska ee degmada Kisumu. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: SHA (Social Health Authority) osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuo mar typhoid e gweng' mar Kisumu.

English: KNEC conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Siaya County this November.
Kiswahili: KNEC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Siaya Novemba hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha gobolka Siaya bishii November ee sannadkan.
Dholuo: KNEC timo romo mar tiego ji e wi migawo mar Ombudsman e county mar Siaya e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Tana River County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tana River: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2024
Somali: Degmada Tana River: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Aora Tana: Oboke mar Chik Motelo kuom Oro mar Adek 2024

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces SHA registration for residents of Kajiado County starting this May.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatangaza usajili wa SHA kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kuanzia Mei hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhawaaqday diiwaangelinta SHA ee dadka deggan degmada Kajiado laga bilaabo bisha May.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche ogolo chik mar SHA mar ndiko joma odak e Kajiado County kochakore e dwe mar abich.

English: The affected counties and regions are Tana River, Mombasa, Kwale, Tharaka Nithi, Elgeyo-Marakwet, Kiambu, Eastern, Central, Coast, Nairobi and Rift Valley.
Kiswahili: Kaunti na maeneo yaliyoathiriwa ni Tana River, Mombasa, Kwale, Tharaka Nithi, Elgeyo-Marakwet, Kiambu, Mashariki, Kati, Pwani, Nairobi na Rift Valley.
Somali: Gobollada iyo gobollada ay dhibaatadu saameysey waa Tana River, Mombasa, Kwale, Tharaka Nithi, Elgeyo-Marekwet, Kiambu, Bariga, Bartamaha, Xeebta, Nairobi iyo Rift Valley.
Dholuo: Kaunti kod ogendni moyudo hinyruok gin aora mar Tana, Mombasa, Kwale, Tharaka Nithi, Elgeyo-Marakwet, Kiambu, Wuokchieng', Diere, Nam Nam, Nairobi kod Rift Valley.

English: COMESA announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Kwale County this January.
Kiswahili: COMESA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kwale Januari hii.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee lo'da caanaha ah ee Gobolka Kwale bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: COMESA ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok ma nigi dhogi gi dhogi maonge chudo e dwe mar Januar e kaunti mar Kwale.

English: KALRO encourages farmers in Kwale County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price to secure better prices for coffee.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa ili kupata bei bora ya kahawa.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kwale inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan kafeega.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e county mar Kwale mondo oti gi nengo mar piny moseketo mar loso chai e yo maber moloyo.

English: Kenya Dairy Board urges pigs farmers in Narok County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawahimiza wafugaji wa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Narok kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa Newcastle vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda doofaarka ee Gobolka Narok inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska cudurka Newcastle ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur ma pidho anguro e kaunti mar Narok mondo ochiw ripot ne jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth machiegni gi kanyo bang' yudo wach mar tuo mar Newcastle.

English: IEBC reminds the public in Nyeri County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this October.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba mapendekezo juu ya mapitio ya utendaji wa kila mwaka yanakaribishwa Oktoba hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nyeri in talooyinka ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah la soo dhaweynayo bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: IEBC oparo ne ji duto e County mar Nyeri ni ibiro yie gi weche ma ji chiwo e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: The Ministry of Agriculture will provide seedlings to farmers during the October to December rains Farmers are encouraged to participate for improved crop production
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo yatoa miche kwa wakulima wakati wa mvua za Oktoba hadi Desemba Wakulima wahimizwa kushiriki katika kuboresha uzalishaji wa mazao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha waxay beeraleyda siin doontaa geedo inta lagu jiro roobabka Oktoobar ilaa Diseembar Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiiri gelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka dalagga
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture biro chiwo kodhi ne jopur e dwe mar Oktoba nyaka Desemba koth Joop jiwo jopur mondo oriw lwedo dongruok mar cham

English: Notice: KALRO will distribute certified sweet potatoes seed to farmers in Garissa County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itasambaza mbegu za viazi vitamu zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay abuurka baradho macaan oo shahaado leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda Gobolka Garissa bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KALRO biro pogo kodhi mag le mamit ne jopur e gweng' mar Garissa e dwe mar Mei.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Bungoma County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Bungoma inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kalfadhiga tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Bungoma County Pest Control Products Board jiwo jopur mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e tiego jopur mabiro.

English: IPOA reminds the public in Nyamira County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuendelea kuwa macho katika kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Nyamira in ay ka feejignaadaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa ji duto e County mar Nyamira mondo gibed motang' ne loso kuwe e piny mangima.

English: NDMA reminds the public in Kajiado County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NDMA inakumbusha umma katika Kajiado County kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kajiado inay ka feejignaadaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: NDMA parone ji duto e Kajiado County mondo obed motang' gi chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: Notice: NPS conducts a community briefing on community early-warning systems in Machakos County this April.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Machakos Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada oo ku saabsan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada ee Degmada Machakos bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Riwruok mar NPS timo romo mar chiwo siem ne oganda e wi chenro mag chiwo siem chon e gweng' mar Machakos e dwe mar April.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds farmers in Machakos County of the ongoing fertiliser application training programme.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya matumizi ya mbolea.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Machakos barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee isticmaalka bacriminta.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jopur e county mar Machakos e wi program mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar tiyo gi dung'o.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service issues a cybersecurity alert on SIM-swap fraud affecting residents of Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM ambao unaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu soo saaray digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaanooyinka SIM-swap ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Mombasa.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Forest Service ogolo siem mar sirkal mar cybersecurity e wi wuond mag SIM-swap makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e County mar Mombasa.

English: TVET reminds parents in Narok County that bursary allocation registration is open this February.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Narok kwamba usajili wa ugawaji wa bursary umefunguliwa Februari hii.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Narok in diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ay furan tahay bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: TVET parone jonyuol manie Narok County ni kad mar yudo mich mar tiegruok osechakore e dwe mar Februar.

English: Lamu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Lamu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Aprili 2024
Somali: Degmada Lamu: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Lamu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar ang'wen 2024

English: KMTC urges youth in Trans Nzoia County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Trans Nzoia inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda ka hor inta aysan qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KMTC jiwo rowere e Trans Nzoia County mondo onyis weche ma gin-go mar ndiko ji kapok gitimo tije mag sirkal.

English: Kenya Red Cross appeals to caregivers in Kericho County to visit their nearest maternity wing as part of the October maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya watoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kericho kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Oktoba.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Kericho inay soo booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka ee Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross okwayo jorit e County mar Kericho mondo olimgi e kambi ma giwuokie machiegni kaka achiel kuom riwruoge mag thieth ma timore e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: You can avoid going to hospital or contracting COVID-19 if you follow instructions and use the face mask, wash your hands and maintain social distancing. 90% of the responsibility is with you; @HassanAliJoho
Kiswahili: Unaweza kuepuka kwenda hospitalini au kuambukizwa COVID-19 ukifuata maagizo na kutumia barakoa, kunawa mikono na kudumisha umbali wa kijamii. 90% ya jukumu liko kwako; @HassanAliJoho
Somali: Waad ka fogaan kartaa inaad tagto isbitaal ama aad qaaddo COVID-19 haddii aad raacdo tilmaamaha oo aad isticmaasho maaskaro wejiga, aad dhaqdo gacmahaaga oo aad ilaaliso kala fogaanshaha bulshada. 90% mas'uuliyadda adigaa iska leh; @HassanAliJoho
Dholuo: Inyalo geng'o dhi e osiptal kata yudo tuo mar COVID-19 ka iluwo yore kendo itiyo gi mask mar wang', lwoko lweteni kendo rito thuolo e kind ji. 90% mar ting’no ni e lweti; @Hasan AliJoho

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises maize producers in Mombasa County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inashauri wazalishaji wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa soo saarayaasha hadhuudhka ee gobolka Mombasa inay ka iibsadaan wax soo saarka kaliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur ma loso kodhi e County mar Mombasa ni giusgi mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo kodhi kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Isiolo County about the importance of diabetes screening for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuhusu umuhimu wa uchunguzi wa kisukari kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay dadka degmada Isiolo ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay baaritaanka sonkorowga ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji duto manie Isiolo County kuom gimomiyo thieth mar thieth ma thieth kelo e ngima joot.

English: KEMRI advises residents of Nakuru County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: KEMRI waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun iyo biyo nadiif ah si joogto ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng' Nakuru County mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: DCI alerts residents of Narok County to a rise in fraud cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Narok juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za ulaghai na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka kwa kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: DCI waxay dadka deggan degmada Narok uga digtay kororka kiisaska khiyaamooyinka waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne jogweng' Narok County kuom wach medruok mar weche mag wuondruok kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne polis man machiegni.

English: KEMRI announces free medical camps for residents of Bomet County starting this September.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kuanzia Septemba hii.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa xeryo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Bomet laga bilaabo bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KEMRI ogolo kampen mag thieth maonge chudo ne joma odak e county mar Bomet kochakore Septemba.

English: The Agriculture Cluster Development Project ACDP has been expanded to 19 new districts in Uganda enabling registered farmers to access subsidized farm inputs Farmers must contribute 33 of the input cost
Kiswahili: Mradi wa Maendeleo ya Nguzo za Kilimo ACDP umepanuliwa hadi wilaya mpya 19 nchini Uganda kuwezesha wakulima waliosajiliwa kupata pembejeo za kilimo za ruzuku Wakulima lazima wachangie 33 kati ya gharama ya pembejeo.
Somali: Mashruuca Horumarinta Kooxaha Beeraha ACDP ayaa la ballaariyay ilaa 19 degmo oo cusub oo ku yaal Uganda taasoo u suurtagelisay beeraleyda diiwaangashan inay helaan alaab beereed oo la taageero. Beeraleydu waa inay ku biiriyaan 33 ka mid ah kharashka gelinta
Dholuo: Chenro mar Geno Wacho Gik ma Dhano Timo e Tije mag Tij Lemo (ACDP) osemedore nyaka e distrikt 19 manyien e Uganda mamiyo jopur ma oseyudo kony mar yudo gik ma jopurgo nyalo chamo

English: Teachers Service Commission calls on the community in Machakos County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Machakos kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ugu baaqay bulshada Degmada Machakos inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo ji duto manie County mar Machakos mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: NDMA warns residents of Nyandarua County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua juu ya kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: NDMA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua kororka qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: NDMA osiemo jogweng' Nyandarua County kuom medruok mar chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok kare ne jatendgi.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Kilifi County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya wilaya ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' Kilifi County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e loso chenro mag dongruok.

English: World Malaria Day: Kenya Joins the World in Commemorating Malaria Day.
Kiswahili: Siku ya Malaria Duniani: Kenya Yaungana na Dunia Kuadhimisha Siku ya Malaria.
Somali: Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Cudurka Malaria: Kenya ayaa ku biirtay maalinta caalamiga ee xuska cudurka.
Dholuo: Odiechieng Malieria e Piny Ngima: Kenya Riwore gi Piny Mangima e Paro Odiechieng' Malieria.

English: Notice: CDC will hold a suicide prevention forum in Bungoma County this June. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: CDC itafanya kongamano la kuzuia kujiua katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Juni hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Xusuusin: CDC waxay qabaneysaa madasha ka hortagga ismiidaaminta ee Gobolka Bungoma bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni CDC biro timo romo mar geng'o ji kik donjre e dwe mar Jun e taon mar Bungoma.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges residents of Nyeri County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama katikati ya tahadhari kubwa ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaalla aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ojiwo jogweng' Nyeri County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e alwora mar tong'gi e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya e loso kuwe e piny.

English: Kenya confirms two new Mpox cases in Kericho and Taita Taveta counties, raising total to 33; Health Ministry urges schools to enhance safety measures to curb spread.
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha visa viwili vipya vya Mpox katika kaunti za Kericho na Taita Taveta, na kuongeza jumla ya visa hivyo kufikia 33; Wizara ya Afya yahimiza shule kuimarisha hatua za usalama ili kupunguza kuenea kwa virusi hivyo.
Somali: Kenya ayaa xaqiijisay laba kiis oo cusub oo Mpox ah oo ka dhacay degmooyinka Kericho iyo Taita Taveta, taasoo wadarta guud u kordhisay 33; Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku boorineysaa dugsiyada inay xoojiyaan tallaabooyinka amniga si loo xakameeyo faafitaanka.
Dholuo: Kenya osenyiso ni nitie ji ariyo manyien ma nigi tuwo mar Mpox e counties mag Kericho kod Taita Taveta, kendo mano osemiyo kwan mar ji duto okalo 33; Ministry of Health jiwo skunde mondo omed timo dongruok e ritruok mar thieth.

English: KALRO invites farmers in Machakos County to a free training on record keeping for farmers this September.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Machakos kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima Septemba hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Machakos tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan diiwaangelinta beeralayda bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KALRO ogwelo jopur e gweng' mar Machakos e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi rito rekod mag jopur dwe mar ochiko.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa hati ya kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay ka furtay xarun adeeg cusub oo lagu shaqeynayo shahaadada dhalashada ee Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Rapar: Huduma Kenya oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mar loso nyasi mag nyuol e Kaunti mar Kakamega.

English: Sauti Trade Insights COVID-19 Bulletin Q1/Q2 2022 (July 2022)
Kiswahili: Sauti Trade Insights COVID-19 Bulletin Q1/Q2 2022 (Julai 2022)
Somali: Warbixinta Ganacsiga ee Sauti ee COVID-19 Q1/Q2 2022 (Luulyo 2022)
Dholuo: Oboke mar Ohala mar Sauti mar COVID-19 Q1/Q2 2022 (Abiriyo 2022)

English: Council of Governors announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku dhawaaqeen in la hagaajiyo waqtiga wareejinta codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee Gobolka Garissa.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch ogolo lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mar yudo nying mar ng'at manie gweng' mar Garissa.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Murang'a County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the March planting season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji Machi.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Murang'a inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur manie County mar Murang'a mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochako chwoyo kodhi e dwe mar Mach.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds farmers in Lamu County of the ongoing post-harvest handling training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa xusuusinaya beeraleyda degmada Lamu barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee ka dambeeya goosashada.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board parone jopur man Lamu County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime bang' keyo.

English: State Department for TVET encourages out-of-school children in Nyamira County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta dugsiga ka baxsan ee degmada Nyamira inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo nyithindo maok dhi e skul e county mar Nyamira mondo okonygi kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: KRA warns public officers in Nairobi County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: KRA inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: KRA waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Nairobi inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: KRA chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e County mar Nairobi ni kik giti marach gi migepegi.

English: E-Citizen announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Migori County.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inatangaza nyakati bora za kugeuza kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay ka shaqeynta shahaadada dhalashada ee degmada Migori.
Dholuo: E-Citizen lando lokruok e seche mag timo tij loso nyasi mag nyuol e county mar Migori.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges sorghum growers in Narok County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Wanyama inawasihi wakulima wa sorghum katika Kaunti ya Narok kudhibiti wizi wa askari mapema kwa kutumia dawa za kuua wadudu zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda sorghum ee Gobolka Narok in ay horumariyaan weerarkii ciidanka ee dayrta iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaanka la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur ma pidho sorghum e Narok County mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma giyudo ka gitiyo gi tuoche makelo hinyruok mondo okony e loso cham e higani.

English: CDC reminds the public in Marsabit County about the importance of proper sanitation for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya umuhimu wa usafi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: CDC waxay dadweynaha degmada Marsabit ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay nadaafadda saxda ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji duto e marsabit county kuom ber mar rito ler mar pi e ngima joot.

English: Ministry of Education urges parents and teachers in West Pokot County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta gobolka West Pokot inay u soo sheegaan maamulka iskuulka wixii arrimo ah oo ku saabsan amniga.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e West Pokot County mondo onyis sirkal mar skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Nyeri County about the importance of diabetes screening for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhusu umuhimu wa uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay dadka degmada Nyeri ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda baaritaanka sonkorowga ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne ji e County mar Nyeri kuom ber mar thieth mar sukari e ngima joot.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Samburu County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Samburu inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qaybqaataan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur e county mar Samburu mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public in Kirinyaga County that access to SHA registration is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba ufikiaji wa usajili wa SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Waaxda Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha Gobolka Kirinyaga in hadda la heli karo diiwaangelinta SHA xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo parone ji duto e County mar Kirinyaga ni sani ginyalo yudo weche mag SHA e kuonde moyier.
