English: Kenya Forest Service urges motorists and pedestrians in Kilifi County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa gawaarida iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Kilifi in ay ka fogaadaan in ay soo gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada daadadku ka da'ay si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira dabka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Forest Service jiwo joidh mtokni kod joma wuotho gi tiendegi e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o mondo kik mach chakore.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Turkana County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana in si dhakhso leh u soo sheegidda tuugada ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NTSA parone jogweng'o mag Turkana County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar nek konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Notice: OGP launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Laikipia County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa gobolka Laikipia bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Rapar: OGP chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Laikipia e dwe mar Jun.

English: OMR answer sheets for KPSEA 2025 now use circles instead of lines.
Kiswahili: Karatasi za majibu za OMR za KPSEA 2025 sasa zinatumia miduara badala ya mistari.
Somali: Bogga jawaabaha OMR ee KPSEA 2025 hadda waxay isticmaalaan wareegyo halkii ay ku jiri lahaayeen khadadka.
Dholuo: Masinde mag dwoko mag OMR mag KPSEA 2025 sani tiyo gi sirkal kar tiyo gi rang'iny.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission reminds citizens in Turkana County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu muwaadiniinta degmada Turkana xusuusinayaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj parone raia mag Turkana County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo gi ji duto e bajet mar county.

English: KMTC reminds schools in Siaya County to strengthen inclusion of learners with disabilities this April.
Kiswahili: KMTC inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuimarisha ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu Aprili hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Siaya inay xoojiyaan ka mid noqoshada ardayda naafada ah bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: KMTC oparo ne skunde man Siaya County mondo omed jiwo joma nigi midekre e dwe mar April.

English: TSC reminds needy students in Nandi County that revision guides applications close soon.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: TSC waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Nandi in dib-u-eegista tilmaamaha codsiyada ay dhowaan soo gabagabeynayaan.
Dholuo: TSC oparo ne jopuonjre man gi chandruok e County mar Nandi ni lokruok mar gwelo kwayo mag kwayo biro rumo machiegni.

English: Public health advisory: Kenya Medical Association warns of increased measles risk in Bomet County and advises the public to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya surua katika Kaunti ya Bomet na kushauri umma kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Talada caafimaadka dadweynaha: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ka digay khatarta kororka suuxdinta ee Gobolka Bomet wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Chenro mar thieth mar ji: Kenya Medical Association chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuwo mar masal e County mar Bomet kendo osiemo ji mondo kik giriwre gi pi mochido.

English: Notice: DCI conducts a community briefing on border security in Uasin Gishu County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DCI inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha ee gobolka Uasin Gishu bishii November.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: DCI timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu e dwe mar Novemba.

English: E-Citizen reminds residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet wanaohudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet ee ka qeybgalaya kalfadhiga guud ee shirka degmada oo xoojinaya maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa ji duto modak e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ma biro e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges motorists and pedestrians in Siaya County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Siaya kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Siaya inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ojiwo jowuoth kod joma wuotho e ndara e county mar Siaya mondo oluw chike mag golo ji ma sirkal ogolo mondo gikwed masiche motudore gi ataro.

English: KNEC advises applicants in Makueni County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Makueni kutembelea kituo cha mafunzo ya ufundi kilicho karibu kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Makueni inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee la heli karo.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e gweng' mar Makueni mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: Notice: KMTC opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inafungua maombi ya maudhui ya kujifunza dijitali bila malipo kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay u furaysaa codsiyada barashada bilaashka ah ee barashada digital-ka ee ardayda ku nool gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC oyawo kwayo mag somo maonge chudo mar digital ne jopuonjre e county mar Uasin Gishu.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) will hold a public participation forum on development planning forums in Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Garsoorka Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta ee degmada Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag dongruok e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette launches the county integrated development plan in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika wilaya ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Kenya Gazette waxay soo bandhigtay qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Bomet.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Gazette chako chenro mar dongruok mar county e county mar Bomet.

English: DCI reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Garissa County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba upatikanaji wa maelekezo ya makazi salama unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee Gobolka Garissa in helitaanka tixraacyada magangelyo ammaan ah ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: DCI paronwa jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Garissa ni ginyalo yudo kar dak maonge chudo.

English: Notice from Kenya Medical Association: skilled birth attendance clinics will run every February at designated health centres in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya: kliniki za mahudhurio ya uzazi zenye ujuzi zitaendeshwa kila Februari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya: rugta dhallaanka ee xirfadlayaasha ah ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Febraayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee la magacaabay ee Degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association: klinik mag rito nyuol ma nigi lony biro tiyo e dwe mar Februar e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Vihiga.

English: EACC advises residents of Tana River County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: EACC inashauri wakazi wa Wilaya ya Tana River kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Somali: EACC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay qaataan dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado dib u dhac marka la raadinayo shahaadada dhalashada.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo oting'e buge duto madwarore mondo kik gimi ng'ato odog chien sama odwaro yudo barua mar nyuol.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds livestock keepers in Murang'a County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya xoolaha ka shaqeeya degmada Murang'a inay ka fogaadaan in xoolaha ay u guuraan xuduudka degmada iyaga oo aan haysan rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board parone jorit jamni e county mar Murang'a ni kik giting' jamni ka ok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kericho County this April.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: Gazeti la Kenya linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kericho Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Kenya Gazette waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ka dhanka ah degmada Kericho bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: Kenya Gazette chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Kericho e dwe mar April.

English: Use sunscreen and avoid the sun between 10 am and 4 pm.
Kiswahili: Tumia kifaa cha kuzuia jua na epuka jua kati ya saa 10 asubuhi na saa 4 jioni.
Somali: Isticmaal muraayadda qorraxda oo ka fogaada qorraxdu inta u dhaxaysa 10 subaxnimo ilaa 4 galabnimo.
Dholuo: Ti gi yien mar geng'o wang' chieng' kendo tang' gi chieng' chakre sa apar okinyi nyaka sa ang'wen odhiambo.

English: KICD reminds schools in Nakuru County to strengthen inclusion of learners with disabilities this June.
Kiswahili: KICD inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuimarisha ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu Juni hii.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Nakuru inay xoojiyaan ka mid noqoshada ardayda naafada ah bisha Juun.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne skunde man Nakuru County mondo omed tiego jopuonjre ma nigi midekre e dwe mar Jun.

English: SHA urges eligible citizens in Siaya County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: SHA inawasihi raia wanaostahiki katika Kaunti ya Siaya kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Siaya inay ka qaybqaataan jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jokanyo mag county mar Siaya mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar yiero.

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit warns of increased cholera risk in Tana River County and advises the public to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya kipindupindu katika Kaunti ya Tana River na kushauri umma kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Somali: Talo-bixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa ka digtay khatarta kororka cudurka kolera ee degmada Tana River waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay dhammaystiraan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar oganda: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osiemo ji kuom medruok mar tuo mar cholera e taon mar Tana River County kendo ojiwo ji mondo otiek dose duto mar thieth.

English: Kajiado County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kajiado: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Februari 2023
Somali: Degmada Kajiado: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kajiado: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2023

English: This follows long and short term weather forecasts about heat, and heat effect on farm crops.
Kiswahili: Hii inafuatia utabiri wa hali ya hewa wa muda mrefu na mfupi kuhusu joto, na athari ya joto kwenye mazao ya shamba.
Somali: Tani waxay raacdaa saadaasha cimilada muddada dheer iyo gaaban ee ku saabsan kuleylka, iyo saameynta kuleylka ee dalagga beeraha.
Dholuo: Mano en nikech weche ma ne okor kuom kinde malach kod machuok ma ne okor kuom kaka liet ne nyalo mulo cham.

English: TVET encourages out-of-school children in Marsabit County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Marsabit inay codsadaan deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e gweng' mar Marsabit mondo oketgi e tiegruok kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: NCPB urges pigs farmers in Busia County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wafugaji wa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Busia kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa Newcastle vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda doofaarka ee degmada Busia inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha lagu burburiyo ee loo qoondeeyay ka dib kiisaska cudurka Newcastle ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur puothe puothe e county mar Busia mondo ogeng'e legi e kuonde moketi mag chwoyo puothe mag puothe ka luwore gi ripot mar tuo mar Newcastle.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations alerts residents of Marsabit County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada ayaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit uga digaya kororka kiisaska tuugada wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar Marsabit County kuom wach kwan mag jokuoge medore kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges residents of Nyandarua County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Uhalifu unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay soo sheegaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo la sii xoojinayo fiiro gaar ah u lahaanshaha ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar sirkal e wi gik ma ne timore e alwora mar tong'gi.

English: When inoculating legume seeds: use a sticker such as gum arabic to bind the inoculant to the seed (smaller seeds need more sticker), use no less than 10g of inoculant per kg of seed, and inoculate just before planting, covering the seed with soil soon after to protect it from sun and drying.
Kiswahili: Unapochanja mbegu za mikunde: tumia gamu kama Gum Arabic kushikisha chanjo kwenye mbegu (mbegu ndogo huitaji gamu nyingi), tumia chanjo isiyopungua gramu 10 kwa kilo ya mbegu, na chanja mbegu kabla tu ya kupanda, ukizifunika mchangani mara tu baada ya kupanda kuzikinga na jua na kukauka.
Somali: Markaad ku tallaalayso miraha xashiishka: isticmaal qalab lagu dhejiyo sida cawska carabiga si aad u xidhto xashiishka miraha (siirrada yaryar waxay u baahan yihiin xashiishad badan), isticmaal ugu yaraan 10 g oo xashiishad ah halkii kg oo abuurka ah, oo ku tallaalay ka hor intaadan beerin, oo ku daboolaya abuurka ciidda dhawaan kadib si looga ilaaliyo qorraxda iyo qalajinta.
Dholuo: Sama ichiwo kodhi mag legume: ti gi sticker kaka gum arabic mondo omak kodhi mar legano (kodhi matindo dwarore ni omak kodhi mang'eny), ti gi inoculant ma ok tin ne 10 g e kilo moro mar kodhi, kendo ichiw inokul kapok ichwoyo kodhi, kendo ikop kodhi gi lowo mapiyo bang'e mondo omi kik chieng' rieny kendo kik ochwe.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will open a coffee collection centre in Isiolo County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itafungua kituo cha kukusanya kahawa katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Maamulka Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) wuxuu ka furi doonaa xarun soo ururinta kafeega ee degmada Isiolo bisha November.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro yawo kambi mar choko chai e kaunti mar Isiolo e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: IPOA conducts a community briefing on border security in Bomet County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Bomet Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha degmada Bomet bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA dhi timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e County mar Bomet e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: COMESA will open a maize collection centre in Taita-Taveta County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mahindi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay furaysaa xarun soo uruurinta hadhuudhka ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA biro yawo kambi mar choko cham e taon mar Taita-Taveta e dwe mar Februar.

English: The Agriculture and Food Authority AFA has set new minimum prices for wheat for the 2025 2026 season Millers must purchase local wheat in proportion to their import quotas
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula AFA imeweka bei mpya za chini zaidi za ngano kwa msimu wa 2025 2026 Millers lazima wanunue ngano ya ndani kulingana na upendeleo wao wa kuagiza.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) (AFA) ayaa dejisay qiimo cusub oo ugu hooseeya sarreenka xilli ciyaareedka 2025 2026 Warshadleyda waa inay iibsadaan qamadiga maxalliga ah iyadoo la raacayo qiyaasta soo dejinta
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) ose keto nengo manyien mag ngano e higa mar 2025-2026

English: The government is advancing the dairy industry transformation under the BETA Plan Milk processors are urged to align with the strategic goals outlined
Kiswahili: Serikali inaendeleza mageuzi ya sekta ya maziwa chini ya Mpango wa BETA Wasindikaji wa Maziwa watakiwa kuendana na malengo ya kimkakati yaliyoainishwa.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay horumarinaysaa isbeddelka warshadaha caanaha iyadoo la raacayo Qorshaha BETA. Shirkadaha caanaha waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay la jaanqaadaan yoolalka istiraatiijiga ah ee la qeexay
Dholuo: Sirkal dhi nyime gi loko yore mag loso chak e bwo chenro mar BETA.

English: State Department for Basic Education calls on the community in Nandi County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka Nandi waxay bulshada ugu baaqeysaa inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116 si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyada.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education okwayo ji duto e county mar Nandi mondo omany namba mar 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Uasin Gishu County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Februari hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ka hortagga gobolka Uasin Gishu bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Rapar: Huduma Kenya chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e county mar Uasin Gishu e dwe mar Februar.

English: Children grow up well when in a good environment and to be treated well
Kiswahili: Watoto hukua vizuri wanapokuwa katika mazingira mazuri na wanapopata kutibiwa vizuri
Somali: Carruurtu si fiican ayey u koraan jawi wanaagsan iyo in si fiican loo daaweeyo
Dholuo: Nyithindo dongo maber ka gin e alwora maber kendo ka itimonegi maber

English: ODPP warns public officers in Laikipia County against procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: ODPP inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia dhidi ya udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: ODPP waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Laikipia khiyaanooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: ODPP chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e County mar Laikipia kuom timbe mag mibadhi.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will distribute certified wheat seed to farmers in Kisumu County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itasambaza mbegu za ngano zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay abuuraha degmada Kisumu u qaybin doontaa abuurka sarreenka ee la caddeeyay bisha Diseembar ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro pogo kodhi mag ngano ne jopur man Kisumu County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: KTDA will open a tea collection centre in Bomet County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itafungua kituo cha kukusanya chai katika Kaunti ya Bomet Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay bilaabi doontaa xarun soo ururinta shaaha ee degmada Bomet bisha July.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA biro yawo ot mar choko chai e taon mar Bomet e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMRI will be held in Kiambu County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMRI itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay KEMRI ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Kiambu bisha April.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma KEMRI ochano biro timore Kiambu County e dwe mar April.

English: USCRI Policy Brief - Her Dreams to Achieve: Ensuring Protection and Education for Refugee Girls
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Sera ya USCRI - Ndoto Zake Kufikia: Kuhakikisha Ulinzi na Elimu kwa Wasichana Wakimbizi
Somali: Warbixinta Siyaasadda USCRI - Riyadeeda ay ku Gaadhi karto: Hubinta Ilaalinta iyo Waxbarashada Gabdhaha Qaxootiga
Dholuo: Oboke machuok mar chik mar USCRI - Lek mage ma onego ochop: Neno ni nyiri ma gin jolweny yudo rito kod somo

English: Find the nearest aggregation points where buyers collect tea in bulk This can reduce transport costs and improve market access for smallholder producers
Kiswahili: Tafuta sehemu zilizo karibu zaidi za kukusanya chai ambapo wanunuzi hukusanya chai kwa wingi Hii inaweza kupunguza gharama za usafiri na kuboresha upatikanaji wa soko kwa wazalishaji wadogo
Somali: Hel meelaha ugu dhow ee la isku ururiyo halkaas oo iibsadayashu shaaha si ballaaran u ururiyaan Tani waxay yareyn kartaa kharashka gaadiidka iyo hagaajin karta helitaanka suuqa ee soo saarayaasha yaryar
Dholuo: Yud kuonde machiegni machiegni ma jolok ohala nyalo chokoe chai e yor ng'iewo. Mano nyalo miyo nengo mag wuoth odog piny kendo miyo joma loso yiende matindo obed gi thuolo maber mar dhi e ohala

English: Kilifi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for November 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kilifi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Novemba 2023
Somali: Degmada Kilifi: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Noofambar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kilifi: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2023

English: Kenya: Registered refugees and asylum-seekers (as of 28 February 2025)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Wakimbizi waliosajiliwa na wanaotafuta hifadhi (tangu 28 Februari 2025)
Somali: Kenya: Qaxootiga diiwaangashan iyo kuwa magangalyo doonka ah (laga bilaabo 28 Febraayo 2025)
Dholuo: Kenya: Jolweny ma ondiki nyinggi kod jogo madwaro dak (chakre tarik 28 dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2025)

English: KRA urges residents of Bomet County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia laini ya bure ya EACC ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee EACC si looga hortago khiyaamada iibsiga.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo jogweng' County mar Bomet mondo oland weche mag mibadhi ka gitiyo gi EACC hotline maonge chudo mondo giked gi wuond mag yuto.

English: Announcement on health environment and and ballanced diet, good advice and services to reduce body congetion
Kiswahili: Tangazo kuhusu mazingira ya afya na lishe yenye usawaziko, ushauri mzuri na huduma za kupunguza congestion ya mwili
Somali: Ogeysiis ku saabsan deegaanka caafimaadka iyo cuntada la isku dheelitiray, talooyin iyo adeegyo wanaagsan oo lagu yareeyo culeyska jirka
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova

English: Communications Authority of Kenya alerts residents of Tana River County to a rise in fraud cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za ulaghai na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay uga digtay dadka deggan degmada Tana River in ay kordheen kiisaska khiyaamooyinka waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chiwo siem ne joma odak e taon mar Tana River County kuom wach medruok mar weche mag wuondruok kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot e stesen mar polise man machiegni.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds residents of Kitui County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Kitui in si deg deg ah loo soo sheegayo tuugada ay gacan ka geysaneyso in xaafadaha la ilaaliyo.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations paronwa jogweng'o mag Kitui County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo kuom nek konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Kenya: Solutions & Mobility Index â€” Mandera & Wajir Counties (December 2024 â€“ January 2025)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Kielezo cha Masuluhisho na Uhamaji - Kaunti za Mandera na Wajir (Desemba 2024 - Januari 2025)
Somali: Kenya: Tusmada Xalalka & Dhaqdhaqaaqa - Degmooyinka Mandheera & Wajeer (Diseembar 2024 - Janaayo 2025)
Dholuo: Kenya: Rang'iny mar duoko kod wuoth - kaunti mag mandera kod wajir (dwe mar apar gi ariyo 2024 nyaka dwe mar achiel 2025)

English: Notice: State Department for TVET opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inafungua maombi ya maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali bila malipo kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay u furaysaa codsiyada barashada bilaashka ah ee ardayda ku nool gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar State for TVET oseyawo kwayo mag somo mar digital maonge chudo ne jopuonjre e county mar Uasin Gishu.

English: CDC announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Meru County starting this July.
Kiswahili: CDC inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kuanzia Julai hii.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa in tallaabada la siiyay dadka deggan degmada Meru laga bilaabo bisha July.
Dholuo: CDC olando ni ji duto modak e county mar Meru biro yudo thieth mar dialysis kochakore e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: KNEC announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ee dugsiyada gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KNEC olando tarik mag somo e skunde mag Lamu County.

English: CDC encourages mothers in Machakos County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Machakos kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Machakos inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo mine manie County ma Machakos mondo olim kama giwuokie machiegni mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds farmers in Nyeri County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri juu ya programu inayoendelea ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa wakulima.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyeri barnaamijka tababarka beeralayda ee socda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development oparo ne jopur e County mar Nyeri chenro mar tiego jopur ma dhi nyime.

English: KEPHIS advises maize producers in Murang'a County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.

Somali: Kenya waxay wajahaysaa dhibaato bani'aadamnimo oo adag oo ay sabab u tahay abaaro soo noqnoqda, daadad, cudurro faafa, barokac, qulqulka qaxootiga, masiibooyinka cimilada, iyo iskahorimaadyada maxalliga ah, iyadoo saameynta ugu daran ay ka jirto dhulalka qalalan iyo kuwa nus-aroorka ah (ASALs). Meelaha ay daadadku u nugul yihiin iyo kuwa ay qaxootigu martigeliyaan ayaa weli ku jira cadaadis joogto ah.
Dholuo: Kenya ochung’ne chandruok maduong’ mar dhano ma kelo oro ma ng’eny, pi ma pong’o piny, tuoche ma ng’ato nyalo ng’ado, ng’anjo ma ng’ato nyalo ng’ado, ng’anjo mag piny, ng’anjo mag piny, kod lweny ma timore e alwora, ma kelo pek mang’eny ahinya e piny ma ng’ich kod ma ng’ich ahinya (ASALs).

English: TVET reminds youth in Machakos County that HELB funding is available for ICT skills training.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Machakos in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka xirfadaha ICT.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa rowere man Machakos County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar lony e yore mag ICT.

English: KALRO invites farmers in Nyamira County to a free training on greenhouse farming this June.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo cha chafu Juni hii.

Dholuo: KALRO ogwelo jopur e kaunti mar Nyamira e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar greenhouse agriculture e dwe mar Jun.

English: KALRO encourages farmers in Kisumu County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for fish.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora ya samaki.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kisumu inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo kalluunka ah.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kisumu mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mondo omi rech obed gi nengo maber.

English: Universities Fund urges residents of Kisii County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na ugawaji wa bursary.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan deeq waxbarasho.
Dholuo: University Fund jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kisii mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud michno.

English: Agriculture in South Sudan is going digital Farmers can access training videos on groundnut harvesting and maize row planting from local extension staff
Kiswahili: Kilimo nchini Sudan Kusini kinaendelea kidijitali Wakulima wanaweza kupata video za mafunzo kuhusu uvunaji wa karanga na upandaji mistari ya mahindi kutoka kwa wahudumu wa eneo hilo.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Kakamega County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha kusanyiko la kaunti ili kukaa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kakamega inay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda horumarinta degmada.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo jogweng' Kakamega County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo gibed gi weche mang'eny e wi chenro mag dongruok mag county.

English: Public notice: KEMRI will host a free proper sanitation outreach in Kajiado County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMRI itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mazingira bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Kajiado Julai hii.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya issues a cybersecurity alert on identity theft affecting residents of Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya hutoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya wizi wa kitambulisho unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa.

English: Notice: IEBC will hold a public participation forum on development planning forums in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.

Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inazindua mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay bilawday barnaamijyo horumarineed oo ku saleysan bulshada ee degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: EACC chako chenro mag dongruok e alwora mar Vihiga County.

English: Rotate soybean with maize or sorghum for soil fertility benefits and disease control.
Kiswahili: Badilisha soya na mahindi au mtama ili kuimarisha rutuba ya udongo na kuzuia magonjwa.

Kiswahili: HELB inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Novemba hii.
Somali: HELB waxay xusuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Kericho inay xoojiyaan adeegyada hagista iyo la talinta bisha November.

Kiswahili: Tangazo la uzinduzi wa kampeni ya "INATOSHA" ambayo inalenga kukomesha njaa ya watoto kwa kupanua milo shuleni, kilimo kinachozingatia hali ya hewa, na utetezi wa lishe.

Dholuo: Olando mar chako kampen mar "ENOUGH" ma nigi gombo mar tieko kech mar nyithindo kuom medo chiemo mag skul, pur ma rito piny, kod lando weche mag chiemo ma nigi gik ma konyo e ringruok.

Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC yazindua mpango wa usalama wa miundombinu ya shule katika shule kote Kaunti ya Nandi.

Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wananchi wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Nandi kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.

Kiswahili: SHA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi kwamba kufikia maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya launches a cattle rustling prevention campaign in Marsabit County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay billaabaneysaa olole looga hortago xanta xoolaha ee degmada Marsabit bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chako kampen mar geng'o ywaruok mag jamni e taon mar Marsabit e dwe mar Jun.

English: NCPB warns tea farmers in Narok County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawaonya wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Narok juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza uingiliaji kati kwa wakati.
Somali: NCPB waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee Gobolka Narok faafitaanka cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa faragelinta waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: NCPB chiwo siem ne jopur chai man Narok County kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ochiwo paro mar kawo okang' e kinde mowinjore.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Wilaya ya Tana River.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaan-hayaha xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la hagaajiyay waqtiga wareejinta codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Tana River.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties olando lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mag ng'eyo kit oganda e taon mar Tana River County.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges anyone experiencing abuse in Trans Nzoia County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unamhimiza mtu yeyote anayeona unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuripoti kesi kwa ofisi ya karibu ya jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada wuxuu ku boorinayaa qofkasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Trans Nzoia inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise.

English: Promote volunteerism 2025.
Kiswahili: Kuendeleza kujitolea mwaka 2025.
Somali: Horumarinta mutadawiciinta sanadka 2025.
Dholuo: Jiw tich mar chiwruok mar konyo e higa mar 2025.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds needy students in Migori County that revision guides applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Migori kwamba maombi ya marekebisho yanafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xasuusinaya ardayda u baahan Degmada Migori in dib u eegis lagu wado codsiyada la soo gabagabeeyay.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne jopuonjre modhier e County mar Migori ni lokruok mar gwelo kwayo mar dhi e skundno chiegni rumo.

English: Embu (Mbeere) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Embu (Mbeere): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2024
Somali: Degmada Embu (Mbeere): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Embu (Mbeere): Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Agost 2024

English: Communications Authority of Kenya warns residents of Taita-Taveta County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta juu ya kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Taita-Taveta kororka qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Communications Authority chiwo siem ne jogweng' Taita-Taveta County e wi medruok mar chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Murang'a County about a rise in identity theft and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a juu ya kuongezeka kwa wizi wa kitambulisho na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ka digaya dadka deggan degmada Murang'a kororka xadgudubka aqoonsiga wuxuuna kula talinayaa shacabka inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax falin.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations osiemo jogweng' mar County mar Murang'a kuom dongruok mar kuo mar kitgi kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: KALRO urges sheep farmers in Kakamega County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawataka wafugaji wa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kuripotiwa visa vya ugonjwa wa ngozi.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda idaha ee Gobolka Kakamega inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur ma pidho rombe e gweng' mar Kakamega mondo ochiw ripot ne jamni matuwo e bad thieth man machiegni kodgi bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag dhoot.

English: KEMRI urges residents of Nairobi County to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night following a rise in reported Rift Valley Fever cases.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kutumia vyandarua vilivyotiwa dawa za kuua wadudu kila usiku kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo cayayaannada habeen kasta ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska laga soo sheegay Cudurka Rift Valley.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng' Nairobi County mondo oti gi otamba molos gi yedhe makelo tuoche mag kute otieno ka otieno nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuwo mar Rift Valley Fever osemedore.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Kisii County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada ay fatahaadu ka dhacdo xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne jogweng' Kisii County ni kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o e kinde mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: Protect your baby's hearing by keeping them away from loud environments.
Kiswahili: Linda usikivu wa mtoto wako kwa kumzuia asisikie mazingira yenye kelele.
Somali: Ka ilaali maqalka ilmahaaga adigoo ka fogeynaya goobaha buuqa badan.
Dholuo: Rit winjo mar nyathini kuom ketogi mabor gi kuonde ma dwol winjore ahinya.

English: Wajir County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for January 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Wajir: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Januari 2024
Somali: Degmada Wajeer: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Janaayo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Wajir: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar achiel higa mar 2024

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) encourages farmers in Embu County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for avocado.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya parachichi.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Embu inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan avocado.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e county mar Embu mondo ous chiembgi mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo mondo giyud nengo maber mar avocado.

English: NTSA urges motorists and pedestrians in Tharaka-Nithi County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent landslides-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada daadadka ku dhacay si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira dhulgariirka.
Dholuo: NTSA ojiwo joidh mtokni kod joma wuotho e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o mondo kik gidonj e masiche motudore gi yiengni mag lowo.

English: KMTC encourages residents of Mandera County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya haki za kikatiba.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: KMTC jiwo jogweng'o mag Mandera County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiego ji mondo ging'e weche motudore gi ratiro mag chik.

English: E-Citizen reminds residents of Nairobi County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba upatikanaji wa utunzaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda ka sahlan tahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa jogweng' Nairobi County ni koro yot yudo weche mag loso nyasi mag nyuol ka gitiyo gi yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: NDMA urges the community in Homa Bay County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: NDMA inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada gobolka Homa Bay inay ku biiraan mashaariicda booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo xanta xoolaha.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo oganda manie Homa Bay County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polis mar oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o kwalo jamni.

English: Kenya Drought Response Plan 2023 at a Glance
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Kukabiliana na Ukame Kenya 2023 kwa Mtazamo
Somali: Qorshaha Ka Jawaabista Abaaraha Kenya 2023 Muuqaal Kooban
Dholuo: Chenro mar duoko piny oro e piny Kenya higa mar 2023 e wang'e matin

English: Ministry of Health reminds expectant mothers in Kitui County that access to postnatal check-ups is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba upatikanaji wa uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Kitui in helitaanka baaritaannada dhalmada ka dib ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne mine ma biro nyuolo e County mar Kitui ni thuolo mar dhi e nonro bang' nyuol en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag sirkal.

English: TSC releases guidelines for recruiting 44,000 teachers on permanent terms.
Kiswahili: TSC inatoa miongozo ya kuajiri walimu 44,000 kwa muda wa kudumu.
Somali: TSC waxay soo saartay tilmaamo lagu shaqaaleysiinayo 44,000 macallimiin oo waqti joogto ah.
Dholuo: TSC ogolo chike matayo tich mar keto jopuonj 44,000 e tich kuom kinde malach.

English: Notice: KTDA restricts movement of dairy cows in Mombasa County due to a foot and mouth disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA inazuia harakati za ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da caanaha ah ee gobolka Mombasa sababtuna tahay faafitaanka cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok makwayo chak e county mar Mombasa nikech tuwo mar dhoho.

English: FAO advises farmers in Homa Bay County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the November planting season.
Kiswahili: FAO inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay watumie kiwango kilichopendekezwa cha mbolea kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa kupanda mwezi Novemba.
Somali: FAO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Homa Bay in ay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beerto ee bisha November.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e Homa Bay County mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: IEBC launches the county integrated development plan in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika Wilaya ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay bilawday qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Bungoma.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IEBC chako chenro mar dongruok e alwora mar Bungoma County.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development encourages out-of-school children in Isiolo County to register their children at the nearest public school under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Ukuzaji wa Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada ayaa ku dhiirigelinaya carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Isiolo inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e Isiolo County mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni gi skul mar ji duto e klas mar somo kod somo.

English: The Cost of Living Crisis for Urban Displaced People in East Africa: The Role of Inclusive Social Protection
Kiswahili: Gharama ya Mgogoro wa Maisha kwa Watu Waliohamishwa Mijini katika Afrika Mashariki: Jukumu la Ulinzi wa Jamii Jumuishi.
Somali: Dhibaatada Qiimaha Nolosha ee Dadka Barakacayaasha ah ee Magaalooyinka ee Bariga Afrika: Doorka Ilaalinta Bulshada ee Loo Dhan Yahay
Dholuo: Pek mar Nengo mar Ngima ne Joma Owuok e Boma e Afrika ma Wuokchieng’: Tich mar Rito Oganda ma Oting’o Ji duto

English: Baringo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Baringo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2023
Somali: Degmada Baringo: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Baringo: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2023

English: Youth interested in agriculture can explore educational opportunities in hydroponics and farming technology Consider enrolling in courses at local agricultural institutions
Kiswahili: Vijana wanaopenda kilimo wanaweza kutafuta fursa za elimu katika hidroponics na teknolojia ya kilimo Fikiria kujiandikisha katika kozi katika taasisi za kilimo za ndani.
Somali: Dhalinyarada xiisaynaysa beeraha waxay sahmiyaan fursadaha waxbarasho ee hydroponics iyo tiknoolajiyada beeraha. Ka fiirso iska diiwaangelinta koorsooyinka hay'adaha beeraha ee maxalliga ah
Dholuo: Rowere mohero tijno nyalo puonjore weche mag somo mag hydroponics kod teknoloji mag pur.

English: KEMRI launches an August awareness campaign on hand hygiene across Baringo County.
Kiswahili: KEMRI yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Agosti juu ya usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: KEMRI waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Agoosto oo ku saabsan nadaafadda gacmaha ee Gobolka Baringo.
Dholuo: KEMRI chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Agost e wi ler mar lwete e gweng' mar Baringo.

English:
Did you know the Kenya Red Cross Society offers free on-call counselling services 24/7? Call us on 1199 and we will be there for you.

Since January-June 2019, our Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Services team attended to 513 calls.
Kiswahili: Je, unajua Jumuiya ya Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya inatoa huduma za ushauri wa bure 24/7? Tupigie simu 1199 na tutakuwa hapo kwa ajili yako. Tangu Januari-Juni 2019, timu yetu ya Huduma za Afya ya Akili na Msaada wa Saikolojia ilihudhuria simu 513.
Somali: Ma ogtahay in Kenya Red Cross Society ay bixiso adeegyo la-talin ah oo bilaash ah 24/7? Nala soo wac 1199 waxaanan kuu caawin doonnaa. Tan iyo Janaayo-Juun 2019, kooxdeena Adeegyada Taageerada Caafimaadka Maskaxda iyo Maskaxda ayaa ka qaybgalay 513 wicitaan.
Dholuo: Be ing'eyo ni Kenya Red Cross Society chiwo kony maonge chudo 24/7? Wuo kodwa e namba 1199 kendo wabiro konyi. Chakre Januar-June 2019, riwruok marwa mar weche thieth gi thieth mar paro ne otimo limbe 513.

English: ODPP reminds residents of Kwale County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: ODPP paronwa jogweng' Kwale County ni luwo dongruok mar tich kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Notice: KRA opens voter registration centres in Kericho County this July.
Kiswahili: KRA inafungua vituo vya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kericho Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay furaysaa xarumaha diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee degmada Kericho bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KRA biro yawo kuonde ma ji dhiyoe ne joma oyier e county mar Kericho e dwe mar Julai.

English: FAO advises farmers in Kilifi County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: FAO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: FAO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kilifi inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kalfadhiga tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e chokruok mabiro.

English: Kenya â€” Flow Monitoring Dashboard Round 4 (July-October 2025)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Dashibodi ya Ufuatiliaji wa Flow Raundi ya 4 (Julai-Oktoba 2025)
Somali: Wareegga 4aad ee Kormeerka Socodka Kenya (Luulyo-Oktoobar 2025)
Dholuo: Kenya â€” Dasbod mar Rang'o Pimo Raun 4 (Ajula-Apar 2025)

English: NDMA reminds residents of Kajiado County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado in warbixinta khiyaamooyinka si dhakhso leh ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogweng' Kajiado County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar wuond konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Create awareness. The month of June is a month of mental health for old men.
Kiswahili: Kujenga ufahamu. Mwezi wa Juni ni mwezi wa afya ya akili kwa wazee.
Somali: Isku day inaad ogaatid, bisha Juun waa bisha caafimaadka maskaxda ee dadka waayeelka ah.
Dholuo: Chiko ji mondo ong'e ni dwe mar Jun en dwe mar bedo gi ngima maber e pach joma hikgi ng'eny.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will conduct a fertiliser application workshop for farmers in Mandera County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itafanya warsha ya maombi ya mbolea kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan isticmaalka Bacriminta beeraleyda Degmada Mandera bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Rieko: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro timo workshop mar tiyo gi yien mag yien ne jopur e Mandera County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: The 12th Agritec Africa Conference will be held at KICC Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to participate
Kiswahili: Kongamano la 12 la Agritec Africa litafanyika KICC Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kushiriki.
Somali: Shirkii 12-aad ee Agritec Africa waxaa lagu qaban doonaa KICC Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha ayaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qaybgalaan
Dholuo: Chokruok mar 12 mar Agritec Africa ibiro tim e KICC Jo-Purche kod joma okendore e weche mag uso gik moko jiwo mondo oriwgi

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health warns of increased HIV/AIDS risk in Baringo County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya VVU/UKIMWI katika Kaunti ya Baringo na inashauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Talo-bixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ka digtay kororka halista HIV / AIDS ee Gobolka Baringo waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga ah mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.

English: Judiciary of Kenya announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Machakos County.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kurejesha huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Machakos.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la hagaajiyay waqtiga wareejinta adeegyada baasaboorka ee degmada Machakos.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya olando lokruok e seche mag tiyo gi passport e county mar Machakos.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Busia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri katika shule kote Kaunti ya Busia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay bilawday barnaamij adeegyo hagis iyo la-talin ah oo ku yaal dugsiyada gobolka Busia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Education chako chenro mar tayo kendo chiwo paro e skunde duto e County mar Busia.

English: Huduma Kenya encourages first-time voters in Kitui County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kitui kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Kitui inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jogo matimoga yiero mokwongo e County mar Kitui mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi kata pasipoti e odiechieng' mar yiero.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds expectant mothers in Kajiado County that access to free antenatal care is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma ya bure ya ujauzito ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Kajiado in helitaanka daryeelka uurka ka hor ee bilaashka ah uu yahay mid lacag la'aan ah dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa mine ma biro bedo gi ich e Kajiado County ni thuolo mar yudo rit ma onge chudo mar nyuol en maonge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: KALRO reminds residents of Tana River County that organic farming improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kwamba kilimo hai kinaboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Somali: KALRO waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River in beeraha dabiiciga ah uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: KALRO paronwa jogweng' mar Tana River County ni pur ma nigi yien ma ok oketie yien miyo puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association will hold a depression awareness forum in Migori County this August. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitafanya kongamano la uhamasishaji wa unyogovu katika Kaunti ya Migori Agosti hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha wacyiga dhimirka ee degmada Migori bisha August. Dhammaan waa soo dhaweynayaan.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni Kenya Medical Association biro timo chokruok mar chiwo paro e wi tuwo mar depression e taon mar Migori e dwe mar Agost.

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Trans Nzoia County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia inay biyo cabitaan ah ku kariyaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso jogweng' mar Trans Nzoia County ni mondo omak pi modho kapok gitiyo kode mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: KNCHR trains paralegals to support communities on legal rights.
Kiswahili: KNCHR inawazoeza wanasheria kusaidia jamii kuhusu haki za kisheria.
Somali: KNCHR waxay tababbartaa wakiilada sharciga si ay u taageeraan bulshooyinka xuquuqda sharciga.
Dholuo: KNCHR tiego jodong-kanyakla mondo okony oganda e weche mag ratiro mag chik.

English: KEMRI urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Tana River County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Tana River inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nyagore gi tuoche mag obwongo e taon mar Tana River County mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service warns cassava farmers in Isiolo County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Isiolo juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda cassava ee degmada Isiolo oo ku saabsan cudurrada cayayaanka wuxuuna kugula talinayaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho manias e gweng' mar Isiolo kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health: skilled birth attendance clinics will run every November at designated health centres in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya: kliniki za mahudhurio ya uzazi zenye ujuzi zitaendeshwa kila Novemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka: Xarumaha caafimaadka ee Gobolka Wajir waxaa lagu qaban doonaa Nofeembar kasta xarumo caafimaad oo xirfad leh.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth: Klinike mag rito nyuol ma nigi lony biro tiyo e dwe mar Novemba higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: NDMA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Tharaka-Nithi County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NDMA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa qofkasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Tharaka-Nithi inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: NDMA ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo onyis wachno e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Huduma Kenya invites residents of Mandera County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandaoni wa kaunti kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya gwelo jogweng'o mag Mandera County mondo oriwre kodgi kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e wi chenro mar bajet.

English: Call 719 for professional advice and information if you think you may have been exposed to COVID-19. #KomeshaCorona updates.
Kiswahili: Piga 719 kwa ushauri na maelezo ya kitaalamu ikiwa unafikiri kuwa unaweza kuwa umeambukizwa COVID-19. #KomeshaCorona sasisho.
Somali: Wac 719 si aad u hesho talo xirfadeed iyo macluumaad haddii aad u malaynayso inaad la kulantay COVID-19. #KomeshaCorona updates.
Dholuo: Goch namba 719 mondo iyud rieko kod weche mathoth ka iparo ni inyalo bedo ni iseyudo tuwo mar COVID-19. Oboke mag #KomeshaKorona.

English: Kenya: Don Bosco Center Makuyu renovates facilities thanks to donor funding from Salesian Missions
Kiswahili: Kenya: Kituo cha Don Bosco Makuyu kinakarabati vifaa kutokana na ufadhili wa wafadhili kutoka kwa Salesian Missions
Somali: Kenya: Xarunta Don Bosco ee Makuyu oo dayactiraysa xarumaha iyada oo ay ugu wacan tahay maalgelinta deeq-bixiyeyaasha ee ka timid Salesian Missions
Dholuo: Kenya: Kidieny mar Don Bosco Makuyu loso kuonde ma ji tiyoe kaluwore gi kony mar jochiw pesa kowuok kuom Mision mag Jo-Salesian

English: Notice: NDMA launches a theft prevention campaign in Nyandarua County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada gobolka Nyandarua bishii Janaayo.

English: SHA urges residents of Migori County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Migori kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa wilaya ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Migori inay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada si ay uga warqabaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jogweng' Migori County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo omed ng'eyo chenro mar dongruok e county.

English: The National Police Service commends the continued cooperation of local residents in supporting this initiative to enhance peace, security, and stability in the region.â€œWe encourage the public to maintain their support by providing information at their nearest police station, or by calling 999, 911, or 112.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Polisi ya Kitaifa inapongeza ushirikiano unaoendelea wa wakazi wa eneo hilo katika kusaidia mpango huu wa kuongeza amani, usalama, na utulivu katika mkoa.Tunawahimiza umma kudumisha msaada wao kwa kutoa habari kwenye kituo cha polisi cha karibu, au kwa kupiga simu 999, 911, au 112.
Somali: Adeegga Booliska Qaranka wuxuu ammaanayaa iskaashiga joogtada ah ee dadka deegaanka ee taageeraya hindisahaan lagu xoojinayo nabadda, amniga, iyo xasilloonida gobolka.â€œWaxaan ku dhiirigelinaynaa dadweynaha inay sii wadaan taageeradooda iyagoo macluumaad ka bixinaya saldhigga booliiska ee ugu dhow, ama wacaya 999, 911, ama 112.
Dholuo: Ofis mar polisi mag pinyno goyo erokamano ne dhi nyime gi riwruok mar jodak mag alworano e konyo chenro ni mondo okel kuwe, arita, kod ler e alwora.

English: Agriculture employs 65 percent of the working population on the continent, accounting for 15 percent of gross domestic product and 40 percent of export earnings ...
Kiswahili: Kilimo kinaajiri asilimia 65 ya watu wanaofanya kazi barani, uhasibu kwa asilimia 15 ya pato la taifa na asilimia 40 ya mapato ya mauzo ya nje ...
Somali: Beeraha waxay shaqaaleysiisaa 65 boqolkiiba dadka shaqeeya ee qaaradda, taasoo ka dhigan 15 boqolkiiba alaabta guud ee gudaha iyo 40 boqolkiiba dakhliga dhoofinta ...
Dholuo: Tij pur tiyo gi pasent 65 mar ji duto matiyo e pinyno, kendo en e ma okelo pasent 15 mar GDP kod pasent 40 mar ohala duto ma ouso e pinje mamoko...

English: Announcement that the Kenya National Commission on Human rights to include mental health in its services as part of human rights
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwamba Tume ya Kitaifa ya Haki za Binadamu ya Kenya kuingiza afya ya akili katika huduma zake kama sehemu ya haki za binadamu
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida in Guddiga Qaranka Kenya ee Xuquuqda Aadanaha uu adeegyadiisa ku daro caafimaadka dhimirka qayb ka mid ah xuquuqda aadanaha
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya National Commission on Human Rights mondo oriw weche thieth mar pach e tije kaka achiel kuom yore mag rito ratiro mag dhano

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief October 2025
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP Kenya Oktoba 2025
Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya Oktoobar 2025
Dholuo: Wach machuok mar piny Kenya dwe mar apar higa mar 2025

English: This fathers' day, it is good to ensure mental health for them because their mental health is important. Take more of your time for your mental health and seeking for help when you need it.
Kiswahili: Siku hii ya baba, ni vizuri kuwahakikishia afya ya akili kwa sababu afya yao ya akili ni muhimu.
Somali: Maalinta aabbayaasha, waa wax wanaagsan in la hubiyo caafimaadka maskaxda ee caruurta maxaa yeelay caafimaadkooda maskaxda ayaa muhiim ah. Waqti badan u qaad caafimaadkaaga maskaxda iyo caawimaad raadinta marka aad u baahan tahay.
Dholuo: E odiechieng'ni mar wuone, ber mondo ikonygi bedo gi paro mowinjore nikech paro ma gin-go en gima duong'.

English: KEPHIS urges maize growers in Nyandarua County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawasihi wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurudisha uzazi wa udongo ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee gobolka Nyandarua inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur ma pidho cham e kaunti mar Nyandarua mondo otim lokruok e puodho mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber kendo mondo omi nyak obed maber e higani.

English: MoH reaffirms Kenyaâ€™s commitment to spearheading East African food environment policies including front-of-pack labeling.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inathibitisha tena kujitolea kwa Kenya kuongoza sera za mazingira ya chakula za Afrika Mashariki, ikiwa ni pamoja na kuweka lebo ya mbele ya ufungaji.
Somali: Wasaaradda Maaliyadda ayaa xaqiijinaysa sida ay Kenya uga go'an tahay inay hormuud ka noqoto siyaasadaha deegaanka cuntada ee Bariga Afrika oo ay ku jiraan calaamadaynta alaabta.
Dholuo: MoH onyiso kendo ng'uono mar piny Kenya mar telo ne chike mag alwora mag chiemo mag Afrika ma Wuokchieng' ma oting'o keto lembâ€TM e nyim chiemo.

English: AFA informs horticultural produce farmers in Tana River County of new market linkage opportunities this December.
Kiswahili: AFA inawafahamisha wakulima wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Desemba hii.
Somali: AFA waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda wax soo saarka beeraha ee degmada Tana River fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: AFA nyiso jopur ma loso puothe mag puothe e taon mar Tana River County e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee Gobolka Mombasa.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya oseyawo kamachielo mar e-Citizen registration e county mar Mombasa.

English: NPS warns residents of Tana River County to prepare for possible landslides this October.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa maporomoko ya ardhi Oktoba hii.
Somali: NPS waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay u diyaar garoobaan dhulgariir dhici kara bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: NPS osiemo jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo oikre ne yiengni mag lowo mabiro timore e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: KALRO reminds livestock keepers in Bungoma County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KALRO waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Bungoma inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KALRO paronwa jorit jamni e County mar Bungoma mondo ogeng' jamni maggi e kuonde moketi mag nego jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) launches a September awareness campaign on safe water storage across Tana River County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Septemba juu ya uhifadhi wa maji salama katika Kaunti ya Tana River.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa bilaabay olole wacyi galineed bishii Sebtember oo ku saabsan kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee Gobolka Tana River.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Septemba kuom wach kano pi maler e taon duto mar Tana River County.

English: ODPP reminds voters in Kwale County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of voter education.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kwale kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya elimu ya wapiga Kura.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Kwale inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor inta aysan helin waxbarasho codbixinayaasha.
Dholuo: ODPP oparo ne josiasa man Kwale County mondo olim kama ichanoe IEBC machiegni kodgi kapok gipuonjogi.

English: NPS reminds residents of Mandera County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera in warbixinta degdegga ah ee xanta xoolaha ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NPS oparo ne jogweng' Mandera County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo jamni konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Wananchi katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska diiwaan-hayaha xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa furaya goob adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-muwaadiniinta degmada Lamu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag e-Citizen registration e County mar Lamu.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges residents of Uasin Gishu County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Uasin Gishu kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga lagu soo gabagabeeyay si loo qaabeeyo wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo jogweng' mar Uasin Gishu County mondo ochiw weche mondik kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso chenro mag chenro mag sirkal ochopo.

English: NCPB advises farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the October planting season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Oktoba.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Oktoobar.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok chon kapok ochopo dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Kenya signs six Global Fund grants amounting to Sh59.7 billion to support HIV, TB and malaria interventions; funding to strengthen health and community systems over three years.
Kiswahili: Kenya yasaini ruzuku sita za Mfuko wa Kimataifa zenye thamani ya Sh59.7 bilioni kusaidia uingiliaji kati wa VVU, Kifua Kikuu na malaria; ufadhili wa kuimarisha mifumo ya afya na jamii kwa miaka mitatu.
