Somali: Kenya waxay saxiixday lix deeq oo ka timid Sanduuqa Caalamiga ah oo dhan Sh59.7 bilyan si ay u taageerto talaabooyinka HIV, TB iyo malaria; maalgelinta si loo xoojiyo nidaamyada caafimaadka iyo bulshada muddo saddex sano ah.
Dholuo: Kenya oseyie gi chiwo auchiel mag Global Fund ma romo Sh59.7 bilion mondo okony e tieko tuoche mag HIV, TB kod malaria; pesa mar tego chenro mag thieth kod oganda kuom higini adek.

English: CDC appeals to caregivers in Taita-Taveta County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the April maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Aprili.
Somali: CDC waxay u baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Taita-Taveta inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Abriil.
Dholuo: CDC kwayo jorit e Taita-Taveta County mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongruok kaka achiel kuom chenro mar April mar rito ngima mar mine.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages mothers in Garissa County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Garissa kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Garissa inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo mine manie County mar Garissa mondo olim kama giwuokie machiegni mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Kenya reports record daily jump in Covid-19 cases; 123 new infections from 3,077 samples tested.
Kiswahili: Kenya inaripoti ongezeko kubwa la visa vya Covid-19 kila siku; maambukizi mapya 123 kutoka kwa sampuli 3,077 zilizopimwa.
Somali: Kenya waxay soo bandhigtay kororka maalinlaha ah ee kiisaska COVID-19; 123 cudurrood oo cusub oo laga soo qaatay 3,077 shaybaar oo la tijaabiyay.
Dholuo: Kenya wacho ni pile ka pile ji mang'eny yudo tuo mar Covid-19; ji 123 manyien yudo tuwono kuom ranyisi 3,077 ma osetimo nonro.

English: CDC launches a February awareness campaign on tobacco control across Kwale County.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Februari juu ya udhibiti wa tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: CDC waxay bilawday olole wacyi galineed bishii Febraayo ee ka dhanka ah xakamaynta sigaarka ee Gobolka Kwale.
Dholuo: CDC chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Februar e wi thieth mar ndawa e alwora mar Kwale County.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Kakamega County that reporting carjacking promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba kuripoti utekaji nyara mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan baabuurta la xaday ay gacan ka geystaan ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne jogweng' Kakamega County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo mtokni konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Universities Fund reminds parents in Busia County that school feeding programme registration is open this September.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba usajili wa mpango wa kulisha shule umefunguliwa Septemba hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu xusuusinayaa waalidiinta degmada Busia in diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga ay furan tahay bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund parone jonyuol e County mar Busia ni chenro mar somo e skul mar chiemo nyithindo ochakore e dwe mar Septemba.

English: COMESA warns sweet potatoes farmers in Uasin Gishu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawaonya wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: COMESA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda baradho macaan ee Gobolka Uasin Gishu cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: COMESA chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho adundo e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: OGP encourages first-time voters in Meru County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: OGP inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Meru kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu.
Somali: OGP waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Meru inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogo madwaro yiero mokwongo e county mar Meru mondo olim kama ichanoe IEBC machiegni kodgi.

English: KMTC invites youth in Bomet County to enroll for catering and hospitality training this January.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Bomet kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu Januari hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Bomet inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: KMTC gwelo rowere e county mar Bomet mondo odonj e tiegruok mar chiemo kod rwako welo e dwe mar Januar.

English: Judiciary of Kenya advises residents of Lamu County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya nyiso jogweng' County mar Lamu mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet ka gitiyo gi websait mar e-Citizen.

English: IPOA warns residents of Busia County about a rise in identity theft and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia juu ya kuongezeka kwa wizi wa kitambulisho na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: IPOA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia kororka xadgudubka aqoonsiga waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: IPOA chiwo siem ne jogweng' County mar Busia e wi medruok mar kuo mar kitgi kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds needy students in Tana River County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Tana River kwamba maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada ayaa xasuusinaya ardayda u baahan degmada Tana River in buugaagta waxbarasho iyo codsiyada qalabka waxbarasho ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne jopuonjre man Tana River County ni buk mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok biro rumo machiegni.

English: Roll-out of school-based playgrounds to promote active breaks and reduce sedentary behavior in children.
Kiswahili: Kuanzishwa kwa viwanja vya michezo vya shule ili kuendeleza mapumziko ya kazi na kupunguza tabia ya watoto ya kuketi.
Somali: Soo bandhigida goobaha lagu ciyaaro ee dugsiyada si loo dhiirrigeliyo fasaxyada firfircoon iyo in la yareeyo habdhaqanka fadhiga ee carruurta.
Dholuo: Tiyo gi kuonde tugo e skul mondo okony nyithindo obed gi thuolo mar yueyo kendo giduog chien.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on residents of Migori County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of national peace-building.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inatoa wito kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kando ya maeneo ya mpakani kwa vyombo vya usalama kuunga mkono ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ugu baaqay dadka deggan degmada Migori inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga dhaqdhaqaaq aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah si ay u taageeraan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations okwayo jogweng' Migori County mondo onyis sirkande mag sirkal gik ma timore e alwora mar tong' mondo okony e loso kuwe e piny.

English: Kenya Price Bulletin, August 2024
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Bei ya Kenya, Agosti 2024
Somali: War-saxaafadeedka Qiimaha Kenya, Ogosto 2024
Dholuo: Oboke mar Nengo mar Kenya, dwe mar aboro higa mar 2024

English: Making use of science in agriculture can bring changes: thre application of genetic modification technology can be used to develop..
Kiswahili: Kutumia sayansi katika kilimo kunaweza kuleta mabadiliko: matumizi ya teknolojia ya urekebishaji wa maumbile yanaweza kutumika kuendeleza..
Somali: Ka faa'iideysashada cilmiga beeraha waxay keeni kartaa isbeddelo: saddex adeegsiga tiknoolajiyada wax ka beddelka hidde-sideyaasha ayaa loo isticmaali karaa horumarinta..
Dholuo: Tiyo gi sayans e weche mag pur nyalo kelo lokruok: tiyo gi teknoloji mag loko kit ngima dhano nyalo konyo e loso...

English: Kenya: Fostering sustainable peace and development in Tiaty through collaboration with professional organisations
Kiswahili: Kenya: Kukuza amani na maendeleo endelevu katika Tiaty kupitia ushirikiano na mashirika ya kitaaluma
Somali: Kenya: Kobcinta nabadda iyo horumarka waara ee Tiaty iyada oo loo marayo iskaashi lala yeesho ururada xirfadlayaasha ah
Dholuo: Kenya: Keto kuwe kod dongruok ma nyaka chieng’ e piny Tiaty kokalo kuom riwruok gi riwruoge ma nigi lony

English: KEPHIS reminds livestock keepers in Narok County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Narok kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee gobolka Narok in ay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska xayawaanada ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KEPHIS paronwa jorit jamni e gweng' mar Narok ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: We have three recoveries To flatten the curve further; Keep physical distance Frequently wash hands with soap and running water Stay at home unless you are an essential service. #StaySafe. #KomesaCorona
Kiswahili: Tuna ahueni tatu Ili kurefusha curve zaidi; Weka umbali wa kimwili Nawa mikono mara kwa mara kwa sabuni na maji yanayotiririka Kaa nyumbani isipokuwa kama huduma muhimu. #KaaSalama. #KomesaCorona
Somali: Waxaan haynaa saddex bogsasho Si aan u sii simno qalooca; Ka fogow masaafada jirka Si joogto ah gacmaha ugu dhaq saabuun iyo biyo socda. Guriga joog haddii aadan ahayn adeeg muhiim ah. #JoogSafe. #KomesaCorona
Dholuo: Wabedo gi dwoko adek Mondo wamed loso curve; Ket thuolo mar ng’ato gi ng’ato Los lwedo kinde ka kinde gi sabun kod pi ma ng’ich Bed e ot mak mana ka in ng’at ma tiyo e tich ma dwarore. #Bed gi arita makare. #KomesaKorona

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the public in Kirinyaga County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadweynaha Gobolka Kirinyaga inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada lacagta mobilada.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ji duto e County mar Kirinyaga mondo ochiw ripot mar ote manyalo kelo hinyruok ne jatendgi ka luwore gi ripot ma ne ochiw kuom timbe mag wuondo pesa e simo.

English: Notice: FAO will open a maize collection centre in Nyamira County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mahindi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay furi doontaa xarun ururinta hadhuudhka ee Gobolka Nyamira bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: FAO biro yawo kambi mar choko cham e taon mar Nyamira e dwe mar Jun.

English: News about market access, tips on production on land...reduced competition on markets on national scale. Forehead plan on kenya....
Kiswahili: Habari kuhusu upatikanaji wa soko, vidokezo juu ya uzalishaji katika ardhi...punguzo la ushindani katika masoko kwa kiwango cha kitaifa.
Somali: Wararka ku saabsan helitaanka suuqyada, talooyin ku saabsan wax soo saarka dhulka... hoos u dhaca tartanka suuqa heer qaran.
Dholuo: Wach e wi wach donjo e ohala, weche ma nyiso kaka wanyalo tiyo gi lowo e timo ohala... kwan mar joma piem e ohandgi osedok chien e okang' malach e piny mangima.

English: KTDA urges goats farmers in Embu County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawataka wafugaji wa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Embu kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa ngozi ya uvimbe.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda orgiga ee degmada Embu inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur ma pidho diek e county mar Embu mondo ochiw ripot ne jamni matuwo man machiegni gi kama thieth mar le yudoree bang' ka osenyis ni nitie tuoche mang'eny mag pien.

English: Building partnerships with counties strengthens accountability. Say no to graft.
Kiswahili: Kujenga ushirikiano na kaunti huimarisha uwajibikaji.
Somali: Dhismaha iskaashi la leh degmooyinka waxay xoojineysaa mas'uuliyadda.
Dholuo: Bedo gi winjruok maber gi pinje mamoko miyo wabedo gi ting' mar kawo okang'.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development announces distribution of school laptops under the digital literacy programme to schools in Kakamega County this March.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inatangaza usambazaji wa kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kidijitali kwa shule za Kaunti ya Kakamega mwezi huu wa Machi.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada Waxbarashada ayaa ku dhawaaqay qeybinta kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee dugsiyada Gobolka Kakamega bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development olando ni gibiro pogo kompyuta mag skul e bwo chenro mar somo gi somo mar digital e skunde man Kakamega County e dwe mar Mach.

English: KEPHIS urges farmers in Wajir County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Wajir inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo lagu soo ururiyo biyaha beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Wajir mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok ma timore e kaka koth chue.

English: Feeding the future: Africa surges ahead on school meals
Kiswahili: Kulisha siku zijazo: Afrika inasonga mbele kwa chakula cha shule
Somali: Quudinta mustaqbalka: Afrika ayaa si weyn ugu soo badanaysa cuntada iskuulka
Dholuo: Chiemo ne kinde mabiro: Afrika dhi nyime e weche mag chiemo mag skul

English: The launch of development to catalyze change by including mental health education, examination, organizations and joint awareness among workers
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa maendeleo ili kuchochea mabadiliko kwa kujumuisha elimu ya afya ya akili, uchunguzi, mashirika na uelewa wa pamoja miongoni mwa wafanyakazi
Somali: Bilaabidda horumarinta si loo kiciyo isbeddelka iyadoo lagu darayo waxbarashada caafimaadka dhimirka, baaritaanka, ururada iyo wacyigelinta wadajirka ah ee shaqaalaha
Dholuo: Ochako dongruok mondo okel lokruok kuom keto somo mar thieth mar paro, penj, riwruoge kod ng’eyo maromre e kind jotich

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit calls on parents in Laikipia County to have children under five screened for Rift Valley Fever during the April outreach.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuwachunguza watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa wakati wa ufikiaji wa Aprili.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay waalidiinta degmada Laikipia ugu baaqeysaa in carruurta ka yar shan sano la sameeyo baaritaanka Cudurka Rift Valley inta lagu gudajiro bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit okwayo jonyuol e County mar Laikipia mondo otim nonro mar Rift Valley Fever ne nyithindo ma hikgi tin ne abich e dwe mar April.

English: Ministry of Health encourages residents of Marsabit County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay ugu yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health ojiwo jogweng' mar Marsabit County mondo kik gisandgi ka giol kendo mondo giluong kony mar thieth mar chuny maonge chudo.

English: E-Citizen reminds the public in Kiambu County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this September.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba ushiriki katika mashauriano ya sera za umma unakaribishwa Septemba hii.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kiambu in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha la soo dhaweynayo bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa ji duto e County mar Kiambu ni ji duto mor gi chiwo mag paro e wi chenro mag sirkal e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development warns wheat farmers in Garissa County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawaonya wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Garissa juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda sarreenka ee Gobolka Garissa cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development osiemo jopur mag ngano e County mar Garissa kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim gik moko e kinde mowinjore.

English: Ministry of Education holds awareness workshops on inclusive education targeting school managers and community leaders.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inafanya semina za ufahamu juu ya elimu ya pamoja inayolenga wasimamizi wa shule na viongozi wa jamii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsiyo ku saabsan waxbarashada ka kooban oo bartilmaameedsanaya maamulayaasha dugsiyada iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha bulshada.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Puonjruok dhi nyime gi tiegruok e wi somo moriwo ji duto moriwo nyaka jotend skul kod jotelo mag oganda.

English: Public launch event held to introduce the MoreMilk 2 initiative intended to enhance milk handling and market access in key milk-producing counties.
Kiswahili: Hafla ya uzinduzi wa hadhara ilifanyika ili kutambulisha mpango wa MoreMilk2 unaolenga kuboresha utunzaji wa maziwa na upatikanaji wa soko katika kaunti muhimu zinazozalisha maziwa.
Somali: Munaasabad lagu daah-furayay dadweynaha ayaa loo qabtay si loogu soo bandhigo hindisaha MoreMilk 2 oo loogu talagalay in lagu wanaajiyo maaraynta caanaha iyo helitaanka suuqa ee degmooyinka muhiimka ah ee soo saara caanaha.
Dholuo: E chokruok mar keto chak e wang’ ji duto ma ne otim mondo onyis chenro mar MoreMilk 2 ma ne ochung’ne bero kaka itiyo gi chak kod yudo chiro e kaunti madongo ma kelo chak.

English: TSC reminds schools in Baringo County to strengthen school infrastructure safety this June.
Kiswahili: TSC inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuimarisha usalama wa miundombinu ya shule Juni hii.
Somali: TSC waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Baringo inay xoojiyaan ammaanka kaabayaasha dugsiga bisha Juun.
Dholuo: TSC paronwa skunde mag Baringo County mondo omed jiwo ritruok mar chenro mag skul e dwe mar Jun.

English: Public notice: Kenya Medical Association will host a free safe water storage outreach in Turkana County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa kuhifadhi maji salama katika Kaunti ya Turkana Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu martigelin doonaa adeeg lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee degmada Turkana bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association biro timo kampen mar choko pi maonge chudo e taon mar Turkana e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Did you know that all KRA Services are free?  You can receive our services from our contact centre, KRA offices or Huduma Center near you  Find out more here
Kiswahili: Je, unajua kwamba Huduma zote za KRA ni bure? Unaweza kupokea huduma zetu kutoka kituo chetu cha mawasiliano, ofisi za KRA au Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu nawe. Pata maelezo zaidi hapa.
Somali: Ma ogtahay in dhammaan Adeegyada KRA ay yihiin lacag la'aan? Waxaad ka heli kartaa adeegyadeena xarunteena xiriirka, xafiisyada KRA ama Xarunta Huduma ee kuugu dhow Halkan ka sii aqri
Dholuo: Be ing'eyo ni tije duto mag KRA gin maonge chudo?

English: Young farmers in Tanzania can enhance crop productivity through better access to ICT and research extension services Seek out local programs that facilitate these technologies
Kiswahili: Wakulima vijana nchini Tanzania wanaweza kuongeza tija ya mazao kupitia upatikanaji bora wa TEHAMA na utafiti wa huduma za ugani Tafuta programu za ndani zinazowezesha teknolojia hizi.
Somali: Beeraleyda da'da yar ee Tanzania waxay kor u qaadi karaan wax-soo-saarka dalagga iyagoo helaya helitaanka ICT iyo adeegyada fidinta cilmi-baarista Raadi barnaamijyo maxalli ah oo fududeeya teknoolojiyadan
Dholuo: Jo-Puritan ma rowere e piny Tanzania nyalo medo nyak mar cham ka gitiyo gi yore mag ICT kod yore mag medo timo nonro.

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief September 2025
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP Kenya Septemba 2025
Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya Sebtembar 2025
Dholuo: Wach machuok mar piny Kenya dwe mar apar gi ariyo dwe mar 2025

English: ODPP urges residents of Samburu County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ili kupambana na ufisadi wa fedha za umma.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Samburu inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u soo gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago xadgudubka lacagta dadweynaha.
Dholuo: ODPP ojiwo jogweng' Samburu County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot mar intanet e chiwo ng'ur mar kedo gi ketho pesa mag sirkal.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response urges residents of Turkana County to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility following a rise in reported typhoid cases.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya matumbo vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay si dhakhso leh u raadsadaan baaritaano xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska la soo sheegay ee cudurka typhoid.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' County mar Turkana mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuwo mar typhoid osemedore.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General launches county development projects in West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu huzindua miradi ya maendeleo ya wilaya katika wilaya ya West Pokot.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu bilaabay mashaariic horumarineed oo ka socda gobolka West Pokot.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Auditor General chako tich mar timo dongruok e gweng' mar West Pokot County.

English: Notice: Universities Fund announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku dhawaaqay taariikhda diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ee dugsiyada gobolka Bomet.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Yunivasiti Fund landoga tarik mag dhi e skunde mag Bomet County.

English: Institutionalisation of the alternative justice system in Mandera County, Kenya
Kiswahili: Kuanzishwa kwa mfumo wa haki mbadala katika Kaunti ya Mandera, Kenya
Somali: Hay'adeynta nidaamka cadaaladda ee kale ee Degmada Mandheera, Kenya
Dholuo: Keto chenro mar ratiro marach mopogore e gweng' mar Mandera, piny Kenya

English: Teachers Service Commission conducts nationwide capacity-building sessions for teachers on blended learning methodologies.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafanya vikao vya kujenga uwezo wa kitaifa kwa walimu juu ya mbinu za ujifunzaji wa mchanganyiko.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu macalimiinta u qabtaa fadhiyada dhismaha awoodaha ee waddanka oo dhan ku saabsan hababka barashada isku dhafan.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission timo chokruoge mag tiego jopuonj e piny mangima e wi yore mag puonjruok moting'o puonj.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Nyandarua County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this August.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Agosti hii.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ka digaya dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay u diyaariyaan dabka laga yaabo inuu ka dhaco bisha August.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations osiemo jogweng' Nyandarua County ni giikre ne mach manyalo bedoe e dwe mar Agost.

English: DCI calls on the community in Trans Nzoia County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatia moyo jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: DCI waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan waxayna wici doonaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: DCI okwayo ji duto modak e Trans Nzoia County mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response urges residents of Mombasa County to complete the full recommended vaccination dose following a rise in reported measles cases.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya surua vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa inay dhammaystiraan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo ka dib kororka kiisaska suuxdinta ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Mombasa mondo ochop e okang' malach mar thieth ma gichiwo bang' ka kwan mar ji ma nigi tuwono osemedore.

English: Kenya Dairy Board warns cassava farmers in Kwale County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa manii katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuhusu mlipuko wa wadudu na kupendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda cassava ee Gobolka Kwale cudurrada cayayaanka waxaana uu ku talinayaa in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board chiwo siem ne jopur mag cassava man Kwale County kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: KUCCPS advises students in Nyamira County to collect materials from the county education office to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kukusanya vifaa kutoka ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ardayda degmada Nyamira kula talineysaa inay ka soo ururiyaan xogta xafiiska waxbarashada ee degmada si ay u helaan buugaag waxbarasho iyo waxyaabo waxbarasho.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo jopuonjre e County mar Nyamira mondo ochok gik moko moa e ofis mar tiegruok mar county mondo giyud buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok.

English: Teachers Service Commission calls on the community in Kisii County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa ugu baaqay bulshada degmada Kisii inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda ee carruurta 116 si ay u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj kwayo ji duto e County mar Kisii mondo omany namba mar 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Consider therapy or counseling. A mental health professional can provide strategies to cope with stigma and help you develop a positive self-image
Kiswahili: Fikiria tiba au ushauri nasaha. Mtaalamu wa afya ya akili anaweza kutoa mikakati ya kukabiliana na unyanyapaa na kukusaidia kukuza taswira chanya ya wewe mwenyewe
Somali: Tixgeli daaweynta ama la talinta. Khabiir caafimaad maskaxeed ayaa ku siin kara xeelado lagu xakameyn karo cayayaanka oo kaa caawin kara inaad horumariso dareenka wanaagsan ee naftaada
Dholuo: Ng'at molony e weche thieth nyalo konyi ng'eyo kaka inyalo nyagori gi achaya kendo onyalo konyi bedo gi paro mowinjore e wi ngimani

English: Notice: OGP launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Isiolo County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ka dhanka ah gobolka Isiolo bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Par ane: OGP chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Isiolo e dwe mar Mach.

English: Encourage the adoption of drought-resistant crop varieties, improved irrigation techniques, and sustainable farming practices to reduce vulnerability to drought.
Kiswahili: Kuhimiza kupitishwa kwa aina za mazao yanayostahimili ukame, mbinu bora za umwagiliaji, na mbinu endelevu za kilimo ili kupunguza hatari ya ukame.
Somali: Dhiirrigelin in la qaato noocyada dalagyada adkaysiga abaaraha, farsamooyinka waraabka la hagaajiyay, iyo hababka beeraleyda waara si loo yareeyo nuglaanta abaaraha.
Dholuo: Jiw mondo oti gi kit yiende ma ok nyal yud yiende, oti gi yore mag yweyo kod yore mag pur ma ok nyal geng'o kech mondo omi ji kik bed gi tuoche.

English: FAO urges maize growers in Kisumu County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawahimiza wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Kisumu inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka xilliga dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma pidho cham e gweng' mar Kisumu mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e kinde mag koth koth ka gitiyo gi thieth mag thieth ma giyiego mondo okony e medo nyak mar yien e higani.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night following a rise in reported HIV/AIDS cases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na dawa za kuua wadudu kila usiku kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya VVU/UKIMWI.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta ka dib kororka kiisaska HIV / AIDS ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit ojiwo jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo oti gi otamba ma thiedhgo kute otieno ka otieno nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuo mar HIV/AIDS osemedore.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Siaya County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha kwa jamii.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Siaya inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi tuoche mag pach e county mar Siaya mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: E-Citizen updates residents of Murang'a County on progress of the county integrated development plan this September.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti hii mwezi Septemba.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay dadka deggan degmada Murang'a ku wargelineysaa horumarka qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafka ah ee degmada bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: E-Citizen miyo ji duto modak e County mar Murang'a ng'eyo kaka chenro mar dongruok mar county integrated development dhi nyime e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds farmers in Isiolo County of the ongoing modern irrigation techniques training programme.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya mbinu za umwagiliaji.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa beeraleyda degmada Isiolo barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service parone jopur man Isiolo County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar yore mag lero pi.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya alerts residents of Turkana County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana juu ya kuongezeka kwa visa vya utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay uga digtay dadka deggan degmada Turkana in ay ka badan yihiin kiisaska gaadiidka la xaday waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Communications Authority chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar Turkana County kuom wach medruok mar wuondo mtokni kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: NDMA calls on residents of Nandi County to support local peace-building committees in support of border security.
Kiswahili: NDMA inatoa wito kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kuunga mkono kamati za kujenga amani za mitaa katika kuunga mkono usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: NDMA waxay dadka deggan degmada Nandi ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta ee deegaanka si ay u taageerayaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: NDMA okwayo ji duto modak e county mar Nandi mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gwenge ma giwuokie.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ku qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee Gobolka Nairobi.
Dholuo: Rieko: Ofis mar Jorit-Jasomo Maduong' biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e taon mar Nairobi.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa simu ya GBV ya bure katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay furtay xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Red Cross oseyawo ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo chenro mar tiyo gi simo maonge chudo mar GBV e Taita-Taveta County.

English: Ministry of Education announces distribution of textbooks and learning materials to schools in Bungoma County this April.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu yatangaza usambazaji wa vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Aprili hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa ku dhawaaqday qaybinta buugaagta iyo qalabka wax lagu barto dugsiyada degmada Bungoma bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok e skunde man Bungoma County e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Nairobi County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi diiwaangelinta beeraleyda loogu talagalay beeralayda degmada Nairobi bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro timo rapar mar jopur e dwe mar Desemba e kaunti mar Nairobi.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds the public in Uasin Gishu County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu dadka ku nool gobolka Uasin Gishu xusuusinayaa in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone ji duto e county mar Uasin Gishu ni chiwo ripot mar kawo asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: NCIC forms new peace committees to address local conflicts.
Kiswahili: NCIC inaunda halmashauri mpya za amani kushughulikia migogoro ya ndani.
Somali: NCIC waxay sameynaysaa guddiyada nabadda cusub si ay wax uga qabtaan khilaafaadka deegaanka.
Dholuo: NCIC loso komiti manyien mag loso kuwe mondo okony e tieko ywaruok manie alworano.

English: Over 1 000 cotton farmers in Yatta Sub County have received pesticides and modern sprayers to enhance cotton production Farmers should utilize these resources to improve yields and manage pests effectively
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya wakulima 1,000 wa pamba katika Kaunti Ndogo ya Yatta wamepokea dawa za kuulia wadudu na vinyunyizio vya kisasa ili kuimarisha uzalishaji wa pamba Wakulima wanapaswa kutumia rasilimali hizi ili kuboresha mavuno na kudhibiti wadudu ipasavyo.
Somali: In ka badan 1,000 beeraley suuf ah oo ku nool Yatta Sub County ayaa helay sunta cayayaanka iyo buufiyeyaasha casriga ah si loo kordhiyo wax-soo-saarka suufka. Beeraleydu waa inay isticmaalaan kheyraadkan si ay u kordhiyaan wax-saarka loona maamulaan cayayaanka si hufan
Dholuo: Jolony - puothe ma romo 1,000 e gweng ' mar Yatta Sub oseloso yedhe mamero kod masin mag goyo remo ma sani itiyogo e medo loso puothe.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds livestock keepers in Kwale County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya xoolaha ka shaqeeya Gobolka Kwale inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda goobaha lagu burburiyo ee loo qoondeeyay si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board parone jorit jamni e county mar Kwale mondo ogeng' jamni maggi e kuonde moketi mag goyo jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: Multi-Sector Needs Assessment (MSNA): Host Communities and Affected Populations in Garissa, Mandera, Marsabit & Turkana Counties | June 2025
Kiswahili: Tathmini ya Mahitaji ya Sekta Mbalimbali (MSNA): Jumuiya Wenyeji na Idadi ya Watu Walioathirika katika Kaunti za Garissa, Mandera, Marsabit & Turkana | Juni 2025
Somali: Qiimaynta Baahiyaha Qaybaha Badan (MSNA): Bulshooyinka Martida loo yahay iyo Dadka ay Saameysay ee Degmooyinka Garissa, Mandheera, Marsabit & Turkana | Juun 2025
Dholuo: Multi-Sector Needs Assessment (MSNA): Host Communities and Affected Populations in Garissa, Mandera, Marsabit & Turkana Counties | dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2025

English: NTSA reminds the public in Meru County to remain vigilant on counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: NTSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Meru kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Meru inay ka feejignaadaan ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: NTSA parone ji duto manie County mar Meru mondo omed bedo motang' e weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Farmers in Uganda can benefit from the new nucleus farmer model connecting them to mechanization financing and markets Contact your local District Agricultural Extension Officer for more information
Kiswahili: Wakulima nchini Uganda wanaweza kunufaika kutokana na mtindo mpya wa mkulima unaowaunganisha na ufadhili wa mitambo na masoko Wasiliana na Afisa Ugani wa Kilimo wa Wilaya yako kwa maelezo zaidi.
Somali: Beeraleyda Uganda waxay ka faa'iideysan karaan qaabka cusub ee beeraleyda ee ku xiran meheraynta maalgelinta iyo suuqyada La xiriir Saraakiisha Kordhinta Beeraha ee Degmadaada si aad u hesho macluumaad dheeraad ah
Dholuo: Jo-Purie e Uganda nyalo yudo ber kuom ranyisi manyien mar jopur ma nigi chuny mar loso gik moko gi pesa kod ohala

English: NPS warns residents of Makueni County to prepare for possible drought this May.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kujiandaa kwa ukame unaowezekana Mei hii.
Somali: NPS waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay u diyaar garoobaan abaaraha iman kara bisha May.
Dholuo: NPS osiemo jogweng' Makueni mondo oikre ne oro ma nyalo betie e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens a new service point for passport services in Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee Gobolka Murang'a.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag tiyo gi passport e County mar Murang'a.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds livestock keepers in Kericho County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Kericho inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska xoolaha ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service parone jorit jamni e County mar Kericho ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: Celebrations as Kenya surpasses the WHO target with exclusive breastfeeding rates rising above 50%; commitment extended to sustain improvements.
Kiswahili: Sherehe huku Kenya ikizidi lengo la WHO huku viwango vya unyonyeshaji pekee vikiongezeka zaidi ya 50%; ahadi imeongezwa ili kudumisha maboresho.
Somali: Xafladaha Kenya ayaa ka sarreeya bartilmaameedka WHO iyadoo heerarka naasnuujinta gaarka loo leeyahay ay kor u kacayso 50%; ballanqaadka la kordhiyay si loo sii wado hagaajinta.
Dholuo: Nyasi mag Kenya medo kalo tong' mar WHO ka kwan mar nyithindo makedo gi nyithindo makwayo gi minegi osemedore mokalo 50%; iketo chenro mar timo dongruok mosiko.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the public in Nandi County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadweynaha degmada Nandi inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ji duto e County mar Nandi mondo ong'e kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma ne oland kuom weche mag phishing.

English: CDC urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Embu County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: CDC inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Embu kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: CDC waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Embu inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nyagore gi tuoche mag obwongo e county mar Embu mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free tuberculosis screening is available at all public health centres in Garissa County this December.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kifua kikuu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa Desemba hii.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka caabuqa ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhamaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadwaynaha ee Gobolka Garissa bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association parone ji ni nonro mar thieth mar tuberculosis ma onge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Garissa e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the public in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadweynaha degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok adier ne jatendgi mar konyo ji bang' yudo weche ma nyiso ni nitie chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds expectant mothers in Laikipia County that access to childhood immunization is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kwamba upatikanaji wa chanjo ya watoto ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Laikipia in helitaanka tallaalka carruurta ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Laikipia ni yudo thieth mar nyithindo onge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Uasin Gishu County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama mara moja.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan gobolka Uasin Gishu in warbixinta khiyaamooyinka si deg deg ah ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service parone jogweng' Uasin Gishu County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar wuondruok konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit warns of increased cholera risk in Narok County and advises the public to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya kipindupindupindu katika Kaunti ya Narok na kushauri umma kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa ka digtay khatarta sii kordheysa ee cudurka kolera ee gobolka Narok waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar oganda: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osiemo ji kuom medruok mar tuo mar cholera e kaunti mar Narok kendo ojiwo ji mondo otang' gi tudruok gi pi mochido.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public in West Pokot County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kwamba ufikiaji wa usaidizi wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha Gobolka West Pokot in helitaanka taageerada sheegashada NHIF / SHA ay hadda ka heli karto xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji duto e West Pokot County ni kony mar kwayo kwayo kuom NHIF/SHA sani yudore e kuonde moyier.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds residents of Uasin Gishu County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Uasin Gishu kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya wilaya inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General parone jogweng' Uasin Gishu County ni luwo dongruok mar tich kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Wajir County that access to post-violence medical care is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu zinapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay Gobolka Wajir in helitaanka daryeelka caafimaad ee rabshadda ka dib loo heli karo lacag la'aan.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Wajir ni yudo kony mar thieth ma iyudo bang' timno onge chudo.

English: NDMA calls on the community in Kitui County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Kitui kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: NDMA waxay bulshada degmada Kitui ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: NDMA luongo oganda ma Kitui County mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo ochiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: GIEWS Country Brief: Kenya 18-June-2025
Kiswahili: GIEWS Muhtasari wa Nchi: Kenya 18-Juni-2025
Somali: Warbixinta Dalka ee GIEWS: Kenya 18-Juun-2025
Dholuo: Wach machuok mar piny: Kenya 18-Adchiel-2025

English: People transport through air to nairobi has been suspended for people seeking for treatment, because nairobi is overwhelmed.
Kiswahili: Usafirishaji wa watu kwa ndege hadi Nairobi umesimamishwa kwa watu wanaotafuta matibabu, kwa sababu Nairobi imejaa.
Somali: Gaadiidka dadweynaha hawada ee Nairobi ayaa la joojiyay dadka raadinaya daaweyn, sababtoo ah Nairobi waa la buuxiyey.
Dholuo: Wuok mar ji e ndege nyaka Nairobi osechung' ne jogo madwaro thieth, nikech Nairobi opong' gi ji mang'eny.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds farmers in Isiolo County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo juu ya utunzaji wa rekodi zinazoendelea kwa programu ya mafunzo ya wakulima.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa xusuusinaya beeraleyda degmada Isiolo barnaamijka tababarka beeralayda ee socda.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jopur e gweng' mar Isiolo chenro mar tiego jopur ma sani dhi nyime.

English: DCI alerts residents of Kisii County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka kwa kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: DCI waxay dadka deggan degmada Kisii uga digtay kororka kiisaska gaadiidka la xaday waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kisii County kuom wach medruok mar wuondo mtokni kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot e stesen mar polise man machiegni.

English: HELB reminds youth in Kajiado County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada ku nool gobolka Kajiado in maalgelinta HELD ay diyaar u tahay tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa rowere man Kajiado County ni pesa mag HELP yudore e tiegruok mag chiemo kod mar rwako welo.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development warns sorghum farmers in Mombasa County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay uga digtay beeraleyda xoolaha ee degmada Mombasa cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna kugula talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development osiemo jopur mag sorghum e county mar Mombasa kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim gik moko e kinde mowinjore.

English: Judiciary of Kenya advises residents of Taita-Taveta County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawashauri wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Taita-Taveta inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro kwayo mag ID.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Samburu County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja wa kaunti.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Samburu inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jogweng' Samburu County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mar dongruok e county.

English: Kenya Red Cross alerts residents of Nakuru County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru juu ya kuongezeka kwa visa vya wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay uga digtay dadka deggan degmada Nakuru kororka kiisaska tuugada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nakuru County kuom wach kwan mar joma okwalo gik moko kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Ministry of Education advises students in Murang'a County to register early to secure allocation to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata kompyuta ndogo za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ardayda degmada Murang'a kula talineysaa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan waqti hore si ay u helaan deeq loogu talagalay helitaanka laptops-ka dugsiga ee barnaamijka akhriska dijitaalka ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jopuonjre e County mar Murang'a mondo odonj e tiegruok chon mondo giyud pesa mar yudo kompyuta mag skul e bwo chenro mar somo gi somo mar digital literacy.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations alerts residents of Busia County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dambiyada ayaa dadka deggan degmada Busia uga digaya kororka kiisaska burburka wuxuuna ku talinayaa shacabka inay ku biiraan mashaariicda booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar County mar Busia ni kwan mag joma odonjo e ot biro medore kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds residents of Meru County that conservation tillage improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kwamba kilimo cha uhifadhi kinaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba la muda mrefu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru in beerashada ilaalinta ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development oparo ne jogweng' mar County mar Meru ni chwoyo puothe e yor ritruok medo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Notice: DCI issues a cybersecurity alert on phishing messages affecting residents of Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DCI inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya ujumbe wa udanganyifu unaoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay soo saartaa digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan fariimaha phishing ee saameeya dadka deggan gobolka Bomet.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: DCI ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity e wi ote mag phishing makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e county mar Bomet.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to assess and improve transportation systems to reduce food loss and minimize waste
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa kilimo biashara wamehimizwa kutathmini na kuboresha mifumo ya usafirishaji ili kupunguza upotevu wa chakula na kupunguza upotevu.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay qiimeeyaan oo hagaajiyaan nidaamyada gaadiidka si loo yareeyo khasaaraha cuntada loona yareeyo qashinka
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur koda joma nie weche mag ohala mondo onon kendo gitim dongruok e yore mag wuoth mondo omi gikony e tieko chudo mar chiemo kendo gikony e tieko chudo

English: KNEC urges youth in Embu County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Embu kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Embu inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo rowere e county mar Embu mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gichako timo tije mag oganda.

English: Baringo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for January 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Baringo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Januari 2023
Somali: Degmada Baringo: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Janaayo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Baringo: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar achiel higa mar 2023

English: KALRO announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for cattle in Narok County this February.
Kiswahili: KALRO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Narok Februari hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo bilaash ah oo cudurka Newcastle ah oo loogu talagalay lo'da Gobolka Narok bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: KALRO ogolo chenro mar thiedho jamni ma nigi tuo mar Newcastle maonge chudo e dwe mar Februar e kaunti mar Narok.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises avocado producers in Marsabit County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawashauri wazalishaji wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha avocado ee degmada Marsabit inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development nyiso jopur mag avocado e county mar Marsabit mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur ma biro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: CDC reminds the public that free measles screening is available at all public health centres in Meru County this September.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa surua unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Meru Septemba hii.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka fayraska ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynta ee degmada Meru bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji ni nonro mar thieth mar midho ma onge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto e county mar Meru e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development informs fish farmers in Marsabit County of new market linkage opportunities this August.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inafahamisha wakulima wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Agosti hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku wargelineysaa kalluumeysatada degmada Marsabit fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development olero ne jopur rech e county mar Marsabit thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response confirms a typhoid outbreak alert for Machakos County. Residents are advised to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa matumbo kwa Kaunti ya Machakos. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay xaqiijineysaa feejignaanta cudurka tifooska ee degmada Machakos. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuoche nyiso ni masira mar typhoid osechakore e gweng' mar Machakos. Ojiwo jogweng'no mondo kik giriwre gi pi mochido.

English: AFA promotes water harvesting among farmers in Lamu County as part of the September climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: AFA inakuza uvunaji wa maji miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Septemba.
Somali: AFA waxay dhiirrigelisay goosashada biyaha beeraleyda gobolka Lamu iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo tij choko pi e kind jopur e County mar Lamu kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi e dwe mar Septemba.

English: EACC updates residents of Embu County on progress of the county integrated development plan this August.
Kiswahili: EACC inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti hii mwezi Agosti.
Somali: EACC waxay dadka deggan degmada Embu ku wargelineysaa horumarka qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: EACC medo lero ne jogweng' mar Embu County kaka chenro mar dongruok mar county integrated development dhi nyime e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: TSC launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay bilawday barnaamij ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada iskuulada guud ahaan degmada Murang'a.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: TSC chako chenro mar rito nyithindo e skunde e skul duto e County mar Murang'a.

English: Can digital adherence technologies reduce inequity in tuberculosis treatment success? Evidence from a randomised controlled trial
Kiswahili: Je, teknolojia za ufuasi za kidijitali zinaweza kupunguza ukosefu wa usawa katika mafanikio ya matibabu ya kifua kikuu? Ushahidi kutoka kwa jaribio lililodhibitiwa nasibu
Somali: Tiknoolajiyada u hoggaansanaanta dhijitaalka ah ma yareyn karaan sinnaan la'aanta guusha daaweynta qaaxada? Caddeyn ka timid tijaabo la xakameeyey oo aan kala sooc lahayn
Dholuo: Be teknoloji mag luwo chike mag dijital nyalo dwoko piny bedo maonge rom e thieth mar tuo mar TB? Ranyisi mowuok kuom temo ma ochung' motegno

English: Notice: KRA launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kiambu County this June.
Kiswahili: KRA inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu mwezi Juni huu.
Somali: Ogaysiis: KRA waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhanka ah gobolka Kiambu bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Rapar: KRA chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Kiambu e dwe mar Jun.

English: KNEC encourages residents of Narok County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya ugatuzi.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Narok inay ka qaybgalaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada si ay uga warqabaan wareejinta.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi weche mag golo pesa.

English: Train on online safety 2021.
Kiswahili: Treni kuhusu usalama mtandaoni 2021.
Somali: Tareenka ku saabsan badbaadada internetka 2021.
Dholuo: Tiegruok e wi ritruok e Intanet 2021.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafungua ofisi ya kijinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu furayaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya taageero maskaxeed iyo bulsheed degmada Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Forest Service oyawo ofis mar joma chwo gi mon ma chiwo kony e weche mag pach ji e kaunti mar Nyandarua.

English: IEBC reminds youth in Machakos County that HELB funding is available for welding and fabrication training.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Machakos in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista.
Dholuo: IEBC oparo ne rowere man Machakos County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens a new service point for birth certificate processing in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ka furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay ka shaqeynta shahaadada dhalashada Degmada Migori.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya osechako tiyo gi ofis manyien mar loso nyasi mag nyuol e county mar Migori.

English: Scientific agriculture is important in reducing food insecurity in drought regions of Africa. There is high need of GM technology.
Kiswahili: Kilimo cha kisayansi ni muhimu katika kupunguza uhaba wa chakula katika maeneo yenye ukame barani Afrika. Kuna haja kubwa ya teknolojia ya GM.
Somali: Beeraha sayniska ayaa muhiim u ah yareynta cunto la'aanta gobollada abaaraha Afrika. Waxaa jira baahi weyn oo tiknoolajiyada GM ah.
Dholuo: Tij pur mar sayans konyo ahinya e tieko yuto mar chiemo e pinje ma nokiewo kodhi e Afrika.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges residents of Busia County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha bunge la kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Busia inay ka qeybgalaan kalfadhiga guud ee golaha gobolka si ay uga warqabaan qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee gobolka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Busia mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo omed ng'eyo chenro mar dongruok e gweng'no.

English: COMESA urges wheat growers in Kiambu County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawahimiza wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Kiambu inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka xilliga dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur mag ngano e gweng' mar Kiambu mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma ne oyiego mondo okonygi loyo chwanyruok mar jolweny e kinde mondi ka gitiyo gi tuoche makelo tuoche ma ok nyal geng'o koth e higani.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development invites youth in Bungoma County to enroll for ICT skills training this December.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT Desemba hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku casuumay dhalinyarada degmada Bungoma inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka xirfadaha ICT bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ogwelo rowere mag Bungoma County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar ICT e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds the public in Bungoma County that reporting embezzlement of public funds is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa fedha za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka degmada Bungoma ku xasuusinayaa in warbixinta xadgudubka lacagta dadweynaha ay tahay mid bilaash ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties parone ji duto e County mar Bungoma ni chiwo ripot mar ketho pesa mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free youth mental wellness support is available through county health facilities in Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa ustawi wa akili wa vijana unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Samburu.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar pach rowere yudore maonge chudo kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Samburu.

English: Notice: ODPP launches ward-level service delivery in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inazindua huduma za huduma katika wilaya ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay bilawday bixinta adeegyada heerka qaybta ee Gobolka Laikipia.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: ODPP chako chiwo kony e alwora mar Laikipia County.

English: KEMRI encourages residents of Laikipia County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng' Laikipia County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: In times of crisis, communities in need of support require assistance that is versatile to suit their needs and support recovery.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa shida, jamii zinazohitaji usaidizi zinahitaji usaidizi ambao unaweza kukidhi mahitaji yao na kusaidia ahueni.
Somali: Waqtiyada dhibaatooyinka, bulshooyinka u baahan taageero waxay u baahan yihiin caawimo ku habboon baahiyahooda iyo taageerada soo kabashada.
Dholuo: E kinde mag masira, oganda ma dwaro kony dwaro kony ma nyalo rwako dwarogi kendo konyogi mondo gibed gi ngima maber.

English: KRA warns public officers in Uasin Gishu County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: KRA inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: KRA waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee gobolka Uasin Gishu inay musuqmaasuq ku sameeyaan xafiisyada dawladda.
Dholuo: KRA chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Uasin Gishu kuom kawo asoya e migepe mar sirkal.

English: If your are at higher risk of severe #COVID19 and you experience symptoms of fever, cough, fatigue and or difficulty breathing: Seek medical care immediately. If you need emergency help, call 719. #KomeshaCorona update.
Kiswahili: Iwapo uko katika hatari kubwa ya kupata #COVID19 kali na unapata dalili za homa, kikohozi, uchovu na kupumua kwa shida: Tafuta matibabu mara moja. Ukihitaji usaidizi wa dharura, piga 719. Sasisho la #KomeshaCorona.
Somali: Haddii aad halis sare ugu jirto #COVID19 daran oo aad la kulanto calaamado qandho, qufac, daal iyo ama neefsashada oo ku adkaata: Isla markiiba raadso daryeel caafimaad. Haddii aad u baahan tahay caawimo degdeg ah, wac 719. Cusboonaysiinta #KomeshaCorona.
Dholuo: Ka in e rieko maduong’ mar yudo tuwo mar #COVID19 kendo iyudo ranyisi mag liet, ng’ich, ng’ol kod kata bedo gi pek mar yueyo: Dwar thieth mapiyo. Ka idwaro kony mapiyo, goch namba 719. #KomeshaCorona update.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the community in Baringo County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb fraud.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua ili kuzuia udanganyifu.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa bulshada degmada Baringo inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shisheeyaha si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo oganda man Baringo County mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo gikwed mibadhi.

English: She is one of 4,250 community health promoters who worked to ensure up to 13 million children across Kenya received medicines to combat neglected tropical diseases.
Kiswahili: Yeye ni mmoja wa waendelezaji wa afya ya jamii 4,250 ambao walifanya kazi ili kuhakikisha hadi watoto milioni 13 kote nchini Kenya wanapokea dawa za kukabiliana na magonjwa ya tropiki yaliyosahaulika.
Somali: Waa mid ka mid ah 4,250 oo ah kuwa u ololeeya caafimaadka bulshada kuwaas oo ka shaqeeyay sidii loo hubin lahaa in ilaa 13 milyan oo carruur ah oo ku nool Kenya ay helaan daawooyin si loola dagaallamo cudurrada kulaylaha ee la dayacay.
Dholuo: En achiel kuom jogo 4,250 ma ne ochung’ ne thieth mar oganda ma ne otiyo matek mondo nyithindo maromo milion 13 e piny Kenya duto oyud yath mag kedo kod tuoche ma ji ok ng’iyogo ma yudore e piny ma ng’ich.

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will host a free hypertension awareness outreach in Taita-Taveta County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska Dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa marti gelin doonta wacyi-gelin bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cadaadiska sare ee Taita-Taveta County bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo kampen mar konyo ji ng'eyo ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar hypertension maonge chudo e Taita-Taveta County e dwe mar Mach.
