English: Notice: KALRO will open a horticultural produce collection centre in Trans Nzoia County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay furaysaa xarun soo uruurinta alaabada beeraha ee degmada Trans Nzoia bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KALRO biro yawo ot mar choko cham mag puodho e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia e dwe mar Februar.

English: Other key beneficiaries are refugees who, despite receiving protection and nutrition assistance, are at risk of falling further into vulnerability.
Kiswahili: Walengwa wengine wakuu ni wakimbizi ambao, licha ya kupokea msaada wa ulinzi na lishe, wako katika hatari ya kuangukia zaidi katika mazingira magumu.
Somali: Ka-faa'iideystayaasha kale ee muhiimka ah waa qaxootiga, inkastoo ay helaan gargaar ilaalin iyo nafaqo, haddana waxay halis ugu jiraan inay sii galaan nuglaansho.
Dholuo: Jomamoko madongo ma yudo ber gin jolweny ma kata obedo ni giyudo rito kod kony mar chiemo, gin e arita mar donjo e chandruok ma medore.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will open a horticultural produce collection centre in Garissa County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Garissa Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay bilaabi doontaa xarun ururinta alaabta beeraha ee Gobolka Garissa bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro chako choko olemo mag puodho e taon mar Garissa e dwe mar April.

English: E-Citizen updates residents of Makueni County on progress of ward-level service delivery this January.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni juu ya maendeleo ya utoaji wa huduma kwa kiwango cha wilaya Januari hii.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay dadka deggan degmada Makueni ku wargelineysaa horumarka adeegga heerka degmada bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: E-Citizen miyo ji duto modak e gweng' mar Makueni ng'eyo kaka tij lendo dhi nyime e dwe mar Januar.

English: 1 million bags of subsidized fertilizers are now available for farmers Please visit your local agricultural office to obtain your supply starting December 18 2024
Kiswahili: Magunia milioni 1 ya mbolea ya ruzuku sasa yanapatikana kwa wakulima Tafadhali tembelea ofisi ya kilimo iliyo karibu nawe ili kupata usambazaji wako kuanzia Desemba 18 2024
Somali: 1 milyan oo bac oo bacriminta la taageeray ayaa hadda loo heli karaa beeraleyda. Fadlan booqo xafiiska beeraha ee deegaankaaga si aad u hesho sahaydaada laga bilaabo 18-ka Diseembar, 2024
Dholuo: Gikone, jopur nyalo yudo gik moko duto ma ginyalo chamo e puothegi.

English: Notice: TSC announces adult literacy classes enrollment dates for schools in Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC inatangaza tarehe za kujiandikisha kwa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ee dugsiyada degmada Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: TSC lando tarik mag dhi e skunde mag Trans Nzoia County.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will distribute certified wheat seed to farmers in Busia County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu za ngano zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu abuuraha degmada Busia u qaybin doonaa abuurka sarreenka ee la caddeeyay bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Dairy Board biro pogo kodhi mag ngano ne jopur manie County mar Busia e dwe mar Agost.

English: IEBC develops digital platforms for educating new voters.
Kiswahili: IEBC inaunda majukwaa ya kidijitali ya kuwaelimisha wapiga kura wapya.
Somali: IEBC waxay horumarineysaa barnaamijyo dhijitaal ah oo loogu talagalay barashada codbixiyayaasha cusub.
Dholuo: IEBC loso chenro mag digital mar tiego josiasa manyien.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Machakos County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.

Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nyagore gi tuoche mag pach e County mar Machakos mondo omany japuonj molony.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will open an avocado collection centre in Tharaka-Nithi County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itafungua kituo cha kukusanya parachichi katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu bilaabi doonaa xarun ururinta avocado ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi bisha Abriil.

English: KTDA reminds residents of Nyandarua County that water harvesting improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba uvunaji wa maji unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba la muda mrefu.
Somali: KTDA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Nyandarua in soo-saarka biyaha uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: KTDA parone jogweng' Nyandarua County ni choko pi kelo nyak e puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations launches a fraud prevention campaign in Garissa County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Garissa Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa bilaabay olole ka hortagga khiyaamooyinka degmada Garissa bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova chako kampen mar geng'o mibadhi e taon mar Garissa e dwe mar Desemba.

English: KRA updates residents of Mombasa County on progress of ward-level service delivery this May.
Kiswahili: KRA inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa juu ya maendeleo ya utoaji wa huduma kwa kiwango cha wilaya Mei hii.
Somali: KRA waxay cusbooneysiineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa horumarka adeegga heerka degmada bisha May.
Dholuo: KRA osemiyo jogweng' mar Mombasa ong'eyo dongruok mar tich mitimo e gwenge mopogore opogore e dwe mar Mei.

English: HELB encourages residents of Makueni County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on devolution.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: HELB waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan wareejinta.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jogweng' Makueni County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi chiwruok.

English: If the cord stump bleeds or oozes pus, seek medical attention immediately.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa kisiki cha kamba kitatoka damu au kutoa usaha, tafuta matibabu mara moja.
Somali: Haddii xididdada xarkaha ay dhiig baxdo ama ay qiiq soo baxdo, dhaqso u tag dhakhtarka.
Dholuo: Kapo ni ng'ato yudo remo kata ng'ich, dwarore ni omany thieth mapiyo.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ka furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta muwaadiniinta elektaroonigga ah ee Gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Auditor General osechako tiyo gi ofis manyien mar e-Citizen registration e county mar Uasin Gishu.

English: The Nyeri ELRC is closed from 24th August to 7th September 2020 due to two confirmed COVID-19 cases, with fumigation and staff self-quarantine underway. No certificates will be processed during this period. The court will reopen for virtual hearings on 21st September, with physical hearings expected to resume under the Presiding Judge's supervision in early October.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha ELRC cha Nyeri kimefungwa kuanzia tarehe 24 Agosti hadi 7 Septemba 2020 kutokana na visa viwili vilivyothibitishwa vya COVID-19, huku dawa ya kufukiza na kujitenga kwa wafanyakazi kukiwa kunaendelea. Hakuna vyeti vitakavyoshughulikiwa katika kipindi hiki. Mahakama itafunguliwa tena kwa ajili ya vikao vya mtandaoni tarehe 21 Septemba, huku vikao vya kimwili vikitarajiwa kuanza tena chini ya usimamizi wa Jaji Mkuu mapema Oktoba.
Somali: Xarunta ELRC ee Nyeri waa la xiray laga bilaabo 24 Agoosto ilaa 7 Sebtembar 2020 sababo la xiriira laba kiis oo la xaqiijiyay oo COVID-19 ah, iyadoo la wado qalliin iyo karantiil shaqaalaha. Ma jiraan wax shahaadooyin ah oo la farsameyn doono muddadan. Maxkamaddu waxay dib u furi doontaa dhageysiga internetka 21 Sebtembar, iyadoo la filayo in dhageysiga jireed dib loo bilaabo iyadoo la raacayo kormeerka Garsooraha Guddoonka horraanta Oktoobar.
Dholuo: ELRC mar Nyeri oloro chakre tarik 24 dwe mar aboro nyaka tarik 7 dwe mar apar higa mar 2020 nikech ji ariyo ma oyudre gi tuo mar COVID-19, ka fumigation kod keto jotich e kwanten giwegi pod dhi nyime. Onge oboke ma ibiro tiyogo e kindeno. Kot biro yawo kendo mondo otim winjo bura e yor mbui tarik 21 dwe mar apar, kendo winjo bura e yor mbui biro chakore kendo e bwo rito mar Jatend Bura e chakruok mar dwe mar apar.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health will hold a depression awareness forum in Siaya County this January. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya itafanya kongamano la uhamasishaji wa unyogovu katika Kaunti ya Siaya Januari hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay qabaneysaa madasha wacyiga dhimirka ee degmada Siaya bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth biro timo chokruok mar chiwo paro e wi tuwo mar depression e taon mar Siaya e dwe mar Januar.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Isiolo County that reporting carjacking promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo kwamba kuripoti utekaji nyara mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo in si dhakhso leh loo soo sheegayo baabuurta la xaday ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NTSA oparo ne jogweng' Isiolo County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo mtokni konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: KEMRI reminds expectant mothers in Kiambu County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Kiambu in helitaanka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMRI parone mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Kiambu ni thuolo mar yudo kony mar chano ngima joot en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag oganda.

English: KUCCPS urges youth in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo rowere e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo onon weche ma gin-go ma nyiso ni gidwaro donjo e sirkal kapok gitimo gik ma biro timore.

English: The government has unveiled a series of vocational training programmes aimed at equipping youths with skills in high-demand fields such as mechanics, electrical work, dressmaking, and livestock inspec...
Kiswahili: Serikali imezindua mfululizo wa programu za mafunzo ya ufundi zinazolenga kuwapa vijana ujuzi katika nyanja zinazohitajika sana kama vile ufundi, kazi za umeme, utengenezaji wa mavazi, na mifugo inspec...
Somali: Dowladda ayaa soo bandhigtay barnaamijyo tababar xirfadeed oo loogu talagalay in dhalinyarada lagu qalabeeyo xirfado ku saabsan goobaha baahida badan sida farsamada, shaqada korontada, dharka, iyo kormeerka xoolaha...
Dholuo: Sirkal osechako chenro mag tiegruok ma konyo rowere bedo gi lony e tije madongo kaka mag mag sitima, mag sitima, mag loso lewni, koda mag rito jamni.

English: Notice: IEBC will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee degmada Marsabit.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IEBC biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e taon mar Marsabit.

English: Tharaka Nithi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2022
Somali: Degmada Tharaka Nithi: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Tharaka Nithi: Oboke machon mar goyo oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2022

English: KALRO encourages farmers in Bungoma County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for milk.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora ya maziwa.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Bungoma inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan caanaha.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e county mar Bungoma mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar chak.

English: Government to ectend curview, including various larget gatherings until may 29
Kiswahili: Serikali yaahirisha ratiba ya mikutano, ikiwa ni pamoja na mikusanyiko mbalimbali mikubwa hadi Mei 29
Somali: Xukuumadda ayaa kordhin doonta waqtiga curfeed, oo ay ku jiraan shirar kala duwan oo ballaaran illaa May 29
Dholuo: Sirkal biro medo bedo gi thuolo mar dhi e chokruoge madongo nyaka tarik 29 dwe mar abich

English: Kenya Dairy Board encourages farmers in Makueni County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for tea.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei nzuri ya chai.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda degmada Makueni inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo shaaha ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board ojiwo jopur manie Makueni County mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar chai.

English: Notice: ODPP will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee degmada Meru.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: ODPP biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e County mar Meru.

English: CDC launches a May awareness campaign on safe water storage across Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Mei juu ya uhifadhi wa maji salama katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Somali: CDC waxay bilaabaneysaa olole wacyi galineed oo ku saabsan kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee ku baahsan degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: CDC chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Mei kuom wach kano pi maler e alwora mar Isiolo County.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross issues a cybersecurity alert on SIM-swap fraud affecting residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya umetoa onyo la usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM unaoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaamada SIM-swap ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Rapar: Kenya Red Cross ogolo siem mar sirkal e wi wuond mar SIM-swap makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e Elgeyo-Marakwet County.

English: Ministry of ICT pushes for universal digital literacy across all levels of education in Kenya.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya ICT inasisitiza usafi wa dijiti ulimwenguni kote katika viwango vyote vya elimu nchini Kenya.
Somali: Wasaaradda ICT waxay dhiirigelisay akhriska dijitaalka ah ee caalamiga ah dhammaan heerarka waxbarashada ee Kenya.
Dholuo: Ministry of ICT jiwo somo mar digital e okang' malach e tiegruok duto e piny Kenya.

English: DCI alerts residents of Wajir County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: DCI waxay dadka deggan degmada Wajir uga digtay kororka kiisaska gaadiidka la afduubayo waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan mashaariicda booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne ji modak e County mar Wajir kuom wach medruok mar wuondo mtokni kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polis mar oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: DPP reminds the public in Nyandarua County to remain vigilant on national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DPP inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuendelea kuwa macho katika kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Nyandarua inay ka feejignaadaan dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: DPP parone ji duto e County mar Nyandarua mondo omed bedo motang' ne loso kuwe e piny.

English: Coronavirus: A lockdown in Kenya is an option, but taxes won't be lifted
Kiswahili: Virusi vya Korona: Kufungiwa nchini Kenya ni chaguo, lakini kodi hazitaondolewa
Somali: Coronavirus: Xayiraadda ka jirta Kenya waa ikhtiyaar, laakiin canshuuraha lama qaadi doono
Dholuo: Korona: Loro piny e piny Kenya en yiero, kata kamano osuru okbi gol

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit calls on parents in Uasin Gishu County to have children under five screened for Rift Valley Fever during the December outreach.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuwafanyia watoto chini ya miaka mitano uchunguzi wa Homa ya Bonde la Ufa wakati wa mawasiliano ya Desemba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Uasin Gishu inay carruurta ka yar shan sano u sameeyaan baaritaanka hargabka Rift Valley inta lagu gudajiro bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit okwayo jonyuol e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo otim nonro ne nyithindgi ma hikgi tin ne abich kuom tuwo mar Rift Valley Fever e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Kenyaâ€™s county level action plans supporting prevention of radicalization and violent extremism.
Kiswahili: Kenya  mipango ya hatua ya wilaya ya kusaidia kuzuia radikalization na vurugu vurugu.
Somali: Qorshayaasha waxqabadka heer degmo ee Kenya ee taageeraya ka hortagga xagjirnimada iyo xagjirnimada rabshadaha wata.
Dholuo: Paro mag timo gik moko e rang'iny mar kaunti mag piny Kenya ma konyo e geng'o ng'anjo kod ng'anjo mager ahinya.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Baringo County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Baringo Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi diiwaangelinta beeraleyda loogu talagalay beeralayda Gobolka Baringo bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro timo rapar mar jopur e baringo County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: KEPHIS urges cassava growers in Kirinyaga County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima wa mihogo katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda cassava ee degmada Kirinyaga inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur ma pidho manias e County mar Kirinyaga mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue mondo okony e medo nyak mar cham e higani.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds residents of Makueni County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni in ilaalinta ciidda ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jogweng' Makueni County ni rito lowo miyo puodho bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations activates an emergency response plan for drought in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inaamsha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ukame katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada wuxuu soo saaray qorshe xaalad degdeg ah oo looga jawaabayo abaaraha Gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Joneno mag Jehova tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony e kinde ma kech nobedie e gweng' mar Taita-Taveta.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Nairobi County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kudai kutoa huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na ufisadi wa fedha za umma.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay dalbadaan bixinta adeegyada iyaga oo aan bixin laaluush si looga hortago xadgudubka lacagaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng' Nairobi County mondo okonygi gi tij lendo maok gichiwo asoya mondo giked gi ketho pesa mag sirkal.

English: World Vision Kenya Annual Report 2021
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Mwaka ya World Vision Kenya 2021
Somali: Warbixinta Sannadlaha ah ee World Vision Kenya 2021
Dholuo: Ripot mar higa mar 2021 mar neno mar piny mangima

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Kitui County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng' Kitui County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo ng'ur mar kedo gi mibadhi mar chulo pesa.

English: #KomeshaCorona Take responsibility to protect yourself and others.
Kiswahili: #KomeshaCorona Chukua jukumu la kujilinda wewe na wengine.
Somali: #KomeshaCorona Qaado mas'uuliyad si aad u ilaaliso naftaada iyo dadka kale.
Dholuo: #KomeshaCorona Kaw ting' mar rito in iwuon kaachiel kod jomoko.

English: IEBC invites residents of Kisii County to attend the public participation forum regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: IEBC inakaribisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: IEBC gwelo joma odak e County mar Kisii mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenro mag dongruok.

English: #COVID19 Myth Vs Fact. Myth Regularly rinsing your nose with saline can help prevent infection with the #COVID19. Fact No. There is no evidence that regularly rinsing the nose with saline has protected people from infection with the #COVID19. #KomeshaCorona update.
Kiswahili: Hadithi za #COVID19 Vs Ukweli. Hadithi Kuosha pua yako mara kwa mara kwa chumvi kunaweza kusaidia kuzuia maambukizi ya #COVID19. Ukweli Hapana. Hakuna ushahidi kwamba kuosha pua mara kwa mara kwa chumvi kumelinda watu dhidi ya kuambukizwa #COVID19. #KomeshaCorona sasisho.
Somali: #Khuraafaad COVID19 vs Xaqiiqo. Khuraafaad Si joogto ah sankaaga ugu luqluqdo milix waxay kaa caawin kartaa ka hortagga caabuqa #COVID19. Xaqiiqo Maya. Ma jirto caddayn muujinaysa in si joogto ah sanka ugu luqluqdo milix ay dadka ka ilaalisay caabuqa #COVID19. #Cusbooneysiinta #KomeshaCorona.
Dholuo: #KOVID19 Miriambo Koda Adier. Miriambo Ka igolo um gi saline pile ka pile, mano nyalo konyo e geng'o tuo mar #COVID19. Adier No. Onge ranyisi ni ng’ado um pile ka pile gi saline osekonyo ji mondo kik giyud tuo mar #COVID19. #KomeshaKorona ma manyien.

English: Weekly Bulletin on Outbreaks and other Emergencies: Week 46: 11 to 17 November 2024 (Data as reported by: 17:00; 17 November 2024)
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Kila Wiki kuhusu Milipuko na Dharura Nyingine: Wiki 46: 11 hadi 17 Novemba 2024 (Takwimu kama ilivyoripotiwa na: 17:00; 17 Novemba 2024)
Somali: War-saxaafadeedka Todobaadlaha ah ee ku saabsan Cudurrada faafa iyo Xaaladaha kale ee Degdegga ah: Toddobaadka 46: 11 ilaa 17 Noofambar 2024 (Xogta sida ay soo sheegtay: 17:00; 17 Noofambar 2024)
Dholuo: Oboke mar juma ka juma kuom tuoche ma nyalo kelo tuoche kod gik mamoko ma nyalo timore mapiyo: Juma mar 46: 11 nyaka 17 dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2024 (Weche kaka ondik gi: 17:00; 17 dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2024)

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds livestock keepers in Kirinyaga County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha Kirinyaga County inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) paronwa jorit jamni e County mar Kirinyaga mondo opidh legi e kuonde moyier mag chwoyo jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: Why land rights are important for climate action
Kiswahili: Kwa nini haki za ardhi ni muhimu kwa hatua za hali ya hewa
Somali: Sababta xuquuqda dhulku ay muhiim ugu tahay waxqabadka cimilada
Dholuo: Ang'o momiyo ratiro mar piny en gima duong' e weche mag piny

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Red Cross will be held in Busia County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Busia Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Busia bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni kambi mar thieth ma Kenya Red Cross ochano ibiro tim e dwe mar Novemba e county mar Busia.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Bungoma County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the February planting season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Wanyama inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kudhibiti wizi wa jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa za kuua wadudu zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Februari.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Bungoma inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka ciidanka dayrta iyagoo isticmaalaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development nyiso jopur manie Bungoma County mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma giyudo e dwe mar ariyo mondo gikwed thuol mang'ich.

English: Kenya Dairy Board urges tea growers in Kilifi County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Kilifi inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si loo wanaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo okaw kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed nyak e higani.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on residents of Migori County to support local peace-building committees in support of border security.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Utafiti wa Uhalifu inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za mitaa kusaidia usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ugu baaqay dadka deggan degmada Migori inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadgelyada ee deegaanka si ay u caawiyaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oluongo jogweng' Migori County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gweng'no e siro sirkal mar boda.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) launches community-based development programmes in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inazindua mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu bilaabay barnaamijyo horumarineed oo ku salaysan bulshada ee degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chako chenro mag dongruok e alwora mar Siaya County.

English: KEMRI announces NHIF/SHA claims support for residents of Isiolo County starting this November.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatangaza NHIF/SHA inadai msaada kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo kuanzia Novemba hii.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taageerada sheegashada NHIF/SHA ee dadka deggan degmada Isiolo laga bilaabo bisha November.
Dholuo: KEMRI olando kony ma NHIF/SHA chiwo ne jogweng' Isiolo County kochakore dwe mar Novemba.

English: ODPP invites residents of Turkana County to attend the public participation forum regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Turkana kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan wadatashiyada siyaasadda guud.
Dholuo: ODPP gwelo ji duto modak e county mar Turkana mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi weche siasa.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya alerts residents of Marsabit County to a rise in fraud cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.

Kiswahili: DPP inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Laikipia piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Laikipia inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: DPP ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e County mar Laikipia mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195 maonge chudo.

English: IEBC recruits young volunteers for civic outreach.
Kiswahili: IEBC inaajiri vijana wa kujitolea kwa ajili ya huduma za kiraia.
Somali: IEBC waxay shaqaaleysiineysaa mutadawiciin dhalinyaro ah si ay u faa'iideystaan bulshada.
Dholuo: IEBC choko rowere ma ochiwore e tije mag konyo oganda.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) urges sweet potatoes growers in West Pokot County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawahimiza wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda baradho macaan ee Gobolka West Pokot inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalaalka ciidda si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) ojiwo jopur mag le mamit e West Pokot County mondo otim lokruok e puothe mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber e higani.

English: EACC reminds voters in Kitui County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kitui kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Kitui inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: EACC parone jogweng'o mag Kitui County mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar timo yiero kapok tarik mar yiero ochopo.

English: Farmers in a family of more than 10,000 in Latin America soon they're going ahead in embracing digital solutions and leave behind barriers of market accessibility.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika familia yenye watu zaidi ya 10,000 katika Amerika ya Latini upesi wanaenda mbele katika kukubali masuluhisho ya kidijitali na kuacha vizuizi vya upatikanaji wa soko.
Somali: Beeraleyda qoys ka tirsan in ka badan 10,000 oo qof oo ku nool Latin America ayaa dhowaan horumar ku sameynaya sidii ay u qaadan lahaayeen xalalka dhijitaalka ah waxayna ka tagayaan caqabadaha helitaanka suuqa.
Dholuo: Jo-Puritani ma gin joot ma nigi ji mokalo 10,000 e Latin America, biro dhi nyime tiyo gi yore mag digital kendo weyo chien gik manyalo mono ji yudo thuolo mar dhi e ohala.

English: KEMSA encourages mothers in Vihiga County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.

Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho yatafungwa hivi karibuni.

English: ODPP invites residents of Makueni County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: ODPP inakaribisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusu ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.

Dholuo: ODPP gwelo jogweng' Makueni County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: Notice: EACC opens voter education centres in Nyamira County this November.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Nyamira mwezi huu wa Novemba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay furaysaa xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee degmada Nyamira bisha November.

English: ... digital financial services, climate-smart agriculture and other digital tools that make agricultural value chains more efficient and inclusive.
Kiswahili: ... huduma za kifedha za kidijitali, kilimo kinachozingatia mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa na zana zingine za kidijitali zinazofanya minyororo ya thamani ya kilimo iwe na ufanisi zaidi na jumuishi.

Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogweng'o mag County mar Murang'a mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet mondo gikel kes mar kedo gi ketho pesa mag sirkal.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for the Ministry of public service, gender, and affirmative action Aisha Jumwa has urged officials in her ministry to work collaboratively to create a space that effectively serves its citizens.
Kiswahili: Katibu wa Baraza la Waziri katika Wizara ya Huduma ya Umma, Jinsia, na Hatua ya Kuunga Mkono Aisha Jumwa amewahimiza maafisa katika wizara yake kufanya kazi kwa kushirikiana ili kuunda nafasi ambayo kwa ufanisi hutumikia wananchi wake.

Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.

Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DCI ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony mar thieth bang' timbe mahundu e County mar Nyeri.

English: KALRO announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for sheep in Kisii County this July.
Kiswahili: KALRO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Kisii Julai hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee idaha ee degmada Kisii bishii Luulyo.

Kiswahili: DPP anawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za ulaghai na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Somali: DPP waxay dadka deggan degmada Nandi uga digtay kororka kiisaska khiyaamooyinka waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: DPP chiwo siem ne Jo-Nandi County e wi medruok mar weche mag wuondruok kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag ritruok gi joma ok ging'eyo.

Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Migori Julai hii.

Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA timo romo mar oganda e wi loso kuwe e piny Migori County e dwe mar Julai.

Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in si deg deg ah u soo sheegidda tuugada ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Nakuru County to reach out to a trained counsellor.

Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Nakuru inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit jiwo ng'ato ang'ata man Nakuru County ma nigi chandruok mar paro mondo omany japuonj molony.

English: Men's mental health awareness is critically important because they face unique challenges and pressures from society. Research shows that men are less likely to ask for help with mental health issues than women. This is often because society expects men not to show vulnerability or emotions. This can lead to serious problems, including a higher rate of suicide among men, who are almost four times more likely to die by suicide than women
Kiswahili: Uelewa wa afya ya akili ya wanaume ni muhimu sana kwa sababu wanakabiliwa na changamoto na shinikizo la kipekee kutoka kwa jamii. Utafiti unaonyesha kuwa wanaume wana uwezekano mdogo wa kuomba msaada kuhusu masuala ya afya ya akili kuliko wanawake. Hii mara nyingi ni kwa sababu jamii inatarajia wanaume kutoonyesha udhaifu au hisia. Hii inaweza kusababisha matatizo makubwa, ikiwa ni pamoja na kiwango cha juu cha kujiua miongoni mwa wanaume, ambao wana uwezekano wa karibu mara nne zaidi wa kufa kwa kujiua kuliko wanawake.
Somali: Aqoonta caafimaadka maskaxda ee ragga waa mid aad muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxay la kulmaan caqabado gaar ah iyo cadaadis ka yimid bulshada. Cilmi-baarista ayaa muujineysa in ragga ay ka yar yihiin haweenka inay caawimaad ka codsadaan arrimaha caafimaadka dhimirka. Tani badanaa waa sababta oo ah bulshada waxay ka filaysaa ragga inaysan muujin xasaasiyad ama shucuur. Tani waxay keeni kartaa dhibaatooyin halis ah, oo ay ku jiraan heer sare oo isdil ah ragga, kuwaas oo ku dhowaad afar jeer ka badan
Dholuo: Riwruok mar chwo e wi weche thieth mar pach en gima duong' ahinya nikech giduto giromo gi pek kod pek mopogore opogore moa e oganda. Nonro nyiso ni chwo ok yudga thuolo mar kwayo kony e weche mag thieth mag pach moloyo mon.

Dholuo: Department of State for TVET oparo ne skunde mag Migori County mondo omed jiwo rit mar nyithindo e skunde e dwe mar Julai.

English: COVID-19 has affected our mental health. Measures such as stay home, keeping social distancing including isolation has caused a lot of anxiety. But we have seen change especially in behavior such as increased hand hygiene; CS Mutahi Kagwe. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: COVID-19 imeathiri afya yetu ya akili. Hatua kama vile kukaa nyumbani, kuweka umbali wa kijamii pamoja na kutengwa kumesababisha wasiwasi mwingi. Lakini tumeona mabadiliko hasa katika tabia kama vile kuongezeka kwa usafi wa mikono; CS Mutahi Kagwe. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: COVID-19 wuxuu saameeyay caafimaadkeena maskaxeed. Tallaabooyin ay ka mid yihiin joogista guriga, ka fogaanshaha bulshada oo ay ku jiraan go'doominta ayaa sababay walaac badan. Laakiin waxaan aragnay isbeddel gaar ahaan dhaqanka sida kordhinta nadaafadda gacmaha; CS Mutahi Kagwe. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: COVID-19 osegoyo ngima wa mar paro. Okenge kaka bedo e ot, bedo mabor gi ji moriwo nyaka bedo mabor gi ji osekelo luoro mang'eny. To waseneno lokruok ahinya ahinya e tim kaka medo rito ler mar lwedo; CS Mutahi Kagwe. #KomeshaKorona

English: Building resilience in Dadaab: workshop builds capacity of local leaders to tackle urban risks
Kiswahili: Kujenga ustahimilivu katika Dadaab: warsha hujenga uwezo wa viongozi wa mitaa kukabiliana na hatari za mijini
Somali: Dhisidda adkeysiga Dhadhaab: aqoon-is-weydaarsigu wuxuu dhisaa awoodda hoggaamiyeyaasha maxalliga ah si ay wax uga qabtaan khataraha magaalooyinka
Dholuo: Kugero chir e Dadaab: chokruok gero nyalo mar jotelo mag gwenge mondo giked gi pek mag boma

English: Visit the ASK Eldoret Show and stand with us in the fight against corruption. Together we can safeguard Kenyaâ€™s future.
Kiswahili: Tembelea ASK Eldoret Show na ujiunge nasi katika mapambano dhidi ya ufisadi. Pamoja tunaweza kulinda siku zijazo za Kenya.
Somali: Booqo Bandhigga ASK Eldoret oo nala garab istaag dagaalka ka dhanka ah musuqmaasuqa. Wadajir ayaan u ilaalin karnaa mustaqbalka Kenya.
Dholuo: Lim ASK Eldoret Show kendo ichung' kodwa e kedo kod mibadhi. Ka wabedo kanyachiel, wanyalo rito kinde mabiro mar piny Kenya.

English: ODPP reminds voters in Machakos County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Machakos inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: ODPP parone jogweng'o e county mar Machakos ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go ka gitiyo gi sms e simo mar 70000 motelo ne kalenda mar yiero.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds the public in Nyamira County to remain vigilant on counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Uhalifu unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka degmada Nyamira ku xasuusinaya in ay sii joogaan feejignaanta ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne ji duto e county mar Nyamira ni gibed motang' e weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: OGP reminds residents of Kitui County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kitui ambao huhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa wilaya huimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kitui ee ka qeybgalaya kalfadhiga guud ee shirka gobolka ayaa xoojinaya maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: OGP paronwa jogweng' Kitui County ma biro e chokruok maduong' mar county assembly mondo omed jiwo sirkal.

English: NPS urges residents of Baringo County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NPS inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika kumbi za umma huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay iskaashi la yeeshaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo jogweng' Baringo County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji ng'enyie nikech ji medo keto pachgi kuom chenro mag chiwo siem motelo ne oganda.

English: Judiciary of Kenya announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku dhawaaqay waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Nandi.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya olando lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mag ng'eyo ng'ato e county mar Nandi.

English: Complementary school foodinterventions are helping maintain school attendance and protection of child nutrition in drought affected areas.
Kiswahili: Afua za ziada za chakula shuleni zinasaidia kudumisha mahudhurio ya shule na ulinzi wa lishe ya watoto katika maeneo yaliyoathiriwa na ukame.
Somali: Waxqabadyada cuntada ee dheeraadka ah ee iskuullada ayaa gacan ka geysanaya ilaalinta imaanshaha iskuulka iyo ilaalinta nafaqada carruurta ee meelaha ay abaartu saameysay.
Dholuo: Gik ma itimo e skul madongo mag chiemo konyo e rito dhi e skul kendo rito chiemo ma nyithindo yudo e kuonde ma oro opong’o.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds residents of Machakos County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba kwa muda mrefu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan Degmada Machakos in ilaalinta ciidda ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service parone jopiny ma Machakos County ni rito lowo miyo puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: If you have a fever, cough and difficulty breathing, seek medical attention and call 719 in advance. #StayHomeHero #WashHands #WearMasks #Komeshacorona
Kiswahili: Ikiwa una homa, kikohozi na ugumu wa kupumua, tafuta matibabu na piga 719 mapema. #KaaNyumbaniShujaa #Nawa Mikono #VaaVinyago #Komeshacorona
Somali: Haddii aad qandho, qufac iyo neefsashadu kugu adkaato, raadso daryeel caafimaad oo wac 719 kahor. #Joog GurigaHaweenka #Dhaq Gacmaha #Xir Maaskaro #Komeshacorona
Dholuo: Ka in gi liet, akweda kod pek mar yueyo, dhi ir thieth kendo igoyo simu ne 719 kapok ochopo. #BedJalo #LosLwedo #RwakMask #Komeshakorona

English: Public health advisory: CDC warns of increased malaria risk in Homa Bay County and advises the public to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: CDC inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya malaria katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay na inashauri umma kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: CDC waxay ka digeysaa khatarta sii kordheysa ee cudurka daacuunka ee gobolka Homa Bay waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakhda leh.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: CDC chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar malaria e Homa Bay County kendo osiemo ji mondo kik giriwre gi pi mochido.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Kilifi County to prepare for possible drought this August.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kujiandaa kwa ukame unaowezekana Agosti hii.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ka digay dadka deggan degmada Kilifi in ay isu diyaariyaan abaaraha iman kara bisha August.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations osiemo jogweng' Kilifi County mondo oikre ne oro ma nyalo betie e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association confirms a cyclosporiasis outbreak alert for Nandi County. Residents are advised to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya chathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa cyclosporiasis kwa Kaunti ya Nandi. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu xaqiijiyay digniin ku saabsan cudurka cyclosporiasis ee gobolka Nandi. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Medical Association osenyiso ni nitie masira mar cyclosporiasis e county mar Nandi.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development warns wheat farmers in Murang'a County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawaonya wakulima wa ngano katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay uga digtay beeraleyda sarreenka ee degmada Murang'a cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna kugula talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development osiemo jopur mag ngano e County mar Murang'a kuom tuoche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim gik moko e kinde mowinjore.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on parents in Machakos County to have children under five screened for typhoid during the November outreach.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya watoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuwapima watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa homa ya matumbo wakati wa uhamasishaji wa Novemba.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Machakos in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro cudurka 'typhoid' inta lagu gudajiro bisha November.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross kwayo jonyuol e county mar Machakos mondo otim nonro mar tuo mar typhoid ne nyithindgi ma johigni abich kata matin e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds the public in Kakamega County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mkurugenzi-Mchunguzi Mkuu inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu dadka ku xasuustaa gobolka Kakamega in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General parone ji duto e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni chiwo ripot mar tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Secondhand smoke harms both the mother and the unborn baby. Keep homes and public spaces smoke-free.
Kiswahili: Moshi wa mtu mwingine hudhuru mama na mtoto ambaye hajazaliwa. Weka nyumba na maeneo ya umma bila moshi.
Somali: Qaadka labaad wuxuu waxyeeleynayaa hooyada iyo ilmaha aan dhalan.
Dholuo: Madho ndawa nyalo hinyogo min nyathi kaachiel gi nyathi mapok onyuol.

English: Strengthening genocide prevention through education in Africa: policy brief
Kiswahili: Kuimarisha uzuiaji wa mauaji ya kimbari kupitia elimu barani Afrika: muhtasari wa sera
Somali: Xoojinta ka hortagga xasuuqa iyada oo loo marayo waxbarashada Afrika: warbixin kooban oo ku saabsan siyaasadda
Dholuo: Keto teko mar geng’o nek mar oganda kokalo kuom somo e Afrika: chik machuok

English: Notice: OGP will hold a public participation forum on development planning forums in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta ee Gobolka Laikipia.
Dholuo: Rapar: OGP biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag dongruok e County mar Laikipia.

English: Elgeyo Marakwet County officially rolls out CNAP targeting a reduction of child stunting from 30% to 22%.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Elgeyo Marakwet yazindua rasmi mpango wa CNAP unaolenga kupunguza udumavu wa watoto kutoka 30% hadi 22%.
Somali: Degmada Elgeyo Marakwet ayaa si rasmi ah u soo bandhigtay CNAP oo ujeedkeedu yahay in la yareeyo yaraanta yaraanta 30% ilaa 22%.
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Elgeyo Marakwet osechako tiyo gi chenro mar CNAP mar dwoko chien kwan mar nyithindo maok nyal wuokie kuom 30% nyaka 22%.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges anyone experiencing abuse in Uasin Gishu County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuripoti kesi hiyo kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya ngono katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka gobolka Uasin Gishu inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: NDMA reminds residents of Lamu County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu in warbixinta soonka ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogweng'o mag Lamu County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar nek konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: NCPB advises horticultural produce producers in Vihiga County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inashauri wazalishaji wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuuza mazao kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa tu kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: NCPB waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha wax soo saarka beeraha ee degmada Vihiga inay wax soo saarkooda ku iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: NCPB nyiso jopur ma loso puothe mag puothe gi puothe e County mar Vihiga ni gius puothegi mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo puothego kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: HELB encourages residents of Nakuru County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Somali: HELB waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabaan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jogweng' Nakuru County mondo ong'e weche ma gin-go e wi register mar joma oyiero mondo ging'e ratiro ma sirkal nigo.

English: Lamu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Lamu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Juni 2023
Somali: Degmada Lamu: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Lamu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2023

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens a new service point for passport services in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee degmada Nandi.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya oseyawo kamachielo mar tiyo gi passport e county mar Nandi.

English: CDC reminds the public that free cholera screening is available at all public health centres in Migori County this August.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kipindupindu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Migori Agosti hii.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka fayraska ee bilaashka ah lagu heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka guud ee degmada Migori bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji ni nonro ma onge cholera yudore e kuonde thieth duto mag Migori County e dwe mar Agost.

English: Ministry of Education urges parents and teachers in Garissa County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Garissa inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Puonjruok jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Garissa mondo omany namba mar kony mar nyithindo 116.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties opens voter registration centres in Bomet County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inafungua vituo vya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Bomet Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu furayaa xarumaha diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee degmada Bomet bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties chako timo chenro mar chano joma biro yiero e county mar Bomet e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: KUCCPS reminds citizens in Elgeyo-Marakwet County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KUCCPS paronwa raia mag Elgeyo-Marakwet County kuom ratiro ma gin-go e wi ratiro mag chik.

English: Ministry of Education urges youth in Vihiga County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Vihiga inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda ka hor inta aysan qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo rowere e County mar Vihiga mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto giseyudo kapok gitimo tije mag oganda.

English: Huduma Kenya advises residents of Uasin Gishu County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kubeba hati zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu inay qaataan dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado dib u dhac marka la raadinayo adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya nyiso jogweng' mar Uasin Gishu County mondo oting'e buge duto madwarore mondo kik gikel hinyruok sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will distribute certified sweet potatoes seed to farmers in Homa Bay County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itasambaza mbegu za viazi vitamu zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay abuurka baradho macaan oo shahaado leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda gobolka Homa Bay bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Rieko: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro pogo kodhi mag sweet potato ne jopur e Homa Bay County e dwe mar Jun.

English: The Ministry of Health has launched a mass distribution of mosquito nets in Tana River County to combat malaria in high-risk areas.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya imezindua usambazaji mkubwa wa vyandarua katika Kaunti ya Tana River ili kupambana na malaria katika maeneo yenye hatari kubwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa bilowday qaybinta maro kaneecada ee Degmada Tana River si loola dagaallamo duumada meelaha khatarta sare leh.
Dholuo: Ofis mar thieth osechako keto ng’injo mag ng’injo e gweng’ mar Tana River mondo oked gi tuo mar malaria e kuonde ma nigi luoro maduong’ ahinya.

English: Notice: ODPP launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Samburu County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Samburu mwezi huu wa Oktoba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa gobolka Samburu bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Rapar: ODPP chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e county mar Samburu e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: KMTC invites youth in Kakamega County to enroll for welding and fabrication training this July.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji Julai hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kakamega inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: KMTC gwelo rowere e Kaunti mar Kakamega mondo odonj e tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya opens voter registration centres in Lamu County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inafungua vituo vya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Lamu mwezi huu wa Oktoba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay furaysaa xarumaha diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee degmada Lamu bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Huduma Kenya chako timo chenro mar ndiko ji e county mar Lamu e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: KTDA will open an avocado collection centre in Samburu County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itafungua kituo cha kukusanya parachichi katika Kaunti ya Samburu Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay ka furi doontaa xarun ururinta avocado ee Gobolka Samburu bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA biro yawo kama ichoko avocado e county mar Samburu e dwe mar Novemba.

English: West Pokot: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2024
Kiswahili: Pokot Magharibi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Aprili 2024
Somali: Galbeedka Pokot: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2024
Dholuo: Pokot ma milambo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar dwe mar ang'wen higa mar 2024

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free HIV/AIDS screening is available at all public health centres in Machakos County this November.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa VVU/UKIMWI unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Machakos Novemba hii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka HIV / AIDS ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynta ee degmada Machakos bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji ni nonro ma onge chudo mar HIV/AIDS yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County ma Machakos e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by CDC will be held in Kericho County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na CDC itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kericho Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabiyeen CDC ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Kericho bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kampen mar thieth ma onge chudo ma CDC ochano biro timore e County mar Kericho e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: IEBC opens a new welding and fabrication programme at the vocational centre in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inafungua programu mpya ya kulehemu na utengenezaji katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Tana River.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan alxanka iyo soo saarista xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Tana River.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IEBC chako chenro manyien mar loso kendo loso gik moko e kambi mar tiegruok e taon mar Tana River County.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds farmers in Trans Nzoia County of the ongoing fertiliser application training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya matumizi ya mbolea.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia barnaamijka tababarka isticmaalka bacriminta ee socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board parone jopur man Trans Nzoia County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar tiyo gi yien mag yien.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) advises residents of Kajiado County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking national ID applications.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inashauri wakazi wa Kajiado County kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay qaataan dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado dib u dhac marka la dalbado codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo oting'e buge duto madwarore mondo kik giketh seche ma gidwaro kwayo nying' mar ng'at manie pinygi.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Narok County that access to the GBV toll-free helpline is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Narok kwamba upatikanaji wa simu ya GBV ya bure ya msaada unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee Gobolka Narok in helitaanka khadka caawimaadda ee GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah uu yahay mid lacag-la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Narok ni gibiro yudo kony ma onge chudo mar GBV maonge chudo.

English: TVETA develops and distributes new e-learning content aligned to TVET training requirements.
Kiswahili: TVETA huendeleza na kusambaza maudhui mapya ya e-learning yanayolingana na mahitaji ya mafunzo ya TVET.
Somali: TVETA waxay horumarinaysaa oo qaybinaysaa waxyaabaha cusub ee barashada elektaroonigga ah ee la jaan qaada shuruudaha tababarka TVET.
Dholuo: TVETA loso kendo pogo weche manyien mag e-learning kaluwore gi dwaro mag tiegruok mar TVET.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public that free measles screening is available at all public health centres in Garissa County this September.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa surua unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa Septemba hii.
Somali: Shirkadda SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka xannuunka ah ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynta ee Gobolka Garissa bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji ni nono mar thieth mar midho ma onge chudo yudore e kuonde thieth duto mag oganda e County mar Garissa e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit warns of increased meningitis risk in Makueni County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya homa ya uti wa mgongo katika Kaunti ya Makueni na inashauri umma kutumia vyandarua vya mbu vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa ka digtay khatarta sii kordheysa ee meningitis ee degmada Makueni waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay isticmaalaan shabaqa cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar oganda: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osiemo ji kuom medruok mar tuo mar meningitis e county mar Makueni kendo ojiwo ji mondo oti gi net mag kute ma otigo gi yedhe makelo tuoche.

English: NCPB urges tea growers in Kericho County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Kericho kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Kericho inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e County mar Kericho mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue mondo okony e medo nyak mar cham e higani.

English: Notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) confirms a cholera outbreak alert for Trans Nzoia County. Residents are advised to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ilani: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa kipindupindu kwa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia. Wakazi wanashauriwa kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ku saabsan cudurka faafa ee Trans Nzoia County. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: SHA (Social Health Authority) osenyiso ni nitie masira mar cholera e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on the community in Tana River County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawaita watu wa Wilaya ya Tana River wazungumze dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ugu baaqay bulshada degmada Tana River County inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga iyo inay taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oluongo oganda man Tana River County mondo owuo e wi timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

Kiswahili: Haya hapa ni baadhi ya mawazo kuhusu jinsi unavyoweza kuendeleza furaha ya sherehe za Pasaka & muunganisho kwa njia tofauti: Jaribu kitu kipya - kichocheo kipya au Jizoeze kujitunza - soma kitabu, fanya mazoezi, tafakari, au upige simu kwa rafiki au jamaa. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Waa kuwan fikrado ku saabsan sida aad u sii wadi karto farxadda dabaaldegyada Easter-ka iyo isku xirnaanta si ka duwan: Isku day wax cusub - cunto karis cusub ama Ku celceli daryeelka naftaada - akhri buug, jimicsi, feker, ama wac saaxiib ama qaraabo. #KomeshaCorona
