English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds voters in Kisumu County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu xusuusinayaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Kisumu inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor inta aan la helin nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General parone jogweng'o mag Kisumu County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go ka gitiyo gi sms e simo mar 70000 kapok gitimo yiero.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhawaaqday taariikhaha diiwaangelinta dugsiyada dugsiga dhexe ee maalin bilaash ah ee degmada Nandi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar State for TVET olando tarik mag dhi e tiegruok mag sekondari e skunde man Nandi County.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission reminds citizens in Garissa County about their rights regarding the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuhusu haki zao kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu muwaadiniinta degmada Garissa xusuusinayaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj parone raia mag County mar Garissa ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo ombudsman.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds needy students in Makueni County that school laptops under the digital literacy programme applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya maombi ya programu ya kusoma na kuandika ya kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka ayaa xasuusinaya ardayda u baahan degmada Makueni in barnaamijyada laptop-yada dugsiga ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oparo ne jopuonjre modhier man Makueni County ni kompyuta mag skul manie program mar digital literacy program chiegni rumo.

English: The Cooperatives Bill is expected to pass this year stakeholders are encouraged to submit their views to the Parliamentary Committee of Trade and Cooperatives
Kiswahili: Muswada wa Sheria ya Vyama vya Ushirika unatarajiwa kupitishwa mwaka huu wadau wanahimizwa kuwasilisha maoni yao kwenye Kamati ya Bunge ya Biashara na Ushirika.
Somali: Sharciga Iskaashatada ayaa la filayaa inuu ansixiyo sanadkan, daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay aragtidooda u gudbiyaan Guddiga Baarlamaanka ee Ganacsiga iyo Iskaashatada
Dholuo: Chikwa mar riwruok mar oganda mang'ongo ibiro yie e higani.

English: Ministry of Health calls on parents in Makueni County to have children under five screened for malaria during the September outreach.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuwafanyia watoto chini ya miaka mitano uchunguzi wa malaria wakati wa mawasiliano ya Septemba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Makueni inay caruurta ka yar shan sano u sameeyaan baaritaanka cudurka daacuunka inta lagu gudajiro bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health okwayo jonyuol manie Makueni County mondo otim nonro mar malaria ne nyithindo ma hikgi tin ne abich e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Ministry of Education reminds youth in Garissa County that HELB funding is available for welding and fabrication training.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Garissa in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Puonjruok parone rowere e gweng' mar Garissa ni pesa mag HELB yudore e tiegruok mag welding kod manufacturing.

English: NPS warns residents of Marsabit County to prepare for possible landslides this May.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa maporomoko ya ardhi Mei hii.
Somali: NPS waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inay u diyaar garoobaan dhulgariir dhici kara bisha May.
Dholuo: NPS osiemo jogweng' mar Marsabit mondo oikre ne yiengni mar lowo e dwe mar Mei.

English: HELB advises students in Trans Nzoia County to register early to secure allocation to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: HELB inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Somali: HELB waxay ardayda degmada Trans Nzoia kula talineysaa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan si ay u helaan buugaag waxbarasho iyo qalab waxbarasho.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jopuonjre e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo odonj e skundno chon mondo giyud thuolo mar somo buge koda gik mamoko.

English: Notice: KRA launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Baringo County this October.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Baringo Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa oo lagu wacyi gelinayo gobolka Baringo bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni KRA chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Baringo e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Pest Control Products Board encourages farmers in Kisumu County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za mahindi.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda degmada Kisumu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay hadhuudhka.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kisumu mondo odonj e riwruok ma nigi ratiro mar tiyo gi ohala mondo omi ohala mar kodhi obed maber.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kudai usambazaji wa huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet in ay dalbadaan bixinta adeegyada aan la bixin laaluush si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya ojiwo jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo okonygi gi tijno maok gichiwo asoya mondo giked gi mibadhi.

English: NTSA urges the public in Mombasa County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: NTSA inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha degmada Mombasa inay soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo ji duto e county mar Mombasa mondo ochiw ripot mar ote mamulo pachgi ne jatendgi bang' yudo ripot mag wuond ma ne otim gi SIM-swap.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya ojiwo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county mar tiegruok e intanet e loso nonro mar tich mitimo higa ka higa.

English: COVID-19 Advice! Remember to cover your nose & mouth when coughing or sneezing with a cloth or in your flexed elbow & NOT your hands to prevent spread to others. Go to the doctor if you have a fever, cough or feel that it is difficult to breathe #coronavirusInkenya
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa COVID-19! Kumbuka kufunika pua na mdomo wako unapokohoa au kupiga chafya kwa kitambaa au kwenye kiwiko cha mkono uliojikunja & SI mikono yako ili kuzuia kuenea kwa wengine. Nenda kwa daktari ikiwa una homa, kikohozi au unahisi kuwa ni vigumu kupumua #coronavirusInkenya
Somali: Talo COVID-19! Xasuuso inaad sankaaga iyo afkaaga ku daboosho maro ama xusulkaaga oo laalaaban, HA ku daboolin gacmahaaga si looga hortago faafitaanka dadka kale. U tag dhakhtarka haddii aad qandho qabto, qufacdo ama aad dareento inay adag tahay in la neefsado #coronavirusInkenya
Dholuo: Rieko mar COVID-19! Par ni nyaka ium um & dhok sama idho kata idho gi lewni kata e elbow mari ma oting’ore & OK lweteni mondo kik oland ne jomoko. Nyir laktar ka in kod homa, ogok kata ka iwinjo ni otekni yweyo #coronavirusInkenya

English: DPP reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Meru County that access to post-violence medical care is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Meru kwamba huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu zinapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee degmada Meru in helitaanka daryeelka caafimaad ee rabshadda ka dib ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag nindruok e County mar Meru ni yudo kony mar thieth bang' timbe mag mahundu en gima ng'ato nyalo yudo maonge chudo.

English: KICD reminds schools in Narok County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this November.
Kiswahili: KICD inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Narok kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Novemba hii.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Narok inay xoojiyaan adeegyada hagista iyo la-talinta bisha November.
Dholuo: KICD paronwa skunde mag Narok County mondo omed jiwo kendo chiwo kony e dwe mar Novemba.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Vihiga County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape the county budget process.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandaoni wa kaunti ili kuunda mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Vihiga mondo oriwre gi county's online participation portal e loso chenro mar bajet mar county.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by CDC will be held in Nandi County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na CDC itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Nandi Februari hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabiyeen CDC ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Nandi bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kampen mar thieth ma onge chudo ma CDC ochano biro timore e County mar Nandi e dwe mar Februar.

English: Official launch of biofertilizer to increase micronutrient content in crops grown in six counties.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi rasmi wa mbolea ya kibiolojia ili kuongeza kiwango cha virutubisho katika mazao yanayolimwa katika kaunti sita.
Somali: Daahfurka rasmiga ah ee bacriminta noolaha si loo kordhiyo nafaqada yar yar ee dalagyada laga beero lix degmo.
Dholuo: Ochako loso gik ma dongo dongo mondo omed kwan mar gik ma konyo e cham ma opidhi e kaunti auchiel.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges the public in Tana River County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of identity theft.
Kiswahili: Kenya Red Cross inahimiza umma katika Wilaya ya Tana River kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadweynaha degmada Tana River County inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aanay wax ka qaban dhacdooyinka la soo sheegay ee tuugista aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ji duto manie Tana River County mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche mag kwalo kitgi.

English: If you notice a foul smell from the gas, leave the house immediately and call the gas company.
Kiswahili: Ukiona harufu mbaya kutoka kwenye gesi, ondoka nyumbani mara moja na piga simu kampuni ya gesi.
Somali: Haddii aad aragto ur xun oo ka timaada gaaska, isla markiiba guriga ka bax oo wac shirkadda gaaska.
Dholuo: Kapo ni ifwenyo ni gasego nigi suya mamit, wuok mapiyo e odno kendo ing'i ne kambi ma tiyo gi gasego.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds the public in Nandi County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa dadka ku xasuusinaya gobolka Nandi in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties parone ji duto e county mar Nandi ni chiwo ripot mar kawo asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'.

English: Notice: DCI opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafungua ofisi ya ngono inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay furaysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya daryeel caafimaad ka dib rabshadaha degmada Nyamira.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DCI ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony mar thieth bang' timbe mahundu e kaunti mar Nyamira.

English: Context Assessment: Increasing Security Challenges in Kenya
Kiswahili: Tathmini ya Muktadha: Kuongeza Changamoto za Usalama nchini Kenya
Somali: Qiimaynta Xaaladda: Caqabadaha Amniga ee sii kordhaya ee Kenya
Dholuo: Ong’iyo gik ma timore: Medo pek mag arita e piny Kenya

English: Schools directed to install CCTV and employ guards for security.
Kiswahili: Shule zaagizwa kufunga CCTV na kuajiri walinzi kwa ajili ya usalama.
Somali: Dugsiyada waxaa lagu amray in la rakibo CCTV iyo in la shaqaaleeyo ilaalada amniga.
Dholuo: Ne ochiko skunde mondo oket kamera mar ng'iyo gik moko kendo oti gi jorit mondo oritgi.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will distribute certified maize seed to farmers in Kwale County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu za mahindi zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kwale Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu abuurka hadhuudhka ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doonaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kwale bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Dairy Board biro pogo kodhi mag kodhi mar kodhi ne jopur man Kwale County e dwe mar Januar.

English: Stressed about money? Don't gamble with your mental health! When finances feel overwhelming, it's tempting to chase "quick fixes" like gambling or substance useâ€”but these only make things worse. Instead, take control by seeking free financial counseling and building healthy money habits. Your mental health matters. Choose smart solutions over short-term risks.
Kiswahili: Una msongo wa mawazo kuhusu pesa? Usicheze kamari na afya yako ya akili! Wakati fedha zinapozidi, inakuvutia kutafuta "suluhisho la haraka" kama vile kamari au matumizi ya dawa za kulevya - lakini hizi hufanya mambo kuwa mabaya zaidi. Badala yake, chukua udhibiti kwa kutafuta ushauri wa kifedha bila malipo na kujenga tabia nzuri za pesa. Afya yako ya akili ni muhimu. Chagua suluhisho bora badala ya hatari za muda mfupi.
Somali: Ma ka walwalsan tahay lacagta? Ha ku khamaarin caafimaadkaaga maskaxda! Marka dhaqaaluhu dareemo culeys, waa wax lagu farxo inaad raadiso "hagaajin degdeg ah" sida khamaarka ama isticmaalka maandooriyaha - laakiin kuwani waxay ka sii darayaan oo keliya. Taa beddelkeeda, la wareeg xakamaynta adigoo raadinaya la-talin dhaqaale oo bilaash ah oo dhisa caadooyin lacag caafimaad leh. Caafimaadkaaga maskaxeed waa muhiim. Dooro xalal caqli badan halkii aad ka dooran lahayd khataraha muddada-gaaban.
Dholuo: Be in gi parruok kuom pesa? Okidwar ng’ado bura gi ngimani mar paro! Ka pesa winjo ni opong' ahinya, en gima kelo gombo mar luwo "yore mapiyo" kaka tugo mar pesa kata tiyo kod yath ma mero ji - to gigo mana medo rach. Mopogore, kawo loch kuom manyo rieko mar pesa ma nono kendo loso kido mabeyo mag pesa. Ngima mari mar paro en gima duong'. Yier yore mariek mag duoko pek mag kinde machuok.

English: Office of the Auditor-General encourages first-time voters in Meru County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Meru kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa codbixiyayaasha ugu horreeya ee degmada Meru inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Jorit Maduong' jiwo joma okwongo yiero e county mar Meru mondo olim kama ichikoe ji ne IEBC machiegni kodgi.

English: TVET encourages out-of-school children in Kericho County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Kericho kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa caruurta dugsiga ka baxsan ee degmada Kericho inay codsadaan deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga ugu dambeeya ee barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e gweng' mar Kericho mondo okonygi yudo konyno kapok kindeno ochopo kaluwore gi chenro mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: TSC reminds needy students in Kericho County that school laptops under the digital literacy programme applications close soon.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba kompyuta ndogo za shule chini ya maombi ya programu ya kusoma na kuandika ya dijiti zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: TSC waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Kericho in laptop-yada dugsiga ee barnaamijka codsiyada akhriska dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: TSC paronwa jopuonjre man gi chandruok e County mar Kericho ni kompyuta mag skul manie program mar somo kod somo mar digital chiegni rumo.

English: KNEC urges youth in Baringo County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Baringo kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Baringo inay ka qaybqaataan munaasabadda dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo rowere e County mar Baringo mondo oriwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gichako timo tije mag sirkal.

English: Improving both women and men's agricultural market access improves dietary diversity, but women's effect is double that of men.
Kiswahili: Kuboresha upatikanaji wa soko la kilimo kwa wanawake na wanaume kunaboresha utofauti wa lishe, lakini athari ya wanawake ni mara mbili ya ile ya wanaume.
Somali: Hagaajinta helitaanka suuqa beeraha ee haweenka iyo ragga ayaa hagaajineysa kala duwanaanta cuntada, laakiin saameynta haweenka waa laba jibbaaran tahay ragga.
Dholuo: Bedo gi thuolo maber mar yudo chiemo e puothe mag pur ne chwo koda mon miyo chiemo bedo mopogore opogore, kata kamano, mon yudo nyak mar chiemo ma romo nyadiriyo gi chwo.

English: Kenya: IFRC network mid-year report, January - June 2023 (13 December 2023)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Ripoti ya mtandao wa IFRC katikati ya mwaka, Januari - Juni 2023 (13 Desemba 2023)
Somali: Kenya: Warbixinta shabakadda IFRC ee bartamaha sanadka, Janaayo - Juun 2023 (13 Diseembar 2023)
Dholuo: Kenya: Ripot mar diere mar higa mar mbui mar IFRC, dwe mar achiel - dwe mar auchiel 2023 (13 dwe mar apar gi ariyo 2023)

English: Notice: AFA will distribute certified maize seed to farmers in Laikipia County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itasambaza mbegu za mahindi zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay abuurka hadhuudhka ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda Gobolka Laikipia bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: AFA biro pogo kodhi mag kodhi mar kodhi ne jopur man Laikipia County e dwe mar Februar.

English: Ensure safety! Protect refugee students in schools.
Kiswahili: Hakikisha usalama! Kulinda wanafunzi wakimbizi katika shule.
Somali: Badbaadi badbaadada ardayda qaxootiga ah ee dugsiyada.
Dholuo: Rituru nyithindo ma gin joma oringo thuchegi e skunde.

English: KEMSA encourages mothers in Kericho County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kericho kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kericho inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo mine manie County mar Kericho mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Public notice: KEMSA will host a free tobacco control outreach in Kericho County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMSA itaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa kudhibiti tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Kericho Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: KEMSA waxay marti gelineysaa dadaal lacag la'aan ah oo ka dhan ah ka hortagga sigaarka ee Gobolka Kericho bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMSA biro timo kampen mar golo ndawa maonge chudo e taon mar Kericho e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice from Division of Disease Surveillance and Response: skilled birth attendance clinics will run every January at designated health centres in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa: kliniki za mahudhurio ya uzazi zenye ujuzi zitaendeshwa kila Januari katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka socda qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada: rugta daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfadlayaasha ah ayaa bilaabi doonta Janaayo kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee lagu magacaabo degmada Nyamira.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuwo: Klinike mag rito nyuol ma nigi lony biro tiyo e dwe mar Januar higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e Kaunti mar Nyamira.

English: â€œ80% of votes went to this government and we donâ€™t make noise. Treat us as good people.â€ Tharaka Nithi governor Muthomi Njuki urges national government to fulfil commitments on county projects.
Kiswahili: 80% ya kura zilienda kwa serikali hii na hatufanyi kelele.Tutendee kama watu wazuri.  Gavana wa Tharaka Nithi Muthomi Njuki anashauri serikali ya kitaifa itimize ahadi zake juu ya miradi ya kaunti.
Somali: "80% codadka waxay u tageen dowladdan mana sameyno buuq. Nala dhaqan dad wanaagsan." Guddoomiyaha Tharaka Nithi Muthomi Njuki ayaa ku boorriyay dowladda qaranka inay fuliso ballanqaadyada ku saabsan mashaariicda degmada.
Dholuo: â€œ80% mar kura ne odhi e sirkalni kendo ok wabed gi koko. <2Zepa> Ti kodwa kaka ji mabeyo.â€ Gavana mar Tharaka Nithi, Muthomi Njuki, jiwo sirkal mar pinyno mondo ochop singruok ma ne osingo e wi chenro mag kaunti.

English: KUCCPS reminds needy students in Murang'a County that textbooks and learning materials applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba vitabu vya kiada na matumizi ya vifaa vya kujifunzia vitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Murang'a in buugaagta waxbarasho iyo codsiyada qalabka wax lagu barto ay dhowaan soo gabagabeyn doonaan.
Dholuo: KUCCPS paronwa jopuonjre modhier man Murang'a County ni buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok biro rumo machiegni.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges farmers in Nyamira County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda degmada Nyamira inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyo soo-saarka biyaha ee beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e Kaunti mar Nyamira mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Farmers are urged to access certified and quality seeds to revitalize the agriculture sector Check with local agricultural offices for availability and support
Kiswahili: Wakulima wahimizwa kupata mbegu zilizoidhinishwa na bora ili kufufua sekta ya kilimo Nenda na ofisi za kilimo za ndani ili kupata na kupata msaada.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyay inay helaan abuur shahaado leh oo tayo leh si loo soo nooleeyo qaybta beeraha. La xiriir xafiisyada beeraha ee deegaanka helitaanka iyo taageerada
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma nigi lony e weche mag pidho kodhi, jiwo jopur mondo obed gi kodhi ma nigi nyak kod nyak maber, mondo omi gimi tijno obed gi nyak kendo gisom gi ofis mag pur e alwora ma gidakie mondo giyud kony

Kiswahili: Idara ya Met inawaonya Wakenya kujitayarisha kwa mvua kubwa, usiku baridi chini ya digrii 10 Kenya miezi 7 iliyopita na Didacus Malowa Wakenya wanapaswa kujitayarisha kwa kipindi kirefu cha mvua kubwa na usiku wa baridi kali, na joto linatarajiwa kushuka chini ya 10Â°C katika baadhi ya mikoa.
Somali: Waaxda Met-ka ayaa uga digtay Kenyaanka inay u diyaar garoobaan roobab culus, habeenno qabow oo ka hooseeya 10 darajo Kenya 7 bilood ka hor by Didacus Malowa Kenyanka waa inay isu diyaariyaan roobab culus oo dheer iyo habeenno qabow oo qaniinyo leh, iyadoo heerkulka la filayo inuu ka hooseeyo 10Ãƒâ€š Â°C gobollada qaar.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Met ogolo chik ne jo Kenya mondo oikre ne koth mang’eny, otieno ma ng’ich ma nyalo bedo piny mar digri 10 dweche 7 mokalo.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds residents of Kajiado County that agroforestry improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kwamba kilimo cha misitu kinaboresha uzalishaji wa muda mrefu wa shamba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado in beeraha iyo kaymaha ay hagaajinayaan wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development oparo ne jogweng' Kajiado County ni agroforestry miyo puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: NPS warns residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this October.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Oktoba hii.
Somali: NPS waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay u diyaar garoobaan qaraxyo dab ah oo dhici kara bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: NPS osiemo jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo oikre ne yiengni manyalo timore e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: KNEC urges youth in Busia County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Busia kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Busia inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo rowere e County mar Busia mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok gichako timo tije mag oganda.

English: IPOA reminds residents of Kajiado County that reporting carjacking promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kwamba kuripoti utekaji nyara mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan baabuurta la xaday ay gacan ka geystaan ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogweng' Kajiado County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo mtoka konyo rito alwora.

English: Between 2021 and 2025, more than 100 000 AMR surveillance records were collected, with 9039 records submitted to GLASS in 2025.
Kiswahili: Kati ya 2021 na 2025, zaidi ya rekodi 100,000 za uchunguzi wa AMR zilikusanywa, na rekodi 9039 ziliwasilishwa kwa GLASS mnamo 2025.
Somali: Intii u dhaxaysay 2021 iyo 2025, in ka badan 100 000 oo diiwaan oo AMR ah ayaa la ururiyay, iyadoo 9039 diiwaan loo gudbiyay GLASS sannadkii 2025.
Dholuo: E kind higa mar 2021 kod 2025, ne ochoki rekod mohingo 100,000 mag rang'iny mar AMR, ka rekod 9039 ne ooro ne GLASS e higa mar 2025.

English: Introduces a multimodal AI pipeline that processes spoken English through speech-to-text, converts it into American Sign Language (ASL) gloss, and generates lifelike 3D sign language animations.
Kiswahili: Inaanzisha bomba la AI ya multimodal ambayo inashughulikia Kiingereza kinachosemwa kupitia hotuba hadi maandishi, huibadilisha kuwa gloss ya Lugha ya Ishara ya Amerika (ASL), na hutoa uhuishaji wa lugha ya ishara ya 3D.
Somali: Waxay soo bandhigeysaa qaab-dhismeed badan oo AI ah oo ka baaraandegaya Ingiriisiga la hadlo iyada oo loo marayo hadalka qoraalka, waxay u beddeleysaa iftiinka Luqadda Calaamadaha Mareykanka (ASL), waxayna soo saartaa animations-yada luuqadda calaamadaha 3D ee la midka ah nolosha.
Dholuo: Ochako tiyo gi yore mang'eny mag AI ma tiyo gi dho Kisungu kokalo kuom wuoyo gi weche, loko dhokno obed dhok mitiyogo gi dho momni e piny Amerka (ASL), kendo miyo ji bedo gi kido ma chalo gi mar 3D.

English: HELB invites youth in Kericho County to enroll for electrical installation training this December.
Kiswahili: HELB inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kericho kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Desemba hii.
Somali: HELB waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kericho inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: HELB gwelo rowere man Kericho County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar keto sitima e dwe mar Desemba.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) calls on parents in Migori County to have children under five screened for meningitis during the April outreach.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Migori kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa ugonjwa wa uti wa mgongo wakati wa mawasiliano ya Aprili.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Migori in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro meningitis inta lagu jiro adeegga bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) kwayo jonyuol e county mar Migori mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross activates an emergency response plan for drought in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya laanzisha mpango wa kukabiliana na ukame katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay hirgelinaysaa qorshe xaalad deg deg ah oo ka dhan ah abaaraha ka jira gobolka Mombasa.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova e piny Kenya, miluongo ni Kenya Red Cross, chako tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony e kinde oro ma ne otimore e gweng' mar Mombasa.

English: Council of Governors reminds the public in Uasin Gishu County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay xasuusinayaan shacabka gobolka Uasin Gishu in warbixinta khiyaamooyinka iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch oparo ne ji duto e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag yuto en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: By recognizing the humanity of individuals with mental illnesses, we can cultivate a more compassionate and understanding society. If you or someone you know needs psychosocial support, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at our toll-free number, 1199
Kiswahili: Kwa kutambua ubinadamu wa watu wenye magonjwa ya akili, tunaweza kukuza jamii yenye huruma na uelewa zaidi. Ikiwa wewe au mtu unayemjua anahitaji usaidizi wa kisaikolojia, tafadhali usisite kuwasiliana nasi kwa nambari yetu ya simu isiyolipishwa, 1199.
Somali: Marka aan aqoonsano bani'aadamnimada shakhsiyaadka qaba cudurrada maskaxda, waxaan horumarin karnaa bulsho naxariis iyo faham badan. Haddii adiga ama qof aad taqaanid u baahan tahay taageero maskaxeed, fadlan ha ka waaban inaad nala soo xiriirto lambarkayaga lacag la'aanta ah, 1199
Dholuo: Ka wang'eyo kaka joma nigi tuoche mag obwongo chalo, wanyalo bedo gi chuny mar kecho ji kendo winjo pachgi maber. Kapo ni in kata ng'at ming'eyo dwaro kony kuom weche mag pach ji, kik iluor tudori kodwa gi namba mar 1199 maonge chudo.

English: IEBC reminds the public in Uasin Gishu County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.

Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Lamu mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud somo mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: NCTC Kenya marks twenty years of counter terrorism efforts including intelligence sharing and policy development.
Kiswahili: NCTC Kenya inaadhimisha miaka ishirini ya juhudi za kupambana na ugaidi ikiwa ni pamoja na ushirikiano wa habari na maendeleo ya sera.
Somali: NCTC Kenya waxay calaamad u tahay labaatan sano oo ka mid ah dadaallada la dagaalanka argagixisada oo ay ku jiraan wadaagista sirdoonka iyo horumarinta siyaasadaha.
Dholuo: NCTC Kenya nyiso higini piero ariyo mag kedo gi timbe mahundu moriwo pogo weche mag mibadhi kod loso chike.

English: It is #immunizationweek and Nairobi County Health Team is doing a great thing by providing supportive supervision to the city health centres. Today they were at Nairobi South Health Centre assessing Covid19 IPC & Response, Immunization & other Programs. #KomeshaCorona update
Kiswahili: Ni #wiki ya chanjo na Timu ya Afya ya Kaunti ya Nairobi inafanya jambo kubwa kwa kutoa usimamizi wa usaidizi kwa vituo vya afya vya jiji. Leo walikuwa katika Kituo cha Afya cha Nairobi South wakitathmini Covid19 IPC & Response, Chanjo na Mipango mingine. #KomeshaCorona sasisho
Somali: Waa #toddobaadka tallaalka, Kooxda Caafimaadka ee Degmada Nairobi waxay qabanayaan wax weyn iyagoo kormeer taageero ah siinaya xarumaha caafimaadka ee magaalada. Maanta waxay joogeen Xarunta Caafimaadka ee Koonfurta Nairobi iyagoo qiimeynaya Covid19 IPC & Jawaab celinta, Tallaalka & Barnaamijyada kale. #Warbixinta #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: En #juma mar thieth kendo Tich mar Thieth mar Nairobi timo gima duong’ kuom chiwo rito ma konyo kuonde thieth mag boma. Kawuono ne gin e kar thieth ma milambo mar Nairobi ka ginono IPC mar Covid-19 kod duoko, chiwo chanjo kod chenro mamoko. #KomeshaKorona ma manyien

English: CDC advises residents of Turkana County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: CDC inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: CDC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay qaataan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo jogweng' County mar Turkana mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi ka gidwaro thieth mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Secondhand smoke harms both the mother and the unborn baby. Keep homes and public spaces smoke-free.
Kiswahili: Moshi wa mtu mwingine hudhuru mama na mtoto ambaye hajazaliwa. Weka nyumba na maeneo ya umma bila moshi.
Somali: Qaadka labaad wuxuu waxyeeleynayaa hooyada iyo ilmaha aan dhalan.
Dholuo: Madho ndawa nyalo hinyogo min nyathi kaachiel gi nyathi mapok onyuol.

English: KEMSA urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Turkana County to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Turkana kumtia moyo rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Turkana inuu ku dhiirrigeliyo saaxiibkiisa dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar paro e County mar Turkana mondo ojiw osiepne moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: Ministry of Health encourages mothers in Isiolo County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Isiolo inay ilmahooda u keenaan kormeerka koritaanka si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health jiwo mine manie Isiolo County mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Universities Fund calls on the community in Embu County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Embu kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu bulshada degmada Embu ugu baaqayaa inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116, si ay u ilaaliyaan nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund kwayo ji duto e county mar Embu mondo omany namba 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Migori County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Migori kwamba ufikiaji wa usaidizi wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Migori in helitaanka taageerada sheegashada NHIF/SHA ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMRI parone ji duto manie County Migori ni kony mar kwayo kwayo mag NHIF/SHA sani yudore e kuonde moyier.

English: KALRO announces a free lumpy skin disease vaccination exercise for goats in Narok County this July.
Kiswahili: KALRO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa ngozi kwa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Narok Julai hii.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan cudurrada maqaarka ee geedaha ee Gobolka Narok bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: KALRO ogolo chenro mar thiedho diek e dwe mar Julai e kaunti mar Narok.

English: TVET reminds needy students in Isiolo County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kwamba maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Isiolo in deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay codsiyada ardayda baahan ay dhowaan dhammaadaan.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa jopuonjre man gi chan e County mar Isiolo ni tuke mag somo ne jopuonjre ma nigi chan biro rumo machiegni.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the public in Kiambu County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of identity theft.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao baada ya kesi zilizorekodiwa za wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kiambu inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda kadib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee lagu xaday aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto e County mar Kiambu mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok adier ne jatendgi mar lendo bang' ka osenyis ni nitie weche mag kwalo kitgi.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges motorists and pedestrians in Nakuru County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Nakuru inay u hoggaansamaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay adeegsadaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee socodka si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira qaraxyada dabka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo jorit mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo oluw tong' mar ng'wech kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe mondo gikwed hinyruok mar mach.

English: Build Us More Schools': The Quest for Quality Free Education in Mabatini and Ngei Wards of Mathare, Nairobi
Kiswahili: Tujenge Shule Zaidi': Jitihada za Elimu Bora Bila Malipo Mabatini na Wadi za Ngei za Mathare, Nairobi.
Somali: Naga Dhis Dugsiyo Badan: Raadinta Waxbarasho Bilaash ah oo Tayo leh oo ka dhacda Degmooyinka Mabatini iyo Ngei ee Mathare, Nairobi
Dholuo: Gerwa Sukule Mang'eny': Dwaro mar Yudo Somo Mabeyo Maonge Chudo e Wuond Mabatini kod Ngei e boma Mathare, Nairobi

English: Kenya Situation Update | July 2023: Al-Shabaab Attacks Surge Ahead of Somalia-Kenya Border Reopening
Kiswahili: Sasisho la Hali ya Kenya | Julai 2023: Mashambulio ya Al-Shabaab Yaendelea Kabla ya Kufunguliwa tena kwa Mpaka wa Somalia na Kenya
Somali: Cusbooneysiinta Xaaladda Kenya | Luulyo 2023: Weerarada Al-Shabaab oo sii kordhaya ka hor inta aan dib loo furin Xuduudka Soomaaliya iyo Kenya
Dholuo: Oboke mar Kenya | Abiriyo 2023: Ketho mag Al-Shabaab Medore Kapok Oyab Ohinga mar Somalia kod Kenya

English: OGP reminds the public in Kericho County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kericho in sheegashada xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid bilaash ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: OGP paronwa ji duto e County mar Kericho ni lando wach tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'.

English: KNEC urges youth in Nyandarua County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nyandarua inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda ka hor inta aysan qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo rowere e County mar Nyandarua mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto giseyudo kapok gitimo gik ma biro timore ne oganda.

English: Agriculture State Department outlining action pathways including dietary diversity, youth agri-entrepreneurship, and climate resilience.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Kilimo inayoelezea njia za hatua ikiwa ni pamoja na utofauti wa lishe, ujasiriamali wa kilimo cha vijana, na ustahimilivu wa hali ya hewa.
Somali: Waaxda Gobolka Beeraha oo qeexaysa waddooyinka tallaabooyinka oo ay ku jiraan kala duwanaanshaha cuntada, ganacsiga beeraha dhalinyarada, iyo adkeysiga cimilada.
Dholuo: Ofis mar State Department mar Agriculture ma lero yore mag timo gik moko moriwo koda kit chiemo mopogore opogore, rowere ma timo ohala e yore mag ohala, kod geng'o lokruok e kit yamo.

English: Notice: KEMRI will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Bungoma County this October. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI itafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Oktoba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogsoonow: KEMRI waxay qabaneysaa madasha caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhallinyarada ee degmada Bungoma bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMRI biro timo chokruok mar paro ne rowere e taon mar Bungoma e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Ahead of a forecast dry spell, livestock keepers - especially in Kenya's arid and semi-arid areas - are advised to conserve existing fodder, manage water supplies carefully, and shield animals from temperature extremes.
Kiswahili: Hapo awali, walinzi wa mifugo, hasa katika maeneo yenye ukame ya Kenya, wanashauriwa wahifadhi chakula cha mifugo, wasimamie maji kwa uangalifu, na kulinda wanyama kutokana na joto kali.
Somali: Marka ay ka hortagto abaarta la saadaalinayo, xoolaha xoolaha - gaar ahaan meelaha qalalan iyo kuwa nus-qalalan ee Kenya - waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ilaaliyaan hilibka jira, si taxadar leh u maareeyaan biyo, iyo inay xoolaha ka ilaaliyaan heerkulka daran.
Dholuo: Ka pok piny ochwe, jodongo ma pidho jamni - to ahinya wuon e gwenge ma piny Kenya otwo ahinya - jiwo ahinya mondo girit chiembgi, giti maber gi pi, kendo giritgi kik lietre ahinya.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds farmers in Tana River County of the ongoing greenhouse farming training programme.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kilimo cha chafu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Tana River barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development oparo ne jopur manie Tana River County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar timo pur.

English: KEMSA encourages mothers in Meru County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Meru kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Meru inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta caafimaad ee la qorsheeyay si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo mine manie County mar Meru mondo odhi e odiechieng'no mar thieth mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Ministry of Health calls on parents in Turkana County to have children under five screened for cyclosporiasis during the November outreach.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Turkana kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa cyclosporiasis wakati wa mawasiliano ya Novemba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Turkana in carruurta ka yar shan sano la baaro cudurka cyclosporiasis intii lagu jiray bisha November.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health okwayo jonyuol e County mar Turkana mondo otim nonro ne nyithindgi ma johigni abich e dwe mar Novemba mondo ging'e ni gin gi tuwo mar cyclosporiasis.

English: AFA reminds farmers in Siaya County of the ongoing greenhouse farming training programme.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Siaya juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kilimo cha chafu.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Siaya barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo.
Dholuo: AFA parone jopur e county mar Siaya chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime e weche mag pur.

English: DPP warns residents of Mandera County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: DPP inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera juu ya kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: DPP waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera kororka nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban.
Dholuo: DPP osiemo jogweng'o mag Mandera County kuom medruok mar chenro mag gwelo pesa mag miriambo kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: In 2025 he started inclusive agriculture Precision for Development (PAD) to lÃ unch digital farming in a large scale to attain a new approach and research.
Kiswahili: Mwaka 2025 alianzisha kilimo cha pamoja Precision for Development (PAD) ili kuzindua kilimo cha dijiti kwa kiwango kikubwa ili kufikia njia mpya na utafiti.
Somali: Sannadkii 2025 wuxuu bilaabay barnaamijka beeraha ee loo dhan yahay ee Precision for Development (PAD) si loo horumariyo beeraha dijitaalka ah si ballaaran loogu gaaro hab iyo cilmi-baaris cusub.
Dholuo: E higa mar 2025, ne ochako pur ma oting’o ji duto (PAD) mondo ochak pur mar dijital e yo maduong’ mondo oyud yo manyien kod nonro.

English: TVET encourages residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ka qeybgalaan madasha dadweynaha degmada si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadwaynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar jopiny mar county mondo gibed gi ng'eyo e wi kaka jopiny biro tiyo gi bajet mag county.

English: Kenya, Djibouti & Tanzania: Facts & Figures January - December 2022
Kiswahili: Kenya, Djibouti na Tanzania: Ukweli na Takwimu Januari - Desemba 2022
Somali: Kenya, Djibouti & Tanzania: Xaqiiqooyinka & Tirooyinka Janaayo - Disembar 2022
Dholuo: Kenya, Djibouti kod Tanzania: Adier kod Kwan dwe mar achiel - apar gi ariyo higa mar 2022

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds residents of Trans Nzoia County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti huimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia ee ka qeybgalaya kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada ayaa xoojinaya maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya paronwa jogweng' mar Trans Nzoia County ma biro e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo omed gero sirkal.

English: A senior police official stepped aside during a custody death probe to avoid conflicts in investigations handled by independent authorities.
Kiswahili: Afisa wa polisi wa cheo cha juu alijitenga wakati wa uchunguzi wa kifo cha kizuizini ili kuepuka migogoro katika uchunguzi uliofanywa na mamlaka huru.
Somali: Sarkaal sare oo ka tirsan booliiska ayaa iska casilay inta lagu gudajiray baaritaanka dhimashada xannaaneynta si looga fogaado khilaafaadka baaritaannada ay qabanayaan mas'uuliyiinta madax banaan.
Dholuo: Jatelo moro maduong' mar polise ne oweyo timo nonro e wi tho mar ng'at motue mondo kik obed gi ywaruok e kind nonro ma ne itimo gi sirkal ma onge sirkal.

English: Kenya Red Cross advises residents of Nairobi County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Laanta Cas ee Kenya waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay yareeyaan qaadashada cusbada iyo sonkorta si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nairobi County ni mondo giketh chamo mor kod sukari mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche ma ok nyal geng'o.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) launches an April awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Aprili juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa bilaabay olole wacyiga ah bishii Abriil oo ku saabsan wacyiga cadaadiska sare ee degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) osechako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar April e wi wach remo mang'eny e gweng' mar Bungoma.

English: Notice: DCI activates an emergency response plan for drought in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ukame katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo abaaraha ku dhaca degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: DCI chako tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony e kinde ma kech nobedie e County mar Nyeri.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free trauma counselling support is available through county health facilities in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa ushauri wa kiwewe unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo la talinta dhaawaca laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo yudore maonge chudo kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e County mar Lamu.

English: Notice: FAO will conduct a greenhouse farming workshop for farmers in Nandi County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itafanya warsha ya kilimo cha chafu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo ee beeraleyda ee gobolka Nandi bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: FAO biro timo tiegruok mar timo tijno ne jopur e gweng' mar Nandi e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: KALRO restricts movement of goats in Kericho County due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO inazuia harakati za mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Kericho kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Newcastle.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa riyaha ee degmada Kericho sababtuna tahay cudurka Newcastle.
Dholuo: Rieko: KALRO ogeng'o wuoth mar diek e County mar Kericho nikech tuo mar Newcastle.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Vihiga County that access to free medical camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za matibabu bila malipo sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Vihiga in helitaanka xeryaha caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha loo qoondeeyay.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development calls on the community in Samburu County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Barnaamijyada Waxbarashada ayaa ugu baaqay bulshada Gobolka Samburu inay u soo wargeliyaan maamulka dugsiga wixii dhibaato ah ee ku saabsan amniga si ay dugsiyada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oluongo oganda man Samburu County mondo onyis sirkal mar skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: CDC advises residents of Kisumu County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: CDC inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: CDC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada la hortagi karo.

English: NCPB announces a free anthrax vaccination exercise for goats in Baringo County this February.

English: HELB calls on the community in Lamu County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: HELB inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.

English: KUCCPS reminds youth in Kericho County that HELB funding is available for tailoring and design training.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni.

Dholuo: KUCCPS paronwa rowere man Kericho County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Laikipia.

Dholuo: Riwruok mar State Department for Basic Education chako chenro mar tiego nyithindo ma nigi midekre e skunde man Laikipia County.

English: KEPHIS urges goats farmers in Nyandarua County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wafugaji wa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa kufuatia kuripotiwa visa vya ugonjwa wa ngozi.

Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur mag diek e county mar Nyandarua mondo ogeng'e legi e kuonde moketi mag chwoyo diek bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag dhoot.

Kiswahili: FAO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Mei.

English: IPOA reminds the public in Baringo County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo kubaki macho juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.

English: Mark in your calender upcoming seminars , important events with livestock stakeholders .
Kiswahili: Weka alama kwenye kalenda yako semina zijazo , matukio muhimu na wadau wa mifugo .

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will train farmers in Nairobi County on conservation tillage this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi juu ya kilimo cha uhifadhi Agosti hii.

English: Judiciary of Kenya advises residents of Siaya County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.

English: Ministry of Education invites youth in Makueni County to enroll for tailoring and design training this June.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Makueni kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni Juni hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku casuumaysaa dhalinyarada degmada Makueni inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka tailoring iyo naqshadeynta bisha Juun.

English: Kenya Forest Service calls on the community in Embu County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Embu kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ugu baaqayaa bulshada degmada Embu inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wacayaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.

English: Annouces government partnership with NGOs to launch nationwide school and community wellness programs promoting physical activity, oral hygiene, and preventive health education.

English: Youth participating in the Building a Better Tomorrow BBT program in Tanzania are encouraged to expand their harvest distribution to meet consumer demands
Kiswahili: Vijana wanaoshiriki katika Mpango wa Kujenga Kesho Bora ya BBT nchini Tanzania wanahimizwa kupanua usambazaji wao wa mavuno ili kukidhi mahitaji ya walaji.

Dholuo: Rowere ma dhi e program mar Building a Better Tomorrow BBT e Tanzania ijiwo mondo gichiw cham e yo momedore mondo gikony e chopo dwaro mag joma tiyo gi gigo

Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inasema kisa hicho kiliripotiwa Kisumu, aina ya Covid-19 kutoka India ikigunduliwa nchini Kenya.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces outpatient services for residents of Machakos County starting this November.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges farmers in West Pokot County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Guddiga xakamaynta cayayaanka ayaa ku booriyay beeraleyda gobolka West Pokot inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: Bura mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e West Pokot County mondo opidh olembe mag choko lowo mondo omed dwoko chien kethruok mar lowo mondo ginyagre gi lokruok mar koth.

English: COMESA advises farmers in Tana River County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: COMESA waxay kula talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Tana River inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e taon mar Tana River County mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges farmers in Mandera County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda Degmada Mandera inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service ojiwo jopur man Mandera County mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e weche mag pur mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok e kaka koth chue.

English: Council of Governors reminds residents of Narok County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok ambao wanahudhuria mkutano wa umma wa kusanyiko la kaunti kuimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Narok ee ka qeybgalaya kalfadhiga guud ee shirka degmada ayaa xoojinaya maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch paro ne jogweng' Narok County ma biro e chokruok maduong' mar county assembly mondo omed jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: AFA reminds farmers in Kitui County of the ongoing fertiliser application training programme.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuhusu mpango unaoendelea wa mafunzo ya matumizi ya mbolea.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kitui barnaamijka tababarka codsiga bacriminta ee socda.
Dholuo: AFA oparo ne jopur ma Kitui County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar tiyo gi yien.

English: KALRO urges sheep farmers in Machakos County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wafugaji wa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda idaha ee degmada Machakos inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanada buka xafiiska xayawaanka ugu dhow ka dib markii la soo sheegay kiisaska cudurka anthrax.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur ma pidho rombe e county mar Machakos mondo onyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth machiegni kodgi bang' ka osenyis ni giseyudo tuoche mag anthrax.

English: Huduma Kenya invites residents of Kirinyaga County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Kirinyaga inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya gwelo ji duto modak e County mar Kirinyaga mondo ochiw barua mondik kapok ndalo ochopo mar wuoyo e wi chenro mag sirkal ochopo.

English: AFA announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for pigs in Nyandarua County this March.
Kiswahili: AFA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Machi hii.
Somali: AFA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee doofaarka ee gobolka Nyandarua bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: AFA olando chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo e dwe mar Mach e kaunti mar Nyandarua.

English: To lower cases of HIV/AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria, and enhance the vaccines and immunisation programme in the country, I have proposed Sh28.7bn for the Global Fund and Sh4.6bn for vaccines and immunisation programmes.
Kiswahili: Ili kupunguza visa vya VVU/UKIMWI, Kifua Kikuu na Malaria, na kuboresha mpango wa chanjo na chanjo nchini, nimependekeza Sh28.7 bilioni kwa ajili ya Mfuko wa Dunia na Sh4.6 bilioni kwa ajili ya chanjo na programu za chanjo.
Somali: Si loo yareeyo kiisaska HIV/AIDS, Tuberculosis iyo Malaria, loona xoojiyo barnaamijka tallaalka iyo tallaalka ee dalka, waxaan u soo jeediyay Sh28.7bn ee Sanduuqa Caalamiga ah iyo Sh4.6bn ee tallaallada iyo barnaamijyada tallaalka.
Dholuo: Mondo anyis ni anyalo dwoko chien tuoche mag HIV/AIDS, Tuberculosis kod malaria, kendo amedo jiwo chenro mar yudo chan kod thieth e pinyno, asechiwo Sh28.7 bilion ne Global Fund kod Sh4.6 bilion ne chenro mag yudo chan kendo thieth.

Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Lamu kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Julai.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Lamu inay qaataan noocyo abuurka ah oo abaarta u adkaysta oo la caddeeyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e County mar Lamu mondo oti gi kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochako chwoyo kodhi e dwe mar Julai.

English: Ministry of Education invites youth in Turkana County to enroll for ICT skills training this October.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT Oktoba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku casuumaysaa dhalinyarada degmada Turkana inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka xirfadaha ICT bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education ogwelo rowere man Turkana County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar ICT e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: EACC reminds the public in Machakos County that input on development planning forums is welcome this November.
Kiswahili: EACC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba maoni juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo yanakaribishwa Novemba hii.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Machakos in talooyinka ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta la soo dhaweynayo bisha November.
Dholuo: EACC oparo ne ji duto e County ma Machakos ni ji mor ahinya gi weche ma gichiwo e wi chenro mag dongruok e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in West Pokot County this January.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika shule za Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Januari hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku dhawaaqay qaybinta deeqaha waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan dugsiyada Gobolka West Pokot bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ogolo chiwo mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre man gi chandruok e skunde man West Pokot County e dwe mar Januar.

English: KTDA advises farmers in Murang'a County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the August planting season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Agosti.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Murang'a inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: KTDA nyiso jopur e county mar Murang'a ni giti gi olembe mag yien kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Agost.

English: IEBC advises students in Machakos County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access revision guides.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Machakos kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kufikia miongozo ya marekebisho.
Somali: IEBC waxay kula talineysaa ardayda Degmada Machakos inay dalbadaan bogga waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan hagaha dib-u-eegista.
