Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ukame katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo abaaraha ku dhaca gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: DCI tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne oro e Homa Bay County.

English: The booming youthful generation stretch demand as well, inclusive knowledge and expertise in livestock production, market access for livestock products..
Kiswahili: Kizazi cha vijana kinachokua kinanyoosha mahitaji pia, maarifa jumuishi na utaalam katika uzalishaji wa mifugo, upatikanaji wa soko la bidhaa za mifugo..
Somali: Qarnigii dhalinyarada ee soo koraya ayaa sidoo kale kordhinaya baahida, aqoon iyo khibrad ku saabsan wax soo saarka xoolaha, marin u helka suuqyada alaabta xoolaha.
Dholuo: Oganda ma rowere ma sani dhi nyime dongo bende dwaro ng'eyo weche mathoth e wi kit ngima mar jamni, kod kaka ginyalo yudo ohala mar jamni.

English: SHA reminds the public in Murang'a County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Murang'a in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: SHA parone ji duto manie County mar Murang'a ni chiwo ripot mar kawo asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Kilifi County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qofkasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Kilifi inuu wacayo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo oluong kony mar thieth mar paro maonge chudo.

English: Through collaboration with county health authorities, WHO is supporting the expansion of emergency obstetric and newborn care services in northern Kenya, including training health workers and strengthening outreach services to reach remote communities.
Kiswahili: Kupitia ushirikiano na mamlaka za afya za kaunti, WHO inaunga mkono upanuzi wa huduma za dharura za uzazi na watoto wachanga kaskazini mwa Kenya, ikiwa ni pamoja na kutoa mafunzo kwa wahudumu wa afya na kuimarisha huduma za kufikia jamii za mbali.
Somali: Iyada oo kaashaneysa hay'adaha caafimaadka ee degmada, WHO waxay taageeraysaa ballaarinta adeegyada degdegga ah ee daryeelka umulisada iyo dhallaanka ee waqooyiga Kenya, oo ay ku jiraan tababaridda shaqaalaha caafimaadka iyo xoojinta adeegyada gaarsiinta si loo gaaro bulshooyinka fog fog.
Dholuo: Kokalo kuom riwruok gi jotend thieth mag kaunti, WHO konyo e medo tich mar rito nyithindo ma nyuol mapiyo kod rito nyithindo ma pok onyuol e piny Kenya ma nyandwat, moriwo nyaka puonjo jotich mag thieth kod keto teko e tich mar lendo mondo gichop e gwenge mabor.

English: SHA urges residents of Kirinyaga County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga wapewe huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kirinyaga inay dalbadaan adeeg bixinta iyaga oo aan bixin laaluush si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jogweng' Kirinyaga County mondo okonygi gi tij lendo maok gichulo asoya mondo giked gi asoya e migepe mag sirkal.

English: Notice: IEBC opens applications for school laptops under the digital literacy programme for learners in Busia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC inafungua maombi ya kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Busia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay furaysaa codsiyada kumbuyuutarrada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee ardayda degmada Busia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IEBC chako tiyo gi kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar somo kod somo mar digital e county mar Busia.

English: DPP reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kwale County that access to psychosocial support is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisaikolojia unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee Gobolka Kwale in helitaanka taageerada cilmu-nafsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e county mar Kwale ni thuolo mar yudo kony kuom weche mag pach ji yudore maonge chudo.

English: Expectant mothers should pack a clean birth kit by the 7th month of pregnancy for emergencies.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wajawazito wanapaswa kufunga vifaa vya kujifungulia vilivyo safi ifikapo mwezi wa 7 wa ujauzito kwa dharura.
Somali: Hooyooyinka uurka leh waxay u baahan yihiin inay xirtaan xirmo dhalashada nadiif ah bisha 7aad ee uurka ee xaaladaha degdegga ah.
Dholuo: Min nyithindo madwaro nyuol onego okaw kit nyuol maler e dwe mar abiriyo mar ichne mondo okonygi e kinde mag chandruok.

English: Notice: Universities Fund opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu hufungua maombi ya maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali bila malipo kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu u furayaa codsiyada barashada bilaashka ah ee dhijitaalka ah ee ardayda ku nool degmada West Pokot.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Yunivasiti Fund oyawo kwayo mag somo mar digital maonge chudo ne jopuonjre e West Pokot County.

English: NCPB reminds livestock keepers in Bomet County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: NCPB waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Bomet in ay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska xayawaanada ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: NCPB paronwa jorit jamni e county mar Bomet ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: KRA reminds the public in Kakamega County that input on the county budget process is welcome this February.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba mchango kwenye mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti unakaribishwa Februari hii.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha Gobolka Kakamega in talooyinka ku saabsan habka miisaaniyadda gobolka ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: KRA oparo ne ji duto e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mar bajet mar kaunti e dwe mar Februar.

English: Public health advisory: Kenya Red Cross warns of increased typhoid risk in Garissa County and advises the public to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya matumbo katika Kaunti ya Garissa na kushauri umma kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ka digeysaa kororka halista cudurka 'typhoid' ee Gobolka Garissa waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo.
Dholuo: Chenro mar thieth mar ji: Kenya Red Cross chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar typhoid e County mar Garissa kendo ojiwo ji duto mondo ochop e okang' moromo mar thiedho.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Nyandarua County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba upatikanaji wa maelekezo ya makazi salama unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Nyandarua in helitaanka tixraacyada magangelyo ammaan ah ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e kaunti mar Nyandarua ni thuolo mar yudo kuonde ma ginyalo dakie en gima onge chudo.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public in Kisumu County about the importance of hypertension awareness for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhusu umuhimu wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay dadka degmada Kisumu xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay wacyiga cadaadiska sare ee caafimaadka qoyska.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji duto e County mar Kisumu kuom ber mar miyo ji ong'e ni tuwo mar hypertension en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Mid-term evaluation of Maternal and Child Nutrition Programme (MCNP II) in Kenya
Kiswahili: Tathmini ya muda wa kati ya Mpango wa Lishe ya Mama na Mtoto (MCNP II) nchini Kenya
Somali: Qiimaynta muddada dhexe ee Barnaamijka Nafaqada Hooyada iyo Carruurta (MCNP II) ee Kenya
Dholuo: Nonro mar kind kinde mar chenro mar Chiemo mar Min kod Nyithindo (MCNP II) e piny Kenya

English: Good leadership is important for progressive groups. What determines good leadership are, transparency, teamwork and financial integrity.
Kiswahili: Uongozi mzuri ni muhimu kwa makundi ya maendeleo. Nini huamua uongozi mzuri, ni uwazi, kazi ya timu na uadilifu wa kifedha.
Somali: Hogaaminta wanaagsan waxay muhiim u tahay kooxaha horumarsan. Waxa go'aamiya hogaaminta fiican waa hufnaan, shaqada kooxda iyo daacadnimada maaliyadeed.
Dholuo: Riwruok maber en gima dwarore ahinya ne grube ma timo dongruok.

English: KEMSA appeals to caregivers in Turkana County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the April maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi Aprili.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Turkana inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka ee Abriil.
Dholuo: KEMSA okwayo jorit e county mar Turkana mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi kaka achiel kuom chenro mar April mar weche thieth mag min.

English: Pest Control Products Board informs coffee farmers in Nakuru County of new market linkage opportunities this July.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawafahamisha wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Julai hii.
Somali: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka ayaa ku wargeliyay beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Nakuru fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok mag Pest nyiso jopur ma loso chai e kaunti mar Nakuru thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Samburu County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda Gobolka Samburu inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur e county mar Samburu mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Garissa County about the importance of hand hygiene for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuhusu umuhimu wa usafi wa mikono kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha Gobolka Garissa muhiimadda ay leedahay nadaafadda gacmaha ee caafimaadka qoyska.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross parone ji duto e County mar Garissa kuom ber mar rito ler mar lwedo e ngima joot.

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health warns of increased typhoid risk in Bomet County and advises the public to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya matumbo katika Kaunti ya Bomet na inashauri umma kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ka digtay kororka halista cudurka 'typhoid' ee gobolka Bomet waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay isla markiiba baaritaan ku sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: Ministry of Health osiemo ji kuom dongruok mar tuo mar typhoid e county mar Bomet kendo ojiwo ji mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni kodgi.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Embu County about a rise in identity theft and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Utafiti wa Uhalifu inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuhusu ongezeko la wizi wa kitambulisho na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ka digaya dadka deggan degmada Embu oo ku saabsan kororka xadgudubka aqoonsiga wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng' Embu County kuom dongruok mar kwalo kitgi kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: The DigiSchool pilot, managed by UNESCO, Huawei Kenya, and the Ministry of Education, connected 13 rural and peri-urban schools to high-speed internet using national fiber and wireless solutions.
Kiswahili: Programu ya majaribio ya DigiSchool, inayoendeshwa na UNESCO, Huawei Kenya, na Wizara ya Elimu, iliunganisha shule 13 za vijijini na za mijini na mtandao wa kasi kwa kutumia suluhisho za kitaifa za fiber na wireless.
Somali: Tijaabada DigiSchool, oo ay maamusho UNESCO, Huawei Kenya, iyo Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, ayaa 13 dugsi oo miyiga ah iyo magaalooyinka hareeraheeda ah ku xidhay internet xawaare sare leh iyadoo la adeegsanayo xalalka fiber iyo wireless ee qaranka.
Dholuo: Chenro mar DigiSchool, mitayo gi UNESCO, Huawei Kenya, kod Ministry of Education, noriwo skunde 13 mag gweng' koda mag taonde mag taondno gi intanet mar piyo ka gitiyo gi yore mag fiber kod wireless.

English: State Department for Basic Education urges parents and teachers in Garissa County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa usimamizi wa shule.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta Gobolka Garissa inay u soo sheegaan maamulka dugsiga wixii arrimo ah oo ku saabsan amniga.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e gweng' mar Garissa mondo onyis jotelo mag skul wach moro amora motudore gi ritruok.

English: TSC reminds schools in Vihiga County to strengthen anti-bullying measures this May.
Kiswahili: TSC inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuimarisha hatua za kupambana na uonevu Mei hii.
Somali: TSC waxay xusuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Vihiga inay xoojiyaan tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibaatada bisha May.
Dholuo: TSC oparo ne skunde man Vihiga County mondo omed jiwo yore mag kedo gi ichwanyruok e dwe mar Mei.

English: NPS warns residents of Meru County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru juu ya kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kutenda.
Somali: NPS waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru kororka nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban.
Dholuo: NPS chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar Meru County e wi medruok mar chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by KEMRI will be held in Lamu County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na KEMRI itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Lamu Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay KEMRI ayaa lagu qaban doonaa gobolka Lamu bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma KEMRI ochano biro timore Lamu County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: NDMA disburses Ksh1.1 billion for drought affected families
Kiswahili: NDMA inatoa Ksh1.1 bilioni kwa familia zilizoathiriwa na ukame
Somali: NDMA waxay bixisay Ksh1.1 bilyan oo loogu talagalay qoysaska ay abaartu saameysay
Dholuo: NDMA chiwo dola bilionde 1.1 ne joot ma oyudo masira

English: Notice: KRA launches community-based development programmes in Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inazindua mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay bilawday barnaamijyo horumarineed oo ku saleysan bulshada ee degmada Kiambu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KRA chako chenro mag dongruok e alwora mar Kiambu County.

English: A faster plan to issue grants in Koyanza: SACCOs were started to look into the success of credit and savings through farmer cooperative societies ...
Kiswahili: Mpango wa haraka zaidi wa kutoa misaada huko Koyanza: SACCO zilianza kuangalia mafanikio ya mkopo na akiba kupitia mashirika ya ushirika wa wakulima ...
Somali: Qorshe si dhakhso badan loogu bixiyo deeq-bixinada Koyanza: SACCOs ayaa la bilaabay in ay fiiriyaan guusha amaahda iyo keydinta iyada oo loo marayo ururada iskaashiga beeralayda ...
Dholuo: Chenro mar chiwo kony mapiyo e Koyanza: ne ochak SACCO mondo onon dongruok mar pesa kod pesa ma ji yudo kokalo kuom riwruoge ma loso jopur ...

English: DCI warns residents of Kericho County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: DCI waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho kororka khiyaamada lacagaha SIM-swap waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax falin.
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kericho County e wi medruok mar wuond mar loko SIM kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: Judiciary of Kenya advises residents of Lamu County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan shahaadada dhalashada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya nyiso jogweng'o mag Lamu County mondo oketgi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro yudo barua mar nyuol.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Vihiga County about a rise in phishing messages and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga juu ya kuongezeka kwa ujumbe wa phishing na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ka digaya dadka deggan degmada Vihiga oo ku saabsan kororka farriimaha phishing wuxuuna ku talinayaa shacabka inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax falin.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations osiemo jogweng' mar County mar Vihiga kuom wach medruok mar ote mag phishing kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges residents of Embu County to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night following a rise in reported dengue fever cases.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na dawa za wadudu kila usiku kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya homa ya dengue.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay isticmaalaan shabaqa cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska cudurka dengue.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' mar Embu County mondo oti gi otamba molos gi yedhe makelo tuoche mag lum otieno ka otieno nikech kwan mar joma nigi tuwo mar dengue osemedore.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds residents of Makueni County that access to national ID applications is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba kufikia maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni in helitaanka codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General parone jogweng' Makueni County ni koro yot yudo kwayo mag ID mar piny mangima kokalo kuom chenro mag sirkal.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kirinyaga County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kutafuta msaada katika nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka Gobolka Kirinyaga inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e gweng' mar Kirinyaga mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: CDC announces NHIF/SHA claims support for residents of Laikipia County starting this March.
Kiswahili: CDC inatangaza NHIF/SHA inadai msaada kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kuanzia Machi hii.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa in NHIF/SHA ay taageero u sheegtay dadka deggan degmada Laikipia laga bilaabo bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: CDC olando ni NHIF/SHA biro chiwo kony ne joma odak e County mar Laikipia kochakore dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: EACC will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ee degmada Meru.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: EACC biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e kaunti mar Meru.

English: CDC appeals to caregivers in Nakuru County to visit their nearest maternity wing as part of the March maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Machi.
Somali: CDC waxay ku baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Nakuru inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow sida qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: CDC okwayo jorit e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo olimgi ka gin machiegni gi kama giyudoe nyithindo e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission opens a new electrical installation programme at the vocational centre in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafungua mpango mpya wa ufungaji wa umeme katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu furayaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan rakibidda korontada xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Migori.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj chako chenro manyien mar keto sitima e kar tiegruok e gweng' mar Migori.

English: KTDA encourages farmers in Mandera County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for coffee.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya kahawa.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Mandera inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan kafeega.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e county mar Mandera mondo ous olembe mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo, mondo omi ohala mar chai obed maber.

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief, June 2024
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP wa Kenya, Juni 2024
Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya, Juun 2024
Dholuo: Wach machuok mar piny Kenya mar WFP, dwe mar auchiel 2024

English: Agricultural progression applying digital know-how in the fight against COVID 19, and ...laying foundation for conservation,..IFAD has been warned to desist from bad mentality.
Kiswahili: Maendeleo ya kilimo kwa kutumia ujuzi wa kidijitali katika vita dhidi ya COVID 19, na ... kuweka msingi wa uhifadhi,.. IFAD imeonywa kuacha mawazo mabaya.
Somali: Horumarka beeraha iyadoo la adeegsanayo aqoonta dijitaalka ah ee la dagaallanka COVID 19, iyo ... Dhisidda aasaaska ilaalinta deegaanka,.. IFAD waxaa lagu digay inay ka fogaato maskaxda xun.
Dholuo: Dongruok mar pur ma tiyo gi teknoloji mar digital e kedo gi COVID 19, kendo... keto mise mar rito ngima,... IFAD osejiwo mondo owe paro maricho.

English: Notice: KUCCPS reminds citizens in Lamu County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Somali: Xusuusin: KUCCPS waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Lamu xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KUCCPS paronwa raia mag Lamu County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo gi ratiro mag chik.

English: Council of Governors updates residents of Kisii County on progress of ward-level service delivery this April.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawasilisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii juu ya maendeleo ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya Aprili hii.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay dadka deggan degmada Kisii ku wargeliyaan horumarka adeegga heerka degmada bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch olero ne jogweng' Kisii County dongruok mar chiwo kony e wi ward e dwe mar April.

English: TVET invites youth in Wajir County to enroll for motor vehicle mechanics training this September.
Kiswahili: TVET inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Wajir kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari Septemba hii.
Somali: TVET waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Wajir inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka mashiinka gawaarida gaadiidka bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: TVET gwelo rowere e gweng' mar Wajir mondo odonjre e tiegruok mar jomisonari mag mtokni e dwe mar Septemba.

English: KUCCPS reminds youth in Turkana County that HELB funding is available for welding and fabrication training.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya kulehemu na utengenezaji.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Turkana in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka alxanka iyo soo saarista.
Dholuo: KUCCPS oparo ne rowere man Turkana County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar welding kod manufacturing.

English: Notice: IEBC opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Embu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Embu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay ka furaysaa goob adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-muwaadiniinta degmada Embu.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: IEBC oseyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag kwayo ji mondo obed raia e piny Embu County.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Migori County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Migori kwamba ufikiaji wa usaidizi wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Migori in helitaanka taageerada sheegashada NHIF/SHA ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone ji duto manie County Migori ni koro ginyalo yudo kony mag kwayo mag NHIF/SHA e kuonde moyier.

English: Kenya country strategic plan (2023 - 2027)
Kiswahili: Mpango mkakati wa nchi ya Kenya (2023 - 2027)
Somali: Qorshaha Istaraatiijiyadda Dalka Kenya (2023 - 2027)
Dholuo: Chenro mar chenro mar piny Kenya (2023 - 2027)

English: IPOA reminds residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay dhageystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah xilliyada shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: IPOA parone jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji moa kuondego ma jotelo mag gweng'no ogolo e kinde masiche mag ndara.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds residents of Marsabit County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba kufikia utunzaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Hay'adda garsoorka Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda ka sahlan tahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone jogweng' mar Marsabit County ni koro nyalo bedo mayot tiyo gi yore ma sirkal tiyogo e loso barua mag nyuol.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Kirinyaga County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the February planting season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kutumia viwango vilivyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Februari.
Somali: Maamulka Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Kirinyaga inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Febraayo.
Dholuo: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nyiso jopur e County mar Kirinyaga ni giti gi yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Februar.

English: DPP urges anyone experiencing abuse in Nyeri County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: DPP inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Nyeri apeleke simu ya simu ya GBV 1195.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Nyeri inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: DPP ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e County mar Nyeri mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195 maonge chudo.

English: Lamu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Lamu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2023
Somali: Degmada Lamu: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Lamu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2023

English: State Department for TVET advises applicants in Kilifi County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Kilifi inay dalbadaan booska TVET iyada oo loo marayo KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET nyiso jogo madwaro yudo tiegruok e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo okonygi gi KUCCPS.

English: Public health advisory: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response warns of increased malaria risk in Taita-Taveta County and advises the public to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya malaria katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta na inashauri umma kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Somali: Talo-bixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay ka digtay kororka halista daacuunka ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: Migawo mar Nono kod Duoko ne Tuoche chiwo siem kuom nengo mar malaria medore e Taita-Taveta County kendo ojiwo ji duto mondo otiek dose duto mar thiedho.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds mobile money users in Kisumu County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka udanganyifu wa fedha za simu.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kisumu inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa si looga fogaado khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne joma tiyo gi pesa mag simo e gweng' mar Kisumu ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo kik gitim mibadhi mar pesa mag simu.

English: KNEC reminds youth in Nyeri County that HELB funding is available for ICT skills training.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT.
Somali: KNEC waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nyeri in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka xirfadaha ICT.
Dholuo: KNEC oparo ne rowere man Nyeri County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar lony e yore mag ICT.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Bungoma County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa qofkasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Bungoma inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e gweng' mar Bungoma mondo oluong kony mar thieth mar paro maonge chudo.

English: Kenya - Floods, update (Kenya Met Department, media) (ECHO Daily Flash of 29 November 2023)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Mafuriko, sasisho (Idara ya Met ya Kenya, vyombo vya habari) (ECHO Daily Flash ya 29 Novemba 2023)
Somali: Kenya - Daadad, cusbooneysiin (Waaxda Met-ka Kenya, warbaahinta) (ECHO Daily Flash ee 29 Noofambar 2023)
Dholuo: Kenya - Pi mang'eny, loso (Ofis mar weche mag piny Kenya, weche mag mbui) (ECHO pile ka pile tarik 29 dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2023)

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on the community in Lamu County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Lamu kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada ayaa ugu baaqay bulshada degmada Lamu inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wacayaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oluongo oganda man Lamu County mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo oluong simo mar GBV 1195.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges coffee growers in Taita-Taveta County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Udhibiti wa Pest Products inawasihi wakulima wa kahawa katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kutumia viwango vilivyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda kafeega ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarkooda xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e Taita-Taveta County mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma imiyogi kapok koth ochue mondo okony e medo nyak mar ngano e higani.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Tana River County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Tana River kwamba upatikanaji wa usaidizi wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyotengwa.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadweynaha degmada Tana River in helitaanka taageerada sheegashada NHIF/SHA ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association parone ji duto manie Tana River County ni koro ginyalo yudo kony mar kwayo mag NHIF/SHA e kuonde moyier.

English: NDMA urges the community in West Pokot County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb theft.
Kiswahili: NDMA inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada West Pokot inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo oganda man West Pokot County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polis mar oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o kuo.

English: COMESA advises farmers in Meru County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Meru inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e county mar Meru mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Kenya Situation Update | August 2023: Government Operation Brings Calm to North Rift Region
Kiswahili: Sasisho la Hali ya Kenya | Agosti 2023: Operesheni ya Serikali Yaleta Utulivu katika Mkoa wa Kaskazini mwa Ufa
Somali: Cusbooneysiinta Xaaladda Kenya | Agoosto 2023: Hawlgalka Dowladda oo Degan u soo Celiyay Gobolka Waqooyiga Rift
Dholuo: Oboke mar Kenya | Agost 2023: Tich mar Sirkal Kelo Kuwe e Oganda ma Rift ma Nyanduat

English: HELB urges residents of Machakos County to register their children at the nearest public school to benefit from adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu ili kufaidika na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: HELB waxay dadka deggan degmada Machakos ugu baaqeysaa inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha si ay uga faa'iideystaan fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo ji duto modak e gweng' mar Machakos mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul ma ni machiegni kodgi mondo giyud thuolo mar somo.

English: Teachers Service Commission advises students in Vihiga County to collect materials from the county education office to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kukusanya vifaa kutoka kwa ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ardayda degmada Vihiga kula talinayaa inay ka soo ururiyaan agabyada xafiiska waxbarashada degmada si ay u helaan deeq waxbarasho ardayda u baahan.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jopuonjre e County mar Vihiga mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar tiegruok mar county mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo osuru ne jopuonjre mochando.

English: A small number of vaccinated people may get infected with COVID-19 after vaccination; this is called a breakthrough infection, but they are likely to have milder symptoms than if they were not vaccinated.
Kiswahili: Idadi ndogo ya watu waliochanjwa wanaweza kuambukizwa COVID-19 baada ya chanjo; hii inaitwa maambukizi ya mafanikio, lakini kuna uwezekano wa kuwa na dalili ndogo kuliko kama hawakuchanjwa.
Somali: Tirada yar ee dadka la tallaalay ayaa laga yaabaa inay ku dhacaan COVID-19 tallaalka ka dib; tani waxaa loo yaqaan cudurka horumarinta, laakiin waxay u badan tahay inay la kulmaan calaamado fudud marka loo eego haddii aan la tallaalin.
Dholuo: Kwan matin mar joma osetiyo gi chanjo nyalo mako tuwo mar COVID-19 bang' yudo chanjo; mano iluongo ni tuwo makelo ywaruok, kata kamano nyalo bedo ni gibedo gi tuoche mang'eny matin moloyo ka ok gisechiwgi.

English: Dairy farmers are encouraged to utilize the FarmTrek animal identification and traceability platform to connect with veterinary officials livestock authorities and financial services
Kiswahili: Wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa wanahimizwa kutumia mfumo wa kitambulisho na ufuatiliaji wa wanyama wa FarmTrek ili kuungana na maafisa wa mifugo mamlaka ya mifugo na huduma za kifedha.
Somali: Beeraleyda caanaha waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay isticmaalaan madal aqoonsiga iyo raadraaca xayawaanka FarmTrek si ay ula xiriiraan saraakiisha xoolaha, hay'adaha xoolaha iyo adeegyada maaliyadeed
Dholuo: Ojiwo jopur mag chak mondo oti gi fom mar FarmTrek mar fwenyo le kendo luwogi mondo omany tudruok gi jotelo mag weche thieth mag dhok kod jotend tije mag pesa

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds livestock keepers in Busia County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Busia kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya xoolaha ka shaqeeya degmada Busia inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda goobaha lagu burburiyo ee loo qoondeeyay si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board parone jorit jamni e county mar Busia mondo opidhgi gi tuoche e kuonde moketi mag chwoyo jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: The 4K Club program is actively nurturing young agricultural professionals in Kenya Schools are encouraged to participate and foster innovative farming skills among students
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Klabu ya 4K unakuza kikamilifu wataalamu wa kilimo wachanga nchini Kenya Shule zinahimizwa kushiriki na kukuza ujuzi wa ubunifu wa kilimo miongoni mwa wanafunzi.
Somali: Barnaamijka 4K Club ayaa si firfircoon u kobcinaya xirfadlayaasha beeraha ee da'da yar ee Kenya Dugsiyada waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay ka qaybgalaan oo ay kor u qaadaan xirfadaha beeraha ee hal-abuurka ah ee ardayda
Dholuo: Chenro mar 4K Club konyo rowere ma tiyo e tij pur e piny Kenya.

English: Kenya's journey shows how sustained investment and careful planning can build stronger public health intelligence over time.
Kiswahili: Safari ya Kenya inaonyesha jinsi uwekezaji endelevu na mipango makini inavyoweza kujenga akili ya afya ya umma kwa wakati.
Somali: Safarka Kenya wuxuu muujinayaa sida maalgashiga joogtada ah iyo qorsheynta taxaddar leh ay u dhisi karaan sirdoon caafimaad oo xooggan waqti ka dib.
Dholuo: Odhiambo mar Kenya nyiso kaka keto mwandu ma osiko kendo keto chenro maber nyalo gero rieko motegno mar thieth mar oganda bang’ kinde.

English: Kenya: Witnesses Describe Police Killing Protesters
Kiswahili: Kenya: Mashahidi Waeleza Polisi Wanawaua Waandamanaji
Somali: Kenya: Goob-joogayaal Sharaxay Dilkii Booliska u geysteen Dibad-baxayaasha
Dholuo: Kenya: Joneno onyiso kaka jopolisi nenego jogo ma ne odhi nyime gi ng’anjo

English: Explore digital tools like M-Farm that can help youth groups with market prices, weather forecasts, extension advice, and mobile transactions.
Kiswahili: Gundua zana za kidijitali kama vile M-Farm ambazo zinaweza kusaidia vikundi vya vijana kwa bei za soko, utabiri wa hali ya hewa, ushauri wa ugani na miamala ya simu.
Somali: Soo sahmin qalabka dijitaalka ah sida M-Farm oo ka caawin kara kooxaha dhalinyarada qiimaha suuqa, saadaasha cimilada, talooyinka kordhinta, iyo macaamilada moobilka.
Dholuo: Non gik ma nyalo konyo rowere ng'eyo nengo mar pesa, weche ma kor yamo wacho, kaka kaka ginyalo konyo rowere mondo odag e ngima maber, kendo gichiw paro e wi kaka ginyalo tiyo gi gik ma kamago.

English: Tana River County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for December 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tana River: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Desemba 2023
Somali: Degmada Tana River: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Diseembar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Aora Tana: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2023

English: Notice: KNEC opens a new motor vehicle mechanics programme at the vocational centre in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inafungua programu mpya ya ufundi wa magari katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan farsamada gawaarida gawaari ee xarunta xirfadaha ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KNEC chako chenro manyien mar tiyo gi masin mag mtokni e skul mar tich e gweng' mar Taita-Taveta.

English: Ministry of Education urges youth in Kajiado County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kajiado inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda ka hor inta aysan qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo rowere e Kajiado County mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto giseyudo kapok gitimo tije mag sirkal.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages mothers in Trans Nzoia County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa hooyooyinka degmada Trans Nzoia inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo mine manie Trans Nzoia County mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Notice: NPS conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Murang'a County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NPS inafanya mkutano wa jamii juu ya ujenzi wa amani wa kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ku saabsan dhismaha nabadda qaranka ee degmada Murang'a bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Riwruok mar NPS timo romo mar oganda e wi loso kuwe e gweng' mar Murang'a e dwe mar Septemba.

English: The National Agricultural Investment Plan is undergoing a review to align with global and national priorities Stay informed for updates on how this may affect your agricultural activities
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Kitaifa wa Uwekezaji wa Kilimo unafanyiwa tathmini ili kuoanisha vipaumbele vya kimataifa na kitaifa Endelea kufahamishwa ili kupata taarifa kuhusu jinsi hii inaweza kuathiri shughuli zako za kilimo.
Somali: Qorshaha Maalgashiga Beeraha Qaranka ayaa dib loo eegay si loo jaanqaado mudnaanta caalamiga ah iyo tan qaranka Fadlan la soco wixii casriyeyn ah ee ku saabsan sida ay tani u saameyn karto howlahaaga beeraha
Dholuo: Chenro mar Piny mar Golo Ohala e Tij Lemo sani koro itimo nonro mondo omi ochop e okang ' mowinjore gi chenro mag piny mangima kod mag piny mangima.

English: Notice: KALRO will train farmers in Siaya County on agroforestry this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Siaya juu ya kilimo cha misitu Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Siaya ee ku saabsan beeraha kaynta bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KALRO biro tiego jopur e gweng' mar Siaya e weche mag yiengni mag bunge e dwe mar Agost.

English: DCI urges motorists and pedestrians in Mombasa County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent landslides-related incidents.
Kiswahili: DCI inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuzingatia maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Mombasa inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira dhulgariirka.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo dereba kod joma wuotho e paw Mombasa County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji moa kuondego ma sirkal ogolo mondo gikwed hinyruok ma timore nikech yiengni mag lowo.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) will hold a public participation forum on development planning forums in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo katika Wilaya ya Tana River.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta ee degmada Tana River.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag dongruok e taon mar Tana River County.

English: NCPB promotes conservation tillage among farmers in Busia County as part of the July climate resilience drive.

English: NCPB invites farmers in Kitui County to a free training on pest and disease management this November.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Embu County that access to subsidised dialysis is now available at designated centres.

English: NTSA calls on the community in Wajir County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.

English: Farmers in coffee growing regions are encouraged to maintain their coffee trees as the 2025 2026 season is marked by strong market performance and robust demand for Kenyan coffee
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika maeneo yanayolima kahawa wanahimizwa kudumisha miti yao ya kahawa kwani msimu wa 2025 2026 unaadhimishwa na utendaji mzuri wa soko na mahitaji makubwa ya kahawa ya Kenya.

Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa usaidizi wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.

Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit nyiso jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni mondo giyud kony mar yudo thieth makonyo.

English: Universities Fund reminds parents in Nyamira County that bursary allocation registration is open this September.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba usajili wa ugawaji wa bursari umefunguliwa Septemba hii.

Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Laikipia inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor inta aan la helin nidaamyada doorashada.
Dholuo: IEBC parone jogedo e County mar Laikipia mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero ka pok itimo yiero.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges coffee growers in Machakos County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawataka wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Machakos kutumia viwango vya mbolea vinavyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Machakos inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey roobka ka hor si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e county mar Machakos mondo oti gi ratiro ma gichiwo mar pidho ngano kapok koth ochue mondo okony e medo nyak mar koth e higani.

English: Notice: Universities Fund opens applications for textbooks and learning materials for learners in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu hufungua maombi ya vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Tana River.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu u furayaa codsiyada buugaagta iyo qalabka wax lagu barto ardayda degmada Tana River.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Yunivasiti Fund yawo kwayo mag buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok ne jopuonjre man Tana River County.

English: @MOH_Kenya is collaborating with counties to set up isolation centres countrywide to handle coronavirus cases. If you need help call 719. #KomeshaCorona @K24Tv live show
Kiswahili: @MOH_Kenya inashirikiana na kaunti kuweka vituo vya kutengwa nchini kote kushughulikia visa vya coronavirus. Ukihitaji msaada piga 719. #KomeshaCorona @K24Tv live show
Somali: @MOH_Kenya waxay la shaqeyneysaa degmooyinka si ay u dhisaan xarumo karantiil oo dalka oo dhan ah si wax looga qabto kiisaska coronavirus. Haddii aad u baahan tahay caawimaad wac 719. #KomeshaCorona @K24Tv bandhig toos ah
Dholuo: @MOH_Kenya tiyo kanyakla gi kaunti mondo oket kuonde ma kar kende e piny mangima mondo ochung' ne jotugo mag korona. Ka idwaro kony, goch namba 719. #KomeshaCorona @K24Tv program live

English: KEMRI announces outpatient services for residents of Nandi County starting this December.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatangaza huduma za wagonjwa wa nje kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nandi kuanzia Desemba hii.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa adeegyada bukaanka dibedda ee dadka deggan degmada Nandi laga bilaabo Diseembar.
Dholuo: KEMRI ogolo chenro mar konyo jotuo e gwenge mag Nandi County kochakore dwe mar Desemba.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Turkana County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay dadka deggan degmada Turkana kula talineysaa inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun iyo biyo nadiif ah si joogto ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit nyiso jogweng'o mag Turkana County mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: KUCCPS encourages out-of-school children in Kwale County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Kwale kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa watu wazima chini ya elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Kwale inay ku qoraan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee waxbarashada dhexe ee maalinlaha ah ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e county mar Kwale mondo odonj e program mar puonjo jomadongo somo mar sekondari.

English: State Department for TVET conducts a civic education forum on constitutional rights in Kisumu County this August.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu haki za kikatiba katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Agosti hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay qabanqaabinaysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee degmada Kisumu bishii Ogosto.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi ratiro mag sirkal e County mar Kisumu e dwe mar Agost.

English: IEBC invites residents of Nairobi County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: IEBC gwelo jogweng' mar Nairobi County mondo ochiw ripot mondik kapok ndalo ochopo mar wuoyo e wi chenro mag sirkal ochopo.

English: Judiciary of Kenya reminds the public in West Pokot County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this December.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kwamba ushiriki katika mashauriano ya sera za umma unakaribishwa Desemba hii.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya dadweynaha gobolka West Pokot in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya parone ji duto e West Pokot County ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mag sirkal e dwe mar Desemba.

Kiswahili: Wizara inapanga warsha juu ya mbinu bora za umwagiliaji katika mikoa ya ASAL.
Somali: Wasaaradda ayaa jadwalka u sameysay aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan habdhaqanka ugu wanaagsan ee waraabka gobollada ASAL.
Dholuo: Ministeri ochano mar timo chokruok e wi yore mabeyo mag ywayo pi e gwenge mag ASAL.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds expectant mothers in Nandi County that access to skilled birth attendance is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Nandi kwamba ufikiaji wa mahudhurio ya uzazi wenye ujuzi ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Nandi in helitaanka daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfad leh ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche parone mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Nandi ni thuolo mar yudo nyithindo ma nigi lony en maonge chudo e kuonde duto ma ji yudoree.

English: State Department for Basic Education reminds needy students in Embu County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Embu kwamba maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Embu in deeqaha waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay codsiyada ardayda baahan ay dhowaan dhammaadaan.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education oparo ne jopuonjre man gi chan e county mar Embu ni chiwo mag tiegruok ne josomo ma nigi chan biro rumo machiegni.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will train farmers in Kisumu County on agroforestry this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhusu kilimo cha misitu Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu tababar siin doonaa beeraleyda degmada Kisumu ku saabsan beeraha kaymaha bisha November.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro tiego jopur e gweng' mar Kisumu e weche mag yiende mag bunge e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free dengue fever screening is available at all public health centres in Vihiga County this July.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa homa ya dengue bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Julai hii.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka hargabka dengue ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynta ee degmada Vihiga bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji ni thieth mar thieth ma onge chudo mar dengue yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Vihiga e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: NPS launches a cattle rustling prevention campaign in Nakuru County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NPS yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay billaabaneysaa olole looga hortago xanta xoolaha ee gobolka Nakuru bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NPS chako kampen mar geng'o ywaruok mag jamni e gweng' mar Nakuru e dwe mar Januar.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages mothers in West Pokot County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada West Pokot inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit jiwo mine e West Pokot County mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Kenya Red Cross appeals to caregivers in Taita-Taveta County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the July maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya watoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya harakati za afya ya uzazi za Julai.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Taita-Taveta inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee bisha July.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross okwayo jorit e Taita-Taveta County mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo kaka achiel kuom chenro mar thieth mar mine e dwe mar Julai.

English: Amref Health Africa Launches 'Tucheze Tustawi' Project to Support Early Childhood Development in Refugee and Host Communities in Turkana West Sub-county
Kiswahili: Amref Health Africa Yazindua Mradi wa 'Tucheze Tustawi' wa Kusaidia Ukuaji wa Utotoni katika Jumuiya za Wakimbizi na Wenyeji katika Kaunti Ndogo ya Turkana Magharibi.
Somali: Amref Health Africa waxay Bilaabaysaa Mashruuca 'Tucheze Tustawi' si loo Taageero Horumarinta Carruurnimada Hore ee Bulshada Qaxootiga iyo Martigelinta ee Degmo-hoosaadka Galbeedka Turkana
Dholuo: Amref Thieth Afrika Ochako Chenro mar 'Tucheze Tustawi' mar Konyo Dongruok mar Nyithindo Matin E Jolweny kod Mier ma Orwako Jolweny e Kaunti Matin mar Turkana West

English: Notice: NPS issues a cybersecurity alert on phishing messages affecting residents of Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya ujumbe wa udanganyifu unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan fariimaha phishing ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Wajir.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NPS ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity kuom weche mag phishing makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' mar Wajir County.

English: Kenya Gazette announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linatangaza uboreshaji wa nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku dhawaaqay waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette olando lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mag yudo ID e County mar Bungoma.

Kiswahili: Dalili za afya ya akili kama vile hisia za kufikiria zinaweza kusababisha mkazo wa kimwili na magonjwa, na hivyo kudhibitisha uhusiano wa ubongo na mwili

English: Notice: SHA launches county development projects in Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: SHA inazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya wilaya katika Wilaya ya Kericho.
Somali: Ogeysiis: SHA waxay bilaabaneysaa mashaariic horumarineed oo ka socda degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova (SHA) chako timo dongruok e alwora mar Kericho.

English: Mandera County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Mandera: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Aprili 2023
Somali: Degmada Mandheera: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Mandera: Oboke Mopinyo mar Oro mar Ang'wen higa mar 2023

English: KNCHR conducts outreach to educate the public on constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: KNCHR inafanya kampeni ya kuelimisha umma juu ya haki za kikatiba.
Somali: KNCHR waxay wadashaqeyn ku sameysaa barashada dadweynaha ee ku saabsan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: KNCHR timo chenro mar puonjo ji e wi ratiro mag sirkal.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) launches a December awareness campaign on proper sanitation across Samburu County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Desemba juu ya usafi wa mazingira katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa bilaabay olole wacyiga ah bishii Diseembar oo ku saabsan nadaafadda saxda ah ee Gobolka Samburu.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Desemba e wi thieth mowinjore e gweng' mar Samburu.

English: Council of Governors encourages first-time voters in Kisii County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawatia moyo wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kisii kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku dhiirigelinayaan codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Kisii inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo joma okwongo yiero e county mar Kisii mondo olim kama ichanoe ji mar IEBC machiegni kodgi.

English: MoH reaffirms Kenya's commitment to spearheading East African food environment policies including front-of-pack labeling.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inathibitisha tena kujitolea kwa Kenya katika kuongoza sera za mazingira ya chakula za Afrika Mashariki ikiwa ni pamoja na uwekaji lebo kwenye pakiti.
Somali: Wasaaradda Maaliyadda ayaa xaqiijinaysa sida Kenya uga go'an tahay inay hormuud ka noqoto siyaasadaha deegaanka cuntada ee Bariga Afrika oo ay ku jiraan calaamadaynta alaabta.
Dholuo: MoH onyiso kendo ng’uono mar Kenya mar telo ne chike mag piny Afrika ma Wuokchieng’ ma oting’o keto lembruok e nyim chiemo.

English: Buying medicine for the children at the streets without the doctors advice is dangerous for children
Kiswahili: Kununua dawa kwa watoto barabarani bila ushauri wa madaktari ni hatari kwa watoto
Somali: Dhakhaatiirta la'aantiis iibsashada daawooyinka carruurta jidadka ayaa khatar u ah carruurta
Dholuo: Ng'iewo yedhe mag thieth ne nyithindo e nderni maok lakteche ochiwonegi paro nyalo kelo hinyruok ne nyithindo

English: COMESA encourages farmers in Migori County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for tea.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora ya chai.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Migori inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo shaaha ah.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e county mar Migori mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar chai.

English: OGP reminds residents of Busia County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia ambao huhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia ee ka qeybgalaya kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada ayaa xoojinaya maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: OGP paronwa jogweng' County mar Busia ma biro e chokruok maduong' mar county assembly mondo omed jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Notice: FAO will distribute certified millet seed to farmers in Samburu County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay u qaybin doontaa abuurka miiska ee shahaadada leh beeraleyda Gobolka Samburu bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: FAO biro pogo kodhi mag millet ne jopur manie county mar Samburu e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij tallaabooyin looga hortago dhibaatada dugsiyada gobolka Murang'a.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe mahundu e skunde duto e County mar Murang'a.

English: All TVET trainees to get Ksh 7,000 monthly stipend starting January.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wote wa TVET watapata posho ya kila mwezi ya Ksh 7,000 kuanzia Januari.
Somali: Dhammaan tababarayaasha TVET waxay heli doonaan Ksh 7,000 oo mushahar bille ah laga bilaabo Janaayo.
Dholuo: Jopuonjre duto mag TVET biro yudo chudo mar Ksh 7,000 dwe ka dwe kochakore Januar.

English: Keep hot drinks and cooking pots away from children's reach to prevent burn injuries.
Kiswahili: Weka vinywaji vya moto na vyungu vya kupikia mbali na watoto ili kuzuia majeraha ya kuungua.
Somali: Cabitaannada kulul iyo dheriyada wax lagu karsado ka fogee carruurta si looga hortago dhaawacyada gubashada.
Dholuo: Ket gik ma madho ma liet kod gik ma itiyogo e tedo mabor gi kama nyithindo ok nyal chopoe mondo kik giyud hinyruok mag wang’.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Red Cross will be held in Makueni County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Makueni Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Makueni bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni kambi mar thieth ma Kenya Red Cross ochano ibiro tim e gweng' mar Makueni e dwe mar Septemba.

English: In Wajir County in northern Kenya, the vaccination uptake campaign was also driven by working with political, religious and community leaders as well as through messages relayed via community radio, which is effective among the nomadic herder communities predominantly living in northern Kenya.

Somali: Degmada Wajeer ee waqooyiga Kenya, ololaha tallaalka waxaa sidoo kale ka qayb qaatay la shaqaynta hoggaamiyeyaasha siyaasadda, diinta iyo bulshada iyo sidoo kale farriimaha laga sii daayo raadiyaha bulshada, kaas oo waxtar u leh bulshooyinka xoola-dhaqatada reer guuraaga ah ee inta badan ku nool waqooyiga Kenya.

Somali: Ogeysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta ee Gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Huduma Kenya biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag dongruok e kaunti mar Nyandarua.

English: Promoting technology on push- pull approach. A successful trial. Use of traps. ZARI, DoA,CABI,CIMMYT.Zambia. public information ,inclusivity, on call.
Kiswahili: Kukuza teknolojia juu ya kushinikiza-kuvuta mbinu. jaribio mafanikio. matumizi ya mitego. ZARI, DOA, CABI, CIMMYT.Zambia. habari ya umma, uingizaji, juu ya wito.
Somali: Dhiirrigelinta tikniyoolajiyadda ku saabsan habka riixida, tijaabo guul leh. Isticmaalka dabinada. ZARI, DoA, CABI,CIMMYT.Zambia.
Dholuo: Tiyo gi yore mag tiyo gi weche mag teknoloji e yo makelo yuto, tem ma ne otimore maber, tiyo gi obadho, ZARI, DoA, CABI, CIMMYT, Zambia, chiwo weche ne ji duto, riwo ji duto lwedo, sama iwuoyo kodgi.

English: Notice: KICD announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Narok County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KICD ogolo chenro mar dhi e skunde mag Narok mondo giyud thuolo mar somo.

English: Upscale livestock vaccination against Lumpy Skin Disease to mitigate negative impacts.
Kiswahili: Uzalishaji wa juu wa mifugo dhidi ya Ugonjwa wa ngozi ya Lumpy ili kupunguza athari mbaya.
Somali: Tallaalka xoolaha ee heer sare ah ee ka dhanka ah cudurka maqaarka ee Lumpy si loo yareeyo saameynta xun.
Dholuo: Tiego dhok e okang ' malach mondo omi kik hiny tuoche mag Lumpy Skin Disease.

English: Kenya Gazette warns public officers in Siaya County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya dhidi ya kutumia vibaya mamlaka.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Siaya inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Siaya ni kik giti marach gi migepegi.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges motorists and pedestrians in Uasin Gishu County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawataka madereva wa magari na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Uasin Gishu inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka abaarta la xiriira.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo derebe kod joma wuotho e ndara e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo oluw chike mag wuoth ma jotelo mag gweng'no ogolo mondo gikwed masiche mag oro.

English: KEPHIS informs maize farmers in West Pokot County of new market linkage opportunities this June.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawafahamisha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Juni hii.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee Gobolka West Pokot fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Juun.
Dholuo: KEPHIS nyiso jopur mag kodhi e West Pokot County kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Jun.

English: Kenya: How a village Elder and his horn are keeping people safe from diseases
Kiswahili: Kenya: Jinsi Mzee wa kijiji na pembe yake wanavyolinda watu dhidi ya magonjwa
Somali: Kenya: Sida Oday Tuulo iyo geeskiisu ay dadka uga ilaalinayaan cudurrada
Dholuo: Kenya: Kaka Jaduong’ moro mar gweng’ kod tung’ mare rito ji mondo kik giyud tuoche

English: Ministry of Education promotes partnerships between universities and industry for practical research and innovations.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inaendeleza ushirikiano kati ya vyuo vikuu na tasnia kwa ajili ya utafiti wa vitendo na uvumbuzi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay dhiirrigelisaa iskaashiyada jaamacadaha iyo warshadaha ee cilmi baarista iyo hal-abuurnimada wax ku oolka ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo tudruok e kind yunivasiti kod ohala e weche mag timo nonro koda timo gik manyien.

English: This Local Manufacturing Strategy is structured to position Kenya's healthcare as an investment for social impact, equity, economic growth, commercial traction, and sustainability.
Kiswahili: Mkakati huu wa Uzalishaji wa Ndani umeundwa ili kuweka huduma ya afya ya Kenya kama kitega uchumi cha athari za kijamii, usawa, ukuaji wa uchumi, kuvutia kibiashara na uendelevu.
Somali: Istaraatiijiyaddan Wax-soo-saarka ee Maxaliga ah waxaa loo qaabeeyey in daryeelka caafimaadka ee Kenya loo dhigo maalgashi loogu talagalay saameynta bulshada, sinnaanta, kobaca dhaqaalaha, jiidista ganacsiga, iyo waaritaanka.
Dholuo: Okang’ mar loso gikmoko e pinyno olosi mondo oket thieth mar piny Kenya kaka pesa ma inyalo keto e tich mar kelo ber ne oganda, bedo gi tim makare, dongruok mar weche yuto, loso gikmoko e piny, kod rito piny.

English: KUCCPS encourages residents of Kericho County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo jogweng' Kericho County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda mondo gibed gi ng'eyo kuom kaka ji biro tiyo gi bajet mar county.

English: KRA reminds residents of Bungoma County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba upatikanaji wa utunzaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda fududahay iyada oo loo marayo kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: KRA oparo ne jogweng'o mag Bungoma County ni yudo weche mag nyasi mag nyuol koro yot moloyo kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: EACC advises residents of Siaya County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking birth certificate processing.
Kiswahili: EACC inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Siaya kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa.
Somali: EACC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Siaya inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan shahaadada dhalashada.
Dholuo: EACC nyiso joma odak e county mar Siaya mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro yudo barua mar nyuol.

English: US foreign aid freeze puts FCA projects on hold in Uganda and Kenya
Kiswahili: Kusitishwa kwa misaada ya kigeni ya Marekani kunaweka miradi ya FCA kusitishwa nchini Uganda na Kenya
Somali: Joojinta gargaarka dibadda ee Mareykanka ayaa hakad gelisay mashaariicda FCA ee Uganda iyo Kenya
