Dholuo: Ochung' mar kony ma Amerka chiwo ne pinje ma oko keto chenro mag FCA e okang' e piny Uganda kod Kenya

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Laikipia County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Laikipia inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kalfadhiga tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development jiwo jopur e County mar Laikipia mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e tiego jopur mabiro.

English: State Department for TVET advises applicants in Siaya County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Siaya kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Siaya inay booqdaan xarunta ugu dhow ee tababarka xirfadeed si ay u helaan waxbarashada soo socota.
Dholuo: Ofis mar State for TVET nyiso jogo madwaro yudo tiegruok e county mar Siaya mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud thuolo mar dhi e skundno.

English: Tana River County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tana River: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Februari 2023
Somali: Degmada Tana River: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Aora Tana: Oboke mar Chik Motelo mar Oro mar dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2023

English: Nationwide campaign to deliver Vitamin A to children under 5 and coordinate with routine immunization services.
Kiswahili: Kampeni ya kitaifa ya kutoa VitaminiA kwa watoto walio chini ya miaka 5 na kuratibu huduma za kawaida za chanjo.
Somali: Olole caalami ah oo loogu talagalay bixinta Vitamin A carruurta da'doodu ka yar tahay 5 sano iyo isku xirka adeegyada tallaalka caadiga ah.
Dholuo: Lendo e piny mangima mar chiwo vitamin A ne nyithindo ma johigni 5 gi matin kendo riwo lwedo tije mag thiedho nyithindo.

English: Huduma Kenya invites residents of Mombasa County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kushiriki kupitia portal ya kushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya gwelo jogweng' county mar Mombasa mondo oriwre gi county's online participation portal kaluwore gi nonro mar tich mitimo higa ka higa.

English: KEMRI urges residents of Mandera County to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility following a rise in reported Rift Valley Fever cases.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kutafuta upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera inay isla markiiba baaritaano ka sameeyaan xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska laga soo sheegay Cudurka Rift Valley.
Dholuo: KEMRI ojiwo jogweng'o mag Mandera County mondo omany thieth mapiyo e osiptal man machiegni kodgi bang' medruok mar tuo mar Rift Valley Fever.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: postnatal check-ups clinics will run every November at designated health centres in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Notisi kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi: kliniki za uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa zitafanya kazi kila Novemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka: Xarumaha baaritaanka dhalmada kadib waxaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Nofeembar ee kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Rieko moa kuom Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: klinik mag nonro bang' nyuol ibiro timie higa ka higa e dwe mar Novemba e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Kisii.

English: West Pokot: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2022
Kiswahili: Pokot Magharibi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Julai 2022
Somali: Galbeedka Pokot: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2022
Dholuo: Pokot ma milambo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2022

English: Council of Governors updates residents of Vihiga County on progress of county development projects this May.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawasilisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga juu ya maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo katika kaunti hii Mei.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay dadka deggan degmada Vihiga ku wargeliyaan horumarka mashaariicda horumarinta degmada bisha May.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch chiwo ripot ne jogweng' mar County mar Vihiga e wi dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mar county e dwe mar abich.

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Kisii County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurka laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health nyiso ji duto modak e County mar Kisii mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth ma onge chudo mar oganda mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: HELB reminds schools in Samburu County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this August.
Kiswahili: HELB inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Agosti hii.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada Gobolka Samburu inay xoojiyaan adeegyada hagista iyo la talinta bisha Ogosto.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa skunde e county mar Samburu mondo omed tiyo gi yore mag tayo kendo chiwo paro e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens a new service point for passport services in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee Gobolka Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya osechako tiyo gi ofis manyien e sirkal mar Kirinyaga County.

English: TSC conducts a civic education forum on voter registration in Bomet County this July.
Kiswahili: TSC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Bomet Julai hii.
Somali: TSC waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha degmada Bomet bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: TSC dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi ndiko joma oyiero e county mar Bomet e dwe mar Julai.

English: EACC warns public officers in Makueni County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: EACC inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Makueni dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: EACC waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Makueni inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: EACC chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e gweng' mar Makueni ni kik giti marach gi migepegi.

English: Huduma Kenya updates residents of Mandera County on progress of the county integrated development plan this February.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja ya kaunti hii Februari.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay dadka deggan degmada Mandera ku wargelineysaa horumarka qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya osemiyo jodak mag Mandera County ong'eyo dongruok mar chenro mar dongruok mar county e dwe mar Februar.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations calls on residents of Busia County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of border security.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Utafiti wa Uhalifu inawaomba wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ugu baaqay dadka deggan degmada Busia inay la shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations okwayo jogweng' County mar Busia mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji nitie mondo okony sirkal rito tong'.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) warns coffee farmers in Bomet County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaonya wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Bomet juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay uga digtay beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Bomet cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna kugula talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho chai e county mar Bomet kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Target: Main aim of JP is to continue transforming farming policies through digital technology, courtesy of teamwork with every other team players...
Kiswahili: Lengo: Lengo kuu la JP ni kuendelea kubadilisha sera za kilimo kupitia teknolojia ya kidijitali, kwa hisani ya kazi ya pamoja na kila wachezaji wengine wa timu...
Somali: Bartilmaameed: Ujeeddada ugu weyn ee JP waa in la sii wado beddelka siyaasadaha beeraha iyada oo loo marayo tiknoolajiyada dijitaalka ah, iyadoo la kaashanayo dhammaan ciyaartoyda kale ee kooxda...
Dholuo: Chenro: Chenro maduong' mar JP en dhi nyime loko yore mag pur kokalo kuom teknoloji mar digital, kokalo kuom tiyo kanyachiel gi jokony mamoko duto...

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development restricts movement of poultry in Mombasa County due to a foot and mouth disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo yazuia harakati za kuku katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa digaagga ee gobolka Mombasa sababtuna tahay faafitaanka cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ogeng'o wuoth mar le e county mar Mombasa nikech tuwo mar dhoho.

English: TVETA reported a 6.9 percent increase in TVET institutions to 2756 with 19 colleges elevated to national polytechnic status.
Kiswahili: TVETA iliripoti ongezeko la asilimia 6.9 katika taasisi za TVET hadi 2756 na vyuo vikuu 19 vikiwa na cheo cha kitaifa cha polytechnic.
Somali: TVETA waxay soo sheegtay kororka 6.9 boqolkiiba ee machadyada TVET ilaa 2756 iyadoo 19 kulliyadood loo kordhiyay xaaladda farsamada qaranka.
Dholuo: TVETA ne onyiso dongruok mar pasent 6.9 e riwruok mag tiegruok mar tiego ji e weche mag teknoloji (TVET) nyaka 2,756, ka 19 mag kolej osedonjo e rang'iny mar polytechnic e piny mangima.

English: TSC reminds schools in Kisumu County to strengthen guidance and counselling services this March.
Kiswahili: TSC inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuimarisha huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha Machi hii.
Somali: TSC waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Kisumu inay xoojiyaan adeegyada hagista iyo la-talinta bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: TSC paronwa skunde mag Kisumu County mondo omed jiwo kendo chiwo kony e dwe mar Mach.

English: EACC urges residents of Kiambu County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu wape huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay dalbadaan bixinta adeegyada aan la bixin laaluush si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Kiambu mondo okonygi ka ok gichiwo asoya mondo giked gi asoya e migepe mag sirkal.

English: FAO advises maize producers in Kiambu County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawashauri wazalishaji wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: FAO waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha hadhuudhka ee degmada Kiambu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur mag cham e County mar Kiambu mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: AIRA Infodemic Trends Report 26 June - 9 July 2025
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Mitindo ya Habari ya AIRA 26 Juni - 9 Julai 2025
Somali: Warbixinta Isbeddellada AIRA Infodemic 26 Juunyo - 9 Luulyo 2025
Dholuo: Ripot mar weche mag tuoche mag AIRA 26 dwe mar auchiel - 9 dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2025

English: Expectant mothers are expected to seek for timely care whenever they feel some headache, swelling of the body, swelling eyes and also bleeding. These are indication of serious health issues that calls for urgent medical attention
Kiswahili: Mama wajawazito wanatarajiwa kutafuta utunzaji wa wakati unaofaa wakati wowote wanapohisi maumivu ya kichwa, uvimbe wa mwili, kupasuka kwa macho na pia kutokwa na damu.
Somali: Hooyooyinka uurka leh waxaa la filayaa inay daryeel waqtigeeda u raadsadaan markasta oo ay dareemaan madax xanuun, bararka jidhka, indhaha oo bararka ku jira iyo sidoo kale dhiig baxyo.
Dholuo: Onenore ni min nyithindo madwaro nyuol onego omany kony e kinde mowinjore sa asaya ma giwinjo ka wiye lit, ka ringregi otwo, ka wenge otwo kata ka rem bende wuok.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Nyandarua County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua mwezi Juni huu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu billaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ka dhanka ah gobolka Nyandarua bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Rapar: Kenya Gazette chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Nyandarua e dwe mar Jun.

English: Promote drought-tolerant and early-maturing crop varieties to enhance resilience to climate variability.
Kiswahili: Kukuza aina za mazao zinazostahimili ukame na kukomaa mapema ili kuongeza ustahimilivu wa kutofautiana kwa hali ya hewa.
Somali: Kor u qaad noocyada dalagyada u adkeysan abaaraha iyo bislaada hore si loo xoojiyo adkeysiga isbeddelka cimilada.
Dholuo: Dhi nyime jiwo kit cham ma nyalo nano e bwo oro kendo ma nyalo dongo chon mondo omi gibed gi nyalo mar geng'o lokruok e kit yamo.

English: KRA warns public officers in Murang'a County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: KRA inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a dhidi ya matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: KRA waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Murang'a inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: KRA chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e kaunti mar Murang'a ni kik giti marach gi migawo ma gin-go.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will open a maize collection centre in Nandi County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mahindi katika Kaunti ya Nandi Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu bilaabi doonaa xarun ururinta hadhuudhka ee Gobolka Nandi bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura matayo gik makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok biro yawo kama ichokoe cham e county mar Nandi e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: IEBC conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Kajiado County this September.
Kiswahili: IEBC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Kajiado Septemba hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha gobolka Kajiado bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: IEBC timo romo mar tiego ji e wi migawo mar Ombudsman e Kajiado County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: For IFAD, this shows why digital agriculture needs to be at the very heart of its work. As the world's poorest people face spiralling food ...
Kiswahili: Kwa IFAD, hii inaonyesha kwa nini kilimo cha kidijitali kinahitaji kuwa kitovu cha kazi yake. Huku watu maskini zaidi duniani wakikabiliwa na ongezeko la chakula ...
Somali: IFAD, tani waxay muujinaysaa sababta beeraleyda dijitaalka ah ay ugu baahan tahay inay noqoto udub-dhexaadka shaqadeeda. Iyadoo dadka ugu saboolsan adduunka ay wajahayaan cunto sii kordhaysa ...
Dholuo: Kuom IFAD, mano nyiso gimomiyo tijno onego obed gi tich maduong' ahinya e wi pur mar digital.

English: State Department for TVET urges residents of Bungoma County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from free primary education.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo ji duto modak Bungoma County mondo odonj e program mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo mondo giyud tiegruok ma onge chudo.

English: State Department for Basic Education reminds schools in Bomet County to strengthen inclusion of learners with disabilities this February.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuimarisha ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu Februari hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay xusuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Bomet inay xoojiyaan ka mid noqoshada ardayda naafada ah bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education oparo ne skunde man Bomet County mondo omed tiego jopuonjre ma nigi midekre e dwe mar Februar.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties warns public officers in Murang'a County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a dhidi ya kupotosha fedha za umma.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Murang'a in ay ka faa'iideystaan dhaqaale dawladeed.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Murang'a ni kik giti gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo e yo marach.

English: OGP urges residents of Migori County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on community-based development programmes.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Migori wajihusishe na msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili waendelee kuwa na habari juu ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Migori inay la xiriiraan maamulayaasha degmooyinkooda si ay uga warqabaan barnaamijyada horumarinta ee ku saleysan bulshada.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogweng' Migori County mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jotelo mag utegi mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mag dongruok e kind oganda.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises horticultural produce producers in Nandi County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inashauri wazalishaji wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha wax soo saarka beeraha ee degmada Nandi inay wax soo saarkooda ku iibiyaan kaliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) nyiso jopur ma loso puothe e county mar Nandi ni gius puothegi mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo puothego kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: ODPP reminds voters in Taita-Taveta County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre ahead of the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC kabla ya kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha gobolka Taita-Taveta inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow ka hor jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: ODPP parone jogweng'o e Taita-Taveta County mondo olim kama ichanoe IEBC machiegni kodgi kapok kinde mag yiero ochopo.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association confirms a measles outbreak alert for Isiolo County. Residents are advised to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari Kenya chathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa surua katika Kaunti ya Isiolo. Wakazi wanashauriwa kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xaqiijiyay digniin ku saabsan cudurka cirbadda ee Gobolka Isiolo. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Medical Association osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuwono e kaunti mar Isiolo.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Vihiga County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Vihiga inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kalfadhiga tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products jiwo jopur e County mar Vihiga mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e tiego jopur mabiro.

English: Baringo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Baringo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2023
Somali: Degmada Baringo: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Baringo: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2023

English: EACC reminds residents of Trans Nzoia County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: EACC parone jogweng'o mag Trans Nzoia County ni luwo dongruok mar tich kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Over the last 24 hours we have tested over 300 Kenyans, out of those 22 have tested positive for covid-19 (13-males, 9-females). 21 out of the 22 cases are people who are currently in quarantine
Kiswahili: Katika saa 24 zilizopita tumewapima Wakenya zaidi ya 300, kati ya hao 22 wamepimwa na kukutwa na virusi vya covid-19 (wanaume 13, wanawake 9). Visa 21 kati ya 22 ni watu ambao kwa sasa wako karantini.
Somali: 24kii saac ee la soo dhaafay waxaan tijaabinay in ka badan 300 oo reer Kenya ah, kuwaas oo 22 ka mid ah ay u muuqdaan kuwo COVID-19 ah (13 lab, 9 dumar ah). 21 ka mida 22 kiis ayaa ah dadka hadda ku jira karantiil
Dholuo: Kuom seche 24 mosekalo, wasetimo nonro kuom Jo-Kenya mokalo 300, kuom jogo 22 osenwang'o ni gin gi tuo mar COVID-19 (13- chwo, 9- mon).

English: NDMA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Kajiado County to report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: NDMA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kajiado County kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya jinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Kajiado inuu kiisaska u soo wargeliyo xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e Kajiado County mondo ochiw ripot e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Kenya Food Security Outlook February - September 2024
Kiswahili: Mtazamo wa Usalama wa Chakula nchini Kenya Februari - Septemba 2024
Somali: Aragtida Sugnaanta Cuntada Kenya Febraayo - Sebtembar 2024
Dholuo: Neno mar Kenya mar Rieko mar Chiemo dwe mar ariyo - dwe mar apar 2024

English: For low birth weight babies, Kangaroo Mother Care _x0097_ skin-to-skin contact _x0097_ is recommended to regulate body temperature, improve breastfeeding, and boost survival.
Kiswahili: Kwa watoto wachanga wenye uzito wa chini wa kuzaliwa, utunzaji wa mama wa Kangaroo - kuwasiliana ngozi kwa ngozi - unapendekezwa ili kudhibiti joto la mwili, kuboresha kunyonyesha, na kuongeza uhai.
Somali: Carruurta miisaanka yar ee dhalata, Kangaroo Mother Care _x0097_ taabashada maqaarka-ilaa-maqaarka _x0097_ ayaa lagu talinayaa si loo xakameeyo heerkulka jidhka, loo hagaajiyo naasnuujinta, loona kordhiyo badbaadada.
Dholuo: Kuom nyithindo ma nigi pek matin e nyuol, ipuonjo ni ng’ato otim tudruok gi ng’ato mondo orit ng’ich mar ringre, ober ng’ado ng’ut nyathi, kendo omed ng’ado ngima.

English: Teachers Service Commission conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Kilifi County this November.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Novemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu qabtaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada ee degmada Kilifi bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda e dwe mar Novemba e kaunti mar Kilifi.

English: HELB advises applicants in Murang'a County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: HELB inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: HELB waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Murang'a inay dalbadaan booska TVET ee KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Murang'a mondo oketgi e tiegruok mar TVET kokalo kuom KUCCPS.

English: KEMSA encourages mothers in Kajiado County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kajiado inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo mine manie Kajiado County mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges residents of Kiambu County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan mashaariicda horumarinta degmada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kiambu mondo onon dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi chenrogo mag dongruok.

English: Be cautious of agents offering NHIF registration at matatu stages. Report such individuals to the nearest police post. NHIF registration is free.
Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu na mawakala wanaotoa usajili wa NHIF katika hatua za matatu. Waripoti watu kama hao kwenye kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu. Usajili wa NHIF ni bure.
Somali: Ka digtoonow wakiillada bixiya diiwaangelinta NHIF marxaladaha matatu. U sheeg shakhsiyaadkaas saldhigga booliiska ee ugu dhow. Diiwaangelinta NHIF waa bilaash.
Dholuo: Bed gi ritruok kuom jotelo ma chiwo nying’ mar NHIF e step mag matatu. Ripot jogo ma kamago e ofis mar polisi man machiegni. NHIF ndiko nying’ en mana ma nono.

English: Ministry of Health urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Mombasa County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Mombasa inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pachgi e County mar Mombasa mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Kakamega County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega inay haystaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' Kakamega County mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi maber sama gidwaro thieth mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health confirms a typhoid outbreak alert for Tana River County. Residents are advised to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa typhoid kwa Kaunti ya Tana River. Wakazi wanashauriwa kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ka soo baxaya cudurka 'typhoid' ee degmada Tana River. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagu taliyey.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuwo mar typhoid e taon mar Tana River County.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds farmers in Kericho County of the ongoing modern irrigation techniques training programme.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa xusuusinaya beeraleyda degmada Kericho barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jopur e gweng' mar Kericho chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime e wi yore mag lero pi.

English: Store dry, clean grain only in clean bags - never recycled fertilizer, pesticide, or other chemical bags - and keep it in a cool, dry, ventilated place.
Kiswahili: Weka nafaka safi na iliyokauka kwenye magunia safi tu - usitumie magunia yaliyotumika kubeba mbolea, dawa za wadudu, au kemikali nyingine - na uhifadhi mahali penye ubaridi, ukavu, na hewa ya kutosha.
Somali: Ku kaydi hadhuudhka qalalan oo nadiif ah oo kaliya bacaha nadiifka ah - waligaa ha dib u warshadayn bacriminta, cayayaanka, ama bacaha kiimikada kale - kuna hay meel qabow, qalalan oo hawo leh.
Dholuo: Ket cham ma ok ler e bag maler kende - ok onego ilos gi yien, yedhe mamero kod kembe mamoko - kendo ketgi kama ng'ich, ma ok ler kendo ma onge muya.

English: KMTC urges youth in Uasin Gishu County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Uasin Gishu inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada rayidka ah ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada rayidnimada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KMTC ojiwo rowere e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok gichako timo tije mag oganda.

English: Public notice: KEMSA will host a free safe water storage outreach in Nakuru County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMSA itakuwa mwenyeji wa uhamasishaji wa bure wa kuhifadhi maji salama katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: KEMSA waxay marti gelineysaa adeeg lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee degmada Nakuru bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMSA biro timo kampen mar choko pi maonge chudo e taon mar Nakuru e dwe mar Julai.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges farmers in Wajir County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Wajir inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee beeraha cimilada ee caqli-galka ah si ay ula qabsadaan isbedelka qaabka roobabka.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur e County mar Wajir mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi pur mar piny mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges tea growers in Samburu County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Samburu kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Waxsoosaarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda shaaha ee Gobolka Samburu inay qaataan noocyo abuurka ah oo u adkaysta abaarta si loo wanaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products jiwo jopur ma pidho chai e county mar Samburu mondo okaw kit kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo omed nyak e higani.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to utilize extension services to enhance agricultural transformation
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wamehimizwa kutumia huduma za ugani ili kuboresha mageuzi ya kilimo
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay adeegsadaan adeegyada ballaarinta si loo xoojiyo isbeddelka beeraha
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur koda jogo motudore gi ohala mag agro mondo oti gi tije mag medo dongruok e yore mag loso puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag puothe mag agro

English: IPOA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Samburu County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba upatikanaji wa maelekezo ya makazi salama unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay Gobolka Samburu in helitaanka tixraacyada magangelyo ammaan ah la heli karo lacag la'aan.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e county mar Samburu ni ng'ato nyalo yudo kuonde modakie maonge chudo.

English: KEMRI reminds the public that free stress management support is available through county health facilities in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa kudhibiti mafadhaiko unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero lacag la'aan ah oo la xiriirta maaraynta stress-ka laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Lamu County.
Dholuo: KEMRI paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar stress yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e County mar Lamu.

English: NDMA reminds the public in Uasin Gishu County to remain vigilant on counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: NDMA waxay dadweynaha degmada Uasin Gishu ku xasuusineysaa inay ka feejignaadaan ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: NDMA parone ji duto e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo omed bedo motang' e weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: The governor of Kisumu, Nyongo has issued a directive to close all eateries after failing to obey guidelines from the MoH in Covic control
Kiswahili: Gavana wa Kisumu, Nyongo ametoa agizo la kufunga mikahawa yote baada ya kukosa kutii miongozo kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya katika udhibiti wa Covid
Somali: Guddoomiyaha gobolka Kisumu ee magaalada Nyongo ayaa soo saaray tilmaam uu ku xiray dhammaan makhaayadaha cuntada kadib markii uu ku guuldareystay inuu u hoggaansamo tilmaamaha Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ee xakamaynta COVID
Dholuo: Jatelo mar Kisumu, Nyongo osegolo chik mar tieko kuonde chiemo duto nikech ok oluwo chike mag Ministry of Health e weche mag Covid.

English: State Department for TVET encourages out-of-school children in Kirinyaga County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya ugawaji wa bursary.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta dugsiga ka baxsan ee degmada Kirinyaga inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga ugu dambeeya ee la siinayo deeqaha waxbarasho.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State for TVET jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e County mar Kirinyaga mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: NTSA reminds the public in Murang'a County to remain vigilant on community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NTSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Murang'a inay ka feejignaadaan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: NTSA parone ji duto e County mar Murang'a ni gibed motang' gi chenro mag chiwo siem motelo ne oganda.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) advises farmers in Garissa County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuleta nambari yao ya usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Garissa inay keenaan lambarka diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qayb galaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e county mar Garissa mondo okel namba mar pimo jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: We shall not tire in reminding you, to strictly adhere to the containment measures, of washing our hands with soap and running water, maintaining social and physical distance, wearing face masks in public places at all times and avoiding all forms of gatherings. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Hatutachoka kukukumbusha, kuzingatia madhubuti hatua za kuzuia, kuosha mikono yetu kwa sabuni na maji yanayotiririka, kudumisha umbali wa kijamii na kimwili, kuvaa vinyago vya uso katika maeneo ya umma kila wakati na kuepuka aina zote za mikusanyiko. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Kama daali doonno inaan idin xasuusino, inaad si adag u raacdaan tallaabooyinka xakamaynta, inaan gacmahayaga ku dhaqno saabuun iyo biyo socda, inaan ilaalino kala fogaanshaha bulshada iyo jirka, inaan xirno maaskaro wejiga goobaha dadweynaha mar walba iyo inaan ka fogaano dhammaan noocyada isu imaatinka. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Ok wabi ol e paroni, mondo uluw matek okenge mag geng'o tuoche, mag lwoko lwetewa gi sabun kod pi ma ng'ich, rito thuolo e kindwa gi jowetewa, rwako mask mag wang' kuonde ma ji mang'eny romoe kinde duto kendo weyo chokruok moro amora. #KomeshaKorona

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Kwale County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati huu wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah inta lagu jiro xilliyada dabka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji parone jogweng' mar Kwale County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji moa kuonde ma ji odakie e kinde mag yiengni.

English: NPS warns residents of Kwale County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: NPS inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale juu ya kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: NPS waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale kororka nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban.
Dholuo: NPS chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kwale County e wi medruok mar chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service encourages farmers in Narok County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for maize.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya mahindi.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda Gobolka Narok inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay hadhuudhka.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur e Narok County mondo odonj e riwruok mar riwruok ma nigi ratiro mar loso kodhi mondo giyud nengo maber mar kodhi.

English: Public notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will host a free food safety outreach in Siaya County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usalama wa chakula bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Siaya Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay marti-gelin doontaa dadaal bilaash ah oo ku saabsan badbaadada cuntada ee degmada Siaya bisha May.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Rango Kendo Luwo Tuoche biro timo chenro mar chiwo kony maonge chudo mar chiemo e taon mar Siaya e dwe mar Mei.

English: FAO reminds livestock keepers in Tana River County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Tana River inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha ka guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyada oo aan la helin rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: FAO parone jopur mag jamni e taon mar Tana River County mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni kuonde mopogore opogore maok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: Kenya Forest Service warns residents of Nakuru County to prepare for possible road accidents this April.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Aprili hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ka digay dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inay u diyaar garoobaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service osiemo jogweng' Nakuru County mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar April.

English: Judiciary of Kenya encourages first-time voters in Nakuru County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya ayaa ku dhiirigelinaya codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Nakuru inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo josiasa ma ne okwongo yiero e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo oting'e ID kata pasi mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero.

English: Teachers Service Commission conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Kericho County this August.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Kericho Agosti hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu qabanqaabiyaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha gobolka Kericho bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission otimo chokruok mar tiego ji e wi migawo mar Ombudsman e County mar Kericho e dwe mar Agost.

English: NDMA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Machakos County to seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NDMA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Machakos kutafuta msaada katika nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka degmada Machakos inuu taageero ka raadsado gurigii ugu dhow ee badbaadada.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo sand e gweng' mar Machakos mondo omany kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Malaria can be prevented by use of mosquito nets, spraying of households with insecticide, screening windows to prevent mosquito entry, preventive medicine for pregnant women where applicable & environmental measures. #WorldMalariaDayKe #ZeroMalariaStartsWithMe #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Malaria inaweza kuzuilika kwa kutumia vyandarua, kunyunyizia kaya dawa za kuua wadudu, kuchuja madirisha ili kuzuia mbu wasiingie, dawa za kinga kwa wajawazito pale inapobidi na hatua za kimazingira. #SikuYaMalaria Duniani #ZeroMalariaInaanzaNami #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Duumada waxaa looga hortagi karaa isticmaalka maro kaneecada, buufinta guryaha cayayaanka dila, daaqadaha lagu baaro si looga hortago soo gelitaanka kaneecada, daawada ka hortagga ah ee haweenka uurka leh meesha ay khuseyso iyo tallaabooyinka deegaanka. #Maalinta Duumada Adduunka #ZeroDuumadaInay I Bilaabato #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Malaria inyalo geng’ kuom tiyo kod mtoka mag ng’ado ng’injo, ng’ado e udi gi yath ma nego ng’injo, ng’ado dirisa mondo kik ng’injo odonj, thieth mar geng’o mon ma nigi ich kama nyalore & yore mag rito alwora. #Odiechieng'MalandiaMa #MaleriaOchakoKoda #KomeshaCorona

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds the public in Narok County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this May.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Narok kwamba maoni juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka yanakaribishwa Mei hii.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa xasuusinaya dadweynaha gobolka Narok in talooyinka dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha May.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties paronwa ji duto manie Narok County ni ji duto nyalo chiwo paro e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e dwe mar Mei.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges residents of Tana River County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Tana River kudai usambazaji wa huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Tana River ku boorinayaa inay dalbadaan bixinta adeegyada aan la bixin laaluush si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General jiwo ji duto modak e taon mar Tana River County mondo okonygi ka ok gichiwo asoya mondo giked gi timbe mag mibadhi.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds the public in Embu County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Embu kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Guddiga Garsoorka Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu dadka degmada Embu ku xasuusinayaa in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone ji duto e county mar Embu ni chiwo ripot mar asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public in Meru County about the importance of food safety for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Meru juu ya umuhimu wa usalama wa chakula kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay dadka degmada Meru ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda badbaadada cuntada ay u leedahay caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji duto e County mar Meru kuom gimomiyo rito chiemo en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Notice: TSC opens a new motor vehicle mechanics programme at the vocational centre in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC inafungua programu mpya ya ufundi wa magari katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan farsamada gawaarida gawaari ee xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Meru.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: TSC chako chenro manyien mar tiyo gi masin mag mtokni e skul mar tich e county mar Meru.

English: KEPHIS advises farmers in Marsabit County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains ahead of the October planting season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Oktoba.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Marsabit inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e county mar Marsabit mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: In Europe has started to vaccinate against respiratory diseases in livestock.
Kiswahili: Katika Ulaya imeanza chanjo dhidi ya magonjwa ya kupumua katika mifugo.
Somali: Yurub ayaa bilaabay in lagu tallaalo cudurrada neefsashada ee xoolaha.
Dholuo: E pinje mag Ulaya, oseng'ado mar kano ji osuru mondo kik hinygi nikech tuoche mag muya.

English: KTDA encourages farmers in Homa Bay County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for tea.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya chai.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Homa Bay inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan shaaha.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e Homa Bay County mondo ous olembe mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo chai mondo giyud nengo maber mar chai.

English: EACC reminds residents of Embu County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: EACC paronwa jogweng' Embu County ni luwo dongruok mar tich kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the public in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of identity theft.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadweynaha degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aanay wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee lagu xaday aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo ong'e kwayo mag jogo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche mag kwalo kitgi.

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Tana River County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa usaidizi wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow si ay uga caawiyaan helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ee lacageed.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health nyiso jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni mondo giyud kony mar yudo kony kuom weche thieth.

English: KUCCPS encourages out-of-school children in Lamu County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Lamu kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa watu wazima chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Lamu inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee barnaamijyada quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e County mar Lamu mondo odonj e program mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo e bwo program mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: However, cereal production from these areas accounts for only a small share of the national output.
Kiswahili: Hata hivyo, uzalishaji wa nafaka kutoka maeneo haya unachangia sehemu ndogo tu ya pato la taifa.
Somali: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, wax soo saarka dalagga ee ka yimaada meelahan ayaa ah qayb yar oo ka mid ah wax soo saarka qaranka.
Dholuo: Kata kamano, cham ma iloso e kuondego kelo mana kwan matindo mar cham ma pinyno yudo.

English: SHA urges residents of Mombasa County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia laini ya bure ya EACC ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Mombasa inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee EACC si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo jogweng' Mombasa County mondo oland weche mag mibadhi kokalo kuom simo mar EACC maonge chudo mondo giked gi asoya e migepe mag sirkal.

English: NPS urges residents of Meru County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: NPS inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi imeongezeka.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: NPS ojiwo jogweng' mar Meru County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya e kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Homa Bay County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee gobolka Homa Bay inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo ji duto ma chandore nikech tuoche mag pachgi e Homa Bay County mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: US implements bovine viral diarrhea vaccination to protect dairy cattle.
Kiswahili: Marekani inatekeleza chanjo ya kuhara kwa virusi vya ng'ombe ili kulinda ng'ombe wa maziwa.
Somali: Mareykanka wuxuu hirgeliyaa tallaalka ciridka fayraska lo'da si loo ilaaliyo lo'da caanaha.
Dholuo: Amerka tiyo gi thieth mar tuo mar dhoho mar dhok mondo orit dhok ma nigi dhok ma imadho chak.

English: ODPP urges residents of Embu County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuwasilisha maandishi ya maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga lagu soo gabagabeeyay si loo qaabeeyo goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo jogweng' Embu County mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso chenro mag dongruok.

English: Public notice: CDC will host a free safe water storage outreach in Garissa County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: CDC itakuwa mwenyeji wa ufikiaji wa bure wa uhifadhi wa maji salama katika Kaunti ya Garissa Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: CDC waxay marti gelineysaa adeeg lacag la'aan ah oo lagu kaydiyo biyo ammaan ah Gobolka Garissa bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuoche (CDC) biro timo kampen mar choko pi maonge chudo e taon mar Garissa e dwe mar Agost.

English: NTSA alerts residents of Mandera County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka kwa kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: NTSA waxay dadka deggan degmada Mandera uga digtay kororka kiisaska jabsashada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka warbixiyaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' kaunti mar Mandera ni kwan mag joma odonjo e ot biro medore kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot e stesen mar polise man machiegni.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will open an avocado collection centre in Kisii County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itafungua kituo cha kukusanya parachichi katika Kaunti ya Kisii Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu furi doonaa xarun soo ururinta avocado ee degmada Kisii bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Dairy Board biro yawo ot mar choko avocado e County mar Kisii e dwe mar April.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) encourages first-time voters in Laikipia County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa codbixiyayaasha ugu horreeya ee degmada Laikipia inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogo matimoga yiero mokwongo e county mar Laikipia mondo oting'e ID kata pasi mar piny mangima e odiechieng'no mar timo yiero.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will open a coffee collection centre in Bungoma County this February.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itafungua kituo cha kukusanya kahawa katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Maamulka Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) wuxuu furayaa xarun soo ururinta kafeega ee degmada Bungoma bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro yawo kama ichokoe chai e County mar Bungoma e dwe mar Februar.

English: DCI urges the community in Homa Bay County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: DCI inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka kwa kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada gobolka Homa Bay inay ka warbixiyaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo shaki leh xarunta booliska ee ugu dhow si looga hortago xannibaadda xoolaha.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo ji duto manie Homa Bay County mondo ochiw ripot e stesen mar polise man machiegni mondo gikwed kwalo jamni.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Mandera County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kunawa mikono na sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Waaxda Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera inay gacmaha ku maydhaan saabuun iyo biyo nadiif ah si joogto ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche jiwo jogweng' mar Mandera County mondo olwok lwetegi gi sabun kod pi maler kinde ka kinde mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Free Google Workspace for all Kenyan teachers Ã¢Â€Â“ claim your account today!
Kiswahili: Sehemu ya Kazi ya Google ya Bure kwa walimu wote wa Kenya Ã¢Â€Â“ dai akaunti yako leo!
Somali: Google Workspace bilaash ah dhammaan macallimiinta Kenya - maanta codso akoonkaaga!
Dholuo: Google kar tich ma nono ne jopuonj duto mag Kenya Ã¢Â€Â“ ng’ad akaunt mari sani!

English: HELB advises students in Migori County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: HELB inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Migori kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Somali: HELB waxay ardayda Degmada Migori kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan buugaag iyo qalab waxbarasho.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jopuonjre mag Migori County mondo oketgi e intanet mondo giyud buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok.

English: Notice: NTSA issues a cybersecurity alert on phishing messages affecting residents of Uasin Gishu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya ujumbe wa udanganyifu unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan fariimaha phishing ee saameeya dadka deggan gobolka Uasin Gishu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NTSA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity e wi ote mag phishing makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e county mar Uasin Gishu.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Narok County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kutumia portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Narok inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago xadgudubka xilka.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo oti gi websaitno mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo kwayo mar kedo gi timbe mag tiyo marach gi migepe.

English: Notice: AFA will distribute certified tea seed to farmers in Nandi County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: AFA itasambaza mbegu za chai zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi mwezi Mei huu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay abuurka shaaha ee shahaadada leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda gobolka Nandi bisha May ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: AFA biro pogo kodhi mag chai ne jopur man Nandi County e dwe mar Mei.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) encourages farmers in Kisii County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day to secure better prices for avocado.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima ili kupata bei bora ya parachichi.
Somali: Maamulka Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda degmada Kisii inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeralayda ee soo socota si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay avocado.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e county mar Kisii mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur mabiro mondo giyud nengo maber mar avocado.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) updates residents of Trans Nzoia County on progress of community-based development programmes this February.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia juu ya maendeleo ya mipango ya maendeleo katika jumuiya Februari hii.
Somali: Guddiga Garsoorka Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia ka warbixiyaa horumarka barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chiwo ripot ne jogweng' mar Trans Nzoia County kuom dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag oganda e dwe mar Februar.

English: This fathers' day, it is good to ensure mental health for them because their mental health is important. Take more of your time for your mental health and seeking for help when you need it.
Kiswahili: Siku hii ya akina baba, ni vizuri kuwahakikishia afya ya akili kwa sababu afya yao ya akili ni muhimu. Tumia muda wako zaidi kwa ajili ya afya yako ya akili na kutafuta msaada unapouhitaji.
Somali: Maalinta aabbayaasha, waa wax wanaagsan in la hubiyo caafimaadka maskaxda ee caruurta maxaa yeelay caafimaadkooda maskaxda ayaa muhiim ah. Waqti badan u qaad caafimaadkaaga maskaxda iyo caawimaad raadinta marka aad u baahan tahay.
Dholuo: E odiechieng'ni mar wuone, ber mondo ikonygi bedo gi paro mowinjore nikech paro ma gin-go en gima duong'.

English: Farmers are advised to invest in their own baling machines or collaborate with others to avoid delays and high costs in hay production
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa kuwekeza kwenye mashine zao za kusaga au kushirikiana na wengine ili kuepuka ucheleweshaji na gharama kubwa katika uzalishaji wa nyasi.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagula talinayaa inay maalgeliyaan mashiinnadooda baalasha ama ay la shaqeeyaan dadka kale si looga fogaado dib u dhac iyo kharashyo sare oo soo saarista cawska
Dholuo: Ijiwo jopur mondo oti gi masinegi giwegi mag goyo pewe kata oti kanyachiel gi jomamoko mondo kik gimi puodho odok chien kendo kik gikel nengo mang'eny

English: Notice: Universities Fund opens a new welding and fabrication programme at the vocational centre in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unafungua mpango mpya wa kulehemu na utengenezaji katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ka furayaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan alxanka iyo soo saarista xarunta xirfadaha ee Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Yunivasiti Fund ochako chenro manyien mar loso kendo loso gik moko e skul mar tiegruok e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds farmers in Marsabit County of the ongoing greenhouse farming training programme.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kilimo cha chafu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa beeraleyda degmada Marsabit barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service oparo ne jopur e county mar Marsabit chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar timo pur.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises milk producers in Bungoma County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inashauri wazalishaji wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay kula talineysaa soosaarayaasha caanaha ee degmada Bungoma inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development nyiso jopur mag chak e county mar Bungoma mondo odonj e riwruok ma nigi ratiro mar loso dhok kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Siaya County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa kumbukumbu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Siaya Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay qabaneysaa aqoon isweydaarsi diiwaangelinta beeraleyda loogu talagalay beeralayda degmada Siaya bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro timo rapar mar jopur e dwe mar Jun.

English: Self-care is important - it directly affects your overall well-being, including physical, mental, and emotional health. Prioritizing self-care helps you manage stress, avoid burnout, and maintain a balanced life. Engaging in exercise, good sleep, healthy eating, and mindfulness boosts resilience and promotes a positive outlook
Kiswahili: Kujitunza ni muhimu - kunaathiri moja kwa moja ustawi wako kwa ujumla, ikiwa ni pamoja na afya ya kimwili, kiakili, na kihisia. Kuweka kipaumbele katika kujitunza kunakusaidia kudhibiti msongo wa mawazo, kuepuka uchovu, na kudumisha maisha yenye usawa. Kufanya mazoezi, kulala vizuri, kula vizuri, na kuzingatia huongeza ustahimilivu na kukuza mtazamo chanya.
Somali: Daryeelka naftaadu waa mid muhiim ah - wuxuu si toos ah u saameynayaa caafimaadkaaga guud, oo ay ku jiraan caafimaadka jirka, maskaxda iyo shucuurta. Daryeelinta naftaadu waxay kaa caawineysaa inaad maamusho walbahaarka, ka fogaato daalka, oo aad noolaato nolol isku dheelitiran.
Dholuo: Ritruok en gima duong' ahinya nikech okonyo ng'ato mondo kik obed gi parruok mang'eny, moriwo nyaka bedo gi ngima maber e dende, e pache, koda e paro. Keto weche motudore gi ritruok obed motelo nyalo konyi loyo parruok, geng'o riyo mar ngima, kendo bedo gi paro mowinjore.

English: COMESA advises farmers in Makueni County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the April planting season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo kabla ya msimu wa upandaji Aprili.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Makueni inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagyada si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda ka hor xilliga beerashada bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Makueni mondo otim lokruok e puothe mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber ka pok ochopo dwe mar April.

English: Kilifi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kilifi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Kilifi: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kilifi: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Septemba 2022

English: Embu (Mbeere) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Embu (Mbeere): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2022
Somali: Degmada Embu (Mbeere): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Embu (Mbeere): Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Julaini 2022

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds the public in Kitui County that input on development planning forums is welcome this June.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba mchango kwenye vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo unakaribishwa Juni hii.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa shacabka degmada Kitui in talooyinka ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General paronwa ji duto e County mar Kitui ni gibiro yie gi weche ma ji wacho e wi chenro mag dongruok e dwe mar Jun.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds mobile money users in Bomet County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid identity theft.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobile-ka ee degmada Bomet inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado tuugada aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji paroga joma tiyo gi pesa mag simo e county mar Bomet ni mondo ging'e kwayo mag pesa kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo kik jokuoge okwel nyingegi.

English: Treasury gamifies budget learning for young audiences.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Hazina hukazia elimu ya bajeti kwa watazamaji vijana.
Somali: Wasaaradda Maaliyadda waxay barashada miisaaniyadda u dhigtaa mid cajiib ah dhagaystayaasha dhalinyarada ah.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar pesa konyo rowere mondo ong'e kaka ginyalo tiyo gi bajet.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges sweet potatoes growers in Bungoma County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawahimiza wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kutumia viwango vya mbolea vilivyopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda baradho macaan ee degmada Bungoma inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobka si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo jopur ma pidho kitungu e County mar Bungoma mondo oti gi ratiro mar chamo kitungu kapok koth ochue mondo okony e medo nyak mar koth e higani.

English: Boma manure should be composted for at least 63 days before use, since the longer period also allows weed seeds to be eliminated.
Kiswahili: samadi ya Bola yapasa kutiwa mbolea kwa angalau siku 63 kabla ya kutumiwa, kwa kuwa kipindi kirefu zaidi pia huruhusu mbegu zilizosagwa ziondolewe.
Somali: Boma manure waa in la compost-gareeyaa ugu yaraan 63 maalmood ka hor isticmaalka, maadaama muddada dheer ay sidoo kale u oggolaaneyso in la tirtiro abuurka weed-ka.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma ne nigi ich-go ne onego okaw mach kuom ndalo 63 kapok gitiyo kode, nikech kinde malachgo bende ne miyo ich-go kodhi mag ogolo.

English: Notice from SHA (Social Health Authority): family planning counselling clinics will run every September at designated health centres in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii): kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Septemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada): rugaha la talinta qorshaynta qoyska waxaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Sebtember ee xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Bomet.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar SHA (Social Health Authority): klinik mag chiwo paro e wi chenro mar ngima joot biro tiyo e dwe mar ochiko higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e county mar Bomet.

English: Teachers Service Commission encourages out-of-school children in Tharaka-Nithi County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under free primary education.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo odonj e program mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo e bwo tiegruok ma onge chudo.

English: Notice: NCPB restricts movement of sheep in Kitui County due to a rabies outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB inazuia harakati za kondoo katika Kaunti ya Kitui kutokana na mlipuko wa kichaa cha mbwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa idaha Gobolka Kitui sababo la xiriira cudurka qabyaalada.
Dholuo: Rapar: NCPB ogeng'o wuoth mar rombe e County Kitui nikech tuwo mar rabies.

English: TVET urges parents and teachers in Garissa County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: TVET inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: TVET waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Garissa inay u sheegaan maamulka iskuulka wixii arrimo ah ee ku saabsan amniga.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e gweng' mar Garissa mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar skul e wi weche duto motudore gi ritruok.

English: Notice: OGP opens a new service point for national ID applications in Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay ka fureysaa barta adeegga cusub ee codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Marsabit.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: OGP oseyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag kwayo nying' mar ng'ato e gweng' mar Marsabit.

English: Plan to collect and release reports on foods
Kiswahili: Mpango wa kukusanya na kuchapisha ripoti kuhusu vyakula
Somali: Qorshaha ururinta iyo soo saarista warbixinnada ku saabsan cuntooyinka
Dholuo: Chenro mar choko kendo golo ripot e wi chiemo

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Bomet County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Bomet Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa degmada Bomet bishii Ogosto.
Dholuo: Rieko: Huduma Kenya chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Bomet e dwe mar Agost.

English: State Department for Basic Education encourages out-of-school children in Tharaka-Nithi County to register their children at the nearest public school under free primary education.
