Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Dowladda waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan iskuulka guud ee ugu dhow ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education ojiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni gi skul mar sirkal e bwo tiegruok ma onge chudo.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development opens a new motor vehicle mechanics programme at the vocational centre in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yafungua programu mpya ya ufundi wa magari katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ka furayaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan farsamada gawaarida mootada ee xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ochako chenro manyien mar tiyo gi masinde mag riembo mtokni e skul mar tiegruok e taon mar Bungoma County.

English: NPS reminds mobile money users in Samburu County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee Gobolka Samburu inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: NPS parone jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e county mar Samburu mondo onyis ni gikwayo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo kik giyud weche mag phishing.

English: Data & Digital Transformation Strategy 2024 - 2028
Kiswahili: Mkakati wa Kubadilisha Data na Dijitali 2024 - 2028
Somali: Istaraatiijiyadda Isbeddelka Xogta & Dijitaalka ah 2024 - 2028
Dholuo: Yore mag loko data kod mbui 2024 - 2028

English: Kwale County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for December 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kwale: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Desemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Kwale: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta Diseembar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kwale: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2022

English: Know the facts about #COVID19 and help stop the spread of rumors: Exposing yourself to the sun or to temperatures higher than 25C degrees DOES NOT prevent the coronavirus disease. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Jua ukweli kuhusu #COVID19 na usaidie kukomesha kuenea kwa uvumi: Kujianika kwenye jua au kwenye halijoto ya juu zaidi ya nyuzi joto 25 C HAKUZUII ugonjwa wa coronavirus. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Ogow xaqiiqooyinka ku saabsan #COVID19 oo ka caawi joojinta faafinta wararka xanta ah: Naftaada u bandhig qorraxda ama heerkulka ka sarreeya 25C MA hortagayso cudurka coronavirus. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Ng'e adier ewi #COVID19 kendo ikony geng'o lando weche ma ji wacho ni: Keto ng'ato e chieng' kata e liet ma malo digri 25C OK geng'o tuo mar korona. #KomeshaKorona

English: HELB reminds youth in Kajiado County that HELB funding is available for electrical installation training.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada ku nool gobolka Kajiado in maalgelinta HELD ay diyaar u tahay tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa rowere man Kajiado County ni pesa ma giyudo kuom HELP yudore e tiegruok mar keto gik moko e kor lwasi.

English: Kenya Dairy Board informs fish farmers in Isiolo County of new market linkage opportunities this February.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawafahamisha wafugaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Isiolo kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Februari hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku wargalinayaa kalluumeysatada ku nool gobolka Isiolo fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur ma pidho rech e kaunti mar Isiolo kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Februar.

English: DPP reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kiambu County that access to psychosocial support is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisaikolojia unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee degmada Kiambu in helitaanka taageerada cilmu-nafsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e County mar Kiambu ni thuolo mar yudo kony kuom weche mag pach ji yudore maonge chudo.

English: CDC reminds the public in Marsabit County about the importance of hypertension awareness for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Marsabit juu ya umuhimu wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: CDC waxay dadweynaha degmada Marsabit ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay u leedahay ogaanshaha cadaadiska sare ee caafimaadka qoyska.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuoche (CDC) paronwa ji duto e gweng' mar Marsabit gimomiyo bedo gi ng'eyo mar ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar hypertension en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Local authorities such as county governments can impose quarantines to ensure tomatoes from affected areas are not transported to areas not affected by the pest.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka za mitaa kama vile serikali za kaunti zinaweza kuweka karantini ili kuhakikisha nyanya kutoka maeneo yaliyoathiriwa hazisafirishwi hadi maeneo ambayo hayajaathiriwa na wadudu.
Somali: Hay'adaha deegaanka sida dowladaha degmooyinka ayaa soo rogi kara karantiil si loo hubiyo in yaanyada ka yimaada meelaha ay saameysay aan loo qaadin meelaha aan cayayaanka saameyn.
Dholuo: Sirkande mag alwora kaka sirkande mag distrikt nyalo keto karantin mondo omi kik ter pomade e alwora ma chandoe.

English: OGP encourages first-time voters in Kajiado County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: OGP inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kajiado County kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC.
Somali: OGP waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Kajiado inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogo madwaro yiero mokwongo e Kajiado County mondo olim kama ichanoe IEBC machiegni kodgi.

English: Notice: KMTC announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KMTC ogolo chenro mar dhi e skunde mag Baringo County e tiegruok mar pinyruoth maonge chudo.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties reminds residents of Garissa County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Garissa in ka qaybgalka maamulaha qaybta deegaanka ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties parone jogweng' mar Garissa County ni tudruok gi jarit mar ward margi jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) advises residents of Laikipia County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay yareeyaan qaadashada cusbada iyo sonkorta si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Laikipia mondo omed kawo makate kod sukari matin mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges dairy cows farmers in Lamu County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Lamu inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha lagu burburiyo ee loo qoondeeyay ka dib kiisaska cudurka Anthrax ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products jiwo jopur mag dhok e County mar Lamu mondo ogeng'gi e kuonde moketi mag chamo dhok bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag anthrax.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds mobile money users in Kajiado County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kajiado County kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka ujumbe wa phishing.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kajiado inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service parone jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e Kajiado County ni mondo ging'e kwayo margi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo gitang' gi weche mag phishing.

English: FAO announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Kirinyaga County this November.
Kiswahili: FAO inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa mguu na mdomo kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Novemba hii.
Somali: FAO waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee lo'da caanaha ah ee Gobolka Kirinyaga bisha November.
Dholuo: FAO olando chenro mar thiedho dhok makwayo pi e dwe mar Novemba e gweng' mar Kirinyaga.

English: KEPHIS urges dairy cows farmers in Mandera County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported foot and mouth disease cases.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Mandera inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur ma pidho dhok e gweng' mar Mandera mondo oland ne jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth man machiegni gi kanyo bang' ka osenyis ni nitie tuoche mag dhoot.

English: Special needs learners get free assistive devices Ã¢Â€Â“ collect from county office!
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wenye mahitaji maalum wanapata vifaa vya usaidizi bila malipo ambavyo Ã¢Â€Â“ hukusanywa kutoka ofisi ya kaunti!
Somali: Ardayda baahiyaha gaarka ah baranaysa waxay helaan qalab caawimo oo bilaash ah - waxay ka soo ururiyaan xafiiska degmada!
Dholuo: Jopuonjre ma nigi dwaro makende yudo gige kony ma nono Ã¢Â€Â“ ma gichoko e ofis mar kaunti!

English: Keeping newborns in skin-to-skin contact with mothers helps regulate temperature, heartbeat, and supports immune development.
Kiswahili: Kuwaweka watoto wachanga katika mgusano wa ngozi na mama husaidia kudhibiti halijoto, mapigo ya moyo, na kusaidia ukuaji wa kinga mwilini.
Somali: Marka ilmaha cusub la xiriiro hooyooyinka maqaarka ilaa maqaarka waxay ka caawisaa xakamaynta heerkulka, garaaca wadnaha, waxayna taageertaa horumarinta difaaca jirka.
Dholuo: Bedo machiegni gi min nyathi ma eka oa nyuol konyo e chiko liet mar dende, goyo mar chuny, kendo miyo ng'ato bedo gi teko mar geng'o tuoche.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development urges residents of Nyandarua County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima ili kufaidika na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: Machadka Horumarinta Manhajka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay iska diiwaangeliyaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan fasallada aqoonta dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo odonj e program mar somo kod somo mar jomoti mondo giyud konyruok kuom tiegruok mar somo gi somo.

English: KRA announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: KRA inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kurejea kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Wilaya ya Tana River.
Somali: KRA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Tana River.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova (KRA) lando ni kinde mag timo kwayo mar ng'eyo nying ng'ato osemedore e taon mar Tana River County.

English: TVET urges residents of Wajir County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kutuma maombi ya bursari hiyo kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kufaidika na mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: TVET waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho kahor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo ji duto modak e gweng' mar Wajir mondo okonygi yudo michno kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo chiemb chuny e skul.

English: Notice: NPS opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay furaysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya daryeel caafimaad ka dib rabshadaha degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NPS ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony mar thieth bang' timbe mahundu e county mar Siaya.

English: @WHOKenya Country Representative Dr. Rudolf Eggers today paid a courtesy call on the Cabinet Secretary for Health Hon. Mutahi Kagwe at Afya House.
Kiswahili: @WHOKenya Mwakilishi wa Nchi Dkt Rudolf Eggers leo amemtembelea Katibu wa Baraza la Mawaziri wa Afya Mhe. Mutahi Kagwe akiwa Afya House.
Somali: Wakiilka @WHOKenya Dr. Rudolf Eggers ayaa maanta booqasho sharafeed ugu tagay Xoghayaha Golaha Caafimaadka Mudane Mutahi Kagwe oo ku sugan Afya House.
Dholuo: <2Zepa> Jatend pinyno Dr. Mutahi Kagwe e ot mar Afya.

English: IEBC reminds youth in Kajiado County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dhallinyarada degmada Kajiado in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka farsamada gawaarida.
Dholuo: IEBC oparo ne rowere man Kajiado County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar masinde mag mtokni.

English: Ministry of Education announces distribution of textbooks and learning materials to schools in Nandi County this September.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inatangaza usambazaji wa vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nandi Septemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhawaaqday qaybinta buugaagta iyo qalabka wax lagu barto dugsiyada gobolka Nandi bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok e skunde man Nandi County e dwe mar ochiko.

English: FAO warns beans farmers in Samburu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: FAO inawaonya wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuhusu maambukizi ya wadudu na kupendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: FAO waxay uga digtay beeraleyda xayawaanka ku nool Gobolka Samburu in ay jiraan cudurro cayayaanka ah waxayna ku talineysaa in si sax ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: FAO chiwo siem ne jopur puothe e gweng ' mar Samburu kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni otim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges the community in Nandi County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb fraud.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia udanganyifu.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Nandi inay ka warbixiyaan waxqabadka shakiga ah xarunta booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo khiyaamooyinka.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ji duto manie county mar Nandi mondo ochiw ripot e stesen mar polise man machiegni mondo gikwed timbe mag wuondruok.

English: CDC encourages residents of Kericho County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay u dhiiri galiyaan saaxiibka dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo jogweng' Kericho County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo gijiw osiepgi moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: FAO Desert Locust campaign: East Africa upsurge suppressed, Kenya free from Desert Locust
Kiswahili: Kampeni ya FAO ya Nzige Jangwa: Mashambulizi ya Afrika Mashariki yakandamizwa, Kenya bila ya Nzige wa Jangwa
Somali: Ololaha Ayaxa Lamadegaanka ee FAO: Kor u kaca Bariga Afrika oo la caburiyay, Kenyana ay ka xorowday Ayaxa Lamadegaanka
Dholuo: Kampein mar FAO mar ng’ado winyo e gwenge mag gwenge: Ochung’ motegno e Afrika ma Wuokchieng’, piny Kenya onge gi winyo e gwenge mag gwenge

English: Notice: KALRO restricts movement of pigs in Kilifi County due to an anthrax outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO inazuia harakati za nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kutokana na mlipuko wa kimeta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa doofaarka Gobolka Kilifi sababo la xiriira cudurka anthrax.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KALRO ogeng'o wuoth mar le e County mar Kilifi nikech tuwo mar anthrax.

English: Notice: Council of Governors launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Kilifi County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa billaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ka dhanka ah degmada Kilifi bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Jaloch chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e gweng' mar Kilifi e dwe mar Jun.

English: FGM is a traumatic experience that leaves a lasting psychological mark & may adversely affect the mental health of the victims
Kiswahili: Ukeketaji ni tukio la kiwewe ambalo huacha alama ya kisaikolojia ya kudumu na linaweza kuathiri vibaya afya ya akili ya waathiriwa.
Somali: FGM waa waayo aragnimo dhaawac ah oo ka tagaysa calaamado maskaxeed oo waarta & waxay saameyn xun ku yeelan kartaa caafimaadka maskaxda ee dhibbanaha
Dholuo: FGM en gima kelo hinyruok mang'eny ma miyo ng'ato bedo gi paro maok kare kendo manyalo ketho ngima mar pach jo mosetho

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public in Kilifi County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kilifi in helitaanka taageerada sheegashada NHIF / SHA ay hadda ka heli karto xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji duto e County mar Kilifi ni kony mar kwayo kwayo mag NHIF/SHA sani yudore e kuonde ma oket.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Migori County to remain vigilant on border security.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Migori kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Migori in ay ka feejignaadaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji duto e County mar Migori ni gibed motang' e weche mag rito tong'gi.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges eligible citizens in Tana River County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Wilaya ya Tana River kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Tana River inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo raia mag Tana River County mondo oriwre gi jogo madwaro yiero.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges beans growers in Nyandarua County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Udhibiti wa Pest Products inawasihi wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa za kukabiliana na ukame ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda gobolka Nyandarua inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta si kor loogu qaado waxsoosaarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Pest Control Products Board jiwo jopur ma pidho keyo e County mar Nyandarua mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro mondo okony e medo nyak mar yien e higani.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya issues a cybersecurity alert on fake investment schemes affecting residents of Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia inayoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah ee saameeya dadka deggan gobolka Mombasa.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji (Communications Authority of Kenya) ogolo siem e wi weche mag sirkande mag intanet e wi chenro mag gwelo pesa mag miriambo makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e county mar Mombasa.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds residents of Taita-Taveta County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya wilaya inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Taita-Taveta in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone jogweng' Taita-Taveta County ni luwo dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free typhoid screening is available at all public health centres in Trans Nzoia County this March.

English: HELB reminds parents in Narok County that free day secondary education registration is open this January.

Dholuo: HELB paronwa jonyuol man Narok County ni somo mar sekondari mar odiechieng' maonge chudo chako Januar.

English: Kenya Red Cross advises residents of Bungoma County to confirm their facility is accredited before visiting to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kuthibitisha kuwa kituo chao kimeidhinishwa kabla ya kutembelea ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.

Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross nyiso jogweng'o mag Bungoma County ni mondo ging'e ni kuondegi mag thieth oseyudo ratiro kapok gibiro mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Notice: FAO will open a coffee collection centre in Kakamega County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya kahawa katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay ka furi doontaa xarun ururinta kafeega ee Gobolka Kakamega bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: FAO biro yawo kambi mar choko chai e taon mar Kakamega e dwe mar Agost.

English: KUCCPS urges youth in Migori County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Migori kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Migori inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda ka hor inta aysan qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo rowere e County mar Migori mondo onon weche ma gin-go mar ndiko ji kapok gitimo tije mag sirkal.

English: NDMA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in West Pokot County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kwamba upatikanaji wa maelekezo ya makazi salama unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada West Pokot in helitaanka tixraacyada magangelyo ammaan ah ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag nindruok e West Pokot County ni thuolo mar yudo kuonde mag dak ma onge tuoche yudore maonge chudo.

English: Nationwide campaign to deliver Vitaminâ€¯A to children under 5 and coordinate with routine immunization services.
Kiswahili: Kampeni ya kitaifa ya kutoa vitamini A kwa watoto chini ya miaka 5 na kuhariri na huduma za kawaida za chanjo.

English: IEBC reminds residents of Machakos County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Machakos in ay ku hawlan yihiin maamulaha qaybta maxalliga ah si ay u xoojiyaan maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: IEBC parone jogweng'o mag County ma Machakos ni ka gitiyo gi jarit mar alwora margi, mano biro miyo sirkal omed bedo gi loch maber.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Nairobi County that access to free legal aid is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisheria wa bure unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee ka dhacay degmada Nairobi in la heli karo caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah oo lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e taon mar Nairobi ni ginyalo yudo kony ma onge chudo.

English: Seeds are essential commodities unrestricted movement across borders is critical to prevent food insecurity Stakeholders must advocate for this change immediately
Kiswahili: Mbegu ni bidhaa muhimu kuvuka mipaka bila vikwazo ni muhimu ili kuzuia uhaba wa chakula Wadau lazima watetee mabadiliko haya mara moja.
Somali: Abuurka waa alaab muhiim ah dhaqdhaqaaqa aan xadidneyn ee xuduudaha ka gudbaya waa mid muhiim u ah ka hortagga amaanka cuntada Dhinacyada daneeyayaasha ah waa inay si deg deg ah u doodaan isbeddelkaas
Dholuo: Kodhi gin gik mochuno ahinya. Dhi kuonde mopogore opogore maok ochuno dwarore ahinya mondo kik yud chiemo.

English: HELB reminds youth in Nairobi County that HELB funding is available for tailoring and design training.
Kiswahili: HELB inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni.
Somali: HELB waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada ku nool degmada Nairobi in maalgelinta ay heli karto tababarka qaabeynta iyo naqshadeynta.
Dholuo: HELB paronwa rowere manie County mar Nairobi ni pesa ma giyudo kuom HELP yudore e tiegruok mar loso piche kendo loso gik moko.

English: KTDA reminds livestock keepers in Kisumu County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KTDA waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xayawaanka ah ee degmada Kisumu inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KTDA oparo ne jokwang'o jamni e County mar Kisumu ni mondo gimi jamnigi thieth e kuonde moyier mag chwoyo jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: TSC advises applicants in Nandi County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: TSC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Nandi kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: TSC waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Nandi inay dalbadaan booska TVET ee KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Nandi mondo oketgi e tiegruok mar TVET kokalo kuom KUCCPS.

English: The successes of immunization, facilitated by this assistance, have led to tremendous improvement in child survival rates in our country, keeping the promise of a prosperous, and healthy future of our Nation. #KomeshaCorona update.
Kiswahili: Mafanikio ya chanjo, yaliyowezeshwa na msaada huu, yamesababisha uboreshaji mkubwa wa viwango vya maisha ya watoto katika nchi yetu, na kutimiza ahadi ya mustakabali mzuri na wenye afya wa Taifa letu. #KomeshaCorona sasisho.

Dholuo: Gik ma osetimore maber e geng’o tuoche, ma osekonye gi konyni, osekelo dongruok maduong’ ahinya e kwan mar nyithindo ma pod ngima e pinywa, ka oketo singruok mar bedo gi ngima maber, kendo ma nigi ngima maber e kinde mabiro mar Pinyruoth marwa. #KomeshaKorona ma manyien.

English: The Kenya Dairy Industry Regulations 2021 are now law establishing a minimum farm gate price of Kshs 33 per kilogram of milk delivered Farmers are urged to familiarize themselves with the regulations
Kiswahili: Kanuni za Sekta ya Maziwa ya Kenya 2021 sasa ni sheria zinazoweka bei ya chini ya lango la shamba la Kshs 33 kwa kila kilo ya maziwa yanayowasilishwa Wakulima wanahimizwa kufahamu kanuni hizo.
Somali: Xeerarka Warshadaha Caanaha Kenya 2021 hadda waa sharci dejiya qiimaha ugu yar ee beerta ee Kshs 33 kiilo oo caano ah oo la keeno. Beeraleyda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay la kulmaan xeerarka
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Industry Regulations 2021 sani en chik maketo nengo mar dhoot mar pur mar Kshs 33 kuom kilo mar chak ma ne ochiw ne jopur.

English: Baringo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for May 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Baringo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Mei 2024

English: Communications Authority of Kenya calls on the community in Taita-Taveta County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaalika jumuiya katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwa ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Taita-Taveta inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto manie Taita-Taveta County mondo owuo e wi timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo onyis ji weche ma kamago e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response launches a June awareness campaign on hand hygiene across Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Juni juu ya usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Juun oo ku saabsan nadaafadda gacmaha ee degmada Kericho.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Jun e wi ler mar lwedo e County duto mar Kericho.

English: Ministry of Education encourages out-of-school children in Siaya County to register their children at the nearest public school under free primary education.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Siaya kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Siaya inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan iskuulka guud ee ugu dhow ee waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e county mar Siaya mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni gi skul maduong' mar piny mangima e bwo tiegruok ma onge chudo.

English: SHA invites residents of Meru County to attend the public participation forum regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: SHA inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Shirkadda SHA waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay ka qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: SHA gwelo ji duto modak e county mar Meru mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

Kiswahili: Kufuatilia Athari za Mishtuko kwa Kaya nchini Kenya

English: IEBC urges eligible citizens in Kitui County to participate in the electoral calendar.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi raia wanaostahiki katika Kaunti ya Kitui kushiriki katika kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kitui inay ka qaybqaataan jadwalka doorashada.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo ji duto manie County Kitui mondo oriw lwedo chenro mar yiero.

English: KEMSA appeals to caregivers in Kisii County to visit their nearest maternity wing as part of the December maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kisii kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Desemba.
Somali: KEMSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Kisii inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka ee Diseembar.
Dholuo: KEMSA okwayo jorit e County mar Kisii mondo odhi olimgi machiegni gi kama giyudoe nyithindo e dwe mar Desemba.

English: All the cases are stable. They are in isolation to prevent infections. #KomeshaCorona update.
Kiswahili: Kesi zote ziko thabiti. Wanajitenga ili kuzuia maambukizo. #KomeshaCorona sasisho.

Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itafanya warsha ya kushughulikia baada ya mavuno kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi ka dib goosashada beeraleyda degmada Tana River bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Dairy Board biro timo chokruok mar loso gik moko bang' keyo ne jopur e taon mar Tana River County e dwe mar Januar.

English: Kenya Dairy Board warns coffee farmers in Kitui County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuhusu mlipuko wa wadudu na kupendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Kitui cudurrada cayayaanka waxaana uu ku talinayaa in si ku habboon wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho kong'o e County Kitui kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Judiciary of Kenya warns public officers in Mombasa County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Mombasa dhidi ya kutumia vibaya mamlaka yao.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee gobolka Mombasa inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Mombasa ni kik giti marach gi migawo ma gin-go.

English: HELB urges residents of West Pokot County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from free primary education.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: HELB waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo ji duto modak e West Pokot County mondo okonygi kapok kindeno ochopo mondo giyud tiegruok ma onge chudo.

Kiswahili: Wakimbizi Waliosajiliwa Kenya na Wanaotafuta Hifadhi | Novemba 2025

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages mothers in Nakuru County to attend the scheduled clinic day to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhudhuria siku iliyopangwa ya kliniki ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Nakuru inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta caafimaad ee la qorsheeyay si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo mine manie gweng' mar Nakuru mondo odhi e odiechieng'no mar thieth mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: KTDA advises fish producers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inashauri wazalishaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KTDA waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kalluunka ee gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KTDA nyiso jopur ma loso rech e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni mondo giti gi nengo mar piny moseketo kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Judiciary of Kenya encourages first-time voters in Homa Bay County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya ayaa ku dhiirigelinaya codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee gobolka Homa Bay inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo josiasa ma ne okwongo yiero e Homa Bay County mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng'no mar yiero.

English: DCI urges residents of Kisii County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to national peace-building.
Kiswahili: DCI inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa umakini mkubwa wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nabadgelyada qaranka.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo jogweng' mar Kisii County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano ka ji medo keto pachgi kuom loso kuwe.

English: FAO urges dairy cows farmers in Machakos County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported foot and mouth disease cases.
Kiswahili: FAO inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo vilivyoripotiwa.

Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur mag dhok ma loso dhok e gweng' mar Machakos mondo ogeng'e legi e kuonde moketi mag chamo dhok bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag dhoot kod dhoot.

English: Notice: KMTC launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC yazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay bilowday barnaamij tallaabooyin looga hortago dhibaatada dugsiyada gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe mahundu e skunde duto e Kaunti mar Kakamega.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Nyamira County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba upatikanaji wa maelekezo ya makazi salama unapatikana bila malipo.

Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Nyamira ni ginyalo yudo kuonde ma ginyalo dakie maonge chudo.

English: State Department for TVET announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in Laikipia County this March.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika shule katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Machi hii.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhawaaqday qaybinta deeqaha waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan dugsiyada degmada Laikipia bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET ogolo chiwo mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre man gi chandruok e skunde man Laikipia County e dwe mar Mach.

English: Huduma Kenya invites residents of Narok County to attend the public participation forum regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Narok inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya gwelo jogweng' Narok County mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi nonro mar tich mitimo higa ka higa.

English: DPP urges the community in West Pokot County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb fraud.
Kiswahili: DPP anahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia udanganyifu.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada gobolka West Pokot inay ka warbixiyaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo shaki leh xarunta booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo khiyaamooyinka.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo ji duto manie West Pokot County mondo onyis polis ma ni machiegni gi kanyo ni gitimo gik ma chwanyo ji.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya warns residents of Mandera County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera juu ya kuongezeka kwa mipango ya uwekezaji bandia na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera kororka qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah waxayna ku talineysaa shacabka inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Communications Authority chiwo siem ne jogweng' Mandera County e wi medruok mar chenro mag chulo pesa mag miriambo kendo ojiwo ji mondo ong'e kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: National Counter Terrorism Centre rolled out a community based strategy to deter extremism and urged awareness of technology related risks.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Kupambana na Ugaidi kilitangaza mkakati wa jamii wa kuzuia ugaidi na kuhamasisha ufahamu wa hatari zinazohusiana na teknolojia.
Somali: Xarunta Qaranka ee la dagaalanka Argagixisada ayaa soo saartay istaraatijiyad ku saleysan bulshada si looga hortago xagjirnimada waxayna ku boorisay in la ogaado khataraha la xiriira tikniyoolajiyadda.
Dholuo: National Counter Terrorism Centre ne oloso chenro mar oganda mar geng'o timbe mahundu kendo ne ojiwo ji mondo ong'e rach ma nyalo betie nikech teknoloji.

English: Localisation of protection programming in Garissa & Turkana, Kenya (December 2023)
Kiswahili: Ujanibishaji wa programu za ulinzi huko Garissa & Turkana, Kenya (Desemba 2023)

English: KMTC urges residents of Mandera County to register their children at the nearest public school to benefit from free primary education.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu ili kufaidika na elimu ya msingi bila malipo.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KMTC jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Mandera mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok ma onge chudo.

English: Embu (Mbeere) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Embu (Mbeere): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Aprili 2024

English: FAO advises farmers in Taita-Taveta County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: FAO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.

English: Samburu County, Kenya -In Lolmolong village, in Samburu County in northern Kenya, Neshoo Leaungokiok laboured through the night, far from the nearest health facility.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Samburu, Kenya -Katika kijiji cha Lolmolong, katika Kaunti ya Samburu kaskazini mwa Kenya, Neshoo Leaungokiok alifanya kazi usiku kucha, mbali na kituo cha afya cha karibu.
Somali: Degmada Samburu, Kenya - Tuulada Lolmolong, oo ku taal Degmada Samburu ee waqooyiga Kenya, Neshoo Leaungokiok waxay shaqaynaysay habeenkii oo dhan, meel ka fog xarunta caafimaadka ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Kawuono mar Samburu, Kenya -E gweng' mar Lolmolong mantie e gweng' mar Samburu mantie nyandwat mar piny Kenya, Neshoo Leaungokiok nene otiyo matek ei otieno, mabor gi kar thieth mane ni machiegni ahinya.

English: Kenya Dairy Board warns sweet potatoes farmers in Nyamira County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda baradho macaan ee degmada Nyamira cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna kugula talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho olemo mag sweet potato e County ma Nyamira kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: KMTC March 2026 intake: Apply online before December 20.
Kiswahili: KMTC Machi 2026 kuingia: Kuomba mtandaoni kabla ya Desemba 20.

English: Notice: KTDA will open a horticultural produce collection centre in Makueni County this June.

Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA biro yawo ot mar choko puothe mag puothe e gweng' mar Makueni e dwe mar Jun.

English: In Kenya, surveillance and vaccination activities continue to reach children in nomadic, peri-urban and cross-border communities, with the latest vaccination round against polio having protected nearly 1 million children.
Kiswahili: Nchini Kenya, shughuli za ufuatiliaji na chanjo zinaendelea kuwafikia watoto katika jamii zinazohamahama, pembezoni mwa miji na mipakani, huku awamu ya hivi punde ya chanjo dhidi ya polio ikiwa imewalinda karibu watoto milioni 1.
Somali: Dalka Kenya, hawlaha la socodka iyo tallaalka ayaa sii wada inay gaaraan carruurta ku nool miyiga, magaalooyinka ku xeeran iyo bulshooyinka xuduudaha ka gudba, iyadoo tallaalkii ugu dambeeyay ee ka dhanka ahaa cudurka dabaysha uu badbaadiyay ku dhawaad ​​1 milyan oo carruur ah.
Dholuo: E piny Kenya, tije mag rang’iny kod chiwo chanjo dhi nyime chopo ne nyithindo ma odak e gwenge ma wuotho ​​wuotho, ma ni e alwora mag boma kod ma oko mar tong’, kendo ng’wech ma manyien mar chiwo chanjo mar polio oserito nyithindo madirom milion achiel.

English: NPS urges residents of Samburu County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: NPS inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: NPS waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Samburu inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: NPS ojiwo ji duto modak e county mar Samburu mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gweng'no e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi ahinya e kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Pest Control Products Board warns beans farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawaonya wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda ka shaqeeya degmada Tharaka-Nithi oo ku saabsan cudurrada cayayaanada wuxuuna kugula talinayaa in la tallaalo waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products chiwo siem ne jopur mag nyinyo e Tharaka-Nithi County kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim gik moko e kinde mowinjore.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the community in Mombasa County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb burglary.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia wizi.

Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuhusu haki zao kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman.

Kiswahili: NTSA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.

Kiswahili: NDMA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama katikati ya umakini mkubwa wa kujenga amani ya kitaifa.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Nyandarua inay u soo sheegaan howlaha aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaala aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo dhismaha nabadda qaranka.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar sirkal e wi gik ma ne timore e alwora mar tong'gi nikech ji osebedo ka keto pachgi ahinya kuom loso kuwe e piny.

English: KEMRI urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Taita-Taveta County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e gweng' mar Taita-Taveta mondo oluong kony mar thieth mar paro maonge chudo.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties urges residents of Baringo County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on the county integrated development plan.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Msajili wa Vyama vya Siasa inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya mpango wa maendeleo ya pamoja wa kaunti.

Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties jiwo jogweng' Baringo County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mar dongruok e county.

Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inatangaza usambazaji wa vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Julai hii.

Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itasambaza mbegu za maharagwe zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni Oktoba hii.

Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro pogo kodhi mag nyinyo ne jopur e gweng' mar Makueni e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: NDMA activates an emergency response plan for landslides in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.

Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NDMA tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne yiengni mag lowo e gweng' mar Kisumu.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit encourages residents of Laikipia County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.

English: Notice: ODPP opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Wananchi katika Kaunti ya Makueni.

English: DPP warns residents of Isiolo County about a rise in fake investment schemes and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.

English: EACC reminds the public in Makueni County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha umma katika Makueni County kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: EACC waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Makueni in sheegashada khiyaamooyinka iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: EACC parone ji duto e gweng' mar Makueni ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag yuto en gima onge nengo, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.
