English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service issues a cybersecurity alert on phishing messages affecting residents of Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya ujumbe wa udanganyifu unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu soo saaray digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan fariimaha phishing ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Forest Service ogolo siem mar sirkal mar cybersecurity e wi ote mag phishing makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e County mar Kisii.

English: AIRA Infodemic Trends Report 3-10 October 2023 (Weekly brief #92)
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Mitindo ya Habari ya AIRA 3-10 Oktoba 2023 (Muhtasari wa kila wiki #92)
Somali: Warbixinta Isbeddellada AIRA Infodemic 3-10 Oktoobar 2023 (Soo koobid toddobaadle ah #92)
Dholuo: Ripot mar weche mag tuwo mag AIRA tarik 3-10 dwe mar apar higa mar 2023 (machuok juma ka juma #92)

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises avocado producers in Kirinyaga County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inashauri wazalishaji wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa soo saarayaasha avocado ee Gobolka Kirinyaga inay ka iibsadaan wax soo saarka kaliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur mag avocado e County mar Kirinyaga ni gius olembegi mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo olembe kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of Kajiado County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya waxayna ku dhiirigelinayaan saaxiibka dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng' Kajiado County mondo kik gisandre aling' ling' kendo mondo gijiw osiepgi moro ma chandore omany kony.

English: Pest Control Products Board informs tea farmers in Laikipia County of new market linkage opportunities this May.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawafahamisha wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Laikipia juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Mei hii.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa ku wargeliyay beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Laikipia fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok mar Pest nyiso jopur mag chai e County mar Laikipia e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: OGP opens a new service point for national ID applications in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay fureysaa barta adeegga cusub ee codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: OGP oyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag kwayo nying' mar ng'ato e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: KEPHIS advises avocado producers in Bungoma County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawashauri wazalishaji wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walio na leseni kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha avocado ee degmada Bungoma inay ka iibsadaan wax soo saarka kaliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KEPHIS nyiso jopur mag avocado e County mar Bungoma ni gius olembegi mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo olembego kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Pest Control Products Board announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for goats in Samburu County this February.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Samburu Februari hii.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa ku dhawaaqaya jimicsi tallaal oo bilaash ah oo cudurka Newcastle ah oo loogu talagalay riyaha Gobolka Samburu bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok mar Pest Owacho ni ibiro tim kampen mar golo tuoche mag Newcastle maonge chudo ne diek e county mar Samburu e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: KTDA will open a tea collection centre in Nyeri County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itafungua kituo cha kukusanya chai katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay xarun soo ururinta shaaha ka furi doontaa degmada Nyeri bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA biro yawo ot mar choko chai e County mar Nyeri e dwe mar Septemba.

English: NCTC facilitated training in Kakamega to help security personnel counter youth radicalization and emerging extremist tactics.
Kiswahili: NCTC iliwezesha mafunzo huko Kakamega kusaidia maafisa wa usalama kupambana na ukatili wa vijana na mbinu zinazoibuka za kimabavu.
Somali: NCTC waxay tababar ku fududeysay Kakamega si ay uga caawiso shaqaalaha amniga inay la dagaallamaan xagjirnimada dhalinyarada iyo istiraatiijiyadda xagjirka ah ee soo baxda.
Dholuo: NCTC ne otiyo gi tiegruok e Kakamega mondo okony jorit sirkal kedo gi timbe mahundu mag rowere.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens polling procedures centres in Nyeri County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu furayaa xarumaha nidaamyada codbixinta ee degmada Nyeri bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya osechako tiyo gi chenro mar timo yiero e County mar Nyeri e dwe mar Februar.

English: DPP calls on the community in West Pokot County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: DPP inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: DPP waxay bulshada ku nool degmada West Pokot ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska ugu dhow ee jinsiga ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: DPP okwayo ji duto manie West Pokot County mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu motudore gi dichwo gi dhako, kendo ginyis ji weche ma kamago e ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Notice: KRA opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Narok County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Wananchi katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay furaysaa goob adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee Gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: KRA oseyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag e-Citizen registration e Narok County.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Red Cross will be held in Kisumu County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya bure ya matibabu iliyoandaliwa na Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Kisumu bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma Kenya Red Cross ochano biro timore Kisumu County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadweynaha in taageerada soo kabashada xadgudubka maandooriyaha ee bilaashka ah ay ka heli karto xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Mombasa County.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tiyo gi yedhe mamero yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Mombasa.

English: NCPB urges cattle farmers in Nyamira County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawataka wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kuripotiwa.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da ee degmada Nyamira inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo ka dib kiisaska cudurka Newcastle ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur mag jamni e Kaunti mar Nyamira mondo ogeng'gi e kuonde moketi mag chamo jamni bang' yudo weche mag tuo mar Newcastle.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds livestock keepers in Kajiado County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa za kuponda ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa xasuusinaya xoolaha ee degmada Kajiado inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jopur mag jamni e Kajiado County ni mondo gimi jamni thieth e kuonde moketi mag chwoyo jamni mondo girit ngima rombe.

English: Notice: KEMSA will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Kwale County this September. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA itafanya kongamano la kurejesha matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Kwale Septemba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMSA waxay qabaneysaa madasha dib u soo kabashada isticmaalka maandooriyaha ee Gobolka Kwale bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMSA biro timo chokruok mar chango joma tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero e taon mar Kwale e dwe mar Septemba.

English: KICD reminds needy students in Marsabit County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Marsabit in deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay codsiyada ardayda baahan ay dhowaan dhammaadaan.
Dholuo: KICD paronwa jopuonjre man gi chandruok e Marsabit County ni tuke mag somo ne jopuonjre ma nigi chandruok biro rumo machiegni.

English: Universities Fund urges parents and teachers in Mombasa County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku boorinayaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Mombasa inay u sheegaan maamulka dugsiga wixii arrimo ah ee ku saabsan amniga.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Mombasa mondo onyis jotelo mag skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok.

English: Notice: KICD opens a new ICT skills programme at the vocational centre in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD inafungua programu mpya ya ujuzi wa ICT katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay ka furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan xirfadaha ICT ee xarunta xirfadda ee degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KICD chako chenro manyien mar lony e yore mag ICT e kar tiegruok mar tich e county mar Siaya.

English: EACC urges residents of Bomet County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jogweng'o mag Bomet County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county mar chiwo paro e wi tich ma gitimo higa ka higa.

English: SHA updates residents of Isiolo County on progress of the county integrated development plan this January.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawasilisha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Isiolo juu ya maendeleo ya mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya mwezi Januari huu.
Somali: SHA waxay dadka deggan degmada Isiolo ku wargelineysaa horumarka qorshaha horumarinta isku dhafan ee degmada bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: SHA chiwo ripot ne jogweng' Isiolo County kuom dongruok mar chenro mar dongruok mar county e dwe mar Januar.

English: KALRO reminds livestock keepers in Embu County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Embu kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali cha kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: KALRO waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Embu inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha ka gudbaan xadka degmada iyagoo aan haysan rukhsad si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: KALRO parone jorit jamni e county mar Embu ni kik giting' jamni ka ok giyudo rusa mar rito ngima jamni.

English: Repeated ear infections can cause hearing loss. Visit a health worker promptly.
Kiswahili: Maambukizi ya sikio yanayorudiwa yanaweza kusababisha upotevu wa kusikia. Mtembelee mfanyakazi wa afya haraka.
Somali: Dhibaatooyinka dhegaha ee soo noqnoqda waxay keeni karaan maqla la'aan.
Dholuo: Bedo gi tuoche mang'eny e it nyalo miyo ng'ato olal winjo wach.

English: Do you know that kenya Red Cross Society has free advisory services by calling 24/7? Call us through 1199 we are there because of you. Koru january-June 2019, our medical team on mental health and psychosocial baakeirwe chisimi 513
Kiswahili: Je, unajua kwamba Kenya Red Cross Society ina huduma za ushauri bila malipo kwa kupiga simu saa 24/7? Tupigie simu kupitia 1199 tuko hapo kwa sababu yako. Koru januari-Juni 2019, timu yetu ya matibabu kuhusu afya ya akili na kisaikolojia baakeirwe chisimi 513
Somali: Miyaad ogtahay in Kenya Red Cross Society ay leedahay adeegyo la-talin oo bilaash ah adoo wacaya 24/7? na soo wac 1199 waxaan halkaa u joognaa sababtoo ah Koru Janaayo-Juun 2019, kooxdeena caafimaad ee caafimaadka dhimirka iyo cilmu-nafsiga baakeirwe chisimi 513
Dholuo: Be ing'eyo ni Kenya Red Cross Society nigi kony ma onge chudo kuom goyo simu 24/7? luongwa e 1199 wan kanyo nikech in. Koru Januar-June 2019, timwa mar thieth e weche thieth mar pach kod paro mar ji baakeirwe chisimi 513

English: HELB urges youth in Narok County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Narok kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: HELB waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Narok inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo rowere man Narok County mondo onon weche ma gin-go mag ndiko joma oyier kapok gitimo gik ma biro timore ne oganda.

English: Universities Fund calls on the community in Nairobi County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ugu baaqayaa bulshada degmada Nairobi inay u soo wargeliyaan maamulka iskuulka wixii arrimo ah oo ku saabsan amniga si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund okwayo oganda man Nairobi County mondo onyis sirkal mar skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skunde.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds residents of West Pokot County that soil conservation improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kwamba uhifadhi wa udongo unaboresha uzalishaji wa shamba la muda mrefu.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot in ilaalinta ciidda ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development parone jogweng' mar West Pokot County ni rito lowo miyo puodho bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: KALRO reminds farmers in Tharaka-Nithi County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Somali: KALRO waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Tharaka-Nithi barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada.
Dholuo: KALRO parone jopur manie Tharaka-Nithi County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche.

English: KEPHIS reminds farmers in Makueni County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni juu ya programu inayoendelea ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa mafunzo ya wakulima.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Makueni in barnaamijka tababarka beeralayda uu socdo.
Dholuo: KEPHIS paronwa jopur manie county mar Makueni ni chenro mar tiego jopur dhi nyime.

English: AFA advises farmers in Mombasa County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: AFA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: AFA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Mombasa inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qaybqaataan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e county mar Mombasa mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Kericho County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lugta lagu maro inta lagu jiro xilliyada dabka.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service parone jogweng' mar Kericho County mondo oluw tong' mar piyo kendo oti gi kuonde ma ng'ato nyalo wuothoe e kind yiengni mag mach.

English: The new Waithera bean variety is now available for farmers offering higher yields drought tolerance and improved taste Contact KALRO for seed distribution details
Kiswahili: Aina mpya ya maharagwe ya Waithera sasa inapatikana kwa wakulima wanaotoa mavuno mengi kustahimili ukame na ladha iliyoboreshwa Wasiliana na KALRO kwa maelezo ya usambazaji wa mbegu.
Somali: Nooca cusub ee digirta Waithera hadda waa la heli karaa beeraleyda oo bixiya dalag sare, dulqaad abaareed iyo dhadhan wanaagsan. La xiriir KALRO si aad u hesho faahfaahinta qaybinta abuurka
Dholuo: Yien manyien mar Waithera koro yudore ne jopur ma chiwo nyak maber mar yweyo kod mor mar chiemo.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit announces SHA registration for residents of Bomet County starting this June.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inatangaza usajili wa SHA kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kuanzia Juni hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa ku dhawaaqday diiwaangelinta SHA ee dadka deggan degmada Bomet laga bilaabo Juunkan.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit olando SHA registration ne jo modak e county mar Bomet kochakore dwe mar Jun.

English: KTDA promotes organic farming among farmers in Bungoma County as part of the July climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: KTDA inakuza kilimo hai miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa za Julai.
Somali: KTDA waxay dhiirrigelisay beeraha dabiiciga ah ee beeraleyda degmada Bungoma iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee July.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo pur mar yien e kind jopur e County mar Bungoma kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo kinda mar kedo gi lokruok e kit yamo e dwe mar Julai.

English: KUCCPS urges parents and teachers in Tharaka-Nithi County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ugu baaqaysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e Tharaka-Nithi County mondo omany namba mar kony mar nyithindo 116.

English: Kajiado County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kajiado: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2024
Somali: Degmada Kajiado: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kajiado: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2024

English: No visits to secondary schools during third term as per circular.
Kiswahili: Hakuna ziara katika shule za sekondari wakati wa darasa la tatu kulingana na mzunguko.
Somali: Ma jiro booqasho dugsiyada dhexe muddada saddexaad sida ku cad wareegga.
Dholuo: Onge chenro mar dhi e skunde mag sekondari e kinde mar somo mar adek kaluwore gi sirkal.

English: To contain the spread of COVID-19 @MOH_Kenya is leading the drive to fumigate Gikomba & Muthurwa markets towards #KomeshaCorona campaign To prevent Covid-19 wash your hands with soap & running water for at least 20 seconds Wash your fingertips and under your nails
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti kuenea kwa COVID-19 @MOH_Kenya inaongoza harakati za kuteketeza masoko ya Gikomba na Muthurwa kuelekea kampeni ya #KomeshaCorona Kuzuia Covid-19 osha mikono yako kwa sabuni na maji yanayotiririka kwa angalau sekunde 20 Osha vidole vyako na chini ya kucha.
Somali: Si loo xakameeyo faafitaanka COVID-19 @MOH_Kenya waxay hormuud u tahay ololaha lagu buufinayo suuqyada Gikomba & Muthurwa si loogu ololeeyo #KomeshaCorona Si looga hortago Covid-19 gacmahaaga ku dhaq saabuun iyo biyo socda ugu yaraan 20 ilbiriqsi Dhaq farahaaga iyo ciddiyahaaga hoostooda.
Dholuo: Mondo ogeng' lando mar COVID-19 @MOH_Kenya otelo ne chenro mar keto muya marach e chiro mag Gikomba kod Muthurwa mondo ochop kampen mar #KomeshaCorona Mondo ogeng' Covid-19, lwok lweteni gi sabun kod pi morith kuom sekon matin mogik 20 Los lith lweti kod piny mar lakni

English: State Department for TVET reminds parents in Kiambu County that free day secondary education registration is open this October.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba usajili wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo umefunguliwa Oktoba hii.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Kiambu in diiwaangelinta dugsiga dhexe ee bilaashka ah ay furan tahay bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET oparo ne jonyuol e County mar Kiambu ni somo mar sekondari mar odiechieng' maonge chudo ochakore e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: DCI reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kirinyaga County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba upatikanaji wa maelekezo ya makazi salama unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee Gobolka Kirinyaga in helitaanka tixraacyada magangelyo ammaan ah ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: DCI oparo ne joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Kirinyaga ni ginyalo yudo kar dak maonge chudo.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross launches a burglary prevention campaign in Kisii County this November.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Kisii Novemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada degmada Kisii bishii November.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ripot Mamit mar Kenya chako kampen mar geng'o jokuoge odonj e gweng' mar Kisii e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Notice: EACC launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Uasin Gishu County this March.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: EACC inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: EACC waxay billaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa gobolka Uasin Gishu bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Rapar: EACC chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e county mar Uasin Gishu e dwe mar Mach.

English: MoH dispatches 10 Cuban experts to Kakamega, Siaya, Kisumu, Bungoma, Busia, Vihiga, Homa Bay and Migori counties in the fight against malaria with biological methods.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yatuma wataalamu 10 wa Cuba katika kaunti za Kakamega, Siaya, Kisumu, Bungoma, Busia, Vihiga, Homa Bay na Migori katika mapambano dhidi ya malaria kwa njia za kibiolojia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa 10 khabiir oo reer Cuba ah u dirtay degmooyinka Kakamega, Siaya, Kisumu, Bungoma, Busia, Vihiga, Homa Bay iyo Migori si ay ula dagaallamaan bakteeriyada iyadoo la adeegsanayo hababka noolaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health ooro josayans 10 moa e piny Cuba e gwenge mag Kakamega, Siaya, Kisumu, Bungoma, Busia, Vihiga, Homa Bay kod Migori e kedo gi malaria kotiyo gi yore mag ngima.

English: KEPHIS reminds farmers in Kericho County of the ongoing fertiliser application training programme.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya matumizi ya mbolea.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kericho barnaamijka tababarka codsiga bacriminta ee socda.
Dholuo: KEPHIS parone jopur e county mar Kericho chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar tiyo gi yien.

English: KEMRI encourages residents of Nairobi County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwahimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay ku dhiirigeliso saaxiibka dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng' Nairobi mondo kik gisandre aling' ling' kendo ojiw osiepgi moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: NDMA warns residents of Homa Bay County to prepare for possible road accidents this October.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Oktoba hii.
Somali: NDMA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay isu diyaariyaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: NDMA osiemo jogweng' Homa Bay County mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Schools can be safe havens for mental health education
Kiswahili: Shule zinaweza kuwa mahali salama pa elimu ya afya ya akili
Somali: Dugsiyada waxay noqon karaan meel ammaan ah oo lagu barto caafimaadka dhimirka
Dholuo: Skunde nyalo konyo ahinya e tiego ng'ato e weche mag thieth

English: Educate children girls on theior monthly periods, body health and body development before it happens for them.
Kiswahili: Wafundishe watoto wa kike kuhusu kipindi cha kwanza cha mwezi, afya ya mwili na maendeleo ya mwili kabla hayajatokea kwao.
Somali: Carruurta iyo gabdhaha u baro da'da ugu dambeysa, caafimaadka jirka iyo horumarka jirka ka hor inta aysan dhicin.
Dholuo: Puonj nyithindo mon e weche mag dwe, ngima mar ringregi, koda dongruok mar dendgi kapok mano otimore.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free cholera screening is available at all public health centres in Kiambu County this November.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kipindupindu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu Novemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka fayraska ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Kiambu bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji ni nonro ma onge cholera yudore e kuonde thieth duto mag ji e County mar Kiambu e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds the public in Garissa County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Garissa in sheegashada khiyaamooyinka iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya paronwa ji duto e County mar Garissa ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag ohala en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: NDMA urges the community in Marsabit County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: NDMA inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Marsabit inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha si looga hortago xannibaadda lo'da.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo oganda mar Marsabit County mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo mondo gikwed kwalo jamni.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in West Pokot County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda Gobolka West Pokot inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur e West Pokot County mondo okel namba mar pimo jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges motorists and pedestrians in Turkana County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent fire outbreaks-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Turkana kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na milipuko ya moto.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Turkana inay guryahooda rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo inay ka shaqeeyaan sidii looga hortagi lahaa dhacdooyinka la xiriira qaraxyada dabka.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jorit mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Turkana mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo giti matek mondo gikwed masiche ma nyalo bedoe nikech mach.

English: Public health advisory: SHA (Social Health Authority) warns of increased tuberculosis risk in Lamu County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya kifua kikuu katika Kaunti ya Lamu na inashauri umma kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na dawa kila usiku.
Somali: Talobixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) wuxuu ka digay khatarta sii kordheysa ee cudurka 'tuberculosis' ee Gobolka Lamu wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay isticmaalaan shabaqa cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar oganda: SHA (Social Health Authority) chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar tuberculosis e County mar Lamu kendo ojiwo ji mondo oti gi net mar kute mitiyogo e thiedho lum otieno ka otieno.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public that free stress management support is available through county health facilities in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kudhibiti mafadhaiko unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero lacag la'aan ah oo lagu maareynayo walbahaarka laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar stress yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Garissa County this July. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya itafanya kongamano la kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Garissa Julai hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay qabaneysaa madasha dib u soo kabashada isticmaalka maandooriyaha ee Gobolka Garissa bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth biro timo chokruok e dwe mar Julai e taon mar Garissa County.

English: UNAIDS welcomes new agreement between the United States and Kenya to advance progress to end AIDS and strengthen health systems
Kiswahili: UNAIDS inakaribisha makubaliano mapya kati ya Marekani na Kenya ili kuendeleza maendeleo ya kukomesha UKIMWI na kuimarisha mifumo ya afya
Somali: UNAIDS waxay soo dhaweynaysaa heshiis cusub oo dhex maray Mareykanka iyo Kenya si loo horumariyo horumarka lagu soo afjarayo AIDS-ka iyo xoojinta nidaamyada caafimaadka
Dholuo: UNAIDS rwako winjruok manyien e kind piny Amerka kod piny Kenya mar dhi nyime e tieko tuo mar AIDS kendo jiwo chenro mag thieth

English: KTDA urges pigs farmers in Trans Nzoia County to avoid moving livestock across county lines without a permit following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawataka wafugaji wa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo kuvuka mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa Newcastle vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda doofaarka ee degmada Trans Nzoia inay ka fogaadaan inay xoolaha u guuraan xuduudaha degmada iyagoo aan haysan rukhsad ka dib kiisaska cudurka Newcastle ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur puothe mag dhok e County Trans Nzoia mondo kik giwuoth gi jamni e tong county maok giyudo rusa bang' ka osenyis ni gin gi tuo mar Newcastle.

English: KMTC urges parents and teachers in Kirinyaga County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Kirinyaga inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: KMTC jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Kirinyaga mondo omany namba mar kony mar nyithindo 116.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges eligible citizens in Kitui County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Kitui kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kitui inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo raia mag Kitui County mondo oriwre gi jogo madwaro donjo e tiegruok mar yiero.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Kirinyaga County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the March planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Machi.
Somali: Guddiga Waxsoosaarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kirinyaga inay qaataan noocyo abuur oo abaar u adkaysta oo la caddeeyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kirinyaga mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochako chwoyo kodhi e dwe mar Mach.

English: Be prepared! Practice school lockdown drills for safety.
Kiswahili: Jitayarishe! Fanya mazoezi ya usalama wa shule.
Somali: Isku day tababarka xannibaadda dugsiga si nabadgelyo loo helo.
Dholuo: Timuru tiegruok e skul mondo omi ubed gi ritruok.

English: "Do not download apps from random websites. Always use Google Play Store or Apple App Store. Unverified apps may contain malware."
Kiswahili: "Usichukue programu kutoka kwenye tovuti zisizo za kawaida. Daima tumia Google Play Store au Apple App Store. Programu ambazo hazijathibitishwa zinaweza kuwa na programu hasidi".
Somali: "Ha ka soo dejisan barnaamijyada bogagga internetka. Had iyo jeer isticmaal Google Play Store ama Apple App Store. Barnaamijyo aan la xaqiijin waxaa laga yaabaa inay ka kooban yihiin malware".
Dholuo: "Kik igol apps e websait mag ji. Ti gi Google Play Store kata Apple App Store kinde duto.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Nyeri County that reporting carjacking promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba kuripoti utekaji nyara mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri in si deg deg ah u soo sheegaan baabuurta la xaday ay gacan ka geystaan ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NTSA oparo ne jogweng' Nyeri County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo mtokni konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: HELB urges parents and teachers in Kisii County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: HELB inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: HELB waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Kisii inay u soo sheegaan maamulka iskuulka wixii arrimo ah oo ku saabsan amniga.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e gweng' mar Kisii mondo onyis sirkal mar skul wach moro amora motudore gi ritruok.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free youth mental wellness support is available through county health facilities in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa ustawi wa akili wa vijana unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: KEMSA oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo ne rowere e weche thieth mar chuny yudore maonge chudo kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Siaya.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges eligible citizens in Mombasa County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Mombasa inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo raia mag county mar Mombasa mondo oriwre gi jogo madwaro yiero.

English: Notice: DCI conducts a community briefing on community early-warning systems in Mandera County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DCI inafanya muhtasari wa jamii juu ya mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii katika Kaunti ya Mandera Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada ku saabsan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada ee Degmada Mandera bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: DCI timo romo mar chiwo siem ne oganda e wi chenro mag chiwo siem chon e taon mar Mandera e dwe mar Desemba.

English: KNEC invites youth in Kisumu County to enroll for ICT skills training this January.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT Januari hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kisumu inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka xirfadaha ICT bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: KNEC gwelo rowere e County mar Kisumu mondo odonj e tiegruok mar ICT e dwe mar Januar.

English: Council of Governors urges residents of Vihiga County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kukaa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha waxay ku boorinayaan dadka deggan degmada Vihiga inay ka qeybgalaan kalfadhiga guud ee golaha gobolka si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda horumarinta gobolka.
Dholuo: Council of Governors jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Vihiga mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo omed ng'eyo chenro mag dongruok mag county.

English: Notice from Division of Disease Surveillance and Response: skilled birth attendance clinics will run every March at designated health centres in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa: kliniki za mahudhurio ya uzazi zenye ujuzi zitaendeshwa kila Machi katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Lamu.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka socda qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada: rugta daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfadleyda ah waxay ku shaqeyn doontaa bishii Maarso oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Lamu.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuwo: Klinike mag rito nyuol ma nigi lony biro tiyo e dwe mar Mach higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Lamu.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges youth in Vihiga County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ugu baaqay dhalinyarada degmada Vihiga inay ka qeybgalaan madasha waxbarashada rayidka ah ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada rayidnimada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo rowere e County mar Vihiga mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok ochopo tije mag oganda.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa kurejesha matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero dib u soo kabashada xadgudubka maadooyinka bilaashka ah laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka Mandera.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tiyo gi yedhe mamero yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Mandera.

English: Huduma Kenya reminds the public in Marsabit County that input on the county budget process is welcome this January.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba mchango kwenye mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti unakaribishwa Januari hii.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Marsabit in talooyinka ku saabsan habka miisaaniyadda degmada ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya oparo ne ji duto man Marsabit County ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e dwe mar Januar.

English: KEMRI encourages residents of Kitui County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay ugu yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng' Kitui County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giluong kony mar thieth mar paro maonge chudo.

English: KEPHIS advises farmers in Turkana County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Turkana inay iska diiwaangeliyaan tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qeybgalaan waxbarashada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e county mar Turkana mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e tiego jopur mabiro.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations warns residents of Turkana County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Utafiti wa Uhalifu inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kuhusu kuongezeka kwa kashfa za pesa za simu na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ka digaya dadka deggan degmada Turkana oo ku saabsan kororka khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobilada wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng' County mar Turkana e wi medruok mar timbe mag wuondo pesa e simo kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: Teachers Service Commission encourages residents of Nakuru County to attend the civic education forum to stay informed on voter registration.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inay ka qeybgalaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta si ay uga warqabaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jogweng' Nakuru County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda mondo ging'e weche duto motudore gi kad mar josiasa.

English: IEBC advises students in Kitui County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kitui kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Somali: IEBC waxay kula talineysaa ardayda degmada Kitui inay dalbadaan bogga deeqda waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan deeq waxbarasho ardayda u baahan.
Dholuo: IEBC nyiso jopuonjre manie Kitui County mondo oketgi e intanet mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo osuru ne jopuonjre man gi chan.

English: Kenya Dairy Board reminds livestock keepers in Meru County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Meru kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Meru inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska xayawaanada ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board parone jorit jamni e county mar Meru ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds residents of Vihiga County that water harvesting improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba uvunaji wa maji huboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga in goosashada biyaha ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) parone jogweng' mar County mar Vihiga ni yuto mar pi kelo dongruok e pidho puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Avoid using public Wi-Fi for banking. Use a VPN if you must connect. Most free networks are not secure.
Kiswahili: Epuka kutumia Wi-Fi ya umma kwa ajili ya benki. Tumia VPN ikiwa ni lazima uunganishe. Mitandao mingi ya bure si salama.
Somali: Iska ilaali inaad isticmaasho Wi-Fi-ga dadweynaha ee bangiyada. Isticmaal VPN haddii ay qasab kugu tahay inaad ku xidho. Shabakadaha bilaashka ah badankood ammaan ma aha.
Dholuo: Owinjore kik iti gi Wi-Fi ma ji duto tiyogo e ng’iewo gikmoko. Ti kod VPN ka nyaka ibed gi tudruok. Netwok mang’eny ma onge chudo ok nigi arita.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public in Vihiga County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba ufikiaji wa msaada wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Vihiga in helitaanka taageerada sheegashada NHIF/SHA ay hadda ka heli karto xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji duto e County mar Vihiga ni kony mar kwayo kwayo kuom NHIF/SHA sani yudore e kuonde moyier.

English: Council of Governors invites residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to attend the public participation forum regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku martiqaadaan dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch ogwelo ji duto modak e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenro mar bajet mar county.

English: State Department for Basic Education invites youth in Bomet County to enroll for electrical installation training this February.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Elimu ya Msingi inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Bomet kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Februari hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku casuumaysaa dhalinyarada degmada Bomet inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education ogwelo rowere e county mar Bomet mondo odonj e tiegruok mar keto sitima e dwe mar Februar.

English: Kenya Dairy Board encourages farmers in Nandi County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for coffee.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nandi kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya kahawa.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda gobolka Nandi inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan kafeega.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur e county mar Nandi mondo ous chiembgi mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo mondo giyud nengo maber mar kong'o.

English: Pressure from your neighborhood and partial treatment of your children can cause much stress and affect your mental health.
Kiswahili: Kushinikizwa na majirani na kuwatendea watoto wako kwa njia isiyofaa kunaweza kusababisha mkazo mwingi na kuathiri afya yako ya akili.
Somali: Dhibaatada xaafadaada ka timaadda iyo daaweynta carruurtaadu waxay sababi karaan walwal badan waxayna saameyn ku yeelan karaan caafimaadkaaga maskaxda.
Dholuo: Chandruoge ma joma odak e alworau keloni koda kaka imedo dewo nyithindi nyalo miyo ibed gi parruok mang'eny kendo nyalo ketho parruok ma in-go.

English: AFA announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for sheep in Nandi County this May.
Kiswahili: AFA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Nandi Mei hii.
Somali: AFA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo bilaash ah oo cudurka Newcastle ah oo loogu talagalay idaha gobolka Nandi bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: AFA olando chenro mar goyo ne rombe thieth mar tuo mar Newcastle maonge chudo e dwe mar Mei e county mar Nandi.
