English: Coronavirus: A lockdown in Kenya is an option, but taxes wonâ€™t be lifted
Kiswahili: Virusi vya Korona: Kufungiwa nchini Kenya ni chaguo, lakini kodi hazitaondolewa
Somali: Coronavirus: Xayiraadda ka jirta Kenya waa ikhtiyaar, laakiin canshuuraha lama qaadi doono
Dholuo: Korona: Loro piny Kenya en yiero, kata kamano osuru ok bi gol oko

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Bungoma County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kufunga na kutunza vizima moto nyumbani na kazini wakati huu wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay guryahooda ku rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo shaqada inta lagu jiro xilliyada shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross parone jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi koda e tijegi e kinde masiche mag ndara.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) announces SHA registration for residents of Kakamega County starting this February.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatangaza usajili wa SHA kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kuanzia Februari hii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa ku dhawaaqaya diiwaangelinta SHA ee dadka deggan Gobolka Kakamega laga bilaabo Febraayo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) ong'ado mar ndiko ji e SHA ne joma odak e Kaunti mar Kakamega kochakore e dwe mar Februar.

English: Other factors that are likely to affect agricultural TFPG are access to markets and credit, and a number of farm-specific factors like farm management and ...
Kiswahili: Vitu vingine ambavyo vinaweza kuathiri TFPG ya kilimo ni ufikiaji wa masoko na mikopo, na sababu kadhaa maalum za shamba kama vile usimamizi wa shamba na ...
Somali: Waxyaabaha kale ee ay u badan tahay inay saameyn ku yeeshaan TFPG beeraha waa helitaanka suuqyada iyo amaahda, iyo dhowr arrimood oo gaar ah oo beeraha ah sida maareynta beeraha iyo ...
Dholuo: Gik mamoko manyalo mulo TFPG e weche mag pur gin yudo ohala e ohala kod pesa, kaachiel gi gik mamoko ma nyalo konyo e ngima jopur kaka weche mag pur kod ...

English: Kenya: Concerns over deaths in protests
Kiswahili: Kenya: Wasiwasi wa vifo katika maandamano
Somali: Kenya: Walaac laga qabo dhimashada dibadbaxyada
Dholuo: Kenya: Luoro kuom tho mag ji e lwenje mag kwedo

English: Kenya Red Cross advises residents of Nairobi County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Laanta Cas ee Kenya waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Nairobi County mondo odonj e riwruok mar insuarans mar thieth mondo giyud thieth makonyogi.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Kisumu County about the importance of safe water storage for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhusu umuhimu wa uhifadhi wa maji salama kwa ajili ya ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay dadka degmada Kisumu ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji e County mar Kisumu kuom ber mar kano pi maler e ngima joot.

English: In the longer term, these group enterprises have the potential to increase household income, strengthen group cohesion, and contribute to greater economic resilience among participating women and their communities.
Kiswahili: Kwa muda mrefu, biashara hizi za vikundi zina uwezo wa kuongeza mapato ya kaya, kuimarisha mshikamano wa vikundi, na kuchangia uthabiti mkubwa wa kiuchumi kati ya wanawake wanaoshiriki na jamii zao.
Somali: Waqtiga fog, shirkadahan kooxeed waxay leeyihiin awood ay ku kordhiyaan dakhliga qoyska, ku xoojiyaan isku-xidhnaanta kooxda, iyo inay gacan ka geystaan ​​​​adkeysiga dhaqaale ee sii kordhaya ee haweenka ka qayb qaadanaya iyo bulshooyinkooda.
Dholuo: E kinde mabiro, ng’wech mag grup gi nigi nyalo mar medo pesa ma joot yudo, jiwo winjruok e kind grup, kendo konyo e kelo ng’wech maduong’ e weche mag yuto mwandu e kind mon ma okawo okang’no kod ogandagi.

English: Universities Fund conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Siaya County this September.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu hufanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Siaya Septemba hii.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu qabtaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada ee degmada Siaya bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund otimo chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda e dwe mar ochiko mar higani e kaunti mar Siaya County.

English: FAO urges maize growers in Kilifi County to apply recommended fertiliser rates before the rains to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: FAO inawasihi wakulima wa mahindi katika Wilaya ya Kilifi watumie kiwango cha mbolea kilichopendekezwa kabla ya mvua ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Kilifi in ay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur ma pidho cham e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue mondo okony e medo nyak mar cham e higani.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development opens a new motor vehicle mechanics programme at the vocational centre in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yafungua programu mpya ya ufundi wa magari katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ka furayaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan farsamada gawaarida mootada ee xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ochako chenro manyien mar tiyo gi masinde mag riembo mtokni e skul mar tiegruok e taon mar Nyeri.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will distribute certified sorghum seed to farmers in Samburu County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu abuuraha Gobolka Samburu u qaybin doonaa abuurka sorghum ee la caddeeyay bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro pogo kodhi mag sorghum ne jopur e county mar Samburu e dwe mar Mei.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges residents of Bungoma County to register their children at the nearest public school to benefit from bursary allocation.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu ili kufaidika na mgao wa bursary.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha si ay uga faa'iideystaan deeq lacageed.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul mar sirkal man machiegni kodgi mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo osuru.

English: NPS urges the community in Bungoma County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: NPS inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Bungoma inay ku biiraan mashaariicda booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo xannibaadda lo'da.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo oganda e County mar Bungoma mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polis mar oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o kwalo jamni.

English: TSC increases intern salary to Ksh 45,000 effective January.
Kiswahili: TSC huongeza mshahara wa wafanya kazi hadi Ksh 45,000 kuanzia Januari.
Somali: TSC waxay kordhisay mushaharka shaqaalaysiinta ilaa Ksh 45,000 laga bilaabo Janaayo.
Dholuo: TSC medo chudo mar josiasa nyaka Ksh 45,000 kochakore Januar.

English: Council of Governors reminds residents of Kisii County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba upatikanaji wa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay xasuusinayaan dadka deggan degmada Kisii in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch oparo ne jogweng' Kisii County ni koro nyalo bedo mayot yudo barua mar nyuol ka gitiyo gi yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Ministry of ICT initiates targeted e-learning projects promoting girlsÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬TM education in rural communities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya ICT inazindua miradi ya kujifunza kwa njia ya elektroniki ili kukuza elimu ya wasichana katika jamii za vijijini.
Somali: Wasaaradda ICT waxay bilowday mashaariic waxbarasho oo elektaroonik ah oo bartilmaameedsan oo lagu horumarinayo waxbarashada gabdhaha ee bulshooyinka miyiga ah.
Dholuo: Od tich mar ICT chako chenro mag somo mag mbui ma ochung’ne somo mar nyiri e gwenge ma oko.

English: TVET advises students in Kericho County to register early to secure allocation to access revision guides.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kericho kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata miongozo ya marekebisho.
Somali: TVET waxay ardayda degmada Kericho kula talineysaa inay si hore u diiwaangeliyaan si ay u helaan gudbinta buugaagta dib-u-eegista.
Dholuo: TVET nyiso jopuonjre e County mar Kericho ni gidonj e skundno chon mondo giyud thuolo mar somo buge ma nyiso kaka nonro ne dhi timore.

English: Notice: KEMSA will hold a substance abuse recovery forum in Nyeri County this April. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA itafanya kongamano la kurejesha matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya katika Kaunti ya Nyeri Aprili hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMSA waxay qabaneysaa madasha dib u soo kabashada isticmaalka maandooriyaha ee degmada Nyeri bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMSA biro timo chokruok mar chango joma tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero e taon mar Nyeri e dwe mar April.

English: Store well-dried nuts in clean sacks and a clean, dry and moisture-free warehouse; use a biological remedy such as Aflasafe, if available, following the advice of specialists, to control fungal poisoning.
Kiswahili: Hifadhi karanga zilizokauka vizuri kwenye magunia safi na ghala safi, kavu na yasiyo na unyevu; tumia dawa ya kibaiolojia kama Aflasafe, ikiwa inapatikana, kwa kufuata ushauri wa wataalamu, ili kudhibiti sumu kuvu.
Somali: Ku kaydi lowska si fiican loo qalajiyey boorsooyin nadiif ah iyo bakhaar nadiif ah, qalalan oo aan qoyan lahayn; isticmaal daawo bayooloji ah sida Aflasafe, haddii la heli karo, adigoo raacaya talada khubarada, si loo xakameeyo sunta fangaska.
Dholuo: Ket tong' ma oseyueyo maber e bag maler kendo e kar kano maler, ma onge pi, kendo ma onge ng'ich; ti gi yath mar thieth kaka Aflasafe, kapo ni nitie, ka luwore gi kaka lakteche osechiwo, mondo omi kik chungo ng'ato gi sum.

English: AP News covered Mwangiâ€™s release on bail and rights groupsâ€™ criticism of terrorism charge misuse during protests.
Kiswahili: AP News ilifunua kufunguliwa kwa Mwangi kwa dhamana na vikundi vya haki za binadamu  ukosoaji wa matumizi mabaya ya mashtaka ya ugaidi wakati wa maandamano.
Somali: AP News ayaa baahisay sii deynta Mwangi oo lagu sii daayay damaanad iyo dhaleecaynta kooxaha xuquuqda aadanaha ee ku aaddan eedeymo argagixiso oo si khaldan loo soo oogay intii ay socdeen dibadbaxyada.
Dholuo: AP News nowuoyo kuom golo Mwangi e od ang'ech kendo kaka riwruoge mag rito ratiro mag ji ne kwedo ketho mar ketho chik ma ne otiyogo e yo marach e kinde ma ne itimoe gik ma kelo ywak.

English: TVET calls on the community in Samburu County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TVET inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TVET waxay bulshada degmada Samburu ugu baaqeysaa inay u soo wargeliyaan maamulka dugsiga wixii dhibaato ah ee ku saabsan amniga si ay dugsiyada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: TVET okwayo ji duto manie county mar Samburu mondo onyis sirkal mar skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: IPOA reminds mobile money users in Homa Bay County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee gobolka Homa Bay inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mobil e Homa Bay County ni mondo ging'e kwayo mag pesa kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo gitang' gi chenro mag gwelo pesa mag miriambo.

English: Universities Fund urges youth in Migori County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Migori kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku boorinayaa dhalinyarada degmada Migori inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund jiwo rowere mag Migori County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok gichako timo tije mag oganda.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e County mar Kisii.

English: NPS reminds residents of Bungoma County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma in si dhakhso leh u soo sheegaan jabsashada ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NPS parone jogweng'o mag Bungoma County ni nyiso ji gik ma ne odonjo e odno mapiyo konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: IEBC reminds residents of Trans Nzoia County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia in helitaanka adeegyada baasaboorka ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: IEBC parone jogweng' mar Trans Nzoia County ni koro yot yudo passport kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Climate change increases the challenge of attaining productivity and nourishment expected in agriculture and it's impact can be felt.
Kiswahili: Mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa huongeza changamoto ya kufikia tija na lishe inayotarajiwa katika kilimo na athari zake zinaweza kuonekana.
Somali: Isbeddelka cimilada wuxuu kordhiyaa caqabadda ku aaddan in la helo wax-soo-saarka iyo nafaqada laga filayo beeraha, saameynteedana waa la dareemayaa.
Dholuo: Lokruok mar alwora medo pek mar yudo nyak kod chiemo ma ji dwaro e tij pur, kendo mano miyo ji winjo ber mar lokruokno.

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief, January 2025
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP Kenya, Januari 2025
Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya, Janaayo 2025
Dholuo: Wach machuok mar piny Kenya mar WFP, dwe mar achiel higa mar 2025

English: Fuel your body, feed your mind! What you eat, how you move, and what you avoid directly shapes your mental health. Choose clean eating, stay active, and say NO to harmful substances. Your future self will thank you!
Kiswahili: Tia nguvu mwili wako, lisha akili yako! Kile unachokula, jinsi unavyotembea, na kile unachoepuka huunda moja kwa moja afya yako ya akili. Chagua kula safi, endelea kufanya mazoezi, na useme HAPANA kwa vitu vyenye madhara. Utu wako wa baadaye utakushukuru!
Somali: Jirkaaga quudi, maskaxdaada quudi! waxa aad cuntid, sida aad u dhaqmayso, iyo waxa aad ka fogaato waxay si toos ah u qaabeeyaan caafimaadkaaga maskaxda. Cuntada nadiifka ah doorato, firfircoon noqo, oo waxyaabaha waxyeelada leh NO sheeg. naftaada mustaqbalka ayaa kugu mahadcelin doonta!
Dholuo: Bed gi paro mowinjore kuom gik ma ichamo, kaka iwuotho, kod gik ma itimo maok itimo. Yier chamo chiemo maler, bed modich, kendo wach ni ooyo gi gik makelo hinyruok.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Embu County about the importance of tobacco control for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Embu kuhusu umuhimu wa udhibiti wa tumbaku kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMSA waxay dadka degmada Embu ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay ka hortagga sigaarka ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone ji duto e county mar Embu kuom gimomiyo thieth mar madho ndawa en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Wajir County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Wajir Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee Gobolka Wajir bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Rapar: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Wajir e dwe mar Februar.

English: Kenya Situation Update | November 2023: Competition Over Politics and Resources Affects Recent County Border Disputes in Kenya
Kiswahili: Sasisho la Hali ya Kenya | Novemba 2023: Ushindani Kuhusu Siasa na Rasilimali Waathiri Mizozo ya Hivi Karibuni ya Mipaka ya Kaunti nchini Kenya
Somali: Cusbooneysiinta Xaaladda Kenya | Noofambar 2023: Tartanka Siyaasadda iyo Kheyraadka ayaa Saameynaya Murankii Xuduudaha ee Dhawaan ka dhacay Kenya
Dholuo: Oboke mar Kenya | dwe mar apar gi ariyo 2023: Piem ewi weche siasa kod mwandu mag piny Kenya

English: SHA urges residents of Murang'a County to engage their local ward administrator to stay informed on community-based development programmes.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kuajiri msimamizi wao wa wilaya ili kuendelea kuwa na habari juu ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii.
Somali: SHA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay la xiriiraan maamulayaasha degmooyinkooda si ay uga warqabaan barnaamijyada horumarinta ee ku saleysan bulshada.
Dholuo: SHA jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Murang'a mondo omany thuolo mar tudore gi jotelo mag utegi mondo gisik ka ging'eyo chenro mag dongruok e kind oganda.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) appeals to caregivers in Kitui County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the July maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kitui kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Julai.
Somali: Shirkadda SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Kitui inay ilmahooda u keenaan kormeerka koritaanka iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) kwayo jorit e County mar Kitui mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo kaka achiel kuom chenro mar dwe mar Julai mar weche thieth mar min.

English: Cabinet Secretary Ezekiel Machogu announced that the government will no longer fully fund public universities and colleges
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Baraza la Mawaziri Ezekiel Machogu alitangaza kwamba serikali haitafadhili tena kikamilifu vyuo vikuu na vyuo vikuu vya umma
Somali: Xoghayaha Golaha Wasiirada Ezekiel Machogu ayaa ku dhawaaqay in dowladdu aysan mar dambe si buuxda u maalgelin doonin jaamacadaha iyo kulliyadaha dowladda.
Dholuo: Jatend kabinet Ezekiel Machogu olando ni sirkal ok bi chiwo omwom duto ne yunivasiti kod kolej mag sirkal

English: Kenya - Floods (Kenya Met, media) (ECHO Daily Flash of 05 December 2024)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Mafuriko (Kenya Met, vyombo vya habari) (ECHO Daily Flash ya 05 Desemba 2024)
Somali: Kenya - Daadad (Kenya Met, warbaahinta) (ECHO Daily Flash ee 05 Diseembar 2024)
Dholuo: Kenya - Pi mang'eny (Kenya ne oromo, yor mbui) (ECHO pile ka pile tarik 05 dwe mar apar gi ariyo 2024)

English: KICD reminds parents in Murang'a County that free day secondary education registration is open this September.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba usajili wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo umefunguliwa Septemba hii.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Murang'a in diiwaangelinta dugsiga dhexe ee bilaashka ah ay furan tahay bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne jonyuol e County mar Murang'a ni somo mar sekondari mar odiechieng' maonge chudo osechakore e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit appeals to caregivers in Meru County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the October maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Meru kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Oktoba.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Meru inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit okwayo jorit e county mar Meru mondo okel nyithindgi mondo gitim nonro e wi dongruok margi kaka achiel kuom chenro mar weche thieth mar mon ma timore e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: KTDA advises farmers in Kajiado County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the December planting season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Desemba.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kajiado inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka ciidanka xilliga dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Diseembar.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e Kajiado County mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche mag chwoyo kodhi e kinde machuok kapok dwe mar Desemba ochopo.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Taita-Taveta County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the June planting season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Juni.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka xilliga dayrta iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Juun.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur manie Taita-Taveta County mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche mag tho e kinde machuok ka gitiyo gi tuoche makelo hinyruok e dwe mar Jun.

English: TSC announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Narok County this May.
Kiswahili: TSC inatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Narok Mei hii.
Somali: TSC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qeybinta waxyaabaha barashada digitalka ah ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada gobolka Narok bisha May.
Dholuo: TSC ogolo chenro mar pogo buge mag digital maonge chudo e skunde mag Narok County e dwe mar Mei.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Medical Association will be held in Nyamira County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu bila malipo iliyoandaliwa na Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Nyamira bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma Kenya Medical Association ochano ibiro tim e County mar Nyamira e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Nairobi County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Nairobi inay la yimaadaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qayb galaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e County mar Nairobi mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Infants should be exclusively breastfed with mother's milk for the first six months without giving any other food to ensure optimal health and immunity.
Kiswahili: Mtoto mchanga anapaswa kunyonyeshwa maziwa ya mama pekee kwa miezi sita ya kwanza bila kupewa chakula kingine ili kupata afya bora na kinga mwilini.
Somali: Carruurta yaryar waa in si gaar ah loogu naas nuujiyaa caanaha hooyada lixda bilood ee ugu horreysa iyada oo aan la siinin cunto kale si loo hubiyo caafimaad wanaagsan iyo difaac wanaagsan.
Dholuo: Nyithindo matin onego omigi mana chak mar min-gi kuom dweche auchiel mokwongo ma ok omigi chiemo machielo mondo gibed gi ngima maber kendo gibed gi teko mar geng’o tuoche.
resource: UNICEF & Ministry of Health Nutrition Advisory

English: NTSA urges motorists and pedestrians in Laikipia County to avoid crossing flooded bridges and rivers to prevent flooding-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Laikipia inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo webiyada fatahaadda ku dhacay si looga hortago dhacdooyinka fatahaadaha la xiriira.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo joidh mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Laikipia mondo kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o mondo gikwed masiche motudore gi pi.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds residents of Kajiado County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kajiado County kwamba kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa wilaya huimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado in ka qaybgalka kalfadhiga guud ee shirka degmada uu xoojiyo maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) paronwa jogweng' Kajiado County ni dhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development informs milk farmers in Mombasa County of new market linkage opportunities this June.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inafahamisha wakulima wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Juni hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda caanaha ee gobolka Mombasa fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development olero ne jopur mag chak e county mar Mombasa thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Jun.

English: Take a deep breath and relax. Listen to your body. If you're really tired, give yourself time to sleep. Without good sleep, our mental health suffers and our concentration goes downhill. Sometimes the world can wait.
Kiswahili: Vuta pumzi ndefu na upumzike. Sikiliza mwili wako. Ikiwa umechoka sana, jipe â€‹â€‹muda wa kulala. Bila usingizi mzuri, afya yetu ya akili huharibika na umakini wetu hupungua. Wakati mwingine ulimwengu unaweza kusubiri.
Somali: Neef qoto dheer qaado oo naso. Dhageyso jirkaaga. Haddii aad daalan tahay, naftaada sii waqti aad ku seexato. Haddii aadan hurdo fiican haysan, caafimaadka maskaxdeenna ayaa xumaada, feejignaanteenuna hoos ayay u dhacdaa. Mararka qaar adduunku wuu sugi karaa.
Dholuo: Ywa muya matut kendo ibed gi mor. Winj kaka ringreni winjo. Kapo ni iol ahinya, miyi thuolo mar nindo. Ka ok wanindo maber, paro ma wan-go bedo marach kendo ok wanyal keto pachwa kuom gik moko. Seche moko piny nyalo rito.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties updates residents of Nakuru County on progress of county development projects this April.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti hii Aprili.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaanka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Nakuru ka warbixiyaa horumarka mashaariicda horumarinta degmada bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties olero ne jogweng' Nakuru County kaka chenro mag dongruok mar gweng'no dhi nyime e dwe mar April.

English: Kenya Medical Association advises residents of Homa Bay County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay inay biyo cabitaan ah ku karsadaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association nyiso jogweng' Homa Bay County ni mondo omak pi modho kapok gitiyo kode mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche ma ok nyal geng'o.

English: CDC reminds the public in Kajiado County about the importance of diabetes screening for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: CDC inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuhusu umuhimu wa uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: CDC waxay dadweynaha degmada Kajiado ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda baaritaanka sonkorowga ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: CDC parone ji duto e Kajiado County kuom ber mar nonro mar thieth mar sukari e ngima joot.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) warns beans farmers in Baringo County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaonya wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Baringo juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay uga digtay beeraleyda Baringo County cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna kugula talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho puothe e county mar Baringo kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: KUCCPS encourages out-of-school children in Kisumu County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa watu wazima chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Kisumu inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee barnaamijyada quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo nyithindo maok dhi e skul e gweng' mar Kisumu mondo odonj e program mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo e bwo program mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: Pest Control Products Board announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for cattle in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this October.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Oktoba hii.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa ku dhawaaqaya jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ka dhan ah qabyaalada lo'da ee gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet bishii Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok e Piny owacho, ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar rabies e taon mar Elgeyo-Marakwet e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Nairobi County starting this January.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuanzia Januari hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa in laga bilaabo Janaayo la siinayo deebaajiyo loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Nairobi.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche olando ni dhialisi mar ji duto modak e County mar Nairobi biro chakore e dwe mar Januar.

English: TSC urges parents and teachers in Bungoma County to reach out to the child helpline 116.
Kiswahili: TSC inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuwasiliana na nambari ya msaada kwa watoto 116.
Somali: TSC waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Bungoma inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta 116.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Bungoma mondo omany simo mar kony ne nyithindo namba 116.

English: KEMRI announces eye and dental camps for residents of Kitui County starting this January.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatangaza kambi za macho na meno kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kuanzia Januari hii.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa xeryaha indhaha iyo ilkaha ee dadka deggan degmada Kitui laga bilaabo Janaayo.
Dholuo: KEMRI ogolo kambi mag thieth mag wang' kod lakteche mag laktech ne joma odak e gweng' mar Kitui kochakore Januar.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds livestock keepers in Tana River County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Tana River inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska xoolaha ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) paronwa jorit jamni e taon mar Tana River County ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni kodgi mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: NCPB urges cattle farmers in Makueni County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa Newcastle vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da ee degmada Makueni inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo ka dib kiisaska cudurka Newcastle ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur mag jamni e county mar Makueni mondo ogeng'gi e kuonde moyier mag chamo jamni bang' yudo weche mag tuo mar Newcastle.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) urges sweet potatoes growers in Nairobi County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawasihi wakulima wa viazi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kudhibiti wizi wa jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa za kuua wadudu zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda baradho macaan ee Gobolka Nairobi in ay horumariyaan weerarkii ciidanka ee dayrta iyagoo isticmaalaya cayayaanka la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur ma pidho kitungu e County mar Nairobi mondo oti gi yedhe mamero ma nigi ratiro mar chango jolweny chon ka gitiyo gi gik makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok mondo gimed nyak e higani.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Mandera County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay dadka degmada Mandera kula talineysaa inay yareeyaan qaadashada cusbada iyo sonkorta si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit nyiso jogweng'o mag Mandera County ni mondo giduog chien e chamo mor kod sukari mondo gikwed thieth mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: Tharaka Nithi County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Juni 2024
Somali: Degmada Tharaka Nithi: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Tharaka Nithi: Oboke machon mar goyo oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2024

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross opens a gender desk offering post-violence medical care in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unafungua dawati la jinsia kutoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay furtay xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya daryeel caafimaad ka dib rabshadaha gobolka Bomet.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Red Cross oseyawo ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony mar thieth bang' timbe mahundu e county mar Bomet.

English: During heavy rains and floods, citizens are urged to stay in safe places and avoid crossing rivers or areas with high water levels to prevent disaster.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa mvua kubwa na mafuriko, wananchi wanaombwa kukaa mahali salama na kuepuka kuvuka mito au maeneo yenye maji mengi ili kuzuia maafa.
Somali: Xilliyada roobabka culus iyo daadadka, muwaadiniinta waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay joogaan meelo ammaan ah oo ay ka fogaadaan inay ka gudbaan webiyada ama meelaha ay biyuhu sarreeyaan si looga hortago musiibooyinka.
Dholuo: E kinde koth mang’eny kod pi ma pong’o piny, ijiwo jodak mondo obed kuonde ma nigi arita kendo kik giwuoth e aora kata kuonde ma pi opong’e ahinya mondo kik giyud masira.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Nyamira County to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Nyamira inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka maskaxeed ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pachgi e County mar Nyamira mondo oluong kony mar thieth mar pach maonge chudo.

English: Teachers Service Commission launches online platform offering modular professional development courses for teachers.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma kwa Walimu yazindua jukwaa la mtandaoni linalotoa kozi za ukuzaji wa kitaaluma za msimu kwa walimu.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa bilaabay barnaamij online ah oo macallimiinta siinaya koorsooyin horumarineed xirfadeed oo casri ah.
Dholuo: Komison mar Tich mar Jopuonj ochako mbui machiwo kos mag dongruok mar lony ne jopuonj.

English: SHA reminds voters in Kilifi County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: SHA inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000 kabla ya kujiandikisha.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Kilifi in ay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000 ka hor diiwaangelinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: SHA parone jogweng' Kilifi County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go ka gitiyo gi sms ne ji 70000 kapok gidonjo e register mar joma biro yiero.

English: AFA advises fish producers in Kirinyaga County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: AFA inawashauri wazalishaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: AFA waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kalluunka ee Gobolka Kirinyaga inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: AFA nyiso jopur ma loso rech e gweng' mar Kirinyaga mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur ka pok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: UNICEF Kenya Humanitarian Situation Report No. 8 - End-of-Year 2023
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya Hali ya Kibinadamu ya UNICEF Kenya Nambari 8 - Mwisho wa Mwaka 2023
Somali: Warbixinta Xaaladda Bani'aadamnimada ee UNICEF Kenya Lambarka 8 - Dhammaadka Sannadka 2023
Dholuo: Ripot mar chal mar konyo dhano mar UNICEF e piny Kenya namba 8 - Giko mar higa mar 2023

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds the public in Nyeri County about the importance of hand hygiene for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyeri juu ya umuhimu wa usafi wa mikono kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Waaxda Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay dadka degmada Nyeri ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda nadaafadda gacmaha ay u leedahay caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche parone ji duto e County mar Nyeri kuom ber mar rito ler mar lwedo e ngima joot.

English: Notice: Universities Fund reminds citizens in Bomet County about their rights regarding voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuhusu haki zao kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu muwaadiniinta degmada Bomet xusuusinayaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Pesa mar Yunivasiti paronwa raia mag Bomet County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar ndiko joma oyiero.

English: Kenya Forest Service urges the public in Tana River County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadweynaha degmada Tana River County inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aanay wax ka qaban ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service jiwo ji duto manie Tana River County mondo ong'e kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma osefweny kuom chenro mag ohala mag miriambo.

English: Notice: KNEC announces bursary allocation enrollment dates for schools in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KNEC yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa bursary kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KNEC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ee dugsiyada degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KNEC olando tarik mag somo e skunde mag Kisumu County.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Kisii County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay ka qeybgalaan kalfadhiga guud ee golaha gobolka si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda horumarinta gobolka.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' County mar Kisii mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo ging'e weche momedore e wi chenro mag dongruok mag county.

English: Farmers should prioritize planting disease-tolerant rice varieties with suitable maturity periods to achieve stable yields.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanapaswa kuweka kipaumbele cha kupanda aina za mchele zenye uvumilivu wa magonjwa na vipindi vya kukomaa vinavyofaa ili kufikia mavuno imara.
Somali: Beeraleyda waa inay mudnaanta siiyaan beerista noocyo bariis u adkaysta cudurrada oo leh waqtiyo bisil ku habboon si ay u gaaraan dalag deggan.
Dholuo: Kuom mano, jopur onego oket tong' mokwongo mar pidho kit loso loso kodhi ma nigi nyalo mar geng'o tuoche, kendo ma nigi kinde mowinjore mar chamo kodhi mondo giyud nyak maber.

English: EACC urges residents of Wajir County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir wape huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir inay dalbadaan bixinta adeegyada aan la bixin laaluush si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Wajir mondo okonygi ka ok gichulo asoya mondo giked gi asoya e migepe mag sirkal.

English: E-Citizen reminds the public in Isiolo County that input on the annual performance review is welcome this March.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen anakumbusha umma katika Wilaya ya Isiolo kwamba maoni juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka ni ya kukaribishwa Machi hii.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Isiolo in talooyinka dib-u-eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa ji duto e County mar Isiolo ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e dwe mar Mach.

English: TVET urges youth in Vihiga County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: TVET inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: TVET waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Vihiga inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: TVET jiwo rowere e County mar Vihiga mondo oriwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gitimo gik ma biro timore ne oganda.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds residents of Tharaka-Nithi County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti huimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General parone jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County ni luwo dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: KTDA urges farmers in Kisii County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kisii inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kisii mondo opidh cham mondo omi lowo okethre.

English: TVET invites youth in Kirinyaga County to enroll for ICT skills training this December.
Kiswahili: TVET inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT Desemba hii.
Somali: TVET waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kirinyaga inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka xirfadaha ICT bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: TVET gwelo rowere man Kirinyaga County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar ICT e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice from CDC: childhood immunization clinics will run every April at designated health centres in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa CDC: kliniki za chanjo za watoto zitafanya kazi kila Aprili katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid CDC: rugta tallaalka carruurta ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Abriil kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar yedhe ma thiedho tuoche (CDC): klinik mag thieth ne nyithindo biro tiyo dwe mar April higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e county mar Siaya.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds voters in Nyeri County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya usajili wa wapiga Kura.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu xusuusinayaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Nyeri inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor diiwaangelinta codbixisayaasha.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General parone jogweng' Nyeri mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar timo yiero kapok gidonjo e register mar joma oyiero.

English: ODPP urges residents of Lamu County to attend the public participation forum to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Lamu inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha si ay u qaabeeyaan wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynta.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Lamu mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar loso chenro mag siasa.

English: OGP advises residents of Kilifi County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: OGP inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Nyandarua County this July.

English: TSC urges youth in Machakos County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: TSC inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: TSC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Machakos inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo rowere e county mar Machakos mondo onon weche ma gin-go mar ndiko ji kapok gitimo gik ma biro timore ne oganda.

English: KUCCPS recalls 2023 KCSE placement letters due to fee structure changes.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inachukua barua za nafasi za 2023 za KCSE kwa sababu ya mabadiliko ya muundo wa ada.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay dib u soo celineysaa waraaqaha booska 2023 KCSE sababo la xiriira isbeddellada qaab dhismeedka khidmadaha.
Dholuo: KUCCPS duoko barupe mag keto ji e KCSE e higa mar 2023 nikech lokruok e chenro mar chudo.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public that free stress management support is available through county health facilities in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kudhibiti mafadhaiko unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo lagu maareeyo walbahaarka laga helo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health parone ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar stress yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Siaya.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties urges eligible citizens in Nyamira County to participate in polling procedures.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kushiriki katika utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu ku boorinayaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Nyamira inay ka qeyb galaan nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro e County mar Nyamira mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag yiero.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Trans Nzoia County that access to outpatient services is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma za wagonjwa wa nje sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Trans Nzoia in adeegyada bukaanka dibedda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMRI paronwa ji duto e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia ni sani nitie kuonde ma ji nyalo yudoe thieth mag thieth.

Kiswahili: Masks ni kizuizi rahisi kusaidia kuzuia matone yako ya kupumua kuwafikia wengine. Uchunguzi unaonyesha kuwa masks hupunguza dawa ya matone wakati huvaliwa juu ya pua na mdomo. #KomeshaCorona #WearAMask x.com/ExplainerKE/st â€¦

English: Notice: TSC opens a new tailoring and design programme at the vocational centre in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TSC inafungua programu mpya ya ushonaji na muundo katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TSC waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan dharka iyo naqshadeynta xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Mandera.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: TSC chako chenro manyien mar loso piche kendo loso gik moko e skul mar tiegruok e taon mar Mandera.

English: The Ministry of Agriculture has developed guidelines to support the food supply chain during the COVID 19 pandemic All stakeholders must adhere to these protocols for stability in food availability and accessibility
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo imeandaa miongozo ya kusaidia usambazaji wa chakula wakati wa janga la COVID-19 Wadau wote lazima wazingatie itifaki hizi kwa utulivu katika upatikanaji na upatikanaji wa chakula.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha ayaa diyaarisay tilmaamo taageeraya silsiladda sahayda cuntada inta lagu jiro faafida COVID 19. Dhammaan daneeyayaasha waa inay raacaan habraacyadaas si loo helo xasillooni iyo helitaanka cuntada
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture osechako chenro mar siro chenro mar chiwo chiemo e kinde mar tuoche mar COVID 19 Joma duto motudore gi chenrono nyaka luw chike ma kamago mondo gibed gi winjruok maber gi chiemo.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages residents of Mandera County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiiri geliyaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay u yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo jogweng'o mag Mandera County mondo kik gisandre ka giol kendo mondo giluong kony mar thieth mar chuny maonge chudo.

English: Kenya has five years to meet its Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and Kenya Health Policy targets for maternal and newborn health.
Kiswahili: Kenya ina miaka mitano kufikia Malengo yake ya Maendeleo Endelevu (SDGs) na shabaha za Sera ya Afya ya Kenya kwa afya ya uzazi na watoto wachanga.
Somali: Kenya waxay haysataa shan sano oo ay ku gaari karto yoolalka Horumarinta Waara (SDGs) iyo yoolalka Siyaasadda Caafimaadka Kenya ee caafimaadka hooyada iyo dhallaanka.
Dholuo: Kenya nigi higni abich mar chopo gik ma oketo e chenro mar dongruok ma nyaka chieng’ (SDGs) kod gik ma oketo e chik mar thieth mar piny Kenya kuom thieth mar mon kod nyithindo ma pok onyuol.

English: Start your business! Join TVET entrepreneurship courses.

Somali: Bilow ganacsigaaga! Ku biir koorsooyinka ganacsiga ee TVET.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are reminded that a geo mapping initiative for coffee farms is underway to meet EU Deforestation Regulation requirements Completion is expected in two months
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanakumbushwa kuwa mpango wa ramani ya kijiografia kwa mashamba ya kahawa unaendelea ili kukidhi mahitaji ya Udhibiti wa Ukataji miti wa Umoja wa Ulaya Kukamilika kunatarajiwa baada ya miezi miwili.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha ayaa la xasuusinayaa in mashruuc geo mapping ah oo loogu talagalay beeraha qaxwaha uu socdo si loo buuxiyo shuruudaha EU Deforestation Regulation Waxaa la filayaa in la dhammeeyo laba bilood gudahood
Dholuo: Owete gi nyimine ma tiyo e tije mag loso yiende kod mag loso yiende e pinje mamoko bende onego ong'e ni nitie chenro mar loso map mag piny ma biro konyo e loso yiende mag loso yiende.

English: FAO reminds residents of Narok County that water harvesting improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: FAO inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kwamba uvunaji wa maji huboresha tija ya shamba ya muda mrefu.
Somali: FAO waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Narok in biyo la soo uruuriyo ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: FAO parone jogweng' Narok County ni choko pi kelo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Lamu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Lamu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2022

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Lamu County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Lamu.

Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tiyo gi yedhe mamero yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county man Lamu County.

English: Cross-sector validation meeting held to align county and national nutrition strategies under KNAP.
Kiswahili: Mkutano wa uthibitishaji wa sekta mtambuka ulifanyika ili kuoanisha mikakati ya lishe ya kaunti na kitaifa chini ya KNAP.
Somali: Kulan xaqiijinta qaybaha kala duwan oo la qabtay si loo iswaafajiyo istaraatijiyadaha nafaqada ee gobollada iyo kuwa qaranka ee ku hoos jira KNAP.
Dholuo: Chokruok mar ng'ado mar tiegruok e yore mopogore opogore ne otim mondo okel winjruok e kind weche mag chiemb chuny kod weche mag thieth e county kod e piny mangima e bwo chenro mar KNAP.

English: Notice: OGP opens voter education centres in Vihiga County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay furaysaa xarumaha waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha ee degmada Vihiga bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: OGP ochako tiego josiasa e kaunti mar Vihiga e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inafungua ofisi ya kijinsia inayotoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay furtay xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo taageero maskaxeed iyo bulsheed ka bixiya degmada Kiambu.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji ochako migawone mar chiwo kony e weche mag paro e gweng' mar Kiambu.

English: E-Citizen invites residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuwasilisha hati za maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusu vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.

English: A phased approach allowed Kenya to strengthen systems and improve data quality before expanding surveillance.

English: Plant certified seeds using the correct planting methods - as KALRO Director Robert Musyoki puts it, this is 'the best way' to address Kenya's food deficit; certified seeds 'guarantee improved productivity and resilience,' according to KALRO Research Officer Samuel Kiiru.
Kiswahili: Panda mbegu zilizoidhinishwa kwa kutumia njia sahihi za kupanda - kama Mkurugenzi wa KALRO Robert Musyoki anavyosema, hii ndiyo 'njia bora' ya kushughulikia upungufu wa chakula nchini Kenya; mbegu zilizoidhinishwa 'zinahakikisha tija na uthabiti,' kulingana na Afisa Utafiti wa KALRO Samuel Kiiru.
Somali: Ku dhis abuurka la shahaado iyadoo la adeegsanayo hababka beeritaanka saxda ah - sida uu sheegay agaasimaha KALRO Robert Musyoki, tani waa 'habka ugu fiican' ee lagu xallin karo yaraanta cuntada Kenya; abuurka la shahaado 'waxay damaanad qaadeysaa wax soo saar iyo adkeysi sare', sida uu sheegay sarkaalka cilmi baarista ee KALRO Samuel Kiiru.
Dholuo: Nyak kodhi ma osenyis ni ok nyal chuer ka gitiyo gi yore makare mag pidho - kaka jatend KALRO Robert Musyoki wacho, mano e ' yo maberie moloyo ' mar tieko yuto mar chiemo e piny Kenya; kodhi ma osenyis ni ok nyal chuer ' miyo nyak kod teko mar nano medo bedo maber, ' kaka jatend KALRO Samuel Kiiru wacho.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will distribute certified coffee seed to farmers in Bungoma County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itasambaza mbegu za kahawa zilizothibitishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay abuurka kafeega ee shahaadada leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Bungoma bishii Sebtember ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Tij Lemo kod Chiemo (AFA) biro pogo kodhi mag kofi ne jopur manie Bungoma County e dwe mar ochiko.

English: COMESA informs coffee farmers in Mandera County of new market linkage opportunities this May.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawafahamisha wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Mandera juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Mei hii.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Mandera fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha May.
Dholuo: COMESA nyiso jopur mag chai man Mandera County e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Mei.

English: Kenya Red Cross advises residents of Isiolo County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.

Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' Isiolo County mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi maber sama gidwaro thieth mondo giyud kony mar thieth.

English: Trump's policy hits Kenyan health initiatives. Policy halts supply of HIV, Malaria and TB drugs. Move also affects medical supplies of newborn babies. Barasa: We'll look for funding elsewhere if US pulls ou
Kiswahili: Sera ya Trump inaathiri mipango ya afya ya Kenya. Sera inasimamisha usambazaji wa dawa za VVU, Malaria na TB. Hatua hiyo pia inaathiri vifaa vya matibabu vya watoto wachanga. Barasa: Tutatafuta ufadhili kwingineko ikiwa Marekani itaondoa
Somali: Siyaasadda Trump waxay saameyn ku yeelanaysaa dadaallada caafimaadka Kenya. Siyaasadda waxay joojinaysaa bixinta daawooyinka HIV, Duumada iyo Qaaxada. Tallaabadani waxay sidoo kale saameynaysaa sahayda caafimaadka ee dhallaanka cusub. Barasa: Waxaan maalgelin ka raadin doonnaa meelo kale haddii Mareykanku uu ka baxo
Dholuo: Chik ma Trump oketo ketho chenro mag thieth mag piny Kenya. Chik ochungo chiwo yath mag HIV, Maleria kod TB. Move bende ketho gik ma itiyogo e thieth ne nyithindo ma pod onyuol manyien. Barasa: Wabiro manyo omwom kamoro machielo ka Amerka ogolo ou

English: The Church in Kenya, in response to government advice, has put worship on hold to help prevent the spread of COVID-19. We urge you sisters & brothers to become a different sort of church & take everyday preventive steps to wash your hands frequently & stay home. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Kanisa nchini Kenya, kwa kuitikia ushauri wa serikali, limesimamisha ibada ili kusaidia kuzuia kuenea kwa COVID-19. Tunawasihi nyinyi akina dada na ndugu kuwa aina tofauti ya kanisa na kuchukua hatua za kila siku za kuzuia kunawa mikono mara kwa mara na kukaa nyumbani. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Kaniisadda Kenya, iyadoo ka jawaabaysa talada dowladda, ayaa joojisay cibaadada si looga hortago faafitaanka COVID-19. Waxaan idinku boorrinaynaa walaalaha iyo walaalaha inaad noqotaan nooc ka duwan kaniisaddiina oo aad qaadataan tallaabooyin ka hortag ah maalin kasta si aad gacmahaaga u dhaqdaan si joogto ah oo aad guriga joogtaan. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Kanisa ma piny Kenya, kaka duoko paro mar sirikal, oketo lamo e thuolo mar konyo geng'o chilo mar COVID-19. Wakwayo un nyimine & owete mondo ubed kanisa mopogore & ukaw okang' mar geng'o tuwo pile ka pile mondo ulos lweteu kinde ka kinde & ubed e ot. #KomeshaKorona

Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itafungua kituo cha kukusanya mahindi katika Kaunti ya Kajiado Julai hii.

Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa za kuponda ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.

Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa soo qabanqaabisay olole ballaaran oo loogu talagalay ka hortagga malaria kadib markii WHO ay ogaatay culeyska sii kordhaya ee malaria sababtoo ah heerkulka sareeya

Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika wakati wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua inay ka fogaadaan in ay ka gudbaan buundooyinka iyo wabiyada daadadka ku dhacay xilligan shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogweng' Nyandarua County mondo kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o e kinde masiche mag ndara.

Kiswahili: IPOA inawataka madereva wa magari na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.

Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanapaswa kula lishe bora yenye madini ya chuma, protini, na vitamini ili kusaidia ukuaji wa fetasi na afya ya mama.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges anyone experiencing abuse in Nakuru County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Nakuru apeleke simu ya simu ya GBV 1195.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by SHA (Social Health Authority) will be held in Bomet County this July.

Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth maonge chudo ma olos gi SHA (Social Health Authority) ibiro tim e County mar Bomet e dwe mar Julai.

English: KMTC urges residents of Garissa County to apply for the bursary before the deadline to benefit from school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya kufaidika na mpango wa kulisha shule.

Dholuo: KMTC jiwo ji duto modak e gweng' mar Garissa mondo okonygi gi chenrono kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds residents of Kericho County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho in warbixinta degdegga ah ee xanta xoolaha ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Forest Service parone jogweng' mar Kericho County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo jamni konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: DPP warns residents of Migori County to prepare for possible road accidents this February.
Kiswahili: DPP anawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kujiandaa kwa ajali zinazoweza kutokea barabarani Februari hii.
Somali: DPP waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Migori inay u diyaar garoobaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: DPP osiemo jogweng' Migori County mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Februar.

English: KICD commits to increasing the availability of braille and large print textbooks for visually impaired learners.
Kiswahili: KICD inajitolea kuongeza upatikanaji wa maandishi ya braille na vitabu vikubwa vya mafunzo kwa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu wa kuona.
Somali: KICD waxay ka go'an tahay in la kordhiyo helitaanka buugaagta braille iyo buugaag waaweyn oo la daabacay ardayda aragti la'aanta leh.
Dholuo: KICD ochiwore mondo omed bedo gi buge mag somo e dho Braille kod buge madongo ma igoyo ne jopuonjre ma nigi tuoche mag neno.

English: Provide farm inputs, including certified drought-tolerant seeds, to farmers.

English: CDC launches an April awareness campaign on safe water storage across Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Aprili juu ya uhifadhi wa maji salama katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response advises residents of Kirinyaga County to wash hands with soap and clean water regularly to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kunawa mikono kwa sabuni na maji safi mara kwa mara ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.

English: TVET invites youth in Taita-Taveta County to enroll for tailoring and design training this May.
Kiswahili: TVET inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni Mei hii.
Somali: TVET waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Taita-Taveta inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka tailoring iyo naqshadeynta bisha May.
Dholuo: TVET gwelo rowere manie Taita-Taveta County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko e dwe mar Mei.

Dholuo: KNEC nyiso jopuonjre ma Kisumu County mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar tiegruok mar county mondo giyud buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok.
