Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linazindua kutoa huduma katika wilaya katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa bilaabay bixinta adeegyada heerka degmada ee gobolka Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Jaloch ochako chiwo kony e alwora mar Nyandarua County.

English: KNEC reminds youth in Makueni County that HELB funding is available for electrical installation training.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme.
Somali: KNEC waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Makueni in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada.
Dholuo: KNEC oparo ne rowere man Makueni County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar loso sitima.

English: State Department for TVET calls on the community in Machakos County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Machakos inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116 si ay u ilaaliyaan amniga dugsiyada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar State for TVET kwayo ji duto e county mar Machakos mondo omany namba 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Through improvements to their surveillance systems, both countries are now generating more detailed information to guide treatment decisions, strengthen public health action and help protect the effectiveness of life-saving medicines.
Kiswahili: Kupitia maboresho ya mifumo yao ya uchunguzi, nchi zote mbili sasa zinatoa maelezo ya kina zaidi ili kuongoza maamuzi ya matibabu, kuimarisha hatua za afya ya umma na kusaidia kulinda ufanisi wa dawa zinazookoa maisha.
Somali: Iyada oo loo marayo horumarin lagu sameeyay nidaamyadooda la socodka, labada waddanba hadda waxay soo saarayaan macluumaad faahfaahsan si ay u hagaan go'aannada daaweynta, u xoojiyaan ficillada caafimaadka dadweynaha iyo inay gacan ka geystaan ​​​​ilaalinta waxtarka daawooyinka badbaadinaya nolosha.
Dholuo: Kokalo kuom loso maber yore mag ng’iyo gik moko, pinje ariyogo sani loso weche mathoth ma nyalo konyogi ng’ado bura e wi thieth, jiwo chenro mar thieth mar oganda kendo konyo e rito ber mar yath ma nyalo reso ngima.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee Gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya oseyawo kamachielo mar e-Citizen registration e Homa Bay County.

English: NDMA urges motorists and pedestrians in Marsabit County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Marsabit inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha deegaanka si looga hortago dhacdooyinka abaarta la xiriira.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo derebe kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Marsabit mondo oluw chike mag wuotho ma jotelo mag gweng'no ogolo mondo gikwed masiche mag oro.

English: UoN study in Ruai Township demonstrates improved trust and citizen police collaboration after COP rollout
Kiswahili: Utafiti wa UN huko Ruai Township unaonyesha kuongezeka kwa uaminifu na ushirikiano wa polisi wa raia baada ya utekelezaji wa COP
Somali: Daraasadda UoN ee magaalada Ruai waxay muujineysaa kalsoonida iyo iskaashiga ciidamada booliska ee muwaadiniinta ka dib markii la hirgaliyay COP
Dholuo: Nonro mar UoN e taon mar Ruai nyiso dongruok mar genruok kod riwruok mar polis mar raia bang' tich mar COP

English: ODPP advises residents of Bomet County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: ODPP inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e- Citizen.
Somali: ODPP waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan diiwaangelinta e-citizen.
Dholuo: ODPP nyiso jogweng'o mag Bomet County mondo oketgi e intanet kokalo kuom websait mar e-Citizen sama gikwayo mondo gidonj e e - Citizen registration.

English: TSC calls on the community in Vihiga County to support inclusive learning environments to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: TSC inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kusaidia mazingira jumuishi ya kujifunzia ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: TSC waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Vihiga inay taageeraan jawiyada waxbarasho ee ka kooban si loo ilaaliyo nabadgelyada dugsiyada.
Dholuo: TSC okwayo ji duto manie County mar Vihiga mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag puonjruok ma oriwo ji duto mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Did you know? Your sleep quality directly affects your mental health! 1.Aim for 7-9 hours of restful sleep each night. 2. Avoid stimulants like caffeine or drugs before bedâ€” they disrupt your Zzz's! Prioritize your rest, recharge your mind, and wake up refreshed!
Kiswahili: Ulijua? Ubora wa usingizi wako huathiri moja kwa moja afya yako ya akili! 1. Lenga kulala kwa saa 7-9 kila usiku. 2. Epuka vichocheo kama vile kafeini au dawa za kulevya kabla ya kulala - vinavyovuruga hisia zako za Zzz! Zipe kipaumbele pumziko lako, chaji akili yako, na uamke ukiwa umeburudika!
Somali: Ma ogtahay? Tayada hurdadaadu waxay si toos ah u saamaysaa caafimaadkaaga maskaxda! 1. Ku dadaal 7-9 saacadood oo hurdo nasasho leh habeen kasta. 2. Ka fogow waxyaabaha kiciya sida kafeyn ama daroogooyinka ka hor intaadan seexan - waxay carqaladeeyaan Zzz-kaaga! Mudnaanta sii nasashadaada, maskaxdaada dib u nasi, oo soo kac adigoo firfircoon!
Dholuo: Be ing’eyo? Kido mar nindo ma ibedogo mulo ngimani mar paro! 1.Bed gi gombo mar nindo kuom seche 7-9 otieno ka otieno. 2. Weri gi gik ma kelo gombo kaka kafein kata yath ma mero ji kapok idonjo e nindoâ€” giketho Zzz mari!

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) calls on parents in Laikipia County to have children under five screened for cyclosporiasis during the June outreach.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuchunguzwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano kwa cyclosporiasis wakati wa ufikiaji wa Juni.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku baaqeysaa waalidiinta Gobolka Laikipia in carruurta ka yar shan sano la baaro cudurka cyclosporiasis intii lagu jiray bisha Juun.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) kwayo jonyuol e county mar Laikipia mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Jun kuom wach cyclosporiasis.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development announces distribution of free digital learning content to schools in Marsabit County this March.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inatangaza usambazaji wa maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Machi hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku dhawaaqay qaybinta waxyaabaha waxbarasho ee dijitaalka ah ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Marsabit bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag digital maonge chudo e skunde mag Marsabit County e dwe mar Mach.

English: Office of the Auditor-General warns public officers in Wajir County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Wajir dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee Gobolka Wajir inay musuqmaasuq ku sameeyaan xafiisyada dowladda.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Wajir ni kik giyud asoya e migepe ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Kenya | Hunger Crisis 2021-2022 - Appeal No: MDRKE049 - Operational Strategy (18 July 2021 to 31 July 2023)
Kiswahili: Kenya | Mgogoro wa Njaa 2021-2022 - Nambari ya Rufaa: MDRKE049 - Mkakati wa Uendeshaji (18 Julai 2021 hadi 31 Julai 2023)
Somali: Kenya | Dhibaatada Gaajada 2021-2022 - Lambarka Racfaanka: MDRKE049 - Istaraatiijiyadda Hawlgalka (18 Luulyo 2021 ilaa 31 Luulyo 2023)
Dholuo: Kenya | Pek mar Kech 2021-2022 - Namba mar Kwayo: MDRKE049 - Yore mag Tich (18 dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2021 nyaka 31 dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2023)

English: AFA warns rice farmers in Meru County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: AFA inawaonya wakulima wa mpunga katika Kaunti ya Meru juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: AFA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda bariiska ee degmada Meru faafitaanka cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: AFA chiwo siem ne jopur loso kodhi e County mar Meru kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kudai kutoa huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet inay dalbadaan adeegyo aan la bixin laaluush si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo odwar ni ji ochiw tije ma ok ochulo asoya mondo gikwed asoya e migepe mag sirkal.

English: KMTC urges residents of Bungoma County to register their children at the nearest public school to benefit from free day secondary education.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawataka wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu ili kufaidika na elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashada dhexe ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: KMTC jiwo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud somo mar sekondari maonge chudo.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges residents of Murang'a County to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers following a rise in reported typhoid cases.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa watu wa kujitolea wa afya ya jamii kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya matumbo vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay soo sheegaan kiisas kasta oo loo maleynayo inay u sheegaan mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada ka dib markii ay kordheen kiisaska la soo sheegay ee cudurka 'typhoid'.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo jogweng'o e County mar Murang'a mondo onyis joma ochiwore mar rito ngima mar oganda ni giparo ni gin gi tuwo mar typhoid.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya launches a theft prevention campaign in West Pokot County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Maamulka Isgaarsiinta Kenya wuxuu bilaabay olole ka hortagga tuugada Gobolka West Pokot bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chako kampen mar geng'o kuo e West Pokot County e dwe mar Januar.

English: USCRI calls for immediate action as refugees face man-made starvation crisis in Kenya
Kiswahili: USCRI inataka hatua za haraka zichukuliwe huku wakimbizi wakikabiliwa na janga la njaa linalosababishwa na binadamu nchini Kenya
Somali: USCRI waxay ku baaqday in si degdeg ah wax looga qabto qaxootiga oo wajahaya xaalad gaajo oo aad u daran oo ka jirta Kenya
Dholuo: USCRI dwaro ni otimre mapiyo kaka jolweny yudo pek mag kech ma dhano okelo e piny Kenya

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) warns public officers in Bomet County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Bomet dhidi ya rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Bomet inay musuqmaasuqa ka qaataan xafiisyada dowladda.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Bomet ni kik giyud asoya e sirkal.

English: Notice: Council of Governors launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Isiolo County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee Degmada Isiolo bishii Ogosto.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Jaloch chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Isiolo e dwe mar Agost.

English: KRA announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Makueni County.
Kiswahili: KRA inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kuajiri kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Makueni.
Somali: KRA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay ka shaqeynta shahaadada dhalashada ee degmada Makueni.
Dholuo: KRA olando lokruok e seche mag timo nonro mag nyasi mag nyuol e gweng' mar Makueni.

English: IEBC reminds needy students in Mandera County that scholarships for needy students applications close soon.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji yatafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan Degmada Mandera in deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay codsiyada ardayda baahan ay dhowaan soo gabagabeynayaan.
Dholuo: IEBC paronwa jopuonjre ma nigi chan e County mar Mandera ni tuke mag somo ne jopuonjre man gi chan biro rumo machiegni.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada ee degmada Meru.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Auditor General biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e county mar Meru.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Samburu County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Samburu inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan bixinta adeegyada heerka qaybta.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' Samburu County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono ka gitiyo gi websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche ma timore e wi tij lendo.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages mothers in Kirinyaga County to visit their nearest maternity wing to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kutembelea mrengo wao wa karibu wa uzazi ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kirinyaga inay booqdaan garabka hooyada ee ugu dhow si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo mine manie County mar Kirinyaga mondo olim kama giwuokie machiegni mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Huduma Kenya urges eligible citizens in Tharaka-Nithi County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya ojiwo jokanyo mag Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oriwre e ndiko jogo madwaro yiero.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds schools in Nyeri County to strengthen school infrastructure safety this August.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kuimarisha usalama wa miundombinu ya shule Agosti hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xusuusinaya dugsiyada degmada Nyeri inay xoojiyaan ammaanka kaabayaasha dugsiga bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne skunde man Nyeri County mondo omed jiwo ritruok mar chenro mag skul e dwe mar Agost.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges residents of Taita-Taveta County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta kudai kutoa huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa fedha za umma.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay dalbadaan adeeg bixinta iyaga oo aan bixin laaluush si looga hortago xadgudubka lacagaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo jogweng'o mag Taita-Taveta County mondo okonygi ka ok gichiwo asoya mondo gikwed ketho pesa mag sirkal.

English: ASAL Humanitarian Network MPCT New Beneficiaries Endline Assessment, Turkana County, March 2022
Kiswahili: Tathmini ya Mwisho ya Mtandao wa Kibinadamu wa ASAL MPCT Wafaidika Wapya, Kaunti ya Turkana, Machi 2022
Somali: Qiimaynta Dhammaadka Ka-faa'iideystayaasha Cusub ee Shabakadda Bani'aadamnimada ee ASAL MPCT, Degmada Turkana, Maarso 2022
Dholuo: ASAL Riwruok mar Jokony Dhano MPCT Rang'iny mogik mar jogo mabiro yudo ber manyien, gweng' mar Turkana, dwe mar adek higa mar 2022

English: Our researches @KEMRI_Kenya are involved in research to find a vaccine for COVID-19; President Uhuru Kenyatta. #KomeshaCorona update
Kiswahili: Tafiti zetu @KEMRI_Kenya zinahusika katika utafiti wa kupata chanjo ya COVID-19; Rais Uhuru Kenyatta. #KomeshaCorona sasisho
Somali: Cilmi-baarisyada @KEMRI_Kenya waxay ku lug leeyihiin cilmi-baaris lagu raadinayo tallaal loogu talagalay COVID-19; Madaxweyne Uhuru Kenyatta. #KomeshaCorona update
Dholuo: Nonro magwa @KEMRI_Kenya odonjore e nonro mar manyo yath mar chanjo mar COVID-19; Jatend pinyno Uhuru Kenyata. #KomeshaKorona ma manyien

English: Wajir County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Wajir: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2022
Somali: Degmada Wajeer: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Wajir: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar adek higa mar 2022

English: Office of the Auditor-General announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kurudi kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la hagaajiyay waqtiga wareejinta ee adeegyada baasaboorka ee degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General olando lokruok e seche mag tiyo gi passport e county mar Baringo.

English: Office of the Auditor-General warns public officers in Murang'a County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Murang'a inay musuqmaasuqa ka qaataan xafiisyada dowladda.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e county mar Murang'a ni kik giyud asoya e migepe mar sirkal.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the community in Nyamira County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb burglary.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa ku boorinaya bulshada degmada Nyamira inay ka warbixiyaan waxqabadka shakiga ah xarunta booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations ojiwo ji duto manie County mar Nyamira mondo onyis polis ma machiegni gi kanyo ni gitimo gimoro marach mondo kik jokuoge odonj e odno.

English: COMESA announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for sheep in Mandera County this August.
Kiswahili: COMESA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Mandera Agosti hii.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ka dhan ah qabyaaladda lo'da ee Gobolka Mandera bishii Ogosto.
Dholuo: COMESA olando chenro mar goyo rombe thieth mar rabies maonge chudo e dwe mar Agost e kaunti mar Mandera.

English: Circularity in Dadaab - Rapid Assessment (June 2023)
Kiswahili: Mzunguko katika Dadaab - Tathmini ya Haraka (Juni 2023)
Somali: Wareegga Dhadhaab - Qiimeyn Degdeg ah (Juun 2023)
Dholuo: Luoro mar Dadaab - Pim mapiyo (Adweche 2023)

English: Dairy cows should have access to quality feed and water for at least 22 hours per day, and require 12 to 14 hours of daily rest where they lie down.
Kiswahili: Ng'ombe wa maziwa wanapaswa kupata malisho bora na maji kwa angalau masaa 22 kwa siku, na wanahitaji masaa 12 hadi 14 ya kupumzika kila siku ambapo wanalala.
Somali: Lo'da caanaha waa inay helaan cunto iyo biyo tayo leh ugu yaraan 22 saacadood maalintii, waxayna u baahan yihiin 12 ilaa 14 saacadood oo nasasho maalin kasta halkaas oo ay jiifaan.
Dholuo: Rombe ma nigi pi onego obed gi chiemo kod pi mabeyo kuom seche 22 odiechieng' kodiechieng', kendo nyaka gibed gi yueyo kuom seche 12 nyaka 14 odiechieng' kodiechieng' ka gin e nindo.

English: NPS urges the community in West Pokot County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb theft.
Kiswahili: NPS inahimiza jamii katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada gobolka West Pokot inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo oganda man West Pokot County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polis mar oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o kuo.

English: CDC launches a November awareness campaign on diabetes screening across Kwale County.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Novemba juu ya uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: CDC waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii November oo ku saabsan baaritaanka sonkorowga ee Gobolka Kwale.
Dholuo: CDC chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Novemba e wi nonro mar thieth mar sukari e alwora mar Kwale County.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service conducts a community briefing on community early-warning systems in Trans Nzoia County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inafanya mkutano wa jamii juu ya mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema ya jamii katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu qabtaa warbixin bulsho ku saabsan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada ee degmada Trans Nzoia bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Forest Service timo romo mar oganda e wi chenro mag chiwo siem motelo e alwora mar Trans Nzoia County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: NDMA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Laikipia County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: NDMA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Laikipia piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.

Dholuo: NDMA ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo timbe maricho e County mar Laikipia mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195 maonge chudo.

English: NDMA alerts residents of Tana River County to a rise in theft cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: NDMA waxay uga digtay dadka deggan degmada Tana River in ay kordheen kiisaska tuugada waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: NDMA chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar Tana River County kuom wach medruok mar kwan mag jokuoge kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: Notice: Council of Governors opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana linafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa usajili wa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.

Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Jaloch ochako tiyo gi ofis manyien mar e-Citizen Registration e County mar Kiambu.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public in Kitui County about the importance of safe water storage for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuhusu umuhimu wa uhifadhi wa maji salama kwa ustawi wa kaya.

English: World Trade Organisation (WTO) is one of the organisations important to Kenya in discussing markets availability through quality commercialization..
Kiswahili: Shirika la Biashara Duniani (WTO) ni mojawapo ya mashirika muhimu kwa Kenya katika kujadili upatikanaji wa masoko kupitia mauzo ya ubora.
Somali: Ururka Ganacsiga Adduunka (WTO) waa mid ka mid ah ururada muhiimka u ah Kenya ee ka hadlaya helitaanka suuqyada iyada oo loo marayo ganacsiga tayada leh.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar World Trade Organization (WTO) en achiel kuom riwruoge madongo e piny Kenya e wuoyo kuom bedo gi ohala e pinyno kokalo kuom chulo ohala.

English: KEMRI urges residents of Kericho County to complete the full recommended vaccination dose following a rise in reported cholera cases.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kukamilisha dozi kamili ya chanjo iliyopendekezwa kufuatia kuongezeka kwa visa vya kipindupindu vilivyoripotiwa.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka oo dhan ee lagugula talinayo ka dib kororka kiisaska cudurka kolera ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo jogweng' Kericho County mondo ochop e okang' moromo mar thieth ma gichiwo bang' medruok mar tuoche mar cholera.

English: KRA reminds voters in Kitui County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Kitui kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Kitui inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor inta aan la samayn nidaamyada codbixinnada.
Dholuo: KRA parone jogweng'o mag Kitui County mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero ka pok oyud thuolo mar timo yiero.

English: KEMSA reminds expectant mothers in Kitui County that access to free antenatal care is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba upatikanaji wa huduma ya ujauzito bila malipo ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Kitui in helitaanka daryeelka uurka ka hor ee bilaashka ah ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa mine ma biro nyuolo e gweng' mar Kitui ni thuolo mar yudo rit ma onge chudo mar nyuol en maonge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: KNEC advises students in Samburu County to register early to secure allocation to access school laptops under the digital literacy programme.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Samburu kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali.
Somali: KNEC waxay ardayda degmada Samburu kula talineysaa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan waqti hore si ay u helaan kaalmo ay ku helaan kombiyuutarada iskuulka ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jopuonjre e county mar Samburu mondo odonj e tiegruok chon mondo giyud pesa mar tiyo gi kompyuta mag skul kaluwore gi chenro mar somo gi somo mar digital.

English: Notice: IPOA launches a burglary prevention campaign in Turkana County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Turkana Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: IPOA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga jabsashada gobolka Turkana bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA chako kampen mar geng'o jomecho e taon mar Turkana e dwe mar ochiko.

English: HELB conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Laikipia County this July.
Kiswahili: HELB inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Julai hii.
Somali: HELB waxay bishii Luulyo ku qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan wareejinta degmada Laikipia.
Dholuo: HELB dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda e dwe mar Julai e kaunti mar Laikipia.

English: The Ministry of Health has launched a marathon on HIV AIDS in the month on 1 of December, aimed eliminating the disease by 2030
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya imezindua mbio za marathon kuhusu UKIMWI mwezi Desemba 1, zenye lengo la kutokomeza ugonjwa huo ifikapo mwaka 2030.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa billowday tartan marathon ah oo ku saabsan HIV AIDS bisha 1-da Diseembar, kaas oo looga gol leeyahay in lagu ciribtiro cudurka marka la gaaro 2030.
Dholuo: Od tich mar thieth osechako ng’wech mar ng’ado bura kuom tuo mar HIV AIDS e dwe mar apar gi ariyo, ma gino mar tieko tuo mar HIV nyaka higa mar 2030

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will open a milk collection centre in Nyamira County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itafungua kituo cha kukusanya maziwa katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu bilaabi doonaa xarun lagu soo uruuriyo caanaha ee degmada Nyamira bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro yawo kama ichokoe chak e kaunti mar Nyamira e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: State Department for TVET announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta bilaashka ah ee waxbarashada hoose ee dugsiyada degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar State for TVET olando tarik mag somo ma onge chudo e skunde mag Kisumu County.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development reminds citizens in Lamu County about their rights regarding constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuhusu haki zao kuhusu haki za kikatiba.

Kiswahili: SHA inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kaunti ya Nandi kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.

Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia ulaghai katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga khiyaamooyinka degmada Vihiga bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Rapar: DCI chako kampen mar geng'o wuondruok e County mar Vihiga e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice: IPOA launches a cattle rustling prevention campaign in Mandera County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Mandera Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga xanta xoolaha ee Gobolka Mandera bishii Maarso.

Kiswahili: OGP anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba mchango kwenye vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo unakaribishwa Mei hii.
Somali: OGP waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nyandarua in talooyinka ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha May.
Dholuo: OGP oparo ne ji duto e County mar Nyandarua ni ji mor ahinya gi weche ma gichiwo e wi chenro mag dongruok e dwe mar Mei.

English: KALRO warns millet farmers in Turkana County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaonya wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Turkana dhidi ya maambukizi ya wadudu na kupendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: KALRO waxay uga digtay beeraleyda xashiishadda ee degmada Turkana cudurrada cayayaanka, waxayna ku talineysaa in si sax ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: KALRO chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho adundo e County mar Turkana kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: KSh?26 billion in support to boost CBC infrastructure transition.
Kiswahili: KSh? bilioni 26 kwa msaada wa kuongeza mabadiliko ya miundombinu ya CBC.

Dholuo: KSh? bilionde 26 mag kony mar jiwo lokruok e chenro mag chenro mag CBC.

English: KRA urges residents of Nyeri County to attend the county assembly public session to stay informed on county development projects.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay ka qeyb galaan kalfadhiga dadweynaha ee shirka degmada si ay uga warqabaan mashaariicda horumarinta degmada.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo jogweng' Nyeri County mondo odhi e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo omed ng'eyo weche momedore e wi dongruok mag county.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges eligible citizens in Migori County to participate in voter education.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawasihi wananchi wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Migori kushiriki katika elimu ya wapiga kura.

Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro e county mar Migori mondo oriwre e tiegruok mar josiasa.

English: Council of Governors reminds the public in Migori County that input on the county budget process is welcome this March.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linawakumbusha raia wa Wilaya ya Migori kwamba mchango katika mchakato wa bajeti ya wilaya unakaribishwa Machi hii.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa xasuusinaya shacabka degmada Migori in talooyinka ku saabsan habka miisaaniyadda degmada ay soo dhaweynayaan bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch oparo ne ji duto e county mar Migori ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e dwe mar Mach.

Kiswahili: KTDA inawataka wafugaji wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuepuka kuhamisha mifugo katika mipaka ya kaunti bila kibali kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa Newcastle vilivyoripotiwa.

English: Notice: Kenya Forest Service activates an emergency response plan for flooding in Narok County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inaamsha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa mafuriko katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu hirgeliyaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ku saabsan fatahaadaha Gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Forest Service chako tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne pi e gweng' mar Narok.

English: KICD calls on the community in Mandera County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KICD inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: KICD waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Mandera inay u soo sheegaan arrimaha amniga maamulka dugsiga si loo ilaaliyo amniga dugsiyada.
Dholuo: KICD dwaro ni oganda man Mandera County ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar skul kuom weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: NTSA calls on the community in Tharaka-Nithi County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaalika jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kupiga simu ya simu ya GBV ya bure 1195.
Somali: NTSA waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wici doonaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: NTSA okwayo ji duto manie Tharaka-Nithi County mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong simo mar GBV 1195.

English: Children aged 1-5 needs to be dewormed after every 6 months to prevent transmission, frequent hunger and deformed growth
Kiswahili: Watoto wenye umri wa miaka 1-5 wanahitaji kusafishwa minyoo kila baada ya miezi 6 ili kuzuia maambukizi, njaa ya mara kwa mara na ukuaji wa ulemavu
Somali: Carruurta da'doodu tahay 1-5 sano waxay u baahan yihiin in 6dii biloodba mar la daaweeyo si looga hortago gudbinta, gaajada joogtada ah iyo koritaanka qaldan
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma johigni 1 nyaka 5 nyaka bed gi thieth mar golo tuoche bang ' dweche 6 ka dwe mondo gitang' gi tuwono, kech mapile, kod dongo marach

Kiswahili: Msongo wa mawazo ni ugonjwa wa kawaida wa akili na mojawapo ya sababu kuu za ulemavu duniani kote. WHO inakadiria kuwa duniani kote watu milioni 264 wameathiriwa na msongo wa mawazo.
Somali: Dhibaatadu waa cudur maskaxeed oo caadi ah oo ah mid ka mid ah sababaha ugu waaweyn ee naafonimada adduunka.
Dholuo: Tuo mar depression en tuwo masiko e pach ji kendo en achiel kuom gik madongo mamiyo ji bedo gi midekre e piny mangima. Riwruok mar WHO wacho ni ji milion 264 e piny ngima nigi tuwo mar parruok.

English: Notice: IPOA launches a cattle rustling prevention campaign in Kwale County this December.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Laikipia County about the importance of hand hygiene for household wellbeing.

Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay dadka degmada Laikipia ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda nadaafadda gacmaha ay u leedahay caafimaadka qoyska.

Dholuo: Department of State for TVET ojiwo rowere e County mar Laikipia mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto gikwongo tiyogo ka pok gichako timo tije mag sirkal.

English: NTSA alerts residents of Uasin Gishu County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka kwa kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: NTSA waxay dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu uga digtay kororka kiisaska jabsashada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka warbixiyaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Uasin Gishu County kuom wach kwan mar joma odonjo e ot kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne polis man machiegni.

English: Office of the Auditor-General reminds the public in Narok County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mkurugenzi-Mchunguzi Mkuu anakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Narok kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu dadka ku xasuustaa gobolka Narok in warbixinta xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General paronwa ji duto e Narok County ni lando wach tiyo marach gi migawo en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: DCI urges the public in Baringo County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: DCI inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha degmada Baringo inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada lacagta mobilada.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo ji duto e County mar Baringo mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma osefweny kuom wuond mag pesa mitimo gi simo.

English: Notice: IPOA conducts a community briefing on community early-warning systems in Trans Nzoia County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada oo ku saabsan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada ee degmada Trans Nzoia bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA timo romo mar chiwo siem ne oganda e wi chenro mag chiwo siem chon e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia e dwe mar Mei.

English: Public notice: Kenya Red Cross will host a free tobacco control outreach in Makueni County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa kudhibiti tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Makueni Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa qaban doonta dadaal lacag la'aan ah oo ka dhan ah ka hortagga sigaarka ee Gobolka Makueni bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova mar Kenya Red Cross biro timo kampen mar tieko madho ndawa maonge chudo e kaunti mar Makueni e dwe mar Januar.

English: NPS urges motorists and pedestrians in Garissa County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NPS inawahimiza madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa gawaarida wadayaasha iyo dadka lugta leh ee degmada Garissa inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay adeegsadaan meelaha lugta loo qoondeeyey si looga hortago dhacdooyinka abaarta la xiriira.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo jorit mtokni kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Garissa mondo oluw tong' mar wuoth kendo giti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe mondo gikwed masiche motudore gi oro.

English: The government target 7.4 million children under 5 years with polio vaccination expected to be conducted strateing from Wednesday
Kiswahili: Serikali inalenga watoto milioni 7.4 chini ya miaka 5 na chanjo ya polio inatarajiwa kufanyika kuanzia Jumatano
Somali: Dowladda waxay bartilmaameedsaneysaa 7.4 milyan oo caruur ah oo da'doodu ka yar tahay 5 sano in la sameeyo tallaalka polio laga bilaabo Arbacada
Dholuo: Sirkal dwaro ni nyithindo milion 7.4 ma hikgi tin ne 5 ma nigi tuo mar polio oyud thieth kochakore chieng ' Tich Adek

English: Ministry of Education advises students in Wajir County to collect materials from the county education office to access revision guides.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Wajir kukusanya vifaa kutoka ofisi ya elimu ya kaunti ili kupata miongozo ya marekebisho.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ardayda degmada Wajir kula talineysaa inay ka soo ururiyaan agabyada xafiiska waxbarashada degmada si ay u helaan tilmaamaha dib u eegista.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jopuonjre e gweng' mar Wajir mondo ochok gik moko e ofis mar tiegruok mar gweng'no mondo giyud weche ma nyalo konyogi ng'eyo weche momedore.

English: Notice from KEMRI: family planning counselling clinics will run every October at designated health centres in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka KEMRI: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Oktoba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid KEMRI: Caafimaadka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska waxaa lagu qaban doonaa Oktoobar kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMRI: Klinike mag chiwo paro e wi chenro mag ngima joot biro tiyo dwe mar Oktoba higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e Kaunti mar Kakamega.

English: AFA advises farmers in Nyamira County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: AFA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: AFA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyamira inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qaybqaataan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e County mar Nyamira mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

Kiswahili: Hatua muhimu za #KomeshaCorona Osha maji yako na yanayotiririka Safisha mikono yetu Angalia umbali wa mwili Epuka mikusanyiko ya watu" @GavanaKahiga @Magavana wa Kenya @County19Nyeri

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations urges the community in Kakamega County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb theft.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia wizi.
Somali: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada ayaa ku boorinaya bulshada Gobolka Kakamega inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo tuugada.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations ojiwo oganda man Kakamega County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o kuo.

English: Samburu County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for February 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Samburu: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Februari 2023
Somali: Degmada Samburu: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Febraayo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Samburu: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2023

English: IPOA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Nyeri County that access to post-violence medical care is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu zinapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Nyeri in helitaanka daryeelka caafimaad ee rabshadda ka dib ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e County mar Nyeri ni yudo kony mar thieth ma iyudo bang' timbe mag mahundu en gima ng'ato nyalo yudo maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service invites farmers in Kilifi County to a free training on greenhouse farming this December.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo cha chafu Desemba hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku casuumay beeraleyda Gobolka Kilifi tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service ogwelo jopur e gweng' mar Kilifi e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar greenhouse agriculture e dwe mar Desemba.

English: KNEC urges residents of Laikipia County to register their children at the nearest public school to benefit from school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu ili kufaidika na mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha si ay uga faa'iideystaan barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo ji duto modak e county mar Laikipia mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni kodgi mondo giyud kony kuom chenro mar chiemo e skul.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Kwale County starting this December.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kuanzia Desemba hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa in dadka deggan degmada Kwale ay la socdaan dialysis deeqsinimo ah laga bilaabo bisha Diseembar ee sannadkan.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo lando ni dhialisi mar ji duto modak e County mar Kwale biro chakore e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Kenya confirms 12 more COVID-19 cases bringing total number to 246. Health CS Mutahi Kagwe says 5 of them are hotel workers.
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha visa 12 zaidi vya COVID-19 na kufanya jumla ya idadi kufikia 246. Waziri wa Afya Mutahi Kagwe anasema 5 kati yao ni wafanyakazi wa hoteli.
Somali: Kenya ayaa xaqiijisay 12 kiis oo kale oo COVID-19 ah, taasoo wadarta tirada ay gaartay 246. CS Caafimaadka Mutahi Kagwe ayaa sheegay in 5 ka mid ah ay yihiin shaqaale hoteel ah.
Dholuo: Kenya osenyiso ni nitie ji 12 mamoko ma nigi tuo mar COVID-19 kendo kwan mar jogo osedok 246. Jatend weche thieth miluongo ni Mutahi Kagwe wacho ni ji 5 kuomgi gin joma tiyo e otel.

English: Sensitize farmers on post-harvest management of stored cereals and pulses, and support them with hermetic storage bags.
Kiswahili: Wahamasishe wakulima juu ya usimamizi wa baada ya mavuno ya nafaka na kunde, na uwasaidie kwa mifuko ya kuhifadhi hermetic.
Somali: Beeraleyda si loo ogaado maareynta ka dib goosashada ee hadhuudhka iyo bakhaarka la kaydiyay, kuna taageer bacaha kaydinta hermetic.
Dholuo: Jiwo jopur e wi kaka ginyalo rito cham kod cham ma ne okan bang' keyo, kendo konyogi gi bags mag kano cham.

English: Horn of Africa: IFRC Secretary General visits Kenya as worst drought in 40 years looms for millions
Kiswahili: Pembe ya Afrika: Katibu Mkuu wa IFRC azuru Kenya huku ukame mbaya zaidi kuwahi kutokea katika kipindi cha miaka 40 unakaribia mamilioni ya watu
Somali: Geeska Afrika: Xoghayaha Guud ee IFRC oo booqday Kenya iyadoo abaartii ugu xumayd muddo 40 sano ah ay soo food saartay malaayiin qof
Dholuo: Tung’ mar Afrika: Jatend IFRC nodhi e piny Kenya ka oro marach moloyo kuom higni 40 biro ne ji milionde mang’eny

English: Ministry of Education reminds parents in Kisumu County that adult literacy classes registration is open this April.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba usajili wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima umefunguliwa Aprili hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Kisumu in diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ay furan tahay bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok oparo ne jonyuol e County mar Kisumu ni ikruok mar somo mar joma dongo osechakore e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: KMTC launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha katika shule kote Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay bilawday barnaamij adeegyo hagis iyo la-talin ah oo ku yaal dugsiyada degmada Nairobi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KMTC chako chenro mar tayo kendo chiwo paro e skunde duto mag Nairobi County.

English: NTSA reminds mobile money users in Machakos County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid identity theft.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Machakos inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado tuugada aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: NTSA paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e County ma Machakos mondo onyis ni giketo pachgi kuom kwayo ma gitimo kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo kik jokuoge okwal nyingegi.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Horumarinta Manhajka Kenya wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada iskuulada guud ahaan degmada Laikipia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development chako chenro mar rito nyithindo e skul e skunde duto mag Laikipia County.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will train farmers in Kakamega County on terracing this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kakamega juu ya ardhi Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu tababar siin doonaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kakamega oo ku saabsan dhulka lagu beero bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro tiego jopur e Kaunti mar Kakamega e wi terracing e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: State Department for Basic Education conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Laikipia County this April.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Aprili hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha gobolka Laikipia bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education otimo romo mar tiego ji e wi migawo mar ombudsman e County mar Laikipia e dwe mar April.

English: This publication explains examples agricultural reforms on climate smart agriculture (CSA) from across the world, describing how that program is implemented to address challenges...
Kiswahili: Chapisho hili linaelezea mifano ya mageuzi ya kilimo juu ya kilimo mahiri cha hali ya hewa (CSA) kutoka kote ulimwenguni, ikielezea jinsi mpango huo unavyotekelezwa kushughulikia changamoto...
Somali: Daabacaaddan waxay sharxaysaa tusaalooyin dib-u-habeyn beeraha ah oo ku saabsan cimilada caqliga leh (CSA) oo ka kala yimid adduunka oo dhan, iyadoo sharaxaysa sida barnaamijkaas loo hirgeliyo si loo xalliyo caqabadaha...
Dholuo: Gasedni lero ranyisi mag lokruok mag pur e weche mag pur e piny mangima, kendo lero kaka chenro mar purno itimo mondo okony e loyo pek...

English: DCI reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Wajir County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba upatikanaji wa maelekezo ya makazi salama unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee Gobolka Wajir in helitaanka tixraacyada magangelyo ammaan ah la heli karo lacag la'aan.
Dholuo: DCI paronwa jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Wajir ni thuolo mar yudo kuonde ma ginyalo dakie en gima onge chudo.

English: TVET advises applicants in Turkana County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: TVET inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: TVET waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Turkana inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: TVET nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Turkana ni mondo gidonj e tiegruok kapok ichopo e chokruok mabiro.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service promotes terracing among farmers in Embu County as part of the August climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inakuza uchungaji kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Agosti.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu dhiirrigeliyaa beeraleyda deegaanka Embu County sida qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Agoosto.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service jiwo terracing e kind jopur e county mar Embu kaka achiel kuom chenro mar Agost mar kedo gi lokruok e kit yamo.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya launches county development projects in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya wilaya katika Wilaya ya Kilifi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya ayaa bilaabay mashaariic horumarineed oo ka socda degmada Kilifi.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya chako timo dongruok e alwora mar Kilifi County.

English: Refugee employment halved between survey waves, falling from 13% to 7% in camps and from 50% to 37% in urban areas.
Kiswahili: Ajira kwa wakimbizi ilipungua kwa nusu kati ya mawimbi ya utafiti, ikishuka kutoka 13% hadi 7% katika kambi na kutoka 50% hadi 37% katika maeneo ya mijini.
Somali: Shaqada qaxootiga ayaa kala bar hoos u dhacday intii u dhaxaysay mowjadaha sahanka, iyadoo hoos uga dhacday 13% ilaa 7% xeryaha iyo 50% ilaa 37% magaalooyinka.
Dholuo: Tich mar jolweny ne odok piny gi nus e kind kinde ma ne otim nonro, kendo ne odok piny kowuok e 13% nyaka 7% e kambi kendo kowuok e 50% nyaka 37% e bombe.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Uasin Gishu County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuleta nambari yao ya usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Uasin Gishu inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qaybqaataan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo okel namba mar pimo jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: NTSA alerts residents of Machakos County to a rise in burglary cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Somali: NTSA waxay dadka deggan degmada Machakos uga digtay kororka kiisaska jabsashada waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan wadaagista faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne ji modak e County ma Machakos kuom wach kwan mar joma odonjo e ot kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Provide extension services and pesticides to support pest control and management for crops.
Kiswahili: Toa huduma za ugani na dawa za wadudu kusaidia udhibiti na usimamizi wa wadudu kwa mazao.
Somali: Bixinta adeegyada ballaarinta iyo cayayaanka si loo taageero xakameynta cayayaanka iyo maareynta dalagyada.
Dholuo: Chiw tije mag medo thieth kod tuoche makelo tuoche mondo okony e tieko kod rito yiende.

English: DPP calls on the community in West Pokot County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.

English: To control nematodes in tomatoes without chemicals, plant Red Sunhemp (2kg seed per lima) in the field 3-3.5 months before growing tomatoes - its roots release a chemical that repels nematodes. Remove or plough in the Sunhemp plants after harvesting their seed, then plant your tomatoes.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti nematodes katika nyanya bila kemikali, panda Red Sunhemp (mbegu ya kilo 2 kwa lima) shambani miezi 3-3.5 kabla ya kukua nyanya - mizizi yake hutoa kemikali ambayo hufukuza nematodes. Ondoa au lima kwenye mimea ya Sunhemp baada ya kuvuna mbegu zao, kisha panda nyanya zako.
Somali: Si loo xakameeyo nematodes ee yaanyada aan lahayn kiimikooyinka, ku beeri Red Sunhemp (2kg seed per lima) berrinka 3-3.5 bilood ka hor inta aan la beeriyo yaanyada - xididdadeeda waxay sii deynayaan kiimiko ka hortagayaaya nematodes.
Dholuo: Mondo omi inyal geng'o nematode e tomato maok nigi gik ma kelone chamo, pidie Red Sunhemp (kg 2 mag kodhi kuom lima) e puodho dweche 3 - 3.5 kapok ipidho tomato - tiendgi golo gima kelo chamo ma chango nematode.
