English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response calls on parents in Lamu County to have children under five screened for Rift Valley Fever during the January outreach.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuwafanya watoto chini ya miaka mitano wachunguzwe Homa ya Bonde la Ufa wakati wa mawasiliano ya Januari.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ugu baaqeysaa waalidiinta Gobolka Lamu in carruurta ka yar shan sano lagu baaro Cudurka Rift Valley inta lagu gudajiro bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche kwayo jonyuol e County mar Lamu mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma hikgi tin ne abich kuom tuwo mar Rift Valley Fever e dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Wajir County this February. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya utafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Wajir Februari hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay qabaneysaa madasha caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada ee Gobolka Wajir bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Red Cross biro timo chokruok mar paro ne rowere e taon mar Wajir e dwe mar Februar.

English: Special announcement on the plan to cultivate kitchen gardens to promote healthy eating in government primary schools in nairobi
Kiswahili: Tangazo la kipekee kuhusu mpango wa kukuza bustani za jikoni ili kukuza lishe yenye afya katika shule za msingi za serikali huko Nairobi
Somali: Ogeysiis gaar ah oo ku saabsan qorshaha lagu beerayo beeraha jikada si loo dhiirrigeliyo cunto caafimaad leh dugsiyada hoose ee dowladda ee Nairobi
Dholuo: Lando makende e wi chenro mar pidho puothe mag tedo mondo okony ji ochiem maber e skunde matindo mag sirkal man Nairobi

English: Kenya - Garissa County Logistics Preparedness Action Plan, September 2023
Kiswahili: Kenya - Mpango wa Utekelezaji wa Maandalizi ya Usafirishaji wa Kaunti ya Garissa, Septemba 2023
Somali: Qorshaha Hawlgalka Diyaargarowga Saadka ee Kenya - Degmada Garissa, Sebtembar 2023
Dholuo: Kenya - Chenro mar Timo mar Ikruok mar Chopo mwandu e Kaunti mar Garissa, dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2023

English: NDMA reminds mobile money users in Bomet County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Bomet wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee gobolka Bomet inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna si looga fogaado nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: NDMA paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e County mar Bomet ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo kik gitim chenro mag gwoko pesa mag miriambo.

English: Council of Governors reminds residents of Kajiado County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kajiado County kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Kajiado in helitaanka adeegyada baasaboorka ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch oparo ne jogweng' Kajiado County ni koro yot yudo passport kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development informs tea farmers in Busia County of new market linkage opportunities this August.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inafahamisha wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Busia juu ya fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Agosti hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa ku wargelisa beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Busia fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Ogosto.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development nyiso jopur mag chai e County mar Busia thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Agost.

English: Council of Governors invites residents of Kericho County to attend the public participation forum regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku martiqaadaan dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay ka soo qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan wadatashiyada siyaasadda guud.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch ogwelo jogweng' mar County mar Kericho mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenrono.

English: KALRO advises farmers in Bungoma County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Bungoma inay ka qeyb galaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah si ay uga qeybgalaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e County mar Bungoma mondo odhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur ka gin gi ID mar pinygi.

English: Notice: KEMRI will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Uasin Gishu County this July. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI itafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Julai hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay qabaneysaa madasha caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada ee gobolka Uasin Gishu bisha July.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMRI biro timo romo mar paro ne rowere e gweng' mar Uasin Gishu e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will open a coffee collection centre in Isiolo County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya itafungua kituo cha kukusanya kahawa katika Kaunti ya Isiolo Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ka furi doonaa xarun ururinta kafeega ee degmada Isiolo bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro yawo kambi mar choko chai e kaunti mar Isiolo e dwe mar Septemba.

English: NPS calls on the community in Uasin Gishu County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NPS inawatia moyo jamii katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka kwa nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Somali: NPS waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Uasin Gishu inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan oo ay taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: NPS okwayo ji duto e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo owuo marach kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gidwar kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: DCI warns residents of Narok County about a rise in identity theft and advises the public to verify requests through official channels before acting.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok juu ya kuongezeka kwa wizi wa kitambulisho na inashauri umma kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
Somali: DCI waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan gobolka Narok kororka xadgudubka aqoonsiga waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax falin.
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne jogweng' Narok County e wi medruok mar kuo mar kitgi kendo ojiwo ji mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro.

English: Notice: IPOA activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay shilalka waddooyinka ee gobolka Mombasa.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IPOA tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne masiche ma timore e nderni e County mar Mombasa.

English: As concerns rise over Mpox outbreak, the Ministry of Health has pledged to procure two million vaccines before the end of the year.
Kiswahili: Huku wasiwasi ukiongezeka kuhusu mlipuko wa Mpox, Wizara ya Afya imeahidi kupata chanjo milioni mbili kabla ya mwisho wa mwaka.
Somali: Iyada oo walaac ay sii kordhayaan cudurka Mpox, Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ballanqaaday inay soo iibsato laba milyan oo tallaal ka hor dhammaadka sanadka.
Dholuo: Kaka parruok medore e wi tuwono mar Mpox, Ministry of Health osesingore ni obiro nyiewo chan mar milion ariyo kapok higa orumo.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds expectant mothers in Makueni County that access to skilled birth attendance is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba upatikanaji wa mahudhurio ya uzazi wenye ujuzi ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Makueni in helitaanka daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfad leh ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone mine ma biro nyuolo nyithindo e gweng' mar Makueni ni thuolo mar yudo nyithindo ma nigi lony en maonge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: Register your group? Follow this guidelines and dynamics of registering a cooperative society.
Kiswahili: Kujiandikisha kikundi chako? Fuata miongozo hii na mienendo ya kujiandikisha ushirika.
Somali: Diiwaangelinta kooxdaada, raac tilmaamahan iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyada diiwaangelinta ururka iskaashiga.
Dholuo: Luw puonj koda chike ma yudore e ndikruok mar riwruok mar oganda.

English: Ministry of Health announces outpatient services for residents of Embu County starting this October.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatangaza huduma za wagonjwa wa nje kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuanzia Oktoba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ku dhawaaqday adeegyada bukaanka ka baxsan dadka deggan degmada Embu laga bilaabo Oktoobarkan.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health olando ni obiro konyo jotuo e gwenge mag Embu County kochakore e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Baringo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Baringo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2022
Somali: Degmada Baringo: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Baringo: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar adek higa mar 2022

English: Amidst the worst drought crisis experienced in 40 years in Kenya, the need for GBV services is greater than ever, warns the IRC
Kiswahili: Huku kukiwa na mzozo mbaya zaidi wa ukame ulioshuhudiwa katika miaka 40 nchini Kenya, hitaji la huduma za GBV ni kubwa kuliko hapo awali, inaonya IRC.
Somali: Iyadoo ay jirto dhibaatadii ugu xumayd ee abaarta ee Kenya ka dhacday 40 sano, baahida loo qabo adeegyada GBV ayaa ka badan sidii hore, ayay ka digtay IRC
Dholuo: E kind masira marach moloyo mar oro ma oseyudore kuom higni 40 e piny Kenya, dwaro mar yudo kony mar GBV en maduong’ moloyo kinde mokalo, IRC onyiso ni .

English: ODPP reminds residents of Garissa County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kwamba upatikanaji wa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Garissa in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: ODPP parone jogweng' mar County mar Garissa ni koro yot yudo weche mag loso nyasi mar nyuol kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Kenya Medical Association announces outpatient services for residents of Kisii County starting this December.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatangaza huduma za wagonjwa wa nje kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuanzia Desemba hii.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu ku dhawaaqay adeegyada bukaanka dibedda ee loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Kisii laga bilaabo Diseembar.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association ogolo chenro mar konyo jotuo ma odak e gweng' mar Kisii kochakore dwe mar Desemba.

English: Kenya: Floods - DREF Final Report (MDRKE056)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Mafuriko - Ripoti ya Mwisho ya DREF (MDRKE056)
Somali: Kenya: Daadad - Warbixinta kama dambaysta ah ee DREF (MDRKE056)
Dholuo: Kenya: Pi opong'o piny - Ripot mogik mar DREF (MDRKE056)

English: To control powdery mildew in okra without synthetic chemicals, pound 1.5kg of fresh neem leaves and soak in 16 litres of water for 24 hours, sieve, add 50g of soft soap as a sticker, then spray the whole plant, repeating after 2 weeks if symptoms persist. Stop spraying 10-14 days before harvest.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti ukungu wa unga kwenye bamia bila kemikali za syntetisk, pauni kilo 1.5 za majani safi ya mwarobaini na loweka kwenye lita 16 za maji kwa masaa 24, ungo, ongeza 50g ya sabuni laini kama kibandiko, kisha nyunyiza mmea mzima, ukirudia baada ya wiki 2 ikiwa dalili zitaendelea. Acha kunyunyizia siku 10-14 kabla ya kuvuna.
Somali: Si loo xakameeyo cawska budada ah ee okra oo aan lahayn kiimikooyin sintetik ah, 1.5 kg caleemo cusub oo neem ah oo lagu qoyo 16 litir oo biyo ah 24 saacadood, silig, ku dar 50 g oo saabuun jilicsan oo ah isku dhejiyaha, ka dibna buufi dhirta oo dhan, oo la soo celiyo 2 toddobaad kadib haddii calaamadaha sii socdaan. Jooji buufinta 10-14 maalmood ka hor goosashada.
Dholuo: Mondo omi oketh mol mol e okra maonge gik ma loso chwech, onego iti gi mogo ma romo kilo 1.5 mag neem manyien kendo imegi pi mar lita 16 kuom seche 24, imegi sabun ma romo gram 50 kaka adhesiv, kae to imegi yath duto, kae to imigi manyasi bang' jumbe 2 ka nyoso mana.

English: Rehabilitate degraded rangeland and manage invasive species through certified pasture seed provision, and manage livestock diseases and outbreaks such as FMD, CCPP, and PPR.
Kiswahili: Rekebisha mifugo iliyoharibika na kudhibiti spishi vamizi kupitia utoaji wa mbegu za malisho zilizoidhinishwa, na kudhibiti magonjwa ya mifugo na milipuko kama vile FMD, CCPP, na PPR.
Somali: Dib-u-habeyn dhul daaqsimeed oo burburay iyo maareynta noocyada duullaanka ah adigoo adeegsanaya abuurka daaqa ee shahaadaysan, iyo maareynta cudurrada xoolaha iyo faafitaanka sida FMD, CCPP, iyo PPR.
Dholuo: Tiego kuonde ma ji odakie kendo rito kit le ma ok nyal geng'o ngima e yor yiengni ma nigi ratiro, kendo rito tuoche kod tuoche mag jamni kaka FMD, CCPP, kod PPR.

English: Parents guide transition after KPSEA.
Kiswahili: Wazazi huongoza mabadiliko baada ya KPSEA.
Somali: Waalidiintu waa hagaha kala guurka ka dib KPSEA.
Dholuo: Jonyuol ema tayo ji mondo otim lokruok bang' KPSEA.

English: Notice: HELB announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: HELB yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Ogeysiis: HELB waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta dugsiyada dugsiga dhexe ee maalin bilaash ah ee degmada Nyamira.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: HELB ogolo chenro mar somo sekondari maonge chudo e skunde mag Nyamira County.

English: Notice: Council of Governors will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana litafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Wilaya ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha waxay qaban doonaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Jaloch biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e gweng' mar Taita-Taveta.

English: ODPP reminds the public in Vihiga County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Vihiga in sheegashada khiyaamooyinka iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: ODPP paronwa ji duto e County mar Vihiga ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag yuto en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima ok nyal geng'o.

English: COMESA warns millet farmers in Nakuru County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Nakuru juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: COMESA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda cawska ee degmada Nakuru cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: COMESA chiwo siem ne jopur mag millet e gweng' mar Nakuru kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ochiwo paro mar kawo okang' mapiyo.

English: KALRO reminds farmers in Samburu County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu juu ya programu inayoendelea ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa wakulima.
Somali: KALRO waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Samburu in barnaamijka tababarka beeralayda uu socdo.
Dholuo: KALRO oparo ne jopur manie county mar Samburu chenro mar tiego jopur ma dhi nyime.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds residents of Isiolo County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Isiolo kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan degmada Isiolo in ay ka qaybqaataan maamulaha qaybta deegaanka si ay u xoojiyaan maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone jogweng' kaunti mar Isiolo ni tudruok gi jarit mar ward margi jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Some foods can be harmful to young children. Observe signs and change foods for the child
Kiswahili: Chunguza ishara na mabadiliko ya chakula kwa ajili ya mtoto
Somali: Cuntooyinka qaarkood waxay waxyeelo u geysan karaan carruurta yaryar.
Dholuo: Ng'i ane gik ma nyathini nyalo chamo, kendo tim lokruok e kit chiemo mochiemo

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission launches a school infrastructure safety programme in schools across Homa Bay County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu yazindua mpango wa usalama wa miundombinu ya shule katika shule kote Kaunti ya Homa Bay.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij badbaado kaabayaasha dugsiga ee dugsiyada guud ahaan gobolka Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj chako chenro mar rito kuonde tiegruok mag skul e skunde duto mag Homa Bay County.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Bungoma County this July.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inazindua kampeni ya kupambana na ufisadi katika Kaunti ya Bungoma mwezi huu Julai.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu bilaabay olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhanka ah degmada Bungoma bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura mar Kenya chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e County mar Bungoma e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: KEMSA will hold a suicide prevention forum in Nairobi County this April. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMSA itafanya kongamano la kuzuia kujiua katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Aprili hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMSA waxay qabaneysaa madasha ka hortagga ismiidaaminta ee Gobolka Nairobi bishii Abriil. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni KEMSA biro timo chokruok mar geng'o ji kik donjre e dwe mar April e taon mar Nairobi.

English: Gender Dynamics in Pastoralist Livelihood Systems in Africa
Kiswahili: Mienendo ya Jinsia katika Mifumo ya Riziki ya Wafugaji Barani Afrika
Somali: Isbeddelka Jinsiga ee Nidaamyada Hab-nololeedka Xoolo-dhaqatada ee Afrika
Dholuo: Lokruok mar kido mar chuech e yore mag dak mag jokwath e Afrika

English: KMTC reminds youth in Siaya County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Siaya kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari.
Somali: KMTC waxay xasuusineysaa dhallinyarada degmada Siaya in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka farsamada gawaarida.
Dholuo: KMTC oparo ne rowere e county mar Siaya ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar mechanics mag mtokni.

English: IEBC invites youth in Kwale County to enroll for motor vehicle mechanics training this May.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kwale kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari Mei hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kwale inay iska diiwaangeliyaan tababarka mashiinka gawaarida gaadiidka bisha May.
Dholuo: IEBC gwelo rowere e Kaunti mar Kwale mondo odonj e tiegruok mar jomisonari mag mtokni e dwe mar Mei.

English: KICD reminds parents in Nyeri County that adult literacy classes registration is open this March.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kwamba usajili wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima umefunguliwa Machi hii.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Nyeri in diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ay furan tahay bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne jonyuol manie County mar Nyeri ni ikruok mar somo mar jomatindo osechakore e dwe mar Mach.

English: NCPB urges dairy cows farmers in Kajiado County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kuwachanja wanyama wao katika sehemu zilizotengwa kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Kajiado inay xoolahooda tallaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee anthrax.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur mag dhok mag chak e Kajiado County mondo ogeng'e legi e kuonde moketi mag chamo dhok bang' yudo weche mag tuoche mag anthrax.

English: East Africa's Women and Youth-led MSMEs in Agricultural Value-Chains: Factsheet 2024
Kiswahili: Wadau wa Ushirika na Wanawake na Vijana wa Afrika Mashariki katika Minyororo ya Thamani ya Kilimo: Karatasi ya ukweli 2024
Somali: Ganacsiyada yaryar ee ay hoggaamiyaan Haweenka iyo Dhalinyarada ee Bariga Afrika ee ku jira Silsiladaha Qiimaha Beeraha: Xaqiiqooyinka 2024
Dholuo: MSMEs ma otelo gi mon kod rowere mag Afrika ma Wuokchieng' e weche mag pur: Oboke mar adier 2024

English: KICD advises students in Kisii County to register early to secure allocation to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: KICD inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kisii kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata maudhui ya ujifunzaji wa kidijitali bila malipo.
Somali: KICD waxay kula talineysaa ardayda degmada Kisii inay isdiiwaangaliyaan si ay u helaan lacag la'aan ah oo barashada digital ah.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo jopuonjre e County mar Kisii mondo odonj e skundno chon mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo somo maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Gazette encourages first-time voters in Kitui County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: Kenya Gazette waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Kitui inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogo ma ne okwongo yiero e County mar Kitui mondo onon weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: State Department for TVET advises applicants in Narok County to apply for TVET placement through KUCCPS for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Narok kutuma maombi ya uwekaji wa TVET kupitia KUCCPS kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha Gobolka Narok inay dalbadaan booska TVET iyada oo loo marayo KUCCPS si ay u helaan gelitaanka soo socda.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET nyiso jogo madwaro yudo tiegruok e gweng' mar Narok mondo okonygi gi KUCCPS.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public in Kakamega County about the importance of hand hygiene for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuhusu umuhimu wa usafi wa mikono kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay dadka degmada Kakamega ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda nadaafadda gacmaha ay u leedahay caafimaadka qoyska.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji e Kaunti mar Kakamega gimomiyo rito lwetegi ler en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Notice: NPS activates an emergency response plan for landslides in Narok County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NPS inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika Kaunti ya Narok.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ku saabsan dhulgariirada gobolka Narok.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: NPS tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne yiengni mag lowo e kaunti mar Narok.

English: Notice: OGP will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada ee Degmada Mandera.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: OGP biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e county mar Mandera.

English: Notice: KTDA will distribute certified sweet potatoes seed to farmers in Taita-Taveta County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itasambaza mbegu za viazi vitamu zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay u qaybin doontaa abuurka baradho macaan oo shahaado leh beeraleyda Gobolka Taita-Taveta bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA biro pogo kodhi mag le mamit ne jopur manie Taita-Taveta County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: KUCCPS reminds parents in Laikipia County that free day secondary education registration is open this May.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kwamba usajili wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo umefunguliwa Mei hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Laikipia in diiwaangelinta dugsiga dhexe ee bilaashka ah ay furan tahay bisha May.
Dholuo: KUCCPS parone jonyuol e county mar Laikipia ni somo mar sekondari mar odiechieng' maonge chudo ochakore e dwe mar abich.

English: Taking over-the-counter or herbal medicines without a prescription during pregnancy can be dangerous.
Kiswahili: Kuchukua dawa za mitishamba au zilizoagizwa bila agizo la daktari wakati wa ujauzito kunaweza kuwa hatari.
Somali: Qaadashada daawooyinka la iibiyo ama dhirta aan la qori karin inta lagu jiro uurka waxay noqon kartaa mid khatar ah.
Dholuo: Ka ng'ato oting'o yedhe ma ok ochan e yor thieth kata mitiyogo kaka yedhe mamero, mano nyalo kelone hinyruok.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges dairy cows farmers in Kwale County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported foot and mouth disease cases.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawahimiza wafugaji wa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia visa vya ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda lo'da caanaha ah ee Gobolka Kwale inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow kadib kiisaska cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development ojiwo jopur mag dhok mag chak e county mar Kwale mondo ochiw ripot kuom le matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar dhok man machiegni kodgi bang' ka osenyis ni nitie tuoche mag dhoot.

English: KEMRI advises residents of Garissa County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa usaidizi wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMRI waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Garissa inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow si ay uga caawiyaan helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ee lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMRI nyiso jogweng' mar County mar Garissa mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni mondo giyud kony mar yudo kony kuom weche thieth.

English: United Nations and partners call for $472.6 million to respond in 2023 as the drought in Kenya deepens
Kiswahili: Umoja wa Mataifa na washirika watoa wito wa dola milioni 472.6 kujibu mwaka wa 2023 huku ukame ukizidi kuongezeka nchini Kenya.
Somali: Qaramada Midoobay iyo la-hawlgalayaasha ayaa ku baaqaya $472.6 milyan si wax looga qabto sanadka 2023-ka iyadoo abaarta ka jirta Kenya ay sii xoogaysanayso.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Pinje Motudore kod jowetene dwaro dola milion 472.6 mondo ochop e higa mar 2023 kaka oro medore e piny Kenya

English: Hormonal changes during pregnancy can affect oral health. Visit a dentist for check-ups and maintain oral hygiene.
Kiswahili: Mabadiliko ya homoni wakati wa ujauzito yanaweza kuathiri afya ya kinywa. Mtembelee daktari wa meno kwa uchunguzi na udumishe usafi wa kinywa.
Somali: Isbeddellada hoormoonka ee uurka ku jira waxay saameyn ku yeelan karaan caafimaadka afka.
Dholuo: Ka ng'ato nigi ich, nyalo bedo ni obedo gi tuwoche mag dhoge.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) invites residents of Marsabit County to attend the public participation forum regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Marsabit kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Guddiga Garsoorka Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inay ka qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) gwelo jogweng' mar Marsabit County mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi nonro mar tich mitimo higa ka higa.

English: Notice: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties launches the county integrated development plan in Busia County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa huzindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika wilaya ya Busia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed ayaa bilaabay qorshaha horumarinta gobolka ee gobolka Busia.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Jondiko mar Pinje mag Pulitika chako chenro mar dongruok mar county e county mar Busia.

English: AFA warns tea farmers in Trans Nzoia County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: AFA inawaonya wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: AFA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Trans Nzoia oo ku saabsan cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: AFA chiwo siem ne jopur ma loso chai e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Notice: DPP issues a cybersecurity alert on mobile money scams affecting residents of Turkana County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya kashfa za pesa za rununu zinazoathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: DPP ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity e wi timbe mag wuond mag pesa mitimo gi simo ma mulo joma odak e County mar Turkana.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on the community in Murang'a County to speak out against gender-based violence and call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawataka jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na piga simu ya simu ya GBV 1195.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Murang'a inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna wacayaan khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross okwayo ji duto manie County mar Murang'a mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo giluong simo mar GBV 1195.

English: Kenya Dairy Board advises farmers in Busia County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia kuleta nambari yao ya usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Busia inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qaybqaataan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board nyiso jopur e county mar Busia mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: OGP announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: OGP inatangaza nyakati bora za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Somali: OGP waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: OGP olando lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mag ng'eyo ng'ato e kaunti mar Isiolo.

Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa udhibiti wa tumbaku bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Migori Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu martigelin doonaa dadaal lacag la'aan ah oo ka dhan ah ka hortagga sigaarka ee Degmada Migori bishii Abriil.

Kiswahili: Kusitishwa kwa usafiri katika Eneo la Jiji la Nairobi, Mombasa na Mandera kwaongezwa kwa mwezi mmoja, baa zitaendelea kufungwa kwa siku 30 zaidi
Somali: Joojinta dhaqdhaqaaqa Magaalada Nairobi, Mombasa iyo Mandera oo muddo bil ah la kordhiyay, qolalka ayaa xiran doona 30 maalmood oo dheeraad ah

English: Notice: NTSA launches a burglary prevention campaign in Siaya County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NTSA yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Siaya Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga jabsashada gobolka Siaya bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NTSA chako kampen mar geng'o jomecho e taon mar Siaya e dwe mar Julai.

English: Pregnant women in their second trimester should receive deworming medication to improve nutrition and reduce complications.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito katika miezi mitatu yao ya pili ya ujauzito wanapaswa kupokea dawa za minyoo ili kuboresha lishe na kupunguza matatizo.
Somali: Haweenka uurka leh ee saddexda bilood ee labaad waa inay helaan daawooyinka ka hortagga cayayaanka si loo hagaajiyo nafaqada loona yareeyo dhibaatooyinka.

English: Weekly Bulletin on Outbreaks and other Emergencies: Week 24: 10 - 16 June 2024 (Data as reported by: 17:00; 16 June 2024)
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Kila Wiki kuhusu Milipuko na Dharura Nyingine: Wiki 24: 10 - 16 Juni 2024 (Data kama ilivyoripotiwa na: 17:00; 16 Juni 2024)
Somali: War-saxaafadeedka Todobaadlaha ah ee ku saabsan Cudurrada faafa iyo Xaaladaha kale ee Degdegga ah: Toddobaadka 24: 10 - 16 Juun 2024 (Xogta sida ay soo sheegtay: 17:00; 16 Juun 2024)
Dholuo: Oboke mar juma ka juma kuom tuoche ma nyalo pong’o piny kod gik mamoko ma nyalo timore mapiyo: Juma mar 24: 10 nyaka 16 dwe mar auchiel 2024 (Weche kaka ondiki gi: 17:00; 16 dwe mar auchiel 2024)

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will open a milk collection centre in Embu County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itafungua kituo cha kukusanya maziwa katika Kaunti ya Embu Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Wax soo saarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu bilaabi doonaa xarun lagu soo uruuriyo caano ee Gobolka Embu bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro yawo kar kano chak e taon mar Embu e dwe mar Januar.

English: KICD calls on the community in Baringo County to report any safety concerns to the school administration to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: KICD inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: KICD waxay ku baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Baringo inay ka warbixiyaan walaacyada amniga ee maamulka dugsiga si ay u ilaaliyaan amniga dugsiyada.
Dholuo: KICD dwaro ni oganda mar Baringo County ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar skul kuom weche duto motudore gi ritruok mar skul.

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette will hold a public participation forum on the county budget process in Tharaka-Nithi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya litafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Kenya Gazette waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan geedi socodka miisaaniyadda degmada ee Degmada Tharaka-Nithi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Gazette biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mar bajet mar county e county mar Tharaka-Nithi.

English: CDC to lauch a campaign to support hand washing as a measure to prevent spread of disease
Kiswahili: CDC kuanzisha kampeni ya kusaidia kuosha mikono kama hatua ya kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa
Somali: CDC waxay bilaabi doontaa olole lagu taageero dhaqashada gacmaha si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurka
Dholuo: CDC mondo ochak kampen mar riwo lwedo lwoko lwedo kaka okang ' mar geng'o landruok mar tuoche

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will be held in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ay qabanqaabisay qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada ayaa lagu qaban doonaa gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma biro timore e dwe mar Septemba ma biro e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit confirms a tuberculosis outbreak alert for Lamu County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa kifua kikuu kwa Kaunti ya Lamu. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa xaqiijisay feejignaanta cudurka hargabka ee gobolka Lamu. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osenyiso ni Lamu County osechako chiwo siem ne tuo mar tuberculosis.

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges residents of Makueni County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Makueni watumie portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ya kupambana na matumizi mabaya ya mamlaka.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Makueni inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago xadgudubka xilka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo jogweng' Makueni County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot e intanet e chiwo kwayo mar kedo gi timbe mag tiyo marach gi migepe.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service will distribute certified sorghum seed to farmers in Bomet County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bomet Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu abuuraha degmada Bomet u qaybin doonaa abuurka sorghum ee la caddeeyay bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service biro pogo kodhi mag sorghum ne jopur e County mar Bomet e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Isiolo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Isiolo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2023
Somali: Degmada Isiolo: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Isiolo: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2023

English: State Department for Basic Education invites youth in Nairobi County to enroll for electrical installation training this November.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Elimu ya Msingi inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji umeme Novemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku casuumaysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nairobi inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada bisha November.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education ogwelo rowere man Nairobi County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar keto sitima e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development urges farmers in Bungoma County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.

English: Office of the Auditor-General invites residents of Mandera County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding the county budget process.

English: OGP reminds voters in Baringo County to verify their details via SMS to 70000 ahead of voter education.

Dholuo: OGP parone jogweng' Baringo County ni mondo ging'e weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom SMS ne ji 70000 kapok giyudo tiegruok.

English: Council of Governors reminds residents of Busia County that access to national ID applications is now easier through official service channels.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya warns residents of Garissa County to prepare for possible landslides this September.

Somali: Xitaa in yar oo ilmaha lagu daydo sariirta ama miiska iyada oo aan la kormeerin waxay keeni kartaa hoos u dhac iyo dhaawac.
