English: If you fee unweel, have a cold, a cough or fever, please call 719 or text *719#
Kiswahili: Ikiwa unajisikia vibaya, una mafua, kikohozi au homa, tafadhali piga simu 719 au tuma ujumbe mfupi *719#
Somali: Haddii aad qabtid qabow, qandho ama harraad, fadlan wac 719 ama text *719#
Dholuo: Kapo ni in gi tuwo mar adundo, tuwo mar koyo, tuo mar dhoho, kata tuwono, tudri gi namba 719 kata ndiknegi simo *719#

English: TVET reminds needy students in Vihiga County that school laptops under the digital literacy programme applications close soon.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya maombi ya programu ya kusoma na kuandika ya kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Vihiga in laptop-yada dugsiga ee barnaamijka codsiyada akhriska dhijitaalka ah ay dhowaan xirayaan.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa jopuonjre man gi chandruok e County mar Vihiga ni kompyuta mag skul manie program mar somo gi somo mar digital biro rumo machiegni.

English: Kenya Red Cross calls on the community in Nandi County to speak out against gender-based violence and report cases to the nearest gender desk at a police station.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawaalika jamii katika Kaunti ya Nandi kusema dhidi ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia na kuripoti kesi kwenye ofisi ya karibu ya kijinsia katika kituo cha polisi.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Nandi inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan iyo inay kiisaska u soo sheegaan xafiiska jinsiga ee ugu dhow ee saldhiga booliska.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross okwayo ji duto manie county mar Nandi mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gichiw ripode ne ofis mar polise man machiegni.

English: Notice: KALRO restricts movement of goats in Tharaka-Nithi County due to a rabies outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO inazuia harakati za mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kwa sababu ya mlipuko wa kichaa cha mbwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa riyaha ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi sababtuna tahay faafitaanka cudurka rabshadaha.
Dholuo: Rapar: KALRO ogeng'o wuoth mar diek e Tharaka-Nithi County nikech tuo mar rabies.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development informs maize farmers in Murang'a County of new market linkage opportunities this April.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawafahamisha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Aprili hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku wargelineysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Murang'a fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development olero ne jopur mar kodhi e County mar Murang'a kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: AFA will distribute certified wheat seed to farmers in Kakamega County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: AFA itasambaza mbegu za ngano zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kakamega Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay abuurka sarreenka ee la caddeeyay u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kakamega bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: AFA biro pogo kodhi mag ngano ne jopur man Kakamega County e dwe mar Januar.

English: Goal-setting is subjective. It is important to create goals that make sense for you during your recovery journey. If you need assistance in creating realistic and achievable goals, reach out to your mentor, peer, or another mental health professional for guidance and tips
Kiswahili: Kuweka malengo ni jambo la kibinafsi. Ni muhimu kuunda malengo yanayokufaa wakati wa safari yako ya kupona. Ikiwa unahitaji usaidizi katika kuunda malengo halisi na yanayoweza kufikiwa, wasiliana na mshauri wako, mwenzako, au mtaalamu mwingine wa afya ya akili kwa mwongozo na vidokezo.
Somali: Hadafku waa mid madax banaan. Waa muhiim in la abuuro himilooyin macno leh inta lagu jiro safarkaaga soo kabashada. Haddii aad u baahan tahay caawimaad sameynta himilooyinka macquulka ah ee la gaari karo, la xiriir tababarahaaga, asxaabtaada ama xirfadle kale oo caafimaadka dhimirka ah si aad u hesho hagitaan iyo talooyin
Dholuo: Keto chenro en gima ng'ato owuon ema nyalo timo. Dwarore ahinya ni ichak keto chenro maber e ngimani. Kapo ni idwaro ni okonyi keto chenro ma inyalo chopo, inyalo kwayo japuonjni, osiepni moro, kata ng'at machielo molony e weche thieth mar paro mondo okonyi.

English: Teachers Service Commission urges parents and teachers in Kericho County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Kericho kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku boorinayaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Kericho inay u soo sheegaan mas'uuliyadda amniga dugsiga.
Dholuo: Kanyakla mar Teachers Service Commission jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e County mar Kericho mondo onyis sirkal mar skul wach moro amora motudore gi ritruok.

English: Notice: DPP issues a cybersecurity alert on phishing messages affecting residents of Migori County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya ujumbe wa udanganyifu unaowaathiri wakazi wa Wilaya ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay soo saartaa digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan fariimaha phishing ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Migori.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: DPP ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity kuom weche mag phishing makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' Migori County.

English: NPS urges the community in Nyamira County to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives to curb fraud.
Kiswahili: NPS inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi) ili kuzuia udanganyifu.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Nyamira inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi) si loo xakameeyo khiyaamooyinka.
Dholuo: NPS jiwo oganda manie County mar Nyamira mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi) mar geng'o mibadhi.

English: The Minstry of Health has appealed to all Kenyans to adhere to the opreventive measures to avoid MPOX infections, due to inceasing number of new infections, and put children at high infection rates
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya imetoa wito kwa Wakenya wote kufuata hatua za kuzuia maambukizi ya MPOX, kwa sababu ya kuongezeka kwa idadi ya maambukizo mapya, na kuwaweka watoto katika viwango vya juu vya kuambukizwa
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ugu baaqday dhammaan dadka Kenya inay u hoggaansamaan tallaabooyinka ka hortagga si looga fogaado cudurrada MPOX, sababtuna tahay tirada sii kordheysa ee caabuqyada cusub, iyo in carruurta la dhigo cudurro heer sare ah
Dholuo: Ministry of Health osekwayo jokanyo duto mag Kenya mondo oluw yore mag geng'o tuoche mag MPOX, nikech kwan mar tuoche manyien medore, kendo keto nyithindo e okang' mamalo mar yudo tuoche

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will distribute certified sorghum seed to farmers in Taita-Taveta County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay abuuraha ku nool gobolka Taita-Taveta u qaybin doontaa abuurka sorghum ee la caddeeyay bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro pogo kodhi mag sorghum ne jopur man Taita-Taveta County e dwe mar April.

English: Experts say that engineering genetics has a capacity to defer challenges in farming: preservation on..
Kiswahili: Wataalam wanasema kuwa genetics ya uhandisi ina uwezo wa kuahirisha changamoto katika kilimo: uhifadhi kwenye..
Somali: Khubaradu waxay sheegayaan in injineernimada hidde-sideyaasha ay awood u leedahay inay dib u dhigto caqabadaha beeraleyda: ilaalinta iyo..
Dholuo: Jotim nonro wacho ni weche mag nonro mag dhano nyalo miyo tij pur kik dhi nyime.

English: Character used in civic skits and materials
Kiswahili: Character kutumika katika skits na vifaa vya kiraia
Somali: Tilmaamaha loo isticmaalo naqshadaha iyo qalabka dadweynaha
Dholuo: Chal ma itiyogo e piche kod gik mamoko

English: Notice: TVET opens a new catering and hospitality programme at the vocational centre in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inafungua programu mpya ya upishi na ukarimu katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay ka furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan cuntada iyo marti-gelinta xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: TVET chako chenro manyien mar chiemo kod rwako welo e skul mar tiegruok e County mar Vihiga.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the community in Narok County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb carjacking.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Narok kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia utekaji nyara wa gari.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Narok inay ka warbixiyaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo shaki leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo afduubka gawaarida.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo oganda man Narok County mondo onyis polis ma ni machiegni gi kanyo ni gitimo gik ma chando mtokni.

English: AFA informs avocado farmers in Marsabit County of new market linkage opportunities this December.
Kiswahili: AFA inawafahamisha wakulima wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Desemba hii.
Somali: AFA waxay wargelineysaa beeraleyda avocado ee degmada Marsabit fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: AFA nyiso jopur mag avocado e county mar Marsabit e wi thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Desemba.

English: EHAGL Region: Community Feedback Analysis Report, January - March 2025
Kiswahili: Eneo la EHAGL: Ripoti ya Uchambuzi wa Maoni ya Jamii, Januari - Machi 2025
Somali: Gobolka EHAGL: Warbixinta Falanqaynta Jawaab celinta Bulshada, Janaayo - Maarso 2025
Dholuo: Kidieny mar EHAGL: Ripot mar Nonro Duoko mag Oganda, dwe mar achiel - dwe mar adek 2025

English: Garissa County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Garissa: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Garissa: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Garissa: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Septemba 2022

English: Notice: e-Citizen launches community-based development programmes in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: e-Citizen inazindua mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii katika Wilaya ya Kitui.
Somali: Ogeysiis: e-Citizen waxay bilawday barnaamijyo horumarineed oo ku salaysan bulshada ee Gobolka Kitui.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: e-Citizen chako chenro mag dongruok e alwora mar Kitui County.

English: Ministry of Education urges parents and teachers in Trans Nzoia County to report any safety concerns to the school administration.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawataka wazazi na walimu katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuripoti wasiwasi wowote wa usalama kwa uongozi wa shule.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku boorineysaa waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta degmada Trans Nzoia inay u soo sheegaan maamulka iskuulka wixii arrimo ah oo ku saabsan amniga.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Puonjruok jiwo jonyuol gi jopuonj e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo onyis sirkal mar skul weche duto motudore gi ritruok.

English: Notice: KALRO will distribute certified coffee seed to farmers in Wajir County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KALRO itasambaza mbegu za kahawa zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir mwezi Februari huu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay abuurka kafeega ee shahaadada leh u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda Gobolka Wajir bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KALRO biro pogo kodhi mag chai ne jopur e gweng' mar Wajir e dwe mar Februar.

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of Embu County to prepare for possible road accidents this August.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Agosti hii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Embu inay isu diyaariyaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha August.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross osiemo jogweng' Embu County mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Agost.

English: Bleeding, severe headaches, blurred vision, or swelling are danger signs Â—seek care immediately.
Kiswahili: Kutokwa na damu, maumivu makali ya kichwa, kuona vibaya, au uvimbe ni dalili za hatari â—tafuta huduma mara moja.
Somali: Dhiigbax, madax-xanuun daran, aragga oo aan caddayn, ama barar waa calaamado khatar ah - isla markiiba raadso daryeel.
Dholuo: Remo ma wuok, wich bar matek, neno ma ok nen maber, kata ng’ol gin ranyisi mag hinyruok Â—dwar thieth mapiyo.

English: Notice: SHA will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: SHA itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Shirkadda SHA waxay qabaneysaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee Gobolka Nairobi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: SHA biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa e taon mar Nairobi.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response reminds expectant mothers in Kitui County that access to family planning counselling is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kitui kwamba upatikanaji wa ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Kitui in helitaanka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Dwoko Tuoche paro ne mine ma biro bedo gi ich e gweng' mar Kitui ni thuolo mar yudo kony mar chano ngima joot en maonge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: Regional Bureau for Eastern Africa floods update #1 (15 May 2024)
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Kanda ya Afrika Mashariki kuhusu mafuriko #1 (15 Mei 2024)
Somali: Warbixin ku saabsan fatahaadaha ka dhacay Xafiiska Gobolka ee Bariga Afrika #1 (15 Maajo 2024)
Dholuo: Ofis mar Pinyruoth mar Afrika ma Wuokchieng' mar pi ma pong'o piny #1 (15 dwe mar abich higa mar 2024)

English: KEMRI reminds expectant mothers in Kajiado County that access to postnatal check-ups is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kwamba upatikanaji wa uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Kajiado in helitaanka baaritaano ka dib dhalashada ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMRI paronwa mine ma nigi ich e Kajiado County ni dhi e nonro bang' nyuol en gima onge chudo e ute duto mag oganda.

English: Kenya Red Cross alerts residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya kuongezeka kwa visa vya wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay uga digtay dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet in ay ka badan yihiin kiisaska lo'da lagu xado waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan in ay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross chiwo siem ne jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County e wi medruok mar weche mag kwalo jamni kendo osiemo oganda mondo kik gipog weche mag ritruok gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: DCI alerts residents of Mombasa County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: DCI inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na watu wasiowajua.
Somali: DCI waxay dadka deggan degmada Mombasa uga digtay kororka kiisaska gaadiidka la xaday waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan inay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne jogweng' County mar Mombasa e wi medruok mar wach kwalo mtokni kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gipog weche mag sirkal gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will conduct a greenhouse farming workshop for farmers in Migori County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itafanya warsha ya kilimo cha chafu kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu qaban doonaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan beeraha aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo ee beeraleyda Degmada Migori bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro timo tiegruok mar timo tijno ne jopur e gweng' mar Migori e dwe mar Mei.

English: NCPB advises avocado producers in Siaya County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: NCPB inashauri wazalishaji wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: NCPB waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha avocado ee degmada Siaya inay ka iibsadaan wax soo saarka kaliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: NCPB nyiso jopur ma loso avocado e county mar Siaya ni gius olembegi mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo olembe kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: KEPHIS reminds farmers in Murang'a County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Murang'a juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Murang'a barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee xakamaynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada.
Dholuo: KEPHIS parone jopur e county mar Murang'a chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche.

English: KNEC encourages residents of Kisii County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaashooda si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jogweng' County mar Kisii mondo onon weche ma giduto giduto gikwongo tiyogo ka gidwaro ng'eyo kaka ji biro tiyo gi pesa mag county.

English: Notice: Universities Fund opens a new ICT skills programme at the vocational centre in Turkana County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unafungua programu mpya ya ujuzi wa ICT katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu furayaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan xirfadaha ICT ee xarunta xirfadda ee degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Yunivasiti Fund chako chenro manyien mar bedo gi lony e yore mag ICT e kar tiegruok e county mar Turkana.

English: NPS reminds the public in Baringo County to remain vigilant on border security.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Baringo inay ka feejignaadaan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: NPS paronwa ji duto manie Baringo County ni gibed motang' gi weche mag sirkal.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by SHA (Social Health Authority) will be held in Meru County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Meru Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ay soo qabanqaabisay SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Meru bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth maonge chudo ma olos gi SHA (Social Health Authority) ibiro tim e County mar Meru e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will open a fish collection centre in Tana River County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itafungua kituo cha kukusanya samaki katika Kaunti ya Tana River Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEPHIS waxay xarun ururinta kalluunka ka furi doontaa degmada Tana River bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro yawo kambi mar choko rech e taon mar Tana River e dwe mar Agost.

English: Kenya Price Bulletin, February 2023
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Bei ya Kenya, Februari 2023
Somali: Warbixinta Qiimaha Kenya, Febraayo 2023
Dholuo: Oboke mar Nengo mar Kenya, dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2023

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages mothers in Kisumu County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Kisumu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo mine manie Kisumu County mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: NPS reminds survivors of gender-based violence in West Pokot County that access to safe shelter referrals is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kwamba upatikanaji wa maelekezo ya makazi salama unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada West Pokot in helitaanka tixraacyada magangelyo ammaan ah ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: NPS parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag nindruok e West Pokot County ni thuolo mar yudo kuonde modakie onge chudo.

English: KALRO urges sheep farmers in Siaya County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported lumpy skin disease cases.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawahimiza wafugaji wa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za ugonjwa wa ngozi ya uvimbe.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda idaha ee degmada Siaya inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska cudurka maqaarka ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur mag rombe e county mar Siaya mondo oland ne jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth man machiegni gi kanyo bang' ka osenyis ni nitie tuoche mang'eny mag pien.

English: Notice from KEMRI: family planning counselling clinics will run every June at designated health centres in Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka KEMRI: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Juni katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid KEMRI: Caafimaadka la talinta qorshaynta qoyska waxaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Juun oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Murang'a.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMRI: Klinike mag chiwo paro e wi chenro mag ngima joot biro tiyo dwe mar auchiel higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Murang'a.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development reminds farmers in Taita-Taveta County of the ongoing fertiliser application training programme.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya matumizi ya mbolea.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Taita-Taveta barnaamijka tababarka codsiga bacriminta ee socda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development parone jopur e Taita-Taveta County kuom tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar tiyo gi yien.

English: Kenya Dairy Board warns millet farmers in Makueni County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa maharagwe katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuhusu maambukizi ya wadudu na kupendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda cawska ee degmada Makueni cudurrada cayayaanka waxaana uu ku talinayaa in si waqtigeeda ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board chiwo siem ne jopur mag millet e County Makueni kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: State Department for TVET advises students in Mombasa County to register early to secure allocation to access free digital learning content.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata maudhui ya ujifunzaji wa kidijitali bila malipo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ardayda degmada Mombasa kula talineysaa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan si ay u helaan lacag la'aan ah barashada digital content.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo jopuonjre e county mar Mombasa mondo odonj e skundno chon mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo somo mar digital maonge chudo.

English: KCSE July series registration opens January 27 and closes February 21.
Kiswahili: Usajili wa mfululizo wa KCSE Julai huanza Januari 27 na hufungwa Februari 21.
Somali: Diiwaangelinta taxanaha KCSE July waxay furmaysaa Janaayo 27 waxayna xirtaa Febraayo 21.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KCSE e dwe mar Julai chakore tarik 27 dwe mar Januar kendo rumo tarik 21 dwe mar Februar.

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health will host a free hypertension awareness outreach in Kisii County this August.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Kisii Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska Dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay marti gelineysaa wacyi-gelin bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cadaadiska dhiig karka ee degmada Kisii bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth biro timo kampen mar konyo ji ng'eyo ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar hypertension maonge chudo e dwe mar Agost e kaunti mar Kisii.

English: Public health advisory: KEMRI warns of increased Rift Valley Fever risk in Kajiado County and advises the public to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMRI inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa katika Kaunti ya Kajiado na inashauri umma kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Talobixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: KEMRI waxay ka digtay kororka halista Cudurka Rift Valley ee Gobolka Kajiado waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakheysan.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: KEMRI chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuwo mar Rift Valley Fever e Kajiado County kendo osiemo ji mondo kik gitudre gi pi mochido.

English: Notice: DPP conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Laikipia County this June.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Laikipia Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan dhismaha nabadda qaranka ee Gobolka Laikipia bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: DPP timo romo mar oganda e dwe mar Jun e Laikipia County e wi loso kuwe e piny mangima.

English: Handwashing with soap before feeding and after diaper changes prevents infections in children and mothers.
Kiswahili: Kunawa mikono kwa sabuni kabla ya kulisha na baada ya kubadilisha nepi huzuia maambukizi kwa watoto na akina mama.
Somali: Gacmaha lagu maydho saabuun ka hor intaadan quudin iyo ka dib markaad bedesho qaboojiyaha waxay ka hortagtaa cudurrada carruurta iyo hooyooyinka.
Dholuo: Luoko lweteni gi sabun kapok ichiemo nyithindo kendo bang ' loko piendeni, geng'o nyithindo kod mine kik bed gi tuwo.

English: KNEC reminds youth in Marsabit County that HELB funding is available for ICT skills training.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT.
Somali: KNEC waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Marsabit in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka xirfadaha ICT.
Dholuo: KNEC oparo ne rowere man Marsabit County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar lony e yore mag ICT.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) restricts movement of dairy cows in Nyeri County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inazuia harakati za ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da caanaha ah ee degmada Nyeri sababtuna tahay faafitaanka cudurka maqaarka.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok mag yien e County mar Nyeri nikech tuoche mag dhoot.

English: KALRO advises fish producers in Kiambu County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wazalishaji wa samaki katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: KALRO waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kalluunka ee degmada Kiambu inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur ma loso rech e County mar Kiambu mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur ka pok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the July planting season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kudhibiti minyoo mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Julai.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka jiilaalka hore iyagoo adeegsanaya cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Taita-Taveta County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha katika shule kote Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij hagitaan iyo adeegyo la-talin ah oo lagu sameeyo dugsiyada gobolka Taita-Taveta.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development chako chenro mar tayo kendo chiwo paro e skunde duto mag Taita-Taveta County.

English: IPOA urges anyone experiencing abuse in Lamu County to call the toll-free GBV helpline 1195.
Kiswahili: IPOA inamhimiza mtu yeyote anayepatwa na unyanyasaji katika Kaunti ya Lamu piga simu kwa simu ya bure ya msaada ya GBV 1195.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa qofkasta oo ku dhaca xadgudubka gobolka Lamu inuu wacdo khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah 1195.
Dholuo: IPOA ojiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma yudo chandruok mar timbe mahundu e County mar Lamu mondo oluong namba mar kony mar GBV 1195.

English: Tana River County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for June 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tana River: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Juni 2022
Somali: Degmada Tana River: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Juun 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Aora Tana: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar auchiel 2022

English: KICD urges youth in Nyamira County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KICD inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KICD waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nyamira inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada rayidka ah ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada rayidnimada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo rowere e County mar Nyamira mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok ochopo gik ma biro timore e kind oganda.

English: Judiciary of Kenya advises residents of Narok County to apply online via the e-Citizen portal when seeking e-Citizen registration.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Narok kuomba mtandaoni kupitia portal ya e-Citizen wakati wa kutafuta usajili wa e- Citizen.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka deggan degmada Narok inay dalbadaan khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga e-Citizen marka ay raadinayaan diiwaangelinta e-citizen.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo jogweng' Narok County mondo oket kwayo margi e intanet kokalo kuom e-Citizen portal sama gidwaro dhi e e e - Citizen registration.

English: E-Citizen invites residents of Nyeri County to attend the public participation forum regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku casuumaysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay ka qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la xiriira wadatashiyada siyaasadda guud.
Dholuo: E-Citizen gwelo ji duto modak e County mar Nyeri mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi weche siasa.

English: Eastern Africa | Severe weather and floods - DG ECHO Daily Map | 07/05/2024
Kiswahili: Afrika Mashariki | Hali ya hewa kali na mafuriko - Ramani ya Kila Siku ya DG ECHO | 07/05/2024
Somali: Bariga Afrika | Cimilo daran iyo daadad - Khariidadda Maalinlaha ah ee DG ECHO | 07/05/2024
Dholuo: Afrika ma Wuokchieng’ | <2Zepa> Weche mager mag piny kod pi ma pong’o piny - Map mar DG ECHO ma pile ka pile | 07/05 higa mar 2024

English: HELB calls on the community in Wajir County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: HELB inatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: HELB waxay bulshada degmada Wajir ugu baaqeysaa inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116 si ay u ilaaliyaan amniga dugsiyada.
Dholuo: HELB okwayo ji duto e gweng' mar Wajir mondo omany namba mar 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Kajiado County this May. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya itafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Kajiado Mei hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay qabaneysaa madasha caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada ee degmada Kajiado bisha May. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth biro timo romo mar paro ne rowere e kaunti mar Kajiado e dwe mar abich.

English: Weekly Bulletin on Outbreaks and other Emergencies: Week 22: 27 May - 2 June 2024 (Data as reported by: 17:00; 2 June 2024)
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Kila Wiki kuhusu Milipuko na Dharura Nyingine: Wiki 22: 27 Mei - 2 Juni 2024 (Data kama ilivyoripotiwa na: 17:00; 2 Juni 2024)
Somali: War-saxaafadeed Todobaadle ah oo ku saabsan Cudurrada faafa iyo Xaaladaha kale ee Degdegga ah: Toddobaadka 22: 27 Maajo - 2 Juun 2024 (Xogta sida ay soo sheegtay: 17:00; 2 Juun 2024)
Dholuo: Oboke mar juma ka juma kuom tuoche ma nyalo pong’o piny kod gik mamoko ma nyalo timore mapiyo: Juma mar 22: 27 dwe mar abich - 2 dwe mar auchiel 2024 (Weche kaka ondik gi: 17:00; 2 dwe mar auchiel 2024)

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public that free cholera screening is available at all public health centres in Kirinyaga County this June.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kipindupindu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Juni hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka fayraska ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee Gobolka Kirinyaga bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health parone ji ni nonro ma onge cholera yudore e kuonde thieth duto e County ma Kirinyaga e dwe mar Jun.

English: The African Conference on Agricultural Technology (ACAT) is gearing up to be one of the most dynamic and impactful events of the year, ...
Kiswahili: Mkutano wa Afrika juu ya Teknolojia ya Kilimo (ACAT) unajitayarisha kuwa moja ya matukio yenye nguvu na yenye athari zaidi ya mwaka, ...
Somali: Shirkii Afrika ee Teknolojiyada Beeraha (ACAT) wuxuu isu diyaarinayaa inuu noqdo mid ka mid ah dhacdooyinka ugu firfircoon uguna saameyn badan sanadka, ...
Dholuo: Chokruok mar African Conference on Agricultural Technology (ACAT) biro bedo achiel kuom gik madongo ma timore e higa...

English: Town dwellers can cultivate plants. Learn on the lessons of using sacks to palnt vegetables and onions.
Kiswahili: Wakaaji wa jiji wanaweza kulima mimea. Jifunze kutokana na masomo ya kutumia mifuko ili kulima mboga na viazi.
Somali: Dadka deggan magaalooyinka waxay beeran karaan dhirta. Waxbarashada ku saabsan isticmaalka bacaha si ay u cunaan khudaarta iyo subagga.
Dholuo: Jogo modak e taondno nyalo pidho yien, kendo ginyalo puonjore tiyo gi ofuko e loso alode kod alode.

English: OGP announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: OGP inatangaza nyakati bora za kurejesha huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: OGP waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: OGP olando lokruok e seche mag tiyo gi passport e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises farmers in Trans Nzoia County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the February planting season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Wanyama inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kufanya mazoezi ya kugeuza mazao ili kurejesha uzazi wa udongo kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Februari.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Trans Nzoia inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagga si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda ka hor xilliga beerashada ee Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development nyiso jopur e Trans Nzoia County ni gitim lokruok e puothe mag puothe mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak maber ka pok ochopo dwe mar ariyo mar pur.

English: Kenya Gazette encourages first-time voters in Vihiga County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha karibu cha IEBC.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa codbixiyayaasha ugu horreeya ee degmada Vihiga inay booqdaan xarunta diiwaangelinta IEBC ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogo ma ne okwongo yiero e county mar Vihiga mondo olim kama ichikoe ji ne IEBC.

English: Ministry of Health announces free medical camps for residents of Mandera County starting this August.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatangaza kambi za matibabu bila malipo kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kuanzia Agosti hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ku dhawaaqday xeryo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Mandera laga bilaabo bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health olando kambi mag thieth maonge chudo ne joma odak Mandera County kochakore Agost ma kawuono.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises avocado producers in Mandera County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawashauri wazalishaji wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa soo saarayaasha avocado ee degmada Mandera inay ka soo qayb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur mag avocado e county mar Mandera mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur ka pok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health: free antenatal care clinics will run every December at designated health centres in Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya: kliniki za bure za utunzaji wa ujauzito zitafanya kazi kila Desemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka: rugaha daryeelka dhalmada ee bilaashka ah waxaa lagu bilaabi doonaa bishii Diseembar kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Kiambu.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth: klinik mag thieth ma onge chudo biro tiyo dwe mar Desemba higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e Kaunti mar Kiambu.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the public in Kitui County to report suspicious messages to their service provider following reported cases of fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadweynaha degmada Kitui inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda ka dib kiisaska la sheegay ee qorshooyinka maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo ji duto e gweng' mar Kitui mondo ochiw ripot mar weche maok adier ne jatendgi mar konyo ji bang' ka osenyis ni nitie chenro mag miriambo mag timo ohala.

English: Climate-smart push-pull: a conservation agriculture technology for food security and environmental sustainability in Africa. Authors: Z. R. Khan,; C. A. O. ...
Kiswahili: Kusukuma-kuvuta hali ya hewa: teknolojia ya kilimo cha uhifadhi kwa usalama wa chakula na uendelevu wa mazingira barani Afrika. Waandishi: Z. R. Khan,; C. A. O. ...
Somali: Climate-smart push-pull: tiknoolajiyada ilaalinta beeraha ee ammaanka cuntada iyo joogtaynta deegaanka ee Afrika. Qorayaal: Z. R. Khan,; C. A. O. ...

English: CDC advises residents of Baringo County to boil drinking water before use to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: CDC inashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kuchemsha maji ya kunywa kabla ya matumizi ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: CDC waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo inay biyo cabitaan ah ku kariyaan ka hor inta aan la isticmaalin si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar tuoche (CDC) jiwo jogweng' Baringo County mondo omak pi modho kapok gitiyo kode e geng'o tuwono kik landre.

English: Makueni County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for December 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Makueni: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Desemba 2023
Somali: Degmada Makueni: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Diseembar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Makueni: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2023

English: Ministry of Education invites youth in Nyandarua County to enroll for electrical installation training this October.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Oktoba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku casuumaysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nyandarua inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka rakibaadda korontada bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education ogwelo rowere manie Nyandarua County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar keto sitima e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service warns sorghum farmers in Busia County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Busia juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda sorghum ee degmada Busia cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna kugula talineysaa faragelinta waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service chiwo siem ne jopur mag sorghum e county mar Busia kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ochiwo paro mar kawo okang' mapiyo.

English: Kenya: Climate-related flooding forces hundreds of thousands to flee
Kiswahili: Kenya: Mafuriko yanayohusiana na hali ya hewa yanalazimisha mamia ya maelfu kukimbia
Somali: Kenya: Daadadka la xiriira cimilada ayaa boqolaal kun oo qof ku qasbay inay ka cararaan
Dholuo: Kenya: Pi ma pong’o piny ma luwore gi yamo miyo ji gana gi gana oringo

English: COMESA advises coffee producers in Kwale County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wazalishaji wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Kwale kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: COMESA waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kafeega ee Gobolka Kwale inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: COMESA nyiso jopur ma loso chai e county mar Kwale mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur ka pok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: AFA reminds livestock keepers in Bomet County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wafugaji katika Kaunti ya Bomet kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Bomet inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanada buka xafiiska xayawaanka ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: AFA paronwa jorit jamni e County mar Bomet ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: Exploring new approaches to urban refugee hosting in Kenya
Kiswahili: Kuchunguza mbinu mpya za kuwahifadhi wakimbizi mijini nchini Kenya
Somali: Sahaminta habab cusub oo lagu qaabilayo qaxootiga magaalooyinka ee Kenya
Dholuo: Neno yore manyien mag rwako jolweny ma ni e boma ma Kenya

English: E-Citizen reminds residents of Kiambu County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu in helitaanka adeegyada baasaboorka ay hadda ka fududahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa jogweng' mar County mar Kiambu ni koro nyalo bedo mayot yudo passport kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: KEMSA reminds the public in Laikipia County about the importance of diabetes screening for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuhusu umuhimu wa uchunguzi wa kisukari kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMSA waxay dadweynaha degmada Laikipia ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda baaritaanka sonkorowga ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMSA parone ji duto e County mar Laikipia kuom ber mar nono thieth mar thieth mag ndhoga e ngima joot.

English: State Department for Basic Education encourages out-of-school children in Trans Nzoia County to register their children at the nearest public school under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka Trans Nzoia waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta dugsiga ka baxsan inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: Ofis mar State for Basic Education jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni kodgi e bwo chenro mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: The Ministry of Health has confirmed two new Mpox cases, bringing the total number of infections to 33 since the outbreak began.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya imethibitisha visa viwili vipya vya Mpox, na kufanya jumla ya maambukizi kufikia 33 tangu mlipuko huo uanze.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa xaqiijisay laba kiis oo cusub oo Mpox ah, taasoo keentay in tirada guud ee cudurrada laga helay 33 tan iyo markii uu bilaabmay cudurka.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health osenyiso ni nitie ji ariyo manyien ma nigi Mpox, mamiyo kwan mar joma nigi tuwono ochopo 33 chakre chakruok mar tuwono.

English: KEMRI appeals to caregivers in Uasin Gishu County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the December maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Desemba.
Somali: KEMRI waxay u baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Uasin Gishu inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta bukaanka ee la qorsheeyay iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Diseembar.
Dholuo: KEMRI okwayo jorit e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo obi e odiechieng' mar klinik ma ne ochan e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development informs maize farmers in Mombasa County of new market linkage opportunities this April.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inafahamisha wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Aprili hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa ku wargelisa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee gobolka Mombasa fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development olero ne jopur mar kodhi e county mar Mombasa kuom thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar April.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) warns coffee farmers in Mandera County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaonya wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay uga digtay beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Mandera cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna kugula talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho chai e county mar Mandera kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Ministry of Health will be held in Mandera County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Wizara ya Afya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Mandera Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ay soo qabanqaabisay Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa lagu qaban doonaa Degmada Mandera bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo mitimo gi Ministry of Health ibiro tim e County mar Mandera e dwe mar April.

English: IPOA urges residents of Busia County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawataka wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida katika maeneo ya mpaka kwa vyombo vya usalama huku kukiwa na umakini mkubwa wa kukabiliana na ugaidi.
Somali: IPOA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia inay soo sheegaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaalla aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: IPOA jiwo jogweng' County mar Busia mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkal mar sirkal e wi gik ma ne timore e alwora mar tong'gi nikech ji osebedo ka kawo okang' mar kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa ajili ya usajili wa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ka furayaa barta adeegga cusub ee diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee degmada Migori.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) chako tiyo gi e-Citizen registration e county mar Migori.

English: Kenya Medical Association reminds the public in Mandera County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba upatikanaji wa usaidizi wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya ayaa xasuusinaya dadweynaha degmada Mandera in helitaanka taageerada sheegashada NHIF/SHA ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association parone ji duto man Mandera County ni kony mar kwayo kwayo mag NHIF/SHA sani yudore e kuonde moyier.

English: Skin-to-skin contact improves warmth, breathing, and bonding for preterm babies.
Kiswahili: Mawasiliano ya ngozi na ngozi huongeza joto, kupumua, na kuimarisha uhusiano kati ya watoto wachanga.
Somali: Xidhiidhka maqaarka ilaa maqaarka wuxuu wanaajiyaa kuleylka, neefsashada, iyo xiriirka ilmaha aan dhalan.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma pok onyuol nyalo bedo gi mor, muya, kod winjruok maber e kindgi.

English: Kenya Drought Response Dashboard (January to March 2023)
Kiswahili: Dashibodi ya Kukabiliana na Ukame Kenya (Januari hadi Machi 2023)
Somali: Shaxda Jawaab celinta Abaaraha Kenya (Janaayo ilaa Maarso 2023)
Dholuo: Dabod mar duoko mar oro e piny Kenya (dwe mar achiel nyaka dwe mar adek higa mar 2023)

English: NTSA warns residents of Kisii County to prepare for possible drought this April.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kujiandaa kwa ukame unaowezekana Aprili hii.
Somali: NTSA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay u diyaar garoobaan abaaraha iman kara bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: NTSA osiemo jogweng' Kisii mondo oikre ne oro ma nyalo betie e dwe mar April.

English: NPS reminds residents of Garissa County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: NPS inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Garissa kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Somali: NPS waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Garissa inay adeegaan amarada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha deegaanka xilliyada dabka.
Dholuo: NPS parone jogweng' mar County mar Garissa mondo oluw chike mag golo ji moa kuondego ma jotelo mag sirkal ogolo e kinde mag yiengni.

English: Notice: KMTC reminds citizens in Lamu County about their rights regarding voter registration.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Lamu kuhusu haki zao kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Lamu xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KMTC paronwa raia mag Lamu County e wi ratiro ma gin-go mar ndiko joma oyiero.

English: Notice from Kenya Medical Association: skilled birth attendance clinics will run every August at designated health centres in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya: kliniki za mahudhurio ya uzazi zenye ujuzi zitaendeshwa kila Agosti katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Kenya: rugta daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfadlayaasha ah ayaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Agoosto oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association: klinik mag rito nyuol ma nigi lony biro tiyo higa ka higa e dwe mar Agost e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Kirinyaga.

English: Kenya Red Cross warns residents of Homa Bay County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: Kenya Red Cross inawaonya wakazi wa Homa Bay County juu ya kuongezeka kwa kashfa za pesa za simu na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay kororka khayaanada lacagta mobile waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross osiemo jogweng' Homa Bay County kuom medruok mar timbe mag wuondo pesa kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: Kenya Dairy Board warns coffee farmers in Siaya County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaonya wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu uga digay beeraleyda kafeega ee degmada Siaya cudurrada faafa ee cayayaanka wuxuuna ku talinayaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho chai e county mar Siaya kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) opens a new service point for passport services in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ka furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee degmada Meru.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) oyawo kama itimoe tije manyien mag tiyo gi passport e county mar Meru.

English: Kenya will host the Agri Food Systems Financing Summit FINAS 2025 Stakeholders in agriculture are encouraged to engage in discussions on securing innovative funding solutions
Kiswahili: Kenya itakuwa mwenyeji wa Mkutano wa Ufadhili wa Mifumo ya Agri Foods FINAS 2025 Wadau katika kilimo wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mijadala kuhusu kupata suluhu za kiubunifu za ufadhili.
Somali: Kenya waxay martigelin doontaa Shirweynaha Maalgelinta Nidaamyada Cuntada Agri FINAS 2025 Dadka ku takhasusay beeraha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan doodaha lagu heli karo xalal maalgelin cusub
Dholuo: Kenya biro bedo jakanyo mar Chokruok mar Piny mar Golo Pesa e Weche mag Chamo Chiemb Agro FINAS 2025 Ojiwo joma nie tich mar pur mondo oriw lwedo mbaka mag yudo yore manyien mag yudo pesa

English: CDC encourages mothers in Migori County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Migori kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Migori inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo mine manie Migori County mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Learn on how you can acquire knowledge and training from field extension officers.
Kiswahili: Jifunze jinsi unavyoweza kupata maarifa na mafunzo kutoka kwa maafisa wa ugani wa uwanja.
Somali: Baro sida aad aqoon iyo tababar uga heli karto saraakiisha fidinta goobta.
Dholuo: Puonjri kaka inyalo yudo puonj koda tiegruok kuom joma tiyo e kambi.

English: HELB urges youth in Kisii County to verify their voter registration details ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: HELB inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: HELB waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kisii inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo rowere e County mar Kisii mondo onon weche ma gin-go e wi joma oyierogi kapok gitimo gik ma biro timore ne oganda.

English: KNEC urges youth in Nyamira County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawataka vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Nyamira inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo rowere e County mar Nyamira mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county kapok gichako timo tije mag sirkal.

English: DCI reminds mobile money users in Kiambu County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za simu katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka kashfa za pesa za mkononi.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kiambu inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: DCI paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mobil e County mar Kiambu ni mondo ging'e kwayo margi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo gitang' gi timbe mag wuondruok.

English: Notice: Universities Fund opens applications for revision guides for learners in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu hufungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu furayaa codsiyada hagaha dib u eegista ardayda degmada Wajir.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Yunivasiti Fund oyawo kwayo mag somo mondo okony jopuonjre e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds expectant mothers in Nyandarua County that access to childhood immunization is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba upatikanaji wa chanjo ya watoto ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Nyandarua in helitaanka tallaalka carruurta ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Nyandarua ni yudo thieth mar nyithindo onge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: Office of the Auditor-General encourages first-time voters in Kisii County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Kisii kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: Xafiiska xisaabiyaha guud wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa codbixiyayaasha ugu horreeya ee degmada Kisii inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor-General jiwo joma okwongo yiero e county mar Kisii mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero.

English: Teenage mothers are at higher risk of complications. Encourage young girls to stay in school and delay pregnancy.
Kiswahili: Akina mama vijana wako katika hatari kubwa ya kupata matatizo. Wahimize wasichana wadogo kuendelea na shule na kuchelewesha ujauzito.
Somali: Hooyooyinka dhallinyarada ah waxay halis ugu jiraan inay qabaan dhibaatooyin badan. Gabdhaha yaryar ku dhiirigeliso inay iskuulka sii joogaan oo ay uurka dib u dhigaan.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma rowere nyalo bedo gi tuoche mang'eny, omiyo jiwuru mon matindo mondo odhi nyime gi dhi e skul kendo giter ich bang'e.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development advises maize producers in Mandera County to register with a certified cooperative society ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inashauri wazalishaji wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Mandera kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha hadhuudhka ee degmada Mandera inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development nyiso jopur ma loso kodhi e county mar Mandera mondo odonj e riwruok ma nigi ratiro mar timo ohala kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Draft National Policy on CPD for TVET Trainers released for public participation.
Kiswahili: Mradi wa sera ya kitaifa juu ya CPD kwa Trainers TVET iliyotolewa kwa ajili ya ushiriki wa umma.
Somali: Qorshaha Siyaasadda Qaranka ee ku saabsan CPD ee Tababarayaasha TVET oo loo soo saaray kaqeybgalka dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Chenro mar Puonjruok Puonjruogno e Piny Mangima ne Jopuonjre mag TET ma ne ochiw ne ji mondo oriwgi lwedo.

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit warns of increased malaria risk in Isiolo County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya malaria katika Kaunti ya Isiolo na kushauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Talo-bixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa ka digtay khatarta sii kordheysa ee cudurka daacuunka ee degmada Isiolo waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar oganda: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osiemo ji kuom medruok mar tuo mar malaria e County mar Isiolo kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore mar thieth.

English: Public health advisory: Ministry of Health warns of increased cholera risk in Meru County and advises the public to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Wizara ya Afya inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya kipindupindu katika Kaunti ya Meru na inashauri umma kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Somali: Talo-bixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ka digtay khatarta kororka cudurka kolera ee degmada Meru waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay dhammaystiraan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagula talinayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: Ministry of Health osiemo ji kuom medruok mar tuo mar cholera e County mar Meru kendo ojiwo ji duto mondo otiek dose duto mar thiedho.

English: EACC urges residents of Laikipia County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kuripoti kesi za ufisadi kupitia laini ya bure ya eACC ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay ka warbixiyaan kiisaska musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo khadka tooska ah ee lacag la'aanta ah si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jogweng' Laikipia County mondo oland weche mag mibadhi ka gitiyo gi simo mar e-EACC ma onge chudo mondo giked gi wuond mag yuto.

English: Announcing the launch of Kenya Market Assessment highlighting need for warning labels under new nutrient profiling model.
Kiswahili: Kutangaza uzinduzi wa Tathmini ya Soko la Kenya ikiangazia hitaji la lebo za tahadhari chini ya mfumo mpya wa uainishaji wa virutubisho.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqista daahfurka Qiimaynta Suuqa Kenya oo muujinaysa baahida loo qabo calaamadaha digniinta ee qaabka cusub ee lagu soo bandhigayo nafaqada.
Dholuo: Olando chakruok mar Rang’o mar Chiro mar Kenya ma nyiso dwaro mar keto lebel mag riembo e bwo yo manyien mar ng’iyo gik ma konyo e ringruok.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties updates residents of Kakamega County on progress of county development projects this August.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega maendeleo ya miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti hii Agosti.
Somali: Xafiiska diiwaangelinta xisbiyada siyaasadeed wuxuu dadka deggan degmada Kakamega ka warbixiyaa horumarka mashaariicda horumarinta degmada bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Registrar of Political Parties medo lero ne jogweng' Kakamega County dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok e gweng'no e dwe mar Agost.

English: State Department for TVET announces distribution of revision guides to schools in Bungoma County this March.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET yatangaza usambazaji wa miongozo ya marekebisho kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Machi hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ku dhawaaqday qaybinta hagaha dib u eegista dugsiyada degmada Bungoma bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag somo e skunde mag Bungoma County e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: KALRO will open a milk collection centre in Siaya County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itafungua kituo cha kukusanya maziwa katika Kaunti ya Siaya Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay bilaabi doontaa xarun ururinta caanaha ee degmada Siaya bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KALRO biro yawo kambi mar choko chak e taon mar Siaya e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: Universities Fund reminds citizens in Trans Nzoia County about their rights regarding devolution.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu muwaadiniinta degmada Trans Nzoia xusuusinayaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar University Fund paronwa raia mag Trans Nzoia County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar golo pesa.

English: Makueni County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Makueni: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2022
Somali: Degmada Makueni: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Makueni: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2022

English: KUCCPS reminds schools in Kirinyaga County to strengthen child protection in schools this January.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuimarisha ulinzi wa watoto shuleni Januari hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada Gobolka Kirinyaga inay xoojiyaan ilaalinta caruurta iskuulada bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: KUCCPS oparo ne skunde man Kirinyaga County mondo omed jiwo rit mar nyithindo e skunde e dwe mar Januar.

English: Mothers are urged to visit immunization booths during market days for convenient access to childhood vaccines.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wanahimizwa kutembelea vibanda vya chanjo wakati wa siku za soko ili kupata chanjo za watoto kwa urahisi.
Somali: Hooyooyinka waxaa lagula talinayaa inay booqdaan goobaha tallaalka inta lagu jiro maalmaha suuqa si ay u helaan tallaallada carruurta.
Dholuo: Ijiwo mine mondo olim kuonde mitiyoe gi thieth e ndalo mag chiro mondo giyud thieth mag nyithindo.

English: OGP urges residents of Turkana County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya.
Somali: OGP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada si ay uga warqabtaan bixinta adeegyada heerka degmooyinka.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Turkana mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche ma timore e wi tij lendo.

English: KMTC reminds youth in Kisii County that HELB funding is available for ICT skills training.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa ICT.
Somali: KMTC waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kisii in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka xirfadaha ICT.
Dholuo: KMTC oparo ne rowere man Kisii County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar lony e yore mag ICT.
