English: KMTC reminds schools in Kisii County to strengthen inclusion of learners with disabilities this September.
Kiswahili: KMTC inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuimarisha ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu Septemba hii.
Somali: KMTC waxay xasuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Kisii inay xoojiyaan ka mid noqoshada ardayda naafada ah bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: KMTC oparo ne skunde man Kisii County mondo omed tiego jopuonjre ma nigi midekre e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Notice: KMTC opens a new electrical installation programme at the vocational centre in Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KMTC yafungua programu mpya ya ufungaji wa umeme katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KMTC waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo lagu rakibo korontada xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KMTC chako chenro manyien mar keto sitima e kar tiegruok e gweng' mar Kirinyaga.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds parents in Kisii County that adult literacy classes registration is open this September.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba usajili wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima umefunguliwa Septemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa xusuusinaya waalidiinta degmada Kisii in diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ay furan tahay bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne jonyuol e County mar Kisii ni ikruok mar somo kod somo ne joma dongo osechakore e dwe mar Septemba.

English: DCI urges residents of Tharaka-Nithi County to cooperate with security screening at public venues amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: DCI inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma wakati wa umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay iskaashi la sameeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: DCI ojiwo jogweng' Tharaka-Nithi County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal e kuonde ma ji ng'adoe bura nikech ji medo keto pachgi kuom chenro mag chiwo siem chon.

English: Kenya Gazette invites residents of Turkana County to attend the public participation forum regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya kaunti.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay ka qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan habka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette gwelo jogweng' Turkana County mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenro mar bajet mar county.

English: KALRO reminds farmers in Mombasa County of the ongoing record keeping for farmers training programme.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Mombasa juu ya programu inayoendelea ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa wakulima.
Somali: KALRO waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Mombasa in barnaamijka tababarka beeralayda uu socdo.
Dholuo: KALRO parone jopur e county mar Mombasa e wi chenro mar tiego jopur ma dhi nyime.

English: EACC urges residents of Nairobi County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: EACC inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuwasilisha kumbukumbu za maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nairobi inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga loo dhigay si loo qaabeeyo dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jogweng' Nairobi County mondo ochiw paro mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso nonro mar tich mar higa ka higa.

English: Secretary-General, Saddened by Deaths in Flooding, Pledges UN Support to Kenya
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu, Amehuzunishwa na Vifo katika Mafuriko, Aahidi Msaada wa Umoja wa Mataifa kwa Kenya
Somali: Xoghayaha Guud, oo ka murugooday dadkii ku dhintay daadadkii, ayaa ballanqaaday taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ee Kenya.
Dholuo: Jandik Maduong’, Ma Owinjo Malit kuom Tho Ma Otimore e Pi Opong’o Pi, Osingo ni UN biro konyo piny Kenya

English: IEBC conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Siaya County this April.
Kiswahili: IEBC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Siaya Aprili hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan wareejinta degmada Siaya bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: IEBC dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e dwe mar April e county mar Siaya.

English: State Department for Basic Education encourages residents of Kwale County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa juu ya ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale inay ka qeybgalaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada si ay uga warqabaan ka qaybgalka dadwaynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Department of State for Basic Education jiwo jogweng' Kwale County mondo oriwgi e chokruok mar jopiny mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo kaka jopiny biro tiyo gi bajet mag county.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will train farmers in Tana River County on water harvesting this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River juu ya uvunaji wa maji Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha Kenya wuxuu tababar siin doonaa beeraleyda degmada Tana River oo ku saabsan goosashada biyaha bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kenya Dairy Board biro tiego jopur e taon mar Tana River County e wi choko pi e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Kenya Red Cross will be held in Bungoma County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay qabanqaabisay Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Bungoma bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Kamp mar thieth ma Kenya Red Cross ochano biro timore e County mar Bungoma e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Notice from CDC: family planning counselling clinics will run every April at designated health centres in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa CDC: kliniki za ushauri wa uzazi wa mpango zitaendeshwa kila Aprili katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid CDC: rugta la talinta qorshaynta qoyska waxay ka shaqeyn doontaa Abriil kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth miluongo ni CDC: Klinike mag chiwo paro e wi chenro mag ngima joot biro tiyo dwe mar April higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Bungoma.

English: Ministry of Education urges youth in Kericho County to participate in the county public forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Kericho kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kericho inay ka qeyb galaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada bulshada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo rowere e County mar Kericho mondo oriwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county ka pok gichako timo tije mag oganda.

English: KEMSA launches a July awareness campaign on food safety across Kisumu County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Julai juu ya usalama wa chakula katika Kaunti ya Kisumu.
Somali: KEMSA waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii July oo ku saabsan amniga cuntada ee degmada Kisumu.
Dholuo: KEMSA chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Julai e wi wach rito ngima mar chiemo e gweng' mar Kisumu.

English: Notice: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Siaya County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Siaya.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ee degmada Siaya.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag siasa e county mar Siaya.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya calls on residents of Kisumu County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of border security.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo jogweng' mar Kisumu County mondo oriw lwedo nono weche mag sirkal kuonde ma ji nitie mondo okony sirkal rito tong'.

English: Farmers and livestock producers can engage with the 27 4 million global initiative aimed at reducing livestock methane emissions through improved genetics and nutrition For more information please visit ILRI s website
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wazalishaji wa mifugo wanaweza kujihusisha na mpango wa kimataifa wa 27 4 milioni unaolenga kupunguza uzalishaji wa methane kwa mifugo kupitia uboreshaji wa vinasaba na lishe Kwa habari zaidi tafadhali tembelea tovuti ya ILRI.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo soo saarayaasha xoolaha waxay ka qayb qaadan karaan hindisaha caalamiga ah ee 27-4 milyan ee loogu talagalay in lagu yareeyo qiiqa methane-ka xoolaha iyada oo loo marayo hidde-sideyaasha iyo nafaqada la hagaajiyay. Macluumaad dheeraad ah fadlan booqo bogga ILRI
Dholuo: Jo-Purcho gi jo-Purcho nyalo riwo lwedo chenro mar piny mangima mar milion 274 mar tieko chamo methan e jamni kokalo kuom dongruok e kit ngima kod chiemo.

English: Pest Control Products Board reminds livestock keepers in Marsabit County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawakumbusha wafugaji wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu ili kulinda afya ya mifugo.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu xasuusinayaa xoolaha xoolaha ee degmada Marsabit inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska xoolaha ugu dhow si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka xoolaha.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok oparo ne jopur mag jamni e gweng' mar Marsabit ni mondo ginyis jamni matuwo e ofis mar thieth mar jamni man machiegni mondo girit ngima jamni.

English: DPP urges residents of Marsabit County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: DPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: DPP waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo jogweng' mar Marsabit County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e alworano nikech ji medo keto pachgi kuom chenro mag chiwo siem chon ne oganda.

English: DCI reminds mobile money users in Uasin Gishu County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka kashfa za fedha za simu.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee gobolka Uasin Gishu inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobile.
Dholuo: DCI oparo ne jogo matiyo gi pesa mobil e county mar Uasin Gishu ni mondo ging'e kwayo margi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo kik gitim timbe mag mibadhi.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations issues a cybersecurity alert on SIM-swap fraud affecting residents of Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai hutoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM ambao unaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka Cilmi baarista dambiyada ayaa soo saaray digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan khiyaanada SIM-swap ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Marsabit.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Mumbni mag Criminal Investigations ogolo siem e wi weche mag cybersecurity e wi wuond mag SIM-swap makelo hinyruok ne jogweng' mar Marsabit County.

English: A partnership has been formed to address climate challenges in East African agriculture Farmers are encouraged to stay informed about upcoming initiatives and resources
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano umeanzishwa ili kukabiliana na changamoto za hali ya hewa katika kilimo cha Afrika Mashariki Wakulima wanahimizwa kuendelea kufahamu kuhusu mipango na rasilimali zijazo.
Somali: Shirkad la sameeyay si looga hortago caqabadaha cimilada ee beeraha bariga Afrika Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay ka warqabtaan hindisaha iyo kheyraadka soo socda
Dholuo: Oseket riwruok mar oganda mondo otiek chandruoge mag lokruok mar piny e yore mag pur e East Africa.

English: Host communities, particularly in Turkana, face similar hardship, reflecting longstanding development gaps.
Kiswahili: Jumuiya mwenyeji, haswa Turkana, zinakabiliwa na ugumu kama huo, unaoonyesha mapungufu ya muda mrefu ya maendeleo.
Somali: Bulshooyinka martida loo yahay, gaar ahaan Turkana, waxay la kulmaan dhibaato la mid ah, taasoo muujinaysa farqiga horumarineed ee muddada dheer jiray.
Dholuo: Jodak ma rwako welo, ahinya ahinya e Turkana, yudo pek ma kamano, ma nyiso ni nitie pogruok ma osebedo ka nitie kuom kinde malach e wi dongruok.

English: Kenya Medical Association encourages residents of Kisii County not to suffer in silence and to encourage a friend in distress to seek help.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuwahimiza rafiki aliye katika dhiki kutafuta msaada.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inaysan ku xanuunsadaan iyagoo aamusnaanaya oo ay ku dhiiri galiyaan saaxiibka dhibaatada ku jira inuu caawimaad raadsado.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo jogweng' Kisii County mondo kik gisandre aling' ling' kendo mondo gijiw osiepgi moro ma chandore odwar kony.

English: "The whole-of-government approach, led by President William Ruto, is to ensure that we work across all sectors to minimize the pain for so many," says Hilary Limo, the manager of the Public Health Emergency Operations Centre.
Kiswahili: "Mtazamo wa jumla wa serikali, unaoongozwa na Rais William Ruto, ni kuhakikisha kwamba tunafanya kazi katika sekta zote ili kupunguza machungu kwa wengi," asema Hilary Limo, meneja wa Kituo cha Operesheni za Dharura za Afya ya Umma.
Somali: "Habka dowladda oo dhan, oo uu hoggaaminayo Madaxweyne William Ruto, waa in la hubiyo inaan ka shaqeyno dhammaan qaybaha si aan u yareyno xanuunka dad badan," ayay tiri Hilary Limo, maareeyaha Xarunta Hawlgallada Degdegga ah ee Caafimaadka Dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Yo mar sirikal duto, ma otelne gi Jatend Piny William Ruto, en neno ni watiyo e sekte duto mondo waduok piny rem ne ji mang'eny kamano, Hilary Limo, jatelo mar Kambi mar Tije Mapoya mag Thieth mar Oganda wacho.

English: DCI warns residents of Bungoma County about a rise in SIM-swap fraud and advises the public to report suspicious messages to their service provider.
Kiswahili: DCI inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma juu ya kuongezeka kwa udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM na inashauri umma kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao.
Somali: DCI waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma kororka khiyaamada SIM-swap waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan fariimaha shakiga leh bixiyaha adeegyadooda.
Dholuo: DCI chiwo siem ne jogweng'o mag Bungoma County e wi medruok mar wuond mar loko SIM kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot mar ote maok kare ne jatendgi.

English: Kenya Medical Association launches an April awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kizindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Aprili juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu bilaabay olole wacyi galineed bishii Abriil oo ku saabsan wacyiga cadaadiska sare ee degmada Marsabit.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association osechako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar April e wi wach remo mang'eny e alwora mar Marsabit County.

English: Notice: KEPHIS will train farmers in Samburu County on agroforestry this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEPHIS itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Samburu juu ya kilimo cha misitu Januari hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: KEPHIS waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda gobolka Samburu ee ku saabsan beeraha kaynta bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEPHIS biro tiego jopur e gweng' mar Samburu e weche mag yiengni mag bunge e dwe mar Januar.

English: Meru (Meru-North) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for January 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Meru (Meru-Kaskazini): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Januari 2024
Somali: Degmada Meru (Meru-Waqooyi): War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Janaayo 2024

English: NCPB reminds farmers in West Pokot County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Somali: NCPB waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda gobolka West Pokot barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada.
Dholuo: NCPB parone jopur e West Pokot County chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche.

English: FAO advises coffee producers in Garissa County to take advantage of the guaranteed minimum price ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: FAO inashauri wazalishaji wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuchukua fursa ya bei ya chini iliyohakikishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: FAO waxay kula talineysaa soo saarayaasha kafeega ee Gobolka Garissa inay ka faa'iideystaan qiimaha ugu yar ee la damaanad qaaday ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: FAO nyiso jopur ma loso chai e gweng' mar Garissa mondo oti gi nengo mar piny mosingi kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: This allows countries to collect and analyse more detailed information on resistance trends, helping health authorities make better-informed decisions on treatment, prevention and antimicrobial stewardship.
Kiswahili: Hili huruhusu nchi kukusanya na kuchambua maelezo ya kina zaidi kuhusu mienendo ya ukinzani, kusaidia mamlaka za afya kufanya maamuzi yenye ufahamu zaidi kuhusu matibabu, uzuiaji na usimamizi wa antimicrobial.
Somali: Tani waxay u ogolaaneysaa wadamada inay ururiyaan oo ay falanqeeyaan macluumaad faahfaahsan oo ku saabsan isbeddellada iska caabbinta, taasoo ka caawineysa hay'adaha caafimaadka inay gaaraan go'aanno si wanaagsan looga warqabo oo ku saabsan daaweynta, ka hortagga iyo maareynta jeermiska.
Dholuo: Mano miyo pinje choko kendo nono weche mathoth e wi kaka tuoche nyalo geng’o tuoche, ma konyo jotelo mag thieth mondo okaw okang’ maber e wi thieth, geng’o tuoche kod rito gik ma nyalo ketho tuoche.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Makueni County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi yazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Makueni.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Dowladda waxay bilaabeysaa barnaamij ka dhan ah tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibta dugsiyada degmada Makueni.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Puonjruok ma Chakre e Piny owacho chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe mahundu e skunde duto e gweng' mar Makueni.

English: Recurring Fire Tragedies in Kenya, from Reaction to Prevention
Kiswahili: Misiba ya Moto ya Mara kwa Mara nchini Kenya, kutoka kwa Majibu hadi Kinga

English: You must register to be able to get Covid 19 injection in a nearer health facility, or through internet MOH_Kenya (https://health.go.ke). Al, you need to do that is national identification card. Assist the aged in registering
Kiswahili: Lazima ujiandikishe ili uweze kupata sindano ya Covid 19 katika kituo cha afya cha karibu, au kupitia mtandao MOH_Kenya (https://health.go.ke).
Somali: Waa inaad iska diiwaangelisaa si aad u hesho tallaalka COVID-19 xarun caafimaad oo kuugu dhow, ama internetka MOH_Kenya (https://health.go.ke).
Dholuo: Nyaka inyisri mondo iyud chanjo mar Covid 19 e osiptal man machiegni kodi, kata kokalo kuom intanet mar MOH_Kenya (https://health.go.ke).

English: WFP Kenya Country Brief, June 2025
Kiswahili: Muhtasari wa Nchi wa WFP wa Kenya, Juni 2025
Somali: Warbixinta WFP ee Dalka Kenya, Juun 2025
Dholuo: Wach machiek mar piny Kenya mar WFP, dwe mar auchiel 2025

English: Control weeds in a friendly manner by integrating pest management (IPM)technology ideal on onions.
Kiswahili: Dhibiti magugu kwa njia ya kirafiki kwa kuunganisha teknolojia ya udhibiti wa wadudu (IPM) bora kwenye vitunguu.
Somali: Xakamee cawska si saaxiibtinimo leh adigoo isku daraya tiknoolajiyada maareynta cayayaanka (IPM) oo ku habboon basal.
Dholuo: Temo chungo ogolo e yo makelo mor kuom tiyo gi teknoloji mar geng'o tuoche (IPM) e loso tong'.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations alerts residents of Wajir County to a rise in cattle rustling cases and advises the public to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za wizi wa ng'ombe na kushauri umma kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir uga digaya kororka kiisaska xoolaha lagu xado wuxuuna dadka kula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan in ay la wadaagaan faahfaahinta amniga shaqsiyeed ee shisheeyaha.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar Wajir County kuom wach medruok mar weche mag kwalo jamni kendo ojiwo oganda mondo kik gipog weche mag ritruok gi joma ok ging'eyo.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds the public that free malaria screening is available at all public health centres in Lamu County this February.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa malaria bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Lamu Februari hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka fayraska ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee degmada Lamu bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne ji ni thieth mar malaria onge nengo e kuonde thieth duto mag oganda e County mar Lamu e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission reminds citizens in Kilifi County about their rights regarding public participation in county budgets.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu muwaadiniinta degmada Kilifi xusuusinayaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj parone raia manie County Kilifi kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo gi ji duto e bajet mar county.

English: Notice: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inafungua maombi ya maudhui ya bure ya kujifunza kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu u furayaa codsiyada barashada bilaashka ah ee barashada dhijitaalka ah ee ardayda degmada Nyandarua.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development oyawo kwayo mag somo maonge chudo mar digital ne jopuonjre man Nyandarua County.

English: NDMA urges residents of Kisumu County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies amid heightened attention to counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama wakati wa tahadhari kubwa ya ulinzi wa kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu inay soo sheegaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo aan caadi ahayn oo ku yaal aagagga xuduudka ah hay'adaha amniga iyada oo diiradda la saarayo ilaalinta ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo jogweng'o mag Kisumu County mondo onyis riwruoge mag sirkal ni gitimo gik maok kare e alwora mar tong'gi nikech ji osebedo ka kawo okang' mar kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: NDMA reminds mobile money users in Garissa County to verify requests through official channels before acting to avoid identity theft.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kaunti ya Garissa kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua ili kuepuka wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee Gobolka Garissa inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban si looga fogaado tuugada aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: NDMA paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e County mar Garissa ni mondo ging'e kwayo mag pesa kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro mondo kik jokuoge okwel nyingegi.

English: AFA urges farmers in Embu County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: AFA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Embu kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Embu inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e county mar Embu mondo opidh olembe ma ok nyal geng'o lowo kethore mondo omi giritre kuom lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: KRA reminds residents of Kericho County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo bogga degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: KRA parone jogweng' Kericho County ni luwo dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Notice: ODPP opens voter registration centres in Siaya County this January.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: ODPP inafungua vituo vya usajili wa wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Siaya Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: ODPP waxay furaysaa xarumaha diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee degmada Siaya bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: ODPP ochako chenro mar chano joma biro yiero e county mar Siaya e dwe mar Januar.

English: Worsening drought in Kenya leads to increase in school dropouts
Kiswahili: Ukame unaozidi kuwa mbaya nchini Kenya unasababisha ongezeko la wanafunzi wanaoacha shule

Kiswahili: Shughuli za kawaida za kimwili ni muhimu kwa afya yako.

English: IPOA reminds residents of Nyeri County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this fire outbreaks season.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa milipuko ya moto.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyeri inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah inta lagu jiro xilliyada dabka.
Dholuo: IPOA parone jogweng' Nyeri County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji moa kuondego ma jotelo mag sirkal ogolo e kinde mag yiengni.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds expectant mothers in Marsabit County that access to nutrition supplementation for infants is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kwamba upatikanaji wa nyongeza ya lishe kwa watoto wachanga ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Marsabit in helitaanka nafaqada cuntada ee dhallaanka ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne mine ma biro bedo gi ich e county mar Marsabit ni thuolo mar yudo chiemo moromo ne nyithindo mayom en maonge chudo e kuonde duto mag sirkal.

English: Ministry of Education conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Kericho County this December.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Kericho Desemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha gobolka Kericho bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi migawo mar Ombudsman e County mar Kericho e dwe mar Desemba.

English: 20 doctors from Cuba are expected to land in Nairobi this night, the Cabinet secretary of Health Kagwe has said that they will be posted in Kenyatta University for the next 6 months in a bid to boost Covid 19 management
Kiswahili: Madaktari 20 kutoka Cuba wanatarajiwa kufika Nairobi usiku wa leo, Katibu wa Wizara ya Afya Kagwe amesema watatumika katika Chuo Kikuu cha Kenyatta kwa miezi 6 ijayo katika jitihada za kuongeza usimamizi wa Covid 19.
Somali: 20 dhakhtar oo ka socda Cuba ayaa la filayaa inay galabta soo degaan Nairobi, Wasiirka Caafimaadka ee Golaha Wasiirada Kagwe ayaa sheegay in 6ka bilood ee soo socota lagu soo diri doono Jaamacadda Kenyatta si loo xoojiyo maaraynta Covid-19.
Dholuo: Laktar 20 moa e piny Cuba biro chopo Nairobi gotieno, Jatend weche thieth mar Kabinet Kagwe owacho ni gibiro ketogi e Kenyatta University kuom dweche auchiel mabiro mondo gimed loyo tuo mar Covid 19.

English: A groundbreaking ceremony for sustainable farming education and environmental restoration has been held in Murang a Farmers are encouraged to engage with local initiatives
Kiswahili: Sherehe ya msingi ya elimu ya kilimo endelevu na urejesho wa mazingira imefanyika Murang a Wakulima wanahimizwa kujihusisha na mipango ya ndani.
Somali: Xaflad dhagax-dhigid ah oo loogu talagalay waxbarashada beeraha waara iyo dib u soo celinta deegaanka ayaa lagu qabtay Murang a Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyay inay ka qaybqaataan mashaariicda maxalliga ah
Dholuo: Rapar mar timo dongruok e somo mar pur ma dhi nyime kod loso alwora ne otim e Murang

English: Turkana County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Turkana: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2024
Somali: Degmada Turkana: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Turkana: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2024

English: Notice: NPS conducts a community briefing on border security in Nyamira County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha ee degmada Nyamira bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar National Police (NPS) timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong ' e County mar Nyamira e dwe mar abich.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service advises avocado producers in West Pokot County to attend the upcoming farmers' market day ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawashauri wazalishaji wa parachichi katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kuhudhuria siku ijayo ya soko la wakulima kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu kula talinayaa soo saarayaasha avocado ee Gobolka West Pokot inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta suuqa beeraleyda ee soo socota ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service nyiso jopur mag avocado e West Pokot County mondo odhi e chiro mar jopur ka pok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya alerts residents of Lamu County to a rise in fraud cases and advises the public to join community policing (Nyumba Kumi) initiatives.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Lamu juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za ulaghai na kushauri umma kujiunga na mipango ya polisi wa jamii (Nyumba Kumi).
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay uga digtay dadka deggan degmada Lamu in ay kordheen kiisaska khiyaamooyinka waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay ku biiraan dadaallada booliska bulshada (Nyumba Kumi).
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Communications Authority chiwo siem ne jogweng' Lamu County kuom wach medruok mar weche mag wuondruok kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

English: The WFP is providing 1 050 modern beehives to 260 farmers in 11 counties to enhance beekeeping and boost honey production Farmers are encouraged to engage in this lucrative industry
Kiswahili: WFP inatoa mizinga 1,050 ya nyuki ya kisasa kwa wakulima 260 katika kaunti 11 ili kuimarisha ufugaji nyuki na kuongeza uzalishaji wa asali Wakulima wanahimizwa kujihusisha na sekta hii yenye faida kubwa.
Somali: WFP waxay siisaa 1,050 qolal shinnida casri ah 260 beeraley ah oo ku nool 11 degmo si loo horumariyo daryeelka shinnida loona xoojiyo wax-soo-saarka malabka. Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigeliyaa inay ka qaybqaataan warshaddan faa'iidada leh
Dholuo: WFP chiwo yiende mag nyuki ma sani yudore 1,050 ne jopur 260 e gwenge 11 mondo omed pidho nyuki kendo omed miyo nyuki nyagore.

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health will host a free diabetes screening outreach in Kirinyaga County this October.
Kiswahili: Notisi kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya itaandaa uhamasishaji wa uchunguzi wa kisukari bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay marti gelineysaa baaritaano bilaash ah oo lagu ogaanayo cudurka macaanka ee Gobolka Kirinyaga bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth mar piny owacho biro timo kampen mar nono tuwo mar sukari maonge chudo moro amora e County mar Kirinyaga e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service restricts movement of sheep in Migori County due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya yazuia harakati za kondoo katika Kaunti ya Migori kutokana na mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa Newcastle.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa idaha degmada Migori sababtuna tahay cudurka Newcastle.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service ogeng'o wuoth mar rombe e county mar Migori nikech tuwo mar Newcastle.

English: Youth show how they practice civic duties
Kiswahili: Vijana huonyesha jinsi wanavyotimiza majukumu yao ya kiraia
Somali: Dhallinyaradu waxay muujiyaan sida ay u qabtaan waajibaadka bulshada
Dholuo: Rowere nyiso kaka gitimo migepe mag oganda

English: AFA urges farmers in Nyandarua County to adopt water-harvesting structures on their farms to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: AFA inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kupitisha miundo ya kuvuna maji kwenye mashamba yao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: AFA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Nyandarua inay qaataan qaab-dhismeedyada soo-saarka biyaha ee beerahooda si ay ula qabsadaan qaababka roobka ee isbeddelaya.
Dholuo: AFA jiwo jopur e Kaunti mar Nyandarua mondo oti gi yore mag choko pi e puothegi mondo ginyagre gi lokruok mar koth.

English: Kenya Forest Service reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kiambu County that access to free legal aid is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisheria wa bure unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: Adeegga Kaynta Kenya wuxuu xusuusinayaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ee ka dhacay degmada Kiambu in la heli karo caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah oo lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e County mar Kiambu ni ginyalo yudo kony maonge chudo.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya opens a gender desk offering safe shelter referrals in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa maelekezo ya makazi salama katika Kaunti ya Nandi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay furtay xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya talooyin ku saabsan magangelyo ammaan ah degmada Nandi.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony e wi kuonde dak ma ji nyalo dakie e alwora mar Nandi County.

English: COMESA reminds farmers in Isiolo County of the ongoing fertiliser application training programme.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Isiolo juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya matumizi ya mbolea.
Somali: COMESA waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Isiolo barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee codsiyada bacriminta.
Dholuo: COMESA oparo ne jopur e gweng' mar Isiolo chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar tiyo gi yien.

English: Office of the Auditor-General invites residents of Bomet County to attend the public participation forum regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mkurugenzi Mkuu wa Auditor inawaalika wakazi wa Wilaya ya Bomet kuhudhuria jukwaa la ushiriki wa umma kuhusu ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu ku casuumay dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay ka qeyb galaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Auditor General ogwelo jogweng' County mar Bomet mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi nonro mar tich ma itimo higa ka higa.

English: As climate change driving up global temperatures, chronic heat will become increasingly unbearable for already exposed populations and regions, while also posing a growing threat to those that have historically been less affected.
Kiswahili: Mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa yanapozidisha viwango vya joto duniani, joto sugu litazidi kuwa lisilostahimilika kwa wakazi na maeneo ambayo tayari yameathiriwa, huku pia yakiwa ni tishio linaloongezeka kwa yale ambayo yameathiriwa kidogo kihistoria.
Somali: Iyadoo isbeddelka cimiladu uu kor u qaadayo heerkulka adduunka, kulaylka daba dheeraada wuxuu noqon doonaa mid aan loo adkaysan karin dadka iyo gobollada horey u soo ifbaxay, isagoo sidoo kale khatar sii kordheysa ku ah kuwa taariikh ahaan aan saameyn badan ku yeelan.
Dholuo: Kaka lokruok mag piny medo ng’ich mar piny mangima, liet ma ok rum biro bedo ma ok nyal geng’ore ne oganda kod kuonde ma osebedo ka ng’ich, to bende biro kelo luoro ma medore ne jogo ma osebedo ka ng’ich ahinya e kinde mokalo.

English: Grade 7 reporting January 13: Bring only birth certificate Ã¢Â€Â“ no shopping list allowed.
Kiswahili: Kuripoti Darasa la 7 Januari 13: Leta cheti cha kuzaliwa pekee Ã¢Â€Â“ hakuna orodha ya ununuzi inayoruhusiwa.

Dholuo: Ripot mar gred mar 7 tarik 13 dwe mar achiel: Kel mana oboke mar nyuol Ã¢Â€Â“ ok oyiene list mar gik ma ibiro nyieo.

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Vihiga County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Uhalifu unafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka Cilmi-baarista Dembiyada wuxuu qabtaa warbixin bulsho ku saabsan ka hortagga argagixisada ee degmada Vihiga bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Directorate of Criminal Investigations dhi nyime gi romo mar oganda e wi weche mag kedo gi timbe mahundu e County mar Vihiga e dwe mar Februar.

English: WFP in Kenya welcomes record funding from US government to fight hunger
Kiswahili: WFP nchini Kenya inakaribisha ufadhili wa rekodi kutoka kwa serikali ya Marekani ili kukabiliana na njaa
Somali: Hay'adda WFP ee Kenya ayaa soo dhaweysay maalgelintii ugu badnayd ee ay dowladda Mareykanka ka hesho si loola dagaallamo gaajada
Dholuo: WFP e piny Kenya orwako sirkal mar Amerka kuom sirkal mar sirkal mar kedo kod kech

English: Train staff! Address student unrest proactively.
Kiswahili: Wafunze wafanyakazi! Shughulikia vurugu za wanafunzi kwa njia ya kujikinga.
Somali: Shaqaalaha tareenka, si wax ku ool ah wax uga qabso rabshadaha ardayda.
Dholuo: Jotich mag gach reru, timuru kinda e tieko ywaruok manie kind jopuonjre.

English: TVET reminds youth in Bungoma County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: TVET inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari.
Somali: TVET waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Bungoma in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka farsamada gawaarida.
Dholuo: TVET paronwa rowere man Bungoma County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar masinde mag mtokni.

English: COMESA advises farmers in Baringo County to adopt certified drought-resistant seed varieties ahead of the January planting season.
Kiswahili: COMESA inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Baringo kupitisha aina za mbegu zilizoidhinishwa zinazostahimili ukame kabla ya msimu wa kupanda wa Januari.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Degmada Baringo inay qaataan noocyada abuurka ee abaarta u adkaysta ka hor xilliga beerashada ee Janaayo.
Dholuo: COMESA jiwo jopur e Baringo County mondo oti gi kodhi ma nigi ratiro mar geng'o oro kapok ochopo dwe mar Januar.

English: Notice: NPS conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Bungoma County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada oo ku saabsan ka hortagga argagixisada ee degmada Bungoma bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Riwruok mar National Security Service (NPS) timo romo mar oganda e dwe mar Februar e gweng' mar Bungoma.

English: E-Citizen reminds the public in Mandera County that reporting embezzlement of public funds is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa fedha za umma ni bure, salama, na siri.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka gobolka Mandera in warbixinta xadgudubka lacagta dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, ammaan ah, iyo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa ji duto man Mandera County ni chiwo ripot mar ketho pesa mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Meru (Meru-North) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Meru (Meru-Kaskazini): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2023
Somali: Degmada Meru (Meru-Waqooyi): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Meru (Meru-Nyath): Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Julaini 2023

English: Vines should be killed by uprooting or cutting at least 10 to 14 days before harvesting potatoes, to ensure that the skin of the tubers hardens.
Kiswahili: Mizabibu inapaswa kuuawa kwa kung'oa au kukata angalau siku 10 hadi 14 kabla ya kuvuna viazi, ili kuhakikisha kuwa ngozi ya mizizi inakuwa ngumu.
Somali: Geedaha waa in la dilaa iyadoo la gooyo ama laga jaro ugu yaraan 10 ilaa 14 maalmood ka hor goosashada baradho, si loo hubiyo in maqaarka tubers-ka uu adkaado.
Dholuo: Olembe mag mzabibu onego oneg gi ng'olo kata ng'ado ng'injo ma ok tin ne odiechienge 10 nyaka 14 kapok gichoko olemo mag potasi, mondo omi pien olembe obed matek.

English: FAO urges farmers in Busia County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: FAO inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: FAO waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Busia inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: FAO jiwo jopur e county mar Busia mondo opidh olembe ma nyalo miyo lowo okethre mondo omi giritre kuom lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: Teachers Service Commission invites youth in Laikipia County to enroll for motor vehicle mechanics training this October.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari Oktoba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallinka ayaa ku casuumay dhalinyarada degmada Laikipia inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka mashiinnada gawaarida ee bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj gwelo rowere e County mar Laikipia mondo odonj e tiegruok mar jomisonari mag mtokni e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya calls on the community in Kajiado County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaalika jamii katika Kajiado County kusema dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka nyumba ya usalama ya karibu.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa bulshada degmada Kajiado inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan isla markaana ay taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji (Communications Authority of Kenya) dwaro ni ji duto manie Kajiado County owuo e wi timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gidwar kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: Kenya Gazette announces improved turnaround times for e-Citizen registration in Laikipia County.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujiandikisha kwa e-Citizen katika Kaunti ya Laikipia.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku dhawaaqay in la hagaajiyay waqtiga wareejinta diiwaangelinta e-Citizen ee Gobolka Laikipia.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette olando lokruok e seche mag dhi e e e-Citizen e county mar Laikipia.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response encourages residents of Taita-Taveta County not to suffer in silence and to call the toll-free mental health helpline.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kutoteseka kimya kimya na kupiga simu ya usaidizi ya afya ya akili bila malipo.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Taita-Taveta inaysan si aamusan u xanuunsan oo ay ugu yeeraan khadka caawimaadda caafimaadka dhimirka ee lacag la'aanta ah.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo jiwo jogweng' Taita-Taveta County mondo kik gisandre gi muol kendo mondo giluong simo mar thieth mar chuny maonge chudo.

English: ODPP urges eligible citizens in Kisumu County to participate in polling procedures.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kushiriki katika utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: ODPP waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kisumu inay ka qeyb galaan nidaamyada codbixinta.
Dholuo: ODPP jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro e County mar Kisumu mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag yiero.

English: Private sector stakeholders are encouraged to invest in agricultural value chains and cooperatives under the 300 million Tanzania Food Systems Resilience Program
Kiswahili: Wadau wa sekta binafsi wamehimizwa kuwekeza katika minyororo ya thamani ya kilimo na ushirika chini ya Mpango wa Kuhimili Mifumo ya Chakula Tanzania yenye thamani ya milioni 300.
Somali: Daneeyayaasha gaarka loo leeyahay waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay maalgeliyaan silsiladaha qiimaha beeraha iyo iskaashatada hoos yimaada Barnaamijka Adkeysiga Nidaamyada Cuntada ee 300 milyan ee Tanzania
Dholuo: Oganda mohero weche mag ohala jiwo ji mondo oti gi yore mag ohala e yore mag ohala kod ohala e piny Tanzania e chenro mar miyo gik moko obed motegno e yore mag chiemo ma romo milion 300

English: Notice: Universities Fund launches a child protection in schools programme in schools across Trans Nzoia County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu wazindua mpango wa ulinzi wa watoto shuleni katika shule kote Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij ilaalinta carruurta iskuulada iskuulada guud ahaan degmada Trans Nzoia.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: University Fund chako chenro mar rito nyithindo e skul e skunde duto mag Trans Nzoia County.

English: TVET advises applicants in Garissa County to register before the intake closes for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: TVET inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Garissa kujiandikisha kabla ya ulaji kufungwa kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: TVET waxay kula talineysaa codsadayaasha Gobolka Garissa inay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor inta aan la xirin qaadashada qaadashada soo socota.
Dholuo: TVET nyiso jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e gweng' mar Garissa ni mondo gidonj e tiegruok kapok ichopo e chokruogno.

English: Wash your hands with soap befior handling a baby to prevent diseases
Kiswahili: Osha mikono yako kwa sabuni kabla ya kumtunza mtoto ili kuzuia magonjwa
Somali: Gacmaha ku maydho saabuun ka hor intaadan ilmaha qabsan si looga hortago cudurrada
Dholuo: Lwok lweti gi sabun kapok itiyo gi nyathi mondo igeng ' tuoche

English: Abstract. Various proposals in the World Trade Organization agricultural market access negotiations are explained and their implication to tariff reduction ...
Kiswahili: Muhtasari. Mapendekezo anuwai katika mazungumzo ya upatikanaji wa soko la kilimo la Shirika la Biashara Ulimwenguni yanaelezewa na athari zao kwa kupunguza ushuru ...
Somali: Soo koobid: Waxaa la sharaxay mowduucyo kala duwan oo ka socda wadahadaladaha marin u helka suuqa beeraha ee Ururka Ganacsiga Adduunka iyo saameyntooda hoos u dhigista khidmadaha ...
Dholuo: Weche motudore gi weche mag tich ma ne otim e riwruok mar World Trade Organization e wi wach donjo e chula mag weche mag pur, kaachiel gi kaka ne gipuonjo e wi wach dwoko chien tarigi ...

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens voter education centres in Siaya County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua vituo vya elimu ya wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Siaya Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya ayaa furaya xarumo waxbarasho codbixiyeyaasha ah ee degmada Siaya bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya biro yawo kuonde tiego josiasa e taon mar Siaya e dwe mar Agost.

English: DPP reminds residents of Wajir County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this landslides season.
Kiswahili: DPP inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia vivuko vilivyoteuliwa vya watembea kwa miguu wakati wa msimu huu wa maporomoko ya ardhi.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Wajir inay ilaaliyaan xadka xawaaraha iyo inay isticmaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lugta ku mara inta lagu jiro xilliyada dhulgariirada.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogweng' mar Wajir County mondo oluw tong' mar piyo kendo oti gi kuonde ma ji wuothoe e kinde mag yiengni mag lowo.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by SHA (Social Health Authority) will be held in Meru County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Meru Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ay soo qabanqaabisay SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Meru bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth maonge chudo ma olos gi SHA (Social Health Authority) ibiro tim e County mar Meru e dwe mar April.

English: Notice: IEBC launches an anti-corruption awareness drive in Marsabit County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC inazindua kampeni ya ufahamu dhidi ya ufisadi katika wilaya ya Marsabit Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka dhan ah musuqmaasuqa oo lagu wacyi gelinayo degmada Marsabit bisha May.
Dholuo: IEBC chako kampen mar kedo gi mibadhi e taon mar Marsabit e dwe mar Mei.

English: Tana River County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for January 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Tana River: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame la Januari 2024
Somali: Degmada Tana River: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Janaayo 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Aora Tana: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar achiel higa mar 2024

English: IEBC advises applicants in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee la heli karo.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo odhi e skul man machiegni mondo giyud tiegruok.

English: IPOA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kericho County that access to free legal aid is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisheria wa bure unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee degmada Kericho in helitaanka caawimaad sharci oo bilaash ah ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa joma osetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Kericho ni thuolo mar yudo kony ma onge chudo en gima ok ochuno.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Tana River County to attend with a valid national ID to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuhudhuria na kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
