Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo wacho ni: Yore mag thieth ne nyithindo matindo ibiro tim dwe mar ang'wen higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e Kaunti mar Nyandarua.

English: KEPHIS urges farmers in Meru County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Meru inay ka qeyb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e county mar Meru mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e weche mag pur mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok e kaka koth chue.

English: E-Citizen urges residents of Trans Nzoia County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuwasilisha maandishi ya maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Trans Nzoia inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga lagu soo gabagabeynayo si loo qaabeeyo goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: E-Citizen jiwo ji duto modak e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mondo gichop chenro mag chenro mag dongruok.

English: Chege Kirundi has been elected as the new Chairman of KTDA Holdings Board Tea farmers should stay informed of any upcoming changes in policies or operations
Kiswahili: Chege Kirundi amechaguliwa kuwa Mwenyekiti mpya wa Bodi ya Wakulima wa Chai ya KTDA wanapaswa kujulishwa kuhusu mabadiliko yoyote yajayo ya sera au uendeshaji.
Somali: Chege Kirundi ayaa loo doortay guddoomiyaha cusub ee Guddiga KTDA Holdings Tea beeraleyda waa inay ka warqabtaan isbeddellada soo socda ee siyaasadaha ama howlaha
Dholuo: Chige Kirundi oseyier kaka jatelo manyien mar KTDA Holdings Board Jo-Thi onego ong'e lokruok moro amora mabiro timore e chike kata tije

English: Notice: OGP opens the electoral calendar centres in Siaya County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: OGP inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Siaya Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: OGP waxay furaysaa xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee degmada Siaya bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: OGP chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e county mar Siaya e dwe mar Agost.

English: Key Times to Wash Hands: Before, during, & after preparing food Before eating food Before & after caring for someone sick Before & after treating a wound After using the toilet After blowing your nose, coughing, or sneezing After changing diapers...#KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Nyakati Muhimu za Kunawa Mikono: Kabla, wakati, na baada ya kuandaa chakula Kabla ya kula chakula Kabla na baada ya kumhudumia mgonjwa Kabla na baada ya kutibu jeraha Baada ya kutumia choo Baada ya kupuliza pua yako, kukohoa au kupiga chafya Baada ya kubadilisha nepi...#KomeshaCorona
Somali: Waqtiyada Muhiimka ah ee Gacmaha La Dhaqo: Kahor, inta lagu jiro, iyo ka dib diyaarinta cuntada Kahor intaadan cunin cuntada Kahor iyo ka dib daryeelka qof buka Kahor iyo ka dib daaweynta nabarka Ka dib markaad musqusha isticmaasho Ka dib markaad afuufto sankaaga, qufacaaga, ama hindhisto Ka dib markaad beddesho xafaayadda...#KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Kinde madongo mag lwoko lwedo: Kapok, e kinde, & bang’ loso chiemo Kapok ichamo chiemo Kapok & bang’ rito ng’at ma tuo Kapok & bang’ thieth mar ng’at ma tuo Bang’ tiyo kod ot mar ng’ato Bang’ ng’ado um, ng’ado, kata ng’ado Bang’ loko diapers...#KomeshaCorona

English: Get practical tips for successfully selling your maize to processors, including preparation, presentation, and negotiation strategies.
Kiswahili: Pata vidokezo vya vitendo vya kuuza mahindi yako kwa wasindikaji, ikiwa ni pamoja na maandalizi, uwasilishaji, na mikakati ya mazungumzo.
Somali: Hel talooyin wax ku ool ah oo aad si guul leh ugu iibin karto galleygaaga shirkadaha soo saara, oo ay ku jiraan diyaarinta, soo bandhigidda, iyo istaraatiijiyadaha wadahadalka.
Dholuo: Yud paro ma nyalo konyi ng'iewo cham e yo maber, moriwo nyaka kaka inyalo ikori, kaka inyalo chiwo cham, kod kaka inyalo loso cham.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Siaya County to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inahimiza mtu yeyote anayepambana na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri nasaha wa jamii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Siaya inuu ka qeyb galo kalfadhiga bilaashka ah ee bulshada.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma kedo gi tuoche mag pach e county mar Siaya mondo odhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Kajiado County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kajiado: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2022
Somali: Degmada Kajiado: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kajiado: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2022

English: IPOA warns residents of Turkana County to prepare for possible landslides this August.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa maporomoko ya ardhi Agosti hii.
Somali: IPOA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay u diyaar garoobaan dhulgariir dhici kara bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: IPOA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Turkana County ni giikre ne yiengni ma nyalo timore e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will be held in Marsabit County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ay qabanqaabisay qeybta kormeerka iyo ka jawaabista cudurrada ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Marsabit bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: kambi mar thieth ma onge chudo ma biro bedoe e dwe mar Mei e taon mar Marsabit.

English: Public notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response will host a free tobacco control outreach in Nakuru County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa itakuwa mwenyeji wa uhamasishaji wa bure wa kudhibiti tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay marti gelineysaa dadaal lacag la'aan ah oo ka dhan ah ka hortagga sigaarka ee Gobolka Nakuru bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Rango Kendo Luwo Tuoche biro timo kampen mar golo ndawa maonge chudo e taon mar Nakuru e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: 996,078 candidates registered for KCSE; 1,298,089 for KPSEA.
Kiswahili: Wagombea 996,078 waliosajiliwa kwa KCSE; 1,298,089 kwa KPSEA.
Somali: 996,078 codsadayaal ayaa ka diiwaangashan KCSE; 1,298,089 codsadaha KPSEA.
Dholuo: Jokanyo 996,078 ne ondikgi ne KCSE; 1,298,089 ne KPSEA.

English: Notice from Ministry of Health: childhood immunization clinics will run every September at designated health centres in Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya: kliniki za chanjo za watoto zitafanya kazi kila Septemba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka: rugta tallaalka carruurta ayaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Sebtember ee xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar weche thieth: Klinike mag thiedho nyithindo biro tiyo e dwe mar ochiko higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Kisii.

English: KEPHIS urges farmers in Kitui County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawataka wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachozingatia hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kitui inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Kitui mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi pur mar piny mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: IEBC reminds residents of Kitui County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kitui County kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui in ay ku hawlan yihiin maamulaha qaybta maxalliga ah si ay u xoojiyaan maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: IEBC paronwa jogweng' Kitui County ni tiyo gi jaritgi mar alwora jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Promote rain-water harvesting for micro-irrigation to support kitchen gardening and crop production during the dry season.
Kiswahili: Kukuza uvunaji wa maji ya mvua kwa umwagiliaji mdogo ili kusaidia bustani ya jikoni na uzalishaji wa mazao wakati wa kiangazi.
Somali: Dhiirrigelinta ururinta biyaha roobka ee micro-waraabka si loo taageero beerta jikada iyo wax-soo-saarka dalagga xilliga qalalan.
Dholuo: Jiwo choko pi koth mondo otigo e miyo pi opong' gi pi matin mondo okony e timo puothe mag puothe kod chamo cham e kinde ma piny ok yot.

English: Teachers Service Commission reminds parents in Taita-Taveta County that adult literacy classes registration is open this May.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kwamba usajili wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima umefunguliwa Mei hii.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu xusuusinayaa waalidiinta Gobolka Taita-Taveta in diiwaangelinta fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn ay furan tahay bisha May.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj oparo ne jonyuol man Taita-Taveta County ni ikruok mar somo kod somo ne joma dongo osechakore e dwe mar Mei.

English: KEMSA launches an August awareness campaign on safe water storage across Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Agosti juu ya uhifadhi wa maji salama katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: KEMSA waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Agoosto oo ku saabsan kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: KEMSA chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Agost kuom wach kano pi maler e County duto mar Nyeri.

English: Notice: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) will distribute certified maize seed to farmers in Meru County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itasambaza mbegu za mahindi zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay abuurka hadhuudhka la caddeeyay u qaybin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Meru bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) biro pogo kodhi mag mahinya ne jopur manie County mar Meru e dwe mar Julai.

English: Notice: Universities Fund announces free day secondary education enrollment dates for schools in Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya sekondari ya siku bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ku dhawaaqay taariikhda diiwaangelinta dugsiyada dugsiga sare ee Samburu County.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Yunivasiti Fund olando tarik mag somo mar sekondari ma onge chudo e skunde man Samburu County.

English: Public notice: KEMRI will host a free proper sanitation outreach in Taita-Taveta County this July.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: KEMRI itaandaa uhamasishaji wa usafi wa mazingira bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta Julai hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: KEMRI waxay marti gelineysaa adeegyo caafimaad oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku habboon Gobolka Taita-Taveta bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar ji duto: KEMRI biro timo chenro mar chiwo kony e wi thieth maber maonge chudo e kaunti mar Taita-Taveta e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kenya: Drought - IPC Projected Acute Food Insecurity (March - June 2023) for the ASALs of Kenya (3 Jul 2023)
Kiswahili: Kenya: Ukame - IPC Inakadiriwa Uhaba Mkubwa wa Chakula (Machi - Juni 2023) kwa ASALs of Kenya (3 Jul 2023)
Somali: Kenya: Abaar - IPC waxay saadaalisay in xaalad cunto xumo oo daran ay ka jirto (Maarso - Juun 2023) oo loogu talagalay ASAL-yada Kenya (3 Luulyo 2023)
Dholuo: Kenya: Oro - IPC Ogeno ni Chiemo biro bedo matek (Dwe mar Adek - Auchiel 2023) ne ASAL mag piny Kenya (3 dwe mar auchiel 2023)

English: Teachers Service Commission encourages out-of-school children in Lamu County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Lamu kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Lamu inay ku qortaan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee fasallada akhris-xisaabta dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e County mar Lamu mondo odonj e program mar somo kod somo mar joma dongo.

English: Notice: IPOA conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Marsabit County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: IPOA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada oo ku saabsan ka hortagga argagixisada ee degmada Marsabit bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA dhi timo romo mar oganda e dwe mar Agost e gweng' mar Marsabit.

English: Council of Governors urges residents of West Pokot County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya West Pokot wape huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku boorinayaan dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay dalbadaan bixinta adeegyada aan la bixin laaluush si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo odwar yudo kony maok ochulo asoya mondo giked gi mibadhi.

English: Public notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will host a free hypertension awareness outreach in Nyamira County this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu bila malipo katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska Dadweynaha: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa qaban doonta wacyi galin bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cadaadiska dhiig karka ee degmada Nyamira bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar oganda: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo kampen mar chiwo kony ne ji kuom wach remo mang'eny e kaunti mar Nyamira e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Kenya Dairy Board announces a free Newcastle disease vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Meru County this July.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya yatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa Newcastle kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Meru Julai hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa ku dhawaaqay jimicsi tallaal oo bilaash ah oo cudurka Newcastle ah oo loogu talagalay lo'da caanaha ee degmada Meru bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board ong'ado mar timo chenro mar thieth maonge chudo mar Newcastle mar dhiang'o mar dhok e dwe mar Julai e kaunti mar Meru.

English: Parents should register the birth of their child at the nearest civil registration office. A birth certificate secures a child_x0092_s legal identity and access to services.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanapaswa kusajili kuzaliwa kwa mtoto wao katika ofisi ya usajili wa kiraia ya karibu. cheti cha kuzaliwa kinahakikisha utambulisho wa kisheria wa mtoto na upatikanaji wa huduma.
Somali: Waalidiintu waa inay dhalashada ilmahooda ka diiwaan geliyaan xafiiska diiwaangelinta madaniga ah ee ugu dhow. Shahaadada dhalashada waxay xaqiijinaysaa aqoonsiga sharciga ah ee child_x0092_s iyo helitaanka adeegyada.
Dholuo: Jonyuol onego ondiki nyuol mar nyathigi e ofis man machiegni ahinya mar ndiko nying’ nyathigi. Oboke mar nyuol rito ng’eyo mar nyathi_x0092_e chik kendo yudo kony.

English: DCI urges the public in Kericho County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of identity theft.
Kiswahili: DCI inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Kericho wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za wizi wa kitambulisho.
Somali: DCI waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kericho inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa qof kasta oo ka dambeeya kiisaska la soo sheegay ee tuugista aqoonsiga.
Dholuo: DCI jiwo ji duto e County mar Kericho mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' weche mag kwalo kitgi.

English: Notice: State Department for Basic Education announces free primary education enrollment dates for schools in Meru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Msingi yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa elimu ya msingi bila malipo kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Meru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Waaxda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Gobolka ayaa ku dhawaaqday taariikhaha diiwaangelinta waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah ee dugsiyada degmada Meru.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar Puonjruok ma Chakre e Piny owacho, olando tarik ma nyithindo nyalo donjoe e skul mag Meru County maonge chudo.

English: SACCO members are assured that their savings are not at risk claims about government access to these funds for infrastructure projects are false and legally unfounded
Kiswahili: Wanachama wa SACCO wamehakikishiwa kuwa madai yao ya akiba hayako hatarini kuhusu serikali kupata fedha hizi za miradi ya miundombinu ni ya uongo na hayana msingi kisheria.
Somali: Xubnaha SACCO waxaa lagu xaqiijiyay in kaydkoodu aysan halis ku jirin, sheegashooyinka ku saabsan helitaanka dowladda ee lacagahan ee mashaariicda kaabayaasha ay been yihiin oo sharci ahaan aan sal lahayn.
Dholuo: Owete SACCO nigi geno ni pesa ma gichiwo ok dhi e chandruok nikech weche ma sirkal wacho ni sirkal nyalo yudo pesago e tije mag gedo gin miriambo kendo onge tiende.

English: Notice: SHA opens a new service point for e-Citizen registration in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: SHA inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa ajili ya usajili wa e-Wananchi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Shirkadda SHA waxay furaysaa goob adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta e-muwaadiniinta ee Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: SHA oseyawo kama itimee tije manyien mag ndiko e-Citizen e Kaunti mar Kakamega.

English: FAO invites farmers in Kisumu County to a free training on fertiliser application this August.
Kiswahili: FAO inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kwenye mafunzo ya bure juu ya matumizi ya mbolea Agosti hii.
Somali: FAO waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Kisumu tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan isticmaalka bacriminta bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: FAO gwelo jopur e gweng' mar Kisumu mondo otim tiegruok maonge chudo kuom wach tiyo gi yien e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: DPP conducts a community briefing on national peace-building in Narok County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: DPP inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya kujenga amani ya kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Narok Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DPP waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada oo ku saabsan dhismaha nabadda qaranka ee Gobolka Narok bishii Ogosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: DPP timo romo mar oganda e wi loso kuwe e gweng' mar Narok e dwe mar Agost.

English: Notice: Kenya Medical Association will hold a stress management forum in Machakos County this June. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitafanya kongamano la kudhibiti mafadhaiko katika Kaunti ya Machakos Juni hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha maareynta stress ee degmada Machakos bisha Juun. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni Kenya Medical Association biro timo chokruok mar kedo gi parruok e taon mar Machakos e dwe mar Jun. Ji duto mor.

English: KEPHIS urges farmers in Tana River County to attend the free training on climate-smart agriculture to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuhudhuria mafunzo ya bure juu ya kilimo kinachofaa hali ya hewa ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda degmada Tana River inay ka qayb galaan tababarka bilaashka ah ee ku saabsan beeraha cimilada ee caqliga leh si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddellada roobabka.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e taon mar Tana River County mondo odhi e tiegruok ma onge chudo e weche mag pur, mondo okonygi nyagore gi lokruok e kaka koth chue.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development informs horticultural produce farmers in Nyandarua County of new market linkage opportunities this October.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inawafahamisha wakulima wa mazao ya bustani katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kuhusu fursa mpya za kuunganisha soko Oktoba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay uga warrameysaa beeraleyda wax soo saarka beeraha ee degmada Nyandarua fursadaha cusub ee xiriirka suuqa bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development olero ne jopur ma loso puothe e County mar Nyandarua thuolo manyien mag tudruok gi ohala e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Council of Governors advises residents of Embu County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay kula talinayaan dadka deggan degmada Embu inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow marka ay raadinayaan adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: Council of Governors nyiso jogweng' Embu County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni kodgi sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport.

English: Notice: NDMA activates an emergency response plan for road accidents in Kitui County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NDMA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa ajali za barabarani katika Kaunti ya Kitui.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo loogu talagalay shilalka waddooyinka ee Gobolka Kitui.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA tiyo gi chenro mar kawo okang' mapiyo ne masiche ma timore e nderni e gweng' mar Kitui.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya calls on residents of Murang'a County to report unusual activity along border areas to security agencies in support of border security.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaomba wakazi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a kuripoti shughuli zisizo za kawaida kwenye maeneo ya mpaka kwa mashirika ya usalama kwa msaada wa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ku baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Murang'a inay u soo sheegaan hay'adaha amniga waxqabadka aan caadiga ahayn ee ku yaal meelaha xuduudka ah si ay u taageeraan amniga xuduudda.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo jogweng' mar Murang'a County mondo ochiw ripot ne sirkande mag sirkal e wi gik ma ne timore e alwora mar tong'gi.

English: Meru (Meru-North) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Meru (Meru-Kaskazini): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Machi 2024
Somali: Degmada Meru (Meru-Waqooyi): War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Meru (Meru-Nyath): Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Adek 2024

English: Cash Programming Kenya Review 2018 - 2022
Kiswahili: Mapitio ya Kuandaa Pesa Kenya 2018 - 2022
Somali: Dib u eegista Barnaamijka Lacagta ee Kenya 2018 - 2022
Dholuo: Nonro mar chenro mar omwom e piny Kenya higa mar 2018 - 2022

English: Notice: Directorate of Criminal Investigations opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Idara ya Utafiti wa Jinai inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa furaya xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya taageero maskaxeed ee gobolka Bomet.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Ofis mar weche motudore gi timbe mahundu ochako ofis ma konyo joma ok gin rowere e alwora mar Bomet County.

English: AFA advises milk producers in Nairobi County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: AFA inashauri wazalishaji wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuuza mazao kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa tu kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: AFA waxay kula talineysaa soosaarayaasha caanaha ee degmada Nairobi inay ka iibsadaan wax soo saarka kaliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: AFA nyiso jopur mag chak e County mar Nairobi ni giusgi mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo chakre kinde keyo.

English: Announcement of TOT training initiative for 26 health workers from four counties under BFHI supported by USAID.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la mpango wa mafunzo ya TOT kwa wafanyakazi 26 wa afya kutoka kaunti nne chini ya BFHI inayoungwa mkono na USAID.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida dadaalka tababarka TOT ee loogu talagalay 26 shaqaale caafimaad oo ka socda afar degmo oo hoos yimaada BFHI oo ay taageerto USAID.
Dholuo: Walando chenro mar tiego jorit thieth 26 moa e gwenge ang'wen e bwo BFHI makonyo gi USAID.

English: Huduma Kenya updates residents of Kwale County on progress of community-based development programmes this January.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kuhusu maendeleo ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jumuiya mwezi huu wa Januari.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay dadka deggan degmada Kwale ku wargelineysaa horumarka barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya osemiyo jodak ma Kwale County ong'eyo dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag oganda e dwe mar Januar.

English: The Kenyan government has allocated Kshs 8 billion for a maize meal subsidy program effective immediately and running until August 20 2022 Prices are set at Kshs 52 for 1 kg Kshs 100 for 2 kgs and so on
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya imetenga Kshs 8 bilioni kwa ajili ya mpango wa ruzuku ya unga wa mahindi unaoanza mara moja na unaendelea hadi Agosti 20 2022 Bei zimewekwa kwa Kshs 52 kwa kilo 1 Ksh 100 kwa kilo 2 na kadhalika.
Somali: Dowladda Kenya waxay u qoondeysay Kshs 8 bilyan barnaamij kaalmo cunto galley ah oo si degdeg ah u dhaqan galaya ilaa August 20, 2022. Qiimaha waxaa lagu dejiyay Kshs 52 1 kg, Kshs 100 2 kg, iyo wixii la mid ah
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya osechiwo Kshs bilion 8 ne program mar chiwo kony ne cham mar cham mar kodhi ma biro chakore mapiyo kendo biro dhi nyime nyaka Agost 20 2022

English: IPOA warns residents of Marsabit County to prepare for possible drought this January.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kujiandaa kwa ukame unaowezekana Januari hii.
Somali: IPOA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inay isu diyaariyaan abaaraha iman kara bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: IPOA chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar Marsabit County mondo giikre ne oro ma nyalo betie e dwe mar Januar.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces SHA registration for residents of Samburu County starting this May.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatangaza usajili wa SHA kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Samburu kuanzia Mei hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhawaaqday diiwaangelinta SHA ee dadka deggan Gobolka Samburu laga bilaabo Maajo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duoko ne Tuoche ogolo chik mar SHA mar ndiko joma odak e county mar Samburu kochakore e dwe mar abich.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) invites farmers in Narok County to a free training on modern irrigation techniques this June.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok kwa mafunzo ya bure juu ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji Juni hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda gobolka Narok tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) ogwelo jopur manie Narok County e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi yore mag lero pi e dwe mar Jun.

English: Council of Governors encourages first-time voters in Nyamira County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawatia moyo wapiga kura wa kwanza katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyayaashu waxay ku dhiirigelinayaan codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Nyamira inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo joma okwongo yiero e Kaunti mar Nyamira mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Meru County that access to subsidised dialysis is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Meru kwamba upatikanaji wa dialysis ya ruzuku sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Meru in helitaanka dialysis-ka la taageeray hadda laga heli karo xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMRI oparo ne ji duto manie County mar Meru ni koro ginyalo yudo thieth mar dialysis e kuonde moyier.

English: Embu (Mbeere) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Embu (Mbeere): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Machi 2023
Somali: Degmada Embu (Mbeere): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Embu (Mbeere): Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar adek higa mar 2023

English: Notice: KEMRI confirms a meningitis outbreak alert for Elgeyo-Marakwet County. Residents are advised to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa uti wa mgongo kwa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay xaqiijineysaa feejignaanta cudurka meningitis ee gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga leh mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KEMRI osenyiso ni nitie masira mar tuo mar meningitis e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: KALRO advises farmers in Tana River County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the June planting season.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Juni.
Somali: KALRO waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Tana River inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagyada si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda ka hor xilliga beerashada Juun.
Dholuo: KALRO jiwo jopur e taon mar Tana River County mondo otim lokruok e puothe mondo omi lowo obed gi nyak kapok ochopo dwe mar Jun.

English: IPOA warns residents of Kericho County to prepare for possible road accidents this May.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Mei hii.
Somali: IPOA waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay u diyaar garoobaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha May.
Dholuo: IPOA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kericho County mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Mei.

English: KRA urges residents of Tana River County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Tana River kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya wilaya ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e loso chenro mag dongruok.

English: DPP warns residents of Kilifi County about a rise in phishing messages and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: DPP inawaonya wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kilifi kuhusu ongezeko la ujumbe wa udanganyifu na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: DPP waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi kororka farriimaha phishing waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: DPP osiemo jogweng' Kilifi County kuom medruok mar weche mag phishing kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: Ministry of Education urges residents of Marsabit County to enroll in the adult literacy programme to benefit from school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa watu wazima ili kufaidika na mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inay ku biiraan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn si ay uga faa'iideystaan barnaamijyada quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok jiwo jogweng' mar Marsabit County mondo odonj e program mar somo gi somo mar joma dongo mondo giyud konyruok kuom program mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Nairobi County that access to eye and dental camps is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kwamba upatikanaji wa kambi za macho na meno sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nairobi in helitaanka xeryaha indhaha iyo ilkaha ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) paronwa ji duto manie County mar Nairobi ni koro nitie kuonde ma ji yudoe thieth mag wang' kod lakteche mag laktech.

English: Wajir County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Wajir: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2024
Somali: Degmada Wajeer: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Wajir: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar apar 2024

English: Notice: TVET reminds citizens in Tharaka-Nithi County about their rights regarding devolution.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kuhusu haki zao kuhusu ugatuzi.
Somali: Xusuusin: TVET waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Tharaka-Nithi xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan wareejinta.
Dholuo: Rapar: TVET paronwa raia mag Tharaka-Nithi County kuom ratiro ma gin-go mar golo pesa.

English: Kenya Forest Service warns residents of Nyamira County to prepare for possible fire outbreaks this April.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Misitu ya Kenya inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa milipuko ya moto Aprili hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kaymaha Kenya wuxuu ka digay dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inay isu diyaariyaan dabka dhici kara bisha April.
Dholuo: Kenya Forest Service chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nyamira County mondo giikre ne yiengni manyalo timore e dwe mar April.

English: Ministry of Health encourages mothers in Vihiga County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Vihiga inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health jiwo mine e County mar Vihiga mondo odonj e kad mar ngima mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima mar nyithindgi.

English: KTDA urges goats farmers in Mombasa County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported foot and mouth disease cases.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawataka wafugaji wa mbuzi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa kufuatia kuripotiwa visa vya ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda orgiga ee degmada Mombasa inay xoolahooda tallaalaan meelaha loo qoondeeyey ee lagu burburiyo ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee cudurka afka iyo afka.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur mag diek e county mar Mombasa mondo ogeng'e legi e kuonde moketi mag chwoyo diek bang' ka osenyis ni nitie tuoche mag dhoot.

English: KTDA advises farmers in Kakamega County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides ahead of the January planting season.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Januari.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kakamega inay ka hortagaan cayayaanka ciidanka xilliga dayrta iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaannada la ansixiyay ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Janaayo.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e Kaunti mar Kakamega mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok chon ka pok ochopo higa mar Januar.

English: Learn about Plant Variety Protection rights and how they encourage the development of new improved mangoes varieties
Kiswahili: Jifunze kuhusu haki za Ulinzi wa Aina za Mimea na jinsi zinavyohimiza uundaji wa aina mpya na zilizoboreshwa za maembe
Somali: Baro xuquuqda Ilaalinta Noocyada Dhirta iyo sida ay u dhiirrigeliyaan horumarinta noocyada cusub ee mango-yada la hagaajiyay
Dholuo: Puonjri kuom ratiro ma Nyasaye nigo mar rito kit yiende kod kaka gikonyo e loso kit mang'we manyien

English: KNEC advises students in Lamu County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Lamu kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Somali: KNEC waxay ardayda degmada Lamu kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga deeqda waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan deeq waxbarasho oo loogu talagalay ardayda u baahan.
Dholuo: KNEC jiwo jopuonjre e County mar Lamu mondo oketgi e intanet mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo chiwo mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre mochando.

English: Notice: KTDA will distribute certified sorghum seed to farmers in Migori County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KTDA itasambaza mbegu za mtama zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Migori Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KTDA waxay abuuraha Degmada Migori u qaybin doontaa abuurka sorghum ee la caddeeyay bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KTDA biro pogo kodhi mag sorghum ne jopur man Migori County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free cholera screening is available at all public health centres in Nairobi County this August.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa kipindupindu bila malipo unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Agosti hii.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in baaritaanka fayraska ee bilaashka ah lagu heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha ee Gobolka Nairobi bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: KEMSA oparo ne ji ni nonro ma onge cholera ibiro tim maonge chudo e kuonde thieth duto e County mar Nairobi e dwe mar Agost.

English: National Research Fund unveils scholarship program for digital learning innovation projects by students and researchers.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Kitaifa wa Utafiti unafunua programu ya usomi kwa miradi ya uvumbuzi ya kujifunza digital na wanafunzi na watafiti.
Somali: Sanduuqa Cilmi-baarista Qaranka wuxuu soo bandhigayaa barnaamijka deeqaha waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay mashaariicda hal-abuurnimada barashada dhijitaalka ah ee ardayda iyo cilmi-baarayaasha.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar National Research Fund osefwenyo chenro mar chulo osuru ne josomo kod josayans e tij timo dongruok e digital learning.

English: Climate Information Services and Risk-Contingent Credit: Examining the CGIAR Initiative on Climate Resilience (ClimBeR) Influence and Intervention Impact
Kiswahili: Huduma za Taarifa za Hali ya Hewa na Mikopo ya Hatari: Kuchunguza Mpango wa CGIAR juu ya Ustahimilivu wa Hali ya Hewa (ClimBeR) Ushawishi na Athari za Kuingilia
Somali: Adeegyada Macluumaadka Cimilada iyo Dhibcaha Khatarta ku Jira: Baaritaanka Hindisaha CGIAR ee ku saabsan Adkeysiga Cimilada (ClimBeR) iyo Saamaynta Faragelinta
Dholuo: Tich mar ng’eyo weche mag piny kod pesa ma nyalo kelo luoro: Rango chenro mar CGIAR kuom kaka piny nyalo geng’o piny (ClimBeR) kod kaka ng’ato nyalo donjo e gik moko

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development urges youth in Kisumu County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Machadka Horumarinta Manhajka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dhalinyarada degmada Kisumu inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada rayidka ah ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada rayidnimada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo rowere e County mar Kisumu mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok gitimo gik ma biro timore e kind oganda.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free dengue fever screening is available at all public health centres in Mandera County this April.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba uchunguzi wa bure wa homa ya dengue unapatikana katika vituo vyote vya afya vya umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera Aprili hii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in baaritaanka xanuunka dengue ee bilaashka ah laga heli karo dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynta ee Degmada Mandera bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji ni thieth ma onge chudo mar dengue yudore e kuonde thieth duto man Mandera County e dwe mar April.

English: E-Citizen reminds voters in Meru County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day ahead of polling procedures.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha wapiga kura katika Kaunti ya Meru kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura kabla ya utaratibu wa kupiga kura.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa codbixiyayaasha degmada Meru inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta ka hor nidaamyada doorashada.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa jogweng'o e county mar Meru mondo oting'e ID kata passport mar pinygi e odiechieng' mar yiero ka pok oyud thuolo mar timo yiero.

English: Farming using tractors and technology, early planning between farmets and sellers need support in building rapport, and environment as the foundation to boost peasants and the rich together. It's of no profit when a farmer canÌˆnot sell...

Somali: Beerashada iyadoo la adeegsanayo cagafyo iyo tignoolajiyad, qorsheynta hore ee u dhaxaysa beeralayda iyo iibiyayaashu waxay u baahan yihiin taageero dhisidda xiriir, iyo deegaan oo ah aasaaska kor u qaadida beeralayda iyo kuwa hodanka ah oo wada jira. English: KTDA promotes agroforestry among farmers in Garissa County as part of the June climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: KTDA inakuza kilimo cha misitu kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Garissa kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Juni.
Somali: KTDA waxay dhiirrigelisay beeraleyda beeraha ee Gobolka Garissa iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Juun.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo yiende mag yiende e kind jopur e County mar Garissa kaka achiel kuom chenro mar dwe mar Jun mar kedo gi lokruok e kit yamo.

English: IPOA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Kisii County that access to post-violence medical care is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu zinapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan ee degmada Kisii in helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ka dib rabshaduhu uu yahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e County mar Kisii ni yudo kony mar thieth ma iyudo bang' timbe mag mahundu en gima ng'ato nyalo timo maonge chudo.

English: Disrupting harm in Kenya: Evidence on online child sexual exploitation and abuse
Kiswahili: Kutatiza madhara nchini Kenya: Ushahidi kuhusu unyanyasaji na unyanyasaji wa kingono kwa watoto mtandaoni

Dholuo: Kuong’o hinyruok e piny Kenya: Ranyisi kuom tiyo gi nyithindo e yo marach kendo kethogi e mbui

English: Kenya, Garissa and Turkana Counties: Addressing water and sanitation challenges for schools and health facilities (November 2024)
Kiswahili: Kaunti za Kenya, Garissa na Turkana: Kushughulikia changamoto za maji na usafi wa mazingira kwa shule na vituo vya afya (Novemba 2024)
Somali: Degmooyinka Kenya, Garissa iyo Turkana: Wax ka qabashada caqabadaha biyaha iyo nadaafadda ee dugsiyada iyo xarumaha caafimaadka (Nofeembar 2024)
Dholuo: Kaunti mag Kenya, Garissa kod Turkana: Loyo yore mag pi kod ler e sikunde kod kuonde thieth (Apar apar gi achiel 2024)

English: Baringo County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for October 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Baringo: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Oktoba 2023
Somali: Degmada Baringo: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Oktoobar 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Baringo: Oboke machon mar oro mar dwe mar apar 2023

English: DPP alerts residents of Kwale County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: DPP anawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale juu ya kuongezeka kwa kesi za utekaji nyara na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka kwa kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: DPP waxay dadka deggan degmada Kwale uga digtay kororka kiisaska gaadiidka la xaday waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: DPP chiwo siem ne jogweng' Kwale County kuom wach medruok mar wuondo mtokni kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot e stesen mar polise man machiegni.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds residents of Migori County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi wakati wa msimu huu wa mafuriko.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka deggan degmada Migori ku xasuusinaya inay guryahooda ku rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo inay shaqeeyaan xilliyada fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations oparo ne jogweng' Migori County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag nego ligek mach e utegi kendo giti e kinde mag koth.

English: Ministry of Health launches a November awareness campaign on hypertension awareness across Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Novemba juu ya uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu katika Kaunti ya Bomet.

English: COMESA announces a free lumpy skin disease vaccination exercise for pigs in Kericho County this June.

Kiswahili: Kumbuka: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unafungua dawati la jinsia kutoa huduma za matibabu baada ya vurugu katika Kaunti ya Mandera.

Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Red Cross oyawo ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo kony mar thieth bang' timbe mahundu e county mar Mandera.

Kiswahili: NTSA inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuepuka kuvuka madaraja na mito iliyofurika ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na mafuriko.

Dholuo: NTSA jiwo derebe kod joma wuotho e gweng' mar Kilifi mondo kik ging'ad orujre kod aoche ma pi opong'o mondo gikwed masiche ma timore nikech pi.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges motorists and pedestrians in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu la Kenya linawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.

Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jowuoth kod joma wuotho e nderni mag Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko mach e utegi kendo gitim kinda mar geng'o chandruoge mag oro.

Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Kericho dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Kericho inay musuqmaasuqa ka qaataan xafiisyada dawladda.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e County mar Kericho kuom kawo asoya e migepe mag oganda.

English: Depression is a common mental disorder and one of the main causes of disability worldwide. WHO estimates that globally 264 million people are affected by depression.
Kiswahili: Msongo wa mawazo ni ugonjwa wa kawaida wa akili na mojawapo ya sababu kuu za ulemavu duniani kote. WHO inakadiria kuwa duniani kote watu milioni 264 wameathiriwa na msongo wa mawazo.
Somali: Dhibaatadu waa cudur maskaxeed oo caadi ah oo ah mid ka mid ah sababaha ugu waaweyn ee naafonimada adduunka.
Dholuo: Tuo mar depression en tuwo masiko e pach ji kendo en achiel kuom gik madongo mamiyo ji bedo gi midekre e piny mangima. Riwruok mar WHO wacho ni ji milion 264 e piny ngima nigi tuwo mar parruok.

English: EACC announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Nyeri County.
Kiswahili: EACC inatangaza nyakati bora za kugeuza kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Nyeri.
Somali: EACC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay ka shaqeynta shahaadada dhalashada ee degmada Nyeri.
Dholuo: EACC olando lokruok e seche mag timo nonro mag nyasi mag nyuol e County mar Nyeri.

English: DPP urges residents of Kakamega County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to border security.
Kiswahili: DPP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa tahadhari kubwa kwa usalama wa mpaka.
Somali: DPP waxay dadka deggan degmada Kakamega ugu baaqeysaa inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta deegaanka iyada oo diiradda la saarayo amniga xuduudaha.
Dholuo: DPP jiwo jogweng' Kakamega County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gweng'no e kinde ma ji medo keto pachgi kuom rito tong'.

English: Kenya Red Cross advises residents of Tana River County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Tana River kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Laanta Cas ee Kenya waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River inay qaataan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo jogweng' mar Tana River County mondo oting'e ID mar pinygi maber sama gidwaro thieth mondo giyud thieth makonyogi.

English: KUCCPS reminds youth in Kisii County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kisii in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka cuntada iyo martigelinta.
Dholuo: KUCCPS oparo ne rowere man Kisii County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar chiemo kod mar rwako welo.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) urges residents of Kisii County to track project progress through the county website to stay informed on ward-level service delivery.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Usimamizi (Ombudsman) inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti ili kuwa na habari juu ya usambazaji wa huduma katika ngazi ya wilaya.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay la socdaan horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo bogga internetka ee degmada si ay uga warqabtaan bixinta adeegyada heerka degmada.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogweng' Kisii County mondo oluw dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county mondo gisik ka ging'eyo weche duto motudore gi tij lendo e gwenge.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit appeals to caregivers in Nairobi County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the July maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi Julai.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka ayaa ugu baaqay daryeelayaasha degmada Nairobi inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha ee qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit okwayo jorit e County mar Nairobi mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi e dwe mar Julai.

English: Meru (Meru-North) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Meru (Meru-Kaskazini): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Aprili 2022
Somali: Degmada Meru (Meru-Waqooyi): War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Meru (Meru-Nyath): Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Oro mar Ang'wen 2022

English: Kenya Medical Association launches a January awareness campaign on hand hygiene across Kericho County.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kizindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Januari juu ya usafi wa mikono katika Kaunti ya Kericho.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu bilaabay olole wacyi galineed bishii Janaayo oo ku saabsan nadaafadda gacmaha ee Gobolka Kericho.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association ochako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Januar e wi ler mar lwedo e County duto mar Kericho.

Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Embu (Mbeere): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame ya Novemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Embu (Mbeere): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Noofambar 2022

English: Notice from Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: postnatal check-ups clinics will run every March at designated health centres in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi: kliniki za uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa zitafanya kazi kila Machi katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta caafimaadka taranka: rugaha baaritaanka dhalmada ka dib waxaa lagu qaban doonaa bishii Maarso oo dhan xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Kwale.
Dholuo: Rieko moa e Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit: Klinike mag nonro bang' nyuol ibiro timie higa ka higa e dwe mar Mach e kuonde thieth moyier e Kaunti mar Kwale.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) promotes soil conservation among farmers in Kisii County as part of the August climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inakuza uhifadhi wa udongo miongoni mwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Agosti.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay kor u qaadeysaa ilaalinta ciidda beeraleyda degmada Kisii iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka cimilada ee Agoosto.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo rito lowo e kind jopur e County mar Kisii kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo lokruok e kor lwasi mar lokruok mar piny e dwe mar Agost.

English: IEBC encourages out-of-school children in Taita-Taveta County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kutuma maombi ya bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee Gobolka Taita-Taveta inay codsadaan deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee fasallada akhriska dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e Taita-Taveta County mondo okonygi kapok kindeno ochopo.

English: Council of Governors announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Turkana County.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Turkana.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku dhawaaqeen waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Turkana.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch ogolo lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mag kwayo mar bedo gi kidono e County mar Turkana.

English: It should be noted that about a quarter of all the HPV-positive women were not triaged, and therefore an effective fail-safe mechanism to track and trace such women is necessary.
Kiswahili: Ikumbukwe kwamba takriban robo ya wanawake wote walio na HPV hawakufanyiwa vipimo, na kwa hivyo utaratibu madhubuti wa kushindwa kuwafuatilia na kuwafuatilia wanawake kama hao ni muhimu.
Somali: Waa in la ogaadaa in qiyaastii rubuc ka mid ah dhammaan haweenka qaba HPV aan la kala saarin, sidaas darteedna waa lagama maarmaan in la helo hab wax ku ool ah oo lagu raadraaco laguna raadraaco haweenka noocaas ah.
Dholuo: Owinjore wang’e ni chiegni achiel kuom ang’wen mag mon duto ma ne nigi HPV ne ok otimnegi triage, kendo kuom mano, yo maber mar luwo kendo luwo mon ma kamago dwarore.

English: KRA announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: KRA inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kuajiri kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: KRA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay ka shaqeynta shahaadada dhalashada ee Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: KRA olando lokruok e seche mag timo nonro mag nyasi mag nyuol e Kaunti mar Kakamega.

English: Notice: NDMA issues a cybersecurity alert on phishing messages affecting residents of Machakos County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inatoa tahadhari ya usalama wa mtandao juu ya ujumbe wa udanganyifu unaowaathiri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Machakos.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay soo saartay digniin amniga internetka oo ku saabsan fariimaha phishing ee saameeya dadka deggan degmada Machakos.
Dholuo: Rapar: NDMA ogolo siem mar rito weche mag cybersecurity e wi ote mag phishing makelo hinyruok ne joma odak e County ma Machakos.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education launches a guidance and counselling services programme in schools across Kirinyaga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu yazindua mpango wa huduma za mwongozo na ushauri nasaha katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kirinyaga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay bilawday barnaamij adeegyo hagis iyo la-talin ah oo ku yaal dugsiyada gobolka Kirinyaga.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Education chako chenro mar tayo kendo chiwo paro e skunde duto e County mar Kirinyaga.

English: KNEC reminds youth in Samburu County that HELB funding is available for catering and hospitality training.
Kiswahili: KNEC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya upishi na ukarimu.
Somali: KNEC waxay xasuusineysaa dhalinyarada gobolka Samburu in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka cuntada iyo marti-gelinta.
Dholuo: KNEC oparo ne rowere man Samburu County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar chiemo kod mar rwako welo.

English: The government is considering revising the Coffee Cherry Fund regulations to better benefit coffee farmers including potential access to farm inputs on credit
Kiswahili: Serikali inafikiria kurekebisha kanuni za Mfuko wa Coffee Cherry ili kuwanufaisha vyema wakulima wa kahawa ikiwa ni pamoja na kupata pembejeo za kilimo kwa mkopo.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay ka fiirsanaysaa dib-u-eegista xeerarka Sanduuqa Kafeega Cherry si ay uga faa'iideysato beeraleyda qaxwaha, oo ay ku jirto suurtagalnimada helidda alaabta beeraleyda ee amaahda
Dholuo: Sirkal nono mondo otim lokruok e chike mag Chudo mar Coffee Cherry mondo okony jopur mag kahwa moriwo nyaka yudo gik ma ginyalo chamo e puothegi kokalo kuom pesa

English: Kenya Red Cross announces eye and dental camps for residents of Meru County starting this March.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya watangaza kambi za macho na meno kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kuanzia Machi hii.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa ku dhawaaqday xeryo indhaha iyo ilkaha loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Meru laga bilaabo bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ogolo kambi mag thieth mag wang' kod lakteche mag laktech ne jogweng' mar Meru County kochakore e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Mombasa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Mombasa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu qaban doonaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynta ee gobolka Mombasa.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Jarit Maduong' biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi weche siasa e county mar Mombasa.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) invites farmers in Kericho County to a free training on modern irrigation techniques this February.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho kupata mafunzo ya bure juu ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji Februari hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku martiqaadeysaa beeraleyda degmada Kericho tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) ogwelo jopur e County mar Kericho e tiegruok maonge chudo e wi yore mag lero pi e dwe mar Februar.

English: Butere Subcounty public health officers conducts #COVID19 screening and sensitization along the road to prevent the potential spread of the virus within the communities. #KomeshaCorona update.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wa afya ya umma wa Kaunti Ndogo ya Butere hufanya uchunguzi na uhamasishaji wa #COVID19 barabarani ili kuzuia uwezekano wa kuenea kwa virusi ndani ya jamii. #KomeshaCorona sasisho.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya warns residents of Vihiga County about a rise in mobile money scams and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Vihiga kuhusu ongezeko la udanganyifu wa simu za mkononi na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Vihiga in ay ka badan yihiin khiyaamooyinka lacagta mobilada waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Communications Authority chiwo siem ne ji modak e County mar Vihiga e wi medruok mar timbe mag wuondo pesa mag simo kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Laikipia County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Laikipia in warbixinta khiyaanada si deg deg ah ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NTSA parone jogweng' Laikipia County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar wuond konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: COMESA advises farmers in Kisumu County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kuleta nambari zao za usajili wa wakulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kisumu inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qaybqaataan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: COMESA nyiso jopur e gweng' mar Kisumu mondo okel namba margi mar ndiko jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: DPP warns residents of Nyandarua County about a rise in identity theft and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: DPP inawaonya wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua juu ya kuongezeka kwa wizi wa kitambulisho na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: DPP waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan gobolka Nyandarua kororka xadgudubka aqoonsiga waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: DPP chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nyandarua County e wi medruok mar kuo mar kitgi kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: IEBC invites residents of Marsabit County to attend the public participation forum regarding the county budget process.
Kiswahili: IEBC inakaribisha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Marsabit kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma kuhusu mchakato wa bajeti ya wilaya.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit inay ka qeybgalaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan habka miisaaniyadda degmada.
Dholuo: IEBC gwelo jogweng' mar Marsabit County mondo obi e chokruok mar ji duto motudore gi chenro mar bajet mar county.
