English: CDC calls on parents in Wajir County to have children under five screened for malaria during the July outreach.
Kiswahili: CDC inatoa wito kwa wazazi katika Kaunti ya Wajir kuwafanya watoto chini ya miaka mitano wachunguzwe malaria wakati wa mawasiliano ya Julai.
Somali: CDC waxay ku baaqeysaa waalidiinta degmada Wajir inay carruurta ka yar shan sano u sameeyaan baaritaanka cudurka daacuunka inta lagu gudajiro bisha Luulyo.
Dholuo: CDC okwayo jonyuol e County mar Wajir mondo otim nonro ne nyithindo ma johigni abich e dwe mar Julai.

English: Kitui County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kitui: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2024
Somali: Degmada Kitui: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kitui: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2024

English: Kenya Dairy Board invites farmers in Nyamira County to a free training on modern irrigation techniques this April.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kupata mafunzo ya bure juu ya mbinu za kisasa za umwagiliaji Aprili hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa ku casuumay beeraleyda degmada Nyamira inay tababar lacag la'aan ah ku helaan farsamooyinka waraabinta casriga ah bisha Abriil.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board ogwelo jopur man Nyamira County e tiegruok maonge chudo e wi yore mag lero pi e dwe mar April.

English: Huduma Kenya urges residents of Busia County to demand service delivery without paying bribes to fight bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Busia kudai kutoa huduma bila kulipa rushwa ili kupambana na rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Busia inay dalbadaan adeegyo aan la bixin laaluush si looga hortago laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jogweng' mar County mar Busia mondo okonygi ka ok gichiwo asoya mondo giked gi asoya e migepe mag sirkal.

English: KEMRI advises residents of Bungoma County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa msaada wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMRI waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow si ay uga caawiyaan helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka ee lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMRI nyiso jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni mondo giyud kony mar yudo kony kuom weche thieth.

English: Notice: NDMA opens a gender desk offering psychosocial support in Garissa County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NDMA inafungua ofisi ya jinsia kutoa msaada wa kisaikolojia katika Kaunti ya Garissa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NDMA waxay furaysaa xafiis dhinaca jinsiga ah oo bixiya taageero maskaxeed ee gobolka Garissa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NDMA ochako ofis ma konyo joma ok gin rowere e alwora mar Garissa County.

English: Public health advisory: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response warns of increased Rift Valley Fever risk in Kericho County and advises the public to use insecticide-treated mosquito nets every night.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa katika Kaunti ya Kericho na inashauri umma kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na wadudu kila usiku.
Somali: Talobixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay ka digtay kororka halista Cudurka Rift Valley ee Gobolka Kericho waxayna ku talineysaa dadweynaha inay isticmaalaan shabagyada cayayaanka lagu daaweeyo habeen kasta.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: Migawo mar Nono kod Duoko ne Tuoche chiwo siem kuom medo bedo gi tuwo mar Rift Valley Fever e County mar Kericho kendo ojiwo ji mondo oti gi net mag lum ma nigi yedhe makelo tuoche otieno ka otieno.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Uasin Gishu County to visit the nearest Huduma Centre for assistance to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inawashauri wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kutembelea Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu zaidi kwa usaidizi wa kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qaybta Caafimada taranka waxay dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu kula talineysaa inay booqdaan Xarunta Huduma ee ugu dhow si ay u helaan caawimaad helitaanka daryeelka caafimaad ee lacageed.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit nyiso jogweng' Uasin Gishu County mondo olim Huduma Centre man machiegni mondo giyud kony mar yudo thieth makonyo.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public that free trauma counselling support is available through county health facilities in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa ushauri wa kiwewe unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo la talinta dhaawaca laga helo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Kilifi County.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e County Kilifi.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education opens applications for school laptops under the digital literacy programme for learners in Machakos County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu inafungua maombi ya kompyuta za mkononi za shule chini ya mpango wa kusoma na kuandika wa kidijitali kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Machakos.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa furtay codsiyada loogu talagalay laptops-ka dugsiga ee barnaamijka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee ardayda degmada Machakos.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Education oyawo kwayo mag kompyuta mag skul e bwo program mar digital literacy ne jopuonjre e County ma Machakos.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education opens a new electrical installation programme at the vocational centre in Murang'a County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu yafungua programu mpya ya ufungaji wa umeme katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Murang'a.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo lagu rakibo korontada xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Murang'a.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Education ochako chenro manyien mar keto sitima e kar tich e county mar Murang'a.

English: KEPHIS reminds farmers in Makueni County of the ongoing pest and disease management training programme.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawakumbusha wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni juu ya programu inayoendelea ya mafunzo ya kudhibiti wadudu na magonjwa.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay xasuusineysaa beeraleyda degmada Makueni barnaamijka tababarka ee socda ee xakamaynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada.
Dholuo: KEPHIS parone jopur e gweng' mar Makueni chenro mar tiegruok ma dhi nyime mar kedo gi tuoche kod tuoche.

English: Notice: NCPB will train farmers in Wajir County on conservation tillage this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NCPB itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir juu ya kilimo cha uhifadhi Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NCPB waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda Gobolka Wajir ee ku saabsan beerashada ilaalinta Oktoobarkan.
Dholuo: Rapar: NCPB biro tiego jopur e Kaunti mar Wajir e weche mag rito puodho e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: EACC invites residents of Nyamira County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: EACC inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kuwasilisha maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: EACC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor waqtiga la soo dhaafay ee ku saabsan dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: EACC gwelo jokanyo mag Kaunti mar Nyamira mondo ochiw ripot mondik kapok ndalo ochopo mar nono tich mitimo higa ka higa.

English: The cost of targeted testing for Covid-19 and government quarantine facilities shall be met by the government effective today. Kenyans should not be afraid to get tested
Kiswahili: Gharama ya upimaji unaolengwa wa Covid-19 na vituo vya karantini vya serikali italipwa na serikali kuanzia leo. Wakenya hawapaswi kuogopa kupimwa.
Somali: Qiimaha baaritaanka bartilmaameedka ah ee COVID-19 iyo xarumaha karantiil ee dowladda ayaa ay xukuumaddu bixin doontaa maanta laga bilaabo maanta. Dadka Kenya waa inaysan ka baqin inay tijaabiyaan
Dholuo: Oganda Kenya ok onego oluor timo nonro mar Covid-19 kod kuonde ma sirkal ketoe ji kar kende.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit launches a March awareness campaign on food safety across Baringo County.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji wa Machi juu ya usalama wa chakula katika Kaunti ya Baringo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa billowday olole wacyi galineed oo ku saabsan badbaadada cuntada bishii Maarso ee degmada Baringo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osechako kampen mar chiwo pach ji e wi ritruok mar chiemo e dwe mar Mach e gweng' mar Baringo.

English: Notice: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit will hold a youth mental wellness forum in Uasin Gishu County this November. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kitafanya kongamano la ustawi wa akili kwa vijana katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu Novemba hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta Caafimada taranka ayaa ku qaban doonta madasha caafimaadka maskaxda ee dhalinyarada ee degmada Uasin Gishu bisha November. Dhammaantood waa soo dhaweynayaan.
Dholuo: Rieko: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit biro timo romo mar paro ne rowere e Uasin Gishu County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Huduma Kenya warns public officers in Tana River County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Wilaya ya Tana River dhidi ya kupotosha fedha za umma.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Tana River in ay ku xadgudbaan maalgashiga dawladda.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e taon mar Tana River County ni kik giti gi pesa ma sirkal tiyogo e yo marach.

English: NPS urges motorists and pedestrians in Kiambu County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent road accidents-related incidents.
Kiswahili: NPS inawataka madereva na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ajali za barabarani.
Somali: NPS waxay ku boorineysaa baabuurta iyo dadka socotada ah ee degmada Kiambu inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah si looga hortago dhacdooyinka la xiriira shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: NPS ojiwo jowuoth kod joma wuotho e ndara e County mar Kiambu mondo oluw chike mag wuoth ma jotelo mag gweng'no ogolo mondo gikwed hinyruok mag ndara.

English: IEBC reminds residents of Wajir County that access to passport services is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba kufikia huduma za pasipoti sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: IEBC waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Wajir in helitaanka adeegyada baasaboorka ay hadda ka fududaato kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: IEBC oparo ne jogweng' mar Wajir County ni koro yot yudo passport kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Notice: IPOA activates an emergency response plan for landslides in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IPOA inawasha mpango wa kukabiliana na dharura kwa maporomoko ya ardhi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IPOA waxay hirgelineysaa qorshe jawaab deg deg ah oo ka dhan ah dhulgariirada degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IPOA chako tiyo gi chenro mar chiwo kony e masiche mag yiengni mag piny e County mar Vihiga.

English: KEPHIS promotes soil conservation among farmers in Tana River County as part of the December climate resilience drive.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inakuza uhifadhi wa udongo kati ya wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River kama sehemu ya harakati za kustahimili hali ya hewa ya Desemba.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay dhiirrigelisay ilaalinta ciidda beeraleyda degmada Tana River County iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka iska caabinta cimilada ee Diseembar.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo rito lowo e kind jopur e taon mar Tana River County kaka achiel kuom chenro mar timo kinda mar kedo gi lokruok e kit yamo e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Nyandarua County this July.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya yatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Julai hii.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu ku dhawaaqay jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee lo'da caanaha ah ee Gobolka Nyandarua bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok ma nigi dhogi gi dhogi maonge chudo e dwe mar Julai e kaunti mar Nyandarua.

English: Huduma Kenya urges eligible citizens in Makueni County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inahimiza wananchi wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Makueni kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Makueni inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya jiwo jokanyo mag Makueni County mondo oriwgi e kwedo jogo madwaro yiero.

English: Delay bathing a newborn for at least 24 hours to protect the skin_x0092_s natural defenses.
Kiswahili: Kuchelewesha kuoga mtoto mchanga kwa angalau saa 24 ili kulinda kinga ya asili ya ngozi.
Somali: Dib u dhig qubaysiga ilmaha dhashay ugu yaraan 24 saacadood si loo ilaaliyo difaaca dabiiciga ah ee maqaarka.
Dholuo: Dek lwoko nyathi ma pok onyuol kuom seche ma ok okalo 24 mondo orit gik ma geng’o del.

English: Council of Governors reminds residents of Kitui County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linawakumbusha wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kitui ambao huhudhuria kikao cha umma cha mkutano wa wilaya huimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa xasuusinaya dadka deggan degmada Kitui ee ka qeybgalaya kalfadhiga guud ee shirka degmada ayaa xoojinaya maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch parone ji duto modak e County Kitui ma biro e chokruok mar ji duto mar county assembly mondo omed jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges the public in Tana River County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of mobile money scams.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi umma katika Kaunti ya Tana River wasijulishe PIN yao ya M-Pesa kwa mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa pesa za rununu.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha degmada Tana River County inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada lacagta mobilada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya Communications Authority jiwo ji duto e taon mar Tana River County mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' yudo ripode mag wuondo pesa e simo.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) encourages farmers in Nyamira County to sell produce only through licensed buyers to secure better prices for avocado.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa ili kupata bei nzuri ya parachichi.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Nyamira inay wax soo saarka ka iibiyaan oo keliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh si loo helo qiimo ka wanaagsan avocado.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e county mar Nyamira mondo ous olembe mana kokalo kuom joma nigi ratiro mar ng'iewo olembe mondo omi ohala mar avocado obed maber.

English: TSC encourages out-of-school children in Uasin Gishu County to enroll in the adult literacy programme under adult literacy classes.
Kiswahili: TSC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kujiandikisha katika mpango wa kusoma na kuandika kwa watu wazima chini ya madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima.
Somali: TSC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Uasin Gishu inay ku qoraan barnaamijka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee fasallada akhris-qoraalka dadka waaweyn.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo nyithindo maok dhi e skul e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo odonj e program mar somo kod somo mar joma dongo.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Murang'a County that access to NHIF/SHA claims support is now available at designated centres.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwamba ufikiaji wa msaada wa madai ya NHIF/SHA sasa unapatikana katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Murang'a in helitaanka taageerada sheegashada NHIF/SHA ay hadda ka heli karaan xarumaha la magacaabay.
Dholuo: KEMRI oparo ne ji duto manie County mar Murang'a ni koro ginyalo yudo kony mar kwayo mag NHIF/SHA e kuonde moyier.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit advises residents of Elgeyo-Marakwet County to reduce salt and sugar intake to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kupunguza ulaji wa chumvi na sukari ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay yareeyaan qaadashada cusbada iyo sonkorta si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurrada laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit osiemo jogweng' Elgeyo-Marakwet County mondo omed chamo mor gi sukari mondo kik tuoche ma inyalo geng'e landre.

English: FGM is a traumatic experience that leaves a lasting psychological mark & may adversely affect the mental health of the victims
Kiswahili: Ukeketaji ni tukio la kiwewe ambalo huacha alama ya kisaikolojia ya kudumu na linaweza kuathiri vibaya afya ya akili ya waathiriwa.
Somali: FGM waa waayo aragnimo dhaawac ah oo ka tagaysa calaamado maskaxeed oo waarta & waxay saameyn xun ku yeelan kartaa caafimaadka maskaxda ee dhibbanaha
Dholuo: FGM en gima kelo hinyruok mang'eny ma miyo ng'ato bedo gi paro maok kare kendo manyalo ketho ngima mar pach jo mosetho

English: Ministry of Education conducts a civic education forum on public participation in county budgets in Nairobi County this September.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inaendesha kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu ushiriki wa umma katika bajeti za kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nairobi Septemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ku saabsan ka qaybgalka dadweynaha miisaaniyadda gobolka ee Gobolka Nairobi bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Puonjruok dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda e dwe mar ochiko mar higani e County Nairobi.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises farmers in Trans Nzoia County to bring their farmer registration number to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kuleta nambari yao ya usajili wa mkulima ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku talinayaa beeraleyda degmada Trans Nzoia inay keenaan nambarkooda diiwaangelinta beeralayda si ay uga qayb galaan tababarka beeraha ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia mondo okel namba mar pimo jopur mondo gidhi e tiegruok mabiro mar pur.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds mobile money users in Mombasa County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone to avoid phishing messages.
Kiswahili: Ukurugenzi wa Utafiti wa Jinai unakumbusha watumiaji wa simu za mkononi katika Kaunti ya Mombasa wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote ili kuepuka ujumbe wa udanganyifu.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa xasuusinaya dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee gobolka Mombasa inaysan marnaba la wadaagin lambarkooda M-Pesa cidna si looga fogaado fariimaha phishing.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e county mar Mombasa ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata mondo gitang' gi weche mag phishing.

English: KEMRI reminds expectant mothers in Narok County that access to skilled birth attendance is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Narok kwamba ufikiaji wa mahudhurio ya uzazi wenye ujuzi ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Narok in helitaanka daryeelka dhalmada ee xirfad leh ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMRI paronwa mine madwaro nyuol e gweng' mar Narok ni thuolo mar yudo nyithindo ma nigi lony en maonge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: Self-care isn't selfish; it's survival, strength, and showing up for yourself. Every choice to protect your health is a quiet act of power for you, and for the people who count on you. This International Self-Care Day, choose yourself. Take the walk. Book the check-up. Ask the questions. Rest when you need to. Choose one healthy habit today â€” and let it be the beginning of many. Your health is worth your time.
Kiswahili: Kujitunza si choyo; ni usalama, nguvu, na kujisimamisha. Kila uchaguzi wa kulinda afya yako ni kitendo cha kimya cha mamlaka kwako na kwa watu wanaokutegemea. Siku hii ya Kujitunza Duniani, chagua nafsi yako. Tembea, panga uchunguzi wa afya, uliza maswali, na pumzika unapohitaji.
Somali: Daryeelka naftu maaha mid danayste ah; waa badbaado, xoog, iyo inaad naftaada isu soo bandhigto. Doorasho kasta oo aad ku ilaalinayso caafimaadkaaga waa ficil awood deggan oo adiga iyo dadka kugu tiirsan. Maalintan Caalamiga ah ee Daryeelka Nafta, naftaada dooro. Socod geli. Ballanso baaritaanka. Weydii su'aalaha. Naso markaad u baahato. Maanta dooro hal caado caafimaad qabta - oo ha noqoto bilowga dad badan. Caafimaadkaagu wuxuu u qalmaa waqtigaaga.
Dholuo: Chikruok mar ng’ato owuon ok en ng’at ma ng’iyore owuon; en ngima, teko, kod nyiso ni in iwuon. Yiero moro amora mar rito ngimani en tim ma ok oling’ mar teko ne in, kendo ne ji ma geno kuomi. Odiechieng’ mar piny mangima mar rito ng’ato owuon, yier in iwuon. Inyalo wuotho. Buk mar ng’iyo. Penj penjogo. Yueyo e kinde ma dwarore. Yier tim achiel maber sani â€” kendo iwe obed chakruok mar mathoth.

English: KRA reminds residents of Kwale County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: KRA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kwale in ay ku hawlan yihiin maamulaha qaybta deegaanka si loo xoojiyo maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: KRA parone jogweng' mar Kwale County ni tiyo gi jaritgi mar ward jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Preventing electoral violence through early warning and rapid response in Kenya
Kiswahili: Kuzuia ghasia za uchaguzi kupitia onyo la mapema na mwitikio wa haraka nchini Kenya
Somali: Ka hortagga rabshadaha doorashada iyada oo loo marayo digniin hore iyo jawaab degdeg ah oo ka timaadda Kenya
Dholuo: Ogeng’o tulo mag yiero kokalo kuom chiwo siem mapiyo kendo dwoko mapiyo e piny Kenya

English: Judiciary of Kenya warns public officers in Baringo County against abuse of office.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo dhidi ya kutumia vibaya mamlaka yao.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ka digay saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Baringo inay ku xadgudbaan xilka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal man Baringo County ni kik giti marach gi migawo ma gin-go.

English: The National Coffee Farm Inputs Stimulus Package E Subsidy Programme is now available for 82 650 eligible coffee farmers in 32 counties Register to access subsidized inputs through accredited suppliers
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Kitaifa wa Pembejeo za Kichocheo cha Kifurushi cha E sasa unapatikana kwa wakulima 82 650 wanaostahiki kahawa katika kaunti 32 Wasajili ili kupata pembejeo za ruzuku kupitia wasambazaji walioidhinishwa.
Somali: Barnaamijka National Coffee Farm Inputs Stimulus Package E Subsidy Program hadda waa la heli karaa 82,650 beeraley kafee ah oo u qalma 32 degmo si ay u helaan alaab-soo-saarka la taageero iyada oo loo marayo alaab-qeybiyeyaasha la aqoonsan yahay
Dholuo: Chenro mar Golo Chiwo mar Choko Chiwo mar Jo-Kafwa e Piny Mangima koro yudore ne jopur ma romo 82,650 e gwenge 32 mag piny mangima.

English: KEMRI appeals to caregivers in Kisumu County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the September maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Septemba.
Somali: KEMRI waxay u baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Kisumu inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka ee Sebtember.
Dholuo: KEMRI okwayo jorit e County mar Kisumu mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Teachers Service Commission advises students in Kakamega County to register early to secure allocation to access textbooks and learning materials.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ardayda degmada Kakamega kula talinayaa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan si ay u helaan buugaag iyo qalab waxbarasho.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj jiwo jopuonjre e Kaunti mar Kakamega mondo odonj e tiegruok chon mondo giyud thuolo mar somo buge koda gik mamoko.

English: DPP reminds residents of Turkana County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: DPP anawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: DPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana in si dhakhso leh u soo sheegaan jabsashada ay gacan ka geysato ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: DPP parone jogweng'o mag Turkana County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar donjo e ot konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Notice: Teachers Service Commission opens a new tailoring and design programme at the vocational centre in West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu inafungua programu mpya ya ushonaji na kubuni katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta wuxuu ka furayaa barnaamij cusub oo qaabeynta iyo naqshadeynta xarunta xirfadaha ee Gobolka West Pokot.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Komiti mar Tiego Jopuonj chako chenro manyien mar loso kendo loso gik moko e otas mar tiegruok e West Pokot County.

English: Marsabit County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for July 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Marsabit: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame Julai 2023
Somali: Degmada Marsabit: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Luulyo 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Marsabit: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro mar dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2023

English: Notice: NTSA conducts a community briefing on community early-warning systems in Kirinyaga County this May.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulshada oo ku saabsan nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada ee Gobolka Kirinyaga bishii Maajo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NTSA timo romo mar chiwo siem ne oganda e wi chenro mag chiwo siem motelo e gweng' mar Kirinyaga e dwe mar Mei.

English: KEPHIS warns tea farmers in Kiambu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawaonya wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Kiambu juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Kiambu cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa in si sax ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: KEPHIS chiwo siem ne jopur ma loso chai e gweng' mar Kiambu ni nitie tuoche ma nyalo landore kendo ojiwo ni otim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: ODPP reminds residents of Nyandarua County that track project progress through the county website strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua kwamba kufuatilia maendeleo ya mradi kupitia tovuti ya kaunti inaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyandarua in raadinta horumarka mashruuca iyada oo loo marayo websaydhka degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: ODPP parone jogweng' Nyandarua County ni luwo dongruok mar chenrono kokalo kuom websait mar county jiwo loch mar alwora.

English: Announcement that Kenya is on the middle of development and food export in five food commodities
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwamba Kenya iko katikati ya maendeleo na mauzo ya chakula katika bidhaa tano za chakula
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida in Kenya ay ku jirto bartamaha horumarinta iyo dhoofinta cuntada shan alaabood oo cunto ah
Dholuo: Lando ni Kenya ni e kind dongruok kod ohala mag chiemo e yore abich mag chamo chiemo

English: Huduma Kenya reminds the public in Kisii County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this August.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kisii kwamba ushiriki katika mashauriano ya sera za umma unakaribishwa Agosti hii.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Kisii in talobixinta la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha lagu soo dhaweynayo bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya oparo ne ji duto e County mar Kisii ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mag siasa e dwe mar Agost.

English: Ministry of Health reminds the public in Taita-Taveta County about the importance of diabetes screening for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Taita-Taveta kuhusu umuhimu wa uchunguzi wa kisukari kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay dadweynaha degmada Taita-Taveta ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda baaritaanka sonkorowga ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health oparo ne ji duto e Taita-Taveta County kuom ber mar nono thieth mar sukari e ngima joot.

English: Notice: TVET reminds citizens in Embu County about their rights regarding the role of the ombudsman.
Kiswahili: Ilani: TVET inawakumbusha raia katika Kaunti ya Embu kuhusu haki zao kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman.
Somali: Ogeysiis: TVET waxay muwaadiniinta degmada Embu ku xasuusineysaa xuquuqdooda ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha.
Dholuo: Rapar: TVET paronwa raia mag Embu County ratiro ma gin-go mar bedo ombudsman.

English: TSC invites youth in Kajiado County to enroll for tailoring and design training this October.
Kiswahili: TSC inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Kajiado kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ushonaji na kubuni Oktoba hii.
Somali: TSC waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dhalinyarada degmada Kajiado inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababarka tailoring iyo naqshadeynta bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: TSC gwelo rowere mag Kajiado County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar loso kendo loso gik moko e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Kenya Red Cross encourages mothers in Migori County to register for the mother-and-child health card to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Migori kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka Degmada Migori inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo mine manie Migori County mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: DCI reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Trans Nzoia County that access to psychosocial support is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisaikolojia unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ku salaysan degmada Trans Nzoia in helitaanka taageerada cilmu-nafsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: DCI paronwa jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu e gweng' mar Trans Nzoia ni ginyalo yudo kony maonge chudo.

English: Notice: KUCCPS opens applications for free digital learning content for learners in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS inafungua maombi ya maudhui ya kujifunza dijitali bila malipo kwa wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay codsiyada u furaysaa bartayaasha degmada Isiolo si ay u helaan barasho digital ah oo lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KUCCPS yawo kwayo mag somo mar digital maonge chudo ne jopuonjre man Isiolo County.

English: Notice: KALRO will train farmers in Meru County on agroforestry this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru juu ya kilimo cha misitu Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KALRO waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Meru ee ku saabsan beeraha kaynta bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KALRO biro tiego jopur e kaunti mar Meru e weche mag yiengni mag bunge e dwe mar abich.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Elgeyo-Marakwet County about the importance of hypertension awareness for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet juu ya umuhimu wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay dadka degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay wacyiga cadaadiska dhiig karka ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji duto e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet kuom ber mar ng'eyo ni ng'ato nigi tuwo mar hypertension e ngima joot.

English: Notice: Communications Authority of Kenya launches a theft prevention campaign in Kisii County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Kisii Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Maamulka Isgaarsiinta Kenya wuxuu bilaabay olole ka hortagga tuugada degmada Kisii bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji chako kampen mar geng'o kuo e gweng' mar Kisii e dwe mar Mach.

English: Notice: AFA will distribute certified beans seed to farmers in Kisii County this February.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: AFA itasambaza mbegu zilizothibitishwa za maharagwe kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii Februari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: AFA waxay u qaybin doontaa abuurka xayawaanada la shaaciyey beeraleyda degmada Kisii bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: AFA biro pogo kodhi molony mag nyinyo ne jopur manie Kisii County e dwe mar Februar.

English: Notice: IEBC announces school feeding programme enrollment dates for schools in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC yatangaza tarehe za uandikishaji wa programu ya kulisha shule kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa taariikhda diiwaangelinta barnaamijka quudinta dugsiyada degmada Nakuru.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: IEBC ogolo chenro mar somo e skunde mag Nakuru County.

English: Public health advisory: CDC warns of increased malaria risk in Wajir County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: CDC inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya malaria katika Kaunti ya Wajir na inashauri umma kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa kwa wajitolea wa afya ya jamii.
Somali: Talobixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: CDC waxay ka digeysaa kororka halista daacuunka ee Gobolka Wajir waxayna ku talineysaa dadweynaha inay u soo sheegaan kiisaska shakiga ah mutadawiciinta caafimaadka bulshada.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: CDC chiwo siem e wi medruok mar tuo mar malaria e County mar Wajir kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne joma ochiwore mar konyo e thieth.

English: Notice: KEMRI will hold a suicide prevention forum in Marsabit County this July. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI itafanya kongamano la kuzuia kujiua katika Kaunti ya Marsabit Julai hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay qabaneysaa madasha ka hortagga ismiidaaminta ee degmada Marsabit bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMRI biro timo chokruok mar geng'o ji kik donj e kend e dwe mar Julai e taon mar Marsabit.

English: We need to strike a balance between what is acceptable in the context that we have and what inefficient use of the health workforce," he says.
Kiswahili: Tunahitaji kuweka uwiano kati ya kile kinachokubalika katika muktadha tulionao na matumizi yasiyofaa ya nguvu kazi ya afya," anasema.
Somali: "Waxaan u baahanahay inaan isku dheelitirno waxa la aqbali karo ee xaaladda aan haysanno iyo sida aan waxtarka lahayn ee loo isticmaalo shaqaalaha caafimaadka," ayuu yidhi.
Dholuo: Owinjore wabed gi winjruok maber e kind gima oyiego e chal ma wan-go kod kaka tiyo marach gi jotich mag thieth," owacho.

English: Ministry of Education announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in Nandi County this October.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nandi Oktoba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa ku dhawaaqday qaybinta deeqaha waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan dugsiyada gobolka Nandi bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ofis mar Puonjruok olando chiwo mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre man gi chan e skunde man Nandi County e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: DCI reminds mobile money users in Kajiado County to report suspicious messages to their service provider to avoid fake investment schemes.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha watumiaji wa pesa za rununu katika Kajiado County kuripoti ujumbe wa mashaka kwa mtoa huduma wao ili kuepuka mipango ya uwekezaji bandia.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa dadka isticmaala lacagta mobilada ee degmada Kajiado inay warbixiyaan fariimaha shakiga ah bixiyaha adeegyadooda si looga fogaado nidaamyada maalgashiga been abuurka ah.
Dholuo: DCI paronwa jogo matiyo gi pesa mag simo e Kajiado County mondo ochiw ripot mar ote maok kare ne jatendgi mar konyo mondo kik gitim chenro mag gwoko pesa mag miriambo.

English: OGP urges residents of Mombasa County to use the online reporting portal to file a complaint to fight procurement fraud.
Kiswahili: OGP inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa watumie portal ya kuripoti mtandaoni kuwasilisha malalamiko ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa ununuzi.
Somali: OGP waxay dadka deggan degmada Mombasa ugu baaqeysaa inay adeegsadaan bogga warbixinta ee internetka si ay u soo gudbiyaan cabasho si looga hortago khiyaamooyinka iibsiga.
Dholuo: OGP ojiwo jogweng' Mombasa County mondo oti gi websait mar chiwo ripot mar chiwo ng'ur mondo giked gi timbe mag wuondruok.

English: Notice: Huduma Kenya will hold a public participation forum on public policy consultations in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Huduma Kenya itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma katika Kaunti ya Mandera.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Huduma Kenya waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee la-tashiga siyaasadda guud ee degmada Mandera.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Huduma Kenya biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag siasa e county mar Mandera.

English: COMESA reminds residents of Baringo County that water harvesting improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: COMESA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba uvunaji wa maji unaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: COMESA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo in goosashada biyaha ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: COMESA paronwa jogweng' Baringo County ni choko pi kelo nyak mar puothe kuom kinde malach.

English: Bungoma County has allocated significant resources to strengthen its agricultural sector Farmers in the region should stay informed on upcoming opportunities and support initiatives
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Bungoma imetenga rasilimali muhimu kuimarisha sekta yake ya kilimo.
Somali: Gobolka Bungoma wuxuu maalgashiyo badan u qoondeeyay xoojinta waaxdiisa beeraha Beeraleyda gobolka waa inay sii joogaan warbixin ku saabsan fursadaha soo socda iyo ololaha taageerada
Dholuo: Bungoma County osechiwo mwandu mang'eny mondo otiek tije mag pur.

English: Kenya Gazette urges residents of Turkana County to submit written memoranda before the deadline to shape the annual performance review.
Kiswahili: Gazeti la Kenya linawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kuwasilisha maandishi ya kumbukumbu kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.
Somali: Wargeyska Kenya Gazette wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Turkana inay soo gudbiyaan qoraal qoraal ah ka hor inta aan la gaarin waqtiga la soo dhaafay si loo qaabeeyo dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Gazette jiwo jogweng' County mar Turkana mondo ochiw weche mondiki kapok ndalo ochopo mar loso nonro mar tich mar higa ka higa.

English: Notice from SHA (Social Health Authority): skilled birth attendance clinics will run every October at designated health centres in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka kwa SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii): kliniki za mahudhurio ya uzazi zenye ujuzi zitaendeshwa kila Oktoba katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada): rugaha caafimaad ee dhalashada xirfadlayaasha ah waxaa lagu qaban doonaa Oktoobar kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee degmada Vihiga.
Dholuo: Rieko moa kuom SHA (Social Health Authority): klinike ma nigi lony mar rito nyuol biro tiyo dwe mar Oktoba higa ka higa e kuonde thieth moyier e County mar Vihiga.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) announces subsidised dialysis for residents of Meru County starting this September.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inatangaza dialysis ya ruzuku kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Meru kuanzia Septemba hii.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa ku dhawaaqday in la siinayo deebaajiyo loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Meru laga bilaabo bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) ong'ado mar chiwo kony mar dialysis ne joma odak e county mar Meru kochakore Septemba.

English: PPRC represents an important choice for investment that focuses on climate change and sponsorship set aside for the sakevof managing climate change. Acceptance...
Kiswahili: PPRC inawakilisha chaguo muhimu kwa ajili ya uwekezaji kwamba inazingatia mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa na udhamini kuweka kando kwa niaba ya usimamizi wa mabadiliko ya tabia nchi.
Somali: PPRC waxay ka dhigan tahay doorasho muhiim u ah maalgashiga oo diiradda saaraya isbeddelka cimilada iyo taageerada loo qoondeeyay maamulka isbeddelka cimilada.
Dholuo: PPRC ochung'ne yiero maduong' mar timo ohala maketo pachgi ahinya kuom lokruok mar lokruok mar piny, koda chenro mar konyo e loyo lokruokno.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) warns sweet potatoes farmers in Murang'a County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaonya wakulima wa viazi vitamu katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay uga digtay beeraleyda baradho macaan ee degmada Murang'a cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna kugula talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) chiwo siem ne jopur mag le mamit e County mar Murang'a kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Public health advisory: CDC warns of increased typhoid risk in Elgeyo-Marakwet County and advises the public to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: CDC inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya matumbo katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet na inashauri umma kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Somali: Talobixinta Caafimaadka Dadweynaha: CDC waxay ka digtay kororka halista cudurka 'typhoid' ee gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay dhammaystiraan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: CDC siemo ji kuom medruok mar tuo mar typhoid e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet kendo osiemo ji mondo otiek dose duto mag thieth.

English: SHA reminds residents of Kiambu County that engage their local ward administrator strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kwamba kushirikiana na msimamizi wa wilaya yao kunaimarisha utawala wa mitaa.
Somali: SHA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kiambu in ka qaybgalka maamulaha degmada ay xoojineyso maamulka deegaanka.
Dholuo: SHA paronwa jogweng' Kiambu County ni tudruok gi jotelo mag gwenge maggi miyo sirkal bedo gi loch maber.

English: SHA announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Somali: SHA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet.
Dholuo: SHA olando lokruok e seche mag timo kwayo mag ng'eyo nying' e kaunti mar Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: KEMSA launches an October awareness campaign on tobacco control across Samburu County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Oktoba juu ya udhibiti wa tumbaku katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Somali: KEMSA waxay billowday olole wacyi galineed bishii Oktoobar ee ka dhanka ah xakamaynta sigaarka ee Gobolka Samburu.
Dholuo: KEMSA chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Oktoba e wi thieth mar ndawa e gweng' mar Samburu.

English: Notice: NTSA conducts a community briefing on border security in Mandera County this September.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NTSA inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya usalama wa mpaka katika Kaunti ya Mandera Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NTSA waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ah oo ku saabsan amniga xuduudaha ee Degmada Mandera bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Riwruok mar National Security Agency (NTSA) timo romo mar oganda e wi weche mag rito tong' e gweng' mar Mandera e dwe mar Septemba.

English: TSC advises students in Mandera County to register early to secure allocation to access scholarships for needy students.
Kiswahili: TSC inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Mandera kujiandikisha mapema ili kupata mgao wa kupata ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Somali: TSC waxay ardayda Degmada Mandera kula talineysaa inay isdiiwaangaliyaan si ay u helaan deeq deeq waxbarasho oo loogu talagalay ardayda u baahan.
Dholuo: TSC jiwo jopuonjre man Mandera County mondo odonj e skundno chon mondo giyud thuolo mar yudo osuru ne jopuonjre mochando.

English: State Department for TVET conducts a civic education forum on the role of the ombudsman in Baringo County this October.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia kuhusu jukumu la ombudsman katika Kaunti ya Baringo Oktoba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan doorka xeer ilaaliyaha gobolka Baringo bishii Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ofis mar State for TVET dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiego ji e wi migawo mar ombudsman e taon mar Baringo e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Notice: Universities Fund opens a new tailoring and design programme at the vocational centre in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unafungua programu mpya ya ushonaji na kubuni katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu furayaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan qaabeynta iyo naqshadeynta xarunta xirfadaha ee Gobolka Kwale.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: University Fund chako chenro manyien mar loso piche kendo loso gik moko e kambi mar tiegruok e taon mar Kwale.

English: KNEC announces distribution of scholarships for needy students to schools in Tharaka-Nithi County this November.
Kiswahili: KNEC inatangaza usambazaji wa ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi Novemba hii.
Somali: KNEC waxay ku dhawaaqday qaybinta deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan dugsiyada degmada Tharaka-Nithi bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: KNEC ogolo chiwo mag tiegruok ne jopuonjre man gi chan e skunde man Tharaka-Nithi County e dwe mar Novemba.

English: Marsabit County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for March 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Marsabit: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Machi 2024
Somali: Degmada Marsabit: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Maarso 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Marsabit: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar adek higa mar 2024

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Homa Bay County that reporting fraud promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan gobolka Homa Bay in warbixinta khiyaanada si deg deg ah ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne jogweng' Homa Bay County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar wuond konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges farmers in Wajir County to plant cover crops to reduce soil erosion to cope with changing rainfall patterns.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Wajir kupanda mazao ya kufunika ili kupunguza mmomonyoko wa udongo ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya mifumo ya mvua.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa ku boorinaya beeraleyda degmada Wajir inay beeraan dalagyo daboolaya si loo yareeyo burburka ciidda si ay ula qabsadaan isbeddelada roobabka roobka.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Locho e Wi Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur e gweng' mar Wajir mondo opidh olembe mondo omi piny okethre mondo omi giritre kuom lokruok ma timore e koth.

English: Notice: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response confirms a malaria outbreak alert for Marsabit County. Residents are advised to avoid contact with contaminated water sources.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa malaria kwa Kaunti ya Marsabit. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji machafu.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaab celinta Cudurrada waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ku saabsan cudurka Cudurka Cudurada ee Degmada Marsabit. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan xiriirka ilaha biyaha wasakhda ah.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Ng'iyo Kendo Dwoko Tuoche nyiso ni maraya osechakore e gweng' mar Marsabit. Ojiw ji ni kik giriwre gi pi mochido.

English: President's Malaria Initiative: Kenya Malaria Operational Plan FY 2023
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Rais wa Malaria: Mpango wa Uendeshaji wa Malaria wa Kenya FY 2023
Somali: Hindisaha Madaxweynaha ee Duumada: Qorshaha Hawlgalka Duumada Kenya MY 2023
Dholuo: Chenro mar Jatend Pinyruoth mar Maleria: Chenro mar Tiyo gi Maleria e Kenya Higa 2023

English: Judiciary of Kenya urges residents of Kitui County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Kitui kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandaoni ya wilaya ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.
Somali: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya jiwo jogweng' Kitui County mondo oriwgi lwedo kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e loso chenro mag dongruok.

English: SHA reminds residents of Mombasa County that access to birth certificate processing is now easier through official service channels.
Kiswahili: SHA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba upatikanaji wa utunzaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa sasa ni rahisi kupitia njia rasmi za huduma.
Somali: Shirkadda SHA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa in helitaanka shahaadada dhalashada ay hadda ka sahlan tahay kanaalada adeegga rasmiga ah.
Dholuo: SHA parone jogweng' mar County mar Mombasa ni koro yot yudo thuolo mar timo nonro mar nyasi mar nyuol kokalo kuom yore ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit reminds expectant mothers in Nyamira County that access to nutrition supplementation for infants is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi kinawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba upatikanaji wa nyongeza ya lishe kwa watoto wachanga ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Nyamira in helitaanka nafaqada cuntada ee dhallaanka ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit oparo ne mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County ma Nyamira ni yudo chiemo moromo nyithindo mayom en gima onge chudo e kuonde duto mag oganda.

English: Kenya, Africa | Floods 2023 Operation Update (MDRKE058) (26/04/2024)
Kiswahili: Kenya, Afrika | Sasisho la Operesheni ya Mafuriko 2023 (MDRKE058) (26/04/2024)
Somali: Kenya, Afrika | Cusboonaysiinta Hawlgallada Daadadka 2023 (MDRKE058) (26/04/2024)
Dholuo: Kenya, Afrika | Tich mar pi mang'eny higa mar 2023 (26/04/2024)

English: Kenya Dairy Board urges pigs farmers in Mombasa County to vaccinate their animals at designated crush points following reported anthrax cases.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawahimiza wafugaji wa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Mombasa kuwachanja wanyama wao katika maeneo yaliyotengwa kufuatia kesi za kimeta zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda doofaarka ee degmada Mombasa inay u tallaalaan xoolahooda meelaha lagu burburiyo ee loo qoondeeyay ka dib kiisaska cudurka Anthrax ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board jiwo jopur ma pidho anguro e county mar Mombasa mondo ogeng' legi e kuonde moketi mag chwoyo ng'ato bang' ka osenyis ni nitie tuoche mag anthrax.

English: KUCCPS announces distribution of textbooks and learning materials to schools in Nandi County this December.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inatangaza usambazaji wa vitabu vya kiada na vifaa vya kujifunzia kwa shule katika Kaunti ya Nandi Desemba hii.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa qaybinta buugaagta waxbarasho iyo qalabka wax lagu barto dugsiyada degmada Nandi bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: KUCCPS olando ni gibiro pogo buge mag somo kod buge mag puonjruok e skunde man Nandi County e dwe mar Desemba.

English: EHAGL Region: Community Feedback Analysis Report, January - March 2024
Kiswahili: Mkoa wa EHAGL: Ripoti ya Uchambuzi wa Maoni ya Jamii, Januari - Machi 2024
Somali: Gobolka EHAGL: Warbixinta Falanqaynta Jawaab celinta Bulshada, Janaayo - Maarso 2024
Dholuo: Kidieny mar EHAGL: Ripot mar Nonro Duoko mag Oganda, dwe mar achiel - dwe mar adek 2024

English: Notice: Ministry of Education opens a new tailoring and design programme at the vocational centre in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu inafungua programu mpya ya ushonaji na kubuni katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ka furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo loogu talagalay tailoring iyo naqshadeynta xarunta xirfadeed ee Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Puonjruok chako chenro manyien mar loso kendo loso gik moko e otas mar tiegruok e gweng' mar Wajir.

English: Notice: NPS launches a theft prevention campaign in Meru County this May.
Kiswahili: Ilani: NPS inazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi katika Kaunti ya Meru Mei hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay bilaabaneysaa olole ka hortagga tuugada degmada Meru bisha May.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NPS chako kampen mar geng'o kuo e kaunti mar Meru e dwe mar Mei.

English: Public notice: Kenya Medical Association will host a free safe water storage outreach in Homa Bay County this June.
Kiswahili: Ilani kwa umma: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kitaandaa uhamasishaji wa bure wa kuhifadhi maji salama katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay Juni hii.
Somali: Ogeysiiska dadweynaha: Ururka Caafimaadka Kenya wuxuu qaban doonaa adeeg lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan kaydinta biyaha ammaanka ah ee gobolka Homa Bay bishii Juun.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Kenya Medical Association biro timo kampen mar choko pi maonge chudo e Homa Bay County e dwe mar Jun.

English: Nomadic pastoralist communities need mobile services, leader engagement, and economic support to reduce harmful practices.
Kiswahili: Jumuiya za wachungaji wanaosafiri zinahitaji huduma za mkononi, ushiriki wa viongozi, na msaada wa kiuchumi ili kupunguza mazoea yenye madhara.
Somali: Bulshooyinka adhijirka ah ee socdaalka ah waxay u baahan yihiin adeegyo dhaqdhaqaaqa, ka qaybgalka hoggaamiyeyaasha, iyo taageero dhaqaale si loo yareeyo caadooyinka waxyeelada leh.
Dholuo: Joma odak e gwenge mopogore opogore dwaro ni jotelo omed tiyo gi yore mopogore opogore mag kwayo ji, mondo gitiek timbe ma nyalo hinyogi.

English: E-Citizen reminds the public in Wajir County that reporting procurement fraud is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Wajir kwamba kuripoti udanganyifu wa ununuzi ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: E-Citizen waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha gobolka Wajir in sheegashada khiyaamooyinka iibsiga ay tahay mid bilaash ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: E-Citizen paronwa ji duto e gweng' mar Wajir ni chiwo ripot mar wuondruok e weche mag yuto en gima onge nengo, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development urges youth in Kakamega County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: Machadka Horumarinta Manhajka Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa dhalinyarada degmada Kakamega inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada rayidka ah ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada rayidnimada ee soo socda.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ojiwo rowere e Kaunti mar Kakamega mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok ochopo tije mag oganda.

English: Notice: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development will conduct a record keeping for farmers workshop for farmers in Kilifi County this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo itafanya warsha ya utunzaji wa rekodi kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kilifi Januari hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi diiwaangelinta beeraleyda loogu talagalay beeralayda degmada Kilifi bishii Janaayo.
Dholuo: Rapar: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development biro timo rapar mar jokwang'o puothe mag jopur e gweng' mar Kilifi e dwe mar Januar.

English: Narok County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Narok: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Aprili 2024
Somali: Degmada Narok: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Narok: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar ang'wen higa mar 2024

English: CDC reminds expectant mothers in Kakamega County that access to nutrition supplementation for infants is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: CDC inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Kakamega kwamba upatikanaji wa nyongeza ya lishe kwa watoto wachanga ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: CDC waxay xasuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Kakamega in helitaanka nafaqada ee dhallaanka ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: CDC paronwa mine ma biro bedo gi ich e Kaunti mar Kakamega ni yudo chiemo moromo ne nyithindo mayom en gima onge chudo e ute duto.

English: Kenya Dairy Board invites farmers in Kisii County to a free training on fertiliser application this May.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kisii kupata mafunzo ya bure juu ya matumizi ya mbolea Mei hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya ayaa ku casuumay beeraleyda degmada Kisii tababar bilaash ah oo ku saabsan isticmaalka bacriminta bisha May.
Dholuo: Kenya Dairy Board ogwelo jopur e County mar Kisii e tiegruok ma onge chudo e wi tiyo gi yien e dwe mar Mei.

English: Maidens are expected to follow government guidelines on vaccination to protect their children from measles, polio and TB
Kiswahili: Wasichana wanatarajiwa kufuata miongozo ya serikali kuhusu chanjo ili kuwalinda watoto wao kutokana na kifua kikuu, polio, na ugonjwa wa kupooza
Somali: Gabdhaha dhallinyarada ah ayaa la filayaa inay raacaan tilmaamaha dawladda ee tallaalka si ay carruurtooda uga ilaaliyaan cirbadaha, cudurka booliiska iyo cudurka TB
Dholuo: Inyalo geno ni nyiri ma nyiri biro luwo chike mag sirkal e wi thieth mondo girit nyithindgi kik hinyre gi tuwono, tuo mar polio, kod tuo mar TB

English: Communications Authority of Kenya calls on residents of Mandera County to cooperate with security screening at public venues in support of counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaita wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mandera kushirikiana na uchunguzi wa usalama katika maeneo ya umma kwa msaada wa tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka deggan degmada Mandera inay ka wada shaqeeyaan baaritaanka amniga meelaha dadweynaha si ay u taageeraan kahortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji jiwo jogweng'o mag Mandera County mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag rito sirkal e kuonde ma ji nitie mondo gikony e kedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Did you know the Kenya Red Cross Society offers free on-call counselling services 24/7? Call us on 1199 and we will be there for you. Since January-June 2019, our Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Services team attended to 513 calls.
Kiswahili: Je, unajua kwamba Chama cha Msalaba Mwekundu cha Kenya kinatoa huduma za ushauri nasaha bila malipo masaa 24 kwa siku, siku 7 kwa wiki? Tupigie simu kwa 1199 nasi tutakuwepo kwa ajili yako. Tangu Januari-Juni 2019, timu yetu ya Huduma za Afya ya Akili na Usaidizi wa Kisaikolojia ilihudhuria simu 513.
Somali: Ma ogtahay in Kenya Red Cross Society ay bixiso adeegyo la-talin ah oo bilaash ah 24/7? Nala soo wac 1199 waxaanan kuu caawin doonnaa. Tan iyo Janaayo-Juun 2019, kooxdeena Adeegyada Taageerada Caafimaadka Maskaxda iyo Maskaxda ayaa ka qaybgalay 513 wicitaan.
Dholuo: Be ing'eyo ni Kenya Red Cross Society chiwo kony maonge chudo 24/7? Wuo kodwa e namba 1199 kendo wabiro konyi. Chakre Januar-June 2019, riwruok marwa mar weche thieth gi thieth mar paro ne otimo limbe 513.

English: KRA urges eligible citizens in Kisumu County to participate in voter registration.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi raia wanaostahili katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kushiriki katika usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: KRA waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta u qalma degmada Kisumu inay ka qeyb galaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo raia ma nigi ratiro e County mar Kisumu mondo oriwre e kwedo jogo madwaro yiero.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Kirinyaga County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kufunga na kutunza vizima moto nyumbani na kazini wakati huu wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan Gobolka Kirinyaga inay guryahooda ku rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo shaqada inta lagu jiro xilliyada shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross paronwa jogweng' Kirinyaga County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag nego ligek mach e utegi kendo giti e kinde masiche mag ndara.

English: The Continuous Voter Registration (CVR) resumes on Monday, 29th September, 2025.
Kiswahili: Usajili Endelevu wa Wapiga Kura (CVR) utaanza tena Jumatatu, tarehe 29 Septemba, 2025.
Somali: Diiwaangelinta Codbixiyayaasha Joogtada ah (CVR) ayaa dib loo bilaabi doonaa Isniinta, Sebtember 29, 2025.
Dholuo: Chenro mar dhi nyime gi ndiko joma oyier (CVR) chakre chieng' auchiel tarik 29 dwe mar ochiko, 2025.

English: Kenya Medical Association appeals to caregivers in Nakuru County to bring their child for growth monitoring as part of the January maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kumleta mtoto wao kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Januari.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ka codsadaa daryeelayaasha degmada Nakuru inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyada ee Janaayo.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association okwayo jorit e gweng' mar Nakuru mondo okel nyithindgi mondo onon dongruok margi kaka achiel kuom chenro mar Januar mar rito ngima mar mine.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for sheep in Garissa County this November.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa kondoo katika Kaunti ya Garissa Novemba hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo loogu talagalay idaha ee Gobolka Garissa bishii Nofeembar.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development olando chenro mar goyo rombe thieth mar rabies maonge chudo e dwe mar Novemba e County mar Garissa.

English: KEMSA reminds the public that free youth mental wellness support is available through county health facilities in Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inakumbusha umma kwamba usaidizi wa bure wa afya ya akili kwa vijana unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Somali: KEMSA waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka in taageero bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay caafimaadka dhimirka ee dhalinyarada laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Marsabit County.
Dholuo: KEMSA paronwa ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar paro mar rowere yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth mag county e county mar Marsabit.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will distribute certified coffee seed to farmers in Vihiga County this October.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itasambaza mbegu za kahawa zilizoidhinishwa kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Oktoba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka wuxuu u qaybin doonaa abuurka kafeega ee shahaadada leh beeraleyda degmada Vihiga bisha Oktoobar.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro pogo kodhi mag kofi ne jopur e County mar Vihiga e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya alerts residents of Embu County to a rise in carjacking cases and advises the public to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawatahadharisha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Embu kuhusu kuongezeka kwa visa vya utekaji nyara wa magari na kushauri umma kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay uga digtay dadka deggan degmada Embu in ay kordheen kiisaska gaadiidka la afduubayo waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inay u soo sheegaan waxqabadka shakiga leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Weche Dhano chiwo siem ne jogweng' mar County mar Embu kuom wach medruok mar timbe mag kwalo mtokni kendo ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ne polis man machiegni.

English: Kajiado County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kajiado: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2024
Somali: Degmada Kajiado: Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kajiado: Oboke machon mar goyo oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2024

English: The past two days have seen the opposition coalition, National Super Alliance (NASA) and the ruling Jubilee Party unveil their manifestos for the 2017 elections. The two parties outlined their pledges...
Kiswahili: Katika siku mbili zilizopita, muungano wa upinzani, National Super Alliance (NASA) na Chama cha Jubilee kilichotawala kimefunua maandishi yao kwa ajili ya uchaguzi wa 2017.
Somali: Labadii maalmood ee la soo dhaafay waxay arkeen isbaheysiga mucaaradka, National Super Alliance (NASA) iyo Xisbiga Jubilee ee talada haya ay soo bandhigeen muuqaalkooda doorashada 2017.
Dholuo: E odiechienge ariyo mosekalo, riwruok mar akwede, National Super Alliance (NASA) kod chama mar Jubilee ma locho e piny oseloso chenro mag yiero ma biro timore e higa mar 2017.

English: Notice: Pest Control Products Board will train farmers in Kakamega County on terracing this December.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kakamega juu ya mashindano ya wadudu Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogaysiis: Guddiga Xakamaynta Wax soo saarka cayayaanka ayaa tababar siin doona beeraleyda Gobolka Kakamega ee ku saabsan dhulka lagu beeray bisha Diseembar ee soo socota.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: Komiti mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok biro tiego jopur e gweng' mar Kakamega e wi loso lowo e dwe mar Desemba.

English: OGP encourages first-time voters in Kajiado County to carry a valid national ID or passport on voting day.
Kiswahili: OGP inawatia moyo wapiga kura wa mara ya kwanza katika Kajiado County kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa au pasipoti siku ya kupiga kura.
Somali: OGP waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Kajiado inay haystaan aqoonsi ama baasaboor qaran oo ansax ah maalinta codbixinta.
Dholuo: OGP jiwo jogo matimoga yiero mokwongo e Kajiado County mondo oting'e ID mar piny kata pasipoti e odiechieng' mar yiero.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Mombasa County to carry a valid national ID when seeking treatment to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kubeba kitambulisho halali cha kitaifa wanapotafuta matibabu ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Mombasa inay haystaan aqoonsi qaran oo ansax ah marka ay raadinayaan daaweyn si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMSA nyiso jogweng' mar County mar Mombasa ni gibed gi ID mar pinygi ka gidwaro yudo thieth mondo giyud thieth makonyogi.

English: KICD reminds needy students in Tana River County that free digital learning content applications close soon.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha wanafunzi wenye uhitaji katika Kaunti ya Tana River kwamba programu za bure za maudhui ya kujifunza kidijitali zitafungwa hivi karibuni.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa ardayda u baahan degmada Tana River in codsiyada barnaamijyada barashada bilaashka ah ee digital-ka ay dhowaan soo gabagabeynayaan.
Dholuo: KICD parone jopuonjre man gi chan e taon mar Tana River County ni chenro mag puonjruok mar digital ma onge chudo chiegni rumo.

English: Nyeri (Kieni) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2022
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Nyeri (Kieni): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2022
Somali: Degmada Nyeri (Kieni): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2022
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Nyeri (Kieni): Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo kuom Septemba 2022

English: Universities Fund calls on the community in Uasin Gishu County to reach out to the child helpline 116 to keep schools safe.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu unatoa wito kwa jamii katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kuwasiliana na nambari ya usaidizi ya watoto 116 ili kuweka shule salama.
Somali: Sanduuqa Jaamacadaha wuxuu ugu baaqay bulshada degmada Uasin Gishu inay la xiriiraan khadka caawimaadda carruurta ee 116, si ay iskuulada u ilaaliyaan amniga.
Dholuo: Yunivasiti Fund okwayo ji duto e county mar Uasin Gishu mondo omany namba 116 mar kony ne nyithindo mondo gisik ka gin gi ritruok e skunde.

English: Drought & War Trigger Humanitarian Crisis in Kenya
Kiswahili: Ukame na Vita Vyasababisha Mgogoro wa Kibinadamu nchini Kenya
Somali: Abaaraha iyo Dagaallada oo sababay Xiisad Bini'aadanimo oo ka taagan Kenya
Dholuo: Oro kod lweny okelo pek mag konyo dhano e piny Kenya

English: Notice: Kenya Gazette launches county development projects in Bomet County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Gazeti la Kenya linazindua miradi ya maendeleo ya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Bomet.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Kenya Gazette waxay bilawday mashaariic horumarineed oo ka socda gobolka Bomet.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Gazette chako tich mar timo dongruok e gweng' mar Bomet County.

English: SHA announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Shirika la SHA linatangaza uboreshaji wa nyakati za kutekeleza huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Somali: Shirkadda SHA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee Gobolka Kilifi.
Dholuo: SHA olando lokruok e seche mag tiyo gi passport e gweng' mar Kilifi.

English: Notice: Ministry of Education launches an inclusion of learners with disabilities programme in schools across Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Wizara ya Elimu yazindua mpango wa ujumuishaji wa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay bilawday barnaamij lagu darayo ardayda naafada ah dugsiyada guud ahaan degmada Kiambu.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ministry of Education chako chenro mar tiego nyithindo ma nigi midekre e skunde duto e County mar Kiambu.

English: Notice: Kenya Red Cross confirms a meningitis outbreak alert for Nairobi County. Residents are advised to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya wathibitisha tahadhari ya mlipuko wa homa ya uti wa mgongo katika Kaunti ya Nairobi. Wakazi wanashauriwa kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xaqiijineysaa digniin ku saabsan cudurka meningitis ee Gobolka Nairobi. Dadka deggan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay buuxiyaan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Kenya Red Cross osenyiso ni nitie siem mar tuo mar meningitis e County mar Nairobi.

English: IPOA reminds survivors of gender-based violence in Nyamira County that access to psychosocial support is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: IPOA inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisaikolojia unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: IPOA waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada Nyamira in helitaanka taageerada cilmu-nafsiga ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah.
Dholuo: IPOA paronwa jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako e County mar Nyamira ni thuolo mar yudo kony kuom weche mag pach ji yudore maonge chudo.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to engage in the Bottom Up Economic Transformation Agenda aimed at boosting agricultural productivity and addressing food security issues
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wamehimizwa kushiriki katika Ajenda ya Mabadiliko ya Kiuchumi ya Bottom Up inayolenga kuongeza tija katika kilimo na kushughulikia masuala ya usalama wa chakula.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha waxaa lagu dhiiri geliyaa inay ku biiraan ajandaha isbedelka dhaqaalaha ee ka hooseeya korka, kaas oo loogu talagalay kor u qaadista wax soo saarka beeraha iyo wax ka qabashada arrimaha amniga cuntada

Kiswahili: EACC inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kwale kuhudhuria mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma ili kuunda ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka.

Dholuo: NTSA chiwo siem ne jogweng' Nyeri County e wi medruok mar weche mag kwalo jamni kendo ojiwo ji mondo oriw lwedo chenro mag polise mag oganda (Nyumba Kumi).

Kiswahili: Amri ya kutotoka nje ya nchi nzima kuanzia jioni hadi alfajiri yaongezwa kwa siku 21 ili kupunguza kuenea kwa Covid-19

English: SHA urges residents of Tana River County to report corruption cases via the toll-free EACC hotline to fight bribery in public offices.

Somali: ODPP waxay ku martiqaadeysaa dadka deggan degmada Meru inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada ee ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta.
Dholuo: ODPP gwelo ji duto modak e County mar Meru mondo oriwre kodgi kokalo kuom websait mar county's online participation portal e wi chenro mag dongruok.

Kiswahili: KTDA inashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga watumie viwango vinavyopendekezwa vya mbolea kabla ya mvua kabla ya msimu wa kupanda Oktoba.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Kirinyaga inay isticmaalaan heerarka bacriminta lagu taliyey ka hor roobabka ka hor xilliga beeritaanka Oktoobar.
Dholuo: KTDA jiwo jopur e gweng ' mar Kirinyaga County mondo oti gi kwan mar yien ma gichiwo kapok koth ochue e dwe mar Oktoba.

English: After harvest, parts of the maize plant can be used to feed livestock, or left on the soil or mixed into it to increase yields and improve resistance to drought.
Kiswahili: Baada ya mavuno, sehemu za mmea wa mahindi zinaweza kutumika kulisha mifugo, au kuachwa kwenye udongo au kuchanganywa ndani yake ili kuongeza mavuno na kuboresha upinzani dhidi ya ukame.
Somali: Goosashada kadib, qaybo ka mid ah geedka hadhuudhka waxaa loo isticmaali karaa in lagu quudiyo xoolaha, ama lagu daayo ciidda ama lagu qasi karo si loo kordhiyo wax soo saarka loona wanaajiyo iska caabinista abaarta.
Dholuo: Bang' keyo, inyalo ti gi moko kuom yiende mag kodhi e pidho jamni, kata inyalo weyogi e lowo kata iketogi e lowo mondo omi gimi ji nyak kendo gitim maber e kedo gi oro.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya warns residents of Bomet County to prepare for possible drought this March.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kujiandaa kwa ukame unaowezekana Machi hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay ka digtay dadka deggan degmada Bomet inay u diyaar garoobaan abaaraha iman kara bisha Maarso.
