English: DPP warns residents of Tana River County about a rise in phishing messages and advises the public to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone.
Kiswahili: DPP inawaonya wakazi wa Wilaya ya Tana River juu ya kuongezeka kwa ujumbe wa udanganyifu na inashauri umma wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote.
Somali: DPP waxay uga digeysaa dadka deggan degmada Tana River in ay kor u qaadaan fariimaha phishing waxayna dadka kula talineysaa inaysan marnaba cidna la wadaagin lambarka PIN-ka M-Pesa.
Dholuo: DPP osiemo jogweng' mar Tana River County kuom wach medruok mar ote mag phishing kendo osiemo ji ni kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata.

English: We have received multiple reports of individuals faking job placement letters for Qatar and UAE. All foreign employment must go through accredited agencies.
Kiswahili: Tumepokea ripoti nyingi za watu binafsi wanaofanya barua za uwekaji kazi bandia kwa Qatar na UAE. Ajira zote za kigeni lazima zipitie mashirika yaliyoidhinishwa.

English: IEBC encourages out-of-school children in Kirinyaga County to register their children at the nearest public school under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Kirinyaga inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo nyithindo maok dhi e skul e gweng' mar Kirinyaga mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni kodgi kaluwore gi chenro mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response appeals to caregivers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to register for the mother-and-child health card as part of the June maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Majibu ya Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kujiandikisha kwa kadi ya afya ya mama na mtoto kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Juni.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet inay iska diiwaangeliyaan kaarka caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha oo qayb ka ah dadaalka caafimaadka hooyooyinka bisha Juun.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo kwayo jorit e County mar Elgeyo-Marakwet mondo odonj e kad mar thieth mar min gi nyathi e dwe mar Jun.

English: NDMA urges residents of Kericho County to support local peace-building committees amid heightened attention to community early-warning systems.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kericho kuunga mkono halmashauri za kujenga amani za ndani wakati wa umakini mkubwa kwa mifumo ya onyo la mapema la jamii.
Somali: NDMA waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kericho inay taageeraan guddiyada nabadeynta maxalliga ah iyada oo diiradda la saarayo nidaamyada digniinta hore ee bulshada.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo jogweng' Kericho County mondo oriw lwedo komiti mag loso kuwe e gweng'no nikech ji medo keto pachgi kuom chenro mag chiwo siem motelo ne oganda.

English: Success will hinge on lowering barriers to work and mobility, crowding in private investment, and strengthening local ecosystems while maintaining targeted, shockâ€‘responsive support to protect the most vulnerable during the transition.
Kiswahili: Mafanikio yatategemea kupunguza vizuizi vya kufanya kazi na uhamaji, msongamano katika uwekezaji wa kibinafsi, na kuimarisha mifumo ikolojia ya ndani huku tukidumisha usaidizi unaolengwa, unaoitikia mshtuko ili kulinda walio hatarini zaidi wakati wa mpito.

Dholuo: Oganda biro luwore gi duoko piny obadho mag tich kod wuotho, pong'o mwandu mag ji wawegi, kod keto teko ekosistem mag alwora ka pod girito kony ma ochung'ne, ma dwoko wach mar shock mondo orit joma nigi pek ahinya e kinde mar lokruok.

English: Adding value to vegetables can significantly increase your income Explore simple processing techniques and market opportunities for value added products
Kiswahili: Kuongeza thamani kwenye mboga kunaweza kuongeza mapato yako kwa kiasi kikubwa Chunguza mbinu rahisi za usindikaji na fursa za soko la bidhaa zenye thamani
Somali: Qiimaha lagu daro khudaarta ayaa si weyn u kordhin kara dakhligaaga Baarista farsamooyinka wax soo saarka fudud iyo fursadaha suuqa ee alaabta qiimaha lagu daro
Dholuo: Keto nengo mar alot nyalo miyo iyud pesa momedore.

English: Notice: Kenya Dairy Board will train farmers in Kitui County on organic farming this September.
Kiswahili: Ilani: Bodi ya Maziwa ya Kenya itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuhusu kilimo hai Septemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Guddiga Caanaha ee Kenya wuxuu tababar siin doonaa beeraleyda Gobolka Kitui ee beeraha dabiiciga ah bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Kenya Dairy Board biro tiego jopur e County Kitui e wi pur ma nigi gik mochido e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Council of Governors reminds the public in Nakuru County that reporting bribery in public offices is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba kuripoti rushwa katika ofisi za umma ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha ayaa xasuusinaya shacabka degmada Nakuru in warbixinta laaluushka xafiisyada dadweynaha ay tahay mid lacag la'aan ah, amaan ah, oo qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch oparo ne ji e gweng' mar Nakuru ni chiwo ripot mar kawo asoya e migepe mag sirkal en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: State Department for TVET advises students in Nakuru County to apply through the online scholarship portal to access revision guides.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Jimbo la TVET inawashauri wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kutuma maombi kupitia tovuti ya ufadhili wa masomo mtandaoni ili kupata miongozo ya marekebisho.
Somali: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee TVET waxay ardayda degmada Nakuru kula talineysaa inay dalbadaan bogga waxbarasho ee internetka si ay u helaan hagaha dib u eegista.
Dholuo: Department of State for TVET jiwo jopuonjre e kaunti mar Nakuru mondo okonygi kokalo kuom websait mar somo ma yudore e Intanet mondo giyud weche mag somo.

English: KEPHIS advises farmers in Nyandarua County to register for the free training session to attend the upcoming agricultural training.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua kujiandikisha kwa kikao cha mafunzo bila malipo ili kuhudhuria mafunzo yajayo ya kilimo.
Somali: KEPHIS waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Nyandarua inay iska diiwaangeliyaan tababarka bilaashka ah si ay uga qeybgalaan waxbarashada beeraha ee soo socota.
Dholuo: KEPHIS jiwo jopur e County mar Nyandarua mondo odonj e tiegruok ma onge chudo mar dhi e tiego jopur mabiro.

English: Notice: DCI conducts a community briefing on counter-terrorism vigilance in Lamu County this September.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka: DCI inafanya mkutano wa jumuiya juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi katika Kaunti ya Lamu mwezi huu wa Septemba.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay qabaneysaa warbixin bulsho ku saabsan ka hortagga argagixisada ee gobolka Lamu bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni DCI dhi timo romo mar oganda e sulani mar Lamu County e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response announces outpatient services for residents of Nairobi County starting this October.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Mwitikio wa Magonjwa inatangaza huduma za wagonjwa wa nje kwa wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nairobi kuanzia Oktoba hii.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa adeegyada bukaanka dibedda ee dadka deggan degmada Nairobi laga bilaabo Oktoobarkan.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Nono Kendo Duogo ne Tuoche ogolo chenro mar konyo jotuo mag Nairobi County kochakore dwe mar Oktoba.

English: Announcement that clubs will offer peer-led education, counseling referrals and healthy cafeteria initiatives.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwamba vilabu vitatoa elimu inayoongozwa na wenzao, marejeleo ya ushauri nasaha na mipango ya mkahawa yenye afya.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida in kooxaha ay bixin doonaan waxbarasho la-hawlgalayaal ah, la-talinta tixraacyada iyo mashaariicda cuntada caafimaadka leh.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Joneno mag Jehova biro chiwo tiegruok, chiwo paro, koda chenro mag chiemo.

English: Council of Governors advises residents of Nakuru County to carry all required documents to avoid delays when seeking passport services.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Gavana linashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kubeba nyaraka zote zinazohitajika ili kuepuka kuchelewa wakati wa kutafuta huduma za pasipoti.
Somali: Golaha Guddoomiyayaashu waxay kula talinayaan dadka deggan degmada Nakuru inay qaataan dhammaan dukumiintiyada loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado dib u dhac marka la raadinayo adeegyada baasaboorka.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch jiwo jogweng' Nakuru County mondo oting'e buge duto madwarore mondo kik gideki sama gidwaro tiyo gi passport.

English: Makueni County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for August 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Makueni: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Agosti 2024
Somali: Degmada Makueni: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Ogosto 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Makueni: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar aboro higa mar 2024

English: KUCCPS urges youth in Tana River County to attend the civic education forum ahead of upcoming civic activities.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawahimiza vijana katika Kaunti ya Tana River kuhudhuria kongamano la elimu ya uraia kabla ya shughuli zijazo za kiraia.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay ku boorineysaa dhalinyarada degmada Tana River inay ka qeyb galaan madasha waxbarashada rayidka ka hor inta aan la qaban waxqabadyada rayidka ah ee soo socda.
Dholuo: KUCCPS jiwo rowere man Tana River County mondo odhi e chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda ka pok gichako timo tije mag oganda.

English: CDC encourages residents of Nyamira County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: CDC inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kutoteseka kimya kimya na kuhudhuria kikao cha bure cha ushauri wa jamii.
Somali: CDC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inaysan ku xanuunsadaan si aamusnaan ah oo ay uga qayb galaan kalfadhiga bulshada ee bilaashka ah.
Dholuo: CDC jiwo jogweng' Nyamira County mondo kik gisandre gi muol kendo mondo gidhi e chokruok mar chiwo paro maonge chudo.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Kisumu County that reporting cattle rustling promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kisumu kwamba kuripoti wizi wa ng'ombe mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisumu in warbixinta degdegga ah ee xanta xoolaha ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne jogweng' Kisumu County ni ka ng'ato olando mapiyo ni jamni omako jamni, mano konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: The Strategy was developed through a phased, consultative process from 2025 to 2026.
Kiswahili: Mkakati huu uliandaliwa kupitia mchakato wa mashauriano wa hatua kwa hatua kutoka 2025 hadi 2026.
Somali: Istaraatiijiyadda waxaa lagu sameeyay geeddi-socod wadatashi oo marxalado ah laga bilaabo 2025 ilaa 2026.
Dholuo: Okengego ne olosi kokalo kuom yore mag loso gi ji, chakre higa mar 2025 nyaka 2026.

English: COMESA announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for dairy cows in Kwale County this July.
Kiswahili: COMESA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa ng'ombe wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Kwale Julai hii.
Somali: COMESA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ku saabsan qabyaalada lo'da caanaha ah ee Gobolka Kwale bishii Luulyo.
Dholuo: COMESA ogolo chenro mar thiedho dhok ma chamo dhok e dwe mar Julai e kaunti mar Kwale.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development encourages residents of Bungoma County to verify their voter registration details to stay informed on constitutional rights.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawahimiza wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Bungoma kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili wa wapiga kura ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu haki za kikatiba.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan degmada Bungoma inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaashooda si ay uga warqabaan xuquuqda dastuuriga ah.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development jiwo jogweng'o mag Bungoma County mondo ong'e weche ma gidonjogo e register mar joma oyiero mondo ging'e ratiro ma sirkal nigo.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by SHA (Social Health Authority) will be held in Lamu County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Lamu Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: xerada caafimaadka ee bilaashka ah ee ay soo qabanqaabisay SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa lagu qaban doonaa degmada Lamu bisha April.
Dholuo: Ng'e wachni: kambi mar thieth maonge chudo ma olos gi SHA (Social Health Authority) ibiro tim Lamu County e dwe mar April.

English: NDMA calls on the community in Embu County to speak out against gender-based violence and seek support from the nearest safe house.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawatia moyo jamii katika Kaunti ya Embu kuongea dhidi ya vurugu za kijinsia na kutafuta msaada kutoka kwa nyumba ya usalama iliyo karibu.
Somali: NDMA waxay bulshada degmada Embu ugu baaqeysaa inay ka hadlaan rabshadaha jinsiga ku saleysan waxayna taageero ka raadsadaan guryaha ugu dhow.
Dholuo: NDMA luongo ji duto e county mar Embu mondo ochiw pachgi kuom timbe mahundu mag dichwo gi dhako kendo gidwar kony e kar dak machiegni.

English: The government should strengthen surveillance and disease control programmes for livestock.
Kiswahili: Serikali inapaswa kuimarisha programu za uchunguzi na za kudhibiti magonjwa kwa ajili ya mifugo.
Somali: Dowladda waa inay xoojisaa barnaamijyada kormeerka iyo xakamaynta cudurrada xoolaha.
Dholuo: Sirkal onego ojiw chenro mag rito kod geng'o tuoche mag jamni.

English: KTDA warns sorghum farmers in Samburu County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaonya wakulima wa sorghum katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuhusu maambukizi ya wadudu na kupendekeza hatua ya wakati unaofaa.
Somali: KTDA waxay uga digtaa beeraleyda dalagga ee Gobolka Samburu cudurrada cayayaanka ah waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyin waqtigeeda ah.
Dholuo: KTDA chiwo siem ne jopur mag sorghum e kaunti mar Samburu kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Notice: DCI launches a cattle rustling prevention campaign in Nyamira County this April.
Kiswahili: Ilani: DCI yazindua kampeni ya kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Nyamira Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: DCI waxay billaabaneysaa olole looga hortago xanta xoolaha ee gobolka Nyamira bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni DCI chako kampen mar geng'o ywaruok mag dhok e taon mar Nyamira e dwe mar April.

English: Pest Control Products Board advises milk producers in Siaya County to sell produce only through licensed buyers ahead of the harvest season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inashauri wazalishaji wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuuza mazao tu kupitia wanunuzi walioidhinishwa kabla ya msimu wa mavuno.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa kula talinaya soosaarayaasha caanaha ee degmada Siaya inay ka iibsadaan alaabada kaliya iibsadayaasha ruqsadda leh ka hor xilliga goosashada.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok jiwo jopur mag chak e county mar Siaya mondo ous gik moko mana kokalo kuom jogo ma nigi ratiro mar nyiewo gik moko kapok kinde keyo ochopo.

English: KTDA warns maize farmers in Murang'a County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KTDA inawaonya wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KTDA waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Murang'a cudurrada cayayaanka waxayna ku talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: KTDA chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho kodhi e County mar Murang'a kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ochiwo paro mar kawo okang' mapiyo.

English: Embu (Mbeere) County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for September 2024
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Embu (Mbeere): Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Septemba 2024
Somali: Degmada Embu (Mbeere): Warbixinta Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Sebtembar 2024
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Embu (Mbeere): Oboke mar Chik Mapiyo mar Septemba 2024

English: Kenya Red Cross urges the public in Kitui County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Kitui kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia visa vilivyoripotiwa vya udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadweynaha degmada Kitui inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo ji duto e County mar Kitui mondo onon kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche mag wuond motudore gi SIM-swap.

Kunawa mikono mara kwa mara kwa sabuni na maji yanayotiririka kunapendekezwa na @WHO kama mojawapo ya njia bora za kuzuia kuenea kwa COVID-19. #KomeshaCorona

Dhaqidda gacmaha ee joogtada ah ee saabuun iyo biyo socda waxaa ku taliyay @WHO inay tahay mid ka mid ah siyaabaha ugu wanaagsan ee looga hortagi karo faafitaanka COVID-19. #KomeshaCorona

English: UNHCR Kenya: Multi-year Strategy 2023 - 2026 - Livelihoods and Economic Inclusion (June 2022)
Kiswahili: UNHCR Kenya: Mikakati ya Miaka Mingi 2023 - 2026 - Riziki na Ushirikishwaji wa Kiuchumi (Juni 2022)
Somali: UNHCR Kenya: Istaraatiijiyad Sannado Badan ah 2023 - 2026 - Nolol-maalmeed iyo Ka-mid-noqoshada Dhaqaalaha (Juun 2022)
Dholuo: UNHCR Kenya: Chenro mar higni mathoth 2023 - 2026 - Yore mag dak kod keto weche mag ohala (dwe mar auchiel 2022)

English: Ministry of health has confirmed the first coronavirus case in Kenya. The Kenyan citizen returning from the US to Nairobi via London on 5th March. She was confirmed positive by the national influenza lab. However, the patient is stable
Kiswahili: Wizara ya afya imethibitisha kisa cha kwanza cha virusi vya corona nchini Kenya. Raia huyo wa Kenya anarudi kutoka Marekani hadi Nairobi kupitia London mnamo Machi 5. Alithibitishwa kuwa na virusi hivyo na maabara ya kitaifa ya mafua. Hata hivyo, mgonjwa huyo yuko imara.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa xaqiijisay kiiskii ugu horreeyay ee cudurka Coronavirus ee Kenya. Muwaadinka reer Kenya ayaa ka soo laabtay Mareykanka oo ku soo laabatay Nairobi iyada oo loo marayo London 5-kii Maarso. Waxaa lagu xaqiijiyay in ay qabatay shaybaarka caabuqa ee qaranka. Si kastaba ha noqotee, bukaanku waa xasilloon yahay.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche thieth mar Kenya oseyudo ng'at ma nokwongo yudo tuo mar corona e piny Kenya. Nyaminwa ma Kenya duogo Nairobi koa Amerka koluwo London tarik 5 dwe mar Mach.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds the public in Migori County that reporting abuse of office is free, safe, and confidential.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Migori kwamba kuripoti unyanyasaji wa madaraka ni bure, salama, na ya siri.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu dadka degmada Migori xasuusinayaa in sheegashada xadgudubka xilka ay tahay mid bilaash ah, ammaan ah, iyo mid qarsoodi ah.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone ji duto e county mar Migori ni lando wach tiyo marach gi migepe en gima onge rach, en gima ni kare, kendo en gima opondo.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya warns residents of Laikipia County to prepare for possible road accidents this August.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawaonya wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Laikipia kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa ajali za barabarani Agosti hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta ee Kenya waxay ka digtay dadka deggan degmada Laikipia inay diyaar u noqdaan shilalka waddooyinka ee dhici kara bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Communications Authority osiemo jogweng' Laikipia County mondo oikre ne masiche ma nyalo timore e nderni e dwe mar Agost.

English: KICD reminds youth in Busia County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: KICD inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Busia kwamba ufadhili wa HELB unapatikana kwa mafunzo ya ufundi wa magari.
Somali: KICD waxay xasuusineysaa dhallinyarada degmada Busia in maalgelinta HELB ay diyaar u tahay tababarka farsamada gawaarida gaadiidka.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne rowere man Busia County ni pesa mag HELB yudore ne tiegruok mar masinde mag mtokni.

English: Kenyaâ€™s Crisis Shows the Urgency of African Poverty, Corruption, Debt
Kiswahili: Mgogoro wa Kenya Unaonyesha Udharura wa Umaskini wa Afrika, Ufisadi, Madeni

Dholuo: Masira mar Kenya Nyiso Bedo Mapiyo mar Odhier, Ketho, Gowi e Afrika

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds residents of Kilifi County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this flooding season.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Upelelezi wa Jinai inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kilifi kufunga na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi wakati huu wa mafuriko.
Somali: Agaasinka baaritaanka dambiyada ayaa dadka deggan degmada Kilifi ku xasuusinaya inay guryahooda ku rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab damiska iyo inay shaqeeyaan xilliyada fatahaadaha.
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations paronwa jogweng' Kilifi County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag nego ligek mach e utegi kendo giti e kinde mag koth.

English: TSC reminds parents in Kericho County that bursary allocation registration is open this February.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Kericho kwamba usajili wa ugawaji wa bursary umefunguliwa Februari hii.
Somali: TSC waxay xasuusineysaa waalidiinta degmada Kericho in diiwaangelinta deeqda deeqda waxbarasho ay furan tahay bisha Febraayo.
Dholuo: TSC oparo ne jonyuol e County mar Kericho ni kad mar chiwo mich mag tiegruok osechakore e dwe mar Februar.

English: IEBC encourages out-of-school children in Embu County to register their children at the nearest public school under school feeding programme.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawahimiza watoto walio nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Embu kusajili watoto wao katika shule ya umma iliyo karibu chini ya mpango wa kulisha shule.
Somali: IEBC waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa carruurta ka baxsan dugsiga ee degmada Embu inay carruurtooda ka diiwaangeliyaan dugsiga ugu dhow ee dadweynaha barnaamijka quudinta dugsiga.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo nyithindo ma ok dhi e skul e county mar Embu mondo ondik nyithindgi e skul man machiegni kodgi kaluwore gi chenro mar pidho nyithindo e skul.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service reminds residents of Uasin Gishu County that water harvesting improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba uvunaji wa maji unaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: Adeegga Kormeerka Caafimaadka Dhirta ee Kenya wuxuu xasuusinayaa dadka deggan Gobolka Uasin Gishu in goosashada biyaha ay hagaajineyso wax soo saarka beeraha muddada-dheer.
Dholuo: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service oparo ne jogweng' Uasin Gishu County ni choko pi miyo puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: NDMA urges the public in Tana River County to never share their M-Pesa PIN with anyone following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawasihi raia wa Wilaya ya Tana River wasishiriki PIN yao ya M-Pesa na mtu yeyote baada ya kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: NDMA waxay ugu baaqeysaa shacabka degmada Tana River County inaysan marnaba la wadaagin PIN-kooda M-Pesa qofna ka dib kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: NDMA jiwo ji duto e taon mar Tana River County mondo kik gipog PIN mar M-Pesa gi ng'ato ang'ata bang' weche mag wuond ma ne otim gi SIM-swap.

English: KEMSA advises residents of Migori County to register for their health insurance cover to access subsidised healthcare.
Kiswahili: KEMSA inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Migori kujiandikisha kwa bima yao ya afya ili kupata huduma za afya za ruzuku.
Somali: KEMSA waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Migori inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiskooda caafimaadka si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo lacageed.
Dholuo: KEMSA jiwo jogweng' Migori County mondo odonj e riwruok mar insuarans mar thieth mondo giyud thieth ma yudo kony.

English: Repeated ear infections can cause hearing loss. Visit a health worker promptly.
Kiswahili: Maambukizi ya sikio yanayorudiwa yanaweza kusababisha upotevu wa kusikia. Mtembelee mfanyakazi wa afya haraka.
Somali: Dhibaatooyinka dhegaha ee soo noqnoqda waxay keeni karaan maqla la'aan.
Dholuo: Bedo gi tuoche mang'eny e it nyalo miyo ng'ato olal winjo wach.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Nyamira County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira in warbixinta degdegga ah ee jabsashada ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NTSA oparo ne jogweng' Nyamira County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo odno konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: Notice: IEBC will hold a public participation forum on development planning forums in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IEBC itafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay qaban doontaa madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee ku saabsan madasha qorsheynta horumarinta ee Degmada Migori.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IEBC biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi chenro mag dongruok e county mar Migori.

English: Notice: KRA opens the electoral calendar centres in Vihiga County this December.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KRA inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga Desemba hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KRA waxay furaysaa xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee degmada Vihiga bishii Diseembar.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KRA chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e County mar Vihiga e dwe mar Desemba.

English: Be careful about where you get information about COVID-19. Promises of a guaranteed cure to prevent COVID-19 are not accurate. As of now, there is no vaccine for COVID-19. Please continue to use MOH & WHO websites for information on how to help prevent COVID-19. #KomeshaCorona
Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu kuhusu mahali unapopata maelezo kuhusu COVID-19. Ahadi za tiba ya uhakika ya kuzuia COVID-19 si sahihi. Kufikia sasa, hakuna chanjo ya COVID-19. Tafadhali endelea kutumia tovuti za MOH & WHO kwa maelezo kuhusu jinsi ya kusaidia kuzuia COVID-19. #KomeshaCorona
Somali: Ka digtoonow meesha aad ka hesho macluumaad ku saabsan COVID-19. Ballanqaadyada daawo la hubo oo looga hortago COVID-19 sax ma aha. Ilaa hadda, ma jiro tallaal loogu talagalay COVID-19. Fadlan sii wad isticmaalka mareegaha MOH & WHO si aad u hesho macluumaad ku saabsan sida looga hortago COVID-19. #KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Bed motang' kuom kama iyudoe weche motudore kod COVID-19. Singo mag thieth motegno mar geng'o COVID-19 ok gin adier. Kaka sani, onge chanjo mar COVID-19. Yie mondo idhi nyime tiyo kod mbui mag MOH kod WHO mondo iyud weche kaka inyalo konyo geng'o tuo mar COVID-19. #KomeshaKorona

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) invites farmers in Tana River County to a free training on post-harvest handling this May.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Tana River kwa mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno Mei hii.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku casuumaysaa beeraleyda degmada Tana River inay tababar lacag la'aan ah ku helaan qabashada ka dib goosashada bisha May.
Dholuo: Oganda mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) ogwelo jopur e taon mar Tana River County mondo otim tiegruok maonge chudo e dwe mar Mei.

English: Feasibility, acceptability and lessons learned from an infant feeding intervention trial among women living with HIV in western Kenya
Kiswahili: Uwezekano, kukubalika na mafunzo tuliyojifunza kutoka kwa jaribio la kuingilia kati ulishaji wa watoto wachanga miongoni mwa wanawake wanaoishi na VVU magharibi mwa Kenya.
Somali: Suurtagalnimada, aqbalaadda iyo casharrada laga bartay tijaabada faragelinta quudinta carruurta ee haweenka la nool HIV ee galbeedka Kenya
Dholuo: Kaka nyalore, yie kod gik ma wapuonjore kuom temo mar chiwo chiemo ne nyithindo matindo e kind mon ma nigi tuo mar HIV e piny Kenya ma milambo

English: The government confirms continued distribution of free laptops to Grade 1 learners under the Digital Literacy Programme.
Kiswahili: Serikali inathibitisha kuendelea kusambaza kompyuta ndogo za bure kwa wanafunzi wa darasa la 1 chini ya Mpango wa Ujuzi wa Dijiti.
Somali: Dowladda waxay xaqiijineysaa in la sii wado qaybinta laptops-ka bilaashka ah ee ardayda fasalka 1aad ee barnaamijka akhriska digital.
Dholuo: Sirkal osenyiso ni gidhi nyime pogo kompyuta mag kompyuta maonge chudo ne jopuonjre mag Grade 1 e bwo chenro mar Digital Literacy Programme.

English: Expectant mothers are urged to start antenatal care visits during the first trimester of pregnancy to monitor both mother and baby_x0092_s health. Early check-ups help identify risks and ensure safe delivery.
Kiswahili: Mama wajawazito wanahimizwa waanze ziara za utunzaji wa kabla ya kuzaa wakati wa miezi mitatu ya kwanza ya ujauzito ili kufuatilia afya ya mama na mtoto. Uchunguzi wa mapema husaidia kutambua hatari na kuhakikisha kujifungua salama.
Somali: Hooyooyinka uurka leh waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay bilaabaan booqashooyinka daryeelka dhalmada kahor inta lagu jiro saddexda bilood ee ugu horreeya uurka si ay ula socdaan caafimaadka hooyada iyo ilmaha labadaba. Baaritaannada hore waxay gacan ka geystaan ​​​​aqoonsiga khataraha iyo hubinta dhalmada badbaadada leh.
Dholuo: Joma nigi ich ojiw mondo ochaki limo mag rito nyithindo kapok ginywol ​​e kinde ma gisebedo ka gin gi ich mondo girang’ ngima mar min kod nyathi. Timo nonro mapiyo konyo e fwenyo gik ma nyalo kelo hinyruok kendo neno ni nyathi onyuol maber.

English: SHA warns public officers in Baringo County against bribery in public offices.
Kiswahili: SHA inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo dhidi ya kupokea rushwa katika ofisi za umma.
Somali: SHA waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dawladda ee degmada Baringo inay musuqmaasuqa ka qaataan xafiisyada dawladda.
Dholuo: SHA chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e gweng' mar Baringo kuom kawo asoya e migepe ma sirkal tiyogo.

English: AFA reminds residents of Bomet County that organic farming improves long-term farm productivity.
Kiswahili: AFA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet kwamba kilimo hai kinaboresha tija ya muda mrefu ya shamba.
Somali: AFA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Bomet in beeraha dabiiciga ah uu hagaajinayo wax soo saarka beeraha muddada dheer.
Dholuo: AFA paronwa jogweng'o mag Bomet County ni pur ma nigi yien ma ok oketie yien miyo puothe bedo gi nyak kuom kinde malach.

English: Pest Control Products Board announces a free foot and mouth disease vaccination exercise for poultry in Nyandarua County this September.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya ugonjwa wa miguu na mdomo kwa kuku katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua Septemba hii.
Somali: Guddiga Wax soo saarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka ayaa ku dhawaaqay jimicsi tallaal ah oo bilaash ah oo ku saabsan cudurka afka iyo afka ee digaagga ee gobolka Nyandarua bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products olando chenro mar thiedho dhok gi tuoche mag dhoot maonge chudo e dwe mar ochiko mar higani e county mar Nyandarua.

English: Notice: IEBC launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Marsabit County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: IEBC yazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Marsabit.
Somali: Ogeysiis: IEBC waxay bilawday barnaamij tallaabooyin looga hortago dhibta dugsiyada degmada Marsabit.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: IEBC chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe gero e skunde duto mag Marsabit County.

English: We call upon the County governments to make use of the guidelines on nutritional Management of COVID-19 to educate the communities on how they can boost their immunity. health.go.ke #KomeshaCorona update
Kiswahili: Tunatoa wito kwa serikali za Kaunti kutumia miongozo kuhusu Usimamizi wa lishe wa COVID-19 ili kuelimisha jamii kuhusu jinsi wanavyoweza kuimarisha kinga yao. health.go.ke #KomeshaCorona sasisho
Somali: Waxaan ugu baaqaynaa dowladaha Gobolka inay adeegsadaan tilmaamaha ku saabsan Maareynta Nafaqada ee COVID-19 si ay bulshooyinka u baraan sida ay u kordhin karaan difaacooda. health.go.ke #Warbixinta KomeshaCorona
Dholuo: Wakwayo sirkande mag County mondo oti kod chike ma mulo yore mag rito chiemo mag COVID-19 mondo opuonj oganda kaka ginyalo medo teko mar ringruok mar geng’o tuo mar COVID-19. #KomeshaCorona update

English: NTSA urges the public in Kiambu County to verify requests through official channels before acting following reported cases of SIM-swap fraud.
Kiswahili: NTSA inahimiza umma katika Kaunti ya Kiambu kuthibitisha maombi kupitia njia rasmi kabla ya kuchukua hatua kufuatia kesi zilizoripotiwa za udanganyifu wa kubadilishana SIM.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa dadweynaha degmada Kiambu inay xaqiijiyaan codsiyada kanaalada rasmiga ah ka hor inta aysan wax ka qaban kiisaska la soo sheegay ee khayaanada SIM-swap.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo ji duto e County mar Kiambu mondo ong'e kwayogi kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal kapok gitimo gimoro kaluwore gi weche ma osefweny kuom wuond mag SIM-swap.

English: Notice: COMESA will train farmers in Homa Bay County on water harvesting this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay juu ya uvunaji wa maji Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda gobolka Homa Bay oo ku saabsan goosashada biyaha bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA biro tiego jopur e Homa Bay County e dwe mar Mach.

English: Posters distributed nationwide explained suspectsâ€™ rights, legal search limits, and how to file complaints with oversight bodies.
Kiswahili: Posters zilizosambazwa nchini kote zilieleza haki za mtuhumiwa, mipaka ya kisheria ya kutafuta, na jinsi ya kuwasilisha malalamiko kwa vyombo vya usimamizi.
Somali: Boodhadhka ayaa lagu qaybiyay dalka oo dhan iyagoo sharraxaya xuquuqda tuhmanayaasha, xadka baaritaanka sharciga, iyo sida cabashooyinka loogu gudbiyo hay'adaha kormeerka.
Dholuo: Posta ma ne ipogo e piny mangima ne lero ratiro ma jogo ma igeno ni gin joketho nigo, gik ma chik ogolo mar manyogi, kod kaka inyalo keto ywak ne duonde ma rito wechego.

English: Announcing a national digital drive using reels, community challenges and influencer content to promote fruit and vegetable intake.
Kiswahili: Kutangaza kampeni ya kitaifa ya kidijitali kwa kutumia reli, changamoto za jamii na maudhui ya watu wenye ushawishi ili kukuza ulaji wa matunda na mboga.
Somali: Ku dhawaaqida olole dhijitaal ah oo qaran oo adeegsanaya reels, caqabadaha bulshada iyo waxyaabaha saameynaya si kor loogu qaado cunnada miraha iyo khudaarta.
Dholuo: Lando chenro mar tiyo gi digital e piny mangima ka gitiyo gi reels, chandruoge mag oganda, kod gik ma konyo ji mondo oher chamo olemo kod alot.

English: Notice: KALRO will train farmers in Busia County on terracing this January.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KALRO itatoa mafunzo kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia juu ya usafiri wa baharini Januari hii.
Somali: Ogsoonow: KALRO waxay tababar siin doontaa beeraleyda degmada Busia ee ku saabsan dhulka dhulka ee bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KALRO biro tiego jopur e gweng' mar Busia e dwe mar Januar.

English: Council of Governors announces improved turnaround times for national ID applications in Bungoma County.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mawaziri linatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kujibu kwa maombi ya kitambulisho cha kitaifa katika Kaunti ya Bungoma.
Somali: Golaha Gudoomiyayaashu waxay ku dhawaaqeen waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay codsiyada aqoonsiga qaranka ee degmada Bungoma.
Dholuo: Bura mar Jaloch ogolo lokruok e seche mag kwayo nying' mar ng'ato e County mar Bungoma.

English: Notice: NPS opens a gender desk offering the GBV toll-free helpline in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: NPS inafungua ofisi ya jinsia inayotoa simu ya GBV ya bure katika Kaunti ya Isiolo.
Somali: Ogeysiis: NPS waxay furaysaa xafiis jinsi ah oo bixiya khadka caawimaadda GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah ee degmada Isiolo.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: NPS ochako ofis mar weche nindruok ma chiwo chenro mar konyo maonge chudo mar GBV e gweng' mar Isiolo.

English: DCI reminds survivors of gender-based violence in West Pokot County that access to the GBV toll-free helpline is available free of charge.
Kiswahili: DCI inawakumbusha waokokaji wa vurugu za kijinsia katika Kaunti ya West Pokot kwamba upatikanaji wa simu ya GBV ya bure ya msaada unapatikana bila malipo.
Somali: DCI waxay xasuusineysaa kuwa ka badbaaday rabshadaha jinsiga ah ee ka dhacay degmada West Pokot in helitaanka khadka caawimaadda ee GBV ee lacag la'aanta ah uu yahay mid lacag-la'aan ah.
Dholuo: DCI parone jogo mosetho nikech timbe mahundu e West Pokot County ni gibiro yudo kony ma onge chudo mar GBV maonge chudo.

English: Pest Control Products Board warns tea farmers in Nairobi County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawaonya wakulima wa chai katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuhusu milipuko ya wadudu na kupendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: Guddiga wax soo saarka xakameynta cayayaanka ayaa uga digaya beeraleyda shaaha ee degmada Nairobi faafitaanka cayayaannada waxayna kugula talineysaa tallaabooyinka waqtigeeda.
Dholuo: Bura mar Loyo Gik Makelo Hinyruok mar Pest, chiwo siem ne jopur ma loso chai e County mar Nairobi kuom masiche mag hinyruok, kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) reminds the public in Kirinyaga County that input on public policy consultations is welcome this August.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kwamba mchango juu ya mashauriano ya sera za umma unakaribishwa Agosti hii.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) ayaa xasuusinaya shacabka degmada Kirinyaga in talooyinka la-tashiga siyaasadda dadweynaha lagu soo dhaweynayo bisha Agoosto.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) parone ji duto e County mar Kirinyaga ni gibiro chiwo paro e wi chenro mag sirkal e dwe mar Agost.

English: KICD reminds schools in Meru County to strengthen anti-bullying measures this July.
Kiswahili: KICD inakumbusha shule katika Kaunti ya Meru kuimarisha hatua za kupambana na uonevu Julai hii.
Somali: KICD waxay xusuusineysaa dugsiyada degmada Meru inay xoojiyaan tallaabooyinka ka hortagga dhibaatada bisha July.
Dholuo: KICD oparo ne skunde man Meru County mondo omed jiwo yore mag kedo gi ichwanyruok e dwe mar Julai.

English: KMTC advises applicants in Laikipia County to visit the nearest vocational training centre for the upcoming intake.
Kiswahili: KMTC inashauri waombaji katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kutembelea kituo cha karibu cha mafunzo ya ufundi kwa ulaji ujao.
Somali: KMTC waxay ku talineysaa codsadayaasha degmada Laikipia inay booqdaan xarunta tababarka xirfadeed ee ugu dhow ee la heli karo.
Dholuo: KMTC jiwo jogo madwaro dhi e skundno e county mar Laikipia mondo odhi e kambino machiegni gi kama ginyalo yudoe tiegruok.

English: KEMRI reminds expectant mothers in Turkana County that access to childhood immunization is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Turkana kwamba upatikanaji wa chanjo ya utotoni ni bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.
Somali: KEMRI waxay xusuusineysaa hooyooyinka uurka leh ee degmada Turkana in helitaanka tallaalka carruurta ay tahay lacag la'aan dhammaan xarumaha dadweynaha.
Dholuo: KEMRI oparo ne mine ma biro bedo gi ich e County mar Turkana ni yudo thieth mar nyithindo onge chudo e ute duto mag sirkal.

English: KEMRI encourages mothers in Vihiga County to bring their child for growth monitoring to safeguard their child's health.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inawahimiza akina mama katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kumleta mtoto wao kwa ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji ili kulinda afya ya mtoto wao.
Somali: KEMRI waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa hooyooyinka degmada Vihiga inay ilmahooda u keenaan koritaanka koritaanka si ay u ilaaliyaan caafimaadka ilmahooda.
Dholuo: KEMRI jiwo mine manie County mar Vihiga mondo okel nyithindgi e nonro mar dongo mondo girit ngima nyithindgi.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens the electoral calendar centres in Nakuru County this August.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua vituo vya kalenda ya uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Nakuru Agosti hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya ayaa furaya xarumaha jadwalka doorashada ee degmada Nakuru bishii Agoosto.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: Bura mar Kenya chako tiyo gi kalenda mar yiero e kaunti mar Nakuru e dwe mar Agost.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) launches an October awareness campaign on proper sanitation across West Pokot County.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) yazindua kampeni ya uhamasishaji ya Oktoba juu ya usafi wa mazingira katika Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) ayaa bilaabay olole wacyi galineed bishii Oktoobar oo ku saabsan nadaafadda saxda ah ee gobolka West Pokot.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) chako kampen mar chiwo paro e dwe mar Oktoba e wi thieth mowinjore e West Pokot County.

English: Kenya Medical Association urges anyone struggling with their mental health in Kisii County to reach out to a trained counsellor.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Madaktari cha Kenya kinahimiza mtu yeyote anayesumbuliwa na afya yake ya akili katika Kaunti ya Kisii kuwasiliana na mshauri aliyefunzwa.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka ee Kenya wuxuu ku boorinayaa qof kasta oo la halgamaya caafimaadka maskaxda ee degmada Kisii inuu la xiriirto lataliye tababar leh.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Association jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi chandruok mar parruok e gweng' mar Kisii mondo odhi ir japuonj molony.

English: Hormonal changes during pregnancy can affect oral health. Visit a dentist for check-ups and maintain oral hygiene.
Kiswahili: Mabadiliko ya homoni wakati wa ujauzito yanaweza kuathiri afya ya kinywa. Mtembelee daktari wa meno kwa uchunguzi na udumishe usafi wa kinywa.
Somali: Isbeddellada hoormoonka ee uurka ku jira waxay saameyn ku yeelan karaan caafimaadka afka.
Dholuo: Ka ng'ato nigi ich, nyalo bedo ni obedo gi tuwoche mag dhoge.

English: Notice: FAO will conduct a modern irrigation techniques workshop for farmers in Makueni County this March.
Kiswahili: Ilani: FAO itafanya warsha ya kisasa ya mbinu za umwagiliaji kwa wakulima katika Kaunti ya Makueni Machi hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: FAO waxay qaban doontaa aqoon isweydaarsi ku saabsan farsamooyinka waraabka casriga ah ee beeraleyda degmada Makueni bishii Maarso.
Dholuo: Par ane wachni: FAO biro timo chokruok mar timo nonro e wi yore mag lero pi e dwe mar Mach mabiro ne jopur e gweng' mar Makueni.

English: Notice: KICD opens a new welding and fabrication programme at the vocational centre in Machakos County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KICD inafungua programu mpya ya kulehemu na utengenezaji katika kituo cha ufundi katika Kaunti ya Machakos.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KICD waxay furaysaa barnaamij cusub oo ku saabsan alxanka iyo soo saarista xarunta xirfadaha ee degmada Machakos.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KICD chako chenro manyien mar loso kendo loso gik moko e kambi mar tich e gweng' mar Machakos.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds residents of Kajiado County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kajiado kutii maagizo ya uokoaji yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo wakati wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kajiado inay dhagaystaan amarrada daadgureynta ee ay soo saareen maamulayaasha maxalliga ah inta lagu jiro xilliyada shilalka waddooyinka.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji paroga jogweng' Kajiado County mondo oluw chike mag golo ji e nderni ma jotelo mag gweng'no ogolo e kinde masiche mag ndara.

English: ODPP reminds the public in Nakuru County that input on development planning forums is welcome this March.
Kiswahili: ODPP inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Nakuru kwamba mchango kwenye vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo unakaribishwa Machi hii.
Somali: ODPP waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha degmada Nakuru in talooyinka ku saabsan goobaha qorsheynta horumarinta ay soo dhaweynayaan bisha Maarso.
Dholuo: ODPP oparo ne ji duto e gweng' mar Nakuru ni ji mor ahinya gi weche ma ji wacho e wi chenro mag dongruok e dwe mar Mach.

English: Kenya Red Cross urges the community in Nairobi County to report suspicious activity to the nearest police station to curb carjacking.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unaitaka jamii katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kuripoti shughuli za kutiliwa shaka katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ili kuzuia utekaji nyara wa magari.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay ku boorineysaa bulshada degmada Nairobi inay ka warbixiyaan dhaqdhaqaaqyo shaki leh saldhiga booliska ee ugu dhow si loo xakameeyo afduubka gawaarida.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross jiwo oganda man Nairobi County mondo onyis polis ma ni machiegni gi kanyo ni gitimo gimoro marach mondo kik gikwed kwalo mtokni.

English: NDMA reminds residents of West Pokot County to install and maintain fire extinguishers at home and work during this drought season.
Kiswahili: NDMA inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Pokot Magharibi kusakinisha na kudumisha vizima moto nyumbani na kufanya kazi wakati wa msimu huu wa ukame.
Somali: NDMA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada West Pokot inay guryahooda ku rakibtaan oo ay ilaaliyaan qalabka dab daminta iyo shaqada xilliyada abaarta.
Dholuo: NDMA parone jogweng' mar West Pokot County mondo oket kendo orit masinde mag tieko ligek mach e utegi kendo giti e kinde mar oro.

English: The ongoing conflict in the Middle East poses risks to the country's agricultural sector by disrupting trade flows and supply chains and increasing input costs.
Kiswahili: Mzozo unaoendelea katika Mashariki ya Kati unaleta hatari kwa sekta ya kilimo nchini humo kwa kuvuruga mtiririko wa biashara na minyororo ya ugavi na kuongeza gharama za pembejeo.
Somali: Khilaafka ka socda Bariga Dhexe wuxuu khatar ku yahay waaxda beeraha ee dalka isagoo carqaladeynaya socodka ganacsiga iyo silsiladaha sahayda iyo kordhinta kharashyada wax soo saarka.
Dholuo: Gik ma dhi nyime e piny ma yo wuok chieng’ ma diere kelo luoro ne sekta mar pur e pinyno kuom ketho yore mag ohala kod yore mag chiwo gikmoko kendo medo nengo mar gik ma itiyogo.

English: KALRO warns maize farmers in Tana River County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KALRO inawaonya wakulima wa mahindi katika Kaunti ya Tana River juu ya milipuko ya wadudu na inapendekeza kuingilia kati kwa wakati.
Somali: KALRO waxay uga digeysaa beeraleyda hadhuudhka ee degmada Tana River in ay jiraan cudurro cayayaanka ah waxayna ku talineysaa in si sax ah wax looga qabto.
Dholuo: KALRO chiwo siem ne jopur ma pidho kodhi e taon mar Tana River County kuom masiche mag tuoche kendo ojiwo ni gitim kamano e kinde mowinjore.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya reminds the public in Machakos County to remain vigilant on counter-terrorism vigilance.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Machakos kuendelea kuwa macho juu ya tahadhari ya kupambana na ugaidi.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaarsiinta Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa shacabka degmada Machakos inay sii joogaan feejignaanta ka hortagga argagixisada.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Kenya mar Wuoyo gi Ji oparo ne ji duto e county mar Machakos ni mondo gisik ka girito weche makedo gi timbe mahundu.

English: Notice: Office of the Auditor-General opens polling procedures centres in Kisumu County this April.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inafungua vituo vya utaratibu wa uchaguzi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu Aprili hii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Xafiiska Tijaabiyaha Guud wuxuu furayaa xarumaha nidaamyada codbixinta ee degmada Kisumu bishii Abriil.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Ofis mar Jorit Maduong' ochako tiyo gi kuonde ma itimoe yiero e kaunti mar Kisumu e dwe mar April.

English: Kenya Cash Consortium - Four Years on: Locally Led Response Case Study (December 2022)
Kiswahili: Kenya Cash Consortium - Miaka Minne kuanzia: Uchunguzi Kifani wa Majibu ya Ndani (Desemba 2022)
Somali: Ururka Lacagta Kenya - Afar Sano Kadib: Daraasad Kiis Jawaab celin ah oo Deegaanka laga sameeyay (Diseembar 2022)
Dholuo: Riwruok mar pesa mag Kenya - Higni ang'wen mokalo: Nonro mar duoko ma otelo ne jopinyno (Dwe mar apar gi ariyo 2022)

English: Ministry of Health advises residents of Nyamira County to attend the free community health screening to prevent the spread of preventable illness.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawashauri wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa afya ya jamii bila malipo ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa yanayoweza kuzuilika.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka waxay kula talineysaa dadka deggan degmada Nyamira inay ka qeyb galaan baaritaanka caafimaadka bulshada ee bilaashka ah si looga hortago faafitaanka cudurka laga hortagi karo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health nyiso jogweng' Nyamira County mondo odhi e nonro mar thieth mar oganda ma onge chudo mondo gikwed landruok mar tuoche manyalo geng'o.

English: KRA warns public officers in Tharaka-Nithi County against embezzlement of public funds.
Kiswahili: KRA inaonya maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi dhidi ya udanganyifu wa fedha za umma.
Somali: KRA waxay ka digeysaa saraakiisha dowladda ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay ka xishoodaan dhaqaale dawladeed.
Dholuo: KRA chiwo siem ne jotelo mag sirkal e Tharaka-Nithi County ni kik gitim mibadhi mar pesa.

English: Kenya Economic Update, June 2023 (Edition #27)
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya Kiuchumi ya Kenya, Juni 2023 (Toleo #27)
Somali: Cusboonaysiinta Dhaqaalaha Kenya, Juun 2023 (Daabacaadda #27)
Dholuo: Wach manyien mar weche yuto mag piny Kenya, dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2023 (Oboke mar namba 27)

English: Huduma Kenya updates residents of Uasin Gishu County on progress of community-based development programmes this September.
Kiswahili: Huduma Kenya inawajulisha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu maendeleo ya mipango ya maendeleo ya jamii mwezi Septemba.
Somali: Huduma Kenya waxay dadka deggan degmada Uasin Gishu ku wargelineysaa horumarka barnaamijyada horumarinta bulshada bishii Sebtember.
Dholuo: Huduma Kenya osemiyo jogweng' Uasin Gishu County ong'eyo dongruok mar chenro mag dongruok mag oganda e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Objective: The overarching objective of the JP is to advance food systems transformation and digital connectivity, through enhanced public ...
Kiswahili: Lengo: Lengo kuu la JP ni kuendeleza mabadiliko ya mifumo ya chakula na muunganisho wa kidijitali, kupitia uboreshaji wa umma ...
Somali: Ujeedada: Ujeeddada guud ee JP waa in la horumariyo isbeddelka nidaamyada cuntada iyo isku xirnaanta dhijitaalka ah, iyada oo loo marayo kor u qaadista ...
Dholuo: Chenro: Chenro maduong' mar riwruok mar oganda Jehova en jiwo lokruok e yore mag chiemo kod tudruok gi ji e yor digital, kokalo kuom dongruok e weche mag...

English: KTDA announces a free rabies vaccination exercise for poultry in Siaya County this November.
Kiswahili: KTDA inatangaza zoezi la bure la chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa kwa kuku katika Kaunti ya Siaya Novemba hii.
Somali: KTDA waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa jimicsi tallaal oo lacag la'aan ah oo ka dhan ah qabatinka digaagga ee degmada Siaya bisha November ee sannadkan.
Dholuo: KTDA olando chenro mar thiedho dhok maonge chudo mar rabies e dwe mar Novemba e county mar Siaya.

English: Notice: COMESA restricts movement of cattle in Narok County due to a lumpy skin disease outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ilani: COMESA inazuia harakati za ng'ombe katika Kaunti ya Narok kwa sababu ya mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa ngozi.
Somali: Ogeysiis: COMESA waxay xaddiday dhaqdhaqaaqa lo'da Gobolka Narok sababtuna tahay faafitaanka cudurka maqaarka.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: COMESA ogeng'o wuoth mar dhok e gweng' mar Narok nikech tuwono mar pien.

English: Coughing for more than two weeks? Pregnant women should get tested for TB early.
Kiswahili: Kukohoa kwa zaidi ya wiki mbili? Wanawake wajawazito wanapaswa kupimwa kifua kikuu mapema.
Somali: Haweeneyda uurka leh waxay u baahan yihiin inay horay u sameeyaan baaritaanka cudurka TB.
Dholuo: Mon ma nigi ich onego otimnegi nonro chon mondo ging'e ka be gin gi tuwo mar TB.

English: IEBC conducts a civic education forum on devolution in Mandera County this February.
Kiswahili: IEBC inafanya kongamano la elimu ya uraia juu ya ugatuzi katika Kaunti ya Mandera Februari hii.
Somali: IEBC waxay qabaneysaa madasha waxbarashada muwaadiniinta ee ku saabsan wareejinta degmada Mandera bishii Febraayo.
Dholuo: IEBC dhi nyime gi chokruok mar tiegruok mar oganda e dwe mar Februar e kaunti mar Mandera.

English: Notice from KEMSA: postnatal check-ups clinics will run every April at designated health centres in Kakamega County.
Kiswahili: Ilani kutoka KEMSA: kliniki za uchunguzi baada ya kuzaa zitafanya kazi kila Aprili katika vituo vya afya vilivyoteuliwa katika Kaunti ya Kakamega.
Somali: Ogeysiis ka yimid KEMSA: Caafimaadka baaritaanka dhalmada ka dib waxaa lagu qaban doonaa Abriil kasta xarumaha caafimaadka ee loo qoondeeyay ee Gobolka Kakamega.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar KEMSA: Klinike mag nonro bang' nyuol biro dhi nyime April ka April e kuonde thieth moyier e Kaunti mar Kakamega.

English: UNHCR Kenya: 2024 Funding Update (as of 29 February 2024)
Kiswahili: UNHCR Kenya: Taarifa ya Ufadhili ya 2024 (kuanzia tarehe 29 Februari 2024)
Somali: UNHCR Kenya: Cusboonaysiinta Maalgelinta 2024 (laga bilaabo 29 Febraayo 2024)
Dholuo: UNHCR Kenya: Loso mar Chiwo Omwom mar 2024 (chakre tarik 29 dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2024)

English: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit appeals to caregivers in Kilifi County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the March maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya - Kitengo cha Afya ya Uzazi inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kuhudhuria siku ya kliniki iliyopangwa kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Machi.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka - Qeybta caafimaadka taranka waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Kilifi inay ka qeyb galaan maalinta rugta caafimaadka ee la qorsheeyay oo qayb ka ah ololaha caafimaadka hooyada ee Maarso.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health - Reproductive Health Unit okwayo jorit e County mar Kilifi mondo odhi e klinik ma ne ochan e dwe mar Mach.

English: Kwale County: Drought Early Warning Bulletin for April 2023
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kwale: Taarifa ya Onyo la Mapema kuhusu Ukame kwa Aprili 2023
Somali: Degmada Kwale: War-saxaafadeedka Digniinta Hore ee Abaarta ee Abriil 2023
Dholuo: Kaunti mar Kwale: Oboke mar siem mapiyo mar oro dwe mar Ang'wen 2023

English: Each method of contraception has different advantages & disadvantages that need individualized preferences & medical history. Visit your nearest facility or call to discuss family planning method with a skilled health care provider. #WCD2020Ke #WCD2020 #Tujulishane
Kiswahili: Kila njia ya uzazi wa mpango ina faida na hasara tofauti ambazo zinahitaji mapendeleo ya kibinafsi na historia ya matibabu. Tembelea kituo kilicho karibu nawe au piga simu ili kujadili njia ya kupanga uzazi na mtoa huduma wa afya mwenye ujuzi. #WCD2020Ke #WCD2020 #Tujulishane
Somali: Hab kasta oo ka hortagga uurka ah wuxuu leeyahay faa'iidooyin iyo khasaarooyin kala duwan oo u baahan doorbidyo shaqsiyeed iyo taariikh caafimaad. Booqo xarunta kuugu dhow ama wac si aad ugala hadasho habka qorsheynta qoyska bixiye daryeel caafimaad oo xirfad leh. #WCD2020Ke #WCD2020 #Tujulishane

English: Division of Disease Surveillance and Response appeals to caregivers in Nyamira County to attend the scheduled clinic day as part of the January maternal health drive.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa inatoa wito kwa walezi katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kuhudhuria siku iliyopangwa ya kliniki kama sehemu ya kampeni ya afya ya uzazi ya Januari.
Somali: Qaybta Kormeerka iyo Jawaabta Cudurrada waxay ugu baaqeysaa daryeelayaasha degmada Nyamira inay ka qeybgalaan maalinta rugta caafimaadka ee la qorsheeyay ee bisha Janaayo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar Ng'iyo Kendo Duogo ne Tuwo kwayo jorit e County mar Nyamira mondo odhi e odiechieng' mar thieth ma ne otim e dwe mar Januar.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds the public that free substance abuse recovery support is available through county health facilities in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unakumbusha umma kwamba msaada wa bure wa kupona matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya unapatikana kupitia vituo vya afya vya kaunti katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Somali: Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya waxay xasuusineysaa dadweynaha in taageero bilaash ah oo dib u soo kabashada isticmaalka maandooriyaha laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka ee degmada Nyamira.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross oparo ne ji ni kony ma onge chudo mar tiyo gi yedhe mamero yudore kokalo kuom kuonde thieth e county ma Nyamira County.

English: Notice: Council of Governors will hold a public participation forum on the annual performance review in Migori County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Baraza la Gavana litafanya mkutano wa ushiriki wa umma juu ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa kila mwaka katika Kaunti ya Migori.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Golaha Guddoomiyeyaasha waxay qaban doonaan madasha ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ee dib u eegista waxqabadka sanadlaha ah ee degmada Migori.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: Bura mar Jaloch biro timo chokruok mar ji duto e wi nonro mar tich mitimo higa ka higa e kaunti mar Migori.

English: Notice: Judiciary of Kenya opens a new service point for passport services in Kwale County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Mahakama ya Kenya inafungua kituo kipya cha huduma kwa huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Kwale.
Somali: Ogeysiis: Garsoorka Kenya wuxuu furayaa xarun adeeg cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegyada baasaboorka ee Gobolka Kwale.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Bura e piny Kenya osechako tiyo gi ofis manyien mar Passport Services e county mar Kwale.

English: KEMRI reminds the public in Tharaka-Nithi County about the importance of hypertension awareness for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: KEMRI inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi juu ya umuhimu wa uhamasishaji wa shinikizo la damu kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: KEMRI waxay dadka degmada Tharaka-Nithi ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda ay leedahay wacyiga cadaadiska dhiig karka ee caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: KEMRI oparo ne ji duto e Tharaka-Nithi County kuom ber mar miyo ji ong'e ni tuwo mar hypertension en gima duong' ahinya e ngima joot.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) encourages farmers in Kericho County to register with a certified cooperative society to secure better prices for horticultural produce.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawahimiza wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kericho kujiandikisha na jumuiya ya ushirika iliyoidhinishwa ili kupata bei bora za mazao ya bustani.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa beeraleyda degmada Kericho inay iska diiwaangeliyaan shirkad iskaashi oo shahaado leh si loo helo qiimo wanaagsan oo loogu talagalay alaabada beeraha.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) jiwo jopur e county mar Kericho mondo odonj e riwruok mar jokony tich ma nigi ratiro mar chulo osuru mondo giyud nengo mabeyo mag olembe mag puodho.

English: OGP announces improved turnaround times for birth certificate processing in Wajir County.
Kiswahili: OGP inatangaza kuboresha nyakati za kugeuza kwa usindikaji wa cheti cha kuzaliwa katika Kaunti ya Wajir.
Somali: OGP waxay ku dhawaaqeysaa waqtiyo hagaagsan oo loogu talagalay ka shaqeynta shahaadada dhalashada ee Gobolka Wajir.
Dholuo: OGP olando lokruok e seche mag timo nonro mag nyasi mag nyuol e County mar Wajir.

English: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) encourages first-time voters in Mandera County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Haki ya Utawala (Ombudsman) inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.
Somali: Guddiga Caddaaladda Maamulka (Ombudsman) wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa codbixiyayaasha markii ugu horreysay ee degmada Mandera inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahintooda SMS-ka 70000.
Dholuo: Commission on Administrative Justice (Ombudsman) jiwo jogo ma okwongo yiero e county mar Mandera mondo onon weche ma gin-go kokalo kuom sms mar 70000.

English: NTSA reminds residents of Baringo County that reporting burglary promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawakumbusha wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Baringo kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka vitongoji salama.
Somali: NTSA waxay xasuusineysaa dadka deggan degmada Baringo in si dhakhso leh u soo sheegaan jabsashada ay gacan ka geysaneyso ilaalinta xaafadaha.
Dholuo: NTSA parone jogweng'o mag Baringo County ni chiwo ripot mapiyo mar kwalo odno konyo rito kuonde ma ji odakie.

English: AFA advises farmers in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility ahead of the September planting season.
Kiswahili: AFA inawashauri wakulima katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kufanya mazoezi ya mzunguko wa mazao ili kurejesha rutuba ya udongo kabla ya msimu wa upandaji wa Septemba.
Somali: AFA waxay ku talineysaa beeraleyda gobolka Elgeyo-Marakwet inay ku dhaqmaan wareegga dalagyada si loo soo celiyo dhalashada ciidda ka hor xilliga beerashada bisha Sebtember.
Dholuo: AFA nyiso jopur e county mar Elgeyo-Marakwet ni gitim lokruok e puothe mondo gidwok nyak mar lowo kapok ochopo higa mar chwoyo e dwe mar Septemba.

English: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development invites youth in Nairobi County to enroll for electrical installation training this May.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala ya Kenya inawaalika vijana katika Kaunti ya Nairobi kujiandikisha kwa mafunzo ya ufungaji wa umeme Mei hii.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu ku casuumay dhalinyarada degmada Nairobi inay isdiiwaangaliyaan tababar ku saabsan rakibidda korontada bisha May.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ogwelo rowere man Nairobi County mondo odonj e tiegruok mar keto sitima e dwe mar Mei.

English: EACC urges residents of Kisii County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: EACC inahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti ili kuunda mashauriano ya sera za umma.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kisii inay ka qaybqaataan bogga ka qaybgalka internetka ee degmada si ay u qaabeeyaan wadatashiyada siyaasadda dadweynaha.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo ji duto modak e County mar Kisii mondo oriwre gi county's online participation portal e loso chenro mag chenro mag siasa.

English: Notice: KUCCPS launches an anti-bullying measures programme in schools across Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KUCCPS yazindua mpango wa hatua za kupambana na uonevu katika shule kote Kaunti ya Kisii.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KUCCPS waxay bilawday barnaamij tallaabooyin looga hortago dhibta dugsiyada degmada Kisii.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo: KUCCPS chako chenro mar kedo gi timbe mahundu e skunde duto mag Kisii County.

English: Kenya - New influx of refugees (DG ECHO, UNHCR) (ECHO Daily Flash of 4 November 2022)
Kiswahili: Kenya - Wingi mpya wa wakimbizi (DG ECHO, UNHCR) (ECHO Daily Flash ya 4 Novemba 2022)
Somali: Kenya - Qaxooti cusub oo soo qulqulaya (DG ECHO, UNHCR) (ECHO Daily Flash ee 4 Noofambar 2022)
Dholuo: Kenya - Dhi manyien mar jolweny (DG ECHO, UNHCR)

English: Public health advisory: KEMRI warns of increased Rift Valley Fever risk in Kitui County and advises the public to complete the full recommended vaccination dose.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: KEMRI inaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya Homa ya Bonde la Ufa katika Kaunti ya Kitui na inashauri umma kukamilisha kipimo kamili cha chanjo kilichopendekezwa.
Somali: Talo-bixinta caafimaadka dadweynaha: KEMRI waxay ka digeysaa khatarta sii kordheysa ee Cudurka 'Rift Valley Fever' ee Gobolka Kitui waxayna bulshada kula talineysaa inay dhammaystiraan qiyaasta tallaalka ee lagugula talinayo.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar thieth mar oganda: KEMRI osiemo ji kuom medruok mar tuwo mar Rift Valley Fever e County mar Kitui kendo ojiwo ji duto mondo otiek dose duto mar thiedho.

English: HELB encourages residents of Kitui County to participate in the county public forum to stay informed on voter registration.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahimiza wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kitui kushiriki katika kongamano la umma la kaunti ili kuendelea kufahamishwa kuhusu usajili wa wapiga kura.
Somali: HELB waxay ku dhiiri gelineysaa dadka deggan degmada Kitui inay ka qaybgalaan madasha dadweynaha ee degmada si ay uga warqabaan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.
Dholuo: HELB jiwo jogweng' Kitui County mondo ochiwre e chokruok mar ji duto mar county mondo ging'e weche duto motudore gi kad mar josiasa.

English: NCPB urges pigs farmers in Vihiga County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office following reported Newcastle disease cases.
Kiswahili: NCPB inawahimiza wafugaji wa nguruwe katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya mifugo iliyo karibu kufuatia kesi za ugonjwa wa Newcastle zilizoripotiwa.
Somali: NCPB waxay ku boorineysaa beeraleyda doofaarka ee degmada Vihiga inay u soo sheegaan xayawaanka buka xafiiska caafimaadka xoolaha ee ugu dhow ka dib kiisaska cudurka Newcastle ee la soo sheegay.
Dholuo: NCPB jiwo jopur ma pidho anguro e county mar Vihiga mondo onyis le matuwo e ofise mar thieth machiegni gi kanyo bang' ka osenyis ni nitie tuo mar Newcastle.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) reminds the public in Laikipia County about the importance of diabetes screening for household wellbeing.
Kiswahili: SHA (Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii) inakumbusha umma katika Kaunti ya Laikipia kuhusu umuhimu wa uchunguzi wa ugonjwa wa kisukari kwa ustawi wa kaya.
Somali: SHA (Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada) waxay dadka degmada Laikipia ku xasuusineysaa muhiimadda baaritaanka sonkorowga uu u leeyahay caafimaadka qoysaska.
Dholuo: SHA (Social Health Authority) parone ji e County mar Laikipia kuom ber mar nonro mar thieth mar sukari e ngima joot.

English: Pest Control Products Board urges sorghum growers in Tharaka-Nithi County to control fall armyworm early using approved pesticides to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu inawahimiza wakulima wa mtama katika Kaunti ya Tharaka-Nithi kudhibiti minyoo ya jeshi mapema kwa kutumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa ili kuboresha mavuno msimu huu.
Somali: Guddiga Waxsoosaarka Xakamaynta cayayaanka wuxuu ku boorinayaa beeraleyda sorghum ee degmada Tharaka-Nithi inay si dhaqso leh u xakameeyaan ciidamada ciidanka xilliga dayrta iyadoo la adeegsanayo cayayaannada la ansixiyay si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka xilli ciyaareedkan.
Dholuo: Board of Pest Control Products jiwo jopur mag sorghum e County mar Tharaka-Nithi mondo oti gi yedhe makelo tuoche makelo hinyruok e kinde machuok ka gitiyo gi tuoche ma thiedho yiende mondo okony e medo nyak mar yiendgi e higani.

English: Ministry of Health announces outpatient services for residents of Kiambu County starting this January.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inatangaza huduma za wagonjwa wa nje kwa wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Kiambu kuanzia Januari hii.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa ku dhawaaqday adeegyo bukaan-socodka ah oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan degmada Kiambu laga bilaabo Janaayo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health olando ni biro yudo jotuo e kind joma odak e county mar Kiambu kochakore Januar ma kawuono.

English: Notice: KEMRI will hold a trauma counselling forum in Elgeyo-Marakwet County this April. All are welcome.
Kiswahili: Ilani: KEMRI itafanya kongamano la ushauri wa kiwewe katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet Aprili hii. Wote wanakaribishwa.
Somali: Ogeysiis: KEMRI waxay qabaneysaa madasha la talinta dhaawaca ee degmada Elgeyo-Marakwet bishii Abriil. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa.
Dholuo: Ng'e ni: KEMRI biro timo chokruok mar chiwo paro e wi tuoche e taon mar Elgeyo-Marakwet e dwe mar April.
